title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1008566
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1008566), "Gauss–Lucas theorem": roots of the derivative
-- of a nonconstant complex polynomial lie in the convex hull of its roots, with an explicit
-- center-of-mass formula for each derivative root. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Polynomial.Basic

open scoped Polynomial ComplexConjugate

namespace Polynomial

/-- The weight of a root in the center-of-mass formula for a root of the derivative. -/
noncomputable def derivRootWeight (P : ℂ[X]) (z w : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  if P.eval z = 0 then (Pi.single z 1 : ℂ → ℝ) w
  else P.rootMultiplicity w / ‖z - w‖ ^ 2

variable {P : ℂ[X]} {z : ℂ}

/-- A root of the derivative is the specified weighted center of mass of the roots. -/
theorem eq_centerMass_of_eval_derivative_eq_zero (hP : 0 < P.degree)
    (hz : P.derivative.eval z = 0) :
    z = P.roots.toFinset.centerMass (P.derivRootWeight z) id := sorry

/-- The Gauss–Lucas theorem for nonconstant complex polynomials. -/
theorem rootSet_derivative_subset_convexHull_rootSet (h₀ : 0 < P.degree) :
    P.derivative.rootSet ℂ ⊆ convexHull ℝ (P.rootSet ℂ) := sorry

end Polynomial

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1008566
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1008566), "Gauss–Lucas theorem": roots of the
  derivative of a nonconstant complex polynomial lie in the real convex hull
  of its roots, with the explicit root-multiplicity center-of-mass formula.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope R_scope.

Definition complex := (R * R)%type.
Definition cpolynomial := list complex.

Definition czero : complex := (0, 0).

Definition cadd (z w : complex) : complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition csub (z w : complex) : complex :=
  (fst z - fst w, snd z - snd w).

Definition cmul (z w : complex) : complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition cscale (r : R) (z : complex) : complex :=
  (r * fst z, r * snd z).

Definition cnorm_sq (z : complex) : R :=
  fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2.

Fixpoint poly_eval (p : cpolynomial) (z : complex) : complex :=
  match p with
  | [] => czero
  | a :: q => cadd a (cmul z (poly_eval q z))
  end.

Fixpoint poly_derivative_aux
    (p : cpolynomial) (n : nat) : cpolynomial :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: q =>
      cscale (INR n) a :: poly_derivative_aux q (S n)
  end.

Definition poly_derivative (p : cpolynomial) : cpolynomial :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | _ :: q => poly_derivative_aux q 1%nat
  end.

Fixpoint iterated_derivative
    (n : nat) (p : cpolynomial) : cpolynomial :=
  match n with
  | O => p
  | S k => poly_derivative (iterated_derivative k p)
  end.

Definition polynomial_positive_degree (p : cpolynomial) : Prop :=
  exists (n : nat) (a : complex),
    (0 < n)%nat /\
    nth_error p n = Some a /\
    a <> czero.

Definition poly_root (p : cpolynomial) (z : complex) : Prop :=
  poly_eval p z = czero.

Definition root_multiplicity
    (p : cpolynomial) (z : complex) (m : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall k : nat,
      (k < m)%nat ->
      poly_root (iterated_derivative k p) z) /\
  ~ poly_root (iterated_derivative m p) z.

Definition root_enumeration
    (p : cpolynomial) (roots : list complex) : Prop :=
  NoDup roots /\
  forall z : complex, In z roots <-> poly_root p z.

Definition deriv_root_weight_spec
    (p : cpolynomial)
    (z : complex)
    (multiplicity : complex -> nat)
    (weight : complex -> R) : Prop :=
  (poly_root p z /\
   weight z = 1 /\
   forall w : complex, w <> z -> weight w = 0) \/
  (~ poly_root p z /\
   forall w : complex,
     weight w =
       INR (multiplicity w) / cnorm_sq (csub z w)).

Fixpoint sum_root_weights
    (roots : list complex) (weight : complex -> R) : R :=
  match roots with
  | [] => 0
  | z :: rest => weight z + sum_root_weights rest weight
  end.

Fixpoint weighted_root_sum
    (roots : list complex) (weight : complex -> R) : complex :=
  match roots with
  | [] => czero
  | z :: rest =>
      cadd (cscale (weight z) z) (weighted_root_sum rest weight)
  end.

Definition center_mass
    (roots : list complex) (weight : complex -> R) : complex :=
  cscale
    (/ sum_root_weights roots weight)
    (weighted_root_sum roots weight).

Fixpoint sum_reals (weights : list R) : R :=
  match weights with
  | [] => 0
  | r :: rest => r + sum_reals rest
  end.

Fixpoint weighted_point_sum
    (points : list complex) (weights : list R) : complex :=
  match points, weights with
  | z :: points', r :: weights' =>
      cadd (cscale r z) (weighted_point_sum points' weights')
  | _, _ => czero
  end.

Definition complex_convex_hull
    (set : complex -> Prop) (z : complex) : Prop :=
  exists (points : list complex) (weights : list R),
    length points = length weights /\
    Forall set points /\
    Forall (fun r : R => 0 <= r) weights /\
    sum_reals weights = 1 /\
    z = weighted_point_sum points weights.

Theorem eq_centerMass_of_eval_derivative_eq_zero :
  forall (p : cpolynomial) (z : complex),
    polynomial_positive_degree p ->
    poly_root (poly_derivative p) z ->
    exists (roots : list complex)
           (multiplicity : complex -> nat)
           (weight : complex -> R),
      root_enumeration p roots /\
      (forall w : complex,
        root_multiplicity p w (multiplicity w)) /\
      deriv_root_weight_spec p z multiplicity weight /\
      z = center_mass roots weight.
Admitted.

Theorem rootSet_derivative_subset_convexHull_rootSet :
  forall p : cpolynomial,
    polynomial_positive_degree p ->
    forall z : complex,
      poly_root (poly_derivative p) z ->
      complex_convex_hull (poly_root p) z.
Admitted.

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1008566,
  "Gauss–Lucas theorem": every zero of the derivative of a nonconstant complex
  polynomial lies in the convex hull of its zeros, with the companion explicit
  derivative-root weighted center-of-mass identity. Polynomials use their
  finitely supported coefficient functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition gauss_lucas_support :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "gauss_lucas_support p = {n. p n \<noteq> 0}"

definition gauss_lucas_positive_degree :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "gauss_lucas_positive_degree p \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite (gauss_lucas_support p) \<and>
    (\<exists>n > 0. p n \<noteq> 0)"

definition gauss_lucas_poly_eval ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "gauss_lucas_poly_eval p z =
    (\<Sum>n\<in>gauss_lucas_support p. p n * z ^ n)"

definition gauss_lucas_pderiv ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "gauss_lucas_pderiv p n = of_nat (Suc n) * p (Suc n)"

definition gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity p w =
    (LEAST n. gauss_lucas_poly_eval ((gauss_lucas_pderiv ^^ n) p) w \<noteq> 0)"

definition gauss_lucas_root_weight ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "gauss_lucas_root_weight p z w =
    (if gauss_lucas_poly_eval p z = 0 then
       if w = z then 1 else 0
     else real (gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity p w) / norm (z - w) ^ 2)"

definition gauss_lucas_center_mass ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "gauss_lucas_center_mass p z =
    inverse
      (\<Sum>w | gauss_lucas_poly_eval p w = 0.
        gauss_lucas_root_weight p z w) *\<^sub>R
      (\<Sum>w | gauss_lucas_poly_eval p w = 0.
        gauss_lucas_root_weight p z w *\<^sub>R w)"

definition gauss_lucas_convex_hull :: "complex set \<Rightarrow> complex set" where
  "gauss_lucas_convex_hull s =
    {z. \<exists>u :: complex \<Rightarrow> real.
      finite {w. u w \<noteq> 0} \<and>
      {w. u w \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> s \<and>
      (\<forall>w. 0 \<le> u w) \<and>
      (\<Sum>w | u w \<noteq> 0. u w) = 1 \<and>
      (\<Sum>w | u w \<noteq> 0. u w *\<^sub>R w) = z}"

theorem eq_center_mass_of_poly_pderiv_eq_zero:
  fixes p :: "nat \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and z :: complex
  assumes "gauss_lucas_positive_degree p"
    and "gauss_lucas_poly_eval (gauss_lucas_pderiv p) z = 0"
  shows "z = gauss_lucas_center_mass p z"
  sorry

theorem root_set_pderiv_subset_convex_hull_root_set:
  fixes p :: "nat \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes "gauss_lucas_positive_degree p"
  shows "{z. gauss_lucas_poly_eval (gauss_lucas_pderiv p) z = 0}
    \<subseteq> gauss_lucas_convex_hull {z. gauss_lucas_poly_eval p z = 0}"
  sorry

end

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1008566,
;; "Gauss–Lucas theorem": every zero of the derivative of a nonconstant
;; complex polynomial lies in the convex hull of its zeros and equals the
;; center of mass determined by the source's derivative-root weights.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars form an arbitrary real closed ordered field. Complex numbers are
;; pairs of scalars, and polynomials are canonical coefficient lists in
;; ascending degree order. Real closed fields are elementarily equivalent, so
;; this first-order polynomial formulation is equivalent to the source theorem
;; over the real and complex numbers.
;;
;; DEFUN-SK supplies all unbounded quantifiers. A complete root multiset is an
;; internal existential witness, never an external statement parameter.
;; Repeating each root according to its multiplicity turns the source sum of
;; rootMultiplicity/||z-w||^2 over distinct roots into the equal per-occurrence
;; sum used below. Caratheodory's theorem in the real plane makes membership in
;; the convex hull equivalent to a convex combination of three roots.

(defun q1008566-add (add left right)
  (apply$ add (list left right)))

(defun q1008566-mul (mul left right)
  (apply$ mul (list left right)))

(defun q1008566-neg (neg value)
  (apply$ neg (list value)))

(defun q1008566-inv (inv value)
  (apply$ inv (list value)))

(defun q1008566-lt (lt left right)
  (apply$ lt (list left right)))

(defun q1008566-sqrt (square-root value)
  (apply$ square-root (list value)))

(defun-sk q1008566-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (apply$ carrier (list x))
      (apply$ carrier (list y))
      (apply$ carrier (list z)))
     (let* ((xy-add (q1008566-add add x y))
            (yz-add (q1008566-add add y z))
            (xy-mul (q1008566-mul mul x y))
            (yz-mul (q1008566-mul mul y z))
            (neg-x (q1008566-neg neg x))
            (inv-x (q1008566-inv inv x)))
       (and
        (apply$ carrier (list xy-add))
        (apply$ carrier (list xy-mul))
        (apply$ carrier (list neg-x))
        (apply$ carrier (list inv-x))
        (equal
         (q1008566-add add xy-add z)
         (q1008566-add add x yz-add))
        (equal
         (q1008566-mul mul xy-mul z)
         (q1008566-mul mul x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-add (q1008566-add add y x))
        (equal xy-mul (q1008566-mul mul y x))
        (equal (q1008566-add add x zero) x)
        (equal (q1008566-add add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal (q1008566-mul mul x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (q1008566-mul mul x inv-x) one))
        (equal
         (q1008566-mul mul x yz-add)
         (q1008566-add
          add
          (q1008566-mul mul x y)
          (q1008566-mul mul x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1008566-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add mul lt)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (apply$ carrier (list x))
      (apply$ carrier (list y))
      (apply$ carrier (list z)))
     (and
      (not (q1008566-lt lt x x))
      (or
       (q1008566-lt lt x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q1008566-lt lt y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1008566-lt lt x y)
        (q1008566-lt lt y z))
       (q1008566-lt lt x z))
      (implies
       (q1008566-lt lt x y)
       (q1008566-lt
        lt
        (q1008566-add add x z)
        (q1008566-add add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1008566-lt lt zero x)
        (q1008566-lt lt zero y))
       (q1008566-lt
        lt zero (q1008566-mul mul x y)))))))

(defun-sk q1008566-square-root-laws-p
    (carrier zero mul lt square-root)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (apply$ carrier (list x))
      (not (q1008566-lt lt x zero)))
     (let ((root (q1008566-sqrt square-root x)))
       (and
        (apply$ carrier (list root))
        (not (q1008566-lt lt root zero))
        (equal (q1008566-mul mul root root) x))))))

(defun q1008566-field-natural (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (q1008566-add
     add
     one
     (q1008566-field-natural (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun q1008566-real-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (equal coefficients nil)
    (and
     (apply$ carrier (list (car coefficients)))
     (q1008566-real-coefficient-list-p
      (cdr coefficients) carrier))))

(defun q1008566-real-polynomial-p
    (coefficients carrier zero)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (q1008566-real-coefficient-list-p coefficients carrier)
   (or
    (equal (len coefficients) 1)
    (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero)))))

(defun q1008566-real-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x zero add mul)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      zero
    (q1008566-add
     add
     (car coefficients)
     (q1008566-mul
      mul
      x
      (q1008566-real-polynomial-eval
       (cdr coefficients) x zero add mul)))))

(defun-sk q1008566-odd-root-laws-p
    (carrier zero add mul odd-root)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1008566-real-polynomial-p
       coefficients carrier zero)
      (evenp (len coefficients)))
     (let ((root (apply$ odd-root (list coefficients))))
       (and
        (apply$ carrier (list root))
        (equal
         (q1008566-real-polynomial-eval
          coefficients root zero add mul)
         zero))))))

(defun q1008566-real-closed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add mul neg inv lt square-root odd-root)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp mul)
   (tamep-functionp neg)
   (tamep-functionp inv)
   (tamep-functionp lt)
   (tamep-functionp square-root)
   (tamep-functionp odd-root)
   (apply$ carrier (list zero))
   (apply$ carrier (list one))
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1008566-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
   (q1008566-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add mul lt)
   (q1008566-square-root-laws-p
    carrier zero mul lt square-root)
   (q1008566-odd-root-laws-p
    carrier zero add mul odd-root)))

(defun q1008566-complex-p (z carrier)
  (and
   (consp z)
   (apply$ carrier (list (car z)))
   (apply$ carrier (list (cdr z)))))

(defun q1008566-complex-zero (zero)
  (cons zero zero))

(defun q1008566-complex-one (zero one)
  (cons one zero))

(defun q1008566-complex-add (left right add)
  (cons
   (q1008566-add add (car left) (car right))
   (q1008566-add add (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun q1008566-complex-neg (value neg)
  (cons
   (q1008566-neg neg (car value))
   (q1008566-neg neg (cdr value))))

(defun q1008566-complex-mul (left right add mul neg)
  (let ((ac (q1008566-mul mul (car left) (car right)))
        (bd (q1008566-mul mul (cdr left) (cdr right)))
        (ad (q1008566-mul mul (car left) (cdr right)))
        (bc (q1008566-mul mul (cdr left) (car right))))
    (cons
     (q1008566-add add ac (q1008566-neg neg bd))
     (q1008566-add add ad bc))))

(defun q1008566-complex-sub (left right add neg)
  (q1008566-complex-add
   left (q1008566-complex-neg right neg) add))

(defun q1008566-complex-scale (scalar value mul)
  (cons
   (q1008566-mul mul scalar (car value))
   (q1008566-mul mul scalar (cdr value))))

(defun q1008566-complex-norm-square (value add mul)
  (q1008566-add
   add
   (q1008566-mul mul (car value) (car value))
   (q1008566-mul mul (cdr value) (cdr value))))

(defun q1008566-complex-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (equal coefficients nil)
    (and
     (q1008566-complex-p (car coefficients) carrier)
     (q1008566-complex-coefficient-list-p
      (cdr coefficients) carrier))))

(defun q1008566-positive-degree-polynomial-p
    (coefficients carrier zero)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (q1008566-complex-coefficient-list-p
    coefficients carrier)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (q1008566-complex-zero zero)))))

(defun q1008566-complex-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x zero add mul neg)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (q1008566-complex-zero zero)
    (q1008566-complex-add
     (car coefficients)
     (q1008566-complex-mul
      x
      (q1008566-complex-polynomial-eval
       (cdr coefficients) x zero add mul neg)
      add mul neg)
     add)))

(defun q1008566-complex-polynomial-derivative-aux
    (coefficients index zero one add mul)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1008566-complex-scale
      (q1008566-field-natural index zero one add)
      (car coefficients)
      mul)
     (q1008566-complex-polynomial-derivative-aux
      (cdr coefficients) (+ index 1) zero one add mul))))

(defun q1008566-complex-polynomial-derivative
    (coefficients zero one add mul)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (q1008566-complex-polynomial-derivative-aux
     (cdr coefficients) 1 zero one add mul)))

(defun q1008566-complex-polynomial-add
    (left right add)
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   (t
    (cons
     (q1008566-complex-add (car left) (car right) add)
     (q1008566-complex-polynomial-add
      (cdr left) (cdr right) add)))))

(defun q1008566-complex-polynomial-scale
    (scalar coefficients add mul neg)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1008566-complex-mul
      scalar (car coefficients) add mul neg)
     (q1008566-complex-polynomial-scale
      scalar (cdr coefficients) add mul neg))))

(defun q1008566-multiply-by-linear
    (coefficients root zero add mul neg)
  (q1008566-complex-polynomial-add
   (q1008566-complex-polynomial-scale
    (q1008566-complex-neg root neg)
    coefficients add mul neg)
   (cons (q1008566-complex-zero zero) coefficients)
   add))

(defun q1008566-root-product
    (roots zero one add mul neg)
  (if (endp roots)
      (list (q1008566-complex-one zero one))
    (q1008566-multiply-by-linear
     (q1008566-root-product
      (cdr roots) zero one add mul neg)
     (car roots)
     zero add mul neg)))

(defun q1008566-roots-p (roots carrier)
  (if (endp roots)
      (equal roots nil)
    (and
     (q1008566-complex-p (car roots) carrier)
     (q1008566-roots-p (cdr roots) carrier))))

(defun q1008566-factorization-p
    (coefficients roots carrier zero one add mul neg)
  (and
   (true-listp roots)
   (equal (len roots) (- (len coefficients) 1))
   (q1008566-roots-p roots carrier)
   (equal
    (q1008566-complex-polynomial-scale
     (car (last coefficients))
     (q1008566-root-product
      roots zero one add mul neg)
     add mul neg)
    coefficients)))

(defun q1008566-root-weight
    (root coefficients z zero one add mul neg inv)
  (if
      (equal
       (q1008566-complex-polynomial-eval
        coefficients z zero add mul neg)
       (q1008566-complex-zero zero))
      (if (equal root z) one zero)
    (q1008566-inv
     inv
     (q1008566-complex-norm-square
      (q1008566-complex-sub z root add neg)
      add mul))))

(defun q1008566-root-weight-sum
    (roots coefficients z zero one add mul neg inv)
  (if (endp roots)
      zero
    (q1008566-add
     add
     (q1008566-root-weight
      (car roots) coefficients z
      zero one add mul neg inv)
     (q1008566-root-weight-sum
      (cdr roots) coefficients z
      zero one add mul neg inv))))

(defun q1008566-weighted-root-sum
    (roots coefficients z zero one add mul neg inv)
  (if (endp roots)
      (q1008566-complex-zero zero)
    (q1008566-complex-add
     (q1008566-complex-scale
      (q1008566-root-weight
       (car roots) coefficients z
       zero one add mul neg inv)
      (car roots)
      mul)
     (q1008566-weighted-root-sum
      (cdr roots) coefficients z
      zero one add mul neg inv)
     add)))

(defun q1008566-center-mass-equality-p
    (roots coefficients z zero one add mul neg inv)
  (let ((total
         (q1008566-root-weight-sum
          roots coefficients z
          zero one add mul neg inv))
        (weighted-sum
         (q1008566-weighted-root-sum
          roots coefficients z
          zero one add mul neg inv)))
    (equal
     z
     (q1008566-complex-scale
      (q1008566-inv inv total)
      weighted-sum
      mul))))

(defun-sk q1008566-center-mass-statement-p
    (coefficients z carrier zero one add mul neg inv)
  (exists (roots)
    (and
     (q1008566-factorization-p
      coefficients roots carrier
      zero one add mul neg)
     (q1008566-center-mass-equality-p
      roots coefficients z
      zero one add mul neg inv))))

(defun q1008566-polynomial-root-p
    (root coefficients carrier zero add mul neg)
  (and
   (q1008566-complex-p root carrier)
   (equal
    (q1008566-complex-polynomial-eval
     coefficients root zero add mul neg)
    (q1008566-complex-zero zero))))

(defun q1008566-convex-witness-p
    (root1 root2 root3 weight1 weight2 weight3

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1008566
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1008566), "Gauss–Lucas theorem": the zeros of
-- the derivative of a nonconstant complex polynomial lie in the real convex
-- hull of its zeros, with the indexed center-of-mass formula stated
-- explicitly. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Bottom

_≠_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≠ y = Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_ {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

data Dec (A : Set) : Set where
  yes : A → Dec A
  no  : Not A → Dec A

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR inverseR : R → R
    lessOrEqualR : R → R → Set
    fromNatR : Nat → R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR ≡ zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zeroR →
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y z →
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR × (zeroR ≠ oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero ≡ zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (suc n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat (λ n → lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R (λ upper → (x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexFromReal :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Complex R
complexFromReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexAdd reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex (addR reals a c) (addR reals b d)

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexNegate reals (complex a b) =
  complex (negateR reals a) (negateR reals b)

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (negateR reals (multiplyR reals b d)))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

complexScale :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexScale reals scalar (complex a b) =
  complex
    (multiplyR reals scalar a)
    (multiplyR reals scalar b)

normSquared :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  R
normSquared reals (complex a b) =
  addR reals
    (multiplyR reals a a)
    (multiplyR reals b b)

divideR :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  R →
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

Polynomial : Set → Set
Polynomial R = List (Complex R)

coefficient :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Nat →
  Complex R
coefficient reals [] n =
  complexZero reals
coefficient reals (a ∷ coefficients) zero =
  a
coefficient reals (a ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient reals coefficients n

PolynomialEqual :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R →
  Set
PolynomialEqual reals p q =
  (n : Nat) →
  coefficient reals p n ≡ coefficient reals q n

evaluate :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
evaluate reals [] z =
  complexZero reals
evaluate reals (a ∷ coefficients) z =
  complexAdd reals a
    (complexMultiply reals z (evaluate reals coefficients z))

addPolynomial :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
addPolynomial reals [] q =
  q
addPolynomial reals p [] =
  p
addPolynomial reals (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
  complexAdd reals a b ∷ addPolynomial reals p q

scalePolynomial :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
scalePolynomial reals scalar [] =
  []
scalePolynomial reals scalar (a ∷ p) =
  complexMultiply reals scalar a ∷ scalePolynomial reals scalar p

multiplyPolynomial :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
multiplyPolynomial reals [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomial reals (a ∷ p) q =
  addPolynomial reals
    (scalePolynomial reals a q)
    (complexZero reals ∷ multiplyPolynomial reals p q)

onePolynomial :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R
onePolynomial reals =
  complexOne reals ∷ []

linearFactor :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Polynomial R
linearFactor reals z =
  complexNegate reals z ∷ complexOne reals ∷ []

powerPolynomial :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Nat →
  Polynomial R
powerPolynomial reals p zero =
  onePolynomial reals
powerPolynomial reals p (suc n) =
  multiplyPolynomial reals p (powerPolynomial reals p n)

differentiateFrom :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Nat →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
differentiateFrom reals n [] =
  []
differentiateFrom reals n (a ∷ p) =
  complexScale reals (fromNatR reals n) a
  ∷ differentiateFrom reals (suc n) p

derivative :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
derivative reals [] =
  []
derivative reals (a ∷ p) =
  differentiateFrom reals (suc zero) p

data HasNonzeroCoefficient
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Polynomial R → Set where

  here :
    {a : Complex R} {p : Polynomial R} →
    a ≠ complexZero reals →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient reals (a ∷ p)

  there :
    {a : Complex R} {p : Polynomial R} →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient reals p →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient reals (a ∷ p)

Nonconstant :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Set
Nonconstant reals [] =
  Bottom
Nonconstant reals (a ∷ p) =
  HasNonzeroCoefficient reals p

PolynomialNonzero :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Set
PolynomialNonzero reals p =
  Not (PolynomialEqual reals p [])

IsRoot :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Complex R →
  Set
IsRoot reals p z =
  evaluate reals p z ≡ complexZero reals

Divides :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R →
  Set
Divides {R} reals divisor dividend =
  Σ (Polynomial R)
    (λ quotient →
      PolynomialEqual reals dividend
        (multiplyPolynomial reals divisor quotient))

ExactRootMultiplicity :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Polynomial R →
  Complex R →
  Nat →
  Set
ExactRootMultiplicity reals p z n =
  Divides reals
    (powerPolynomial reals (linearFactor reals z) n)
    p
  ×
  Not
    (Divides reals
      (powerPolynomial reals (linearFactor reals z) (suc n))
      p)

data Member {A : Set} (x : A) : List A → Set where
  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)
  in-tail :
    {y : A} {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates {A : Set} : List A → Set where
  empty :
    NoDuplicates []
  prepend :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} →
    Not (Member x xs) →
    NoDuplicates xs →
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

record ComplexPolynomialRootData
  (R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set₁ where

  field
    decide-complex-equality :
      (z w : Complex R) →
      Dec (z ≡ w)

    rootSupport :
      Polynomial R →
      List (Complex R)

    rootSupport-no-duplicates :
      (p : Polynomial R) →
      PolynomialNonzero reals p →
      NoDuplicates (rootSupport p)

    rootSupport-sound :
      (p : Polynomial R) →
      PolynomialNonzero reals p →
      (z : Complex R) →
      Member z (rootSupport p) →
      IsRoot reals p z

    rootSupport-complete :
      (p : Polynomial R) →
      PolynomialNonzero reals p →
      (z : Complex R) →
      IsRoot reals p z →
      Member z (rootSupport p)

    rootMultiplicity :
      Polynomial R →
      Complex R →
      Nat

    rootMultiplicity-correct :
      (p : Polynomial R) →
      PolynomialNonzero reals p →
      (z : Complex R) →
      ExactRootMultiplicity reals p z (rootMultiplicity p z)

open ComplexPolynomialRootData

singleWeight :
  {R : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  ComplexPolynomialRootData R reals →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  R
singleWeight reals roots z w
  with decide-complex-equality roots w z
... | yes equality =
  oneR reals
... | no inequality =
  zeroR reals

derivRootWeight :
  {R : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (roots : ComplexPolynomialRootData R reals) →
  Polynomial R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  R
derivRootWeight reals roots p z w
  with decide-complex-equality roots
    (evaluate reals p z)
    (complexZero reals)
... | yes evaluation-is-zero =
  singleWeight reals roots z w
... | no evaluation-is-nonzero =
  divideR reals
    (fromNatR reals (rootMultiplicity roots p w))
    (normSquared reals (complexSubtract reals z w))

sumWeights :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  List R →
  R
sumWeights reals [] =
  zeroR reals
sumWeights reals (weight ∷ weights) =
  addR reals weight (sumWeights reals weights)

weightsOn :
  {R : Set} →
  (Complex R → R) →
  List (Complex R) →
  List R
weightsOn weight [] =
  []
weightsOn weight (z ∷ points) =
  weight z ∷ weightsOn weight points

weightedSum :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  List (Complex R) →
  List R →
  Complex R
weightedSum reals [] weights =
  complexZero reals
weightedSum reals points [] =
  complexZero reals
weightedSum reals (z ∷ points) (weight ∷ weights) =
  complexAdd reals
    (complexScale reals weight z)
    (weightedSum reals points weights)

centerMass :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  List (Complex R) →
  (Complex R → R) →
  Complex R
centerMass reals points weight =
  complexScale reals
    (inverseR reals (sumWeights reals (weightsOn weight points)))
    (weightedSum reals points (weightsOn weight points))

data ConvexTerms
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (S : Complex R → Set) :
  List (Complex R) →
  List R →
  Set where

  no-terms :
    ConvexTerms reals S [] []

  add-term :
    {z : Complex R} {points : List (Complex R)}
    {weight : R} {weights : List R} →
    S z →
    lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) weight →
    ConvexTerms reals S points weights →
    ConvexTerms reals S (z ∷ points) (weight ∷ weights)

ConvexHull :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  (Complex R → Set) →
  Complex R →
  Set
ConvexHull {R} reals S z =
  Σ (List (Complex R))
    (λ points →
      Σ (List R)
        (λ weights →
          ConvexTerms reals S points weights
          ×
          ((sumWeights reals weights ≡ oneR reals)
          ×
          (weightedSum reals points weights ≡ z))))

eq-centerMass-of-eval-derivative-eq-zero : Set₁
eq-centerMass-of-eval-derivative-eq-zero =
  (R : Set) →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (roots : ComplexPolynomialRootData R reals) →
  (p : Polynomial R) →
  Nonconstant reals p →
  (z : Complex R) →
  IsRoot reals (derivative reals p) z →
  z ≡
    centerMass reals
      (rootSupport roots p)
      (derivRootWeight reals roots p z)

rootSet-derivative-subset-convexHull-rootSet : Set₁
rootSet-derivative-subset-convexHull-rootSet =
  (R : Set) →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (p : Polynomial R) →
  Nonconstant reals p →
  (z : Complex R) →
  IsRoot reals (derivative reals p) z →
  ConvexHull reals (IsRoot reals p) z

gauss-lucas-theorem : Set₁
gauss-lucas-theorem =
  eq-centerMass-of-eval-derivative-eq-zero
  ×
  rootSet-derivative-subset-convexHull-rootSet

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1008566, "Gauss–Lucas theorem": roots of the derivative of a positive-degree
  complex polynomial lie in the real convex hull of its roots, with the
  source's explicit root-multiplicity center-of-mass formula. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val gauss_lucas_poly_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_poly_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_poly (P : complex list) <=>
      P = [] \/ LAST P <> 0``);

val gauss_lucas_degree_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_degree_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_degree (P : complex list) =
      PRE (LENGTH P)``);

val gauss_lucas_eval_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_eval_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_eval (P : complex list) (z : complex) =
      FOLDR (\a acc. a + acc * z) 0 P``);

val gauss_lucas_derivative_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_derivative_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_derivative (P : complex list) =
      GENLIST
        (\k.
           complex_of_real (real_of_num (SUC k)) *
           EL (SUC k) P)
        (PRE (LENGTH P))``);

val gauss_lucas_root_set_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_root_set_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_root_set (P : complex list) =
      {z : complex | gauss_lucas_eval P z = 0}``);

val gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity
      (P : complex list) (w : complex) =
      MAX_SET
        {n : num |
           ?Q : complex list.
             !z : complex.
               gauss_lucas_eval P z =
               (z - w) pow n * gauss_lucas_eval Q z}``);

val gauss_lucas_real_sum_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_real_sum_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_real_sum (f : complex -> real) (s : complex -> bool) =
      ITSET (\z acc. f z + acc) s 0``);

val gauss_lucas_complex_sum_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_complex_sum_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_complex_sum
      (f : complex -> complex) (s : complex -> bool) =
      ITSET (\z acc. f z + acc) s 0``);

val gauss_lucas_deriv_root_weight_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_deriv_root_weight_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_deriv_root_weight
      (P : complex list) (z : complex) (w : complex) : real =
      if gauss_lucas_eval P z = 0 then
        if w = z then 1 else 0
      else
        real_of_num (gauss_lucas_root_multiplicity P w) /
        modu (z - w) pow 2``);

val gauss_lucas_center_mass_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_center_mass_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_center_mass (P : complex list) (z : complex) =
      complex_scalar_lmul
        (inv
          (gauss_lucas_real_sum
            (gauss_lucas_deriv_root_weight P z)
            (gauss_lucas_root_set P)))
        (gauss_lucas_complex_sum
          (\w.
             complex_scalar_lmul
               (gauss_lucas_deriv_root_weight P z w)
               w)
          (gauss_lucas_root_set P))``);

val gauss_lucas_in_convex_hull_def = new_definition (
  "gauss_lucas_in_convex_hull_def",
  ``gauss_lucas_in_convex_hull
      (s : complex -> bool) (z : complex) <=>
      ?t : complex -> bool. ?a : complex -> real.
        FINITE t /\
        t SUBSET s /\
        (!w. w IN t ==> 0 <= a w) /\
        gauss_lucas_real_sum a t = 1 /\
        z =
          gauss_lucas_complex_sum
            (\w. complex_scalar_lmul (a w) w)
            t``);

val Polynomial_eq_centerMass_of_eval_derivative_eq_zero =
  ``!P : complex list. !z : complex.
      gauss_lucas_poly P /\
      0 < gauss_lucas_degree P /\
      gauss_lucas_eval (gauss_lucas_derivative P) z = 0
      ==>
      z = gauss_lucas_center_mass P z``;

val Polynomial_rootSet_derivative_subset_convexHull_rootSet =
  ``!P : complex list.
      gauss_lucas_poly P /\
      0 < gauss_lucas_degree P
      ==>
      gauss_lucas_root_set (gauss_lucas_derivative P)
      SUBSET
      {z : complex |
         gauss_lucas_in_convex_hull
           (gauss_lucas_root_set P)
           z}``;

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1008566
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1008566), "Gauss-Lucas theorem": every
  critical point of a nonconstant complex polynomial lies in the real convex
  hull of its complex roots, with the corresponding root-weighted

$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  QGLRoots is the set of complex roots of a SetMM complex polynomial
  function. QGLConvex expresses convexity over the real scalars on the complex
  plane, and QGLHull is the intersection of all such convex supersets.

  QGLCompleteRoots(P,r) says that r lists all roots of P with multiplicity:
  P is a nonzero leading constant times the product of the linear factors
  indexed from 1 through deg(P). QGLMultiplicity counts occurrences of a
  given root in that list. QGLWeight is exactly the source weight: a delta
  weight when the critical point is a root, and otherwise root multiplicity
  divided by squared distance. QGLCenter sums these weights once over each
  distinct root, matching roots.toFinset.centerMass.

  The two final unproved $a assertions render the two Lean declarations. The
  complete-root enumeration and leading coefficient remain internally
  quantified. SetMM's first complex derivative of a polynomial function is
  its formal polynomial derivative, and no finiteness restriction is placed
  on the ambient complex domain.
$)

$c QGLRoots QGLConvex QGLHull QGLCompleteRoots QGLMultiplicity
   QGLWeight QGLCenter $.

qgl-roots-syntax $a class ( QGLRoots A ) $.
qgl-convex-syntax $a wff ( QGLConvex A ) $.
qgl-hull-syntax $a class ( QGLHull A ) $.
qgl-complete-roots-syntax $a wff ( QGLCompleteRoots A B ) $.
qgl-multiplicity-syntax $a class ( QGLMultiplicity A B C ) $.
qgl-weight-syntax $a class ( QGLWeight A B C D ) $.
qgl-center-syntax $a wff ( QGLCenter A B C ) $.

${
  $d A x $.

  qgl-roots-definition $a |- ( QGLRoots A ) =
    { x e. CC | ( A ` x ) = 0 }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A t x y $.

  qgl-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( QGLConvex A )
    <->
    (
      A C_ CC
      /\
      A. x e. A
        A. y e. A
          A. t e. RR
            (
              (
                0 <_ t
                /\
                t <_ 1
              )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( ( 1 - t ) x. x )
                  +
                  ( t x. y )
                )
                e. A
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A s $.

  qgl-hull-definition $a |- ( QGLHull A ) =
    |^| { s e. ~P CC | ( A C_ s /\ ( QGLConvex s ) ) }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B a i x $.

  qgl-complete-roots-definition $a |- (
    ( QGLCompleteRoots A B )
    <->
    E. a e. ( CC \ { 0 } )
      A. x e. CC
        ( A ` x )
        =
        (
          a
          x.
          prod_ i e. ( 1 ... ( deg ` A ) )
            ( x - ( B ` i ) )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A C D i $.

  qgl-multiplicity-definition $a |- ( QGLMultiplicity A C D ) =
    ( # ` { i e. ( 1 ... ( deg ` A ) ) | ( C ` i ) = D } )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D $.

  qgl-weight-definition $a |- ( QGLWeight A B C D ) =
    if (
      ( A ` B ) = 0
      ,
      if ( D = B , 1 , 0 )
      ,
      (
        ( QGLMultiplicity A C D )
        /
        ( ( abs ` ( B - D ) ) ^ 2 )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B C w $.

  qgl-center-definition $a |- (
    ( QGLCenter A B C )
    <->
    B
    =
    (
      (
        1
        /
        sum_ w e. ( QGLRoots A )
          ( QGLWeight A B C w )
      )
      x.
      (
        sum_ w e. ( QGLRoots A )
          (
            ( QGLWeight A B C w )
            x.
            w
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d P r z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1008566-center-mass $a |-
    A. P e. ( Poly ` CC )
      A. z e. CC
        (
          (
            0 < ( deg ` P )
            /\
            ( ( ( CC Dn P ) ` 1 ) ` z ) = 0
          )
          ->
          E. r e. ( CC ^m ( 1 ... ( deg ` P ) ) )
            (
              ( QGLCompleteRoots P r )
              /\
              ( QGLCenter P z r )
            )
        )
  $.
$}

${
  $d P z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1008566-gauss-lucas $a |-
    A. P e. ( Poly ` CC )
      (
        0 < ( deg ` P )
        ->
        A. z e. CC
          (
            ( ( ( CC Dn P ) ` 1 ) ` z ) = 0
            ->
            z e. ( QGLHull ( QGLRoots P ) )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q1008566_gauss_lucas_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1008566,
% "Gauss–Lucas theorem": the derivative roots of a nonconstant complex
% polynomial lie in the convex hull of its roots, with the corresponding
% root-multiplicity center-of-mass identity. This file contains no proof.

gauss_lucas_theorem_Q1008566: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  root_enumeration: TYPE =
    [# roots: complex_sequence, root_count: nat #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) - real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) - imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_scale(scalar: real, z: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := scalar * real_part(z),
       imag_part := scalar * imag_part(z) #)

  complex_norm_squared(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          polynomial_value(coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            coefficients(index),
            complex_power(z, index)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_derivative_value(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count <= 1 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          polynomial_derivative_value(
            coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            complex_scale(index :: real, coefficients(index)),
            complex_power(z, index - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  exact_positive_degree(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat): bool =
    0 < degree
      AND coefficients(degree) /= complex_zero

  polynomial_root(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      z: complex): bool =
    polynomial_value(coefficients, z, degree + 1) = complex_zero

  derivative_root(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      z: complex): bool =
    polynomial_derivative_value(
      coefficients, z, degree + 1) = complex_zero

  has_root_multiplicity(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      root: complex,
      multiplicity: nat): bool =
    EXISTS
        (quotient: complex_sequence),
        (quotient_count: nat):
      polynomial_value(quotient, root, quotient_count)
          /= complex_zero
        AND FORALL (z: complex):
          polynomial_value(coefficients, z, degree + 1)
            = complex_mul(
                complex_power(
                  complex_sub(z, root), multiplicity),
                polynomial_value(
                  quotient, z, quotient_count))

  root_multiplicity_assignment: TYPE = [complex -> nat]

  has_root_multiplicities(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      multiplicities: root_multiplicity_assignment): bool =
    FORALL (root: complex):
      polynomial_root(coefficients, degree, root)
      IMPLIES
        has_root_multiplicity(
          coefficients,
          degree,
          root,
          multiplicities(root))

  enumerates_distinct_roots(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      enumeration: root_enumeration): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index < root_count(enumeration) IMPLIES
        polynomial_root(
          coefficients, degree, roots(enumeration)(index)))
      AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      left < root_count(enumeration)
        AND right < root_count(enumeration)
        AND roots(enumeration)(left)
          = roots(enumeration)(right)
      IMPLIES left = right)
      AND
    (FORALL (root: complex):
      polynomial_root(coefficients, degree, root) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (index: nat):
          index < root_count(enumeration)
            AND roots(enumeration)(index) = root)

  deriv_root_weight(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      multiplicities: root_multiplicity_assignment,
      z, root: complex): real =
    IF polynomial_root(coefficients, degree, z) THEN
      IF root = z THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ELSE
      safe_div(
        multiplicities(root) :: real,
        complex_norm_squared(complex_sub(z, root)))
    ENDIF

  sum_deriv_root_weights(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      z: complex,
      enumeration: root_enumeration,
      multiplicities: root_multiplicity_assignment,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_deriv_root_weights(
        coefficients,
        degree,
        z,
        enumeration,
        multiplicities,
        count - 1)
        + deriv_root_weight(
            coefficients,
            degree,
            multiplicities,
            z,
            roots(enumeration)(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  weighted_deriv_root_sum(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      z: complex,
      enumeration: root_enumeration,
      multiplicities: root_multiplicity_assignment,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        weighted_deriv_root_sum(
          coefficients,
          degree,
          z,
          enumeration,
          multiplicities,
          count - 1),
        complex_scale(
          deriv_root_weight(
            coefficients,
            degree,
            multiplicities,
            z,
            roots(enumeration)(count - 1)),
          roots(enumeration)(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  deriv_root_center_mass(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      z: complex,
      enumeration: root_enumeration,
      multiplicities: root_multiplicity_assignment): complex =
    complex_scale(
      safe_div(
        1,
        sum_deriv_root_weights(
          coefficients,
          degree,
          z,
          enumeration,
          multiplicities,
          root_count(enumeration))),
      weighted_deriv_root_sum(
        coefficients,
        degree,
        z,
        enumeration,
        multiplicities,
          root_count(enumeration)))

  sum_weights(
      weights: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      sum_weights(weights, count - 1) + weights(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  weighted_point_sum(
      points: complex_sequence,
      weights: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        weighted_point_sum(points, weights, count - 1),
        complex_scale(
          weights(count - 1), points(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  in_convex_hull_of_roots(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      degree: nat,
      z: complex): bool =
    EXISTS
        (points: complex_sequence),
        (weights: real_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          polynomial_root(
            coefficients, degree, points(index))
            AND 0 <= weights(index))
        AND sum_weights(weights, count) = 1
        AND weighted_point_sum(points, weights, count) = z

  eq_center_mass_of_eval_derivative_eq_zero: bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: complex_sequence),
        (degree: nat),
        (z: complex):
      (exact_positive_degree(coefficients, degree)
        AND derivative_root(coefficients, degree, z))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (enumeration: root_enumeration),
            (multiplicities: root_multiplicity_assignment):
          enumerates_distinct_roots(
            coefficients, degree, enumeration)
            AND has_root_multiplicities(
              coefficients, degree, multiplicities)
            AND z =
              deriv_root_center_mass(
                coefficients,
                degree,
                z,
                enumeration,
                multiplicities)

  root_set_derivative_subset_convex_hull_root_set: bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: complex_sequence),
        (degree: nat):
      exact_positive_degree(coefficients, degree)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (z: complex):
          derivative_root(coefficients, degree, z)
          IMPLIES
            in_convex_hull_of_roots(
              coefficients, degree, z)
END gauss_lucas_theorem_Q1008566

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1032886), "Hales–Jewett theorem": for every

module

@[expose] public section

/-- The Hales–Jewett theorem for arbitrary finite alphabet and color types. -/
theorem hales_jewett_statement (α : Type u) [Finite α] (κ : Type v) [Finite κ] :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι), ∀ C : (ι → α) → κ,

title: Q1032886_hales_jewett_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1032886
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1032886), "Hales–Jewett theorem": for every
  finite alphabet and finite set of colors, some finite-dimensional word
  space has a monochromatic nondegenerate combinatorial line.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.

Record FiniteWitness (A : Type) : Type := {
  finite_enumeration : list A;
  finite_enumeration_complete :
    forall x : A, In x finite_enumeration
}.

Record CombinatorialLine (A I : Type) : Type := {
  line_coordinates : I -> option A;
  line_nondegenerate :
    exists i : I, line_coordinates i = None
}.

Definition line_word
    {A I : Type} (line : CombinatorialLine A I) (x : A) (i : I) : A :=
  match @line_coordinates A I line i with
  | Some a => a
  | None => x
  end.

Theorem hales_jewett_theorem :
  forall (A K : Type),
    FiniteWitness A ->
    FiniteWitness K ->
    exists (I : Type),
      exists _ : FiniteWitness I,
        forall coloring : (I -> A) -> K,
          exists line : CombinatorialLine A I,
            exists color : K,
              forall x : A, coloring (line_word line x) = color.
Admitted.

title: Q1032886_hales_jewett_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1032886
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1032886), "Hales–Jewett theorem": for every
  finite alphabet and finite color set, every coloring of sufficiently
  high-dimensional words has a monochromatic combinatorial line. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1032886_hales_jewett_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1032886_words ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "q1032886_words alphabet n =
    {w. length w = n \<and> set w \<subseteq> alphabet}"

definition q1032886_line_word ::
    "'a option list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "q1032886_line_word pattern x =
    map (\<lambda>entry. case entry of None \<Rightarrow> x | Some a \<Rightarrow> a) pattern"

definition q1032886_line ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1032886_line alphabet n pattern \<longleftrightarrow>
    length pattern = n \<and>
    None \<in> set pattern \<and>
    set pattern \<subseteq> insert None (Some ` alphabet)"

definition q1032886_coloring ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'c set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      ('a list \<times> 'c) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1032886_coloring alphabet colors n C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>w \<in> q1032886_words alphabet n.
      \<exists>!c. c \<in> colors \<and> (w, c) \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>w c. (w, c) \<in> C \<longrightarrow>
      w \<in> q1032886_words alphabet n \<and> c \<in> colors)"

theorem q1032886_hales_jewett:
  fixes alphabet :: "'a set"
    and colors :: "'c set"
  assumes finite_alphabet: "finite alphabet"
    and finite_colors: "finite colors"
  shows "\<exists>n. \<forall>C :: ('a list \<times> 'c) set.
    q1032886_coloring alphabet colors n C \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>pattern c.
        q1032886_line alphabet n pattern \<and>
        c \<in> colors \<and>
        (\<forall>x \<in> alphabet. (q1032886_line_word pattern x, c) \<in> C))"
  sorry

end

let Q1032886_HALES_JEWETT_THEOREM =
  `let valid_word =
     \(alphabet:A->bool) (n:num) (w:A list).
       LENGTH w = n /\
       (!x:A. MEM x w ==> x IN alphabet) in
   let valid_line =
     \(alphabet:A->bool) (n:num) (pattern:(A option)list).

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1032886,
;; "Hales–Jewett theorem": for every finite alphabet and finite color type,
;; some finite-dimensional word space has a nondegenerate monochromatic
;; combinatorial line under every coloring. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A finite type is transported to the canonical natural-number carrier of
;; its cardinality. Thus ALPHABET-SIZE, COLOR-COUNT, and DIMENSION represent
;; the source finite types alpha, kappa, and iota up to equivalence.
;;
;; A word in alpha^iota is its base-ALPHABET-SIZE digit list. A coloring is
;; the table of its values on all such words, in base-code order. This is a
;; bijective representation of the complete finite function space, including
;; the empty-type cases.

(defun q1032886-color-list-p (colors color-count)
  (if (consp colors)
      (and
       (natp (car colors))
       (< (car colors) color-count)
       (q1032886-color-list-p
        (cdr colors) color-count))
    (equal colors nil)))

(defun q1032886-coloring-p
    (coloring dimension alphabet-size color-count)
  (and
   (true-listp coloring)
   (equal
    (len coloring)
    (expt alphabet-size dimension))
   (q1032886-color-list-p coloring color-count)))

;; A line pattern has one entry per coordinate. Entries below ALPHABET-SIZE
;; are constants; the entry equal to ALPHABET-SIZE is the variable coordinate
;; marker. Requiring that marker to occur is exactly Line.proper.

(defun q1032886-pattern-entry-list-p
    (pattern alphabet-size)
  (if (consp pattern)
      (and
       (natp (car pattern))
       (<= (car pattern) alphabet-size)
       (q1032886-pattern-entry-list-p
        (cdr pattern) alphabet-size))
    (equal pattern nil)))

(defun q1032886-line-pattern-p
    (pattern dimension alphabet-size)
  (and
   (true-listp pattern)
   (equal (len pattern) dimension)
   (q1032886-pattern-entry-list-p
    pattern alphabet-size)
   (member-equal alphabet-size pattern)))

;; The first pattern entry is the least-significant base digit. Substituting
;; SYMBOL at every variable marker gives the exact word on the line.

(defun q1032886-line-word-index
    (pattern symbol alphabet-size)
  (if (consp pattern)
      (+
       (if (equal (car pattern) alphabet-size)
           symbol
         (car pattern))
       (* alphabet-size
          (q1032886-line-word-index
           (cdr pattern) symbol alphabet-size)))
    0))

(defun q1032886-all-symbols-have-color-p
    (remaining pattern alphabet-size coloring color)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      t
    (let* ((symbol (- remaining 1))
           (word-index
            (q1032886-line-word-index
             pattern symbol alphabet-size)))
      (and
       (equal (nth word-index coloring) color)
       (q1032886-all-symbols-have-color-p
        (- remaining 1)
        pattern alphabet-size coloring color)))))

(defun q1032886-monochromatic-line-witness-p
    (dimension alphabet-size color-count
               coloring pattern color)
  (and
   (q1032886-line-pattern-p
    pattern dimension alphabet-size)
   (natp color)
   (< color color-count)
   (q1032886-all-symbols-have-color-p
    alphabet-size pattern alphabet-size coloring color)))

;; These three predicates retain the source quantifier order:
;;   exists dimension, forall colorings, exists line, exists color.

(defun-sk q1032886-coloring-has-monochromatic-line-p
    (dimension alphabet-size color-count coloring)
  (exists (pattern color)
    (q1032886-monochromatic-line-witness-p
     dimension alphabet-size color-count
     coloring pattern color)))

(defun-sk q1032886-dimension-works-p
    (dimension alphabet-size color-count)
  (forall (coloring)
    (implies
     (q1032886-coloring-p
      coloring dimension alphabet-size color-count)
     (q1032886-coloring-has-monochromatic-line-p
      dimension alphabet-size color-count coloring))))

(defun-sk q1032886-good-dimension-exists-p
    (alphabet-size color-count)
  (exists (dimension)
    (and
     (natp dimension)
     (q1032886-dimension-works-p
      dimension alphabet-size color-count))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1032886-hales-jewett-statement
    (alphabet-size color-count)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp alphabet-size)
    (natp color-count))
   (q1032886-good-dimension-exists-p
    alphabet-size color-count)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1032886,
-- "Hales–Jewett theorem": every finite coloring of sufficiently high-dimensional
-- words over a finite alphabet has a monochromatic combinatorial line.
-- This file contains no proof.

module Q1032886_hales_jewett_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

FiniteType :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
FiniteType A =
  Σ Nat (λ cardinality → Bijection A (Fin cardinality))

data Maybe
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  nothing : Maybe A
  just    : A → Maybe A

record Line
  {a i : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (a ⊔ i) where

  field
    index-word :
      I →
      Maybe A
    proper :
      Σ I (λ coordinate → index-word coordinate ≡ nothing)

open Line

line-point :
  {a i : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {I : Set i} →
  Line A I →
  A →
  I →
  A
line-point line letter coordinate
  with index-word line coordinate
... | nothing = letter
... | just fixed-letter = fixed-letter

Monochromatic :
  {a i k : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {K : Set k} →
  ((I → A) → K) →
  Line A I →
  Set (a ⊔ k)
Monochromatic {A = A} {K = K} coloring line =
  Σ K
    (λ color →
      (letter : A) →
      coloring (line-point line letter) ≡ color)

hales-jewett-theorem :
  {a k : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ k))
hales-jewett-theorem {a} {k} =
  (A : Set a) →
  FiniteType A →
  (K : Set k) →
  FiniteType K →
  Σ Set
    (λ I →
      FiniteType I
      ×
      ((coloring : (I → A) → K) →
        Σ (Line A I)
          (λ line → Monochromatic coloring line)))

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1032886,
% "Hales-Jewett theorem": every finite alphabet and finite color set admits
% a finite dimension in which every coloring has a monochromatic
% combinatorial line. This file contains no proof.

hales_jewett_theorem_Q1032886[Alpha, Kappa: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  coordinate(n: nat): TYPE = below(n)
  word(n: nat): TYPE = [coordinate(n) -> Alpha]
  coloring(n: nat): TYPE = [word(n) -> Kappa]
  line(n: nat): TYPE = [coordinate(n) -> lift[Alpha]]

  proper_line(n: nat)(ell: line(n)): bool =
    EXISTS (i: coordinate(n)):
      bottom?(ell(i))

  line_point(n: nat)(ell: line(n), letter: Alpha): word(n) =
    LAMBDA (i: coordinate(n)):
      CASES ell(i) OF
        bottom: letter,
        up(fixed_letter): fixed_letter
      ENDCASES

  monochromatic_line(
      n: nat)(
      C: coloring(n),
      ell: line(n)): bool =
    proper_line(n)(ell)
      AND EXISTS (color: Kappa):
        FORALL (letter: Alpha):
          C(line_point(n)(ell, letter)) = color

  hales_jewett_theorem: bool =
    is_finite_type[Alpha]
      AND is_finite_type[Kappa]
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (n: nat):
        FORALL (C: coloring(n)):
          EXISTS (ell: line(n)):
            monochromatic_line(n)(C, ell)
END hales_jewett_theorem_Q1032886

-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1033910), "Cantor–Bernstein–Schroeder theorem":
-- injections between two arbitrary types in both directions imply the existence
-- of a bijection. This file contains no proof.

module Q1033910_cantor_bernstein_schroeder_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

Injective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) →

Surjective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Surjective {A = A} {B = B} function =
  (y : B) →

Bijective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Bijective function =
  Injective function × Surjective function

cantor-bernstein-schroeder-theorem :
  {a b : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
cantor-bernstein-schroeder-theorem {a} {b} =
  (A : Set a) →
  (B : Set b) →
  (f : A → B) →
  (g : B → A) →
  Injective f →
  Injective g →
  Σ (A → B) (λ h → Bijective h)

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1033910,
% "Cantor–Bernstein–Schroeder theorem": for arbitrary types, injections in
% both directions imply the existence of a bijection. This file contains no proof.

cantor_bernstein_schroeder_theorem_Q1033910[
  A: TYPE,
  B: TYPE
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  injective_ab(f: [A -> B]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      f(x) = f(y) IMPLIES x = y

  injective_ba(g: [B -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: B):
      g(x) = g(y) IMPLIES x = y

  surjective_ab(h: [A -> B]): bool =
    FORALL (y: B):
      EXISTS (x: A): h(x) = y

  cantor_bernstein_schroeder_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (f: [A -> B]), (g: [B -> A]):
      (injective_ab(f) AND injective_ba(g))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (h: [A -> B]):

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Record q1038716_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1038716_nf_zero : K;
  q1038716_nf_one : K;
  q1038716_nf_add : K -> K -> K;
  q1038716_nf_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q1038716_nf_neg : K -> K;
  q1038716_nf_inv : K -> K;
  q1038716_nf_add_assoc :

      q1038716_nf_add x (q1038716_nf_add y z) =

  q1038716_nf_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1038716_nf_add x y = q1038716_nf_add y x;
  q1038716_nf_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q1038716_nf_add x q1038716_nf_zero = x;
  q1038716_nf_add_neg :
    forall x : K, q1038716_nf_add x (q1038716_nf_neg x) =
      q1038716_nf_zero;
  q1038716_nf_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1038716_nf_mul x (q1038716_nf_mul y z) =

  q1038716_nf_mul_comm :

  q1038716_nf_inv_zero :

      q1038716_nf_mul x (q1038716_nf_inv x) = q1038716_nf_one;
  q1038716_nf_nontrivial :
    q1038716_nf_zero <> q1038716_nf_one;
  q1038716_nf_norm : K -> R;
  q1038716_nf_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : K, 0 <= q1038716_nf_norm x;
  q1038716_nf_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : K,

  q1038716_nf_norm_neg :

Arguments q1038716_nf_zero {K} _.
Arguments q1038716_nf_one {K} _.
Arguments q1038716_nf_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1038716_nf_mul {K} _ _ _.

Record q1038716_normed_vector_space
    (K : Type) (F : q1038716_normed_field K) (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1038716_nv_zero : E;
  q1038716_nv_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1038716_nv_neg : E -> E;
  q1038716_nv_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q1038716_nv_norm : E -> R;
  q1038716_nv_add_assoc :

  q1038716_nv_add_zero :

  q1038716_nv_add_neg :

  q1038716_nv_one_smul :

  q1038716_nv_mul_smul :

  q1038716_nv_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q1038716_nv_smul (q1038716_nf_zero F) x =

  q1038716_nv_smul_zero :

  q1038716_nv_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1038716_nv_norm x;
  q1038716_nv_norm_eq_zero :

Arguments q1038716_nv_zero {K F E} _.

Arguments q1038716_nv_neg {K F E} _ _.
