Definition q1038716_k_sub
    {K : Type} (F : q1038716_normed_field K) (x y : K) : K :=
  q1038716_nf_add F x (q1038716_nf_neg F y).

Definition q1038716_e_sub
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1038716_normed_field K}
    (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E) (x y : E) : E :=
  q1038716_nv_add V x (q1038716_nv_neg V y).

Fixpoint q1038716_k_pow
    {K : Type} (F : q1038716_normed_field K)
    (x : K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q1038716_nf_one F
  | S m => q1038716_nf_mul F x (q1038716_k_pow F x m)
  end.

Fixpoint q1038716_partial_sum
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1038716_normed_field K}
    (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E)
    (terms : nat -> E) (n : nat) : E :=
  match n with
  | O => q1038716_nv_zero V
  | S m =>
      q1038716_nv_add V
        (q1038716_partial_sum V terms m) (terms m)
  end.

Definition q1038716_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1038716_normed_field K}
    (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E)
    (sequence : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat ->
      q1038716_nv_norm V
        (q1038716_e_sub V (sequence n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1038716_has_sum
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1038716_normed_field K}
    (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E)
    (terms : nat -> E) (sum : E) : Prop :=
  q1038716_converges V
    (fun n => q1038716_partial_sum V terms n) sum.

Definition q1038716_analytic_at
    {K E : Type}
    (F : q1038716_normed_field K)
    (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E)
    (f : K -> E) (center : K) : Prop :=
  exists coefficients : nat -> E, exists radius : R,
    0 < radius /\
    forall z : K,
      q1038716_nf_norm F (q1038716_k_sub F z center) < radius ->
      q1038716_has_sum V
        (fun n : nat =>
          q1038716_nv_smul V
            (q1038716_k_pow F (q1038716_k_sub F z center) n)
            (coefficients n))
        (f z).

Definition q1038716_analytic_on_nhd
    {K E : Type}
    (F : q1038716_normed_field K)
    (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E)
    (f : K -> E) (U : K -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall z : K, U z ->
    @q1038716_analytic_at K E F V f z.

Definition q1038716_metric_open
    {K : Type}
    (F : q1038716_normed_field K) (S : K -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x : K, S x ->
    exists radius : R, 0 < radius /\
      forall y : K,
        q1038716_nf_norm F (q1038716_k_sub F y x) < radius ->
        S y.

Definition q1038716_relatively_open
    {K : Type}
    (F : q1038716_normed_field K)
    (U S : K -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists ambient : K -> Prop,
    q1038716_metric_open F ambient /\
    forall x : K, S x <-> U x /\ ambient x.

Definition q1038716_is_preconnected
    {K : Type}
    (F : q1038716_normed_field K) (U : K -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall left right : K -> Prop,
    q1038716_relatively_open F U left ->
    q1038716_relatively_open F U right ->
    (forall x : K, U x <-> left x \/ right x) ->
    (forall x : K, ~ (left x /\ right x)) ->
    (forall x : K, ~ left x) \/ (forall x : K, ~ right x).

Definition q1038716_frequently_equal_near
    {K E : Type}
    (F : q1038716_normed_field K)
    (f g : K -> E) (center : K) : Prop :=
  forall radius : R, 0 < radius ->
    exists z : K,
      z <> center /\
      q1038716_nf_norm F (q1038716_k_sub F z center) < radius /\
      f z = g z.

Theorem AnalyticOnNhd_eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq :
  forall (K E : Type)
         (F : q1038716_normed_field K)
         (V : q1038716_normed_vector_space F E)
         (U : K -> Prop) (f g : K -> E) (z0 : K),
    @q1038716_analytic_on_nhd K E F V f U ->
    @q1038716_analytic_on_nhd K E F V g U ->
    @q1038716_is_preconnected K F U ->
    U z0 ->
    @q1038716_frequently_equal_near K E F f g z0 ->
    forall z : K, U z -> f z = g z.
Admitted.

title: Q1038716_identity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1038716,
  "Identity theorem": two functions from an arbitrary nontrivially normed field
  to a normed vector space, analytic on neighborhoods of a preconnected set and
  agreeing frequently in a punctured neighborhood of a point of that set,
  agree throughout the set. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1038716_identity_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1038716_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1038716_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. dist a b = knorm (a - b)) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q1038716_normed_space ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1038716_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. dist x y = enorm (x - y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) \<le> knorm a * enorm x)"

definition q1038716_continuous_multilinear ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
     ('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k list \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1038716_continuous_multilinear n knorm enorm scale A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>xs i u v.
      length xs = n \<longrightarrow> i < n \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := u + v]) = A (xs[i := u]) + A (xs[i := v])) \<and>
    (\<forall>xs i a u.
      length xs = n \<longrightarrow> i < n \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := a * u]) = scale a (A (xs[i := u]))) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>xs. length xs = n \<longrightarrow>
      enorm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<n. knorm (xs ! i)))"

definition q1038716_multilinear_operator_norm ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
     ('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k list \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1038716_multilinear_operator_norm n knorm enorm A =
    Inf {C. 0 \<le> C \<and> (\<forall>xs. length xs = n \<longrightarrow>
      enorm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<n. knorm (xs ! i)))}"

definition q1038716_analytic_at ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1038716_analytic_at knorm enorm scale f z0 \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>A r. 0 < r \<and>
      (\<forall>n. q1038716_continuous_multilinear
        n knorm enorm scale (A n)) \<and>
      summable (\<lambda>n.
        q1038716_multilinear_operator_norm n knorm enorm (A n) * r ^ n) \<and>
      (\<forall>z. dist z z0 < r \<longrightarrow>
        ((\<lambda>n. A n (replicate n (z - z0))) sums f z)))"

definition q1038716_analytic_on_nhd ::
    "('k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'k set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1038716_analytic_on_nhd knorm enorm scale f U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> U. q1038716_analytic_at knorm enorm scale f z)"

theorem identity_theorem:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and scale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and U :: "'k set"
    and f g :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and z0 :: 'k
  assumes "q1038716_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and "q1038716_normed_space knorm enorm scale"
    and "q1038716_analytic_on_nhd knorm enorm scale f U"
    and "q1038716_analytic_on_nhd knorm enorm scale g U"
    and "connected U"
    and "z0 \<in> U"
    and "frequently (\<lambda>z. f z = g z) (at z0)"
  shows "\<forall>z \<in> U. f z = g z"
  sorry

end

title: Q1038716_identity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1038716,
  "Identity theorem": two functions analytic on a preconnected set over an
  arbitrary nontrivially normed field, with values in a normed vector space,
  agree throughout the set if their coincidence points accumulate at a point
  of the set. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1038716_IDENTITY_THEOREM =
 `let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c. mulK a (addK b c) =
                  addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a. &1 < normK a) in
  let normed_add_comm_group =
    \(zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (normE:B->real).
       (!x y z. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       normE zeroE = &0 /\
       (!x. &0 <= normE x) /\
       (!x. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
       (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
       (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A) (normK:A->real)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b x. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a x y. smul a (addE x y) =
                  addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a b x. smul (addK a b) x =
                  addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a. smul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
       (!x. smul zeroK x = zeroE) /\
       (!a x. normE (smul a x) = normK a * normE x) in
  let subK =
    \(addK:A->A->A) (negK:A->A) x y. addK x (negK y) in
  let subE =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) x y. addE x (negE y) in
  let power =
    \(mulK:A->A->A) (oneK:A) (z:A) (n:num).
       ((@p:num->A.
           p 0 = oneK /\
           (!m. p (SUC m) = mulK z (p m))) n) in
  let partial_sum =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (zeroE:B) (term:num->B) (n:num).
       ((@s:num->B.
           s 0 = zeroE /\
           (!m. s (SUC m) = addE (s m) (term m))) n) in
  let tends_to =
    \(normE:B->real) (subE:B->B->B) (u:num->B) (l:B).
       !eps. &0 < eps
             ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> normE (subE (u n) l) < eps in
  let open_in_norm =
    \(normK:A->real) (subK:A->A->A) (s:A->bool).
       !x. x IN s
           ==> ?eps. &0 < eps /\
                     !y. normK (subK y x) < eps ==> y IN s in
  let preconnected =
    \(normK:A->real) (subK:A->A->A) (U:A->bool).
       !s t:A->bool.
         open_in_norm normK subK s /\
         open_in_norm normK subK t /\
         U SUBSET (s UNION t) /\
         DISJOINT (U INTER s) (U INTER t)
         ==> U INTER s = {} \/ U INTER t = {} in
  let analytic_at =
    \(mulK:A->A->A) (oneK:A) (normK:A->real)
     (addE:B->B->B) (zeroE:B) (normE:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B) (subK:A->A->A) (subE:B->B->B)
     (f:A->B) (x:A).
       ?coeff:num->B. ?radius:real.
         &0 < radius /\
         !z. normK (subK z x) < radius
             ==> tends_to normE subE
                   (\n. partial_sum addE zeroE
                          (\m. smul (power mulK oneK (subK z x) m)
                                    (coeff m))
                          n)
                   (f z) in
  let analytic_on_nhd =
    \(mulK:A->A->A) (oneK:A) (normK:A->real)
     (addE:B->B->B) (zeroE:B) (normE:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B) (subK:A->A->A) (subE:B->B->B)
     (f:A->B) (U:A->bool).
       !x. x IN U
           ==> analytic_at mulK oneK normK addE zeroE normE
                 smul subK subE f x in
  let frequently_equal_near =
    \(normK:A->real) (subK:A->A->A)
     (f:A->B) (g:A->B) (z0:A).
       !eps. &0 < eps
             ==> ?z. ~(z = z0) /\
                     normK (subK z z0) < eps /\
                     f z = g z in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !smul:A->B->B.
  !f g:A->B.
  !U:A->bool.
  !z0:A.
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    normed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE normE smul /\
    analytic_on_nhd
      mulK oneK normK addE zeroE normE smul
      (subK addK negK) (subE addE negE) f U /\
    analytic_on_nhd
      mulK oneK normK addE zeroE normE smul
      (subK addK negK) (subE addE negE) g U /\
    preconnected normK (subK addK negK) U /\
    z0 IN U /\
    frequently_equal_near normK (subK addK negK) f g z0
    ==> !z. z IN U ==> f z = g z`;;

title: Q1038716_identity_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1038716,
;; "Identity theorem": two functions analytic on neighborhoods of a
;; preconnected subset of a nontrivially normed field agree throughout the
;; subset when their coincidence points accumulate at one of its points.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Carriers, operations, sets, functions, and coefficient sequences are
;; arbitrary ACL2 objects interpreted through conservative interfaces.  Norms
;; are represented by rational upper cuts: NORM-LT records ||x|| < q for
;; positive rational q.  Thus norm values range over all nonnegative reals,
;; rather than being restricted to ACL2 rationals.

(defstub q1038716-member-p (predicate object) t)
(defstub q1038716-unary-value (function object) t)
(defstub q1038716-binary-value (function left right) t)
(defstub q1038716-norm-lt-p (norm object bound) t)

(defun q1038716-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and (rationalp value) (< 0 value)))

(defun-sk q1038716-norm-finite-p (norm object)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm object bound))))

(defun-sk q1038716-norm-positive-p (norm object)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p bound)
     (not (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm object bound)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-norm-rounded-p (norm object bound)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (rationalp bound)
     (< smaller bound)
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm object smaller))))

(defun-sk q1038716-norm-product-lt-p
    (left-norm right-norm left right bound)
  (exists (left-bound right-bound)
    (and
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p left-bound)
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p right-bound)
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p left-norm left left-bound)
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p right-norm right right-bound)
     (< (* left-bound right-bound) bound))))

(defun-sk q1038716-norm-cut-laws-p
    (carrier norm zero)
  (forall (x q r)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
     (and
      (implies
       (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x q)
       (q1038716-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x r))
      (implies
       (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x q)
       (q1038716-norm-rounded-p norm x q))
      (q1038716-norm-finite-p norm x)
      (iff
       (equal x zero)
       (not (q1038716-norm-positive-p norm x)))))))

;; A nontrivially normed field.

(defun-sk q1038716-field-closure-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier (q1038716-binary-value add x y))
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier (q1038716-binary-value multiply x y))
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier (q1038716-unary-value negate x))
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier (q1038716-unary-value inverse x))))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-additive-laws-p
    (carrier add negate zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add (q1038716-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add x (q1038716-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value add x y)
       (q1038716-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (q1038716-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add x (q1038716-unary-value negate x))
       zero)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-multiplicative-laws-p
    (carrier multiply inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        multiply (q1038716-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (q1038716-binary-value
        multiply x (q1038716-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value multiply x y)
       (q1038716-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (q1038716-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (q1038716-unary-value inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (q1038716-binary-value
         multiply x (q1038716-unary-value inverse x))
        one))))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-distributive-p
    (carrier add multiply)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier z))
     (equal
      (q1038716-binary-value
       multiply x (q1038716-binary-value add y z))
      (q1038716-binary-value
       add
       (q1038716-binary-value multiply x y)
       (q1038716-binary-value multiply x z))))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-norm-zero-one-p
    (norm zero one)
  (forall (q)
    (and
     (iff
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm zero q)
      (q1038716-positive-rational-p q))
     (iff
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm one q)
      (and (rationalp q) (< 1 q))))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-norm-negate-p
    (carrier negate norm)
  (forall (x q)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p
       norm (q1038716-unary-value negate x) q)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x q)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-norm-add-p
    (carrier add norm)
  (forall (x y r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y)
      (q1038716-positive-rational-p r)
      (q1038716-positive-rational-p s)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x r)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm y s))
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p
      norm (q1038716-binary-value add x y) (+ r s)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-norm-multiply-p
    (carrier multiply norm)
  (forall (x y q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y))
     (iff
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p
       norm (q1038716-binary-value multiply x y) q)
      (q1038716-norm-product-lt-p
       norm norm x y q)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-field-norm-nontrivial-p
    (carrier norm)
  (exists (x q)
    (and
     (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
     (rationalp q)
     (< 1 q)
     (not (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x q)))))

(defun q1038716-nontrivially-normed-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse norm)
  (and
   (q1038716-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1038716-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1038716-field-closure-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1038716-field-additive-laws-p carrier add negate zero)
   (q1038716-field-multiplicative-laws-p
    carrier multiply inverse zero one)
   (q1038716-field-distributive-p carrier add multiply)
   (q1038716-norm-cut-laws-p carrier norm zero)
   (q1038716-field-norm-zero-one-p norm zero one)
   (q1038716-field-norm-negate-p carrier negate norm)
   (q1038716-field-norm-add-p carrier add norm)
   (q1038716-field-norm-multiply-p carrier multiply norm)
   (q1038716-field-norm-nontrivial-p carrier norm)))

;; A normed additive commutative group and vector space over the field.

(defun-sk q1038716-space-closure-p
    (field-carrier carrier add negate scalar-multiply)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p field-carrier a)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier (q1038716-binary-value add x y))
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier (q1038716-unary-value negate x))
      (q1038716-member-p
       carrier
       (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply a x))))))

(defun-sk q1038716-space-additive-laws-p
    (carrier add negate zero)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add (q1038716-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add x (q1038716-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value add x y)
       (q1038716-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (q1038716-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add x (q1038716-unary-value negate x))
       zero)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-space-module-laws-p
    (field-carrier field-zero field-one field-add field-multiply
     carrier zero add scalar-multiply)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p field-carrier a)
      (q1038716-member-p field-carrier b)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply field-one x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        (q1038716-binary-value field-multiply a b)
        x)
       (q1038716-binary-value
        scalar-multiply a
        (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply b x)))
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        (q1038716-binary-value field-add a b)
        x)
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add
        (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply a x)
        (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply b x)))
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value
        scalar-multiply a
        (q1038716-binary-value add x y))
       (q1038716-binary-value
        add
        (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply a x)
        (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply a y)))
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply field-zero x)
       zero)
      (equal
       (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply a zero)
       zero)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-space-norm-negate-p
    (carrier negate norm)
  (forall (x q)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p
       norm (q1038716-unary-value negate x) q)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x q)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-space-norm-add-p
    (carrier add norm)
  (forall (x y r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier y)
      (q1038716-positive-rational-p r)
      (q1038716-positive-rational-p s)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm x r)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p norm y s))
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p
      norm (q1038716-binary-value add x y) (+ r s)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-space-norm-smul-p
    (field-carrier field-norm carrier scalar-multiply norm)
  (forall (a x q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p field-carrier a)
      (q1038716-member-p carrier x))
     (iff
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p
       norm (q1038716-binary-value scalar-multiply a x) q)
      (q1038716-norm-product-lt-p
       field-norm norm a x q)))))

(defun q1038716-normed-space-p
    (field-carrier field-zero field-one field-add field-multiply
     field-norm carrier zero add negate scalar-multiply norm)
  (and
   (q1038716-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1038716-space-closure-p
    field-carrier carrier add negate scalar-multiply)
   (q1038716-space-additive-laws-p carrier add negate zero)
   (q1038716-space-module-laws-p
    field-carrier field-zero field-one field-add field-multiply
    carrier zero add scalar-multiply)
   (q1038716-norm-cut-laws-p carrier norm zero)
   (q1038716-space-norm-negate-p carrier negate norm)
   (q1038716-space-norm-add-p carrier add norm)
   (q1038716-space-norm-smul-p
    field-carrier field-norm carrier scalar-multiply norm)))

(defun q1038716-field-difference (add negate left right)
  (q1038716-binary-value
   add left (q1038716-unary-value negate right)))

(defun q1038716-space-difference (add negate left right)
  (q1038716-binary-value
   add left (q1038716-unary-value negate right)))

;; Arbitrary subsets, functions, and coefficient sequences.

(defun-sk q1038716-valid-set-p (field-carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p set x)
     (q1038716-member-p field-carrier x))))

(defun-sk q1038716-function-p
    (field-carrier space-carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p field-carrier x)
     (q1038716-member-p
      space-carrier (q1038716-unary-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-coefficient-sequence-p
    (space-carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1038716-member-p
      space-carrier (q1038716-unary-value sequence n)))))

;; Scalar powers, vector-valued power-series partial sums, and convergence.

(defun q1038716-field-power (one multiply base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (q1038716-binary-value
     multiply
     base
     (q1038716-field-power
      one multiply base (1- exponent)))))

(defun q1038716-power-series-partial-sum
    (field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add scalar-multiply
     coefficients delta count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      space-zero
    (let ((index (1- count)))
      (q1038716-binary-value
       space-add
       (q1038716-power-series-partial-sum
        field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add scalar-multiply
        coefficients delta index)
       (q1038716-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        (q1038716-field-power
         field-one field-multiply delta index)
        (q1038716-unary-value coefficients index))))))

(defun-sk q1038716-convergence-tail-p
    (field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm coefficients delta limit
     epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (q1038716-norm-lt-p
      space-norm
      (q1038716-space-difference
       space-add space-negate
       (q1038716-power-series-partial-sum
        field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add scalar-multiply
        coefficients delta count)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1038716-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm coefficients delta limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1038716-convergence-tail-p
      field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add space-negate
      scalar-multiply space-norm coefficients delta limit
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1038716-power-series-converges-p
    (field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm coefficients delta limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (q1038716-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add space-negate
      scalar-multiply space-norm coefficients delta limit epsilon))))

;; Analyticity is local representability by a convergent scalar power series.
;; For a one-dimensional field domain, continuous multilinear coefficients are
;; equivalently their values at (1,...,1), hence the vector coefficient
;; sequence below is definitionally equivalent to the source power series.

(defun-sk q1038716-power-series-ball-p
    (field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
     field-norm space-zero space-add space-negate scalar-multiply
     space-norm function center coefficients radius)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p field-carrier z)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p
       field-norm
       (q1038716-field-difference field-add field-negate z center)
       radius))
     (q1038716-power-series-converges-p
      field-one field-multiply space-zero space-add space-negate
      scalar-multiply space-norm coefficients
      (q1038716-field-difference field-add field-negate z center)
      (q1038716-unary-value function z)))))

(defun q1038716-analytic-witness-p
    (field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
     field-norm space-carrier space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm function center coefficients radius)
  (and
   (q1038716-coefficient-sequence-p space-carrier coefficients)
   (q1038716-positive-rational-p radius)
   (q1038716-power-series-ball-p
    field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
    field-norm space-zero space-add space-negate scalar-multiply
    space-norm function center coefficients radius)))

(defun-sk q1038716-analytic-at-p
    (field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
     field-norm space-carrier space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm function center)
  (exists (coefficients radius)
    (q1038716-analytic-witness-p
     field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
     field-norm space-carrier space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm function center coefficients radius)))

(defun-sk q1038716-analytic-on-neighborhood-p
    (field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
     field-norm space-carrier space-zero space-add space-negate
     scalar-multiply space-norm function set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p set center)
     (q1038716-analytic-at-p
      field-carrier field-one field-add field-multiply field-negate
      field-norm space-carrier space-zero space-add space-negate
      scalar-multiply space-norm function center))))

;; The norm topology and preconnectedness.

(defun-sk q1038716-open-ball-contained-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm
     set center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-member-p field-carrier point)
      (q1038716-norm-lt-p
       field-norm
       (q1038716-field-difference
        field-add field-negate point center)
       radius))
     (q1038716-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q1038716-open-radius-exists-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1038716-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q1038716-open-ball-contained-p
      field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm
      set center radius))))

(defun-sk q1038716-metric-open-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p set center)
     (q1038716-open-radius-exists-p
      field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm
      set center))))

(defun-sk q1038716-cover-p (set left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1038716-member-p set x)
     (or
      (q1038716-member-p left x)
      (q1038716-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1038716-intersects-p (left right)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1038716-member-p left x)
     (q1038716-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q1038716-triple-intersects-p (set left right)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1038716-member-p set x)
     (q1038716-member-p left x)
     (q1038716-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q1038716-preconnected-p
    (field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm set)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1038716-valid-set-p field-carrier left)
      (q1038716-valid-set-p field-carrier right)
      (q1038716-metric-open-p
       field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm left)
      (q1038716-metric-open-p
       field-carrier field-add field-negate field-norm right)
      (q1038716-cover-p set left right)
      (q1038716-intersects-p set left)
      (q1038716-intersects-p set right))
     (q1038716-triple-intersects-p set left right))))

;; Frequent equality in the punctured neighborhood filter and equality on U.

(defun-sk q1038716-frequent-equality-witness-exists-p

title: Q1038716_identity_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1038716
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1038716), "Identity theorem": analytic functions
-- on a preconnected set that agree arbitrarily near a point of the set agree
-- throughout the set. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1038716_identity_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_ _≤N_
infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set → Set
Not A = A → Bottom

_≠_ : {A : Set} → A → A → Set
x ≠ y = Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data _≤N_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤   : {n : Nat} → zero ≤N n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤N n → suc m ≤N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR inverseR absoluteR : R → R
    lessOrEqualR : R → R → Set
    fromNatR : Nat → R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR ≡ zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zeroR →
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y z →
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR × (zeroR ≠ oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) →
      absoluteR x ≡ zeroR →
      x ≡ zeroR
    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) →
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ≡
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero ≡ zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (suc n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    characteristic-zero :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n →
      m ≡ n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat (λ n → lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R (λ upper → (x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  R →
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y × (x ≠ y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NormedField
  (R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (K : Set) : Set₁ where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K → K → K
    negateK inverseK : K → K
    normK : K → R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK ≠ zeroK
    norm-greater-than-one :
      Σ K
        (λ x →
          StrictLess reals (oneR reals) (normK x))

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) →
      addK x y ≡ addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) →
      addK (addK x y) z ≡ addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) →
      addK x zeroK ≡ x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) →
      addK x (negateK x) ≡ zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) →
      multiplyK x y ≡ multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ≡
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) →
      multiplyK x oneK ≡ x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) →
      multiplyK x zeroK ≡ zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ≡
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    inverse-zeroK :
      inverseK zeroK ≡ zeroK
    multiply-inverseK :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ zeroK →
      multiplyK x (inverseK x) ≡ oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) →
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK ≡ zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) →
      normK x ≡ zeroR reals →
      x ≡ zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) →
      normK (negateK x) ≡ normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) →
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) →
      normK (multiplyK x y) ≡
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)

open NormedField

subtractK :
  {R K : Set} →
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} →
  NormedField R reals K →
  K →
  K →
  K
subtractK scalars x y =
  addK scalars x (negateK scalars y)

powerK :
  {R K : Set} →
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} →
  NormedField R reals K →
  K →
  Nat →
  K
powerK scalars x zero =
  oneK scalars
powerK scalars x (suc n) =
  multiplyK scalars x (powerK scalars x n)

record NormedSpace
  (R K E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) : Set₁ where

  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E → E → E
    negateE : E → E
    scaleE : K → E → E
    normE : E → R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) →
      addE x y ≡ addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) →
      addE (addE x y) z ≡ addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) →
      addE x zeroE ≡ x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) →
      addE x (negateE x) ≡ zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) →
      scaleE (oneK scalars) x ≡ x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : K) →
      (x : E) →
      scaleE (multiplyK scalars a b) x ≡
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : K) →
      (x y : E) →
      scaleE a (addE x y) ≡ addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : K) →
      (x : E) →
      scaleE (addK scalars a b) x ≡ addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) →
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE ≡ zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) →
      normE x ≡ zeroR reals →
      x ≡ zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) →
      normE (negateE x) ≡ normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) →
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : K) →
      (x : E) →
      normE (scaleE a x) ≡
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normE x)

open NormedSpace

subtractE :
  {R K E : Set} →
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} →
  {scalars : NormedField R reals K} →
  NormedSpace R K E reals scalars →
  E →
  E →
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

SetOf : Set → Set₁
SetOf A = A → Set

Open :
  {R K : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  SetOf K →
  Set
Open {R = R} {K = K} reals scalars O =
  (x : K) →
  O x →
  Σ R
    (λ radius →
      Positive reals radius
      ×
      ((y : K) →
        StrictLess reals
          (normK scalars (subtractK scalars y x))
          radius →
        O y))

DisjointWithin :
  {A : Set} →
  SetOf A →
  SetOf A →
  SetOf A →
  Set
DisjointWithin {A = A} whole leftSet rightSet =
  (x : A) →
  whole x →
  leftSet x →
  rightSet x →
  Bottom

CoveredBy :
  {A : Set} →
  SetOf A →
  SetOf A →
  SetOf A →
  Set
CoveredBy {A = A} whole leftSet rightSet =
  (x : A) →
  whole x →
  Either (leftSet x) (rightSet x)

EmptyWithin :
  {A : Set} →
  SetOf A →
  SetOf A →
  Set
EmptyWithin {A = A} whole part =
  (x : A) →
  whole x →
  Not (part x)

Preconnected :
  {R K : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  SetOf K →
  Set₁
Preconnected {K = K} reals scalars U =
  (leftSet rightSet : SetOf K) →
  Open reals scalars leftSet →
  Open reals scalars rightSet →
  CoveredBy U leftSet rightSet →
  DisjointWithin U leftSet rightSet →
  Either
    (EmptyWithin U leftSet)
    (EmptyWithin U rightSet)

partialPowerSum :
  {R K E : Set} →
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} →
  {scalars : NormedField R reals K} →
  NormedSpace R K E reals scalars →
  (Nat → E) →
  K →
  Nat →
  E
partialPowerSum space coefficients displacement zero =
  zeroE space
partialPowerSum {scalars = scalars} space coefficients displacement (suc n) =
  addE space
    (partialPowerSum space coefficients displacement n)
    (scaleE space (powerK scalars displacement n) (coefficients n))

SequenceLimit :
  {R K E : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  (space : NormedSpace R K E reals scalars) →
  (Nat → E) →
  E →
  Set
SequenceLimit {R = R} reals scalars space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) →
  Positive reals epsilon →
  Σ Nat
    (λ cutoff →
      (n : Nat) →
      cutoff ≤N n →
      StrictLess reals
        (normE space (subtractE space (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

HasPowerSeriesAt :
  {R K E : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  (space : NormedSpace R K E reals scalars) →
  (K → E) →
  K →
  (Nat → E) →
  R →
  Set
HasPowerSeriesAt {K = K} reals scalars space f center coefficients radius =
  Positive reals radius
  ×
  ((x : K) →
    StrictLess reals
      (normK scalars (subtractK scalars x center))
      radius →
    SequenceLimit reals scalars space
      (partialPowerSum space coefficients (subtractK scalars x center))
      (f x))

AnalyticAt :
  {R K E : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  (space : NormedSpace R K E reals scalars) →
  (K → E) →
  K →
  Set
AnalyticAt {R = R} {E = E} reals scalars space f center =
  Σ (Nat → E)
    (λ coefficients →
      Σ R
        (λ radius →
          HasPowerSeriesAt reals scalars space
            f center coefficients radius))

AnalyticOnNeighborhood :
  {R K E : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  (space : NormedSpace R K E reals scalars) →
  (K → E) →
  SetOf K →
  Set
AnalyticOnNeighborhood {K = K} reals scalars space f U =
  (x : K) →
  U x →
  AnalyticAt reals scalars space f x

FrequentlyEqualInPuncturedNeighborhood :
  {R K E : Set} →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  (K → E) →
  (K → E) →
  K →
  Set
FrequentlyEqualInPuncturedNeighborhood {R = R} {K = K}
  reals scalars f g center =
  (epsilon : R) →
  Positive reals epsilon →
  Σ K
    (λ x →
      (x ≠ center)
      ×
      (StrictLess reals
        (normK scalars (subtractK scalars x center))
        epsilon
      ×
      (f x ≡ g x)))

EqualOn :
  {K E : Set} →
  (K → E) →
  (K → E) →
  SetOf K →
  Set
EqualOn {K = K} f g U =
  (x : K) →
  U x →
  f x ≡ g x

identity-theorem : Set₁
identity-theorem =
  (R K E : Set) →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  (scalars : NormedField R reals K) →
  (space : NormedSpace R K E reals scalars) →
  (U : SetOf K) →
  (f g : K → E) →
  (center : K) →
  AnalyticOnNeighborhood reals scalars space f U →
  AnalyticOnNeighborhood reals scalars space g U →
  Preconnected reals scalars U →
  U center →
  FrequentlyEqualInPuncturedNeighborhood reals scalars f g center →
  EqualOn f g U

title: Q1038716_identity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1038716,
  "Identity theorem": two analytic functions from a nontrivially normed field
  to a normed vector space that agree frequently in a punctured neighborhood
  of a point of a preconnected set agree throughout that set. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory realTheory;

val identity_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "identity_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``identity_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK a zeroK = a) /\
      (!a. addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK a oneK = a) /\
      (!a b c.
         mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      (?a. 1 < normK a)``);

val identity_normed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "identity_normed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``identity_normed_add_comm_group
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x. addE x zeroE = x) /\
      (!x. addE x (negE x) = zeroE) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x. (normE x = 0) <=> (x = zeroE)) /\
      (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y)``);

val identity_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "identity_normed_space_def",
  ``identity_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x. smul oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul zeroK x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smul a x) = normK a * normE x)``);

val identity_pow_def = new_definition (
  "identity_pow_def",
  ``identity_pow (oneK : 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (x : 'k) (n : num) =
      FOLDL mulK oneK (GENLIST (\i. x) n)``);

val identity_partial_sum_def = new_definition (
  "identity_partial_sum_def",
  ``identity_partial_sum
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (a : num -> 'e) (n : num) =
      FOLDL addE zeroE (GENLIST a n)``);

val identity_has_sum_def = new_definition (
  "identity_has_sum_def",
  ``identity_has_sum
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (a : num -> 'e) (s : 'e) <=>
      !eps : real.
        0 < eps ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==>
          normE
            (addE (identity_partial_sum zeroE addE a n) (negE s))
          < eps``);

val identity_analytic_at_def = new_definition (
  "identity_analytic_at_def",
  ``identity_analytic_at
      (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'k -> 'e) (x : 'k) <=>
      ?a : num -> 'e. ?r : real.
        0 < r /\
        !y : 'k.
          normK y < r ==>
          identity_has_sum zeroE addE negE normE
            (\n. smul (identity_pow oneK mulK y n) (a n))
            (f (addK x y))``);

val identity_analytic_on_nhd_def = new_definition (
  "identity_analytic_on_nhd_def",
  ``identity_analytic_on_nhd
      (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'k -> 'e) (U : 'k -> bool) <=>
      !x : 'k.
        U x ==>
        identity_analytic_at oneK addK mulK zeroE addE negE
          smul normK normE f x``);

val identity_open_def = new_definition (
  "identity_open_def",
  ``identity_open
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (s : 'k -> bool) <=>
      !x : 'k.
        s x ==>
        ?r : real.
          0 < r /\
          !y : 'k.
            normK (addK (negK x) y) < r ==> s y``);

val identity_preconnected_def = new_definition (
  "identity_preconnected_def",
  ``identity_preconnected
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (U : 'k -> bool) <=>
      !u v : 'k -> bool.
        identity_open addK negK normK u /\
        identity_open addK negK normK v /\
        (!x. U x ==> u x \/ v x) /\
        (?x. U x /\ u x) /\
        (?x. U x /\ v x)
        ==>
        ?x. U x /\ u x /\ v x``);

val identity_frequently_eq_punctured_def = new_definition (
  "identity_frequently_eq_punctured_def",
  ``identity_frequently_eq_punctured
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (f : 'k -> 'e) (g : 'k -> 'e) (z0 : 'k) <=>
      !eps : real.
        0 < eps ==>
        ?z : 'k.
          z <> z0 /\
          normK (addK (negK z0) z) < eps /\
          f z = g z``);

val AnalyticOnNhd_eqOn_of_preconnected_of_frequently_eq =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (U : 'k -> bool) (f : 'k -> 'e) (g : 'k -> 'e)
      (z0 : 'k).
      identity_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      identity_normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      identity_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroE addE smul normK normE /\
      identity_analytic_on_nhd
        oneK addK mulK zeroE addE negE smul normK normE f U /\
      identity_analytic_on_nhd
        oneK addK mulK zeroE addE negE smul normK normE g U /\
      identity_preconnected addK negK normK U /\
      U z0 /\
      identity_frequently_eq_punctured addK negK normK f g z0
      ==>
      !z : 'k. U z ==> f z = g z``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1038716
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1038716), "Identity theorem": two functions
  from an arbitrary nontrivially normed field to an arbitrary normed vector
  space that are analytic on neighborhoods of a preconnected set and agree
  frequently in a punctured neighborhood of a point of the set agree
  everywhere on the set. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  QIDDiff is field subtraction. QIDTerm and QIDPartial are respectively a
  coefficient term and a finite partial sum of a one-variable vector-valued
  power series. QIDAnalytic says that at every point of U, the function has a
  power-series expansion converging on a positive-radius ball. For a function
  on the one-dimensional space K, this coefficient-sequence formulation is
  equivalent to the continuous multilinear-map formulation of
  AnalyticOnNhd used by the Lean source.

  The final $a assertion quantifies over bundled SetMM normed fields and
  normed vector spaces. The existential element of norm greater than one is
  the explicit SetMM rendering of Lean's nontrivial-norm field assumption.
  Connectedness is imposed on the subspace topology. The last hypothesis says
  every open neighborhood of z contains a distinct point where F and G agree,
  exactly rendering frequent equality in the punctured neighborhood filter.
  The assertion is unproved and adds no $p proof statement.
$)

$c QIDDiff QIDTerm QIDPartial QIDAnalytic $.

qid-diff-syntax $a class ( QIDDiff K X Y ) $.
qid-term-syntax $a class ( QIDTerm K W A X Y N ) $.
qid-partial-syntax $a class ( QIDPartial K W A X Y M ) $.
qid-analytic-syntax $a wff ( QIDAnalytic K W F U ) $.

${
  $d K X Y $.

  qid-diff-definition $a |- ( QIDDiff K X Y ) =
    ( Y ( +g ` K ) ( ( -g ` K ) ` X ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A K N W X Y $.

  qid-term-definition $a |- ( QIDTerm K W A X Y N ) =
    (
      (
        N
        ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` K ) )
        ( QIDDiff K X Y )
      )
      ( .s ` W )
      ( A ` N )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A K M W X Y n $.

  qid-partial-definition $a |- ( QIDPartial K W A X Y M ) =
    (
      W
      gsum
      (
        n e. ( 0 ... M ) |->
        ( QIDTerm K W A X Y n )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A F K N U W e m r x y $.

  qid-analytic-definition $a |- (
    ( QIDAnalytic K W F U )
    <->
    A. x e. U
      E. A e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m NN0 )
        E. r e. RR+
          A. y e. ( Base ` K )
            (
              (
                ( ( norm ` K ) ` ( QIDDiff K x y ) )
                <
                r
              )
              ->
              A. e e. RR+
                E. N e. NN0
                  A. m e. ( ZZ>= ` N )
                    (
                      (
                        ( norm ` W )
                        `
                        (
                          ( QIDPartial K W A x y m )
                          ( +g ` W )
                          (
                            ( -g ` W )
                            `
                            ( F ` y )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                      <
                      e
                    )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G K U W O c w x y z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1038716-identity $a |-
    A. K e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )
      A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = K }
        A. F e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m ( Base ` K ) )
          A. G e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m ( Base ` K ) )
            A. U e. ~P ( Base ` K )
              A. z e. U
                (
                  (
                    E. c e. ( Base ` K )
                      1 < ( ( norm ` K ) ` c )
                    /\
                    ( QIDAnalytic K W F U )
                    /\
                    ( QIDAnalytic K W G U )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( ( TopOpen ` K ) |`t U )
                      e. Conn
                    )
                    /\
                    A. O e. ( TopOpen ` K )
                      (
                        z e. O
                        ->
                        E. y e. ( O \ { z } )
                          ( F ` y ) = ( G ` y )
                      )
                  )
                  ->
                  A. x e. U
                    ( F ` x ) = ( G ` x )
                )
  $.
$}

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1038716,
:: "Identity theorem": two analytic functions from a nontrivially normed field
:: to a normed vector space that agree arbitrarily near a point of a
:: preconnected set agree throughout that set. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1,
    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,

  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, CARD_1,
    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, BINOP_2, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    NAT_1, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R,V being non empty set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      oppR,invR being UnOp of R,
      powR being Function of [:R,NAT:],R,
      normR being Function of R,REAL,
      zeroV being Element of V,
      addV being BinOp of V,
      oppV being UnOp of V,
      smul being Function of [:R,V:],V,
      normV being Function of V,REAL,
      f,g being Function of R,V,
      U being Subset of R,
      z0 being Element of R
  st
    zeroR <> oneR &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,y) = addR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(x,y),z) = addR.(x,addR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,zeroR) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      addR.(x,oppR.x) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,y) = mulR.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(x,y),z) = mulR.(x,mulR.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,oneR) = x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,zeroR) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of R holds
      mulR.(x,addR.(y,z)) =
        addR.(mulR.(x,y),mulR.(x,z))) &
    (for x being Element of R st x <> zeroR holds
      mulR.(x,invR.x) = oneR) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      powR.(x,0) = oneR) &
    (for x being Element of R, n being Nat holds
      powR.(x,n+1) = mulR.(powR.(x,n),x)) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      0 <= normR.x) &
    (for x being Element of R holds
      (normR.x = 0 iff x = zeroR)) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      normR.(addR.(x,y)) <= normR.x + normR.y) &
    (for x,y being Element of R holds
      normR.(mulR.(x,y)) = normR.x * normR.y) &
    (ex c being Element of R st 1 < normR.c) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,v) = addV.(v,u)) &
    (for u,v,w being Element of V holds
      addV.(addV.(u,v),w) = addV.(u,addV.(v,w))) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,zeroV) = u) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      addV.(u,oppV.u) = zeroV) &
    (for a being Element of R, u,v being Element of V holds
      smul.(a,addV.(u,v)) =
        addV.(smul.(a,u),smul.(a,v))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      smul.(addR.(a,b),u) =
        addV.(smul.(a,u),smul.(b,u))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      smul.(mulR.(a,b),u) = smul.(a,smul.(b,u))) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      smul.(oneR,u) = u) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      0 <= normV.u) &
    (for u being Element of V holds
      (normV.u = 0 iff u = zeroV)) &
    (for u,v being Element of V holds
      normV.(addV.(u,v)) <= normV.u + normV.v) &
    (for a being Element of R, u being Element of V holds
      normV.(smul.(a,u)) = normR.a * normV.u) &
    not ex A,B being Subset of R st
      A c= U & B c= U & U = A \/ B & A misses B &
      A <> {} & B <> {} &
      (for x being Element of R st x in A holds
        ex r being Real st 0 < r &
          for y being Element of R st
            y in U &
            normR.(addR.(y,oppR.x)) < r
          holds y in A) &
      (for x being Element of R st x in B holds
        ex r being Real st 0 < r &
          for y being Element of R st
            y in U &
            normR.(addR.(y,oppR.x)) < r
          holds y in B) &
    z0 in U &
    (for x being Element of R st x in U holds
      ex radius being Real,
         coeff being Function of NAT,V st
        0 < radius &
        for z being Element of R st
          normR.(addR.(z,oppR.x)) < radius
        holds
          ex sums being Function of Fin NAT,V st
            sums.{} = zeroV &
            (for A being Element of Fin NAT, n being Nat st not n in A holds
              sums.(A \/ {n}) =
                addV.(sums.A,
                  smul.(powR.(addR.(z,oppR.x),n),coeff.n))) &
            (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
              ex A0 being Element of Fin NAT st
                for A being Element of Fin NAT st A0 c= A holds
                  normV.(addV.(sums.A,oppV.(f.z))) < epsilon)) &
    (for x being Element of R st x in U holds
      ex radius being Real,
         coeff being Function of NAT,V st
        0 < radius &
        for z being Element of R st
          normR.(addR.(z,oppR.x)) < radius
        holds
          ex sums being Function of Fin NAT,V st
            sums.{} = zeroV &
            (for A being Element of Fin NAT, n being Nat st not n in A holds
              sums.(A \/ {n}) =
                addV.(sums.A,
                  smul.(powR.(addR.(z,oppR.x),n),coeff.n))) &
            (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
              ex A0 being Element of Fin NAT st
                for A being Element of Fin NAT st A0 c= A holds
                  normV.(addV.(sums.A,oppV.(g.z))) < epsilon)) &
    (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex z being Element of R st
        z <> z0 &
        normR.(addR.(z,oppR.z0)) < epsilon &
        f.z = g.z)
  holds
    for z being Element of R st z in U holds f.z = g.z

end;
