title: Q1038716_identity_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1038716,
% "Identity theorem": two functions analytic on a preconnected subset of an
% arbitrary nontrivially normed field and frequently equal in a punctured
% neighborhood of a point in the set are equal throughout the set. This file
% contains no proof.

identity_theorem_Q1038716[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroK: K,
  oneK: K,
  addK: [K, K -> K],
  mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK: [K -> K],
  invK: [K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smul: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [K -> bool]
  function_type: TYPE = [K -> E]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]

  subK(x, y: K): K = addK(x, negK(y))

  subE(x, y: E): E = addE(x, negE(y))

  field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        addK(x, zeroK) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
          addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  normed_field_laws: bool =
    field_laws
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        0 <= normK(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        (normK(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroK))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        normK(negK(x)) = normK(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        normK(addK(x, y)) <= normK(x) + normK(y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        normK(mulK(x, y)) = normK(x) * normK(y))
      AND (EXISTS (x: K):
        1 < normK(x))

  additive_normed_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        (normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
      smul(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smul(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smul(mulK(a, b), x) = smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smul(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smul(zeroK, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smul(a, zeroE) = zeroE)

  normed_space_laws: bool =
    additive_normed_group_laws
      AND module_laws
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smul(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  scalar_power(x: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      oneK
    ELSE
      mulK(
        scalar_power(x, exponent - 1),
        x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  power_series_partial_sum(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      delta: K,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        power_series_partial_sum(
          coefficients, delta, count - 1),
        smul(
          scalar_power(delta, count - 1),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  power_series_converges(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      delta: K,
      limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      0 < epsilon IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (count: nat):
            cutoff <= count IMPLIES
              normE(
                subE(
                  power_series_partial_sum(
                    coefficients, delta, count),
                  limit))
                < epsilon

  analytic_at(f: function_type, center: K): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: coefficient_sequence),
        (radius: real):
      0 < radius
        AND FORALL (z: K):
          normK(subK(z, center)) < radius IMPLIES
            power_series_converges(
              coefficients,
              subK(z, center),
              f(z))

  analytic_on_neighborhood(
      f: function_type,
      U: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: K):
      U(x) IMPLIES analytic_at(f, x)

  open_point_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: K):
      S(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          0 < radius
            AND FORALL (y: K):
              normK(subK(y, x)) < radius IMPLIES S(y)

  preconnected(U: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: point_set):
      (open_point_set(A)
        AND open_point_set(B)
        AND (FORALL (x: K):
          U(x) IMPLIES (A(x) OR B(x)))
        AND (EXISTS (x: K):
          U(x) AND A(x))
        AND (EXISTS (x: K):
          U(x) AND B(x)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (x: K):
          U(x) AND A(x) AND B(x)

  frequently_equal_off(
      f, g: function_type,
      center: K): bool =
    FORALL (radius: real):
      0 < radius IMPLIES
        EXISTS (z: K):
          z /= center
            AND normK(subK(z, center)) < radius
            AND f(z) = g(z)

  equal_on(
      f, g: function_type,
      U: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (z: K):
      U(z) IMPLIES f(z) = g(z)

  identity_theorem: bool =
    (normed_field_laws AND normed_space_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (U: point_set),
          (f, g: function_type),
          (z0: K):
        (analytic_on_neighborhood(f, U)
          AND analytic_on_neighborhood(g, U)
          AND preconnected(U)
          AND U(z0)
          AND frequently_equal_off(f, g, z0))
        IMPLIES equal_on(f, g, U)
END identity_theorem_Q1038716

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1047749
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1047749), "Turán's theorem": for positive r, a finite
-- graph is r-Turán-maximal exactly when it is isomorphic to the canonical complete r-partite
-- Turán graph on the same number of vertices. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Extremal.Basic

@[expose] public section

open Fintype

namespace SimpleGraph

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] {r : ℕ}

variable (G) in
/-- An `r + 1`-cliquefree graph is `r`-Turán-maximal if every other such graph on
the same vertex type has at most as many edges. -/
def IsTuranMaximal (r : ℕ) : Prop := G.IsExtremal (CliqueFree · (r + 1))

/-- The canonical complete `r`-partite graph on `Fin n`, with parts indexed by residues modulo `r`. -/
def turanGraph (n r : ℕ) : SimpleGraph (Fin n) where
  Adj v w := v % r ≠ w % r

/-- Turán's theorem: the canonical Turán graph is the unique Turán-maximal graph up to isomorphism. -/
theorem isTuranMaximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph (hr : 0 < r) :
    G.IsTuranMaximal r ↔ Nonempty (G ≃g turanGraph (card V) r) := sorry

end SimpleGraph

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1047749
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1047749), "Turán's theorem": for positive r,
  a finite simple graph has the maximum number of edges among graphs on the
  same vertices with no clique of size r + 1 exactly when it is isomorphic to
  the canonical balanced r-partite Turán graph. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Bool.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1047749_finite_type (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1047749_enum : list A;
  q1047749_enum_nodup : NoDup q1047749_enum;
  q1047749_enum_complete :
    forall x : A, In x q1047749_enum
}.

Arguments q1047749_enum {A} _.

Definition q1047749_card
    {A : Type} (F : q1047749_finite_type A) : nat :=
  length (q1047749_enum F).

Record q1047749_simple_graph (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1047749_adj : A -> A -> bool;
  q1047749_adj_sym :
    forall x y : A, q1047749_adj x y = q1047749_adj y x;
  q1047749_adj_irrefl :
    forall x : A, q1047749_adj x x = false
}.

Arguments q1047749_adj {A} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q1047749_count_neighbors
    {A : Type}
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
    (v : A) (vertices : list A) : nat :=
  match vertices with
  | nil => 0
  | w :: rest =>
      (if q1047749_adj G v w then 1 else 0) +
      q1047749_count_neighbors G v rest
  end.

Fixpoint q1047749_count_edges_in
    {A : Type}
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
    (vertices : list A) : nat :=
  match vertices with
  | nil => 0
  | v :: rest =>
      q1047749_count_neighbors G v rest +
      q1047749_count_edges_in G rest
  end.

Definition q1047749_edge_count
    {A : Type}
    (F : q1047749_finite_type A)
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A) : nat :=
  q1047749_count_edges_in G (q1047749_enum F).

Definition q1047749_injective_on_initial_segment
    {A : Type} (k : nat) (f : nat -> A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    f i = f j ->
    i = j.

Definition q1047749_has_clique_of_size
    {A : Type}
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
    (k : nat) : Prop :=
  exists f : nat -> A,
    q1047749_injective_on_initial_segment k f /\
    forall i j : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      (j < k)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      q1047749_adj G (f i) (f j) = true.

Definition q1047749_clique_free
    {A : Type}
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
    (k : nat) : Prop :=
  ~ q1047749_has_clique_of_size G k.

Definition q1047749_is_turan_maximal
    {A : Type}
    (F : q1047749_finite_type A)
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
    (r : nat) : Prop :=
  q1047749_clique_free G (S r) /\
  forall H : q1047749_simple_graph A,
    q1047749_clique_free H (S r) ->
    (q1047749_edge_count F H <= q1047749_edge_count F G)%nat.

Definition q1047749_nonempty_iso_turan_graph
    {A : Type}
    (F : q1047749_finite_type A)
    (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
    (r : nat) : Prop :=
  exists label : A -> nat,
    (forall x : A,
      (label x < q1047749_card F)%nat) /\
    (forall x y : A,
      label x = label y -> x = y) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < q1047749_card F)%nat ->
      exists x : A, label x = i) /\
    (forall x y : A,
      q1047749_adj G x y =
      negb
        (Nat.eqb
          (Nat.modulo (label x) r)
          (Nat.modulo (label y) r))).

Theorem isTuranMaximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph :
  forall (A : Type)
         (F : q1047749_finite_type A)
         (G : q1047749_simple_graph A)
         (r : nat),
    (0 < r)%nat ->
    (q1047749_is_turan_maximal F G r <->
     q1047749_nonempty_iso_turan_graph F G r).
Admitted.

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1047749 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1047749), "Turán's theorem":
  for a positive number of parts, a finite simple graph is Turán-maximal
  exactly when it is isomorphic to the canonical Turán graph on the same
  number of vertices. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1047749_simple_graph_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1047749_simple_graph_on V G \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>v \<in> V. \<not> G v v) \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> V. \<forall>v \<in> V. G u v \<longleftrightarrow> G v u)"

definition q1047749_edge_set_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'v set set" where
  "q1047749_edge_set_on V G =
    (\<lambda>(u, v). {u, v}) ` {(u, v). u \<in> V \<and> v \<in> V \<and> G u v}"

definition q1047749_clique_free_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1047749_clique_free_on V G k \<longleftrightarrow>
    \<not> (\<exists>f :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'v.
      inj_on f {..<k} \<and>
      f ` {..<k} \<subseteq> V \<and>
      (\<forall>i < k. \<forall>j < k. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow> G (f i) (f j)))"

definition q1047749_is_turan_maximal_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1047749_is_turan_maximal_on V G r \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1047749_simple_graph_on V G \<and>
    q1047749_clique_free_on V G (r + 1) \<and>
    (\<forall>H :: 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool.
      q1047749_simple_graph_on V H \<and>
      q1047749_clique_free_on V H (r + 1)
      \<longrightarrow>
      card (q1047749_edge_set_on V H)
        \<le> card (q1047749_edge_set_on V G))"

definition q1047749_isomorphic_to_turan_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1047749_isomorphic_to_turan_on V G r \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>f :: 'v \<Rightarrow> nat.
      bij_betw f V {..<card V} \<and>
      (\<forall>u \<in> V. \<forall>v \<in> V.
        G u v \<longleftrightarrow> f u mod r \<noteq> f v mod r))"

theorem q1047749_is_turan_maximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turan:
  fixes V :: "'v set"
    and G :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and r :: nat
  assumes "finite V"
    and "q1047749_simple_graph_on V G"
    and "0 < r"
  shows "q1047749_is_turan_maximal_on V G r \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1047749_isomorphic_to_turan_on V G r"
  sorry

end

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1047749,
  "Turán's theorem": for positive r, a finite simple graph is maximal among
  graphs with no (r + 1)-clique exactly when it is isomorphic to the balanced
  complete r-partite Turán graph. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1047749_TURAN_THEOREM =
  `let simple_graph_on =
     \(V:A->bool) (G:A->A->bool).
       (!x. x IN V ==> ~(G x x)) /\
       (!x y. x IN V /\ y IN V ==> (G x y <=> G y x)) in
   let clique_free_on =
     \(V:A->bool) (G:A->A->bool) (k:num).
       ~(?c:A->bool.
           FINITE c /\
           c SUBSET V /\
           CARD c = k /\
           (!x y. x IN c /\ y IN c /\ ~(x = y) ==> G x y)) in
   let directed_edges =
     \(V:A->bool) (G:A->A->bool).
       {(x,y) | x IN V /\ y IN V /\ G x y} in
   let is_turan_maximal =
     \(V:A->bool) (G:A->A->bool) (r:num).
       clique_free_on V G (r + 1) /\
       (!H:A->A->bool.
          simple_graph_on V H /\ clique_free_on V H (r + 1)
          ==> CARD (directed_edges V H) <= CARD (directed_edges V G)) in
   let isomorphic_to_turan =
     \(V:A->bool) (G:A->A->bool) (r:num).
       ?f:A->num.
         (!x. x IN V ==> f x < CARD V) /\
         (!x y. x IN V /\ y IN V /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
         (!i. i < CARD V ==> ?x. x IN V /\ f x = i) /\
         (!x y.
            x IN V /\ y IN V
            ==> (G x y <=> ~(f x MOD r = f y MOD r))) in
   !V:A->bool. !G:A->A->bool. !r:num.
     FINITE V /\ simple_graph_on V G /\ 0 < r
     ==> (is_turan_maximal V G r <=> isomorphic_to_turan V G r)`;;

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1047749,
;; "Turán's theorem": a finite simple graph is r-Turán-maximal exactly when it
;; is isomorphic to the complete r-partite graph whose part sizes differ by at
;; most one, for positive r. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A duplicate-free list is an enumeration of the finite vertex type. An edge
;; is an unordered pair of distinct enumerated vertices. Thus valid edge lists
;; represent exactly the finite simple graphs in the source, independently of
;; the chosen carrier order or the orientation used to write each pair.

(defun q1047749-carrier-p (vertices)
  (and (true-listp vertices)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal vertices)))

(defun q1047749-edge-record-p (edge vertices)
  (and (true-listp edge)
       (equal (len edge) 2)
       (member-equal (nth 0 edge) vertices)
       (member-equal (nth 1 edge) vertices)
       (not (equal (nth 0 edge) (nth 1 edge)))))

(defun q1047749-same-undirected-edge-p (left right)
  (or (and (equal (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
           (equal (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
      (and (equal (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
           (equal (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right)))))

(defun q1047749-edge-distinct-from-list-p (edge remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (not (q1047749-same-undirected-edge-p
                 edge (car remaining)))
           (q1047749-edge-distinct-from-list-p
            edge (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q1047749-edge-list-p (edges vertices)
  (if (consp edges)
      (and (q1047749-edge-record-p (car edges) vertices)
           (q1047749-edge-distinct-from-list-p
            (car edges) (cdr edges))
           (q1047749-edge-list-p (cdr edges) vertices))
    (equal edges nil)))

(defun q1047749-simple-graph-p (vertices edges)
  (and (q1047749-carrier-p vertices)
       (q1047749-edge-list-p edges vertices)))

(defun q1047749-adjacent-p (edges u v)
  (if (or (member-equal (list u v) edges)
          (member-equal (list v u) edges))
      t
    nil))

;; The recursive search below detects a clique of the requested cardinality.
;; Since VERTICES has no duplicates, selecting N vertices produces a genuine
;; N-element set, matching SimpleGraph.CliqueFree.

(defun q1047749-adjacent-to-all-p (vertex chosen edges)
  (if (consp chosen)
      (and (q1047749-adjacent-p
            edges vertex (car chosen))
           (q1047749-adjacent-to-all-p
            vertex (cdr chosen) edges))
    t))

(defun q1047749-has-clique-from-p
    (remaining edges needed chosen)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (cond
   ((zp needed) t)
   ((not (consp remaining)) nil)
   (t
    (or
     (and
      (q1047749-adjacent-to-all-p
       (car remaining) chosen edges)
      (q1047749-has-clique-from-p
       (cdr remaining)
       edges
       (- needed 1)
       (cons (car remaining) chosen)))
     (q1047749-has-clique-from-p
      (cdr remaining) edges needed chosen)))))

(defun q1047749-clique-free-p (vertices edges clique-size)
  (not (q1047749-has-clique-from-p
        vertices edges clique-size nil)))

;; Every finite simple graph on VERTICES is a subset of this list of all
;; unordered pairs. Exhausting all subsets therefore preserves the universal
;; quantifier over competing graphs in IsTuranMaximal.

(defun q1047749-pairs-with (vertex remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (cons (list vertex (car remaining))
            (q1047749-pairs-with
             vertex (cdr remaining)))
    nil))

(defun q1047749-potential-edges (vertices)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (append
       (q1047749-pairs-with
        (car vertices) (cdr vertices))
       (q1047749-potential-edges (cdr vertices)))
    nil))

(defun q1047749-all-clique-free-subsets-bounded-p
    (remaining-potential selected vertices clique-size bound)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining-potential)))
  (if (consp remaining-potential)
      (and
       (q1047749-all-clique-free-subsets-bounded-p
        (cdr remaining-potential)
        (cons (car remaining-potential) selected)
        vertices
        clique-size
        bound)
       (q1047749-all-clique-free-subsets-bounded-p
        (cdr remaining-potential)
        selected
        vertices
        clique-size
        bound))
    (or
     (not (q1047749-clique-free-p
           vertices selected clique-size))
     (<= (len selected) bound))))

(defun q1047749-is-turan-maximal-p (vertices edges r)
  (let ((clique-size (+ r 1)))
    (and
     (q1047749-clique-free-p
      vertices edges clique-size)
     (q1047749-all-clique-free-subsets-bounded-p
      (q1047749-potential-edges vertices)
      nil
      vertices
      clique-size
      (len edges)))))

;; INSERT-AT-SPLITS and PERMUTATIONS enumerate every bijection from the
;; canonical positions 0,...,|V|-1 to V. A labeling is an isomorphism to the
;; source Turán graph exactly when adjacency agrees at every vertex pair with
;; inequality of the position residues modulo r.

(defun q1047749-insert-at-splits (vertex prefix suffix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len suffix)))
  (if (consp suffix)
      (cons
       (append prefix (cons vertex suffix))
       (q1047749-insert-at-splits
        vertex
        (append prefix (list (car suffix)))
        (cdr suffix)))
    (list (append prefix (list vertex)))))

(defun q1047749-insert-into-permutations
    (vertex permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (append
       (q1047749-insert-at-splits
        vertex nil (car permutations))
       (q1047749-insert-into-permutations
        vertex (cdr permutations)))
    nil))

(defun q1047749-permutations (vertices)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (q1047749-insert-into-permutations
       (car vertices)
       (q1047749-permutations (cdr vertices)))
    (list nil)))

(defun q1047749-turan-row-p
    (vertex remaining edges r left-index right-index)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (equal
        (q1047749-adjacent-p
         edges vertex (car remaining))
        (not
         (equal
          (mod left-index r)
          (mod right-index r))))
       (q1047749-turan-row-p
        vertex
        (cdr remaining)
        edges
        r
        left-index
        (+ right-index 1)))
    t))

(defun q1047749-turan-labeling-p
    (labeling edges r index)
  (if (consp labeling)
      (and
       (q1047749-turan-row-p
        (car labeling)
        (cdr labeling)
        edges
        r
        index
        (+ index 1))
       (q1047749-turan-labeling-p
        (cdr labeling)
        edges
        r
        (+ index 1)))
    t))

(defun q1047749-some-turan-labeling-p
    (labelings edges r)
  (if (consp labelings)
      (or
       (q1047749-turan-labeling-p
        (car labelings) edges r 0)
       (q1047749-some-turan-labeling-p
        (cdr labelings) edges r))
    nil))

(defun q1047749-nonempty-iso-turan-graph-p
    (vertices edges r)
  (q1047749-some-turan-labeling-p
   (q1047749-permutations vertices)
   edges
   r))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1047749-turans-theorem-statement
    (vertices edges r)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp r)
    (< 0 r)
    (q1047749-simple-graph-p vertices edges))
   (equal
    (q1047749-is-turan-maximal-p
     vertices edges r)
    (q1047749-nonempty-iso-turan-graph-p
     vertices edges r))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1047749,
-- "Turán's theorem": for positive r, a finite simple graph is r-Turán-maximal
-- exactly when it is isomorphic to the canonical residue-class Turán graph.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true; false)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; mod-helper)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_
infix 2 _↔_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition → Bottom

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Positive : Nat → Set where
  positive : {n : Nat} → Positive (suc n)

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤    : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc  : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

FinitePresentation :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
FinitePresentation A =
  Σ Nat (λ cardinality → Bijection A (Fin cardinality))

record SimpleGraph
  {a : Level}
  (V : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    adjacent  : V → V → Bool
    loopless  : (v : V) → adjacent v v ≡ false
    symmetric : (v w : V) → adjacent v w ≡ adjacent w v

open Bijection
open SimpleGraph

notBool : Bool → Bool
notBool true =
  false
notBool false =
  true

andBool : Bool → Bool → Bool
andBool true right =
  right
andBool false right =
  false

indicator : Bool → Nat
indicator true =
  suc zero
indicator false =
  zero

finLess :
  {n : Nat} →
  Fin n →
  Fin n →
  Bool
finLess fzero fzero =
  false
finLess fzero (fsuc j) =
  true
finLess (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finLess (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finLess i j

finToNat :
  {n : Nat} →
  Fin n →
  Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

natEqual :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc right) =
  false
natEqual (suc left) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc left) (suc right) =
  natEqual left right

naturalMod :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

countFin :
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → Bool) →
  Nat
countFin {zero} predicate =
  zero
countFin {suc n} predicate =
  indicator (predicate fzero) +
  countFin (λ i → predicate (fsuc i))

sumFin :
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → Nat) →
  Nat
sumFin {zero} term =
  zero
sumFin {suc n} term =
  term fzero +
  sumFin (λ i → term (fsuc i))

cardinality :
  {a : Level} →
  {V : Set a} →
  FinitePresentation V →
  Nat
cardinality finite =
  Σ.fst finite

enumeration :
  {a : Level} →
  {V : Set a} →
  (finite : FinitePresentation V) →
  Bijection V (Fin (cardinality finite))
enumeration finite =
  Σ.snd finite

edgeCount :
  {a : Level} →
  {V : Set a} →
  FinitePresentation V →
  SimpleGraph V →
  Nat
edgeCount finite graph =
  sumFin
    (λ i →
      countFin
        (λ j →
          andBool
            (finLess i j)
            (adjacent graph
              (from (enumeration finite) i)
              (from (enumeration finite) j))))

Injective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) →
  function x ≡ function y →
  x ≡ y

PairwiseAdjacent :
  {a : Level} →
  {V : Set a} →
  {k : Nat} →
  SimpleGraph V →
  (Fin k → V) →
  Set
PairwiseAdjacent graph vertices =
  (i j : Fin _) →
  Not (i ≡ j) →
  adjacent graph (vertices i) (vertices j) ≡ true

CliqueEmbedding :
  {a : Level} →
  {V : Set a} →
  SimpleGraph V →
  Nat →
  Set a
CliqueEmbedding {V = V} graph k =
  Σ (Fin k → V)
    (λ vertices →
      Injective vertices ×
      PairwiseAdjacent graph vertices)

CliqueFree :
  {a : Level} →
  {V : Set a} →
  SimpleGraph V →
  Nat →
  Set a
CliqueFree graph k =
  Not (CliqueEmbedding graph k)

record IsTuranMaximal
  {a : Level}
  {V : Set a}
  (finite : FinitePresentation V)
  (graph : SimpleGraph V)
  (r : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    clique-free :
      CliqueFree graph (suc r)
    maximal :
      (other : SimpleGraph V) →
      CliqueFree other (suc r) →
      edgeCount finite other ≤ edgeCount finite graph

turanAdjacent :
  {n : Nat} →
  Nat →
  Fin n →
  Fin n →
  Bool
turanAdjacent r left right =
  notBool
    (natEqual
      (naturalMod (finToNat left) r)
      (naturalMod (finToNat right) r))

record IsomorphicToTuranGraph
  {a : Level}
  {V : Set a}
  (finite : FinitePresentation V)
  (graph : SimpleGraph V)
  (r : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    relabel :
      Bijection V (Fin (cardinality finite))
    adjacency-equivalence :
      (v w : V) →
      adjacent graph v w ≡
      turanAdjacent r (to relabel v) (to relabel w)

turan-s-theorem :
  {a : Level} →
  Set (lsuc a)
turan-s-theorem {a} =
  (V : Set a) →
  (finite : FinitePresentation V) →
  (graph : SimpleGraph V) →
  (r : Nat) →
  Positive r →
  IsTuranMaximal finite graph r
    ↔
  IsomorphicToTuranGraph finite graph r

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1047749,
  "Turán's theorem": a finite simple graph is maximal among graphs with no
  (r + 1)-clique exactly when it is isomorphic to the balanced complete
  r-partite Turán graph. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val q1047749_simple_graph_def = new_definition (
  "q1047749_simple_graph_def",
  ``q1047749_simple_graph
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
         adj u v ==> u IN vertices /\ v IN vertices) /\
      (!(v : 'a). ~adj v v) /\
      (!(u : 'a) (v : 'a). adj u v <=> adj v u)``);

val q1047749_edge_arcs_def = new_definition (
  "q1047749_edge_arcs_def",
  ``q1047749_edge_arcs
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool) =
      {p : 'a # 'a |
         FST p IN vertices /\
         SND p IN vertices /\
         adj (FST p) (SND p)}``);

val q1047749_clique_free_def = new_definition (
  "q1047749_clique_free_def",
  ``q1047749_clique_free
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (k : num) <=>
      ~(?C : 'a set.
          FINITE C /\
          C SUBSET vertices /\
          CARD C = k /\
          !(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
            u IN C /\ v IN C /\ u <> v
            ==>
            adj u v)``);

val q1047749_is_turan_maximal_def = new_definition (
  "q1047749_is_turan_maximal_def",
  ``q1047749_is_turan_maximal
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (r : num) <=>
      q1047749_clique_free vertices adj (r + 1) /\
      !other : 'a -> 'a -> bool.
        q1047749_simple_graph vertices other /\
        q1047749_clique_free vertices other (r + 1)
        ==>
        CARD (q1047749_edge_arcs vertices other) <=
        CARD (q1047749_edge_arcs vertices adj)``);

val isTuranMaximal_iff_nonempty_iso_turanGraph =
  ``!vertices : 'a set. !adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool. !r : num.
      FINITE vertices /\
      q1047749_simple_graph vertices adj /\
      0 < r
      ==>
      (q1047749_is_turan_maximal vertices adj r
       <=>
       ?f : 'a -> num.
         BIJ f vertices {i : num | i < CARD vertices} /\
         !(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
           u IN vertices /\ v IN vertices
           ==>
           (adj u v <=> f u MOD r <> f v MOD r))``;

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1047749
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1047749), "Turan's theorem": for a positive
  natural number r, a finite simple graph is maximal by edge count among
  graphs with no clique of size r + 1 exactly when it is isomorphic to the
  canonical Turan graph with adjacency determined by unequal residues
  modulo r. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Finite Lean vertex types are represented by arbitrary finite sets V.
  Q1047749SimpleGraph says that G is an irreflexive symmetric relation on V.
  Q1047749CliqueFree excludes a subset of V of the specified finite
  cardinality whose distinct vertices are pairwise adjacent.

  Q1047749Edges is the set of unordered two-element edges. Thus its finite
  cardinality is the source edgeFinset cardinality. Q1047749TuranMaximal
  states both (r + 1)-clique-freeness and maximal edge count among all simple
  graphs on the same vertex set satisfying that condition.

  Q1047749IsoTuran internally quantifies a bijection from V to the canonical
  n-element set 0 ..^ (# V) and requires adjacency to correspond in both
  directions to unequal residues modulo r. This is exactly graph
  isomorphism with turanGraph (card V) r; no witness has been externalized.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. The
  preceding $a declarations are syntax and faithful definitions only. This
  file introduces no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1047749SimpleGraph Q1047749CliqueFree Q1047749Edges $.
$c Q1047749TuranMaximal Q1047749IsoTuran $.

q1047749-simple-graph-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1047749SimpleGraph V G ) $.
q1047749-clique-free-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1047749CliqueFree V G r ) $.
q1047749-edges-syntax $a
  class ( Q1047749Edges V G ) $.
q1047749-turan-maximal-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1047749TuranMaximal V G r ) $.
q1047749-iso-turan-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1047749IsoTuran V G r ) $.

${
  $d G V u v $.

  q1047749-simple-graph-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1047749SimpleGraph V G )
    <->
    (
      G C_ ( V X. V )
      /\
      (
        A. u e. V -. <. u , u >. e. G
        /\
        A. u e. V A. v e. V
          ( <. u , v >. e. G -> <. v , u >. e. G )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G K V r u v $.

  q1047749-clique-free-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1047749CliqueFree V G r )
    <->
    -.
    E. K
      (
        (
          K C_ V
          /\
          ( # ` K ) = r
        )
        /\
        A. u e. K A. v e. K
          ( u =/= v -> <. u , v >. e. G )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G K V u v $.

  q1047749-edges-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1047749Edges V G )
    =
    { K e. ~P V |
      E. u e. V E. v e. V
        (
          K = { u , v }
          /\
          (
            u =/= v
            /\
            <. u , v >. e. G
          )
        )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H V r $.

  q1047749-turan-maximal-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1047749TuranMaximal V G r )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1047749SimpleGraph V G )
      /\
      (
        ( Q1047749CliqueFree V G ( r + 1 ) )
        /\
        A. H
          (
            (
              ( Q1047749SimpleGraph V H )
              /\
              ( Q1047749CliqueFree V H ( r + 1 ) )
            )
            ->
            (
              ( # ` ( Q1047749Edges V H ) )
              <_
              ( # ` ( Q1047749Edges V G ) )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G V f r u v $.

  q1047749-iso-turan-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1047749IsoTuran V G r )
    <->
    E. f
      (
        f : V -1-1-onto-> ( 0 ..^ ( # ` V ) )
        /\
        A. u e. V A. v e. V
          (
            <. u , v >. e. G
            <->
            ( ( ( f ` u ) mod r ) =/= ( ( f ` v ) mod r ) )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G V r $.

  thousand-theorems-q1047749-turan $a |- (
    A. V A. G A. r
      (
        (
          (
            V e. Fin
            /\
            r e. NN
          )
          /\
          ( Q1047749SimpleGraph V G )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( Q1047749TuranMaximal V G r )
          <->
          ( Q1047749IsoTuran V G r )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1047749,
:: "Turán's theorem": a finite simple graph has the maximum number of edges
:: among graphs on the same vertices with no clique of size r+1 exactly when
:: it is isomorphic to the balanced complete r-partite graph. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ORDINAL1, FINSET_1, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, INT_1, INT_2, CARD_3, MEMBERED;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, INT_1, INT_2, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1,
    MEMBERED, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSET_1;
  constructors REAL_1, NAT_D, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS,
    RVSUM_1, FINSEQOP, FINSET_1, CARD_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
    XREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, CARD_1, MEMBERED, FINSET_1, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for V being finite set
  for G being Relation of V
  for r being Nat st
    0 < r &
    (for x being Element of V holds not [x,x] in G) &
    (for x,y being Element of V st [x,y] in G holds [y,x] in G)
  holds
    (((not ex C being finite Subset of V st
          card C = r + 1 &
          (for x,y being Element of V st
            x in C & y in C & x <> y holds [x,y] in G)) &
      (for H being Relation of V st
        (for x being Element of V holds not [x,x] in H) &
        (for x,y being Element of V st [x,y] in H holds [y,x] in H) &
        not ex C being finite Subset of V st
          card C = r + 1 &
          (for x,y being Element of V st
            x in C & y in C & x <> y holds [x,y] in H)
       holds card H <= card G))
    iff
      ex f being Function of V, Seg card V st
        f is one-to-one & rng f = Seg card V &
        for x,y being Element of V holds
          ([x,y] in G iff
            x <> y & (f.x -' 1) mod r <> (f.y -' 1) mod r))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1047749_tur_n_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1047749,
% "Turán's theorem": a finite simple graph is maximal among graphs with no
% clique of size r + 1 exactly when it is isomorphic to the canonical complete
% r-partite Turán graph with parts as equal in size as possible. This file contains no proof.

turan_s_theorem_Q1047749[V: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  graph: TYPE = [V, V -> bool]
  vertex_pair: TYPE = [# left_vertex: V, right_vertex: V #]

  simple_graph(G: graph): bool =
    (FORALL (v: V): NOT G(v, v))
      AND
    (FORALL (v, w: V): G(v, w) IFF G(w, v))

  injective_vertices(
      count: nat,
      vertices: [below(count) -> V]): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: below(count)):
      vertices(i) = vertices(j) IMPLIES i = j

  clique_embedding(
      G: graph,
      count: nat,
      vertices: [below(count) -> V]): bool =
    injective_vertices(count, vertices)
      AND
    (FORALL (i, j: below(count)):
      i /= j IMPLIES G(vertices(i), vertices(j)))

  clique_free(G: graph, count: nat): bool =
    NOT EXISTS (vertices: [below(count) -> V]):
      clique_embedding(G, count, vertices)

  % For a loopless symmetric graph, every unordered edge has exactly two
  % ordered orientations. Comparing ordered-edge counts is therefore
  % equivalent to comparing the source graph's unordered edge counts.
  enumerates_ordered_edges(
      G: graph,
      count: nat,
      enumeration: [below(count) -> vertex_pair]): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: below(count)):
      enumeration(i) = enumeration(j) IMPLIES i = j)
      AND
    (FORALL (edge: vertex_pair):
      G(left_vertex(edge), right_vertex(edge))
        IFF
      EXISTS (i: below(count)): enumeration(i) = edge)

  has_ordered_edge_count(G: graph, count: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [below(count) -> vertex_pair]):
      enumerates_ordered_edges(G, count, enumeration)

  ordered_edge_count_le(H, G: graph): bool =
    EXISTS (h_count, g_count: nat):
      has_ordered_edge_count(H, h_count)
        AND has_ordered_edge_count(G, g_count)
        AND h_count <= g_count

  is_turan_maximal(G: graph, r: nat): bool =
    simple_graph(G)
      AND clique_free(G, r + 1)
      AND
    (FORALL (H: graph):
      simple_graph(H) AND clique_free(H, r + 1)
        IMPLIES ordered_edge_count_le(H, G))

  bijection_to_below(n: nat, index_of: [V -> below(n)]): bool =
    (FORALL (v, w: V):
      index_of(v) = index_of(w) IMPLIES v = w)
      AND
    (FORALL (i: below(n)):
      EXISTS (v: V): index_of(v) = i)

  finite_vertex_type: bool =
    EXISTS (n: nat):
      EXISTS (index_of: [V -> below(n)]):
        bijection_to_below(n, index_of)

  turan_adj(n, r: nat, i, j: below(n)): bool =
    IF r = 0 THEN
      i /= j
    ELSE
      mod(i, r) /= mod(j, r)
    ENDIF

  isomorphic_to_turan(G: graph, r: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (n: nat):
      EXISTS (index_of: [V -> below(n)]):
        bijection_to_below(n, index_of)
          AND
        (FORALL (v, w: V):
          G(v, w)
            IFF turan_adj(n, r, index_of(v), index_of(w)))

  turan_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (G: graph), (r: nat):
      (simple_graph(G)
        AND finite_vertex_type
        AND 0 < r)
      IMPLIES
        (is_turan_maximal(G, r)
          IFF isomorphic_to_turan(G, r))
END turan_s_theorem_Q1047749

title: Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1050203
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1050203), "Cantor's intersection theorem": the total
-- intersection of a nonempty downward-directed family of nonempty compact closed sets is
-- nonempty. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Order.Filter.Tendsto

@[expose] public section

open Set Filter Topology TopologicalSpace Function

universe u

variable {X : Type u}

/-- Cantor's intersection theorem for a set of sets. -/
theorem IsCompact.nonempty_sInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed
    {S : Set (Set X)} [hS : Nonempty S] (hSd : DirectedOn (· ⊇ ·) S) (hSn : ∀ U ∈ S, U.Nonempty)
    (hSc : ∀ U ∈ S, IsCompact U) (hScl : ∀ U ∈ S, IsClosed U) : (⋂₀ S).Nonempty := sorry

title: Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1050203
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1050203), "Cantor's intersection theorem": the
  intersection of a nonempty downward-directed family of nonempty compact
  closed subsets of an arbitrary topological space is nonempty.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q1050203_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1050203_same_set
    {A : Type}
    (U V : q1050203_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x <-> V x.

Record q1050203_family (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1050203_member : q1050203_set X -> Prop;
  q1050203_member_ext :
    forall U V : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_same_set U V ->
      (q1050203_member U <-> q1050203_member V)
}.

Arguments q1050203_member {X} _ _.

Record q1050203_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1050203_is_open : q1050203_set X -> Prop;
  q1050203_open_ext :
    forall U V : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_same_set U V ->
      (q1050203_is_open U <-> q1050203_is_open V);
  q1050203_open_univ :
    q1050203_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1050203_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_is_open U ->
      q1050203_is_open V ->
      q1050203_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1050203_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q1050203_family X,
      (forall U : q1050203_set X,
        q1050203_member family U -> q1050203_is_open U) ->
      q1050203_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1050203_set X,
            q1050203_member family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1050203_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q1050203_is_closed
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1050203_topological_space X)
    (U : q1050203_set X) : Prop :=
  q1050203_is_open T (fun x : X => ~ U x).

Definition q1050203_is_compact
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1050203_topological_space X)
    (U : q1050203_set X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q1050203_family X,
    (forall V : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_member cover V -> q1050203_is_open T V) ->
    (forall x : X,
      U x ->
      exists V : q1050203_set X,
        q1050203_member cover V /\ V x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q1050203_set X),
      Forall (fun V => q1050203_member cover V) finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        U x ->
        exists V : q1050203_set X,
          In V finite_cover /\ V x.

Definition q1050203_nonempty_set
    {X : Type} (U : q1050203_set X) : Prop :=
  exists x : X, U x.

Definition q1050203_nonempty_family
    {X : Type}
    (S : q1050203_family X) : Prop :=
  exists U : q1050203_set X, q1050203_member S U.

Definition q1050203_directed_on_reverse_inclusion
    {X : Type}
    (S : q1050203_family X) : Prop :=
  forall U V : q1050203_set X,
    q1050203_member S U ->
    q1050203_member S V ->
    exists W : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_member S W /\
      (forall x : X, W x -> U x) /\
      (forall x : X, W x -> V x).

Definition q1050203_sInter
    {X : Type}
    (S : q1050203_family X) : q1050203_set X :=
  fun x : X =>
    forall U : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_member S U -> U x.

Theorem nonempty_sInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed :
  forall (X : Type)
         (T : q1050203_topological_space X)
         (S : q1050203_family X),
    q1050203_nonempty_family S ->
    q1050203_directed_on_reverse_inclusion S ->
    (forall U : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_member S U -> q1050203_nonempty_set U) ->
    (forall U : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_member S U -> q1050203_is_compact T U) ->
    (forall U : q1050203_set X,
      q1050203_member S U -> q1050203_is_closed T U) ->
    q1050203_nonempty_set (q1050203_sInter S).
Admitted.

title: Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1050203,
  "Cantor's intersection theorem": a nonempty downward-directed family of
  nonempty compact closed sets has nonempty intersection. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
  imports "HOL.Topological_Spaces"
begin

theorem cantor_s_intersection:
  fixes S :: "'a::topological_space set set"
  assumes "S \<noteq> {}"
    and "\<And>U V. U \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> V \<in> S \<Longrightarrow>
      \<exists>W \<in> S. W \<subseteq> U \<and> W \<subseteq> V"
    and "\<And>U. U \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> U \<noteq> {}"
    and "\<And>U. U \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> compact U"
    and "\<And>U. U \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> closed U"
  shows "\<Inter>S \<noteq> {}"
  sorry

end

title: Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1050203,
  "Cantor's intersection theorem": every nonempty downward-directed family of
  nonempty compact closed subsets of an arbitrary topological space has
  nonempty total intersection. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1050203_CANTOR_INTERSECTION_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (UNIV:A->bool) /\
       (!C:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
       (!U V:A->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let is_closed =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (U:A->bool).
       open_sets ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF U) in
   let is_compact =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (K:A->bool).
       !C:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U) /\
         K SUBSET UNIONS C
         ==> ?D:(A->bool)->bool.
               D SUBSET C /\
               FINITE D /\
               K SUBSET UNIONS D in
   !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool.
   !S:(A->bool)->bool.
     is_topology open_sets /\
     (?U:A->bool. U IN S) /\
     (!U V:A->bool.
        U IN S /\ V IN S
        ==> ?W:A->bool. W IN S /\ W SUBSET U /\ W SUBSET V) /\
     (!U:A->bool.
        U IN S
        ==> ~(U = {}) /\
            is_compact open_sets U /\
            is_closed open_sets U)
     ==> ?x:A. x IN INTERS S`;;

title: Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1050203,
;; "Cantor's intersection theorem": a nonempty downward-directed family of
;; nonempty compact closed subsets of an arbitrary topological space has
;; nonempty total intersection. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Sets, families of sets, and the topology are characteristic function
;; objects over an arbitrary carrier. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal
;; quantification; its negation supplies internal existential witnesses.

(defun q1050203-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1050203-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q1050203-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1050203-quoted nil)))

(defun q1050203-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q1050203-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1050203-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1050203-apply-term

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1050203,
-- "Cantor's intersection theorem": a nonempty downward-directed family of
-- nonempty compact closed subsets of a topological space has nonempty total
-- intersection. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} →
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

Subset :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X → Set a

Family :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Family {a} X =
  Subset X → Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X
Empty {a} x =
  Bottom {a}

Union :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  V x

NonemptySet :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Set a
NonemptySet {X = X} U =
  Σ X U

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      Subset X →
      Subset X

    close-empty :
      (x : X) →
      close Empty x →
      Bottom {a}

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-monotone :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U V →
      SubsetOf (close U) (close V)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      (x : X) →
      close (Union U V) x →
      Either (close U x) (close V x)

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      (x : X) →
      Either (close U x) (close V x) →
      close (Union U V) x

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

Covers :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
Covers {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  Σ (Subset X)
    (λ V →
      cover V × V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} U cover =
  Σ (List (Subset X))
    (λ selected →
      ((V : Subset X) →
        Member V selected →
        cover V)
      ×
      ((x : X) →
        U x →
        Σ (Subset X)
          (λ V →
            Member V selected × V x)))

Compact :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set (lsuc a)
Compact {X = X} topology U =
  (cover : Family X) →
  ((V : Subset X) →
    cover V →
    IsOpen topology V) →
  Covers U cover →
  FiniteSubcover U cover

NonemptyFamily :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
NonemptyFamily {X = X} S =
  Σ (Subset X) S

DirectedDown :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
DirectedDown {X = X} S =
  (U V : Subset X) →
  S U →
  S V →
  Σ (Subset X)
    (λ W →
      S W
      ×
      (SubsetOf W U × SubsetOf W V))

TotalIntersectionNonempty :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
TotalIntersectionNonempty {X = X} S =
  Σ X
    (λ x →
      (U : Subset X) →
      S U →
      U x)

cantor-s-intersection-theorem :
  {a : Level} →
  Set (lsuc a)
cantor-s-intersection-theorem {a} =
  (X : Set a) →
  (topology : TopologicalSpace X) →
  (S : Family X) →
  NonemptyFamily S →
  DirectedDown S →
  ((U : Subset X) →
    S U →
    NonemptySet U) →
  ((U : Subset X) →
    S U →
    Compact topology U) →
  ((U : Subset X) →
    S U →
    IsClosed topology U) →
  TotalIntersectionNonempty S

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1050203 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1050203), "Cantor's intersection
  theorem": a nonempty downward-directed family of nonempty compact closed
  sets has nonempty total intersection. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory;

val IsCompact_nonempty_sInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed =
  ``!(top : 'a topology) (S : ('a set) set).
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      S <> {} /\
      (!U : 'a set. U IN S ==> U <> {}) /\
      (!U : 'a set. U IN S ==> compact_in top U) /\
      (!U : 'a set. U IN S ==> closed_in top U) /\
      (!U V : 'a set.
         U IN S /\ V IN S
         ==>
         ?W : 'a set. W IN S /\ W SUBSET U /\ W SUBSET V)
      ==>
      BIGINTER S <> {}``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

title: Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
Q1050203_cantor_s_intersection_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1050203,
% "Cantor's intersection theorem": a nonempty family directed downward by
% inclusion, whose members are nonempty compact closed sets, has nonempty
% intersection. This file contains no proof.

cantors_intersection_theorem_Q1050203[
  X: TYPE,
  open_sets: [[X -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point_set]

  finite_family: TYPE = finite_set[point_set]

  empty_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  whole_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE

  complement(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): NOT A(x)

  binary_intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): A(x) AND B(x)

  union_of_family(F: set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (U: point_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  union_of_finite_family(F: finite_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (U: point_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  intersection_of_family(F: set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      FORALL (U: point_set):
        F(U) IMPLIES U(x)

  subset_of(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  nonempty_point_set(A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: X): A(x)

  nonempty_family(F: set_family): bool =
    EXISTS (U: point_set): F(U)

  topology_laws: bool =
    open_sets(empty_point_set)
      AND open_sets(whole_point_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
          (open_sets(A) AND open_sets(B))
            IMPLIES open_sets(binary_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
        (FORALL (F: set_family):
          (FORALL (U: point_set):
            F(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
          IMPLIES open_sets(union_of_family(F)))

  closed_point_set(A: point_set): bool =
    open_sets(complement(A))

  open_cover(C: set_family, A: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
      AND subset_of(A, union_of_family(C))

  compact_point_set(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: set_family):
      open_cover(C, A)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (D: finite_family):
            (FORALL (U: point_set):
              D(U) IMPLIES C(U))
              AND subset_of(A, union_of_finite_family(D))

  reverse_inclusion_directed(F: set_family): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: point_set):
      (F(A) AND F(B))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (C: point_set):
            F(C) AND subset_of(C, A) AND subset_of(C, B)

  cantors_intersection_theorem: bool =
    topology_laws
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (S: set_family):
          (nonempty_family(S)
            AND reverse_inclusion_directed(S)
            AND
              (FORALL (U: point_set):
                S(U) IMPLIES nonempty_point_set(U))
            AND
              (FORALL (U: point_set):
                S(U) IMPLIES compact_point_set(U))
            AND
              (FORALL (U: point_set):
                S(U) IMPLIES closed_point_set(U)))
          IMPLIES nonempty_point_set(intersection_of_family(S))
END cantors_intersection_theorem_Q1050203

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1050932
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1050932), "Hartogs's theorem": a function from
-- `ℂ × ℂ` to a separable complex Banach space that is analytic in each coordinate
-- separately at every point of an open set is jointly analytic there. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Analytic.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Basic

/-- Hartogs's theorem on `ℂ × ℂ`: separately analytic functions are jointly analytic. -/
theorem Pair.hartogs {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    [SecondCountableTopology E] {f : ℂ × ℂ → E} {s : Set (ℂ × ℂ)} (so : IsOpen s)
    (fa0 : ∀ c0 c1, (c0, c1) ∈ s → AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z0 ↦ f (z0, c1)) c0)
    (fa1 : ∀ c0 c1, (c0, c1) ∈ s → AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z1 ↦ f (c0, z1)) c1) :
