title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1050932
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1050932), "Hartogs's theorem": a function from
  an open subset of the complex plane squared to a complete second-countable
  complex normed space is jointly analytic when it is analytic separately in
  each complex coordinate. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1050932_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1050932_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.
Definition q1050932_complex_pair : Type :=
  (q1050932_complex * q1050932_complex)%type.

Definition q1050932_czero : q1050932_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q1050932_cone : q1050932_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q1050932_cadd
    (z w : q1050932_complex) : q1050932_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q1050932_cneg
    (z : q1050932_complex) : q1050932_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q1050932_csub
    (z w : q1050932_complex) : q1050932_complex :=
  q1050932_cadd z (q1050932_cneg w).

Definition q1050932_cmul
    (z w : q1050932_complex) : q1050932_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q1050932_cmodulus
    (z : q1050932_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Definition q1050932_pair_zero : q1050932_complex_pair :=
  (q1050932_czero, q1050932_czero).

Definition q1050932_pair_add
    (x y : q1050932_complex_pair) : q1050932_complex_pair :=
  (q1050932_cadd (fst x) (fst y),
   q1050932_cadd (snd x) (snd y)).

Definition q1050932_pair_smul
    (a : q1050932_complex)
    (x : q1050932_complex_pair) : q1050932_complex_pair :=
  (q1050932_cmul a (fst x), q1050932_cmul a (snd x)).

Definition q1050932_pair_sub
    (x y : q1050932_complex_pair) : q1050932_complex_pair :=
  (q1050932_csub (fst x) (fst y),
   q1050932_csub (snd x) (snd y)).

Definition q1050932_pair_norm
    (x : q1050932_complex_pair) : R :=
  Rmax (q1050932_cmodulus (fst x)) (q1050932_cmodulus (snd x)).

Record q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1050932_zero : E;
  q1050932_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1050932_neg : E -> E;
  q1050932_smul : q1050932_complex -> E -> E;
  q1050932_norm : E -> R;

  q1050932_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1050932_add x (q1050932_add y z) =
      q1050932_add (q1050932_add x y) z;
  q1050932_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1050932_add x y = q1050932_add y x;
  q1050932_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1050932_add x q1050932_zero = x;
  q1050932_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1050932_add x (q1050932_neg x) = q1050932_zero;

  q1050932_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1050932_smul q1050932_cone x = x;
  q1050932_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q1050932_complex) (x : E),
      q1050932_smul (q1050932_cmul a b) x =
      q1050932_smul a (q1050932_smul b x);
  q1050932_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q1050932_complex) (x : E),
      q1050932_smul (q1050932_cadd a b) x =
      q1050932_add
        (q1050932_smul a x) (q1050932_smul b x);
  q1050932_smul_add :
    forall (a : q1050932_complex) (x y : E),
      q1050932_smul a (q1050932_add x y) =
      q1050932_add
        (q1050932_smul a x) (q1050932_smul a y);
  q1050932_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q1050932_smul q1050932_czero x = q1050932_zero;
  q1050932_smul_zero :
    forall a : q1050932_complex,
      q1050932_smul a q1050932_zero = q1050932_zero;

  q1050932_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1050932_norm x;
  q1050932_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q1050932_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1050932_zero;
  q1050932_norm_neg :
    forall x : E, q1050932_norm (q1050932_neg x) = q1050932_norm x;
  q1050932_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1050932_norm (q1050932_add x y) <=
      q1050932_norm x + q1050932_norm y;
  q1050932_norm_smul :
    forall (a : q1050932_complex) (x : E),
      q1050932_norm (q1050932_smul a x) =
      q1050932_cmodulus a * q1050932_norm x
}.

Arguments q1050932_zero {E} _.
Arguments q1050932_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1050932_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q1050932_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1050932_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q1050932_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1050932_add V x (q1050932_neg V y).

Definition q1050932_dist
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : R :=
  q1050932_norm V (q1050932_sub V x y).

Definition q1050932_sequence_converges
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat ->
      q1050932_dist V (u n) limit < epsilon.

Definition q1050932_sequence_cauchy
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall m n : nat,
      (N <= m)%nat ->
      (N <= n)%nat ->
      q1050932_dist V (u m) (u n) < epsilon.

Definition q1050932_complete
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q1050932_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : E, q1050932_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q1050932_open_in_E
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (U : q1050932_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E, U x ->
    exists radius : R, 0 < radius /\
      forall y : E, q1050932_dist V y x < radius -> U y.

Definition q1050932_second_countable
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q1050932_set E,
    (forall n : nat, q1050932_open_in_E V (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q1050932_set E) (x : E),
      q1050932_open_in_E V U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\
        forall y : E, basis n y -> U y.

Record q1050932_scalar_linear_map
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q1050932_scalar_linear_apply : q1050932_complex -> E;
  q1050932_scalar_linear_add :
    forall z w : q1050932_complex,
      q1050932_scalar_linear_apply (q1050932_cadd z w) =
      q1050932_add V
        (q1050932_scalar_linear_apply z)
        (q1050932_scalar_linear_apply w);
  q1050932_scalar_linear_smul :
    forall z w : q1050932_complex,
      q1050932_scalar_linear_apply (q1050932_cmul z w) =
      q1050932_smul V z (q1050932_scalar_linear_apply w);
  q1050932_scalar_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall z : q1050932_complex,
        q1050932_norm V (q1050932_scalar_linear_apply z) <=
        bound * q1050932_cmodulus z
}.

Arguments q1050932_scalar_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Record q1050932_pair_linear_map
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q1050932_pair_linear_apply : q1050932_complex_pair -> E;
  q1050932_pair_linear_add :
    forall x y : q1050932_complex_pair,
      q1050932_pair_linear_apply (q1050932_pair_add x y) =
      q1050932_add V
        (q1050932_pair_linear_apply x)
        (q1050932_pair_linear_apply y);
  q1050932_pair_linear_smul :
    forall (a : q1050932_complex) (x : q1050932_complex_pair),
      q1050932_pair_linear_apply (q1050932_pair_smul a x) =
      q1050932_smul V a (q1050932_pair_linear_apply x);
  q1050932_pair_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : q1050932_complex_pair,
        q1050932_norm V (q1050932_pair_linear_apply x) <=
        bound * q1050932_pair_norm x
}.

Arguments q1050932_pair_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Definition q1050932_has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex -> E)
    (x : q1050932_complex)
    (D : q1050932_scalar_linear_map V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R, 0 < delta /\
      forall h : q1050932_complex,
        q1050932_cmodulus h < delta ->
        q1050932_norm V
          (q1050932_sub V
            (q1050932_sub V (f (q1050932_cadd x h)) (f x))
            (q1050932_scalar_linear_apply D h)) <=
        epsilon * q1050932_cmodulus h.

Definition q1050932_scalar_differentiable_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex -> E)
    (x : q1050932_complex) : Prop :=
  exists D : q1050932_scalar_linear_map V,
    @q1050932_has_scalar_frechet_derivative_at E V f x D.

Definition q1050932_scalar_analytic_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex -> E)
    (x : q1050932_complex) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R, 0 < radius /\
    forall y : q1050932_complex,
      q1050932_cmodulus (q1050932_csub y x) < radius ->
      @q1050932_scalar_differentiable_at E V f y.

Definition q1050932_has_pair_frechet_derivative_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex_pair -> E)
    (x : q1050932_complex_pair)
    (D : q1050932_pair_linear_map V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R, 0 < delta /\
      forall h : q1050932_complex_pair,
        q1050932_pair_norm h < delta ->
        q1050932_norm V
          (q1050932_sub V
            (q1050932_sub V (f (q1050932_pair_add x h)) (f x))
            (q1050932_pair_linear_apply D h)) <=
        epsilon * q1050932_pair_norm h.

Definition q1050932_pair_differentiable_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex_pair -> E)
    (x : q1050932_complex_pair) : Prop :=
  exists D : q1050932_pair_linear_map V,
    @q1050932_has_pair_frechet_derivative_at E V f x D.

Definition q1050932_pair_analytic_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex_pair -> E)
    (x : q1050932_complex_pair) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R, 0 < radius /\
    forall y : q1050932_complex_pair,
      q1050932_pair_norm (q1050932_pair_sub y x) < radius ->
      @q1050932_pair_differentiable_at E V f y.

Definition q1050932_pair_open
    (S : q1050932_set q1050932_complex_pair) : Prop :=
  forall x : q1050932_complex_pair, S x ->
    exists radius : R, 0 < radius /\
      forall y : q1050932_complex_pair,
        q1050932_pair_norm (q1050932_pair_sub y x) < radius ->
        S y.

Definition q1050932_pair_analytic_on_nhd
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1050932_complex_pair -> E)
    (S : q1050932_set q1050932_complex_pair) : Prop :=
  forall x : q1050932_complex_pair,
    S x -> @q1050932_pair_analytic_at E V f x.

Module Pair.

Theorem hartogs :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q1050932_normed_complex_vector_space E)
         (f : q1050932_complex_pair -> E)
         (S : q1050932_set q1050932_complex_pair),
    q1050932_complete V ->
    q1050932_second_countable V ->
    q1050932_pair_open S ->
    (forall c0 c1 : q1050932_complex,
      S (c0, c1) ->
      @q1050932_scalar_analytic_at E V (fun z0 => f (z0, c1)) c0) ->
    (forall c0 c1 : q1050932_complex,
      S (c0, c1) ->
      @q1050932_scalar_analytic_at E V (fun z1 => f (c0, z1)) c1) ->
    @q1050932_pair_analytic_on_nhd E V f S.
Admitted.

End Pair.

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1050932,
  "Hartogs's theorem": a function from an open subset of complex two-space to
  a separable complex Banach space that is analytic separately in each complex
  coordinate is jointly analytic. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1050932_complex_banach_structure ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1050932_complex_banach_structure cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q1050932_complex_scale ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q1050932_complex_scale a z = a * z"

definition q1050932_complex_add ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q1050932_complex_add z w = z + w"

definition q1050932_complex_sub ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q1050932_complex_sub z w = z - w"

definition q1050932_complex_norm :: "complex \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1050932_complex_norm z = norm z"

definition q1050932_pair_complex_scale ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> (complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow> (complex \<times> complex)" where
  "q1050932_pair_complex_scale a z = (a * fst z, a * snd z)"

definition q1050932_pair_complex_norm ::
    "(complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1050932_pair_complex_norm z = max (norm (fst z)) (norm (snd z))"

definition q1050932_pair_complex_add ::
    "(complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow> (complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<times> complex)" where
  "q1050932_pair_complex_add z w =
    (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w)"

definition q1050932_pair_complex_sub ::
    "(complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow> (complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<times> complex)" where
  "q1050932_pair_complex_sub z w =
    (fst z - fst w, snd z - snd w)"

definition q1050932_open_pair_set ::
    "(complex \<times> complex) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1050932_open_pair_set U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> U. \<exists>r>0. \<forall>w.
      q1050932_pair_complex_norm (q1050932_pair_complex_sub w z) < r
      \<longrightarrow> w \<in> U)"

definition q1050932_continuous_complex_multilinear ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d list \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1050932_continuous_complex_multilinear n dadd dscale dnorm escale A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>xs i u v.
      length xs = n \<longrightarrow> i < n \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := dadd u v]) = A (xs[i := u]) + A (xs[i := v])) \<and>
    (\<forall>xs i a u.
      length xs = n \<longrightarrow> i < n \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := dscale a u]) = escale a (A (xs[i := u]))) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>xs. length xs = n \<longrightarrow>
      norm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<n. dnorm (xs ! i)))"

definition q1050932_multilinear_operator_norm ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('d \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('d list \<Rightarrow>
      'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1050932_multilinear_operator_norm n dnorm A =
    Inf {C. 0 \<le> C \<and> (\<forall>xs. length xs = n \<longrightarrow>
      norm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<n. dnorm (xs ! i)))}"

definition q1050932_analytic_at ::
    "('d \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1050932_analytic_at dadd dsub dscale dnorm escale g z0 \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>A r. 0 < r \<and>
      (\<forall>n. q1050932_continuous_complex_multilinear
        n dadd dscale dnorm escale (A n)) \<and>
      summable (\<lambda>n.
        q1050932_multilinear_operator_norm n dnorm (A n) * r ^ n) \<and>
      (\<forall>z. dnorm (dsub z z0) < r \<longrightarrow>
        ((\<lambda>n. A n (replicate n (dsub z z0))) sums g z)))"

definition q1050932_analytic_on_nhd ::
    "('d \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'd) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('d \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'd set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1050932_analytic_on_nhd dadd dsub dscale dnorm escale g U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> U. q1050932_analytic_at
      dadd dsub dscale dnorm escale g z)"

definition q1050932_separable_space ::
    "'e::metric_space itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1050932_separable_space _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>d::nat \<Rightarrow> 'e. \<forall>x e. 0 < e \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>n. dist x (d n) < e))"

theorem q1050932_hartogs:
  fixes cscale ::
      "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::banach \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "(complex \<times> complex) \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and U :: "(complex \<times> complex) set"
  assumes complex_banach: "q1050932_complex_banach_structure cscale"
    and separable: "q1050932_separable_space TYPE('e)"
    and open_set: "q1050932_open_pair_set U"
    and analytic_first:
      "\<forall>c0 c1. (c0, c1) \<in> U \<longrightarrow>
        q1050932_analytic_at q1050932_complex_add q1050932_complex_sub
          q1050932_complex_scale q1050932_complex_norm cscale
          (\<lambda>z0. f (z0, c1)) c0"
    and analytic_second:
      "\<forall>c0 c1. (c0, c1) \<in> U \<longrightarrow>
        q1050932_analytic_at q1050932_complex_add q1050932_complex_sub
          q1050932_complex_scale q1050932_complex_norm cscale
          (\<lambda>z1. f (c0, z1)) c1"
  shows
    "q1050932_analytic_on_nhd q1050932_pair_complex_add
      q1050932_pair_complex_sub q1050932_pair_complex_scale
      q1050932_pair_complex_norm cscale f U"
  sorry

end

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1050932,
  "Hartogs's theorem": a function from two complex variables to a separable
  complex Banach space that is analytic in each variable separately on an open
  set is jointly analytic there. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1050932_HARTOGS_S_THEOREM =
 `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cadd =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
  let cneg =
    \(z:real#real).
      (--(FST z),--(SND z)) in
  let csub =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      cadd z (cneg w) in
  let cmul =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
       FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
  let cnorm =
    \(z:real#real).
      sqrt(FST z * FST z + SND z * SND z) in
  let cpadd =
    \(z:(real#real)#(real#real))
     (w:(real#real)#(real#real)).
      (cadd (FST z) (FST w),cadd (SND z) (SND w)) in
  let cpsub =
    \(z:(real#real)#(real#real))
     (w:(real#real)#(real#real)).
      (csub (FST z) (FST w),csub (SND z) (SND w)) in
  let cpnorm =
    \(z:(real#real)#(real#real)).
      max (cnorm (FST z)) (cnorm (SND z)) in
  !(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A)
   (smulE:(real#real)->A->A) (normE:A->real)
   (f:((real#real)#(real#real))->A)
   (s:((real#real)#(real#real))->bool).
    let subE =
      \(x:A) (y:A). addE x (negE y) in
    let is_complex_normed_space =
      ((!x y z:A.
         addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
      (!x y:A. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x:A. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x:A. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      normE zeroE = &0 /\
      (!x:A. &0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x:A. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y:A. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) /\
      (!x:A. smulE cone x = x) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cmul a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cadd a b) x =
         addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x y:A.
         smulE a (addE x y) =
         addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. smulE czero x = zeroE) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A.
         normE (smulE a x) = cnorm a * normE x)) in
    let tends_to =
      \(u:num->A) (x:A).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n
                ==> normE (subE (u n) x) < epsilon in
    let complete_space =
      (!u:num->A.
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                 N <= m /\ N <= n
                 ==> normE (subE (u m) (u n)) < epsilon)
        ==> ?x:A. tends_to u x) in
    let norm_open =
      \(U:A->bool).
        !x:A.
          x IN U
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:A.
                  normE (subE y x) < epsilon
                  ==> y IN U in
    let second_countable =
      (?basis:(A->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!b:A->bool. b IN basis ==> norm_open b) /\
        (!U:A->bool. !x:A.
           norm_open U /\ x IN U
           ==> ?b:A->bool.
                 b IN basis /\ x IN b /\ b SUBSET U)) in
    let complex_differentiable_at_1 =
      \(g:(real#real)->A) (x:real#real).
        ?d:A.
          !epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?delta:real.
                  &0 < delta /\
                  !h:real#real.
                    cnorm h < delta
                    ==> normE
                          (subE
                            (subE (g (cadd x h)) (g x))
                            (smulE h d))
                        <= epsilon * cnorm h in
    let complex_differentiable_at_2 =
      \(g:((real#real)#(real#real))->A)
       (x:(real#real)#(real#real)).
        ?d0 d1:A.
          !epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?delta:real.
                  &0 < delta /\
                  !h:(real#real)#(real#real).
                    cpnorm h < delta
                    ==> normE
                          (subE
                            (subE (g (cpadd x h)) (g x))
                            (addE
                              (smulE (FST h) d0)
                              (smulE (SND h) d1)))
                        <= epsilon * cpnorm h in
    let analytic_at_1 =
      \(g:(real#real)->A) (x:real#real).
        ?radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          !y:real#real.
            cnorm (csub y x) < radius
            ==> complex_differentiable_at_1 g y in
    let analytic_at_2 =
      \(g:((real#real)#(real#real))->A)
       (x:(real#real)#(real#real)).
        ?radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          !y:(real#real)#(real#real).
            cpnorm (cpsub y x) < radius
            ==> complex_differentiable_at_2 g y in
    let product_open =
      \(U:((real#real)#(real#real))->bool).
        !x:(real#real)#(real#real).
          x IN U
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:(real#real)#(real#real).
                  cpnorm (cpsub y x) < epsilon
                  ==> y IN U in
    let analytic_on_nhd_2 =
      \(g:((real#real)#(real#real))->A)
       (U:((real#real)#(real#real))->bool).
        !x:(real#real)#(real#real).
          x IN U ==> analytic_at_2 g x in
      is_complex_normed_space /\
      complete_space /\
      second_countable /\
      product_open s /\
      (!c0 c1:real#real.
         (c0,c1) IN s
         ==> analytic_at_1 (\z0. f (z0,c1)) c0) /\
      (!c0 c1:real#real.
         (c0,c1) IN s
         ==> analytic_at_1 (\z1. f (c0,z1)) c1)
      ==> analytic_on_nhd_2 f s`;;

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1050932,
;; "Hartogs's theorem": a function from complex two-space to a separable
;; complex Banach space that is analytic in each variable separately on an
;; open set is jointly analytic there. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary carriers, operations, sets,
;; functions, sequences, and continuous linear maps. A Dedekind-complete
;; ordered field presents the reals, and real/imaginary coordinates present
;; the complex field. All algebraic, normed-space, completeness, separability,
;; openness, differentiability, and typing laws used by the statement are
;; explicit below.

;; The real numbers.

(defstub q1050932-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q1050932-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defun q1050932-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q1050932-r-less real right left)))

(defun q1050932-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q1050932-r-member-p real value)
   (q1050932-r-less
    real (q1050932-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q1050932-r-max (real left right)
  (if (q1050932-r-less real left right)
      right
    left))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-r-member-p real x)
      (q1050932-r-member-p real y)
      (q1050932-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q1050932-r-zero real))
            (one (q1050932-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q1050932-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q1050932-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q1050932-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q1050932-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q1050932-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q1050932-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q1050932-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q1050932-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q1050932-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q1050932-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1050932-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q1050932-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1050932-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q1050932-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q1050932-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1050932-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q1050932-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1050932-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q1050932-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q1050932-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1050932-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1050932-r-multiply
          real x (q1050932-r-add real y z))
         (q1050932-r-add
          real
          (q1050932-r-multiply real x y)
          (q1050932-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-r-member-p real x)
      (q1050932-r-member-p real y)
      (q1050932-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q1050932-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q1050932-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1050932-r-less real x y)
         (q1050932-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1050932-r-less real x y)
          (q1050932-r-less real y z))
         (q1050932-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q1050932-r-less real x y)
         (q1050932-r-less
          real
          (q1050932-r-add real x z)
          (q1050932-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1050932-r-less real zero x)
          (q1050932-r-less real zero y))
         (q1050932-r-less
          real zero
          (q1050932-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1050932-r-member-p real x)
     (q1050932-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-r-member-p real x)
      (q1050932-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q1050932-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1050932-r-member-p real bound)
     (q1050932-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1050932-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q1050932-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1050932-r-member-p real bound)
       (q1050932-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q1050932-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1050932-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1050932-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q1050932-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q1050932-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q1050932-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q1050932-r-zero real))
        (one (q1050932-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q1050932-r-member-p real zero)
     (q1050932-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1050932-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q1050932-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q1050932-r-less real zero one)
     (q1050932-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; The complex numbers as an isometric real-coordinate field.

(defstub q1050932-c-member-p (complex value) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-zero (complex) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-one (complex) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-add (complex left right) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-multiply (complex left right) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-negate (complex value) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-inverse (complex value) t)
(defstub q1050932-c-norm (real complex value) t)

(defun-sk q1050932-c-field-laws-p (complex)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-c-member-p complex x)
      (q1050932-c-member-p complex y)
      (q1050932-c-member-p complex z))
     (let* ((zero (q1050932-c-zero complex))
            (one (q1050932-c-one complex))
            (xy-add (q1050932-c-add complex x y))
            (yz-add (q1050932-c-add complex y z))
            (xy-mul (q1050932-c-multiply complex x y))
            (yz-mul (q1050932-c-multiply complex y z))
            (neg-x (q1050932-c-negate complex x))
            (inv-x (q1050932-c-inverse complex x)))
       (and
        (q1050932-c-member-p complex xy-add)
        (q1050932-c-member-p complex xy-mul)
        (q1050932-c-member-p complex neg-x)
        (q1050932-c-member-p complex inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-add complex xy-add z)
         (q1050932-c-add complex x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1050932-c-add complex y x))
        (equal (q1050932-c-add complex x zero) x)
        (equal (q1050932-c-add complex x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-multiply complex xy-mul z)
         (q1050932-c-multiply complex x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1050932-c-multiply complex y x))
        (equal (q1050932-c-multiply complex x one) x)
        (equal (q1050932-c-inverse complex zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1050932-c-multiply complex x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-multiply
          complex x (q1050932-c-add complex y z))
         (q1050932-c-add
          complex
          (q1050932-c-multiply complex x y)
          (q1050932-c-multiply complex x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1050932-c-norm-laws-p (real complex)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-c-member-p complex x)
      (q1050932-c-member-p complex y))
     (let ((zero-c (q1050932-c-zero complex))
           (zero-r (q1050932-r-zero real))
           (norm-x (q1050932-c-norm real complex x))
           (norm-y (q1050932-c-norm real complex y)))
       (and
        (q1050932-r-member-p real norm-x)
        (q1050932-r-member-p real norm-y)
        (q1050932-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
        (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
             (equal x zero-c))
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-norm
          real complex (q1050932-c-negate complex x))
         norm-x)
        (q1050932-r-leq
         real
         (q1050932-c-norm
          real complex (q1050932-c-add complex x y))
         (q1050932-r-add real norm-x norm-y))
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-norm
          real complex (q1050932-c-multiply complex x y))
         (q1050932-r-multiply real norm-x norm-y)))))))

(defun-sk q1050932-c-coordinate-laws-p (real complex)
  (forall (a b z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1050932-r-member-p real a)
      (q1050932-r-member-p real b)
      (q1050932-c-member-p complex z))
     (let* ((zero-r (q1050932-r-zero real))
            (one-r (q1050932-r-one real))
            (zero-c (q1050932-c-zero complex))
            (one-c (q1050932-c-one complex))
            (imaginary-unit (q1050932-c-I complex))
            (of-a (q1050932-c-of-real real complex a))
            (of-b (q1050932-c-of-real real complex b))
            (re-z (q1050932-c-re real complex z))
            (im-z (q1050932-c-im real complex z))
            (norm-z (q1050932-c-norm real complex z)))
       (and
        (q1050932-c-member-p complex imaginary-unit)
        (q1050932-c-member-p complex of-a)
        (q1050932-r-member-p real re-z)
        (q1050932-r-member-p real im-z)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-of-real real complex zero-r)
         zero-c)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-of-real real complex one-r)
         one-c)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-of-real
          real complex (q1050932-r-add real a b))
         (q1050932-c-add complex of-a of-b))
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-of-real
          real complex (q1050932-r-multiply real a b))
         (q1050932-c-multiply complex of-a of-b))
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-of-real
          real complex (q1050932-r-negate real a))
         (q1050932-c-negate complex of-a))
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-re real complex of-a)
         a)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-im real complex of-a)
         zero-r)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-re real complex imaginary-unit)
         zero-r)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-im real complex imaginary-unit)
         one-r)
        (equal
         (q1050932-c-multiply
          complex imaginary-unit imaginary-unit)
         (q1050932-c-negate complex one-c))
        (equal
         z
         (q1050932-c-add
          complex
          (q1050932-c-of-real real complex re-z)
          (q1050932-c-multiply
           complex
           (q1050932-c-of-real real complex im-z)
           imaginary-unit)))
        (equal
         (q1050932-r-multiply real norm-z norm-z)
         (q1050932-r-add
          real
          (q1050932-r-multiply real re-z re-z)
          (q1050932-r-multiply real im-z im-z))))))))

(defun q1050932-complex-field-p (real complex)
  (let ((zero (q1050932-c-zero complex))
        (one (q1050932-c-one complex)))
    (and
     (q1050932-real-field-p real)
     (q1050932-c-member-p complex zero)
     (q1050932-c-member-p complex one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1050932-c-field-laws-p complex)
     (q1050932-c-norm-laws-p real complex)
     (q1050932-c-coordinate-laws-p real complex))))

(defun-sk q1050932-normed-space-laws-p

    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1050932-e-member-p space x)
       (q1050932-e-member-p space y)
       (q1050932-e-member-p space z))
      (let* ((zero-e (q1050932-e-zero space))
             (zero-r (q1050932-r-zero real))
             (xy-add (q1050932-e-add space x y))
             (yz-add (q1050932-e-add space y z))
             (neg-x (q1050932-e-negate space x))
             (norm-x (q1050932-e-norm real space x))
             (norm-y (q1050932-e-norm real space y)))
        (and
         (q1050932-e-member-p space xy-add)
         (q1050932-e-member-p space neg-x)
         (q1050932-r-member-p real norm-x)
         (q1050932-r-member-p real norm-y)
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-add space xy-add z)
          (q1050932-e-add space x yz-add))
         (equal xy-add (q1050932-e-add space y x))
         (equal (q1050932-e-add space x zero-e) x)
         (equal (q1050932-e-add space x neg-x) zero-e)
         (q1050932-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
         (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
              (equal x zero-e))
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-norm real space neg-x)
          norm-x)
         (q1050932-r-leq
          real
          (q1050932-e-norm real space xy-add)
          (q1050932-r-add real norm-x norm-y)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1050932-c-member-p complex a)
       (q1050932-c-member-p complex b)
       (q1050932-e-member-p space x)
       (q1050932-e-member-p space y))
      (let ((zero-c (q1050932-c-zero complex))
            (one-c (q1050932-c-one complex))
            (zero-e (q1050932-e-zero space)))
        (and
         (q1050932-e-member-p
          space (q1050932-e-smul complex space a x))
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-smul complex space one-c x)
          x)
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-smul
           complex space
           (q1050932-c-multiply complex a b) x)
          (q1050932-e-smul
           complex space a
           (q1050932-e-smul complex space b x)))
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-smul
           complex space
           (q1050932-c-add complex a b) x)
          (q1050932-e-add
           space
           (q1050932-e-smul complex space a x)
           (q1050932-e-smul complex space b x)))
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-smul
           complex space a
           (q1050932-e-add space x y))
          (q1050932-e-add
           space
           (q1050932-e-smul complex space a x)
           (q1050932-e-smul complex space a y)))
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-smul complex space zero-c x)
          zero-e)
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-smul complex space a zero-e)
          zero-e)
         (equal
          (q1050932-e-norm
           real space
           (q1050932-e-smul complex space a x))
          (q1050932-r-multiply
           real
           (q1050932-c-norm real complex a)
           (q1050932-e-norm real space x)))))))))

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1050932,
-- "Hartogs's theorem": a function from two complex variables to a
-- second-countable complex Banach space that is analytic separately in each
-- variable on an open set is jointly analytic there. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem where

open import Support.Hartogs
open import Support.Liouville

hartogs-theorem : Set2
hartogs-theorem =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (complexSpace :
    NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm (Complex R)) ->
  ComplexSpacePresentation reals complexNorm complexSpace ->
  (pairSpace :
    NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm
      (Pair (Complex R) (Complex R))) ->
  PairSpacePresentation
    reals complexNorm complexSpace pairSpace ->
  (target :
    NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  CompleteMetric reals target ->
  SecondCountableMetric reals target ->
  (function : Pair (Complex R) (Complex R) -> E) ->
  (U : SetOf (Pair (Complex R) (Complex R))) ->
  OpenInNormedSpace reals pairSpace U ->
  ((c0 c1 : Complex R) ->
    U (pair c0 c1) ->
    AnalyticAt
      reals complexNorm complexSpace target
      (\ z0 -> function (pair z0 c1))
      c0) ->
  ((c0 c1 : Complex R) ->
    U (pair c0 c1) ->
    AnalyticAt
      reals complexNorm complexSpace target
      (\ z1 -> function (pair c0 z1))
      c1) ->
  AnalyticOnNeighborhood
    reals complexNorm pairSpace target function U

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1050932, "Hartogs's theorem": for a function from an open subset of
  the complex plane squared to a complete second-countable complex normed
  space, separate analyticity in each coordinate implies joint analyticity.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory cardinalTheory realTheory;
open complexTheory;

val q1050932_normed_complex_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_normed_complex_space_def",
  ``q1050932_normed_complex_space
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      (!x. smulE 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (a * b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (a + b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE 0 x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x. negE x = smulE (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x. (normE x = 0) <=> (x = zeroE)) /\
      (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = modu a * normE x)``);

val q1050932_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_tendsto_def",
  ``q1050932_tendsto
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==>
          normE (addE (u n) (negE x)) < epsilon``);

val q1050932_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_cauchy_def",
  ``q1050932_cauchy
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          normE (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q1050932_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_complete_def",
  ``q1050932_complete
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q1050932_cauchy addE negE normE u ==>
        ?x : 'e. q1050932_tendsto addE negE normE u x``);

val q1050932_norm_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_norm_open_def",
  ``q1050932_norm_open
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (u : 'e set) <=>
      !x : 'e.
        x IN u ==>
        ?radius : real.
          0 < radius /\
          !y : 'e.
            normE (addE y (negE x)) < radius ==>
            y IN u``);

val q1050932_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_second_countable_def",
  ``q1050932_second_countable
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      ?basis : ('e set) set.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!v. v IN basis ==> q1050932_norm_open addE negE normE v) /\
        !u x.
          q1050932_norm_open addE negE normE u /\ x IN u ==>
          ?v.
            v IN basis /\
            x IN v /\
            v SUBSET u``);

val q1050932_pair_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_pair_norm_def",
  ``q1050932_pair_norm (z : complex # complex) =
      max (modu (FST z)) (modu (SND z))``);

val q1050932_pair_add_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_pair_add_def",
  ``q1050932_pair_add
      (z : complex # complex) (w : complex # complex) =
      (FST z + FST w, SND z + SND w)``);

val q1050932_pair_sub_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_pair_sub_def",
  ``q1050932_pair_sub
      (z : complex # complex) (w : complex # complex) =
      (FST z - FST w, SND z - SND w)``);

val q1050932_open_in_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_open_in_pair_def",
  ``q1050932_open_in_pair (s : (complex # complex) set) <=>
      !x : complex # complex.
        x IN s ==>
        ?radius : real.
          0 < radius /\
          !y : complex # complex.
            q1050932_pair_norm (q1050932_pair_sub y x) < radius ==>
            y IN s``);

val q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_one_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_one_def",
  ``q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_one
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (L : complex -> 'e) <=>
      (!z w. L (z + w) = addE (L z) (L w)) /\
      (!a z. L (a * z) = smulE a (L z)) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\ !z. normE (L z) <= C * modu z``);

val q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_one_at_def =
  new_definition (
    "q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_one_at_def",
    ``q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_one_at
        (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
        (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
        (g : complex -> 'e) (x : complex) <=>
        ?L : complex -> 'e.
          q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_one addE smulE normE L /\
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !h : complex.
                0 < modu h /\ modu h < delta
                ==>
                normE
                  (addE
                    (addE (g (x + h)) (negE (g x)))
                    (negE (L h))) <
                epsilon * modu h``);

val q1050932_analytic_one_at_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_analytic_one_at_def",
  ``q1050932_analytic_one_at
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (g : complex -> 'e) (x : complex) <=>
      ?radius : real.
        0 < radius /\
        !y : complex.
          modu (y - x) < radius ==>
          q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_one_at
            addE negE smulE normE g y``);

val q1050932_pair_smul_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_pair_smul_def",
  ``q1050932_pair_smul
      (a : complex) (z : complex # complex) =
      (a * FST z, a * SND z)``);

val q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_pair_def",
  ``q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_pair
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (L : complex # complex -> 'e) <=>
      (!z w.
        L (q1050932_pair_add z w) = addE (L z) (L w)) /\
      (!a z.
        L (q1050932_pair_smul a z) = smulE a (L z)) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\
        !z. normE (L z) <= C * q1050932_pair_norm z``);

val q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_pair_at_def =
  new_definition (
    "q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_pair_at_def",
    ``q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_pair_at
        (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
        (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
        (f : complex # complex -> 'e) (x : complex # complex) <=>
        ?L : complex # complex -> 'e.
          q1050932_bounded_complex_linear_pair addE smulE normE L /\
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !h : complex # complex.
                0 < q1050932_pair_norm h /\
                q1050932_pair_norm h < delta
                ==>
                normE
                  (addE
                    (addE
                      (f (q1050932_pair_add x h))
                      (negE (f x)))
                    (negE (L h))) <
                epsilon * q1050932_pair_norm h``);

val q1050932_analytic_pair_at_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_analytic_pair_at_def",
  ``q1050932_analytic_pair_at
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex # complex -> 'e) (x : complex # complex) <=>
      ?radius : real.
        0 < radius /\
        !y : complex # complex.
          q1050932_pair_norm (q1050932_pair_sub y x) < radius ==>
          q1050932_complex_frechet_differentiable_pair_at
            addE negE smulE normE f y``);

val q1050932_analytic_on_nhd_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q1050932_analytic_on_nhd_pair_def",
  ``q1050932_analytic_on_nhd_pair
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex # complex -> 'e)
      (s : (complex # complex) set) <=>
      !x : complex # complex.
        x IN s ==>
        q1050932_analytic_pair_at
          addE negE smulE normE f x``);

val Pair_hartogs =
  ``!(zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex # complex -> 'e)
      (s : (complex # complex) set).
      q1050932_normed_complex_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q1050932_complete addE negE normE /\
      q1050932_second_countable addE negE normE /\
      q1050932_open_in_pair s /\
      (!c0 c1.
        (c0,c1) IN s ==>
        q1050932_analytic_one_at
          addE negE smulE normE
          (\z0. f (z0,c1)) c0) /\
      (!c0 c1.
        (c0,c1) IN s ==>
        q1050932_analytic_one_at
          addE negE smulE normE
          (\z1. f (c0,z1)) c1)
      ==>
      q1050932_analytic_on_nhd_pair
        addE negE smulE normE f s``;

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1050932
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1050932), "Hartogs's theorem": a function
  from the complex plane squared to a complete second-countable complex
  normed space that is analytic separately in each coordinate on an open set
  is jointly analytic there. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1050932Sub is subtraction in the codomain normed vector space.
  Q1050932PairDist is the l1 distance on CC X. CC; it induces the same
  topology as the product norm used by the Lean source.

  Q1050932HasDeriv0At and Q1050932HasDeriv1At are the complex Frechet
  remainder estimates for the two one-variable slices. Q1050932AnalyticAt0
  and Q1050932AnalyticAt1 require such derivatives throughout a neighborhood
  of the indicated coordinate. Q1050932HasJointDerivAt uses the complex-linear
  map (h0,h1) |-> h0 D0 + h1 D1, which represents every complex-linear map
  from CC squared into E. Q1050932AnalyticAt and Q1050932AnalyticOnNhd are
  their corresponding local joint notions.

  For maps from finite-dimensional complex spaces into a complete complex
  normed space, local complex Frechet differentiability is equivalent to the
  power-series AnalyticAt and AnalyticOnNhd predicates in the Lean source.
  The final $a assertion keeps the complete-space, second-countability,
  openness, separate-analyticity, and joint-analyticity scopes explicit. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions; the database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1050932Sub Q1050932PairDist Q1050932Linear
   Q1050932HasDeriv0At Q1050932HasDeriv1At
   Q1050932AnalyticAt0 Q1050932AnalyticAt1
   Q1050932HasJointDerivAt Q1050932AnalyticAt
   Q1050932AnalyticOnNhd $.

$v D1 $.
q1050932-vD1 $f class D1 $.

q1050932-sub-syntax
  $a class ( Q1050932Sub E x y ) $.
q1050932-pair-dist-syntax
  $a class ( Q1050932PairDist p q ) $.
q1050932-linear-syntax
  $a class ( Q1050932Linear E p q D0 D1 ) $.
q1050932-has-deriv0-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932HasDeriv0At E F p D0 ) $.
q1050932-has-deriv1-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932HasDeriv1At E F p D1 ) $.
q1050932-analytic-at0-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932AnalyticAt0 E F p ) $.
q1050932-analytic-at1-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932AnalyticAt1 E F p ) $.
q1050932-has-joint-deriv-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932HasJointDerivAt E F p D0 D1 ) $.
q1050932-analytic-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932AnalyticAt E F p ) $.
q1050932-analytic-on-nhd-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1050932AnalyticOnNhd E F S ) $.

${
  $d E x y $.

  q1050932-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q1050932Sub E x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` E )
    ( ( -g ` E ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d p q $.

  q1050932-pair-dist-definition $a |- (
    Q1050932PairDist p q
  ) = (
    ( abs ` ( ( 1st ` q ) - ( 1st ` p ) ) )
    +
    ( abs ` ( ( 2nd ` q ) - ( 2nd ` p ) ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D0 D1 E p q $.

  q1050932-linear-definition $a |- (
    Q1050932Linear E p q D0 D1
  ) = (
    (
      ( ( 1st ` q ) - ( 1st ` p ) )
      ( .s ` E )
      D0
    )
    ( +g ` E )
    (

title: Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1050932,
% "Hartogs's theorem": a separately analytic function from an open subset of
% the complex plane squared into a separable complex Banach space is jointly
% analytic. This file contains no proof.

Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  cscaleE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE =
    [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_pair: TYPE =
    [# first_component: complex,
       second_component: complex #]

  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> E]
  pair_function: TYPE = [complex_pair -> E]
  pair_set: TYPE = [complex_pair -> bool]
  e_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  e_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_set]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  pair_linear_candidate: TYPE = [complex_pair -> E]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(a, b: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(a) + real_part(b),
       imag_part := imag_part(a) + imag_part(b) #)

  complex_neg(a: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(a),
       imag_part := -imag_part(a) #)

  complex_sub(a, b: complex): complex =
    complex_add(a, complex_neg(b))

  complex_mul(a, b: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(a) * real_part(b)
           - imag_part(a) * imag_part(b),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(a) * imag_part(b)
           + imag_part(a) * real_part(b) #)

  complex_norm_squared(a: complex): real =
    real_part(a) * real_part(a)
      + imag_part(a) * imag_part(a)

  complex_pair_of(z0, z1: complex): complex_pair =
    (# first_component := z0,
       second_component := z1 #)

  complex_pair_zero: complex_pair =
    complex_pair_of(complex_zero, complex_zero)

  complex_pair_add(x, y: complex_pair): complex_pair =
    complex_pair_of(
      complex_add(
        first_component(x),
        first_component(y)),
      complex_add(
        second_component(x),
        second_component(y)))

  complex_pair_smul(
      a: complex,
      x: complex_pair): complex_pair =
    complex_pair_of(
      complex_mul(a, first_component(x)),
      complex_mul(a, second_component(x)))

  real_max(x, y: real): real =
    IF x >= y THEN x ELSE y ENDIF

  pair_norm_squared(x: complex_pair): real =
    real_max(
      complex_norm_squared(first_component(x)),
      complex_norm_squared(second_component(x)))

  pair_distance_squared(
      x, y: complex_pair): real =
    pair_norm_squared(
      complex_pair_of(
        complex_sub(
          first_component(x),
          first_component(y)),
        complex_sub(
          second_component(x),
          second_component(y))))

  smulE(a: complex, x: E): E =
    cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x)

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  normed_complex_vector_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) =
          addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <=
          normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_add(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_mul(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_zero, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) * normE(smulE(a, x))
          =
        complex_norm_squared(a) * normE(x) * normE(x))

  cauchy_E(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          (cutoff <= left_index
            AND cutoff <= right_index)
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  converges_E(
      values: e_sequence,
      limit_value: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(values(index), limit_value))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_E: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_E(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit_value: E):
          converges_E(values, limit_value)

  subset_E(A, B: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  open_E(U: e_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: E):
            normE(subE(y, x)) < radius
              IMPLIES U(y)

  second_countable_E: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: e_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        open_E(basis(index)))
        AND (FORALL (U: e_set), (x: E):
          (open_E(U) AND U(x))
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              basis(index)(x)
                AND subset_E(basis(index), U))

  open_pair_set(s: pair_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex_pair):
      s(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: complex_pair):
            pair_distance_squared(y, x)
                < radius * radius
              IMPLIES s(y)

  bounded_complex_linear_pair_map(
      derivative: pair_linear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: complex_pair):
      derivative(complex_pair_add(x, y)) =
        addE(derivative(x), derivative(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: complex_pair):
        derivative(complex_pair_smul(a, x)) =
          smulE(a, derivative(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: complex_pair):
            normE(derivative(x))
                * normE(derivative(x))
              <= bound * bound * pair_norm_squared(x)

  has_complex_derivative_at(
      f: complex_function,
      derivative: E,
      point: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (increment: complex):
          complex_norm_squared(increment)
              < radius * radius
            IMPLIES
              normE(
                subE(
                  subE(
                    f(complex_add(point, increment)),
                    f(point)),
                  smulE(increment, derivative)))
                *
              normE(
                subE(
                  subE(
                    f(complex_add(point, increment)),
                    f(point)),
                  smulE(increment, derivative)))
              <= epsilon_value * epsilon_value
                   * complex_norm_squared(increment)

  complex_differentiable_at(
      f: complex_function,
      point: complex): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: E):
      has_complex_derivative_at(
        f, derivative, point)

  has_complex_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: pair_function,
      derivative: pair_linear_candidate,
      point: complex_pair): bool =
    bounded_complex_linear_pair_map(derivative)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (increment: complex_pair):
            pair_norm_squared(increment)
                < radius * radius
              IMPLIES
                normE(
                  subE(
                    subE(
                      f(complex_pair_add(
                        point, increment)),
                      f(point)),
                    derivative(increment)))
                  *
                normE(
                  subE(
                    subE(
                      f(complex_pair_add(
                        point, increment)),
                      f(point)),
                    derivative(increment)))
                <= epsilon_value * epsilon_value
                     * pair_norm_squared(increment)

  complex_frechet_differentiable_at(
      f: pair_function,
      point: complex_pair): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: pair_linear_candidate):
      has_complex_frechet_derivative_at(
        f, derivative, point)

  analytic_at_complex(
      f: complex_function,
      point: complex): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (nearby: complex):
        complex_norm_squared(
          complex_sub(nearby, point))
            < radius * radius
          IMPLIES
            complex_differentiable_at(f, nearby)

  analytic_at_pair(
      f: pair_function,
      point: complex_pair): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (nearby: complex_pair):
        pair_distance_squared(nearby, point)
            < radius * radius
          IMPLIES
            complex_frechet_differentiable_at(
              f, nearby)

  analytic_on_neighborhood_pair(
      f: pair_function,
      s: pair_set): bool =
    FORALL (point: complex_pair):
      s(point) IMPLIES analytic_at_pair(f, point)

  hartogs_s_theorem: bool =
    (normed_complex_vector_space_E
      AND complete_E
      AND second_countable_E)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (f: pair_function),
          (s: pair_set):
        (open_pair_set(s)
          AND (FORALL (c0, c1: complex):
            s(complex_pair_of(c0, c1))
              IMPLIES
                analytic_at_complex(
                  LAMBDA (z0: complex):
                    f(complex_pair_of(z0, c1)),
                  c0))
          AND (FORALL (c0, c1: complex):
            s(complex_pair_of(c0, c1))
              IMPLIES
                analytic_at_complex(
                  LAMBDA (z1: complex):
                    f(complex_pair_of(c0, z1)),
                  c1)))
        IMPLIES
          analytic_on_neighborhood_pair(f, s)
END Q1050932_hartogs_s_theorem

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1052678), "Baire category theorem": a countable
-- intersection of dense open subsets of a Baire space is dense. This file contains no proof.

module

variable {X : Type*}

/-- The Baire category theorem, formulated using the intersection of a set of sets. -/
theorem dense_sInter_of_isOpen {S : Set (Set X)} (ho : ∀ s ∈ S, IsOpen s)

title: Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1052678
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1052678), "Baire category theorem": in a Baire
  topological space, the intersection of any countable family of open dense
  subsets is dense. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q1052678_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q1052678_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1052678_is_open : q1052678_set X -> Prop;
  q1052678_open_ext :
    forall U V : q1052678_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q1052678_is_open U <-> q1052678_is_open V);
  q1052678_open_univ :
    q1052678_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1052678_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1052678_set X,
      q1052678_is_open U ->
      q1052678_is_open V ->
      q1052678_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1052678_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q1052678_set (q1052678_set X),
      (forall U : q1052678_set X,
        family U -> q1052678_is_open U) ->
      q1052678_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1052678_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1052678_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q1052678_is_closed
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1052678_topological_space X)
    (U : q1052678_set X) : Prop :=
  q1052678_is_open T (fun x : X => ~ U x).

Definition q1052678_closure
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1052678_topological_space X)
    (U : q1052678_set X) : q1052678_set X :=
  fun x : X =>
    forall C : q1052678_set X,
      q1052678_is_closed T C ->
      (forall y : X, U y -> C y) ->
      C x.

Definition q1052678_dense
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1052678_topological_space X)
    (U : q1052678_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X, q1052678_closure T U x.

Definition q1052678_countable
    {A : Type}
    (S : q1052678_set A) : Prop :=
  exists encode : A -> nat,
    forall x y : A,
      S x -> S y ->
      encode x = encode y ->
      x = y.

Definition q1052678_sInter
    {X : Type}
    (S : q1052678_set (q1052678_set X)) : q1052678_set X :=
  fun x : X =>
    forall U : q1052678_set X, S U -> U x.

Record q1052678_baire_space
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1052678_topological_space X) : Prop := {
  q1052678_baire_property :
    forall f : nat -> q1052678_set X,
      (forall n : nat, q1052678_is_open T (f n)) ->
      (forall n : nat, q1052678_dense T (f n)) ->
      q1052678_dense T
        (fun x : X => forall n : nat, f n x)
}.

Theorem dense_sInter_of_isOpen :
  forall (X : Type)
         (T : q1052678_topological_space X)
         (B : q1052678_baire_space T)
         (S : q1052678_set (q1052678_set X)),
    (forall U : q1052678_set X,
      S U -> q1052678_is_open T U) ->
    q1052678_countable S ->
    (forall U : q1052678_set X,
      S U -> q1052678_dense T U) ->
    q1052678_dense T (q1052678_sInter S).
Admitted.

title: Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1052678,
  "Baire category theorem": in a Baire topological space, the intersection of
  any countable family of open dense sets is dense. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
  imports "HOL.Topological_Spaces"
begin

definition dense_set :: "'a::topological_space set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "dense_set D \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>U. open U \<longrightarrow> U \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow> U \<inter> D \<noteq> {})"

definition is_baire_space :: "'a::topological_space itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_baire_space _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>f :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. open (f n)) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>n. dense_set (f n)) \<longrightarrow>
      dense_set (\<Inter>n. f n))"

theorem dense_sInter_of_isOpen:
  fixes S :: "'a::topological_space set set"
  assumes "is_baire_space TYPE('a)"
    and "\<And>s. s \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> open s"
    and "countable S"
    and "\<And>s. s \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> dense_set s"
  shows "dense_set (\<Inter>S)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1052678,
  "Baire category theorem": in an arbitrary Baire topological space, every
  countable intersection of open dense sets is dense. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let Q1052678_BAIRE_CATEGORY_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology =
     \(X:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets X /\
       (!U:A->bool. open_sets U ==> U SUBSET X) /\
       (!C:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
       (!U V:A->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V
          ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let dense =
     \(X:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (D:A->bool).
       D SUBSET X /\
       !U:A->bool.
         open_sets U /\ ~(U = {})
         ==> ~(U INTER D = {}) in
   let is_baire_space =
     \(X:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       !f:num->A->bool.
         (!n. open_sets (f n)) /\
         (!n. dense X open_sets (f n))
         ==> dense X open_sets
               (X INTER INTERS (IMAGE f (:num))) in
   !X:A->bool.
   !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool.
   !S:(A->bool)->bool.
     is_topology X open_sets /\
     is_baire_space X open_sets /\
     (!U:A->bool. U IN S ==> open_sets U) /\
     COUNTABLE S /\
     (!U:A->bool. U IN S ==> dense X open_sets U)
     ==> dense X open_sets (X INTER INTERS S)`;;

title: Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1052678,
;; "Baire category theorem": in an arbitrary Baire topological space, the
;; intersection of a countable family of dense open sets is dense. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame characteristic functions represent the carrier, subsets, families of
;; subsets, and natural-number sequences. DEFUN-SK keeps every point, set,
;; family, enumeration, and sequence in its source quantifier scope. APPLY$ is
;; used only to apply those externally supplied characteristic functions.

(defun q1052678-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1052678-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

;; Extensional subsets and arbitrary families of subsets.

(defun-sk q1052678-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p set x)
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q1052678-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q1052678-set-contained-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q1052678-set-pointwise-equiv-p
    (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1052678-member-p left x)
      (q1052678-member-p right x)))))

(defun q1052678-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q1052678-set-pointwise-equiv-p
    carrier left right)))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-extensional-p
    (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q1052678-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q1052678-member-p family left)
      (q1052678-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-members-valid-p
    (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p family set)
     (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q1052678-family-of-sets-p
    (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q1052678-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q1052678-family-members-valid-p
    carrier family)))

(defun-sk q1052678-set-has-point-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (q1052678-member-p set x))))

(defun q1052678-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1052678-set-has-point-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q1052678-intersection-has-point-p
    (carrier left right)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (q1052678-member-p left x)
     (q1052678-member-p right x))))

(defun q1052678-intersection-nonempty-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q1052678-intersection-has-point-p
    carrier left right)))

;; Topological spaces, with empty set, whole carrier, binary intersections,
;; and arbitrary unions represented extensionally.

(defun q1052678-open-set-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1052678-member-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p family set)
     (q1052678-open-set-p
      carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1052678-empty-representation-p
    (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (not (q1052678-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q1052678-open-empty-exists-p
    (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1052678-open-set-p carrier topology set)
     (q1052678-empty-representation-p
      carrier set))))

(defun-sk q1052678-full-representation-p
    (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (q1052678-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-open-full-exists-p
    (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1052678-open-set-p carrier topology set)
     (q1052678-full-representation-p
      carrier set))))

(defun-sk q1052678-intersection-representation-p
    (carrier left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1052678-member-p intersection x)
      (and
       (q1052678-member-p left x)
       (q1052678-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q1052678-open-intersection-exists-p
    (carrier topology left right)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (q1052678-open-set-p
      carrier topology intersection)
     (q1052678-intersection-representation-p
      carrier left right intersection))))

(defun-sk q1052678-topology-intersection-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1052678-open-set-p
       carrier topology left)
      (q1052678-open-set-p
       carrier topology right))
     (q1052678-open-intersection-exists-p
      carrier topology left right))))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-union-contains-p
    (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1052678-member-p family set)
     (q1052678-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-union-representation-p
    (carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1052678-member-p union x)
      (q1052678-family-union-contains-p
       carrier family x)))))

(defun-sk q1052678-open-union-exists-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q1052678-open-set-p carrier topology union)
     (q1052678-union-representation-p
      carrier family union))))

(defun-sk q1052678-topology-union-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1052678-family-of-sets-p
       carrier family)
      (q1052678-family-members-open-p
       carrier topology family))
     (q1052678-open-union-exists-p
      carrier topology family))))

(defun q1052678-topological-space-p
    (carrier topology)
  (and
   (q1052678-family-of-sets-p carrier topology)
   (q1052678-open-empty-exists-p
    carrier topology)
   (q1052678-open-full-exists-p
    carrier topology)
   (q1052678-topology-intersection-law-p
    carrier topology)
   (q1052678-topology-union-law-p
    carrier topology)))

;; Density is the equivalent open-set characterization: every nonempty open
;; subset of the carrier meets the given set.

(defun-sk q1052678-dense-open-meeting-exists-p
    (carrier set open)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (q1052678-member-p set x)
     (q1052678-member-p open x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-dense-open-law-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (forall (open)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1052678-open-set-p
       carrier topology open)
      (q1052678-set-nonempty-p carrier open))
     (q1052678-dense-open-meeting-exists-p
      carrier set open))))

(defun q1052678-dense-set-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1052678-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1052678-dense-open-law-p
    carrier topology set)))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-members-dense-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p family set)
     (q1052678-dense-set-p
      carrier topology set))))

;; Countability is an internal existential enumeration by natural numbers,
;; covering the family up to extensional equality.

(defun-sk q1052678-enumeration-hits-set-p
    (carrier enumeration set)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1052678-set-equiv-p
      carrier
      (q1052678-value enumeration n)
      set))))

(defun-sk q1052678-enumeration-covers-p
    (carrier family enumeration)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p family set)
     (q1052678-enumeration-hits-set-p
      carrier enumeration set))))

(defun-sk q1052678-countable-family-witness-p
    (carrier family)
  (exists (enumeration)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp enumeration)
     (q1052678-enumeration-covers-p
      carrier family enumeration))))

(defun q1052678-countable-family-p
    (carrier family)
  (and
   (q1052678-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
   (q1052678-countable-family-witness-p
    carrier family)))

;; The set-theoretic intersection of a family is represented directly by its
;; membership condition, without constructing a lambda term.

(defun-sk q1052678-family-intersection-point-p
    (family x)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1052678-member-p family set)
     (q1052678-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-intersection-meets-open-p
    (carrier family open)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (q1052678-member-p open x)
     (q1052678-family-intersection-point-p
      family x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-family-intersection-dense-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (open)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1052678-open-set-p
       carrier topology open)
      (q1052678-set-nonempty-p carrier open))
     (q1052678-family-intersection-meets-open-p
      carrier family open))))

;; A Baire space is one in which every natural-number sequence of dense open
;; sets has dense intersection.

(defun-sk q1052678-sequence-of-sets-p
    (carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1052678-valid-set-p
      carrier (q1052678-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1052678-sequence-members-open-p
    (carrier topology sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1052678-open-set-p
      carrier
      topology
      (q1052678-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1052678-sequence-members-dense-p
    (carrier topology sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1052678-dense-set-p
      carrier
      topology
      (q1052678-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1052678-sequence-intersection-point-p
    (sequence x)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1052678-member-p
      (q1052678-value sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-sequence-intersection-meets-open-p
    (carrier sequence open)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1052678-member-p carrier x)
     (q1052678-member-p open x)
     (q1052678-sequence-intersection-point-p
      sequence x))))

(defun-sk q1052678-sequence-intersection-dense-p
    (carrier topology sequence)
  (forall (open)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1052678-open-set-p
       carrier topology open)
      (q1052678-set-nonempty-p carrier open))
     (q1052678-sequence-intersection-meets-open-p

(defun-sk q1052678-baire-sequence-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp sequence)
      (q1052678-sequence-of-sets-p
       carrier sequence)
      (q1052678-sequence-members-open-p
       carrier topology sequence)
      (q1052678-sequence-members-dense-p
       carrier topology sequence))
     (q1052678-sequence-intersection-dense-p
      carrier topology sequence))))

(defun q1052678-baire-space-p
    (carrier topology)
  (and
   (q1052678-topological-space-p
    carrier topology)
   (q1052678-baire-sequence-law-p
    carrier topology)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1052678-baire-category-statement
    (carrier topology family)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1052678-baire-space-p carrier topology)
    (q1052678-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
    (q1052678-family-members-open-p
