title: Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1052678
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1052678), "Baire category theorem": in a Baire
-- topological space, the intersection of an arbitrary countable family of
-- open dense subsets is dense. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1052678_baire_category_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

Subset :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X → Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X
Empty {a} _ =
  Bottom {a}

Whole :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X
Whole _ =
  Top

Union :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  V x

SameSubset :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
SameSubset {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) →
  Iff (U x) (V x)

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      Subset X →
      Subset X

    close-congruent :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SameSubset U V →
      SameSubset (close U) (close V)

    close-empty :
      SubsetOf (close Empty) Empty

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf (close (Union U V)) (Union (close U) (close V))

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf (Union (close U) (close V)) (close (Union U V))

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

Dense :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
Dense {X = X} topology U =
  (x : X) →
  close topology U x

CountableIntersection :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  (Nat → Subset X) →
  Subset X
CountableIntersection sets x =
  (n : Nat) →
  sets n x

BaireSpace :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Set (lsuc a)
BaireSpace {X = X} topology =
  (sets : Nat → Subset X) →
  ((n : Nat) → IsOpen topology (sets n)) →
  ((n : Nat) → Dense topology (sets n)) →
  Dense topology (CountableIntersection sets)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) →
  function x ≡ function y →
  x ≡ y

Countable :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Countable {a} I =
  Σ (I → Nat) (λ code → Injective code)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} →
  {X I : Set a} →
  (I → Subset X) →
  Subset X
Intersection {I = I} sets x =
  (i : I) →
  sets i x

baire-category-theorem :
  {a : Level} →
  Set (lsuc a)
baire-category-theorem {a} =
  (X : Set a) →
  (topology : TopologicalSpace X) →
  BaireSpace topology →
  (I : Set a) →
  (sets : I → Subset X) →
  Countable I →
  ((i : I) → IsOpen topology (sets i)) →
  ((i : I) → Dense topology (sets i)) →
  Dense topology (Intersection sets)

(*

*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory;

title: Q1052678_baire_category_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1052678,
% "Baire category theorem": in a Baire topological space, the intersection
% of any countable family of open dense sets is dense. This file contains no proof.

baire_category_theorem_Q1052678[
  X: TYPE,
  open_sets: [[X -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]

  empty_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  whole_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE

  binary_intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      A(x) AND B(x)

  union_of_family(F: set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (U: point_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  intersection_of_family(F: set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      FORALL (U: point_set):
        F(U) IMPLIES U(x)

  intersection_of_sequence(f: set_sequence): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      FORALL (n: nat):
        f(n)(x)

  topology_laws: bool =
    open_sets(empty_point_set)
      AND open_sets(whole_point_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
          (open_sets(A) AND open_sets(B))
            IMPLIES open_sets(binary_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
        (FORALL (F: set_family):
          (FORALL (U: point_set):
            F(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
          IMPLIES open_sets(union_of_family(F)))

  nonempty_point_set(A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: X):
      A(x)

  intersects(A, B: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: X):
      A(x) AND B(x)

  dense_point_set(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (U: point_set):
      (open_sets(U) AND nonempty_point_set(U))
        IMPLIES intersects(A, U)

  empty_family(F: set_family): bool =
    FORALL (U: point_set):
      NOT F(U)

  countable_family(F: set_family): bool =
    empty_family(F)
      OR EXISTS (enumeration: set_sequence):
        FORALL (U: point_set):
          F(U)
            IFF EXISTS (n: nat):
              enumeration(n) = U

  baire_space: bool =
    FORALL (f: set_sequence):
      ((FORALL (n: nat):
          open_sets(f(n)))
        AND
          (FORALL (n: nat):
            dense_point_set(f(n))))
      IMPLIES dense_point_set(intersection_of_sequence(f))

  dense_sInter_of_isOpen: bool =
    (topology_laws AND baire_space)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (S: set_family):
          (countable_family(S)
            AND
              (FORALL (U: point_set):
                S(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
            AND
              (FORALL (U: point_set):
                S(U) IMPLIES dense_point_set(U)))
          IMPLIES dense_point_set(intersection_of_family(S))
END baire_category_theorem_Q1052678

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1057919
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1057919), "Sylow theorems": existence of
-- prime-power-order subgroups, conjugacy of Sylow subgroups, and divisibility
-- and congruence properties of their number. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Sylow

@[expose] public section

universe u

namespace Q1057919

open MulAction

variable {G : Type u} [Group G]
variable {p : ℕ}

/-- If `p ^ n` divides the cardinality of `G`, then `G` has a subgroup of that cardinality. -/
theorem exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime [Finite G] (p : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdvd : p ^ n ∣ Nat.card G) : ∃ K : Subgroup G, Nat.card K = p ^ n := sorry

/-- If there are finitely many Sylow `p`-subgroups, any two are conjugate. -/
theorem isPretransitive_of_finite [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] :
    IsPretransitive G (Sylow p G) := sorry

/-- The number of Sylow `p`-subgroups divides the index of each Sylow `p`-subgroup. -/
theorem card_dvd_index [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] (P : Sylow p G) :
    Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ P.index := sorry

/-- The number of Sylow `p`-subgroups is congruent to one modulo `p`. -/
theorem card_sylow_modEq_one (p : ℕ) (G : Type u) [Group G]
    [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] :
    Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p] := sorry

end Q1057919

title: Q1057919_sylow_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1057919
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1057919), "Sylow theorems": prime-power
  subgroups, conjugacy of Sylow p-subgroups when their collection is finite,
  the Sylow count divides a Sylow subgroup's index and is congruent to one
  modulo p. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1057919_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q1057919_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q1057919_one : G;
  q1057919_inv : G -> G;
  q1057919_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q1057919_mul x (q1057919_mul y z) =
      q1057919_mul (q1057919_mul x y) z;
  q1057919_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q1057919_mul q1057919_one x = x;
  q1057919_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q1057919_mul x q1057919_one = x;
  q1057919_inv_mul :
    forall x : G, q1057919_mul (q1057919_inv x) x = q1057919_one;
  q1057919_mul_inv :
    forall x : G, q1057919_mul x (q1057919_inv x) = q1057919_one
}.

Arguments q1057919_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q1057919_one {G} _.
Arguments q1057919_inv {G} _ _.

Fixpoint q1057919_pow
    {G : Type} (grp : q1057919_group G) (x : G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q1057919_one grp
  | S k => q1057919_mul grp x (q1057919_pow grp x k)
  end.

Record q1057919_subgroup
    {G : Type} (grp : q1057919_group G) : Type := {
  q1057919_mem : G -> Prop;
  q1057919_subgroup_one :
    q1057919_mem (q1057919_one grp);
  q1057919_subgroup_mul :
    forall x y : G,
      q1057919_mem x ->
      q1057919_mem y ->
      q1057919_mem (q1057919_mul grp x y);
  q1057919_subgroup_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q1057919_mem x ->
      q1057919_mem (q1057919_inv grp x)
}.

Arguments q1057919_mem {G grp} _ _.

Definition q1057919_subgroup_included
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H K : q1057919_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall x : G, q1057919_mem H x -> q1057919_mem K x.

Definition q1057919_subgroup_equiv
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H K : q1057919_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall x : G, q1057919_mem H x <-> q1057919_mem K x.

Definition q1057919_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Definition q1057919_is_p_group
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (p : nat)
    (H : q1057919_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall x : G,
    q1057919_mem H x ->
    exists k : nat,
      q1057919_pow grp x (Nat.pow p k) = q1057919_one grp.

Definition q1057919_is_sylow
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (p : nat)
    (P : q1057919_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  q1057919_is_p_group p P /\
  forall Q : q1057919_subgroup grp,
    q1057919_is_p_group p Q ->
    q1057919_subgroup_included P Q ->
    q1057919_subgroup_equiv P Q.

Definition q1057919_conjugate_subgroups
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (P Q : q1057919_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  exists g : G,
    forall x : G,
      q1057919_mem Q x <->
      q1057919_mem P
        (q1057919_mul grp
          (q1057919_inv grp g)
          (q1057919_mul grp x g)).

Record q1057919_finite_type (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1057919_enum : list A;
  q1057919_enum_nodup : NoDup q1057919_enum;
  q1057919_enum_complete :
    forall x : A, In x q1057919_enum
}.

Arguments q1057919_enum {A} _.

Definition q1057919_finite_card
    {A : Type} (F : q1057919_finite_type A) : nat :=
  length (q1057919_enum F).

Definition q1057919_subgroup_card
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H : q1057919_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list G,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : G, In x xs <-> q1057919_mem H x) /\
    length xs = n.

Fixpoint q1057919_sylow_enum_nodup
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (xs : list (q1057919_subgroup grp)) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | nil => True
  | P :: rest =>
      (forall Q : q1057919_subgroup grp,
        In Q rest -> ~ q1057919_subgroup_equiv P Q) /\
      q1057919_sylow_enum_nodup rest
  end.

Record q1057919_finite_sylows
    {G : Type}
    (grp : q1057919_group G)
    (p : nat) : Type := {
  q1057919_sylow_enum : list (q1057919_subgroup grp);
  q1057919_sylow_enum_distinct :
    q1057919_sylow_enum_nodup q1057919_sylow_enum;
  q1057919_sylow_enum_sound :
    forall P : q1057919_subgroup grp,
      In P q1057919_sylow_enum ->
      q1057919_is_sylow p P;
  q1057919_sylow_enum_complete :
    forall P : q1057919_subgroup grp,
      q1057919_is_sylow p P ->
      exists Q : q1057919_subgroup grp,
        In Q q1057919_sylow_enum /\
        q1057919_subgroup_equiv P Q
}.

Arguments q1057919_sylow_enum {G grp p} _.

Definition q1057919_sylow_card
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    {p : nat}
    (F : q1057919_finite_sylows grp p) : nat :=
  length (q1057919_sylow_enum F).

Definition q1057919_same_left_coset
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H : q1057919_subgroup grp)
    (x y : G) : Prop :=
  q1057919_mem H
    (q1057919_mul grp (q1057919_inv grp x) y).

Fixpoint q1057919_coset_reps_nodup
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H : q1057919_subgroup grp)
    (xs : list G) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | nil => True
  | x :: rest =>
      (forall y : G,
        In y rest -> ~ q1057919_same_left_coset H x y) /\
      q1057919_coset_reps_nodup H rest
  end.

Definition q1057919_has_finite_index_card
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H : q1057919_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists reps : list G,
    q1057919_coset_reps_nodup H reps /\
    (forall x : G,
      exists r : G,
        In r reps /\ q1057919_same_left_coset H x r) /\
    length reps = n.

Definition q1057919_nat_index
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q1057919_group G}
    (H : q1057919_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q1057919_has_finite_index_card H n \/
  (n = 0 /\
   forall m : nat, ~ q1057919_has_finite_index_card H m).

Definition q1057919_mod_eq
    (modulus a b : nat) : Prop :=
  Nat.modulo a modulus = Nat.modulo b modulus.

Theorem Sylow_exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q1057919_group G)
         (F : q1057919_finite_type G)
         (p n : nat),
    q1057919_prime p ->
    Nat.divide (Nat.pow p n) (q1057919_finite_card F) ->
    exists K : q1057919_subgroup grp,
      q1057919_subgroup_card K (Nat.pow p n).
Admitted.

Theorem Sylow_isPretransitive_of_finite :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q1057919_group G)
         (p : nat)
         (F : q1057919_finite_sylows grp p),
    q1057919_prime p ->
    forall P Q : q1057919_subgroup grp,
      q1057919_is_sylow p P ->
      q1057919_is_sylow p Q ->
      q1057919_conjugate_subgroups P Q.
Admitted.

Theorem Sylow_card_dvd_index :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q1057919_group G)
         (p : nat)
         (F : q1057919_finite_sylows grp p)
         (P : q1057919_subgroup grp)
         (index : nat),
    q1057919_prime p ->
    q1057919_is_sylow p P ->
    q1057919_nat_index P index ->
    Nat.divide (q1057919_sylow_card F) index.
Admitted.

Theorem card_sylow_modEq_one :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q1057919_group G)
         (p : nat)
         (F : q1057919_finite_sylows grp p),
    q1057919_prime p ->
    q1057919_mod_eq p (q1057919_sylow_card F) 1.
Admitted.

title: Q1057919_sylow_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1057919,
  "Sylow theorems": existence of prime-power subgroups, conjugacy of Sylow
  subgroups, and the divisibility and congruence properties of their number.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1057919_sylow_theorems
  imports Main
begin

definition nat_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "nat_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    2 \<le> p \<and> (\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

primrec add_power :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'g" where
  "add_power x 0 = 0"
| "add_power x (Suc n) = x + add_power x n"

definition is_subgroup :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_subgroup H \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> H \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. - x \<in> H) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<forall>y \<in> H. x + y \<in> H)"

definition is_p_subgroup :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_p_subgroup p H \<longleftrightarrow>
    is_subgroup H \<and> (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<exists>n. add_power x (p ^ n) = 0)"

definition is_sylow_subgroup :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_sylow_subgroup p P \<longleftrightarrow>
    is_p_subgroup p P \<and>
    (\<forall>Q. is_p_subgroup p Q \<longrightarrow> P \<subseteq> Q \<longrightarrow> Q = P)"

definition sylow_subgroups :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'g::group_add set set" where
  "sylow_subgroups p = {P. is_sylow_subgroup p P}"

definition conjugate_subgroup :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "conjugate_subgroup g H =
    (\<lambda>h. g + h + (- g)) ` H"

definition right_cosets :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "right_cosets H = (\<lambda>g. (\<lambda>h. h + g) ` H) ` UNIV"

definition subgroup_index :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "subgroup_index H = card (right_cosets H)"

theorem exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime:
  fixes p n :: nat
  assumes "finite (UNIV :: 'g::group_add set)"
    and "nat_prime p"
    and "p ^ n dvd card (UNIV :: 'g set)"
  shows "\<exists>K :: 'g set. is_subgroup K \<and> card K = p ^ n"
  sorry

theorem sylow_is_pretransitive_of_finite:
  fixes p :: nat
  assumes "nat_prime p"
    and "finite (sylow_subgroups p :: 'g::group_add set set)"
  shows "\<forall>P \<in> sylow_subgroups p. \<forall>Q \<in> sylow_subgroups p.
    \<exists>g :: 'g. conjugate_subgroup g P = Q"
  sorry

theorem card_sylow_dvd_index:
  fixes p :: nat
    and P :: "'g::group_add set"
  assumes "nat_prime p"
    and "finite (sylow_subgroups p :: 'g set set)"
    and "P \<in> sylow_subgroups p"
  shows "card (sylow_subgroups p) dvd subgroup_index P"
  sorry

theorem card_sylow_mod_eq_one:
  fixes p :: nat
  assumes "nat_prime p"
    and "finite (sylow_subgroups p :: 'g::group_add set set)"
  shows "card (sylow_subgroups p :: 'g set set) mod p = 1 mod p"
  sorry

end

;; enumerations where the Lean source has a Finite hypothesis.

(defun q1057919-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)

   'if

(defun q1057919-no-divisor-from-p (n divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- n divisor))))
  (if (and
       (natp n)
       (natp divisor)
       (<= 2 divisor)
       (< divisor n))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod n divisor) 0))
       (q1057919-no-divisor-from-p
        n (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

title: Q1057919_sylow_theorems
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1057919,
-- "Sylow theorems": existence of prime-power subgroups, conjugacy of Sylow
-- subgroups, divisibility of their index, and their cardinality modulo the
-- prime. This file contains no proof.

module Q1057919_sylow_theorems where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≤_ _∣_ _↔_ _⊆_ _≈_
infixr 8 _^_

data ⊥ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

¬_ : {ℓ : Level} → Set ℓ → Set ℓ
¬_ {ℓ} A = A → ⊥ {ℓ}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤   : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    divides-equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : suc (suc zero) ≤ n
    divisor-is-trivial :
      (d : Nat) →
      d ∣ n →
      (d ≡ suc zero) ∨ (d ≡ n)

_^_ : Nat → Nat → Nat
base ^ zero = suc zero
base ^ suc exponent = base * (base ^ exponent)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  open Group structure

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity : member identity
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) → member x → member (inverse x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (multiply x y)

open SubgroupOf

_⊆_ :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
H ⊆ K =
  (x : _) → member H x → member K x

record _≈_
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  {structure : Group G}
  (H K : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    same-members-forward  : H ⊆ K
    same-members-backward : K ⊆ H

power :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  G →
  Nat →
  G
power structure x zero = Group.identity structure
power structure x (suc n) =
  Group.multiply structure x (power structure x n)

IsPGroup :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  Nat →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
IsPGroup structure prime H =
  (x : _) →
  member H x →
  Σ Nat
    (λ exponent →
      power structure x (prime ^ exponent) ≡
      Group.identity structure)

record IsSylow
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (prime : Nat)
  (H : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    is-p-group : IsPGroup structure prime H
    maximal :
      (K : SubgroupOf structure) →
      IsPGroup structure prime K →
      H ⊆ K →
      K ≈ H

SubgroupCarrier :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
SubgroupCarrier {G = G} H =
  Σ G (member H)

record SylowEnumeration
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (prime count : Nat) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    subgroup-at :
      Fin count →
      SubgroupOf structure
    subgroup-at-is-sylow :
      (i : Fin count) →
      IsSylow structure prime (subgroup-at i)
    complete :
      (H : SubgroupOf structure) →
      IsSylow structure prime H →
      Σ (Fin count)
        (λ i → H ≈ subgroup-at i)
    no-duplicates :
      (i j : Fin count) →
      subgroup-at i ≈ subgroup-at j →
      i ≡ j

ConjugateBy :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  G →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
ConjugateBy structure g H K =
  let open Group structure
  in
  (x : _) →
  member K x ↔
  member H (multiply (multiply (inverse g) x) g)

SameLeftCoset :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
SameLeftCoset structure H x y =
  let open Group structure
  in
  member H (multiply (inverse x) y)

record CosetTransversal
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (H : SubgroupOf structure)
  (count : Nat) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    representative :
      Fin count →
      G
    covers :
      (x : G) →
      Σ (Fin count)
        (λ i →
          SameLeftCoset structure H (representative i) x)
    unique :
      (i j : Fin count) →
      SameLeftCoset
        structure H (representative i) (representative j) →
      i ≡ j

InfiniteIndex :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
InfiniteIndex {ℓ = ℓ} structure H =
  (count : Nat) →
  CosetTransversal structure H count →
  ⊥ {ℓ}

data Index
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (H : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Nat →
  Set ℓ where

  finite-index :
    {count : Nat} →
    CosetTransversal structure H count →
    Index structure H count

  infinite-index :
    {count : Nat} →
    count ≡ zero →
    InfiniteIndex structure H →
    Index structure H count

record ModEq (modulus a b : Nat) : Set where
  field
    left-quotient  : Nat
    right-quotient : Nat
    mod-equation :
      a + modulus * left-quotient ≡
      b + modulus * right-quotient

-- Lean: Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime
exists-subgroup-card-pow-prime :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
exists-subgroup-card-pow-prime ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (group-order prime exponent : Nat) →
  Bijection G (Fin group-order) →
  Prime prime →
  prime ^ exponent ∣ group-order →
  Σ (SubgroupOf structure)
    (λ H →
      Bijection
        (SubgroupCarrier H)
        (Fin (prime ^ exponent)))

-- Lean: Sylow.isPretransitive_of_finite
is-pretransitive-of-finite :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
is-pretransitive-of-finite ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (prime count : Nat) →
  Prime prime →
  SylowEnumeration structure prime count →
  (P Q : SubgroupOf structure) →
  IsSylow structure prime P →
  IsSylow structure prime Q →
  Σ G
    (λ g → ConjugateBy structure g P Q)

-- Lean: Sylow.card_dvd_index
card-sylow-divides-index :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
card-sylow-divides-index ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (prime sylow-count subgroup-index : Nat) →
  Prime prime →
  SylowEnumeration structure prime sylow-count →
  (P : SubgroupOf structure) →
  IsSylow structure prime P →
  Index structure P subgroup-index →
  sylow-count ∣ subgroup-index

-- Lean: card_sylow_modEq_one
card-sylow-modEq-one :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
card-sylow-modEq-one ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (prime sylow-count : Nat) →
  Prime prime →
  SylowEnumeration structure prime sylow-count →
  ModEq prime sylow-count (suc zero)

title: Q1057919_sylow_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1057919, "Sylow theorems": existence of subgroups of prime-power order,
  conjugacy of Sylow subgroups, divisibility of their index by their count,
  and congruence of that count to one modulo the prime. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val q1057919_nat_card_def = new_definition(
  "q1057919_nat_card_def",
  ``q1057919_nat_card (s : 'a set) =
      if FINITE s then CARD s else 0``);

val q1057919_is_p_group_def = new_definition(
  "q1057919_is_p_group_def",
  ``q1057919_is_p_group (p : num) (h : 'a group) <=>
      !x : 'a.
        x IN h.carrier
        ==>
        ?k : num. h.exp x (p ** k) = h.id``);

val q1057919_is_sylow_def = new_definition(
  "q1057919_is_sylow_def",
  ``q1057919_is_sylow (p : num) (g : 'a group) (h : 'a group) <=>
      Subgroup h g /\
      q1057919_is_p_group p h /\
      !q : 'a group.
        Subgroup q g /\
        q1057919_is_p_group p q /\
        h.carrier SUBSET q.carrier
        ==>
        q.carrier = h.carrier``);

val q1057919_sylow_carriers_def = new_definition(
  "q1057919_sylow_carriers_def",
  ``q1057919_sylow_carriers (p : num) (g : 'a group) =
      {s : 'a set |
        ?h : 'a group.
          q1057919_is_sylow p g h /\ s = h.carrier}``);

val Sylow_exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (p : num) (n : num).
      Group g /\
      FINITE g.carrier /\
      prime p /\
      (p ** n) divides q1057919_nat_card g.carrier
      ==>
      ?h : 'a group.
        Subgroup h g /\
        q1057919_nat_card h.carrier = p ** n``;

val Sylow_isPretransitive_of_finite =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (p : num).
      Group g /\
      prime p /\
      FINITE (q1057919_sylow_carriers p g)
      ==>
      !(P : 'a group) (Q : 'a group).
        q1057919_is_sylow p g P /\
        q1057919_is_sylow p g Q
        ==>
        ?a : 'a.
          a IN g.carrier /\
          (conjugate_subgroup P g a).carrier = Q.carrier``;

val Sylow_card_dvd_index =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (p : num) (P : 'a group).
      Group g /\
      prime p /\
      FINITE (q1057919_sylow_carriers p g) /\
      q1057919_is_sylow p g P
      ==>
      q1057919_nat_card (q1057919_sylow_carriers p g)
        divides
      q1057919_nat_card (CosetPartition g P)``;

val card_sylow_modEq_one =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (p : num).
      Group g /\
      prime p /\
      FINITE (q1057919_sylow_carriers p g)
      ==>
      q1057919_nat_card (q1057919_sylow_carriers p g) MOD p =
      1 MOD p``;

title: Q1057919_sylow_theorems
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1057919
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1057919), "Sylow theorems": existence of
  subgroups of prime-power order, conjugacy of Sylow subgroups, and divisibility
  and modular-congruence properties of the number of Sylow subgroups. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's native class ( P pSyl G ) is the set of maximal P-subgroups of G,
  matching the Sylow subtype in the Lean source. Q1057919Conj is conjugation by
  g, written with the group subtraction operation as g * x * g^-1.

  Lean's Subgroup.index is Nat.card of the left-coset quotient, hence is zero
  when that quotient is infinite. SetMM's hash operation instead returns +oo
  on infinite sets, so Q1057919Index uses a conditional to preserve Lean's
  zero-on-infinite convention exactly.

  The four final $a assertions correspond, in source order, to
  Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime, Sylow.isPretransitive_of_finite,
  Sylow.card_dvd_index, and card_sylow_modEq_one. Only the first assertion
  assumes that the group carrier is finite; the other three retain the source
  assumption that the set of Sylow subgroups is finite. These assertions are
  unproved and add no $p proof statements.
$)

$c Q1057919Conj Q1057919Index $.

q1057919-conj-syntax $a class ( Q1057919Conj G g H ) $.
q1057919-index-syntax $a class ( Q1057919Index G H ) $.

${
  $d G H g x $.

  q1057919-conj-definition $a |- ( Q1057919Conj G g H ) =
    ran (
      x e. H |->
      ( ( g ( +g ` G ) x ) ( -g ` G ) g )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H $.

  q1057919-index-definition $a |- ( Q1057919Index G H ) =
    if (
      ( ( Base ` G ) /. ( G ~QG H ) ) e. Fin
      ,
      ( # ` ( ( Base ` G ) /. ( G ~QG H ) ) )
      ,
      0
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H N P $.

  thousand-theorems-q1057919-exists-subgroup $a |- (
    A. G A. P A. N
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          ( Base ` G ) e. Fin
          /\
          P e. Prime
          /\
          N e. NN0
          /\
          ( P ^ N ) || ( # ` ( Base ` G ) )
        )
        ->
        E. H e. ( SubGrp ` G )
          ( # ` H ) = ( P ^ N )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H K P g $.

  thousand-theorems-q1057919-sylow-conjugacy $a |- (
    A. G A. P
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          P e. Prime
          /\
          ( P pSyl G ) e. Fin
        )
        ->
        A. H e. ( P pSyl G )
          A. K e. ( P pSyl G )
            E. g e. ( Base ` G )
              ( Q1057919Conj G g H ) = K
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H P $.

  thousand-theorems-q1057919-card-divides-index $a |- (
    A. G A. P A. H
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          P e. Prime
          /\
          ( P pSyl G ) e. Fin
          /\
          H e. ( P pSyl G )
        )
        ->
        ( # ` ( P pSyl G ) ) || ( Q1057919Index G H )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G P $.

  thousand-theorems-q1057919-card-modeq-one $a |- (
    A. G A. P
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          P e. Prime
          /\
          ( P pSyl G ) e. Fin
        )
        ->
        (
          ( ( # ` ( P pSyl G ) ) mod P )
          =
          ( 1 mod P )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for G being finite Group, p being Prime, n being Nat st
    p |^ n divides card G
  holds ex K being strict Subgroup of G st
    card K = p |^ n
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for G being Group, p being Prime, S being finite set st
    S = {H where H is Element of Subgroups G:
      ex P being strict Subgroup of G st
        P = H &
        (for x being Element of P holds
          ex n being Nat st x |^ (p |^ n) = 1_P) &
        for Q being strict Subgroup of G st
          (for y being Element of Q holds
            ex m being Nat st y |^ (p |^ m) = 1_Q) &
          P is Subgroup of Q
        holds P = Q}
  holds
    for P1,P2 being strict Subgroup of G st
      ((for x being Element of P1 holds
          ex n being Nat st x |^ (p |^ n) = 1_P1) &
        for Q being strict Subgroup of G st
          (for y being Element of Q holds
            ex m being Nat st y |^ (p |^ m) = 1_Q) &
          P1 is Subgroup of Q
        holds P1 = Q) &
      ((for x being Element of P2 holds
          ex n being Nat st x |^ (p |^ n) = 1_P2) &
        for Q being strict Subgroup of G st
          (for y being Element of Q holds
            ex m being Nat st y |^ (p |^ m) = 1_Q) &
          P2 is Subgroup of Q
        holds P2 = Q)
    holds P1,P2 are_conjugated
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for G being Group, p being Prime, S being finite set st
    S = {H where H is Element of Subgroups G:
      ex Q being strict Subgroup of G st
        Q = H &
        (for x being Element of Q holds
          ex n being Nat st x |^ (p |^ n) = 1_Q) &
        for R being strict Subgroup of G st
          (for y being Element of R holds
            ex m being Nat st y |^ (p |^ m) = 1_R) &
          Q is Subgroup of R
        holds Q = R}
  holds
    for P being strict Subgroup of G st
      (for x being Element of P holds
        ex n being Nat st x |^ (p |^ n) = 1_P) &
      for Q being strict Subgroup of G st
        (for y being Element of Q holds
          ex m being Nat st y |^ (p |^ m) = 1_Q) &
        P is Subgroup of Q
      holds P = Q
    holds
      (Left_Cosets P is finite implies
        for C being finite set st C = Left_Cosets P holds
          card S divides card C) &
      (not Left_Cosets P is finite implies card S divides 0)
proof
end;

title: Q1057919_sylow_theorems
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1057919,
% "Sylow theorems": existence of prime-power subgroups, conjugacy of Sylow
% subgroups, and divisibility and congruence properties of their number.
% This file contains no proof.

Q1057919_sylow_theorems[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  element_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[G], finite_sets[element_set]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  group_power(x: G, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      mul(group_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: nat): value = divisor * factor

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND (FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value)

  nat_congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) =
        (modulus :: int) * offset

  subset_of(H, K: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): H(x) IMPLIES K(x)

  is_subgroup(H: element_set): bool =
    H(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        H(x) AND H(y) IMPLIES H(mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES H(inv(x)))

  is_p_subgroup(p: nat, H: element_set): bool =
    is_subgroup(H)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (exponent: nat):
            group_power(x, p ^ exponent) = one)

  is_sylow(p: nat, P: element_set): bool =
    is_p_subgroup(p, P)
      AND (FORALL (Q: element_set):
        is_p_subgroup(p, Q)
          AND subset_of(P, Q)
          IMPLIES Q = P)

  exact_sylow_family(
      p: nat,
      family: finite_set[element_set]): bool =
    FORALL (H: element_set):
      family(H) IFF is_sylow(p, H)

  conjugate_subgroup(g: G, H: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      H(mul(mul(inv(g), x), g))

  full_carrier(carrier: finite_set[G]): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): carrier(x)

  left_coset(g: G, H: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      EXISTS (h: G):
        H(h) AND x = mul(g, h)

  exact_left_coset_family(
      H: element_set,
      family: finite_set[element_set]): bool =
    FORALL (C: element_set):
      family(C) IFF
        EXISTS (g: G): C = left_coset(g, H)

  subgroup_index(H: element_set, index: nat): bool =
    (EXISTS (family: finite_set[element_set]):
      exact_left_coset_family(H, family)
        AND index = card(family))
      OR
    (index = 0
      AND NOT
        EXISTS (family: finite_set[element_set]):
          exact_left_coset_family(H, family))

  Q1057919_exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime: bool =
    FORALL (p, exponent: nat),
           (carrier: finite_set[G]):
      (group_laws
        AND full_carrier(carrier)
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND nat_divides(p ^ exponent, card(carrier)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (H: finite_set[G]):
          is_subgroup(H)
            AND card(H) = p ^ exponent

  Q1057919_isPretransitive_of_finite: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat),
           (family: finite_set[element_set]):
      (group_laws
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND exact_sylow_family(p, family))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (P, Q: element_set):
          is_sylow(p, P)
            AND is_sylow(p, Q)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (g: G):
                conjugate_subgroup(g, P) = Q

  Q1057919_card_dvd_index: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat),
           (family: finite_set[element_set]),
           (P: element_set),
           (index: nat):
      (group_laws
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND exact_sylow_family(p, family)
        AND is_sylow(p, P)
        AND subgroup_index(P, index))
      IMPLIES
        nat_divides(card(family), index)

  Q1057919_card_sylow_modEq_one: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat),
           (family: finite_set[element_set]):
      (group_laws
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND exact_sylow_family(p, family))
      IMPLIES
        nat_congruent(card(family), 1, p)

END Q1057919_sylow_theorems

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1065257
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1065257), "Squeeze theorem": if two bounding
-- functions tend to the same limit and eventually bound a third function, then the third
-- function tends to that limit. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.Basic

@[expose] public section

open Filter TopologicalSpace

open scoped Topology

universe u v

variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v}
variable [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]

namespace Q1065257

/-- The squeeze theorem with inequalities that hold eventually in the source filter. -/
theorem tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' [OrderTopology α]
    {f g h : β → α} {b : Filter β} {a : α}
    (hg : Tendsto g b (𝓝 a)) (hh : Tendsto h b (𝓝 a))
    (hgf : ∀ᶠ x in b, g x ≤ f x) (hfh : ∀ᶠ x in b, f x ≤ h x) :
    Tendsto f b (𝓝 a) := sorry

end Q1065257

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1065257
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1065257), "Squeeze theorem": for functions into
  a preordered space with its order topology, if lower and upper functions
  converge to the same limit and eventually bound a middle function, then the
  middle function converges to that limit. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q1065257_set (X : Type) : Type := X -> Prop.

Definition q1065257_subset
    {X : Type}
    (U V : q1065257_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X, U x -> V x.

Record q1065257_preorder (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1065257_le : X -> X -> Prop;
  q1065257_le_refl :
    forall x : X, q1065257_le x x;
  q1065257_le_trans :
    forall x y z : X,
      q1065257_le x y ->
      q1065257_le y z ->
      q1065257_le x z
}.

Arguments q1065257_le {X} _ _ _.

Definition q1065257_lt
    {X : Type}
    (O : q1065257_preorder X)
    (x y : X) : Prop :=
  q1065257_le O x y /\ ~ q1065257_le O y x.

Record q1065257_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1065257_is_open : q1065257_set X -> Prop;
  q1065257_open_univ :
    q1065257_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1065257_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1065257_set X,
      q1065257_is_open U ->
      q1065257_is_open V ->
      q1065257_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1065257_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q1065257_set (q1065257_set X),
      (forall U : q1065257_set X,
        family U -> q1065257_is_open U) ->
      q1065257_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1065257_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1065257_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q1065257_generated_order_open
    {X : Type}
    (O : q1065257_preorder X)
    (U : q1065257_set X) : Prop :=
  forall T : q1065257_topological_space X,
    (forall a : X,
      q1065257_is_open T
        (fun x : X => q1065257_lt O a x)) ->
    (forall a : X,
      q1065257_is_open T
        (fun x : X => q1065257_lt O x a)) ->
    q1065257_is_open T U.

Definition q1065257_order_topology
    {X : Type}
    (O : q1065257_preorder X)
    (T : q1065257_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  forall U : q1065257_set X,
    q1065257_is_open T U <->
    q1065257_generated_order_open O U.

Record q1065257_filter (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1065257_filter_sets : q1065257_set X -> Prop;
  q1065257_filter_univ :
    q1065257_filter_sets (fun _ : X => True);
  q1065257_filter_superset :
    forall U V : q1065257_set X,
      q1065257_filter_sets U ->
      q1065257_subset U V ->
      q1065257_filter_sets V;
  q1065257_filter_inter :
    forall U V : q1065257_set X,
      q1065257_filter_sets U ->
      q1065257_filter_sets V ->
      q1065257_filter_sets (fun x : X => U x /\ V x)
}.

Arguments q1065257_filter_sets {X} _ _.

Definition q1065257_eventually
    {X : Type}
    (F : q1065257_filter X)
    (P : X -> Prop) : Prop :=
  q1065257_filter_sets F P.

Definition q1065257_neighborhood
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1065257_topological_space X)
    (a : X)
    (U : q1065257_set X) : Prop :=
  exists V : q1065257_set X,
    q1065257_is_open T V /\
    V a /\
    q1065257_subset V U.

Definition q1065257_tendsto
    {X Y : Type}
    (f : X -> Y)
    (F : q1065257_filter X)
    (T : q1065257_topological_space Y)
    (a : Y) : Prop :=
  forall U : q1065257_set Y,
    q1065257_neighborhood T a U ->
    q1065257_eventually F (fun x : X => U (f x)).

Theorem tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' :
  forall (Alpha Beta : Type)
         (O : q1065257_preorder Alpha)
         (T : q1065257_topological_space Alpha)
         (F : q1065257_filter Beta)
         (f g h : Beta -> Alpha)
         (a : Alpha),
    q1065257_order_topology O T ->
    q1065257_tendsto g F T a ->
    q1065257_tendsto h F T a ->
    q1065257_eventually F
      (fun x : Beta => q1065257_le O (g x) (f x)) ->
    q1065257_eventually F
      (fun x : Beta => q1065257_le O (f x) (h x)) ->
    q1065257_tendsto f F T a.
Admitted.

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065257,
  "Squeeze theorem": for functions into a preordered space with its order
  topology, eventual lower and upper bounds converging to the same point force
  the bounded function to converge there. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
  imports "HOL.Topological_Spaces"
begin

locale preorder_order_topology =
  fixes le :: "'a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" (infix "\<preceq>" 50)
    and lt :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" (infix "\<prec>" 50)
  assumes le_refl: "\<And>x. x \<preceq> x"
    and le_trans:
      "\<And>x y z. x \<preceq> y \<Longrightarrow> y \<preceq> z \<Longrightarrow> x \<preceq> z"
    and lt_iff_le_not_le:
      "\<And>x y. x \<prec> y \<longleftrightarrow> x \<preceq> y \<and> \<not> y \<preceq> x"
    and open_generated_order:
      "open =
        generate_topology
          (range (\<lambda>a. {b. a \<prec> b}) \<union> range (\<lambda>a. {b. b \<prec> a}))"
begin

theorem squeeze_theorem:
  fixes f g h :: "'b \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and net :: "'b filter"
    and a :: "'a"
  assumes "(g \<longlongrightarrow> a) net"
    and "(h \<longlongrightarrow> a) net"
    and "eventually (\<lambda>x. g x \<preceq> f x) net"
    and "eventually (\<lambda>x. f x \<preceq> h x) net"
  shows "(f \<longlongrightarrow> a) net"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1065257,
  "Squeeze theorem": for functions into an arbitrary preorder with its order
  topology, convergence of lower and upper bounds to the same point together
  with eventual pointwise bounds implies convergence of the middle function.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1065257_SQUEEZE_THEOREM =
  `let is_preorder =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) in
   let is_topology =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (UNIV:A->bool) /\
       (!C:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
       (!U V:A->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V
          ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let is_order_topology =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       !U:A->bool.
         open_sets U <=>
         !candidate:(A->bool)->bool.
           is_topology candidate /\
           (!a:A. candidate {x:A | le a x /\ ~(le x a)}) /\
           (!a:A. candidate {x:A | le x a /\ ~(le a x)})
           ==> candidate U in
   let is_filter =
     \(sets:(B->bool)->bool).
       sets (UNIV:B->bool) /\
       (!S U:B->bool.
          sets S /\ S SUBSET U ==> sets U) /\
       (!S U:B->bool.
          sets S /\ sets U ==> sets (S INTER U)) in
   let tends_to =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
      (sets:(B->bool)->bool) (u:B->A) (a:A).
       !U:A->bool.
         open_sets U /\ a IN U
         ==> sets {x:B | u x IN U} in
   !le:A->A->bool.
   !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool.
   !sets:(B->bool)->bool.
   !f g h:B->A.
   !a:A.
     is_preorder le /\
     is_topology open_sets /\
     is_order_topology le open_sets /\
     is_filter sets /\
     tends_to open_sets sets g a /\
     tends_to open_sets sets h a /\
     sets {x:B | le (g x) (f x)} /\
     sets {x:B | le (f x) (h x)}
     ==> tends_to open_sets sets f a`;;

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065257,
;; "Squeeze theorem": in an arbitrary preordered space with its order topology,
;; two functions converging along a filter to the same point squeeze any
;; eventually intermediate function to that point. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The stubs are conservative evaluators for arbitrary carrier predicates,
;; preorder relations, maps, and filter membership. Sets needed by the
;; statement are represented by symbolic expressions whose membership is
;; defined below. They include the full set, finite intersections, strict
;; order preimages, and pointwise non-strict order bounds.
;;
;; Restricting a source filter to these expressions preserves every predicate
;; occurring in the theorem. Conversely, the upward closure of the represented
;; large sets is a filter on the full powerset and agrees with the represented
;; filter on every expression. Thus this is a bidirectionally equivalent
;; definitional presentation, not a finite or executable approximation.
;;
;; Convergence is expressed using all strict lower and upper order intervals.
;; For a preorder equipped with its order topology, this is equivalent to
;; Tendsto into the neighborhood filter.

(defstub q1065257-domain-p (domain x) t)
(defstub q1065257-codomain-p (codomain x) t)
(defstub q1065257-le (codomain order left right) t)
(defstub q1065257-map-value
  (domain codomain map x)
  t)
(defstub q1065257-large-p
  (domain codomain order filter set-expression)
  t)

(defun q1065257-lt-p
    (codomain order left right)
  (and
   (q1065257-le codomain order left right)
   (not
    (q1065257-le codomain order right left))))

(defun-sk q1065257-preorder-p (codomain order)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1065257-codomain-p codomain x)
      (q1065257-le codomain order x x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065257-codomain-p codomain x)
       (q1065257-codomain-p codomain y)
       (q1065257-codomain-p codomain z)
       (q1065257-le codomain order x y)
       (q1065257-le codomain order y z))
      (q1065257-le codomain order x z)))))

(defun-sk q1065257-map-typed-p
    (domain codomain map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1065257-domain-p domain x)
     (q1065257-codomain-p
      codomain
      (q1065257-map-value
       domain codomain map x)))))

;; Symbolic sets over the source carrier.

(defun q1065257-full-set ()
  (list 'q1065257-full-set))

(defun q1065257-intersection-set (left right)
  (list 'q1065257-intersection-set left right))

(defun q1065257-lower-set (map bound)
  (list 'q1065257-lower-set map bound))

(defun q1065257-upper-set (map bound)
  (list 'q1065257-upper-set map bound))

(defun q1065257-pointwise-le-set (left-map right-map)
  (list
   'q1065257-pointwise-le-set
   left-map
   right-map))

(defun q1065257-set-expression-p (set-expression)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count set-expression)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (true-listp set-expression)
     (equal (len set-expression) 1)
     (equal
      (car set-expression)
      'q1065257-full-set))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp set-expression)
     (equal (len set-expression) 3)
     (equal
      (car set-expression)
      'q1065257-intersection-set))
    (and
     (q1065257-set-expression-p
      (cadr set-expression))
     (q1065257-set-expression-p
      (caddr set-expression))))
   ((and
     (true-listp set-expression)
     (equal (len set-expression) 3)
     (equal
      (car set-expression)
      'q1065257-lower-set))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp set-expression)
     (equal (len set-expression) 3)
     (equal
      (car set-expression)
      'q1065257-upper-set))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp set-expression)
     (equal (len set-expression) 3)
     (equal
      (car set-expression)
      'q1065257-pointwise-le-set))
    t)
   (t nil)))

(defun q1065257-set-member-p
    (domain codomain order set-expression x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count set-expression)))
  (if (not (q1065257-domain-p domain x))
      nil
    (cond
     ((and
       (true-listp set-expression)
       (equal (len set-expression) 1)
       (equal
        (car set-expression)
        'q1065257-full-set))
      t)
     ((and
       (true-listp set-expression)
       (equal (len set-expression) 3)
       (equal
        (car set-expression)
        'q1065257-intersection-set))
      (and
       (q1065257-set-member-p
        domain codomain order
        (cadr set-expression) x)
       (q1065257-set-member-p
        domain codomain order
        (caddr set-expression) x)))
     ((and
       (true-listp set-expression)
       (equal (len set-expression) 3)
       (equal
        (car set-expression)
        'q1065257-lower-set))
      (let ((map (cadr set-expression))
            (bound (caddr set-expression)))
        (and
         (q1065257-codomain-p codomain bound)
         (q1065257-lt-p
          codomain order bound
          (q1065257-map-value
           domain codomain map x)))))
     ((and
       (true-listp set-expression)
       (equal (len set-expression) 3)
       (equal
        (car set-expression)
        'q1065257-upper-set))
      (let ((map (cadr set-expression))
            (bound (caddr set-expression)))
        (and
         (q1065257-codomain-p codomain bound)
         (q1065257-lt-p
          codomain order
          (q1065257-map-value
           domain codomain map x)
          bound))))
     ((and
       (true-listp set-expression)
       (equal (len set-expression) 3)
       (equal
        (car set-expression)
        'q1065257-pointwise-le-set))
      (q1065257-le
       codomain order
       (q1065257-map-value
        domain codomain
        (cadr set-expression) x)
       (q1065257-map-value
        domain codomain
        (caddr set-expression) x)))
     (t nil))))

(defun-sk q1065257-subset-p
    (domain codomain order left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1065257-set-member-p
      domain codomain order left x)
     (q1065257-set-member-p
      domain codomain order right x))))

(defun-sk q1065257-filter-intersection-closed-p
    (domain codomain order filter)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1065257-set-expression-p left)
      (q1065257-set-expression-p right)
      (q1065257-large-p
       domain codomain order filter left)
      (q1065257-large-p
       domain codomain order filter right))
     (q1065257-large-p
      domain codomain order filter
      (q1065257-intersection-set left right)))))

(defun-sk q1065257-filter-upward-closed-p
    (domain codomain order filter)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1065257-set-expression-p left)
      (q1065257-set-expression-p right)
      (q1065257-large-p
       domain codomain order filter left)
      (q1065257-subset-p
       domain codomain order left right))
     (q1065257-large-p
      domain codomain order filter right))))

(defun q1065257-filter-p
    (domain codomain order filter)
  (and
   (q1065257-large-p
    domain codomain order filter
    (q1065257-full-set))
   (q1065257-filter-intersection-closed-p
    domain codomain order filter)

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065257,
-- "Squeeze theorem": for functions into a preordered space with its order
-- topology, eventual lower and upper bounds converging to the same point force
-- the bounded function to converge there. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1065257_squeeze_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

Subset :
  {a p : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Subset {p = p} X =
  X → Set p

Whole :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset {p = p} X
Whole _ =
  Top

Intersection :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Subset {p = p} X
Intersection U V x =
  U x × V x

SubsetOf :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Set (a ⊔ p)
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  V x

record Preorder
  {a p : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p) where

  field
    le :
      X →
      X →
      Set p

    le-reflexive :
      (x : X) →
      le x x

    le-transitive :
      (x y z : X) →
      le x y →
      le y z →
      le x z

open Preorder

StrictLess :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Preorder {p = p} X →
  X →
  X →
  Set p
StrictLess order x y =
  le order x y × Not (le order y x)

record Filter
  {a p : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p) where

  field
    eventually :
      Subset {p = p} X →
      Set p

    eventually-whole :
      eventually Whole

    eventually-upward :
      (U V : Subset {p = p} X) →
      eventually U →
      SubsetOf U V →
      eventually V

    eventually-intersection :
      (U V : Subset {p = p} X) →
      eventually U →
      eventually V →
      eventually (Intersection U V)

open Filter

data OrderRay
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set a where

  above : X → OrderRay X
  below : X → OrderRay X

RayContains :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Preorder {p = p} X →
  OrderRay X →
  X →
  Set p
RayContains order (above lower) x =
  StrictLess order lower x
RayContains order (below upper) x =
  StrictLess order x upper

All :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  (P : A → Set b) →
  List A →
  Set b
All P [] =
  Top
All P (x ∷ xs) =
  P x × All P xs

BasicContains :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Preorder {p = p} X →
  List (OrderRay X) →
  X →
  Set p
BasicContains order rays x =
  All (λ ray → RayContains order ray x) rays

OrderNeighborhood :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Preorder {p = p} X →
  X →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Set (a ⊔ p)
OrderNeighborhood {X = X} order x U =
  Σ (List (OrderRay X))
    (λ rays →
      BasicContains order rays x
      ×
      SubsetOf (BasicContains order rays) U)

Tendsto :
  {a b p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {Y : Set b} →
  Preorder {p = p} X →
  Filter {p = p} Y →
  (Y → X) →
  X →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Tendsto {p = p} {X = X} order source-filter function limit =
  (U : Subset {p = p} X) →
  OrderNeighborhood order limit U →
  eventually source-filter (λ y → U (function y))

squeeze-theorem :
  {a b : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
squeeze-theorem {a} {b} =
  (X : Set a) →
  (Y : Set b) →
  (order : Preorder {p = a ⊔ b} X) →
  (source-filter : Filter {p = a ⊔ b} Y) →
  (f g h : Y → X) →
  (limit : X) →
  Tendsto order source-filter g limit →
  Tendsto order source-filter h limit →
  eventually source-filter (λ y → le order (g y) (f y)) →
  eventually source-filter (λ y → le order (f y) (h y)) →
  Tendsto order source-filter f limit

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1065257 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1065257), "Squeeze theorem": for
  functions into a preordered space with its order topology, eventual lower
  and upper bounds converging to the same point force the bounded function
  to converge there. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory;

val q1065257_preorder_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_preorder_def",
  ``q1065257_preorder (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z)``);

val q1065257_strict_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_strict_def",
  ``q1065257_strict (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) x y <=>
      leq x y /\ ~leq y x``);

val q1065257_order_basic_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_order_basic_def",
  ``q1065257_order_basic
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (lower : 'a set) (upper : 'a set) =
      {x |
        (!l. l IN lower ==> q1065257_strict leq l x) /\
        (!u. u IN upper ==> q1065257_strict leq x u)}``);

val q1065257_order_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_order_topology_def",
  ``q1065257_order_topology
      (top : 'a topology) (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      q1065257_preorder leq /\
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      (!U.
        open_in top U <=>
        !x.
          x IN U ==>
          ?lower upper.
            FINITE lower /\
            FINITE upper /\
            x IN q1065257_order_basic leq lower upper /\
            q1065257_order_basic leq lower upper SUBSET U)``);

val q1065257_filter_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_filter_def",
  ``q1065257_filter (sets : ('b set) set) <=>
      UNIV IN sets /\
      (!s t. s IN sets /\ s SUBSET t ==> t IN sets) /\
      (!s t. s IN sets /\ t IN sets ==> s INTER t IN sets)``);

val q1065257_eventually_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_eventually_def",
  ``q1065257_eventually (sets : ('b set) set) (p : 'b -> bool) <=>
      {x | p x} IN sets``);

val q1065257_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1065257_tendsto_def",
  ``q1065257_tendsto
      (top : 'a topology) (sets : ('b set) set)
      (f : 'b -> 'a) (a : 'a) <=>
      !U.
        open_in top U /\ a IN U ==>
        q1065257_eventually sets (\x. f x IN U)``);

val tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' =
  ``!(top : 'a topology) (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (sets : ('b set) set)
      (f : 'b -> 'a) (g : 'b -> 'a) (h : 'b -> 'a) (a : 'a).
      q1065257_order_topology top leq /\
      q1065257_filter sets /\
      q1065257_tendsto top sets g a /\
      q1065257_tendsto top sets h a /\
      q1065257_eventually sets (\x. leq (g x) (f x)) /\
      q1065257_eventually sets (\x. leq (f x) (h x))
      ==>
      q1065257_tendsto top sets f a``;

  eventually bounded between two functions tending to the same point in the
  order topology of a preorder also tends to that point. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1065257Preorder says that R is a reflexive, transitive relation on X.
  Q1065257OrderTop is the topology generated by the strict upper and lower
  rays x R y and not y R x of that preorder.

  Q1065257Filter uses the axioms of Lean's Filter: it contains the whole
  carrier and is closed under supersets and binary intersections. In
  particular it permits the improper filter containing the empty set, unlike
  SetMM's proper-filter class Fil. Q1065257Tendsto says that every open
  neighborhood of the proposed limit has an eventual inverse image.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1065257Preorder Q1065257OrderTop Q1065257Filter
   Q1065257Tendsto $.

q1065257-preorder-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1065257Preorder R X ) $.
q1065257-order-top-syntax
  $a class ( Q1065257OrderTop R X ) $.
q1065257-filter-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1065257Filter L Y ) $.
q1065257-tendsto-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1065257Tendsto J L F A Y ) $.

${
  $d R X x y z $.

  q1065257-preorder-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1065257Preorder R X )
    <->
    (
      R C_ ( X X. X )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. X x R x
        /\
        A. x e. X A. y e. X A. z e. X
          ( ( x R y /\ y R z ) -> x R z )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d R X x y $.

  q1065257-order-top-definition $a |- (
    Q1065257OrderTop R X
  ) = (
    topGen ` ( fi ` (
      { X }
      u.
      (
        ran ( x e. X |-> { y e. X | ( x R y /\ -. y R x ) } )
        u.
        ran ( x e. X |-> { y e. X | ( y R x /\ -. x R y ) } )
      )
    ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d L U V Y $.

  q1065257-filter-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1065257Filter L Y )
    <->
    (
      L C_ ~P Y
      /\
      (
        Y e. L
        /\
        (
          A. U e. L A. V e. L ( U i^i V ) e. L
          /\
          A. U e. L A. V e. ~P Y
            ( U C_ V -> V e. L )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F J L U Y y $.

  q1065257-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1065257Tendsto J L F A Y )
    <->
    A. U e. J
      (
        A e. U
        ->
        { y e. Y | ( F ` y ) e. U } e. L
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F G H J L R X Y y $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q1065257-squeeze-theorem $a |-
    A. X A. Y A. R A. J A. L A. F A. G A. H A. A e. X
      (
        (
          ( Q1065257Preorder R X )
          /\
          (
            J = ( Q1065257OrderTop R X )
            /\
            (
              ( Q1065257Filter L Y )
              /\
              (
                F : Y --> X
                /\
                ( G : Y --> X /\ H : Y --> X )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            (
              ( Q1065257Tendsto J L G A Y )
              /\
              ( Q1065257Tendsto J L H A Y )
            )
            /\
            (
              { y e. Y | ( G ` y ) R ( F ` y ) } e. L
              /\
              { y e. Y | ( F ` y ) R ( H ` y ) } e. L
            )
          )
          ->
          ( Q1065257Tendsto J L F A Y )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q1065257_squeeze_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1065257
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1065257), "Squeeze theorem": functions eventually
% bounded below and above by functions tending to the same point also tend to
% that point. This file contains no proof.

squeeze_theorem_Q1065257[
  alpha: TYPE,
  beta: TYPE,
  leq: [alpha, alpha -> bool],
  open_sets: [[alpha -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  alpha_set: TYPE = [alpha -> bool]
  beta_set: TYPE = [beta -> bool]
  alpha_set_family: TYPE = [alpha_set -> bool]
  beta_filter: TYPE = [beta_set -> bool]

  empty_alpha_set: alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): FALSE

  whole_alpha_set: alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): TRUE

  alpha_intersection(A, B: alpha_set): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): A(x) AND B(x)

  alpha_union(F: alpha_set_family): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha):
      EXISTS (U: alpha_set): F(U) AND U(x)

  alpha_subset(A, B: alpha_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  beta_subset(A, B: beta_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: beta): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  beta_intersection(A, B: beta_set): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta): A(x) AND B(x)

  whole_beta_set: beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta): TRUE

  strict_less(x, y: alpha): bool =
    leq(x, y) AND NOT leq(y, x)

  upper_ray(a: alpha): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): strict_less(a, x)

  lower_ray(a: alpha): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): strict_less(x, a)

  preorder_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: alpha): leq(x, x))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: alpha):
          leq(x, y) AND leq(y, z) IMPLIES leq(x, z))

  topology_laws(candidate_open: [alpha_set -> bool]): bool =
    candidate_open(empty_alpha_set)
      AND candidate_open(whole_alpha_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (A, B: alpha_set):
          candidate_open(A) AND candidate_open(B)
            IMPLIES candidate_open(alpha_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
        (FORALL (F: alpha_set_family):
          (FORALL (U: alpha_set):
            F(U) IMPLIES candidate_open(U))
          IMPLIES candidate_open(alpha_union(F)))

  contains_interval_subbasis(
      candidate_open: [alpha_set -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (a: alpha): candidate_open(upper_ray(a)))
      AND (FORALL (a: alpha): candidate_open(lower_ray(a)))

  generated_order_open(U: alpha_set): bool =
    FORALL (candidate_open: [alpha_set -> bool]):
      topology_laws(candidate_open)
        AND contains_interval_subbasis(candidate_open)
        IMPLIES candidate_open(U)

  order_topology_law: bool =
    topology_laws(open_sets)
      AND
        (FORALL (U: alpha_set):
          open_sets(U) IFF generated_order_open(U))

  filter_laws(eventually_sets: beta_filter): bool =
    eventually_sets(whole_beta_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (A, B: beta_set):
          eventually_sets(A) AND beta_subset(A, B)
            IMPLIES eventually_sets(B))
      AND
        (FORALL (A, B: beta_set):
          eventually_sets(A) AND eventually_sets(B)
            IMPLIES eventually_sets(beta_intersection(A, B)))

  neighborhood(U: alpha_set, a: alpha): bool =
    EXISTS (V: alpha_set):
      open_sets(V) AND V(a) AND alpha_subset(V, U)

  preimage(u: [beta -> alpha], U: alpha_set): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta): U(u(x))

  tendsto(
      u: [beta -> alpha],
      eventually_sets: beta_filter,
      a: alpha): bool =
    FORALL (U: alpha_set):
      neighborhood(U, a)
        IMPLIES eventually_sets(preimage(u, U))

  eventually_le(
      u, v: [beta -> alpha],
      eventually_sets: beta_filter): bool =
    eventually_sets(
      LAMBDA (x: beta): leq(u(x), v(x)))

  squeeze_theorem: bool =
    preorder_laws AND order_topology_law
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
            (f, g, h: [beta -> alpha]),
            (eventually_sets: beta_filter),
            (a: alpha):
          (filter_laws(eventually_sets)
            AND tendsto(g, eventually_sets, a)
            AND tendsto(h, eventually_sets, a)
            AND eventually_le(g, f, eventually_sets)
            AND eventually_le(f, h, eventually_sets))
          IMPLIES tendsto(f, eventually_sets, a)
END squeeze_theorem_Q1065257

title: Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1065966
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1065966), "Isomorphism theorem": the canonical
-- first, second, and third isomorphisms for quotient groups. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.QuotientGroup.Basic

@[expose] public section

universe u v

namespace Q1065966

open MonoidHom

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {H : Type v} [Group H]

/-- The quotient by a homomorphism's kernel is multiplicatively equivalent to its range. -/
noncomputable def quotientKerEquivRange_statement (φ : G →* H) :
    G ⧸ ker φ ≃* range φ := sorry

/-- For normal `N`, `H / (H ∩ N)` is multiplicatively equivalent to `(H ⊔ N) / N`. -/
noncomputable def quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient_statement
    (H N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] :
    H ⧸ N.subgroupOf H ≃* (H ⊔ N : Subgroup G) ⧸ N.subgroupOf (H ⊔ N) := sorry

/-- If `N ≤ M` are normal, then `(G / N) / (M / N)` is equivalent to `G / M`. -/
def quotientQuotientEquivQuotient_statement
    (N M : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] [M.Normal] (h : N ≤ M) :
    (G ⧸ N) ⧸ M.map (QuotientGroup.mk' N) ≃* G ⧸ M := sorry

end Q1065966
