  q1065966_mul :
    q1065966_carrier -> q1065966_carrier -> q1065966_carrier;
  q1065966_inv : q1065966_carrier -> q1065966_carrier;
  q1065966_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : q1065966_carrier,
      q1065966_mul x (q1065966_mul y z) =
      q1065966_mul (q1065966_mul x y) z;
  q1065966_one_mul :
    forall x : q1065966_carrier, q1065966_mul q1065966_one x = x;
  q1065966_mul_one :
    forall x : q1065966_carrier, q1065966_mul x q1065966_one = x;
  q1065966_inv_mul :
    forall x : q1065966_carrier,
      q1065966_mul (q1065966_inv x) x = q1065966_one;
  q1065966_mul_inv :
    forall x : q1065966_carrier,
      q1065966_mul x (q1065966_inv x) = q1065966_one
}.

Arguments q1065966_carrier _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1065966_one {q}.
Arguments q1065966_mul {q} _ _.
Arguments q1065966_inv {q} _.

Definition q1065966_subgroup (G : q1065966_group) : Type :=
  q1065966_carrier G -> Prop.

Definition q1065966_is_subgroup
    (G : q1065966_group) (S : q1065966_subgroup G) : Prop :=
  S q1065966_one /\
  (forall x y : q1065966_carrier G,
      S x -> S y -> S (q1065966_mul x y)) /\
  (forall x : q1065966_carrier G,
      S x -> S (q1065966_inv x)).

Definition q1065966_subgroup_le
    {G : q1065966_group}
    (A B : q1065966_subgroup G) : Prop :=
  forall x : q1065966_carrier G, A x -> B x.

Definition q1065966_normal_subgroup
    (G : q1065966_group) (N : q1065966_subgroup G) : Prop :=
  q1065966_is_subgroup G N /\
  forall g n : q1065966_carrier G,
    N n ->
    N (q1065966_mul (q1065966_mul g n) (q1065966_inv g)).

Definition q1065966_top_subgroup
    (G : q1065966_group) : q1065966_subgroup G :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q1065966_bottom_subgroup
    (G : q1065966_group) : q1065966_subgroup G :=
  fun x => x = q1065966_one.

Definition q1065966_subgroup_inf
    {G : q1065966_group}
    (A B : q1065966_subgroup G) : q1065966_subgroup G :=
  fun x => A x /\ B x.

Definition q1065966_subgroup_join
    {G : q1065966_group}
    (A B : q1065966_subgroup G) : q1065966_subgroup G :=
  fun x =>
    forall K : q1065966_subgroup G,
      q1065966_is_subgroup G K ->
      q1065966_subgroup_le A K ->
      q1065966_subgroup_le B K ->
      K x.

Definition q1065966_group_homomorphism
    (G H : q1065966_group)
    (f : q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier H) : Prop :=
  f q1065966_one = q1065966_one /\
  forall x y : q1065966_carrier G,
    f (q1065966_mul x y) = q1065966_mul (f x) (f y).

Definition q1065966_kernel
    {G H : q1065966_group}
    (f : q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier H) :
    q1065966_subgroup G :=
  fun x => f x = q1065966_one.

Definition q1065966_range
    {G H : q1065966_group}
    (f : q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier H) :
    q1065966_subgroup H :=
  fun y => exists x : q1065966_carrier G, f x = y.

Definition q1065966_quotient_equal
    (G : q1065966_group)
    (N : q1065966_subgroup G)
    (x y : q1065966_carrier G) : Prop :=
  N (q1065966_mul (q1065966_inv x) y).

Definition q1065966_relation_map_isomorphism
    (G H : q1065966_group)
    (A : q1065966_subgroup G)
    (C : q1065966_subgroup H)
    (source_equal :
      q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier G -> Prop)
    (target_equal :
      q1065966_carrier H -> q1065966_carrier H -> Prop)
    (forward : q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier H) : Prop :=
  q1065966_group_homomorphism G H forward /\
  (forall x : q1065966_carrier G, A x -> C (forward x)) /\
  (forall x y : q1065966_carrier G,
      A x -> A y -> source_equal x y ->
      target_equal (forward x) (forward y)) /\
  exists backward : q1065966_carrier H -> q1065966_carrier G,
    (forall y : q1065966_carrier H, C y -> A (backward y)) /\
    (forall y z : q1065966_carrier H,
      C y -> C z -> target_equal y z ->
      source_equal (backward y) (backward z)) /\
    (forall x : q1065966_carrier G,
      A x -> source_equal (backward (forward x)) x) /\
    (forall y : q1065966_carrier H,
      C y -> target_equal (forward (backward y)) y).

Definition q1065966_quotient_map_isomorphism
    (G H : q1065966_group)
    (A B : q1065966_subgroup G)
    (C D : q1065966_subgroup H)
    (forward : q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier H) : Prop :=
  q1065966_relation_map_isomorphism
    G H A C
    (q1065966_quotient_equal G B)
    (q1065966_quotient_equal H D)
    forward.

Definition q1065966_quotient_image_member
    (G : q1065966_group)
    (N M : q1065966_subgroup G)
    (x : q1065966_carrier G) : Prop :=
  exists m : q1065966_carrier G,
    M m /\ q1065966_quotient_equal G N x m.

Definition q1065966_double_quotient_equal
    (G : q1065966_group)
    (N M : q1065966_subgroup G)
    (x y : q1065966_carrier G) : Prop :=
  q1065966_quotient_image_member G N M
    (q1065966_mul (q1065966_inv x) y).

Theorem QuotientGroup_quotientKerEquivRange :
  forall (G H : q1065966_group)
         (phi : q1065966_carrier G -> q1065966_carrier H),
    q1065966_group_homomorphism G H phi ->
    q1065966_quotient_map_isomorphism
      G H
      (q1065966_top_subgroup G)
      (q1065966_kernel phi)
      (q1065966_range phi)
      (q1065966_bottom_subgroup H)
      phi.
Admitted.

Theorem QuotientGroup_quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient :
  forall (G : q1065966_group)
         (H N : q1065966_subgroup G),
    q1065966_is_subgroup G H ->
    q1065966_normal_subgroup G N ->
    q1065966_quotient_map_isomorphism
      G G
      H
      (q1065966_subgroup_inf H N)
      (q1065966_subgroup_join H N)
      N
      (fun x : q1065966_carrier G => x).
Admitted.

Theorem QuotientGroup_quotientQuotientEquivQuotient :
  forall (G : q1065966_group)
         (N M : q1065966_subgroup G),
    q1065966_normal_subgroup G N ->
    q1065966_normal_subgroup G M ->
    q1065966_subgroup_le N M ->
    q1065966_relation_map_isomorphism
      G G
      (q1065966_top_subgroup G)
      (q1065966_top_subgroup G)
      (q1065966_double_quotient_equal G N M)
      (q1065966_quotient_equal G M)
      (fun x : q1065966_carrier G => x).
Admitted.

title: Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065966,
  "Isomorphism theorem": the canonical first, second, and third isomorphism
  theorems for arbitrary groups and their normal-subgroup quotients. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1065966_is_subgroup :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1065966_is_subgroup H \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> H \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. -x \<in> H) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<forall>y \<in> H. x + y \<in> H)"

definition q1065966_is_normal_subgroup ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1065966_is_normal_subgroup N \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1065966_is_subgroup N \<and>
    (\<forall>g. \<forall>n \<in> N. g + n + (-g) \<in> N)"

definition q1065966_is_group_hom ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1065966_is_group_hom f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f 0 = 0 \<and> (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y)"

definition q1065966_hom_kernel ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add) \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1065966_hom_kernel f = {x. f x = 0}"

definition q1065966_hom_range ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add) \<Rightarrow> 'h set" where
  "q1065966_hom_range f = f ` UNIV"

definition q1065966_left_coset ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1065966_left_coset N g = (\<lambda>n. n + g) ` N"

definition q1065966_quotient_carrier ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q1065966_quotient_carrier A N = q1065966_left_coset N ` A"

definition q1065966_coset_mult ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1065966_coset_mult X Y =
    {x + y |x y. x \<in> X \<and> y \<in> Y}"

definition q1065966_subgroup_join ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1065966_subgroup_join H N =
    {x. \<forall>K. q1065966_is_subgroup K \<longrightarrow>
      H \<subseteq> K \<longrightarrow> N \<subseteq> K \<longrightarrow> x \<in> K}"

definition q1065966_quotient_image ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q1065966_quotient_image N M = q1065966_left_coset N ` M"

definition q1065966_quotient_left_coset ::
    "'g::group_add set set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q1065966_quotient_left_coset S X =
    (\<lambda>A. q1065966_coset_mult A X) ` S"

definition q1065966_double_quotient_element ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q1065966_double_quotient_element N M g =
    q1065966_quotient_left_coset
      (q1065966_quotient_image N M)
      (q1065966_left_coset N g)"

definition q1065966_double_quotient_carrier ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set set" where
  "q1065966_double_quotient_carrier N M =
    q1065966_quotient_left_coset (q1065966_quotient_image N M) `
      q1065966_quotient_carrier UNIV N"

definition q1065966_quotient_coset_mult ::
    "'g::group_add set set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q1065966_quotient_coset_mult X Y =
    {q1065966_coset_mult A B |A B. A \<in> X \<and> B \<in> Y}"

theorem q1065966_quotientKerEquivRange:
  fixes phi :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add"
  assumes "q1065966_is_group_hom phi"
  shows "\<exists>F :: 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'h.
    bij_betw F
      (q1065966_quotient_carrier UNIV (q1065966_hom_kernel phi))
      (q1065966_hom_range phi) \<and>
    (\<forall>g. F (q1065966_left_coset (q1065966_hom_kernel phi) g) = phi g) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> q1065966_quotient_carrier UNIV (q1065966_hom_kernel phi).
      \<forall>Y \<in> q1065966_quotient_carrier UNIV (q1065966_hom_kernel phi).
        F (q1065966_coset_mult X Y) = F X + F Y)"
  sorry

theorem q1065966_quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient:
  fixes H N :: "'g::group_add set"
  assumes "q1065966_is_subgroup H"
    and "q1065966_is_normal_subgroup N"
  shows "\<exists>F :: 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set.
    bij_betw F
      (q1065966_quotient_carrier H (H \<inter> N))
      (q1065966_quotient_carrier (q1065966_subgroup_join H N) N) \<and>
    (\<forall>h \<in> H.
      F (q1065966_left_coset (H \<inter> N) h) =
        q1065966_left_coset N h) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> q1065966_quotient_carrier H (H \<inter> N).
      \<forall>Y \<in> q1065966_quotient_carrier H (H \<inter> N).
        F (q1065966_coset_mult X Y) =
          q1065966_coset_mult (F X) (F Y))"
  sorry

theorem q1065966_quotientQuotientEquivQuotient:
  fixes N M :: "'g::group_add set"
  assumes "q1065966_is_normal_subgroup N"
    and "q1065966_is_normal_subgroup M"
    and "N \<subseteq> M"
  shows "\<exists>F :: 'g set set \<Rightarrow> 'g set.
    bij_betw F
      (q1065966_double_quotient_carrier N M)
      (q1065966_quotient_carrier UNIV M) \<and>
    (\<forall>g.
      F (q1065966_double_quotient_element N M g) =
        q1065966_left_coset M g) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> q1065966_double_quotient_carrier N M.
      \<forall>Y \<in> q1065966_double_quotient_carrier N M.
        F (q1065966_quotient_coset_mult X Y) =
          q1065966_coset_mult (F X) (F Y))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065966,
;; "Isomorphism theorem": the canonical first, second, and third isomorphisms
;; for groups, expressed through quotient-coset representative relations.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ function objects represent arbitrary carriers, operations,
;; homomorphisms, and subgroup predicates. DEFUN-SK supplies genuine
;; unbounded quantification over their carrier elements.

(defun q1065966-member-p (predicate element)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list element))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1065966-multiply (multiplication left right)
  (apply$ multiplication (list left right)))

(defun q1065966-invert (inverse element)
  (apply$ inverse (list element)))

(defun q1065966-map (mapping element)
  (apply$ mapping (list element)))

(defun-sk q1065966-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q1065966-member-p left element)
     (q1065966-member-p right element))))

(defun-sk q1065966-range-member-p (source mapping value)
  (exists (element)
    (and
     (q1065966-member-p source element)
     (equal (q1065966-map mapping element) value))))

(defun-sk q1065966-range-preimage-p (source mapping value)
  (exists (preimage)
    (and
     (q1065966-member-p source preimage)
     (equal (q1065966-map mapping preimage) value))))

(defun-sk q1065966-product-member-p
    (subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication element)
  (exists (h n)
    (and
     (q1065966-member-p subgroup-h h)
     (q1065966-member-p subgroup-n n)
     (equal
      element
      (q1065966-multiply multiplication h n)))))

(defun-sk q1065966-group-laws-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1065966-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p
        carrier
        (q1065966-invert inverse x))
       (equal
        (q1065966-multiply multiplication identity x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q1065966-multiply multiplication x identity)
        x)
       (equal
        (q1065966-multiply
         multiplication
         (q1065966-invert inverse x)
         x)
        identity)
       (equal
        (q1065966-multiply
         multiplication
         x
         (q1065966-invert inverse x))
        identity)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p carrier x)
       (q1065966-member-p carrier y))
      (q1065966-member-p
       carrier
       (q1065966-multiply multiplication x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p carrier x)
       (q1065966-member-p carrier y)
       (q1065966-member-p carrier z))
      (equal
       (q1065966-multiply
        multiplication
        (q1065966-multiply multiplication x y)
        z)
       (q1065966-multiply
        multiplication
        x
        (q1065966-multiply multiplication y z)))))))

(defun q1065966-group-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q1065966-member-p carrier identity)
   (q1065966-group-laws-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity)))

(defun q1065966-subgroup-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp subgroup)
   (q1065966-group-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity)
   (q1065966-subset-p subgroup carrier)
   (q1065966-group-p
    subgroup multiplication inverse identity)))

(defun-sk q1065966-normal-laws-p
    (carrier subgroup multiplication inverse)
  (forall (conjugator element)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1065966-member-p carrier conjugator)
      (q1065966-member-p subgroup element))
     (q1065966-member-p
      subgroup
      (q1065966-multiply
       multiplication
       (q1065966-multiply multiplication conjugator element)
       (q1065966-invert inverse conjugator))))))

(defun q1065966-normal-subgroup-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
  (and
   (q1065966-subgroup-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
   (q1065966-normal-laws-p
    carrier subgroup multiplication inverse)))

;; Equality of representatives modulo a normal subgroup K is x^-1*y in K.

(defun q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
    (subgroup multiplication inverse x y)
  (q1065966-member-p
   subgroup
   (q1065966-multiply
    multiplication
    (q1065966-invert inverse x)
    y)))

(defun-sk q1065966-hom-laws-p
    (source target source-multiplication target-multiplication mapping)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1065966-member-p source x)
      (q1065966-member-p target (q1065966-map mapping x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p source x)
       (q1065966-member-p source y))
      (equal
       (q1065966-map
        mapping
        (q1065966-multiply source-multiplication x y))
       (q1065966-multiply
        target-multiplication
        (q1065966-map mapping x)
        (q1065966-map mapping y)))))))

(defun q1065966-hom-p
    (source
     target
     source-multiplication
     target-multiplication
     source-identity
     target-identity
     mapping)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp mapping)
   (equal
    (q1065966-map mapping source-identity)
    target-identity)
   (q1065966-hom-laws-p
    source target source-multiplication target-multiplication mapping)))

;; First isomorphism theorem. The kernel quotient relation agrees exactly
;; with equality in the range, the representative map preserves products,
;; and every member of the range has a source representative. These are the
;; well-definedness, injectivity, multiplicativity, and surjectivity clauses
;; of the canonical equivalence G/ker(phi) -> range(phi).

(defun-sk q1065966-first-canonical-isomorphism-p
    (source
     target
     source-multiplication
     target-multiplication
     source-inverse
     mapping
     target-identity)
  (forall (x y value)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p source x)
       (q1065966-member-p source y))
      (and
       (iff
        (equal
         (q1065966-map
          mapping
          (q1065966-multiply
           source-multiplication
           (q1065966-invert source-inverse x)
           y))
         target-identity)
        (equal
         (q1065966-map mapping x)
         (q1065966-map mapping y)))
       (equal
        (q1065966-map
         mapping
         (q1065966-multiply source-multiplication x y))
        (q1065966-multiply
         target-multiplication
         (q1065966-map mapping x)
         (q1065966-map mapping y)))))
     (implies
     (and
      (q1065966-member-p target value)
      (q1065966-range-member-p source mapping value))
      (q1065966-range-preimage-p source mapping value)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1065966-quotient-ker-equiv-range-statement
    (source
     target
     source-multiplication
     target-multiplication
     source-inverse
     target-inverse
     source-identity
     target-identity
     mapping)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1065966-group-p
     source
     source-multiplication
     source-inverse
     source-identity)
    (q1065966-group-p
     target
     target-multiplication
     target-inverse
     target-identity)
    (q1065966-hom-p
     source
     target
     source-multiplication
     target-multiplication
     source-identity
     target-identity
     mapping))
   (q1065966-first-canonical-isomorphism-p
    source
    target
    source-multiplication
    target-multiplication
    source-inverse
    mapping
    target-identity)))

;; Second isomorphism theorem. Since N is normal, H join N is the product HN.
;; The canonical inclusion is the identity on H-representatives. Its domain
;; relation is equality modulo H intersect N, its codomain relation is
;; equality modulo N, and H join N is represented by the product HN.

(defun q1065966-second-domain-equivalent-p
    (subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication inverse x y)
  (and
   (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
    subgroup-h multiplication inverse x y)
   (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
    subgroup-n multiplication inverse x y)))

(defun q1065966-second-canonical-forward (representative)
  representative)

(defun-sk q1065966-h-representative-mod-n-p
    (subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication inverse element)
  (exists (h)
    (and
     (q1065966-member-p subgroup-h h)
     (q1065966-member-p
      subgroup-n
      (q1065966-multiply
       multiplication
       (q1065966-invert inverse h)
       element)))))

(defun-sk q1065966-second-canonical-isomorphism-p
    (subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1065966-member-p subgroup-h x)
      (q1065966-product-member-p
       subgroup-h
       subgroup-n
       multiplication
       (q1065966-second-canonical-forward x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p subgroup-h x)
       (q1065966-member-p subgroup-h y))
      (and
       (iff
        (q1065966-second-domain-equivalent-p
         subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication inverse x y)
        (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-n
         multiplication
         inverse
         (q1065966-second-canonical-forward x)
         (q1065966-second-canonical-forward y)))
       (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-n
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q1065966-second-canonical-forward
         (q1065966-multiply multiplication x y))
        (q1065966-multiply
         multiplication
         (q1065966-second-canonical-forward x)
         (q1065966-second-canonical-forward y)))))
     (implies
      (q1065966-product-member-p
       subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication z)
      (q1065966-h-representative-mod-n-p
       subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication inverse z)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1065966-quotient-inf-equiv-prod-normal-quotient-statement
    (carrier
     multiplication
     inverse
     identity
     subgroup-h
     subgroup-n)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1065966-subgroup-p
     carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup-h)
    (q1065966-normal-subgroup-p
     carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup-n))
   (q1065966-second-canonical-isomorphism-p
    subgroup-h subgroup-n multiplication inverse)))

;; An element xN lies in M/N exactly when it has an M-representative.

(defun-sk q1065966-mapped-m-member-p
    (subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse element)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q1065966-member-p subgroup-m representative)
     (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
      subgroup-n
      multiplication
      inverse
      representative
      element))))

(defun q1065966-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
    (subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse x y)
  (q1065966-mapped-m-member-p
   subgroup-n
   subgroup-m
   multiplication
   inverse
   (q1065966-multiply
    multiplication
    (q1065966-invert inverse x)
    y)))

;; The forward and inverse maps are both induced by the identity on
;; G-representatives, but use the two different quotient relations.

(defun q1065966-third-canonical-forward (representative)
  representative)

(defun q1065966-third-canonical-inverse (representative)
  representative)

;; These clauses state well-definedness in both directions, inverse laws on
;; equivalence classes, and preservation of quotient multiplication.

(defun-sk q1065966-third-canonical-isomorphism-p
    (carrier subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1065966-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p
        carrier
        (q1065966-third-canonical-forward x))
       (q1065966-member-p
        carrier
        (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse x))
       (q1065966-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-n
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse
         (q1065966-third-canonical-forward x))
        x)
       (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q1065966-third-canonical-forward
         (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse x))
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1065966-member-p carrier x)
       (q1065966-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (implies
        (q1065966-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse x y)
        (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-m
         multiplication
         inverse
         (q1065966-third-canonical-forward x)
         (q1065966-third-canonical-forward y)))
       (implies
        (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-m multiplication inverse x y)
        (q1065966-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-n
         subgroup-m
         multiplication
         inverse
         (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse x)
         (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse y)))
       (q1065966-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q1065966-third-canonical-forward
         (q1065966-multiply multiplication x y))
        (q1065966-multiply
         multiplication
         (q1065966-third-canonical-forward x)
         (q1065966-third-canonical-forward y)))
       (q1065966-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-n
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse
         (q1065966-multiply multiplication x y))
        (q1065966-multiply
         multiplication
         (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse x)
         (q1065966-third-canonical-inverse y))))))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1065966-quotient-quotient-equiv-quotient-statement
    (carrier

title: Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065966,
-- "Isomorphism theorem": the canonical first, second, and third isomorphisms
-- for groups and their quotient groups. This file contains no proof.

module Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _⊆_
infixr 5 _×_

data ⊤ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where
  tt : ⊤

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record GroupHom
  {a b : Level}
  {G : Set a}
  {H : Set b}
  (domain : Group G)
  (codomain : Group H) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : G → H
    map-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      map (Group.multiply domain x y) ≡
      Group.multiply codomain (map x) (map y)

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity :
      member (Group.identity structure)
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) →
      member x →
      member (Group.inverse structure x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (Group.multiply structure x y)

_⊆_ :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
H ⊆ K =
  (x : _) →
  SubgroupOf.member H x →
  SubgroupOf.member K x

record Normal
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  {structure : Group G}
  (N : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    closed-under-conjugation :
      (g n : G) →
      SubgroupOf.member N n →
      SubgroupOf.member N
        (Group.multiply structure
          (Group.multiply structure g n)
          (Group.inverse structure g))

record RestrictedMulEquiv
  {a b p q r s : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (domain-member : A → Set p)
  (codomain-member : B → Set q)
  (domain-related : A → A → Set r)
  (codomain-related : B → B → Set s)
  (domain-multiply : A → A → A)
  (codomain-multiply : B → B → B)
  (forward : A → B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ p ⊔ q ⊔ r ⊔ s) where

  field
    inverse :
      (y : B) →
      codomain-member y →
      A
    forward-closed :
      (x : A) →
      domain-member x →
      codomain-member (forward x)
    inverse-closed :
      (y : B) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      domain-member (inverse y hy)
    forward-congruent :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-member x →
      domain-member y →
      domain-related x y →
      codomain-related (forward x) (forward y)
    inverse-congruent :
      (x y : B) →
      (hx : codomain-member x) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      codomain-related x y →
      domain-related (inverse x hx) (inverse y hy)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-member x →
      domain-member y →
      codomain-related
        (forward (domain-multiply x y))
        (codomain-multiply (forward x) (forward y))
    inverse-forward :
      (x : A) →
      (hx : domain-member x) →
      domain-related
        (inverse (forward x) (forward-closed x hx))
        x
    forward-inverse :
      (y : B) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      codomain-related (forward (inverse y hy)) y

InRange :
  {a b : Level} →
  {G : Set a} →
  {H : Set b} →
  {domain : Group G} →
  {codomain : Group H} →
  GroupHom domain codomain →
  H →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
InRange {G = G} hom y =
  Σ G (λ x → GroupHom.map hom x ≡ y)

KernelQuotientRelated :
  {a b : Level} →
  {G : Set a} →
  {H : Set b} →
  {domain : Group G} →
  {codomain : Group H} →
  GroupHom domain codomain →
  G →
  G →
  Set b
KernelQuotientRelated {domain = domain} {codomain = codomain} hom x y =
  GroupHom.map hom
    (Group.multiply domain (Group.inverse domain x) y) ≡
  Group.identity codomain

QuotientRelated :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
QuotientRelated structure N x y =
  SubgroupOf.member N
    (Group.multiply structure (Group.inverse structure x) y)

ProductMember :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  Set ℓ
ProductMember {G = G} structure H N x =
  Σ G (λ h →
    SubgroupOf.member H h ×
    Σ G (λ n →
      SubgroupOf.member N n ×
      (Group.multiply structure h n ≡ x)))

DoubleQuotientRelated :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (N M : SubgroupOf structure) →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
DoubleQuotientRelated {G = G} structure N M x y =
  Σ G (λ m →
    SubgroupOf.member M m ×
    QuotientRelated structure N m
      (Group.multiply structure (Group.inverse structure x) y))

-- Lean: QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange
first-isomorphism-theorem :
  (a b : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
first-isomorphism-theorem a b =
  {G : Set a} →
  {H : Set b} →
  (domain : Group G) →
  (codomain : Group H) →
  (hom : GroupHom domain codomain) →
  RestrictedMulEquiv
    G
    H
    (λ _ → ⊤ {a})
    (InRange hom)
    (KernelQuotientRelated hom)
    _≡_
    (Group.multiply domain)
    (Group.multiply codomain)
    (GroupHom.map hom)

-- Lean: QuotientGroup.quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient
second-isomorphism-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
second-isomorphism-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (H N : SubgroupOf structure) →
  Normal N →
  RestrictedMulEquiv
    G
    G
    (SubgroupOf.member H)
    (ProductMember structure H N)
    (QuotientRelated structure N)
    (QuotientRelated structure N)
    (Group.multiply structure)
    (Group.multiply structure)
    (λ x → x)

-- Lean: QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient
third-isomorphism-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
third-isomorphism-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (N M : SubgroupOf structure) →
  Normal N →
  Normal M →
  N ⊆ M →
  RestrictedMulEquiv
    G
    G
    (λ _ → ⊤ {ℓ})
    (λ _ → ⊤ {ℓ})
    (DoubleQuotientRelated structure N M)
    (QuotientRelated structure M)
    (Group.multiply structure)
    (Group.multiply structure)
    (λ x → x)

title: Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1065966, "Isomorphism theorem": the first, second, and third isomorphism
  theorems for groups, expressed using kernels, homomorphic images, subgroup
  intersections and products, and quotient groups. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val quotientKerEquivRange =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (h : 'b group) (f : 'a -> 'b).
      Group g /\
      Group h /\
      GroupHomo f g h
      ==>
      ?e : 'a set -> 'b.
        GroupIso e
          (quotient_group g (kernel_group f g h))
          (homo_image f g h)``;

val quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (h : 'a group) (n : 'a group).
      Group g /\
      Subgroup h g /\
      normal_subgroup n g
      ==>
      ?e : 'a set -> 'a set.
        GroupIso e
          (quotient_group h (monoid_intersect h n))
          (quotient_group (subgroup_cross g h n) n)``;

val quotientQuotientEquivQuotient =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (n : 'a group) (m : 'a group).
      Group g /\
      normal_subgroup n g /\
      normal_subgroup m g /\
      Subgroup n m
      ==>
      ?e : ('a set) set -> 'a set.
        GroupIso e
          (quotient_group
            (quotient_group g n)
            (homo_image
              (left_coset g n.carrier)
              m
              (quotient_group g n)))
          (quotient_group g m)``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1065966
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1065966), "Isomorphism theorem": the first,
  second, and third isomorphism theorems for arbitrary groups, homomorphisms,
  subgroups, and normal subgroups. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's relation G ~=g H means that the two bundled groups are isomorphic.
  The restriction G |`s H equips a subgroup carrier H with the inherited group
  structure, and G /s ( G ~QG N ) is the quotient group by a normal subgroup N.

  In the second assertion, H i^i N is the subgroup intersection and
  H ( LSSum ` G ) N is the subgroup product HN. In the third assertion, the
  image of M under x |-> [ x ] ( G ~QG N ) is the subgroup M / N of G / N.

  The three final $a assertions correspond, in source order, to
  QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange,
  QuotientGroup.quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient, and
  QuotientGroup.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient. They are unproved and add no
  $p proof statements.
$)

${
  $d F G H $.

  thousand-theorems-q1065966-quotient-ker-equiv-range $a |- (
    A. G A. H A. F
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          H e. Grp
          /\
          F e. ( G GrpHom H )
        )
        ->
        (
          G /s
          (
            G ~QG
            ( `' F " { ( 0g ` H ) } )
          )
        )
        ~=g
        ( H |`s ran F )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H N $.

  thousand-theorems-q1065966-quotient-inf-equiv-prod-normal-quotient $a |- (
    A. G A. H A. N
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          H e. ( SubGrp ` G )
          /\
          N e. ( NrmSGrp ` G )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            ( G |`s H ) /s
            ( ( G |`s H ) ~QG ( H i^i N ) )
          )
          ~=g
          (
            ( G |`s ( H ( LSSum ` G ) N ) ) /s
            (
              ( G |`s ( H ( LSSum ` G ) N ) )
              ~QG
              N
            )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M N x $.

  thousand-theorems-q1065966-quotient-quotient-equiv-quotient $a |- (
    A. G A. N A. M
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          N e. ( NrmSGrp ` G )
          /\
          M e. ( NrmSGrp ` G )
          /\
          N C_ M
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            ( G /s ( G ~QG N ) ) /s
            (
              ( G /s ( G ~QG N ) )
              ~QG
              (
                (
                  x e. ( Base ` G )
                  |->
                  [ x ] ( G ~QG N )
                )
                " M
              )
            )
          )
          ~=g
          ( G /s ( G ~QG M ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}
