title: Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1065966,
% "Isomorphism theorem": Noether's first, second, and third isomorphism theorems
% for arbitrary groups through their canonical quotient-group maps. This file contains no proof.

Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  H: TYPE+,
  g_mul: [G, G -> G],
  g_inv: [G -> G],
  g_one: G,
  h_mul: [H, H -> H],
  h_inv: [H -> H],
  h_one: H,
  phi: [G -> H]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  g_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]
  h_set: TYPE = [H -> bool]
  quotient_set: TYPE = [g_set -> bool]

  first_relation: TYPE = [g_set, H -> bool]
  quotient_relation: TYPE = [g_set, g_set -> bool]
  iterated_quotient_relation: TYPE = [quotient_set, g_set -> bool]

  g_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      g_mul(g_mul(x, y), z) = g_mul(x, g_mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        g_mul(g_one, x) = x
          AND g_mul(x, g_one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        g_mul(g_inv(x), x) = g_one
          AND g_mul(x, g_inv(x)) = g_one)

  h_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: H):
      h_mul(h_mul(x, y), z) = h_mul(x, h_mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: H):
        h_mul(h_one, x) = x
          AND h_mul(x, h_one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: H):
        h_mul(h_inv(x), x) = h_one
          AND h_mul(x, h_inv(x)) = h_one)

  is_homomorphism: bool =
    phi(g_one) = h_one
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        phi(g_mul(x, y)) = h_mul(phi(x), phi(y)))

  subset_of(A, B: g_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  is_subgroup(A: g_set): bool =
    A(g_one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        A(x) AND A(y) IMPLIES A(g_mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        A(x) IMPLIES A(g_inv(x)))

  is_normal_subgroup(A: g_set): bool =
    is_subgroup(A)
      AND (FORALL (g, x: G):
        A(x) IMPLIES
          A(g_mul(g_mul(g, x), g_inv(g))))

  kernel: g_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): phi(x) = h_one

  range: h_set =
    LAMBDA (y: H): EXISTS (x: G): y = phi(x)

  intersection(A, B: g_set): g_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): A(x) AND B(x)

  subgroup_product(A, B: g_set): g_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      EXISTS (a, b: G):
        A(a) AND B(b) AND x = g_mul(a, b)

  left_coset(g: G, A: g_set): g_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      EXISTS (a: G):
        A(a) AND x = g_mul(g, a)

  is_coset(A: g_set, C: g_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G): C = left_coset(g, A)

  is_coset_with_representative_in(
      A, carrier: g_set,
      C: g_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G):
      carrier(g) AND C = left_coset(g, A)

  quotient_product(
      A: g_set,
      C, D, E: g_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: G):
      C = left_coset(x, A)
        AND D = left_coset(y, A)
        AND E = left_coset(g_mul(x, y), A)

  first_canonical_relation(C: g_set, y: H): bool =
    EXISTS (x: G):
      C = left_coset(x, kernel)
        AND y = phi(x)

  bijection_gset_to_h(
      relation: first_relation,
      domain: [g_set -> bool],
      codomain: h_set): bool =
    (FORALL (C: g_set), (y: H):
      relation(C, y) IMPLIES domain(C) AND codomain(y))
      AND (FORALL (C: g_set):
        domain(C) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (y: H): codomain(y) AND relation(C, y))
      AND (FORALL (C: g_set), (y, z: H):
        domain(C)
          AND codomain(y)
          AND codomain(z)
          AND relation(C, y)
          AND relation(C, z)
          IMPLIES y = z)
      AND (FORALL (y: H):
        codomain(y) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (C: g_set): domain(C) AND relation(C, y))
      AND (FORALL (C, D: g_set), (y: H):
        domain(C)
          AND domain(D)
          AND codomain(y)
          AND relation(C, y)
          AND relation(D, y)
          IMPLIES C = D)

  multiplicative_gset_to_h(
      relation: first_relation,
      normal_subgroup: g_set): bool =
    FORALL (C, D, E: g_set), (x, y, z: H):
      quotient_product(normal_subgroup, C, D, E)
        AND relation(C, x)
        AND relation(D, y)
        AND relation(E, z)
        IMPLIES h_mul(x, y) = z

  quotientKerEquivRange: bool =
    (g_group_laws AND h_group_laws AND is_homomorphism)
      IMPLIES
        (bijection_gset_to_h(
          first_canonical_relation,
          LAMBDA (C: g_set): is_coset(kernel, C),
          range)
          AND multiplicative_gset_to_h(
            first_canonical_relation,
            kernel))

  second_canonical_relation(
      A, N: g_set,
      C, D: g_set): bool =
    EXISTS (a: G):
      A(a)
        AND C = left_coset(a, intersection(A, N))
        AND D = left_coset(a, N)

  bijection_between_quotients(
      relation: quotient_relation,
      domain, codomain: [g_set -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (C, D: g_set):
      relation(C, D) IMPLIES domain(C) AND codomain(D))
      AND (FORALL (C: g_set):
        domain(C) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (D: g_set): codomain(D) AND relation(C, D))
      AND (FORALL (C, D, E: g_set):
        domain(C)
          AND codomain(D)
          AND codomain(E)
          AND relation(C, D)
          AND relation(C, E)
          IMPLIES D = E)
      AND (FORALL (D: g_set):
        codomain(D) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (C: g_set): domain(C) AND relation(C, D))
      AND (FORALL (C, D, E: g_set):
        domain(C)
          AND domain(D)
          AND codomain(E)
          AND relation(C, E)
          AND relation(D, E)
          IMPLIES C = D)

  canonical_quotient_products_preserved(
      relation: quotient_relation,
      source_normal, target_normal: g_set): bool =
    FORALL (C1, C2, C3, D1, D2, D3: g_set):
      quotient_product(source_normal, C1, C2, C3)
        AND relation(C1, D1)
        AND relation(C2, D2)
        AND relation(C3, D3)
        IMPLIES quotient_product(target_normal, D1, D2, D3)

  quotientInfEquivProdNormalQuotient: bool =
    FORALL (A, N: g_set):
      (g_group_laws
        AND is_subgroup(A)
        AND is_normal_subgroup(N))
      IMPLIES
        (bijection_between_quotients(
          LAMBDA (C, D: g_set):
            second_canonical_relation(A, N, C, D),
          LAMBDA (C: g_set):
            is_coset_with_representative_in(
              intersection(A, N), A, C),
          LAMBDA (D: g_set):
            is_coset_with_representative_in(
              N, subgroup_product(A, N), D))
          AND canonical_quotient_products_preserved(
            LAMBDA (C, D: g_set):
              second_canonical_relation(A, N, C, D),
            intersection(A, N),
            N))

  quotient_subgroup(N, M: g_set, C: g_set): bool =
    EXISTS (m: G):
      M(m) AND C = left_coset(m, N)

  iterated_left_coset(
      N, M: g_set,
      g: G): quotient_set =
    LAMBDA (C: g_set):
      EXISTS (m: G):
        M(m) AND C = left_coset(g_mul(g, m), N)

  is_iterated_coset(
      N, M: g_set,
      Q: quotient_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G):
      Q = iterated_left_coset(N, M, g)

  iterated_quotient_product(
      N, M: g_set,
      Q1, Q2, Q3: quotient_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: G):
      Q1 = iterated_left_coset(N, M, x)
        AND Q2 = iterated_left_coset(N, M, y)
        AND Q3 = iterated_left_coset(N, M, g_mul(x, y))

  third_canonical_relation(
      N, M: g_set,
      Q: quotient_set,
      C: g_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G):
      Q = iterated_left_coset(N, M, g)
        AND C = left_coset(g, M)

  bijection_iterated_to_quotient(
      relation: iterated_quotient_relation,
      domain: [quotient_set -> bool],
      codomain: [g_set -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (Q: quotient_set), (C: g_set):
      relation(Q, C) IMPLIES domain(Q) AND codomain(C))
      AND (FORALL (Q: quotient_set):
        domain(Q) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (C: g_set): codomain(C) AND relation(Q, C))
      AND (FORALL (Q: quotient_set), (C, D: g_set):
        domain(Q)
          AND codomain(C)
          AND codomain(D)
          AND relation(Q, C)
          AND relation(Q, D)
          IMPLIES C = D)
      AND (FORALL (C: g_set):
        codomain(C) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (Q: quotient_set): domain(Q) AND relation(Q, C))
      AND (FORALL (Q, R: quotient_set), (C: g_set):
        domain(Q)
          AND domain(R)
          AND codomain(C)
          AND relation(Q, C)
          AND relation(R, C)
          IMPLIES Q = R)

  canonical_iterated_products_preserved(
      N, M: g_set,
      relation: iterated_quotient_relation): bool =
    FORALL (Q1, Q2, Q3: quotient_set),
           (C1, C2, C3: g_set):
      iterated_quotient_product(N, M, Q1, Q2, Q3)
        AND relation(Q1, C1)
        AND relation(Q2, C2)
        AND relation(Q3, C3)
        IMPLIES quotient_product(M, C1, C2, C3)

  quotientQuotientEquivQuotient: bool =
    FORALL (N, M: g_set):
      (g_group_laws
        AND is_normal_subgroup(N)
        AND is_normal_subgroup(M)
        AND subset_of(N, M))
      IMPLIES
        (bijection_iterated_to_quotient(
          LAMBDA (Q: quotient_set), (C: g_set):
            third_canonical_relation(N, M, Q, C),
          LAMBDA (Q: quotient_set):
            is_iterated_coset(N, M, Q),
          LAMBDA (C: g_set):
            is_coset(M, C))
          AND canonical_iterated_products_preserved(
            N,
            M,
            LAMBDA (Q: quotient_set), (C: g_set):
              third_canonical_relation(N, M, Q, C)))

END Q1065966_isomorphism_theorem

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1067156
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1067156), "Dominated convergence theorem": an almost
-- everywhere convergent sequence of almost everywhere strongly measurable functions dominated
-- by an integrable real-valued bound has convergent Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic

open MeasureTheory Filter TopologicalSpace

open scoped Topology

namespace Q1067156

variable {α G : Type*}
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α}

/-- The dominated convergence theorem for the Bochner integral. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence {F : ℕ → α → G} {f : α → G}
    (bound : α → ℝ) (F_measurable : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) μ)
    (bound_integrable : Integrable bound μ) (h_bound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ‖F n a‖ ≤ bound a)
    (h_lim : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => F n a) atTop (𝓝 (f a))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ a, F n a ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 <| ∫ a, f a ∂μ) := sorry

end Q1067156

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1067156
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1067156), "Dominated convergence theorem":
  almost-everywhere convergence of a sequence of strongly measurable
  normed-real-vector-space-valued functions dominated by an integrable real
  function implies convergence of their Bochner integrals. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1067156_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1067156_empty {A : Type} : q1067156_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1067156_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1067156_set A) : q1067156_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1067156_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1067156_set A) : q1067156_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1067156_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1067156_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1067156_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1067156_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1067156_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1067156_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1067156_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q1067156_ennreal : Type :=
| q1067156_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q1067156_ennreal
| q1067156_ennreal_infinity : q1067156_ennreal.

Arguments q1067156_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_zero : q1067156_ennreal :=
  q1067156_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q1067156_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1067156_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156_ennreal_finite a _, q1067156_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q1067156_ennreal_finite _ _, q1067156_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q1067156_ennreal_infinity, q1067156_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q1067156_ennreal_infinity, q1067156_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1067156_ennreal) : q1067156_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1067156_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1067156_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q1067156_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q1067156_ennreal) : q1067156_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1067156_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1067156_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q1067156_ennreal_finite a _, q1067156_ennreal_infinity
  | q1067156_ennreal_infinity, q1067156_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q1067156_ennreal_zero
      else q1067156_ennreal_infinity
  | q1067156_ennreal_infinity, q1067156_ennreal_infinity =>
      q1067156_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q1067156_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1067156_ennreal) (n : nat) : q1067156_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1067156_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1067156_ennreal_add
        (q1067156_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q1067156_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q1067156_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q1067156_ennreal,
      values value -> q1067156_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q1067156_ennreal,
      (forall value : q1067156_ennreal,
        values value -> q1067156_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q1067156_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q1067156_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1067156_ennreal)
    (sum : q1067156_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1067156_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        value = q1067156_ennreal_partial_sum u n)
    sum.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_represents
    (x : q1067156_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    x = q1067156_ennreal_finite value nonnegative.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q1067156_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q1067156_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q1067156_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1067156_measurable : q1067156_set A -> Prop;
  q1067156_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q1067156_set A,
      q1067156_same_set E F ->
      (q1067156_measurable E <-> q1067156_measurable F);
  q1067156_measurable_empty :
    q1067156_measurable q1067156_empty;
  q1067156_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q1067156_set A,
      q1067156_measurable E ->
      q1067156_measurable (q1067156_complement E);
  q1067156_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q1067156_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1067156_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1067156_measurable (q1067156_countable_union E);
  q1067156_measure : q1067156_set A -> q1067156_ennreal;
  q1067156_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1067156_set A,
      q1067156_same_set E F ->
      q1067156_measure E = q1067156_measure F;
  q1067156_measure_empty :
    q1067156_measure q1067156_empty = q1067156_ennreal_zero;
  q1067156_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1067156_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1067156_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1067156_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1067156_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1067156_measure (E n))
        (q1067156_measure (q1067156_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q1067156_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q1067156_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q1067156_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A) (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q1067156_set A,
    q1067156_measurable mu null_set /\
    q1067156_measure mu null_set = q1067156_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q1067156_normed_real_vector_space (G : Type) : Type := {
  q1067156_zero : G;
  q1067156_add : G -> G -> G;
  q1067156_neg : G -> G;
  q1067156_smul : R -> G -> G;
  q1067156_norm : G -> R;
  q1067156_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q1067156_add x (q1067156_add y z) =
      q1067156_add (q1067156_add x y) z;
  q1067156_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q1067156_add x y = q1067156_add y x;
  q1067156_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q1067156_add x q1067156_zero = x;
  q1067156_add_neg :
    forall x : G, q1067156_add x (q1067156_neg x) = q1067156_zero;
  q1067156_one_smul :
    forall x : G, q1067156_smul 1 x = x;
  q1067156_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q1067156_smul (a * b) x =
      q1067156_smul a (q1067156_smul b x);
  q1067156_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q1067156_smul (a + b) x =
      q1067156_add (q1067156_smul a x) (q1067156_smul b x);
  q1067156_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : G),
      q1067156_smul a (q1067156_add x y) =
      q1067156_add (q1067156_smul a x) (q1067156_smul a y);
  q1067156_zero_smul :
    forall x : G, q1067156_smul 0 x = q1067156_zero;
  q1067156_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1067156_smul a q1067156_zero = q1067156_zero;
  q1067156_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q1067156_norm x;
  q1067156_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G, q1067156_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1067156_zero;
  q1067156_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q1067156_norm (q1067156_add x y) <=
      q1067156_norm x + q1067156_norm y;
  q1067156_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : G),
      q1067156_norm (q1067156_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q1067156_norm x
}.

Arguments q1067156_zero {G} _.
Arguments q1067156_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q1067156_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q1067156_smul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q1067156_norm {G} _ _.

Definition q1067156_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q1067156_add V x (q1067156_neg V y).

Definition q1067156_vector_sequence_converges {G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (limit : G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1067156_norm V (q1067156_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1067156_vector_sequence_cauchy {G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1067156_norm V (q1067156_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1067156_complete {G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> G,
    q1067156_vector_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : G, q1067156_vector_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q1067156_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1067156_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q1067156_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q1067156_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q1067156_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q1067156_measurable_simple {A G : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q1067156_set A),
    q1067156_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q1067156_measurable_simple_real {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> R) : Prop :=
  q1067156_measurable_simple mu s.

Definition q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1067156_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q1067156_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q1067156_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Definition q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable_real {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1067156_measurable_simple_real mu (approximants n)) /\
    q1067156_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q1067156_real_sequence_converges
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q1067156_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q1067156_nnreal_value : R;
  q1067156_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q1067156_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q1067156_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q1067156_nonnegative_real) : q1067156_ennreal :=
  q1067156_ennreal_finite
    (q1067156_nnreal_value x) (q1067156_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q1067156_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1067156_ennreal)
    (value : q1067156_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q1067156_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q1067156_set A),
    q1067156_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q1067156_ennreal_le
        (q1067156_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    value =
      q1067156_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q1067156_ennreal_mul
            (q1067156_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q1067156_measure mu (cells i)))
        k.

Definition q1067156_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1067156_ennreal)
    (value : q1067156_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1067156_ennreal_supremum
    (q1067156_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q1067156_absolute_ennreal (x : R) : q1067156_ennreal :=
  q1067156_ennreal_finite (Rabs x) (Rabs_pos x).

Definition q1067156_integrable_real {A : Type}
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable_real mu f /\
  exists value : q1067156_ennreal,
    q1067156_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q1067156_absolute_ennreal (f x)) value /\
    q1067156_ennreal_finite_value value.

Fixpoint q1067156_vector_sum {G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => q1067156_zero V
  | S k =>
      q1067156_add V
        (q1067156_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1067156_weighted_cell_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (cell : q1067156_set A)
    (coefficient value : G) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q1067156_zero V /\
    value = q1067156_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q1067156_ennreal_represents
      (q1067156_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value = q1067156_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q1067156_simple_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q1067156_set A),
    q1067156_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q1067156_weighted_cell_value
        V mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q1067156_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q1067156_l1_approximates {A G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q1067156_ennreal,
        q1067156_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q1067156_absolute_ennreal
              (q1067156_norm V
                (q1067156_sub V (approximants n x) (f x))))
          integral_error /\
        q1067156_ennreal_represents integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q1067156_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q1067156_standard_bochner_integral_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
         (integrals : nat -> G),
    (forall n : nat,
      q1067156_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q1067156_simple_integral_has_value
        V mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q1067156_l1_approximates V mu approximants f /\
    q1067156_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q1067156_bochner_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1067156_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  (~ q1067156_complete V /\ value = q1067156_zero V) \/
  (q1067156_complete V /\
    (q1067156_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value \/
     ((forall other : G,
        ~ q1067156_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f other) /\
      value = q1067156_zero V))).

Theorem tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence :
  forall (Alpha G : Type)
         (V : q1067156_normed_real_vector_space G)
         (mu : q1067156_measure_space Alpha)
         (F : nat -> Alpha -> G)
         (f : Alpha -> G)
         (bound : Alpha -> R),
    (forall n : nat,
      q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable V mu (F n)) ->
    q1067156_integrable_real mu bound ->
    (forall n : nat,
      q1067156_almost_everywhere mu
        (fun a => q1067156_norm V (F n a) <= bound a)) ->
    q1067156_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun a =>
        q1067156_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => F n a) (f a)) ->
    forall (integrals : nat -> G) (limit_integral : G),
      (forall n : nat,
        q1067156_bochner_integral_has_value
          V mu (F n) (integrals n)) ->
      q1067156_bochner_integral_has_value
        V mu f limit_integral ->
      q1067156_vector_sequence_converges
        V integrals limit_integral.
Admitted.

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1067156,
  "Dominated convergence theorem": almost-everywhere pointwise convergence of
  strongly measurable vector-valued functions dominated in norm by an integrable
  real function implies convergence of their Bochner integrals.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
begin

definition q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable M g \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
        (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
        (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> g x))"

definition q1067156_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1067156_integrable M g \<longleftrightarrow>
      q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable M g \<and>
      (\<integral>\<^sup>+ x. ennreal (norm (g x)) \<partial>M) < \<infinity>"

definition q1067156_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1067156_has_bochner_integral M g I \<longleftrightarrow>
      q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable M g \<and>
      (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
        (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
        (\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+ x. ennreal (norm (g x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
          \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0 \<and>
        (\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
          \<longlonglongrightarrow> I)"

definition q1067156_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'b"
  where
    "q1067156_bochner_integral M g =
      (if complete (UNIV :: 'b set) then
        if \<exists>I. q1067156_has_bochner_integral M g I
        then THE I. q1067156_has_bochner_integral M g I
        else 0
      else 0)"

theorem dominated_convergence_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and F :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and bound :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes F_measurable:
      "\<And>n. q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable M (F n)"
    and bound_integrable:
      "q1067156_integrable M bound"
    and h_bound:
      "\<And>n. AE a in M. norm (F n a) \<le> bound a"
    and h_lim:
      "AE a in M. (\<lambda>n. F n a) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f a"
  shows
      "(\<lambda>n. q1067156_bochner_integral M (F n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> q1067156_bochner_integral M f"
  sorry

end

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1067156,
  "Dominated convergence theorem": almost-everywhere convergence of strongly
  measurable functions into an arbitrary real normed vector space, under an
  integrable pointwise bound, implies convergence of their Bochner integrals.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1067156_DOMINATED_CONVERGENCE_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let escale =
      \(c:real) (x:bool#real).
        if c = &0
        then ezero
        else if FST x
             then (T,&0)
             else (F,c * SND x) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:B->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:B->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:B | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!s:B->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:B | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (P:B->bool).
        ?N:B->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:B | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let normed_real_vector_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real).
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x:A. neg (neg x) = x) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real x:A. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real x:A.
           smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a:real x y:A.
           smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!a:real x:A. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
        (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (u:num->A) (l:A).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                       ==> norm (add (u n) (neg l)) < e in
   let complete_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
        !u:num->A.
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?N. !m n.
                     N <= m /\ N <= n
                     ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < e)
          ==> ?l:A. vector_tends zero add neg norm u l in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool) (s:B->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool) (s:B->A).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:A. events {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool) (h:B->real).
        ?s:num->B->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x:B. x IN carrier
                 ==> scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:B->A).
        ?s:num->B->A.
          (!n. simple_vector carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x:B. x IN carrier
                 ==> vector_tends zero add neg norm
                       (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (h:B->real).
        ?g:B->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (h:B->A).
        ?g:B->A.
          strongly_measurable_vector
            carrier events zero add neg norm g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let integrable_simple_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (zero:A) (s:B->A).
        simple_vector carrier events s /\
        (!c:A.
           c IN IMAGE s carrier /\ ~(c = zero)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}))) in
   let simple_nonnegative_integral =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:B->real) (z:bool#real).
        (!x:B. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x) /\
        ?n enum partial:num->bool#real.
          (!c:real.
             c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
             ?i. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   eadd
                     (partial i)
                     (escale
                       (enum i)
                       (mu {x:B |
                              x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i}))) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_vector_integral =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A)
       (s:B->A) (z:A).
        ?n enum partial.
          (!c:A.
             c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
             ?i. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   add
                     (smul
                       (SND (mu {x:B |
                                  x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i}))
                           (enum i))
                     (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (h:B->real) (u:bool#real).
        enonnegative u /\
        !s:B->real z:bool#real.
          simple_scalar carrier events s /\
          (!x:B. x IN carrier ==> s x <= h x) /\
          simple_nonnegative_integral carrier mu s z
          ==> ele z u in
   let has_nonnegative_integral =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (h:B->real) (r:bool#real).
        enonnegative r /\
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound carrier events mu h r /\
        (!u:bool#real.
           nonnegative_integral_upper_bound carrier events mu h u
           ==> ele r u) in
   let scalar_integrable =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (h:B->real).
        ae_strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events mu h /\
        (?r:bool#real.
           has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
             (\x:B. abs(h x)) r /\
           ~(FST r)) in
   let vector_integrable =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (h:B->A).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector
          carrier events mu zero add neg norm h /\
        (?r:bool#real.
           has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
             (\x:B. norm(h x)) r /\
           ~(FST r)) in
   let has_bochner_integral =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:B->A) (z:A).
        ?s:num->B->A ints:num->A.
          (!n. integrable_simple_vector
                 carrier events mu zero (s n)) /\
          (!n. simple_vector_integral
                 carrier mu zero add smul (s n) (ints n)) /\
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                     ==> ?d:bool#real.
                           has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
                             (\x:B.
                                norm
                                  (add (s n x) (neg (h x)))) d /\
                           ~(FST d) /\
                           SND d < e) /\
          vector_tends zero add neg norm ints z in
   let bochner_integral =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:B->A).
        if complete_space zero add neg norm /\
           vector_integrable
             carrier events mu zero add neg norm h
        then @z:A.
               has_bochner_integral
                 carrier events mu zero add neg smul norm h z
        else zero in
   !carrier:B->bool
    events:(B->bool)->bool
    mu:(B->bool)->bool#real
    zero:A
    add:A->A->A
    neg:A->A
    smul:real->A->A
    norm:A->real
    seq:num->B->A
    f:B->A
    bound:B->real.
      measure_space carrier events mu /\
      normed_real_vector_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      (!n. ae_strongly_measurable_vector
             carrier events mu zero add neg norm (seq n)) /\
      scalar_integrable carrier events mu bound /\
      (!n. almost_everywhere carrier events mu
             (\x:B. norm(seq n x) <= bound x)) /\
      almost_everywhere carrier events mu
        (\x:B. vector_tends zero add neg norm
                 (\n. seq n x) (f x))
      ==> vector_tends zero add neg norm
            (\n. bochner_integral
                   carrier events mu zero add neg smul norm (seq n))
            (bochner_integral
               carrier events mu zero add neg smul norm f)`;;

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1067156,
;; "Dominated convergence theorem": an almost-everywhere convergent sequence
;; of almost-everywhere strongly measurable functions into an arbitrary real
;; normed space has convergent Bochner integrals when its norms are dominated
;; almost everywhere by an integrable real function. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Mathematical objects are unrestricted ACL2 objects. The conservative
;; interfaces below only provide application and constructor symbols; every
;; real-field, normed-space, measure, measurability, convergence, and Bochner
;; integration law used by the statement is imposed explicitly by predicates.

(defstub q1067156-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q1067156-zero (type) t)
(defstub q1067156-one (type) t)
(defstub q1067156-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-multiply (type left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-negate (type object) t)
(defstub q1067156-inverse (type object) t)
(defstub q1067156-less (type left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-norm (type object) t)
(defstub q1067156-smul (scalar-type space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q1067156-star (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1067156-real-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1067156-imag-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1067156-of-real (real-type scalar-type real) t)
(defstub q1067156-imaginary-unit (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q1067156-inner (scalar-type space left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q1067156-sequence-at (sequence index) t)
(defstub q1067156-basis-at (basis index) t)
(defstub q1067156-coordinate (coordinates vector index) t)
(defstub q1067156-derivative-function (derivatives function multiindex) t)
(defstub q1067156-fourier-function (fourier function) t)
(defstub q1067156-character-value (fourier-char real) t)
(defstub q1067156-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q1067156-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q1067156-open-ball-set (space center radius) t)
(defstub q1067156-preimage-set (function set) t)
(defstub q1067156-complement-set (carrier set) t)
(defstub q1067156-countable-union-set (carrier sequence) t)
(defstub q1067156-translate-set (space set shift) t)
(defstub q1067156-unit-cell-set (space basis coordinates dimension) t)
(defstub q1067156-fiber-set (function value) t)
(defstub q1067156-simple-values (function) t)
(defstub q1067156-indicator-function (real-type set) t)
(defstub q1067156-function-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-function-difference (type left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-function-norm (real-type type function) t)
(defstub q1067156-inner-integrand (scalar-type space left right) t)
(defstub q1067156-fourier-integrand
  (real-type scalar-type domain space fourier-char function frequency) t)
(defstub q1067156-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q1067156-lintegral-value (lintegral function) t)
(defstub q1067156-bochner-integral-value (integral function) t)
(defstub q1067156-full-set (carrier) t)
(defstub q1067156-point-sequence (function-sequence point) t)
(defstub q1067156-simple-integral-sequence
  (real-type domain space measure function-sequence) t)

(defun q1067156-positive-p (real-type x)
  (q1067156-less real-type (q1067156-zero real-type) x))

(defun q1067156-leq (real-type x y)
  (not (q1067156-less real-type y x)))

(defun q1067156-abs (real-type x)
  (if (q1067156-less real-type x (q1067156-zero real-type))
      (q1067156-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q1067156-natural-cast (type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1067156-zero type)
    (q1067156-add
     type
     (q1067156-one type)
     (q1067156-natural-cast type (- n 1)))))

(defun q1067156-integer-cast (type n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q1067156-negate
       type
       (q1067156-natural-cast type (- n)))
    (q1067156-natural-cast type (nfix n))))

(defun q1067156-real-power (real-type x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1067156-one real-type)
    (q1067156-multiply
     real-type x
     (q1067156-real-power real-type x (- n 1)))))

(defun q1067156-vector-sum
    (real-type space basis coordinates vector n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1067156-zero space)
    (let ((i (- n 1)))
      (q1067156-add
       space
       (q1067156-vector-sum
        real-type space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q1067156-smul
        real-type space
        (q1067156-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q1067156-basis-at basis i))))))

(defun q1067156-zero-multiindex (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (q1067156-zero-multiindex (- n 1)))))

(defun q1067156-natural-list-p (alpha n)
  (if (zp n)
      (equal alpha nil)
    (and
     (consp alpha)
     (natp (car alpha))
     (q1067156-natural-list-p (cdr alpha) (- n 1)))))

(defun q1067156-increment-multiindex (alpha i)
  (if (consp alpha)
      (if (zp i)
          (cons (+ 1 (nfix (car alpha))) (cdr alpha))
        (cons
         (car alpha)
         (q1067156-increment-multiindex (cdr alpha) (- i 1))))
    nil))

(defun q1067156-multiindex-degree (alpha)
  (if (consp alpha)
      (+ (nfix (car alpha))
         (q1067156-multiindex-degree (cdr alpha)))
    0))

;; Complete ordered real field and its canonical complexification.

(defun-sk q1067156-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p type x)
      (q1067156-member-p type y)
      (q1067156-member-p type z))
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p type (q1067156-add type x y))
      (q1067156-member-p type (q1067156-multiply type x y))
      (q1067156-member-p type (q1067156-negate type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q1067156-zero type)))
       (q1067156-member-p type (q1067156-inverse type x)))
      (equal
       (q1067156-add type (q1067156-add type x y) z)
       (q1067156-add type x (q1067156-add type y z)))
      (equal (q1067156-add type x y) (q1067156-add type y x))
      (equal (q1067156-add type x (q1067156-zero type)) x)
      (equal
       (q1067156-add type x (q1067156-negate type x))
       (q1067156-zero type))
      (equal
       (q1067156-multiply type (q1067156-multiply type x y) z)
       (q1067156-multiply type x (q1067156-multiply type y z)))
      (equal
       (q1067156-multiply type x y)
       (q1067156-multiply type y x))
      (equal (q1067156-multiply type x (q1067156-one type)) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q1067156-zero type)))
       (equal
        (q1067156-multiply type x (q1067156-inverse type x))
        (q1067156-one type)))
      (equal
       (q1067156-multiply type x (q1067156-add type y z))
       (q1067156-add
        type
        (q1067156-multiply type x y)
        (q1067156-multiply type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p real-type x)
      (q1067156-member-p real-type y)
      (q1067156-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q1067156-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q1067156-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q1067156-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1067156-less real-type x y)
        (q1067156-less real-type y z))
       (q1067156-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q1067156-less real-type x y)
       (q1067156-less
        real-type
        (q1067156-add real-type x z)
        (q1067156-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1067156-positive-p real-type x)
        (q1067156-positive-p real-type y))
       (q1067156-positive-p
        real-type
        (q1067156-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun q1067156-distance
    (real-type type x y)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (q1067156-norm
   type
   (q1067156-add type x (q1067156-negate type y))))

(defun-sk q1067156-norm-values-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1067156-member-p type x)
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p real-type (q1067156-norm type x))
      (q1067156-leq
       real-type
       (q1067156-zero real-type)
       (q1067156-norm type x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q1067156-norm type x)
        (q1067156-zero real-type))
       (equal x (q1067156-zero type)))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-norm-triangle-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p type x)
      (q1067156-member-p type y))
     (q1067156-leq
      real-type
      (q1067156-norm type (q1067156-add type x y))
      (q1067156-add
       real-type
       (q1067156-norm type x)
       (q1067156-norm type y))))))

(defun q1067156-norm-laws-p (real-type type)
  (and
   (q1067156-norm-values-p real-type type)
   (q1067156-norm-triangle-p real-type type)))

(defun-sk q1067156-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))
     (q1067156-less
      real-type
      (q1067156-distance
       real-type type
       (q1067156-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1067156-convergence-start-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1067156-convergence-tail-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q1067156-converges-p
    (real-type type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1067156-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1067156-convergence-start-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1067156-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m) (natp n) (natp start)
      (<= start m) (<= start n))
     (q1067156-less
      real-type
      (q1067156-distance
       real-type type
       (q1067156-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q1067156-sequence-at sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1067156-cauchy-start-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1067156-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q1067156-cauchy-p (real-type type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1067156-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1067156-cauchy-start-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1067156-sequence-in-type-p (type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1067156-member-p
      type
      (q1067156-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-limit-exists-p
    (real-type type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q1067156-member-p type limit)
     (q1067156-converges-p
      real-type type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q1067156-complete-p (real-type type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-sequence-in-type-p type sequence)
      (q1067156-cauchy-p real-type type sequence))
     (q1067156-limit-exists-p
      real-type type sequence))))

(defun-sk q1067156-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1067156-less
      real-type x
      (q1067156-natural-cast real-type n)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1067156-member-p real-type x)
     (q1067156-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q1067156-real-norm-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1067156-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (equal
       (q1067156-norm real-type x)
       (q1067156-abs real-type x))
      (equal (q1067156-star real-type x) x)
      (equal
       (q1067156-real-part real-type real-type x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1067156-imag-part real-type real-type x)
       (q1067156-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q1067156-of-real real-type real-type x)
       x)))))

(defun q1067156-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q1067156-member-p real-type (q1067156-zero real-type))
   (q1067156-member-p real-type (q1067156-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1067156-zero real-type)
     (q1067156-one real-type)))
   (q1067156-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q1067156-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q1067156-positive-p real-type (q1067156-one real-type))
   (q1067156-real-norm-laws-p real-type)
   (q1067156-complete-p real-type real-type)
   (q1067156-archimedean-p real-type)))

(defun-sk q1067156-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q1067156-member-p complex-type z)
     (let* ((re (q1067156-real-part real-type complex-type z))
            (im (q1067156-imag-part real-type complex-type z))
            (re-z (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type re))
            (im-z
             (q1067156-multiply
              complex-type
              (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type im)
              (q1067156-imaginary-unit complex-type))))
       (and
        (q1067156-member-p real-type re)
        (q1067156-member-p real-type im)
        (equal z (q1067156-add complex-type re-z im-z))
        (equal
         (q1067156-star complex-type z)
         (q1067156-add
          complex-type re-z
          (q1067156-negate complex-type im-z)))
        (equal
         (q1067156-multiply
          real-type
          (q1067156-norm complex-type z)
          (q1067156-norm complex-type z))
         (q1067156-add
          real-type
          (q1067156-multiply real-type re re)
          (q1067156-multiply real-type im im))))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-of-real-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p real-type x)
      (q1067156-member-p real-type y))
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p
       complex-type
       (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type x))
      (equal
       (q1067156-real-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       x)
      (equal
       (q1067156-imag-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       (q1067156-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q1067156-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q1067156-add real-type x y))
       (q1067156-add
        complex-type
        (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type y)))
      (equal
       (q1067156-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q1067156-multiply real-type x y))
       (q1067156-multiply
        complex-type
        (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type y)))))))

(defun q1067156-complex-field-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (and
   (q1067156-real-field-p real-type)
   (q1067156-member-p complex-type (q1067156-zero complex-type))
   (q1067156-member-p complex-type (q1067156-one complex-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1067156-zero complex-type)
     (q1067156-one complex-type)))
   (q1067156-field-laws-p complex-type)
   (q1067156-of-real-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (equal
    (q1067156-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q1067156-zero real-type))
    (q1067156-zero complex-type))
   (equal
    (q1067156-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q1067156-one real-type))
    (q1067156-one complex-type))
   (equal
    (q1067156-multiply
     complex-type
     (q1067156-imaginary-unit complex-type)
     (q1067156-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q1067156-negate complex-type (q1067156-one complex-type)))
   (equal
    (q1067156-real-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q1067156-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q1067156-zero real-type))
   (equal
    (q1067156-imag-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q1067156-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q1067156-one real-type))
   (q1067156-complex-coordinate-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q1067156-norm-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q1067156-complete-p real-type complex-type)))

;; Real and complex inner-product spaces.

(defun-sk q1067156-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q1067156-member-p scalar-type b)
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (q1067156-member-p space y)
      (q1067156-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p space (q1067156-add space x y))
      (q1067156-member-p space (q1067156-negate space x))
      (q1067156-member-p
       space (q1067156-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (equal
       (q1067156-add space (q1067156-add space x y) z)
       (q1067156-add space x (q1067156-add space y z)))
      (equal (q1067156-add space x y) (q1067156-add space y x))
      (equal (q1067156-add space x (q1067156-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q1067156-add space x (q1067156-negate space x))
       (q1067156-zero space))
      (equal
       (q1067156-smul
        scalar-type space (q1067156-one scalar-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1067156-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q1067156-multiply scalar-type a b) x)
       (q1067156-smul
        scalar-type space a
        (q1067156-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1067156-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q1067156-add scalar-type a b) x)
       (q1067156-add
        space
        (q1067156-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q1067156-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1067156-smul
        scalar-type space a (q1067156-add space x y))
       (q1067156-add
        space
        (q1067156-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q1067156-smul scalar-type space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-normed-space-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q1067156-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q1067156-norm
       space
       (q1067156-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (q1067156-multiply
       real-type
       (q1067156-norm scalar-type a)
       (q1067156-norm space x))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (q1067156-member-p space y)
      (q1067156-member-p space z))
     (let ((xy (q1067156-inner scalar-type space x y))
           (xx (q1067156-inner scalar-type space x x)))
       (and
        (q1067156-member-p scalar-type xy)
        (equal
         (q1067156-inner
          scalar-type space x (q1067156-add space y z))
         (q1067156-add
          scalar-type xy
          (q1067156-inner scalar-type space x z)))
        (equal
         (q1067156-inner
          scalar-type space x
          (q1067156-smul scalar-type space a y))
         (q1067156-multiply scalar-type a xy))
        (equal
         (q1067156-inner scalar-type space y x)
         (q1067156-star scalar-type xy))
        (equal
         (q1067156-multiply
          real-type
          (q1067156-norm space x)
          (q1067156-norm space x))
         (q1067156-real-part real-type scalar-type xx))
        (iff
         (equal xx (q1067156-zero scalar-type))
         (equal x (q1067156-zero space))))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-real-smul-compatibility-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (r x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p real-type r)
      (q1067156-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q1067156-smul real-type space r x)
      (q1067156-smul
       complex-type space
       (q1067156-of-real real-type complex-type r)
       x)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (i j x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
      (q1067156-member-p space (q1067156-basis-at basis i)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp i) (natp j)
       (< i dimension) (< j dimension))
      (equal
       (q1067156-inner
        real-type space
        (q1067156-basis-at basis i)
        (q1067156-basis-at basis j))
       (if (equal i j)
           (q1067156-one real-type)
         (q1067156-zero real-type))))
     (implies
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
        (q1067156-member-p
         real-type
         (q1067156-coordinate coordinates x i)))
       (equal
        x
        (q1067156-vector-sum
         real-type space basis coordinates x dimension)))))))

(defun q1067156-finite-real-inner-product-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (and
   (natp dimension)
   (q1067156-member-p space (q1067156-zero space))
   (q1067156-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q1067156-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q1067156-normed-space-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q1067156-inner-product-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q1067156-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)))

(defun q1067156-complex-hilbert-space-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (and
   (q1067156-member-p space (q1067156-zero space))
   (q1067156-vector-space-laws-p complex-type space)
   (q1067156-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q1067156-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q1067156-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q1067156-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type real-type space)
   (q1067156-real-smul-compatibility-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q1067156-inner-product-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q1067156-complete-p real-type space)))

;; Borel sigma algebra and normalized translation-invariant volume.

(defun-sk q1067156-countable-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-sequence-at sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q1067156-valid-set-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1067156-set-member-p set x)
     (q1067156-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q1067156-sets-equal-on-p (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1067156-member-p space x)
     (iff
      (q1067156-set-member-p left x)
      (q1067156-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-empty-on-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1067156-member-p space x)
     (not (q1067156-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-full-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-full-set space) x)
     (q1067156-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q1067156-complement-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set x)
    (iff
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-complement-set space set) x)
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (not (q1067156-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-countable-union-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (sequence x)
    (iff
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-countable-union-set space sequence) x)
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (q1067156-countable-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-open-ball-set-law-p (real-type space)
  (forall (center radius x)
    (iff
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-open-ball-set space center radius) x)
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (q1067156-member-p space center)
      (q1067156-member-p real-type radius)
      (q1067156-less
       real-type
       (q1067156-distance real-type space x center)
       radius)))))

(defun-sk q1067156-preimage-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function set x)
    (iff
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-preimage-set function set) x)
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p domain x)
      (q1067156-set-member-p
       set (q1067156-function-at function x))))))

(defun-sk q1067156-translate-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set shift x)
    (iff
     (q1067156-set-member-p
      (q1067156-translate-set space set shift) x)
     (and
      (q1067156-member-p space x)
      (q1067156-set-member-p
       set

(defun-sk q1067156-function-constructor-laws-p

      (q1067156-function-at

       type
       (q1067156-function-at f x)
       (q1067156-function-at g x)))
     (equal
      (q1067156-function-at
       (q1067156-function-difference type f g) x)
      (q1067156-add
       type
       (q1067156-function-at f x)
       (q1067156-negate
        type (q1067156-function-at g x))))
     (equal
      (q1067156-function-at
       (q1067156-function-norm real-type type f) x)
      (q1067156-norm type (q1067156-function-at f x)))
     (equal
      (q1067156-function-at
       (q1067156-indicator-function real-type set) x)

     (implies

       (q1067156-nonnegative-measurable-p

       (q1067156-pointwise-leq-p real-type domain f g))

        real-type domain measurable f)

        real-type domain measurable g))
      (equal
