title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1067156,
-- "Dominated convergence theorem": almost-everywhere convergence of strongly
-- measurable functions dominated by an integrable real function implies
-- convergence of their Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

Not1 : Set1 -> Set1
Not1 A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Iff1 (A B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor equivalence1
  field
    forward1  : A -> B
    backward1 : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) -> Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NormedVectorSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) -> addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zero :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-only :
      (x : E) -> normE x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroE
    norm-negate :
      (x : E) -> normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) == multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normE x)

open NormedVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
distanceR reals x y =
  absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals distance sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} reals distance sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence m) (sequence n)) epsilon)

Complete :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} reals distance =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence reals distance sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit reals distance sequence limit)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroM oneM infinityM : M
    addM multiplyM : M -> M -> M
    lessOrEqualM : M -> M -> Set
    finiteM : (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x -> M

    zero-least :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatest :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    infinity-not-zero :
      infinityM != zeroM
    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) -> Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) -> addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) -> addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) -> addM x zeroM == x
    add-infinityM :
      (x : M) -> addM x infinityM == infinityM
    add-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM w y) (addM x z)
    multiply-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) -> multiplyM x y == multiplyM y x
    multiply-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM (multiplyM x y) z == multiplyM x (multiplyM y z)
    multiply-oneM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x oneM == x
    multiply-zeroM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x zeroM == zeroM
    multiply-distributesM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM x (addM y z) ==
      addM (multiplyM x y) (multiplyM x z)
    multiply-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (multiplyM w y) (multiplyM x z)

    finite-zero :
      finiteM (zeroR reals) (order-reflexive reals (zeroR reals)) == zeroM
    finite-one :
      finiteM (oneR reals) (Both.first (zero-less-than-one reals)) == oneM
    finite-order :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Iff (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy))
        (lessOrEqualR reals x y)
    finite-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (addR reals x y))
        (\ hsum ->
          addM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (addR reals x y) hsum)
    finite-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (multiplyR reals x y))
        (\ hproduct ->
          multiplyM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (multiplyR reals x y) hproduct)
    finite-or-infinity :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            Exists
              (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
              (\ nonnegative -> x == finiteM value nonnegative)))
    multiply-infinity-nonzero :
      (x : M) ->
      x != zeroM ->
      multiplyM x infinityM == infinityM

    supremumM : Predicate M -> M
    supremum-upper :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (x : M) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualM x (supremumM P)
    supremum-least :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (upper : M) ->
      ((x : M) -> P x -> lessOrEqualM x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM (supremumM P) upper

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

sumFirstM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumFirstM {reals = reals} extended terms zero =
  zeroM extended
sumFirstM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) (terms n)

sumThroughM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumThroughM extended terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThroughM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumThroughM extended terms n) (terms (suc n))

CountableSum :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
CountableSum extended terms value =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) -> lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) value)
    ((upper : _) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper)

record Measure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    outerMass : Predicate A -> M
    measurableHull : Predicate A -> Predicate A
    measurable-hull-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events (measurableHull S)
    subset-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S (measurableHull S)
    outer-mass-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass (measurableHull S) == outerMass S

    outer-mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      outerMass S == outerMass T
    outer-mass-empty :
      outerMass emptySet == zeroM extended
    outer-mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (outerMass S) (outerMass T)
    outer-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sumValue : M) ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))
        sumValue
    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass T ==
      addM extended
        (outerMass (intersection T S))
        (outerMass (intersection T (complement S)))
    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere {extended = extended} measure property =
  outerMass measure (\ x -> Not (property x)) == zeroM extended

record SimpleFunction
  {A V : Set}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    function : A -> V
    cutoff : Nat
    values : Nat -> V
    pieces : Nat -> Predicate A

    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      measurable events (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      j <=N cutoff ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat (\ i -> Both (i <=N cutoff) (pieces i x))
    represented-on-pieces :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      function x == values i

open SimpleFunction

record StronglyMeasurable
  {A R V : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (distance : V -> V -> R)
  (f : A -> V) : Set1 where
  field
    approximants :
      Nat -> SimpleFunction {V = V} events
    approximates :
      (x : A) ->
      SequentialLimit reals distance
        (\ n -> function (approximants n) x)
        (f x)

record AEStronglyMeasurable
  {A R M V : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (distance : V -> V -> R)
  (f : A -> V) : Set1 where
  field
    representative :
      A -> V
    representative-strongly-measurable :
      StronglyMeasurable reals events distance representative
    equal-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere measure (\ x -> f x == representative x)

record NonnegativeSimpleBelow
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (f : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    underlying :
      SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = R} events
    values-nonnegative :
      (i : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (values underlying i)
    pointwise-below :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (function underlying x)
        (f x)

open NonnegativeSimpleBelow

record SimpleLowerIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  {f : A -> R}
  (simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    integral-equation :
      value ==
      sumThroughM extended
        (\ i ->
          multiplyM extended
            (finiteM extended
              (values (underlying simple) i)
              (values-nonnegative simple i))
            (outerMass measure (pieces (underlying simple) i)))
        (cutoff (underlying simple))

record LowerIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    simple-integrals-below :
      (simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f) ->
      (simpleValue : M) ->
      SimpleLowerIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue value
    least-upper-bound :
      (upper : M) ->
      ((simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f) ->
        (simpleValue : M) ->
        SimpleLowerIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
        lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper

record RealIntegrability
  {A R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    strongly-measurable :
      AEStronglyMeasurable reals events measure (distanceR reals) f
    absolute-integral-value :
      M
    absolute-integral-definition :
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure
        (\ x -> absoluteR reals (f x))
        absolute-integral-value
    absolute-integral-finite :
      absolute-integral-value != infinityM extended

record VectorIntegrable
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    strongly-measurable :
      AEStronglyMeasurable reals events measure (distanceE space) f
    norm-integral-value :
      M
    norm-integral-definition :
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure
        (\ x -> normE space (f x))
        norm-integral-value
    norm-integral-finite :
      norm-integral-value != infinityM extended

sumThroughE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  Nat ->
  E
sumThroughE space terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThroughE space terms (suc n) =
  addE space (sumThroughE space terms n) (terms (suc n))

data PieceBochnerIntegralValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (coefficient : E)
  (piece : Predicate A)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  zero-coefficient-value :
    coefficient == zeroE space ->
    value == zeroE space ->
    PieceBochnerIntegralValue space measure coefficient piece value
  finite-mass-value :
    (mass : R) ->
    (mass-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) mass) ->
    outerMass measure piece ==
      finiteM extended mass mass-nonnegative ->
    value == scaleE space mass coefficient ->
    PieceBochnerIntegralValue space measure coefficient piece value

record SimpleBochnerIntegralValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (simple : SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = E} events)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  field
    terms :
      Nat -> E
    term-definition :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff simple ->
      PieceBochnerIntegralValue space measure
        (values simple i)
        (pieces simple i)
        (terms i)
    integral-equation :
      value == sumThroughE space terms (cutoff simple)

record BochnerLimitValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> E)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  field
    approximants :
      Nat -> SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = E} events
    approximant-integrals :
      Nat -> E
    approximant-integral-definitions :
      (n : Nat) ->
      SimpleBochnerIntegralValue space events measure
        (approximants n)
        (approximant-integrals n)
    errors :
      Nat -> R
    errors-nonnegative :
      (n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (errors n)
    errors-represent-lower-integrals :
      (n : Nat) ->
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure
        (\ x ->
          normE space
            (subtractE space
              (function (approximants n) x)
              (f x)))
        (finiteM extended (errors n) (errors-nonnegative n))
    errors-tend-to-zero :
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceR reals)
        errors
        (zeroR reals)
    approximant-integrals-tend-to-value :
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceE space)
        approximant-integrals
        value

data TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> E)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  complete-integrable-value :
    Complete reals (distanceE space) ->
    VectorIntegrable
      reals space events extended measure f ->
    BochnerLimitValue
      reals space events extended measure f value ->
    TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
      reals space events extended measure f value
  nonintegrable-value :
    Not1
      (VectorIntegrable
        reals space events extended measure f) ->
    value == zeroE space ->
    TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
      reals space events extended measure f value
  incomplete-space-value :
    Not (Complete reals (distanceE space)) ->
    value == zeroE space ->
    TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
      reals space events extended measure f value

record BochnerIntegralConvergence
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (F : Nat -> A -> E)
  (f : A -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    sequence-integrals :
      Nat -> E
    sequence-integral-definitions :
      (n : Nat) ->
      TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
        reals space events extended measure
        (F n)
        (sequence-integrals n)
    limit-integral :
      E
    limit-integral-definition :
      TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
        reals space events extended measure
        f
        limit-integral
    every-integral-selection-converges :
      (values : Nat -> E) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
          reals space events extended measure
          (F n)
          (values n)) ->
      (limitValue : E) ->
      TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
        reals space events extended measure
        f
        limitValue ->
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceE space)
        values
        limitValue

dominated-convergence-theorem : Set1
dominated-convergence-theorem =
  (A R M E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (F : Nat -> A -> E) ->
  (f : A -> E) ->
  (bound : A -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    AEStronglyMeasurable reals events measure (distanceE space) (F n)) ->
  RealIntegrability
    reals events extended measure bound ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    AlmostEverywhere measure
      (\ x ->
        lessOrEqualR reals (normE space (F n x)) (bound x))) ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceE space)
        (\ n -> F n x)
        (f x)) ->
  BochnerIntegralConvergence
    reals space events extended measure F f

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1067156, "Dominated convergence theorem": almost-everywhere convergence of
  strongly measurable functions dominated by an integrable real bound implies
  convergence of their Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q1067156_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q1067156_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1067156_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_tendsto_def",
  ``q1067156_tendsto
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !n. N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q1067156_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_cauchy_def",
  ``q1067156_cauchy
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !p q. N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
          norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q1067156_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_complete_def",
  ``q1067156_complete
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'g.
        q1067156_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell. q1067156_tendsto add neg norm u ell``);

val q1067156_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q1067156_measurable_simple
      (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'g. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q1067156_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q1067156_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'a -> 'g.
        (!n. q1067156_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q1067156_tendsto add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'g.
        q1067156_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q1067156_ae_real_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_ae_real_integrable_def",
  ``q1067156_ae_real_integrable
      (m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> real) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> real.
        integrable m (Normal o g) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q1067156_bochner_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_bochner_integrable_def",
  ``q1067156_bochner_integrable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'g.
        q1067156_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q1067156_simple_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_simple_integral_def",
  ``q1067156_simple_integral
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (s : 'a -> 'g) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add (smul (real (measure m {x | s x = y})) y) acc)
        (IMAGE s UNIV) zero``);

val q1067156_bochner_approximates_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_bochner_approximates_def",
  ``q1067156_bochner_approximates
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) (s : num -> 'a -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'g.
        q1067156_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q1067156_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (s n x)))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable m
            (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x)))))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral m
                (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x))))))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q1067156_tendsto add neg norm
          (\n. q1067156_simple_integral m zero add smul (s n))
          ell``);

val q1067156_bochner_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156_bochner_integral_def",
  ``q1067156_bochner_integral
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) =
      if q1067156_complete add neg norm /\
         q1067156_bochner_integrable m add neg norm f
      then
        @ell.
          ?s : num -> 'a -> 'g.
            q1067156_bochner_approximates
              m zero add neg smul norm f s ell
      else
        zero``);

val tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space)
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (F : num -> 'a -> 'g) (f : 'a -> 'g) (bound : 'a -> real).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q1067156_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      (!n. q1067156_ae_strongly_measurable m add neg norm (F n)) /\
      q1067156_ae_real_integrable m bound /\
      (!n. AE x::m. norm (F n x) <= bound x) /\
      (AE x::m. q1067156_tendsto add neg norm (\n. F n x) (f x))
      ==>
      q1067156_tendsto add neg norm
        (\n. q1067156_bochner_integral
          m zero add neg smul norm (F n))
        (q1067156_bochner_integral m zero add neg smul norm f)``;

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1067156
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1067156), "Dominated convergence theorem":
  a sequence of almost-everywhere strongly measurable functions into an
  arbitrary real normed vector space, dominated in norm almost everywhere by
  an integrable real function and converging almost everywhere pointwise, has
  convergent totalized Bochner integrals. The Bochner integral is encoded by
  L1-approximation with integrable measurable finite-range functions. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1067156Tendsto W S z is convergence of the NN0-indexed sequence S to z in
  the norm topology of W.

  Q1067156AEStrong M W H expresses almost-everywhere strong measurability:
  outside one M-null measurable set, H is the pointwise limit of a sequence
  of finite-range Borel-measurable functions. This is the standard simple-
  function characterization of Lean's AEStronglyMeasurable predicate.

  Q1067156Simple, Q1067156SimpleIntegral, and Q1067156LIntegral define the
  lower Lebesgue integral of a nonnegative extended-real-valued function.
  Q1067156Integrable M W H is almost-everywhere strong measurability together
  with finiteness of the lower integral of the pointwise norm, matching Lean's
  Integrable predicate on arbitrary measure spaces and arbitrary real normed
  codomains.

  Q1067156HasIntegral M W H y says that H is approximated in L1 by a sequence
  of measurable finite-range functions in the domain of SetMM's simple
  Bochner integral, whose integrals converge to y. Q1067156Integral W M H is
  the unique such y when W is complete and H is integrable, and is the zero
  vector otherwise. Thus it is Lean's totalized Bochner integral without
  imposing completeness or integrability as additional theorem assumptions.

  Q1067156AELe M W H b is the almost-everywhere bound norm(H(x)) <= b(x), and
  Q1067156AELimit M W F f is almost-everywhere pointwise convergence F_n(x)
  to f(x). The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement;
  the preceding $a declarations are syntax and faithful definitions only.
$)

$c Q1067156Tendsto Q1067156AEStrong
   Q1067156Simple Q1067156SimpleIntegral Q1067156LIntegral
   Q1067156Diff Q1067156L1Distance Q1067156Integrable
   Q1067156HasIntegral Q1067156Integral
   Q1067156AELe Q1067156AELimit $.

q1067156-tendsto-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156Tendsto W S z ) $.
q1067156-aestrong-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156AEStrong M W H ) $.
q1067156-simple-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156Simple M G ) $.
q1067156-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q1067156SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q1067156-lintegral-syntax $a class ( Q1067156LIntegral M H ) $.
q1067156-diff-syntax $a class ( Q1067156Diff M W H K ) $.
q1067156-l1-distance-syntax
  $a class ( Q1067156L1Distance M W H K ) $.
q1067156-integrable-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156Integrable M W H ) $.
q1067156-has-integral-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1067156HasIntegral M W H y ) $.
q1067156-integral-syntax $a class ( Q1067156Integral W M H ) $.
q1067156-aele-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156AELe M W H b ) $.
q1067156-aelimit-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156AELimit M W F f ) $.

${
  $d S W z $.

  q1067156-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156Tendsto W S z )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) z
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N S W n x $.

  q1067156-aestrong-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156AEStrong M W H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( S ` n )
                e. ( dom M MblFnM ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) )
              /\
              ran ( S ` n ) e. Fin
            )
          /\
          E. N e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` N ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                (
                  Q1067156Tendsto
                  W
                  ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( S ` n ) ` x ) )
                  ( H ` x )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q1067156-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q1067156-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q1067156-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q1067156Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q1067156SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1067156-diff-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156Diff M W H K
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      (
        ( H ` x )
        ( +g ` W )
        ( ( -g ` W ) ` ( K ` x ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1067156-l1-distance-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156L1Distance M W H K
  ) =
    (
      Q1067156LIntegral
      M
      ( x e. U. dom M |->
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          `
          ( ( Q1067156Diff M W H K ) ` x )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M W x $.

  q1067156-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156Integrable M W H )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1067156AEStrong M W H )
      /\
      (
        Q1067156LIntegral
        M
        ( x e. U. dom M |->
          ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( H ` x ) )
        )
      )
      < +oo
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M S W n y $.

  q1067156-has-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156HasIntegral M W H y )
    <->
    (
      y e. ( Base ` W )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            ( ( S ` n ) e. dom ( W sitg M ) )
          /\
          (
            Q1067156Tendsto
            ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
            ( n e. NN0 |->
              ( Q1067156L1Distance M W H ( S ` n ) ) )
            0
            /\
            Q1067156Tendsto
            W
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( W sitg M ) ` ( S ` n ) ) )
            y
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M W y $.

  q1067156-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156Integral W M H
    =
    if
    (
      (
        W e. CMetSp
        /\
        ( Q1067156Integrable M W H )
      ) ,
      (
        iota_ y e. ( Base ` W )
          ( Q1067156HasIntegral M W H y )
      ) ,
      ( 0g ` W )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N W b x $.

  q1067156-aele-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156AELe M W H b )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
          ( ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( H ` x ) ) <_ ( b ` x ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M N W f n x $.

  q1067156-aelimit-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156AELimit M W F f )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
          (
            Q1067156Tendsto
            W
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( F ` n ) ` x ) )
            ( f ` x )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M W b f n w $.

  thousand-theorems-q1067156-dominated-convergence $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = RRfld }
        A. F e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
          A. f e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M )
            A. b e. ( RR ^m U. dom M )
              (
                (
                  (
                    A. n e. NN0
                      ( Q1067156AEStrong M W ( F ` n ) )
                    /\
                    ( Q1067156Integrable M RRfld b )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    A. n e. NN0
                      ( Q1067156AELe M W ( F ` n ) b )
                    /\
                    ( Q1067156AELimit M W F f )
                  )
                )
                ->
                (
                  Q1067156Tendsto
                  W
                  ( n e. NN0 |->
                    ( Q1067156Integral W M ( F ` n ) ) )
                  ( Q1067156Integral W M f )
                )
              )
  $.
$}

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems artifact Q1067156,
:: "Dominated convergence theorem": a sequence of almost-everywhere strongly
:: measurable functions dominated in norm by an integrable real function and
:: converging pointwise almost everywhere has Bochner integrals converging to
:: the integral of its pointwise limit in an arbitrary real normed space.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, SUBSET_1, SEQFUNC,
      MESFUNC5, PARTFUN1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, RELAT_1, ARYTM_3,
      ARYTM_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL2, CARD_1, COMPLEX1, SEQ_2, TARSKI,
      REAL_1, PBOOLE, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, VALUED_1, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_2,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN,
      HAHNBAN1, DUALSP01, FINSET_1, BINOP_1, INTEGRA5, LOPBAN_1, RSSPACE3,
      FCONT_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
      XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_0,
      RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NAT_1, PROB_1,
      MEASURE1, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1,
      DUALSP01, FINSET_1, BINOP_1, RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1;
 constructors REAL_1, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6,
      RELSET_1, COMPLEX1, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1, DUALSP01,
      FINSET_1, BINOP_1, RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1;
 registrations SUBSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, ORDINAL1, PARTFUN1,
      MEASURE1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0,
      FUNCT_1, VALUED_0, XXREAL_3, RELSET_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
      NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1, DUALSP01, FINSET_1,
      RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, NORMSP_0,
      NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1, RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, NORMSP_0, BINOP_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       G being RealNormSpace,
       F being sequence of Funcs(X,the carrier of G),
       f being Function of X,the carrier of G,
       bound being Function of X,REAL
   holds
     ex I being sequence of G,
        v being Point of G
     st
       (for n being Nat holds I.n = the ZeroF of G) &
       v = the ZeroF of G &
       I is convergent &
       lim I = v)
  &
  (for X being non empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       G being RealNormSpace,
       F being sequence of Funcs(X,the carrier of G),
       f being Function of X,the carrier of G,
       bound being Function of X,REAL
   st
     (for n being Nat holds
       ex Fn being Function of X,the carrier of G,
          N being Element of S,
          Q being sequence of Funcs(X,the carrier of G)
       st
         F.n = Fn &
         M.N = 0 &
         (for k being Nat holds
           ex q being Function of X,the carrier of G,
              R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
           st
             Q.k = q &
             (for x being Element of X holds q.x in R) &
             (for y being Point of G holds
               {x where x is Element of X: q.x = y} in S)) &
         for x being Element of X st not x in N holds
           for r being Real st 0 < r holds
             ex k0 being Nat st
               for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
                 ex q being Function of X,the carrier of G st
                   Q.k = q & ||.q.x - Fn.x.|| < r) &
     bound is_integrable_on M &
     (for n being Nat holds
       ex Fn being Function of X,the carrier of G,
          N being Element of S
       st
         F.n = Fn &
         M.N = 0 &
         for x being Element of X st not x in N holds
           ||.Fn.x.|| <= bound.x) &
     (ex N being Element of S st
       M.N = 0 &
       for x being Element of X st not x in N holds
         for r being Real st 0 < r holds
           ex n0 being Nat st
             for n being Nat st n0 <= n holds
               ex Fn being Function of X,the carrier of G st
                 F.n = Fn & ||.Fn.x - f.x.|| < r)
   holds
     ex I being sequence of G,
        v being Point of G
     st
       (((for s being sequence of G
            st s is Cauchy_sequence_by_Norm holds s is convergent) &
         (for n being Nat holds
           for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds
             ex Fn being Function of X,the carrier of G,
                h being Function of X,REAL
             st
               F.n = Fn &
               (for x being Element of X holds
                 h.x = L.(Fn.x)) &
               Integral(M,h) = L.(I.n)) &
         (for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds
           ex h being Function of X,REAL st
             (for x being Element of X holds h.x = L.(f.x)) &
             Integral(M,h) = L.v))
        or
        ((ex s being sequence of G st
            s is Cauchy_sequence_by_Norm & not s is convergent) &
         (for n being Nat holds I.n = the ZeroF of G) &
         v = the ZeroF of G)) &
       I is convergent &
       lim I = v)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1067156,
% "Dominated convergence theorem": on an arbitrary possibly empty source carrier,
% almost-everywhere convergence of strongly measurable Bochner-integrable functions under an
% integrable dominator implies convergence of their Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.

dominated_convergence_theorem_Q1067156[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool],
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  smulG: [real, G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  g_function: TYPE = [A -> G]
  g_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> g_function]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  subG(x, y: G): G = addG(x, negG(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G): addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: G):
        smulG(a, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a + b, x) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a * b, x) = smulG(a, smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): smulG(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        normG(smulG(a, x)) = abs(a) * normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  converges_to_g(values: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normG(subG(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_g(values: g_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normG(
              subG(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_g: bool =
    FORALL (values: g_sequence):
      cauchy_g(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: G): converges_to_g(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND (FORALL (omega: A):
            carrier(omega) AND E(omega)
              IMPLIES measurable_cover(omega))
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) AND NOT property(omega))

  finite_g_sum(values: g_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_g_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_g_value(
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): G =
    finite_g_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroG
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_g_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  finite_simple_real_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_real_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: g_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_g(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_g(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: g_function):
      strongly_measurable_g(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      strongly_measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_g(function_value: g_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(normG(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  abs_enorm_real(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(abs(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_finite_integral_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M, Sigma, enorm_g(function_value), integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  has_finite_integral_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        abs_enorm_real(function_value),
        integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  integrable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_g(M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_real(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_real(
        M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_simple_g_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroG
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_simple_g_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        smulG(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_g_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_g_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: g_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_g(
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            subG(
              function_value(omega),
              approximant(omega))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      approximants: g_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_g(Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: g_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: g_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_g_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_g(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): G =
    IF complete_space_g
        AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: G):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroG
    ENDIF

  dominated_convergence_theorem: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (F: g_function_sequence),
          (f: g_function),
          (bound: real_function):
        (is_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND (FORALL (index: nat):
            ae_strongly_measurable_g(
              M, Sigma, F(index)))
          AND integrable_real(M, Sigma, bound)
          AND (FORALL (index: nat):
            almost_everywhere(
              M,
              Sigma,
              LAMBDA (omega: A):
                normG(F(index)(omega)) <= bound(omega)))
          AND almost_everywhere(
            M,
            Sigma,
            LAMBDA (omega: A):
              converges_to_g(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  F(index)(omega),
                f(omega))))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_g(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              bochner_integral(
                M, Sigma, F(index)),
            bochner_integral(M, Sigma, f))
END dominated_convergence_theorem_Q1067156

-- generated filter have convergent lower Lebesgue integrals. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Lebesgue.Basic
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Typeclasses.Finite
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Bounded.Basic

@[expose] public section

namespace Q1067156X

variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace Ω] [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω]

/-- Finite measures bundled exactly as a measure together with its finiteness instance. -/
def FiniteMeasure (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] : Type _ :=
  { μ : Measure Ω // IsFiniteMeasure μ }

/-- Bounded convergence along a countably generated filter for a finite measure. -/
theorem tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const {ι : Type*} {L : Filter ι}
    [L.IsCountablyGenerated] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {fs : ι → Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (fs_le_const : ∀ᶠ i in L, ∀ᵐ ω : Ω ∂μ, fs i ω ≤ c) {f : Ω → ℝ≥0}

    Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫⁻ ω, fs i ω ∂μ) L (𝓝 (∫⁻ ω, f ω ∂μ)) := sorry

/-- The sequence and pointwise-convergence specialization of bounded convergence. -/
theorem tendsto_lintegral_nn_of_le_const (μ : FiniteMeasure Ω)
    {fs : ℕ → Ω →ᵇ ℝ≥0} {c : ℝ≥0} (fs_le_const : ∀ n ω, fs n ω ≤ c)
    {f : Ω → ℝ≥0} (fs_lim : ∀ ω, Tendsto (fun n ↦ fs n ω) atTop (𝓝 (f ω))) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫⁻ ω, fs n ω ∂μ.1) atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ ω, f ω ∂μ.1)) := sorry

end Q1067156X

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1067156X
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1067156X), "Bounded convergence theorem":
  uniformly bounded continuous nonnegative functions converging almost
  everywhere along a countably generated filter have convergent lower
  Lebesgue integrals, with the pointwise sequence specialization included.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1067156x_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1067156x_empty {A : Type} : q1067156x_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1067156x_full {A : Type} : q1067156x_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q1067156x_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1067156x_set A) : q1067156x_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1067156x_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1067156x_set A) : q1067156x_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1067156x_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1067156x_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1067156x_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q1067156x_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q1067156x_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1067156x_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1067156x_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1067156x_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1067156x_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Record q1067156x_topological_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1067156x_is_open : q1067156x_set A -> Prop;
  q1067156x_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_same_set U V ->
      (q1067156x_is_open U <-> q1067156x_is_open V);
  q1067156x_open_full :
    q1067156x_is_open q1067156x_full;
  q1067156x_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_is_open U ->
      q1067156x_is_open V ->
      q1067156x_is_open (fun x => U x /\ V x);
  q1067156x_open_union :
    forall family : q1067156x_set (q1067156x_set A),
      (forall U : q1067156x_set A,
        family U -> q1067156x_is_open U) ->
      q1067156x_is_open
        (fun x => exists U : q1067156x_set A, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1067156x_is_open {A} _ _.

Record q1067156x_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1067156x_measurable : q1067156x_set A -> Prop;
  q1067156x_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_same_set E F ->
      (q1067156x_measurable E <-> q1067156x_measurable F);
  q1067156x_measurable_empty :
    q1067156x_measurable q1067156x_empty;
  q1067156x_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_measurable E ->
      q1067156x_measurable (q1067156x_complement E);
  q1067156x_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q1067156x_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1067156x_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1067156x_measurable (q1067156x_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q1067156x_measurable {A} _ _.

Definition q1067156x_opens_measurable {A : Type}
    (T : q1067156x_topological_space A)
    (M : q1067156x_measurable_space A) : Prop :=
  forall U : q1067156x_set A,
    q1067156x_is_open T U -> q1067156x_measurable M U.

Record q1067156x_nnreal : Type := {
  q1067156x_nnreal_value : R;
  q1067156x_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q1067156x_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q1067156x_nnreal_le
    (x y : q1067156x_nnreal) : Prop :=
  q1067156x_nnreal_value x <= q1067156x_nnreal_value y.

Definition q1067156x_nnreal_open
    (U : q1067156x_set q1067156x_nnreal) : Prop :=
  forall x : q1067156x_nnreal,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : q1067156x_nnreal,
        Rabs
          (q1067156x_nnreal_value y -
           q1067156x_nnreal_value x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q1067156x_continuous_nnreal {A : Type}
    (T : q1067156x_topological_space A)
    (f : A -> q1067156x_nnreal) : Prop :=
  forall U : q1067156x_set q1067156x_nnreal,
    q1067156x_nnreal_open U ->
    q1067156x_is_open T (fun x => U (f x)).

Record q1067156x_bounded_continuous_nnreal
    (A : Type) (T : q1067156x_topological_space A) : Type := {
  q1067156x_bc_apply : A -> q1067156x_nnreal;
  q1067156x_bc_continuous :
    q1067156x_continuous_nnreal T q1067156x_bc_apply;
  q1067156x_bc_bounded :
    exists bound : q1067156x_nnreal,
      forall x : A,
        q1067156x_nnreal_le (q1067156x_bc_apply x) bound
}.

Arguments q1067156x_bc_apply {A T} _ _.

Inductive q1067156x_ennreal : Type :=
| q1067156x_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q1067156x_ennreal
| q1067156x_ennreal_infinity : q1067156x_ennreal.

Arguments q1067156x_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_zero : q1067156x_ennreal :=
  q1067156x_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite a _, q1067156x_ennreal_finite b _ =>
      a = b
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity, q1067156x_ennreal_infinity =>
      True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite a _, q1067156x_ennreal_finite b _ =>
      a <= b
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite _ _, q1067156x_ennreal_infinity =>
      True
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity, q1067156x_ennreal_finite _ _ =>
      False
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity, q1067156x_ennreal_infinity =>
      True
  end.

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1067156x_ennreal) : q1067156x_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1067156x_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1067156x_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q1067156x_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q1067156x_ennreal) : q1067156x_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1067156x_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1067156x_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite a _, q1067156x_ennreal_infinity
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity, q1067156x_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q1067156x_ennreal_zero
      else q1067156x_ennreal_infinity
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity, q1067156x_ennreal_infinity =>
      q1067156x_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_of_nnreal
    (x : q1067156x_nnreal) : q1067156x_ennreal :=
  q1067156x_ennreal_finite
    (q1067156x_nnreal_value x) (q1067156x_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R,
    exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
      q1067156x_ennreal_eq x
        (q1067156x_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Fixpoint q1067156x_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1067156x_ennreal) (n : nat) : q1067156x_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1067156x_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1067156x_ennreal_add
        (q1067156x_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q1067156x_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q1067156x_ennreal,
      values value -> q1067156x_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q1067156x_ennreal,
      (forall value : q1067156x_ennreal,
        values value -> q1067156x_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q1067156x_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q1067156x_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1067156x_ennreal)
    (sum : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1067156x_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q1067156x_ennreal_eq value
          (q1067156x_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q1067156x_measure {A : Type}
    (M : q1067156x_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q1067156x_measure_value :
    q1067156x_set A -> q1067156x_ennreal;
  q1067156x_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_same_set E F ->
      q1067156x_ennreal_eq
        (q1067156x_measure_value E)
        (q1067156x_measure_value F);
  q1067156x_measure_empty :
    q1067156x_ennreal_eq
      (q1067156x_measure_value q1067156x_empty)
      q1067156x_ennreal_zero;
  q1067156x_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1067156x_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1067156x_measurable M (E n)) ->
      q1067156x_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1067156x_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1067156x_measure_value (E n))
        (q1067156x_measure_value (q1067156x_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q1067156x_measure_value {A M} _ _.

Definition q1067156x_finite_measure {A : Type}
    {M : q1067156x_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q1067156x_measure M) : Prop :=
  q1067156x_ennreal_finite_value
    (q1067156x_measure_value mu q1067156x_full).

Definition q1067156x_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    {M : q1067156x_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q1067156x_measure M) (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q1067156x_set A,
    q1067156x_measurable M null_set /\
    q1067156x_ennreal_eq
      (q1067156x_measure_value mu null_set)
      q1067156x_ennreal_zero /\
    q1067156x_subset (fun x => ~ P x) null_set.

Definition q1067156x_finite_partition {A : Type}
    {M : q1067156x_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q1067156x_measure M)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q1067156x_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q1067156x_measurable M (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q1067156x_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q1067156x_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    {M : q1067156x_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q1067156x_measure M)
    (f : A -> q1067156x_ennreal)
    (value : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q1067156x_nnreal)
         (cells : nat -> q1067156x_set A),
    q1067156x_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q1067156x_ennreal_le
        (q1067156x_ennreal_of_nnreal (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q1067156x_ennreal_eq value
      (q1067156x_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q1067156x_ennreal_mul
            (q1067156x_ennreal_of_nnreal (coefficients i))
            (q1067156x_measure_value mu (cells i)))
        k).
