    {M : q1067156x_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q1067156x_measure M)
    (f : A -> q1067156x_nnreal)
    (value : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1067156x_ennreal_supremum
    (q1067156x_simple_lintegral_below mu
      (fun x => q1067156x_ennreal_of_nnreal (f x)))

Record q1067156x_filter (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1067156x_filter_sets : q1067156x_set A -> Prop;
  q1067156x_filter_full :
    q1067156x_filter_sets q1067156x_full;
  q1067156x_filter_superset :
    forall U V : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_filter_sets U ->
      q1067156x_subset U V ->
      q1067156x_filter_sets V;
  q1067156x_filter_intersection :
    forall U V : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_filter_sets U ->
      q1067156x_filter_sets V ->
      q1067156x_filter_sets (fun x => U x /\ V x)
}.

Arguments q1067156x_filter_sets {A} _ _.

Definition q1067156x_eventually {A : Type}
    (L : q1067156x_filter A) (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  q1067156x_filter_sets L P.

Definition q1067156x_countably_generated {A : Type}
    (L : q1067156x_filter A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q1067156x_set A,
    (forall n : nat, q1067156x_eventually L (basis n)) /\
    forall U : q1067156x_set A,
      q1067156x_eventually L U ->
      exists n : nat, q1067156x_subset (basis n) U.

Definition q1067156x_filter_tendsto_nnreal {A : Type}
    (u : A -> q1067156x_nnreal)
    (L : q1067156x_filter A)
    (limit : q1067156x_nnreal) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    q1067156x_eventually L
      (fun i =>
        Rabs
          (q1067156x_nnreal_value (u i) -
           q1067156x_nnreal_value limit) < epsilon).

Definition q1067156x_filter_tendsto_ennreal {A : Type}
    (u : A -> q1067156x_ennreal)
    (L : q1067156x_filter A)
    (limit : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match limit with
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite value _ =>
      forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        q1067156x_eventually L
          (fun i =>
            match u i with
            | q1067156x_ennreal_finite current _ =>
                Rabs (current - value) < epsilon
            | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity => False
            end)
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity =>
      forall threshold : R,
        q1067156x_eventually L
          (fun i =>
            match u i with
            | q1067156x_ennreal_finite current _ =>
                threshold < current
            | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity => True
            end)
  end.

Definition q1067156x_sequence_tendsto_nnreal
    (u : nat -> q1067156x_nnreal)
    (limit : q1067156x_nnreal) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs
          (q1067156x_nnreal_value (u n) -
           q1067156x_nnreal_value limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1067156x_sequence_tendsto_ennreal
    (u : nat -> q1067156x_ennreal)
    (limit : q1067156x_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match limit with
  | q1067156x_ennreal_finite value _ =>
      forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists N : nat,
          forall n : nat,
            (N <= n)%nat ->
            match u n with
            | q1067156x_ennreal_finite current _ =>
                Rabs (current - value) < epsilon
            | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity => False
            end
  | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity =>
      forall threshold : R,
        exists N : nat,
          forall n : nat,
            (N <= n)%nat ->
            match u n with
            | q1067156x_ennreal_finite current _ =>
                threshold < current
            | q1067156x_ennreal_infinity => True
            end
  end.

Theorem tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const :
  forall (Omega Iota : Type)
         (T : q1067156x_topological_space Omega)
         (M : q1067156x_measurable_space Omega)
         (mu : q1067156x_measure M)
         (L : q1067156x_filter Iota)
         (fs :
           Iota -> q1067156x_bounded_continuous_nnreal T)
         (c : q1067156x_nnreal)
         (f : Omega -> q1067156x_nnreal),
    q1067156x_opens_measurable T M ->
    q1067156x_finite_measure mu ->
    q1067156x_countably_generated L ->
    q1067156x_eventually L
      (fun i =>
        q1067156x_almost_everywhere mu
          (fun omega =>
            q1067156x_nnreal_le
              (q1067156x_bc_apply (fs i) omega) c)) ->
    q1067156x_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun omega =>
        q1067156x_filter_tendsto_nnreal
          (fun i => q1067156x_bc_apply (fs i) omega)
          L (f omega)) ->
    exists (integrals : Iota -> q1067156x_ennreal)
           (limit_integral : q1067156x_ennreal),
      (forall i : Iota,

          (integrals i)) /\

      q1067156x_filter_tendsto_ennreal
        integrals L limit_integral.

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1067156X,
  "Bounded convergence theorem". This uses Isabelle's native finite-measure,
  almost-everywhere, filter, bounded-continuous-function, ennreal, and
  nonnegative-Lebesgue-integral infrastructure. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Complete_Measure"
    "HOL-Analysis.Bounded_Continuous_Function"
    "HOL-Analysis.Infinite_Sum"
begin

theorem bounded_convergence_filter:
  fixes M :: "'a::topological_space measure"
    and L :: "'i filter"
    and fs :: "'i \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow>\<^sub>C real)"
    and c :: real
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes finite_measure: "finite_measure M"
    and opens_measurable: "sets borel \<subseteq> sets M"
    and countably_generated: "countably_generated_filter L"
    and c_nonnegative: "0 \<le> c"
    and fs_nonnegative: "\<And>i x. 0 \<le> fs i x"
    and f_nonnegative: "\<And>x. 0 \<le> f x"
    and fs_le_const: "\<forall>\<^sub>F i in L. AE x in M. fs i x \<le> c"
    and fs_lim: "AE x in M. ((\<lambda>i. fs i x) \<longlongrightarrow> f x) L"
  shows
    "((\<lambda>i. \<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (fs i x) \<partial>M) \<longlongrightarrow>
      (\<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (f x) \<partial>M)) L"

theorem bounded_convergence_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a::topological_space measure"

  assumes finite_measure: "finite_measure M"

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1067156X,
  "Bounded convergence theorem": uniformly bounded continuous nonnegative
  functions converging almost everywhere along a countably generated filter,
  and pointwise in the sequence specialization, have convergent lower Lebesgue
  integrals for a finite measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1067156X_BOUNDED_CONVERGENCE_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then (F,&0)
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let eembed =
      \(z:bool#real).
        if FST z then &1 else SND z / (&1 + SND z) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n:num. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\ (!n:num. ele (u n) w)
           ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n:num.
              ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n:num.
                    partial (SUC n) =
                    eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n})) in
   let finite_measure =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        ~(FST (mu (UNIV:A->bool))) in
   let simple_function =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s (UNIV:A->bool)) /\
        (!c:bool#real. events {x:A | s x = c}) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x:bool#real.
           x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n:num enum:num->bool#real partial:num->bool#real.
          (!x:bool#real.
             x IN items <=>
             ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s (UNIV:A->bool))
          (\c:bool#real.
             emul c (mu {x:A | s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\
           (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele v w)
           ==> ele z w) in
   let lintegral =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (f:A->real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v:bool#real.
               ?s:A->bool#real.
                 simple_function events s /\
                 (!x:A. ele (s x) (F,f x)) /\
                 simple_lintegral mu s v)
            z in
   let is_topology =
      \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
        open_sets {} /\
        open_sets (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!C:(A->bool)->bool.
           (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
           ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
        (!U V:A->bool.
           open_sets U /\ open_sets V
           ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let opens_measurable =
      \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        !U:A->bool. open_sets U ==> events U in
   let real_open =
      \(U:real->bool).
        !y:real.
          y IN U
          ==> ?e:real.
                &0 < e /\
                !z:real. abs(z - y) < e ==> z IN U in
   let continuous_real =
      \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real).
        !U:real->bool.
          real_open U
          ==> open_sets {x:A | h x IN U} in
   let bounded_continuous_nonnegative =
      \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real).
        (!x:A. &0 <= h x) /\
        continuous_real open_sets h /\
        (?M:real. !x:A. abs(h x) <= M) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (P:A->bool).
        ?N:A->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:A | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let is_filter =
      \(sets:(B->bool)->bool).
        sets (UNIV:B->bool) /\
        (!S U:B->bool.
           sets S /\ S SUBSET U ==> sets U) /\
        (!S U:B->bool.
           sets S /\ sets U ==> sets (S INTER U)) in
   let countably_generated =
      \(sets:(B->bool)->bool).
        ?basis:num->B->bool.
          !S:B->bool.
            sets S <=>
            ?n:num. basis n SUBSET S in
   let tends_to_nonnegative =
      \(sets:(B->bool)->bool)
       (u:B->real) (l:real).
        &0 <= l /\
        (!i:B. &0 <= u i) /\
        (!e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> sets {i:B | abs(u i - l) < e}) in
   let etends =
      \(sets:(B->bool)->bool)
       (u:B->bool#real) (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!i:B. enonnegative (u i)) /\
        (!e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> sets
                 {i:B |
                    abs(eembed (u i) - eembed l) < e}) in
   let sequence_tends_nonnegative =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        &0 <= l /\
        (!n:num. &0 <= u n) /\
        (!e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> ?N:num.
                 !n:num. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e) in
   let sequence_etends =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!n:num. enonnegative (u n)) /\
        (!e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> ?N:num.
                 !n:num.
                   N <= n
                   ==> abs(eembed (u n) - eembed l) < e) in
   let filter_form =
      !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool
       events:(A->bool)->bool
       mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
       sets:(B->bool)->bool
       fs:B->A->real
       c:real
       f:A->real.
        is_topology open_sets /\
        measure_space events mu /\
        finite_measure mu /\
        opens_measurable open_sets events /\
        is_filter sets /\
        countably_generated sets /\
        &0 <= c /\
        (!i:B.
           bounded_continuous_nonnegative open_sets (fs i)) /\
        sets
          {i:B |
             almost_everywhere events mu
               (\x:A. fs i x <= c)} /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= f x) /\
        almost_everywhere events mu
          (\x:A.
             tends_to_nonnegative sets
               (\i:B. fs i x) (f x))
        ==> etends sets
              (\i:B. lintegral events mu (fs i))
              (lintegral events mu f) in
   let sequence_form =
      !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool
       events:(A->bool)->bool
       mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
       fs:num->A->real
       c:real
       f:A->real.
        is_topology open_sets /\
        measure_space events mu /\
        finite_measure mu /\
        opens_measurable open_sets events /\
        &0 <= c /\
        (!n:num.
           bounded_continuous_nonnegative open_sets (fs n)) /\
        (!n:num. !x:A. fs n x <= c) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= f x) /\
        (!x:A.
           sequence_tends_nonnegative
             (\n:num. fs n x) (f x))
        ==> sequence_etends
              (\n:num. lintegral events mu (fs n))
              (lintegral events mu f) in
   filter_form /\ sequence_form`;;

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1067156X,
;; "Bounded convergence theorem": a uniformly eventually almost-everywhere
;; bounded family of bounded continuous nonnegative-real functions, converging
;; almost everywhere along a countably generated filter on a finite measure
;; space, has lower integrals converging to the lower integral of its limit;
;; the natural-number, everywhere-bounded specialization is included as well.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, functions, sigma algebras, and operations are tame APPLY$
;; function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification, and
;; inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal existential
;; witnesses. The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence
;; a presentation of the real field. The measure on an arbitrary subset is
;; characterized as the infimum of the measures of its measurable supersets,
;; so null exceptional sets use outer-measure semantics. Measurability is
;; defined through upper-ray preimages, lintegral is the supremum of integrals
;; of measurable finite-range simple functions below the integrand, and the
;; target functions take finite nonnegative values. Topologies and filters are
;; represented extensionally as families of sets. Tendsto is encoded by
;; eventual membership in every strict lower and upper order neighborhood.

(defun q1067156x-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1067156x-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q1067156x-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1067156x-quoted nil)))

(defun q1067156x-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (q1067156x-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1067156x-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1067156x-apply-term
   (q1067156x-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q1067156x-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q1067156x-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q1067156x-quoted nil))
    (q1067156x-quoted t)))

(defun q1067156x-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q1067156x-quoted t)
            (q1067156x-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q1067156x-quoted nil)))

(defun q1067156x-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q1067156x-quoted nil)
        (q1067156x-quoted t)))

(defun q1067156x-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q1067156x-quoted t)))

(defun q1067156x-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q1067156x-quoted t)
              (q1067156x-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q1067156x-quoted nil)
              (q1067156x-quoted t))))

(defun q1067156x-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1067156x-quoted t)))

(defun q1067156x-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1067156x-quoted nil)))

(defun q1067156x-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q1067156x-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q1067156x-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (q1067156x-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q1067156x-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q1067156x-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q1067156x-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets and arbitrary functions.

(defun q1067156x-set-subset-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q1067156x-implies-term
    (q1067156x-and-terms
     (list
      (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q1067156x-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q1067156x-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q1067156x-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (q1067156x-universal-p
    (q1067156x-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q1067156x-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q1067156x-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun q1067156x-set-equiv-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q1067156x-implies-term
    (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q1067156x-iff-term
     (q1067156x-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q1067156x-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q1067156x-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q1067156x-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q1067156x-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q1067156x-universal-p
    (q1067156x-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q1067156x-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (q1067156x-quoted nil)))

(defun q1067156x-full-set (carrier)
  (list 'lambda '(x)
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun q1067156x-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q1067156x-and-terms
    (list
     (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q1067156x-not-term
      (q1067156x-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun q1067156x-function-values-function
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q1067156x-implies-term
    (q1067156x-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))
    (q1067156x-static-apply-term
     codomain-carrier
     (list (q1067156x-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun q1067156x-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q1067156x-universal-p
    (q1067156x-function-values-function
     domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun q1067156x-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (q1067156x-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (q1067156x-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q1067156x-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (q1067156x-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q1067156x-implies-term
      (q1067156x-and-terms
       (list
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1067156x-and-terms
       (list
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q1067156x-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q1067156x-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q1067156x-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (q1067156x-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q1067156x-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q1067156x-quoted zero)))
        (q1067156x-implies-term
         (q1067156x-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q1067156x-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q1067156x-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q1067156x-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (q1067156x-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q1067156x-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q1067156x-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (q1067156x-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (q1067156x-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (q1067156x-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q1067156x-implies-term
      (q1067156x-and-terms
       (list
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1067156x-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1067156x-and-terms
       (list
        (q1067156x-not-term
         (q1067156x-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q1067156x-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (q1067156x-implies-term
         (q1067156x-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q1067156x-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q1067156x-implies-term
         xy
         (q1067156x-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q1067156x-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q1067156x-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q1067156x-implies-term
         (q1067156x-and-terms
          (list

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :q1067156x-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q1067156x-finite)
    (q1067156x-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (q1067156x-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q1067156x-finite value))

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (q1067156x-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q1067156x-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q1067156x-top) t)
   (t
    (q1067156x-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (q1067156x-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :q1067156x-top)
          (equal right :q1067156x-top))
      :q1067156x-top
    (q1067156x-ennreal-finite
     (q1067156x-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q1067156x-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q1067156x-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (q1067156x-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (q1067156x-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :q1067156x-top)
        (equal right :q1067156x-top))
    :q1067156x-top)
   (t
    (q1067156x-ennreal-finite
     (q1067156x-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q1067156x-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q1067156x-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (q1067156x-ennreal-add
     (q1067156x-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (q1067156x-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

                (q1067156x-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (q1067156x-quoted scalar-zero)
                (q1067156x-quoted scalar-add))
          (q1067156x-quoted total)
          (q1067156x-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q1067156x-everywhere-pointwise-limit-p

  (and

    domain-carrier codomain-carrier limit)

;; Finiteness of the measure and integral families.

(defun q1067156x-finite-measure-p

  (let* ((ennreal-carrier

         (ennreal-less

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1067156X,
-- "Bounded convergence theorem": uniformly bounded nonnegative continuous
-- functions converging pointwise, or almost everywhere along a countably
-- generated filter, have convergent lower integrals against a finite measure.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

Not1 : Set1 -> Set1
Not1 A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Iff1 (A B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor equivalence1
  field
    forward1  : A -> B
    backward1 : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) -> Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NormedVectorSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) -> addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zero :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-only :
      (x : E) -> normE x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroE
    norm-negate :
      (x : E) -> normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) == multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normE x)

open NormedVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
distanceR reals x y =
  absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals distance sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} reals distance sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence m) (sequence n)) epsilon)

Complete :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} reals distance =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence reals distance sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit reals distance sequence limit)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroM oneM infinityM : M
    addM multiplyM : M -> M -> M
    lessOrEqualM : M -> M -> Set
    finiteM : (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x -> M

    zero-least :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatest :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    infinity-not-zero :
      infinityM != zeroM
    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) -> Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) -> addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) -> addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) -> addM x zeroM == x
    add-infinityM :
      (x : M) -> addM x infinityM == infinityM
    add-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM w y) (addM x z)
    multiply-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) -> multiplyM x y == multiplyM y x
    multiply-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM (multiplyM x y) z == multiplyM x (multiplyM y z)
    multiply-oneM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x oneM == x
    multiply-zeroM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x zeroM == zeroM
    multiply-distributesM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM x (addM y z) ==
      addM (multiplyM x y) (multiplyM x z)
    multiply-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (multiplyM w y) (multiplyM x z)

    finite-zero :
      finiteM (zeroR reals) (order-reflexive reals (zeroR reals)) == zeroM
    finite-one :
      finiteM (oneR reals) (Both.first (zero-less-than-one reals)) == oneM
    finite-order :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Iff (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy))
        (lessOrEqualR reals x y)
    finite-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (addR reals x y))
        (\ hsum ->
          addM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (addR reals x y) hsum)
    finite-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (multiplyR reals x y))
        (\ hproduct ->
          multiplyM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (multiplyR reals x y) hproduct)
    finite-or-infinity :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            Exists
              (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
              (\ nonnegative -> x == finiteM value nonnegative)))
    multiply-infinity-nonzero :
      (x : M) ->
      x != zeroM ->
      multiplyM x infinityM == infinityM

    supremumM : Predicate M -> M
    supremum-upper :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (x : M) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualM x (supremumM P)
    supremum-least :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (upper : M) ->
      ((x : M) -> P x -> lessOrEqualM x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM (supremumM P) upper

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

sumFirstM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumFirstM {reals = reals} extended terms zero =
  zeroM extended
sumFirstM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) (terms n)

sumThroughM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumThroughM extended terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThroughM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumThroughM extended terms n) (terms (suc n))

CountableSum :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
CountableSum extended terms value =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) -> lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) value)
    ((upper : _) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper)

record Measure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    outerMass : Predicate A -> M
    measurableHull : Predicate A -> Predicate A

    outer-mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      outerMass S == outerMass T
    measurable-hull-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events (measurableHull S)
    subset-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S (measurableHull S)
    outer-mass-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass (measurableHull S) == outerMass S
    outer-mass-empty :
      outerMass emptySet == zeroM extended
    outer-mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (outerMass S) (outerMass T)
    outer-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sumValue : M) ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))
        sumValue
    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass T ==
      addM extended
        (outerMass (intersection T S))
        (outerMass (intersection T (complement S)))
    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere {extended = extended} measure property =
  outerMass measure (\ x -> Not (property x)) == zeroM extended

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

_<=NN_ :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  Set
_<=NN_ {reals = reals} x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y)

finiteNN :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  M
finiteNN extended x =
  finiteM extended (realValue x) (realValue-nonnegative x)

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

data CanonicalENNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  finite-ennreal :
    NonnegativeReal reals ->
    CanonicalENNReal reals
  infinity-ennreal :
    CanonicalENNReal reals

CanonicalENNRealLe :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  Set
CanonicalENNRealLe (finite-ennreal x) (finite-ennreal y) =
  x <=NN y
CanonicalENNRealLe (finite-ennreal x) infinity-ennreal =
  Top
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal (finite-ennreal y) =
  Bottom
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal infinity-ennreal =
  Top

record ENNRealPresentation
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set1 where
  field
    toCanonicalENNReal :
      M -> CanonicalENNReal reals
    fromCanonicalENNReal :
      CanonicalENNReal reals -> M
    to-after-fromENNReal :
      (x : CanonicalENNReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (fromCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    from-after-toENNReal :
      (x : M) ->
      fromCanonicalENNReal (toCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    finite-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (finiteNN extended x) == finite-ennreal x
    infinity-correspondenceENNReal :
      toCanonicalENNReal (infinityM extended) == infinity-ennreal
    order-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x y : M) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
        (CanonicalENNRealLe
          (toCanonicalENNReal x)
          (toCanonicalENNReal y))

record IndexedNonnegativeSimpleBelow
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (f : A -> R) : Set where
  field
    simpleCutoff :
      Nat
    simpleIndex :
      A -> Nat
    simpleValues :
      Nat -> R
    simpleIndexWithin :
      (x : A) ->
      simpleIndex x <=N simpleCutoff
    simpleFiberMeasurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simpleCutoff ->
      measurable events (\ x -> simpleIndex x == i)
    simpleValuesNonnegative :
      (i : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (simpleValues i)
    simplePointwiseBelow :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (simpleValues (simpleIndex x)) (f x)

open IndexedNonnegativeSimpleBelow

indexedSimpleIntegral :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  {f : A -> R} ->
  IndexedNonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f ->
  M
indexedSimpleIntegral extended measure simple =
  sumThroughM extended
    (\ i ->
      multiplyM extended
        (finiteM extended
          (simpleValues simple i)
          (simpleValuesNonnegative simple i))
        (outerMass measure
          (\ x -> simpleIndex simple x == i)))
    (simpleCutoff simple)

record SimpleIntegralCandidate
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (candidate : M) : Set where
  field
    candidateSimple :
      IndexedNonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f
    candidateEquation :
      candidate ==
      indexedSimpleIntegral extended measure candidateSimple

canonicalLowerIntegral :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (A -> R) ->
  M
canonicalLowerIntegral extended measure f =
  supremumM extended
    (\ candidate ->
      SimpleIntegralCandidate extended measure f candidate)

canonicalLowerIntegralNN :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (A -> NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  M
canonicalLowerIntegralNN extended measure f =
  canonicalLowerIntegral extended measure (\ x -> realValue (f x))

record NeighborhoodRefinement
  {A : Set}
  (near : A -> Predicate A -> Set)
  (x : A)
  (U : Predicate A) : Set1 where
  field
    refinement :
      Predicate A
    refinement-near :
      near x refinement
    refinement-stays-near :
      (y : A) ->
      refinement y ->
      near y U

record TopologicalSpace (A : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    neighborhood :
      A ->
      Predicate A ->
      Set
    neighborhood-contains :
      (x : A) ->
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      U x
    neighborhood-whole :
      (x : A) ->
      neighborhood x wholeSet
    neighborhood-upward :
      (x : A) ->
      (U V : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      Subset U V ->
      neighborhood x V
    neighborhood-intersection :
      (x : A) ->
      (U V : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      neighborhood x V ->
      neighborhood x (intersection U V)
    neighborhood-local :
      (x : A) ->
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      NeighborhoodRefinement neighborhood x U

open TopologicalSpace

IsOpen :
  {A : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
IsOpen {A = A} topology U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  neighborhood topology x U

OpensMeasurableSpace :
  {A : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  Set1
OpensMeasurableSpace topology events =
  (U : _) ->
  IsOpen topology U ->
  measurable events U

StrictLessBy :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  X ->
  X ->
  Set
StrictLessBy le x y =
  Both (le x y) (Not (le y x))

data OrderRay (X : Set) : Set where
  above : X -> OrderRay X
  below : X -> OrderRay X

RayContains :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  OrderRay X ->
  X ->
  Set
RayContains le (above lower) x =
  StrictLessBy le lower x
RayContains le (below upper) x =
  StrictLessBy le x upper

All :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> Set) ->
  List X ->
  Set
All P [] =
  Top
All P (x ∷ xs) =
  Both (P x) (All P xs)

BasicContains :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  List (OrderRay X) ->
  X ->
  Set
BasicContains le rays x =
  All (\ ray -> RayContains le ray x) rays

OrderNeighborhood :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> X -> Set) ->
  X ->
  Predicate X ->
  Set
OrderNeighborhood {X = X} le x U =
  Exists (List (OrderRay X))
    (\ rays ->
      Both
        (BasicContains le rays x)
        (Subset (BasicContains le rays) U))

record Filter (I : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    eventually :
      Predicate I ->
      Set
    eventually-whole :
      eventually wholeSet
    eventually-upward :
      (P Q : Predicate I) ->
      eventually P ->
      Subset P Q ->
      eventually Q
    eventually-intersection :
      (P Q : Predicate I) ->
      eventually P ->
      eventually Q ->
      eventually (intersection P Q)

open Filter

record CountablyGenerated
  {I : Set}
  (source-filter : Filter I) : Set1 where
  field
    basis :
      Nat ->
      Predicate I
    basis-eventually :
      (n : Nat) ->
      eventually source-filter (basis n)
    eventually-has-basis :
      (P : Predicate I) ->
      eventually source-filter P ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> Subset (basis n) P)
    basis-generates :
      (P : Predicate I) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> Subset (basis n) P) ->
      eventually source-filter P

TendstoNN :
  {I R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  Filter I ->
  (I -> NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  Set
TendstoNN {reals = reals} source-filter sequence limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay (NonnegativeReal reals))) ->
  BasicContains _<=NN_ rays limit ->
  eventually source-filter
    (\ i -> BasicContains _<=NN_ rays (sequence i))

TendstoM :
  {I R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  Filter I ->
  (I -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
TendstoM extended source-filter sequence limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay _)) ->
  BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays limit ->
  eventually source-filter
    (\ i ->
      BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays (sequence i))

EventuallyAtTop :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
EventuallyAtTop P =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      P n)

SequentialTendstoNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (Nat -> NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  Set
SequentialTendstoNN {reals = reals} sequence limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay (NonnegativeReal reals))) ->
  BasicContains _<=NN_ rays limit ->
  EventuallyAtTop
    (\ n -> BasicContains _<=NN_ rays (sequence n))

SequentialTendstoM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
SequentialTendstoM extended sequence limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay _)) ->
  BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays limit ->
  EventuallyAtTop
    (\ n ->
      BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays (sequence n))

record BoundedContinuousNN
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) : Set1 where
  field
    applyNN :
      A ->
      NonnegativeReal reals
    continuousNN :
      (x : A) ->
      (rays : List (OrderRay (NonnegativeReal reals))) ->
      BasicContains _<=NN_ rays (applyNN x) ->
      neighborhood topology x
        (\ y -> BasicContains _<=NN_ rays (applyNN y))
    boundedNN :
      Exists (NonnegativeReal reals)
        (\ bound ->
          (x : A) ->
          applyNN x <=NN bound)

open BoundedContinuousNN

FiniteMeasure :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Set
FiniteMeasure {extended = extended} measure =
  outerMass measure wholeSet != infinityM extended

tendsto-lintegral-nn-filter-of-le-const : Set2
tendsto-lintegral-nn-filter-of-le-const =
  (A R M I : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  OpensMeasurableSpace topology events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  FiniteMeasure measure ->
  (source-filter : Filter I) ->
  CountablyGenerated source-filter ->
  (functions : I -> BoundedContinuousNN reals topology) ->
  (constant : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  eventually source-filter
    (\ i ->
      AlmostEverywhere measure
        (\ x -> applyNN (functions i) x <=NN constant)) ->
  (limit : A -> NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      TendstoNN source-filter
        (\ i -> applyNN (functions i) x)
        (limit x)) ->
  TendstoM extended source-filter
    (\ i ->
      canonicalLowerIntegralNN extended measure (applyNN (functions i)))
    (canonicalLowerIntegralNN extended measure limit)

tendsto-lintegral-nn-of-le-const : Set2
tendsto-lintegral-nn-of-le-const =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  OpensMeasurableSpace topology events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  FiniteMeasure measure ->
  (functions : Nat -> BoundedContinuousNN reals topology) ->
  (constant : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    (x : A) ->
    applyNN (functions n) x <=NN constant) ->
  (limit : A -> NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    SequentialTendstoNN
      (\ n -> applyNN (functions n) x)
      (limit x)) ->
  SequentialTendstoM extended
    (\ n ->
      canonicalLowerIntegralNN extended measure (applyNN (functions n)))
    (canonicalLowerIntegralNN extended measure limit)

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1067156X, "Bounded convergence theorem": uniformly bounded nonnegative
  bounded continuous functions converging almost everywhere along a countably
  generated filter have convergent lower Lebesgue integrals for a finite
  measure; the sequence specialization uses pointwise convergence. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q1067156x_filter_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156x_filter_def",
  ``q1067156x_filter (L : ('i set) set) <=>
      UNIV IN L /\
      (!s t. s IN L /\ s SUBSET t ==> t IN L) /\
      (!s t. s IN L /\ t IN L ==> s INTER t IN L)``);

val q1067156x_countably_generated_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156x_countably_generated_def",
  ``q1067156x_countably_generated (L : ('i set) set) <=>
      ?B : num -> 'i set.
        (!m n. m <= n ==> B n SUBSET B m) /\
        !s. s IN L <=> ?n. B n SUBSET s``);

val q1067156x_eventually_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156x_eventually_def",
  ``q1067156x_eventually (L : ('i set) set) (P : 'i -> bool) <=>
      {i | P i} IN L``);

val q1067156x_at_top_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156x_at_top_def",
  ``q1067156x_at_top (s : num set) <=>
      ?N. !n. N <= n ==> n IN s``);

val q1067156x_tendsto_nnreal_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156x_tendsto_nnreal_def",
  ``q1067156x_tendsto_nnreal
      (L : ('i set) set) (u : 'i -> real) (ell : real) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        q1067156x_eventually L
          (\i. abs (u i - ell) < epsilon)``);

val q1067156x_tendsto_ennreal_def = new_definition (
  "q1067156x_tendsto_ennreal_def",
  ``q1067156x_tendsto_ennreal
      (L : ('i set) set) (u : 'i -> extreal) (ell : extreal) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        q1067156x_eventually L
          (\i. dist extreal_mr1 (u i,ell) < epsilon)``);

val tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (top : 'a topology)
      (L : ('i set) set) (fs : 'i -> 'a -> real)
      (c : real) (f : 'a -> real).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measure m UNIV <> PosInf /\
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      (!s. open_in top s ==> s IN measurable_sets m) /\
      q1067156x_filter L /\
      q1067156x_countably_generated L /\
      0 <= c /\
      (!i. fs i IN bounded_continuous top) /\
      (!i x. 0 <= fs i x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
      q1067156x_eventually L
        (\i. almost_everywhere m (\x. fs i x <= c)) /\
      almost_everywhere m
        (\x. q1067156x_tendsto_nnreal L (\i. fs i x) (f x))
      ==>
      q1067156x_tendsto_ennreal L
        (\i. pos_fn_integral m (Normal o (fs i)))
        (pos_fn_integral m (Normal o f))``;

val tendsto_lintegral_nn_of_le_const =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (top : 'a topology)
      (fs : num -> 'a -> real) (c : real) (f : 'a -> real).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measure m UNIV <> PosInf /\
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      (!s. open_in top s ==> s IN measurable_sets m) /\
      0 <= c /\
      (!n. fs n IN bounded_continuous top) /\
      (!n x. 0 <= fs n x /\ fs n x <= c) /\
      (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
      (!x.
        q1067156x_tendsto_nnreal
          q1067156x_at_top (\n. fs n x) (f x))
      ==>
      q1067156x_tendsto_ennreal q1067156x_at_top
        (\n. pos_fn_integral m (Normal o (fs n)))
        (pos_fn_integral m (Normal o f))``;

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1067156X
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1067156X), "Bounded convergence theorem":
  uniformly bounded nonnegative bounded continuous functions converging along
  a countably generated filter have convergent lower Lebesgue integrals for a
  finite measure; the sequence specialization uses pointwise convergence at
  infinity. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The nonnegative reals are ( 0 [,) +oo ), with their real subspace topology.
  The extended nonnegative reals are ( 0 [,] +oo ), with the topology inherited
  from the extended-real structure RR*s.

  Q1067156XCountablyGenerated gives a filter a countable refinement basis.
  Q1067156XBoundedContinuous is the actual class of continuous nonnegative
  functions with bounded range. Q1067156XAE M S says that S contains the
  complement of a measurable M-null set, allowing S itself to be arbitrary
  and matching Lean's completion-aware almost-everywhere filter.
  Q1067156XSimple and Q1067156XSimpleIntegral describe finite-range measurable
  extended-nonnegative simple functions and their extended-nonnegative
  integrals. Q1067156XLIntegral is the usual lower Lebesgue integral, defined
  as the supremum of simple integrals below a function; a nonnegative-real
  function is included canonically in the extended nonnegative reals.

  Q1067156XNatAtTop is the eventual-tail filter on NN0. The final two unproved
  $a declarations encode respectively the general countably generated filter
  theorem and its NN0-indexed pointwise specialization. All preceding $a
  declarations are syntax or faithful definitions.
$)

$c Q1067156XCountablyGenerated Q1067156XBoundedContinuous Q1067156XAE
   Q1067156XSimple Q1067156XSimpleIntegral Q1067156XLIntegral
   Q1067156XNatAtTop $.

q1067156x-countably-generated-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1067156XCountablyGenerated L Y ) $.
q1067156x-bounded-continuous-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1067156XBoundedContinuous J H ) $.
q1067156x-ae-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156XAE M S ) $.
q1067156x-simple-syntax $a wff ( Q1067156XSimple M G ) $.
q1067156x-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q1067156XSimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q1067156x-lintegral-syntax $a class ( Q1067156XLIntegral M H ) $.
q1067156x-nat-at-top-syntax $a class Q1067156XNatAtTop $.

${
  $d A B L Y n $.

  q1067156x-countably-generated-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156XCountablyGenerated L Y )
    <->
    E. B
      (
        B : NN0 --> L
        /\
        A. A e. L E. n e. NN0 ( B ` n ) C_ A
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d M N S $.

  q1067156x-ae-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156XAE M S )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        ( U. dom M \ N ) C_ S
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H J d x $.

  q1067156x-bounded-continuous-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156XBoundedContinuous J H )
    <->
    (
      H e.
        (
          J
          Cn
          ( ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) |`t ( 0 [,) +oo ) )
        )
      /\
      E. d e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
        A. x e. U. J ( H ` x ) <_ d
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q1067156x-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1067156XSimple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q1067156x-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156XSimpleIntegral M G
    =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q1067156x-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q1067156XLIntegral M H
    =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q1067156XSimple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q1067156XSimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <

title: Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1067156X
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1067156X), "Bounded convergence theorem": uniformly
% bounded continuous nonnegative functions converging almost everywhere along a
% countably generated filter have convergent lower Lebesgue integrals; the pointwise
% sequence specialization is also stated. This file contains no proof.

bounded_convergence_theorem_Q1067156X[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool],
  I: TYPE+,
  index_carrier: [I -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  event_family: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  topology: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  index_event: TYPE = [I -> bool]
  index_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> index_event]
  index_filter: TYPE = [index_event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  indexed_real_functions: TYPE = [I -> real_function]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  indexed_measure_values: TYPE = [I -> measure_value]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      E(omega) AND F(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  arbitrary_union(events: event_family): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (E: event):
          events(E) AND E(omega)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES F(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_topology(open_sets: topology): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      open_sets(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND open_sets(empty_event)
      AND open_sets(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E, F: event):
        open_sets(E) AND open_sets(F)
          IMPLIES open_sets(event_intersection(E, F)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_family):
        (FORALL (E: event):
          events(E) IMPLIES open_sets(E))
          IMPLIES open_sets(arbitrary_union(events)))

  opens_measurable(
      open_sets: topology,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      open_sets(E) IMPLIES Sigma(E)

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  finite_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(M(full_event))
      AND NOT infinite_flag(M(full_event))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) AND NOT property(omega))

  nonnegative_on_carrier(function_value: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES function_value(omega) >= 0

  bounded_on_carrier(function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      bound >= 0
        AND FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            abs(function_value(omega)) <= bound

  continuous_on_carrier(
      open_sets: topology,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (neighborhood: event):
            open_sets(neighborhood)
              AND neighborhood(omega)
              AND (FORALL (point: A):
                neighborhood(point) IMPLIES
                  abs(function_value(point)
                    - function_value(omega))
                    < epsilon_value)

  bounded_continuous_nonnegative(
      open_sets: topology,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    nonnegative_on_carrier(function_value)
      AND bounded_on_carrier(function_value)
      AND continuous_on_carrier(open_sets, function_value)

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  as_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =

      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(function_value(omega))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  index_event_is_carried(E: index_event): bool =
    FORALL (index: I):
      E(index) IMPLIES index_carrier(index)

  full_index_event: index_event = index_carrier

  index_intersection(E, F: index_event): index_event =
    LAMBDA (index: I):
      E(index) AND F(index)

  index_subset(E, F: index_event): bool =
    FORALL (index: I):
      E(index) IMPLIES F(index)

  filter_laws(eventually_sets: index_filter): bool =
    (FORALL (E: index_event):
      eventually_sets(E) IMPLIES index_event_is_carried(E))
      AND eventually_sets(full_index_event)
      AND (FORALL (E, F: index_event):

        eventually_sets(basis(number)))
        AND (FORALL (E: index_event):
          eventually_sets(E) IFF
            (index_event_is_carried(E)
              AND EXISTS (number: nat):
                index_subset(basis(number), E)))

  eventually_property(
      eventually_sets: index_filter,
      property: [I -> bool]): bool =
    eventually_sets(
      LAMBDA (index: I):
        index_carrier(index) AND property(index))

  filter_converges_real(
      values: [I -> real],
      eventually_sets: index_filter,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      eventually_property(
        eventually_sets,
        LAMBDA (index: I):
          abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value)

  filter_converges_measure_value(
      values: indexed_measure_values,
      eventually_sets: index_filter,
      limit: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(limit)
      AND IF infinite_flag(limit) THEN
        FORALL (bound: real):
          eventually_property(
            eventually_sets,
            LAMBDA (index: I):
              canonical_measure_value(values(index))
                AND (infinite_flag(values(index))
                  OR bound < finite_part(values(index))))
      ELSE
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          eventually_property(
            eventually_sets,
            LAMBDA (index: I):
              canonical_measure_value(values(index))
                AND NOT infinite_flag(values(index))
                AND abs(finite_part(values(index))
                  - finite_part(limit))
