      ENDIF

  sequence_converges_measure_value(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      limit: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(limit)
      AND IF infinite_flag(limit) THEN
        FORALL (bound: real):
          EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              cutoff <= index IMPLIES
                canonical_measure_value(values(index))
                  AND (infinite_flag(values(index))
                    OR bound < finite_part(values(index)))
      ELSE
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              cutoff <= index IMPLIES
                canonical_measure_value(values(index))
                  AND NOT infinite_flag(values(index))
                  AND abs(finite_part(values(index))
                    - finite_part(limit))
                    < epsilon_value
      ENDIF

  tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (open_sets: topology),
        (eventually_sets: index_filter),
        (functions: indexed_real_functions),
        (constant: real),
        (limit_function: real_function):
      (is_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND finite_measure(M)
        AND is_topology(open_sets)
        AND opens_measurable(open_sets, Sigma)
        AND filter_laws(eventually_sets)
        AND countably_generated(eventually_sets)
        AND constant >= 0
        AND nonnegative_on_carrier(limit_function)
        AND (FORALL (index: I):
          index_carrier(index) IMPLIES
            bounded_continuous_nonnegative(
              open_sets, functions(index)))
        AND eventually_property(
          eventually_sets,
          LAMBDA (index: I):
            almost_everywhere(
              M,
              Sigma,
              LAMBDA (omega: A):
                functions(index)(omega) <= constant))
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            filter_converges_real(
              LAMBDA (index: I):
                functions(index)(omega),
              eventually_sets,
              limit_function(omega))))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (integral_values: indexed_measure_values),
            (limit_integral: measure_value):
          (FORALL (index: I):
            index_carrier(index) IMPLIES
              has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
                M,
                Sigma,
                as_nonnegative_function(
                  functions(index)),
                integral_values(index)))
            AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M,
              Sigma,
              as_nonnegative_function(limit_function),
              limit_integral)
            AND filter_converges_measure_value(
              integral_values,
              eventually_sets,
              limit_integral)

  tendsto_lintegral_nn_of_le_const: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (open_sets: topology),
        (functions: real_function_sequence),
        (constant: real),
        (limit_function: real_function):
      (is_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND finite_measure(M)
        AND is_topology(open_sets)
        AND opens_measurable(open_sets, Sigma)

          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            functions(index)(omega) <= constant)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                functions(index)(omega),
              limit_function(omega))))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (integral_values: measure_value_sequence),
            (limit_integral: measure_value):
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M,
              Sigma,
              as_nonnegative_function(
                functions(index)),
              integral_values(index)))
            AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M,
              Sigma,

    {X : Type}

    {X : Type}

    {E G : Type} (f : E -> G) : E * G -> Prop :=

    {K E G : Type}
    {F : q1068085_normed_field K}
    (VE : q1068085_normed_vector_space F E)

    {K E G : Type}
    {F : q1068085_normed_field K}
    (VE : q1068085_normed_vector_space F E)
    (VG : q1068085_normed_vector_space F G)

    exists delta : R, 0 < delta /\
      forall y : E,
        q1068085_dist VE y x < delta ->
        q1068085_dist VG (f y) (f x) < epsilon.

  forall (K E G : Type)
         (F : q1068085_normed_field K)
         (VE : q1068085_normed_vector_space F E)
         (VG : q1068085_normed_vector_space F G)
         (g : E -> G),
    q1068085_linear_map VE VG g ->
    q1068085_complete VE ->
    q1068085_complete VG ->
    q1068085_closed_graph VE VG g ->
    q1068085_continuous VE VG g.

    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. dist x y = enorm (x - y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>c x y. scale c (x + y) = scale c x + scale c y) \<and>
    (\<forall>c d x. scale (c + d) x = scale c x + scale d x) \<and>
    (\<forall>c d x. scale c (scale d x) = scale (c * d) x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>c x. enorm (scale c x) \<le> knorm c * enorm x)"

definition q1068085_linear_map ::
    "('k \<Rightarrow> 'e::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'f::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1068085_linear_map escale fscale g \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. g (x + y) = g x + g y) \<and>
    (\<forall>c x. g (escale c x) = fscale c (g x))"

theorem closed_graph_theorem:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::{field,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::{ab_group_add,metric_space,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and fnorm :: "'f::{ab_group_add,metric_space,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and escale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and fscale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and g :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
  assumes "q1068085_nontrivially_normed_field_structure knorm"
    and "q1068085_normed_space_structure knorm enorm escale"
    and "q1068085_normed_space_structure knorm fnorm fscale"
    and "q1068085_linear_map escale fscale g"
    and "closed {(x, y). y = g x}"
  shows "continuous_on UNIV g"
  sorry

end

title: Q1068085_closed_graph_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1068085,
  "Closed graph theorem": a linear map between arbitrary Banach spaces over a
  nontrivially normed field is continuous when its graph is closed. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q1068085_CLOSED_GRAPH_THEOREM =
 `let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:A. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:A. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a:A. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:A. &1 < normK a) in
  let normed_add_comm_group =
    \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:B. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:B. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:B. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:B. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:B. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_add_comm_group' =
    \(zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real).
       (!x y z:C. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:C. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:C. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:C. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:C. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:C. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:C. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:C. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A x:B. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A x y:B.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a b:A x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:B. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:A x:B. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let normed_space' =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (norm:C->real)
     (smul:A->C->C).
       (!x:C. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A x:C. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A x y:C.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a b:A x:C.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:C. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:A x:C. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let tends_to =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (u:num->B) (x:B).
       !eps:real.
         &0 < eps
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < eps in
  let tends_to' =
    \(add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real)
     (u:num->C) (x:C).
       !eps:real.
         &0 < eps
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < eps in
  let complete_space =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       !u:num->B.
         (!eps:real.
            &0 < eps
            ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                  N <= m /\ N <= n
                  ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < eps)
         ==> ?x:B. tends_to add neg norm u x in
  let complete_space' =
    \(add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real).
       !u:num->C.
         (!eps:real.
            &0 < eps
            ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                  N <= m /\ N <= n
                  ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < eps)
         ==> ?x:C. tends_to' add neg norm u x in
  let linear_map =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (smulE:A->B->B)
     (addF:C->C->C) (smulF:A->C->C) (g:B->C).
       (!x y:B. g (addE x y) = addF (g x) (g y)) /\
       (!a:A x:B. g (smulE a x) = smulF a (g x)) in
  let graph_closed =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (addF:C->C->C) (negF:C->C) (normF:C->real)
     (g:B->C).
       !u:num->B. !v:num->C. !x:B. !y:C.
         (!n:num. v n = g (u n)) /\
         tends_to addE negE normE u x /\
         tends_to' addF negF normF v y
         ==> y = g x in
  let continuous =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (addF:C->C->C) (negF:C->C) (normF:C->real)
     (g:B->C).
       !x:B. !eps:real.
         &0 < eps
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:B.
                 normE (addE y (negE x)) < delta
                 ==> normF (addF (g y) (negF (g x))) < eps in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smulE:A->B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !zeroF:C.
  !addF:C->C->C.
  !negF:C->C.
  !smulF:A->C->C.
  !normF:C->real.
  !g:B->C.
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    normed_add_comm_group' zeroF addF negF normF /\
    normed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE normE smulE /\
    normed_space'
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroF addF normF smulF /\
    complete_space addE negE normE /\
    complete_space' addF negF normF /\
    linear_map addE smulE addF smulF g /\
    graph_closed addE negE normE addF negF normF g
    ==> continuous addE negE normE addF negF normF g`;;

title: Q1068085_closed_graph_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1068085,
;; "Closed graph theorem": a linear map between Banach spaces over an arbitrary
;; nontrivially normed field is continuous when its graph is closed. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary carriers and operations. Tame
;; APPLY$ function objects directly represent arbitrary sequences and linear
;; maps. Norms are represented by rounded rational upper cuts:
;; NORM-LT(type,x,q) means ||x|| < q. Such cuts represent genuine finite
;; nonnegative real values, not rational-valued approximations.
;;
;; Closedness of the graph and continuity are expressed sequentially. Normed
;; spaces are metrizable, so these formulations are bidirectionally equivalent
;; to the source notions. Every quantifier and witness below is introduced
;; directly by DEFUN-SK.

(defstub q1068085-member-p (carrier-type value) t)
(defstub q1068085-zero (carrier-type) t)
(defstub q1068085-one (carrier-type) t)
(defstub q1068085-add (carrier-type left right) t)
(defstub q1068085-multiply (carrier-type left right) t)
(defstub q1068085-negate (carrier-type value) t)
(defstub q1068085-inverse (carrier-type value) t)
(defstub q1068085-smul
  (field-type vector-type scalar vector)
  t)
(defstub q1068085-norm-lt-p
  (carrier-type value rational-bound)
  t)

(defun q1068085-sequence-value (sequence index)
  (apply$ sequence (list index)))

(defun q1068085-map-value (mapping value)
  (apply$ mapping (list value)))

(defun q1068085-positive-rational-p (q)
  (and (rationalp q) (< 0 q)))

(defun q1068085-subtract (carrier-type left right)
  (q1068085-add
   carrier-type
   left
   (q1068085-negate carrier-type right)))

(defun q1068085-norm-difference-lt-p
    (carrier-type left right epsilon)
  (q1068085-norm-lt-p
   carrier-type
   (q1068085-subtract carrier-type left right)
   epsilon))

(defun-sk q1068085-norm-finite-p
    (carrier-type value)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p q)
     (q1068085-norm-lt-p carrier-type value q))))

(defun-sk q1068085-norm-positive-p
    (carrier-type value)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p q)
     (not
      (q1068085-norm-lt-p
       carrier-type value q)))))

(defun-sk q1068085-norm-rounded-p
    (carrier-type value q)
  (exists (r)
    (and
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p r)
     (rationalp q)
     (< r q)
     (q1068085-norm-lt-p
      carrier-type value r))))

(defun-sk q1068085-norm-cut-laws-p
    (carrier-type)
  (forall (x q r)
    (implies
     (q1068085-member-p carrier-type x)
     (and
      (implies
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
       (q1068085-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1068085-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p carrier-type x r))
      (implies
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
       (q1068085-norm-rounded-p
        carrier-type x q))
      (q1068085-norm-finite-p carrier-type x)
      (implies
       (equal x (q1068085-zero carrier-type))
       (iff
        (q1068085-norm-lt-p carrier-type x q)
        (q1068085-positive-rational-p q)))
      (implies
       (not
        (equal x (q1068085-zero carrier-type)))
       (q1068085-norm-positive-p
        carrier-type x))))))

(defun-sk q1068085-normed-add-comm-group-laws-p
    (carrier-type)
  (forall (x y z q r)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p carrier-type x)
      (q1068085-member-p carrier-type y)
      (q1068085-member-p carrier-type z))
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p
       carrier-type
       (q1068085-add carrier-type x y))
      (q1068085-member-p
       carrier-type
       (q1068085-negate carrier-type x))
      (equal
       (q1068085-add
        carrier-type
        (q1068085-add carrier-type x y)
        z)
       (q1068085-add
        carrier-type
        x
        (q1068085-add carrier-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q1068085-add carrier-type x y)
       (q1068085-add carrier-type y x))
      (equal
       (q1068085-add
        carrier-type
        x
        (q1068085-zero carrier-type))
       x)
      (equal
       (q1068085-add
        carrier-type
        x
        (q1068085-negate carrier-type x))
       (q1068085-zero carrier-type))
      (iff
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p
        carrier-type
        (q1068085-negate carrier-type x)
        q)
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p
        carrier-type x q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1068085-positive-rational-p q)
        (q1068085-positive-rational-p r)
        (q1068085-norm-lt-p
         carrier-type x q)
        (q1068085-norm-lt-p
         carrier-type y r))
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p
        carrier-type
        (q1068085-add carrier-type x y)
        (+ q r)))))))

(defun q1068085-normed-add-comm-group-p
    (carrier-type)
  (and
   (q1068085-member-p
    carrier-type
    (q1068085-zero carrier-type))
   (q1068085-norm-cut-laws-p carrier-type)
   (q1068085-normed-add-comm-group-laws-p
    carrier-type)))

(defun-sk q1068085-product-norm-lt-p
    (field-type x y q)
  (exists (r s)
    (and
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p q)
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p r)
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p s)
     (q1068085-norm-lt-p field-type x r)
     (q1068085-norm-lt-p field-type y s)
     (< (* r s) q))))

(defun-sk q1068085-field-laws-p
    (field-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p field-type x)
      (q1068085-member-p field-type y)
      (q1068085-member-p field-type z))
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p
       field-type
       (q1068085-multiply field-type x y))
      (q1068085-member-p
       field-type
       (q1068085-inverse field-type x))
      (equal
       (q1068085-multiply
        field-type
        (q1068085-multiply field-type x y)
        z)
       (q1068085-multiply
        field-type
        x
        (q1068085-multiply field-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q1068085-multiply field-type x y)
       (q1068085-multiply field-type y x))
      (equal
       (q1068085-multiply
        field-type
        x
        (q1068085-one field-type))
       x)
      (equal
       (q1068085-inverse
        field-type
        (q1068085-zero field-type))
       (q1068085-zero field-type))
      (implies
       (not
        (equal x (q1068085-zero field-type)))
       (equal
        (q1068085-multiply
         field-type
         x
         (q1068085-inverse field-type x))
        (q1068085-one field-type)))
      (equal
       (q1068085-multiply
        field-type
        x
        (q1068085-add field-type y z))
       (q1068085-add
        field-type
        (q1068085-multiply field-type x y)
        (q1068085-multiply field-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q1068085-field-norm-laws-p
    (field-type)
  (forall (x y q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p field-type x)
      (q1068085-member-p field-type y))
     (iff
      (q1068085-norm-lt-p
       field-type
       (q1068085-multiply field-type x y)
       q)
      (q1068085-product-norm-lt-p
       field-type x y q)))))

(defun-sk q1068085-large-norm-element-exists-p
    (field-type)
  (exists (x q)
    (and
     (q1068085-member-p field-type x)
     (rationalp q)
     (< 1 q)
     (not
      (q1068085-norm-lt-p
       field-type x q)))))

(defun q1068085-nontrivially-normed-field-p
    (field-type)
  (and
   (q1068085-normed-add-comm-group-p
    field-type)
   (q1068085-member-p
    field-type
    (q1068085-one field-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1068085-zero field-type)
     (q1068085-one field-type)))
   (q1068085-field-laws-p field-type)
   (q1068085-field-norm-laws-p field-type)
   (q1068085-large-norm-element-exists-p
    field-type)))

(defun-sk q1068085-scaled-norm-lt-p
    (field-type vector-type scalar vector q)
  (exists (r s)
    (and
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p q)
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p r)
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p s)
     (q1068085-norm-lt-p field-type scalar r)
     (q1068085-norm-lt-p vector-type vector s)
     (< (* r s) q))))

(defun-sk q1068085-normed-space-laws-p
    (field-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b x y q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p field-type a)
      (q1068085-member-p field-type b)
      (q1068085-member-p vector-type x)
      (q1068085-member-p vector-type y))
     (and
      (q1068085-member-p
       vector-type
       (q1068085-smul
        field-type vector-type a x))
      (equal
       (q1068085-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        (q1068085-one field-type)
        x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1068085-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        (q1068085-multiply field-type a b)
        x)
       (q1068085-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        a
        (q1068085-smul
         field-type vector-type b x)))
      (equal
       (q1068085-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        (q1068085-add field-type a b)
        x)
       (q1068085-add
        vector-type
        (q1068085-smul
         field-type vector-type a x)
        (q1068085-smul
         field-type vector-type b x)))
      (equal
       (q1068085-smul
        field-type
        vector-type
        a
        (q1068085-add vector-type x y))
       (q1068085-add
        vector-type
        (q1068085-smul
         field-type vector-type a x)
        (q1068085-smul
         field-type vector-type a y)))
      (iff
       (q1068085-norm-lt-p
        vector-type
        (q1068085-smul
         field-type vector-type a x)
        q)
       (q1068085-scaled-norm-lt-p
        field-type vector-type a x q))))))

(defun q1068085-normed-space-p
    (field-type vector-type)
  (and
   (q1068085-normed-add-comm-group-p
    vector-type)
   (q1068085-normed-space-laws-p
    field-type vector-type)))

(defun-sk q1068085-sequence-valid-p
    (carrier-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (and
     (tamep-functionp sequence)
     (implies
      (natp n)
      (q1068085-member-p
       carrier-type
       (q1068085-sequence-value sequence n))))))

(defun-sk q1068085-cauchy-tail-p
    (carrier-type sequence epsilon n0)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp n0)
      (<= n0 m)
      (<= n0 n))
     (q1068085-norm-difference-lt-p
      carrier-type
      (q1068085-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q1068085-sequence-value sequence n)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1068085-cauchy-epsilon-p
    (carrier-type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (n0)
    (and
     (natp n0)
     (q1068085-cauchy-tail-p
      carrier-type sequence epsilon n0))))

(defun-sk q1068085-cauchy-all-epsilon-p
    (carrier-type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1068085-positive-rational-p epsilon)
     (q1068085-cauchy-epsilon-p
      carrier-type sequence epsilon))))

(defun q1068085-cauchy-p
    (carrier-type sequence)
  (and
   (q1068085-sequence-valid-p
    carrier-type sequence)
   (q1068085-cauchy-all-epsilon-p
    carrier-type sequence)))

(defun-sk q1068085-convergence-tail-p
    (carrier-type sequence limit epsilon n0)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp n0)
      (<= n0 n))
     (q1068085-norm-difference-lt-p
      carrier-type
      (q1068085-sequence-value sequence n)
      limit
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1068085-convergence-epsilon-p
    (carrier-type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (n0)

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1068085,
-- "Closed graph theorem": a linear map between Banach spaces over a
-- nontrivially normed field is continuous when its graph is closed. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1068085_closed_graph_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NontriviallyNormedField
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z == multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) -> normK x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)
    non-trivial-normK :
      Exists K
        (\ c -> StrictLess reals (oneR reals) (normK c))

open NontriviallyNormedField

record NormedSpace
  (K R V : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : K -> V -> V
    normV : V -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) -> addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) -> addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) -> addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) -> scaleV (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyK scalars a b) x == scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (addK scalars a b) x == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyV :
      (x : V) -> normV x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroV
    norm-negateV :
      (x : V) -> normV (negateV x) == normV x
    norm-addV :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normV x)

open NormedSpace

subtractV :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  V ->
  V ->
  V
subtractV space x y =
  addV space x (negateV space y)

distanceV :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R
distanceV space x y =
  normV space (subtractV space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceV space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceV space (sequence m) (sequence n)) epsilon)

Complete :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  NormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} space =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit space sequence limit)

record LinearMap
  {K R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars)
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) : Set where
  field
    apply : E -> F
    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addV domain x y) ==
      addV codomain (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleV domain a x) ==
      scaleV codomain a (apply x)

open LinearMap

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

open Pair

Graph :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  {domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars} ->
  {codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars} ->
  LinearMap domain codomain ->
  Pair E F ->
  Set
Graph linear p =
  apply linear (first p) == second p

ClosedGraph :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) ->
  LinearMap domain codomain ->
  Set
ClosedGraph {R = R} {E = E} {F = F} {reals = reals}
  domain codomain linear =
  (point : Pair E F) ->
  Not (Graph linear point) ->
  Exists R
    (\ domainRadius ->
      Exists R
        (\ codomainRadius ->
          Both
            (Positive reals domainRadius)
            (Both
              (Positive reals codomainRadius)
              ((nearby : Pair E F) ->
                StrictLess reals
                  (distanceV domain (first nearby) (first point))
                  domainRadius ->
                StrictLess reals
                  (distanceV codomain (second nearby) (second point))
                  codomainRadius ->
                Not (Graph linear nearby)))))

Continuous :
  {K R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) ->
  LinearMap domain codomain ->
  Set
Continuous {R = R} {E = E} {F = F} {reals = reals}
  domain codomain linear =
  (x : E) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((y : E) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceV domain y x) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceV codomain (apply linear y) (apply linear x))
            epsilon))

closed-graph-theorem : Set1
closed-graph-theorem =
  (R K E F : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) ->
  (domain : NormedSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  (codomain : NormedSpace K R F reals scalars) ->
  Complete domain ->
  Complete codomain ->
  (linear : LinearMap domain codomain) ->
  ClosedGraph domain codomain linear ->
  Continuous domain codomain linear

      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)

      invK zeroK = zeroK /\

      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\

      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\

      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)

      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)

  "q1068085_tendsto_def",

      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)

  map between complete normed vector spaces over an arbitrary nontrivially
  normed field is continuous when its graph is closed. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K is a bundled SetMM normed field, and the existential element whose norm
  exceeds one renders Lean's nontrivial-norm assumption. V and W are arbitrary
  normed vector spaces over K whose norm-induced metric spaces are complete.
  The class g is a SetMM linear map V LMHom W and, as a set-theoretic function,
  is itself its graph, a subset of ( Base ` V ) X. ( Base ` W ). Thus
  membership of g in the closed subsets of the product topology is exactly the
  source hypothesis that the graph is closed. The conclusion uses SetMM's
  native class of continuous functions between the two norm topologies.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d K V W c g v w $.

  thousand-theorems-q1068085-closed-graph $a |-
    A. K e. ( NrmRing i^i Field )
      A. V e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = K }
        A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = K }
          A. g e. ( V LMHom W )
            (
              (
                E. c e. ( Base ` K )
                  1 < ( ( norm ` K ) ` c )
                /\
                V e. CMetSp
                /\
                W e. CMetSp
                /\
                g e. (
                  Clsd
                  `
                  ( ( TopOpen ` V ) tX ( TopOpen ` W ) )
                )
              )
              ->
              g e. ( ( TopOpen ` V ) Cn ( TopOpen ` W ) )
            )
  $.
$}

theorem

      mulR.(a,invR.a) = oneR) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      0 <= normR.a) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      (normR.a = 0 iff a = zeroR)) &
    (for a,b being Element of R holds
      normR.(addR.(a,b)) <= normR.a + normR.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of R holds

    (ex a being Element of R st 1 < normR.a) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,y) = addE.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of E holds
      addE.(addE.(x,y),z) = addE.(x,addE.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of E holds

    (for a,b being Element of R, x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(addR.(a,b),x) =
        addE.(smulE.(a,x),smulE.(b,x))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(mulR.(a,b),x) = smulE.(a,smulE.(b,x))) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(oneR,x) = x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      0 <= normE.x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      (normE.x = 0 iff x = zeroE)) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      normE.(addE.(x,y)) <= normE.x + normE.y) &
    (for a being Element of R, x being Element of E holds
      normE.(smulE.(a,x)) = normR.a * normE.x) &
    (for y,z being Element of F holds
      addF.(y,z) = addF.(z,y)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of F holds
      addF.(addF.(x,y),z) = addF.(x,addF.(y,z))) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      addF.(y,zeroF) = y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      addF.(y,oppF.y) = zeroF) &
    (for a being Element of R, y,z being Element of F holds
      smulF.(a,addF.(y,z)) =
        addF.(smulF.(a,y),smulF.(a,z))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(addR.(a,b),y) =
        addF.(smulF.(a,y),smulF.(b,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(mulR.(a,b),y) = smulF.(a,smulF.(b,y))) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(oneR,y) = y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      0 <= normF.y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds

    (for y,z being Element of F holds

title: Q1068085_closed_graph_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1068085,
% "Closed graph theorem": a linear map between Banach spaces over an arbitrary
% nontrivially normed field is continuous when its graph is closed. This file
% contains no proof.

closed_graph_theorem_Q1068085[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  zeroK: K,
  oneK: K,
  addK: [K, K -> K],
  mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK: [K -> K],
  invK: [K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [K, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  f_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> F]
  linear_function: TYPE = [E -> F]

  subE(x, y: E): E = addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F = addF(x, negF(y))

  field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        addK(x, zeroK) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
          addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  nontrivially_normed_field_laws: bool =
    field_laws
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        0 <= normK(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        (normK(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroK))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        normK(negK(x)) = normK(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        normK(addK(x, y)) <= normK(x) + normK(y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        normK(mulK(x, y)) = normK(x) * normK(y))
      AND (EXISTS (x: K):
        1 < normK(x))

  additive_normed_group_e_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        (normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  module_e_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
      smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK(a, b), x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(zeroK, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)

  normed_space_e_laws: bool =
    additive_normed_group_e_laws
      AND module_e_laws
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  additive_normed_group_f_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        0 <= normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        (normF(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroF))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(negF(x)) = normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <= normF(x) + normF(y))

  module_f_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: F):
      smulF(a, addF(x, y)) =
        addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: F):
        smulF(addK(a, b), x) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: F):
        smulF(mulK(a, b), x) = smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(zeroK, x) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulF(a, zeroF) = zeroF)

  normed_space_f_laws: bool =
    additive_normed_group_f_laws
      AND module_f_laws
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) = normK(a) * normF(x))

  converges_e(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_e(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
            IMPLIES
              normE(
                subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
                < epsilon_value

  complete_space_e: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_e(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges_e(values, limit)

  converges_f(values: f_sequence, limit: F): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normF(subF(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_f(values: f_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
            IMPLIES
              normF(
                subF(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
                < epsilon_value

  complete_space_f: bool =
    FORALL (values: f_sequence):
      cauchy_f(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: F):
          converges_f(values, limit)

  linear_map(g: linear_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      g(addE(x, y)) = addF(g(x), g(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        g(smulE(a, x)) = smulF(a, g(x)))

  closed_graph(g: linear_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: E), (y: F):
      g(x) /= y IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (u: E), (v: F):
            normE(subE(u, x)) < radius
              AND normF(subF(v, y)) < radius
            IMPLIES g(u) /= v

  continuous_map(g: linear_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: E), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: E):
          normE(subE(y, x)) < delta IMPLIES
            normF(subF(g(y), g(x))) < epsilon_value

  closed_graph_theorem: bool =
    (nontrivially_normed_field_laws
      AND normed_space_e_laws
      AND normed_space_f_laws
      AND complete_space_e
      AND complete_space_f)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (g: linear_function):
        (linear_map(g) AND closed_graph(g))
          IMPLIES continuous_map(g)
END closed_graph_theorem_Q1068085

title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1068283
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1068283), "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem": for an infinite
-- first-order structure and a sufficiently large infinite cardinal, there is a structure
-- of that cardinality with an elementary embedding in one direction. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.ModelTheory.Bundled
public import Mathlib.ModelTheory.Skolem
public import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Basic

@[expose] public section

universe u v w w'

open Cardinal CategoryTheory

namespace FirstOrder.Language

namespace Q1068283

/-- The Löwenheim–Skolem theorem for an infinite first-order structure. -/
theorem exists_elementaryEmbedding_card_eq (L : Language.{u, v}) (M : Type w')
    [L.Structure M] [Infinite M] (κ : Cardinal.{w}) (h1 : ℵ₀ ≤ κ)
    (h2 : lift.{w} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v} κ) :
    ∃ N : Bundled L.Structure,
      (Nonempty (N ↪ₑ[L] M) ∨ Nonempty (M ↪ₑ[L] N)) ∧ #N = κ := sorry

end Q1068283

end FirstOrder.Language

content:

  in one direction. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1068283_language : Type := {
  q1068283_functions : nat -> Type;
  q1068283_relations : nat -> Type
}.

Inductive q1068283_tuple (A : Type) : nat -> Type :=
| q1068283_tuple_nil : q1068283_tuple A 0
| q1068283_tuple_cons :
    forall n, A -> q1068283_tuple A n -> q1068283_tuple A (S n).

Arguments q1068283_tuple_nil {A}.
Arguments q1068283_tuple_cons {A n} _ _.

Record q1068283_structure (L : q1068283_language) (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1068283_function_interpretation :
    forall n,
      q1068283_functions L n ->
      q1068283_tuple A n ->
      A;
  q1068283_relation_interpretation :
    forall n,
      q1068283_relations L n ->
      q1068283_tuple A n ->
      Prop
}.

Arguments q1068283_function_interpretation {L A} _ {n} _ _.
Arguments q1068283_relation_interpretation {L A} _ {n} _ _.

Inductive q1068283_term (L : q1068283_language) : Type :=
| q1068283_variable : nat -> q1068283_term L
| q1068283_function :
    forall n,
      q1068283_functions L n ->
      q1068283_terms L n ->
      q1068283_term L
with q1068283_terms (L : q1068283_language) : nat -> Type :=
| q1068283_terms_nil : q1068283_terms L 0
| q1068283_terms_cons :
    forall n,
      q1068283_term L ->
      q1068283_terms L n ->
      q1068283_terms L (S n).

Arguments q1068283_variable {L} _.
Arguments q1068283_function {L n} _ _.
Arguments q1068283_terms_nil {L}.
Arguments q1068283_terms_cons {L n} _ _.

Fixpoint q1068283_term_denote
    {L : q1068283_language}
    {A : Type}
    (S : q1068283_structure L A)
    (valuation : nat -> A)
    (t : q1068283_term L) : A :=
  match t with
  | q1068283_variable k => valuation k
  | q1068283_function f ts =>
      q1068283_function_interpretation S f
        (q1068283_terms_denote S valuation ts)
  end
with q1068283_terms_denote
    {L : q1068283_language}
    {A : Type}
    (S : q1068283_structure L A)
    (valuation : nat -> A)
    {n : nat}
    (ts : q1068283_terms L n) : q1068283_tuple A n :=
  match ts with
  | q1068283_terms_nil => q1068283_tuple_nil
  | q1068283_terms_cons t rest =>
      q1068283_tuple_cons
        (q1068283_term_denote S valuation t)
        (q1068283_terms_denote S valuation rest)
  end.

Inductive q1068283_formula (L : q1068283_language) : Type :=
| q1068283_equal :
    q1068283_term L -> q1068283_term L -> q1068283_formula L
| q1068283_atomic :
    forall n,
      q1068283_relations L n ->
      q1068283_terms L n ->
      q1068283_formula L
| q1068283_falsum : q1068283_formula L
| q1068283_implies :
    q1068283_formula L -> q1068283_formula L -> q1068283_formula L
| q1068283_forall : q1068283_formula L -> q1068283_formula L.

Arguments q1068283_equal {L} _ _.
Arguments q1068283_atomic {L n} _ _.
Arguments q1068283_falsum {L}.
Arguments q1068283_implies {L} _ _.
Arguments q1068283_forall {L} _.

Definition q1068283_extend_valuation
    {A : Type} (x : A) (valuation : nat -> A) : nat -> A :=
  fun k =>
    match k with
    | 0 => x
    | S j => valuation j
    end.

Fixpoint q1068283_satisfies
    {L : q1068283_language}
    {A : Type}
    (S : q1068283_structure L A)
    (valuation : nat -> A)
    (phi : q1068283_formula L) : Prop :=
  match phi with
  | q1068283_equal t u =>
      q1068283_term_denote S valuation t =
      q1068283_term_denote S valuation u
  | q1068283_atomic r ts =>
      q1068283_relation_interpretation S r
        (q1068283_terms_denote S valuation ts)
  | q1068283_falsum => False
  | q1068283_implies psi chi =>
      q1068283_satisfies S valuation psi ->
      q1068283_satisfies S valuation chi
  | q1068283_forall psi =>
      forall x : A,
        q1068283_satisfies S
          (q1068283_extend_valuation x valuation) psi
  end.

Definition q1068283_injective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A, f x = f y -> x = y.

Definition q1068283_surjective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall y : B, exists x : A, f x = y.

Definition q1068283_card_le (A B : Type) : Prop :=
  exists f : A -> B, q1068283_injective f.

Definition q1068283_same_cardinality (A B : Type) : Prop :=
  exists f : A -> B,
    q1068283_injective f /\ q1068283_surjective f.

Definition q1068283_infinite (A : Type) : Prop :=
  ~ exists enumeration : list A,
      forall x : A, In x enumeration.

Definition q1068283_symbols (L : q1068283_language) : Type :=
  ({ n : nat & q1068283_functions L n } +
   { n : nat & q1068283_relations L n })%type.

Definition q1068283_elementary_embedding
    {L : q1068283_language}
    {A B : Type}
    (SA : q1068283_structure L A)
    (SB : q1068283_structure L B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  q1068283_injective f /\
  forall (phi : q1068283_formula L) (valuation : nat -> A),
    q1068283_satisfies SA valuation phi <->
    q1068283_satisfies SB (fun k => f (valuation k)) phi.

Theorem q1068283_lowenheim_skolem :
  forall (L : q1068283_language)
         (M : Type)
         (K : Type)
         (SM : q1068283_structure L M),
    q1068283_infinite M ->
    q1068283_card_le nat K ->
    q1068283_card_le (q1068283_symbols L) K ->
    exists (N : Type) (SN : q1068283_structure L N),
      ((exists f : N -> M,
          q1068283_elementary_embedding SN SM f) \/
       (exists f : M -> N,
          q1068283_elementary_embedding SM SN f)) /\
      q1068283_same_cardinality N K.
Admitted.

title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1068283 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1068283), "Löwenheim–Skolem
  theorem": for an infinite first-order structure and any infinite cardinal
  at least the cardinality of its language, there is a structure of exactly
  that cardinality with an elementary embedding in the appropriate direction.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
  imports Main
begin

datatype 'f fo_term =
    FOVar nat
  | FOFunc 'f "'f fo_term list"

datatype ('f, 'r) fo_formula =
    FOFalse
  | FOEqual "'f fo_term" "'f fo_term"
  | FORel 'r "'f fo_term list"
  | FOImp "('f, 'r) fo_formula" "('f, 'r) fo_formula"
  | FOAll nat "('f, 'r) fo_formula"

record ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure =
  fun_interp :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  rel_interp :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> bool"

primrec wf_fo_term :: "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_term ar (FOVar n) = True"
| "wf_fo_term ar (FOFunc f ts) =
    (length ts = ar f \<and> list_all (wf_fo_term ar) ts)"

primrec wf_fo_formula ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_formula far rar FOFalse = True"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOEqual s t) =
    (wf_fo_term far s \<and> wf_fo_term far t)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FORel r ts) =
    (length ts = rar r \<and> list_all (wf_fo_term far) ts)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOImp p q) =
    (wf_fo_formula far rar p \<and> wf_fo_formula far rar q)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOAll n p) = wf_fo_formula far rar p"

primrec eval_fo_term ::
    "('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "eval_fo_term A v (FOVar n) = v n"
| "eval_fo_term A v (FOFunc f ts) =
    fun_interp A f (map (eval_fo_term A v) ts)"

primrec satisfies_fo ::
    "('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "satisfies_fo A v FOFalse = False"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOEqual s t) =
    (eval_fo_term A v s = eval_fo_term A v t)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FORel r ts) =
    rel_interp A r (map (eval_fo_term A v) ts)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOImp p q) =
    (satisfies_fo A v p \<longrightarrow> satisfies_fo A v q)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOAll n p) =
    (\<forall>x. satisfies_fo A (v(n := x)) p)"

definition fo_elementary_embedding ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r, 'b) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fo_elementary_embedding far rar A B e \<longleftrightarrow>
    inj e \<and>
    (\<forall>p v. wf_fo_formula far rar p \<longrightarrow>
      (satisfies_fo A v p \<longleftrightarrow> satisfies_fo B (e \<circ> v) p))"

theorem lowenheim_skolem:
  fixes far :: "'f \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and rar :: "'r \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and M :: "('f, 'r, 'm) fo_structure"
  assumes "infinite (UNIV :: 'm set)"
    and "infinite (UNIV :: 'k set)"
    and "ordLeq3 (card_of (UNIV :: ('f + 'r) set))
      (card_of (UNIV :: 'k set))"
  shows "\<exists>N :: ('f, 'r, 'k) fo_structure.
    (\<exists>e :: 'k \<Rightarrow> 'm. fo_elementary_embedding far rar N M e) \<or>
    (\<exists>e :: 'm \<Rightarrow> 'k. fo_elementary_embedding far rar M N e)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1068283,
  "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem": for an infinite structure and an infinite
  cardinal at least as large as its first-order language, there is a structure
  of that cardinality with an elementary embedding in one direction between
  the two structures. This file contains no proof.
*)

let lowenheim_skolem_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
Format.pp_set_formatter_out_channel
  Format.std_formatter lowenheim_skolem_output;;

let Q1068283_LOWENHEIM_SKOLEM_THEOREM =
 `let is_structure_A =
    \(function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (relation_arity:R->num)
     (function_interp:F->(num->A)->A)
     (relation_interp:R->(num->A)->bool).
       (!f:F. !xs ys:num->A.
          f IN function_symbols /\
          (!i:num. i < function_arity f ==> xs i = ys i)
          ==> function_interp f xs = function_interp f ys) /\
       (!r:R. !xs ys:num->A.
          r IN relation_symbols /\
          (!i:num. i < relation_arity r ==> xs i = ys i)
          ==> (relation_interp r xs <=> relation_interp r ys)) in
  let is_structure_K =
    \(carrier_K:K->bool)
     (function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (relation_arity:R->num)
     (function_interp:F->(num->K)->K)
     (relation_interp:R->(num->K)->bool).
       (?x:K. x IN carrier_K) /\
       (!f:F. !xs:num->K.
          f IN function_symbols /\
          (!i:num. i < function_arity f ==> xs i IN carrier_K)
          ==> function_interp f xs IN carrier_K) /\
       (!f:F. !xs ys:num->K.
          f IN function_symbols /\
          (!i:num.
             i < function_arity f
             ==> xs i IN carrier_K /\
                 ys i IN carrier_K /\
                 xs i = ys i)
          ==> function_interp f xs = function_interp f ys) /\
       (!r:R. !xs ys:num->K.
          r IN relation_symbols /\
          (!i:num.
             i < relation_arity r
             ==> xs i IN carrier_K /\
                 ys i IN carrier_K /\
                 xs i = ys i)
          ==> (relation_interp r xs <=> relation_interp r ys)) in
  let carrier_card_eq_K =
    \(carrier_K:K->bool).
       ?enumerate:K->K.
         (!x:K. enumerate x IN carrier_K) /\
         (!x y:K. enumerate x = enumerate y ==> x = y) /\
         (!y:K. y IN carrier_K ==> ?x:K. enumerate x = y) in
  let language_card_le_K =
    \(function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool).
       ?code_num:num->K. ?code_function:F->K. ?code_relation:R->K.
         (!m n:num. code_num m = code_num n ==> m = n) /\
         (!f g:F.
            f IN function_symbols /\ g IN function_symbols /\
            code_function f = code_function g
            ==> f = g) /\
         (!r s:R.
            r IN relation_symbols /\ s IN relation_symbols /\
            code_relation r = code_relation s
            ==> r = s) /\
         (!n:num. !f:F.
            f IN function_symbols
            ==> ~(code_num n = code_function f)) /\
         (!n:num. !r:R.
            r IN relation_symbols
            ==> ~(code_num n = code_relation r)) /\
         (!f:F. !r:R.
            f IN function_symbols /\ r IN relation_symbols
            ==> ~(code_function f = code_relation r)) in
  let term_pair_AK =
    \(function_symbols:F->bool) (function_arity:F->num)
     (function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A)
     (function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K)
     (term_A:(num->A)->A) (term_K:(num->K)->K).
       !closed:((num->A)->A)->((num->K)->K)->bool.
         ((!j:num.
             closed (\assignment:num->A. assignment j)
                    (\assignment:num->K. assignment j)) /\
          (!f:F.
           !arguments_A:num->(num->A)->A.
           !arguments_K:num->(num->K)->K.
             f IN function_symbols /\
             (!i:num.
                i < function_arity f
                ==> closed (arguments_A i) (arguments_K i))
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      function_interp_A f
                        (\i:num. arguments_A i assignment))
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      function_interp_K f
                        (\i:num. arguments_K i assignment))))
         ==> closed term_A term_K in
  let term_pair_KA =
    \(function_symbols:F->bool) (function_arity:F->num)
     (function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K)
     (function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A)
     (term_K:(num->K)->K) (term_A:(num->A)->A).
       !closed:((num->K)->K)->((num->A)->A)->bool.
         ((!j:num.
             closed (\assignment:num->K. assignment j)
                    (\assignment:num->A. assignment j)) /\
          (!f:F.
           !arguments_K:num->(num->K)->K.
           !arguments_A:num->(num->A)->A.
             f IN function_symbols /\
             (!i:num.
                i < function_arity f
                ==> closed (arguments_K i) (arguments_A i))
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      function_interp_K f
                        (\i:num. arguments_K i assignment))
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      function_interp_A f
                        (\i:num. arguments_A i assignment))))
         ==> closed term_K term_A in
  let formula_pair_AK =
    \(carrier_K:K->bool)
     (function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (relation_arity:R->num)
     (function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A)
     (relation_interp_A:R->(num->A)->bool)
     (function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K)
     (relation_interp_K:R->(num->K)->bool)
     (formula_A:(num->A)->bool) (formula_K:(num->K)->bool).
       !closed:((num->A)->bool)->((num->K)->bool)->bool.
         ((!left_A right_A:(num->A)->A.
           !left_K right_K:(num->K)->K.
             term_pair_AK function_symbols function_arity
               function_interp_A function_interp_K left_A left_K /\
             term_pair_AK function_symbols function_arity
               function_interp_A function_interp_K right_A right_K
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      left_A assignment = right_A assignment)
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      left_K assignment = right_K assignment)) /\
          (!r:R.
           !arguments_A:num->(num->A)->A.
           !arguments_K:num->(num->K)->K.
             r IN relation_symbols /\
             (!i:num.
                i < relation_arity r
                ==> term_pair_AK function_symbols function_arity
                      function_interp_A function_interp_K
                      (arguments_A i) (arguments_K i))
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      relation_interp_A r
                        (\i:num. arguments_A i assignment))
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      relation_interp_K r
                        (\i:num. arguments_K i assignment))) /\
          (!p_A:(num->A)->bool. !p_K:(num->K)->bool.
             closed p_A p_K
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->A. ~(p_A assignment))
                   (\assignment:num->K. ~(p_K assignment))) /\
          (!p_A q_A:(num->A)->bool.
           !p_K q_K:(num->K)->bool.
             closed p_A p_K /\ closed q_A q_K
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      p_A assignment /\ q_A assignment)
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      p_K assignment /\ q_K assignment)) /\
          (!p_A:(num->A)->bool. !p_K:(num->K)->bool.
             closed p_A p_K
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      ?x:A.
                        p_A
                          (\i:num.
                             if i = 0 then x
                             else assignment (PRE i)))
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      ?x:K.
                        x IN carrier_K /\
                        p_K
                          (\i:num.
                             if i = 0 then x
                             else assignment (PRE i)))))
         ==> closed formula_A formula_K in
  let formula_pair_KA =
    \(carrier_K:K->bool)
     (function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (relation_arity:R->num)
     (function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K)
     (relation_interp_K:R->(num->K)->bool)
     (function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A)
     (relation_interp_A:R->(num->A)->bool)
     (formula_K:(num->K)->bool) (formula_A:(num->A)->bool).
       !closed:((num->K)->bool)->((num->A)->bool)->bool.
         ((!left_K right_K:(num->K)->K.
           !left_A right_A:(num->A)->A.
             term_pair_KA function_symbols function_arity
               function_interp_K function_interp_A left_K left_A /\
             term_pair_KA function_symbols function_arity
               function_interp_K function_interp_A right_K right_A
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      left_K assignment = right_K assignment)
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      left_A assignment = right_A assignment)) /\
          (!r:R.
           !arguments_K:num->(num->K)->K.
           !arguments_A:num->(num->A)->A.
             r IN relation_symbols /\
             (!i:num.
                i < relation_arity r
                ==> term_pair_KA function_symbols function_arity
                      function_interp_K function_interp_A
                      (arguments_K i) (arguments_A i))
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      relation_interp_K r
                        (\i:num. arguments_K i assignment))
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      relation_interp_A r
                        (\i:num. arguments_A i assignment))) /\
          (!p_K:(num->K)->bool. !p_A:(num->A)->bool.
             closed p_K p_A
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->K. ~(p_K assignment))
                   (\assignment:num->A. ~(p_A assignment))) /\
          (!p_K q_K:(num->K)->bool.
           !p_A q_A:(num->A)->bool.
             closed p_K p_A /\ closed q_K q_A
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      p_K assignment /\ q_K assignment)
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      p_A assignment /\ q_A assignment)) /\
          (!p_K:(num->K)->bool. !p_A:(num->A)->bool.
             closed p_K p_A
             ==> closed
                   (\assignment:num->K.
                      ?x:K.
                        x IN carrier_K /\
                        p_K
                          (\i:num.
                             if i = 0 then x
                             else assignment (PRE i)))
                   (\assignment:num->A.
                      ?x:A.
                        p_A
                          (\i:num.
                             if i = 0 then x
                             else assignment (PRE i)))))
         ==> closed formula_K formula_A in
  let elementary_AK =
    \(carrier_K:K->bool)
     (function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (relation_arity:R->num)
     (function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A)
     (relation_interp_A:R->(num->A)->bool)
     (function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K)
     (relation_interp_K:R->(num->K)->bool)
     (embedding:A->K).
       (!x:A. embedding x IN carrier_K) /\
       (!x y:A. embedding x = embedding y ==> x = y) /\
       (!f:F. !arguments:num->A.
          f IN function_symbols
          ==> embedding (function_interp_A f arguments) =
              function_interp_K f
                (\i:num. embedding (arguments i))) /\
       (!r:R. !arguments:num->A.
          r IN relation_symbols
          ==> (relation_interp_A r arguments <=>
               relation_interp_K r
                 (\i:num. embedding (arguments i)))) /\
       (!formula_A:(num->A)->bool.
        !formula_K:(num->K)->bool.
          formula_pair_AK
            carrier_K
            function_symbols relation_symbols
            function_arity relation_arity
            function_interp_A relation_interp_A
            function_interp_K relation_interp_K
            formula_A formula_K
          ==> !assignment:num->A.
                (formula_A assignment <=>
                 formula_K
                   (\i:num. embedding (assignment i)))) in
  let elementary_KA =
    \(carrier_K:K->bool)
     (function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (relation_arity:R->num)
     (function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K)
     (relation_interp_K:R->(num->K)->bool)
     (function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A)
     (relation_interp_A:R->(num->A)->bool)
     (embedding:K->A).
       (!x y:K.
          x IN carrier_K /\ y IN carrier_K /\
          embedding x = embedding y
          ==> x = y) /\
       (!f:F. !arguments:num->K.
          f IN function_symbols /\
          (!i:num.
             i < function_arity f ==> arguments i IN carrier_K)
          ==> embedding (function_interp_K f arguments) =
              function_interp_A f
                (\i:num. embedding (arguments i))) /\
       (!r:R. !arguments:num->K.
          r IN relation_symbols /\
          (!i:num.
             i < relation_arity r ==> arguments i IN carrier_K)
          ==> (relation_interp_K r arguments <=>
               relation_interp_A r
                 (\i:num. embedding (arguments i)))) /\
       (!formula_K:(num->K)->bool.
        !formula_A:(num->A)->bool.
          formula_pair_KA
            carrier_K
            function_symbols relation_symbols
            function_arity relation_arity
            function_interp_K relation_interp_K
            function_interp_A relation_interp_A
            formula_K formula_A
          ==> !assignment:num->K.
                (!i:num. assignment i IN carrier_K)
                ==>
                (formula_K assignment <=>
                 formula_A
                   (\i:num. embedding (assignment i)))) in
  !function_symbols:F->bool.
  !relation_symbols:R->bool.
  !function_arity:F->num.
  !relation_arity:R->num.
  !function_interp_A:F->(num->A)->A.
  !relation_interp_A:R->(num->A)->bool.
    is_structure_A
      function_symbols relation_symbols
      function_arity relation_arity
      function_interp_A relation_interp_A /\
    (?enumerate:num->A.
       !m n:num. enumerate m = enumerate n ==> m = n) /\
    language_card_le_K function_symbols relation_symbols
    ==> ?carrier_K:K->bool.
        ?function_interp_K:F->(num->K)->K.
        ?relation_interp_K:R->(num->K)->bool.
          is_structure_K
            carrier_K
            function_symbols relation_symbols
            function_arity relation_arity
            function_interp_K relation_interp_K /\
          carrier_card_eq_K carrier_K /\
          ((?embedding:K->A.
              elementary_KA
                carrier_K
                function_symbols relation_symbols
                function_arity relation_arity
                function_interp_K relation_interp_K
                function_interp_A relation_interp_A
                embedding) \/
           (?embedding:A->K.
              elementary_AK
                carrier_K
                function_symbols relation_symbols
                function_arity relation_arity
                function_interp_A relation_interp_A
                function_interp_K relation_interp_K
                embedding))`;;
