title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1068283,
;; "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem": for an arbitrary first-order language, infinite
;; structure, and sufficiently large infinite cardinal, there is a structure
;; of that cardinality elementarily embedding in one direction. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tags index arbitrary, potentially infinite carriers, languages, structures,
;; assignments, and maps.  The predicates below do not enumerate carriers.
;; Instead, the statement gives the complete first-order syntax and Tarski
;; semantics, and keeps every cardinal, structure, map, and embedding witness
;; under unbounded DEFUN-SK quantification.

(defstub q1068283-function-symbol-p
  (language arity symbol)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-relation-symbol-p
  (language arity symbol)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-carrier-p
  (carrier element)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-function-value
  (language structure arity symbol arguments)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-relation-holds-p
  (language structure arity symbol arguments)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-term-value
  (language structure term assignment bound-values)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-satisfies-p
  (language structure formula assignment bound-values)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-map-value
  (map element)
  t)

(defstub q1068283-base-assignment-value
  (assignment index)
  t)

(defun q1068283-truth (value)
  (if value t nil))

;; Free-variable assignments can be transported through an internally
;; quantified map without introducing an external assignment witness.

(defun q1068283-mapped-assignment-form-p (assignment)
  (and
   (true-listp assignment)
   (equal (len assignment) 3)
   (equal (car assignment) 'q1068283-mapped-assignment)))

(defun q1068283-assignment-value (assignment index)
  (if (q1068283-mapped-assignment-form-p assignment)
      (q1068283-map-value
       (cadr assignment)
       (q1068283-assignment-value (caddr assignment) index))
    (q1068283-base-assignment-value assignment index)))

(defun q1068283-map-assignment (map assignment)
  (list 'q1068283-mapped-assignment map assignment))

;; Finite tuples and lists of bound-variable values.

(defun q1068283-carrier-list-p (carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1068283-carrier-p carrier (car values))
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1068283-map-list (map values)
  (if (consp values)
      (cons
       (q1068283-map-value map (car values))
       (q1068283-map-list map (cdr values)))
    nil))

;; A term is either (Q1068283-FREE n), (Q1068283-BOUND n), or
;; (Q1068283-FUNCTION arity symbol argument-list).  The work-list recognizer
;; checks all subterms without restricting their number or the carrier.

(defun q1068283-free-term-p (term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 2)
   (equal (car term) 'q1068283-free)
   (natp (cadr term))))

(defun q1068283-bound-term-p (depth term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 2)
   (equal (car term) 'q1068283-bound)
   (natp (cadr term))
   (< (cadr term) depth)))

(defun q1068283-function-term-shape-p (term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 4)
   (equal (car term) 'q1068283-function)
   (natp (cadr term))
   (true-listp (cadddr term))
   (equal (len (cadddr term)) (cadr term))))

(defun q1068283-all-terms-p (language depth pending fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (consp pending)
      (if (zp fuel)
          nil
        (let ((term (car pending)))
          (cond
           ((q1068283-free-term-p term)
            (q1068283-all-terms-p
             language depth (cdr pending) (- fuel 1)))
           ((q1068283-bound-term-p depth term)
            (q1068283-all-terms-p
             language depth (cdr pending) (- fuel 1)))
           ((and
             (q1068283-function-term-shape-p term)
             (q1068283-function-symbol-p
              language (cadr term) (caddr term)))
            (q1068283-all-terms-p
             language
             depth
             (append (cadddr term) (cdr pending))
             (- fuel 1)))
           (t nil))))
    (equal pending nil)))

(defun q1068283-term-p (language depth term)
  (and
   (natp depth)
   (q1068283-all-terms-p
    language depth (list term) (acl2-count term))))

(defun q1068283-term-list-p (language depth arity terms)
  (and
   (natp arity)
   (true-listp terms)
   (equal (len terms) arity)
   (q1068283-all-terms-p
    language depth terms (acl2-count terms))))

;; Mathlib's primitive bounded formulas are falsity, equality, relation
;; application, implication, and universal quantification.  These constructors
;; are represented directly; the natural number DEPTH counts bound variables.

(defun q1068283-formula-p (language depth formula)
  (and
   (natp depth)
   (cond
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 1)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1068283-falsum))
     t)
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1068283-equal))
     (and
      (q1068283-term-p language depth (cadr formula))
      (q1068283-term-p language depth (caddr formula))))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 4)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1068283-relation)
      (natp (cadr formula))
      (q1068283-relation-symbol-p
       language (cadr formula) (caddr formula)))
     (q1068283-term-list-p
      language depth (cadr formula) (cadddr formula)))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1068283-implies))
     (and
      (q1068283-formula-p language depth (cadr formula))
      (q1068283-formula-p language depth (caddr formula))))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 2)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1068283-forall))
     (q1068283-formula-p
      language (+ 1 depth) (cadr formula)))
    (t nil))))

(defun q1068283-term-values
    (language structure terms assignment bound-values)
  (if (consp terms)
      (cons
       (q1068283-term-value
        language structure (car terms) assignment bound-values)
       (q1068283-term-values
        language structure (cdr terms) assignment bound-values))
    nil))

(defun q1068283-holds-p
    (language structure formula assignment bound-values)
  (q1068283-truth
   (q1068283-satisfies-p
    language structure formula assignment bound-values)))

(defun-sk q1068283-assignment-valid-p (carrier assignment)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q1068283-carrier-p
      carrier
      (q1068283-assignment-value assignment index)))))

(defun-sk q1068283-all-elements-satisfy-p
    (language structure body assignment bound-values)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q1068283-carrier-p structure element)
     (q1068283-holds-p
      language
      structure
      body
      assignment
      (cons element bound-values)))))

;; A language structure has total interpretations of every function symbol.

(defun-sk q1068283-function-closure-p (language structure)
  (forall (arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1068283-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp arguments)
      (equal (len arguments) arity)
      (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure arguments))
     (q1068283-carrier-p
      structure
      (q1068283-function-value
       language structure arity symbol arguments)))))

;; The term-value interface is a definitional expansion of recursive term
;; evaluation.  The universally quantified equations characterize variables
;; and function applications exactly.

(defun-sk q1068283-term-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall
    (depth assignment bound-values term index arity symbol arguments)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (natp depth)
       (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (equal (len bound-values) depth)
       (q1068283-term-p language depth term))
      (q1068283-carrier-p
       structure
       (q1068283-term-value
        language structure term assignment bound-values)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp index))
      (equal
       (q1068283-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1068283-free index)
        assignment
        bound-values)
       (q1068283-assignment-value assignment index)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp index)
       (< index (len bound-values)))
      (equal
       (q1068283-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1068283-bound index)
        assignment
        bound-values)
       (nth index bound-values)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp arity)
       (q1068283-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
       (q1068283-term-list-p
        language (len bound-values) arity arguments))
      (equal
       (q1068283-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1068283-function arity symbol arguments)
        assignment
        bound-values)
       (q1068283-function-value
        language
        structure
        arity
        symbol
        (q1068283-term-values
         language structure arguments assignment bound-values)))))))

;; These are the exact Tarski clauses for the primitive formula constructors.

(defun-sk q1068283-falsum-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (assignment bound-values)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
      (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values))
     (not
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1068283-falsum)
       assignment
       bound-values)))))

(defun-sk q1068283-equality-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (assignment bound-values left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
      (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1068283-term-p language (len bound-values) left)
      (q1068283-term-p language (len bound-values) right))
     (equal
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1068283-equal left right)
       assignment
       bound-values)
      (equal
       (q1068283-term-value
        language structure left assignment bound-values)
       (q1068283-term-value
        language structure right assignment bound-values))))))

(defun-sk q1068283-relation-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (assignment bound-values arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
      (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (natp arity)
      (q1068283-relation-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (q1068283-term-list-p
       language (len bound-values) arity arguments))
     (equal
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1068283-relation arity symbol arguments)
       assignment
       bound-values)
      (q1068283-truth
       (q1068283-relation-holds-p
        language
        structure
        arity
        symbol
        (q1068283-term-values
         language structure arguments assignment bound-values)))))))

(defun-sk q1068283-implication-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (assignment bound-values left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
      (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1068283-formula-p
       language (len bound-values) left)
      (q1068283-formula-p
       language (len bound-values) right))
     (equal
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1068283-implies left right)
       assignment
       bound-values)
      (if
       (q1068283-holds-p
        language structure left assignment bound-values)
       (q1068283-holds-p
        language structure right assignment bound-values)
       t)))))

(defun-sk q1068283-universal-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (assignment bound-values body)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-assignment-valid-p structure assignment)
      (q1068283-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1068283-formula-p
       language (+ 1 (len bound-values)) body))
     (equal
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1068283-forall body)
       assignment
       bound-values)
      (q1068283-truth
       (q1068283-all-elements-satisfy-p
        language structure body assignment bound-values))))))

(defun q1068283-formula-semantics-p (language structure)
  (and
   (q1068283-falsum-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1068283-equality-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1068283-relation-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1068283-implication-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1068283-universal-semantics-p language structure)))

(defun q1068283-structure-p (language structure)
  (and
   (q1068283-function-closure-p language structure)
   (q1068283-term-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1068283-formula-semantics-p language structure)))

;; The cardinal represented by a carrier is infinite exactly when there is an
;; injection from the natural numbers.  This is classically equivalent to
;; Lean's Infinite typeclass and also represents aleph_0 <= kappa.

(defun-sk q1068283-nat-injection-laws-p (carrier map)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (implies
      (natp left)
      (q1068283-carrier-p
       carrier (q1068283-map-value map left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp left)
       (natp right)
       (equal
        (q1068283-map-value map left)
        (q1068283-map-value map right)))
      (equal left right)))))

(defun-sk q1068283-infinite-carrier-p (carrier)
  (exists (map)
    (q1068283-nat-injection-laws-p carrier map)))

;; A language symbol is the disjointly tagged sigma-type element consisting of
;; its kind, arity, and symbol.  This is exactly mathlib's Language.Symbols.

(defun q1068283-language-symbol-p (language object)
  (and
   (true-listp object)
   (equal (len object) 3)
   (natp (cadr object))
   (if (equal (car object) 'q1068283-function-symbol)
       (q1068283-function-symbol-p
        language (cadr object) (caddr object))
     (and
      (equal (car object) 'q1068283-relation-symbol)
      (q1068283-relation-symbol-p
       language (cadr object) (caddr object))))))

(defun-sk q1068283-language-injection-laws-p
    (language cardinal-carrier map)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1068283-language-symbol-p language left)
      (q1068283-carrier-p
       cardinal-carrier
       (q1068283-map-value map left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1068283-language-symbol-p language left)
       (q1068283-language-symbol-p language right)
       (equal
        (q1068283-map-value map left)
        (q1068283-map-value map right)))
      (equal left right)))))

(defun-sk q1068283-language-card-le-p
    (language cardinal-carrier)
  (exists (map)
    (q1068283-language-injection-laws-p
     language cardinal-carrier map)))

;; Cardinal equality is represented by mutually inverse total maps.

(defun-sk q1068283-bijection-laws-p
    (source target forward inverse)
  (forall (source-element target-element)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1068283-carrier-p source source-element)
      (and
       (q1068283-carrier-p
        target
        (q1068283-map-value forward source-element))
       (equal
        (q1068283-map-value
         inverse
         (q1068283-map-value forward source-element))
        source-element)))
     (implies
      (q1068283-carrier-p target target-element)
      (and
       (q1068283-carrier-p
        source
        (q1068283-map-value inverse target-element))
       (equal
        (q1068283-map-value
         forward
         (q1068283-map-value inverse target-element))
        target-element))))))

(defun-sk q1068283-bijection-exists-p (source target)
  (exists (forward inverse)
    (q1068283-bijection-laws-p
     source target forward inverse)))

;; Elementary embeddings are injective structure maps preserving realization
;; of every formula with finitely many free variables.  Free variables are
;; natural-number coded; every individual formula uses only finitely many.

(defun-sk q1068283-embedding-map-laws-p
    (language source target map)
  (forall (left right arity symbol arguments)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1068283-carrier-p source left)
      (q1068283-carrier-p
       target (q1068283-map-value map left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1068283-carrier-p source left)
       (q1068283-carrier-p source right)
       (equal
        (q1068283-map-value map left)
        (q1068283-map-value map right)))
      (equal left right))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp arity)
       (q1068283-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
       (true-listp arguments)
       (equal (len arguments) arity)
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p source arguments))
      (equal
       (q1068283-map-value
        map
        (q1068283-function-value
         language source arity symbol arguments))
       (q1068283-function-value
        language
        target
        arity
        symbol
        (q1068283-map-list map arguments))))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp arity)
       (q1068283-relation-symbol-p language arity symbol)
       (true-listp arguments)
       (equal (len arguments) arity)
       (q1068283-carrier-list-p source arguments))
      (equal
       (q1068283-truth
        (q1068283-relation-holds-p
         language source arity symbol arguments))
       (q1068283-truth
        (q1068283-relation-holds-p
         language
         target
         arity
         symbol
         (q1068283-map-list map arguments))))))))

(defun-sk q1068283-elementary-formula-laws-p
    (language source target map)
  (forall (formula assignment)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-formula-p language 0 formula)
      (q1068283-assignment-valid-p source assignment))
     (equal
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language
       target
       formula
       (q1068283-map-assignment map assignment)
       nil)
      (q1068283-holds-p
       language source formula assignment nil)))))

(defun q1068283-elementary-embedding-p
    (language source target map)
  (and
   (q1068283-embedding-map-laws-p
    language source target map)
   (q1068283-elementary-formula-laws-p
    language source target map)))

(defun-sk q1068283-elementary-embedding-exists-p
    (language source target)
  (exists (map)
    (q1068283-elementary-embedding-p
     language source target map)))

(defun-sk q1068283-lowenheim-skolem-conclusion-p
    (language original cardinal-carrier)
  (exists (new-structure)
    (and
     (q1068283-structure-p language new-structure)
     (q1068283-bijection-exists-p
      new-structure cardinal-carrier)
     (or
      (q1068283-elementary-embedding-exists-p
       language new-structure original)
      (q1068283-elementary-embedding-exists-p
       language original new-structure)))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1068283-lowenheim-skolem-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (language original cardinal-carrier)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1068283-structure-p language original)
      (q1068283-infinite-carrier-p original)
      (q1068283-infinite-carrier-p cardinal-carrier)
      (q1068283-language-card-le-p
       language cardinal-carrier))
     (q1068283-lowenheim-skolem-conclusion-p
      language original cardinal-carrier))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1068283
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1068283), "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem": an infinite
-- first-order structure has, at every sufficiently large cardinal, an
-- elementarily comparable structure of that cardinality. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 4 _⊎_
infixr 3 _×_
infix  2 _↔_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top : Set where
  constructor truth

data _⊎_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → A ⊎ B
  right : B → A ⊎ B

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  zero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  next : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Language (u v : Level) : Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v)) where
  field
    FunctionSymbol : Nat → Set u
    RelationSymbol : Nat → Set v

open Language

LanguageSymbol :
  {u v : Level} →
  Language u v →
  Set (u ⊔ v)
LanguageSymbol language =
  Σ Nat
    (λ arity →
      FunctionSymbol language arity
      ⊎ RelationSymbol language arity)

record Structure
  {u v a : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (u ⊔ v ⊔ lsuc a) where

  field
    functionMeaning :
      (arity : Nat) →
      FunctionSymbol language arity →
      (Fin arity → A) →
      A

    relationMeaning :
      (arity : Nat) →
      RelationSymbol language arity →
      (Fin arity → A) →
      Set a

open Structure

data Term
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (freeVariables : Nat) :
  Set (u ⊔ v) where

  variableTerm :
    Fin freeVariables →
    Term language freeVariables

  applyFunction :
    (arity : Nat) →
    FunctionSymbol language arity →
    (Fin arity → Term language freeVariables) →
    Term language freeVariables

data Formula
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (freeVariables : Nat) :
  Set (u ⊔ v) where

  equal :
    Term language freeVariables →
    Term language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables

  relation :
    (arity : Nat) →
    RelationSymbol language arity →
    (Fin arity → Term language freeVariables) →
    Formula language freeVariables

  falsehood :
    Formula language freeVariables

  implies :
    Formula language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables

  all :
    Formula language (suc freeVariables) →
    Formula language freeVariables

interpretTerm :
  {u v a : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Structure language A →
  Term language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → A) →
  A
interpretTerm structure (variableTerm index) assignment =
  assignment index
interpretTerm structure (applyFunction arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  functionMeaning structure arity symbol
    (λ index → interpretTerm structure (arguments index) assignment)

extend :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → A) →
  A →
  Fin (suc n) →
  A
extend assignment value zero =
  value
extend assignment value (next index) =
  assignment index

Realize :
  {u v a : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Structure language A →
  Formula language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → A) →
  Set a
Realize structure (equal leftTerm rightTerm) assignment =
  interpretTerm structure leftTerm assignment
  ≡ interpretTerm structure rightTerm assignment
Realize structure (relation arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  relationMeaning structure arity symbol
    (λ index → interpretTerm structure (arguments index) assignment)
Realize structure falsehood assignment =
  Bottom
Realize structure (implies premise conclusion) assignment =
  Realize structure premise assignment →
  Realize structure conclusion assignment
Realize {A = A} structure (all body) assignment =
  (value : A) →
  Realize structure body (extend assignment value)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) →
  function x ≡ function y →
  x ≡ y

record Injection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map       : A → B
    injective : Injective map

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

Infinite :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Infinite A =
  Injection Nat A

record ElementaryEmbedding
  {u v a b : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b}
  (source : Structure language A)
  (target : Structure language B) :
  Set (u ⊔ v ⊔ a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map        : A → B
    injective  : Injective map
    elementary :
      (freeVariables : Nat) →
      (formula : Formula language freeVariables) →
      (assignment : Fin freeVariables → A) →
      Realize source formula assignment
      ↔
      Realize target formula (λ index → map (assignment index))

lowenheim-skolem-theorem :
  {u v k m : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v ⊔ k ⊔ m))
lowenheim-skolem-theorem {u} {v} {k} {m} =
  (language : Language u v) →
  (M : Set m) →
  (structureM : Structure language M) →
  Infinite M →
  (K : Set k) →
  Injection Nat K →
  Injection (LanguageSymbol language) K →
  Σ (Set k)
    (λ N →
      Σ (Structure language N)
        (λ structureN →
          (ElementaryEmbedding language structureN structureM
           ⊎ ElementaryEmbedding language structureM structureN)
          × Bijection N K))

title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1068283 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1068283), "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem":
  for an infinite first-order structure and an infinite cardinal at least as
  large as its language, there is a structure of that cardinality elementarily
  embedding into, or admitting an elementary embedding from, the original
  structure. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open cardinalTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

Datatype:
  q1068283_term =
    Q1068283Var num
  | Q1068283Fun 'f (q1068283_term list)
End

Datatype:
  q1068283_formula =
    Q1068283False
  | Q1068283Equal ('f q1068283_term) ('f q1068283_term)
  | Q1068283Rel 'r (('f q1068283_term) list)
  | Q1068283Imp q1068283_formula q1068283_formula
  | Q1068283Forall q1068283_formula
End

val q1068283_term_wf_def = Define`
  (q1068283_term_wf FS f_arity (Q1068283Var n) <=> T) /\
  (q1068283_term_wf FS f_arity (Q1068283Fun f ts) <=>
     f IN FS /\
     LENGTH ts = f_arity f /\
     EVERY (q1068283_term_wf FS f_arity) ts)`;

val q1068283_formula_wf_def = Define`
  (q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity Q1068283False <=> T) /\
  (q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1068283Equal s t) <=>
     q1068283_term_wf FS f_arity s /\
     q1068283_term_wf FS f_arity t) /\
  (q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1068283Rel r ts) <=>
     r IN RS /\
     LENGTH ts = r_arity r /\
     EVERY (q1068283_term_wf FS f_arity) ts) /\
  (q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1068283Imp p q) <=>
     q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p /\
     q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity q) /\
  (q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1068283Forall p) <=>
     q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p)`;

val q1068283_term_value_def = Define`
  (q1068283_term_value fnI v (Q1068283Var n) = v n) /\
  (q1068283_term_value fnI v (Q1068283Fun f ts) =
     fnI f (MAP (q1068283_term_value fnI v) ts))`;

val q1068283_satisfies_def = Define`
  (q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v Q1068283False <=> F) /\
  (q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1068283Equal s t) <=>
     q1068283_term_value fnI v s = q1068283_term_value fnI v t) /\
  (q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1068283Rel r ts) <=>
     relI r (MAP (q1068283_term_value fnI v) ts)) /\
  (q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1068283Imp p q) <=>
     (q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v p ==>
      q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v q)) /\
  (q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1068283Forall p) <=>
     !x.
       x IN carrier
       ==>
       q1068283_satisfies carrier fnI relI
         (\n. if n = 0 then x else v (PRE n)) p)`;

val q1068283_structure_def = new_definition(
  "q1068283_structure_def",
  ``q1068283_structure FS f_arity carrier fnI <=>
      !f xs.
        f IN FS /\
        LENGTH xs = f_arity f /\
        EVERY (\x. x IN carrier) xs
        ==>
        fnI f xs IN carrier``);

val q1068283_elementary_embedding_def = new_definition(
  "q1068283_elementary_embedding_def",
  ``q1068283_elementary_embedding
      FS RS f_arity r_arity carrierA FA RA carrierB FB RB e <=>
      INJ e carrierA carrierB /\
      !p v.
        q1068283_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p /\
        (!n. v n IN carrierA)
        ==>
        (q1068283_satisfies carrierA FA RA v p <=>
         q1068283_satisfies carrierB FB RB (\n. e (v n)) p)``);

val lowenheim_skolem_theorem =
  ``!(FS : 'f set) (RS : 'r set)
      (f_arity : 'f -> num) (r_arity : 'r -> num)
      (MF : 'f -> 'm list -> 'm) (MR : 'r -> 'm list -> bool)
      (K : 'k set).
      INFINITE (UNIV : 'm set) /\
      (UNIV : num set) <<= K /\
      (IMAGE INL FS UNION IMAGE INR RS) <<= K
      ==>
      ?N : ('m + 'k) set.
      ?NF : 'f -> ('m + 'k) list -> ('m + 'k).
      ?NR : 'r -> ('m + 'k) list -> bool.
        q1068283_structure FS f_arity N NF /\
        N =~ K /\
        ((?e : ('m + 'k) -> 'm.
            q1068283_elementary_embedding
              FS RS f_arity r_arity N NF NR
              (UNIV : 'm set) MF MR e) \/
         (?e : 'm -> ('m + 'k).
            q1068283_elementary_embedding
              FS RS f_arity r_arity (UNIV : 'm set) MF MR
              N NF NR e))``;

title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1068283
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1068283),
  "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem": for an
  arbitrary first-order language, infinite structure, and infinite cardinal
  at least the size of the language, there is a structure of that cardinality
  with an elementary embedding in one direction between the two structures.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A language L is encoded by a pair of arity-indexed families of function and
  relation symbols. Q1068283FunKeys L and Q1068283RelKeys L are their dependent
  sums over NN0, and Q1068283Symbols L is their tagged disjoint union. Thus its
  cardinality is exactly Mathlib's Language.card.

  A structure is a nonempty carrier together with total interpretations of
  every function symbol and relation symbol. Terms and formulas use standard
  finite tagged-tree codes and are defined as the least sets closed under the
  variable, application, atomic, false, implication, and universal-quantifier
  constructors. Q1068283Eval and Q1068283Sat give the corresponding
  compositional Tarski semantics.

  Q1068283ElemEmb L M N H says that H is injective from the carrier of M to
  the carrier of N and preserves truth of every formula under every variable
  assignment. This is equivalent to an elementary embedding; preservation of
  atomic formulas also forces preservation of all interpreted functions and
  relations.

  The cardinal K is represented by its initial ordinal, expressed by
  ( card ` K ) = K. The relations _om ~<_ K and Q1068283Symbols L ~<_ K encode
  aleph_0 <= K and L.card <= K. The final declaration is the single unproved
  corpus $a statement. All preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful
  definitions, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1068283Language Q1068283FunKeys Q1068283RelKeys Q1068283Symbols $.
$c Q1068283Terms Q1068283Formulas Q1068283Structure $.
$c Q1068283Eval Q1068283Sat Q1068283ElemEmb $.

q1068283-language-syntax $a wff ( Q1068283Language L ) $.
q1068283-fun-keys-syntax $a class ( Q1068283FunKeys L ) $.
q1068283-rel-keys-syntax $a class ( Q1068283RelKeys L ) $.
q1068283-symbols-syntax $a class ( Q1068283Symbols L ) $.
q1068283-terms-syntax $a class ( Q1068283Terms L ) $.
q1068283-formulas-syntax $a class ( Q1068283Formulas L ) $.
q1068283-structure-syntax $a wff ( Q1068283Structure L M ) $.
q1068283-eval-syntax $a wff ( Q1068283Eval L M E ) $.
q1068283-sat-syntax $a wff ( Q1068283Sat L M E S ) $.
q1068283-elementary-embedding-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1068283ElemEmb L M N H ) $.

${
  $d F L R $.

  q1068283-language-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1068283Language L )
    <->
    E. F E. R
      (
        L = <. F , R >.
        /\
        (
          F Fn NN0
          /\
          R Fn NN0
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d L n $.

  q1068283-fun-keys-definition $a |- (
    Q1068283FunKeys L
    =
    U_ n e. NN0
      ( { n } X. ( ( 1st ` L ) ` n ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d L n $.

  q1068283-rel-keys-definition $a |- (
    Q1068283RelKeys L
    =
    U_ n e. NN0
      ( { n } X. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` n ) )
  ) $.
$}

q1068283-symbols-definition $a |- (
  Q1068283Symbols L
  =
  ( Q1068283FunKeys L |_| Q1068283RelKeys L )
) $.

${
  $d A C L f i n $.

  q1068283-terms-definition $a |- (
    Q1068283Terms L
    =
    |^| { C |
      (
        A. i e. NN0
          <. 0 , i >. e. C
        /\
        A. n e. NN0
          A. f e. ( ( 1st ` L ) ` n )
            A. A e. ( C ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
              <. 1 , <. n , <. f , A >. >. >. e. C
      )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A C L i n p q r s t $.

  q1068283-formulas-definition $a |- (
    Q1068283Formulas L
    =
    |^| { C |
      (
        A. n e. NN0
          A. r e. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` n )
            A. A e. ( ( Q1068283Terms L ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
              <. 0 , <. n , <. r , A >. >. >. e. C
        /\
        (
          A. s e. ( Q1068283Terms L )
            A. t e. ( Q1068283Terms L )
              <. 1 , <. s , t >. >. e. C
          /\
          (
            <. 2 , 0 >. e. C
            /\
            (
              A. p e. C A. q e. C
                <. 3 , <. p , q >. >. e. C
              /\
              A. i e. NN0 A. p e. C
                <. 4 , <. i , p >. >. e. C
            )
          )
        )
      )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F L M R X f n r $.

  q1068283-structure-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1068283Structure L M )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1068283Language L )
      /\
      E. X E. F E. R
        (
          M = <. X , <. F , R >. >.
          /\
          (
            X =/= ( / )
            /\
            (
              F Fn ( Q1068283FunKeys L )
              /\
              (
                R Fn ( Q1068283RelKeys L )
                /\
                (
                  A. n e. NN0
                    A. f e. ( ( 1st ` L ) ` n )
                      ( F ` <. n , f >. )
                        : ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) ) --> X
                  /\
                  A. n e. NN0
                    A. r e. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` n )
                      ( R ` <. n , r >. )
                        C_ ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E L M V f i j n $.

  q1068283-eval-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1068283Eval L M E )
    <->
    (
      E :
        (
          ( ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 ) X. ( Q1068283Terms L ) )
        )
        --> ( 1st ` M )
      /\
      (
        A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          A. i e. NN0
            ( E ` <. V , <. 0 , i >. >. ) = ( V ` i )
        /\
        A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          A. n e. NN0
            A. f e. ( ( 1st ` L ) ` n )
              A. A e. ( ( Q1068283Terms L ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
                (
                  E `
                    <. V , <. 1 , <. n , <. f , A >. >. >. >.
                )
                =
                (
                  (
                    ( 1st ` ( 2nd ` M ) )
                    ` <. n , f >.
                  )
                  `
                  (
                    j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    |->
                    ( E ` <. V , ( A ` j ) >. )
                  )
                )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E L M S V i j n p q r s t x $.

  q1068283-sat-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1068283Sat L M E S )
    <->
    (
      S C_
        (
          ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          X.
          ( Q1068283Formulas L )
        )
      /\
      (
        A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          A. n e. NN0
            A. r e. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` n )
              A. A e. ( ( Q1068283Terms L ) ^m ( 0 ..^ n ) )
                (
                  <.
                    V ,
                    <. 0 , <. n , <. r , A >. >. >.
                  >. e. S
                  <->
                  (
                    j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
                    |->
                    ( E ` <. V , ( A ` j ) >. )
                  )
                  e.
                  (
                    ( 2nd ` ( 2nd ` M ) )
                    ` <. n , r >.
                  )
                )
        /\
        (
          A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
            A. s e. ( Q1068283Terms L )
              A. t e. ( Q1068283Terms L )
                (
                  <. V , <. 1 , <. s , t >. >. >. e. S
                  <->
                  ( E ` <. V , s >. ) = ( E ` <. V , t >. )
                )
          /\
          (
            A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
              -. <. V , <. 2 , 0 >. >. e. S
            /\
            (
              A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
                A. p e. ( Q1068283Formulas L )
                  A. q e. ( Q1068283Formulas L )
                    (
                      <. V , <. 3 , <. p , q >. >. >. e. S
                      <->
                      (
                        <. V , p >. e. S
                        ->
                        <. V , q >. e. S
                      )
                    )
              /\
              A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
                A. i e. NN0
                  A. p e. ( Q1068283Formulas L )
                    (
                      <. V , <. 4 , <. i , p >. >. >. e. S
                      <->
                      A. x e. ( 1st ` M )
                        <.
                          (
                            j e. NN0
                            |->
                            if ( j = i , x , ( V ` j ) )
                          ) ,
                          p
                        >. e. S
                    )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F H L M N S T V p $.

  q1068283-elementary-embedding-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1068283ElemEmb L M N H )
    <->
    (
      (
        ( Q1068283Structure L M )
        /\
        ( Q1068283Structure L N )
      )
      /\
      (
        H : ( 1st ` M ) -1-1-> ( 1st ` N )
        /\
        E. E E. S E. F E. T
          (
            (
              ( Q1068283Eval L M E )
              /\
              ( Q1068283Sat L M E S )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( Q1068283Eval L N F )
                /\
                ( Q1068283Sat L N F T )
              )
              /\
              A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
                A. p e. ( Q1068283Formulas L )
                  (
                    <. V , p >. e. S
                    <->
                    <. ( H o. V ) , p >. e. T
                  )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H K L M N $.

  thousand-theorems-q1068283-lowenheim-skolem $a |- (
    A. L A. M A. K
      (
        (
          (
            ( Q1068283Language L )
            /\
            ( Q1068283Structure L M )
          )
          /\
          (
            _om ~<_ ( 1st ` M )
            /\
            (
              (
                ( card ` K ) = K
                /\
                _om ~<_ K
              )
              /\
              ( Q1068283Symbols L ) ~<_ K
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        E. N
          (
            ( Q1068283Structure L N )
            /\
            (
              (
                E. H ( Q1068283ElemEmb L N M H )
                \/
                E. H ( Q1068283ElemEmb L M N H )
              )
              /\
              ( card ` ( 1st ` N ) ) = K
            )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

 equalities XBOOLE_0, FUNCOP_1, EQREL_1, XBOOLEAN, FOMODEL0, FOMODEL1,
      FOMODEL2, ORDINAL1;
 expansions XBOOLE_0, RELAT_2, FOMODEL1, FOMODEL2;
 theorems TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, FINSEQ_1, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_1, ZFMISC_1,
      FUNCT_2, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, EQREL_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_2, XREAL_1,
      FUNCT_4, FUNCOP_1, FUNCT_5, RELAT_2, RELSET_1, RELSET_2, GRFUNC_1,
      ORDERS_1, CARD_1, XTUPLE_0, FINSET_1, FOMODEL0, FOMODEL1, FOMODEL2,
      PRE_POLY;
 schemes NAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FRAENKEL, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for S being Language,
      U being infinite non empty set,
      I being Element of U-InterpretersOf S,
      K being Cardinal st
    omega c= K &
    card (OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) c= K
  holds
    ex V being non empty set,
       J being Element of V-InterpretersOf S st
      card V = K &
      ((ex f being Function of V,U st
          f is one-to-one &
          for J1 being Element of V-InterpretersOf S st
            J1|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) =
              J|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S)
          holds
            ex I1 being Element of U-InterpretersOf S st
              I1|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) =
                I|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) &
              (for l being literal Element of S holds
                I1.l.{} = f.(J1.l.{})) &
              (for phi being wff string of S holds
                J1-TruthEval phi = I1-TruthEval phi))
       or
       (ex f being Function of U,V st
          f is one-to-one &
          for I1 being Element of U-InterpretersOf S st
            I1|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) =
              I|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S)
          holds
            ex J1 being Element of V-InterpretersOf S st
              J1|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) =
                J|(OwnSymbolsOf S \ LettersOf S) &
              (for l being literal Element of S holds
                J1.l.{} = f.(I1.l.{})) &
              (for phi being wff string of S holds
                I1-TruthEval phi = J1-TruthEval phi)))
proof
end;
