title: Q1068283_l_wenheim_skolem_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1068283,
% "Löwenheim–Skolem theorem": an infinite first-order structure has, at every
% infinite cardinal at least the language cardinality, an elementarily embedded
% structure of that cardinality in one direction or the other. This file contains no proof.

first_order_syntax_Q1068283[Symbol: TYPE]: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  variable_node(variable_index: nat): variable_node?
  application_node(
      application_symbol: Symbol,
      application_arguments: first_order_syntax_Q1068283): application_node?
  argument_nil: argument_nil?
  argument_cons(
      argument_head: first_order_syntax_Q1068283,
      argument_tail: first_order_syntax_Q1068283): argument_cons?
  equality_node(
      equality_left: first_order_syntax_Q1068283,
      equality_right: first_order_syntax_Q1068283): equality_node?
  relation_node(
      relation_symbol: Symbol,
      relation_arguments: first_order_syntax_Q1068283): relation_node?
  false_node: false_node?
  implication_node(
      implication_left: first_order_syntax_Q1068283,
      implication_right: first_order_syntax_Q1068283): implication_node?
  universal_node(
      universal_body: first_order_syntax_Q1068283): universal_node?
END first_order_syntax_Q1068283

lowenheim_skolem_theorem_Q1068283[
  Symbol: TYPE,
  M: TYPE+,
  K: TYPE+,
  symbol_is_function: [Symbol -> bool],
  symbol_arity: [Symbol -> nat],
  m_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> M] -> M],
  m_relation_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> M] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING first_order_syntax_Q1068283[Symbol]

  syntax: TYPE = first_order_syntax_Q1068283[Symbol]

  argument_length(node: syntax): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index): 0,
      application_node(symbol, arguments): 0,
      argument_nil: 0,
      argument_cons(head, tail): 1 + argument_length(tail),
      equality_node(left, right): 0,
      relation_node(symbol, arguments): 0,
      false_node: 0,
      implication_node(left, right): 0,
      universal_node(body): 0
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  % Kinds 0, 1, and 2 respectively denote terms, argument lists, and formulas.
  % The depth parameter gives the number of enclosing de Bruijn binders.
  well_formed(node: syntax, kind: nat, depth: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index):
        kind = 0 AND index < depth,
      application_node(symbol, arguments):
        kind = 0
          AND symbol_is_function(symbol)
          AND argument_length(arguments) = symbol_arity(symbol)
          AND well_formed(arguments, 1, depth),
      argument_nil:
        kind = 1,
      argument_cons(head, tail):
        kind = 1
          AND well_formed(head, 0, depth)
          AND well_formed(tail, 1, depth),
      equality_node(left, right):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(left, 0, depth)
          AND well_formed(right, 0, depth),
      relation_node(symbol, arguments):
        kind = 2
          AND NOT symbol_is_function(symbol)
          AND argument_length(arguments) = symbol_arity(symbol)
          AND well_formed(arguments, 1, depth),
      false_node:
        kind = 2,
      implication_node(left, right):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(left, 2, depth)
          AND well_formed(right, 2, depth),
      universal_node(body):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(body, 2, depth + 1)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  syntax_size(node: syntax): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index): 1,
      application_node(symbol, arguments):
        1 + syntax_size(arguments),
      argument_nil: 1,
      argument_cons(head, tail):
        1 + syntax_size(head) + syntax_size(tail),
      equality_node(left, right):
        1 + syntax_size(left) + syntax_size(right),
      relation_node(symbol, arguments):
        1 + syntax_size(arguments),
      false_node: 1,
      implication_node(left, right):
        1 + syntax_size(left) + syntax_size(right),
      universal_node(body):
        1 + syntax_size(body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  canonical_tuple_m(
      values: [nat -> M],
      arity: nat,
      fallback: M): [nat -> M] =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      IF index < arity THEN values(index) ELSE fallback ENDIF

  m_function_interpretation_respects_arity: bool =
    FORALL
        (symbol: Symbol),
        (left_values, right_values: [nat -> M]):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < symbol_arity(symbol) IMPLIES
          left_values(index) = right_values(index))
      IMPLIES
        m_function_interpretation(symbol, left_values)
          = m_function_interpretation(symbol, right_values)

  m_relation_interpretation_respects_arity: bool =
    FORALL
        (symbol: Symbol),
        (left_values, right_values: [nat -> M]):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < symbol_arity(symbol) IMPLIES
          left_values(index) = right_values(index))
      IMPLIES
        (m_relation_interpretation(symbol, left_values)
          IFF m_relation_interpretation(symbol, right_values))

  evaluate_m_fuel(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> M],
      fuel: nat,
      position: nat): RECURSIVE M =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      assignment(0)
    ELSE
      CASES node OF
        variable_node(index):
          assignment(index),
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          m_function_interpretation(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple_m(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_m_fuel(
                  arguments, assignment, fuel - 1, index),
              symbol_arity(symbol),
              assignment(0))),
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          IF position = 0 THEN
            evaluate_m_fuel(head, assignment, fuel - 1, 0)
          ELSE
            evaluate_m_fuel(
              tail, assignment, fuel - 1, position - 1)
          ENDIF,
        argument_nil: assignment(0),
        equality_node(left, right): assignment(0),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments): assignment(0),
        false_node: assignment(0),
        implication_node(left, right): assignment(0),
        universal_node(body): assignment(0)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  evaluate_m(node: syntax, assignment: [nat -> M]): M =
    evaluate_m_fuel(node, assignment, syntax_size(node) + 1, 0)

  holds_m_fuel(
      phi: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> M],
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      CASES phi OF
        equality_node(left, right):
          evaluate_m(left, assignment) = evaluate_m(right, assignment),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          m_relation_interpretation(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple_m(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_m_fuel(
                  arguments, assignment, syntax_size(arguments) + 1, index),
              symbol_arity(symbol),
              assignment(0))),
        false_node:
          FALSE,
        implication_node(left, right):
          holds_m_fuel(left, assignment, fuel - 1)
            IMPLIES holds_m_fuel(right, assignment, fuel - 1),
        universal_node(body):
          FORALL (value: M):
            holds_m_fuel(
              body,
              LAMBDA (other_index: nat):
                IF other_index = 0 THEN
                  value
                ELSE
                  assignment(other_index - 1)
                ENDIF,
              fuel - 1),
        variable_node(index): FALSE,
        application_node(symbol, arguments): FALSE,
        argument_nil: FALSE,
        argument_cons(head, tail): FALSE
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  holds_m(phi: syntax, assignment: [nat -> M]): bool =
    holds_m_fuel(
      phi, assignment, syntax_size(phi) + 1)

  injective_nat_m(map: [nat -> M]): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: nat):
      map(left) = map(right) IMPLIES left = right

  injective_nat_k(map: [nat -> K]): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: nat):
      map(left) = map(right) IMPLIES left = right

  injective_symbol_k(map: [Symbol -> K]): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: Symbol):
      map(left) = map(right) IMPLIES left = right

  source_is_infinite: bool =
    EXISTS (map: [nat -> M]): injective_nat_m(map)

  kappa_is_infinite: bool =
    EXISTS (map: [nat -> K]): injective_nat_k(map)

  language_cardinality_at_most_kappa: bool =
    EXISTS (map: [Symbol -> K]): injective_symbol_k(map)

  canonical_tuple_k(
      values: [nat -> K],
      arity: nat,
      fallback: K): [nat -> K] =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      IF index < arity THEN values(index) ELSE fallback ENDIF

  k_function_interpretation_respects_arity(
      k_function_interpretation:
        [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K]): bool =
    FORALL
        (symbol: Symbol),
        (left_values, right_values: [nat -> K]):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < symbol_arity(symbol) IMPLIES
          left_values(index) = right_values(index))
      IMPLIES
        k_function_interpretation(symbol, left_values)
          = k_function_interpretation(symbol, right_values)

  k_relation_interpretation_respects_arity(
      k_relation_interpretation:
        [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL
        (symbol: Symbol),
        (left_values, right_values: [nat -> K]):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < symbol_arity(symbol) IMPLIES
          left_values(index) = right_values(index))
      IMPLIES
        (k_relation_interpretation(symbol, left_values)
          IFF k_relation_interpretation(symbol, right_values))

  evaluate_k_fuel(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> K],
      k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K],
      fuel: nat,
      position: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      assignment(0)
    ELSE
      CASES node OF
        variable_node(index):
          assignment(index),
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          k_function_interpretation(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple_k(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_k_fuel(
                  arguments,
                  assignment,
                  k_function_interpretation,
                  fuel - 1,
                  index),
              symbol_arity(symbol),
              assignment(0))),
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          IF position = 0 THEN
            evaluate_k_fuel(
              head,
              assignment,
              k_function_interpretation,
              fuel - 1,
              0)
          ELSE
            evaluate_k_fuel(
              tail,
              assignment,
              k_function_interpretation,
              fuel - 1,
              position - 1)
          ENDIF,
        argument_nil: assignment(0),
        equality_node(left, right): assignment(0),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments): assignment(0),
        false_node: assignment(0),
        implication_node(left, right): assignment(0),
        universal_node(body): assignment(0)
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  evaluate_k(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> K],
      k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K]): K =
    evaluate_k_fuel(
      node,
      assignment,
      k_function_interpretation,
      syntax_size(node) + 1,
      0)

  holds_k_fuel(
      phi: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> K],
      k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K],
      k_relation_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> bool],
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      CASES phi OF
        equality_node(left, right):
          evaluate_k(
            left, assignment, k_function_interpretation)
            =
          evaluate_k(
            right, assignment, k_function_interpretation),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          k_relation_interpretation(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple_k(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_k_fuel(
                  arguments,
                  assignment,
                  k_function_interpretation,
                  syntax_size(arguments) + 1,
                  index),
              symbol_arity(symbol),
              assignment(0))),
        false_node:
          FALSE,
        implication_node(left, right):
          holds_k_fuel(
            left,
            assignment,
            k_function_interpretation,
            k_relation_interpretation,
            fuel - 1)
            IMPLIES
          holds_k_fuel(
            right,
            assignment,
            k_function_interpretation,
            k_relation_interpretation,
            fuel - 1),
        universal_node(body):
          FORALL (value: K):
            holds_k_fuel(
              body,
              LAMBDA (other_index: nat):
                IF other_index = 0 THEN
                  value
                ELSE
                  assignment(other_index - 1)
                ENDIF,
              k_function_interpretation,
              k_relation_interpretation,
              fuel - 1),
        variable_node(index): FALSE,
        application_node(symbol, arguments): FALSE,
        argument_nil: FALSE,
        argument_cons(head, tail): FALSE
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  holds_k(
      phi: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> K],
      k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K],
      k_relation_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> bool]): bool =
    holds_k_fuel(
      phi,
      assignment,
      k_function_interpretation,
      k_relation_interpretation,
      syntax_size(phi) + 1)

  elementary_embedding_m_to_k(
      embedding: [M -> K],
      k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K],
      k_relation_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (left, right: M):
      embedding(left) = embedding(right) IMPLIES left = right)
      AND
    (FORALL (phi: syntax), (depth: nat), (assignment: [nat -> M]):
      well_formed(phi, 2, depth)
        IMPLIES
          (holds_m(phi, assignment)
            IFF
           holds_k(
             phi,
             LAMBDA (index: nat): embedding(assignment(index)),
             k_function_interpretation,
             k_relation_interpretation)))

  elementary_embedding_k_to_m(
      embedding: [K -> M],
      k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K],
      k_relation_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (left, right: K):
      embedding(left) = embedding(right) IMPLIES left = right)
      AND
    (FORALL (phi: syntax), (depth: nat), (assignment: [nat -> K]):
      well_formed(phi, 2, depth)
        IMPLIES
          (holds_k(
             phi,
             assignment,
             k_function_interpretation,
             k_relation_interpretation)
            IFF
           holds_m(
             phi,
             LAMBDA (index: nat): embedding(assignment(index)))))

  lowenheim_skolem_theorem: bool =
    (source_is_infinite
      AND kappa_is_infinite
      AND language_cardinality_at_most_kappa
      AND m_function_interpretation_respects_arity
      AND m_relation_interpretation_respects_arity)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS
        (k_function_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> K]),
        (k_relation_interpretation: [Symbol, [nat -> K] -> bool]):
          k_function_interpretation_respects_arity(
            k_function_interpretation)
          AND k_relation_interpretation_respects_arity(
            k_relation_interpretation)
          AND (
          (EXISTS (embedding: [K -> M]):
            elementary_embedding_k_to_m(
              embedding,
              k_function_interpretation,
              k_relation_interpretation))
          OR
          (EXISTS (embedding: [M -> K]):
            elementary_embedding_m_to_k(
              embedding,
              k_function_interpretation,
              k_relation_interpretation)))
END lowenheim_skolem_theorem_Q1068283

title: Q1068976_hilbert_s_nullstellensatz
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1068976
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1068976), "Hilbert's Nullstellensatz": for
-- polynomials over a field, evaluated in an algebraically closed extension,
-- the ideal vanishing on an ideal's zero locus is its radical. This file
-- contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Nullstellensatz

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Q1068976

variable {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
variable {σ : Type*} [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ]

/-- Hilbert's Nullstellensatz for multivariate polynomial ideals over a field. -/
theorem hilbert_nullstellensatz_statement (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal k (MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K I) = I.radical := sorry

end Q1068976

title: Q1068976_hilbert_s_nullstellensatz
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1068976
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1068976), "Hilbert's Nullstellensatz": over an
  algebraically closed field extension, the vanishing ideal of the common
  zero locus of an ideal in a finitely generated multivariate polynomial ring
  is its radical. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Bool.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Import ListNotations.

Record q1068976_field (F : Type) : Type := {
  q1068976_zero : F;
  q1068976_one : F;
  q1068976_add : F -> F -> F;
  q1068976_mul : F -> F -> F;
  q1068976_neg : F -> F;
  q1068976_inv : F -> F;
  q1068976_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1068976_add x (q1068976_add y z) =
      q1068976_add (q1068976_add x y) z;
  q1068976_add_comm :
    forall x y : F, q1068976_add x y = q1068976_add y x;
  q1068976_add_zero :
    forall x : F, q1068976_add x q1068976_zero = x;
  q1068976_add_neg :
    forall x : F, q1068976_add x (q1068976_neg x) = q1068976_zero;
  q1068976_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1068976_mul x (q1068976_mul y z) =
      q1068976_mul (q1068976_mul x y) z;
  q1068976_mul_comm :
    forall x y : F, q1068976_mul x y = q1068976_mul y x;
  q1068976_mul_one :
    forall x : F, q1068976_mul x q1068976_one = x;
  q1068976_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1068976_mul x (q1068976_add y z) =
      q1068976_add
        (q1068976_mul x y) (q1068976_mul x z);
  q1068976_mul_inv :
    forall x : F, x <> q1068976_zero ->
      q1068976_mul x (q1068976_inv x) = q1068976_one;
  q1068976_nontrivial : q1068976_zero <> q1068976_one
}.

Arguments q1068976_zero {F} _.
Arguments q1068976_one {F} _.
Arguments q1068976_add {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q1068976_mul {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q1068976_neg {F} _ _.
Arguments q1068976_inv {F} _ _.

Record q1068976_field_algebra
    (k K : Type)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (FK : q1068976_field K) : Type := {
  q1068976_embed : k -> K;
  q1068976_embed_zero :
    q1068976_embed (q1068976_zero Fk) = q1068976_zero FK;
  q1068976_embed_one :
    q1068976_embed (q1068976_one Fk) = q1068976_one FK;
  q1068976_embed_add :
    forall a b : k,
      q1068976_embed (q1068976_add Fk a b) =
      q1068976_add FK (q1068976_embed a) (q1068976_embed b);
  q1068976_embed_mul :
    forall a b : k,
      q1068976_embed (q1068976_mul Fk a b) =
      q1068976_mul FK (q1068976_embed a) (q1068976_embed b)
}.

Arguments q1068976_embed {k K Fk FK} _ _.

Fixpoint q1068976_univariate_eval
    {K : Type} (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) (x : K) : K :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => q1068976_zero FK
  | c :: rest =>
      q1068976_add FK c
        (q1068976_mul FK x
          (q1068976_univariate_eval FK rest x))
  end.

Fixpoint q1068976_some_nonzero
    {K : Type} (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => False
  | c :: rest =>
      c <> q1068976_zero FK \/
      q1068976_some_nonzero FK rest
  end.

Definition q1068976_univariate_nonconstant
    {K : Type} (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => False
  | _ :: positive_degree_coefficients =>
      q1068976_some_nonzero FK positive_degree_coefficients
  end.

Definition q1068976_is_algebraically_closed
    {K : Type} (FK : q1068976_field K) : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : list K,
    q1068976_univariate_nonconstant FK coefficients ->
    exists x : K,
      q1068976_univariate_eval FK coefficients x =
      q1068976_zero FK.

Record q1068976_finite_index (S : Type) : Type := {
  q1068976_enum : list S;
  q1068976_enum_complete :
    forall s : S, In s q1068976_enum;
  q1068976_enum_nodup : NoDup q1068976_enum
}.

Arguments q1068976_enum {S} _.

Definition q1068976_monomial (S : Type) : Type := S -> nat.

Fixpoint q1068976_monomial_eqb_on
    {S : Type} (indices : list S)
    (a b : q1068976_monomial S) : bool :=
  match indices with
  | [] => true
  | s :: rest =>
      Nat.eqb (a s) (b s) &&
      q1068976_monomial_eqb_on rest a b
  end.

Definition q1068976_monomial_eqb
    {S : Type} (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (a b : q1068976_monomial S) : bool :=
  q1068976_monomial_eqb_on (q1068976_enum FS) a b.

Definition q1068976_monomial_zero
    {S : Type} : q1068976_monomial S :=
  fun _ => 0.

Definition q1068976_monomial_add
    {S : Type}
    (a b : q1068976_monomial S) : q1068976_monomial S :=
  fun s => a s + b s.

Definition q1068976_polynomial (S k : Type) : Type :=
  list (q1068976_monomial S * k).

Fixpoint q1068976_polynomial_coefficient
    {S k : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (p : q1068976_polynomial S k)
    (m : q1068976_monomial S) : k :=
  match p with
  | [] => q1068976_zero Fk
  | (n, c) :: rest =>
      if q1068976_monomial_eqb FS n m
      then q1068976_add Fk c
        (q1068976_polynomial_coefficient FS Fk rest m)
      else q1068976_polynomial_coefficient FS Fk rest m
  end.

Definition q1068976_polynomial_equiv
    {S k : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (p q : q1068976_polynomial S k) : Prop :=
  forall m : q1068976_monomial S,
    q1068976_polynomial_coefficient FS Fk p m =
    q1068976_polynomial_coefficient FS Fk q m.

Definition q1068976_polynomial_zero
    {S k : Type} : q1068976_polynomial S k :=
  [].

Definition q1068976_polynomial_one
    {S k : Type} (Fk : q1068976_field k) :
    q1068976_polynomial S k :=
  [(q1068976_monomial_zero, q1068976_one Fk)].

Definition q1068976_polynomial_add
    {S k : Type}
    (p q : q1068976_polynomial S k) :
    q1068976_polynomial S k :=
  p ++ q.

Definition q1068976_polynomial_neg
    {S k : Type} (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (p : q1068976_polynomial S k) :
    q1068976_polynomial S k :=
  map (fun term =>
    (fst term, q1068976_neg Fk (snd term))) p.

Definition q1068976_term_mul
    {S k : Type} (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (left right : q1068976_monomial S * k) :
    q1068976_monomial S * k :=
  (q1068976_monomial_add (fst left) (fst right),
   q1068976_mul Fk (snd left) (snd right)).

Definition q1068976_polynomial_mul
    {S k : Type} (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (p q : q1068976_polynomial S k) :
    q1068976_polynomial S k :=
  flat_map
    (fun left => map (q1068976_term_mul Fk left) q) p.

Fixpoint q1068976_polynomial_pow
    {S k : Type} (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (p : q1068976_polynomial S k) (n : nat) :
    q1068976_polynomial S k :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q1068976_polynomial_one Fk
  | S exponent =>
      q1068976_polynomial_mul Fk p
        (q1068976_polynomial_pow Fk p exponent)
  end.

Record q1068976_ideal
    (S k : Type)
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k) : Type := {
  q1068976_ideal_mem : q1068976_polynomial S k -> Prop;
  q1068976_ideal_respects :
    forall p q : q1068976_polynomial S k,
      q1068976_polynomial_equiv FS Fk p q ->
      (q1068976_ideal_mem p <-> q1068976_ideal_mem q);
  q1068976_ideal_zero :
    q1068976_ideal_mem q1068976_polynomial_zero;
  q1068976_ideal_add :
    forall p q : q1068976_polynomial S k,
      q1068976_ideal_mem p ->
      q1068976_ideal_mem q ->
      q1068976_ideal_mem (q1068976_polynomial_add p q);
  q1068976_ideal_neg :
    forall p : q1068976_polynomial S k,
      q1068976_ideal_mem p ->
      q1068976_ideal_mem (q1068976_polynomial_neg Fk p);
  q1068976_ideal_mul :
    forall a p : q1068976_polynomial S k,
      q1068976_ideal_mem p ->
      q1068976_ideal_mem (q1068976_polynomial_mul Fk a p)
}.

Arguments q1068976_ideal_mem {S k FS Fk} _ _.

Fixpoint q1068976_field_pow
    {F : Type} (FF : q1068976_field F)
    (x : F) (n : nat) : F :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q1068976_one FF
  | S exponent =>
      q1068976_mul FF x
        (q1068976_field_pow FF x exponent)
  end.

Fixpoint q1068976_monomial_value_on
    {S K : Type}
    (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (indices : list S)
    (point : S -> K)
    (m : q1068976_monomial S) : K :=
  match indices with
  | [] => q1068976_one FK
  | s :: rest =>
      q1068976_mul FK
        (q1068976_field_pow FK (point s) (m s))
        (q1068976_monomial_value_on FK rest point m)
  end.

Definition q1068976_monomial_value
    {S K : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (point : S -> K)
    (m : q1068976_monomial S) : K :=
  q1068976_monomial_value_on
    FK (q1068976_enum FS) point m.

Fixpoint q1068976_evaluate
    {S k K : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (A : q1068976_field_algebra Fk FK)
    (point : S -> K)
    (p : q1068976_polynomial S k) : K :=
  match p with
  | [] => q1068976_zero FK
  | (m, c) :: rest =>
      q1068976_add FK
        (q1068976_mul FK
          (q1068976_embed A c)
          (q1068976_monomial_value FS FK point m))
        (@q1068976_evaluate S k K FS Fk FK A point rest)
  end.

Definition q1068976_zero_locus
    {S k K : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (A : q1068976_field_algebra Fk FK)
    (I : q1068976_ideal FS Fk)
    (point : S -> K) : Prop :=
  forall p : q1068976_polynomial S k,
    q1068976_ideal_mem I p ->
    @q1068976_evaluate S k K FS Fk FK A point p =
    q1068976_zero FK.

Definition q1068976_vanishing_ideal_member
    {S k K : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (FK : q1068976_field K)
    (A : q1068976_field_algebra Fk FK)
    (I : q1068976_ideal FS Fk)
    (p : q1068976_polynomial S k) : Prop :=
  forall point : S -> K,
    @q1068976_zero_locus S k K FS Fk FK A I point ->
    @q1068976_evaluate S k K FS Fk FK A point p =
    q1068976_zero FK.

Definition q1068976_radical_member
    {S k : Type}
    (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
    (Fk : q1068976_field k)
    (I : q1068976_ideal FS Fk)
    (p : q1068976_polynomial S k) : Prop :=
  exists exponent : nat,
    q1068976_ideal_mem I
      (q1068976_polynomial_pow Fk p (Datatypes.S exponent)).

Theorem MvPolynomial_vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical :
  forall (k K : Type)
         (Fk : q1068976_field k)
         (FK : q1068976_field K)
         (A : q1068976_field_algebra Fk FK),
    q1068976_is_algebraically_closed FK ->
    forall (S : Type)
           (FS : q1068976_finite_index S)
           (I : q1068976_ideal FS Fk)
           (p : q1068976_polynomial S k),
      @q1068976_vanishing_ideal_member S k K FS Fk FK A I p <->
      @q1068976_radical_member S k FS Fk I p.
Admitted.

title: Q1068976_hilbert_s_nullstellensatz
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1068976,
  "Hilbert's Nullstellensatz": over an algebraically closed field extension,
  the ideal of finite-variable polynomials vanishing on an ideal's common zero
  locus is exactly the radical of that ideal. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1068976_hilbert_s_nullstellensatz
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly = "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition is_field_embedding ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'K::field) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_field_embedding e \<longleftrightarrow>
    e 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. e (a + b) = e a + e b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. e (a * b) = e a * e b)"

definition is_algebraically_closed ::
    "'K::field itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_algebraically_closed _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>c :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'K.
      finite {n. c n \<noteq> 0} \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>n>0. c n \<noteq> 0) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. (\<Sum>n\<in>{n. c n \<noteq> 0}. c n * x ^ n) = 0))"

definition monomial_support :: "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "monomial_support m = {v. m v \<noteq> 0}"

definition polynomial_support ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "polynomial_support p = {m. p m \<noteq> 0}"

definition is_mpoly ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_mpoly p \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite (polynomial_support p) \<and>
    (\<forall>m\<in>polynomial_support p. finite (monomial_support m))"

definition mpoly_zero :: "('v, 'a::zero) raw_mpoly" where
  "mpoly_zero = (\<lambda>_. 0)"

definition mpoly_one :: "('v, 'a::zero_neq_one) raw_mpoly" where
  "mpoly_one = (\<lambda>m. if m = (\<lambda>_. 0) then 1 else 0)"

definition mpoly_add ::
    "('v, 'a::plus) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly" where
  "mpoly_add p q = (\<lambda>m. p m + q m)"

definition mpoly_neg ::
    "('v, 'a::uminus) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly" where
  "mpoly_neg p = (\<lambda>m. - p m)"

definition mpoly_mul ::
    "('v, 'a::comm_semiring_1) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly" where
  "mpoly_mul p q =
    (\<lambda>m.
      \<Sum>ab\<in>polynomial_support p \<times> polynomial_support q.
        if m = (\<lambda>v. fst ab v + snd ab v)
        then p (fst ab) * q (snd ab)
        else 0)"

fun mpoly_pow ::
    "('v, 'a::comm_semiring_1) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a) raw_mpoly" where
  "mpoly_pow p 0 = mpoly_one"
| "mpoly_pow p (Suc n) = mpoly_mul p (mpoly_pow p n)"

definition mpoly_eval ::
    "('k::zero \<Rightarrow> 'K::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'K) \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'k) raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> 'K" where
  "mpoly_eval e x p =
    (\<Sum>m\<in>polynomial_support p.
      e (p m) * (\<Prod>v\<in>monomial_support m. x v ^ m v))"

definition is_ideal ::
    "('v, 'k::comm_ring_1) raw_mpoly set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_ideal I \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p\<in>I. is_mpoly p) \<and>
    mpoly_zero \<in> I \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>I. \<forall>q\<in>I. mpoly_add p q \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>I. mpoly_neg p \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. is_mpoly a \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>p\<in>I. mpoly_mul a p \<in> I))"

definition zero_locus ::
    "('k::zero \<Rightarrow> 'K::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'k) raw_mpoly set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'K) set" where
  "zero_locus e I =
    {x. \<forall>p\<in>I. mpoly_eval e x p = 0}"

definition vanishing_ideal ::
    "('k::zero \<Rightarrow> 'K::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'K) set \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'k) raw_mpoly set" where
  "vanishing_ideal e V =
    {p. is_mpoly p \<and> (\<forall>x\<in>V. mpoly_eval e x p = 0)}"

definition ideal_radical ::
    "('v, 'k::comm_ring_1) raw_mpoly set \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'k) raw_mpoly set" where
  "ideal_radical I =
    {p. is_mpoly p \<and> (\<exists>n>0. mpoly_pow p n \<in> I)}"

theorem hilbert_nullstellensatz:
  fixes e :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> 'K::field"
    and I :: "('v, 'k) raw_mpoly set"
  assumes "is_field_embedding e"
    and "is_algebraically_closed (TYPE('K))"
    and "finite (UNIV :: 'v set)"
    and "is_ideal I"
  shows "vanishing_ideal e (zero_locus e I) = ideal_radical I"
  sorry

end

title: Q1068976_hilbert_s_nullstellensatz
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1068976,
  "Hilbert's Nullstellensatz": over a field embedded in an algebraically
  closed field, the ideal of multivariate polynomials vanishing on the common
  zero locus of an ideal is its radical. This file contains no proof.
*)

let HILBERTS_NULLSTELLENSATZ =
  `let is_field_A =
     \(z:A) (unitA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (negA0:A->A) (invA0:A->A).
       ~(z = unitA) /\
       (!x. add z x = x) /\
       (!x. add (negA0 x) x = z) /\
       (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y w. add x (add y w) = add (add x y) w) /\
       (!x. mul unitA x = x) /\
       (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
       (!x y w. mul x (mul y w) = mul (mul x y) w) /\
       (!x y w. mul x (add y w) = add (mul x y) (mul x w)) /\
       (!x. ~(x = z) ==> mul (invA0 x) x = unitA) in
   let is_field_B =
     \(z:B) (unitB:B) (add:B->B->B) (mul:B->B->B)
      (negB0:B->B) (invB0:B->B).
       ~(z = unitB) /\
       (!x. add z x = x) /\
       (!x. add (negB0 x) x = z) /\
       (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y w. add x (add y w) = add (add x y) w) /\
       (!x. mul unitB x = x) /\
       (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
       (!x y w. mul x (mul y w) = mul (mul x y) w) /\
       (!x y w. mul x (add y w) = add (mul x y) (mul x w)) /\
       (!x. ~(x = z) ==> mul (invB0 x) x = unitB) in
   let power_B =
     \(unitB:B) (mul:B->B->B) (x:B) (n:num).
       ITLIST mul (REPLICATE n x) unitB in
   let is_polynomial =
     \(z:A) (vars:V->bool) (p:(V->num)->A).
       FINITE {m | ~(p m = z)} /\
       (!m i. ~(p m = z) /\ ~(i IN vars) ==> m i = 0) in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(z:A). \(m:V->num). z in
   let polynomial_one =
     \(z:A) (unitA:A). \(m:V->num).
       if (!i. m i = 0) then unitA else z in
   let polynomial_neg =
     \(negA0:A->A) (p:(V->num)->A). \m. negA0 (p m) in
   let polynomial_add =
     \(add:A->A->A) (p:(V->num)->A) (q:(V->num)->A).
       \m. add (p m) (q m) in
   let polynomial_mul =
     \(z:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (p:(V->num)->A) (q:(V->num)->A).
       \m. iterate add
             {(u,v) |
                ~(p u = z) /\
                ~(q v = z) /\
                (!i. m i = u i + v i)}
             (\(u,v). mul (p u) (q v)) in
   let polynomial_power =
     \(z:A) (unitA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (p:(V->num)->A) (n:num).
       ITLIST (polynomial_mul z add mul)
              (REPLICATE n p)
              (polynomial_one z unitA) in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(zA:A) (h:A->B) (zB:B) (oB:B)
      (addB:B->B->B) (mulB:B->B->B)
      (vars:V->bool) (p:(V->num)->A) (x:V->B).
       iterate addB {m | ~(p m = zA)}
         (\m. mulB (h (p m))
               (iterate mulB vars
                 (\i. power_B oB mulB (x i) (m i)))) in
   let is_univariate_polynomial =
     \(z:B) (p:num->B). FINITE {n | ~(p n = z)} in
   let univariate_eval =
     \(z:B) (unitB:B) (add:B->B->B) (mul:B->B->B)
      (p:num->B) (x:B).
       iterate add {n | ~(p n = z)}
         (\n. mul (p n) (power_B unitB mul x n)) in
   let is_algebraically_closed =
     \(z:B) (unitB:B) (add:B->B->B) (mul:B->B->B).
       !p:num->B.
         is_univariate_polynomial z p /\
         (?n. ~(n = 0) /\ ~(p n = z))
         ==> ?x:B. univariate_eval z unitB add mul p x = z in
   let is_ideal =
     \(z:A) (unitA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (negA0:A->A) (vars:V->bool) (ideal:((V->num)->A)->bool).
       (!p. ideal p ==> is_polynomial z vars p) /\
       ideal (polynomial_zero z) /\
       (!p. ideal p ==> ideal (polynomial_neg negA0 p)) /\
       (!p q. ideal p /\ ideal q ==> ideal (polynomial_add add p q)) /\
       (!a p.
          is_polynomial z vars a /\ ideal p
          ==> ideal (polynomial_mul z add mul a p)) in
   let zero_locus =
     \(zA:A) (h:A->B) (zB:B) (oB:B)
      (addB:B->B->B) (mulB:B->B->B)
      (vars:V->bool) (ideal:((V->num)->A)->bool).
       {x:V->B |
          !p. ideal p
              ==> polynomial_eval zA h zB oB addB mulB vars p x = zB} in
   let vanishing_ideal =
     \(zA:A) (h:A->B) (zB:B) (oB:B)
      (addB:B->B->B) (mulB:B->B->B)
      (vars:V->bool) (ideal:((V->num)->A)->bool).
       {p:(V->num)->A |
          is_polynomial zA vars p /\
          !x. x IN zero_locus zA h zB oB addB mulB vars ideal
              ==> polynomial_eval zA h zB oB addB mulB vars p x = zB} in
   let radical_ideal =
     \(z:A) (unitA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (vars:V->bool) (ideal:((V->num)->A)->bool).
       {p:(V->num)->A |
          is_polynomial z vars p /\
          ?n. ~(n = 0) /\
              ideal (polynomial_power z unitA add mul p n)} in
   !zA:A. !oA:A. !addA:A->A->A. !mulA:A->A->A.
   !negA:A->A. !invA:A->A.
   !zB:B. !oB:B. !addB:B->B->B. !mulB:B->B->B.
   !negB:B->B. !invB:B->B. !h:A->B.
   !vars:V->bool. !ideal:((V->num)->A)->bool.
     is_field_A zA oA addA mulA negA invA /\
     is_field_B zB oB addB mulB negB invB /\
     h zA = zB /\
     h oA = oB /\
     (!x y. h (addA x y) = addB (h x) (h y)) /\
     (!x y. h (mulA x y) = mulB (h x) (h y)) /\
     is_algebraically_closed zB oB addB mulB /\
     FINITE vars /\
     is_ideal zA oA addA mulA negA vars ideal
     ==> vanishing_ideal zA h zB oB addB mulB vars ideal =
         radical_ideal zA oA addA mulA vars ideal`;;

title: Q1068976_hilbert_s_nullstellensatz
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1068976,
;; "Hilbert's Nullstellensatz": over a field embedded in an algebraically
;; closed field and finitely many variables, the vanishing ideal of an ideal's
;; zero locus equals its radical. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Variables are a duplicate-free finite list. Polynomials are canonical
;; sorted finite-support lists whose entries are (exponent-vector coefficient).
;; Field carriers, ideals, point sets, and polynomial families remain arbitrary
;; tame predicates and are not enumerated.
;;
;; ALGEBRAIC-PACKAGE, POLYNOMIAL-PACKAGE, and LOCUS-PACKAGE bundle operations
;; and classical choice components with both directions of their defining
;; laws. Forgetting the components gives exactly the source fields, polynomial
;; ring, ideal, zero locus, vanishing ideal, and radical; conversely classical
;; choice supplies every bundled component. Thus roots, counterexamples, and
;; radical powers remain internal witnesses rather than theorem parameters.
;;
;; Every function object supplied to FN-EQUAL contains only ACL2 primitives,
;; loop scions, and APPLY$ calls on quoted tame functions. The final diagnostic
;; checks every directly or transitively reified lambda.

(defun q1068976-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1068976-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q1068976-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1068976-quoted nil)))

(defun q1068976-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (q1068976-quoted function)
        (q1068976-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1068976-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q1068976-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q1068976-quoted nil))
    (q1068976-quoted t)))

(defun q1068976-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q1068976-quoted nil)
        (q1068976-quoted t)))

(defun q1068976-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q1068976-quoted t)))

(defun q1068976-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q1068976-quoted t)
              (q1068976-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q1068976-quoted nil)
              (q1068976-quoted t))))

(defun q1068976-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1068976-quoted t)))

(defun q1068976-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q1068976-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q1068976-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q1068976-index-range-term (last)
  (list 'from-to-by
        (q1068976-quoted 0)
        last
        (q1068976-quoted 1)))

(defun q1068976-zero-vector (variables)
  (if (consp variables)
      (cons 0 (q1068976-zero-vector (cdr variables)))
    nil))

;; Fields and the embedding k -> K.

(defun q1068976-field-laws-function
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (let* ((add-xy (q1068976-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (add-yz (q1068976-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (mul-xy (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (mul-yz (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q1068976-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (q1068976-static-apply-term inverse '(x)))
         (domain
          (q1068976-and-terms
           (list (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
                 (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
                 (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      domain
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier (list add-xy))
        (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier (list mul-xy))
        (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q1068976-implies-term
         (q1068976-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q1068976-quoted zero)))
         (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term add (list add-xy 'z))
              (q1068976-static-apply-term add (list 'x add-yz)))
        (list 'equal add-xy
              (q1068976-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q1068976-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q1068976-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply (list mul-xy 'z))
              (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x mul-yz)))
        (list 'equal mul-xy
              (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q1068976-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (q1068976-implies-term
         (q1068976-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q1068976-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q1068976-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x add-yz))
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q1068976-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q1068976-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q1068976-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1068976-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1068976-universal-p
    (q1068976-field-laws-function
     carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
    '(x y z))))

(defun q1068976-embedding-laws-function
    (small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
  (let* ((map-x (q1068976-static-apply-term embedding '(x)))
         (map-y (q1068976-static-apply-term embedding '(y)))
         (domain
          (q1068976-and-terms
           (list
            (q1068976-static-apply-term small-carrier '(x))
            (q1068976-static-apply-term small-carrier '(y))))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      domain
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-static-apply-term large-carrier (list map-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               embedding
               (list
                (q1068976-static-apply-term small-add '(x y))))
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               large-add (list map-x map-y)))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               embedding
               (list
                (q1068976-static-apply-term small-multiply '(x y))))
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               large-multiply (list map-x map-y)))
        (q1068976-implies-term
         (list 'equal map-x map-y)
         (list 'equal 'x 'y))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               embedding (list (q1068976-quoted small-zero)))
              (q1068976-quoted large-zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q1068976-static-apply-term
               embedding (list (q1068976-quoted small-one)))
              (q1068976-quoted large-one))))))))

(defun q1068976-field-embedding-p
    (small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp embedding)
   (q1068976-universal-p
    (q1068976-embedding-laws-function
     small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
    '(x y))))

;; Canonical polynomial and point terms.

(defun q1068976-natural-function ()
  '(lambda (value) (natp value)))

(defun q1068976-exponent-valid-term (exponent variables)
  (q1068976-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'true-listp exponent)
    (list 'equal (list 'len exponent)
          (q1068976-quoted (len variables)))
    (list 'always$
          (q1068976-quoted (q1068976-natural-function))
          exponent))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-entry-function
    (variables carrier zero)
  (let ((exponent (list 'car 'entry))
        (coefficient (list 'car (list 'cdr 'entry))))
    (list
     'lambda '(entry)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (list 'true-listp 'entry)
       (list 'equal (list 'len 'entry) (q1068976-quoted 2))
       (q1068976-exponent-valid-term exponent variables)
       (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier (list coefficient))
       (q1068976-not-term
        (list 'equal coefficient (q1068976-quoted zero))))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-order-function ()
  (let* ((polynomial (list 'car 'loop$-gvars))
         (left
          (list 'car
                (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars polynomial)))
         (right
          (list 'car
                (list 'nth
                      (list 'binary-+ 'loop$-ivars
                            (q1068976-quoted 1))
                      polynomial))))
    (list
     'lambda '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (list 'lexorder left right)
       (q1068976-not-term
        (list 'equal left right)))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
    (polynomial variables carrier zero)
  (q1068976-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'true-listp polynomial)
    (list 'always$
          (q1068976-quoted
           (q1068976-polynomial-entry-function
            variables carrier zero))
          polynomial)
    (list
     'always$+
     (q1068976-quoted
      (q1068976-polynomial-order-function))
     (q1068976-term-list (list polynomial))
     (q1068976-index-range-term
      (list 'binary-+
            (list 'len polynomial)
            (q1068976-quoted -2)))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-valid-function
    (variables carrier zero)
  (list 'lambda '(polynomial)
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         'polynomial variables carrier zero)))

(defun q1068976-point-valid-term (point variables carrier)
  (q1068976-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'true-listp point)
    (list 'equal (list 'len point)
          (q1068976-quoted (len variables)))
    (list 'always$ (q1068976-quoted carrier) point))))

(defun q1068976-coefficient-term
    (polynomial exponent zero)
  (let ((entry (list 'assoc-equal exponent polynomial)))
    (list 'if entry
          (list 'car (list 'cdr entry))
          (q1068976-quoted zero))))

(defun q1068976-coordinate-le-function ()
  (let* ((shift (list 'car 'loop$-gvars))
         (target (list 'car (list 'cdr 'loop$-gvars)))
         (shift-coordinate
          (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars shift))
         (target-coordinate
          (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars target)))
    (list
     'lambda '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (q1068976-not-term
      (list '< target-coordinate shift-coordinate)))))

(defun q1068976-coordinatewise-le-term (shift target)
  (list
   'always$+
   (q1068976-quoted
    (q1068976-coordinate-le-function))
   (q1068976-term-list (list shift target))
   (q1068976-index-range-term
    (list 'binary-+
          (list 'len target)
          (q1068976-quoted -1)))))

(defun q1068976-coordinate-difference-function ()
  (let* ((target (list 'car 'loop$-gvars))
         (shift (list 'car (list 'cdr 'loop$-gvars))))
    (list
     'lambda '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (list 'binary-+
           (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars target)
           (list 'unary--
                 (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars shift))))))

(defun q1068976-coordinate-difference-term (target shift)
  (list
   'collect$+
   (q1068976-quoted
    (q1068976-coordinate-difference-function))
   (q1068976-term-list (list target shift))
   (q1068976-index-range-term
    (list 'binary-+
          (list 'len target)
          (q1068976-quoted -1)))))

(defun q1068976-unit-coordinate-function ()
  (let ((target-index (list 'car 'loop$-gvars)))
    (list
     'lambda '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (list 'if
           (list 'equal 'loop$-ivars target-index)
           (q1068976-quoted 1)
           (q1068976-quoted 0)))))

(defun q1068976-variable-polynomial-term
    (index variables one)
  (let ((exponent
         (list
          'collect$+
          (q1068976-quoted
           (q1068976-unit-coordinate-function))
          (q1068976-term-list (list index))
          (q1068976-index-range-term
           (q1068976-quoted
            (- (len variables) 1))))))
    (list 'cons
          (q1068976-term-list
           (list exponent (q1068976-quoted one)))
          (q1068976-quoted nil))))

(defun q1068976-constant-polynomial-term
    (coefficient variables zero)
  (list
   'if
   (list 'equal coefficient (q1068976-quoted zero))
   (q1068976-quoted nil)
   (list
    'cons
    (q1068976-term-list
     (list
      (q1068976-quoted
       (q1068976-zero-vector variables))
      coefficient))
    (q1068976-quoted nil))))

;; Algebraic closedness, using a package-internal selected root and a Horner
;; trace. The trace is a finite certificate for evaluation at that root.

(defun q1068976-root-trace-step-function
    (add multiply)
  (let* ((coefficients (list 'car 'loop$-gvars))
         (root (list 'car (list 'cdr 'loop$-gvars)))
         (trace
          (list 'car
                (list 'cdr
                      (list 'cdr 'loop$-gvars))))
         (coefficient-index
          (list
           'binary-+
           (list 'binary-+
                 (list 'len coefficients)
                 (q1068976-quoted -1))
           (list 'unary-- 'loop$-ivars))))
    (list
     'lambda '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (list
      'equal
      (list 'nth
            (list 'binary-+ 'loop$-ivars
                  (q1068976-quoted 1))
            trace)
      (q1068976-static-apply-term
       add
       (list
        (list 'nth coefficient-index coefficients)
        (q1068976-static-apply-term
         multiply
         (list root
               (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars trace)))))))))

(defun q1068976-algebraic-closure-function
    (carrier add multiply zero root-selector)
  (let* ((witness
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           root-selector '(coefficients)))
         (root (list 'car witness))
         (trace (list 'car (list 'cdr witness)))
         (positive-degree
          (q1068976-and-terms
           (list
            (list 'true-listp 'coefficients)
            (q1068976-not-term
             (list '< (list 'len 'coefficients)
                   (q1068976-quoted 2)))
            (list 'always$
                  (q1068976-quoted carrier)
                  'coefficients)
            (q1068976-not-term
             (list
              'equal
              (list 'nth
                    (list 'binary-+
                          (list 'len 'coefficients)
                          (q1068976-quoted -1))
                    'coefficients)
              (q1068976-quoted zero))))))
         (trace-law
          (list
           'always$+
           (q1068976-quoted
            (q1068976-root-trace-step-function
             add multiply))
           (q1068976-term-list
            (list 'coefficients root trace))
           (q1068976-index-range-term
            (list 'binary-+
                  (list 'len 'coefficients)
                  (q1068976-quoted -1))))))
    (list
     'lambda '(coefficients)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      positive-degree
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'true-listp witness)
        (list 'equal (list 'len witness)
              (q1068976-quoted 2))
        (q1068976-static-apply-term carrier (list root))
        (list 'true-listp trace)
        (list 'equal
              (list 'len trace)
              (list 'binary-+
                    (list 'len 'coefficients)
                    (q1068976-quoted 1)))
        (list 'equal
              (list 'nth (q1068976-quoted 0) trace)
              (q1068976-quoted zero))
        trace-law
        (list 'equal
              (list 'nth
                    (list 'len 'coefficients)
                    trace)
              (q1068976-quoted zero))))))))

(defun q1068976-algebraically-closed-p
    (carrier add multiply zero algebraic-package)
  (let ((root-selector (nth 0 algebraic-package)))
    (and
     (true-listp algebraic-package)
     (equal (len algebraic-package) 1)
     (tamep-functionp root-selector)
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-algebraic-closure-function
       carrier add multiply zero root-selector)
      '(coefficients)))))

;; POLYNOMIAL-PACKAGE fields and exact operation laws.

(defun q1068976-polynomial-add (package) (nth 0 package))
(defun q1068976-polynomial-negate (package) (nth 1 package))
(defun q1068976-polynomial-scale (package) (nth 2 package))
(defun q1068976-polynomial-multiply (package) (nth 3 package))
(defun q1068976-polynomial-evaluate (package) (nth 4 package))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-add-law-function
    (variables carrier add zero polynomial-add)
  (let* ((sum
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-add '(p q)))
         (domain
          (q1068976-and-terms
           (list
            (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
             'p variables carrier zero)
            (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
             'q variables carrier zero)
            (q1068976-exponent-valid-term
             'exponent variables)))))
    (list
     'lambda '(p q exponent)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      domain
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         sum variables carrier zero)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-coefficient-term
          sum 'exponent zero)
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           (q1068976-coefficient-term
            'p 'exponent zero)
           (q1068976-coefficient-term
            'q 'exponent zero))))))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-negate-law-function
    (variables carrier negate zero polynomial-negate)
  (let ((negative
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          polynomial-negate '(p))))
    (list
     'lambda '(p exponent)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         'p variables carrier zero)
        (q1068976-exponent-valid-term
         'exponent variables)))
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         negative variables carrier zero)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-coefficient-term
          negative 'exponent zero)
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          negate
          (list
           (q1068976-coefficient-term
            'p 'exponent zero))))))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-scale-law-function
    (variables carrier multiply zero polynomial-scale)
  (let* ((term-exponent (list 'car 'term))
         (term-coefficient
          (list 'car (list 'cdr 'term)))
         (scaled
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-scale '(term p)))
         (source-exponent
          (q1068976-coordinate-difference-term
           'exponent term-exponent))
         (expected
          (list
           'if
           (q1068976-coordinatewise-le-term
            term-exponent 'exponent)
           (q1068976-static-apply-term
            multiply
            (list
             term-coefficient
             (q1068976-coefficient-term
              'p source-exponent zero)))
           (q1068976-quoted zero))))
    (list
     'lambda '(term p exponent)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         (list 'cons 'term (q1068976-quoted nil))
         variables carrier zero)
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         'p variables carrier zero)
        (q1068976-exponent-valid-term
         'exponent variables)))
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         scaled variables carrier zero)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-coefficient-term
          scaled 'exponent zero)
         expected)))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-multiply-law-function
    (variables carrier zero
     polynomial-add polynomial-scale polynomial-multiply)
  (let ((product
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          polynomial-multiply '(p q)))
        (recursive-product
         (list
          'if
          (list 'consp 'p)
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-add
           (list
            (q1068976-static-apply-term
             polynomial-scale
             (list (list 'car 'p) 'q))
            (q1068976-static-apply-term
             polynomial-multiply
             (list (list 'cdr 'p) 'q))))
          (q1068976-quoted nil))))
    (list
     'lambda '(p q)
     (q1068976-implies-term
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         'p variables carrier zero)
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         'q variables carrier zero)))
      (q1068976-and-terms
       (list
        (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
         product variables carrier zero)
        (list 'equal product recursive-product)))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-evaluate-law-function
    (variables
     small-carrier small-zero small-one
     large-carrier embedding large-add large-multiply
     polynomial-add polynomial-multiply polynomial-evaluate)
  (let* ((eval-p
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-evaluate '(p point)))
         (eval-q
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-evaluate '(q point)))
         (valid-point
          (q1068976-point-valid-term
           'point variables large-carrier))
         (valid-p
          (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
           'p variables small-carrier small-zero))
         (valid-q
          (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
           'q variables small-carrier small-zero))
         (constant
          (q1068976-constant-polynomial-term
           'coefficient variables small-zero))
         (variable
          (q1068976-variable-polynomial-term
           'index variables small-one)))
    (list
     'lambda '(p q point coefficient index)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms (list valid-p valid-point))
        (q1068976-static-apply-term
         large-carrier (list eval-p)))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list valid-p valid-q valid-point))
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          (list
           'equal
           (q1068976-static-apply-term
            polynomial-evaluate
            (list
             (q1068976-static-apply-term
              polynomial-add '(p q))
             'point))
           (q1068976-static-apply-term
            large-add (list eval-p eval-q)))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1068976-static-apply-term
            polynomial-evaluate
            (list
             (q1068976-static-apply-term
              polynomial-multiply '(p q))
             'point))
           (q1068976-static-apply-term
            large-multiply (list eval-p eval-q))))))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           small-carrier '(coefficient))
          valid-point))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          polynomial-evaluate
          (list constant 'point))
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          embedding '(coefficient))))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          (list 'natp 'index)
          (list '< 'index
                (q1068976-quoted (len variables)))
          valid-point))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          polynomial-evaluate
          (list variable 'point))
         (list 'nth 'index 'point))))))))

(defun q1068976-polynomial-package-p
    (variables
     small-carrier small-add small-multiply small-negate
     small-zero small-one
     large-carrier embedding large-add large-multiply
     polynomial-package)
  (let* ((polynomial-add
          (q1068976-polynomial-add polynomial-package))
         (polynomial-negate
          (q1068976-polynomial-negate polynomial-package))
         (polynomial-scale
          (q1068976-polynomial-scale polynomial-package))
         (polynomial-multiply
          (q1068976-polynomial-multiply polynomial-package))
         (polynomial-evaluate
          (q1068976-polynomial-evaluate polynomial-package)))
    (and
     (true-listp polynomial-package)
     (equal (len polynomial-package) 5)
     (tamep-functionp polynomial-add)
     (tamep-functionp polynomial-negate)
     (tamep-functionp polynomial-scale)
     (tamep-functionp polynomial-multiply)
     (tamep-functionp polynomial-evaluate)
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-polynomial-add-law-function
       variables small-carrier small-add small-zero
       polynomial-add)
      '(p q exponent))
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-polynomial-negate-law-function
       variables small-carrier small-negate small-zero
       polynomial-negate)
      '(p exponent))
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-polynomial-scale-law-function
       variables small-carrier small-multiply small-zero
       polynomial-scale)
      '(term p exponent))
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-polynomial-multiply-law-function
       variables small-carrier small-zero
       polynomial-add polynomial-scale polynomial-multiply)
      '(p q))
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-polynomial-evaluate-law-function
       variables
       small-carrier small-zero small-one
       large-carrier embedding large-add large-multiply
       polynomial-add polynomial-multiply polynomial-evaluate)
      '(p q point coefficient index)))))

;; Ideals of the canonical polynomial ring.

(defun q1068976-ideal-law-function
    (variables carrier zero ideal
     polynomial-add polynomial-negate polynomial-multiply)
  (let ((p-in (q1068976-static-apply-term ideal '(p)))
        (q-in (q1068976-static-apply-term ideal '(q)))
        (p-valid
         (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
          'p variables carrier zero)))
    (list
     'lambda '(p q)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (q1068976-implies-term p-in p-valid)
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms (list p-in q-in))
        (q1068976-static-apply-term
         ideal
         (list
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-add '(p q)))))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        p-in
        (q1068976-static-apply-term
         ideal
         (list
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-negate '(p)))))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms (list p-valid q-in))
        (q1068976-static-apply-term
         ideal
         (list
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           polynomial-multiply '(p q))))))))))

(defun q1068976-ideal-p
    (variables carrier zero ideal polynomial-package)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q1068976-member-p ideal nil)
   (q1068976-universal-p
    (q1068976-ideal-law-function
     variables carrier zero ideal
     (q1068976-polynomial-add polynomial-package)
     (q1068976-polynomial-negate polynomial-package)
     (q1068976-polynomial-multiply polynomial-package))
    '(p q))))

;; LOCUS-PACKAGE fields and exact definitions of zero locus, vanishing ideal,
;; and radical.

(defun q1068976-zero-locus (package) (nth 0 package))
(defun q1068976-zero-counterexample (package) (nth 1 package))
(defun q1068976-vanishing (package) (nth 2 package))
(defun q1068976-vanishing-counterexample (package) (nth 3 package))
(defun q1068976-radical (package) (nth 4 package))
(defun q1068976-radical-witness (package) (nth 5 package))

(defun q1068976-zero-locus-law-function
    (variables large-carrier large-zero ideal polynomial-evaluate
     zero-locus zero-counterexample)
  (let ((point-valid
         (q1068976-point-valid-term
          'point variables large-carrier))
        (point-zero
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          zero-locus '(point)))
        (counterexample
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          zero-counterexample '(point))))
    (list
     'lambda '(point polynomial)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (q1068976-implies-term point-zero point-valid)
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          point-valid
          point-zero
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           ideal '(polynomial))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          polynomial-evaluate '(polynomial point))
         (q1068976-quoted large-zero)))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list point-valid
               (q1068976-not-term point-zero)))
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           ideal (list counterexample))
          (q1068976-not-term
           (list
            'equal
            (q1068976-static-apply-term
             polynomial-evaluate
             (list counterexample 'point))
            (q1068976-quoted large-zero)))))))))))

(defun q1068976-vanishing-law-function
    (variables small-carrier small-zero
     large-carrier large-zero polynomial-evaluate
     zero-locus vanishing vanishing-counterexample)
  (let ((polynomial-valid
         (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
          'polynomial variables small-carrier small-zero))
        (polynomial-vanishes
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          vanishing '(polynomial)))
        (counterexample
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          vanishing-counterexample '(polynomial))))
    (list
     'lambda '(polynomial point)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (q1068976-implies-term
        polynomial-vanishes polynomial-valid)
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          polynomial-valid
          polynomial-vanishes
          (q1068976-point-valid-term
           'point variables large-carrier)
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           zero-locus '(point))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1068976-static-apply-term
          polynomial-evaluate '(polynomial point))
         (q1068976-quoted large-zero)))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          polynomial-valid
          (q1068976-not-term polynomial-vanishes)))
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          (q1068976-point-valid-term
           counterexample variables large-carrier)
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           zero-locus (list counterexample))
          (q1068976-not-term
           (list
            'equal
            (q1068976-static-apply-term
             polynomial-evaluate
             (list 'polynomial counterexample))
            (q1068976-quoted large-zero)))))))))))

(defun q1068976-power-chain-step-function
    (polynomial-multiply)
  (let* ((polynomial (list 'car 'loop$-gvars))
         (chain (list 'car (list 'cdr 'loop$-gvars))))
    (list
     'lambda '(loop$-gvars loop$-ivars)
     (list
      'equal
      (list 'nth
            (list 'binary-+ 'loop$-ivars
                  (q1068976-quoted 1))
            chain)
      (q1068976-static-apply-term
       polynomial-multiply
       (list polynomial
             (list 'nth 'loop$-ivars chain)))))))

(defun q1068976-power-certificate-term
    (polynomial exponent chain
     variables carrier zero one
     ideal polynomial-multiply)
  (q1068976-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'natp exponent)
    (list 'true-listp chain)
    (list 'equal
          (list 'len chain)
          (list 'binary-+ exponent
                (q1068976-quoted 1)))
    (list 'always$
          (q1068976-quoted
           (q1068976-polynomial-valid-function
            variables carrier zero))
          chain)
    (list 'equal
          (list 'nth (q1068976-quoted 0) chain)
          (q1068976-quoted
           (list
            (list
             (q1068976-zero-vector variables)
             one))))
    (list
     'always$+
     (q1068976-quoted
      (q1068976-power-chain-step-function
       polynomial-multiply))
     (q1068976-term-list
      (list polynomial chain))
     (q1068976-index-range-term
      (list 'binary-+ exponent
            (q1068976-quoted -1))))
    (q1068976-static-apply-term
     ideal (list (list 'nth exponent chain))))))

(defun q1068976-radical-law-function
    (variables carrier zero one ideal polynomial-multiply
     radical radical-witness)
  (let* ((valid
          (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
           'polynomial variables carrier zero))
         (in-radical
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           radical '(polynomial)))
         (witness
          (q1068976-static-apply-term
           radical-witness '(polynomial)))
         (selected-exponent (list 'car witness))
         (selected-chain
          (list 'car (list 'cdr witness))))
    (list
     'lambda '(polynomial exponent chain)
     (q1068976-and-terms
      (list
       (q1068976-implies-term in-radical valid)
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms (list valid in-radical))
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          (list 'true-listp witness)
          (list 'equal (list 'len witness)
                (q1068976-quoted 2))
          (q1068976-power-certificate-term
           'polynomial selected-exponent selected-chain
           variables carrier zero one
           ideal polynomial-multiply))))
       (q1068976-implies-term
        (q1068976-and-terms
         (list
          valid
          (q1068976-power-certificate-term
           'polynomial 'exponent 'chain
           variables carrier zero one
           ideal polynomial-multiply)))
        in-radical))))))

(defun q1068976-locus-package-p
    (variables
     small-carrier small-zero small-one
     large-carrier large-zero
     ideal polynomial-package locus-package)
  (let* ((polynomial-evaluate
          (q1068976-polynomial-evaluate polynomial-package))
         (polynomial-multiply
          (q1068976-polynomial-multiply polynomial-package))
         (zero-locus
          (q1068976-zero-locus locus-package))
         (zero-counterexample
          (q1068976-zero-counterexample locus-package))
         (vanishing
          (q1068976-vanishing locus-package))
         (vanishing-counterexample
          (q1068976-vanishing-counterexample locus-package))
         (radical
          (q1068976-radical locus-package))
         (radical-witness
          (q1068976-radical-witness locus-package)))
    (and
     (true-listp locus-package)
     (equal (len locus-package) 6)
     (tamep-functionp zero-locus)
     (tamep-functionp zero-counterexample)
     (tamep-functionp vanishing)
     (tamep-functionp vanishing-counterexample)
     (tamep-functionp radical)
     (tamep-functionp radical-witness)
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-zero-locus-law-function
       variables large-carrier large-zero
       ideal polynomial-evaluate
       zero-locus zero-counterexample)
      '(point polynomial))
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-vanishing-law-function
       variables small-carrier small-zero
       large-carrier large-zero polynomial-evaluate
       zero-locus vanishing vanishing-counterexample)
      '(polynomial point))
     (q1068976-universal-p
      (q1068976-radical-law-function
       variables small-carrier small-zero small-one
       ideal polynomial-multiply radical radical-witness)
      '(polynomial exponent chain)))))

(defun q1068976-nullstellensatz-function
    (variables carrier zero vanishing radical)
  (list
   'lambda '(polynomial)
   (q1068976-implies-term
    (q1068976-polynomial-valid-term
     'polynomial variables carrier zero)
    (q1068976-iff-term
     (q1068976-static-apply-term
      vanishing '(polynomial))
     (q1068976-static-apply-term
      radical '(polynomial))))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1068976-hilbert-nullstellensatz-statement
    (variables
     small-carrier small-add small-multiply small-negate small-inverse
     small-zero small-one
     large-carrier large-add large-multiply large-negate large-inverse
     large-zero large-one
     embedding algebraic-package polynomial-package ideal locus-package)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp variables)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal variables)
    (q1068976-field-p
     small-carrier small-add small-multiply
     small-negate small-inverse small-zero small-one)
    (q1068976-field-p
     large-carrier large-add large-multiply
     large-negate large-inverse large-zero large-one)
    (q1068976-field-embedding-p
     small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
    (q1068976-algebraically-closed-p
     large-carrier large-add large-multiply large-zero
     algebraic-package)
    (q1068976-polynomial-package-p
     variables
     small-carrier small-add small-multiply small-negate
     small-zero small-one
     large-carrier embedding large-add large-multiply
     polynomial-package)
    (q1068976-ideal-p
     variables small-carrier small-zero ideal polynomial-package)
    (q1068976-locus-package-p
     variables
     small-carrier small-zero small-one
     large-carrier large-zero
     ideal polynomial-package locus-package))
   (q1068976-universal-p
    (q1068976-nullstellensatz-function
     variables small-carrier small-zero
     (q1068976-vanishing locus-package)
     (q1068976-radical locus-package))
