title: Q1082910_euler_s_partition_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1082910,
% "Euler's partition theorem": for every natural n, partitions of n into odd parts and
% partitions of n into distinct parts have equal cardinality. This file contains no proof.

Q1082910_euler_s_partition_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  % For a fixed n, the n base-(n + 1) digits of code are the
  % multiplicities of the parts 1 through n.
  partition_sum(
      code, n, next_part, remaining_parts: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF remaining_parts = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      mod(code, n + 1) * next_part
        + partition_sum(
            ndiv(code, n + 1),
            n,
            next_part + 1,
            remaining_parts - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_parts

  distinct_digits(
      code, n, remaining_parts: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining_parts = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      mod(code, n + 1) <= 1
        AND distinct_digits(
            ndiv(code, n + 1),
            n,
            remaining_parts - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_parts

  odd_part_digits(
      code, n, next_part, remaining_parts: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining_parts = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      (mod(next_part, 2) = 1 OR mod(code, n + 1) = 0)
        AND odd_part_digits(
            ndiv(code, n + 1),
            n,
            next_part + 1,
            remaining_parts - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_parts

  partition_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < (n + 1) ^ n
      AND partition_sum(code, n, 1, n) = n

  distinct_partition_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    partition_code(code, n)
      AND distinct_digits(code, n, n)

  odd_partition_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    partition_code(code, n)
      AND odd_part_digits(code, n, 1, n)

  count_below(limit: nat, property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  distinct_partition_count(n: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      (n + 1) ^ n,
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): distinct_partition_code(code, n)))

  odd_partition_count(n: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      (n + 1) ^ n,
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): odd_partition_code(code, n)))

  euler_partition_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      odd_partition_count(n) = distinct_partition_count(n)
END Q1082910_euler_s_partition_theorem

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1097021
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1097021), "Minkowski's theorem": a convex symmetric
-- set of sufficiently large Haar measure contains a nonzero point of a countable lattice.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Body
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Defs
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Measure

public section

open ENNReal Module MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure Set Filter Function

open scoped Pointwise NNReal

namespace MeasureTheory

/-- A faithful reconstruction of the source predicate: the translates of the set are measurable,
cover almost everywhere, and are pairwise almost-everywhere disjoint. -/
structure IsAddFundamentalDomain (G : Type*) {α : Type*} [Zero G] [VAdd G α]
    [MeasurableSpace α] (s : Set α) (μ : Measure α) : Prop where
  protected nullMeasurableSet : NullMeasurableSet s μ
  protected ae_covers : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ g : G, g +ᵥ x ∈ s
  protected aedisjoint : Pairwise <| (AEDisjoint μ on fun g : G => g +ᵥ s)

end MeasureTheory

namespace Q1097021

variable {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] {μ : Measure E} {F s : Set E}

/-- The Minkowski convex body theorem. -/
theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_lattice_of_measure_mul_two_pow_lt_measure [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [BorelSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [IsAddHaarMeasure μ]
    {L : AddSubgroup E} [Countable L] (fund : MeasureTheory.IsAddFundamentalDomain L F μ)
    (h_symm : ∀ x ∈ s, -x ∈ s) (h_conv : Convex ℝ s)
    (h : μ F * 2 ^ finrank ℝ E < μ s) :
    ∃ x ≠ 0, ((x : L) : E) ∈ s := sorry

end Q1097021

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1097021
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1097021), "Minkowski's theorem": a convex
  origin-symmetric set whose Haar measure is sufficiently large relative to
  a fundamental domain contains a nonzero point of the countable lattice.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals Arith List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1097021_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1097021_empty {A : Type} : q1097021_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1097021_complement {A : Type}
    (S : q1097021_set A) : q1097021_set A :=
  fun x => ~ S x.

Definition q1097021_countable_union {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q1097021_set A) : q1097021_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, S n x.

Definition q1097021_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q1097021_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q1097021_intersection {A : Type}
    (S T : q1097021_set A) : q1097021_set A :=
  fun x => S x /\ T x.

Definition q1097021_symmetric_difference {A : Type}
    (S T : q1097021_set A) : q1097021_set A :=
  fun x => (S x /\ ~ T x) \/ (T x /\ ~ S x).

Record q1097021_normed_real_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1097021_zero : E;
  q1097021_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1097021_neg : E -> E;
  q1097021_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q1097021_norm : E -> R;
  q1097021_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1097021_add x (q1097021_add y z) =
      q1097021_add (q1097021_add x y) z;
  q1097021_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1097021_add x y = q1097021_add y x;
  q1097021_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1097021_add x q1097021_zero = x;
  q1097021_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1097021_add x (q1097021_neg x) = q1097021_zero;
  q1097021_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1097021_smul 1 x = x;
  q1097021_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1097021_smul (a * b) x =
      q1097021_smul a (q1097021_smul b x);
  q1097021_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1097021_smul (a + b) x =
      q1097021_add (q1097021_smul a x) (q1097021_smul b x);
  q1097021_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q1097021_smul a (q1097021_add x y) =
      q1097021_add (q1097021_smul a x) (q1097021_smul a y);
  q1097021_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1097021_norm x;
  q1097021_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1097021_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1097021_zero;
  q1097021_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1097021_norm (q1097021_add x y) <=
      q1097021_norm x + q1097021_norm y;
  q1097021_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q1097021_norm (q1097021_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q1097021_norm x
}.

Arguments q1097021_zero {E} _.
Arguments q1097021_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1097021_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q1097021_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1097021_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q1097021_sub {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1097021_add V x (q1097021_neg V y).

Fixpoint q1097021_vector_sum
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> E) -> E :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> E) -> E with
  | O => fun _ => q1097021_zero V
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q1097021_add V
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1097021_vector_sum E V k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q1097021_vector_sum {E} V n _.

Record q1097021_finite_dimensional
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q1097021_dimension : nat;
  q1097021_basis : Fin.t q1097021_dimension -> E;
  q1097021_basis_spans :
    forall x : E,
      exists coefficients : Fin.t q1097021_dimension -> R,
        x =
          q1097021_vector_sum V q1097021_dimension
            (fun i =>
              q1097021_smul V
                (coefficients i) (q1097021_basis i));
  q1097021_basis_independent :
    forall coefficients : Fin.t q1097021_dimension -> R,
      q1097021_vector_sum V q1097021_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q1097021_smul V
            (coefficients i) (q1097021_basis i)) =
        q1097021_zero V ->
      forall i : Fin.t q1097021_dimension,
        coefficients i = 0
}.

Arguments q1097021_dimension {E V} _.

Definition q1097021_dist {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : R :=
  q1097021_norm V (q1097021_sub V x y).

Definition q1097021_open {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (U : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : E,
        q1097021_dist V y x < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q1097021_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q1097021_set (q1097021_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q1097021_empty /\
  (forall S : q1097021_set A,
    C S -> C (q1097021_complement S)) /\
  (forall S : nat -> q1097021_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (S n)) ->
    C (q1097021_countable_union S)).

Definition q1097021_borel_set {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (S : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  forall C : q1097021_set (q1097021_set E),
    q1097021_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q1097021_set E,
      q1097021_open V U -> C U) ->
    C S.

Definition q1097021_compact {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (K : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q1097021_set (q1097021_set E),
    (forall U : q1097021_set E,
      cover U -> q1097021_open V U) ->
    (forall x : E,
      K x ->
      exists U : q1097021_set E, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q1097021_set E),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : E,
        K x ->
        exists U : q1097021_set E,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Inductive q1097021_ennreal : Type :=
| q1097021_ennreal_finite : R -> q1097021_ennreal
| q1097021_ennreal_infinity : q1097021_ennreal.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_valid
    (x : q1097021_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite value => 0 <= value
  | q1097021_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_zero : q1097021_ennreal :=
  q1097021_ennreal_finite 0.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1097021_ennreal) : q1097021_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite a, q1097021_ennreal_finite b =>
      q1097021_ennreal_finite (a + b)
  | _, _ => q1097021_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q1097021_ennreal) : q1097021_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite a, q1097021_ennreal_finite b =>
      q1097021_ennreal_finite (a * b)
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite a, q1097021_ennreal_infinity
  | q1097021_ennreal_infinity, q1097021_ennreal_finite a =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q1097021_ennreal_zero
      else q1097021_ennreal_infinity
  | q1097021_ennreal_infinity, q1097021_ennreal_infinity =>
      q1097021_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1097021_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite a, q1097021_ennreal_finite b => a <= b
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite _, q1097021_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q1097021_ennreal_infinity, q1097021_ennreal_finite _ => False
  | q1097021_ennreal_infinity, q1097021_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_lt
    (x y : q1097021_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite a, q1097021_ennreal_finite b => a < b
  | q1097021_ennreal_finite _, q1097021_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Fixpoint q1097021_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1097021_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q1097021_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1097021_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1097021_ennreal_add
        (q1097021_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1097021_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1097021_ennreal)
    (total : q1097021_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1097021_ennreal_valid total /\
  (forall n : nat,
    q1097021_ennreal_le
      (q1097021_ennreal_partial_sum u n) total) /\
  forall upper : q1097021_ennreal,
    q1097021_ennreal_valid upper ->
    (forall n : nat,
      q1097021_ennreal_le
        (q1097021_ennreal_partial_sum u n) upper) ->
    q1097021_ennreal_le total upper.

Definition q1097021_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q1097021_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j ->
    forall x : A, ~ (S i x /\ S j x).

Record q1097021_borel_measure
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q1097021_measure :
    q1097021_set E -> q1097021_ennreal;
  q1097021_measure_valid :
    forall S : q1097021_set E,
      q1097021_ennreal_valid (q1097021_measure S);
  q1097021_measure_extensional :
    forall S T : q1097021_set E,
      q1097021_same_set S T ->
      q1097021_measure S = q1097021_measure T;
  q1097021_measure_empty :
    q1097021_measure q1097021_empty =
      q1097021_ennreal_zero;
  q1097021_measure_monotone :
    forall S T : q1097021_set E,
      (forall x : E, S x -> T x) ->
      q1097021_ennreal_le
        (q1097021_measure S) (q1097021_measure T);
  q1097021_measure_canonical_extension :
    forall (S : q1097021_set E)
           (lower : q1097021_ennreal),
      q1097021_ennreal_valid lower ->
      ((forall T : q1097021_set E,
          q1097021_borel_set V T ->
          (forall x : E, S x -> T x) ->
          q1097021_ennreal_le lower
            (q1097021_measure T)) <->
       q1097021_ennreal_le lower
         (q1097021_measure S));
  q1097021_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall S : nat -> q1097021_set E,
      exists total : q1097021_ennreal,
        q1097021_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q1097021_measure (S n)) total /\
        q1097021_ennreal_le
          (q1097021_measure (q1097021_countable_union S))
          total;
  q1097021_measure_countable_additive :
    forall S : nat -> q1097021_set E,
      (forall n : nat, q1097021_borel_set V (S n)) ->
      q1097021_pairwise_disjoint S ->
      exists total : q1097021_ennreal,
        q1097021_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q1097021_measure (S n)) total /\
        q1097021_measure (q1097021_countable_union S) = total
}.

Arguments q1097021_measure {E V} _ _.

Definition q1097021_null_measurable {E : Type}
    {V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (mu : q1097021_borel_measure V)
    (S : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  exists T : q1097021_set E,
    q1097021_borel_set V T /\
    q1097021_measure mu
      (q1097021_symmetric_difference S T) =
      q1097021_ennreal_zero.

Record q1097021_add_haar_measure
    {E : Type}
    {V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (mu : q1097021_borel_measure V) : Prop := {
  q1097021_haar_left_invariant :
    forall (a : E) (S : q1097021_set E),
      q1097021_measure mu
        (fun x : E => S (q1097021_add V a x)) =
      q1097021_measure mu S;
  q1097021_haar_finite_on_compact :
    forall K : q1097021_set E,
      q1097021_compact V K ->
      q1097021_ennreal_lt
        (q1097021_measure mu K)
        q1097021_ennreal_infinity;
  q1097021_haar_positive_on_nonempty_open :
    forall U : q1097021_set E,
      q1097021_open V U ->
      (exists x : E, U x) ->
      q1097021_measure mu U <> q1097021_ennreal_zero
}.

Definition q1097021_add_subgroup {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  L (q1097021_zero V) /\
  (forall x y : E,
    L x -> L y -> L (q1097021_add V x y)) /\
  forall x : E,
    L x -> L (q1097021_neg V x).

Definition q1097021_countable_set {E : Type}
    (L : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  exists encode : E -> nat,
    forall x y : E,
      L x ->
      L y ->
      encode x = encode y ->
      x = y.

Definition q1097021_translate {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (a : E)
    (S : q1097021_set E) : q1097021_set E :=
  fun x : E =>
    exists y : E, S y /\ x = q1097021_add V a y.

Record q1097021_is_add_fundamental_domain
    {E : Type}
    {V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (mu : q1097021_borel_measure V)
    (L F : q1097021_set E) : Prop := {
  q1097021_fund_null_measurable :
    q1097021_null_measurable mu F;
  q1097021_fund_ae_covers :
    q1097021_measure mu
      (fun x : E =>
        ~ exists g : E,
          L g /\ q1097021_translate V g F x) =
      q1097021_ennreal_zero;
  q1097021_fund_ae_disjoint :
    forall g h : E,
      L g ->
      L h ->
      g <> h ->
      q1097021_measure mu
        (q1097021_intersection
          (q1097021_translate V g F)
          (q1097021_translate V h F)) =
        q1097021_ennreal_zero
}.

Definition q1097021_origin_symmetric {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (S : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    S x -> S (q1097021_neg V x).

Definition q1097021_convex {E : Type}
    (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (S : q1097021_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : E) (a b : R),
    S x ->
    S y ->
    0 <= a ->
    0 <= b ->
    a + b = 1 ->
    S
      (q1097021_add V
        (q1097021_smul V a x)
        (q1097021_smul V b y)).

Definition q1097021_two_pow
    (n : nat) : q1097021_ennreal :=
  q1097021_ennreal_finite (INR (Nat.pow 2 n)).

Theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_lattice_of_measure_mul_two_pow_lt_measure :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q1097021_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (D : q1097021_finite_dimensional V)
         (mu : q1097021_borel_measure V)
         (L F S : q1097021_set E),
    q1097021_add_haar_measure mu ->
    q1097021_add_subgroup V L ->
    q1097021_countable_set L ->
    q1097021_is_add_fundamental_domain mu L F ->
    q1097021_origin_symmetric V S ->
    q1097021_convex V S ->
    q1097021_ennreal_lt
      (q1097021_ennreal_mul
        (q1097021_measure mu F)
        (q1097021_two_pow (q1097021_dimension D)))
      (q1097021_measure mu S) ->
    exists x : E,
      L x /\ x <> q1097021_zero V /\ S x.
Admitted.

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1097021,
  "Minkowski's theorem": in a finite-dimensional real normed vector space, a
  convex set symmetric about zero whose additive Haar measure is greater than
  2 to the dimension times the measure of a fundamental domain of a countable
  additive subgroup contains a nonzero point of that subgroup. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Convex"
    "HOL-Analysis.Complete_Measure"
begin

definition q1097021_finite_dimensional ::
    "'a::real_vector itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1097021_finite_dimensional _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B :: 'a set. finite_dimensional_vector_space ((*\<^sub>R)) B)"

definition q1097021_dimension ::
    "'a::real_vector itself \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1097021_dimension _ = dim (UNIV :: 'a set)"

definition q1097021_null_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1097021_null_measurable M A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B \<in> sets M. AE x in M. (x \<in> A) = (x \<in> B))"

definition q1097021_add_subgroup ::
    "'a::ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1097021_add_subgroup L \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> L \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> L. \<forall>y \<in> L. x + y \<in> L) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> L. -x \<in> L)"

definition q1097021_translate ::
    "'a::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q1097021_translate a A = ((+) a) ` A"

definition q1097021_is_add_haar_measure ::
    "'a::real_normed_vector measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1097021_is_add_haar_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a A. A \<in> sets M \<longrightarrow>
      emeasure M (q1097021_translate a A) = emeasure M A) \<and>
    (\<forall>K. compact K \<longrightarrow> emeasure M K < \<infinity>) \<and>
    (\<forall>U. open U \<longrightarrow> U \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow> 0 < emeasure M U)"

definition q1097021_is_add_fundamental_domain ::
    "'a::ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1097021_is_add_fundamental_domain L F M \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1097021_null_measurable M F \<and>
    (AE x in M. \<exists>a \<in> L. a + x \<in> F) \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> L. \<forall>b \<in> L. a \<noteq> b \<longrightarrow>
      (AE x in M.
        \<not> (x \<in> q1097021_translate a F \<and>
          x \<in> q1097021_translate b F)))"

theorem minkowski_s_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a::real_normed_vector measure"
    and L F S :: "'a set"
  assumes borel_space:
      "sets M = sets (borel :: 'a measure)"
    and finite_dimensional:
      "q1097021_finite_dimensional TYPE('a)"
    and haar_measure:
      "q1097021_is_add_haar_measure M"
    and subgroup:
      "q1097021_add_subgroup L"
    and countable_subgroup:
      "countable L"
    and fundamental_domain:
      "q1097021_is_add_fundamental_domain L F M"
    and symmetric:
      "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> -x \<in> S"
    and convex:
      "convex S"
    and large_measure:
      "outer_measure_of M F * (2::ennreal) ^ q1097021_dimension TYPE('a) <
        outer_measure_of M S"
  shows
      "\<exists>x \<in> L. x \<noteq> 0 \<and> x \<in> S"
  sorry

end

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1097021,
  "Minkowski's theorem": a convex symmetric set whose Haar measure is larger
  than 2^n times the measure of a fundamental domain of a countable additive
  subgroup in an n-dimensional real normed vector space contains a nonzero
  subgroup element. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1097021_MINKOWSKI_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let elt =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        ~(FST x) /\ (FST y \/ SND x < SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then (F,&0)
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!i. enonnegative (u i) /\ ele (u i) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!i. ele (u i) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!t:A->bool. events t ==> events ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF t)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!i. events (sets i))
           ==> events {x:A | ?i. x IN sets i}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!t:A->bool. enonnegative (mu t)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s t:A->bool.
           events t /\ s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!s:A->bool. !z:bool#real.
           enonnegative z /\
           (!t:A->bool.
              events t /\ s SUBSET t ==> ele z (mu t))
           ==> ele z (mu s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!i. events (sets i)) /\
           (!i j. ~(i = j) ==> DISJOINT (sets i) (sets j))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!i. partial (SUC i) =
                      eadd (partial i) (mu (sets i))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:A | ?i. x IN sets i})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (P:A->bool).
        ?N:A->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:A | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let null_measurable_set =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (t:A->bool).
        ?u:A->bool.
          events u /\
          almost_everywhere events mu
            (\x:A. x IN t <=> x IN u) in
   let normed_real_vector_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real).
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
        (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real. !x:A.
           smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real. !x:A.
           smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a:real. !x y:A.
           smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. !x:A. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
        (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let linear_combination =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A)
       (n:num) (basis:num->A) (coeff:num->real) (x:A).
        ?partial:num->A.
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   add (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial n = x in
   let has_dimension =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A)
       (n:num) (basis:num->A).
        (!x:A. ?coeff:num->real.
           linear_combination zero add smul n basis coeff x) /\
        (!c d:num->real. !x:A.
           linear_combination zero add smul n basis c x /\
           linear_combination zero add smul n basis d x
           ==> !i. i < n ==> c i = d i) in
   let open_set =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (u:A->bool).
        !x:A.
          x IN u
          ==> ?e:real.
                &0 < e /\
                !y:A.
                  norm (add y (neg x)) < e ==> y IN u in
   let tends_to =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (seq:num->A) (x:A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?N:num. !i:num.
                N <= i ==> norm (add (seq i) (neg x)) < e in
   let compact_set =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (k:A->bool).
        !seq:num->A.
          (!i. seq i IN k)
          ==> ?sub:num->num. ?x:A.
                x IN k /\
                (!i. sub i < sub (SUC i)) /\
                tends_to add neg norm (\i. seq (sub i)) x in
   let borel_space =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           open_set add neg norm u ==> events u) /\
        (!other:(A->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!u:A->bool.
              open_set add neg norm u ==> other u)
           ==> !t:A->bool. events t ==> other t) in
   let translate =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (a:A) (t:A->bool).
        {x:A | add (neg a) x IN t} in
   let additive_subgroup =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (L:A->bool).
        zero IN L /\
        (!x y:A. x IN L /\ y IN L ==> add x y IN L) /\
        (!x:A. x IN L ==> neg x IN L) in
   let is_add_haar_measure =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!a:A. !t:A->bool.
           events t
           ==> mu (translate add neg a t) = mu t) /\
        (!k:A->bool.
           compact_set add neg norm k ==> ~(FST (mu k))) /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           open_set add neg norm u /\ ~(u = {})
           ==> ~(mu u = ezero)) in
   let ae_disjoint =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (s:A->bool) (t:A->bool).
        almost_everywhere events mu
          (\x:A. ~(x IN s /\ x IN t)) in
   let is_add_fundamental_domain =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (L:A->bool) (fd:A->bool).
        null_measurable_set events mu fd /\
        almost_everywhere events mu
          (\x:A. ?g:A. g IN L /\ add g x IN fd) /\
        (!g h:A.
           g IN L /\ h IN L /\ ~(g = h)
           ==> ae_disjoint events mu
                 (translate add neg g fd)
                 (translate add neg h fd)) in
   let convex_set =
      \(add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (s:A->bool).
        !x y:A. !a b:real.
          x IN s /\ y IN s /\
          &0 <= a /\ &0 <= b /\ a + b = &1
          ==> add (smul a x) (smul b y) IN s in
   !zero:A.
   !add:A->A->A.
   !neg:A->A.
   !smul:real->A->A.
   !norm:A->real.
   !events:(A->bool)->bool.
   !mu:(A->bool)->bool#real.
   !L fd s:A->bool.
     normed_real_vector_space zero add neg smul norm /\
     borel_space add neg norm events /\
     measure_space events mu /\
     is_add_haar_measure zero add neg norm events mu /\
     additive_subgroup zero add neg L /\
     COUNTABLE L /\
     is_add_fundamental_domain add neg events mu L fd /\
     (!x:A. x IN s ==> neg x IN s) /\
     convex_set add smul s /\
     (?n:num. ?basis:num->A.
        has_dimension zero add smul n basis /\
        elt
          (emul (mu fd) (F,&2 pow n))
          (mu s))
     ==> ?x:A. x IN L /\ ~(x = zero) /\ x IN s`;;

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1097021,
;; "Minkowski's theorem": in a finite-dimensional real normed vector space
;; with additive Haar measure, a convex centrally symmetric set whose measure
;; exceeds 2^dim times the measure of a fundamental domain for a countable
;; additive subgroup contains a nonzero point of that subgroup. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, operations, sequences, and families are tame APPLY$
;; function objects.  FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification,
;; and inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal
;; existential quantification.  The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete
;; ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.  The explicit basis
;; and coordinate map witness finite dimensionality without fixing a finite
;; carrier.  The norm defines the topology, MEASURABLE is required to be its
;; Borel sigma-algebra, and MEASURE is an extended-nonnegative-real-valued
;; countably additive measure with its outer values on arbitrary sets.  Haar
;; measure, an arbitrary countable additive subgroup, and its measurable
;; fundamental domain are represented with all defining laws explicit.
;;
;; A basis and coordinate map witness finite dimensionality, while a
;; surjective natural-number enumeration witnesses countability of the
;; subgroup. Universally closing the resulting statement over either witness
;; is equivalent to assuming existence of that structure, since the
;; conclusion is independent of the choices and all finite bases have the
;; same length.

(defun q1097021-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1097021-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q1097021-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1097021-quoted nil)))

(defun q1097021-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q1097021-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1097021-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1097021-apply-term
   (q1097021-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q1097021-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1097021-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q1097021-quoted nil))
    (q1097021-quoted t)))

(defun q1097021-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1097021-quoted t)
       (q1097021-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q1097021-quoted nil)))

(defun q1097021-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q1097021-quoted nil)
   (q1097021-quoted t)))

(defun q1097021-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q1097021-quoted t)))

(defun q1097021-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1097021-quoted t)
    (q1097021-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1097021-quoted nil)
    (q1097021-quoted t))))

(defun q1097021-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1097021-quoted t)))

(defun q1097021-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1097021-quoted nil)))

(defun q1097021-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (q1097021-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q1097021-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false
         (q1097021-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q1097021-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1097021-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q1097021-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets over an arbitrary carrier.

(defun q1097021-set-subset-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1097021-implies-term
    (q1097021-and-terms
     (list
      (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q1097021-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q1097021-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q1097021-set-subset-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (q1097021-universal-p
    (q1097021-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q1097021-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q1097021-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun q1097021-set-equiv-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1097021-implies-term
    (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q1097021-iff-term
     (q1097021-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q1097021-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q1097021-set-equiv-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q1097021-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q1097021-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q1097021-universal-p
    (q1097021-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q1097021-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (q1097021-quoted nil)))

(defun q1097021-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1097021-and-terms
    (list
     (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q1097021-not-term
      (q1097021-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun q1097021-intersection-set (left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1097021-and-terms
    (list
     (q1097021-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q1097021-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q1097021-symmetric-difference-set
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1097021-and-terms
    (list
     (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q1097021-or-terms
      (list
       (q1097021-and-terms
        (list
         (q1097021-static-apply-term left '(x))
         (q1097021-not-term
          (q1097021-static-apply-term right '(x)))))
       (q1097021-and-terms
        (list
         (q1097021-static-apply-term right '(x))
         (q1097021-not-term
          (q1097021-static-apply-term left '(x)))))))))))

(defun q1097021-set-nonempty-function
    (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1097021-and-terms
    (list
     (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q1097021-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun q1097021-set-nonempty-p
    (carrier set)
  (and
   (q1097021-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1097021-exists-p
    (q1097021-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun q1097021-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add
          (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add
          (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul
          (q1097021-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul
          (q1097021-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q1097021-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x
          (q1097021-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q1097021-implies-term
      (q1097021-and-terms
       (list
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1097021-and-terms
       (list
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))

(defun q1097021-order-laws-function

     'lambda

        (q1097021-or-terms

        (q1097021-implies-term
         (q1097021-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q1097021-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q1097021-implies-term
         xy
         (q1097021-static-apply-term

           (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(x z))

        (q1097021-implies-term

(defun q1097021-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)

   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (q1097021-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1097021-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1097021-member-p
    carrier
    (q1097021-unary-value inverse zero))
   (q1097021-universal-p
    (q1097021-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (q1097021-universal-p
    (q1097021-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (q1097021-member-p
    carrier
    (q1097021-unary-value supremum
                           (q1097021-empty-set)))
   (q1097021-universal-p
    (q1097021-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (q1097021-binary-value less zero one)))

;; Finite-dimensional normed vector spaces over the represented real field.

(defun q1097021-vector-laws-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add negate smul)
  (let* ((xy
          (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz
          (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q1097021-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (a-x
          (q1097021-static-apply-term smul '(a x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a b x y z)
     (q1097021-implies-term
      (q1097021-and-terms
       (list
        (q1097021-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(a))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(b))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1097021-and-terms
       (list
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier (list xy))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier (list a-x))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term add (list xy 'z))
         (q1097021-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy
         (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x (q1097021-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
         (q1097021-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list (q1097021-quoted scalar-one) 'x))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           (q1097021-static-apply-term
            scalar-multiply
            '(a b))
           'x))
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           'a
           (q1097021-static-apply-term smul '(b x)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           (q1097021-static-apply-term scalar-add '(a b))
           'x))
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           a-x
           (q1097021-static-apply-term smul '(b x)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term smul (list 'a xy))
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           a-x
           (q1097021-static-apply-term smul '(a y)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list (q1097021-quoted scalar-zero) 'x))
         (q1097021-quoted zero))))))))

(defun q1097021-norm-laws-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate
     scalar-less carrier zero add negate smul norm)
  (let* ((norm-x
          (q1097021-static-apply-term norm '(x)))
         (norm-y
          (q1097021-static-apply-term norm '(y)))
         (norm-a-x
          (q1097021-static-apply-term
           norm
           (list
            (q1097021-static-apply-term smul '(a x)))))
         (abs-a
          (list
           'q1097021-scalar-absolute-value
           (q1097021-quoted scalar-less)
           (q1097021-quoted scalar-zero)
           (q1097021-quoted scalar-negate)
           'a)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a x y)
     (q1097021-implies-term
      (q1097021-and-terms
       (list
        (q1097021-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(a))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1097021-static-apply-term carrier '(y))))
      (q1097021-and-terms
       (list
        (q1097021-static-apply-term scalar-carrier (list norm-x))
        (q1097021-not-term
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          scalar-less
          (list norm-x (q1097021-quoted scalar-zero))))
        (q1097021-iff-term
         (list 'equal norm-x (q1097021-quoted scalar-zero))
         (list 'equal 'x (q1097021-quoted zero)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          norm
          (list
           (q1097021-static-apply-term negate '(x))))
         norm-x)
        (list
         'equal
         norm-a-x
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          scalar-multiply
          (list abs-a norm-x)))
        (q1097021-not-term
         (q1097021-static-apply-term
          scalar-less
          (list
           (q1097021-static-apply-term
            scalar-add
            (list norm-x norm-y))
           (q1097021-static-apply-term
            norm
            (list
             (q1097021-static-apply-term add '(x y)))))))))))))

(defun q1097021-normed-vector-space-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     scalar-negate scalar-less
     carrier zero add negate smul norm)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp smul)
   (tamep-functionp norm)

    (q1097021-vector-laws-function

     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate

(defun q1097021-basis-spanning-function

;; Extended nonnegative real values built from the represented real field.

(defun q1097021-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :q1097021-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q1097021-finite)
    (q1097021-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (q1097021-scalar-nonnegative-p
     scalar-less scalar-zero (cdr value)))))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q1097021-finite value))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (q1097021-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-less-p
    (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q1097021-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q1097021-top) t)
   (t
    (q1097021-binary-value
     scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-less-equal-p
    (left right scalar-less)
  (not
   (q1097021-ennreal-less-p
    right left scalar-less)))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-add
    (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :q1097021-top)
          (equal right :q1097021-top))
      :q1097021-top
    (q1097021-ennreal-finite
     (q1097021-binary-value
      scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left
               (q1097021-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right
               (q1097021-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (q1097021-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :q1097021-top)
        (equal right :q1097021-top))
    :q1097021-top)
   (t
    (q1097021-ennreal-finite
     (q1097021-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q1097021-ennreal-two-power
    (dimension scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply)
  (q1097021-ennreal-finite
   (q1097021-field-power
    (q1097021-field-natural
     2 scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add)
    dimension scalar-one scalar-multiply)))

    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less

  (and
   (tamep-functionp measure)
   (q1097021-universal-p

(defun q1097021-compact-finite-function
