title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1097021,
-- "Minkowski's theorem": a convex origin-symmetric set in a finite-dimensional
-- real normed space whose Haar measure exceeds 2^dimension times a lattice
-- fundamental-domain measure contains a nonzero lattice point.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessThanR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR
    negate-involutive :
      (x : R) ->
      negateR (negateR x) == x

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-irreflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessThanR x x ->
      Bottom
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessThanR x y ->
      lessThanR y z ->
      lessThanR x z
    order-trichotomy :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR x y or
      (x == y or lessThanR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessThanR x y ->
      lessThanR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-positive :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR zeroR x ->
      lessThanR zeroR y ->
      lessThanR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessThanR zeroR oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessThanR zeroR (absoluteR x) or absoluteR x == zeroR
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      (lessThanR zeroR x or zeroR == x) ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      (lessThanR x zeroR or x == zeroR) ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)
    absolute-triangle :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)) or
      absoluteR (addR x y) ==
        addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessThanR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessThanR x upper or x == upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessThanR x supremum or x == supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessThanR x upper or x == upper) ->
            lessThanR supremum upper or supremum == upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

LessOrEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
LessOrEqual reals x y =
  lessThanR reals x y or x == y

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals x (powerR reals x n)

twoPowerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
twoPowerR reals n =
  powerR reals
    (addR reals (oneR reals) (oneR reals))
    n

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) :
  Set1 where

  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (inverseR source x) ==
      inverseR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) ==
      fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessThanR source x y)
        (lessThanR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set2 where

  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

record NormedRealVectorSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zero :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-only :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negate :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-triangle :
      (x y : E) ->
      LessOrEqual reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normE x)

open NormedRealVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

record FiniteDimensional
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals) :
  Set1 where

  field
    dimension : Nat
    coordinates : E -> Fin dimension -> R
    rebuild : (Fin dimension -> R) -> E

    rebuild-coordinates :
      (x : E) ->
      rebuild (coordinates x) == x
    coordinates-rebuild :
      (values : Fin dimension -> R) ->
      (i : Fin dimension) ->
      coordinates (rebuild values) i == values i
    coordinates-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      (i : Fin dimension) ->
      coordinates (addE space x y) i ==
      addR reals (coordinates x i) (coordinates y i)
    coordinates-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      (i : Fin dimension) ->
      coordinates (scaleE space a x) i ==
      multiplyR reals a (coordinates x i)

open FiniteDimensional

Region : Set -> Set1
Region E =
  E -> Set

Empty :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Whole :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E
Whole _ =
  Bottom -> Bottom

Complement :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E ->
  Region E
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

Intersection :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E ->
  Region E ->
  Region E
Intersection S T x =
  S x and T x

Union :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E ->
  Region E ->
  Region E
Union S T x =
  S x or T x

UnionAll :
  {E : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region E) ->
  Region E
UnionAll sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E ->
  Region E ->
  Set
Subset {E = E} S T =
  (x : E) ->
  S x ->
  T x

Disjoint :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E ->
  Region E ->
  Set
Disjoint {E = E} S T =
  (x : E) ->
  S x ->
  T x ->
  Bottom

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {E : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Region E) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint sets =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m != n ->
  Disjoint (sets m) (sets n)

translateRegion :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  Region E ->
  Region E
translateRegion {E = E} space offset S x =
  Exists E
    (\ y ->
      S y and
      x == addE space offset y)

Open :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Region E ->
  Set
Open {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space U =
  (x : E) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ epsilon ->
      lessThanR reals (zeroR reals) epsilon and
      ((y : E) ->
        lessThanR reals
          (normE space (subtractE space y x))
          epsilon ->
        U y))

ConvergesTo :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  lessThanR reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      lessThanR reals
        (normE space (subtractE space (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

StrictlyIncreasing :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
StrictlyIncreasing subsequence =
  (n : Nat) ->
  subsequence n <N subsequence (suc n)

Compact :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Region E ->
  Set
Compact {E = E} space K =
  (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> K (sequence n)) ->
  Exists (Nat -> Nat)
    (\ subsequence ->
      StrictlyIncreasing subsequence and
      Exists E
        (\ limit ->
          ConvergesTo space
            (\ n -> sequence (subsequence n))
            limit
          and
          K limit))

Convex :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Region E ->
  Set
Convex {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space S =
  (x y : E) ->
  S x ->
  S y ->
  (t : R) ->
  LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  LessOrEqual reals t (oneR reals) ->
  S
    (addE space
      (scaleE space t x)
      (scaleE space
        (subtractR reals (oneR reals) t)
        y))

OriginSymmetric :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Region E ->
  Set
OriginSymmetric {E = E} space S =
  (x : E) ->
  S x ->
  S (negateE space x)

data Borel
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals) :
  Region E ->
  Set1 where

  open-borel :
    (U : Region E) ->
    Open space U ->
    Borel space U

  complement-borel :
    {S : Region E} ->
    Borel space S ->
    Borel space (Complement S)

  union-borel :
    (sets : Nat -> Region E) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> Borel space (sets n)) ->
    Borel space (UnionAll sets)

  congruent-borel :
    {S T : Region E} ->
    ((x : E) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    Borel space S ->
    Borel space T

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set where

  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroM oneM infinityM :
      M
    addM multiplyM :
      M -> M -> M
    lessOrEqualM :
      M -> M -> Set
    finiteM :
      (x : R) ->
      LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      M

    zero-leastM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatestM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    infinity-not-zeroM :
      infinityM != zeroM
    one-not-zeroM :
      oneM != zeroM
    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y or lessOrEqualM y x

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x
    add-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x infinityM == infinityM
    add-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM w y) (addM x z)

    multiply-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) ->
      multiplyM x y == multiplyM y x
    multiply-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM (multiplyM x y) z ==
      multiplyM x (multiplyM y z)
    multiply-oneM :
      (x : M) ->
      multiplyM x oneM == x
    multiply-zeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      multiplyM x zeroM == zeroM
    multiply-distributesM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM x (addM y z) ==
      addM (multiplyM x y) (multiplyM x z)
    multiply-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM
        (multiplyM w y)
        (multiplyM x z)
    multiply-infinity-nonzeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      x != zeroM ->
      multiplyM x infinityM == infinityM

    finite-zeroM :
      (hzero : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)) ->
      finiteM (zeroR reals) hzero == zeroM
    finite-oneM :
      (hone : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) (oneR reals)) ->
      finiteM (oneR reals) hone == oneM
    finite-orderM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy))
        (LessOrEqual reals x y)
    finite-addM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (LessOrEqual reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (addR reals x y))
        (\ hsum ->
          addM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (addR reals x y) hsum)
    finite-multiplyM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (LessOrEqual reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (multiplyR reals x y))
        (\ hproduct ->
          multiplyM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (multiplyR reals x y) hproduct)
    finite-or-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      x == infinityM or
      Exists R
        (\ value ->
          Exists
            (LessOrEqual reals (zeroR reals) value)
            (\ nonnegative ->
              x == finiteM value nonnegative))

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

finiteNN :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  M
finiteNN extended x =
  finiteM extended
    (realValue x)
    (realValue-nonnegative x)

StrictLessM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set
StrictLessM extended x y =
  lessOrEqualM extended x y and x != y

powerM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  M ->
  Nat ->
  M
powerM extended x zero =
  oneM extended
powerM extended x (suc n) =
  multiplyM extended x (powerM extended x n)

sumFirstM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M
sumFirstM extended zero term =
  zeroM extended
sumFirstM extended (suc n) term =
  addM extended
    (sumFirstM extended n term)
    (term n)

CountableSum :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
CountableSum extended terms value =
  ((n : Nat) ->
    lessOrEqualM extended
      (sumFirstM extended n terms)
      value)
  and
  ((upper : _) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (sumFirstM extended n terms)
        upper) ->
    lessOrEqualM extended value upper)

data CanonicalENNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set where

  finite-ennreal :
    NonnegativeReal reals ->
    CanonicalENNReal reals
  infinity-ennreal :
    CanonicalENNReal reals

CanonicalENNRealLe :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  Set
CanonicalENNRealLe
  {reals = reals}
  (finite-ennreal x)
  (finite-ennreal y) =
  LessOrEqual reals (realValue x) (realValue y)
CanonicalENNRealLe (finite-ennreal x) infinity-ennreal =
  Top
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal (finite-ennreal y) =
  Bottom
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal infinity-ennreal =
  Top

record ENNRealPresentation
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) :
  Set1 where

  field
    toCanonicalENNReal :
      M ->
      CanonicalENNReal reals
    fromCanonicalENNReal :
      CanonicalENNReal reals ->
      M
    to-after-fromENNReal :
      (x : CanonicalENNReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (fromCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    from-after-toENNReal :
      (x : M) ->
      fromCanonicalENNReal (toCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    finite-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (finiteNN extended x) ==
      finite-ennreal x
    infinity-correspondenceENNReal :
      toCanonicalENNReal (infinityM extended) ==
      infinity-ennreal
    order-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x y : M) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
        (CanonicalENNRealLe
          (toCanonicalENNReal x)
          (toCanonicalENNReal y))

record BorelMeasure
  {R E M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) :
  Set1 where

  field
    mass :
      Region E ->
      M

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Region E) ->
      ((x : E) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      mass S == mass T
    mass-empty :
      mass Empty == zeroM extended
    mass-nonnegative :
      (S : Region E) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (zeroM extended)
        (mass S)
    mass-monotone :
      (S T : Region E) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (mass S) (mass T)
    mass-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Region E) ->
      (sumValue : M) ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (mass (UnionAll sets))
        sumValue
    borel-caratheodory :
      (S : Region E) ->
      Borel space S ->
      (T : Region E) ->
      mass T ==
      addM extended
        (mass (Intersection T S))
        (mass (Intersection T (Complement S)))
    mass-countable-additive :
      (sets : Nat -> Region E) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> Borel space (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        (mass (UnionAll sets))

open BorelMeasure

AlmostEverywhere :
  {R E M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  BorelMeasure space extended ->
  Region E ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere {extended = extended} measure P =
  mass measure (Complement P) == zeroM extended

AEDisjoint :
  {R E M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  BorelMeasure space extended ->
  Region E ->
  Region E ->
  Set
AEDisjoint {extended = extended} measure S T =
  mass measure (Intersection S T) == zeroM extended

SymmetricDifference :
  {E : Set} ->
  Region E ->
  Region E ->
  Region E
SymmetricDifference S T =
  Union
    (Intersection S (Complement T))
    (Intersection T (Complement S))

record NullMeasurable
  {R E M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : BorelMeasure space extended)
  (S : Region E) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measurable-representative :
      Region E
    representative-borel :
      Borel space measurable-representative
    null-envelope :
      Region E
    null-envelope-borel :
      Borel space null-envelope
    null-envelope-has-zero-mass :
      mass measure null-envelope ==
      zeroM extended
    symmetric-difference-contained-in-null-envelope :
      Subset
        (SymmetricDifference S measurable-representative)
        null-envelope

record IsAddHaarMeasure
  {R E M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : BorelMeasure space extended) :
  Set1 where

  field
    left-invariant :
      (offset : E) ->
      (S : Region E) ->
      Borel space S ->
      mass measure (translateRegion space offset S) ==
      mass measure S

    finite-on-compacts :
      (K : Region E) ->
      Compact space K ->
      mass measure K != infinityM extended

    positive-on-nonempty-open :
      (U : Region E) ->
      Open space U ->
      Exists E U ->
      mass measure U != zeroM extended

record AddSubgroup
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals) :
  Set1 where

  field
    contains : E -> Set
    contains-zero :
      contains (zeroE space)
    contains-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      contains x ->
      contains y ->
      contains (addE space x y)
    contains-negate :
      (x : E) ->
      contains x ->
      contains (negateE space x)

open AddSubgroup

record CountableSubgroup
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals}
  (lattice : AddSubgroup space) :
  Set1 where

  field
    enumerate :
      Nat -> E
    enumerate-in-lattice :
      (n : Nat) ->
      contains lattice (enumerate n)
    enumerate-surjective :
      (x : E) ->
      contains lattice x ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> enumerate n == x)

record IsAddFundamentalDomain
  {R E M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : BorelMeasure space extended)
  (lattice : AddSubgroup space)
  (F : Region E) :
  Set1 where

  field
    null-measurable :
      NullMeasurable measure F

    ae-covers :
      AlmostEverywhere measure
        (\ x ->
          Exists E
            (\ g ->
              contains lattice g and
              F (addE space g x)))

    pairwise-ae-disjoint :
      (g h : E) ->
      contains lattice g ->
      contains lattice h ->
      g != h ->
      AEDisjoint measure
        (translateRegion space g F)
        (translateRegion space h F)

minkowski-s-theorem : Set2
minkowski-s-theorem =
  (R E M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : NormedRealVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (finite-dimensional : FiniteDimensional space) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : BorelMeasure space extended) ->
  IsAddHaarMeasure space extended measure ->
  (lattice : AddSubgroup space) ->
  CountableSubgroup lattice ->
  (F s : Region E) ->
  IsAddFundamentalDomain measure lattice F ->
  OriginSymmetric space s ->
  Convex space s ->
  StrictLessM extended
    (multiplyM extended
      (mass measure F)
      (powerM extended
        (addM extended
          (oneM extended)
          (oneM extended))
        (dimension finite-dimensional)))
    (mass measure s) ->
  Exists E
    (\ x ->
      x != zeroE space and
      (contains lattice x and s x))

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1097021 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1097021), "Minkowski's theorem": in a
  finite-dimensional real normed vector space with an additive Haar measure,
  a symmetric convex set whose measure exceeds 2^dim times the measure of a
  fundamental domain of a countable additive subgroup contains a nonzero
  subgroup point. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;

val q1097021_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q1097021_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1097021_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_lincomb_def",
  ``q1097021_lincomb
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) (coeff : num -> real) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. add acc (smul (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
        zero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q1097021_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_basis_def",
  ``q1097021_basis
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) <=>
      ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
      (!coeff : num -> real.
        q1097021_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = zero ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = 0) /\
      (!x : 'e.
        ?coeff : num -> real.
          q1097021_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = x)``);

val q1097021_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q1097021_finite_dimensional
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) <=>
      ?basis : 'e list. q1097021_basis zero add smul basis``);

val q1097021_dimension_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_dimension_def",
  ``q1097021_dimension
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) =
      LENGTH
        (@basis : 'e list. q1097021_basis zero add smul basis)``);

val q1097021_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_open_def",
  ``q1097021_open
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : 'e set) <=>
      !x. x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q1097021_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_compact_def",
  ``q1097021_compact
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (k : 'e set) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        (!n. u n IN k) ==>
        ?r : num -> num. ?x : 'e.
          x IN k /\
          (!p q. p < q ==> r p < r q) /\
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?N : num. !n : num.
              N <= n ==>
              norm (add (u (r n)) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q1097021_borel_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_borel_measure_def",
  ``q1097021_borel_measure
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (m : 'e m_space) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m =
        subsets
          (sigma UNIV
            {u : 'e set | q1097021_open add neg norm u})``);

val q1097021_translate_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_translate_def",
  ``q1097021_translate
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (a : 'e) (s : 'e set) =
      {x | ?y. y IN s /\ x = add a y}``);

val q1097021_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_outer_measure_def",
  ``q1097021_outer_measure (m : 'e m_space) (s : 'e set) =
      inf
        {r : extreal |
          ?t : 'e set.
            s SUBSET t /\
            t IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m t = r}``);

val q1097021_add_haar_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_add_haar_measure_def",
  ``q1097021_add_haar_measure
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (m : 'e m_space) <=>
      (!a : 'e. !s : 'e set.
        q1097021_outer_measure m (q1097021_translate add a s) =
        q1097021_outer_measure m s) /\
      (!k : 'e set.
        q1097021_compact add neg norm k ==>
        q1097021_outer_measure m k <> PosInf) /\
      (!u : 'e set.
        q1097021_open add neg norm u /\ u <> {} ==>
        q1097021_outer_measure m u <> 0)``);

val q1097021_add_subgroup_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_add_subgroup_def",
  ``q1097021_add_subgroup
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (lattice : 'e set) <=>
      zero IN lattice /\
      (!x y. x IN lattice /\ y IN lattice ==> add x y IN lattice) /\
      (!x. x IN lattice ==> neg x IN lattice)``);

val q1097021_add_fundamental_domain_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_add_fundamental_domain_def",
  ``q1097021_add_fundamental_domain
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (m : 'e m_space)
      (lattice : 'e set) (fund : 'e set) <=>
      fund IN subsets (completion m) /\
      q1097021_outer_measure m
        {x | ~(?a. a IN lattice /\ add a x IN fund)} = 0 /\
      (!a b.
        a IN lattice /\ b IN lattice /\ a <> b ==>
        q1097021_outer_measure m
          (q1097021_translate add a fund INTER
           q1097021_translate add b fund) = 0)``);

val q1097021_symmetric_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_symmetric_def",
  ``q1097021_symmetric (neg : 'e -> 'e) (s : 'e set) <=>
      !x. x IN s ==> neg x IN s``);

val q1097021_convex_def = new_definition (
  "q1097021_convex_def",
  ``q1097021_convex
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (s : 'e set) <=>
      !x y t.
        x IN s /\ y IN s /\ 0 <= t /\ t <= 1 ==>
        add (smul (1 - t) x) (smul t y) IN s``);

val exists_ne_zero_mem_lattice_of_measure_mul_two_pow_lt_measure =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (m : 'e m_space) (lattice : 'e set)
      (fund : 'e set) (s : 'e set).
      q1097021_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q1097021_finite_dimensional zero add smul /\
      q1097021_borel_measure add neg norm m /\
      q1097021_add_haar_measure add neg norm m /\
      q1097021_add_subgroup zero add neg lattice /\
      COUNTABLE lattice /\
      q1097021_add_fundamental_domain add m lattice fund /\
      q1097021_symmetric neg s /\
      q1097021_convex add smul s /\
      q1097021_outer_measure m fund *
        Normal
          ((2 : real) pow q1097021_dimension zero add smul) <
        q1097021_outer_measure m s
      ==>
      ?x : 'e. x IN lattice /\ x <> zero /\ x IN s``;

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1097021
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1097021), "Minkowski's theorem": a convex
  symmetric subset of a finite-dimensional real normed vector space whose
  Haar measure exceeds two to the dimension times a lattice fundamental
  domain's measure contains a nonzero point of the lattice. This file contains
  no proof of its own.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V ranges over arbitrary SetMM normed vector spaces over RRfld, including the
  zero-dimensional space. M is a measure on the Borel sigma-algebra generated
  by V's norm topology. Q1097021Haar expands the source IsAddHaarMeasure
  assumptions: translation invariance, finite measure on compact sets, and
  positive measure on nonempty open sets.

  Q1097021Measure uses the outer measure canonically induced by the SetMM
  Borel measure, so it evaluates arbitrary subsets just as Lean's measure
  does; *e is SetMM's extended-real multiplication used in the volume
  inequality. Q1097021Null and Q1097021NullMeasurable render measure-null and
  null-measurable sets. Q1097021Fundamental expands IsAddFundamentalDomain:
  the domain is null-measurable, almost every point has a translate by L in
  the domain, and distinct L-translates of the domain are almost everywhere
  disjoint. Q1097021Convex and Q1097021Symmetric use V's native real scalar,
  addition, and inverse operations.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding root-file $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions.
  This root artifact contributes no $p statement; the included SetMM library
  contains its standard verified proofs.
$)

$c Q1097021Translate Q1097021Measure Q1097021Null
   Q1097021NullMeasurable Q1097021Haar Q1097021Fundamental
   Q1097021Symmetric Q1097021Convex $.

q1097021-translate-syntax $a class ( Q1097021Translate V a A ) $.
q1097021-measure-syntax $a class ( Q1097021Measure M A ) $.
q1097021-null-syntax $a wff ( Q1097021Null M A ) $.
q1097021-null-measurable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1097021NullMeasurable M A ) $.
q1097021-haar-syntax $a wff ( Q1097021Haar V M ) $.
q1097021-fundamental-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1097021Fundamental V M L F ) $.
q1097021-symmetric-syntax $a wff ( Q1097021Symmetric V S ) $.
q1097021-convex-syntax $a wff ( Q1097021Convex V S ) $.

${
  $d A V a x y $.

  q1097021-translate-definition $a |- (
    Q1097021Translate V a A
  ) = {
    y e. ( Base ` V ) |
      E. x e. A y = ( a ( +g ` V ) x )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A M $.

  q1097021-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q1097021Measure M A
  ) = ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A ) $.
$}

${
  $d A M $.

  q1097021-null-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1097021Null M A )
    <->
    ( Q1097021Measure M A ) = 0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A M b $.

  q1097021-null-measurable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1097021NullMeasurable M A )
    <->
    E. b e. dom M
      (
        Q1097021Null
        M
        ( ( A \ b ) u. ( b \ A ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d M V a b k u $.

  q1097021-haar-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1097021Haar V M )
    <->
    (
      M e.
        (
          measures
          `
          ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` V ) )
        )
      /\
      (
        A. a e. ( Base ` V ) A. b e. ~P ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( Q1097021Measure M ( Q1097021Translate V a b ) )
            =
            ( Q1097021Measure M b )
          )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ~P ( Base ` V )
            (
              (
                ( ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t k ) e. Comp
                ->
                ( Q1097021Measure M k ) e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
              )
            )
          /\
          A. u e. ( TopOpen ` V )
            (
              u =/= (/)
              ->
              0 < ( Q1097021Measure M u )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L M V a b x $.

  q1097021-fundamental-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1097021Fundamental V M L F )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1097021NullMeasurable M F )
      /\
      (
        (
          Q1097021Null
          M
          {
            x e. ( Base ` V ) |
              -. E. a e. L
                ( a ( +g ` V ) x ) e. F
          }
        )
        /\
        A. a e. L A. b e. L
          (
            a =/= b
            ->
            (
              Q1097021Null
              M
              (
                ( Q1097021Translate V a F )
                i^i
                ( Q1097021Translate V b F )
              )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S V x $.

  q1097021-symmetric-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1097021Symmetric V S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      ( ( -g ` V ) ` x ) e. S
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S V t x y $.

  q1097021-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1097021Convex V S )
    <->
    A. x e. S A. y e. S A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      (
        (
          ( t ( .s ` V ) x )
          ( +g ` V )
          ( ( 1 - t ) ( .s ` V ) y )
        )
        e. S
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f l m s v w x $.

  thousand-theorems-q1097021-minkowski $a |-
    A. w e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = RRfld }
      A. m A. l A. f A. s
        (
          (
            (
              ( dim ` w ) e. NN0
              /\
              ( Q1097021Haar w m )
            )
            /\
            (
              (
                l e. ( SubGrp ` w )
                /\
                l ~<_ _om
              )
              /\
              (
                f e. ~P ( Base ` w )
                /\
                s e. ~P ( Base ` w )
              )
            )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              (
                ( Q1097021Fundamental w m l f )
                /\
                (
                  ( Q1097021Symmetric w s )
                  /\
                  ( Q1097021Convex w s )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                (
                  ( Q1097021Measure m f )
                  *e
                  ( 2 ^ ( dim ` w ) )
                )
                <
                ( Q1097021Measure m s )
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              E. x e. l
                (
                  x =/= ( 0g ` w )
                  /\
                  x e. s
                )
            )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1097021,
:: "Minkowski's theorem": a convex origin-symmetric subset of a finite-
:: dimensional real normed vector space whose Haar measure is sufficiently
:: large contains a nonzero point of a countable additive subgroup. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
    RLVECT_5, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, TOPS_2,
    TOPGEN_4, COMPTS_1, RCOMP_1,
    CONVEX1, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE8, XXREAL_0,
    XXREAL_2,
    SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2, NAT_1, NEWTON, POWER, REAL_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
    SETFAM_1, REAL_NS1, MEMBERED;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, ORDINAL1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XXREAL_3, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
    EXTREAL1, NAT_1, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_2,
    COMPTS_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5,
    NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4,
    MEASURE8, TOPGEN_4, CONVEX1, REAL_NS1, NEWTON, POWER;
  constructors RELSET_1, DOMAIN_1, REAL_1, EXTREAL1, NAT_1, TOPS_2, COMPTS_1,
    NORMSP_2, RLVECT_5, CONVEX1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE8,
    TOPGEN_4, REAL_NS1, SUPINF_1, NEWTON, POWER;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
    NAT_1, CARD_1, CARD_3, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, NORMSP_1,
    PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, COMPTS_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE8,
    XXREAL_3, REAL_NS1, REAL_NS2;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1;
  equalities XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0;
  expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for X being finite-dimensional RealNormSpace,
      Sigma being SigmaField of the carrier of X,
      M being sigma_Measure of Sigma,
      C being C_Measure of the carrier of X,
      L,F,s being Subset of X st
    Sigma = BorelSets(TopSpaceNorm X) &
    C = C_Meas M &
    (for a being Point of X, A being Subset of X holds
      C.({z where z is Point of X :
        ex y being Point of X st y in A & z = a + y}) = C.A) &
    (for K being compact Subset of TopSpaceNorm X,
         A being Subset of X st K = A holds
      C.A < +infty) &
    (for U being open Subset of TopSpaceNorm X,
         A being Subset of X st U = A & U <> {} holds
      0. < C.A) &
    0.X in L &
    (for x,y being Point of X st x in L & y in L holds x + y in L) &
    (for x being Point of X st x in L holds -x in L) &
    L is countable &
    (ex B being Element of Sigma st
      C.((F \ B) \/ (B \ F)) = 0.) &
    C.({x where x is Point of X :
      not ex g being Point of X st g in L & g + x in F}) = 0. &
    (for g,h being Point of X st g in L & h in L & g <> h holds
      C.({x where x is Point of X :
        (ex y being Point of X st y in F & x = g + y) &
        (ex z being Point of X st z in F & x = h + z)}) = 0.) &
    (for x being Point of X st x in s holds -x in s) &
    s is convex &
    C.F * ((2 to_power dim X) qua ExtReal) < C.s
  holds ex x being Point of X st x <> 0.X & x in L & x in s
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1097021_minkowski_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1097021,
% "Minkowski's theorem": a symmetric convex set in a finite-dimensional real
% normed space whose Haar measure exceeds 2^real-finrank times a lattice
% fundamental-domain measure contains a nonzero lattice point. This file contains no proof.

minkowski_s_theorem_Q1097021[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  point_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [point_set -> measure_value]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  empty_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): FALSE

  full_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): TRUE

  complement(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): NOT A(x)

  intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): A(x) AND B(x)

  symmetric_difference(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      (A(x) AND NOT B(x)) OR (B(x) AND NOT A(x))

  countable_union(sets: point_set_sequence): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (index: nat): sets(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(sets: point_set_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: E):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x) AND sets(right_index)(x))

  translate(a: E, A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (y: E):
        A(y) AND x = addE(a, y)

  normed_real_vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        (normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = abs(a) * normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  finite_linear_combination(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      vectors: vector_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_linear_combination(
          coefficients, vectors, count - 1),
        smulE(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          vectors(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  supported_below(
      rank: nat,
      coordinates: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      rank <= index IMPLIES coordinates(index) = 0

  unique_basis_coordinates(
      rank: nat,
      basis: vector_sequence,
      x: E,
      coordinates: real_sequence): bool =
    supported_below(rank, coordinates)
      AND x = finite_linear_combination(
        coordinates, basis, rank)
      AND (FORALL (other: real_sequence):
        (supported_below(rank, other)
          AND x = finite_linear_combination(
            other, basis, rank))
        IMPLIES other = coordinates)

  basis_of_real_finrank(
      rank: nat,
      basis: vector_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      EXISTS (coordinates: real_sequence):
        unique_basis_coordinates(
          rank, basis, x, coordinates)

  is_real_finrank(rank: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (basis: vector_sequence):
      basis_of_real_finrank(rank, basis)

  open_set(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: E):
            normE(subE(y, x)) < radius IMPLIES A(y)

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(empty_set)
      AND Sigma(full_set)
      AND (FORALL (A: point_set):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: point_set_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          Sigma(sets(index)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(sets)))

  contains_open_sets(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (A: point_set):
      open_set(A) IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  borel_set(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      (is_sigma_algebra(Sigma) AND contains_open_sets(Sigma))
        IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_finite(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  measure_value_add(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_lt(
      left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        NOT infinite_flag(left)
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) < finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_scale(
      value: measure_value,
      factor: real): measure_value =
    IF factor <= 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(factor * finite_part(value))
    ENDIF

  partial_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    partial_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  covered_by_null_borel_set(
      M: measure_map,
      A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (cover: point_set):
      borel_set(cover)
        AND (FORALL (x: E):
          A(x) IMPLIES cover(x))
        AND measure_value_is_zero(M(cover))

  is_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_set))
      AND (FORALL (A: point_set):
        canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
        covered_by_null_borel_set(
          M, symmetric_difference(A, B))
        IMPLIES M(A) = M(B))
      AND (FORALL (sets: point_set_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            borel_set(sets(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(sets))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              M(sets(index)),
            M(countable_union(sets))))

  null_set(M: measure_map, A: point_set): bool =
    covered_by_null_borel_set(M, A)

  null_measurable_set(
      M: measure_map,
      A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: point_set):
      borel_set(measurable_version)
        AND null_set(
          M,
          symmetric_difference(A, measurable_version))

  add_invariant_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (a: E), (A: point_set):
      M(translate(a, A)) = M(A)

  locally_finite_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      EXISTS (neighborhood: point_set):
        open_set(neighborhood)
          AND neighborhood(x)
          AND measure_value_is_finite(M(neighborhood))

  nonzero_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    EXISTS (A: point_set):
      borel_set(A)
        AND NOT measure_value_is_zero(M(A))

  is_add_haar_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    is_measure(M)
      AND add_invariant_measure(M)
      AND locally_finite_measure(M)
      AND nonzero_measure(M)

  additive_subgroup(lattice: point_set): bool =
    lattice(zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        lattice(x) AND lattice(y)
          IMPLIES lattice(addE(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        lattice(x) IMPLIES lattice(negE(x)))

  countable_set(A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (code: [E -> nat]):
      FORALL (x, y: E):
        A(x) AND A(y) AND code(x) = code(y)
          IMPLIES x = y

  countable_additive_subgroup(lattice: point_set): bool =
    additive_subgroup(lattice)
      AND countable_set(lattice)

  union_of_lattice_translates(
      lattice, fundamental_set: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (a, y: E):
        lattice(a)
          AND fundamental_set(y)
          AND x = addE(a, y)

  almost_disjoint(
      M: measure_map,
      A, B: point_set): bool =
    null_set(M, intersection(A, B))

  is_add_fundamental_domain(
      lattice, fundamental_set: point_set,
      M: measure_map): bool =
    null_measurable_set(M, fundamental_set)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: E):
        lattice(a)
          AND lattice(b)
          AND a /= b
        IMPLIES
          almost_disjoint(
            M,
            translate(a, fundamental_set),
            translate(b, fundamental_set)))
      AND null_set(
        M,
        complement(
          union_of_lattice_translates(
            lattice, fundamental_set)))

  symmetric_set(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES A(negE(x))

  convex_set(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (a, b: real):
      A(x)
        AND A(y)
        AND a >= 0
        AND b >= 0
        AND a + b = 1
      IMPLIES
        A(addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, y)))

  two_power(dimension: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF dimension = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      2 * two_power(dimension - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE dimension

  finrank_scaled_measure_lt(
      M: measure_map,
      fundamental_set, convex_body: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (dimension: nat):
      is_real_finrank(dimension)
        AND measure_value_lt(
          measure_value_scale(
            M(fundamental_set),
            two_power(dimension)),
          M(convex_body))

  minkowski_s_theorem: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space_laws IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (lattice, fundamental_set, convex_body: point_set):
        (is_add_haar_measure(M)
          AND countable_additive_subgroup(lattice)
          AND is_add_fundamental_domain(
            lattice, fundamental_set, M)
          AND symmetric_set(convex_body)
          AND convex_set(convex_body)
          AND finrank_scaled_measure_lt(
            M, fundamental_set, convex_body))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: E):
            lattice(x)
              AND x /= zeroE
              AND convex_body(x)
END minkowski_s_theorem_Q1097021

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1134776
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1134776), "Dilworth's theorem": in a finite
-- partially ordered set, the minimum cardinality of a partition into chains
-- equals the maximum cardinality of an antichain. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.ENat.Lattice
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Card
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Subset

@[expose] public section

namespace Q1134776

/-- The extended-natural cardinality of a largest antichain for a relation. -/
noncomputable def antichainWidth (α : Type*) (r : α → α → Prop) : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨆ s : {s : Set α // IsAntichain r s}, s.val.encard

/-- A set of sets is a chain partition when each element lies in exactly one member,
and every member is a chain. -/
def IsChainPartition (α : Type*) (r : α → α → Prop) (S : Set (Set α)) :=
  (∀ x : α, ∃! s ∈ S, x ∈ s) ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, IsChain r s)

/-- The minimum extended-natural cardinality of a partition into chains. -/
noncomputable def minChainPartition (α : Type*) (r : α → α → Prop) : ℕ∞ :=
  ⨅ s : {s : Set (Set α) // IsChainPartition α r s}, s.val.encard

/-- Dilworth's theorem for finite partially ordered sets. -/
theorem minChainPartition_eq_antichainWidth
    (α : Type*) [PartialOrder α] [Finite α] :
    minChainPartition α (· ≤ ·) = antichainWidth α (· ≤ ·) := sorry

end Q1134776

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1134776
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1134776), "Dilworth's theorem": for every finite
  partial order, the minimum size of a partition into chains equals the
  maximum size of an antichain. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1134776_partial_order (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1134776_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q1134776_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q1134776_le x x;
  q1134776_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q1134776_le x y ->
      q1134776_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q1134776_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q1134776_le x y ->
      q1134776_le y z ->
      q1134776_le x z
}.

Arguments q1134776_le {A} _ _ _.

Definition q1134776_injective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A, f x = f y -> x = y.

Definition q1134776_surjective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall y : B, exists x : A, f x = y.

Definition q1134776_finite_type (A : Type) : Prop :=
  exists (n : nat) (enumeration : Fin.t n -> A),
    q1134776_injective enumeration /\
    q1134776_surjective enumeration.

Definition q1134776_chain_partition_size
    {A : Type}
    (P : q1134776_partial_order A)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists color : A -> Fin.t n,
    q1134776_surjective color /\
    forall (i : Fin.t n) (x y : A),
      color x = i ->
      color y = i ->
      q1134776_le P x y \/ q1134776_le P y x.

Definition q1134776_antichain_size
    {A : Type}
    (P : q1134776_partial_order A)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists elements : Fin.t n -> A,
    q1134776_injective elements /\
    forall i j : Fin.t n,
      i <> j ->
      ~ q1134776_le P (elements i) (elements j) /\
      ~ q1134776_le P (elements j) (elements i).

Definition q1134776_is_min_chain_partition_size
    {A : Type}
    (P : q1134776_partial_order A)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q1134776_chain_partition_size P n /\
  forall m : nat,
    q1134776_chain_partition_size P m ->
    (n <= m)%nat.

Definition q1134776_is_antichain_width
    {A : Type}
    (P : q1134776_partial_order A)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q1134776_antichain_size P n /\
  forall m : nat,
    q1134776_antichain_size P m ->
    (m <= n)%nat.

Theorem minChainPartition_eq_antichainWidth :
  forall (A : Type) (P : q1134776_partial_order A),
    q1134776_finite_type A ->
    exists n : nat,
      q1134776_is_min_chain_partition_size P n /\
      q1134776_is_antichain_width P n.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1134776,
  "Dilworth's theorem": in a finite partial order, the minimum cardinality of a
  partition into chains equals the maximum cardinality of an antichain. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1134776_is_chain :: "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1134776_is_chain C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. x \<le> y \<or> y \<le> x)"

definition q1134776_is_antichain :: "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1134776_is_antichain A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. x \<le> y \<longrightarrow> x = y)"

definition q1134776_is_chain_partition ::
    "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1134776_is_chain_partition U P \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<exists>!C. C \<in> P \<and> x \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>C\<in>P. C \<subseteq> U \<and> q1134776_is_chain C)"

definition q1134776_min_chain_partition ::
    "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1134776_min_chain_partition U =
    Min (card ` {P. q1134776_is_chain_partition U P})"

definition q1134776_antichain_width ::
    "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1134776_antichain_width U =
    Max (card ` {A. A \<subseteq> U \<and> q1134776_is_antichain A})"

theorem q1134776_dilworth:
  "q1134776_min_chain_partition (UNIV :: 'a::{finite,order} set) =
    q1134776_antichain_width UNIV"
  sorry

end

title: Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1134776,
  "Dilworth's theorem": for every finite carrier equipped with a partial
  order, the minimum cardinality of a chain partition equals the maximum
  cardinality of an antichain. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1134776_DILWORTH_THEOREM =
  `let is_partial_order_on =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> le x x) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier /\
          le x y /\ le y z
          ==> le x z) /\
       (!x y:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ le x y /\ le y x
          ==> x = y) in
   let is_chain =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool).
       s SUBSET carrier /\
       !x y:A. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> le x y \/ le y x in
   let is_antichain =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool).
       s SUBSET carrier /\
       !x y:A.
         x IN s /\ y IN s /\ ~(x = y)
         ==> ~(le x y) /\ ~(le y x) in
   let is_chain_partition =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool) (C:(A->bool)->bool).
       (!x:A.
          x IN carrier ==> ?!c:A->bool. c IN C /\ x IN c) /\
       (!c:A->bool. c IN C ==> is_chain carrier le c) in
   let min_chain_partition =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool).
       minimal n.
         ?C:(A->bool)->bool.
           is_chain_partition carrier le C /\ CARD C = n in
   let antichain_width =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool).
       minimal n.
         !s:A->bool.
           is_antichain carrier le s ==> CARD s <= n in
   !carrier:A->bool.
     !le:A->A->bool.
       FINITE carrier /\
       is_partial_order_on carrier le
       ==> min_chain_partition carrier le =
           antichain_width carrier le`;;

title: Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q1134776, "Dilworth's theorem": for every finite
;; partial order, the minimum cardinality of a partition into chains equals
;; the maximum cardinality of an antichain. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A duplicate-free true list enumerates an arbitrary finite carrier. The
;; conservative interface below supplies the arbitrary order relation itself;
;; it is not replaced by a finite lookup table. All partial-order laws are
;; explicit hypotheses of the final statement predicate.

(defstub q1134776-leq (x y) t)

(defun q1134776-carrier-p (carrier)
  (and (true-listp carrier)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal carrier)))

(defun q1134776-reflexive-p (remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (q1134776-leq (car remaining) (car remaining))
           (q1134776-reflexive-p (cdr remaining)))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun q1134776-antisymmetric-from-p (x remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (q1134776-leq x (car remaining))
             (q1134776-leq (car remaining) x))
        (equal x (car remaining)))
       (q1134776-antisymmetric-from-p x (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q1134776-antisymmetric-p (remaining carrier)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (q1134776-antisymmetric-from-p (car remaining) carrier)
       (q1134776-antisymmetric-p (cdr remaining) carrier))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun q1134776-transitive-from-p (x y remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (q1134776-leq x y)
             (q1134776-leq y (car remaining)))
        (q1134776-leq x (car remaining)))
       (q1134776-transitive-from-p x y (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q1134776-transitive-from-x-p (x remaining carrier)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (q1134776-transitive-from-p
        x (car remaining) carrier)
       (q1134776-transitive-from-x-p
        x (cdr remaining) carrier))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun q1134776-transitive-p (remaining carrier)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (q1134776-transitive-from-x-p
        (car remaining) carrier carrier)
       (q1134776-transitive-p (cdr remaining) carrier))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun q1134776-partial-order-p (carrier)
  (and
   (q1134776-reflexive-p carrier)
   (q1134776-antisymmetric-p carrier carrier)
   (q1134776-transitive-p carrier carrier)))

;; The recursively generated power set contains every subset of the finite
;; carrier exactly once, in carrier order. Applying the same construction to
;; that power set contains every set of subsets exactly once, so minima and
;; maxima below range over the full objects quantified in the Lean statement.

(defun q1134776-prepend-to-each (value sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (cons
       (cons value (car sets))
       (q1134776-prepend-to-each value (cdr sets)))
    nil))

(defun q1134776-power-set (set)
  (if (consp set)
      (let ((tail-power-set
             (q1134776-power-set (cdr set))))
        (append
         tail-power-set
         (q1134776-prepend-to-each
          (car set) tail-power-set)))
    (list nil)))

(defun q1134776-subset-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and (member-equal (car left) right)
           (q1134776-subset-p (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun q1134776-set-equal-p (left right)
  (and (q1134776-subset-p left right)
       (q1134776-subset-p right left)))

(defun q1134776-set-union (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (if (member-equal (car left) right)
          (q1134776-set-union (cdr left) right)
        (cons
         (car left)
         (q1134776-set-union (cdr left) right)))
    right))

(defun q1134776-family-union (family)
  (if (consp family)
      (q1134776-set-union
       (car family)
       (q1134776-family-union (cdr family)))
    nil))

(defun q1134776-disjoint-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and (not (member-equal (car left) right))
           (q1134776-disjoint-p (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun q1134776-disjoint-from-family-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q1134776-disjoint-p set (car family))
           (q1134776-disjoint-from-family-p
            set (cdr family)))
    t))

(defun q1134776-pairwise-disjoint-family-p (family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and
       (q1134776-disjoint-from-family-p
        (car family) (cdr family))
       (q1134776-pairwise-disjoint-family-p
        (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q1134776-comparable-with-all-p (x remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (or (q1134776-leq x (car remaining))
           (q1134776-leq (car remaining) x))
       (q1134776-comparable-with-all-p
        x (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q1134776-chain-p (set)
  (if (consp set)
      (and
       (q1134776-comparable-with-all-p
        (car set) (cdr set))
       (q1134776-chain-p (cdr set)))
    (equal set nil)))

(defun q1134776-incomparable-with-all-p (x remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not (q1134776-leq x (car remaining)))
       (not (q1134776-leq (car remaining) x))
       (q1134776-incomparable-with-all-p
        x (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q1134776-antichain-p (set)
  (if (consp set)
      (and
       (q1134776-incomparable-with-all-p
        (car set) (cdr set))
       (q1134776-antichain-p (cdr set)))
    (equal set nil)))

(defun q1134776-all-chains-p (family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q1134776-chain-p (car family))
           (q1134776-all-chains-p (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

;; Pairwise disjointness together with union equal to the carrier is exactly
;; the unique-membership partition condition. Empty chains remain permitted,
;; as they are in the source's Set (Set alpha) definition, but cannot lower
;; the minimum.

(defun q1134776-chain-partition-p (family carrier)
