title: Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1134776
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1134776), "Dilworth's theorem": in every finite
-- partial order, the minimum size of a chain partition equals the maximum
-- size of an antichain. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _and_
infix 4 _≤_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {p : Level} →
  Set p →
  Set p
Not proposition =
  proposition → Bottom

record _and_
  {p q : Level}
  (P : Set p)
  (Q : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (P : Set p)
  (Q : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : P → Either P Q
  right : Q → Either P Q

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A → Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤   : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) →
  function x ≡ function y →
  x ≡ y

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

Finite :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Finite A =
  Exists Nat (λ cardinality → Bijection A (Fin cardinality))

record HProp (p : Level) : Set (lsuc p) where
  constructor proposition
  field
    Carrier : Set p
    carrier-is-proposition :
      (left right : Carrier) →
      left ≡ right

open HProp using (Carrier)

Relation :
  {a : Level} →
  (p : Level) →
  Set a →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Relation p A =
  A → A → HProp p

record IsPartialOrder
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      Carrier (relation x x)
    transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      Carrier (relation x y) →
      Carrier (relation y z) →
      Carrier (relation x z)
    antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) →
      Carrier (relation x y) →
      Carrier (relation y x) →
      x ≡ y

record ChainPartition
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A)
  (number-of-chains : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    chain-index :
      A →
      Fin number-of-chains
    every-chain-used :
      (index : Fin number-of-chains) →
      Exists A (λ x → chain-index x ≡ index)
    each-fiber-is-chain :
      (x y : A) →
      Not (x ≡ y) →
      chain-index x ≡ chain-index y →
      Either
        (Carrier (relation x y))
        (Carrier (relation y x))

record Antichain
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    element :
      Fin cardinality →
      A
    distinct :
      Injective element
    incomparable :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) →
      Not (left-index ≡ right-index) →
      Not
        (Carrier
          (relation
            (element left-index)
            (element right-index)))

record IsMinimumChainPartitionSize
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A)
  (minimum : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    attained :
      ChainPartition relation minimum
    least :
      (candidate : Nat) →
      ChainPartition relation candidate →
      minimum ≤ candidate

record IsMaximumAntichainSize
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : Relation p A)
  (maximum : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  field
    attained :
      Antichain relation maximum
    greatest :
      (candidate : Nat) →
      Antichain relation candidate →
      candidate ≤ maximum

dilworth-s-theorem :
  {a p : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ p))
dilworth-s-theorem {a} {p} =
  (A : Set a) →
  (relation : Relation p A) →
  IsPartialOrder relation →
  Finite A →
  Exists Nat
    (λ optimum →
      IsMinimumChainPartitionSize relation optimum
      and
      IsMaximumAntichainSize relation optimum)

title: Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1134776, "Dilworth's theorem": in a finite partially ordered set, the
  minimum size of a partition into chains equals the maximum size of an
  antichain. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val dilworth_is_chain_def = new_definition (
  "dilworth_is_chain_def",
  ``dilworth_is_chain (le : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (s : 'a set) <=>
      !x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> le x y \/ le y x``);

val dilworth_is_antichain_def = new_definition (
  "dilworth_is_antichain_def",
  ``dilworth_is_antichain (le : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (s : 'a set) <=>
      !x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ x <> y ==> ~le x y``);

val dilworth_is_chain_partition_def = new_definition (
  "dilworth_is_chain_partition_def",
  ``dilworth_is_chain_partition
      (le : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (C : ('a set) set) <=>
      (!x. ?!s. s IN C /\ x IN s) /\
      (!s. s IN C ==> dilworth_is_chain le s)``);

val dilworth_is_min_chain_partition_size_def = new_definition (
  "dilworth_is_min_chain_partition_size_def",
  ``dilworth_is_min_chain_partition_size
      (le : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (n : num) <=>
      (?C : ('a set) set.
         FINITE C /\
         dilworth_is_chain_partition le C /\
         CARD C = n) /\
      (!C : ('a set) set.
         FINITE C /\ dilworth_is_chain_partition le C
         ==>
         n <= CARD C)``);

val dilworth_is_max_antichain_size_def = new_definition (
  "dilworth_is_max_antichain_size_def",
  ``dilworth_is_max_antichain_size
      (le : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (n : num) <=>
      (?A : 'a set.
         FINITE A /\
         dilworth_is_antichain le A /\
         CARD A = n) /\
      (!A : 'a set.
         FINITE A /\ dilworth_is_antichain le A
         ==>
         CARD A <= n)``);

val minChainPartition_eq_antichainWidth =
  ``!le : 'a -> 'a -> bool.
      FINITE (UNIV : 'a set) /\
      (!x. le x x) /\
      (!x y. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z)
      ==>
      ?n : num.
        dilworth_is_min_chain_partition_size le n /\
        dilworth_is_max_antichain_size le n``;

title: Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1134776
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1134776), "Dilworth's theorem": on every
  finite partially ordered set, the minimum number of chains in a partition
  equals the maximum cardinality of an antichain. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The finite Lean type is represented by an arbitrary finite set A, and its
  partial order by a relation R on A. Q1134776Chain and
  Q1134776Antichain are the corresponding pairwise comparability and
  incomparability predicates. Q1134776ChainPartition requires a unique chain
  block containing each element of A.

  Q1134776MinChainNumber A R k says that k is attained by a chain partition
  and is no larger than the cardinality of any chain partition.
  Q1134776AntichainWidth A R k says that k is attained by an antichain and
  bounds the cardinality of every antichain. For finite A these predicates
  uniquely characterize the natural values of the source ENat definitions.
  Thus the shared existential k in the final declaration is bidirectionally
  equivalent to minChainPartition = antichainWidth, including when A is empty.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding root-artifact $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions,
  and this root artifact introduces no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1134776PartialOrder Q1134776Chain Q1134776Antichain
   Q1134776ChainPartition Q1134776MinChainNumber
   Q1134776AntichainWidth $.

q1134776-partial-order-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1134776PartialOrder A R ) $.
q1134776-chain-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1134776Chain A R C ) $.
q1134776-antichain-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1134776Antichain A R B ) $.
q1134776-chain-partition-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1134776ChainPartition A R P ) $.
q1134776-min-chain-number-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1134776MinChainNumber A R k ) $.
q1134776-antichain-width-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1134776AntichainWidth A R k ) $.

${
  $d A R x y z $.

  q1134776-partial-order-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1134776PartialOrder A R )
    <->
    (
      R C_ ( A X. A )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. A x R x
        /\
        (
          A. x e. A A. y e. A
            ( ( x R y /\ y R x ) -> x = y )
          /\
          A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
            ( ( x R y /\ y R z ) -> x R z )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A C R x y $.

  q1134776-chain-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1134776Chain A R C )
    <->
    (
      C C_ A
      /\
      A. x e. C A. y e. C
        ( x =/= y -> ( x R y \/ y R x ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B R x y $.

  q1134776-antichain-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1134776Antichain A R B )
    <->
    (
      B C_ A
      /\
      A. x e. B A. y e. B
        ( x =/= y -> -. x R y )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A P R c x $.

  q1134776-chain-partition-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1134776ChainPartition A R P )
    <->
    (
      P C_ ~P A
      /\
      (
        A. x e. A E! c e. P x e. c
        /\
        A. c e. P ( Q1134776Chain A R c )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R k p q $.

  q1134776-min-chain-number-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1134776MinChainNumber A R k )
    <->
    (
      k e. NN0
      /\
      E. p
        (
          ( Q1134776ChainPartition A R p )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` p ) = k
            /\
            A. q
              (
                ( Q1134776ChainPartition A R q )
                ->
                k <_ ( # ` q )
              )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R b c k $.

  q1134776-antichain-width-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1134776AntichainWidth A R k )
    <->
    (
      k e. NN0
      /\
      E. b
        (
          ( Q1134776Antichain A R b )
          /\
          (
            ( # ` b ) = k
            /\
            A. c
              (
                ( Q1134776Antichain A R c )
                ->
                ( # ` c ) <_ k
              )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a k r $.

  thousand-theorems-q1134776-dilworth $a |- (
    A. a A. r
      (
        (
          a e. Fin
          /\
          ( Q1134776PartialOrder a r )
        )
        ->
        E. k e. NN0
          (
            ( Q1134776MinChainNumber a r k )
            /\
            ( Q1134776AntichainWidth a r k )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1134776,
% "Dilworth's theorem": in a finite partially ordered set, the minimum number
% of chains in a partition equals the maximum size of an antichain. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem[
  A: TYPE,
  order: [A, A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[A], finite_sets_of_sets[A]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[A]
  finite_family: TYPE = finite_set[element_set]

  is_partial_order: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      order(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      order(x, y) AND order(y, z)
        IMPLIES order(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      order(x, y) AND order(y, x)
        IMPLIES x = y)

  is_chain(chain: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      chain(x) AND chain(y) AND x /= y
        IMPLIES order(x, y) OR order(y, x)

  is_antichain(antichain: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      antichain(x) AND antichain(y) AND x /= y
        IMPLIES NOT order(x, y) AND NOT order(y, x)

  is_chain_partition(family: finite_family): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      EXISTS (chain: element_set):
        family(chain)
          AND chain(x)
          AND
        (FORALL (other: element_set):
          family(other) AND other(x)
            IMPLIES other = chain))
      AND
    (FORALL (chain: element_set):
      family(chain) IMPLIES is_chain(chain))

  is_minimum_chain_partition_size(k: nat): bool =
    (EXISTS (family: finite_family):
      is_chain_partition(family) AND card(family) = k)
      AND
    (FORALL (family: finite_family):
      is_chain_partition(family) IMPLIES k <= card(family))

  is_maximum_antichain_size(k: nat): bool =
    (EXISTS (antichain: element_set):
      is_antichain(antichain) AND card(antichain) = k)
      AND
    (FORALL (antichain: element_set):
      is_antichain(antichain) IMPLIES card(antichain) <= k)

  minChainPartition_eq_antichainWidth: bool =
    is_finite_type[A] AND is_partial_order
      IMPLIES
    EXISTS (k: nat):
      is_minimum_chain_partition_size(k)
        AND is_maximum_antichain_size(k)
END Q1134776_dilworth_s_theorem

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q11352023
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q11352023), "Vitali convergence theorem": convergence
-- in measure together with uniform integrability and uniform tightness is equivalent
-- to convergence in Lp. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.UnifTight

@[expose] public section

namespace MeasureTheory

open Set Filter Topology NNReal ENNReal

namespace Q11352023

variable {α β : Type*} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α} [NormedAddCommGroup β]

/-- Vitali's convergence theorem on a measure space of not necessarily finite measure. -/
theorem tendstoInMeasure_iff_tendsto_Lp {p : ℝ≥0∞} {f : ℕ → α → β} {g : α → β}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≠ ⊤) (hf : ∀ n, MemLp (f n) p μ) (hg : MemLp g p μ) :
    TendstoInMeasure μ f atTop g ∧ UnifIntegrable f p μ ∧ UnifTight f p μ
      ↔ Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (f n - g) p μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := sorry

end Q11352023

end MeasureTheory

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q11352023
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q11352023), "Vitali convergence theorem":
  on an arbitrary measure space, convergence in measure together with uniform
  integrability and uniform tightness is equivalent to convergence in Lp for
  finite exponents p at least one. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q11352023_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q11352023_empty {A : Type} : q11352023_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q11352023_full {A : Type} : q11352023_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q11352023_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q11352023_set A) : q11352023_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q11352023_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q11352023_set A) : q11352023_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q11352023_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q11352023_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q11352023_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q11352023_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q11352023_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q11352023_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q11352023_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q11352023_ennreal : Type :=
| q11352023_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q11352023_ennreal
| q11352023_ennreal_infinity : q11352023_ennreal.

Arguments q11352023_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_zero : q11352023_ennreal :=
  q11352023_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q11352023_ennreal_one : q11352023_ennreal :=
  q11352023_ennreal_finite 1 Rle_0_1.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite a _,
    q11352023_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity,
    q11352023_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_le
    (x y : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite a _,
    q11352023_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q11352023_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity,
    q11352023_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity,
    q11352023_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_lt
    (x y : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite a _,
    q11352023_ennreal_finite b _ => a < b
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q11352023_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_below_real
    (x : q11352023_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_le_real
    (x : q11352023_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite value _ => value <= bound
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_add
    (x y : q11352023_ennreal) : q11352023_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q11352023_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q11352023_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q11352023_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q11352023_ennreal) : q11352023_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q11352023_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q11352023_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite a _, q11352023_ennreal_infinity
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity, q11352023_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q11352023_ennreal_zero
      else q11352023_ennreal_infinity
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity, q11352023_ennreal_infinity =>
      q11352023_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_rpow
    (x : q11352023_ennreal) (exponent : R) : q11352023_ennreal :=
  match x with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite value _ =>
      if Req_EM_T value 0 then
        if Rlt_dec 0 exponent then q11352023_ennreal_zero
        else if Req_EM_T exponent 0
             then q11352023_ennreal_one
             else q11352023_ennreal_infinity
      else
        q11352023_ennreal_finite
          (exp (ln value * exponent))
          (Rlt_le 0 (exp (ln value * exponent))
            (exp_pos (ln value * exponent)))
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity =>
      if Rlt_dec 0 exponent then q11352023_ennreal_infinity
      else if Req_EM_T exponent 0
           then q11352023_ennreal_one
           else q11352023_ennreal_zero
  end.

Fixpoint q11352023_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q11352023_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q11352023_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q11352023_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q11352023_ennreal_add
        (q11352023_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q11352023_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q11352023_ennreal,
      values value -> q11352023_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q11352023_ennreal,
      (forall value : q11352023_ennreal,
        values value -> q11352023_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q11352023_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q11352023_ennreal_infimum
    (values : q11352023_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q11352023_ennreal,
      values value -> q11352023_ennreal_le bound value) /\
  (forall lower : q11352023_ennreal,
      (forall value : q11352023_ennreal,
        values value -> q11352023_ennreal_le lower value) ->
      q11352023_ennreal_le lower bound).

Definition q11352023_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q11352023_ennreal)
    (sum : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q11352023_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q11352023_ennreal_eq value
          (q11352023_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q11352023_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q11352023_measurable : q11352023_set A -> Prop;
  q11352023_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q11352023_set A,
      q11352023_same_set E F ->
      (q11352023_measurable E <-> q11352023_measurable F);
  q11352023_measurable_empty :
    q11352023_measurable q11352023_empty;
  q11352023_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q11352023_set A,
      q11352023_measurable E ->
      q11352023_measurable (q11352023_complement E);
  q11352023_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q11352023_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q11352023_measurable (E n)) ->
      q11352023_measurable (q11352023_countable_union E);
  q11352023_measure : q11352023_set A -> q11352023_ennreal;
  q11352023_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q11352023_set A,
      q11352023_same_set E F ->
      q11352023_ennreal_eq
        (q11352023_measure E) (q11352023_measure F);
  q11352023_measure_empty :
    q11352023_ennreal_eq
      (q11352023_measure q11352023_empty)
      q11352023_ennreal_zero;
  q11352023_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q11352023_set A,
      (forall x : A, E x -> F x) ->
      q11352023_ennreal_le
        (q11352023_measure E) (q11352023_measure F);
  q11352023_measure_trimmed :
    forall E : q11352023_set A,
      q11352023_ennreal_infimum
        (fun value =>
          exists F : q11352023_set A,
            q11352023_measurable F /\
            (forall x : A, E x -> F x) /\
            q11352023_ennreal_eq
              value (q11352023_measure F))
        (q11352023_measure E);
  q11352023_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall E : nat -> q11352023_set A,
      exists total : q11352023_ennreal,
        q11352023_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q11352023_measure (E n)) total /\
        q11352023_ennreal_le
          (q11352023_measure (q11352023_countable_union E))
          total;
  q11352023_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q11352023_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q11352023_measurable (E n)) ->
      q11352023_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q11352023_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q11352023_measure (E n))
        (q11352023_measure (q11352023_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q11352023_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q11352023_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q11352023_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  q11352023_ennreal_eq
    (q11352023_measure mu (fun x => ~ P x))
    q11352023_ennreal_zero.

Record q11352023_normed_add_comm_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q11352023_zero : G;
  q11352023_add : G -> G -> G;
  q11352023_neg : G -> G;
  q11352023_norm : G -> R;
  q11352023_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q11352023_add x (q11352023_add y z) =
      q11352023_add (q11352023_add x y) z;
  q11352023_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q11352023_add x y = q11352023_add y x;
  q11352023_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q11352023_add x q11352023_zero = x;
  q11352023_add_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q11352023_add x (q11352023_neg x) = q11352023_zero;
  q11352023_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q11352023_norm x;
  q11352023_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q11352023_norm x = 0 <-> x = q11352023_zero;
  q11352023_norm_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q11352023_norm (q11352023_neg x) = q11352023_norm x;
  q11352023_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q11352023_norm (q11352023_add x y) <=
      q11352023_norm x + q11352023_norm y
}.

Arguments q11352023_zero {G} _.
Arguments q11352023_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q11352023_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q11352023_norm {G} _ _.

Definition q11352023_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q11352023_add V x (q11352023_neg V y).

Definition q11352023_vector_sequence_converges {G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (u : nat -> G) (limit : G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q11352023_norm V
          (q11352023_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q11352023_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q11352023_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q11352023_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q11352023_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q11352023_measurable_simple {A G : Type}
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q11352023_set A),
    q11352023_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q11352023_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q11352023_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q11352023_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q11352023_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q11352023_nnreal_value : R;
  q11352023_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q11352023_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q11352023_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q11352023_nonnegative_real) : q11352023_ennreal :=
  q11352023_ennreal_finite
    (q11352023_nnreal_value x)
    (q11352023_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q11352023_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q11352023_ennreal)
    (value : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q11352023_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q11352023_set A),
    q11352023_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q11352023_ennreal_le
        (q11352023_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q11352023_ennreal_eq value
      (q11352023_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q11352023_ennreal_mul
            (q11352023_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q11352023_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q11352023_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q11352023_ennreal)
    (value : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q11352023_ennreal_supremum
    (q11352023_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q11352023_norm_rpow {G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (x : G) (exponent : R) : q11352023_ennreal :=
  q11352023_ennreal_rpow
    (q11352023_ennreal_finite
      (q11352023_norm V x)
      (q11352023_norm_nonnegative V x))
    exponent.

Definition q11352023_eLpNorm_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G)
    (p value : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | q11352023_ennreal_finite exponent _ =>
      0 < exponent /\
      exists integral : q11352023_ennreal,
        q11352023_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x => q11352023_norm_rpow V (f x) exponent)
          integral /\
        q11352023_ennreal_eq value
          (q11352023_ennreal_rpow integral (/ exponent))
  | q11352023_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q11352023_mem_lp {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G)
    (p : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable V mu f /\
  exists value : q11352023_ennreal,
    q11352023_eLpNorm_has_value V mu f p value /\
    q11352023_ennreal_lt value q11352023_ennreal_infinity.

Definition q11352023_indicator {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (E : q11352023_set A)
    (f : A -> G) (x : A) : G :=
  if excluded_middle_informative (E x)
  then f x
  else q11352023_zero V.

Definition q11352023_tendsto_in_measure {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : nat -> A -> G)
    (g : A -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon delta : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    0 < delta ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q11352023_ennreal_below_real
          (q11352023_measure mu
            (fun x =>
              epsilon <=
              q11352023_norm V
                (q11352023_sub V (f n x) (g x))))
          delta.

Definition q11352023_unif_integrable {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : nat -> A -> G)
    (p : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall (n : nat) (E : q11352023_set A),
        q11352023_measurable mu E ->
        q11352023_ennreal_le_real
          (q11352023_measure mu E) delta ->
        exists value : q11352023_ennreal,
          q11352023_eLpNorm_has_value V mu
            (q11352023_indicator V E (f n)) p value /\
          q11352023_ennreal_le_real value epsilon.

Definition q11352023_unif_tight {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : nat -> A -> G)
    (p : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists E : q11352023_set A,
      ~ q11352023_ennreal_eq
          (q11352023_measure mu E)
          q11352023_ennreal_infinity /\
      forall n : nat,
        exists value : q11352023_ennreal,
          q11352023_eLpNorm_has_value V mu
            (q11352023_indicator V
              (q11352023_complement E) (f n))
            p value /\
          q11352023_ennreal_le_real value epsilon.

Definition q11352023_tendsto_lp {A G : Type}
    (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (mu : q11352023_measure_space A)
    (f : nat -> A -> G)
    (g : A -> G)
    (p : q11352023_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        exists value : q11352023_ennreal,
          q11352023_eLpNorm_has_value V mu
            (fun x => q11352023_sub V (f n x) (g x))
            p value /\
          q11352023_ennreal_below_real value epsilon.

Theorem tendstoInMeasure_iff_tendsto_Lp :
  forall (Alpha G : Type)
         (V : q11352023_normed_add_comm_group G)
         (mu : q11352023_measure_space Alpha)
         (p : q11352023_ennreal)
         (f : nat -> Alpha -> G)
         (g : Alpha -> G),
    q11352023_ennreal_le q11352023_ennreal_one p ->
    p <> q11352023_ennreal_infinity ->
    (forall n : nat, q11352023_mem_lp V mu (f n) p) ->
    q11352023_mem_lp V mu g p ->
    (q11352023_tendsto_in_measure V mu f g /\
     q11352023_unif_integrable V mu f p /\
     q11352023_unif_tight V mu f p
     <->
     q11352023_tendsto_lp V mu f g p).
Admitted.

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q11352023,
  "Vitali convergence theorem": for a finite exponent at least one, convergence
  in measure together with uniform integrability and uniform tightness is
  equivalent to convergence in Lp on an arbitrary measure space.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
begin

definition q11352023_normed_add_comm_group ::
    "('b::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q11352023_normed_add_comm_group bnorm \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> bnorm x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x. bnorm x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. bnorm (x + y) \<le> bnorm x + bnorm y) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. dist x y = bnorm (x - y))"

definition q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::metric_space) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable M h \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
        (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
        (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> h x))"

definition q11352023_eLpNorm ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('b \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  where
    "q11352023_eLpNorm M bnorm p h =
      (let I = nn_integral M (\<lambda>x. ennreal (bnorm (h x) powr p))
       in if I = \<infinity> then \<infinity>
          else ennreal (enn2real I powr (1 / p)))"

definition q11352023_mem_Lp ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('b::metric_space \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q11352023_mem_Lp M bnorm p h \<longleftrightarrow>
      q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable M h \<and>
      q11352023_eLpNorm M bnorm p h < \<infinity>"

definition q11352023_outer_measure ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  where
    "q11352023_outer_measure M A =
      Inf {emeasure M B | B. B \<in> sets M \<and> A \<subseteq> B}"

definition q11352023_tendsto_in_measure ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b::metric_space) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q11352023_tendsto_in_measure M f g \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>\<epsilon> :: real. 0 < \<epsilon> \<longrightarrow>
        (\<lambda>n. q11352023_outer_measure M
          {x. \<epsilon> \<le> dist (f n x) (g x)})
          \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0)"

definition q11352023_indicator ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::zero) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
  where
    "q11352023_indicator A h x = (if x \<in> A then h x else 0)"

definition q11352023_unif_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('b::zero \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q11352023_unif_integrable M bnorm p f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>\<epsilon> :: real. 0 < \<epsilon> \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>\<delta> :: real. 0 < \<delta> \<and>
          (\<forall>n A. A \<in> sets M \<longrightarrow>
            emeasure M A \<le> ennreal \<delta> \<longrightarrow>
            q11352023_eLpNorm M bnorm p (q11352023_indicator A (f n))
              \<le> ennreal \<epsilon>)))"

definition q11352023_unif_tight ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('b::zero \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q11352023_unif_tight M bnorm p f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>\<epsilon> :: real. 0 < \<epsilon> \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>A. q11352023_outer_measure M A \<noteq> \<infinity> \<and>
          (\<forall>n. q11352023_eLpNorm M bnorm p
            (q11352023_indicator (- A) (f n))
            \<le> ennreal \<epsilon>)))"

theorem vitali_convergence_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and bnorm :: "'b::{ab_group_add,metric_space} \<Rightarrow> real"
    and p :: real
    and f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and g :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
  assumes full_space:
      "space M = UNIV"
    and normed_group:
      "q11352023_normed_add_comm_group bnorm"
    and exponent:
      "1 \<le> p"
    and f_mem_Lp:
      "\<And>n. q11352023_mem_Lp M bnorm p (f n)"
    and g_mem_Lp:
      "q11352023_mem_Lp M bnorm p g"
  shows
      "q11352023_tendsto_in_measure M f g \<and>
        q11352023_unif_integrable M bnorm p f \<and>
        q11352023_unif_tight M bnorm p f
      \<longleftrightarrow>
        (\<lambda>n. q11352023_eLpNorm M bnorm p
          (\<lambda>x. f n x - g x)) \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0"
  sorry

end

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q11352023,
  "Vitali convergence theorem": for a sequence of functions on an arbitrary
  measure space, convergence in measure together with uniform Lp integrability
  and uniform Lp tightness is equivalent to convergence in Lp. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q11352023_VITALI_CONVERGENCE_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let eone = (F,&1) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let elt =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        ~(FST x) /\ (FST y \/ SND x < SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let rpow =
      \(x:real) (q:real).
        if x = &0
        then if q = &0 then &1 else &0
        else exp(q * log x) in
   let erpow =
      \(z:bool#real) (q:real).
        if q = &0
        then eone
        else if FST z
        then etop
        else (F,rpow (SND z) q) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:B->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:B->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:B | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!s:B->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s:B->bool. mu s = mu (s INTER carrier)) /\
        (!s t:B->bool.
           s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!s:B->bool. !z:bool#real.
           enonnegative z /\
           (!t:B->bool.
              events t /\ (s INTER carrier) SUBSET t
              ==> ele z (mu t))
           ==> ele z (mu s)) /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:B | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real) (P:B->bool).
        ?N:B->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:B | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let normed_add_comm_group =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!x:A. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
        (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let vector_tends =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (u:num->A) (l:A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n
                ==> norm (add (u n) (neg l)) < e in
   let simple_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool) (s:B->A).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:A. events {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:B->A).
        ?s:num->B->A.
          (!n. simple_vector carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x:B.
             x IN carrier
             ==> vector_tends add neg norm
                   (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:B->A).
        ?g:B->A.
          strongly_measurable_vector
            carrier events add neg norm g /\
          almost_everywhere
            carrier events mu (\x:B. h x = g x) in
   let simple_function =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool) (s:B->bool#real).
        (!x:B. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:bool#real.
           events {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x. x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n enum partial.
          (!x. x IN items <=> ?i. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:B->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s carrier)
          (\c. emul c
                 (mu {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(P:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v. P v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!v. P v ==> ele v w)
             ==> ele z w) in
   let lintegral =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:B->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v. ?s:B->bool#real.
                   simple_function carrier events s /\
                   (!x:B.
                      x IN carrier ==> ele (s x) (h x)) /\
                   simple_lintegral carrier mu s v)
            z in
   let indicator =
      \(zero:A) (s:B->bool) (h:B->A) (x:B).
        if x IN s then h x else zero in
   let difference =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (h:B->A) (k:B->A) (x:B).
        add (h x) (neg (k x)) in
   let lp_norm =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (norm:A->real) (p:real) (h:B->A).
        erpow
          (lintegral carrier events mu
            (\x:B. (F,rpow (norm (h x)) p)))
          (&1 / p) in
   let mem_lp =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (p:real) (h:B->A).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector
          carrier events mu add neg norm h /\
        elt (lp_norm carrier events mu norm p h) etop in
   let etends_zero =
      \(u:num->bool#real).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n ==> elt (u n) (F,e) in
   let tends_in_measure =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (seq:num->B->A) (g:B->A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> etends_zero
                (\n:num.
                   mu {x:B |
                     x IN carrier /\
                     e <= norm
                       (add (seq n x) (neg (g x)))}) in
   let unif_integrable =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (zero:A) (norm:A->real) (p:real)
       (seq:num->B->A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?d:real.
                &0 < d /\
                !n:num. !s:B->bool.
                  events s /\
                  ele (mu s) (F,d)
                  ==> ele
                        (lp_norm carrier events mu norm p
                          (indicator zero s (seq n)))
                        (F,e) in
   let unif_tight =
      \(carrier:B->bool)
       (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (zero:A) (norm:A->real) (p:real)
       (seq:num->B->A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?s:B->bool.
                s SUBSET carrier /\
                ~(FST (mu s)) /\
                !n:num.
                  ele
                    (lp_norm carrier events mu norm p
                      (indicator zero (carrier DIFF s) (seq n)))
                    (F,e) in
   !carrier:B->bool
    events:(B->bool)->bool
    mu:(B->bool)->bool#real
    zero:A
    add:A->A->A
    neg:A->A
    norm:A->real
    p:real
    seq:num->B->A
    g:B->A.
      measure_space carrier events mu /\
      normed_add_comm_group zero add neg norm /\
      &1 <= p /\
      (!n:num.
         mem_lp carrier events mu add neg norm p (seq n)) /\
      mem_lp carrier events mu add neg norm p g
      ==>
      (tends_in_measure carrier mu add neg norm seq g /\
       unif_integrable carrier events mu zero norm p seq /\
       unif_tight carrier events mu zero norm p seq
       <=>
       etends_zero
         (\n:num.
            lp_norm carrier events mu norm p
              (difference add neg (seq n) g)))`;;

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q11352023,
;; "Vitali convergence theorem": for a finite exponent p at least one on an
;; arbitrary measure space, convergence in measure together with uniform
;; integrability and uniform tightness is equivalent to convergence in Lp.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, functions, sigma algebras, and operations are tame APPLY$
;; function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification, and
;; inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal existential
;; witnesses. The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence
;; a presentation of the real field. The measure on an arbitrary subset is
;; characterized as the infimum of the measures of its measurable supersets,
;; so null exceptional sets use outer-measure semantics. The lower integral is
;; the supremum of integrals of measurable finite-range simple minorants.
;; Strong measurability is approximation by measurable finite-range functions,
;; real powers are characterized through the exponential series and logarithm,
;; and all Lp, convergence, integrability, and tightness predicates below are
;; expanded from those objects. Since the source assumes p is finite and at
;; least one, p is represented by its unique real value in [1,infinity).

(defun q11352023-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q11352023-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q11352023-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q11352023-quoted nil)))

(defun q11352023-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (q11352023-term-list arguments)))

(defun q11352023-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q11352023-apply-term
   (q11352023-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q11352023-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q11352023-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q11352023-quoted nil))
    (q11352023-quoted t)))

(defun q11352023-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q11352023-quoted t)
            (q11352023-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q11352023-quoted nil)))

(defun q11352023-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q11352023-quoted nil)
        (q11352023-quoted t)))

(defun q11352023-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q11352023-quoted t)))

(defun q11352023-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q11352023-quoted t)
              (q11352023-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q11352023-quoted nil)
              (q11352023-quoted t))))

(defun q11352023-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q11352023-quoted t)))

(defun q11352023-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q11352023-quoted nil)))

(defun q11352023-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q11352023-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q11352023-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (q11352023-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q11352023-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q11352023-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q11352023-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets and arbitrary functions.

(defun q11352023-set-subset-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q11352023-implies-term
    (q11352023-and-terms
     (list
      (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q11352023-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q11352023-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q11352023-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (q11352023-universal-p
    (q11352023-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q11352023-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q11352023-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun q11352023-set-equiv-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q11352023-implies-term
    (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q11352023-iff-term
     (q11352023-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q11352023-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q11352023-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q11352023-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q11352023-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q11352023-universal-p
    (q11352023-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q11352023-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (q11352023-quoted nil)))

(defun q11352023-full-set (carrier)
  (list 'lambda '(x)
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun q11352023-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q11352023-and-terms
    (list
     (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q11352023-not-term
      (q11352023-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun q11352023-function-values-function
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q11352023-implies-term
    (q11352023-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))
    (q11352023-static-apply-term
     codomain-carrier
     (list (q11352023-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun q11352023-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q11352023-universal-p
    (q11352023-function-values-function
     domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun q11352023-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (q11352023-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (q11352023-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q11352023-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (q11352023-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q11352023-implies-term
      (q11352023-and-terms
       (list
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q11352023-and-terms
       (list
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (q11352023-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (q11352023-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q11352023-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q11352023-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q11352023-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (q11352023-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q11352023-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q11352023-quoted zero)))
        (q11352023-implies-term
         (q11352023-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q11352023-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q11352023-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q11352023-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q11352023-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (q11352023-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (q11352023-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (q11352023-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q11352023-implies-term
      (q11352023-and-terms
       (list
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q11352023-and-terms
       (list
        (q11352023-not-term
         (q11352023-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q11352023-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (q11352023-implies-term
         (q11352023-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q11352023-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q11352023-implies-term
         xy
         (q11352023-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q11352023-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q11352023-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q11352023-implies-term
         (q11352023-and-terms
          (list
           (q11352023-static-apply-term
            less (list (q11352023-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q11352023-static-apply-term
            less (list (q11352023-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q11352023-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q11352023-quoted zero)
           (q11352023-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun q11352023-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q11352023-implies-term
    (q11352023-and-terms
     (list
      (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q11352023-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q11352023-not-term
     (q11352023-static-apply-term
      less (list (q11352023-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun q11352023-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (q11352023-member-p carrier upper)
   (q11352023-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q11352023-universal-p
    (q11352023-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun q11352023-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q11352023-and-terms
    (list
     (q11352023-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q11352023-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun q11352023-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (q11352023-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q11352023-exists-p
    (q11352023-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun q11352023-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'q11352023-upper-bound-p
         (q11352023-quoted carrier)
         (q11352023-quoted less)
         (q11352023-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun q11352023-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (q11352023-exists-p
   (q11352023-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun q11352023-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (q11352023-implies-term
    (list 'q11352023-upper-bound-p
          (q11352023-quoted carrier)
          (q11352023-quoted less)
          (q11352023-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (q11352023-not-term
     (q11352023-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (q11352023-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun q11352023-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (q11352023-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (q11352023-universal-p

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun q11352023-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :q11352023-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q11352023-finite)
    (q11352023-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (q11352023-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun q11352023-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q11352023-finite value))

(defun q11352023-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (q11352023-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun q11352023-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q11352023-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q11352023-top) t)
   (t
    (q11352023-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q11352023-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (q11352023-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun q11352023-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :q11352023-top)
          (equal right :q11352023-top))
      :q11352023-top
    (q11352023-ennreal-finite
     (q11352023-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q11352023-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q11352023-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (q11352023-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (q11352023-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :q11352023-top)
        (equal right :q11352023-top))
    :q11352023-top)
   (t
    (q11352023-ennreal-finite
     (q11352023-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q11352023-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q11352023-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (q11352023-ennreal-add
     (q11352023-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (q11352023-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(count)
   (q11352023-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'count)
    (list 'q11352023-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (list 'q11352023-finite-ennreal-sum
                (q11352023-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (q11352023-quoted scalar-zero)
                (q11352023-quoted scalar-add))
          (q11352023-quoted total)
          (q11352023-quoted scalar-less)))))

    (sequence total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)

     (list

            'bound
            (q11352023-quoted scalar-carrier)

            (q11352023-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'q11352023-sum-upper-bound-p
            (q11352023-quoted sequence)

            (q11352023-quoted scalar-zero)
            (q11352023-quoted scalar-add)
            (q11352023-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'q11352023-ennreal-less-equal-p

;; Arbitrary normed additive commutative groups.

(defun q11352023-normed-group-laws-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less
     vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate vector-norm)
  (let* ((xy
          (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-add '(x y)))
         (yz
          (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-add '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-negate '(x)))
         (norm-x
          (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-norm '(x)))
         (norm-y
          (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-norm '(y))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q11352023-implies-term
      (q11352023-and-terms
       (list
        (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-carrier '(x))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-carrier '(y))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-carrier '(z))))
      (q11352023-and-terms
       (list
        (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-carrier (list xy))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-carrier (list neg-x))
        (q11352023-static-apply-term scalar-carrier (list norm-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               vector-add (list xy 'z))
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               vector-add (list 'x yz)))
        (list 'equal xy
              (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               vector-add
               (list 'x (q11352023-quoted vector-zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               vector-add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q11352023-quoted vector-zero))
        (q11352023-not-term
         (q11352023-static-apply-term
          scalar-less
          (list norm-x (q11352023-quoted scalar-zero))))
        (q11352023-iff-term
         (list 'equal norm-x (q11352023-quoted scalar-zero))
         (list 'equal 'x (q11352023-quoted vector-zero)))
        (list 'equal
              (q11352023-static-apply-term
               vector-norm (list neg-x))
              norm-x)
        (q11352023-less-equal-term
         scalar-less
         (q11352023-static-apply-term vector-norm (list xy))
         (q11352023-static-apply-term
          scalar-add (list norm-x norm-y)))))))))
