title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q11352023,
-- "Vitali convergence theorem": for 1 <= p < infinity, convergence in measure
-- together with uniform integrability and uniform tightness is equivalent to
-- convergence in the Lp seminorm. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

Not1 : Set1 -> Set1
Not1 A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record BothL
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor bothL
  field
    firstL  : A
    secondL : B

record IffL
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor equivalenceL
  field
    forwardL  : A -> B
    backwardL : B -> A

record ExistsL
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor witnessL
  field
    valueL    : A
    propertyL : P valueL

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLessR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLessR reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

PositiveR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
PositiveR reals x =
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) x

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

record RealPower
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    powerR :
      R -> R -> R
    power-nonnegativeR :
      (x q : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (powerR x q)
    power-one-exponentR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      powerR x (oneR reals) == x
    power-one-baseR :
      (q : R) ->
      powerR (oneR reals) q == oneR reals
    power-add-exponentsR :
      (x q r : R) ->
      PositiveR reals x ->
      powerR x (addR reals q r) ==
      multiplyR reals (powerR x q) (powerR x r)
    power-multiply-exponentsR :
      (x q r : R) ->
      PositiveR reals x ->
      powerR (powerR x q) r ==
      powerR x (multiplyR reals q r)
    power-strict-monotone-baseR :
      (x y q : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      StrictLessR reals x y ->
      PositiveR reals q ->
      StrictLessR reals (powerR x q) (powerR y q)

open RealPower

record NormedAddCommGroup
  {R : Set}
  (E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE :
      E
    addE :
      E -> E -> E
    negateE :
      E -> E
    normE :
      E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))

open NormedAddCommGroup

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedAddCommGroup E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE group x y =
  addE group x (negateE group y)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A -> Set
    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

data CanonicalENNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  finite-ennreal :
    NonnegativeReal reals ->
    CanonicalENNReal reals
  infinity-ennreal :
    CanonicalENNReal reals

CanonicalENNRealLe :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  Set
CanonicalENNRealLe {reals = reals}
  (finite-ennreal x) (finite-ennreal y) =
  lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y)
CanonicalENNRealLe (finite-ennreal x) infinity-ennreal =
  Top
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal (finite-ennreal y) =
  Bottom
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal infinity-ennreal =
  Top

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (realPower : RealPower reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroM oneM infinityM :
      M
    addM multiplyM :
      M -> M -> M
    lessOrEqualM :
      M -> M -> Set
    finiteM :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      M
    toRealM :
      M -> R
    powerM :
      M -> R -> M

    zero-leastM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatestM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    infinity-not-zeroM :
      infinityM != zeroM
    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x
    add-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x infinityM == infinityM
    add-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM w y) (addM x z)

    multiply-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) ->
      multiplyM x y == multiplyM y x
    multiply-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM (multiplyM x y) z ==
      multiplyM x (multiplyM y z)
    multiply-oneM :
      (x : M) ->
      multiplyM x oneM == x
    multiply-zeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      multiplyM x zeroM == zeroM
    multiply-distributesM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM x (addM y z) ==
      addM (multiplyM x y) (multiplyM x z)

    finite-zeroM :
      finiteM
        (zeroR reals)
        (order-reflexiveR reals (zeroR reals)) ==
      zeroM
    finite-oneM :
      finiteM
        (oneR reals)
        (Both.first (zero-less-than-oneR reals)) ==
      oneM
    finite-orderM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy))
        (lessOrEqualR reals x y)
    finite-addM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (addR reals x y))
        (\ hsum ->
          addM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (addR reals x y) hsum)
    finite-multiplyM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (multiplyR reals x y))
        (\ hproduct ->
          multiplyM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (multiplyR reals x y) hproduct)
    finite-or-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            Exists
              (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
              (\ nonnegative ->
                x == finiteM value nonnegative)))

    toReal-finiteM :
      (x : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      toRealM (finiteM x hx) == x
    toReal-infinityM :
      toRealM infinityM == zeroR reals
    power-finiteM :
      (x q : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      powerM (finiteM x hx) q ==
      finiteM
        (powerR realPower x q)
        (power-nonnegativeR realPower x q hx)
    power-infinity-positiveM :
      (q : R) ->
      PositiveR reals q ->
      powerM infinityM q == infinityM

    supremumM :
      Predicate M -> M
    supremum-upperM :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (x : M) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualM x (supremumM P)
    supremum-leastM :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (upper : M) ->
      ((x : M) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqualM x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM (supremumM P) upper

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

record ENNRealPresentation
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {realPower : RealPower reals}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower) : Set1 where
  field
    toCanonicalENNReal :
      M -> CanonicalENNReal reals
    fromCanonicalENNReal :
      CanonicalENNReal reals -> M
    to-after-fromENNReal :
      (x : CanonicalENNReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (fromCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    from-after-toENNReal :
      (x : M) ->
      fromCanonicalENNReal (toCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    finite-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal
        (finiteM extended
          (realValue x)
          (realValue-nonnegative x)) ==
      finite-ennreal x
    infinity-correspondenceENNReal :
      toCanonicalENNReal (infinityM extended) == infinity-ennreal
    order-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x y : M) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
        (CanonicalENNRealLe
          (toCanonicalENNReal x)
          (toCanonicalENNReal y))

sumFirstM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumFirstM {reals = reals} extended terms zero =
  zeroM extended
sumFirstM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) (terms n)

CountableSum :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
CountableSum extended terms value =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) value)
    ((upper : _) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper)

record Measure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {realPower : RealPower reals}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    outerMass :
      Predicate A -> M
    measurableHull :
      Predicate A -> Predicate A
    outer-mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      outerMass S == outerMass T
    measurable-hull-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events (measurableHull S)
    subset-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S (measurableHull S)
    outer-mass-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass (measurableHull S) == outerMass S
    outer-mass-empty :
      outerMass emptySet == zeroM extended
    outer-mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (outerMass S) (outerMass T)
    outer-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sumValue : M) ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))
        sumValue
    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass T ==
      addM extended
        (outerMass (intersection T S))
        (outerMass (intersection T (complement S)))
    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere {extended = extended} measure property =
  outerMass measure (\ x -> Not (property x)) == zeroM extended

record SimpleFunction
  {A V : Set}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    function :
      A -> V
    cutoff :
      Nat
    values :
      Nat -> V
    pieces :
      Nat -> Predicate A
    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      measurable events (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      j <=N cutoff ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ i ->
          Both (i <=N cutoff) (pieces i x))
    represented-on-pieces :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      function x == values i

open SimpleFunction

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedAddCommGroup E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE group x y =
  normE group (subtractE group x y)

SequentialLimitR :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimitR {R = R} reals distance sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  PositiveR reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLessR reals (distance (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

record StronglyMeasurable
  {A R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals)
  (f : A -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    approximants :
      Nat -> SimpleFunction {V = E} events
    approximates :
      (x : A) ->
      SequentialLimitR reals (distanceE group)
        (\ n -> function (approximants n) x)
        (f x)

record AEStronglyMeasurable
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {realPower : RealPower reals}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals)
  (f : A -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    representative :
      A -> E
    representative-strongly-measurable :
      StronglyMeasurable reals events group representative
    equal-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere measure (\ x -> f x == representative x)

record Indicator
  {A E : Set}
  (zero : E) : Set1 where
  field
    indicator :
      Predicate A ->
      (A -> E) ->
      A -> E
    indicator-on :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (f : A -> E) ->
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      indicator S f x == f x
    indicator-off :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (f : A -> E) ->
      (x : A) ->
      Not (S x) ->
      indicator S f x == zero

open Indicator

record NonnegativeSimpleBelow
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (f : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    underlying :
      SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = R} events
    values-nonnegative :
      (i : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (values underlying i)
    pointwise-below :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (function underlying x)
        (f x)

open NonnegativeSimpleBelow

sumThroughM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumThroughM extended terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThroughM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumThroughM extended terms n) (terms (suc n))

record SimpleLowerIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {realPower : RealPower reals}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  {f : A -> R}
  (simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    integral-equation :
      value ==
      sumThroughM extended
        (\ i ->
          multiplyM extended
            (finiteM extended
              (values (underlying simple) i)
              (values-nonnegative simple i))
            (outerMass measure (pieces (underlying simple) i)))
        (cutoff (underlying simple))

record LowerIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {realPower : RealPower reals}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    simple-integrals-below :
      (simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f) ->
      (simpleValue : M) ->
      SimpleLowerIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue value
    least-upper-bound-integral :
      (upper : M) ->
      ((simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f) ->
        (simpleValue : M) ->
        SimpleLowerIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
        lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper

record LowerIntegration
  {A R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (realPower : RealPower reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower)
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set2 where
  field
    lowerIntegral :
      (A -> R) -> M
    lower-integral-definition :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      ((x : A) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (f x)) ->
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure f (lowerIntegral f)
    lower-integral-unique :
      (f : A -> R) ->
      ((x : A) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (f x)) ->
      (value : M) ->
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure f value ->
      lowerIntegral f == value

open LowerIntegration

record LpSeminorm
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (realPower : RealPower reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals)
  (integration : LowerIntegration reals realPower events extended measure) :
  Set2 where
  field
    eLpNorm :
      (A -> E) ->
      M ->
      M
    eLpNorm-finite-positive-definition :
      (f : A -> E) ->
      (p : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (oneM extended) p ->
      p != infinityM extended ->
      eLpNorm f p ==
      powerM extended
        (lowerIntegral integration
          (\ x ->
            powerR realPower
              (normE group (f x))
              (toRealM extended p)))
        (reciprocalR reals (toRealM extended p))
    eLpNorm-congruent-almost-everywhere :
      (f g : A -> E) ->
      AlmostEverywhere measure (\ x -> f x == g x) ->
      (p : M) ->
      eLpNorm f p == eLpNorm g p

open LpSeminorm

FiniteM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower) ->
  M ->
  Set
FiniteM extended x =
  x != infinityM extended

StrictLessM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set
StrictLessM extended x y =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
    (x != y)

PositiveM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower ->
  M ->
  Set
PositiveM extended x =
  StrictLessM extended (zeroM extended) x

TendsToZeroM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Set
TendsToZeroM {M = M} extended sequence =
  (epsilon : M) ->
  PositiveM extended epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (sequence n) epsilon)

enorm :
  {R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower) ->
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals) ->
  E ->
  M
enorm extended group x =
  finiteM extended
    (normE group x)
    (norm-nonnegativeE group x)

edistance :
  {R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower) ->
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals) ->
  E ->
  E ->
  M
edistance extended group x y =
  enorm extended group (subtractE group x y)

record MemLp
  {A R M E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {realPower : RealPower reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower}
  {measure : Measure extended events}
  {group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals}
  {integration : LowerIntegration reals realPower events extended measure}
  (lp : LpSeminorm
    reals realPower events extended measure group integration)
  (f : A -> E)
  (p : M) : Set1 where
  field
    almost-everywhere-strongly-measurable :
      AEStronglyMeasurable reals events measure group f
    finite-eLpNorm :
      FiniteM extended (eLpNorm lp f p)

TendstoInMeasure :
  {A R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals) ->
  (Nat -> A -> E) ->
  (A -> E) ->
  Set
TendstoInMeasure {M = M} extended measure group functions limit =
  (epsilon : M) ->
  PositiveM extended epsilon ->
  TendsToZeroM extended
    (\ n ->
      outerMass measure
        (\ x ->
          lessOrEqualM extended epsilon
            (edistance extended group (functions n x) (limit x))))

UnifIntegrable :
  {A R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower} ->
  {measure : Measure extended events} ->
  {group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals} ->
  {integration : LowerIntegration reals realPower events extended measure} ->
  (lp : LpSeminorm reals realPower events extended measure group integration) ->
  Indicator (zeroE group) ->
  (Nat -> A -> E) ->
  M ->
  Set1
UnifIntegrable {A = A} {R = R} {reals = reals}
  {events = events} {extended = extended} {measure = measure}
  lp indicators functions p =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  (epsilon-positive : PositiveR reals epsilon) ->
  ExistsL R
    (\ delta ->
      ExistsL (PositiveR reals delta)
        (\ delta-positive ->
          (n : Nat) ->
          (S : Predicate A) ->
          measurable events S ->
          lessOrEqualM extended
            (outerMass measure S)
            (finiteM extended delta (Both.first delta-positive)) ->
          lessOrEqualM extended
            (eLpNorm lp (indicator indicators S (functions n)) p)
            (finiteM extended epsilon (Both.first epsilon-positive))))

UnifTight :
  {A R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {realPower : RealPower reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower} ->
  {measure : Measure extended events} ->
  {group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals} ->
  {integration : LowerIntegration reals realPower events extended measure} ->
  (lp : LpSeminorm reals realPower events extended measure group integration) ->
  Indicator (zeroE group) ->
  (Nat -> A -> E) ->
  M ->
  Set1
UnifTight {A = A} {R = R} {reals = reals}
  {extended = extended} {measure = measure}
  lp indicators functions p =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  (epsilon-positive : PositiveR reals epsilon) ->
  ExistsL (Predicate A)
    (\ S ->
      Both
        (outerMass measure S != infinityM extended)
        ((n : Nat) ->
          lessOrEqualM extended
            (eLpNorm lp
              (indicator indicators (complement S) (functions n))
              p)
            (finiteM extended epsilon (Both.first epsilon-positive))))

vitali-convergence-theorem : Set2
vitali-convergence-theorem =
  (A R M E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (realPower : RealPower reals) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals realPower) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (group : NormedAddCommGroup E reals) ->
  (indicators : Indicator (zeroE group)) ->
  (integration : LowerIntegration reals realPower events extended measure) ->
  (lp : LpSeminorm
    reals realPower events extended measure group integration) ->
  (p : M) ->
  lessOrEqualM extended (oneM extended) p ->
  p != infinityM extended ->
  (functions : Nat -> A -> E) ->
  (limit : A -> E) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> MemLp lp (functions n) p) ->
  MemLp lp limit p ->
  IffL
    (BothL
      (TendstoInMeasure extended measure group functions limit)
      (BothL
        (UnifIntegrable lp indicators functions p)
        (UnifTight lp indicators functions p)))
    (TendsToZeroM extended
      (\ n ->
        eLpNorm lp
          (\ x -> subtractE group (functions n x) (limit x))
          p))

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q11352023, "Vitali convergence theorem": for a finite exponent p at least
  one, Lp convergence is equivalent to convergence in measure together with
  uniform integrability and uniform tightness. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q11352023_normed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_normed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q11352023_normed_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)``);

val q11352023_tendsto_zero_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_tendsto_zero_def",
  ``q11352023_tendsto_zero (u : num -> extreal) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !n. N <= n ==> u n <= Normal epsilon``);

val q11352023_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q11352023_measurable_simple
      (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'g. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q11352023_tendsto_in_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_tendsto_in_norm_def",
  ``q11352023_tendsto_in_norm
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !n. N <= n ==>
          norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q11352023_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q11352023_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'a -> 'g.
        (!n. q11352023_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q11352023_tendsto_in_norm add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?h : 'a -> 'g.
        q11352023_strongly_measurable m add neg norm h /\
        (AE x::m. f x = h x)``);

val q11352023_rpow_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_rpow_def",
  ``q11352023_rpow (r : real) (p : real) =
      if r = 0 then 0 else r rpow p``);

val q11352023_lp_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_lp_norm_def",
  ``q11352023_lp_norm
      (m : 'a m_space) (norm : 'g -> real) (p : real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) =
      let integral_p =
        pos_fn_integral m
          (\x. Normal (q11352023_rpow (norm (f x)) p))
      in
        if integral_p = PosInf then PosInf
        else if integral_p = 0 then Normal 0
        else Normal (q11352023_rpow (real integral_p) (inv p))``);

val q11352023_mem_lp_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_mem_lp_def",
  ``q11352023_mem_lp
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (p : real) (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      q11352023_ae_strongly_measurable m add neg norm f /\
      q11352023_lp_norm m norm p f <> PosInf``);

val q11352023_indicator_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_indicator_def",
  ``q11352023_indicator
      (zero : 'g) (s : 'a set) (f : 'a -> 'g) (x : 'a) =
      if x IN s then f x else zero``);

val q11352023_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_outer_measure_def",
  ``q11352023_outer_measure (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) =
      inf
        {r : extreal |
          ?t : 'a set.
            s SUBSET t /\
            t IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m t = r}``);

val q11352023_tendsto_in_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_tendsto_in_measure_def",
  ``q11352023_tendsto_in_measure
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : num -> 'a -> 'g) (g : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        q11352023_tendsto_zero
          (\n.
            q11352023_outer_measure m
              {x |
                epsilon <=
                  norm (add (f n x) (neg (g x)))})``);

val q11352023_unif_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_unif_integrable_def",
  ``q11352023_unif_integrable
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (p : real) (f : num -> 'a -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !i s.
            s IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m s <= Normal delta
            ==>
            q11352023_lp_norm m norm p
              (q11352023_indicator zero s (f i)) <= Normal epsilon``);

val q11352023_unif_tight_def = new_definition (
  "q11352023_unif_tight_def",
  ``q11352023_unif_tight
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (p : real) (f : num -> 'a -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?s : 'a set.
          q11352023_outer_measure m s <> PosInf /\
          !i.
            q11352023_lp_norm m norm p
              (q11352023_indicator zero (UNIV DIFF s) (f i))
              <= Normal epsilon``);

val vitali_convergence_theorem =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space)
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (norm : 'g -> real) (p : real)
      (f : num -> 'a -> 'g) (g : 'a -> 'g).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q11352023_normed_add_comm_group zero add neg norm /\
      1 <= p /\
      (!n. q11352023_mem_lp m add neg norm p (f n)) /\
      q11352023_mem_lp m add neg norm p g
      ==>
      (q11352023_tendsto_in_measure m add neg norm f g /\
       q11352023_unif_integrable m zero norm p f /\
       q11352023_unif_tight m zero norm p f
       <=>
       q11352023_tendsto_zero
         (\n.
           q11352023_lp_norm m norm p
             (\x. add (f n x) (neg (g x)))))``;

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q11352023
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q11352023), "Vitali convergence theorem":
  for a sequence and limit in L^p over an arbitrary measure space, convergence
  in measure together with uniform integrability and uniform tightness is
  equivalent to convergence in L^p. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  M ranges over arbitrary SetMM measures and W over arbitrary normed Abelian
  groups, matching Lean's measure spaces and NormedAddCommGroup codomain.
  Since the theorem assumes 1 <= p and p != infinity, p is represented by its
  unique finite real value in [1,infinity), canonically equivalent to the
  corresponding extended nonnegative real.

  Q11352023Simple and Q11352023SimpleIntegral give the usual nonnegative
  measurable simple functions and their integrals. Q11352023LIntegral is the
  lower Lebesgue integral, and Q11352023ELpNorm is the p-th root of the lower
  integral of the p-th power of the pointwise norm. Q11352023Measure is the
  outer measure induced by M, so it applies to arbitrary subsets exactly as a
  Lean measure does.

  The remaining definitions expand almost-everywhere strong measurability,
  MemLp, convergence in measure, uniform integrability, uniform tightness, and
  convergence of the L^p norm to zero. The final declaration is the single
  unproved corpus $a statement. All preceding $a declarations are syntax or
  faithful definitions, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q11352023Simple Q11352023SimpleIntegral Q11352023LIntegral
   Q11352023Measure Q11352023Indicator Q11352023Diff Q11352023Tendsto
   Q11352023AEStrong Q11352023ELpNorm Q11352023MemLp
   Q11352023InMeasure Q11352023UnifIntegrable Q11352023UnifTight
   Q11352023TendstoLpZero $.

q11352023-simple-syntax $a wff ( Q11352023Simple M G ) $.
q11352023-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q11352023SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q11352023-lintegral-syntax $a class ( Q11352023LIntegral M H ) $.
q11352023-measure-syntax $a class ( Q11352023Measure M A ) $.
q11352023-indicator-syntax
  $a class ( Q11352023Indicator M W A H ) $.
q11352023-diff-syntax $a class ( Q11352023Diff M W H K ) $.
q11352023-tendsto-syntax $a wff ( Q11352023Tendsto W S z ) $.
q11352023-aestrong-syntax $a wff ( Q11352023AEStrong M W H ) $.
q11352023-elp-norm-syntax
  $a class ( Q11352023ELpNorm M W p H ) $.
q11352023-mem-lp-syntax $a wff ( Q11352023MemLp M W p H ) $.
q11352023-in-measure-syntax
  $a wff ( Q11352023InMeasure M W F G ) $.
q11352023-unif-integrable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q11352023UnifIntegrable M W p F ) $.
q11352023-unif-tight-syntax
  $a wff ( Q11352023UnifTight M W p F ) $.
q11352023-tendsto-lp-zero-syntax
  $a wff ( Q11352023TendstoLpZero M W p F G ) $.

${
  $d G M $.

  q11352023-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q11352023-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q11352023SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M g x y $.

  q11352023-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q11352023LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. g
          (
            ( Q11352023Simple M g )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M ( g ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q11352023SimpleIntegral M g )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A M $.

  q11352023-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q11352023Measure M A
  ) = ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A ) $.
$}

${
  $d A H M W x $.

  q11352023-indicator-definition $a |- (
    Q11352023Indicator M W A H
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      if
      (
        x e. A ,
        ( H ` x ) ,
        ( 0g ` W )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q11352023-diff-definition $a |- (
    Q11352023Diff M W H K
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      (
        ( H ` x )
        ( +g ` W )
        ( ( -g ` W ) ` ( K ` x ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d S W z $.

  q11352023-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023Tendsto W S z )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) z
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M W a f n x $.

  q11352023-aestrong-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023AEStrong M W H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      E. f e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( f ` n )
                e. ( dom M MblFnM ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) )
              /\
              ran ( f ` n ) e. Fin
            )
          /\
          E. a e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` a ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ a )
                (
                  Q11352023Tendsto
                  W
                  ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( f ` n ) ` x ) )
                  ( H ` x )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M W p x y $.

  q11352023-elp-norm-definition $a |- (
    Q11352023ELpNorm M W p H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. ( 0 [,) +oo ) |
        ( y ^c p )
        <_
        (
          Q11352023LIntegral
          M
          ( x e. U. dom M |->
            ( ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( H ` x ) ) ^c p )
          )
        )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M W p $.

  q11352023-mem-lp-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023MemLp M W p H )
    <->
    (
      ( Q11352023AEStrong M W H )
      /\
      ( Q11352023ELpNorm M W p H ) < +oo
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G M W d e k n x $.

  q11352023-in-measure-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023InMeasure M W F G )
    <->
    A. e e. ( 0 (,) +oo ) A. d e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
      E. n e. NN0 A. k e. NN0
        (
          n <_ k
          ->
          (
            Q11352023Measure
            M
            { x e. U. dom M |
              e <_
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  (
                    (
                      Q11352023Diff
                      M
                      W
                      ( F ` k )
                      G
                    )
                    `
                    x
                  )
                )
            }
          )
          <_
          d
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M W a d e n p $.

  q11352023-unif-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023UnifIntegrable M W p F )
    <->
    A. e e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
      E. d e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
        A. n e. NN0 A. a e. dom M
          (
            ( M ` a ) <_ d
            ->
            (
              Q11352023ELpNorm
              M
              W
              p
              ( Q11352023Indicator M W a ( F ` n ) )
            )
            <_
            e
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M W a e n p $.

  q11352023-unif-tight-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023UnifTight M W p F )
    <->
    A. e e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
      E. a e. ~P ( U. dom M )
        (
          ( Q11352023Measure M a ) =/= +oo
          /\
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              Q11352023ELpNorm
              M
              W
              p
              (
                Q11352023Indicator
                M
                W
                ( U. dom M \ a )
                ( F ` n )
              )
            )
            <_
            e
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G M W e k n p $.

  q11352023-tendsto-lp-zero-definition $a |- (
    ( Q11352023TendstoLpZero M W p F G )
    <->
    A. e e. ( 0 (,) +oo )
      E. n e. NN0 A. k e. NN0
        (
          n <_ k
          ->
          (
            Q11352023ELpNorm
            M
            W
            p
            ( Q11352023Diff M W ( F ` k ) G )
          )
          <_
          e
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f g m n p w $.

  thousand-theorems-q11352023-vitali-convergence $a |-
    A. m e. U. ran measures
      A. w e. ( NrmGrp i^i Abel )
        A. p e. ( 1 [,) +oo )
          A. f e. ( ( ( Base ` w ) ^m U. dom m ) ^m NN0 )
            A. g e. ( ( Base ` w ) ^m U. dom m )
              (
                (
                  A. n e. NN0
                    ( Q11352023MemLp m w p ( f ` n ) )
                  /\
                  ( Q11352023MemLp m w p g )
                )
                ->
                (
                  (
                    ( Q11352023InMeasure m w f g )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( Q11352023UnifIntegrable m w p f )
                      /\
                      ( Q11352023UnifTight m w p f )
                    )
                  )
                  <->
                  ( Q11352023TendstoLpZero m w p f g )
                )
              )
  $.
$}

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q11352023,
:: "Vitali convergence theorem": for a finite exponent at least one, an
:: Lp sequence converges in measure and is uniformly integrable and uniformly
:: tight if and only if it converges in Lp to its specified Lp limit.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4,
      MEASURE6, MEASURE8, SUBSET_1, SEQFUNC, MESFUNC5, PARTFUN1, XXREAL_0,
      NAT_1,
      RELAT_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL2, CARD_1, COMPLEX1, SEQ_2,

theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       B being non empty set,
       z being Element of B,
       Aop being Function of [:B,B:],B,
       Nop being Function of B,B,
       rho being Function of B,REAL,
       p being Real,
       F being sequence of Funcs(X,B),
       g being Function of X,B
   st
     1 <= p &
     (for a,b,c being Element of B holds
       Aop.[Aop.[a,b],c] = Aop.[a,Aop.[b,c]]) &
     (for a,b being Element of B holds Aop.[a,b] = Aop.[b,a]) &
     (for a being Element of B holds
       Aop.[a,z] = a & Aop.[a,Nop.a] = z) &
     (for a being Element of B holds
       0 <= rho.a & (rho.a = 0 iff a = z) & rho.(Nop.a) = rho.a) &
     (for a,b being Element of B holds
       rho.(Aop.[a,b]) <= rho.a + rho.b)
   holds
     ((for eps,eta being Real st 0 < eps & 0 < eta holds
         ex n0 being Nat st
           for n being Nat st n0 <= n holds
             (C_Meas M).X < eta)
      &
      (for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for n being Nat,
              A being Element of S st M.A <= delta holds
            0 <= eps to_power p)
      &
      (for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex A being Element of S st
          M.A < +infty &
          for n being Nat holds 0 <= eps to_power p))
     iff
      for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex n0 being Nat st
          for n being Nat st n0 <= n holds
            0 < eps to_power p)
  &
  (for X being non empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       B being non empty set,
       z being Element of B,
       Aop being Function of [:B,B:],B,
       Nop being Function of B,B,
       rho being Function of B,REAL,
       p being Real,
       F being sequence of Funcs(X,B),
       g being Function of X,B
   st
     1 <= p &
     (for a,b,c being Element of B holds
       Aop.[Aop.[a,b],c] = Aop.[a,Aop.[b,c]]) &
     (for a,b being Element of B holds Aop.[a,b] = Aop.[b,a]) &
     (for a being Element of B holds
       Aop.[a,z] = a & Aop.[a,Nop.a] = z) &
     (for a being Element of B holds
       0 <= rho.a & (rho.a = 0 iff a = z) & rho.(Nop.a) = rho.a) &
     (for a,b being Element of B holds
       rho.(Aop.[a,b]) <= rho.a + rho.b) &
     (for n being Nat holds
       ex Fn being Function of X,B,
          N being Element of S,
          Q being sequence of Funcs(X,B),
          u being Function of X,REAL
       st
         F.n = Fn &
         M.N = 0 &
         (for k being Nat holds
           ex q being Function of X,B,
              R being finite Subset of B
           st
             Q.k = q &
             (for x being Element of X holds q.x in R) &
             for y being Element of B holds
               {x where x is Element of X: q.x = y} in S) &
         (for x being Element of X st not x in N holds
           for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
             ex k0 being Nat st
               for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
                 ex q being Function of X,B st
                   Q.k = q &
                   rho.(Aop.[q.x,Nop.(Fn.x)]) < eps) &
         (for x being Element of X holds
           u.x = (rho.(Fn.x)) to_power p) &
         integral+(COM(M),R_EAL u) < +infty) &
     (ex N being Element of S,
         Q being sequence of Funcs(X,B),
         u being Function of X,REAL
      st
        M.N = 0 &
        (for k being Nat holds
          ex q being Function of X,B,
             R being finite Subset of B
          st
            Q.k = q &
            (for x being Element of X holds q.x in R) &
            for y being Element of B holds
              {x where x is Element of X: q.x = y} in S) &
        (for x being Element of X st not x in N holds
          for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
                ex q being Function of X,B st
                  Q.k = q &
                  rho.(Aop.[q.x,Nop.(g.x)]) < eps) &
        (for x being Element of X holds
          u.x = (rho.(g.x)) to_power p) &
        integral+(COM(M),R_EAL u) < +infty)
   holds
     ((for eps,eta being Real st 0 < eps & 0 < eta holds
         ex n0 being Nat st
           for n being Nat st n0 <= n holds
             ex Fn being Function of X,B st
               F.n = Fn &
               (C_Meas M).
                 {x where x is Element of X:
                   eps <= rho.(Aop.[Fn.x,Nop.(g.x)])} < eta)
      &
      (for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for n being Nat,
              A being Element of S st M.A <= delta holds
            ex Fn being Function of X,B,
               u being Function of X,REAL
            st
              F.n = Fn &
              (for x being Element of X st x in A holds
                u.x = (rho.(Fn.x)) to_power p) &
              (for x being Element of X st not x in A holds u.x = 0) &
              integral+(COM(M),R_EAL u) <= eps to_power p)
      &
      (for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex A being Element of S st
          M.A < +infty &
          for n being Nat holds
            ex Fn being Function of X,B,
               u being Function of X,REAL
            st
              F.n = Fn &
              (for x being Element of X st x in A holds u.x = 0) &
              (for x being Element of X st not x in A holds
                u.x = (rho.(Fn.x)) to_power p) &
              integral+(COM(M),R_EAL u) <= eps to_power p))
     iff
      for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex n0 being Nat st
          for n being Nat st n0 <= n holds
            ex Fn being Function of X,B,
               u being Function of X,REAL
            st
              F.n = Fn &
              (for x being Element of X holds
                u.x =
                  (rho.(Aop.[Fn.x,Nop.(g.x)])) to_power p) &
              integral+(COM(M),R_EAL u) < eps to_power p)
proof

title: Q11352023_vitali_convergence_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q11352023,
% "Vitali convergence theorem": for any finite exponent p at least one on an arbitrary measure space,
% Lp convergence is equivalent to convergence in measure together with uniform integrability
% and uniform tightness. This file contains no proof.

vitali_convergence_theorem_Q11352023[
  A: TYPE,
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  g_function: TYPE = [A -> G]
  g_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> g_function]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  subG(x, y: G): G =
    addG(x, negG(y))

  normed_add_comm_group: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G): addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(negG(x)) = normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  converges_to_g(values: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normG(subG(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_finite(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): NOT E(omega)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): E(omega) AND F(omega)

  event_difference(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): E(omega) AND NOT F(omega)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES F(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  outer_measure_laws(M: measure_map): bool =
    measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (E, F: event):
        event_subset(E, F) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(M(E), M(F)))
      AND (FORALL
          (events: event_sequence),
          (total: measure_value):
        extended_nonnegative_sum(
          LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
          total)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(M(countable_union(events)), total))

  caratheodory_measurable(
      M: measure_map,
      E: event): bool =
    FORALL (test_event: event):
      M(test_event)
        = measure_value_add(
            M(event_intersection(test_event, E)),
            M(event_difference(test_event, E)))

  sigma_outer_measure_extension(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      (FORALL (measurable_cover: event):
        (Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover))
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(M(E), M(measurable_cover)))
      AND
        (FORALL (lower_bound: measure_value):
          (canonical_measure_value(lower_bound)
            AND (FORALL (measurable_cover: event):
              (Sigma(measurable_cover)
                AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover))
              IMPLIES
                measure_value_le(
                  lower_bound,
                  M(measurable_cover))))
          IMPLIES measure_value_le(lower_bound, M(E)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND outer_measure_laws(M)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES caratheodory_measurable(M, E))
      AND sigma_outer_measure_extension(M, Sigma)

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
      Sigma(measurable_cover)
        AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
        AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A): NOT property(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (pieces(left_index)(omega)
            AND pieces(right_index)(omega))

  finite_g_sum(values: g_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_g_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_g_value(
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): G =
    finite_g_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroG
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          function_value(omega)
            = finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: g_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_g(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          converges_to_g(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              approximants(index)(omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: g_function):
      strongly_measurable_g(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega)
              = measurable_version(omega))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
          function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  powered_norm(
      function_value: g_function,
      p: real): nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      finite_measure_value(
        real_power(normG(function_value(omega)), p))

  lp_norm_at_most(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      p, bound: real): bool =
    bound >= 0
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M,
        Sigma,
        powered_norm(function_value, p),
        finite_measure_value(real_power(bound, p)))

  mem_lp(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      p: real): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND EXISTS (finite_bound: real):
        finite_bound >= 0
          AND lp_norm_at_most(
            M, Sigma, function_value, p, finite_bound)

  event_indicator(
      E: event,
      function_value: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF E(omega) THEN
        function_value(omega)
      ELSE
        zeroG
      ENDIF

  error_function(
      left, right: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      subG(left(omega), right(omega))

  exceeds_error(
      left, right: g_function,
      threshold: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      threshold <= normG(subG(left(omega), right(omega)))

  converges_in_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      F: g_function_sequence,
      limit_function: g_function): bool =
    FORALL
        (error_threshold: posreal),
        (measure_tolerance: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            measure_value_le(
              M(exceeds_error(
                F(index), limit_function,
                error_threshold)),
              finite_measure_value(measure_tolerance))

  uniformly_integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      F: g_function_sequence,

    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta_value: posreal):

      Sigma: sigma_algebra,

      M: measure_map,

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1137014
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1137014), "Tychonoff's theorem": an arbitrary
  dependent product of compact subsets of topological spaces is compact in
  the finite-support product topology. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q1137014_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1137014_same_set
    {A : Type}
    (U V : q1137014_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x <-> V x.

Record q1137014_family (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1137014_member : q1137014_set A -> Prop;
  q1137014_member_ext :
    forall U V : q1137014_set A,
      q1137014_same_set U V ->
      (q1137014_member U <-> q1137014_member V)
}.

Arguments q1137014_member {A} _ _.

Definition q1137014_finite
    {A : Type} (S : q1137014_set A) : Prop :=
  exists elements : list A,
    forall x : A, S x -> In x elements.

Record q1137014_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1137014_is_open : q1137014_set X -> Prop;
  q1137014_open_ext :
    forall U V : q1137014_set X,
      q1137014_same_set U V ->
      (q1137014_is_open U <-> q1137014_is_open V);
  q1137014_open_univ :
    q1137014_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1137014_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1137014_set X,
      q1137014_is_open U ->
      q1137014_is_open V ->
      q1137014_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1137014_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q1137014_family X,
      (forall U : q1137014_set X,
        q1137014_member family U -> q1137014_is_open U) ->
      q1137014_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1137014_set X,
            q1137014_member family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1137014_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q1137014_is_compact
    {X : Type}
    (is_open : q1137014_set X -> Prop)
    (K : q1137014_set X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q1137014_family X,
    (forall U : q1137014_set X,
      q1137014_member cover U -> is_open U) ->
    (forall x : X,
      K x ->
      exists U : q1137014_set X,
        q1137014_member cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q1137014_set X),
      Forall (q1137014_member cover) finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        K x ->
        exists U : q1137014_set X,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q1137014_basic_product_open
    {I : Type}
    {X : I -> Type}
    (T : forall i : I, q1137014_topological_space (X i))
    (B : q1137014_set (forall i : I, X i)) : Prop :=
  exists U : forall i : I, q1137014_set (X i),
    (forall i : I, q1137014_is_open (T i) (U i)) /\
    (exists F : q1137014_set I,
      q1137014_finite F /\
      forall i : I,
        ~ F i ->
        forall x : X i, U i x) /\
    forall x : (forall i : I, X i),
      B x <-> forall i : I, U i (x i).

Definition q1137014_product_is_open
    {I : Type}
    {X : I -> Type}
    (T : forall i : I, q1137014_topological_space (X i))
    (V : q1137014_set (forall i : I, X i)) : Prop :=
  exists family : q1137014_family (forall i : I, X i),
    (forall B : q1137014_set (forall i : I, X i),
      q1137014_member family B ->
      q1137014_basic_product_open T B) /\
    forall x : (forall i : I, X i),
      V x <->
      exists B : q1137014_set (forall i : I, X i),
        q1137014_member family B /\ B x.

Theorem isCompact_pi_infinite :
  forall (I : Type)
         (X : I -> Type)
         (T : forall i : I, q1137014_topological_space (X i))
         (s : forall i : I, q1137014_set (X i)),
    (forall i : I,
      q1137014_is_compact
        (q1137014_is_open (T i))
        (s i)) ->
    q1137014_is_compact
      (q1137014_product_is_open T)
      (fun x : (forall i : I, X i) =>
        forall i : I, s i (x i)).
Admitted.

title: Q1137014_tychonoff_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1137014,
  "Tychonoff's theorem": an arbitrary indexed product of compact subsets of
  topological spaces is compact. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1137014_tychonoff_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition tt_is_topology ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "tt_is_topology A T \<longleftrightarrow>
    {} \<in> T \<and>
    A \<in> T \<and>
    (\<forall>U \<in> T. U \<subseteq> A) \<and>
    (\<forall>C. C \<subseteq> T \<longrightarrow> \<Union>C \<in> T) \<and>
    (\<forall>U \<in> T. \<forall>V \<in> T. U \<inter> V \<in> T)"

definition tt_compactin ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "tt_compactin A T K \<longleftrightarrow>
    K \<subseteq> A \<and>
    (\<forall>C. C \<subseteq> T \<longrightarrow> K \<subseteq> \<Union>C \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>F \<subseteq> C. finite F \<and> K \<subseteq> \<Union>F))"

definition tt_product_set ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set" where
  "tt_product_set I A = {f. \<forall>i \<in> I. f i \<in> A i}"

definition tt_product_open ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set set) \<Rightarrow>
      'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "tt_product_open A T I U \<longleftrightarrow>
    U \<subseteq> tt_product_set I A \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> U. \<exists>J V.
      finite J \<and> J \<subseteq> I \<and>
      (\<forall>i \<in> J. V i \<in> T i) \<and>
      x \<in> tt_product_set I
        (\<lambda>i. if i \<in> J then V i else A i) \<and>
      tt_product_set I
        (\<lambda>i. if i \<in> J then V i else A i) \<subseteq> U)"

definition tt_product_topology ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set set) \<Rightarrow>
      'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set set" where
  "tt_product_topology A T I = {U. tt_product_open A T I U}"

theorem isCompact_pi_infinite:
  fixes A :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
    and T :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a set set"
    and s :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  assumes "\<And>i. tt_is_topology (A i) (T i)"
    and "\<And>i. tt_compactin (A i) (T i) (s i)"
  shows "tt_compactin
    (tt_product_set UNIV A)
    (tt_product_topology A T UNIV)
    (tt_product_set UNIV s)"
  sorry

end
