(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1137014
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1137014), "Tychonoff's theorem": an
  arbitrary, possibly empty indexed product of compact subsets of topological
  spaces is compact in the product topology. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1137014_TYCHONOFF_S_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
       opens {} /\
       opens carrier /\
       (!topology_set:A->bool.
          opens topology_set ==> topology_set SUBSET carrier) /\
       (!topology_family:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!family_member:A->bool.
             family_member IN topology_family ==> opens family_member)
          ==> opens (UNIONS topology_family)) /\
       (!intersection_left intersection_right:A->bool.
          opens intersection_left /\ opens intersection_right
          ==> opens (intersection_left INTER intersection_right)) in
   let is_compact =
     \(compact_carrier:A->bool) (compact_opens:(A->bool)->bool)
      (compact_subset:A->bool).
       compact_subset SUBSET compact_carrier /\
       !open_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!cover_member:A->bool.
            cover_member IN open_cover ==> compact_opens cover_member) /\
         compact_subset SUBSET UNIONS open_cover
         ==> ?finite_subcover:(A->bool)->bool.
               finite_subcover SUBSET open_cover /\
               FINITE finite_subcover /\
               compact_subset SUBSET UNIONS finite_subcover in
   let extensional =
     \(extensional_indices:K->bool) (extensional_function:K->A).
       !extensional_index:K.
         ~(extensional_index IN extensional_indices)
         ==> extensional_function extensional_index = (ARB:A) in
   let product_carrier =
     \(carrier_indices:K->bool) (fibers:K->A->bool).
       {carrier_function:K->A |
          extensional carrier_indices carrier_function /\
          !carrier_index:K.
            carrier_index IN carrier_indices
            ==> carrier_function carrier_index IN fibers carrier_index} in
   let product_open =
     \(open_indices:K->bool) (open_fibers:K->A->bool)
      (coordinate_opens:K->(A->bool)->bool)
      (W:(K->A)->bool).
       W SUBSET
         product_carrier open_indices open_fibers /\
       !product_point:K->A.
         product_point IN W
         ==> ?finite_coordinates:K->bool.
               FINITE finite_coordinates /\
               finite_coordinates SUBSET open_indices /\
               ?basic_sets:K->A->bool.
                 (!basic_index:K.
                    basic_index IN finite_coordinates
                    ==> coordinate_opens basic_index (basic_sets basic_index) /\
                        product_point basic_index IN basic_sets basic_index) /\
                 {basic_point:K->A |
                    basic_point IN
                      product_carrier open_indices open_fibers /\
                    !basic_coordinate:K.
                      basic_coordinate IN finite_coordinates
                      ==> basic_point basic_coordinate IN
                          basic_sets basic_coordinate}
                 SUBSET W in
   let is_product_compact =
     \(product_compact_carrier:(K->A)->bool)
      (product_opens:((K->A)->bool)->bool)
      (product_compact_subset:(K->A)->bool).
       product_compact_subset SUBSET product_compact_carrier /\
       !product_cover:((K->A)->bool)->bool.
         (!product_cover_member:(K->A)->bool.
            product_cover_member IN product_cover
            ==> product_opens product_cover_member) /\
         product_compact_subset SUBSET UNIONS product_cover
         ==> ?product_finite_subcover:((K->A)->bool)->bool.
               product_finite_subcover SUBSET product_cover /\
               FINITE product_finite_subcover /\
               product_compact_subset SUBSET
                 UNIONS product_finite_subcover in
   !idx:K->bool.
   !spaces:K->A->bool.
   !space_opens:K->(A->bool)->bool.
   !compact_sets:K->A->bool.
     (!index:K.
        index IN idx
        ==> is_topology (spaces index) (space_opens index) /\
            is_compact
              (spaces index) (space_opens index) (compact_sets index))
     ==> is_product_compact
           (product_carrier idx spaces)
           (product_open idx spaces space_opens)
           (product_carrier idx compact_sets)`;;

title: Q1137014_tychonoff_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1137014
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1137014), "Tychonoff's theorem": an arbitrary
-- dependent product of compact subsets of topological spaces is compact in
-- the product topology. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1137014_tychonoff_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} →
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

Subset :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X → Set a

Family :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Family {a} X =
  Subset X → Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X
Empty {a} _ =
  Bottom {a}

Union :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  V x

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      Subset X →
      Subset X

    close-empty :
      (x : X) →
      close Empty x →
      Bottom {a}

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-monotone :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U V →
      SubsetOf (close U) (close V)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      (x : X) →
      close (Union U V) x →
      Either (close U x) (close V x)

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      (x : X) →
      Either (close U x) (close V x) →
      close (Union U V) x

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

Covers :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
Covers {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  Σ (Subset X)
    (λ V →
      cover V × V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} U cover =
  Σ (List (Subset X))
    (λ selected →
      ((V : Subset X) →
        Member V selected →
        cover V)
      ×
      ((x : X) →
        U x →
        Σ (Subset X)
          (λ V →
            Member V selected × V x)))

CompactFor :
  {a o : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  (Subset X → Set o) →
  Subset X →
  Set (lsuc a ⊔ o)
CompactFor {X = X} Open U =
  (cover : Family X) →
  ((V : Subset X) →
    cover V →
    Open V) →
  Covers U cover →
  FiniteSubcover U cover

Compact :
  {a : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set (lsuc a)
Compact topology U =
  CompactFor (IsOpen topology) U

Product :
  {i x : Level} →
  (I : Set i) →
  (I → Set x) →
  Set (i ⊔ x)
Product I X =
  (k : I) → X k

record CoordinateOpen
  {i x : Level}
  (I : Set i)
  (X : I → Set x)
  (topology : (k : I) → TopologicalSpace (X k)) :
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc x) where

  field
    coordinate :
      I

    region :
      Subset (X coordinate)

    region-open :
      IsOpen (topology coordinate) region

open CoordinateOpen

InBasicProductOpen :
  {i x : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {X : I → Set x} →
  {topology : (k : I) → TopologicalSpace (X k)} →
  List (CoordinateOpen I X topology) →
  Product I X →
  Set (i ⊔ x)
InBasicProductOpen [] point =
  Top
InBasicProductOpen (constraint ∷ constraints) point =
  region constraint (point (coordinate constraint))
  ×
  InBasicProductOpen constraints point

ProductOpen :
  {i x : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {X : I → Set x} →
  (topology : (k : I) → TopologicalSpace (X k)) →
  Subset (Product I X) →
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc x)
ProductOpen {I = I} {X = X} topology U =
  (point : Product I X) →
  U point →
  Σ (List (CoordinateOpen I X topology))
    (λ constraints →
      InBasicProductOpen constraints point
      ×
      SubsetOf (InBasicProductOpen constraints) U)

ProductSubset :
  {i x : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {X : I → Set x} →
  ((k : I) → Subset (X k)) →
  Subset (Product I X)
ProductSubset subsets point =
  (k : _) →
  subsets k (point k)

tychonoff-s-theorem :
  {i x : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (i ⊔ x))
tychonoff-s-theorem {i} {x} =
  (I : Set i) →
  (X : I → Set x) →
  (topology : (k : I) → TopologicalSpace (X k)) →
  (subsets : (k : I) → Subset (X k)) →
  ((k : I) →

val q1137014_product_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q1137014_product_carrier_def",
  ``q1137014_product_carrier
      (indices : 'i set) (default : 'a) (top : 'i -> 'a topology) =
      {x : 'i -> 'a |
        (!i. i IN indices ==> x i IN topspace (top i)) /\
        (!i. i NOTIN indices ==> x i = default)}``);

val q1137014_product_basic_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1137014_product_basic_open_def",
  ``q1137014_product_basic_open
      (indices : 'i set) (default : 'a) (top : 'i -> 'a topology)
      (coordinates : 'i set) (u : 'i -> 'a set) =
      {x : 'i -> 'a |
        x IN q1137014_product_carrier indices default top /\
        (!i. i IN coordinates ==> x i IN u i)}``);

val q1137014_product_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1137014_product_open_def",
  ``q1137014_product_open
      (indices : 'i set) (default : 'a) (top : 'i -> 'a topology)
      (U : ('i -> 'a) set) <=>
      U SUBSET q1137014_product_carrier indices default top /\
      !x. x IN U ==>
        ?coordinates u.
          FINITE coordinates /\
          coordinates SUBSET indices /\
          (!i. i IN coordinates ==> open_in (top i) (u i)) /\
          x IN q1137014_product_basic_open
            indices default top coordinates u /\
          q1137014_product_basic_open
            indices default top coordinates u SUBSET U``);

val q1137014_product_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q1137014_product_compact_def",
  ``q1137014_product_compact
      (indices : 'i set) (default : 'a) (top : 'i -> 'a topology)
      (k : ('i -> 'a) set) <=>

      !cover.
        (!v. v IN cover ==>
          q1137014_product_open indices default top v) /\
        k SUBSET UNIONS cover
        ==>
        ?subcover.
          FINITE subcover /\
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          k SUBSET UNIONS subcover``);

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1137014
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1137014), "Tychonoff's theorem": the
  arbitrarily indexed product of compact subsets of arbitrary topological
  spaces is compact. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  j is an arbitrary family of topologies indexed by a, and s is a family
  assigning to each index a subset of the corresponding carrier. The
  hypothesis that ( ( J ` i ) |`t ( S ` i ) ) belongs to Comp says exactly
  that s(i), with its subspace topology, is compact.

  SetMM's indexed product X_ i e. a ( s ` i ) is the dependent function
  space of points whose i-th coordinate lies in s(i). Restricting the indexed
  product topology ( Xt_ ` j ) to this set gives the same topology as the
  product of the factor subspace topologies, so the conclusion is equivalent
  to compactness of the set of dependent functions in the Lean source.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. This
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d a i j s $.

  thousand-theorems-q1137014-tychonoff $a |-
    A. a A. j A. s
      (
        (
          (
            j : a --> Top
            /\
            s Fn a
          )
          /\
          A. i e. a
            ( s ` i ) C_ U. ( j ` i )
        )
        ->
        (
          A. i e. a
            ( ( j ` i ) |`t ( s ` i ) ) e. Comp
          ->
          (
            ( Xt_ ` j )
            |`t
            X_ i e. a ( s ` i )
          ) e. Comp
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q1137014_tychonoff_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1137014,
% "Tychonoff's theorem": an arbitrary indexed product of compact subsets of
% topological spaces is compact in the product topology. This file contains no proof.
%
% Coordinate types are represented as fibers in a common carrier. Every
% dependent family of types has this representation via its disjoint sum.

tychonoff_s_theorem_Q1137014[
  Index: TYPE,
  Value: TYPE+,
  fiber, coordinate_set: [Index -> [Value -> bool]],
  coordinate_open: [Index -> [[Value -> bool] -> bool]]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [Value -> bool]
  point_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  product_point: TYPE = [Index -> Value]
  product_set: TYPE = [product_point -> bool]
  product_family: TYPE = [product_set -> bool]
  coordinate_neighborhoods: TYPE = [Index -> point_set]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index]
  IMPORTING finite_sets[point_set]
  IMPORTING finite_sets[product_set]

  finite_index_set: TYPE = finite_set[Index]
  finite_point_family: TYPE = finite_set[point_set]
  finite_product_family: TYPE = finite_set[product_set]

  empty_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Value): FALSE

  fiber_set(i: Index): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Value): fiber(i)(x)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Value):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  point_intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Value):
      A(x) AND B(x)

  point_union(F: point_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Value):
      EXISTS (U: point_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  finite_point_union(F: finite_point_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Value):
      EXISTS (U: point_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  coordinate_topology_law(i: Index): bool =
    coordinate_open(i)(empty_point_set)
      AND coordinate_open(i)(fiber_set(i))
      AND
        (FORALL (U: point_set):
          coordinate_open(i)(U)
            IMPLIES point_subset(U, fiber_set(i)))
      AND
        (FORALL (U, V: point_set):
          (coordinate_open(i)(U) AND coordinate_open(i)(V))
            IMPLIES
              coordinate_open(i)(point_intersection(U, V)))
      AND
        (FORALL (F: point_family):
          (FORALL (U: point_set):
            F(U) IMPLIES coordinate_open(i)(U))
          IMPLIES coordinate_open(i)(point_union(F)))

  family_well_formed: bool =
    FORALL (i: Index):
      point_subset(coordinate_set(i), fiber_set(i))

  coordinate_open_cover(
      i: Index,
      C: point_family,
      A: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES coordinate_open(i)(U))
      AND point_subset(A, point_union(C))

  coordinate_compact(i: Index): bool =
    FORALL (C: point_family):
      coordinate_open_cover(i, C, coordinate_set(i))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (D: finite_point_family):
            (FORALL (U: point_set):
              D(U) IMPLIES C(U))
              AND point_subset(
                coordinate_set(i),
                finite_point_union(D))

  choice_space: product_set =
    LAMBDA (x: product_point):
      FORALL (i: Index):
        fiber(i)(x(i))

  product_of_coordinate_sets: product_set =
    LAMBDA (x: product_point):
      choice_space(x)
        AND FORALL (i: Index):
          coordinate_set(i)(x(i))

  product_subset(A, B: product_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: product_point):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  basic_product_set(
      J: finite_index_set,
      U: coordinate_neighborhoods): product_set =
    LAMBDA (x: product_point):
      choice_space(x)
        AND FORALL (i: Index):
          J(i) IMPLIES U(i)(x(i))

  product_open(U: product_set): bool =
    product_subset(U, choice_space)
      AND FORALL (x: product_point):
        U(x)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS
              (J: finite_index_set),
              (V: coordinate_neighborhoods):
                (FORALL (i: Index):
                  J(i) IMPLIES coordinate_open(i)(V(i)))
                AND basic_product_set(J, V)(x)
                AND product_subset(basic_product_set(J, V), U)

  product_union(F: product_family): product_set =
    LAMBDA (x: product_point):
      EXISTS (U: product_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  finite_product_union(F: finite_product_family): product_set =
    LAMBDA (x: product_point):
      EXISTS (U: product_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  product_open_cover(
      C: product_family,
      A: product_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: product_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES product_open(U))
      AND product_subset(A, product_union(C))

  product_compact(A: product_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: product_family):
      product_open_cover(C, A)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (D: finite_product_family):
            (FORALL (U: product_set):
              D(U) IMPLIES C(U))
              AND product_subset(A, finite_product_union(D))

  tychonoff_s_theorem: bool =
    (family_well_formed
      AND FORALL (i: Index):
        coordinate_topology_law(i))
      IMPLIES
        ((FORALL (i: Index):
          coordinate_compact(i))
        IMPLIES product_compact(product_of_coordinate_sets))
END tychonoff_s_theorem_Q1137014

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1137206
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1137206), "Taylor's theorem": under the source
-- differentiability hypotheses on a real interval, the Taylor remainder has both
-- Lagrange and Cauchy mean-value forms. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Taylor

@[expose] public section

open scoped Interval Topology Nat

open Set

namespace Q1137206

/-- Taylor's theorem with the Lagrange form of the remainder. -/
theorem taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hx : x₀ < x) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (Icc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Icc x₀ x)) (Ioo x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ Ioo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Icc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Icc x₀ x) x' * (x - x₀) ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1)! := sorry

/-- Taylor's theorem with the Cauchy form of the remainder. -/
theorem taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hx : x₀ < x) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ n f (Icc x₀ x))
    (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Icc x₀ x)) (Ioo x₀ x)) :
    ∃ x' ∈ Ioo x₀ x, f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Icc x₀ x) x₀ x =
      iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Icc x₀ x) x' * (x - x') ^ n / n ! * (x - x₀) := sorry

end Q1137206

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1137206
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1137206), "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and
  Cauchy forms of the remainder for the Taylor polynomial of a real function
  on a closed interval. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals
  ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon
  Arith.Factorial
  Arith.PeanoNat.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1137206_set : Type := R -> Prop.

Definition q1137206_closed_interval
    (a b : R) : q1137206_set :=
  fun y : R => a <= y /\ y <= b.

Definition q1137206_open_interval
    (a b : R) : q1137206_set :=
  fun y : R => a < y /\ y < b.

Definition q1137206_continuous_within_at
    (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        s y ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs (f y - f x) < epsilon.

Definition q1137206_continuous_on
    (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    s x ->
    q1137206_continuous_within_at f s x.

Definition q1137206_has_deriv_within_at
    (f : R -> R) (derivative : R)
    (s : q1137206_set) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        s y ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs
          (f y - f x - derivative * (y - x))
        <= epsilon * Rabs (y - x).

Definition q1137206_differentiable_within_at
    (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) (x : R) : Prop :=
  exists derivative : R,
    q1137206_has_deriv_within_at f derivative s x.

Definition q1137206_differentiable_on
    (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    s x ->
    q1137206_differentiable_within_at f s x.

Definition q1137206_deriv_within
    (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists derivative : R,
            q1137206_has_deriv_within_at f derivative s x) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun derivative : R =>
          q1137206_has_deriv_within_at f derivative s x)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Fixpoint q1137206_iterated_deriv_within
    (n : nat) (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) : R -> R :=
  match n with
  | O => f
  | S k =>
      fun x : R =>
        q1137206_deriv_within
          (q1137206_iterated_deriv_within k f s) s x
  end.

Definition q1137206_cont_diff_on
    (n : nat) (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set) : Prop :=
  forall k : nat,
    (k <= n)%nat ->
    q1137206_continuous_on
      (q1137206_iterated_deriv_within k f s) s /\
    ((k < n)%nat ->
      q1137206_differentiable_on
        (q1137206_iterated_deriv_within k f s) s).

Definition q1137206_taylor_term
    (f : R -> R) (s : q1137206_set)
    (x0 x : R) (k : nat) : R :=
  q1137206_iterated_deriv_within k f s x0 *
  (x - x0) ^ k / INR (fact k).

Fixpoint q1137206_taylor_within_eval
    (f : R -> R) (n : nat) (s : q1137206_set)
    (x0 x : R) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q1137206_taylor_term f s x0 x O
  | S k =>
      q1137206_taylor_within_eval f k s x0 x +
      q1137206_taylor_term f s x0 x (S k)
  end.

Theorem taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange :
  forall (f : R -> R) (x x0 : R) (n : nat),
    x0 < x ->
    q1137206_cont_diff_on n f
      (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x) ->
    q1137206_differentiable_on
      (q1137206_iterated_deriv_within n f
        (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x))
      (q1137206_open_interval x0 x) ->
    exists x' : R,
      q1137206_open_interval x0 x x' /\
      f x -
        q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n
          (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x) x0 x =
      q1137206_iterated_deriv_within (S n) f
        (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x) x' *
      (x - x0) ^ (S n) / INR (fact (S n)).
Admitted.

Theorem taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy :
  forall (f : R -> R) (x x0 : R) (n : nat),
    x0 < x ->
    q1137206_cont_diff_on n f
      (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x) ->
    q1137206_differentiable_on
      (q1137206_iterated_deriv_within n f
        (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x))
      (q1137206_open_interval x0 x) ->
    exists x' : R,
      q1137206_open_interval x0 x x' /\
      f x -
        q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n
          (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x) x0 x =
      q1137206_iterated_deriv_within (S n) f
        (q1137206_closed_interval x0 x) x' *
      (x - x') ^ n / INR (fact n) * (x - x0).
Admitted.

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1137206,
  "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and Cauchy forms of the remainder for a
  finite Taylor expansion of a real function on a closed interval. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition q1137206_real_deriv_within ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1137206_real_deriv_within f S x =
    vector_derivative f (at x within S)"

fun q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within 0 f S = f"
| "q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within (Suc k) f S =
    (\<lambda>y. q1137206_real_deriv_within
      (q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within k f S) S y)"

definition q1137206_cont_diff_on_up_to ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1137206_cont_diff_on_up_to n f S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>k \<le> n.
      continuous_on S (q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within k f S) \<and>
      (k < n \<longrightarrow>
        q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within k f S differentiable_on S))"

definition q1137206_taylor_within_eval ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n S x0 x =
    (\<Sum>k<Suc n.
      q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within k f S x0 *
        (x - x0) ^ k / fact k)"

theorem taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
    and x x0 :: real
    and n :: nat
  assumes "x0 < x"
    and "q1137206_cont_diff_on_up_to n f {x0..x}"
    and "q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within n f {x0..x}
      differentiable_on {x0<..<x}"
  shows "\<exists>x' \<in> {x0<..<x}.
    f x - q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n {x0..x} x0 x =
      q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within (Suc n) f {x0..x} x' *
        (x - x0) ^ (Suc n) / fact (Suc n)"
  sorry

theorem taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
    and x x0 :: real
    and n :: nat
  assumes "x0 < x"
    and "q1137206_cont_diff_on_up_to n f {x0..x}"
    and "q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within n f {x0..x}
      differentiable_on {x0<..<x}"
  shows "\<exists>x' \<in> {x0<..<x}.
    f x - q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n {x0..x} x0 x =
      q1137206_iterated_real_deriv_within (Suc n) f {x0..x} x' *
        (x - x') ^ n / fact n * (x - x0)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1137206,
  "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and Cauchy remainder formulas for the
  Taylor polynomial of a real function on a closed interval. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let q1137206_has_derivative_within = new_definition
  `q1137206_has_derivative_within
     (f:real->real) (s:real->bool) (a:real) (d:real) <=>
     !epsilon:real.
       &0 < epsilon
       ==> ?delta:real.
             &0 < delta /\
             !y:real.
               y IN s /\ ~(y = a) /\ abs (y - a) < delta
               ==> abs ((f y - f a) / (y - a) - d) < epsilon`;;

let q1137206_derivative_within = new_definition
  `q1137206_derivative_within
     (f:real->real) (s:real->bool) (a:real) =
     if (?d:real. q1137206_has_derivative_within f s a d) /\
        (!d e:real.
           q1137206_has_derivative_within f s a d /\
           q1137206_has_derivative_within f s a e
           ==> d = e)
     then @d:real. q1137206_has_derivative_within f s a d
     else &0`;;

let q1137206_iterated_derivative_within =
  new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `q1137206_iterated_derivative_within 0 f s = (f:real->real) /\
   (!n.
      q1137206_iterated_derivative_within (SUC n) f s =
      \a:real.
        q1137206_derivative_within
          (q1137206_iterated_derivative_within n f s) s a)`;;

let q1137206_continuous_on = new_definition
  `q1137206_continuous_on (f:real->real) (s:real->bool) <=>
     !a:real.
       a IN s
       ==> !epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?delta:real.
                   &0 < delta /\
                   !y:real.
                     y IN s /\ abs (y - a) < delta
                     ==> abs (f y - f a) < epsilon`;;

let q1137206_differentiable_on = new_definition
  `q1137206_differentiable_on (f:real->real) (s:real->bool) <=>
     !a:real.
       a IN s
       ==> ?d:real. q1137206_has_derivative_within f s a d`;;

let q1137206_cont_diff_on = new_definition
  `q1137206_cont_diff_on
     (n:num) (f:real->real) (s:real->bool) <=>
     (!k:num.
        k <= n
        ==> q1137206_continuous_on
              (q1137206_iterated_derivative_within k f s) s) /\
     (!k:num.
        k < n
        ==> q1137206_differentiable_on
              (q1137206_iterated_derivative_within k f s) s)`;;

let q1137206_taylor_polynomial = new_definition
  `q1137206_taylor_polynomial
     (n:num) (f:real->real) (s:real->bool) (x0:real) (x:real) =
     sum (0..n)
       (\k:num.
          q1137206_iterated_derivative_within k f s x0 *
          (x - x0) pow k / &(FACT k))`;;

let Q1137206_TAYLOR_S_THEOREM =
  `!f:real->real. !x x0:real. !n:num.
     let closed_interval = {t:real | x0 <= t /\ t <= x} in
     let open_interval = {t:real | x0 < t /\ t < x} in
     x0 < x /\
     q1137206_cont_diff_on n f closed_interval /\
     q1137206_differentiable_on
       (q1137206_iterated_derivative_within n f closed_interval)
       open_interval
     ==>
     (?x':real.
        x' IN open_interval /\
        f x -
        q1137206_taylor_polynomial n f closed_interval x0 x =
        q1137206_iterated_derivative_within
          (SUC n) f closed_interval x' *
        (x - x0) pow (SUC n) / &(FACT (SUC n))) /\
     (?x':real.
        x' IN open_interval /\
        f x -
        q1137206_taylor_polynomial n f closed_interval x0 x =
        q1137206_iterated_derivative_within
          (SUC n) f closed_interval x' *
        (x - x') pow n / &(FACT n) * (x - x0))`;;

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1137206,
;; "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and Cauchy remainder formulas for a
;; real-valued function continuously differentiable through order n on a
;; closed interval and differentiable once more on its interior.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ objects represent the real carrier, its operations, every
;; subset used by completeness, the arbitrary source function, and its
;; derivative family. All quantifiers remain direct DEFUN-SK quantifiers, so
;; no finite table or opaque set/function tag replaces an extensional object.

(defun q1137206-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q1137206-unary-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun q1137206-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; A scalar context consists of a carrier predicate, zero, one, addition,
;; multiplication, negation, inversion, and strict order.

(defun q1137206-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-multiply (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-negate (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-inverse (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun q1137206-r-less (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun q1137206-real-p (ctx value)
  (q1137206-member-p (q1137206-r-carrier ctx) value))

(defun q1137206-zero (ctx)
  (q1137206-r-zero ctx))

(defun q1137206-one (ctx)
  (q1137206-r-one ctx))

(defun q1137206-add (ctx left right)
  (q1137206-binary-value
   (q1137206-r-add ctx) left right))

(defun q1137206-multiply (ctx left right)
  (q1137206-binary-value
   (q1137206-r-multiply ctx) left right))

(defun q1137206-negate (ctx value)
  (q1137206-unary-value
   (q1137206-r-negate ctx) value))

(defun q1137206-inverse (ctx value)
  (q1137206-unary-value
   (q1137206-r-inverse ctx) value))

(defun q1137206-less (ctx left right)
  (if
      (q1137206-binary-value
       (q1137206-r-less ctx) left right)
      t nil))

(defun q1137206-set-member-p (ctx set value)
  (declare (ignore ctx))
  (q1137206-member-p set value))

(defun q1137206-function-value (function point)
  (q1137206-unary-value function point))

(defun q1137206-derivative-value
    (derivatives derivative-order point)
  (q1137206-binary-value
   derivatives derivative-order point))

(defun q1137206-subtract (ctx left right)
  (q1137206-add ctx left (q1137206-negate ctx right)))

(defun q1137206-divide (ctx numerator denominator)
  (q1137206-multiply
   ctx numerator (q1137206-inverse ctx denominator)))

(defun q1137206-less-equal-p (ctx left right)
  (not (q1137206-less ctx right left)))

(defun q1137206-absolute-value (ctx value)
  (if (q1137206-less ctx value (q1137206-zero ctx))
      (q1137206-negate ctx value)
    value))

(defun q1137206-positive-real-p (ctx value)
  (and
   (q1137206-real-p ctx value)
   (q1137206-less ctx (q1137206-zero ctx) value)))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.

(defun-sk q1137206-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-real-p ctx a)
      (q1137206-real-p ctx b)
      (q1137206-real-p ctx c))
     (let* ((ab-add (q1137206-add ctx a b))
            (bc-add (q1137206-add ctx b c))
            (ab-mul (q1137206-multiply ctx a b))
            (bc-mul (q1137206-multiply ctx b c))
            (neg-a (q1137206-negate ctx a))
            (inv-a (q1137206-inverse ctx a))
            (zero (q1137206-zero ctx))
            (one (q1137206-one ctx)))
       (and
        (q1137206-real-p ctx ab-add)
        (q1137206-real-p ctx ab-mul)
        (q1137206-real-p ctx neg-a)
        (q1137206-real-p ctx inv-a)
        (equal
         (q1137206-add ctx ab-add c)
         (q1137206-add ctx a bc-add))
        (equal ab-add (q1137206-add ctx b a))
        (equal (q1137206-add ctx a zero) a)
        (equal (q1137206-add ctx a neg-a) zero)
        (equal
         (q1137206-multiply ctx ab-mul c)
         (q1137206-multiply ctx a bc-mul))
        (equal ab-mul (q1137206-multiply ctx b a))
        (equal (q1137206-multiply ctx a one) a)
        (implies
         (equal a zero)
         (equal inv-a zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal a zero))
         (equal (q1137206-multiply ctx a inv-a) one))
        (equal
         (q1137206-multiply ctx a bc-add)
         (q1137206-add
          ctx
          (q1137206-multiply ctx a b)
          (q1137206-multiply ctx a c))))))))

(defun-sk q1137206-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b c)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-real-p ctx a)
      (q1137206-real-p ctx b)
      (q1137206-real-p ctx c))
     (and
      (not (q1137206-less ctx a a))
      (or
       (q1137206-less ctx a b)
       (equal a b)
       (q1137206-less ctx b a))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1137206-less ctx a b)
        (q1137206-less ctx b c))
       (q1137206-less ctx a c))
      (implies
       (q1137206-less ctx a b)
       (q1137206-less
        ctx
        (q1137206-add ctx a c)
        (q1137206-add ctx b c)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1137206-less ctx (q1137206-zero ctx) a)
        (q1137206-less ctx (q1137206-zero ctx) b))
       (q1137206-less
        ctx
        (q1137206-zero ctx)
        (q1137206-multiply ctx a b)))))))

(defun-sk q1137206-valid-set-p (ctx set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q1137206-set-member-p ctx set value)
     (q1137206-real-p ctx value))))

(defun q1137206-extensional-set-p (ctx set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q1137206-valid-set-p ctx set)))

(defun-sk q1137206-set-nonempty-p (ctx set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q1137206-real-p ctx value)
     (q1137206-set-member-p ctx set value))))

(defun-sk q1137206-upper-bound-p (ctx set upper)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-real-p ctx value)
      (q1137206-set-member-p ctx set value))
     (not (q1137206-less ctx upper value)))))

(defun-sk q1137206-bounded-above-p (ctx set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (q1137206-real-p ctx upper)
     (q1137206-upper-bound-p ctx set upper))))

(defun-sk q1137206-least-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-real-p ctx upper)
      (q1137206-upper-bound-p ctx set upper))
     (not (q1137206-less ctx upper supremum)))))

(defun q1137206-is-supremum-p (ctx set supremum)
  (and
   (q1137206-real-p ctx supremum)
   (q1137206-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)
   (q1137206-least-upper-bound-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1137206-has-supremum-p (ctx set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1137206-is-supremum-p ctx set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1137206-completeness-p (ctx)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-extensional-set-p ctx set)
      (q1137206-set-nonempty-p ctx set)
      (q1137206-bounded-above-p ctx set))
     (q1137206-has-supremum-p ctx set))))

(defun q1137206-real-field-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (tamep-functionp (q1137206-r-carrier ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (q1137206-r-add ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (q1137206-r-multiply ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (q1137206-r-negate ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (q1137206-r-inverse ctx))
   (tamep-functionp (q1137206-r-less ctx))
   (q1137206-real-p ctx (q1137206-zero ctx))
   (q1137206-real-p ctx (q1137206-one ctx))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1137206-zero ctx)
     (q1137206-one ctx)))
   (q1137206-field-laws-p ctx)
   (q1137206-order-laws-p ctx)
   (q1137206-completeness-p ctx)
   (q1137206-less
    ctx (q1137206-zero ctx) (q1137206-one ctx))))

;; Natural numbers embedded in the abstract real field.

(defun q1137206-real-natural (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1137206-zero ctx)
    (q1137206-add
     ctx
     (q1137206-one ctx)
     (q1137206-real-natural ctx (- n 1)))))

(defun q1137206-power (ctx base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q1137206-one ctx)
    (q1137206-multiply
     ctx
     base
     (q1137206-power ctx base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun q1137206-factorial (ctx n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1137206-one ctx)
    (q1137206-multiply
     ctx
     (q1137206-real-natural ctx n)
     (q1137206-factorial ctx (- n 1)))))

;; The intervals Icc x0 x and Ioo x0 x.

(defun q1137206-in-closed-interval-p
    (ctx x0 x point)
  (and
   (q1137206-real-p ctx point)
   (not (q1137206-less ctx point x0))
   (not (q1137206-less ctx x point))))

(defun q1137206-in-open-interval-p
    (ctx x0 x point)
  (and
   (q1137206-real-p ctx point)
   (q1137206-less ctx x0 point)
   (q1137206-less ctx point x)))

;; Arbitrary real-valued functions and explicitly tied iterated derivatives.

(defun-sk q1137206-real-function-p (ctx function)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1137206-real-p ctx point)
     (q1137206-real-p
      ctx (q1137206-function-value function point)))))

(defun q1137206-extensional-real-function-p
    (ctx function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q1137206-real-function-p ctx function)))

(defun-sk q1137206-derivative-order-real-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1137206-real-p ctx point)
     (q1137206-real-p
      ctx
      (q1137206-derivative-value
       derivatives derivative-order point)))))

(defun-sk q1137206-derivative-family-p
    (ctx derivatives maximum-order)
  (forall (derivative-order)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp derivative-order)
      (<= derivative-order maximum-order))
     (q1137206-derivative-order-real-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order))))

(defun q1137206-extensional-derivative-family-p
    (ctx derivatives maximum-order)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp derivatives)
   (q1137206-derivative-family-p
    ctx derivatives maximum-order)))

(defun-sk q1137206-order-zero-is-function-p
    (ctx function derivatives)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1137206-real-p ctx point)
     (equal
      (q1137206-derivative-value derivatives 0 point)
      (q1137206-function-value function point)))))

;; Epsilon-delta continuity of a derivative row on the closed interval.

(defun-sk q1137206-continuity-radius-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point epsilon radius)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-in-closed-interval-p
       ctx x0 x nearby)
      (q1137206-less
       ctx
       (q1137206-absolute-value
        ctx (q1137206-subtract ctx nearby point))
       radius))
     (q1137206-less
      ctx
      (q1137206-absolute-value
       ctx
       (q1137206-subtract
        ctx
        (q1137206-derivative-value
         derivatives derivative-order nearby)
        (q1137206-derivative-value
         derivatives derivative-order point)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1137206-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1137206-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (q1137206-continuity-radius-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order
      x0 x point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q1137206-continuous-within-at-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1137206-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (q1137206-continuity-radius-exists-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order
      x0 x point epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1137206-continuous-on-closed-interval-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1137206-in-closed-interval-p ctx x0 x point)
     (q1137206-continuous-within-at-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x point))))

;; HasDerivWithinAt in epsilon-delta form, restricted to Icc x0 x.

(defun-sk q1137206-derivative-radius-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
         x0 x point epsilon radius)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-in-closed-interval-p
       ctx x0 x nearby)
      (q1137206-less
       ctx
       (q1137206-absolute-value
        ctx (q1137206-subtract ctx nearby point))
       radius))
     (q1137206-less-equal-p
      ctx
      (q1137206-absolute-value
       ctx
       (q1137206-subtract
        ctx
        (q1137206-subtract
         ctx
         (q1137206-derivative-value
          derivatives derivative-order nearby)
         (q1137206-derivative-value
          derivatives derivative-order point))
        (q1137206-multiply
         ctx
         derivative
         (q1137206-subtract ctx nearby point))))
      (q1137206-multiply
       ctx
       epsilon
       (q1137206-absolute-value
        ctx (q1137206-subtract ctx nearby point)))))))

(defun-sk q1137206-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
         x0 x point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1137206-positive-real-p ctx radius)
     (q1137206-derivative-radius-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
      x0 x point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q1137206-has-derivative-within-at-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
         x0 x point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1137206-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (q1137206-derivative-radius-exists-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order derivative
      x0 x point epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1137206-contdiff-orders-continuous-p
    (ctx derivatives order x0 x)
  (forall (derivative-order)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp derivative-order)
      (<= derivative-order order))
     (q1137206-continuous-on-closed-interval-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x))))

(defun-sk q1137206-derivative-chain-at-index-p
    (ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1137206-in-closed-interval-p ctx x0 x point)
     (q1137206-has-derivative-within-at-p
      ctx
      derivatives
      derivative-order
      (q1137206-derivative-value
       derivatives (+ 1 derivative-order) point)
      x0 x point))))

(defun-sk q1137206-derivative-chain-p
    (ctx derivatives order x0 x)
  (forall (derivative-order)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp derivative-order)
      (< derivative-order order))
     (q1137206-derivative-chain-at-index-p
      ctx derivatives derivative-order x0 x))))

(defun q1137206-contdiff-through-p
    (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
  (and
   (q1137206-order-zero-is-function-p
    ctx function derivatives)
   (q1137206-contdiff-orders-continuous-p
    ctx derivatives order x0 x)
   (q1137206-derivative-chain-p
    ctx derivatives order x0 x)))

(defun-sk q1137206-next-derivative-on-interior-p
    (ctx derivatives order x0 x)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1137206-in-open-interval-p ctx x0 x point)
     (q1137206-has-derivative-within-at-p
      ctx
      derivatives
      order
      (q1137206-derivative-value
       derivatives (+ 1 order) point)
      x0 x point))))

;; The finite Taylor polynomial sum from k = 0 through k = ORDER.

(defun q1137206-taylor-sum
    (ctx derivatives terms x0 x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (q1137206-zero ctx)
    (let* ((index (- terms 1))
           (delta (q1137206-subtract ctx x x0))
           (coefficient
            (q1137206-divide
             ctx
             (q1137206-derivative-value
              derivatives index x0)
             (q1137206-factorial ctx index)))
           (term
            (q1137206-multiply
             ctx
             coefficient
             (q1137206-power ctx delta index))))
      (q1137206-add
       ctx
       (q1137206-taylor-sum
        ctx derivatives index x0 x)
       term))))

;; Independent internal existential witnesses for the two source conclusions.

(defun-sk q1137206-lagrange-remainder-p
    (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
  (exists (witness)
    (let* ((next-order (+ 1 order))
           (delta (q1137206-subtract ctx x x0))
           (left-side
            (q1137206-subtract
             ctx
             (q1137206-function-value function x)
             (q1137206-taylor-sum
              ctx derivatives next-order x0 x)))
           (right-side
            (q1137206-divide
             ctx
             (q1137206-multiply
              ctx
              (q1137206-derivative-value
               derivatives next-order witness)
              (q1137206-power ctx delta next-order))
             (q1137206-factorial ctx next-order))))
      (and
       (q1137206-in-open-interval-p
        ctx x0 x witness)
       (equal left-side right-side)))))

(defun-sk q1137206-cauchy-remainder-p
    (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
  (exists (witness)
    (let* ((next-order (+ 1 order))
           (delta (q1137206-subtract ctx x x0))
           (left-side
            (q1137206-subtract
             ctx
             (q1137206-function-value function x)
             (q1137206-taylor-sum
              ctx derivatives next-order x0 x)))
           (right-side
            (q1137206-multiply
             ctx
             (q1137206-divide
              ctx
              (q1137206-multiply
               ctx
               (q1137206-derivative-value
                derivatives next-order witness)
               (q1137206-power
                ctx
                (q1137206-subtract ctx x witness)
                order))
              (q1137206-factorial ctx order))
             delta)))
      (and
       (q1137206-in-open-interval-p
        ctx x0 x witness)
       (equal left-side right-side)))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1137206-taylor-s-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1137206-real-field-p ctx)
      (natp order)
      (q1137206-real-p ctx x0)
      (q1137206-real-p ctx x)
      (q1137206-less ctx x0 x)
      (q1137206-extensional-real-function-p
       ctx function)
      (q1137206-extensional-derivative-family-p
       ctx derivatives (+ 1 order))
      (q1137206-contdiff-through-p
       ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
      (q1137206-next-derivative-on-interior-p
       ctx derivatives order x0 x))
     (and
      (q1137206-lagrange-remainder-p
       ctx function derivatives order x0 x)
      (q1137206-cauchy-remainder-p
       ctx function derivatives order x0 x)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1137206,
-- "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and Cauchy forms of the remainder for a
-- real function with the stated closed-interval smoothness assumptions.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Exists1 (A : Set) (P : A -> Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor witness1
  field
    value1    : A
    property1 : P value1

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  succ<=succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (Agda.Builtin.Nat._+_ m n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtractR reals center radius) x)
    (StrictLess reals x (addR reals center radius))

InClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InClosedInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals lower point)
    (lessOrEqualR reals point upper)

InOpenInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
InOpenInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower point)
    (StrictLess reals point upper)

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R} reals function domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function y)))

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals function domain point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point y =
  divideR reals
    (subtractR reals (function y) (function point))
    (subtractR reals y point)

DerivativeWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeWithinAt {R} reals function domain point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          y != point ->
          CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals function point y)))

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          y != point ->
          CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals function point y)))

record RepresentsTaylorDerivatives
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (function : R -> R)
  (center endpoint : R)
  (order : Nat)
  (derivatives : Nat -> R -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroth-derivative :
      (point : R) ->
      InClosedInterval reals center endpoint point ->
      derivatives zero point == function point

    continuous-through-order :
      (k : Nat) ->
      k <=N order ->
      ContinuousOn reals
        (derivatives k)
        (InClosedInterval reals center endpoint)

    derivative-through-predecessors :
      (k : Nat) ->
      k <N order ->
      (point : R) ->
      InClosedInterval reals center endpoint point ->
      DerivativeWithinAt reals
        (derivatives k)
        (InClosedInterval reals center endpoint)
        point
        (derivatives (suc k) point)

    top-derivative-on-interior :
      (point : R) ->
      InOpenInterval reals center endpoint point ->
      DerivativeAt reals
        (derivatives order)
        point
        (derivatives (suc order) point)

open RepresentsTaylorDerivatives

TaylorRegularity :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  (center endpoint : R) ->
  Nat ->
  Set1
TaylorRegularity reals function center endpoint order =
  Exists1
    (Nat -> _ -> _)
    (RepresentsTaylorDerivatives
      reals function center endpoint order)

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals term (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (sumFirst reals term n)
    (term n)

taylorTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
taylorTerm reals derivatives center point k =
  multiplyR reals
    (divideR reals
      (derivatives k center)
      (fromNatR reals (factorial k)))
    (powerR reals (subtractR reals point center) k)

taylorPolynomial :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
taylorPolynomial reals derivatives center point order =
  sumFirst reals
    (taylorTerm reals derivatives center point)
    (suc order)

lagrangeRemainder :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
lagrangeRemainder reals derivatives center endpoint order intermediate =
  divideR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (derivatives (suc order) intermediate)
      (powerR reals
        (subtractR reals endpoint center)
        (suc order)))
    (fromNatR reals (factorial (suc order)))

cauchyRemainder :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
cauchyRemainder reals derivatives center endpoint order intermediate =
  multiplyR reals
    (divideR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (derivatives (suc order) intermediate)
        (powerR reals
          (subtractR reals endpoint intermediate)
          order))
      (fromNatR reals (factorial order)))
    (subtractR reals endpoint center)

taylor-mean-remainder-lagrange : Set2
taylor-mean-remainder-lagrange =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  (center endpoint : R) ->
  (order : Nat) ->
  StrictLess reals center endpoint ->
  (regularity :
    TaylorRegularity reals function center endpoint order) ->
  Exists R
    (\ intermediate ->
      Both
        (InOpenInterval reals center endpoint intermediate)
        (subtractR reals
          (function endpoint)
          (taylorPolynomial reals
            (Exists1.value1 regularity)
            center endpoint order)
        ==
        lagrangeRemainder reals
          (Exists1.value1 regularity)
          center endpoint order intermediate))

taylor-mean-remainder-cauchy : Set2
taylor-mean-remainder-cauchy =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (function : R -> R) ->
  (center endpoint : R) ->
  (order : Nat) ->
  StrictLess reals center endpoint ->
  (regularity :
    TaylorRegularity reals function center endpoint order) ->
  Exists R
    (\ intermediate ->
      Both
        (InOpenInterval reals center endpoint intermediate)
        (subtractR reals
          (function endpoint)
          (taylorPolynomial reals
            (Exists1.value1 regularity)
            center endpoint order)
        ==
        cauchyRemainder reals
          (Exists1.value1 regularity)
          center endpoint order intermediate))

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1137206, "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and Cauchy forms of the
  remainder for a real function on a closed interval. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory derivativeTheory;

val q1137206_iterated_deriv_within_def = new_definition (
  "q1137206_iterated_deriv_within_def",
  ``q1137206_iterated_deriv_within
      n (f : real -> real) (s : real set) =
      FUNPOW
        (\g. \y. vector_derivative g (at y within s))
        n f``);

val q1137206_taylor_within_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q1137206_taylor_within_eval_def",
  ``q1137206_taylor_within_eval
      (f : real -> real) n (s : real set) x0 x =
      SIGMA
        (\k.
          q1137206_iterated_deriv_within k f s x0 /
            &(FACT k) *
          (x - x0) pow k)
        (count (SUC n))``);

val q1137206_cont_diff_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1137206_cont_diff_on_def",
  ``q1137206_cont_diff_on
      n (f : real -> real) (s : real set) <=>
      (!m.
        m <= n ==>
        q1137206_iterated_deriv_within m f s continuous_on s) /\
      (!m.
        m < n ==>
        q1137206_iterated_deriv_within m f s differentiable_on s)``);

val taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange =
  ``!f x x0 n.
      x0 < x /\
      q1137206_cont_diff_on n f (interval [x0,x]) /\
      q1137206_iterated_deriv_within n f (interval [x0,x])
        differentiable_on interval (x0,x)
      ==>
      ?x'.
        x0 < x' /\ x' < x /\
        f x -
          q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n (interval [x0,x]) x0 x =
        q1137206_iterated_deriv_within
            (SUC n) f (interval [x0,x]) x' *
          (x - x0) pow (SUC n) / &(FACT (SUC n))``;

val taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy =
  ``!f x x0 n.
      x0 < x /\
      q1137206_cont_diff_on n f (interval [x0,x]) /\
      q1137206_iterated_deriv_within n f (interval [x0,x])
        differentiable_on interval (x0,x)
      ==>
      ?x'.
        x0 < x' /\ x' < x /\
        f x -
          q1137206_taylor_within_eval f n (interval [x0,x]) x0 x =
        q1137206_iterated_deriv_within
            (SUC n) f (interval [x0,x]) x' *
          (x - x') pow n / &(FACT n) * (x - x0)``;

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1137206
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1137206), "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange
  and Cauchy forms of the remainder for the Taylor polynomial of a real
  function on a closed interval, under the source relative smoothness
  hypotheses. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1137206Icc and Q1137206Ioo are the closed and open real intervals from the
  first endpoint to the second. Q1137206Iter is SetMM's relative iterated
  derivative of the restricted function, and Q1137206Taylor is the degree-N
  Taylor polynomial at the first endpoint, evaluated at the second.

  Q1137206Smooth states exactly the two source regularity assumptions: the
  restricted function is C^N on the closed interval, and its N-th relative
  derivative is differentiable at every point of the open interval. The two
  final $a declarations are the Lagrange and Cauchy remainder statements.
  Every preceding $a declaration is syntax or a faithful definition.
$)

$c Q1137206Icc Q1137206Ioo Q1137206Iter Q1137206Taylor
   Q1137206Smooth $.

q1137206-icc-syntax $a class ( Q1137206Icc A X ) $.
q1137206-ioo-syntax $a class ( Q1137206Ioo A X ) $.
q1137206-iter-syntax $a class ( Q1137206Iter F A X N ) $.
q1137206-taylor-syntax $a class ( Q1137206Taylor F A X N ) $.
q1137206-smooth-syntax $a wff ( Q1137206Smooth F A X N ) $.

${
  $d t A $.
  $d t X $.

  q1137206-icc-definition $a |- ( Q1137206Icc A X ) =
    { t e. RR | ( A <_ t /\ t <_ X ) } $.
$}

${
  $d t A $.
  $d t X $.

  q1137206-ioo-definition $a |- ( Q1137206Ioo A X ) =
    { t e. RR | ( A < t /\ t < X ) } $.
$}

q1137206-iter-definition $a |- ( Q1137206Iter F A X N ) =
  (
    (
      ( Q1137206Icc A X )
      Dn
      ( F |` ( Q1137206Icc A X ) )
    )
    ` N
  ) $.

${
  $d k A $.
  $d k F $.
  $d k N $.
  $d k X $.

  q1137206-taylor-definition $a |- ( Q1137206Taylor F A X N ) =
    sum_ k e. ( 0 ... N )
      (
        (
          ( ( Q1137206Iter F A X k ) ` A )
          /
          ( ! ` k )
        )
        x.
        ( ( X - A ) ^ k )
      ) $.
$}

q1137206-smooth-definition $a |- (
  ( Q1137206Smooth F A X N )
  <->
  (
    (
      F |` ( Q1137206Icc A X )
    )
    e.
    (
      (
        C^n ` ( Q1137206Icc A X )
      )
      ` N
    )
    /\
    (
      ( Q1137206Ioo A X )
      C_
      dom
        (
          ( Q1137206Ioo A X )
          _D
          (
            ( Q1137206Iter F A X N )
            |`
            ( Q1137206Ioo A X )
          )
        )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d a c f n x $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q1137206-taylor-mean-remainder-lagrange $a |-
    A. a e. RR
      A. x e. RR
        A. n e. NN0
          A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
            (
              (
                a < x
                /\
                ( Q1137206Smooth f a x n )
              )
              ->
              E. c e. ( Q1137206Ioo a x )
                (
                  ( f ` x )
                  -
                  ( Q1137206Taylor f a x n )
                )
                =
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( Q1137206Iter f a x ( n + 1 ) )
                      ` c
                    )
                    x.
                    ( ( x - a ) ^ ( n + 1 ) )
                  )
                  /
                  ( ! ` ( n + 1 ) )
                )
            ) $.
$}

${
  $d a c f n x $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q1137206-taylor-mean-remainder-cauchy $a |-
    A. a e. RR
      A. x e. RR
        A. n e. NN0
          A. f e. ( RR ^m RR )
            (
              (
                a < x
                /\
                ( Q1137206Smooth f a x n )
              )
              ->
              E. c e. ( Q1137206Ioo a x )
                (
                  ( f ` x )
                  -
                  ( Q1137206Taylor f a x n )
                )
                =
                (
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( Q1137206Iter f a x ( n + 1 ) )
                        ` c
                      )
                      x.
                      ( ( x - c ) ^ n )
                    )
                    /
                    ( ! ` n )
                  )
                  x.
                  ( x - a )
                )
            ) $.
$}

title: Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1137206,
% "Taylor's theorem": the Lagrange and Cauchy mean-value remainder formulas
% for real functions on a closed interval. This file contains no proof.

Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  in_closed_interval(t, a, b: real): bool =
    a <= t AND t <= b

  in_open_interval(t, a, b: real): bool =
    a < t AND t < b

  continuous_within_at(
      f: real_function,
      t, a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (in_closed_interval(y, a, b)
            AND abs(y - t) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              abs(f(y) - f(t)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_within(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, t, a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (in_closed_interval(y, a, b)
            AND y /= t
            AND abs(y - t) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(y) - f(t)
                  - derivative * (y - t))
                < epsilon_value * abs(y - t)

  differentiable_within_at(
      f: real_function,
      t, a, b: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_within(
        f, derivative, t, a, b)

  deriv_within(
      f: real_function,
      t, a, b: real): real =
    IF differentiable_within_at(f, t, a, b) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_within(
            f, derivative, t, a, b))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, t: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (increment: real):
          (increment /= 0
            AND abs(increment) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(t + increment) - f(t)
                  - derivative * increment)
                < epsilon_value * abs(increment)

  differentiable_at(
      f: real_function,
      t: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, t)

  iterated_deriv_within(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat,
      a, b, t: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF order = 0 THEN
      f(t)
    ELSE
      deriv_within(
        (LAMBDA (y: real):
          iterated_deriv_within(
            f, order - 1, a, b, y)),
        t,
        a,
        b)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE order

  iterated_deriv_within_function(
      f: real_function,
      order: nat,
      a, b: real): real_function =
    LAMBDA (t: real):
      iterated_deriv_within(f, order, a, b, t)

  continuous_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_closed_interval(t, a, b)
        IMPLIES continuous_within_at(f, t, a, b)

  differentiable_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_closed_interval(t, a, b)
        IMPLIES differentiable_within_at(f, t, a, b)

  differentiable_on_open_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_open_interval(t, a, b)
        IMPLIES differentiable_at(f, t)

  cont_diff_on_through(
      f: real_function,
      degree: nat,
      a, b: real): bool =
    (FORALL (order: nat):
      order <= degree IMPLIES
        continuous_on_closed_interval(
          iterated_deriv_within_function(
            f, order, a, b),
          a,
          b))
      AND (FORALL (order: nat):
        order < degree IMPLIES
          differentiable_on_closed_interval(
            iterated_deriv_within_function(
              f, order, a, b),
            a,
            b))

  taylor_polynomial(
      f: real_function,
      center, argument: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET order: nat = count - 1 IN
        taylor_polynomial(
          f,
          center,
          argument,
          count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              iterated_deriv_within(
                f,
                order,
                center,
                argument,
                center)
                * (argument - center) ^ order,
              factorial(order) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  taylor_hypotheses(
      f: real_function,
      degree: nat,
      center, argument: real): bool =
    center < argument
      AND cont_diff_on_through(
        f, degree, center, argument)
      AND differentiable_on_open_interval(
        iterated_deriv_within_function(
          f, degree, center, argument),
        center,
        argument)

  lagrange_remainder(
      f: real_function,
      degree: nat,
      center, argument, remainder_point: real): real =
    safe_div(
      iterated_deriv_within(
        f,
        degree + 1,
        center,
        argument,
        remainder_point)
        * (argument - center) ^ (degree + 1),
      factorial(degree + 1) :: real)

  cauchy_remainder(
      f: real_function,
      degree: nat,
      center, argument, remainder_point: real): real =
    safe_div(
      iterated_deriv_within(
        f,
        degree + 1,
        center,
        argument,
        remainder_point)
        * (argument - remainder_point) ^ degree,
      factorial(degree) :: real)
      * (argument - center)

  taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange: bool =
    FORALL
        (f: real_function),
        (x, x0: real),
        (degree: nat):
      taylor_hypotheses(f, degree, x0, x)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (remainder_point: real):
            in_open_interval(remainder_point, x0, x)
              AND f(x)
                - taylor_polynomial(
                    f,
                    x0,
                    x,
                    degree + 1)
                  = lagrange_remainder(
                      f,
                      degree,
                      x0,
                      x,
                      remainder_point)

  taylor_mean_remainder_cauchy: bool =
    FORALL
        (f: real_function),
        (x, x0: real),
        (degree: nat):
      taylor_hypotheses(f, degree, x0, x)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (remainder_point: real):
            in_open_interval(remainder_point, x0, x)
              AND f(x)
                - taylor_polynomial(
                    f,
                    x0,
                    x,
                    degree + 1)
                  = cauchy_remainder(
                      f,
                      degree,
                      x0,
                      x,
                      remainder_point)
END Q1137206_taylor_s_theorem

title: Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1139041
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1139041), "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)":
  every prime dividing the cardinality of a finite group is the order of
  some group element. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1139041_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q1139041_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q1139041_one : G;
  q1139041_inv : G -> G;
  q1139041_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q1139041_mul x (q1139041_mul y z) =
      q1139041_mul (q1139041_mul x y) z;
  q1139041_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q1139041_mul q1139041_one x = x;
  q1139041_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q1139041_mul x q1139041_one = x;
  q1139041_inv_mul :
    forall x : G,
      q1139041_mul (q1139041_inv x) x = q1139041_one;
  q1139041_mul_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q1139041_mul x (q1139041_inv x) = q1139041_one
}.

Arguments q1139041_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q1139041_one {G} _.

Record q1139041_finite_type (G : Type) : Type := {
  q1139041_enum : list G;
  q1139041_enum_nodup : NoDup q1139041_enum;
  q1139041_enum_complete :
    forall x : G, In x q1139041_enum
}.

Arguments q1139041_enum {G} _.

Definition q1139041_finite_card
    {G : Type} (F : q1139041_finite_type G) : nat :=
  length (q1139041_enum F).

Fixpoint q1139041_pow
    {G : Type}
    (grp : q1139041_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q1139041_one grp
  | S k => q1139041_mul grp x (q1139041_pow grp x k)
  end.

Definition q1139041_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Definition q1139041_has_order
    {G : Type}
    (grp : q1139041_group G)
    (x : G)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  (0 < n)%nat /\
  q1139041_pow grp x n = q1139041_one grp /\
  forall k : nat,
    (0 < k < n)%nat ->
    q1139041_pow grp x k <> q1139041_one grp.

Theorem exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q1139041_group G)
         (F : q1139041_finite_type G)
         (p : nat),
    q1139041_prime p ->
    Nat.divide p (q1139041_finite_card F) ->
    exists x : G, q1139041_has_order grp x p.
Admitted.
