title: Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1139041,
  "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)": every prime divisor of the order of a
  finite group is the order of some element of the group. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q1139041_CAUCHY_GROUP_THEOREM =
  `let dvd_rel =
     \d n:num. ?k:num. n = d * k in
   let is_prime =
     \p:num. 2 <= p /\ !d:num. dvd_rel d p ==> d = 1 \/ d = p in
   let is_group_on =
     \(s:A->bool) (op:A->A->A) (iinv:A->A) (id:A).
       id IN s /\
       (!x. x IN s ==> iinv x IN s) /\
       (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> op x y IN s) /\
       (!x y z.
          x IN s /\ y IN s /\ z IN s
          ==> op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\
       (!x. x IN s ==> op id x = x /\ op x id = x) /\
       (!x. x IN s ==> op (iinv x) x = id /\ op x (iinv x) = id) in
   let is_power =
     \(op:A->A->A) (id:A) (x:A) (n:num) (y:A).
       ?f:num->A.
         f 0 = id /\
         (!k. k < n ==> f (k + 1) = op x (f k)) /\
         f n = y in
   !(s:A->bool) (op:A->A->A) (iinv:A->A) (id:A) (p:num).
     is_group_on s op iinv id /\
     FINITE s /\
     is_prime p /\
     dvd_rel p (CARD s)
     ==> ?x:A.
           x IN s /\
           !n:num. is_power op id x n id <=> dvd_rel p n`;;

title: Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1139041,
;; "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)": if a prime divides the cardinality of an
;; arbitrary finite group, then the group contains an element whose order is
;; that prime. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces present arbitrary group carriers and
;; operations. Every group law used by the statement is explicit below.

(defstub q1139041-element-p (group value) t)
(defstub q1139041-identity (group) t)
(defstub q1139041-multiply (group left right) t)
(defstub q1139041-inverse (group value) t)

(defun-sk q1139041-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall (a b c)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1139041-element-p group a)
      (and
       (q1139041-element-p
        group
        (q1139041-inverse group a))
       (equal
        (q1139041-multiply
         group a (q1139041-identity group))
        a)
       (equal
        (q1139041-multiply
         group (q1139041-identity group) a)
        a)
       (equal
        (q1139041-multiply
         group a (q1139041-inverse group a))
        (q1139041-identity group))
       (equal
        (q1139041-multiply
         group (q1139041-inverse group a) a)
        (q1139041-identity group))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1139041-element-p group a)
       (q1139041-element-p group b))
      (q1139041-element-p
       group
       (q1139041-multiply group a b)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1139041-element-p group a)
       (q1139041-element-p group b)
       (q1139041-element-p group c))
      (equal
       (q1139041-multiply
        group
        a
        (q1139041-multiply group b c))
       (q1139041-multiply
        group
        (q1139041-multiply group a b)
        c))))))

(defun q1139041-group-p (group)
  (and
   (q1139041-element-p
    group
    (q1139041-identity group))
   (q1139041-group-laws-p group)))

;; A duplicate-free exact enumeration is an internal witness that the
;; arbitrary carrier is finite. Its length is therefore the carrier's
;; cardinality, independently of the chosen enumeration order.

(defun-sk q1139041-enumerates-carrier-p
    (group enumeration)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1139041-element-p group x)
     (member-equal x enumeration))))

(defun q1139041-exact-finite-enumeration-p
    (group enumeration)
  (and
   (true-listp enumeration)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal enumeration)
   (q1139041-enumerates-carrier-p
    group enumeration)))

(defun q1139041-divides-p (divisor dividend)
  (and
   (natp divisor)
   (natp dividend)
   (if (equal divisor 0)
       (equal dividend 0)
     (equal (mod dividend divisor) 0))))

(defun-sk q1139041-prime-divisor-law-p (p)
  (forall (divisor)
    (implies
     (q1139041-divides-p divisor p)
     (or
      (equal divisor 1)
      (equal divisor p)))))

(defun q1139041-primep (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (q1139041-prime-divisor-law-p p)))

(defun-sk q1139041-prime-divides-card-p (group p)
  (exists (enumeration)
    (and
     (q1139041-exact-finite-enumeration-p
      group enumeration)
     (q1139041-divides-p
      p
      (len enumeration)))))

;; The order predicate says exactly that p is the least positive exponent
;; taking the element to the identity.

(defun q1139041-power (group element exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q1139041-identity group)
    (q1139041-multiply
     group
     element
     (q1139041-power
      group element (- exponent 1)))))

(defun-sk q1139041-no-smaller-positive-power-p
    (group element p)
  (forall (exponent)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp exponent)
      (< 0 exponent)
      (< exponent p))
     (not
      (equal
       (q1139041-power
        group element exponent)
       (q1139041-identity group))))))

(defun q1139041-order-equals-p
    (group element p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 0 p)
   (equal
    (q1139041-power group element p)
    (q1139041-identity group))
   (q1139041-no-smaller-positive-power-p
    group element p)))

(defun-sk q1139041-has-element-of-order-p (group p)
  (exists (element)
    (and
     (q1139041-element-p group element)
     (q1139041-order-equals-p
      group element p))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1139041-cauchys-theorem-group-theory-statement
    ()
  (forall (group p)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1139041-group-p group)
      (q1139041-primep p)
      (q1139041-prime-divides-card-p group p))
     (q1139041-has-element-of-order-p group p))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1139041,
-- "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)": every prime divisor of the order of a
-- finite group is the order of some group element. This file contains no proof.

module Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≤_ _∣_

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤   : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    divides-equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : suc (suc zero) ≤ n
    divisor-is-trivial :
      (d : Nat) →
      d ∣ n →
      (d ≡ suc zero) ∨ (d ≡ n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

power :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  G →
  Nat →
  G
power structure x zero = Group.identity structure
power structure x (suc n) =
  Group.multiply structure x (power structure x n)

record ExactOrder
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (x : G)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    power-is-identity :
      power structure x n ≡ Group.identity structure
    least-positive :
      (k : Nat) →
      suc zero ≤ k →
      power structure x k ≡ Group.identity structure →
      n ≤ k

cauchys-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
cauchys-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (group-order prime : Nat) →
  Bijection G (Fin group-order) →
  Prime prime →
  prime ∣ group-order →
  Σ G (λ x → ExactOrder structure x prime)

title: Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1139041, "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)": if a prime divides the
  cardinality of a finite group, the group contains an element of that prime
  order. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (p : num).
      Group g /\
      FINITE g.carrier /\
      prime p /\
      p divides CARD g.carrier
      ==>
      ?x : 'a.
        x IN g.carrier /\
        order g x = p``;

content:

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1139041), "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)":
  every prime dividing the order of a finite group is the order of some group
  element. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. Grp supplies an arbitrary group, Base ` G is its carrier,
  Fin and # express finiteness and finite cardinality, Prime is the class of
  natural primes, || is divisibility, and ( od ` G ) ` x is the order of the
  carrier element x.

  The element witness remains existentially quantified inside the conclusion,
  exactly as in exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card. The final declaration is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement; the root artifact source contains no
  $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d G P x $.

  thousand-theorems-q1139041-cauchy $a |- (
    A. G A. P
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          ( Base ` G ) e. Fin
          /\
          P e. Prime
          /\
          P || ( # ` ( Base ` G ) )
        )
        ->
        E. x e. ( Base ` G )
          ( ( od ` G ) ` x ) = P

$}

title: Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1139041,
% "Cauchy's theorem (group theory)": a prime dividing the order of a finite group
% is the order of some group element. This file contains no proof.

Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  IMPORTING finite_sets[G]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  group_power(x: G, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      mul(group_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  has_exact_order(x: G, order: nat): bool =
    order > 0
      AND group_power(x, order) = one
      AND (FORALL (exponent: nat):
        exponent > 0 AND exponent < order IMPLIES
          group_power(x, exponent) /= one)

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: nat): value = divisor * factor

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND (FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value)

  full_carrier(carrier: finite_set[G]): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): carrier(x)

  exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat), (carrier: finite_set[G]):
      (group_laws
        AND full_carrier(carrier)
        AND prime_nat(p)
        AND nat_divides(p, card(carrier)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (x: G): has_exact_order(x, p)

END Q1139041_cauchy_s_theorem_group_theory

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1140119
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1140119), "Morera's theorem": for a function
  from the complex plane to an arbitrary complex Banach space on an open set,
  being conservative on rectangles and continuous is equivalent to being
  complex differentiable there. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1140119_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.
Definition q1140119_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1140119_czero : q1140119_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q1140119_cone : q1140119_complex := (1, 0).
Definition q1140119_ci : q1140119_complex := (0, 1).

Definition q1140119_cadd
    (z w : q1140119_complex) : q1140119_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q1140119_cneg
    (z : q1140119_complex) : q1140119_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q1140119_csub
    (z w : q1140119_complex) : q1140119_complex :=
  q1140119_cadd z (q1140119_cneg w).

Definition q1140119_cmul
    (z w : q1140119_complex) : q1140119_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q1140119_of_real (x : R) : q1140119_complex :=
  (x, 0).

Definition q1140119_cmodulus
    (z : q1140119_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Record q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1140119_zero : E;
  q1140119_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1140119_neg : E -> E;
  q1140119_smul : q1140119_complex -> E -> E;
  q1140119_norm : E -> R;

  q1140119_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1140119_add x (q1140119_add y z) =
      q1140119_add (q1140119_add x y) z;
  q1140119_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1140119_add x y = q1140119_add y x;
  q1140119_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1140119_add x q1140119_zero = x;
  q1140119_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1140119_add x (q1140119_neg x) = q1140119_zero;

  q1140119_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1140119_smul q1140119_cone x = x;
  q1140119_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q1140119_complex) (x : E),
      q1140119_smul (q1140119_cmul a b) x =
      q1140119_smul a (q1140119_smul b x);
  q1140119_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q1140119_complex) (x : E),
      q1140119_smul (q1140119_cadd a b) x =
      q1140119_add
        (q1140119_smul a x) (q1140119_smul b x);
  q1140119_smul_add :
    forall (a : q1140119_complex) (x y : E),
      q1140119_smul a (q1140119_add x y) =
      q1140119_add
        (q1140119_smul a x) (q1140119_smul a y);
  q1140119_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q1140119_smul q1140119_czero x = q1140119_zero;
  q1140119_smul_zero :
    forall a : q1140119_complex,
      q1140119_smul a q1140119_zero = q1140119_zero;

  q1140119_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1140119_norm x;
  q1140119_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q1140119_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1140119_zero;
  q1140119_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1140119_norm (q1140119_add x y) <=
      q1140119_norm x + q1140119_norm y;
  q1140119_norm_smul :
    forall (a : q1140119_complex) (x : E),
      q1140119_norm (q1140119_smul a x) =
      q1140119_cmodulus a * q1140119_norm x
}.

Arguments q1140119_zero {E} _.
Arguments q1140119_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1140119_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q1140119_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1140119_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q1140119_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1140119_add V x (q1140119_neg V y).

Definition q1140119_sequence_converges
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1140119_norm V
          (q1140119_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1140119_sequence_cauchy
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1140119_norm V
          (q1140119_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1140119_complete
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q1140119_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : E,
      q1140119_sequence_converges V u limit.

Fixpoint q1140119_sum_first
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (term : nat -> E) (n : nat) : E :=
  match n with
  | O => q1140119_zero V
  | S k => q1140119_add V (q1140119_sum_first V term k) (term k)
  end.

Definition q1140119_uniform_riemann_sum
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (g : R -> E) (a b : R) (n : nat) : E :=
  let step := (b - a) / INR n in
  q1140119_sum_first V
    (fun k : nat =>
      q1140119_smul V (q1140119_of_real step)
        (g (a + INR k * step)))
    n.

Definition q1140119_forward_riemann_limit
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (g : R -> E) (a b : R) (value : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        (0 < n)%nat ->
        q1140119_norm V
          (q1140119_sub V
            (q1140119_uniform_riemann_sum V g a b n)
            value) < epsilon.

Definition q1140119_interval_integral_value
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (g : R -> E) (a b : R) (value : E) : Prop :=
  if Rle_dec a b then
    q1140119_forward_riemann_limit V g a b value
  else
    q1140119_forward_riemann_limit V g b a
      (q1140119_neg V value).

Definition q1140119_interval_integral
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (g : R -> E) (a b : R) : E :=
  if excluded_middle_informative
      (exists value : E,
        q1140119_interval_integral_value V g a b value)
  then
    epsilon (inhabits (q1140119_zero V))
      (fun value : E =>
        q1140119_interval_integral_value V g a b value)
  else q1140119_zero V.

Definition q1140119_between (a b x : R) : Prop :=
  (a <= x /\ x <= b) \/ (b <= x /\ x <= a).

Definition q1140119_rectangle
    (z w : q1140119_complex) :
    q1140119_set q1140119_complex :=
  fun u =>
    q1140119_between (fst z) (fst w) (fst u) /\
    q1140119_between (snd z) (snd w) (snd u).

Definition q1140119_subset
    {A : Type}
    (S T : q1140119_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q1140119_wedge_integral
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (z w : q1140119_complex)
    (f : q1140119_complex -> E) : E :=
  q1140119_add V
    (q1140119_interval_integral V
      (fun x : R => f (x, snd z)) (fst z) (fst w))
    (q1140119_smul V q1140119_ci
      (q1140119_interval_integral V
        (fun y : R => f (fst w, y)) (snd z) (snd w))).

Definition q1140119_is_conservative_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1140119_complex -> E)
    (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex) : Prop :=
  forall z w : q1140119_complex,
    q1140119_subset (q1140119_rectangle z w) U ->
    q1140119_wedge_integral V z w f =
    q1140119_neg V (q1140119_wedge_integral V w z f).

Definition q1140119_is_open
    (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex) : Prop :=
  forall z : q1140119_complex,
    U z ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q1140119_complex,
        q1140119_cmodulus (q1140119_csub w z) < delta ->
        U w.

Definition q1140119_continuous_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1140119_complex -> E)
    (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex)
    (z : q1140119_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q1140119_complex,
        U w ->
        q1140119_cmodulus (q1140119_csub w z) < delta ->
        q1140119_norm V
          (q1140119_sub V (f w) (f z)) < epsilon.

Definition q1140119_continuous_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1140119_complex -> E)
    (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex) : Prop :=
  forall z : q1140119_complex,
    U z ->
    q1140119_continuous_within_at V f U z.

Record q1140119_continuous_complex_linear_map
    (E : Type)
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q1140119_linear_apply : q1140119_complex -> E;
  q1140119_linear_add :
    forall z w : q1140119_complex,
      q1140119_linear_apply (q1140119_cadd z w) =
      q1140119_add V
        (q1140119_linear_apply z) (q1140119_linear_apply w);
  q1140119_linear_smul :
    forall a z : q1140119_complex,
      q1140119_linear_apply (q1140119_cmul a z) =
      q1140119_smul V a (q1140119_linear_apply z);
  q1140119_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall z : q1140119_complex,
        q1140119_norm V (q1140119_linear_apply z) <=
        bound * q1140119_cmodulus z
}.

Arguments q1140119_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Definition q1140119_has_frechet_derivative_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1140119_complex -> E)
    (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex)
    (z : q1140119_complex)
    (D : q1140119_continuous_complex_linear_map V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q1140119_complex,
        U w ->
        q1140119_cmodulus (q1140119_csub w z) < delta ->
        q1140119_norm V
          (q1140119_sub V
            (q1140119_sub V (f w) (f z))
            (q1140119_linear_apply D
              (q1140119_csub w z))) <=
        epsilon * q1140119_cmodulus (q1140119_csub w z).

Definition q1140119_differentiable_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q1140119_complex -> E)
    (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex) : Prop :=
  forall z : q1140119_complex,
    U z ->
    exists D : q1140119_continuous_complex_linear_map V,
      @q1140119_has_frechet_derivative_within_at E V f U z D.

Theorem isConservativeOn_and_continuousOn_iff_isDifferentiableOn :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q1140119_normed_complex_vector_space E),
    q1140119_complete V ->
    forall (f : q1140119_complex -> E)
           (U : q1140119_set q1140119_complex),
      q1140119_is_open U ->
      (q1140119_is_conservative_on V f U /\
       q1140119_continuous_on V f U) <->
      q1140119_differentiable_on V f U.
Admitted.

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1140119 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1140119), "Morera's theorem":
  for a function from the complex plane to a complete complex normed vector
  space on an open set, vanishing oriented integrals around every
  axis-parallel rectangle together with continuity is equivalent to complex
  differentiability on that set. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1140119_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1140119_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q1140119_riemann_sum ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      (real \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q1140119_riemann_sum n a b g =
    (if n = 0 then 0 else
      (\<Sum>k<n.
        ((b - a) / real n) *\<^sub>R
          g (a + (real k / real n) * (b - a))))"

definition q1140119_directed_integral ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow>
      (real \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space}) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q1140119_directed_integral a b g =
    Lim at_top (\<lambda>n. q1140119_riemann_sum n a b g)"

definition q1140119_rectangle :: "complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex set" where
  "q1140119_rectangle z w =
    {u. min (Re z) (Re w) \<le> Re u \<and> Re u \<le> max (Re z) (Re w) \<and>
        min (Im z) (Im w) \<le> Im u \<and> Im u \<le> max (Im z) (Im w)}"

definition q1140119_wedge_integral ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      complex \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q1140119_wedge_integral cscale z w f =
    q1140119_directed_integral (Re z) (Re w)
      (\<lambda>x. f (of_real x + of_real (Im z) * \<i>)) +
    cscale \<i>
      (q1140119_directed_integral (Im z) (Im w)
        (\<lambda>y. f (of_real (Re w) + of_real y * \<i>)))"

definition q1140119_is_conservative_on ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> complex set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1140119_is_conservative_on cscale f U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z w. q1140119_rectangle z w \<subseteq> U \<longrightarrow>
      q1140119_wedge_integral cscale z w f =
        - q1140119_wedge_integral cscale w z f)"

definition q1140119_complex_differentiable_on ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> complex set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1140119_complex_differentiable_on cscale f U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> U. \<exists>d.
      ((\<lambda>w. cscale (inverse (w - z)) (f w - f z)) \<longlongrightarrow> d)
        (at z within (U - {z})))"

theorem q1140119_morera_s_theorem:
  fixes cscale ::
      "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and U :: "complex set"
  assumes complex_space: "q1140119_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and open_set: "open U"
  shows
    "q1140119_is_conservative_on cscale f U \<and> continuous_on U f
      \<longleftrightarrow> q1140119_complex_differentiable_on cscale f U"
  sorry

end

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1140119
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1140119), "Morera's theorem": on an
  arbitrary open subset of the complex plane, a function into a complete
  complex normed vector space is continuous with zero integral around every
  axis-aligned rectangle exactly when it is complex differentiable there.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1140119_MORERA_S_THEOREM =
 `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
  let ci = ((&0:real),(&1:real)) in
  let cadd =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
  let csub =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z - FST w,SND z - SND w) in
  let cmul =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
       FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
  let cnorm =
    \(z:real#real).
      sqrt(FST z * FST z + SND z * SND z) in
  let subE =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (x:A) (y:A).
      addE x (negE y) in
  let normed_add_comm_group =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real).
      (!x y z:A. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
      (!x y:A. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x:A. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x:A. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      normE zeroE = &0 /\
      (!x:A. &0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x:A. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
      (!x y:A. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
  let complex_normed_space =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A).
      (!x:A. smulE cone x = x) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cmul a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cadd a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x y:A.
         smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. smulE czero x = zeroE) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A.
         normE (smulE a x) = cnorm a * normE x) in
  let tends_to =
    \(normE:A->real) (subE:A->A->A) (u:num->A) (l:A).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n ==> normE (subE (u n) l) < epsilon in
  let cauchy_sequence =
    \(normE:A->real) (subE:A->A->A) (u:num->A).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
              N <= m /\ N <= n
              ==> normE (subE (u m) (u n)) < epsilon in
  let complete_space =
    \(normE:A->real) (subE:A->A->A).
      !u:num->A.
        cauchy_sequence normE subE u
        ==> ?l:A. tends_to normE subE u l in
  let finite_sum =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (term:num->A) (n:num).
      ((@s:num->A.
          s 0 = zeroE /\
          (!j:num. s (SUC j) = addE (s j) (term j))) n) in
  let midpoint_sum =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A)
     (g:real->A) (a:real) (b:real) (n:num).
      finite_sum zeroE addE
        (\k:num.
          smulE ((b - a) / &(SUC n),&0)
            (g (a + ((&k + &1 / &2) / &(SUC n)) * (b - a))))
        (SUC n) in
  let has_interval_integral =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A) (subE:A->A->A)
     (g:real->A) (a:real) (b:real) (v:A).
      tends_to normE subE
        (\n:num. midpoint_sum zeroE addE smulE g a b n) v in
  let interval_integral =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A) (subE:A->A->A)
     (g:real->A) (a:real) (b:real).
      @v:A.
        has_interval_integral
          zeroE addE normE smulE subE g a b v in
  let open_set =
    \(U:(real#real)->bool).
      !z:real#real.
        U z
        ==> ?r:real.
              &0 < r /\
              !w:real#real.
                cnorm (csub w z) < r ==> U w in
  let continuous_on =
    \(normE:A->real) (subE:A->A->A)
     (f:(real#real)->A) (U:(real#real)->bool).
      !x:real#real.
        U x
        ==> !epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon
              ==> ?delta:real.
                    &0 < delta /\
                    !y:real#real.
                      U y /\ cnorm (csub y x) < delta
                      ==> normE (subE (f y) (f x)) < epsilon in
  let differentiable_on =
    \(normE:A->real) (smulE:(real#real)->A->A)
     (subE:A->A->A) (f:(real#real)->A)
     (U:(real#real)->bool).
      !x:real#real.
        U x
        ==> ?d:A.
              !epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon
                ==> ?delta:real.
                      &0 < delta /\
                      !y:real#real.
                        U y /\ cnorm (csub y x) < delta
                        ==> normE
                              (subE
                                (subE (f y) (f x))
                                (smulE (csub y x) d))
                            <= epsilon * cnorm (csub y x) in
  let rectangle_subset =
    \(U:(real#real)->bool) (z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      !x y:real.
        min (FST z) (FST w) <= x /\
        x <= max (FST z) (FST w) /\
        min (SND z) (SND w) <= y /\
        y <= max (SND z) (SND w)
        ==> U (x,y) in
  let wedge_integral =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A) (subE:A->A->A)
     (z:real#real) (w:real#real) (f:(real#real)->A).
      addE
        (interval_integral zeroE addE normE smulE subE
          (\x:real. f (x,SND z)) (FST z) (FST w))
        (smulE ci
          (interval_integral zeroE addE normE smulE subE
            (\y:real. f (FST w,y)) (SND z) (SND w))) in
  let conservative_on =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A) (subE:A->A->A)
     (f:(real#real)->A) (U:(real#real)->bool).
      !z w:real#real.
        rectangle_subset U z w
        ==> wedge_integral zeroE addE normE smulE subE z w f =
            negE
              (wedge_integral
                zeroE addE normE smulE subE w z f) in
  !zeroE:A.
  !addE:A->A->A.
  !negE:A->A.
  !normE:A->real.
  !smulE:(real#real)->A->A.
  !f:(real#real)->A.
  !U:(real#real)->bool.
    normed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    complex_normed_space zeroE addE normE smulE /\
    complete_space normE (subE addE negE) /\
    open_set U
    ==>
    (conservative_on
       zeroE addE negE normE smulE (subE addE negE) f U /\
     continuous_on normE (subE addE negE) f U
     <=>
     differentiable_on
       normE smulE (subE addE negE) f U)`;;

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1140119,
;; "Morera's theorem": on an open subset of the complex plane, a function into
;; an arbitrary complex Banach space is differentiable exactly when it is
;; continuous and its integrals around all contained rectangles vanish.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. Complex
;; numbers are explicit real-coordinate pairs. The codomain is an arbitrary
;; complete normed complex vector space.

(defstub q1140119-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q1140119-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defun q1140119-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q1140119-r-add
   real left (q1140119-r-negate real right)))

(defun q1140119-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q1140119-r-less real right left)))

(defun q1140119-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q1140119-r-member-p real value)
   (q1140119-r-less
    real (q1140119-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q1140119-r-square (real value)
  (q1140119-r-multiply real value value))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-r-member-p real x)
      (q1140119-r-member-p real y)
      (q1140119-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q1140119-r-zero real))
            (one (q1140119-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q1140119-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q1140119-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q1140119-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q1140119-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q1140119-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q1140119-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q1140119-r-member-p real zero)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real one)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1140119-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q1140119-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1140119-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q1140119-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q1140119-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1140119-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q1140119-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1140119-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q1140119-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q1140119-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1140119-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1140119-r-multiply
          real x (q1140119-r-add real y z))
         (q1140119-r-add
          real
          (q1140119-r-multiply real x y)
          (q1140119-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-r-member-p real x)
      (q1140119-r-member-p real y)
      (q1140119-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q1140119-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q1140119-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1140119-r-less real x y)
         (q1140119-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1140119-r-less real x y)
          (q1140119-r-less real y z))
         (q1140119-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q1140119-r-less real x y)
         (q1140119-r-less
          real
          (q1140119-r-add real x z)
          (q1140119-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1140119-r-less real zero x)
          (q1140119-r-less real zero y))
         (q1140119-r-less
          real zero
          (q1140119-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-valid-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-set-member-p real set x)
     (q1140119-r-member-p real x))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1140119-r-member-p real x)
     (q1140119-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-r-member-p real x)
      (q1140119-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q1140119-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1140119-r-member-p real bound)
     (q1140119-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1140119-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q1140119-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1140119-r-member-p real bound)
       (q1140119-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q1140119-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1140119-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1140119-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-r-valid-set-p real set)
      (q1140119-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q1140119-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q1140119-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q1140119-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q1140119-r-zero real))
        (one (q1140119-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q1140119-r-member-p real zero)
     (q1140119-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1140119-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q1140119-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q1140119-r-less real zero one)
     (q1140119-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Complex arithmetic in real coordinates.

(defun q1140119-c-member-p (real value)
  (and
   (consp value)
   (q1140119-r-member-p real (car value))
   (q1140119-r-member-p real (cdr value))))

(defun q1140119-c-make (real-part imaginary-part)
  (cons real-part imaginary-part))

(defun q1140119-c-re (value)
  (car value))

(defun q1140119-c-im (value)
  (cdr value))

(defun q1140119-c-zero (real)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-r-zero real)
   (q1140119-r-zero real)))

(defun q1140119-c-one (real)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-r-one real)
   (q1140119-r-zero real)))

(defun q1140119-c-I (real)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-r-zero real)
   (q1140119-r-one real)))

(defun q1140119-c-of-real (real value)
  (q1140119-c-make value (q1140119-r-zero real)))

(defun q1140119-c-add (real left right)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-r-add
    real
    (q1140119-c-re left)
    (q1140119-c-re right))
   (q1140119-r-add
    real
    (q1140119-c-im left)
    (q1140119-c-im right))))

(defun q1140119-c-negate (real value)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-r-negate real (q1140119-c-re value))
   (q1140119-r-negate real (q1140119-c-im value))))

(defun q1140119-c-subtract (real left right)
  (q1140119-c-add
   real left (q1140119-c-negate real right)))

(defun q1140119-c-multiply (real left right)
  (let ((a (q1140119-c-re left))
        (b (q1140119-c-im left))
        (c (q1140119-c-re right))
        (d (q1140119-c-im right)))
    (q1140119-c-make
     (q1140119-r-subtract
      real
      (q1140119-r-multiply real a c)
      (q1140119-r-multiply real b d))
     (q1140119-r-add
      real
      (q1140119-r-multiply real a d)
      (q1140119-r-multiply real b c)))))

(defun q1140119-c-modulus-square (real value)
  (q1140119-r-add
   real
   (q1140119-r-square real (q1140119-c-re value))
   (q1140119-r-square real (q1140119-c-im value))))

(defun q1140119-c-distance-square (real left right)
  (q1140119-c-modulus-square
   real (q1140119-c-subtract real left right)))

;; Arbitrary complex normed vector spaces and functions C -> E.

(defstub q1140119-e-member-p (space value) t)
(defstub q1140119-e-zero (space) t)
(defstub q1140119-e-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q1140119-e-negate (space value) t)
(defstub q1140119-e-smul (real space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q1140119-e-norm (real space value) t)
(defstub q1140119-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q1140119-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q1140119-sequence-value (sequence index) t)

(defun q1140119-e-subtract (space left right)
  (q1140119-e-add
   space left (q1140119-e-negate space right)))

(defun-sk q1140119-e-additive-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-e-member-p space x)
      (q1140119-e-member-p space y)
      (q1140119-e-member-p space z))
     (let* ((zero (q1140119-e-zero space))
            (xy (q1140119-e-add space x y))
            (yz (q1140119-e-add space y z))
            (neg-x (q1140119-e-negate space x))
            (norm-x (q1140119-e-norm real space x))
            (norm-y (q1140119-e-norm real space y)))
       (and
        (q1140119-e-member-p space zero)
        (q1140119-e-member-p space xy)
        (q1140119-e-member-p space neg-x)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real norm-x)
        (q1140119-r-member-p real norm-y)
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-add space xy z)
         (q1140119-e-add space x yz))
        (equal xy (q1140119-e-add space y x))
        (equal (q1140119-e-add space x zero) x)
        (equal (q1140119-e-add space x neg-x) zero)
        (q1140119-r-leq
         real (q1140119-r-zero real) norm-x)
        (iff
         (equal norm-x (q1140119-r-zero real))
         (equal x zero))
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-norm real space neg-x)
         norm-x)
        (q1140119-r-leq
         real
         (q1140119-e-norm real space xy)
         (q1140119-r-add real norm-x norm-y)))))))

(defun-sk q1140119-e-scalar-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-c-member-p real a)
      (q1140119-c-member-p real b)
      (q1140119-e-member-p space x)
      (q1140119-e-member-p space y))
     (let ((zero-e (q1140119-e-zero space))
           (ax (q1140119-e-smul real space a x)))
       (and
        (q1140119-e-member-p space ax)
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-smul
          real space (q1140119-c-one real) x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-smul
          real space
          (q1140119-c-multiply real a b)
          x)
         (q1140119-e-smul
          real space a
          (q1140119-e-smul real space b x)))
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-smul
          real space
          (q1140119-c-add real a b)
          x)
         (q1140119-e-add
          space
          (q1140119-e-smul real space a x)
          (q1140119-e-smul real space b x)))
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-smul
          real space a
          (q1140119-e-add space x y))
         (q1140119-e-add
          space
          (q1140119-e-smul real space a x)
          (q1140119-e-smul real space a y)))
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-smul
          real space (q1140119-c-zero real) x)
         zero-e)
        (equal
         (q1140119-e-smul real space a zero-e)
         zero-e)
        (equal
         (q1140119-r-square
          real (q1140119-e-norm real space ax))
         (q1140119-r-multiply
          real
          (q1140119-c-modulus-square real a)
          (q1140119-r-square
           real (q1140119-e-norm real space x)))))))))

(defun q1140119-complex-normed-space-p (real space)
  (and
   (q1140119-e-member-p space (q1140119-e-zero space))
   (q1140119-e-additive-laws-p real space)
   (q1140119-e-scalar-laws-p real space)))

(defun-sk q1140119-sequence-in-space-p (space sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q1140119-e-member-p
      space (q1140119-sequence-value sequence index)))))

(defun-sk q1140119-cauchy-tail-p
    (real space sequence epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-index)
      (natp right-index)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff left-index)
      (<= cutoff right-index))
     (q1140119-r-less
      real
      (q1140119-e-norm
       real space
       (q1140119-e-subtract
        space
        (q1140119-sequence-value sequence left-index)
        (q1140119-sequence-value sequence right-index)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (real space sequence epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1140119-cauchy-tail-p
      real space sequence epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1140119-cauchy-sequence-p
    (real space sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1140119-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      real space sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-convergence-tail-p
    (real space sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff index))
     (q1140119-r-less
      real
      (q1140119-e-norm
       real space
       (q1140119-e-subtract
        space
        (q1140119-sequence-value sequence index)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (real space sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1140119-convergence-tail-p
      real space sequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1140119-sequence-converges-p
    (real space sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1140119-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      real space sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-sequence-limit-exists-p
    (real space sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q1140119-e-member-p space limit)
     (q1140119-sequence-converges-p
      real space sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q1140119-complete-space-p (real space)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-sequence-in-space-p space sequence)
      (q1140119-cauchy-sequence-p real space sequence))
     (q1140119-sequence-limit-exists-p
      real space sequence))))

(defun q1140119-complex-banach-space-p (real space)
  (and
   (q1140119-complex-normed-space-p real space)
   (q1140119-complete-space-p real space)))

(defun-sk q1140119-valid-complex-set-p (real set)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q1140119-set-member-p set z)
     (q1140119-c-member-p real z))))

(defun-sk q1140119-function-into-space-p
    (real space function)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q1140119-c-member-p real z)
     (q1140119-e-member-p
      space (q1140119-function-value function z)))))

;; Squared complex distances generate the ordinary complex norm topology.

(defun-sk q1140119-ball-contained-p
    (real set center radius-square)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-c-member-p real point)
      (q1140119-r-less
       real
       (q1140119-c-distance-square real point center)
       radius-square))
     (q1140119-set-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q1140119-open-radius-exists-p
    (real set center)
  (exists (radius-square)
    (and
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real radius-square)
     (q1140119-ball-contained-p
      real set center radius-square))))

(defun-sk q1140119-open-set-p (real set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q1140119-set-member-p set center)
     (q1140119-open-radius-exists-p
      real set center))))

(defun-sk q1140119-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (real space set function center epsilon radius-square)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-c-member-p real point)
      (q1140119-set-member-p set point)
      (q1140119-r-less
       real
       (q1140119-c-distance-square real point center)
       radius-square))
     (q1140119-r-less
      real
      (q1140119-e-norm
       real space
       (q1140119-e-subtract
        space
        (q1140119-function-value function point)
        (q1140119-function-value function center)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (real space set function center epsilon)
  (exists (radius-square)
    (and
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real radius-square)
     (q1140119-continuity-neighborhood-p
      real space set function center epsilon radius-square))))

(defun-sk q1140119-continuous-within-at-p
    (real space set function center)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1140119-continuity-radius-exists-p
      real space set function center epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-continuous-on-p
    (real space set function)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q1140119-set-member-p set center)
     (q1140119-continuous-within-at-p
      real space set function center))))

;; Complex Frechet differentiability C -> E. A complex-linear map from C is
;; uniquely determined by its value at one, so its action is h |-> h * d.
;; Squaring the standard norm estimate gives an equivalent epsilon-delta
;; condition without introducing a square-root operation on the real field.

(defun q1140119-derivative-remainder
    (real space function center point derivative)
  (q1140119-e-subtract
   space
   (q1140119-e-subtract
    space
    (q1140119-function-value function point)
    (q1140119-function-value function center))
   (q1140119-e-smul
    real space
    (q1140119-c-subtract real point center)
    derivative)))

(defun-sk q1140119-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (real space set function center derivative
          epsilon radius-square)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-c-member-p real point)
      (q1140119-set-member-p set point)
      (q1140119-r-less
       real
       (q1140119-c-distance-square real point center)
       radius-square))
     (q1140119-r-leq
      real
      (q1140119-r-square
       real
       (q1140119-e-norm
        real space
        (q1140119-derivative-remainder
         real space function center point derivative)))
      (q1140119-r-multiply
       real
       (q1140119-r-square real epsilon)
       (q1140119-c-distance-square
        real point center))))))

(defun-sk q1140119-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (real space set function center derivative epsilon)
  (exists (radius-square)
    (and
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real radius-square)
     (q1140119-derivative-neighborhood-p
      real space set function center derivative
      epsilon radius-square))))

(defun-sk q1140119-has-derivative-within-at-p
    (real space set function center derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1140119-derivative-radius-exists-p
      real space set function center derivative epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-differentiable-within-at-p
    (real space set function center)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (q1140119-e-member-p space derivative)
     (q1140119-has-derivative-within-at-p
      real space set function center derivative))))

(defun-sk q1140119-differentiable-on-p
    (real space set function)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q1140119-set-member-p set center)
     (q1140119-differentiable-within-at-p
      real space set function center))))

;; Uniform right-endpoint Riemann sums characterize each vector-valued
;; interval integral along a rectangle edge. For continuous edge restrictions
;; these are the source Bochner interval integrals. If no E-valued limit
;; exists, the value is zero, matching Mathlib's totalized integral for a
;; nonintegrable function. Completeness is an explicit source assumption.

(defun q1140119-r-natural (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1140119-r-zero real)
    (q1140119-r-add
     real
     (q1140119-r-one real)
     (q1140119-r-natural real (- n 1)))))

(defun q1140119-horizontal-point
    (real z step index)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-r-add
    real
    (q1140119-c-re z)
    (q1140119-r-multiply
     real
     (q1140119-r-natural real index)
     step))
   (q1140119-c-im z)))

(defun q1140119-vertical-point
    (real z step index)
  (q1140119-c-make
   (q1140119-c-re z)
   (q1140119-r-add
    real
    (q1140119-c-im z)
    (q1140119-r-multiply
     real
     (q1140119-r-natural real index)
     step))))

(defun q1140119-horizontal-sum
    (real space function z step remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (q1140119-e-zero space)
    (q1140119-e-add
     space
     (q1140119-function-value
      function
      (q1140119-horizontal-point
       real z step remaining))
     (q1140119-horizontal-sum
      real space function z step (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1140119-vertical-sum
    (real space function z step remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (q1140119-e-zero space)
    (q1140119-e-add
     space
     (q1140119-function-value
      function
      (q1140119-vertical-point
       real z step remaining))
     (q1140119-vertical-sum
      real space function z step (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1140119-horizontal-riemann-sum
    (real space function z w pieces)
  (if (posp pieces)
      (let* ((denominator
              (q1140119-r-natural real pieces))
             (step
              (q1140119-r-multiply
               real
               (q1140119-r-subtract
                real
                (q1140119-c-re w)
                (q1140119-c-re z))
               (q1140119-r-inverse real denominator))))
        (q1140119-e-smul
         real space
         (q1140119-c-of-real real step)
         (q1140119-horizontal-sum
          real space function z step pieces)))
    (q1140119-e-zero space)))

(defun q1140119-vertical-riemann-sum
    (real space function z w pieces)
  (if (posp pieces)
      (let* ((denominator
              (q1140119-r-natural real pieces))
             (step
              (q1140119-r-multiply
               real
               (q1140119-r-subtract
                real
                (q1140119-c-im w)
                (q1140119-c-im z))
               (q1140119-r-inverse real denominator))))
        (q1140119-e-smul
         real space
         (q1140119-c-of-real real step)
         (q1140119-vertical-sum
          real space function z step pieces)))
    (q1140119-e-zero space)))

(defun-sk q1140119-horizontal-limit-tail-p
    (real space function z w value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (pieces)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp pieces)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff pieces))
     (q1140119-r-less
      real
      (q1140119-e-norm
       real space
       (q1140119-e-subtract
        space
        (q1140119-horizontal-riemann-sum
         real space function z w pieces)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-horizontal-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (real space function z w value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (q1140119-horizontal-limit-tail-p
      real space function z w value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1140119-horizontal-limit-p
    (real space function z w value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1140119-horizontal-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      real space function z w value epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-horizontal-limit-exists-p
    (real space function z w)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q1140119-e-member-p space value)
     (q1140119-horizontal-limit-p
      real space function z w value))))

(defun q1140119-horizontal-integral-value-p
    (real space function z w value)
  (and
   (q1140119-e-member-p space value)
   (if
       (q1140119-horizontal-limit-exists-p
        real space function z w)
       (q1140119-horizontal-limit-p
        real space function z w value)
     (equal value (q1140119-e-zero space)))))

(defun-sk q1140119-vertical-limit-tail-p
    (real space function z w value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (pieces)
    (implies
     (and
      (posp pieces)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff pieces))
     (q1140119-r-less
      real
      (q1140119-e-norm
       real space
       (q1140119-e-subtract
        space
        (q1140119-vertical-riemann-sum
         real space function z w pieces)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-vertical-limit-cutoff-exists-p
    (real space function z w value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (posp cutoff)
     (q1140119-vertical-limit-tail-p
      real space function z w value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1140119-vertical-limit-p
    (real space function z w value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1140119-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1140119-vertical-limit-cutoff-exists-p
      real space function z w value epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1140119-vertical-limit-exists-p
    (real space function z w)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q1140119-e-member-p space value)
     (q1140119-vertical-limit-p
      real space function z w value))))

(defun q1140119-vertical-integral-value-p
    (real space function z w value)
  (and
   (q1140119-e-member-p space value)
   (if
       (q1140119-vertical-limit-exists-p
        real space function z w)
       (q1140119-vertical-limit-p
        real space function z w value)
     (equal value (q1140119-e-zero space)))))

;; Rectangle z w is the product of the two unoriented closed coordinate
;; intervals. This is Mathlib's Complex.Rectangle z w.

(defun q1140119-r-between-p (real left value right)
  (or
   (and
    (q1140119-r-leq real left value)
    (q1140119-r-leq real value right))
   (and
    (q1140119-r-leq real right value)
    (q1140119-r-leq real value left))))

(defun q1140119-in-rectangle-p (real z w point)
  (and
   (q1140119-c-member-p real point)
   (q1140119-r-between-p
    real
    (q1140119-c-re z)
    (q1140119-c-re point)
    (q1140119-c-re w))
   (q1140119-r-between-p
    real
    (q1140119-c-im z)
    (q1140119-c-im point)
    (q1140119-c-im w))))

(defun-sk q1140119-rectangle-subset-p
    (real set z w)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1140119-in-rectangle-p real z w point)
     (q1140119-set-member-p set point))))

(defun q1140119-wedge-equality-for-values-p
    (real space horizontal-zw vertical-zw
          horizontal-wz vertical-wz)
  (equal
   (q1140119-e-add
    space
    horizontal-zw
    (q1140119-e-smul
     real space (q1140119-c-I real) vertical-zw))
   (q1140119-e-negate
    space
    (q1140119-e-add
     space
     horizontal-wz
     (q1140119-e-smul
      real space (q1140119-c-I real) vertical-wz)))))

(defun-sk q1140119-wedge-integrals-cancel-p
    (real space function z w)
  (exists
    (horizontal-zw vertical-zw horizontal-wz vertical-wz)
    (and
     (q1140119-horizontal-integral-value-p
      real space function z w horizontal-zw)
     (q1140119-vertical-integral-value-p
      real space function
      (q1140119-c-make
       (q1140119-c-re w)
       (q1140119-c-im z))
      w vertical-zw)
     (q1140119-horizontal-integral-value-p
      real space function w z horizontal-wz)
     (q1140119-vertical-integral-value-p
      real space function
      (q1140119-c-make
       (q1140119-c-re z)
       (q1140119-c-im w))
      z vertical-wz)
     (q1140119-wedge-equality-for-values-p
      real space
      horizontal-zw vertical-zw
      horizontal-wz vertical-wz))))

(defun-sk q1140119-is-conservative-on-p
    (real space set function)
  (forall (z w)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-c-member-p real z)
      (q1140119-c-member-p real w)
      (q1140119-rectangle-subset-p real set z w))
     (q1140119-wedge-integrals-cancel-p
      real space function z w))))

;; On every continuous edge restriction, the Riemann-limit characterization
;; above is bidirectionally equivalent to the source intervalIntegral.
;; Consequently this conjunction is exactly
;; IsConservativeOn f U /\ ContinuousOn f U, not an approximation.

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1140119-morera-s-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (real space set function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1140119-real-field-p real)
      (q1140119-complex-banach-space-p real space)
      (q1140119-valid-complex-set-p real set)
      (q1140119-function-into-space-p real space function)
      (q1140119-open-set-p real set))
     (iff
      (and
       (q1140119-is-conservative-on-p
        real space set function)
       (q1140119-continuous-on-p
        real space set function))
      (q1140119-differentiable-on-p
       real space set function)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1140119,
-- "Morera's theorem": on an open subset of the complex plane, a continuous
-- function into a complete normed complex vector space has vanishing
-- integrals around every contained rectangle exactly when it is complex
-- differentiable there. All analytic notions are defined below; this file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1140119_morera_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

oneC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
oneC reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

record ComplexNorm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    normC : Complex R -> R
    norm-nonnegativeC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normC z)
    norm-zeroC :
      normC (zeroC reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC z == zeroR reals ->
      z == zeroC reals
    norm-negateC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC (negateC reals z) == normC z
    norm-addC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normC (addC reals z w))
        (addR reals (normC z) (normC w))
    norm-multiplyC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      normC (multiplyC reals z w) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC w)
    norm-squareC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexNorm

record NormedComplexVectorSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals)
  (E : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : Complex R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneC reals) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyC reals a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addC reals a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC complexNorm a) (normE x)

open NormedComplexVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)
open CompleteOrderedField
open Complex
open ComplexNorm
open NormedComplexVectorSpace

infix 4 _<N_ _<=N_

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  succ<=succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

SetOf : Set -> Set1
SetOf A =
  A -> Set

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  SetOf A ->
  SetOf A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) ->
  P x ->
  Q x

Between :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Between reals a b x =
  Either
    (Both
      (lessOrEqualR reals a x)
      (lessOrEqualR reals x b))
    (Both
      (lessOrEqualR reals b x)
      (lessOrEqualR reals x a))

distanceC :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ComplexNorm reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
distanceC {reals = reals} complexNorm z w =
  normC complexNorm (addC reals z (negateC reals w))

OpenInComplexPlane :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ComplexNorm reals ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Set
OpenInComplexPlane {R = R} reals complexNorm U =
  (z : Complex R) ->
  U z ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((w : Complex R) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceC complexNorm w z) radius ->
          U w))

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R = R}
  reals complexNorm codomain f U point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((z : Complex R) ->
          U z ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceC complexNorm z point) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE codomain (f z) (f point))
            epsilon))

ContinuousOn :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R = R}
  reals complexNorm codomain f U =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  U point ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals complexNorm codomain f U point

DerivativeRemainderC :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  E ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  E
DerivativeRemainderC {reals = reals}
  codomain f derivative point z =
  subtractE codomain
    (subtractE codomain (f z) (f point))
    (scaleE codomain
      (addC reals z (negateC reals point))
      derivative)

HasComplexDerivativeWithinAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  E ->
  Set
HasComplexDerivativeWithinAt {R = R}
  reals complexNorm codomain f U point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((z : Complex R) ->
          U z ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceC complexNorm z point) delta ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE codomain
              (DerivativeRemainderC
                codomain f derivative point z))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceC complexNorm z point))))

DifferentiableWithinAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithinAt
  reals complexNorm codomain f U point =
  Exists _
    (HasComplexDerivativeWithinAt
      reals complexNorm codomain f U point)

DifferentiableOn :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Set
DifferentiableOn {R = R}
  reals complexNorm codomain f U =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  U point ->
  DifferentiableWithinAt
    reals complexNorm codomain f U point

SequentialLimit :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals}
  codomain sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceE codomain (sequence n) limit)
        epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals}
  codomain sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceE codomain (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Complete :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  Set
Complete {E = E} codomain =
  (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
  CauchySequence codomain sequence ->
  Exists E (\ limit -> SequentialLimit codomain sequence limit)

TaggedPartition :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
TaggedPartition reals lower upper count nodes tags =
  Both
    (nodes zero == lower)
    (Both
      (nodes count == upper)
      (Both
        ((k : Nat) ->
          k <N count ->
          StrictLess reals (nodes k) (nodes (suc k)))
        ((k : Nat) ->
          k <N count ->
          Both
            (lessOrEqualR reals (nodes k) (tags k))
            (lessOrEqualR reals (tags k) (nodes (suc k))))))

PartitionMeshBelow :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {lower upper : R} ->
  {count : Nat} ->
  {nodes tags : Nat -> R} ->
  TaggedPartition reals lower upper count nodes tags ->
  R ->
  Set
PartitionMeshBelow reals {count = count} {nodes = nodes}
  partition delta =
  (k : Nat) ->
  k <N count ->
  StrictLess reals
    (addR reals
      (nodes (suc k))
      (negateR reals (nodes k)))
    delta

riemannSumE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (R -> E) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  E
riemannSumE reals codomain integrand nodes tags zero =
  zeroE codomain
riemannSumE reals codomain integrand nodes tags (suc n) =
  addE codomain
    (riemannSumE reals codomain integrand nodes tags n)
    (scaleE codomain
      (complex
        (addR reals
          (nodes (suc n))
          (negateR reals (nodes n)))
        (zeroR reals))
      (integrand (tags n)))

RiemannIntegralIncreasing :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (R -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
RiemannIntegralIncreasing {R = R}
  reals codomain lower upper integrand value =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((count : Nat) ->
          (nodes tags : Nat -> R) ->
          (partition :
            TaggedPartition
              reals lower upper count nodes tags) ->
          PartitionMeshBelow reals partition delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE codomain
              (riemannSumE
                reals codomain integrand nodes tags count)
              value)
            epsilon))

data OrientedRiemannIntegralValue
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals}
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E)
  (lower upper : R)
  (integrand : R -> E)
  (value : E) : Set where
  forwardIntegral :
    lessOrEqualR reals lower upper ->
    RiemannIntegralIncreasing
      reals codomain lower upper integrand value ->
    OrientedRiemannIntegralValue
      reals codomain lower upper integrand value
  backwardIntegral :
    lessOrEqualR reals upper lower ->
    RiemannIntegralIncreasing
      reals codomain upper lower integrand
      (negateE codomain value) ->
    OrientedRiemannIntegralValue
      reals codomain lower upper integrand value

RectangleSubset :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Set
RectangleSubset reals z w U =
  (x y : _) ->
