  Between reals (realPart z) (realPart w) x ->
  Between reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w) y ->
  U (complex x y)

record WedgeIntegralValue
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals}
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E)
  (z w : Complex R)
  (f : Complex R -> E)
  (value : E) : Set where
  field
    horizontalValue verticalValue : E
    horizontalIntegral :
      OrientedRiemannIntegralValue
        reals codomain
        (realPart z) (realPart w)
        (\ x -> f (complex x (imaginaryPart z)))
        horizontalValue
    verticalIntegral :
      OrientedRiemannIntegralValue
        reals codomain
        (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart w)
        (\ y -> f (complex (realPart w) y))
        verticalValue
    combines :
      value ==
      addE codomain horizontalValue
        (scaleE codomain
          (complex (zeroR reals) (oneR reals))
          verticalValue)

IsConservativeOn :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Set
IsConservativeOn {E = E}
  reals complexNorm codomain f U =
  (z w : _) ->
  RectangleSubset reals z w U ->
  Exists E
    (\ forwardValue ->
      Both
        (WedgeIntegralValue
          reals codomain z w f forwardValue)
        (Exists E
          (\ reverseValue ->
            Both
              (WedgeIntegralValue
                reals codomain w z f reverseValue)
              (forwardValue ==
                negateE codomain reverseValue))))

morera-theorem : Set2
morera-theorem =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  Complete codomain ->
  (U : SetOf (Complex R)) ->
  OpenInComplexPlane reals complexNorm U ->
  (f : Complex R -> E) ->
  Iff
    (Both
      (IsConservativeOn reals complexNorm codomain f U)
      (ContinuousOn reals complexNorm codomain f U))
    (DifferentiableOn reals complexNorm codomain f U)

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1140119 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1140119), "Morera's theorem": on an
  open subset of the complex plane, a function into a complete complex
  normed space is continuous with zero integral around every axis-parallel
  rectangle exactly when it is complex differentiable there. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory complexTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q1140119_normed_complex_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_normed_complex_space_def",
  ``q1140119_normed_complex_space
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      (!x. smulE 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (a * b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (a + b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE 0 x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x. negE x = smulE (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x. (normE x = 0) <=> (x = zeroE)) /\
      (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = modu a * normE x)``);

val q1140119_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_tendsto_def",
  ``q1140119_tendsto
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==>
          normE (addE (u n) (negE x)) < epsilon``);

val q1140119_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_cauchy_def",
  ``q1140119_cauchy
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          normE (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q1140119_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_complete_def",
  ``q1140119_complete
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q1140119_cauchy addE negE normE u ==>
        ?x : 'e. q1140119_tendsto addE negE normE u x``);

val q1140119_measurable_simple_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_measurable_simple_on_def",
  ``q1140119_measurable_simple_on
      (s : real set) (phi : real -> 'e) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE phi s) /\
      !y : 'e. {x | x IN s /\ phi x = y} IN measurable_sets lborel``);

val q1140119_strongly_measurable_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_strongly_measurable_on_def",
  ``q1140119_strongly_measurable_on
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (s : real set) (f : real -> 'e) <=>
      ?phi : num -> real -> 'e.
        (!n. q1140119_measurable_simple_on s (phi n)) /\
        !x. x IN s ==>
          q1140119_tendsto addE negE normE (\n. phi n x) (f x)``);

val q1140119_bochner_integrable_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_bochner_integrable_on_def",
  ``q1140119_bochner_integrable_on
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (s : real set) (f : real -> 'e) <=>
      ?g : real -> 'e.
        q1140119_strongly_measurable_on addE negE normE s g /\
        integrable lborel
          (Normal o (\x. if x IN s then normE (g x) else 0)) /\
        (AE x::lborel. x IN s ==> f x = g x)``);

val q1140119_simple_integral_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_simple_integral_on_def",
  ``q1140119_simple_integral_on
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (s : real set) (phi : real -> 'e) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          addE
            (smulE
              (complex_of_real
                (real (measure lborel {x | x IN s /\ phi x = y}))) y)
            acc)
        (IMAGE phi s) zeroE``);

val q1140119_bochner_approximates_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_bochner_approximates_on_def",
  ``q1140119_bochner_approximates_on
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'e)
      (phi : num -> real -> 'e) (ell : 'e) <=>
      ?g : real -> 'e.
        q1140119_strongly_measurable_on addE negE normE s g /\
        integrable lborel
          (Normal o (\x. if x IN s then normE (g x) else 0)) /\
        (AE x::lborel. x IN s ==> f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q1140119_measurable_simple_on s (phi n)) /\
        (!n.
          integrable lborel
            (Normal o (\x. if x IN s then normE (phi n x) else 0))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable lborel
            (Normal o
              (\x.
                if x IN s
                then normE (addE (phi n x) (negE (g x)))
                else 0))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral lborel
                (Normal o
                  (\x.
                    if x IN s
                    then normE (addE (phi n x) (negE (g x)))
                    else 0)))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q1140119_tendsto addE negE normE
          (\n. q1140119_simple_integral_on zeroE addE smulE s (phi n))
          ell``);

val q1140119_bochner_integral_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_bochner_integral_on_def",
  ``q1140119_bochner_integral_on
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'e) =
      if q1140119_complete addE negE normE /\
         q1140119_bochner_integrable_on addE negE normE s f
      then
        @ell.
          ?phi : num -> real -> 'e.
            q1140119_bochner_approximates_on
              zeroE addE negE smulE normE s f phi ell
      else
        zeroE``);

val q1140119_interval_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_interval_integral_def",
  ``q1140119_interval_integral
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : real -> 'e) (a : real) (b : real) =
      if a <= b
      then
        q1140119_bochner_integral_on
          zeroE addE negE smulE normE (interval (a,b)) f
      else
        negE
          (q1140119_bochner_integral_on
            zeroE addE negE smulE normE (interval (b,a)) f)``);

val q1140119_rectangle_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_rectangle_def",
  ``q1140119_rectangle (z : complex) (w : complex) (u : complex) <=>
      ((RE z <= RE u /\ RE u <= RE w) \/
       (RE w <= RE u /\ RE u <= RE z)) /\
      ((IM z <= IM u /\ IM u <= IM w) \/
       (IM w <= IM u /\ IM u <= IM z))``);

val q1140119_wedge_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_wedge_integral_def",
  ``q1140119_wedge_integral
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (z : complex) (w : complex) (f : complex -> 'e) =
      addE
        (q1140119_interval_integral
          zeroE addE negE smulE normE
          (\x. f (complex_of_real x + complex_of_real (IM z) * i))
          (RE z) (RE w))
        (smulE i
          (q1140119_interval_integral
            zeroE addE negE smulE normE
            (\y. f (complex_of_real (RE w) + complex_of_real y * i))
            (IM z) (IM w)))``);

val q1140119_is_conservative_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_is_conservative_on_def",
  ``q1140119_is_conservative_on
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (U : complex set) <=>
      !z w : complex.
        (!u. q1140119_rectangle z w u ==> u IN U) ==>
        q1140119_wedge_integral
          zeroE addE negE smulE normE z w f =
        negE
          (q1140119_wedge_integral
            zeroE addE negE smulE normE w z f)``);

val q1140119_is_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_is_open_def",
  ``q1140119_is_open (U : complex set) <=>
      !x : complex.
        x IN U ==>
        ?radius : real.
          0 < radius /\
          !y : complex. modu (y - x) < radius ==> y IN U``);

val q1140119_continuous_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_continuous_on_def",
  ``q1140119_continuous_on
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e) (U : complex set) <=>
      !x : complex.
        x IN U ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y : complex.
              y IN U /\ modu (y - x) < delta ==>
              normE (addE (f y) (negE (f x))) < epsilon``);

val q1140119_bounded_complex_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_bounded_complex_linear_def",
  ``q1140119_bounded_complex_linear
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (L : complex -> 'e) <=>
      (!z w. L (z + w) = addE (L z) (L w)) /\
      (!a z. L (a * z) = smulE a (L z)) /\
      ?C : real. 0 <= C /\ !z. normE (L z) <= C * modu z``);

val q1140119_differentiable_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1140119_differentiable_on_def",
  ``q1140119_differentiable_on
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (U : complex set) <=>
      !x : complex.
        x IN U ==>
        ?L : complex -> 'e.
          q1140119_bounded_complex_linear addE smulE normE L /\
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !y : complex.
                y IN U /\
                0 < modu (y - x) /\ modu (y - x) < delta
                ==>
                normE
                  (addE
                    (addE (f y) (negE (f x)))
                    (negE (L (y - x)))) <
                epsilon * modu (y - x)``);

val isConservativeOn_and_continuousOn_iff_isDifferentiableOn =
  ``!(zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e) (U : complex set).
      q1140119_normed_complex_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q1140119_complete addE negE normE /\
      q1140119_is_open U
      ==>
      (q1140119_is_conservative_on
          zeroE addE negE smulE normE f U /\
       q1140119_continuous_on addE negE normE f U
       <=>
       q1140119_differentiable_on addE negE smulE normE f U)``;

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1140119
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1140119), "Morera's theorem": for a function
  from the complex numbers to an arbitrary complete complex normed vector
  space on an open set, vanishing oriented integrals around every
  axis-parallel rectangle together with continuity is equivalent to complex
  differentiability on that set. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1140119Rectangle is the closed axis-parallel rectangle with opposite
  corners z and w. Q1140119FunctionIntegrable encodes almost-everywhere
  strong measurability and finite L1 norm. Q1140119HasIntegral defines the
  Banach-valued Bochner integral by L1-approximation with measurable
  finite-range functions, and Q1140119Integral is its directed totalization.
  Q1140119WedgeIntegral is exactly the source wedge integral: first along the
  horizontal segment from z to w.re + z.im*i, then along the vertical segment
  to w.

  Q1140119ConservativeOn states that for every rectangle contained in U, the
  wedge integral from z to w is the negative of the reverse wedge integral.
  Q1140119ContinuousOn is relative epsilon-delta continuity.
  Q1140119HasComplexDerivWithinAt uses the equivalent one-dimensional
  complex Frechet remainder estimate, and Q1140119DifferentiableOn
  existentially quantifies that derivative at every point of U.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies over arbitrary complete SetMM
  complex normed vector spaces, total functions on CC, and open subsets of
  CC. Every preceding $a declaration is syntax or an explicit faithful
  definition; this root artifact has no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1140119Sub Q1140119Restrict Q1140119Tendsto Q1140119AEStrong
   Q1140119Simple Q1140119SimpleIntegral Q1140119LIntegral
   Q1140119Diff Q1140119L1Distance Q1140119FunctionIntegrable
   Q1140119HasIntegral Q1140119TotalIntegral Q1140119Integral
   Q1140119Rectangle Q1140119WedgeIntegral Q1140119ConservativeOn
   Q1140119ContinuousOn Q1140119HasComplexDerivWithinAt
   Q1140119DifferentiableOn $.

  $a class ( Q1140119Sub W x y ) $.
q1140119-restrict-syntax

${
  $d W x y $.

  q1140119-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119Sub W x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` W )
    ( ( -g ` W ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B H W t $.

  q1140119-restrict-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119Restrict W H A B
  ) = (
    t e. RR |->
    if (
      t e. ( A (,) B ) ,
      ( H ` t ) ,
      ( 0g ` W )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C S W $.

  q1140119-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119Tendsto W S C )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) C
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N S W n x $.

  q1140119-aestrong-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119AEStrong M W H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( S ` n )
                e. ( dom M MblFnM ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) )
              /\
              ran ( S ` n ) e. Fin
            )
          /\
          E. N e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` N ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                (
                  Q1140119Tendsto
                  W
                  ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( S ` n ) ` x ) )
                  ( H ` x )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q1140119-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q1140119-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q1140119-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q1140119Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q1140119SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1140119-diff-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119Diff M W H K
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      (
        ( H ` x )
        ( +g ` W )
        ( ( -g ` W ) ` ( K ` x ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1140119-l1-distance-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119L1Distance M W H K
  ) =
    (
      Q1140119LIntegral
      M
      ( x e. U. dom M |->
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          `
          ( ( Q1140119Diff M W H K ) ` x )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M W x $.

  q1140119-function-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119FunctionIntegrable M W H )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1140119AEStrong M W H )
      /\
      (
        Q1140119LIntegral
        M
        ( x e. U. dom M |->
          ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( H ` x ) )
        )
      )
      < +oo
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M S W n y $.

  q1140119-has-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119HasIntegral M W H y )
    <->
    (
      y e. ( Base ` W )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            ( ( S ` n ) e. dom ( W sitg M ) )
          /\
          (
            Q1140119Tendsto
            ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
            ( n e. NN0 |->
              ( Q1140119L1Distance M W H ( S ` n ) ) )
            0
            /\
            Q1140119Tendsto
            W
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( W sitg M ) ` ( S ` n ) ) )
            y
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H W y $.

  q1140119-total-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119TotalIntegral W H
  ) = if (
    (
      W e. CMetSp
      /\
      ( Q1140119FunctionIntegrable vol W H )
    ) ,
    (
      iota_ y e. ( Base ` W )
        ( Q1140119HasIntegral vol W H y )
    ) ,
    ( 0g ` W )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B H W $.

  q1140119-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119Integral W H A B
  ) = if (
    A <_ B ,
    (
      Q1140119TotalIntegral
      W
      ( Q1140119Restrict W H A B )
    ) ,
    (
      ( -g ` W )
      `
      (
        Q1140119TotalIntegral
        W
        ( Q1140119Restrict W H B A )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d u w z $.

  q1140119-rectangle-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119Rectangle z w
  ) = {
    u e. CC |
      (
        (
          (
            ( Re ` z ) <_ ( Re ` u )
            /\
            ( Re ` u ) <_ ( Re ` w )
          )
          \/
          (
            ( Re ` w ) <_ ( Re ` u )
            /\
            ( Re ` u ) <_ ( Re ` z )
          )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( Im ` z ) <_ ( Im ` u )
            /\
            ( Im ` u ) <_ ( Im ` w )
          )
          \/
          (
            ( Im ` w ) <_ ( Im ` u )
            /\
            ( Im ` u ) <_ ( Im ` z )
          )
        )
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d F W t w x y z $.

  q1140119-wedge-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1140119WedgeIntegral W F z w
  ) = (
    (
      Q1140119Integral
      W
      (
        x e. RR |->
        (
          F
          `
          (
            x
            +
            ( ( Im ` z ) x. _i )
          )
        )
      )
      ( Re ` z )
      ( Re ` w )
    )
    ( +g ` W )
    (
      _i
      ( .s ` W )
      (
        Q1140119Integral
        W
        (
          y e. RR |->
          (
            F
            `
            (
              ( Re ` w )
              +
              ( y x. _i )
            )
          )
        )
        ( Im ` z )
        ( Im ` w )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F U W w z $.

  q1140119-conservative-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119ConservativeOn W F U )
    <->
    A. z e. CC
      A. w e. CC
        (
          ( Q1140119Rectangle z w ) C_ U
          ->
          (
            Q1140119WedgeIntegral W F z w
          )
          =
          (
            ( -g ` W )
            `
            ( Q1140119WedgeIntegral W F w z )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F U W d e x y $.

  q1140119-continuous-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119ContinuousOn W F U )
    <->
    A. x e. U
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. U
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  ( Q1140119Sub W ( F ` y ) ( F ` x ) )
                )
                <
                e
              )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D F U W d e x y $.

  q1140119-has-complex-deriv-within-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F U x D )
    <->
    (
      D e. ( Base ` W )
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. U
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  (
                    Q1140119Sub
                    W
                    ( Q1140119Sub W ( F ` y ) ( F ` x ) )
                    ( ( y - x ) ( .s ` W ) D )
                  )
                )
                <_
                ( e x. ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) )
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D F U W x $.

  q1140119-differentiable-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1140119DifferentiableOn W F U )
    <->
    A. x e. U
      E. D e. ( Base ` W )
        ( Q1140119HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F U x D )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F U W v $.

  thousand-theorems-q1140119-morera $a |-
    A. W e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = CCfld }
      A. F e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m CC )
        A. U e. ~P CC
          (
            (
              W e. CMetSp
              /\
              U e. ( TopOpen ` CCfld )
            )
            ->
            (
              (
                ( Q1140119ConservativeOn W F U )
                /\
                ( Q1140119ContinuousOn W F U )
              )
              <->
              ( Q1140119DifferentiableOn W F U )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1140119
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q1140119), "Morera's theorem": on an open
:: subset of the complex plane, a continuous function into a complete complex
:: normed space has zero integral around every contained axis-parallel
:: rectangle exactly when it is complex differentiable there. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, ZFMISC_1, XCMPLX_0, FUNCOP_1,
      SUBSET_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, PARTFUN1, CLVECT_1, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1,
      LOPBAN_1, SUPINF_2, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, COMPLEX1, ALGSTR_0, MONOID_0,
      TARSKI, MSSUBFAM, UNIALG_1, RLSUB_1, RSSPACE, NAT_1, PRE_TOPC, SEQ_2,
      ORDINAL2, NORMSP_1, XXREAL_0, CARD_1, REAL_1, XXREAL_2, SEQ_4,
      REWRITE1, RSSPACE3, SEQ_1, VALUED_1, CLOPBAN1, METRIC_1, RELAT_2,
      FCONT_1, ASYMPT_1, FINSEQ_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCT_3, PRE_TOPC, DOMAIN_1, FUNCOP_1, BINOP_1,
      XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, ORDINAL1,
      NAT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, MONOID_0, NUMBERS, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0,
      NORMSP_1, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, FUNCSDOM, CLVECT_1,
      CSSPACE, CSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1, VECTSP_1, CLOPBAN1, FINSEQ_1;
 constructors DOMAIN_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, FUNCSDOM, MONOID_0, LOPBAN_1,
      CSSPACE3, SEQ_4, RELSET_1, BINOP_2, SEQ_2, COMSEQ_2, FUNCT_3,
      SEQ_1, CLOPBAN1, FINSEQ_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, MONOID_0, CLVECT_1,
      CSSPACE3, VALUED_1, VALUED_0, SEQ_4, FUNCT_1, NAT_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2,
      CLOPBAN1, FINSEQ_1;
 requirements SUBSET, REAL, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
 definitions FUNCT_1, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1, XXREAL_2;
 equalities BINOP_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, NORMSP_0;
 expansions FUNCT_1, BINOP_1, NORMSP_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for E being ComplexNormSpace,
      f being Function of COMPLEX,the carrier of E,
      U being Subset of COMPLEX,
      J being Relation st
    E is complete &
    (for z being Complex st z in U holds
      ex r being Real st
        0 < r &
        for w being Complex st |.w-z.| < r holds w in U) &
    (for g being Function of REAL,the carrier of E,
         a,b being Real, y being Point of E holds
      [[g,[a,b]],y] in J iff
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for p,t being FinSequence of REAL st
              2 <= len p &
              p.1 = 0 & p.(len p) = 1 &
              len t + 1 = len p &
              (for i being Nat st 1 <= i & i < len p holds
                p.i < p.(i+1) &
                p.(i+1)-p.i < delta &
                p.i <= t.i & t.i <= p.(i+1))
            holds
              ex s being sequence of E st
                s.0 = 0.E &
                (for i being Nat st i < len t holds
                  ex v being Point of E st
                    v = g.(a+t.(i+1)*(b-a)) &
                    s.(i+1) =
                      s.i +
                      (((p.(i+2)-p.(i+1))*(b-a)) qua Complex)*v) &
                ||.s.(len t)-y.|| < epsilon)
  holds
    (((for z,w being Complex st
        (for q being Complex st
          min(Re z,Re w) <= Re q & Re q <= max(Re z,Re w) &
          min(Im z,Im w) <= Im q & Im q <= max(Im z,Im w)
        holds q in U)
      holds
        ex g1,g2,g3,g4 being Function of REAL,the carrier of E,
           y1,y2,y3,y4 being Point of E st
          (for t being Real holds
            g1.t = f.(t+(Im z)*<i>) &
            g2.t = f.((Re w)+t*<i>) &
            g3.t = f.(t+(Im w)*<i>) &
            g4.t = f.((Re z)+t*<i>)) &
          [[g1,[Re z,Re w]],y1] in J &
          [[g2,[Im z,Im w]],y2] in J &
          [[g3,[Re w,Re z]],y3] in J &
          [[g4,[Im w,Im z]],y4] in J &
          y1 + <i>*y2 = -(y3 + <i>*y4)) &
      (for z being Complex st z in U holds
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for w being Complex st w in U & |.w-z.| < delta holds
              ex fw,fz being Point of E st
                fw = f.w & fz = f.z &
                ||.fw-fz.|| < epsilon))
    iff
      for z being Complex st z in U holds
        ex d being Point of E st
          for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
            ex delta being Real st
              0 < delta &
              for w being Complex st
                w in U & 0 < |.w-z.| & |.w-z.| < delta
              holds
                ex fw,fz being Point of E st
                  fw = f.w & fz = f.z &
                  ||.fw-fz-(w-z)*d.|| < epsilon*|.w-z.|)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1140119_morera_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1140119,
% "Morera's theorem": on an open subset of the complex plane, continuity
% together with vanishing exact Lebesgue-Bochner integrals around every
% contained axis-aligned rectangle is equivalent to complex differentiability
% for functions into a complete complex normed vector space. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1140119_morera_s_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  cscaleE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_set: TYPE = [complex -> bool]
  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> E]
  linear_candidate: TYPE = [complex -> E]

  event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  e_function: TYPE = [real -> E]
  e_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_function]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [real -> measure_value]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_i: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 1 #)

  make_complex(x, y: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := y #)

  complex_add(z, w: complex): complex =
    make_complex(
      real_part(z) + real_part(w),
      imag_part(z) + imag_part(w))

  complex_neg(z: complex): complex =
    make_complex(-real_part(z), -imag_part(z))

  complex_sub(z, w: complex): complex =
    complex_add(z, complex_neg(w))

  complex_mul(z, w: complex): complex =
    make_complex(
      real_part(z) * real_part(w)
        - imag_part(z) * imag_part(w),
      real_part(z) * imag_part(w)
        + imag_part(z) * real_part(w))

  complex_norm_squared(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) * real_part(z)
      + imag_part(z) * imag_part(z)

  distanceC_squared(z, w: complex): real =
    complex_norm_squared(complex_sub(z, w))

  smulE(scalar: complex, x: E): E =
    cscaleE(real_part(scalar), imag_part(scalar), x)

  real_smulE(scalar: real, x: E): E =
    cscaleE(scalar, 0, x)

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  normed_complex_vector_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_add(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_mul(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_zero, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        (normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) * normE(smulE(a, x)) =
          complex_norm_squared(a) * normE(x) * normE(x))

  converges_to_e(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_e(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index
            AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_E: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_e(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges_to_e(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      0 <= finite_part(value)
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): NOT A(x)

  countable_union(sets: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        sets(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(sets: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x)
            AND sets(right_index)(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      sets: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x)
            AND sets(right_index)(x))

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          Sigma(sets(index)))
        IMPLIES
          Sigma(countable_union(sets)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            Sigma(sets(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(sets))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              M(sets(index)),
            M(countable_union(sets))))

  open_real_set(A: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: real):
            abs(y - x) < radius IMPLIES
              A(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        open_real_set(A) IMPLIES
          Sigma(A))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (A: event):
            open_real_set(A) IMPLIES
              Other(A)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (A: event):
            Sigma(A) IMPLIES
              Other(A))

  open_closed_interval(a, b: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      a < x AND x <= b

  real_volume_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
      AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real):
        a <= b IMPLIES
          M(open_closed_interval(a, b)) =
            finite_measure_value(b - a))

  finite_e_sum(
      values: e_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_e_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_e_value(
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): E =
    finite_e_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count
            AND pieces(index)(x) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroE
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_e_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_e(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: e_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_e_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          function_value(x) =
            finite_simple_e_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(x))

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, x),
          function_value(x)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma,
          function_value,
          coefficients,
          pieces,
          count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_e(function_value: e_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      finite_measure_value(normE(function_value(x)))

  integrable_simple_e_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_e_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroE
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_e_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_simple_e_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        real_smulE(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_e_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: e_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_e_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          function_value(x) =
            finite_simple_e_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_e_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: e_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    0 <= error_value
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_e(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            subE(
              function_value(x),
              approximant(x))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      approximants: e_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_e(
        Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: e_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: e_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_e_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_e(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: E):
      has_bochner_integral(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): E =
    IF bochner_integrable(
        M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: E):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroE
    ENDIF

  restrict_e_function(
      function_value: e_function,
      A: event): e_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      IF A(x) THEN
        function_value(x)
      ELSE
        zeroE
      ENDIF

  interval_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      a, b: real): E =
    subE(
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        restrict_e_function(
          function_value,
          open_closed_interval(a, b))),
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        restrict_e_function(
          function_value,
          open_closed_interval(b, a))))

  open_complex_set(U: complex_set): bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      U(z) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (w: complex):
            distanceC_squared(w, z)
                < radius * radius
              IMPLIES
                U(w)

  continuous_on(
      f: complex_function,
      U: complex_set): bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      U(z) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (w: complex):
              (U(w)
                AND distanceC_squared(w, z)
                  < radius * radius)
              IMPLIES
                normE(subE(f(w), f(z)))
                  < epsilon_value

  bounded_complex_linear_map(
      L: linear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (z, w: complex):
      L(complex_add(z, w)) =
        addE(L(z), L(w)))
      AND (FORALL (a, z: complex):
        L(complex_mul(a, z)) =
          smulE(a, L(z)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
        FORALL (z: complex):
          normE(L(z)) * normE(L(z))
            <= bound * bound
              * complex_norm_squared(z)

  has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
      f: complex_function,
      L: linear_candidate,
      U: complex_set,
      z: complex): bool =
    bounded_complex_linear_map(L)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (w: complex):
            (U(w)
              AND distanceC_squared(w, z)
                < radius * radius)
            IMPLIES
              normE(
                subE(
                  subE(f(w), f(z)),
                  L(complex_sub(w, z))))
                * normE(
                    subE(
                      subE(f(w), f(z)),
                      L(complex_sub(w, z))))
              <= epsilon_value * epsilon_value
                   * distanceC_squared(w, z)

  differentiable_on(
      f: complex_function,
      U: complex_set): bool =
    FORALL (z: complex):
      U(z) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (L: linear_candidate):
          has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
            f, L, U, z)

  between(
      value,
      endpoint_one,
      endpoint_two: real): bool =
    (endpoint_one <= value
      AND value <= endpoint_two)
      OR (endpoint_two <= value
        AND value <= endpoint_one)

  rectangle_contains(
      z, w, point: complex): bool =
    between(
      real_part(point),
      real_part(z),
      real_part(w))

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1144897), "Brouwer fixed-point theorem": every

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1144897_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q1144897_normed_real_vector_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q1144897_zero : V;
  q1144897_add : V -> V -> V;
  q1144897_neg : V -> V;
  q1144897_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q1144897_norm : V -> R;
  q1144897_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1144897_add x (q1144897_add y z) =
      q1144897_add (q1144897_add x y) z;
  q1144897_add_comm :
    forall x y : V,
      q1144897_add x y = q1144897_add y x;
  q1144897_zero_add :
    forall x : V, q1144897_add q1144897_zero x = x;
  q1144897_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q1144897_add x q1144897_zero = x;
  q1144897_neg_add :
    forall x : V,
      q1144897_add (q1144897_neg x) x = q1144897_zero;
  q1144897_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q1144897_add x (q1144897_neg x) = q1144897_zero;
  q1144897_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q1144897_smul 1 x = x;
  q1144897_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1144897_smul (a * b) x =
      q1144897_smul a (q1144897_smul b x);
  q1144897_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1144897_smul (a + b) x =
      q1144897_add
        (q1144897_smul a x) (q1144897_smul b x);
  q1144897_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1144897_smul a (q1144897_add x y) =
      q1144897_add
        (q1144897_smul a x) (q1144897_smul a y);
  q1144897_zero_smul :
    forall x : V, q1144897_smul 0 x = q1144897_zero;
  q1144897_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1144897_smul a q1144897_zero = q1144897_zero;
  q1144897_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q1144897_norm x;
  q1144897_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,

    forall x y : V,

      q1144897_norm x + q1144897_norm y;

    forall (a : R) (x : V),

      Rabs a * q1144897_norm x

Arguments q1144897_zero {V} _.
Arguments q1144897_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1144897_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q1144897_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1144897_norm {V} _ _.

Definition q1144897_sub {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (x y : V) : V :=
  q1144897_add N x (q1144897_neg N y).

Fixpoint q1144897_vector_sum
    {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> V) -> V :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> V) -> V with
  | O => fun _ => q1144897_zero N
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q1144897_add N
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1144897_vector_sum V N k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q1144897_vector_sum {V} N n _.

Definition q1144897_finite_dimensional
    {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V) : Prop :=
  exists (n : nat) (basis : Fin.t n -> V),
    (forall x : V,
      exists coefficients : Fin.t n -> R,
        x =
        q1144897_vector_sum N n
          (fun i =>
            q1144897_smul N
              (coefficients i) (basis i))) /\
    (forall coefficients : Fin.t n -> R,
      q1144897_vector_sum N n
        (fun i =>
          q1144897_smul N
            (coefficients i) (basis i)) =
      q1144897_zero N ->
      forall i : Fin.t n, coefficients i = 0).

Definition q1144897_convex
    {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (S : q1144897_set V) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : V) (t : R),
    S x ->
    S y ->
    0 <= t ->
    t <= 1 ->
    S
      (q1144897_add N
        (q1144897_smul N t x)
        (q1144897_smul N (1 - t) y)).

Definition q1144897_norm_open
    {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (U : q1144897_set V) : Prop :=
  forall x : V,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : V,
        q1144897_norm N (q1144897_sub N y x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q1144897_compact
    {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (S : q1144897_set V) : Prop :=
  forall (J : Type) (U : J -> q1144897_set V),
    (forall j : J, q1144897_norm_open N (U j)) ->
    (forall x : V, S x -> exists j : J, U j x) ->
    exists finite_subcover : list J,
      forall x : V,
        S x ->
        exists j : J, In j finite_subcover /\ U j x.

Record q1144897_member
    {V : Type}
    (S : q1144897_set V) : Type := {
  q1144897_value : V;
  q1144897_value_mem : S q1144897_value
}.

Arguments q1144897_value {V S} _.

Definition q1144897_continuous_self_map
    {V : Type}
    (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (S : q1144897_set V)
    (f : q1144897_member S -> q1144897_member S) : Prop :=
  forall (x : q1144897_member S) (epsilon : R),
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : q1144897_member S,
        q1144897_norm N
          (q1144897_sub N
            (q1144897_value y) (q1144897_value x)) < delta ->
        q1144897_norm N
          (q1144897_sub N
            (q1144897_value (f y))
            (q1144897_value (f x))) < epsilon.

Arguments q1144897_continuous_self_map {V} N S f.

Theorem brouwer_fixed_point :
  forall (V : Type)
         (N : q1144897_normed_real_vector_space V),
    q1144897_finite_dimensional N ->
    forall S : q1144897_set V,
      q1144897_convex N S ->
      q1144897_compact N S ->
      (exists x : V, S x) ->
      forall f : q1144897_member S -> q1144897_member S,
        q1144897_continuous_self_map N S f ->
        exists x : q1144897_member S, f x = x.
Proof.
Admitted.

let Q1144897_BROUWER_FIXED_POINT_THEOREM =
  `let real_normed_vector_space =
     \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
      (smul:real->V->V) (norm:V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
       (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:V. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!a:real. !x:V. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
       (!x y:V. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let finite_linear_combination =
     \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
      (n:num) (basis:num->V) (coeff:num->real) (x:V).
       ?partial:num->V.
         partial 0 = zero /\
         (!i:num.
            i < n
            ==> partial (SUC i) =
                add (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
         partial n = x in
   let finite_dimensional =
     \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
       ?n:num. ?basis:num->V.
         !x:V.
           ?coeff:num->real.
             finite_linear_combination
               zero add smul n basis coeff x in
   let open_set =
     \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (norm:V->real)
      (u:V->bool).
       !x:V.
         x IN u
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:V.
                 norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon
                 ==> y IN u in
   let compact_set =
     \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (norm:V->real)
      (s:V->bool).
       !cover:(V->bool)->bool.
         (!u:V->bool. u IN cover ==> open_set add neg norm u) /\
         s SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?subcover:(V->bool)->bool.
               subcover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE subcover /\
               s SUBSET UNIONS subcover in
   let convex_set =
     \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V) (s:V->bool).
       !x y:V. !a b:real.
         x IN s /\
         y IN s /\
         &0 <= a /\
         &0 <= b /\
         a + b = &1
         ==> add (smul a x) (smul b y) IN s in
   let continuous_on =
     \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (norm:V->real)
      (f:V->V) (s:V->bool).
       !x:V.
         x IN s
         ==> !epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !y:V.
                       y IN s /\
                       norm (add y (neg x)) < delta
                       ==> norm (add (f y) (neg (f x))) < epsilon in
   !zero:V.
   !add:V->V->V.
   !neg:V->V.
   !smul:real->V->V.
   !norm:V->real.
   !s:V->bool.
   !f:V->V.
     real_normed_vector_space zero add neg smul norm /\
     finite_dimensional zero add smul /\
     convex_set add smul s /\
     compact_set add neg norm s /\
     (?x:V. x IN s) /\
     continuous_on add neg norm f s /\
     (!x:V. x IN s ==> f x IN s)
     ==> ?x:V. x IN s /\ f x = x`;;

(defun q1144897-vector-laws-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply

     'lambda
     '(a b x y z)
     (q1144897-implies-term
      (q1144897-and-terms
       (list
        (q1144897-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(a))
        (q1144897-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(b))

        (q1144897-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1144897-and-terms

        (q1144897-static-apply-term carrier (list xy))
        (q1144897-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q1144897-static-apply-term carrier (list a-x))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term add (list xy 'z))
         (q1144897-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy
         (q1144897-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x (q1144897-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
         (q1144897-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list (q1144897-quoted scalar-one) 'x))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           (q1144897-static-apply-term
            scalar-multiply
            '(a b))
           'x))
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           'a
           (q1144897-static-apply-term smul '(b x)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           (q1144897-static-apply-term scalar-add '(a b))
           'x))
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           a-x
           (q1144897-static-apply-term smul '(b x)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term smul (list 'a xy))
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           a-x
           (q1144897-static-apply-term smul '(a y)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1144897-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list (q1144897-quoted scalar-zero) 'x))
         (q1144897-quoted zero))))))))

            (q1144897-static-apply-term smul '(a x)))))

title: Q1144897_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1144897,
-- "Brouwer fixed-point theorem": every continuous self-map of a nonempty
-- compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real normed vector space has
-- a fixed point. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1144897_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} →
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real line.
record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R →
      R →
      R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R →
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R →
      R →
      Set r

    fromNatR :
      Nat →
      R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡ multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zeroR →
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y z →
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y x →
      x ≡ y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) →
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR × zeroR ≠ oneR

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      absoluteR x ≡ x

    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR →
      absoluteR x ≡ negateR x

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero ≡ zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (suc n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n →
      m ≡ n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat (λ n → lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R → Set r) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R (λ upper → (x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqualR x upper) →
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

StrictLessR :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RealLine R →
  R →
  R →
  Set r
StrictLessR reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y × x ≠ y

record RealVectorSpace
  {r v : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (V : Set v) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    zeroV :
      V

    addV :
      V →
      V →
      V

    negateV :
      V →
      V

    scaleV :
      R →
      V →
      V

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) →
      addV x y ≡ addV y x

    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) →
      addV (addV x y) z ≡ addV x (addV y z)

    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) →
      addV x zeroV ≡ x

    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) →
      addV x (negateV x) ≡ zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) →
      scaleV (oneR reals) x ≡ x

    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : R) →
      (x : V) →
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) x ≡ scaleV a (scaleV b x)

    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : R) →
      (x y : V) →
      scaleV a (addV x y) ≡ addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)

    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : R) →
      (x : V) →
      scaleV (addR reals a b) x ≡ addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    scale-zero-vectorV :
      (a : R) →
      scaleV a zeroV ≡ zeroV

    scale-zero-scalarV :
      (x : V) →
      scaleV (zeroR reals) x ≡ zeroV

open RealVectorSpace

subtractV :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  RealVectorSpace reals V →
  V →
  V →
  V
subtractV space x y =
  addV space x (negateV space y)

record NormedSpace
  {r v : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {V : Set v}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals V) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    normV :
      V →
      R

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) →
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)

    norm-zeroV :
      normV (zeroV space) ≡ zeroR reals

    norm-zero-onlyV :
      (x : V) →
      normV x ≡ zeroR reals →
      x ≡ zeroV space

    norm-triangleV :
      (x y : V) →
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV (addV space x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))

    norm-scaleV :
      (a : R) →
      (x : V) →
      normV (scaleV space a x) ≡
      multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normV x)

open NormedSpace

Distance :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  {space : RealVectorSpace reals V} →
  NormedSpace reals space →
  V →
  V →
  R
Distance {space = space} normed x y =
  normV normed (subtractV space x y)

sumScaled :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals V) →
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → R) →
  (Fin n → V) →
  V
sumScaled space {zero} coefficients vectors =
  zeroV space
sumScaled space {suc n} coefficients vectors =
  addV space
    (scaleV space (coefficients fzero) (vectors fzero))
    (sumScaled space
      (λ i → coefficients (fsuc i))
      (λ i → vectors (fsuc i)))

record FiniteDimensional
  {r v : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {V : Set v}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals V) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    dimension :
      Nat

    basis :
      Fin dimension →
      V

    basis-independent :
      (coefficients : Fin dimension → R) →
      sumScaled space coefficients basis ≡ zeroV space →
      (i : Fin dimension) →
      coefficients i ≡ zeroR reals

    basis-spans :
      (x : V) →
      Σ (Fin dimension → R)
        (λ coefficients →
          sumScaled space coefficients basis ≡ x)

Subset :
  {v : Level} →
  Set v →
  Set (lsuc v)
Subset {v} V =
  V → Set v

Nonempty :
  {v : Level} →
  {V : Set v} →
  Subset V →
  Set v
Nonempty {V = V} subset =
  Σ V subset

Convex :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  (reals : RealLine R) →
  RealVectorSpace reals V →
  Subset V →
  Set (r ⊔ v)
Convex {R = R} {V = V} reals space subset =
  (a b : R) →
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) a →
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) b →
  addR reals a b ≡ oneR reals →
  (x y : V) →
  subset x →
  subset y →
  subset
    (addV space
      (scaleV space a x)
      (scaleV space b y))

IsOpen :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  {space : RealVectorSpace reals V} →
  NormedSpace reals space →
  Subset V →
  Set (r ⊔ v)
IsOpen {R = R} {V = V} {reals = reals} normed subset =
  (center : V) →
  subset center →
  Σ R
    (λ radius →
      StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) radius
      ×
      ((point : V) →
        StrictLessR reals (Distance normed center point) radius →
        subset point))

Covers :
  {i v : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {V : Set v} →
  Subset V →
  (I → Subset V) →
  Set (i ⊔ v)
Covers {I = I} {V = V} subset family =
  (x : V) →
  subset x →
  Σ I (λ index → family index x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {i v : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {V : Set v} →
  Subset V →
  (I → Subset V) →
  Set (i ⊔ v)
FiniteSubcover {I = I} {V = V} subset family =
  Σ (List I)
    (λ selected →
      (x : V) →
      subset x →
      Σ I
        (λ index →
          Member index selected × family index x))

Compact :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  {space : RealVectorSpace reals V} →
  NormedSpace reals space →
  Subset V →
  Setω
Compact {r = r} {v = v} {V = V} normed subset =
  (i : Level) →
  (I : Set i) →
  (family : I → Subset V) →
  ((index : I) → IsOpen normed (family index)) →
  Covers subset family →
  FiniteSubcover subset family

record PointIn
  {v : Level}
  {V : Set v}
  (subset : Subset V) :
  Set v where

  constructor point-in
  field
    point :
      V

    point-membership :
      subset point

open PointIn

ContinuousOnSubset :
  {r v : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {V : Set v} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  {space : RealVectorSpace reals V} →
  (normed : NormedSpace reals space) →
  (subset : Subset V) →
  (PointIn subset → PointIn subset) →
  Set (r ⊔ v)
ContinuousOnSubset {R = R} {reals = reals} normed subset function =
  (x : PointIn subset) →
  (epsilon : R) →
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) epsilon →
  Σ R
    (λ delta →
      StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) delta
      ×
      ((y : PointIn subset) →
        StrictLessR reals
          (Distance normed (point x) (point y))
          delta →
        StrictLessR reals
          (Distance normed (point (function x)) (point (function y)))
          epsilon))

record ContinuousSelfMap
  {r v : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {V : Set v}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {space : RealVectorSpace reals V}
  (normed : NormedSpace reals space)
  (subset : Subset V) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    apply :
      PointIn subset →
      PointIn subset

    continuous :
      ContinuousOnSubset normed subset apply

open ContinuousSelfMap

brouwer-fixed-point-theorem : Setω
brouwer-fixed-point-theorem =
  {r v : Level} →
  (R : Set r) →
  (reals : RealLine R) →
  (V : Set v) →
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals V) →
  (normed : NormedSpace reals space) →
  FiniteDimensional reals space →
  (subset : Subset V) →
  Convex reals space subset →
  Compact normed subset →
  Nonempty subset →
  (function : ContinuousSelfMap normed subset) →
  Σ (PointIn subset)
    (λ x →
      point (apply function x) ≡ point x)

title: Q1144897_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1144897, "Brouwer fixed-point theorem": every continuous self-map of a
  nonempty compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real normed vector
  space has a fixed point in that subset. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;
open topologyTheory;

val q1144897_real_normed_vector_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_real_normed_vector_space_def",
  ``q1144897_real_normed_vector_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1144897_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_lincomb_def",
  ``q1144897_lincomb
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (basis : 'v list) (coeff : num -> real) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. add acc (smul (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
        zero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q1144897_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q1144897_finite_dimensional
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      ?basis : 'v list.
        !x : 'v.
          ?coeff : num -> real.
            q1144897_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = x``);

val q1144897_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_open_def",
  ``q1144897_open
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (u : 'v set) <=>
      !x. x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q1144897_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_compact_def",
  ``q1144897_compact
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (s : 'v set) <=>
      !cover : ('v set) set.
        (!u. u IN cover ==> q1144897_open add neg norm u) /\
        s SUBSET UNIONS cover
        ==>
        ?subcover.
          FINITE subcover /\
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          s SUBSET UNIONS subcover``);

val q1144897_convex_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_convex_def",
  ``q1144897_convex
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (s : 'v set) <=>
      !x y t.
        x IN s /\ y IN s /\ 0 <= t /\ t <= 1
        ==>
        add (smul (1 - t) x) (smul t y) IN s``);

val q1144897_continuous_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1144897_continuous_on_def",
  ``q1144897_continuous_on
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (s : 'v set) (f : 'v -> 'v) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              y IN s /\
              norm (add y (neg x)) < delta
              ==>
              norm (add (f y) (neg (f x))) < epsilon``);

val brouwer_fixed_point =
  ``!(zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (norm : 'v -> real)
      (s : 'v set) (f : 'v -> 'v).
      q1144897_real_normed_vector_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q1144897_finite_dimensional zero add smul /\
      q1144897_convex add smul s /\
      q1144897_compact add neg norm s /\
      (?x. x IN s) /\
      q1144897_continuous_on add neg norm s f /\
      (!x. x IN s ==> f x IN s)
      ==>
      ?x. x IN s /\ f x = x``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V ranges over SetMM normed vector spaces over RRfld, and
  ( dim ` V ) e. NN0 is the finite-dimensionality assumption, including the
  zero-dimensional case. Q1144897Convex expands convexity using V's native
  real scalar multiplication and addition.

  The topology ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t S is the norm topology restricted to S.
  Compactness and continuity are stated for this induced topology, while
  F : S --> S preserves the source's continuous subtype self-map. The fixed
  point remains existentially quantified in the conclusion.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. The
  preceding $a declarations are syntax and a faithful bidirectional
  definition; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1144897Convex $.

q1144897-convex-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1144897Convex V S ) $.

${
  $d S V t x y $.

  q1144897-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1144897Convex V S )
    <->
    A. x e. S A. y e. S A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      (
        (
          ( t ( .s ` V ) x )
          ( +g ` V )
          ( ( 1 - t ) ( .s ` V ) y )
        )
        e. S

${
  $d F S V v x $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q1144897-brouwer-fixed-point $a |-
    A. V e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = RRfld }
      A. S e. ~P ( Base ` V )
        (
          (
            ( dim ` V ) e. NN0
            /\
            (
              S =/= (/)
              /\
              (
                ( Q1144897Convex V S )
                /\
                ( ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t S ) e. Comp
              )
            )
          )
          ->
          A. F
            (
              (
                F : S --> S
                /\
                F e.
                  (
                    ( ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t S )
                    Cn
                    ( ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t S )
                  )
              )
              ->
              E. x e. S ( F ` x ) = x
            )
        )
  $.
$}
