title: Q1144897_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1144897,
% "Brouwer fixed-point theorem": every continuous self-map of a nonempty
% compact convex subset of a finite-dimensional real normed vector space has
% a fixed point. This file contains no proof.

Q1144897_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  zeroV: V,
  addV: [V, V -> V],
  negV: [V -> V],
  smulV: [real, V -> V],
  normV: [V -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [V -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> V]
  coordinate_vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coordinate_map: TYPE = [V -> coordinate_vector]
  reconstruction_map: TYPE = [coordinate_vector -> V]
  self_map: TYPE = [V -> V]

  subV(x, y: V): V =
    addV(x, negV(y))

  coordinate_zero: coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  coordinate_add(
      left, right: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      left(index) + right(index)

  coordinate_scale(
      scalar: real,
      value: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      scalar * value(index)

  supported(
      value: coordinate_vector,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES value(index) = 0

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: V):
      addV(x, y) = addV(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: V):
        addV(addV(x, y), z) =
          addV(x, addV(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: V):
        addV(x, zeroV) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: V):
        addV(x, negV(x)) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: V):
        smulV(a, addV(x, y)) =
          addV(smulV(a, x), smulV(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: V):
        smulV(a + b, x) =
          addV(smulV(a, x), smulV(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: V):
        smulV(a * b, x) =
          smulV(a, smulV(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: V):
        smulV(1, x) = x)
      AND normV(zeroV) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: V):
        0 <= normV(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: V):
        normV(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: V):
        normV(smulV(a, x)) =
          abs(a) * normV(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: V):
        normV(addV(x, y)) <=
          normV(x) + normV(y))

  finite_dimensional: bool =
    EXISTS
        (dimension: nat),
        (coordinates: coordinate_map),
        (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
      (FORALL (x: V):
        supported(coordinates(x), dimension))
        AND (FORALL (x, y: V):
          coordinates(addV(x, y)) =
            coordinate_add(
              coordinates(x), coordinates(y)))
        AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: V):
          coordinates(smulV(a, x)) =
            coordinate_scale(a, coordinates(x)))
        AND (FORALL (x: V):
          reconstruct(coordinates(x)) = x)
        AND (FORALL (value: coordinate_vector):
          supported(value, dimension) IMPLIES
            coordinates(reconstruct(value)) = value)

  open_set(U: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: V):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          0 < radius
            AND FORALL (y: V):
              normV(subV(y, x)) < radius IMPLIES U(y)

  open_cover(
      cover: set_family,
      S: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES open_set(U))
      AND (FORALL (x: V):
        S(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: point_set):
            cover(U) AND U(x))

  finite_subcover(
      cover: set_family,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: V):
          S(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (cover: set_family):
      open_cover(cover, S) IMPLIES
        finite_subcover(cover, S)

  affine_combination(
      parameter: real,
      x, y: V): V =
    addV(
      smulV(parameter, x),
      smulV(1 - parameter, y))

  convex_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: V), (parameter: real):
      (S(x)
        AND S(y)
        AND 0 <= parameter
        AND parameter <= 1)
      IMPLIES
        S(affine_combination(parameter, x, y))

  nonempty_set(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: V):
      S(x)

  maps_into(
      function_value: self_map,
      S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: V):
      S(x) IMPLIES S(function_value(x))

  continuous_on(
      function_value: self_map,
      S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: V):
      S(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
          0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
            EXISTS (delta: real):
              0 < delta
                AND FORALL (y: V):
                  (S(y)
                    AND normV(subV(y, x)) < delta)
                  IMPLIES
                    normV(
                      subV(
                        function_value(y),
                        function_value(x)))
                      < epsilon_value

  has_fixed_point_on(
      function_value: self_map,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: V):
      S(x) AND function_value(x) = x

  brouwer_fixed_point: bool =
    (normed_real_vector_space
      AND finite_dimensional)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: point_set), (function_value: self_map):
        (convex_set(S)
          AND compact_set(S)
          AND nonempty_set(S)
          AND maps_into(function_value, S)
          AND continuous_on(function_value, S))
        IMPLIES
          has_fixed_point_on(function_value, S)
END Q1144897_brouwer_fixed_point_theorem

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1148215
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1148215), "Mitchell's embedding theorem":
-- every abelian category admits a full and faithful embedding into modules over
-- a ring that preserves finite limits and finite colimits. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Basic
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Preserves.Finite

universe v u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace Q1148215

/-- The Freyd-Mitchell embedding theorem for an arbitrary abelian category. -/
theorem mitchell_embedding_theorem_statement (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] :
    ∃ (R : Type (max u v)) (_ : Ring R) (F : C ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} R),
      F.Full ∧ F.Faithful ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits F ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits F := sorry

end Q1148215

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1148215
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1148215), "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every
  abelian category admits a full and faithful functor to modules over a ring
  that preserves finite limits and finite colimits. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1148215_category : Type := {
  q1148215_obj : Type;
  q1148215_hom : q1148215_obj -> q1148215_obj -> Type;
  q1148215_id :
    forall X : q1148215_obj, q1148215_hom X X;
  q1148215_comp :
    forall X Y Z : q1148215_obj,
      q1148215_hom X Y ->
      q1148215_hom Y Z ->
      q1148215_hom X Z;
  q1148215_comp_id_left :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj) (f : q1148215_hom X Y),
      @q1148215_comp X X Y (q1148215_id X) f = f;
  q1148215_comp_id_right :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj) (f : q1148215_hom X Y),
      @q1148215_comp X Y Y f (q1148215_id Y) = f;
  q1148215_comp_assoc :
    forall (W X Y Z : q1148215_obj)
           (f : q1148215_hom W X)
           (g : q1148215_hom X Y)
           (h : q1148215_hom Y Z),
      @q1148215_comp W Y Z (@q1148215_comp W X Y f g) h =
      @q1148215_comp W X Z f (@q1148215_comp X Y Z g h)
}.

Arguments q1148215_hom _ _ _ : clear implicits.

Record q1148215_abelian_group (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1148215_ag_zero : A;
  q1148215_ag_add : A -> A -> A;
  q1148215_ag_neg : A -> A;
  q1148215_ag_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q1148215_ag_add x (q1148215_ag_add y z) =
      q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_ag_add x y) z;
  q1148215_ag_zero_left :
    forall x : A, q1148215_ag_add q1148215_ag_zero x = x;
  q1148215_ag_zero_right :
    forall x : A, q1148215_ag_add x q1148215_ag_zero = x;
  q1148215_ag_neg_left :
    forall x : A,
      q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_ag_neg x) x = q1148215_ag_zero;
  q1148215_ag_neg_right :
    forall x : A,
      q1148215_ag_add x (q1148215_ag_neg x) = q1148215_ag_zero;
  q1148215_ag_add_comm :
    forall x y : A, q1148215_ag_add x y = q1148215_ag_add y x
}.

Arguments q1148215_ag_zero {A} _.
Arguments q1148215_ag_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q1148215_ag_neg {A} _ _.

Record q1148215_preadditive (C : q1148215_category) : Type := {
  q1148215_hom_group :
    forall X Y : q1148215_obj C,
      q1148215_abelian_group (q1148215_hom C X Y);
  q1148215_comp_add_left :
    forall (W X Y : q1148215_obj C)
           (f g : q1148215_hom C W X)
           (h : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      q1148215_comp
        (q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_hom_group W X) f g) h =
      q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_hom_group W Y)
        (q1148215_comp f h) (q1148215_comp g h);
  q1148215_comp_add_right :
    forall (W X Y : q1148215_obj C)
           (f : q1148215_hom C W X)
           (g h : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      q1148215_comp f
        (q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_hom_group X Y) g h) =
      q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_hom_group W Y)
        (q1148215_comp f g) (q1148215_comp f h)
}.

Arguments q1148215_hom_group {C} _ _ _.

Definition q1148215_zero_morphism
    {C : q1148215_category}
    (P : q1148215_preadditive C)
    (X Y : q1148215_obj C) : q1148215_hom C X Y :=
  q1148215_ag_zero (q1148215_hom_group P X Y).

Definition q1148215_is_zero_object
    (C : q1148215_category) (Z : q1148215_obj C) : Prop :=
  (forall X : q1148215_obj C,
    exists f : q1148215_hom C Z X,
      forall g : q1148215_hom C Z X, g = f) /\
  (forall X : q1148215_obj C,
    exists f : q1148215_hom C X Z,
      forall g : q1148215_hom C X Z, g = f).

Definition q1148215_is_binary_biproduct
    {C : q1148215_category}
    (P : q1148215_preadditive C)
    (X Y B : q1148215_obj C)
    (inl : q1148215_hom C X B)
    (inr : q1148215_hom C Y B)
    (fst : q1148215_hom C B X)
    (snd : q1148215_hom C B Y) : Prop :=
  q1148215_comp inl fst = q1148215_id X /\
  q1148215_comp inr snd = q1148215_id Y /\
  q1148215_comp inl snd = q1148215_zero_morphism P X Y /\
  q1148215_comp inr fst = q1148215_zero_morphism P Y X /\
  q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_hom_group P B B)
    (q1148215_comp fst inl) (q1148215_comp snd inr) =
  q1148215_id B.

Record q1148215_additive_category
    (C : q1148215_category) : Type := {
  q1148215_add_preadditive : q1148215_preadditive C;
  q1148215_add_zero_object :
    exists Z : q1148215_obj C, q1148215_is_zero_object C Z;
  q1148215_add_biproduct :
    forall X Y : q1148215_obj C,
      exists B : q1148215_obj C,
      exists inl : q1148215_hom C X B,
      exists inr : q1148215_hom C Y B,
      exists fst : q1148215_hom C B X,
      exists snd : q1148215_hom C B Y,
        q1148215_is_binary_biproduct
          q1148215_add_preadditive X Y B inl inr fst snd
}.

Arguments q1148215_add_preadditive {C} _.

Definition q1148215_is_monomorphism
    {C : q1148215_category}
    {X Y : q1148215_obj C}
    (f : q1148215_hom C X Y) : Prop :=
  forall (Z : q1148215_obj C) (g h : q1148215_hom C Z X),
    q1148215_comp g f = q1148215_comp h f ->
    g = h.

Definition q1148215_is_epimorphism
    {C : q1148215_category}
    {X Y : q1148215_obj C}
    (f : q1148215_hom C X Y) : Prop :=
  forall (Z : q1148215_obj C) (g h : q1148215_hom C Y Z),
    q1148215_comp f g = q1148215_comp f h ->
    g = h.

Definition q1148215_is_kernel
    {C : q1148215_category}
    (P : q1148215_preadditive C)
    {X Y K : q1148215_obj C}
    (f : q1148215_hom C X Y)
    (k : q1148215_hom C K X) : Prop :=
  q1148215_comp k f = q1148215_zero_morphism P K Y /\
  forall (T : q1148215_obj C) (t : q1148215_hom C T X),
    q1148215_comp t f = q1148215_zero_morphism P T Y ->
    exists u : q1148215_hom C T K,
      q1148215_comp u k = t /\
      forall v : q1148215_hom C T K,
        q1148215_comp v k = t -> v = u.

Definition q1148215_is_cokernel
    {C : q1148215_category}
    (P : q1148215_preadditive C)
    {X Y Q : q1148215_obj C}
    (f : q1148215_hom C X Y)
    (q : q1148215_hom C Y Q) : Prop :=
  q1148215_comp f q = q1148215_zero_morphism P X Q /\
  forall (T : q1148215_obj C) (t : q1148215_hom C Y T),
    q1148215_comp f t = q1148215_zero_morphism P X T ->
    exists u : q1148215_hom C Q T,
      q1148215_comp q u = t /\
      forall v : q1148215_hom C Q T,
        q1148215_comp q v = t -> v = u.

Record q1148215_abelian_category
    (C : q1148215_category) : Type := {
  q1148215_ab_additive : q1148215_additive_category C;
  q1148215_ab_kernel :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C) (f : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      exists K : q1148215_obj C,
      exists k : q1148215_hom C K X,
        q1148215_is_kernel
          (q1148215_add_preadditive q1148215_ab_additive) f k;
  q1148215_ab_cokernel :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C) (f : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      exists Q : q1148215_obj C,
      exists q : q1148215_hom C Y Q,
        q1148215_is_cokernel
          (q1148215_add_preadditive q1148215_ab_additive) f q;
  q1148215_ab_mono_is_kernel :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C) (m : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      q1148215_is_monomorphism m ->
      exists Z : q1148215_obj C,
      exists f : q1148215_hom C Y Z,
        q1148215_is_kernel
          (q1148215_add_preadditive q1148215_ab_additive) f m;
  q1148215_ab_epi_is_cokernel :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C) (e : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      q1148215_is_epimorphism e ->
      exists Z : q1148215_obj C,
      exists f : q1148215_hom C Z X,
        q1148215_is_cokernel
          (q1148215_add_preadditive q1148215_ab_additive) f e
}.

Record q1148215_ring : Type := {
  q1148215_ring_carrier : Type;
  q1148215_ring_additive_group :

  q1148215_ring_one : q1148215_ring_carrier;

      q1148215_ring_mul x (q1148215_ring_mul y z) =

  q1148215_ring_one_left :
    forall x : q1148215_ring_carrier,
      q1148215_ring_mul q1148215_ring_one x = x;
  q1148215_ring_one_right :

Arguments q1148215_ring_carrier _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1148215_ring_additive_group _.
Arguments q1148215_ring_one {q}.

Record q1148215_module (R : q1148215_ring) : Type := {
  q1148215_module_carrier : Type;
  q1148215_module_additive_group :
    q1148215_abelian_group q1148215_module_carrier;
  q1148215_smul :
    q1148215_ring_carrier R ->
    q1148215_module_carrier ->
    q1148215_module_carrier;
  q1148215_smul_one :
    forall x : q1148215_module_carrier,
      q1148215_smul (q1148215_ring_one (q := R)) x = x;
  q1148215_smul_mul :
    forall (a b : q1148215_ring_carrier R)
           (x : q1148215_module_carrier),
      q1148215_smul (q1148215_ring_mul a b) x =
      q1148215_smul a (q1148215_smul b x);
  q1148215_smul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : q1148215_ring_carrier R)
           (x : q1148215_module_carrier),
      q1148215_smul
        (q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_ring_additive_group R) a b) x =
      q1148215_ag_add q1148215_module_additive_group
        (q1148215_smul a x) (q1148215_smul b x);

    forall (a : q1148215_ring_carrier R)
           (x y : q1148215_module_carrier),
      q1148215_smul a
        (q1148215_ag_add q1148215_module_additive_group x y) =
      q1148215_ag_add q1148215_module_additive_group
        (q1148215_smul a x) (q1148215_smul a y)
}.

Arguments q1148215_module_carrier {R} _.
Arguments q1148215_module_additive_group {R} _.
Arguments q1148215_smul {R} {q} _ _.

Definition q1148215_is_linear
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (M N : q1148215_module R)
    (f : q1148215_module_carrier M ->
         q1148215_module_carrier N) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : q1148215_module_carrier M,
    f (q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_module_additive_group M) x y) =
    q1148215_ag_add (q1148215_module_additive_group N) (f x) (f y)) /\
  (forall (a : q1148215_ring_carrier R)
          (x : q1148215_module_carrier M),
    f (q1148215_smul a x) = q1148215_smul a (f x)).

Record q1148215_module_functor
    (C : q1148215_category) (R : q1148215_ring) : Type := {
  q1148215_fobj :
    q1148215_obj C -> q1148215_module R;
  q1148215_fmap :
    forall X Y : q1148215_obj C,
      q1148215_hom C X Y ->
      q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj X) ->
      q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj Y);
  q1148215_fmap_linear :
    forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C) (f : q1148215_hom C X Y),
      q1148215_is_linear (q1148215_fobj X) (q1148215_fobj Y)
        (q1148215_fmap X Y f);
  q1148215_fmap_id :
    forall (X : q1148215_obj C)
           (x : q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj X)),
      q1148215_fmap X X (q1148215_id X) x = x;
  q1148215_fmap_comp :
    forall (X Y Z : q1148215_obj C)
           (f : q1148215_hom C X Y)
           (g : q1148215_hom C Y Z)
           (x : q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj X)),
      q1148215_fmap X Z (q1148215_comp f g) x =
      q1148215_fmap Y Z g (q1148215_fmap X Y f x)
}.

Arguments q1148215_fobj {C R} _ _.
Arguments q1148215_fmap {C R} _ {X Y} _ _.

Definition q1148215_functor_full
    {C : q1148215_category}
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (F : q1148215_module_functor C R) : Prop :=
  forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C)
         (f : q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj F X) ->
              q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj F Y)),
    q1148215_is_linear (q1148215_fobj F X) (q1148215_fobj F Y) f ->
    exists g : q1148215_hom C X Y,
      forall x : q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj F X),
        q1148215_fmap F g x = f x.

Definition q1148215_functor_faithful
    {C : q1148215_category}
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (F : q1148215_module_functor C R) : Prop :=
  forall (X Y : q1148215_obj C) (f g : q1148215_hom C X Y),
    (forall x : q1148215_module_carrier (q1148215_fobj F X),
      q1148215_fmap F f x = q1148215_fmap F g x) ->
    f = g.

  q1148215_finite_objects_complete :

  q1148215_finite_morphisms :

  q1148215_finite_morphisms_complete :
    forall (i j : q1148215_obj J) (f : q1148215_hom J i j),
      In f (q1148215_finite_morphisms i j)

    (J C : q1148215_category) : Type := {

    q1148215_obj J -> q1148215_obj C;
  q1148215_dmap :
    forall i j : q1148215_obj J,

  q1148215_dmap_id :

Record q1148215_cone
    {J C : q1148215_category}
    (D : q1148215_diagram J C) : Type := {

    forall j : q1148215_obj J,

Definition q1148215_is_limit
    {J C : q1148215_category}
    {D : q1148215_diagram J C}

  forall (X : q1148215_obj C)

           q1148215_hom C X (q1148215_dobj D j)),
    (forall (i j : q1148215_obj J) (f : q1148215_hom J i j),
      q1148215_comp (leg i) (q1148215_dmap D f) = leg j) ->
    exists u : q1148215_hom C X (q1148215_cone_apex K),
      (forall j : q1148215_obj J,
        q1148215_comp u (q1148215_cone_leg K j) = leg j) /\
      forall v : q1148215_hom C X (q1148215_cone_apex K),
        (forall j : q1148215_obj J,
          q1148215_comp v (q1148215_cone_leg K j) = leg j) ->

Definition q1148215_is_colimit
    {J C : q1148215_category}

        q1148215_comp (q1148215_cocone_leg K j) u = leg j) /\

Definition q1148215_mapped_cone_is_limit
    {J C : q1148215_category}
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (F : q1148215_module_functor C R)
    (D : q1148215_diagram J C)
    (K : q1148215_cone D) : Prop :=
  forall (M : q1148215_module R)
         (leg : forall j : q1148215_obj J,
           q1148215_module_carrier M ->
           q1148215_module_carrier
             (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D j))),
    (forall j : q1148215_obj J,
      q1148215_is_linear M
        (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D j)) (leg j)) ->
    (forall (i j : q1148215_obj J)
            (f : q1148215_hom J i j)
            (x : q1148215_module_carrier M),
      q1148215_fmap F (q1148215_dmap D f) (leg i x) = leg j x) ->
    exists u :
      q1148215_module_carrier M ->
      q1148215_module_carrier
        (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cone_apex K)),
      q1148215_is_linear M
        (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cone_apex K)) u /\
      (forall (j : q1148215_obj J)
              (x : q1148215_module_carrier M),
        q1148215_fmap F (q1148215_cone_leg K j) (u x) = leg j x) /\
      forall v :
        q1148215_module_carrier M ->
        q1148215_module_carrier
          (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cone_apex K)),
        q1148215_is_linear M
          (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cone_apex K)) v ->
        (forall (j : q1148215_obj J)
                (x : q1148215_module_carrier M),
          q1148215_fmap F (q1148215_cone_leg K j) (v x) = leg j x) ->
        forall x : q1148215_module_carrier M, v x = u x.

Definition q1148215_mapped_cocone_is_colimit
    {J C : q1148215_category}
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (F : q1148215_module_functor C R)
    (D : q1148215_diagram J C)
    (K : q1148215_cocone D) : Prop :=
  forall (M : q1148215_module R)
         (leg : forall j : q1148215_obj J,
           q1148215_module_carrier
             (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D j)) ->
           q1148215_module_carrier M),
    (forall j : q1148215_obj J,
      q1148215_is_linear
        (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D j)) M (leg j)) ->
    (forall (i j : q1148215_obj J)
            (f : q1148215_hom J i j)
            (x : q1148215_module_carrier
              (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D i))),
      leg j (q1148215_fmap F (q1148215_dmap D f) x) = leg i x) ->
    exists u :
      q1148215_module_carrier
        (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cocone_apex K)) ->
      q1148215_module_carrier M,
      q1148215_is_linear
        (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cocone_apex K)) M u /\
      (forall (j : q1148215_obj J)
              (x : q1148215_module_carrier
                (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D j))),
        u (q1148215_fmap F (q1148215_cocone_leg K j) x) = leg j x) /\
      forall v :
        q1148215_module_carrier
          (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cocone_apex K)) ->
        q1148215_module_carrier M,
        q1148215_is_linear
          (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cocone_apex K)) M v ->
        (forall (j : q1148215_obj J)
                (x : q1148215_module_carrier
                  (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_dobj D j))),
          v (q1148215_fmap F (q1148215_cocone_leg K j) x) = leg j x) ->
        forall x :
          q1148215_module_carrier
            (q1148215_fobj F (q1148215_cocone_apex K)),
          v x = u x.

Definition q1148215_preserves_finite_limits
    {C : q1148215_category}
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (F : q1148215_module_functor C R) : Prop :=
  forall (J : q1148215_category)
         (_ : q1148215_finite_category J)
         (D : q1148215_diagram J C)
         (K : q1148215_cone D),
    q1148215_is_limit K ->
    q1148215_mapped_cone_is_limit F (D := D) K.

Definition q1148215_preserves_finite_colimits
    {C : q1148215_category}
    {R : q1148215_ring}
    (F : q1148215_module_functor C R) : Prop :=
  forall (J : q1148215_category)
         (_ : q1148215_finite_category J)
         (D : q1148215_diagram J C)
         (K : q1148215_cocone D),
    q1148215_is_colimit K ->
    q1148215_mapped_cocone_is_colimit F (D := D) K.

Theorem CategoryTheory_Abelian_freyd_mitchell :
  forall (C : q1148215_category),
    q1148215_abelian_category C ->
    exists R : q1148215_ring,
    exists F : q1148215_module_functor C R,
      q1148215_functor_full F /\
      q1148215_functor_faithful F /\
      q1148215_preserves_finite_limits F /\
      q1148215_preserves_finite_colimits F.
Admitted.

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1148215,
  "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every abelian category admits a full and
  faithful embedding into modules over a ring that preserves finite limits
  and finite colimits. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
  imports Main
begin

record ('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data =
  objects :: "'o set"
  arrows :: "'m set"
  source :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'o"
  target :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'o"
  identity :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  compose :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  zero_arrow :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  add_arrow :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  neg_arrow :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm"

definition hom ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm set" where
  "hom C X Y =
    {f \<in> arrows C. source C f = X \<and> target C f = Y}"

definition is_category ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_category C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C.
      source C f \<in> objects C \<and> target C f \<in> objects C) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C.
      identity C X \<in> hom C X X) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C Y Z.
        compose C g f \<in> hom C X Z) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y.
        compose C (identity C Y) f = f \<and>
        compose C f (identity C X) = f) \<and>
    (\<forall>W \<in> objects C. \<forall>X \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C W X. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>h \<in> hom C Y Z.
        compose C h (compose C g f) = compose C (compose C h g) f)"

definition is_preadditive ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_preadditive C \<longleftrightarrow>
    is_category C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      zero_arrow C X Y \<in> hom C X Y \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. neg_arrow C f \<in> hom C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y.
        add_arrow C f g \<in> hom C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y.
        add_arrow C (zero_arrow C X Y) f = f \<and>
        add_arrow C f (zero_arrow C X Y) = f) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y.
        add_arrow C f (neg_arrow C f) = zero_arrow C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y.
        add_arrow C f g = add_arrow C g f) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y.
        \<forall>h \<in> hom C X Y.
          add_arrow C (add_arrow C f g) h =
          add_arrow C f (add_arrow C g h))) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>h \<in> hom C Y Z.
        compose C h (add_arrow C f g) =
          add_arrow C (compose C h f) (compose C h g)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C Y Z. \<forall>h \<in> hom C Y Z.
        compose C (add_arrow C g h) f =
          add_arrow C (compose C g f) (compose C h f))"

definition is_zero_object ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_zero_object C Z \<longleftrightarrow>
    Z \<in> objects C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<exists>!f. f \<in> hom C Z X) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<exists>!f. f \<in> hom C X Z)"

definition is_binary_biproduct ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_binary_biproduct C X Y B i1 i2 p1 p2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    X \<in> objects C \<and> Y \<in> objects C \<and> B \<in> objects C \<and>
    i1 \<in> hom C X B \<and> i2 \<in> hom C Y B \<and>
    p1 \<in> hom C B X \<and> p2 \<in> hom C B Y \<and>
    compose C p1 i1 = identity C X \<and>
    compose C p2 i2 = identity C Y \<and>
    compose C p1 i2 = zero_arrow C Y X \<and>
    compose C p2 i1 = zero_arrow C X Y \<and>
    add_arrow C (compose C i1 p1) (compose C i2 p2) = identity C B"

definition is_kernel ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_kernel C k f \<longleftrightarrow>
    k \<in> arrows C \<and> f \<in> arrows C \<and> target C k = source C f \<and>
    compose C f k = zero_arrow C (source C k) (target C f) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>h \<in> hom C X (source C f).
      compose C f h = zero_arrow C X (target C f) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>!u. u \<in> hom C X (source C k) \<and> compose C k u = h))"

definition is_cokernel ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_cokernel C q f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q \<in> arrows C \<and> f \<in> arrows C \<and> source C q = target C f \<and>
    compose C q f = zero_arrow C (source C f) (target C q) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>h \<in> hom C (target C f) X.
      compose C h f = zero_arrow C (source C f) X \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>!u. u \<in> hom C (target C q) X \<and> compose C u q = h))"

definition is_monomorphism ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_monomorphism C f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> arrows C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X (source C f).
      \<forall>h \<in> hom C X (source C f).
        compose C f g = compose C f h \<longrightarrow> g = h)"

definition is_epimorphism ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_epimorphism C f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> arrows C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>g \<in> hom C (target C f) X.
      \<forall>h \<in> hom C (target C f) X.
        compose C g f = compose C h f \<longrightarrow> g = h)"

definition is_abelian_category ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_abelian_category C \<longleftrightarrow>
    is_preadditive C \<and>
    (\<exists>Z. is_zero_object C Z) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<exists>B i1 i2 p1 p2. is_binary_biproduct C X Y B i1 i2 p1 p2) \<and>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C. \<exists>k. is_kernel C k f) \<and>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C. \<exists>q. is_cokernel C q f) \<and>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C.
      is_monomorphism C f \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>q. is_cokernel C q f \<and> is_kernel C f q)) \<and>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C.
      is_epimorphism C f \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>k. is_kernel C k f \<and> is_cokernel C f k))"

record 'r ring_data =
  ring_carrier :: "'r set"
  ring_zero :: "'r"
  ring_one :: "'r"
  ring_add :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  ring_mul :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  ring_neg :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"

definition is_ring :: "'r ring_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_ring R \<longleftrightarrow>
    ring_zero R \<in> ring_carrier R \<and>
    ring_one R \<in> ring_carrier R \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> ring_carrier R. ring_neg R a \<in> ring_carrier R) \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> ring_carrier R. \<forall>b \<in> ring_carrier R.
      ring_add R a b \<in> ring_carrier R \<and>
      ring_mul R a b \<in> ring_carrier R) \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> ring_carrier R.
      ring_add R (ring_zero R) a = a \<and>
      ring_add R a (ring_zero R) = a \<and>
      ring_add R a (ring_neg R a) = ring_zero R \<and>
      ring_mul R (ring_one R) a = a \<and>
      ring_mul R a (ring_one R) = a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> ring_carrier R. \<forall>b \<in> ring_carrier R.
      ring_add R a b = ring_add R b a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> ring_carrier R. \<forall>b \<in> ring_carrier R.
      \<forall>c \<in> ring_carrier R.
        ring_add R (ring_add R a b) c = ring_add R a (ring_add R b c) \<and>
        ring_mul R (ring_mul R a b) c = ring_mul R a (ring_mul R b c) \<and>
        ring_mul R a (ring_add R b c) =
          ring_add R (ring_mul R a b) (ring_mul R a c) \<and>
        ring_mul R (ring_add R a b) c =
          ring_add R (ring_mul R a c) (ring_mul R b c))"

record ('o, 'm, 'r, 'v) module_embedding_data =
  coefficient_ring :: "'r ring_data"
  module_carrier :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'v set"
  module_zero :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  module_add :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  module_neg :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  scalar_mul :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  morphism_map :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"

definition is_module_at ::
    "('o, 'm, 'r, 'v) module_embedding_data \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_module_at E X \<longleftrightarrow>
    module_zero E X \<in> module_carrier E X \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. module_neg E X u \<in> module_carrier E X) \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. \<forall>v \<in> module_carrier E X.
      module_add E X u v \<in> module_carrier E X) \<and>
    (\<forall>r \<in> ring_carrier (coefficient_ring E).
      \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
        scalar_mul E X r u \<in> module_carrier E X) \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
      module_add E X (module_zero E X) u = u \<and>
      module_add E X u (module_zero E X) = u \<and>
      module_add E X u (module_neg E X u) = module_zero E X \<and>
      scalar_mul E X (ring_one (coefficient_ring E)) u = u \<and>
      scalar_mul E X (ring_zero (coefficient_ring E)) u = module_zero E X) \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. \<forall>v \<in> module_carrier E X.
      module_add E X u v = module_add E X v u) \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. \<forall>v \<in> module_carrier E X.
      \<forall>w \<in> module_carrier E X.
        module_add E X (module_add E X u v) w =
          module_add E X u (module_add E X v w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>r \<in> ring_carrier (coefficient_ring E).
      \<forall>s \<in> ring_carrier (coefficient_ring E).
      \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. \<forall>v \<in> module_carrier E X.
        scalar_mul E X (ring_add (coefficient_ring E) r s) u =
          module_add E X (scalar_mul E X r u) (scalar_mul E X s u) \<and>
        scalar_mul E X r (module_add E X u v) =
          module_add E X (scalar_mul E X r u) (scalar_mul E X r v) \<and>
        scalar_mul E X (ring_mul (coefficient_ring E) r s) u =
          scalar_mul E X r (scalar_mul E X s u))"

definition is_linear_map ::
    "('o, 'm, 'r, 'v) module_embedding_data \<Rightarrow>
      'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_linear_map E X Y L \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. L u \<in> module_carrier E Y) \<and>
    L (module_zero E X) = module_zero E Y \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. \<forall>v \<in> module_carrier E X.
      L (module_add E X u v) = module_add E Y (L u) (L v)) \<and>
    (\<forall>r \<in> ring_carrier (coefficient_ring E).
      \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
        L (scalar_mul E X r u) = scalar_mul E Y r (L u))"

definition is_full_faithful_exact_module_embedding ::
    "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('o, 'm, 'r, 'v) module_embedding_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_full_faithful_exact_module_embedding C E \<longleftrightarrow>
    is_ring (coefficient_ring E) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. is_module_at E X) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. is_linear_map E X Y (morphism_map E f)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
      morphism_map E (identity C X) u = u) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C Y Z.
      \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
        morphism_map E (compose C g f) u =
          morphism_map E g (morphism_map E f u)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
        morphism_map E (zero_arrow C X Y) u = module_zero E Y) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y.
      \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
        morphism_map E (add_arrow C f g) u =
          module_add E Y (morphism_map E f u) (morphism_map E g u)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>L. is_linear_map E X Y L \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>f \<in> hom C X Y.
          \<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X. morphism_map E f u = L u)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> hom C X Y.
        (\<forall>u \<in> module_carrier E X.
          morphism_map E f u = morphism_map E g u) \<longrightarrow> f = g) \<and>
    (\<forall>k f. is_kernel C k f \<longrightarrow>
      inj_on (morphism_map E k) (module_carrier E (source C k)) \<and>
      morphism_map E k ` module_carrier E (source C k) =
        {u \<in> module_carrier E (source C f).
          morphism_map E f u = module_zero E (target C f)}) \<and>
    (\<forall>q f. is_cokernel C q f \<longrightarrow>
      morphism_map E q ` module_carrier E (source C q) =
        module_carrier E (target C q) \<and>
      {u \<in> module_carrier E (target C f).
        morphism_map E q u = module_zero E (target C q)} =
        morphism_map E f ` module_carrier E (source C f))"

(*
  HOL cannot existentially quantify over carrier types. Let kappa bound the
  object and arrow carriers (and nat). In the standard small-category
  construction, the embedding ring has cardinal at most kappa^kappa, hence at
  most 2^kappa, and its modules fit in a further powerset. These code types
  therefore retain the existential carrier freedom of the source theorem.
*)
type_synonym ('o, 'm) freyd_mitchell_ring_code = "((nat + 'o) + 'm) set"
type_synonym ('o, 'm) freyd_mitchell_vector_code =
  "('o, 'm) freyd_mitchell_ring_code set"

theorem freyd_mitchell:
  fixes C :: "('o, 'm) preadditive_category_data"
  assumes "is_abelian_category C"
  shows "\<exists>E ::
      ('o, 'm, ('o, 'm) freyd_mitchell_ring_code,
        ('o, 'm) freyd_mitchell_vector_code) module_embedding_data.
    is_full_faithful_exact_module_embedding C E"
  sorry

end

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1148215,
  "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every abelian category admits a full and
  faithful functor into modules over a ring that preserves finite limits and
  finite colimits. This file contains no proof.

  HOL cannot existentially quantify over carrier types. The ring is therefore
  coded in a powerset of the object, arrow, and natural-number data, while
  module vectors use one further powerset. These two levels retain the carrier
  freedom needed by the standard small-category construction.
*)

let Q1148215_MITCHELL_S_EMBEDDING_THEOREM =
  `let hom =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (x:O) (y:O) (f:M).
       objects x /\ objects y /\ morphisms f /\ dom f = x /\ cod f = y in
   let is_category =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M).
       (!f:M.
          morphisms f
          ==> objects (dom f) /\ objects (cod f)) /\
       (!x:O.
          objects x
          ==> hom objects morphisms dom cod x x (identity x)) /\
       (!x y z:O. !f g:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod y z g
          ==> hom objects morphisms dom cod x z (compose g f)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f
          ==> compose (identity y) f = f /\
              compose f (identity x) = f) /\
       (!w x y z:O. !f g h:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod w x f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod y z h
          ==> compose h (compose g f) = compose (compose h g) f) in
   let is_preadditive_category =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M)
      (zero:O->O->M) (add:M->M->M) (neg:M->M).
       is_category objects morphisms dom cod identity compose /\
       (!x y:O.
          objects x /\ objects y
          ==> hom objects morphisms dom cod x y (zero x y)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f g:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g
          ==> hom objects morphisms dom cod x y (add f g) /\
              add f g = add g f) /\
       (!x y:O. !f g h:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y h
          ==> add f (add g h) = add (add f g) h) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f
          ==> add (zero x y) f = f /\
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y (neg f) /\
              add (neg f) f = zero x y) /\
       (!w x y:O. !f g:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod w x f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g
          ==> compose (zero x y) f = zero w y /\
              compose g (zero w x) = zero w y) /\
       (!w x y:O. !f g h:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod w x f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod w x g /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y h
          ==> compose h (add f g) =
              add (compose h f) (compose h g)) /\
       (!w x y:O. !f g h:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod w x f /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g /\
          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y h
          ==> compose (add g h) f =
              add (compose g f) (compose h f)) in
   let is_zero_object =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (z:O).
       objects z /\
       (!x:O.
          objects x
          ==> (?f:M.
                 hom objects morphisms dom cod x z f /\
                 !g:M. hom objects morphisms dom cod x z g ==> g = f) /\
              (?f:M.
                 hom objects morphisms dom cod z x f /\
                 !g:M. hom objects morphisms dom cod z x g ==> g = f)) in
   let is_biproduct =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M)
      (zero:O->O->M) (add:M->M->M)
      (x:O) (y:O) (p:O) (i1:M) (i2:M) (p1:M) (p2:M).
       hom objects morphisms dom cod x p i1 /\
       hom objects morphisms dom cod y p i2 /\
       hom objects morphisms dom cod p x p1 /\
       hom objects morphisms dom cod p y p2 /\
       compose p1 i1 = identity x /\
       compose p2 i2 = identity y /\
       compose p1 i2 = zero y x /\
       compose p2 i1 = zero x y /\
       add (compose i1 p1) (compose i2 p2) = identity p in
   let is_kernel =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (compose:M->M->M) (zero:O->O->M)
      (kobject:O) (a:O) (b:O) (k:M) (f:M).
       hom objects morphisms dom cod kobject a k /\
       hom objects morphisms dom cod a b f /\
       compose f k = zero kobject b /\
       (!tobject:O. !t:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod tobject a t /\
          compose f t = zero tobject b
          ==> ?u:M.
                hom objects morphisms dom cod tobject kobject u /\
                compose k u = t /\
                !v:M.
                  hom objects morphisms dom cod tobject kobject v /\
                  compose k v = t
                  ==> v = u) in
   let is_cokernel =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (compose:M->M->M) (zero:O->O->M)
      (a:O) (b:O) (qobject:O) (f:M) (q:M).
       hom objects morphisms dom cod a b f /\
       hom objects morphisms dom cod b qobject q /\
       compose q f = zero a qobject /\
       (!tobject:O. !t:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod b tobject t /\
          compose t f = zero a tobject
          ==> ?u:M.
                hom objects morphisms dom cod qobject tobject u /\
                compose u q = t /\
                !v:M.
                  hom objects morphisms dom cod qobject tobject v /\
                  compose v q = t
                  ==> v = u) in
   let is_monic =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (compose:M->M->M) (x:O) (y:O) (f:M).
       hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
       !z:O. !g h:M.
         hom objects morphisms dom cod z x g /\
         hom objects morphisms dom cod z x h /\
         compose f g = compose f h
         ==> g = h in
   let is_epic =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (compose:M->M->M) (x:O) (y:O) (f:M).
       hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
       !z:O. !g h:M.
         hom objects morphisms dom cod y z g /\
         hom objects morphisms dom cod y z h /\
         compose g f = compose h f
         ==> g = h in
   let is_abelian_category =
     \(objects:O->bool) (morphisms:M->bool) (dom:M->O) (cod:M->O)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M)
      (zero:O->O->M) (add:M->M->M) (neg:M->M).
       is_preadditive_category objects morphisms dom cod identity compose
         zero add neg /\
       (?z:O. is_zero_object objects morphisms dom cod z) /\
       (!x y:O.
          objects x /\ objects y
          ==> ?p:O. ?i1 i2 p1 p2:M.
                objects p /\
                is_biproduct objects morphisms dom cod identity compose
                  zero add x y p i1 i2 p1 p2) /\
       (!a b:O. !f:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod a b f
          ==> ?kobject:O. ?k:M.
                objects kobject /\
                is_kernel objects morphisms dom cod compose zero
                  kobject a b k f) /\
       (!a b:O. !f:M.
          hom objects morphisms dom cod a b f
          ==> ?qobject:O. ?q:M.
                objects qobject /\
                is_cokernel objects morphisms dom cod compose zero
                  a b qobject f q) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          is_monic objects morphisms dom cod compose x y f
          ==> ?z:O. ?g:M.
                objects z /\
                is_kernel objects morphisms dom cod compose zero
                  x y z f g) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          is_epic objects morphisms dom cod compose x y f
          ==> ?z:O. ?g:M.
                objects z /\
                is_cokernel objects morphisms dom cod compose zero
                  z x y g f) in
   let is_ring =
     \(carrier:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)
      (rzero:(num#O#M)->bool) (rone:(num#O#M)->bool)
      (radd:((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool))
      (rmul:((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool))
      (rneg:((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool)).
       carrier rzero /\ carrier rone /\
       (!r s:(num#O#M)->bool.
          carrier r /\ carrier s
          ==> carrier (radd r s) /\
              carrier (rmul r s)) /\
       (!r:(num#O#M)->bool.
          carrier r
          ==> carrier (rneg r) /\
              radd rzero r = r /\
              radd (rneg r) r = rzero /\
              rmul rone r = r /\
              rmul r rone = r) /\
       (!r s:(num#O#M)->bool.
          carrier r /\ carrier s
          ==> radd r s = radd s r) /\
       (!r s t:(num#O#M)->bool.
          carrier r /\ carrier s /\ carrier t
          ==> radd r (radd s t) = radd (radd r s) t /\
              rmul r (rmul s t) = rmul (rmul r s) t /\
              rmul r (radd s t) = radd (rmul r s) (rmul r t) /\
              rmul (radd r s) t = radd (rmul r t) (rmul s t)) in
   let is_module =
     \(ring_carrier:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)
      (rone:(num#O#M)->bool)
      (radd:((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool))
      (rmul:((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool))
      (module_carrier:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->bool)
      (mzero:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)
      (madd:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->
            (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool))
      (mneg:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool))
      (smul:((num#O#M)->bool)->
            (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)).
       module_carrier mzero /\
       (!u v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          module_carrier u /\ module_carrier v
          ==> module_carrier (madd u v) /\
              madd u v = madd v u) /\
       (!u v w:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          module_carrier u /\ module_carrier v /\ module_carrier w
          ==> madd u (madd v w) = madd (madd u v) w) /\
       (!u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          module_carrier u
          ==> module_carrier (mneg u) /\
              madd mzero u = u /\
              madd (mneg u) u = mzero) /\
       (!r:(num#O#M)->bool. !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          ring_carrier r /\ module_carrier u
          ==> module_carrier (smul r u)) /\
       (!r s:(num#O#M)->bool. !u v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          ring_carrier r /\ ring_carrier s /\
          module_carrier u /\ module_carrier v
          ==> smul r (madd u v) = madd (smul r u) (smul r v) /\
              smul (radd r s) u = madd (smul r u) (smul s u) /\
              smul (rmul r s) u = smul r (smul s u) /\
              smul rone u = u) in
   let is_linear =
     \(ring_carrier:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)
      (source_carrier:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->bool)
      (source_zero:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)
      (source_add:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->
                  (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool))
      (source_smul:((num#O#M)->bool)->
                   (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool))
      (target_carrier:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->bool)
      (target_zero:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)
      (target_add:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->
                  (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool))
      (target_smul:((num#O#M)->bool)->
                   (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool))
      (linear:(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)).
       (!u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          source_carrier u ==> target_carrier (linear u)) /\
       linear source_zero = target_zero /\
       (!u v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          source_carrier u /\ source_carrier v
          ==> linear (source_add u v) =
              target_add (linear u) (linear v)) /\
       (!r:(num#O#M)->bool. !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
          ring_carrier r /\ source_carrier u
          ==> linear (source_smul r u) =
              target_smul r (linear u)) in
   !objects:O->bool. !morphisms:M->bool.
   !dom:M->O. !cod:M->O. !identity:O->M. !compose:M->M->M.
   !zero:O->O->M. !add:M->M->M. !neg:M->M.
     is_abelian_category objects morphisms dom cod identity compose
       zero add neg
     ==> ?ring_carrier:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
         ?rzero rone:(num#O#M)->bool.
         ?radd rmul:
            ((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool).
         ?rneg:((num#O#M)->bool)->((num#O#M)->bool).
         ?module_carrier:O->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->bool.
         ?module_zero:O->((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
         ?module_add:
            O->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->
               (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool).
         ?module_neg:
            O->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool).
         ?module_smul:
            O->((num#O#M)->bool)->
               (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool).
         ?functor_morphism:
            M->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool).
           is_ring ring_carrier rzero rone radd rmul rneg /\
           (!x:O.
              objects x
              ==> is_module ring_carrier rone radd rmul
                    (module_carrier x) (module_zero x)
                    (module_add x) (module_neg x) (module_smul x)) /\
           (!x y:O. !f:M.
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f
              ==> is_linear ring_carrier
                    (module_carrier x) (module_zero x)
                    (module_add x) (module_smul x)
                    (module_carrier y) (module_zero y)
                    (module_add y) (module_smul y)
                    (functor_morphism f)) /\
           (!x:O. !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
              objects x /\ module_carrier x u
              ==> functor_morphism (identity x) u = u) /\
           (!x y z:O. !f g:M. !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
              hom objects morphisms dom cod y z g /\
              module_carrier x u
              ==> functor_morphism (compose g f) u =
                  functor_morphism g (functor_morphism f u)) /\
           (!x y:O. !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
              objects x /\ objects y /\ module_carrier x u
              ==> functor_morphism (zero x y) u = module_zero y) /\
           (!x y:O. !f g:M. !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g /\
              module_carrier x u
              ==> functor_morphism (add f g) u =
                  module_add y
                    (functor_morphism f u) (functor_morphism g u)) /\
           (!x y:O.
              objects x /\ objects y
              ==> !linear:
                    (((num#O#M)->bool)->bool)->(((num#O#M)->bool)->bool).
                    is_linear ring_carrier
                      (module_carrier x) (module_zero x)
                      (module_add x) (module_smul x)
                      (module_carrier y) (module_zero y)
                      (module_add y) (module_smul y) linear
                    ==> ?f:M.
                          hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
                          !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                            module_carrier x u
                            ==> functor_morphism f u = linear u) /\
           (!x y:O. !f g:M.
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y f /\
              hom objects morphisms dom cod x y g /\
              (!u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                 module_carrier x u
                 ==> functor_morphism f u = functor_morphism g u)
              ==> f = g) /\
           (!z:O.
              is_zero_object objects morphisms dom cod z
              ==> !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                    module_carrier z u ==> u = module_zero z) /\
           (!x y p:O. !i1 i2 p1 p2:M.
              is_biproduct objects morphisms dom cod identity compose
                zero add x y p i1 i2 p1 p2
              ==> !u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                    !v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                      module_carrier x u /\ module_carrier y v
                      ==> ?w:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                            module_carrier p w /\
                            functor_morphism p1 w = u /\
                            functor_morphism p2 w = v /\
                            !w':((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                              module_carrier p w' /\
                              functor_morphism p1 w' = u /\
                              functor_morphism p2 w' = v
                              ==> w' = w) /\
           (!kobject a b:O. !k f:M.
              is_kernel objects morphisms dom cod compose zero
                kobject a b k f
              ==> (!u v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                     module_carrier kobject u /\
                     module_carrier kobject v /\
                     functor_morphism k u = functor_morphism k v
                     ==> u = v) /\
                  (!v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                     module_carrier a v
                     ==> (functor_morphism f v = module_zero b <=>
                          ?u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                            module_carrier kobject u /\
                            functor_morphism k u = v))) /\
           (!a b qobject:O. !f q:M.
              is_cokernel objects morphisms dom cod compose zero
                a b qobject f q
              ==> (!w:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                     module_carrier qobject w
                     ==> ?v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                           module_carrier b v /\
                           functor_morphism q v = w) /\
                  (!v:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                     module_carrier b v
                     ==> (functor_morphism q v = module_zero qobject <=>
                          ?u:((num#O#M)->bool)->bool.
                            module_carrier a u /\
                            functor_morphism f u = v)))`;;

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1148215,
;; "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every abelian category admits a full and
;; faithful functor into modules over a ring that preserves finite limits and
;; finite colimits. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Categories, rings, modules, and functors are explicit bundles of tame
;; ACL2 function objects.  Thus all structure quantified in the Lean theorem,
;; including the existential ring and functor, remains inside the statement.
;; Linear maps include every tame unary function satisfying the linear laws;
;; identity and composition are exact syntax constructors.  Equality of
;; linear maps below is pointwise equality, the ACL2 presentation of the
;; function-extensional equality used by ModuleCat.

(defun q1148215-app1 (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun q1148215-app2 (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun q1148215-app3 (function x y z)
  (apply$ function (list x y z)))

(defun q1148215-app4 (function w x y z)
  (apply$ function (list w x y z)))

(defun q1148215-app5 (function v w x y z)
  (apply$ function (list v w x y z)))

;; A category bundle contains, in order, predicates for objects and typed
;; morphisms, identity and composition operations, and the zero, addition,
;; and negation operations on hom groups.

(defun q1148215-category-structure-p (category)
  (and
   (true-listp category)
   (equal (len category) 7)
   (tamep-functionp (nth 0 category))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 1 category))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 2 category))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 3 category))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 4 category))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 5 category))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 6 category))))

(defun q1148215-object-p (category object)
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 0 category) object))

(defun q1148215-hom-p (category source target morphism)
  (q1148215-app3 (nth 1 category) source target morphism))

(defun q1148215-identity (category object)
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 2 category) object))

(defun q1148215-compose
    (category source middle target first second)
  (q1148215-app5
   (nth 3 category) source middle target first second))

(defun q1148215-zero-hom (category source target)
  (q1148215-app2 (nth 4 category) source target))

(defun q1148215-add-hom
    (category source target left right)
  (q1148215-app4
   (nth 5 category) source target left right))

(defun q1148215-negate-hom
    (category source target morphism)
  (q1148215-app3
   (nth 6 category) source target morphism))

;; A ring bundle contains a carrier predicate, zero, one, addition,
;; multiplication, and negation.

(defun q1148215-ring-structure-p (ring)
  (and
   (true-listp ring)
   (equal (len ring) 6)
   (tamep-functionp (nth 0 ring))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 3 ring))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 4 ring))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 5 ring))))

(defun q1148215-ring-element-p (ring value)
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 0 ring) value))

(defun q1148215-ring-zero (ring)
  (nth 1 ring))

(defun q1148215-ring-one (ring)
  (nth 2 ring))

(defun q1148215-ring-add (ring left right)
  (q1148215-app2 (nth 3 ring) left right))

(defun q1148215-ring-multiply (ring left right)
  (q1148215-app2 (nth 4 ring) left right))

(defun q1148215-ring-negate (ring value)
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 5 ring) value))

;; A module bundle contains a carrier predicate, zero, addition, negation,
;; and scalar multiplication.

(defun q1148215-module-structure-p (module)
  (and
   (true-listp module)
   (equal (len module) 5)
   (tamep-functionp (nth 0 module))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 2 module))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 3 module))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 4 module))))

(defun q1148215-module-element-p (ring module value)
  (declare (ignore ring))
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 0 module) value))

(defun q1148215-module-zero (ring module)
  (declare (ignore ring))
  (nth 1 module))

(defun q1148215-module-add (ring module left right)
  (declare (ignore ring))
  (q1148215-app2 (nth 2 module) left right))

(defun q1148215-module-negate (ring module value)
  (declare (ignore ring))
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 3 module) value))

(defun q1148215-module-smul (ring module scalar value)
  (declare (ignore ring))
  (q1148215-app2 (nth 4 module) scalar value))

;; A linear map is either a tame unary function, the identity constructor,
;; or a composition constructor.

(defun q1148215-linear-map-syntax-p (linear-map)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count linear-map)))
  (cond
   ((tamep-functionp linear-map) t)
   ((equal linear-map '(:identity)) t)
   ((and
     (consp linear-map)
     (equal (car linear-map) :compose)
     (consp (cdr linear-map))
     (consp (cddr linear-map))
     (null (cdddr linear-map)))
    (and
     (q1148215-linear-map-syntax-p (cadr linear-map))
     (q1148215-linear-map-syntax-p (caddr linear-map))))
   (t nil)))

(defun q1148215-linear-apply-core (linear-map value)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count linear-map)))
  (cond
   ((tamep-functionp linear-map)
    (q1148215-app1 linear-map value))
   ((equal linear-map '(:identity))
    value)
   ((and
     (consp linear-map)
     (equal (car linear-map) :compose)
     (consp (cdr linear-map))
     (consp (cddr linear-map))
     (null (cdddr linear-map)))
    (q1148215-linear-apply-core
     (caddr linear-map)
     (q1148215-linear-apply-core
      (cadr linear-map) value)))
   (t nil)))

(defun q1148215-linear-apply
    (ring source target linear-map value)
  (declare (ignore ring source target))
  (q1148215-linear-apply-core linear-map value))

(defun q1148215-linear-identity (ring module)
  (declare (ignore ring module))
  '(:identity))

(defun q1148215-linear-compose
    (ring source middle target first second)
  (declare (ignore ring source middle target))
  (list :compose first second))

;; A functor bundle contains an object map and a typed morphism map.

(defun q1148215-functor-structure-p (functor)
  (and
   (true-listp functor)
   (equal (len functor) 2)
   (tamep-functionp (nth 0 functor))
   (tamep-functionp (nth 1 functor))))

(defun q1148215-functor-object (functor object)
  (q1148215-app1 (nth 0 functor) object))

(defun q1148215-functor-morphism
    (functor source target morphism)
  (q1148215-app3 (nth 1 functor) source target morphism))

;; Categories and preadditive categories.

(defun-sk q1148215-category-laws-p (category)
  (forall (a b c d f g h)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1148215-hom-p category a b f)
      (and
       (q1148215-object-p category a)
       (q1148215-object-p category b)))
     (implies
      (q1148215-object-p category a)
      (q1148215-hom-p
       category a a (q1148215-identity category a)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1148215-hom-p category b c g))
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p
        category a c
        (q1148215-compose category a b c f g))
       (equal
        (q1148215-compose
         category a a b (q1148215-identity category a) f)
        f)
       (equal
        (q1148215-compose
         category a b b f (q1148215-identity category b))
        f)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1148215-hom-p category b c g)
       (q1148215-hom-p category c d h))
      (equal
       (q1148215-compose
        category a c d
        (q1148215-compose category a b c f g)
        h)
       (q1148215-compose
        category a b d
        f
        (q1148215-compose category b c d g h)))))))

(defun-sk q1148215-preadditive-laws-p (category)
  (forall (a b c f g h)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-object-p category a)
       (q1148215-object-p category b))
      (q1148215-hom-p
       category a b (q1148215-zero-hom category a b)))
     (implies
      (q1148215-hom-p category a b f)
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p
        category a b (q1148215-negate-hom category a b f))
       (equal
        (q1148215-add-hom
         category a b f (q1148215-zero-hom category a b))
        f)
       (equal
        (q1148215-add-hom
         category a b (q1148215-zero-hom category a b) f)
        f)
       (equal
        (q1148215-add-hom
         category a b f
         (q1148215-negate-hom category a b f))
        (q1148215-zero-hom category a b))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b g))
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p
        category a b (q1148215-add-hom category a b f g))
       (equal
        (q1148215-add-hom category a b f g)
        (q1148215-add-hom category a b g f))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b g)
       (q1148215-hom-p category a b h))
      (equal
       (q1148215-add-hom
        category a b
        (q1148215-add-hom category a b f g)
        h)
       (q1148215-add-hom
        category a b
        f
        (q1148215-add-hom category a b g h))))
     (implies
      (and

(defun-sk q1148215-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1148215-ring-element-p ring x)
      (and
       (q1148215-ring-element-p
        ring (q1148215-ring-negate ring x))
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring x (q1148215-ring-zero ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring (q1148215-ring-zero ring) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring x (q1148215-ring-negate ring x))
        (q1148215-ring-zero ring))
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-multiply
         ring x (q1148215-ring-one ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-multiply
         ring (q1148215-ring-one ring) x)
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-ring-element-p ring x)
       (q1148215-ring-element-p ring y))
      (and
       (q1148215-ring-element-p
        ring (q1148215-ring-add ring x y))
       (q1148215-ring-element-p
        ring (q1148215-ring-multiply ring x y))
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-add ring x y)
        (q1148215-ring-add ring y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1148215-ring-element-p ring x)
       (q1148215-ring-element-p ring y)
       (q1148215-ring-element-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring (q1148215-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring x (q1148215-ring-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-multiply
         ring (q1148215-ring-multiply ring x y) z)
        (q1148215-ring-multiply
         ring x (q1148215-ring-multiply ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-multiply
         ring x (q1148215-ring-add ring y z))
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring
         (q1148215-ring-multiply ring x y)
         (q1148215-ring-multiply ring x z)))
       (equal
        (q1148215-ring-multiply
         ring (q1148215-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q1148215-ring-add
         ring
         (q1148215-ring-multiply ring x z)
         (q1148215-ring-multiply ring y z))))))))

     (q1148215-embedding-witness-exists-p category))))
