:q

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1148215,
-- "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every abelian category admits a full,
-- faithful, finite-limit- and finite-colimit-preserving functor into a
-- category of modules over a ring. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _×_

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

PointwiseEqual :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
PointwiseEqual {A = A} f g =
  (x : A) → f x ≡ g x

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} →
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    enumeration : List A
    exhaustive  : (x : A) → Member x enumeration

record AbelianGroup
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zero            : A
    add             : A → A → A
    negate          : A → A
    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero :
      (x : A) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : A) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

record Ring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    additive-group : AbelianGroup R
    one             : R
    multiply        : R → R → R
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) →
      multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) →
      multiply x one ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply x (AbelianGroup.add additive-group y z) ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group
        (multiply x y)
        (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply (AbelianGroup.add additive-group x y) z ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group
        (multiply x z)
        (multiply y z)

record LeftModule
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : Ring R)
  (M : Set m) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    additive-group : AbelianGroup M
    scale          : R → M → M
    scale-add :
      (a : R) (x y : M) →
      scale a (AbelianGroup.add additive-group x y) ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group (scale a x) (scale a y)
    add-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) →
      scale
        (AbelianGroup.add (Ring.additive-group ring) a b)
        x
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group (scale a x) (scale b x)
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) →
      scale (Ring.multiply ring a b) x ≡ scale a (scale b x)
    one-scale :
      (x : M) →
      scale (Ring.one ring) x ≡ x

record ModuleObject
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : Ring R)
  (m : Level) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    Carrier          : Set m
    module-structure : LeftModule ring Carrier

record IsLinear
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {ring : Ring R}
  (M N : ModuleObject ring m)
  (function :
    ModuleObject.Carrier M →
    ModuleObject.Carrier N) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  private
    module M = LeftModule (ModuleObject.module-structure M)
    module N = LeftModule (ModuleObject.module-structure N)

  field
    map-add :
      (x y : ModuleObject.Carrier M) →
      function (AbelianGroup.add M.additive-group x y) ≡
      AbelianGroup.add N.additive-group (function x) (function y)
    map-scale :
      (a : R) (x : ModuleObject.Carrier M) →
      function (M.scale a x) ≡ N.scale a (function x)

record Category
  {o h : Level}
  (Object : Set o) :
  Set (o ⊔ lsuc h) where

  infixr 7 _after_

  field
    Hom      : Object → Object → Set h
    identity : (A : Object) → Hom A A
    _after_  :
      {A B C : Object} →
      Hom B C →
      Hom A B →
      Hom A C
    compose-associative :
      {A B C D : Object} →
      (h : Hom C D) →
      (g : Hom B C) →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      h after (g after f) ≡ (h after g) after f
    identity-left :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      identity B after f ≡ f
    identity-right :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      f after identity A ≡ f

record Preadditive
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    hom-additive-group :
      (A B : Object) →
      AbelianGroup (C.Hom A B)
    compose-add-left :
      {A B C : Object} →
      (f g : C.Hom B C) →
      (h : C.Hom A B) →
      C._after_
        (AbelianGroup.add (hom-additive-group B C) f g)
        h
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.add
        (hom-additive-group A C)
        (C._after_ f h)
        (C._after_ g h)
    compose-add-right :
      {A B C : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom B C) →
      (g h : C.Hom A B) →
      C._after_
        f
        (AbelianGroup.add (hom-additive-group A B) g h)
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.add
        (hom-additive-group A C)
        (C._after_ f g)
        (C._after_ f h)

ZeroMorphism :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object} →
  Preadditive category →
  (A B : Object) →
  Category.Hom category A B
ZeroMorphism preadditive A B =
  AbelianGroup.zero
    (Preadditive.hom-additive-group preadditive A B)

record ZeroObject
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    object : Object
    from   : (A : Object) → C.Hom object A
    to     : (A : Object) → C.Hom A object
    from-unique :
      (A : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom object A) →
      f ≡ from A
    to-unique :
      (A : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom A object) →
      f ≡ to A

record BinaryProduct
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object)
  (A B : Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    object     : Object
    projection-left  : C.Hom object A
    projection-right : C.Hom object B
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom X A) →
      (g : C.Hom X B) →
      Σ (C.Hom X object)
        (λ lift →
          (C._after_ projection-left lift ≡ f)
          ×
          ((C._after_ projection-right lift ≡ g)
          ×
          ((other : C.Hom X object) →
            C._after_ projection-left other ≡ f →
            C._after_ projection-right other ≡ g →
            other ≡ lift)))

record BinaryCoproduct
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object)
  (A B : Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    object    : Object
    injection-left  : C.Hom A object
    injection-right : C.Hom B object
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom A X) →
      (g : C.Hom B X) →
      Σ (C.Hom object X)
        (λ descend →
          (C._after_ descend injection-left ≡ f)
          ×
          ((C._after_ descend injection-right ≡ g)
          ×
          ((other : C.Hom object X) →
            C._after_ other injection-left ≡ f →
            C._after_ other injection-right ≡ g →
            other ≡ descend)))

record IsKernel
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  (preadditive : Preadditive category)
  {K A B : Object}
  (kernel-arrow : Category.Hom category K A)
  (arrow : Category.Hom category A B) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    annihilates :
      C._after_ arrow kernel-arrow ≡
      ZeroMorphism preadditive K B
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom X A) →
      C._after_ arrow f ≡ ZeroMorphism preadditive X B →
      Σ (C.Hom X K)
        (λ lift →
          (C._after_ kernel-arrow lift ≡ f)
          ×
          ((other : C.Hom X K) →
            C._after_ kernel-arrow other ≡ f →
            other ≡ lift))

record IsCokernel
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  (preadditive : Preadditive category)
  {A B Q : Object}
  (arrow : Category.Hom category A B)
  (cokernel-arrow : Category.Hom category B Q) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    annihilates :
      C._after_ cokernel-arrow arrow ≡
      ZeroMorphism preadditive A Q
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom B X) →
      C._after_ f arrow ≡ ZeroMorphism preadditive A X →
      Σ (C.Hom Q X)
        (λ descend →
          (C._after_ descend cokernel-arrow ≡ f)
          ×
          ((other : C.Hom Q X) →
            C._after_ other cokernel-arrow ≡ f →
            other ≡ descend))

Monomorphism :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  {A B : Object} →
  Category.Hom category A B →
  Set (o ⊔ h)
Monomorphism {Object = Object} category {A} arrow =
  (X : Object) →
  (f g : Category.Hom category X A) →
  Category._after_ category arrow f ≡
  Category._after_ category arrow g →
  f ≡ g

Epimorphism :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  {A B : Object} →
  Category.Hom category A B →
  Set (o ⊔ h)
Epimorphism {Object = Object} category {B = B} arrow =
  (X : Object) →
  (f g : Category.Hom category B X) →
  Category._after_ category f arrow ≡
  Category._after_ category g arrow →
  f ≡ g

record AbelianCategory
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Set (lsuc (o ⊔ h)) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    preadditive : Preadditive category
    zero-object : ZeroObject category
    binary-products :
      (A B : Object) →
      BinaryProduct category A B
    binary-coproducts :
      (A B : Object) →
      BinaryCoproduct category A B
    kernels :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      Σ Object
        (λ K →
          Σ (C.Hom K A)
            (λ kernel-arrow →
              IsKernel preadditive kernel-arrow f))
    cokernels :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      Σ Object
        (λ Q →
          Σ (C.Hom B Q)
            (λ cokernel-arrow →
              IsCokernel preadditive f cokernel-arrow))
    every-monomorphism-is-normal :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      Monomorphism category f →
      Σ Object
        (λ Q →
          Σ (C.Hom B Q)
            (λ g → IsKernel preadditive f g))
    every-epimorphism-is-normal :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      Epimorphism category f →
      Σ Object
        (λ K →
          Σ (C.Hom K A)
            (λ g → IsCokernel preadditive g f))

record Diagram
  {jo jh o h : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  (index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index)
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module C = Category category

  field
    object-map : Index → Object
    arrow-map :
      {i j : Index} →
      J.Hom i j →
      C.Hom (object-map i) (object-map j)
    map-identity :
      (i : Index) →
      arrow-map (J.identity i) ≡ C.identity (object-map i)
    map-compose :
      {i j k : Index} →
      (g : J.Hom j k) →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      arrow-map (J._after_ g f) ≡
      C._after_ (arrow-map g) (arrow-map f)

record FiniteCategory
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  field
    finite-objects : Finite Object
    finite-arrows :
      (A B : Object) →
      Finite (Category.Hom category A B)

record Cone
  {jo jh o h : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  (diagram : Diagram index-category category)
  (apex : Object) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module C = Category category
    module D = Diagram diagram

  field
    leg :
      (i : Index) →
      C.Hom apex (D.object-map i)
    natural :
      {i j : Index} →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      C._after_ (D.arrow-map f) (leg i) ≡ leg j

record IsLimit
  {jo jh o h : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  {diagram : Diagram index-category category}
  {apex : Object}
  (cone : Cone diagram apex) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (other : Cone diagram X) →
      Σ (C.Hom X apex)
        (λ factor →
          ((i : Index) →
            C._after_ (Cone.leg cone i) factor ≡
            Cone.leg other i)
          ×
          ((candidate : C.Hom X apex) →
            ((i : Index) →
              C._after_ (Cone.leg cone i) candidate ≡
              Cone.leg other i) →
            candidate ≡ factor))

record Cocone
  {jo jh o h : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  (diagram : Diagram index-category category)
  (apex : Object) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module C = Category category
    module D = Diagram diagram

  field
    leg :
      (i : Index) →
      C.Hom (D.object-map i) apex
    natural :
      {i j : Index} →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      C._after_ (leg j) (D.arrow-map f) ≡ leg i

record IsColimit
  {jo jh o h : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  {diagram : Diagram index-category category}
  {apex : Object}
  (cocone : Cocone diagram apex) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (other : Cocone diagram X) →
      Σ (C.Hom apex X)
        (λ factor →
          ((i : Index) →
            C._after_ factor (Cocone.leg cocone i) ≡
            Cocone.leg other i)
          ×
          ((candidate : C.Hom apex X) →
            ((i : Index) →
              C._after_ candidate (Cocone.leg cocone i) ≡
              Cocone.leg other i) →
            candidate ≡ factor))

record FunctorToModules
  {o h r m : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  {R : Set r}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object)
  (ring : Ring R) :
  Set (o ⊔ h ⊔ r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    object-map :
      Object →
      ModuleObject ring m
    arrow-map :
      {A B : Object} →
      C.Hom A B →
      ModuleObject.Carrier (object-map A) →
      ModuleObject.Carrier (object-map B)
    arrow-linear :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      IsLinear (object-map A) (object-map B) (arrow-map f)
    map-identity :
      (A : Object) →
      PointwiseEqual
        (arrow-map (C.identity A))
        (λ x → x)
    map-compose :
      {A B D : Object} →
      (g : C.Hom B D) →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      PointwiseEqual
        (arrow-map (C._after_ g f))
        (λ x → arrow-map g (arrow-map f x))

Full :
  {o h r m : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object} →
  {ring : Ring R} →
  FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring →
  Set (o ⊔ h ⊔ r ⊔ m)
Full {Object = Object} {category = category} functor =
  (A B : Object) →
  (function :
    ModuleObject.Carrier (FunctorToModules.object-map functor A) →
    ModuleObject.Carrier (FunctorToModules.object-map functor B)) →
  IsLinear
    (FunctorToModules.object-map functor A)
    (FunctorToModules.object-map functor B)
    function →
  Σ (Category.Hom category A B)
    (λ f →
      PointwiseEqual
        (FunctorToModules.arrow-map functor f)
        function)

Faithful :
  {o h r m : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object} →
  {ring : Ring R} →
  FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring →
  Set (o ⊔ h ⊔ m)
Faithful {Object = Object} {category = category} functor =
  (A B : Object) →
  (f g : Category.Hom category A B) →
  PointwiseEqual
    (FunctorToModules.arrow-map functor f)
    (FunctorToModules.arrow-map functor g) →
  f ≡ g

record ModuleCone
  {jo jh o h r m : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {R : Set r}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  {ring : Ring R}
  (functor : FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring)
  (diagram : Diagram index-category category)
  (apex : ModuleObject ring m) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h ⊔ r ⊔ m) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module D = Diagram diagram
    module F = FunctorToModules functor

  field
    leg :
      (i : Index) →
      ModuleObject.Carrier apex →
      ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map (D.object-map i))
    leg-linear :
      (i : Index) →
      IsLinear apex (F.object-map (D.object-map i)) (leg i)
    natural :
      {i j : Index} →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      (x : ModuleObject.Carrier apex) →
      F.arrow-map (D.arrow-map f) (leg i x) ≡ leg j x

record MappedConeIsLimit
  {jo jh o h r m : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {R : Set r}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {diagram : Diagram index-category category}
  {apex : Object}
  (functor : FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring)
  (cone : Cone diagram apex) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h ⊔ r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module D = Diagram diagram
    module F = FunctorToModules functor

  field
    mapped-cone-natural :
      {i j : Index} →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      (x : ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map apex)) →
      F.arrow-map (D.arrow-map f)
        (F.arrow-map (Cone.leg cone i) x)
      ≡
      F.arrow-map (Cone.leg cone j) x
    universal :
      (other-apex : ModuleObject ring m) →
      (other : ModuleCone functor diagram other-apex) →
      Σ
        (ModuleObject.Carrier other-apex →
         ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map apex))
        (λ factor →
          IsLinear other-apex (F.object-map apex) factor
          ×
          (((i : Index) →
            (x : ModuleObject.Carrier other-apex) →
            F.arrow-map (Cone.leg cone i) (factor x) ≡
            ModuleCone.leg other i x)
          ×
          ((candidate :
              ModuleObject.Carrier other-apex →
              ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map apex)) →
            IsLinear other-apex (F.object-map apex) candidate →
            ((i : Index) →
              (x : ModuleObject.Carrier other-apex) →
              F.arrow-map (Cone.leg cone i) (candidate x) ≡
              ModuleCone.leg other i x) →
            PointwiseEqual candidate factor)))

record ModuleCocone
  {jo jh o h r m : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {R : Set r}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  {ring : Ring R}
  (functor : FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring)
  (diagram : Diagram index-category category)
  (apex : ModuleObject ring m) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h ⊔ r ⊔ m) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module D = Diagram diagram
    module F = FunctorToModules functor

  field
    leg :
      (i : Index) →
      ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map (D.object-map i)) →
      ModuleObject.Carrier apex
    leg-linear :
      (i : Index) →
      IsLinear (F.object-map (D.object-map i)) apex (leg i)
    natural :
      {i j : Index} →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      (x :
        ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map (D.object-map i))) →
      leg j (F.arrow-map (D.arrow-map f) x) ≡ leg i x

record MappedCoconeIsColimit
  {jo jh o h r m : Level}
  {Index : Set jo}
  {Object : Set o}
  {R : Set r}
  {index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {diagram : Diagram index-category category}
  {apex : Object}
  (functor : FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring)
  (cocone : Cocone diagram apex) :
  Set (jo ⊔ jh ⊔ o ⊔ h ⊔ r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  private
    module J = Category index-category
    module D = Diagram diagram
    module F = FunctorToModules functor

  field
    mapped-cocone-natural :
      {i j : Index} →
      (f : J.Hom i j) →
      (x :
        ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map (D.object-map i))) →
      F.arrow-map (Cocone.leg cocone j)
        (F.arrow-map (D.arrow-map f) x)
      ≡
      F.arrow-map (Cocone.leg cocone i) x
    universal :
      (other-apex : ModuleObject ring m) →
      (other : ModuleCocone functor diagram other-apex) →
      Σ
        (ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map apex) →
         ModuleObject.Carrier other-apex)
        (λ factor →
          IsLinear (F.object-map apex) other-apex factor
          ×
          (((i : Index) →
            (x :
              ModuleObject.Carrier
                (F.object-map (D.object-map i))) →
            factor (F.arrow-map (Cocone.leg cocone i) x) ≡
            ModuleCocone.leg other i x)
          ×
          ((candidate :
              ModuleObject.Carrier (F.object-map apex) →
              ModuleObject.Carrier other-apex) →
            IsLinear (F.object-map apex) other-apex candidate →
            ((i : Index) →
              (x :
                ModuleObject.Carrier
                  (F.object-map (D.object-map i))) →
              candidate (F.arrow-map (Cocone.leg cocone i) x) ≡
              ModuleCocone.leg other i x) →
            PointwiseEqual candidate factor)))

PreservesFiniteLimits :
  {o h r m : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object} →
  {ring : Ring R} →
  FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring →
  Setω
PreservesFiniteLimits {Object = Object} functor =
  ∀ {jo jh : Level} →
  {Index : Set jo} →
  (index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index) →
  FiniteCategory index-category →
  (diagram : Diagram index-category _) →
  (apex : Object) →
  (cone : Cone diagram apex) →
  IsLimit cone →
  MappedConeIsLimit functor cone

PreservesFiniteColimits :
  {o h r m : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object} →
  {ring : Ring R} →
  FunctorToModules {m = m} category ring →
  Setω
PreservesFiniteColimits {Object = Object} functor =
  ∀ {jo jh : Level} →
  {Index : Set jo} →
  (index-category : Category {jo} {jh} Index) →
  FiniteCategory index-category →
  (diagram : Diagram index-category _) →
  (apex : Object) →
  (cocone : Cocone diagram apex) →
  IsColimit cocone →
  MappedCoconeIsColimit functor cocone

record MitchellEmbedding
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Setω where

  field
    RingCarrier : Set (o ⊔ h)
    ring :
      Ring RingCarrier
    functor :
      FunctorToModules
        {m = o ⊔ h}
        category
        ring
    full :
      Full functor
    faithful :
      Faithful functor
    preserves-finite-limits :
      PreservesFiniteLimits functor
    preserves-finite-colimits :
      PreservesFiniteColimits functor

mitchell-s-embedding-theorem : Setω
mitchell-s-embedding-theorem =
  ∀ {o h : Level} →
  (Object : Set o) →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  AbelianCategory category →
  MitchellEmbedding category

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1148215 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1148215), "Mitchell's embedding
  theorem": every abelian category admits a full and faithful functor into
  modules over some ring that preserves finite limits and finite colimits.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q1148215_category_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_category_def",
  ``q1148215_category
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (id : 'o -> 'm) (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==> dom f IN objects /\ cod f IN objects) /\
      (!x. x IN objects ==>
        id x IN morphisms /\ dom (id x) = x /\ cod (id x) = x) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ cod f = dom g
        ==>
        comp g f IN morphisms /\
        dom (comp g f) = dom f /\
        cod (comp g f) = cod g) /\
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
        comp f (id (dom f)) = f /\
        comp (id (cod f)) f = f) /\
      (!f g h.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
        cod f = dom g /\ cod g = dom h
        ==>
        comp h (comp g f) = comp (comp h g) f)``);

val q1148215_preadditive_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_preadditive_def",
  ``q1148215_preadditive
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (zero : 'o -> 'o -> 'm)
      (add : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (neg : 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!x y.
        x IN objects /\ y IN objects
        ==>
        zero x y IN morphisms /\
        dom (zero x y) = x /\ cod (zero x y) = y) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\
        dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g
        ==>
        add f g IN morphisms /\
        dom (add f g) = dom f /\ cod (add f g) = cod f) /\
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
        neg f IN morphisms /\
        dom (neg f) = dom f /\ cod (neg f) = cod f) /\
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
        add (zero (dom f) (cod f)) f = f /\
        add (neg f) f = zero (dom f) (cod f)) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\
        dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g
        ==>
        add f g = add g f) /\
      (!f g h.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
        dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g /\
        dom g = dom h /\ cod g = cod h
        ==>
        add (add f g) h = add f (add g h)) /\
      (!f g h.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
        dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g /\ cod f = dom h
        ==>
        comp h (add f g) = add (comp h f) (comp h g)) /\
      (!f g h.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
        cod f = dom g /\ dom g = dom h /\ cod g = cod h
        ==>
        comp (add g h) f = add (comp g f) (comp h f))``);

val q1148215_zero_object_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_zero_object_def",
  ``q1148215_zero_object
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o) (z : 'o) <=>
      z IN objects /\
      (!x. x IN objects ==>
        ?f. f IN morphisms /\ dom f = z /\ cod f = x /\
            !g. g IN morphisms /\ dom g = z /\ cod g = x ==> g = f) /\
      (!x. x IN objects ==>
        ?f. f IN morphisms /\ dom f = x /\ cod f = z /\
            !g. g IN morphisms /\ dom g = x /\ cod g = z ==> g = f)``);

val q1148215_biproduct_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_biproduct_def",
  ``q1148215_biproduct
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (id : 'o -> 'm) (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (zero : 'o -> 'o -> 'm) (add : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (x : 'o) (y : 'o) (b : 'o)
      (i1 : 'm) (i2 : 'm) (p1 : 'm) (p2 : 'm) <=>
      b IN objects /\
      i1 IN morphisms /\ dom i1 = x /\ cod i1 = b /\
      i2 IN morphisms /\ dom i2 = y /\ cod i2 = b /\
      p1 IN morphisms /\ dom p1 = b /\ cod p1 = x /\
      p2 IN morphisms /\ dom p2 = b /\ cod p2 = y /\
      comp p1 i1 = id x /\
      comp p2 i2 = id y /\
      comp p1 i2 = zero y x /\
      comp p2 i1 = zero x y /\
      add (comp i1 p1) (comp i2 p2) = id b``);

val q1148215_kernel_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_kernel_def",
  ``q1148215_kernel
      (morphisms : 'm set) (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (zero : 'o -> 'o -> 'm)
      (k : 'm) (f : 'm) <=>
      k IN morphisms /\ f IN morphisms /\ cod k = dom f /\
      comp f k = zero (dom k) (cod f) /\
      !h. h IN morphisms /\ cod h = dom f /\
          comp f h = zero (dom h) (cod f)
          ==>
          ?u. u IN morphisms /\ dom u = dom h /\ cod u = dom k /\
              comp k u = h /\
              !v. v IN morphisms /\ dom v = dom h /\ cod v = dom k /\
                  comp k v = h ==> v = u``);

val q1148215_cokernel_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_cokernel_def",
  ``q1148215_cokernel
      (morphisms : 'm set) (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (zero : 'o -> 'o -> 'm)
      (f : 'm) (q : 'm) <=>
      f IN morphisms /\ q IN morphisms /\ cod f = dom q /\
      comp q f = zero (dom f) (cod q) /\
      !h. h IN morphisms /\ dom h = cod f /\
          comp h f = zero (dom f) (cod h)
          ==>
          ?u. u IN morphisms /\ dom u = cod q /\ cod u = cod h /\
              comp u q = h /\
              !v. v IN morphisms /\ dom v = cod q /\ cod v = cod h /\
                  comp v q = h ==> v = u``);

val q1148215_monomorphism_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_monomorphism_def",
  ``q1148215_monomorphism
      (morphisms : 'm set) (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (f : 'm) <=>
      f IN morphisms /\
      !g h. g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
            cod g = dom f /\ cod h = dom f /\ dom g = dom h /\
            comp f g = comp f h
            ==> g = h``);

val q1148215_epimorphism_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_epimorphism_def",
  ``q1148215_epimorphism
      (morphisms : 'm set) (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (f : 'm) <=>
      f IN morphisms /\
      !g h. g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
            dom g = cod f /\ dom h = cod f /\ cod g = cod h /\
            comp g f = comp h f
            ==> g = h``);

val q1148215_abelian_category_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_abelian_category_def",
  ``q1148215_abelian_category
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (id : 'o -> 'm) (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (zero : 'o -> 'o -> 'm)
      (add : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (neg : 'm -> 'm) <=>
      q1148215_category objects morphisms dom cod id comp /\
      q1148215_preadditive objects morphisms dom cod comp zero add neg /\
      (?z. q1148215_zero_object objects morphisms dom cod z) /\
      (!x y. x IN objects /\ y IN objects ==>
        ?b i1 i2 p1 p2.
          q1148215_biproduct objects morphisms dom cod id comp zero add
            x y b i1 i2 p1 p2) /\
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
        ?k. q1148215_kernel morphisms dom cod comp zero k f) /\
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
        ?q. q1148215_cokernel morphisms dom cod comp zero f q) /\
      (!f. q1148215_monomorphism morphisms dom cod comp f ==>
        ?g. q1148215_kernel morphisms dom cod comp zero f g) /\
      (!f. q1148215_epimorphism morphisms dom cod comp f ==>
        ?g. q1148215_cokernel morphisms dom cod comp zero g f)``);

val q1148215_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_ring_def",
  ``q1148215_ring
      (carrier : 'a set) (zero : 'a) (rone_value : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      zero IN carrier /\ rone_value IN carrier /\
      (!x y. x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==>
        add x y IN carrier /\ mul x y IN carrier) /\
      (!x. x IN carrier ==> neg x IN carrier) /\
      (!x. x IN carrier ==>
        add zero x = x /\ add (neg x) x = zero /\
        mul rone_value x = x /\ mul x rone_value = x) /\
      (!x y. x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==> add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier ==>
        add (add x y) z = add x (add y z) /\
        mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z) /\
        mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z) /\
        mul (add x y) z = add (mul x z) (mul y z))``);

val q1148215_module_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_module_def",
  ``q1148215_module
      (rcarrier : 'r set) (rzero : 'r) (rone : 'r)
      (radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mcarrier : 'a set) (mzero : 'a)
      (madd : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mneg : 'a -> 'a)
      (smul : 'r -> 'a -> 'a) <=>
      mzero IN mcarrier /\
      (!x y. x IN mcarrier /\ y IN mcarrier ==> madd x y IN mcarrier) /\
      (!x. x IN mcarrier ==> mneg x IN mcarrier) /\
      (!r x. r IN rcarrier /\ x IN mcarrier ==> smul r x IN mcarrier) /\
      (!x. x IN mcarrier ==>
        madd mzero x = x /\ madd (mneg x) x = mzero) /\
      (!x y. x IN mcarrier /\ y IN mcarrier ==> madd x y = madd y x) /\
      (!x y z. x IN mcarrier /\ y IN mcarrier /\ z IN mcarrier ==>
        madd (madd x y) z = madd x (madd y z)) /\
      (!x. x IN mcarrier ==>
        smul rone x = x /\ smul rzero x = mzero) /\
      (!r s x. r IN rcarrier /\ s IN rcarrier /\ x IN mcarrier ==>
        smul (radd r s) x = madd (smul r x) (smul s x) /\
        smul (rmul r s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. r IN rcarrier /\ x IN mcarrier /\ y IN mcarrier ==>
        smul r (madd x y) = madd (smul r x) (smul r y))``);

val q1148215_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q1148215_linear_def",
  ``q1148215_linear
      (rcarrier : 'r set) (mcarrier : 'o -> 'a set)
      (mzero : 'o -> 'a) (madd : 'o -> 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (smul : 'o -> 'r -> 'a -> 'a)
      (x : 'o) (y : 'o) (f : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!a. a IN mcarrier x ==> f a IN mcarrier y) /\
      f (mzero x) = mzero y /\
      (!a b. a IN mcarrier x /\ b IN mcarrier x ==>
        f (madd x a b) = madd y (f a) (f b)) /\
      (!r a. r IN rcarrier /\ a IN mcarrier x ==>
        f (smul x r a) = smul y r (f a))``);

(*
  HOL cannot existentially quantify over carrier types. Let kappa bound the
  object and arrow carriers and num. The standard small-category construction
  admits ring codes in a powerset of kappa; a further powerset is sufficient
  for all module carriers. The types below retain that carrier freedom instead
  of identifying ring elements and module vectors.
*)
val freyd_mitchell =
  ``!(objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (id : 'o -> 'm) (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (zero : 'o -> 'o -> 'm)
      (add : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (neg : 'm -> 'm).
      q1148215_abelian_category
        objects morphisms dom cod id comp zero add neg
      ==>
      ?(rcarrier : (('o # 'm # num) set) set)
       (rzero : ('o # 'm # num) set)
       (rone : ('o # 'm # num) set)
       (radd : ('o # 'm # num) set ->
               ('o # 'm # num) set -> ('o # 'm # num) set)
       (rmul : ('o # 'm # num) set ->
               ('o # 'm # num) set -> ('o # 'm # num) set)
       (rneg : ('o # 'm # num) set -> ('o # 'm # num) set)
       (mcarrier : 'o -> ((('o # 'm # num) set) set) set)
       (mzero : 'o -> (('o # 'm # num) set) set)
       (madd : 'o -> (('o # 'm # num) set) set ->
               (('o # 'm # num) set) set ->
               (('o # 'm # num) set) set)
       (mneg : 'o -> (('o # 'm # num) set) set ->
               (('o # 'm # num) set) set)
       (smul : 'o -> ('o # 'm # num) set ->
               (('o # 'm # num) set) set ->
               (('o # 'm # num) set) set)
       (fmap : 'm -> (('o # 'm # num) set) set ->
               (('o # 'm # num) set) set).
        q1148215_ring rcarrier rzero rone radd rmul rneg /\
        (!x. x IN objects ==>
          q1148215_module rcarrier rzero rone radd rmul
            (mcarrier x) (mzero x) (madd x) (mneg x) (smul x)) /\
        (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
          q1148215_linear rcarrier mcarrier mzero madd smul
            (dom f) (cod f) (fmap f)) /\
        (!x a. x IN objects /\ a IN mcarrier x ==>
          fmap (id x) a = a) /\
        (!f g a.
          f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ cod f = dom g /\
          a IN mcarrier (dom f)
          ==>
          fmap (comp g f) a = fmap g (fmap f a)) /\
        (!x y h.
          x IN objects /\ y IN objects /\
          q1148215_linear rcarrier mcarrier mzero madd smul x y h
          ==>
          ?f. f IN morphisms /\ dom f = x /\ cod f = y /\
              !a. a IN mcarrier x ==> fmap f a = h a) /\
        (!f g.
          f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\
          dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g /\
          (!a. a IN mcarrier (dom f) ==> fmap f a = fmap g a)
          ==>
          f = g) /\
        (!x y a.
          x IN objects /\ y IN objects /\ a IN mcarrier x
          ==>
          fmap (zero x y) a = mzero y) /\
        (!f g a.
          f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\
          dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g /\
          a IN mcarrier (dom f)
          ==>
          fmap (add f g) a = madd (cod f) (fmap f a) (fmap g a)) /\
        (!k f.
          q1148215_kernel morphisms dom cod comp zero k f
          ==>
          (!a b. a IN mcarrier (dom k) /\ b IN mcarrier (dom k) /\
                 fmap k a = fmap k b ==> a = b) /\
          (!x. x IN mcarrier (dom f) ==>
            (fmap f x = mzero (cod f) <=>
             ?a. a IN mcarrier (dom k) /\ fmap k a = x))) /\
        (!f q.
          q1148215_cokernel morphisms dom cod comp zero f q
          ==>
          (!y. y IN mcarrier (cod q) ==>
            ?x. x IN mcarrier (dom q) /\ fmap q x = y) /\
          (!x. x IN mcarrier (dom q) ==>
            (fmap q x = mzero (cod q) <=>
             ?a. a IN mcarrier (dom f) /\ fmap f a = x)))``;

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1148215
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1148215), "Mitchell's embedding theorem":
  every abelian category admits a full and faithful functor into modules over
  a ring which preserves finite limits and finite colimits. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  All objects in this encoding are sets. A category, ring, and module-valued
  functor are finite records represented by actual SetMM functions. Their
  fields, morphisms, scalars, vectors, and linear maps therefore use native
  set equality, with the substitutivity and extensionality of SetMM.

  Q1148215Abelian expands the standard small set-coded definition: a
  preadditive category with a zero object, binary biproducts, kernels and
  cokernels, in which every monomorphism is a kernel and every epimorphism is
  a cokernel. Q1148215Functor describes modules over one ring on every source
  object and an additive functorial action on every source morphism.

  Q1148215Linear recognizes every actual function between two module
  carriers which preserves addition and scalar multiplication.
  Q1148215Full quantifies over all sets L, so its implication ranges over
  every such linear function, not over a selected collection of codes.

  For an additive functor between abelian categories, preservation of finite
  limits is equivalent to preservation of kernels, and preservation of finite
  colimits is equivalent to preservation of cokernels. The two preservation
  predicates use these equivalent characterizations in modules: an image of
  a kernel is injective with range the algebraic kernel, and an image of a
  cokernel is surjective with algebraic kernel equal to the preceding image.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement. There is no $p proof statement in this file.
$)

$c Q1148215Obj Q1148215Arr Q1148215Src Q1148215Tgt
   Q1148215Id Q1148215Comp Q1148215Zero Q1148215Add Q1148215Neg $.
$c Q1148215Hom Q1148215Category Q1148215HomAbGroup
   Q1148215Preadditive Q1148215ZeroObject Q1148215Biproduct
   Q1148215Kernel Q1148215Cokernel Q1148215Mono Q1148215Epi
   Q1148215Abelian $.
$c Q1148215Scalars Q1148215RZero Q1148215ROne
   Q1148215RAdd Q1148215RMul Q1148215RNeg Q1148215Ring $.
$c Q1148215Vectors Q1148215VZero Q1148215VAdd
   Q1148215VNeg Q1148215SMul Q1148215FMap $.
$c Q1148215Module Q1148215Linear Q1148215Functor
   Q1148215Additive Q1148215Full Q1148215Faithful
   Q1148215PresFinLim Q1148215PresFinColim $.

    ( Q1148215Linear E R X Y L )
    <->
    (
      L : ( Q1148215Vectors E X ) --> ( Q1148215Vectors E Y )
      /\
      (
        ( L ` ( Q1148215VZero E X ) ) = ( Q1148215VZero E Y )
        /\
        A. u e. ( Q1148215Vectors E X )
          A. v e. ( Q1148215Vectors E X )
            A. a e. ( Q1148215Scalars R )

${
  $d C E R W X Y Z f g u $.

  q1148215-functor-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1148215Functor C R E )
    <->
    (
      (
        ( Q1148215Category C )
        /\
        ( Q1148215Ring R )
      )
      /\
      (
        E Fn ( 0 ..^ 6 )
        /\
        (
          ( E ` 0 ) Fn ( Q1148215Obj C )
          /\
          (
            ( E ` 1 ) Fn ( Q1148215Obj C )
            /\
            (
              ( E ` 2 ) Fn ( Q1148215Obj C )
              /\
              (
                ( E ` 3 ) Fn ( Q1148215Obj C )
                /\
                (
                  ( E ` 4 ) Fn ( Q1148215Obj C )
                  /\
                  ( E ` 5 ) Fn ( Q1148215Arr C )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        A. X e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
          ( Q1148215Module E R X )
        /\
        A. f e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
          (
            Q1148215Linear E R
              ( Q1148215Src C f ) ( Q1148215Tgt C f )
              ( Q1148215FMap E f )

      /\
      (
        A. X e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
          (
            ( Q1148215FMap E ( Q1148215Id C X ) )
            =

          )
        /\
        A. W e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
          A. X e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
            A. Y e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
              A. f e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
                A. g e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
                  (
                    (
                      ( Q1148215Hom C f W X )
                      /\
                      ( Q1148215Hom C g X Y )

                    (
                      Q1148215FMap E ( Q1148215Comp C g f )

                      ( Q1148215FMap E g )

                      ( Q1148215FMap E f )

${
  $d C E R X Y f g u $.

  q1148215-additive-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1148215Additive C R E )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1148215Functor C R E )
      /\
      A. X e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
        A. Y e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
          (
            (
              Q1148215FMap E ( Q1148215Zero C X Y )
            )
            =
            (
              u e. ( Q1148215Vectors E X )
              |->
              ( Q1148215VZero E Y )
            )
            /\
            A. f e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
              A. g e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
                (
                  (
                    ( Q1148215Hom C f X Y )
                    /\
                    ( Q1148215Hom C g X Y )
                  )

                    Q1148215FMap E ( Q1148215Add C f g )
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    u e. ( Q1148215Vectors E X )
                    |->
                    (
                      Q1148215VAdd E Y
                        ( ( Q1148215FMap E f ) ` u )
                        ( ( Q1148215FMap E g ) ` u )
                    )

${
  $d C E L R X Y f $.

  q1148215-full-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1148215Full C R E )
    <->
    A. X e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
      A. Y e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
        A. L
          (

            ->

${
  $d C E R X Y f g $.

  q1148215-faithful-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1148215Faithful C R E )
    <->
    A. X e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
      A. Y e. ( Q1148215Obj C )
        A. f e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
          A. g e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( Q1148215Hom C f X Y )
                  /\
                  ( Q1148215Hom C g X Y )

                /\
                ( Q1148215FMap E f ) = ( Q1148215FMap E g )

${
  $d C E R f k u $.

  q1148215-pres-fin-lim-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1148215PresFinLim C R E )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1148215Additive C R E )
      /\
      A. f e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
        A. k e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
          (
            ( Q1148215Kernel C k f )
            ->
            (
              ( Q1148215FMap E k )
                : ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Src C k ) )
                -1-1->
                ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Src C f ) )
              /\
              ran ( Q1148215FMap E k )
              =
              {
                u e. ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Src C f ) )
                |
                (
                  ( Q1148215FMap E f ) ` u
                )
                =
                ( Q1148215VZero E ( Q1148215Tgt C f ) )

            )
          )
