$}

${
  $d C E R f q u $.

  q1148215-pres-fin-colim-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1148215PresFinColim C R E )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1148215Additive C R E )
      /\
      A. f e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
        A. q e. ( Q1148215Arr C )
          (
            ( Q1148215Cokernel C q f )
            ->
            (
              ( Q1148215FMap E q )
                : ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Tgt C f ) )
                -onto->
                ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Tgt C q ) )
              /\
              {
                u e. ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Tgt C f ) )
                |
                (
                  ( Q1148215FMap E q ) ` u
                )
                =
                ( Q1148215VZero E ( Q1148215Tgt C q ) )
              }
              =
              (
                ( Q1148215FMap E f )
                "
                ( Q1148215Vectors E ( Q1148215Src C f ) )
              )
            )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C E R $.

  q1148215-mitchell-embedding-theorem $a |- A. C
    (
      ( Q1148215Abelian C )
      ->
      E. R E. E
        (
          ( Q1148215Functor C R E )
          /\
          (
            ( Q1148215Full C R E )
            /\
            (
              ( Q1148215Faithful C R E )
              /\
              (
                ( Q1148215PresFinLim C R E )
                /\
                ( Q1148215PresFinColim C R E )
              )
            )
          )
        )
    ) $.
$}

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1148215,
:: "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every abelian category admits a full,
:: faithful, finite-limit- and finite-colimit-preserving embedding into a
:: category of modules over a ring. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies XBOOLE_0, CLASSES2, FUNCSDOM, VECTSP_2, SUBSET_1, STRUCT_0,
      MOD_2, MIDSP_1, CAT_1, GRCAT_1, FUNCT_2, ENS_1, RELAT_1, GRAPH_1,
      FUNCT_1, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1, ZFMISC_1, MCART_1, TARSKI, ARYTM_3,
      PARTFUN1, MODCAT_1, MSSUBFAM, UNIALG_1, MONOID_0, RELAT_2, BINOP_1,
      CARD_1, FUNCOP_1, CAT_3, CAT_4;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, SETFAM_1, RELSET_1,
      ORDINAL1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCT_3, BINOP_1, FUNCT_5,
      FUNCOP_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, GRAPH_1, CAT_1,
      CAT_3, CAT_4, CLASSES2, GRCAT_1, MOD_2, MODCAT_1;
 constructors GRCAT_1, MOD_2, RELSET_1, FUNCT_5, FUNCOP_1, CAT_1, CAT_3,
      CAT_4, MODCAT_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, RELSET_1, STRUCT_0, CAT_1, VECTSP_2, GRCAT_1,
      MOD_2, MODCAT_1;
 requirements SUBSET, BOOLE;
 definitions CAT_1, CAT_3, CAT_4;
 equalities FUNCOP_1, ALGSTR_0, MOD_2, GRAPH_1, CAT_1, ORDINAL1;
 expansions CAT_1, CAT_3, CAT_4;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for C being Category,
      A being Function of [:the carrier' of C,the carrier' of C:],
        the carrier' of C,
      N being UnOp of the carrier' of C,
      Z being Function of [:the carrier of C,the carrier of C:],
        the carrier' of C
  st
    (for a,b being Object of C holds Z.[a,b] in Hom(a,b)) &
    (for a,b being Object of C,
         f,g,h being Morphism of a,b st Hom(a,b) <> {}
    holds
      A.[f,g] in Hom(a,b) & N.f in Hom(a,b) &
      A.[f,g] = A.[g,f] &
      A.[A.[f,g],h] = A.[f,A.[g,h]] &
      A.[f,Z.[a,b]] = f &
      A.[f,N.f] = Z.[a,b]) &
    (for a,b,c being Object of C,
         f1,f2,x being Morphism of a,b,
         g1,g2,y being Morphism of b,c st
      Hom(a,b) <> {} & Hom(b,c) <> {} &
      x = A.[f1,f2] & y = A.[g1,g2]
    holds
      g1*x = A.[g1*f1,g1*f2] &
      y*f1 = A.[g1*f1,g2*f1]) &
    C is with_finite_product &
    C is with_finite_coproduct &
    (ex z being Object of C st z is initial terminal) &
    (for a,b being Object of C, f being Morphism of a,b st Hom(a,b) <> {}
      holds
      (ex x,y being Object of C,
          k being Morphism of x,a, q being Morphism of b,y st
        Hom(x,a) <> {} & Hom(b,y) <> {} &
        f*k = Z.[x,b] &
        (for d being Object of C, h being Morphism of d,a st
          Hom(d,a) <> {} & f*h = Z.[d,b]
        holds ex u being Morphism of d,x st
          Hom(d,x) <> {} & k*u = h &
          (for v being Morphism of d,x st k*v = h holds v = u)) &
        q*f = Z.[a,y] &
        (for d being Object of C, h being Morphism of b,d st
          Hom(b,d) <> {} & h*f = Z.[a,d]
        holds ex u being Morphism of y,d st
          Hom(y,d) <> {} & u*q = h &
          (for v being Morphism of y,d st v*q = h holds v = u)))) &
    (for a,b being Object of C, m being Morphism of a,b st
      Hom(a,b) <> {} & m is monic
    holds ex y being Object of C, q being Morphism of b,y st
      Hom(b,y) <> {} & q*m = Z.[a,y] &
      (for d being Object of C, h being Morphism of d,b st
        Hom(d,b) <> {} & q*h = Z.[d,y]
      holds ex u being Morphism of d,a st
        Hom(d,a) <> {} & m*u = h &
        (for v being Morphism of d,a st m*v = h holds v = u))) &
    (for a,b being Object of C, e being Morphism of a,b st
      Hom(a,b) <> {} & e is epi
    holds ex x being Object of C, k being Morphism of x,a st
      Hom(x,a) <> {} & e*k = Z.[x,b] &
      (for d being Object of C, h being Morphism of a,d st
        Hom(a,d) <> {} & h*k = Z.[x,d]
      holds ex u being Morphism of b,d st
        Hom(b,d) <> {} & u*e = h &
        (for v being Morphism of b,d st v*e = h holds v = u)))
  holds
    ex UN being Universe st
    ex R being Ring st
    ex D being Category st D = LModCat(UN,R) &
    ex F being Functor of C,D st
      F is full faithful &
      (for t being Object of C st t is terminal
        holds F.t is terminal) &
      (for c being Object of C, p1,p2 being Morphism of C st
        c is_a_product_wrt p1,p2
      holds F.c is_a_product_wrt F.p1,F.p2) &
      (for a,b,x being Object of C, e being Morphism of x,a,
           f,g being Morphism of a,b st
        Hom(x,a) <> {} & Hom(a,b) <> {} & f*e = g*e &
        (for d being Object of C, h being Morphism of d,a st
          Hom(d,a) <> {} & f*h = g*h
        holds ex u being Morphism of d,x st
          Hom(d,x) <> {} & e*u = h &
          (for v being Morphism of d,x st e*v = h holds v = u))
      holds
        for aa,bb,xx being Object of D,
            ee being Morphism of xx,aa,
            ff,gg being Morphism of aa,bb st
          ee = F.e & ff = F.f & gg = F.g
        holds
          Hom(xx,aa) <> {} & Hom(aa,bb) <> {} & ff*ee = gg*ee &
          (for dd being Object of D,
               h being Morphism of dd,aa st
            Hom(dd,aa) <> {} & ff*h = gg*h
          holds ex u being Morphism of dd,xx st
            Hom(dd,xx) <> {} & ee*u = h &
            (for v being Morphism of dd,xx st ee*v = h holds v = u))) &
      (for i being Object of C st i is initial
        holds F.i is initial) &
      (for c being Object of C, i1,i2 being Morphism of C st
        c is_a_coproduct_wrt i1,i2
      holds F.c is_a_coproduct_wrt F.i1,F.i2) &
      (for a,b,y being Object of C, q being Morphism of b,y,
           f,g being Morphism of a,b st
        Hom(a,b) <> {} & Hom(b,y) <> {} & q*f = q*g &
        (for d being Object of C, h being Morphism of b,d st
          Hom(b,d) <> {} & h*f = h*g
        holds ex u being Morphism of y,d st
          Hom(y,d) <> {} & u*q = h &
          (for v being Morphism of y,d st v*q = h holds v = u))
      holds
        for aa,bb,yy being Object of D,
            qq being Morphism of bb,yy,
            ff,gg being Morphism of aa,bb st
          qq = F.q & ff = F.f & gg = F.g
        holds
          Hom(aa,bb) <> {} & Hom(bb,yy) <> {} & qq*ff = qq*gg &
          (for dd being Object of D,
               h being Morphism of bb,dd st
            Hom(bb,dd) <> {} & h*ff = h*gg
          holds ex u being Morphism of yy,dd st
            Hom(yy,dd) <> {} & u*qq = h &
            (for v being Morphism of yy,dd st v*qq = h holds v = u)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
% Q1148215, "Mitchell's embedding theorem": every abelian category admits a
% full and faithful embedding into modules over a ring that preserves finite
% limits and finite colimits. This file contains no proof.

Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem[
  Object, Morphism: TYPE+,
  object_p: [Object -> bool],
  morphism_p: [Morphism -> bool],
  dom, cod: [Morphism -> Object],
  identity: [Object -> Morphism],
  compose: [Morphism, Morphism -> Morphism],
  zero_arrow: [Object, Object -> Morphism],
  add_arrow: [Morphism, Morphism -> Morphism],
  neg_arrow: [Morphism -> Morphism]
]: THEORY

BEGIN

  atom: TYPE = [Object, Morphism, nat]
  code: TYPE = [atom -> bool]
  code_set: TYPE = [code -> bool]
  code_unary: TYPE = [code -> code]
  code_binary: TYPE = [code, code -> code]

  % PVS cannot existentially quantify over carrier types. If kappa bounds the
  % object and arrow carriers and nat, code has powerset cardinality 2^kappa.
  % A second powerset gives enough room for module vectors independently of
  % the embedding ring's carrier.
  module_code: TYPE = [code -> bool]
  module_code_unary: TYPE = [module_code -> module_code]
  module_carrier_family: TYPE = [Object, module_code -> bool]
  module_zero_family: TYPE = [Object -> module_code]
  module_unary_family: TYPE = [Object, module_code -> module_code]
  module_binary_family: TYPE =
    [Object, module_code, module_code -> module_code]
  scalar_family: TYPE = [Object, code, module_code -> module_code]
  morphism_map_family: TYPE = [Morphism, module_code -> module_code]

  hom(f: Morphism, X, Y: Object): bool =
    object_p(X) AND object_p(Y) AND morphism_p(f)
      AND dom(f) = X AND cod(f) = Y

  category_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (f: Morphism):
      morphism_p(f) IMPLIES object_p(dom(f)) AND object_p(cod(f)))
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object):
      object_p(X) IMPLIES hom(identity(X), X, X))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y, Z: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, Y, Z)
        IMPLIES hom(compose(g, f), X, Z))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) IMPLIES
        compose(identity(Y), f) = f
          AND compose(f, identity(X)) = f)
    AND
    (FORALL (W, X, Y, Z: Object), (f, g, h: Morphism):
      hom(f, W, X) AND hom(g, X, Y) AND hom(h, Y, Z)
        IMPLIES
          compose(h, compose(g, f)) = compose(compose(h, g), f))

  preadditive_laws: bool =
    category_laws
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object):
      object_p(X) AND object_p(Y) IMPLIES hom(zero_arrow(X, Y), X, Y))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) IMPLIES hom(neg_arrow(f), X, Y))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, X, Y)
        IMPLIES hom(add_arrow(f, g), X, Y))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) IMPLIES
        add_arrow(zero_arrow(X, Y), f) = f
          AND add_arrow(f, zero_arrow(X, Y)) = f
          AND add_arrow(f, neg_arrow(f)) = zero_arrow(X, Y)
          AND add_arrow(neg_arrow(f), f) = zero_arrow(X, Y))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, X, Y)
        IMPLIES add_arrow(f, g) = add_arrow(g, f))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f, g, h: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, X, Y) AND hom(h, X, Y)
        IMPLIES
          add_arrow(add_arrow(f, g), h) = add_arrow(f, add_arrow(g, h)))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y, Z: Object), (f, g, h: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, X, Y) AND hom(h, Y, Z)
        IMPLIES
          compose(h, add_arrow(f, g)) =
            add_arrow(compose(h, f), compose(h, g)))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y, Z: Object), (f, g, h: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, Y, Z) AND hom(h, Y, Z)
        IMPLIES
          compose(add_arrow(g, h), f) =
            add_arrow(compose(g, f), compose(h, f)))

  zero_object(Z: Object): bool =
    object_p(Z)
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object):
      object_p(X) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (f: Morphism):
          hom(f, Z, X)
          AND (FORALL (g: Morphism): hom(g, Z, X) IMPLIES g = f))
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object):
      object_p(X) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (f: Morphism):
          hom(f, X, Z)
          AND (FORALL (g: Morphism): hom(g, X, Z) IMPLIES g = f))

  binary_biproduct(
    X, Y, B: Object,
    i1, i2, p1, p2: Morphism
  ): bool =
    object_p(X) AND object_p(Y) AND object_p(B)
    AND hom(i1, X, B) AND hom(i2, Y, B)
    AND hom(p1, B, X) AND hom(p2, B, Y)
    AND compose(p1, i1) = identity(X)
    AND compose(p2, i2) = identity(Y)
    AND compose(p1, i2) = zero_arrow(Y, X)
    AND compose(p2, i1) = zero_arrow(X, Y)
    AND add_arrow(compose(i1, p1), compose(i2, p2)) = identity(B)

  kernel(k, f: Morphism): bool =
    morphism_p(k) AND morphism_p(f) AND cod(k) = dom(f)
    AND compose(f, k) = zero_arrow(dom(k), cod(f))
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object), (h: Morphism):
      object_p(X) AND hom(h, X, dom(f))
        AND compose(f, h) = zero_arrow(X, cod(f))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (u: Morphism):
          hom(u, X, dom(k)) AND compose(k, u) = h
          AND
          (FORALL (v: Morphism):
            hom(v, X, dom(k)) AND compose(k, v) = h IMPLIES v = u))

  cokernel(f, q: Morphism): bool =
    morphism_p(f) AND morphism_p(q) AND cod(f) = dom(q)
    AND compose(q, f) = zero_arrow(dom(f), cod(q))
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object), (h: Morphism):
      object_p(X) AND hom(h, cod(f), X)
        AND compose(h, f) = zero_arrow(dom(f), X)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (u: Morphism):
          hom(u, cod(q), X) AND compose(u, q) = h
          AND
          (FORALL (v: Morphism):
            hom(v, cod(q), X) AND compose(v, q) = h IMPLIES v = u))

  monomorphism(f: Morphism): bool =
    morphism_p(f)
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object), (g, h: Morphism):
      object_p(X) AND hom(g, X, dom(f)) AND hom(h, X, dom(f))
        AND compose(f, g) = compose(f, h)
      IMPLIES g = h)

  epimorphism(f: Morphism): bool =
    morphism_p(f)
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object), (g, h: Morphism):
      object_p(X) AND hom(g, cod(f), X) AND hom(h, cod(f), X)
        AND compose(g, f) = compose(h, f)
      IMPLIES g = h)

  abelian_category: bool =
    preadditive_laws
    AND (EXISTS (Z: Object): zero_object(Z))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object):
      object_p(X) AND object_p(Y) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (B: Object), (i1, i2, p1, p2: Morphism):
          binary_biproduct(X, Y, B, i1, i2, p1, p2))
    AND
    (FORALL (f: Morphism):
      morphism_p(f) IMPLIES EXISTS (k: Morphism): kernel(k, f))
    AND
    (FORALL (f: Morphism):
      morphism_p(f) IMPLIES EXISTS (q: Morphism): cokernel(f, q))
    AND
    (FORALL (f: Morphism):
      monomorphism(f) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (q: Morphism): cokernel(f, q) AND kernel(f, q))
    AND
    (FORALL (f: Morphism):
      epimorphism(f) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (k: Morphism): kernel(k, f) AND cokernel(k, f))

  ring_laws(
    ring_elements: code_set,
    rzero, rone: code,
    radd, rmul: code_binary,
    rneg: code_unary
  ): bool =
    ring_elements(rzero) AND ring_elements(rone)
    AND
    (FORALL (a: code):
      ring_elements(a) IMPLIES ring_elements(rneg(a)))
    AND
    (FORALL (a, b: code):
      ring_elements(a) AND ring_elements(b) IMPLIES
        ring_elements(radd(a, b)) AND ring_elements(rmul(a, b)))
    AND
    (FORALL (a: code):
      ring_elements(a) IMPLIES
        radd(rzero, a) = a AND radd(a, rzero) = a
        AND radd(a, rneg(a)) = rzero AND radd(rneg(a), a) = rzero
        AND rmul(rone, a) = a AND rmul(a, rone) = a)
    AND
    (FORALL (a, b: code):
      ring_elements(a) AND ring_elements(b) IMPLIES
        radd(a, b) = radd(b, a))
    AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: code):
      ring_elements(a) AND ring_elements(b) AND ring_elements(c) IMPLIES
        radd(radd(a, b), c) = radd(a, radd(b, c))
        AND rmul(rmul(a, b), c) = rmul(a, rmul(b, c))
        AND rmul(a, radd(b, c)) = radd(rmul(a, b), rmul(a, c))
        AND rmul(radd(a, b), c) = radd(rmul(a, c), rmul(b, c)))

  module_laws(
    X: Object,
    ring_elements: code_set,
    rzero, rone: code,
    radd, rmul: code_binary,
    module_elements: module_carrier_family,
    mzero: module_zero_family,
    madd: module_binary_family,
    mneg: module_unary_family,
    smul: scalar_family
  ): bool =
    module_elements(X, mzero(X))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES module_elements(X, mneg(X, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) AND module_elements(X, y) IMPLIES
        module_elements(X, madd(X, x, y)))
    AND
    (FORALL (r: code), (x: module_code):
      ring_elements(r) AND module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES
        module_elements(X, smul(X, r, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES
        madd(X, mzero(X), x) = x AND madd(X, x, mzero(X)) = x
        AND madd(X, x, mneg(X, x)) = mzero(X)
        AND madd(X, mneg(X, x), x) = mzero(X)
        AND smul(X, rone, x) = x
        AND smul(X, rzero, x) = mzero(X))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) AND module_elements(X, y) IMPLIES
        madd(X, x, y) = madd(X, y, x))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) AND module_elements(X, y)
        AND module_elements(X, z)
      IMPLIES
        madd(X, madd(X, x, y), z) = madd(X, x, madd(X, y, z)))
    AND
    (FORALL (r, s: code), (x: module_code):
      ring_elements(r) AND ring_elements(s) AND module_elements(X, x)
      IMPLIES
        smul(X, radd(r, s), x) =
          madd(X, smul(X, r, x), smul(X, s, x))
        AND smul(X, rmul(r, s), x) = smul(X, r, smul(X, s, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (r: code), (x, y: module_code):
      ring_elements(r) AND module_elements(X, x) AND module_elements(X, y)
      IMPLIES
        smul(X, r, madd(X, x, y)) =
          madd(X, smul(X, r, x), smul(X, r, y)))

  linear_map(
    X, Y: Object,
    linear: module_code_unary,
    ring_elements: code_set,
    module_elements: module_carrier_family,
    mzero: module_zero_family,
    madd: module_binary_family,
    smul: scalar_family
  ): bool =
    (FORALL (x: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES module_elements(Y, linear(x)))
    AND linear(mzero(X)) = mzero(Y)
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y: module_code):
      module_elements(X, x) AND module_elements(X, y) IMPLIES
        linear(madd(X, x, y)) = madd(Y, linear(x), linear(y)))
    AND
    (FORALL (r: code), (x: module_code):
      ring_elements(r) AND module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES
        linear(smul(X, r, x)) = smul(Y, r, linear(x)))

  mapped_linear(
    f: Morphism,
    ring_elements: code_set,
    module_elements: module_carrier_family,
    mzero: module_zero_family,
    madd: module_binary_family,
    smul: scalar_family,
    fmap: morphism_map_family
  ): bool =
    (FORALL (x: module_code):
      module_elements(dom(f), x) IMPLIES
        module_elements(cod(f), fmap(f, x)))
    AND fmap(f, mzero(dom(f))) = mzero(cod(f))
    AND
    (FORALL (x, y: module_code):
      module_elements(dom(f), x) AND module_elements(dom(f), y) IMPLIES
        fmap(f, madd(dom(f), x, y)) =
          madd(cod(f), fmap(f, x), fmap(f, y)))
    AND
    (FORALL (r: code), (x: module_code):
      ring_elements(r) AND module_elements(dom(f), x) IMPLIES
        fmap(f, smul(dom(f), r, x)) =
          smul(cod(f), r, fmap(f, x)))

  embedding_laws(
    ring_elements: code_set,
    rzero, rone: code,
    radd, rmul: code_binary,
    rneg: code_unary,
    module_elements: module_carrier_family,
    mzero: module_zero_family,
    madd: module_binary_family,
    mneg: module_unary_family,
    smul: scalar_family,
    fmap: morphism_map_family
  ): bool =
    ring_laws(ring_elements, rzero, rone, radd, rmul, rneg)
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object):
      object_p(X) IMPLIES
        module_laws(
          X, ring_elements, rzero, rone, radd, rmul,
          module_elements, mzero, madd, mneg, smul))
    AND
    (FORALL (f: Morphism):
      morphism_p(f) IMPLIES
        mapped_linear(
          f, ring_elements, module_elements, mzero, madd, smul, fmap))
    AND
    (FORALL (X: Object), (x: module_code):
      object_p(X) AND module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES
        fmap(identity(X), x) = x)
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y, Z: Object), (f, g: Morphism), (x: module_code):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, Y, Z) AND module_elements(X, x)
      IMPLIES fmap(compose(g, f), x) = fmap(g, fmap(f, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (linear: module_code_unary):
      object_p(X) AND object_p(Y)
        AND linear_map(
          X, Y, linear, ring_elements, module_elements, mzero, madd, smul)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (f: Morphism):
          hom(f, X, Y)
          AND
          (FORALL (x: module_code):
            module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES fmap(f, x) = linear(x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, X, Y)
        AND
        (FORALL (x: module_code):
          module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES fmap(f, x) = fmap(g, x))
      IMPLIES f = g)
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (x: module_code):
      object_p(X) AND object_p(Y) AND module_elements(X, x) IMPLIES
        fmap(zero_arrow(X, Y), x) = mzero(Y))
    AND
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object), (f, g: Morphism), (x: module_code):
      hom(f, X, Y) AND hom(g, X, Y) AND module_elements(X, x)
      IMPLIES
        fmap(add_arrow(f, g), x) =
          madd(Y, fmap(f, x), fmap(g, x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (k, f: Morphism):
      kernel(k, f) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (x, y: module_code):
          module_elements(dom(k), x) AND module_elements(dom(k), y)
            AND fmap(k, x) = fmap(k, y)
          IMPLIES x = y)
        AND
        (FORALL (x: module_code):
          module_elements(dom(f), x) IMPLIES
            (fmap(f, x) = mzero(cod(f)) IFF
              EXISTS (y: module_code):
                module_elements(dom(k), y) AND fmap(k, y) = x)))
    AND
    (FORALL (f, q: Morphism):
      cokernel(f, q) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (y: module_code):
          module_elements(cod(q), y) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (x: module_code):
              module_elements(dom(q), x) AND fmap(q, x) = y)
        AND
        (FORALL (x: module_code):
          module_elements(dom(q), x) IMPLIES
            (fmap(q, x) = mzero(cod(q)) IFF
              EXISTS (y: module_code):
                module_elements(dom(f), y) AND fmap(f, y) = x)))

  mitchell_s_embedding_theorem: bool =
    abelian_category IMPLIES
      EXISTS
        (ring_elements: code_set),
        (rzero, rone: code),
        (radd, rmul: code_binary),
        (rneg: code_unary),
        (module_elements: module_carrier_family),
        (mzero: module_zero_family),
        (madd: module_binary_family),
        (mneg: module_unary_family),
        (smul: scalar_family),
        (fmap: morphism_map_family):
          embedding_laws(
            ring_elements, rzero, rone, radd, rmul, rneg,
            module_elements, mzero, madd, mneg, smul, fmap)

END Q1148215_mitchell_s_embedding_theorem

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1149022
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1149022), "Fubini's theorem": for an integrable
-- function on a product of s-finite measure spaces, its Bochner integral equals
-- the corresponding iterated Bochner integral. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Prod

open scoped ENNReal MeasureTheory

open MeasureTheory

namespace Q1149022

variable {α β E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSpace β]
  {μ : Measure α} {ν : Measure β}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]

/-- Fubini's theorem for the Bochner integral on a product measure. -/
theorem integral_prod (f : α × β → E) (hf : Integrable f (μ.prod ν)) :
    ∫ z, f z ∂μ.prod ν = ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂ν ∂μ := sorry

end Q1149022

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1149022
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1149022), "Fubini's theorem": for an integrable
  normed-real-vector-space-valued function on the product of two s-finite
  measure spaces, its Bochner integral equals the iterated Bochner integral.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1149022_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1149022_empty {A : Type} : q1149022_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1149022_full {A : Type} : q1149022_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q1149022_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1149022_set A) : q1149022_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1149022_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1149022_set A) : q1149022_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1149022_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1149022_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1149022_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1149022_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1149022_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1149022_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1149022_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q1149022_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q1149022_set (q1149022_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q1149022_empty /\
  (forall E F : q1149022_set A,
    q1149022_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q1149022_set A,
    C E -> C (q1149022_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q1149022_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q1149022_countable_union E)).

Inductive q1149022_ennreal : Type :=
| q1149022_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q1149022_ennreal
| q1149022_ennreal_infinity : q1149022_ennreal.

Arguments q1149022_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_zero : q1149022_ennreal :=
  q1149022_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q1149022_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1149022_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1149022_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q1149022_ennreal_infinity,
    q1149022_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1149022_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1149022_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q1149022_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q1149022_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q1149022_ennreal_infinity,
    q1149022_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q1149022_ennreal_infinity,
    q1149022_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1149022_ennreal) : q1149022_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1149022_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1149022_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1149022_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q1149022_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q1149022_ennreal) : q1149022_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1149022_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1149022_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1149022_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q1149022_ennreal_finite a _, q1149022_ennreal_infinity
  | q1149022_ennreal_infinity, q1149022_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q1149022_ennreal_zero
      else q1149022_ennreal_infinity
  | q1149022_ennreal_infinity, q1149022_ennreal_infinity =>
      q1149022_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q1149022_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1149022_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q1149022_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1149022_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1149022_ennreal_add
        (q1149022_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q1149022_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q1149022_ennreal,
      values value -> q1149022_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q1149022_ennreal,
      (forall value : q1149022_ennreal,
        values value -> q1149022_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q1149022_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q1149022_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1149022_ennreal)
    (sum : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1149022_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q1149022_ennreal_eq value
          (q1149022_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_represents
    (x : q1149022_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q1149022_ennreal_eq x
      (q1149022_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q1149022_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q1149022_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q1149022_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1149022_measurable : q1149022_set A -> Prop;
  q1149022_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q1149022_set A,
      q1149022_same_set E F ->
      (q1149022_measurable E <-> q1149022_measurable F);
  q1149022_measurable_empty :
    q1149022_measurable q1149022_empty;
  q1149022_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q1149022_set A,
      q1149022_measurable E ->
      q1149022_measurable (q1149022_complement E);
  q1149022_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q1149022_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1149022_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1149022_measurable (q1149022_countable_union E);
  q1149022_measure : q1149022_set A -> q1149022_ennreal;
  q1149022_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1149022_set A,
      q1149022_same_set E F ->
      q1149022_ennreal_eq
        (q1149022_measure E) (q1149022_measure F);
  q1149022_measure_empty :
    q1149022_ennreal_eq
      (q1149022_measure q1149022_empty)
      q1149022_ennreal_zero;
  q1149022_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1149022_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1149022_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1149022_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1149022_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1149022_measure (E n))
        (q1149022_measure (q1149022_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q1149022_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q1149022_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q1149022_same_measurable_space {A : Type}
    (mu nu : q1149022_measure_space A) : Prop :=
  forall E : q1149022_set A,
    q1149022_measurable mu E <-> q1149022_measurable nu E.

Definition q1149022_finite_measure {A : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A) : Prop :=
  q1149022_ennreal_finite_value
    (q1149022_measure mu q1149022_full).

Definition q1149022_s_finite {A : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A) : Prop :=
  exists components : nat -> q1149022_measure_space A,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1149022_same_measurable_space mu (components n) /\
      q1149022_finite_measure (components n)) /\
    forall E : q1149022_set A,
      q1149022_measurable mu E ->
      q1149022_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1149022_measure (components n) E)
        (q1149022_measure mu E).

Definition q1149022_rectangle {A B : Type}
    (E : q1149022_set A)
    (F : q1149022_set B) : q1149022_set (A * B) :=
  fun pair => E (fst pair) /\ F (snd pair).

Definition q1149022_product_measurable_set {A B : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (nu : q1149022_measure_space B)
    (S : q1149022_set (A * B)) : Prop :=
  forall C : q1149022_set (q1149022_set (A * B)),
    q1149022_sigma_class C ->
    (forall (E : q1149022_set A) (F : q1149022_set B),
      q1149022_measurable mu E ->
      q1149022_measurable nu F ->
      C (q1149022_rectangle E F)) ->
    C S.

Definition q1149022_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q1149022_set A,
    q1149022_measurable mu null_set /\
    q1149022_ennreal_eq
      (q1149022_measure mu null_set)
      q1149022_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q1149022_normed_real_vector_space (G : Type) : Type := {
  q1149022_zero : G;
  q1149022_add : G -> G -> G;
  q1149022_neg : G -> G;
  q1149022_smul : R -> G -> G;
  q1149022_norm : G -> R;
  q1149022_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q1149022_add x (q1149022_add y z) =
      q1149022_add (q1149022_add x y) z;
  q1149022_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q1149022_add x y = q1149022_add y x;
  q1149022_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q1149022_add x q1149022_zero = x;
  q1149022_add_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q1149022_add x (q1149022_neg x) = q1149022_zero;
  q1149022_one_smul :
    forall x : G, q1149022_smul 1 x = x;
  q1149022_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q1149022_smul (a * b) x =
      q1149022_smul a (q1149022_smul b x);
  q1149022_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q1149022_smul (a + b) x =
      q1149022_add (q1149022_smul a x) (q1149022_smul b x);
  q1149022_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : G),
      q1149022_smul a (q1149022_add x y) =
      q1149022_add (q1149022_smul a x) (q1149022_smul a y);
  q1149022_zero_smul :
    forall x : G, q1149022_smul 0 x = q1149022_zero;
  q1149022_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1149022_smul a q1149022_zero = q1149022_zero;
  q1149022_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q1149022_norm x;
  q1149022_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q1149022_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1149022_zero;
  q1149022_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q1149022_norm (q1149022_add x y) <=
      q1149022_norm x + q1149022_norm y;
  q1149022_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : G),
      q1149022_norm (q1149022_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q1149022_norm x
}.

Arguments q1149022_zero {G} _.
Arguments q1149022_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q1149022_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q1149022_smul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q1149022_norm {G} _ _.

Definition q1149022_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q1149022_add V x (q1149022_neg V y).

Definition q1149022_vector_sequence_converges {G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (limit : G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1149022_norm V
          (q1149022_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1149022_vector_sequence_cauchy {G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1149022_norm V
          (q1149022_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1149022_complete {G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> G,
    q1149022_vector_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : G,
      q1149022_vector_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q1149022_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1149022_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q1149022_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q1149022_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q1149022_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q1149022_measurable_simple {A G : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q1149022_set A),
    q1149022_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1149022_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q1149022_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q1149022_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q1149022_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q1149022_nnreal_value : R;
  q1149022_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q1149022_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q1149022_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q1149022_nonnegative_real) : q1149022_ennreal :=
  q1149022_ennreal_finite
    (q1149022_nnreal_value x)
    (q1149022_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q1149022_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1149022_ennreal)
    (value : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q1149022_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q1149022_set A),
    q1149022_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q1149022_ennreal_le
        (q1149022_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q1149022_ennreal_eq value
      (q1149022_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q1149022_ennreal_mul
            (q1149022_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q1149022_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q1149022_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1149022_ennreal)
    (value : q1149022_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1149022_ennreal_supremum
    (q1149022_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q1149022_vertical_section {A B : Type}
    (S : q1149022_set (A * B))
    (x : A) : q1149022_set B :=
  fun y => S (x, y).

Definition q1149022_is_product_measure {A B : Type}
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (nu : q1149022_measure_space B)
    (product : q1149022_measure_space (A * B)) : Prop :=
  (forall S : q1149022_set (A * B),
    q1149022_measurable product S <->
    q1149022_product_measurable_set mu nu S) /\
  (forall S : q1149022_set (A * B),
    q1149022_measurable product S ->
    q1149022_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x =>
        q1149022_measure nu
          (q1149022_vertical_section S x))
      (q1149022_measure product S)).

Definition q1149022_norm_ennreal {G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x : G) : q1149022_ennreal :=
  q1149022_ennreal_finite
    (q1149022_norm V x)
    (q1149022_norm_nonnegative V x).

Definition q1149022_integrable {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable V mu f /\
  exists value : q1149022_ennreal,
    q1149022_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q1149022_norm_ennreal V (f x)) value /\
    q1149022_ennreal_finite_value value.

Fixpoint q1149022_vector_sum {G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => q1149022_zero V
  | S k =>
      q1149022_add V
        (q1149022_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1149022_weighted_cell_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (cell : q1149022_set A)
    (coefficient value : G) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q1149022_zero V /\
    value = q1149022_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q1149022_ennreal_represents
      (q1149022_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value = q1149022_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q1149022_simple_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q1149022_set A),
    q1149022_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q1149022_weighted_cell_value
        V mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q1149022_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q1149022_l1_approximates {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q1149022_ennreal,
        q1149022_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q1149022_norm_ennreal V
              (q1149022_sub V (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q1149022_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q1149022_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q1149022_standard_bochner_integral_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
         (integrals : nat -> G),
    (forall n : nat,
      q1149022_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q1149022_simple_integral_has_value
        V mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q1149022_l1_approximates V mu approximants f /\
    q1149022_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q1149022_bochner_integral {A G : Type}
    (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q1149022_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : G :=
  match excluded_middle_informative (q1149022_complete V) with
  | left _ =>
      match excluded_middle_informative
              (exists value : G,
                q1149022_standard_bochner_integral_value
                  V mu f value) with
      | left _ =>
          epsilon (inhabits (q1149022_zero V))
            (fun value : G =>
              q1149022_standard_bochner_integral_value
                V mu f value)
      | right _ => q1149022_zero V
      end
  | right _ => q1149022_zero V
  end.

Theorem integral_prod :
  forall (Alpha Beta G : Type)
         (V : q1149022_normed_real_vector_space G)
         (mu : q1149022_measure_space Alpha)
         (nu : q1149022_measure_space Beta)
         (product : q1149022_measure_space (Alpha * Beta))
         (f : Alpha * Beta -> G),
    q1149022_s_finite mu ->
    q1149022_s_finite nu ->
    q1149022_is_product_measure mu nu product ->
    q1149022_integrable V product f ->
    q1149022_bochner_integral V product f =
    q1149022_bochner_integral V mu
      (fun x =>
        q1149022_bochner_integral V nu
          (fun y => f (x, y))).
Admitted.

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1149022,
  "Fubini's theorem": the Bochner integral of an integrable real normed-space-
  valued function over a product of s-finite measure spaces equals its iterated
  Bochner integral. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
begin

definition q1149022_s_finite_measure :: "'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1149022_s_finite_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>Ms :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure.
      (\<forall>n. sets (Ms n) = sets M) \<and>
      (\<forall>n. emeasure (Ms n) (space M) < \<infinity>) \<and>
      (\<forall>A. emeasure M A = (\<Sum>n. emeasure (Ms n) A)))"

definition q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
      (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f x))"

definition q1149022_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1149022_integrable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<integral>\<^sup>+ x. ennreal (norm (f x)) \<partial>M) < \<infinity>"

definition q1149022_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1149022_has_bochner_integral M f I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
      (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
      (\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+ x. ennreal (norm (f x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0 \<and>
      (\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> I)"

definition q1149022_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'b" where
  "q1149022_bochner_integral M f =
    (if complete (UNIV :: 'b set) then
      if \<exists>I. q1149022_has_bochner_integral M f I
      then THE I. q1149022_has_bochner_integral M f I
      else 0
    else 0)"

theorem fubini_s_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and N :: "'b measure"
    and f :: "'a \<times> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'c::real_normed_vector"
  assumes "q1149022_s_finite_measure M"
    and "q1149022_s_finite_measure N"
    and "q1149022_integrable (M \<Otimes>\<^sub>M N) f"
  shows "q1149022_bochner_integral (M \<Otimes>\<^sub>M N) f =
    q1149022_bochner_integral M
      (\<lambda>x. q1149022_bochner_integral N (\<lambda>y. f (x, y)))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1149022,
  "Fubini's theorem": the Bochner integral of an integrable function over the
  product of two s-finite measure spaces equals its iterated Bochner integral.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1149022_FUBINI_S_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let product_carrier =
      \(carrierB:B->bool) (carrierC:C->bool).
        {p:B#C | FST p IN carrierB /\ SND p IN carrierC} in
   let sigmaB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:B->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:B->bool. events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:B | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let sigmaC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:C->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:C->bool. events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->C->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:C | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let sigmaBC =
      \(carrier:(B#C)->bool)
       (events:((B#C)->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:(B#C)->bool.
           events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:(B#C)->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->(B#C)->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:B#C | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measureB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real).
        sigmaB carrier events /\
        (!s:B->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                     (mu {x:B | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let measureC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(C->bool)->bool#real).
        sigmaC carrier events /\
        (!s:C->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->C->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                     (mu {x:C | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let measureBC =
      \(carrier:(B#C)->bool)
       (events:((B#C)->bool)->bool)
       (mu:((B#C)->bool)->bool#real).
        sigmaBC carrier events /\
        (!s:(B#C)->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->(B#C)->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                     (mu {x:B#C | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let finite_measureB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real).
        measureB carrier events mu /\ ~(FST (mu carrier)) in
   let finite_measureC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(C->bool)->bool#real).
        measureC carrier events mu /\ ~(FST (mu carrier)) in
   let sfiniteB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real).
        measureB carrier events mu /\
        ?parts:num->(B->bool)->bool#real.
          (!n. finite_measureB carrier events (parts n)) /\
          (!s:B->bool.
             events s
             ==> esum (\n. parts n s) (mu s)) in
   let sfiniteC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(C->bool)->bool#real).
        measureC carrier events mu /\
        ?parts:num->(C->bool)->bool#real.
          (!n. finite_measureC carrier events (parts n)) /\
          (!s:C->bool.
             events s
             ==> esum (\n. parts n s) (mu s)) in
   let product_events =
      \(carrierB:B->bool) (carrierC:C->bool)
       (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool)
       (eventsC:(C->bool)->bool)
       (s:(B#C)->bool).
        !events:((B#C)->bool)->bool.
          sigmaBC (product_carrier carrierB carrierC) events /\
          (!u:B->bool. !v:C->bool.
             eventsB u /\ eventsC v
             ==> events {p:B#C |
                           FST p IN u /\ SND p IN v})
          ==> events s in
   let almost_everywhereB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(B->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:B->bool).
        ?N:B->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:B | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let almost_everywhereC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(C->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:C->bool).
        ?N:C->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:C | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let almost_everywhereBC =
      \(carrier:(B#C)->bool)
       (events:((B#C)->bool)->bool)
       (mu:((B#C)->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:(B#C)->bool).
        ?N:(B#C)->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:B#C | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let normed_real_vector_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real).
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x:A. neg (neg x) = x) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real x:A. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real x:A.
           smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a:real x y:A.
           smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!a:real x:A. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
        (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (u:num->A) (l:A).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                       ==> norm (add (u n) (neg l)) < e in
   let complete_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
        !u:num->A.
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?N. !m n.
                     N <= m /\ N <= n
                     ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < e)
          ==> ?l:A. vector_tends zero add neg norm u l in
   let simple_scalarB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool) (s:B->real).
        (!x:B. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_scalarC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool) (s:C->real).
        (!x:C. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:C | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_scalarBC =
      \(carrier:(B#C)->bool)
       (events:((B#C)->bool)->bool) (s:(B#C)->real).
        (!x:B#C. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:B#C | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_vectorB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool) (s:B->A).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:A. events {x:B | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_vectorC =
      \(carrier:C->bool) (events:(C->bool)->bool) (s:C->A).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:A. events {x:C | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_vectorBC =
      \(carrier:(B#C)->bool)
       (events:((B#C)->bool)->bool) (s:(B#C)->A).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:A. events {x:B#C | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurableB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool)
       (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:B->A).
        ?s:num->B->A.

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1149022,
;; "Fubini's theorem": for an integrable function from the product of two
;; arbitrary s-finite measure spaces into an arbitrary real normed vector
;; space, the Bochner integral over the product measure equals the iterated
;; Bochner integral. This file contains no proof.
