title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1149022,
-- "Fubini's theorem": the Bochner integral of an integrable function with
-- respect to the product of two s-finite measures equals its iterated integral.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

Not1 : Set1 -> Set1
Not1 A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Iff1 (A B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor equivalence1
  field
    forward1  : A -> B
    backward1 : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) -> Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NormedVectorSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) -> addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zero :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-only :
      (x : E) -> normE x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroE
    norm-negate :
      (x : E) -> normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) == multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normE x)

open NormedVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
distanceR reals x y =
  absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals distance sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} reals distance sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (sequence m) (sequence n)) epsilon)

Complete :
  {R V : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (V -> V -> R) ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} reals distance =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence reals distance sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit reals distance sequence limit)

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable : Predicate A -> Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroM oneM infinityM : M
    addM multiplyM : M -> M -> M
    lessOrEqualM : M -> M -> Set
    finiteM : (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x -> M

    zero-least :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatest :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    infinity-not-zero :
      infinityM != zeroM
    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) -> Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) -> addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) -> addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) -> addM x zeroM == x
    add-infinityM :
      (x : M) -> addM x infinityM == infinityM
    add-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM w y) (addM x z)
    multiply-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) -> multiplyM x y == multiplyM y x
    multiply-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM (multiplyM x y) z == multiplyM x (multiplyM y z)
    multiply-oneM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x oneM == x
    multiply-zeroM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x zeroM == zeroM
    multiply-distributesM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiplyM x (addM y z) ==
      addM (multiplyM x y) (multiplyM x z)
    multiply-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (multiplyM w y) (multiplyM x z)

    finite-zero :
      finiteM (zeroR reals) (order-reflexive reals (zeroR reals)) == zeroM
    finite-one :
      finiteM (oneR reals) (Both.first (zero-less-than-one reals)) == oneM
    finite-order :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Iff (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy))
        (lessOrEqualR reals x y)
    finite-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (addR reals x y))
        (\ hsum ->
          addM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (addR reals x y) hsum)
    finite-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (multiplyR reals x y))
        (\ hproduct ->
          multiplyM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
          finiteM (multiplyR reals x y) hproduct)
    finite-or-infinity :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            Exists
              (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
              (\ nonnegative -> x == finiteM value nonnegative)))
    multiply-infinity-nonzero :
      (x : M) ->
      x != zeroM ->
      multiplyM x infinityM == infinityM

    supremumM : Predicate M -> M
    supremum-upper :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (x : M) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualM x (supremumM P)
    supremum-least :
      (P : Predicate M) ->
      (upper : M) ->
      ((x : M) -> P x -> lessOrEqualM x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM (supremumM P) upper

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

sumFirstM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumFirstM {reals = reals} extended terms zero =
  zeroM extended
sumFirstM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) (terms n)

sumThroughM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumThroughM extended terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThroughM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumThroughM extended terms n) (terms (suc n))

CountableSum :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
CountableSum extended terms value =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) -> lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) value)
    ((upper : _) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper)

record Measure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    outerMass : Predicate A -> M
    measurableHull : Predicate A -> Predicate A

    outer-mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      outerMass S == outerMass T
    measurable-hull-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events (measurableHull S)
    subset-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S (measurableHull S)
    outer-mass-measurable-hull :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass (measurableHull S) == outerMass S
    outer-mass-empty :
      outerMass emptySet == zeroM extended
    outer-mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (outerMass S) (outerMass T)
    outer-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sumValue : M) ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))
        sumValue
    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass T ==
      addM extended
        (outerMass (intersection T S))
        (outerMass (intersection T (complement S)))
    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere {extended = extended} measure property =
  outerMass measure (\ x -> Not (property x)) == zeroM extended

record SimpleFunction
  {A V : Set}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    function : A -> V
    cutoff : Nat
    values : Nat -> V
    pieces : Nat -> Predicate A

    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      measurable events (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      j <=N cutoff ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat (\ i -> Both (i <=N cutoff) (pieces i x))
    represented-on-pieces :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      function x == values i

open SimpleFunction

record StronglyMeasurable
  {A R V : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (distance : V -> V -> R)
  (f : A -> V) : Set1 where
  field
    approximants :
      Nat -> SimpleFunction {V = V} events
    approximates :
      (x : A) ->
      SequentialLimit reals distance
        (\ n -> function (approximants n) x)
        (f x)

record AEStronglyMeasurable
  {A R M V : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (distance : V -> V -> R)
  (f : A -> V) : Set1 where
  field
    representative :
      A -> V
    representative-strongly-measurable :
      StronglyMeasurable reals events distance representative
    equal-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere measure (\ x -> f x == representative x)

record NonnegativeSimpleBelow
  {A R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (f : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    underlying :
      SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = R} events
    values-nonnegative :
      (i : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (values underlying i)
    pointwise-below :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (function underlying x)
        (f x)

open NonnegativeSimpleBelow

record SimpleLowerIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  {f : A -> R}
  (simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    integral-equation :
      value ==
      sumThroughM extended
        (\ i ->
          multiplyM extended
            (finiteM extended
              (values (underlying simple) i)
              (values-nonnegative simple i))
            (outerMass measure (pieces (underlying simple) i)))
        (cutoff (underlying simple))

record LowerIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    simple-integrals-below :
      (simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f) ->
      (simpleValue : M) ->
      SimpleLowerIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue value
    least-upper-bound :
      (upper : M) ->
      ((simple : NonnegativeSimpleBelow reals events f) ->
        (simpleValue : M) ->
        SimpleLowerIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
        lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper

record ExtendedSimpleBelow
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (f : A -> M) : Set1 where
  field
    underlying :
      SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = M} events
    pointwise-below :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (function underlying x)
        (f x)

open ExtendedSimpleBelow

record SimpleLIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  {f : A -> M}
  (simple : ExtendedSimpleBelow extended events f)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    integral-equation :
      value ==
      sumThroughM extended
        (\ i ->
          multiplyM extended
            (values (underlying simple) i)
            (outerMass measure (pieces (underlying simple) i)))
        (cutoff (underlying simple))

record LIntegralValue
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> M)
  (value : M) : Set1 where
  field
    simple-integrals-below :
      (simple : ExtendedSimpleBelow extended events f) ->
      (simpleValue : M) ->
      SimpleLIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue value
    least-upper-bound :
      (upper : M) ->
      ((simple : ExtendedSimpleBelow extended events f) ->
        (simpleValue : M) ->
        SimpleLIntegralValue extended measure simple simpleValue ->
        lessOrEqualM extended simpleValue upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper

record RealIntegrability
  {A R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (lowerIntegral : (A -> R) -> M)
  (f : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    strongly-measurable :
      AEStronglyMeasurable reals events measure (distanceR reals) f
    absolute-integral-definition :
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure
        (\ x -> absoluteR reals (f x))
        (lowerIntegral (\ x -> absoluteR reals (f x)))
    absolute-integral-finite :
      lowerIntegral (\ x -> absoluteR reals (f x)) != infinityM extended

record VectorIntegrable
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    strongly-measurable :
      AEStronglyMeasurable reals events measure (distanceE space) f
    norm-integral :
      M
    norm-integral-definition :
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure
        (\ x -> normE space (f x))
        norm-integral
    norm-integral-finite :
      norm-integral != infinityM extended

sumThroughE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  Nat ->
  E
sumThroughE space terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThroughE space terms (suc n) =
  addE space (sumThroughE space terms n) (terms (suc n))

data PieceBochnerIntegralValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (coefficient : E)
  (piece : Predicate A)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  zero-coefficient-value :
    coefficient == zeroE space ->
    value == zeroE space ->
    PieceBochnerIntegralValue space measure coefficient piece value
  finite-mass-value :
    (mass : R) ->
    (mass-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) mass) ->
    outerMass measure piece ==
      finiteM extended mass mass-nonnegative ->
    value == scaleE space mass coefficient ->
    PieceBochnerIntegralValue space measure coefficient piece value

record SimpleBochnerIntegralValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (simple : SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = E} events)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  field
    terms :
      Nat -> E
    term-definition :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff simple ->
      PieceBochnerIntegralValue space measure
        (values simple i)
        (pieces simple i)
        (terms i)
    integral-equation :
      value == sumThroughE space terms (cutoff simple)

record BochnerLimitValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> E)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  field
    approximants :
      Nat -> SimpleFunction {A = A} {V = E} events
    approximant-integrals :
      Nat -> E
    approximant-integral-definitions :
      (n : Nat) ->
      SimpleBochnerIntegralValue space events measure
        (approximants n)
        (approximant-integrals n)
    errors :
      Nat -> R
    errors-nonnegative :
      (n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (errors n)
    errors-represent-lower-integrals :
      (n : Nat) ->
      LowerIntegralValue extended events measure
        (\ x ->
          normE space
            (subtractE space
              (function (approximants n) x)
              (f x)))
        (finiteM extended (errors n) (errors-nonnegative n))
    errors-tend-to-zero :
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceR reals)
        errors
        (zeroR reals)
    approximant-integrals-tend-to-value :
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceE space)
        approximant-integrals
        value

data TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> E)
  (value : E) : Set1 where
  complete-integrable-value :
    Complete reals (distanceE space) ->
    VectorIntegrable
      reals space events extended measure f ->
    BochnerLimitValue
      reals space events extended measure f value ->
    TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
      reals space events extended measure f value
  nonintegrable-value :
    Not1
      (VectorIntegrable
        reals space events extended measure f) ->
    value == zeroE space ->
    TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
      reals space events extended measure f value
  incomplete-space-value :
    Not (Complete reals (distanceE space)) ->
    value == zeroE space ->
    TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
      reals space events extended measure f value

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor _,_
  field
    firstOf  : A
    secondOf : B

open Pair

Rectangle :
  {A B : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate (Pair A B)
Rectangle S T pair =
  Both (S (firstOf pair)) (T (secondOf pair))

rightSection :
  {A B : Set} ->
  Predicate (Pair A B) ->
  A ->
  Predicate B
rightSection U x y =
  U (x , y)

record ProductSigmaAlgebra
  {A B : Set}
  (eventsA : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (eventsB : SigmaAlgebra B)
  (eventsAB : SigmaAlgebra (Pair A B)) : Set1 where
  field
    rectangles-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (T : Predicate B) ->
      measurable eventsA S ->
      measurable eventsB T ->
      measurable eventsAB (Rectangle S T)
    generated-by-rectangles :
      (candidate : SigmaAlgebra (Pair A B)) ->
      ((S : Predicate A) ->
        (T : Predicate B) ->
        measurable eventsA S ->
        measurable eventsB T ->
        measurable candidate (Rectangle S T)) ->
      (U : Predicate (Pair A B)) ->
      measurable eventsAB U ->
      measurable candidate U

FiniteMeasure :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Set
FiniteMeasure {extended = extended} measure =
  outerMass measure wholeSet != infinityM extended

record SFiniteMeasure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set1 where
  field
    finite-parts :
      Nat -> Measure extended events
    each-part-finite :
      (n : Nat) ->
      FiniteMeasure (finite-parts n)
    parts-sum-to-measure :
      (S : Predicate _) ->
      measurable events S ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (finite-parts n) S)
        (outerMass measure S)

record CanonicalMeasureOperations
  {R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  : Set2 where
  field
    productEvents :
      {A B : Set} ->
      SigmaAlgebra A ->
      SigmaAlgebra B ->
      SigmaAlgebra (Pair A B)
    product-sigma-definition :
      {A B : Set} ->
      (eventsA : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      (eventsB : SigmaAlgebra B) ->
      ProductSigmaAlgebra
        eventsA eventsB (productEvents eventsA eventsB)
    productMeasure :
      {A B : Set} ->
      (eventsA : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      (eventsB : SigmaAlgebra B) ->
      Measure extended eventsA ->
      Measure extended eventsB ->
      Measure extended (productEvents eventsA eventsB)
    product-measure-sfinite :
      {A B : Set} ->
      (eventsA : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      (eventsB : SigmaAlgebra B) ->
      (measureA : Measure extended eventsA) ->
      (measureB : Measure extended eventsB) ->
      SFiniteMeasure measureA ->
      SFiniteMeasure measureB ->
      SFiniteMeasure
        (productMeasure eventsA eventsB measureA measureB)
    product-measurable-set-construction :
      {A B : Set} ->
      (eventsA : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      (eventsB : SigmaAlgebra B) ->
      (measureA : Measure extended eventsA) ->
      (measureB : Measure extended eventsB) ->
      SFiniteMeasure measureB ->
      (U : Predicate (Pair A B)) ->
      measurable (productEvents eventsA eventsB) U ->
      LIntegralValue extended eventsA measureA
        (\ x -> outerMass measureB (rightSection U x))
        (outerMass
          (productMeasure eventsA eventsB measureA measureB)
          U)
    bochnerIntegral :
      {A : Set} ->
      (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      Measure extended events ->
      (A -> E) ->
      E
    bochner-integral-definition :
      {A : Set} ->
      (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f : A -> E) ->
      TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
        reals space events extended measure f
        (bochnerIntegral events measure f)
    bochner-integral-unique :
      {A : Set} ->
      (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (f : A -> E) ->
      (value : E) ->
      TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
        reals space events extended measure f value ->
      bochnerIntegral events measure f == value

open CanonicalMeasureOperations

fubini-s-theorem : Set2
fubini-s-theorem =
  (A B R M E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (eventsA : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (eventsB : SigmaAlgebra B) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (operations :
    CanonicalMeasureOperations reals space extended) ->
  (measureA : Measure extended eventsA) ->
  (measureB : Measure extended eventsB) ->
  (sfiniteA : SFiniteMeasure measureA) ->
  (sfiniteB : SFiniteMeasure measureB) ->
  (f : Pair A B -> E) ->
  VectorIntegrable
    reals space
    (productEvents operations eventsA eventsB)
    extended
    (productMeasure operations eventsA eventsB measureA measureB)
    f ->
  bochnerIntegral operations
    (productEvents operations eventsA eventsB)
    (productMeasure operations eventsA eventsB measureA measureB)
    f ==
  bochnerIntegral operations eventsA measureA
    (\ x ->
      bochnerIntegral operations eventsB measureB
        (\ y -> f (x , y)))

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1149022, "Fubini's theorem": the Bochner integral of an integrable
  function on the product of two s-finite measure spaces equals its iterated
  Bochner integral. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;
open martingaleTheory;

val q1149022_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q1149022_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1149022_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_tendsto_def",
  ``q1149022_tendsto
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !n. N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q1149022_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_cauchy_def",
  ``q1149022_cauchy
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !p q. N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
          norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q1149022_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_complete_def",
  ``q1149022_complete
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'g.
        q1149022_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell. q1149022_tendsto add neg norm u ell``);

val q1149022_sfinite_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_sfinite_def",
  ``q1149022_sfinite (m : 'a m_space) <=>
      ?parts : num -> 'a set -> extreal.
        (!n.
          measure_space (m_space m,measurable_sets m,parts n) /\
          parts n (m_space m) <> PosInf) /\
        !s.
          s IN measurable_sets m ==>
          measure m s = suminf (\n. parts n s)``);

val q1149022_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q1149022_measurable_simple
      (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'g. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q1149022_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q1149022_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'a -> 'g.
        (!n. q1149022_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q1149022_tendsto add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q1149022_ae_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'g.
        q1149022_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q1149022_bochner_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_bochner_integrable_def",
  ``q1149022_bochner_integrable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'g.
        q1149022_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q1149022_simple_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_simple_integral_def",
  ``q1149022_simple_integral
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (s : 'a -> 'g) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add (smul (real (measure m {x | s x = y})) y) acc)
        (IMAGE s UNIV DELETE zero) zero``);

val q1149022_bochner_approximates_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_bochner_approximates_def",
  ``q1149022_bochner_approximates
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) (s : num -> 'a -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'g.
        q1149022_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q1149022_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (s n x)))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable m
            (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x)))))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral m
                (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x))))))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q1149022_tendsto add neg norm
          (\n. q1149022_simple_integral m zero add smul (s n))
          ell``);

val q1149022_bochner_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1149022_bochner_integral_def",
  ``q1149022_bochner_integral
      (m : 'a m_space) (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'g) =
      if q1149022_complete add neg norm /\
         q1149022_bochner_integrable m add neg norm f
      then
        @ell.
          ?s : num -> 'a -> 'g.
            q1149022_bochner_approximates
              m zero add neg smul norm f s ell
      else
        zero``);

val integral_prod =
  ``!(m1 : 'a m_space) (m2 : 'b m_space)
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : ('a # 'b) -> 'g).
      measure_space m1 /\
      measure_space m2 /\
      m_space m1 = UNIV /\
      m_space m2 = UNIV /\
      q1149022_sfinite m1 /\
      q1149022_sfinite m2 /\
      q1149022_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q1149022_bochner_integrable
        (prod_measure_space m1 m2) add neg norm f
      ==>
      q1149022_bochner_integral
        (prod_measure_space m1 m2) zero add neg smul norm f =
      q1149022_bochner_integral
        m1 zero add neg smul norm
        (\x.
          q1149022_bochner_integral
            m2 zero add neg smul norm (\y. f (x,y)))``;

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1149022
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1149022), "Fubini's theorem": for an
  integrable function from the product of two arbitrary s-finite measure
  spaces into an arbitrary real normed vector space, its Bochner integral
  over the product measure equals the iterated Bochner integral. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1149022Simple, Q1149022SimpleIntegral, and Q1149022LIntegral give the
  lower Lebesgue integral of a nonnegative extended-real-valued function.
  The simple integral uses SetMM's extended multiplication and sum, so a
  positive value on a fiber of measure +oo contributes +oo, while the empty
  sum and every zero contribution are zero.
  Q1149022SFinite says that a measure is a countable pointwise sum of finite
  measures on the same sigma-algebra.

  Q1149022ProdMeasure is the canonical product measure on SetMM's product
  sigma-algebra. Under the stated s-finiteness hypotheses it is uniquely
  characterized by integrating the measures of measurable sections.

  Q1149022AEStrong is the simple-function characterization of Lean's
  AEStronglyMeasurable predicate. Q1149022Integrable is almost-everywhere
  strong measurability together with finiteness of the lower integral of the
  pointwise norm, matching Lean's Integrable predicate on arbitrary normed
  codomains.

  Q1149022HasIntegral M W H y says that H is approximated in L1 by measurable
  finite-range functions in the domain of SetMM's simple Bochner integral,
  with their simple integrals converging to y. Q1149022Integral W M H is the
  unique such y when W is complete and H is integrable, and is the zero vector
  otherwise. This gives Lean's totalized Bochner integral directly from
  simple approximants rather than delegating to a general integral operator.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1149022Simple Q1149022SimpleIntegral Q1149022LIntegral
   Q1149022SFinite Q1149022ProdMeasure Q1149022Tendsto
   Q1149022AEStrong Q1149022Diff Q1149022L1Distance
   Q1149022Integrable Q1149022HasIntegral Q1149022Integral $.

q1149022-simple-syntax $a wff ( Q1149022Simple M G ) $.
q1149022-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q1149022SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q1149022-lintegral-syntax $a class ( Q1149022LIntegral M H ) $.
q1149022-sfinite-syntax $a wff ( Q1149022SFinite M ) $.
q1149022-prod-measure-syntax
  $a class ( Q1149022ProdMeasure M N ) $.
q1149022-tendsto-syntax $a wff ( Q1149022Tendsto W S z ) $.
q1149022-aestrong-syntax $a wff ( Q1149022AEStrong M W H ) $.
q1149022-diff-syntax $a class ( Q1149022Diff M W H K ) $.
q1149022-l1-distance-syntax
  $a class ( Q1149022L1Distance M W H K ) $.
q1149022-integrable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1149022Integrable M W H ) $.
q1149022-has-integral-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1149022HasIntegral M W H y ) $.
q1149022-integral-syntax $a class ( Q1149022Integral W M H ) $.

${
  $d G M $.

  q1149022-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149022Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q1149022-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1149022SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q1149022-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q1149022LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q1149022Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q1149022SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F M A n $.

  q1149022-sfinite-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149022SFinite M )
    <->
    E. F e. ( ( U. ran measures ) ^m NN0 )
      (
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            dom ( F ` n ) = dom M
            /\
            ( ( F ` n ) ` U. dom M ) < +oo
          )
        /\
        A. A e. dom M
          ( M ` A )
          =
          ( sum^ ` ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( F ` n ) ` A ) ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C M N P x y $.

  q1149022-prod-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q1149022ProdMeasure M N
  ) =
    (
      iota_ P e. U. ran measures
        (
          dom P = ( dom M sX dom N )
          /\
          A. C e. ( dom M sX dom N )
            ( P ` C )
            =
            (
              Q1149022LIntegral
              M
              ( x e. U. dom M |->
                (
                  N `
                  { y e. U. dom N | <. x , y >. e. C }
                )
              )
            )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d S W z $.

  q1149022-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149022Tendsto W S z )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) z
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N S W n x $.

  q1149022-aestrong-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149022AEStrong M W H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( S ` n )
                e. ( dom M MblFnM ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) )
              /\
              ran ( S ` n ) e. Fin
            )
          /\
          E. N e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` N ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                (
                  Q1149022Tendsto
                  W
                  ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( S ` n ) ` x ) )
                  ( H ` x )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1149022-diff-definition $a |- (
    Q1149022Diff M W H K
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      (
        ( H ` x )
        ( +g ` W )
        ( ( -g ` W ) ` ( K ` x ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1149022-l1-distance-definition $a |- (
    Q1149022L1Distance M W H K
  ) =
    (
      Q1149022LIntegral
      M
      ( x e. U. dom M |->
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          `
          ( ( Q1149022Diff M W H K ) ` x )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M W x $.

  q1149022-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149022Integrable M W H )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1149022AEStrong M W H )
      /\
      (
        Q1149022LIntegral
        M
        ( x e. U. dom M |->
          ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( H ` x ) )
        )
      )
      < +oo
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M S W n y $.

  q1149022-has-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149022HasIntegral M W H y )
    <->
    (
      y e. ( Base ` W )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            ( ( S ` n ) e. dom ( W sitg M ) )
          /\
          (
            Q1149022Tendsto
            ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
            ( n e. NN0 |->
              ( Q1149022L1Distance M W H ( S ` n ) ) )
            0
            /\
            Q1149022Tendsto
            W
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( W sitg M ) ` ( S ` n ) ) )
            y
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M W y $.

  q1149022-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1149022Integral W M H
    =
    if
    (
      (
        W e. CMetSp
        /\
        ( Q1149022Integrable M W H )
      ) ,
      (
        iota_ y e. ( Base ` W )
          ( Q1149022HasIntegral M W H y )
      ) ,
      ( 0g ` W )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M N W w x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q1149022-fubini $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. N e. U. ran measures
        A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = RRfld }
          A. F e.
            (
              ( Base ` W )
              ^m
              ( U. dom M X. U. dom N )
            )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( Q1149022SFinite M )
                  /\
                  ( Q1149022SFinite N )
                )
                /\
                (
                  Q1149022Integrable
                  ( Q1149022ProdMeasure M N )
                  W
                  F
                )
              )
              ->
              (
                Q1149022Integral
                W
                ( Q1149022ProdMeasure M N )
                F
              )
              =
              (
                Q1149022Integral
                W
                M
                ( x e. U. dom M |->
                  (
                    Q1149022Integral
                    W
                    N
                    ( y e. U. dom N |->
                      ( F ` <. x , y >. )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
  $.
$}

title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1149022,
:: "Fubini's theorem": for a Bochner-integrable function from a product of
:: s-finite measure spaces (including empty carriers) to a real normed space,
:: its product integral equals the iterated integral. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE6, SUBSET_1,
      SEQFUNC, MESFUNC5, PARTFUN1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, RELAT_1, ARYTM_3,
      ARYTM_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL2, CARD_1, COMPLEX1, SEQ_2, TARSKI, REAL_1,
      PBOOLE, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, VALUED_1, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_2, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1,
      DUALSP01, FINSET_1, BINOP_1, INTEGRA5, LOPBAN_1, RSSPACE3, FCONT_1,
      MEASUR10, FUNCT_3, MEASUR11, MESFUN12, MESFUN13, SUPINF_2, LPSPACE1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
      XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_0,
      RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NAT_1, PROB_1,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE6, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6,
      STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1,
      DUALSP01, FINSET_1, BINOP_1, RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1, SUPINF_2, MEASUR10,
      MEASUR11, MESFUN12, LPSPACE1;
 constructors REAL_1, EXTREAL1, MEASURE6, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5,
      MESFUNC6, RELSET_1, COMPLEX1, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1, DUALSP01,
      FINSET_1, BINOP_1, RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1, SUPINF_1, MEASUR11, MESFUN12,
      LPSPACE1;
 registrations SUBSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, ORDINAL1, PARTFUN1,
      MEASURE1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0,
      FUNCT_1, VALUED_0, XXREAL_3, RELSET_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
      NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1, DUALSP01, FINSET_1, RSSPACE3,
      LOPBAN_1, MEASURE6, MESFUNC7;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6,
      NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, HAHNBAN, HAHNBAN1, RSSPACE3, LOPBAN_1;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, NORMSP_0, BINOP_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1;

theorem
  (for X1 being empty set,
       X2 being set,
       S1 being SigmaField of X1,
       S2 being SigmaField of X2,
       M1 being sigma_Measure of S1,
       M2 being sigma_Measure of S2,
       G being RealNormSpace,
       f being Function of [:X1,X2:],the carrier of G
   st
     (ex D1 being sequence of Funcs(S1,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
         ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
           D1.n = m & m.X1 < +infty) &
       (for A being Element of S1 holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
             ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
               D1.n = m & a.n = m.A) &
           M1.A = SUM(a))) &
     (ex D2 being sequence of Funcs(S2,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
         ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
           D2.n = m & m.X2 < +infty) &
       (for B being Element of S2 holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
             ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
               D2.n = m & a.n = m.B) &
           M2.B = SUM(a)))
   holds
     ex vp,vi being Point of G st
       vp = the ZeroF of G &
       vi = the ZeroF of G &
       vp = vi)
  &
  (for X1 being non empty set,
       X2 being empty set,
       S1 being SigmaField of X1,
       S2 being SigmaField of X2,
       M1 being sigma_Measure of S1,
       M2 being sigma_Measure of S2,
       G being RealNormSpace,
       f being Function of [:X1,X2:],the carrier of G
   st
     (ex D1 being sequence of Funcs(S1,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
         ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
           D1.n = m & m.X1 < +infty) &
       (for A being Element of S1 holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
             ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
               D1.n = m & a.n = m.A) &
           M1.A = SUM(a))) &
     (ex D2 being sequence of Funcs(S2,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
         ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
           D2.n = m & m.X2 < +infty) &
       (for B being Element of S2 holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
             ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
               D2.n = m & a.n = m.B) &
           M2.B = SUM(a)))
   holds
     ex vp,vi being Point of G,
        inner being Function of X1,the carrier of G
     st
       (for x being Element of X1 holds
         inner.x = the ZeroF of G) &
       vp = the ZeroF of G &
       vi = the ZeroF of G &
       vp = vi)
  &
  (for X1,X2 being non empty set,
      S1 being SigmaField of X1,
      S2 being SigmaField of X2,
      M1 being sigma_Measure of S1,
      M2 being sigma_Measure of S2,
      G being RealNormSpace,
      f being Function of [:X1,X2:],the carrier of G
  st
    (ex D1 being sequence of Funcs(S1,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
         ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
           D1.n = m & m.X1 < +infty) &
       (for A being Element of S1 holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
             ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
               D1.n = m & a.n = m.A) &
           M1.A = SUM(a))) &
    (ex D2 being sequence of Funcs(S2,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
         ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
           D2.n = m & m.X2 < +infty) &
       (for B being Element of S2 holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
             ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
               D2.n = m & a.n = m.B) &
           M2.B = SUM(a)))
  holds
  for D1 being sequence of Funcs(S1,ExtREAL),
      D2 being sequence of Funcs(S2,ExtREAL),
      e being sequence of [:NAT,NAT:],
      P being sigma_Measure of sigma measurable_rectangles(S1,S2),
      g being Function of [:X1,X2:],the carrier of G
  st
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
        D1.n = m & m.X1 < +infty) &
    (for A being Element of S1 holds
      ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
        (for n being Nat holds
          ex m being sigma_Measure of S1 st
            D1.n = m & a.n = m.A) &
        M1.A = SUM(a)) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
        D2.n = m & m.X2 < +infty) &
    (for B being Element of S2 holds
      ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
        (for n being Nat holds
          ex m being sigma_Measure of S2 st
            D2.n = m & a.n = m.B) &
        M2.B = SUM(a)) &
    e is one-to-one &
    rng e = [:NAT,NAT:] &
    (for C being Element of sigma measurable_rectangles(S1,S2) holds
      ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
        (for n being Nat holds
          ex i,j being Nat,
             m1 being sigma_Measure of S1,
             m2 being sigma_Measure of S2
          st
            e.n = [i,j] &
            D1.i = m1 &
            D2.j = m2 &
            a.n = Prod_Measure(m1,m2).C) &
        P.C = SUM(a)) &
    (ex N being Element of sigma measurable_rectangles(S1,S2),
        Q being sequence of Funcs([:X1,X2:],the carrier of G)
     st
       P.N = 0 &
       (for z being Element of [:X1,X2:] st not z in N holds
         g.z = f.z) &
       (for k being Nat holds
         ex q being Function of [:X1,X2:],the carrier of G,
            R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
         st
           Q.k = q &
           (for z being Element of [:X1,X2:] holds q.z in R) &
           (for y being Point of G holds
             {z where z is Element of [:X1,X2:]: q.z = y}
               in sigma measurable_rectangles(S1,S2))) &
       (for z being Element of [:X1,X2:] holds
         for r being Real st 0 < r holds
           ex k0 being Nat st
             for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
               ex q being Function of [:X1,X2:],the carrier of G st
                 Q.k = q & ||.q.z - g.z.|| < r)) &
    (ex nf being Function of [:X1,X2:],REAL st
       (for z being Element of [:X1,X2:] holds nf.z = ||.g.z.||) &
       nf is_integrable_on P)
  holds
    (not (for s being sequence of G
            st s is Cauchy_sequence_by_Norm holds s is convergent))
    or
    ex vp,vi being Point of G,
       inner being Function of X1,the carrier of G,
       N1 being Element of S1
    st
      M1.N1 = 0 &
      (for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds
        ex sf being Function of [:X1,X2:],REAL st
          (for z being Element of [:X1,X2:] holds
            sf.z = L.(g.z)) &
          Integral(P,sf) = L.vp) &
      (for x being Element of X1 st not x in N1 holds
        (ex Qx being sequence of Funcs(X2,the carrier of G),
            ns being Function of X2,REAL
         st
           (for k being Nat holds
             ex q being Function of X2,the carrier of G,
                R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
             st
               Qx.k = q &
               (for y being Element of X2 holds q.y in R) &
               (for v being Point of G holds
                 {y where y is Element of X2: q.y = v} in S2)) &
           (for y being Element of X2 holds
             for r being Real st 0 < r holds
               ex k0 being Nat st
                 for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
                   ex q being Function of X2,the carrier of G st
                     Qx.k = q & ||.q.y - g.(x,y).|| < r) &
           (for y being Element of X2 holds
             ns.y = ||.g.(x,y).||) &
           ns is_integrable_on M2) &
        (for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds
          ex ss being Function of X2,REAL st
            (for y being Element of X2 holds
              ss.y = L.(g.(x,y))) &
            Integral(M2,ss) = L.(inner.x))) &
      (ex Qh being sequence of Funcs(X1,the carrier of G),
          ni being Function of X1,REAL
       st
         (for k being Nat holds
           ex q being Function of X1,the carrier of G,
              R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
           st
             Qh.k = q &
             (for x being Element of X1 holds q.x in R) &
             (for v being Point of G holds
               {x where x is Element of X1: q.x = v} in S1)) &
         (for x being Element of X1 holds
           for r being Real st 0 < r holds
             ex k0 being Nat st
               for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
                 ex q being Function of X1,the carrier of G st
                   Qh.k = q & ||.q.x - inner.x.|| < r) &
         (for x being Element of X1 holds
           ni.x = ||.inner.x.||) &
         ni is_integrable_on M1) &
      (for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds
        ex si being Function of X1,REAL st
          (for x being Element of X1 holds
            si.x = L.(inner.x)) &
          Integral(M1,si) = L.vi) &
      vp = vi)
proof
end;
