title: Q1149022_fubini_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1149022,
% "Fubini's theorem": an integrable normed-real-vector-space-valued function on
% the product of two s-finite measure spaces has product integral equal to its iterated integral.
% This file contains no proof.

fubini_s_theorem_Q1149022[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrierA: [A -> bool],
  B: TYPE+,
  carrierB: [B -> bool],
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  smulG: [real, G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE =
    [# point_tag: nat, a_coordinate: A, b_coordinate: B #]

  defaultA: A =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: A): TRUE)

  defaultB: B =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: B): TRUE)

  a_point(value: A): point =
    (# point_tag := 0,
       a_coordinate := value,
       b_coordinate := defaultB #)

  b_point(value: B): point =
    (# point_tag := 1,
       a_coordinate := defaultA,
       b_coordinate := value #)

  pair_point(left: A, right: B): point =
    (# point_tag := 2,
       a_coordinate := left,
       b_coordinate := right #)

  event: TYPE = [point -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  measure_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_map]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  g_function: TYPE = [point -> G]
  g_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> g_function]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [point -> measure_value]

  a_domain: event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      point_tag(p) = 0
        AND b_coordinate(p) = defaultB
        AND carrierA(a_coordinate(p))

  b_domain: event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      point_tag(p) = 1
        AND a_coordinate(p) = defaultA
        AND carrierB(b_coordinate(p))

  product_domain: event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      point_tag(p) = 2
        AND carrierA(a_coordinate(p))
        AND carrierB(b_coordinate(p))

  subG(x, y: G): G =
    addG(x, negG(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G): addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: G):
        smulG(a, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a + b, x) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a * b, x) = smulG(a, smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): smulG(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        normG(smulG(a, x)) = abs(a) * normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  converges_to_g(values: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normG(subG(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_g(values: g_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
            IMPLIES
              normG(
                subG(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
                < epsilon_value

  complete_space_g: bool =
    FORALL (values: g_sequence):
      cauchy_g(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: G): converges_to_g(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_finite(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (p: point): FALSE

  event_complement(domain, E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      domain(p) AND NOT E(p)

  countable_union(domain: event, events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      domain(p)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(p)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      E(p) IMPLIES F(p)

  carrier_event(domain, E: event): bool =
    event_subset(E, domain)

  pairwise_disjoint(
      domain: event,
      events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (p: point):
          domain(p) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(p)
              AND events(right_index)(p))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      domain: event,
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (p: point):
          domain(p) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(p)
              AND events(right_index)(p))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(
      domain: event,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(domain, E))
      AND Sigma(domain)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          Sigma(event_complement(domain, E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(domain, events)))

  is_measure(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(domain, Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(domain, events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(domain, events))))

  finite_measure(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(domain, M, Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_finite(M(domain))

  is_measure_sum(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      summands: measure_sequence,
      total: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES
        extended_nonnegative_sum(
          LAMBDA (index: nat): summands(index)(E),
          total(E))

  s_finite_measure(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(domain, M, Sigma)
      AND EXISTS (summands: measure_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          finite_measure(
            domain, summands(index), Sigma))
          AND is_measure_sum(Sigma, summands, M)

  sigma_subset(left, right: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      left(E) IMPLIES right(E)

  rectangle(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      product_domain(p)
        AND E(a_point(a_coordinate(p)))
        AND F(b_point(b_coordinate(p)))

  contains_measurable_rectangles(
      SigmaAB, SigmaA, SigmaB: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E, F: event):
      SigmaA(E) AND SigmaB(F) IMPLIES
        SigmaAB(rectangle(E, F))

  is_product_sigma_algebra(
      SigmaAB, SigmaA, SigmaB: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(product_domain, SigmaAB)
      AND contains_measurable_rectangles(
        SigmaAB, SigmaA, SigmaB)
      AND (FORALL (candidate: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(product_domain, candidate)
          AND contains_measurable_rectangles(
            candidate, SigmaA, SigmaB))
        IMPLIES sigma_subset(SigmaAB, candidate))

  product_sigma_algebra(
      SigmaA, SigmaB: sigma_algebra): sigma_algebra =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (SigmaAB: sigma_algebra):
        is_product_sigma_algebra(
          SigmaAB, SigmaA, SigmaB))

  null_event(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(domain, E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property_value: [point -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      domain,
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (p: point):
        domain(p) AND NOT property_value(p))

  finite_g_sum(values: g_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_g_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_g_value(
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      p: point): G =
    finite_g_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(p) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroG
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_g_data(
      domain: event,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(domain, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_g(
      domain: event,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_g_data(
        domain, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (p: point):
          domain(p) IMPLIES
            function_value(p) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, p))

  strongly_measurable_g(
      domain: event,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: g_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_g(
          domain, Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (p: point):
          domain(p) IMPLIES
            converges_to_g(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(p),
              function_value(p)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: g_function):
      strongly_measurable_g(
        domain, Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          domain,
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (p: point):
            function_value(p) = measurable_version(p))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      domain: event,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      domain(p) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(p))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      p: point): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, p),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(p) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      domain: event,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(domain, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      domain: event,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(domain, function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        domain, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (p: point):
        domain(p) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, p),
            function_value(p)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          domain, Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(domain, function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        domain, M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          domain, M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  lower_lebesgue_integral(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: measure_value):
        has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          domain,
          M,
          Sigma,
          function_value,
          integral_value))

  vertical_section(S: event, x: A): event =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      b_domain(p)
        AND S(pair_point(x, b_coordinate(p)))

  section_measure_function(
      N: measure_map,
      SigmaB: sigma_algebra,
      S: event): nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      IF a_domain(p)
          AND SigmaB(
            vertical_section(S, a_coordinate(p))) THEN
        N(vertical_section(S, a_coordinate(p)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  product_measure(
      M, N: measure_map,
      SigmaA, SigmaB: sigma_algebra): measure_map =
    LAMBDA (S: event):
      lower_lebesgue_integral(
        a_domain,
        M,
        SigmaA,
        section_measure_function(N, SigmaB, S))

  enorm_g(
      domain: event,
      function_value: g_function): nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      IF domain(p) THEN
        finite_measure_value(normG(function_value(p)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_finite_integral_g(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        domain,
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_g(domain, function_value),
        integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  integrable_g(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    is_measure(domain, M, Sigma)
      AND ae_strongly_measurable_g(
        domain, M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_g(
        domain, M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_simple_g_data(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_g_data(
      domain, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroG
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_simple_g_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        smulG(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_g_integral(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_g_data(
        domain, M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (p: point):
          domain(p) IMPLIES
            function_value(p) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, p))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_g_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: g_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        domain,
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_g(
          domain,
          LAMBDA (p: point):
            subG(function_value(p), approximant(p))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      approximants: g_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_g(
        domain, Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            domain,
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: g_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: g_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        domain, M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_g_integral(
            domain,
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_g(simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      domain: event,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): G =
    IF complete_space_g
        AND integrable_g(domain, M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: G):
          has_bochner_integral(
            domain,
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroG
    ENDIF

  right_section(f: g_function, x: A): g_function =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      IF b_domain(p) THEN
        f(pair_point(x, b_coordinate(p)))
      ELSE
        zeroG
      ENDIF

  iterated_integral_function(
      N: measure_map,
      SigmaB: sigma_algebra,
      f: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (p: point):
      IF a_domain(p) THEN
        bochner_integral(
          b_domain,
          N,
          SigmaB,
          right_section(f, a_coordinate(p)))
      ELSE
        zeroG
      ENDIF

  fubini_s_theorem: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M, N: measure_map),
          (SigmaA, SigmaB: sigma_algebra),
          (f: g_function):
        (s_finite_measure(a_domain, M, SigmaA)
          AND s_finite_measure(b_domain, N, SigmaB)
          AND integrable_g(
            product_domain,
            product_measure(M, N, SigmaA, SigmaB),
            product_sigma_algebra(SigmaA, SigmaB),
            f))
        IMPLIES
          bochner_integral(
            product_domain,
            product_measure(M, N, SigmaA, SigmaB),
            product_sigma_algebra(SigmaA, SigmaB),
            f)
            =
          bochner_integral(
            a_domain,
            M,
            SigmaA,
            iterated_integral_function(N, SigmaB, f))
END fubini_s_theorem_Q1149022

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1149458
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1149458), "Compactness theorem": an arbitrary
  first-order theory has a nonempty model if and only if each of its finite
  subtheories has a nonempty model. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Polymorphic Record q1149458_language@{u v} : Type := {
  q1149458_functions : nat -> Type@{u};
  q1149458_relations : nat -> Type@{v}
}.

Polymorphic Inductive q1149458_list@{w}
    (A : Type@{w}) : Type@{w} :=
| q1149458_list_nil : q1149458_list A
| q1149458_list_cons : A -> q1149458_list A -> q1149458_list A.

Arguments q1149458_list_nil {A}.
Arguments q1149458_list_cons {A} _ _.

Polymorphic Fixpoint q1149458_member@{w}
    {A : Type@{w}} (x : A) (xs : q1149458_list@{w} A) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | q1149458_list_nil => False
  | q1149458_list_cons y ys =>
      x = y \/ q1149458_member x ys
  end.

Polymorphic Inductive q1149458_tuple@{w}
    (A : Type@{w}) : nat -> Type@{w} :=
| q1149458_tuple_nil : q1149458_tuple A 0
| q1149458_tuple_cons :
    forall n, A -> q1149458_tuple A n -> q1149458_tuple A (S n).

Arguments q1149458_tuple_nil {A}.
Arguments q1149458_tuple_cons {A n} _ _.

Polymorphic Record q1149458_structure@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    (L : q1149458_language@{u v}) (A : Type@{w}) : Type@{w} := {
  q1149458_function_interpretation :
    forall n,
      q1149458_functions L n ->
      q1149458_tuple@{w} A n ->
      A;
  q1149458_relation_interpretation :
    forall n,
      q1149458_relations L n ->
      q1149458_tuple@{w} A n ->
      Prop
}.

Arguments q1149458_function_interpretation {L A} _ {n} _ _.
Arguments q1149458_relation_interpretation {L A} _ {n} _ _.

Polymorphic Inductive q1149458_term@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    (L : q1149458_language@{u v}) (variables : nat) : Type@{w} :=
| q1149458_variable :
    Fin.t variables ->
    q1149458_term L variables
| q1149458_function :
    forall arity,
      q1149458_functions L arity ->
      q1149458_terms L variables arity ->
      q1149458_term L variables
with q1149458_terms
    (L : q1149458_language@{u v})
    (variables : nat) : nat -> Type@{w} :=
| q1149458_terms_nil :
    q1149458_terms L variables 0
| q1149458_terms_cons :
    forall arity,
      q1149458_term L variables ->
      q1149458_terms L variables arity ->
      q1149458_terms L variables (S arity).

Arguments q1149458_variable {L variables} _.
Arguments q1149458_function {L variables arity} _ _.
Arguments q1149458_terms_nil {L variables}.
Arguments q1149458_terms_cons {L variables arity} _ _.

Polymorphic Fixpoint q1149458_term_denote@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    {A : Type@{w}}
    {variables : nat}
    (S : q1149458_structure@{u v w} L A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (t : q1149458_term@{u v w} L variables) : A :=
  match t with
  | q1149458_variable index => valuation index
  | q1149458_function function_symbol arguments =>
      q1149458_function_interpretation S function_symbol
        (q1149458_terms_denote S valuation arguments)
  end
with q1149458_terms_denote
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    {A : Type@{w}}
    {variables arity : nat}
    (S : q1149458_structure@{u v w} L A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (ts : q1149458_terms@{u v w} L variables arity) :
      q1149458_tuple@{w} A arity :=
  match ts with
  | q1149458_terms_nil => q1149458_tuple_nil
  | q1149458_terms_cons t rest =>
      q1149458_tuple_cons
        (q1149458_term_denote S valuation t)
        (q1149458_terms_denote S valuation rest)
  end.

Polymorphic Inductive q1149458_formula@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    (L : q1149458_language@{u v}) : nat -> Type@{w} :=
| q1149458_equal :
    forall variables,
      q1149458_term@{u v w} L variables ->
      q1149458_term@{u v w} L variables ->
      q1149458_formula L variables
| q1149458_atomic :
    forall variables arity,
      q1149458_relations L arity ->
      q1149458_terms@{u v w} L variables arity ->
      q1149458_formula L variables
| q1149458_falsum :
    forall variables, q1149458_formula L variables
| q1149458_implies :
    forall variables,
      q1149458_formula L variables ->
      q1149458_formula L variables ->
      q1149458_formula L variables
| q1149458_forall :
    forall variables,
      q1149458_formula L (S variables) ->
      q1149458_formula L variables.

Arguments q1149458_equal {L variables} _ _.
Arguments q1149458_atomic {L variables arity} _ _.
Arguments q1149458_falsum {L variables}.
Arguments q1149458_implies {L variables} _ _.
Arguments q1149458_forall {L variables} _.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_extend_valuation@{w | Set < w}
    {A : Type@{w}}
    {variables : nat}
    (x : A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (index : Fin.t (S variables)) : A :=
  (match index in Fin.t size return
     match size with
     | 0 => A
     | S predecessor => (Fin.t predecessor -> A) -> A
     end
   with
   | @Fin.F1 _ => fun _ => x
   | @Fin.FS _ index' => fun predecessor_valuation =>
       predecessor_valuation index'
   end) valuation.

Polymorphic Fixpoint q1149458_satisfies@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    {A : Type@{w}}
    {variables : nat}
    (S : q1149458_structure@{u v w} L A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (phi : q1149458_formula@{u v w} L variables) : Prop :=
  (match phi in q1149458_formula _ matched_variables
     return (Fin.t matched_variables -> A) -> Prop with
  | q1149458_equal t u =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1149458_term_denote S matched_valuation t =
        q1149458_term_denote S matched_valuation u
  | q1149458_atomic relation_symbol arguments =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1149458_relation_interpretation S relation_symbol
          (q1149458_terms_denote S matched_valuation arguments)
  | q1149458_falsum => fun _ => False
  | q1149458_implies psi chi =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1149458_satisfies S matched_valuation psi ->
        q1149458_satisfies S matched_valuation chi
  | q1149458_forall psi =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        forall x : A,
          q1149458_satisfies S
            (q1149458_extend_valuation@{w} x matched_valuation) psi
  end) valuation.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_sentence@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    (L : q1149458_language@{u v}) : Type@{w} :=
  q1149458_formula@{u v w} L 0.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_theory@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    (L : q1149458_language@{u v}) : Type@{w} :=
  q1149458_sentence@{u v w} L -> Prop.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_empty_valuation@{w | Set < w}
    {A : Type@{w}} (index : Fin.t 0) : A :=
  match index with
  end.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_models@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    {A : Type@{w}}
    (S : q1149458_structure@{u v w} L A)
    (T : q1149458_theory@{u v w} L) : Prop :=
  forall phi : q1149458_sentence@{u v w} L,
    T phi ->
    q1149458_satisfies S q1149458_empty_valuation@{w} phi.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_nonempty@{w}
    (A : Type@{w}) : Prop :=
  exists x : A, True.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_is_satisfiable@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    (T : q1149458_theory@{u v w} L) : Prop :=
  exists (A : Type@{w})
      (S : q1149458_structure@{u v w} L A),
    q1149458_nonempty@{w} A /\
    q1149458_models@{u v w} S T.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_list_theory@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    (sentences :
      q1149458_list@{w} (q1149458_sentence@{u v w} L)) :
      q1149458_theory@{u v w} L :=
  fun phi => q1149458_member@{w} phi sentences.

Polymorphic Definition q1149458_is_finitely_satisfiable@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w}
    {L : q1149458_language@{u v}}
    (T : q1149458_theory@{u v w} L) : Prop :=
  forall sentences :
      q1149458_list@{w} (q1149458_sentence@{u v w} L),
    (forall phi : q1149458_sentence@{u v w} L,
      q1149458_member@{w} phi sentences -> T phi) ->
    @q1149458_is_satisfiable@{u v w}
      L (q1149458_list_theory@{u v w} sentences).

Polymorphic Theorem q1149458_compactness_theorem@{u v w
    | Set < w, u <= w, v <= w} :
  forall (L : q1149458_language@{u v})
      (T : q1149458_theory@{u v w} L),
    @q1149458_is_satisfiable@{u v w} L T <->
    @q1149458_is_finitely_satisfiable@{u v w} L T.
Admitted.

  satisfiable. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1149458_compactness_theorem
  imports Main
begin

datatype 'f fo_term =
    FOVar nat
  | FOFunc 'f "'f fo_term list"

datatype ('f, 'r) fo_formula =
    FOFalse
  | FOEqual "'f fo_term" "'f fo_term"
  | FORel 'r "'f fo_term list"
  | FOImp "('f, 'r) fo_formula" "('f, 'r) fo_formula"
  | FOAll nat "('f, 'r) fo_formula"

type_synonym ('f, 'r) fo_universe = "('f + 'r) + nat"

record ('f, 'r) fo_structure =
  fo_carrier :: "('f, 'r) fo_universe set"
  fo_fun_interp ::
    "'f \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_universe list \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_universe"
  fo_rel_interp :: "'r \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_universe list \<Rightarrow> bool"

primrec wf_fo_term :: "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_term ar (FOVar n) = True"
| "wf_fo_term ar (FOFunc f ts) =
    (length ts = ar f \<and> list_all (wf_fo_term ar) ts)"

primrec wf_fo_formula ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_formula far rar FOFalse = True"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOEqual s t) =
    (wf_fo_term far s \<and> wf_fo_term far t)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FORel r ts) =
    (length ts = rar r \<and> list_all (wf_fo_term far) ts)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOImp p q) =
    (wf_fo_formula far rar p \<and> wf_fo_formula far rar q)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOAll n p) = wf_fo_formula far rar p"

primrec free_vars_fo_term :: "'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "free_vars_fo_term (FOVar n) = [n]"
| "free_vars_fo_term (FOFunc f ts) =
    concat (map free_vars_fo_term ts)"

primrec free_vars_fo_formula :: "('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "free_vars_fo_formula FOFalse = []"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FOEqual s t) =
    (free_vars_fo_term s @ free_vars_fo_term t)"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FORel r ts) =
    concat (map free_vars_fo_term ts)"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FOImp p q) =
    (free_vars_fo_formula p @ free_vars_fo_formula q)"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FOAll n p) =
    filter (\<lambda>m. m \<noteq> n) (free_vars_fo_formula p)"

definition is_fo_sentence ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_fo_sentence far rar p \<longleftrightarrow>
    wf_fo_formula far rar p \<and> free_vars_fo_formula p = []"

definition fo_theory ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fo_theory far rar T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p\<in>T. is_fo_sentence far rar p)"

definition wf_fo_structure ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_structure far A \<longleftrightarrow>
    fo_carrier A \<noteq> {} \<and>
    (\<forall>f xs. length xs = far f \<longrightarrow>
      set xs \<subseteq> fo_carrier A \<longrightarrow>
      fo_fun_interp A f xs \<in> fo_carrier A)"

primrec eval_fo_term ::
    "('f, 'r) fo_structure \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_universe) \<Rightarrow>
      'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_universe" where
  "eval_fo_term A v (FOVar n) = v n"
| "eval_fo_term A v (FOFunc f ts) =
    fo_fun_interp A f (map (eval_fo_term A v) ts)"

primrec satisfies_fo ::
    "('f, 'r) fo_structure \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_universe) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "satisfies_fo A v FOFalse = False"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOEqual s t) =
    (eval_fo_term A v s = eval_fo_term A v t)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FORel r ts) =
    fo_rel_interp A r (map (eval_fo_term A v) ts)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOImp p q) =
    (satisfies_fo A v p \<longrightarrow> satisfies_fo A v q)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOAll n p) =
    (\<forall>x\<in>fo_carrier A. satisfies_fo A (v(n := x)) p)"

definition fo_sentence_holds ::
    "('f, 'r) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fo_sentence_holds A p \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>v. range v \<subseteq> fo_carrier A \<longrightarrow> satisfies_fo A v p)"

definition fo_satisfiable ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fo_satisfiable far rar T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>A :: ('f, 'r) fo_structure.
      wf_fo_structure far A \<and> (\<forall>p\<in>T. fo_sentence_holds A p))"

definition fo_finitely_satisfiable ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fo_finitely_satisfiable far rar T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>T0. finite T0 \<longrightarrow> T0 \<subseteq> T \<longrightarrow>
      fo_satisfiable far rar T0)"

theorem compactness_theorem:
  fixes far :: "'f \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and rar :: "'r \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and T :: "('f, 'r) fo_formula set"
  assumes "fo_theory far rar T"
  shows "fo_satisfiable far rar T \<longleftrightarrow>
    fo_finitely_satisfiable far rar T"
  sorry

end

title: Q1149458_compactness_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1149458,
  "Compactness theorem": an arbitrary first-order theory is satisfiable if and
  only if each of its finite subtheories is satisfiable. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let q1149458_term_INDUCT,q1149458_term_RECURSION = define_type
  "q1149458_term =
       Q1149458_Var num
     | Q1149458_Fun F (q1149458_term list)";;

let q1149458_form_INDUCT,q1149458_form_RECURSION = define_type
  "q1149458_form =
       Q1149458_Equal (F q1149458_term) (F q1149458_term)
     | Q1149458_Rel R ((F q1149458_term) list)
     | Q1149458_Not q1149458_form
     | Q1149458_And q1149458_form q1149458_form
     | Q1149458_Exists num q1149458_form";;

let q1149458_term_wellformed = new_recursive_definition
  q1149458_term_RECURSION
  `(q1149458_term_wellformed function_symbols function_arity
       (Q1149458_Var x) <=> T) /\
   (q1149458_term_wellformed function_symbols function_arity
       (Q1149458_Fun f arguments) <=>
      f IN function_symbols /\
      LENGTH arguments = function_arity f /\
      q1149458_term_list_wellformed
        function_symbols function_arity arguments) /\
   (q1149458_term_list_wellformed
       function_symbols function_arity [] <=> T) /\
   (q1149458_term_list_wellformed
       function_symbols function_arity (CONS term rest) <=>
      q1149458_term_wellformed function_symbols function_arity term /\
      q1149458_term_list_wellformed
        function_symbols function_arity rest)`;;

let q1149458_form_wellformed = new_recursive_definition
  q1149458_form_RECURSION
  `(q1149458_form_wellformed
       function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1149458_Equal left right) <=>
      q1149458_term_wellformed function_symbols function_arity left /\
      q1149458_term_wellformed function_symbols function_arity right) /\
   (q1149458_form_wellformed
       function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1149458_Rel relation arguments) <=>
      relation IN relation_symbols /\
      LENGTH arguments = relation_arity relation /\
      q1149458_term_list_wellformed
        function_symbols function_arity arguments) /\
   (q1149458_form_wellformed
       function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1149458_Not p) <=>
      q1149458_form_wellformed
        function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity p) /\
   (q1149458_form_wellformed
       function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1149458_And p q) <=>
      q1149458_form_wellformed
        function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity p /\
      q1149458_form_wellformed
        function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity q) /\
   (q1149458_form_wellformed
       function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1149458_Exists x p) <=>
      q1149458_form_wellformed
        function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity relation_arity p)`;;

let q1149458_term_has_variable = new_recursive_definition
  q1149458_term_RECURSION
  `(q1149458_term_has_variable x (Q1149458_Var y) <=> x = y) /\
   (q1149458_term_has_variable x (Q1149458_Fun f arguments) <=>
      q1149458_term_list_has_variable x arguments) /\
   (q1149458_term_list_has_variable x [] <=> F) /\
   (q1149458_term_list_has_variable x (CONS term rest) <=>
      q1149458_term_has_variable x term \/
      q1149458_term_list_has_variable x rest)`;;

let q1149458_form_has_free_variable = new_recursive_definition
  q1149458_form_RECURSION
  `(q1149458_form_has_free_variable x (Q1149458_Equal left right) <=>
      q1149458_term_has_variable x left \/
      q1149458_term_has_variable x right) /\
   (q1149458_form_has_free_variable x (Q1149458_Rel relation arguments) <=>
      q1149458_term_list_has_variable x arguments) /\
   (q1149458_form_has_free_variable x (Q1149458_Not p) <=>
      q1149458_form_has_free_variable x p) /\
   (q1149458_form_has_free_variable x (Q1149458_And p q) <=>
      q1149458_form_has_free_variable x p \/
      q1149458_form_has_free_variable x q) /\
   (q1149458_form_has_free_variable x (Q1149458_Exists y p) <=>
      ~(x = y) /\ q1149458_form_has_free_variable x p)`;;

let q1149458_is_sentence = new_definition
  `q1149458_is_sentence p <=>
     !x. ~(q1149458_form_has_free_variable x p)`;;

let q1149458_update = new_definition
  `q1149458_update x a (valuation:num->A) =
     \y. if y = x then a else valuation y`;;

let q1149458_term_value = new_recursive_definition
  q1149458_term_RECURSION
  `(q1149458_term_value function_interpretation valuation
       (Q1149458_Var x) =
      valuation x) /\
   (q1149458_term_value function_interpretation valuation
       (Q1149458_Fun f arguments) =
      function_interpretation f
        (q1149458_term_list_value
           function_interpretation valuation arguments)) /\
   (q1149458_term_list_value function_interpretation valuation [] = []) /\
   (q1149458_term_list_value function_interpretation valuation
       (CONS term rest) =
      CONS (q1149458_term_value function_interpretation valuation term)
           (q1149458_term_list_value
              function_interpretation valuation rest))`;;

let q1149458_holds = new_recursive_definition
  q1149458_form_RECURSION
  `(q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
       valuation (Q1149458_Equal left right) <=>
      q1149458_term_value function_interpretation valuation left =
      q1149458_term_value function_interpretation valuation right) /\
   (q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
       valuation (Q1149458_Rel relation arguments) <=>
      relation_interpretation relation
        (q1149458_term_list_value
           function_interpretation valuation arguments)) /\
   (q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
       valuation (Q1149458_Not p) <=>
      ~(q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
          valuation p)) /\
   (q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
       valuation (Q1149458_And p q) <=>
      q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
        valuation p /\
      q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
        valuation q) /\
   (q1149458_holds domain function_interpretation relation_interpretation
       valuation (Q1149458_Exists x p) <=>
      ?a. a IN domain /\
          q1149458_holds domain
            function_interpretation relation_interpretation
            (q1149458_update x a valuation) p)`;;

let Q1149458_COMPACTNESS_THEOREM =
 `let is_satisfiable =
    \(function_symbols:F->bool) (relation_symbols:R->bool)
     (function_arity:F->num) (theory:(F,R)q1149458_form->bool).
       ?domain:(num#F#R)->bool.
       ?function_interpretation:F->((num#F#R)list)->(num#F#R).
       ?relation_interpretation:R->((num#F#R)list)->bool.
         (?a:num#F#R. a IN domain) /\
         (!f:F. !arguments:(num#F#R)list.
            f IN function_symbols /\
            LENGTH arguments = function_arity f /\
            ALL (\a:num#F#R. a IN domain) arguments
            ==> function_interpretation f arguments IN domain) /\
         (!p:(F,R)q1149458_form.
            p IN theory
            ==> !valuation:num->(num#F#R).
                  (!x:num. valuation x IN domain)
                  ==> q1149458_holds
                        domain function_interpretation
                        relation_interpretation valuation p) in
  !function_symbols:F->bool.
  !relation_symbols:R->bool.
  !function_arity:F->num.
  !relation_arity:R->num.
  !theory:(F,R)q1149458_form->bool.
    (!p:(F,R)q1149458_form.
       p IN theory
       ==> q1149458_form_wellformed
             function_symbols relation_symbols
             function_arity relation_arity p /\
           q1149458_is_sentence p)
    ==> (is_satisfiable
           function_symbols relation_symbols function_arity theory <=>
         !finite_theory:(F,R)q1149458_form->bool.
           FINITE finite_theory /\ finite_theory SUBSET theory
           ==> is_satisfiable
                 function_symbols relation_symbols
                 function_arity finite_theory)`;;

title: Q1149458_compactness_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1149458,
;; "Compactness theorem": an arbitrary first-order theory has a nonempty model
;; if and only if each of its finite subtheories has a nonempty model. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; These conservative interfaces represent arbitrary, potentially infinite
;; languages, theories, carriers, and interpretations.  No carrier, language,
;; theory, function, or relation is replaced by a finite table.

(defstub q1149458-function-symbol-p
  (language arity symbol)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-relation-symbol-p
  (language arity symbol)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-theory-member-p
  (language theory sentence)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-carrier-p
  (structure element)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-function-value
  (language structure arity symbol arguments)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-relation-holds-p
  (language structure arity symbol arguments)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-term-value
  (language structure term bound-values)
  t)

(defstub q1149458-satisfies-p
  (language structure formula bound-values)
  t)

(defun q1149458-truth (value)
  (if value t nil))

;; Terms use de Bruijn indices for bound variables.  A term is either
;; (Q1149458-BOUND n) or
;; (Q1149458-FUNCTION arity symbol argument-list).

(defun q1149458-bound-term-p (depth term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 2)
   (equal (car term) 'q1149458-bound)
   (natp (cadr term))
   (< (cadr term) depth)))

(defun q1149458-function-term-shape-p (term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 4)
   (equal (car term) 'q1149458-function)
   (natp (cadr term))
   (true-listp (cadddr term))
   (equal (len (cadddr term)) (cadr term))))

(defun q1149458-all-terms-p (language depth pending fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (consp pending)
      (if (zp fuel)
          nil
        (let ((term (car pending)))
          (cond
           ((q1149458-bound-term-p depth term)
            (q1149458-all-terms-p
             language depth (cdr pending) (- fuel 1)))
           ((and
             (q1149458-function-term-shape-p term)
             (q1149458-function-symbol-p
              language (cadr term) (caddr term)))
            (q1149458-all-terms-p
             language
             depth
             (append (cadddr term) (cdr pending))
             (- fuel 1)))
           (t nil))))
    (equal pending nil)))

(defun q1149458-term-p (language depth term)
  (and
   (natp depth)
   (q1149458-all-terms-p
    language depth (list term) (acl2-count term))))

(defun q1149458-term-list-p (language depth arity terms)
  (and
   (natp arity)
   (true-listp terms)
   (equal (len terms) arity)
   (q1149458-all-terms-p
    language depth terms (acl2-count terms))))

;; Formulas use the same primitive constructors as the Lean source:
;; falsity, equality, relation application, implication, and universal
;; quantification.  Sentences are exactly the formulas at binder depth zero.

(defun q1149458-formula-p (language depth formula)
  (and
   (natp depth)
   (cond
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 1)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1149458-falsum))
     t)
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1149458-equal))
     (and
      (q1149458-term-p language depth (cadr formula))
      (q1149458-term-p language depth (caddr formula))))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 4)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1149458-relation)
      (natp (cadr formula))
      (q1149458-relation-symbol-p
       language (cadr formula) (caddr formula)))
     (q1149458-term-list-p
      language depth (cadr formula) (cadddr formula)))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1149458-implies))
     (and
      (q1149458-formula-p language depth (cadr formula))
      (q1149458-formula-p language depth (caddr formula))))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 2)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1149458-forall))
     (q1149458-formula-p
      language (+ 1 depth) (cadr formula)))
    (t nil))))

(defun q1149458-sentence-p (language sentence)
  (q1149458-formula-p language 0 sentence))

(defun q1149458-carrier-list-p (structure values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1149458-carrier-p structure (car values))
       (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1149458-term-values
    (language structure terms bound-values)
  (if (consp terms)
      (cons
       (q1149458-term-value
        language structure (car terms) bound-values)
       (q1149458-term-values
        language structure (cdr terms) bound-values))
    nil))

(defun q1149458-holds-p
    (language structure formula bound-values)
  (q1149458-truth
   (q1149458-satisfies-p
    language structure formula bound-values)))

(defun-sk q1149458-structure-nonempty-p (structure)
  (exists (element)
    (q1149458-carrier-p structure element)))

(defun-sk q1149458-all-elements-satisfy-p
    (language structure body bound-values)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q1149458-carrier-p structure element)
     (q1149458-holds-p
      language structure body (cons element bound-values)))))

;; A structure interprets every function symbol as a total operation on its
;; nonempty carrier.

(defun-sk q1149458-function-closure-p (language structure)
  (forall (arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1149458-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp arguments)
      (equal (len arguments) arity)
      (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure arguments))
     (q1149458-carrier-p
      structure
      (q1149458-function-value
       language structure arity symbol arguments)))))

;; The following equations characterize recursive term evaluation exactly.

(defun-sk q1149458-term-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (term bound-values index arity symbol arguments)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (q1149458-term-p language (len bound-values) term))
      (q1149458-carrier-p
       structure
       (q1149458-term-value
        language structure term bound-values)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp index)
       (< index (len bound-values)))
      (equal
       (q1149458-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1149458-bound index)
        bound-values)
       (nth index bound-values)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp arity)
       (q1149458-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
       (q1149458-term-list-p
        language (len bound-values) arity arguments))
      (equal
       (q1149458-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1149458-function arity symbol arguments)
        bound-values)
       (q1149458-function-value
        language
        structure
        arity
        symbol
        (q1149458-term-values
         language structure arguments bound-values)))))))

;; These are the exact Tarski clauses for the primitive formula constructors.

(defun-sk q1149458-falsum-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values)
    (implies
     (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
     (not
      (q1149458-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1149458-falsum)
       bound-values)))))

(defun-sk q1149458-equality-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1149458-term-p language (len bound-values) left)
      (q1149458-term-p language (len bound-values) right))
     (equal
      (q1149458-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1149458-equal left right)
       bound-values)
      (equal
       (q1149458-term-value
        language structure left bound-values)
       (q1149458-term-value
        language structure right bound-values))))))

(defun-sk q1149458-relation-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (natp arity)
      (q1149458-relation-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (q1149458-term-list-p
       language (len bound-values) arity arguments))
     (equal
      (q1149458-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1149458-relation arity symbol arguments)
       bound-values)
      (q1149458-truth
       (q1149458-relation-holds-p
        language
        structure
        arity
        symbol
        (q1149458-term-values
         language structure arguments bound-values)))))))

(defun-sk q1149458-implication-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1149458-formula-p
       language (len bound-values) left)
      (q1149458-formula-p
       language (len bound-values) right))
     (equal
      (q1149458-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1149458-implies left right)
       bound-values)
      (if
       (q1149458-holds-p
        language structure left bound-values)
       (q1149458-holds-p
        language structure right bound-values)
       t)))))

(defun-sk q1149458-universal-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values body)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1149458-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1149458-formula-p
       language (+ 1 (len bound-values)) body))
     (equal
      (q1149458-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1149458-forall body)
       bound-values)
      (q1149458-truth
       (q1149458-all-elements-satisfy-p
        language structure body bound-values))))))

(defun q1149458-formula-semantics-p (language structure)
  (and
   (q1149458-falsum-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1149458-equality-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1149458-relation-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1149458-implication-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1149458-universal-semantics-p language structure)))

(defun q1149458-structure-p (language structure)
  (and
   (q1149458-structure-nonempty-p structure)
   (q1149458-function-closure-p language structure)
   (q1149458-term-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1149458-formula-semantics-p language structure)))

;; The ACL2 type guard corresponding to Lean's L.Theory requires every member
;; of the arbitrary theory predicate to be a sentence of the given language.

(defun-sk q1149458-theory-p (language theory)
  (forall (sentence)
    (implies
     (q1149458-theory-member-p language theory sentence)
     (q1149458-sentence-p language sentence))))

(defun-sk q1149458-structure-models-theory-p
    (language structure theory)
  (forall (sentence)
    (implies
     (q1149458-theory-member-p language theory sentence)
     (q1149458-holds-p language structure sentence nil))))

(defun-sk q1149458-satisfiable-p (language theory)
  (exists (structure)
    (and
     (q1149458-structure-p language structure)
     (q1149458-structure-models-theory-p
      language structure theory))))

;; A true list denotes the finite set of its entries.  Quantifying over all
;; such lists is equivalent to quantifying over all finite subtheories:
;; repetitions do not affect whether a single structure models every entry.

(defun q1149458-sentence-list-p (language sentences)
  (if (consp sentences)
      (and
       (q1149458-sentence-p language (car sentences))
       (q1149458-sentence-list-p language (cdr sentences)))
    (equal sentences nil)))

(defun q1149458-list-subset-theory-p
    (language theory sentences)
  (if (consp sentences)
      (and
       (q1149458-theory-member-p
        language theory (car sentences))
       (q1149458-list-subset-theory-p
        language theory (cdr sentences)))
    (equal sentences nil)))

(defun q1149458-structure-models-list-p
    (language structure sentences)
  (if (consp sentences)
      (and
       (q1149458-holds-p
        language structure (car sentences) nil)
       (q1149458-structure-models-list-p
        language structure (cdr sentences)))
    (equal sentences nil)))

(defun-sk q1149458-finite-subtheory-satisfiable-p
    (language sentences)
  (exists (structure)
    (and
     (q1149458-sentence-list-p language sentences)
     (q1149458-structure-p language structure)
     (q1149458-structure-models-list-p
      language structure sentences))))

(defun-sk q1149458-finitely-satisfiable-p
    (language theory)
  (forall (sentences)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1149458-sentence-list-p language sentences)
      (q1149458-list-subset-theory-p
       language theory sentences))
     (q1149458-finite-subtheory-satisfiable-p
      language sentences))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1149458-compactness-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (language theory)
    (implies
     (q1149458-theory-p language theory)
     (iff
      (q1149458-satisfiable-p language theory)
      (q1149458-finitely-satisfiable-p
       language theory)))))

title: Q1149458_compactness_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1149458
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1149458), "Compactness theorem": an arbitrary
-- first-order theory has a nonempty model if and only if each of its finite
-- subtheories has a nonempty model. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1149458_compactness_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 5 _∷_
infix  4 _∈_
infix  2 _↔_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Nonempty
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  constructor inhabited
  field
    witness : A

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

data List
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  []  : List A
  _∷_ : A → List A → List A

data _∈_
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  here  : {xs : List A} → x ∈ (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : A} {xs : List A} → x ∈ xs → x ∈ (y ∷ xs)

record Language (u v : Level) : Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v)) where
  field
    FunctionSymbol : Nat → Set u
    RelationSymbol : Nat → Set v

open Language

record Structure
  {u v c : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (Carrier : Set c) :
  Set (u ⊔ v ⊔ lsuc c) where

  field
    functionMeaning :
      (arity : Nat) →
      FunctionSymbol language arity →
      (Fin arity → Carrier) →
      Carrier

    relationMeaning :
      (arity : Nat) →
      RelationSymbol language arity →
      (Fin arity → Carrier) →
      Set c

open Structure

data Term
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (freeVariables : Nat) :
  Set (u ⊔ v) where

  variableTerm :
    Fin freeVariables →
    Term language freeVariables

  applyFunction :
    (arity : Nat) →
    FunctionSymbol language arity →
    (Fin arity → Term language freeVariables) →
    Term language freeVariables

data Formula
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (freeVariables : Nat) :
  Set (u ⊔ v) where

  equal :
    Term language freeVariables →
    Term language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables

  relation :
    (arity : Nat) →
    RelationSymbol language arity →
    (Fin arity → Term language freeVariables) →
    Formula language freeVariables

  falsehood :
    Formula language freeVariables

  implies :
    Formula language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables

  all :
    Formula language (suc freeVariables) →
    Formula language freeVariables

Sentence :
  {u v : Level} →
  Language u v →
  Set (u ⊔ v)
Sentence language =
  Formula language zero

Theory :
  {u v : Level} →
  Language u v →
  Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v))
Theory {u} {v} language =
  Sentence language → Set (u ⊔ v)

interpretTerm :
  {u v c : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {Carrier : Set c} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Structure language Carrier →
  Term language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → Carrier) →
  Carrier
interpretTerm structure (variableTerm index) assignment =
  assignment index
interpretTerm structure (applyFunction arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  functionMeaning structure arity symbol
    (λ index → interpretTerm structure (arguments index) assignment)

extend :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → A) →
  A →
  Fin (suc n) →
  A
extend assignment value fzero =
  value
extend assignment value (fsuc index) =
  assignment index

Realize :
  {u v c : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {Carrier : Set c} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Structure language Carrier →
  Formula language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → Carrier) →
  Set c
Realize structure (equal leftTerm rightTerm) assignment =
  interpretTerm structure leftTerm assignment
  ≡ interpretTerm structure rightTerm assignment
Realize structure (relation arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  relationMeaning structure arity symbol
    (λ index → interpretTerm structure (arguments index) assignment)
Realize structure falsehood assignment =
  Bottom
Realize structure (implies premise conclusion) assignment =
  Realize structure premise assignment →
  Realize structure conclusion assignment
Realize {Carrier = Carrier} structure (all body) assignment =
  (value : Carrier) →
  Realize structure body (extend assignment value)

emptyAssignment :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Fin zero →
  A
emptyAssignment ()

record Model
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (theory : Theory language) :
  Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v)) where

  field
    Carrier  : Set (u ⊔ v)
    nonempty : Nonempty Carrier
    structure : Structure language Carrier
    satisfies :
      (sentence : Sentence language) →
      theory sentence →
      Realize structure sentence emptyAssignment

IsSatisfiable :
  {u v : Level} →
  (language : Language u v) →
  Theory language →
  Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v))
IsSatisfiable language theory =
  Model language theory

Subset :
  {a p q : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  (A → Set p) →
  (A → Set q) →
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ q)
Subset {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) → P x → Q x

ListTheory :
  {u v : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  List (Sentence language) →
  Theory language
ListTheory sentences sentence =
  sentence ∈ sentences

IsFinitelySatisfiable :
  {u v : Level} →
  (language : Language u v) →
  Theory language →
  Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v))
IsFinitelySatisfiable language theory =
  (sentences : List (Sentence language)) →
  Subset (ListTheory sentences) theory →
  IsSatisfiable language (ListTheory sentences)

compactness-theorem :
  {u v : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v))
compactness-theorem {u} {v} =
  (language : Language u v) →
  (theory : Theory language) →
  IsSatisfiable language theory
  ↔
  IsFinitelySatisfiable language theory

title: Q1149458_compactness_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1149458 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1149458), "Compactness theorem": an
  arbitrary first-order theory has a nonempty model if and only if each of its
  finite subtheories has a nonempty model. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open listTheory pred_setTheory;

Datatype:
  q1149458_term =
    Q1149458Var num
  | Q1149458Fun 'f (q1149458_term list)
End

Datatype:
  q1149458_formula =
    Q1149458False
  | Q1149458Equal ('f q1149458_term) ('f q1149458_term)
  | Q1149458Rel 'r (('f q1149458_term) list)
  | Q1149458Imp q1149458_formula q1149458_formula
  | Q1149458Forall q1149458_formula
End

val q1149458_term_wf_def = Define`
  (q1149458_term_wf FS f_arity (Q1149458Var n) <=> T) /\
  (q1149458_term_wf FS f_arity (Q1149458Fun f ts) <=>
     f IN FS /\
     LENGTH ts = f_arity f /\
     EVERY (q1149458_term_wf FS f_arity) ts)`;

val q1149458_formula_wf_def = Define`
  (q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity Q1149458False <=> T) /\
  (q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity (Q1149458Equal s t) <=>
     q1149458_term_wf FS f_arity s /\
     q1149458_term_wf FS f_arity t) /\
  (q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity (Q1149458Rel r ts) <=>
     r IN RS /\
     LENGTH ts = r_arity r /\
     EVERY (q1149458_term_wf FS f_arity) ts) /\
  (q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity (Q1149458Imp p q) <=>
     q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p /\
     q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity q) /\
  (q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity (Q1149458Forall p) <=>
     q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p)`;

val q1149458_term_closed_at_def = Define`
  (q1149458_term_closed_at k (Q1149458Var n) <=> n < k) /\
  (q1149458_term_closed_at k (Q1149458Fun f ts) <=>
     EVERY (q1149458_term_closed_at k) ts)`;

val q1149458_formula_closed_at_def = Define`
  (q1149458_formula_closed_at k Q1149458False <=> T) /\
  (q1149458_formula_closed_at k (Q1149458Equal s t) <=>
     q1149458_term_closed_at k s /\
     q1149458_term_closed_at k t) /\
  (q1149458_formula_closed_at k (Q1149458Rel r ts) <=>
     EVERY (q1149458_term_closed_at k) ts) /\
  (q1149458_formula_closed_at k (Q1149458Imp p q) <=>
     q1149458_formula_closed_at k p /\
     q1149458_formula_closed_at k q) /\
  (q1149458_formula_closed_at k (Q1149458Forall p) <=>
     q1149458_formula_closed_at (SUC k) p)`;

val q1149458_term_value_def = Define`
  (q1149458_term_value fnI v (Q1149458Var n) = v n) /\
  (q1149458_term_value fnI v (Q1149458Fun f ts) =
     fnI f (MAP (q1149458_term_value fnI v) ts))`;

val q1149458_satisfies_def = Define`
  (q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v Q1149458False <=> F) /\
  (q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1149458Equal s t) <=>
     q1149458_term_value fnI v s = q1149458_term_value fnI v t) /\
  (q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1149458Rel r ts) <=>
     relI r (MAP (q1149458_term_value fnI v) ts)) /\
  (q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1149458Imp p q) <=>
     (q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v p ==>
      q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v q)) /\
  (q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1149458Forall p) <=>
     !x.
       x IN carrier
       ==>
       q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI
         (\n. if n = 0 then x else v (PRE n)) p)`;

val q1149458_structure_def = new_definition (
  "q1149458_structure_def",
  ``q1149458_structure FS f_arity carrier fnI <=>
      !f xs.
        f IN FS /\
        LENGTH xs = f_arity f /\
        EVERY (\x. x IN carrier) xs
        ==>
        fnI f xs IN carrier``);

val q1149458_theory_def = new_definition (
  "q1149458_theory_def",
  ``q1149458_theory FS RS f_arity r_arity thy <=>
      !p.
        p IN thy
        ==>
        q1149458_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p /\
        q1149458_formula_closed_at 0 p``);

val q1149458_satisfiable_def = new_definition (
  "q1149458_satisfiable_def",
  ``q1149458_satisfiable
      (FS : 'f set) (RS : 'r set)
      (f_arity : 'f -> num) (r_arity : 'r -> num) thy <=>
      ?carrier : (('f + 'r) + num) set.
      ?fnI : 'f -> ((('f + 'r) + num) list) -> (('f + 'r) + num).
      ?relI : 'r -> ((('f + 'r) + num) list) -> bool.
        carrier <> {} /\
        q1149458_structure FS f_arity carrier fnI /\
        !p v.
          p IN thy /\
          (!n. v n IN carrier)
          ==>
          q1149458_satisfies carrier fnI relI v p``);

val q1149458_finitely_satisfiable_def = new_definition (
  "q1149458_finitely_satisfiable_def",
  ``q1149458_finitely_satisfiable FS RS f_arity r_arity thy <=>
      !thy0.
        FINITE thy0 /\
        thy0 SUBSET thy
        ==>
        q1149458_satisfiable FS RS f_arity r_arity thy0``);

val compactness_theorem =
  ``!(FS : 'f set) (RS : 'r set)
      (f_arity : 'f -> num) (r_arity : 'r -> num) thy.
      q1149458_theory FS RS f_arity r_arity thy
      ==>
      (q1149458_satisfiable FS RS f_arity r_arity thy <=>
       q1149458_finitely_satisfiable FS RS f_arity r_arity thy)``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1149458), "Compactness theorem": an arbitrary
  first-order theory has a nonempty model if and only if every finite
  subtheory has a nonempty model. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A language is a pair of arity-indexed families of function and relation
  symbols. Terms and formulas are standard finite tagged-tree codes.
  Q1149458TermsAt L n contains exactly the terms whose free de Bruijn
  variables are below n. Q1149458FormulaLevels L contains <. n , p >.
  exactly when p is a formula with n available free variables; universal
  quantification changes level n + 1 to level n. Thus Q1149458Sentences L,
  the level-zero formulas, is precisely the set of closed sentences.

  A structure has a nonempty carrier and total interpretations of every
  symbol. Q1149458Eval and Q1149458Sat give compositional Tarski semantics.
  A theory is an arbitrary set of sentences. It is satisfiable when some
  nonempty structure models every sentence, and finitely satisfiable when
  each finite subset is satisfiable.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition required for this encoding. The final $a declaration is the
  single unproved corpus statement, and this database has no $p statement.
$)

$c Q1149458Language Q1149458FunKeys Q1149458RelKeys $.
$c Q1149458TermsAt Q1149458Terms Q1149458FormulaLevels $.
$c Q1149458Formulas Q1149458Sentences Q1149458Structure $.

${

  q1149458-language-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149458Language L )

${

  q1149458-terms-at-definition $a |- (
    Q1149458TermsAt L n
    =
    |^| { C |

        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n )

        /\
        A. k e. NN0

    Q1149458Terms L

  ) $.

${
  $d A C L k n p q r s t $.

  q1149458-formula-levels-definition $a |- (
    Q1149458FormulaLevels L
    =
    |^| { C |
      A. n e. NN0
        (
          A. k e. NN0
            A. r e. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` k )
              A. A e. ( ( Q1149458TermsAt L n ) ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
                <.
                  n ,

                >. e. C

            A. s e. ( Q1149458TermsAt L n )
              A. t e. ( Q1149458TermsAt L n )
                <. n , <. 1 , <. s , t >. >. >. e. C

  Q1149458Formulas L

                    A. r e. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` k )
                      ( R ` <. k , r >. )
                        C_ ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
                )

            )

${
  $d A E L M V f i j k $.

  q1149458-eval-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1149458Eval L M E )
    <->
    (
      E :
        (
          ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          X.
          ( Q1149458Terms L )
        )
        --> ( 1st ` M )
      /\
      (
