title: Q1149458_compactness_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1149458,
% "Compactness theorem": a first-order theory has a nonempty model if and only
% if each of its finite subtheories has a nonempty model. This file contains no proof.

first_order_syntax_Q1149458[Symbol: TYPE]: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  variable_node(variable_index: nat): variable_node?
  application_node(
      application_symbol: Symbol,
      application_arguments: first_order_syntax_Q1149458): application_node?
  argument_nil: argument_nil?
  argument_cons(
      argument_head: first_order_syntax_Q1149458,
      argument_tail: first_order_syntax_Q1149458): argument_cons?
  equality_node(
      equality_left: first_order_syntax_Q1149458,
      equality_right: first_order_syntax_Q1149458): equality_node?
  relation_node(
      relation_symbol: Symbol,
      relation_arguments: first_order_syntax_Q1149458): relation_node?
  false_node: false_node?
  implication_node(
      implication_left: first_order_syntax_Q1149458,
      implication_right: first_order_syntax_Q1149458): implication_node?
  universal_node(
      universal_body: first_order_syntax_Q1149458): universal_node?
END first_order_syntax_Q1149458

model_universe_Q1149458[Symbol: TYPE]: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  natural_element(natural_index: nat): natural_element?
  symbol_element(symbol_index: Symbol): symbol_element?
END model_universe_Q1149458

compactness_theorem_Q1149458[
  Symbol: TYPE,
  symbol_is_function: [Symbol -> bool],
  symbol_arity: [Symbol -> nat]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING first_order_syntax_Q1149458[Symbol],
    model_universe_Q1149458[Symbol]

  syntax: TYPE = first_order_syntax_Q1149458[Symbol]
  universe: TYPE = model_universe_Q1149458[Symbol]

  argument_length(node: syntax): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index): 0,
      application_node(symbol, arguments): 0,
      argument_nil: 0,
      argument_cons(head, tail): 1 + argument_length(tail),
      equality_node(left, right): 0,
      relation_node(symbol, arguments): 0,
      false_node: 0,
      implication_node(left, right): 0,
      universal_node(body): 0
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  % Kinds 0, 1, and 2 respectively denote terms, argument lists, and formulas.
  % The depth parameter gives the number of enclosing de Bruijn binders.
  well_formed(node: syntax, kind: nat, depth: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index):
        kind = 0 AND index < depth,
      application_node(symbol, arguments):
        kind = 0
          AND symbol_is_function(symbol)
          AND argument_length(arguments) = symbol_arity(symbol)
          AND well_formed(arguments, 1, depth),
      argument_nil:
        kind = 1,
      argument_cons(head, tail):
        kind = 1
          AND well_formed(head, 0, depth)
          AND well_formed(tail, 1, depth),
      equality_node(left, right):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(left, 0, depth)
          AND well_formed(right, 0, depth),
      relation_node(symbol, arguments):
        kind = 2
          AND NOT symbol_is_function(symbol)
          AND argument_length(arguments) = symbol_arity(symbol)
          AND well_formed(arguments, 1, depth),
      false_node:
        kind = 2,
      implication_node(left, right):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(left, 2, depth)
          AND well_formed(right, 2, depth),
      universal_node(body):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(body, 2, depth + 1)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  sentence: TYPE = {phi: syntax | well_formed(phi, 2, 0)}
  theory_set: TYPE = [sentence -> bool]
  carrier_predicate: TYPE = [universe -> bool]
  function_interpretation: TYPE =
    [Symbol, [nat -> universe] -> universe]
  relation_interpretation: TYPE =
    [Symbol, [nat -> universe] -> bool]

  syntax_size(node: syntax): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index): 1,
      application_node(symbol, arguments):
        1 + syntax_size(arguments),
      argument_nil: 1,
      argument_cons(head, tail):
        1 + syntax_size(head) + syntax_size(tail),
      equality_node(left, right):
        1 + syntax_size(left) + syntax_size(right),
      relation_node(symbol, arguments):
        1 + syntax_size(arguments),
      false_node: 1,
      implication_node(left, right):
        1 + syntax_size(left) + syntax_size(right),
      universal_node(body):
        1 + syntax_size(body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  default_element: universe = natural_element(0)

  canonical_tuple(
      values: [nat -> universe],
      arity: nat): [nat -> universe] =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      IF index < arity THEN values(index) ELSE default_element ENDIF

  evaluate_fuel(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> universe],
      functions: function_interpretation,
      fuel: nat,
      position: nat): RECURSIVE universe =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      default_element
    ELSE
      CASES node OF
        variable_node(index):
          assignment(index),
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          functions(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_fuel(
                  arguments,
                  assignment,
                  functions,
                  fuel - 1,
                  index),
              symbol_arity(symbol))),
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          IF position = 0 THEN
            evaluate_fuel(head, assignment, functions, fuel - 1, 0)
          ELSE
            evaluate_fuel(
              tail, assignment, functions, fuel - 1, position - 1)
          ENDIF,
        argument_nil:
          default_element,
        equality_node(left, right):
          default_element,
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          default_element,
        false_node:
          default_element,
        implication_node(left, right):
          default_element,
        universal_node(body):
          default_element
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  evaluate(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> universe],
      functions: function_interpretation): universe =
    evaluate_fuel(
      node, assignment, functions, syntax_size(node) + 1, 0)

  holds_fuel(
      phi: syntax,
      assignment: [nat -> universe],
      carrier: carrier_predicate,
      functions: function_interpretation,
      relations: relation_interpretation,
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      CASES phi OF
        equality_node(left, right):
          evaluate(left, assignment, functions)
            = evaluate(right, assignment, functions),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          relations(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_fuel(
                  arguments,
                  assignment,
                  functions,
                  syntax_size(arguments) + 1,
                  index),
              symbol_arity(symbol))),
        false_node:
          FALSE,
        implication_node(left, right):
          holds_fuel(
            left, assignment, carrier, functions, relations, fuel - 1)
            IMPLIES
          holds_fuel(
            right, assignment, carrier, functions, relations, fuel - 1),
        universal_node(body):
          FORALL (value: universe):
            carrier(value)
              IMPLIES
                holds_fuel(
                  body,
                  LAMBDA (index: nat):
                    IF index = 0 THEN
                      value
                    ELSE
                      assignment(index - 1)
                    ENDIF,
                  carrier,
                  functions,
                  relations,
                  fuel - 1),
        variable_node(index):
          FALSE,
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          FALSE,
        argument_nil:
          FALSE,
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          FALSE
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  holds(
      phi: syntax,
      carrier: carrier_predicate,
      functions: function_interpretation,
      relations: relation_interpretation): bool =
    holds_fuel(
      phi,
      LAMBDA (index: nat): default_element,
      carrier,
      functions,
      relations,
      syntax_size(phi) + 1)

  tuple_in_carrier(
      carrier: carrier_predicate,
      values: [nat -> universe],
      arity: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < arity IMPLIES carrier(values(index))

  is_structure(
      carrier: carrier_predicate,
      functions: function_interpretation): bool =
    (EXISTS (value: universe): carrier(value))
      AND
    (FORALL (symbol: Symbol), (values: [nat -> universe]):
      (symbol_is_function(symbol)
        AND tuple_in_carrier(carrier, values, symbol_arity(symbol)))
      IMPLIES
        carrier(
          functions(
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple(values, symbol_arity(symbol)))))

  models(
      carrier: carrier_predicate,
      functions: function_interpretation,
      relations: relation_interpretation,
      T: theory_set): bool =
    is_structure(carrier, functions)
      AND
    (FORALL (phi: sentence):
      T(phi)
        IMPLIES holds(phi, carrier, functions, relations))

  satisfiable(T: theory_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (carrier: carrier_predicate),
        (functions: function_interpretation),
        (relations: relation_interpretation):
      models(carrier, functions, relations, T)

  subset(T0, T: theory_set): bool =
    FORALL (phi: sentence):
      T0(phi) IMPLIES T(phi)

  finite_theory(T0: theory_set): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat), (enumeration: [nat -> sentence]):
      FORALL (phi: sentence):
        T0(phi)
          IFF
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < bound AND enumeration(index) = phi

  finitely_satisfiable(T: theory_set): bool =
    FORALL (T0: theory_set):
      (finite_theory(T0) AND subset(T0, T))
        IMPLIES satisfiable(T0)

  compactness_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (T: theory_set):
      satisfiable(T) IFF finitely_satisfiable(T)
END compactness_theorem_Q1149458

title: Q11518_pythagorean_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q11518
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q11518), "Pythagorean theorem": for three points in a
-- real Euclidean affine space, the squared-distance identity holds exactly when
-- the displacement vectors from the second point are orthogonal, equivalently when
-- the angle there is π / 2. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.AddTorsor
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Defs

@[expose] public section

namespace Q11518

variable {V : Type*} {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
  [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P]

/-- The Pythagorean theorem, with the right-angle condition encoded by orthogonality. -/
theorem dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) :
    dist p₁ p₃ * dist p₁ p₃ = dist p₁ p₂ * dist p₁ p₂ + dist p₃ p₂ * dist p₃ p₂ ↔
      inner ℝ (p₁ -ᵥ p₂ : V) (p₃ -ᵥ p₂ : V) = 0 := sorry

end Q11518

title: Q11518_pythagorean_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q11518
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q11518), "Pythagorean theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, the squared-distance identity holds exactly
  when the angle at the middle point is pi/2. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q11518_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q11518_zero : V;
  q11518_add : V -> V -> V;
  q11518_neg : V -> V;
  q11518_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q11518_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q11518_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q11518_add x (q11518_add y z) =
      q11518_add (q11518_add x y) z;
  q11518_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q11518_add x y = q11518_add y x;
  q11518_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q11518_add x q11518_zero = x;
  q11518_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q11518_add x (q11518_neg x) = q11518_zero;

  q11518_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q11518_smul 1 x = x;
  q11518_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q11518_smul (a * b) x = q11518_smul a (q11518_smul b x);
  q11518_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q11518_smul a (q11518_add x y) =
      q11518_add (q11518_smul a x) (q11518_smul a y);
  q11518_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q11518_smul (a + b) x =
      q11518_add (q11518_smul a x) (q11518_smul b x);

  q11518_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q11518_inner (q11518_add x y) z =
      q11518_inner x z + q11518_inner y z;
  q11518_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q11518_inner (q11518_smul a x) y =
      a * q11518_inner x y;
  q11518_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q11518_inner x y = q11518_inner y x;
  q11518_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q11518_inner x x;
  q11518_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V, q11518_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q11518_zero
}.

Arguments q11518_zero {V} _.
Arguments q11518_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q11518_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q11518_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q11518_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q11518_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q11518_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q11518_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q11518_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q11518_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q11518_vadd (q11518_zero E) p = p;
  q11518_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q11518_vadd (q11518_add E x y) p =
      q11518_vadd x (q11518_vadd y p);
  q11518_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q11518_vsub (q11518_vadd x p) p = x;
  q11518_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q11518_vadd (q11518_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q11518_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q11518_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q11518_norm
    {V : Type} (E : q11518_real_inner_product_space V) (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q11518_inner E x x).

Definition q11518_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q11518_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q11518_affine_torsor V P E)

    {V P : Type}
    {E : q11518_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q11518_affine_torsor V P E)

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two :
  forall (V P : Type)

    q11518_dist A p1 p3 * q11518_dist A p1 p3 =

      q11518_dist A p3 p2 * q11518_dist A p3 p2 <->
    q11518_angle A p1 p2 p3 = PI / 2.

title: Q11518_pythagorean_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q11518,
  "Pythagorean theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the
  squared-distance identity holds exactly when the angle at the middle point
  is a right angle. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q11518_PYTHAGOREAN_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!p:P. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:V. !p:P.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!v:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (p:P) (q:P).
       norm inner (vsub p q) in
  let vector_angle =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V) (y:V).
       acs (inner x y / (norm inner x * norm inner y)) in
  let point_angle =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (p1:P) (p2:P) (p3:P).
       vector_angle inner (vsub p1 p2) (vsub p3 p2) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !p1 p2 p3:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub
    ==>
    (distance inner vsub p1 p3 * distance inner vsub p1 p3 =
       distance inner vsub p1 p2 * distance inner vsub p1 p2 +
       distance inner vsub p3 p2 * distance inner vsub p3 p2 <=>
     point_angle inner vsub p1 p2 p3 = pi / &2)`;;

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q11518
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q11518), "Pythagorean theorem": in a real
-- Euclidean affine space, the squared-distance identity holds exactly when
-- the angle at the middle point is pi divided by two. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q11518_pythagorean_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and oneR != zeroR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

divide :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divide reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

ValidCosineInput :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
ValidCosineInput reals x =
  lessOrEqualR reals (negateR reals (oneR reals)) x
  and
  lessOrEqualR reals x (oneR reals)

record StandardRealTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine arccosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-zero :
      sine (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals
    cosine-zero :
      cosine (zeroR reals) == oneR reals
    sine-addition :
      (x y : R) ->
      sine (addR reals x y) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (sine x) (cosine y))
        (multiplyR reals (cosine x) (sine y))
    cosine-addition :
      (x y : R) ->
      cosine (addR reals x y) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (cosine x) (cosine y))
        (negateR reals
          (multiplyR reals (sine x) (sine y)))
    sine-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      sine (negateR reals x) == negateR reals (sine x)
    cosine-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      cosine (negateR reals x) == cosine x
    sine-square-add-cosine-square :
      (x : R) ->
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (sine x) (sine x))
        (multiplyR reals (cosine x) (cosine x))
      ==
      oneR reals

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    cosine-pi :
      cosine pi == negateR reals (oneR reals)
    sine-positive-before-pi :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      StrictLess reals x pi ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) (sine x)

    arccosine-range :
      (x : R) ->
      ValidCosineInput reals x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (arccosine x)
      and
      lessOrEqualR reals (arccosine x) pi
    cosine-arccosine :
      (x : R) ->
      ValidCosineInput reals x ->
      cosine (arccosine x) == x
    arccosine-cosine :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals x pi ->
      arccosine (cosine x) == x

open StandardRealTrigonometry

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm v)
    norm-square :
      (v : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm v) (norm v) == inner v v
    norm-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      norm v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV
    norm-negate :
      (v : V) ->
      norm (negateV v) == norm v

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

vectorAngle :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealTrigonometry reals ->
  RealInnerProductSpace reals V ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R
vectorAngle {reals = reals} trigonometry space u v =
  arccosine trigonometry
    (divide reals
      (inner space u v)
      (multiplyR reals (norm space u) (norm space v)))

halfPi :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealTrigonometry reals ->
  R
halfPi {reals = reals} trigonometry =
  divide reals
    (pi trigonometry)
    (fromNatR reals twoN)

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine p q =
  norm space (vsub affine p q)

angleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardRealTrigonometry reals ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
angleAt trigonometry {space = space} affine p q r =
  vectorAngle trigonometry space
    (vsub affine p q)
    (vsub affine r q)

module PythagoreanTheoremStatement
  {R V P : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (trigonometry : StandardRealTrigonometry reals)
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) where

  squaredDistanceIdentity :
    P ->
    P ->
    P ->
    Set
  squaredDistanceIdentity p1 p2 p3 =
    multiplyR reals
      (distance affine p1 p3)
      (distance affine p1 p3)
    ==
    addR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (distance affine p1 p2)
        (distance affine p1 p2))
      (multiplyR reals
        (distance affine p3 p2)
        (distance affine p3 p2))

  rightAngleAtMiddle :
    P ->
    P ->
    P ->
    Set
  rightAngleAtMiddle p1 p2 p3 =
    angleAt trigonometry affine p1 p2 p3 ==
    halfPi trigonometry

  proposition : Set
  proposition =
    (p1 p2 p3 : P) ->
    Iff
      (squaredDistanceIdentity p1 p2 p3)
      (rightAngleAtMiddle p1 p2 p3)

pythagorean-theorem : Set1
pythagorean-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardRealTrigonometry reals) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  PythagoreanTheoremStatement.proposition
    reals
    trigonometry
    space
    affine

title: Q11518_pythagorean_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q11518, "Pythagorean theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine
  space, the squared-distance identity for three points holds if and only if
  their angle at the middle point is pi / 2. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q11518_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q11518_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q11518_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q11518_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q11518_norm_def",
  ``q11518_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q11518_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q11518_dist_def",
  ``q11518_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p : 'p)
      (q : 'p) =
      q11518_norm inner (vsub p q)``);

val q11518_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q11518_angle_def",
  ``q11518_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p : 'p)
      (q : 'p)
      (r : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub p q) (vsub r q) /
          (q11518_norm inner (vsub p q) *
           q11518_norm inner (vsub r q)))``);

val dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_iff_angle_eq_pi_div_two =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p1 p2 p3 : 'p).
      q11518_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub
      ==>
      (q11518_dist inner vsub p1 p3 *
         q11518_dist inner vsub p1 p3 =
       q11518_dist inner vsub p1 p2 *
         q11518_dist inner vsub p1 p2 +
       q11518_dist inner vsub p3 p2 *
         q11518_dist inner vsub p3 p2
       <=>
       q11518_angle inner vsub p1 p2 p3 = pi / 2)``;

title: Q11518_pythagorean_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q11518
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q11518), "Pythagorean theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the squared-distance identity
  for three points holds if and only if the angle at the second point is a
  right angle. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces represented by SetMM
  CPreHil structures whose scalar field is RRfld. Choosing any point as an
  affine origin identifies the source's normed affine torsor with this vector
  presentation while preserving all distances and angles.

  W Q11518Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q11518Dist A B is its norm,
  and W Q11518Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When either ray
  is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention; otherwise it is
  the arccosine of the normalized inner product.

  Squaring with ^ 2 is equivalent over the reals to the source's explicit
  self-products. Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an
  explicit definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and the database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q11518Ray Q11518Dist Q11518Angle $.

q11518-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q11518Ray A B ) $.
q11518-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q11518Dist A B ) $.
q11518-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q11518Angle A B C ) $.

q11518-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q11518Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q11518-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q11518Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q11518Ray A B )
) $.

q11518-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q11518Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q11518Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q11518Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q11518Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q11518Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q11518Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q11518Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C W $.

  thousand-theorems-q11518-pythagorean-theorem $a |- A. W
    (
      (
        W e. CPreHil
        /\
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
      )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            (
              (
                ( ( W Q11518Dist A C ) ^ 2 )
                =
                (
                  ( ( W Q11518Dist A B ) ^ 2 )
                  +
                  ( ( W Q11518Dist C B ) ^ 2 )
                )
              )
              <->
              (
                ( W Q11518Angle A B C )
                =
                ( _pi / 2 )
              )
            )
    )
  $.
$}

title: Q11518_pythagorean_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q11518,
% "Pythagorean theorem": in a real Euclidean affine space, the squared-distance
% identity is equivalent to the angle at the middle point being pi/2.
% This file contains no proof.

Q11518_pythagorean_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  squared_distance(p, q: P): real =
    inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  angle_at_is_pi_over_two(p1, p2, p3: P): bool =
    inner(vsub(p1, p2), vsub(p3, p2)) = 0

  pythagorean_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p1, p2, p3: P):
        squared_distance(p1, p3) =
            squared_distance(p1, p2) + squared_distance(p3, p2)
          IFF angle_at_is_pi_over_two(p1, p2, p3))
END Q11518_pythagorean_theorem

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1153584
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1153584), "Monotone convergence theorem":
-- almost-everywhere monotone convergence for extended-nonnegative Lebesgue integrals
-- and antitone convergence for integrable real-valued Bochner integrals.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic

@[expose] public section

open Filter Topology
open scoped ENNReal MeasureTheory
open MeasureTheory

namespace Q1153584

variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}

/-- Monotone convergence for extended-nonnegative Lebesgue integrals. -/
theorem lintegral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone
    {f : ℕ → α → ℝ≥0∞} {F : α → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (f n) μ)
    (h_mono : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Monotone fun n ↦ f n x)
    (h_tendsto : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n ↦ f n x) atTop (𝓝 (F x))) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫⁻ x, f n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ x, F x ∂μ)) := sorry

/-- Monotone convergence in antitone form for real-valued Bochner integrals. -/
theorem integral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_antitone
    {f : ℕ → α → ℝ} {F : α → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ n, Integrable (f n) μ)
    (hF : Integrable F μ)
    (h_mono : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Antitone fun n ↦ f n x)
    (h_tendsto : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n ↦ f n x) atTop (𝓝 (F x))) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ x, f n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, F x ∂μ)) := sorry

end Q1153584

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1153584
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1153584), "Monotone convergence theorem":
  almost-everywhere monotone convergence for extended-nonnegative Lebesgue
  integrals and antitone convergence for integrable real-valued Bochner
  integrals. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1153584_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1153584_empty {A : Type} : q1153584_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1153584_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1153584_set A) : q1153584_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1153584_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1153584_set A) : q1153584_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1153584_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1153584_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1153584_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1153584_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1153584_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1153584_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1153584_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q1153584_ennreal : Type :=
| q1153584_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q1153584_ennreal
| q1153584_ennreal_infinity : q1153584_ennreal.

Arguments q1153584_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_zero : q1153584_ennreal :=
  q1153584_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q1153584_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1153584_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity,
    q1153584_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1153584_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q1153584_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity,
    q1153584_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity,
    q1153584_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1153584_ennreal) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1153584_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1153584_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q1153584_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q1153584_ennreal) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1153584_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1153584_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite a _, q1153584_ennreal_infinity
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity, q1153584_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q1153584_ennreal_zero
      else q1153584_ennreal_infinity
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity, q1153584_ennreal_infinity =>
      q1153584_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q1153584_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1153584_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1153584_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1153584_ennreal_add
        (q1153584_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q1153584_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q1153584_ennreal,
      values value -> q1153584_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q1153584_ennreal,
      (forall value : q1153584_ennreal,
        values value -> q1153584_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q1153584_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q1153584_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1153584_ennreal)
    (sum : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1153584_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q1153584_ennreal_eq value
          (q1153584_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_represents
    (x : q1153584_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q1153584_ennreal_eq x
      (q1153584_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q1153584_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q1153584_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q1153584_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1153584_measurable : q1153584_set A -> Prop;
  q1153584_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q1153584_set A,
      q1153584_same_set E F ->
      (q1153584_measurable E <-> q1153584_measurable F);
  q1153584_measurable_empty :
    q1153584_measurable q1153584_empty;
  q1153584_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q1153584_set A,
      q1153584_measurable E ->
      q1153584_measurable (q1153584_complement E);
  q1153584_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q1153584_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1153584_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1153584_measurable (q1153584_countable_union E);
  q1153584_measure : q1153584_set A -> q1153584_ennreal;
  q1153584_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1153584_set A,
      q1153584_same_set E F ->
      q1153584_ennreal_eq
        (q1153584_measure E) (q1153584_measure F);
  q1153584_measure_empty :
    q1153584_ennreal_eq
      (q1153584_measure q1153584_empty)
      q1153584_ennreal_zero;
  q1153584_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1153584_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1153584_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1153584_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1153584_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1153584_measure (E n))
        (q1153584_measure (q1153584_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q1153584_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q1153584_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q1153584_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q1153584_set A,
    q1153584_measurable mu null_set /\
    q1153584_ennreal_eq
      (q1153584_measure mu null_set)
      q1153584_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_below_real
    (x : q1153584_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q1153584_measurable_ennreal_function {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall bound : R,
    q1153584_measurable mu
      (fun x => q1153584_ennreal_below_real (f x) bound).

Definition q1153584_ae_measurable_ennreal_function {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists g : A -> q1153584_ennreal,
    q1153584_measurable_ennreal_function mu g /\
    q1153584_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x => q1153584_ennreal_eq (f x) (g x)).

Definition q1153584_ennreal_above_real
    (x : q1153584_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite value _ => bound < value
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> q1153584_ennreal)
    (limit : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match limit with
  | q1153584_ennreal_finite value _ =>
      forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists N : nat,
          forall n : nat,
            (N <= n)%nat ->
            match u n with
            | q1153584_ennreal_finite term _ =>
                Rabs (term - value) < epsilon
            | q1153584_ennreal_infinity => False
            end
  | q1153584_ennreal_infinity =>
      forall bound : R,
        exists N : nat,
          forall n : nat,
            (N <= n)%nat ->
            q1153584_ennreal_above_real (u n) bound
  end.

Definition q1153584_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1153584_monotone_ennreal
    (u : nat -> q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall n m : nat,
    (n <= m)%nat ->
    q1153584_ennreal_le (u n) (u m).

Definition q1153584_antitone_real
    (u : nat -> R) : Prop :=
  forall n m : nat,
    (n <= m)%nat ->
    u m <= u n.

Definition q1153584_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q1153584_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q1153584_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q1153584_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q1153584_measurable_simple_real {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> R)
         (cells : nat -> q1153584_set A),
    q1153584_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q1153584_ae_strongly_measurable_real {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1153584_measurable_simple_real mu (approximants n)) /\
    q1153584_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q1153584_real_sequence_converges
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q1153584_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q1153584_nnreal_value : R;
  q1153584_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q1153584_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q1153584_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q1153584_nonnegative_real) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  q1153584_ennreal_finite
    (q1153584_nnreal_value x)
    (q1153584_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q1153584_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1153584_ennreal)
    (value : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q1153584_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q1153584_set A),
    q1153584_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q1153584_ennreal_le
        (q1153584_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q1153584_ennreal_eq value
      (q1153584_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q1153584_ennreal_mul
            (q1153584_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q1153584_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q1153584_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q1153584_ennreal)
    (value : q1153584_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1153584_ennreal_supremum
    (q1153584_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q1153584_absolute_ennreal
    (x : R) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  q1153584_ennreal_finite (Rabs x) (Rabs_pos x).

Definition q1153584_positive_ennreal
    (x : R) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  q1153584_ennreal_finite (Rmax x 0) (Rmax_r x 0).

Definition q1153584_negative_ennreal
    (x : R) : q1153584_ennreal :=
  q1153584_ennreal_finite (Rmax (- x) 0) (Rmax_r (- x) 0).

Definition q1153584_integrable_real {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  q1153584_ae_strongly_measurable_real mu f /\
  exists value : q1153584_ennreal,
    q1153584_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q1153584_absolute_ennreal (f x)) value /\
    q1153584_ennreal_finite_value value.

Definition q1153584_bochner_integral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q1153584_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists (positive_integral negative_integral : q1153584_ennreal)
         (positive_value negative_value : R),
    q1153584_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q1153584_positive_ennreal (f x))
      positive_integral /\
    q1153584_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q1153584_negative_ennreal (f x))
      negative_integral /\
    q1153584_ennreal_represents
      positive_integral positive_value /\
    q1153584_ennreal_represents
      negative_integral negative_value /\
    value = positive_value - negative_value.

Theorem lintegral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (mu : q1153584_measure_space Alpha)
         (f : nat -> Alpha -> q1153584_ennreal)
         (F : Alpha -> q1153584_ennreal),
    (forall n : nat,
      q1153584_ae_measurable_ennreal_function mu (f n)) ->
    q1153584_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x => q1153584_monotone_ennreal (fun n => f n x)) ->
    q1153584_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q1153584_ennreal_sequence_converges
          (fun n => f n x) (F x)) ->
    exists (integrals : nat -> q1153584_ennreal)
           (limit_integral : q1153584_ennreal),
      (forall n : nat,
        q1153584_lintegral_has_value
          mu (f n) (integrals n)) /\
      q1153584_lintegral_has_value mu F limit_integral /\
      q1153584_ennreal_sequence_converges
        integrals limit_integral.
Admitted.

Theorem integral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_antitone :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (mu : q1153584_measure_space Alpha)
         (f : nat -> Alpha -> R)
         (F : Alpha -> R),
    (forall n : nat, q1153584_integrable_real mu (f n)) ->
    q1153584_integrable_real mu F ->
    q1153584_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x => q1153584_antitone_real (fun n => f n x)) ->
    q1153584_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q1153584_real_sequence_converges
          (fun n => f n x) (F x)) ->
    exists (integrals : nat -> R) (limit_integral : R),
      (forall n : nat,
        q1153584_bochner_integral_has_value
          mu (f n) (integrals n)) /\
      q1153584_bochner_integral_has_value
        mu F limit_integral /\
      q1153584_real_sequence_converges
        integrals limit_integral.
Admitted.

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1153584,
  "Monotone convergence theorem": almost-everywhere monotone convergence for
  extended-nonnegative Lebesgue integrals, together with the antitone
  real-valued Bochner-integral formulation. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complete_Measure"
begin

theorem monotone_convergence_theorem_antitone_real:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and F :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes f_integrable:
      "\<And>n. integrable (completion M) (f n)"
    and F_integrable:
      "integrable (completion M) F"
    and f_antitone:
      "AE x in M. antimono (\<lambda>n. f n x)"
    and f_tendsto:
      "AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. f n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> F x"
  shows
      "(\<lambda>n. integral\<^sup>L (completion M) (f n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> integral\<^sup>L (completion M) F"
  sorry

theorem monotone_convergence_theorem_nn:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
    and F :: "'a \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  assumes f_ae_measurable:
      "\<And>n. f n \<in> borel_measurable (completion M)"
    and f_monotone:
      "AE x in M. mono (\<lambda>n. f n x)"
    and f_tendsto:
      "AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. f n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> F x"
  shows
      "(\<lambda>n. nn_integral M (f n)) \<longlonglongrightarrow> nn_integral M F"
  sorry

end

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1153584,
  "Monotone convergence theorem": convergence of real integrals for an
  almost-everywhere antitone integrable sequence, and convergence of lower
  Lebesgue integrals for an almost-everywhere monotone sequence of
  extended-nonnegative functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1153584_MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then (F,&0)
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let eembed =
      \(z:bool#real).
        if FST z then &1 else SND z / (&1 + SND z) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s:A->bool. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           s IN events ==> (carrier DIFF s) IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:A | x IN carrier /\ ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) in
   let measure_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s:A->bool. mu s = mu (s INTER carrier)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:A | x IN carrier /\ ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:A->bool).
        ?N:A->bool.
          N IN events /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:A | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let sequence_etends =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n)) /\
        (!e. &0 < e
             ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                          ==> abs(eembed (u n) - eembed l) < e) in
   let simple_ennreal =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->bool#real).
        (!x. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:bool#real.
           {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c} IN events) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real)
       (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x. x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n enum partial.
          (!x. x IN items <=> ?i. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool#real)
       (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s carrier)
          (\c. emul c (mu {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v. p v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!v. p v ==> ele v w)
             ==> ele z w) in
   let lintegral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v. ?s:A->bool#real.
                   simple_ennreal carrier events s /\
                   (!x. x IN carrier ==> ele (s x) (f x)) /\
                   simple_lintegral carrier mu s v)
            z in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real.
           {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c} IN events) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (h:A->real).
        ?s:num->A->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x. x IN carrier
               ==> scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->real).
        ?g:A->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let strongly_measurable_ennreal =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (h:A->bool#real).
        (!x. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?s:num->A->bool#real.
          (!n. simple_ennreal carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x. x IN carrier
               ==> sequence_etends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_measurable_ennreal =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->bool#real).
        (!x. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?g:A->bool#real.
          strongly_measurable_ennreal carrier events g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let scalar_integrable =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->real).
        ae_strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events mu h /\
        ~(FST
            (lintegral carrier events mu
              (\x:A. (F,abs(h x))))) in
   let real_integral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->real).
        SND
          (lintegral carrier events mu
            (\x:A. (F,max (h x) (&0)))) -
        SND
          (lintegral carrier events mu
            (\x:A. (F,max (--(h x)) (&0)))) in
   let real_antitone_form =
      !carrier:A->bool
       events:(A->bool)->bool
       mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
       seq:num->A->real
       limit:A->real.
        measure_space carrier events mu /\
        (!n. scalar_integrable carrier events mu (seq n)) /\
        scalar_integrable carrier events mu limit /\
        almost_everywhere carrier events mu
          (\x:A. !m n. m <= n ==> seq n x <= seq m x) /\
        almost_everywhere carrier events mu
          (\x:A. scalar_tends (\n. seq n x) (limit x))
        ==> scalar_tends
              (\n. real_integral carrier events mu (seq n))
              (real_integral carrier events mu limit) in
   let ennreal_monotone_form =
      !carrier:A->bool
       events:(A->bool)->bool
       mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
       seq:num->A->bool#real
       limit:A->bool#real.
        measure_space carrier events mu /\
        (!n x. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (seq n x)) /\
        (!x. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (limit x)) /\
        (!n. ae_measurable_ennreal
               carrier events mu (seq n)) /\
        almost_everywhere carrier events mu
          (\x:A. !m n. m <= n ==> ele (seq m x) (seq n x)) /\
        almost_everywhere carrier events mu
          (\x:A. sequence_etends (\n. seq n x) (limit x))
        ==> sequence_etends
              (\n. lintegral carrier events mu (seq n))
              (lintegral carrier events mu limit) in
   real_antitone_form /\ ennreal_monotone_form`;;

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1153584,
;; "Monotone convergence theorem": lower integrals preserve almost-everywhere
;; monotone limits of extended-nonnegative-real functions, and Bochner
;; integrals preserve almost-everywhere antitone limits of integrable
;; real-valued functions. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces give identifiers to arbitrary carriers, subsets,
;; functions, and sequences.  No carrier or function is replaced by a finite
;; table or restricted to an APPLY$ class.  The hypotheses below characterize
;; the real field, sigma algebra, measure, lower integral, real integral,
;; almost-everywhere predicates, and order-topological convergence exactly.

;; Real numbers and arbitrary mathematical objects.

(defstub q1153584-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q1153584-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q1153584-domain-member-p (domain value) t)
(defstub q1153584-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q1153584-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q1153584-function-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q1153584-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q1153584-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q1153584-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q1153584-lintegral-value
  (lintegral domain measurable measure function) t)
(defstub q1153584-integral-value
  (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function) t)

(defun q1153584-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q1153584-r-less real right left)))

(defun q1153584-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q1153584-r-less real value (q1153584-r-zero real))
      (q1153584-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-r-member-p real x)
      (q1153584-r-member-p real y)
      (q1153584-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q1153584-r-zero real))
            (one (q1153584-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q1153584-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q1153584-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q1153584-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q1153584-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q1153584-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q1153584-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q1153584-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q1153584-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q1153584-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q1153584-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1153584-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q1153584-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1153584-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q1153584-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q1153584-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1153584-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q1153584-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1153584-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q1153584-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q1153584-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1153584-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1153584-r-multiply
          real x (q1153584-r-add real y z))
         (q1153584-r-add
          real
          (q1153584-r-multiply real x y)
          (q1153584-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-r-member-p real x)
      (q1153584-r-member-p real y)
      (q1153584-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q1153584-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q1153584-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1153584-r-less real x y)
         (q1153584-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1153584-r-less real x y)
          (q1153584-r-less real y z))
         (q1153584-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q1153584-r-less real x y)
         (q1153584-r-less
          real
          (q1153584-r-add real x z)
          (q1153584-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1153584-r-less real zero x)
          (q1153584-r-less real zero y))
         (q1153584-r-less
          real zero
          (q1153584-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1153584-r-member-p real x)
     (q1153584-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-r-member-p real x)
      (q1153584-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q1153584-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1153584-r-member-p real bound)
     (q1153584-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1153584-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q1153584-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1153584-r-member-p real bound)
       (q1153584-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q1153584-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1153584-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1153584-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q1153584-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q1153584-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q1153584-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q1153584-r-zero real))
        (one (q1153584-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q1153584-r-member-p real zero)
     (q1153584-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1153584-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q1153584-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q1153584-r-less real zero one)
     (q1153584-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q1153584-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q1153584-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q1153584-finite)
    (q1153584-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q1153584-r-leq
     real (q1153584-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q1153584-finite value))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q1153584-ennreal-finite (q1153584-r-zero real)))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q1153584-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q1153584-top) t)
   (t (q1153584-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q1153584-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q1153584-top)
          (equal right :q1153584-top))
      :q1153584-top
    (q1153584-ennreal-finite
     (q1153584-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q1153584-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q1153584-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q1153584-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q1153584-top)
        (equal right :q1153584-top))
    :q1153584-top)
   (t
    (q1153584-ennreal-finite
     (q1153584-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-to-real (real value)
  (if (and (consp value)
           (equal (car value) :q1153584-finite))
      (cdr value)
    (q1153584-r-zero real)))

;; Sets, sigma algebras, and measures.

(defun-sk q1153584-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q1153584-set-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-set-member-p left x)
     (q1153584-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q1153584-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q1153584-set-member-p left x)
      (q1153584-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x) nil))))

(defun-sk q1153584-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p complement x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not (q1153584-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-valid-set-p
      domain
      (q1153584-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-set-member-p
      (q1153584-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q1153584-sequence-union-set-p
    (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q1153584-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-family-extensional-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q1153584-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-family-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q1153584-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-empty-exists-p (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q1153584-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q1153584-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-complements-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q1153584-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-sequence-measurable-p (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q1153584-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q1153584-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-sequence-unions-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q1153584-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence))
     (q1153584-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q1153584-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q1153584-family-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q1153584-family-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q1153584-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q1153584-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q1153584-measurable-sequence-unions-p domain measurable)))

(defun-sk q1153584-disjoint-sets-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q1153584-set-member-p left x)
      (q1153584-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pairwise-disjoint-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n)))
     (q1153584-disjoint-sets-p
      (q1153584-set-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q1153584-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q1153584-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q1153584-ennreal-zero real)
    (q1153584-ennreal-add
     real
     (q1153584-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q1153584-measure-value
      measure
      (q1153584-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q1153584-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q1153584-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1153584-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-p real total)
     (q1153584-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1153584-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q1153584-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q1153584-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q1153584-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q1153584-measure-value measure left)
      (q1153584-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measure-values-p (real domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1153584-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q1153584-ennreal-p
      real (q1153584-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q1153584-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q1153584-measure-value measure empty)
      (q1153584-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-countably-additive-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q1153584-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q1153584-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence)
      (q1153584-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q1153584-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q1153584-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    (real measurable measure set lower)
  (forall (superset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable superset)
      (q1153584-set-subset-p set superset))
     (q1153584-ennreal-leq
      real lower
      (q1153584-measure-value measure superset)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-outer-measure-value-p
    (real measurable measure set)
  (forall (lower)
    (and
     (q1153584-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
      real measurable measure set
      (q1153584-measure-value measure set))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1153584-ennreal-p real lower)
       (q1153584-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
        real measurable measure set lower))
      (q1153584-ennreal-leq
       real lower
       (q1153584-measure-value measure set))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-outer-measure-values-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1153584-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q1153584-outer-measure-value-p
      real measurable measure set))))

(defun q1153584-measure-space-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q1153584-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q1153584-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q1153584-measure-values-p real domain measure)
   (q1153584-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q1153584-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)
   (q1153584-outer-measure-values-p
    real domain measurable measure)))

(defun q1153584-null-set-p (real domain measure set)
  (and
   (q1153584-valid-set-p domain set)
   (equal
    (q1153584-measure-value measure set)
    (q1153584-ennreal-zero real))))

;; Typed functions and measurability through upper-ray preimages.

(defun-sk q1153584-real-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q1153584-r-member-p
      real (q1153584-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ennreal-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q1153584-ennreal-p
      real (q1153584-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q1153584-r-less
       real threshold
       (q1153584-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q1153584-ennreal-less
       real threshold
       (q1153584-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-real-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q1153584-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-real-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q1153584-real-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q1153584-r-member-p real threshold)
      (q1153584-real-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q1153584-ennreal-p real threshold)
      (q1153584-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-disagreement-set-p
    (domain left right set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (equal
        (q1153584-function-value left x)
        (q1153584-function-value right x)))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-equal-p
    (real domain measure left right)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-disagreement-set-p domain left right set)
     (q1153584-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-real-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q1153584-real-function-p real domain function)
     (q1153584-measurable-real-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q1153584-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-ennreal-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q1153584-measurable-ennreal-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q1153584-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

;; The lower Lebesgue integral as the supremum of measurable finite-range
;; simple functions below the integrand.

(defun-sk q1153584-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q1153584-function-value function x)
      value))))

(defun q1153584-values-attained-p
    (domain function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1153584-value-attained-p
