        domain function (car values))
       (q1153584-values-attained-p
        domain function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1153584-ennreal-value-list-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1153584-ennreal-p real (car values))
       (q1153584-ennreal-value-list-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q1153584-range-in-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
     (member-equal
      (q1153584-function-value function x)
      values))))

(defun-sk q1153584-fiber-set-p
    (domain function value set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q1153584-function-value function x)
       value)))))

(defun q1153584-fiber-list-p
    (domain function values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (consp fibers)
       (q1153584-fiber-set-p
        domain function (car values) (car fibers))
       (q1153584-fiber-list-p
        domain function (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (equal fibers nil)))

(defun q1153584-finite-simple-integral
    (real measure values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (q1153584-ennreal-add
       real
       (q1153584-ennreal-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q1153584-measure-value measure (car fibers)))
       (q1153584-finite-simple-integral
        real measure (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (q1153584-ennreal-zero real)))

(defun q1153584-simple-function-data-p
    (real domain measurable function values fibers)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (true-listp fibers)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q1153584-ennreal-value-list-p real values)
   (q1153584-values-attained-p domain function values)
   (q1153584-range-in-values-p domain function values)
   (q1153584-fiber-list-p domain function values fibers)
   (q1153584-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    real domain measurable function)))

(defun-sk q1153584-simple-below-p
    (real domain simple function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q1153584-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q1153584-function-value simple x)
      (q1153584-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values fibers)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1153584-simple-function-data-p
       real domain measurable simple values fibers)
      (q1153584-simple-below-p
       real domain simple function))
     (q1153584-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q1153584-finite-simple-integral
       real measure values fibers)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-value-p
    (real domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q1153584-ennreal-p real value)
     (q1153584-lintegral-upper-bound-p
      real domain measurable measure function value)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1153584-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q1153584-lintegral-upper-bound-p
        real domain measurable measure function bound))
      (q1153584-ennreal-leq real value bound)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-operation-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q1153584-lintegral-value-p
      real domain measurable measure function
      (q1153584-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure function)))))

;; The real Bochner integral, specialized to real-valued functions.

(defun-sk q1153584-enorm-function-p
    (real domain function enorm-function)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain enorm-function)
     (implies
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q1153584-function-value enorm-function x)
       (q1153584-ennreal-finite
        (q1153584-r-abs
         real
         (q1153584-function-value function x))))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-integrable-enorm-exists-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
  (exists (enorm-function)
    (and
     (q1153584-enorm-function-p
      real domain function enorm-function)
     (q1153584-ennreal-less
      real
      (q1153584-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure enorm-function)
      :q1153584-top))))

(defun q1153584-integrable-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
  (and
   (q1153584-ae-real-measurable-p
    real domain measurable measure function)
   (q1153584-integrable-enorm-exists-p
    real domain measurable measure lintegral function)))

(defun-sk q1153584-positive-part-function-p
    (real domain function positive)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain positive)
     (implies
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q1153584-function-value positive x)
       (q1153584-ennreal-finite
        (if
            (q1153584-r-less
             real
             (q1153584-function-value function x)
             (q1153584-r-zero real))
            (q1153584-r-zero real)
          (q1153584-function-value function x))))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-negative-part-function-p
    (real domain function negative)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain negative)
     (implies
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (let ((negated
             (q1153584-r-negate
              real
              (q1153584-function-value function x))))
        (equal
         (q1153584-function-value negative x)
         (q1153584-ennreal-finite
          (if
              (q1153584-r-less
               real negated (q1153584-r-zero real))
              (q1153584-r-zero real)
            negated))))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-integral-witness-exists-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function value)
  (exists (positive negative)
    (and
     (q1153584-positive-part-function-p
      real domain function positive)
     (q1153584-negative-part-function-p
      real domain function negative)
     (equal
      value
      (q1153584-r-add
       real
       (q1153584-ennreal-to-real
        real
        (q1153584-lintegral-value
         lintegral domain measurable measure positive))
       (q1153584-r-negate
        real
        (q1153584-ennreal-to-real
         real
         (q1153584-lintegral-value
          lintegral domain measurable measure negative))))))))

(defun q1153584-real-integral-value-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function value)
  (and
   (q1153584-r-member-p real value)
   (if
       (q1153584-integrable-p
        real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
       (q1153584-real-integral-witness-exists-p
        integral real domain measurable measure
        lintegral function value)
     (equal value (q1153584-r-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-integral-operation-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q1153584-real-function-p real domain function)
     (q1153584-real-integral-value-p
      integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function
      (q1153584-integral-value
       integral real domain measurable measure
       lintegral function)))))

;; Almost-everywhere monotonicity and pointwise convergence.

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-monotone-p
    (real sequence x)
  (forall (n m)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp m) (<= n m))
     (q1153584-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n) x)
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence m) x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-real-antitone-p
    (real sequence x)
  (forall (n m)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp m) (<= n m))
     (q1153584-r-leq
      real
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence m) x)
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n) x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ennreal-monotone-failure-set-p
    (real domain sequence set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-monotone-p
        real sequence x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-antitone-failure-set-p
    (real domain sequence set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (q1153584-pointwise-real-antitone-p
        real sequence x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-ennreal-monotone-p
    (real domain measure sequence)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-monotone-failure-set-p
      real domain sequence set)
     (q1153584-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-real-antitone-p
    (real domain measure sequence)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-real-antitone-failure-set-p
      real domain sequence set)
     (q1153584-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-above-from-p
    (real sequence x lower start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-ennreal-less
      real lower
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n) x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-above-p
    (real sequence x lower)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-above-from-p
      real sequence x lower start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-below-from-p
    (real sequence x upper start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-ennreal-less
      real
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n) x)
      upper))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-below-p
    (real sequence x upper)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-below-from-p
      real sequence x upper start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-tendsto-p
    (real sequence limit x)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q1153584-ennreal-p real bound)
     (and
      (implies
       (q1153584-ennreal-less
        real bound
        (q1153584-function-value limit x))
       (q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-above-p
        real sequence x bound))
      (implies
       (q1153584-ennreal-less
        real
        (q1153584-function-value limit x)
        bound)
       (q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-eventually-below-p
        real sequence x bound))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-above-from-p
    (real sequence x lower start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-r-less
      real lower
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n) x)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-above-p
    (real sequence x lower)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-above-from-p
      real sequence x lower start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-below-from-p
    (real sequence x upper start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-r-less
      real
      (q1153584-function-value
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n) x)
      upper))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-below-p
    (real sequence x upper)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-below-from-p
      real sequence x upper start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-pointwise-real-tendsto-p
    (real sequence limit x)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q1153584-r-member-p real bound)
     (and
      (implies
       (q1153584-r-less
        real bound
        (q1153584-function-value limit x))
       (q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-above-p
        real sequence x bound))
      (implies
       (q1153584-r-less
        real
        (q1153584-function-value limit x)
        bound)
       (q1153584-pointwise-real-eventually-below-p
        real sequence x bound))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ennreal-tendsto-failure-set-p
    (real domain sequence limit set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (q1153584-pointwise-ennreal-tendsto-p
        real sequence limit x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-tendsto-failure-set-p
    (real domain sequence limit set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1153584-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q1153584-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (q1153584-pointwise-real-tendsto-p
        real sequence limit x))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-ennreal-pointwise-tendsto-p
    (real domain measure sequence limit)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-ennreal-tendsto-failure-set-p
      real domain sequence limit set)
     (q1153584-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ae-real-pointwise-tendsto-p
    (real domain measure sequence limit)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1153584-real-tendsto-failure-set-p
      real domain sequence limit set)
     (q1153584-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q1153584-ennreal-function-sequence-p
    (real domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-ennreal-function-p
      real domain
      (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-real-function-sequence-p
    (real domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-real-function-p
      real domain
      (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-sequence-ae-ennreal-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-ae-ennreal-measurable-p
      real domain measurable measure
      (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1153584-sequence-integrable-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1153584-integrable-p
      real domain measurable measure lintegral
      (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n)))))

;; Convergence of the two sequences of integral values.

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-eventually-above-from-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence lower start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-ennreal-less
      real lower
      (q1153584-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-eventually-above-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence lower)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-lintegral-eventually-above-from-p
      real domain measurable measure lintegral
      sequence lower start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-eventually-below-from-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence upper start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-ennreal-less
      real
      (q1153584-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n))
      upper))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-eventually-below-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence upper)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-lintegral-eventually-below-from-p
      real domain measurable measure lintegral
      sequence upper start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-lintegral-sequence-tendsto-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence limit)
  (forall (bound)
    (let ((limit-value
           (q1153584-lintegral-value
            lintegral domain measurable measure limit)))
      (implies
       (q1153584-ennreal-p real bound)
       (and
        (implies
         (q1153584-ennreal-less real bound limit-value)
         (q1153584-lintegral-eventually-above-p
          real domain measurable measure lintegral
          sequence bound))
        (implies
         (q1153584-ennreal-less real limit-value bound)
         (q1153584-lintegral-eventually-below-p
          real domain measurable measure lintegral
          sequence bound)))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-integral-eventually-above-from-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
     sequence lower start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-r-less
      real lower
      (q1153584-integral-value
       integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n))))))

(defun-sk q1153584-integral-eventually-above-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence lower)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-integral-eventually-above-from-p
      integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
      sequence lower start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-integral-eventually-below-from-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
     sequence upper start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= start n))
     (q1153584-r-less
      real
      (q1153584-integral-value
       integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
       (q1153584-function-sequence-value sequence n))
      upper))))

(defun-sk q1153584-integral-eventually-below-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence upper)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1153584-integral-eventually-below-from-p
      integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
      sequence upper start))))

(defun-sk q1153584-integral-sequence-tendsto-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence limit)
  (forall (bound)
    (let ((limit-value
           (q1153584-integral-value
            integral real domain measurable measure lintegral limit)))
      (implies
       (q1153584-r-member-p real bound)
       (and
        (implies
         (q1153584-r-less real bound limit-value)
         (q1153584-integral-eventually-above-p
          integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
          sequence bound))
        (implies
         (q1153584-r-less real limit-value bound)
         (q1153584-integral-eventually-below-p
          integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
          sequence bound)))))))

;; The two indexed statements.

(defun q1153584-lintegral-monotone-convergence-statement
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence limit)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1153584-real-field-p real)
    (q1153584-measure-space-p real domain measurable measure)
    (q1153584-lintegral-operation-p
     real domain measurable measure lintegral)
    (q1153584-ennreal-function-sequence-p
     real domain sequence)
    (q1153584-ennreal-function-p real domain limit)
    (q1153584-sequence-ae-ennreal-measurable-p
     real domain measurable measure sequence)
    (q1153584-ae-ennreal-monotone-p
     real domain measure sequence)
    (q1153584-ae-ennreal-pointwise-tendsto-p
     real domain measure sequence limit))
   (q1153584-lintegral-sequence-tendsto-p
    real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence limit)))

(defun q1153584-integral-antitone-convergence-statement
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence limit)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1153584-real-field-p real)
    (q1153584-measure-space-p real domain measurable measure)
    (q1153584-lintegral-operation-p
     real domain measurable measure lintegral)
    (q1153584-real-integral-operation-p
     integral real domain measurable measure lintegral)
    (q1153584-real-function-sequence-p real domain sequence)
    (q1153584-real-function-p real domain limit)
    (q1153584-sequence-integrable-p
     real domain measurable measure lintegral sequence)
    (q1153584-integrable-p
     real domain measurable measure lintegral limit)
    (q1153584-ae-real-antitone-p
     real domain measure sequence)
    (q1153584-ae-real-pointwise-tendsto-p
     real domain measure sequence limit))
   (q1153584-integral-sequence-tendsto-p
    integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
    sequence limit)))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1153584-monotone-convergence-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall
      (real domain measurable measure lintegral integral
       ennreal-sequence ennreal-limit real-sequence real-limit)
    (and
     (q1153584-lintegral-monotone-convergence-statement
      real domain measurable measure lintegral
      ennreal-sequence ennreal-limit)
     (q1153584-integral-antitone-convergence-statement
      integral real domain measurable measure lintegral
      real-sequence real-limit))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1153584,
-- "Monotone convergence theorem": almost-everywhere monotone sequences of
-- extended-nonnegative-real measurable functions, and almost-everywhere
-- antitone sequences of integrable real functions, have integrals converging
-- to the integral of their pointwise limit. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List)
open import Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open SigmaAlgebra
open Measure
open NonnegativeReal
open ENNRealPresentation

record IndexedSimpleBelowM
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (f : A -> M) : Set where
  field
    simpleCutoffM :
      Nat
    simpleIndexM :
      A -> Nat
    simpleValuesM :
      Nat -> M
    simpleIndexWithinM :
      (x : A) ->
      simpleIndexM x <=N simpleCutoffM
    simpleFiberMeasurableM :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simpleCutoffM ->
      measurable events (\ x -> simpleIndexM x == i)
    simplePointwiseBelowM :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (simpleValuesM (simpleIndexM x)) (f x)

open IndexedSimpleBelowM

indexedSimpleIntegralM :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  {f : A -> M} ->
  IndexedSimpleBelowM events extended f ->
  M
indexedSimpleIntegralM extended measure simple =
  sumThroughM extended
    (\ i ->
      multiplyM extended
        (simpleValuesM simple i)
        (outerMass measure
          (\ x -> simpleIndexM simple x == i)))
    (simpleCutoffM simple)

record SimpleIntegralCandidateM
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> M)
  (candidate : M) : Set where
  field
    candidateSimpleM :
      IndexedSimpleBelowM events extended f
    candidateEquationM :
      candidate ==
      indexedSimpleIntegralM extended measure candidateSimpleM

canonicalLIntegralM :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (A -> M) ->
  M
canonicalLIntegralM extended measure f =
  supremumM extended
    (\ candidate ->
      SimpleIntegralCandidateM extended measure f candidate)

MeasurableOrder :
  {A V : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (A -> V) ->
  Set
MeasurableOrder events le f =
  (ray : OrderRay _) ->
  measurable events (\ x -> RayContains le ray (f x))

AEMeasurableOrder :
  {A R M V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (A -> V) ->
  Set
AEMeasurableOrder {A = A} events measure le f =
  Exists (A -> _)
    (\ representative ->
      Both
        (MeasurableOrder events le representative)
        (AlmostEverywhere measure
          (\ x -> f x == representative x)))

MonotoneSequence :
  {V : Set} ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
MonotoneSequence le sequence =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i <=N j ->
  le (sequence i) (sequence j)

AntitoneSequence :
  {V : Set} ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
AntitoneSequence le sequence =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i <=N j ->
  le (sequence j) (sequence i)

SequentialTendstoOrder :
  {V : Set} ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialTendstoOrder le sequence limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay _)) ->
  BasicContains le rays limit ->
  EventuallyAtTop
    (\ n -> BasicContains le rays (sequence n))

positivePartNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  R ->
  NonnegativeReal reals
positivePartNN reals x with
  order-total reals (zeroR reals) x
... | left zero-le-x =
  nonnegative-real x zero-le-x
... | right x-le-zero =
  nonnegative-real
    (zeroR reals)
    (order-reflexive reals (zeroR reals))

negativePartNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  R ->
  NonnegativeReal reals
negativePartNN reals x =
  positivePartNN reals (negateR reals x)

absolutePartNN :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  R ->
  NonnegativeReal reals
absolutePartNN reals x =
  nonnegative-real
    (absoluteR reals x)
    (absolute-nonnegative reals x)

toRealM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  M ->
  R
toRealM {reals = reals} presentation x with
  toCanonicalENNReal presentation x
... | finite-ennreal value =
  realValue value
... | infinity-ennreal =
  zeroR reals

RealIntegrable :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set
RealIntegrable reals events extended measure f =
  Both
    (AEMeasurableOrder events measure (lessOrEqualR reals) f)
    (canonicalLIntegralM extended measure
      (\ x -> finiteNN extended (absolutePartNN reals (f x))) !=
      infinityM extended)

realIntegral :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (A -> R) ->
  R
realIntegral reals extended presentation measure f =
  subtractR reals
    (toRealM presentation
      (canonicalLIntegralM extended measure
        (\ x -> finiteNN extended (positivePartNN reals (f x)))))
    (toRealM presentation
      (canonicalLIntegralM extended measure
        (\ x -> finiteNN extended (negativePartNN reals (f x)))))

lintegral-tendsto-of-tendsto-of-monotone : Set2
lintegral-tendsto-of-tendsto-of-monotone =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (functions : Nat -> A -> M) ->
  (limit : A -> M) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    AEMeasurableOrder events measure
      (lessOrEqualM extended)
      (functions n)) ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      MonotoneSequence
        (lessOrEqualM extended)
        (\ n -> functions n x)) ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      SequentialTendstoM extended
        (\ n -> functions n x)
        (limit x)) ->
  SequentialTendstoM extended
    (\ n -> canonicalLIntegralM extended measure (functions n))
    (canonicalLIntegralM extended measure limit)

integral-tendsto-of-tendsto-of-antitone : Set2
integral-tendsto-of-tendsto-of-antitone =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (presentation : ENNRealPresentation extended) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (functions : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  (limit : A -> R) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    RealIntegrable reals events extended measure (functions n)) ->
  RealIntegrable reals events extended measure limit ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      AntitoneSequence
        (lessOrEqualR reals)
        (\ n -> functions n x)) ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      SequentialTendstoOrder
        (lessOrEqualR reals)
        (\ n -> functions n x)
        (limit x)) ->
  SequentialTendstoOrder
    (lessOrEqualR reals)
    (\ n ->
      realIntegral reals extended presentation measure (functions n))
    (realIntegral reals extended presentation measure limit)

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1153584, "Monotone convergence theorem": almost-everywhere monotone
  convergence of nonnegative extended-real functions passes through the lower
  Lebesgue integral, and an integrable antitone real-valued sequence has
  convergent Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q1153584_ae_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q1153584_ae_measurable_def",
  ``q1153584_ae_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space) (h : 'a -> extreal) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> extreal.
        g IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
        (AE x::m. h x = g x)``);

val q1153584_ae_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q1153584_ae_integrable_def",
  ``q1153584_ae_integrable
      (m : 'a m_space) (h : 'a -> real) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> real.
        integrable m (Normal o g) /\
        (AE x::m. h x = g x)``);

val q1153584_tendsto_ennreal_def = new_definition (
  "q1153584_tendsto_ennreal_def",
  ``q1153584_tendsto_ennreal
      (u : num -> extreal) (ell : extreal) <=>
      (ell = PosInf /\
       !b : real.
         ?N. !n. N <= n ==> Normal b < u n) \/
      (?r : real.
         ell = Normal r /\
         !epsilon : real.
           0 < epsilon ==>
           ?N. !n.
             N <= n ==>
             Normal (r - epsilon) < u n /\
             u n < Normal (r + epsilon))``);

val integral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_antitone =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (f : num -> 'a -> real) (F : 'a -> real).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      (!n. q1153584_ae_integrable m (f n)) /\
      q1153584_ae_integrable m F /\
      (AE x::m. !i j. i <= j ==> f j x <= f i x) /\
      (AE x::m. ((\n. f n x) --> F x) sequentially)
      ==>
      ((\n. real (integral m (Normal o (f n)))) -->
        real (integral m (Normal o F))) sequentially``;

val lintegral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (f : num -> 'a -> extreal)
      (F : 'a -> extreal).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      (!n x. 0 <= f n x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= F x) /\
      (!n. q1153584_ae_measurable m (f n)) /\
      (AE x::m. !i j. i <= j ==> f i x <= f j x) /\
      (AE x::m. q1153584_tendsto_ennreal (\n. f n x) (F x))
      ==>
      q1153584_tendsto_ennreal
        (\n. pos_fn_integral m (f n))
        (pos_fn_integral m F)``;

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1153584
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1153584), "Monotone convergence theorem":
  almost-everywhere monotone convergence for extended-nonnegative Lebesgue
  integrals and antitone convergence for integrable real-valued Bochner
  integrals. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1153584Simple and Q1153584SimpleIntegral describe finite-range measurable
  extended-nonnegative simple functions and their integrals.
  Q1153584LIntegral is the lower Lebesgue integral, defined as the supremum of
  the integrals of simple functions bounded by its argument.

  Q1153584AEMeasurable says that a function agrees outside a measurable null
  set with a measurable function. Q1153584AEMonotone and
  Q1153584AEAntitone state the respective pointwise order properties outside
  a measurable null set. Q1153584AELimit is almost-everywhere pointwise
  sequence convergence in the indicated topology. These are equivalent to
  the Lean almost-everywhere predicates because every measure-zero exceptional
  set is contained in a measurable measure-zero set.

  Q1153584AEStrong is the simple-function characterization of almost-
  everywhere strong measurability. Q1153584Integrable is almost-everywhere
  strong measurability together with finiteness of the lower integral of the
  pointwise norm. Q1153584HasIntegral says that a function is approximated in
  L1 by measurable finite-range functions whose simple Bochner integrals
  converge, and Q1153584Integral is that unique limit for an integrable real
  function and zero otherwise. This avoids SetMM's unfinished general itgm
  operator while matching Lean's totalized real Bochner integral.

  Q1153584Tendsto uses SetMM's native NN0-indexed sequence convergence. The
  two final unproved $a declarations render respectively the extended-
  nonnegative monotone theorem and the real-valued antitone theorem. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1153584Simple Q1153584SimpleIntegral Q1153584LIntegral
   Q1153584Tendsto Q1153584AEMeasurable Q1153584AEMonotone
   Q1153584AEAntitone Q1153584AELimit Q1153584AEStrong
   Q1153584Diff Q1153584L1Distance Q1153584Integrable
   Q1153584HasIntegral Q1153584Integral $.

q1153584-simple-syntax $a wff ( Q1153584Simple M G ) $.
q1153584-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q1153584SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q1153584-lintegral-syntax $a class ( Q1153584LIntegral M H ) $.
q1153584-tendsto-syntax $a wff ( Q1153584Tendsto W S z ) $.
q1153584-aemeasurable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584AEMeasurable M H ) $.
q1153584-aemonotone-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584AEMonotone M F ) $.
q1153584-aeantitone-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584AEAntitone M F ) $.
q1153584-aelimit-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584AELimit M W F H ) $.
q1153584-aestrong-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584AEStrong M W H ) $.
q1153584-diff-syntax
  $a class ( Q1153584Diff M W H K ) $.
q1153584-l1-distance-syntax
  $a class ( Q1153584L1Distance M W H K ) $.
q1153584-integrable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584Integrable M H ) $.
q1153584-has-integral-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1153584HasIntegral M H y ) $.
q1153584-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q1153584Integral M H ) $.

${
  $d G M $.

  q1153584-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q1153584-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1153584SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q1153584-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q1153584LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q1153584Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M
                ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q1153584SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S W z $.

  q1153584-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584Tendsto W S z )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) z
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G H M N x $.

  q1153584-aemeasurable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584AEMeasurable M H )
    <->
    (
      H : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      E. G
        (
          G e.
            (
              dom M
              MblFnM
              (
                sigaGen `
                ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
              )
            )
          /\
          E. N e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` N ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                ( H ` x ) = ( G ` x )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M N m n x $.

  q1153584-aemonotone-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584AEMonotone M F )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
          A. n e. NN0
            A. m e. NN0
              (
                n <_ m
                ->
                ( ( F ` n ) ` x ) <_ ( ( F ` m ) ` x )
              )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M N m n x $.

  q1153584-aeantitone-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584AEAntitone M F )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
          A. n e. NN0
            A. m e. NN0
              (
                n <_ m
                ->
                ( ( F ` m ) ` x ) <_ ( ( F ` n ) ` x )
              )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F H M N W n x $.

  q1153584-aelimit-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584AELimit M W F H )
    <->
    E. N e. dom M
      (
        ( M ` N ) = 0
        /\
        A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
          (
            Q1153584Tendsto
            W
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( F ` n ) ` x ) )
            ( H ` x )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N S W n x $.

  q1153584-aestrong-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584AEStrong M W H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( ( Base ` W ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( S ` n )
                e. ( dom M MblFnM ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) )
              /\
              ran ( S ` n ) e. Fin
            )
          /\
          E. N e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` N ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                (
                  Q1153584Tendsto
                  W
                  ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( S ` n ) ` x ) )
                  ( H ` x )
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1153584-diff-definition $a |- (
    Q1153584Diff M W H K
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      (
        ( H ` x )
        ( +g ` W )
        ( ( -g ` W ) ` ( K ` x ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M W x $.

  q1153584-l1-distance-definition $a |- (
    Q1153584L1Distance M W H K
  ) =
    (
      Q1153584LIntegral
      M
      ( x e. U. dom M |->
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          `
          ( ( Q1153584Diff M W H K ) ` x )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M x $.

  q1153584-integrable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584Integrable M H )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1153584AEStrong M RRfld H )
      /\
      (
        Q1153584LIntegral
        M
        ( x e. U. dom M |->
          ( ( norm ` RRfld ) ` ( H ` x ) )
        )
      )
      < +oo
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M S n y $.

  q1153584-has-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1153584HasIntegral M H y )
    <->
    (
      y e. RR
      /\
      E. S e. ( ( RR ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            ( ( S ` n ) e. dom ( RRfld sitg M ) )
          /\
          (
            Q1153584Tendsto
            ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
            ( n e. NN0 |->
              ( Q1153584L1Distance M RRfld H ( S ` n ) ) )
            0
            /\
            Q1153584Tendsto
            RRfld
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( RRfld sitg M ) ` ( S ` n ) ) )
            y
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M y $.

  q1153584-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q1153584Integral M H
    =
    if
    (
      ( Q1153584Integrable M H ) ,
      (
        iota_ y e. RR
          ( Q1153584HasIntegral M H y )
      ) ,
      0
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G H M N S W f m n x y z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1153584-lintegral-monotone-convergence $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. F e.
        ( ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        A. f e. ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m U. dom M )
          (
            (
              (
                A. n e. NN0
                  ( Q1153584AEMeasurable M ( F ` n ) )
                /\
                ( Q1153584AEMonotone M F )
              )
              /\
              (
                Q1153584AELimit
                M
                ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
                F
                f
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              Q1153584Tendsto
              ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
              ( n e. NN0 |->
                ( Q1153584LIntegral M ( F ` n ) ) )
              ( Q1153584LIntegral M f )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F G H M N S W f m n x y z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1153584-integral-antitone-convergence $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. F e. ( ( RR ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        A. f e. ( RR ^m U. dom M )
          (
            (
              (
                A. n e. NN0
                  ( Q1153584Integrable M ( F ` n ) )
                /\
                ( Q1153584Integrable M f )
              )
              /\
              (
                ( Q1153584AEAntitone M F )
                /\
                ( Q1153584AELimit M RRfld F f )
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              Q1153584Tendsto
              RRfld
              ( n e. NN0 |->
                ( Q1153584Integral M ( F ` n ) ) )
              ( Q1153584Integral M f )
            )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1153584,
:: "Monotone convergence theorem": almost-everywhere monotone convergence for
:: extended-nonnegative Lebesgue integrals and antitone convergence for
:: integrable real-valued Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, SUBSET_1, SEQFUNC,
      MESFUNC5, PARTFUN1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, RELAT_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1,
      FUNCT_1, ORDINAL2, CARD_1, COMPLEX1, SEQ_2, TARSKI, REAL_1, PBOOLE,
      MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, VALUED_1, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_2, SETFAM_1, MEASURE6,
      INTEGRA5, SEQ_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
      XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_0,
      RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NAT_1, PROB_1,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE3, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6,
      SETFAM_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2;
 constructors REAL_1, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6,
      RELSET_1, COMPLEX1, MEASURE3, SETFAM_1, SEQ_2;
 registrations SUBSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, ORDINAL1, PARTFUN1,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE3, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0,
      XCMPLX_0, FUNCT_1, VALUED_0, XXREAL_3, RELSET_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6;
 equalities XBOOLE_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       F being sequence of Funcs(X,ExtREAL),
       g being Function of X,ExtREAL
   holds
     ex J being ExtREAL_sequence st
       (for n being Nat holds J.n = 0) &
       J is convergent & lim J = 0)
  &
  (for X being non empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       F being sequence of Funcs(X,ExtREAL),
       g being Function of X,ExtREAL
   st
     (for n being Nat holds
       ex Fn,Hn being Function of X,ExtREAL,
          N being Element of S
       st
         F.n = Fn &

title: Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1153584,
% "Monotone convergence theorem": almost-everywhere monotone convergence for
% extended-nonnegative Lebesgue integrals and antitone convergence for integrable
% real-valued Bochner integrals. This file contains no proof.

monotone_convergence_theorem_Q1153584[A: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]
  nonnegative_function_sequence: TYPE =
    [nat -> nonnegative_function]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): NOT E(omega)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES F(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  converges_to_measure_value(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      limit: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(limit)
      AND IF infinite_flag(limit) THEN
        FORALL (bound: real):
          EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              cutoff <= index IMPLIES
                canonical_measure_value(values(index))
                  AND (infinite_flag(values(index))
                    OR bound < finite_part(values(index)))
      ELSE
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              cutoff <= index IMPLIES
                canonical_measure_value(values(index))
                  AND NOT infinite_flag(values(index))
                  AND abs(finite_part(values(index))
                    - finite_part(limit))
                    < epsilon_value
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
      Sigma(measurable_cover)
        AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
        AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A): NOT property(omega))

  sublevel_event(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      NOT infinite_flag(function_value(omega))
        AND finite_part(function_value(omega)) <= bound

  measurable_nonnegative_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        0 <= bound IMPLIES
          Sigma(sublevel_event(function_value, bound)))

  ae_measurable_nonnegative_function(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_version: nonnegative_function):
        measurable_nonnegative_function(
          Sigma, measurable_version)
          AND almost_everywhere(
            M,
            Sigma,
            LAMBDA (omega: A):
              function_value(omega)
                = measurable_version(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
          function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: measure_value):
        has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))

  finite_real_simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          function_value(omega)
            = finite_real_simple_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              approximants(index)(omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      strongly_measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega)
              = measurable_version(omega))

  positive_part(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      finite_measure_value(
        IF function_value(omega) >= 0 THEN
          function_value(omega)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF)

  negative_part(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      finite_measure_value(
        IF function_value(omega) <= 0 THEN
          -function_value(omega)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF)

  absolute_value_function(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      finite_measure_value(abs(function_value(omega)))

  has_finite_integral_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(
      lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        absolute_value_function(function_value)))

  integrable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND ae_strongly_measurable_real(
        M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_real(
        M, Sigma, function_value)

  bochner_integral_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): real =
    IF integrable_real(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      finite_part(
        lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M, Sigma, positive_part(function_value)))
        - finite_part(
          lower_lebesgue_integral(
            M, Sigma, negative_part(function_value)))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  monotone_nonnegative_sequence_at(
      functions: nonnegative_function_sequence,
      omega: A): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index <= right_index IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(
          functions(left_index)(omega),
          functions(right_index)(omega))

  antitone_real_sequence_at(
      functions: real_function_sequence,
      omega: A): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index <= right_index IMPLIES
        functions(right_index)(omega)
          <= functions(left_index)(omega)

  lintegral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (functions: nonnegative_function_sequence),
        (limit_function: nonnegative_function):
      (is_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          ae_measurable_nonnegative_function(
            M, Sigma, functions(index)))
        AND canonical_nonnegative_function(limit_function)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            monotone_nonnegative_sequence_at(
              functions, omega))
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            converges_to_measure_value(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                functions(index)(omega),
              limit_function(omega))))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to_measure_value(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M, Sigma, functions(index)),
          lower_lebesgue_integral(
            M, Sigma, limit_function))

  integral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_antitone: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (functions: real_function_sequence),
        (limit_function: real_function):
      ((FORALL (index: nat):
          integrable_real(
            M, Sigma, functions(index)))
        AND integrable_real(
          M, Sigma, limit_function)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            antitone_real_sequence_at(
              functions, omega))
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                functions(index)(omega),
              limit_function(omega))))
      IMPLIES
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            bochner_integral_real(
              M, Sigma, functions(index)),
          bochner_integral_real(
            M, Sigma, limit_function))

  monotone_convergence_theorem: bool =
    lintegral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_monotone
      AND integral_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_antitone
END monotone_convergence_theorem_Q1153584

title: Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1186808
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1186808), "Lucas's theorem": for a prime `p`,
-- a binomial coefficient is congruent modulo `p` to the product of the
-- binomial coefficients of its base-`p` digits. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.CharP.Lemmas
public import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Basic

@[expose] public section

open Finset hiding choose

open Nat

namespace Choose

variable {n k p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]

/-- Lucas's theorem for natural-number binomial coefficients, stated as an integer congruence. -/
theorem lucas_theorem {a : ℕ} (ha₁ : n < p ^ a) (ha₂ : k < p ^ a) :
    choose n k ≡ ∏ i ∈ range a, choose (n / p ^ i % p) (k / p ^ i % p) [ZMOD p] := sorry

end Choose

title: Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1186808
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1186808), "Lucas's theorem": for a prime p,
  a binomial coefficient is congruent modulo p to the product of the
  binomial coefficients of the corresponding base-p digits. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat ZArith.ZArith.
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Definition q1186808_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Theorem lucas_theorem :
  forall n k p a : nat,
    q1186808_prime p ->
    (n < Nat.pow p a)%nat ->
    (k < Nat.pow p a)%nat ->
    Z.divide
      (Z.of_nat p)
      (Z.of_nat
         (\prod_(0 <= i < a)
            binomial
              (Nat.modulo (Nat.div n (Nat.pow p i)) p)
              (Nat.modulo (Nat.div k (Nat.pow p i)) p)) -
       Z.of_nat (binomial n k))%Z.
Admitted.

Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1186808,
;; "Lucas's theorem": for a prime p and natural n and k below p^a, choose(n,k)
;; is congruent modulo p to the product of the binomial coefficients of their
;; corresponding base-p digits through position a - 1. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun q1186808-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (q1186808-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) k)
       (q1186808-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

(defun q1186808-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (q1186808-no-divisor-from-p number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun q1186808-primep (number)
  (and (natp number)
       (< 1 number)
       (q1186808-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

(defun q1186808-digit-binomial-product (n k p a)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix a)))
  (if (zp a)
      1
    (let* ((i (- a 1))
           (p-to-i (expt p i))
           (n-digit (mod (floor n p-to-i) p))
           (k-digit (mod (floor k p-to-i) p)))

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1186808,
-- "Lucas's theorem": modulo a prime, a binomial coefficient is congruent to
-- the product of the binomial coefficients of its base-prime digits. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 2 _or_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : two <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
power base zero =
  one
power base (suc exponent) =
  base * power base exponent

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n (suc k) + choose n k

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus lhs rhs =
  naturalMod lhs modulus == naturalMod rhs modulus

digitChoose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
digitChoose p n k i =
  choose
    (naturalMod (naturalDiv n (power p i)) p)
    (naturalMod (naturalDiv k (power p i)) p)

digitChooseProduct : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
digitChooseProduct p n k zero =
  one
digitChooseProduct p n k (suc a) =
  digitChooseProduct p n k a * digitChoose p n k a

lucas-theorem : Set
lucas-theorem =
  (p n k a : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  n < power p a ->
  k < power p a ->
  ModEq p (choose n k) (digitChooseProduct p n k a)

title: Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1186808,
% "Lucas's theorem": for a prime p, a binomial coefficient is congruent modulo
% p to the product of the binomial coefficients of its base-p digits. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_quotient(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      ndiv(numerator, denominator)
    ENDIF

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  nat_remainder(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(numerator, denominator, numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  digitwise_binomial_product(
      n, k, p, count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      digitwise_binomial_product(n, k, p, count - 1)
        * binomial_coefficient(
            nat_remainder(
              nat_quotient(n, p ^ (count - 1)), p),
            nat_remainder(
              nat_quotient(k, p ^ (count - 1)), p))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nat_congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) = (modulus :: int) * offset

  lucas_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (p, n, k, a: nat):
      (prime_nat(p) AND n < p ^ a AND k < p ^ a)
        IMPLIES
          nat_congruent(
            binomial_coefficient(n, k),
            digitwise_binomial_product(n, k, p, a),
            p)
END Q1186808_lucas_s_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1187646
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1187646), "Fundamental theorem on homomorphisms":
  every homomorphism of arbitrary groups induces a group isomorphism from the
  quotient of its domain by its kernel to its range. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Record q1187646_group : Type := {
  q1187646_carrier : Type;
  q1187646_one : q1187646_carrier;
  q1187646_mul :
    q1187646_carrier -> q1187646_carrier -> q1187646_carrier;
  q1187646_inv : q1187646_carrier -> q1187646_carrier;
  q1187646_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : q1187646_carrier,
      q1187646_mul x (q1187646_mul y z) =
      q1187646_mul (q1187646_mul x y) z;
  q1187646_one_mul :
    forall x : q1187646_carrier, q1187646_mul q1187646_one x = x;
  q1187646_mul_one :
    forall x : q1187646_carrier, q1187646_mul x q1187646_one = x;
  q1187646_inv_mul :
    forall x : q1187646_carrier,
      q1187646_mul (q1187646_inv x) x = q1187646_one;
  q1187646_mul_inv :
    forall x : q1187646_carrier,
      q1187646_mul x (q1187646_inv x) = q1187646_one
}.

Arguments q1187646_carrier _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1187646_one {q}.
Arguments q1187646_mul {q} _ _.
Arguments q1187646_inv {q} _.

Definition q1187646_subgroup (G : q1187646_group) : Type :=
  q1187646_carrier G -> Prop.

Definition q1187646_group_homomorphism
    (G H : q1187646_group)
    (f : q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier H) : Prop :=
  f q1187646_one = q1187646_one /\
  forall x y : q1187646_carrier G,
    f (q1187646_mul x y) = q1187646_mul (f x) (f y).

Definition q1187646_kernel
    {G H : q1187646_group}
    (f : q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier H) :
    q1187646_subgroup G :=
  fun x => f x = q1187646_one.

Definition q1187646_range
    {G H : q1187646_group}
    (f : q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier H) :
    q1187646_subgroup H :=
  fun y => exists x : q1187646_carrier G, f x = y.

Definition q1187646_top_subgroup
    (G : q1187646_group) : q1187646_subgroup G :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q1187646_bottom_subgroup
    (G : q1187646_group) : q1187646_subgroup G :=
  fun x => x = q1187646_one.

Definition q1187646_quotient_equal
    (G : q1187646_group)
    (N : q1187646_subgroup G)
    (x y : q1187646_carrier G) : Prop :=
  N (q1187646_mul (q1187646_inv x) y).

Definition q1187646_relation_map_isomorphism
    (G H : q1187646_group)
    (A : q1187646_subgroup G)
    (C : q1187646_subgroup H)
    (source_equal :
      q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier G -> Prop)
    (target_equal :
      q1187646_carrier H -> q1187646_carrier H -> Prop)
    (forward : q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier H) : Prop :=
  q1187646_group_homomorphism G H forward /\
  (forall x : q1187646_carrier G, A x -> C (forward x)) /\
  (forall x y : q1187646_carrier G,
      A x -> A y -> source_equal x y ->
      target_equal (forward x) (forward y)) /\
  exists backward : q1187646_carrier H -> q1187646_carrier G,
    (forall y : q1187646_carrier H, C y -> A (backward y)) /\
    (forall y z : q1187646_carrier H,
      C y -> C z -> target_equal y z ->
      source_equal (backward y) (backward z)) /\
    (forall x : q1187646_carrier G,
      A x -> source_equal (backward (forward x)) x) /\
    (forall y : q1187646_carrier H,
      C y -> target_equal (forward (backward y)) y).

Definition q1187646_quotient_map_isomorphism
    (G H : q1187646_group)
    (A B : q1187646_subgroup G)
    (C D : q1187646_subgroup H)
    (forward : q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier H) : Prop :=
  q1187646_relation_map_isomorphism
    G H A C
    (q1187646_quotient_equal G B)
    (q1187646_quotient_equal H D)
    forward.

Theorem QuotientGroup_quotientKerEquivRange :
  forall (G H : q1187646_group)
         (phi : q1187646_carrier G -> q1187646_carrier H),
    q1187646_group_homomorphism G H phi ->
    q1187646_quotient_map_isomorphism
      G H
      (q1187646_top_subgroup G)
      (q1187646_kernel phi)
      (q1187646_range phi)
      (q1187646_bottom_subgroup H)
      phi.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1187646
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1187646), "Fundamental theorem on
  homomorphisms": every group homomorphism canonically identifies the quotient
  by its kernel with its range as a group. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1187646_fundamental_theorem_on_homomorphisms
  imports Main
begin

definition q1187646_is_group_hom ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1187646_is_group_hom f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f 0 = 0 \<and> (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y)"

definition q1187646_hom_kernel ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add) \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1187646_hom_kernel f = {x. f x = 0}"

definition q1187646_hom_range ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add) \<Rightarrow> 'h set" where
  "q1187646_hom_range f = f ` UNIV"

definition q1187646_left_coset ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1187646_left_coset N g = (\<lambda>n. n + g) ` N"

definition q1187646_quotient_carrier ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q1187646_quotient_carrier N = q1187646_left_coset N ` UNIV"

definition q1187646_coset_add ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q1187646_coset_add X Y =
    {x + y |x y. x \<in> X \<and> y \<in> Y}"

theorem q1187646_quotientKerEquivRange:
  fixes phi :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h::group_add"
  assumes "q1187646_is_group_hom phi"
  shows "\<exists>F :: 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'h.
    bij_betw F
      (q1187646_quotient_carrier (q1187646_hom_kernel phi))
      (q1187646_hom_range phi) \<and>
    (\<forall>g.
      F (q1187646_left_coset (q1187646_hom_kernel phi) g) = phi g) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> q1187646_quotient_carrier (q1187646_hom_kernel phi).
      \<forall>Y \<in> q1187646_quotient_carrier (q1187646_hom_kernel phi).
        F (q1187646_coset_add X Y) = F X + F Y)"
  sorry

end

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1187646,
-- "Fundamental theorem on homomorphisms": for every group homomorphism, the
-- quotient of its domain by its kernel is canonically isomorphic to its range.
-- This file contains no proof.

module Q1187646_fundamental_theorem_on_homomorphisms where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data ⊤ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where
  tt : ⊤

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record GroupHom
  {a b : Level}
  {G : Set a}
  {H : Set b}
  (domain : Group G)
  (codomain : Group H) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : G → H
    map-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      map (Group.multiply domain x y) ≡
      Group.multiply codomain (map x) (map y)

record RestrictedMulEquiv
  {a b p q r s : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (domain-member : A → Set p)
  (codomain-member : B → Set q)
  (domain-related : A → A → Set r)
  (codomain-related : B → B → Set s)
  (domain-multiply : A → A → A)
  (codomain-multiply : B → B → B)
  (forward : A → B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ p ⊔ q ⊔ r ⊔ s) where

  field
    inverse :
      (y : B) →
      codomain-member y →
      A
    forward-closed :
      (x : A) →
      domain-member x →
      codomain-member (forward x)
    inverse-closed :
      (y : B) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      domain-member (inverse y hy)
    forward-congruent :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-member x →
      domain-member y →
      domain-related x y →
      codomain-related (forward x) (forward y)
    inverse-congruent :
      (x y : B) →
      (hx : codomain-member x) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      codomain-related x y →
      domain-related (inverse x hx) (inverse y hy)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-member x →
      domain-member y →
      codomain-related
        (forward (domain-multiply x y))
        (codomain-multiply (forward x) (forward y))
    inverse-forward :
      (x : A) →
      (hx : domain-member x) →
      domain-related
        (inverse (forward x) (forward-closed x hx))
        x
    forward-inverse :
      (y : B) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      codomain-related (forward (inverse y hy)) y

InRange :
  {a b : Level} →
  {G : Set a} →
  {H : Set b} →
  {domain : Group G} →
  {codomain : Group H} →
  GroupHom domain codomain →
  H →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
InRange {G = G} hom y =
  Σ G (λ x → GroupHom.map hom x ≡ y)

KernelQuotientRelated :
  {a b : Level} →
  {G : Set a} →
  {H : Set b} →
  {domain : Group G} →
  {codomain : Group H} →
  GroupHom domain codomain →
  G →
  G →
  Set b
KernelQuotientRelated {domain = domain} {codomain = codomain} hom x y =
  GroupHom.map hom
    (Group.multiply domain (Group.inverse domain x) y) ≡
  Group.identity codomain

-- Lean: QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange
fundamental-theorem-on-homomorphisms :
  (a b : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
fundamental-theorem-on-homomorphisms a b =
  {G : Set a} →
  {H : Set b} →
  (domain : Group G) →
  (codomain : Group H) →
  (hom : GroupHom domain codomain) →
  RestrictedMulEquiv
    G
    H
    (λ _ → ⊤ {a})
    (InRange hom)
    (KernelQuotientRelated hom)
    _≡_
    (Group.multiply domain)
    (Group.multiply codomain)
    (GroupHom.map hom)

      Group g /\
      Group h /\
