            dom S = dom M
            /\
            (
              ( Q1191319MutuallySingular S N )
              /\
              A. A e. dom M
                ( M ` A )
                =
                (
                  ( S ` A )
                  +e
                  ( Q1191319WithDensityValue N F A )
                )
            )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M N $.

  q1191319-have-decomposition-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1191319HaveDecomposition M N )
    <->
    E. F ( Q1191319RNDerivative M N F )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F M N $.

  q1191319-rn-with-density-eq-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1191319RNWithDensityEq M N )
    <->
    E. F
      (
        ( Q1191319RNDerivative M N F )
        /\
        A. A e. dom M
          ( Q1191319WithDensityValue N F A )
          =
          ( M ` A )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F G H M N S r x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q1191319-radon-nikodym $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. N e. U. ran measures
        (
          ( Q1191319HaveDecomposition M N )
          ->
          (
            ( Q1191319AbsolutelyContinuous M N )
            <->
            ( Q1191319RNWithDensityEq M N )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q1191319_radon_nikodym_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1191319,
:: "Radon–Nikodym theorem": when a Lebesgue decomposition exists, absolute
:: continuity is equivalent to recovery by the density component of every such
:: decomposition. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, SUBSET_1, MESFUNC5,
      PARTFUN1, XXREAL_0, RELAT_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL2,
      CARD_1, COMPLEX1, TARSKI, REAL_1, PBOOLE, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2,
      VALUED_1, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_2, SETFAM_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
      XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, XXREAL_0, VALUED_0,
      RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, PROB_1, MEASURE1,
      EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, SETFAM_1;
 constructors REAL_1, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, RELSET_1,
      COMPLEX1, SETFAM_1;
 registrations SUBSET_1, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, ORDINAL1, PARTFUN1, MEASURE1,
      FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, FUNCT_1,
      VALUED_0, XXREAL_3, RELSET_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, MESFUNC5;
 equalities XBOOLE_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M,N being sigma_Measure of S
   st
     ex Sing being sigma_Measure of S st
       (ex Z being Element of S st
          Sing.Z = 0 & N.(X \ Z) = 0) &
       (for A being Element of S holds
          M.A = Sing.A + 0)
   holds
     ((for A being Element of S st N.A = 0 holds M.A = 0)
      iff
      for A being Element of S holds M.A = 0))
  &
  (for X being non empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       M,N being sigma_Measure of S
   st
     ex Sing being sigma_Measure of S,
       rn being Function of X,ExtREAL st
       (ex E being Element of S st
          E = X & rn is E-measurable) &
       (for x being Element of X holds 0 <= rn.x) &
       (ex Z being Element of S st
          Sing.Z = 0 & N.(X \ Z) = 0) &
       (for A being Element of S holds
          M.A = Sing.A + integral+(N,rn|A))
   holds
     ((for A being Element of S st N.A = 0 holds M.A = 0)
      iff
      for Sing being sigma_Measure of S,
          rn being Function of X,ExtREAL
      st
        (ex E being Element of S st
           E = X & rn is E-measurable) &
        (for x being Element of X holds 0 <= rn.x) &
        (ex Z being Element of S st
           Sing.Z = 0 & N.(X \ Z) = 0) &
        (for A being Element of S holds
           M.A = Sing.A + integral+(N,rn|A))
      holds
        for A being Element of S holds
          integral+(N,rn|A) = M.A))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1191319_radon_nikodym_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1191319,
% "Radon–Nikodym theorem": for measures admitting a Lebesgue decomposition,
% absolute continuity is equivalent to recovery by weighting the reference
% measure with the selected Radon–Nikodym derivative. This file contains no proof.

radon_nikodym_theorem_Q1191319[A: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): NOT E(omega)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): E(omega) AND F(omega)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES F(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  measure_equal(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      left, right: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES left(E) = right(E)

  measure_add(left, right: measure_map): measure_map =
    LAMBDA (E: event):
      measure_value_add(left(E), right(E))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  sublevel_event(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      NOT infinite_flag(function_value(omega))
        AND finite_part(function_value(omega)) <= bound

  measurable_nonnegative_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        0 <= bound IMPLIES
          Sigma(sublevel_event(function_value, bound)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
          function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: measure_value):
        has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))

  restricted_function(
      E: event,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF E(omega) THEN
        function_value(omega)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  with_density(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): measure_map =
    LAMBDA (E: event):
      IF Sigma(E) THEN
        lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M,
          Sigma,
          restricted_function(E, function_value))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  absolutely_continuous(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) AND measure_value_is_zero(N(E))
        IMPLIES measure_value_is_zero(M(E))

  mutually_singular(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (support: event):
      Sigma(support)
        AND measure_value_is_zero(
          M(event_complement(support)))
        AND measure_value_is_zero(N(support))

  decomposition_pair: TYPE =
    [# singular_component: measure_map,
       density_component: nonnegative_function #]

  is_lebesgue_decomposition(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      decomposition: decomposition_pair): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND is_measure(N, Sigma)
      AND is_measure(
        singular_component(decomposition), Sigma)
      AND measurable_nonnegative_function(
        Sigma, density_component(decomposition))
      AND mutually_singular(
        singular_component(decomposition), N, Sigma)
      AND measure_equal(
        Sigma,
        M,
        measure_add(
          singular_component(decomposition),
          with_density(
            N, Sigma, density_component(decomposition))))

  have_lebesgue_decomposition(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (decomposition: decomposition_pair):
      is_lebesgue_decomposition(
        M, N, Sigma, decomposition)

  zero_measure: measure_map =
    LAMBDA (E: event): zero_measure_value

  zero_nonnegative_function: nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): zero_measure_value

  zero_decomposition: decomposition_pair =
    (# singular_component := zero_measure,
       density_component := zero_nonnegative_function #)

  selected_lebesgue_decomposition(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): decomposition_pair =
    IF have_lebesgue_decomposition(M, N, Sigma) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (decomposition: decomposition_pair):
          is_lebesgue_decomposition(
            M, N, Sigma, decomposition))
    ELSE
      zero_decomposition
    ENDIF

  rn_deriv(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): nonnegative_function =
    density_component(
      selected_lebesgue_decomposition(M, N, Sigma))

  radon_nikodym_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (M, N: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      have_lebesgue_decomposition(M, N, Sigma)
        IMPLIES
          (absolutely_continuous(M, N, Sigma)
            IFF
          measure_equal(
            Sigma,
            with_density(
              N, Sigma, rn_deriv(M, N, Sigma)),
            M))
END radon_nikodym_theorem_Q1191319

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
