-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1191709
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1191709), "Egorov's theorem": on a measurable set
-- of finite measure, an almost-everywhere convergent family of strongly measurable
-- functions converges uniformly outside an arbitrarily small measurable subset.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.StronglyMeasurable.Basic

@[expose] public section

open MeasureTheory NNReal ENNReal Topology
open Set Filter TopologicalSpace

namespace Q1191709

variable {α β ι : Type*} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [PseudoEMetricSpace β] {μ : Measure α}
variable [SemilatticeSup ι] [Nonempty ι] [Countable ι]
  {f : ι → α → β} {g : α → β} {s : Set α}

/-- Egorov's theorem for strongly measurable functions on a finite-measure measurable set. -/
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_of_ae_tendsto (hf : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable (f n))
    (hg : StronglyMeasurable g) (hsm : MeasurableSet s) (hs : μ s ≠ ∞)
    (hfg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ s → Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t ⊆ s, MeasurableSet t ∧ μ t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop (s \ t) :=
  sorry

end Q1191709

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1191709
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1191709), "Egorov's theorem": on a measurable
  set of finite measure, an almost-everywhere convergent countable net of
  strongly measurable functions into an extended pseudometric space converges
  uniformly outside a measurable set of arbitrarily small measure. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1191709_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1191709_empty {A : Type} : q1191709_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1191709_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1191709_set A) : q1191709_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1191709_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q1191709_set A) : q1191709_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ ~ F x.

Definition q1191709_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1191709_set A) : q1191709_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1191709_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1191709_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1191709_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q1191709_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q1191709_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1191709_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1191709_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1191709_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1191709_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q1191709_ennreal : Type :=
| q1191709_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q1191709_ennreal
| q1191709_ennreal_infinity : q1191709_ennreal.

Arguments q1191709_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q1191709_ennreal_zero : q1191709_ennreal :=
  q1191709_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q1191709_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q1191709_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1191709_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1191709_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q1191709_ennreal_infinity,
    q1191709_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q1191709_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1191709_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1191709_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1191709_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q1191709_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q1191709_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q1191709_ennreal_infinity,
    q1191709_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q1191709_ennreal_infinity,
    q1191709_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1191709_ennreal_lt_real
    (x : q1191709_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q1191709_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q1191709_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q1191709_ennreal_le_real
    (x : q1191709_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q1191709_ennreal_finite value _ => value <= bound
  | q1191709_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q1191709_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1191709_ennreal) : q1191709_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1191709_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1191709_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1191709_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q1191709_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q1191709_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1191709_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q1191709_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1191709_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1191709_ennreal_add
        (q1191709_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1191709_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q1191709_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q1191709_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q1191709_ennreal,
      values value -> q1191709_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q1191709_ennreal,
      (forall value : q1191709_ennreal,
        values value -> q1191709_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q1191709_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q1191709_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1191709_ennreal)
    (sum : q1191709_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1191709_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q1191709_ennreal_eq value
          (q1191709_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q1191709_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1191709_measurable : q1191709_set A -> Prop;
  q1191709_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q1191709_set A,
      q1191709_same_set E F ->
      (q1191709_measurable E <-> q1191709_measurable F);
  q1191709_measurable_empty :
    q1191709_measurable q1191709_empty;
  q1191709_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q1191709_set A,
      q1191709_measurable E ->
      q1191709_measurable (q1191709_complement E);
  q1191709_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q1191709_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1191709_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1191709_measurable (q1191709_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q1191709_measurable {A} _ _.

Record q1191709_measure (A : Type)
    (m : q1191709_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q1191709_measure_value : q1191709_set A -> q1191709_ennreal;
  q1191709_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1191709_set A,
      q1191709_same_set E F ->
      q1191709_ennreal_eq
        (q1191709_measure_value E)
        (q1191709_measure_value F);
  q1191709_measure_empty :
    q1191709_ennreal_eq
      (q1191709_measure_value q1191709_empty)
      q1191709_ennreal_zero;
  q1191709_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q1191709_set A,
      q1191709_subset E F ->
      q1191709_ennreal_le
        (q1191709_measure_value E)
        (q1191709_measure_value F);
  q1191709_measure_trim :
    forall E : q1191709_set A,
      exists F : q1191709_set A,
        q1191709_measurable m F /\
        q1191709_subset E F /\
        q1191709_ennreal_eq
          (q1191709_measure_value F)
          (q1191709_measure_value E);
  q1191709_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1191709_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1191709_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q1191709_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1191709_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1191709_measure_value (E n))
        (q1191709_measure_value (q1191709_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q1191709_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Definition q1191709_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    {m : q1191709_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q1191709_measure m)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q1191709_set A,
    q1191709_measurable m null_set /\
    q1191709_ennreal_eq
      (q1191709_measure_value mu null_set)
      q1191709_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q1191709_countable_sup_index (I : Type) : Type := {
  q1191709_index_le : I -> I -> Prop;
  q1191709_index_le_refl :
    forall i : I, q1191709_index_le i i;
  q1191709_index_le_trans :
    forall i j k : I,
      q1191709_index_le i j ->
      q1191709_index_le j k ->
      q1191709_index_le i k;
  q1191709_index_le_antisymmetric :
    forall i j : I,
      q1191709_index_le i j ->
      q1191709_index_le j i ->
      i = j;
  q1191709_index_sup : I -> I -> I;
  q1191709_index_le_sup_left :
    forall i j : I,
      q1191709_index_le i (q1191709_index_sup i j);
  q1191709_index_le_sup_right :
    forall i j : I,
      q1191709_index_le j (q1191709_index_sup i j);
  q1191709_index_sup_le :
    forall i j k : I,
      q1191709_index_le i k ->
      q1191709_index_le j k ->
      q1191709_index_le (q1191709_index_sup i j) k;
  q1191709_index_inhabitant : I;
  q1191709_index_encode : I -> nat;
  q1191709_index_encode_injective :
    forall i j : I,
      q1191709_index_encode i = q1191709_index_encode j ->
      i = j
}.

Arguments q1191709_index_le {I} _ _ _.

Record q1191709_pseudo_emetric_space (B : Type) : Type := {
  q1191709_edist : B -> B -> q1191709_ennreal;
  q1191709_edist_self :
    forall x : B,
      q1191709_ennreal_eq
        (q1191709_edist x x) q1191709_ennreal_zero;
  q1191709_edist_comm :
    forall x y : B,
      q1191709_ennreal_eq
        (q1191709_edist x y) (q1191709_edist y x);
  q1191709_edist_triangle :
    forall x y z : B,
      q1191709_ennreal_le
        (q1191709_edist x z)
        (q1191709_ennreal_add
          (q1191709_edist x y) (q1191709_edist y z))
}.

Arguments q1191709_edist {B} _ _ _.

Definition q1191709_nat_sequence_converges {B : Type}
    (E : q1191709_pseudo_emetric_space B)
    (u : nat -> B) (limit : B) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1191709_ennreal_lt_real
          (q1191709_edist E (u n) limit) epsilon.

Definition q1191709_indexed_converges {I B : Type}
    (J : q1191709_countable_sup_index I)
    (E : q1191709_pseudo_emetric_space B)
    (u : I -> B) (limit : B) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : I,
      forall n : I,
        q1191709_index_le J N n ->
        q1191709_ennreal_lt_real
          (q1191709_edist E (u n) limit) epsilon.

Definition q1191709_measurable_simple {A B : Type}
    (m : q1191709_measurable_space A)
    (simple : A -> B) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (code : A -> nat),
    (forall x : A, (code x < k)%nat) /\
    (forall x y : A,
      code x = code y <-> simple x = simple y) /\
    forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q1191709_measurable m (fun x => code x = i).

Definition q1191709_strongly_measurable {A B : Type}
    (m : q1191709_measurable_space A)
    (E : q1191709_pseudo_emetric_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> B,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1191709_measurable_simple m (approximants n)) /\
    forall x : A,
      q1191709_nat_sequence_converges E
        (fun n => approximants n x) (f x).

Definition q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on {I A B : Type}
    (J : q1191709_countable_sup_index I)
    (E : q1191709_pseudo_emetric_space B)
    (f : I -> A -> B) (g : A -> B)
    (s : q1191709_set A) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : I,
      forall (n : I) (x : A),
        q1191709_index_le J N n ->
        s x ->
        q1191709_ennreal_lt_real
          (q1191709_edist E (f n x) (g x)) epsilon.

Theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_of_ae_tendsto :
  forall (Alpha Beta I : Type)
         (m : q1191709_measurable_space Alpha)
         (mu : q1191709_measure m)
         (J : q1191709_countable_sup_index I)
         (E : q1191709_pseudo_emetric_space Beta)
         (f : I -> Alpha -> Beta)
         (g : Alpha -> Beta)
         (s : q1191709_set Alpha)
         (epsilon : R),
    (forall n : I,
      q1191709_strongly_measurable m E (f n)) ->
    q1191709_strongly_measurable m E g ->
    q1191709_measurable m s ->
    ~ q1191709_ennreal_eq
        (q1191709_measure_value mu s)
        q1191709_ennreal_infinity ->
    q1191709_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        s x ->
        q1191709_indexed_converges J E
          (fun n => f n x) (g x)) ->
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists t : q1191709_set Alpha,
      q1191709_subset t s /\
      q1191709_measurable m t /\
      q1191709_ennreal_le_real
        (q1191709_measure_value mu t) epsilon /\
      q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on J E f g
        (q1191709_difference s t).
Admitted.

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1191709,
  "Egorov's theorem": an almost-everywhere convergent countable directed family
  of strongly measurable functions on a measurable set of finite measure
  converges uniformly outside a measurable subset of arbitrarily small measure.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
begin

definition q1191709_pseudo_emetric ::
    "('b \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1191709_pseudo_emetric edist \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. edist x x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. edist x y = edist y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. edist x z \<le> edist x y + edist y z)"

definition q1191709_tendsto_at_top ::
    "('b \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i::semilattice_sup \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1191709_tendsto_at_top edist u y \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>\<delta> :: real. 0 < \<delta> \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>j. \<forall>k \<ge> j. edist (u k) y < ennreal \<delta>))"

definition q1191709_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('b \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1191709_strongly_measurable M edist h \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (u n)) \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> space M.
        q1191709_tendsto_at_top edist (\<lambda>n. u n x) (h x)))"

definition q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on ::
    "('b \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i::semilattice_sup \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on edist f g A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>\<delta> :: real. 0 < \<delta> \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>j. \<forall>k \<ge> j. \<forall>x \<in> A.
        edist (f k x) (g x) < ennreal \<delta>))"

theorem egorov_s_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and edist :: "'b \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
    and f :: "'i::{semilattice_sup,countable} \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and g :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and s :: "'a set"
    and \<epsilon> :: real
  assumes pseudo_emetric:
      "q1191709_pseudo_emetric edist"
    and f_strongly_measurable:
      "\<And>n. q1191709_strongly_measurable M edist (f n)"
    and g_strongly_measurable:
      "q1191709_strongly_measurable M edist g"
    and s_measurable:
      "s \<in> sets M"
    and s_finite:
      "emeasure M s \<noteq> \<infinity>"
    and ae_tendsto:
      "AE x in M.
        x \<in> s \<longrightarrow>
          q1191709_tendsto_at_top edist (\<lambda>n. f n x) (g x)"
    and epsilon_pos:
      "0 < \<epsilon>"
  shows
      "\<exists>t \<subseteq> s.
        t \<in> sets M \<and>
        emeasure M t \<le> ennreal \<epsilon> \<and>
        q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on edist f g (s - t)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1191709,
  "Egorov's theorem": an almost-everywhere convergent countable directed family
  of strongly measurable functions on a measurable set of finite measure
  converges uniformly outside an arbitrarily small measurable subset. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1191709_EGOROV_S_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let elt =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        ~(FST x) /\ (FST y \/ SND x < SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                     (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (P:A->bool).
        ?N:A->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:A | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let pseudo_emetric_space =
      \(edist:B->B->bool#real).
        (!x y:B. enonnegative (edist x y)) /\
        (!x:B. edist x x = ezero) /\
        (!x y:B. edist x y = edist y x) /\
        (!x y z:B.
           ele (edist x z) (eadd (edist x y) (edist y z))) in
   let semilattice_sup =
      \(le:I->I->bool) (join:I->I->I).
        (!i:I. le i i) /\
        (!i j k:I. le i j /\ le j k ==> le i k) /\
        (!i j:I. le i j /\ le j i ==> i = j) /\
        (!i j:I. le i (join i j)) /\
        (!i j:I. le j (join i j)) /\
        (!i j k:I. le i k /\ le j k ==> le (join i j) k) in
   let countable_index =
      \(_le:I->I->bool).
        ?code:I->num.
          !i j:I. code i = code j ==> i = j in
   let emetric_tends =
      \(edist:B->B->bool#real) (u:num->B) (l:B).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?N:num.
                !n:num.
                  N <= n ==> elt (edist (u n) l) (F,e) in
   let simple_function =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->B).
        FINITE (IMAGE h (:A)) /\
        (!b:B. events {x:A | h x = b}) in
   let strongly_measurable =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (edist:B->B->bool#real) (h:A->B).
        ?simple:num->A->B.
          (!n:num. simple_function events (simple n)) /\
          (!x:A.
             emetric_tends edist
               (\n:num. simple n x) (h x)) in
   let index_tends =
      \(le:I->I->bool) (edist:B->B->bool#real)
       (u:I->B) (l:B).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?j:I.
                !i:I.
                  le j i ==> elt (edist (u i) l) (F,e) in
   let tends_uniformly_on =
      \(le:I->I->bool) (edist:B->B->bool#real)
       (f:I->A->B) (g:A->B) (u:A->bool).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?j:I.
                !i:I x:A.
                  le j i /\ x IN u
                  ==> elt (edist (f i x) (g x)) (F,e) in
   !events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    edist:B->B->bool#real
    le:I->I->bool
    join:I->I->I
    f:I->A->B
    g:A->B
    s:A->bool
    epsilon:real.
      measure_space events mu /\
      pseudo_emetric_space edist /\
      semilattice_sup le join /\
      countable_index le /\
      (!i:I. strongly_measurable events edist (f i)) /\
      strongly_measurable events edist g /\
      events s /\
      ~(FST (mu s)) /\
      almost_everywhere events mu
        (\x:A.
           x IN s
           ==> index_tends le edist
                 (\i:I. f i x) (g x)) /\
      &0 < epsilon
      ==>
      ?t:A->bool.
        t SUBSET s /\
        events t /\
        ele (mu t) (F,epsilon) /\
        tends_uniformly_on le edist f g (s DIFF t)`;;

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1191709,
;; "Egorov's theorem": strongly measurable functions that converge almost
;; everywhere on a measurable finite-measure set converge uniformly outside
;; an arbitrarily small measurable subset. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative application interfaces present arbitrary carriers, sets, and
;; functions without finite tables or APPLY$ tameness restrictions.  All
;; structure laws are explicit hypotheses below.  A Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field presents the reals; finite values over its nonnegative cone together
;; with a top element present the extended nonnegative reals.  DEFUN-SK keeps
;; every quantified cutoff, null set, simple-function approximation, and
;; exceptional set internal.

(defstub q1191709-apply1 (function x) t)

(defstub q1191709-apply2 (function x y) t)

(defun q1191709-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (q1191709-apply1 carrier x) t nil))

;; A presentation of the real field.

(defun-sk q1191709-real-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (q1191709-member-p carrier x)
          (q1191709-member-p carrier y)
          (q1191709-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q1191709-apply2 add x y))
            (yz-add (q1191709-apply2 add y z))
            (xy-multiply (q1191709-apply2 multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (q1191709-apply2 multiply y z))
            (negative-x (q1191709-apply1 negate x))
            (inverse-x (q1191709-apply1 inverse x)))
       (and
        (q1191709-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q1191709-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (q1191709-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (q1191709-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal (q1191709-apply2 add xy-add z)
               (q1191709-apply2 add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1191709-apply2 add y x))
        (equal (q1191709-apply2 add x zero) x)
        (equal (q1191709-apply2 add x negative-x) zero)
        (equal (q1191709-apply2 multiply xy-multiply z)
               (q1191709-apply2 multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal xy-multiply (q1191709-apply2 multiply y x))
        (equal (q1191709-apply2 multiply x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (q1191709-apply2 multiply x inverse-x) one))
        (equal
         (q1191709-apply2 multiply x yz-add)
         (q1191709-apply2
          add
          (q1191709-apply2 multiply x y)
          (q1191709-apply2 multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (q1191709-member-p carrier x)
          (q1191709-member-p carrier y)
          (q1191709-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q1191709-apply2 less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (q1191709-apply2 less x y)
          (q1191709-apply2 less y x))
      (implies
       (and (q1191709-apply2 less x y)
            (q1191709-apply2 less y z))
       (q1191709-apply2 less x z))
      (implies
       (q1191709-apply2 less x y)
       (q1191709-apply2
        less
        (q1191709-apply2 add x z)
        (q1191709-apply2 add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (q1191709-apply2 less zero x)
            (q1191709-apply2 less zero y))
       (q1191709-apply2
        less zero (q1191709-apply2 multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-set-valid-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-apply1 set x)
     (q1191709-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (q1191709-member-p carrier x)
         (q1191709-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (q1191709-member-p carrier x)
          (q1191709-apply1 set x))
     (not (q1191709-apply2 less bound x)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1191709-member-p carrier bound)
     (q1191709-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1191709-member-p carrier supremum)
     (q1191709-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-member-p carrier bound)
       (q1191709-real-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not (q1191709-apply2 less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1191709-real-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1191709-real-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-real-set-valid-p carrier set)
      (q1191709-real-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q1191709-real-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (q1191709-real-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q1191709-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (q1191709-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1191709-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1191709-real-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1191709-real-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (q1191709-apply2 less zero one)
   (q1191709-real-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun q1191709-real-leq (less left right)
  (not (q1191709-apply2 less right left)))

;; Canonical extended nonnegative reals over the presented real field.

(defun q1191709-ennreal-finite (value)
  (list :q1191709-finite value))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-top ()
  :q1191709-top)

(defun q1191709-ennreal-zero (real-zero)
  (q1191709-ennreal-finite real-zero))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-finite-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (equal (car value) :q1191709-finite)
   (q1191709-member-p real-carrier (cadr value))
   (q1191709-real-leq real-less real-zero (cadr value))))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (or
   (equal value (q1191709-ennreal-top))
   (q1191709-ennreal-finite-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less value)))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-leq
    (real-less left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right (q1191709-ennreal-top)) t)
   ((equal left (q1191709-ennreal-top)) nil)
   (t (q1191709-real-leq
       real-less (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-less
    (real-less left right)
  (and
   (q1191709-ennreal-leq real-less left right)
   (not (equal left right))))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-add
    (real-add left right)
  (if (or (equal left (q1191709-ennreal-top))
          (equal right (q1191709-ennreal-top)))
      (q1191709-ennreal-top)
    (q1191709-ennreal-finite
     (q1191709-apply2 real-add (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q1191709-ennreal-of-real
    (real-zero real-less value)
  (if (q1191709-apply2 real-less value real-zero)
      (q1191709-ennreal-zero real-zero)
    (q1191709-ennreal-finite value)))

(defun q1191709-positive-ennreal-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (and
   (q1191709-ennreal-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
   (q1191709-ennreal-less
    real-less (q1191709-ennreal-zero real-zero) value)))

;; Countable nonempty semilattice-sup index presentations.

(defun-sk q1191709-index-laws-p
    (carrier less-equal supremum)
  (forall (i j k)
    (implies
     (and (q1191709-member-p carrier i)
          (q1191709-member-p carrier j)
          (q1191709-member-p carrier k))
     (let ((ij (q1191709-apply2 supremum i j)))
       (and
        (q1191709-member-p carrier ij)
        (q1191709-apply2 less-equal i i)
        (implies
         (and (q1191709-apply2 less-equal i j)
              (q1191709-apply2 less-equal j k))
         (q1191709-apply2 less-equal i k))
        (implies
         (and (q1191709-apply2 less-equal i j)
              (q1191709-apply2 less-equal j i))
         (equal i j))
        (q1191709-apply2 less-equal i ij)
        (q1191709-apply2 less-equal j ij)
        (implies
         (and (q1191709-apply2 less-equal i k)
              (q1191709-apply2 less-equal j k))
         (q1191709-apply2 less-equal ij k)))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-index-nonempty-p (carrier)
  (exists (i)
    (q1191709-member-p carrier i)))

(defun-sk q1191709-index-enumeration-witness-exists-p
    (enumeration i)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (equal (q1191709-apply1 enumeration n) i))))

(defun-sk q1191709-index-enumeration-covers-p
    (carrier enumeration)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p carrier i)
     (q1191709-index-enumeration-witness-exists-p
      enumeration i))))

(defun-sk q1191709-index-enumeration-values-p
    (carrier enumeration)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1191709-member-p
      carrier (q1191709-apply1 enumeration n)))))

(defun q1191709-countable-semilattice-sup-p
    (carrier less-equal supremum enumeration)
  (and
   (q1191709-index-laws-p carrier less-equal supremum)
   (q1191709-index-nonempty-p carrier)
   (q1191709-index-enumeration-values-p carrier enumeration)
   (q1191709-index-enumeration-covers-p carrier enumeration)))

;; Arbitrary subsets of the point carrier and a sigma algebra on them.

(defun-sk q1191709-set-p (point-carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-apply1 set x)
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x))))

(defun-sk q1191709-set-equivalent-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff (q1191709-apply1 left x)
          (q1191709-apply1 right x)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-subset-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q1191709-apply1 left x))
     (q1191709-apply1 right x))))

(defun-sk q1191709-empty-set-p
    (point-carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
     (not (q1191709-apply1 set x)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-complement-of-p
    (point-carrier set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1191709-apply1 complement x)
      (not (q1191709-apply1 set x))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-family-values-are-sets-p
    (point-carrier family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1191709-set-p
      point-carrier (q1191709-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-family-member-exists-p
    (family x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1191709-apply1
      (q1191709-apply1 family n) x))))

(defun-sk q1191709-union-of-family-p
    (point-carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1191709-apply1 union x)
      (q1191709-family-member-exists-p family x)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-family-measurable-p
    (measurable-set-p family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1191709-apply1
      measurable-set-p (q1191709-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measurable-set-extensional-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-set-p point-carrier left)
      (q1191709-set-p point-carrier right)
      (q1191709-set-equivalent-p
       point-carrier left right)
      (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p left))
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p right))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measurable-empty-set-exists-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q1191709-set-p point-carrier empty)
     (q1191709-empty-set-p point-carrier empty)
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p empty))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q1191709-set-p point-carrier complement)
     (q1191709-complement-of-p
      point-carrier set complement)
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p complement))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measurable-union-exists-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q1191709-set-p point-carrier union)
     (q1191709-union-of-family-p
      point-carrier family union)
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p union))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measurable-space-laws-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p)
  (forall (set family)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p set)
      (q1191709-set-p point-carrier set))
     (implies
      (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p set)
      (q1191709-measurable-complement-exists-p
       point-carrier measurable-set-p set))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-family-values-are-sets-p
        point-carrier family)
       (q1191709-family-measurable-p
        measurable-set-p family))
      (q1191709-measurable-union-exists-p
       point-carrier measurable-set-p family)))))

(defun q1191709-measurable-space-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p)
  (and
   (q1191709-measurable-set-extensional-p
    point-carrier measurable-set-p)
   (q1191709-measurable-empty-set-exists-p
    point-carrier measurable-set-p)
   (q1191709-measurable-space-laws-p
    point-carrier measurable-set-p)))

;; Measures are extensional, zero on empty sets, and countably additive on
;; disjoint measurable families.  Infinite sums are least upper bounds of
;; their finite partial sums in the canonical extended nonnegative reals.

(defun-sk q1191709-family-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (point-carrier family)
  (forall (m n x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n))
      (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x))
     (not
      (and
       (q1191709-apply1 (q1191709-apply1 family m) x)
       (q1191709-apply1 (q1191709-apply1 family n) x))))))

(defun q1191709-measure-partial-sum
    (real-zero real-add measure family count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q1191709-ennreal-zero real-zero)
    (q1191709-ennreal-add
     real-add
     (q1191709-measure-partial-sum
      real-zero real-add measure family (1- count))
     (q1191709-apply1
      measure (q1191709-apply1 family (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measure-series-upper-bound-p
    (real-zero real-add real-less measure family bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q1191709-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q1191709-measure-partial-sum
       real-zero real-add measure family count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measure-series-sum-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     measure family total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1191709-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less total)
     (q1191709-measure-series-upper-bound-p
      real-zero real-add real-less measure family total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-ennreal-p
        real-carrier real-zero real-less bound)
       (q1191709-measure-series-upper-bound-p
        real-zero real-add real-less measure family bound))
      (q1191709-ennreal-leq real-less total bound)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measure-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable-set-p measure)
  (forall (set left right family union)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1191709-set-p point-carrier set)
      (q1191709-ennreal-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       (q1191709-apply1 measure set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q1191709-set-p point-carrier right)
       (q1191709-set-equivalent-p
        point-carrier left right))
      (equal
       (q1191709-apply1 measure left)
       (q1191709-apply1 measure right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-set-p point-carrier set)
       (q1191709-empty-set-p point-carrier set))
      (equal
       (q1191709-apply1 measure set)
       (q1191709-ennreal-zero real-zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-family-values-are-sets-p
        point-carrier family)
       (q1191709-family-measurable-p
        measurable-set-p family)
       (q1191709-family-pairwise-disjoint-p
        point-carrier family)
       (q1191709-set-p point-carrier union)
       (q1191709-union-of-family-p
        point-carrier family union))
      (q1191709-measure-series-sum-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       measure family (q1191709-apply1 measure union))))))

(defun q1191709-measure-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable-set-p measure)
  (and
   (q1191709-measurable-space-p
    point-carrier measurable-set-p)
   (q1191709-measure-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    point-carrier measurable-set-p measure)))

;; The codomain is an arbitrary pseudo-emetric space.

(defun-sk q1191709-pseudo-emetric-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     value-carrier edistance)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-member-p value-carrier x)
      (q1191709-member-p value-carrier y)
      (q1191709-member-p value-carrier z))
     (let ((dxy (q1191709-apply2 edistance x y))
           (dyz (q1191709-apply2 edistance y z))
           (dxz (q1191709-apply2 edistance x z)))
       (and
        (q1191709-ennreal-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-less dxy)
        (q1191709-ennreal-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-less dyz)
        (q1191709-ennreal-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-less dxz)
        (equal
         (q1191709-apply2 edistance x x)
         (q1191709-ennreal-zero real-zero))
        (equal dxy (q1191709-apply2 edistance y x))
        (q1191709-ennreal-leq
         real-less dxz
         (q1191709-ennreal-add real-add dxy dyz)))))))

(defun q1191709-pseudo-emetric-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     value-carrier edistance)
  (q1191709-pseudo-emetric-laws-p
   real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
   value-carrier edistance))

;; Pointwise convergence along atTop of the arbitrary directed index order.

(defun-sk q1191709-pointwise-tail-p
    (real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
     point value sequence limit edistance radius cutoff)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-member-p index-carrier index)
      (q1191709-apply2 index-less-equal cutoff index))
     (q1191709-ennreal-less
      real-less
      (q1191709-apply2
       edistance
       (q1191709-apply2 sequence index point)
       (q1191709-apply1 limit point))
      radius))))

(defun-sk q1191709-pointwise-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
     point value sequence limit edistance radius)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (q1191709-member-p index-carrier cutoff)
     (q1191709-pointwise-tail-p
      real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
      point value sequence limit edistance radius cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1191709-pointwise-converges-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     index-carrier index-less-equal
     point value sequence limit edistance)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (q1191709-positive-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less radius)
     (q1191709-pointwise-cutoff-exists-p
      real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
      point value sequence limit edistance radius))))

;; Strong measurability is expressed by pointwise limits of measurable simple
;; functions.  Each simple function has an internally supplied finite range,
;; and each fiber is an internally supplied measurable set.

(defun q1191709-value-list-p (value-carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1191709-member-p value-carrier (car values))
       (q1191709-value-list-p value-carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q1191709-simple-values-p
    (point-carrier value-carrier approximation ranges n)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
     (and
      (q1191709-member-p
       value-carrier (q1191709-apply2 approximation n x))
      (member-equal
       (q1191709-apply2 approximation n x)
       (q1191709-apply1 ranges n))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-fiber-set-p
    (point-carrier approximation n value fiber)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1191709-apply1 fiber x)
      (equal
       (q1191709-apply2 approximation n x)
       value)))))

(defun-sk q1191709-measurable-fiber-exists-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p approximation n value)
  (exists (fiber)
    (and
     (q1191709-set-p point-carrier fiber)
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p fiber)
     (q1191709-fiber-set-p
      point-carrier approximation n value fiber))))

(defun q1191709-simple-fibers-measurable-p
    (point-carrier measurable-set-p approximation n values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1191709-measurable-fiber-exists-p
        point-carrier measurable-set-p
        approximation n (car values))
       (q1191709-simple-fibers-measurable-p
        point-carrier measurable-set-p
        approximation n (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q1191709-simple-approximations-p
    (point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
     approximation ranges)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (let ((values (q1191709-apply1 ranges n)))
       (and
        (true-listp values)
        (q1191709-value-list-p value-carrier values)
        (q1191709-simple-values-p
         point-carrier value-carrier
         approximation ranges n)
        (q1191709-simple-fibers-measurable-p
         point-carrier measurable-set-p
         approximation n values))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-natural-tail-p
    (real-less point target approximation edistance radius cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (<= cutoff n))
     (q1191709-ennreal-less
      real-less
      (q1191709-apply2
       edistance
       (q1191709-apply2 approximation n point)
       target)
      radius))))

(defun-sk q1191709-natural-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-less point target approximation edistance radius)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1191709-natural-tail-p
      real-less point target approximation
      edistance radius cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1191709-natural-converges-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point target approximation edistance)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (q1191709-positive-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less radius)
     (q1191709-natural-cutoff-exists-p
      real-less point target approximation
      edistance radius))))

(defun-sk q1191709-approximation-converges-to-function-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier function approximation edistance)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier point)
     (q1191709-natural-converges-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point (q1191709-apply1 function point)
      approximation edistance))))

(defun-sk q1191709-strongly-measurable-function-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
     function edistance)
  (exists (approximation ranges)
    (and
     (q1191709-simple-approximations-p
      point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
      approximation ranges)
     (q1191709-approximation-converges-to-function-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier function approximation edistance))))

(defun-sk q1191709-approximation-converges-to-section-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier index sequence approximation edistance)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p point-carrier point)
     (q1191709-natural-converges-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point (q1191709-apply2 sequence index point)
      approximation edistance))))

(defun-sk q1191709-strongly-measurable-section-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
     sequence index edistance)
  (exists (approximation ranges)
    (and
     (q1191709-simple-approximations-p
      point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
      approximation ranges)
     (q1191709-approximation-converges-to-section-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier index sequence approximation edistance))))

(defun-sk q1191709-all-sections-strongly-measurable-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
     index-carrier sequence edistance)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1191709-member-p index-carrier index)
     (q1191709-strongly-measurable-section-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
      sequence index edistance))))

;; Function typing, almost-everywhere convergence, and uniform convergence.

(defun-sk q1191709-function-types-p
    (index-carrier point-carrier value-carrier sequence limit)
  (forall (index point)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1191709-member-p index-carrier index)
       (q1191709-member-p point-carrier point))
      (q1191709-member-p
       value-carrier (q1191709-apply2 sequence index point)))
     (implies
      (q1191709-member-p point-carrier point)
      (q1191709-member-p
       value-carrier (q1191709-apply1 limit point))))))

(defun-sk q1191709-converges-outside-null-set-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
     set exceptional sequence limit edistance)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-member-p point-carrier point)
      (not (q1191709-apply1 exceptional point))
      (q1191709-apply1 set point))
     (q1191709-pointwise-converges-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      index-carrier index-less-equal
      point nil sequence limit edistance))))

(defun-sk q1191709-null-set-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
     measurable-set-p measure set sequence limit edistance)
  (exists (exceptional)
    (and
     (q1191709-set-p point-carrier exceptional)
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p exceptional)
     (equal
      (q1191709-apply1 measure exceptional)
      (q1191709-ennreal-zero real-zero))
     (q1191709-converges-outside-null-set-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
      set exceptional sequence limit edistance))))

(defun-sk q1191709-uniform-tail-p
    (real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
     point-carrier set exceptional
     sequence limit edistance radius cutoff)
  (forall (index point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-member-p index-carrier index)
      (q1191709-apply2 index-less-equal cutoff index)
      (q1191709-member-p point-carrier point)
      (q1191709-apply1 set point)
      (not (q1191709-apply1 exceptional point)))
     (q1191709-ennreal-less
      real-less
      (q1191709-apply2
       edistance
       (q1191709-apply2 sequence index point)
       (q1191709-apply1 limit point))
      radius))))

(defun-sk q1191709-uniform-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
     point-carrier set exceptional
     sequence limit edistance radius)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (q1191709-member-p index-carrier cutoff)
     (q1191709-uniform-tail-p
      real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
      point-carrier set exceptional
      sequence limit edistance radius cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1191709-uniformly-converges-off-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
     set exceptional sequence limit edistance)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (q1191709-positive-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less radius)
     (q1191709-uniform-cutoff-exists-p
      real-less index-carrier index-less-equal
      point-carrier set exceptional
      sequence limit edistance radius))))

(defun-sk q1191709-exceptional-set-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
     measurable-set-p measure set sequence limit edistance epsilon)
  (exists (exceptional)
    (and
     (q1191709-set-p point-carrier exceptional)
     (q1191709-subset-p point-carrier exceptional set)
     (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p exceptional)
     (q1191709-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q1191709-apply1 measure exceptional)
      (q1191709-ennreal-of-real
       real-zero real-less epsilon))
     (q1191709-uniformly-converges-off-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
      set exceptional sequence limit edistance))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1191709-egorov-s-theorem-statement ()
  (forall
      (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less
       index-carrier index-less-equal index-supremum index-enumeration
       point-carrier measurable-set-p measure
       value-carrier edistance sequence limit set epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1191709-real-field-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less)
      (q1191709-countable-semilattice-sup-p
       index-carrier index-less-equal
       index-supremum index-enumeration)
      (q1191709-measure-space-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       point-carrier measurable-set-p measure)
      (q1191709-pseudo-emetric-space-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       value-carrier edistance)
      (q1191709-set-p point-carrier set)
      (q1191709-function-types-p
       index-carrier point-carrier value-carrier sequence limit)
      (q1191709-all-sections-strongly-measurable-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
       index-carrier sequence edistance)
      (q1191709-strongly-measurable-function-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier value-carrier measurable-set-p
       limit edistance)
      (q1191709-apply1 measurable-set-p set)
      (not
       (equal
        (q1191709-apply1 measure set)
        (q1191709-ennreal-top)))
      (q1191709-null-set-exists-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
       measurable-set-p measure set sequence limit edistance)
      (q1191709-member-p real-carrier epsilon)
      (q1191709-apply2 real-less real-zero epsilon))
     (q1191709-exceptional-set-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      index-carrier index-less-equal point-carrier
      measurable-set-p measure set sequence limit edistance epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1191709,
-- "Egorov's theorem": almost-everywhere convergence of strongly measurable
-- functions on a measurable finite-measure set is uniform outside an
-- arbitrarily small measurable subset. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record BothL
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor bothL
  field
    firstL  : A
    secondL : B

record ExistsL
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor witnessL
  field
    valueL    : A
    propertyL : P valueL

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    add-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (addR x y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLessR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLessR reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

PositiveR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
PositiveR reals x =
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) x

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

difference :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
difference S T x =
  Both (S x) (Not (T x))

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A -> Set
    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

data CanonicalENNReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  finite-ennreal :
    NonnegativeReal reals ->
    CanonicalENNReal reals
  infinity-ennreal :
    CanonicalENNReal reals

CanonicalENNRealLe :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  Set
CanonicalENNRealLe {reals = reals}
  (finite-ennreal x) (finite-ennreal y) =
  lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y)
CanonicalENNRealLe (finite-ennreal x) infinity-ennreal =
  Top
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal (finite-ennreal y) =
  Bottom
CanonicalENNRealLe infinity-ennreal infinity-ennreal =
  Top

CanonicalENNRealAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals ->
  CanonicalENNReal reals
CanonicalENNRealAdd {reals = reals}
  (finite-ennreal x) (finite-ennreal y) =
  finite-ennreal
    (nonnegative-real
      (addR reals (realValue x) (realValue y))
      (add-nonnegativeR reals
        (realValue x)
        (realValue y)
        (realValue-nonnegative x)
        (realValue-nonnegative y)))
CanonicalENNRealAdd (finite-ennreal x) infinity-ennreal =
  infinity-ennreal
CanonicalENNRealAdd infinity-ennreal (finite-ennreal y) =
  infinity-ennreal
CanonicalENNRealAdd infinity-ennreal infinity-ennreal =
  infinity-ennreal

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroM infinityM :
      M
    addM :
      M -> M -> M
    lessOrEqualM :
      M -> M -> Set
    finiteM :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      M

    zero-leastM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatestM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    infinity-not-zeroM :
      infinityM != zeroM
    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x
    add-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x infinityM == infinityM
    add-monotoneM :
      (w x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM w x ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM w y) (addM x z)

    finite-zeroM :
      finiteM
        (zeroR reals)
        (order-reflexiveR reals (zeroR reals)) ==
      zeroM
    finite-orderM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy))
        (lessOrEqualR reals x y)
    finite-addM :
      (x y : R) ->
      (hx : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) ->
      (hy : lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) y) ->
      addM (finiteM x hx) (finiteM y hy) ==
      finiteM
        (addR reals x y)
        (add-nonnegativeR reals x y hx hy)
    finite-or-infinityM :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists R
          (\ value ->
            Exists
              (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
              (\ nonnegative ->
                x == finiteM value nonnegative)))

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

record ENNRealPresentation
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set1 where
  field
    toCanonicalENNReal :
      M -> CanonicalENNReal reals
    fromCanonicalENNReal :
      CanonicalENNReal reals -> M
    to-after-fromENNReal :
      (x : CanonicalENNReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (fromCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    from-after-toENNReal :
      (x : M) ->
      fromCanonicalENNReal (toCanonicalENNReal x) == x
    zero-correspondenceENNReal :
      toCanonicalENNReal (zeroM extended) ==
      finite-ennreal
        (nonnegative-real
          (zeroR reals)
          (order-reflexiveR reals (zeroR reals)))
    finite-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal
        (finiteM extended
          (realValue x)
          (realValue-nonnegative x)) ==
      finite-ennreal x
    infinity-correspondenceENNReal :
      toCanonicalENNReal (infinityM extended) == infinity-ennreal
    order-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x y : M) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
        (CanonicalENNRealLe
          (toCanonicalENNReal x)
          (toCanonicalENNReal y))
    add-correspondenceENNReal :
      (x y : M) ->
      toCanonicalENNReal (addM extended x y) ==
      CanonicalENNRealAdd
        (toCanonicalENNReal x)
        (toCanonicalENNReal y)

sumFirstM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
sumFirstM extended terms zero =
  zeroM extended
sumFirstM extended terms (suc n) =
  addM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) (terms n)

CountableSum :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set
CountableSum extended terms value =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) value)
    ((upper : _) ->
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualM extended (sumFirstM extended terms n) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended value upper)

record Measure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    outerMass :
      Predicate A -> M
    outer-mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      outerMass S == outerMass T
    outer-mass-empty :
      outerMass emptySet == zeroM extended
    outer-mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (outerMass S) (outerMass T)
    outer-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sumValue : M) ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        sumValue ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))
        sumValue
    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass T ==
      addM extended
        (outerMass (intersection T S))
        (outerMass (intersection T (complement S)))
    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (sets n))
        (outerMass (countableUnion sets))

open Measure

AlmostEverywhere :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhere {extended = extended} measure property =
  outerMass measure (\ x -> Not (property x)) == zeroM extended

record SimpleFunction
  {A V : Set}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    function :
      A -> V
    cutoff :
      Nat
    values :
      Nat -> V
    pieces :
      Nat -> Predicate A
    pieces-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      measurable events (pieces i)
    pieces-disjoint :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      j <=N cutoff ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      pieces j x ->
      Bottom
    pieces-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ i ->
          Both (i <=N cutoff) (pieces i x))
    represented-on-pieces :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N cutoff ->
      (x : A) ->
      pieces i x ->
      function x == values i

open SimpleFunction

record PseudoEMetricSpace
  {R M : Set}
  (E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set1 where
  field
    edistance :
      E -> E -> M
    edistance-self :
      (x : E) ->
      edistance x x == zeroM extended
    edistance-symmetric :
      (x y : E) ->
      edistance x y == edistance y x
    edistance-triangle :
      (x y z : E) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (edistance x z)
        (addM extended (edistance x y) (edistance y z))

open PseudoEMetricSpace

StrictLessM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set
StrictLessM extended x y =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
    (x != y)

TendstoNat :
  {R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  PseudoEMetricSpace E reals extended ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
TendstoNat {R = R} {reals = reals} {extended = extended}
  space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  (epsilon-positive : PositiveR reals epsilon) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLessM extended
        (edistance space (sequence n) limit)
        (finiteM extended epsilon (Both.first epsilon-positive)))

record StronglyMeasurable
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (space : PseudoEMetricSpace E reals extended)
  (f : A -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    approximants :
      Nat -> SimpleFunction {V = E} events
    approximates :
      (x : A) ->
      TendstoNat space
        (\ n -> function (approximants n) x)
        (f x)

record SemilatticeSup (I : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    leI :
      I -> I -> Set
    supI :
      I -> I -> I
    order-reflexiveI :
      (i : I) ->
      leI i i
    order-transitiveI :
      (i j k : I) ->
      leI i j ->
      leI j k ->
      leI i k
    order-antisymmetricI :
      (i j : I) ->
      leI i j ->
      leI j i ->
      i == j
    le-sup-leftI :
      (i j : I) ->
      leI i (supI i j)
    le-sup-rightI :
      (i j : I) ->
      leI j (supI i j)
    sup-leastI :
      (i j k : I) ->
      leI i k ->
      leI j k ->
      leI (supI i j) k

open SemilatticeSup

record Countable (I : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    code :
      I -> Nat
    code-injective :
      (i j : I) ->
      code i == code j ->
      i == j

TendstoAtTop :
  {I R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  SemilatticeSup I ->
  PseudoEMetricSpace E reals extended ->
  (I -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
TendstoAtTop {I = I} {R = R}
  {reals = reals} {extended = extended}
  index space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  (epsilon-positive : PositiveR reals epsilon) ->
  Exists I
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i : I) ->
      leI index cutoff i ->
      StrictLessM extended
        (edistance space (sequence i) limit)
        (finiteM extended epsilon (Both.first epsilon-positive)))

TendstoUniformlyOn :
  {A I R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  SemilatticeSup I ->
  PseudoEMetricSpace E reals extended ->
  (I -> A -> E) ->
  (A -> E) ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
TendstoUniformlyOn {A = A} {I = I} {R = R}
  {reals = reals} {extended = extended}
  index space functions limit S =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  (epsilon-positive : PositiveR reals epsilon) ->
  Exists I
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i : I) ->
      leI index cutoff i ->
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      StrictLessM extended
        (edistance space (functions i x) (limit x))
        (finiteM extended epsilon (Both.first epsilon-positive)))

egorov-s-theorem : Set2
egorov-s-theorem =
  (A I R M E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (space : PseudoEMetricSpace E reals extended) ->
  (index : SemilatticeSup I) ->
  I ->
  Countable I ->
  (functions : I -> A -> E) ->
  (limit : A -> E) ->
  ((i : I) -> StronglyMeasurable reals events space (functions i)) ->
  StronglyMeasurable reals events space limit ->
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  measurable events S ->
  outerMass measure S != infinityM extended ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      S x ->
      TendstoAtTop index space
        (\ i -> functions i x)
        (limit x)) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  (epsilon-positive : PositiveR reals epsilon) ->
  ExistsL (Predicate A)
    (\ T ->
      BothL
        (Subset T S)
        (BothL
          (measurable events T)
          (BothL
            (lessOrEqualM extended
              (outerMass measure T)
              (finiteM extended epsilon (Both.first epsilon-positive)))
            (TendstoUniformlyOn index space functions limit
              (difference S T)))))

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1191709 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1191709), "Egorov's theorem":
  almost-everywhere convergence of strongly measurable functions on a
  measurable set of finite measure is uniform outside a measurable subset
  of arbitrarily small measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open measureTheory;

val q1191709_semilattice_sup_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_semilattice_sup_def",
  ``q1191709_semilattice_sup
      (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool) (join : 'i -> 'i -> 'i) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x (join x y)) /\
      (!x y. leq y (join x y)) /\
      (!x y z. leq x z /\ leq y z ==> leq (join x y) z)``);

val q1191709_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_countable_def",
  ``q1191709_countable (carrier : 'i set) <=>
      ?encode : 'i -> num.
        INJ encode carrier (UNIV : num set)``);

val q1191709_pseudo_emetric_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_pseudo_emetric_def",
  ``q1191709_pseudo_emetric (edist : 'b -> 'b -> extreal) <=>
      (!x. edist x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. 0 <= edist x y) /\
      (!x y. edist x y = edist y x) /\
      (!x y z. edist x z <= edist x y + edist y z)``);

val q1191709_tendsto_sequence_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_tendsto_sequence_def",
  ``q1191709_tendsto_sequence
      (edist : 'b -> 'b -> extreal)
      (u : num -> 'b) (ell : 'b) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !n. N <= n ==> edist (u n) ell < Normal epsilon``);

val q1191709_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q1191709_measurable_simple
      (m : 'a m_space) (u : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE u UNIV) /\
      !y : 'b. {x | u x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q1191709_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q1191709_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space) (edist : 'b -> 'b -> extreal)
      (h : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      ?u : num -> 'a -> 'b.
        (!n. q1191709_measurable_simple m (u n)) /\
        !x. q1191709_tendsto_sequence edist (\n. u n x) (h x)``);

val q1191709_tendsto_at_top_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_tendsto_at_top_def",
  ``q1191709_tendsto_at_top
      (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool) (edist : 'b -> 'b -> extreal)
      (u : 'i -> 'b) (ell : 'b) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?i0. !i. leq i0 i ==> edist (u i) ell < Normal epsilon``);

val q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on_def",
  ``q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on
      (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool) (edist : 'b -> 'b -> extreal)
      (f : 'i -> 'a -> 'b) (g : 'a -> 'b) (u : 'a set) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?i0. !i x.
          leq i0 i /\ x IN u ==>
          edist (f i x) (g x) < Normal epsilon``);

val tendstoUniformlyOn_of_ae_tendsto =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space)
      (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool) (join : 'i -> 'i -> 'i)
      (edist : 'b -> 'b -> extreal)
      (f : 'i -> 'a -> 'b) (g : 'a -> 'b)
      (s : 'a set) (epsilon : real).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q1191709_semilattice_sup leq join /\
      q1191709_countable (UNIV : 'i set) /\
      q1191709_pseudo_emetric edist /\
      (!i. q1191709_strongly_measurable m edist (f i)) /\
      q1191709_strongly_measurable m edist g /\
      s IN measurable_sets m /\
      measure m s <> PosInf /\
      (AE x::m.
        x IN s ==>
        q1191709_tendsto_at_top leq edist (\i. f i x) (g x)) /\
      0 < epsilon
      ==>
      ?t : 'a set.
        t SUBSET s /\
        t IN measurable_sets m /\
        measure m t <= Normal epsilon /\
        q1191709_tendsto_uniformly_on
          leq edist f g (s DIFF t)``;

title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1191709
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1191709), "Egorov's theorem": an almost
  everywhere convergent family of strongly measurable functions on a
  measurable set of finite measure converges uniformly outside a measurable
  subset of arbitrarily small measure. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1191709SemilatticeSup says that R is a partial order on the nonempty set I
  and U chooses the binary least upper bound. The separate cardinal comparison
  I ~<_ NN0 is SetMM's assertion that I is countable.

  D e. ( PsMet ` B ) is SetMM's native extended nonnegative pseudometric on
  the arbitrary carrier B; distinct points may have distance zero and distance
  may be +oo. Its induced topology is
  unifTop ` ( metUnif ` D ).

  Q1191709StronglyMeasurable uses the defining characterization by pointwise
  limits of finite-range simple functions whose singleton fibers are
  measurable. Q1191709AEConverges expands convergence along the at-top filter
  outside a measurable null set, and Q1191709UniformlyOn expands uniform
  convergence along that same filter. Positive real radii give the usual
  convergence criterion for an extended pseudometric.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1191709SemilatticeSup Q1191709StronglyMeasurable
   Q1191709AEConverges Q1191709UniformlyOn $.

q1191709-semilattice-sup-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1191709SemilatticeSup I R U ) $.
q1191709-strongly-measurable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1191709StronglyMeasurable M B D H ) $.
q1191709-ae-converges-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1191709AEConverges M B D I R F G S ) $.
q1191709-uniformly-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1191709UniformlyOn B D I R F G S ) $.

${
  $d I R U x y z $.

  q1191709-semilattice-sup-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1191709SemilatticeSup I R U )
    <->
    (
      I =/= (/)
      /\
      (
        R C_ ( I X. I )
        /\
        (
          U : ( I X. I ) --> I
          /\
          (
            A. x e. I <. x , x >. e. R
            /\
