title: Q1191709_egorov_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1191709,
% "Egorov's theorem": strongly measurable functions converging almost everywhere on a
% measurable set of finite measure converge uniformly outside a measurable subset of
% arbitrarily small measure. This file contains no proof.

egorov_s_theorem_Q1191709[
  A: TYPE,
  B: TYPE,
  I: TYPE+
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  ennreal: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  ennreal_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> ennreal]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> ennreal]

  b_function: TYPE = [A -> B]
  indexed_functions: TYPE = [I -> b_function]
  function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> b_function]
  indexed_values: TYPE = [I -> B]
  value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> B]
  extended_distance: TYPE = [B, B -> ennreal]
  index_order: TYPE = [I, I -> bool]
  index_join: TYPE = [I, I -> I]

  zero_ennreal: ennreal =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_ennreal: ennreal =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_ennreal(value: real): ennreal =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_ennreal(value: ennreal): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  ennreal_is_zero(value: ennreal): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  ennreal_le(left, right: ennreal): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(left)
      AND canonical_ennreal(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  ennreal_add(left, right: ennreal): ennreal =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_ennreal
    ELSE
      finite_ennreal(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  edist_lt_real(value: ennreal, radius: real): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) < radius

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): FALSE

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): TRUE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): NOT E(x)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): E(x) AND F(x)

  event_difference(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): E(x) AND NOT F(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      E(x) IMPLIES F(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  finite_real_sum(values: [nat -> real], count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: [nat -> real], limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (radius: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < radius

  unbounded_above(values: [nat -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_ennreal_sum(
      values: ennreal_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: ennreal_sequence,
      total: ennreal): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_ennreal(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_ennreal_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_ennreal_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND ennreal_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        canonical_ennreal(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
      Sigma(measurable_cover)
        AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
        AND ennreal_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (x: A): NOT property(x))

  measurable_finite_set(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    Sigma(E)
      AND canonical_ennreal(M(E))
      AND NOT infinite_flag(M(E))

  pseudo_emetric_laws(edist: extended_distance): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: B):
      canonical_ennreal(edist(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: B):
        ennreal_is_zero(edist(x, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: B):
        edist(x, y) = edist(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: B):
        ennreal_le(
          edist(x, z),
          ennreal_add(edist(x, y), edist(y, z))))

  converges_sequence(
      values: value_sequence,
      limit_value: B,
      edist: extended_distance): bool =
    FORALL (radius: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            edist_lt_real(
              edist(values(index), limit_value),
              radius)

  finite_range(function_value: b_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (bound: nat),
        (code: [B -> nat]):
      (FORALL (x: A):
        code(function_value(x)) < bound)
        AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
          code(function_value(x))
            = code(function_value(y))
          IMPLIES function_value(x) = function_value(y))

  measurable_simple(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: b_function): bool =
    finite_range(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (value: B):
        Sigma(
          LAMBDA (x: A):
            function_value(x) = value))

  strongly_measurable(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      edist: extended_distance,
      function_value: b_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: A):
          converges_sequence(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              approximants(index)(x),
            function_value(x),
            edist))

  partial_order_laws(leq: index_order): bool =
    (FORALL (i: I): leq(i, i))
      AND (FORALL (i, j, k: I):
        leq(i, j) AND leq(j, k) IMPLIES leq(i, k))
      AND (FORALL (i, j: I):
        leq(i, j) AND leq(j, i) IMPLIES i = j)

  semilattice_sup_laws(
      leq: index_order,
      join: index_join): bool =
    partial_order_laws(leq)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: I):
        leq(i, join(i, j))
          AND leq(j, join(i, j)))
      AND (FORALL (i, j, k: I):
        leq(i, k) AND leq(j, k)
          IMPLIES leq(join(i, j), k))

  countable_index: bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [nat -> I]):
      FORALL (i: I):
        EXISTS (number: nat):
          enumeration(number) = i

  converges_at_top(
      values: indexed_values,
      limit_value: B,
      leq: index_order,
      edist: extended_distance): bool =
    FORALL (radius: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: I):
        FORALL (index: I):
          leq(cutoff, index) IMPLIES
            edist_lt_real(
              edist(values(index), limit_value),
              radius)

  tends_uniformly_on(
      functions: indexed_functions,
      limit_function: b_function,
      leq: index_order,
      edist: extended_distance,
      domain: event): bool =
    FORALL (radius: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: I):
        FORALL (index: I):
          leq(cutoff, index) IMPLIES
            FORALL (x: A):
              domain(x) IMPLIES
                edist_lt_real(
                  edist(
                    functions(index)(x),
                    limit_function(x)),
                  radius)

  tendstoUniformlyOn_of_ae_tendsto: bool =
    FORALL
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (M: measure_map),
        (edist: extended_distance),
        (leq: index_order),
        (join: index_join),
        (functions: indexed_functions),
        (limit_function: b_function),
        (source_set: event),
        (epsilon_value: real):
      (is_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND pseudo_emetric_laws(edist)
        AND semilattice_sup_laws(leq, join)
        AND countable_index
        AND (FORALL (index: I):
          strongly_measurable(
            Sigma, edist, functions(index)))
        AND strongly_measurable(
          Sigma, edist, limit_function)
        AND measurable_finite_set(
          M, Sigma, source_set)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (x: A):
            source_set(x) IMPLIES
              converges_at_top(
                LAMBDA (index: I):
                  functions(index)(x),
                limit_function(x),
                leq,
                edist))
        AND epsilon_value > 0)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (exception_set: event):
          event_subset(exception_set, source_set)
            AND Sigma(exception_set)
            AND ennreal_le(
              M(exception_set),
              finite_ennreal(epsilon_value))
            AND tends_uniformly_on(
              functions,
              limit_function,
              leq,
              edist,
              event_difference(
                source_set, exception_set))
END egorov_s_theorem_Q1191709

Definition q1194053_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q1194053_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1194053_is_open : q1194053_set X -> Prop;
  q1194053_open_ext :
    forall U V : q1194053_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q1194053_is_open U <-> q1194053_is_open V);
  q1194053_open_univ :
    q1194053_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1194053_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1194053_set X,
      q1194053_is_open U ->
      q1194053_is_open V ->
      q1194053_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1194053_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q1194053_set (q1194053_set X),
      (forall U : q1194053_set X,
        family U -> q1194053_is_open U) ->
      q1194053_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1194053_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1194053_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q1194053_is_closed
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1194053_topological_space X)
    (C : q1194053_set X) : Prop :=
  q1194053_is_open T (fun x : X => ~ C x).

Record q1194053_t3_space
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1194053_topological_space X) : Prop := {
  q1194053_t0 :
    forall x y : X,
      (forall U : q1194053_set X,
        q1194053_is_open T U -> (U x <-> U y)) ->
      x = y;
  q1194053_regular :
    forall (C : q1194053_set X) (x : X),
      q1194053_is_closed T C ->
      ~ C x ->
      exists U V : q1194053_set X,
        q1194053_is_open T U /\
        q1194053_is_open T V /\
        U x /\
        (forall y : X, C y -> V y) /\
        (forall y : X, ~ (U y /\ V y))
}.

Definition q1194053_second_countable
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1194053_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q1194053_set X,
    (forall n : nat, q1194053_is_open T (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q1194053_set X) (x : X),
      q1194053_is_open T U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\
        forall y : X, basis n y -> U y.

Record q1194053_metric_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1194053_dist : X -> X -> R;
  q1194053_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : X, 0 <= q1194053_dist x y;
  q1194053_dist_eq_zero :
    forall x y : X, q1194053_dist x y = 0 <-> x = y;
  q1194053_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : X, q1194053_dist x y = q1194053_dist y x;
  q1194053_triangle :
    forall x y z : X,
      q1194053_dist x z <=
      q1194053_dist x y + q1194053_dist y z
}.

Arguments q1194053_dist {X} _ _ _.

Definition q1194053_metric_induces
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1194053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1194053_metric_space X) : Prop :=
  forall U : q1194053_set X,
    q1194053_is_open T U <->
    forall x : X, U x ->
      exists epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon /\
        forall y : X,
          q1194053_dist M x y < epsilon ->
          U y.

Theorem metrizableSpace_of_t3_secondCountable :
  forall (X : Type)
         (T : q1194053_topological_space X),
    q1194053_t3_space T ->
    q1194053_second_countable T ->
    exists M : q1194053_metric_space X,
      q1194053_metric_induces T M.
Admitted.

title: Q1194053_metrization_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1194053,
  "Metrization theorems": Urysohn's metrization theorem states that every T3,
  second-countable topology is induced by a metric. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1194053_metrization_theorems
  imports "HOL.Real"
begin

definition mt_is_topology :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mt_is_topology A T \<longleftrightarrow>
    T \<subseteq> Pow A \<and>
    {} \<in> T \<and>
    A \<in> T \<and>
    (\<forall>K. K \<subseteq> T \<longrightarrow> \<Union>K \<in> T) \<and>
    (\<forall>U \<in> T. \<forall>V \<in> T. U \<inter> V \<in> T)"

definition mt_is_t3 :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mt_is_t3 A T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x \<in> A. \<forall>y \<in> A. x \<noteq> y \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>U \<in> T. \<exists>V \<in> T.
        x \<in> U \<and> y \<in> V \<and> U \<inter> V = {})) \<and>
    (\<forall>C \<subseteq> A. A - C \<in> T \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> A. x \<notin> C \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>U \<in> T. \<exists>V \<in> T.
        x \<in> U \<and> C \<subseteq> V \<and> U \<inter> V = {})))"

definition mt_is_second_countable :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mt_is_second_countable A T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>b :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set. (\<forall>n. b n \<in> T) \<and>
      (\<forall>U \<in> T. \<forall>x \<in> U.
        \<exists>n. x \<in> b n \<and> b n \<subseteq> U))"

definition mt_is_metric_on ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mt_is_metric_on A d \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x \<in> A. \<forall>y \<in> A. 0 \<le> d x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> A. \<forall>y \<in> A. d x y = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> A. \<forall>y \<in> A. d x y = d y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> A. \<forall>y \<in> A. \<forall>z \<in> A.
      d x z \<le> d x y + d y z)"

definition mt_metric_open_family ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set set" where
  "mt_metric_open_family A d =
    {U. U \<subseteq> A \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> U. \<exists>r>0. \<forall>y \<in> A. d x y < r \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U)}"

definition mt_is_metrizable :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "mt_is_metrizable A T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>d :: 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real.
      mt_is_metric_on A d \<and> T = mt_metric_open_family A d)"

theorem urysohn_metrization:
  fixes A :: "'a set"
    and T :: "'a set set"
  assumes "mt_is_topology A T"
    and "mt_is_t3 A T"
    and "mt_is_second_countable A T"
  shows "mt_is_metrizable A T"
  sorry

end

title: Q1194053_metrization_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1194053
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1194053), "Metrization theorems": every T3
  second-countable topological space admits a real-valued metric inducing
  exactly its given topology. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1194053_METRIZATION_THEOREMS =
  `let is_topology =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets carrier /\
       (!U:A->bool. open_sets U ==> U SUBSET carrier) /\
       (!C:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
       (!U V:A->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V
          ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let is_closed =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (C:A->bool).
       C SUBSET carrier /\ open_sets (carrier DIFF C) in
   let is_t0 =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       !x y:A.
         x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ ~(x = y)
         ==> ?U:A->bool.
               open_sets U /\
               ((x IN U /\ ~(y IN U)) \/
                (y IN U /\ ~(x IN U))) in
   let is_regular =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       !C:A->bool.
       !x:A.
         is_closed carrier open_sets C /\
         x IN carrier /\
         ~(x IN C)
         ==> ?U V:A->bool.
               open_sets U /\
               open_sets V /\
               x IN U /\
               C SUBSET V /\
               U INTER V = {} in
   let is_second_countable =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       ?basis:(A->bool)->bool.
         COUNTABLE basis /\
         (!V:A->bool. V IN basis ==> open_sets V) /\
         !U:A->bool.
           open_sets U
           ==> !x:A.
                 x IN U
                 ==> ?V:A->bool.
                       V IN basis /\
                       x IN V /\
                       V SUBSET U in
   let is_metric =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
       (!x y:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
          ==> &0 <= d x y) /\
       (!x y:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
          ==> (d x y = &0 <=> x = y)) /\
       (!x y:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
          ==> d x y = d y x) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
          ==> d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let induces_topology =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
      (d:A->A->real).
       !U:A->bool.
         open_sets U <=>
         U SUBSET carrier /\
         !x:A.
           x IN U
           ==> ?epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon /\
                 !y:A.
                   y IN carrier /\ d x y < epsilon
                   ==> y IN U in
   let is_metrizable =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       ?d:A->A->real.
         is_metric carrier d /\
         induces_topology carrier open_sets d in
   !carrier:A->bool.
   !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool.
     is_topology carrier open_sets /\
     is_t0 carrier open_sets /\
     is_regular carrier open_sets /\
     is_second_countable carrier open_sets
     ==> is_metrizable carrier open_sets`;;

title: Q1194053_metrization_theorems
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1194053,
;; "Metrization theorems": every T3 topological space with a second-countable
;; topology admits a compatible metrizable-space structure. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Sets, relations, families, and sequences are tame function objects over an
;; arbitrary carrier. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification,
;; and its negation supplies internal existential witnesses. The conclusion
;; uses the standard bidirectional uniform metrization characterization: a
;; topology is metrizable exactly when it is T0 and is induced by a uniformity
;; with a countable entourage basis.

(defun q1194053-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1194053-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q1194053-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1194053-quoted nil)))

(defun q1194053-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q1194053-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1194053-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1194053-apply-term
   (q1194053-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q1194053-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1194053-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q1194053-quoted nil))
    (q1194053-quoted t)))

(defun q1194053-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q1194053-quoted nil)
   (q1194053-quoted t)))

(defun q1194053-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q1194053-quoted t)))

(defun q1194053-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1194053-quoted t)
    (q1194053-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1194053-quoted nil)
    (q1194053-quoted t))))

(defun q1194053-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1194053-quoted t)))

(defun q1194053-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1194053-set-subset-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-and-terms
     (list
      (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q1194053-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q1194053-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q1194053-set-subset-p
    (carrier left right)
  (let ((condition
         (q1194053-set-subset-function
          carrier left right))
        (always-true
         (q1194053-true-function '(x))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp left)
     (tamep-functionp right)
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun q1194053-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q1194053-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun q1194053-set-equiv-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q1194053-iff-term
     (q1194053-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q1194053-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q1194053-set-equiv-p
    (carrier left right)
  (let ((condition
         (q1194053-set-equiv-function
          carrier left right))
        (always-true
         (q1194053-true-function '(x))))
    (and
     (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier left)
     (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier right)
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun q1194053-family-extensional-function
    (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(left right)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q1194053-valid-set-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       'left)
      (list
       'q1194053-valid-set-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       'right)
      (list
       'q1194053-set-equiv-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       'left
       'right)))
    (q1194053-iff-term
     (q1194053-static-apply-term family '(left))
     (q1194053-static-apply-term family '(right))))))

(defun q1194053-family-members-valid-function
    (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(set)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (list
     'q1194053-valid-set-p
     (q1194053-quoted carrier)
     'set))))

(defun q1194053-family-of-sets-p
    (carrier family)
  (let ((extensional
         (q1194053-family-extensional-function
          carrier family))
        (members-valid
         (q1194053-family-members-valid-function
          carrier family))
        (true2
         (q1194053-true-function '(left right)))
        (true1
         (q1194053-true-function '(set))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp family)
     (tamep-functionp extensional)
     (tamep-functionp members-valid)
     (tamep-functionp true2)
     (tamep-functionp true1)
     (fn-equal extensional true2)
     (fn-equal members-valid true1))))

(defun q1194053-set-nonempty-failure-function
    (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (list
    'if
    (q1194053-and-terms
     (list
      (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q1194053-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q1194053-quoted nil)
    (q1194053-quoted t))))

(defun q1194053-set-nonempty-p
    (carrier set)
  (let ((failure
         (q1194053-set-nonempty-failure-function
          carrier set))
        (always-true
         (q1194053-true-function '(x))))
    (and
     (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1194053-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (q1194053-quoted nil)))

(defun q1194053-full-set (carrier)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun q1194053-intersection-set (left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-and-terms
    (list
     (q1194053-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q1194053-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q1194053-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-and-terms
    (list
     (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q1194053-not-term
      (q1194053-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun q1194053-intersection-nonempty-p
    (carrier left right)
  (q1194053-set-nonempty-p
   carrier
   (q1194053-intersection-set left right)))

(defun q1194053-union-member-witness-p
    (carrier family x set)
  (and
   (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1194053-member-p family set)
   (q1194053-member-p set x)))

(defun q1194053-union-member-failure-function
    (carrier family x)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(set)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'q1194053-union-member-witness-p
     (q1194053-quoted carrier)
     (q1194053-quoted family)
     (q1194053-quoted x)
     'set)
    (q1194053-quoted nil)
    (q1194053-quoted t))))

(defun q1194053-union-member-p
    (carrier family x)
  (let ((failure
         (q1194053-union-member-failure-function
          carrier family x))
        (always-true
         (q1194053-true-function '(set))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1194053-union-set (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-and-terms
    (list
     (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (list
      'q1194053-union-member-p
      (q1194053-quoted carrier)
      (q1194053-quoted family)
      'x)))))

(defun q1194053-open-set-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1194053-member-p topology set)))

(defun q1194053-closed-set-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1194053-open-set-p
    carrier
    topology
    (q1194053-complement-set carrier set))))

(defun q1194053-family-members-open-function
    (carrier topology family)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(set)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (list
     'q1194053-open-set-p
     (q1194053-quoted carrier)
     (q1194053-quoted topology)
     'set))))

(defun q1194053-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (let ((condition
         (q1194053-family-members-open-function
          carrier topology family))
        (always-true
         (q1194053-true-function '(set))))
    (and
     (q1194053-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun q1194053-topology-intersection-function
    (carrier topology)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(left right)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q1194053-open-set-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       (q1194053-quoted topology)
       'left)
      (list
       'q1194053-open-set-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       (q1194053-quoted topology)
       'right)))
    (list
     'q1194053-open-set-p
     (q1194053-quoted carrier)
     (q1194053-quoted topology)
     (list
      'q1194053-intersection-set
      'left
      'right)))))

(defun q1194053-topology-union-function
    (carrier topology)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(family)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q1194053-family-of-sets-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       'family)
      (list
       'q1194053-family-members-open-p
       (q1194053-quoted carrier)
       (q1194053-quoted topology)
       'family)))
    (list
     'q1194053-open-set-p
     (q1194053-quoted carrier)
     (q1194053-quoted topology)
     (list
      'q1194053-union-set
      (q1194053-quoted carrier)
      'family)))))

(defun q1194053-topological-space-p
    (carrier topology)
  (let ((empty
         (q1194053-empty-set))
        (full
         (q1194053-full-set carrier))
        (intersection-law
         (q1194053-topology-intersection-function
          carrier topology))
        (union-law
         (q1194053-topology-union-function
          carrier topology))
        (true2
         (q1194053-true-function '(left right)))
        (true1
         (q1194053-true-function '(family))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (q1194053-family-of-sets-p carrier topology)
     (tamep-functionp empty)
     (tamep-functionp full)
     (q1194053-open-set-p carrier topology empty)
     (q1194053-open-set-p carrier topology full)
     (tamep-functionp intersection-law)
     (tamep-functionp union-law)
     (tamep-functionp true2)
     (tamep-functionp true1)
     (fn-equal intersection-law true2)
     (fn-equal union-law true1))))

(defun q1194053-set-disjoint-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1194053-implies-term
    (q1194053-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q1194053-not-term
     (q1194053-and-terms
      (list
       (q1194053-static-apply-term left '(x))
       (q1194053-static-apply-term right '(x))))))))

(defun q1194053-set-disjoint-p
    (carrier left right)
  (let ((condition
         (q1194053-set-disjoint-function
          carrier left right))
        (always-true
         (q1194053-true-function '(x))))
    (and
     (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier left)
     (q1194053-valid-set-p carrier right)
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun q1194053-topologically-indistinguishable-function
    (carrier topology x y)

title: Q1194053_metrization_theorems
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1194053,
-- "Metrization theorems": every T3 topological space with a second-countable
-- topology admits a real-valued metric inducing exactly that topology. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1194053_metrization_theorems where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<=Z_ _<=Q_ _<Q_ _≈E_ _<=E_ _<E_
infixl 6 _+N_ _+Z_ _+Q_ _+E_
infixl 7 _*N_ _*Z_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

_+N_ :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set where

  zero<= :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <=N n

  suc<= :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    suc m <=N suc n

-- Integers are exact differences of natural numbers.
record Integer : Set where
  constructor integer
  field
    positivePart :
      Nat

    negativePart :
      Nat

naturalInteger :
  Nat ->
  Integer
naturalInteger n =
  integer n zero

_+Z_ :
  Integer ->
  Integer ->
  Integer
integer p n +Z integer q m =
  integer
    (p +N q)
    (n +N m)

negateZ :
  Integer ->
  Integer
negateZ (integer p n) =
  integer n p

_*Z_ :
  Integer ->
  Integer ->
  Integer
integer p n *Z integer q m =
  integer
    ((p *N q) +N (n *N m))
    ((p *N m) +N (n *N q))

_<=Z_ :
  Integer ->
  Integer ->
  Set
integer p n <=Z integer q m =
  (p +N m) <=N (q +N n)

-- A positive denominator is stored as one plus a natural number.
data Positive : Set where
  onePlus :
    Nat ->
    Positive

positiveValue :
  Positive ->
  Nat
positiveValue (onePlus n) =
  suc n

_*P_ :
  Positive ->
  Positive ->
  Positive
onePlus m *P onePlus n =
  onePlus ((m +N n) +N (m *N n))

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator :
      Integer

    denominator :
      Positive

scaleInteger :
  Integer ->
  Positive ->
  Integer
scaleInteger z d =
  z *Z naturalInteger (positiveValue d)

_+Q_ :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Rational
fraction x xd +Q fraction y yd =
  fraction
    ((scaleInteger x yd) +Z (scaleInteger y xd))
    (xd *P yd)

negateQ :
  Rational ->
  Rational
negateQ (fraction x xd) =
  fraction (negateZ x) xd

_<=Q_ :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Set
fraction x xd <=Q fraction y yd =
  scaleInteger x yd <=Z scaleInteger y xd

_<Q_ :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Set
x <Q y =
  Both
    (x <=Q y)
    (Not (y <=Q x))

naturalRational :
  Nat ->
  Rational
naturalRational n =
  fraction
    (naturalInteger n)
    (onePlus zero)

rationalZero :
  Rational
rationalZero =
  naturalRational zero

unitFraction :
  Nat ->
  Rational
unitFraction n =
  fraction
    (naturalInteger (suc zero))
    (onePlus n)

RealExpression :
  Set
RealExpression =
  Nat -> Rational

constant :
  Rational ->
  RealExpression
constant q n =
  q

naturalExpression :
  Nat ->
  RealExpression
naturalExpression n =
  constant (naturalRational n)

_+E_ :
  RealExpression ->
  RealExpression ->
  RealExpression
(x +E y) n =
  x n +Q y n

Close :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Set
Close x y tolerance =
  Both
    (x <=Q (y +Q tolerance))
    (y <=Q (x +Q tolerance))

-- Every classical real admits a rational approximation with this regular
-- Cauchy modulus.
Regular :
  RealExpression ->
  Set
Regular x =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  Close
    (x m)
    (x n)
    (unitFraction m +Q unitFraction n)

-- Real numbers are fixed regular Cauchy presentations. The relations below
-- are equality and order on their Cauchy completion.
record Real : Set where
  constructor real
  field
    approximation :
      RealExpression

    regular :
      Regular approximation

realExpression :
  Real ->
  RealExpression
realExpression =
  Real.approximation

_≈E_ :
  RealExpression ->
  RealExpression ->
  Set
x ≈E y =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Σ Nat
    (λ threshold ->
      (index : Nat) ->
      threshold <=N index ->
      Close
        (x index)
        (y index)
        (unitFraction precision))

_<=E_ :
  RealExpression ->
  RealExpression ->
  Set
x <=E y =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Σ Nat
    (λ threshold ->
      (index : Nat) ->
      threshold <=N index ->
      x index <=Q
      (y index +Q unitFraction precision))

_<E_ :
  RealExpression ->
  RealExpression ->
  Set
x <E y =
  Σ Rational
    (λ gap ->
      Both
        (rationalZero <Q gap)
        (Σ Nat
          (λ threshold ->
            (index : Nat) ->
            threshold <=N index ->
            (x index +Q gap) <=Q y index)))

RealEqual :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Set
RealEqual x y =
  realExpression x ≈E realExpression y

RealNonnegative :
  Real ->
  Set
RealNonnegative x =
  naturalExpression zero <=E realExpression x

RealPositive :
  Real ->
  Set
RealPositive x =
  naturalExpression zero <E realExpression x

RealStrictLess :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Set
RealStrictLess x y =
  realExpression x <E realExpression y

RealZero :
  Real ->
  Set
RealZero x =
  realExpression x ≈E naturalExpression zero

RealLessOrEqualSum :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Set
RealLessOrEqualSum x y z =
  realExpression x <=E
  (realExpression y +E realExpression z)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X -> Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X
Empty {a} _ =
  Bottom {a}

Union :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  V x

SameSubset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
SameSubset {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  Iff (U x) (V x)

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      Subset X ->
      Subset X

    close-congruent :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      SameSubset U V ->
      SameSubset (close U) (close V)

    close-empty :
      SubsetOf (close Empty) Empty

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf
        (close (Union U V))
        (Union (close U) (close V))

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf
        (Union (close U) (close V))
        (close (Union U V))

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

T0Space :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
T0Space {X = X} topology =
  (x y : X) ->
  x != y ->
  Either
    (Σ (Subset X)
      (λ U ->
        Both
          (IsOpen topology U)
          (Both
            (U x)
            (Not (U y)))))
    (Σ (Subset X)
      (λ U ->
        Both
          (IsOpen topology U)
          (Both
            (U y)
            (Not (U x)))))

RegularSpace :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
RegularSpace {X = X} topology =
  (U : Subset X) ->
  IsOpen topology U ->
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Σ (Subset X)
    (λ V ->
      Both
        (IsOpen topology V)
        (Both
          (V x)
          (SubsetOf (close topology V) U)))

T3Space :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
T3Space topology =
  Both
    (T0Space topology)
    (RegularSpace topology)

SecondCountableTopology :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
SecondCountableTopology {X = X} topology =
  Σ (Nat -> Subset X)
    (λ basis ->
      Both
        ((n : Nat) ->
          IsOpen topology (basis n))
        ((U : Subset X) ->
          IsOpen topology U ->
          (x : X) ->
          U x ->
          Σ Nat
            (λ n ->
              Both
                (basis n x)
                (SubsetOf (basis n) U))))

record MetricSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    distance :
      X ->
      X ->
      Real

    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : X) ->
      RealNonnegative (distance x y)

    distance-self :
      (x : X) ->
      RealZero (distance x x)

    distance-zero-only :
      (x y : X) ->
      RealZero (distance x y) ->
      x == y

    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : X) ->
      RealEqual (distance x y) (distance y x)

    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : X) ->
      RealLessOrEqualSum
        (distance x z)
        (distance x y)
        (distance y z)

open MetricSpace

MetricClosure :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  MetricSpace X ->
  Subset X ->
  X ->
  Set a
MetricClosure {X = X} metric U x =
  (epsilon : Real) ->
  RealPositive epsilon ->
  Σ X
    (λ y ->
      Both
        (U y)
        (RealStrictLess
          (distance metric x y)
          epsilon))

InducesTopology :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  MetricSpace X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
InducesTopology {X = X} topology metric =
  (U : Subset X) ->
  (x : X) ->
  Iff
    (close topology U x)
    (MetricClosure metric U x)

MetrizableSpace :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
MetrizableSpace {X = X} topology =
  Σ (MetricSpace X)
    (λ metric ->
      InducesTopology topology metric)

metrization-theorems :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
metrization-theorems {a} =
  (X : Set a) ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace X) ->
  T3Space topology ->
  SecondCountableTopology topology ->
  MetrizableSpace topology

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1194053 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1194053), "Metrization theorems":
  every T3 topological space with a second-countable topology admits a
  compatible metric. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory realTheory;

val q1194053_t0_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1194053_t0_space_def",
  ``q1194053_t0_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      !(x : 'a) (y : 'a).
        x IN topspace top /\ y IN topspace top /\ ~(x = y)
        ==>
        ?(u : 'a set).
          open_in top u /\
          ((x IN u /\ ~(y IN u)) \/ (y IN u /\ ~(x IN u)))``);

val q1194053_regular_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1194053_regular_space_def",
  ``q1194053_regular_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      !(s : 'a set) (a : 'a).
        closed_in top s /\ a IN topspace top /\ ~(a IN s)
        ==>
        ?(u : 'a set) (v : 'a set).
          open_in top u /\
          open_in top v /\
          s SUBSET u /\
          a IN v /\
          DISJOINT u v``);

val q1194053_t3_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1194053_t3_space_def",
  ``q1194053_t3_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      q1194053_t0_space top /\ q1194053_regular_space top``);

val q1194053_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q1194053_second_countable_def",
  ``q1194053_second_countable (top : 'a topology) <=>
      ?(basis : ('a set) set).
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!(v : 'a set). v IN basis ==> open_in top v) /\
        !(u : 'a set) (x : 'a).
          open_in top u /\ x IN u
          ==>
          ?(v : 'a set). v IN basis /\ x IN v /\ v SUBSET u``);

val q1194053_metrizable_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1194053_metrizable_space_def",
  ``q1194053_metrizable_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      ?(d : 'a -> 'a -> real).
        (!(x : 'a) (y : 'a).
          x IN topspace top /\ y IN topspace top
          ==>
          0 <= d x y /\
          (d x y = 0 <=> x = y) /\
          d x y = d y x) /\
        (!(x : 'a) (y : 'a) (z : 'a).
          x IN topspace top /\
          y IN topspace top /\
          z IN topspace top
          ==>
          d x z <= d x y + d y z) /\
        !(u : 'a set).
          open_in top u <=>
          u SUBSET topspace top /\
          !(x : 'a).
            x IN u
            ==>
            ?(r : real).
              0 < r /\
              !(y : 'a).
                y IN topspace top /\ d x y < r
                ==>
                y IN u``);

val TopologicalSpace_metrizableSpace_of_t3_secondCountable =
  ``!(top : 'a topology).
      q1194053_t3_space top /\
      q1194053_second_countable top
      ==>
      q1194053_metrizable_space top``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1194053), "Metrization theorems":
  Urysohn's metrization theorem says that every T3 second-countable topology
  on an arbitrary carrier is induced by a genuine metric. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's Reg and Kol2 predicates jointly express the T3 assumption:
  regularity together with the T0 separation property. For a regular topology,
  SetMM also proves that Kol2 is equivalent to Hausdorff separation. The 2ndc
  predicate is second countability, and U. j is the full carrier of topology j.

  The conclusion retains the internal existential witness: d is a genuine
  real-valued metric on the entire carrier U. j, and MetOpen d is required to
  equal the given topology j. Thus it directly expresses existence of a metric
  space structure generating the original topology.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. This
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d d j $.

  thousand-theorems-q1194053-metrization $a |-
    A. j
      (
        (
          (
            j e. Reg
            /\
            j e. Kol2
          )
          /\
          j e. 2ndc
        )
        ->
        E. d e. ( Met ` U. j )
          j = ( MetOpen ` d )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q1194053_metrization_theorems
Q1194053_metrization_theorems
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1194053,
% "Metrization theorems": every T3 second-countable topological space has a
% metric inducing its topology. This file contains no proof.

metrization_theorems_Q1194053[
  X: TYPE,
  carrier: [X -> bool],
  open_sets: [[X -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  countable_basis: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  distance_function: TYPE = [X, X -> real]

  empty_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  whole_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): carrier(x)

  set_on_carrier(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      A(x) IMPLIES carrier(x)

  complement(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND NOT A(x)

  binary_intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): A(x) AND B(x)

  union_of_family(F: set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (U: point_set):
          F(U) AND U(x)

  subset_of(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  disjoint(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      NOT (A(x) AND B(x))

  topology_laws: bool =
    open_sets(empty_point_set)
      AND open_sets(whole_point_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (U: point_set):
          open_sets(U) IMPLIES set_on_carrier(U))
      AND
        (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
          (open_sets(A) AND open_sets(B))
            IMPLIES open_sets(binary_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
        (FORALL (F: set_family):
          (FORALL (U: point_set):
            F(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
          IMPLIES open_sets(union_of_family(F)))

  closed_point_set(C: point_set): bool =
    set_on_carrier(C)
      AND open_sets(complement(C))

  t0_space: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: X):
      (carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND x /= y)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: point_set):
            open_sets(U)
              AND
                ((U(x) AND NOT U(y))
                  OR (U(y) AND NOT U(x)))

  regular_space: bool =
    FORALL (C: point_set), (x: X):
      (closed_point_set(C) AND carrier(x) AND NOT C(x))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U, V: point_set):
            open_sets(U)
              AND open_sets(V)
              AND U(x)
              AND subset_of(C, V)
              AND disjoint(U, V)

  t3_space: bool =
    t0_space AND regular_space

  second_countable: bool =
    EXISTS (B: countable_basis):
      (FORALL (n: nat):
        open_sets(B(n)))
        AND
          (FORALL (U: point_set), (x: X):
            (open_sets(U) AND carrier(x) AND U(x))
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (n: nat):
                  B(n)(x) AND subset_of(B(n), U))

  metric_laws(d: distance_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      (carrier(x) AND carrier(y))
        IMPLIES 0 <= d(x, y))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: X):
          (carrier(x) AND carrier(y))
            IMPLIES (d(x, y) = 0 IFF x = y))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: X):
          (carrier(x) AND carrier(y))
            IMPLIES d(x, y) = d(y, x))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
          (carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z))
            IMPLIES d(x, z) <= d(x, y) + d(y, z))

  metric_open(d: distance_function, U: point_set): bool =
    set_on_carrier(U)
      AND
        FORALL (x: X):
          (carrier(x) AND U(x))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (epsilon: real):
                0 < epsilon
                  AND
                    FORALL (y: X):
                      (carrier(y) AND d(x, y) < epsilon)
                        IMPLIES U(y)

  metrizable_space: bool =
    EXISTS (d: distance_function):
      metric_laws(d)
        AND
          (FORALL (U: point_set):
            open_sets(U) IFF metric_open(d, U))

  metrizableSpace_of_t3_secondCountable: bool =
    (topology_laws AND t3_space AND second_countable)
      IMPLIES metrizable_space
END metrization_theorems_Q1194053

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
