-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1217677
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1217677), "Fundamental theorem of calculus":
-- a variable-endpoint interval integral has the expected strict derivative under an
-- almost-everywhere limit, and integrating an integrable right derivative recovers endpoint
-- subtraction. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.FundThmCalculus

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory Set Filter

open scoped Topology

namespace Q1217677

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  {f f' : ℝ → E} {c : E} {a b : ℝ}

/-- FTC-1 for a variable right endpoint under an almost-everywhere limit at that endpoint. -/
theorem integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right
    (hf : IntervalIntegrable f volume a b)
    (hmeas : StronglyMeasurableAtFilter f (𝓝 b))
    (hb : Tendsto f (𝓝 b ⊓ ae volume) (𝓝 c)) :
    HasStrictDerivAt (fun u => ∫ x in a..u, f x) c b := sorry

/-- FTC-2 for a continuous function with an integrable right derivative on an ordered interval. -/
theorem integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le
    (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b))
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (Ioi x) x)
    (f'int : IntervalIntegrable f' volume a b) :
    ∫ y in a..b, f' y = f b - f a := sorry

end Q1217677

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1217677
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1217677), "Fundamental theorem of calculus":
  strict differentiation of a Lebesgue interval integral at an endpoint and
  recovery of a function from an integrable right derivative. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1217677_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1217677_empty {A : Type} : q1217677_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1217677_complement {A : Type}
    (S : q1217677_set A) : q1217677_set A :=
  fun x => ~ S x.

Definition q1217677_countable_union {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q1217677_set A) : q1217677_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, S n x.

Definition q1217677_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q1217677_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q1217677_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S T : q1217677_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (S x /\ T x).

Definition q1217677_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q1217677_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1217677_disjoint (S i) (S j).

Definition q1217677_Ioc (a b : R) : q1217677_set R :=
  fun x => a < x /\ x <= b.

Definition q1217677_Icc (a b : R) : q1217677_set R :=
  fun x => a <= x /\ x <= b.

Definition q1217677_Ioo (a b : R) : q1217677_set R :=
  fun x => a < x /\ x < b.

Definition q1217677_Ioi (a : R) : q1217677_set R :=
  fun x => a < x.

Definition q1217677_open_interval (a b : R) : q1217677_set R :=
  q1217677_Ioo a b.

Definition q1217677_sigma_class
    (C : q1217677_set (q1217677_set R)) : Prop :=
  C q1217677_empty /\
  (forall S T : q1217677_set R,
    q1217677_same_set S T -> C S -> C T) /\
  (forall S : q1217677_set R,
    C S -> C (q1217677_complement S)) /\
  (forall S : nat -> q1217677_set R,
    (forall n : nat, C (S n)) ->
    C (q1217677_countable_union S)).

Inductive q1217677_ennreal : Type :=
| q1217677_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q1217677_ennreal
| q1217677_ennreal_infinity : q1217677_ennreal.

Arguments q1217677_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_zero : q1217677_ennreal :=
  q1217677_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q1217677_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1217677_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1217677_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q1217677_ennreal_infinity,
    q1217677_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_le
    (x y : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q1217677_ennreal_finite a _,
    q1217677_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q1217677_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q1217677_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q1217677_ennreal_infinity,
    q1217677_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q1217677_ennreal_infinity,
    q1217677_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_add
    (x y : q1217677_ennreal) : q1217677_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1217677_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1217677_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1217677_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q1217677_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q1217677_ennreal) : q1217677_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q1217677_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q1217677_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q1217677_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q1217677_ennreal_finite a _, q1217677_ennreal_infinity
  | q1217677_ennreal_infinity, q1217677_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q1217677_ennreal_zero
      else q1217677_ennreal_infinity
  | q1217677_ennreal_infinity, q1217677_ennreal_infinity =>
      q1217677_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q1217677_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q1217677_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q1217677_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q1217677_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q1217677_ennreal_add
        (q1217677_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q1217677_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q1217677_ennreal,
      values value -> q1217677_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q1217677_ennreal,
      (forall value : q1217677_ennreal,
        values value -> q1217677_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q1217677_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q1217677_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q1217677_ennreal)
    (sum : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1217677_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q1217677_ennreal_eq value
          (q1217677_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_represents
    (x : q1217677_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q1217677_ennreal_eq x
      (q1217677_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q1217677_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q1217677_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space : Type := {
  q1217677_measurable : q1217677_set R -> Prop;
  q1217677_measurable_extensional :
    forall S T : q1217677_set R,
      q1217677_same_set S T ->
      (q1217677_measurable S <-> q1217677_measurable T);
  q1217677_measurable_empty :
    q1217677_measurable q1217677_empty;
  q1217677_measurable_complement :
    forall S : q1217677_set R,
      q1217677_measurable S ->
      q1217677_measurable (q1217677_complement S);
  q1217677_measurable_countable_union :
    forall S : nat -> q1217677_set R,
      (forall n : nat, q1217677_measurable (S n)) ->
      q1217677_measurable (q1217677_countable_union S);
  q1217677_measurable_open_interval :
    forall a b : R,
      q1217677_measurable (q1217677_open_interval a b);
  q1217677_measurable_borel_minimal :
    forall C : q1217677_set (q1217677_set R),
      q1217677_sigma_class C ->
      (forall a b : R, C (q1217677_open_interval a b)) ->
      forall S : q1217677_set R,
        q1217677_measurable S -> C S;
  q1217677_measure : q1217677_set R -> q1217677_ennreal;
  q1217677_measure_extensional :
    forall S T : q1217677_set R,
      q1217677_same_set S T ->
      q1217677_ennreal_eq
        (q1217677_measure S) (q1217677_measure T);
  q1217677_measure_empty :
    q1217677_ennreal_eq
      (q1217677_measure q1217677_empty)
      q1217677_ennreal_zero;
  q1217677_measure_monotone :
    forall S T : q1217677_set R,
      (forall x : R, S x -> T x) ->
      q1217677_ennreal_le
        (q1217677_measure S) (q1217677_measure T);
  q1217677_measure_trim :
    forall S : q1217677_set R,
      exists T : q1217677_set R,
        q1217677_measurable T /\
        (forall x : R, S x -> T x) /\
        q1217677_ennreal_eq
          (q1217677_measure T) (q1217677_measure S);
  q1217677_measure_countable_additive :
    forall S : nat -> q1217677_set R,
      (forall n : nat, q1217677_measurable (S n)) ->
      q1217677_pairwise_disjoint S ->
      q1217677_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q1217677_measure (S n))
        (q1217677_measure (q1217677_countable_union S));
  q1217677_measure_Ioc :
    forall a b : R,
      q1217677_ennreal_eq
        (q1217677_measure (q1217677_Ioc a b))
        (q1217677_ennreal_finite
          (Rmax (b - a) 0) (Rmax_r (b - a) 0))
}.

Arguments q1217677_measurable _ _.
Arguments q1217677_measure _ _.

Definition q1217677_almost_everywhere
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (P : R -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q1217677_set R,
    q1217677_ennreal_eq
      (q1217677_measure L null_set)
      q1217677_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : R, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q1217677_normed_real_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1217677_zero : E;
  q1217677_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1217677_neg : E -> E;
  q1217677_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q1217677_norm : E -> R;
  q1217677_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1217677_add x (q1217677_add y z) =
      q1217677_add (q1217677_add x y) z;
  q1217677_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1217677_add x y = q1217677_add y x;
  q1217677_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1217677_add x q1217677_zero = x;
  q1217677_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1217677_add x (q1217677_neg x) = q1217677_zero;
  q1217677_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1217677_smul 1 x = x;
  q1217677_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1217677_smul (a * b) x =
      q1217677_smul a (q1217677_smul b x);
  q1217677_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1217677_smul (a + b) x =
      q1217677_add (q1217677_smul a x) (q1217677_smul b x);
  q1217677_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q1217677_smul a (q1217677_add x y) =
      q1217677_add (q1217677_smul a x) (q1217677_smul a y);
  q1217677_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q1217677_smul 0 x = q1217677_zero;
  q1217677_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1217677_smul a q1217677_zero = q1217677_zero;
  q1217677_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1217677_norm x;
  q1217677_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1217677_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1217677_zero;
  q1217677_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1217677_norm (q1217677_add x y) <=
      q1217677_norm x + q1217677_norm y;
  q1217677_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q1217677_norm (q1217677_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q1217677_norm x
}.

Arguments q1217677_zero {E} _.
Arguments q1217677_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1217677_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q1217677_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1217677_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q1217677_sub {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1217677_add V x (q1217677_neg V y).

Definition q1217677_vector_sequence_converges {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1217677_norm V
          (q1217677_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1217677_vector_sequence_cauchy {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1217677_norm V
          (q1217677_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1217677_complete {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q1217677_vector_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : E,
      q1217677_vector_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q1217677_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1217677_finite_partition
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q1217677_set R) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q1217677_measurable L (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q1217677_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : R,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q1217677_measurable_simple {E : Type}
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (s : R -> E) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> E)
         (cells : nat -> q1217677_set R),
    q1217677_finite_partition L k cells /\
    forall (x : R) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q1217677_strongly_measurable_on {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (S : q1217677_set R) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> R -> E,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1217677_measurable_simple L (approximants n)) /\
    forall x : R,
      S x ->
      q1217677_vector_sequence_converges V
        (fun n => approximants n x) (f x).

Definition q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> R -> E,
    (forall n : nat,
      q1217677_measurable_simple L (approximants n)) /\
    q1217677_almost_everywhere L
      (fun x =>
        q1217677_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q1217677_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q1217677_nnreal_value : R;
  q1217677_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q1217677_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q1217677_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q1217677_nonnegative_real) : q1217677_ennreal :=
  q1217677_ennreal_finite
    (q1217677_nnreal_value x)
    (q1217677_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q1217677_simple_lintegral_below
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> q1217677_ennreal)
    (value : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q1217677_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q1217677_set R),
    q1217677_finite_partition L k cells /\
    (forall (x : R) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q1217677_ennreal_le
        (q1217677_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q1217677_ennreal_eq value
      (q1217677_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q1217677_ennreal_mul
            (q1217677_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q1217677_measure L (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q1217677_lintegral_has_value
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> q1217677_ennreal)
    (value : q1217677_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q1217677_ennreal_supremum
    (q1217677_simple_lintegral_below L f) value.

Definition q1217677_norm_ennreal {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x : E) : q1217677_ennreal :=
  q1217677_ennreal_finite
    (q1217677_norm V x)
    (q1217677_norm_nonnegative V x).

Definition q1217677_indicator {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (S : q1217677_set R) (f : R -> E) (x : R) : E :=
  if excluded_middle_informative (S x)
  then f x
  else q1217677_zero V.

Definition q1217677_integrable {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) : Prop :=
  q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable V L f /\
  exists value : q1217677_ennreal,
    q1217677_lintegral_has_value L
      (fun x => q1217677_norm_ennreal V (f x)) value /\
    q1217677_ennreal_finite_value value.

Definition q1217677_integrable_on {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (S : q1217677_set R) : Prop :=
  q1217677_integrable V L (q1217677_indicator V S f).

Definition q1217677_interval_integrable {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (a b : R) : Prop :=
  q1217677_integrable_on V L f (q1217677_Ioc a b) /\
  q1217677_integrable_on V L f (q1217677_Ioc b a).

Fixpoint q1217677_vector_sum {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) (n : nat) : E :=
  match n with
  | O => q1217677_zero V
  | S k =>
      q1217677_add V
        (q1217677_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q1217677_weighted_cell_value {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (cell : q1217677_set R)
    (coefficient value : E) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q1217677_zero V /\
    value = q1217677_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q1217677_ennreal_represents
      (q1217677_measure L cell) mass /\
    value = q1217677_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q1217677_simple_integral_has_value {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (s : R -> E) (value : E) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> E)
         (cells : nat -> q1217677_set R),
    q1217677_finite_partition L k cells /\
    (forall (x : R) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q1217677_weighted_cell_value
        V L (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q1217677_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q1217677_l1_approximates {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (approximants : nat -> R -> E)
    (f : R -> E) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q1217677_ennreal,
        q1217677_lintegral_has_value L
          (fun x =>
            q1217677_norm_ennreal V
              (q1217677_sub V (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q1217677_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q1217677_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q1217677_standard_bochner_integral_value {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (value : E) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> R -> E)
         (integrals : nat -> E),
    (forall n : nat,
      q1217677_measurable_simple L (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q1217677_simple_integral_has_value
        V L (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q1217677_l1_approximates V L approximants f /\
    q1217677_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q1217677_bochner_integral {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) : E :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : E,
            q1217677_standard_bochner_integral_value V L f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits (q1217677_zero V))
        (fun value : E =>
          q1217677_standard_bochner_integral_value V L f value)
  | right _ => q1217677_zero V
  end.

Definition q1217677_interval_integral {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (a b : R) : E :=
  q1217677_sub V
    (q1217677_bochner_integral V L
      (q1217677_indicator V (q1217677_Ioc a b) f))
    (q1217677_bochner_integral V L
      (q1217677_indicator V (q1217677_Ioc b a) f)).

Definition q1217677_strongly_measurable_at {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (b : R) : Prop :=
  exists delta : R,
    0 < delta /\
    q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable V L
      (q1217677_indicator V
        (fun x => Rabs (x - b) < delta) f).

Definition q1217677_tendsto_ae_at {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
    (f : R -> E) (b : R) (c : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists (delta : R) (null_set : q1217677_set R),
      0 < delta /\
      q1217677_ennreal_eq
        (q1217677_measure L null_set)
        q1217677_ennreal_zero /\
      forall x : R,
        Rabs (x - b) < delta ->
        ~ null_set x ->
        q1217677_norm V
          (q1217677_sub V (f x) c) < epsilon.

Definition q1217677_continuous_within_at {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : R -> E) (S : q1217677_set R) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        S y ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        q1217677_norm V
          (q1217677_sub V (f y) (f x)) < epsilon.

Definition q1217677_continuous_on {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : R -> E) (S : q1217677_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    S x ->
    q1217677_continuous_within_at V f S x.

Definition q1217677_has_deriv_within_at {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : R -> E) (derivative : E)
    (S : q1217677_set R) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        S y ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        q1217677_norm V
          (q1217677_sub V
            (q1217677_sub V (f y) (f x))
            (q1217677_smul V (y - x) derivative))
        <= epsilon * Rabs (y - x).

Definition q1217677_has_strict_deriv_at {E : Type}
    (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : R -> E) (derivative : E) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y z : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs (z - x) < delta ->
        q1217677_norm V
          (q1217677_sub V
            (q1217677_sub V (f y) (f z))
            (q1217677_smul V (y - z) derivative))
        <= epsilon * Rabs (y - z).

Theorem intervalIntegral_integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
         (f : R -> E) (a b : R) (c : E),
    q1217677_complete V ->
    q1217677_interval_integrable V L f a b ->
    q1217677_strongly_measurable_at V L f b ->
    q1217677_tendsto_ae_at V L f b c ->
    q1217677_has_strict_deriv_at V
      (fun u => q1217677_interval_integral V L f a u) c b.
Admitted.

Theorem intervalIntegral_integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q1217677_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (L : q1217677_lebesgue_measure_space)
         (f f' : R -> E) (a b : R),
    q1217677_complete V ->
    a <= b ->
    q1217677_continuous_on V f (q1217677_Icc a b) ->
    (forall x : R,
      q1217677_Ioo a b x ->
      q1217677_has_deriv_within_at
        V f (f' x) (q1217677_Ioi x) x) ->
    q1217677_interval_integrable V L f' a b ->
    q1217677_interval_integral V L f' a b =
      q1217677_sub V (f b) (f a).
Admitted.

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1217677,
  "Fundamental theorem of calculus": strict differentiation of a Banach-space-valued
  indefinite Lebesgue-Bochner integral at an endpoint, and recovery of endpoint
  differences by integrating a right derivative. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
    "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
    "HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
      (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f x))"

definition q1217677_strongly_measurable_at ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1217677_strongly_measurable_at f b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>S. eventually (\<lambda>x. x \<in> S) (nhds b) \<and>
      q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable (restrict_space lborel S) f)"

definition q1217677_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1217677_has_bochner_integral M f I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
      (\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+ x. ennreal (norm (f x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0 \<and>
      (\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> I)"

definition q1217677_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1217677_integrable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>I. q1217677_has_bochner_integral M f I)"

definition q1217677_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q1217677_bochner_integral M f =
    (if \<exists>I. q1217677_has_bochner_integral M f I
     then THE I. q1217677_has_bochner_integral M f I
     else 0)"

definition q1217677_interval_integrable ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1217677_interval_integrable f a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1217677_integrable (restrict_space lborel {a<..b}) f \<and>
    q1217677_integrable (restrict_space lborel {b<..a}) f"

definition q1217677_interval_integral ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q1217677_interval_integral f a b =
    q1217677_bochner_integral (restrict_space lborel {a<..b}) f -
    q1217677_bochner_integral (restrict_space lborel {b<..a}) f"

definition q1217677_has_strict_vector_derivative ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1217677_has_strict_vector_derivative F c b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>e>0. eventually
      (\<lambda>p. norm ((F (fst p) - F (snd p)) -
          (fst p - snd p) *\<^sub>R c)
        \<le> e * norm (fst p - snd p))
      (nhds (b, b)))"

theorem integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space}"
    and a b :: real
    and c :: 'e
  assumes interval_integrable:
      "q1217677_interval_integrable f a b"
    and strongly_measurable_at:
      "q1217677_strongly_measurable_at f b"
    and tendsto_ae_right:
      "filterlim f (nhds c) (inf (nhds b) (ae_filter lborel))"
  shows "q1217677_has_strict_vector_derivative
    (\<lambda>u. q1217677_interval_integral f a u) c b"
  sorry

theorem integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le:
  fixes f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space}"
    and a b :: real
  assumes le: "a \<le> b"
    and continuous: "continuous_on {a..b} f"
    and right_derivative:
      "\<forall>x \<in> {a<..<b}.
        (f has_vector_derivative f' x) (at x within {x<..})"
    and interval_integrable:
      "q1217677_interval_integrable f' a b"
  shows "q1217677_interval_integral f' a b = f b - f a"
  sorry

end

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1217677,
  "Fundamental theorem of calculus": the strict-derivative form of FTC-1 for
  Banach-valued Lebesgue interval integrals under local almost-everywhere
  strong measurability and an almost-everywhere endpoint limit, and the
  right-derivative form of FTC-2 for continuous Banach-valued functions.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1217677_FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:real->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:real->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->real->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:real | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!s:real->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->real->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:real | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let borel_events =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra (:real) events /\
        (!a b:real. events {x:real | a < x /\ x <= b}) /\
        (!other:(real->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra (:real) other /\
           (!a b:real. other {x:real | a < x /\ x <= b})
           ==> !s:real->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let lebesgue_measure =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real).
        borel_events events /\
        measure_space (:real) events mu /\
        (!a b:real.
           mu {x:real | a < x /\ x <= b} =
           if a <= b then (F,b - a) else ezero) in
   !events:(real->bool)->bool
    mu:(real->bool)->bool#real.
    lebesgue_measure events mu
    ==>
   (let real_lebesgue_measurable =
      \(s:real->bool). events s in
   let real_negligible =
      \(s:real->bool).
        ?N:real->bool.
          events N /\ mu N = ezero /\ s SUBSET N in
   let real_measurable =
      \(s:real->bool).
        events s /\ ~(FST (mu s)) in
   let real_measure =
      \(s:real->bool). SND (mu s) in
   let normed_real_vector_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real).
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x:A. neg (neg x) = x) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real x:A. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real x:A.
           smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a:real x y:A.
           smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!x:A. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!a:real x:A. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
        (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (u:num->A) (l:A).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                       ==> norm (add (u n) (neg l)) < e in
   let complete_space =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
        !u:num->A.
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?N. !m n.
                     N <= m /\ N <= n
                     ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < e)
          ==> ?l:A. vector_tends zero add neg norm u l in
   let simple_scalar_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (s:real->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real.
           real_lebesgue_measurable
             {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_vector_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (s:real->A).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:A.
           real_lebesgue_measurable
             {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (h:real->A).
        ?s:num->real->A.
          (!n. simple_vector_on carrier (s n)) /\
          (!x:real.
             x IN carrier
             ==> vector_tends zero add neg norm
                   (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (h:real->A).
        ?g:real->A.
          strongly_measurable_vector_on
            carrier zero add neg norm g /\
          real_negligible
            {x:real | x IN carrier /\ ~(h x = g x)} in
   let integrable_simple_scalar_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (s:real->real).
        simple_scalar_on carrier s /\
        (!c:real.
           c IN IMAGE s carrier /\ ~(c = &0)
           ==> real_measurable
                 {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let integrable_simple_vector_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (s:real->A).
        simple_vector_on carrier s /\
        (!c:A.
           c IN IMAGE s carrier /\ ~(c = zero)
           ==> real_measurable
                 {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_scalar_integral_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (s:real->real) (z:real).
        ?n enum partial.
          (!c:real.
             c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
             ?i. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = &0 /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   real_measure
                     {x:real |
                        x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i} *
                   enum i + partial i) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_vector_integral_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (smul:real->A->A) (s:real->A) (z:A).
        ?n enum partial.
          (!c:A.
             c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
             ?i. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   add
                     (smul
                       (real_measure
                         {x:real |
                            x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i})
                       (enum i))
                     (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (h:real->real) (u:real).
        !s:real->real z:real.
          integrable_simple_scalar_on carrier s /\
          (!x:real.
             x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x /\ s x <= h x) /\
          simple_scalar_integral_on carrier s z
          ==> z <= u in
   let has_nonnegative_integral_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (h:real->real) (r:real).
        &0 <= r /\
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound_on carrier h r /\
        (!u:real.
           &0 <= u /\
           nonnegative_integral_upper_bound_on carrier h u
           ==> r <= u) in
   let vector_integrable_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (h:real->A).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector_on
          carrier zero add neg norm h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral_on carrier
             (\x:real. norm(h x)) r) in
   let has_bochner_integral_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A) (z:A).
        ?s:num->real->A ints:num->A.
          (!n. integrable_simple_vector_on carrier zero (s n)) /\
          (!n. simple_vector_integral_on
                 carrier zero add smul (s n) (ints n)) /\
          (!e. &0 < e
               ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                     ==> ?d:real.
                           has_nonnegative_integral_on carrier
                             (\x:real.
                                norm
                                  (add (s n x) (neg (h x)))) d /\
                           d < e) /\
          vector_tends zero add neg norm ints z in
   let bochner_integral_on =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A).
        if complete_space zero add neg norm /\
           vector_integrable_on
             carrier zero add neg norm h
        then @z:A.
               has_bochner_integral_on
                 carrier zero add neg smul norm h z
        else zero in
   let interval_integrable =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A) (a:real) (b:real).
        vector_integrable_on
          {x:real | a < x /\ x <= b} zero add neg norm h /\
        vector_integrable_on
          {x:real | b < x /\ x <= a} zero add neg norm h in
   let interval_integral =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A) (a:real) (b:real).
        add
          (bochner_integral_on
             {x:real | a < x /\ x <= b}
             zero add neg smul norm h)
          (neg
            (bochner_integral_on
              {x:real | b < x /\ x <= a}
              zero add neg smul norm h)) in
   let locally_ae_strongly_measurable_at =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A) (b:real).
        ?d. &0 < d /\
            ae_strongly_measurable_vector_on
              {x:real | abs(x - b) < d}
              zero add neg norm h in
   let ae_tends_at =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A) (b:real) (c:A).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d N.
                  &0 < d /\
                  real_negligible N /\
                  (!x:real.
                     abs(x - b) < d /\ ~(x IN N)
                     ==> norm (add (h x) (neg c)) < e) in
   let continuous_on =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
       (h:real->A) (carrier:real->bool).
        !x. x IN carrier
            ==> !e. &0 < e
                    ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                            !y. y IN carrier /\
                                abs(y - x) < d
                                ==> norm
                                      (add (h y) (neg (h x))) < e in
   let has_strict_derivative_at =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A)
       (norm:A->real) (h:real->A) (c:A) (b:real).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                    !x y.
                      abs(x - b) < d /\ abs(y - b) < d
                      ==> norm
                            (add
                              (add (h x) (neg (h y)))
                              (neg (smul (x - y) c)))
                          <= e * abs(x - y) in
   let has_right_derivative_within =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A)
       (norm:A->real) (h:real->A) (c:A) (x:real).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                    !y. x < y /\ abs(y - x) < d
                        ==> norm
                              (add
                                (add (h y) (neg (h x)))
                                (neg (smul (y - x) c)))
                            <= e * abs(y - x) in
   !zero:A
    add:A->A->A
    neg:A->A
    smul:real->A->A
    norm:A->real.
      normed_real_vector_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      complete_space zero add neg norm
      ==>
      ((!f:real->A c:A a b:real.
          interval_integrable zero add neg norm f a b /\
          locally_ae_strongly_measurable_at
            zero add neg norm f b /\
          ae_tends_at zero add neg norm f b c
          ==> has_strict_derivative_at
                add neg smul norm
                (\u. interval_integral
                       zero add neg smul norm f a u)
                c b) /\
       (!f f':real->A a b:real.
          a <= b /\
          continuous_on add neg norm f
            {x:real | a <= x /\ x <= b} /\
          (!x. a < x /\ x < b
               ==> has_right_derivative_within
                     add neg smul norm f (f' x) x) /\
          interval_integrable zero add neg norm f' a b
          ==> interval_integral
                zero add neg smul norm f' a b =
              add (f b) (neg (f a)))))`;;

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1217677,
;; "Fundamental theorem of calculus": for Banach-space-valued functions on
;; real intervals, an almost-everywhere endpoint limit gives the strict
;; derivative of the indefinite Bochner integral, and an integrable right
;; derivative integrates to the endpoint difference. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Mathematical objects are unrestricted ACL2 objects. The conservative
;; interfaces below only provide application and constructor symbols; every
;; real-field, normed-space, measure, measurability, convergence, and Bochner
;; integration law used by the statement is imposed explicitly by predicates.

(defstub q1217677-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q1217677-zero (type) t)
(defstub q1217677-one (type) t)
(defstub q1217677-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-multiply (type left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-negate (type object) t)
(defstub q1217677-inverse (type object) t)
(defstub q1217677-less (type left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-norm (type object) t)
(defstub q1217677-smul (scalar-type space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q1217677-star (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1217677-real-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1217677-imag-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1217677-of-real (real-type scalar-type real) t)
(defstub q1217677-imaginary-unit (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q1217677-inner (scalar-type space left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q1217677-sequence-at (sequence index) t)
(defstub q1217677-basis-at (basis index) t)
(defstub q1217677-coordinate (coordinates vector index) t)
(defstub q1217677-derivative-function (derivatives function multiindex) t)
(defstub q1217677-fourier-function (fourier function) t)
(defstub q1217677-character-value (fourier-char real) t)
(defstub q1217677-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q1217677-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q1217677-open-ball-set (space center radius) t)
(defstub q1217677-preimage-set (function set) t)
(defstub q1217677-complement-set (carrier set) t)
(defstub q1217677-countable-union-set (carrier sequence) t)
(defstub q1217677-translate-set (space set shift) t)
(defstub q1217677-unit-cell-set (space basis coordinates dimension) t)
(defstub q1217677-fiber-set (function value) t)
(defstub q1217677-simple-values (function) t)
(defstub q1217677-indicator-function (real-type set) t)
(defstub q1217677-function-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-function-difference (type left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-function-norm (real-type type function) t)
(defstub q1217677-inner-integrand (scalar-type space left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-fourier-integrand
  (real-type scalar-type domain space fourier-char function frequency) t)
(defstub q1217677-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q1217677-lintegral-value (lintegral function) t)
(defstub q1217677-bochner-integral-value (integral function) t)
(defstub q1217677-full-set (carrier) t)
(defstub q1217677-point-sequence (function-sequence point) t)
(defstub q1217677-simple-integral-sequence
  (real-type domain space measure function-sequence) t)
(defstub q1217677-closed-interval-set (left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-open-interval-set (left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-right-ray-set (left) t)
(defstub q1217677-half-open-interval-set (left right) t)
(defstub q1217677-restricted-function (space function set) t)

(defun q1217677-positive-p (real-type x)
  (q1217677-less real-type (q1217677-zero real-type) x))

(defun q1217677-leq (real-type x y)
  (not (q1217677-less real-type y x)))

(defun q1217677-abs (real-type x)
  (if (q1217677-less real-type x (q1217677-zero real-type))
      (q1217677-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q1217677-natural-cast (type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1217677-zero type)
    (q1217677-add
     type
     (q1217677-one type)
     (q1217677-natural-cast type (- n 1)))))

(defun q1217677-integer-cast (type n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q1217677-negate
       type
       (q1217677-natural-cast type (- n)))
    (q1217677-natural-cast type (nfix n))))

(defun q1217677-real-power (real-type x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1217677-one real-type)
    (q1217677-multiply
     real-type x
     (q1217677-real-power real-type x (- n 1)))))

(defun q1217677-vector-sum
    (real-type space basis coordinates vector n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1217677-zero space)
    (let ((i (- n 1)))
      (q1217677-add
       space
       (q1217677-vector-sum
        real-type space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q1217677-smul
        real-type space
        (q1217677-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q1217677-basis-at basis i))))))

(defun q1217677-zero-multiindex (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (q1217677-zero-multiindex (- n 1)))))

(defun q1217677-natural-list-p (alpha n)
  (if (zp n)
      (equal alpha nil)
    (and
     (consp alpha)
     (natp (car alpha))
     (q1217677-natural-list-p (cdr alpha) (- n 1)))))

(defun q1217677-increment-multiindex (alpha i)
  (if (consp alpha)
      (if (zp i)
          (cons (+ 1 (nfix (car alpha))) (cdr alpha))
        (cons
         (car alpha)
         (q1217677-increment-multiindex (cdr alpha) (- i 1))))
    nil))

(defun q1217677-multiindex-degree (alpha)
  (if (consp alpha)
      (+ (nfix (car alpha))
         (q1217677-multiindex-degree (cdr alpha)))
    0))

;; Complete ordered real field and its canonical complexification.

(defun-sk q1217677-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p type x)
      (q1217677-member-p type y)
      (q1217677-member-p type z))
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p type (q1217677-add type x y))
      (q1217677-member-p type (q1217677-multiply type x y))
      (q1217677-member-p type (q1217677-negate type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q1217677-zero type)))
       (q1217677-member-p type (q1217677-inverse type x)))
      (equal
       (q1217677-add type (q1217677-add type x y) z)
       (q1217677-add type x (q1217677-add type y z)))
      (equal (q1217677-add type x y) (q1217677-add type y x))
      (equal (q1217677-add type x (q1217677-zero type)) x)
      (equal
       (q1217677-add type x (q1217677-negate type x))
       (q1217677-zero type))
      (equal
       (q1217677-multiply type (q1217677-multiply type x y) z)
       (q1217677-multiply type x (q1217677-multiply type y z)))
      (equal
       (q1217677-multiply type x y)
       (q1217677-multiply type y x))
      (equal (q1217677-multiply type x (q1217677-one type)) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q1217677-zero type)))
       (equal
        (q1217677-multiply type x (q1217677-inverse type x))
        (q1217677-one type)))
      (equal
       (q1217677-multiply type x (q1217677-add type y z))
       (q1217677-add
        type
        (q1217677-multiply type x y)
        (q1217677-multiply type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type y)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q1217677-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q1217677-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q1217677-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1217677-less real-type x y)
        (q1217677-less real-type y z))
       (q1217677-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q1217677-less real-type x y)
       (q1217677-less
        real-type
        (q1217677-add real-type x z)
        (q1217677-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1217677-positive-p real-type x)
        (q1217677-positive-p real-type y))
       (q1217677-positive-p
        real-type
        (q1217677-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun q1217677-distance
    (real-type type x y)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (q1217677-norm
   type
   (q1217677-add type x (q1217677-negate type y))))

(defun-sk q1217677-norm-values-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p type x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type (q1217677-norm type x))
      (q1217677-leq
       real-type
       (q1217677-zero real-type)
       (q1217677-norm type x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q1217677-norm type x)
        (q1217677-zero real-type))
       (equal x (q1217677-zero type)))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-norm-triangle-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p type x)
      (q1217677-member-p type y))
     (q1217677-leq
      real-type
      (q1217677-norm type (q1217677-add type x y))
      (q1217677-add
       real-type
       (q1217677-norm type x)
       (q1217677-norm type y))))))

(defun q1217677-norm-laws-p (real-type type)
  (and
   (q1217677-norm-values-p real-type type)
   (q1217677-norm-triangle-p real-type type)))

(defun-sk q1217677-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))
     (q1217677-less
      real-type
      (q1217677-distance
       real-type type
       (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-convergence-start-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1217677-convergence-tail-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q1217677-converges-p
    (real-type type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-convergence-start-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m) (natp n) (natp start)
      (<= start m) (<= start n))
     (q1217677-less
      real-type
      (q1217677-distance
       real-type type
       (q1217677-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-cauchy-start-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1217677-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q1217677-cauchy-p (real-type type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-cauchy-start-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-sequence-in-type-p (type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1217677-member-p
      type
      (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-limit-exists-p
    (real-type type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q1217677-member-p type limit)
     (q1217677-converges-p
      real-type type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q1217677-complete-p (real-type type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-sequence-in-type-p type sequence)
      (q1217677-cauchy-p real-type type sequence))
     (q1217677-limit-exists-p
      real-type type sequence))))

(defun-sk q1217677-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1217677-less
      real-type x
      (q1217677-natural-cast real-type n)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
     (q1217677-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q1217677-real-norm-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (equal
       (q1217677-norm real-type x)
       (q1217677-abs real-type x))
      (equal (q1217677-star real-type x) x)
      (equal
       (q1217677-real-part real-type real-type x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1217677-imag-part real-type real-type x)
       (q1217677-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q1217677-of-real real-type real-type x)
       x)))))

(defun q1217677-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q1217677-member-p real-type (q1217677-zero real-type))
   (q1217677-member-p real-type (q1217677-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1217677-zero real-type)
     (q1217677-one real-type)))
   (q1217677-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q1217677-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q1217677-positive-p real-type (q1217677-one real-type))
   (q1217677-real-norm-laws-p real-type)
   (q1217677-complete-p real-type real-type)
   (q1217677-archimedean-p real-type)))

;; Real and complex inner-product spaces.

(defun-sk q1217677-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q1217677-member-p scalar-type b)
      (q1217677-member-p space x)
      (q1217677-member-p space y)
      (q1217677-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space (q1217677-add space x y))
      (q1217677-member-p space (q1217677-negate space x))
      (q1217677-member-p
       space (q1217677-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (equal
       (q1217677-add space (q1217677-add space x y) z)
       (q1217677-add space x (q1217677-add space y z)))
      (equal (q1217677-add space x y) (q1217677-add space y x))
      (equal (q1217677-add space x (q1217677-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q1217677-add space x (q1217677-negate space x))
       (q1217677-zero space))
      (equal
       (q1217677-smul
        scalar-type space (q1217677-one scalar-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1217677-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q1217677-multiply scalar-type a b) x)
       (q1217677-smul
        scalar-type space a
        (q1217677-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1217677-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q1217677-add scalar-type a b) x)
       (q1217677-add
        space
        (q1217677-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q1217677-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1217677-smul
        scalar-type space a (q1217677-add space x y))
       (q1217677-add
        space
        (q1217677-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q1217677-smul scalar-type space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-normed-space-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q1217677-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q1217677-norm
       space
       (q1217677-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (q1217677-multiply
       real-type
       (q1217677-norm scalar-type a)
       (q1217677-norm space x))))))

;; Borel sigma algebra and normalized translation-invariant volume.

(defun-sk q1217677-countable-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q1217677-valid-set-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-set-member-p set x)
     (q1217677-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q1217677-sets-equal-on-p (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p space x)
     (iff
      (q1217677-set-member-p left x)
      (q1217677-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-empty-on-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p space x)
     (not (q1217677-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-full-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-full-set space) x)
     (q1217677-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q1217677-complement-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-complement-set space set) x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space x)
      (not (q1217677-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-countable-union-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (sequence x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-countable-union-set space sequence) x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space x)
      (q1217677-countable-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-open-ball-set-law-p (real-type space)
  (forall (center radius x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-open-ball-set space center radius) x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space x)
      (q1217677-member-p space center)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type radius)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type space x center)
       radius)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-preimage-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function set x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-preimage-set function set) x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p domain x)
      (q1217677-set-member-p
       set (q1217677-function-at function x))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-translate-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set shift x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-translate-set space set shift) x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space x)
      (q1217677-set-member-p
       set
       (q1217677-add
        space x (q1217677-negate space shift)))))))

(defun q1217677-set-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type space)
  (and
   (q1217677-full-set-law-p space)
   (q1217677-complement-set-law-p space)
   (q1217677-countable-union-set-law-p space)
   (q1217677-open-ball-set-law-p real-type space)
   (q1217677-translate-set-law-p space)))

(defun-sk q1217677-sequence-measurable-p (family sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1217677-family-member-p
      family
      (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-family-valid-sets-p (space family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1217677-family-member-p family set)
     (q1217677-valid-set-p space set))))

(defun-sk q1217677-family-extensional-p (space family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-family-member-p family left)
      (q1217677-valid-set-p space right)
      (q1217677-sets-equal-on-p space left right))
     (q1217677-family-member-p family right))))

(defun-sk q1217677-sigma-algebra-closure-p (space family)
  (forall (set sequence)
    (and
     (q1217677-family-member-p family (q1217677-full-set space))
     (implies
      (q1217677-family-member-p family set)
      (q1217677-family-member-p
       family (q1217677-complement-set space set)))
     (implies
      (q1217677-sequence-measurable-p family sequence)
      (q1217677-family-member-p
       family
       (q1217677-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun q1217677-sigma-algebra-p (space family)
  (and
   (q1217677-family-valid-sets-p space family)
   (q1217677-family-extensional-p space family)
   (q1217677-sigma-algebra-closure-p space family)))

(defun-sk q1217677-balls-measurable-p
    (real-type space family)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space center)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type radius)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type radius))
     (q1217677-family-member-p
      family
      (q1217677-open-ball-set space center radius)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-family-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1217677-family-member-p left set)
     (q1217677-family-member-p right set))))

(defun-sk q1217677-borel-minimal-p
    (real-type space borel)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-sigma-algebra-p space candidate)
      (q1217677-balls-measurable-p
       real-type space candidate))
     (q1217677-family-subset-p borel candidate))))

(defun q1217677-borel-space-p
    (real-type space borel)
  (and
   (q1217677-sigma-algebra-p space borel)
   (q1217677-balls-measurable-p real-type space borel)
   (q1217677-borel-minimal-p real-type space borel)))

(defun q1217677-ennreal-p (real-type x)
  (or
   (equal x :q1217677-top)
   (and
    (consp x)
    (equal (car x) :q1217677-finite)
    (q1217677-member-p real-type (cdr x))
    (q1217677-leq
     real-type (q1217677-zero real-type) (cdr x)))))

(defun q1217677-ennreal-finite (x)
  (cons :q1217677-finite x))

(defun q1217677-ennreal-add (real-type x y)
  (if (or
       (equal x :q1217677-top)
       (equal y :q1217677-top))
      :q1217677-top
    (q1217677-ennreal-finite
     (q1217677-add real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun q1217677-ennreal-leq-p (real-type x y)
  (or
   (equal y :q1217677-top)
   (and
    (not (equal x :q1217677-top))
    (q1217677-leq real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-disjoint-sequence-p
    (space sequence)
  (forall (i j x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i) (natp j)
      (not (equal i j))
      (q1217677-member-p space x))
     (not
      (and
       (q1217677-set-member-p
        (q1217677-sequence-at sequence i) x)
       (q1217677-set-member-p
        (q1217677-sequence-at sequence j) x))))))

(defun q1217677-ennreal-partial-sum
    (real-type measure sequence n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1217677-ennreal-finite (q1217677-zero real-type))
    (q1217677-ennreal-add
     real-type
     (q1217677-ennreal-partial-sum
      real-type measure sequence (- n 1))
     (q1217677-measure-value
      measure
      (q1217677-sequence-at sequence (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-ennreal-upper-bound-p
    (real-type measure sequence bound)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1217677-ennreal-leq-p
      real-type
      (q1217677-ennreal-partial-sum
       real-type measure sequence n)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1217677-ennreal-series-value-p
    (real-type measure sequence value)
  (forall (bound)
    (iff
     (q1217677-ennreal-upper-bound-p
      real-type measure sequence bound)
     (q1217677-ennreal-leq-p real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q1217677-countable-additivity-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q1217677-disjoint-sequence-p space sequence))
     (q1217677-ennreal-series-value-p
      real-type
      measure
      sequence
      (q1217677-measure-value
       measure
       (q1217677-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-measure-values-p (real-type measure)
  (forall (set)
    (q1217677-ennreal-p
     real-type
     (q1217677-measure-value measure set))))

(defun-sk q1217677-measure-extensional-p (space measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-valid-set-p space left)
      (q1217677-valid-set-p space right)
      (q1217677-sets-equal-on-p space left right))
     (equal
      (q1217677-measure-value measure left)
      (q1217677-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-empty-measurable-zero-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-family-member-p measurable set)
      (q1217677-empty-on-p space set))
     (equal
      (q1217677-measure-value measure set)
      (q1217677-ennreal-finite
       (q1217677-zero real-type))))))

(defun q1217677-measure-space-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (and
   (q1217677-sigma-algebra-p space measurable)
   (q1217677-measure-values-p real-type measure)
   (q1217677-measure-extensional-p space measure)
   (q1217677-empty-measurable-zero-p
    real-type space measurable measure)
   (equal
    (q1217677-measure-value
     measure
     (q1217677-complement-set
      space (q1217677-full-set space)))
    (q1217677-ennreal-finite (q1217677-zero real-type)))
   (q1217677-countable-additivity-p
    real-type space measurable measure)))

(defun q1217677-unit-coordinates-p
    (real-type coordinates x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      t
    (let ((c
           (q1217677-coordinate
            coordinates x (- n 1))))
      (and
       (q1217677-leq
        real-type (q1217677-zero real-type) c)
       (q1217677-less
        real-type c (q1217677-one real-type))
       (q1217677-unit-coordinates-p
        real-type coordinates x (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-unit-cell-coordinate-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-unit-cell-set
       space basis coordinates dimension)
      x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p space x)
      (q1217677-unit-coordinates-p
       real-type coordinates x dimension)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-translation-invariant-p
    (space measurable measure)
  (forall (set shift)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-family-member-p measurable set)
      (q1217677-member-p space shift))
     (equal
      (q1217677-measure-value
       measure
       (q1217677-translate-set space set shift))
      (q1217677-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun q1217677-volume-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension measurable measure)
  (and
   (q1217677-borel-space-p real-type space measurable)
   (q1217677-measure-space-p
    real-type space measurable measure)
   (q1217677-unit-cell-coordinate-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
   (q1217677-family-member-p
    measurable
    (q1217677-unit-cell-set
     space basis coordinates dimension))
   (equal
    (q1217677-measure-value
     measure
     (q1217677-unit-cell-set
      space basis coordinates dimension))
    (q1217677-ennreal-finite
     (q1217677-one real-type)))
   (q1217677-translation-invariant-p
    space measurable measure)))

;; Lebesgue lower integration and Bochner integration.

(defun-sk q1217677-function-into-p
    (domain codomain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p domain x)
     (q1217677-member-p
      codomain
      (q1217677-function-at function x)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-continuous-at-delta-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p domain y)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type domain y x)
       delta))
     (q1217677-less
      real-type
      (q1217677-distance
       real-type codomain
       (q1217677-function-at function y)
       (q1217677-function-at function x))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-continuous-at-epsilon-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q1217677-member-p real-type delta)
     (q1217677-positive-p real-type delta)
     (q1217677-continuous-at-delta-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q1217677-continuous-function-p
    (real-type domain codomain function)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p domain x)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-continuous-at-epsilon-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-function-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (type f g set value x)
    (and
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at
       (q1217677-function-add type f g) x)
      (q1217677-add
       type
       (q1217677-function-at f x)
       (q1217677-function-at g x)))
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at
       (q1217677-function-difference type f g) x)
      (q1217677-add
       type
       (q1217677-function-at f x)
       (q1217677-negate
        type (q1217677-function-at g x))))
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at
       (q1217677-function-norm real-type type f) x)
      (q1217677-norm type (q1217677-function-at f x)))
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at
       (q1217677-indicator-function real-type set) x)
      (if (q1217677-set-member-p set x)
          (q1217677-one real-type)
        (q1217677-zero real-type))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-fiber-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function value x)
    (iff
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-fiber-set function value)
      x)
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p domain x)
      (equal (q1217677-function-at function x) value)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-measurable-function-p
    (real-type domain measurable codomain function)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p codomain center)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type radius)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type radius))
     (q1217677-family-member-p
      measurable
      (q1217677-preimage-set
       function
       (q1217677-open-ball-set
        codomain center radius))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-nonnegative-values-p
    (real-type domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p domain x)
     (q1217677-leq
      real-type
      (q1217677-zero real-type)
      (q1217677-function-at function x)))))

(defun q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
    (real-type domain measurable function)
  (and
   (q1217677-function-into-p
    domain real-type function)
   (q1217677-measurable-function-p
    real-type domain measurable real-type function)
   (q1217677-nonnegative-values-p
    real-type domain function)))

(defun-sk q1217677-pointwise-leq-p
    (real-type domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p domain x)
     (q1217677-leq
      real-type
      (q1217677-function-at left x)
      (q1217677-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-functions-equal-on-p
    (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at left x)
      (q1217677-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-lintegral-laws-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (f g set)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1217677-functions-equal-on-p domain f g)
      (equal
       (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
       real-type domain measurable f)
      (q1217677-ennreal-p
       real-type
       (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral f)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)
       (q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable g)
       (q1217677-pointwise-leq-p real-type domain f g))
      (q1217677-ennreal-leq-p
       real-type
       (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q1217677-family-member-p measurable set)
      (equal
       (q1217677-lintegral-value
        lintegral
        (q1217677-indicator-function real-type set))
       (q1217677-measure-value measure set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)
       (q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable g))
      (equal
       (q1217677-lintegral-value
        lintegral
        (q1217677-function-add real-type f g))
       (q1217677-ennreal-add
        real-type
        (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral f)
        (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral g)))))))

(defun q1217677-simple-values-correct-p
    (domain measurable function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1217677-family-member-p
        measurable
        (q1217677-fiber-set function (car values)))
       (q1217677-simple-values-correct-p
        domain measurable function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1217677-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
    (space values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1217677-member-p space (car values))
       (q1217677-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
        space (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q1217677-simple-range-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-member-p domain x)

      (q1217677-function-at function x)
      values))))

(defun-sk q1217677-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1217677-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at function x)
      value))))

(defun q1217677-simple-function-p
    (domain measurable space function)
  (and
   (q1217677-function-into-p domain space function)
   (true-listp (q1217677-simple-values function))
   (no-duplicatesp-equal (q1217677-simple-values function))
   (q1217677-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
    space (q1217677-simple-values function))
   (q1217677-simple-values-correct-p
    domain measurable function
    (q1217677-simple-values function))
   (q1217677-simple-range-values-p
    domain function
    (q1217677-simple-values function))))

(defun q1217677-simple-integrable-values-p
    (real-type domain measure zero function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (implies
        (not
         (q1217677-value-attained-p
          domain function (car values)))
        (equal
         (q1217677-measure-value
          measure
          (q1217677-fiber-set function (car values)))
         (q1217677-ennreal-finite
          (q1217677-zero real-type))))
       (or
        (equal (car values) zero)
        (not
         (equal
          (q1217677-measure-value
           measure
           (q1217677-fiber-set function (car values)))
          :q1217677-top)))
       (q1217677-simple-integrable-values-p
        real-type domain measure zero function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1217677-simple-integral
    (real-type domain space measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q1217677-add
       space
       (if (or
            (equal (car values) (q1217677-zero space))
            (not
             (q1217677-value-attained-p
              domain function (car values))))
           (q1217677-zero space)
         (q1217677-smul
          real-type space
          (cdr
           (q1217677-measure-value
            measure
            (q1217677-fiber-set function (car values))))
          (car values)))
       (q1217677-simple-integral
        real-type domain space measure function (cdr values)))
    (q1217677-zero space)))

(defun q1217677-ennreal-scale
    (real-type scalar value)
  (if (equal scalar (q1217677-zero real-type))

    (if (equal value :q1217677-top)
        :q1217677-top
      (q1217677-ennreal-finite
       (q1217677-multiply
        real-type scalar (cdr value))))))

(defun q1217677-simple-nonnegative-integral
    (real-type domain measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q1217677-ennreal-add
       real-type
       (if
           (q1217677-value-attained-p
            domain function (car values))
           (q1217677-ennreal-scale
            real-type
            (car values)
            (q1217677-measure-value
             measure
             (q1217677-fiber-set function (car values))))
         (q1217677-ennreal-finite
          (q1217677-zero real-type)))
       (q1217677-simple-nonnegative-integral
        real-type domain measure function (cdr values)))
    (q1217677-ennreal-finite
     (q1217677-zero real-type))))

(defun-sk q1217677-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple)
    (implies

      (q1217677-simple-function-p

      (q1217677-pointwise-leq-p
       real-type domain simple function))
     (q1217677-ennreal-leq-p
      real-type
      (q1217677-simple-nonnegative-integral
       real-type domain measure simple
       (q1217677-simple-values simple))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1217677-lintegral-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure function value)

      (q1217677-ennreal-p real-type bound)
      (q1217677-lintegral-upper-bound-p
       real-type domain measurable measure function bound))
     (q1217677-ennreal-leq-p real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q1217677-lintegral-supremum-laws-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)

     (q1217677-nonnegative-measurable-p
      real-type domain measurable function)

            (q1217677-lintegral-value

        (q1217677-ennreal-p real-type value)

         real-type domain measurable measure function value))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-simple-sequence-p

      (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q1217677-simple-integral-sequence-laws-p ()
  (forall (real-type domain space measure sequence n)
    (equal
     (q1217677-sequence-at
      (q1217677-simple-integral-sequence

      real-type domain space measure
      (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n)
