       (q1217677-sequence-at sequence n))))))

(defun q1217677-bochner-approximation-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral
     space function value sequence)
  (and
   (q1217677-integrable-simple-sequence-p
    real-type domain measurable measure space sequence)
   (q1217677-l1-converges-p
    real-type space lintegral sequence function)
   (q1217677-converges-p
    real-type space
    (q1217677-simple-integral-sequence
     real-type domain space measure sequence)
    value)))

(defun-sk q1217677-bochner-approximation-exists-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral
     space function value)
  (exists (sequence)
    (q1217677-bochner-approximation-p
     real-type domain measurable measure lintegral
     space function value sequence)))

(defun-sk q1217677-bochner-integral-operation-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral space integral)
  (forall (function other)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1217677-functions-equal-on-p
       domain function other)
      (equal
       (q1217677-bochner-integral-value
        integral function)
       (q1217677-bochner-integral-value
        integral other)))
     (implies
      (q1217677-function-into-p domain space function)
      (let ((value
             (q1217677-bochner-integral-value
              integral function)))
        (and
         (q1217677-member-p space value)
         (if
             (and
              (q1217677-complete-p real-type space)
              (q1217677-integrable-p
               real-type domain measurable lintegral
               space function))
             (q1217677-bochner-approximation-exists-p
              real-type domain measurable measure lintegral
              space function value)
           (equal value (q1217677-zero space)))))))))
;; The source domain is an arbitrary measurable space, so only the set
;; constructors needed for a sigma algebra are required on it.

(defun q1217677-basic-set-constructor-laws-p (domain)
  (and
   (q1217677-full-set-law-p domain)
   (q1217677-complement-set-law-p domain)
   (q1217677-countable-union-set-law-p domain)))

;; A real normed vector space need not be complete. This distinction is
;; semantically relevant because mathlib defines its Bochner integral to be
;; zero when the codomain is incomplete.

(defun q1217677-real-normed-space-p (real-type space)
  (and
   (q1217677-member-p space (q1217677-zero space))
   (q1217677-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q1217677-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q1217677-normed-space-laws-p real-type real-type space)))

;; Almost-everywhere predicates use a measurable null envelope, which is
;; equivalent to membership in the measure's almost-everywhere filter.

(defun q1217677-null-measurable-set-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure set)
  (and
   (q1217677-valid-set-p domain set)
   (q1217677-family-member-p measurable set)
   (equal
    (q1217677-measure-value measure set)
    (q1217677-ennreal-finite
     (q1217677-zero real-type)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-equal-off-set-p
    (domain left right exceptional)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p domain x)
      (not (q1217677-set-member-p exceptional x)))
     (equal
      (q1217677-function-at left x)
      (q1217677-function-at right x)))))

(defun q1217677-ae-equal-witness-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure left right exceptional)
  (and
   (q1217677-null-measurable-set-p
    real-type domain measurable measure exceptional)
   (q1217677-equal-off-set-p
    domain left right exceptional)))

(defun-sk q1217677-ae-equal-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure left right)
  (exists (exceptional)
    (q1217677-ae-equal-witness-p
     real-type domain measurable measure
     left right exceptional)))

(defun q1217677-ae-strongly-measurable-witness-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure
     space function representative)
  (and
   (q1217677-function-into-p
    domain space representative)
   (q1217677-strongly-measurable-p
    real-type domain measurable space representative)
   (q1217677-ae-equal-p
    real-type domain measurable measure
    function representative)))

(defun-sk q1217677-ae-strongly-measurable-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure space function)
  (exists (representative)
    (q1217677-ae-strongly-measurable-witness-p
     real-type domain measurable measure
     space function representative)))

(defun q1217677-ae-integrable-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure
     lintegral space function)
  (and
   (q1217677-function-into-p domain space function)
   (q1217677-ae-strongly-measurable-p
    real-type domain measurable measure space function)
   (not
    (equal
     (q1217677-lintegral-value
      lintegral
      (q1217677-function-norm
       real-type space function))
     :q1217677-top))))

;; Both lower integration and Bochner integration are invariant under
;; almost-everywhere equality. The Bochner operation uses the same simple
;; function/L1 characterization as above, and returns zero for incomplete
;; codomains or nonintegrable functions, matching mathlib's total integral.

(defun-sk q1217677-lintegral-ae-congruence-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q1217677-ae-equal-p
      real-type domain measurable measure left right)
     (equal
      (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral left)
      (q1217677-lintegral-value lintegral right)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-bochner-integral-ae-operation-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure
     lintegral space integral)
  (forall (function other)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1217677-ae-equal-p
       real-type domain measurable measure function other)
      (equal
       (q1217677-bochner-integral-value integral function)
       (q1217677-bochner-integral-value integral other)))
     (implies
      (q1217677-function-into-p domain space function)
      (let ((value
             (q1217677-bochner-integral-value
              integral function)))
        (and
         (q1217677-member-p space value)
         (if
             (and
              (q1217677-complete-p real-type space)
              (q1217677-ae-integrable-p
               real-type domain measurable measure
               lintegral space function))
             (q1217677-bochner-approximation-exists-p
              real-type domain measurable measure lintegral
              space function value)
           (equal value (q1217677-zero space)))))))))

;; Real interval constructors, restriction by zero, and normalized Lebesgue
;; volume.  The half-open interval is (left,right], so the signed interval
;; integral below is integral_(a,b] f - integral_(b,a] f.

(defun-sk q1217677-real-interval-constructor-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (a b x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type a)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type b))
     (and
      (iff
       (q1217677-set-member-p
        (q1217677-closed-interval-set a b) x)
       (and
        (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
        (q1217677-leq real-type a x)
        (q1217677-leq real-type x b)))
      (iff
       (q1217677-set-member-p
        (q1217677-open-interval-set a b) x)
       (and
        (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
        (q1217677-less real-type a x)
        (q1217677-less real-type x b)))
      (iff
       (q1217677-set-member-p
        (q1217677-right-ray-set a) x)
       (and
        (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
        (q1217677-less real-type a x)))
      (iff
       (q1217677-set-member-p
        (q1217677-half-open-interval-set a b) x)
       (and
        (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
        (q1217677-less real-type a x)
        (q1217677-leq real-type x b)))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-restricted-function-laws-p ()
  (forall (space function set x)
    (equal
     (q1217677-function-at
      (q1217677-restricted-function space function set) x)
     (if (q1217677-set-member-p set x)
         (q1217677-function-at function x)
       (q1217677-zero space)))))

(defun q1217677-lebesgue-volume-p
    (real-type measurable measure)
  (and
   (q1217677-borel-space-p real-type real-type measurable)
   (q1217677-measure-space-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure)
   (q1217677-translation-invariant-p
    real-type measurable measure)
   (q1217677-family-member-p
    measurable
    (q1217677-half-open-interval-set
     (q1217677-zero real-type)
     (q1217677-one real-type)))
   (equal
    (q1217677-measure-value
     measure
     (q1217677-half-open-interval-set
      (q1217677-zero real-type)
      (q1217677-one real-type)))
    (q1217677-ennreal-finite
     (q1217677-one real-type)))))

(defun q1217677-analysis-context-p
    (real-type space measurable measure lintegral integral)
  (and
   (q1217677-real-field-p real-type)
   (q1217677-real-normed-space-p real-type space)
   (q1217677-complete-p real-type space)
   (q1217677-basic-set-constructor-laws-p real-type)
   (q1217677-open-ball-set-law-p real-type real-type)
   (q1217677-preimage-set-law-p real-type)
   (q1217677-translate-set-law-p real-type)
   (q1217677-fiber-set-law-p real-type)
   (q1217677-real-interval-constructor-laws-p real-type)
   (q1217677-restricted-function-laws-p)
   (q1217677-function-constructor-laws-p real-type)
   (q1217677-point-sequence-laws-p)
   (q1217677-simple-integral-sequence-laws-p)
   (q1217677-lebesgue-volume-p
    real-type measurable measure)
   (q1217677-lintegral-laws-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure lintegral)
   (q1217677-lintegral-supremum-laws-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure lintegral)
   (q1217677-lintegral-ae-congruence-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure lintegral)
   (q1217677-bochner-integral-ae-operation-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure
    lintegral space integral)))

;; Signed Bochner interval integration and interval integrability.

(defun q1217677-interval-integral-value
    (space integral function a b)
  (q1217677-add
   space
   (q1217677-bochner-integral-value
    integral
    (q1217677-restricted-function
     space function
     (q1217677-half-open-interval-set a b)))
   (q1217677-negate
    space
    (q1217677-bochner-integral-value
     integral
     (q1217677-restricted-function
      space function
      (q1217677-half-open-interval-set b a))))))

(defun q1217677-interval-integrable-p
    (real-type space measurable measure lintegral function a b)
  (and
   (q1217677-ae-integrable-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure lintegral space
    (q1217677-restricted-function
     space function
     (q1217677-half-open-interval-set a b)))
   (q1217677-ae-integrable-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure lintegral space
    (q1217677-restricted-function
     space function
     (q1217677-half-open-interval-set b a)))))

;; AE strong measurability at the neighborhood filter of b is expressed by an
;; AE strongly measurable zero extension on some open ball around b.

(defun q1217677-strongly-measurable-near-witness-p
    (real-type space measurable measure function b radius)
  (and
   (q1217677-member-p real-type radius)
   (q1217677-positive-p real-type radius)
   (q1217677-ae-strongly-measurable-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure space
    (q1217677-restricted-function
     space function
     (q1217677-open-ball-set real-type b radius)))))

(defun-sk q1217677-strongly-measurable-at-p
    (real-type space measurable measure function b)
  (exists (radius)
    (q1217677-strongly-measurable-near-witness-p
     real-type space measurable measure function b radius)))

;; Tendsto f (nhds b inf ae volume) (nhds c): for every target radius there
;; are a source neighborhood and a measurable null exceptional set.

(defun-sk q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-off-set-p
    (real-type space function b c epsilon radius exceptional)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type x b)
       radius)
      (not (q1217677-set-member-p exceptional x)))
     (q1217677-less
      real-type
      (q1217677-distance
       real-type space
       (q1217677-function-at function x) c)
      epsilon))))

(defun q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-witness-p
    (real-type space measurable measure
     function b c epsilon radius exceptional)
  (and
   (q1217677-member-p real-type radius)
   (q1217677-positive-p real-type radius)
   (q1217677-null-measurable-set-p
    real-type real-type measurable measure exceptional)
   (q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-off-set-p
    real-type space function b c epsilon radius exceptional)))

(defun-sk q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-at-epsilon-p
    (real-type space measurable measure function b c epsilon)
  (exists (radius exceptional)
    (q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-witness-p
     real-type space measurable measure
     function b c epsilon radius exceptional)))

(defun-sk q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-p
    (real-type space measurable measure function b c)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-at-epsilon-p
      real-type space measurable measure function b c epsilon))))

;; Strict derivative of u |-> integral a..u f at b with derivative c.

(defun-sk q1217677-interval-integral-strict-derivative-bound-p
    (real-type space integral function a b c epsilon radius)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type x)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type y)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type x b)
       radius)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type y b)
       radius))
     (q1217677-leq
      real-type
      (q1217677-norm
       space
       (q1217677-add
        space
        (q1217677-add
         space
         (q1217677-interval-integral-value
          space integral function a x)
         (q1217677-negate
          space
          (q1217677-interval-integral-value
           space integral function a y)))
        (q1217677-negate
         space
         (q1217677-smul
          real-type space
          (q1217677-add
           real-type x (q1217677-negate real-type y))
          c))))
      (q1217677-multiply
       real-type epsilon
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type x y))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-interval-integral-strict-derivative-epsilon-p
    (real-type space integral function a b c epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1217677-member-p real-type radius)
     (q1217677-positive-p real-type radius)
     (q1217677-interval-integral-strict-derivative-bound-p
      real-type space integral function a b c epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q1217677-interval-integral-has-strict-derivative-p
    (real-type space integral function a b c)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-interval-integral-strict-derivative-epsilon-p
      real-type space integral function a b c epsilon))))

;; Continuity on [a,b].

(defun-sk q1217677-continuous-on-delta-p
    (real-type space function set x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-set-member-p set y)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type y x)
       delta))
     (q1217677-less
      real-type
      (q1217677-distance
       real-type space
       (q1217677-function-at function y)
       (q1217677-function-at function x))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-continuous-on-epsilon-p
    (real-type space function set x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q1217677-member-p real-type delta)
     (q1217677-positive-p real-type delta)
     (q1217677-continuous-on-delta-p
      real-type space function set x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q1217677-continuous-on-p
    (real-type space function set)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-set-member-p set x)
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-continuous-on-epsilon-p
      real-type space function set x epsilon))))

;; HasDerivWithinAt f d (Ioi x) x, written as the usual one-sided
;; epsilon estimate on the derivative remainder.

(defun-sk q1217677-has-right-derivative-bound-p
    (real-type space function derivative x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type y)
      (q1217677-set-member-p
       (q1217677-right-ray-set x) y)
      (q1217677-less
       real-type
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type y x)
       delta))
     (q1217677-leq
      real-type
      (q1217677-norm
       space
       (q1217677-add
        space
        (q1217677-add
         space
         (q1217677-function-at function y)
         (q1217677-negate
          space (q1217677-function-at function x)))
        (q1217677-negate
         space
         (q1217677-smul
          real-type space
          (q1217677-add
           real-type y (q1217677-negate real-type x))
          derivative))))
      (q1217677-multiply
       real-type epsilon
       (q1217677-distance real-type real-type y x))))))

(defun-sk q1217677-has-right-derivative-epsilon-p
    (real-type space function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q1217677-member-p real-type delta)
     (q1217677-positive-p real-type delta)
     (q1217677-has-right-derivative-bound-p
      real-type space function derivative x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q1217677-has-right-derivative-p
    (real-type space function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1217677-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q1217677-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1217677-has-right-derivative-epsilon-p
      real-type space function derivative x epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1217677-has-right-derivative-on-open-interval-p
    (real-type space function derivative-function a b)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1217677-set-member-p
      (q1217677-open-interval-set a b) x)
     (q1217677-has-right-derivative-p
      real-type space function
      (q1217677-function-at derivative-function x) x))))

;; This predicate is exactly the indexed Lean theorem
;; intervalIntegral.integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right.

(defun thousand-theorems-q1217677-ftc-strict-derivative-statement
    (real-type space measurable measure lintegral integral
     function a b c)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1217677-analysis-context-p
     real-type space measurable measure lintegral integral)
    (q1217677-member-p real-type a)
    (q1217677-member-p real-type b)
    (q1217677-member-p space c)
    (q1217677-function-into-p real-type space function)
    (q1217677-interval-integrable-p
     real-type space measurable measure lintegral function a b)
    (q1217677-strongly-measurable-at-p
     real-type space measurable measure function b)
    (q1217677-tendsto-ae-near-p
     real-type space measurable measure function b c))
   (q1217677-interval-integral-has-strict-derivative-p
    real-type space integral function a b c)))

;; This predicate is exactly the indexed Lean theorem
;; intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le.

(defun thousand-theorems-q1217677-ftc-integral-equals-sub-statement
    (real-type space measurable measure lintegral integral
     function derivative-function a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1217677-analysis-context-p
     real-type space measurable measure lintegral integral)
    (q1217677-member-p real-type a)
    (q1217677-member-p real-type b)
    (q1217677-function-into-p real-type space function)
    (q1217677-function-into-p
     real-type space derivative-function)
    (q1217677-leq real-type a b)
    (q1217677-continuous-on-p
     real-type space function
     (q1217677-closed-interval-set a b))
    (q1217677-has-right-derivative-on-open-interval-p
     real-type space function derivative-function a b)
    (q1217677-interval-integrable-p
     real-type space measurable measure lintegral
     derivative-function a b))
   (equal
    (q1217677-interval-integral-value
     space integral derivative-function a b)
    (q1217677-add
     space
     (q1217677-function-at function b)
     (q1217677-negate
      space
      (q1217677-function-at function a))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1217677,
-- "Fundamental theorem of calculus": the almost-everywhere endpoint-limit
-- form of FTC-1 and the Banach-valued right-derivative form of FTC-2.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus where

open import Q1067156_dominated_convergence_theorem
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)

open CompleteOrderedField
open NormedVectorSpace
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

record BochnerIntegration
  {A R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set2 where
  field
    integralVector :
      (A -> E) -> E
    integral-vector-definition :
      (f : A -> E) ->
      TotalizedBochnerIntegralValue
        reals space events extended measure f
        (integralVector f)

open BochnerIntegration

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

OpenInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
OpenInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower point)
    (StrictLess reals point upper)

ClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
ClosedInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals lower point)
    (lessOrEqualR reals point upper)

OpenClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
OpenClosedInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower point)
    (lessOrEqualR reals point upper)

OpenBall :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
OpenBall reals center radius point =
  StrictLess reals (distanceR reals point center) radius

data BorelGenerated
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Predicate R -> Set1 where
  borel-open-interval :
    (lower upper : R) ->
    BorelGenerated reals (OpenInterval reals lower upper)
  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated reals emptySet
  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate R} ->
    BorelGenerated reals S ->
    BorelGenerated reals (complement S)
  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated reals (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated reals (countableUnion sets)
  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate R} ->
    ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated reals S ->
    BorelGenerated reals T

record BorelLebesguePresentation
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    events :
      SigmaAlgebra R
    extended :
      ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals
    volume :
      Measure extended events
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      BorelGenerated reals S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated reals S
    volume-open-interval :
      (lower upper : R) ->
      (ordered : lessOrEqualR reals lower upper) ->
      Exists
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (zeroR reals)
          (subtractR reals upper lower))
        (\ nonnegative-length ->
          outerMass volume (OpenInterval reals lower upper) ==
          finiteM extended
            (subtractR reals upper lower)
            nonnegative-length)

open BorelLebesguePresentation

record StronglyMeasurableOn
  {R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra R)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : R -> E)
  (domain : Predicate R) : Set1 where
  field
    extension :
      R -> E
    extension-strongly-measurable :
      StronglyMeasurable reals events (distanceE space) extension
    agrees-on-domain-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere measure
        (\ x ->
          domain x ->
          extension x == f x)

record StronglyMeasurableNear
  {R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra R)
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : R -> E)
  (point : R) : Set1 where
  field
    radius :
      R
    radius-positive :
      Positive reals radius
    measurable-on-ball :
      StronglyMeasurableOn
        reals space events measure f
        (OpenBall reals point radius)

AELimitAt :
  {R M E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra R} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  (R -> E) ->
  R ->
  E ->
  Set
AELimitAt reals space measure f point limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        (AlmostEverywhere measure
          (\ x ->
            OpenBall reals point radius x ->
            StrictLess reals
              (distanceE space (f x) limit)
              epsilon)))

ContinuousOn :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (R -> E) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
ContinuousOn reals space f domain =
  (point : _) ->
  domain point ->
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((x : _) ->
          domain x ->
          OpenBall reals point radius x ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE space (f x) (f point))
            epsilon))

DerivativeRemainder :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (R -> E) ->
  E ->
  R ->
  R ->
  E
DerivativeRemainder reals space f derivative x y =
  subtractE space
    (subtractE space (f y) (f x))
    (scaleE space (subtractR reals y x) derivative)

RightDerivativeAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (R -> E) ->
  E ->
  R ->
  Set
RightDerivativeAt reals space f derivative point =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          StrictLess reals point y ->
          OpenBall reals point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE space
              (DerivativeRemainder
                reals space f derivative point y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceR reals y point))))

StrictDerivativeAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (R -> E) ->
  E ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictDerivativeAt reals space f derivative point =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((x y : _) ->
          OpenBall reals point radius x ->
          OpenBall reals point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE space
              (DerivativeRemainder reals space f derivative x y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceR reals y x))))

record IntervalCalculus
  {R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra R}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  {measure : Measure extended events}
  (integration :
    BochnerIntegration reals space events extended measure) : Set2 where
  field
    positivePart :
      (R -> E) -> R -> R -> R -> E
    positive-part-on :
      (f : R -> E) ->
      (a b x : R) ->
      OpenClosedInterval reals a b x ->
      positivePart f a b x == f x
    positive-part-off :
      (f : R -> E) ->
      (a b x : R) ->
      Not (OpenClosedInterval reals a b x) ->
      positivePart f a b x == zeroE space

    negativePart :
      (R -> E) -> R -> R -> R -> E
    negative-part-on :
      (f : R -> E) ->
      (a b x : R) ->
      OpenClosedInterval reals b a x ->
      negativePart f a b x == f x
    negative-part-off :
      (f : R -> E) ->
      (a b x : R) ->
      Not (OpenClosedInterval reals b a x) ->
      negativePart f a b x == zeroE space

    intervalIntegral :
      (R -> E) -> R -> R -> E
    interval-integral-definition :
      (f : R -> E) ->
      (a b : R) ->
      intervalIntegral f a b ==
      subtractE space
        (integralVector integration (positivePart f a b))
        (integralVector integration (negativePart f a b))

open IntervalCalculus

record IntervalIntegrable
  {R M E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra R}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  {measure : Measure extended events}
  (integration :
    BochnerIntegration reals space events extended measure)
  (calculus :
    IntervalCalculus reals space integration)
  (f : R -> E)
  (a b : R) : Set1 where
  field
    positive-integrable :
      VectorIntegrable
        reals space events extended measure
        (positivePart calculus f a b)
    negative-integrable :
      VectorIntegrable
        reals space events extended measure
        (negativePart calculus f a b)

integral-has-strict-derivative-of-ae-limit-right : Set2
integral-has-strict-derivative-of-ae-limit-right =
  (R M E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  Complete reals (distanceE space) ->
  (lebesgue : BorelLebesguePresentation R M reals) ->
  (integration :
    BochnerIntegration
      reals space
      (events lebesgue)
      (extended lebesgue)
      (volume lebesgue)) ->
  (calculus : IntervalCalculus reals space integration) ->
  (f : R -> E) ->
  (a b : R) ->
  (c : E) ->
  IntervalIntegrable reals space integration calculus f a b ->
  StronglyMeasurableNear
    reals space
    (events lebesgue)
    (volume lebesgue)
    f b ->
  AELimitAt reals space (volume lebesgue) f b c ->
  StrictDerivativeAt reals space
    (\ u -> intervalIntegral calculus f a u)
    c b

integral-equals-subtraction-of-right-derivative : Set2
integral-equals-subtraction-of-right-derivative =
  (R M E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  Complete reals (distanceE space) ->
  (lebesgue : BorelLebesguePresentation R M reals) ->
  (integration :
    BochnerIntegration
      reals space
      (events lebesgue)
      (extended lebesgue)
      (volume lebesgue)) ->
  (calculus : IntervalCalculus reals space integration) ->
  (f f' : R -> E) ->
  (a b : R) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals a b ->
  ContinuousOn reals space f (ClosedInterval reals a b) ->
  ((x : R) ->
    OpenInterval reals a b x ->
    RightDerivativeAt reals space f (f' x) x) ->
  IntervalIntegrable reals space integration calculus f' a b ->
  intervalIntegral calculus f' a b ==
  subtractE space (f b) (f a)

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1217677, "Fundamental theorem of calculus": Banach-valued interval
  integrals have the expected strict derivative at an almost-everywhere
  Lebesgue point, and integrate a continuous function's right derivative to
  its endpoint difference. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q1217677_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q1217677_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1217677_tendsto_seq_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_tendsto_seq_def",
  ``q1217677_tendsto_seq
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !n. N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q1217677_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_cauchy_def",
  ``q1217677_cauchy
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (u : num -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N. !p q. N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
          norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q1217677_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_complete_def",
  ``q1217677_complete
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'g.
        q1217677_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell. q1217677_tendsto_seq add neg norm u ell``);

val q1217677_measurable_simple_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_measurable_simple_on_def",
  ``q1217677_measurable_simple_on
      (s : real set) (phi : real -> 'g) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE phi s) /\
      !y : 'g. {x | x IN s /\ phi x = y} IN measurable_sets lborel``);

val q1217677_strongly_measurable_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_strongly_measurable_on_def",
  ``q1217677_strongly_measurable_on
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'g) <=>
      ?phi : num -> real -> 'g.
        (!n. q1217677_measurable_simple_on s (phi n)) /\
        !x. x IN s ==>
          q1217677_tendsto_seq add neg norm (\n. phi n x) (f x)``);

val q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable_on_def",
  ``q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable_on
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'g) <=>
      ?g : real -> 'g.
        q1217677_strongly_measurable_on add neg norm s g /\
        (AE x::lborel. x IN s ==> f x = g x)``);

val q1217677_bochner_integrable_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_bochner_integrable_on_def",
  ``q1217677_bochner_integrable_on
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'g) <=>
      ?g : real -> 'g.
        q1217677_strongly_measurable_on add neg norm s g /\
        integrable lborel
          (Normal o (\x. if x IN s then norm (g x) else 0)) /\
        (AE x::lborel. x IN s ==> f x = g x)``);

val q1217677_simple_integral_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_simple_integral_on_def",
  ``q1217677_simple_integral_on
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (s : real set) (phi : real -> 'g) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add
            (smul
              (real (measure lborel {x | x IN s /\ phi x = y})) y)
            acc)
        (IMAGE phi s) zero``);

val q1217677_bochner_approximates_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_bochner_approximates_on_def",
  ``q1217677_bochner_approximates_on
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'g)
      (phi : num -> real -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      ?g : real -> 'g.
        q1217677_strongly_measurable_on add neg norm s g /\
        integrable lborel
          (Normal o (\x. if x IN s then norm (g x) else 0)) /\
        (AE x::lborel. x IN s ==> f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q1217677_measurable_simple_on s (phi n)) /\
        (!n.
          integrable lborel
            (Normal o
              (\x. if x IN s then norm (phi n x) else 0))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable lborel
            (Normal o
              (\x.
                if x IN s
                then norm (add (phi n x) (neg (g x)))
                else 0))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral lborel
                (Normal o
                  (\x.
                    if x IN s
                    then norm (add (phi n x) (neg (g x)))
                    else 0)))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q1217677_tendsto_seq add neg norm
          (\n. q1217677_simple_integral_on zero add smul s (phi n))
          ell``);

val q1217677_bochner_integral_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_bochner_integral_on_def",
  ``q1217677_bochner_integral_on
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (s : real set) (f : real -> 'g) =
      if q1217677_complete add neg norm /\
         q1217677_bochner_integrable_on add neg norm s f
      then
        @ell.
          ?phi : num -> real -> 'g.
            q1217677_bochner_approximates_on
              zero add neg smul norm s f phi ell
      else
        zero``);

val q1217677_interval_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_interval_integrable_def",
  ``q1217677_interval_integrable
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (a : real) (b : real) <=>
      q1217677_bochner_integrable_on add neg norm (interval (a,b)) f /\
      q1217677_bochner_integrable_on add neg norm (interval (b,a)) f``);

val q1217677_interval_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_interval_integral_def",
  ``q1217677_interval_integral
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (a : real) (b : real) =
      if a <= b
      then
        q1217677_bochner_integral_on
          zero add neg smul norm (interval (a,b)) f
      else
        neg
          (q1217677_bochner_integral_on
            zero add neg smul norm (interval (b,a)) f)``);

val q1217677_strongly_measurable_at_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_strongly_measurable_at_def",
  ``q1217677_strongly_measurable_at
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (b : real) <=>
      ?delta.
        0 < delta /\
        q1217677_ae_strongly_measurable_on add neg norm
          (interval (b - delta,b + delta)) f``);

val q1217677_tendsto_ae_at_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_tendsto_ae_at_def",
  ``q1217677_tendsto_ae_at
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (b : real) (c : 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta.
          0 < delta /\
          (AE x::lborel.
            abs (x - b) < delta ==>
            norm (add (f x) (neg c)) < epsilon)``);

val q1217677_has_strict_derivative_at_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_has_strict_derivative_at_def",
  ``q1217677_has_strict_derivative_at
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (primitive : real -> 'g) (c : 'g) (b : real) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta.
          0 < delta /\
          !x y.
            abs (x - b) < delta /\
            abs (y - b) < delta /\
            x <> y ==>
            norm
              (add
                (add (primitive x) (neg (primitive y)))
                (neg (smul (x - y) c))) <
            epsilon * abs (x - y)``);

val q1217677_continuous_on_closed_interval_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_continuous_on_closed_interval_def",
  ``q1217677_continuous_on_closed_interval
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (a : real) (b : real) <=>
      !x.
        a <= x /\ x <= b ==>
        !epsilon.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              a <= y /\ y <= b /\ abs (y - x) < delta ==>
              norm (add (f y) (neg (f x))) < epsilon``);

val q1217677_has_right_derivative_at_def = new_definition (
  "q1217677_has_right_derivative_at_def",
  ``q1217677_has_right_derivative_at
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (f' : 'g) (x : real) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta.
          0 < delta /\
          !y.
            x < y /\ y - x < delta ==>
            norm
              (add
                (add (f y) (neg (f x)))
                (neg (smul (y - x) f'))) <
            epsilon * abs (y - x)``);

val intervalIntegral_integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right =
  ``!(zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (c : 'g) (a : real) (b : real).
      q1217677_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q1217677_complete add neg norm /\
      q1217677_interval_integrable add neg norm f a b /\
      q1217677_strongly_measurable_at add neg norm f b /\
      q1217677_tendsto_ae_at add neg norm f b c
      ==>
      q1217677_has_strict_derivative_at add neg smul norm
        (\u.
          q1217677_interval_integral
            zero add neg smul norm f a u)
        c b``;

val intervalIntegral_integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le =
  ``!(zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (smul : real -> 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (f : real -> 'g) (f' : real -> 'g) (a : real) (b : real).
      q1217677_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q1217677_complete add neg norm /\
      a <= b /\
      q1217677_continuous_on_closed_interval add neg norm f a b /\
      (!x.
        a < x /\ x < b ==>
        q1217677_has_right_derivative_at
          add neg smul norm f (f' x) x) /\
      q1217677_interval_integrable add neg norm f' a b
      ==>
      q1217677_interval_integral zero add neg smul norm f' a b =
      add (f b) (neg (f a))``;

title: Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1217677
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1217677), "Fundamental theorem of calculus":
  an integrand that is locally almost-everywhere strongly measurable and has
  an almost-everywhere finite limit at an endpoint gives a strict derivative
  of its directed Bochner interval integral, and a continuous function with
  an interval-integrable right derivative satisfies the integral difference
  formula in an arbitrary complete real normed vector space. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1217677Restrict is the zero extension of F from the open real interval
  (A,B). Using the open interval instead of Lean's half-open interval changes
  only Lebesgue-null endpoints. Q1217677IntervalIntegrable requires the two
  endpoint orders, exactly as Lean's directed IntervalIntegrable predicate.
  Q1217677AEStrong and Q1217677FunctionIntegrable encode Lean's

  Q1217677AETendstoAt is convergence to C along the infimum of the neighborhood
  filter at B and the Lebesgue almost-everywhere filter.

  Q1217677ContinuousOn is relative continuity on a set, and
  Q1217677HasRightDerivAt is the derivative within the open right ray. The two
  final $a declarations are the requested unproved corpus statements; every
  preceding $a declaration is syntax or an explicit definition.

:: "Fundamental theorem of calculus": locally almost-everywhere convergent
:: Banach-space-valued integrands differentiate their oriented Bochner integral
:: primitives strictly, and an integrable right derivative of a continuous
:: Banach-space-valued function integrates to its endpoint difference.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for G being RealNormSpace,
      f being Function of REAL,the carrier of G,
      a,b being Element of REAL,
      c being Point of G
  st
    (for s being sequence of G st
      s is Cauchy_sequence_by_Norm holds s is convergent) &
    (ex I,N being Element of L-Field,
        Q being sequence of Funcs(REAL,the carrier of G),
        nf being Function of REAL,REAL
     st
       ((a <= b & I = [.a,b.]) or (b < a & I = [.b,a.])) &
       L-Meas.N = 0 &
       (for k being Nat holds
         ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of G,
            R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
         st
           Q.k = q &
           (for x being Element of REAL holds q.x in R) &
           (for y being Point of G holds
             {x where x is Element of REAL: q.x = y} in L-Field)) &
       (for x being Element of REAL st x in I & not x in N holds
         for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
           ex k0 being Nat st
             for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
               ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of G st
                 Q.k = q & ||.q.x - f.x.|| < epsilon) &
       (for x being Element of REAL holds nf.x = ||.f.x.||) &
       nf|I is_integrable_on L-Meas) &
    (ex r being Real,
        J,N being Element of L-Field,
        Q being sequence of Funcs(REAL,the carrier of G)
     st
       0 < r &
       J = [.b-r,b+r.] &
       L-Meas.N = 0 &
       (for k being Nat holds
         ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of G,
            R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
         st
           Q.k = q &
           (for x being Element of REAL holds q.x in R) &
           (for y being Point of G holds
             {x where x is Element of REAL: q.x = y} in L-Field)) &
       for x being Element of REAL st x in J & not x in N holds
         for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
           ex k0 being Nat st
             for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
               ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of G st
                 Q.k = q & ||.q.x - f.x.|| < epsilon) &
    (ex N being Element of L-Field st
       L-Meas.N = 0 &
       for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
         ex delta being Real st
           0 < delta &
           for x being Element of REAL st
             not x in N & |.x-b.| < delta
           holds ||.f.x - c.|| < epsilon)
  holds
    ex P being Function of REAL,the carrier of G,
       rho being Real
    st
      0 < rho &
      (for u being Element of REAL st |.u-b.| < rho holds
        for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds
          ex h being Function of REAL,REAL st
            (for x being Element of REAL holds h.x = L.(f.x)) &
            ((a <= u &
                Integral(L-Meas,h|[.a,u.]) = L.(P.u)) or
             (u < a &
                -Integral(L-Meas,h|[.u,a.]) = L.(P.u)))) &
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for x,y being Element of REAL st
            |.x-b.| < delta & |.y-b.| < delta
          holds
            ||.(P.x - P.y) - (x-y)*c.|| <= epsilon*|.x-y.|
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for G being RealNormSpace,
      f,f9 being Function of REAL,the carrier of G,

    (for s being sequence of G st

            ||.f.y - f.x.|| < epsilon) &
    (for x being Element of REAL st a < x & x < b holds
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for y being Element of REAL st x < y & |.y-x.| < delta holds
            ||.(f.y - f.x) - (y-x)*(f9.x).||
              <= epsilon*|.y-x.|) &
    (ex I,N being Element of L-Field,
        Q being sequence of Funcs(REAL,the carrier of G),
        nf being Function of REAL,REAL
     st
       I = [.a,b.] &
       L-Meas.N = 0 &
       (for k being Nat holds
         ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of G,
            R being finite Subset of the carrier of G
         st
           Q.k = q &
           (for x being Element of REAL holds q.x in R) &
           (for y being Point of G holds
             {x where x is Element of REAL: q.x = y} in L-Field)) &
       (for x being Element of REAL st x in I & not x in N holds
         for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
           ex k0 being Nat st
             for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds
               ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of G st
                 Q.k = q & ||.q.x - f9.x.|| < epsilon) &
       (for x being Element of REAL holds nf.x = ||.f9.x.||) &
       nf|I is_integrable_on L-Meas)
  holds
    for L being Lipschitzian linear-Functional of G holds

        (for x being Element of REAL holds h.x = L.(f9.x)) &

proof

% "Fundamental theorem of calculus": the endpoint derivative of a Banach-valued
% Lebesgue interval integral and recovery of a continuous function from its
% integrable right derivative. This file contains no proof.

Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  e_function: TYPE = [real -> E]
  e_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_function]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [real -> measure_value]

  subE(x, y: E): E = addE(x, negE(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E): addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = abs(a) * normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  converges_to_e(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_e(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_e: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_e(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E): converges_to_e(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): NOT A(x)

  countable_union(sets: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat): sets(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(sets: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x)
            AND sets(right_index)(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      sets: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x)
            AND sets(right_index)(x))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(sets(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(sets)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(sets(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(sets))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(sets(index)),
            M(countable_union(sets))))

  open_real_set(A: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: real):
            abs(y - x) < radius IMPLIES A(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        open_real_set(A) IMPLIES Sigma(A))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (A: event):
            open_real_set(A) IMPLIES Other(A)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (A: event):
            Sigma(A) IMPLIES Other(A))

  open_closed_interval(a, b: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): a < x AND x <= b

  open_interval(a, b: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): a < x AND x < b

  closed_interval(a, b: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): a <= x AND x <= b

  open_ball(center: real, radius: posreal): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): abs(x - center) < radius

  real_volume_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
      AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real):
        a <= b IMPLIES
          M(open_closed_interval(a, b)) =
            finite_measure_value(b - a))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
      Sigma(measurable_cover)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          A(x) IMPLIES measurable_cover(x))
        AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [real -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (x: real): NOT property(x))

  finite_e_sum(values: e_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_e_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_e_value(
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): E =
    finite_e_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(x) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroE
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_e_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_e(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: e_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_e_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          function_value(x) =
            finite_simple_e_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x))

  strongly_measurable_e(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: e_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_e(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          converges_to_e(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              approximants(index)(x),
            function_value(x)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_e(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: e_function):
      strongly_measurable_e(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            function_value(x) = measurable_version(x))

  restrict_e_function(
      function_value: e_function,
      A: event): e_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      IF A(x) THEN function_value(x) ELSE zeroE ENDIF

  strongly_measurable_at_neighborhood(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      center: real): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      ae_strongly_measurable_e(
        M,
        Sigma,
        restrict_e_function(
          function_value, open_ball(center, radius)))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(x))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, x),
          function_value(x)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_e(function_value: e_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      finite_measure_value(normE(function_value(x)))

  integrable_simple_e_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_e_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroE
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_e_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_simple_e_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        smulE(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_e_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: e_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_e_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          function_value(x) =
            finite_simple_e_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_e_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: e_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_e(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            subE(
              function_value(x),
              approximant(x))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      approximants: e_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_e(Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: e_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: e_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_e_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_e(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: E):
      has_bochner_integral(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): E =
    IF bochner_integrable(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: E):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroE
    ENDIF

  integrable_on(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      A: event): bool =
    bochner_integrable(
      M, Sigma, restrict_e_function(function_value, A))

  interval_integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    integrable_on(
      M, Sigma, function_value, open_closed_interval(a, b))
      AND integrable_on(
        M, Sigma, function_value, open_closed_interval(b, a))

  interval_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      a, b: real): E =
    subE(
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        restrict_e_function(
          function_value, open_closed_interval(a, b))),
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        restrict_e_function(
          function_value, open_closed_interval(b, a))))

  ae_tends_to_at(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      center: real,
      limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS
          (radius: posreal),
          (exceptional: event):
        null_event(M, Sigma, exceptional)
          AND (FORALL (x: real):
            (abs(x - center) < radius
              AND NOT exceptional(x))
            IMPLIES
              normE(subE(function_value(x), limit))
                < epsilon_value)

  has_strict_derivative_at(
      function_value: e_function,
      derivative: E,
      center: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (x, y: real):
          (abs(x - center) < radius
            AND abs(y - center) < radius)
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                subE(function_value(x), function_value(y)),
                smulE(x - y, derivative)))
              <= epsilon_value * abs(x - y)

  continuous_on_closed_interval(
      function_value: e_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      closed_interval(a, b)(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (closed_interval(a, b)(y)
                AND abs(y - x) < radius)
              IMPLIES
                normE(
                  subE(function_value(y), function_value(x)))
                  < epsilon_value

  has_right_derivative_within_at(
      function_value: e_function,
      derivative: E,
      center: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (center < y AND y - center < radius)
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                subE(function_value(y), function_value(center)),
                smulE(y - center, derivative)))
              <= epsilon_value * (y - center)

  integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right: bool =
    (normed_real_vector_space AND complete_space_e) IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (f: e_function),
          (c: E),
          (a, b: real):
        (real_volume_space(M, Sigma)
          AND interval_integrable(M, Sigma, f, a, b)
          AND strongly_measurable_at_neighborhood(
            M, Sigma, f, b)
          AND ae_tends_to_at(M, Sigma, f, b, c))
        IMPLIES
          has_strict_derivative_at(
            LAMBDA (u: real):
              interval_integral(M, Sigma, f, a, u),
            c,
            b)

  integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le: bool =
    (normed_real_vector_space AND complete_space_e) IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (f, f_prime: e_function),
          (a, b: real):
        (real_volume_space(M, Sigma)
          AND a <= b
          AND continuous_on_closed_interval(f, a, b)
          AND (FORALL (x: real):
            open_interval(a, b)(x) IMPLIES
              has_right_derivative_within_at(
                f, f_prime(x), x))
          AND interval_integrable(
            M, Sigma, f_prime, a, b))
        IMPLIES
          interval_integral(
            M, Sigma, f_prime, a, b)
            = subE(f(b), f(a))

  fundamental_theorem_of_calculus: bool =
    integral_hasStrictDerivAt_of_tendsto_ae_right
      AND integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right_of_le
END Q1217677_fundamental_theorem_of_calculus

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1227702
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1227702), "Dirichlet's unit theorem": the unit group
-- modulo torsion has a finite integral basis, and every unit is uniquely a root
-- of unity times integral powers of the associated fundamental units. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.NumberTheory.NumberField.Units.DirichletTheorem

noncomputable section

open Module NumberField

namespace Q1227702

variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]

/-- The source basis of the unit group modulo torsion. -/
abbrev basisModTorsion := NumberField.Units.basisModTorsion K

/-- Dirichlet's unit theorem in its unique fundamental-unit decomposition form. -/
theorem exist_unique_eq_mul_prod (x : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    ∃! ζe : NumberField.Units.torsion K ×
        (Fin (NumberField.Units.rank K) → ℤ),
      x = ζe.1 * ∏ i, (NumberField.Units.fundSystem K i) ^ (ζe.2 i) := sorry

end Q1227702

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1227702
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1227702), "Dirichlet's unit theorem": for a
  number field, the unit group of its ring of integers modulo torsion has a
  finite integer basis, and every unit has a unique decomposition as a root
  of unity times integer powers of corresponding fundamental units.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List QArith.QArith Reals
  Vectors.Fin ZArith.ZArith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1227702_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1227702_zero : K;
  q1227702_one : K;
  q1227702_add : K -> K -> K;
  q1227702_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q1227702_neg : K -> K;
  q1227702_inv : K -> K;
  q1227702_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1227702_add x (q1227702_add y z) =
      q1227702_add (q1227702_add x y) z;
  q1227702_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1227702_add x y = q1227702_add y x;
  q1227702_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q1227702_add x q1227702_zero = x;
  q1227702_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q1227702_add x (q1227702_neg x) = q1227702_zero;
  q1227702_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1227702_mul x (q1227702_mul y z) =
      q1227702_mul (q1227702_mul x y) z;
  q1227702_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1227702_mul x y = q1227702_mul y x;
  q1227702_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q1227702_mul x q1227702_one = x;
  q1227702_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1227702_mul x (q1227702_add y z) =
      q1227702_add
        (q1227702_mul x y) (q1227702_mul x z);
  q1227702_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q1227702_zero ->
      q1227702_mul x (q1227702_inv x) = q1227702_one;
  q1227702_nontrivial : q1227702_zero <> q1227702_one
}.

Arguments q1227702_zero {K} _.
Arguments q1227702_one {K} _.
Arguments q1227702_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1227702_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1227702_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q1227702_inv {K} _ _.

Fixpoint q1227702_vector_sum
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q1227702_field K)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> K) -> K :=
  match n as m return (Fin.t m -> K) -> K with
  | O => fun _ => q1227702_zero FK
  | S m =>
      fun terms =>
        q1227702_add FK
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1227702_vector_sum K FK m
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q1227702_vector_sum {K} FK n _.

Record q1227702_number_field
    (K : Type) (FK : q1227702_field K) : Type := {
  q1227702_q_smul : Q -> K -> K;
  q1227702_q_smul_one :
    forall x : K, q1227702_q_smul 1%Q x = x;
  q1227702_q_smul_assoc :
    forall (a b : Q) (x : K),
      q1227702_q_smul (a * b)%Q x =
      q1227702_q_smul a (q1227702_q_smul b x);
  q1227702_q_add_smul :
    forall (a b : Q) (x : K),
      q1227702_q_smul (a + b)%Q x =
      q1227702_add FK
        (q1227702_q_smul a x) (q1227702_q_smul b x);
  q1227702_q_smul_add :
    forall (a : Q) (x y : K),
      q1227702_q_smul a (q1227702_add FK x y) =
      q1227702_add FK
        (q1227702_q_smul a x) (q1227702_q_smul a y);
  q1227702_q_smul_mul :
    forall (a : Q) (x y : K),
      q1227702_q_smul a (q1227702_mul FK x y) =
      q1227702_mul FK (q1227702_q_smul a x) y;
  q1227702_q_embedding_injective :
    forall a b : Q,
      q1227702_q_smul a (q1227702_one FK) =
      q1227702_q_smul b (q1227702_one FK) ->
      a = b;
  q1227702_dimension : nat;
  q1227702_basis : Fin.t q1227702_dimension -> K;
  q1227702_basis_spans :
    forall x : K,
      exists coefficients : Fin.t q1227702_dimension -> Q,
        x =
        q1227702_vector_sum FK q1227702_dimension
          (fun i =>
            q1227702_q_smul
              (coefficients i) (q1227702_basis i));
  q1227702_basis_independent :
    forall coefficients : Fin.t q1227702_dimension -> Q,
      q1227702_vector_sum FK q1227702_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q1227702_q_smul
            (coefficients i) (q1227702_basis i)) =
      q1227702_zero FK ->
      forall i : Fin.t q1227702_dimension,
        coefficients i = 0%Q
}.

Arguments q1227702_q_smul {K FK} _ _ _.
Arguments q1227702_dimension {K FK} _.

Definition q1227702_integer_embedding
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (z : Z) : K :=
  q1227702_q_smul NF (inject_Z z) (q1227702_one FK).

Fixpoint q1227702_integer_polynomial_eval
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (coefficients : list Z)
    (x : K) : K :=
  match coefficients with
  | nil => q1227702_zero FK
  | z :: rest =>
      q1227702_add FK
        (q1227702_integer_embedding NF z)
        (q1227702_mul FK x
          (q1227702_integer_polynomial_eval NF rest x))
  end.

Definition q1227702_is_algebraic_integer
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (x : K) : Prop :=
  exists coefficients : list Z,
    coefficients <> nil /\
    List.last coefficients 0%Z = 1%Z /\
    q1227702_integer_polynomial_eval NF coefficients x =
      q1227702_zero FK.

Definition q1227702_is_integer_unit
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (x : K) : Prop :=
  q1227702_is_algebraic_integer NF x /\
  exists y : K,
    q1227702_is_algebraic_integer NF y /\
    q1227702_mul FK x y = q1227702_one FK.

Fixpoint q1227702_nat_pow
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q1227702_field K)
    (x : K)
    (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q1227702_one FK
  | S m =>
      q1227702_mul FK x (q1227702_nat_pow FK x m)
  end.

Definition q1227702_zpow
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q1227702_field K)
    (x : K)
    (z : Z) : K :=
  match z with
  | Z0 => q1227702_one FK
  | Zpos p =>
      q1227702_nat_pow FK x (Pos.to_nat p)
  | Zneg p =>
      q1227702_inv FK
        (q1227702_nat_pow FK x (Pos.to_nat p))
  end.

Fixpoint q1227702_product
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q1227702_field K)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> K) -> K :=
  match n as m return (Fin.t m -> K) -> K with
  | O => fun _ => q1227702_one FK
  | S m =>
      fun terms =>
        q1227702_mul FK
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1227702_product K FK m
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
