  end.

Arguments q1227702_product {K} FK n _.

Definition q1227702_complex : Type :=
  (RbaseSymbolsImpl.R * RbaseSymbolsImpl.R)%type.

Definition q1227702_complex_zero : q1227702_complex := (0%R, 0%R).

Definition q1227702_complex_one : q1227702_complex := (1%R, 0%R).

Definition q1227702_complex_add
    (z w : q1227702_complex) : q1227702_complex :=
  ((fst z + fst w)%R, (snd z + snd w)%R).

Definition q1227702_complex_mul
    (z w : q1227702_complex) : q1227702_complex :=
  ((fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w)%R,
   (fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w)%R).

Definition q1227702_complex_conj
    (z : q1227702_complex) : q1227702_complex :=
  (fst z, (- snd z)%R).

Definition q1227702_is_complex_embedding
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q1227702_field K)
    (embedding : K -> q1227702_complex) : Prop :=
  embedding (q1227702_zero FK) = q1227702_complex_zero /\
  embedding (q1227702_one FK) = q1227702_complex_one /\
  (forall x y : K,
    embedding (q1227702_add FK x y) =
    q1227702_complex_add (embedding x) (embedding y)) /\
  forall x y : K,
    embedding (q1227702_mul FK x y) =
    q1227702_complex_mul (embedding x) (embedding y).

Definition q1227702_embeddings_conjugate
    {K : Type}
    (left right : K -> q1227702_complex) : Prop :=
  (forall x : K, left x = right x) \/
  forall x : K,
    left x = q1227702_complex_conj (right x).

Record q1227702_archimedean_places
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q1227702_field K) : Type := {
  q1227702_place_count : nat;
  q1227702_place_representative :
    Fin.t q1227702_place_count -> K -> q1227702_complex;
  q1227702_place_valid :
    forall i : Fin.t q1227702_place_count,
      q1227702_is_complex_embedding FK
        (q1227702_place_representative i);
  q1227702_place_separated :
    forall i j : Fin.t q1227702_place_count,
      q1227702_embeddings_conjugate
        (q1227702_place_representative i)
        (q1227702_place_representative j) ->
      i = j;
  q1227702_place_complete :
    forall embedding : K -> q1227702_complex,
      q1227702_is_complex_embedding FK embedding ->
      exists i : Fin.t q1227702_place_count,
        q1227702_embeddings_conjugate
          embedding (q1227702_place_representative i);
  q1227702_place_nonempty : (0 < q1227702_place_count)%nat
}.

Arguments q1227702_place_count {K FK} _.

Definition q1227702_unit_rank
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (places : q1227702_archimedean_places FK) : nat :=
  (q1227702_place_count places - 1)%nat.

Definition q1227702_is_torsion_unit
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (x : K) : Prop :=
  q1227702_is_integer_unit NF x /\
  exists n : nat,
    (0 < n)%nat /\
    q1227702_nat_pow FK x n = q1227702_one FK.

Definition q1227702_same_mod_torsion
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (x y : K) : Prop :=
  q1227702_is_integer_unit NF x /\
  q1227702_is_integer_unit NF y /\
  q1227702_is_torsion_unit NF
    (q1227702_mul FK x (q1227702_inv FK y)).

Definition q1227702_fundamental_product
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    {rank : nat}
    (fundamental_units : Fin.t rank -> K)
    (exponents : Fin.t rank -> Z) : K :=
  q1227702_product FK rank
    (fun i =>
      q1227702_zpow FK
        (fundamental_units i) (exponents i)).

Record q1227702_basis_mod_torsion
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (rank : nat) : Type := {
  q1227702_fundamental_units : Fin.t rank -> K;
  q1227702_fundamental_units_are_units :
    forall i : Fin.t rank,
      q1227702_is_integer_unit NF
        (q1227702_fundamental_units i);
  q1227702_basis_spans_mod_torsion :
    forall x : K,
      q1227702_is_integer_unit NF x ->
      exists exponents : Fin.t rank -> Z,
        q1227702_same_mod_torsion NF x
          (@q1227702_fundamental_product K FK rank
            q1227702_fundamental_units exponents);
  q1227702_basis_independent_mod_torsion :
    forall exponents : Fin.t rank -> Z,
      q1227702_same_mod_torsion NF
        (@q1227702_fundamental_product K FK rank
          q1227702_fundamental_units exponents)
        (q1227702_one FK) ->
      forall i : Fin.t rank, exponents i = 0%Z
}.

Definition NumberField_Units_basisModTorsion
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (rank : nat) : Type :=
  q1227702_basis_mod_torsion NF rank.

Definition q1227702_is_unit_decomposition
    {K : Type}
    {FK : q1227702_field K}
    {rank : nat}
    (NF : q1227702_number_field FK)
    (basis : NumberField_Units_basisModTorsion NF rank)
    (x torsion_factor : K)
    (exponents : Fin.t rank -> Z) : Prop :=
  q1227702_is_torsion_unit NF torsion_factor /\
  x =
  q1227702_mul FK torsion_factor
    (@q1227702_fundamental_product K FK rank
      (q1227702_fundamental_units basis) exponents).

Theorem NumberField_Units_exist_unique_eq_mul_prod :
  forall (K : Type)
         (FK : q1227702_field K)
         (NF : q1227702_number_field FK),
    exists places : q1227702_archimedean_places FK,
      exists basis :
        NumberField_Units_basisModTorsion NF
          (q1227702_unit_rank places),
        forall x : K,
          q1227702_is_integer_unit NF x ->
          exists (torsion_factor : K)
                 (exponents :
                   Fin.t (q1227702_unit_rank places) -> Z),
            @q1227702_is_unit_decomposition
              K FK (q1227702_unit_rank places)
              NF basis x torsion_factor exponents /\
            forall (other_torsion_factor : K)
                   (other_exponents :
                     Fin.t (q1227702_unit_rank places) -> Z),
              @q1227702_is_unit_decomposition
                K FK (q1227702_unit_rank places)
                NF basis x other_torsion_factor other_exponents ->
              other_torsion_factor = torsion_factor /\
              forall i : Fin.t (q1227702_unit_rank places),
                other_exponents i = exponents i.
Admitted.

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227702
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1227702), "Dirichlet's unit theorem": the
  units of the ring of integers of a number field, modulo roots of unity, have
  an integer basis indexed by the infinite places minus one, yielding a unique
  decomposition of every unit. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1227702_is_rat_basis ::
    "'K::field_char_0 set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_rat_basis B \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite B \<and>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>!c :: 'K \<Rightarrow> rat.
      (\<forall>b. b \<notin> B \<longrightarrow> c b = 0) \<and>
      x = (\<Sum>b\<in>B. of_rat (c b) * b))"

definition q1227702_is_number_field ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_number_field _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B :: 'K set. q1227702_is_rat_basis B)"

definition q1227702_is_algebraic_integer ::
    "'K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_algebraic_integer x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>c :: nat \<Rightarrow> int. \<exists>n.
      finite {i. c i \<noteq> 0} \<and>
      c n = 1 \<and>
      (\<forall>m>n. c m = 0) \<and>
      (\<Sum>i\<in>{i. c i \<noteq> 0}. of_int (c i) * x ^ i) = 0)"

definition q1227702_is_integer_unit ::
    "'K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_integer_unit u \<longleftrightarrow>
    u \<noteq> 0 \<and>
    q1227702_is_algebraic_integer u \<and>
    q1227702_is_algebraic_integer (inverse u)"

definition q1227702_is_root_of_unity ::
    "'K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_root_of_unity u \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>n>0. u ^ n = 1)"

definition q1227702_is_torsion_unit ::
    "'K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_torsion_unit u \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1227702_is_integer_unit u \<and>
    q1227702_is_root_of_unity u"

definition q1227702_is_complex_embedding ::
    "('K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_complex_embedding e \<longleftrightarrow>
    e 0 = 0 \<and>
    e 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. e (x + y) = e x + e y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. e (x * y) = e x * e y)"

definition q1227702_complex_embeddings ::
    "('K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> complex) set" where
  "q1227702_complex_embeddings =
    {e. q1227702_is_complex_embedding e}"

definition q1227702_embedding_orbit ::
    "('K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow>
      ('K \<Rightarrow> complex) set" where
  "q1227702_embedding_orbit e =
    {e, (\<lambda>x. cnj (e x))}"

definition q1227702_infinite_places ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> ('K \<Rightarrow> complex) set set" where
  "q1227702_infinite_places _ =
    q1227702_embedding_orbit ` q1227702_complex_embeddings"

definition q1227702_unit_rank ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1227702_unit_rank K =
    card (q1227702_infinite_places K) - 1"

definition q1227702_unit_torsion_coset ::
    "'K::field_char_0 \<Rightarrow> 'K set" where
  "q1227702_unit_torsion_coset u =
    {v. q1227702_is_integer_unit v \<and>
      q1227702_is_root_of_unity (v / u)}"

definition q1227702_units_mod_torsion ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> 'K set set" where
  "q1227702_units_mod_torsion _ =
    {C. \<exists>u. q1227702_is_integer_unit u \<and>
      C = q1227702_unit_torsion_coset u}"

definition q1227702_coset_combination ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'K set) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> int) \<Rightarrow>
      'K set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_coset_combination K B z C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'K.
      (\<forall>i<q1227702_unit_rank K.
        q1227702_is_integer_unit (u i) \<and>
        B i = q1227702_unit_torsion_coset (u i)) \<and>
      C = q1227702_unit_torsion_coset
        (\<Prod>i\<in>{..<q1227702_unit_rank K}. (u i) powi (z i)))"

definition q1227702_is_basis_mod_torsion ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'K set) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1227702_is_basis_mod_torsion K B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i<q1227702_unit_rank K.
      B i \<in> q1227702_units_mod_torsion K) \<and>
    (\<forall>C\<in>q1227702_units_mod_torsion K.
      \<exists>!z :: nat \<Rightarrow> int.
        (\<forall>i\<ge>q1227702_unit_rank K. z i = 0) \<and>
        q1227702_coset_combination K B z C)"

definition q1227702_basisModTorsion ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'K set" where
  "q1227702_basisModTorsion K =
    (SOME B. q1227702_is_basis_mod_torsion K B)"

definition q1227702_fundSystem ::
    "'K::field_char_0 itself \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'K" where
  "q1227702_fundSystem K =
    (\<lambda>i. SOME u.
      q1227702_is_integer_unit u \<and>
      q1227702_basisModTorsion K i =
        q1227702_unit_torsion_coset u)"

theorem q1227702_basisModTorsion_is_basis:
  assumes "q1227702_is_number_field (TYPE('K::field_char_0))"
  shows "q1227702_is_basis_mod_torsion TYPE('K)
    (q1227702_basisModTorsion TYPE('K))"
  sorry

theorem q1227702_exist_unique_eq_mul_prod:
  fixes x :: "'K::field_char_0"
  assumes "q1227702_is_number_field TYPE('K)"
    and "q1227702_is_integer_unit x"
  shows "\<exists>!ze :: 'K \<times> (nat \<Rightarrow> int).
    q1227702_is_torsion_unit (fst ze) \<and>
    (\<forall>i\<ge>q1227702_unit_rank TYPE('K). snd ze i = 0) \<and>
    x = fst ze *
      (\<Prod>i\<in>{..<q1227702_unit_rank TYPE('K)}.
        (q1227702_fundSystem TYPE('K) i) powi (snd ze i))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1227702,
  "Dirichlet's unit theorem": for an arbitrary number field, the units modulo
  torsion have rank one less than the number of infinite places, with a basis
  whose lifts give unique torsion-times-integer-powers decompositions.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let q1227702_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q1227702_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q1227702_output;;
let q1227702_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q1227702_formatter path);;
let q1227702_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q1227702_formatter "Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q1227702_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q1227702_formatter ();;
close_out q1227702_output;;
if not q1227702_loaded then failwith "Unable to load complex library";;

let Q1227702_DIRICHLET_S_UNIT_THEOREM =
 `let field =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (inv:A->A) (of_int:int->A).
        ~(zero = one_value) /\
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x y:A. mul x y = mul y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
        (!x:A. mul x one_value = x) /\
        (!x y z:A. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
        (!x:A. ~(x = zero) ==> mul x (inv x) = one_value) /\
        of_int (&0) = zero /\
        of_int (&1) = one_value /\
        (!m n:int. of_int (m + n) = add (of_int m) (of_int n)) /\
        (!m n:int. of_int (m * n) = mul (of_int m) (of_int n)) /\
        (!m:int. of_int (--m) = neg (of_int m)) /\
        (!m n:int. of_int m = of_int n ==> m = n) in
   let rational_element =
      \(mul:A->A->A) (inv:A->A) (of_int:int->A) (q:A).
        ?m:int n:num.
          q = mul (of_int m) (inv (of_int (&(SUC n)))) in
   let finite_sum =
      \(add:A->A->A) (n:num) (f:num->A).
        iterate add {i | i < n} f in
   let finite_product =
      \(mul:A->A->A) (n:num) (f:num->A).
        iterate mul {i | i < n} f in
   let natural_power =
      \(mul:A->A->A) (x:A) (n:num).
        finite_product mul n (\i. x) in
   let integer_power =
      \(mul:A->A->A) (inv:A->A) (x:A) (n:int).
        if &0 <= n
        then natural_power mul x (num_of_int n)
        else inv (natural_power mul x (num_of_int (--n))) in
   let rational_coordinates =
      \(add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) (inv:A->A)
       (of_int:int->A) (dimension:num) (basis:num->A)
       (x:A) (coefficients:num->A).
        (!i. i < dimension
             ==> rational_element mul inv of_int (coefficients i)) /\
        x =
        finite_sum add dimension
          (\i. mul (coefficients i) (basis i)) in
   let number_field =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (neg:A->A) (inv:A->A) (of_int:int->A).
        field zero one_value add mul neg inv of_int /\
        ?dimension basis.
          0 < dimension /\
          (!x:A.
             ?coefficients.
               rational_coordinates add mul inv of_int
                 dimension basis x coefficients) /\
          (!x:A c d.
             rational_coordinates add mul inv of_int
               dimension basis x c /\
             rational_coordinates add mul inv of_int
               dimension basis x d
             ==> !i. i < dimension ==> c i = d i) in
   let integer_element =
      \(of_int:int->A) (x:A). ?m:int. x = of_int m in
   let algebraic_integer =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (of_int:int->A) (x:A).
        ?degree coefficients.
          0 < degree /\
          (!i. i <= degree
               ==> integer_element of_int (coefficients i)) /\
          coefficients degree = one_value /\
          finite_sum add (SUC degree)
            (\i. mul (coefficients i) (natural_power mul x i)) =
          zero in
   let unit =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (inv:A->A) (of_int:int->A) (x:A).
        ~(x = zero) /\
        algebraic_integer zero one_value add mul of_int x /\
        algebraic_integer zero one_value add mul of_int (inv x) in
   let torsion_unit =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (inv:A->A) (of_int:int->A) (x:A).
        unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int x /\
        ?n. 0 < n /\ natural_power mul x n = one_value in
   let field_embedding =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (sigma:A->complex).
        sigma zero = Cx(&0) /\
        sigma one_value = Cx(&1) /\
        (!x y:A. sigma (add x y) = sigma x + sigma y) /\
        (!x y:A. sigma (mul x y) = sigma x * sigma y) /\
        (!x y:A. sigma x = sigma y ==> x = y) in
   let place_equivalent =
      \(sigma:A->complex) (tau:A->complex).
        (!x:A. tau x = sigma x) \/
        (!x:A. tau x = cnj (sigma x)) in
   let infinite_places =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (places:(A->complex)->bool).
        FINITE places /\
        (!p. p IN places ==> field_embedding zero one_value add mul p) /\
        (!sigma.
           field_embedding zero one_value add mul sigma
           ==> ?!p. p IN places /\ place_equivalent sigma p) in
   let valid_coefficients =
      \(rank:num) (coefficients:num->int).
        !i. rank <= i ==> coefficients i = &0 in
   let unit_product =
      \(mul:A->A->A) (inv:A->A) (rank:num)
       (fundamental_unit:num->A) (coefficients:num->int).
        finite_product mul rank
          (\i. integer_power mul inv
                 (fundamental_unit i) (coefficients i)) in
   let basis_mod_torsion =
      \(zero:A) (one_value:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       (inv:A->A) (of_int:int->A) (rank:num)
       (fundamental_unit:num->A).
        (!i. i < rank
             ==> unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int
                   (fundamental_unit i)) /\
        (!coefficients.
           valid_coefficients rank coefficients /\
           torsion_unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int
             (unit_product mul inv rank
               fundamental_unit coefficients)
           ==> !i. i < rank ==> coefficients i = &0) /\
        (!x.
           unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int x
           ==> ?zeta coefficients.
                 torsion_unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int zeta /\
                 valid_coefficients rank coefficients /\
                 x =
                 mul zeta
                   (unit_product mul inv rank
                     fundamental_unit coefficients)) in
   !zero:A one_value:A add:A->A->A mul:A->A->A
    neg:A->A inv:A->A of_int:int->A
    places:(A->complex)->bool.
     number_field zero one_value add mul neg inv of_int /\
     infinite_places zero one_value add mul places
     ==>
     ?fundamental_unit:num->A.
       let rank = CARD places - 1 in
       basis_mod_torsion zero one_value add mul inv of_int
         rank fundamental_unit /\
       !x.
         unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int x
         ==> ?!decomposition:A#(num->int).
               torsion_unit zero one_value add mul inv of_int
                 (FST decomposition) /\
               valid_coefficients rank (SND decomposition) /\
               x =
               mul (FST decomposition)
                 (unit_product mul inv rank
                   fundamental_unit (SND decomposition))`;;

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227702,
;; "Dirichlet's unit theorem": the units of the ring of integers of a number
;; field, modulo torsion, have a basis of rank equal to the number of infinite
;; places minus one, yielding a unique torsion-times-basis-power decomposition.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ objects present arbitrary carriers and operations. Conservative
;; DEFUN-SK predicates keep every unbounded universal or existential quantifier
;; internal to the statement. The real-value field is Archimedean and real
;; closed. Infinite places are exactly the normalized Archimedean absolute
;; values on the number field, listed extensionally without duplicates.
;;
;; A fundamental system has one unit for each place except one. Its unique
;; decomposition property is equivalent to being a Z-basis of the unit group
;; modulo torsion, and also states the indexed Lean theorem's unique
;; torsion-times-basis-power factorization.

(defun q1227702-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q1227702-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q1227702-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Fields and ordered real-closed Archimedean fields.

(defun-sk q1227702-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
      (q1227702-member-p carrier y)
      (q1227702-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add
             (q1227702-binary-value add x y))
            (yz-add
             (q1227702-binary-value add y z))
            (xy-mul
             (q1227702-binary-value multiply x y))
            (yz-mul
             (q1227702-binary-value multiply y z))
            (neg-x
             (q1227702-unary-value negate x))
            (inv-x
             (q1227702-unary-value inverse x)))
       (and
        (q1227702-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q1227702-member-p carrier xy-mul)
        (q1227702-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (q1227702-member-p carrier inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value add xy-add z)
         (q1227702-binary-value add x yz-add))
        (equal
         xy-add
         (q1227702-binary-value add y x))
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value add x zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value add x neg-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value multiply xy-mul z)
         (q1227702-binary-value multiply x yz-mul))
        (equal
         xy-mul
         (q1227702-binary-value multiply y x))
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value multiply x one)
         x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1227702-binary-value multiply x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value multiply x yz-add)
         (q1227702-binary-value
          add
          (q1227702-binary-value multiply x y)
          (q1227702-binary-value multiply x z))))))))

(defun q1227702-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q1227702-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1227702-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1227702-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

(defun-sk q1227702-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
      (q1227702-member-p carrier y)
      (q1227702-member-p carrier z))
     (let ((xy (q1227702-binary-value less x y))
           (yx (q1227702-binary-value less y x))
           (yz (q1227702-binary-value less y z)))
       (and
        (not (q1227702-binary-value less x x))
        (or xy yx (equal x y))
        (implies
         (and xy yz)
         (q1227702-binary-value less x z))
        (implies
         xy
         (q1227702-binary-value
          less
          (q1227702-binary-value add x z)
          (q1227702-binary-value add y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1227702-binary-value less zero x)
          (q1227702-binary-value less zero y))
         (q1227702-binary-value
          less
          zero
          (q1227702-binary-value multiply x y))))))))

(defun q1227702-natural-cast (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (q1227702-binary-value
     add
     one
     (q1227702-natural-cast (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun q1227702-integer-cast
    (n zero one add negate)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q1227702-unary-value
       negate
       (q1227702-natural-cast (- n) zero one add))
    (q1227702-natural-cast (nfix n) zero one add)))

(defun q1227702-rational-cast
    (q zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (if (rationalp q)
      (q1227702-binary-value
       multiply
       (q1227702-integer-cast
        (numerator q) zero one add negate)
       (q1227702-unary-value
        inverse
        (q1227702-integer-cast
         (denominator q) zero one add negate)))
    zero))

(defun-sk q1227702-archimedean-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add less bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
     (let ((n (q1227702-unary-value bound x)))
       (and
        (natp n)
        (q1227702-binary-value
         less
         x
         (q1227702-natural-cast n zero one add)))))))

(defun q1227702-real-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients carrier)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (q1227702-member-p carrier (car coefficients))
       (q1227702-real-coefficient-list-p
        (cdr coefficients) carrier))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q1227702-real-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x zero add multiply)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q1227702-binary-value
       add
       (car coefficients)
       (q1227702-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (q1227702-real-polynomial-eval
         (cdr coefficients) x zero add multiply)))
    zero))

(defun-sk q1227702-square-root-laws-p
    (carrier zero multiply less square-root)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
      (not (q1227702-binary-value less x zero)))
     (let ((root
            (q1227702-unary-value square-root x)))
       (and
        (q1227702-member-p carrier root)
        (not (q1227702-binary-value less root zero))
        (equal
         (q1227702-binary-value multiply root root)
         x))))))

(defun-sk q1227702-odd-root-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply odd-root)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp coefficients)
      (<= 2 (len coefficients))
      (evenp (len coefficients))
      (q1227702-real-coefficient-list-p
       coefficients carrier)
      (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero)))
     (let ((root
            (q1227702-unary-value odd-root coefficients)))
       (and
        (q1227702-member-p carrier root)
        (equal
         (q1227702-real-polynomial-eval
          coefficients root zero add multiply)
         zero))))))

(defun q1227702-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less
     square-root odd-root archimedean-bound)
  (and
   (q1227702-field-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp square-root)
   (tamep-functionp odd-root)
   (tamep-functionp archimedean-bound)
   (q1227702-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (q1227702-binary-value less zero one)
   (q1227702-archimedean-laws-p
    carrier zero one add less archimedean-bound)
   (q1227702-square-root-laws-p
    carrier zero multiply less square-root)
   (q1227702-odd-root-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply odd-root)))

;; Finite extensions of Q, presented by an explicit finite basis and inverse
;; coordinate map. The carrier itself remains arbitrary and potentially
;; infinite.

(defun-sk q1227702-rational-cast-injective-p
    (zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (q r)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (rationalp r)
      (equal
       (q1227702-rational-cast
        q zero one add multiply negate inverse)
       (q1227702-rational-cast
        r zero one add multiply negate inverse)))
     (equal q r))))

(defun q1227702-rational-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (rationalp (car values))
       (q1227702-rational-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1227702-linear-combination
    (basis coefficients
     zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len basis)))
  (if (and (consp basis) (consp coefficients))
      (q1227702-binary-value
       add
       (q1227702-binary-value
        multiply
        (q1227702-rational-cast
         (car coefficients)
         zero one add multiply negate inverse)
        (car basis))
       (q1227702-linear-combination
        (cdr basis)
        (cdr coefficients)
        zero one add multiply negate inverse))
    zero))

(defun q1227702-basis-elements-p (basis carrier)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (q1227702-member-p carrier (car basis))
       (q1227702-basis-elements-p (cdr basis) carrier))
    (equal basis nil)))

(defun-sk q1227702-basis-laws-p
    (carrier basis coordinates
     zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x coefficients)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
      (let ((coordinate-vector
             (q1227702-unary-value coordinates x)))
        (and
         (true-listp coordinate-vector)
         (q1227702-rational-list-p coordinate-vector)
         (equal (len coordinate-vector) (len basis))
         (equal
          (q1227702-linear-combination
           basis coordinate-vector
           zero one add multiply negate inverse)
          x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (true-listp coefficients)
       (q1227702-rational-list-p coefficients)
       (equal (len coefficients) (len basis)))
      (equal
       (q1227702-unary-value
        coordinates
        (q1227702-linear-combination
         basis coefficients
         zero one add multiply negate inverse))
       coefficients)))))

(defun q1227702-number-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
     basis coordinates)
  (and
   (q1227702-field-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (true-listp basis)
   (q1227702-basis-elements-p basis carrier)
   (tamep-functionp coordinates)
   (q1227702-rational-cast-injective-p
    zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1227702-basis-laws-p
    carrier basis coordinates
    zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

;; Algebraic integers, units, torsion, and integer powers.

(defun q1227702-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (integerp (car values))
       (q1227702-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1227702-monic-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients x
     zero one add multiply negate)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q1227702-binary-value
       add
       (q1227702-integer-cast
        (car coefficients) zero one add negate)
       (q1227702-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (q1227702-monic-polynomial-eval
         (cdr coefficients) x
         zero one add multiply negate)))
    one))

(defun-sk q1227702-integral-p
    (x zero one add multiply negate)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (consp coefficients)
     (q1227702-integer-list-p coefficients)
     (equal
      (q1227702-monic-polynomial-eval
       coefficients x
       zero one add multiply negate)
      zero))))

(defun q1227702-unit-p
    (x carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (and
   (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
   (not (equal x zero))
   (q1227702-integral-p
    x zero one add multiply negate)
   (q1227702-integral-p
    (q1227702-unary-value inverse x)
    zero one add multiply negate)))

(defun q1227702-natural-power
    (x n one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      one
    (q1227702-binary-value
     multiply
     x
     (q1227702-natural-power
      x (- n 1) one multiply))))

(defun q1227702-integer-power
    (x n one multiply inverse)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q1227702-natural-power
       (q1227702-unary-value inverse x)
       (- n)
       one
       multiply)
    (q1227702-natural-power
     x (nfix n) one multiply)))

(defun-sk q1227702-torsion-p
    (x carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (q1227702-unit-p
      x carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
     (natp n)
     (< 0 n)
     (equal
      (q1227702-natural-power x n one multiply)
      one))))

;; Infinite places as normalized Archimedean absolute values.

(defun q1227702-real-nonnegative-p
    (less zero value)
  (not (q1227702-binary-value less value zero)))

(defun q1227702-real-le-p (less left right)
  (not (q1227702-binary-value less right left)))

(defun q1227702-real-abs
    (value zero negate less)
  (if (q1227702-binary-value less value zero)
      (q1227702-unary-value negate value)
    value))

(defun-sk q1227702-infinite-place-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse place)
  (forall (x y q)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
       (q1227702-member-p carrier y))
      (let ((place-x
             (q1227702-unary-value place x))
            (place-y
             (q1227702-unary-value place y)))
        (and
         (q1227702-member-p real-carrier place-x)
         (q1227702-real-nonnegative-p
          real-less real-zero place-x)
         (iff
          (equal place-x real-zero)
          (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1227702-unary-value
           place
           (q1227702-binary-value multiply x y))
          (q1227702-binary-value
           real-multiply place-x place-y))
         (q1227702-real-le-p
          real-less
          (q1227702-unary-value
           place
           (q1227702-binary-value add x y))
          (q1227702-binary-value
           real-add place-x place-y)))))
     (implies
      (rationalp q)
      (equal
       (q1227702-unary-value
        place
        (q1227702-rational-cast
         q zero one add multiply negate inverse))
       (q1227702-real-abs
        (q1227702-rational-cast
         q real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
         real-negate real-inverse)
        real-zero real-negate real-less))))))

(defun q1227702-infinite-place-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse place)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp place)
   (q1227702-infinite-place-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse place)))

(defun-sk q1227702-places-extensionally-equal-p
    (carrier left-place right-place)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1227702-member-p carrier x)
     (equal
      (q1227702-unary-value left-place x)
      (q1227702-unary-value right-place x)))))

(defun q1227702-same-infinite-place-p
    (carrier left-place right-place)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp left-place)
   (tamep-functionp right-place)
   (q1227702-places-extensionally-equal-p
    carrier left-place right-place)))

(defun q1227702-place-in-list-p (place places carrier)
  (if (consp places)
      (or
       (q1227702-same-infinite-place-p
        carrier place (car places))
       (q1227702-place-in-list-p
        place (cdr places) carrier))
    nil))

(defun q1227702-place-list-valid-p
    (places
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (if (consp places)
      (and
       (q1227702-infinite-place-p
        real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse real-less
        carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
        (car places))
       (not
        (q1227702-place-in-list-p
         (car places) (cdr places) carrier))
       (q1227702-place-list-valid-p
        (cdr places)
        real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
        real-negate real-inverse real-less
        carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse))
    (equal places nil)))

(defun-sk q1227702-place-coverage-p
    (places
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (place)
    (implies
     (q1227702-infinite-place-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
      real-negate real-inverse real-less
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse place)
     (q1227702-place-in-list-p
      place places carrier))))

(defun q1227702-infinite-place-list-p
    (places
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (and
   (true-listp places)
   (consp places)
   (q1227702-place-list-valid-p
    places
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1227702-place-coverage-p
    places
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

;; Basis modulo torsion and unique decomposition.

(defun q1227702-fund-product
    (fund-system exponents one multiply inverse)
  (if (and (consp fund-system) (consp exponents))
      (q1227702-binary-value
       multiply
       (q1227702-integer-power
        (car fund-system)
        (car exponents)
        one multiply inverse)
       (q1227702-fund-product
        (cdr fund-system)
        (cdr exponents)
        one multiply inverse))
    one))

(defun q1227702-unit-list-p
    (values carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1227702-unit-p
        (car values)
        carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
       (q1227702-unit-list-p
        (cdr values)
        carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1227702-decomposition-p
    (decomposition x fund-system
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let ((zeta (nth 0 decomposition))
        (exponents (nth 1 decomposition)))
    (and
     (true-listp decomposition)
     (equal (len decomposition) 2)
     (q1227702-torsion-p
      zeta carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
     (true-listp exponents)
     (q1227702-integer-list-p exponents)
     (equal (len exponents) (len fund-system))
     (equal
      x
      (q1227702-binary-value
       multiply
       zeta
       (q1227702-fund-product
        fund-system exponents one multiply inverse))))))

(defun-sk q1227702-decomposition-exists-p
    (x fund-system
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (exists (decomposition)
    (q1227702-decomposition-p
     decomposition x fund-system
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

(defun-sk q1227702-decomposition-unique-p
    (x fund-system
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227702-decomposition-p
       left x fund-system
       carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
      (q1227702-decomposition-p
       right x fund-system
       carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse))
     (equal left right))))

(defun q1227702-unit-decomposition-p
    (x fund-system
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (and
   (q1227702-decomposition-exists-p
    x fund-system
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1227702-decomposition-unique-p
    x fund-system
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

(defun-sk q1227702-all-unit-decompositions-p
    (fund-system
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1227702-unit-p
      x carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
     (q1227702-unit-decomposition-p
      x fund-system
      carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse))))

(defun q1227702-fund-system-p
    (fund-system rank
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (and
   (true-listp fund-system)
   (equal (len fund-system) rank)
   (q1227702-unit-list-p
    fund-system
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1227702-all-unit-decompositions-p
    fund-system
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

(defun-sk q1227702-fund-system-exists-p
    (rank carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (exists (fund-system)
    (q1227702-fund-system-p
     fund-system rank
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1227702-dirichlet-unit-theorem-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     real-square-root real-odd-root real-archimedean-bound
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
     field-basis field-coordinates places)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1227702-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     real-square-root real-odd-root real-archimedean-bound)
    (q1227702-number-field-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse
     field-basis field-coordinates)
    (q1227702-infinite-place-list-p
     places
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse))
   (q1227702-fund-system-exists-p
    (- (len places) 1)
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227702,
-- "Dirichlet's unit theorem": the units of a number field's ring of integers
-- have a basis modulo torsion, giving a unique root-of-unity times
-- integer-powers decomposition. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 4 _×_
infixr 3 _∨_
infix 4 _≠_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
_≠_ {a} x y =
  x ≡ y → Bottom {a}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _∨_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

predecessor : Nat → Nat
predecessor zero = zero
predecessor (suc n) = n

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR : R → R

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing K
    inverseK : K → K
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    inverse-law :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (inverseK x) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring

record RingHom
  {a b : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  {S : Set b}
  (domain : CommutativeRing R)
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : R → S
    map-zero :
      map (CommutativeRing.zeroR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain
    map-one :
      map (CommutativeRing.oneR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR codomain
    map-add :
      (x y : R) →
      map (CommutativeRing.addR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.addR codomain (map x) (map y)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : R) →
      map (CommutativeRing.multiplyR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR codomain (map x) (map y)

record FieldEmbedding
  {a b : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  {L : Set b}
  (domain : Field K)
  (codomain : Field L) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    hom : RingHom (Field.ring domain) (Field.ring codomain)
    injective :
      (x y : K) →
      RingHom.map hom x ≡ RingHom.map hom y →
      x ≡ y

fromNat :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Nat →
  R
fromNat ring zero =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
fromNat ring (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (fromNat ring n)
    (CommutativeRing.oneR ring)

fromInt :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Int →
  R
fromInt ring (pos n) =
  fromNat ring n
fromInt ring (negsuc n) =
  CommutativeRing.negateR ring
    (fromNat ring (suc n))

power :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
power ring x zero =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
power ring x (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (power ring x n)

evaluateMonic :
  {a : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  List Int →
  K →
  K
evaluateMonic ring [] x =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
evaluateMonic ring (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (fromInt ring coefficient)
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x
      (evaluateMonic ring coefficients x))

IntegralOverIntegers :
  {a : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  Field K →
  K →
  Set a
IntegralOverIntegers field-structure x =
  Σ (List Int)
    (λ coefficients →
      evaluateMonic
        (Field.ring field-structure)
        coefficients
        x
      ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring field-structure))

sumFin :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → R) →
  R
sumFin ring zero terms =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
sumFin ring (suc n) terms =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin ring n (λ i → terms (fsuc i)))

record RationalField
  {q : Level}
  (Q : Set q)
  (field-structure : Field Q) :
  Set q where

  field
    characteristic-zero :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNat (Field.ring field-structure) m ≡
      fromNat (Field.ring field-structure) n →
      m ≡ n
    every-element-is-a-fraction :
      (x : Q) →
      Σ Int
        (λ numerator →
          Σ Nat
            (λ denominator-minus-one →
              CommutativeRing.multiplyR
                (Field.ring field-structure)
                x
                (fromNat
                  (Field.ring field-structure)
                  (suc denominator-minus-one))
              ≡
              fromInt (Field.ring field-structure) numerator))

record FiniteRationalBasis
  {q k : Level}
  {Q : Set q}
  {K : Set k}
  (rationalField : Field Q)
  (numberField : Field K)
  (inclusion :
    FieldEmbedding rationalField numberField) :
  Set (q ⊔ k) where

  open CommutativeRing (Field.ring numberField)

  field
    dimension : Nat
    vector : Fin dimension → K
    coordinates : K → Fin dimension → Q
    reconstruct :
      (x : K) →
      sumFin
        (Field.ring numberField)
        dimension
        (λ i →
          multiplyR
            (RingHom.map
              (FieldEmbedding.hom inclusion)
              (coordinates x i))
            (vector i))
      ≡
      x
    coordinates-unique :
      (x : K) →
      (coefficients : Fin dimension → Q) →
      sumFin
        (Field.ring numberField)
        dimension
        (λ i →
          multiplyR
            (RingHom.map
              (FieldEmbedding.hom inclusion)
              (coefficients i))
            (vector i))
      ≡
      x →
      (i : Fin dimension) →
      coefficients i ≡ coordinates x i

record RingOfIntegers
  {k o : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (numberField : Field K)
  (O : Set o) :
  Set (k ⊔ o) where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing O
    inclusion :
      RingHom ring (Field.ring numberField)
    inclusion-injective :
      (x y : O) →
      RingHom.map inclusion x ≡ RingHom.map inclusion y →
      x ≡ y
    image-is-integral :
      (x : O) →
      IntegralOverIntegers numberField
        (RingHom.map inclusion x)
    contains-every-integral-element :
      (x : K) →
      IntegralOverIntegers numberField x →
      Σ O
        (λ y → RingHom.map inclusion y ≡ x)

record CommutativeGroup
  {u : Level}
  (U : Set u) :
  Set u where

  field
    identity : U
    inverse : U → U
    multiply : U → U → U
    associative :
      (x y z : U) →
      multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
      multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left :
      (x : U) →
      multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right :
      (x : U) →
      multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left :
      (x : U) →
      multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right :
      (x : U) →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity
    commutative :
      (x y : U) →
      multiply x y ≡ multiply y x

groupPower :
  {u : Level} →
  {U : Set u} →
  CommutativeGroup U →
  U →
  Nat →
  U
groupPower group x zero =
  CommutativeGroup.identity group
groupPower group x (suc n) =
  CommutativeGroup.multiply group x
    (groupPower group x n)

integerPower :
  {u : Level} →
  {U : Set u} →
  CommutativeGroup U →
  U →
  Int →
  U
integerPower group x (pos n) =
  groupPower group x n
integerPower group x (negsuc n) =
  groupPower group
    (CommutativeGroup.inverse group x)
    (suc n)

groupProductFin :
  {u : Level} →
  {U : Set u} →
  CommutativeGroup U →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → U) →
  U
groupProductFin group zero terms =
  CommutativeGroup.identity group
groupProductFin group (suc n) terms =
  CommutativeGroup.multiply group
    (terms fzero)
    (groupProductFin group n (λ i → terms (fsuc i)))

record UnitGroupOf
  {o u : Level}
  {O : Set o}
  (ring : CommutativeRing O)
  (U : Set u) :
  Set (o ⊔ u) where

  field
    group : CommutativeGroup U
    value inverse-value : U → O
    value-identity :
      value (CommutativeGroup.identity group) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring
    value-multiply :
      (x y : U) →
      value (CommutativeGroup.multiply group x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring (value x) (value y)
    value-inverse :
      (x : U) →
      value (CommutativeGroup.inverse group x) ≡
      inverse-value x
    unit-law :
      (x : U) →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring
        (value x)
        (inverse-value x)
      ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring
    value-injective :
      (x y : U) →
      value x ≡ value y →
      x ≡ y
    every-unit-is-represented :
      (x y : O) →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring →
      Σ U (λ unit → value unit ≡ x)

-- Complete Archimedean ordered fields present the standard real numbers
-- uniquely up to ordered-field isomorphism.
record CompleteArchimedeanOrderedField
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r)
  (real-field : Field R) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  open CommutativeRing (Field.ring real-field)

  field
    less-or-equal : R → R → Set r
    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) →
      less-or-equal x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      less-or-equal x y →
      less-or-equal y z →
      less-or-equal x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      less-or-equal x y →
      less-or-equal y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      less-or-equal x y ∨ less-or-equal y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      less-or-equal x y →
      less-or-equal (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      less-or-equal zeroR x →
      less-or-equal zeroR y →
      less-or-equal zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      less-or-equal zeroR oneR × (oneR ≠ zeroR)
    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat
        (λ n →
          less-or-equal x
            (fromNat (Field.ring real-field) n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set r) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R
        (λ upper →
          (x : R) →
          P x →
          less-or-equal x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) →
            P x →
            less-or-equal x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) →
              P x →
              less-or-equal x upper) →
            less-or-equal supremum upper))

record Complex
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  constructor complex
  field
    real-part : R
    imaginary-part : R

complexZero :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Field R →
  Complex R
complexZero real-field =
  complex
    (CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring real-field))
    (CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring real-field))

complexOne :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Field R →
  Complex R
complexOne real-field =
  complex
    (CommutativeRing.oneR (Field.ring real-field))
    (CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring real-field))

complexAdd :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Field R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexAdd real-field (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  let ring = Field.ring real-field
  in
  complex
    (CommutativeRing.addR ring a c)
    (CommutativeRing.addR ring b d)

complexNegate :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Field R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexNegate real-field (complex a b) =
  let ring = Field.ring real-field
  in
  complex
    (CommutativeRing.negateR ring a)
    (CommutativeRing.negateR ring b)

complexMultiply :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Field R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexMultiply real-field (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  let ring = Field.ring real-field
  in
  complex
    (CommutativeRing.addR ring
      (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring a c)
      (CommutativeRing.negateR ring
        (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring b d)))
    (CommutativeRing.addR ring
      (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring a d)
      (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring b c))

complexConjugate :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Field R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
complexConjugate real-field (complex a b) =
  complex a
    (CommutativeRing.negateR
      (Field.ring real-field) b)

record StandardComplexField
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (real-field : Field R) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    field-structure : Field (Complex R)
    zero-is-standard :
      CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring field-structure) ≡
      complexZero real-field
    one-is-standard :
      CommutativeRing.oneR (Field.ring field-structure) ≡
      complexOne real-field
    add-is-standard :
      (z w : Complex R) →
      CommutativeRing.addR
        (Field.ring field-structure) z w
      ≡
      complexAdd real-field z w
    multiply-is-standard :
      (z w : Complex R) →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR
        (Field.ring field-structure) z w
      ≡
      complexMultiply real-field z w
    negate-is-standard :
      (z : Complex R) →
      CommutativeRing.negateR
        (Field.ring field-structure) z
      ≡
      complexNegate real-field z

PointwiseEqual :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
PointwiseEqual f g =
  (x : _) → f x ≡ g x

record InfinitePlaces
  {k r p : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {R : Set r}
  (numberField : Field K)
  (real-field : Field R)
  (real-numbers :
    CompleteArchimedeanOrderedField R real-field)
  (complex-numbers : StandardComplexField real-field)
  (P : Set p) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ r ⊔ p)) where

  field
    representative :
      P →
      FieldEmbedding numberField
        (StandardComplexField.field-structure complex-numbers)
    place-count : Nat
    finite-places :
      Bijection P (Fin place-count)
    complete-up-to-conjugation :
      (embedding :
        FieldEmbedding numberField
          (StandardComplexField.field-structure complex-numbers)) →
      Σ P
        (λ place →
          PointwiseEqual
            (λ x →
              RingHom.map
                (FieldEmbedding.hom embedding) x)
            (λ x →
              RingHom.map
                (FieldEmbedding.hom
                  (representative place)) x)
          ∨
          PointwiseEqual
            (λ x →
              RingHom.map
                (FieldEmbedding.hom embedding) x)
            (λ x →
              complexConjugate real-field
                (RingHom.map
                  (FieldEmbedding.hom
                    (representative place)) x)))
    no-duplicate-places :
      (p q : P) →
      (PointwiseEqual
        (λ x →
          RingHom.map
            (FieldEmbedding.hom (representative p)) x)
        (λ x →
          RingHom.map
            (FieldEmbedding.hom (representative q)) x)
      ∨
      PointwiseEqual
        (λ x →
          RingHom.map
            (FieldEmbedding.hom (representative p)) x)
        (λ x →
          complexConjugate real-field
            (RingHom.map
              (FieldEmbedding.hom
                (representative q)) x))) →
      p ≡ q

record NumberFieldUnitData
  {q k o u r p : Level}
  (Q : Set q)
  (K : Set k)
  (O : Set o)
  (U : Set u)
  (R : Set r)
  (P : Set p) :
  Set (lsuc (q ⊔ k ⊔ o ⊔ u ⊔ r ⊔ p)) where

  field
    rational-field : Field Q
    rationals : RationalField Q rational-field
    number-field : Field K
    rational-inclusion :
      FieldEmbedding rational-field number-field
    finite-dimensional :
      FiniteRationalBasis
        rational-field
        number-field
        rational-inclusion
    ring-of-integers :
      RingOfIntegers number-field O
    unit-group :
      UnitGroupOf
        (RingOfIntegers.ring ring-of-integers)
        U
    real-field : Field R
    real-numbers :
      CompleteArchimedeanOrderedField R real-field
    complex-numbers :
      StandardComplexField real-field
    infinite-places :
      InfinitePlaces
        number-field
        real-field
        real-numbers
        complex-numbers
        P

Torsion :
  {u : Level} →
  {U : Set u} →
  CommutativeGroup U →
  U →
  Set u
Torsion group x =
  Σ Nat
    (λ exponent-minus-one →
      groupPower group x (suc exponent-minus-one) ≡
      CommutativeGroup.identity group)

record Coordinates
  {u : Level}
  {U : Set u}
  (group : CommutativeGroup U)
  (rank : Nat) :
  Set u where

  constructor coordinates
  field
    torsion-unit : U
    torsion-proof : Torsion group torsion-unit
    exponents : Fin rank → Int

Decomposes :
  {u : Level} →
  {U : Set u} →
  (group : CommutativeGroup U) →
  (rank : Nat) →
  (fundamental-system : Fin rank → U) →
  U →
  Coordinates group rank →
  Set u
Decomposes group rank fundamental-system x coordinate-data =
  x ≡
  CommutativeGroup.multiply group
    (Coordinates.torsion-unit coordinate-data)
    (groupProductFin group rank
      (λ i →
        integerPower group
          (fundamental-system i)
          (Coordinates.exponents coordinate-data i)))

record SameCoordinates
  {u : Level}
  {U : Set u}
  {group : CommutativeGroup U}
  {rank : Nat}
  (left-coordinate right-coordinate :
    Coordinates group rank) :
  Set u where

  field
    same-torsion-unit :
      Coordinates.torsion-unit left-coordinate ≡
      Coordinates.torsion-unit right-coordinate
    same-exponents :
      (i : Fin rank) →
      Coordinates.exponents left-coordinate i ≡
      Coordinates.exponents right-coordinate i

UniqueDecomposition :
  {u : Level} →
  {U : Set u} →
  (group : CommutativeGroup U) →
  (rank : Nat) →
  (fundamental-system : Fin rank → U) →
  U →
  Set u
UniqueDecomposition group rank fundamental-system x =
  Σ (Coordinates group rank)
    (λ coordinate-data →
      Decomposes
        group rank fundamental-system x coordinate-data
      ×
      ((other-coordinate-data : Coordinates group rank) →
        Decomposes
          group rank fundamental-system x other-coordinate-data →
        SameCoordinates coordinate-data other-coordinate-data))

record BasisModuloTorsion
  {u : Level}
  {U : Set u}
  (group : CommutativeGroup U)
  (rank : Nat)
  (fundamental-system : Fin rank → U) :
  Set u where

  field
    unique-expansion :
      (x : U) →
      UniqueDecomposition group rank fundamental-system x

-- Lean: NumberField.Units.basisModTorsion and
-- NumberField.Units.exist_unique_eq_mul_prod
dirichlet-unit-theorem :
  (q k o u r p : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (q ⊔ k ⊔ o ⊔ u ⊔ r ⊔ p))
dirichlet-unit-theorem q k o u r p =
  (Q : Set q) →
  (K : Set k) →
  (O : Set o) →
  (U : Set u) →
  (R : Set r) →
  (P : Set p) →
  (number-field-data : NumberFieldUnitData Q K O U R P) →
  let group =
        UnitGroupOf.group
          (NumberFieldUnitData.unit-group number-field-data)
      rank =
        predecessor
          (InfinitePlaces.place-count
            (NumberFieldUnitData.infinite-places number-field-data))
  in
  Σ (Fin rank → U)
    (λ fundamental-system →
      BasisModuloTorsion group rank fundamental-system)

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1227702, "Dirichlet's unit theorem": for a number field, the units of its
  ring of integers modulo roots of unity have a Z-basis of rank one less than
  the number of infinite places, and every unit has a unique decomposition
  into a root of unity times integer powers of fundamental units. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory
     ratTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val q1227702_field_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_field_def",
  ``q1227702_field
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      zero <> oneK /\
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (mul y z) = mul (mul x y) z) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneK x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      kinv zero = zero /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul (kinv x) x = oneK)``);

val q1227702_rat_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_rat_embedding_def",
  ``q1227702_rat_embedding
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a) <=>
      qemb 0q = zero /\
      qemb 1q = oneK /\
      (!q r. qemb (q + r) = add (qemb q) (qemb r)) /\
      (!q r. qemb (q * r) = mul (qemb q) (qemb r)) /\
      (!q. qemb (-q) = neg (qemb q)) /\
      (!q. q <> 0q ==> qemb (rat_minv q) = kinv (qemb q)) /\
      (!q r. qemb q = qemb r ==> q = r)``);

val q1227702_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_lincomb_def",
  ``q1227702_lincomb
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a) (basis : 'a list) (coeff : rat list) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. add acc (mul (qemb (EL i coeff)) (EL i basis)))
        zero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q1227702_rat_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_rat_basis_def",
  ``q1227702_rat_basis
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a) (basis : 'a list) <=>
      !x : 'a.
        ?!coeff : rat list.
          LENGTH coeff = LENGTH basis /\
          q1227702_lincomb zero add mul qemb basis coeff = x``);

val q1227702_number_field_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_number_field_def",
  ``q1227702_number_field
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a) <=>
      q1227702_field zero oneK add mul neg kinv /\
      q1227702_rat_embedding zero oneK add mul neg kinv qemb /\
      ?basis : 'a list.
        q1227702_rat_basis zero add mul qemb basis``);

val q1227702_poly_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_poly_eval_def",
  ``q1227702_poly_eval
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a) (coeff : int list) (x : 'a) =
      FOLDR
        (\c acc. add (qemb (rat_of_int c)) (mul x acc))
        zero
        coeff``);

val q1227702_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_integral_def",
  ``q1227702_integral
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      ?coeff : int list.
        coeff <> [] /\
        LAST coeff = (1 : int) /\
        q1227702_poly_eval zero add mul qemb coeff x = zero``);

val q1227702_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_unit_def",
  ``q1227702_unit
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (kinv : 'a -> 'a) (qemb : rat -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      x <> zero /\
      q1227702_integral zero add mul qemb x /\
      q1227702_integral zero add mul qemb (kinv x)``);

val q1227702_torsion_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_torsion_unit_def",
  ``q1227702_torsion_unit
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (kinv : 'a -> 'a) (qemb : rat -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      q1227702_unit zero add mul kinv qemb x /\
      ?n : num. 0 < n /\ FUNPOW (mul x) n oneK = oneK``);

val q1227702_complex_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_complex_embedding_def",
  ``q1227702_complex_embedding
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (phi : 'a -> complex) <=>
      phi zero = 0 /\
      phi oneK = 1 /\
      (!x y. phi (add x y) = phi x + phi y) /\
      (!x y. phi (mul x y) = phi x * phi y) /\
      (!x. phi (neg x) = -phi x) /\
      (!x y. phi x = phi y ==> x = y)``);

val q1227702_infinite_places_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_infinite_places_def",
  ``q1227702_infinite_places
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) =
      {place : ('a -> complex) set |
        ?phi : 'a -> complex.
          q1227702_complex_embedding zero oneK add mul neg phi /\
          place =
            {psi : 'a -> complex |
              q1227702_complex_embedding zero oneK add mul neg psi /\
              (psi = phi \/ psi = (\x. conj (phi x)))}}``);

val q1227702_unit_rank_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_unit_rank_def",
  ``q1227702_unit_rank
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) =
      CARD (q1227702_infinite_places zero oneK add mul neg) - 1``);

val q1227702_int_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_int_pow_def",
  ``q1227702_int_pow
      (oneK : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a)
      (x : 'a) (z : int) =
      if 0 <= z then FUNPOW (mul x) (Num z) oneK
      else FUNPOW (mul (kinv x)) (Num (-z)) oneK``);

val q1227702_fund_product_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_fund_product_def",
  ``q1227702_fund_product
      (oneK : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a)
      (fund : 'a list) (coeff : int list) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i.
          mul acc
            (q1227702_int_pow oneK mul kinv
              (EL i fund) (EL i coeff)))
        oneK
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH fund))``);

val q1227702_basis_mod_torsion_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_basis_mod_torsion_def",
  ``q1227702_basis_mod_torsion
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (kinv : 'a -> 'a) (qemb : rat -> 'a)
      (rank : num) (fund : 'a list) <=>
      LENGTH fund = rank /\
      EVERY (q1227702_unit zero add mul kinv qemb) fund /\
      !x : 'a.
        q1227702_unit zero add mul kinv qemb x ==>
        ?!coeff : int list.
          LENGTH coeff = rank /\
          q1227702_torsion_unit zero oneK add mul kinv qemb
            (mul x
              (kinv
                (q1227702_fund_product oneK mul kinv fund coeff)))``);

val q1227702_fund_system_def = new_definition (
  "q1227702_fund_system_def",
  ``q1227702_fund_system
      (zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (kinv : 'a -> 'a) (qemb : rat -> 'a) (rank : num) =
      @fund : 'a list.
        q1227702_basis_mod_torsion
          zero oneK add mul kinv qemb rank fund``);

val basisModTorsion =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a).
      q1227702_number_field zero oneK add mul neg kinv qemb ==>
      q1227702_basis_mod_torsion
        zero oneK add mul kinv qemb
        (q1227702_unit_rank zero oneK add mul neg)
        (q1227702_fund_system
          zero oneK add mul kinv qemb
          (q1227702_unit_rank zero oneK add mul neg))``;

val exist_unique_eq_mul_prod =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (oneK : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (kinv : 'a -> 'a)
      (qemb : rat -> 'a).
      q1227702_number_field zero oneK add mul neg kinv qemb ==>
      !x : 'a.
        q1227702_unit zero add mul kinv qemb x ==>
        ?zeta : 'a. ?coeff : int list.
          q1227702_torsion_unit
            zero oneK add mul kinv qemb zeta /\
          LENGTH coeff =
            q1227702_unit_rank zero oneK add mul neg /\
          x =
            mul zeta
              (q1227702_fund_product oneK mul kinv
                (q1227702_fund_system
                  zero oneK add mul kinv qemb
                  (q1227702_unit_rank zero oneK add mul neg))
                coeff) /\
          !zeta' : 'a. !coeff' : int list.
            q1227702_torsion_unit
              zero oneK add mul kinv qemb zeta' /\
            LENGTH coeff' =
              q1227702_unit_rank zero oneK add mul neg /\
            x =
              mul zeta'
                (q1227702_fund_product oneK mul kinv
                  (q1227702_fund_system
                    zero oneK add mul kinv qemb
                    (q1227702_unit_rank zero oneK add mul neg))
                  coeff')
            ==>
            zeta' = zeta /\ coeff' = coeff``;

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1227702
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1227702), "Dirichlet's unit theorem": for a
  number field, presented as an arbitrary finite-dimensional extension of the
  rational field, the units of its ring of integers modulo torsion have a
  Z-basis indexed by the number of infinite places minus one, and every unit
  has a unique expression as a torsion unit times integral powers of lifted
  basis units. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K is an arbitrary field and A is its rational-field homomorphism.
  SetMM realizes the rational field as ( CCfld |`s QQ ).
  Q1227702ExtensionModule is K as a vector space over that field, with scalar
  action c . x = A(c) * x. Q1227702FiniteDimensional says that this vector
  space has a finite basis, exactly the number-field hypothesis in the Lean
  source. A rational-field homomorphism into a field is unique, so making A
  explicit does not restrict K to a chosen subfield of CCfld.

  Q1227702RingOfIntegers restricts K to the elements integral over the
  canonical image of Z. Q1227702UnitGroup is its multiplicative group of
  units, and Q1227702Torsion is the subgroup of units whose group-element
  order is a positive integer.

  Q1227702Embeddings is the set of field embeddings into the complex field.
  Q1227702InfinitePlaces is their orbit set under complex conjugation, written
  as the set of pairs { f, * o. f }. Its cardinal minus one is the source
  rank. The interval 1 ... rank is a harmless one-based reindexing of Lean's
  Fin rank.

  In the final assertion, ran B is a basis of the canonical Z-module attached
  to the unit quotient, F chooses unit representatives of its indexed basis,
  and z ranges over the product of the torsion subgroup with all
  integer-valued exponent functions. SetMM's gsum uses the group operation,
  so on this multiplicative unit group it is the finite product in the Lean
  statement. Every declaration is an unproved $a statement; there is no $p
  proof statement in this file.
$)

$c Q1227702ExtensionModule Q1227702FiniteDimensional
   Q1227702RingOfIntegers Q1227702UnitGroup Q1227702Torsion
   Q1227702Embeddings Q1227702InfinitePlaces Q1227702Rank $.

q1227702-extension-module-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702ExtensionModule K A ) $.
q1227702-finite-dimensional-syntax $a wff
  ( Q1227702FiniteDimensional K A ) $.
q1227702-ring-of-integers-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702RingOfIntegers K ) $.
q1227702-unit-group-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702UnitGroup K ) $.
q1227702-torsion-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702Torsion K ) $.
q1227702-embeddings-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702Embeddings K ) $.
q1227702-infinite-places-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702InfinitePlaces K ) $.
q1227702-rank-syntax $a class
  ( Q1227702Rank K ) $.

${
  $d A K a x $.

  q1227702-extension-module-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702ExtensionModule K A )
    =
    (
      {
        <.
          ( Base ` ndx ) ,
          ( Base ` K )
        >. ,
        <.
          ( +g ` ndx ) ,
          ( +g ` K )
        >. ,
        <.
          ( Scalar ` ndx ) ,
          ( CCfld |`s QQ )
        >.
      }
      u.
      {
        <.
          ( .s ` ndx ) ,
          (
            a e. ( Base ` ( CCfld |`s QQ ) ) ,
            x e. ( Base ` K )
            |->
            ( ( A ` a ) ( .r ` K ) x )
          )
        >.
      }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A K b $.

  q1227702-finite-dimensional-definition $a |- (
    Q1227702FiniteDimensional K A
  ) <->
  (
    E. b e.
      (
        LBasis `
        ( Q1227702ExtensionModule K A )
      )
      b e. Fin
  ) $.
$}

${
  q1227702-ring-of-integers-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702RingOfIntegers K )
    =
    (
      K |`s
      ( K IntgRing ran ( ZRHom ` K ) )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  q1227702-unit-group-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
    =
    (
      ( mulGrp ` ( Q1227702RingOfIntegers K ) )
      |`s
      ( Unit ` ( Q1227702RingOfIntegers K ) )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  q1227702-torsion-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702Torsion K )
    =
    (
      `' ( od ` ( Q1227702UnitGroup K ) ) " NN
    )
  $.
$}

${
  q1227702-embeddings-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702Embeddings K )
    =
    ( K RingHom CCfld )
  $.
$}

${
  $d K f $.

  q1227702-infinite-places-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702InfinitePlaces K )
    =
    ran
    (
      f e. ( Q1227702Embeddings K )
      |->
      { f , ( * o. f ) }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  q1227702-rank-definition $a |-
    ( Q1227702Rank K )
    =
    ( ( # ` ( Q1227702InfinitePlaces K ) ) - 1 )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B F K i x z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1227702-dirichlet-unit-theorem $a |- (
    A. K e. Field
      A. A e. ( ( CCfld |`s QQ ) RingHom K )
        (
          ( Q1227702FiniteDimensional K A )
          ->
          E. B E. F
            (
              (
                B
                :
                ( 1 ... ( Q1227702Rank K ) )
                -1-1->
                (
                  Base `
                  (
                    ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
                    /s
                    (
                      ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
                      ~QG
                      ( Q1227702Torsion K )
                    )
                  )
                )
                /\
                ran B e.
                (
                  LBasis `
                  (
                    ZMod `
                    (
                      ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
                      /s
                      (
                        ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
                        ~QG
                        ( Q1227702Torsion K )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
              /\
              (
                F
                :
                ( 1 ... ( Q1227702Rank K ) )
                -->
                ( Base ` ( Q1227702UnitGroup K ) )
                /\
                A. i e. ( 1 ... ( Q1227702Rank K ) )
                  [
                    ( F ` i )
                  ]
                  (
                    ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
                    ~QG
                    ( Q1227702Torsion K )
                  )
                  =
                  ( B ` i )
              )
              /\
              A. x e. ( Base ` ( Q1227702UnitGroup K ) )
                E! z e.
                (
                  (
                    ( Q1227702Torsion K )
                    X.
                    (
                      ZZ
                      ^m
                      ( 1 ... ( Q1227702Rank K ) )
                    )
                  )
                  x
                  =
                  (
                    ( 1st ` z )
                    ( +g ` ( Q1227702UnitGroup K ) )
                    (
                      ( Q1227702UnitGroup K )
                      gsum
                      (
                        i e. ( 1 ... ( Q1227702Rank K ) )
                        |->
                        (
                          ( ( 2nd ` z ) ` i )
                          ( .g ` ( Q1227702UnitGroup K ) )
                          ( F ` i )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227702,
:: "Dirichlet's unit theorem": the units of the ring of integers of a number
:: field, modulo roots of unity, form a free abelian group whose rank is one
:: less than the number of infinite places. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, VECTSP_1, ALGSTR_0, TARSKI, STRUCT_0, SUBSET_1,
      GROUP_1, GROUP_4, GROUP_5, GROUP_6, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_3, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2,
      RELAT_1,
      PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, CARD_1, CARD_3, XBOOLE_0, NUMBERS, ORDINAL1,
      ZFMISC_1, RLVECT_1, RING_2, RING_3, FIELD_1, FIELD_4, ALGNUM_1,
      COMPLEX1, COMPLFLD, UNIROOTS, XXREAL_0, FINSET_1, EQREL_1, RAT_1,
      GAUSSINT, FUNCSDOM, MSSUBFAM, XCMPLX_0, NEWTON;

      ORDINAL1, FUNCT_2, ZFMISC_1, PARTFUN1, STRUCT_0, CARD_1, NUMBERS,
