title: Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227702
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1227702), "Dirichlet's unit theorem": the units of
% a number field's ring of integers modulo torsion have an integer basis of
% rank one less than the number of infinite places, and every unit has a unique
% torsion-times-fundamental-units decomposition. This file contains no proof.

Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem[
  K: TYPE+,
  Unit: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  invK: [K -> K],
  rational_map: [rat -> K],
  oneU: Unit,
  mulU: [Unit, Unit -> Unit],
  invU: [Unit -> Unit],
  unit_value: [Unit -> K]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  rational_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> rat]
  k_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> K]
  integer_polynomial: TYPE = [nat -> int]
  unit_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> Unit]
  integer_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> int]

  complex_number: TYPE =
    [# real_part: real, imaginary_part: real #]
  complex_embedding: TYPE = [K -> complex_number]
  infinite_place: TYPE = [complex_embedding -> bool]
  place_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> infinite_place]

  complex_zero: complex_number =
    (# real_part := 0, imaginary_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex_number =
    (# real_part := 1, imaginary_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex_number): complex_number =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imaginary_part :=
         imaginary_part(left) + imaginary_part(right) #)

  complex_multiply(left, right: complex_number): complex_number =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imaginary_part(left) * imaginary_part(right),
       imaginary_part :=
         real_part(left) * imaginary_part(right)
           + imaginary_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_conjugate(value: complex_number): complex_number =
    (# real_part := real_part(value),
       imaginary_part := -imaginary_part(value) #)

  field_laws: bool =
    oneK /= zeroK
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K): addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K): addK(x, zeroK) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: K): addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K): mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K): mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
          addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  rational_map_laws: bool =
    rational_map(0) = zeroK
      AND rational_map(1) = oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b: rat):
        rational_map(a + b) =
          addK(rational_map(a), rational_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: rat):
        rational_map(a * b) =
          mulK(rational_map(a), rational_map(b)))

  scalar_multiply(q: rat, x: K): K =
    mulK(rational_map(q), x)

  finite_linear_combination(
      coefficients: rational_sequence,
      vectors: k_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroK
    ELSE
      addK(
        finite_linear_combination(
          coefficients, vectors, count - 1),
        scalar_multiply(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          vectors(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  rational_coordinates_supported_below(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: rational_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES coordinates(index) = 0

  unique_rational_coordinates(
      dimension: nat,
      basis: k_sequence,
      x: K,
      coordinates: rational_sequence): bool =
    rational_coordinates_supported_below(dimension, coordinates)
      AND x =
        finite_linear_combination(
          coordinates, basis, dimension)
      AND (FORALL (other: rational_sequence):
        (rational_coordinates_supported_below(dimension, other)
          AND x =
            finite_linear_combination(
              other, basis, dimension))
        IMPLIES other = coordinates)

  finite_dimensional_over_rationals: bool =
    EXISTS (dimension: posnat), (basis: k_sequence):
      FORALL (x: K):
        EXISTS (coordinates: rational_sequence):
          unique_rational_coordinates(
            dimension, basis, x, coordinates)

  k_power(x: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      oneK
    ELSE
      mulK(k_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  integer_polynomial_value(
      coefficients: integer_polynomial,
      x: K,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroK
    ELSE
      addK(
        integer_polynomial_value(
          coefficients, x, count - 1),
        mulK(
          rational_map(coefficients(count - 1) :: rat),
          k_power(x, count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  monic_integer_polynomial(
      coefficients: integer_polynomial,
      degree: nat): bool =
    coefficients(degree) = 1
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        degree < index IMPLIES coefficients(index) = 0)

  algebraic_integer(x: K): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat),
           (coefficients: integer_polynomial):
      monic_integer_polynomial(coefficients, degree)
        AND integer_polynomial_value(
          coefficients, x, degree + 1) = zeroK

  is_complex_embedding(embedding: complex_embedding): bool =
    embedding(zeroK) = complex_zero
      AND embedding(oneK) = complex_one
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        embedding(addK(x, y)) =
          complex_add(embedding(x), embedding(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        embedding(mulK(x, y)) =
          complex_multiply(embedding(x), embedding(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K):
        embedding(x) = embedding(y) IMPLIES x = y)

  conjugate_complex_embedding(
      embedding: complex_embedding): complex_embedding =
    LAMBDA (x: K): complex_conjugate(embedding(x))

  infinite_place_of_embedding(
      embedding: complex_embedding): infinite_place =
    LAMBDA (candidate: complex_embedding):
      is_complex_embedding(candidate)
        AND (candidate = embedding
          OR candidate = conjugate_complex_embedding(embedding))

  is_infinite_place(place: infinite_place): bool =
    EXISTS (embedding: complex_embedding):
      is_complex_embedding(embedding)
        AND place = infinite_place_of_embedding(embedding)

  unit_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Unit):
      mulU(mulU(x, y), z) = mulU(x, mulU(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Unit):
        mulU(x, y) = mulU(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: Unit):
        mulU(oneU, x) = x
          AND mulU(x, oneU) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: Unit):
        mulU(invU(x), x) = oneU
          AND mulU(x, invU(x)) = oneU)

  unit_representation_laws: bool =
    unit_value(oneU) = oneK
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Unit):
        unit_value(mulU(x, y)) =
          mulK(unit_value(x), unit_value(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: Unit):
        unit_value(invU(x)) = invK(unit_value(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Unit):
        unit_value(x) = unit_value(y) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        (EXISTS (u: Unit): unit_value(u) = x)
          IFF
            algebraic_integer(x)
              AND x /= zeroK
              AND algebraic_integer(invK(x)))

  number_field_context: bool =
    field_laws
      AND rational_map_laws
      AND finite_dimensional_over_rationals
      AND unit_group_laws
      AND unit_representation_laws

  unit_power(x: Unit, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE Unit =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      oneU
    ELSE
      mulU(unit_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  torsion_unit(x: Unit): bool =
    EXISTS (order: posnat):
      unit_power(x, order) = oneU

  integer_power_value(
      base: Unit,
      exponent: int,
      value: Unit): bool =
    (exponent >= 0
      AND EXISTS (power: nat):
        exponent = (power :: int)
          AND value = unit_power(base, power))
      OR
    (exponent < 0
      AND EXISTS (power: posnat):
        exponent = -(power :: int)
          AND value = unit_power(invU(base), power))

  integer_coordinates_supported_below(
      rank: nat,
      coordinates: integer_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      rank <= index IMPLIES coordinates(index) = 0

  product_of_integer_powers(
      basis: unit_sequence,
      coordinates: integer_sequence,
      rank: nat,
      value: Unit): bool =
    EXISTS (powers, partial_products: unit_sequence):
      partial_products(0) = oneU
        AND partial_products(rank) = value
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < rank IMPLIES
            integer_power_value(
              basis(index),
              coordinates(index),
              powers(index))
              AND partial_products(index + 1) =
                mulU(partial_products(index), powers(index)))

  equal_modulo_torsion(x, y: Unit): bool =
    torsion_unit(mulU(x, invU(y)))

  quotient_coordinates(
      rank: nat,
      basis: unit_sequence,
      x: Unit,
      coordinates: integer_sequence): bool =
    integer_coordinates_supported_below(rank, coordinates)
      AND EXISTS (product: Unit):
        product_of_integer_powers(
          basis, coordinates, rank, product)
          AND equal_modulo_torsion(x, product)

  basis_mod_torsion(
      rank: nat,
      basis: unit_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (x: Unit):
      EXISTS (coordinates: integer_sequence):
        quotient_coordinates(rank, basis, x, coordinates)
          AND (FORALL (other: integer_sequence):
            quotient_coordinates(rank, basis, x, other)
              IMPLIES other = coordinates)

  unit_decomposition(
      rank: nat,
      fundamental_units: unit_sequence,
      x, torsion_factor: Unit,
      exponents: integer_sequence): bool =
    torsion_unit(torsion_factor)
      AND integer_coordinates_supported_below(rank, exponents)
      AND EXISTS (product: Unit):
        product_of_integer_powers(
          fundamental_units, exponents, rank, product)
          AND x = mulU(torsion_factor, product)

  unique_unit_decomposition(
      rank: nat,
      fundamental_units: unit_sequence,
      x, torsion_factor: Unit,
      exponents: integer_sequence): bool =
    unit_decomposition(
      rank, fundamental_units, x, torsion_factor, exponents)
      AND (FORALL (other_torsion_factor: Unit),
                  (other_exponents: integer_sequence):
        unit_decomposition(
          rank,
          fundamental_units,
          x,
          other_torsion_factor,
          other_exponents)
        IMPLIES
          other_torsion_factor = torsion_factor
            AND other_exponents = exponents)

  fundamental_system(
      rank: nat,
      fundamental_units: unit_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (x: Unit):
      EXISTS (torsion_factor: Unit),
             (exponents: integer_sequence):
        unique_unit_decomposition(
          rank,
          fundamental_units,
          x,
          torsion_factor,
          exponents)

  exact_place_enumeration(
      places: place_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index < count IMPLIES is_infinite_place(places(index)))
      AND (FORALL (place: infinite_place):
        is_infinite_place(place) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            index < count AND places(index) = place)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: nat):
        left < count
          AND right < count
          AND places(left) = places(right)
        IMPLIES left = right)

  dirichlet_rank(rank: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (place_count: posnat),
           (places: place_sequence):
      exact_place_enumeration(places, place_count)
        AND rank = place_count - 1

  dirichlets_unit_theorem: bool =
    number_field_context IMPLIES
      EXISTS (rank: nat),
             (fundamental_units: unit_sequence):
        dirichlet_rank(rank)
          AND basis_mod_torsion(rank, fundamental_units)
          AND fundamental_system(rank, fundamental_units)

END Q1227702_dirichlet_s_unit_theorem

title: Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1227703
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1227703), "Dirichlet's approximation theorem":
-- on an additive circle of positive circumference, for every point and positive
-- natural number n, some multiplier from 1 through n has norm at most the
-- circumference divided by n + 1. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.AddCircle

@[expose] public section

open Set

namespace Q1227703

variable {T : ℝ} [Fact (0 < T)]

/-- Dirichlet's approximation theorem for the additive circle. -/
theorem exists_norm_nsmul_le (ξ : AddCircle T) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ j ∈ Icc 1 n, ‖j • ξ‖ ≤ T / ↑(n + 1) := sorry

end Q1227703

title: Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1227703
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1227703), "Dirichlet's approximation theorem":
  for every point of the additive circle of positive circumference T and
  every positive n, some multiple indexed from 1 through n has circle norm
  at most T/(n+1). Real representatives modulo the lattice T Z are used.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Reals ZArith.ZArith.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1227703_circle_norm_le
    (T x bound : R) : Prop :=
  exists k : Z,
    Rabs (x - IZR k * T) <= bound.

Theorem AddCircle_exists_norm_nsmul_le :
  forall (T xi : R) (n : nat),
    0 < T ->
    (0 < n)%nat ->
    exists j : nat,
      (1 <= j)%nat /\
      (j <= n)%nat /\
      q1227703_circle_norm_le
        T (INR j * xi) (T / INR (S n)).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227703,
  "Dirichlet's approximation theorem": every point on an additive circle of
  positive circumference has a nonzero multiple, bounded by a given positive
  integer, whose distance to zero is at most the circumference divided by the
  successor of that integer. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem:
  fixes T x :: real
    and n :: nat
  assumes "0 < T"
    and "0 < n"
  shows "\<exists>j::nat. 1 \<le> j \<and> j \<le> n \<and>
    (\<exists>k::int.
      abs (real j * x - of_int k * T) \<le> T / real (n + 1))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227703,
;; "Dirichlet's approximation theorem": every point of the real additive
;; circle of positive circumference T has a multiple j, with 1 <= j <= n,
;; whose circle norm is at most T/(n+1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The real numbers are presented as an arbitrary Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field. Tame unary function objects represent arbitrary subsets for the
;; completeness law. This avoids restricting the source's real domain to the
;; rational numbers available as executable ACL2 numbers.

(defstub q1227703-real-p (x) t)
(defstub q1227703-zero () t)
(defstub q1227703-one () t)
(defstub q1227703-add (left right) t)
(defstub q1227703-multiply (left right) t)
(defstub q1227703-negate (x) t)
(defstub q1227703-inverse (x) t)
(defstub q1227703-less (left right) t)
(defstub q1227703-supremum (set) t)

(defun q1227703-leq (left right)
  (not (q1227703-less right left)))

(defun q1227703-subtract (left right)
  (q1227703-add left (q1227703-negate right)))

(defun q1227703-absolute-value (x)
  (if (q1227703-less x (q1227703-zero))
      (q1227703-negate x)
    x))

(defun q1227703-positive-p (x)
  (and
   (q1227703-real-p x)
   (q1227703-less (q1227703-zero) x)))

(defun q1227703-set-member-p (set x)
  (if (apply$ set (list x)) t nil))

(defun-sk q1227703-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227703-real-p x)
      (q1227703-real-p y)
      (q1227703-real-p z))
     (let* ((zero (q1227703-zero))
            (one (q1227703-one))
            (xy-add (q1227703-add x y))
            (yz-add (q1227703-add y z))
            (xy-mul (q1227703-multiply x y))
            (yz-mul (q1227703-multiply y z))
            (neg-x (q1227703-negate x))
            (inv-x (q1227703-inverse x)))
       (and
        (q1227703-real-p xy-add)
        (q1227703-real-p xy-mul)
        (q1227703-real-p neg-x)
        (q1227703-real-p inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1227703-add xy-add z)
         (q1227703-add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1227703-add y x))
        (equal (q1227703-add x zero) x)
        (equal (q1227703-add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1227703-multiply xy-mul z)
         (q1227703-multiply x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1227703-multiply y x))
        (equal (q1227703-multiply x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (q1227703-multiply x inv-x) one))
        (equal
         (q1227703-multiply x yz-add)
         (q1227703-add
          (q1227703-multiply x y)
          (q1227703-multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1227703-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227703-real-p x)
      (q1227703-real-p y)
      (q1227703-real-p z))
     (let ((zero (q1227703-zero)))
       (and
        (not (q1227703-less x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1227703-less x y)
         (q1227703-less y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1227703-less x y)
          (q1227703-less y z))
         (q1227703-less x z))
        (implies
         (q1227703-less x y)
         (q1227703-less
          (q1227703-add x z)
          (q1227703-add y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1227703-less zero x)
          (q1227703-less zero y))
         (q1227703-less
          zero
          (q1227703-multiply x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1227703-valid-real-set-p (set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1227703-set-member-p set x)
     (q1227703-real-p x))))

(defun-sk q1227703-set-nonempty-p (set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1227703-real-p x)
     (q1227703-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1227703-upper-bound-p (set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227703-real-p x)
      (q1227703-set-member-p set x))
     (q1227703-leq x bound))))

(defun-sk q1227703-bounded-above-p (set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1227703-real-p bound)
     (q1227703-upper-bound-p set bound))))

(defun-sk q1227703-least-upper-bound-p (set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1227703-real-p supremum)
     (q1227703-upper-bound-p set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1227703-real-p bound)
       (q1227703-upper-bound-p set bound))
      (q1227703-leq supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q1227703-dedekind-complete-p ()
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (q1227703-valid-real-set-p set)
      (q1227703-set-nonempty-p set)
      (q1227703-bounded-above-p set))
     (q1227703-least-upper-bound-p
      set
      (q1227703-supremum set)))))

(defun q1227703-real-context-p ()
  (let ((zero (q1227703-zero))
        (one (q1227703-one)))
    (and
     (q1227703-real-p zero)
     (q1227703-real-p one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1227703-field-laws-p)
     (q1227703-order-laws-p)
     (q1227703-less zero one)
     (q1227703-dedekind-complete-p))))

;; Natural and integer scalar multiplication are the canonical repeated
;; additions in the presented real field.

(defun q1227703-nsmul (n x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1227703-zero)
    (q1227703-add
     x
     (q1227703-nsmul (- n 1) x))))

(defun q1227703-zsmul (k x)
  (if (and (integerp k) (< k 0))
      (q1227703-negate
       (q1227703-nsmul (- k) x))
    (q1227703-nsmul (nfix k) x)))

(defun q1227703-natural-cast (n)
  (q1227703-nsmul n (q1227703-one)))

(defun q1227703-divide (numerator denominator)
  (q1227703-multiply
   numerator
   (q1227703-inverse denominator)))

;; A representative X denotes a point of R/(T Z). The quotient norm inequality
;; ||j [X]|| <= B is definitionally eliminated as the existence of an integer

(defun-sk q1227703-integer-approximation-p
    (period representative j bound)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (integerp k)
     (q1227703-leq
      (q1227703-absolute-value
       (q1227703-subtract
        (q1227703-nsmul j representative)
        (q1227703-zsmul k period)))

(defun-sk q1227703-dirichlet-witness-p
    (period representative n)
  (exists (j)
    (and
     (natp j)
     (<= 1 j)
     (<= j n)
     (q1227703-integer-approximation-p
      period
      representative
      j
      (q1227703-divide
       period
       (q1227703-natural-cast (+ n 1)))))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1227703-dirichlet-approximation-statement ()
  (forall (period representative n)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1227703-real-context-p)
      (q1227703-positive-p period)
      (q1227703-real-p representative)
      (natp n)
      (< 0 n))
     (q1227703-dirichlet-witness-p
      period representative n))))

title: Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1227703,
-- "Dirichlet's approximation theorem": every point of a real additive circle
-- of positive circumference T has, for each positive n, a multiple indexed
-- from 1 through n whose circle norm is at most T / (n + 1), expressed using
-- a real representative modulo integer multiples of T. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessThanR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR
    negate-involutive :
      (x : R) ->
      negateR (negateR x) == x

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-irreflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessThanR x x ->
      Bottom
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessThanR x y ->
      lessThanR y z ->
      lessThanR x z
    order-trichotomy :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR x y or
      (x == y or lessThanR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessThanR x y ->
      lessThanR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-positive :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR zeroR x ->
      lessThanR zeroR y ->
      lessThanR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessThanR zeroR oneR

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessThanR zeroR (absoluteR x) or absoluteR x == zeroR
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      (lessThanR zeroR x or zeroR == x) ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      (lessThanR x zeroR or x == zeroR) ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)
    absolute-triangle :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessThanR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)) or
      absoluteR (addR x y) ==
        addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-addition :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplication :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessThanR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessThanR x upper or x == upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessThanR x supremum or x == supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessThanR x upper or x == upper) ->
            lessThanR supremum upper or supremum == upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

LessOrEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
LessOrEqual reals x y =
  lessThanR reals x y or x == y

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

fromIntR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromIntR reals (pos n) =
  fromNatR reals n
fromIntR reals (negsuc n) =
  negateR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n))

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) :
  Set1 where

  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (inverseR source x) ==
      inverseR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) ==
      fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessThanR source x y)
        (lessThanR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set2 where

  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

CircleNormAtMost :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CircleNormAtMost {R = R} reals T representative bound =
  Exists Int
    (\ periodShift ->
      LessOrEqual reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals representative
            (multiplyR reals
              (fromIntR reals periodShift)
              T)))
        bound)

dirichlet-s-approximation-theorem : Set2
dirichlet-s-approximation-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (T : R) ->
  lessThanR reals (zeroR reals) T ->
  (representative : R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  zero <N n ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ j ->
      (suc zero <=N j)
      and
      ((j <=N n)
      and
      CircleNormAtMost reals T
        (multiplyR reals
          (fromNatR reals j)
          representative)
        (divideR reals T (fromNatR reals (suc n)))))

  circumference, every point on the additive real circle, and every positive

val addCircle_exists_norm_nsmul_le =

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1227703
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1227703), "Dirichlet's approximation
  theorem": every point of a real additive circle has a positive multiple,
  bounded by a prescribed positive natural number, whose quotient norm is at
  most the circumference divided by one more than that bound. This root
  statement file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A point of AddCircle T is represented by an arbitrary real x, with two
  representatives identified when their difference is an integer multiple of
  the positive circumference T. For j in 1 ... n, the quotient norm of j times
  that point is at most T / (n + 1) exactly when some k in ZZ satisfies the
  absolute-value inequality below. Thus quantifying over all real x is
  equivalent to quantifying over every element of the quotient RR / T ZZ.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this root
  statement file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d T j k n x $.

  thousand-theorems-q1227703-dirichlet-approximation-theorem $a |-
    A. T e. RR
      A. x e. RR
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            (
              0 < T
              /\
              0 < n
            )
            ->
            E. j e. ( 1 ... n )
              E. k e. ZZ
                (
                  abs `
                  (
                    ( j x. x )
                    -
                    ( k x. T )
                  )
                )
                <_
                (
                  T
                  /
                  ( n + 1 )
                )
          )
  $.
$}

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1227703
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1227703), "Dirichlet's approximation theorem":
% every point represented on an additive circle of positive circumference T

Q1227703_dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  dirichlet_s_approximation_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (T, x: real), (n: nat):
      (0 < T AND 0 < n)

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1243340
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1243340), "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": the set
-- of doubly stochastic matrices over a strictly ordered field is the convex hull
-- of the permutation matrices. This file contains no proof.

namespace Q1243340Support

universe u v

/-- An explicit presentation of a strictly ordered field. -/
class StrictOrderedField (R : Type u) where
  zero : R
  one : R
  add : R → R → R
  neg : R → R
  mul : R → R → R
  inv : R → R
  le : R → R → Prop
  decidableLE : DecidableRel le
  add_assoc : ∀ a b c : R, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c)
  add_comm : ∀ a b : R, add a b = add b a
  zero_add : ∀ a : R, add zero a = a
  add_left_neg : ∀ a : R, add (neg a) a = zero
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : R, mul (mul a b) c = mul a (mul b c)
  mul_comm : ∀ a b : R, mul a b = mul b a
  one_mul : ∀ a : R, mul one a = a
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, mul a (add b c) = add (mul a b) (mul a c)
  inv_zero : inv zero = zero
  mul_inv_cancel : ∀ a : R, a ≠ zero → mul a (inv a) = one
  le_refl : ∀ a : R, le a a
  le_trans : ∀ a b c : R, le a b → le b c → le a c
  le_antisymm : ∀ a b : R, le a b → le b a → a = b
  le_total : ∀ a b : R, le a b ∨ le b a
  add_le_add_left : ∀ a b c : R, le a b → le (add c a) (add c b)
  zero_lt_one : le zero one ∧ zero ≠ one
  mul_pos : ∀ a b : R,
    le zero a → a ≠ zero → le zero b → b ≠ zero →
      le zero (mul a b) ∧ mul a b ≠ zero

def ListMem {α : Type u} (x : α) : List α → Prop
  | [] => False
  | y :: ys => x = y ∨ ListMem x ys

def ListNodup {α : Type u} : List α → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: xs => ¬ListMem x xs ∧ ListNodup xs

/-- A duplicate-free enumeration of a finite type. -/
class FiniteType (n : Type u) where
  elements : List n
  nodup : ListNodup elements
  complete : ∀ i : n, ListMem i elements

abbrev Matrix (n : Type u) (R : Type v) := n → n → R

/-- A permutation presented together with a two-sided inverse. -/
structure Permutation (n : Type u) where
  toFun : n → n
  invFun : n → n
  left_inv : ∀ i, invFun (toFun i) = i
  right_inv : ∀ i, toFun (invFun i) = i

def sumOnList {R : Type u} {α : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R) (f : α → R) :
    List α → R
  | [] => K.zero
  | x :: xs => K.add (f x) (sumOnList K f xs)

def finiteSum {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R) (F : FiniteType n)
    (f : n → R) : R :=
  sumOnList K f F.elements

def matrixZero {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R) : Matrix n R :=
  fun _ _ => K.zero

def matrixAdd {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R)
    (A B : Matrix n R) : Matrix n R :=
  fun i j => K.add (A i j) (B i j)

def matrixSmul {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R) (a : R)
    (A : Matrix n R) : Matrix n R :=
  fun i j => K.mul a (A i j)

def permMatrix {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R) [DecidableEq n]
    (σ : Permutation n) : Matrix n R :=
  fun i j => if σ.toFun i = j then K.one else K.zero

/-- Entrywise nonnegative matrices whose rows and columns each sum to one. -/
def doublyStochastic {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R)
    (F : FiniteType n) : Matrix n R → Prop :=
  fun M =>
    (∀ i j, K.le K.zero (M i j)) ∧
      (∀ i, finiteSum K F (fun j => M i j) = K.one) ∧
      ∀ j, finiteSum K F (fun i => M i j) = K.one

def SameLength {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : List α → List β → Prop
  | [], [] => True
  | _ :: xs, _ :: ys => SameLength xs ys
  | _, _ => False

def AllNonnegative {R : Type u} (K : StrictOrderedField R) : List R → Prop
  | [] => True
  | w :: ws => K.le K.zero w ∧ AllNonnegative K ws

def weightedPermSum {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R) [DecidableEq n] :
    List R → List (Permutation n) → Matrix n R
  | w :: ws, σ :: σs =>
      matrixAdd K (matrixSmul K w (permMatrix K σ)) (weightedPermSum K ws σs)
  | _, _ => matrixZero K

/-- Membership in the convex hull of the permutation matrices. -/
def convexHullPermutationMatrices {R : Type u} {n : Type v} (K : StrictOrderedField R)
    [DecidableEq n] : Matrix n R → Prop :=
  fun M =>
    ∃ weights : List R, ∃ permutations : List (Permutation n),
      SameLength weights permutations ∧
        AllNonnegative K weights ∧
        sumOnList K (fun w => w) weights = K.one ∧
        weightedPermSum K weights permutations = M

end Q1243340Support

open Q1243340Support

universe u v

variable {R : Type u} {n : Type v}
variable [K : StrictOrderedField R] [F : FiniteType n] [DecidableEq n]

/-- The Birkhoff–Von Neumann characterization of doubly stochastic matrices. -/
theorem doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix :
    doublyStochastic K F = convexHullPermutationMatrices K := sorry

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1243340
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1243340), "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": over
  any linear ordered field and finite index type, the doubly stochastic
  matrices are exactly the convex hull of the permutation matrices. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1243340_linear_ordered_field (F : Type) : Type := {
  q1243340_zero : F;
  q1243340_one : F;
  q1243340_add : F -> F -> F;
  q1243340_mul : F -> F -> F;
  q1243340_neg : F -> F;
  q1243340_inv : F -> F;
  q1243340_le : F -> F -> Prop;
  q1243340_zero_ne_one :
    q1243340_zero <> q1243340_one;
  q1243340_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1243340_add x (q1243340_add y z) =
      q1243340_add (q1243340_add x y) z;
  q1243340_add_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      q1243340_add x y = q1243340_add y x;
  q1243340_add_zero :
    forall x : F, q1243340_add x q1243340_zero = x;
  q1243340_add_neg :
    forall x : F,
      q1243340_add x (q1243340_neg x) = q1243340_zero;
  q1243340_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1243340_mul x (q1243340_mul y z) =
      q1243340_mul (q1243340_mul x y) z;
  q1243340_mul_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      q1243340_mul x y = q1243340_mul y x;
  q1243340_mul_one :
    forall x : F, q1243340_mul x q1243340_one = x;
  q1243340_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1243340_mul x (q1243340_add y z) =
      q1243340_add
        (q1243340_mul x y) (q1243340_mul x z);
  q1243340_inv_zero :
    q1243340_inv q1243340_zero = q1243340_zero;
  q1243340_mul_inv :
    forall x : F,
      x <> q1243340_zero ->
      q1243340_mul x (q1243340_inv x) = q1243340_one;
  q1243340_le_refl :
    forall x : F, q1243340_le x x;
  q1243340_le_trans :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1243340_le x y ->
      q1243340_le y z ->
      q1243340_le x z;
  q1243340_le_antisym :
    forall x y : F,
      q1243340_le x y ->
      q1243340_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q1243340_le_total :
    forall x y : F,
      q1243340_le x y \/ q1243340_le y x;
  q1243340_add_le_add_left :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1243340_le x y ->
      q1243340_le
        (q1243340_add z x) (q1243340_add z y);
  q1243340_mul_pos :
    forall x y : F,
      q1243340_le q1243340_zero x ->
      q1243340_le q1243340_zero y ->
      q1243340_le q1243340_zero (q1243340_mul x y)
}.

Arguments q1243340_zero {F} _.
Arguments q1243340_one {F} _.
Arguments q1243340_add {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q1243340_mul {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q1243340_neg {F} _ _.
Arguments q1243340_inv {F} _ _.
Arguments q1243340_le {F} _ _ _.

Record q1243340_finite_type (I : Type) : Type := {
  q1243340_enum : list I;
  q1243340_enum_nodup : NoDup q1243340_enum;
  q1243340_enum_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q1243340_enum;
  q1243340_eq_dec :
    forall i j : I, {i = j} + {i <> j}
}.

Arguments q1243340_enum {I} _.
Arguments q1243340_eq_dec {I} _ _ _.

Record q1243340_permutation (I : Type) : Type := {
  q1243340_perm_apply : I -> I;
  q1243340_perm_inverse : I -> I;
  q1243340_perm_left_inverse :
    forall i : I,
      q1243340_perm_inverse (q1243340_perm_apply i) = i;
  q1243340_perm_right_inverse :
    forall i : I,
      q1243340_perm_apply (q1243340_perm_inverse i) = i
}.

Arguments q1243340_perm_apply {I} _ _.
Arguments q1243340_perm_inverse {I} _ _.

Definition q1243340_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1243340_subset {A : Type}
    (S T : q1243340_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q1243340_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q1243340_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q1243340_matrix (I F : Type) : Type :=
  I -> I -> F.

Definition q1243340_matrix_equal {I F : Type}
    (A B : q1243340_matrix I F) : Prop :=
  forall i j : I, A i j = B i j.

(* Matrix predicates are extensional, as they are in the Lean source. *)
Definition q1243340_matrix_extensional {I F : Type}
    (S : q1243340_set (q1243340_matrix I F)) : Prop :=
  forall A B : q1243340_matrix I F,
    q1243340_matrix_equal A B ->
    S A ->
    S B.

Fixpoint q1243340_sum_list {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (xs : list I)
    (f : I -> F) : F :=
  match xs with
  | nil => q1243340_zero fld
  | cons x rest =>
      q1243340_add fld
        (f x) (q1243340_sum_list fld rest f)
  end.

Definition q1243340_finite_sum {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (fin : q1243340_finite_type I)
    (f : I -> F) : F :=
  q1243340_sum_list fld (q1243340_enum fin) f.

Definition q1243340_matrix_add {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (A B : q1243340_matrix I F) : q1243340_matrix I F :=
  fun i j =>
    q1243340_add fld (A i j) (B i j).

Definition q1243340_matrix_smul {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (a : F)
    (A : q1243340_matrix I F) : q1243340_matrix I F :=
  fun i j => q1243340_mul fld a (A i j).

Definition q1243340_convex {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (S : q1243340_set (q1243340_matrix I F)) : Prop :=
  forall (A B : q1243340_matrix I F) (a b : F),
    S A ->
    S B ->
    q1243340_le fld (q1243340_zero fld) a ->
    q1243340_le fld (q1243340_zero fld) b ->
    q1243340_add fld a b = q1243340_one fld ->
    S
      (q1243340_matrix_add fld
        (q1243340_matrix_smul fld a A)
        (q1243340_matrix_smul fld b B)).

Definition q1243340_convex_hull {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (S : q1243340_set (q1243340_matrix I F))
    : q1243340_set (q1243340_matrix I F) :=
  fun M =>
    forall C : q1243340_set (q1243340_matrix I F),
      q1243340_matrix_extensional C ->
      q1243340_convex fld C ->
      q1243340_subset S C ->
      C M.

Definition q1243340_permutation_matrix {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (fin : q1243340_finite_type I)
    (p : q1243340_permutation I) : q1243340_matrix I F :=
  fun i j =>
    if q1243340_eq_dec fin (q1243340_perm_apply p i) j
    then q1243340_one fld
    else q1243340_zero fld.

Definition q1243340_permutation_matrices {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (fin : q1243340_finite_type I)
    : q1243340_set (q1243340_matrix I F) :=
  fun M =>
    exists p : q1243340_permutation I,
      q1243340_matrix_equal M
        (q1243340_permutation_matrix fld fin p).

Definition q1243340_doubly_stochastic {I F : Type}
    (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
    (fin : q1243340_finite_type I)
    (M : q1243340_matrix I F) : Prop :=
  (forall i j : I,
    q1243340_le fld (q1243340_zero fld) (M i j)) /\
  (forall i : I,
    q1243340_finite_sum fld fin (fun j => M i j) =
    q1243340_one fld) /\
  forall j : I,
    q1243340_finite_sum fld fin (fun i => M i j) =
    q1243340_one fld.

Theorem doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix :
  forall (F I : Type)
         (fld : q1243340_linear_ordered_field F)
         (fin : q1243340_finite_type I),
    q1243340_same_set
      (q1243340_doubly_stochastic fld fin)
      (q1243340_convex_hull fld
        (q1243340_permutation_matrices fld fin)).
Admitted.

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1243340
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1243340), "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem":
  over any linearly ordered field and any finite carrier, including the empty
  carrier, the doubly stochastic matrices are exactly the convex hull of the
  permutation matrices. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1243340_doubly_stochastic ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a::linordered_field) set"
  where
  "q1243340_doubly_stochastic I =
    {M. (\<forall>i j. M i j \<noteq> 0 \<longrightarrow> i \<in> I \<and> j \<in> I) \<and>
      (\<forall>i\<in>I. \<forall>j\<in>I. 0 \<le> M i j) \<and>
      (\<forall>i\<in>I. (\<Sum>j\<in>I. M i j) = 1) \<and>
      (\<forall>j\<in>I. (\<Sum>i\<in>I. M i j) = 1)}"

definition q1243340_permutation_matrices ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a::linordered_field) set"
  where
  "q1243340_permutation_matrices I =
    {P. \<exists>\<sigma> :: 'i \<Rightarrow> 'i.
      bij_betw \<sigma> I I \<and>
      P = (\<lambda>i j. if i \<in> I \<and> j \<in> I \<and> \<sigma> i = j then 1 else 0)}"

definition q1243340_convex_hull_matrix ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a::linordered_field) set
      \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set" where
  "q1243340_convex_hull_matrix S =
    {M. \<exists>w :: ('i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a.
      finite {P. w P \<noteq> 0} \<and>
      {P. w P \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> S \<and>
      (\<forall>P. 0 \<le> w P) \<and>
      (\<Sum>P\<in>{P. w P \<noteq> 0}. w P) = 1 \<and>
      M = (\<lambda>i j. \<Sum>P\<in>{P. w P \<noteq> 0}. w P * P i j)}"

theorem doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix:
  fixes I :: "'i set"
  assumes finite_I: "finite I"
  shows "(q1243340_doubly_stochastic I ::
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a::linordered_field) set) =
    q1243340_convex_hull_matrix (q1243340_permutation_matrices I)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1243340,
  "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": over an arbitrary linearly ordered field,
  the doubly stochastic matrices on any finite index type, represented by a
  finite subset to include the empty case, are exactly the convex hull of the
  permutation matrices. This file contains no proof.
*)

let DOUBLY_STOCHASTIC_EQ_CONVEX_HULL_PERM_MATRIX =
 `let linear_ordered_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
     (neg:A->A) (invk:A->A) (le:A->A->bool).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x y z:A. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:A. add zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y z:A. mul x (mul y z) = mul (mul x y) z) /\
       (!x y:A. mul x y = mul y x) /\
       (!x:A. mul oneK x = x) /\
       invk zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mul (invk x) x = oneK) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y \/ le y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y ==> le (add x z) (add y z)) /\
       (!x y:A. le zeroK x /\ le zeroK y ==> le zeroK (mul x y)) in
  let matrix_on =
    \(zeroK:A) (s:I->bool) (M:I->I->A).
       !i j:I. ~(i IN s /\ j IN s) ==> M i j = zeroK in
  let doubly_stochastic =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (add:A->A->A) (le:A->A->bool)
     (s:I->bool).
       {M:I->I->A |
          matrix_on zeroK s M /\
          (!i j:I. i IN s /\ j IN s ==> le zeroK (M i j)) /\
          (!i:I.
             i IN s
             ==> iterate add s (\j:I. M i j) = oneK) /\
          (!j:I.
             j IN s
             ==> iterate add s (\i:I. M i j) = oneK)} in
  let permutation_matrix =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (s:I->bool) (p:I->I) (M:I->I->A).
       matrix_on zeroK s M /\
       BIJ p s s /\
       (!i j:I.
          i IN s /\ j IN s
          ==> M i j = if p i = j then oneK else zeroK) in
  let permutation_matrices =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (s:I->bool).
       {M:I->I->A |
          ?p:I->I. permutation_matrix zeroK oneK s p M} in
  let convex_set =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
     (le:A->A->bool) (c:(I->I->A)->bool).
       !M N:I->I->A. !a b:A.
         M IN c /\ N IN c /\
         le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b /\ add a b = oneK
         ==> (\i j:I.
                add (mul a (M i j)) (mul b (N i j))) IN c in
  let convex_hull =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
     (le:A->A->bool) (u:(I->I->A)->bool).
       {M:I->I->A |
          !c:(I->I->A)->bool.
            u SUBSET c /\
            convex_set zeroK oneK add mul le c
            ==> M IN c} in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !add mul:A->A->A.
  !neg invk:A->A.
  !le:A->A->bool.
  !s:I->bool.
    linear_ordered_field zeroK oneK add mul neg invk le /\
    FINITE s
    ==>
    doubly_stochastic zeroK oneK add le s =
    convex_hull zeroK oneK add mul le
      (permutation_matrices zeroK oneK s)`;;

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1243340
;; (thousand-theorems__acl2__Q1243340), "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": over
;; any linearly ordered field, the set of finite doubly stochastic matrices is
;; exactly the convex hull of the permutation matrices. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A finite index type is transported along a bijection to 0,...,n-1.
;; Matrices are exact n-by-n tables, extensionally equivalent to functions on
;; the source finite type. Field carriers and operations are tame APPLY$
;; functions with all ordered-field laws stated below. FN-EQUAL supplies
;; unbounded universal quantification, and inequality with a constant-false
;; function supplies the internal convex weights.
;;
;; The statement's free MATRIX formal supplies the outer universal
;; quantification. Every reified matrix or weight predicate is a
;; primitive-only ACL2 lambda. Its finitely many matrix entries and
;; permutations are unrolled when the function object is constructed. Thus
;; no helper call hidden in a reified lambda can make the statement vacuous.

(defun q1243340-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1243340-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q1243340-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1243340-quoted nil)))

(defun q1243340-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q1243340-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1243340-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1243340-apply-term
   (q1243340-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q1243340-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1243340-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q1243340-quoted nil))
    (q1243340-quoted t)))

(defun q1243340-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1243340-quoted t)
       (q1243340-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q1243340-quoted nil)))

(defun q1243340-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q1243340-quoted nil)
   (q1243340-quoted t)))

(defun q1243340-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q1243340-quoted t)))

(defun q1243340-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1243340-quoted t)
    (q1243340-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1243340-quoted nil)
    (q1243340-quoted t))))

(defun q1243340-nth-term (index tuple)
  (list 'nth (q1243340-quoted index) tuple))

(defun q1243340-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1243340-quoted t)))

(defun q1243340-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1243340-quoted nil)))

(defun q1243340-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (q1243340-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q1243340-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object))
      t
    nil))

;; Exact first-order laws of a nontrivial linearly ordered field.

(defun q1243340-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (let* ((xy-add
          (q1243340-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add
          (q1243340-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul
          (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul
          (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q1243340-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x
          (q1243340-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q1243340-implies-term
      (q1243340-and-terms
       (list
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1243340-and-terms
       (list
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
         (q1243340-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-add
         (q1243340-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x (q1243340-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
         (q1243340-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
         (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-mul
         (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-static-apply-term
          multiply
          (list 'x (q1243340-quoted one)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
         (q1243340-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
           (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))
        (q1243340-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q1243340-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q1243340-quoted zero)))
        (q1243340-implies-term
         (q1243340-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q1243340-quoted zero)))
         (list
          'equal
          (q1243340-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x inv-x))
          (q1243340-quoted one)))
        (q1243340-not-term
         (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q1243340-implies-term
         (q1243340-and-terms
          (list
           (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(x y))
           (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
         (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q1243340-or-terms
         (list
          (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(x y))
          (list 'equal 'x 'y)
          (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(y x))))
        (q1243340-implies-term
         (q1243340-static-apply-term less '(x y))
         (q1243340-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q1243340-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q1243340-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q1243340-implies-term
         (q1243340-and-terms
          (list
           (q1243340-static-apply-term
            less
            (list (q1243340-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q1243340-static-apply-term
            less
            (list (q1243340-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q1243340-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q1243340-quoted zero)
           xy-mul)))))))))

(defun q1243340-linearly-ordered-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (let ((laws
         (q1243340-field-laws-function
          carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp carrier)
     (tamep-functionp add)
     (tamep-functionp multiply)
     (tamep-functionp negate)
     (tamep-functionp inverse)
     (tamep-functionp less)
     (q1243340-member-p carrier zero)
     (q1243340-member-p carrier one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (tamep-functionp laws)
     (q1243340-universal-p laws '(x y z)))))

;; Finite indices and the complete permutation enumeration.

(defun q1243340-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     start
     (q1243340-range-from (+ 1 start) (- count 1)))))

(defun q1243340-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons item (car lists))
     (q1243340-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun q1243340-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons
     (cons item list)
     (q1243340-prefix-each
      (car list)
      (q1243340-insert-everywhere item (cdr list))))))

(defun q1243340-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (q1243340-insert-everywhere item (car lists))
     (q1243340-insert-into-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun q1243340-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (q1243340-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (q1243340-permutations (cdr list)))))

;; Primitive term generators for typed matrices and field expressions.

(defun q1243340-row-entry-valid-terms
    (carrier row-term columns)
  (if (endp columns)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1243340-static-apply-term
      carrier
      (list (q1243340-nth-term (car columns) row-term)))
     (q1243340-row-entry-valid-terms
      carrier row-term (cdr columns)))))

(defun q1243340-matrix-row-valid-terms
    (carrier n matrix-term rows columns)
  (if (endp rows)
      nil
    (let ((row-term
           (q1243340-nth-term (car rows) matrix-term)))
      (append
       (list
        (list 'true-listp row-term)
        (list
         'equal
         (list 'len row-term)
         (q1243340-quoted n)))
       (q1243340-row-entry-valid-terms
        carrier row-term columns)
       (q1243340-matrix-row-valid-terms
        carrier n matrix-term (cdr rows) columns)))))

(defun q1243340-matrix-valid-term
    (carrier n matrix-term rows columns)
  (q1243340-and-terms
   (append
    (list
     (list 'true-listp matrix-term)
     (list
      'equal
      (list 'len matrix-term)
      (q1243340-quoted n)))
    (q1243340-matrix-row-valid-terms
     carrier n matrix-term rows columns))))

(defun q1243340-field-sum-term (add zero values)
  (if (endp values)
      (q1243340-quoted zero)
    (q1243340-static-apply-term
     add
     (list
      (car values)
      (q1243340-field-sum-term add zero (cdr values))))))

(defun q1243340-row-entry-terms (row-term columns)
  (if (endp columns)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1243340-nth-term (car columns) row-term)
     (q1243340-row-entry-terms row-term (cdr columns)))))

(defun q1243340-row-nonnegative-terms
    (less zero row-term columns)
  (if (endp columns)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1243340-not-term
      (q1243340-static-apply-term
       less
       (list
        (q1243340-nth-term (car columns) row-term)
        (q1243340-quoted zero))))
     (q1243340-row-nonnegative-terms
      less zero row-term (cdr columns)))))

(defun q1243340-matrix-nonnegative-terms
    (less zero matrix-term rows columns)
  (if (endp rows)
      nil
    (append
     (q1243340-row-nonnegative-terms
      less zero
      (q1243340-nth-term (car rows) matrix-term)
      columns)
     (q1243340-matrix-nonnegative-terms
      less zero matrix-term (cdr rows) columns))))

(defun q1243340-row-sum-one-terms
    (add zero one matrix-term rows columns)
  (if (endp rows)
      nil
    (let ((row-term
           (q1243340-nth-term (car rows) matrix-term)))
      (cons
       (list
        'equal
        (q1243340-field-sum-term
         add zero
         (q1243340-row-entry-terms row-term columns))
        (q1243340-quoted one))
       (q1243340-row-sum-one-terms
        add zero one matrix-term (cdr rows) columns)))))

(defun q1243340-column-entry-terms
    (matrix-term rows column)
  (if (endp rows)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1243340-nth-term
      column
      (q1243340-nth-term (car rows) matrix-term))
     (q1243340-column-entry-terms
      matrix-term (cdr rows) column))))

(defun q1243340-column-sum-one-terms
    (add zero one matrix-term rows columns)
  (if (endp columns)
      nil
    (cons
     (list
      'equal
      (q1243340-field-sum-term
       add zero
       (q1243340-column-entry-terms
        matrix-term rows (car columns)))
      (q1243340-quoted one))
     (q1243340-column-sum-one-terms
      add zero one matrix-term rows (cdr columns)))))

(defun q1243340-doubly-stochastic-term
    (add zero one less matrix-term rows columns)
  (q1243340-and-terms
   (append
    (q1243340-matrix-nonnegative-terms
     less zero matrix-term rows columns)
    (q1243340-row-sum-one-terms
     add zero one matrix-term rows columns)
    (q1243340-column-sum-one-terms
     add zero one matrix-term rows columns))))

;; Primitive terms for a convex weighting of every permutation matrix.

(defun q1243340-values-at-indices (tuple indices)
  (if (endp indices)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1243340-nth-term (car indices) tuple)
     (q1243340-values-at-indices tuple (cdr indices)))))

(defun q1243340-weight-entry-valid-terms
    (carrier less zero weights indices)
  (if (endp indices)
      nil
    (let ((weight
           (q1243340-nth-term (car indices) weights)))
      (cons
       (q1243340-static-apply-term carrier (list weight))
       (cons
        (q1243340-not-term
         (q1243340-static-apply-term
          less
          (list weight (q1243340-quoted zero))))
        (q1243340-weight-entry-valid-terms
         carrier less zero weights (cdr indices)))))))

(defun q1243340-weighted-entry-term
    (add multiply zero one weights permutations
     weight-index row column)
  (if (endp permutations)
      (q1243340-quoted zero)
    (q1243340-static-apply-term
     add
     (list
      (q1243340-static-apply-term
       multiply
       (list
        (q1243340-nth-term weight-index weights)
        (q1243340-quoted
         (if (equal column (nth row (car permutations)))
             one
           zero))))
      (q1243340-weighted-entry-term
       add multiply zero one weights
       (cdr permutations) (+ 1 weight-index)
       row column)))))

(defun q1243340-weighted-row-equality-terms
    (add multiply zero one weights permutations matrix-term
     row columns)
  (if (endp columns)
      nil
    (cons
     (list
      'equal
      (q1243340-nth-term
       (car columns)
       (q1243340-nth-term row matrix-term))
      (q1243340-weighted-entry-term
       add multiply zero one weights permutations
       0 row (car columns)))
     (q1243340-weighted-row-equality-terms
      add multiply zero one weights permutations matrix-term
      row (cdr columns)))))

(defun q1243340-weighted-matrix-equality-terms
    (add multiply zero one weights permutations matrix-term
     rows columns)
  (if (endp rows)
      nil
    (append
     (q1243340-weighted-row-equality-terms
      add multiply zero one weights permutations matrix-term
      (car rows) columns)
     (q1243340-weighted-matrix-equality-terms
      add multiply zero one weights permutations matrix-term
      (cdr rows) columns))))

(defun q1243340-convex-witness-template
    (carrier add multiply zero one less
     permutations rows columns matrix-term)
  (let* ((weight-count (len permutations))
         (weight-indices
          (q1243340-range-from 0 weight-count)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(weights)
     (q1243340-and-terms
      (append
       (list
        (list 'true-listp 'weights)
        (list
         'equal
         (list 'len 'weights)
         (q1243340-quoted weight-count)))
       (q1243340-weight-entry-valid-terms
        carrier less zero 'weights weight-indices)
       (list
        (list
         'equal
         (q1243340-field-sum-term
          add zero
          (q1243340-values-at-indices
           'weights weight-indices))
         (q1243340-quoted one)))
       (q1243340-weighted-matrix-equality-terms
        add multiply zero one 'weights permutations matrix-term
        rows columns))))))

(defun q1243340-matrix-valid-function (carrier n indices)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(matrix)
   (q1243340-matrix-valid-term
    carrier n 'matrix indices indices)))

(defun q1243340-doubly-stochastic-function
    (add zero one less indices)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(matrix)
   (q1243340-doubly-stochastic-term
    add zero one less 'matrix indices indices)))

(defun q1243340-convex-witness-function
    (carrier add multiply zero one less
     permutations indices matrix)
  (q1243340-convex-witness-template
   carrier add multiply zero one less
   permutations indices indices
   (q1243340-quoted matrix)))

(defun q1243340-convex-combination-witness-p
    (carrier add multiply zero one less
     permutations indices matrix weights)
  (let ((witness
         (q1243340-convex-witness-function
          carrier add multiply zero one less
          permutations indices matrix)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp witness)
     (apply$ witness (list weights)))))

(defun-sk q1243340-convex-combination-p
    (carrier add multiply zero one less
     permutations indices matrix)
  (exists (weights)
    (q1243340-convex-combination-witness-p
     carrier add multiply zero one less
     permutations indices matrix weights)))

;; Pointwise extensional equality of the two sets. ACL2 universally closes
;; the free MATRIX formal of this statement predicate. The only internal
;; quantifier is the existential choice of convex weights.

(defun thousand-theorems-q1243340-birkhoff-von-neumann-statement
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less n matrix)
  (let* ((indices
          (q1243340-range-from 0 n))
         (permutations
          (q1243340-permutations indices))
         (matrix-valid
          (q1243340-matrix-valid-function carrier n indices))
         (doubly-stochastic
          (q1243340-doubly-stochastic-function
           add zero one less indices)))
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (q1243340-linearly-ordered-field-p
       carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less))
     (and
      (tamep-functionp matrix-valid)
      (tamep-functionp doubly-stochastic)
      (implies
       (apply$ matrix-valid (list matrix))
       (iff
        (apply$ doubly-stochastic (list matrix))
        (q1243340-convex-combination-p
         carrier add multiply zero one less
         permutations indices matrix)))))))

;; Non-proof tameness diagnostic. These sample operation objects are chosen

(value-triple
 (let* ((carrier '(lambda (x) (rationalp x)))
        (add '(lambda (x y) (binary-+ x y)))
        (multiply '(lambda (x y) (binary-* x y)))
        (negate '(lambda (x) (unary-- x)))

        (less '(lambda (x y) (< x y)))
        (indices-0 (q1243340-range-from 0 0))
        (indices-1 (q1243340-range-from 0 1))

    :add
    (tamep-functionp add)
    :multiply
    (tamep-functionp multiply)
    :negate
    (tamep-functionp negate)
    :inverse
    (tamep-functionp inverse)
    :less
    (tamep-functionp less)
    :field
    (tamep-functionp
     (q1243340-field-laws-function
      carrier 0 1 add multiply negate inverse less))
    :matrix-valid-0
    (tamep-functionp

    :matrix-valid-1
