title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1243340,
-- "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": over any linear ordered field and finite index
-- type, the doubly stochastic matrices are exactly the finite convex combinations
-- of permutation matrices. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record FiniteIndex
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    size : Nat
    toFin : I -> Fin size
    fromFin : Fin size -> I
    to-from :
      (k : Fin size) ->
      toFin (fromFin k) == k
    from-to :
      (x : I) ->
      fromFin (toFin x) == x
    equalIndex : I -> I -> Bool
    equalIndex-sound :
      (x y : I) ->
      equalIndex x y == true ->
      x == y
    equalIndex-complete :
      (x y : I) ->
      x == y ->
      equalIndex x y == true

open FiniteIndex

record LinearOrderedField
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set r

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

open LinearOrderedField

Matrix :
  {i r : Level} ->
  Set i ->
  Set r ->
  Set (i ⊔ r)
Matrix I R =
  I -> I -> R

MatrixEqual :
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r} ->
  Matrix I R ->
  Matrix I R ->
  Set (i ⊔ r)
MatrixEqual {I = I} A B =
  (row column : I) ->
  A row column == B row column

record Permutation
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    forwardPermutation : I -> I
    inversePermutation : I -> I
    forward-inverse :
      (x : I) ->
      forwardPermutation (inversePermutation x) == x
    inverse-forward :
      (x : I) ->
      inversePermutation (forwardPermutation x) == x

open Permutation

select :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
select false yes no = no
select true yes no = yes

permutationMatrix :
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  LinearOrderedField R ->
  Permutation I ->
  Matrix I R
permutationMatrix finite orderedField permutation row column =
  select
    (equalIndex finite
      (forwardPermutation permutation row)
      column)
    (oneR orderedField)
    (zeroR orderedField)

sumFin :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  LinearOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin orderedField {zero} term =
  zeroR orderedField
sumFin orderedField {suc n} term =
  addR orderedField
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin orderedField (\ k -> term (fsuc k)))

sumIndex :
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  LinearOrderedField R ->
  (I -> R) ->
  R
sumIndex finite orderedField term =
  sumFin orderedField
    (\ k -> term (fromFin finite k))

record DoublyStochastic
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r}
  (finite : FiniteIndex I)
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField R)
  (matrix : Matrix I R) :
  Set (i ⊔ r) where

  field
    entries-nonnegative :
      (row column : I) ->
      lessOrEqualR orderedField
        (zeroR orderedField)
        (matrix row column)
    row-sums-one :
      (row : I) ->
      sumIndex finite orderedField (matrix row) ==
      oneR orderedField
    column-sums-one :
      (column : I) ->
      sumIndex finite orderedField
        (\ row -> matrix row column) ==
      oneR orderedField

record WeightedPermutation
  {i r : Level}
  (I : Set i)
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc i ⊔ r) where

  constructor weighted
  field
    coefficient : R
    permutation : Permutation I

open WeightedPermutation

data NonnegativeWeights
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r}
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField R) :
  List (WeightedPermutation I R) ->
  Set (lsuc i ⊔ r) where

  no-weights :
    NonnegativeWeights orderedField []
  nonnegative-cons :
    {term : WeightedPermutation I R}
    {terms : List (WeightedPermutation I R)} ->
    lessOrEqualR orderedField
      (zeroR orderedField)
      (coefficient term) ->
    NonnegativeWeights orderedField terms ->
    NonnegativeWeights orderedField (term ∷ terms)

weightSum :
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r} ->
  LinearOrderedField R ->
  List (WeightedPermutation I R) ->
  R
weightSum orderedField [] =
  zeroR orderedField
weightSum orderedField (term ∷ terms) =
  addR orderedField
    (coefficient term)
    (weightSum orderedField terms)

weightedPermutationSum :
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  LinearOrderedField R ->
  List (WeightedPermutation I R) ->
  Matrix I R
weightedPermutationSum finite orderedField [] row column =
  zeroR orderedField
weightedPermutationSum finite orderedField (term ∷ terms) row column =
  addR orderedField
    (multiplyR orderedField
      (coefficient term)
      (permutationMatrix finite orderedField
        (permutation term)
        row
        column))
    (weightedPermutationSum finite orderedField terms row column)

ConvexCombinationOfPermutationMatrices :
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  LinearOrderedField R ->
  Matrix I R ->
  Set (lsuc i ⊔ r)
ConvexCombinationOfPermutationMatrices
    {I = I} {R = R} finite orderedField matrix =
  Exists
    (List (WeightedPermutation I R))
    (\ terms ->
      NonnegativeWeights orderedField terms and
      (weightSum orderedField terms == oneR orderedField and
      MatrixEqual
        (weightedPermutationSum finite orderedField terms)
        matrix))

birkhoff-von-neumann-theorem : Setω
birkhoff-von-neumann-theorem =
  {i r : Level} ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField R) ->
  (matrix : Matrix I R) ->
  Iff
    (DoublyStochastic finite orderedField matrix)
    (ConvexCombinationOfPermutationMatrices
      finite orderedField matrix)

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1243340, "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": over any linear ordered field and
  finite index type, the doubly stochastic matrices are exactly the convex
  hull of the permutation matrices. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory permutesTheory;

val doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (one : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (recip : 'r -> 'r)
      (leq : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (s : 'i set).
      let ordered_field = (
        one <> zero /\
        (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
        (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
        (!x. mul x one = x) /\
        (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
        recip zero = zero /\
        (!x. x <> zero ==> mul x (recip x) = one) /\
        (!x. leq x x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
        (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y ==> leq (add z x) (add z y)) /\
        (!x y. leq zero x /\ leq zero y ==> leq zero (mul x y)))
      in
      let index_sum =
        \(f : 'i -> 'r) (t : 'i set).
          ITSET (\i acc. add (f i) acc) t zero
      in
      let permutation_sum =
        \(f : ('i -> 'i) -> 'r) (t : ('i -> 'i) set).
          ITSET (\p acc. add (f p) acc) t zero
      in
      let permutations = {p : 'i -> 'i | p permutes s}
      in
      let permutation_matrix =
        \(p : 'i -> 'i) (i : 'i) (j : 'i).
          if i IN s /\ j IN s /\ p i = j then one else zero
      in
      let matrix_on_carrier =
        \(M : 'i -> 'i -> 'r).
          !i j. ~(i IN s /\ j IN s) ==> M i j = zero
      in
      let doubly_stochastic =
        \(M : 'i -> 'i -> 'r).
          matrix_on_carrier M /\
          (!i j. i IN s /\ j IN s ==> leq zero (M i j)) /\
          (!i. i IN s ==> index_sum (M i) s = one) /\
          (!j. j IN s ==> index_sum (\i. M i j) s = one)
      in
      let convex_hull_of_permutation_matrices =
        \(M : 'i -> 'i -> 'r).
          matrix_on_carrier M /\
          ?t : ('i -> 'i) set. ?w : ('i -> 'i) -> 'r.
            FINITE t /\
            t SUBSET permutations /\
            (!p. p IN t ==> leq zero (w p)) /\
            permutation_sum w t = one /\
            (!i j.
              permutation_sum
                (\p. mul (w p) (permutation_matrix p i j))
                t =
              M i j)
      in
        ordered_field /\ FINITE s
        ==>
        {M : 'i -> 'i -> 'r | doubly_stochastic M} =
        {M : 'i -> 'i -> 'r |
          convex_hull_of_permutation_matrices M}``;

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1243340
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1243340), "Birkhoff-Von Neumann theorem":
  over every linearly ordered field and every finite index carrier, the set of
  doubly stochastic square matrices is the convex hull of the permutation
  matrices. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  QBVNPerm R N is the set of permutation matrices over the ordered field R
  indexed by the finite set N. A permutation is represented by a bijection
  s : N -1-1-onto-> N, and its matrix has entry one exactly in column s(i)
  of row i and zero elsewhere.

  QBVNDS R N is the set of matrices over R with nonnegative entries and with
  every row sum and every column sum equal to one.

  QBVNConvex R N S is the set of all finite convex combinations of members of
  S. The finite coefficient carrier W and the coefficient and point functions
  remain internally existentially quantified. This finite-combination
  characterization is bidirectionally equivalent to convexHull R S over a
  linear ordered field, including when N is empty.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c QBVNPerm QBVNDS QBVNConvex $.

qbvn-permutation-matrices-syntax $a class ( QBVNPerm R N ) $.
qbvn-doubly-stochastic-syntax $a class ( QBVNDS R N ) $.
qbvn-convex-hull-syntax $a class ( QBVNConvex R N S ) $.

${
  $d M N R i j s $.

  qbvn-permutation-matrices-definition $a |- ( QBVNPerm R N ) =
    {
      M e. ( Base ` ( N Mat R ) ) |
        E. s
          (
            s : N -1-1-onto-> N
            /\
            A. i e. N A. j e. N
              ( i M j )
              =
              if (
                ( s ` i ) = j
                ,
                ( 1r ` R )
                ,
                ( 0g ` R )
              )
          )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d M N R i j $.

  qbvn-doubly-stochastic-definition $a |- ( QBVNDS R N ) =
    {
      M e. ( Base ` ( N Mat R ) ) |
        (
          A. i e. N A. j e. N
            ( 0g ` R ) ( le ` R ) ( i M j )
          /\
          (
            A. i e. N
              (
                R gsum
                  ( j e. N |-> ( i M j ) )
              )
              =
              ( 1r ` R )
            /\
            A. j e. N
              (
                R gsum
                  ( i e. N |-> ( i M j ) )
              )
              =
              ( 1r ` R )
          )
        )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d M N R S W c i j k p $.

  qbvn-convex-hull-definition $a |- ( QBVNConvex R N S ) =
    {
      M e. ( Base ` ( N Mat R ) ) |
        E. W e. Fin
          E. c e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m W )
            E. p e. ( S ^m W )
              (
                A. k e. W
                  ( 0g ` R ) ( le ` R ) ( c ` k )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    R gsum
                      ( k e. W |-> ( c ` k ) )
                  )
                  =
                  ( 1r ` R )
                  /\
                  A. i e. N A. j e. N
                    ( i M j )
                    =
                    (
                      R gsum
                        (
                          k e. W |->
                            (
                              ( c ` k )
                              ( .r ` R )
                              ( i ( p ` k ) j )
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
              )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d N R $.

  thousand-theorems-q1243340-birkhoff-von-neumann $a |-
    A. R e. oField
      A. N e. Fin
        ( QBVNDS R N )
        =
        ( QBVNConvex R N ( QBVNPerm R N ) )
  $.
$}

              (q.i <> j implies s.k = 0.K)) &

end;

title: Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1243340,
% "Birkhoff–Von Neumann theorem": over any linearly ordered field and finite
% index type, the doubly stochastic matrices are exactly the finite convex
% combinations of permutation matrices. This file contains no proof.

Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem[
  I: TYPE,
  R: TYPE+,
  zero, one: R,
  neg, inv: [R -> R],
  add, mul: [R, R -> R],
  le: [R, R -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  matrix: TYPE = [I, I -> R]
  permutation: TYPE = [I -> I]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[I], finite_sets[permutation]

  additive_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R): add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R):
      add(x, zero) = x
        AND add(x, neg(x)) = zero)

  field_multiplication_laws: bool =
    zero /= one
      AND
    inv(zero) = zero
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R): mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R): mul(x, one) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mul(x, add(y, z)) =
        add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R):
      x /= zero IMPLIES mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: R): le(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      le(x, y) AND le(y, z) IMPLIES le(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      le(x, y) AND le(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      le(x, y) OR le(y, x))

  ordered_ring_laws: bool =
    le(zero, one)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      le(x, y) IMPLIES le(add(x, z), add(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      le(zero, x) AND le(zero, y)
        IMPLIES le(zero, mul(x, y)))

  linearly_ordered_field_laws: bool =
    additive_group_laws
      AND field_multiplication_laws
      AND linear_order_laws
      AND ordered_ring_laws

  full_index_set(carrier: finite_set[I]): bool =
    FORALL (i: I): member(i, carrier)

  index_sum_value(values: [I -> R], total: R): bool =
    EXISTS
      (carrier: finite_set[I]),
      (enumeration: [below(card(carrier)) -> (carrier)]),
      (partial_sums: [upto(card(carrier)) -> R]):
        full_index_set(carrier)
          AND bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zero
          AND
            (FORALL (k: below(card(carrier))):
              partial_sums(k + 1) =
                add(partial_sums(k), values(enumeration(k))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(carrier))

  permutation_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[permutation],
      values: [permutation -> R],
      total: R): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums: [upto(card(support)) -> R]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zero
          AND
            (FORALL (k: below(card(support))):
              partial_sums(k + 1) =
                add(partial_sums(k), values(enumeration(k))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  is_permutation(p: permutation): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: I):
      p(i) = p(j) IMPLIES i = j)
      AND
    (FORALL (j: I):
      EXISTS (i: I): p(i) = j)

  permutation_matrix_entry(
      p: permutation,
      i, j: I): R =
    IF p(i) = j THEN one ELSE zero ENDIF

  doubly_stochastic(M: matrix): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: I): le(zero, M(i, j)))
      AND
    (FORALL (i: I):
      index_sum_value(
        (LAMBDA (j: I): M(i, j)),
        one))
      AND
    (FORALL (j: I):
      index_sum_value(
        (LAMBDA (i: I): M(i, j)),
        one))

  convex_combination_of_permutation_matrices(
      M: matrix): bool =
    EXISTS
      (support: finite_set[permutation]),
      (weight: [permutation -> R]):
        (FORALL (p: permutation):
          member(p, support) IMPLIES
            is_permutation(p)
              AND le(zero, weight(p)))
          AND permutation_sum_value(support, weight, one)
          AND
            (FORALL (i, j: I):
              permutation_sum_value(
                support,
                (LAMBDA (p: permutation):
                  mul(
                    weight(p),
                    permutation_matrix_entry(p, i, j))),
                M(i, j)))

  doublyStochastic_eq_convexHull_permMatrix: bool =
    (is_finite_type[I]
      AND linearly_ordered_field_laws)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL (M: matrix):
        doubly_stochastic(M)
          IFF
        convex_combination_of_permutation_matrices(M))
END Q1243340_birkhoff_von_neumann_theorem

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1259814
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1259814), "Nielsen–Schreier theorem": every
  subgroup of an arbitrary free group is itself a free group. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Polymorphic Record q1259814_group@{u} : Type@{u+1} := {
  q1259814_carrier : Type@{u};
  q1259814_one : q1259814_carrier;
  q1259814_mul :
    q1259814_carrier -> q1259814_carrier -> q1259814_carrier;
  q1259814_inv : q1259814_carrier -> q1259814_carrier;
  q1259814_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : q1259814_carrier,

  q1259814_one_mul :
    forall x : q1259814_carrier, q1259814_mul q1259814_one x = x;
  q1259814_mul_one :
    forall x : q1259814_carrier, q1259814_mul x q1259814_one = x;
  q1259814_inv_mul :
    forall x : q1259814_carrier,
      q1259814_mul (q1259814_inv x) x = q1259814_one;
  q1259814_mul_inv :
    forall x : q1259814_carrier,
      q1259814_mul x (q1259814_inv x) = q1259814_one
}.

Arguments q1259814_carrier _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1259814_one {q}.
Arguments q1259814_mul {q} _ _.
Arguments q1259814_inv {q} _.

Polymorphic Record q1259814_subgroup@{u}
    (G : q1259814_group@{u}) : Type@{u+1} := {
  q1259814_member : q1259814_carrier G -> Prop;
  q1259814_subgroup_one : q1259814_member q1259814_one;
  q1259814_subgroup_mul :
    forall x y : q1259814_carrier G,
      q1259814_member x ->
      q1259814_member y ->
      q1259814_member (q1259814_mul x y);
  q1259814_subgroup_inv :
    forall x : q1259814_carrier G,
      q1259814_member x ->
      q1259814_member (q1259814_inv x)
}.

Arguments q1259814_member {G} _ _.
Arguments q1259814_subgroup_one {G} _.
Arguments q1259814_subgroup_mul {G} _ _ _ _ _.
Arguments q1259814_subgroup_inv {G} _ _ _.

Polymorphic Definition q1259814_group_homomorphism@{u}
    (G K : q1259814_group@{u})
    (f : q1259814_carrier G -> q1259814_carrier K) : Prop :=
  f q1259814_one = q1259814_one /\
  forall x y : q1259814_carrier G,
    f (q1259814_mul x y) = q1259814_mul (f x) (f y).

(* Coherence makes maps from the inherited subgroup independent of the
   particular proofs that their arguments belong to the subgroup. *)
Polymorphic Record q1259814_subgroup_map@{u}
    (G : q1259814_group@{u})
    (H : q1259814_subgroup@{u} G)
    (K : q1259814_group@{u}) : Type@{u+1} := {
  q1259814_subgroup_map_apply :
    forall x : q1259814_carrier G,
      q1259814_member H x -> q1259814_carrier K;
  q1259814_subgroup_map_coherent :
    forall (x : q1259814_carrier G)
           (hx hy : q1259814_member H x),
      q1259814_subgroup_map_apply x hx =
      q1259814_subgroup_map_apply x hy
}.

Polymorphic Definition q1259814_subgroup_homomorphism@{u}
    (G : q1259814_group@{u})
    (H : q1259814_subgroup@{u} G)
    (K : q1259814_group@{u})
    (f : q1259814_subgroup_map@{u} G H K) : Prop :=
  @q1259814_subgroup_map_apply
    G H K f q1259814_one (q1259814_subgroup_one H) =
    q1259814_one /\
  forall (x y : q1259814_carrier G)
         (hx : q1259814_member H x)
         (hy : q1259814_member H y),
    @q1259814_subgroup_map_apply
      G H K f
      (q1259814_mul x y)
      (q1259814_subgroup_mul H x y hx hy) =
    q1259814_mul
      (@q1259814_subgroup_map_apply G H K f x hx)
      (@q1259814_subgroup_map_apply G H K f y hy).

Polymorphic Definition q1259814_is_free_group@{u}
    (G : q1259814_group@{u}) : Prop :=
  exists X : Type@{u},
  exists generators : X -> q1259814_carrier G,
  forall (K : q1259814_group@{u})
         (label : X -> q1259814_carrier K),
    exists lift : q1259814_carrier G -> q1259814_carrier K,
      q1259814_group_homomorphism@{u} G K lift /\
      (forall x : X, lift (generators x) = label x) /\
      (forall other : q1259814_carrier G -> q1259814_carrier K,
        q1259814_group_homomorphism@{u} G K other ->
        (forall x : X, other (generators x) = label x) ->
        forall g : q1259814_carrier G, other g = lift g).

Polymorphic Definition q1259814_is_free_subgroup@{u}
    (G : q1259814_group@{u})
    (H : q1259814_subgroup@{u} G) : Prop :=
  exists X : Type@{u},
  exists generators : X -> q1259814_carrier G,
  exists generators_mem :
    forall x : X, q1259814_member H (generators x),
  forall (K : q1259814_group@{u})
         (label : X -> q1259814_carrier K),
    exists lift : q1259814_subgroup_map@{u} G H K,
      q1259814_subgroup_homomorphism@{u} G H K lift /\
      (forall x : X,
        @q1259814_subgroup_map_apply
          G H K lift (generators x) (generators_mem x) =
        label x) /\
      (forall other : q1259814_subgroup_map@{u} G H K,
        q1259814_subgroup_homomorphism@{u} G H K other ->
        (forall x : X,
          @q1259814_subgroup_map_apply
            G H K other (generators x) (generators_mem x) =
          label x) ->
        forall (h : q1259814_carrier G)
               (hh_other hh_lift : q1259814_member H h),
          @q1259814_subgroup_map_apply G H K other h hh_other =
          @q1259814_subgroup_map_apply G H K lift h hh_lift).

Polymorphic Theorem subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree@{u} :
  forall (G : q1259814_group@{u})
         (H : q1259814_subgroup@{u} G),
    q1259814_is_free_group@{u} G ->
    q1259814_is_free_subgroup@{u} G H.
Admitted.

title: Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1259814,
  "Nielsen–Schreier theorem": every subgroup of a free group is itself a free
  group, expressed by the equivalent unique reduced-word characterization of
  a free basis. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
  imports "HOL-Algebra.Group"
begin

datatype 'g q1259814_letter =
    Q1259814_Pos 'g
  | Q1259814_Neg 'g

fun q1259814_letter_base :: "'g q1259814_letter \<Rightarrow> 'g" where
  "q1259814_letter_base (Q1259814_Pos x) = x"
| "q1259814_letter_base (Q1259814_Neg x) = x"

fun q1259814_inverse_letter ::
    "'g q1259814_letter \<Rightarrow> 'g q1259814_letter" where
  "q1259814_inverse_letter (Q1259814_Pos x) = Q1259814_Neg x"
| "q1259814_inverse_letter (Q1259814_Neg x) = Q1259814_Pos x"

fun q1259814_letter_value ::
    "('g, 'm) monoid_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'g q1259814_letter \<Rightarrow> 'g" where
  "q1259814_letter_value G (Q1259814_Pos x) = x"
| "q1259814_letter_value G (Q1259814_Neg x) = inv\<^bsub>G\<^esub> x"

fun q1259814_word_value ::
    "('g, 'm) monoid_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'g q1259814_letter list \<Rightarrow> 'g" where
  "q1259814_word_value G [] = \<one>\<^bsub>G\<^esub>"
| "q1259814_word_value G (l # w) =
    q1259814_letter_value G l \<otimes>\<^bsub>G\<^esub> q1259814_word_value G w"

fun q1259814_reduced ::
    "'g set \<Rightarrow> 'g q1259814_letter list \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1259814_reduced B [] = True"
| "q1259814_reduced B [l] = (q1259814_letter_base l \<in> B)"
| "q1259814_reduced B (l # k # w) =
    (q1259814_letter_base l \<in> B \<and>
     k \<noteq> q1259814_inverse_letter l \<and>
     q1259814_reduced B (k # w))"

definition q1259814_is_free_subgroup ::
    "('g, 'm) monoid_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1259814_is_free_subgroup G H \<longleftrightarrow>
    subgroup H G \<and>
    (\<exists>B \<subseteq> H. \<forall>x \<in> H. \<exists>!w.
      q1259814_reduced B w \<and> q1259814_word_value G w = x)"

theorem (in group) subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree:
  assumes "q1259814_is_free_subgroup G (carrier G)"
    and "subgroup H G"
  shows "q1259814_is_free_subgroup G H"
  sorry

end

title: Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1259814,
  "Nielsen–Schreier theorem": every subgroup of a free group is itself a free
  group, expressed through unique reduced signed words over a basis. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

loads "Library/grouptheory.ml";;

let Q1259814_NIELSEN_SCHREIER_THEOREM =
  `let reduced_word =
     \(basis:A->bool) (word:(A#bool)list).
       ALL (\letter. FST letter IN basis) word /\
       (!i. i + 1 < LENGTH word
            ==> ~(FST (EL i word) = FST (EL (i + 1) word) /\
                  ~(SND (EL i word) = SND (EL (i + 1) word)))) in
   let word_value =
     \(K:A group) (word:(A#bool)list).
       ITLIST
         (\letter value.
            group_mul K
              (if SND letter
               then FST letter
               else group_inv K (FST letter))
              value)
         word (group_id K) in
   let is_free_group =
     \(K:A group).
       ?basis:A->bool.
         basis SUBSET group_carrier K /\
         (!x. x IN group_carrier K
              ==> ?!word:(A#bool)list.
                    reduced_word basis word /\
                    word_value K word = x) in
   !G:A group. !H:A->bool.
     H subgroup_of G /\ is_free_group G
     ==> is_free_group (subgroup_generated G H)`;;

title: Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1259814,
;; "Nielsen–Schreier theorem": every subgroup of an arbitrary free group is
;; itself a free group. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, operations, and subsets are tame APPLY$ function
;; objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification over ACL2
;; objects, while inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal
;; existential quantification.
;;
;; Freeness is represented by the equivalent reduced-word normal-form
;; property. The existential witness contains a basis predicate, the reduced
;; word predicate, word evaluation, and a normal-form map. A letter is a
;; two-element list (generator sign), where T is the generator and NIL is its
;; inverse. The laws say that every group element has exactly one reduced word.
;; Thus no basis, lift, or normal-form witness is exposed as a statement
;; parameter.

(defun q1259814-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1259814-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q1259814-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1259814-quoted nil)))

(defun q1259814-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q1259814-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1259814-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1259814-apply-term
   (q1259814-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q1259814-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1259814-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q1259814-quoted nil))
    (q1259814-quoted t)))

(defun q1259814-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1259814-quoted t)
       (q1259814-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q1259814-quoted nil)))

(defun q1259814-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q1259814-quoted nil)
   (q1259814-quoted t)))

(defun q1259814-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q1259814-quoted t)))

(defun q1259814-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1259814-quoted t)
    (q1259814-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1259814-quoted nil)
    (q1259814-quoted t))))

(defun q1259814-nth-term (index tuple)
  (list 'nth (q1259814-quoted index) tuple))

(defun q1259814-tuple-of-length-term (tuple length)
  (q1259814-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'true-listp tuple)
    (list
     'equal
     (list 'len tuple)
     (q1259814-quoted length)))))

(defun q1259814-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1259814-quoted t)))

(defun q1259814-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1259814-quoted nil)))

(defun q1259814-universal-p (condition formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (q1259814-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun q1259814-exists-p (condition formals)
  (let ((always-false
         (q1259814-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal condition always-false)))))

(defun q1259814-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1259814-member-term (predicate-term object)
  (q1259814-apply-term predicate-term (list object)))

(defun q1259814-mul-term (multiplication-term left right)
  (q1259814-apply-term multiplication-term (list left right)))

(defun q1259814-inv-term (inverse-term object)
  (q1259814-apply-term inverse-term (list object)))

;; Group and subgroup structures on arbitrary, potentially infinite carriers.

(defun q1259814-group-laws-function
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (let* ((x (q1259814-nth-term 0 'tuple))
         (y (q1259814-nth-term 1 'tuple))
         (z (q1259814-nth-term 2 'tuple))
         (x-in
          (q1259814-static-apply-term carrier (list x)))
         (y-in
          (q1259814-static-apply-term carrier (list y)))
         (z-in
          (q1259814-static-apply-term carrier (list z)))
         (inv-x
          (q1259814-static-apply-term inverse (list x)))
         (xy
          (q1259814-static-apply-term
           multiplication
           (list x y)))
         (unary-hypothesis
          (q1259814-and-terms
           (list
            (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 1)
            x-in)))
         (binary-hypothesis
          (q1259814-and-terms
           (list
            (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 2)
            x-in
            y-in)))
         (ternary-hypothesis
          (q1259814-and-terms
           (list
            (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 3)
            x-in
            y-in
            z-in))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(tuple)
     (q1259814-and-terms
      (list
       (q1259814-implies-term
        unary-hypothesis
        (q1259814-and-terms
         (list
          (q1259814-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1259814-static-apply-term
            multiplication
            (list x (q1259814-quoted identity)))
           x)
          (list
           'equal
           (q1259814-static-apply-term
            multiplication
            (list (q1259814-quoted identity) x))
           x)
          (list
           'equal
           (q1259814-static-apply-term
            multiplication
            (list x inv-x))
           (q1259814-quoted identity))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1259814-static-apply-term
            multiplication
            (list inv-x x))
           (q1259814-quoted identity)))))
       (q1259814-implies-term
        binary-hypothesis
        (q1259814-static-apply-term carrier (list xy)))
       (q1259814-implies-term
        ternary-hypothesis
        (list
         'equal
         (q1259814-static-apply-term
          multiplication
          (list
           (q1259814-static-apply-term
            multiplication
            (list x y))
           z))
         (q1259814-static-apply-term
          multiplication
          (list
           x
           (q1259814-static-apply-term
            multiplication
            (list y z)))))))))))

(defun q1259814-group-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q1259814-member-p carrier identity)
   (q1259814-universal-p
    (q1259814-group-laws-function
     carrier multiplication inverse identity)
    '(tuple))))

(defun q1259814-subset-function (left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q1259814-implies-term
    (q1259814-static-apply-term left '(x))
    (q1259814-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q1259814-subset-p (left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (q1259814-universal-p
    (q1259814-subset-function left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q1259814-subgroup-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
  (and
   (q1259814-group-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity)
   (q1259814-subset-p subgroup carrier)
   (q1259814-group-p
    subgroup multiplication inverse identity)))

;; The following marker is used only while constructing a reified function
;; object. It inserts a runtime term into an otherwise quoted syntax tree.

(defun q1259814-runtime-node (term)
  (list :q1259814-runtime term))

(defun q1259814-runtime-node-p (tree)
  (and
   (true-listp tree)
   (equal (len tree) 2)
   (equal (car tree) :q1259814-runtime)))

(defun q1259814-dynamic-tree-term (tree)
  (if (q1259814-runtime-node-p tree)
      (cadr tree)
    (if (consp tree)
        (list
         'cons
         (q1259814-dynamic-tree-term (car tree))
         (q1259814-dynamic-tree-term (cdr tree)))
      (q1259814-quoted tree))))

(defun q1259814-runtime-quoted-template (runtime-term)
  (list 'quote (q1259814-runtime-node runtime-term)))

;; This template is turned into a tame unary function after a candidate
;; witness has supplied BASIS, REDUCED, EVALUATE, and NORMAL-FORM.

(defun q1259814-free-laws-template
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (let* ((basis
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-nth-term 0 'witness)))
         (reduced
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-nth-term 1 'witness)))
         (evaluate
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-nth-term 2 'witness)))
         (normal-form
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-nth-term 3 'witness)))
         (carrier-term
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-quoted carrier)))
         (multiplication-term
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-quoted multiplication)))
         (inverse-term
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-quoted inverse)))
         (identity-term
          (q1259814-runtime-quoted-template
           (q1259814-quoted identity)))
         (unary-case
          (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term 'case 1))
         (binary-case
          (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term 'case 2))
         (word (q1259814-nth-term 0 'case))
         (other-word (q1259814-nth-term 1 'case))
         (letter (list 'car word))
         (rest (list 'cdr word))
         (generator (q1259814-nth-term 0 letter))
         (sign (q1259814-nth-term 1 letter))
         (next-letter (list 'car rest))
         (next-generator
          (q1259814-nth-term 0 next-letter))
         (next-sign
          (q1259814-nth-term 1 next-letter))
         (valid-sign
          (q1259814-or-terms
           (list
            (list 'equal sign (q1259814-quoted t))
            (list 'equal sign (q1259814-quoted nil)))))
         (valid-letter
          (q1259814-and-terms
           (list
            (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term letter 2)
            valid-sign
            (q1259814-member-term basis generator))))
         (adjacent-inverses
          (q1259814-and-terms
           (list
            (list 'equal generator next-generator)
            (q1259814-not-term
             (list 'equal sign next-sign)))))
         (expected-reduced
          (list
           'if
           (list 'consp word)
           (q1259814-and-terms
            (list
             valid-letter
             (q1259814-member-term reduced rest)
             (q1259814-implies-term
              (list 'consp rest)
              (q1259814-not-term adjacent-inverses))))
           (list 'equal word (q1259814-quoted nil))))
         (letter-value
          (list
           'if
           (list 'equal sign (q1259814-quoted t))
           generator
           (q1259814-inv-term inverse-term generator)))
         (expected-value
          (list
           'if
           (list 'consp word)
           (q1259814-mul-term
            multiplication-term
            letter-value
            (q1259814-apply-term evaluate (list rest)))
           identity-term))
         (word-value
          (q1259814-apply-term evaluate (list word)))
         (other-word-value
          (q1259814-apply-term evaluate (list other-word)))
         (normal-word
          (q1259814-apply-term normal-form (list word))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(case)
     (q1259814-and-terms
      (list
       (q1259814-implies-term
        unary-case
        (q1259814-and-terms
         (list
          (q1259814-implies-term
           (q1259814-member-term basis word)
           (q1259814-member-term carrier-term word))
          (q1259814-iff-term
           (q1259814-member-term reduced word)
           expected-reduced)
          (list 'equal word-value expected-value)
          (q1259814-implies-term
           (q1259814-member-term carrier-term word)
           (q1259814-and-terms
            (list
             (q1259814-member-term reduced normal-word)
             (list
              'equal
              (q1259814-apply-term
               evaluate
               (list normal-word))
              word))))
          (q1259814-implies-term
           (q1259814-member-term reduced word)
           (q1259814-member-term carrier-term word-value)))))
       (q1259814-implies-term
        (q1259814-and-terms
         (list
          binary-case
          (q1259814-member-term reduced word)
          (q1259814-member-term reduced other-word)
          (list 'equal word-value other-word-value)))
        (list 'equal word other-word)))))))

(defun q1259814-free-witness-condition-function
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (let* ((laws-template
          (q1259814-free-laws-template
           carrier multiplication inverse identity))
         (laws
          (q1259814-dynamic-tree-term laws-template))
         (always-true
          (q1259814-true-function '(case))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(witness)
     (q1259814-and-terms
      (list
       (q1259814-tuple-of-length-term 'witness 4)
       (list
        'tamep-functionp
        (q1259814-nth-term 0 'witness))
       (list
        'tamep-functionp
        (q1259814-nth-term 1 'witness))
       (list
        'tamep-functionp
        (q1259814-nth-term 2 'witness))
       (list
        'tamep-functionp
        (q1259814-nth-term 3 'witness))
       (list 'tamep-functionp laws)
       (list
        'fn-equal
        laws
        (q1259814-quoted always-true)))))))

(defun q1259814-free-group-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (and
   (q1259814-group-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity)
   (q1259814-exists-p
    (q1259814-free-witness-condition-function
     carrier multiplication inverse identity)
    '(witness))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1259814-subgroup-is-free-of-is-free-statement
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1259814-subgroup-p
     carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
    (q1259814-free-group-p
     carrier multiplication inverse identity))
   (q1259814-free-group-p
    subgroup multiplication inverse identity)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1259814,
-- "Nielsen–Schreier theorem": every subgroup of a free group is itself a free
-- group. This file contains no proof.

module Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ; _,_)

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record MultiplicativeHom
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (multiply-A : A → A → A)
  (multiply-B : B → B → B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : A → B
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      map (multiply-A x y) ≡ multiply-B (map x) (map y)

record UniqueExtension
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A X K : Set ℓ}
  (multiply-A : A → A → A)
  (target : Group K)
  (include : X → A)
  (assignment : X → K) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    extension :
      MultiplicativeHom A K multiply-A (Group.multiply target)
    extends-assignment :
      (x : X) →
      MultiplicativeHom.map extension (include x) ≡ assignment x
    unique :
      (other :
        MultiplicativeHom A K multiply-A (Group.multiply target)) →
      ((x : X) →
        MultiplicativeHom.map other (include x) ≡ assignment x) →
      (a : A) →
      MultiplicativeHom.map other a ≡
      MultiplicativeHom.map extension a

record FreeGroupStructure
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ)
  (multiply-A : A → A → A) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    Generators : Set ℓ
    include : Generators → A
    universal-property :
      {K : Set ℓ} →
      (target : Group K) →
      (assignment : Generators → K) →
      UniqueExtension multiply-A target include assignment

IsFreeGroup :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
IsFreeGroup {G = G} structure =
  FreeGroupStructure G (Group.multiply structure)

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity :
      member (Group.identity structure)
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) →
      member x →
      member (Group.inverse structure x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (Group.multiply structure x y)

SubgroupCarrier :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
SubgroupCarrier {G = G} H =
  Σ G (SubgroupOf.member H)

subgroupMultiply :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (H : SubgroupOf structure) →
  SubgroupCarrier H →
  SubgroupCarrier H →
  SubgroupCarrier H
subgroupMultiply structure H (x , hx) (y , hy) =
  Group.multiply structure x y ,
  SubgroupOf.closed-under-multiply H x y hx hy

IsFreeSubgroup :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
IsFreeSubgroup structure H =
  FreeGroupStructure
    (SubgroupCarrier H)
    (subgroupMultiply structure H)

-- Lean: subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree
nielsen-schreier-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
nielsen-schreier-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  IsFreeGroup structure →
  (H : SubgroupOf structure) →
  IsFreeSubgroup structure H

title: Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1259814, "Nielsen–Schreier theorem": every subgroup of a free group is
  free. Freeness is expressed by unique reduced signed words over a basis.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory groupTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val ns_word_eval_def = new_definition (
  "ns_word_eval_def",
  ``ns_word_eval (g : 'a group) (w : ('a # bool) list) =
      FOLDL g.op g.id
        (MAP (\p. if SND p then FST p else g.inv (FST p)) w)``);

val ns_reduced_word_def = new_definition (
  "ns_reduced_word_def",
  ``ns_reduced_word (b : 'a set) (w : ('a # bool) list) <=>
      EVERY (\p. FST p IN b) w /\
      !n. SUC n < LENGTH w ==>
          (FST (EL n w) <> FST (EL (SUC n) w) \/
           SND (EL n w) = SND (EL (SUC n) w))``);

val ns_is_free_group_def = new_definition (
  "ns_is_free_group_def",
  ``ns_is_free_group (g : 'a group) <=>
      Group g /\
      ?b : 'a set.
        b SUBSET g.carrier /\
        (!x. x IN g.carrier ==>
             ?w. ns_reduced_word b w /\ ns_word_eval g w = x) /\
        (!u v.
           ns_reduced_word b u /\
           ns_reduced_word b v /\
           ns_word_eval g u = ns_word_eval g v
           ==>
           u = v)``);

val subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (h : 'a group).
      ns_is_free_group g /\ Subgroup h g
      ==>
      ns_is_free_group h``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1259814
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1259814), "Nielsen-Schreier theorem": every
  subgroup of an arbitrary free group is itself a free group. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's freeGrp constructs the free group on an arbitrary set of generators,
  and G ~=g H states that the bundled groups G and H are isomorphic. Thus
  existence of I with G ~=g ( freeGrp ` I ) faithfully expresses that G is a
  free group. For H e. ( SubGrp ` G ), the restriction G |`s H is the inherited
  group structure on H. Both generator sets remain existentially quantified,
  and no finiteness restriction is imposed.

  The declaration below is the unproved $a statement corresponding to
  subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree; it adds no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d G H I J $.

  thousand-theorems-q1259814-nielsen-schreier $a |- (
    A. G A. H
      (
        (
          (
            G e. Grp
            /\
            E. I G ~=g ( freeGrp ` I )
          )
          /\
          H e. ( SubGrp ` G )
        )
        ->
        E. J ( G |`s H ) ~=g ( freeGrp ` J )
      )
  ) $.
$}
