title: Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1259814,
% "Nielsen-Schreier theorem": every subgroup of an arbitrary free group is free,
% expressed through unique reduced words over an internal basis. This file contains no proof.

Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  element_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]
  signed_generator: TYPE =
    [# generator: G, inverted: bool #]
  word: TYPE = list[signed_generator]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  is_subgroup(carrier: element_set): bool =
    carrier(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
          carrier(mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        carrier(x) IMPLIES carrier(inv(x)))

  letter_value(letter: signed_generator): G =
    IF inverted(letter) THEN
      inv(generator(letter))
    ELSE
      generator(letter)
    ENDIF

  evaluate(letters: word): RECURSIVE G =
    CASES letters OF
      null: one,
      cons(letter, tail):
        mul(letter_value(letter), evaluate(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE letters BY <<

  word_over(
      basis: element_set,
      letters: word): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES letters OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(letter, tail):
        basis(generator(letter))
          AND word_over(basis, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE letters BY <<

  reduced(letters: word): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES letters OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(first, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(second, rest):
            NOT (generator(first) = generator(second)
              AND inverted(first) /= inverted(second))
              AND reduced(tail)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE letters BY <<

  is_free_on(carrier: element_set): bool =
    EXISTS (basis: element_set):
      (FORALL (generator_value: G):
        basis(generator_value) IMPLIES carrier(generator_value))
        AND (FORALL (x: G):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (normal_form: word):
              word_over(basis, normal_form)
                AND reduced(normal_form)
                AND evaluate(normal_form) = x)
        AND (FORALL (left, right: word):
          (word_over(basis, left)
            AND reduced(left)
            AND word_over(basis, right)
            AND reduced(right)
            AND evaluate(left) = evaluate(right))
            IMPLIES left = right)

  full_carrier: element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): TRUE

  subgroupIsFreeOfIsFree: bool =
    (group_laws AND is_free_on(full_carrier))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (subgroup: element_set):
          is_subgroup(subgroup) IMPLIES is_free_on(subgroup))

END Q1259814_nielsen_schreier_theorem

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1306095
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1306095), "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff
-- smooth finite-dimensional real manifold admits a smooth closed embedding into some
-- finite-dimensional Euclidean space with injective manifold derivative everywhere.
-- This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib

universe uE uH uM

open Function Topology
open scoped Manifold ContDiff

namespace Q1306095

variable {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {H : Type uH} [TopologicalSpace H]
  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {M : Type uM} [TopologicalSpace M]
  [ChartedSpace H M] [IsManifold I ∞ M]

/-- Every compact Hausdorff smooth real manifold embeds smoothly into some Euclidean space. -/
theorem exists_embedding_euclidean_of_compact [T2Space M] [CompactSpace M] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (e : M → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      CMDiff ∞ e ∧ IsClosedEmbedding e ∧ ∀ x : M, Injective (mfderiv% e x) := sorry

end Q1306095

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1306095
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1306095), "Whitney embedding theorem": every
  compact Hausdorff smooth finite-dimensional real manifold admits a smooth
  closed embedding into some finite-dimensional Euclidean space, with
  injective manifold derivative at every point. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals List.

Import ListNotations.
Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1306095_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q1306095_normed_real_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1306095_zero : E;
  q1306095_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1306095_neg : E -> E;
  q1306095_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q1306095_norm : E -> R;
  q1306095_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1306095_add x (q1306095_add y z) =
      q1306095_add (q1306095_add x y) z;
  q1306095_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1306095_add x y = q1306095_add y x;
  q1306095_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1306095_add x q1306095_zero = x;
  q1306095_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1306095_add x (q1306095_neg x) = q1306095_zero;
  q1306095_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1306095_smul 1 x = x;
  q1306095_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1306095_smul (a * b) x =
      q1306095_smul a (q1306095_smul b x);
  q1306095_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1306095_smul (a + b) x =
      q1306095_add
        (q1306095_smul a x) (q1306095_smul b x);
  q1306095_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q1306095_smul a (q1306095_add x y) =
      q1306095_add
        (q1306095_smul a x) (q1306095_smul a y);
  q1306095_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q1306095_smul 0 x = q1306095_zero;
  q1306095_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1306095_smul a q1306095_zero = q1306095_zero;
  q1306095_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1306095_norm x;
  q1306095_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1306095_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1306095_zero;
  q1306095_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1306095_norm (q1306095_add x y) <=
      q1306095_norm x + q1306095_norm y;
  q1306095_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q1306095_norm (q1306095_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q1306095_norm x
}.

Arguments q1306095_zero {E} _.
Arguments q1306095_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1306095_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q1306095_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1306095_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q1306095_sub {E : Type}
    (V : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1306095_add V x (q1306095_neg V y).

Fixpoint q1306095_vector_sum
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> E) -> E :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> E) -> E with
  | O => fun _ => q1306095_zero V
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q1306095_add V
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1306095_vector_sum E V k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q1306095_vector_sum {E} V n _.

Record q1306095_finite_dimensional
    {E : Type}
    (V : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q1306095_dimension : nat;
  q1306095_basis : Fin.t q1306095_dimension -> E;
  q1306095_basis_spans :
    forall x : E,
      exists coefficients : Fin.t q1306095_dimension -> R,
        x =
        q1306095_vector_sum V q1306095_dimension
          (fun i =>
            q1306095_smul V
              (coefficients i) (q1306095_basis i));
  q1306095_basis_independent :
    forall coefficients : Fin.t q1306095_dimension -> R,
      q1306095_vector_sum V q1306095_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q1306095_smul V
            (coefficients i) (q1306095_basis i)) =
      q1306095_zero V ->
      forall i : Fin.t q1306095_dimension,
        coefficients i = 0
}.

Record q1306095_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1306095_is_open : q1306095_set X -> Prop;
  q1306095_open_ext :
    forall U V : q1306095_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q1306095_is_open U <-> q1306095_is_open V);
  q1306095_open_univ :
    q1306095_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1306095_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1306095_set X,
      q1306095_is_open U ->
      q1306095_is_open V ->
      q1306095_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1306095_open_union :
    forall family : q1306095_set (q1306095_set X),
      (forall U : q1306095_set X,
        family U -> q1306095_is_open U) ->
      q1306095_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1306095_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1306095_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q1306095_norm_open {E : Type}
    (V : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (U : q1306095_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : E,
        q1306095_norm V (q1306095_sub V y x) < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q1306095_continuous_on
    {X Y : Type}
    (TX : q1306095_topological_space X)
    (TY : q1306095_topological_space Y)
    (source : q1306095_set X)
    (f : X -> Y) : Prop :=
  forall V : q1306095_set Y,
    q1306095_is_open TY V ->
    exists U : q1306095_set X,
      q1306095_is_open TX U /\
      forall x : X, source x -> (V (f x) <-> U x).

Definition q1306095_continuous_norm_to_top
    {E Y : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (TY : q1306095_topological_space Y)
    (source : q1306095_set E)
    (f : E -> Y) : Prop :=
  forall V : q1306095_set Y,
    q1306095_is_open TY V ->
    exists U : q1306095_set E,
      q1306095_norm_open VE U /\
      forall x : E, source x -> (V (f x) <-> U x).

Definition q1306095_continuous_top_to_norm
    {X E : Type}
    (TX : q1306095_topological_space X)
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (source : q1306095_set X)
    (f : X -> E) : Prop :=
  forall V : q1306095_set E,
    q1306095_norm_open VE V ->
    exists U : q1306095_set X,
      q1306095_is_open TX U /\
      forall x : X, source x -> (V (f x) <-> U x).

Definition q1306095_hausdorff
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1306095_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  forall x y : X,
    x <> y ->
    exists U V : q1306095_set X,
      q1306095_is_open T U /\
      q1306095_is_open T V /\
      U x /\ V y /\
      forall z : X, ~ (U z /\ V z).

Definition q1306095_compact
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1306095_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  forall (J : Type) (U : J -> q1306095_set X),
    (forall j : J, q1306095_is_open T (U j)) ->
    (forall x : X, exists j : J, U j x) ->
    exists finite_subcover : list J,
      forall x : X,
        exists j : J, In j finite_subcover /\ U j x.

Record q1306095_continuous_linear_map
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F) : Type := {
  q1306095_clm_fun : E -> F;
  q1306095_clm_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q1306095_clm_fun (q1306095_add VE x y) =
      q1306095_add VF
        (q1306095_clm_fun x) (q1306095_clm_fun y);
  q1306095_clm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q1306095_clm_fun (q1306095_smul VE a x) =
      q1306095_smul VF a (q1306095_clm_fun x);
  q1306095_clm_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : E,
        q1306095_norm VF (q1306095_clm_fun x) <=
        bound * q1306095_norm VE x
}.

Arguments q1306095_clm_fun {E F VE VF} _ _.

Definition q1306095_has_frechet_derivative_within_at
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (source : q1306095_set E)
    (f : E -> F)
    (x : E)
    (derivative : q1306095_continuous_linear_map VE VF) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : E,
        source y ->
        q1306095_norm VE (q1306095_sub VE y x) < delta ->
        q1306095_norm VF
          (q1306095_sub VF
            (q1306095_sub VF (f y) (f x))
            (q1306095_clm_fun derivative
              (q1306095_sub VE y x))) <=
        epsilon * q1306095_norm VE (q1306095_sub VE y x).

Definition q1306095_unique_diff_on
    {E : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (source : q1306095_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (x : E),
    source x ->
    forall (F : Type)
           (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
           (f : E -> F)
           (first second :
             q1306095_continuous_linear_map VE VF),
      @q1306095_has_frechet_derivative_within_at
        E F VE VF source f x first ->
      @q1306095_has_frechet_derivative_within_at
        E F VE VF source f x second ->
      forall v : E,
        q1306095_clm_fun first v =
        q1306095_clm_fun second v.

Definition q1306095_norm_interior
    {E : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (source : q1306095_set E) : q1306095_set E :=
  fun x : E =>
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : E,
        q1306095_norm VE (q1306095_sub VE y x) < radius ->
        source y.

Definition q1306095_norm_closure
    {E : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (source : q1306095_set E) : q1306095_set E :=
  fun x : E =>
    forall radius : R,
      0 < radius ->
      exists y : E,
        source y /\
        q1306095_norm VE (q1306095_sub VE y x) < radius.

Record q1306095_model_with_corners
    {E H : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (TH : q1306095_topological_space H) : Type := {
  q1306095_model_source : q1306095_set E;
  q1306095_to_model : E -> H;
  q1306095_from_model : H -> E;
  q1306095_to_model_mem :
    forall x : E,
      q1306095_model_source x ->
      q1306095_from_model (q1306095_to_model x) = x;
  q1306095_from_model_mem :
    forall h : H,
      q1306095_model_source (q1306095_from_model h);
  q1306095_from_model_inverse :
    forall h : H,
      q1306095_to_model (q1306095_from_model h) = h;
  q1306095_to_model_continuous :
    q1306095_continuous_norm_to_top
      VE TH q1306095_model_source q1306095_to_model;
  q1306095_from_model_continuous :
    q1306095_continuous_top_to_norm
      TH VE (fun _ : H => True) q1306095_from_model;
  q1306095_model_source_convex :
    forall (x y : E) (t : R),
      q1306095_model_source x ->
      q1306095_model_source y ->
      0 <= t <= 1 ->
      q1306095_model_source
        (q1306095_add VE
          (q1306095_smul VE t x)
          (q1306095_smul VE (1 - t) y));
  q1306095_model_source_nonempty_interior :
    exists x : E,
      @q1306095_norm_interior E VE q1306095_model_source x;
  q1306095_model_source_unique_diff :
    @q1306095_unique_diff_on E VE q1306095_model_source;
  q1306095_model_source_dense_interior :
    forall x : E,
      q1306095_model_source x ->
      @q1306095_norm_closure E VE
        (@q1306095_norm_interior E VE q1306095_model_source) x;
  q1306095_model_source_contains_closure_interior :
    forall x : E,
      @q1306095_norm_closure E VE
        (@q1306095_norm_interior E VE q1306095_model_source) x ->
      q1306095_model_source x
}.

Arguments q1306095_model_source {E H VE TH} _ _.
Arguments q1306095_to_model {E H VE TH} _ _.
Arguments q1306095_from_model {E H VE TH} _ _.

Record q1306095_chart
    {H M : Type}
    (TH : q1306095_topological_space H)
    (TM : q1306095_topological_space M) : Type := {
  q1306095_chart_source : q1306095_set M;
  q1306095_chart_target : q1306095_set H;
  q1306095_chart_to : M -> H;
  q1306095_chart_from : H -> M;
  q1306095_chart_source_open :
    q1306095_is_open TM q1306095_chart_source;
  q1306095_chart_target_open :
    q1306095_is_open TH q1306095_chart_target;
  q1306095_chart_to_target :
    forall x : M,
      q1306095_chart_source x ->
      q1306095_chart_target (q1306095_chart_to x);
  q1306095_chart_from_source :
    forall h : H,
      q1306095_chart_target h ->
      q1306095_chart_source (q1306095_chart_from h);
  q1306095_chart_left_inverse :
    forall x : M,
      q1306095_chart_source x ->
      q1306095_chart_from (q1306095_chart_to x) = x;
  q1306095_chart_right_inverse :
    forall h : H,
      q1306095_chart_target h ->
      q1306095_chart_to (q1306095_chart_from h) = h;
  q1306095_chart_to_continuous :
    q1306095_continuous_on
      TM TH q1306095_chart_source q1306095_chart_to;
  q1306095_chart_from_continuous :
    q1306095_continuous_on
      TH TM q1306095_chart_target q1306095_chart_from
}.

Arguments q1306095_chart_source {H M TH TM} _ _.
Arguments q1306095_chart_target {H M TH TM} _ _.
Arguments q1306095_chart_to {H M TH TM} _ _.
Arguments q1306095_chart_from {H M TH TM} _ _.

Fixpoint q1306095_iterated
    (E F : Type) (order : nat) : Type :=
  match order with
  | O => F
  | S k => E -> q1306095_iterated E F k
  end.

Fixpoint q1306095_iterated_eq
    {E F : Type}
    (order : nat) :
    q1306095_iterated E F order ->
    q1306095_iterated E F order -> Prop :=
  match order as k return
    q1306095_iterated E F k ->
    q1306095_iterated E F k -> Prop with
  | O => fun x y => x = y
  | S k =>
      fun f g =>
        forall v : E,
          q1306095_iterated_eq k (f v) (g v)
  end.

Fixpoint q1306095_iterated_add
    {E F : Type}
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (order : nat) :
    q1306095_iterated E F order ->
    q1306095_iterated E F order ->
    q1306095_iterated E F order :=
  match order as k return
    q1306095_iterated E F k ->
    q1306095_iterated E F k ->
    q1306095_iterated E F k with
  | O => fun x y => q1306095_add VF x y
  | S k =>
      fun f g v =>
        q1306095_iterated_add VF k (f v) (g v)
  end.

Fixpoint q1306095_iterated_neg
    {E F : Type}
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (order : nat) :
    q1306095_iterated E F order ->
    q1306095_iterated E F order :=
  match order as k return
    q1306095_iterated E F k ->
    q1306095_iterated E F k with
  | O => fun x => q1306095_neg VF x
  | S k =>
      fun f v => q1306095_iterated_neg VF k (f v)
  end.

Definition q1306095_iterated_sub
    {E F : Type}
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (order : nat)
    (x y : q1306095_iterated E F order) :
    q1306095_iterated E F order :=
  q1306095_iterated_add VF order x
    (q1306095_iterated_neg VF order y).

Fixpoint q1306095_iterated_smul
    {E F : Type}
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (order : nat) :
    R ->
    q1306095_iterated E F order ->
    q1306095_iterated E F order :=
  match order as k return
    R ->
    q1306095_iterated E F k ->
    q1306095_iterated E F k with
  | O => fun a x => q1306095_smul VF a x
  | S k =>
      fun a f v => q1306095_iterated_smul VF k a (f v)
  end.

Fixpoint q1306095_multilinear
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (order : nat)
    (D : q1306095_iterated E F order) : Prop :=
  match order as k return q1306095_iterated E F k -> Prop with
  | O => fun _ => True
  | S k =>
      fun L =>
        (forall v : E, q1306095_multilinear VE VF k (L v)) /\
        (forall x y : E,
          q1306095_iterated_eq k
            (L (q1306095_add VE x y))
            (q1306095_iterated_add VF k (L x) (L y))) /\
        (forall (a : R) (x : E),
          q1306095_iterated_eq k
            (L (q1306095_smul VE a x))
            (q1306095_iterated_smul VF k a (L x)))
  end D.

Fixpoint q1306095_iterated_bound
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (order : nat)
    (D : q1306095_iterated E F order)
    (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match order as k return
    q1306095_iterated E F k -> Prop with
  | O => fun value => q1306095_norm VF value <= bound
  | S k =>
      fun L =>
        forall v : E,
          q1306095_norm VE v <= 1 ->
          q1306095_iterated_bound VE VF k (L v) bound
  end D.

Definition q1306095_is_smooth_data
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (source : q1306095_set E)
    (f : E -> F)
    (D : forall order : nat,
      E -> q1306095_iterated E F order) : Prop :=
  (forall x : E, source x -> D O x = f x) /\
  (forall (order : nat) (x : E),
    source x ->
    q1306095_multilinear VE VF (S order) (D (S order) x) /\
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      q1306095_iterated_bound
        VE VF (S order) (D (S order) x) bound) /\
  forall (order : nat) (x : E),
    source x ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall y : E,
          source y ->
          q1306095_norm VE (q1306095_sub VE y x) < delta ->
          q1306095_iterated_bound VE VF order
            (q1306095_iterated_sub VF order
              (q1306095_iterated_sub VF order
                (D order y) (D order x))
              (D (S order) x (q1306095_sub VE y x)))
            (epsilon *
              q1306095_norm VE (q1306095_sub VE y x)).

Definition q1306095_smooth_on
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (source : q1306095_set E)
    (f : E -> F) : Prop :=
  exists D : forall order : nat,
      E -> q1306095_iterated E F order,
    q1306095_is_smooth_data VE VF source f D.

Record q1306095_smooth_atlas
    {E H M : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (TH : q1306095_topological_space H)
    (TM : q1306095_topological_space M)
    (I : q1306095_model_with_corners VE TH) : Type := {
  q1306095_atlas_chart : M -> q1306095_chart TH TM;
  q1306095_atlas_chart_mem :
    forall x : M,
      q1306095_chart_source (q1306095_atlas_chart x) x;
  q1306095_atlas_compatible :
    forall x y : M,
      q1306095_smooth_on VE VE
        (fun u : E =>
          q1306095_model_source I u /\
          q1306095_chart_target
            (q1306095_atlas_chart x)
            (q1306095_to_model I u) /\
          q1306095_chart_source
            (q1306095_atlas_chart y)
            (q1306095_chart_from
              (q1306095_atlas_chart x)
              (q1306095_to_model I u)))
        (fun u : E =>
          q1306095_from_model I
            (q1306095_chart_to
              (q1306095_atlas_chart y)
              (q1306095_chart_from
                (q1306095_atlas_chart x)
                (q1306095_to_model I u))))
}.

Arguments q1306095_atlas_chart {E H M VE TH TM I} _ _.

Definition q1306095_euclidean (n : nat) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> R.

Definition q1306095_euclidean_zero
    (n : nat) : q1306095_euclidean n :=
  fun _ => 0.

Definition q1306095_euclidean_add
    {n : nat}
    (x y : q1306095_euclidean n) : q1306095_euclidean n :=
  fun i => x i + y i.

Definition q1306095_euclidean_neg
    {n : nat}
    (x : q1306095_euclidean n) : q1306095_euclidean n :=
  fun i => - x i.

Definition q1306095_euclidean_smul
    {n : nat}
    (a : R) (x : q1306095_euclidean n) : q1306095_euclidean n :=
  fun i => a * x i.

Fixpoint q1306095_euclidean_sumsq
    (n : nat) : q1306095_euclidean n -> R :=
  match n as k return q1306095_euclidean k -> R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun x =>
        x Fin.F1 * x Fin.F1 +
        @q1306095_euclidean_sumsq k
          (fun i => x (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Definition q1306095_euclidean_norm
    {n : nat}
    (x : q1306095_euclidean n) : R :=
  sqrt (@q1306095_euclidean_sumsq n x).

Definition q1306095_standard_euclidean_structure
    (n : nat)
    (V : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space
      (q1306095_euclidean n)) : Prop :=
  q1306095_zero V = @q1306095_euclidean_zero n /\
  (forall x y : q1306095_euclidean n,
    q1306095_add V x y = q1306095_euclidean_add x y) /\
  (forall x : q1306095_euclidean n,
    q1306095_neg V x = q1306095_euclidean_neg x) /\
  (forall (a : R) (x : q1306095_euclidean n),
    q1306095_smul V a x = q1306095_euclidean_smul a x) /\
  forall x : q1306095_euclidean n,
    q1306095_norm V x = q1306095_euclidean_norm x.

Definition q1306095_smooth_map_with_derivative
    {E H M F : Type}
    (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (TH : q1306095_topological_space H)
    (TM : q1306095_topological_space M)
    (I : q1306095_model_with_corners VE TH)
    (A : @q1306095_smooth_atlas E H M VE TH TM I)
    (f : M -> F)
    (derivative :
      M -> q1306095_continuous_linear_map VE VF) : Prop :=
  forall x : M,
    exists D : forall order : nat,
        E -> q1306095_iterated E F order,
      q1306095_is_smooth_data VE VF
        (fun u : E =>
          q1306095_model_source I u /\
          q1306095_chart_target
            (q1306095_atlas_chart A x)
            (q1306095_to_model I u))
        (fun u : E =>
          f
            (q1306095_chart_from
              (q1306095_atlas_chart A x)
              (q1306095_to_model I u)))
        D /\
      forall v : E,
        D (S O)
          (q1306095_from_model I
            (q1306095_chart_to
              (q1306095_atlas_chart A x) x)) v =
        q1306095_clm_fun (derivative x) v.

Definition q1306095_closed_embedding
    {M F : Type}
    (TM : q1306095_topological_space M)
    (VF : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (f : M -> F) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\
  (forall V : q1306095_set F,
    q1306095_norm_open VF V ->
    q1306095_is_open TM (fun x : M => V (f x))) /\
  (forall U : q1306095_set M,
    q1306095_is_open TM U ->
    exists V : q1306095_set F,
      q1306095_norm_open VF V /\
      forall x : M, U x <-> V (f x)) /\
  q1306095_norm_open VF
    (fun y : F => ~ exists x : M, f x = y).

Definition q1306095_injective
    {X Y : Type} (f : X -> Y) : Prop :=
  forall x y : X, f x = f y -> x = y.

Theorem exists_embedding_euclidean_of_compact :
  forall (E : Type)
         (VE : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (_ : q1306095_finite_dimensional VE)
         (H : Type)
         (TH : q1306095_topological_space H)
         (I : q1306095_model_with_corners VE TH)
         (M : Type)
         (TM : q1306095_topological_space M)
         (A : @q1306095_smooth_atlas E H M VE TH TM I),
    q1306095_hausdorff TM ->
    q1306095_compact TM ->
    exists n : nat,
    exists VN : q1306095_normed_real_vector_space
      (q1306095_euclidean n),
      @q1306095_standard_euclidean_structure n VN /\
      exists e : M -> q1306095_euclidean n,
      exists de :
        M -> q1306095_continuous_linear_map VE VN,
        @q1306095_smooth_map_with_derivative
          E H M (q1306095_euclidean n)
          VE VN TH TM I A e de /\
        @q1306095_closed_embedding
          M (q1306095_euclidean n) TM VN e /\
        forall x : M,
          @q1306095_injective
            E (q1306095_euclidean n)
            (q1306095_clm_fun (de x)).
Admitted.

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1306095,
  "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth finite-dimensional
  real manifold admits a smooth closed embedding into some finite-dimensional
  Euclidean space whose manifold derivative is injective everywhere. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

record ('m, 'e, 'c) q1306095_manifold_data =
  q1306095_topology :: "'m topology"
  q1306095_model_carrier :: "'e set"
  q1306095_chart_source :: "'c \<Rightarrow> 'm set"
  q1306095_chart_target :: "'c \<Rightarrow> 'e set"
  q1306095_to_chart :: "'c \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  q1306095_from_chart :: "'c \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  q1306095_chart_at :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'c"

definition q1306095_multilinear ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('e::real_normed_vector list \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_multilinear k A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>xs i u v.
      length xs = k \<longrightarrow> i < k \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := u + v]) = A (xs[i := u]) + A (xs[i := v])) \<and>
    (\<forall>xs i r u.
      length xs = k \<longrightarrow> i < k \<longrightarrow>
      A (xs[i := r *\<^sub>R u]) = r *\<^sub>R A (xs[i := u])) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>xs. length xs = k \<longrightarrow>
      norm (A xs) \<le> C * (\<Prod>i<k. norm (xs ! i)))"

definition q1306095_cont_diff_within_order ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
      ('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_cont_diff_within_order k f S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>D :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e list \<Rightarrow> 'f.
      (\<forall>x\<in>S. D 0 x [] = f x) \<and>
      (\<forall>j\<le>k. \<forall>x\<in>S. q1306095_multilinear j (D j x)) \<and>
      (\<forall>j<k. \<forall>x\<in>S. \<forall>xs. length xs = j \<longrightarrow>
        ((\<lambda>y. D j y xs) has_derivative
          (\<lambda>h. D (Suc j) x (xs @ [h]))) (at x within S)) \<and>
      (\<forall>xs. length xs = k \<longrightarrow>
        continuous_on S (\<lambda>x. D k x xs)))"

definition q1306095_smooth_within ::
    "('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_smooth_within f S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>k. q1306095_cont_diff_within_order k f S)"

definition q1306095_model_with_corners ::
    "'e::euclidean_space set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_model_with_corners H \<longleftrightarrow>
    closed H \<and> convex H \<and> interior H \<noteq> {}"

definition q1306095_valid_manifold ::
    "('m, 'e::euclidean_space, 'c) q1306095_manifold_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_valid_manifold A \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1306095_model_with_corners (q1306095_model_carrier A) \<and>
    (\<Union>c. q1306095_chart_source A c) =
      topspace (q1306095_topology A) \<and>
    (\<forall>c. openin (q1306095_topology A) (q1306095_chart_source A c)) \<and>
    (\<forall>c. q1306095_chart_target A c \<subseteq> q1306095_model_carrier A) \<and>
    (\<forall>c. openin (top_of_set (q1306095_model_carrier A))
      (q1306095_chart_target A c)) \<and>
    (\<forall>c. homeomorphic_maps
      (subtopology (q1306095_topology A) (q1306095_chart_source A c))
      (subtopology (top_of_set (q1306095_model_carrier A))
        (q1306095_chart_target A c))
      (q1306095_to_chart A c) (q1306095_from_chart A c)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>topspace (q1306095_topology A).
      x \<in> q1306095_chart_source A (q1306095_chart_at A x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. q1306095_smooth_within
      (q1306095_to_chart A b \<circ> q1306095_from_chart A a)
      {z \<in> q1306095_chart_target A a.
        q1306095_from_chart A a z \<in> q1306095_chart_source A b})"

definition q1306095_hausdorff ::
    "'a topology \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_hausdorff X \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>topspace X. \<forall>y\<in>topspace X.
      x \<noteq> y \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>U V. openin X U \<and> openin X V \<and>
        x \<in> U \<and> y \<in> V \<and> U \<inter> V = {}))"

definition q1306095_euclidean_carrier ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) set" where
  "q1306095_euclidean_carrier n = {v. \<forall>i\<ge>n. v i = 0}"

definition q1306095_euclidean_dist ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1306095_euclidean_dist n x y =
    sqrt (\<Sum>i<n. (x i - y i)\<^sup>2)"

definition q1306095_euclidean_open ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_euclidean_open n U \<longleftrightarrow>
    U \<subseteq> q1306095_euclidean_carrier n \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<exists>r>0.
      \<forall>y\<in>q1306095_euclidean_carrier n.
        q1306095_euclidean_dist n x y < r \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U)"

definition q1306095_euclidean_topology ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real) topology" where
  "q1306095_euclidean_topology n =
    topology (q1306095_euclidean_open n)"

definition q1306095_linear_to_euclidean ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_linear_to_euclidean n L \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>v. L v \<in> q1306095_euclidean_carrier n) \<and>
    (\<forall>u v. L (u + v) = (\<lambda>i. L u i + L v i)) \<and>
    (\<forall>r v. L (r *\<^sub>R v) = (\<lambda>i. r * L v i)) \<and>
    (\<exists>C\<ge>0. \<forall>v.
      q1306095_euclidean_dist n (L v) (\<lambda>i. 0) \<le> C * norm v)"

definition q1306095_smooth_map ::
    "('m, 'e::euclidean_space, 'c) q1306095_manifold_data \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> ('m \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_smooth_map A n e \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>topspace (q1306095_topology A).
      e x \<in> q1306095_euclidean_carrier n) \<and>
    (\<forall>c i. i < n \<longrightarrow>
      q1306095_smooth_within
        (\<lambda>z. e (q1306095_from_chart A c z) i)
        (q1306095_chart_target A c))"

definition q1306095_has_manifold_derivative ::
    "('m, 'e::euclidean_space, 'c) q1306095_manifold_data \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> ('m \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1306095_has_manifold_derivative A n e x L \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1306095_linear_to_euclidean n L \<and>
    (\<forall>i. i < n \<longrightarrow>
      ((\<lambda>z. e (q1306095_from_chart A (q1306095_chart_at A x) z) i)
        has_derivative (\<lambda>v. L v i))
       (at (q1306095_to_chart A (q1306095_chart_at A x) x)
        within q1306095_chart_target A (q1306095_chart_at A x)))"

theorem exists_embedding_euclidean_of_compact:
  fixes A :: "('m, 'e::euclidean_space, 'c) q1306095_manifold_data"
  assumes "q1306095_valid_manifold A"
    and "q1306095_hausdorff (q1306095_topology A)"
    and "compact_space (q1306095_topology A)"
  shows "\<exists>n e.
    q1306095_smooth_map A n e \<and>
    embedding_map (q1306095_topology A)
      (q1306095_euclidean_topology n) e \<and>
    closed_map (q1306095_topology A)
      (q1306095_euclidean_topology n) e \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>topspace (q1306095_topology A). \<exists>L.
      q1306095_has_manifold_derivative A n e x L \<and> inj L)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1306095,
  "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth
  finite-dimensional real manifold, including a manifold with corners, has a
  smooth closed embedding into some finite-dimensional Euclidean space whose
  intrinsic manifold differential is injective at every point. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q1306095_WHITNEY_EMBEDDING_THEOREM =
 `let supported =
    \(d:num) (x:num->real).
      !i:num. d <= i ==> x i = &0 in
  let vzero =
    \i:num. &0 in
  let vadd =
    \(x:num->real) (y:num->real) i. x i + y i in
  let vsub =
    \(x:num->real) (y:num->real) i. x i - y i in
  let vsmul =
    \(a:real) (x:num->real) i. a * x i in
  let dot =
    \(d:num) (x:num->real) (y:num->real).
      sum {i:num | i < d} (\i. x i * y i) in
  let sqdist =
    \(d:num) (x:num->real) (y:num->real).
      sum {i:num | i < d} (\i. (x i - y i) pow 2) in
  let euclidean_open =
    \(d:num) (s:(num->real)->bool).
      (!x:num->real. x IN s ==> supported d x) /\
      (!x:num->real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:num->real.
                 supported d y /\
                 sqdist d x y < epsilon pow 2
                 ==> y IN s) in
  let relative_open =
    \(d:num) (model:(num->real)->bool)
     (s:(num->real)->bool).
      s SUBSET model /\
      (!x:num->real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:num->real.
                 y IN model /\
                 sqdist d x y < epsilon pow 2
                 ==> y IN s) in
  let linear_map =
    \(d:num) (m:num) (l:(num->real)->num->real).
      (!x:num->real. supported d x ==> supported m (l x)) /\
      (!x y:num->real.
         supported d x /\ supported d y
         ==> l (vadd x y) = vadd (l x) (l y)) /\
      (!a:real. !x:num->real.
         supported d x
         ==> l (vsmul a x) = vsmul a (l x)) in
  let has_scalar_derivative =
    \(d:num) (f:(num->real)->real)
     (domain:(num->real)->bool) (x:num->real)
     (gradient:num->real).
      supported d gradient /\
      (!epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:num->real.
                 y IN domain /\
                 &0 < sqdist d x y /\
                 sqdist d x y < delta pow 2
                 ==> (f y - f x -
                      dot d gradient (vsub y x)) pow 2
                     < epsilon pow 2 * sqdist d x y) in
  let has_vector_derivative =
    \(d:num) (m:num) (f:(num->real)->num->real)
     (domain:(num->real)->bool) (x:num->real)
     (l:(num->real)->num->real).
      linear_map d m l /\
      (!epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !y:num->real.
                 y IN domain /\
                 &0 < sqdist d x y /\
                 sqdist d x y < delta pow 2
                 ==> sqdist m
                       (vsub (vsub (f y) (f x))
                             (l (vsub y x)))
                       vzero
                     < epsilon pow 2 * sqdist d x y) in
	  let intrinsic_vector_derivative =
	    \(d:num) (m:num) (f:(num->real)->num->real)
	     (domain:(num->real)->bool) (x:num->real)
	     (l:(num->real)->num->real).
      has_vector_derivative d m f domain x l /\
      (!l':(num->real)->num->real.
         has_vector_derivative d m f domain x l'
	         ==> !v:num->real.
	               supported d v ==> l' v = l v) in
	  let scalar_continuous_within =
	    \(d:num) (f:(num->real)->real)
	     (domain:(num->real)->bool) (x:num->real).
	      !epsilon:real.
	        &0 < epsilon
	        ==> ?delta:real.
	              &0 < delta /\
	              !y:num->real.
	                y IN domain /\
	                sqdist d x y < delta pow 2
	                ==> (f y - f x) pow 2 < epsilon pow 2 in
	  let jet_index =
	    \(d:num) (m:num) (k:num) (alpha:num list).
	      LENGTH alpha = SUC k /\
	      HD alpha < m /\
	      (!r:num. r < k ==> EL (SUC r) alpha < d) in
	  let finite_order_jet =
	    \(d:num) (m:num) (order:num)
	     (domain:(num->real)->bool)
	     (f:(num->real)->num->real).
	      (!x:num->real. x IN domain ==> supported m (f x)) /\
	      ?jet:num->(num->real)->num list->real.
	        (!x:num->real. !j:num.
	           x IN domain /\ j < m ==> jet 0 x [j] = f x j) /\
	        (!k:num. !alpha:num list.
	           k <= order /\ jet_index d m k alpha
	           ==> !x:num->real.
	                 x IN domain
	                 ==> scalar_continuous_within d
	                       (\y:num->real. jet k y alpha)
	                       domain x) /\
	        (!k:num. !alpha:num list.
	           k < order /\ jet_index d m k alpha
	           ==> !x:num->real.
	                 x IN domain
	                 ==> has_scalar_derivative d
	                       (\y:num->real. jet k y alpha)
	                       domain x
	                       (\i:num. jet (SUC k) x (APPEND alpha [i]))) in
	  let relative_neighborhood =
	    \(d:num) (s:(num->real)->bool) (x:num->real)
	     (u:(num->real)->bool).
	      u SUBSET s /\
	      x IN u /\
	      ?epsilon:real.
	        &0 < epsilon /\
	        !y:num->real.
	          y IN s /\ sqdist d x y < epsilon pow 2
	          ==> y IN u in
	  let cont_diff_infinity_within_at =
	    \(d:num) (m:num) (f:(num->real)->num->real)
	     (s:(num->real)->bool) (x:num->real).
	      x IN s /\
	      !order:num.
	        ?u:(num->real)->bool.
	          relative_neighborhood d s x u /\
	          finite_order_jet d m order u f in
  let model_with_corners_range =
    \(d:num) (model:(num->real)->bool).
      (!x:num->real. x IN model ==> supported d x) /\
      (!x y:num->real.
         x IN model /\ y IN model
         ==> !a b:real.
               &0 <= a /\ &0 <= b /\ a + b = &1
               ==> vadd (vsmul a x) (vsmul b y) IN model) /\
      (?x:num->real.
         x IN model /\
         ?epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon /\
           !y:num->real.
             supported d y /\
             sqdist d x y < epsilon pow 2
             ==> y IN model) in
  let is_topology =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
      open_sets {} /\
      open_sets carrier /\
      (!u:A->bool. open_sets u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
      (!c:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!u:A->bool. u IN c ==> open_sets u)
         ==> open_sets (UNIONS c)) /\
      (!u v:A->bool.
         open_sets u /\ open_sets v
         ==> open_sets (u INTER v)) in
  let open_in_space =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
     (s:A->bool) (u:A->bool).
      u SUBSET s /\
      ?v:A->bool. open_sets v /\ u = s INTER v in
  let compact_space =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
      !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
        (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> open_sets u) /\
        carrier SUBSET UNIONS cover
        ==> ?finite_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
              FINITE finite_cover /\
              finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
              carrier SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
  let hausdorff_space =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
      !x y:A.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ ~(x = y)
        ==> ?u v:A->bool.
              open_sets u /\ open_sets v /\
              x IN u /\ y IN v /\ u INTER v = {} in
  let chart_atlas =
    \(d:num) (model:(num->real)->bool)
     (carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
     (source:K->A->bool)
     (target:K->(num->real)->bool)
     (chart:K->A->num->real)
     (chart_inv:K->(num->real)->A).
      (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> ?p:K. x IN source p) /\
      (!p:K.
         open_sets (source p) /\
         source p SUBSET carrier /\
         relative_open d model (target p) /\
         (!x:A.
            x IN source p
            ==> chart p x IN target p /\
                chart_inv p (chart p x) = x) /\
         (!y:num->real.
            y IN target p
            ==> chart_inv p y IN source p /\
                chart p (chart_inv p y) = y) /\
         (!v:(num->real)->bool.
            relative_open d (target p) v
            ==> open_in_space carrier open_sets (source p)
                  {x:A | x IN source p /\ chart p x IN v}) /\
         (!u:A->bool.
            open_in_space carrier open_sets (source p) u
            ==> relative_open d (target p)
                  {y:num->real |
                     y IN target p /\ chart_inv p y IN u})) in
	  let smooth_atlas =
	    \(d:num) (source:K->A->bool)
	     (target:K->(num->real)->bool)
	     (chart:K->A->num->real)
	     (chart_inv:K->(num->real)->A).
	      !p q:K. !x:A.
	        x IN source p /\ x IN source q
	        ==> cont_diff_infinity_within_at d d
	              (\y:num->real. chart q (chart_inv p y))
	              {y:num->real |
	                 y IN target p /\ chart_inv p y IN source q}
	              (chart p x) in
  let is_smooth_manifold =
    \(d:num) (model:(num->real)->bool)
     (carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
     (source:K->A->bool)
     (target:K->(num->real)->bool)
     (chart:K->A->num->real)
     (chart_inv:K->(num->real)->A).
      is_topology carrier open_sets /\
      model_with_corners_range d model /\
      chart_atlas d model carrier open_sets
        source target chart chart_inv /\
      smooth_atlas d source target chart chart_inv in
  let closed_embedding =
    \(n:num) (carrier:A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
     (e:A->num->real).
      (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> supported n (e x)) /\
      (!x y:A.
         x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ e x = e y ==> x = y) /\
      (!u:A->bool.
         open_sets u <=>
         ?v:(num->real)->bool.
           euclidean_open n v /\
           u = {x:A | x IN carrier /\ e x IN v}) /\
      relative_open n
        {z:num->real | supported n z}
        ({z:num->real | supported n z} DIFF
         {z:num->real | ?x:A. x IN carrier /\ z = e x}) in
  let smooth_immersion =
    \(d:num) (n:num) (carrier:A->bool)
     (source:K->A->bool)
     (target:K->(num->real)->bool)
     (chart:K->A->num->real)
     (chart_inv:K->(num->real)->A)
	     (e:A->num->real).
	      !x:A.
	        x IN carrier
	        ==> ?p:K.
	            ?derivative:(num->real)->num->real.
	              x IN source p /\
	              cont_diff_infinity_within_at d n
	                (\y:num->real. e (chart_inv p y))
	                (target p) (chart p x) /\
	              intrinsic_vector_derivative d n
	                (\y:num->real. e (chart_inv p y))
                (target p) (chart p x) derivative /\
              (!v:num->real.
                 supported d v /\ derivative v = vzero
                 ==> v = vzero) in
  !d:num.
  !model:(num->real)->bool.
  !carrier:A->bool.
  !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool.
  !source:K->A->bool.
  !target:K->(num->real)->bool.
  !chart:K->A->num->real.
  !chart_inv:K->(num->real)->A.
    is_smooth_manifold d model carrier open_sets
      source target chart chart_inv /\
    hausdorff_space carrier open_sets /\
    compact_space carrier open_sets
    ==> ?n:num. ?e:A->num->real.
          closed_embedding n carrier open_sets e /\
          smooth_immersion d n carrier source target
            chart chart_inv e`;;

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1306095,
;; "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth
;; finite-dimensional real manifold admits a smooth closed embedding into
;; some finite-dimensional Euclidean space with injective derivative
;; everywhere. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Mathematical carriers, sets, families, maps, charts, linear maps, and jets
;; range over unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The conservative interfaces below
;; interpret these tags; every field, topology, vector-space, chart, and
;; smoothness law used by the statement is explicit in its predicate body.

(defstub q1306095-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q1306095-family-member-p (family set) t)

(defstub q1306095-empty-set (carrier) t)
(defstub q1306095-full-set (carrier) t)
(defstub q1306095-intersection-set (carrier left right) t)
(defstub q1306095-union-set (carrier family) t)
(defstub q1306095-complement-set (carrier set) t)

(defstub q1306095-field-member-p (field value) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-carrier-set (field) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-zero (field) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-one (field) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-inverse (field value) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-absolute (field value) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-le-p (field left right) t)
(defstub q1306095-field-from-nat (field n) t)

(defstub q1306095-space-member-p (space value) t)
(defstub q1306095-space-carrier-set (space) t)
(defstub q1306095-space-zero (space) t)
(defstub q1306095-space-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q1306095-space-negate (space value) t)
(defstub q1306095-space-smul (space scalar value) t)
(defstub q1306095-space-norm (space value) t)

(defstub q1306095-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q1306095-linear-value (linear-map argument) t)
(defstub q1306095-jet-value (jet order point arguments) t)
(defstub q1306095-chart-jet (jet-family chart) t)

(defstub q1306095-atlas-member-p (atlas chart) t)
(defstub q1306095-chart-source (chart) t)
(defstub q1306095-chart-target (chart) t)
(defstub q1306095-chart-forward (chart point) t)
(defstub q1306095-chart-inverse (chart coordinate) t)

(defstub q1306095-topology-open-p (topology set) t)

(defstub q1306095-coordinate-function (chart mapping) t)
(defstub q1306095-transition-function (left-chart right-chart) t)
(defstub q1306095-zero-function (space) t)

;; Set constructors are extensional on the represented carrier.  Families are
;; arbitrary extensional collections of represented subsets, not finite
;; enumerations.

(defun-sk q1306095-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-set-member-p set x)
     (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q1306095-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1306095-set-member-p left x)
      (q1306095-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1306095-family-member-p family set)
     (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun-sk q1306095-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q1306095-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q1306095-family-member-p family left)
      (q1306095-family-member-p family right)))))

(defun q1306095-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (q1306095-family-members-valid-p carrier family)
   (q1306095-family-extensional-p carrier family)))

(defun-sk q1306095-union-member-exists-p (family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1306095-family-member-p family set)
     (q1306095-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1306095-set-constructor-laws-p (carrier)
  (forall (x left right family)
    (and
     (not
      (q1306095-set-member-p
       (q1306095-empty-set carrier) x))
     (iff
      (q1306095-set-member-p
       (q1306095-full-set carrier) x)
      (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x))
     (iff
      (q1306095-set-member-p
       (q1306095-intersection-set carrier left right) x)
      (and
       (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
       (q1306095-set-member-p left x)
       (q1306095-set-member-p right x)))
     (iff
      (q1306095-set-member-p
       (q1306095-complement-set carrier left) x)
      (and
       (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
       (not (q1306095-set-member-p left x))))
     (iff
      (q1306095-set-member-p
       (q1306095-union-set carrier family) x)
      (and
       (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
       (q1306095-union-member-exists-p family x))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-carrier-set-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1306095-set-member-p
      (q1306095-field-carrier-set field) x)
     (q1306095-field-member-p field x))))

(defun-sk q1306095-space-carrier-set-laws-p (space)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q1306095-set-member-p
      (q1306095-space-carrier-set space) x)
     (q1306095-space-member-p space x))))

;; A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real numbers.

(defun q1306095-field-subtract (field left right)
  (q1306095-field-add
   field left (q1306095-field-negate field right)))

(defun q1306095-field-lt-p (field left right)
  (and
   (q1306095-field-le-p field left right)
   (not (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-algebra-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field x)
      (q1306095-field-member-p field y)
      (q1306095-field-member-p field z))
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-field-add field x y))
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-field-multiply field x y))
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-field-negate field x))
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-field-inverse field x))
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-field-absolute field x))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-add
        field (q1306095-field-add field x y) z)
       (q1306095-field-add
        field x (q1306095-field-add field y z)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-add field x y)
       (q1306095-field-add field y x))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-add
        field x (q1306095-field-zero field))
       x)
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-add
        field x (q1306095-field-negate field x))
       (q1306095-field-zero field))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field (q1306095-field-multiply field x y) z)
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field x (q1306095-field-multiply field y z)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-multiply field x y)
       (q1306095-field-multiply field y x))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field x (q1306095-field-one field))
       x)
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field x (q1306095-field-zero field))
       (q1306095-field-zero field))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q1306095-field-zero field)))
       (equal
        (q1306095-field-multiply
         field x (q1306095-field-inverse field x))
        (q1306095-field-one field)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field x (q1306095-field-add field y z))
       (q1306095-field-add
        field
        (q1306095-field-multiply field x y)
        (q1306095-field-multiply field x z)))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-order-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field x)
      (q1306095-field-member-p field y)
      (q1306095-field-member-p field z))
     (and
      (q1306095-field-le-p field x x)
      (implies
       (and
        (q1306095-field-le-p field x y)
        (q1306095-field-le-p field y z))
       (q1306095-field-le-p field x z))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1306095-field-le-p field x y)
        (q1306095-field-le-p field y x))
       (equal x y))
      (or
       (q1306095-field-le-p field x y)
       (q1306095-field-le-p field y x))
      (implies
       (q1306095-field-le-p field x y)
       (q1306095-field-le-p
        field
        (q1306095-field-add field z x)
        (q1306095-field-add field z y)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1306095-field-le-p
         field (q1306095-field-zero field) x)
        (q1306095-field-le-p
         field (q1306095-field-zero field) y))
       (q1306095-field-le-p
        field
        (q1306095-field-zero field)
        (q1306095-field-multiply field x y)))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-absolute-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field x)
      (q1306095-field-member-p field y))
     (and
      (q1306095-field-le-p
       field
       (q1306095-field-zero field)
       (q1306095-field-absolute field x))
      (implies
       (q1306095-field-le-p
        field (q1306095-field-zero field) x)
       (equal (q1306095-field-absolute field x) x))
      (implies
       (q1306095-field-le-p
        field x (q1306095-field-zero field))
       (equal
        (q1306095-field-absolute field x)
        (q1306095-field-negate field x)))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q1306095-field-absolute field x)
        (q1306095-field-zero field))
       (equal x (q1306095-field-zero field)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-absolute
        field (q1306095-field-negate field x))
       (q1306095-field-absolute field x))
      (q1306095-field-le-p
       field
       (q1306095-field-absolute
        field (q1306095-field-add field x y))
       (q1306095-field-add
        field
        (q1306095-field-absolute field x)
        (q1306095-field-absolute field y)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-absolute
        field (q1306095-field-multiply field x y))
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field
        (q1306095-field-absolute field x)
        (q1306095-field-absolute field y)))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-nat-laws-p (field)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-field-from-nat field n))
      (iff
       (equal n 0)
       (equal
        (q1306095-field-from-nat field n)
        (q1306095-field-zero field)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-field-from-nat field (+ 1 n))
       (q1306095-field-add
        field
        (q1306095-field-from-nat field n)
        (q1306095-field-one field)))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-archimedean-witness-exists-p (field x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q1306095-field-le-p
      field x (q1306095-field-from-nat field n)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-archimedean-p (field)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-field-member-p field x)
     (q1306095-archimedean-witness-exists-p field x))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-set-nonempty-p (field set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p field x)
     (q1306095-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1306095-upper-bound-p (field set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field x)
      (q1306095-set-member-p set x))
     (q1306095-field-le-p field x upper))))

(defun-sk q1306095-upper-bound-exists-p (field set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p field upper)
     (q1306095-upper-bound-p field set upper))))

(defun-sk q1306095-least-upper-bound-p (field set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field upper)
      (q1306095-upper-bound-p field set upper))
     (q1306095-field-le-p field supremum upper))))

(defun-sk q1306095-supremum-exists-p (field set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p field supremum)
     (q1306095-upper-bound-p field set supremum)
     (q1306095-least-upper-bound-p field set supremum))))

(defun-sk q1306095-field-complete-p (field)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-valid-set-p
       (q1306095-field-carrier-set field) set)
      (q1306095-field-set-nonempty-p field set)
      (q1306095-upper-bound-exists-p field set))
     (q1306095-supremum-exists-p field set))))

(defun q1306095-real-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q1306095-field-member-p
    field (q1306095-field-zero field))
   (q1306095-field-member-p
    field (q1306095-field-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1306095-field-zero field)
     (q1306095-field-one field)))
   (equal
    (q1306095-field-inverse
     field (q1306095-field-zero field))
    (q1306095-field-zero field))
   (q1306095-field-algebra-laws-p field)
   (q1306095-field-order-laws-p field)
   (q1306095-field-absolute-laws-p field)
   (q1306095-field-nat-laws-p field)
   (q1306095-field-archimedean-p field)
   (q1306095-field-complete-p field)))

;; Normed vector spaces and exact finite bases.

(defun q1306095-space-subtract (space left right)
  (q1306095-space-add
   space left (q1306095-space-negate space right)))

(defun q1306095-space-distance (space left right)
  (q1306095-space-norm
   space (q1306095-space-subtract space left right)))

(defun-sk q1306095-normed-space-laws-p (field space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field a)
      (q1306095-field-member-p field b)
      (q1306095-space-member-p space x)
      (q1306095-space-member-p space y)
      (q1306095-space-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q1306095-space-member-p
       space (q1306095-space-add space x y))
      (q1306095-space-member-p
       space (q1306095-space-negate space x))
      (q1306095-space-member-p
       space (q1306095-space-smul space a x))
      (q1306095-field-member-p
       field (q1306095-space-norm space x))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-add
        space (q1306095-space-add space x y) z)
       (q1306095-space-add
        space x (q1306095-space-add space y z)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-add space x y)
       (q1306095-space-add space y x))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-add
        space x (q1306095-space-zero space))
       x)
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-add
        space x (q1306095-space-negate space x))
       (q1306095-space-zero space))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-smul
        space (q1306095-field-one field) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-smul
        space (q1306095-field-multiply field a b) x)
       (q1306095-space-smul
        space a (q1306095-space-smul space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-smul
        space (q1306095-field-add field a b) x)
       (q1306095-space-add
        space
        (q1306095-space-smul space a x)
        (q1306095-space-smul space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-smul
        space a (q1306095-space-add space x y))
       (q1306095-space-add
        space
        (q1306095-space-smul space a x)
        (q1306095-space-smul space a y)))
      (q1306095-field-le-p
       field
       (q1306095-field-zero field)
       (q1306095-space-norm space x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q1306095-space-norm space x)
        (q1306095-field-zero field))
       (equal x (q1306095-space-zero space)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-norm
        space (q1306095-space-negate space x))
       (q1306095-space-norm space x))
      (q1306095-field-le-p
       field
       (q1306095-space-norm
        space (q1306095-space-add space x y))
       (q1306095-field-add
        field
        (q1306095-space-norm space x)
        (q1306095-space-norm space y)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-space-norm
        space (q1306095-space-smul space a x))
       (q1306095-field-multiply
        field
        (q1306095-field-absolute field a)
        (q1306095-space-norm space x)))))))

(defun q1306095-normed-space-p (field space)
  (and
   (q1306095-space-member-p
    space (q1306095-space-zero space))
   (q1306095-normed-space-laws-p field space)))

(defun q1306095-coefficients-valid-p
    (field coefficients count)
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p
      field
      (q1306095-function-value coefficients (- count 1)))
     (q1306095-coefficients-valid-p
      field coefficients (- count 1)))))

(defun q1306095-basis-elements-p (space basis)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (q1306095-space-member-p space (car basis))
       (q1306095-basis-elements-p space (cdr basis)))
    (equal basis nil)))

(defun q1306095-linear-combination
    (field space basis coefficients index)
  (if (zp index)
      (q1306095-space-zero space)
    (q1306095-space-add
     space
     (q1306095-linear-combination
      field space basis coefficients (- index 1))
     (q1306095-space-smul
      space
      (q1306095-function-value coefficients (- index 1))
      (nth (- index 1) basis)))))

(defun q1306095-all-coefficients-zero-p
    (field coefficients count)
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (q1306095-function-value coefficients (- count 1))
      (q1306095-field-zero field))
     (q1306095-all-coefficients-zero-p
      field coefficients (- count 1)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-basis-independent-p
    (field space basis)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-coefficients-valid-p
       field coefficients (len basis))
      (equal
       (q1306095-linear-combination
        field space basis coefficients (len basis))
       (q1306095-space-zero space)))
     (q1306095-all-coefficients-zero-p
      field coefficients (len basis)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-basis-spans-point-p
    (field space basis point)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (q1306095-coefficients-valid-p
      field coefficients (len basis))
     (equal
      (q1306095-linear-combination
       field space basis coefficients (len basis))
      point))))

(defun-sk q1306095-basis-spans-p (field space basis)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q1306095-space-member-p space point)
     (q1306095-basis-spans-point-p
      field space basis point))))

(defun q1306095-basis-p (field space basis)
  (and
   (true-listp basis)
   (q1306095-basis-elements-p space basis)
   (q1306095-basis-independent-p field space basis)
   (q1306095-basis-spans-p field space basis)))

(defun-sk q1306095-finite-dimensional-p (field space)
  (exists (basis)
    (q1306095-basis-p field space basis)))

(defun-sk q1306095-exact-dimension-p (field space n)
  (exists (basis)
    (and
     (q1306095-basis-p field space basis)
     (equal (len basis) n))))

(defun q1306095-euclidean-space-p (field space n)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (q1306095-space-carrier-set-laws-p space)
   (q1306095-set-constructor-laws-p
    (q1306095-space-carrier-set space))
   (q1306095-normed-space-p field space)
   (q1306095-exact-dimension-p field space n)))

;; Topology, Hausdorffness, and compactness are stated through arbitrary open
;; covers with internal finite-subcover witnesses.

(defun q1306095-open-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1306095-topology-open-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q1306095-topology-extensional-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q1306095-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q1306095-topology-open-p topology left)
      (q1306095-topology-open-p topology right)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1306095-family-member-p family set)
     (q1306095-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1306095-topology-closure-laws-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right family)
    (and
     (q1306095-open-set-p
      carrier topology (q1306095-empty-set carrier))
     (q1306095-open-set-p
      carrier topology (q1306095-full-set carrier))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1306095-open-set-p carrier topology left)
       (q1306095-open-set-p carrier topology right))
      (q1306095-open-set-p
       carrier topology
       (q1306095-intersection-set carrier left right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1306095-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
       (q1306095-family-members-open-p
        carrier topology family))
      (q1306095-open-set-p
       carrier topology
       (q1306095-union-set carrier family))))))

(defun q1306095-topology-laws-p (carrier topology)
  (and
   (q1306095-topology-extensional-p carrier topology)
   (q1306095-topology-closure-laws-p carrier topology)))

(defun-sk q1306095-disjoint-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q1306095-set-member-p left x)
      (q1306095-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-separated-neighborhoods-exist-p
    (carrier topology x y)
  (exists (left right)
    (and
     (q1306095-open-set-p carrier topology left)
     (q1306095-open-set-p carrier topology right)
     (q1306095-set-member-p left x)
     (q1306095-set-member-p right y)
     (q1306095-disjoint-p left right))))

(defun-sk q1306095-hausdorff-p (carrier topology)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
      (q1306095-set-member-p carrier y)
      (not (equal x y)))
     (q1306095-separated-neighborhoods-exist-p
      carrier topology x y))))

(defun-sk q1306095-cover-point-p (family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1306095-family-member-p family set)
     (q1306095-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1306095-cover-p (carrier family)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
     (q1306095-cover-point-p family x))))

(defun q1306095-subcover-elements-p (chosen carrier family)
  (if (consp chosen)
      (and
       (q1306095-valid-set-p carrier (car chosen))
       (q1306095-family-member-p family (car chosen))
       (q1306095-subcover-elements-p
        (cdr chosen) carrier family))
    (equal chosen nil)))

(defun q1306095-subcover-covers-point-p (chosen x)
  (if (consp chosen)
      (or
       (q1306095-set-member-p (car chosen) x)
       (q1306095-subcover-covers-point-p (cdr chosen) x))
    nil))

(defun-sk q1306095-subcover-covers-p (chosen carrier)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-set-member-p carrier x)
     (q1306095-subcover-covers-point-p chosen x))))

(defun q1306095-finite-subcover-p
    (chosen carrier family)
  (and
   (true-listp chosen)
   (q1306095-subcover-elements-p chosen carrier family)
   (q1306095-subcover-covers-p chosen carrier)))

(defun-sk q1306095-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (carrier family)
  (exists (chosen)
    (q1306095-finite-subcover-p chosen carrier family)))

(defun-sk q1306095-compact-p (carrier topology)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q1306095-family-members-open-p
       carrier topology family)
      (q1306095-cover-p carrier family))
     (q1306095-finite-subcover-exists-p
      carrier family))))

;; Norm-open and relatively open subsets.

(defun-sk q1306095-norm-ball-subset-p
    (field space ambient set center radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-set-member-p ambient point)
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field
       (q1306095-space-distance space point center)
       radius))
     (q1306095-set-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q1306095-open-radius-exists-p
    (field space ambient set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p field radius)
     (q1306095-field-lt-p
      field (q1306095-field-zero field) radius)
     (q1306095-norm-ball-subset-p
      field space ambient set center radius))))

(defun-sk q1306095-relatively-open-law-p
    (field space ambient set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (q1306095-set-member-p set center)
     (q1306095-open-radius-exists-p
      field space ambient set center))))

(defun q1306095-relatively-open-p
    (field space ambient set)
  (and
   (q1306095-valid-set-p ambient set)
   (q1306095-relatively-open-law-p
    field space ambient set)))

(defun q1306095-norm-open-p (field space set)
  (q1306095-relatively-open-p
   field space (q1306095-space-carrier-set space) set))

;; Linear maps, Fréchet derivatives within a set, and all-order smooth jets.

(defun-sk q1306095-linear-map-p
    (field source target linear-map)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field a)
      (q1306095-space-member-p source x)
      (q1306095-space-member-p source y))
     (and
      (q1306095-space-member-p
       target (q1306095-linear-value linear-map x))
      (equal
       (q1306095-linear-value
        linear-map (q1306095-space-add source x y))
       (q1306095-space-add
        target
        (q1306095-linear-value linear-map x)
        (q1306095-linear-value linear-map y)))
      (equal
       (q1306095-linear-value
        linear-map (q1306095-space-smul source a x))
       (q1306095-space-smul
        target a (q1306095-linear-value linear-map x)))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-derivative-delta-law-p
    (field source target domain function point linear-map
     epsilon delta)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-set-member-p domain nearby)
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field
       (q1306095-field-zero field)
       (q1306095-space-distance source nearby point))
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field
       (q1306095-space-distance source nearby point)
       delta))
     (q1306095-field-le-p
      field
      (q1306095-space-norm
       target
       (q1306095-space-subtract
        target
        (q1306095-space-subtract
         target
         (q1306095-function-value function nearby)
         (q1306095-function-value function point))
        (q1306095-linear-value
         linear-map
         (q1306095-space-subtract source nearby point))))
      (q1306095-field-multiply
       field epsilon
       (q1306095-space-distance source nearby point))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-derivative-delta-exists-p
    (field source target domain function point linear-map epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p field delta)
     (q1306095-field-lt-p
      field (q1306095-field-zero field) delta)
     (q1306095-derivative-delta-law-p
      field source target domain function point linear-map
      epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q1306095-has-derivative-within-p
    (field source target domain function point linear-map)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field epsilon)
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field (q1306095-field-zero field) epsilon))
     (q1306095-derivative-delta-exists-p
      field source target domain function point linear-map epsilon))))

(defun q1306095-derivative-within-p
    (field source target domain function point linear-map)
  (and
   (q1306095-set-member-p domain point)
   (q1306095-linear-map-p field source target linear-map)
   (q1306095-has-derivative-within-p
    field source target domain function point linear-map)))

(defun q1306095-arguments-in-space-p (space arguments)
  (if (consp arguments)
      (and
       (q1306095-space-member-p space (car arguments))
       (q1306095-arguments-in-space-p space (cdr arguments)))
    (equal arguments nil)))

(defun q1306095-valid-arguments-p (space order arguments)
  (and
   (true-listp arguments)
   (equal (len arguments) order)
   (q1306095-arguments-in-space-p space arguments)))

(defun-sk q1306095-multilinear-slot-laws-p
    (field source target jet order point arguments slot)
  (forall (a u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field a)
      (q1306095-space-member-p source u)
      (q1306095-space-member-p source v))
     (and
      (equal
       (q1306095-jet-value
        jet order point
        (update-nth
         slot (q1306095-space-add source u v) arguments))
       (q1306095-space-add
        target
        (q1306095-jet-value
         jet order point (update-nth slot u arguments))
        (q1306095-jet-value
         jet order point (update-nth slot v arguments))))
      (equal
       (q1306095-jet-value
        jet order point
        (update-nth
         slot (q1306095-space-smul source a u) arguments))
       (q1306095-space-smul
        target a
        (q1306095-jet-value
         jet order point
         (update-nth slot u arguments))))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-multilinear-map-p
    (field source target jet order point)
  (forall (arguments slot)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-valid-arguments-p source order arguments)
      (natp slot)
      (< slot order))
     (and
      (q1306095-space-member-p
       target
       (q1306095-jet-value
        jet order point arguments))
      (q1306095-multilinear-slot-laws-p
       field source target jet order point arguments slot)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-jet-step-delta-law-p
    (field source target domain jet order point arguments
     epsilon delta)
  (forall (nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-set-member-p domain nearby)
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field
       (q1306095-field-zero field)
       (q1306095-space-distance source nearby point))
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field
       (q1306095-space-distance source nearby point)
       delta))
     (q1306095-field-le-p
      field
      (q1306095-space-norm
       target
       (q1306095-space-subtract
        target
        (q1306095-space-subtract
         target
         (q1306095-jet-value
          jet order nearby arguments)
         (q1306095-jet-value
          jet order point arguments))
        (q1306095-jet-value
         jet (+ 1 order) point
         (cons
          (q1306095-space-subtract source nearby point)
          arguments))))
      (q1306095-field-multiply
       field
       epsilon
       (q1306095-space-distance source nearby point))))))

(defun-sk q1306095-jet-step-delta-exists-p
    (field source target domain jet order point arguments epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q1306095-field-member-p field delta)
     (q1306095-field-lt-p
      field (q1306095-field-zero field) delta)
     (q1306095-jet-step-delta-law-p
      field source target domain jet order point arguments
      epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q1306095-jet-step-p
    (field source target domain jet order point arguments)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-field-member-p field epsilon)
      (q1306095-field-lt-p
       field (q1306095-field-zero field) epsilon))
     (q1306095-jet-step-delta-exists-p
      field source target domain jet order point arguments
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1306095-smooth-jet-laws-p
    (field source target domain function jet)
  (forall (order point arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp order)
      (q1306095-set-member-p domain point)
      (q1306095-valid-arguments-p source order arguments))
     (and
      (q1306095-space-member-p
       target
       (q1306095-jet-value jet order point arguments))
      (q1306095-multilinear-map-p
       field source target jet order point)
      (q1306095-jet-step-p
       field source target domain jet order point arguments)
      (implies
       (equal order 0)
       (equal
        (q1306095-jet-value jet 0 point nil)
        (q1306095-function-value function point)))))))

(defun q1306095-smooth-jet-within-p
    (field source target domain function jet)
  (and
   (q1306095-valid-set-p
    (q1306095-space-carrier-set source) domain)
   (q1306095-smooth-jet-laws-p
    field source target domain function jet)))

(defun-sk q1306095-smooth-jet-exists-p
    (field source target domain function)
  (exists (jet)
    (q1306095-smooth-jet-within-p
     field source target domain function jet)))

;; Unique differentiability of the model-with-corners range ensures that the
;; manifold derivative does not depend on a chosen smooth extension.

(defun-sk q1306095-zero-function-laws-p (space)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-space-member-p space x)

      (q1306095-function-value
       (q1306095-zero-function space) x)
      (q1306095-space-zero space)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-linear-map-zero-p (source target linear-map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1306095-space-member-p source x)
     (equal
      (q1306095-linear-value linear-map x)
      (q1306095-space-zero target)))))

(defun-sk q1306095-unique-diff-on-p
    (field space corner)
  (forall (point linear-map)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1306095-set-member-p corner point)
      (q1306095-derivative-within-p
       field space space corner
       (q1306095-zero-function space)

      space space linear-map))))

;; Coordinate and transition function constructors have their exact values.

(defun-sk q1306095-function-constructor-laws-p ()
  (forall (chart left right mapping coordinate)
    (and
     (equal
      (q1306095-function-value
       (q1306095-coordinate-function chart mapping)
       coordinate)
      (q1306095-function-value
       mapping
       (q1306095-chart-inverse chart coordinate)))
     (equal
      (q1306095-function-value
       (q1306095-transition-function left right)
       coordinate)
      (q1306095-chart-forward
       right
       (q1306095-chart-inverse left coordinate))))))

;; Charts are homeomorphisms onto relatively open pieces of the
;; model-with-corners range.

(defun-sk q1306095-chart-target-characterization-p
    (corner chart ambient-open)
  (forall (coordinate)
    (iff
     (q1306095-set-member-p
      (q1306095-chart-target chart) coordinate)

      (q1306095-set-member-p corner coordinate)
