title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1306095,
-- "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth real manifold
-- modeled on a finite-dimensional normed space admits a smooth closed embedding
-- into some Euclidean space with injective differential. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record MixedIff (A : Set) (B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor mixed-equivalence
  field
    forward-mixed  : A -> B
    backward-mixed : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Member {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  at-head : {xs : List A} -> Member x (x ∷ xs)
  in-tail : {y : A} {xs : List A} -> Member x xs -> Member x (y ∷ xs)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR : R -> S
    backwardR : S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) == negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) == absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NormedVectorSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) -> addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zero :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-only :
      (x : E) -> normE x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroE
    norm-negate :
      (x : E) -> normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normE x)

open NormedVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

Vector : Set -> Nat -> Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

vectorAdd :
  {R : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorAdd reals x y i =
  addR reals (x i) (y i)

vectorSubtract :
  {R : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorSubtract reals x y i =
  subtractR reals (x i) (y i)

vectorScale :
  {R : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorScale reals scalar x i =
  multiplyR reals scalar (x i)

vectorNorm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
vectorNorm reals zero x =
  zeroR reals
vectorNorm reals (suc n) x =
  addR reals
    (absoluteR reals (x fzero))
    (vectorNorm reals n (\ i -> x (fsuc i)))

vectorDistance :
  {R : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
vectorDistance {n = n} reals x y =
  vectorNorm reals n (vectorSubtract reals x y)

record LinearEquivalence
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (n : Nat) : Set1 where
  field
    forward-linear : E -> Vector R n
    backward-linear : Vector R n -> E
    forward-after-backward :
      (x : Vector R n) ->
      VectorEqual (forward-linear (backward-linear x)) x
    backward-after-forward :
      (x : E) ->
      backward-linear (forward-linear x) == x
    forward-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (forward-linear (addE space x y))
        (vectorAdd reals (forward-linear x) (forward-linear y))
    forward-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (forward-linear (scaleE space a x))
        (vectorScale reals a (forward-linear x))

record FiniteDimensional
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) : Set1 where
  field
    dimension : Nat
    linear-equivalence :
      LinearEquivalence reals space dimension

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

record TopologicalSpace (X : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    Open : Predicate X -> Set
    open-empty :
      Open emptySet
    open-whole :
      Open wholeSet
    open-intersection :
      (U V : Predicate X) ->
      Open U ->
      Open V ->
      Open (\ x -> Both (U x) (V x))
    open-arbitrary-union :
      (I : Set) ->
      (family : I -> Predicate X) ->
      ((i : I) -> Open (family i)) ->
      Open (\ x -> Exists I (\ i -> family i x))

open TopologicalSpace

NormOpen :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
NormOpen {R = R} {reals = reals} space U =
  (x : _) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) radius ->
          U y))

VectorOpen :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Predicate (Vector R n) ->
  Set
VectorOpen reals n U =
  (x : Vector _ n) ->
  U x ->
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : Vector _ n) ->
          StrictLess reals (vectorDistance reals y x) radius ->
          U y))

record RelativelyOpen
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (carrier U : Predicate E) : Set1 where
  field
    ambient-open-set :
      Predicate E
    ambient-is-open :
      NormOpen space ambient-open-set
    relative-characterization :
      (x : E) ->
      Iff
        (U x)
        (Both (carrier x) (ambient-open-set x))

Compact :
  {X : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set1
Compact {X} topology =
  (I : Set) ->
  (cover : I -> Predicate X) ->
  ((i : I) -> Open topology (cover i)) ->
  ((x : X) -> Exists I (\ i -> cover i x)) ->
  Exists (List I)
    (\ chosen ->
      (x : X) ->
      Exists I
        (\ i ->
          Both
            (Member i chosen)
            (cover i x)))

record SeparatedNeighborhoods
  {X : Set}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace X)
  (x y : X) : Set1 where
  field
    left-neighborhood :
      Predicate X
    right-neighborhood :
      Predicate X
    left-open :
      Open topology left-neighborhood
    right-open :
      Open topology right-neighborhood
    left-contains :
      left-neighborhood x
    right-contains :
      right-neighborhood y
    neighborhoods-disjoint :
      (z : X) ->
      left-neighborhood z ->
      right-neighborhood z ->
      Bottom

Hausdorff :
  {X : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Set1
Hausdorff {X} topology =
  (x y : X) ->
  x != y ->
  SeparatedNeighborhoods topology x y

Continuous :
  {X Y : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  TopologicalSpace Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set1
Continuous source target f =
  (U : Predicate _) ->
  Open target U ->
  Open source (\ x -> U (f x))

Directions : Set -> Nat -> Set
Directions E n =
  Fin n -> E

prependDirection :
  {E : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  E ->
  Directions E n ->
  Directions E (suc n)
prependDirection x directions fzero =
  x
prependDirection x directions (fsuc i) =
  directions i

singleDirection :
  {E : Set} ->
  E ->
  Directions E (suc zero)
singleDirection x fzero =
  x

DirectionalDerivativeAtE :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (E -> E) ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  Set
DirectionalDerivativeAtE {R} {E} {reals} space f point direction derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((t : R) ->
          Positive reals (absoluteR reals t) ->
          StrictLess reals (absoluteR reals t) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE space
              (scaleE space
                (reciprocalR reals t)
                (subtractE space
                  (f (addE space point (scaleE space t direction)))
                  (f point)))
              derivative)
            epsilon))

DirectionalDerivativeAtVector :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {n : Nat} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (E -> Vector R n) ->
  E ->
  E ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
DirectionalDerivativeAtVector {R} {E} {reals} {n}
  space f point direction derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((t : R) ->
          Positive reals (absoluteR reals t) ->
          StrictLess reals (absoluteR reals t) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (vectorDistance reals
              (vectorScale reals
                (reciprocalR reals t)
                (vectorSubtract reals
                  (f (addE space point (scaleE space t direction)))
                  (f point)))
              derivative)
            epsilon))

record SmoothFunctionE
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (f : E -> E) : Set1 where
  field
    derivativesE :
      (order : Nat) ->
      E ->
      Directions E order ->
      E
    derivative-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      (directions : Directions E zero) ->
      derivativesE zero x directions == f x
    derivative-stepE :
      (order : Nat) ->
      (x direction : E) ->
      (directions : Directions E order) ->
      DirectionalDerivativeAtE space
        (\ y -> derivativesE order y directions)
        x
        direction
        (derivativesE (suc order) x
          (prependDirection direction directions))
    derivatives-continuousE :
      (order : Nat) ->
      (x : E) ->
      (directions : Directions E order) ->
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Both
            (Positive reals delta)
            ((y : E) ->
              StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) delta ->
              (otherDirections : Directions E order) ->
              ((i : Fin order) ->
                StrictLess reals
                  (distanceE space (otherDirections i) (directions i))
                  delta) ->
              StrictLess reals
                (distanceE space
                  (derivativesE order y otherDirections)
                  (derivativesE order x directions))
                epsilon))

open SmoothFunctionE

record SmoothFunctionVector
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {n : Nat}
  (f : E -> Vector R n) : Set1 where
  field
    derivativesVector :
      (order : Nat) ->
      E ->
      Directions E order ->
      Vector R n
    derivative-zeroVector :
      (x : E) ->
      (directions : Directions E zero) ->
      VectorEqual (derivativesVector zero x directions) (f x)
    derivative-stepVector :
      (order : Nat) ->
      (x direction : E) ->
      (directions : Directions E order) ->
      DirectionalDerivativeAtVector space
        (\ y -> derivativesVector order y directions)
        x
        direction
        (derivativesVector (suc order) x
          (prependDirection direction directions))
    derivatives-continuousVector :
      (order : Nat) ->
      (x : E) ->
      (directions : Directions E order) ->
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Both
            (Positive reals delta)
            ((y : E) ->
              StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) delta ->
              (otherDirections : Directions E order) ->
              ((i : Fin order) ->
                StrictLess reals
                  (distanceE space (otherDirections i) (directions i))
                  delta) ->
              StrictLess reals
                (vectorDistance reals
                  (derivativesVector order y otherDirections)
                  (derivativesVector order x directions))
                epsilon))

open SmoothFunctionVector

firstDerivativeE :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals}
  {f : E -> E} ->
  SmoothFunctionE reals space f ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
firstDerivativeE smooth point direction =
  derivativesE smooth (suc zero) point (singleDirection direction)

firstDerivativeVector :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals}
  {n : Nat}
  {f : E -> Vector R n} ->
  SmoothFunctionVector reals space f ->
  E ->
  E ->
  Vector R n
firstDerivativeVector smooth point direction =
  derivativesVector smooth (suc zero) point (singleDirection direction)

LocallyAgreeE :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  Predicate E ->
  (E -> E) ->
  (E -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
LocallyAgreeE {R} {reals = reals} space domain f g point =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          domain y ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y point) radius ->
          f y == g y))

LocallyAgreeVector :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {n : Nat} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  Predicate E ->
  (E -> Vector R n) ->
  (E -> Vector R n) ->
  E ->
  Set
LocallyAgreeVector {R} {reals = reals} space domain f g point =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          domain y ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y point) radius ->
          VectorEqual (f y) (g y)))

record ModelWithCorners
  {R E H : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (topologyH : TopologicalSpace H) : Set2 where
  field
    carrier : Predicate E
    toModel : H -> E
    fromModel : E -> H
    toModel-in-carrier :
      (x : H) ->
      carrier (toModel x)
    from-to-model :
      (x : H) ->
      fromModel (toModel x) == x
    to-from-model :
      (x : E) ->
      carrier x ->
      toModel (fromModel x) == x
    carrier-convex :
      (x y : E) ->
      carrier x ->
      carrier y ->
      (t : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) t ->
      lessOrEqualR reals t (oneR reals) ->
      carrier
        (addE space
          (scaleE space t x)
          (scaleE space
            (addR reals (oneR reals) (negateR reals t))
            y))
    carrier-interior-nonempty :
      Exists E
        (\ center ->
          Both
            (carrier center)
            (Exists R
              (\ radius ->
                Both
                  (Positive reals radius)
                  ((point : E) ->
                    StrictLess reals
                      (distanceE space point center)
                      radius ->
                    carrier point))))
    model-topology :
      (U : Predicate H) ->
      MixedIff
        (Open topologyH U)
        (RelativelyOpen space carrier
          (\ x -> Both (carrier x) (U (fromModel x))))
    unique-differentialE :
      (f g : E -> E) ->
      (smoothF : SmoothFunctionE reals space f) ->
      (smoothG : SmoothFunctionE reals space g) ->
      (point : E) ->
      carrier point ->
      LocallyAgreeE space carrier f g point ->
      (direction : E) ->
      firstDerivativeE smoothF point direction ==
      firstDerivativeE smoothG point direction
    unique-differentialVector :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (f g : E -> Vector R n) ->
      (smoothF : SmoothFunctionVector reals space f) ->
      (smoothG : SmoothFunctionVector reals space g) ->
      (point : E) ->
      carrier point ->
      LocallyAgreeVector space carrier f g point ->
      (direction : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (firstDerivativeVector smoothF point direction)
        (firstDerivativeVector smoothG point direction)

open ModelWithCorners

record ChartedSpace
  {H M : Set}
  (topologyH : TopologicalSpace H)
  (topologyM : TopologicalSpace M) : Set2 where
  field
    Chart : Set
    source : Chart -> Predicate M
    target : Chart -> Predicate H
    toChart : Chart -> M -> H
    fromChart : Chart -> H -> M
    source-open :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      Open topologyM (source chart)
    target-open :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      Open topologyH (target chart)
    chart-cover :
      (x : M) ->
      Exists Chart (\ chart -> source chart x)
    toChart-in-target :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      (x : M) ->
      source chart x ->
      target chart (toChart chart x)
    fromChart-in-source :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      (x : H) ->
      target chart x ->
      source chart (fromChart chart x)
    from-to-chart :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      (x : M) ->
      source chart x ->
      fromChart chart (toChart chart x) == x
    to-from-chart :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      (x : H) ->
      target chart x ->
      toChart chart (fromChart chart x) == x
    toChart-continuous :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      (U : Predicate H) ->
      Open topologyH U ->
      Open topologyM
        (\ x -> Both (source chart x) (U (toChart chart x)))
    fromChart-continuous :
      (chart : Chart) ->
      (U : Predicate M) ->
      Open topologyM U ->
      Open topologyH
        (\ x -> Both (target chart x) (U (fromChart chart x)))

open ChartedSpace

record LocalSmoothExtensionE
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (domain : Predicate E)
  (f : E -> E)
  (point : E) : Set1 where
  field
    local-extension :
      E -> E
    local-extension-smooth :
      SmoothFunctionE reals space local-extension
    local-extension-agrees :
      LocallyAgreeE space domain local-extension f point

SmoothOnCorner :
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  Predicate E ->
  (E -> E) ->
  Set1
SmoothOnCorner space domain f =
  (point : _) ->
  domain point ->
  LocalSmoothExtensionE space domain f point

transitionDomain :
  {R E H M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals}
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM) ->
  Chart charts ->
  Chart charts ->
  Predicate E
transitionDomain model charts firstChart secondChart x =
  Both
    (carrier model x)
    (Both
      (target charts firstChart (fromModel model x))
      (source charts secondChart
        (fromChart charts firstChart (fromModel model x))))

transitionMap :
  {R E H M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals}
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM) ->
  Chart charts ->
  Chart charts ->
  E ->
  E
transitionMap model charts firstChart secondChart x =
  toModel model
    (toChart charts secondChart
      (fromChart charts firstChart (fromModel model x)))

record SmoothManifold
  {R E H M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM) : Set2 where
  field
    smooth-transition :
      (firstChart secondChart : Chart charts) ->
      SmoothOnCorner space
        (transitionDomain model charts firstChart secondChart)
        (transitionMap model charts firstChart secondChart)

chartDomain :
  {R E H M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals}
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM) ->
  Chart charts ->
  Predicate E
chartDomain model charts chart x =
  Both
    (carrier model x)
    (target charts chart (fromModel model x))

record LocalSmoothRepresentative
  {R E H M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM)
  {n : Nat}
  (f : M -> Vector R n)
  (point : M) : Set2 where
  field
    local-chart :
      Chart charts
    point-in-source :
      source charts local-chart point
    extension :
      E -> Vector R n
    smooth-extension :
      SmoothFunctionVector reals space extension
    agrees-in-chart :
      LocallyAgreeVector space
        (chartDomain model charts local-chart)
        extension
        (\ x ->
          f (fromChart charts local-chart (fromModel model x)))
        (toModel model (toChart charts local-chart point))

open LocalSmoothRepresentative

localDifferential :
  {R E H M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals}
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  {model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH}
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  {charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM}
  {n : Nat}
  {f : M -> Vector R n}
  {point : M} ->
  LocalSmoothRepresentative reals space model charts f point ->
  E ->
  Vector R n
localDifferential
  {model = model}
  {charts = charts}
  {point = point}
  representative =
  firstDerivativeVector
    (smooth-extension representative)
    (toModel model
      (toChart charts (local-chart representative) point))

Injective :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
Injective f =
  (x y : _) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

InjectiveVectorMap :
  {A R : Set}
  {n : Nat} ->
  (A -> Vector R n) ->
  Set
InjectiveVectorMap f =
  (x y : _) ->
  VectorEqual (f x) (f y) ->
  x == y

record SmoothImmersionAt
  {R E H M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM)
  {n : Nat}
  (f : M -> Vector R n)
  (point : M) : Set2 where
  field
    representative :
      LocalSmoothRepresentative reals space model charts f point
    differential-injective :
      InjectiveVectorMap (localDifferential representative)

ContinuousToEuclidean :
  {R M : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (topologyM : TopologicalSpace M) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (M -> Vector R n) ->
  Set1
ContinuousToEuclidean reals topologyM {n} f =
  (U : Predicate (Vector _ n)) ->
  VectorOpen reals n U ->
  Open topologyM (\ x -> U (f x))

record InducedOpenWitness
  {R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  {n : Nat}
  (f : M -> Vector R n)
  (U : Predicate M) : Set1 where
  field
    ambient-open-set :
      Predicate (Vector R n)
    ambient-is-open :
      VectorOpen reals n ambient-open-set
    preimage-characterization :
      (x : M) ->
      Iff (U x) (ambient-open-set (f x))

record InducesTopology
  {R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (topologyM : TopologicalSpace M)
  {n : Nat}
  (f : M -> Vector R n) : Set2 where
  field
    open-has-ambient-witness :
      (U : Predicate M) ->
      Open topologyM U ->
      InducedOpenWitness reals f U
    ambient-witness-is-open :
      (U : Predicate M) ->
      InducedOpenWitness reals f U ->
      Open topologyM U

ClosedRange :
  {R M : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (M -> Vector R n) ->
  Set
ClosedRange {M = M} reals {n} f =
  VectorOpen reals n
    (\ y ->
      Not (Exists M (\ x -> VectorEqual (f x) y)))

record ClosedEmbedding
  {R M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (topologyM : TopologicalSpace M)
  {n : Nat}
  (f : M -> Vector R n) : Set2 where
  field
    embedding-injective :
      InjectiveVectorMap f
    embedding-continuous :
      ContinuousToEuclidean reals topologyM f
    embedding-induces-topology :
      InducesTopology reals topologyM f
    embedding-range-closed :
      ClosedRange reals f

record WhitneyEmbeddingExists
  {R E H M : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {topologyH : TopologicalSpace H}
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH)
  {topologyM : TopologicalSpace M}
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM) : Set2 where
  field
    euclidean-dimension :
      Nat
    embedding :
      M -> Vector R euclidean-dimension
    closed-embedding :
      ClosedEmbedding reals topologyM embedding
    smooth-with-injective-differential :
      (x : M) ->
      SmoothImmersionAt reals space model charts embedding x

whitney-embedding-theorem : Set2
whitney-embedding-theorem =
  (R E H M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  FiniteDimensional reals space ->
  (topologyH : TopologicalSpace H) ->
  (model : ModelWithCorners reals space topologyH) ->
  (topologyM : TopologicalSpace M) ->
  (charts : ChartedSpace topologyH topologyM) ->
  SmoothManifold reals space model charts ->
  Hausdorff topologyM ->
  Compact topologyM ->
  WhitneyEmbeddingExists reals space model charts

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1306095, "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth
  finite-dimensional real manifold admits a smooth closed embedding into
  some finite-dimensional Euclidean space, with injective derivative
  everywhere. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open topologyTheory;

val q1306095_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q1306095_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1306095_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_lincomb_def",
  ``q1306095_lincomb
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) (coeff : num -> real) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. add acc (smul (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
        zero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q1306095_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_basis_def",
  ``q1306095_basis
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) <=>
      (!coeff : num -> real.
        q1306095_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = zero
        ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = 0) /\
      (!x : 'e.
        ?coeff : num -> real.
          q1306095_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = x)``);

val q1306095_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q1306095_finite_dimensional
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) <=>
      ?basis : 'e list. q1306095_basis zero add smul basis``);

val q1306095_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_linear_def",
  ``q1306095_linear
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f) (L : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      L zeroE = zeroF /\
      (!x y. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
      (!a x. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x))``);

val q1306095_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_open_def",
  ``q1306095_open
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : 'e set) <=>
      !x. x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q1306095_has_derivative_within_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_has_derivative_within_def",
  ``q1306095_has_derivative_within
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (negF : 'f -> 'f) (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (s : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'f) (x : 'e) (L : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      q1306095_linear zeroE addE smulE zeroF addF smulF L /\
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y.
            y IN s /\
            0 < normE (addE y (negE x)) /\
            normE (addE y (negE x)) < delta
            ==>
            normF
              (addF
                (addF (f y) (negF (f x)))
                (negF (L (addE y (negE x))))) <=
              epsilon * normE (addE y (negE x))``);

val q1306095_unique_diff_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_unique_diff_on_def",
  ``q1306095_unique_diff_on
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (s : 'e set) <=>
      !x L.
        x IN s /\
        q1306095_linear zero add smul 0 $+ $* L /\
        (!epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              y IN s /\
              0 < norm (add y (neg x)) /\
              norm (add y (neg x)) < delta
              ==>
              abs (L (add y (neg x))) <=
                epsilon * norm (add y (neg x)))
        ==>
        !v. L v = 0``);

val q1306095_convex_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_convex_def",
  ``q1306095_convex
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (s : 'e set) <=>
      !x y t.
        x IN s /\ y IN s /\ 0 <= t /\ t <= 1
        ==>
        add (smul t x) (smul (1 - t) y) IN s``);

val q1306095_nonempty_interior_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_nonempty_interior_def",
  ``q1306095_nonempty_interior
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (s : 'e set) <=>
      ?x epsilon.
        x IN s /\
        0 < epsilon /\
        !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q1306095_multilinear_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_multilinear_def",
  ``q1306095_multilinear
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f)
      k (A : 'e list -> 'f) <=>
      !args i.
        LENGTH args = k /\ i < k
        ==>
        A (LUPDATE zeroE i args) = zeroF /\
        (!u v.
          A (LUPDATE (addE u v) i args) =
            addF
              (A (LUPDATE u i args))
              (A (LUPDATE v i args))) /\
        (!a u.
          A (LUPDATE (smulE a u) i args) =
            smulF a (A (LUPDATE u i args)))``);

val q1306095_has_smooth_jet_within_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_has_smooth_jet_within_def",
  ``q1306095_has_smooth_jet_within
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (negF : 'f -> 'f) (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (s : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'f)
      (J : num -> 'e -> 'e list -> 'f) <=>
      (!x. x IN s ==> J 0 x [] = f x) /\
      (!k x.
        x IN s ==>
        q1306095_multilinear
          zeroE addE smulE zeroF addF smulF k (J k x)) /\
      (!k x args.
        x IN s /\ LENGTH args = k
        ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              y IN s /\
              0 < normE (addE y (negE x)) /\
              normE (addE y (negE x)) < delta
              ==>
              normF
                (addF
                  (addF (J k y args) (negF (J k x args)))
                  (negF
                    (J (SUC k) x
                      ((addE y (negE x))::args)))) <=
                epsilon *
                normE (addE y (negE x)) *
                FOLDL (\p r. p * r) 1 (MAP normE args))``);

val q1306095_smooth_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_smooth_on_def",
  ``q1306095_smooth_on
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (negF : 'f -> 'f) (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (s : 'e set) (f : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      ?J : num -> 'e -> 'e list -> 'f.
        q1306095_has_smooth_jet_within
          zeroE addE negE smulE normE
          zeroF addF negF smulF normF s f J``);

val q1306095_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_compact_def",
  ``q1306095_compact (top : 'm topology) (carrier : 'm set) <=>
      !cover : ('m set) set.
        (!u. u IN cover ==> open_in top u) /\
        carrier SUBSET UNIONS cover
        ==>
        ?subcover.
          FINITE subcover /\
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          carrier SUBSET UNIONS subcover``);

val q1306095_hausdorff_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_hausdorff_def",
  ``q1306095_hausdorff (top : 'm topology) (carrier : 'm set) <=>
      !x y.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ x <> y
        ==>
        ?u v.
          open_in top u /\ open_in top v /\
          x IN u /\ y IN v /\ DISJOINT u v``);

val q1306095_charted_manifold_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_charted_manifold_def",
  ``q1306095_charted_manifold
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (corner : 'e set)
      (top : 'm topology) (carrier : 'm set)
      (charts : 'c set)
      (source : 'c -> 'm set) (target : 'c -> 'e set)
      (chart : 'c -> 'm -> 'e) (chart_inv : 'c -> 'e -> 'm) <=>
      topspace top = carrier /\
      q1306095_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q1306095_finite_dimensional zero add smul /\
      q1306095_convex add smul corner /\
      q1306095_nonempty_interior add neg norm corner /\
      q1306095_unique_diff_on zero add neg smul norm corner /\
      q1306095_compact top carrier /\
      q1306095_hausdorff top carrier /\
      (!c. c IN charts ==> open_in top (source c)) /\
      carrier = UNIONS (IMAGE source charts) /\
      (!c. c IN charts ==>
        source c SUBSET carrier /\
        (?u.
          q1306095_open add neg norm u /\
          target c = corner INTER u) /\
        (!x. x IN source c ==>
          chart c x IN target c /\ chart_inv c (chart c x) = x) /\
        (!z. z IN target c ==>
          chart_inv c z IN source c /\ chart c (chart_inv c z) = z) /\
        (!u.
          q1306095_open add neg norm u ==>
          open_in top
            {x | x IN source c /\ chart c x IN u}) /\
        (!u.
          open_in top u ==>
          ?v.
            q1306095_open add neg norm v /\
            {z | z IN target c /\ chart_inv c z IN u} =
              target c INTER v)) /\
      (!a b.
        a IN charts /\ b IN charts ==>
        q1306095_smooth_on
          zero add neg smul norm zero add neg smul norm
          {z | z IN target a /\ chart_inv a z IN source b}
          (\z. chart b (chart_inv a z)))``);

val q1306095_euclidean_active_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_euclidean_active_def",
  ``q1306095_euclidean_active n (x : num -> real) <=>
      !i. n <= i ==> x i = 0``);

val q1306095_euclidean_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_euclidean_norm_def",
  ``q1306095_euclidean_norm n (x : num -> real) =
      sqrt (SIGMA (\i. x i * x i) (count n))``);

val q1306095_euclidean_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_euclidean_open_def",
  ``q1306095_euclidean_open n (u : (num -> real) set) <=>
      u SUBSET {x | q1306095_euclidean_active n x} /\
      !x. x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            q1306095_euclidean_active n y /\
            q1306095_euclidean_norm n (\i. y i - x i) < epsilon
            ==>
            y IN u``);

val q1306095_euclidean_closed_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_euclidean_closed_def",
  ``q1306095_euclidean_closed n (s : (num -> real) set) <=>
      s SUBSET {x | q1306095_euclidean_active n x} /\
      q1306095_euclidean_open n
        ({x | q1306095_euclidean_active n x} DIFF s)``);

val q1306095_smooth_manifold_map_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_smooth_manifold_map_def",
  ``q1306095_smooth_manifold_map
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (carrier : 'm set)
      (charts : 'c set) (target : 'c -> 'e set)
      (chart_inv : 'c -> 'e -> 'm)
      n (f : 'm -> num -> real) <=>
      (!x. x IN carrier ==> q1306095_euclidean_active n (f x)) /\
      !c. c IN charts ==>
        q1306095_smooth_on
          zero add neg smul norm
          (\i. 0) (\x y i. x i + y i) (\x i. -x i)
          (\a x i. a * x i) (q1306095_euclidean_norm n)
          (target c) (\z. f (chart_inv c z))``);

val q1306095_closed_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_closed_embedding_def",
  ``q1306095_closed_embedding
      (top : 'm topology) (carrier : 'm set)
      n (f : 'm -> num -> real) <=>
      (!x. x IN carrier ==> q1306095_euclidean_active n (f x)) /\
      (!x y. x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
      (!u.
        q1306095_euclidean_open n u ==>
        open_in top {x | x IN carrier /\ f x IN u}) /\
      q1306095_euclidean_closed n (IMAGE f carrier)``);

val q1306095_injective_mfderiv_def = new_definition (
  "q1306095_injective_mfderiv_def",
  ``q1306095_injective_mfderiv
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (carrier : 'm set) (charts : 'c set)
      (source : 'c -> 'm set) (target : 'c -> 'e set)
      (chart : 'c -> 'm -> 'e) (chart_inv : 'c -> 'e -> 'm)
      n (f : 'm -> num -> real) <=>
      !x.
        x IN carrier ==>
        ?c.
          c IN charts /\ x IN source c /\
          (?L.
            (!v. q1306095_euclidean_active n (L v)) /\
            q1306095_has_derivative_within
              zero add neg smul norm
              (\i. 0) (\u v i. u i + v i) (\u i. -u i)
              (\a u i. a * u i) (q1306095_euclidean_norm n)
              (target c) (\z. f (chart_inv c z)) (chart c x) L) /\
          (!L.
            (!v. q1306095_euclidean_active n (L v)) /\
            q1306095_has_derivative_within
              zero add neg smul norm
              (\i. 0) (\u v i. u i + v i) (\u i. -u i)
              (\a u i. a * u i) (q1306095_euclidean_norm n)
              (target c) (\z. f (chart_inv c z)) (chart c x) L
            ==>
            !u v. L u = L v ==> u = v)``);

val exists_embedding_euclidean_of_compact =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (corner : 'e set)
      (top : 'm topology) (carrier : 'm set)
      (charts : 'c set)
      (source : 'c -> 'm set) (target : 'c -> 'e set)
      (chart : 'c -> 'm -> 'e) (chart_inv : 'c -> 'e -> 'm).
      q1306095_charted_manifold
        zero add neg smul norm corner top carrier
        charts source target chart chart_inv
      ==>
      ?n (f : 'm -> num -> real).
        q1306095_smooth_manifold_map
          zero add neg smul norm carrier charts target chart_inv n f /\
        q1306095_closed_embedding top carrier n f /\
        q1306095_injective_mfderiv
          zero add neg smul norm carrier charts source target chart chart_inv n f``;

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1306095
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1306095), "Whitney embedding theorem":
  every compact Hausdorff smooth finite-dimensional real manifold modeled
  with corners on a convex coordinate range with nonempty interior admits a
  smooth closed embedding into some finite-dimensional Euclidean space whose
  manifold derivative is injective everywhere. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Finite-dimensional real normed model spaces are normalized by a linear
  coordinate equivalence to Q1306095Vec d, the real functions on 1 ... d.
  Q1306095Eucl d and Q1306095Norm d are its Euclidean topology and norm.

  Q1306095HasFDerivWithin gives the epsilon-delta definition of a Frechet
  derivative using only points of the subset S. A linear map is represented
  by its d columns in R^m. Q1306095Model is the coordinate-normalized range
  of the source's real ModelWithCorners: a convex subset of the model vector
  space with nonempty Euclidean interior. The source model map and its
  continuous total inverse identify the arbitrary model type homeomorphically
  with this range, so transporting charts to the range is bidirectionally
  equivalent rather than a restriction. These conditions give the unique
  differentiability used by manifold derivatives.

  Q1306095JetWithin is the finite-coordinate form of ContDiffWithin infinity:
  it records all iterated within-set Frechet derivatives and requires each
  derivative field to be continuous in the subspace topology. This is an
  intrinsic definition on the model range and never asks for a smooth
  extension to the ambient space.

  An atlas consists of genuine homeomorphisms from open subsets of the
  arbitrary carrier topology to relatively open subsets of the model range,
  covers the carrier, and has intrinsically smooth transition maps. The
  conclusion keeps the Euclidean dimension and embedding internally
  existential. Q1306095ClosedEmbedding is a homeomorphism onto a closed
  image. Q1306095Immersion requires the unique first within-set derivative of
  each chart-coordinate representative to be injective on the full model
  vector space, exactly expressing injectivity of mfderiv.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement. This database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1306095Vec Q1306095Eucl Q1306095Norm Q1306095Diff
   Q1306095LinApply Q1306095One Q1306095Snoc Q1306095Deriv
   Q1306095HasFDerivWithin Q1306095JetWithin Q1306095CInfWithin
   Q1306095Model Q1306095Dom Q1306095Img Q1306095Map Q1306095Chart
   Q1306095Overlap Q1306095Transition Q1306095Manifold
   Q1306095SmoothMap Q1306095Jac Q1306095ClosedEmbedding
   Q1306095Immersion $.

q1306095-vec-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Vec d ) $.
q1306095-eucl-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Eucl d ) $.
q1306095-norm-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Norm d x ) $.
q1306095-diff-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Diff d x y ) $.
q1306095-lin-apply-syntax
  $a class ( Q1306095LinApply d m L v ) $.
q1306095-one-syntax $a class ( Q1306095One i ) $.
q1306095-snoc-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Snoc q r i ) $.
q1306095-deriv-syntax
  $a class ( Q1306095Deriv d D r q x ) $.
q1306095-has-fderiv-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1306095HasFDerivWithin d m S F x L ) $.
q1306095-jet-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1306095JetWithin d m S F D ) $.
q1306095-cinf-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1306095CInfWithin d m S F ) $.
q1306095-model-syntax $a wff ( Q1306095Model d H ) $.
q1306095-dom-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Dom c ) $.
q1306095-img-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Img c ) $.
q1306095-map-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Map c ) $.
q1306095-chart-syntax $a wff ( Q1306095Chart d H J c ) $.
q1306095-overlap-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Overlap c k ) $.
q1306095-transition-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Transition c k ) $.
q1306095-manifold-syntax $a wff ( Q1306095Manifold X J d H A ) $.
q1306095-smooth-map-syntax $a wff ( Q1306095SmoothMap X d n A e ) $.
q1306095-jac-syntax $a class ( Q1306095Jac d n D y v ) $.
q1306095-closed-embedding-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1306095ClosedEmbedding n J e ) $.
q1306095-immersion-syntax $a wff ( Q1306095Immersion d n A e ) $.

q1306095-vec-definition $a |-
  ( Q1306095Vec d ) = ( RR ^m ( 1 ... d ) ) $.

q1306095-eucl-definition $a |-
  ( Q1306095Eucl d ) =
  (
    Xt_ `
    ( ( 1 ... d ) X. { ( topGen ` ran (,) ) } )
  ) $.

${
  $d d i x $.

  q1306095-norm-definition $a |-
    ( Q1306095Norm d x ) =
    (
      sqrt `
      (
        sum_ i e. ( 1 ... d )
          ( ( x ` i ) ^ 2 )
      )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d d i x y $.

  q1306095-diff-definition $a |-
    ( Q1306095Diff d x y ) =
    (
      i e. ( 1 ... d ) |->
      ( ( x ` i ) - ( y ` i ) )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d L d i j m v $.

  q1306095-lin-apply-definition $a |-
    ( Q1306095LinApply d m L v ) =
    (
      j e. ( 1 ... m ) |->
      sum_ i e. ( 1 ... d )
        (
          ( ( ( L ` i ) ` j ) )
          x.
          ( v ` i )
        )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d k i $.

  q1306095-one-definition $a |-
    ( Q1306095One i ) =
    ( k e. { 1 } |-> i ) $.
$}

${
  $d k i q r $.

  q1306095-snoc-definition $a |-
    ( Q1306095Snoc q r i ) =
    (
      k e. ( 1 ... ( r + 1 ) ) |->
      if ( k = ( r + 1 ) , i , ( q ` k ) )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d D d i q r x $.

  q1306095-deriv-definition $a |-
    ( Q1306095Deriv d D r q x ) =
    (
      i e. ( 1 ... d ) |->
      (
        (
          D `
          <.
            ( r + 1 ) ,
            ( Q1306095Snoc q r i )
          >.
        )
        ` x
      )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L S d i j m t u x y $.

  q1306095-has-fderiv-within-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1306095HasFDerivWithin d m S F x L )
    <->
    (
      (
        S C_ ( Q1306095Vec d )
        /\
        (
          F : S --> ( Q1306095Vec m )
          /\
          (
            x e. S
            /\
            L : ( 1 ... d ) --> ( Q1306095Vec m )
          )
        )
      )
      /\
      A. u e. RR+
        E. t e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              (
                ( Q1306095Norm d
                    ( Q1306095Diff d y x ) )
                <
                t
              )
              ->
              (
                ( Q1306095Norm m
                    (
                      Q1306095Diff m
                        ( F ` y )
                        (
                          j e. ( 1 ... m ) |->
                          (
                            ( ( F ` x ) ` j )
                            +
                            (
                              (
                                Q1306095LinApply d m L
                                  ( Q1306095Diff d y x )
                              )
                              ` j
                            )
                          )
