title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1306095,
:: "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth manifold
:: modeled with corners on a finite-dimensional real normed space admits a
:: smooth closed embedding into some Euclidean space whose manifold derivative
:: is injective at every point. This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, CARD_3, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, REAL_1,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, COMPLEX1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, BINOP_1, NAT_1,
    STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC,
    TOPS_1, TOPS_2, T_0TOPSP, COMPTS_1, RCOMP_1, METRIC_1, EUCLID,
    ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, REAL_NS1,
    LOPBAN_1, FDIFF_1, FCONT_1, NDIFF_6, ASYMPT_0, CONVEX1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, CARD_3, NUMBERS,
    XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    BINOP_1, NAT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, TOPS_2,
    T_0TOPSP, COMPTS_1, METRIC_1, EUCLID, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, VFUNCT_1,
    NORMSP_0, VECTSP_1, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, REAL_NS1, LOPBAN_1, NDIFF_1,
    NDIFF_6, CONVEX1;
  constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_3, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, VFUNCT_1,
    BINOP_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, TOPS_1, TOPS_2,
    T_0TOPSP, COMPTS_1, EUCLID, RLVECT_5, REAL_NS1, NORMSP_2, LOPBAN_1,
    NDIFF_1, NDIFF_6, CONVEX1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    ORDINAL1, CARD_1, CARD_3, NUMBERS, NAT_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1,
    COMPTS_1, EUCLID, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, XREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, NORMSP_1, NORMSP_2, REAL_NS1, REAL_NS2, LOPBAN_1;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, TOPS_2;
  equalities XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, STRUCT_0, NORMSP_0;
  expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, TOPS_2;

begin

definition
  let E,F be RealNormSpace;
  let f be PartFunc of E,F;
  let L be Lipschitzian LinearOperator of E,F;
  let S be Subset of E;
  let x be Point of E;
  pred f,L is_differentiable_in S,x means
    x in S & S c= dom f &
    for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta &
        for y being Point of E st
          y in S & ||.y-x.|| < delta
        holds
          ||.f/.y-(f/.x+L.(y-x)).||
              <= epsilon * ||.y-x.||;
end;

definition
  let E,F be RealNormSpace;
  let f be PartFunc of E,F;
  let S be Subset of E;
  let x be Point of E;
  pred f is_smooth_wrt S,x means
    x in S & S c= dom f &
    for k being Nat holds
      ex W being open Subset of TopSpaceNorm E,
         D being Function st
        x in W &
        dom D = NAT &
        (for i being Nat st i <= k+1 holds
          ex Di being PartFunc of E,diff_SP(i,E,F) st
            Di = D.i & S /\ W c= dom Di) &
        (ex D0 being PartFunc of E,F st
          D0 = D.0 &
          for y being Point of E st y in S /\ W holds
            D0/.y = f/.y) &
        for i being Nat st i <= k holds
          ex Di being PartFunc of E,diff_SP(i,E,F),
             Dip being PartFunc of E,
               R_NormSpace_of_BoundedLinearOperators
                 (E,diff_SP(i,E,F)) st
            Di = D.i &
            Dip = D.(i+1) &
            for a being Point of E st a in S /\ W holds
              ex L being Lipschitzian LinearOperator of
                E,diff_SP(i,E,F) st
                L = Dip/.a &
                S /\ W c= dom Di &
                for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
                  ex delta being Real st
                    0 < delta &
                    for y being Point of E st
                      y in S /\ W & ||.y-a.|| < delta
                    holds
                      ||.Di/.y-(Di/.a+L.(y-a)).||
                        <= epsilon * ||.y-a.||;
end;

::$P-
theorem
  for E being finite-dimensional RealNormSpace,
      H being non empty TopSpace,
      M being compact T_2 TopSpace,
      R being Subset of E,
      Rt being Subset of TopSpaceNorm E,
      i being Function of H,TopSpaceNorm E,
      j being Function of TopSpaceNorm E,H,
      im being Function of H,(TopSpaceNorm E) | Rt,
      A being Subset of
        PFuncs(the carrier of M,the carrier of H),
      C being Function of the carrier of M,
        PFuncs(the carrier of M,the carrier of H) st
    Rt = R &
    R = rng i &
    im = i &
    im is being_homeomorphism &
    R is convex &
    (ex J being open Subset of TopSpaceNorm E st
      J <> {} & J c= R) &
    (for P being Subset of H st P is closed holds j" P is closed) &
    (for h being object st h in the carrier of H holds
      j.(i.h) = h) &
    (for x being Point of E st x in R holds
      i.(j.x) = x) &
    (for c being PartFunc of the carrier of M,the carrier of H st
        c in A holds
      ex U being open Subset of M,
         V being open Subset of H,
         h being Function of M|U,H|V st
        U = dom c &
        V = rng c &
        h = c &
        h is being_homeomorphism) &
    (for p being object st p in the carrier of M holds
      ex c being PartFunc of the carrier of M,the carrier of H st
        c = C.p & c in A & p in dom c) &
    (for c,d being PartFunc of the carrier of M,the carrier of H st
        c in A & d in A holds
      ex S being Subset of E,
         T being PartFunc of E,E,
         U being Subset of E,
         G being PartFunc of E,E st
        S = {z where z is Point of E :
          ex y being object st
            y in dom c /\ dom d & z = i.(c.y)} &
        dom T = S &
        (for y being object st y in dom c /\ dom d holds
          T/.(i.(c.y)) = i.(d.y)) &
        (for z being Point of E st z in S holds
          T is_smooth_wrt S,z) &
        U = {z where z is Point of E :
          ex y being object st
            y in dom c /\ dom d & z = i.(d.y)} &
        dom G = U &
        (for y being object st y in dom c /\ dom d holds
          G/.(i.(d.y)) = i.(c.y)) &
        for z being Point of E st z in U holds
          G is_smooth_wrt U,z)
  holds
    ex n being Nat,
       e being Function of M,TOP-REAL n,
       Q being closed Subset of TOP-REAL n,
       emb being Function of M,(TOP-REAL n)|Q st
      Q = rng e &
      emb = e &
      emb is being_homeomorphism &
      for p being object st p in the carrier of M holds
        ex c being PartFunc of the carrier of M,the carrier of H,
           S being Subset of E,
           z being Point of E,
           F being PartFunc of E,REAL-NS n,
           L being Lipschitzian LinearOperator of E,REAL-NS n st
          c = C.p &
          S = {w where w is Point of E :
            ex y being object st y in dom c & w = i.(c.y)} &
          z = i.(c.p) &
          dom F = S &
          (for y being object st y in dom c holds
            F/.(i.(c.y)) = e.y) &
          F is_smooth_wrt S,z &
          F,L is_differentiable_in S,z &
          L is one-to-one
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1306095_whitney_embedding_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1306095,
% "Whitney embedding theorem": every compact Hausdorff smooth
% finite-dimensional real manifold admits a smooth closed embedding into
% some finite-dimensional Euclidean space with injective canonical manifold
% derivative everywhere. This file contains no proof.

whitney_embedding_theorem_Q1306095[
  Point: TYPE+,
  Chart: TYPE+,
  carrier: [Point -> bool],
  open_sets: [[Point -> bool] -> bool],
  model_dimension: nat,
  model_range: [[nat -> real] -> bool],
  atlas: [Chart -> bool],
  chart_source: [Chart -> [Point -> bool]],
  chart_target: [Chart -> [[nat -> real] -> bool]],
  chart_forward: [Chart, Point -> [nat -> real]],
  chart_inverse: [Chart, [nat -> real] -> Point],
  preferred_chart: [Point -> Chart]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> vector]
  vector_set: TYPE = [vector -> bool]
  point_set: TYPE = [Point -> bool]
  point_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  vector_function: TYPE = [vector -> vector]
  multilinear_candidate: TYPE = [vector_sequence -> vector]
  jet_field: TYPE = [nat, vector -> multilinear_candidate]
  embedding_function: TYPE = [Point -> vector]

  zero_vector: vector =
    LAMBDA (i: nat): 0

  vector_add(u, v: vector): vector =
    LAMBDA (i: nat): u(i) + v(i)

  vector_subtract(u, v: vector): vector =
    LAMBDA (i: nat): u(i) - v(i)

  vector_scale(a: real, v: vector): vector =
    LAMBDA (i: nat): a * v(i)

  supported(v: vector, dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      dimension <= i IMPLIES v(i) = 0

  squared_norm(v: vector, dimension: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF dimension = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      squared_norm(v, dimension - 1) + v(dimension - 1) ^ 2
    ENDIF
  MEASURE dimension

  squared_distance(u, v: vector, dimension: nat): real =
    squared_norm(vector_subtract(u, v), dimension)

  linear_map(
      source_dimension, target_dimension: nat,
      candidate: vector_function): bool =
    (FORALL (u: vector):
      supported(u, source_dimension)
        IMPLIES supported(candidate(u), target_dimension))
      AND
        (FORALL (u, v: vector):
          (supported(u, source_dimension)
            AND supported(v, source_dimension))
          IMPLIES
            candidate(vector_add(u, v))
              = vector_add(candidate(u), candidate(v)))
      AND
        (FORALL (scalar: real), (u: vector):
          supported(u, source_dimension)
            IMPLIES
              candidate(vector_scale(scalar, u))
                = vector_scale(scalar, candidate(u)))
      AND
        EXISTS (bound: real):
          0 <= bound
            AND FORALL (u: vector):
              supported(u, source_dimension)
                IMPLIES
                  squared_norm(candidate(u), target_dimension)
                    <= bound ^ 2
                      * squared_norm(u, source_dimension)

  same_linear_map_on_model(
      left, right: vector_function,
      source_dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (u: vector):
      supported(u, source_dimension)
        IMPLIES left(u) = right(u)

  has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
      function_value: vector_function,
      domain: vector_set,
      source_dimension, target_dimension: nat,
      center: vector,
      derivative: vector_function): bool =
    domain(center)
      AND supported(center, source_dimension)
      AND supported(function_value(center), target_dimension)
      AND linear_map(
            source_dimension,
            target_dimension,
            derivative)
      AND
        FORALL (epsilon: real):
          0 < epsilon IMPLIES
            EXISTS (delta: real):
              0 < delta
                AND FORALL (nearby: vector):
                  (domain(nearby)
                    AND squared_distance(
                          nearby,
                          center,
                          source_dimension)
                        < delta ^ 2)
                  IMPLIES
                    squared_norm(
                      vector_subtract(
                        vector_subtract(
                          function_value(nearby),
                          function_value(center)),
                        derivative(
                          vector_subtract(nearby, center))),
                      target_dimension)
                      <=
                        epsilon ^ 2
                          * squared_distance(
                              nearby,
                              center,
                              source_dimension)

  unique_differentiability_on(
      domain: vector_set,
      source_dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL
        (target_dimension: nat),
        (function_value: vector_function),
        (center: vector),
        (left, right: vector_function):
      (domain(center)
        AND has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
              function_value,
              domain,
              source_dimension,
              target_dimension,
              center,
              left)
        AND has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
              function_value,
              domain,
              source_dimension,
              target_dimension,
              center,
              right))
      IMPLIES
        same_linear_map_on_model(
          left,
          right,
          source_dimension)

  repeat_vector(v: vector): vector_sequence =
    LAMBDA (i: nat): v

  first_derivative(
      jets: jet_field,
      center: vector): vector_function =
    LAMBDA (u: vector):
      jets(1, center)(repeat_vector(u))

  replace_vector(
      values: vector_sequence,
      index: nat,
      value: vector): vector_sequence =
    LAMBDA (i: nat):
      IF i = index THEN value ELSE values(i) ENDIF

  valid_arguments(
      values: vector_sequence,
      count, dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < count IMPLIES supported(values(i), dimension)

  same_prefix(
      left, right: vector_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < count IMPLIES left(i) = right(i)

  squared_norm_product(
      values: vector_sequence,
      count, dimension: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      squared_norm_product(values, count - 1, dimension)
        * squared_norm(values(count - 1), dimension)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  factorial(count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      count * factorial(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  safe_divide(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  multilinear_map(
      order, source_dimension, target_dimension: nat,
      candidate: multilinear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (values: vector_sequence):
      valid_arguments(values, order, source_dimension)
        IMPLIES supported(candidate(values), target_dimension))
      AND
        (order = 0 IMPLIES
          FORALL (left, right: vector_sequence):
            candidate(left) = candidate(right))
      AND
        (FORALL (left, right: vector_sequence):
          (valid_arguments(left, order, source_dimension)
            AND valid_arguments(right, order, source_dimension)
            AND same_prefix(left, right, order))
          IMPLIES candidate(left) = candidate(right))
      AND
        (FORALL
            (values: vector_sequence),
            (slot: nat),
            (u, v: vector):
          (slot < order
            AND valid_arguments(values, order, source_dimension)
            AND supported(u, source_dimension)
            AND supported(v, source_dimension))
          IMPLIES
            candidate(
              replace_vector(
                values,
                slot,
                vector_add(u, v)))
              =
                vector_add(
                  candidate(replace_vector(values, slot, u)),
                  candidate(replace_vector(values, slot, v))))
      AND
        (FORALL
            (values: vector_sequence),
            (slot: nat),
            (scalar: real),
            (u: vector):
          (slot < order
            AND valid_arguments(values, order, source_dimension)
            AND supported(u, source_dimension))
          IMPLIES
            candidate(
              replace_vector(
                values,
                slot,
                vector_scale(scalar, u)))
              =
                vector_scale(
                  scalar,
                  candidate(replace_vector(values, slot, u))))
      AND
        EXISTS (bound: real):
          0 <= bound
            AND FORALL (values: vector_sequence):
              valid_arguments(values, order, source_dimension)
                IMPLIES
                  squared_norm(
                    candidate(values),
                    target_dimension)
                    <=
                      bound ^ 2
                        * squared_norm_product(
                            values,
                            order,
                            source_dimension)

  taylor_sum(
      jets: jet_field,
      center, increment: vector,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE vector =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_vector
    ELSE
      vector_add(
        taylor_sum(jets, center, increment, count - 1),
        vector_scale(
          safe_divide(1, factorial(count - 1) :: real),
          jets(count - 1, center)(repeat_vector(increment))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  jet_continuous_on(
      jets: jet_field,
      domain: vector_set,
      source_dimension, target_dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL
        (order: nat),
        (center: vector),
        (values: vector_sequence):
      (domain(center)
        AND valid_arguments(values, order, source_dimension))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon: real):
          0 < epsilon IMPLIES
            EXISTS (delta: real):
              0 < delta
                AND FORALL (nearby: vector):
                  (domain(nearby)
                    AND squared_distance(
                          nearby,
                          center,
                          source_dimension)
                        < delta ^ 2)
                  IMPLIES
                    squared_norm(
                      vector_subtract(
                        jets(order, nearby)(values),
                        jets(order, center)(values)),
                      target_dimension)
                      < epsilon ^ 2

  has_smooth_taylor_jets(
      function_value: vector_function,
      domain: vector_set,
      source_dimension, target_dimension: nat,
      jets: jet_field): bool =
    (FORALL (x: vector):
      domain(x) IMPLIES
        (supported(x, source_dimension)
          AND supported(function_value(x), target_dimension)))
      AND
        (FORALL (order: nat), (x: vector):
          domain(x) IMPLIES
            multilinear_map(
              order,
              source_dimension,
              target_dimension,
              jets(order, x)))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: vector), (values: vector_sequence):
          domain(x) IMPLIES
            jets(0, x)(values) = function_value(x))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: vector):
          domain(x) IMPLIES
            has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
              function_value,
              domain,
              source_dimension,
              target_dimension,
              x,
              first_derivative(jets, x)))
      AND
        jet_continuous_on(
          jets,
          domain,
          source_dimension,
          target_dimension)
      AND
        (FORALL (order: nat), (center: vector):
          domain(center) IMPLIES
            FORALL (epsilon: real):
              0 < epsilon IMPLIES
                EXISTS (delta: real):
                  0 < delta
                    AND FORALL (nearby: vector):
                      (domain(nearby)
                        AND squared_distance(
                              nearby,
                              center,
                              source_dimension)
                            < delta ^ 2)
                      IMPLIES
                        squared_norm(
                          vector_subtract(
                            function_value(nearby),
                            taylor_sum(
                              jets,
                              center,
                              vector_subtract(nearby, center),
                              order + 1)),
                          target_dimension)
                          <=
                            epsilon ^ 2
                              * squared_distance(
                                  nearby,
                                  center,
                                  source_dimension) ^ order)

  empty_point_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Point): FALSE

  whole_carrier: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Point): carrier(x)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Point):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  point_intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Point):
      A(x) AND B(x)

  point_union(family: point_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Point):
      carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (U: point_set):
          family(U) AND U(x)

  topology_laws: bool =
    open_sets(empty_point_set)
      AND open_sets(whole_carrier)
      AND
        (FORALL (U: point_set):
          open_sets(U) IMPLIES point_subset(U, whole_carrier))
      AND
        (FORALL (U, V: point_set):
          (open_sets(U) AND open_sets(V))
            IMPLIES open_sets(point_intersection(U, V)))
      AND
        (FORALL (family: point_family):
          (FORALL (U: point_set):
            family(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
          IMPLIES open_sets(point_union(family)))

  disjoint_point_sets(U, V: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Point):
      NOT (U(x) AND V(x))

  hausdorff_carrier: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: Point):
      (carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND x /= y)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U, V: point_set):
            open_sets(U)
              AND open_sets(V)
              AND U(x)
              AND V(y)
              AND disjoint_point_sets(U, V)

  compact_carrier: bool =
    FORALL (cover: point_family):
      ((FORALL (U: point_set):
          cover(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
        AND
          (FORALL (x: Point):
            carrier(x) IMPLIES
              EXISTS (U: point_set):
                cover(U) AND U(x)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (count: nat), (chosen: point_sequence):
          (FORALL (i: nat):
            i < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(i)))
            AND
              (FORALL (x: Point):
                carrier(x) IMPLIES
                  EXISTS (i: nat):
                    i < count AND chosen(i)(x))

  vector_subset(A, B: vector_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: vector):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  full_vector_space(dimension: nat): vector_set =
    LAMBDA (x: vector):
      supported(x, dimension)

  relatively_open(
      U, ambient: vector_set,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    vector_subset(U, ambient)
      AND FORALL (x: vector):
        U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: real):
            0 < radius
              AND FORALL (y: vector):
                (ambient(y)
                  AND squared_distance(y, x, dimension)
                    < radius ^ 2)
                IMPLIES U(y)

  convex_vector_set(
      domain: vector_set,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: vector), (t: real):
      (domain(x)
        AND domain(y)
        AND 0 <= t
        AND t <= 1)
      IMPLIES
        domain(
          vector_add(
            vector_scale(t, x),
            vector_scale(1 - t, y)))

  nonempty_vector_interior(
      domain: vector_set,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (x: vector), (radius: real):
      domain(x)
        AND 0 < radius
        AND FORALL (y: vector):
          (supported(y, dimension)
            AND squared_distance(y, x, dimension) < radius ^ 2)
          IMPLIES domain(y)

  % A ModelWithCorners range is convex with nonempty interior in its
  % finite-dimensional model space.
  model_with_corners_laws: bool =
    vector_subset(
      model_range,
      full_vector_space(model_dimension))
      AND convex_vector_set(
            model_range,
            model_dimension)
      AND nonempty_vector_interior(
            model_range,
            model_dimension)
      AND unique_differentiability_on(
            model_range,
            model_dimension)

  chart_image(chart: Chart, U: point_set): vector_set =
    LAMBDA (v: vector):
      chart_target(chart)(v)
        AND U(chart_inverse(chart, v))

  chart_laws(chart: Chart): bool =
    point_subset(chart_source(chart), whole_carrier)
      AND vector_subset(chart_target(chart), model_range)
      AND open_sets(chart_source(chart))
      AND relatively_open(
            chart_target(chart),
            model_range,
            model_dimension)
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Point):
          chart_source(chart)(x) IMPLIES
            (chart_target(chart)(chart_forward(chart, x))
              AND chart_inverse(
                    chart,
                    chart_forward(chart, x))
                  = x))
      AND
        (FORALL (v: vector):
          chart_target(chart)(v) IMPLIES
            (chart_source(chart)(chart_inverse(chart, v))
              AND chart_forward(
                    chart,
                    chart_inverse(chart, v))
                  = v))
      AND
        (FORALL (U: point_set):
          point_subset(U, chart_source(chart))
            IMPLIES
              (open_sets(U)
                IFF relatively_open(
                      chart_image(chart, U),
                      chart_target(chart),
                      model_dimension)))

  charted_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (chart: Chart):
      atlas(chart) IMPLIES chart_laws(chart))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: Point):
          carrier(x) IMPLIES
            (atlas(preferred_chart(x))
              AND chart_source(preferred_chart(x))(x)))

  transition_domain(left, right: Chart): vector_set =
    LAMBDA (v: vector):
      chart_target(left)(v)
        AND chart_source(right)(chart_inverse(left, v))

  transition_function(left, right: Chart): vector_function =
    LAMBDA (v: vector):
      chart_forward(
        right,
        chart_inverse(left, v))

  smooth_atlas_laws: bool =
    FORALL (left, right: Chart):
      (atlas(left) AND atlas(right))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (jets: jet_field):
            has_smooth_taylor_jets(
              transition_function(left, right),
              transition_domain(left, right),
              model_dimension,
              model_dimension,
              jets)

  pullback_open(
      e: embedding_function,
      V: vector_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: Point):
      carrier(x) AND V(e(x))

  euclidean_open(V: vector_set, dimension: nat): bool =
    relatively_open(
      V,
      full_vector_space(dimension),
      dimension)

  embedding_image(
      e: embedding_function,
      dimension: nat): vector_set =
    LAMBDA (v: vector):
      supported(v, dimension)
        AND EXISTS (x: Point):
          carrier(x) AND e(x) = v

  vector_complement_in_dimension(
      A: vector_set,
      dimension: nat): vector_set =
    LAMBDA (v: vector):
      supported(v, dimension) AND NOT A(v)

  closed_euclidean_set(
      A: vector_set,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    vector_subset(A, full_vector_space(dimension))
      AND euclidean_open(
            vector_complement_in_dimension(A, dimension),
            dimension)

  induces_source_topology(
      e: embedding_function,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (V: vector_set):
      euclidean_open(V, dimension)
        IMPLIES open_sets(pullback_open(e, V)))
      AND
        (FORALL (U: point_set):
          open_sets(U) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (V: vector_set):
              euclidean_open(V, dimension)
                AND FORALL (x: Point):
                  U(x) IFF pullback_open(e, V)(x))

  closed_embedding(
      e: embedding_function,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (x: Point):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES supported(e(x), dimension))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y: Point):
          (carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND e(x) = e(y))
            IMPLIES x = y)
      AND induces_source_topology(e, dimension)
      AND closed_euclidean_set(
            embedding_image(e, dimension),
            dimension)

  coordinate_representation(
      chart: Chart,
      e: embedding_function): vector_function =
    LAMBDA (v: vector):
      e(chart_inverse(chart, v))

  cmdiff_infinity(
      e: embedding_function,
      target_dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (chart: Chart):
      atlas(chart) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (jets: jet_field):
          has_smooth_taylor_jets(
            coordinate_representation(chart, e),
            chart_target(chart),
            model_dimension,
            target_dimension,
            jets)

  injective_on_model(
      derivative: vector_function,
      source_dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (u, v: vector):
      (supported(u, source_dimension)
        AND supported(v, source_dimension)
        AND derivative(u) = derivative(v))
      IMPLIES u = v

  canonical_manifold_derivative_injective(
      e: embedding_function,
      target_dimension: nat,
      x: Point): bool =
    LET chart: Chart = preferred_chart(x),
        coordinate: vector = chart_forward(chart, x) IN
      (EXISTS (derivative: vector_function):
        has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
          coordinate_representation(chart, e),
          chart_target(chart),
          model_dimension,
          target_dimension,
          coordinate,
          derivative))
        AND
          (FORALL (derivative: vector_function):
            has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
              coordinate_representation(chart, e),
              chart_target(chart),
              model_dimension,
              target_dimension,
              coordinate,
              derivative)
            IMPLIES
              injective_on_model(
                derivative,
                model_dimension))

  injective_manifold_derivative(
      e: embedding_function,
      target_dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (x: Point):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES
        canonical_manifold_derivative_injective(
          e,
          target_dimension,
          x)

  smooth_compact_manifold_context: bool =
    topology_laws
      AND hausdorff_carrier
      AND compact_carrier
      AND model_with_corners_laws
      AND charted_space_laws
      AND smooth_atlas_laws

  whitney_embedding_statement: bool =
    smooth_compact_manifold_context
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (euclidean_dimension: nat),
            (e: embedding_function):
          cmdiff_infinity(
            e,
            euclidean_dimension)
            AND closed_embedding(e, euclidean_dimension)
            AND injective_manifold_derivative(
                  e,
                  euclidean_dimension)
END whitney_embedding_theorem_Q1306095

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q132427
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q132427), "Rademacher's theorem": a function between
-- finite-dimensional real normed vector spaces that is Lipschitz on a measurable set is
-- differentiable within that set almost everywhere. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Body
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Defs
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Group.Measure
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Restrict
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Lipschitz

public section

open Filter MeasureTheory Measure

namespace Q132427

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  {C : NNReal} {f : E → F} {s : Set E} {μ : Measure E} [IsAddHaarMeasure μ]

/-- Rademacher's theorem for a function that is Lipschitz on a measurable set. -/
theorem rademacher_on_measurable_set (hf : LipschitzOnWith C f s) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict s), DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ f s x := sorry

end Q132427

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q132427
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q132427), "Rademacher's theorem": a Lipschitz map
  on a measurable subset of a finite-dimensional real normed vector space is
  Frechet differentiable within that subset almost everywhere for the
  restricted additive Haar measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals Arith List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q132427_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q132427_empty {A : Type} : q132427_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q132427_complement {A : Type}
    (S : q132427_set A) : q132427_set A :=
  fun x => ~ S x.

Definition q132427_intersection {A : Type}
    (S T : q132427_set A) : q132427_set A :=
  fun x => S x /\ T x.

Definition q132427_countable_union {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q132427_set A) : q132427_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, S n x.

Definition q132427_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q132427_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q132427_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q132427_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j ->
    forall x : A, ~ (S i x /\ S j x).

Record q132427_normed_real_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q132427_zero : E;
  q132427_add : E -> E -> E;
  q132427_neg : E -> E;
  q132427_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q132427_norm : E -> R;
  q132427_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q132427_add x (q132427_add y z) =
      q132427_add (q132427_add x y) z;
  q132427_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q132427_add x y = q132427_add y x;
  q132427_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q132427_add x q132427_zero = x;
  q132427_add_neg :
    forall x : E, q132427_add x (q132427_neg x) = q132427_zero;
  q132427_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q132427_smul 1 x = x;
  q132427_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q132427_smul (a * b) x =
      q132427_smul a (q132427_smul b x);
  q132427_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q132427_smul (a + b) x =
      q132427_add (q132427_smul a x) (q132427_smul b x);
  q132427_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q132427_smul a (q132427_add x y) =
      q132427_add (q132427_smul a x) (q132427_smul a y);
  q132427_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q132427_norm x;
  q132427_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q132427_norm x = 0 <-> x = q132427_zero;
  q132427_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q132427_norm (q132427_add x y) <=
      q132427_norm x + q132427_norm y;
  q132427_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q132427_norm (q132427_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q132427_norm x
}.

Arguments q132427_zero {E} _.
Arguments q132427_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q132427_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q132427_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q132427_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q132427_sub {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q132427_add V x (q132427_neg V y).

Definition q132427_dist {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : R :=
  q132427_norm V (q132427_sub V x y).

Fixpoint q132427_vector_sum
    {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> E) -> E :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> E) -> E with
  | O => fun _ => q132427_zero V
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q132427_add V
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q132427_vector_sum E V k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q132427_vector_sum {E} V n _.

Record q132427_finite_dimensional
    {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q132427_dimension : nat;
  q132427_basis : Fin.t q132427_dimension -> E;
  q132427_basis_spans :
    forall x : E,
      exists coefficients : Fin.t q132427_dimension -> R,
        x =
          q132427_vector_sum V q132427_dimension
            (fun i =>
              q132427_smul V
                (coefficients i) (q132427_basis i));
  q132427_basis_independent :
    forall coefficients : Fin.t q132427_dimension -> R,
      q132427_vector_sum V q132427_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q132427_smul V
            (coefficients i) (q132427_basis i)) =
        q132427_zero V ->
      forall i : Fin.t q132427_dimension,
        coefficients i = 0
}.

Definition q132427_open {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (U : q132427_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : E,
        q132427_dist V y x < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q132427_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q132427_set (q132427_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q132427_empty /\
  (forall S T : q132427_set A,
    q132427_same_set S T -> C S -> C T) /\
  (forall S : q132427_set A,
    C S -> C (q132427_complement S)) /\
  (forall S : nat -> q132427_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (S n)) ->
    C (q132427_countable_union S)).

Definition q132427_borel_set {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (S : q132427_set E) : Prop :=
  forall C : q132427_set (q132427_set E),
    q132427_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q132427_set E,
      q132427_open V U -> C U) ->
    C S.

Definition q132427_compact {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (K : q132427_set E) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q132427_set (q132427_set E),
    (forall U : q132427_set E,
      cover U -> q132427_open V U) ->
    (forall x : E,
      K x ->
      exists U : q132427_set E, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q132427_set E),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : E,
        K x ->
        exists U : q132427_set E,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Inductive q132427_ennreal : Type :=
| q132427_ennreal_finite : R -> q132427_ennreal
| q132427_ennreal_infinity : q132427_ennreal.

Definition q132427_ennreal_valid
    (x : q132427_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q132427_ennreal_finite value => 0 <= value
  | q132427_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q132427_ennreal_zero : q132427_ennreal :=
  q132427_ennreal_finite 0.

Definition q132427_ennreal_add
    (x y : q132427_ennreal) : q132427_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q132427_ennreal_finite a, q132427_ennreal_finite b =>
      q132427_ennreal_finite (a + b)
  | _, _ => q132427_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q132427_ennreal_le
    (x y : q132427_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q132427_ennreal_finite a, q132427_ennreal_finite b => a <= b
  | q132427_ennreal_finite _, q132427_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q132427_ennreal_infinity, q132427_ennreal_finite _ => False
  | q132427_ennreal_infinity, q132427_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q132427_ennreal_lt
    (x y : q132427_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q132427_ennreal_finite a, q132427_ennreal_finite b => a < b
  | q132427_ennreal_finite _, q132427_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Fixpoint q132427_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q132427_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q132427_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q132427_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q132427_ennreal_add
        (q132427_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q132427_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q132427_ennreal)
    (total : q132427_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q132427_ennreal_valid total /\
  (forall n : nat,
    q132427_ennreal_le
      (q132427_ennreal_partial_sum u n) total) /\
  forall upper : q132427_ennreal,
    q132427_ennreal_valid upper ->
    (forall n : nat,
      q132427_ennreal_le
        (q132427_ennreal_partial_sum u n) upper) ->
    q132427_ennreal_le total upper.

Record q132427_borel_measure
    {E : Type}
    (V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q132427_measure :
    q132427_set E -> q132427_ennreal;
  q132427_measure_valid :
    forall S : q132427_set E,
      q132427_ennreal_valid (q132427_measure S);
  q132427_measure_extensional :
    forall S T : q132427_set E,
      q132427_same_set S T ->
      q132427_measure S = q132427_measure T;
  q132427_measure_empty :
    q132427_measure q132427_empty =
      q132427_ennreal_zero;
  q132427_measure_monotone :
    forall S T : q132427_set E,
      (forall x : E, S x -> T x) ->
      q132427_ennreal_le
        (q132427_measure S) (q132427_measure T);
  q132427_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall S : nat -> q132427_set E,
      exists total : q132427_ennreal,
        q132427_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q132427_measure (S n)) total /\
        q132427_ennreal_le
          (q132427_measure (q132427_countable_union S))
          total;
  q132427_measure_caratheodory :
    forall S T : q132427_set E,
      q132427_borel_set V S ->
      q132427_measure T =
        q132427_ennreal_add
          (q132427_measure (q132427_intersection T S))
          (q132427_measure
            (q132427_intersection T
              (q132427_complement S)));
  q132427_measure_countable_additive :
    forall S : nat -> q132427_set E,
      (forall n : nat, q132427_borel_set V (S n)) ->
      q132427_pairwise_disjoint S ->
      exists total : q132427_ennreal,
        q132427_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q132427_measure (S n)) total /\
        q132427_measure (q132427_countable_union S) = total
}.

Arguments q132427_measure {E V} _ _.

Record q132427_add_haar_measure
    {E : Type}
    {V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (mu : q132427_borel_measure V) : Prop := {
  q132427_haar_left_invariant :
    forall (a : E) (S : q132427_set E),
      q132427_measure mu
        (fun x : E => S (q132427_add V a x)) =
      q132427_measure mu S;
  q132427_haar_finite_on_compact :
    forall K : q132427_set E,
      q132427_compact V K ->
      q132427_ennreal_lt
        (q132427_measure mu K)
        q132427_ennreal_infinity;
  q132427_haar_positive_on_nonempty_open :
    forall U : q132427_set E,
      q132427_open V U ->
      (exists x : E, U x) ->
      q132427_measure mu U <> q132427_ennreal_zero
}.

Record q132427_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q132427_nonnegative_value : R;
  q132427_value_nonnegative : 0 <= q132427_nonnegative_value
}.

Definition q132427_lipschitz_on_with
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q132427_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (C : q132427_nonnegative_real)
    (f : E -> F)
    (s : q132427_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x y : E,
    s x ->
    s y ->
    q132427_norm VF (q132427_sub VF (f x) (f y)) <=
      q132427_nonnegative_value C *
      q132427_norm VE (q132427_sub VE x y).

Record q132427_continuous_linear_map
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q132427_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (L : E -> F) : Prop := {
  q132427_linear_add :
    forall x y : E,
      L (q132427_add VE x y) =
      q132427_add VF (L x) (L y);
  q132427_linear_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      L (q132427_smul VE a x) =
      q132427_smul VF a (L x);
  q132427_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall x : E,
        q132427_norm VF (L x) <=
        bound * q132427_norm VE x
}.

Definition q132427_has_frechet_derivative_within_at
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q132427_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (f : E -> F)
    (L : E -> F)
    (s : q132427_set E)
    (x : E) : Prop :=
  q132427_continuous_linear_map VE VF L /\
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : E,
        s y ->
        q132427_norm VE (q132427_sub VE y x) < delta ->
        q132427_norm VF
          (q132427_sub VF
            (q132427_sub VF (f y) (f x))
            (L (q132427_sub VE y x))) <=
        epsilon * q132427_norm VE (q132427_sub VE y x).

Definition q132427_differentiable_within_at
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (VF : q132427_normed_real_vector_space F)
    (f : E -> F)
    (s : q132427_set E)
    (x : E) : Prop :=
  exists L : E -> F,
    q132427_has_frechet_derivative_within_at
      VE VF f L s x.

Definition q132427_almost_everywhere_restrict
    {E : Type}
    {V : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (mu : q132427_borel_measure V)
    (s : q132427_set E)
    (P : E -> Prop) : Prop :=
  q132427_measure mu
    (q132427_intersection s (fun x => ~ P x)) =
  q132427_ennreal_zero.

Theorem LipschitzOnWith_ae_differentiableWithinAt :
  forall (E F : Type)
         (VE : q132427_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (VF : q132427_normed_real_vector_space F)
         (_ : q132427_finite_dimensional VE)
         (_ : q132427_finite_dimensional VF)
         (mu : q132427_borel_measure VE)
         (C : q132427_nonnegative_real)
         (f : E -> F)
         (s : q132427_set E),
    q132427_add_haar_measure mu ->
    q132427_borel_set VE s ->
    q132427_lipschitz_on_with VE VF C f s ->
    q132427_almost_everywhere_restrict mu s
      (fun x =>
        q132427_differentiable_within_at VE VF f s x).
Admitted.

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q132427,
  "Rademacher's theorem": a Lipschitz map on a measurable subset of an arbitrary
  finite-dimensional real normed vector space into another such space is
  Frechet differentiable within the subset almost everywhere with respect to
  the additive Haar measure restricted to that subset. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Lipschitz" "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
begin

definition q132427_additive_haar_measure ::
    "'e::real_normed_vector measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q132427_additive_haar_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
    sets M = sets borel \<and>
    (\<forall>K. compact K \<longrightarrow> emeasure M K < \<infinity>) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. distr M borel ((+) a) = M) \<and>
    (\<forall>U. open U \<longrightarrow> U \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow> 0 < emeasure M U)"

theorem rademacher_s_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'e::real_normed_vector measure"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector"
    and s :: "'e set"
    and C :: real
  assumes finite_dimensional_domain:
      "\<exists>BE :: 'e set.
        finite_dimensional_vector_space
          ((*\<^sub>R) :: real \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) BE"
    and finite_dimensional_codomain:
      "\<exists>BF :: 'f set.
        finite_dimensional_vector_space
          ((*\<^sub>R) :: real \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) BF"
    and haar_measure:
      "q132427_additive_haar_measure M"
    and measurable_set:
      "s \<in> sets M"
    and lipschitz:
      "C-lipschitz_on s f"
  shows
      "AE x in restrict_space M s.
        f differentiable (at x within s)"
  sorry

end

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q132427,
  "Rademacher's theorem": a Lipschitz map between finite-dimensional real
  normed spaces is differentiable within a measurable set almost everywhere
  for an additive Haar measure restricted to that set. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let Q132427_RADEMACHER_S_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:E) /\
        (!s:E->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:E) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->E->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:E | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(E->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:E->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s t:E->bool.
           events t /\ s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!s:E->bool. !z:bool#real.
           enonnegative z /\
           (!t:E->bool.
              events t /\ s SUBSET t ==> ele z (mu t))
           ==> ele z (mu s)) /\
        (!sets:num->E->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n.
                    partial (SUC n) =
                    eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:E | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let normed_real_vector_spaceE =
      \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E)
       (smul:real->E->E) (norm:E->real).
        (!x y z:E. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x y:E. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x:E. add zero x = x) /\
        (!x:E. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
        (!x:E. smul (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real. !x:E.
           smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real. !x:E.
           smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a:real. !x y:E.
           smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!x:E. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
        (!x:E. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:E. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. !x:E. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
        (!x y:E. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let normed_real_vector_spaceF =
      \(zero:F) (add:F->F->F) (neg:F->F)
       (smul:real->F->F) (norm:F->real).
        (!x y z:F. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x y:F. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x:F. add zero x = x) /\
        (!x:F. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
        (!x:F. smul (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real. !x:F.
           smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real. !x:F.
           smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a:real. !x y:F.
           smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!x:F. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
        (!x:F. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:F. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!a:real. !x:F. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) /\
        (!x y:F. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let linear_combinationE =
      \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E)
       (n:num) (basis:num->E) (coeff:num->real) (x:E).
        ?partial:num->E.
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 add (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial n = x in
   let linear_combinationF =
      \(zero:F) (add:F->F->F) (smul:real->F->F)
       (n:num) (basis:num->F) (coeff:num->real) (x:F).
        ?partial:num->F.
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 add (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial n = x in
   let finite_dimensionalE =
      \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E).
        ?n:num. ?basis:num->E.
          (!x:E.
             ?coeff:num->real.
               linear_combinationE
                 zero add smul n basis coeff x) /\
          (!c d:num->real. !x:E.
             linear_combinationE zero add smul n basis c x /\
             linear_combinationE zero add smul n basis d x
             ==> !i. i < n ==> c i = d i) in
   let finite_dimensionalF =
      \(zero:F) (add:F->F->F) (smul:real->F->F).
        ?n:num. ?basis:num->F.
          (!x:F.
             ?coeff:num->real.
               linear_combinationF
                 zero add smul n basis coeff x) /\
          (!c d:num->real. !x:F.
             linear_combinationF zero add smul n basis c x /\
             linear_combinationF zero add smul n basis d x
             ==> !i. i < n ==> c i = d i) in
   let open_set =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
       (u:E->bool).
        !x:E.
          x IN u
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:E.
                  norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon
                  ==> y IN u in
   let tends_to =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
       (seq:num->E) (x:E).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num.
                !n:num.
                  N <= n
                  ==> norm (add (seq n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
   let compact_set =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
       (k:E->bool).
        !seq:num->E.
          (!n. seq n IN k)
          ==> ?sub:num->num. ?x:E.
                x IN k /\
                (!n. sub n < sub (SUC n)) /\
                tends_to add neg norm (\n. seq (sub n)) x in
   let borel_space =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
       (events:(E->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!u:E->bool.
           open_set add neg norm u ==> events u) /\
        (!other:(E->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!u:E->bool.
              open_set add neg norm u ==> other u)
           ==> !s:E->bool.
                 events s ==> other s) in
   let translate =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (a:E) (s:E->bool).
        {x:E | add (neg a) x IN s} in
   let is_add_haar_measure =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
       (events:(E->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(E->bool)->bool#real).
        (!a:E. !s:E->bool.
           events s
           ==> mu (translate add neg a s) = mu s) /\
        (!k:E->bool.
           compact_set add neg norm k
           ==> ~(FST (mu k))) /\
        (!u:E->bool.
           open_set add neg norm u /\ ~(u = {})
           ==> ~(mu u = ezero)) in
   let bounded_linear =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (smulE:real->E->E)
       (zeroF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (smulF:real->F->F)
       (normE:E->real) (normF:F->real) (L:E->F).
        L zeroE = zeroF /\
        (!x y:E. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
        (!a:real. !x:E. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x)) /\
        (?K:real.
           &0 <= K /\
           !x:E. normF (L x) <= K * normE x) in
   let has_frechet_derivative_within_at =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (smulE:real->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (zeroF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (negF:F->F)
       (smulF:real->F->F) (normF:F->real)
       (f:E->F) (s:E->bool) (x:E) (L:E->F).
        bounded_linear
          zeroE addE smulE zeroF addF smulF normE normF L /\
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?delta:real.
                 &0 < delta /\
                 !y:E.
                   y IN s /\
                   normE (addE y (negE x)) < delta
                   ==>
                   normF
                     (addF
                       (addF (f y) (negF (f x)))
                       (negF (L (addE y (negE x)))))
                   <= epsilon * normE (addE y (negE x))) in
   let differentiable_within_at =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (smulE:real->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (zeroF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (negF:F->F)
       (smulF:real->F->F) (normF:F->real)
       (f:E->F) (s:E->bool) (x:E).
        ?L:E->F.
          has_frechet_derivative_within_at
            zeroE addE negE smulE normE
            zeroF addF negF smulF normF f s x L in
   let lipschitz_on_with =
      \(addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (addF:F->F->F) (negF:F->F) (normF:F->real)
       (C:real) (f:E->F) (s:E->bool).
        &0 <= C /\
        !x y:E.
          x IN s /\ y IN s
          ==> normF (addF (f x) (negF (f y)))
              <= C * normE (addE x (negE y)) in
   let restricted_measure =
      \(mu:(E->bool)->bool#real) (s:E->bool) (t:E->bool).
        mu {x:E | x IN t /\ x IN s} in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(E->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:E->bool).
        ?N:E->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:E | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   !zeroE:E.
   !addE:E->E->E.
   !negE:E->E.
   !smulE:real->E->E.
   !normE:E->real.
   !zeroF:F.
   !addF:F->F->F.
   !negF:F->F.
   !smulF:real->F->F.
   !normF:F->real.
   !events:(E->bool)->bool.
   !mu:(E->bool)->bool#real.
   !C:real.
   !f:E->F.
   !s:E->bool.
     normed_real_vector_spaceE zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
     normed_real_vector_spaceF zeroF addF negF smulF normF /\
     finite_dimensionalE zeroE addE smulE /\
     finite_dimensionalF zeroF addF smulF /\
     borel_space addE negE normE events /\
     measure_space events mu /\
     is_add_haar_measure addE negE normE events mu /\
     events s /\
     lipschitz_on_with
       addE negE normE addF negF normF C f s
     ==>
     almost_everywhere events (restricted_measure mu s)
       (\x:E.
          differentiable_within_at
            zeroE addE negE smulE normE
            zeroF addF negF smulF normF f s x)`;;

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q132427,
;; "Rademacher's theorem": a map between finite-dimensional real normed vector
;; spaces that is Lipschitz on a measurable set is differentiable within that
;; set almost everywhere for an additive Haar measure. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, operations, sequences, and families are tame APPLY$
;; function objects.  FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification,
;; and inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal
;; existential quantification.  The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete
;; ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.  Explicit finite
;; bases and coordinate maps witness finite dimensionality without fixing
;; finite carriers.  The domain norm defines its Borel sigma-algebra, and the
;; measure has extended-nonnegative-real outer values on arbitrary sets.
;; Lipschitz continuity and the Frechet derivative within the set are expanded
;; below, including the internal existential quantifier over the derivative.

(defun q132427-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q132427-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q132427-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q132427-quoted nil)))

(defun q132427-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q132427-term-list arguments)))

(defun q132427-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q132427-apply-term
   (q132427-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q132427-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q132427-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q132427-quoted nil))
    (q132427-quoted t)))

(defun q132427-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q132427-quoted t)
       (q132427-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q132427-quoted nil)))

(defun q132427-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q132427-quoted nil)
   (q132427-quoted t)))

(defun q132427-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q132427-quoted t)))

(defun q132427-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q132427-quoted t)
    (q132427-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q132427-quoted nil)
    (q132427-quoted t))))

(defun q132427-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q132427-quoted t)))

(defun q132427-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q132427-quoted nil)))

(defun q132427-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (q132427-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q132427-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false
         (q132427-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q132427-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q132427-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q132427-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets over an arbitrary carrier.

(defun q132427-set-subset-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (q132427-and-terms
     (list
      (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q132427-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q132427-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q132427-set-subset-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q132427-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q132427-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun q132427-set-equiv-function
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q132427-iff-term
     (q132427-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q132427-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q132427-set-equiv-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q132427-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q132427-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q132427-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (q132427-quoted nil)))

(defun q132427-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-and-terms
    (list
     (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q132427-not-term
      (q132427-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun q132427-intersection-set (left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-and-terms
    (list
     (q132427-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q132427-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q132427-symmetric-difference-set
    (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-and-terms
    (list
     (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q132427-or-terms
      (list
       (q132427-and-terms
        (list
         (q132427-static-apply-term left '(x))
         (q132427-not-term
          (q132427-static-apply-term right '(x)))))
       (q132427-and-terms
        (list
         (q132427-static-apply-term right '(x))
         (q132427-not-term
          (q132427-static-apply-term left '(x)))))))))))

(defun q132427-set-nonempty-function
    (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-and-terms
    (list
     (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q132427-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun q132427-set-nonempty-p
    (carrier set)
  (and
   (q132427-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q132427-exists-p
    (q132427-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun q132427-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add
          (q132427-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add
          (q132427-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul
          (q132427-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul
          (q132427-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q132427-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x
          (q132427-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q132427-implies-term
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
         (q132427-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-add
         (q132427-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x (q132427-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
         (q132427-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
         (q132427-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-mul
         (q132427-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          multiply
          (list 'x (q132427-quoted one)))
         'x)
        (q132427-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q132427-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q132427-quoted zero)))
        (q132427-implies-term
         (q132427-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q132427-quoted zero)))
         (list
          'equal
          (q132427-static-apply-term
           multiply
           (list 'x inv-x))
          (q132427-quoted one)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
           (q132427-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q132427-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy
         (q132427-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx
         (q132427-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz
         (q132427-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q132427-implies-term
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-not-term
         (q132427-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q132427-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (q132427-implies-term
         (q132427-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q132427-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q132427-implies-term
         xy
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q132427-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q132427-implies-term
         (q132427-and-terms
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term
            less
            (list (q132427-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q132427-static-apply-term
            less
            (list (q132427-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q132427-quoted zero)
           (q132427-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun q132427-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (q132427-and-terms
     (list
      (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q132427-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q132427-not-term
     (q132427-static-apply-term
      less
      (list (q132427-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun q132427-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (q132427-member-p carrier upper)
   (q132427-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun q132427-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(upper)
   (list
    'q132427-upper-bound-p
    (q132427-quoted carrier)
    (q132427-quoted less)
    (q132427-quoted set)
    'upper)))

(defun q132427-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (q132427-exists-p
   (q132427-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun q132427-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(upper)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (list
     'q132427-upper-bound-p
     (q132427-quoted carrier)
     (q132427-quoted less)
     (q132427-quoted set)
     'upper)
    (q132427-not-term
     (q132427-static-apply-term
      less
      (list 'upper (q132427-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun q132427-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (q132427-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun q132427-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(set)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (q132427-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q132427-valid-set-p
       (q132427-quoted carrier)
       'set)
      (list
       'q132427-set-nonempty-p
       (q132427-quoted carrier)
       'set)
      (list
       'q132427-bounded-above-p
       (q132427-quoted carrier)
       (q132427-quoted less)
       'set)))
    (list
     'q132427-least-upper-bound-p
     (q132427-quoted carrier)
     (q132427-quoted less)
     'set
     (q132427-static-apply-term
      supremum-operation
      '(set))))))

(defun q132427-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (q132427-member-p carrier zero)
   (q132427-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q132427-member-p
    carrier
    (q132427-unary-value inverse zero))
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (q132427-member-p
    carrier
    (q132427-unary-value supremum
                           (q132427-empty-set)))
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (q132427-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun q132427-scalar-nonnegative-p
    (less zero value)
  (not (q132427-binary-value less value zero)))

(defun q132427-scalar-positive-p
    (carrier less zero value)
  (and
   (q132427-member-p carrier value)
   (q132427-binary-value less zero value)))

(defun q132427-scalar-absolute-value
    (less zero negate value)
  (if (q132427-binary-value less value zero)
      (q132427-unary-value negate value)
    value))

(defun q132427-field-natural
    (n zero one add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      zero
    (q132427-binary-value
     add
     one
     (q132427-field-natural
      (- n 1) zero one add))))

(defun q132427-field-power
    (base exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (q132427-binary-value
     multiply
     base
     (q132427-field-power
      base (- exponent 1) one multiply))))

;; Finite-dimensional normed vector spaces over the represented real field.

(defun q132427-vector-laws-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add negate smul)
  (let* ((xy
          (q132427-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz
          (q132427-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q132427-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (a-x
          (q132427-static-apply-term smul '(a x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a b x y z)
     (q132427-implies-term
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(a))
        (q132427-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(b))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list xy))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier (list a-x))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term add (list xy 'z))
         (q132427-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy
         (q132427-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x (q132427-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
         (q132427-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list (q132427-quoted scalar-one) 'x))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term
            scalar-multiply
            '(a b))
           'x))
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           'a
           (q132427-static-apply-term smul '(b x)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term scalar-add '(a b))
           'x))
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           a-x
           (q132427-static-apply-term smul '(b x)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term smul (list 'a xy))
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          add
          (list
           a-x
           (q132427-static-apply-term smul '(a y)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          smul
          (list (q132427-quoted scalar-zero) 'x))
         (q132427-quoted zero))))))))

(defun q132427-norm-laws-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate
     scalar-less carrier zero add negate smul norm)
  (let* ((norm-x
          (q132427-static-apply-term norm '(x)))
         (norm-y
          (q132427-static-apply-term norm '(y)))
         (norm-a-x
          (q132427-static-apply-term
           norm
           (list
            (q132427-static-apply-term smul '(a x)))))
         (abs-a
          (list
           'q132427-scalar-absolute-value
           (q132427-quoted scalar-less)
           (q132427-quoted scalar-zero)
           (q132427-quoted scalar-negate)
           'a)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a x y)
     (q132427-implies-term
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(a))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(y))))
      (q132427-and-terms
       (list
        (q132427-static-apply-term scalar-carrier (list norm-x))
        (q132427-not-term
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          scalar-less
          (list norm-x (q132427-quoted scalar-zero))))
        (q132427-iff-term
         (list 'equal norm-x (q132427-quoted scalar-zero))
         (list 'equal 'x (q132427-quoted zero)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          norm
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term negate '(x))))
         norm-x)
        (list
         'equal
         norm-a-x
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          scalar-multiply
          (list abs-a norm-x)))
        (q132427-not-term
         (q132427-static-apply-term
          scalar-less
          (list
           (q132427-static-apply-term
            scalar-add
            (list norm-x norm-y))
           (q132427-static-apply-term
            norm
            (list
             (q132427-static-apply-term add '(x y)))))))))))))

(defun q132427-normed-vector-space-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     scalar-negate scalar-less
     carrier zero add negate smul norm)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp smul)
   (tamep-functionp norm)
   (q132427-member-p carrier zero)
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-vector-laws-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add negate smul)
    '(a b x y z))
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-norm-laws-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate
     scalar-less carrier zero add negate smul norm)
    '(a x y))))

(defun q132427-coefficient-list-p
    (coefficients basis scalar-carrier)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (consp coefficients)
       (q132427-member-p scalar-carrier (car coefficients))
       (q132427-coefficient-list-p
        (cdr coefficients)
        (cdr basis)
        scalar-carrier))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q132427-basis-elements-p
    (basis carrier)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (q132427-member-p carrier (car basis))
       (q132427-basis-elements-p
        (cdr basis) carrier))
    (equal basis nil)))

(defun q132427-linear-combination
    (coefficients basis vector-zero vector-add smul)
  (if (consp basis)
      (q132427-binary-value
       vector-add
       (q132427-binary-value
        smul
        (car coefficients)
        (car basis))
       (q132427-linear-combination
        (cdr coefficients)
        (cdr basis)
        vector-zero vector-add smul))
    vector-zero))

(defun q132427-all-zero-coefficients-p
    (coefficients scalar-zero)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (equal (car coefficients) scalar-zero)
       (q132427-all-zero-coefficients-p
        (cdr coefficients) scalar-zero))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q132427-basis-independence-function
    (basis scalar-carrier scalar-zero
           vector-zero vector-add smul)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(coefficients)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (q132427-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q132427-coefficient-list-p
       'coefficients
       (q132427-quoted basis)
       (q132427-quoted scalar-carrier))
      (list
       'equal
       (list
        'q132427-linear-combination
        'coefficients
        (q132427-quoted basis)
        (q132427-quoted vector-zero)
        (q132427-quoted vector-add)
        (q132427-quoted smul))
       (q132427-quoted vector-zero))))
    (list
     'q132427-all-zero-coefficients-p
     'coefficients
     (q132427-quoted scalar-zero)))))

(defun q132427-basis-spanning-function
    (basis coordinates scalar-carrier carrier
           vector-zero vector-add smul)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x)
   (q132427-implies-term
    (q132427-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q132427-and-terms
     (list
      (list
       'q132427-coefficient-list-p
       (q132427-static-apply-term coordinates '(x))
       (q132427-quoted basis)
       (q132427-quoted scalar-carrier))
      (list
       'equal
       (list
        'q132427-linear-combination
        (q132427-static-apply-term coordinates '(x))
        (q132427-quoted basis)
        (q132427-quoted vector-zero)
        (q132427-quoted vector-add)
        (q132427-quoted smul))
       'x))))))

(defun q132427-finite-basis-p
    (basis coordinates scalar-carrier scalar-zero
           carrier vector-zero vector-add smul)
  (and
   (true-listp basis)
   (tamep-functionp coordinates)
   (q132427-basis-elements-p basis carrier)
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-basis-independence-function
     basis scalar-carrier scalar-zero
     vector-zero vector-add smul)
    '(coefficients))
   (q132427-universal-p
    (q132427-basis-spanning-function
     basis coordinates scalar-carrier carrier
     vector-zero vector-add smul)
    '(x))))

;; Norm topology, convergence, and compactness.

(defun q132427-vector-difference
    (add negate left right)
  (q132427-binary-value
   add left (q132427-unary-value negate right)))

(defun q132427-distance-less-p
    (scalar-less vector-add vector-negate norm
                 left right epsilon)
  (q132427-binary-value
   scalar-less
   (q132427-unary-value
    norm
    (q132427-vector-difference
     vector-add vector-negate left right))
   epsilon))

(defun q132427-ball-subset-function
    (carrier vector-add vector-negate norm scalar-less
             center epsilon set)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(y)
   (q132427-implies-term
