;; Extended nonnegative real values built from the represented real field.

(defun q132427-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :q132427-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q132427-finite)
    (q132427-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (q132427-scalar-nonnegative-p
     scalar-less scalar-zero (cdr value)))))

(defun q132427-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q132427-finite value))

(defun q132427-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (q132427-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun q132427-ennreal-less-p
    (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q132427-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q132427-top) t)
   (t
    (q132427-binary-value
     scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q132427-ennreal-less-equal-p
    (left right scalar-less)
  (not
   (q132427-ennreal-less-p
    right left scalar-less)))

(defun q132427-ennreal-add
    (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :q132427-top)
          (equal right :q132427-top))
      :q132427-top
    (q132427-ennreal-finite
     (q132427-binary-value
      scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q132427-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left
               (q132427-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right
               (q132427-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (q132427-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :q132427-top)
        (equal right :q132427-top))
    :q132427-top)
   (t
    (q132427-ennreal-finite
     (q132427-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q132427-ennreal-two-power
    (dimension scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply)
  (q132427-ennreal-finite
   (q132427-field-power
    (q132427-field-natural
     2 scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add)
    dimension scalar-one scalar-multiply)))

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q132427,
-- "Rademacher's theorem": a Lipschitz map on a measurable subset of a
-- finite-dimensional real normed space is differentiable within that subset
-- almost everywhere for the restricted Haar measure. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

open CompleteOrderedField
open NormedVectorSpace
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    nonnegative-value :
      R
    value-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        nonnegative-value

open NonnegativeReal

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

vectorAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorAdd reals x y i =
  addR reals (x i) (y i)

vectorScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorScale reals scalar x i =
  multiplyR reals scalar (x i)

record LinearEquivalence
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (n : Nat) : Set1 where
  field
    forward-linear :
      E -> Vector R n
    backward-linear :
      Vector R n -> E
    forward-after-backward :
      (x : Vector R n) ->
      VectorEqual (forward-linear (backward-linear x)) x
    backward-after-forward :
      (x : E) ->
      backward-linear (forward-linear x) == x
    forward-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (forward-linear (addE space x y))
        (vectorAdd reals (forward-linear x) (forward-linear y))
    forward-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (forward-linear (scaleE space a x))
        (vectorScale reals a (forward-linear x))

record FiniteDimensional
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) : Set1 where
  field
    dimension :
      Nat
    linear-equivalence :
      LinearEquivalence reals space dimension

NormOpen :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
NormOpen {R = R} {reals = reals} space U =
  (x : _) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) radius ->
          U y))

data BorelGenerated
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) :
  Predicate E -> Set1 where
  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate E} ->
    NormOpen space U ->
    BorelGenerated space U
  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated space emptySet
  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate E} ->
    BorelGenerated space S ->
    BorelGenerated space (complement S)
  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate E) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated space (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated space (countableUnion sets)
  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate E} ->
    ((x : E) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated space S ->
    BorelGenerated space T

record BorelSpace
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) : Set2 where
  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      BorelGenerated space S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated space S

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<suc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <N suc n
  suc<suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <N n ->
    suc m <N suc n

StrictlyIncreasing :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
StrictlyIncreasing subsequence =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m <N n ->
  subsequence m <N subsequence n

SequentiallyCompact :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
SequentiallyCompact {E = E} {reals = reals} space S =
  (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> S (sequence n)) ->
  Exists (Nat -> Nat)
    (\ subsequence ->
      Both
        (StrictlyIncreasing subsequence)
        (Exists E
          (\ limit ->
            Both
              (S limit)
              (SequentialLimit reals (distanceE space)
                (\ n -> sequence (subsequence n))
                limit))))

translateSet :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  Predicate E ->
  Predicate E
translateSet space shift S x =
  S (subtractE space x shift)

record IsAddHaarMeasure
  {R M E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set1 where
  field
    translation-invariant :
      (shift : E) ->
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      outerMass measure (translateSet space shift S) ==
      outerMass measure S
    positive-on-nonempty-open :
      (U : Predicate E) ->
      NormOpen space U ->
      Exists E U ->
      outerMass measure U != zeroM extended
    finite-on-compact :
      (K : Predicate E) ->
      SequentiallyCompact space K ->
      outerMass measure K != infinityM extended

LipschitzOnWith :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  NormedVectorSpace R F reals ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  (E -> F) ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
LipschitzOnWith {reals = reals} source target constant f S =
  (x y : _) ->
  S x ->
  S y ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (distanceE target (f x) (f y))
    (multiplyR reals
      (nonnegative-value constant)
      (distanceE source x y))

record ContinuousLinearMap
  {R E F : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (source : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (target : NormedVectorSpace R F reals) : Set where
  field
    linear-map :
      E -> F
    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      linear-map (addE source x y) ==
      addE target (linear-map x) (linear-map y)
    map-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      linear-map (scaleE source a x) ==
      scaleE target a (linear-map x)
    operator-bound :
      NonnegativeReal reals
    bounded :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE target (linear-map x))
        (multiplyR reals
          (nonnegative-value operator-bound)
          (normE source x))

open ContinuousLinearMap

DerivativeRemainder :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (source : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (target : NormedVectorSpace R F reals) ->
  (f : E -> F) ->
  ContinuousLinearMap reals source target ->
  E ->
  E ->
  F
DerivativeRemainder source target f derivative point y =
  subtractE target
    (subtractE target (f y) (f point))
    (linear-map derivative (subtractE source y point))

HasFDerivWithinAt :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (source : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (target : NormedVectorSpace R F reals) ->
  (f : E -> F) ->
  ContinuousLinearMap reals source target ->
  Predicate E ->
  E ->
  Set
HasFDerivWithinAt {R = R} {reals = reals}
  source target f derivative S point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          S y ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE source y point) radius ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE target
              (DerivativeRemainder
                source target f derivative point y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceE source y point))))

DifferentiableWithinAt :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (source : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (target : NormedVectorSpace R F reals) ->
  (f : E -> F) ->
  Predicate E ->
  E ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithinAt {reals = reals} source target f S point =
  Exists (ContinuousLinearMap reals source target)
    (\ derivative ->
      HasFDerivWithinAt source target f derivative S point)

AlmostEverywhereOn :
  {R M E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate E ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
AlmostEverywhereOn {extended = extended} measure S property =
  outerMass measure
    (\ x -> Both (S x) (Not (property x))) ==
  zeroM extended

rademacher-s-theorem : Set2
rademacher-s-theorem =
  (R M E F : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (source : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  FiniteDimensional reals source ->
  (target : NormedVectorSpace R F reals) ->
  FiniteDimensional reals target ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) ->
  BorelSpace source events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  IsAddHaarMeasure source measure ->
  (constant : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  (f : E -> F) ->
  (S : Predicate E) ->
  LipschitzOnWith source target constant f S ->
  measurable events S ->
  AlmostEverywhereOn measure S
    (\ x -> DifferentiableWithinAt source target f S x)

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q132427 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q132427), "Rademacher's theorem": a
  Lipschitz map between finite-dimensional real normed vector spaces is
  differentiable within a measurable set almost everywhere on that set.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;

val q132427_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q132427_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q132427_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_lincomb_def",
  ``q132427_lincomb
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) (coeff : num -> real) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. add acc (smul (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
        zero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q132427_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_basis_def",
  ``q132427_basis
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) <=>
      ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
      (!coeff : num -> real.
        q132427_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = zero ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = 0) /\
      (!x : 'e.
        ?coeff : num -> real.
          q132427_lincomb zero add smul basis coeff = x)``);

val q132427_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q132427_finite_dimensional
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) <=>
      ?basis : 'e list. q132427_basis zero add smul basis``);

val q132427_open_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_open_def",
  ``q132427_open
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : 'e set) <=>
      !x. x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q132427_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_compact_def",
  ``q132427_compact
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (k : 'e set) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        (!n. u n IN k) ==>
        ?r : num -> num. ?x : 'e.
          x IN k /\
          (!p q. p < q ==> r p < r q) /\
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?N : num. !n : num.
              N <= n ==>
              norm (add (u (r n)) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q132427_borel_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_borel_measure_def",
  ``q132427_borel_measure
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (m : 'e m_space) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m =
        subsets
          (sigma UNIV
            {u : 'e set | q132427_open add neg norm u})``);

val q132427_translate_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_translate_def",
  ``q132427_translate
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (a : 'e) (s : 'e set) =
      {x | ?y. y IN s /\ x = add a y}``);

val q132427_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q132427_outer_measure_def",
  ``q132427_outer_measure (m : 'e m_space) (s : 'e set) =
      inf
        {r : extreal |

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q132427
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q132427), "Rademacher's theorem": a function
  between finite-dimensional real normed vector spaces that is Lipschitz on a
  measurable set is Frechet differentiable within that set almost everywhere
  for an additive Haar measure. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V and W range over arbitrary SetMM normed vector spaces over RRfld, and
  ( dim ` V ) e. NN0 expresses finite dimensionality. Q132427Haar expands the
  source IsAddHaarMeasure assumption on the Borel sigma-algebra generated by
  V's norm topology.

  Q132427ContinuousLinear says that L is a real-linear map with a global norm
  bound. Q132427HasFDerivWithin is the epsilon-delta form of the Frechet
  remainder estimate along S, and Q132427DifferentiableWithin existentially
  quantifies its continuous linear derivative. Q132427LipschitzOn expands the
  source LipschitzOnWith predicate with its nonnegative real constant.

  Q132427Measure is the outer measure induced by M. Because S is measurable,
  saying that the subset of S where within-set differentiability fails has
  M-outer measure zero is equivalent to differentiability almost everywhere
  for the restricted measure M.restrict S.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful bidirectional definitions,
  and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q132427Sub Q132427Measure Q132427Translate Q132427Haar
   Q132427ContinuousLinear Q132427HasFDerivWithin
   Q132427DifferentiableWithin Q132427LipschitzOn $.

q132427-sub-syntax $a class ( Q132427Sub V x y ) $.
q132427-measure-syntax $a class ( Q132427Measure M A ) $.
q132427-translate-syntax $a class ( Q132427Translate V a A ) $.
q132427-haar-syntax $a wff ( Q132427Haar V M ) $.
q132427-continuous-linear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q132427ContinuousLinear V W L ) $.
q132427-has-fderiv-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q132427HasFDerivWithin V W S H x L ) $.
q132427-differentiable-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q132427DifferentiableWithin V W S H x ) $.
q132427-lipschitz-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q132427LipschitzOn V W C H S ) $.

${
  $d V x y $.

  q132427-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q132427Sub V x y
  ) =
    (
      x
      ( +g ` V )
      ( ( -g ` V ) ` y )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A M $.

  q132427-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q132427Measure M A
  ) = ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A ) $.
$}

${
  $d A V a x y $.

  q132427-translate-definition $a |- (
    Q132427Translate V a A
  ) = {
    y e. ( Base ` V ) |
      E. x e. A y = ( a ( +g ` V ) x )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A K M U V a $.

  q132427-haar-definition $a |- (
    ( Q132427Haar V M )
    <->
    (
      M e.
        (
          measures
          `
          ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` V ) )
        )
      /\
      (
        A. a e. ( Base ` V ) A. A e. ~P ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( Q132427Measure M ( Q132427Translate V a A ) )
            =
            ( Q132427Measure M A )
          )
        /\
        (
          A. K e. ~P ( Base ` V )
            (
              (
                ( ( TopOpen ` V ) |`t K ) e. Comp
                ->
                ( Q132427Measure M K ) e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
              )
            )
          /\
          A. U e. ( TopOpen ` V )
            (
              U =/= (/)
              ->
              0 < ( Q132427Measure M U )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K L V W a u v $.

  q132427-continuous-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q132427ContinuousLinear V W L )
    <->
    (
      L : ( Base ` V ) --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      (
        A. u e. ( Base ` V ) A. v e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            L ` ( u ( +g ` V ) v )
          )
          =
          (
            ( L ` u )
            ( +g ` W )
            ( L ` v )
          )
        /\
        (
          A. a e. RR A. u e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              L ` ( a ( .s ` V ) u )
            )
            =
            (
              a
              ( .s ` W )
              ( L ` u )
            )
          /\
          E. K e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
            A. u e. ( Base ` V )
              (
                ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( L ` u ) )
                <_
                (
                  K
                  x.
                  ( ( norm ` V ) ` u )
                )
              )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H L S V W e t x y $.

  q132427-has-fderiv-within-definition $a |- (
    ( Q132427HasFDerivWithin V W S H x L )
    <->
    A. e e. RR+
      E. t e. RR+
        A. y e. S
          (
            (
              ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( Q132427Sub V y x ) )
              <
              t
            )
            ->
            (
              (
                ( norm ` W )
                `
                (
                  Q132427Sub
                  W
                  ( Q132427Sub W ( H ` y ) ( H ` x ) )
                  ( L ` ( Q132427Sub V y x ) )
                )
              )
              <_
              (
                e
                x.
                ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( Q132427Sub V y x ) )
              )
            )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H L S V W x $.

  q132427-differentiable-within-definition $a |- (
    ( Q132427DifferentiableWithin V W S H x )
    <->
    E. L
      (
        ( Q132427ContinuousLinear V W L )
        /\
        ( Q132427HasFDerivWithin V W S H x L )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C H S V W x y $.

  q132427-lipschitz-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q132427LipschitzOn V W C H S )
    <->
    A. x e. S A. y e. S
      (
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          `
          ( Q132427Sub W ( H ` x ) ( H ` y ) )
        )
        <_
        (
          C
          x.
          ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( Q132427Sub V x y ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C H M S V W x $.

  thousand-theorems-q132427-rademacher $a |-
    A. V e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = RRfld }
      A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = RRfld }
        A. M A. C A. H A. S
          (
            (
              (
                ( dim ` V ) e. NN0
                /\
                ( dim ` W ) e. NN0
              )
              /\
              (
                ( Q132427Haar V M )
                /\
                (
                  C e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
                  /\
                  (
                    H : ( Base ` V ) --> ( Base ` W )
                    /\
                    S C_ ( Base ` V )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
            ->
            (
              (
                S e. dom M
                /\
                ( Q132427LipschitzOn V W C H S )
              )
              ->
              (
                Q132427Measure
                M
                {
                  x e. S |
                    -. ( Q132427DifferentiableWithin V W S H x )
                }
              )
              =
              0
            )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q132427_rademacher_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q132427,
% "Rademacher's theorem": a Lipschitz map on a measurable subset of a finite-dimensional
% real normed vector space is differentiable within that set almost everywhere for the
% restricted additive Haar measure. This file contains no proof.

rademacher_s_theorem_Q132427[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  F: TYPE+,
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [real, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  e_event: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  e_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_event]
  e_event_family: TYPE = [e_event -> bool]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [e_event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [e_event -> measure_value]

  e_function: TYPE = [E -> F]
  linear_candidate: TYPE = [E -> F]
  coordinate_map_e: TYPE = [E -> e_vector]
  coordinate_map_f: TYPE = [F -> e_vector]
  reconstruction_map_e: TYPE = [e_vector -> E]
  reconstruction_map_f: TYPE = [e_vector -> F]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F =
    addF(x, negF(y))

  coordinate_zero: e_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  coordinate_add(left, right: e_vector): e_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      left(index) + right(index)

  coordinate_scale(
      scalar: real,
      value: e_vector): e_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      scalar * value(index)

  supported(
      value: e_vector,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES value(index) = 0

  normed_real_vector_space_e: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) =
          addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) =
          abs(a) * normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <=
          normE(x) + normE(y))

  normed_real_vector_space_f: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) =
          addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: F):
        smulF(a, addF(x, y)) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: F):
        smulF(a + b, x) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: F):
        smulF(a * b, x) =
          smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) =
          abs(a) * normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <=
          normF(x) + normF(y))

  finite_dimensional_e: bool =
    EXISTS
        (dimension: nat),
        (coordinates: coordinate_map_e),
        (reconstruct: reconstruction_map_e):
      (FORALL (x: E):
        supported(coordinates(x), dimension))
        AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
          coordinates(addE(x, y)) =
            coordinate_add(
              coordinates(x), coordinates(y)))
        AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
          coordinates(smulE(a, x)) =
            coordinate_scale(a, coordinates(x)))
        AND (FORALL (x: E):
          reconstruct(coordinates(x)) = x)
        AND (FORALL (value: e_vector):
          supported(value, dimension) IMPLIES
            coordinates(reconstruct(value)) = value)

  finite_dimensional_f: bool =
    EXISTS
        (dimension: nat),
        (coordinates: coordinate_map_f),
        (reconstruct: reconstruction_map_f):
      (FORALL (x: F):
        supported(coordinates(x), dimension))
        AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
          coordinates(addF(x, y)) =
            coordinate_add(
              coordinates(x), coordinates(y)))
        AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: F):
          coordinates(smulF(a, x)) =
            coordinate_scale(a, coordinates(x)))
        AND (FORALL (x: F):
          reconstruct(coordinates(x)) = x)
        AND (FORALL (value: e_vector):
          supported(value, dimension) IMPLIES
            coordinates(reconstruct(value)) = value)

  empty_event: e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): FALSE

  full_event: e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): TRUE

  event_complement(A: e_event): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): NOT A(x)

  event_intersection(A, B: e_event): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): A(x) AND B(x)

  event_difference(A, B: e_event): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): A(x) AND NOT B(x)

  event_subset(A, B: e_event): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  countable_union(events: e_event_sequence): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: e_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: E):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  open_set(A: e_event): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: E):
            normE(subE(y, x)) < radius
              IMPLIES A(y)

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: e_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        open_set(A) IMPLIES Sigma(A))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
            open_set(A) IMPLIES Other(A)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (A: e_event):
            Sigma(A) IMPLIES Other(A))

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_finite(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  measure_value_is_positive(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND (infinite_flag(value) OR finite_part(value) > 0)

  measure_value_le(
      left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  countably_subadditive(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL
        (events: e_event_sequence),
        (total: measure_value):

        LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
        total)
      IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(M(countable_union(events)), total)

  countably_additive_on_sigma(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL
        (events: e_event_sequence),
        (total: measure_value):
      (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
        AND pairwise_disjoint(events)
        AND extended_nonnegative_sum(
          LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
          total)
      IMPLIES
        M(countable_union(events)) = total

  monotone_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: e_event):
      event_subset(A, B) IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(M(A), M(B))

  caratheodory_measurable(
      M: measure_map,
      A: e_event): bool =
    FORALL (B: e_event):
      M(B)
        = measure_value_add(
            M(event_intersection(B, A)),
            M(event_difference(B, A)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND monotone_measure(M)
      AND countably_subadditive(M)
      AND countably_additive_on_sigma(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          caratheodory_measurable(M, A))

  open_cover(
      cover: e_event_family,
      K: e_event): bool =
    (FORALL (A: e_event):
      cover(A) IMPLIES open_set(A))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        K(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (A: e_event):
            cover(A) AND A(x))

  compact_set(K: e_event): bool =
    FORALL (cover: e_event_family):
      open_cover(cover, K) IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (count: nat),
            (chosen: e_event_sequence):
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
            AND (FORALL (x: E):
              K(x) IMPLIES
                EXISTS (index: nat):
                  index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  translated_event(A: e_event, shift: E): e_event =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      A(subE(x, shift))

  is_additive_haar_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event), (shift: E):
        M(translated_event(A, shift)) = M(A))
      AND (FORALL (K: e_event):
        compact_set(K) IMPLIES
          measure_value_is_finite(M(K)))
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        (open_set(A)
          AND EXISTS (x: E): A(x))
        IMPLIES measure_value_is_positive(M(A)))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: e_event): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_cover: e_event):
      Sigma(measurable_cover)
        AND event_subset(A, measurable_cover)
        AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere_restrict(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      source_set: e_event,
      property_value: [E -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (x: E):
        source_set(x) AND NOT property_value(x))

  lipschitz_on_with(
      constant: real,
      function_value: e_function,
      source_set: e_event): bool =
    constant >= 0
      AND FORALL (x, y: E):
        (source_set(x) AND source_set(y))
          IMPLIES
            normF(subF(
              function_value(x), function_value(y)))
              <= constant * normE(subE(x, y))

  continuous_linear_map(L: linear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      L(addE(x, y)) = addF(L(x), L(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        L(smulE(a, x)) = smulF(a, L(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        bound >= 0
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            normF(L(x)) <= bound * normE(x)

  has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
      function_value: e_function,
      derivative: linear_candidate,
      source_set: e_event,
      point: E): bool =
    continuous_linear_map(derivative)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (nearby: E):
            (source_set(nearby)
              AND normE(subE(nearby, point)) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              normF(
                subF(
                  subF(
                    function_value(nearby),
                    function_value(point)),
                  derivative(subE(nearby, point))))
                <= epsilon_value
                  * normE(subE(nearby, point))

  differentiable_within_at(
      function_value: e_function,
      source_set: e_event,
      point: E): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: linear_candidate):
      has_frechet_derivative_within_at(
        function_value,
        derivative,
        source_set,
        point)

  rademacher_s_theorem: bool =
    (normed_real_vector_space_e
      AND normed_real_vector_space_f
      AND finite_dimensional_e
      AND finite_dimensional_f)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (constant: real),
          (function_value: e_function),
          (source_set: e_event):
        (generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
          AND is_additive_haar_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND Sigma(source_set)
          AND lipschitz_on_with(
            constant, function_value, source_set))
        IMPLIES
          almost_everywhere_restrict(
            M,
            Sigma,
            source_set,
            LAMBDA (x: E):
              differentiable_within_at(
                function_value, source_set, x))
END rademacher_s_theorem_Q132427

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1346677
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1346677), "Tietze extension theorem": a bounded
  continuous real-valued function along a closed embedding into a normal
  topological space has a bounded continuous extension with the same norm.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1346677_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1346677_subset {A : Type}
    (U V : q1346677_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x -> V x.

Definition q1346677_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U V : q1346677_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (U x /\ V x).

Definition q1346677_same_set {A : Type}
    (U V : q1346677_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x <-> V x.

Record q1346677_topological_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1346677_is_open : q1346677_set A -> Prop;
  q1346677_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q1346677_set A,
      q1346677_same_set U V ->
      (q1346677_is_open U <-> q1346677_is_open V);
  q1346677_open_full :
    q1346677_is_open (fun _ : A => True);
  q1346677_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q1346677_set A,
      q1346677_is_open U ->
      q1346677_is_open V ->
      q1346677_is_open (fun x : A => U x /\ V x);
  q1346677_open_union :
    forall family : q1346677_set (q1346677_set A),
      (forall U : q1346677_set A,
        family U -> q1346677_is_open U) ->
      q1346677_is_open
        (fun x : A =>
          exists U : q1346677_set A, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1346677_is_open {A} _ _.

Definition q1346677_is_closed {A : Type}
    (T : q1346677_topological_space A)
    (C : q1346677_set A) : Prop :=
  q1346677_is_open T (fun x : A => ~ C x).

Definition q1346677_continuous {A B : Type}
    (TA : q1346677_topological_space A)
    (TB : q1346677_topological_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall V : q1346677_set B,
    q1346677_is_open TB V ->
    q1346677_is_open TA (fun x : A => V (f x)).

Definition q1346677_normal_space {A : Type}
    (T : q1346677_topological_space A) : Prop :=
  forall C D : q1346677_set A,
    q1346677_is_closed T C ->
    q1346677_is_closed T D ->
    q1346677_disjoint C D ->
    exists U V : q1346677_set A,
      q1346677_is_open T U /\
      q1346677_is_open T V /\
      q1346677_subset C U /\
      q1346677_subset D V /\
      q1346677_disjoint U V.

Definition q1346677_range {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) : q1346677_set B :=
  fun y : B => exists x : A, f x = y.

Definition q1346677_closed_embedding {A B : Type}
    (TA : q1346677_topological_space A)
    (TB : q1346677_topological_space B)
    (e : A -> B) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : A, e x = e y -> x = y) /\
  q1346677_continuous TA TB e /\
  (forall U : q1346677_set A,
    q1346677_is_open TA U ->
    exists V : q1346677_set B,
      q1346677_is_open TB V /\
      forall x : A, U x <-> V (e x)) /\
  q1346677_is_closed TB (q1346677_range e).

Definition q1346677_real_open
    (U : q1346677_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q1346677_continuous_real {A : Type}
    (T : q1346677_topological_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall U : q1346677_set R,
    q1346677_real_open U ->
    q1346677_is_open T (fun x : A => U (f x)).

Record q1346677_bounded_continuous_real
    (A : Type) (T : q1346677_topological_space A) : Type := {
  q1346677_bc_apply : A -> R;
  q1346677_bc_continuous :
    q1346677_continuous_real T q1346677_bc_apply;
  q1346677_bc_norm : R;
  q1346677_bc_norm_nonnegative :
    0 <= q1346677_bc_norm;
  q1346677_bc_norm_upper_bound :
    forall x : A,
      Rabs (q1346677_bc_apply x) <= q1346677_bc_norm;
  q1346677_bc_norm_least :
    forall bound : R,
      0 <= bound ->
      (forall x : A, Rabs (q1346677_bc_apply x) <= bound) ->
      q1346677_bc_norm <= bound
}.

Arguments q1346677_bc_apply {A T} _ _.
Arguments q1346677_bc_norm {A T} _.

Theorem
BoundedContinuousFunction_exists_extension_norm_eq_of_isClosedEmbedding :
  forall (X Y : Type)
         (TX : q1346677_topological_space X)
         (TY : q1346677_topological_space Y)
         (f : q1346677_bounded_continuous_real TX)
         (e : X -> Y),
    q1346677_normal_space TY ->
    q1346677_closed_embedding TX TY e ->
    exists g : q1346677_bounded_continuous_real TY,
      q1346677_bc_norm g = q1346677_bc_norm f /\
      forall x : X,
        q1346677_bc_apply g (e x) =
        q1346677_bc_apply f x.
Admitted.

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1346677,
  "Tietze extension theorem": a bounded continuous real-valued function along a
  closed embedding into a normal topological space has a bounded continuous
  extension with the same supremum norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Abstract_Topology"
begin

definition q1346677_is_normal_space :: "'a topology \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1346677_is_normal_space X \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>S T.
        closedin X S \<longrightarrow>
        closedin X T \<longrightarrow>
        disjnt S T \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>U V.
          openin X U \<and>
          openin X V \<and>
          S \<subseteq> U \<and>
          T \<subseteq> V \<and>
          disjnt U V))"

definition q1346677_is_closed_embedding ::
    "'a topology \<Rightarrow> 'b topology \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1346677_is_closed_embedding X Y e \<longleftrightarrow>
      embedding_map X Y e \<and> closedin Y (e ` topspace X)"

definition q1346677_is_bounded_continuous ::
    "'a topology \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1346677_is_bounded_continuous X f \<longleftrightarrow>
      continuous_map X euclideanreal f \<and>
      (\<exists>B. \<forall>x\<in>topspace X. \<bar>f x\<bar> \<le> B)"

definition q1346677_bcf_norm ::
    "'a topology \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "q1346677_bcf_norm X f =
      (if topspace X = {} then 0 else Sup ((\<lambda>x. \<bar>f x\<bar>) ` topspace X))"

theorem exists_extension_norm_eq_of_isClosedEmbedding:
  fixes X :: "'a topology"
    and Y :: "'b topology"
    and e :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes normal_Y: "q1346677_is_normal_space Y"
    and closed_embedding: "q1346677_is_closed_embedding X Y e"
    and bounded_continuous_f: "q1346677_is_bounded_continuous X f"
  shows "\<exists>g :: 'b \<Rightarrow> real.
    q1346677_is_bounded_continuous Y g \<and>
    q1346677_bcf_norm Y g = q1346677_bcf_norm X f \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>topspace X. g (e x) = f x)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1346677
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1346677), "Tietze extension theorem": every
  bounded continuous real-valued map on the domain of a closed embedding into
  a normal space has a bounded continuous extension with exactly the same
  supremum norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1346677_TIETZE_EXTENSION_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology_x =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
       opens {} /\
       opens carrier /\
       (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
       (!c:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!u:A->bool. u IN c ==> opens u)
          ==> opens (UNIONS c)) /\
       (!u v:A->bool.
          opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v)) in
   let is_topology_y =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (opens:(B->bool)->bool).
       opens {} /\
       opens carrier /\
       (!u:B->bool. opens u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
       (!c:(B->bool)->bool.
          (!u:B->bool. u IN c ==> opens u)
          ==> opens (UNIONS c)) /\
       (!u v:B->bool.
          opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v)) in
   let closed_in_y =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (opens:(B->bool)->bool) (c:B->bool).
       c SUBSET carrier /\ opens (carrier DIFF c) in
   let normal_space =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (opens:(B->bool)->bool).
       !s t:B->bool.
         closed_in_y carrier opens s /\
         closed_in_y carrier opens t /\
         s INTER t = {}
         ==> ?u v:B->bool.
               opens u /\
               opens v /\
               s SUBSET u /\
               t SUBSET v /\
               u INTER v = {} in
   let real_open =
     \s:real->bool.
       !x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:real. abs(y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN s in
   let continuous_real_x =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (f:A->real).
       !u:real->bool.
         real_open u
         ==> opens {x:A | x IN carrier /\ f x IN u} in
   let continuous_real_y =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (opens:(B->bool)->bool) (f:B->real).
       !u:real->bool.
         real_open u
         ==> opens {y:B | y IN carrier /\ f y IN u} in
   let bounded_x =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (f:A->real).
       ?bound:real.
         !x:A. x IN carrier ==> abs(f x) <= bound in
   let bounded_y =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (f:B->real).
       ?bound:real.
         !y:B. y IN carrier ==> abs(f y) <= bound in
   let bounded_continuous_x =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (f:A->real).
       continuous_real_x carrier opens f /\ bounded_x carrier f in
   let bounded_continuous_y =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (opens:(B->bool)->bool) (f:B->real).
       continuous_real_y carrier opens f /\ bounded_y carrier f in
   let closed_embedding =
     \(carrier_x:A->bool) (opens_x:(A->bool)->bool)
      (carrier_y:B->bool) (opens_y:(B->bool)->bool) (e:A->B).
       (!x:A. x IN carrier_x ==> e x IN carrier_y) /\
       (!x y:A.
          x IN carrier_x /\ y IN carrier_x /\ e x = e y
          ==> x = y) /\
       (!u:A->bool.
          opens_x u <=>
          ?v:B->bool.
            opens_y v /\
            u = {x:A | x IN carrier_x /\ e x IN v}) /\
       closed_in_y carrier_y opens_y (IMAGE e carrier_x) in
   let is_sup_norm_x =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (f:A->real) (r:real).
       (carrier = {} /\ r = &0) \/
       (~(carrier = {}) /\
        (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> abs(f x) <= r) /\
        (!upper:real.
           (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> abs(f x) <= upper)
           ==> r <= upper)) in
   let is_sup_norm_y =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (f:B->real) (r:real).
       (carrier = {} /\ r = &0) \/
       (~(carrier = {}) /\
        (!y:B. y IN carrier ==> abs(f y) <= r) /\
        (!upper:real.
           (!y:B. y IN carrier ==> abs(f y) <= upper)
           ==> r <= upper)) in
   !carrier_x:A->bool.
   !carrier_y:B->bool.
   !opens_x:(A->bool)->bool.
   !opens_y:(B->bool)->bool.
   !f:A->real.
   !e:A->B.
     is_topology_x carrier_x opens_x /\
     is_topology_y carrier_y opens_y /\
     normal_space carrier_y opens_y /\
     bounded_continuous_x carrier_x opens_x f /\
     closed_embedding carrier_x opens_x carrier_y opens_y e
     ==> ?g:B->real.
           bounded_continuous_y carrier_y opens_y g /\
           (?r:real.
              is_sup_norm_x carrier_x f r /\
              is_sup_norm_y carrier_y g r) /\
           (!x:A. x IN carrier_x ==> g (e x) = f x)`;;

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1346677,
;; "Tietze extension theorem": a bounded continuous real-valued function along
;; a closed embedding into a normal space has a bounded continuous extension
;; with the same supremum norm. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, sets, topologies, and maps are represented by tame
;; APPLY$ function objects. Real numbers are represented exactly by paired
;; rational Dedekind cuts. Rational open intervals form a basis for the real
;; topology, and rational upper cuts determine the supremum norm. DEFUN-SK
;; keeps the extension map and all other existential witnesses internal.

(defun q1346677-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q1346677-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

;; Extensional subsets and arbitrary families of subsets.

(defun-sk q1346677-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p set x)
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q1346677-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q1346677-set-contained-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q1346677-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p left x)
      (q1346677-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q1346677-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p family left)
      (q1346677-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p family set)
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q1346677-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q1346677-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q1346677-family-members-valid-p carrier family)))

(defun q1346677-open-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1346677-member-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q1346677-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p family set)
     (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1346677-empty-representation-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (not (q1346677-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-full-representation-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (q1346677-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1346677-intersection-representation-p
    (carrier left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p intersection x)
      (and
       (q1346677-member-p left x)
       (q1346677-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q1346677-union-member-p (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1346677-member-p family set)
     (q1346677-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1346677-union-representation-p
    (carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p union x)
      (q1346677-union-member-p carrier family x)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-empty-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1346677-empty-representation-p carrier set)
     (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1346677-full-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1346677-full-representation-p carrier set)
     (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1346677-intersection-open-exists-p
    (carrier topology left right)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier intersection)
     (q1346677-intersection-representation-p
      carrier left right intersection)
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      carrier topology intersection))))

(defun-sk q1346677-union-open-exists-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier union)
     (q1346677-union-representation-p
      carrier family union)
     (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology union))))

(defun-sk q1346677-topology-closure-laws-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right family)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology left)
       (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology right))
      (q1346677-intersection-open-exists-p
       carrier topology left right))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1346677-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
       (q1346677-family-members-open-p
        carrier topology family))
      (q1346677-union-open-exists-p
       carrier topology family)))))

(defun q1346677-topological-space-p (carrier topology)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (q1346677-family-of-sets-p carrier topology)
   (q1346677-empty-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q1346677-full-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q1346677-topology-closure-laws-p carrier topology)))

;; Closed subsets and normality.

(defun-sk q1346677-complement-representation-p
    (carrier set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p complement x)
      (not (q1346677-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q1346677-open-complement-exists-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier complement)
     (q1346677-complement-representation-p
      carrier set complement)
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      carrier topology complement))))

(defun q1346677-closed-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1346677-open-complement-exists-p
    carrier topology set)))

(defun-sk q1346677-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
      (q1346677-member-p left x))
     (q1346677-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q1346677-disjoint-sets-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (not
      (and
       (q1346677-member-p left x)
       (q1346677-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q1346677-normal-separation-exists-p
    (carrier topology left right)
  (exists (left-open right-open)
    (and
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      carrier topology left-open)
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      carrier topology right-open)
     (q1346677-set-subset-p
      carrier left left-open)
     (q1346677-set-subset-p
      carrier right right-open)
     (q1346677-disjoint-sets-p
      carrier left-open right-open))))

(defun-sk q1346677-normal-space-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1346677-closed-set-p carrier topology left)
      (q1346677-closed-set-p carrier topology right)
      (q1346677-disjoint-sets-p carrier left right))
     (q1346677-normal-separation-exists-p
      carrier topology left right))))

(defun q1346677-normal-space-p (carrier topology)
  (and
   (q1346677-topological-space-p carrier topology)
   (q1346677-normal-space-law-p carrier topology)))

;; Exact real numbers as paired lower and upper rational Dedekind cuts.
;; LOWER(q) means q < x and UPPER(q) means x < q.

(defun q1346677-real-lower (real)
  (car real))

(defun q1346677-real-upper (real)
  (cdr real))

(defun q1346677-real-lower-p (real q)
  (if (apply$ (q1346677-real-lower real) (list q)) t nil))

(defun q1346677-real-upper-p (real q)
  (if (apply$ (q1346677-real-upper real) (list q)) t nil))

(defun-sk q1346677-lower-inhabited-p (real)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (q1346677-real-lower-p real q))))

(defun-sk q1346677-upper-inhabited-p (real)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (q1346677-real-upper-p real q))))

(defun-sk q1346677-lower-rounded-p (real q)
  (exists (r)
    (and
     (rationalp r)
     (< q r)
     (q1346677-real-lower-p real r))))

(defun-sk q1346677-upper-rounded-p (real q)
  (exists (r)
    (and
     (rationalp r)
     (< r q)
     (q1346677-real-upper-p real r))))

(defun-sk q1346677-real-cut-laws-p (real)
  (forall (q r)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1346677-real-lower-p real q)
      (rationalp q))
     (implies
      (q1346677-real-upper-p real q)
      (rationalp q))
     (implies
      (and
       (rationalp q)
       (rationalp r)
       (< r q)
       (q1346677-real-lower-p real q))
      (q1346677-real-lower-p real r))
     (implies
      (and
       (rationalp q)
       (q1346677-real-lower-p real q))
      (q1346677-lower-rounded-p real q))
     (implies
      (and
       (rationalp q)
       (rationalp r)
       (< q r)
       (q1346677-real-upper-p real q))
      (q1346677-real-upper-p real r))
     (implies
      (and
       (rationalp q)
       (q1346677-real-upper-p real q))
      (q1346677-upper-rounded-p real q))
     (implies
      (rationalp q)
      (not
       (and
        (q1346677-real-lower-p real q)
        (q1346677-real-upper-p real q))))
     (implies
      (and
       (rationalp q)
       (rationalp r)
       (< q r))
      (or
       (q1346677-real-lower-p real q)
       (q1346677-real-upper-p real r))))))

(defun q1346677-real-p (real)
  (and
   (consp real)
   (tamep-functionp (q1346677-real-lower real))
   (tamep-functionp (q1346677-real-upper real))
   (q1346677-lower-inhabited-p real)
   (q1346677-upper-inhabited-p real)
   (q1346677-real-cut-laws-p real)))

(defun-sk q1346677-real-equal-p (left right)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (rationalp q)
     (and
      (iff
       (q1346677-real-lower-p left q)
       (q1346677-real-lower-p right q))
      (iff
       (q1346677-real-upper-p left q)
       (q1346677-real-upper-p right q))))))

(defun q1346677-real-in-rational-interval-p
    (real left right)
  (and
   (rationalp left)
   (rationalp right)
   (< left right)
   (q1346677-real-lower-p real left)
   (q1346677-real-upper-p real right)))

(defun q1346677-real-abs-lt-p (real bound)
  (and
   (rationalp bound)
   (< 0 bound)
   (q1346677-real-lower-p real (- bound))
   (q1346677-real-upper-p real bound)))

;; Maps and continuity.

(defun-sk q1346677-map-into-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier mapping)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p source-carrier x)
     (q1346677-member-p
      target-carrier
      (q1346677-value mapping x)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-preimage-representation-p
    (source-carrier mapping target-set source-set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p source-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p source-set x)
      (q1346677-member-p
       target-set
       (q1346677-value mapping x))))))

(defun-sk q1346677-open-preimage-exists-p
    (source-carrier source-topology mapping target-set)
  (exists (source-set)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p source-carrier source-set)
     (q1346677-preimage-representation-p
      source-carrier mapping target-set source-set)
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      source-carrier source-topology source-set))))

(defun-sk q1346677-continuity-law-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-topology mapping)
  (forall (target-set)
    (implies
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      target-carrier target-topology target-set)
     (q1346677-open-preimage-exists-p
      source-carrier source-topology
      mapping target-set))))

(defun q1346677-continuous-map-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-topology mapping)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp mapping)
   (q1346677-map-into-p
    source-carrier target-carrier mapping)
   (q1346677-continuity-law-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-topology mapping)))

;; Real-valued continuity uses all rational open intervals, an exact basis for
;; the usual topology on the Dedekind reals.

(defun-sk q1346677-real-valued-map-p (carrier mapping)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (q1346677-real-p
      (q1346677-value mapping x)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-interval-preimage-representation-p
    (carrier mapping left right set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p set x)
      (q1346677-real-in-rational-interval-p
       (q1346677-value mapping x)
       left right)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-interval-preimage-open-exists-p
    (carrier topology mapping left right)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1346677-interval-preimage-representation-p
      carrier mapping left right set)
     (q1346677-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1346677-real-continuity-law-p
    (carrier topology mapping)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp left)
      (rationalp right)
      (< left right))
     (q1346677-interval-preimage-open-exists-p
      carrier topology mapping left right))))

(defun-sk q1346677-uniform-abs-bound-p
    (carrier mapping bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p carrier x)
     (q1346677-real-abs-lt-p
      (q1346677-value mapping x)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1346677-bounded-map-p (carrier mapping)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (rationalp bound)
     (< 0 bound)
     (q1346677-uniform-abs-bound-p
      carrier mapping bound))))

(defun q1346677-bounded-continuous-real-map-p
    (carrier topology mapping)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp mapping)
   (q1346677-real-valued-map-p carrier mapping)
   (q1346677-real-continuity-law-p
    carrier topology mapping)
   (q1346677-bounded-map-p carrier mapping)))

;; NORM-LT(q) means that some rational r < q uniformly bounds all absolute
;; values. This is exactly the rational upper cut of the supremum norm.

(defun-sk q1346677-norm-lt-p (carrier mapping q)
  (exists (r)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (rationalp r)
     (< 0 r)
     (< r q)
     (q1346677-uniform-abs-bound-p
      carrier mapping r))))

(defun-sk q1346677-supremum-norm-equal-p
    (left-carrier left-map right-carrier right-map)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (< 0 q))
     (iff
      (q1346677-norm-lt-p
       left-carrier left-map q)
      (q1346677-norm-lt-p
       right-carrier right-map q)))))

;; Closed embeddings: injective continuous maps inducing the source topology,
;; with closed range.

(defun-sk q1346677-injective-map-p (carrier mapping)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1346677-member-p carrier left)
      (q1346677-member-p carrier right)
      (equal
       (q1346677-value mapping left)
       (q1346677-value mapping right)))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q1346677-embedding-open-witness-p
    (source-carrier source-open
     target-carrier target-topology mapping)
  (exists (target-open)
    (and
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      target-carrier target-topology target-open)
     (q1346677-preimage-representation-p
      source-carrier mapping target-open source-open))))

(defun-sk q1346677-source-topology-induced-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-topology mapping)
  (forall (source-open)
    (implies
     (q1346677-open-set-p
      source-carrier source-topology source-open)
     (q1346677-embedding-open-witness-p
      source-carrier source-open
      target-carrier target-topology mapping))))

(defun-sk q1346677-range-member-p
    (source-carrier mapping y)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1346677-member-p source-carrier x)
     (equal (q1346677-value mapping x) y))))

(defun-sk q1346677-range-representation-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier mapping range)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p target-carrier y)
     (iff
      (q1346677-member-p range y)
      (q1346677-range-member-p
       source-carrier mapping y)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-closed-range-exists-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier target-topology mapping)
  (exists (range)
    (and
     (q1346677-valid-set-p target-carrier range)
     (q1346677-range-representation-p
      source-carrier target-carrier mapping range)
     (q1346677-closed-set-p
      target-carrier target-topology range))))

(defun q1346677-closed-embedding-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-topology mapping)
  (and
   (q1346677-continuous-map-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-topology mapping)
   (q1346677-injective-map-p
    source-carrier mapping)
   (q1346677-source-topology-induced-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-topology mapping)
   (q1346677-closed-range-exists-p
    source-carrier target-carrier
    target-topology mapping)))

;; Extensional equality of the extension with the source function.

(defun-sk q1346677-extension-agrees-p
    (source-carrier embedding source-map extension-map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1346677-member-p source-carrier x)
     (q1346677-real-equal-p
      (q1346677-value
       extension-map
       (q1346677-value embedding x))
      (q1346677-value source-map x)))))

(defun-sk q1346677-extension-exists-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier target-topology
     embedding source-map)
  (exists (extension-map)
    (and
     (q1346677-bounded-continuous-real-map-p
      target-carrier target-topology extension-map)
     (q1346677-supremum-norm-equal-p
      target-carrier extension-map
      source-carrier source-map)
     (q1346677-extension-agrees-p
      source-carrier embedding
      source-map extension-map))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1346677-tietze-extension-theorem-statement
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-topology
     source-map embedding)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1346677-topological-space-p
     source-carrier source-topology)
    (q1346677-normal-space-p
     target-carrier target-topology)
    (q1346677-bounded-continuous-real-map-p
     source-carrier source-topology source-map)
    (q1346677-closed-embedding-p
     source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-topology embedding))
   (q1346677-extension-exists-p
    source-carrier target-carrier target-topology
    embedding source-map)))
