title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q1346677, "Tietze extension theorem": every
-- bounded continuous real-valued function along a closed embedding into a
-- normal space has an extension with the same supremum norm. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

Predicate :
  {a q : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
Predicate {a} {q} A =
  A -> Set (a ⊔ q)

Empty :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} A
Empty {a} {q} _ =
  Bottom {a ⊔ q}

Union :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Predicate {q = q} A
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Predicate {q = q} A
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
SubsetOf {A = A} U V =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  V x

SameSubset :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
SameSubset {A = A} U V =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (U x) (V x)

Disjoint :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Predicate {q = q} A ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
Disjoint {a} {q} {A} U V =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  V x ->
  Bottom {a ⊔ q}

record TopologicalSpace
  {a q : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q)) where

  field
    close :
      Predicate {q = q} X ->
      Predicate {q = q} X

    close-congruent :
      (U V : Predicate {q = q} X) ->
      SameSubset {q = q} U V ->
      SameSubset {q = q} (close U) (close V)

    close-empty :
      SubsetOf {q = q}
        (close (Empty {q = q}))
        (Empty {q = q})

    subset-close :
      (U : Predicate {q = q} X) ->
      SubsetOf {q = q} U (close U)

    close-monotone :
      (U V : Predicate {q = q} X) ->
      SubsetOf {q = q} U V ->
      SubsetOf {q = q} (close U) (close V)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Predicate {q = q} X) ->
      SubsetOf {q = q}
        (close (Union {q = q} U V))
        (Union {q = q} (close U) (close V))

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Predicate {q = q} X) ->
      SubsetOf {q = q}
        (Union {q = q} (close U) (close V))
        (close (Union {q = q} U V))

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Predicate {q = q} X) ->
      SubsetOf {q = q} (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {q = q} X ->
  Predicate {q = q} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
IsClosed {q = q} topology C =
  SubsetOf {q = q} (close topology C) C

IsOpen :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {q = q} X ->
  Predicate {q = q} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
IsOpen {q = q} topology U =
  IsClosed {q = q} topology (Complement {q = q} U)

Continuous :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {Y : Set b} ->
  TopologicalSpace {q = b} X ->
  TopologicalSpace {q = a} Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
Continuous {a = a} {b = b} source target f =
  (U : Predicate {a = b} {q = a} _) ->
  IsOpen target U ->
  IsOpen source (\ x -> U (f x))

RealOpen :
  {q : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Predicate {q = q} R ->
  Set q
RealOpen {q} {R} reals U =
  (x : R) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : R) ->
          StrictLess reals
            (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals y x))
            radius ->
          U y))

ContinuousReal :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  TopologicalSpace {q = q} X ->
  (X -> R) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
ContinuousReal {a = a} {q = q} reals topology f =
  (U : Predicate {q = a ⊔ q} _) ->
  RealOpen {q = a ⊔ q} reals U ->
  IsOpen topology (\ x -> U (f x))

record NormalSeparation
  {a q : Level}
  {Y : Set a}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace {q = q} Y)
  (C D : Predicate {q = q} Y) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q)) where

  field
    left-open-set :
      Predicate {q = q} Y
    right-open-set :
      Predicate {q = q} Y
    left-open :
      IsOpen {q = q} topology left-open-set
    right-open :
      IsOpen {q = q} topology right-open-set
    left-contained :
      SubsetOf {q = q} C left-open-set
    right-contained :
      SubsetOf {q = q} D right-open-set
    open-sets-disjoint :
      Disjoint {q = q} left-open-set right-open-set

NormalSpace :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {Y : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {q = q} Y ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
NormalSpace {q = q} {Y = Y} topology =
  (C D : Predicate {q = q} Y) ->
  IsClosed {q = q} topology C ->
  IsClosed {q = q} topology D ->
  Disjoint {q = q} C D ->
  NormalSeparation {q = q} topology C D

record Lift
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor lifted
  field
    lower : A

Range :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {Y : Set b} ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Predicate {q = a} Y
Range {a} {X = X} e y =
  Exists X (\ x -> Lift {p = a} (e x == y))

record InducedOpenWitness
  {a b : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {Y : Set b}
  (target : TopologicalSpace {q = a} Y)
  (e : X -> Y)
  (U : Predicate {q = b} X) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b)) where

  field
    ambient-open-set :
      Predicate {q = a} Y
    ambient-is-open :
      IsOpen target ambient-open-set
    preimage-characterization :
      (x : X) ->
      Iff (U x) (ambient-open-set (e x))

record ClosedEmbedding
  {a b : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {Y : Set b}
  (source : TopologicalSpace {q = b} X)
  (target : TopologicalSpace {q = a} Y)
  (e : X -> Y) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b)) where

  field
    embedding-injective :
      (x y : X) ->
      e x == e y ->
      x == y
    embedding-continuous :
      Continuous source target e
    embedding-induces-topology :
      (U : Predicate {q = b} X) ->
      IsOpen source U ->
      InducedOpenWitness target e U
    embedding-range-closed :
      IsClosed target (Range e)

record BoundedContinuous
  {a q : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace {q = q} X) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q)) where

  field
    apply :
      X ->
      R
    apply-continuous :
      ContinuousReal reals topology apply
    norm :
      R
    norm-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) norm
    norm-upper :
      (x : X) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (absoluteR reals (apply x)) norm
    norm-least :
      (upper : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) upper ->
      ((x : X) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals (absoluteR reals (apply x)) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals norm upper

open BoundedContinuous

record NormPreservingExtension
  {a b : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {Y : Set b}
  {R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {source : TopologicalSpace {q = b} X}
  {target : TopologicalSpace {q = a} Y}
  (f : BoundedContinuous reals source)
  (e : X -> Y) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b)) where

  field
    extension :
      BoundedContinuous reals target
    same-norm :
      norm extension == norm f
    extends :
      (x : X) ->
      apply extension (e x) == apply f x

tietze-extension-theorem : Setω
tietze-extension-theorem =
  (a b : Level) ->
  (R : Set) ->
  (X : Set a) ->
  (Y : Set b) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (source : TopologicalSpace {q = b} X) ->
  (target : TopologicalSpace {q = a} Y) ->
  NormalSpace target ->
  (f : BoundedContinuous reals source) ->
  (e : X -> Y) ->
  ClosedEmbedding source target e ->
  NormPreservingExtension {target = target} f e

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1346677, "Tietze extension theorem": a bounded continuous real-valued
  function extends along a closed embedding into a normal topological space
  with the same uniform norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory topologyTheory real_topologyTheory;

val q1346677_normal_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1346677_normal_space_def",
  ``q1346677_normal_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      !s t.
        closed_in top s /\
        closed_in top t /\
        DISJOINT s t
        ==>
        ?u v.
          open_in top u /\
          open_in top v /\
          s SUBSET u /\
          t SUBSET v /\
          DISJOINT u v``);

val q1346677_closed_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q1346677_closed_embedding_def",
  ``q1346677_closed_embedding
      (topX : 'x topology) (topY : 'y topology) (e : 'x -> 'y) <=>
      continuous_map (topX,topY) e /\
      (!x y.
        x IN topspace topX /\
        y IN topspace topX /\
        e x = e y
        ==>
        x = y) /\
      (!u.
        open_in topX u
        ==>
        ?v.
          open_in topY v /\
          u = {x | x IN topspace topX /\ e x IN v}) /\
      closed_in topY (IMAGE e (topspace topX))``);

val q1346677_bounded_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q1346677_bounded_continuous_def",
  ``q1346677_bounded_continuous
      (top : 'a topology) (f : 'a -> real) <=>
      continuous_map (top,euclidean) f /\
      ?M : real.
        0 <= M /\
        !x. x IN topspace top ==> abs (f x) <= M``);

val q1346677_uniform_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1346677_uniform_norm_def",
  ``q1346677_uniform_norm
      (top : 'a topology) (f : 'a -> real) (n : real) <=>
      0 <= n /\
      (!x. x IN topspace top ==> abs (f x) <= n) /\
      !m : real.
        0 <= m /\
        (!x. x IN topspace top ==> abs (f x) <= m)
        ==>
        n <= m``);

val q1346677_same_uniform_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1346677_same_uniform_norm_def",
  ``q1346677_same_uniform_norm
      (topX : 'x topology) (topY : 'y topology)
      (f : 'x -> real) (g : 'y -> real) <=>
      ?n : real.
        q1346677_uniform_norm topX f n /\
        q1346677_uniform_norm topY g n``);

val BoundedContinuousFunction_exists_extension_norm_eq_of_isClosedEmbedding =
  ``!(topX : 'x topology) (topY : 'y topology)
      (f : 'x -> real) (e : 'x -> 'y).
      q1346677_normal_space topY /\
      q1346677_bounded_continuous topX f /\
      q1346677_closed_embedding topX topY e
      ==>
      ?g : 'y -> real.
        q1346677_bounded_continuous topY g /\
        q1346677_same_uniform_norm topX topY f g /\

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1346677
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1346677), "Tietze extension theorem": every
  bounded continuous real-valued function along a closed embedding into a
  normal topological space has a bounded continuous extension with the same
  norm. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1346677Bounded J F says that the real-valued function F is uniformly
  bounded on the full carrier of topology J. Q1346677SupNorm J F is the
  supremum of its pointwise absolute values, with zero adjoined so that the
  empty-domain norm is zero. For a bounded real-valued function this is
  exactly the norm of Lean's bundled bounded continuous function.

  A SetMM topology K in Nrm is a normal topological space. The conjunction
  saying that E is a homeomorphism from J onto the subspace topology of K on
  ran E, and that ran E is closed in K, is equivalent to Lean's
  IsClosedEmbedding E. Continuity uses SetMM's native Cn class and the usual
  norm topology of RRfld. The final $a assertion retains the internal
  existential extension G and contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1346677Bounded Q1346677SupNorm $.

q1346677-bounded-syntax $a wff ( Q1346677Bounded J F ) $.
q1346677-sup-norm-syntax $a class ( Q1346677SupNorm J F ) $.

${
  $d F J b x $.

  q1346677-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1346677Bounded J F )
    <->
    E. b e. RR+
      A. x e. U. J
        ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) <_ b
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F J x $.

  q1346677-sup-norm-definition $a |-
    ( Q1346677SupNorm J F ) =
      sup (
        ( ran ( x e. U. J |-> ( abs ` ( F ` x ) ) ) u. { 0 } )
        , RR
        , <
      )
  $.
$}

${
  $d E F G J K $.

  thousand-theorems-q1346677-tietze-extension $a |-
    A. J e. Top
      A. K e. Nrm
        A. E
          A. F e. ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
            (
              (
                E e. ( J Homeo ( K |`t ran E ) )
                /\
                ran E e. ( Clsd ` K )
                /\
                ( Q1346677Bounded J F )
              )
              ->
              E. G e. ( K Cn ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
                (
                  ( Q1346677Bounded K G )
                  /\
                  ( Q1346677SupNorm K G ) =
                    ( Q1346677SupNorm J F )
                  /\
                  ( G o. E ) = F
                )
            )
  $.
$}

title: Q1346677_tietze_extension_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1346677,
% "Tietze extension theorem": a bounded continuous real-valued function along
% a closed embedding into a normal space has an extension of the same norm.
% This file contains no proof.

tietze_extension_theorem_Q1346677[
  X, Y: TYPE,
  x_carrier: [X -> bool],
  y_carrier: [Y -> bool],
  x_open: [[X -> bool] -> bool],
  y_open: [[Y -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  x_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  y_set: TYPE = [Y -> bool]
  x_set_family: TYPE = [x_set -> bool]
  y_set_family: TYPE = [y_set -> bool]
  x_real_function: TYPE = [X -> real]
  y_real_function: TYPE = [Y -> real]
  embedding_function: TYPE = [X -> Y]

  empty_x_set: x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  empty_y_set: y_set =
    LAMBDA (y: Y): FALSE

  whole_x_carrier: x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): x_carrier(x)

  whole_y_carrier: y_set =
    LAMBDA (y: Y): y_carrier(y)

  x_subset(A, B: x_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  y_subset(A, B: y_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: Y):
      A(y) IMPLIES B(y)

  x_intersection(A, B: x_set): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      A(x) AND B(x)

  y_intersection(A, B: y_set): y_set =
    LAMBDA (y: Y):
      A(y) AND B(y)

  x_union(family: x_set_family): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      x_carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (U: x_set):
          family(U) AND U(x)

  y_union(family: y_set_family): y_set =
    LAMBDA (y: Y):
      y_carrier(y)
        AND EXISTS (U: y_set):
          family(U) AND U(y)

  x_topology_laws: bool =
    x_open(empty_x_set)
      AND x_open(whole_x_carrier)
      AND
        (FORALL (U: x_set):
          x_open(U) IMPLIES x_subset(U, whole_x_carrier))
      AND
        (FORALL (U, V: x_set):
          (x_open(U) AND x_open(V))
            IMPLIES x_open(x_intersection(U, V)))
      AND
        (FORALL (family: x_set_family):
          (FORALL (U: x_set):
            family(U) IMPLIES x_open(U))
          IMPLIES x_open(x_union(family)))

  y_topology_laws: bool =
    y_open(empty_y_set)
      AND y_open(whole_y_carrier)
      AND
        (FORALL (U: y_set):
          y_open(U) IMPLIES y_subset(U, whole_y_carrier))
      AND
        (FORALL (U, V: y_set):
          (y_open(U) AND y_open(V))
            IMPLIES y_open(y_intersection(U, V)))
      AND
        (FORALL (family: y_set_family):
          (FORALL (U: y_set):
            family(U) IMPLIES y_open(U))
          IMPLIES y_open(y_union(family)))

  y_complement(A: y_set): y_set =
    LAMBDA (y: Y):
      y_carrier(y) AND NOT A(y)

  y_closed(A: y_set): bool =
    y_subset(A, whole_y_carrier)
      AND y_open(y_complement(A))

  y_disjoint(A, B: y_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: Y):
      NOT (A(y) AND B(y))

  y_normal_space: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: y_set):
      (y_closed(A) AND y_closed(B) AND y_disjoint(A, B))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U, V: y_set):
            y_open(U)
              AND y_open(V)
              AND y_subset(A, U)
              AND y_subset(B, V)
              AND y_disjoint(U, V)

  continuous_real_on_x(f: x_real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      x_carrier(x)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
            0 < epsilon_value
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (U: x_set):
                  x_open(U)
                    AND U(x)
                    AND
                      (FORALL (z: X):
                        U(z)
                          IMPLIES
                            abs(f(z) - f(x)) < epsilon_value)

  continuous_real_on_y(g: y_real_function): bool =
    FORALL (y: Y):
      y_carrier(y)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
            0 < epsilon_value
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (V: y_set):
                  y_open(V)
                    AND V(y)
                    AND
                      (FORALL (z: Y):
                        V(z)
                          IMPLIES
                            abs(g(z) - g(y)) < epsilon_value)

  bounded_on_x(f: x_real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      0 <= bound
        AND
          FORALL (x: X):
            x_carrier(x) IMPLIES abs(f(x)) <= bound

  bounded_on_y(g: y_real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      0 <= bound
        AND
          FORALL (y: Y):
            y_carrier(y) IMPLIES abs(g(y)) <= bound

  bounded_continuous_on_x(f: x_real_function): bool =
    bounded_on_x(f) AND continuous_real_on_x(f)

  bounded_continuous_on_y(g: y_real_function): bool =
    bounded_on_y(g) AND continuous_real_on_y(g)

  uniform_bound_on_x(f: x_real_function, bound: real): bool =
    0 <= bound
      AND
        FORALL (x: X):
          x_carrier(x) IMPLIES abs(f(x)) <= bound

  uniform_bound_on_y(g: y_real_function, bound: real): bool =
    0 <= bound
      AND
        FORALL (y: Y):
          y_carrier(y) IMPLIES abs(g(y)) <= bound

  sup_norm_on_x(f: x_real_function, norm_value: real): bool =
    uniform_bound_on_x(f, norm_value)
      AND
        FORALL (bound: real):
          uniform_bound_on_x(f, bound)
            IMPLIES norm_value <= bound

  sup_norm_on_y(g: y_real_function, norm_value: real): bool =
    uniform_bound_on_y(g, norm_value)
      AND
        FORALL (bound: real):
          uniform_bound_on_y(g, bound)
            IMPLIES norm_value <= bound

  embedding_range(e: embedding_function): y_set =
    LAMBDA (y: Y):
      y_carrier(y)
        AND EXISTS (x: X):
          x_carrier(x) AND e(x) = y

  maps_x_into_y(e: embedding_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      x_carrier(x) IMPLIES y_carrier(e(x))

  injective_on_x(e: embedding_function): bool =
    FORALL (x1, x2: X):
      (x_carrier(x1)
        AND x_carrier(x2)
        AND e(x1) = e(x2))
        IMPLIES x1 = x2

  induces_x_topology(e: embedding_function): bool =
    FORALL (U: x_set):
      x_open(U)
        IFF
          EXISTS (V: y_set):
            y_open(V)
              AND
                (FORALL (x: X):
                  U(x)
                    IFF
                      (x_carrier(x) AND V(e(x))))

  closed_embedding(e: embedding_function): bool =
    maps_x_into_y(e)
      AND injective_on_x(e)
      AND induces_x_topology(e)
      AND y_closed(embedding_range(e))

  extends_along(
      f: x_real_function,
      e: embedding_function,
      g: y_real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      x_carrier(x) IMPLIES g(e(x)) = f(x)

  same_sup_norm(
      f: x_real_function,
      g: y_real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (norm_value: real):
      sup_norm_on_x(f, norm_value)
        AND sup_norm_on_y(g, norm_value)

  exists_extension_norm_eq_of_isClosedEmbedding: bool =
    (x_topology_laws
      AND y_topology_laws
      AND y_normal_space)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (f: x_real_function), (e: embedding_function):
          (bounded_continuous_on_x(f) AND closed_embedding(e))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (g: y_real_function):
                bounded_continuous_on_y(g)
                  AND same_sup_norm(f, g)
                  AND extends_along(f, e, g)
END tietze_extension_theorem_Q1346677

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1357684
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1357684), "Riesz representation theorem": a Hilbert
-- space over the real or complex numbers is conjugate-linearly isometrically equivalent
-- to its strong dual via the inner product. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace Q1357684

open InnerProductSpace RCLike

variable (𝕜 E : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- The Fréchet-Riesz representation as the canonical isometric equivalence with the dual. -/
theorem riesz_representation_theorem :
    ∃ e : E ≃ₗᵢ⋆[𝕜] StrongDual 𝕜 E, ∀ x y : E, e x y = inner 𝕜 x y := sorry

end Q1357684

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1357684
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1357684), "Riesz representation theorem": the
  canonical inner-product map from a complete real-or-complex inner-product
  space to its continuous dual is a conjugate-linear isometric equivalence.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q1357684_rclike (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1357684_k_zero : K;
  q1357684_k_one : K;
  q1357684_k_add : K -> K -> K;
  q1357684_k_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q1357684_k_neg : K -> K;
  q1357684_k_inv : K -> K;
  q1357684_k_conj : K -> K;
  q1357684_k_norm : K -> R;
  q1357684_k_of_real : R -> K;
  q1357684_k_re : K -> R;
  q1357684_k_im : K -> R;
  q1357684_k_I : K;

  q1357684_k_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1357684_k_add x (q1357684_k_add y z) =
      q1357684_k_add (q1357684_k_add x y) z;
  q1357684_k_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1357684_k_add x y = q1357684_k_add y x;
  q1357684_k_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q1357684_k_add x q1357684_k_zero = x;
  q1357684_k_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q1357684_k_add x (q1357684_k_neg x) = q1357684_k_zero;
  q1357684_k_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1357684_k_mul x (q1357684_k_mul y z) =
      q1357684_k_mul (q1357684_k_mul x y) z;
  q1357684_k_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1357684_k_mul x y = q1357684_k_mul y x;
  q1357684_k_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q1357684_k_mul x q1357684_k_one = x;
  q1357684_k_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1357684_k_mul x (q1357684_k_add y z) =
      q1357684_k_add
        (q1357684_k_mul x y) (q1357684_k_mul x z);
  q1357684_k_mul_inv :
    forall x : K, x <> q1357684_k_zero ->
      q1357684_k_mul x (q1357684_k_inv x) = q1357684_k_one;
  q1357684_k_nontrivial :
    q1357684_k_zero <> q1357684_k_one;

  q1357684_k_conj_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_conj (q1357684_k_add x y) =
      q1357684_k_add (q1357684_k_conj x) (q1357684_k_conj y);
  q1357684_k_conj_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_conj (q1357684_k_mul x y) =
      q1357684_k_mul (q1357684_k_conj x) (q1357684_k_conj y);
  q1357684_k_conj_involutive :
    forall x : K, q1357684_k_conj (q1357684_k_conj x) = x;

  q1357684_k_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : K, 0 <= q1357684_k_norm x;
  q1357684_k_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q1357684_k_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1357684_k_zero;
  q1357684_k_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_norm (q1357684_k_add x y) <=
      q1357684_k_norm x + q1357684_k_norm y;
  q1357684_k_norm_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_norm (q1357684_k_mul x y) =
      q1357684_k_norm x * q1357684_k_norm y;
  q1357684_k_norm_conj :
    forall x : K,
      q1357684_k_norm (q1357684_k_conj x) = q1357684_k_norm x;

  q1357684_k_of_real_zero :
    q1357684_k_of_real 0 = q1357684_k_zero;
  q1357684_k_of_real_one :
    q1357684_k_of_real 1 = q1357684_k_one;
  q1357684_k_of_real_add :
    forall a b : R,
      q1357684_k_of_real (a + b) =
      q1357684_k_add (q1357684_k_of_real a) (q1357684_k_of_real b);
  q1357684_k_of_real_mul :
    forall a b : R,
      q1357684_k_of_real (a * b) =
      q1357684_k_mul (q1357684_k_of_real a) (q1357684_k_of_real b);
  q1357684_k_of_real_neg :
    forall a : R,
      q1357684_k_of_real (- a) =
      q1357684_k_neg (q1357684_k_of_real a);
  q1357684_k_of_real_injective :
    forall a b : R,
      q1357684_k_of_real a = q1357684_k_of_real b -> a = b;
  q1357684_k_norm_of_real :
    forall a : R, q1357684_k_norm (q1357684_k_of_real a) = Rabs a;

  q1357684_k_re_of_real :
    forall a : R, q1357684_k_re (q1357684_k_of_real a) = a;
  q1357684_k_im_of_real :
    forall a : R, q1357684_k_im (q1357684_k_of_real a) = 0;
  q1357684_k_re_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_re (q1357684_k_add x y) =
      q1357684_k_re x + q1357684_k_re y;
  q1357684_k_im_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_im (q1357684_k_add x y) =
      q1357684_k_im x + q1357684_k_im y;
  q1357684_k_re_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_re (q1357684_k_mul x y) =
      q1357684_k_re x * q1357684_k_re y -
      q1357684_k_im x * q1357684_k_im y;
  q1357684_k_im_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1357684_k_im (q1357684_k_mul x y) =
      q1357684_k_re x * q1357684_k_im y +
      q1357684_k_im x * q1357684_k_re y;
  q1357684_k_re_conj :
    forall x : K, q1357684_k_re (q1357684_k_conj x) = q1357684_k_re x;
  q1357684_k_im_conj :
    forall x : K, q1357684_k_im (q1357684_k_conj x) = - q1357684_k_im x;
  q1357684_k_re_I :
    q1357684_k_re q1357684_k_I = 0;
  q1357684_k_im_I_real :
    q1357684_k_I = q1357684_k_zero -> q1357684_k_im q1357684_k_I = 0;
  q1357684_k_im_I_complex :
    q1357684_k_I <> q1357684_k_zero -> q1357684_k_im q1357684_k_I = 1;
  q1357684_k_I_cases :
    q1357684_k_I = q1357684_k_zero \/
    (q1357684_k_I <> q1357684_k_zero /\
     q1357684_k_mul q1357684_k_I q1357684_k_I =
       q1357684_k_neg q1357684_k_one);
  q1357684_k_coordinate_decomposition :
    forall x : K,
      x =
      q1357684_k_add
        (q1357684_k_of_real (q1357684_k_re x))
        (q1357684_k_mul
          (q1357684_k_of_real (q1357684_k_im x))
          q1357684_k_I);
  q1357684_k_norm_coordinates :
    forall x : K,
      q1357684_k_norm x =
      sqrt (q1357684_k_re x * q1357684_k_re x +
            q1357684_k_im x * q1357684_k_im x)
}.

Arguments q1357684_k_zero {K} _.
Arguments q1357684_k_one {K} _.
Arguments q1357684_k_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_inv {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_conj {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_norm {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_of_real {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_re {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_im {K} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_k_I {K} _.

Record q1357684_inner_product_space
    (K : Type) (F : q1357684_rclike K) (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1357684_e_zero : E;
  q1357684_e_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1357684_e_neg : E -> E;
  q1357684_e_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q1357684_e_norm : E -> R;
  q1357684_e_inner : E -> E -> K;

  q1357684_e_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1357684_e_add x (q1357684_e_add y z) =
      q1357684_e_add (q1357684_e_add x y) z;
  q1357684_e_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1357684_e_add x y = q1357684_e_add y x;
  q1357684_e_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1357684_e_add x q1357684_e_zero = x;
  q1357684_e_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1357684_e_add x (q1357684_e_neg x) = q1357684_e_zero;

  q1357684_e_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1357684_e_smul (q1357684_k_one F) x = x;
  q1357684_e_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1357684_e_smul (q1357684_k_mul F a b) x =
      q1357684_e_smul a (q1357684_e_smul b x);
  q1357684_e_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1357684_e_smul (q1357684_k_add F a b) x =
      q1357684_e_add
        (q1357684_e_smul a x) (q1357684_e_smul b x);
  q1357684_e_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1357684_e_smul a (q1357684_e_add x y) =
      q1357684_e_add
        (q1357684_e_smul a x) (q1357684_e_smul a y);
  q1357684_e_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q1357684_e_smul (q1357684_k_zero F) x = q1357684_e_zero;
  q1357684_e_smul_zero :
    forall a : K, q1357684_e_smul a q1357684_e_zero = q1357684_e_zero;

  q1357684_e_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1357684_e_norm x;
  q1357684_e_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q1357684_e_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1357684_e_zero;
  q1357684_e_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1357684_e_norm (q1357684_e_add x y) <=
      q1357684_e_norm x + q1357684_e_norm y;
  q1357684_e_norm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q1357684_e_norm (q1357684_e_smul a x) =
      q1357684_k_norm F a * q1357684_e_norm x;

  q1357684_e_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1357684_e_inner (q1357684_e_add x y) z =
      q1357684_k_add F
        (q1357684_e_inner x z) (q1357684_e_inner y z);
  q1357684_e_inner_add_right :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1357684_e_inner x (q1357684_e_add y z) =
      q1357684_k_add F
        (q1357684_e_inner x y) (q1357684_e_inner x z);
  q1357684_e_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1357684_e_inner (q1357684_e_smul a x) y =
      q1357684_k_mul F
        (q1357684_k_conj F a) (q1357684_e_inner x y);
  q1357684_e_inner_smul_right :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1357684_e_inner x (q1357684_e_smul a y) =
      q1357684_k_mul F a (q1357684_e_inner x y);
  q1357684_e_inner_conj_symm :
    forall x y : E,
      q1357684_e_inner y x =
      q1357684_k_conj F (q1357684_e_inner x y);
  q1357684_e_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : E,
      exists r : R,
        0 <= r /\
        q1357684_e_inner x x = q1357684_k_of_real F r;
  q1357684_e_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1357684_e_inner x x = q1357684_k_zero F <->
      x = q1357684_e_zero;
  q1357684_e_norm_sq :
    forall x : E,
      q1357684_e_norm x * q1357684_e_norm x =
      q1357684_k_re F (q1357684_e_inner x x)
}.

Arguments q1357684_e_zero {K F E} _.
Arguments q1357684_e_add {K F E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1357684_e_neg {K F E} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_e_smul {K F E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1357684_e_norm {K F E} _ _.
Arguments q1357684_e_inner {K F E} _ _ _.

Definition q1357684_e_sub
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1357684_e_add H x (q1357684_e_neg H y).

Definition q1357684_sequence_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat ->
      q1357684_e_norm H (q1357684_e_sub H (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1357684_sequence_cauchy
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat, forall m n : nat,
      (N <= m)%nat ->
      (N <= n)%nat ->
      q1357684_e_norm H (q1357684_e_sub H (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1357684_complete
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q1357684_sequence_cauchy H u ->
    exists limit : E, q1357684_sequence_converges H u limit.

Definition q1357684_continuous_linear_functional
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E)
    (ell : E -> K) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : E,
    ell (q1357684_e_add H x y) =
    q1357684_k_add F (ell x) (ell y)) /\
  (forall (a : K) (x : E),
    ell (q1357684_e_smul H a x) =
    q1357684_k_mul F a (ell x)) /\
  exists bound : R,
    0 <= bound /\
    forall x : E,
      q1357684_k_norm F (ell x) <= bound * q1357684_e_norm H x.

Definition q1357684_dual_norm_has_value
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E)
    (ell : E -> K) (value : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= value /\
  (forall x : E,
    q1357684_k_norm F (ell x) <= value * q1357684_e_norm H x) /\
  forall bound : R,
    0 <= bound ->
    (forall x : E,
      q1357684_k_norm F (ell x) <= bound * q1357684_e_norm H x) ->
    value <= bound.

Definition q1357684_to_dual_map
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E)
    (x y : E) : K :=
  q1357684_e_inner H x y.

Definition q1357684_is_conjugate_linear_isometric_equivalence
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1357684_rclike K}
    (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E) : Prop :=
  (forall x : E,
    q1357684_continuous_linear_functional H
      (q1357684_to_dual_map H x)) /\
  (forall x y z : E,
    q1357684_to_dual_map H (q1357684_e_add H x y) z =
    q1357684_k_add F
      (q1357684_to_dual_map H x z)
      (q1357684_to_dual_map H y z)) /\
  (forall (a : K) (x z : E),
    q1357684_to_dual_map H (q1357684_e_smul H a x) z =
    q1357684_k_mul F
      (q1357684_k_conj F a)
      (q1357684_to_dual_map H x z)) /\
  (forall x : E,
    q1357684_dual_norm_has_value H
      (q1357684_to_dual_map H x) (q1357684_e_norm H x)) /\
  (forall x y : E,
    (forall z : E,
      q1357684_to_dual_map H x z =
      q1357684_to_dual_map H y z) ->
    x = y) /\
  forall ell : E -> K,
    q1357684_continuous_linear_functional H ell ->
    exists x : E,
      forall y : E, q1357684_to_dual_map H x y = ell y.

Theorem InnerProductSpace_toDual :
  forall (K E : Type)
         (F : q1357684_rclike K)
         (H : q1357684_inner_product_space F E),
    q1357684_complete H ->
    q1357684_is_conjugate_linear_isometric_equivalence H.
Admitted.

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1357684 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1357684), "Riesz representation
  theorem": every bounded linear functional on a real or complex Hilbert
  space has a unique inner-product representing vector, with the same
  operator norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1357684_operator_norm ::
    "('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1357684_operator_norm f =
    Sup {norm (f x) | x. norm x \<le> 1}"

definition q1357684_real_inner_product_space ::
    "('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1357684_real_inner_product_space ip \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y z. ip (x + y) z = ip x z + ip y z) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x y. ip (scaleR r x) y = r * ip x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. ip x y = ip y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. ip x x = norm x ^ 2)"

definition q1357684_real_linear ::
    "('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1357684_real_linear f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. f (scaleR r x) = r * f x)"

definition q1357684_complex_vector_space ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1357684_complex_vector_space scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. scale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (scale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q1357684_complex_inner_product_space ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1357684_complex_inner_product_space scale ip \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1357684_complex_vector_space scale \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. ip x (y + z) = ip x y + ip x z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. ip x (scale a y) = a * ip x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. ip x y = cnj (ip y x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. ip x x = of_real (norm x ^ 2))"

definition q1357684_complex_linear ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1357684_complex_linear scale f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. f (scale a x) = a * f x)"

definition q1357684_bounded ::
    "('e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1357684_bounded f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>C \<ge> 0. \<forall>x. norm (f x) \<le> C * norm x)"

theorem riesz_representation_real:
  fixes ip :: "'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> real"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "q1357684_real_inner_product_space ip"
    and "q1357684_real_linear f"
    and "q1357684_bounded f"
  shows "\<exists>y.
    (\<forall>x. f x = ip y x) \<and>
    norm y = q1357684_operator_norm f \<and>
    (\<forall>z. (\<forall>x. f x = ip z x) \<longrightarrow> z = y)"
  sorry

theorem riesz_representation_complex:
  fixes scale :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and ip :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes "q1357684_complex_inner_product_space scale ip"
    and "q1357684_complex_linear scale f"
    and "q1357684_bounded f"
  shows "\<exists>y.
    (\<forall>x. f x = ip y x) \<and>
    norm y = q1357684_operator_norm f \<and>
    (\<forall>z. (\<forall>x. f x = ip z x) \<longrightarrow> z = y)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1357684,
  "Riesz representation theorem": inner product with a vector gives a
  conjugate-linear isometric equivalence from an arbitrary real or complex
  Hilbert space to its continuous dual. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q1357684_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q1357684_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q1357684_output;;
let q1357684_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q1357684_formatter path);;
let q1357684_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q1357684_formatter "Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q1357684_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q1357684_formatter ();;
close_out q1357684_output;;
if not q1357684_loaded then failwith "Unable to load complex library";;

let Q1357684_RIESZ_REPRESENTATION_THEOREM =
 `let real_vector_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
      (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let real_inner_product =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real).
      (!x y z:V.
         inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let real_vector_norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt(inner x x) in
  let real_tends_to =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
     (u:num->V) (x:V).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n
              ==> real_vector_norm inner (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let real_complete =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
      !u:num->V.
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                 N <= m /\ N <= n
                 ==> real_vector_norm inner
                       (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
        ==> ?x:V. real_tends_to add neg inner u x in
  let real_continuous_linear =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
     (l:V->real).
      (!x y:V. l (add x y) = l x + l y) /\
      (!a:real. !x:V. l (smul a x) = a * l x) /\
      (?C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         !x:V. abs(l x) <= C * real_vector_norm inner x) in
  let real_has_dual_norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (l:V->real) (r:real).
      &0 <= r /\
      (!x:V. abs(l x) <= r * real_vector_norm inner x) /\
      (!C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         (!x:V. abs(l x) <= C * real_vector_norm inner x)
         ==> r <= C) in
  let complex_vector_space =
    \(zero:W) (add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W)
     (smul:complex->W->W).
      (!x y z:W. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:W. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:W. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:W. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:W. smul (Cx(&1)) x = x) /\
      (!a b:complex. !x:W.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:complex. !x:W.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:complex. !x y:W.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let complex_inner_product =
    \(zero:W) (add:W->W->W) (smul:complex->W->W)
     (inner:W->W->complex).
      (!x y z:W.
         inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a:complex. !x y:W.
         inner (smul a x) y = cnj(a) * inner x y) /\
      (!x y:W. cnj(inner y x) = inner x y) /\
      (!x:W. Im(inner x x) = &0 /\ &0 <= Re(inner x x)) /\
      (!x:W. inner x x = Cx(&0) <=> x = zero) in
  let complex_vector_norm =
    \(inner:W->W->complex) (x:W). sqrt(Re(inner x x)) in
  let complex_tends_to =
    \(add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W) (inner:W->W->complex)
     (u:num->W) (x:W).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n
              ==> complex_vector_norm inner
                    (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let complex_complete =
    \(add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W) (inner:W->W->complex).
      !u:num->W.
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                 N <= m /\ N <= n
                 ==> complex_vector_norm inner
                       (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
        ==> ?x:W. complex_tends_to add neg inner u x in
  let complex_continuous_linear =
    \(add:W->W->W) (smul:complex->W->W)
     (inner:W->W->complex) (l:W->complex).
      (!x y:W. l (add x y) = l x + l y) /\
      (!a:complex. !x:W. l (smul a x) = a * l x) /\
      (?C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         !x:W. norm(l x) <= C * complex_vector_norm inner x) in
  let complex_has_dual_norm =
    \(inner:W->W->complex) (l:W->complex) (r:real).
      &0 <= r /\
      (!x:W. norm(l x) <= r * complex_vector_norm inner x) /\
      (!C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         (!x:W. norm(l x) <= C * complex_vector_norm inner x)
         ==> r <= C) in
  ((!zero:V.
    !add:V->V->V.
    !neg:V->V.
    !smul:real->V->V.
    !inner:V->V->real.
      real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
      real_inner_product zero add smul inner /\
      real_complete add neg inner
      ==> ?to_dual:V->V->real.
          ?from_dual:(V->real)->V.
            (!x y:V. to_dual x y = inner x y) /\
            (!x:V.
               real_continuous_linear add smul inner (to_dual x)) /\
            (!x:V.
               real_has_dual_norm inner (to_dual x)
                 (real_vector_norm inner x)) /\
            (!x:V. from_dual (to_dual x) = x) /\
            (!l:V->real.
               real_continuous_linear add smul inner l
               ==> to_dual (from_dual l) = l)) /\
   (!zero:W.
    !add:W->W->W.
    !neg:W->W.
    !smul:complex->W->W.
    !inner:W->W->complex.
      complex_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
      complex_inner_product zero add smul inner /\
      complex_complete add neg inner
      ==> ?to_dual:W->W->complex.
          ?from_dual:(W->complex)->W.
            (!x y:W. to_dual x y = inner x y) /\
            (!x:W.
               complex_continuous_linear add smul inner (to_dual x)) /\
            (!x:W.
               complex_has_dual_norm inner (to_dual x)
                 (complex_vector_norm inner x)) /\
            (!x:W. from_dual (to_dual x) = x) /\
            (!l:W->complex.
               complex_continuous_linear add smul inner l
               ==> to_dual (from_dual l) = l)))`;;

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1357684,
;; "Riesz representation theorem": every continuous linear functional on a
;; real or complex Hilbert space is inner product with a unique vector. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A context tag indexes arbitrary real and scalar fields, an arbitrary vector
;; carrier, their operations, inner product, sequences, and linear
;; functionals. Conservative generic symbols avoid finite carriers or tables;
;; every algebraic, order, completeness, continuity, and typing law used by
;; the statement is explicit below.

;; The complete ordered real field underlying an RCLike scalar field.

(defstub q1357684-real-member-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-one (ctx) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-mul (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-inv (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-lt (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-set-member-p (ctx set-tag x) t)

(defun q1357684-real-le-p (ctx x y)
  (not (q1357684-real-lt ctx y x)))

(defun q1357684-positive-real-p (ctx x)
  (and
   (q1357684-real-member-p ctx x)
   (q1357684-real-lt
    ctx (q1357684-real-zero ctx) x)))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx y)
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q1357684-real-zero ctx))
           (one (q1357684-real-one ctx)))
       (and
        (q1357684-real-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-real-add ctx x y))
        (q1357684-real-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-real-mul ctx x y))
        (q1357684-real-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-real-neg ctx x))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (q1357684-real-member-p
          ctx (q1357684-real-inv ctx x)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-add
          ctx (q1357684-real-add ctx x y) z)
         (q1357684-real-add
          ctx x (q1357684-real-add ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-add ctx x y)
         (q1357684-real-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q1357684-real-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-add
          ctx x (q1357684-real-neg ctx x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-mul
          ctx (q1357684-real-mul ctx x y) z)
         (q1357684-real-mul
          ctx x (q1357684-real-mul ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-mul ctx x y)
         (q1357684-real-mul ctx y x))
        (equal (q1357684-real-mul ctx x one) x)
        (equal (q1357684-real-inv ctx zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1357684-real-mul
           ctx x (q1357684-real-inv ctx x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-mul
          ctx x (q1357684-real-add ctx y z))
         (q1357684-real-add
          ctx
          (q1357684-real-mul ctx x y)
          (q1357684-real-mul ctx x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx y)
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q1357684-real-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (not (q1357684-real-lt ctx x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1357684-real-lt ctx x y)
         (q1357684-real-lt ctx y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1357684-real-lt ctx x y)
          (q1357684-real-lt ctx y z))
         (q1357684-real-lt ctx x z))
        (implies
         (q1357684-real-lt ctx x y)
         (q1357684-real-lt
          ctx
          (q1357684-real-add ctx x z)
          (q1357684-real-add ctx y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1357684-real-lt ctx zero x)
          (q1357684-real-lt ctx zero y))
         (q1357684-real-lt
          ctx zero (q1357684-real-mul ctx x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-set-nonempty-p (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1357684-real-member-p ctx x)
     (q1357684-real-set-member-p ctx set-tag x))))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-upper-bound-p (ctx set-tag upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-real-set-member-p ctx set-tag x))
     (q1357684-real-le-p ctx x upper))))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-bounded-above-p (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (q1357684-real-member-p ctx upper)
     (q1357684-real-upper-bound-p
      ctx set-tag upper))))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set-tag supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx upper)
      (q1357684-real-upper-bound-p
       ctx set-tag upper))
     (q1357684-real-le-p ctx supremum upper))))

(defun q1357684-real-supremum-p (ctx set-tag supremum)
  (and
   (q1357684-real-member-p ctx supremum)
   (q1357684-real-upper-bound-p
    ctx set-tag supremum)
   (q1357684-real-least-upper-bound-p
    ctx set-tag supremum)))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-has-supremum-p (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1357684-real-supremum-p
     ctx set-tag supremum)))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-complete-p (ctx)
  (forall (set-tag)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-real-set-nonempty-p ctx set-tag)
      (q1357684-real-bounded-above-p ctx set-tag))
     (q1357684-real-has-supremum-p
      ctx set-tag))))

(defun q1357684-real-field-p (ctx)
  (let ((zero (q1357684-real-zero ctx))
        (one (q1357684-real-one ctx)))
    (and
     (q1357684-real-member-p ctx zero)
     (q1357684-real-member-p ctx one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1357684-real-lt ctx zero one)
     (q1357684-real-field-laws-p ctx)
     (q1357684-real-order-laws-p ctx)
     (q1357684-real-complete-p ctx))))

;; The scalar field is either the real field or its quadratic complexification.

(defstub q1357684-complexp (ctx) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-member-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-one (ctx) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-mul (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-scalar-inv (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-star (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-of-real (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-real-part (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-imag-part (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-imaginary-unit (ctx) t)

(defun-sk q1357684-scalar-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx y)
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q1357684-scalar-zero ctx))
           (one (q1357684-scalar-one ctx)))
       (and
        (q1357684-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-scalar-add ctx x y))
        (q1357684-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x y))
        (q1357684-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-scalar-neg ctx x))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (q1357684-scalar-member-p
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-inv ctx x)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-add ctx x y) z)
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx x (q1357684-scalar-add ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-scalar-add ctx x y)
         (q1357684-scalar-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q1357684-scalar-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx x (q1357684-scalar-neg ctx x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q1357684-scalar-mul
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x y) z)
         (q1357684-scalar-mul
          ctx x (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x y)
         (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx y x))
        (equal (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x one) x)
        (equal (q1357684-scalar-inv ctx zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1357684-scalar-mul
           ctx x (q1357684-scalar-inv ctx x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q1357684-scalar-mul
          ctx x (q1357684-scalar-add ctx y z))
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx
          (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x y)
          (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-real-embedding-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx r)
      (q1357684-real-member-p ctx s))
     (let ((of-r (q1357684-of-real ctx r))
           (of-s (q1357684-of-real ctx s)))
       (and
        (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx of-r)
        (equal
         (q1357684-real-part ctx of-r) r)
        (equal
         (q1357684-imag-part ctx of-r)
         (q1357684-real-zero ctx))
        (equal
         (q1357684-of-real
          ctx (q1357684-real-add ctx r s))
         (q1357684-scalar-add ctx of-r of-s))
        (equal
         (q1357684-of-real
          ctx (q1357684-real-mul ctx r s))
         (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx of-r of-s))
        (equal
         (q1357684-of-real
          ctx (q1357684-real-neg ctx r))
         (q1357684-scalar-neg ctx of-r)))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-scalar-coordinate-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx y))
     (let* ((re-x (q1357684-real-part ctx x))
            (im-x (q1357684-imag-part ctx x))
            (of-re-x (q1357684-of-real ctx re-x))
            (of-im-x (q1357684-of-real ctx im-x))
            (i (q1357684-imaginary-unit ctx))
            (im-coordinate
             (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx of-im-x i)))
       (and
        (q1357684-real-member-p ctx re-x)
        (q1357684-real-member-p ctx im-x)
        (q1357684-scalar-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-star ctx x))
        (equal
         x
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx of-re-x im-coordinate))
        (equal
         (q1357684-star ctx x)
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx
          of-re-x
          (q1357684-scalar-neg ctx im-coordinate)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-star
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-add ctx x y))
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx
          (q1357684-star ctx x)
          (q1357684-star ctx y)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-star
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx x y))
         (q1357684-scalar-mul
          ctx
          (q1357684-star ctx x)
          (q1357684-star ctx y)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-star
          ctx (q1357684-star ctx x))
         x)
        (if (q1357684-complexp ctx)
            t
          (and
           (equal im-x (q1357684-real-zero ctx))
           (equal x of-re-x)
           (equal (q1357684-star ctx x) x))))))))

(defun q1357684-rclike-field-p (ctx)
  (let ((real-zero (q1357684-real-zero ctx))
        (real-one (q1357684-real-one ctx))
        (zero (q1357684-scalar-zero ctx))
        (one (q1357684-scalar-one ctx))
        (i (q1357684-imaginary-unit ctx)))
    (and
     (booleanp (q1357684-complexp ctx))
     (q1357684-real-field-p ctx)
     (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx zero)
     (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx i)
     (equal (q1357684-of-real ctx real-zero) zero)
     (equal (q1357684-of-real ctx real-one) one)
     (equal (q1357684-real-part ctx zero) real-zero)
     (equal (q1357684-imag-part ctx zero) real-zero)
     (equal (q1357684-real-part ctx one) real-one)
     (equal (q1357684-imag-part ctx one) real-zero)
     (q1357684-scalar-field-laws-p ctx)
     (q1357684-real-embedding-laws-p ctx)
     (q1357684-scalar-coordinate-laws-p ctx)
     (if (q1357684-complexp ctx)
         (and
          (equal (q1357684-real-part ctx i) real-zero)
          (equal (q1357684-imag-part ctx i) real-one)
          (equal
           (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx i i)
           (q1357684-scalar-neg ctx one)))
       (equal i zero)))))

(defun q1357684-scalar-norm-square (ctx x)
  (q1357684-real-add
   ctx
   (q1357684-real-mul
    ctx
    (q1357684-real-part ctx x)
    (q1357684-real-part ctx x))
   (q1357684-real-mul
    ctx
    (q1357684-imag-part ctx x)
    (q1357684-imag-part ctx x))))

;; Inner-product spaces and their norm topology.

(defstub q1357684-vector-member-p (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-vector-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q1357684-vector-add (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-vector-neg (ctx x) t)
(defstub q1357684-vector-smul (ctx a x) t)
(defstub q1357684-inner (ctx x y) t)
(defstub q1357684-sequence-value (ctx sequence-tag n) t)

(defun q1357684-vector-sub (ctx x y)
  (q1357684-vector-add
   ctx x (q1357684-vector-neg ctx y)))

(defun q1357684-scalar-sub (ctx x y)
  (q1357684-scalar-add
   ctx x (q1357684-scalar-neg ctx y)))

(defun q1357684-vector-norm-square (ctx x)
  (q1357684-real-part
   ctx (q1357684-inner ctx x x)))

(defun q1357684-vector-distance-lt-p
    (ctx x y epsilon)
  (q1357684-real-lt
   ctx
   (q1357684-vector-norm-square
    ctx (q1357684-vector-sub ctx x y))
   (q1357684-real-mul ctx epsilon epsilon)))

(defun q1357684-scalar-distance-lt-p
    (ctx x y epsilon)
  (q1357684-real-lt
   ctx
   (q1357684-scalar-norm-square
    ctx (q1357684-scalar-sub ctx x y))
   (q1357684-real-mul ctx epsilon epsilon)))

(defun-sk q1357684-vector-space-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx a)
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx b)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx y)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q1357684-vector-zero ctx))
           (one (q1357684-scalar-one ctx)))
       (and
        (q1357684-vector-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-vector-add ctx x y))
        (q1357684-vector-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-vector-neg ctx x))
        (q1357684-vector-member-p
         ctx (q1357684-vector-smul ctx a x))
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-add
          ctx (q1357684-vector-add ctx x y) z)
         (q1357684-vector-add
          ctx x (q1357684-vector-add ctx y z)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-add ctx x y)
         (q1357684-vector-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q1357684-vector-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-add
          ctx x (q1357684-vector-neg ctx x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-smul ctx one x) x)
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-smul
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx a b) x)
         (q1357684-vector-smul
          ctx a (q1357684-vector-smul ctx b x)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-smul
          ctx (q1357684-scalar-add ctx a b) x)
         (q1357684-vector-add
          ctx
          (q1357684-vector-smul ctx a x)
          (q1357684-vector-smul ctx b x)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-vector-smul
          ctx a (q1357684-vector-add ctx x y))
         (q1357684-vector-add
          ctx
          (q1357684-vector-smul ctx a x)
          (q1357684-vector-smul ctx a y))))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-inner-product-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx a)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx y)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((inner-xy (q1357684-inner ctx x y))
           (inner-xx (q1357684-inner ctx x x))
           (real-zero (q1357684-real-zero ctx))
           (scalar-zero (q1357684-scalar-zero ctx))
           (vector-zero (q1357684-vector-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx inner-xy)
        (equal
         (q1357684-inner
          ctx x (q1357684-vector-add ctx y z))
         (q1357684-scalar-add
          ctx inner-xy (q1357684-inner ctx x z)))
        (equal
         (q1357684-inner
          ctx x (q1357684-vector-smul ctx a y))
         (q1357684-scalar-mul ctx a inner-xy))
        (equal
         (q1357684-inner ctx y x)
         (q1357684-star ctx inner-xy))
        (equal
         (q1357684-imag-part ctx inner-xx)
         real-zero)
        (q1357684-real-le-p
         ctx real-zero
         (q1357684-real-part ctx inner-xx))
        (iff
         (equal inner-xx scalar-zero)
         (equal x vector-zero)))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-sequence-values-p (ctx sequence-tag)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1357684-vector-member-p
      ctx
      (q1357684-sequence-value
       ctx sequence-tag n)))))

(defun-sk q1357684-cauchy-tail-p
    (ctx sequence-tag epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q1357684-vector-distance-lt-p
      ctx
      (q1357684-sequence-value
       ctx sequence-tag m)
      (q1357684-sequence-value
       ctx sequence-tag n)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1357684-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx sequence-tag epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1357684-cauchy-tail-p
      ctx sequence-tag epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1357684-cauchy-p (ctx sequence-tag)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1357684-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (q1357684-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx sequence-tag epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1357684-convergence-tail-p
    (ctx sequence-tag limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q1357684-vector-distance-lt-p
      ctx
      (q1357684-sequence-value
       ctx sequence-tag n)
      limit
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1357684-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (ctx sequence-tag limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1357684-convergence-tail-p
      ctx sequence-tag limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1357684-converges-p
    (ctx sequence-tag limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1357684-positive-real-p ctx epsilon)
     (q1357684-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      ctx sequence-tag limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1357684-limit-exists-p
    (ctx sequence-tag)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx limit)
     (q1357684-converges-p
      ctx sequence-tag limit))))

(defun-sk q1357684-complete-space-p (ctx)
  (forall (sequence-tag)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-sequence-values-p
       ctx sequence-tag)
      (q1357684-cauchy-p
       ctx sequence-tag))
     (q1357684-limit-exists-p
      ctx sequence-tag))))

(defun q1357684-hilbert-space-p (ctx)
  (and
   (q1357684-vector-member-p
    ctx (q1357684-vector-zero ctx))
   (q1357684-vector-space-laws-p ctx)
   (q1357684-inner-product-laws-p ctx)
   (q1357684-complete-space-p ctx)))

;; Strong-dual elements are arbitrary functional tags whose applications are
;; scalar-valued, linear, and continuous in the norm topology above.

(defstub q1357684-functional-value
  (ctx functional-tag vector)
  t)

(defun-sk q1357684-linear-functional-laws-p
    (ctx functional-tag)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p ctx a)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx y))
     (and
      (q1357684-scalar-member-p
       ctx
       (q1357684-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag x))
      (equal
       (q1357684-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag
        (q1357684-vector-add ctx x y))
       (q1357684-scalar-add
        ctx
        (q1357684-functional-value
         ctx functional-tag x)
        (q1357684-functional-value
         ctx functional-tag y)))
      (equal
       (q1357684-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag
        (q1357684-vector-smul ctx a x))
       (q1357684-scalar-mul
        ctx a
        (q1357684-functional-value
         ctx functional-tag x)))))))

(defun-sk q1357684-functional-neighborhood-p
    (ctx functional-tag x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1357684-vector-member-p ctx y)
      (q1357684-vector-distance-lt-p
       ctx y x delta))
     (q1357684-scalar-distance-lt-p
      ctx
      (q1357684-functional-value
       ctx functional-tag y)
      (q1357684-functional-value
       ctx functional-tag x)
      epsilon))))
