title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1357684,
-- "Riesz representation theorem": a complete inner-product space over a scalar field explicitly
-- equivalent to the reals or complexes is conjugate-linearly and isometrically equivalent to its
-- continuous dual via the map sending x to the functional y |-> <x,y>. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

data ScalarKind : Set where
  realScalar    : ScalarKind
  complexScalar : ScalarKind

data CanonicalScalar (R : Set) : ScalarKind -> Set where
  realValue :
    R ->
    CanonicalScalar R realScalar
  complexValue :
    R ->
    R ->
    CanonicalScalar R complexScalar

canonicalZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalZero reals realScalar =
  realValue (zeroR reals)
canonicalZero reals complexScalar =
  complexValue (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

canonicalOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalOne reals realScalar =
  realValue (oneR reals)
canonicalOne reals complexScalar =
  complexValue (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

canonicalAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalAdd reals realScalar (realValue x) (realValue y) =
  realValue (addR reals x y)
canonicalAdd reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) (complexValue c d) =
  complexValue
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

canonicalMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalMultiply reals realScalar (realValue x) (realValue y) =
  realValue (multiplyR reals x y)
canonicalMultiply reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) (complexValue c d) =
  complexValue
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (negateR reals (multiplyR reals b d)))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

canonicalNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalNegate reals realScalar (realValue x) =
  realValue (negateR reals x)
canonicalNegate reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  complexValue (negateR reals a) (negateR reals b)

canonicalConjugate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalConjugate reals realScalar (realValue x) =
  realValue x
canonicalConjugate reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  complexValue a (negateR reals b)

canonicalRealPart :
  {R : Set} ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  R
canonicalRealPart realScalar (realValue x) =
  x
canonicalRealPart complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  a

CanonicalReciprocal :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  Set
CanonicalReciprocal reals kind x y =
  Both
    (x == canonicalZero reals kind -> y == canonicalZero reals kind)
    (x != canonicalZero reals kind ->
      canonicalMultiply reals kind x y == canonicalOne reals kind)

CanonicalNormValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  R ->
  Set
CanonicalNormValue reals realScalar (realValue x) value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
    (multiplyR reals value value == multiplyR reals x x)
CanonicalNormValue reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
    (multiplyR reals value value ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals a a)
        (multiplyR reals b b))

record RCLike
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK conjugateK : K -> K
    realPartK : K -> R
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z == multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    conjugate-involutiveK :
      (x : K) -> conjugateK (conjugateK x) == x
    conjugate-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      conjugateK (addK x y) == addK (conjugateK x) (conjugateK y)
    conjugate-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      conjugateK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyK (conjugateK x) (conjugateK y)
    conjugate-zeroK :
      conjugateK zeroK == zeroK
    conjugate-oneK :
      conjugateK oneK == oneK

    real-part-zeroK :
      realPartK zeroK == zeroR reals
    real-part-oneK :
      realPartK oneK == oneR reals
    real-part-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      realPartK (addK x y) ==
      addR reals (realPartK x) (realPartK y)
    real-part-conjugateK :
      (x : K) -> realPartK (conjugateK x) == realPartK x

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) -> normK x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-conjugateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (conjugateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)
    norm-squareK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK x) ==
      realPartK (multiplyK (conjugateK x) x)

    scalar-kind :
      ScalarKind
    to-canonical :
      K -> CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind
    from-canonical :
      CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind -> K
    from-after-to-canonical :
      (x : K) ->
      from-canonical (to-canonical x) == x
    to-after-from-canonical :
      (x : CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind) ->
      to-canonical (from-canonical x) == x

    to-canonical-zero :
      to-canonical zeroK == canonicalZero reals scalar-kind
    to-canonical-one :
      to-canonical oneK == canonicalOne reals scalar-kind
    to-canonical-add :
      (x y : K) ->
      to-canonical (addK x y) ==
      canonicalAdd reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (to-canonical y)
    to-canonical-multiply :
      (x y : K) ->
      to-canonical (multiplyK x y) ==
      canonicalMultiply reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (to-canonical y)
    to-canonical-negate :
      (x : K) ->
      to-canonical (negateK x) ==
      canonicalNegate reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x)
    to-canonical-reciprocal :
      (x : K) ->
      CanonicalReciprocal reals scalar-kind
        (to-canonical x)
        (to-canonical (reciprocalK x))
    to-canonical-conjugate :
      (x : K) ->
      to-canonical (conjugateK x) ==
      canonicalConjugate reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x)
    to-canonical-real-part :
      (x : K) ->
      realPartK x == canonicalRealPart scalar-kind (to-canonical x)
    to-canonical-norm :
      (x : K) ->
      CanonicalNormValue reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (normK x)

    completeK :
      (sequence : Nat -> K) ->
      ((epsilon : R) ->
        Positive reals epsilon ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ cutoff ->
            (m n : Nat) ->
            cutoff <=N m ->
            cutoff <=N n ->
            StrictLess reals
              (normK
                (addK (sequence m) (negateK (sequence n))))
              epsilon)) ->
      Exists K
        (\ limit ->
          (epsilon : R) ->
          Positive reals epsilon ->
          Exists Nat
            (\ cutoff ->
              (n : Nat) ->
              cutoff <=N n ->
              StrictLess reals
                (normK
                  (addK (sequence n) (negateK limit)))
                epsilon))

open RCLike

record InnerProductSpace
  (K R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : K -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R
    inner : E -> E -> K

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK scalars a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK scalars a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) -> normE x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) -> normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normE x)

    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : E) ->
      inner (addE x y) z ==
      addK scalars (inner x z) (inner y z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      inner (scaleE a x) y ==
      multiplyK scalars (conjugateK scalars a) (inner x y)
    inner-add-right :
      (x y z : E) ->
      inner x (addE y z) ==
      addK scalars (inner x y) (inner x z)
    inner-scale-right :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      inner x (scaleE a y) ==
      multiplyK scalars a (inner x y)
    inner-conjugate-symmetry :
      (x y : E) ->
      inner x y == conjugateK scalars (inner y x)
    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (realPartK scalars (inner x x))
    inner-definite :
      (x : E) ->
      inner x x == zeroK scalars ->
      x == zeroE
    inner-norm-square :
      (x : E) ->
      multiplyR reals (normE x) (normE x) ==
      realPartK scalars (inner x x)

open InnerProductSpace

distanceE :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (addE space x (negateE space y))

SequentialLimit :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceE space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceE space (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Complete :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  Set
Complete {E = E} space =
  (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists E (\ limit -> SequentialLimit space sequence limit)

record ContinuousLinearFunctional
  {K R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals}
  (space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars) : Set1 where
  field
    apply : E -> K
    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addE space x y) ==
      addK scalars (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleE space a x) ==
      multiplyK scalars a (apply x)
    continuous-at-zero :
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Both
            (Positive reals delta)
            ((x : E) ->
              StrictLess reals (normE space x) delta ->
              StrictLess reals (normK scalars (apply x)) epsilon))

open ContinuousLinearFunctional

record OperatorNormValue
  {K R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals}
  {space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars}
  (functional : ContinuousLinearFunctional space)
  (value : R) : Set1 where
  field
    nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value
    bounds :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK scalars (apply functional x))
        (multiplyR reals value (normE space x))
    least-bound :
      (bound : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) bound ->
      ((x : E) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (normK scalars (apply functional x))
          (multiplyR reals bound (normE space x))) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals value bound

record ConjugateLinearIsometricEquivalence
  {K R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals}
  (space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars) : Set1 where
  field
    forward :
      E -> ContinuousLinearFunctional space
    backward :
      ContinuousLinearFunctional space -> E

    forward-application :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (forward x) y == inner space x y
    forward-add :
      (x y z : E) ->
      apply (forward (addE space x y)) z ==
      addK scalars (apply (forward x) z) (apply (forward y) z)
    forward-conjugate-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (forward (scaleE space a x)) y ==
      multiplyK scalars
        (conjugateK scalars a)
        (apply (forward x) y)

    backward-after-forward :
      (x : E) ->
      backward (forward x) == x
    forward-after-backward :
      (functional : ContinuousLinearFunctional space) ->
      (y : E) ->
      apply (forward (backward functional)) y ==
      apply functional y

    forward-isometry :
      (x : E) ->
      OperatorNormValue (forward x) (normE space x)

riesz-representation-theorem : Set1
riesz-representation-theorem =
  (R K E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) ->
  (space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  Complete space ->
  ConjugateLinearIsometricEquivalence space

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1357684 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1357684), "Riesz representation
  theorem": inner product with a vector gives a conjugate-linear isometric
  equivalence from a real or complex Hilbert space to its continuous dual.
  This file contains no proof.

val InnerProductSpace_toDual_real =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real).

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1357684
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1357684), "Riesz representation theorem":
  on every complete real or complex inner-product space, the canonical map
  from a vector to its inner-product functional is a conjugate-linear
  isometric equivalence with the bounded linear dual. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's CHil class consists of complete real or complex inner-product
  spaces. For W in CHil, W NMHom ( ringLMod ` ( Scalar ` W ) ) is the space
  of bounded linear functionals on W. SetMM's inner product is linear in its
  first slot, opposite to mathlib's convention, so ( y ( .i ` W ) x )
  faithfully renders mathlib's inner product inner x y.

  The displayed map is therefore exactly InnerProductSpace.toDual. Its
  explicit inner-product definition supplies conjugate linearity, while the
  two asserted properties say that it is bijective onto the continuous dual
  and preserves the norm. Together these are the source conjugate-linear
  isometric equivalence. The final declaration is the single unproved corpus
  $a statement; this root statement file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d W x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q1357684-riesz-representation $a |-
    A. W e. CHil
      (
        (
          x e. ( Base ` W )
            |->
          (
            y e. ( Base ` W )
              |->
            ( y ( .i ` W ) x )
          )
        )
        :
        ( Base ` W )
        -1-1-onto->
        (
          W
          NMHom
          ( ringLMod ` ( Scalar ` W ) )
        )
        /\
        A. x e. ( Base ` W )
          (
            (
              W
              normOp
              ( ringLMod ` ( Scalar ` W ) )
            )
            `
            (
              (
                x e. ( Base ` W )
                  |->
                (
                  y e. ( Base ` W )
                    |->
                  ( y ( .i ` W ) x )
                )
              )
              `
              x
            )
          )
          =
          ( ( norm ` W ) ` x )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q1357684_riesz_representation_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1357684
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1357684), "Riesz representation theorem": on every
% real or complex Hilbert space, the canonical inner-product map is a
% conjugate-linear isometric equivalence onto the continuous dual. This file
% contains no proof.

riesz_representation_theorem_Q1357684[
  E: TYPE+,
  complex_case: bool,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  inner_re: [E, E -> real],
  inner_im: [E, E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  real_function: TYPE = [E -> real]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  scalar_valid(real_part, imag_part: real): bool =
    complex_case OR imag_part = 0

  scalar_norm_squared(real_part, imag_part: real): real =
    real_part ^ 2 + imag_part ^ 2

  scalar_product_re(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_re - left_im * right_im

  scalar_product_im(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_im + left_im * right_re

  scalar_mode_laws: bool =
    NOT complex_case IMPLIES
      FORALL (x, y: E):
        inner_im(x, y) = 0

  additive_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  scalar_module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL
        (a_re, a_im: real),
        (x, y: E):
      scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
        smulE(a_re, a_im, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(
            smulE(a_re, a_im, x),
            smulE(a_re, a_im, y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: E):
        (scalar_valid(a_re, a_im)
          AND scalar_valid(b_re, b_im))
        IMPLIES
          smulE(a_re + b_re, a_im + b_im, x) =
            addE(
              smulE(a_re, a_im, x),
              smulE(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: E):
        (scalar_valid(a_re, a_im)
          AND scalar_valid(b_re, b_im))
        IMPLIES
          smulE(
            scalar_product_re(a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
            scalar_product_im(a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
            x)
          =
            smulE(
              a_re,
              a_im,
              smulE(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, 0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a_re, a_im: real):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          smulE(a_re, a_im, zeroE) = zeroE)

  norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: E):
      0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          normE(smulE(a_re, a_im, x)) ^ 2 =
            scalar_norm_squared(a_re, a_im) * normE(x) ^ 2)

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      inner_re(addE(x, y), z) =
        inner_re(x, z) + inner_re(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        inner_im(addE(x, y), z) =
          inner_im(x, z) + inner_im(y, z))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_re(smulE(a_re, a_im, x), y) =
            a_re * inner_re(x, y) + a_im * inner_im(x, y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_im(smulE(a_re, a_im, x), y) =
            a_re * inner_im(x, y) - a_im * inner_re(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        inner_re(x, addE(y, z)) =
          inner_re(x, y) + inner_re(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        inner_im(x, addE(y, z)) =
          inner_im(x, y) + inner_im(x, z))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_re(x, smulE(a_re, a_im, y)) =
            a_re * inner_re(x, y) - a_im * inner_im(x, y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_im(x, smulE(a_re, a_im, y)) =
            a_re * inner_im(x, y) + a_im * inner_re(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        inner_re(x, y) = inner_re(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        inner_im(x, y) = -inner_im(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        inner_im(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= inner_re(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        inner_re(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) ^ 2 = inner_re(x, x))

  converges(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges(values, limit)

  hilbert_space_context: bool =
    scalar_mode_laws
      AND additive_group_laws
      AND scalar_module_laws
      AND norm_laws
      AND inner_product_laws
      AND complete_space

  functional_bound(
      ell_re, ell_im: real_function,
      bound: real): bool =
    0 <= bound
      AND FORALL (x: E):
        scalar_norm_squared(ell_re(x), ell_im(x))
          <= bound ^ 2 * normE(x) ^ 2

  continuous_linear_functional(
      ell_re, ell_im: real_function): bool =
    (NOT complex_case IMPLIES
      FORALL (x: E):
        ell_im(x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        ell_re(addE(x, y)) = ell_re(x) + ell_re(y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        ell_im(addE(x, y)) = ell_im(x) + ell_im(y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          ell_re(smulE(a_re, a_im, x)) =
            a_re * ell_re(x) - a_im * ell_im(x))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          ell_im(smulE(a_re, a_im, x)) =
            a_re * ell_im(x) + a_im * ell_re(x))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        functional_bound(ell_re, ell_im, bound)

  functional_norm(
      ell_re, ell_im: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    functional_bound(ell_re, ell_im, value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        functional_bound(ell_re, ell_im, bound)
          IMPLIES value <= bound

  represented_by(
      ell_re, ell_im: real_function,
      representing_vector: E): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      ell_re(x) = inner_re(representing_vector, x)
        AND ell_im(x) = inner_im(representing_vector, x)

  riesz_representation: bool =
    hilbert_space_context IMPLIES
      FORALL (ell_re, ell_im: real_function):
        continuous_linear_functional(ell_re, ell_im)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (representing_vector: E):
            represented_by(
              ell_re, ell_im, representing_vector)
              AND functional_norm(
                ell_re, ell_im, normE(representing_vector))
              AND (FORALL (other_vector: E):
                represented_by(ell_re, ell_im, other_vector)
                  IMPLIES other_vector = representing_vector)
END riesz_representation_theorem_Q1357684

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q137164
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q137164), "Besicovitch covering theorem": in a
-- second-countable metric space with the Besicovitch covering property, admissible closed balls
-- contain a countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily covering a set almost everywhere.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Typeclasses.SFinite
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Defs

@[expose] public section

open Fin Metric Set MeasureTheory

/-- A satellite configuration of `N + 1` balls with parameter `τ`. -/
structure Besicovitch.SatelliteConfig (α : Type*) [MetricSpace α] (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) where
  c : Fin N.succ → α
  r : Fin N.succ → ℝ
  rpos : ∀ i, 0 < r i
  h : Pairwise fun i j =>
    r i ≤ dist (c i) (c j) ∧ r j ≤ τ * r i ∨ r j ≤ dist (c j) (c i) ∧ r i ≤ τ * r j
  hlast : ∀ i < last N, r i ≤ dist (c i) (c (last N)) ∧ r (last N) ≤ τ * r i
  inter : ∀ i < last N, dist (c i) (c (last N)) ≤ r i + r (last N)

/-- The metric space excludes sufficiently large satellite configurations. -/
class HasBesicovitchCovering (α : Type*) [MetricSpace α] : Prop where
  no_satelliteConfig : ∃ (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), 1 < τ ∧
    IsEmpty (Besicovitch.SatelliteConfig α N τ)

namespace Q137164

variable {α : Type*} [MetricSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α] [MeasurableSpace α]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [HasBesicovitchCovering α]

/-- A countable pairwise-disjoint family of admissible closed balls covers `s` almost everywhere. -/
theorem exists_disjoint_closedBall_covering_ae (μ : Measure α) [SFinite μ]
    (f : α → Set ℝ) (s : Set α)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ δ > 0, (f x ∩ Ioo 0 δ).Nonempty) (R : α → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < R x) :
    ∃ (t : Set α) (r : α → ℝ), t.Countable ∧ t ⊆ s ∧
      (∀ x ∈ t, r x ∈ f x ∩ Ioo 0 (R x)) ∧
        μ (s \ ⋃ x ∈ t, closedBall x (r x)) = 0 ∧
          t.PairwiseDisjoint fun x => closedBall x (r x) := sorry

end Q137164

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q137164
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q137164), "Besicovitch covering theorem":
  in a second-countable metric space with the Besicovitch covering property,
  arbitrarily small admissible radii yield a countable pairwise-disjoint
  family of closed balls covering a set almost everywhere for any s-finite
  measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q137164_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q137164_empty {A : Type} : q137164_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q137164_full {A : Type} : q137164_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q137164_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q137164_set A) : q137164_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q137164_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q137164_set A) : q137164_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q137164_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q137164_set A) : q137164_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ ~ F x.

Definition q137164_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q137164_set A) : q137164_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q137164_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q137164_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q137164_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q137164_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q137164_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q137164_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q137164_pairwise_disjoint_sequence {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q137164_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q137164_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q137164_countable {A : Type}
    (E : q137164_set A) : Prop :=
  exists code : A -> nat,
    forall x y : A,
      E x ->
      E y ->
      code x = code y ->
      x = y.

Record q137164_metric_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q137164_dist : A -> A -> R;
  q137164_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : A, 0 <= q137164_dist x y;
  q137164_dist_eq_zero :
    forall x y : A, q137164_dist x y = 0 <-> x = y;
  q137164_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : A, q137164_dist x y = q137164_dist y x;
  q137164_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : A,
      q137164_dist x z <= q137164_dist x y + q137164_dist y z
}.

Arguments q137164_dist {A} _ _ _.

Definition q137164_open {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A)
    (U : q137164_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : A,
        q137164_dist M y x < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q137164_second_countable {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q137164_set A,
    (forall n : nat, q137164_open M (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q137164_set A) (x : A),
      q137164_open M U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\ q137164_subset (basis n) U.

Definition q137164_closed_ball {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q137164_set A :=
  fun x => q137164_dist M x center <= radius.

Definition q137164_pairwise_disjoint_balls {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A)
    (centers : q137164_set A)
    (radius : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A,
    centers x ->
    centers y ->
    x <> y ->
    q137164_disjoint
      (q137164_closed_ball M x (radius x))
      (q137164_closed_ball M y (radius y)).

Definition q137164_union_balls {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A)
    (centers : q137164_set A)
    (radius : A -> R) : q137164_set A :=
  fun y =>
    exists x : A,
      centers x /\ q137164_closed_ball M x (radius x) y.

Definition q137164_satellite_config {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A)
    (N : nat) (tau : R) : Prop :=
  exists (center : nat -> A) (radius : nat -> R),
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < S N)%nat ->
      0 < radius i) /\
    (forall i j : nat,
      (i < S N)%nat ->
      (j < S N)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      ((radius i <= q137164_dist M (center i) (center j) /\
        radius j <= tau * radius i) \/
       (radius j <= q137164_dist M (center j) (center i) /\
        radius i <= tau * radius j))) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < N)%nat ->
      radius i <= q137164_dist M (center i) (center N) /\
      radius N <= tau * radius i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < N)%nat ->
      q137164_dist M (center i) (center N) <=
        radius i + radius N).

Definition q137164_has_besicovitch_covering {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists (N : nat) (tau : R),
    1 < tau /\ ~ q137164_satellite_config M N tau.

Inductive q137164_ennreal : Type :=
| q137164_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q137164_ennreal
| q137164_ennreal_infinity : q137164_ennreal.

Arguments q137164_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q137164_ennreal_zero : q137164_ennreal :=
  q137164_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q137164_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q137164_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q137164_ennreal_finite a _,
    q137164_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q137164_ennreal_infinity,
    q137164_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q137164_ennreal_le
    (x y : q137164_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q137164_ennreal_finite a _,
    q137164_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q137164_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q137164_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q137164_ennreal_infinity,
    q137164_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q137164_ennreal_infinity,
    q137164_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q137164_ennreal_lt
    (x y : q137164_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q137164_ennreal_finite a _,
    q137164_ennreal_finite b _ => a < b
  | q137164_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q137164_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q137164_ennreal_add
    (x y : q137164_ennreal) : q137164_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q137164_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q137164_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q137164_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q137164_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q137164_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q137164_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q137164_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q137164_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q137164_ennreal_add
        (q137164_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q137164_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q137164_ennreal)
    (total : q137164_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat,
    q137164_ennreal_le
      (q137164_ennreal_partial_sum u n) total) /\
  forall upper : q137164_ennreal,
    (forall n : nat,
      q137164_ennreal_le
        (q137164_ennreal_partial_sum u n) upper) ->
    q137164_ennreal_le total upper.

Record q137164_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q137164_measurable : q137164_set A -> Prop;
  q137164_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q137164_set A,
      q137164_same_set E F ->
      (q137164_measurable E <-> q137164_measurable F);
  q137164_measurable_empty :
    q137164_measurable q137164_empty;
  q137164_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q137164_set A,
      q137164_measurable E ->
      q137164_measurable (q137164_complement E);
  q137164_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q137164_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q137164_measurable (E n)) ->
      q137164_measurable (q137164_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q137164_measurable {A} _ _.

Definition q137164_opens_measurable {A : Type}
    (M : q137164_metric_space A)
    (m : q137164_measurable_space A) : Prop :=
  forall U : q137164_set A,
    q137164_open M U -> q137164_measurable m U.

Record q137164_measure {A : Type}
    (m : q137164_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q137164_measure_value : q137164_set A -> q137164_ennreal;
  q137164_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q137164_set A,
      q137164_same_set E F ->
      q137164_ennreal_eq
        (q137164_measure_value E)
        (q137164_measure_value F);
  q137164_measure_empty :
    q137164_ennreal_eq
      (q137164_measure_value q137164_empty)
      q137164_ennreal_zero;
  q137164_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q137164_set A,
      q137164_subset E F ->
      q137164_ennreal_le
        (q137164_measure_value E)
        (q137164_measure_value F);
  q137164_measure_trim :
    forall E : q137164_set A,
      exists F : q137164_set A,
        q137164_measurable m F /\
        q137164_subset E F /\
        q137164_ennreal_eq
          (q137164_measure_value F)
          (q137164_measure_value E);
  q137164_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall E : nat -> q137164_set A,
      exists total : q137164_ennreal,
        q137164_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q137164_measure_value (E n)) total /\
        q137164_ennreal_le
          (q137164_measure_value (q137164_countable_union E))
          total;
  q137164_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q137164_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q137164_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q137164_pairwise_disjoint_sequence E ->
      q137164_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q137164_measure_value (E n))
        (q137164_measure_value (q137164_countable_union E));
  q137164_measure_caratheodory :
    forall E S : q137164_set A,
      q137164_measurable m E ->
      q137164_ennreal_eq
        (q137164_measure_value S)
        (q137164_ennreal_add
          (q137164_measure_value (q137164_intersection S E))
          (q137164_measure_value (q137164_difference S E)))
}.

Arguments q137164_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Definition q137164_s_finite {A : Type}
    {m : q137164_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q137164_measure m) : Prop :=
  exists pieces : nat -> q137164_measure m,
    (forall n : nat,
      q137164_ennreal_lt
        (q137164_measure_value (pieces n) q137164_full)
        q137164_ennreal_infinity) /\
    forall E : q137164_set A,
      exists total : q137164_ennreal,
        q137164_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q137164_measure_value (pieces n) E)
          total /\
        q137164_ennreal_eq
          (q137164_measure_value mu E) total.

Theorem exists_disjoint_closedBall_covering_ae :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (M : q137164_metric_space Alpha)
         (m : q137164_measurable_space Alpha)
         (mu : q137164_measure m)
         (f : Alpha -> q137164_set R)
         (s : q137164_set Alpha)
         (Rbound : Alpha -> R),
    q137164_second_countable M ->
    q137164_opens_measurable M m ->
    q137164_s_finite mu ->
    q137164_has_besicovitch_covering M ->
    (forall (x : Alpha) (delta : R),
      s x ->
      0 < delta ->
      exists radius : R,
        f x radius /\ 0 < radius /\ radius < delta) ->
    (forall x : Alpha, s x -> 0 < Rbound x) ->
    exists (t : q137164_set Alpha) (radius : Alpha -> R),
      q137164_countable t /\
      q137164_subset t s /\
      (forall x : Alpha,
        t x ->
        f x (radius x) /\
        0 < radius x /\
        radius x < Rbound x) /\
      q137164_ennreal_eq
        (q137164_measure_value mu
          (q137164_difference s
            (q137164_union_balls M t radius)))
        q137164_ennreal_zero /\
      q137164_pairwise_disjoint_balls M t radius.
Admitted.

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q137164,
  "Besicovitch covering theorem": in a second-countable metric space with the
  Besicovitch covering property, a family of admissible radii accumulating at
  zero yields a countable pairwise-disjoint family of closed balls covering a
  given set up to an outer-null remainder, with prescribed positive pointwise
  radius bounds. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Borel_Space" "HOL-Analysis.Measure_Space"
begin

definition q137164_satellite_configuration ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::metric_space) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q137164_satellite_configuration N tau c rad \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>i < Suc N. 0 < rad i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < Suc N. \<forall>j < Suc N. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow>
        ((rad i \<le> dist (c i) (c j) \<and> rad j \<le> tau * rad i) \<or>
         (rad j \<le> dist (c j) (c i) \<and> rad i \<le> tau * rad j))) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < N.
        rad i \<le> dist (c i) (c N) \<and> rad N \<le> tau * rad i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i < N. dist (c i) (c N) \<le> rad i + rad N)"

definition q137164_has_besicovitch_covering ::
    "'a::metric_space itself \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q137164_has_besicovitch_covering _ \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>N tau. 1 < tau \<and>
        \<not> (\<exists>c rad.
          q137164_satellite_configuration N tau
            (c :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) rad))"

definition q137164_s_finite_measure :: "'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q137164_s_finite_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>Ms :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure.
        (\<forall>n. sets (Ms n) = sets M \<and>
          emeasure (Ms n) (space M) \<noteq> \<infinity>) \<and>
        (\<forall>A.
          emeasure M A = (\<Sum>n. emeasure (Ms n) A)))"

definition q137164_outer_null ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q137164_outer_null M A \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>u \<in> sets M. A \<subseteq> u \<and> emeasure M u = 0)"

theorem besicovitch_covering_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a::{metric_space,second_countable_topology} measure"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real set"
    and s :: "'a set"
    and R :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes measurable_space:
      "space M = UNIV"
      "sets borel \<subseteq> sets M"
    and s_finite:
      "q137164_s_finite_measure M"
    and besicovitch:
      "q137164_has_besicovitch_covering TYPE('a)"
    and arbitrarily_small:
      "\<And>x delta. x \<in> s \<Longrightarrow> 0 < delta \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>rho \<in> f x. 0 < rho \<and> rho < delta"
    and radius_bound:
      "\<And>x. x \<in> s \<Longrightarrow> 0 < R x"
  shows
      "\<exists>t r. countable t \<and> t \<subseteq> s \<and>
        (\<forall>x \<in> t. r x \<in> f x \<and> 0 < r x \<and> r x < R x) \<and>
        q137164_outer_null M
          (s - (\<Union>x\<in>t. cball x (r x))) \<and>
        pairwise
          (\<lambda>x y. disjnt (cball x (r x)) (cball y (r y))) t"
  sorry

end

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q137164,
  "Besicovitch covering theorem": in a second-countable metric space with the
  Besicovitch covering property, arbitrarily small admissible closed balls
  contain a countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily covering a given set almost
  everywhere for an s-finite measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q137164_BESICOVITCH_COVERING_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           events u ==> events ((:A) DIFF u)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let outer_measure =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!u:A->bool. enonnegative (mu u)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!u v:A->bool.
           u SUBSET v ==> ele (mu u) (mu v)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool total:bool#real.
           esum (\n. mu (sets n)) total
           ==> ele (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) total) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        outer_measure mu /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let sfinite_measure =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        ?pieces:num->(A->bool)->bool#real.
          (!n. measure_space events (pieces n) /\
               ~(FST (pieces n (:A)))) /\
          (!u:A->bool.
             esum (\n. pieces n u) (mu u)) in
   let is_metric =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        (!x y:A. &0 <= d x y) /\
        (!x y:A. d x y = &0 <=> x = y) /\
        (!x y:A. d x y = d y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let metric_open =
      \(d:A->A->real) (u:A->bool).
        !x:A.
          x IN u
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:A. d y x < epsilon ==> y IN u in
   let second_countable =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        ?basis:(A->bool)->bool.
          COUNTABLE basis /\
          (!b:A->bool. b IN basis ==> metric_open d b) /\
          (!u:A->bool x:A.
             metric_open d u /\ x IN u
             ==> ?b:A->bool.
                   b IN basis /\ x IN b /\ b SUBSET u) in
   let opens_measurable =
      \(d:A->A->real) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        !u:A->bool. metric_open d u ==> events u in
   let satellite_configuration =
      \(d:A->A->real) (N:num) (tau:real)
       (c:num->A) (radius:num->real).
        (!i. i <= N ==> &0 < radius i) /\
        (!i j.
           i <= N /\ j <= N /\ ~(i = j)
           ==> (radius i <= d (c i) (c j) /\
                radius j <= tau * radius i) \/
               (radius j <= d (c j) (c i) /\
                radius i <= tau * radius j)) /\
        (!i.
           i < N
           ==> radius i <= d (c i) (c N) /\
               radius N <= tau * radius i) /\
        (!i.
           i < N
           ==> d (c i) (c N) <= radius i + radius N) in
   let has_besicovitch_covering =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        ?N:num tau:real.
          &1 < tau /\
          ~(?c:num->A radius:num->real.
              satellite_configuration d N tau c radius) in
   let closed_ball =
      \(d:A->A->real) (x:A) (radius:real).
        {y:A | d y x <= radius} in
   !d:A->A->real
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    f:A->real->bool
    s:A->bool
    R:A->real.
      is_metric d /\
      second_countable d /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      opens_measurable d events /\
      sfinite_measure events mu /\
      has_besicovitch_covering d /\
      (!x:A.
         x IN s
         ==> !delta:real.
               &0 < delta
               ==> ?radius:real.
                     f x radius /\
                     &0 < radius /\
                     radius < delta) /\
      (!x:A. x IN s ==> &0 < R x)
      ==>
      ?t:A->bool radius:A->real.
        COUNTABLE t /\
        t SUBSET s /\
        (!x:A.
           x IN t
           ==> f x (radius x) /\
               &0 < radius x /\
               radius x < R x) /\
        mu
          (s DIFF
           {y:A |
              ?x:A.
                x IN t /\
                y IN closed_ball d x (radius x)}) = ezero /\
        (!x y:A.
           x IN t /\ y IN t /\ ~(x = y)
           ==> DISJOINT
                 (closed_ball d x (radius x))
                 (closed_ball d y (radius y)))`;;

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q137164,
;; "Besicovitch covering theorem": in a second-countable measurable metric
;; space with the Besicovitch covering property, arbitrarily small admissible
;; radii yield a countable pairwise-disjoint closed-ball covering almost all
;; of a set, with each radius below its prescribed positive bound.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, sets, functions, and relations are represented by tame
;; APPLY$ function objects.  DEFUN-SK keeps all mathematical quantifiers,
;; including the covering set and radius function, internal to the statement.
;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the reals, and its nonnegative
;; cone with a top element presents the extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q137164-apply1 (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun q137164-apply2 (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun q137164-member-p (carrier x)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (if (q137164-apply1 carrier x) t nil)))

(defun q137164-real-leq (less left right)
  (not (q137164-apply2 less right left)))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field.

(defun-sk q137164-real-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p carrier x)
      (q137164-member-p carrier y)
      (q137164-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q137164-apply2 add x y))
            (yz-add (q137164-apply2 add y z))
            (xy-mul (q137164-apply2 multiply x y))
            (yz-mul (q137164-apply2 multiply y z))
            (neg-x (q137164-apply1 negate x))
            (inv-x (q137164-apply1 inverse x)))
       (and
        (q137164-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q137164-member-p carrier xy-mul)
        (q137164-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (q137164-member-p carrier inv-x)
        (equal (q137164-apply2 add xy-add z)
               (q137164-apply2 add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q137164-apply2 add y x))
        (equal (q137164-apply2 add x zero) x)
        (equal (q137164-apply2 add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal (q137164-apply2 multiply xy-mul z)
               (q137164-apply2 multiply x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q137164-apply2 multiply y x))
        (equal (q137164-apply2 multiply x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (q137164-apply2 multiply x inv-x) one))
        (equal
         (q137164-apply2 multiply x yz-add)
         (q137164-apply2
          add
          (q137164-apply2 multiply x y)
          (q137164-apply2 multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q137164-real-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p carrier x)
      (q137164-member-p carrier y)
      (q137164-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q137164-apply2 less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (q137164-apply2 less x y)
       (q137164-apply2 less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q137164-apply2 less x y)
        (q137164-apply2 less y z))
       (q137164-apply2 less x z))
      (implies
       (q137164-apply2 less x y)
       (q137164-apply2
        less
        (q137164-apply2 add x z)
        (q137164-apply2 add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q137164-apply2 less zero x)
        (q137164-apply2 less zero y))
       (q137164-apply2
        less zero (q137164-apply2 multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk q137164-real-set-values-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-apply1 set x)
     (q137164-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q137164-real-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q137164-real-set-values-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q137164-real-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p carrier x)
     (q137164-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q137164-real-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 set x))
     (q137164-real-leq less x bound))))

(defun-sk q137164-real-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p carrier bound)
     (q137164-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q137164-real-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p carrier supremum)
     (q137164-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-member-p carrier bound)
       (q137164-real-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (q137164-real-leq less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q137164-real-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q137164-real-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q137164-real-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-real-set-p carrier set)
      (q137164-real-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q137164-real-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (q137164-real-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q137164-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (q137164-member-p carrier zero)
   (q137164-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q137164-real-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q137164-real-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (q137164-apply2 less zero one)
   (q137164-real-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Arbitrary subsets and functions.

(defun-sk q137164-set-values-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-apply1 set x)
     (q137164-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q137164-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q137164-set-values-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q137164-set-equivalent-p
    (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q137164-apply1 left x)
      (q137164-apply1 right x)))))

(defun-sk q137164-subset-p
    (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 left x))
     (q137164-apply1 right x))))

(defun-sk q137164-empty-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-member-p carrier x)
     (not (q137164-apply1 set x)))))

(defun-sk q137164-complement-of-p
    (carrier set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q137164-apply1 complement x)
      (not (q137164-apply1 set x))))))

(defun-sk q137164-function-values-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-member-p domain-carrier x)
     (q137164-member-p
      codomain-carrier (q137164-apply1 function x)))))

(defun q137164-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q137164-function-values-p
    domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)))

(defun-sk q137164-set-sequence-values-p
    (carrier family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q137164-set-p
      carrier (q137164-apply1 family n)))))

(defun q137164-set-sequence-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q137164-set-sequence-values-p carrier family)))

(defun-sk q137164-family-member-exists-p
    (family x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q137164-apply1
      (q137164-apply1 family n) x))))

(defun-sk q137164-union-of-family-p
    (carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q137164-apply1 union x)
      (q137164-family-member-exists-p family x)))))

(defun-sk q137164-family-measurable-p
    (measurable family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q137164-apply1
      measurable (q137164-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q137164-family-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (carrier family)
  (forall (m n x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n))
      (q137164-member-p carrier x))
     (not
      (and
       (q137164-apply1 (q137164-apply1 family m) x)
       (q137164-apply1 (q137164-apply1 family n) x))))))

;; The metric structure and its induced topology.

(defun-sk q137164-metric-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier distance)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier y)
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier z))
     (let ((dxy (q137164-apply2 distance x y))
           (dyz (q137164-apply2 distance y z))
           (dxz (q137164-apply2 distance x z)))
       (and
        (q137164-member-p real-carrier dxy)
        (q137164-member-p real-carrier dyz)
        (q137164-member-p real-carrier dxz)
        (q137164-real-leq real-less real-zero dxy)
        (iff (equal dxy real-zero) (equal x y))
        (equal dxy (q137164-apply2 distance y x))
        (q137164-real-leq
         real-less dxz
         (q137164-apply2 real-add dxy dyz)))))))

(defun q137164-metric-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier distance)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp point-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp distance)
   (q137164-metric-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    point-carrier distance)))

(defun-sk q137164-open-ball-contained-p
    (real-less point-carrier distance set center radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier y)
      (q137164-apply2
       real-less
       (q137164-apply2 distance center y)
       radius))
     (q137164-apply1 set y))))

(defun-sk q137164-open-radius-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p real-carrier radius)
     (q137164-apply2 real-less real-zero radius)
     (q137164-open-ball-contained-p
      real-less point-carrier distance
      set center radius))))

(defun-sk q137164-metric-open-points-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 set x))
     (q137164-open-radius-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier distance set x))))

(defun q137164-metric-open-set-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance set)
  (and
   (q137164-set-p point-carrier set)
   (q137164-metric-open-points-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less
    point-carrier distance set)))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-active-indices-p (active)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q137164-apply1 active index)
     (natp index))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-section-values-p
    (point-carrier basis index)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-apply2 basis index x)
     (q137164-member-p point-carrier x))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-ball-contained-p
    (real-less point-carrier distance basis index center radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier y)
      (q137164-apply2
       real-less
       (q137164-apply2 distance center y)
       radius))
     (q137164-apply2 basis index y))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-open-radius-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance basis index center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p real-carrier radius)
     (q137164-apply2 real-less real-zero radius)
     (q137164-basis-ball-contained-p
      real-less point-carrier distance
      basis index center radius))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-section-open-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance basis index)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply2 basis index x))
     (q137164-basis-open-radius-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier distance basis index x))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-sections-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance basis active)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (q137164-apply1 active index))
     (and
      (q137164-basis-section-values-p
       point-carrier basis index)
      (q137164-basis-section-open-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier distance basis index)))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-section-subset-p
    (point-carrier basis index set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply2 basis index x))
     (q137164-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-hit-exists-p
    (point-carrier basis active set x)
  (exists (index)
    (and
     (natp index)
     (q137164-apply1 active index)
     (q137164-apply2 basis index x)
     (q137164-basis-section-subset-p
      point-carrier basis index set))))

(defun-sk q137164-basis-law-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance basis active)
  (forall (set x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-metric-open-set-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier distance set)
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 set x))
     (q137164-basis-hit-exists-p
      point-carrier basis active set x))))

(defun q137164-second-countable-witness-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance basis active)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp basis)
   (tamep-functionp active)
   (q137164-basis-active-indices-p active)
   (q137164-basis-sections-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less
    point-carrier distance basis active)
   (q137164-basis-law-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less
    point-carrier distance basis active)))

(defun-sk q137164-second-countable-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance)
  (exists (basis active)
    (q137164-second-countable-witness-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance basis active)))

;; Sigma algebras, measures, and exact s-finiteness.

(defun-sk q137164-measurable-space-laws-p
    (point-carrier measurable)
  (forall (set left right complement family union)
    (and
     (implies
      (q137164-apply1 measurable set)
      (q137164-set-p point-carrier set))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier right)
       (q137164-set-equivalent-p
        point-carrier left right))
      (iff
       (q137164-apply1 measurable left)
       (q137164-apply1 measurable right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier set)
       (q137164-empty-set-p point-carrier set))
      (q137164-apply1 measurable set))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-apply1 measurable set)
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier complement)
       (q137164-complement-of-p
        point-carrier set complement))
      (q137164-apply1 measurable complement))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-set-sequence-p point-carrier family)
       (q137164-family-measurable-p measurable family)
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier union)
       (q137164-union-of-family-p
        point-carrier family union))
      (q137164-apply1 measurable union)))))

(defun q137164-measurable-space-p
    (point-carrier measurable)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp point-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp measurable)
   (q137164-measurable-space-laws-p
    point-carrier measurable)))

(defun-sk q137164-opens-measurable-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q137164-metric-open-set-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier distance set)
     (q137164-apply1 measurable set))))

(defun q137164-ennreal-finite (value)
  (list :q137164-finite value))

(defun q137164-ennreal-top ()
  :q137164-top)

(defun q137164-ennreal-zero (real-zero)
  (q137164-ennreal-finite real-zero))

(defun q137164-ennreal-finite-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (equal (car value) :q137164-finite)
   (q137164-member-p real-carrier (cadr value))
   (q137164-real-leq
    real-less real-zero (cadr value))))

(defun q137164-ennreal-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (or
   (equal value (q137164-ennreal-top))
   (q137164-ennreal-finite-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less value)))

(defun q137164-ennreal-leq
    (real-less left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right (q137164-ennreal-top)) t)
   ((equal left (q137164-ennreal-top)) nil)
   (t
    (q137164-real-leq
     real-less (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q137164-ennreal-add
    (real-add left right)
  (if (or
       (equal left (q137164-ennreal-top))
       (equal right (q137164-ennreal-top)))
      (q137164-ennreal-top)
    (q137164-ennreal-finite
     (q137164-apply2
      real-add (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q137164-measure-partial-sum
    (real-zero real-add measure family count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q137164-ennreal-zero real-zero)
    (q137164-ennreal-add
     real-add
     (q137164-measure-partial-sum
      real-zero real-add measure family (1- count))
     (q137164-apply1
      measure (q137164-apply1 family (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q137164-measure-series-upper-bound-p
    (real-zero real-add real-less
     measure family bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q137164-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q137164-measure-partial-sum
       real-zero real-add measure family count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q137164-measure-series-sum-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     measure family total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q137164-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less total)
     (q137164-measure-series-upper-bound-p
      real-zero real-add real-less
      measure family total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-ennreal-p
        real-carrier real-zero real-less bound)
       (q137164-measure-series-upper-bound-p
        real-zero real-add real-less
        measure family bound))
      (q137164-ennreal-leq
       real-less total bound)))))

(defun-sk q137164-measure-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable measure)
  (forall (set left right family union)
    (and
     (implies
      (q137164-set-p point-carrier set)
      (q137164-ennreal-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       (q137164-apply1 measure set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier right)
       (q137164-set-equivalent-p
        point-carrier left right))
      (equal
       (q137164-apply1 measure left)
       (q137164-apply1 measure right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier set)
       (q137164-empty-set-p point-carrier set))
      (equal
       (q137164-apply1 measure set)
       (q137164-ennreal-zero real-zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-set-sequence-p point-carrier family)
       (q137164-family-measurable-p measurable family)
       (q137164-family-pairwise-disjoint-p
        point-carrier family)
       (q137164-set-p point-carrier union)
       (q137164-union-of-family-p
        point-carrier family union))
      (q137164-measure-series-sum-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       measure family
       (q137164-apply1 measure union))))))

(defun q137164-measure-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable measure)
  (and
   (q137164-measurable-space-p
    point-carrier measurable)
   (tamep-functionp measure)
   (q137164-measure-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    point-carrier measurable measure)))

(defun q137164-finite-measure-p
    (point-carrier measure)
  (not
   (equal
    (q137164-apply1 measure point-carrier)
    (q137164-ennreal-top))))

(defun-sk q137164-component-measures-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable components)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (let ((component (q137164-apply1 components n)))
       (and
        (tamep-functionp component)
        (q137164-measure-space-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
         point-carrier measurable component)
        (q137164-finite-measure-p
         point-carrier component))))))

(defun q137164-component-partial-sum
    (real-zero real-add components set count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q137164-ennreal-zero real-zero)
    (q137164-ennreal-add
     real-add
     (q137164-component-partial-sum
      real-zero real-add components set (1- count))
     (q137164-apply1
      (q137164-apply1 components (1- count))
      set))))

(defun-sk q137164-component-series-upper-bound-p
    (real-zero real-add real-less
     components set bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q137164-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q137164-component-partial-sum
       real-zero real-add components set count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q137164-component-series-sum-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     components set total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q137164-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less total)
     (q137164-component-series-upper-bound-p
      real-zero real-add real-less
      components set total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-ennreal-p
        real-carrier real-zero real-less bound)
       (q137164-component-series-upper-bound-p
        real-zero real-add real-less
        components set bound))
      (q137164-ennreal-leq
       real-less total bound)))))

(defun-sk q137164-component-sum-equals-measure-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier components measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q137164-set-p point-carrier set)
     (q137164-component-series-sum-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
      components set (q137164-apply1 measure set)))))

(defun q137164-sfinite-witness-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable measure components)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp components)
   (q137164-component-measures-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    point-carrier measurable components)
   (q137164-component-sum-equals-measure-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    point-carrier components measure)))

(defun-sk q137164-sfinite-measure-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier measurable measure)
  (exists (components)
    (and
     (q137164-measure-space-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
      point-carrier measurable measure)
     (q137164-sfinite-witness-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
      point-carrier measurable measure components))))

;; The exact no-satellite-configuration definition of the Besicovitch
;; covering property.

(defun q137164-fin-index-p (index size)
  (and
   (natp index)
   (< index size)))

(defun-sk q137164-satellite-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
     point-carrier distance size tau centers radii)
  (forall (i j)
    (let ((ri (q137164-apply1 radii i))
          (rj (q137164-apply1 radii j))
          (ci (q137164-apply1 centers i))
          (cj (q137164-apply1 centers j))
          (last-center (q137164-apply1 centers size))
          (last-radius (q137164-apply1 radii size)))
      (and
       (implies
        (q137164-fin-index-p i (+ 1 size))
        (and
         (q137164-member-p point-carrier ci)
         (q137164-member-p real-carrier ri)
         (q137164-apply2 real-less real-zero ri)))
       (implies
        (and
         (q137164-fin-index-p i (+ 1 size))
         (q137164-fin-index-p j (+ 1 size))
         (not (equal i j)))
        (or
         (and
          (q137164-real-leq
           real-less ri
           (q137164-apply2 distance ci cj))
          (q137164-real-leq
           real-less rj
           (q137164-apply2 real-multiply tau ri)))
         (and
          (q137164-real-leq
           real-less rj
           (q137164-apply2 distance cj ci))
          (q137164-real-leq
           real-less ri
           (q137164-apply2 real-multiply tau rj)))))
       (implies
        (q137164-fin-index-p i size)
        (and
         (q137164-real-leq
          real-less ri
          (q137164-apply2 distance ci last-center))
         (q137164-real-leq
          real-less last-radius
          (q137164-apply2 real-multiply tau ri))
         (q137164-real-leq
          real-less
          (q137164-apply2 distance ci last-center)
          (q137164-apply2 real-add ri last-radius))))))))

(defun q137164-satellite-config-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
     point-carrier distance size tau centers radii)
  (and
   (natp size)
   (q137164-member-p real-carrier tau)
   (tamep-functionp centers)
   (tamep-functionp radii)
   (q137164-satellite-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
    point-carrier distance size tau centers radii)))

(defun-sk q137164-no-satellite-config-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
     point-carrier distance size tau)
  (forall (centers radii)
    (not
     (q137164-satellite-config-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
      point-carrier distance size tau centers radii))))

(defun-sk q137164-has-besicovitch-covering-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one
     real-add real-multiply real-less
     point-carrier distance)
  (exists (size tau)
    (and
     (natp size)
     (q137164-member-p real-carrier tau)
     (q137164-apply2 real-less real-one tau)
     (q137164-no-satellite-config-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
      point-carrier distance size tau))))

;; Source hypotheses on admissible radii.

(defun-sk q137164-radius-family-values-p
    (real-carrier point-carrier admissible)
  (forall (x radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply2 admissible x radius))
     (q137164-member-p real-carrier radius))))

(defun q137164-radius-family-p
    (real-carrier point-carrier admissible)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp admissible)
   (q137164-radius-family-values-p
    real-carrier point-carrier admissible)))

(defun-sk q137164-admissible-radius-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     admissible x delta)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p real-carrier radius)
     (q137164-apply2 admissible x radius)
     (q137164-apply2 real-less real-zero radius)
     (q137164-apply2 real-less radius delta))))

(defun-sk q137164-admissible-arbitrarily-small-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier admissible set)
  (forall (x delta)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 set x)
      (q137164-member-p real-carrier delta)
      (q137164-apply2 real-less real-zero delta))
     (q137164-admissible-radius-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      admissible x delta))))

(defun-sk q137164-positive-bound-p
    (real-zero real-less point-carrier set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 set x))
     (q137164-apply2
      real-less real-zero (q137164-apply1 bound x)))))

;; The countable, subordinate, admissible, disjoint, almost-everywhere
;; closed-ball covering in the conclusion.

(defun-sk q137164-countable-code-laws-p
    (point-carrier set code)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
       (q137164-apply1 set x))
      (natp (q137164-apply1 code x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
       (q137164-member-p point-carrier y)
       (q137164-apply1 set x)
       (q137164-apply1 set y)
       (equal
        (q137164-apply1 code x)
        (q137164-apply1 code y)))
      (equal x y)))))

(defun-sk q137164-countable-set-p
    (point-carrier set)
  (exists (code)
    (and
     (q137164-set-p point-carrier set)
     (tamep-functionp code)
     (q137164-countable-code-laws-p
      point-carrier set code))))

(defun-sk q137164-selected-radii-p
    (real-zero real-less
