     point-carrier admissible bound centers radii)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-apply1 centers x))
     (let ((radius (q137164-apply1 radii x)))
       (and
        (q137164-apply2 admissible x radius)
        (q137164-apply2 real-less real-zero radius)
        (q137164-apply2
         real-less radius (q137164-apply1 bound x)))))))

(defun-sk q137164-covering-center-exists-p
    (real-less point-carrier distance centers radii point)
  (exists (center)
    (and
     (q137164-member-p point-carrier center)
     (q137164-apply1 centers center)
     (q137164-real-leq
      real-less
      (q137164-apply2 distance point center)
      (q137164-apply1 radii center)))))

(defun-sk q137164-uncovered-set-characterization-p
    (real-less point-carrier distance
     source-set centers radii uncovered)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q137164-apply1 uncovered x)
      (and
       (q137164-apply1 source-set x)
       (not
        (q137164-covering-center-exists-p
         real-less point-carrier distance
         centers radii x)))))))

(defun q137164-uncovered-set-p
    (real-less point-carrier distance
     source-set centers radii uncovered)
  (and
   (q137164-set-p point-carrier uncovered)
   (q137164-uncovered-set-characterization-p
    real-less point-carrier distance
    source-set centers radii uncovered)))

(defun-sk q137164-null-set-p
    (real-zero point-carrier measurable measure set)
  (exists (measurable-cover)
    (and
     (q137164-set-p point-carrier measurable-cover)
     (q137164-apply1 measurable measurable-cover)
     (q137164-subset-p
      point-carrier set measurable-cover)
     (equal
      (q137164-apply1 measure measurable-cover)
      (q137164-ennreal-zero real-zero)))))

(defun-sk q137164-pairwise-disjoint-closed-balls-p
    (real-less point-carrier distance centers radii)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier y)
      (q137164-member-p point-carrier z)
      (q137164-apply1 centers x)
      (q137164-apply1 centers y)
      (not (equal x y)))
     (not
      (and
       (q137164-real-leq
        real-less
        (q137164-apply2 distance z x)
        (q137164-apply1 radii x))
       (q137164-real-leq
        real-less
        (q137164-apply2 distance z y)
        (q137164-apply1 radii y)))))))

(defun q137164-covering-data-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance measurable measure
     admissible source-set bound
     centers radii uncovered)
  (and
   (q137164-countable-set-p
    point-carrier centers)
   (q137164-subset-p
    point-carrier centers source-set)
   (q137164-function-p
    point-carrier real-carrier radii)
   (q137164-selected-radii-p
    real-zero real-less
    point-carrier admissible bound centers radii)
   (q137164-uncovered-set-p
    real-less point-carrier distance
    source-set centers radii uncovered)
   (q137164-null-set-p
    real-zero point-carrier measurable measure uncovered)
   (q137164-pairwise-disjoint-closed-balls-p
    real-less point-carrier distance centers radii)))

(defun-sk q137164-covering-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance measurable measure
     admissible source-set bound)
  (exists (centers radii uncovered)
    (q137164-covering-data-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier distance measurable measure
     admissible source-set bound
     centers radii uncovered)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q137164-besicovitch-covering-statement ()
  (forall
      (real-carrier real-zero real-one
       real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse real-less
       point-carrier distance measurable measure
       admissible source-set bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q137164-real-field-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one
       real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse real-less)
      (q137164-metric-space-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       point-carrier distance)
      (q137164-second-countable-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier distance)
      (q137164-measurable-space-p
       point-carrier measurable)
      (q137164-opens-measurable-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier distance measurable)
      (q137164-sfinite-measure-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       point-carrier measurable measure)
      (q137164-has-besicovitch-covering-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one
       real-add real-multiply real-less
       point-carrier distance)
      (q137164-radius-family-p
       real-carrier point-carrier admissible)
      (q137164-set-p point-carrier source-set)
      (q137164-function-p
       point-carrier real-carrier bound)
      (q137164-admissible-arbitrarily-small-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       point-carrier admissible source-set)
      (q137164-positive-bound-p
       real-zero real-less point-carrier source-set bound))
     (q137164-covering-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      point-carrier distance measurable measure
      admissible source-set bound))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q137164,
-- "Besicovitch covering theorem": in a second-countable measurable metric
-- space with the Besicovitch property, admissible arbitrarily small closed
-- balls contain a countable disjoint subfamily covering the set almost
-- everywhere. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

open CompleteOrderedField
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

infix 4 _<N_

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin (suc n)
  fsuc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin n ->
    Fin (suc n)

finValue :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Nat
finValue fzero =
  zero
finValue (fsuc i) =
  suc (finValue i)

last :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Fin (suc n)
last zero =
  fzero
last (suc n) =
  fsuc (last n)

record MetricSpace
  {R : Set}
  (A : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    distance :
      A -> A -> R
    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (distance x y)
    distance-self :
      (x : A) ->
      distance x x == zeroR reals
    distance-zero-only :
      (x y : A) ->
      distance x y == zeroR reals ->
      x == y
    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      distance x y == distance y x
    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance x z)
        (addR reals (distance x y) (distance y z))

open MetricSpace

MetricOpen :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
MetricOpen {A = A} {R = R} {reals = reals} metric U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ epsilon ->
      Both
        (Positive reals epsilon)
        ((y : A) ->
          StrictLess reals (distance metric y x) epsilon ->
          U y))

record SecondCountableMetric
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) : Set1 where
  field
    basis :
      Nat -> Predicate A
    basis-open :
      (n : Nat) ->
      MetricOpen metric (basis n)
    basis-refines-open :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      MetricOpen metric U ->
      (x : A) ->
      U x ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Both
            (basis n x)
            (Subset (basis n) U))

OpensMeasurableSpace :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  Set1
OpensMeasurableSpace metric events =
  (U : Predicate _) ->
  MetricOpen metric U ->
  measurable events U

ClosedBall :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  A ->
  R ->
  Predicate A
ClosedBall {reals = reals} metric center radius point =
  lessOrEqualR reals (distance metric point center) radius

record SatelliteConfig
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals)
  (N : Nat)
  (tau : R) : Set1 where
  field
    center :
      Fin (suc N) -> A
    radius :
      Fin (suc N) -> R
    radius-positive :
      (i : Fin (suc N)) ->
      Positive reals (radius i)
    ordered :
      (i j : Fin (suc N)) ->
      i != j ->
      Either
        (Both
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius i)
            (distance metric (center i) (center j)))
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius j)
            (multiplyR reals tau (radius i))))
        (Both
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius j)
            (distance metric (center j) (center i)))
          (lessOrEqualR reals
            (radius i)
            (multiplyR reals tau (radius j))))
    last-ordered :
      (i : Fin (suc N)) ->
      finValue i <N N ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (radius i)
          (distance metric (center i) (center (last N))))
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (radius (last N))
          (multiplyR reals tau (radius i)))
    intersects-last :
      (i : Fin (suc N)) ->
      finValue i <N N ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance metric (center i) (center (last N)))
        (addR reals (radius i) (radius (last N)))

record HasBesicovitchCovering
  {A R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) : Set2 where
  field
    satellite-bound :
      Nat
    satellite-factor :
      R
    factor-greater-than-one :
      StrictLess reals
        (oneR reals)
        satellite-factor
    no-satellite-configuration :
      SatelliteConfig metric satellite-bound satellite-factor ->
      Bottom

FiniteMeasure :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Set
FiniteMeasure {extended = extended} measure =
  outerMass measure wholeSet != infinityM extended

record SFiniteMeasure
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set1 where
  field
    finite-parts :
      Nat -> Measure extended events
    each-part-finite :
      (n : Nat) ->
      FiniteMeasure (finite-parts n)
    parts-sum-to-measure :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      CountableSum extended
        (\ n -> outerMass (finite-parts n) S)
        (outerMass measure S)

record ElementOf
  {A : Set}
  (S : Predicate A) : Set where
  constructor member
  field
    element :
      A
    membership :
      S element

open ElementOf

record CountableSubset
  {A : Set}
  (S : Predicate A) : Set where
  field
    code :
      ElementOf S -> Nat
    code-injective :
      (x y : ElementOf S) ->
      code x == code y ->
      element x == element y

difference :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
difference S T x =
  Both (S x) (Not (T x))

BallUnion :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  MetricSpace A reals ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Predicate A
BallUnion {A = A} metric centers radii point =
  Exists A
    (\ center ->
      Both
        (centers center)
        (ClosedBall metric center (radii center) point))

SetPairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
SetPairwiseDisjoint {A = A} indices family =
  (x y : A) ->
  indices x ->
  indices y ->
  x != y ->
  (point : A) ->
  family x point ->
  family y point ->
  Bottom

record BesicovitchCoveringConclusion
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (admissibleRadii : A -> Predicate R)
  (S : Predicate A)
  (upperRadius : A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    centers :
      Predicate A
    radii :
      A -> R
    centers-countable :
      CountableSubset centers
    centers-in-set :
      Subset centers S
    radii-admissible :
      (x : A) ->
      centers x ->
      Both
        (admissibleRadii x (radii x))
        (Both
          (Positive reals (radii x))
          (StrictLess reals (radii x) (upperRadius x)))
    covers-almost-everywhere :
      outerMass measure
        (difference S (BallUnion metric centers radii))
      ==
      zeroM extended
    closed-balls-pairwise-disjoint :
      SetPairwiseDisjoint centers
        (\ x -> ClosedBall metric x (radii x))

besicovitch-covering-theorem : Set2
besicovitch-covering-theorem =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (metric : MetricSpace A reals) ->
  SecondCountableMetric metric ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  OpensMeasurableSpace metric events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  SFiniteMeasure measure ->
  HasBesicovitchCovering metric ->
  (admissibleRadii : A -> Predicate R) ->
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    S x ->
    (delta : R) ->
    Positive reals delta ->
    Exists R
      (\ radius ->
        Both
          (admissibleRadii x radius)
          (Both
            (Positive reals radius)
            (StrictLess reals radius delta)))) ->
  (upperRadius : A -> R) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    S x ->
    Positive reals (upperRadius x)) ->
  BesicovitchCoveringConclusion
    metric measure admissibleRadii S upperRadius

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q137164, "Besicovitch covering theorem": admissible closed balls with
  arbitrarily small radii admit a countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily
  covering the given set up to a null remainder. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open measureTheory;

val q137164_metric_space_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_metric_space_def",
  ``q137164_metric_space (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x. d x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. 0 <= d x y) /\
      (!x y. d x y = d y x) /\
      (!x y. d x y = 0 <=> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. d x z <= d x y + d y z)``);

val q137164_open_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_open_def",
  ``q137164_open (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (u : 'a set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. d y x < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q137164_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_second_countable_def",
  ``q137164_second_countable (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?basis : ('a set) set.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!v. v IN basis ==> q137164_open d v) /\
        !u x.
          q137164_open d u /\ x IN u
          ==>
          ?v. v IN basis /\ x IN v /\ v SUBSET u``);

val q137164_opens_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_opens_measurable_def",
  ``q137164_opens_measurable
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (m : 'a m_space) <=>
      !u. q137164_open d u ==> u IN measurable_sets m``);

val q137164_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_closed_ball_def",
  ``q137164_closed_ball
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (x : 'a) (radius : real) =
      {y | d y x <= radius}``);

val q137164_satellite_config_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_satellite_config_def",
  ``q137164_satellite_config
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (N : num) (tau : real)
      (c : num -> 'a) (r : num -> real) <=>
      (!i. i <= N ==> 0 < r i) /\
      (!i j.
        i <= N /\ j <= N /\ i <> j
        ==>
        ((r i <= d (c i) (c j) /\ r j <= tau * r i) \/
         (r j <= d (c j) (c i) /\ r i <= tau * r j))) /\
      (!i.
        i < N ==>
        r i <= d (c i) (c N) /\ r N <= tau * r i) /\
      (!i.
        i < N ==>
        d (c i) (c N) <= r i + r N)``);

val q137164_has_besicovitch_covering_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_has_besicovitch_covering_def",
  ``q137164_has_besicovitch_covering
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?N : num. ?tau : real.
        1 < tau /\
        ~(?c : num -> 'a. ?r : num -> real.
            q137164_satellite_config d N tau c r)``);

val q137164_sfinite_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_sfinite_def",
  ``q137164_sfinite (m : 'a m_space) <=>
      ?parts : num -> 'a set -> extreal.
        (!n.
          measure_space (m_space m,measurable_sets m,parts n) /\
          parts n (m_space m) <> PosInf) /\
        !u.
          u IN measurable_sets m ==>
          measure m u = suminf (\n. parts n u)``);

val q137164_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_outer_measure_def",
  ``q137164_outer_measure (m : 'a m_space) (u : 'a set) =
      inf
        {z : extreal |
          ?v : 'a set.
            u SUBSET v /\
            v IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m v = z}``);

val q137164_pairwise_disjoint_def = new_definition (
  "q137164_pairwise_disjoint_def",
  ``q137164_pairwise_disjoint
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (t : 'a set) (r : 'a -> real) <=>
      !x y.
        x IN t /\ y IN t /\ x <> y
        ==>
        DISJOINT
          (q137164_closed_ball d x (r x))
          (q137164_closed_ball d y (r y))``);

val exists_disjoint_closedBall_covering_ae =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real)
      (f : 'a -> real set) (s : 'a set) (R : 'a -> real).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q137164_metric_space d /\
      q137164_second_countable d /\
      q137164_opens_measurable d m /\
      q137164_sfinite m /\
      q137164_has_besicovitch_covering d /\
      (!x.
        x IN s ==>
        !delta : real.
          0 < delta ==>
          ?radius : real.
            radius IN f x /\
            0 < radius /\
            radius < delta) /\
      (!x. x IN s ==> 0 < R x)
      ==>
      ?t : 'a set. ?r : 'a -> real.
        COUNTABLE t /\
        t SUBSET s /\
        (!x.
          x IN t ==>
          r x IN f x /\
          0 < r x /\
          r x < R x) /\
        q137164_outer_measure m
          (s DIFF
            BIGUNION
              (IMAGE
                (\x. q137164_closed_ball d x (r x))
                t)) = 0 /\
        q137164_pairwise_disjoint d t r``;

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q137164
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q137164), "Besicovitch covering theorem": in
  a second-countable metric space with measurable open sets and the
  Besicovitch covering property, every family of admissible radii available
  at arbitrarily small positive scales admits, for any s-finite measure, a
  countable pairwise-disjoint closed-ball subfamily covering the given set
  almost everywhere. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q137164ClosedBall is the metric closed ball. Q137164Satellite expands the
  finite satellite configurations excluded by the source's Besicovitch
  covering property. Q137164SFinite states that a measure is a countable sum
  of finite measures on the same measurable space. Q137164Measure evaluates
  the outer measure induced by a measure, retaining the source theorem's
  application to arbitrary, not necessarily measurable, sets.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or bidirectional definitions, and
  there are no $p declarations in this file.
$)

$c Q137164ClosedBall Q137164Satellite Q137164HasBesicovitch
   Q137164SFinite Q137164Measure $.

$( The closed metric ball with center x and radius a in the carrier X. $)
q137164-wclosedball $a
  class ( Q137164ClosedBall D X x a ) $.

${
  $d D X x y a $.
  q137164-df-closedball $a
    |- ( Q137164ClosedBall D X x a ) =
       { y e. X | ( x D y ) <_ a } $.
$}

$( A finite satellite configuration, with indices 0 through N. $)
q137164-wsatellite $a
  wff ( Q137164Satellite D X N t c r ) $.

${
  $d D X N t c r i j $.
  q137164-df-satellite $a
    |- ( ( Q137164Satellite D X N t c r ) <->
         ( c e. ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) ) /\
           ( r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) ) /\
             ( A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) 0 < ( r ` i ) /\
               ( A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) )
                 A. j e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) )
                   ( i =/= j ->
                     ( ( ( r ` i ) <_ ( ( c ` i ) D ( c ` j ) ) /\
                         ( r ` j ) <_ ( t x. ( r ` i ) ) ) \/
                       ( ( r ` j ) <_ ( ( c ` j ) D ( c ` i ) ) /\
                         ( r ` i ) <_ ( t x. ( r ` j ) ) ) ) ) /\
                 ( A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N )
                     ( ( r ` i ) <_ ( ( c ` i ) D ( c ` N ) ) /\
                       ( r ` N ) <_ ( t x. ( r ` i ) ) ) /\
                   A. i e. ( 0 ..^ N )
                     ( ( ( c ` i ) D ( c ` N ) ) <_
                       ( ( r ` i ) + ( r ` N ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

$( The Besicovitch covering property, expressed by the absence of a
   sufficiently large finite satellite configuration. $)
q137164-whasbesicovitch $a
  wff ( Q137164HasBesicovitch D X ) $.

${
  $d D X c q r t $.
  q137164-df-hasbesicovitch $a
    |- ( ( Q137164HasBesicovitch D X ) <->
         E. q e. NN0 E. t e. RR
           ( 1 < t /\
             -. E. c e. ( X ^m ( 0 ..^ ( q + 1 ) ) )
                E. r e. ( RR ^m ( 0 ..^ ( q + 1 ) ) )
                  ( Q137164Satellite D X q t c r ) ) ) $.
$}

$( S-finiteness: a measure is a countable sum of finite measures on the
   same measurable space. $)
q137164-wsfinite $a
  wff ( Q137164SFinite M ) $.

${
  $d M a f n $.
  q137164-df-sfinite $a
    |- ( ( Q137164SFinite M ) <->
         E. f
           ( f Fn NN0 /\
             ( ( A. n e. NN0
                   ( ( f ` n ) e. U. ran measures /\
                     ( dom ( f ` n ) = dom M /\
                       ( ( f ` n ) ` U. dom M ) < +oo ) ) ) /\
               A. a e. dom M
                 ( M ` a ) =
                 ( sum^ ` ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( f ` n ) ` a ) ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

$( Evaluation of the outer measure canonically associated with M. $)
q137164-wmeasure $a
  class ( Q137164Measure M A ) $.

${
  $d M A $.
  q137164-df-measure $a
    |- ( Q137164Measure M A ) = ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A ) $.
$}

${
  $d a d f g m p r s t x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q137164-besicovitch-covering-theorem $a
    |- A. m e. U. ran measures
         A. p A. f A. s A. g
           ( ( p e. ( Met ` U. dom m ) /\
               ( ( MetOpen ` p ) e. 2ndc /\
                 ( ( MetOpen ` p ) C_ dom m /\
                   ( ( Q137164SFinite m ) /\
                     ( Q137164HasBesicovitch p ( U. dom m ) ) ) ) ) ) ->
             ( ( f e. ( ( ~P RR ) ^m ( U. dom m ) ) /\
                 ( s C_ U. dom m /\
                   g e. ( RR ^m ( U. dom m ) ) ) ) ->
               ( ( ( A. x e. s A. d e. RR+
                       E. a e. ( f ` x ) ( 0 < a /\ a < d ) ) /\
                   A. x e. s 0 < ( g ` x ) ) ->
                 E. t e. ~P ( U. dom m )
                   E. r e. ( RR ^m ( U. dom m ) )
                     ( t ~<_ NN0 /\
                       ( t C_ s /\
                         ( A. x e. t
                             ( ( r ` x ) e. ( f ` x ) /\
                               ( 0 < ( r ` x ) /\
                                 ( r ` x ) < ( g ` x ) ) ) /\
                           ( ( Q137164Measure m
                                 ( s \ U_ x e. t
                                     ( Q137164ClosedBall
                                       p ( U. dom m ) x ( r ` x ) ) ) ) = 0 /\
                             A. x e. t A. y e. t
                               ( x =/= y ->
                                 ( ( Q137164ClosedBall
                                       p ( U. dom m ) x ( r ` x ) ) i^i
                                   ( Q137164ClosedBall
                                       p ( U. dom m ) y ( r ` y ) ) ) =
                                 (/) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for M being MetrSpace,
      S being SigmaField of the carrier of M,
      Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
      f being Function of the carrier of M,bool REAL,
      s being Subset of M,
      R being Function of the carrier of M,REAL
  st
    TopSpaceMetr M is second-countable &
    (for U being Subset of TopSpaceMetr M st
       U in the topology of TopSpaceMetr M holds U in S) &
    (ex Q being sequence of Funcs(S,ExtREAL) st
       (for n being Nat holds
          ex Mn being sigma_Measure of S st
            Q.n = Mn &
            ex X being Element of S st
              X = the carrier of M &
              ex mass being ExtReal st
                mass = Mn.X & mass < +infty) &
       for A being Element of S holds
         ex a being sequence of ExtREAL st
           (for n being Nat holds
              ex Mn being sigma_Measure of S st
                Q.n = Mn & a.n = Mn.A) &
           Mu.A = SUM(a)) &
    (ex N being Nat, tau being Real st
       1 < tau &
       for c being Function of Segm(N+1),the carrier of M,
           rad being Function of Segm(N+1),REAL holds
         not (
           (for i being Element of Segm(N+1) holds 0 < rad.i) &
           (for i,j being Element of Segm(N+1) st i <> j holds
              (rad.i <= dist(c.i,c.j) & rad.j <= tau * rad.i) or
              (rad.j <= dist(c.j,c.i) & rad.i <= tau * rad.j)) &
           (ex last being Element of Segm(N+1) st
              last = N &
              (for i being Element of Segm(N+1) st i <> last holds
                 rad.i <= dist(c.i,c.last) &
                 rad.last <= tau * rad.i) &
              (for i being Element of Segm(N+1) st i <> last holds
                 dist(c.i,c.last) <= rad.i + rad.last)))) &
    (for x being Point of M st x in s holds
       for delta being Real st 0 < delta holds
         ex rho being Real st
           rho in f.x & 0 < rho & rho < delta) &
    (for x being Point of M st x in s holds
       ex Rx being Real st Rx = R.x & 0 < Rx)
  holds
    ex t being countable Subset of M,
       r being Function of the carrier of M,REAL st
      t c= s &
      (for x being Point of M st x in t holds
         ex rx,Rx being Real st
           rx = r.x & Rx = R.x &

      (C_Meas Mu).
        (s \ {p where p is Point of M :
          ex x being Point of M, rx being Real st
            x in t & rx = r.x & p in cl_Ball(x,rx)}) = 0 &
      (for x,y being Point of M st
         x in t & y in t & x <> y holds
           ex rx,ry being Real st
             rx = r.x & ry = r.y &
             cl_Ball(x,rx) misses cl_Ball(y,ry))
proof
end;

title: Q137164_besicovitch_covering_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q137164,
% "Besicovitch covering theorem": admissible radii accumulating at zero yield
% a countable pairwise-disjoint family of closed balls covering almost all of
% a set in a second-countable Besicovitch metric measure space. This file contains no proof.

besicovitch_covering_theorem_Q137164[
  X: TYPE,
  carrier: [X -> bool],
  distance: [X, X -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  real_function: TYPE = [X -> real]
  radius_family: TYPE = [X -> [real -> bool]]
  center_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> X]
  radius_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  measure_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_map]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): carrier(x)

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      E(x) IMPLIES carrier(x)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      E(x) IMPLIES F(x)

  event_difference(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND E(x) AND NOT F(x)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND E(x) AND F(x)

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND NOT E(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  outer_measure_laws(M: measure_map): bool =
    measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        carrier_event(E) IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (E, F: event):
        carrier_event(E)
          AND carrier_event(F)
          AND event_subset(E, F)
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(M(E), M(F)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          carrier_event(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (total: measure_value):
            extended_nonnegative_sum(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                M(events(index)),
              total)
              AND measure_value_le(
                M(countable_union(events)),
                total))

  caratheodory_measurable(
      M: measure_map,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND FORALL (test: event):
        carrier_event(test) IMPLIES
          M(test) =
            measure_value_add(
              M(event_intersection(test, E)),
              M(event_difference(test, E)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND outer_measure_laws(M)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          caratheodory_measurable(M, E))

  finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(M(full_event))

  s_finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (components: measure_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        finite_measure(components(index), Sigma))
        AND (FORALL (E: event):
          Sigma(E) IMPLIES
            extended_nonnegative_sum(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                components(index)(E),
              M(E)))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(E))

  metric_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
        distance(x, y) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
          (distance(x, y) = 0 IFF x = y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
          distance(x, y) = distance(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z)
          IMPLIES
            distance(x, z)
              <= distance(x, y) + distance(y, z))

  metric_open(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) AND U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
            FORALL (y: X):
              carrier(y)
                AND distance(x, y) < epsilon_value
              IMPLIES U(y)

  second_countable_metric: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        metric_open(basis(index)))
        AND (FORALL (U: event), (x: X):
          metric_open(U) AND carrier(x) AND U(x)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (index: nat):
                basis(index)(x)
                  AND event_subset(basis(index), U))

  opens_measurable(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (U: event):
      metric_open(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U)

  closed_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND distance(x, center) <= radius

  disjoint_events(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES
        NOT (E(x) AND F(x))

  satellite_configuration(
      N: nat,
      tau: real,
      centers: center_sequence,
      radii: radius_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= N IMPLIES
        carrier(centers(index))
          AND 0 < radii(index))
      AND (FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
        left_index <= N
          AND right_index <= N
          AND left_index /= right_index
        IMPLIES
          ((radii(left_index)
              <= distance(
                centers(left_index),
                centers(right_index))
            AND radii(right_index)
              <= tau * radii(left_index))
          OR
          (radii(right_index)
              <= distance(
                centers(right_index),
                centers(left_index))
            AND radii(left_index)
              <= tau * radii(right_index))))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < N IMPLIES
          radii(index)
              <= distance(centers(index), centers(N))
            AND radii(N) <= tau * radii(index))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < N IMPLIES
          distance(centers(index), centers(N))
            <= radii(index) + radii(N))

  has_besicovitch_covering: bool =
    EXISTS (N: nat), (tau: real):
      1 < tau
        AND NOT EXISTS
            (centers: center_sequence),
            (radii: radius_sequence):
          satellite_configuration(
            N, tau, centers, radii)

  event_is_empty(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES NOT E(x)

  countable_event(E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND (event_is_empty(E)
        OR EXISTS (enumeration: center_sequence):
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            E(enumeration(index)))
            AND (FORALL (x: X):
              carrier(x) IMPLIES
                (E(x) IFF
                  EXISTS (index: nat):
                    enumeration(index) = x)))

  union_selected_closed_balls(
      selected: event,
      radii: real_function): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (center: X):
          carrier(center)
            AND selected(center)
            AND distance(x, center) <= radii(center)

  selected_balls_pairwise_disjoint(
      selected: event,
      radii: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (left_center, right_center: X):
      carrier(left_center)
        AND carrier(right_center)
        AND selected(left_center)
        AND selected(right_center)
        AND left_center /= right_center
      IMPLIES
        disjoint_events(
          closed_ball(left_center, radii(left_center)),
          closed_ball(right_center, radii(right_center)))

  admissible_radii_accumulate_at_zero(
      admissible: radius_family,
      source_set: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X), (delta: real):
      carrier(x)
        AND source_set(x)
        AND delta > 0
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          admissible(x)(radius)
            AND 0 < radius
            AND radius < delta

  positive_bound_on(
      bound: real_function,
      source_set: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND source_set(x)
        IMPLIES 0 < bound(x)

  besicovitch_covering_theorem: bool =
    metric_space
      AND second_countable_metric
      AND has_besicovitch_covering
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (admissible: radius_family),
          (source_set: event),
          (bound: real_function):
        (is_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND s_finite_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND opens_measurable(Sigma)
          AND carrier_event(source_set)
          AND admissible_radii_accumulate_at_zero(
            admissible, source_set)
          AND positive_bound_on(bound, source_set))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (selected: event),
              (radii: real_function):
            countable_event(selected)
              AND event_subset(selected, source_set)
              AND (FORALL (x: X):
                carrier(x) AND selected(x)
                  IMPLIES
                    admissible(x)(radii(x))
                      AND 0 < radii(x)
                      AND radii(x) < bound(x))
              AND null_event(
                M,
                event_difference(
                  source_set,
                  union_selected_closed_balls(
                    selected, radii)))
              AND selected_balls_pairwise_disjoint(
                selected, radii)
END besicovitch_covering_theorem_Q137164
