title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1420905
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1420905), "Hilbert's theorem 90": in a
  finite-dimensional cyclic Galois field extension, every element of algebra
  norm one is a quotient y/g(y) for a nonzero y. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1420905_field (F : Type) : Type := {
  q1420905_zero : F;
  q1420905_one : F;
  q1420905_add : F -> F -> F;
  q1420905_mul : F -> F -> F;
  q1420905_neg : F -> F;
  q1420905_inv : F -> F;
  q1420905_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1420905_add x (q1420905_add y z) =
      q1420905_add (q1420905_add x y) z;
  q1420905_add_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      q1420905_add x y = q1420905_add y x;
  q1420905_add_zero :
    forall x : F,
      q1420905_add x q1420905_zero = x;
  q1420905_add_neg :
    forall x : F,
      q1420905_add x (q1420905_neg x) = q1420905_zero;
  q1420905_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1420905_mul x (q1420905_mul y z) =
      q1420905_mul (q1420905_mul x y) z;
  q1420905_mul_comm :
    forall x y : F,
      q1420905_mul x y = q1420905_mul y x;
  q1420905_mul_one :
    forall x : F,
      q1420905_mul x q1420905_one = x;
  q1420905_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : F,
      q1420905_mul x (q1420905_add y z) =
      q1420905_add
        (q1420905_mul x y) (q1420905_mul x z);
  q1420905_mul_zero :
    forall x : F,
      q1420905_mul x q1420905_zero = q1420905_zero;
  q1420905_inv_zero :
    q1420905_inv q1420905_zero = q1420905_zero;
  q1420905_mul_inv :
    forall x : F,
      x <> q1420905_zero ->
      q1420905_mul x (q1420905_inv x) = q1420905_one;
  q1420905_zero_ne_one :
    q1420905_zero <> q1420905_one
}.

Arguments q1420905_zero {F} _.
Arguments q1420905_one {F} _.
Arguments q1420905_add {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q1420905_mul {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q1420905_neg {F} _ _.
Arguments q1420905_inv {F} _ _.

Record q1420905_field_algebra
    (K L : Type)
    (FK : q1420905_field K)
    (FL : q1420905_field L) : Type := {
  q1420905_embed : K -> L;
  q1420905_embed_zero :
    q1420905_embed (q1420905_zero FK) = q1420905_zero FL;
  q1420905_embed_one :
    q1420905_embed (q1420905_one FK) = q1420905_one FL;
  q1420905_embed_add :
    forall a b : K,
      q1420905_embed (q1420905_add FK a b) =
      q1420905_add FL (q1420905_embed a) (q1420905_embed b);
  q1420905_embed_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q1420905_embed (q1420905_mul FK a b) =
      q1420905_mul FL (q1420905_embed a) (q1420905_embed b);
  q1420905_embed_injective :
    forall a b : K,
      q1420905_embed a = q1420905_embed b -> a = b
}.

Arguments q1420905_embed {K L FK FL} _ _.

Record q1420905_finite_type (I : Type) : Type := {
  q1420905_enum : list I;
  q1420905_enum_nodup : NoDup q1420905_enum;
  q1420905_enum_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q1420905_enum
}.

Arguments q1420905_enum {I} _.

Fixpoint q1420905_sum_list
    {I F : Type}
    (FF : q1420905_field F)
    (indices : list I)
    (term : I -> F) : F :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q1420905_zero FF
  | cons i rest =>
      q1420905_add FF
        (term i) (q1420905_sum_list FF rest term)
  end.

Definition q1420905_linear_combination
    {K L I : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL)
    (fin : q1420905_finite_type I)
    (basis : I -> L)
    (coefficients : I -> K) : L :=
  q1420905_sum_list FL (q1420905_enum fin)
    (fun i =>
      q1420905_mul FL
        (q1420905_embed A (coefficients i))
        (basis i)).

Definition q1420905_basis_data
    {K L I : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL)
    (fin : q1420905_finite_type I)
    (basis : I -> L)
    (coordinates : L -> I -> K) : Prop :=
  (forall x : L,
      q1420905_linear_combination A fin basis (coordinates x) = x) /\
  (forall (coefficients : I -> K) (i : I),
      coordinates
        (q1420905_linear_combination A fin basis coefficients) i =
      coefficients i).

Definition q1420905_finite_dimensional
    {K L : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL) : Prop :=
  exists (I : Type)
         (fin : q1420905_finite_type I)
         (basis : I -> L)
         (coordinates : L -> I -> K),
    q1420905_basis_data A fin basis coordinates.

Fixpoint q1420905_determinant
    {I F : Type}
    (FF : q1420905_field F)
    (rows cols : list I)
    (M : I -> I -> F) {struct rows} : F :=
  match rows with
  | nil => q1420905_one FF
  | cons i remaining_rows =>
      let fix expand
          (prefix remaining_cols : list I)
          (positive : bool) {struct remaining_cols} : F :=
        match remaining_cols with
        | nil => q1420905_zero FF
        | cons j suffix =>
            let minor :=
              q1420905_determinant FF
                remaining_rows (rev prefix ++ suffix) M in
            let term := q1420905_mul FF (M i j) minor in
            q1420905_add FF
              (if positive then term else q1420905_neg FF term)
              (expand (cons j prefix) suffix (negb positive))
        end in
      expand nil cols true
  end.

Definition q1420905_norm_eq_one
    {K L : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL)
    (x : L) : Prop :=
  exists (I : Type)
         (fin : q1420905_finite_type I)
         (basis : I -> L)
         (coordinates : L -> I -> K),
    q1420905_basis_data A fin basis coordinates /\
    q1420905_determinant FK
      (q1420905_enum fin)
      (q1420905_enum fin)
      (fun row column =>
        coordinates
          (q1420905_mul FL x (basis column)) row) =
    q1420905_one FK.

Record q1420905_alg_automorphism
    {K L : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL) : Type := {
  q1420905_aut_apply : L -> L;
  q1420905_aut_inverse : L -> L;
  q1420905_aut_embed :
    forall a : K,
      q1420905_aut_apply (q1420905_embed A a) =
      q1420905_embed A a;
  q1420905_aut_add :
    forall x y : L,
      q1420905_aut_apply (q1420905_add FL x y) =
      q1420905_add FL
        (q1420905_aut_apply x) (q1420905_aut_apply y);
  q1420905_aut_mul :
    forall x y : L,
      q1420905_aut_apply (q1420905_mul FL x y) =
      q1420905_mul FL
        (q1420905_aut_apply x) (q1420905_aut_apply y);
  q1420905_aut_inverse_left :
    forall x : L,
      q1420905_aut_inverse (q1420905_aut_apply x) = x;
  q1420905_aut_inverse_right :
    forall x : L,
      q1420905_aut_apply (q1420905_aut_inverse x) = x
}.

Arguments q1420905_aut_apply {K L FK FL A} _ _.
Arguments q1420905_aut_inverse {K L FK FL A} _ _.

Fixpoint q1420905_iterate
    {X : Type} (f : X -> X) (n : nat) (x : X) : X :=
  match n with
  | O => x
  | S m => f (q1420905_iterate f m x)
  end.

Definition q1420905_generates_automorphisms
    {K L : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    {A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL}
    (g : q1420905_alg_automorphism A) : Prop :=
  forall sigma : q1420905_alg_automorphism A,
    exists n : nat,
      (forall x : L,
          q1420905_aut_apply sigma x =
          q1420905_iterate (q1420905_aut_apply g) n x) \/
      (forall x : L,
          q1420905_aut_apply sigma x =
          q1420905_iterate (q1420905_aut_inverse g) n x).

Definition q1420905_is_cyclic
    {K L : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL) : Prop :=
  exists g : q1420905_alg_automorphism A,
    q1420905_generates_automorphisms g.

Definition q1420905_is_galois
    {K L : Type}
    {FK : q1420905_field K}
    {FL : q1420905_field L}
    (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL) : Prop :=
  forall x : L,
    (forall sigma : q1420905_alg_automorphism A,
        q1420905_aut_apply sigma x = x) ->
    exists a : K, q1420905_embed A a = x.

Theorem groupCohomology_exists_div_of_norm_eq_one :
  forall (K L : Type)
         (FK : q1420905_field K)
         (FL : q1420905_field L)
         (A : @q1420905_field_algebra K L FK FL),
    q1420905_finite_dimensional A ->
    q1420905_is_galois A ->
    q1420905_is_cyclic A ->
    forall g : q1420905_alg_automorphism A,
      q1420905_generates_automorphisms g ->
      forall x : L,
        q1420905_norm_eq_one A x ->
        exists y : L,
          y <> q1420905_zero FL /\
          q1420905_mul FL y
            (q1420905_inv FL (q1420905_aut_apply g y)) = x.
Admitted.

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1420905 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1420905), "Hilbert's theorem 90":
  for a finite cyclic Galois extension, every element of norm one is a
  quotient of a nonzero element by its image under a chosen generator of the
  Galois group. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
  imports Main
begin

definition q1420905_field_embedding ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1420905_field_embedding emb \<longleftrightarrow>
    inj emb \<and>
    emb 0 = 0 \<and>
    emb 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. emb (a + b) = emb a + emb b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. emb (a * b) = emb a * emb b)"

definition q1420905_field_automorphism ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> ('l \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1420905_field_automorphism emb sigma \<longleftrightarrow>
    bij sigma \<and>
    sigma 0 = 0 \<and>
    sigma 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. sigma (x + y) = sigma x + sigma y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. sigma (x * y) = sigma x * sigma y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. sigma (emb a) = emb a)"

definition q1420905_galois_group ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> ('l \<Rightarrow> 'l) set" where
  "q1420905_galois_group emb =
    {sigma. q1420905_field_automorphism emb sigma}"

definition q1420905_linear_combination ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> 'l set \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> 'l" where
  "q1420905_linear_combination emb B c =
    (\<Sum>b\<in>B. emb (c b) * b)"

definition q1420905_basis ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> 'l set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1420905_basis emb B \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite B \<and>
    (\<forall>c. q1420905_linear_combination emb B c = 0
      \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>b\<in>B. c b = 0)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>c. q1420905_linear_combination emb B c = x)"

definition q1420905_finite_galois_extension ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1420905_finite_galois_extension emb \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1420905_field_embedding emb \<and>
    finite (q1420905_galois_group emb) \<and>
    (\<exists>B. q1420905_basis emb B \<and>
      card (q1420905_galois_group emb) = card B)"

definition q1420905_zpower ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a)" where
  "q1420905_zpower f n =
    (if 0 \<le> n
      then f ^^ nat n
      else inv_into UNIV f ^^ nat (-n))"

definition q1420905_is_cyclic ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1420905_is_cyclic A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>g\<in>A. \<forall>sigma\<in>A. \<exists>n::int. sigma = q1420905_zpower g n)"

definition q1420905_galois_norm ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field) \<Rightarrow> 'l \<Rightarrow> 'l" where
  "q1420905_galois_norm emb x =
    (\<Prod>sigma\<in>q1420905_galois_group emb. sigma x)"

theorem q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90:
  fixes emb :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::field"
    and g :: "'l \<Rightarrow> 'l"
    and x :: "'l"
  assumes extension: "q1420905_finite_galois_extension emb"
    and cyclic: "q1420905_is_cyclic (q1420905_galois_group emb)"
    and generator:
      "g \<in> q1420905_galois_group emb \<and>
        (\<forall>sigma\<in>q1420905_galois_group emb.
          \<exists>n::int. sigma = q1420905_zpower g n)"
    and norm_one: "q1420905_galois_norm emb x = 1"
  shows "\<exists>y::'l. y \<noteq> 0 \<and> y / g y = x"
  sorry

end

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1420905
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1420905), "Hilbert's theorem 90": in a
  finite cyclic Galois extension, every element of norm one is the quotient
  of a nonzero element by its image under a chosen generator of the Galois
  group. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1420905_HILBERT_THEOREM_90 =
  `let is_field_K =
     \(z:K) (u:K) (fadd:K->K->K) (fmul:K->K->K)
      (fneg:K->K) (finv:K->K).
       ~(z = u) /\
       (!x:K. fadd z x = x) /\
       (!x:K. fadd (fneg x) x = z) /\
       (!x y:K. fadd x y = fadd y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. fadd x (fadd y z) = fadd (fadd x y) z) /\
       (!x:K. fmul u x = x) /\
       (!x y:K. fmul x y = fmul y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. fmul x (fmul y z) = fmul (fmul x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:K. fmul x (fadd y z) =
                    fadd (fmul x y) (fmul x z)) /\
       (!x:K. ~(x = z) ==> fmul (finv x) x = u) in
   let is_field_L =
     \(z:L) (u:L) (fadd:L->L->L) (fmul:L->L->L)
      (fneg:L->L) (finv:L->L).
       ~(z = u) /\
       (!x:L. fadd z x = x) /\
       (!x:L. fadd (fneg x) x = z) /\
       (!x y:L. fadd x y = fadd y x) /\
       (!x y z:L. fadd x (fadd y z) = fadd (fadd x y) z) /\
       (!x:L. fmul u x = x) /\
       (!x y:L. fmul x y = fmul y x) /\
       (!x y z:L. fmul x (fmul y z) = fmul (fmul x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:L. fmul x (fadd y z) =
                    fadd (fmul x y) (fmul x z)) /\
       (!x:L. ~(x = z) ==> fmul (finv x) x = u) in
   let is_field_embedding =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (zeroL:L) (oneL:L) (addL:L->L->L) (mulL:L->L->L)
      (emb:K->L).
       emb zeroK = zeroL /\
       emb oneK = oneL /\
       (!a b:K. emb (addK a b) = addL (emb a) (emb b)) /\
       (!a b:K. emb (mulK a b) = mulL (emb a) (emb b)) /\
       (!a b:K. emb a = emb b ==> a = b) in
   let is_basis =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (zeroL:L) (addL:L->L->L)
      (mulL:L->L->L) (emb:K->L) (b:num->L).
       (!c:num->K.
          iterate addL {i:num | i < n}
            (\i. mulL (emb (c i)) (b i)) = zeroL
          ==> !i:num. i < n ==> c i = zeroK) /\
       (!x:L.
          ?c:num->K.
            x = iterate addL {i:num | i < n}
                  (\i. mulL (emb (c i)) (b i))) in
   let is_K_automorphism =
     \(zeroL:L) (oneL:L) (addL:L->L->L) (mulL:L->L->L)
      (emb:K->L) (s:L->L).
       s zeroL = zeroL /\
       s oneL = oneL /\
       (!x y:L. s (addL x y) = addL (s x) (s y)) /\
       (!x y:L. s (mulL x y) = mulL (s x) (s y)) /\
       (!a:K. s (emb a) = emb a) /\
       (!x y:L. s x = s y ==> x = y) /\
       (!y:L. ?x:L. s x = y) in
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK invK:K->K.
   !zeroL oneL:L.
   !addL mulL:L->L->L.
   !negL invL:L->L.
   !emb:K->L.
     is_field_K zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     is_field_L zeroL oneL addL mulL negL invL /\
     is_field_embedding
       zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroL oneL addL mulL emb
     ==>
     let automorphisms =
       {s:L->L |
          is_K_automorphism zeroL oneL addL mulL emb s} in
     (?n:num. ?b:num->L.
        is_basis n zeroK zeroL addL mulL emb b /\
        FINITE automorphisms /\
        CARD automorphisms = n)
     ==>
     !g:L->L.
       g IN automorphisms /\
       (!s:L->L.
          s IN automorphisms ==> ?m:num. s = ITER m g)
       ==>
       !x:L.
         iterate mulL automorphisms (\s. s x) = oneL
         ==>
         ?y:L.
           ~(y = zeroL) /\
           mulL y (invL (g y)) = x`;;

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1420905,
;; "Hilbert's theorem 90": in a finite cyclic Galois field extension, every
;; element of norm one is y divided by its image under a chosen generator,
;; for some nonzero y. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Field structures and an arbitrary embedding of the base field into the
;; extension field. Structure tags select operations without enumerating or
;; otherwise restricting either carrier.

(defstub q1420905-field-element-p (field value) t)
(defstub q1420905-field-zero (field) t)
(defstub q1420905-field-one (field) t)
(defstub q1420905-field-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q1420905-field-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q1420905-field-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q1420905-field-inverse (field value) t)
(defstub q1420905-algebra-map (extension base top value) t)

(defun-sk q1420905-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (a b c)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1420905-field-element-p field a)
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p
        field (q1420905-field-negate field a))
       (q1420905-field-element-p
        field (q1420905-field-inverse field a))
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-add
         field a (q1420905-field-zero field))
        a)
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-add
         field (q1420905-field-zero field) a)
        a)
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-add
         field a (q1420905-field-negate field a))
        (q1420905-field-zero field))
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         field a (q1420905-field-one field))
        a)
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         field (q1420905-field-one field) a)
        a)
       (implies
        (not (equal a (q1420905-field-zero field)))
        (and
         (equal
          (q1420905-field-multiply
           field a (q1420905-field-inverse field a))
          (q1420905-field-one field))
         (equal
          (q1420905-field-multiply
           field (q1420905-field-inverse field a) a)
          (q1420905-field-one field))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p field a)
       (q1420905-field-element-p field b))
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p
        field (q1420905-field-add field a b))
       (q1420905-field-element-p
        field (q1420905-field-multiply field a b))
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-add field a b)
        (q1420905-field-add field b a))
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-multiply field a b)
        (q1420905-field-multiply field b a))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p field a)
       (q1420905-field-element-p field b)
       (q1420905-field-element-p field c))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-add
         field (q1420905-field-add field a b) c)
        (q1420905-field-add
         field a (q1420905-field-add field b c)))
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         field (q1420905-field-multiply field a b) c)
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         field a (q1420905-field-multiply field b c)))
       (equal
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         field a (q1420905-field-add field b c))
        (q1420905-field-add
         field
         (q1420905-field-multiply field a b)
         (q1420905-field-multiply field a c))))))))

(defun q1420905-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q1420905-field-element-p
    field (q1420905-field-zero field))
   (q1420905-field-element-p
    field (q1420905-field-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1420905-field-zero field)
     (q1420905-field-one field)))
   (q1420905-field-laws-p field)))

(defun-sk q1420905-algebra-map-laws-p (extension base top)
  (forall (a b)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1420905-field-element-p base a)
      (q1420905-field-element-p
       top
       (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top a)))
     (equal
      (q1420905-algebra-map
       extension base top (q1420905-field-zero base))
      (q1420905-field-zero top))
     (equal
      (q1420905-algebra-map
       extension base top (q1420905-field-one base))
      (q1420905-field-one top))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p base a)
       (q1420905-field-element-p base b))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1420905-algebra-map
         extension base top
         (q1420905-field-add base a b))
        (q1420905-field-add
         top
         (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top a)
         (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top b)))
       (equal
        (q1420905-algebra-map
         extension base top
         (q1420905-field-multiply base a b))
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         top
         (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top a)
         (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top b)))
       (implies
        (equal
         (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top a)
         (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top b))
        (equal a b)))))))

(defun q1420905-field-extension-p (extension base top)
  (and
   (q1420905-field-p base)
   (q1420905-field-p top)
   (q1420905-algebra-map-laws-p extension base top)))

;; A finite basis is represented by a list of extension-field elements.
;; Coefficient lists range over all base-field coefficients, so spanning and
;; linear independence retain their ordinary unbounded meanings.

(defun q1420905-field-list-p (field values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p field (car values))
       (q1420905-field-list-p field (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1420905-all-zero-p (base coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (equal
        (car coefficients)
        (q1420905-field-zero base))
       (q1420905-all-zero-p base (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q1420905-linear-combination
    (extension base top coefficients basis)
  (if (and (consp coefficients) (consp basis))
      (q1420905-field-add
       top
       (q1420905-field-multiply
        top
        (q1420905-algebra-map
         extension base top (car coefficients))
        (car basis))
       (q1420905-linear-combination
        extension base top (cdr coefficients) (cdr basis)))
    (q1420905-field-zero top)))

(defun-sk q1420905-linearly-independent-p
    (extension base top basis)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1420905-field-list-p base coefficients)
      (equal (len coefficients) (len basis))
      (equal
       (q1420905-linear-combination
        extension base top coefficients basis)
       (q1420905-field-zero top)))
     (q1420905-all-zero-p base coefficients))))

(defun-sk q1420905-has-basis-coordinates-p
    (extension base top basis value)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (q1420905-field-list-p base coefficients)
     (equal (len coefficients) (len basis))
     (equal
      (q1420905-linear-combination
       extension base top coefficients basis)
      value))))

(defun-sk q1420905-spans-p (extension base top basis)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q1420905-field-element-p top value)
     (q1420905-has-basis-coordinates-p
      extension base top basis value))))

(defun q1420905-basis-p (extension base top basis)
  (and
   (q1420905-field-list-p top basis)
   (q1420905-linearly-independent-p
    extension base top basis)
   (q1420905-spans-p extension base top basis)))

;; K-algebra automorphisms are represented extensionally by their action on
;; the whole extension field. The laws below make every admitted tag an
;; injective base-fixing field endomorphism; finite dimensionality then makes
;; it a bijective K-algebra automorphism.

(defstub q1420905-automorphism-apply
  (extension base top automorphism value)
  t)

(defun-sk q1420905-automorphism-laws-p
    (extension base top automorphism)
  (forall (a b k)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1420905-field-element-p top a)
      (q1420905-field-element-p
       top
       (q1420905-automorphism-apply
        extension base top automorphism a)))
     (equal
      (q1420905-automorphism-apply
       extension base top automorphism
       (q1420905-field-zero top))
      (q1420905-field-zero top))
     (equal
      (q1420905-automorphism-apply
       extension base top automorphism
       (q1420905-field-one top))
      (q1420905-field-one top))
     (implies
      (q1420905-field-element-p base k)
      (equal
       (q1420905-automorphism-apply
        extension base top automorphism
        (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top k))
       (q1420905-algebra-map extension base top k)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1420905-field-element-p top a)
       (q1420905-field-element-p top b))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1420905-automorphism-apply
         extension base top automorphism
         (q1420905-field-add top a b))
        (q1420905-field-add
         top
         (q1420905-automorphism-apply
          extension base top automorphism a)
         (q1420905-automorphism-apply
          extension base top automorphism b)))
       (equal
        (q1420905-automorphism-apply
         extension base top automorphism
         (q1420905-field-multiply top a b))
        (q1420905-field-multiply
         top
         (q1420905-automorphism-apply
          extension base top automorphism a)
         (q1420905-automorphism-apply
          extension base top automorphism b)))
       (implies
        (equal
         (q1420905-automorphism-apply
          extension base top automorphism a)
         (q1420905-automorphism-apply
          extension base top automorphism b))
        (equal a b)))))))

(defun q1420905-automorphism-p
    (extension base top automorphism)
  (q1420905-automorphism-laws-p
   extension base top automorphism))

(defun-sk q1420905-automorphisms-extensionally-equal-p
    (extension base top left right)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q1420905-field-element-p top value)
     (equal
      (q1420905-automorphism-apply
       extension base top left value)
      (q1420905-automorphism-apply
       extension base top right value)))))

(defun q1420905-automorphism-distinct-from-list-p
    (extension base top automorphism automorphisms)
  (if (consp automorphisms)
      (and
       (not
        (q1420905-automorphisms-extensionally-equal-p
         extension base top automorphism (car automorphisms)))
       (q1420905-automorphism-distinct-from-list-p
        extension base top automorphism (cdr automorphisms)))
    t))

(defun q1420905-pairwise-distinct-automorphisms-p
    (extension base top automorphisms)
  (if (consp automorphisms)
      (and
       (q1420905-automorphism-distinct-from-list-p
        extension base top (car automorphisms) (cdr automorphisms))
       (q1420905-pairwise-distinct-automorphisms-p
        extension base top (cdr automorphisms)))
    (equal automorphisms nil)))

(defun q1420905-valid-automorphism-list-p
    (extension base top automorphisms)
  (if (consp automorphisms)
      (and
       (q1420905-automorphism-p
        extension base top (car automorphisms))
       (q1420905-valid-automorphism-list-p
        extension base top (cdr automorphisms)))
    (equal automorphisms nil)))

(defun q1420905-automorphism-extensionally-member-p
    (extension base top automorphism automorphisms)
  (if (consp automorphisms)
      (or
       (q1420905-automorphisms-extensionally-equal-p
        extension base top automorphism (car automorphisms))
       (q1420905-automorphism-extensionally-member-p
        extension base top automorphism (cdr automorphisms)))
    nil))

(defun-sk q1420905-enumerates-all-automorphisms-p
    (extension base top automorphisms)
  (forall (automorphism)
    (implies
     (q1420905-automorphism-p
      extension base top automorphism)
     (q1420905-automorphism-extensionally-member-p
      extension base top automorphism automorphisms))))

(defun q1420905-exact-automorphism-list-p
    (extension base top automorphisms)
  (and
   (true-listp automorphisms)
   (q1420905-valid-automorphism-list-p
    extension base top automorphisms)
   (q1420905-pairwise-distinct-automorphisms-p
    extension base top automorphisms)
   (q1420905-enumerates-all-automorphisms-p
    extension base top automorphisms)))

;; For a finite field extension, having exactly [L:K] distinct K-algebra
;; automorphisms is equivalent to being Galois. This gives a basis-independent
;; first-order representation of FiniteDimensional K L and IsGalois K L.

(defun q1420905-galois-data-p
    (extension base top basis automorphisms)
  (and
   (q1420905-basis-p extension base top basis)
   (q1420905-exact-automorphism-list-p
    extension base top automorphisms)
   (equal (len automorphisms) (len basis))))

(defun-sk q1420905-finite-galois-extension-p
    (extension base top)
  (exists (basis automorphisms)
    (and
     (q1420905-field-extension-p extension base top)
     (q1420905-galois-data-p
      extension base top basis automorphisms))))

;; The generator condition is the source hypothesis that every automorphism
;; lies in the subgroup generated by g. Natural powers suffice because the
;; automorphism group is finite.

(defun q1420905-automorphism-power-apply
    (extension base top generator exponent value)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      value
    (q1420905-automorphism-apply
     extension base top generator
     (q1420905-automorphism-power-apply
      extension base top generator (- exponent 1) value))))

(defun-sk q1420905-automorphism-equals-power-p
    (extension base top automorphism generator exponent)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q1420905-field-element-p top value)
     (equal
      (q1420905-automorphism-apply
       extension base top automorphism value)
      (q1420905-automorphism-power-apply
       extension base top generator exponent value)))))

(defun-sk q1420905-is-power-of-generator-p
    (extension base top automorphism generator)
  (exists (exponent)
    (and
     (natp exponent)
     (q1420905-automorphism-equals-power-p
      extension base top automorphism generator exponent))))

(defun-sk q1420905-generates-galois-group-p
    (extension base top generator)
  (forall (automorphism)
    (implies
     (q1420905-automorphism-p
      extension base top automorphism)
     (q1420905-is-power-of-generator-p
      extension base top automorphism generator))))

;; In a finite Galois extension, the algebra norm equals the product of all
;; Galois conjugates. Thus the internal exact automorphism enumeration below
;; is equivalent to Algebra.norm K x = 1 and introduces no external witness.

(defun q1420905-conjugate-product
    (extension base top automorphisms value)
  (if (consp automorphisms)
      (q1420905-field-multiply
       top
       (q1420905-automorphism-apply
        extension base top (car automorphisms) value)
       (q1420905-conjugate-product
        extension base top (cdr automorphisms) value))
    (q1420905-field-one top)))

(defun-sk q1420905-norm-one-p
    (extension base top value)
  (exists (automorphisms)
    (and
     (q1420905-exact-automorphism-list-p
      extension base top automorphisms)
     (equal
      (q1420905-conjugate-product
       extension base top automorphisms value)
      (q1420905-field-one top)))))

(defun-sk q1420905-hilbert-witness-exists-p
    (extension base top generator value)
  (exists (y)
    (and
     (q1420905-field-element-p top y)
     (not (equal y (q1420905-field-zero top)))
     (equal
      (q1420905-field-multiply
       top
       y
       (q1420905-field-inverse
        top
        (q1420905-automorphism-apply
         extension base top generator y)))
      value))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1420905-hilberts-theorem-90-statement
    ()
  (forall (extension base top generator value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1420905-finite-galois-extension-p
       extension base top)
      (q1420905-automorphism-p
       extension base top generator)
      (q1420905-generates-galois-group-p
       extension base top generator)
      (q1420905-field-element-p top value)
      (q1420905-norm-one-p
       extension base top value))
     (q1420905-hilbert-witness-exists-p
      extension base top generator value))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1420905,
-- "Hilbert's theorem 90": in a finite cyclic Galois field extension, every
-- element of norm one is a quotient y / g(y) for a nonzero y.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1420905HilbertsTheoremNinety where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
  renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 2 _×_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not A =
  A → Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (sucN n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (sucN n)

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zero one : A
    add multiply : A → A → A
    negate : A → A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) →
      add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : A) →
      multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : A) →
      multiply x one ≡ x
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : A) →
      multiply zero x ≡ zero
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : A) →
      multiply x zero ≡ zero

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (add x y) z ≡
      add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing A
    inverse : A → A
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.one ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zero ring
    inverse-zero :
      inverse (CommutativeRing.zero ring) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zero ring
    inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zero ring →
      CommutativeRing.multiply ring (inverse x) x ≡
      CommutativeRing.one ring
    inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zero ring →
      CommutativeRing.multiply ring x (inverse x) ≡
      CommutativeRing.one ring

record RingHom
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b}
  (domain : CommutativeRing A)
  (codomain : CommutativeRing B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : A → B
    map-zero :
      map (CommutativeRing.zero domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zero codomain
    map-one :
      map (CommutativeRing.one domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.one codomain
    map-add :
      (x y : A) →
      map (CommutativeRing.add domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.add codomain (map x) (map y)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      map (CommutativeRing.multiply domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiply codomain (map x) (map y)

sumFin :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → A) →
  A
sumFin ring zeroN values =
  CommutativeRing.zero ring
sumFin ring (sucN n) values =
  CommutativeRing.add ring
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin ring n (λ i → values (fsuc i)))

productFin :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → A) →
  A
productFin ring zeroN values =
  CommutativeRing.one ring
productFin ring (sucN n) values =
  CommutativeRing.multiply ring
    (values fzero)
    (productFin ring n (λ i → values (fsuc i)))

linearCombination :
  {k l : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {L : Set l} →
  (base : CommutativeRing K) →
  (extension : CommutativeRing L) →
  RingHom base extension →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → L) →
  (Fin n → K) →
  L
linearCombination base extension algebra-map n vectors coefficients =
  sumFin extension n
    (λ i →
      CommutativeRing.multiply extension
        (RingHom.map algebra-map (coefficients i))
        (vectors i))

record HasBasis
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {L : Set l}
  (base : CommutativeRing K)
  (extension : CommutativeRing L)
  (algebra-map : RingHom base extension)
  (dimension : Nat) :
  Set (k ⊔ l) where

  field
    basis : Fin dimension → L
    linearly-independent :
      (coefficients : Fin dimension → K) →
      linearCombination
        base extension algebra-map dimension basis coefficients
      ≡
      CommutativeRing.zero extension →
      (i : Fin dimension) →
      coefficients i ≡ CommutativeRing.zero base
    spans :
      (x : L) →
      Σ (Fin dimension → K)
        (λ coefficients →
          linearCombination
            base extension algebra-map dimension basis coefficients
          ≡
          x)

record KAutomorphism
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {L : Set l}
  (base-field : Field K)
  (extension-field : Field L)
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)) :
  Set (k ⊔ l) where

  private
    base = Field.ring base-field
    extension = Field.ring extension-field

  field
    apply inverse-apply : L → L
    apply-after-inverse :
      (x : L) →
      apply (inverse-apply x) ≡ x
    inverse-after-apply :
      (x : L) →
      inverse-apply (apply x) ≡ x
    apply-zero :
      apply (CommutativeRing.zero extension) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zero extension
    apply-one :
      apply (CommutativeRing.one extension) ≡
      CommutativeRing.one extension
    apply-add :
      (x y : L) →
      apply (CommutativeRing.add extension x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.add extension (apply x) (apply y)
    apply-multiply :
      (x y : L) →
      apply (CommutativeRing.multiply extension x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiply extension (apply x) (apply y)
    fixes-base :
      (x : K) →
      apply (RingHom.map algebra-map x) ≡
      RingHom.map algebra-map x

AutomorphismEqual :
  {k l : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {L : Set l} →
  {base-field : Field K} →
  {extension-field : Field L} →
  {algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)} →
  KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  Set l
AutomorphismEqual {L = L} left right =
  (x : L) →
  KAutomorphism.apply left x ≡
  KAutomorphism.apply right x

iterate :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  (A → A) →
  Nat →
  A →
  A
iterate f zeroN x =
  x
iterate f (sucN n) x =
  f (iterate f n x)

integerAction :
  {k l : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {L : Set l} →
  {base-field : Field K} →
  {extension-field : Field L} →
  {algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)} →
  KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  Int →
  L →
  L
integerAction g (pos n) =
  iterate (KAutomorphism.apply g) n
integerAction g (negsuc n) =
  iterate (KAutomorphism.inverse-apply g) (sucN n)

GeneratedBy :
  {k l : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {L : Set l} →
  {base-field : Field K} →
  {extension-field : Field L} →
  {algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)} →
  KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  Set l
GeneratedBy {L = L} generator automorphism =
  Σ Int
    (λ power →
      (x : L) →
      integerAction generator power x ≡
      KAutomorphism.apply automorphism x)

record FiniteGaloisExtension
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {L : Set l}
  (base-field : Field K)
  (extension-field : Field L)
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)) :
  Set (k ⊔ l) where

  private
    extension = Field.ring extension-field

  field
    dimension : Nat
    basis :
      HasBasis
        (Field.ring base-field)
        extension
        algebra-map
        dimension

    automorphism-count : Nat
    automorphism :
      Fin automorphism-count →
      KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map
    automorphism-complete :
      (φ : KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map) →
      Σ (Fin automorphism-count)
        (λ i → AutomorphismEqual (automorphism i) φ)
    automorphism-distinct :
      (i j : Fin automorphism-count) →
      AutomorphismEqual (automorphism i) (automorphism j) →
      i ≡ j

    fixed-elements-are-scalars :
      (x : L) →
      ((i : Fin automorphism-count) →
        KAutomorphism.apply (automorphism i) x ≡ x) →
      Σ K (λ scalar → RingHom.map algebra-map scalar ≡ x)

GaloisNorm :
  {k l : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {L : Set l} →
  {base-field : Field K} →
  {extension-field : Field L} →
  {algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)} →
  FiniteGaloisExtension base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  L →
  L
GaloisNorm {extension-field = extension-field} galois x =
  productFin
    (Field.ring extension-field)
    (FiniteGaloisExtension.automorphism-count galois)
    (λ i →
      KAutomorphism.apply
        (FiniteGaloisExtension.automorphism galois i)
        x)

AutomorphismsAreCyclic :
  {k l : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {L : Set l} →
  {base-field : Field K} →
  {extension-field : Field L} →
  {algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)} →
  FiniteGaloisExtension base-field extension-field algebra-map →
  Set (k ⊔ l)
AutomorphismsAreCyclic
  {base-field = base-field}
  {extension-field = extension-field}
  {algebra-map = algebra-map}
  galois =
  Σ (KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map)
    (λ generator →
      (φ : KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map) →
      GeneratedBy generator φ)

hilbert-theorem-90 : Setω
hilbert-theorem-90 =
  ∀ {k l : Level} →
  (K : Set k) →
  (L : Set l) →
  (base-field : Field K) →
  (extension-field : Field L) →
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)) →
  (galois :
    FiniteGaloisExtension
      base-field
      extension-field
      algebra-map) →
  AutomorphismsAreCyclic galois →
  (g : KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map) →
  ((φ : KAutomorphism base-field extension-field algebra-map) →
    GeneratedBy g φ) →
  (x : L) →
  GaloisNorm galois x ≡
    CommutativeRing.one (Field.ring extension-field) →
  Σ L
    (λ y →
      (y ≠ CommutativeRing.zero (Field.ring extension-field))
      ×
      (CommutativeRing.multiply
        (Field.ring extension-field)
        y
        (Field.inverse extension-field
          (KAutomorphism.apply g y))
      ≡
      x))

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1420905 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1420905), "Hilbert's theorem 90":
  for a finite-dimensional cyclic Galois field extension, every element
  whose product over the Galois automorphisms is one is a quotient of a
  nonzero element by its image under a chosen generator. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q1420905_field_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_field_def",
  ``q1420905_field
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (invA : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      zero <> oneA /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneA x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      invA zero = zero /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul (invA x) x = oneA)``);

val q1420905_field_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_field_embedding_def",
  ``q1420905_field_embedding
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) <=>
      embed Kzero = Lzero /\
      embed Kone = Lone /\
      (!a b. embed (Kadd a b) = Ladd (embed a) (embed b)) /\
      (!a b. embed (Kmul a b) = Lmul (embed a) (embed b)) /\
      (!a. embed (Kneg a) = Lneg (embed a)) /\
      (!a. embed (Kinv a) = Linv (embed a)) /\
      (!a b. embed a = embed b ==> a = b)``);

val q1420905_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_lincomb_def",
  ``q1420905_lincomb
      (Kzero : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (embed : 'k -> 'l)
      (basis : 'l list) (coeff : num -> 'k) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i.
          Ladd acc (Lmul (embed (coeff i)) (EL i basis)))
        Lzero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q1420905_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_basis_def",
  ``q1420905_basis
      (Kzero : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (embed : 'k -> 'l)
      (basis : 'l list) <=>
      ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
      (!coeff : num -> 'k.
        q1420905_lincomb
          Kzero Lzero Ladd Lmul embed basis coeff = Lzero
        ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = Kzero) /\
      (!x : 'l.
        ?coeff : num -> 'k.
          q1420905_lincomb
            Kzero Lzero Ladd Lmul embed basis coeff = x)``);

val q1420905_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q1420905_finite_dimensional
      (Kzero : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (embed : 'k -> 'l) <=>
      ?basis : 'l list.
        q1420905_basis Kzero Lzero Ladd Lmul embed basis``);

val q1420905_automorphism_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_automorphism_def",
  ``q1420905_automorphism
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) (sigma : 'l -> 'l) <=>
      BIJ sigma UNIV UNIV /\
      sigma Lzero = Lzero /\
      sigma Lone = Lone /\
      (!x y. sigma (Ladd x y) = Ladd (sigma x) (sigma y)) /\
      (!x y. sigma (Lmul x y) = Lmul (sigma x) (sigma y)) /\
      (!x. sigma (Lneg x) = Lneg (sigma x)) /\
      (!x. sigma (Linv x) = Linv (sigma x)) /\
      (!a. sigma (embed a) = embed a)``);

val q1420905_automorphisms_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_automorphisms_def",
  ``q1420905_automorphisms
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) =
      {sigma |
        q1420905_automorphism
          Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed sigma}``);

val q1420905_is_galois_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_is_galois_def",
  ``q1420905_is_galois
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) <=>
      FINITE
        (q1420905_automorphisms
          Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed) /\
      !basis : 'l list.
        q1420905_basis Kzero Lzero Ladd Lmul embed basis
        ==>
        CARD
          (q1420905_automorphisms
            Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed) =
        LENGTH basis``);

val q1420905_cyclic_automorphisms_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_cyclic_automorphisms_def",
  ``q1420905_cyclic_automorphisms
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) <=>
      ?generator : 'l -> 'l.
        generator IN
          q1420905_automorphisms
            Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed /\
        !sigma.
          sigma IN
            q1420905_automorphisms
              Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed
          ==>
          ?n : num. sigma = FUNPOW generator n``);

val q1420905_galois_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1420905_galois_norm_def",
  ``q1420905_galois_norm
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) (x : 'l) =
      ITSET
        (\sigma acc. Lmul (sigma x) acc)
        (q1420905_automorphisms
          Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed)
        Lone``);

val exists_div_of_norm_eq_one =
  ``!(Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (Lzero : 'l) (Lone : 'l)
      (Ladd : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (Lmul : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (Lneg : 'l -> 'l) (Linv : 'l -> 'l)
      (embed : 'k -> 'l) (g : 'l -> 'l) (x : 'l).
      q1420905_field Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv /\
      q1420905_field Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv /\
      q1420905_field_embedding
        Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv
        Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed /\
      q1420905_finite_dimensional Kzero Lzero Ladd Lmul embed /\
      q1420905_is_galois
        Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed /\
      q1420905_cyclic_automorphisms
        Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed /\
      g IN
        q1420905_automorphisms
          Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed /\
      (!sigma.
        sigma IN
          q1420905_automorphisms
            Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed
        ==>
        ?n : num. sigma = FUNPOW g n) /\
      q1420905_galois_norm
        Kzero Kone Lzero Lone Ladd Lmul Lneg Linv embed x = Lone
      ==>
      ?y : 'l.
        y <> Lzero /\
        Lmul y (Linv (g y)) = x``;

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1420905
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1420905), "Hilbert's theorem 90": in a
  finite-dimensional cyclic Galois field extension, every element of norm one
  is y divided by its image under a chosen generator, for some nonzero unit y.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  k and l are arbitrary fields and f e. ( k RingHom l ) is the algebra map.
  Q1420905ExtensionModule is l as a k-vector space, and
  Q1420905FiniteDimensional says that it has a finite basis.

  Q1420905Automorphisms is the set of all bijective ring endomorphisms of L
  that fix F pointwise. Restricting the symmetric group of Base ` L to this
  set gives the full K-algebra automorphism group. In a finite-dimensional
  field extension, finiteness of this group and equality of its cardinality
  with the dimension is equivalent to the source IsGalois K L hypothesis.

  Under that Galois hypothesis, Algebra.norm K x = 1 is equivalent, by the
  Galois product formula and injectivity of F, to the product of all conjugates
  s(x) being 1 in L. Q1420905Norm is this product. Q1420905Generates states
  exactly that every automorphism is an integral power of g. The witness stays
  existentially quantified in the conclusion and lies in Unit ` L.

  All auxiliary $a declarations below are syntax or transparent definitions.
  The final $a declaration is the unproved corpus statement; there is no $p
  proof statement in this file.
$)

$c Q1420905ExtensionModule Q1420905FiniteDimensional
   Q1420905Automorphisms Q1420905GaloisGroup Q1420905IsGalois
   Q1420905Generates Q1420905Norm $.

q1420905-extension-module-syntax $a class
  ( Q1420905ExtensionModule K L F ) $.
q1420905-finite-dimensional-syntax $a wff
  ( Q1420905FiniteDimensional K L F ) $.
q1420905-automorphisms-syntax $a class
  ( Q1420905Automorphisms K L F ) $.
q1420905-galois-group-syntax $a class
  ( Q1420905GaloisGroup K L F ) $.
q1420905-is-galois-syntax $a wff
  ( Q1420905IsGalois K L F ) $.
q1420905-generates-syntax $a wff
  ( Q1420905Generates K L F g ) $.
q1420905-norm-syntax $a class
  ( Q1420905Norm K L F x ) $.

${
  $d F K L a x $.

  q1420905-extension-module-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905ExtensionModule K L F
  ) = (
    {
      <. ( Base ` ndx ) , ( Base ` L ) >. ,
      <. ( +g ` ndx ) , ( +g ` L ) >. ,
      <. ( Scalar ` ndx ) , K >.
    }
    u.
    {
      <.
        ( .s ` ndx ) ,
        (
          a e. ( Base ` K ) ,
          x e. ( Base ` L )
          |->
          ( ( F ` a ) ( .r ` L ) x )
        )
      >.
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K L b $.

  q1420905-finite-dimensional-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905FiniteDimensional K L F
  ) <->
  (
    E. b e. ( LBasis ` ( Q1420905ExtensionModule K L F ) )
      b e. Fin
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K L s $.

  q1420905-automorphisms-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905Automorphisms K L F
  ) = {
    s e. ( L RingHom L ) |
    (
      s : ( Base ` L ) -1-1-onto-> ( Base ` L )
      /\
      ( s o. F ) = F
    )
  } $.
$}

${
  q1420905-galois-group-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905GaloisGroup K L F
  ) = (
    ( SymGrp ` ( Base ` L ) )
    |`s
    ( Q1420905Automorphisms K L F )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K L b $.

  q1420905-is-galois-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905IsGalois K L F
  ) <->
  (
    ( Q1420905Automorphisms K L F ) e. Fin
    /\
    A. b e. ( LBasis ` ( Q1420905ExtensionModule K L F ) )
      (
        b e. Fin
        ->
        ( # ` ( Q1420905Automorphisms K L F ) ) = ( # ` b )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K L g n $.

  q1420905-generates-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905Generates K L F g
  ) <->
  (
    g e. ( Base ` ( Q1420905GaloisGroup K L F ) )
    /\
    ran
      (
        n e. ZZ
        |->
        (
          n
          ( .g ` ( Q1420905GaloisGroup K L F ) )
          g
        )
      )
      =
      ( Base ` ( Q1420905GaloisGroup K L F ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K L s x $.

  q1420905-norm-definition $a |- (
    Q1420905Norm K L F x
  ) = (
    ( mulGrp ` L )
    gsum
    (
      s e. ( Q1420905Automorphisms K L F )
      |->
      ( s ` x )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f g k l x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q1420905-hilbert-s-theorem-90 $a |- (
    A. k e. Field
      A. l e. Field
        A. f e. ( k RingHom l )
          (
            (
              ( Q1420905FiniteDimensional k l f )
              /\
              ( Q1420905IsGalois k l f )
              /\
              ( Q1420905GaloisGroup k l f ) e. CycGrp
            )
            ->
            A. g e. ( Base ` ( Q1420905GaloisGroup k l f ) )
              (
                ( Q1420905Generates k l f g )
                ->
                A. x e. ( Base ` l )
                  (
                    ( Q1420905Norm k l f x ) = ( 1r ` l )
                    ->
                    E. y e. ( Unit ` l )
                      (
                        y
                        ( /r ` l )
                        ( g ` y )
                      )
                      =
                      x
                  )
              )
          )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1420905
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1420905), "Hilbert's theorem 90": in a finite
% cyclic Galois field extension, every norm-one element is a quotient y/g(y)
% for a nonzero element y and a generating automorphism g. This file contains
% no proof.

Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90[
  K, L: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  zeroL, oneL: L,
  addL, mulL: [L, L -> L],
  negL, invL: [L -> L],
  algebra_map: [K -> L]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  endomorphism: TYPE = [L -> L]
  automorphism_list: TYPE = list[endomorphism]

  field_laws_K: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K): addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a
          AND addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K): mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K): mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)

  field_laws_L: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: L): addL(x, y) = addL(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        addL(addL(x, y), z) = addL(x, addL(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L):
        addL(x, zeroL) = x
          AND addL(x, negL(x)) = zeroL)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L): mulL(x, y) = mulL(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        mulL(mulL(x, y), z) = mulL(x, mulL(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L): mulL(x, oneL) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        mulL(x, addL(y, z)) =
          addL(mulL(x, y), mulL(x, z)))
      AND zeroL /= oneL
      AND invL(zeroL) = zeroL
      AND (FORALL (x: L):
        x /= zeroL IMPLIES mulL(x, invL(x)) = oneL)

  algebra_embedding_laws: bool =
    algebra_map(zeroK) = zeroL
      AND algebra_map(oneK) = oneL
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        algebra_map(addK(a, b)) =
          addL(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        algebra_map(mulK(a, b)) =
          mulL(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        algebra_map(a) = algebra_map(b) IMPLIES a = b)

  same_length(coefficients: list[K], basis: list[L]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES basis OF
      null:
        CASES coefficients OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail): FALSE
        ENDCASES,
      cons(vector, vector_tail):
        CASES coefficients OF
          null: FALSE,
          cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail):
            same_length(coefficient_tail, vector_tail)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE basis BY <<

  linear_combination(
      coefficients: list[K],
      basis: list[L]): RECURSIVE L =
    CASES basis OF
      null: zeroL,
      cons(vector, vector_tail):
        CASES coefficients OF
          null: zeroL,
          cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail):
            addL(
              mulL(algebra_map(coefficient), vector),
              linear_combination(coefficient_tail, vector_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE basis BY <<

  all_coefficients_zero(coefficients: list[K]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail):
        coefficient = zeroK
          AND all_coefficients_zero(coefficient_tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  basis_length(basis: list[L]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES basis OF
      null: 0,
      cons(vector, vector_tail): 1 + basis_length(vector_tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE basis BY <<

  basis_laws(basis: list[L]): bool =
    (FORALL (x: L):
      EXISTS (coefficients: list[K]):
        same_length(coefficients, basis)
          AND linear_combination(coefficients, basis) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (coefficients: list[K]):
      same_length(coefficients, basis)
        AND linear_combination(coefficients, basis) = zeroL
      IMPLIES
        all_coefficients_zero(coefficients))

  is_automorphism(phi: endomorphism): bool =
    phi(zeroL) = zeroL
      AND phi(oneL) = oneL
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L):
        phi(addL(x, y)) = addL(phi(x), phi(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L):
        phi(mulL(x, y)) = mulL(phi(x), phi(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        phi(algebra_map(a)) = algebra_map(a))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L):
        phi(x) = phi(y) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (y: L):
        EXISTS (x: L): phi(x) = y)

  function_member(
      phi: endomorphism,
      automorphisms: automorphism_list): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES automorphisms OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head = phi OR function_member(phi, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE automorphisms BY <<

  no_duplicate_functions(
      automorphisms: automorphism_list): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES automorphisms OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT function_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_functions(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE automorphisms BY <<

  automorphism_count(
      automorphisms: automorphism_list): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES automorphisms OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail): 1 + automorphism_count(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE automorphisms BY <<

  exact_automorphism_enumeration(
      automorphisms: automorphism_list): bool =
    no_duplicate_functions(automorphisms)
      AND (FORALL (phi: endomorphism):
        function_member(phi, automorphisms)
          IFF is_automorphism(phi))

  identity_map: endomorphism =
    LAMBDA (x: L): x

  compose(phi, psi: endomorphism): endomorphism =
    LAMBDA (x: L): phi(psi(x))

  automorphism_power(
      phi: endomorphism,
      exponent: nat): RECURSIVE endomorphism =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      identity_map
    ELSE
      compose(phi, automorphism_power(phi, exponent - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  is_power_of(
      generator, phi: endomorphism): bool =
    EXISTS (exponent: nat):
      automorphism_power(generator, exponent) = phi

  cyclic_automorphism_group: bool =
    EXISTS (generator: endomorphism):
      is_automorphism(generator)
        AND (FORALL (phi: endomorphism):
          is_automorphism(phi) IMPLIES
            is_power_of(generator, phi))

  generates_automorphism_group(g: endomorphism): bool =
    is_automorphism(g)
      AND (FORALL (phi: endomorphism):
        is_automorphism(phi) IMPLIES is_power_of(g, phi))

  automorphism_product(
      x: L,
      automorphisms: automorphism_list): RECURSIVE L =
    CASES automorphisms OF
      null: oneL,
      cons(phi, tail):
        mulL(phi(x), automorphism_product(x, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE automorphisms BY <<

  hilbert_s_theorem_90: bool =
    FORALL (basis: list[L]),
        (automorphisms: automorphism_list),
        (g: endomorphism),
        (x: L):
      (field_laws_K
        AND field_laws_L
        AND algebra_embedding_laws
        AND basis_laws(basis)
        AND exact_automorphism_enumeration(automorphisms)
        AND automorphism_count(automorphisms) = basis_length(basis)
        AND cyclic_automorphism_group
        AND generates_automorphism_group(g)
        AND automorphism_product(x, automorphisms) = oneL)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (y: L):
          y /= zeroL
            AND mulL(y, invL(g(y))) = x

END Q1420905_hilbert_s_theorem_90

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
