-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1426292
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1426292), "Banach–Steinhaus theorem": a pointwise
-- bounded family of continuous semilinear maps from a Banach space is uniformly
-- bounded in operator norm. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.NormedSpace
public import Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.Barrelled
public import Mathlib.Topology.Baire.CompleteMetrizable

@[expose] public section

variable {E F 𝕜 𝕜₂ : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [SeminormedAddCommGroup F]
  [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]
  [NormedSpace 𝕜₂ F] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜 →+* 𝕜₂} [RingHomIsometric σ₁₂]

/-- The Banach–Steinhaus theorem, or uniform boundedness principle. -/
theorem banach_steinhaus {ι : Type*} [CompleteSpace E] {g : ι → E →SL[σ₁₂] F}
    (h : ∀ x, ∃ C, ∀ i, ‖g i x‖ ≤ C) : ∃ C', ∀ i, ‖g i‖ ≤ C' := sorry

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1426292
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1426292), "Banach-Steinhaus theorem": pointwise
  bounded families of continuous semilinear maps from a complete seminormed
  space to a seminormed space are uniformly bounded. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q1426292_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1426292_fzero : K;
  q1426292_fone : K;
  q1426292_fadd : K -> K -> K;
  q1426292_fmul : K -> K -> K;
  q1426292_fneg : K -> K;
  q1426292_finv : K -> K;
  q1426292_fadd_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q1426292_fadd a (q1426292_fadd b c) =
      q1426292_fadd (q1426292_fadd a b) c;
  q1426292_fadd_comm :
    forall a b : K, q1426292_fadd a b = q1426292_fadd b a;
  q1426292_fadd_zero :
    forall a : K, q1426292_fadd a q1426292_fzero = a;
  q1426292_fadd_neg :
    forall a : K, q1426292_fadd a (q1426292_fneg a) = q1426292_fzero;
  q1426292_fmul_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q1426292_fmul a (q1426292_fmul b c) =
      q1426292_fmul (q1426292_fmul a b) c;
  q1426292_fmul_comm :
    forall a b : K, q1426292_fmul a b = q1426292_fmul b a;
  q1426292_fmul_one :
    forall a : K, q1426292_fmul a q1426292_fone = a;
  q1426292_finv_zero :
    q1426292_finv q1426292_fzero = q1426292_fzero;
  q1426292_fmul_inv :
    forall a : K,
      a <> q1426292_fzero ->
      q1426292_fmul (q1426292_finv a) a = q1426292_fone;
  q1426292_fdistrib :
    forall a b c : K,
      q1426292_fmul a (q1426292_fadd b c) =
      q1426292_fadd
        (q1426292_fmul a b) (q1426292_fmul a c);
  q1426292_fzero_neq_one :
    q1426292_fzero <> q1426292_fone;
  q1426292_fnorm : K -> R;
  q1426292_fnorm_nonnegative :
    forall a : K, 0 <= q1426292_fnorm a;
  q1426292_fnorm_eq_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q1426292_fnorm a = 0 <-> a = q1426292_fzero;
  q1426292_fnorm_add :
    forall a b : K,
      q1426292_fnorm (q1426292_fadd a b) <=
      q1426292_fnorm a + q1426292_fnorm b;
  q1426292_fnorm_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q1426292_fnorm (q1426292_fmul a b) =
      q1426292_fnorm a * q1426292_fnorm b;
  q1426292_fnorm_one :
    q1426292_fnorm q1426292_fone = 1;
  q1426292_norm_nontrivial :
    exists a : K, 1 < q1426292_fnorm a
}.

Arguments q1426292_fzero {K} _.
Arguments q1426292_fone {K} _.
Arguments q1426292_fadd {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1426292_fmul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1426292_fneg {K} _ _.
Arguments q1426292_fnorm {K} _ _.

Record q1426292_seminormed_space
    (K E : Type) (scalar : q1426292_normed_field K) : Type := {
  q1426292_vzero : E;
  q1426292_vadd : E -> E -> E;
  q1426292_vneg : E -> E;
  q1426292_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q1426292_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1426292_vadd x (q1426292_vadd y z) =
      q1426292_vadd (q1426292_vadd x y) z;
  q1426292_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1426292_vadd x y = q1426292_vadd y x;
  q1426292_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E, q1426292_vadd x q1426292_vzero = x;
  q1426292_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E, q1426292_vadd x (q1426292_vneg x) = q1426292_vzero;
  q1426292_smul_one :
    forall x : E, q1426292_smul (q1426292_fone scalar) x = x;
  q1426292_smul_mul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1426292_smul (q1426292_fmul scalar a b) x =
      q1426292_smul a (q1426292_smul b x);
  q1426292_smul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1426292_smul (q1426292_fadd scalar a b) x =
      q1426292_vadd (q1426292_smul a x) (q1426292_smul b x);
  q1426292_smul_add_vector :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1426292_smul a (q1426292_vadd x y) =
      q1426292_vadd (q1426292_smul a x) (q1426292_smul a y);
  q1426292_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q1426292_smul (q1426292_fzero scalar) x = q1426292_vzero;
  q1426292_smul_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q1426292_smul a q1426292_vzero = q1426292_vzero;
  q1426292_vnorm : E -> R;
  q1426292_vnorm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1426292_vnorm x;
  q1426292_vnorm_zero :
    q1426292_vnorm q1426292_vzero = 0;
  q1426292_vnorm_neg :
    forall x : E, q1426292_vnorm (q1426292_vneg x) = q1426292_vnorm x;
  q1426292_vnorm_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q1426292_vnorm (q1426292_vadd x y) <=
      q1426292_vnorm x + q1426292_vnorm y;
  q1426292_vnorm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q1426292_vnorm (q1426292_smul a x) =
      q1426292_fnorm scalar a * q1426292_vnorm x
}.

Arguments q1426292_vzero {K E scalar} _.
Arguments q1426292_vadd {K E scalar} _ _ _.
Arguments q1426292_vneg {K E scalar} _ _.
Arguments q1426292_smul {K E scalar} _ _ _.
Arguments q1426292_vnorm {K E scalar} _ _.

Definition q1426292_vsub
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q1426292_normed_field K}
    (space : @q1426292_seminormed_space K E scalar)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1426292_vadd space x (q1426292_vneg space y).

Record q1426292_isometric_ring_hom
    (K1 K2 : Type)
    (scalar1 : q1426292_normed_field K1)
    (scalar2 : q1426292_normed_field K2) : Type := {
  q1426292_ring_hom_fun : K1 -> K2;
  q1426292_ring_hom_zero :
    q1426292_ring_hom_fun (q1426292_fzero scalar1) =
    q1426292_fzero scalar2;
  q1426292_ring_hom_one :
    q1426292_ring_hom_fun (q1426292_fone scalar1) =
    q1426292_fone scalar2;
  q1426292_ring_hom_add :
    forall a b : K1,
      q1426292_ring_hom_fun (q1426292_fadd scalar1 a b) =
      q1426292_fadd scalar2
        (q1426292_ring_hom_fun a) (q1426292_ring_hom_fun b);
  q1426292_ring_hom_mul :
    forall a b : K1,
      q1426292_ring_hom_fun (q1426292_fmul scalar1 a b) =
      q1426292_fmul scalar2
        (q1426292_ring_hom_fun a) (q1426292_ring_hom_fun b);
  q1426292_ring_hom_isometric :
    forall a : K1,
      q1426292_fnorm scalar2 (q1426292_ring_hom_fun a) =
      q1426292_fnorm scalar1 a
}.

Arguments q1426292_ring_hom_fun
  {K1 K2 scalar1 scalar2} _ _.

Record q1426292_continuous_semilinear_map
    (K1 K2 E F : Type)
    (scalar1 : q1426292_normed_field K1)
    (scalar2 : q1426292_normed_field K2)
    (domain : @q1426292_seminormed_space K1 E scalar1)
    (codomain : @q1426292_seminormed_space K2 F scalar2)
    (sigma : @q1426292_isometric_ring_hom K1 K2 scalar1 scalar2) : Type := {
  q1426292_map_fun : E -> F;
  q1426292_map_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q1426292_map_fun (q1426292_vadd domain x y) =
      q1426292_vadd codomain
        (q1426292_map_fun x) (q1426292_map_fun y);
  q1426292_map_smul :
    forall (a : K1) (x : E),
      q1426292_map_fun (q1426292_smul domain a x) =
      q1426292_smul codomain
        (q1426292_ring_hom_fun sigma a) (q1426292_map_fun x);
  q1426292_map_op_norm : R;
  q1426292_map_op_norm_nonnegative :
    0 <= q1426292_map_op_norm;
  q1426292_map_op_norm_bound :
    forall x : E,
      q1426292_vnorm codomain (q1426292_map_fun x) <=
      q1426292_map_op_norm * q1426292_vnorm domain x;
  q1426292_map_op_norm_least :
    forall bound : R,
      0 <= bound ->
      (forall x : E,
        q1426292_vnorm codomain (q1426292_map_fun x) <=
        bound * q1426292_vnorm domain x) ->
      q1426292_map_op_norm <= bound
}.

Arguments q1426292_map_fun
  {K1 K2 E F scalar1 scalar2 domain codomain sigma} _ _.
Arguments q1426292_map_op_norm
  {K1 K2 E F scalar1 scalar2 domain codomain sigma} _.

Definition q1426292_cauchy_sequence
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q1426292_normed_field K}
    (space : @q1426292_seminormed_space K E scalar)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1426292_vnorm space
          (q1426292_vsub space (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1426292_sequence_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q1426292_normed_field K}
    (space : @q1426292_seminormed_space K E scalar)
    (u : nat -> E)
    (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1426292_vnorm space
          (q1426292_vsub space (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1426292_complete_space
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q1426292_normed_field K}
    (space : @q1426292_seminormed_space K E scalar) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q1426292_cauchy_sequence space u ->
    exists limit : E, q1426292_sequence_converges space u limit.

Theorem banach_steinhaus :
  forall (K1 K2 E F I : Type)
         (scalar1 : q1426292_normed_field K1)
         (scalar2 : q1426292_normed_field K2)
         (domain : @q1426292_seminormed_space K1 E scalar1)
         (codomain : @q1426292_seminormed_space K2 F scalar2)
         (sigma : @q1426292_isometric_ring_hom K1 K2 scalar1 scalar2)
         (g : I ->
           @q1426292_continuous_semilinear_map
             K1 K2 E F scalar1 scalar2 domain codomain sigma),
    q1426292_complete_space domain ->
    (forall x : E,
      exists pointwise_bound : R,
        forall i : I,
          q1426292_vnorm codomain
            (q1426292_map_fun (g i) x) <= pointwise_bound) ->
    exists uniform_bound : R,
      forall i : I,
        q1426292_map_op_norm (g i) <= uniform_bound.
Admitted.

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1426292,
  "Banach–Steinhaus theorem": a pointwise bounded family of continuous
  semilinear maps from a complete seminormed space to a seminormed space has
  uniformly bounded operator norms. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group enorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y)"

definition q1426292_normed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1426292_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x)"

definition q1426292_isometric_ring_hom ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('l::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1426292_isometric_ring_hom knorm lnorm sigma \<longleftrightarrow>
    sigma 0 = 0 \<and>
    sigma 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. sigma (a + b) = sigma a + sigma b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. sigma (a * b) = sigma a * sigma b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. lnorm (sigma a) = knorm a)"

definition q1426292_complete_in_seminorm ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1426292_complete_in_seminorm enorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>N. \<forall>m \<ge> N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
        enorm (u m - u n) < epsilon) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. \<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
        enorm (u n - x) < epsilon))"

definition q1426292_continuous_semilinear ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('l::field \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1426292_continuous_semilinear enorm fnorm escale fscale sigma T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. T (x + y) = T x + T y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. T (escale a x) = fscale (sigma a) (T x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x epsilon. 0 < epsilon \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>delta > 0. \<forall>y.
        enorm (y - x) < delta \<longrightarrow>
        fnorm (T y - T x) < epsilon))"

definition q1426292_operator_norm ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1426292_operator_norm enorm fnorm T =
    Inf {C. 0 \<le> C \<and> (\<forall>x. fnorm (T x) \<le> C * enorm x)}"

theorem banach_steinhaus:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and lnorm :: "'l::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and fnorm :: "'f::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and escale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and fscale :: "'l \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and sigma :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'l"
    and g :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
  assumes "q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and "q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field lnorm"
    and "q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group enorm"
    and "q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group fnorm"
    and "q1426292_normed_space knorm enorm escale"
    and "q1426292_normed_space lnorm fnorm fscale"
    and "q1426292_isometric_ring_hom knorm lnorm sigma"
    and "q1426292_complete_in_seminorm enorm"
    and "\<forall>i.
      q1426292_continuous_semilinear enorm fnorm escale fscale sigma (g i)"
    and "\<forall>x. \<exists>C. \<forall>i. fnorm (g i x) \<le> C"
  shows "\<exists>C'. \<forall>i.
    q1426292_operator_norm enorm fnorm (g i) \<le> C'"
  sorry

end

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1426292,
  "Banach-Steinhaus theorem": a pointwise bounded family of continuous
  semilinear maps from an arbitrary complete seminormed space is uniformly
  bounded in operator norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1426292_BANACH_STEINHAUS_THEOREM =
 `let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:A. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:A. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:A. &1 < normK a) in
  let nontrivially_normed_field' =
    \(zeroK:D) (oneK:D)
     (addK:D->D->D) (mulK:D->D->D)
     (negK:D->D) (invK:D->D) (normK:D->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:D. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:D. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:D. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:D. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:D. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:D. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:D. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:D. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:D. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:D.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:D. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:D. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:D. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:D. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:D. &1 < normK a) in
  let seminormed_add_comm_group =
    \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:B. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:B. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:B. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:B. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let seminormed_add_comm_group' =
    \(zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (neg:C->C) (norm:C->real).
       (!x y z:C. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:C. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:C. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:C. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:C. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:C. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:C. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:B. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let normed_space' =
    \(zeroK:D) (oneK:D) (addK:D->D->D) (mulK:D->D->D)
     (normK:D->real) (zero:C) (add:C->C->C) (norm:C->real)
     (smul:D->C->C).
       (!x:C. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:D. !x:C.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:D. !x:C.
          smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:D. !x y:C.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:D. smul a zero = zero) /\
       (!x:C. smul zeroK x = zero) /\
       (!a:D. !x:C. norm (smul a x) = normK a * norm x) in
  let isometric_ring_hom =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (normK:A->real) (zeroL:D) (oneL:D)
     (addL:D->D->D) (mulL:D->D->D) (normL:D->real)
     (sigma:A->D).
       sigma zeroK = zeroL /\
       sigma oneK = oneL /\
       (!a b:A. sigma (addK a b) = addL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
       (!a b:A. sigma (mulK a b) = mulL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
       (!a:A. normL (sigma a) = normK a) in
  let tends_to =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real)
     (u:num->B) (x:B).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n
               ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_space =
    \(add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real).
       !u:num->B.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                  N <= m /\ N <= n
                  ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:B. tends_to add neg norm u x in
  let continuous_semilinear_map =
    \(addE:B->B->B) (smulE:A->B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (addF:C->C->C) (smulF:D->C->C) (normF:C->real)
     (sigma:A->D) (g:B->C).
       (!x y:B. g (addE x y) = addF (g x) (g y)) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. g (smulE a x) = smulF (sigma a) (g x)) /\
       (!epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !x:B. normE x < delta ==> normF (g x) < epsilon) in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroL oneL:D.
  !addL mulL:D->D->D.
  !negL invL:D->D.
  !normL:D->real.
  !sigma:A->D.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smulE:A->B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !zeroF:C.
  !addF:C->C->C.
  !negF:C->C.
  !smulF:D->C->C.
  !normF:C->real.
  !indices:J->bool.
  !g:J->B->C.
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    nontrivially_normed_field'
      zeroL oneL addL mulL negL invL normL /\
    seminormed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    seminormed_add_comm_group' zeroF addF negF normF /\
    normed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE normE smulE /\
    normed_space'
      zeroL oneL addL mulL normL zeroF addF normF smulF /\
    isometric_ring_hom
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK
      zeroL oneL addL mulL normL sigma /\
    complete_space addE negE normE /\
    (!i:J.
       i IN indices
       ==> continuous_semilinear_map
             addE smulE normE addF smulF normF sigma (g i)) /\
    (!x:B.
       ?C:real.
         &0 <= C /\
         !i:J. i IN indices ==> normF (g i x) <= C)
    ==> ?C':real.
          &0 <= C' /\
          !i:J.
            i IN indices
            ==> !x:B. normF (g i x) <= C' * normE x`;;

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1426292,
;; "Banach–Steinhaus theorem": a pointwise bounded family of continuous
;; semilinear maps from a complete seminormed space is uniformly bounded in
;; operator norm. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary carriers, operations, subsets,
;; sequences, and map families. Every algebraic, norm, completeness, typing,
;; continuity, and semilinearity law used by the source statement is explicit
;; in the predicates below.

(defstub q1426292-member-p (carrier-tag value) t)
(defstub q1426292-zero (carrier-tag) t)
(defstub q1426292-one (carrier-tag) t)
(defstub q1426292-add (carrier-tag left right) t)
(defstub q1426292-multiply (carrier-tag left right) t)
(defstub q1426292-negate (carrier-tag value) t)
(defstub q1426292-inverse (carrier-tag value) t)
(defstub q1426292-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q1426292-norm (real-type carrier-tag value) t)
(defstub q1426292-smul
  (scalar-type vector-type scalar vector)
  t)
(defstub q1426292-ring-hom
  (source-field target-field hom-tag scalar)
  t)
(defstub q1426292-set-member-p (set-tag value) t)
(defstub q1426292-sequence-value
  (vector-type sequence-tag index)
  t)
(defstub q1426292-family-value
  (index-type domain-type codomain-type family-tag index vector)
  t)

(defun q1426292-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (q1426292-less real-type right left)))

(defun q1426292-subtract (carrier-tag left right)
  (q1426292-add
   carrier-tag
   left
   (q1426292-negate carrier-tag right)))

(defun-sk q1426292-field-laws-p (field-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1426292-member-p field-type x)
      (q1426292-member-p field-type y)
      (q1426292-member-p field-type z))
     (let ((zero (q1426292-zero field-type))
           (one (q1426292-one field-type)))
       (and
        (q1426292-member-p
         field-type (q1426292-add field-type x y))
        (q1426292-member-p
         field-type (q1426292-multiply field-type x y))
        (q1426292-member-p
         field-type (q1426292-negate field-type x))
        (q1426292-member-p
         field-type (q1426292-inverse field-type x))
        (equal
         (q1426292-add
          field-type (q1426292-add field-type x y) z)
         (q1426292-add
          field-type x (q1426292-add field-type y z)))
        (equal
         (q1426292-add field-type x y)
         (q1426292-add field-type y x))
        (equal (q1426292-add field-type x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q1426292-add
          field-type x (q1426292-negate field-type x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q1426292-multiply
          field-type (q1426292-multiply field-type x y) z)
         (q1426292-multiply
          field-type x (q1426292-multiply field-type y z)))
        (equal
         (q1426292-multiply field-type x y)
         (q1426292-multiply field-type y x))
        (equal (q1426292-multiply field-type x one) x)
        (equal
         (q1426292-inverse field-type zero)
         zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1426292-multiply
           field-type x (q1426292-inverse field-type x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q1426292-multiply
          field-type x (q1426292-add field-type y z))
         (q1426292-add
          field-type
          (q1426292-multiply field-type x y)
          (q1426292-multiply field-type x z))))))))

(defun q1426292-field-p (field-type)
  (and
   (q1426292-member-p
    field-type (q1426292-zero field-type))
   (q1426292-member-p
    field-type (q1426292-one field-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1426292-zero field-type)
     (q1426292-one field-type)))
   (q1426292-field-laws-p field-type)))

(defun-sk q1426292-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1426292-member-p real-type x)
      (q1426292-member-p real-type y)
      (q1426292-member-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (q1426292-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (q1426292-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1426292-less real-type x y)
         (q1426292-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1426292-less real-type x y)
          (q1426292-less real-type y z))
         (q1426292-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (q1426292-less real-type x y)
         (q1426292-less
          real-type
          (q1426292-add real-type x z)
          (q1426292-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1426292-less real-type zero x)
          (q1426292-less real-type zero y))
         (q1426292-less
          real-type

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1426292,
-- "Banach-Steinhaus theorem": pointwise bounded arbitrary families of
-- continuous semilinear maps from a complete seminormed space to a seminormed
-- space have uniformly bounded operator norms. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR x == zeroR -> x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) -> absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NontriviallyNormedField
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z == multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) -> normK x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)
    norm-nontrivialK :
      Exists K
        (\ x ->
          StrictLess reals (oneR reals) (normK x))

open NontriviallyNormedField

record IsometricRingHom
  {K K2 R : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (source : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals)
  (target : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals) : Set where
  field
    mapScalar : K -> K2
    map-zero :
      mapScalar (zeroK source) == zeroK target
    map-one :
      mapScalar (oneK source) == oneK target
    map-add :
      (a b : K) ->
      mapScalar (addK source a b) ==
      addK target (mapScalar a) (mapScalar b)
    map-multiply :
      (a b : K) ->
      mapScalar (multiplyK source a b) ==
      multiplyK target (mapScalar a) (mapScalar b)
    map-isometry :
      (a : K) ->
      normK target (mapScalar a) == normK source a

open IsometricRingHom

record SeminormedSpace
  (K R V : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : K -> V -> V
    normV : V -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) -> addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) -> addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) -> addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) -> scaleV (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyK scalars a b) x == scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (addK scalars a b) x == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-negateV :
      (x : V) -> normV (negateV x) == normV x
    norm-addV :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normV x)

open SeminormedSpace

subtractV :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  V ->
  V ->
  V
subtractV space x y =
  addV space x (negateV space y)

distanceV :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R
distanceV space x y =
  normV space (subtractV space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  V ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceV space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> V) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceV space (sequence m) (sequence n)) epsilon)

Complete :
  {K R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars ->
  Set
Complete {V = V} space =
  (sequence : Nat -> V) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists V (\ limit -> SequentialLimit space sequence limit)

record ContinuousSemilinearMap
  {K K2 R E F : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals}
  {targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals}
  (scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars)
  (domain : SeminormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars)
  (codomain : SeminormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars) : Set where
  field
    apply : E -> F
    map-add-vector :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addV domain x y) ==
      addV codomain (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale-vector :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleV domain a x) ==
      scaleV codomain (mapScalar scalarHom a) (apply x)

    operatorNorm : R
    operatorNorm-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) operatorNorm
    operatorNorm-bounds :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV codomain (apply x))
        (multiplyR reals operatorNorm (normV domain x))
    operatorNorm-least :
      (bound : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) bound ->
      ((x : E) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (normV codomain (apply x))
          (multiplyR reals bound (normV domain x))) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals operatorNorm bound

open ContinuousSemilinearMap

banach-steinhaus : Set1
banach-steinhaus =
  (R K K2 E F I : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (sourceScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K R reals) ->
  (targetScalars : NontriviallyNormedField K2 R reals) ->
  (scalarHom : IsometricRingHom sourceScalars targetScalars) ->
  (domain : SeminormedSpace K R E reals sourceScalars) ->
  (codomain : SeminormedSpace K2 R F reals targetScalars) ->
  Complete domain ->
  (family : I -> ContinuousSemilinearMap scalarHom domain codomain) ->
  ((x : E) ->
    Exists R
      (\ pointwiseBound ->
        (i : I) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (normV codomain (apply (family i) x))
          pointwiseBound)) ->
  Exists R
    (\ uniformBound ->
      (i : I) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (operatorNorm (family i))
        uniformBound)

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1426292 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1426292), "Banach–Steinhaus theorem":
  a pointwise bounded, possibly empty family of continuous semilinear maps
  from a complete seminormed space to a seminormed space is uniformly
  bounded. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory;

val q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK a zeroK = a) /\
      (!a. addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK a oneK = a) /\
      (!a b c.
        mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      (?a. 1 < normK a)``);

val q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      norm zero = 0 /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)``);

val q1426292_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_normed_space_def",
  ``q1426292_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x. smulE oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (mulK a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (addK a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE zeroK x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = normK a * normE x)``);

val q1426292_isometric_ring_hom_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_isometric_ring_hom_def",
  ``q1426292_isometric_ring_hom
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroL : 'l) (oneL : 'l)
      (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (mulL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (normL : 'l -> real) (sigma : 'k -> 'l) <=>
      sigma zeroK = zeroL /\
      sigma oneK = oneL /\
      (!a b. sigma (addK a b) = addL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
      (!a b. sigma (mulK a b) = mulL (sigma a) (sigma b)) /\
      (!a. normL (sigma a) = normK a)``);

val q1426292_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_tendsto_def",
  ``q1426292_tendsto
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q1426292_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_cauchy_def",
  ``q1426292_cauchy
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q1426292_complete_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_complete_space_def",
  ``q1426292_complete_space
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q1426292_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?x : 'e. q1426292_tendsto add neg norm u x``);

val q1426292_continuous_semilinear_map_def = new_definition (
  "q1426292_continuous_semilinear_map_def",
  ``q1426292_continuous_semilinear_map
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'l -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real) (sigma : 'k -> 'l)
      (g : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      (!x y. g (addE x y) = addF (g x) (g y)) /\
      (!a x. g (smulE a x) = smulF (sigma a) (g x)) /\
      ?K : real.
        0 <= K /\
        !x. normF (g x) <= K * normE x``);

val banach_steinhaus =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroL : 'l) (oneL : 'l)
      (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (mulL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (negL : 'l -> 'l) (invL : 'l -> 'l)
      (normL : 'l -> real) (sigma : 'k -> 'l)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (negF : 'f -> 'f) (smulF : 'l -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (index : 'i -> bool) (g : 'i -> 'e -> 'f).
      q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      q1426292_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroL oneL addL mulL negL invL normL /\
      q1426292_isometric_ring_hom
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK
        zeroL oneL addL mulL normL sigma /\
      q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q1426292_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE smulE normE /\
      q1426292_complete_space addE negE normE /\
      q1426292_seminormed_add_comm_group zeroF addF negF normF /\
      q1426292_normed_space
        zeroL oneL addL mulL normL zeroF addF smulF normF /\
      (!i. index i ==>
        q1426292_continuous_semilinear_map
          addE smulE normE addF smulF normF sigma (g i))
      ==>
      ((!x. ?C : real. !i. index i ==> normF (g i x) <= C) ==>
       ?C' : real.
         0 <= C' /\
         !i. index i ==>
           !x. normF (g i x) <= C' * normE x)``;

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1426292
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1426292), "Banach–Steinhaus theorem": an
  arbitrary pointwise bounded family of continuous semilinear maps from a
  complete seminormed space to a seminormed space has uniformly bounded
  operator norms. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1426292SeminormedSpace K V says that V is a SetMM vector space over the
  normed field K equipped with a nonnegative seminorm satisfying the triangle
  inequality and the normed-space scalar law. Definiteness is deliberately
  not required, matching Lean's SeminormedAddCommGroup rather than the
  stronger SetMM NrmVec class.

  Q1426292Complete V is Cauchy-sequence completeness for the pseudometric
  induced by V's seminorm. For seminormed additive groups this is equivalent
  to Lean's CompleteSpace filter formulation.

  Q1426292IsometricRingHom K L S states that S is a ring homomorphism from K
  to L preserving norms. Q1426292ContinuousSemilinear K L S V W T states
  that T is additive, S-semilinear, and has a finite global seminorm bound;
  the latter is equivalent to continuity for semilinear maps over a
  nontrivially normed field. Q1426292OperatorNorm V W T is the infimum of all
  nonnegative global bounds, exactly the operator norm of T.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1426292Sub Q1426292SeminormedSpace Q1426292Complete
   Q1426292IsometricRingHom Q1426292ContinuousSemilinear
   Q1426292OperatorNorm Q1426292Family $.

q1426292-sub-syntax $a class ( Q1426292Sub V x y ) $.
q1426292-seminormed-space-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1426292SeminormedSpace K V ) $.
q1426292-complete-syntax $a wff ( Q1426292Complete V ) $.
q1426292-isometric-ring-hom-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1426292IsometricRingHom K L S ) $.
q1426292-continuous-semilinear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1426292ContinuousSemilinear K L S V W T ) $.
q1426292-operator-norm-syntax
  $a class ( Q1426292OperatorNorm V W T ) $.
q1426292-family-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1426292Family K L S V W I G ) $.

${
  $d V x y $.

  q1426292-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q1426292Sub V x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` V )
    ( ( -g ` V ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K V a x y $.

  q1426292-seminormed-space-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1426292SeminormedSpace K V )
    <->
    (
      V e. LVec
      /\
      ( Scalar ` V ) = K
      /\
      ( norm ` V ) : ( Base ` V ) --> RR
      /\
      ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( 0g ` V ) ) = 0
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` V )
        0 <_ ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` V )
        A. y e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( norm ` V )
            `
            ( x ( +g ` V ) y )
          )
          <_
          (
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
            +
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` y )
          )
      /\
      A. a e. ( Base ` K )
        A. x e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( norm ` V )
            `
            ( a ( .s ` V ) x )
          )
          =
          (
            ( ( norm ` K ) ` a )
            x.
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` x )
          )
    )
  ) $.

    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,

    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1;

    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, BINOP_2;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    NAT_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K1,K2,E,F,J being non empty set,
      I being Subset of J,
      zeroK1,oneK1 being Element of K1,
      addK1,mulK1 being BinOp of K1,
      oppK1,invK1 being UnOp of K1,

      zeroK2,oneK2 being Element of K2,
      addK2,mulK2 being BinOp of K2,
      oppK2,invK2 being UnOp of K2,
      normK2 being Function of K2,REAL,
      hom being Function of K1,K2,
      zeroE being Element of E,
      addE being BinOp of E,
      oppE being UnOp of E,
      smulE being Function of [:K1,E:],E,
      normE being Function of E,REAL,
      zeroF being Element of F,
      addF being BinOp of F,
      oppF being UnOp of F,
      smulF being Function of [:K2,F:],F,
      normF being Function of F,REAL,
      g being Function of [:J,E:],F
  st
    zeroK1 <> oneK1 &
    (for a,b being Element of K1 holds
      addK1.(a,b) = addK1.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of K1 holds
      addK1.(addK1.(a,b),c) = addK1.(a,addK1.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      addK1.(a,zeroK1) = a) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      addK1.(a,oppK1.a) = zeroK1) &
    (for a,b being Element of K1 holds
      mulK1.(a,b) = mulK1.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of K1 holds
      mulK1.(mulK1.(a,b),c) = mulK1.(a,mulK1.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      mulK1.(a,oneK1) = a) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      mulK1.(a,zeroK1) = zeroK1) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of K1 holds
      mulK1.(a,addK1.(b,c)) =
        addK1.(mulK1.(a,b),mulK1.(a,c))) &
    (for a being Element of K1 st a <> zeroK1 holds
      mulK1.(a,invK1.a) = oneK1) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      0 <= normK1.a) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      (normK1.a = 0 iff a = zeroK1)) &
    (for a,b being Element of K1 holds
      normK1.(addK1.(a,b)) <= normK1.a + normK1.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of K1 holds
      normK1.(mulK1.(a,b)) = normK1.a * normK1.b) &
    (ex a being Element of K1 st 1 < normK1.a) &
    zeroK2 <> oneK2 &
    (for a,b being Element of K2 holds
      addK2.(a,b) = addK2.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of K2 holds
      addK2.(addK2.(a,b),c) = addK2.(a,addK2.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      addK2.(a,zeroK2) = a) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      addK2.(a,oppK2.a) = zeroK2) &
    (for a,b being Element of K2 holds
      mulK2.(a,b) = mulK2.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of K2 holds
      mulK2.(mulK2.(a,b),c) = mulK2.(a,mulK2.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      mulK2.(a,oneK2) = a) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      mulK2.(a,zeroK2) = zeroK2) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of K2 holds
      mulK2.(a,addK2.(b,c)) =
        addK2.(mulK2.(a,b),mulK2.(a,c))) &
    (for a being Element of K2 st a <> zeroK2 holds
      mulK2.(a,invK2.a) = oneK2) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      0 <= normK2.a) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      (normK2.a = 0 iff a = zeroK2)) &
    (for a,b being Element of K2 holds
      normK2.(addK2.(a,b)) <= normK2.a + normK2.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of K2 holds
      normK2.(mulK2.(a,b)) = normK2.a * normK2.b) &
    (ex a being Element of K2 st 1 < normK2.a) &
    hom.zeroK1 = zeroK2 &
    hom.oneK1 = oneK2 &
    (for a,b being Element of K1 holds
      hom.(addK1.(a,b)) = addK2.(hom.a,hom.b)) &
    (for a,b being Element of K1 holds
      hom.(mulK1.(a,b)) = mulK2.(hom.a,hom.b)) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      normK2.(hom.a) = normK1.a) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,y) = addE.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of E holds
      addE.(addE.(x,y),z) = addE.(x,addE.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,zeroE) = x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,oppE.x) = zeroE) &
    (for a being Element of K1, x,y being Element of E holds
      smulE.(a,addE.(x,y)) =
        addE.(smulE.(a,x),smulE.(a,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of K1, x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(addK1.(a,b),x) =
        addE.(smulE.(a,x),smulE.(b,x))) &
    (for a,b being Element of K1, x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(mulK1.(a,b),x) = smulE.(a,smulE.(b,x))) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(oneK1,x) = x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      smulE.(zeroK1,x) = zeroE) &
    (for a being Element of K1 holds
      smulE.(a,zeroE) = zeroE) &
    normE.zeroE = 0 &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      0 <= normE.x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      normE.(oppE.x) = normE.x) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      normE.(addE.(x,y)) <= normE.x + normE.y) &
    (for a being Element of K1, x being Element of E holds
      normE.(smulE.(a,x)) = normK1.a * normE.x) &
    (for y,z being Element of F holds
      addF.(y,z) = addF.(z,y)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of F holds
      addF.(addF.(x,y),z) = addF.(x,addF.(y,z))) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      addF.(y,zeroF) = y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      addF.(y,oppF.y) = zeroF) &
    (for a being Element of K2, y,z being Element of F holds
      smulF.(a,addF.(y,z)) =
        addF.(smulF.(a,y),smulF.(a,z))) &
    (for a,b being Element of K2, y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(addK2.(a,b),y) =
        addF.(smulF.(a,y),smulF.(b,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of K2, y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(mulK2.(a,b),y) = smulF.(a,smulF.(b,y))) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(oneK2,y) = y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      smulF.(zeroK2,y) = zeroF) &
    (for a being Element of K2 holds
      smulF.(a,zeroF) = zeroF) &
    normF.zeroF = 0 &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      0 <= normF.y) &
    (for y being Element of F holds
      normF.(oppF.y) = normF.y) &
    (for y,z being Element of F holds
      normF.(addF.(y,z)) <= normF.y + normF.z) &
    (for a being Element of K2, y being Element of F holds
      normF.(smulF.(a,y)) = normK2.a * normF.y) &
    (for u being Function of NAT,E st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normE.(addE.(u.m,oppE.(u.n))) < epsilon)
    holds ex x being Element of E st
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for n being Nat st N <= n holds
            normE.(addE.(u.n,oppE.x)) < epsilon) &
    (for i being Element of J st i in I holds
      (for x,y being Element of E holds
        g.(i,addE.(x,y)) = addF.(g.(i,x),g.(i,y))) &
      (for a being Element of K1, x being Element of E holds
        g.(i,smulE.(a,x)) = smulF.(hom.a,g.(i,x))) &
      (for x being Element of E,
           epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for z being Element of E st
            normE.(addE.(z,oppE.x)) < delta
          holds
            normF.(addF.(g.(i,z),oppF.(g.(i,x)))) < epsilon)) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      ex C being Real st
        for i being Element of J st i in I holds
          normF.(g.(i,x)) <= C)
  holds
    ex C being Real st
      0 <= C &
      for i being Element of J st i in I holds
        for x being Element of E holds
          normF.(g.(i,x)) <= C * normE.x
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1426292_banach_steinhaus_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1426292,
% "Banach–Steinhaus theorem": an arbitrary pointwise bounded family of continuous
% semilinear maps from a complete seminormed space to a seminormed space is
% uniformly bounded in operator norm. This file contains no proof.

banach_steinhaus_Q1426292[
  K1: TYPE+,
  K2: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  I: TYPE,
  zeroK1: K1,
  oneK1: K1,
  addK1: [K1, K1 -> K1],
  mulK1: [K1, K1 -> K1],
  negK1: [K1 -> K1],
  invK1: [K1 -> K1],
  normK1: [K1 -> real],
  zeroK2: K2,
  oneK2: K2,
  addK2: [K2, K2 -> K2],
  mulK2: [K2, K2 -> K2],
  negK2: [K2 -> K2],
  invK2: [K2 -> K2],
  normK2: [K2 -> real],
  sigma: [K1 -> K2],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [K1, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [K2, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real],
  g: [I, E -> F]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  nontrivially_normed_field_K1: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K1): addK1(a, b) = addK1(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K1):
        addK1(addK1(a, b), c) = addK1(a, addK1(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): addK1(a, zeroK1) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): addK1(a, negK1(a)) = zeroK1)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1): mulK1(a, b) = mulK1(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K1):
        mulK1(mulK1(a, b), c) = mulK1(a, mulK1(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): mulK1(a, oneK1) = a)
      AND NOT (zeroK1 = oneK1)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K1):
        mulK1(a, addK1(b, c)) =
          addK1(mulK1(a, b), mulK1(a, c)))
      AND invK1(zeroK1) = zeroK1
      AND (FORALL (a: K1):
        NOT (a = zeroK1) IMPLIES mulK1(a, invK1(a)) = oneK1)
      AND normK1(zeroK1) = 0
      AND normK1(oneK1) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): 0 <= normK1(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): normK1(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK1)
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): normK1(negK1(a)) = normK1(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1):
        normK1(addK1(a, b)) <= normK1(a) + normK1(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1):
        normK1(mulK1(a, b)) = normK1(a) * normK1(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K1): 1 < normK1(a))

  nontrivially_normed_field_K2: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K2): addK2(a, b) = addK2(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K2):
        addK2(addK2(a, b), c) = addK2(a, addK2(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): addK2(a, zeroK2) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): addK2(a, negK2(a)) = zeroK2)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K2): mulK2(a, b) = mulK2(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K2):
        mulK2(mulK2(a, b), c) = mulK2(a, mulK2(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): mulK2(a, oneK2) = a)
      AND NOT (zeroK2 = oneK2)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K2):
        mulK2(a, addK2(b, c)) =
          addK2(mulK2(a, b), mulK2(a, c)))
      AND invK2(zeroK2) = zeroK2
      AND (FORALL (a: K2):
        NOT (a = zeroK2) IMPLIES mulK2(a, invK2(a)) = oneK2)
      AND normK2(zeroK2) = 0
      AND normK2(oneK2) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): 0 <= normK2(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): normK2(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK2)
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): normK2(negK2(a)) = normK2(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K2):
        normK2(addK2(a, b)) <= normK2(a) + normK2(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K2):
        normK2(mulK2(a, b)) = normK2(a) * normK2(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K2): 1 < normK2(a))

  isometric_ring_homomorphism: bool =
    sigma(zeroK1) = zeroK2
      AND sigma(oneK1) = oneK2
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1):
        sigma(addK1(a, b)) = addK2(sigma(a), sigma(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1):
        sigma(mulK1(a, b)) = mulK2(sigma(a), sigma(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): normK2(sigma(a)) = normK1(a))

  seminormed_K1_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E): addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E): 0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K1), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) = addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1), (x: E):
        smulE(addK1(a, b), x) = addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K1), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK1(a, b), x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): smulE(oneK1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): smulE(zeroK1, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K1): smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K1), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK1(a) * normE(x))

  seminormed_K2_space_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F): addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F): addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND normF(zeroF) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: F): 0 <= normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): normF(negF(x)) = normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <= normF(x) + normF(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K2), (x, y: F):
        smulF(a, addF(x, y)) = addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K2), (x: F):
        smulF(addK2(a, b), x) = addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K2), (x: F):
        smulF(mulK2(a, b), x) = smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): smulF(oneK2, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F): smulF(zeroK2, x) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: K2): smulF(a, zeroF) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: K2), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) = normK2(a) * normF(x))

  subE(x, y: E): E = addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F = addF(x, negF(y))

  cauchy_E(sequence: [nat -> E]): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      0 < epsilon IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (m, n: nat):
            cutoff <= m AND cutoff <= n IMPLIES
              normE(subE(sequence(m), sequence(n))) < epsilon

  converges_E(sequence: [nat -> E], limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real):
      0 < epsilon IMPLIES
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (n: nat):
            cutoff <= n IMPLIES
              normE(subE(sequence(n), limit)) < epsilon

  complete_E: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: [nat -> E]):
      cauchy_E(sequence) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E): converges_E(sequence, limit)

  continuous_semilinear_family: bool =
    (FORALL (i: I), (x, y: E):
      g(i, addE(x, y)) = addF(g(i, x), g(i, y)))
      AND (FORALL (i: I), (a: K1), (x: E):
        g(i, smulE(a, x)) = smulF(sigma(a), g(i, x)))
      AND (FORALL (i: I), (x: E), (epsilon: real):
        0 < epsilon IMPLIES
          EXISTS (delta: real):
            0 < delta
              AND FORALL (y: E):
                normE(subE(y, x)) < delta IMPLIES
                  normF(subF(g(i, y), g(i, x))) < epsilon)

  pointwise_bounded: bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      EXISTS (C: real):
        FORALL (i: I): normF(g(i, x)) <= C

  uniformly_operator_bounded: bool =
    EXISTS (C: real):
      0 <= C
        AND FORALL (i: I), (x: E):
          normF(g(i, x)) <= C * normE(x)

  banach_steinhaus: bool =
    (nontrivially_normed_field_K1
      AND nontrivially_normed_field_K2
      AND isometric_ring_homomorphism
      AND seminormed_K1_space_E
      AND seminormed_K2_space_F
      AND complete_E
      AND continuous_semilinear_family
      AND pointwise_bounded)
    IMPLIES uniformly_operator_bounded
END banach_steinhaus_Q1426292
