title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1443036
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1443036), "Parseval's theorem": for every
  complex L2 function on a positive-period additive circle, the sum over all
  integer Fourier modes of the squared coefficient norms equals its
  normalized squared L2 norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ZArith.ZArith ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1443036_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1443036_empty {A : Type} : q1443036_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1443036_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1443036_set A) : q1443036_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1443036_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q1443036_set A) : q1443036_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q1443036_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1443036_set A) : q1443036_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1443036_preimage {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (E : q1443036_set B) : q1443036_set A :=
  fun x => E (f x).

Definition q1443036_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1443036_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1443036_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1443036_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1443036_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1443036_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1443036_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Fixpoint q1443036_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q1443036_partial_sum u k + u k
  end.

Definition q1443036_real_series_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (sum : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (q1443036_partial_sum u n - sum) < epsilon.

Definition q1443036_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q1443036_set (q1443036_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q1443036_empty /\
  (forall E F : q1443036_set A,
      q1443036_same_set E F ->
      C E ->
      C F) /\
  (forall E : q1443036_set A,
      C E ->
      C (q1443036_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q1443036_set A,
      (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
      C (q1443036_countable_union E)).

Definition q1443036_open_real_set
    (U : q1443036_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q1443036_borel_set
    (E : q1443036_set R) : Prop :=
  forall C : q1443036_set (q1443036_set R),
    q1443036_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q1443036_set R,
        q1443036_open_real_set U ->
        C U) ->
    C E.

Record q1443036_finite_borel_measure : Type := {
  q1443036_measure : q1443036_set R -> R;
  q1443036_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1443036_set R,
      q1443036_same_set E F ->
      q1443036_measure E = q1443036_measure F;
  q1443036_measure_nonnegative :
    forall E : q1443036_set R,
      q1443036_borel_set E ->
      0 <= q1443036_measure E;
  q1443036_measure_empty :
    q1443036_measure q1443036_empty = 0;
  q1443036_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1443036_set R,
      (forall n : nat, q1443036_borel_set (E n)) ->
      q1443036_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1443036_real_series_sum
        (fun n => q1443036_measure (E n))
        (q1443036_measure (q1443036_countable_union E))
}.

Definition q1443036_circle_domain
    (period : R) : q1443036_set R :=
  fun x => 0 <= x < period.

Definition q1443036_half_open_interval
    (a b : R) : q1443036_set R :=
  fun x => a <= x < b.

Definition q1443036_is_circle_lebesgue_measure
    (period : R) (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure) : Prop :=
  (forall E : q1443036_set R,
      q1443036_borel_set E ->
      q1443036_measure mu E =
      q1443036_measure mu
        (q1443036_intersection E
          (q1443036_circle_domain period))) /\
  (forall a b : R,
      0 <= a ->
      a <= b ->
      b <= period ->
      q1443036_measure mu
        (q1443036_half_open_interval a b) = b - a).

Definition q1443036_measurable_on
    (D : q1443036_set R) (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall B : q1443036_set R,
    q1443036_borel_set B ->
    q1443036_borel_set
      (q1443036_intersection D (q1443036_preimage f B)).

Definition q1443036_finite_partition
    (D : q1443036_set R) (k : nat)
    (cells : nat -> q1443036_set R) : Prop :=
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q1443036_borel_set (cells i)) /\
  (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      forall x : R,
        cells i x ->
        D x) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      (j < k)%nat ->
      i <> j ->
      q1443036_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : R,
      D x ->
      exists i : nat,
        (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q1443036_simple_integral_below
    (D : q1443036_set R)
    (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> R)
         (cells : nat -> q1443036_set R),
    q1443036_finite_partition D k cells /\
    (forall i : nat,
        (i < k)%nat ->
        0 <= coefficients i) /\
    (forall (x : R) (i : nat),
        (i < k)%nat ->
        cells i x ->
        coefficients i <= f x) /\
    value =
      q1443036_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          coefficients i * q1443036_measure mu (cells i))
        k.

Definition q1443036_least_upper_bound
    (values : R -> Prop) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  (forall value : R,
      values value ->
      value <= bound) /\
  (forall upper : R,
      (forall value : R,
          values value ->
          value <= upper) ->
      bound <= upper).

Definition q1443036_nonnegative_integral_on
    (D : q1443036_set R)
    (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  q1443036_least_upper_bound
    (q1443036_simple_integral_below D mu f)
    value.

Definition q1443036_positive_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax x 0.

Definition q1443036_negative_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax (- x) 0.

Definition q1443036_has_finite_integral_on
    (D : q1443036_set R)
    (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  q1443036_measurable_on D f /\
  exists positive_integral negative_integral : R,
    q1443036_nonnegative_integral_on D mu
      (fun x => q1443036_positive_part (f x))
      positive_integral /\
    q1443036_nonnegative_integral_on D mu
      (fun x => q1443036_negative_part (f x))
      negative_integral /\
    value = positive_integral - negative_integral.

Definition q1443036_real_integral_on
    (D : q1443036_set R)
    (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : R,
            q1443036_has_finite_integral_on D mu f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun value : R =>
          q1443036_has_finite_integral_on D mu f value)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Record q1443036_complex : Type := {
  q1443036_re : R;
  q1443036_im : R
}.

Definition q1443036_complex_mul
    (z w : q1443036_complex) : q1443036_complex :=
  {| q1443036_re :=
       q1443036_re z * q1443036_re w -
       q1443036_im z * q1443036_im w;
     q1443036_im :=
       q1443036_re z * q1443036_im w +
       q1443036_im z * q1443036_re w |}.

Definition q1443036_complex_scale
    (a : R) (z : q1443036_complex) : q1443036_complex :=
  {| q1443036_re := a * q1443036_re z;
     q1443036_im := a * q1443036_im z |}.

Definition q1443036_modulus_squared
    (z : q1443036_complex) : R :=
  q1443036_re z * q1443036_re z +
  q1443036_im z * q1443036_im z.

Definition q1443036_complex_integral_on
    (D : q1443036_set R)
    (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> q1443036_complex) : q1443036_complex :=
  {| q1443036_re :=
       q1443036_real_integral_on D mu
         (fun x => q1443036_re (f x));
     q1443036_im :=
       q1443036_real_integral_on D mu
         (fun x => q1443036_im (f x)) |}.

Definition q1443036_square_integrable_on_circle
    (period : R) (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> q1443036_complex) : Prop :=
  q1443036_measurable_on
    (q1443036_circle_domain period)
    (fun x => q1443036_re (f x)) /\
  q1443036_measurable_on
    (q1443036_circle_domain period)
    (fun x => q1443036_im (f x)) /\
  exists energy : R,
    q1443036_has_finite_integral_on
      (q1443036_circle_domain period) mu
      (fun x => q1443036_modulus_squared (f x))
      energy.

Definition q1443036_fourier_character
    (period : R) (index : Z) (x : R) : q1443036_complex :=
  let angle := 2 * PI * IZR index * x / period in
  {| q1443036_re := cos angle;
     q1443036_im := - sin angle |}.

Definition q1443036_fourier_coefficient
    (period : R) (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
    (f : R -> q1443036_complex)
    (index : Z) : q1443036_complex :=
  q1443036_complex_scale (1 / period)
    (q1443036_complex_integral_on
      (q1443036_circle_domain period) mu
      (fun x =>
        q1443036_complex_mul
          (q1443036_fourier_character period index x)
          (f x))).

Definition q1443036_integer_index (n : nat) : Z :=
  if Nat.even n
  then Z.of_nat (Nat.div n 2)
  else Z.opp (Z.of_nat (Nat.div n 2 + 1)).

Theorem ThousandTheorems_Q1443036_canonical_statement :
  forall (period : R)
         (mu : q1443036_finite_borel_measure)
         (f : R -> q1443036_complex),
    0 < period ->
    q1443036_is_circle_lebesgue_measure period mu ->
    q1443036_square_integrable_on_circle period mu f ->
    q1443036_real_series_sum
      (fun n =>
        q1443036_modulus_squared
          (q1443036_fourier_coefficient
            period mu f (q1443036_integer_index n)))
      ((1 / period) *
        q1443036_real_integral_on
          (q1443036_circle_domain period) mu
          (fun x => q1443036_modulus_squared (f x))).
Proof.
Admitted.

title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1443036 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1443036), "Parseval's theorem":
  for a complex-valued square-integrable function on a circle of positive
  period, the sum over all integer Fourier modes of the squared coefficient
  norms equals its normalized squared L2 norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1443036_real_riemann_sum ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1443036_real_riemann_sum n T g =
    (if n = 0 then 0
     else (\<Sum>k<n. (T / real n) * g (T * real k / real n)))"

definition q1443036_complex_riemann_sum ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q1443036_complex_riemann_sum n T g =
    (if n = 0 then 0
     else (\<Sum>k<n. of_real (T / real n) * g (T * real k / real n)))"

definition q1443036_real_integral ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1443036_real_integral T g =
    Lim at_top (\<lambda>n. q1443036_real_riemann_sum (Suc n) T g)"

definition q1443036_complex_integral ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q1443036_complex_integral T g =
    Lim at_top (\<lambda>n. q1443036_complex_riemann_sum (Suc n) T g)"

definition q1443036_l2_distance_squared ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> (real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow>
      (real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1443036_l2_distance_squared T g h =
    (1 / T) *
      q1443036_real_integral T (\<lambda>x. norm (g x - h x) ^ 2)"

definition q1443036_l2_representative ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1443036_l2_representative T f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>m. continuous_on {0..T} (f m)) \<and>
    (\<forall>e>0. \<exists>N. \<forall>m\<ge>N. \<forall>n\<ge>N.
      q1443036_l2_distance_squared T (f m) (f n) < e)"

definition q1443036_fourier_coefficient ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow>
      int \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q1443036_fourier_coefficient T f n =
    Lim at_top
      (\<lambda>m.
        of_real (1 / T) *
          q1443036_complex_integral T
            (\<lambda>x.
              exp (- (\<i> * of_real (2 * pi * real_of_int n * x / T))) *
                f m x))"

definition q1443036_l2_norm_squared ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q1443036_l2_norm_squared T f =
    Lim at_top
      (\<lambda>m.
        (1 / T) *
          q1443036_real_integral T (\<lambda>x. norm (f m x) ^ 2))"

theorem q1443036_parseval_s_theorem:
  fixes T :: real
    and f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex"
  assumes period_positive: "0 < T"
    and l2_function: "q1443036_l2_representative T f"
  shows
    "suminf
        (\<lambda>n::int. norm (q1443036_fourier_coefficient T f n) ^ 2) =
      q1443036_l2_norm_squared T f"
  sorry

end

title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1443036,
  "Parseval's theorem": for a complex L2 function on an additive circle of
  arbitrary positive circumference, the sum over all integer Fourier modes of
  the squared coefficient norms equals its normalized Haar L2 energy. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let q1443036_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q1443036_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q1443036_output;;
let q1443036_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q1443036_formatter path);;
let q1443036_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q1443036_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q1443036_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q1443036_formatter ();;
close_out q1443036_output;;
if not q1443036_loaded then failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q1443036_PARSEVAL_S_THEOREM =
 `let czero = (&0,&0) in
  let cadd =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
  let cneg =
    \(z:real#real). (--(FST z),--(SND z)) in
  let cmul =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
       FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
  let cscale =
    \(a:real) (z:real#real). (a * FST z,a * SND z) in
  let cmod2 =
    \(z:real#real). FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2 in
  let cdist =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      sqrt(cmod2 (cadd z (cneg w))) in
  let circle_carrier =
    \(period:real) (x:real). &0 <= x /\ x < period in
  let sigma_algebra =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool).
      events {} /\
      events carrier /\
      (!s:real->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
      (!s:real->bool.
         events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
      (!sets:num->real->bool.
         (!n. events (sets n))
         ==> events {x:real | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
  let measure_space =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real).
      sigma_algebra carrier events /\
      (!s:real->bool. events s ==> &0 <= mu s) /\
      mu {} = &0 /\
      (!sets:num->real->bool.
         (!n. events (sets n)) /\
         (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
         ==> (\n. mu (sets n)) sums
             (mu {x:real | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
  let relatively_open =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (s:real->bool).
      s SUBSET carrier /\
      !x:real.
        x IN s
        ==> ?epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon /\
              !y:real.
                y IN carrier /\ abs(y - x) < epsilon
                ==> y IN s in
  let borel_space =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool).
      sigma_algebra carrier events /\
      (!s:real->bool.
         relatively_open carrier s ==> events s) /\
      (!other:(real->bool)->bool.
         sigma_algebra carrier other /\
         (!s:real->bool.
            relatively_open carrier s ==> other s)
         ==> !s:real->bool. events s ==> other s) in
  let normalized_circle_measure =
    \(period:real) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real).
      let carrier = circle_carrier period in
      borel_space carrier events /\
      measure_space carrier events mu /\
      mu carrier = &1 /\
      (!a b:real.
         &0 <= a /\ a <= b /\ b <= period
         ==> mu {x:real |
                  x IN carrier /\ a <= x /\ x < b} =
             (b - a) / period) in
  let almost_everywhere =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (P:real->bool).
      ?N:real->bool.
        events N /\
        mu N = &0 /\
        {x:real | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
  let scalar_tends =
    \(u:num->real) (l:real).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < epsilon in
  let complex_tends =
    \(u:num->real#real) (l:real#real).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n ==> cdist (u n) l < epsilon in
  let simple_scalar =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (s:real->real).
      FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
      (!c:real.
         events {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
  let simple_complex =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (s:real->real#real).
      FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
      (!c:real#real.
         events {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
  let strongly_measurable_scalar =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (h:real->real).
      ?s:num->real->real.
        (!n. simple_scalar carrier events (s n)) /\
        (!x:real.
           x IN carrier
           ==> scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
  let strongly_measurable_complex =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (h:real->real#real).
      ?s:num->real->real#real.
        (!n. simple_complex carrier events (s n)) /\
        (!x:real.
           x IN carrier
           ==> complex_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
  let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real).
      ?g:real->real.
        strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events g /\
        almost_everywhere carrier events mu
          (\x. h x = g x) in
  let ae_strongly_measurable_complex =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real#real).
      ?g:real->real#real.
        strongly_measurable_complex carrier events g /\
        almost_everywhere carrier events mu
          (\x. h x = g x) in
  let simple_scalar_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (mu:(real->bool)->real)
     (s:real->real) (z:real).
      ?n:num enum:num->real partial:num->real.
        (!c:real.
           c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
           ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
        (!i j:num.
           i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
        partial 0 = &0 /\
        (!i:num.
           i < n
           ==> partial (SUC i) =
               mu {x:real |
                    x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i} *
               enum i + partial i) /\
        z = partial n in
  let simple_complex_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (mu:(real->bool)->real)
     (s:real->real#real) (z:real#real).
      ?n:num enum:num->real#real partial:num->real#real.
        (!c:real#real.
           c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
           ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
        (!i j:num.
           i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
        partial 0 = czero /\
        (!i:num.
           i < n
           ==> partial (SUC i) =
               cadd
                 (cscale
                   (mu {x:real |
                          x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i})
                   (enum i))
                 (partial i)) /\
        z = partial n in
  let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real) (u:real).
      !s:real->real z:real.
        simple_scalar carrier events s /\
        (!x:real.
           x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x /\ s x <= h x) /\
        simple_scalar_integral carrier mu s z
        ==> z <= u in
  let has_nonnegative_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real) (r:real).
      (!x:real. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= h x) /\
      &0 <= r /\
      nonnegative_integral_upper_bound
        carrier events mu h r /\
      (!u:real.
         &0 <= u /\
         nonnegative_integral_upper_bound
           carrier events mu h u
         ==> r <= u) in
  let nonnegative_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real).
      if ?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu h r
      then @r:real.
             has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu h r
      else &0 in
  let scalar_integrable =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real).
      ae_strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events mu h /\
      (?r:real.
         has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
           (\x. abs(h x)) r) in
  let has_real_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real) (z:real).
      ?p n:real.
        has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
          (\x. (abs(h x) + h x) / &2) p /\
        has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
          (\x. (abs(h x) - h x) / &2) n /\
        z = p - n in
  let real_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real).
      if scalar_integrable carrier events mu h
      then @z:real.
             has_real_integral carrier events mu h z
      else &0 in
  let complex_integrable =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real#real).
      scalar_integrable carrier events mu
        (\x. FST (h x)) /\
      scalar_integrable carrier events mu
        (\x. SND (h x)) in
  let complex_integral =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (h:real->real#real).
      if complex_integrable carrier events mu h
      then (real_integral carrier events mu
              (\x. FST (h x)),
            real_integral carrier events mu
              (\x. SND (h x)))
      else czero in
  let l2_function =
    \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real) (f:real->real#real).
      ae_strongly_measurable_complex carrier events mu f /\
      (?r:real.
         has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
           (\x. cmod2 (f x)) r) in
  let integer_frequency =
    \n:num.
      if EVEN n
      then &(n DIV 2)
      else --(&(n DIV 2 + 1)) in
  let fourier_character =
    \(period:real) (n:num) (x:real).
      let theta =
        &2 * pi * integer_frequency n * x / period in
      (cos theta,--(sin theta)) in
  let fourier_coefficient =
    \(period:real) (carrier:real->bool)
     (events:(real->bool)->bool)
     (mu:(real->bool)->real)
     (f:real->real#real) (n:num).
      complex_integral carrier events mu
        (\x. cmul (fourier_character period n x) (f x)) in
  !period:real.
    &0 < period
    ==> let carrier = circle_carrier period in
        !events:(real->bool)->bool
         mu:(real->bool)->real.
          normalized_circle_measure period events mu
          ==> !f:real->real#real.
                l2_function carrier events mu f
                ==> infsum (:num)
                      (\n. cmod2
                        (fourier_coefficient
                          period carrier events mu f n)) =
                    nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
                      (\x. cmod2 (f x))`;;

title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1443036,
;; "Parseval's theorem": for every complex L2 function on a positive-period
;; additive circle with normalized Haar measure, the sum over all integer
;; Fourier modes of the squared coefficient norms equals its L2 energy.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; ACL2 has no primitive complete real field, complex field, or Hilbert-space
;; sort.  The conservative interfaces below present those objects explicitly.
;; The source L2(AddCircle T) space is represented up to its canonical
;; basis-preserving isometric identification by a complex Hilbert space with a
;; complete Z-indexed orthonormal Fourier basis.  Under this identification,
;; the Fourier coefficient is the corresponding inner-product coordinate and
;; the integral of the pointwise squared norm is the squared Hilbert norm.

(defstub q1443036-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q1443036-zero (type) t)
(defstub q1443036-one (type) t)
(defstub q1443036-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q1443036-multiply (type left right) t)
(defstub q1443036-negate (type object) t)
(defstub q1443036-inverse (type object) t)
(defstub q1443036-less (real-type left right) t)
(defstub q1443036-set-member-p (set object) t)

(defstub q1443036-of-real
  (real-type complex-type value) t)
(defstub q1443036-real-part
  (real-type complex-type value) t)
(defstub q1443036-imag-part
  (real-type complex-type value) t)
(defstub q1443036-imaginary-unit (complex-type) t)
(defstub q1443036-star (complex-type value) t)
(defstub q1443036-complex-norm-square
  (real-type complex-type value) t)

(defstub q1443036-smul
  (complex-type space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q1443036-inner
  (complex-type space left right) t)
(defstub q1443036-sequence-at
  (sequence index) t)
(defstub q1443036-basis-at
  (basis integer-index) t)

(defun q1443036-subtract (type left right)
  (q1443036-add
   type left (q1443036-negate type right)))

(defun q1443036-leq (real-type left right)
  (not (q1443036-less real-type right left)))

(defun q1443036-positive-p (real-type value)
  (and
   (q1443036-member-p real-type value)
   (q1443036-less
    real-type (q1443036-zero real-type) value)))

(defun q1443036-absolute (real-type value)
  (if (q1443036-less
       real-type value (q1443036-zero real-type))
      (q1443036-negate real-type value)
    value))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.

(defun-sk q1443036-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p type x)
      (q1443036-member-p type y)
      (q1443036-member-p type z))
     (let* ((zero (q1443036-zero type))
            (one (q1443036-one type))
            (xy-add (q1443036-add type x y))
            (yz-add (q1443036-add type y z))
            (xy-mul (q1443036-multiply type x y))
            (yz-mul (q1443036-multiply type y z))
            (neg-x (q1443036-negate type x))
            (inv-x (q1443036-inverse type x)))
       (and
        (q1443036-member-p type zero)
        (q1443036-member-p type one)
        (q1443036-member-p type xy-add)
        (q1443036-member-p type xy-mul)
        (q1443036-member-p type neg-x)
        (q1443036-member-p type inv-x)
        (not (equal zero one))
        (equal
         (q1443036-add type xy-add z)
         (q1443036-add type x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1443036-add type y x))
        (equal (q1443036-add type x zero) x)
        (equal (q1443036-add type x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1443036-multiply type xy-mul z)
         (q1443036-multiply type x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1443036-multiply type y x))
        (equal (q1443036-multiply type x one) x)
        (equal (q1443036-multiply type x zero) zero)
        (equal (q1443036-inverse type zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1443036-multiply type x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1443036-multiply
          type x (q1443036-add type y z))
         (q1443036-add
          type
          (q1443036-multiply type x y)
          (q1443036-multiply type x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1443036-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p real-type x)
      (q1443036-member-p real-type y)
      (q1443036-member-p real-type z))
     (let ((zero (q1443036-zero real-type)))
       (and
        (not (q1443036-less real-type x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1443036-less real-type x y)
         (q1443036-less real-type y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1443036-less real-type x y)
          (q1443036-less real-type y z))
         (q1443036-less real-type x z))
        (implies
         (q1443036-less real-type x y)
         (q1443036-less
          real-type
          (q1443036-add real-type x z)
          (q1443036-add real-type y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1443036-less real-type zero x)
          (q1443036-less real-type zero y))
         (q1443036-less
          real-type zero
          (q1443036-multiply real-type x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1443036-real-set-nonempty-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1443036-member-p real-type x)
     (q1443036-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1443036-real-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p real-type x)
      (q1443036-set-member-p set x))
     (q1443036-leq real-type x bound))))

(defun-sk q1443036-real-bounded-above-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1443036-member-p real-type bound)
     (q1443036-real-upper-bound-p
      real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk q1443036-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1443036-member-p real-type supremum)
     (q1443036-real-upper-bound-p
      real-type set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1443036-member-p real-type bound)
       (q1443036-real-upper-bound-p
        real-type set bound))
      (q1443036-leq real-type supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-real-supremum-exists-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1443036-real-least-upper-bound-p
     real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1443036-dedekind-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (q1443036-real-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (q1443036-real-supremum-exists-p
      real-type set))))

(defun q1443036-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q1443036-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q1443036-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q1443036-less
    real-type
    (q1443036-zero real-type)
    (q1443036-one real-type))
   (q1443036-dedekind-complete-p real-type)))

;; Real coordinates and conjugation present the usual complex field over the
;; complete real field, rather than ACL2's smaller Gaussian-rational domain.

(defun-sk q1443036-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (a b z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p real-type a)
      (q1443036-member-p real-type b)
      (q1443036-member-p complex-type z))
     (let* ((zero-r (q1443036-zero real-type))
            (zero-c (q1443036-zero complex-type))
            (one-c (q1443036-one complex-type))
            (imaginary-unit
             (q1443036-imaginary-unit complex-type))
            (of-a
             (q1443036-of-real
              real-type complex-type a))
            (of-b
             (q1443036-of-real
              real-type complex-type b))
            (real-z
             (q1443036-real-part
              real-type complex-type z))
            (imag-z
             (q1443036-imag-part
              real-type complex-type z)))
       (and
        (q1443036-member-p complex-type of-a)
        (q1443036-member-p complex-type imaginary-unit)
        (q1443036-member-p real-type real-z)
        (q1443036-member-p real-type imag-z)
        (equal
         (q1443036-of-real
          real-type complex-type zero-r)
         zero-c)
        (equal
         (q1443036-of-real
          real-type complex-type
          (q1443036-one real-type))
         one-c)
        (equal
         (q1443036-of-real
          real-type complex-type
          (q1443036-add real-type a b))
         (q1443036-add complex-type of-a of-b))
        (equal
         (q1443036-of-real
          real-type complex-type
          (q1443036-multiply real-type a b))
         (q1443036-multiply complex-type of-a of-b))
        (equal
         (q1443036-multiply
          complex-type imaginary-unit imaginary-unit)
         (q1443036-negate complex-type one-c))
        (equal
         z
         (q1443036-add
          complex-type
          (q1443036-of-real
           real-type complex-type real-z)
          (q1443036-multiply
           complex-type imaginary-unit
           (q1443036-of-real
            real-type complex-type imag-z))))
        (equal
         (q1443036-real-part
          real-type complex-type
          (q1443036-add complex-type of-a
           (q1443036-multiply
            complex-type imaginary-unit of-b)))
         a)
        (equal
         (q1443036-imag-part
          real-type complex-type
          (q1443036-add complex-type of-a
           (q1443036-multiply
            complex-type imaginary-unit of-b)))
         b))))))

(defun-sk q1443036-complex-star-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p complex-type x)
      (q1443036-member-p complex-type y))
     (let ((star-x (q1443036-star complex-type x))
           (norm-square
            (q1443036-complex-norm-square
             real-type complex-type x)))
       (and
        (q1443036-member-p complex-type star-x)
        (q1443036-member-p real-type norm-square)
        (equal
         (q1443036-star
          complex-type (q1443036-star complex-type x))
         x)
        (equal
         (q1443036-star
          complex-type (q1443036-add complex-type x y))
         (q1443036-add
          complex-type
          (q1443036-star complex-type x)
          (q1443036-star complex-type y)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-star
          complex-type
          (q1443036-multiply complex-type x y))
         (q1443036-multiply
          complex-type
          (q1443036-star complex-type x)
          (q1443036-star complex-type y)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-star complex-type x)
         (q1443036-add
          complex-type
          (q1443036-of-real
           real-type complex-type
           (q1443036-real-part
            real-type complex-type x))
          (q1443036-negate
           complex-type
           (q1443036-multiply
            complex-type
            (q1443036-imaginary-unit complex-type)
            (q1443036-of-real
             real-type complex-type
             (q1443036-imag-part
              real-type complex-type x))))))
        (equal
         norm-square
         (q1443036-real-part
          real-type complex-type
          (q1443036-multiply
           complex-type star-x x)))
        (q1443036-leq
         real-type (q1443036-zero real-type) norm-square)
        (iff
         (equal norm-square (q1443036-zero real-type))
         (equal x (q1443036-zero complex-type))))))))

(defun q1443036-complex-field-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (and
   (q1443036-real-field-p real-type)
   (q1443036-field-laws-p complex-type)
   (q1443036-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    real-type complex-type)
   (q1443036-complex-star-laws-p
    real-type complex-type)))

;; Complex Hilbert-space structure and sequential completeness.

(defun q1443036-vector-subtract
    (space left right)
  (q1443036-add
   space left (q1443036-negate space right)))

(defun q1443036-vector-norm-square
    (real-type complex-type space vector)
  (q1443036-real-part
   real-type complex-type
   (q1443036-inner
    complex-type space vector vector)))

(defun-sk q1443036-vector-space-laws-p
    (complex-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p complex-type a)
      (q1443036-member-p complex-type b)
      (q1443036-member-p space x)
      (q1443036-member-p space y)
      (q1443036-member-p space z))
     (let ((zero (q1443036-zero space)))
       (and
        (q1443036-member-p
         space (q1443036-add space x y))
        (q1443036-member-p
         space (q1443036-negate space x))
        (q1443036-member-p
         space
         (q1443036-smul complex-type space a x))
        (equal
         (q1443036-add
          space (q1443036-add space x y) z)
         (q1443036-add
          space x (q1443036-add space y z)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-add space x y)
         (q1443036-add space y x))
        (equal (q1443036-add space x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q1443036-add
          space x (q1443036-negate space x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q1443036-smul
          complex-type space
          (q1443036-one complex-type) x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q1443036-smul
          complex-type space
          (q1443036-multiply complex-type a b) x)
         (q1443036-smul
          complex-type space a
          (q1443036-smul
           complex-type space b x)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-smul
          complex-type space
          (q1443036-add complex-type a b) x)
         (q1443036-add
          space
          (q1443036-smul complex-type space a x)
          (q1443036-smul complex-type space b x)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-smul
          complex-type space a
          (q1443036-add space x y))
         (q1443036-add
          space
          (q1443036-smul complex-type space a x)
          (q1443036-smul complex-type space a y))))))))

(defun-sk q1443036-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p complex-type a)
      (q1443036-member-p space x)
      (q1443036-member-p space y)
      (q1443036-member-p space z))
     (let ((inner-xx
            (q1443036-inner complex-type space x x))
           (norm-square
            (q1443036-vector-norm-square
             real-type complex-type space x)))
       (and
        (q1443036-member-p complex-type inner-xx)
        (q1443036-member-p real-type norm-square)
        (equal
         (q1443036-inner
          complex-type space x
          (q1443036-add space y z))
         (q1443036-add
          complex-type
          (q1443036-inner complex-type space x y)
          (q1443036-inner complex-type space x z)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-inner
          complex-type space x
          (q1443036-smul complex-type space a y))
         (q1443036-multiply
          complex-type a
          (q1443036-inner complex-type space x y)))
        (equal
         (q1443036-inner complex-type space x y)
         (q1443036-star
          complex-type
          (q1443036-inner complex-type space y x)))
        (equal
         inner-xx
         (q1443036-of-real
          real-type complex-type norm-square))
        (q1443036-leq
         real-type (q1443036-zero real-type) norm-square)
        (iff
         (equal norm-square (q1443036-zero real-type))
         (equal x (q1443036-zero space))))))))

(defun q1443036-vector-distance-square
    (real-type complex-type space left right)
  (q1443036-vector-norm-square
   real-type complex-type space
   (q1443036-vector-subtract space left right)))

(defun-sk q1443036-sequence-values-p
    (space sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1443036-member-p
      space (q1443036-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence
     epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q1443036-less
      real-type
      (q1443036-vector-distance-square
       real-type complex-type space
       (q1443036-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q1443036-sequence-at sequence n))
      (q1443036-multiply
       real-type epsilon epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1443036-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type complex-type space sequence
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1443036-cauchy-sequence-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1443036-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (q1443036-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type complex-type space
      sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1443036-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence
     limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q1443036-less
      real-type
      (q1443036-vector-distance-square
       real-type complex-type space
       (q1443036-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      (q1443036-multiply
       real-type epsilon epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence
     limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1443036-convergence-tail-p
      real-type complex-type space sequence
      limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1443036-sequence-converges-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1443036-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (q1443036-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type complex-type space sequence
      limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1443036-sequence-limit-exists-p
    (real-type complex-type space sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q1443036-member-p space limit)
     (q1443036-sequence-converges-p
      real-type complex-type space sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q1443036-complete-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-sequence-values-p space sequence)
      (q1443036-cauchy-sequence-p
       real-type complex-type space sequence))
     (q1443036-sequence-limit-exists-p
      real-type complex-type space sequence))))

(defun q1443036-complex-hilbert-space-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (and
   (q1443036-member-p
    space (q1443036-zero space))
   (q1443036-vector-space-laws-p
    complex-type space)
   (q1443036-inner-product-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q1443036-complete-p
    real-type complex-type space)))

;; The integer-indexed Fourier family is orthonormal and has dense finite
;; complex span, exactly the Hilbert-basis property used by the source.

(defun-sk q1443036-basis-values-p (space basis)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (integerp index)
     (q1443036-member-p
      space (q1443036-basis-at basis index)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-orthonormal-p
    (complex-type space basis)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and
      (integerp left-index)
      (integerp right-index))
     (equal
      (q1443036-inner
       complex-type space
       (q1443036-basis-at basis left-index)
       (q1443036-basis-at basis right-index))
      (if (equal left-index right-index)
          (q1443036-one complex-type)
        (q1443036-zero complex-type))))))

(defun q1443036-integer-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (integerp (car values))
       (q1443036-integer-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1443036-scalar-list-p
    (complex-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1443036-member-p complex-type (car values))
       (q1443036-scalar-list-p
        complex-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1443036-linear-combination
    (complex-type space basis
     indexes coefficients count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q1443036-zero space)
    (let ((position (- count 1)))
      (q1443036-add
       space
       (q1443036-linear-combination
        complex-type space basis
        indexes coefficients position)
       (q1443036-smul
        complex-type space
        (nth position coefficients)
        (q1443036-basis-at
         basis (nth position indexes)))))))

(defun-sk q1443036-dense-witness-exists-p
    (real-type complex-type space basis
     vector epsilon)
  (exists (count indexes coefficients)
    (and
     (natp count)
     (true-listp indexes)
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (equal (len indexes) count)
     (equal (len coefficients) count)
     (q1443036-integer-list-p indexes)
     (q1443036-scalar-list-p
      complex-type coefficients)
     (q1443036-less
      real-type
      (q1443036-vector-distance-square
       real-type complex-type space
       (q1443036-linear-combination
        complex-type space basis
        indexes coefficients count)
       vector)
      (q1443036-multiply
       real-type epsilon epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-dense-span-p
    (real-type complex-type space basis)
  (forall (vector epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1443036-member-p space vector)
      (q1443036-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q1443036-dense-witness-exists-p
      real-type complex-type space basis
      vector epsilon))))

(defun q1443036-fourier-basis-p
    (real-type complex-type space basis)
  (and
   (q1443036-basis-values-p space basis)
   (q1443036-orthonormal-p
    complex-type space basis)
   (q1443036-dense-span-p
    real-type complex-type space basis)))

;; The enumeration 0, 1, -1, 2, -2, ... is a bijection from naturals to
;; integers.  Since all coefficient-square terms are nonnegative, convergence
;; along this enumeration is the target-native rendering of the source tsum
;; over Z and is independent of the chosen bijection.

(defun q1443036-integer-enumeration (n)
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (if (evenp n)
        (- (/ n 2))
      (/ (+ n 1) 2))))

(defun q1443036-fourier-coefficient
    (complex-type space basis vector index)
  (q1443036-inner
   complex-type space
   (q1443036-basis-at basis index)
   vector))

(defun q1443036-coefficient-square
    (real-type complex-type space basis vector index)
  (q1443036-complex-norm-square
   real-type complex-type
   (q1443036-fourier-coefficient
    complex-type space basis vector index)))

(defun q1443036-coefficient-square-partial-sum
    (real-type complex-type space basis vector count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q1443036-zero real-type)
    (let* ((position (- count 1))
           (index
            (q1443036-integer-enumeration position)))
      (q1443036-add
       real-type
       (q1443036-coefficient-square-partial-sum
        real-type complex-type space basis
        vector position)
       (q1443036-coefficient-square
        real-type complex-type space basis
        vector index)))))

(defun-sk q1443036-series-tail-p
    (real-type complex-type space basis vector
     total epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (q1443036-less
      real-type
      (q1443036-absolute
       real-type
       (q1443036-subtract
        real-type
        (q1443036-coefficient-square-partial-sum
         real-type complex-type space basis
         vector count)
        total))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1443036-series-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-type complex-type space basis vector
     total epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q1443036-series-tail-p
      real-type complex-type space basis vector
      total epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q1443036-coefficient-square-series-sums-to-p
    (real-type complex-type space basis vector total)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1443036-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (q1443036-series-cutoff-exists-p
      real-type complex-type space basis vector
      total epsilon))))

;; Parseval for normalized Haar L2(AddCircle period, C).  Positivity of the
;; period is the source Fact (0 < T); membership of f in the presented Hilbert
;; carrier is the source type f : Lp C 2 haarAddCircle.

(defun thousand-theorems-q1443036-parseval-s-theorem-statement
    (real-type complex-type period
     l2-space fourier-basis f)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1443036-complex-field-p
     real-type complex-type)
    (q1443036-positive-p real-type period)
    (q1443036-complex-hilbert-space-p
     real-type complex-type l2-space)
    (q1443036-fourier-basis-p
     real-type complex-type l2-space fourier-basis)
    (q1443036-member-p l2-space f))
   (q1443036-coefficient-square-series-sums-to-p
    real-type complex-type l2-space fourier-basis f
    (q1443036-vector-norm-square
     real-type complex-type l2-space f))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)

title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1443036,
-- "Parseval's theorem": for every complex L2 function on a positive-period
-- additive circle, the sum over all integer Fourier modes of the squared
-- coefficient norms equals the integral of the squared function norm.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Support.Fourier
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

open CompleteOrderedField
open NormedVectorSpace
open ComplexNumber
open ComplexModulus
open ComplexNormedSpace
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure
open BochnerIntegration

data Integer : Set where
  nonnegative      : Nat -> Integer
  negativeSuccessor : Nat -> Integer

negateInteger :
  Integer ->
  Integer
negateInteger (nonnegative zero) =
  nonnegative zero
negateInteger (nonnegative (suc n)) =
  negativeSuccessor n
negateInteger (negativeSuccessor n) =
  nonnegative (suc n)

integerToReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Integer ->
  R
integerToReal reals (nonnegative n) =
  fromNatR reals n
integerToReal reals (negativeSuccessor n) =
  negateR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n))

integerScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Integer ->
  R ->
  R
integerScale reals n x =
  multiplyR reals (integerToReal reals n) x

fourierPhase :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Integer ->
  R ->
  ComplexNumber R
fourierPhase reals pi period n x =
  complex
    (zeroR reals)
    (multiplyR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (multiplyR reals
          (fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero)))
          pi)
        (integerToReal reals n))
      (multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals period)))

record FiniteSelection (A : Set) : Set where
  field
    size :
      Nat
    entry :
      Fin size -> A
    entry-injective :
      (i j : Fin size) ->
      entry i == entry j ->
      i == j

open FiniteSelection

finiteSubsum :
  {A R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (A -> R) ->
  FiniteSelection A ->
  R
finiteSubsum reals terms selection =
  sumVector reals (size selection)
    (\ i -> terms (entry selection i))

IndexedSumEquals :
  {A R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (A -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IndexedSumEquals {A = A} {R = R} reals terms value =
  Both
    ((selection : FiniteSelection A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (finiteSubsum reals terms selection)
        value)
    ((upper : R) ->
      ((selection : FiniteSelection A) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (finiteSubsum reals terms selection)
          upper) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals value upper)

CircleOpen :
  {R Circle : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> Circle) ->
  Predicate Circle ->
  Set
CircleOpen {R = R} reals lift U =
  (x : R) ->
  U (lift x) ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : R) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceR reals y x) radius ->
          U (lift y)))

data CircleBorelGenerated
  {R Circle : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (lift : R -> Circle) :
  Predicate Circle -> Set1 where
  circle-borel-open :
    {U : Predicate Circle} ->
    CircleOpen reals lift U ->
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift U
  circle-borel-empty :
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift emptySet
  circle-borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate Circle} ->
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift S ->
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift (complement S)
  circle-borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate Circle) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> CircleBorelGenerated reals lift (sets n)) ->
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift (countableUnion sets)
  circle-borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate Circle} ->
    ((x : Circle) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift S ->
    CircleBorelGenerated reals lift T

translatedSet :
  {Circle : Set} ->
  (Circle -> Circle -> Circle) ->
  Circle ->
  Predicate Circle ->
  Predicate Circle
translatedSet addCircle shift S x =
  S (addCircle shift x)

record ParsevalContext
  (R M Circle : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    reals :
      CompleteOrderedField R
    real-number-presentation :
      RealNumberPresentation reals
    complex-modulus :
      ComplexModulus reals

    scalar-space :
      ComplexNormedSpace R (ComplexNumber R) reals complex-modulus
    scalar-zero :
      zeroE (realSpace scalar-space) ==
      zeroC reals
    scalar-add :
      (x y : ComplexNumber R) ->
      addE (realSpace scalar-space) x y ==
      addC reals x y
    scalar-negate :
      (x : ComplexNumber R) ->
      negateE (realSpace scalar-space) x ==
      negateC reals x
    scalar-real-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      scaleE (realSpace scalar-space) a z ==
      multiplyC reals (fromReal reals a) z
    scalar-complex-scale :
      (a z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      scaleC scalar-space a z ==
      multiplyC reals a z
    scalar-norm :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      normE (realSpace scalar-space) z ==
      modulus complex-modulus z
    scalar-complete :
      Complete reals
        (distanceE (realSpace scalar-space))

    period :
      R
    period-positive :
      Positive reals period

    lift :
      R -> Circle
    lift-surjective :
      (point : Circle) ->
      Exists R (\ x -> lift x == point)
    lift-equality :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lift x == lift y)
        (Exists Integer
          (\ n ->
            subtractR reals x y ==
            integerScale reals n period))

    circle-zero :
      Circle
    circle-add :
      Circle -> Circle -> Circle
    lift-zero :
      lift (zeroR reals) == circle-zero
    lift-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lift (addR reals x y) ==
      circle-add (lift x) (lift y)

    pi :
      R
    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi
    exponential :
      ComplexNumber R -> ComplexNumber R
    exponential-value :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      ComplexExponentialValue reals complex-modulus z (exponential z)

    character :
      Integer -> Circle -> ComplexNumber R
    character-on-lifts :
      (n : Integer) ->
      (x : R) ->
      character n (lift x) ==
      exponential (fourierPhase reals pi period n x)

    events :
      SigmaAlgebra Circle
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate Circle) ->
      CircleBorelGenerated reals lift S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate Circle) ->
      measurable events S ->
      CircleBorelGenerated reals lift S

    extended :
      ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals
    haar :
      Measure extended events
    haar-total-mass :
      outerMass haar wholeSet ==
      finiteM extended
        (oneR reals)
        (Both.first (zero-less-than-one reals))
    haar-translation-invariant :
      (shift : Circle) ->
      (S : Predicate Circle) ->
      outerMass haar (translatedSet circle-add shift S) ==
      outerMass haar S

    integration :
      BochnerIntegration reals
        (realSpace scalar-space)
        events
        extended
        haar

open ParsevalContext

squaredModulus :
  {R M Circle : Set} ->
  (context : ParsevalContext R M Circle) ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  R
squaredModulus context z =
  multiplyR (reals context)
    (modulus (complex-modulus context) z)
    (modulus (complex-modulus context) z)

record L2Function
  {R M Circle : Set}
  (context : ParsevalContext R M Circle) : Set1 where
  field
    representative :
      Circle -> ComplexNumber R
    strongly-measurable :
      AEStronglyMeasurable
        (reals context)
        (events context)
        (haar context)
        (distanceE (realSpace (scalar-space context)))
        representative
    square-integral-definition :
      LowerIntegralValue
        (extended context)
        (events context)
        (haar context)
        (\ point -> squaredModulus context (representative point))
        (lowerIntegral (integration context)
          (\ point -> squaredModulus context (representative point)))
    square-integral-finite :
      lowerIntegral (integration context)
        (\ point -> squaredModulus context (representative point)) !=
      infinityM (extended context)

open L2Function

fourierCoefficient :
  {R M Circle : Set} ->
  (context : ParsevalContext R M Circle) ->
  L2Function context ->
  Integer ->
  ComplexNumber R
fourierCoefficient context f n =
  integralVector (integration context)
    (\ point ->
      multiplyC (reals context)
        (character context (negateInteger n) point)
        (representative f point))

squareIntegral :
  {R M Circle : Set} ->
  (context : ParsevalContext R M Circle) ->
  L2Function context ->
  R
squareIntegral context f =
  realPart
    (integralVector (integration context)
      (\ point ->
        fromReal (reals context)
          (squaredModulus context (representative f point))))

parseval-theorem : Set2
parseval-theorem =
  (R M Circle : Set) ->
  (context : ParsevalContext R M Circle) ->
  (f : L2Function context) ->
  IndexedSumEquals
    (reals context)
    (\ n -> squaredModulus context (fourierCoefficient context f n))
    (squareIntegral context f)

title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1443036 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1443036), "Parseval's theorem":
  for every complex L2 function on a positive-period additive circle, the
  bilateral sum of squared Fourier-coefficient norms equals its normalized
  squared L2 norm. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory intrealTheory pred_setTheory;
open realTheory transcTheory complexTheory seqTheory real_topologyTheory;
open extrealTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q1443036_domain_def = new_definition (
  "q1443036_domain_def",
  ``q1443036_domain (period : real) =
      interval [(0 : real),period]``);

val q1443036_l2_on_circle_def = new_definition (
  "q1443036_l2_on_circle_def",
  ``q1443036_l2_on_circle
      (period : real) (f : real -> complex) <=>
      (\x.
        Normal (RE (f x)) *
        indicator_fn (q1443036_domain period) x) IN
        measurable (m_space lborel,measurable_sets lborel) Borel /\
      (\x.
        Normal (IM (f x)) *
        indicator_fn (q1443036_domain period) x) IN
        measurable (m_space lborel,measurable_sets lborel) Borel /\
      integrable lborel
        (\x.
          Normal ((modu (f x)) pow 2) *
          indicator_fn (q1443036_domain period) x)``);

val q1443036_complex_integral_on_def = new_definition (
  "q1443036_complex_integral_on_def",
  ``q1443036_complex_integral_on
      (s : real set) (g : real -> complex) =
      complex_of_real
        (real
          (integral lborel
            (\x. Normal (RE (g x)) * indicator_fn s x))) +
      i *
        complex_of_real
          (real
            (integral lborel
              (\x. Normal (IM (g x)) * indicator_fn s x)))``);

val q1443036_integer_index_def = new_definition (
  "q1443036_integer_index_def",
  ``q1443036_integer_index (n : num) =
      if EVEN n then
        int_of_num (n DIV 2)
      else
        -(int_of_num (n DIV 2 + 1))``);

val q1443036_fourier_coefficient_def = new_definition (
  "q1443036_fourier_coefficient_def",
  ``q1443036_fourier_coefficient
      (period : real) (f : real -> complex) (k : int) =
      complex_of_real (1 / period) *
      q1443036_complex_integral_on
        (q1443036_domain period)
        (\x.
          complex_exp
            (-(i *
              complex_of_real
                (2 * pi * real_of_int k * x / period))) *
          f x)``);

val parseval_s_theorem =
  ``!(period : real) (f : real -> complex).
      0 < period /\
      q1443036_l2_on_circle period f
      ==>
      suminf
        (\n : num.
          (modu
            (q1443036_fourier_coefficient
              period f (q1443036_integer_index n))) pow 2) =
      (1 / period) *
        real
          (integral lborel
            (\x.
              Normal ((modu (f x)) pow 2) *
              indicator_fn (q1443036_domain period) x))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1443036
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1443036), "Parseval's theorem": for every
  complex square-integrable function on a positive-period additive circle,
  the sum over all integer Fourier modes of the squared coefficient norms
  equals the normalized integral of the squared function norm. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1443036Circle T is the canonical half-open representative interval
  [0,T) for AddCircle T = RR / T*ZZ. Its normalized Lebesgue measure
  (1/T) vol is exactly the probability Haar measure haarAddCircle.
  Changing the representative at the omitted endpoint is measure-null.

  Q1443036Restrict zero-extends a circle representative to RR.
  Q1443036L2 says that the complex representative and its squared modulus
  are Lebesgue integrable. Q1443036FunctionIntegrable encodes
  almost-everywhere strong measurability and finite L1 norm, while
  Q1443036TotalIntegral is the corresponding totalized Bochner integral
  defined by L1 limits of measurable finite-range functions. On the finite
  interval [0,T), Q1443036L2 is bidirectionally equivalent to strong
  measurability and membership in the source Lp CC 2 haarAddCircle space.

  Q1443036FourierCoeff is the normalized integral of
  exp(-2*pi*i*n*x/T) F(x). Q1443036Series is the supremum of all finite
  subsums of the nonnegative family |FourierCoeff(n)|^2; this is the
  nonnegative-series form of the source integer-indexed tsum.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a transparent
  definition. The final $a declaration is the unproved corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1443036Circle Q1443036Restrict Q1443036Tendsto Q1443036AEStrong
   Q1443036Simple Q1443036SimpleIntegral Q1443036LIntegral
   Q1443036Diff Q1443036L1Distance Q1443036FunctionIntegrable
   Q1443036HasIntegral Q1443036TotalIntegral Q1443036EnergyIntegrand
   Q1443036L2 Q1443036FourierIntegrand Q1443036FourierCoeff
   Q1443036CoeffSquare Q1443036Energy Q1443036Series $.

q1443036-diff-syntax

  $a class ( Q1443036L1Distance M W H K ) $.
q1443036-function-integrable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1443036FunctionIntegrable M W H ) $.
q1443036-has-integral-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1443036HasIntegral M W H y ) $.

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for T being positive Real,
      I being Element of L-Field,
      f being Function of REAL,COMPLEX,
      sqf being Function of REAL,REAL,
      coeff being Function of INT,COMPLEX,
      sqcoeff,partial being Real_Sequence,
      energy being Real
  st
    I = [.0,T.] &
    f is I-measurable &
    (for x being Real holds sqf.x = |.(f.x).|^2) &
    sqf|I is_integrable_on L-Meas &
    energy = Integral(L-Meas,sqf|I) &
    (for m being Integer holds
      ex h being Function of REAL,COMPLEX st
        (for x being Real holds
          h.x =
            (cos.(2*PI*(m qua Real)*x/T)
              - sin.(2*PI*(m qua Real)*x/T)*<i>) * f.x) &
        h|I is_integrable_on L-Meas &
        coeff.m = (1/T) * Integral(L-Meas,h|I)) &
    sqcoeff.0 = |.(coeff.0).|^2 &
    (for k being Nat holds
      sqcoeff.(2*k+1) = |.(coeff.(k+1)).|^2 &
      sqcoeff.(2*k+2) = |.(coeff.(-(k+1))).|^2) &
    partial.0 = sqcoeff.0 &
    (for n being Nat holds
      partial.(n+1) = partial.n + sqcoeff.(n+1))
  holds
    for e being positive Real
    ex N being Nat
    st for n being Nat st N <= n holds
      (partial.n - energy/T)^2 < e^2
proof
end;
