title: Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1443036
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1443036), "Parseval's theorem": for a complex L2
% function on an additive circle with probability-normalized Haar measure, the
% sum of squared Fourier-coefficient norms equals its squared L2 norm. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem[T: posreal]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_function: TYPE = [real -> complex]
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [real -> measure_value]

  circle_measure_space: TYPE =
    [# measurable_sets: sigma_algebra,
       measure_of: measure_map #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(left) + real_part(right),
       imag_part := imag_part(left) + imag_part(right) #)

  complex_neg(value: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(value),
       imag_part := -imag_part(value) #)

  complex_mul(left, right: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(left) * real_part(right)
           - imag_part(left) * imag_part(right),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(left) * imag_part(right)
           + imag_part(left) * real_part(right) #)

  complex_norm_squared(value: complex): real =
    real_part(value) ^ 2 + imag_part(value) ^ 2

  in_circle_carrier(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x < T

  same_circle_point(x, y: real): bool =
    EXISTS (period: int):
      x - y = (period :: real) * T

  circle_representative(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (y: real):
        in_circle_carrier(y) AND same_circle_point(x, y))

  circle_translate(x, shift: real): real =
    circle_representative(x + shift)

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): in_circle_carrier(x)

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): FALSE

  carrier_event(A: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      A(x) IMPLIES in_circle_carrier(x)

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      in_circle_carrier(x) AND NOT A(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      in_circle_carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          in_circle_carrier(x) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(x)
              AND events(right_index)(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          in_circle_carrier(x) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(x)
              AND events(right_index)(x))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value):
      measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (A: event):
      Sigma(A) IMPLIES carrier_event(A))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  open_circle_event(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: real):
        U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (y: real):
              (in_circle_carrier(y)
                AND abs(y - x) < radius)
              IMPLIES U(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: event):
        open_circle_event(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (U: event):
            open_circle_event(U) IMPLIES Other(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (A: event):
            Sigma(A) IMPLIES Other(A))

  translated_event(A: event, shift: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      in_circle_carrier(x)
        AND A(circle_translate(x, -shift))

  canonical_haar_space(space: circle_measure_space): bool =
    LET Sigma: sigma_algebra = measurable_sets(space),
        M: measure_map = measure_of(space) IN
      generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
        AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND M(full_event) = finite_measure_value(1)
        AND (FORALL (A: event), (shift: real):
          Sigma(A) IMPLIES
            M(translated_event(A, shift)) = M(A))

  haar_space: circle_measure_space =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (space: circle_measure_space):
        canonical_haar_space(space))

  haar_sigma: sigma_algebra =
    measurable_sets(haar_space)

  haar_measure: measure_map =
    measure_of(haar_space)

  null_event(A: event): bool =
    carrier_event(A)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        haar_sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND (FORALL (x: real):
            in_circle_carrier(x) AND A(x)
              IMPLIES measurable_cover(x))
          AND measure_value_is_zero(
            haar_measure(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(property: [real -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      LAMBDA (x: real):
        in_circle_carrier(x) AND NOT property(x))

  finite_simple_real_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(x) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES
            haar_sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_circle_carrier(x) IMPLIES
            function_value(x) =
              finite_simple_real_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, x))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_circle_carrier(x) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(x),
              function_value(x)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      strongly_measurable_real(measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            function_value(x) = measurable_version(x))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_circle_carrier(x) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(x))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND haar_sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        in_circle_carrier(x) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x),
            function_value(x)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          haar_measure(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          function_value, coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(function_value, upper)
          IMPLIES
            measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  abs_enorm_real(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      IF in_circle_carrier(x) THEN
        finite_measure_value(abs(function_value(x)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_finite_integral_real(
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        abs_enorm_real(function_value),
        integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  integrable_real(function_value: real_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_real(function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_real(function_value)

  positive_part(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      IF in_circle_carrier(x) THEN
        finite_measure_value(
          IF function_value(x) < 0 THEN
            0
          ELSE
            function_value(x)
          ENDIF)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  negative_part(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      IF in_circle_carrier(x) THEN
        finite_measure_value(
          IF function_value(x) < 0 THEN
            -function_value(x)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_real_integral(
      function_value: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: nonneg_real):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        positive_part(function_value),
        finite_measure_value(positive_integral))
        AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          negative_part(function_value),
          finite_measure_value(negative_integral))
        AND integral_value =
          positive_integral - negative_integral

  real_integral(function_value: real_function): real =
    IF integrable_real(function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_real_integral(function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  complex_integral(function_value: complex_function): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_integral(
           LAMBDA (x: real):
             real_part(function_value(x))),
       imag_part :=
         real_integral(
           LAMBDA (x: real):
             imag_part(function_value(x))) #)

  ae_strongly_measurable_complex(
      function_value: complex_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      LAMBDA (x: real):
        real_part(function_value(x)))
      AND ae_strongly_measurable_real(
        LAMBDA (x: real):
          imag_part(function_value(x)))

  squared_norm_function(
      function_value: complex_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      complex_norm_squared(function_value(x))

  l2_representative(function_value: complex_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_complex(function_value)
      AND integrable_real(
        squared_norm_function(function_value))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  fourier_kernel(index: int, x: real): complex =
    LET angle: real =
      -2 * pi * (index :: real) * x / T
    IN
      (# real_part := cosine_of_real(angle),
         imag_part := sine_of_real(angle) #)

  fourier_coefficient(
      function_value: complex_function,
      index: int): complex =
    complex_integral(
      LAMBDA (x: real):
        complex_mul(
          fourier_kernel(index, x),
          function_value(x)))

  fourier_square_partial_sum(
      function_value: complex_function,
      radius: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF radius = 0 THEN
      complex_norm_squared(
        fourier_coefficient(function_value, 0))
    ELSE
      fourier_square_partial_sum(
        function_value, radius - 1)
        + complex_norm_squared(
            fourier_coefficient(
              function_value, radius :: int))
        + complex_norm_squared(
            fourier_coefficient(
              function_value, -(radius :: int)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE radius

  fourier_square_tsum(
      function_value: complex_function): real =
    IF EXISTS (total: real):
         converges_to_real(
           LAMBDA (radius: nat):
             fourier_square_partial_sum(
               function_value, radius),
           total)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (total: real):
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (radius: nat):
              fourier_square_partial_sum(
                function_value, radius),
            total))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  parseval_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (function_value: complex_function):
      l2_representative(function_value)
        IMPLIES
          fourier_square_tsum(function_value)
            =
          real_integral(
            squared_norm_function(function_value))
END Q1443036_parseval_s_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1457052
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1457052), "Well-ordering theorem": every type
  admits a linear order whose strict relation is well-founded. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1457052_linear_order (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1457052_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q1457052_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q1457052_le x x;
  q1457052_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q1457052_le x y ->
      q1457052_le y z ->
      q1457052_le x z;
  q1457052_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q1457052_le x y ->
      q1457052_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q1457052_le_total :
    forall x y : A,
      q1457052_le x y \/ q1457052_le y x;
  q1457052_le_decidable :
    forall x y : A,
      {q1457052_le x y} + {~ q1457052_le x y}
}.

Arguments q1457052_le {A} _ _ _.

Definition q1457052_lt
    {A : Type} (O : q1457052_linear_order A) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  q1457052_le O x y /\ ~ q1457052_le O y x.

Theorem exists_wellOrder :
  forall A : Type,
    exists O : q1457052_linear_order A,
      well_founded (q1457052_lt O).
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1457052
;; (thousand-theorems__acl2__Q1457052), "Well-ordering theorem": every
;; arbitrary carrier admits a strict linear order under which every nonempty
;; subset has a least element.  This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Tame APPLY$ function objects represent arbitrary carriers, binary
;; relations, and subsets.  The least-element formulation below is the
;; standard predicate form of well-foundedness for a strict linear order.

(defun q1457052-member-p (predicate element)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list element)) t nil))

(defun q1457052-less-p (less left right)
  (if (apply$ less (list left right)) t nil))

(defun-sk q1457052-strict-linear-order-laws-p (carrier less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
      (implies
        (q1457052-member-p carrier x)
        (not (q1457052-less-p less x x)))
      (implies
        (and (q1457052-member-p carrier x)
             (q1457052-member-p carrier y))
        (or (q1457052-less-p less x y)
            (equal x y)
            (q1457052-less-p less y x)))
      (implies
        (and (q1457052-member-p carrier x)
             (q1457052-member-p carrier y)
             (q1457052-member-p carrier z)
             (q1457052-less-p less x y)
             (q1457052-less-p less y z))
        (q1457052-less-p less x z)))))

(defun q1457052-strict-linear-order-p (carrier less)
  (and (tamep-functionp carrier)
       (tamep-functionp less)
       (q1457052-strict-linear-order-laws-p carrier less)))

(defun-sk q1457052-subset-of-carrier-p (carrier subset)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
      (q1457052-member-p subset x)
      (q1457052-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q1457052-subset-nonempty-p (carrier subset)
  (exists (x)
    (and (q1457052-member-p carrier x)
         (q1457052-member-p subset x))))

(defun-sk q1457052-least-below-all-p (carrier less subset least)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
      (and (q1457052-member-p carrier other)
           (q1457052-member-p subset other))
      (or (equal least other)
          (q1457052-less-p less least other)))))

(defun q1457052-least-element-p (carrier less subset least)
  (and (q1457052-member-p carrier least)
       (q1457052-member-p subset least)
       (q1457052-least-below-all-p carrier less subset least)))

(defun-sk q1457052-least-element-exists-p (carrier less subset)
  (exists (least)
    (q1457052-least-element-p carrier less subset least)))

(defun-sk q1457052-well-founded-p (carrier less)

      (and (tamep-functionp subset)
           (q1457052-subset-of-carrier-p carrier subset)
           (q1457052-subset-nonempty-p carrier subset))
      (q1457052-least-element-exists-p carrier less subset))))

(defun q1457052-well-order-p (carrier less)
  (and (q1457052-strict-linear-order-p carrier less)
       (q1457052-well-founded-p carrier less)))

(defun-sk q1457052-well-order-exists-p (carrier)

    (q1457052-well-order-p carrier less)))

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q1457052, "Well-ordering theorem": every type
-- admits a linear order whose strict relation is well-founded.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1457052_well_ordering_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

data Decidable
  {p : Level}
  (proposition : Set p) :
  Set p where

  yes : proposition -> Decidable proposition
  no  : Not proposition -> Decidable proposition

IsProposition :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
IsProposition proposition =
  (left right : proposition) ->
  left == right

record And
  {p q : Level}
  (left : Set p)
  (right : Set q) :
  Set (p lmax q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : left
    second : right

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (left : Set p)
  (right : Set q) :
  Set (p lmax q) where

  left-case  : left -> Either left right
  right-case : right -> Either left right

record LinearOrder
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    le : A -> A -> Set a
    le-is-proposition :
      (x y : A) ->
      IsProposition (le x y)
    le-decidable :
      (x y : A) ->
      Decidable (le x y)
    le-reflexive :
      (x : A) ->
      le x x
    le-antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      le x y ->
      le y x ->
      x == y
    le-transitive :
      (x y z : A) ->
      le x y ->
      le y z ->
      le x z
    le-total :
      (x y : A) ->
      Either (le x y) (le y x)

open LinearOrder using (le)

Strict :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Strict order x y =
  And (le order x y) (Not (le order y x))

data Accessible
  {a r : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (relation : A -> A -> Set r)
  (x : A) :
  Set (a lmax r) where

  accessible :
    ((y : A) -> relation y x -> Accessible relation y) ->
    Accessible relation x

WellFounded :
  {a r : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A -> Set r) ->
  Set (a lmax r)
WellFounded {A = A} relation =
  (x : A) -> Accessible relation x

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    satisfies : property value

well-ordering-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
well-ordering-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  Exists (LinearOrder A) (\ order -> WellFounded (Strict order))

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
% Q1457052, "Well-ordering theorem": every arbitrary, possibly empty carrier
% admits a linear order whose strict relation is well-founded. This file
% contains no proof.

well_ordering_theorem_Q1457052[
  A: TYPE,
  carrier: [A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  relation_on_carrier(lt: [A, A -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      lt(x, y) IMPLIES carrier(x) AND carrier(y)

  strict_linear_order_on_carrier(lt: [A, A -> bool]): bool =
    relation_on_carrier(lt)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES NOT lt(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      lt(x, y) AND lt(y, z) IMPLIES lt(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      carrier(x) AND carrier(y)
        IMPLIES
          lt(x, y) OR x = y OR lt(y, x))

  well_founded_on_carrier(lt: [A, A -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL (S: [A -> bool]):
      (EXISTS (x: A): carrier(x) AND S(x))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (m: A):
            carrier(m)
              AND S(m)
              AND
            (FORALL (y: A):
              carrier(y) AND S(y) IMPLIES NOT lt(y, m))

  well_ordering_theorem: bool =
    EXISTS (lt: [A, A -> bool]):
      strict_linear_order_on_carrier(lt)
        AND well_founded_on_carrier(lt)
END well_ordering_theorem_Q1457052

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1471282), "Radon's theorem": every affinely
  dependent family over a linearly ordered field has a subset whose convex
  hull meets the convex hull of its complement. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1471282_linear_ordered_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1471282_zero : K;
  q1471282_one : K;
  q1471282_add : K -> K -> K;
  q1471282_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q1471282_neg : K -> K;
  q1471282_inv : K -> K;
  q1471282_le : K -> K -> Prop;
  q1471282_zero_ne_one :
    q1471282_zero <> q1471282_one;
  q1471282_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1471282_add x (q1471282_add y z) =
      q1471282_add (q1471282_add x y) z;
  q1471282_add_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q1471282_add x y = q1471282_add y x;
  q1471282_add_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q1471282_add x q1471282_zero = x;
  q1471282_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q1471282_add x (q1471282_neg x) = q1471282_zero;
  q1471282_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1471282_mul x (q1471282_mul y z) =
      q1471282_mul (q1471282_mul x y) z;
  q1471282_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q1471282_mul x y = q1471282_mul y x;
  q1471282_mul_one :
    forall x : K,
      q1471282_mul x q1471282_one = x;
  q1471282_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1471282_mul x (q1471282_add y z) =
      q1471282_add
        (q1471282_mul x y) (q1471282_mul x z);
  q1471282_inv_zero :
    q1471282_inv q1471282_zero = q1471282_zero;
  q1471282_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q1471282_zero ->
      q1471282_mul x (q1471282_inv x) = q1471282_one;
  q1471282_le_refl :
    forall x : K, q1471282_le x x;
  q1471282_le_trans :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1471282_le x y ->
      q1471282_le y z ->
      q1471282_le x z;
  q1471282_le_antisym :
    forall x y : K,
      q1471282_le x y ->
      q1471282_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q1471282_le_total :
    forall x y : K,
      q1471282_le x y \/ q1471282_le y x;
  q1471282_le_decidable :
    forall x y : K,
      {q1471282_le x y} + {~ q1471282_le x y};
  q1471282_add_le_add_left :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1471282_le x y ->
      q1471282_le
        (q1471282_add z x) (q1471282_add z y);
  q1471282_mul_nonnegative :
    forall x y : K,
      q1471282_le q1471282_zero x ->
      q1471282_le q1471282_zero y ->
      q1471282_le q1471282_zero (q1471282_mul x y)
}.

Arguments q1471282_zero {K} _.
Arguments q1471282_one {K} _.
Arguments q1471282_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1471282_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1471282_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q1471282_inv {K} _ _.
Arguments q1471282_le {K} _ _ _.

Record q1471282_module
    (K E : Type)
    (fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K) : Type := {
  q1471282_vzero : E;
  q1471282_vadd : E -> E -> E;
  q1471282_vneg : E -> E;
  q1471282_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q1471282_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1471282_vadd x (q1471282_vadd y z) =
      q1471282_vadd (q1471282_vadd x y) z;
  q1471282_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : E,
      q1471282_vadd x y = q1471282_vadd y x;
  q1471282_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1471282_vadd x q1471282_vzero = x;
  q1471282_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1471282_vadd x (q1471282_vneg x) = q1471282_vzero;
  q1471282_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q1471282_smul (q1471282_one fld) x = x;
  q1471282_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1471282_smul (q1471282_mul fld a b) x =
      q1471282_smul a (q1471282_smul b x);
  q1471282_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1471282_smul (q1471282_add fld a b) x =
      q1471282_vadd (q1471282_smul a x) (q1471282_smul b x);
  q1471282_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1471282_smul a (q1471282_vadd x y) =
      q1471282_vadd (q1471282_smul a x) (q1471282_smul a y)
}.

Arguments q1471282_vzero {K E fld} _.
Arguments q1471282_vadd {K E fld} _ _ _.
Arguments q1471282_vneg {K E fld} _ _.
Arguments q1471282_smul {K E fld} _ _ _.

Definition q1471282_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1471282_subset {A : Type}
    (S T : q1471282_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q1471282_complement {A : Type}
    (S : q1471282_set A) : q1471282_set A :=
  fun x => ~ S x.

Definition q1471282_image {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B)
    (S : q1471282_set A) : q1471282_set B :=
  fun y => exists x : A, S x /\ f x = y.

Fixpoint q1471282_scalar_sum
    {K I : Type}
    (fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K)
    (indices : list I)
    (weights : I -> K) : K :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q1471282_zero fld
  | cons i rest =>
      q1471282_add fld
        (weights i) (q1471282_scalar_sum fld rest weights)
  end.

Fixpoint q1471282_weighted_sum
    {K E I : Type}
    {fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K}
    (V : @q1471282_module K E fld)
    (indices : list I)
    (weights : I -> K)
    (points : I -> E) : E :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q1471282_vzero V
  | cons i rest =>
      q1471282_vadd V
        (q1471282_smul V (weights i) (points i))
        (q1471282_weighted_sum V rest weights points)
  end.

Definition q1471282_affine_independent
    {K E I : Type}
    (fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K)
    (V : @q1471282_module K E fld)
    (f : I -> E) : Prop :=
  forall (weights : I -> K) (support : list I),
    NoDup support ->
    q1471282_scalar_sum fld support weights =
      q1471282_zero fld ->
    q1471282_weighted_sum V support weights f =
      q1471282_vzero V ->
    forall i : I,
      In i support ->
      weights i = q1471282_zero fld.

Definition q1471282_convex
    {K E : Type}
    (fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K)
    (V : @q1471282_module K E fld)
    (S : q1471282_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : E) (a b : K),
    S x ->
    S y ->
    q1471282_le fld (q1471282_zero fld) a ->
    q1471282_le fld (q1471282_zero fld) b ->
    q1471282_add fld a b = q1471282_one fld ->
    S
      (q1471282_vadd V
        (q1471282_smul V a x)
        (q1471282_smul V b y)).

Definition q1471282_convex_hull
    {K E : Type}
    (fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K)
    (V : @q1471282_module K E fld)
    (S : q1471282_set E) : q1471282_set E :=
  fun x =>
    forall C : q1471282_set E,
      @q1471282_convex K E fld V C ->
      q1471282_subset S C ->
      C x.

Module Convex.

Theorem radon_partition :
  forall (K E I : Type)
         (fld : q1471282_linear_ordered_field K)
         (V : @q1471282_module K E fld)
         (f : I -> E),
    ~ @q1471282_affine_independent K E I fld V f ->
    exists S : q1471282_set I,
    exists x : E,
      @q1471282_convex_hull K E fld V (q1471282_image f S) x /\
      @q1471282_convex_hull K E fld V
        (q1471282_image f (q1471282_complement S)) x.
Admitted.

End Convex.

title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1471282,
  "Radon's theorem": every affinely dependent family over a linearly ordered
  field admits a partition of its index set whose two image sets have
  intersecting convex hulls. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1471282_module ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1471282_module smult \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. smult a (x + y) = smult a x + smult a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a + b) x = smult a x + smult b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a * b) x = smult a (smult b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smult 1 x = x)"

definition q1471282_affine_independent ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1471282_affine_independent smult f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>w :: 'i \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {i. w i \<noteq> 0} \<longrightarrow>
      (\<Sum>i\<in>{i. w i \<noteq> 0}. w i) = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<Sum>i\<in>{i. w i \<noteq> 0}. smult (w i) (f i)) = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>i. w i = 0))"

definition q1471282_convex_hull ::
    "('k::linordered_field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> 'e set" where
  "q1471282_convex_hull smult S =
    {x. \<exists>w :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<and>
      {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> S \<and>
      (\<forall>y. 0 \<le> w y) \<and>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. w y) = 1 \<and>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. smult (w y) y) = x}"

theorem radon_partition:
  fixes smult :: "'k::linordered_field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes module: "q1471282_module smult"
    and affine_dependent: "\<not> q1471282_affine_independent smult f"
  shows "\<exists>I :: 'i set.
    q1471282_convex_hull smult (f ` I) \<inter>
      q1471282_convex_hull smult (f ` (UNIV - I)) \<noteq> {}"
  sorry

end

title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1471282,
  "Radon's theorem": every possibly empty affinely dependent indexed family
  in a module over a linearly ordered field has a subset whose convex hull
  meets the convex hull of its complementary subfamily. The index type is
  represented by a carrier subset so that the empty case is included. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1471282_RADON_PARTITION =
 `let linear_ordered_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (le:A->A->bool).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       (!a:A. le a a) /\
       (!a b:A. le a b /\ le b a ==> a = b) /\
       (!a b c:A. le a b /\ le b c ==> le a c) /\
       (!a b:A. le a b \/ le b a) /\
       (!a b c:A. le a b ==> le (addK a c) (addK b c)) /\
       (!a b:A.
          le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b ==> le zeroK (mulK a b)) in
  let module_over =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x y z:B. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:B. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:B. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let affine_dependent =
    \(zeroK:A) (addK:A->A->A)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B)
     (carrier:I->bool) (f:I->B).
       ?w:I->A.
         FINITE {i:I | i IN carrier /\ ~(w i = zeroK)} /\
         (?i:I. i IN carrier /\ ~(w i = zeroK)) /\
         iterate addK {i:I | i IN carrier /\ ~(w i = zeroK)} w = zeroK /\
         iterate addE {i:I | i IN carrier /\ ~(w i = zeroK)}
           (\i:I. smul (w i) (f i)) = zeroE in
  let convex_set =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (le:A->A->bool)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (s:B->bool).
       !x y:B. !a b:A.
         x IN s /\ y IN s /\
         le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b /\ addK a b = oneK
         ==> addE (smul a x) (smul b y) IN s in
  let convex_hull =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (le:A->A->bool)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (u:B->bool).
       {x:B |
          !s:B->bool.
            u SUBSET s /\
            convex_set zeroK oneK addK le addE smul s
            ==> x IN s} in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !le:A->A->bool.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smul:A->B->B.
  !carrier:I->bool.
  !f:I->B.
    linear_ordered_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK le /\
    module_over zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroE addE negE smul /\
    affine_dependent zeroK addK zeroE addE smul carrier f
    ==>
    ?s:I->bool. ?x:B.
      s SUBSET carrier /\
      x IN
        convex_hull zeroK oneK addK le addE smul (IMAGE f s) /\
      x IN
        convex_hull zeroK oneK addK le addE smul
          (IMAGE f (carrier DIFF s))`;;

title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1471282
;; (thousand-theorems__acl2__Q1471282), "Radon's theorem": every
;; affine-dependent family over a linearly ordered field has complementary
;; parts whose image convex hulls intersect. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic interfaces represent the arbitrary index type,
;; linearly ordered field, module, and indexed family. Every typing and
;; algebraic law used by the source typeclasses is explicit below.

(defstub q1471282-index-member-p (index-type index) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-member-p (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1471282-vector-member-p (vector-type vector) t)

(defstub q1471282-scalar-zero (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-one (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-add (scalar-type left right) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-multiply (scalar-type left right) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-negate (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-inverse (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-less (scalar-type left right) t)

(defstub q1471282-vector-zero (vector-type) t)
(defstub q1471282-vector-add (vector-type left right) t)
(defstub q1471282-vector-negate (vector-type vector) t)
(defstub q1471282-scalar-action
  (scalar-type vector-type scalar vector)
  t)

(defstub q1471282-family-value
  (index-type vector-type family-tag index)
  t)

;; Exact first-order laws of a nontrivial linearly ordered field.

(defun-sk q1471282-linearly-ordered-field-laws-p (scalar-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (let ((zero (q1471282-scalar-zero scalar-type))
          (one (q1471282-scalar-one scalar-type)))
      (and
       (implies
        (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1471282-scalar-negate scalar-type x))
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1471282-scalar-inverse scalar-type x))
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type x zero)
          x)
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-add
           scalar-type x
           (q1471282-scalar-negate scalar-type x))
          zero)
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x one)
          x)
         (implies
          (not (equal x zero))
          (equal
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply
            scalar-type x
            (q1471282-scalar-inverse scalar-type x))
           one))
         (not (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type x x))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type y))
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type x y))
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y))
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type x y)
          (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type y x))
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type y x))
         (or
          (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type x y)
          (equal x y)
          (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type y x))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type y)
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type z))
        (and
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-add
           scalar-type
           (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type x y)
           z)
          (q1471282-scalar-add
           scalar-type
           x
           (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type y z)))
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply
           scalar-type
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)
           z)
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply
           scalar-type
           x
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type y z)))
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-multiply
           scalar-type
           x
           (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type y z))
          (q1471282-scalar-add
           scalar-type
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x z)))
         (implies
          (and
           (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type x y)
           (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type y z))
          (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type x z))
         (implies
          (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type x y)
          (q1471282-scalar-less
           scalar-type
           (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type x z)
           (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type y z)))
         (implies
          (and
           (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type zero x)
           (q1471282-scalar-less scalar-type zero y))
          (q1471282-scalar-less
           scalar-type
           zero
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)))))))))

(defun q1471282-linearly-ordered-field-p (scalar-type)
  (let ((zero (q1471282-scalar-zero scalar-type))
        (one (q1471282-scalar-one scalar-type)))
    (and
     (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type zero)
     (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (equal
      (q1471282-scalar-inverse scalar-type zero)
      zero)
     (q1471282-linearly-ordered-field-laws-p scalar-type))))

;; Exact additive-commutative-group and module laws.

(defun-sk q1471282-module-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (let ((vector-zero (q1471282-vector-zero vector-type)))
      (and
       (implies
        (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type x)
        (and
         (q1471282-vector-member-p
          vector-type
          (q1471282-vector-negate vector-type x))
         (equal
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type x vector-zero)
          x)
         (equal
          (q1471282-vector-add
           vector-type x
           (q1471282-vector-negate vector-type x))
          vector-zero)
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           (q1471282-scalar-one scalar-type)
           x)
          x)))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type x)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type y))
        (and
         (q1471282-vector-member-p
          vector-type
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type x y))
         (equal
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type x y)
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type y x))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type x)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type y)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type z))
        (equal
         (q1471282-vector-add
          vector-type
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type x y)
          z)
         (q1471282-vector-add
          vector-type
          x
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type y z))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type x))
        (q1471282-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (q1471282-scalar-action
          scalar-type vector-type a x)))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type x)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type y))
        (equal
         (q1471282-scalar-action
          scalar-type vector-type a
          (q1471282-vector-add vector-type x y))
         (q1471282-vector-add
          vector-type
          (q1471282-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type a x)
          (q1471282-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type a y))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
         (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type b)
         (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type x))
        (and
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           (q1471282-scalar-add scalar-type a b)
           x)
          (q1471282-vector-add
           vector-type
           (q1471282-scalar-action
            scalar-type vector-type a x)
           (q1471282-scalar-action
            scalar-type vector-type b x)))
         (equal
          (q1471282-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           (q1471282-scalar-multiply scalar-type a b)
           x)
          (q1471282-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           a
           (q1471282-scalar-action
            scalar-type vector-type b x)))))))))

(defun q1471282-module-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (q1471282-vector-member-p
    vector-type
    (q1471282-vector-zero vector-type))
   (q1471282-module-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)))

(defun-sk q1471282-family-p
    (index-type vector-type family-tag)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1471282-index-member-p index-type index)
     (q1471282-vector-member-p
      vector-type
      (q1471282-family-value
       index-type vector-type family-tag index)))))

;; Affine dependence is represented by its exact finite-support
;; characterization: nonzero scalar coefficients summing to zero whose
;; weighted family sum is the zero vector.

(defun q1471282-index-weight-lists-p
    (index-type scalar-type support weights)
  (if (consp support)
      (and
       (consp weights)
       (q1471282-index-member-p index-type (car support))
       (q1471282-scalar-member-p scalar-type (car weights))
       (q1471282-index-weight-lists-p
        index-type scalar-type
        (cdr support) (cdr weights)))
    (and
     (equal support nil)
     (equal weights nil))))

(defun q1471282-has-nonzero-weight-p
    (scalar-type weights)
  (if (consp weights)
      (or
       (not
        (equal
         (car weights)
         (q1471282-scalar-zero scalar-type)))
       (q1471282-has-nonzero-weight-p
        scalar-type (cdr weights)))
    nil))

(defun q1471282-scalar-sum (scalar-type weights)
  (if (consp weights)
      (q1471282-scalar-add
       scalar-type
       (car weights)
       (q1471282-scalar-sum scalar-type (cdr weights)))
    (q1471282-scalar-zero scalar-type)))

(defun q1471282-weighted-family-sum
    (index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag support weights)
  (if (consp support)
      (q1471282-vector-add
       vector-type
       (q1471282-scalar-action
        scalar-type vector-type
        (car weights)
        (q1471282-family-value
         index-type vector-type family-tag (car support)))
       (q1471282-weighted-family-sum
        index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag
        (cdr support) (cdr weights)))
    (q1471282-vector-zero vector-type)))

(defun q1471282-affine-relation-p
    (index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag support weights)
  (and
   (q1471282-index-weight-lists-p
    index-type scalar-type support weights)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal support)
   (q1471282-has-nonzero-weight-p scalar-type weights)
   (equal
    (q1471282-scalar-sum scalar-type weights)
    (q1471282-scalar-zero scalar-type))
   (equal
    (q1471282-weighted-family-sum
     index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag support weights)
    (q1471282-vector-zero vector-type))))

(defun-sk q1471282-affine-dependent-p
    (index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag)
  (exists (support weights)
    (q1471282-affine-relation-p
     index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag support weights)))

;; Convex-hull membership is exactly a finite nonnegative affine
;; combination. Two disjoint supports are equivalent to supports lying in a
;; subset and its complement: use the left support as the subset in one
;; direction, and extract the two finite supports from convex combinations in
;; the other.

(defun q1471282-nonnegative-weights-p
    (scalar-type weights)
  (if (consp weights)
      (and
       (not
        (q1471282-scalar-less
         scalar-type
         (car weights)
         (q1471282-scalar-zero scalar-type)))
       (q1471282-nonnegative-weights-p
        scalar-type (cdr weights)))
    (equal weights nil)))

(defun q1471282-convex-combination-p
    (index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag
     support weights point)
  (and
   (q1471282-vector-member-p vector-type point)
   (q1471282-index-weight-lists-p
    index-type scalar-type support weights)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal support)
   (q1471282-nonnegative-weights-p scalar-type weights)
   (equal
    (q1471282-scalar-sum scalar-type weights)
    (q1471282-scalar-one scalar-type))
   (equal
    (q1471282-weighted-family-sum
     index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag support weights)
    point)))

(defun q1471282-disjoint-supports-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (not (member-equal (car left) right))
       (q1471282-disjoint-supports-p (cdr left) right))
    (equal left nil)))

(defun-sk q1471282-radon-partition-exists-p
    (index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag)
  (exists
    (left-support left-weights
     right-support right-weights point)
    (and
     (q1471282-convex-combination-p
      index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag
      left-support left-weights point)
     (q1471282-convex-combination-p
      index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag
      right-support right-weights point)
     (q1471282-disjoint-supports-p
      left-support right-support))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1471282-radon-s-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1471282-linearly-ordered-field-p scalar-type)
      (q1471282-module-p scalar-type vector-type)
      (q1471282-family-p index-type vector-type family-tag)
      (q1471282-affine-dependent-p
       index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag))
     (q1471282-radon-partition-exists-p
      index-type scalar-type vector-type family-tag))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1471282,
-- "Radon's theorem": every affine-dependent family over a linear ordered field
-- has a subset whose image and complementary image have intersecting convex
-- hulls. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1471282_radon_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record LinearOrderedField
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set (lsuc k) where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK inverseK : K -> K
    lessOrEqualK : K -> K -> Set k

    one-not-zero :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (inverseK x) == oneK

    order-reflexive :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK y z ->
      lessOrEqualK x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y or lessOrEqualK y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK (addK z x) (addK z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK x ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK y ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK (multiplyK x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualK zeroK oneK and zeroK != oneK

open LinearOrderedField

record VectorSpace
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K)
  (E : Set e) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ e)) where

  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : K -> E -> E

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneK orderedField) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK orderedField a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK orderedField a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

open VectorSpace

sumScalars :
  {k : Level}
  {K : Set k} ->
  LinearOrderedField K ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  K
sumScalars orderedField {zero} terms =
  zeroK orderedField
sumScalars orderedField {suc n} terms =
  addK orderedField
    (terms fzero)
    (sumScalars orderedField (\ j -> terms (fsuc j)))

sumWeighted :
  {i k e : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e}
  {orderedField : LinearOrderedField K} ->
  VectorSpace orderedField E ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> I) ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  (I -> E) ->
  E
sumWeighted space {zero} indices weights f =
  zeroE space
sumWeighted space {suc n} indices weights f =
  addE space
    (scaleE space (weights fzero) (f (indices fzero)))
    (sumWeighted space
      (\ j -> indices (fsuc j))
      (\ j -> weights (fsuc j))
      f)

Injective :
  {i : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> I) ->
  Set i
Injective indices =
  (j l : _) ->
  indices j == indices l ->
  j == l

AffineIndependent :
  {i k e : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  VectorSpace orderedField E ->
  (I -> E) ->
  Set (i ⊔ k ⊔ e)
AffineIndependent {K = K} orderedField space f =
  {n : Nat} ->
  (indices : Fin n -> _) ->
  Injective indices ->
  (weights : Fin n -> K) ->
  sumScalars orderedField weights == zeroK orderedField ->
  sumWeighted space indices weights f == zeroE space ->
  (j : Fin n) ->
  weights j == zeroK orderedField

ConvexHullOfImage :
  {i k e : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  VectorSpace orderedField E ->
  (I -> E) ->
  (I -> Set i) ->
  E ->
  Set (i ⊔ k ⊔ e)
ConvexHullOfImage {I = I} {K = K}
    orderedField space f subset point =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Exists (Fin (suc n) -> I)
        (\ indices ->
          Exists (Fin (suc n) -> K)
            (\ weights ->
              ((j : Fin (suc n)) -> subset (indices j))
              and
              (((j : Fin (suc n)) ->
                  lessOrEqualK orderedField
                    (zeroK orderedField)
                    (weights j))
                and
                ((sumScalars orderedField weights ==
                    oneK orderedField)
                  and
                  (sumWeighted space indices weights f ==
                    point))))))

radon-s-theorem : Setω
radon-s-theorem =
  {i k e : Level} ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  (f : I -> E) ->
  Not (AffineIndependent orderedField space f) ->
  Exists (I -> Set i)
    (\ subset ->
      Exists E
        (\ point ->
          ConvexHullOfImage
            orderedField space f subset point
          and
          ConvexHullOfImage
            orderedField space f
            (\ index -> Not (subset index))
            point))

title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1471282 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1471282), "Radon's theorem": every
  affinely dependent family in a vector space over a linear ordered field
  admits a partition whose two convex hulls intersect. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val radon_partition =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (one : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (recip : 'r -> 'r)
      (leq : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (vzero : 'e) (vadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (vneg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'r -> 'e -> 'e) (f : 'i -> 'e).
      let ordered_field_axioms = (
        ~(one = zero) /\
        (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
        (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
        (!x. mul x one = x) /\
        (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
        (!x. x <> zero ==> mul x (recip x) = one) /\
        (!x. leq x x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
        (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y ==> leq (add z x) (add z y)) /\
        (!x y. leq zero x /\ leq zero y ==> leq zero (mul x y)))
      in
      let module_axioms = (
        (!x y. vadd x y = vadd y x) /\
        (!x y z. vadd (vadd x y) z = vadd x (vadd y z)) /\
        (!x. vadd x vzero = x) /\
        (!x. vadd x (vneg x) = vzero) /\
        (!x. smul one x = x) /\
        (!a b x. smul (mul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b x. smul (add a b) x = vadd (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a x y. smul a (vadd x y) = vadd (smul a x) (smul a y)))
      in
      let scalar_sum = (
        \(w : 'i -> 'r) (s : 'i set).
          ITSET (\i acc. add (w i) acc) s zero)
      in
      let vector_sum = (
        \(g : 'i -> 'e) (w : 'i -> 'r) (s : 'i set).
          ITSET (\i acc. vadd (smul (w i) (g i)) acc) s vzero)
      in
      let affine_independent = (
        \(g : 'i -> 'e).
          !s : 'i set. !w : 'i -> 'r.
            FINITE s /\
            scalar_sum w s = zero /\
            vector_sum g w s = vzero
            ==>
            !i. i IN s ==> w i = zero)
      in
      let in_convex_hull = (
        \(g : 'i -> 'e) (indices : 'i set) (p : 'e).
          ?s : 'i set. ?w : 'i -> 'r.
            FINITE s /\
            s SUBSET indices /\
            (!i. i IN s ==> leq zero (w i)) /\
            scalar_sum w s = one /\
            vector_sum g w s = p)
      in
        ordered_field_axioms /\
        module_axioms /\
        ~affine_independent f
        ==>
        ?I : 'i set. ?p : 'e.
          in_convex_hull f I p /\
          in_convex_hull f (COMPL I) p``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1471282
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1471282), "Radon's theorem": every affine
  dependent family in a module over an ordered field admits a subset whose
  image and complementary image have convex hulls with a common point. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1471282AffineIndependent K V A F uses the finite-relation
  characterization of affine independence: every scalar relation on a finite
  subset of the arbitrary index set A whose coefficients and weighted vectors
  both sum to zero has all coefficients zero.

  Q1471282ConvexHull K V S is the set of all finite convex combinations of
  points of S. The finite carrier W, coefficient function c, and point
  function p remain internally existentially quantified. Over an ordered
  field this is equivalent to the source convexHull.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. Its
  subset I and common point x remain existentially quantified, the complement
  is relative to the full arbitrary index set A, and this database contains no
  $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1471282AffineIndependent Q1471282ConvexHull $.

q1471282-affine-independent-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1471282AffineIndependent K V A F ) $.
q1471282-convex-hull-syntax
  $a class ( Q1471282ConvexHull K V S ) $.

${
  $d A F K V c i s $.

  q1471282-affine-independent-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1471282AffineIndependent K V A F )
    <->
    A. s e. ( ~P A i^i Fin )
      A. c e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m s )
        (
          (
            (
              K gsum
                ( i e. s |-> ( c ` i ) )
            )
            =
            ( 0g ` K )
            /\
            (
              V gsum
                (
                  i e. s |->
                    (
                      ( c ` i )
                      ( .s ` V )
                      ( F ` i )
                    )
                )
            )
            =
            ( 0g ` V )
          )
          ->
          A. i e. s
            ( c ` i ) = ( 0g ` K )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K S V c i p w x $.

  q1471282-convex-hull-definition $a |-
    ( Q1471282ConvexHull K V S )
    =
    {
      x e. ( Base ` V ) |
        E. w e. Fin
          E. c e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m w )
            E. p e. ( S ^m w )
              (
                A. i e. w
                  ( 0g ` K ) ( le ` K ) ( c ` i )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    K gsum
                      ( i e. w |-> ( c ` i ) )
                  )
                  =
                  ( 1r ` K )
                  /\
                  x
                  =
                  (
                    V gsum
                      (
                        i e. w |->
                          (
                            ( c ` i )
                            ( .s ` V )
                            ( p ` i )
                          )
                      )
                  )
                )
              )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d a f i k v w x $.

  thousand-theorems-q1471282-radon-partition $a |-
    A. k e. oField
      A. w e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = k }
        A. a
          A. f e. ( ( Base ` w ) ^m a )
            (
              -.
              ( Q1471282AffineIndependent k w a f )
              ->
              E. i e. ~P a
                E. x e. ( Base ` w )
                  (
                    x e.
                      (
                        Q1471282ConvexHull
                        k
                        w
                        ( f " i )
                      )
                    /\
                    x e.
                      (
                        Q1471282ConvexHull
                        k
                        w
                        ( f " ( a \ i ) )
                      )
                  )
            )
  $.
$}

title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1471282
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q1471282), "Radon's theorem": every affine-
:: dependent indexed family in a vector space over a linearly ordered field
:: admits a subset whose image and complementary image have intersecting
:: convex hulls. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, PARTFUN1, CARD_3, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, REALALG1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
      SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, GROUP_1, ALGSTR_1, VECTSP_2;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, NUMBERS, NAT_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2,
      REALALG1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, RLVECT_1,
      GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, ALGSTR_1, REALALG1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
      GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, ALGSTR_1, REALALG1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, REALALG1;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for I being set, K being Field, P being Subset of K,
      V being VectSp of K,
      f being Function of I, the carrier of V st
    P is positive_cone &
    (ex a being FinSequence of I,
        w being FinSequence of the carrier of K,
        t being FinSequence of the carrier of V st
      a is one-to-one &
      len a = len w & len w = len t &
      (ex k being Nat st k in dom w & w/.k <> 0.K) &
      Sum w = 0.K &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom t holds
        t/.k = (w/.k) * f/.(a/.k)) &
      Sum t = 0.V)
  holds
    ex J being Subset of I, x being Element of V,
       a1,a2 being FinSequence of I,
       w1,w2 being FinSequence of the carrier of K,
       t1,t2 being FinSequence of the carrier of V st
      rng a1 c= J & rng a2 c= I \ J &
      len a1 = len w1 & len w1 = len t1 &
      len a2 = len w2 & len w2 = len t2 &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom w1 holds w1/.k in P) &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom w2 holds w2/.k in P) &
      Sum w1 = 1_K & Sum w2 = 1_K &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom t1 holds
        t1/.k = (w1/.k) * f/.(a1/.k)) &
      (for k being Nat st k in dom t2 holds
        t2/.k = (w2/.k) * f/.(a2/.k)) &
      Sum t1 = x & Sum t2 = x
proof
end;
