title: Q1471282_radon_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1471282,
% "Radon's theorem": an affinely dependent indexed family in a module over a
% linearly ordered field has complementary parts whose convex hulls intersect.
% This file contains no proof.

Q1471282_radon_s_theorem[
  I: TYPE,
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  leK: [K, K -> bool],
  zeroE: E,
  negE: [E -> E],
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  smul: [K, E -> E]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  index_set: TYPE = [I -> bool]
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  indexed_family: TYPE = [I -> E]
  scalar_family: TYPE = [I -> K]
  vector_family: TYPE = [I -> E]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[I]

  additive_group_laws_K: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      addK(x, zeroK) = x
        AND addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)

  field_multiplication_laws: bool =
    zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
        addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: K):
      leK(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      leK(x, y) AND leK(y, z) IMPLIES leK(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(x, y) AND leK(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(x, y) OR leK(y, x))

  strictly_ordered_ring_laws: bool =
    leK(zeroK, oneK)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      leK(x, y) IMPLIES
        leK(addK(x, z), addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(zeroK, x) AND leK(zeroK, y)
        IMPLIES leK(zeroK, mulK(x, y)))

  linearly_ordered_field_laws: bool =
    additive_group_laws_K
      AND field_multiplication_laws
      AND linear_order_laws
      AND strictly_ordered_ring_laws

  additive_commutative_group_laws_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      addE(x, zeroE) = x
        AND addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  module_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_laws_E
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
      smul(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
      smul(addK(a, b), x) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
      smul(mulK(a, b), x) =
        smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      smul(oneK, x) = x)

  scalar_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[I],
      values: scalar_family,
      total: K): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> K]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zeroK
          AND
        (FORALL (n: below(card(support))):
          partial_sums(n + 1) =
            addK(
              partial_sums(n),
              values(enumeration(n))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  vector_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[I],
      values: vector_family,
      total: E): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> E]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zeroE
          AND
        (FORALL (n: below(card(support))):
          partial_sums(n + 1) =
            addE(
              partial_sums(n),
              values(enumeration(n))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  affinely_dependent(f: indexed_family): bool =
    EXISTS
      (support: finite_set[I]),
      (weight: scalar_family):
        scalar_sum_value(support, weight, zeroK)
          AND
        vector_sum_value(
          support,
          (LAMBDA (i: I): smul(weight(i), f(i))),
          zeroE)
          AND
        (EXISTS (i: I):
          member(i, support) AND weight(i) /= zeroK)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (a, b: K):
      A(x)
        AND A(y)
        AND leK(zeroK, a)
        AND leK(zeroK, b)
        AND addK(a, b) = oneK
      IMPLIES
        A(addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, y)))

  convex_hull(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND point_subset(A, C) IMPLIES C(x)

  family_image(
      f: indexed_family,
      indices: index_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (i: I):
        indices(i) AND x = f(i)

  index_complement(indices: index_set): index_set =
    LAMBDA (i: I):
      NOT indices(i)

  radon_partition: bool =
    (linearly_ordered_field_laws AND module_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (f: indexed_family):
        affinely_dependent(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (indices: index_set),
              (intersection_point: E):
            convex_hull(
              family_image(f, indices))(intersection_point)
              AND
            convex_hull(
              family_image(
                f,
                index_complement(indices)))(
                  intersection_point)
END Q1471282_radon_s_theorem

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q1472120
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1472120), "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem": a symmetric
-- linear operator on a complete real or complex inner product space is continuous.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic

@[expose] public section

variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]

namespace LinearMap

def IsSymmetric (T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, inner 𝕜 (T x) y = inner 𝕜 x (T y)

/-- The Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem for symmetric linear operators. -/
theorem IsSymmetric.continuous [CompleteSpace E] {T : E →ₗ[𝕜] E}
    (hT : IsSymmetric T) : Continuous T := sorry

end LinearMap

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1472120
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1472120), "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem":
  every everywhere-defined symmetric linear operator on a complete real-or-
  complex inner-product space is continuous. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q1472120_rclike (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1472120_k_zero : K;
  q1472120_k_one : K;
  q1472120_k_add : K -> K -> K;
  q1472120_k_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q1472120_k_neg : K -> K;
  q1472120_k_inv : K -> K;
  q1472120_k_conj : K -> K;
  q1472120_k_norm : K -> R;
  q1472120_k_of_real : R -> K;
  q1472120_k_re : K -> R;
  q1472120_k_im : K -> R;
  q1472120_k_I : K;

  q1472120_k_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1472120_k_add x (q1472120_k_add y z) =
      q1472120_k_add (q1472120_k_add x y) z;
  q1472120_k_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1472120_k_add x y = q1472120_k_add y x;
  q1472120_k_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q1472120_k_add x q1472120_k_zero = x;
  q1472120_k_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q1472120_k_add x (q1472120_k_neg x) = q1472120_k_zero;
  q1472120_k_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1472120_k_mul x (q1472120_k_mul y z) =
      q1472120_k_mul (q1472120_k_mul x y) z;
  q1472120_k_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1472120_k_mul x y = q1472120_k_mul y x;
  q1472120_k_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q1472120_k_mul x q1472120_k_one = x;
  q1472120_k_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1472120_k_mul x (q1472120_k_add y z) =
      q1472120_k_add
        (q1472120_k_mul x y) (q1472120_k_mul x z);
  q1472120_k_mul_inv :
    forall x : K, x <> q1472120_k_zero ->
      q1472120_k_mul x (q1472120_k_inv x) = q1472120_k_one;
  q1472120_k_nontrivial :
    q1472120_k_zero <> q1472120_k_one;

  q1472120_k_conj_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_conj (q1472120_k_add x y) =
      q1472120_k_add (q1472120_k_conj x) (q1472120_k_conj y);
  q1472120_k_conj_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_conj (q1472120_k_mul x y) =
      q1472120_k_mul (q1472120_k_conj x) (q1472120_k_conj y);
  q1472120_k_conj_involutive :
    forall x : K, q1472120_k_conj (q1472120_k_conj x) = x;

  q1472120_k_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : K, 0 <= q1472120_k_norm x;
  q1472120_k_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q1472120_k_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1472120_k_zero;
  q1472120_k_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_norm (q1472120_k_add x y) <=
      q1472120_k_norm x + q1472120_k_norm y;
  q1472120_k_norm_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_norm (q1472120_k_mul x y) =
      q1472120_k_norm x * q1472120_k_norm y;
  q1472120_k_norm_conj :
    forall x : K,
      q1472120_k_norm (q1472120_k_conj x) = q1472120_k_norm x;

  q1472120_k_of_real_zero :
    q1472120_k_of_real 0 = q1472120_k_zero;
  q1472120_k_of_real_one :
    q1472120_k_of_real 1 = q1472120_k_one;
  q1472120_k_of_real_add :
    forall a b : R,
      q1472120_k_of_real (a + b) =
      q1472120_k_add (q1472120_k_of_real a) (q1472120_k_of_real b);
  q1472120_k_of_real_mul :
    forall a b : R,
      q1472120_k_of_real (a * b) =
      q1472120_k_mul (q1472120_k_of_real a) (q1472120_k_of_real b);
  q1472120_k_of_real_neg :
    forall a : R,
      q1472120_k_of_real (- a) =
      q1472120_k_neg (q1472120_k_of_real a);
  q1472120_k_of_real_injective :
    forall a b : R,
      q1472120_k_of_real a = q1472120_k_of_real b -> a = b;
  q1472120_k_norm_of_real :
    forall a : R, q1472120_k_norm (q1472120_k_of_real a) = Rabs a;

  q1472120_k_re_of_real :
    forall a : R, q1472120_k_re (q1472120_k_of_real a) = a;
  q1472120_k_im_of_real :
    forall a : R, q1472120_k_im (q1472120_k_of_real a) = 0;
  q1472120_k_re_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_re (q1472120_k_add x y) =
      q1472120_k_re x + q1472120_k_re y;
  q1472120_k_im_add :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_im (q1472120_k_add x y) =
      q1472120_k_im x + q1472120_k_im y;
  q1472120_k_re_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_re (q1472120_k_mul x y) =
      q1472120_k_re x * q1472120_k_re y -
      q1472120_k_im x * q1472120_k_im y;
  q1472120_k_im_mul :
    forall x y : K,
      q1472120_k_im (q1472120_k_mul x y) =
      q1472120_k_re x * q1472120_k_im y +
      q1472120_k_im x * q1472120_k_re y;
  q1472120_k_re_conj :
    forall x : K, q1472120_k_re (q1472120_k_conj x) = q1472120_k_re x;
  q1472120_k_im_conj :
    forall x : K, q1472120_k_im (q1472120_k_conj x) = - q1472120_k_im x;
  q1472120_k_re_I :
    q1472120_k_re q1472120_k_I = 0;
  q1472120_k_im_I_real :
    q1472120_k_I = q1472120_k_zero -> q1472120_k_im q1472120_k_I = 0;
  q1472120_k_im_I_complex :
    q1472120_k_I <> q1472120_k_zero -> q1472120_k_im q1472120_k_I = 1;
  q1472120_k_I_cases :
    q1472120_k_I = q1472120_k_zero \/
    (q1472120_k_I <> q1472120_k_zero /\
     q1472120_k_mul q1472120_k_I q1472120_k_I =
       q1472120_k_neg q1472120_k_one);
  q1472120_k_coordinate_decomposition :
    forall x : K,
      x =
      q1472120_k_add
        (q1472120_k_of_real (q1472120_k_re x))
        (q1472120_k_mul
          (q1472120_k_of_real (q1472120_k_im x))
          q1472120_k_I);
  q1472120_k_norm_coordinates :
    forall x : K,
      q1472120_k_norm x =
      sqrt (q1472120_k_re x * q1472120_k_re x +
            q1472120_k_im x * q1472120_k_im x)
}.

Arguments q1472120_k_zero {K} _.
Arguments q1472120_k_one {K} _.
Arguments q1472120_k_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1472120_k_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1472120_k_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q1472120_k_conj {K} _ _.
Arguments q1472120_k_norm {K} _ _.
Arguments q1472120_k_of_real {K} _ _.
Arguments q1472120_k_re {K} _ _.

Record q1472120_inner_product_space
    (K : Type) (F : q1472120_rclike K) (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1472120_e_zero : E;
  q1472120_e_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1472120_e_neg : E -> E;
  q1472120_e_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q1472120_e_norm : E -> R;
  q1472120_e_inner : E -> E -> K;

  q1472120_e_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1472120_e_add x (q1472120_e_add y z) =
      q1472120_e_add (q1472120_e_add x y) z;
  q1472120_e_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1472120_e_add x y = q1472120_e_add y x;
  q1472120_e_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q1472120_e_add x q1472120_e_zero = x;
  q1472120_e_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1472120_e_add x (q1472120_e_neg x) = q1472120_e_zero;

  q1472120_e_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1472120_e_smul (q1472120_k_one F) x = x;
  q1472120_e_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1472120_e_smul (q1472120_k_mul F a b) x =
      q1472120_e_smul a (q1472120_e_smul b x);
  q1472120_e_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1472120_e_smul (q1472120_k_add F a b) x =
      q1472120_e_add
        (q1472120_e_smul a x) (q1472120_e_smul b x);
  q1472120_e_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1472120_e_smul a (q1472120_e_add x y) =
      q1472120_e_add
        (q1472120_e_smul a x) (q1472120_e_smul a y);

  q1472120_e_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1472120_e_norm x;
  q1472120_e_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q1472120_e_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1472120_e_zero;
  q1472120_e_norm_neg :
    forall x : E, q1472120_e_norm (q1472120_e_neg x) = q1472120_e_norm x;
  q1472120_e_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q1472120_e_norm (q1472120_e_add x y) <=
      q1472120_e_norm x + q1472120_e_norm y;
  q1472120_e_norm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q1472120_e_norm (q1472120_e_smul a x) =
      q1472120_k_norm F a * q1472120_e_norm x;

  q1472120_e_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1472120_e_inner (q1472120_e_add x y) z =
      q1472120_k_add F
        (q1472120_e_inner x z) (q1472120_e_inner y z);
  q1472120_e_inner_add_right :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1472120_e_inner x (q1472120_e_add y z) =
      q1472120_k_add F
        (q1472120_e_inner x y) (q1472120_e_inner x z);
  q1472120_e_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1472120_e_inner (q1472120_e_smul a x) y =
      q1472120_k_mul F
        (q1472120_k_conj F a) (q1472120_e_inner x y);
  q1472120_e_inner_smul_right :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1472120_e_inner x (q1472120_e_smul a y) =
      q1472120_k_mul F a (q1472120_e_inner x y);
  q1472120_e_inner_conj_symm :
    forall x y : E,
      q1472120_e_inner y x =
      q1472120_k_conj F (q1472120_e_inner x y);
  q1472120_e_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : E,
      exists r : R,
        0 <= r /\
        q1472120_e_inner x x = q1472120_k_of_real F r;
  q1472120_e_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1472120_e_inner x x = q1472120_k_zero F <->
      x = q1472120_e_zero;
  q1472120_e_norm_sq :
    forall x : E,
      q1472120_e_norm x * q1472120_e_norm x =
      q1472120_k_re F (q1472120_e_inner x x)
}.

Arguments q1472120_e_zero {K F E} _.
Arguments q1472120_e_add {K F E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1472120_e_neg {K F E} _ _.
Arguments q1472120_e_smul {K F E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1472120_e_norm {K F E} _ _.
Arguments q1472120_e_inner {K F E} _ _ _.

Definition q1472120_e_sub
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    (H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q1472120_e_add H x (q1472120_e_neg H y).

Definition q1472120_sequence_converges
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    (H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1472120_e_norm H
          (q1472120_e_sub H (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q1472120_sequence_cauchy
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    (H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1472120_e_norm H
          (q1472120_e_sub H (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q1472120_complete
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    (H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q1472120_sequence_cauchy H u ->
    exists limit : E, q1472120_sequence_converges H u limit.

Record q1472120_linear_endomorphism
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    (H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E) : Type := {
  q1472120_map_fun : E -> E;
  q1472120_map_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q1472120_map_fun (q1472120_e_add H x y) =
      q1472120_e_add H (q1472120_map_fun x) (q1472120_map_fun y);
  q1472120_map_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),

      q1472120_e_smul H a (q1472120_map_fun x)

Arguments q1472120_map_fun {K E F H} _ _.

Definition q1472120_is_symmetric
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    {H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E}
    (T : q1472120_linear_endomorphism H) : Prop :=
  forall x y : E,
    q1472120_e_inner H (q1472120_map_fun T x) y =
    q1472120_e_inner H x (q1472120_map_fun T y).

Definition q1472120_is_continuous
    {K E : Type}
    {F : q1472120_rclike K}
    (H : q1472120_inner_product_space F E)
    (T : q1472120_linear_endomorphism H) : Prop :=

        q1472120_e_norm H

Theorem LinearMap_IsSymmetric_continuous :

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1472120 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1472120),
  "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem": every everywhere-defined symmetric
  linear endomorphism of a complete real or complex inner-product space is
  continuous. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

definition q1472120_complex_vector_space ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1472120_complex_vector_space cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q1472120_complex_inner_product_space ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1472120_complex_inner_product_space cscale cinner \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1472120_complex_vector_space cscale \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. cinner (x + y) z = cinner x z + cinner y z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. cinner (cscale a x) y = cnj a * cinner x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. cinner x (y + z) = cinner x y + cinner x z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. cinner x (cscale a y) = a * cinner x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. cinner x y = cnj (cinner y x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cinner x x = of_real (norm x ^ 2))"

definition q1472120_complex_linear ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1472120_complex_linear cscale T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. T (x + y) = T x + T y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. T (cscale a x) = cscale a (T x))"

definition q1472120_complex_symmetric ::
    "('e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1472120_complex_symmetric cinner T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. cinner (T x) y = cinner x (T y))"

theorem hellinger_toeplitz_real:
  fixes T :: "'e::{real_inner,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes linear: "linear T"
    and symmetric: "\<forall>x y. inner (T x) y = inner x (T y)"
  shows "continuous_on UNIV T"
  sorry

theorem hellinger_toeplitz_complex:
  fixes cscale ::
      "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and cinner :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and T :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes hilbert_space: "q1472120_complex_inner_product_space cscale cinner"
    and linear: "q1472120_complex_linear cscale T"
    and symmetric: "q1472120_complex_symmetric cinner T"
  shows "continuous_on UNIV T"
  sorry

end

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1472120,
  "Hellinger--Toeplitz theorem": every symmetric linear operator defined on an
  arbitrary complete real or complex inner-product space is continuous. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let q1472120_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q1472120_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q1472120_output;;
let q1472120_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q1472120_formatter path);;
let q1472120_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q1472120_formatter "Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q1472120_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q1472120_formatter ();;
close_out q1472120_output;;
if not q1472120_loaded then failwith "Unable to load complex library";;

let Q1472120_HELLINGER_TOEPLITZ_THEOREM =
 `let real_vector_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
      (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let real_inner_product =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real).
      (!x y z:V.
         inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let real_vector_norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt(inner x x) in
  let real_tends_to =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
     (u:num->V) (x:V).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n
              ==> real_vector_norm inner
                    (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let real_complete =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
      !u:num->V.
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                 N <= m /\ N <= n
                 ==> real_vector_norm inner
                       (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
        ==> ?x:V. real_tends_to add neg inner u x in
  let real_linear =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V) (op:V->V).
      (!x y:V. op (add x y) = add (op x) (op y)) /\
      (!a:real. !x:V. op (smul a x) = smul a (op x)) in
  let real_symmetric =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (op:V->V).
      !x y:V. inner (op x) y = inner x (op y) in
  let real_continuous =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
     (op:V->V).
      !x:V. !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?delta:real.
              &0 < delta /\
              !y:V.
                real_vector_norm inner (add y (neg x)) < delta
                ==> real_vector_norm inner
                      (add (op y) (neg (op x))) < epsilon in
  let complex_vector_space =
    \(zero:W) (add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W)
     (smul:complex->W->W).
      (!x y z:W. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:W. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:W. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:W. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:W. smul (Cx(&1)) x = x) /\
      (!a b:complex. !x:W.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:complex. !x:W.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:complex. !x y:W.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let complex_inner_product =
    \(zero:W) (add:W->W->W) (smul:complex->W->W)
     (inner:W->W->complex).
      (!x y z:W.
         inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a:complex. !x y:W.
         inner (smul a x) y = cnj(a) * inner x y) /\
      (!x y:W. cnj(inner y x) = inner x y) /\
      (!x:W. Im(inner x x) = &0 /\ &0 <= Re(inner x x)) /\
      (!x:W. inner x x = Cx(&0) <=> x = zero) in
  let complex_vector_norm =
    \(inner:W->W->complex) (x:W). sqrt(Re(inner x x)) in
  let complex_tends_to =
    \(add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W) (inner:W->W->complex)
     (u:num->W) (x:W).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n
              ==> complex_vector_norm inner
                    (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let complex_complete =
    \(add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W) (inner:W->W->complex).
      !u:num->W.
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                 N <= m /\ N <= n
                 ==> complex_vector_norm inner
                       (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
        ==> ?x:W. complex_tends_to add neg inner u x in
  let complex_linear =
    \(add:W->W->W) (smul:complex->W->W) (op:W->W).
      (!x y:W. op (add x y) = add (op x) (op y)) /\
      (!a:complex. !x:W. op (smul a x) = smul a (op x)) in
  let complex_symmetric =
    \(inner:W->W->complex) (op:W->W).
      !x y:W. inner (op x) y = inner x (op y) in
  let complex_continuous =
    \(add:W->W->W) (neg:W->W) (inner:W->W->complex)
     (op:W->W).
      !x:W. !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?delta:real.
              &0 < delta /\
              !y:W.
                complex_vector_norm inner (add y (neg x)) < delta
                ==> complex_vector_norm inner
                      (add (op y) (neg (op x))) < epsilon in
  ((!zero:V.
    !add:V->V->V.
    !neg:V->V.
    !smul:real->V->V.
    !inner:V->V->real.
      real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
      real_inner_product zero add smul inner /\
      real_complete add neg inner
      ==> !op:V->V.
            real_linear add smul op /\
            real_symmetric inner op
            ==> real_continuous add neg inner op) /\
   (!zero:W.
    !add:W->W->W.
    !neg:W->W.
    !smul:complex->W->W.
    !inner:W->W->complex.
      complex_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
      complex_inner_product zero add smul inner /\
      complex_complete add neg inner
      ==> !op:W->W.
            complex_linear add smul op /\
            complex_symmetric inner op
            ==> complex_continuous add neg inner op))`;;

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1472120,
;; "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem": every symmetric linear operator on a
;; complete real or complex inner-product space is continuous. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, operations, vectors, sequences, and operators are tame APPLY$
;; function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification, and
;; inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal existential
;; witnesses. Norms are represented by rational upper cuts, so their values
;; are genuine nonnegative reals rather than rational approximations.
;;
;; The scalar structure is explicitly a presentation of either the real field
;; or its complexification. Completeness is metric completeness, and continuity
;; is sequential continuity; for normed spaces these are equivalent to the
;; source notions. Linearity and symmetry are explicit hypotheses on the
;; arbitrary operator, and the conclusion is continuity of that same operator.

(defun q1472120-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q1472120-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q1472120-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q1472120-quoted nil)))

(defun q1472120-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   function-term
   (q1472120-term-list arguments)))

(defun q1472120-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q1472120-apply-term
   (q1472120-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q1472120-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q1472120-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q1472120-quoted nil))
    (q1472120-quoted t)))

(defun q1472120-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q1472120-quoted nil)
   (q1472120-quoted t)))

(defun q1472120-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q1472120-quoted t)))

(defun q1472120-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1472120-quoted t)
    (q1472120-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q1472120-quoted nil)
    (q1472120-quoted t))))

(defun q1472120-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q1472120-quoted t)))

(defun q1472120-fn-equal-true-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true
         (q1472120-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q1472120-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1472120-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun q1472120-positive-rational-p (q)
  (and (rationalp q) (< 0 q)))

(defun q1472120-norm-lt-p (norm-lt object q)
  (if (apply$ norm-lt (list object q))
      t
    nil))

(defun q1472120-norm-finite-witness-p
    (norm-lt object q)
  (and
   (q1472120-positive-rational-p q)
   (q1472120-norm-lt-p norm-lt object q)))

(defun q1472120-norm-finite-failure-function
    (norm-lt object)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'q1472120-norm-finite-witness-p
     (q1472120-quoted norm-lt)
     (q1472120-quoted object)
     'q)
    (q1472120-quoted nil)
    (q1472120-quoted t))))

(defun q1472120-norm-finite-p
    (norm-lt object)
  (let ((failure
         (q1472120-norm-finite-failure-function
          norm-lt object))
        (always-true
         (q1472120-true-function '(q))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1472120-norm-positive-witness-p
    (norm-lt object q)
  (and
   (q1472120-positive-rational-p q)
   (not (q1472120-norm-lt-p norm-lt object q))))

(defun q1472120-norm-positive-failure-function
    (norm-lt object)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(q)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'q1472120-norm-positive-witness-p
     (q1472120-quoted norm-lt)
     (q1472120-quoted object)
     'q)
    (q1472120-quoted nil)
    (q1472120-quoted t))))

(defun q1472120-norm-positive-p
    (norm-lt object)
  (let ((failure
         (q1472120-norm-positive-failure-function
          norm-lt object))
        (always-true
         (q1472120-true-function '(q))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1472120-rounded-witness-p
    (norm-lt object q r)
  (and
   (q1472120-positive-rational-p r)
   (rationalp q)
   (< r q)
   (q1472120-norm-lt-p norm-lt object r)))

(defun q1472120-rounded-failure-function
    (norm-lt object q)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(r)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'q1472120-rounded-witness-p
     (q1472120-quoted norm-lt)
     (q1472120-quoted object)
     (q1472120-quoted q)
     'r)
    (q1472120-quoted nil)
    (q1472120-quoted t))))

(defun q1472120-rounded-p
    (norm-lt object q)
  (let ((failure
         (q1472120-rounded-failure-function
          norm-lt object q))
        (always-true
         (q1472120-true-function '(r))))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1472120-product-witness-p
    (norm-lt left right q witness)
  (let ((r (car witness))
        (s (cdr witness)))
    (and
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p q)
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p r)
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p s)
     (q1472120-norm-lt-p norm-lt left r)
     (q1472120-norm-lt-p norm-lt right s)
     (< (* r s) q))))

(defun q1472120-product-failure-function
    (norm-lt left right q)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(witness)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'q1472120-product-witness-p
     (q1472120-quoted norm-lt)
     (q1472120-quoted left)
     (q1472120-quoted right)
     (q1472120-quoted q)
     'witness)
    (q1472120-quoted nil)
    (q1472120-quoted t))))

(defun q1472120-product-lt-p
    (norm-lt left right q)
  (let ((failure
         (q1472120-product-failure-function
          norm-lt left right q))
        (always-true
         (q1472120-true-function '(witness))))
    (and
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p q)
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1472120-mixed-product-witness-p
    (left-norm-lt right-norm-lt left right q witness)
  (let ((r (car witness))
        (s (cdr witness)))
    (and
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p q)
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p r)
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p s)
     (q1472120-norm-lt-p left-norm-lt left r)
     (q1472120-norm-lt-p right-norm-lt right s)
     (< (* r s) q))))

(defun q1472120-mixed-product-failure-function
    (left-norm-lt right-norm-lt left right q)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(witness)
   (list
    'if
    (list
     'q1472120-mixed-product-witness-p
     (q1472120-quoted left-norm-lt)
     (q1472120-quoted right-norm-lt)
     (q1472120-quoted left)
     (q1472120-quoted right)
     (q1472120-quoted q)
     'witness)
    (q1472120-quoted nil)
    (q1472120-quoted t))))

(defun q1472120-mixed-product-lt-p
    (left-norm-lt right-norm-lt left right q)
  (let ((failure
         (q1472120-mixed-product-failure-function
          left-norm-lt right-norm-lt
          left right q))
        (always-true
         (q1472120-true-function '(witness))))
    (and
     (q1472120-positive-rational-p q)
     (tamep-functionp failure)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (not (fn-equal failure always-true)))))

(defun q1472120-field-row-function
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one norm-lt)
  (let* ((xy-add
          (q1472120-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add
          (q1472120-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul
          (q1472120-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul
          (q1472120-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q1472120-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x
          (q1472120-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z q r s)
     (q1472120-implies-term
      (q1472120-and-terms
       (list
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1472120-and-terms
       (list
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier
                                   (list xy-add))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier
                                   (list xy-mul))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier
                                   (list neg-x))
        (q1472120-implies-term
         (q1472120-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q1472120-quoted zero)))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier
                                    (list inv-x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          add
          (list xy-add 'z))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-add
         (q1472120-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x (q1472120-quoted zero)))
         'x)
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          add
          (list 'x neg-x))
         (q1472120-quoted zero))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          multiply
          (list xy-mul 'z))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          multiply
          (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list
         'equal
         xy-mul
         (q1472120-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term

        (list
         (q1472120-integer-cast
          (denominator q) zero one add negate))))
    zero))

;; A complete Archimedean ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.
;; Archimedeanness follows from the rationally finite absolute-value cuts.

(defun q1472120-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (q1472120-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (q1472120-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (q1472120-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q1472120-implies-term
      (q1472120-and-terms
       (list
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1472120-and-terms
       (list
        (q1472120-not-term
         (q1472120-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q1472120-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (q1472120-implies-term
         (q1472120-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q1472120-implies-term
         xy
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q1472120-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q1472120-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q1472120-implies-term
         (q1472120-and-terms
          (list
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            less
            (list (q1472120-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            less
            (list (q1472120-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q1472120-quoted zero)
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun q1472120-real-norm-order-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less norm-lt)
  (let* ((cast-q
          (list
           'q1472120-rational-cast
           'q
           (q1472120-quoted zero)
           (q1472120-quoted one)
           (q1472120-quoted add)
           (q1472120-quoted multiply)
           (q1472120-quoted negate)
           (q1472120-quoted inverse)))
         (neg-cast-q
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           negate
           (list cast-q))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x q)
     (q1472120-implies-term
      (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q1472120-iff-term
       (q1472120-static-apply-term norm-lt '(x q))
       (q1472120-and-terms
        (list
         (list 'q1472120-positive-rational-p 'q)
         (q1472120-static-apply-term less
                                    (list neg-cast-q 'x))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term less
                                    (list 'x cast-q)))))))))

(defun q1472120-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less norm-lt)
  (and
   (q1472120-nontrivially-normed-field-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one norm-lt)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (q1472120-fn-equal-true-p
    (q1472120-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (q1472120-binary-value less zero one)
   (q1472120-fn-equal-true-p
    (q1472120-real-norm-order-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less norm-lt)
    '(x q))
   (q1472120-banach-space-p
    carrier add multiply one norm-lt
    carrier add negate zero multiply norm-lt)))

;; An RCLike scalar field is either the real presentation above or its
;; quadratic complexification. RE, IM, OF-REAL, STAR, and I give coordinates
;; and conjugation, while the norm cut is tied to re(x)^2 + im(x)^2.

(defun q1472120-rclike-coordinate-function
    (complexp
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate
     scalar-norm-lt
     of-real real-part imag-part star imaginary-unit)
  (let* ((re-x
          (q1472120-static-apply-term real-part '(x)))
         (im-x
          (q1472120-static-apply-term imag-part '(x)))
         (of-re-x
          (q1472120-static-apply-term of-real (list re-x)))
         (of-im-x
          (q1472120-static-apply-term of-real (list im-x)))
         (im-i
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           scalar-multiply
           (list of-im-x
                 (q1472120-quoted imaginary-unit))))
         (coordinate-sum
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           scalar-add
           (list of-re-x im-i)))
         (star-coordinate
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           scalar-add
           (list
            of-re-x
            (q1472120-static-apply-term
             scalar-negate
             (list im-i)))))
         (of-r
          (q1472120-static-apply-term of-real '(r)))
         (of-s
          (q1472120-static-apply-term of-real '(s)))
         (cast-q
          (list
           'q1472120-rational-cast
           'q
           (q1472120-quoted real-zero)
           (q1472120-quoted real-one)
           (q1472120-quoted real-add)
           (q1472120-quoted real-multiply)
           (q1472120-quoted real-negate)
           (q1472120-quoted real-inverse)))
         (q-square
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           real-multiply
           (list cast-q cast-q)))
         (re-square
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           real-multiply
           (list re-x re-x)))
         (im-square
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           real-multiply
           (list im-x im-x)))
         (modulus-square
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           real-add
           (list re-square im-square))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x r s q)
     (q1472120-and-terms
      (list
       (q1472120-implies-term
        (q1472120-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(x))
        (q1472120-and-terms
         (list
          (q1472120-static-apply-term real-carrier
                                     (list re-x))
          (q1472120-static-apply-term real-carrier
                                     (list im-x))
          (q1472120-static-apply-term scalar-carrier
                                     (list
                                      (q1472120-static-apply-term
                                       star '(x))))
          (q1472120-implies-term
           (q1472120-quoted complexp)
           (q1472120-and-terms
            (list
             (list 'equal 'x coordinate-sum)
             (list
              'equal
              (q1472120-static-apply-term star '(x))
              star-coordinate))))
          (q1472120-implies-term
           (q1472120-not-term
            (q1472120-quoted complexp))
           (q1472120-and-terms
            (list
             (list 'equal 'x of-re-x)
             (list 'equal im-x
                   (q1472120-quoted real-zero))
             (list
              'equal
              (q1472120-static-apply-term star '(x))
              'x))))
          (q1472120-iff-term
           (q1472120-static-apply-term scalar-norm-lt '(x q))
           (q1472120-and-terms
            (list
             (list 'q1472120-positive-rational-p 'q)
             (q1472120-static-apply-term
              real-less
              (list modulus-square q-square))))))))
       (q1472120-implies-term
        (q1472120-and-terms
         (list
          (q1472120-static-apply-term real-carrier '(r))
          (q1472120-static-apply-term real-carrier '(s))))
        (q1472120-and-terms
         (list
          (q1472120-static-apply-term scalar-carrier
                                     (list of-r))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1472120-static-apply-term real-part
                                      (list of-r))
           'r)
          (list
           'equal
           (q1472120-static-apply-term imag-part
                                      (list of-r))
           (q1472120-quoted real-zero))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            of-real
            (list
             (q1472120-static-apply-term
              real-add '(r s))))
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            scalar-add
            (list of-r of-s)))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            of-real
            (list
             (q1472120-static-apply-term
              real-multiply '(r s))))
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            scalar-multiply
            (list of-r of-s)))
          (list
           'equal
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            of-real
            (list
             (q1472120-static-apply-term
              real-negate '(r))))
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            scalar-negate
            (list of-r)))))))))))

(defun q1472120-rclike-field-p
    (complexp
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate scalar-inverse
     scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-norm-lt
     of-real real-part imag-part star imaginary-unit)
  (and
   (booleanp complexp)
   (q1472120-real-field-p
    real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
    real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt)
   (q1472120-nontrivially-normed-field-p
    scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate scalar-inverse
    scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-norm-lt)
   (tamep-functionp of-real)
   (tamep-functionp real-part)
   (tamep-functionp imag-part)
   (tamep-functionp star)
   (q1472120-member-p scalar-carrier imaginary-unit)
   (equal (apply$ of-real (list real-zero)) scalar-zero)
   (equal (apply$ of-real (list real-one)) scalar-one)
   (equal (apply$ real-part (list scalar-zero)) real-zero)
   (equal (apply$ imag-part (list scalar-zero)) real-zero)
   (equal (apply$ real-part (list scalar-one)) real-one)
   (equal (apply$ imag-part (list scalar-one)) real-zero)
   (if complexp
       (and
        (equal
         (apply$ real-part (list imaginary-unit))
         real-zero)
        (equal
         (apply$ imag-part (list imaginary-unit))
         real-one)
        (equal
         (q1472120-binary-value
          scalar-multiply imaginary-unit imaginary-unit)
         (apply$ scalar-negate (list scalar-one))))
     (equal imaginary-unit scalar-zero))
   (q1472120-fn-equal-true-p
    (q1472120-rclike-coordinate-function
     complexp
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate
     scalar-norm-lt
     of-real real-part imag-part star imaginary-unit)
    '(x r s q))))

;; Inner-product spaces, with the norm cut definitionally tied to
;; re(<x,x>). The second argument is linear, matching mathlib's convention.

(defun q1472120-inner-product-laws-function
    (real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-zero
     real-part star
     carrier add zero smul norm-lt inner)
  (let* ((xy-inner
          (q1472120-static-apply-term inner '(x y)))
         (yx-inner
          (q1472120-static-apply-term inner '(y x)))
         (xx-inner
          (q1472120-static-apply-term inner '(x x)))
         (xx-real
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           real-part
           (list xx-inner)))
         (cast-q
          (list
           'q1472120-rational-cast
           'q
           (q1472120-quoted real-zero)
           (q1472120-quoted real-one)
           (q1472120-quoted real-add)
           (q1472120-quoted real-multiply)
           (q1472120-quoted real-negate)
           (q1472120-quoted real-inverse)))
         (q-square
          (q1472120-static-apply-term
           real-multiply
           (list cast-q cast-q))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a x y z q)
     (q1472120-implies-term
      (q1472120-and-terms
       (list
        (q1472120-static-apply-term scalar-carrier '(a))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q1472120-and-terms
       (list
        (q1472120-static-apply-term scalar-carrier
                                   (list xy-inner))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          inner
          (list
           'x
           (q1472120-static-apply-term add '(y z))))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          scalar-add
          (list
           xy-inner
           (q1472120-static-apply-term inner '(x z)))))
        (list
         'equal
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          inner
          (list
           'x
           (q1472120-static-apply-term smul '(a y))))
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          scalar-multiply
          (list 'a xy-inner)))
        (list
         'equal
         yx-inner
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          star
          (list xy-inner)))
        (q1472120-not-term
         (q1472120-static-apply-term
          real-less
          (list xx-real
                (q1472120-quoted real-zero))))
        (q1472120-iff-term
         (list 'equal xx-inner
               (q1472120-quoted scalar-zero))
         (list 'equal 'x
               (q1472120-quoted zero)))
        (q1472120-iff-term
         (q1472120-static-apply-term norm-lt '(x q))
         (q1472120-and-terms
          (list
           (list 'q1472120-positive-rational-p 'q)
           (q1472120-static-apply-term
            real-less
            (list xx-real q-square)))))))))))

(defun q1472120-hilbert-space-p
    (real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-one scalar-norm-lt
     scalar-zero real-part star
     carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner)
  (and
   (q1472120-banach-space-p
    scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-one scalar-norm-lt
    carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt)
   (tamep-functionp inner)
   (q1472120-fn-equal-true-p
    (q1472120-inner-product-laws-function
     real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-zero
     real-part star
     carrier add zero smul norm-lt inner)
    '(a x y z q))))

;; Symmetry is the source equation <T x,y> = <x,T y> for every pair of
;; vectors. The linear-map predicate also supplies closure of T on the carrier.

(defun q1472120-symmetry-function
    (carrier inner operator)
  (list
   'lambda
   '(x y)
   (q1472120-implies-term
    (q1472120-and-terms
     (list
      (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q1472120-static-apply-term carrier '(y))))
    (list
     'equal
     (q1472120-static-apply-term
      inner
      (list
       (q1472120-static-apply-term operator '(x))
       'y))
     (q1472120-static-apply-term
      inner
      (list
       'x
       (q1472120-static-apply-term operator '(y))))))))

(defun q1472120-symmetric-linear-operator-p
    (scalar-carrier carrier add smul inner operator)
  (and
   (q1472120-linear-map-p
    scalar-carrier carrier carrier
    add add smul smul operator)
   (q1472120-fn-equal-true-p
    (q1472120-symmetry-function
     carrier inner operator)
    '(x y))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1472120-hellinger-toeplitz-theorem-statement
    (complexp
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate scalar-inverse
     scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-norm-lt
     of-real real-part imag-part star imaginary-unit
     carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner operator)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1472120-rclike-field-p
     complexp
     real-carrier real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less real-norm-lt
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-negate scalar-inverse
     scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-norm-lt
     of-real real-part imag-part star imaginary-unit)
    (q1472120-hilbert-space-p
     real-add real-multiply real-negate real-inverse
     real-zero real-one real-less
     scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-one scalar-norm-lt
     scalar-zero real-part star
     carrier add negate zero smul norm-lt inner)
    (q1472120-symmetric-linear-operator-p
     scalar-carrier carrier add smul inner operator))
   (q1472120-continuous-p
    carrier add negate norm-lt
    carrier add negate norm-lt
    operator)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1472120,
-- "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem": every everywhere-defined symmetric linear
-- operator on a complete real or complex inner-product space is continuous.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

data ScalarKind : Set where
  realScalar    : ScalarKind
  complexScalar : ScalarKind

data CanonicalScalar (R : Set) : ScalarKind -> Set where
  realValue :
    R ->
    CanonicalScalar R realScalar
  complexValue :
    R ->
    R ->
    CanonicalScalar R complexScalar

canonicalZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalZero reals realScalar =
  realValue (zeroR reals)
canonicalZero reals complexScalar =
  complexValue (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

canonicalOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalOne reals realScalar =
  realValue (oneR reals)
canonicalOne reals complexScalar =
  complexValue (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

canonicalAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalAdd reals realScalar (realValue x) (realValue y) =
  realValue (addR reals x y)
canonicalAdd reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) (complexValue c d) =
  complexValue
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

canonicalMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalMultiply reals realScalar (realValue x) (realValue y) =
  realValue (multiplyR reals x y)
canonicalMultiply reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) (complexValue c d) =
  complexValue
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (negateR reals (multiplyR reals b d)))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

canonicalNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalNegate reals realScalar (realValue x) =
  realValue (negateR reals x)
canonicalNegate reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  complexValue (negateR reals a) (negateR reals b)

canonicalConjugate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind
canonicalConjugate reals realScalar (realValue x) =
  realValue x
canonicalConjugate reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  complexValue a (negateR reals b)

canonicalRealPart :
  {R : Set} ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  R
canonicalRealPart realScalar (realValue x) =
  x
canonicalRealPart complexScalar (complexValue a b) =
  a

CanonicalReciprocal :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  Set
CanonicalReciprocal reals kind x y =
  Both
    (x == canonicalZero reals kind -> y == canonicalZero reals kind)
    (x != canonicalZero reals kind ->
      canonicalMultiply reals kind x y == canonicalOne reals kind)

CanonicalNormValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (kind : ScalarKind) ->
  CanonicalScalar R kind ->
  R ->
  Set
CanonicalNormValue reals realScalar (realValue x) value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
    (multiplyR reals value value == multiplyR reals x x)
CanonicalNormValue reals complexScalar (complexValue a b) value =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value)
    (multiplyR reals value value ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals a a)
        (multiplyR reals b b))

record RCLike
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK conjugateK : K -> K
    realPartK : K -> R
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) -> addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) -> multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z == multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) -> multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    conjugate-involutiveK :
      (x : K) -> conjugateK (conjugateK x) == x
    conjugate-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      conjugateK (addK x y) == addK (conjugateK x) (conjugateK y)
    conjugate-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      conjugateK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyK (conjugateK x) (conjugateK y)
    conjugate-zeroK :
      conjugateK zeroK == zeroK
    conjugate-oneK :
      conjugateK oneK == oneK

    real-part-zeroK :
      realPartK zeroK == zeroR reals
    real-part-oneK :
      realPartK oneK == oneR reals
    real-part-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      realPartK (addK x y) ==
      addR reals (realPartK x) (realPartK y)
    real-part-conjugateK :
      (x : K) -> realPartK (conjugateK x) == realPartK x

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) -> normK x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-conjugateK :
      (x : K) -> normK (conjugateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)
    norm-squareK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK x) ==
      realPartK (multiplyK (conjugateK x) x)

    scalar-kind :
      ScalarKind
    to-canonical :
      K -> CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind
    from-canonical :
      CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind -> K
    from-after-to-canonical :
      (x : K) ->
      from-canonical (to-canonical x) == x
    to-after-from-canonical :
      (x : CanonicalScalar R scalar-kind) ->
      to-canonical (from-canonical x) == x

    to-canonical-zero :
      to-canonical zeroK == canonicalZero reals scalar-kind
    to-canonical-one :
      to-canonical oneK == canonicalOne reals scalar-kind
    to-canonical-add :
      (x y : K) ->
      to-canonical (addK x y) ==
      canonicalAdd reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (to-canonical y)
    to-canonical-multiply :
      (x y : K) ->
      to-canonical (multiplyK x y) ==
      canonicalMultiply reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (to-canonical y)
    to-canonical-negate :
      (x : K) ->
      to-canonical (negateK x) ==
      canonicalNegate reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x)
    to-canonical-reciprocal :
      (x : K) ->
      CanonicalReciprocal reals scalar-kind
        (to-canonical x)
        (to-canonical (reciprocalK x))
    to-canonical-conjugate :
      (x : K) ->
      to-canonical (conjugateK x) ==
      canonicalConjugate reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x)
    to-canonical-real-part :
      (x : K) ->
      realPartK x == canonicalRealPart scalar-kind (to-canonical x)
    to-canonical-norm :
      (x : K) ->
      CanonicalNormValue reals scalar-kind (to-canonical x) (normK x)

    completeK :
      (sequence : Nat -> K) ->
      ((epsilon : R) ->
        Positive reals epsilon ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ cutoff ->
            (m n : Nat) ->
            cutoff <=N m ->
            cutoff <=N n ->
            StrictLess reals
              (normK
                (addK (sequence m) (negateK (sequence n))))
              epsilon)) ->
      Exists K
        (\ limit ->
          (epsilon : R) ->
          Positive reals epsilon ->
          Exists Nat
            (\ cutoff ->
              (n : Nat) ->
              cutoff <=N n ->
              StrictLess reals
                (normK
                  (addK (sequence n) (negateK limit)))
                epsilon))

open RCLike

record InnerProductSpace
  (K R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : K -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R
    inner : E -> E -> K

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK scalars a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK scalars a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) -> normE x == zeroR reals -> x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) -> normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normE x)

    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : E) ->
      inner (addE x y) z ==
      addK scalars (inner x z) (inner y z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      inner (scaleE a x) y ==
      multiplyK scalars (conjugateK scalars a) (inner x y)
    inner-add-right :
      (x y z : E) ->
      inner x (addE y z) ==
      addK scalars (inner x y) (inner x z)
    inner-scale-right :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      inner x (scaleE a y) ==
      multiplyK scalars a (inner x y)
    inner-conjugate-symmetry :
      (x y : E) ->
      inner x y == conjugateK scalars (inner y x)
    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (realPartK scalars (inner x x))
    inner-definite :
      (x : E) ->
      inner x x == zeroK scalars ->
      x == zeroE
    inner-norm-square :
      (x : E) ->
      multiplyR reals (normE x) (normE x) ==
      realPartK scalars (inner x x)

open InnerProductSpace

distanceE :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (addE space x (negateE space y))

SequentialLimit :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceE space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  (Nat -> E) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceE space (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Complete :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars ->
  Set
Complete {E = E} space =
  (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists E (\ limit -> SequentialLimit space sequence limit)

record LinearEndomorphism
  {K R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals}
  (space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars) : Set1 where
  field
    apply : E -> E
    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addE space x y) ==
      addE space (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleE space a x) ==
      scaleE space a (apply x)

open LinearEndomorphism

Symmetric :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  {space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars} ->
  LinearEndomorphism space ->
  Set
Symmetric {E = E} {space = space} linear =
  (x y : E) ->
  inner space (apply linear x) y ==
  inner space x (apply linear y)

Continuous :
  {K R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {scalars : RCLike K R reals} ->
  (space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  LinearEndomorphism space ->
  Set
Continuous {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space linear =
  (x : E) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((y : E) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE space (apply linear y) (apply linear x))
            epsilon))

hellinger-toeplitz-theorem : Set1
hellinger-toeplitz-theorem =
  (R K E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (scalars : RCLike K R reals) ->
  (space : InnerProductSpace K R E reals scalars) ->
  Complete space ->
  (linear : LinearEndomorphism space) ->
  Symmetric linear ->
  Continuous space linear

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1472120 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1472120),
  "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem": a symmetric linear operator on a
  complete real or complex inner product space is continuous. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val q1472120_rclike_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_rclike_def",
  ``q1472120_rclike
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (conjK : 'k -> 'k) (reK : 'k -> real) <=>
      (?encodeR : 'k -> real. ?decodeR : real -> 'k.
        (!a. decodeR (encodeR a) = a) /\
        (!r. encodeR (decodeR r) = r) /\
        encodeR zeroK = 0 /\
        encodeR oneK = 1 /\
        (!a b. encodeR (addK a b) = encodeR a + encodeR b) /\
        (!a b. encodeR (mulK a b) = encodeR a * encodeR b) /\
        (!a. encodeR (conjK a) = encodeR a) /\
        (!a. reK a = encodeR a)) \/
      (?encodeC : 'k -> complex. ?decodeC : complex -> 'k.
        (!a. decodeC (encodeC a) = a) /\
        (!z. encodeC (decodeC z) = z) /\
        encodeC zeroK = 0 /\
        encodeC oneK = 1 /\
        (!a b. encodeC (addK a b) = encodeC a + encodeC b) /\
        (!a b. encodeC (mulK a b) = encodeC a * encodeC b) /\
        (!a. encodeC (conjK a) = conj (encodeC a)) /\
        (!a. reK a = RE (encodeC a)))``);

val q1472120_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q1472120_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero)``);

val q1472120_module_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_module_def",
  ``q1472120_module
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) <=>
      (!x. smul oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addK a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y))``);

val q1472120_inner_product_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_inner_product_def",
  ``q1472120_inner_product
      (zeroK : 'k) (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (conjK : 'k -> 'k) (reK : 'k -> real)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> 'k) <=>
      (!x y. inner x y = conjK (inner y x)) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = addK (inner x z) (inner y z)) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = mulK (conjK a) (inner x y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= reK (inner x x)) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = zeroK) <=> (x = zero))``);

val q1472120_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_norm_def",
  ``q1472120_norm
      (reK : 'k -> real) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> 'k) (x : 'e) =
      sqrt (reK (inner x x))``);

val q1472120_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_cauchy_def",
  ``q1472120_cauchy
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q1472120_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_tendsto_def",
  ``q1472120_tendsto
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q1472120_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_complete_def",
  ``q1472120_complete
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q1472120_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?x : 'e. q1472120_tendsto add neg norm u x``);

val q1472120_linear_map_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_linear_map_def",
  ``q1472120_linear_map
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (t : 'e -> 'e) <=>
      (!x y. t (add x y) = add (t x) (t y)) /\
      (!a x. t (smul a x) = smul a (t x))``);

val q1472120_symmetric_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_symmetric_def",
  ``q1472120_symmetric
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> 'k) (t : 'e -> 'e) <=>
      !x y. inner (t x) y = inner x (t y)``);

val q1472120_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q1472120_continuous_def",
  ``q1472120_continuous
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (t : 'e -> 'e) <=>
      !x : 'e. !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y : 'e.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < delta ==>
            norm (add (t y) (neg (t x))) < epsilon``);

val LinearMap_IsSymmetric_continuous =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (conjK : 'k -> 'k) (reK : 'k -> real)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> 'k)
      (t : 'e -> 'e).
      q1472120_rclike zeroK oneK addK mulK conjK reK /\
      q1472120_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      q1472120_module zeroK oneK addK mulK add smul /\
      q1472120_inner_product
        zeroK addK mulK conjK reK zero add smul inner /\
      q1472120_complete add neg (q1472120_norm reK inner) /\
      q1472120_linear_map add smul t /\
      q1472120_symmetric inner t
      ==>
      q1472120_continuous add neg (q1472120_norm reK inner) t``;

title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1472120
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1472120), "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem":
  every everywhere-defined symmetric linear operator on a complete real or
  complex inner-product space is continuous. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's CHil class consists of complete inner-product spaces over the real
  or complex numbers. For w in CHil, w LMHom w is the class of all
  everywhere-defined linear endomorphisms of w.

  SetMM's inner product is linear in its first slot, opposite to mathlib's
  convention. Thus ( y ( .i ` W ) ( T ` x ) ) renders mathlib's inner product
  of T x with y, and ( ( T ` y ) ( .i ` W ) x ) renders the inner product of
  x with T y. The displayed identity is therefore exactly
  LinearMap.IsSymmetric T. Membership in
  ( ( TopOpen ` W ) Cn ( TopOpen ` W ) ) is continuity for the norm topology.
  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement; this root
  file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d t w x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q1472120-hellinger-toeplitz $a |-
    A. w e. CHil
      A. t e. ( w LMHom w )
        (
          (
            A. x e. ( Base ` w )
              A. y e. ( Base ` w )
                (
                  ( y ( .i ` w ) ( t ` x ) )
                  =
                  ( ( t ` y ) ( .i ` w ) x )
                )
          )
          ->
          t e. ( ( TopOpen ` w ) Cn ( TopOpen ` w ) )
        )
  $.
$}
