title: Q1472120_hellinger_ndash_toeplitz_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1472120
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1472120), "Hellinger–Toeplitz theorem": every
% everywhere-defined symmetric linear operator on a real or complex Hilbert
% space is continuous. This file contains no proof.

hellinger_toeplitz_theorem_Q1472120[
  E: TYPE+,
  complex_case: bool,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  inner_re: [E, E -> real],
  inner_im: [E, E -> real],
  operator: [E -> E]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  scalar_valid(real_part, imag_part: real): bool =
    complex_case OR imag_part = 0

  scalar_norm_squared(real_part, imag_part: real): real =
    real_part ^ 2 + imag_part ^ 2

  scalar_product_re(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_re - left_im * right_im

  scalar_product_im(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_im + left_im * right_re

  scalar_mode_laws: bool =
    NOT complex_case IMPLIES
      FORALL (x, y: E):
        inner_im(x, y) = 0

  additive_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  scalar_module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL
        (a_re, a_im: real),
        (x, y: E):
      scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
        smulE(a_re, a_im, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(
            smulE(a_re, a_im, x),
            smulE(a_re, a_im, y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: E):
        (scalar_valid(a_re, a_im)
          AND scalar_valid(b_re, b_im))
        IMPLIES
          smulE(a_re + b_re, a_im + b_im, x) =
            addE(
              smulE(a_re, a_im, x),
              smulE(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: E):
        (scalar_valid(a_re, a_im)
          AND scalar_valid(b_re, b_im))
        IMPLIES
          smulE(
            scalar_product_re(a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
            scalar_product_im(a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
            x)
          =
            smulE(
              a_re,
              a_im,
              smulE(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, 0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a_re, a_im: real):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          smulE(a_re, a_im, zeroE) = zeroE)

  norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: E):
      0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          normE(smulE(a_re, a_im, x)) ^ 2 =
            scalar_norm_squared(a_re, a_im) * normE(x) ^ 2)

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      inner_re(addE(x, y), z) =
        inner_re(x, z) + inner_re(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        inner_im(addE(x, y), z) =
          inner_im(x, z) + inner_im(y, z))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_re(smulE(a_re, a_im, x), y) =
            a_re * inner_re(x, y) + a_im * inner_im(x, y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_im(smulE(a_re, a_im, x), y) =
            a_re * inner_im(x, y) - a_im * inner_re(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        inner_re(x, addE(y, z)) =
          inner_re(x, y) + inner_re(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        inner_im(x, addE(y, z)) =
          inner_im(x, y) + inner_im(x, z))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_re(x, smulE(a_re, a_im, y)) =
            a_re * inner_re(x, y) - a_im * inner_im(x, y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          inner_im(x, smulE(a_re, a_im, y)) =
            a_re * inner_im(x, y) + a_im * inner_re(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        inner_re(x, y) = inner_re(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        inner_im(x, y) = -inner_im(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        inner_im(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= inner_re(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        inner_re(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) ^ 2 = inner_re(x, x))

  converges(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges(values, limit)

  hilbert_space_context: bool =
    scalar_mode_laws
      AND additive_group_laws
      AND scalar_module_laws
      AND norm_laws
      AND inner_product_laws
      AND complete_space

  linear_operator: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      operator(addE(x, y)) =
        addE(operator(x), operator(y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: E):
        scalar_valid(a_re, a_im) IMPLIES
          operator(smulE(a_re, a_im, x)) =
            smulE(a_re, a_im, operator(x)))

  symmetric_operator: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E):
      inner_re(operator(x), y) =
        inner_re(x, operator(y))
        AND inner_im(operator(x), y) =
          inner_im(x, operator(y))

  continuous_operator: bool =
    FORALL (x: E), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: E):
          normE(subE(y, x)) < delta IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(operator(y), operator(x)))
              < epsilon_value

  hellinger_toeplitz: bool =
    hilbert_space_context IMPLIES
      (linear_operator AND symmetric_operator)
        IMPLIES continuous_operator
END hellinger_toeplitz_theorem_Q1472120

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q1477053), "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": an equicontinuous
-- family of bounded continuous functions on a compact space, with values in a compact

module

@[expose] public section

universe u v

namespace Q1477053

variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [TopologicalSpace α] [CompactSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β]

/-- The Arzelà–Ascoli theorem for bounded continuous functions with compact range. -/
theorem arzela_ascoli_theorem_statement [T2Space β] (s : Set β) (hs : IsCompact s)
    (A : Set (α →ᵇ β)) (in_s : ∀ (f : α →ᵇ β) (x : α), f ∈ A → f x ∈ s)
    (H : Equicontinuous ((↑) : A → α → β)) : IsCompact (closure A) := sorry

end Q1477053

title: Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1477053
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1477053), "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": on a compact
  topological space, a pointwise equicontinuous family of bounded continuous
  functions with values in a fixed compact subset of a Hausdorff pseudometric
  space has compact closure in the uniform-convergence topology. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1477053_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q1477053_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q1477053_is_open : q1477053_set X -> Prop;
  q1477053_open_ext :
    forall U V : q1477053_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q1477053_is_open U <-> q1477053_is_open V);
  q1477053_open_univ :
    q1477053_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q1477053_open_inter :
    forall U V : q1477053_set X,
      q1477053_is_open U ->
      q1477053_is_open V ->
      q1477053_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q1477053_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q1477053_set (q1477053_set X),
      (forall U : q1477053_set X,
        family U -> q1477053_is_open U) ->
      q1477053_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q1477053_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q1477053_is_open {X} _ _.

Record q1477053_pseudo_metric_space (Y : Type) : Type := {
  q1477053_dist : Y -> Y -> R;
  q1477053_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : Y, 0 <= q1477053_dist x y;
  q1477053_dist_self :
    forall x : Y, q1477053_dist x x = 0;
  q1477053_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : Y, q1477053_dist x y = q1477053_dist y x;
  q1477053_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : Y,
      q1477053_dist x z <=
      q1477053_dist x y + q1477053_dist y z
}.

Arguments q1477053_dist {Y} _ _ _.

Definition q1477053_t2_space
    {Y : Type}
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y) : Prop :=
  forall x y : Y,
    q1477053_dist M x y = 0 ->
    x = y.

Definition q1477053_metric_is_open
    {Y : Type}
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (U : q1477053_set Y) : Prop :=
  forall x : Y,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : Y,
        q1477053_dist M x y < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q1477053_is_compact
    {X : Type}
    (is_open : q1477053_set (q1477053_set X))
    (K : q1477053_set X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q1477053_set (q1477053_set X),
    (forall U : q1477053_set X,
      cover U -> is_open U) ->
    (forall x : X,
      K x ->
      exists U : q1477053_set X, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q1477053_set X),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        K x ->
        exists U : q1477053_set X,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q1477053_compact_space
    {X : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  q1477053_is_compact
    (q1477053_is_open T)
    (fun _ : X => True).

Definition q1477053_compact_metric_set
    {Y : Type}
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (K : q1477053_set Y) : Prop :=
  q1477053_is_compact (q1477053_metric_is_open M) K.

Definition q1477053_continuous
    {X Y : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (f : X -> Y) : Prop :=
  forall V : q1477053_set Y,
    q1477053_metric_is_open M V ->
    q1477053_is_open T (fun x : X => V (f x)).

Definition q1477053_bounded_range
    {X Y : Type}
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (f : X -> Y) : Prop :=
  exists bound : R,
    0 <= bound /\
    forall x y : X,
      q1477053_dist M (f x) (f y) <= bound.

Definition q1477053_bounded_continuous
    {X Y : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (f : X -> Y) : Prop :=
  q1477053_continuous T M f /\
  q1477053_bounded_range M f.

Definition q1477053_uniform_is_open
    {X Y : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (U : q1477053_set (X -> Y)) : Prop :=
  forall f : X -> Y,
    q1477053_bounded_continuous T M f ->
    U f ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall g : X -> Y,
        q1477053_bounded_continuous T M g ->
        (forall x : X,
          q1477053_dist M (f x) (g x) < epsilon) ->
        U g.

Definition q1477053_uniform_is_closed
    {X Y : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (C : q1477053_set (X -> Y)) : Prop :=
  q1477053_uniform_is_open T M
    (fun f : X -> Y =>
      q1477053_bounded_continuous T M f /\ ~ C f).

Definition q1477053_uniform_closure
    {X Y : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (A : q1477053_set (X -> Y)) :
    q1477053_set (X -> Y) :=
  fun f : X -> Y =>
    q1477053_bounded_continuous T M f /\
    forall C : q1477053_set (X -> Y),
      q1477053_uniform_is_closed T M C ->
      (forall g : X -> Y,
        q1477053_bounded_continuous T M g ->
        A g ->
        C g) ->
      C f.

Definition q1477053_equicontinuous
    {X Y : Type}
    (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
    (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
    (A : q1477053_set (X -> Y)) : Prop :=
  forall (x : X) (epsilon : R),
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists U : q1477053_set X,
      q1477053_is_open T U /\
      U x /\
      forall (f : X -> Y) (y z : X),
        A f ->
        U y ->
        U z ->
        q1477053_dist M (f y) (f z) < epsilon.

Theorem q1477053_arzela_ascoli :
  forall (X Y : Type)
         (T : q1477053_topological_space X)
         (M : q1477053_pseudo_metric_space Y)
         (s : q1477053_set Y)
         (A : q1477053_set (X -> Y)),
    q1477053_compact_space T ->
    q1477053_t2_space M ->
    q1477053_compact_metric_set M s ->
    (forall f : X -> Y,
      A f ->
      q1477053_bounded_continuous T M f) ->
    (forall (f : X -> Y) (x : X),
      A f ->
      s (f x)) ->
    q1477053_equicontinuous T M A ->
    q1477053_is_compact
      (q1477053_uniform_is_open T M)
      (q1477053_uniform_closure T M A).
Admitted.

title: Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1477053 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1477053), "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem":
  on a compact topological space, the uniform-metric closure of an
  equicontinuous family of bounded continuous functions whose values lie in a
  fixed compact set is compact. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bounded_Continuous_Function"
begin

definition q1477053_equicontinuous ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow>\<^sub>C 'b::metric_space) set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1477053_equicontinuous A \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<epsilon>. 0 < \<epsilon> \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>U. open U \<and> x \<in> U \<and>
          (\<forall>f \<in> A. \<forall>y \<in> U. \<forall>z \<in> U.
            dist (f y) (f z) < \<epsilon>)))"

theorem arzela_ascoli:
  fixes s :: "'b::metric_space set"
    and A :: "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow>\<^sub>C 'b) set"
  assumes compact_domain: "compact (UNIV :: 'a set)"
    and compact_range: "compact s"
    and range_subset: "\<And>f x. f \<in> A \<Longrightarrow> f x \<in> s"
    and equicontinuous: "q1477053_equicontinuous A"
  shows "compact (closure A)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1477053
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1477053), "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": an
  equicontinuous family of bounded continuous functions from a compact
  topological space into a metric space, with values in a common compact set,
  has compact closure in the uniform-convergence topology. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q1477053_ARZEL_ASCOLI_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology =
     \(domain:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
       opens {} /\
       opens domain /\
       (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> u SUBSET domain) /\
       (!family:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!u:A->bool. u IN family ==> opens u)
          ==> opens (UNIONS family)) /\
       (!u v:A->bool.
          opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v)) in
   let compact_topological_space =
     \(domain:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
       !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> opens u) /\
         domain SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?finite_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
               finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE finite_cover /\
               domain SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let is_metric =
     \(codomain:B->bool) (d:B->B->real).
       (!x y:B.
          x IN codomain /\ y IN codomain
          ==> &0 <= d x y) /\
       (!x y:B.
          x IN codomain /\ y IN codomain
          ==> (d x y = &0 <=> x = y)) /\
       (!x y:B.
          x IN codomain /\ y IN codomain
          ==> d x y = d y x) /\
       (!x y z:B.
          x IN codomain /\ y IN codomain /\ z IN codomain
          ==> d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let metric_open =
     \(codomain:B->bool) (d:B->B->real) (u:B->bool).
       u SUBSET codomain /\
       !x:B.
         x IN u
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:B.
                 y IN codomain /\ d y x < epsilon
                 ==> y IN u in
   let compact_metric_subset =
     \(codomain:B->bool) (d:B->B->real) (s:B->bool).
       s SUBSET codomain /\
       !cover:(B->bool)->bool.
         (!u:B->bool. u IN cover ==> metric_open codomain d u) /\
         s SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?finite_cover:(B->bool)->bool.
               finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE finite_cover /\
               s SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let continuous_into_metric =
     \(domain:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
      (codomain:B->bool) (d:B->B->real) (f:A->B).
       (!x:A. x IN domain ==> f x IN codomain) /\
       !v:B->bool.
         metric_open codomain d v
         ==> opens {x:A | x IN domain /\ f x IN v} in
   let bounded_continuous =
     \(domain:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
      (codomain:B->bool) (d:B->B->real) (f:A->B).
       continuous_into_metric domain opens codomain d f /\
       ?bound:real.
         &0 <= bound /\
         !x y:A.
           x IN domain /\ y IN domain
           ==> d (f x) (f y) <= bound in
   let uniformly_close =
     \(domain:A->bool) (d:B->B->real)
      (epsilon:real) (f:A->B) (g:A->B).
       !x:A. x IN domain ==> d (f x) (g x) < epsilon in
   let uniform_open =
     \(domain:A->bool) (bcf:(A->B)->bool)
      (d:B->B->real) (u:(A->B)->bool).
       u SUBSET bcf /\
       !f:A->B.
         f IN u
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !g:A->B.
                 g IN bcf /\
                 uniformly_close domain d epsilon f g
                 ==> g IN u in
   let uniform_closure =
     \(domain:A->bool) (bcf:(A->B)->bool)
      (d:B->B->real) (family:(A->B)->bool).
       {f:A->B |
          f IN bcf /\
          !epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?g:A->B.
                  g IN family /\
                  uniformly_close domain d epsilon f g} in
   let compact_uniform_subset =
     \(domain:A->bool) (bcf:(A->B)->bool)
      (d:B->B->real) (compact_set:(A->B)->bool).
       compact_set SUBSET bcf /\
       !cover:((A->B)->bool)->bool.
         (!u:(A->B)->bool.
            u IN cover ==> uniform_open domain bcf d u) /\
         compact_set SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?finite_cover:((A->B)->bool)->bool.
               finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE finite_cover /\
               compact_set SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let equicontinuous =
     \(domain:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
      (d:B->B->real) (family:(A->B)->bool).
       !x:A.
         x IN domain
         ==> !epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon
               ==> ?u:A->bool.
                     opens u /\
                     x IN u /\
                     !f:A->B.
                       f IN family
                       ==> !y:A.
                             y IN u
                             ==> d (f y) (f x) < epsilon in
   !domain:A->bool.
   !codomain:B->bool.
   !opens:(A->bool)->bool.
   !d:B->B->real.
   !s:B->bool.
   !family:(A->B)->bool.
     let bcf =
       {f:A->B |
          bounded_continuous domain opens codomain d f} in
     is_topology domain opens /\
     compact_topological_space domain opens /\
     is_metric codomain d /\
     compact_metric_subset codomain d s /\
     family SUBSET bcf /\
     (!f:A->B.
        f IN family
        ==> !x:A. x IN domain ==> f x IN s) /\
     equicontinuous domain opens d family
     ==> compact_uniform_subset domain bcf d
           (uniform_closure domain bcf d family)`;;

title: Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1477053,
;; "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": the closure of a pointwise equicontinuous family
;; of bounded continuous maps from a compact space, with range in a compact
;; subset of a metric space, is compact for uniform convergence. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, sets, families, and maps are ACL2 objects interpreted
;; by conservative application interfaces. Distances are represented exactly
;; by rounded rational upper cuts: DISTANCE-LT(x,y,q) means d(x,y) < q.
;; Thus metric values remain arbitrary finite nonnegative reals. DEFUN-SK
;; keeps all points, sets, covers, functions, radii, and finite subcovers in
;; their source quantifier scopes.

(defstub q1477053-member-p (collection object) t)

(defstub q1477053-value (function object) t)

(defstub q1477053-distance-lt-p (distance left right radius) t)

(defun q1477053-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and (rationalp value)
       (< 0 value)))

;; Extensional subsets and arbitrary families of subsets.

(defun-sk q1477053-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p set x)
     (q1477053-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q1477053-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (q1477053-set-contained-p carrier set))

(defun-sk q1477053-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p left x)
      (q1477053-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q1477053-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p family left)
      (q1477053-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p family set)
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q1477053-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (q1477053-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q1477053-family-members-valid-p carrier family)))

;; A general topology on the source carrier.

(defun q1477053-open-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1477053-member-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q1477053-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p family set)
     (q1477053-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1477053-empty-representation-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
     (not (q1477053-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-full-representation-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
     (q1477053-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1477053-intersection-representation-p
    (carrier left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p intersection x)
      (and
       (q1477053-member-p left x)
       (q1477053-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q1477053-union-member-p (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1477053-member-p family set)
     (q1477053-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1477053-union-representation-p
    (carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p union x)
      (q1477053-union-member-p carrier family x)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-empty-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1477053-empty-representation-p carrier set)
     (q1477053-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1477053-full-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1477053-full-representation-p carrier set)
     (q1477053-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q1477053-intersection-open-exists-p
    (carrier topology left right)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier intersection)
     (q1477053-intersection-representation-p
      carrier left right intersection)
     (q1477053-open-set-p
      carrier topology intersection))))

(defun-sk q1477053-union-open-exists-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier union)
     (q1477053-union-representation-p
      carrier family union)
     (q1477053-open-set-p carrier topology union))))

(defun-sk q1477053-topology-closure-laws-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right family)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1477053-open-set-p carrier topology left)
       (q1477053-open-set-p carrier topology right))
      (q1477053-intersection-open-exists-p
       carrier topology left right))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1477053-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
       (q1477053-family-members-open-p
        carrier topology family))
      (q1477053-union-open-exists-p
       carrier topology family)))))

(defun q1477053-topological-space-p (carrier topology)
  (and
   (q1477053-family-of-sets-p carrier topology)
   (q1477053-empty-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q1477053-full-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q1477053-topology-closure-laws-p carrier topology)))

;; Compactness in an arbitrary topology, by unrestricted open covers.

(defun-sk q1477053-cover-point-p (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q1477053-member-p family set)
     (q1477053-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q1477053-cover-p (carrier set family)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
      (q1477053-member-p set x))
     (q1477053-cover-point-p carrier family x))))

(defun q1477053-finite-subcover-elements-p
    (sets carrier family)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier (car sets))
       (q1477053-member-p family (car sets))
       (q1477053-finite-subcover-elements-p
        (cdr sets) carrier family))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun q1477053-finite-subcover-point-p (sets x)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q1477053-member-p (car sets) x)
       (q1477053-finite-subcover-point-p (cdr sets) x))
    nil))

(defun-sk q1477053-finite-subcover-covers-p
    (carrier set sets)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
      (q1477053-member-p set x))
     (q1477053-finite-subcover-point-p sets x))))

(defun q1477053-finite-subcover-p
    (sets carrier set family)
  (and
   (true-listp sets)
   (q1477053-finite-subcover-elements-p
    sets carrier family)
   (q1477053-finite-subcover-covers-p
    carrier set sets)))

(defun-sk q1477053-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (carrier set family)
  (exists (sets)
    (q1477053-finite-subcover-p
     sets carrier set family)))

(defun-sk q1477053-compact-cover-law-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q1477053-family-members-open-p
       carrier topology family)
      (q1477053-cover-p carrier set family))
     (q1477053-finite-subcover-exists-p
      carrier set family))))

(defun q1477053-compact-set-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1477053-compact-cover-law-p
    carrier topology set)))

;; Exact finite real-valued metrics via rounded rational upper cuts. The
;; separation clause is the ACL2 form of PseudoMetricSpace plus T2Space.

(defun-sk q1477053-distance-finite-p
    (distance left right)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1477053-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q1477053-distance-lt-p
      distance left right radius))))

(defun-sk q1477053-distance-rounded-p
    (distance left right radius)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q1477053-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (rationalp radius)
     (< smaller radius)
     (q1477053-distance-lt-p
      distance left right smaller))))

(defun-sk q1477053-positive-distance-p
    (distance left right)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1477053-positive-rational-p radius)
     (not
      (q1477053-distance-lt-p
       distance left right radius)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-metric-laws-p
    (carrier distance)
  (forall (x y z q r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p carrier x)
      (q1477053-member-p carrier y)
      (q1477053-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (implies
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q1477053-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x y r))
      (implies
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q1477053-distance-rounded-p
        distance x y q))
      (q1477053-distance-finite-p distance x y)
      (iff
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance y x q))
      (iff
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x x q)
       (q1477053-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (not (equal x y))
       (q1477053-positive-distance-p distance x y))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1477053-positive-rational-p r)
        (q1477053-positive-rational-p s)
        (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance x y r)
        (q1477053-distance-lt-p distance y z s))
       (q1477053-distance-lt-p
        distance x z (+ r s)))))))

(defun q1477053-metric-space-p (carrier distance)
  (q1477053-metric-laws-p carrier distance))

;; The topology induced by the metric, and compact metric subsets.

(defun-sk q1477053-metric-ball-subset-p
    (carrier distance center radius set)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p carrier point)
      (q1477053-distance-lt-p
       distance center point radius))
     (q1477053-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q1477053-metric-open-radius-exists-p
    (carrier distance set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1477053-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q1477053-metric-ball-subset-p
      carrier distance center radius set))))

(defun-sk q1477053-metric-open-law-p
    (carrier distance set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p carrier center)
      (q1477053-member-p set center))
     (q1477053-metric-open-radius-exists-p
      carrier distance set center))))

(defun q1477053-metric-open-set-p
    (carrier distance set)
  (and
   (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1477053-metric-open-law-p
    carrier distance set)))

(defun-sk q1477053-family-members-metric-open-p
    (carrier distance family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p family set)
     (q1477053-metric-open-set-p
      carrier distance set))))

(defun-sk q1477053-metric-compact-cover-law-p
    (carrier distance set)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q1477053-family-members-metric-open-p
       carrier distance family)
      (q1477053-cover-p carrier set family))
     (q1477053-finite-subcover-exists-p
      carrier set family))))

(defun q1477053-metric-compact-set-p
    (carrier distance set)
  (and
   (q1477053-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q1477053-metric-compact-cover-law-p
    carrier distance set)))

;; Continuous maps from the source topology to the metric codomain.

(defun-sk q1477053-map-into-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier mapping)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p source-carrier x)
     (q1477053-member-p
      target-carrier
      (q1477053-value mapping x)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-preimage-representation-p
    (source-carrier mapping target-set source-set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p source-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p source-set x)
      (q1477053-member-p
       target-set
       (q1477053-value mapping x))))))

(defun-sk q1477053-open-preimage-exists-p
    (source-carrier source-topology mapping target-set)
  (exists (source-set)
    (and
     (q1477053-valid-set-p source-carrier source-set)
     (q1477053-preimage-representation-p
      source-carrier mapping target-set source-set)
     (q1477053-open-set-p
      source-carrier source-topology source-set))))

(defun-sk q1477053-continuity-law-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance mapping)
  (forall (target-set)
    (implies
     (q1477053-metric-open-set-p
      target-carrier target-distance target-set)
     (q1477053-open-preimage-exists-p
      source-carrier source-topology
      mapping target-set))))

(defun q1477053-continuous-map-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance mapping)
  (and
   (q1477053-map-into-p
    source-carrier target-carrier mapping)
   (q1477053-continuity-law-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-distance mapping)))

(defun-sk q1477053-map-equiv-p
    (source-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p source-carrier x)
     (equal
      (q1477053-value left x)
      (q1477053-value right x)))))

;; Sets of bounded continuous functions. On the compact source, every
;; continuous metric-valued map is bounded, so this is the same collection
;; of functions as the bundled type in the Lean source.

(defun-sk q1477053-function-set-contained-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance set)
  (forall (mapping)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p set mapping)
     (q1477053-continuous-map-p
      source-carrier source-topology
      target-carrier target-distance mapping))))

(defun-sk q1477053-function-set-extensional-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance set)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-continuous-map-p
       source-carrier source-topology
       target-carrier target-distance left)
      (q1477053-continuous-map-p
       source-carrier source-topology
       target-carrier target-distance right)
      (q1477053-map-equiv-p source-carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p set left)
      (q1477053-member-p set right)))))

(defun q1477053-valid-function-set-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance set)
  (and
   (q1477053-function-set-contained-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-distance set)
   (q1477053-function-set-extensional-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-distance set)))

(defun-sk q1477053-function-set-equiv-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance left right)
  (forall (mapping)
    (implies
     (q1477053-continuous-map-p
      source-carrier source-topology
      target-carrier target-distance mapping)
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p left mapping)
      (q1477053-member-p right mapping)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-function-family-extensional-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-valid-function-set-p
       source-carrier source-topology
       target-carrier target-distance left)
      (q1477053-valid-function-set-p
       source-carrier source-topology
       target-carrier target-distance right)
      (q1477053-function-set-equiv-p
       source-carrier source-topology
       target-carrier target-distance left right))
     (iff
      (q1477053-member-p family left)
      (q1477053-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q1477053-function-family-members-valid-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p family set)
     (q1477053-valid-function-set-p
      source-carrier source-topology
      target-carrier target-distance set))))

(defun q1477053-function-family-of-sets-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance family)
  (and
   (q1477053-function-family-extensional-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-distance family)
   (q1477053-function-family-members-valid-p
    source-carrier source-topology
    target-carrier target-distance family)))

;; Pointwise equicontinuity and the common compact range.

(defun-sk q1477053-equicontinuity-neighborhood-law-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-distance family center radius neighborhood)
  (forall (mapping point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p family mapping)
      (q1477053-member-p source-carrier point)
      (q1477053-member-p neighborhood point))
     (q1477053-distance-lt-p
      target-distance
      (q1477053-value mapping point)
      (q1477053-value mapping center)
      radius))))

(defun-sk q1477053-equicontinuity-neighborhood-exists-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-distance family center radius)
  (exists (neighborhood)
    (and
     (q1477053-open-set-p
      source-carrier source-topology neighborhood)
     (q1477053-member-p neighborhood center)
     (q1477053-equicontinuity-neighborhood-law-p
      source-carrier source-topology target-distance
      family center radius neighborhood))))

(defun-sk q1477053-equicontinuous-p
    (source-carrier source-topology target-distance family)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p source-carrier center)
      (q1477053-positive-rational-p radius))
     (q1477053-equicontinuity-neighborhood-exists-p
      source-carrier source-topology target-distance
      family center radius))))

(defun-sk q1477053-family-range-in-set-p
    (source-carrier family target-set)
  (forall (mapping x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1477053-member-p family mapping)
      (q1477053-member-p source-carrier x))
     (q1477053-member-p
      target-set
      (q1477053-value mapping x)))))

;; Uniform convergence. The strict upper cut of the supremum distance is
;; expressed by a rational bound strictly below the requested radius.

(defun-sk q1477053-uniform-bound-p
    (source-carrier target-distance left right bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1477053-member-p source-carrier x)
     (q1477053-distance-lt-p
      target-distance
      (q1477053-value left x)
      (q1477053-value right x)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1477053-uniform-distance-lt-p
    (source-carrier target-distance left right radius)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1477053-positive-rational-p bound)
     (rationalp radius)
     (< bound radius)
     (q1477053-uniform-bound-p
      source-carrier target-distance
      left right bound))))

(defun-sk q1477053-uniform-ball-subset-p
    (source-carrier source-topology
     target-carrier target-distance set center radius)
  (forall (mapping)

title: Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1477053,
-- "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": the uniform closure of a pointwise equicontinuous
-- family of bounded continuous maps from a compact space into a Hausdorff
-- pseudometric space is compact when all values lie in one compact subset.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field presents the real line used by
-- Mathlib's real-valued pseudometric spaces.
record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set r

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Σ Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Σ R P ->
      Σ R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Σ R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

StrictLess :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set r
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  Set r
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

Predicate :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Predicate {p = p} X =
  X -> Set p

Whole :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Predicate {p = p} X
Whole _ =
  Top

record NeighborhoodRefinement
  {a p : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  (near : X -> Predicate {p = p} X -> Set p)
  (x : X)
  (U : Predicate {p = p} X) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p) where

  field
    refinement :
      Predicate {p = p} X

    refinement-near :
      near x refinement

    refinement-stays-near :
      (y : X) ->
      refinement y ->
      near y U

record TopologicalSpace
  {a p : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p) where

  field
    neighborhood :
      X ->
      Predicate {p = p} X ->
      Set p

    neighborhood-contains :
      (x : X) ->
      (U : Predicate {p = p} X) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      U x

    neighborhood-whole :
      (x : X) ->
      neighborhood x Whole

    neighborhood-upward :
      (x : X) ->
      (U V : Predicate {p = p} X) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      ((y : X) -> U y -> V y) ->
      neighborhood x V

    neighborhood-intersection :
      (x : X) ->
      (U V : Predicate {p = p} X) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      neighborhood x V ->
      neighborhood x
        (\ y ->
          Both (U y) (V y))

    neighborhood-local :
      (x : X) ->
      (U : Predicate {p = p} X) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      NeighborhoodRefinement neighborhood x U

open TopologicalSpace

IsOpen :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = p} X ->
  Predicate {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ p)
IsOpen {X = X} topology U =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  neighborhood topology x U

Covers :
  {a p i : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  Predicate {p = p} X ->
  (I -> Predicate {p = p} X) ->
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ i)
Covers {X = X} {I = I} U sets =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Σ I
    (\ index ->
      sets index x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a p i : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  Predicate {p = p} X ->
  (I -> Predicate {p = p} X) ->
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ i)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} {I = I} U sets =
  Σ (List I)
    (\ selected ->
      (x : X) ->
      U x ->
      Σ I
        (\ index ->
          Both
            (Member index selected)
            (sets index x)))

CompactFor :
  {a p o : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  (Predicate {p = p} X -> Set o) ->
  Predicate {p = p} X ->
  Setω
CompactFor {a = a} {p = p} {X = X} Open U =
  (i : Level) ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (sets : I -> Predicate {p = p} X) ->
  ((index : I) ->
    Open (sets index)) ->
  Covers {a = a} {p = p} {i = i} U sets ->
  FiniteSubcover {a = a} {p = p} {i = i} U sets

CompactSpace :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = p} X ->
  Setω
CompactSpace topology =
  CompactFor (IsOpen topology) Whole

record PseudoMetricSpace
  {r y : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (Y : Set y) :
  Set (r ⊔ y) where

  field
    distance :
      Y ->
      Y ->
      R

    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : Y) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (distance x y)

    distance-self :
      (x : Y) ->
      distance x x == zeroR reals

    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : Y) ->
      distance x y == distance y x

    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : Y) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance x z)
        (addR reals (distance x y) (distance y z))

open PseudoMetricSpace

HausdorffPseudoMetric :
  {r y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  Set (r ⊔ y)
HausdorffPseudoMetric {reals = reals} metric =
  (x y : _) ->
  distance metric x y == zeroR reals ->
  x == y

MetricOpen :
  {r y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  Predicate {p = r} Y ->
  Set (r ⊔ y)
MetricOpen {R = R} {Y = Y} reals metric U =
  (center : Y) ->
  U center ->
  Σ R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((point : Y) ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distance metric point center)
            radius ->
          U point))

MetricCompact :
  {r y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace reals Y) ->
  Predicate {p = r} Y ->
  Setω
MetricCompact reals metric U =
  CompactFor (MetricOpen reals metric) U

ContinuousToMetric :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = r} X ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
ContinuousToMetric {R = R} {X = X} reals source metric f =
  (x : X) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  neighborhood source x
    (\ y ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distance metric (f y) (f x))
        epsilon)

BoundedRange :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
BoundedRange {R = R} {X = X} reals metric f =
  Σ R
    (\ bound ->
      (x y : X) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance metric (f x) (f y))
        bound)

BoundedContinuous :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = r} X ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
BoundedContinuous reals source metric f =
  Both
    (ContinuousToMetric reals source metric f)
    (BoundedRange reals metric f)

Equicontinuous :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = r} X ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  Predicate {a = x ⊔ y} {p = r ⊔ x ⊔ y} (X -> Y) ->
  Set (x ⊔ y ⊔ lsuc r)
Equicontinuous
  {r = r} {R = R} {X = X}
  reals source metric family =
  (x : X) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Σ (Predicate {p = r} X)
    (\ U ->
      Both
        (neighborhood source x U)
        ((f : X -> _) ->
          family f ->
          (y z : X) ->
          U y ->
          U z ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distance metric (f y) (f z))
            epsilon))

UniformClose :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  R ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x)
UniformClose {R = R} {X = X} reals metric epsilon f g =
  Σ R
    (\ margin ->
      Both
        (Positive reals margin)
        ((x : X) ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (addR reals
              (distance metric (f x) (g x))
              margin)
            epsilon))

UniformOpen :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = r} X ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  Predicate {a = x ⊔ y} {p = r ⊔ x ⊔ y} (X -> Y) ->
  Set (r ⊔ x ⊔ y)
UniformOpen {R = R} {X = X}
  reals source metric U =
  (f : X -> _) ->
  U f ->
  Both
    (BoundedContinuous reals source metric f)
    (Σ R
      (\ epsilon ->
        Both
          (Positive reals epsilon)
          ((g : X -> _) ->
            BoundedContinuous reals source metric g ->
            UniformClose reals metric epsilon f g ->
            U g)))

UniformClosure :
  {r x y : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set x} ->
  {Y : Set y} ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  TopologicalSpace {p = r} X ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals Y ->
  Predicate {a = x ⊔ y} {p = r ⊔ x ⊔ y} (X -> Y) ->
  Predicate {a = x ⊔ y} {p = r ⊔ x ⊔ y} (X -> Y)
UniformClosure {R = R} {X = X}
  reals source metric family f =
  Both
    (BoundedContinuous reals source metric f)
    ((epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Σ (X -> _)
        (\ g ->
          Both
            (family g)
            (UniformClose reals metric epsilon f g)))

arzela-ascoli-theorem : Setω
arzela-ascoli-theorem =
  (r x y : Level) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (X : Set x) ->
  (source : TopologicalSpace {p = r} X) ->
  CompactSpace source ->
  (Y : Set y) ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace reals Y) ->
  HausdorffPseudoMetric metric ->
  (compactRange : Predicate {p = r} Y) ->
  MetricCompact reals metric compactRange ->
  (family :
    Predicate {a = x ⊔ y} {p = r ⊔ x ⊔ y} (X -> Y)) ->
  ((f : X -> Y) ->
    family f ->
    BoundedContinuous reals source metric f) ->
  ((f : X -> Y) ->
    (point : X) ->
    family f ->
    compactRange (f point)) ->
  Equicontinuous reals source metric family ->
  CompactFor
    (UniformOpen reals source metric)
    (UniformClosure reals source metric family)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1477053 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1477053), "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem":
  a pointwise equicontinuous family of bounded continuous functions from a
  compact space, with values in a common compact metric subset, has compact
  uniform closure. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory realTheory;

val q1477053_metric_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_metric_def",
  ``q1477053_metric (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real) <=>
      (!x. dist x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. 0 <= dist x y) /\
      (!x y. dist x y = dist y x) /\
      (!x y. (dist x y = 0) <=> (x = y)) /\
      (!x y z. dist x z <= dist x y + dist y z)``);

val q1477053_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_continuous_def",
  ``q1477053_continuous
      (top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>

        ?u.

val q1477053_bounded_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_bounded_def",

val q1477053_bounded_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_bounded_continuous_def",
  ``q1477053_bounded_continuous
      (top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      q1477053_continuous top dist f /\
      q1477053_bounded dist f``);

val q1477053_metric_open_in_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_metric_open_in_def",
  ``q1477053_metric_open_in
      (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real) (s : 'b set) (u : 'b set) <=>
      u SUBSET s /\
      !x.
        x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            y IN s /\ dist y x < epsilon
            ==>
            y IN u``);

val q1477053_metric_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_metric_compact_def",
  ``q1477053_metric_compact
      (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real) (s : 'b set) <=>
      !cover : ('b set) set.
        (!u. u IN cover ==> q1477053_metric_open_in dist s u) /\
        s SUBSET BIGUNION cover
        ==>
        ?subcover : ('b set) set.
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          FINITE subcover /\
          s SUBSET BIGUNION subcover``);

val q1477053_equicontinuous_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_equicontinuous_def",
  ``q1477053_equicontinuous
      (top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (A : ('a -> 'b) set) <=>
      !x epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?u.
          open_in top u /\
          x IN u /\
          !f y.
            f IN A /\ y IN u
            ==>
            dist (f y) (f x) < epsilon``);

val q1477053_uniform_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_uniform_open_def",
  ``q1477053_uniform_open
      (top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (u : ('a -> 'b) set) <=>
      u SUBSET
        {f | q1477053_bounded_continuous top dist f} /\
      !f.
        f IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !g.
            q1477053_bounded_continuous top dist g /\
            (!x. dist (g x) (f x) < epsilon)
            ==>
            g IN u``);

val q1477053_uniform_closure_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_uniform_closure_def",
  ``q1477053_uniform_closure
      (top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (A : ('a -> 'b) set) =
      {f |
        q1477053_bounded_continuous top dist f /\
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?g.
            g IN A /\
            !x. dist (f x) (g x) < epsilon}``);

val q1477053_uniformly_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q1477053_uniformly_compact_def",
  ``q1477053_uniformly_compact
      (top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (function_set : ('a -> 'b) set) <=>
      !cover : (('a -> 'b) set) set.

        function_set SUBSET BIGUNION cover
        ==>
        ?subcover : (('a -> 'b) set) set.
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          FINITE subcover /\
          function_set SUBSET BIGUNION subcover``);

val BoundedContinuousFunction_arzela_ascoli =
  ``!(top : 'a topology) (dist : 'b -> 'b -> real)
      (s : 'b set) (A : ('a -> 'b) set).
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      compact_in top UNIV /\
      q1477053_metric dist /\
      q1477053_metric_compact dist s /\
      (!f.
        f IN A
        ==>
        q1477053_bounded_continuous top dist f) /\
      (!f x. f IN A ==> f x IN s) /\
      q1477053_equicontinuous top dist A
      ==>
      q1477053_uniformly_compact top dist
        (q1477053_uniform_closure top dist A)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1477053
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1477053),
  "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": for a compact source and a Hausdorff
  pseudometric target, an equicontinuous family of bounded continuous
  functions whose values lie in a fixed compact subset has compact closure in
  the uniform topology. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1477053MetricTopology D is the topology generated by the open balls of the
  real-valued pseudometric D. Q1477053BCF J B D is the full set of bounded
  continuous functions from the carrier of J to B. Boundedness is expressed
  by a common real upper bound on all pairwise distances in the range, which
  is equivalent to bounded range in a pseudometric space.

  Q1477053UniformMetric J B D is the supremum distance on those bounded
  continuous functions; adjoining zero makes the empty-source supremum zero.
  Q1477053UniformTopology J B D is its ball-generated topology.
  Q1477053Equicontinuous J D A is pointwise equicontinuity of the family A,
  written in the positive-radius neighborhood form.

  In the final assertion, J is an arbitrary compact topology, D is an
  arbitrary real-valued pseudometric on B whose induced topology is Hausdorff,
  s is an arbitrary compact subset of B, and A is an arbitrary subset of the
  bounded continuous-function space. The range and equicontinuity hypotheses
  imply that the closure of A in the uniform topology is compact.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1477053MetricTopology Q1477053BCF Q1477053UniformMetric
   Q1477053UniformTopology Q1477053Equicontinuous $.

q1477053-metric-topology-syntax
  $a class ( Q1477053MetricTopology D ) $.
q1477053-bcf-syntax
  $a class ( Q1477053BCF J B D ) $.
q1477053-uniform-metric-syntax
  $a class ( Q1477053UniformMetric J B D ) $.
q1477053-uniform-topology-syntax
  $a class ( Q1477053UniformTopology J B D ) $.
q1477053-equicontinuous-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1477053Equicontinuous J D A ) $.

${
  q1477053-metric-topology-definition $a |- (
    Q1477053MetricTopology D
  ) = (
    topGen ` ran ( ball ` D )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B D J c f x y $.

  q1477053-bcf-definition $a |- (
    Q1477053BCF J B D
  ) = {
    f e. ( B ^m U. J ) |
    (
      f e. ( J Cn ( Q1477053MetricTopology D ) )
      /\
      E. c e. RR
        A. x e. U. J
          A. y e. U. J
            (
              ( ( f ` x ) D ( f ` y ) )
              <_
              c
            )
    )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d B D J f g x $.

  q1477053-uniform-metric-definition $a |- (
    Q1477053UniformMetric J B D
  ) = (
    f e. ( Q1477053BCF J B D ) ,
    g e. ( Q1477053BCF J B D ) |->
    sup (
      (
        ran (
          x e. U. J |->
          ( ( f ` x ) D ( g ` x ) )
        )
        u.
        { 0 }
      )
      ,
      RR
      ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B D J $.

  q1477053-uniform-topology-definition $a |- (
    Q1477053UniformTopology J B D
  ) = (
    topGen `
    ran (
      ball `
      ( Q1477053UniformMetric J B D )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A D J e f u x y $.

  q1477053-equicontinuous-definition $a |- (
    Q1477053Equicontinuous J D A
  ) <->
  A. x e. U. J
    A. e e. RR+
      E. u e. J
        (
          x e. u
          /\
          A. y e. u
            A. f e. A
              (
                ( ( f ` y ) D ( f ` x ) )
                <
                e
              )
        )
  $.
$}

${
  $d a b d f j s x $.

  thousand-theorems-q1477053-arzel-ascoli $a |-
    A. j A. b A. d A. s A. a
      (
        (
          j e. Comp
          /\
          d e. ( PsMet ` b )
          /\
          ran d C_ RR
          /\
          ( Q1477053MetricTopology d ) e. Haus
          /\
          s C_ b
          /\
          (
            ( Q1477053MetricTopology d )
            |`t
            s
          ) e. Comp
          /\
          a C_ ( Q1477053BCF j b d )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            A. f e. a
              A. x e. U. j
                ( f ` x ) e. s
          )
          /\
          ( Q1477053Equicontinuous j d a )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( Q1477053UniformTopology j b d )
          |`t
          (
            (
              cls `
              ( Q1477053UniformTopology j b d )
            )
            `
            a
          )
        ) e. Comp
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q1477053_arzel_ascoli_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1477053,
% "Arzelà–Ascoli theorem": a pointwise equicontinuous family of bounded
% continuous functions from a compact space into a separated pseudometric
% space, with range in a compact set, has compact closure in the uniform
% topology. This file contains no proof.

arzela_ascoli_theorem_Q1477053[
  X: TYPE,
  Y: TYPE,
  open_x: [[X -> bool] -> bool],
  distance_y: [Y, Y -> real],
  s: [Y -> bool],
  A: [[X -> Y] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  x_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  x_set_family: TYPE = [x_set -> bool]
  x_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> x_set]

  y_set: TYPE = [Y -> bool]
  y_set_family: TYPE = [y_set -> bool]
  y_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> y_set]

  map_xy: TYPE = [X -> Y]
  map_set: TYPE = [map_xy -> bool]
  map_set_family: TYPE = [map_set -> bool]
  map_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> map_set]

  empty_x_set: x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  whole_x_set: x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE

  x_intersection(U, V: x_set): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      U(x) AND V(x)

  x_union(F: x_set_family): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (U: x_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  x_subset(U, V: x_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      U(x) IMPLIES V(x)

  x_topology_laws: bool =
    open_x(empty_x_set)
      AND open_x(whole_x_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (U, V: x_set):
          (open_x(U) AND open_x(V))
            IMPLIES open_x(x_intersection(U, V)))
      AND
        (FORALL (F: x_set_family):
          (FORALL (U: x_set):
            F(U) IMPLIES open_x(U))
          IMPLIES open_x(x_union(F)))

  x_open_cover(C: x_set_family, K: x_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: x_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES open_x(U))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: X):
          K(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (U: x_set):
              C(U) AND U(x))

  x_compact(K: x_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: x_set_family):
      x_open_cover(C, K)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (count: nat),
              (chosen: x_set_sequence):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < count IMPLIES C(chosen(index)))
              AND
                (FORALL (x: X):
                  K(x) IMPLIES
                    EXISTS (index: nat):
                      index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  separated_pseudometric_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (y, z: Y):
      0 <= distance_y(y, z))
      AND
        (FORALL (y: Y):
          distance_y(y, y) = 0)
      AND
        (FORALL (y, z: Y):
          distance_y(y, z) = distance_y(z, y))
      AND
        (FORALL (x, y, z: Y):
          distance_y(x, z)
            <= distance_y(x, y) + distance_y(y, z))
      AND
        (FORALL (y, z: Y):
          distance_y(y, z) = 0 IMPLIES y = z)

  y_open(U: y_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: Y):
      U(y)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (z: Y):
              distance_y(y, z) < radius IMPLIES U(z)

  y_open_cover(C: y_set_family, K: y_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: y_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES y_open(U))
      AND
        (FORALL (y: Y):
          K(y) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (U: y_set):
              C(U) AND U(y))

  y_compact(K: y_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: y_set_family):
      y_open_cover(C, K)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (count: nat),
              (chosen: y_set_sequence):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < count IMPLIES C(chosen(index)))
              AND
                (FORALL (y: Y):
                  K(y) IMPLIES
                    EXISTS (index: nat):
                      index < count AND chosen(index)(y))

  preimage(f: map_xy, U: y_set): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      U(f(x))

  continuous_map(f: map_xy): bool =
    FORALL (U: y_set):
      y_open(U) IMPLIES open_x(preimage(f, U))

  bounded_map(f: map_xy): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      0 <= bound
        AND
          FORALL (x, z: X):
            distance_y(f(x), f(z)) <= bound

  bounded_continuous_map(f: map_xy): bool =
    bounded_map(f) AND continuous_map(f)

  all_bounded_continuous_maps: map_set =
    LAMBDA (f: map_xy):
      bounded_continuous_map(f)

  map_subset(B, C: map_set): bool =
    FORALL (f: map_xy):
      B(f) IMPLIES C(f)

  uniform_ball(
      center: map_xy,
      radius: posreal): map_set =
    LAMBDA (f: map_xy):
      bounded_continuous_map(f)
        AND
          EXISTS (uniform_bound: real):
            0 <= uniform_bound
              AND uniform_bound < radius
              AND
                FORALL (x: X):
                  distance_y(center(x), f(x)) <= uniform_bound

  map_open(U: map_set): bool =
    map_subset(U, all_bounded_continuous_maps)
      AND
        FORALL (f: map_xy):
          U(f)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (radius: posreal):
                map_subset(
                  uniform_ball(f, radius),
                  U)

  map_complement(U: map_set): map_set =
    LAMBDA (f: map_xy):
      bounded_continuous_map(f) AND NOT U(f)

  map_closed(C: map_set): bool =
    map_subset(C, all_bounded_continuous_maps)
      AND map_open(map_complement(C))

  map_closure(B: map_set): map_set =
    LAMBDA (f: map_xy):
      bounded_continuous_map(f)
        AND FORALL (C: map_set):
          (map_closed(C) AND map_subset(B, C))
            IMPLIES C(f)

  map_open_cover(C: map_set_family, K: map_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: map_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES map_open(U))
      AND
        (FORALL (f: map_xy):
          K(f) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (U: map_set):
              C(U) AND U(f))

  map_compact(K: map_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: map_set_family):
      map_open_cover(C, K)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (count: nat),
              (chosen: map_set_sequence):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < count IMPLIES C(chosen(index)))
              AND
                (FORALL (f: map_xy):
                  K(f) IMPLIES
                    EXISTS (index: nat):
                      index < count AND chosen(index)(f))

  family_has_range_in_s: bool =
    FORALL (f: map_xy), (x: X):
      A(f) IMPLIES s(f(x))

  pointwise_equicontinuous: bool =
    FORALL (x: X), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (U: x_set):
        open_x(U)
          AND U(x)
          AND
            FORALL (f: map_xy), (y, z: X):
              (A(f) AND U(y) AND U(z))
                IMPLIES
                  distance_y(f(y), f(z)) < epsilon_value

  arzela_ascoli: bool =
    (x_topology_laws
      AND x_compact(whole_x_set)
      AND separated_pseudometric_laws
      AND y_compact(s)
      AND map_subset(A, all_bounded_continuous_maps)
      AND family_has_range_in_s
      AND pointwise_equicontinuous)
    IMPLIES map_compact(map_closure(A))
END arzela_ascoli_theorem_Q1477053

title: Q1506253_euclid_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1506253
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1506253), "Euclid's theorem": for every natural
  number n, there exists a prime natural number p with n <= p. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition q1506253_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Theorem exists_infinite_primes :
  forall n : nat,
    exists p : nat,
      (n <= p)%nat /\ q1506253_prime p.
Admitted.

title: Q1506253_euclid_s_theorem
content:
(*

  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1506253), "Euclid's theorem": for every

theory Q1506253_euclid_s_theorem

begin

  field
    witness : A

AbovePrime : Nat -> Nat -> Set
AbovePrime n p =
  (n <= p) and Prime p

  (n : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat (AbovePrime n)

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1506253,
% "Euclid's theorem": for every natural-number bound, there is a prime
% natural number at least that large. This file contains no proof.

Q1506253_euclid_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  euclid_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      EXISTS (p: nat):
