title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1535225
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1535225), "Łoś' theorem": a first-order sentence
  holds in an ultraproduct exactly when it holds in an ultrafilter-large set
  of the component structures. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1535225_language : Type := {
  q1535225_functions : nat -> Type;
  q1535225_relations : nat -> Type
}.

Inductive q1535225_tuple (A : Type) : nat -> Type :=
| q1535225_tuple_nil : q1535225_tuple A 0
| q1535225_tuple_cons :
    forall n, A -> q1535225_tuple A n -> q1535225_tuple A (S n).

Arguments q1535225_tuple_nil {A}.
Arguments q1535225_tuple_cons {A n} _ _.

Record q1535225_structure
    (L : q1535225_language) (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1535225_function_interpretation :
    forall n,
      q1535225_functions L n ->
      q1535225_tuple A n ->
      A;
  q1535225_relation_interpretation :
    forall n,
      q1535225_relations L n ->
      q1535225_tuple A n ->
      Prop
}.

Arguments q1535225_function_interpretation {L A} _ {n} _ _.
Arguments q1535225_relation_interpretation {L A} _ {n} _ _.

Inductive q1535225_term
    (L : q1535225_language) (variables : nat) : Type :=
| q1535225_variable :
    Fin.t variables ->
    q1535225_term L variables
| q1535225_function :
    forall arity,
      q1535225_functions L arity ->
      q1535225_terms L variables arity ->
      q1535225_term L variables
with q1535225_terms
    (L : q1535225_language) (variables : nat) : nat -> Type :=
| q1535225_terms_nil :
    q1535225_terms L variables 0
| q1535225_terms_cons :
    forall arity,
      q1535225_term L variables ->
      q1535225_terms L variables arity ->
      q1535225_terms L variables (S arity).

Arguments q1535225_variable {L variables} _.
Arguments q1535225_function {L variables arity} _ _.
Arguments q1535225_terms_nil {L variables}.
Arguments q1535225_terms_cons {L variables arity} _ _.

Fixpoint q1535225_term_denote
    {L : q1535225_language}
    {A : Type}
    {variables : nat}
    (M : q1535225_structure L A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (t : q1535225_term L variables) : A :=
  match t with
  | q1535225_variable index => valuation index
  | q1535225_function function_symbol arguments =>
      q1535225_function_interpretation M function_symbol
        (q1535225_terms_denote M valuation arguments)
  end
with q1535225_terms_denote
    {L : q1535225_language}
    {A : Type}
    {variables arity : nat}
    (M : q1535225_structure L A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (ts : q1535225_terms L variables arity) : q1535225_tuple A arity :=
  match ts with
  | q1535225_terms_nil => q1535225_tuple_nil
  | q1535225_terms_cons t rest =>
      q1535225_tuple_cons
        (q1535225_term_denote M valuation t)
        (q1535225_terms_denote M valuation rest)
  end.

Inductive q1535225_formula
    (L : q1535225_language) : nat -> Type :=
| q1535225_equal :
    forall variables,
      q1535225_term L variables ->
      q1535225_term L variables ->
      q1535225_formula L variables
| q1535225_atomic :
    forall variables arity,
      q1535225_relations L arity ->
      q1535225_terms L variables arity ->
      q1535225_formula L variables
| q1535225_falsum :
    forall variables, q1535225_formula L variables
| q1535225_implies :
    forall variables,
      q1535225_formula L variables ->
      q1535225_formula L variables ->
      q1535225_formula L variables
| q1535225_forall :
    forall variables,
      q1535225_formula L (S variables) ->
      q1535225_formula L variables.

Arguments q1535225_equal {L variables} _ _.
Arguments q1535225_atomic {L variables arity} _ _.
Arguments q1535225_falsum {L variables}.
Arguments q1535225_implies {L variables} _ _.
Arguments q1535225_forall {L variables} _.

Definition q1535225_extend_valuation
    {A : Type}
    {variables : nat}
    (x : A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (index : Fin.t (S variables)) : A :=
  Fin.caseS' index (fun _ => A) x valuation.

Fixpoint q1535225_satisfies
    {L : q1535225_language}
    {A : Type}
    {variables : nat}
    (M : q1535225_structure L A)
    (valuation : Fin.t variables -> A)
    (phi : q1535225_formula L variables) : Prop :=
  (match phi in q1535225_formula _ matched_variables
     return (Fin.t matched_variables -> A) -> Prop with
  | q1535225_equal t u =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1535225_term_denote M matched_valuation t =
        q1535225_term_denote M matched_valuation u
  | q1535225_atomic relation_symbol arguments =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1535225_relation_interpretation M relation_symbol
          (q1535225_terms_denote M matched_valuation arguments)
  | q1535225_falsum => fun _ => False
  | q1535225_implies psi chi =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1535225_satisfies M matched_valuation psi ->
        q1535225_satisfies M matched_valuation chi
  | q1535225_forall psi =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        forall x : A,
          q1535225_satisfies M
            (q1535225_extend_valuation x matched_valuation) psi
  end) valuation.

Definition q1535225_sentence
    (L : q1535225_language) : Type :=
  q1535225_formula L 0.

Definition q1535225_empty_valuation
    {A : Type} (index : Fin.t 0) : A :=
  match index with
  end.

Definition q1535225_sentence_satisfies
    {L : q1535225_language}
    {A : Type}
    (M : q1535225_structure L A)
    (phi : q1535225_sentence L) : Prop :=
  q1535225_satisfies M q1535225_empty_valuation phi.

Record q1535225_ultrafilter (I : Type) : Type := {
  q1535225_large : (I -> Prop) -> Prop;
  q1535225_large_universe :
    q1535225_large (fun _ => True);
  q1535225_large_upward :
    forall P Q : I -> Prop,
      (forall i : I, P i -> Q i) ->
      q1535225_large P ->
      q1535225_large Q;
  q1535225_large_intersection :
    forall P Q : I -> Prop,
      q1535225_large P ->
      q1535225_large Q ->
      q1535225_large (fun i => P i /\ Q i);
  q1535225_large_proper :
    ~ q1535225_large (fun _ => False);
  q1535225_large_or_complement :
    forall P : I -> Prop,
      q1535225_large P \/ q1535225_large (fun i => ~ P i)
}.

Arguments q1535225_large {I} _ _.

Definition q1535225_representative
    {I : Type} (A : I -> Type) : Type :=
  forall i : I, A i.

Fixpoint q1535225_ultraproduct_satisfies
    {I : Type}
    {L : q1535225_language}
    {A : I -> Type}
    {variables : nat}
    (M : forall i : I, q1535225_structure L (A i))
    (u : q1535225_ultrafilter I)
    (valuation :
      Fin.t variables -> q1535225_representative A)
    (phi : q1535225_formula L variables) : Prop :=
  (match phi in q1535225_formula _ matched_variables
     return
       (Fin.t matched_variables -> q1535225_representative A) -> Prop
   with
  | q1535225_equal t s =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1535225_large u (fun i =>
          q1535225_term_denote (M i)
            (fun k => matched_valuation k i) t =
          q1535225_term_denote (M i)
            (fun k => matched_valuation k i) s)
  | q1535225_atomic relation_symbol arguments =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1535225_large u (fun i =>
          q1535225_relation_interpretation (M i) relation_symbol
            (q1535225_terms_denote (M i)
              (fun k => matched_valuation k i) arguments))
  | q1535225_falsum => fun _ => False
  | q1535225_implies psi chi =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        q1535225_ultraproduct_satisfies M u matched_valuation psi ->
        q1535225_ultraproduct_satisfies M u matched_valuation chi
  | q1535225_forall psi =>
      fun matched_valuation =>
        forall x : q1535225_representative A,
          q1535225_ultraproduct_satisfies M u
            (q1535225_extend_valuation x matched_valuation) psi
  end) valuation.

Definition q1535225_ultraproduct_sentence_satisfies
    {I : Type}
    {L : q1535225_language}
    {A : I -> Type}
    (M : forall i : I, q1535225_structure L (A i))
    (u : q1535225_ultrafilter I)
    (phi : q1535225_sentence L) : Prop :=
  q1535225_ultraproduct_satisfies
    M u q1535225_empty_valuation phi.

Theorem q1535225_los_theorem :
  forall (I : Type)
         (L : q1535225_language)
         (A : I -> Type)
         (M : forall i : I, q1535225_structure L (A i))
         (u : q1535225_ultrafilter I),
    (forall i : I, inhabited (A i)) ->
    forall phi : q1535225_sentence L,
      q1535225_ultraproduct_sentence_satisfies M u phi <->
      q1535225_large u
        (fun i => q1535225_sentence_satisfies (M i) phi).
Admitted.

title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1535225,
  "Łoś' theorem": a first-order sentence holds in an ultraproduct exactly
  when it holds in almost every factor with respect to the ultrafilter.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1535225_o_theorem
  imports Main
begin

datatype 'f fo_term =
    FOVar nat
  | FOFunc 'f "'f fo_term list"

datatype ('f, 'r) fo_formula =
    FOFalse
  | FOEqual "'f fo_term" "'f fo_term"
  | FORel 'r "'f fo_term list"
  | FOImp "('f, 'r) fo_formula" "('f, 'r) fo_formula"
  | FOAll nat "('f, 'r) fo_formula"

record ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure =
  fo_carrier :: "'a set"
  fo_fun_interp :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  fo_rel_interp :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> bool"

primrec wf_fo_term :: "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_term ar (FOVar n) = True"
| "wf_fo_term ar (FOFunc f ts) =
    (length ts = ar f \<and> list_all (wf_fo_term ar) ts)"

primrec wf_fo_formula ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_formula far rar FOFalse = True"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOEqual s t) =
    (wf_fo_term far s \<and> wf_fo_term far t)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FORel r ts) =
    (length ts = rar r \<and> list_all (wf_fo_term far) ts)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOImp p q) =
    (wf_fo_formula far rar p \<and> wf_fo_formula far rar q)"
| "wf_fo_formula far rar (FOAll n p) = wf_fo_formula far rar p"

primrec free_vars_fo_term :: "'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "free_vars_fo_term (FOVar n) = [n]"
| "free_vars_fo_term (FOFunc f ts) =
    concat (map free_vars_fo_term ts)"

primrec free_vars_fo_formula :: "('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "free_vars_fo_formula FOFalse = []"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FOEqual s t) =
    (free_vars_fo_term s @ free_vars_fo_term t)"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FORel r ts) =
    concat (map free_vars_fo_term ts)"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FOImp p q) =
    (free_vars_fo_formula p @ free_vars_fo_formula q)"
| "free_vars_fo_formula (FOAll n p) =
    filter (\<lambda>m. m \<noteq> n) (free_vars_fo_formula p)"

definition is_fo_sentence ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_fo_sentence far rar p \<longleftrightarrow>
    wf_fo_formula far rar p \<and> free_vars_fo_formula p = []"

definition wf_fo_structure ::
    "('f \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "wf_fo_structure far A \<longleftrightarrow>
    fo_carrier A \<noteq> {} \<and>
    (\<forall>f xs. length xs = far f \<longrightarrow>
      set xs \<subseteq> fo_carrier A \<longrightarrow>
      fo_fun_interp A f xs \<in> fo_carrier A)"

primrec eval_fo_term ::
    "('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      'f fo_term \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "eval_fo_term A v (FOVar n) = v n"
| "eval_fo_term A v (FOFunc f ts) =
    fo_fun_interp A f (map (eval_fo_term A v) ts)"

primrec satisfies_fo ::
    "('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "satisfies_fo A v FOFalse = False"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOEqual s t) =
    (eval_fo_term A v s = eval_fo_term A v t)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FORel r ts) =
    fo_rel_interp A r (map (eval_fo_term A v) ts)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOImp p q) =
    (satisfies_fo A v p \<longrightarrow> satisfies_fo A v q)"
| "satisfies_fo A v (FOAll n p) =
    (\<forall>x\<in>fo_carrier A. satisfies_fo A (v(n := x)) p)"

definition fo_sentence_holds ::
    "('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r) fo_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "fo_sentence_holds A p \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>v. range v \<subseteq> fo_carrier A \<longrightarrow> satisfies_fo A v p)"

definition los_ultrafilter :: "'i set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "los_ultrafilter U \<longleftrightarrow>
    UNIV \<in> U \<and>
    {} \<notin> U \<and>
    (\<forall>A\<in>U. \<forall>B\<in>U. A \<inter> B \<in> U) \<and>
    (\<forall>A B. A \<in> U \<longrightarrow> A \<subseteq> B \<longrightarrow> B \<in> U) \<and>
    (\<forall>A. A \<in> U \<or> - A \<in> U)"

definition los_class ::
    "'i set set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set" where
  "los_class U f = {g. {i. g i = f i} \<in> U}"

definition los_representative ::
    "'i set set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a)" where
  "los_representative U X = (SOME f. los_class U f = X)"

definition los_product_carrier ::
    "'i set set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set set" where
  "los_product_carrier U M =
    {los_class U f | f. \<forall>i. f i \<in> fo_carrier (M i)}"

definition fo_ultraproduct ::
    "'i set set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure) \<Rightarrow>
      ('f, 'r, ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set) fo_structure" where
  "fo_ultraproduct U M =
    \<lparr>fo_carrier = los_product_carrier U M,
      fo_fun_interp = (\<lambda>f Xs.
        los_class U (\<lambda>i.
          fo_fun_interp (M i) f
            (map (\<lambda>X. los_representative U X i) Xs))),
      fo_rel_interp = (\<lambda>r Xs.
        {i. fo_rel_interp (M i) r
          (map (\<lambda>X. los_representative U X i) Xs)} \<in> U)\<rparr>"

theorem los_theorem:
  fixes far :: "'f \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and rar :: "'r \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and U :: "'i set set"
    and M :: "'i \<Rightarrow> ('f, 'r, 'a) fo_structure"
    and p :: "('f, 'r) fo_formula"
  assumes "los_ultrafilter U"
    and "\<forall>i. wf_fo_structure far (M i)"
    and "is_fo_sentence far rar p"
  shows "fo_sentence_holds (fo_ultraproduct U M) p \<longleftrightarrow>
    {i. fo_sentence_holds (M i) p} \<in> U"
  sorry

end

(*

  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1535225), "Łoś' theorem": a first-order
  sentence holds in an ultraproduct exactly when the set of component
  structures in which it holds belongs to the ultrafilter. This file contains

let q1535225_term_INDUCT,q1535225_term_RECURSION = define_type
  "q1535225_term =
       Q1535225_Var num
     | Q1535225_Fun F (q1535225_term list)";;

let q1535225_form_INDUCT,q1535225_form_RECURSION = define_type

     | Q1535225_Exists num q1535225_form";;

let q1535225_term_wellformed = new_recursive_definition
  q1535225_term_RECURSION
  `(q1535225_term_wellformed function_arity (Q1535225_Var x) <=> T) /\
   (q1535225_term_wellformed function_arity
       (Q1535225_Fun f arguments) <=>
      LENGTH arguments = function_arity f /\
      q1535225_term_list_wellformed function_arity arguments) /\
   (q1535225_term_list_wellformed function_arity [] <=> T) /\
   (q1535225_term_list_wellformed function_arity (CONS term rest) <=>
      q1535225_term_wellformed function_arity term /\
      q1535225_term_list_wellformed function_arity rest)`;;

let q1535225_form_wellformed = new_recursive_definition
  q1535225_form_RECURSION
  `(q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1535225_Equal left right) <=>
      q1535225_term_wellformed function_arity left /\
      q1535225_term_wellformed function_arity right) /\
   (q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1535225_Rel relation arguments) <=>
      LENGTH arguments = relation_arity relation /\
      q1535225_term_list_wellformed function_arity arguments) /\
   (q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1535225_Not p) <=>
      q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity p) /\
   (q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1535225_And p q) <=>
      q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity p /\
      q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity q) /\
   (q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity
       (Q1535225_Exists x p) <=>
      q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity p)`;;

let q1535225_term_has_variable = new_recursive_definition
  q1535225_term_RECURSION
  `(q1535225_term_has_variable x (Q1535225_Var y) <=> x = y) /\
   (q1535225_term_has_variable x (Q1535225_Fun f arguments) <=>
      q1535225_term_list_has_variable x arguments) /\
   (q1535225_term_list_has_variable x [] <=> F) /\
   (q1535225_term_list_has_variable x (CONS term rest) <=>
      q1535225_term_has_variable x term \/
      q1535225_term_list_has_variable x rest)`;;

let q1535225_form_has_free_variable = new_recursive_definition
  q1535225_form_RECURSION
  `(q1535225_form_has_free_variable x (Q1535225_Equal left right) <=>
      q1535225_term_has_variable x left \/
      q1535225_term_has_variable x right) /\
   (q1535225_form_has_free_variable x
       (Q1535225_Rel relation arguments) <=>
      q1535225_term_list_has_variable x arguments) /\
   (q1535225_form_has_free_variable x (Q1535225_Not p) <=>
      q1535225_form_has_free_variable x p) /\
   (q1535225_form_has_free_variable x (Q1535225_And p q) <=>
      q1535225_form_has_free_variable x p \/
      q1535225_form_has_free_variable x q) /\
   (q1535225_form_has_free_variable x (Q1535225_Exists y p) <=>
      ~(x = y) /\ q1535225_form_has_free_variable x p)`;;

let q1535225_is_sentence = new_definition
  `q1535225_is_sentence p <=>
     !x. ~(q1535225_form_has_free_variable x p)`;;

let q1535225_update = new_definition
  `q1535225_update x a valuation =
     \y. if y = x then a else valuation y`;;

let q1535225_term_value = new_recursive_definition
  q1535225_term_RECURSION
  `(q1535225_term_value function_interpretation valuation
       (Q1535225_Var x) =
      valuation x) /\
   (q1535225_term_value function_interpretation valuation
       (Q1535225_Fun f arguments) =
      function_interpretation f
        (q1535225_term_list_value
           function_interpretation valuation arguments)) /\
   (q1535225_term_list_value function_interpretation valuation [] = []) /\
   (q1535225_term_list_value function_interpretation valuation
       (CONS term rest) =
      CONS (q1535225_term_value function_interpretation valuation term)
           (q1535225_term_list_value
              function_interpretation valuation rest))`;;

let q1535225_holds = new_recursive_definition
  q1535225_form_RECURSION
  `(q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
       relation_interpretation valuation (Q1535225_Equal left right) <=>
      q1535225_term_value function_interpretation valuation left =
      q1535225_term_value function_interpretation valuation right) /\
   (q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
       relation_interpretation valuation
       (Q1535225_Rel relation arguments) <=>
      relation_interpretation relation
        (q1535225_term_list_value
           function_interpretation valuation arguments)) /\
   (q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
       relation_interpretation valuation (Q1535225_Not p) <=>
      ~(q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
          relation_interpretation valuation p)) /\
   (q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
       relation_interpretation valuation (Q1535225_And p q) <=>
      q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
        relation_interpretation valuation p /\
      q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
        relation_interpretation valuation q) /\
   (q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
       relation_interpretation valuation (Q1535225_Exists x p) <=>
      ?a. domain a /\
          q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
            relation_interpretation
            (q1535225_update x a valuation) p)`;;

let q1535225_is_ultrafilter = new_definition
  `q1535225_is_ultrafilter (u:(I->bool)->bool) <=>
     u (:I) /\
     ~(u {}) /\
     (!s t:I->bool. u s /\ u t ==> u (s INTER t)) /\
     (!s t:I->bool. u s /\ s SUBSET t ==> u t) /\
     (!s:I->bool. u s \/ u ((:I) DIFF s))`;;

let q1535225_is_structure = new_definition
  `q1535225_is_structure domain function_arity function_interpretation <=>
     (!f arguments.
        LENGTH arguments = function_arity f /\
        ALL domain arguments
        ==> domain (function_interpretation f arguments))`;;

let q1535225_choice_function = new_definition
  `q1535225_choice_function domain (choice:I->A) <=>
     !i. domain i (choice i)`;;

let q1535225_equivalent = new_definition
  `q1535225_equivalent u (left:I->A) right <=>
     u {i | left i = right i}`;;

let q1535225_class = new_definition
  `q1535225_class u domain (choice:I->A) =
     {other |
        q1535225_choice_function domain other /\
        q1535225_equivalent u choice other}`;;

let q1535225_representative = new_definition
  `q1535225_representative (class:(I->A)->bool) =
     @choice. choice IN class`;;

let q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier = new_definition
  `q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier u domain =
     IMAGE (q1535225_class u domain)
       {choice | q1535225_choice_function domain choice}`;;

let q1535225_ultraproduct_function = new_definition
  `q1535225_ultraproduct_function
       u domain function_interpretation f classes =
     q1535225_class u domain
       (\i.
          function_interpretation i f
            (MAP (\class. q1535225_representative class i) classes))`;;

let q1535225_ultraproduct_relation = new_definition
  `q1535225_ultraproduct_relation
       u relation_interpretation relation classes <=>
     u {i |
          relation_interpretation i relation
            (MAP (\class. q1535225_representative class i) classes)}`;;

let q1535225_sentence_holds = new_definition
  `q1535225_sentence_holds domain function_interpretation
       relation_interpretation p <=>
     !valuation.
       (!x. domain (valuation x))
       ==> q1535225_holds domain function_interpretation
             relation_interpretation valuation p`;;

let Q1535225_LOS_THEOREM =
 `!u:(I->bool)->bool.
  !domain:I->A->bool.
  !function_arity:F->num.
  !relation_arity:R->num.
  !function_interpretation:I->F->A list->A.
  !relation_interpretation:I->R->A list->bool.
  !p:(F,R)q1535225_form.
    q1535225_is_ultrafilter u /\
    (!i. ?a. domain i a) /\
    (!i. q1535225_is_structure
           (domain i) function_arity (function_interpretation i)) /\
    q1535225_form_wellformed function_arity relation_arity p /\
    q1535225_is_sentence p
    ==> (q1535225_sentence_holds
           (q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier u domain)
           (q1535225_ultraproduct_function
              u domain function_interpretation)
           (q1535225_ultraproduct_relation u relation_interpretation)
           p <=>
         u {i |
            q1535225_sentence_holds
              (domain i) (function_interpretation i)
              (relation_interpretation i) p})`;;

title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1535225,
;; "Łoś' theorem": a sentence holds in an ultraproduct of nonempty first-order
;; structures exactly when it holds in an ultrafilter-large set of component
;; structures. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; Conservative interfaces represent arbitrary, potentially infinite index
;; types, first-order languages, carriers, structures, dependent functions,
;; subsets, and ultrafilters.  Lists below encode only finite syntax and finite
;; argument tuples; no mathematical carrier or function space is enumerated.

(defstub q1535225-index-p
  (index-carrier index)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-function-symbol-p
  (language arity symbol)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-relation-symbol-p
  (language arity symbol)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-structure-at
  (family index)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-carrier-p
  (structure element)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-structure-equal-p
  (structure left right)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-function-value
  (language structure arity symbol arguments)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-relation-holds-p
  (language structure arity symbol arguments)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-term-value
  (language structure term bound-values)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-satisfies-p
  (language structure formula bound-values)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-base-map-value
  (map index)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-base-pointwise-choice-value
  (choice index)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-base-set-member-p
  (index-carrier set index)
  t)

(defstub q1535225-filter-member-p
  (ultrafilter set)
  t)

(defchoose q1535225-carrier-choice
    (element)
    (structure)
  (q1535225-carrier-p structure element))

(defun q1535225-default-product-map (index-carrier family)
  (list 'q1535225-default-product-map index-carrier family))

(defun q1535225-default-product-map-form-p (map)
  (and
   (true-listp map)
   (equal (len map) 3)
   (equal (car map) 'q1535225-default-product-map)))

(defun q1535225-map-value (map index)
  (if (q1535225-default-product-map-form-p map)
      (q1535225-carrier-choice
       (q1535225-structure-at (caddr map) index))
    (q1535225-base-map-value map index)))

(defun q1535225-truth (value)
  (if value t nil))

;; Closed formulas use de Bruijn indices for bound variables and the primitive
;; constructors from the Lean source: falsity, equality, relation application,
;; implication, and universal quantification.

(defun q1535225-bound-term-p (depth term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 2)
   (equal (car term) 'q1535225-bound)
   (natp (cadr term))
   (< (cadr term) depth)))

(defun q1535225-function-term-shape-p (term)
  (and
   (true-listp term)
   (equal (len term) 4)
   (equal (car term) 'q1535225-function)
   (natp (cadr term))
   (true-listp (cadddr term))
   (equal (len (cadddr term)) (cadr term))))

(defun q1535225-all-terms-p (language depth pending fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (consp pending)
      (if (zp fuel)
          nil
        (let ((term (car pending)))
          (cond
           ((q1535225-bound-term-p depth term)
            (q1535225-all-terms-p
             language depth (cdr pending) (- fuel 1)))
           ((and
             (q1535225-function-term-shape-p term)
             (q1535225-function-symbol-p
              language (cadr term) (caddr term)))
            (q1535225-all-terms-p
             language
             depth
             (append (cadddr term) (cdr pending))
             (- fuel 1)))
           (t nil))))
    (equal pending nil)))

(defun q1535225-term-p (language depth term)
  (and
   (natp depth)
   (q1535225-all-terms-p
    language depth (list term) (acl2-count term))))

(defun q1535225-term-list-p (language depth arity terms)
  (and
   (natp arity)
   (true-listp terms)
   (equal (len terms) arity)
   (q1535225-all-terms-p
    language depth terms (acl2-count terms))))

(defun q1535225-formula-p (language depth formula)
  (and
   (natp depth)
   (cond
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 1)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1535225-falsum))
     t)
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1535225-equal))
     (and
      (q1535225-term-p language depth (cadr formula))
      (q1535225-term-p language depth (caddr formula))))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 4)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1535225-relation)
      (natp (cadr formula))
      (q1535225-relation-symbol-p
       language (cadr formula) (caddr formula)))
     (q1535225-term-list-p
      language depth (cadr formula) (cadddr formula)))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1535225-implies))
     (and
      (q1535225-formula-p language depth (cadr formula))
      (q1535225-formula-p language depth (caddr formula))))
    ((and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 2)
      (equal (car formula) 'q1535225-forall))
     (q1535225-formula-p
      language (+ 1 depth) (cadr formula)))
    (t nil))))

(defun q1535225-sentence-p (language sentence)
  (q1535225-formula-p language 0 sentence))

(defun q1535225-carrier-list-p (structure values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1535225-carrier-p structure (car values))
       (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1535225-equivalent-lists-p (structure left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (consp right)
       (q1535225-truth
        (q1535225-structure-equal-p
         structure (car left) (car right)))
       (q1535225-equivalent-lists-p
        structure (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    (equal right nil)))

(defun q1535225-term-values
    (language structure terms bound-values)
  (if (consp terms)
      (cons
       (q1535225-term-value
        language structure (car terms) bound-values)
       (q1535225-term-values
        language structure (cdr terms) bound-values))
    nil))

(defun q1535225-holds-p
    (language structure formula bound-values)
  (q1535225-truth
   (q1535225-satisfies-p
    language structure formula bound-values)))

(defun q1535225-pointwise-values (arguments index)
  (if (consp arguments)
      (cons
       (q1535225-map-value (car arguments) index)
       (q1535225-pointwise-values (cdr arguments) index))
    nil))

(defun-sk q1535225-counterexample-exists-p
    (language structure body bound-values)
  (exists (element)
    (and
     (q1535225-carrier-p structure element)
     (not
      (q1535225-holds-p
       language structure body (cons element bound-values))))))

(defchoose q1535225-counterexample-choice
    (element)
    (language structure body bound-values)
  (and
   (q1535225-carrier-p structure element)
   (not
    (q1535225-holds-p
     language structure body (cons element bound-values)))))

(defun q1535225-formula-pointwise-choice
    (language family body bound-maps)
  (list
   'q1535225-formula-pointwise-choice
   language
   family
   body
   bound-maps))

(defun q1535225-formula-pointwise-choice-form-p (choice)
  (and
   (true-listp choice)
   (equal (len choice) 5)
   (equal (car choice) 'q1535225-formula-pointwise-choice)))

;; This reserved pointwise choice is the function constructed in the universal
;; case of the Lean proof.  At each component it selects a counterexample to
;; BODY for the pointwise bound assignment when one exists, and otherwise uses
;; component nonemptiness.  Generic choices use the conservative base
;; interface below.

(defun q1535225-pointwise-choice-value (choice index)
  (if (q1535225-formula-pointwise-choice-form-p choice)
      (let* ((language (cadr choice))
             (family (caddr choice))
             (body (cadddr choice))
             (bound-maps (car (cddddr choice)))
             (structure
              (q1535225-structure-at family index))
             (bound-values
              (q1535225-pointwise-values bound-maps index)))
        (if
         (q1535225-counterexample-exists-p
          language structure body bound-values)
         (q1535225-counterexample-choice
          language structure body bound-values)
          (q1535225-carrier-choice structure)))
    (q1535225-base-pointwise-choice-value choice index)))

(defun-sk q1535225-structure-nonempty-p (structure)
  (exists (element)
    (q1535225-carrier-p structure element)))

(defun-sk q1535225-all-elements-satisfy-p
    (language structure body bound-values)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q1535225-carrier-p structure element)
     (q1535225-holds-p
      language structure body (cons element bound-values)))))

;; Structures may be presented as setoids.  These laws say that equality is an
;; equivalence relation on the carrier and that all interpretations respect it.
;; Component structures below use literal ACL2 equality; the ultraproduct uses
;; almost-everywhere equality of representatives.

(defun-sk q1535225-equality-laws-p (structure)
  (forall (left middle right)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1535225-carrier-p structure left)
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure left left)))
     (implies
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure left right))
      (and
       (q1535225-carrier-p structure left)
       (q1535225-carrier-p structure right)
       (q1535225-truth
        (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure right left))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1535225-truth
        (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure left middle))
       (q1535225-truth
        (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure middle right)))
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure left right))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-function-closure-p (language structure)
  (forall (arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1535225-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp arguments)
      (equal (len arguments) arity)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure arguments))
     (q1535225-carrier-p
      structure
      (q1535225-function-value
       language structure arity symbol arguments)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-function-congruence-p (language structure)
  (forall (arity symbol left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1535225-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp left)
      (true-listp right)
      (equal (len left) arity)
      (equal (len right) arity)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure left)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure right)
      (q1535225-equivalent-lists-p structure left right))
     (q1535225-truth
      (q1535225-structure-equal-p
       structure
       (q1535225-function-value
        language structure arity symbol left)
       (q1535225-function-value
        language structure arity symbol right))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-relation-congruence-p (language structure)
  (forall (arity symbol left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1535225-relation-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp left)
      (true-listp right)
      (equal (len left) arity)
      (equal (len right) arity)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure left)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure right)
      (q1535225-equivalent-lists-p structure left right))
     (equal
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-relation-holds-p
        language structure arity symbol left))
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-relation-holds-p
        language structure arity symbol right))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-term-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (term bound-values index arity symbol arguments)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (q1535225-term-p language (len bound-values) term))
      (q1535225-carrier-p
       structure
       (q1535225-term-value
        language structure term bound-values)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp index)
       (< index (len bound-values)))
      (equal
       (q1535225-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1535225-bound index)
        bound-values)
       (nth index bound-values)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
       (natp arity)
       (q1535225-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
       (q1535225-term-list-p
        language (len bound-values) arity arguments))
      (equal
       (q1535225-term-value
        language
        structure
        (list 'q1535225-function arity symbol arguments)
        bound-values)
       (q1535225-function-value
        language
        structure
        arity
        symbol
        (q1535225-term-values
         language structure arguments bound-values)))))))

;; Exact Tarski clauses for the primitive formula constructors.

(defun-sk q1535225-falsum-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values)
    (implies
     (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
     (not
      (q1535225-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1535225-falsum)
       bound-values)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-equality-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1535225-term-p language (len bound-values) left)
      (q1535225-term-p language (len bound-values) right))
     (equal
      (q1535225-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1535225-equal left right)
       bound-values)
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-structure-equal-p
        structure
        (q1535225-term-value
         language structure left bound-values)
        (q1535225-term-value
         language structure right bound-values)))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-relation-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (natp arity)
      (q1535225-relation-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (q1535225-term-list-p
       language (len bound-values) arity arguments))
     (equal
      (q1535225-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1535225-relation arity symbol arguments)
       bound-values)
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-relation-holds-p
        language
        structure
        arity
        symbol
        (q1535225-term-values
         language structure arguments bound-values)))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-implication-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1535225-formula-p
       language (len bound-values) left)
      (q1535225-formula-p
       language (len bound-values) right))
     (equal
      (q1535225-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1535225-implies left right)
       bound-values)
      (if
       (q1535225-holds-p
        language structure left bound-values)
       (q1535225-holds-p
        language structure right bound-values)
       t)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-universal-semantics-p (language structure)
  (forall (bound-values body)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p structure bound-values)
      (q1535225-formula-p
       language (+ 1 (len bound-values)) body))
     (equal
      (q1535225-holds-p
       language
       structure
       (list 'q1535225-forall body)
       bound-values)
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-all-elements-satisfy-p
        language structure body bound-values))))))

(defun q1535225-formula-semantics-p (language structure)
  (and
   (q1535225-falsum-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1535225-equality-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1535225-relation-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1535225-implication-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1535225-universal-semantics-p language structure)))

(defun q1535225-structure-p (language structure)
  (and
   (q1535225-equality-laws-p structure)
   (q1535225-function-closure-p language structure)
   (q1535225-function-congruence-p language structure)
   (q1535225-relation-congruence-p language structure)
   (q1535225-term-semantics-p language structure)
   (q1535225-formula-semantics-p language structure)))

;; Each component is a nonempty ordinary first-order structure: its setoid
;; equality is literal equality on its carrier.  Nonemptiness is a separate
;; family assumption, matching the Lean theorem's [Nonempty (M a)] instances.

(defun-sk q1535225-literal-equality-p (structure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-carrier-p structure left)
      (q1535225-carrier-p structure right))
     (equal
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-structure-equal-p structure left right))
      (equal left right)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-family-p
    (language index-carrier family)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1535225-index-p index-carrier index)
     (let ((structure
            (q1535225-structure-at family index)))
       (and
        (q1535225-structure-p language structure)
        (q1535225-structure-nonempty-p structure)
        (q1535225-literal-equality-p structure))))))

;; Sets of indices are represented extensionally.  Reserved constructors below
;; denote the universe, empty set, Boolean operations, and the sets arising in
;; the ultraproduct definition.  All other tags use BASE-SET-MEMBER-P.

(defun q1535225-universe-set ()
  (list 'q1535225-universe-set))

(defun q1535225-empty-set ()
  (list 'q1535225-empty-set))

(defun q1535225-intersection-set (left right)
  (list 'q1535225-intersection-set left right))

(defun q1535225-complement-set (set)
  (list 'q1535225-complement-set set))

(defun q1535225-equality-set (family left right)
  (list 'q1535225-equality-set family left right))

(defun q1535225-relation-set
    (language family arity symbol arguments)
  (list
   'q1535225-relation-set
   language
   family
   arity
   symbol
   arguments))

(defun q1535225-sentence-set (language family sentence)
  (list 'q1535225-sentence-set language family sentence))

(defun q1535225-set-member-p (index-carrier set index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count set)))
  (if (not (q1535225-index-p index-carrier index))
      nil
    (cond
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 1)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-universe-set))
      t)
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 1)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-empty-set))
      nil)
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 3)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-intersection-set))
      (and
       (q1535225-set-member-p
        index-carrier (cadr set) index)
       (q1535225-set-member-p
        index-carrier (caddr set) index)))
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 2)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-complement-set))
      (not
       (q1535225-set-member-p
        index-carrier (cadr set) index)))
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 4)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-equality-set))
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-structure-equal-p
        (q1535225-structure-at (cadr set) index)
        (q1535225-map-value (caddr set) index)
        (q1535225-map-value (cadddr set) index))))
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 6)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-relation-set))
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-relation-holds-p
        (cadr set)
        (q1535225-structure-at (caddr set) index)
        (cadddr set)
        (car (cddddr set))
        (q1535225-pointwise-values
         (cadr (cddddr set)) index))))
     ((and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 4)
       (equal (car set) 'q1535225-sentence-set))
      (q1535225-holds-p
       (cadr set)
       (q1535225-structure-at (caddr set) index)
       (cadddr set)
       nil))
     (t
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-base-set-member-p
        index-carrier set index))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-set-subset-p
    (index-carrier left right)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1535225-set-member-p index-carrier left index)
     (q1535225-set-member-p index-carrier right index))))

(defun q1535225-eventually-p (ultrafilter set)
  (q1535225-truth
   (q1535225-filter-member-p ultrafilter set)))

;; These are the proper-filter and ultrafilter laws on the full arbitrary set
;; interface.  They are not restricted to the special sets used in the result.

(defun-sk q1535225-ultrafilter-set-laws-p
    (index-carrier ultrafilter)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (equal
      (q1535225-eventually-p
       ultrafilter
       (q1535225-intersection-set left right))
      (and
       (q1535225-eventually-p ultrafilter left)
       (q1535225-eventually-p ultrafilter right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1535225-eventually-p ultrafilter left)
       (q1535225-set-subset-p index-carrier left right))
      (q1535225-eventually-p ultrafilter right))
     (or
      (q1535225-eventually-p ultrafilter left)
      (q1535225-eventually-p
       ultrafilter
       (q1535225-complement-set left))))))

(defun q1535225-ultrafilter-p
    (index-carrier ultrafilter)
  (and
   (q1535225-eventually-p
    ultrafilter (q1535225-universe-set))
   (not
    (q1535225-eventually-p
     ultrafilter (q1535225-empty-set)))
   (q1535225-ultrafilter-set-laws-p
    index-carrier ultrafilter)))

;; The ultraproduct is presented by representatives rather than quotient
;; objects.  Its carrier consists of dependent functions choosing an element
;; of each component, and its equality is almost-everywhere component
;; equality.  A conservative DEFCHOOSE map supplies the representative whose
;; existence follows from component nonemptiness, while the fullness and
;; formula-witness laws below supply all pointwise choices needed by arbitrary
;; first-order quantifiers.  Thus quantification over these representatives
;; has the same sentence semantics as quantification over Lean's full dependent
;; product, and quotienting by almost-everywhere equality preserves it.

(defun q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
  (list
   'q1535225-ultraproduct
   language
   index-carrier
   family
   ultrafilter))

(defun-sk q1535225-product-map-p
    (index-carrier family map)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1535225-index-p index-carrier index)
     (q1535225-carrier-p
      (q1535225-structure-at family index)
      (q1535225-map-value map index)))))

(defun q1535225-product-map-list-p
    (index-carrier family maps)
  (if (consp maps)
      (and
       (q1535225-product-map-p
        index-carrier family (car maps))
       (q1535225-product-map-list-p
        index-carrier family (cdr maps)))
    (equal maps nil)))

;; Fullness of the representative sort: every pointwise family of component
;; elements has a map code realizing it.  This is the target-native
;; surjectivity condition identifying map codes with the full dependent
;; function type (forall a, M a), rather than with an arbitrary subcollection.

(defun-sk q1535225-pointwise-choice-valid-p
    (index-carrier family choice)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1535225-index-p index-carrier index)
     (q1535225-carrier-p
      (q1535225-structure-at family index)
      (q1535225-pointwise-choice-value choice index)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-map-realizes-pointwise-choice-p
    (index-carrier choice map)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q1535225-index-p index-carrier index)
     (equal
      (q1535225-map-value map index)
      (q1535225-pointwise-choice-value choice index)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-pointwise-choice-represented-p
    (index-carrier family choice)
  (exists (map)
    (and
     (q1535225-product-map-p index-carrier family map)
     (q1535225-map-realizes-pointwise-choice-p
      index-carrier choice map))))

(defun-sk q1535225-full-dependent-product-p
    (index-carrier family)
  (forall (choice)
    (implies
     (q1535225-pointwise-choice-valid-p
      index-carrier family choice)
     (q1535225-pointwise-choice-represented-p
      index-carrier family choice))))

;; The formula-specific closure makes the quantifier equivalence explicit.
;; Given any bounded formula and finite list of representative parameters, the
;; pointwise counterexample family above is represented by a product map.  By
;; structural induction this is exactly the additional choice needed to pass
;; between quantification over representatives and quantification in every
;; component; atomic formulas and implication use the pointwise and
;; ultrafilter clauses directly.

(defun-sk q1535225-formula-witness-maps-p
    (language index-carrier family)
  (forall (body bound-maps)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-product-map-list-p
       index-carrier family bound-maps)
      (q1535225-formula-p
       language (+ 1 (len bound-maps)) body))
     (q1535225-pointwise-choice-represented-p
      index-carrier
      family
      (q1535225-formula-pointwise-choice
       language family body bound-maps)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-ultraproduct-carrier-laws-p
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
  (forall (map)
    (equal
     (q1535225-truth
      (q1535225-carrier-p
       (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
        language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
       map))
     (q1535225-truth
      (q1535225-product-map-p
       index-carrier family map)))))

(defun-sk q1535225-ultraproduct-equality-laws-p
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
  (forall (left right)
    (equal
     (q1535225-truth
      (q1535225-structure-equal-p
       (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
        language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
       left
       right))
     (and
      (q1535225-product-map-p index-carrier family left)
      (q1535225-product-map-p index-carrier family right)
      (q1535225-eventually-p
       ultrafilter
       (q1535225-equality-set family left right))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-ultraproduct-function-laws-p
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
  (forall (arity symbol arguments index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1535225-function-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp arguments)
      (equal (len arguments) arity)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p
       (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
        language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
       arguments)
      (q1535225-index-p index-carrier index))
     (equal
      (q1535225-map-value
       (q1535225-function-value
        language
        (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
         language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
        arity
        symbol
        arguments)
       index)
      (q1535225-function-value
       language
       (q1535225-structure-at family index)
       arity
       symbol
       (q1535225-pointwise-values arguments index))))))

(defun-sk q1535225-ultraproduct-relation-laws-p
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
  (forall (arity symbol arguments)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp arity)
      (q1535225-relation-symbol-p language arity symbol)
      (true-listp arguments)
      (equal (len arguments) arity)
      (q1535225-carrier-list-p
       (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
        language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
       arguments))
     (equal
      (q1535225-truth
       (q1535225-relation-holds-p
        language
        (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
         language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
        arity
        symbol
        arguments))
      (q1535225-eventually-p
       ultrafilter
       (q1535225-relation-set
        language family arity symbol arguments))))))

(defun q1535225-ultraproduct-p
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
  (let ((structure
         (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
          language index-carrier family ultrafilter)))
    (and
     (q1535225-full-dependent-product-p
      index-carrier family)
     (q1535225-formula-witness-maps-p
      language index-carrier family)
     (q1535225-ultraproduct-carrier-laws-p
      language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
     (q1535225-ultraproduct-equality-laws-p
      language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
     (q1535225-ultraproduct-function-laws-p
      language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
     (q1535225-ultraproduct-relation-laws-p
      language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
     (q1535225-structure-p language structure))))

(defun q1535225-sentence-realize-equivalence-p
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter sentence)
  (equal
   (q1535225-holds-p
    language
    (q1535225-ultraproduct-structure
     language index-carrier family ultrafilter)
    sentence
    nil)
   (q1535225-eventually-p
    ultrafilter
    (q1535225-sentence-set language family sentence))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1535225-los-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall
    (language index-carrier family ultrafilter sentence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1535225-family-p language index-carrier family)
      (q1535225-ultrafilter-p index-carrier ultrafilter)
      (q1535225-sentence-p language sentence)
      (q1535225-ultraproduct-p
       language index-carrier family ultrafilter))
     (q1535225-sentence-realize-equivalence-p
      language
      index-carrier
      family
      ultrafilter
      sentence))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1535225,
-- "Łoś' theorem": a first-order sentence holds in an ultraproduct exactly
-- when it holds in the component structures on an ultrafilter-large set.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1535225_o_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 4 _⊎_
infixr 3 _×_
infix  2 _↔_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor truth

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _⊎_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → A ⊎ B
  right : B → A ⊎ B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record Nonempty
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  constructor inhabited
  field
    witness : A

record Lift
  {a : Level}
  (b : Level)
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor lift
  field
    lower : A

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Language (u v : Level) : Set (lsuc (u ⊔ v)) where
  field
    FunctionSymbol : Nat → Set u
    RelationSymbol : Nat → Set v

open Language

record Structure
  {u v c : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (Carrier : Set c) :
  Set (u ⊔ v ⊔ lsuc c) where

  field
    functionMeaning :
      (arity : Nat) →
      FunctionSymbol language arity →
      (Fin arity → Carrier) →
      Carrier

    relationMeaning :
      (arity : Nat) →
      RelationSymbol language arity →
      (Fin arity → Carrier) →
      Set c

open Structure

data Term
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (freeVariables : Nat) :
  Set (u ⊔ v) where

  variableTerm :
    Fin freeVariables →
    Term language freeVariables

  applyFunction :
    (arity : Nat) →
    FunctionSymbol language arity →
    (Fin arity → Term language freeVariables) →
    Term language freeVariables

data Formula
  {u v : Level}
  (language : Language u v)
  (freeVariables : Nat) :
  Set (u ⊔ v) where

  equal :
    Term language freeVariables →
    Term language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables

  relation :
    (arity : Nat) →
    RelationSymbol language arity →
    (Fin arity → Term language freeVariables) →
    Formula language freeVariables

  falsehood :
    Formula language freeVariables

  implies :
    Formula language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables →
    Formula language freeVariables

  all :
    Formula language (suc freeVariables) →
    Formula language freeVariables

Sentence :
  {u v : Level} →
  Language u v →
  Set (u ⊔ v)
Sentence language =
  Formula language zero

interpretTerm :
  {u v c : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {Carrier : Set c} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Structure language Carrier →
  Term language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → Carrier) →
  Carrier
interpretTerm structure (variableTerm index) assignment =
  assignment index
interpretTerm structure (applyFunction arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  functionMeaning structure arity symbol
    (λ index → interpretTerm structure (arguments index) assignment)

extend :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → A) →
  A →
  Fin (suc n) →
  A
extend assignment value fzero =
  value
extend assignment value (fsuc index) =
  assignment index

Realize :
  {u v c : Level} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {Carrier : Set c} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Structure language Carrier →
  Formula language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → Carrier) →
  Set c
Realize structure (equal leftTerm rightTerm) assignment =
  interpretTerm structure leftTerm assignment
  ≡ interpretTerm structure rightTerm assignment
Realize structure (relation arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  relationMeaning structure arity symbol
    (λ index → interpretTerm structure (arguments index) assignment)
Realize structure falsehood assignment =
  Bottom
Realize structure (implies premise conclusion) assignment =
  Realize structure premise assignment →
  Realize structure conclusion assignment
Realize {Carrier = Carrier} structure (all body) assignment =
  (value : Carrier) →
  Realize structure body (extend assignment value)

record Ultrafilter
  {i p : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc p) where

  field
    eventually :
      (I → Set p) →
      Set p

    eventually-whole :
      eventually (λ _ → Top)

    eventually-upward :
      (P Q : I → Set p) →
      eventually P →
      ((index : I) → P index → Q index) →
      eventually Q

    eventually-intersection :
      (P Q : I → Set p) →
      eventually P →
      eventually Q →
      eventually (λ index → P index × Q index)

    eventually-proper :
      Not (eventually (λ _ → Bottom))

    eventually-decides :
      (P : I → Set p) →
      eventually P ⊎ eventually (λ index → Not (P index))

open Ultrafilter

UltraproductCarrier :
  {i c : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  (I → Set c) →
  Set (i ⊔ c)
UltraproductCarrier {I = I} M =
  (index : I) → M index

UltraproductEqual :
  {i c : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {M : I → Set c} →
  Ultrafilter {p = i ⊔ c} I →
  UltraproductCarrier M →
  UltraproductCarrier M →
  Set (i ⊔ c)
UltraproductEqual {i = i} ultrafilter leftValue rightValue =
  eventually ultrafilter
    (λ index → Lift i (leftValue index ≡ rightValue index))

interpretUltraproductTerm :
  {i u v c : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {M : I → Set c} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  ((index : I) → Structure language (M index)) →
  Term language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → UltraproductCarrier M) →
  UltraproductCarrier M
interpretUltraproductTerm structures term assignment index =
  interpretTerm (structures index) term
    (λ variableIndex → assignment variableIndex index)

UltraproductRealize :
  {i u v c : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {language : Language u v} →
  {M : I → Set c} →
  {freeVariables : Nat} →
  Ultrafilter {p = i ⊔ c} I →
  ((index : I) → Structure language (M index)) →
  Formula language freeVariables →
  (Fin freeVariables → UltraproductCarrier M) →
  Set (i ⊔ c)
UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures
  (equal leftTerm rightTerm) assignment =
  UltraproductEqual ultrafilter
    (interpretUltraproductTerm structures leftTerm assignment)
    (interpretUltraproductTerm structures rightTerm assignment)
UltraproductRealize {i = i} ultrafilter structures
  (relation arity symbol arguments) assignment =
  eventually ultrafilter
    (λ index →
      Lift i
        (relationMeaning (structures index) arity symbol
          (λ argument →
            interpretUltraproductTerm structures
              (arguments argument) assignment index)))
UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures falsehood assignment =
  Bottom
UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures
  (implies premise conclusion) assignment =
  UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures premise assignment →
  UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures conclusion assignment
UltraproductRealize {M = M} ultrafilter structures (all body) assignment =
  (value : UltraproductCarrier M) →
  UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures body
    (extend assignment value)

emptyAssignment :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Fin zero →
  A
emptyAssignment ()

los-theorem :
  {i u v c : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (i ⊔ u ⊔ v ⊔ c))
los-theorem {i} {u} {v} {c} =
  (I : Set i) →
  (language : Language u v) →
  (M : I → Set c) →
  (structures : (index : I) → Structure language (M index)) →
  ((index : I) → Nonempty (M index)) →
  (ultrafilter : Ultrafilter {p = i ⊔ c} I) →
  (sentence : Sentence language) →
  UltraproductRealize ultrafilter structures sentence emptyAssignment
  ↔
  eventually ultrafilter
    (λ index →
      Lift i (Realize (structures index) sentence emptyAssignment))

title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1535225 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1535225), "Łoś' theorem": a
  first-order sentence holds in an ultraproduct exactly when it holds in an
  ultrafilter-large set of component structures. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open listTheory pred_setTheory;

Datatype:
  q1535225_term =
    Q1535225Var num
  | Q1535225Fun 'f (q1535225_term list)
End

Datatype:
  q1535225_formula =
    Q1535225False
  | Q1535225Equal ('f q1535225_term) ('f q1535225_term)
  | Q1535225Rel 'r (('f q1535225_term) list)
  | Q1535225Imp q1535225_formula q1535225_formula
  | Q1535225Forall q1535225_formula
End

val q1535225_term_wf_def = Define`
  (q1535225_term_wf FS f_arity (Q1535225Var n) <=> T) /\
  (q1535225_term_wf FS f_arity (Q1535225Fun f ts) <=>
     f IN FS /\
     LENGTH ts = f_arity f /\
     EVERY (q1535225_term_wf FS f_arity) ts)`;

val q1535225_formula_wf_def = Define`
  (q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity Q1535225False <=> T) /\
  (q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1535225Equal s t) <=>
     q1535225_term_wf FS f_arity s /\
     q1535225_term_wf FS f_arity t) /\
  (q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1535225Rel r ts) <=>
     r IN RS /\
     LENGTH ts = r_arity r /\
     EVERY (q1535225_term_wf FS f_arity) ts) /\
  (q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1535225Imp p q) <=>
     q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p /\
     q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity q) /\
  (q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity
       (Q1535225Forall p) <=>
     q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p)`;

val q1535225_term_closed_at_def = Define`
  (q1535225_term_closed_at k (Q1535225Var n) <=> n < k) /\
  (q1535225_term_closed_at k (Q1535225Fun f ts) <=>
     EVERY (q1535225_term_closed_at k) ts)`;

val q1535225_formula_closed_at_def = Define`
  (q1535225_formula_closed_at k Q1535225False <=> T) /\
  (q1535225_formula_closed_at k (Q1535225Equal s t) <=>
     q1535225_term_closed_at k s /\
     q1535225_term_closed_at k t) /\
  (q1535225_formula_closed_at k (Q1535225Rel r ts) <=>
     EVERY (q1535225_term_closed_at k) ts) /\
  (q1535225_formula_closed_at k (Q1535225Imp p q) <=>
     q1535225_formula_closed_at k p /\
     q1535225_formula_closed_at k q) /\
  (q1535225_formula_closed_at k (Q1535225Forall p) <=>
     q1535225_formula_closed_at (SUC k) p)`;

val q1535225_term_value_def = Define`
  (q1535225_term_value fnI v (Q1535225Var n) = v n) /\
  (q1535225_term_value fnI v (Q1535225Fun f ts) =
     fnI f (MAP (q1535225_term_value fnI v) ts))`;

val q1535225_satisfies_def = Define`
  (q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v Q1535225False <=> F) /\
  (q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1535225Equal s t) <=>
     q1535225_term_value fnI v s = q1535225_term_value fnI v t) /\
  (q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1535225Rel r ts) <=>
     relI r (MAP (q1535225_term_value fnI v) ts)) /\
  (q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1535225Imp p q) <=>
     (q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v p ==>
      q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v q)) /\
  (q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v (Q1535225Forall p) <=>
     !x.
       x IN carrier
       ==>
       q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI
         (\n. if n = 0 then x else v (PRE n)) p)`;

val q1535225_structure_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_structure_def",
  ``q1535225_structure FS f_arity carrier fnI <=>
      !f xs.
        f IN FS /\
        LENGTH xs = f_arity f /\
        EVERY (\x. x IN carrier) xs
        ==>
        fnI f xs IN carrier``);

val q1535225_ultrafilter_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_ultrafilter_def",
  ``q1535225_ultrafilter (U : ('i set) set) <=>
      (UNIV : 'i set) IN U /\
      EMPTY NOTIN U /\
      (!s t. s IN U /\ t IN U ==> s INTER t IN U) /\
      (!s t. s IN U /\ s SUBSET t ==> t IN U) /\
      (!s : 'i set. s IN U \/ COMPL s IN U)``);

val q1535225_choice_function_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_choice_function_def",
  ``q1535225_choice_function carrier (x : 'i -> 'm) <=>
      !i. x i IN carrier i``);

val q1535225_equivalent_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_equivalent_def",
  ``q1535225_equivalent (U : ('i set) set)
      (x : 'i -> 'm) (y : 'i -> 'm) <=>
      {i | x i = y i} IN U``);

val q1535225_class_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_class_def",
  ``q1535225_class U carrier (x : 'i -> 'm) =
      {y |
        q1535225_choice_function carrier y /\
        q1535225_equivalent U x y}``);

val q1535225_representative_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_representative_def",
  ``q1535225_representative (c : ('i -> 'm) set) =
      @x. x IN c``);

val q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier_def",
  ``q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier U carrier =
      IMAGE (q1535225_class U carrier)
        {x | q1535225_choice_function carrier x}``);

val q1535225_ultraproduct_function_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_ultraproduct_function_def",
  ``q1535225_ultraproduct_function U carrier fnI f cs =
      q1535225_class U carrier
        (\i.
          fnI i f
            (MAP (\c. q1535225_representative c i) cs))``);

val q1535225_ultraproduct_relation_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_ultraproduct_relation_def",
  ``q1535225_ultraproduct_relation U relI r cs <=>
      {i |
        relI i r
          (MAP (\c. q1535225_representative c i) cs)} IN U``);

val q1535225_models_def = new_definition (
  "q1535225_models_def",
  ``q1535225_models carrier fnI relI p <=>
      !v.
        (!n. v n IN carrier)
        ==>
        q1535225_satisfies carrier fnI relI v p``);

val los_theorem =
  ``!(FS : 'f set) (RS : 'r set)
      (f_arity : 'f -> num) (r_arity : 'r -> num)
      (carrier : 'i -> 'm set)
      (fnI : 'i -> 'f -> 'm list -> 'm)
      (relI : 'i -> 'r -> 'm list -> bool)
      (U : ('i set) set) p.
      q1535225_ultrafilter U /\
      (!i.
        carrier i <> EMPTY /\
        q1535225_structure FS f_arity (carrier i) (fnI i)) /\
      q1535225_formula_wf FS RS f_arity r_arity p /\
      q1535225_formula_closed_at 0 p
      ==>
      (q1535225_models
         (q1535225_ultraproduct_carrier U carrier)
         (q1535225_ultraproduct_function U carrier fnI)
         (q1535225_ultraproduct_relation U relI)
         p
       <=>
       {i |
         q1535225_models (carrier i) (fnI i) (relI i) p} IN U)``;

title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1535225
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1535225), catalog title
  "Łoś' theorem" (ASCII: "Los' theorem"): a first-order
  sentence holds in an ultraproduct if and only if the set of component
  structures satisfying it belongs to the ultrafilter. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A language is a pair of arity-indexed families of function and relation
  symbols. Terms and formulas are standard finite tagged-tree codes.
  Q1535225TermsAt L n contains exactly the terms whose free de Bruijn
  variables are below n. Q1535225FormulaLevels L contains <. n , p >.
  exactly when p is a formula with n available free variables; universal
  quantification changes level n + 1 to level n. Thus Q1535225Sentences L,
  the level-zero formulas, is precisely the set of closed sentences.

  A structure has a nonempty carrier and total interpretations of every
  symbol. Q1535225Eval and Q1535225Sat give compositional Tarski semantics,
  and Q1535225Models specializes them to closed sentences.

  Q1535225DepProduct is the full dependent product of the component carriers.
  Q1535225EqRel identifies two sections exactly when their equality set is in
  the ultrafilter. Q1535225Ultraproduct is the quotient carrier equipped with
  the pointwise function and relation interpretations; its definition
  explicitly quantifies representatives of quotient classes. Function values
  are full equivalence classes of pointwise outputs, and each relation binds
  one representative tuple before forming its ultrafilter truth set.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition required for this encoding. The final $a declaration is the
  single unproved corpus statement, and the root statement file contains no
  $p declaration.
$)

$c Q1535225Language Q1535225FunKeys Q1535225RelKeys $.
$c Q1535225TermsAt Q1535225Terms Q1535225FormulaLevels $.

    |^| { C |
      A. n e. NN0
        (

                >. e. C

                <. n , <. 1 , <. s , t >. >. >. e. C

                  /\

${
  $d A E L M V f i j k $.

  q1535225-eval-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1535225Eval L M E )
    <->
    (
      E :
        (

          X.

        )
        --> ( 1st ` M )
      /\
      (
        A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          A. i e. NN0
            ( E ` <. V , <. 0 , i >. >. ) = ( V ` i )
        /\
        A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          A. k e. NN0
            A. f e. ( ( 1st ` L ) ` k )
              A. A e. ( ( Q1535225Terms L ) ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
                (
                  E `
                    <. V , <. 1 , <. k , <. f , A >. >. >. >.
                )

                    ` <. k , f >.

${
  $d A E L M S V j k n p q r s t x $.

  q1535225-sat-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1535225Sat L M E S )
    <->
    (
      S C_
        (
          ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
          X.
          ( Q1535225FormulaLevels L )
        )
      /\
      A. n e. NN0
        (
          A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
            A. k e. NN0
              A. r e. ( ( 2nd ` L ) ` k )
                A. A e.
                  ( ( Q1535225TermsAt L n ) ^m ( 0 ..^ k ) )
                  (
                    <.
                      V ,
                      <.
                        n ,
                        <. 0 , <. k , <. r , A >. >. >.
                      >.
                    >. e. S
                    <->
                    (
                      j e. ( 0 ..^ k )
                      |->

                    )
                    e.
                    (

                      ` <. k , r >.
                    )

          /\

            A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
              A. s e. ( Q1535225TermsAt L n )
                A. t e. ( Q1535225TermsAt L n )
                  (

                      e. S
                    <->
                    ( E ` <. V , s >. ) = ( E ` <. V , t >. )
                  )
            /\

              A. V e. ( ( 1st ` M ) ^m NN0 )
                -. <. V , <. n , <. 2 , 0 >. >. >. e. S
              /\

                  A. p A. q

${

${
  $d I L M U a p $.

  thousand-theorems-q1535225-los $a |- (
    A. L A. I A. M A. U A. p
      (
        (
          (

              L

          <->
          { a e. I |
            ( Q1535225Models L ( M ` a ) p )
          } e. U
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

      U being non-empty Function,
      I being Function,
      F being set,
      E being Equivalence_Relation of product U,
      K being E-respecting (S,product U)-interpreter-like Function,
      Q being Element of (Class E)-InterpretersOf S,
      phi being wff string of S st
    dom U = A &
    (for i being Element of A holds U.i is non empty set) &
    dom I = A &
    (for i being Element of A holds
      ex V being non empty set,
         J being Element of V-InterpretersOf S st
        V = U.i & J = I.i) &
    F c= bool A &
    A in F &
    not {} in F &
    (for B,C being Subset of A st B in F & C in F holds B /\ C in F) &
    (for B,C being Subset of A st B in F & B c= C holds C in F) &
    (for B being Subset of A holds B in F or A \ B in F) &
    (for x,y being Element of product U holds
      [x,y] in E iff
      {i where i is Element of A: x.i = y.i} in F) &
    (for o being own Element of S,
         p being FinSequence st p in dom (K.o) holds
      (o is relational implies
        ((K.o).p = TRUE iff
          {i where i is Element of A:
            ex V being non empty set,
               J being Element of V-InterpretersOf S,
               q being FinSequence st
              V = U.i & J = I.i &
              q in dom (J.o) &
              (for j being Nat st j in dom p holds
                ex x being Element of product U st
                  x = p.j & q.j = x.i) &
              (J.o).q = TRUE} in F)) &
      (not o is relational implies
        ex z being Element of product U st
          z = (K.o).p &
          for i being Element of A,
              V being non empty set,
              J being Element of V-InterpretersOf S st
            V = U.i & J = I.i
          holds
            ex q being FinSequence,
               v being Element of V st
              q in dom (J.o) &
              (for j being Nat st j in dom p holds
                ex x being Element of product U st
                  x = p.j & q.j = x.i) &
              v = (J.o).q & z.i = v)) &
    (for W being non empty set,
         H being Element of W-InterpretersOf S,
         l being literal Element of S,
         w being Element of W holds
      H-TruthEval phi = ((l,w) ReassignIn H)-TruthEval phi) &
    (for o being Element of OwnSymbolsOf S holds
      Q.o =
        ((K.o) qua E-respecting Interpreter of o,product U) quotient E)
  holds
    Q-TruthEval phi = TRUE iff
    {i where i is Element of A:
      ex V being non empty set,
         J being Element of V-InterpretersOf S st
        V = U.i & J = I.i & J-TruthEval phi = TRUE} in F
proof
end;
