title: Q1535225_o_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1535225,
% "Łoś' theorem": a first-order sentence holds in an ultraproduct if and only
% if it holds in an ultrafilter-large set of factor structures. This file contains no proof.

first_order_syntax_Q1535225[Symbol: TYPE]: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  variable_node(variable_index: nat): variable_node?
  application_node(
      application_symbol: Symbol,
      application_arguments: first_order_syntax_Q1535225): application_node?
  argument_nil: argument_nil?
  argument_cons(
      argument_head: first_order_syntax_Q1535225,
      argument_tail: first_order_syntax_Q1535225): argument_cons?
  equality_node(
      equality_left: first_order_syntax_Q1535225,
      equality_right: first_order_syntax_Q1535225): equality_node?
  relation_node(
      relation_symbol: Symbol,
      relation_arguments: first_order_syntax_Q1535225): relation_node?
  false_node: false_node?
  implication_node(
      implication_left: first_order_syntax_Q1535225,
      implication_right: first_order_syntax_Q1535225): implication_node?
  universal_node(
      universal_body: first_order_syntax_Q1535225): universal_node?
END first_order_syntax_Q1535225

los_theorem_Q1535225[
  A: TYPE+,
  D: TYPE+,
  Symbol: TYPE,
  symbol_is_function: [Symbol -> bool],
  symbol_arity: [Symbol -> nat],
  carrier: [A, D -> bool],
  function_interpretation: [A, Symbol, [nat -> D] -> D],
  relation_interpretation: [A, Symbol, [nat -> D] -> bool],
  large: [[A -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING first_order_syntax_Q1535225[Symbol]

  syntax: TYPE = first_order_syntax_Q1535225[Symbol]
  point_set: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  factor_assignment: TYPE = [nat -> D]
  representative: TYPE = [A -> D]
  product_assignment: TYPE = [nat -> representative]

  argument_length(node: syntax): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index): 0,
      application_node(symbol, arguments): 0,
      argument_nil: 0,
      argument_cons(head, tail): 1 + argument_length(tail),
      equality_node(left, right): 0,
      relation_node(symbol, arguments): 0,
      false_node: 0,
      implication_node(left, right): 0,
      universal_node(body): 0
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  % Kinds 0, 1, and 2 respectively denote terms, argument lists, and formulas.
  % The depth is the number of enclosing de Bruijn binders.
  well_formed(node: syntax, kind: nat, depth: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index):
        kind = 0 AND index < depth,
      application_node(symbol, arguments):
        kind = 0
          AND symbol_is_function(symbol)
          AND argument_length(arguments) = symbol_arity(symbol)
          AND well_formed(arguments, 1, depth),
      argument_nil:
        kind = 1,
      argument_cons(head, tail):
        kind = 1
          AND well_formed(head, 0, depth)
          AND well_formed(tail, 1, depth),
      equality_node(left, right):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(left, 0, depth)
          AND well_formed(right, 0, depth),
      relation_node(symbol, arguments):
        kind = 2
          AND NOT symbol_is_function(symbol)
          AND argument_length(arguments) = symbol_arity(symbol)
          AND well_formed(arguments, 1, depth),
      false_node:
        kind = 2,
      implication_node(left, right):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(left, 2, depth)
          AND well_formed(right, 2, depth),
      universal_node(body):
        kind = 2
          AND well_formed(body, 2, depth + 1)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  sentence: TYPE = {phi: syntax | well_formed(phi, 2, 0)}

  syntax_size(node: syntax): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES node OF
      variable_node(index): 1,
      application_node(symbol, arguments):
        1 + syntax_size(arguments),
      argument_nil: 1,
      argument_cons(head, tail):
        1 + syntax_size(head) + syntax_size(tail),
      equality_node(left, right):
        1 + syntax_size(left) + syntax_size(right),
      relation_node(symbol, arguments):
        1 + syntax_size(arguments),
      false_node: 1,
      implication_node(left, right):
        1 + syntax_size(left) + syntax_size(right),
      universal_node(body):
        1 + syntax_size(body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE node BY <<

  default_element: D =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: D): TRUE)

  canonical_tuple(
      values: [nat -> D],
      arity: nat): [nat -> D] =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      IF index < arity THEN values(index) ELSE default_element ENDIF

  tuple_in_carrier(
      a: A,
      values: [nat -> D],
      arity: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index < arity IMPLIES carrier(a, values(index))

  family_of_nonempty_structures: bool =
    (FORALL (a: A):
      EXISTS (value: D): carrier(a, value))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: A), (symbol: Symbol), (values: [nat -> D]):
      (symbol_is_function(symbol)
        AND tuple_in_carrier(a, values, symbol_arity(symbol)))
      IMPLIES
        carrier(
          a,
          function_interpretation(
            a,
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple(values, symbol_arity(symbol)))))

  subset(left, right: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (a: A): left(a) IMPLIES right(a)

  intersect(left, right: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (a: A): left(a) AND right(a)

  complement(value: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (a: A): NOT value(a)

  full_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (a: A): TRUE

  empty_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (a: A): FALSE

  ultrafilter_laws: bool =
    large(full_set)
      AND NOT large(empty_set)
      AND
    (FORALL (left, right: point_set):
      (large(left) AND subset(left, right)) IMPLIES large(right))
      AND
    (FORALL (left, right: point_set):
      (large(left) AND large(right))
        IMPLIES large(intersect(left, right)))
      AND
    (FORALL (value: point_set):
      large(value) OR large(complement(value)))

  evaluate_factor_fuel(
      node: syntax,
      a: A,
      assignment: factor_assignment,
      fuel: nat,
      position: nat): RECURSIVE D =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      default_element
    ELSE
      CASES node OF
        variable_node(index):
          assignment(index),
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          function_interpretation(
            a,
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_factor_fuel(
                  arguments, a, assignment, fuel - 1, index),
              symbol_arity(symbol))),
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          IF position = 0 THEN
            evaluate_factor_fuel(head, a, assignment, fuel - 1, 0)
          ELSE
            evaluate_factor_fuel(
              tail, a, assignment, fuel - 1, position - 1)
          ENDIF,
        argument_nil:
          default_element,
        equality_node(left, right):
          default_element,
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          default_element,
        false_node:
          default_element,
        implication_node(left, right):
          default_element,
        universal_node(body):
          default_element
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  evaluate_factor(
      node: syntax,
      a: A,
      assignment: factor_assignment): D =
    evaluate_factor_fuel(
      node, a, assignment, syntax_size(node) + 1, 0)

  holds_factor_fuel(
      phi: syntax,
      a: A,
      assignment: factor_assignment,
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      CASES phi OF
        equality_node(left, right):
          evaluate_factor(left, a, assignment)
            = evaluate_factor(right, a, assignment),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          relation_interpretation(
            a,
            symbol,
            canonical_tuple(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                evaluate_factor_fuel(
                  arguments,
                  a,
                  assignment,
                  syntax_size(arguments) + 1,
                  index),
              symbol_arity(symbol))),
        false_node:
          FALSE,
        implication_node(left, right):
          holds_factor_fuel(left, a, assignment, fuel - 1)
            IMPLIES
          holds_factor_fuel(right, a, assignment, fuel - 1),
        universal_node(body):
          FORALL (value: D):
            carrier(a, value)
              IMPLIES
                holds_factor_fuel(
                  body,
                  a,
                  LAMBDA (index: nat):
                    IF index = 0 THEN
                      value
                    ELSE
                      assignment(index - 1)
                    ENDIF,
                  fuel - 1),
        variable_node(index):
          FALSE,
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          FALSE,
        argument_nil:
          FALSE,
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          FALSE
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  default_factor_assignment: factor_assignment =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): default_element

  models_factor(a: A, phi: sentence): bool =
    holds_factor_fuel(
      phi,
      a,
      default_factor_assignment,
      syntax_size(phi) + 1)

  is_representative(value: representative): bool =
    FORALL (a: A): carrier(a, value(a))

  equivalent(left, right: representative): bool =
    large(LAMBDA (a: A): left(a) = right(a))

  evaluate_product_fuel(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: product_assignment,
      fuel: nat,
      position: nat): RECURSIVE representative =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      LAMBDA (a: A): default_element
    ELSE
      CASES node OF
        variable_node(index):
          assignment(index),
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          LAMBDA (a: A):
            function_interpretation(
              a,
              symbol,
              canonical_tuple(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  evaluate_product_fuel(
                    arguments,
                    assignment,
                    fuel - 1,
                    index)(a),
                symbol_arity(symbol))),
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          IF position = 0 THEN
            evaluate_product_fuel(head, assignment, fuel - 1, 0)
          ELSE
            evaluate_product_fuel(
              tail, assignment, fuel - 1, position - 1)
          ENDIF,
        argument_nil:
          LAMBDA (a: A): default_element,
        equality_node(left, right):
          LAMBDA (a: A): default_element,
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          LAMBDA (a: A): default_element,
        false_node:
          LAMBDA (a: A): default_element,
        implication_node(left, right):
          LAMBDA (a: A): default_element,
        universal_node(body):
          LAMBDA (a: A): default_element
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  evaluate_product(
      node: syntax,
      assignment: product_assignment): representative =
    evaluate_product_fuel(
      node, assignment, syntax_size(node) + 1, 0)

  holds_product_fuel(
      phi: syntax,
      assignment: product_assignment,
      fuel: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF fuel = 0 THEN
      FALSE
    ELSE
      CASES phi OF
        equality_node(left, right):
          equivalent(
            evaluate_product(left, assignment),
            evaluate_product(right, assignment)),
        relation_node(symbol, arguments):
          large(
            LAMBDA (a: A):
              relation_interpretation(
                a,
                symbol,
                canonical_tuple(
                  LAMBDA (index: nat):
                    evaluate_product_fuel(
                      arguments,
                      assignment,
                      syntax_size(arguments) + 1,
                      index)(a),
                  symbol_arity(symbol)))),
        false_node:
          FALSE,
        implication_node(left, right):
          holds_product_fuel(left, assignment, fuel - 1)
            IMPLIES
          holds_product_fuel(right, assignment, fuel - 1),
        universal_node(body):
          FORALL (value: representative):
            is_representative(value)
              IMPLIES
                holds_product_fuel(
                  body,
                  LAMBDA (index: nat):
                    IF index = 0 THEN
                      value
                    ELSE
                      assignment(index - 1)
                    ENDIF,
                  fuel - 1),
        variable_node(index):
          FALSE,
        application_node(symbol, arguments):
          FALSE,
        argument_nil:
          FALSE,
        argument_cons(head, tail):
          FALSE
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  default_product_assignment: product_assignment =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      LAMBDA (a: A): default_element

  models_ultraproduct(phi: sentence): bool =
    holds_product_fuel(
      phi,
      default_product_assignment,
      syntax_size(phi) + 1)

  los_theorem: bool =
    (ultrafilter_laws AND family_of_nonempty_structures)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (phi: sentence):
          models_ultraproduct(phi)
            IFF
          large(LAMBDA (a: A): models_factor(a, phi))
END los_theorem_Q1535225

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1551745
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1551745), "Binomial inverse theorem": over an
  arbitrary ring, compatible finite rectangular matrices satisfy the binomial
  inverse identity under the three required two-sided invertibility
  assumptions. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1551745_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q1551745_zero : R;
  q1551745_one : R;
  q1551745_add : R -> R -> R;
  q1551745_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q1551745_neg : R -> R;
  q1551745_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q1551745_add x (q1551745_add y z) =
      q1551745_add (q1551745_add x y) z;
  q1551745_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q1551745_add x y = q1551745_add y x;
  q1551745_zero_add :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_add q1551745_zero x = x;
  q1551745_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_add x q1551745_zero = x;
  q1551745_neg_add :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_add (q1551745_neg x) x = q1551745_zero;
  q1551745_add_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_add x (q1551745_neg x) = q1551745_zero;
  q1551745_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q1551745_mul x (q1551745_mul y z) =
      q1551745_mul (q1551745_mul x y) z;
  q1551745_one_mul :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_mul q1551745_one x = x;
  q1551745_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_mul x q1551745_one = x;
  q1551745_mul_add :
    forall x y z : R,
      q1551745_mul x (q1551745_add y z) =
      q1551745_add
        (q1551745_mul x y)
        (q1551745_mul x z);
  q1551745_add_mul :
    forall x y z : R,
      q1551745_mul (q1551745_add x y) z =
      q1551745_add
        (q1551745_mul x z)
        (q1551745_mul y z);
  q1551745_zero_mul :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_mul q1551745_zero x = q1551745_zero;
  q1551745_mul_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q1551745_mul x q1551745_zero = q1551745_zero
}.

Arguments q1551745_zero {R} _.
Arguments q1551745_one {R} _.
Arguments q1551745_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q1551745_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q1551745_neg {R} _ _.

Record q1551745_finite_type (I : Type) : Type := {
  q1551745_enum : list I;
  q1551745_enum_nodup : NoDup q1551745_enum;
  q1551745_enum_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q1551745_enum;
  q1551745_eq_dec :
    forall i j : I, {i = j} + {i <> j}
}.

Arguments q1551745_enum {I} _.
Arguments q1551745_eq_dec {I} _ _ _.

Definition q1551745_matrix (I J R : Type) : Type :=
  I -> J -> R.

Definition q1551745_matrix_equal {I J R : Type}
    (A B : q1551745_matrix I J R) : Prop :=
  forall i j, A i j = B i j.

Fixpoint q1551745_sum_list {I R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (indices : list I)
    (term : I -> R) : R :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q1551745_zero ring
  | cons i rest =>
      q1551745_add ring
        (term i)
        (q1551745_sum_list ring rest term)
  end.

Definition q1551745_finite_sum {I R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (fin : q1551745_finite_type I)
    (term : I -> R) : R :=
  q1551745_sum_list ring (q1551745_enum fin) term.

Definition q1551745_identity_matrix {I R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (fin : q1551745_finite_type I) :
    q1551745_matrix I I R :=
  fun i j =>
    if q1551745_eq_dec fin i j
    then q1551745_one ring
    else q1551745_zero ring.

Definition q1551745_matrix_add {I J R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (A B : q1551745_matrix I J R) :
    q1551745_matrix I J R :=
  fun i j => q1551745_add ring (A i j) (B i j).

Definition q1551745_matrix_neg {I J R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (A : q1551745_matrix I J R) :
    q1551745_matrix I J R :=
  fun i j => q1551745_neg ring (A i j).

Definition q1551745_matrix_sub {I J R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (A B : q1551745_matrix I J R) :
    q1551745_matrix I J R :=
  q1551745_matrix_add ring A (q1551745_matrix_neg ring B).

Definition q1551745_matrix_mul {I J K R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (fin : q1551745_finite_type J)
    (A : q1551745_matrix I J R)
    (B : q1551745_matrix J K R) :
    q1551745_matrix I K R :=
  fun i k =>
    q1551745_finite_sum ring fin
      (fun j => q1551745_mul ring (A i j) (B j k)).

Record q1551745_invertible {I R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (fin : q1551745_finite_type I)
    (A : q1551745_matrix I I R) : Type := {
  q1551745_inverse : q1551745_matrix I I R;
  q1551745_inverse_mul_self :
    q1551745_matrix_equal
      (q1551745_matrix_mul ring fin q1551745_inverse A)
      (q1551745_identity_matrix ring fin);
  q1551745_mul_inverse_self :
    q1551745_matrix_equal
      (q1551745_matrix_mul ring fin A q1551745_inverse)
      (q1551745_identity_matrix ring fin)
}.

Arguments q1551745_inverse {I R ring fin A} _.

Definition q1551745_updated_matrix
    {N M R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (finM : q1551745_finite_type M)
    (A : q1551745_matrix N N R)
    (U : q1551745_matrix N M R)
    (C : q1551745_matrix M M R)
    (V : q1551745_matrix M N R) :
    q1551745_matrix N N R :=
  q1551745_matrix_add ring A
    (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM
      (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM U C)
      V).

Definition q1551745_auxiliary_matrix
    {N M R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (finN : q1551745_finite_type N)
    (finM : q1551745_finite_type M)
    (A_inverse : q1551745_matrix N N R)
    (U : q1551745_matrix N M R)
    (C : q1551745_matrix M M R)
    (V : q1551745_matrix M N R) :
    q1551745_matrix M M R :=
  q1551745_matrix_add ring C
    (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM
      (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finN
        (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finN
          (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM C V)
          A_inverse)
        U)
      C).

Definition q1551745_inverse_formula
    {N M R : Type}
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (finN : q1551745_finite_type N)
    (finM : q1551745_finite_type M)
    (A_inverse : q1551745_matrix N N R)
    (auxiliary_inverse : q1551745_matrix M M R)
    (U : q1551745_matrix N M R)
    (C : q1551745_matrix M M R)
    (V : q1551745_matrix M N R) :
    q1551745_matrix N N R :=
  q1551745_matrix_sub ring A_inverse
    (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finN
      (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM
        (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM
          (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM
            (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finM
              (q1551745_matrix_mul ring finN A_inverse U)
              C)
            auxiliary_inverse)
          C)
        V)
      A_inverse).

Theorem Matrix_invOf_add_mul_mul_prime :
  forall
    (R N M : Type)
    (ring : q1551745_ring R)
    (finN : q1551745_finite_type N)
    (finM : q1551745_finite_type M)
    (A : q1551745_matrix N N R)
    (U : q1551745_matrix N M R)
    (C : q1551745_matrix M M R)
    (V : q1551745_matrix M N R)
    (invertible_A : q1551745_invertible ring finN A)
    (invertible_auxiliary :
      q1551745_invertible ring finM
        (q1551745_auxiliary_matrix ring finN finM
          (q1551745_inverse invertible_A) U C V))
    (invertible_updated :
      q1551745_invertible ring finN
        (q1551745_updated_matrix ring finM A U C V)),
    q1551745_matrix_equal
      (q1551745_inverse invertible_updated)
      (q1551745_inverse_formula ring finN finM
        (q1551745_inverse invertible_A)
        (q1551745_inverse invertible_auxiliary)
        U C V).
Admitted.

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1551745
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1551745), "Binomial inverse theorem": for
  rectangular matrices over an arbitrary possibly trivial unital ring, the
  inverse of A + U*C*V has the binomial inverse formula whenever A, the inner
  correction matrix, and A + U*C*V have chosen two-sided inverses. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix = "'i \<Rightarrow> 'j \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q1551745_matrix_add ::
    "('a::ring, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix" where
  "q1551745_matrix_add A B = (\<lambda>i j. A i j + B i j)"

definition q1551745_matrix_sub ::
    "('a::ring, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix" where
  "q1551745_matrix_sub A B = (\<lambda>i j. A i j - B i j)"

definition q1551745_matrix_mult ::
    "'j set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a::ring, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'j, 'k) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'k) q1551745_matrix" where
  "q1551745_matrix_mult J A B =
    (\<lambda>i k. \<Sum>j\<in>J. A i j * B j k)"

definition q1551745_identity_matrix ::
    "'a::ring \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'i) q1551745_matrix" where
  "q1551745_identity_matrix u I =
    (\<lambda>i j. if i \<in> I \<and> j \<in> I \<and> i = j then u else 0)"

definition q1551745_matrix_eq ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> 'j set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1551745_matrix_eq I J A B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i\<in>I. \<forall>j\<in>J. A i j = B i j)"

definition q1551745_two_sided_inverse ::
    "'a::ring \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'i) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'i) q1551745_matrix \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1551745_two_sided_inverse u I A Ainv \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1551745_matrix_eq I I
      (q1551745_matrix_mult I Ainv A)
      (q1551745_identity_matrix u I) \<and>
    q1551745_matrix_eq I I
      (q1551745_matrix_mult I A Ainv)
      (q1551745_identity_matrix u I)"

theorem q1551745_binomial_inverse:
  fixes u :: "'a::ring"
    and I :: "'n set"
    and J :: "'m set"
    and A :: "('a, 'n, 'n) q1551745_matrix"
    and U :: "('a, 'n, 'm) q1551745_matrix"
    and C :: "('a, 'm, 'm) q1551745_matrix"
    and V :: "('a, 'm, 'n) q1551745_matrix"
    and Ainv :: "('a, 'n, 'n) q1551745_matrix"
    and Dinv :: "('a, 'm, 'm) q1551745_matrix"
    and Einv :: "('a, 'n, 'n) q1551745_matrix"
  assumes left_unit: "\<And>x. u * x = x"
    and right_unit: "\<And>x. x * u = x"
    and finite_I: "finite I"
    and finite_J: "finite J"
    and inverse_A: "q1551745_two_sided_inverse u I A Ainv"
    and inverse_D:
      "q1551745_two_sided_inverse u J
        (q1551745_matrix_add C
          (q1551745_matrix_mult J
            (q1551745_matrix_mult I
              (q1551745_matrix_mult I
                (q1551745_matrix_mult J C V) Ainv) U) C))
        Dinv"
    and inverse_E:
      "q1551745_two_sided_inverse u I
        (q1551745_matrix_add A
          (q1551745_matrix_mult J
            (q1551745_matrix_mult J U C) V))
        Einv"
  shows
    "q1551745_matrix_eq I I Einv
      (q1551745_matrix_sub Ainv
        (q1551745_matrix_mult I
          (q1551745_matrix_mult J
            (q1551745_matrix_mult J
              (q1551745_matrix_mult J
                (q1551745_matrix_mult J
                  (q1551745_matrix_mult I Ainv U) C) Dinv) C) V)
          Ainv))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1551745
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1551745), "Binomial inverse theorem": the
  inverse of A + U C V over an arbitrary noncommutative ring is expressed in
  terms of the inverses of A and C + C V A^-1 U C. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q1551745_noncommutative_ring = new_definition
 `q1551745_noncommutative_ring
    (zero:A) (unity:A) (neg:A->A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) <=>
    (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
    (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
    (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
    (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
    (!x y z:A. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
    (!x:A. mul unity x = x) /\
    (!x:A. mul x unity = x) /\
    (!x y z:A. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
    (!x y z:A. mul (add x y) z = add (mul x z) (mul y z))`;;

let q1551745_matrix_eq = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_eq (rows:I->bool) (cols:J->bool)
                     (x:I->J->A) (y:I->J->A) <=>
    !i j. i IN rows /\ j IN cols ==> x i j = y i j`;;

let q1551745_matrix_add = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_add (add:A->A->A)
                      (x:I->J->A) (y:I->J->A) =
    \i j. add (x i j) (y i j)`;;

let q1551745_matrix_sub = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_sub (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
                      (x:I->J->A) (y:I->J->A) =
    \i j. add (x i j) (neg (y i j))`;;

let q1551745_matrix_mul = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_mul (middle:K->bool)
                      (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
                      (x:I->K->A) (y:K->J->A) =
    \i j. iterate add middle (\k. mul (x i k) (y k j))`;;

let q1551745_matrix_one = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_one (zero:A) (unity:A) (i:I) (j:I) =
    if i = j then unity else zero`;;

let q1551745_matrix_invertible = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_invertible
    (indices:I->bool) (zero:A) (unity:A)
    (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) (x:I->I->A) <=>
    ?y:I->I->A.
      q1551745_matrix_eq indices indices
        (q1551745_matrix_mul indices add mul x y)
        (q1551745_matrix_one zero unity) /\
      q1551745_matrix_eq indices indices
        (q1551745_matrix_mul indices add mul y x)
        (q1551745_matrix_one zero unity)`;;

let q1551745_matrix_inv = new_definition
 `q1551745_matrix_inv
    (indices:I->bool) (zero:A) (unity:A)
    (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) (x:I->I->A) =
    @y:I->I->A.
      q1551745_matrix_eq indices indices
        (q1551745_matrix_mul indices add mul x y)
        (q1551745_matrix_one zero unity) /\
      q1551745_matrix_eq indices indices
        (q1551745_matrix_mul indices add mul y x)
        (q1551745_matrix_one zero unity)`;;

let Q1551745_BINOMIAL_INVERSE_THEOREM =
 `!zero:A. !unity:A. !neg:A->A. !add:A->A->A. !mul:A->A->A.
  !nindex:N->bool. !mindex:M->bool.
    q1551745_noncommutative_ring zero unity neg add mul /\
    FINITE nindex /\ FINITE mindex
    ==>
    !a:N->N->A. !u:N->M->A. !c:M->M->A. !v:M->N->A.
      let ainv =
        q1551745_matrix_inv nindex zero unity add mul a in
      let d =
        q1551745_matrix_add add c
          (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul
            (q1551745_matrix_mul nindex add mul
              (q1551745_matrix_mul nindex add mul
                (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul c v) ainv) u) c) in
      let dinv =
        q1551745_matrix_inv mindex zero unity add mul d in
      let s =
        q1551745_matrix_add add a
          (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul
            (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul u c) v) in
      let correction =
        q1551745_matrix_mul nindex add mul
          (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul
            (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul
              (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul
                (q1551745_matrix_mul mindex add mul
                  (q1551745_matrix_mul nindex add mul ainv u) c) dinv) c) v)
          ainv in
      q1551745_matrix_invertible nindex zero unity add mul a /\
      q1551745_matrix_invertible mindex zero unity add mul d /\
      q1551745_matrix_invertible nindex zero unity add mul s
      ==>
      q1551745_matrix_eq nindex nindex
        (q1551745_matrix_inv nindex zero unity add mul s)
        (q1551745_matrix_sub add neg ainv correction)`;;

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems artifact Q1551745,
;; "Binomial inverse theorem": over an arbitrary unital ring and finite
;; matrices, the inverse of A + U*C*V has the binomial inverse formula when
;; A, C + C*V*A^{-1}*U*C, and A + U*C*V are invertible. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A ring tag selects an arbitrary carrier and its operations. Lean's Ring
;; permits noncommutative multiplication and the trivial ring, so neither
;; commutativity nor zero /= one is assumed.

(defstub q1551745-ring-element-p (ring value) t)
(defstub q1551745-ring-zero (ring) t)
(defstub q1551745-ring-one (ring) t)
(defstub q1551745-ring-negate (ring value) t)
(defstub q1551745-ring-add (ring left right) t)
(defstub q1551745-ring-multiply (ring left right) t)

(defun-sk q1551745-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1551745-ring-element-p ring x)
      (let ((zero (q1551745-ring-zero ring))
            (one (q1551745-ring-one ring))
            (negative (q1551745-ring-negate ring x)))
        (and
         (q1551745-ring-element-p ring negative)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-add ring x zero) x)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-add ring zero x) x)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-add ring x negative) zero)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-add ring negative x) zero)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x one) x)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-multiply ring one x) x)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x zero) zero)
         (equal (q1551745-ring-multiply ring zero x) zero))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1551745-ring-element-p ring x)
       (q1551745-ring-element-p ring y))
      (and
       (q1551745-ring-element-p
        ring (q1551745-ring-add ring x y))
       (q1551745-ring-element-p
        ring (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x y))
       (equal
        (q1551745-ring-add ring x y)
        (q1551745-ring-add ring y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1551745-ring-element-p ring x)
       (q1551745-ring-element-p ring y)
       (q1551745-ring-element-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1551745-ring-add
         ring (q1551745-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q1551745-ring-add
         ring x (q1551745-ring-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q1551745-ring-multiply
         ring (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x y) z)
        (q1551745-ring-multiply
         ring x (q1551745-ring-multiply ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q1551745-ring-multiply
         ring x (q1551745-ring-add ring y z))
        (q1551745-ring-add
         ring
         (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x y)
         (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x z)))
       (equal
        (q1551745-ring-multiply
         ring (q1551745-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q1551745-ring-add
         ring
         (q1551745-ring-multiply ring x z)
         (q1551745-ring-multiply ring y z))))))))

(defun q1551745-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (q1551745-ring-element-p
    ring (q1551745-ring-zero ring))
   (q1551745-ring-element-p
    ring (q1551745-ring-one ring))
   (q1551745-ring-laws-p ring)))

;; Choosing enumerations of the two finite Lean index types identifies their
;; matrix function spaces with exact rectangular tables of the corresponding
;; cardinalities. The shape and carrier checks make this representation
;; bidirectionally faithful.

(defun q1551745-matrix-row-p (ring row column-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix column-count)))
  (if (zp column-count)
      (equal row nil)
    (and
     (consp row)
     (q1551745-ring-element-p ring (car row))
     (q1551745-matrix-row-p
      ring (cdr row) (- column-count 1)))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-p
    (ring matrix row-count column-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix row-count)))
  (if (zp row-count)
      (equal matrix nil)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (q1551745-matrix-row-p
      ring (car matrix) column-count)
     (q1551745-matrix-p
      ring (cdr matrix) (- row-count 1) column-count))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-entry (matrix row column)
  (nth column (nth row matrix)))

(defun q1551745-matrix-add-row (ring left right remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-ring-add ring (car left) (car right))
     (q1551745-matrix-add-row
      ring (cdr left) (cdr right) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-add
    (ring left right row-count column-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix row-count)))
  (if (zp row-count)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-matrix-add-row
      ring (car left) (car right) column-count)
     (q1551745-matrix-add
      ring (cdr left) (cdr right)
      (- row-count 1) column-count))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-negate-row (ring row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-ring-negate ring (car row))
     (q1551745-matrix-negate-row
      ring (cdr row) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-negate
    (ring matrix row-count column-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix row-count)))
  (if (zp row-count)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-matrix-negate-row
      ring (car matrix) column-count)
     (q1551745-matrix-negate
      ring (cdr matrix) (- row-count 1) column-count))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-subtract
    (ring left right row-count column-count)
  (q1551745-matrix-add
   ring
   left
   (q1551745-matrix-negate
    ring right row-count column-count)
   row-count
   column-count))

;; Matrix multiplication uses the source order of multiplication; no
;; commutativity of ring multiplication is introduced.

(defun q1551745-dot-product-from
    (ring left right row column index remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (q1551745-ring-zero ring)
    (q1551745-ring-add
     ring
     (q1551745-ring-multiply
      ring
      (q1551745-matrix-entry left row index)
      (q1551745-matrix-entry right index column))
     (q1551745-dot-product-from
      ring left right row column
      (+ index 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-product-row
    (ring left right row inner-count column column-count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix column-count)))
  (if (zp column-count)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-dot-product-from
      ring left right row column 0 inner-count)
     (q1551745-matrix-product-row
      ring left right row inner-count
      (+ column 1) (- column-count 1)))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-product-rows
    (ring left right row inner-count
     total-column-count remaining-rows)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining-rows)))
  (if (zp remaining-rows)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-matrix-product-row
      ring left right row inner-count 0 total-column-count)
     (q1551745-matrix-product-rows
      ring left right (+ row 1) inner-count
      total-column-count (- remaining-rows 1)))))

(defun q1551745-matrix-multiply
    (ring left right row-count inner-count column-count)
  (q1551745-matrix-product-rows
   ring left right 0 inner-count column-count row-count))

(defun q1551745-identity-row
    (ring row column remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (if (equal row column)
         (q1551745-ring-one ring)
       (q1551745-ring-zero ring))
     (q1551745-identity-row
      ring row (+ column 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1551745-identity-rows
    (ring dimension row remaining)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q1551745-identity-row ring row 0 dimension)
     (q1551745-identity-rows
      ring dimension (+ row 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q1551745-identity-matrix (ring dimension)
  (q1551745-identity-rows ring dimension 0 dimension))

;; This is exactly the data carried by Lean's Invertible instance: a selected
;; inverse with both inverse identities.

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1551745,
-- "Binomial inverse theorem": for finite-indexed matrices over a ring, the
-- inverse of A + UCV has the standard binomial inverse form under the stated
-- invertibility assumptions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record FiniteIndex
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    size : Nat
    toFin : I -> Fin size
    fromFin : Fin size -> I
    to-from :
      (k : Fin size) ->
      toFin (fromFin k) == k
    from-to :
      (x : I) ->
      fromFin (toFin x) == x

open FiniteIndex

record Ring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

open Ring

Matrix :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  Set i ->
  Set j ->
  Set r ->
  Set (i ⊔ j ⊔ r)
Matrix I J R =
  I -> J -> R

MatrixEqual :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Set (i ⊔ j ⊔ r)
MatrixEqual {I = I} {J = J} A B =
  (row : I) ->
  (column : J) ->
  A row column == B row column

finEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

select :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
select true yes no =
  yes
select false yes no =
  no

sumFin :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Ring R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin ring {zero} term =
  zeroR ring
sumFin ring {suc n} term =
  addR ring
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin ring (\ k -> term (fsuc k)))

sumIndex :
  {i r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  Ring R ->
  (I -> R) ->
  R
sumIndex finite ring term =
  sumFin ring (\ k -> term (fromFin finite k))

identityMatrix :
  {i r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix I I R
identityMatrix finite ring row column =
  select
    (finEqual (toFin finite row) (toFin finite column))
    (oneR ring)
    (zeroR ring)

matrixAdd :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R
matrixAdd ring A B row column =
  addR ring (A row column) (B row column)

matrixNegate :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R
matrixNegate ring A row column =
  negateR ring (A row column)

matrixSubtract :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R
matrixSubtract ring A B =
  matrixAdd ring A (matrixNegate ring B)

matrixMultiply :
  {i j k r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex K ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix I K R ->
  Matrix K J R ->
  Matrix I J R
matrixMultiply finite ring A B row column =
  sumIndex finite ring
    (\ middle ->
      multiplyR ring
        (A row middle)
        (B middle column))

record Invertible
  {i r : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {R : Set r}
  (finite : FiniteIndex I)
  (ring : Ring R)
  (A : Matrix I I R) :
  Set (lsuc (i ⊔ r)) where

  field
    inverse : Matrix I I R
    inverse-multiply :
      MatrixEqual
        (matrixMultiply finite ring inverse A)
        (identityMatrix finite ring)
    multiply-inverse :
      MatrixEqual
        (matrixMultiply finite ring A inverse)
        (identityMatrix finite ring)

open Invertible

binomialSum :
  {n m r : Level} ->
  {N : Set n} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex M ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix N N R ->
  Matrix N M R ->
  Matrix M M R ->
  Matrix M N R ->
  Matrix N N R
binomialSum finiteM ring A U C V =
  matrixAdd ring A
    (matrixMultiply finiteM ring
      (matrixMultiply finiteM ring U C)
      V)

binomialAuxiliary :
  {n m r : Level} ->
  {N : Set n} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex N ->
  FiniteIndex M ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix N N R ->
  Matrix N M R ->
  Matrix M M R ->
  Matrix M N R ->
  Matrix N N R ->
  Matrix M M R
binomialAuxiliary finiteN finiteM ring A U C V inverseA =
  matrixAdd ring C
    (matrixMultiply finiteM ring
      (matrixMultiply finiteN ring
        (matrixMultiply finiteN ring
          (matrixMultiply finiteM ring C V)
          inverseA)
        U)
      C)

binomialCorrection :
  {n m r : Level} ->
  {N : Set n} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex N ->
  FiniteIndex M ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix N N R ->
  Matrix N M R ->
  Matrix M M R ->
  Matrix M M R ->
  Matrix M N R ->
  Matrix N N R
binomialCorrection finiteN finiteM ring inverseA U C inverseAuxiliary V =
  matrixMultiply finiteN ring
    (matrixMultiply finiteM ring
      (matrixMultiply finiteM ring
        (matrixMultiply finiteM ring
          (matrixMultiply finiteM ring
            (matrixMultiply finiteN ring inverseA U)
            C)
          inverseAuxiliary)
        C)
      V)
    inverseA

binomialInverseExpression :
  {n m r : Level} ->
  {N : Set n} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex N ->
  FiniteIndex M ->
  Ring R ->
  Matrix N N R ->
  Matrix N M R ->
  Matrix M M R ->
  Matrix M M R ->
  Matrix M N R ->
  Matrix N N R
binomialInverseExpression finiteN finiteM ring inverseA U C inverseAuxiliary V =
  matrixSubtract ring inverseA
    (binomialCorrection
      finiteN finiteM ring inverseA U C inverseAuxiliary V)

binomial-inverse-theorem : Setω
binomial-inverse-theorem =
  {n m r : Level} ->
  (N : Set n) ->
  (finiteN : FiniteIndex N) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (finiteM : FiniteIndex M) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (ring : Ring R) ->
  (A : Matrix N N R) ->
  (U : Matrix N M R) ->
  (C : Matrix M M R) ->
  (V : Matrix M N R) ->
  (invertibleA : Invertible finiteN ring A) ->
  (invertibleAuxiliary :
    Invertible finiteM ring
      (binomialAuxiliary
        finiteN finiteM ring A U C V
        (inverse invertibleA))) ->
  (invertibleSum :
    Invertible finiteN ring
      (binomialSum finiteM ring A U C V)) ->
  MatrixEqual
    (inverse invertibleSum)
    (binomialInverseExpression
      finiteN finiteM ring
      (inverse invertibleA)
      U C
      (inverse invertibleAuxiliary)
      V)

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1551745, "Binomial inverse theorem": over an arbitrary ring and arbitrary
  finite row and column index types, three matrix invertibility assumptions
  imply the binomial inverse formula for A + U*C*V. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q1551745_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_ring_def",
  ``q1551745_ring
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (negR : 'a -> 'a)
      (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x. addR zeroR x = x /\ addR x zeroR = x) /\
      (!x. addR (negR x) x = zeroR /\ addR x (negR x) = zeroR) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x. mulR oneR x = x /\ mulR x oneR = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (addR x y) z = addR (mulR x z) (mulR y z))``);

val q1551745_matrix_eq_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_matrix_eq_def",
  ``q1551745_matrix_eq
      (rows : 'i set) (cols : 'j set)
      (M : 'i -> 'j -> 'a) (N : 'i -> 'j -> 'a) <=>
      !i j. i IN rows /\ j IN cols ==> M i j = N i j``);

val q1551745_matrix_one_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_matrix_one_def",
  ``q1551745_matrix_one
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a) (s : 'i set) (i : 'i) (j : 'i) =
      if i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i = j then oneR else zeroR``);

val q1551745_matrix_add_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_matrix_add_def",
  ``q1551745_matrix_add
      (zeroR : 'a) (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (rows : 'i set) (cols : 'j set)
      (M : 'i -> 'j -> 'a) (N : 'i -> 'j -> 'a)
      (i : 'i) (j : 'j) =
      if i IN rows /\ j IN cols then addR (M i j) (N i j) else zeroR``);

val q1551745_matrix_sub_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_matrix_sub_def",
  ``q1551745_matrix_sub
      (zeroR : 'a) (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (negR : 'a -> 'a)
      (rows : 'i set) (cols : 'j set)
      (M : 'i -> 'j -> 'a) (N : 'i -> 'j -> 'a)
      (i : 'i) (j : 'j) =
      if i IN rows /\ j IN cols
      then addR (M i j) (negR (N i j))
      else zeroR``);

val q1551745_matrix_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_matrix_mul_def",
  ``q1551745_matrix_mul
      (zeroR : 'a) (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (rows : 'i set) (inner : 'j set) (cols : 'k set)
      (M : 'i -> 'j -> 'a) (N : 'j -> 'k -> 'a)
      (i : 'i) (k : 'k) =
      if i IN rows /\ k IN cols
      then
        ITSET
          (\j acc. addR (mulR (M i j) (N j k)) acc)
          inner zeroR
      else zeroR``);

val q1551745_matrix_inverse_def = new_definition (
  "q1551745_matrix_inverse_def",
  ``q1551745_matrix_inverse
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'i set) (M : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (Minv : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) <=>
      q1551745_matrix_eq s s
        (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s s s M Minv)
        (q1551745_matrix_one zeroR oneR s) /\
      q1551745_matrix_eq s s
        (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s s s Minv M)
        (q1551745_matrix_one zeroR oneR s)``);

val binomial_inverse_theorem =
  ``!(zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (negR : 'a -> 'a)
      (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'n set) (t : 'm set)
      (A : 'n -> 'n -> 'a) (U : 'n -> 'm -> 'a)
      (C : 'm -> 'm -> 'a) (V : 'm -> 'n -> 'a)
      (Ainv : 'n -> 'n -> 'a) (Dinv : 'm -> 'm -> 'a)
      (Binv : 'n -> 'n -> 'a).
      let B =
        q1551745_matrix_add zeroR addR s s A
          (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s t s
            (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s t t U C) V)
      in
      let D =
        q1551745_matrix_add zeroR addR t t C
          (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR t t t
            (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR t s t
              (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR t s s
                (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR t t s C V) Ainv)
              U)
            C)
      in
      let correction =
        q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s s s
          (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s t s
            (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s t t
              (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s t t
                (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s t t
                  (q1551745_matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s s t Ainv U) C)
                Dinv)
              C)
            V)
          Ainv
      in
        q1551745_ring zeroR oneR addR negR mulR /\
        FINITE s /\
        FINITE t /\
        q1551745_matrix_inverse zeroR oneR addR mulR s A Ainv /\
        q1551745_matrix_inverse zeroR oneR addR mulR t D Dinv /\
        q1551745_matrix_inverse zeroR oneR addR mulR s B Binv
        ==>
        q1551745_matrix_eq s s Binv
          (q1551745_matrix_sub zeroR addR negR s s Ainv correction)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1551745
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1551745), "Binomial inverse theorem": over
  every ring and arbitrary finite matrix index carriers, chosen two-sided
  inverses satisfy the binomial inverse matrix identity. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1551745Mul is multiplication of compatible rectangular matrices over R.
  Q1551745Add and Q1551745Neg are addition and additive inverse in a square
  matrix ring. Q1551745Inv R I A X says that X is the chosen two-sided inverse
  of the square matrix A.

  The final assertion quantifies over the three inverse witnesses carried by
  Lean's Invertible instances: X for A, Y for
  C + C V X U C, and Z for A + U C V. Its implication assumes exactly the
  two inverse equations supplied by each instance and concludes the source
  identity for Z. All auxiliary $a declarations are syntax or faithful
  definitions; the final $a is the single unproved corpus statement, and this
  file contains no $p declaration.
$)

$c Q1551745Mul Q1551745Add Q1551745Neg Q1551745Inv $.

q1551745-mul-syntax $a class
  ( Q1551745Mul R I J K A B ) $.
q1551745-add-syntax $a class
  ( Q1551745Add R I A B ) $.
q1551745-neg-syntax $a class
  ( Q1551745Neg R I A ) $.
q1551745-inv-syntax $a wff
  ( Q1551745Inv R I A B ) $.

${
  $d A B I J K R $.

  q1551745-mul-definition $a |-
    ( Q1551745Mul R I J K A B )
    =
    ( A ( R maMul <. I , J , K >. ) B )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B I R $.

  q1551745-add-definition $a |-
    ( Q1551745Add R I A B )
    =
    ( A ( +g ` ( I Mat R ) ) B )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A I R $.

  q1551745-neg-definition $a |-
    ( Q1551745Neg R I A )
    =
    ( ( invg ` ( I Mat R ) ) ` A )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B I R $.

  q1551745-inv-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1551745Inv R I A B )
    <->
    (
      ( Q1551745Mul R I I I B A )
      =
      ( 1r ` ( I Mat R ) )
      /\
      ( Q1551745Mul R I I I A B )
      =
      ( 1r ` ( I Mat R ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A C M N R U V X Y Z $.

  thousand-theorems-q1551745-binomial-inverse-theorem $a |-
    A. R e. Ring
      A. N e. Fin
        A. M e. Fin
          A. A e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( N X. N ) )
            A. U e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( N X. M ) )
              A. C e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( M X. M ) )
                A. V e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( M X. N ) )
                  A. X e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( N X. N ) )
                    A. Y e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( M X. M ) )
                      A. Z e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( N X. N ) )
                        (
                          (
                            ( Q1551745Inv R N A X )
                            /\
                            (
                              Q1551745Inv R M
                              (
                                Q1551745Add R M C
                                (
                                  Q1551745Mul R M M M
                                  (
                                    Q1551745Mul R M N M
                                    (
                                      Q1551745Mul R M N N
                                      ( Q1551745Mul R M M N C V )
                                      X
                                    )
                                    U
                                  )
                                  C
                                )
                              )
                              Y
                            )
                            /\
                            (
                              Q1551745Inv R N
                              (
                                Q1551745Add R N A
                                (
                                  Q1551745Mul R N M N
                                  ( Q1551745Mul R N M M U C )
                                  V
                                )
                              )
                              Z
                            )
                          )
                          ->
                          Z
                          =
                          (
                            Q1551745Add R N X
                            (
                              Q1551745Neg R N
                              (
                                Q1551745Mul R N N N
                                (
                                  Q1551745Mul R N M N
                                  (
                                    Q1551745Mul R N M M
                                    (
                                      Q1551745Mul R N M M
                                      (
                                        Q1551745Mul R N M M
                                        ( Q1551745Mul R N N M X U )
                                        C
                                      )
                                      Y
                                    )
                                    C
                                  )
                                  V
                                )
                                X
                              )
                            )
                          )
                        )
  $.
$}

title: Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1551745
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1551745), "Binomial inverse theorem": over an
% arbitrary ring and arbitrary finite row and column index types, it gives the
% inverse of A + U C V from inverses of A and C + C V A^-1 U C. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem[
  N, M: TYPE,
  R: TYPE+,
  zeroR, oneR: R,
  negR: [R -> R],
  addR, mulR: [R, R -> R],
  n_count, m_count: nat,
  n_enumeration: [below(n_count) -> N],
  m_enumeration: [below(m_count) -> M],
  sumN: [[N -> R] -> R],
  sumM: [[M -> R] -> R],
  A: [N, N -> R],
  U: [N, M -> R],
  C: [M, M -> R],
  V: [M, N -> R],
  inverse_A: [N, N -> R],
  inverse_inner: [M, M -> R],
  inverse_total: [N, N -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[N], finite_sets[M]

  matrix_nn: TYPE = [N, N -> R]
  matrix_nm: TYPE = [N, M -> R]
  matrix_mn: TYPE = [M, N -> R]
  matrix_mm: TYPE = [M, M -> R]

  ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R):
      addR(zeroR, x) = x
        AND addR(x, zeroR) = x
        AND addR(negR(x), x) = zeroR
        AND addR(x, negR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R):
      mulR(oneR, x) = x
        AND mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mulR(x, addR(y, z)) =
        addR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mulR(addR(x, y), z) =
        addR(mulR(x, z), mulR(y, z)))

  sumN_laws: bool =
    FORALL (values: [N -> R]):
      EXISTS (partial_sums: [upto(n_count) -> R]):
        partial_sums(0) = zeroR
          AND
        (FORALL (position: below(n_count)):
          partial_sums(position + 1) =
            addR(
              partial_sums(position),
              values(n_enumeration(position))))
          AND sumN(values) = partial_sums(n_count)

  sumM_laws: bool =
    FORALL (values: [M -> R]):
      EXISTS (partial_sums: [upto(m_count) -> R]):
        partial_sums(0) = zeroR
          AND
        (FORALL (position: below(m_count)):
          partial_sums(position + 1) =
            addR(
              partial_sums(position),
              values(m_enumeration(position))))
          AND sumM(values) = partial_sums(m_count)

  identity_nn: matrix_nn =
    LAMBDA (row, column: N):
      IF row = column THEN oneR ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  identity_mm: matrix_mm =
    LAMBDA (row, column: M):
      IF row = column THEN oneR ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  add_nn(X, Y: matrix_nn): matrix_nn =
    LAMBDA (row, column: N):
      addR(X(row, column), Y(row, column))

  add_mm(X, Y: matrix_mm): matrix_mm =
    LAMBDA (row, column: M):
      addR(X(row, column), Y(row, column))

  neg_nn(X: matrix_nn): matrix_nn =
    LAMBDA (row, column: N):
      negR(X(row, column))

  sub_nn(X, Y: matrix_nn): matrix_nn =
    add_nn(X, neg_nn(Y))

  mul_nn_nn(X, Y: matrix_nn): matrix_nn =
    LAMBDA (row, column: N):
      sumN(
        LAMBDA (index: N):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_nn_nm(X: matrix_nn, Y: matrix_nm): matrix_nm =
    LAMBDA (row: N), (column: M):
      sumN(
        LAMBDA (index: N):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_nm_mm(X: matrix_nm, Y: matrix_mm): matrix_nm =
    LAMBDA (row: N), (column: M):
      sumM(
        LAMBDA (index: M):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_nm_mn(X: matrix_nm, Y: matrix_mn): matrix_nn =
    LAMBDA (row, column: N):
      sumM(
        LAMBDA (index: M):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_mm_mm(X, Y: matrix_mm): matrix_mm =
    LAMBDA (row, column: M):
      sumM(
        LAMBDA (index: M):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_mm_mn(X: matrix_mm, Y: matrix_mn): matrix_mn =
    LAMBDA (row: M), (column: N):
      sumM(
        LAMBDA (index: M):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_mn_nn(X: matrix_mn, Y: matrix_nn): matrix_mn =
    LAMBDA (row: M), (column: N):
      sumN(
        LAMBDA (index: N):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  mul_mn_nm(X: matrix_mn, Y: matrix_nm): matrix_mm =
    LAMBDA (row, column: M):
      sumN(
        LAMBDA (index: N):
          mulR(X(row, index), Y(index, column)))

  invertible_nn(X, X_inverse: matrix_nn): bool =
    mul_nn_nn(X_inverse, X) = identity_nn
      AND mul_nn_nn(X, X_inverse) = identity_nn

  invertible_mm(X, X_inverse: matrix_mm): bool =
    mul_mm_mm(X_inverse, X) = identity_mm
      AND mul_mm_mm(X, X_inverse) = identity_mm

  U_C: matrix_nm =
    mul_nm_mm(U, C)

  U_C_V: matrix_nn =
    mul_nm_mn(U_C, V)

  total_matrix: matrix_nn =
    add_nn(A, U_C_V)

  C_V: matrix_mn =
    mul_mm_mn(C, V)

  C_V_inverse_A: matrix_mn =
    mul_mn_nn(C_V, inverse_A)

  C_V_inverse_A_U: matrix_mm =
    mul_mn_nm(C_V_inverse_A, U)

  C_V_inverse_A_U_C: matrix_mm =
    mul_mm_mm(C_V_inverse_A_U, C)

  inner_matrix: matrix_mm =
    add_mm(C, C_V_inverse_A_U_C)

  inverse_A_U: matrix_nm =
    mul_nn_nm(inverse_A, U)

  inverse_A_U_C: matrix_nm =
    mul_nm_mm(inverse_A_U, C)

  inverse_A_U_C_inverse_inner: matrix_nm =
    mul_nm_mm(inverse_A_U_C, inverse_inner)

  inverse_A_U_C_inverse_inner_C: matrix_nm =
    mul_nm_mm(inverse_A_U_C_inverse_inner, C)

  inverse_A_U_C_inverse_inner_C_V: matrix_nn =
    mul_nm_mn(inverse_A_U_C_inverse_inner_C, V)

  correction: matrix_nn =
    mul_nn_nn(inverse_A_U_C_inverse_inner_C_V, inverse_A)

  binomial_inverse_theorem: bool =
    (ring_laws
      AND bijective?(n_enumeration)
      AND bijective?(m_enumeration)
      AND sumN_laws
      AND sumM_laws
      AND invertible_nn(A, inverse_A)
      AND invertible_mm(inner_matrix, inverse_inner)
      AND invertible_nn(total_matrix, inverse_total))
    IMPLIES
      inverse_total = sub_nn(inverse_A, correction)
END Q1551745_binomial_inverse_theorem

module

@[expose] public section

    (s : Set (Set M)) (sfin : s.Finite) (scov : Hindman.FP a ⊆ ⋃₀ s) :

title: Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1566341
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1566341), "Hindman's theorem": every finite
  cover of the finite-product set of an infinite stream in a semigroup has a
  member containing the finite-product set of another infinite stream. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q1566341_stream (M : Type) : Type := nat -> M.

Definition q1566341_stream_tail
    {M : Type} (a : q1566341_stream M) : q1566341_stream M :=
  fun n => a (S n).

Inductive q1566341_FP
    {M : Type}
    (mul : M -> M -> M) :
    q1566341_stream M -> M -> Prop :=
| q1566341_FP_head :
    forall a : q1566341_stream M,
      q1566341_FP mul a (a 0)
| q1566341_FP_tail :
    forall (a : q1566341_stream M) (m : M),
      q1566341_FP mul (q1566341_stream_tail a) m ->
      q1566341_FP mul a m
| q1566341_FP_cons :
    forall (a : q1566341_stream M) (m : M),
      q1566341_FP mul (q1566341_stream_tail a) m ->
      q1566341_FP mul a (mul (a 0) m).

Definition q1566341_set_equiv
    {M : Type} (c d : M -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x : M, c x <-> d x.

Definition q1566341_finite
    {M : Type} (s : (M -> Prop) -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists members : list (M -> Prop),
    forall c : M -> Prop,
      s c <->
      exists d : M -> Prop,
        In d members /\ q1566341_set_equiv c d.

Theorem q1566341_FP_partition_regular :
  forall (M : Type)
         (mul : M -> M -> M),
    (forall x y z : M,
      mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) ->
    forall (a : q1566341_stream M)
           (s : (M -> Prop) -> Prop),
      q1566341_finite s ->
      (forall m : M,
        q1566341_FP mul a m ->
        exists c : M -> Prop, s c /\ c m) ->
      exists c : M -> Prop,
        s c /\
        exists b : q1566341_stream M,
          forall m : M, q1566341_FP mul b m -> c m.
Admitted.

title: Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1566341 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1566341), "Hindman's theorem": in
  any finite cover of the finite-product set of an infinite sequence in a
  semigroup, one cell contains the finite-product set of another infinite
  sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

inductive q1566341_FP ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::semigroup_mult) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    head: "q1566341_FP a (a 0)"
  | tail:
      "q1566341_FP (\<lambda>n. a (Suc n)) x \<Longrightarrow>
        q1566341_FP a x"
  | cons:
      "q1566341_FP (\<lambda>n. a (Suc n)) x \<Longrightarrow>
        q1566341_FP a (a 0 * x)"

theorem FP_partition_regular:
  fixes a :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::semigroup_mult"
    and s :: "'a set set"
  assumes sfin: "finite s"
    and scov: "{x. q1566341_FP a x} \<subseteq> \<Union>s"
  shows "\<exists>c \<in> s. \<exists>b :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a.
    {x. q1566341_FP b x} \<subseteq> c"
  sorry

end

title: Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1566341,
  "Hindman's theorem": in every finite cover of the finite-products set of an
  infinite sequence in a semigroup, one member contains the finite-products
  set of another infinite sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1566341_HINDMAN_S_THEOREM =
  `let finite_products =
     \(op:A->A->A) (a:num->A).
       {x:A |
          ?indices:num list.
            ~(indices = []) /\
            PAIRWISE (\i j:num. i < j) indices /\
            x =
            ITLIST op (MAP a (BUTLAST indices)) (a (LAST indices))} in
   !op:A->A->A. !a:num->A. !s:(A->bool)->bool.
     (!x y z:A. op (op x y) z = op x (op y z)) /\
     FINITE s /\
     finite_products op a SUBSET UNIONS s
     ==> ?c:A->bool.
           c IN s /\
           ?b:num->A. finite_products op b SUBSET c`;;

title: Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1566341,
;; "Hindman's theorem": for any stream in a semigroup, every finite cover of
;; its nonempty finite-product set has a cell containing the finite-product
;; set of another infinite stream. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic interfaces interpret semigroup structures, streams,
;; subsets, and families of subsets without enumerating their carriers or
;; replacing sets and functions by finite tables. DEFUN-SK keeps the cover
;; cell and infinite-stream witness inside the conclusion.

(defstub q1566341-carrier-member-p (semigroup value) t)
(defstub q1566341-multiply (semigroup left right) t)
(defstub q1566341-sequence-value (semigroup sequence index) t)
(defstub q1566341-set-member-p (semigroup set value) t)
(defstub q1566341-family-member-p (semigroup family set) t)

;; Semigroup structure and streams over its carrier.

(defun-sk q1566341-semigroup-laws-p (semigroup)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1566341-carrier-member-p semigroup x)
       (q1566341-carrier-member-p semigroup y))
      (q1566341-carrier-member-p
       semigroup
       (q1566341-multiply semigroup x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1566341-carrier-member-p semigroup x)
       (q1566341-carrier-member-p semigroup y)
       (q1566341-carrier-member-p semigroup z))
      (equal
       (q1566341-multiply
        semigroup
        x
        (q1566341-multiply semigroup y z))
       (q1566341-multiply
        semigroup
        (q1566341-multiply semigroup x y)
        z))))))

(defun q1566341-semigroup-p (semigroup)
  (q1566341-semigroup-laws-p semigroup))

(defun-sk q1566341-sequence-in-carrier-p (semigroup sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q1566341-carrier-member-p
      semigroup
      (q1566341-sequence-value
       semigroup sequence index)))))

(defun q1566341-stream-p (semigroup sequence)
  (q1566341-sequence-in-carrier-p semigroup sequence))

;; A nonempty strictly increasing list of natural indices represents a
;; nonempty finite subsequence. Its product is associated to the right;
;; associativity makes this exactly the inductive FP set in the Lean source.

(defun q1566341-increasing-index-list-p (indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (natp (car indices))
       (if (consp (cdr indices))
           (and
            (< (car indices) (cadr indices))
            (q1566341-increasing-index-list-p (cdr indices)))
         (equal (cdr indices) nil)))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun q1566341-finite-product (semigroup sequence indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (if (consp (cdr indices))
          (q1566341-multiply
           semigroup
           (q1566341-sequence-value
            semigroup sequence (car indices))
           (q1566341-finite-product
            semigroup sequence (cdr indices)))
        (q1566341-sequence-value
         semigroup sequence (car indices)))
    nil))

(defun-sk q1566341-fp-member-p
    (semigroup sequence value)
  (exists (indices)
    (and
     (true-listp indices)
     (consp indices)
     (q1566341-increasing-index-list-p indices)
     (equal
      value
      (q1566341-finite-product
       semigroup sequence indices))
     (q1566341-carrier-member-p
      semigroup value))))

;; Subsets are compared extensionally on the carrier. A family is finite when
;; an internal finite list enumerates exactly its extensional members.

(defun-sk q1566341-set-equiv-p (semigroup left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1566341-carrier-member-p semigroup x)
     (iff
      (q1566341-set-member-p semigroup left x)
      (q1566341-set-member-p semigroup right x)))))

(defun q1566341-list-contains-equiv-set-p
    (semigroup set sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q1566341-set-equiv-p
        semigroup set (car sets))
       (q1566341-list-contains-equiv-set-p
        semigroup set (cdr sets)))
    nil))

(defun-sk q1566341-family-enumeration-exact-p
    (semigroup family sets)
  (forall (set)
    (iff
     (q1566341-family-member-p
      semigroup family set)
     (q1566341-list-contains-equiv-set-p
      semigroup set sets))))

(defun q1566341-family-enumeration-p
    (semigroup family sets)
  (and
   (true-listp sets)
   (q1566341-family-enumeration-exact-p
    semigroup family sets)))

(defun-sk q1566341-finite-family-p (semigroup family)
  (exists (sets)
    (q1566341-family-enumeration-p
     semigroup family sets)))

(defun-sk q1566341-family-union-member-p
    (semigroup family value)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q1566341-family-member-p
      semigroup family set)
     (q1566341-set-member-p
      semigroup set value))))

;; The source cover assumption FP(a) subset union(s).

(defun-sk q1566341-fp-covered-p
    (semigroup sequence family)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q1566341-fp-member-p
      semigroup sequence value)
     (q1566341-family-union-member-p
      semigroup family value))))

;; The source conclusion FP(b) subset c, with both c and b existentially
;; quantified in the same scope as in FP_partition_regular.

(defun-sk q1566341-fp-subset-p
    (semigroup sequence set)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q1566341-fp-member-p
      semigroup sequence value)
     (q1566341-set-member-p
      semigroup set value))))

(defun-sk q1566341-monochromatic-fp-stream-exists-p
    (semigroup family)
  (exists (set sequence)
    (and
     (q1566341-family-member-p
      semigroup family set)
     (q1566341-stream-p semigroup sequence)
     (q1566341-fp-subset-p
      semigroup sequence set))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1566341-hindman-s-theorem-statement
    (semigroup sequence family)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1566341-semigroup-p semigroup)
    (q1566341-stream-p semigroup sequence)
    (q1566341-finite-family-p semigroup family)
    (q1566341-fp-covered-p
     semigroup sequence family))
   (q1566341-monochromatic-fp-stream-exists-p
    semigroup family)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1566341
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1566341), "Hindman's theorem": the finite-products
-- set of a stream in any semigroup is partition regular under every finite
-- cover. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_
infix 2 _↔_

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Semigroup
  {m : Level}
  (M : Set m) :
  Set m where

  field
    multiply : M -> M -> M
    associative :
      (x y z : M) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡
      multiply x (multiply y z)

open Semigroup

Stream :
  {m : Level} ->
  Set m ->
  Set m
Stream M =
  Nat -> M

head :
  {m : Level} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  Stream M ->
  M
head stream =
  stream zero

tail :
  {m : Level} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  Stream M ->
  Stream M
tail stream n =
  stream (suc n)

data FiniteProducts
  {m : Level}
  {M : Set m}
  (semigroup : Semigroup M) :
  Stream M ->
  M ->
  Set m where

  head-product :
    (stream : Stream M) ->
    FiniteProducts semigroup stream (head stream)

  tail-product :
    {stream : Stream M} ->
    {product : M} ->
    FiniteProducts semigroup (tail stream) product ->
    FiniteProducts semigroup stream product

  cons-product :
    {stream : Stream M} ->
    {product : M} ->
    FiniteProducts semigroup (tail stream) product ->
    FiniteProducts semigroup stream
      (multiply semigroup (head stream) product)

Subset :
  {m : Level} ->
  Set m ->
  Set (lsuc m)
Subset {m} M =
  M -> Set m

Family :
  {m : Level} ->
  Set m ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc m))
Family {m} M =
  Subset M -> Set (lsuc m)

SubsetEquivalent :
  {m : Level} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  Subset M ->
  Subset M ->
  Set m
SubsetEquivalent {M = M} left right =
  (x : M) ->
  left x ↔ right x

record FiniteFamily
  {m : Level}
  {M : Set m}
  (family : Family M) :
  Set (lsuc (lsuc m)) where

  field
    size : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> Subset M
    exactly-enumerated :
      (candidate : Subset M) ->
      family candidate ↔
      Σ (Fin size)
        (λ index ->
          SubsetEquivalent candidate (enumerate index))

Contained :
  {a p q : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set p) ->
  (A -> Set q) ->
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ q)
Contained {A = A} left right =
  (x : A) ->
  left x ->
  right x

CoveredBy :
  {m : Level} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  Family M ->
  Subset M ->
  Set (lsuc m)
CoveredBy {M = M} family covered =
  (x : M) ->
  covered x ->
  Σ (Subset M)
    (λ member ->
      family member × member x)

hindmans-theorem :
  (m : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc m))
hindmans-theorem m =
  (M : Set m) ->
  (semigroup : Semigroup M) ->
  (stream : Stream M) ->
  (cover : Family M) ->
  FiniteFamily cover ->
  CoveredBy cover (FiniteProducts semigroup stream) ->
  Σ (Subset M)
    (λ cell ->
      cover cell ×
      Σ (Stream M)
        (λ monochromatic-stream ->
          Contained
            (FiniteProducts semigroup monochromatic-stream)
            cell))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1566341, "Hindman's theorem": every finite cover of the finite-product set
  of an infinite sequence in a semigroup has a member containing the
  finite-product set of another infinite sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val hindman_fp_partition_regular =
  ``let finite_products =
      \(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (a : num -> 'a) (x : 'a).
        ?indices : num list.
          indices <> [] /\
          (!i j.
             i < j /\ j < LENGTH indices
             ==>
             EL i indices < EL j indices) /\
          x =
            FOLDL
              mul
              (a (HD indices))
              (MAP a (TL indices))
    in
      !(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
       (a : num -> 'a)
       (s : ('a set) set).
        (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
        FINITE s /\
        finite_products mul a SUBSET BIGUNION s
        ==>
        ?c : 'a set.
          c IN s /\
          ?b : num -> 'a.
            finite_products mul b SUBSET c``;

$(

  Q1566341FP G A is the set of products G gsum ( A o. f ) over all nonempty
  finite strictly increasing index maps f. Thus it is exactly the set of
  left-to-right products of nonempty finite subsequences, bidirectionally
  equivalent to the inductive Lean predicate Hindman.FP.

  A finite family S is required to consist of subsets of the carrier. Its
  union covers Q1566341FP G A, and the conclusion keeps both the chosen
  member C of S and the new stream B internally existential. Exactly as in
  the indexed Lean declaration, the conclusion requires Q1566341FP G B to be

$c Q1566341FP $.

title: Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1566341,
% "Hindman's theorem": every finite cover of the finite-product set of an
% infinite sequence in a semigroup has a member containing another
% finite-product set. This file contains no proof.

Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem[M: TYPE, mul: [M, M -> M]]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element_set: TYPE = [M -> bool]
  finite_family: TYPE = finite_set[element_set]
  stream: TYPE = [nat -> M]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[element_set]

  semigroup_laws: bool =
    FORALL (x, y, z: M):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z))

  strictly_after(first: nat, rest: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES rest OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(next, tail):
        first < next AND strictly_after(next, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rest BY <<

  indexed_product(
      a: stream,
      first: nat,
      rest: list[nat]): RECURSIVE M =
    CASES rest OF
      null: a(first),
      cons(next, tail):
        mul(a(first), indexed_product(a, next, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE rest BY <<

  finite_products(a: stream): element_set =
    LAMBDA (value: M):
      EXISTS (first: nat), (rest: list[nat]):
        strictly_after(first, rest)
          AND value = indexed_product(a, first, rest)

  subset(left, right: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (value: M):
      left(value) IMPLIES right(value)

  covers(target: element_set, family: finite_family): bool =
    FORALL (value: M):
      target(value) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (part: element_set):
          member(part, family) AND part(value)

  FP_partition_regular: bool =
    semigroup_laws IMPLIES
      FORALL (a: stream), (family: finite_family):
        covers(finite_products(a), family) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (part: element_set), (b: stream):
            member(part, family)
              AND subset(finite_products(b), part)
END Q1566341_hindman_s_theorem
