title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1568811
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1568811), "Hahn decomposition theorem": every
  real-valued signed measure on a measurable space admits complementary
  measurable positive and negative sets. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1568811_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1568811_empty {A : Type} : q1568811_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1568811_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q1568811_set A) : q1568811_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q1568811_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1568811_set A) : q1568811_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q1568811_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q1568811_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q1568811_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q1568811_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q1568811_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Record q1568811_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1568811_measurable : q1568811_set A -> Prop;
  q1568811_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q1568811_set A,
      q1568811_same_set E F ->
      (q1568811_measurable E <-> q1568811_measurable F);
  q1568811_measurable_empty :
    q1568811_measurable q1568811_empty;
  q1568811_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q1568811_set A,
      q1568811_measurable E ->
      q1568811_measurable (q1568811_complement E);
  q1568811_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q1568811_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1568811_measurable (E n)) ->
      q1568811_measurable (q1568811_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q1568811_measurable {A} _ _.

Fixpoint q1568811_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q1568811_partial_sum u k + u k
  end.

Definition q1568811_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Record q1568811_signed_measure (A : Type)
    (m : q1568811_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q1568811_signed_measure_value : q1568811_set A -> R;
  q1568811_signed_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q1568811_set A,
      q1568811_same_set E F ->
      q1568811_signed_measure_value E =
      q1568811_signed_measure_value F;
  q1568811_signed_measure_empty :
    q1568811_signed_measure_value q1568811_empty = 0;
  q1568811_signed_measure_nonmeasurable :
    forall E : q1568811_set A,
      ~ q1568811_measurable m E ->
      q1568811_signed_measure_value E = 0;
  q1568811_signed_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q1568811_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q1568811_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q1568811_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q1568811_real_sequence_converges
        (fun n =>
          q1568811_partial_sum
            (fun k => q1568811_signed_measure_value (E k)) n)
        (q1568811_signed_measure_value
          (q1568811_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q1568811_signed_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Definition q1568811_positive_on {A : Type}
    {m : q1568811_measurable_space A}
    (s : q1568811_signed_measure m)
    (i : q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  forall E : q1568811_set A,
    q1568811_measurable m E ->
    q1568811_subset E i ->
    0 <= q1568811_signed_measure_value s E.

Definition q1568811_negative_on {A : Type}
    {m : q1568811_measurable_space A}
    (s : q1568811_signed_measure m)
    (i : q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  forall E : q1568811_set A,
    q1568811_measurable m E ->
    q1568811_subset E i ->
    q1568811_signed_measure_value s E <= 0.

Definition q1568811_is_complement {A : Type}
    (i j : q1568811_set A) : Prop :=
  q1568811_disjoint i j /\
  forall x : A, i x \/ j x.

Theorem exists_isCompl_positive_negative :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (m : q1568811_measurable_space Alpha)
         (s : q1568811_signed_measure m),
    exists i j : q1568811_set Alpha,
      q1568811_measurable m i /\
      q1568811_positive_on s i /\
      q1568811_measurable m j /\
      q1568811_negative_on s j /\
      q1568811_is_complement i j.
Admitted.

title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1568811,
  "Hahn decomposition theorem": every signed measure on an arbitrary measurable
  space admits complementary measurable positive and negative sets. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Measure_Space"
begin

definition q1568811_sigma_algebra :: "'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1568811_sigma_algebra S \<longleftrightarrow>
    {} \<in> S \<and>
    (\<forall>A \<in> S. - A \<in> S) \<and>
    (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. A n \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<Union>n. A n) \<in> S)"

definition q1568811_signed_measure ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1568811_signed_measure S s \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1568811_sigma_algebra S \<and>
    s {} = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>A. A \<notin> S \<longrightarrow> s A = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. A n \<in> S) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>m n. m \<noteq> n \<longrightarrow> A m \<inter> A n = {}) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<lambda>n. s (A n)) sums s (\<Union>n. A n))"

definition q1568811_positive_set ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1568811_positive_set S s P \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>A \<in> S. A \<subseteq> P \<longrightarrow> 0 \<le> s A)"

definition q1568811_negative_set ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1568811_negative_set S s N \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>A \<in> S. A \<subseteq> N \<longrightarrow> s A \<le> 0)"

definition q1568811_complementary :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1568811_complementary P N \<longleftrightarrow>
    P \<inter> N = {} \<and> P \<union> N = UNIV"

theorem hahn_decomposition_theorem:
  fixes S :: "'a set set"
    and s :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "q1568811_signed_measure S s"
  shows "\<exists>P N.
    P \<in> S \<and>
    q1568811_positive_set S s P \<and>
    N \<in> S \<and>
    q1568811_negative_set S s N \<and>
    q1568811_complementary P N"
  sorry

end

title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1568811,
  "Hahn decomposition theorem": every real signed measure on an arbitrary
  measurable space has complementary measurable positive and negative sets.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1568811_HAHN_DECOMPOSITION_THEOREM =
 `let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let signed_measure =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        mu {} = &0 /\
        (!s:A->bool. ~(events s) ==> mu s = &0) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->real.
                 partial 0 = &0 /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      partial n + mu (sets n)) /\
                 scalar_tends partial
                   (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let positive_set =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
       (i:A->bool).
        !t:A->bool.
          events t /\ t SUBSET i ==> &0 <= mu t in
   let negative_set =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
       (j:A->bool).
        !t:A->bool.
          events t /\ t SUBSET j ==> mu t <= &0 in
   !events:(A->bool)->bool mu:(A->bool)->real.
      signed_measure events mu
      ==> ?i j:A->bool.
            events i /\
            positive_set events mu i /\
            events j /\
            negative_set events mu j /\
            DISJOINT i j /\
            i UNION j = (:A)`;;

title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1568811,
;; "Hahn decomposition theorem": every real-valued signed measure on an
;; arbitrary measurable space admits complementary measurable positive and
;; negative sets. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present an arbitrary carrier, arbitrary subsets
;; and countable set families, a sigma algebra, and a real-valued signed
;; measure. The hypotheses below explicitly characterize the real field and
;; the VectorMeasure laws used by Lean's SignedMeasure abbreviation.

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, presenting the real numbers.

(defstub q1568811-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q1568811-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defun q1568811-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q1568811-r-less real right left)))

(defun q1568811-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q1568811-r-add
   real left (q1568811-r-negate real right)))

(defun q1568811-r-absolute-value (real value)
  (if (q1568811-r-less
       real value (q1568811-r-zero real))
      (q1568811-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun q1568811-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q1568811-r-member-p real value)
   (q1568811-r-less
    real (q1568811-r-zero real) value)))

(defun-sk q1568811-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-r-member-p real x)
      (q1568811-r-member-p real y)
      (q1568811-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q1568811-r-zero real))
            (one (q1568811-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q1568811-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q1568811-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q1568811-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q1568811-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q1568811-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q1568811-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q1568811-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q1568811-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q1568811-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q1568811-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q1568811-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q1568811-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1568811-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q1568811-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q1568811-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1568811-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q1568811-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q1568811-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q1568811-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q1568811-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1568811-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1568811-r-multiply
          real x (q1568811-r-add real y z))
         (q1568811-r-add
          real
          (q1568811-r-multiply real x y)
          (q1568811-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1568811-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-r-member-p real x)
      (q1568811-r-member-p real y)
      (q1568811-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q1568811-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q1568811-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1568811-r-less real x y)
         (q1568811-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1568811-r-less real x y)
          (q1568811-r-less real y z))
         (q1568811-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q1568811-r-less real x y)
         (q1568811-r-less
          real
          (q1568811-r-add real x z)
          (q1568811-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1568811-r-less real zero x)
          (q1568811-r-less real zero y))
         (q1568811-r-less
          real zero
          (q1568811-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1568811-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1568811-r-member-p real x)

(defun-sk q1568811-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-r-member-p real x)
      (q1568811-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q1568811-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q1568811-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1568811-r-member-p real bound)
     (q1568811-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q1568811-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q1568811-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q1568811-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q1568811-r-member-p real bound)
       (q1568811-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q1568811-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q1568811-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)

(defun-sk q1568811-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies

      (q1568811-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q1568811-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q1568811-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q1568811-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q1568811-r-zero real))
        (one (q1568811-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q1568811-r-member-p real zero)
     (q1568811-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q1568811-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q1568811-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q1568811-r-less real zero one)
     (q1568811-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Arbitrary subsets of an arbitrary domain and countable set families.

(defstub q1568811-domain-member-p (domain value) t)

    (not

    (real measure sequence count)

  (if (zp count)
      (q1568811-r-zero real)
    (q1568811-r-add
     real
     (q1568811-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q1568811-signed-measure-value
      measure
      (q1568811-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

  (forall (count)

      (natp count)
      (natp start)

      real
      (q1568811-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q1568811-r-subtract
        real
        (q1568811-measure-prefix-sum

        total))
      epsilon))))

    (real measure sequence total epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1568811-series-tail-p
      real measure sequence total epsilon start))))

    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1568811-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1568811-series-start-exists-p
      real measure sequence total epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1568811-measure-extensional-p
    (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q1568811-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure left)
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q1568811-measure-values-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q1568811-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q1568811-r-member-p
      real
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q1568811-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q1568811-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure empty)
      (q1568811-r-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q1568811-nonmeasurable-zero-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-valid-set-p domain set)
      (not
       (q1568811-measurable-set-p measurable set)))
     (equal
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure set)
      (q1568811-r-zero real)))))

    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q1568811-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q1568811-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence)
      (q1568811-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q1568811-has-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun q1568811-signed-measure-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q1568811-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q1568811-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q1568811-measure-values-p real domain measure)
   (q1568811-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q1568811-nonmeasurable-zero-p
    real domain measurable measure)
   (q1568811-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)))

;; Positivity and negativity quantify over every measurable subset, which is
;; equivalent to the source restrictions 0 <=[i] s and s <=[j] 0 because the
;; conclusion also requires i and j themselves to be measurable.

(defun-sk q1568811-positive-set-p
    (real domain measurable measure set)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-valid-set-p domain subset)
      (q1568811-measurable-set-p measurable subset)
      (q1568811-set-subset-p subset set))
     (q1568811-r-leq
      real
      (q1568811-r-zero real)
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure subset)))))

    (real domain measurable measure set)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1568811-valid-set-p domain subset)
      (q1568811-measurable-set-p measurable subset)
      (q1568811-set-subset-p subset set))
     (q1568811-r-leq
      real
      (q1568811-signed-measure-value measure subset)
      (q1568811-r-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q1568811-cover-domain-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1568811-domain-member-p domain x)
     (or
      (q1568811-set-member-p left x)
      (q1568811-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun q1568811-is-complementary-p
    (domain left right)
  (and
   (q1568811-valid-set-p domain left)
   (q1568811-valid-set-p domain right)
   (q1568811-disjoint-sets-p left right)

   (q1568811-measurable-set-p measurable positive)

title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1568811,
-- "Hahn decomposition theorem": every countably additive signed measure
-- valued in a fixed Cauchy-sequence representation of the real numbers admits
-- complementary measurable positive and negative sets. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe --prop #-}

module Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_; Prop)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Prop p where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Prop p ->
  Prop p
Not {p} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Prop p) :
  Prop (a ⊔ p) where

  witness :
    (value : A) ->
    P value ->
    Exists A P

infix 4 _==N_ _!=N_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

data _==N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  reflN : {n : Nat} -> n ==N n

_!=N_ :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Prop
m !=N n =
  Not (m ==N n)

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

-- A rational is an integer numerator, represented as a difference of
-- naturals, divided by a positive denominator. The order below identifies
-- extensionally equal presentations by cross multiplication.
record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart    : Nat
    negativePart    : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue :
  Rational ->
  Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ :
  Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

negateQ :
  Rational ->
  Rational
negateQ q =
  rational
    (negativePart q)
    (positivePart q)
    (denominatorCode q)

addQ :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode
      (denominatorCode q)
      (denominatorCode r))

RationalLE :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Prop
RationalLE q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <=N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

unitFraction :
  Nat ->
  Rational
unitFraction precision =
  rational (suc zero) zero precision

RationalWithin :
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Rational ->
  Prop
RationalWithin epsilon q r =
  Both
    (RationalLE q (addQ r epsilon))
    (RationalLE r (addQ q epsilon))

-- This is a fixed presentation of the real numbers by rational Cauchy
-- sequences. All real operations below are extensional relations, so distinct
-- Cauchy representatives of the same real number are identified.
IsCauchy :
  (Nat -> Rational) ->
  Prop
IsCauchy sequence =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RationalWithin
        (unitFraction precision)
        (sequence m)
        (sequence n))

record Real : Set where
  field
    approximation :
      Nat ->
      Rational

    cauchy :
      IsCauchy approximation

open Real

RealWithinAt :
  Nat ->
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Prop
RealWithinAt precision x y =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i j : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N i ->
      cutoff <=N j ->
      RationalWithin
        (unitFraction precision)
        (approximation x i)
        (approximation y j))

RealEquivalent :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Prop
RealEquivalent x y =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  RealWithinAt precision x y

RealLE :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Prop
RealLE x y =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i j : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N i ->
      cutoff <=N j ->
      RationalLE
        (approximation x i)
        (addQ
          (approximation y j)
          (unitFraction precision)))

RealZero :
  Real ->
  Prop
RealZero x =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N i ->
      RationalWithin
        (unitFraction precision)
        (approximation x i)
        zeroQ)

RealNonnegative :
  Real ->
  Prop
RealNonnegative x =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N i ->
      RationalLE
        (negateQ (unitFraction precision))
        (approximation x i))

RealNonpositive :
  Real ->
  Prop
RealNonpositive x =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N i ->
      RationalLE
        (approximation x i)
        (unitFraction precision))

RealAdd :
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Real ->
  Prop
RealAdd x y sum =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (i j k : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N i ->
      cutoff <=N j ->
      cutoff <=N k ->
      RationalWithin
        (unitFraction precision)
        (approximation sum k)
        (addQ
          (approximation x i)
          (approximation y j)))

RealConverges :
  (Nat -> Real) ->
  Real ->
  Prop
RealConverges sequence limit =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RealWithinAt precision (sequence n) limit)

RealHasSum :
  (Nat -> Real) ->
  Real ->
  Prop
RealHasSum terms total =
  Exists (Nat -> Real)
    (\ partialSums ->
      Both
        (RealZero (partialSums zero))
        (Both
          ((n : Nat) ->
            RealAdd
              (partialSums n)
              (terms n)
              (partialSums (suc n)))
          (RealConverges partialSums total)))

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Predicate A =
  A -> Prop

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop a
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

SamePredicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop a
SamePredicate {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (S x) (T x)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Prop a
PairwiseDisjoint {a = a} {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i !=N j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom {a}

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A ->
      Prop

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record SignedMeasure
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    mass :
      Predicate A ->
      Real

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      RealEquivalent (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-empty :
      RealZero (mass Empty)

    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      RealHasSum
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        (mass (CountableUnion sets))

open SignedMeasure

PositiveOn :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  SignedMeasure events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
PositiveOn {A = A} events signed S =
  (T : Predicate A) ->
  measurable events T ->
  Subset T S ->
  RealNonnegative (mass signed T)

NegativeOn :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  SignedMeasure events ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
NegativeOn {A = A} events signed S =
  (T : Predicate A) ->
  measurable events T ->
  Subset T S ->
  RealNonpositive (mass signed T)

record IsComplementary
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (S T : Predicate A) :
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    disjoint :
      (x : A) ->
      S x ->
      T x ->
      Bottom {a}

    covers :
      (x : A) ->
      Either (S x) (T x)

hahn-decomposition-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Prop (lsuc a)
hahn-decomposition-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (signed : SignedMeasure events) ->
  Exists (Predicate A)
    (\ positiveSet ->
      Exists (Predicate A)
        (\ negativeSet ->
          Both
            (measurable events positiveSet)
            (Both
              (PositiveOn events signed positiveSet)
              (Both
                (measurable events negativeSet)
                (Both
                  (NegativeOn events signed negativeSet)
                  (IsComplementary positiveSet negativeSet))))))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1568811 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1568811), "Hahn decomposition
  theorem": every real-valued signed measure on a measurable space has
  complementary measurable positive and negative sets. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory;

val q1568811_has_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q1568811_has_sum_def",
  ``q1568811_has_sum (f : num -> real) (a : real) <=>
      !e : real.
        0 < e ==>
        ?base : num set.
          FINITE base /\
          !u : num set.
            FINITE u /\ base SUBSET u ==>
            abs (SIGMA f u - a) < e``);

val q1568811_signed_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q1568811_signed_measure_def",
  ``q1568811_signed_measure
      (msets : 'a set set) (s : 'a set -> real) <=>
      sigma_algebra ((UNIV : 'a set), msets) /\
      s {} = 0 /\
      (!u : 'a set. u NOTIN msets ==> s u = 0) /\
      !sets : num -> 'a set.
        (!n. sets n IN msets) /\
        (!m n. m <> n ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
        ==>
        q1568811_has_sum
          (\n. s (sets n))
          (s (BIGUNION (IMAGE sets UNIV)))``);

val q1568811_positive_set_def = new_definition (
  "q1568811_positive_set_def",
  ``q1568811_positive_set
      (msets : 'a set set) (s : 'a set -> real)
      (i : 'a set) <=>
      !u : 'a set.
        u IN msets /\ u SUBSET i ==> 0 <= s u``);

val q1568811_negative_set_def = new_definition (
  "q1568811_negative_set_def",
  ``q1568811_negative_set
      (msets : 'a set set) (s : 'a set -> real)
      (j : 'a set) <=>
      !u : 'a set.
        u IN msets /\ u SUBSET j ==> s u <= 0``);

val hahn_decomposition_theorem =
  ``!(msets : 'a set set) (s : 'a set -> real).
      q1568811_signed_measure msets s
      ==>
      ?i j : 'a set.
        i IN msets /\
        q1568811_positive_set msets s i /\
        j IN msets /\
        q1568811_negative_set msets s j /\
        DISJOINT i j /\
        i UNION j = UNIV``;

title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1568811
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1568811), "Hahn decomposition theorem":
  every real-valued signed measure on an arbitrary measurable space admits
  complementary measurable positive and negative sets. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q1568811SignedMeasure M S says that M is a sigma-algebra and S is a
  real-valued function on every subset of its carrier. It vanishes on
  nonmeasurable sets, as Lean's bundled SignedMeasure does, and is countably
  additive on every NN0-indexed pairwise-disjoint sequence of measurable sets,
  including convergence of the real series.

  Q1568811Positive and Q1568811Negative say respectively that every subset of
  the indicated set has nonnegative or nonpositive signed measure. Because S
  vanishes off M, this is exactly Lean's restriction-order predicate.
  Q1568811Complementary says that the two sets are disjoint and have union
  equal to the carrier U. M.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1568811SignedMeasure Q1568811Positive Q1568811Negative
   Q1568811Complementary $.

q1568811-signed-measure-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1568811SignedMeasure M S ) $.
q1568811-positive-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1568811Positive M S I ) $.
q1568811-negative-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1568811Negative M S J ) $.
q1568811-complementary-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1568811Complementary M I J ) $.

${
  $d A F M S m n $.

  q1568811-signed-measure-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1568811SignedMeasure M S )
    <->
    (
      M e. U. ran sigAlgebra
      /\
      (
        S : ~P U. M --> RR
        /\
        (
          ( S ` (/) ) = 0
          /\
          (
            A. A e. ( ~P U. M \ M )
              ( S ` A ) = 0
            /\
            A. F e. ( M ^m NN0 )
              (
                (
                  A. n e. NN0 A. m e. NN0
                    (
                      n =/= m
                      ->
                      ( ( F ` n ) i^i ( F ` m ) ) = (/)
                    )
                )
                ->
                (
                  seq 0
                    (
                      + ,
                      ( n e. NN0 |-> ( S ` ( F ` n ) ) )
                    )
                    e. dom ~~>
                  /\
                  ( S ` U. ran F )
                  =
                  sum_ n e. NN0 ( S ` ( F ` n ) )
                )
              )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A I M S $.

  q1568811-positive-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1568811Positive M S I )
    <->
    A. A e. ~P U. M
      (
        A C_ I
        ->
        0 <_ ( S ` A )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A J M S $.

  q1568811-negative-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1568811Negative M S J )
    <->
    A. A e. ~P U. M
      (
        A C_ J
        ->
        ( S ` A ) <_ 0
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I J M $.

  q1568811-complementary-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1568811Complementary M I J )
    <->
    (
      ( I i^i J ) = (/)
      /\
      ( I u. J ) = U. M
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I J M S $.

  thousand-theorems-q1568811-hahn-decomposition $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran sigAlgebra
      A. S
        (
          ( Q1568811SignedMeasure M S )
          ->
          E. I e. M E. J e. M
            (
              ( Q1568811Positive M S I )
              /\
              (
                ( Q1568811Negative M S J )
                /\
                ( Q1568811Complementary M I J )
              )
            )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q1568811_hahn_decomposition_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1568811,
% "Hahn decomposition theorem": every signed measure on an arbitrary measurable
% space has complementary measurable positive and negative sets. This file
% contains no proof.

hahn_decomposition_theorem_Q1568811[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  signed_measure: TYPE = [event -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES F(omega)

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    event_subset(E, carrier)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_signed_measure(
      S: signed_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND S(empty_event) = 0
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_real_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat): S(events(index)),
                count),
            S(countable_union(events))))

  positive_on(
      S: signed_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    FORALL (F: event):
      Sigma(F) AND event_subset(F, E)
        IMPLIES 0 <= S(F)

  negative_on(
      S: signed_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    FORALL (F: event):
      Sigma(F) AND event_subset(F, E)
        IMPLIES S(F) <= 0

  complementary(E, F: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND carrier_event(F)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          (E(omega) IFF NOT F(omega)))

  hahn_decomposition_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (S: signed_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      is_signed_measure(S, Sigma)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (positive_part, negative_part: event):
            Sigma(positive_part)
              AND positive_on(
                S, Sigma, positive_part)
              AND Sigma(negative_part)
              AND negative_on(
                S, Sigma, negative_part)
              AND complementary(
                positive_part, negative_part)
END hahn_decomposition_theorem_Q1568811

title: Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q16251580
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q16251580), "Matiyasevich's theorem": membership
-- in the natural Pell sequence is equivalent to solvability of an explicit
-- system of Pell equations, congruences, and divisibility conditions.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.PellMatiyasevic

@[expose] public section

open Nat

namespace Q16251580

/-- Matiyasevich's characterization of pairs in the natural Pell sequence. -/
theorem matiyasevic {a k x y : ℕ} :
    (∃ a1 : 1 < a, Pell.xn a1 k = x ∧ Pell.yn a1 k = y) ↔
      1 < a ∧ k ≤ y ∧ (x = 1 ∧ y = 0 ∨
        ∃ u v s t b : ℕ,
          x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1 ∧ u * u - (a * a - 1) * v * v = 1 ∧
          s * s - (b * b - 1) * t * t = 1 ∧ 1 < b ∧ b ≡ 1 [MOD 4 * y] ∧
          b ≡ a [MOD u] ∧ 0 < v ∧ y * y ∣ v ∧ s ≡ x [MOD u] ∧
          t ≡ k [MOD 4 * y]) := sorry

end Q16251580

title: Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q16251580
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q16251580), "Matiyasevich's theorem": a system of
  natural-number Pell equations, congruences, and divisibility conditions
  characterizes the indexed Pell sequence. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Module Pell.

Fixpoint pell
    (a : nat) (_a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (n : nat) : (nat * nat)%type :=
  match n with
  | O => (1, 0)
  | S m =>
      let '(x, y) := pell a _a1 m in
      (x * a + (a * a - 1) * y, x + y * a)
  end.

Definition xn
    (a : nat) (a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (n : nat) : nat :=
  fst (pell a a1 n).

Definition yn
    (a : nat) (a1 : (1 < a)%nat) (n : nat) : nat :=
  snd (pell a a1 n).

Definition mod_eq (modulus left right : nat) : Prop :=
  match modulus with
  | O => left = right
  | S m => Nat.modulo left (S m) = Nat.modulo right (S m)
  end.

Theorem matiyasevic :
  forall a k x y : nat,
    (exists a1 : (1 < a)%nat,
        xn a a1 k = x /\ yn a a1 k = y) <->
    (1 < a)%nat /\
    (k <= y)%nat /\
    ((x = 1 /\ y = 0) \/
     exists u v s t b : nat,
       x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1 /\
       u * u - (a * a - 1) * v * v = 1 /\
       s * s - (b * b - 1) * t * t = 1 /\
       (1 < b)%nat /\
       mod_eq (4 * y) b 1 /\
       mod_eq u b a /\
       (0 < v)%nat /\
       Nat.divide (y * y) v /\
       mod_eq u s x /\
       mod_eq (4 * y) t k).
Admitted.

End Pell.

title: Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q16251580
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q16251580), "Matiyasevich's theorem":
  membership in a recursively defined Pell sequence is equivalent to a system
  of natural-number Diophantine and congruence conditions. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

fun q16251580_pell :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<times> nat" where
  "q16251580_pell a 0 = (1, 0)"
| "q16251580_pell a (Suc n) =
    (fst (q16251580_pell a n) * a +
       (a * a - 1) * snd (q16251580_pell a n),
     fst (q16251580_pell a n) +
       snd (q16251580_pell a n) * a)"

definition q16251580_xn :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q16251580_xn a n = fst (q16251580_pell a n)"

definition q16251580_yn :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q16251580_yn a n = snd (q16251580_pell a n)"

definition q16251580_congruent ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q16251580_congruent m n modulus \<longleftrightarrow>
    m mod modulus = n mod modulus"

theorem matiyasevic:
  fixes a k x y :: nat
  shows
    "(1 < a \<and> q16251580_xn a k = x \<and> q16251580_yn a k = y)
      \<longleftrightarrow>
     1 < a \<and> k \<le> y \<and>
       ((x = 1 \<and> y = 0) \<or>
        (\<exists>u v s t b :: nat.
          x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1 \<and>
          u * u - (a * a - 1) * v * v = 1 \<and>
          s * s - (b * b - 1) * t * t = 1 \<and>
          1 < b \<and>
          q16251580_congruent b 1 (4 * y) \<and>
          q16251580_congruent b a u \<and>
          0 < v \<and>
          y * y dvd v \<and>
          q16251580_congruent s x u \<and>
          q16251580_congruent t k (4 * y)))"
  sorry

end

title: Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q16251580,
  "Matiyasevich's theorem": Pell-sequence values are characterized by a finite
  system of natural-number equations, divisibility, and congruences. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let q16251580_pell_pair = new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `(q16251580_pell_pair a 0 = (1,0)) /\
   (!n. q16251580_pell_pair a (SUC n) =
        (FST (q16251580_pell_pair a n) * a +
           (a * a - 1) * SND (q16251580_pell_pair a n),
         FST (q16251580_pell_pair a n) +
           SND (q16251580_pell_pair a n) * a))`;;

let q16251580_pell_x = new_definition
  `q16251580_pell_x a n = FST (q16251580_pell_pair a n)`;;

let q16251580_pell_y = new_definition
  `q16251580_pell_y a n = SND (q16251580_pell_pair a n)`;;

let Q16251580_MATIYASEVIC_THEOREM =
  `!a k x y:num.
     (1 < a /\
      q16251580_pell_x a k = x /\
      q16251580_pell_y a k = y) <=>
     1 < a /\
     k <= y /\
     ((x = 1 /\ y = 0) \/
      ?u v s t b:num.
        x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1 /\
        u * u - (a * a - 1) * v * v = 1 /\
        s * s - (b * b - 1) * t * t = 1 /\
        1 < b /\
        b MOD (4 * y) = 1 MOD (4 * y) /\
        b MOD u = a MOD u /\
        0 < v /\
        (y * y) divides v /\
        s MOD u = x MOD u /\
        t MOD (4 * y) = k MOD (4 * y))`;;

title: Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q16251580,
;; "Matiyasevich's theorem": membership in the Pell-recursive sequence is
;; characterized by Davis's natural-number Diophantine system of equations,
;; congruences, and divisibility conditions. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The Pell pair uses the source recursion with natural-number subtraction.

(defun q16251580-nat-sub (left right)
  (nfix (- left right)))

(defun q16251580-pell-pair (a n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q16251580
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q16251580), "Matiyasevich's theorem": Davis's
-- Pell-sequence characterization of a system of natural-number Diophantine
-- equations and congruences. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

four : Nat
four =
  suc (suc (suc one))

natSub : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
natSub n zero =
  n
natSub zero (suc n) =
  zero
natSub (suc m) (suc n) =
  natSub m n

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus lhs rhs =
  naturalMod lhs modulus == naturalMod rhs modulus

_divides_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
divisor divides dividend =
  Exists Nat (λ quotient -> dividend == divisor * quotient)

record NatPair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    pairX : Nat
    pairY : Nat

open NatPair

d : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat
d a a1 =
  natSub (a * a) one

pell : (a : Nat) -> (a1 : one < a) -> Nat -> NatPair
pell a a1 zero =
  pair one zero
pell a a1 (suc n) with pell a a1 n
... | pair x y =
  pair
    (x * a + d a a1 * y)
    (x + y * a)

xn : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat -> Nat
xn a a1 n =
  pairX (pell a a1 n)

yn : (a : Nat) -> one < a -> Nat -> Nat
yn a a1 n =
  pairY (pell a a1 n)

PellMembership : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
PellMembership a k x y =
  Exists (one < a)
    (λ a1 -> (xn a a1 k == x) and (yn a a1 k == y))

PellEquation : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
PellEquation parameter x y =
  natSub
    (x * x)
    (natSub (parameter * parameter) one * y * y)
  == one

DiophantineSystem : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
DiophantineSystem a k x y =
  Exists Nat (λ u ->
  Exists Nat (λ v ->
  Exists Nat (λ s ->
  Exists Nat (λ t ->
  Exists Nat (λ b ->
    PellEquation a x y
    and PellEquation a u v
    and PellEquation b s t
    and one < b
    and ModEq (four * y) b one
    and ModEq u b a
    and zero < v
    and (y * y) divides v
    and ModEq u s x
    and ModEq (four * y) t k)))))

MatiyasevichTheorem : Set
MatiyasevichTheorem =
  (a k x y : Nat) ->
  Iff
    (PellMembership a k x y)
    (one < a
      and k <= y
      and ((x == one and y == zero)
        or DiophantineSystem a k x y))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q16251580, "Matiyasevich's theorem": membership in the recursively defined
  Pell sequence is equivalent to a system of natural-number Pell equations,
  divisibility conditions, and modular congruences. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory pairTheory;

val q16251580_pell_def = Define`
  (q16251580_pell (a : num) 0 = (1, 0)) /\
  (q16251580_pell a (SUC n) =
     (FST (q16251580_pell a n) * a +
        (a * a - 1) * SND (q16251580_pell a n),
      FST (q16251580_pell a n) +
        SND (q16251580_pell a n) * a))`;

val matiyasevich_theorem =
  ``!a k x y : num.
      (1 < a /\
       FST (q16251580_pell a k) = x /\
       SND (q16251580_pell a k) = y)
      <=>
      1 < a /\
      k <= y /\
      ((x = 1 /\ y = 0) \/
       ?u v s t b : num.
         x * x - (a * a - 1) * y * y = 1 /\
         u * u - (a * a - 1) * v * v = 1 /\
         s * s - (b * b - 1) * t * t = 1 /\
         1 < b /\
         b MOD (4 * y) = 1 MOD (4 * y) /\
         b MOD u = a MOD u /\
         0 < v /\
         divides (y * y) v /\
         s MOD u = x MOD u /\
         t MOD (4 * y) = k MOD (4 * y))``;

title: Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q16251580,
% "Matiyasevich's theorem": membership in the recursively generated Pell
% sequence is equivalent to the stated system of natural-number Pell equations,
% divisibility conditions, and modular congruences. This file contains no proof.

Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  pell_pair: TYPE = [# x_coord: nat, y_coord: nat #]

  nat_sub(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF right <= left THEN
      left - right
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  pell(a, n: nat): RECURSIVE pell_pair =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      (# x_coord := 1, y_coord := 0 #)
    ELSE
      LET previous: pell_pair = pell(a, n - 1) IN
        LET d: nat = nat_sub(a * a, 1) IN
          (# x_coord :=
               x_coord(previous) * a + d * y_coord(previous),
             y_coord :=
               x_coord(previous) + y_coord(previous) * a #)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  nat_congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) = (modulus :: int) * offset

  matiyasevic: bool =
    FORALL (a, k, x, y: nat):
      (a > 1
        AND x_coord(pell(a, k)) = x
        AND y_coord(pell(a, k)) = y)
      IFF
        (a > 1
          AND k <= y
          AND
            ((x = 1 AND y = 0)
              OR EXISTS (u, v, s, t, b: nat):
                nat_sub(
                  x * x,
                  nat_sub(a * a, 1) * y * y) = 1
                  AND nat_sub(
                    u * u,
                    nat_sub(a * a, 1) * v * v) = 1
                  AND nat_sub(
                    s * s,
                    nat_sub(b * b, 1) * t * t) = 1
                  AND b > 1
                  AND nat_congruent(b, 1, 4 * y)
                  AND nat_congruent(b, a, u)
                  AND v > 0
                  AND nat_divides(y * y, v)
                  AND nat_congruent(s, x, u)
                  AND nat_congruent(t, k, 4 * y)))
END Q16251580_matiyasevich_s_theorem

      q1632433_vadd x y = q1632433_vadd y x;
  q1632433_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1632433_vadd x q1632433_vzero = x;
  q1632433_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q1632433_vadd x (q1632433_vneg x) = q1632433_vzero;
  q1632433_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q1632433_smul (q1632433_one fld) x = x;
  q1632433_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1632433_smul (q1632433_mul fld a b) x =
      q1632433_smul a (q1632433_smul b x);
  q1632433_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q1632433_smul (q1632433_add fld a b) x =
      q1632433_vadd
        (q1632433_smul a x) (q1632433_smul b x);
  q1632433_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q1632433_smul a (q1632433_vadd x y) =
      q1632433_vadd
        (q1632433_smul a x) (q1632433_smul a y)
}.

Arguments q1632433_vzero {K E fld} _.
Arguments q1632433_vadd {K E fld} _ _ _.
Arguments q1632433_vneg {K E fld} _ _.
Arguments q1632433_smul {K E fld} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q1632433_vector_sum
    {K E : Type}
    {fld : q1632433_linear_ordered_field K}
    (V : @q1632433_module K E fld)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> E) -> E :=
  match n as m return (Fin.t m -> E) -> E with
  | O =>
      fun _ => q1632433_vzero V
  | S m =>
      fun terms =>
        q1632433_vadd V
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1632433_vector_sum K E fld V m
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q1632433_vector_sum {K E fld} V n _.

Definition q1632433_is_basis
    {K E : Type}
    {fld : q1632433_linear_ordered_field K}
    (V : @q1632433_module K E fld)
    (d : nat)
    (basis : Fin.t d -> E) : Prop :=
  (forall x : E,
    exists coefficients : Fin.t d -> K,
      x =
        q1632433_vector_sum V d
          (fun i =>
            q1632433_smul V
              (coefficients i) (basis i))) /\
  forall coefficients : Fin.t d -> K,
    q1632433_vector_sum V d
      (fun i =>
        q1632433_smul V
          (coefficients i) (basis i)) =
      q1632433_vzero V ->
    forall i : Fin.t d,
      coefficients i = q1632433_zero fld.

Definition q1632433_has_finrank
    {K E : Type}
    {fld : q1632433_linear_ordered_field K}
    (V : @q1632433_module K E fld)
    (d : nat) : Prop :=
  exists basis : Fin.t d -> E,
    @q1632433_is_basis K E fld V d basis.

Arguments q1632433_is_basis {K E fld} V d basis.
Arguments q1632433_has_finrank {K E fld} V d.

Definition q1632433_set (A : Type) : Type :=
  A -> Prop.

Definition q1632433_convex
    {K E : Type}
    {fld : q1632433_linear_ordered_field K}
    (V : @q1632433_module K E fld)
    (S : q1632433_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : E) (a b : K),
    S x ->
    S y ->
    q1632433_le fld (q1632433_zero fld) a ->
    q1632433_le fld (q1632433_zero fld) b ->
    q1632433_add fld a b = q1632433_one fld ->
    S
      (q1632433_vadd V
        (q1632433_smul V a x)
        (q1632433_smul V b y)).

Theorem q1632433_helly_theorem :
  forall (K E I : Type)
         (fld : q1632433_linear_ordered_field K)
         (V : @q1632433_module K E fld)
         (d : nat)
         (F : I -> q1632433_set E)
         (family : list I),
    q1632433_has_finrank V d ->
    NoDup family ->
    (S d <= length family)%nat ->
    (forall i : I,
      In i family ->
      q1632433_convex V (F i)) ->
    (forall subfamily : list I,
      NoDup subfamily ->
      (forall i : I, In i subfamily -> In i family) ->
      length subfamily = S d ->
      exists x : E,
        forall i : I, In i subfamily -> F i x) ->
    exists x : E,
      forall i : I, In i family -> F i x.
Admitted.

title: Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1632433,
  "Helly's theorem": for a finite family of convex sets in a finite-dimensional
  vector space over a linearly ordered field, if every subfamily of size one
  more than the dimension has nonempty intersection, then the entire family
  has nonempty intersection. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q1632433_module ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1632433_module smult \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. smult a (x + y) = smult a x + smult a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a + b) x = smult a x + smult b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a * b) x = smult a (smult b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smult 1 x = x)"

definition q1632433_linear_independent ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1632433_linear_independent smult B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>w :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {x. w x \<noteq> 0} \<longrightarrow>
      {x. w x \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> B \<longrightarrow>
      (\<Sum>x\<in>{x. w x \<noteq> 0}. smult (w x) x) = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x\<in>B. w x = 0))"

definition q1632433_spans ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1632433_spans smult B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>w :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<and>
      {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> B \<and>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. smult (w y) y) = x)"

definition q1632433_basis ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1632433_basis smult B \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1632433_linear_independent smult B \<and> q1632433_spans smult B"

definition q1632433_finite_dimensional ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1632433_finite_dimensional smult \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B :: 'e set. finite B \<and> q1632433_basis smult B)"

definition q1632433_dimension ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1632433_dimension smult =
    (LEAST n. \<exists>B :: 'e set.
      finite B \<and> q1632433_basis smult B \<and> card B = n)"

definition q1632433_convex ::
    "('k::linordered_field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1632433_convex smult S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>S. \<forall>y\<in>S. \<forall>a\<ge>0. \<forall>b\<ge>0.
      a + b = 1 \<longrightarrow> smult a x + smult b y \<in> S)"

theorem helly_theorem:
  fixes smult :: "'k::linordered_field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and F :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'e set"
    and s :: "'i set"
  assumes module: "q1632433_module smult"
    and finite_dimensional: "q1632433_finite_dimensional smult"
    and finite_family: "finite s"
    and family_large:
      "q1632433_dimension smult + 1 \<le> card s"
    and convex_family:
      "\<And>i. i \<in> s \<Longrightarrow> q1632433_convex smult (F i)"
    and small_intersections:
      "\<And>I. I \<subseteq> s \<Longrightarrow>
        card I = q1632433_dimension smult + 1 \<Longrightarrow>
        {x. \<forall>i\<in>I. x \<in> F i} \<noteq> {}"
  shows "{x. \<forall>i\<in>s. x \<in> F i} \<noteq> {}"
  sorry

end

title: Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1632433,
  "Helly's theorem": a finite indexed family of convex sets in a
  finite-dimensional module over a linearly ordered field, with at least
  dimension plus one members, has nonempty total intersection when every
  subfamily of exactly that size does. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1632433_HELLY_THEOREM =
 `let linear_ordered_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (le:A->A->bool).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       (!a:A. le a a) /\
       (!a b:A. le a b /\ le b a ==> a = b) /\
       (!a b c:A. le a b /\ le b c ==> le a c) /\
       (!a b:A. le a b \/ le b a) /\
       (!a b c:A. le a b ==> le (addK a c) (addK b c)) /\
       (!a b:A.
          le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b ==> le zeroK (mulK a b)) in
  let module_over =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x y z:B. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:B. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:B. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let linear_combination =
    \(zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B)
     (n:num) (basis:num->B) (coeff:num->A) (x:B).
       ?partial:num->B.
         partial 0 = zeroE /\
         (!i:num.
            i < n
            ==> partial (SUC i) =
                addE (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
         partial n = x in
  let has_dimension =
    \(zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B)
     (n:num) (basis:num->B).
       (!x:B.
          ?coeff:num->A.
            linear_combination zeroE addE smul n basis coeff x) /\
       (!c d:num->A. !x:B.
          linear_combination zeroE addE smul n basis c x /\
          linear_combination zeroE addE smul n basis d x
          ==> !i:num. i < n ==> c i = d i) in
  let convex_set =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (le:A->A->bool)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (u:B->bool).
       !x y:B. !a b:A.
         x IN u /\ y IN u /\
         le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b /\ addK a b = oneK
         ==> addE (smul a x) (smul b y) IN u in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !le:A->A->bool.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smul:A->B->B.
  !fam:I->B->bool.
  !s:I->bool.
    linear_ordered_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK le /\
    module_over zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroE addE negE smul /\
    (?n:num. ?basis:num->B.
       has_dimension zeroE addE smul n basis /\
       FINITE s /\
       n + 1 <= CARD s /\
       (!i:I.
          i IN s
          ==> convex_set zeroK oneK addK le addE smul (fam i)) /\
       (!t:I->bool.
          t SUBSET s /\
          FINITE t /\
          CARD t = n + 1
          ==> ?x:B. !i:I. i IN t ==> x IN fam i))
    ==> ?x:B. !i:I. i IN s ==> x IN fam i`;;

title: Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1632433,
;; "Helly's theorem": for a finite family of convex sets in a finite-dimensional
;; vector space over a linearly ordered field, if the family has at least
;; dimension plus one members and every dimension-plus-one subfamily has
;; nonempty intersection, then the whole family has nonempty intersection.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent the arbitrary index type, ordered
;; field, vector space, and set family. All carrier, algebraic, order, rank,
;; convexity, and intersection conditions are explicit in the statement.

(defstub q1632433-index-member-p (index-type index) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-member-p (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1632433-vector-member-p (vector-type vector) t)

(defstub q1632433-scalar-zero (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-one (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-add (scalar-type left right) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-multiply (scalar-type left right) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-negate (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-inverse (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-less (scalar-type left right) t)

(defstub q1632433-vector-zero (vector-type) t)
(defstub q1632433-vector-add (vector-type left right) t)
(defstub q1632433-vector-negate (vector-type vector) t)
(defstub q1632433-scalar-action
  (scalar-type vector-type scalar vector)
  t)

(defstub q1632433-family-member-p
  (index-type vector-type family-tag index vector)
  t)

;; Exact first-order laws of a nontrivial linearly ordered field.

(defun-sk q1632433-linearly-ordered-field-laws-p (scalar-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (let ((zero (q1632433-scalar-zero scalar-type))
          (one (q1632433-scalar-one scalar-type)))
      (and
       (implies
        (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1632433-scalar-negate scalar-type x))
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1632433-scalar-inverse scalar-type x))
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type x zero)
          x)
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-add
           scalar-type x
           (q1632433-scalar-negate scalar-type x))
          zero)
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x one)
          x)
         (implies
          (not (equal x zero))
          (equal
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply
            scalar-type x
            (q1632433-scalar-inverse scalar-type x))
           one))
         (not (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type x x))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type y))
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type x y))
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p
          scalar-type
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y))
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type x y)
          (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type y x))
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type y x))
         (or
          (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type x y)
          (equal x y)
          (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type y x))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type x)
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type y)
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type z))
        (and
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-add
           scalar-type
           (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type x y)
           z)
          (q1632433-scalar-add
           scalar-type
           x
           (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type y z)))
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply
           scalar-type
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)
           z)
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply
           scalar-type
           x
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type y z)))
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-multiply
           scalar-type
           x
           (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type y z))
          (q1632433-scalar-add
           scalar-type
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x z)))
         (implies
          (and
           (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type x y)
           (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type y z))
          (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type x z))
         (implies
          (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type x y)
          (q1632433-scalar-less
           scalar-type
           (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type x z)
           (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type y z)))
         (implies
          (and
           (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type zero x)
           (q1632433-scalar-less scalar-type zero y))
          (q1632433-scalar-less
           scalar-type
           zero
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type x y)))))))))

(defun q1632433-linearly-ordered-field-p (scalar-type)
  (let ((zero (q1632433-scalar-zero scalar-type))
        (one (q1632433-scalar-one scalar-type)))
    (and
     (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type zero)
     (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (equal
      (q1632433-scalar-inverse scalar-type zero)
      zero)
     (q1632433-linearly-ordered-field-laws-p scalar-type))))

;; Exact additive-commutative-group and module laws.

(defun-sk q1632433-module-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (let ((scalar-zero (q1632433-scalar-zero scalar-type))
          (scalar-one (q1632433-scalar-one scalar-type))
          (vector-zero (q1632433-vector-zero vector-type)))
      (and
       (implies
        (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type x)
        (and
         (q1632433-vector-member-p
          vector-type
          (q1632433-vector-negate vector-type x))
         (equal
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type x vector-zero)
          x)
         (equal
          (q1632433-vector-add
           vector-type x
           (q1632433-vector-negate vector-type x))
          vector-zero)
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type scalar-one x)
          x)
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type scalar-zero x)
          vector-zero)))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type x)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type y))
        (and
         (q1632433-vector-member-p
          vector-type
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type x y))
         (equal
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type x y)
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type y x))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type x)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type y)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type z))
        (equal
         (q1632433-vector-add
          vector-type
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type x y)
          z)
         (q1632433-vector-add
          vector-type
          x
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type y z))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type x))
        (q1632433-vector-member-p
         vector-type
         (q1632433-scalar-action
          scalar-type vector-type a x)))
       (implies
        (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
        (equal
         (q1632433-scalar-action
          scalar-type vector-type a vector-zero)
         vector-zero))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type x)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type y))
        (equal
         (q1632433-scalar-action
          scalar-type vector-type a
          (q1632433-vector-add vector-type x y))
         (q1632433-vector-add
          vector-type
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type a x)
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type a y))))
       (implies
        (and
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type a)
         (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type b)
         (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type x))
        (and
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           (q1632433-scalar-add scalar-type a b)
           x)
          (q1632433-vector-add
           vector-type
           (q1632433-scalar-action
            scalar-type vector-type a x)
           (q1632433-scalar-action
            scalar-type vector-type b x)))
         (equal
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           (q1632433-scalar-multiply scalar-type a b)
           x)
          (q1632433-scalar-action
           scalar-type vector-type
           a
           (q1632433-scalar-action
            scalar-type vector-type b x)))))))))

(defun q1632433-module-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (q1632433-vector-member-p
    vector-type
    (q1632433-vector-zero vector-type))
   (q1632433-module-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)))

;; Finite-dimensionality of exact rank DIMENSION is the internal existence of
;; a finite linearly independent spanning list of that length.

(defun q1632433-scalar-list-p (scalar-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1632433-scalar-member-p scalar-type (car values))
       (q1632433-scalar-list-p scalar-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1632433-vector-list-p (vector-type values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1632433-vector-member-p vector-type (car values))
       (q1632433-vector-list-p vector-type (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1632433-all-zero-coefficients-p
    (scalar-type coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (equal
        (car coefficients)
