title: Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1632433,
-- "Helly's theorem": a sufficiently large finite family of convex sets in a
-- finite-dimensional vector space has nonempty total intersection when every
-- subfamily of dimension plus one has nonempty intersection. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1632433_helly_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record LinearOrderedField
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set (lsuc k) where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK inverseK : K -> K
    lessOrEqualK : K -> K -> Set k

    one-not-zero :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (inverseK x) == oneK

    order-reflexive :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK y z ->
      lessOrEqualK x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y or lessOrEqualK y x
    add-order :
      (x y z : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK (addK z x) (addK z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK x ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK y ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK (multiplyK x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualK zeroK oneK and zeroK != oneK

open LinearOrderedField

record VectorSpace
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K)
  (E : Set e) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ e)) where

  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : K -> E -> E

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneK orderedField) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK orderedField a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK orderedField a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)
    scale-zero-vector :
      (a : K) ->
      scaleE a zeroE == zeroE
    scale-zero-scalar :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (zeroK orderedField) x == zeroE

open VectorSpace

sumScaled :
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e}
  {orderedField : LinearOrderedField K} ->
  VectorSpace orderedField E ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  (Fin n -> E) ->
  E
sumScaled space {zero} coefficients vectors =
  zeroE space
sumScaled space {suc n} coefficients vectors =
  addE space
    (scaleE space (coefficients fzero) (vectors fzero))
    (sumScaled space
      (\ j -> coefficients (fsuc j))
      (\ j -> vectors (fsuc j)))

record FiniteDimensional
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e}
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K)
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ e)) where

  field
    dimension : Nat
    basis : Fin dimension -> E
    basis-independent :
      (coefficients : Fin dimension -> K) ->
      sumScaled space coefficients basis == zeroE space ->
      (j : Fin dimension) ->
      coefficients j == zeroK orderedField
    basis-spans :
      (x : E) ->
      Exists (Fin dimension -> K)
        (\ coefficients ->
          sumScaled space coefficients basis == x)

open FiniteDimensional

record FiniteSubset
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    size : Nat
    member : I -> Set i
    enumerate : Fin size -> I
    enumerate-member :
      (j : Fin size) ->
      member (enumerate j)
    no-duplicates :
      (j l : Fin size) ->
      enumerate j == enumerate l ->
      j == l
    exhaustive :
      (x : I) ->
      member x ->
      Exists (Fin size)
        (\ j -> enumerate j == x)

open FiniteSubset

SubsetOf :
  {i : Level}
  {I : Set i} ->
  FiniteSubset I ->
  FiniteSubset I ->
  Set i
SubsetOf {I = I} child parent =
  (x : I) ->
  member child x ->
  member parent x

Convex :
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  VectorSpace orderedField E ->
  (E -> Set e) ->
  Set (k ⊔ e)
Convex {K = K} {E = E} orderedField space subset =
  (a b : K) ->
  lessOrEqualK orderedField (zeroK orderedField) a ->
  lessOrEqualK orderedField (zeroK orderedField) b ->
  addK orderedField a b == oneK orderedField ->
  (x y : E) ->
  subset x ->
  subset y ->
  subset
    (addE space
      (scaleE space a x)
      (scaleE space b y))

IntersectionNonempty :
  {i e : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (I -> E -> Set e) ->
  FiniteSubset I ->
  Set (i ⊔ e)
IntersectionNonempty {I = I} {E = E} family subfamily =
  Exists E
    (\ point ->
      (index : I) ->
      member subfamily index ->
      family index point)

helly-s-theorem : Setω
helly-s-theorem =
  {i k e : Level} ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  (finiteDimension : FiniteDimensional orderedField space) ->
  (family : I -> E -> Set e) ->
  (s : FiniteSubset I) ->
  suc (dimension finiteDimension) <=N size s ->
  ((index : I) ->
    member s index ->
    Convex orderedField space (family index)) ->
  ((subfamily : FiniteSubset I) ->
    SubsetOf subfamily s ->
    size subfamily == suc (dimension finiteDimension) ->
    IntersectionNonempty family subfamily) ->
  IntersectionNonempty family s

title: Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1632433 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1632433), "Helly's theorem": for a
  finite family of convex sets in a finite-dimensional vector space over a
  linear ordered field, if the family has at least dimension plus one members
  and every subfamily of that size has nonempty intersection, then the whole
  family has nonempty intersection. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val helly_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (one : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (inv : 'r -> 'r)
      (leq : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (vzero : 'e) (vadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (vneg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'r -> 'e -> 'e)
      (F : 'i -> 'e set) (s : 'i set).
      let ordered_field = (
        one <> zero /\
        (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
        (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
        (!x. mul x one = x) /\
        (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
        inv zero = zero /\
        (!x. x <> zero ==> mul x (inv x) = one) /\
        (!x. leq x x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
        (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y ==> leq (add z x) (add z y)) /\
        (!x y. leq zero x /\ leq zero y ==> leq zero (mul x y)))
      in
      let module_axioms = (
        (!x y. vadd x y = vadd y x) /\
        (!x y z. vadd (vadd x y) z = vadd x (vadd y z)) /\
        (!x. vadd x vzero = x) /\
        (!x. vadd x (vneg x) = vzero) /\
        (!x. smul one x = x) /\
        (!a b x. smul (mul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b x. smul (add a b) x = vadd (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a x y. smul a (vadd x y) = vadd (smul a x) (smul a y)))
      in
      let lincomb =
        \(basis : 'e list) (coeff : num -> 'r).
          FOLDL
            (\acc i. vadd acc (smul (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
            vzero
            (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))
      in
      let is_basis =
        \(basis : 'e list).
          ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
          (!coeff : num -> 'r.
            lincomb basis coeff = vzero ==>
            !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = zero) /\
          (!x : 'e.
            ?coeff : num -> 'r. lincomb basis coeff = x)
      in
      let finite_dimensional = (?basis : 'e list. is_basis basis)
      in
      let dimension = LENGTH (@basis : 'e list. is_basis basis)
      in
      let convex =
        \(c : 'e set).
          !x y a b.
            x IN c /\ y IN c /\
            leq zero a /\ leq zero b /\ add a b = one
            ==>
            vadd (smul a x) (smul b y) IN c
      in
      ordered_field /\
      module_axioms /\
      finite_dimensional /\
      FINITE s /\
      SUC dimension <= CARD s /\
      (!i. i IN s ==> convex (F i)) /\
      (!I : 'i set.
        I SUBSET s /\
        CARD I = SUC dimension
        ==>
        ?x : 'e. !i. i IN I ==> x IN F i)
      ==>
      ?x : 'e. !i. i IN s ==> x IN F i``;

$(

  The condition ( dim ` V ) e. NN0 expresses finite dimensionality. A is an
  arbitrary index set, S is the source finset of selected indices, and F maps
  every index to an arbitrary subset of V's carrier.

  Q1632433Convex is the ordered-field definition of convexity: every
  nonnegative two-coefficient affine combination whose coefficients sum to
  one remains in the set. Q1632433Intersects keeps the common point
  existentially quantified and states membership in every set indexed by the
  given subfamily. Thus both the source's subfamily I and every intersection
  witness remain internal to the statement.

  final one are syntax or bidirectional definitions. The final $a declaration
  is the single unproved corpus statement. This root artifact contains no $p

  by ITPEval.

${

      A. x e. T
        A. y e. T
          A. a e. ( Base ` K )
            A. b e. ( Base ` K )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( 0g ` K ) ( le ` K ) a
                    /\
                    ( 0g ` K ) ( le ` K ) b
                  )
                  /\
                  ( a ( +g ` K ) b ) = ( 1r ` K )
                )
                ->
                (
                  (
                    a ( .s ` V ) x
                  )
                  ( +g ` V )
                  (
                    b ( .s ` V ) y
                  )
                )
                e. T
              )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F I V i x $.

  q1632433-intersects-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1632433Intersects V F I )
    <->
    E. x e. ( Base ` V )
      A. i e. I
        x e. ( F ` i )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F I K S V i $.

  thousand-theorems-q1632433-helly $a |- (
    A. K e. oField
      A. V e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = K }
        A. A
          A. F e. ( ( ~P ( Base ` V ) ) ^m A )
            A. S e. ( ~P A i^i Fin )
              (
                (
                  (
                    ( dim ` V ) e. NN0
                    /\
                    (
                      ( ( dim ` V ) + 1 )
                      <_
                      ( # ` S )
                    )
                  )
                  /\
                  A. i e. S
                    ( Q1632433Convex K V ( F ` i ) )
                )
                /\
                A. I e. ( ~P S i^i Fin )
                  (
                    (
                      ( # ` I )
                      =
                      ( ( dim ` V ) + 1 )
                    )
                    ->
                    ( Q1632433Intersects V F I )
                  )
              )
              ->
              ( Q1632433Intersects V F S )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q1632433_helly_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1632433,
% "Helly's theorem": a finite family of convex sets in a finite-dimensional
% module over a linearly ordered field, with at least dimension plus one members,
% has nonempty total intersection if every dimension-plus-one subfamily does.
% This file contains no proof.

Q1632433_helly_s_theorem[
  I: TYPE,
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  leK: [K, K -> bool],
  zeroE: E,
  negE: [E -> E],
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  smul: [K, E -> E]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [I -> point_set]
  basis_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  coordinate_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> K]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[I]

  additive_group_laws_K: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      addK(x, zeroK) = x
        AND addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)

  field_multiplication_laws: bool =
    zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
        addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: K):
      leK(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      leK(x, y) AND leK(y, z) IMPLIES leK(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(x, y) AND leK(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(x, y) OR leK(y, x))

  strictly_ordered_ring_laws: bool =
    leK(zeroK, oneK)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      leK(x, y) IMPLIES
        leK(addK(x, z), addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(zeroK, x) AND leK(zeroK, y)
        IMPLIES leK(zeroK, mulK(x, y)))

  linearly_ordered_field_laws: bool =
    additive_group_laws_K
      AND field_multiplication_laws
      AND linear_order_laws
      AND strictly_ordered_ring_laws

  additive_commutative_group_laws_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      addE(x, zeroE) = x
        AND addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  module_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_laws_E
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
      smul(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
      smul(addK(a, b), x) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
      smul(mulK(a, b), x) =
        smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      smul(oneK, x) = x)

  vector_sum_below(
      count: nat,
      values: vector_sequence,
      total: E): bool =
    EXISTS (partial_sums: [upto(count) -> E]):
      partial_sums(0) = zeroE
        AND
      (FORALL (n: below(count)):
        partial_sums(n + 1) =
          addE(partial_sums(n), values(n)))
        AND total = partial_sums(count)

  basis_of_finrank(
      dimension: nat,
      basis: basis_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      EXISTS (coordinates: coordinate_sequence):
        vector_sum_below(
          dimension,
          (LAMBDA (n: nat):
            smul(coordinates(n), basis(n))),
          x)
          AND
        (FORALL (other: coordinate_sequence):
          vector_sum_below(
            dimension,
            (LAMBDA (n: nat):
              smul(other(n), basis(n))),
            x)
          IMPLIES
            (FORALL (n: nat):
              n < dimension IMPLIES
                other(n) = coordinates(n)))

  is_finrank(dimension: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (basis: basis_sequence):
      basis_of_finrank(dimension, basis)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (a, b: K):
      A(x)
        AND A(y)
        AND leK(zeroK, a)
        AND leK(zeroK, b)
        AND addK(a, b) = oneK
      IMPLIES
        A(addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, y)))

  finite_subset(
      smaller, larger: finite_set[I]): bool =
    FORALL (i: I):
      member(i, smaller) IMPLIES member(i, larger)

  family_intersection_nonempty(
      F: set_family,
      indices: finite_set[I]): bool =
    EXISTS (x: E):
      FORALL (i: I):
        member(i, indices) IMPLIES F(i)(x)

  convex_on(
      F: set_family,
      indices: finite_set[I]): bool =
    FORALL (i: I):
      member(i, indices) IMPLIES convex(F(i))

  critical_subfamilies_intersect(
      F: set_family,
      indices: finite_set[I],
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (subfamily: finite_set[I]):
      (finite_subset(subfamily, indices)
        AND card(subfamily) = dimension + 1)
      IMPLIES family_intersection_nonempty(F, subfamily)

  helly_theorem: bool =
    (linearly_ordered_field_laws AND module_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (F: set_family),
          (indices: finite_set[I]):
        (convex_on(F, indices)
          AND
        (EXISTS (dimension: nat):
          is_finrank(dimension)
            AND dimension + 1 <= card(indices)
            AND critical_subfamilies_intersect(
              F, indices, dimension)))
        IMPLIES family_intersection_nonempty(F, indices)
END Q1632433_helly_s_theorem

title: Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1660147
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1660147), "Mazur–Ulam theorem": every bijective
  isometry between real normed affine spaces is an affine isometry equivalence
  with the same underlying map. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q1660147_normed_real_vector_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q1660147_zero : V;
  q1660147_add : V -> V -> V;
  q1660147_neg : V -> V;
  q1660147_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q1660147_norm : V -> R;

  q1660147_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1660147_add x (q1660147_add y z) =
      q1660147_add (q1660147_add x y) z;
  q1660147_add_comm :
    forall x y : V,
      q1660147_add x y = q1660147_add y x;
  q1660147_add_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q1660147_add x q1660147_zero = x;
  q1660147_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q1660147_add x (q1660147_neg x) = q1660147_zero;

  q1660147_one_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q1660147_smul 1 x = x;
  q1660147_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1660147_smul (a * b) x =
      q1660147_smul a (q1660147_smul b x);
  q1660147_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1660147_smul (a + b) x =
      q1660147_add
        (q1660147_smul a x)
        (q1660147_smul b x);
  q1660147_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1660147_smul a (q1660147_add x y) =
      q1660147_add
        (q1660147_smul a x)
        (q1660147_smul a y);
  q1660147_zero_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q1660147_smul 0 x = q1660147_zero;
  q1660147_smul_zero :
    forall a : R,
      q1660147_smul a q1660147_zero = q1660147_zero;

  q1660147_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : V,
      0 <= q1660147_norm x;
  q1660147_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q1660147_norm x = 0 <-> x = q1660147_zero;
  q1660147_norm_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q1660147_norm (q1660147_neg x) = q1660147_norm x;
  q1660147_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : V,
      q1660147_norm (q1660147_add x y) <=
      q1660147_norm x + q1660147_norm y;
  q1660147_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : V),
      q1660147_norm (q1660147_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q1660147_norm x
}.

Arguments q1660147_zero {V} _.
Arguments q1660147_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1660147_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q1660147_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1660147_norm {V} _ _.

Record q1660147_normed_add_torsor
    (V P : Type)
    (S : q1660147_normed_real_vector_space V) : Type := {
  q1660147_basepoint : P;
  q1660147_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q1660147_vsub : P -> P -> V;

  q1660147_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P,
      q1660147_vadd (q1660147_zero S) p = p;
  q1660147_add_vadd :
    forall (u v : V) (p : P),
      q1660147_vadd (q1660147_add S u v) p =
      q1660147_vadd u (q1660147_vadd v p);
  q1660147_vsub_vadd :
    forall p q : P,
      q1660147_vadd (q1660147_vsub p q) q = p;
  q1660147_vadd_vsub :
    forall (v : V) (p : P),
      q1660147_vsub (q1660147_vadd v p) p = v
}.

Arguments q1660147_vadd {V P S} _ _ _.
Arguments q1660147_vsub {V P S} _ _ _.

Definition q1660147_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {S : q1660147_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (T : @q1660147_normed_add_torsor V P S)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q1660147_norm S (q1660147_vsub T p q).

Theorem IsometryEquiv_coe_toRealAffineIsometryEquiv :
  forall (E PE F PF : Type)
         (VE : q1660147_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (VF : q1660147_normed_real_vector_space F)
         (TE : @q1660147_normed_add_torsor E PE VE)
         (TF : @q1660147_normed_add_torsor F PF VF)
         (forward : PE -> PF)
         (inverse : PF -> PE),
    (forall p : PE, inverse (forward p) = p) ->
    (forall q : PF, forward (inverse q) = q) ->
    (forall p q : PE,
      q1660147_dist TF (forward p) (forward q) =
      q1660147_dist TE p q) ->
    exists (linear_part : E -> F)
           (linear_inverse : F -> E),
      (forall x y : E,
        linear_part (q1660147_add VE x y) =
        q1660147_add VF (linear_part x) (linear_part y)) /\
      (forall (a : R) (x : E),
        linear_part (q1660147_smul VE a x) =
        q1660147_smul VF a (linear_part x)) /\
      (forall x : E,
        q1660147_norm VF (linear_part x) =
        q1660147_norm VE x) /\
      (forall x : E,
        linear_inverse (linear_part x) = x) /\
      (forall y : F,
        linear_part (linear_inverse y) = y) /\
      (forall (v : E) (p : PE),
        forward (q1660147_vadd TE v p) =
        q1660147_vadd TF (linear_part v) (forward p)).
Admitted.

title: Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q1660147 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1660147), "Mazur–Ulam theorem":
  every bijective isometry between normed real affine spaces is induced by an
  affine isometric equivalence. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1660147_normed_add_torsor ::
    "('v::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'p::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'p) \<Rightarrow>
      ('p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1660147_normed_add_torsor vadd vsub \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p. vadd 0 p = p) \<and>
    (\<forall>v w p. vadd (v + w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) \<and>
    (\<forall>p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) \<and>
    (\<forall>v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) \<and>
    (\<forall>p q. dist p q = norm (vsub p q))"

theorem q1660147_mazur_ulam:
  fixes vaddE ::
      "'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'pe::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'pe"
    and vsubE :: "'pe \<Rightarrow> 'pe \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and vaddF ::
      "'f::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'pf::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'pf"
    and vsubF :: "'pf \<Rightarrow> 'pf \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and g :: "'pe \<Rightarrow> 'pf"
  assumes source_torsor: "q1660147_normed_add_torsor vaddE vsubE"
    and target_torsor: "q1660147_normed_add_torsor vaddF vsubF"
    and isometry: "\<forall>p q. dist (g p) (g q) = dist p q"
    and bijective: "bij g"
  shows
    "\<exists>L :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'f.
      linear L \<and>
      bij L \<and>
      (\<forall>v. norm (L v) = norm v) \<and>
      (\<forall>v p. g (vaddE v p) = vaddF (L v) (g p))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1660147,
  "Mazur–Ulam theorem": every bijective isometry between arbitrary real normed
  affine spaces is an affine isometry equivalence. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1660147_MAZUR_ULAM_THEOREM =
 `let real_normed_vector_space =
    \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
     (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real).
       (!x y z:A. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:A.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:A.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:A.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x:A. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
       (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
       (!a:real. !x:A. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) in
  let real_normed_vector_space' =
    \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B)
     (smul:real->B->B) (norm:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:B. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:B. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:B. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:B.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:B.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:B.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x:B. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
       (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) /\
       norm zero = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:B. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:B. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
       (!x y:B. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
       (!a:real. !x:B. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A)
     (vadd:A->C->C) (vsub:C->C->A).
       (!p:C. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:A. !p:C.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!p:C. vsub p p = zero) /\
       (!p q:C. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
       (!v:A. !p:C. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) in
  let affine_torsor' =
    \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B)
     (vadd:B->D->D) (vsub:D->D->B).
       (!p:D. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:B. !p:D.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!p:D. vsub p p = zero) /\
       (!p q:D. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
       (!v:B. !p:D. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) in
  let isometry_equiv =
    \(vsubE:C->C->A) (normE:A->real)
     (vsubF:D->D->B) (normF:B->real)
     (f:C->D) (finv:D->C).
       (!p:C. finv (f p) = p) /\
       (!q:D. f (finv q) = q) /\
       (!p q:C.
          normF (vsubF (f p) (f q)) =
          normE (vsubE p q)) in
  let linear_isometry_equiv =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (smulE:real->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (addF:B->B->B) (smulF:real->B->B) (normF:B->real)
     (L:A->B) (Linv:B->A).
       (!x y:A. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
       (!a:real. !x:A. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x)) /\
       (!x:A. normF (L x) = normE x) /\
       (!x:A. Linv (L x) = x) /\
       (!y:B. L (Linv y) = y) in
  !zeroE:A.
  !addE:A->A->A.
  !negE:A->A.
  !smulE:real->A->A.
  !normE:A->real.
  !zeroF:B.
  !addF:B->B->B.
  !negF:B->B.
  !smulF:real->B->B.
  !normF:B->real.
  !vaddE:A->C->C.
  !vsubE:C->C->A.
  !vaddF:B->D->D.
  !vsubF:D->D->B.
  !f:C->D.
  !finv:D->C.
    real_normed_vector_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
    real_normed_vector_space' zeroF addF negF smulF normF /\
    affine_torsor zeroE addE vaddE vsubE /\
    affine_torsor' zeroF addF vaddF vsubF /\
    isometry_equiv vsubE normE vsubF normF f finv
    ==> ?L:A->B. ?Linv:B->A.
          linear_isometry_equiv
            addE smulE normE addF smulF normF L Linv /\
          (!v:A. !p:C.
             f (vaddE v p) = vaddF (L v) (f p))`;;

;; "Mazur–Ulam theorem": every isometric equivalence between real normed
;; affine spaces is an affine isometry equivalence with the same underlying
;; map. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative application interfaces present arbitrary carriers and

(defstub q1660147-apply1 (function x) t)
(defstub q1660147-apply2 (function x y) t)

(defun q1660147-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (q1660147-apply1 carrier x) t nil))

;; A presentation of the real numbers as a complete ordered field.

(defun-sk q1660147-real-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p carrier x)
      (q1660147-member-p carrier y)
      (q1660147-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q1660147-apply2 add x y))
            (yz-add (q1660147-apply2 add y z))
            (xy-multiply (q1660147-apply2 multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (q1660147-apply2 multiply y z))
            (negative-x (q1660147-apply1 negate x))
            (inverse-x (q1660147-apply1 inverse x)))
       (and
        (q1660147-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q1660147-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (q1660147-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (q1660147-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 add xy-add z)
         (q1660147-apply2 add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1660147-apply2 add y x))
        (equal (q1660147-apply2 add x zero) x)
        (equal (q1660147-apply2 add x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 multiply xy-multiply z)
         (q1660147-apply2 multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal xy-multiply (q1660147-apply2 multiply y x))
        (equal (q1660147-apply2 multiply x one) x)
        (equal (q1660147-apply1 inverse zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1660147-apply2 multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 multiply x yz-add)
         (q1660147-apply2
          add
          (q1660147-apply2 multiply x y)
          (q1660147-apply2 multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p carrier x)
      (q1660147-member-p carrier y)
      (q1660147-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q1660147-apply2 less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (q1660147-apply2 less x y)
       (q1660147-apply2 less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1660147-apply2 less x y)
        (q1660147-apply2 less y z))
       (q1660147-apply2 less x z))
      (implies
       (q1660147-apply2 less x y)
       (q1660147-apply2
        less
        (q1660147-apply2 add x z)
        (q1660147-apply2 add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q1660147-apply2 less zero x)
        (q1660147-apply2 less zero y))
       (q1660147-apply2
        less zero (q1660147-apply2 multiply x y)))))))

(defun q1660147-real-leq-p (less left right)
  (not (q1660147-apply2 less right left)))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-set-valid-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1660147-apply1 set x)
     (q1660147-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q1660147-member-p carrier x)
     (q1660147-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p carrier x)
      (q1660147-apply1 set x))
     (q1660147-real-leq-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q1660147-member-p carrier bound)
     (q1660147-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p carrier bound)
      (q1660147-real-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (q1660147-real-leq-p less supremum bound))))

(defun q1660147-real-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (q1660147-member-p carrier supremum)
   (q1660147-real-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (q1660147-real-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-supremum-exists-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q1660147-real-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q1660147-real-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-real-set-valid-p carrier set)
      (q1660147-real-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q1660147-real-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (q1660147-real-supremum-exists-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q1660147-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (q1660147-member-p carrier zero)
   (q1660147-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q1660147-apply2 less zero one)
   (q1660147-real-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q1660147-real-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (q1660147-real-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun q1660147-real-abs
    (zero negate less value)
  (if (q1660147-apply2 less value zero)
      (q1660147-apply1 negate value)
    value))

;; Normed vector spaces over the presented real field.

(defun-sk q1660147-vector-space-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate scalar-multiply)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p real-carrier a)
      (q1660147-member-p real-carrier b)
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier x)
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier y)
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q1660147-apply2 vector-add x y))
            (yz-add (q1660147-apply2 vector-add y z))
            (negative-x (q1660147-apply1 vector-negate x))
            (a-times-x
             (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply a x))
            (b-times-x
             (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply b x)))
       (and
        (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier xy-add)
        (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier negative-x)
        (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier a-times-x)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 vector-add xy-add z)
         (q1660147-apply2 vector-add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q1660147-apply2 vector-add y x))
        (equal (q1660147-apply2 vector-add x vector-zero) x)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 vector-add x negative-x)
         vector-zero)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply real-one x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2
          scalar-multiply
          (q1660147-apply2 real-multiply a b)
          x)
         (q1660147-apply2
          scalar-multiply a b-times-x))
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2
          scalar-multiply
          (q1660147-apply2 real-add a b)
          x)
         (q1660147-apply2
          vector-add a-times-x b-times-x))
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply a xy-add)
         (q1660147-apply2
          vector-add
          (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply a x)
          (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply a y)))
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply real-zero x)
         vector-zero))))))

(defun-sk q1660147-norm-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
     vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add scalar-multiply norm)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p real-carrier a)
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier x)
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier y))
     (let ((norm-x (q1660147-apply1 norm x))
           (norm-y (q1660147-apply1 norm y))
           (norm-xy
            (q1660147-apply1
             norm (q1660147-apply2 vector-add x y))))
       (and
        (q1660147-member-p real-carrier norm-x)
        (q1660147-real-leq-p real-less real-zero norm-x)
        (iff (equal norm-x real-zero)
             (equal x vector-zero))
        (q1660147-real-leq-p
         real-less
         norm-xy
         (q1660147-apply2 real-add norm-x norm-y))
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply1
          norm
          (q1660147-apply2 scalar-multiply a x))
         (q1660147-apply2
          real-multiply
          (q1660147-real-abs
           real-zero real-negate real-less a)
          norm-x)))))))

(defun q1660147-normed-real-vector-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-less
     vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate
     scalar-multiply norm)
  (and
   (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier vector-zero)
   (q1660147-vector-space-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate scalar-multiply)
   (q1660147-norm-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-negate real-less
    vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add scalar-multiply norm)))

;; Normed affine spaces, represented as additive torsors whose point distance
;; is the norm of the vector difference.

(defun-sk q1660147-torsor-laws-p
    (vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add
     point-carrier vector-add-point point-subtract)
  (forall (v w p q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier v)
      (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier w)
      (q1660147-member-p point-carrier p)
      (q1660147-member-p point-carrier q))
     (let ((v-plus-p
            (q1660147-apply2 vector-add-point v p))
           (p-minus-q
            (q1660147-apply2 point-subtract p q)))
       (and
        (q1660147-member-p point-carrier v-plus-p)
        (q1660147-member-p vector-carrier p-minus-q)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2 vector-add-point vector-zero p)
         p)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2
          vector-add-point
          (q1660147-apply2 vector-add v w)
          p)
         (q1660147-apply2
          vector-add-point
          v
          (q1660147-apply2 vector-add-point w p)))
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2
          vector-add-point p-minus-q q)
         p)
        (equal
         (q1660147-apply2
          point-subtract v-plus-p p)
         v))))))

(defun-sk q1660147-point-carrier-nonempty-p (point-carrier)
  (exists (p)
    (q1660147-member-p point-carrier p)))

(defun q1660147-normed-affine-space-p
    (vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add
     point-carrier vector-add-point point-subtract)
  (and
   (q1660147-point-carrier-nonempty-p point-carrier)
   (q1660147-torsor-laws-p
    vector-carrier vector-zero vector-add
    point-carrier vector-add-point point-subtract)))

(defun q1660147-point-distance
    (norm point-subtract p q)
  (q1660147-apply1
   norm (q1660147-apply2 point-subtract p q)))

;; The source object f : PE ≃ᵢ PF is represented by a mutually inverse pair
;; of maps. Its isometry field is the equality of all point distances.

(defun-sk q1660147-map-points-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier map)
  (forall (p)
    (implies
     (q1660147-member-p source-carrier p)
     (q1660147-member-p
      target-carrier (q1660147-apply1 map p)))))

(defun-sk q1660147-maps-inverse-p
    (source-carrier target-carrier map inverse-map)
  (forall (p q)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1660147-member-p source-carrier p)
      (equal
       (q1660147-apply1
        inverse-map (q1660147-apply1 map p))
       p))
     (implies
      (q1660147-member-p target-carrier q)
      (equal
       (q1660147-apply1
        map (q1660147-apply1 inverse-map q))
       q)))))

(defun-sk q1660147-map-isometry-p
    (source-carrier source-norm source-point-subtract
     target-norm target-point-subtract map)
  (forall (p q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p source-carrier p)
      (q1660147-member-p source-carrier q))
     (equal
      (q1660147-point-distance
       target-norm target-point-subtract
       (q1660147-apply1 map p)
       (q1660147-apply1 map q))
      (q1660147-point-distance
       source-norm source-point-subtract p q)))))

(defun q1660147-isometry-equivalence-p
    (source-carrier source-norm source-point-subtract
     target-carrier target-norm target-point-subtract
     map inverse-map)
  (and
   (q1660147-map-points-p source-carrier target-carrier map)
   (q1660147-map-points-p target-carrier source-carrier inverse-map)
   (q1660147-maps-inverse-p
    source-carrier target-carrier map inverse-map)
   (q1660147-map-isometry-p
    source-carrier source-norm source-point-subtract
    target-norm target-point-subtract map)))

;; An internally quantified linear isometry equivalence is the linear part of
;; the affine lift. Keeping this witness existential preserves the source
;; theorem's quantifier scope.

(defun-sk q1660147-linear-map-laws-p
    (real-carrier
     source-carrier source-add source-scalar-multiply
     target-carrier target-add target-scalar-multiply linear-map)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p real-carrier a)
      (q1660147-member-p source-carrier x)
      (q1660147-member-p source-carrier y))
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p
       target-carrier (q1660147-apply1 linear-map x))
      (equal
       (q1660147-apply1
        linear-map (q1660147-apply2 source-add x y))
       (q1660147-apply2
        target-add
        (q1660147-apply1 linear-map x)
        (q1660147-apply1 linear-map y)))
      (equal
       (q1660147-apply1
        linear-map
        (q1660147-apply2 source-scalar-multiply a x))
       (q1660147-apply2
        target-scalar-multiply
        a
        (q1660147-apply1 linear-map x)))))))

(defun-sk q1660147-linear-norm-preserving-p
    (source-carrier source-norm target-norm linear-map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1660147-member-p source-carrier x)
     (equal
      (q1660147-apply1
       target-norm (q1660147-apply1 linear-map x))
      (q1660147-apply1 source-norm x)))))

(defun q1660147-linear-isometry-equivalence-p
    (real-carrier
     source-carrier source-add source-scalar-multiply source-norm
     target-carrier target-add target-scalar-multiply target-norm
     linear-map linear-inverse)
  (and
   (q1660147-linear-map-laws-p
    real-carrier
    source-carrier source-add source-scalar-multiply
    target-carrier target-add target-scalar-multiply linear-map)
   (q1660147-linear-map-laws-p
    real-carrier
    target-carrier target-add target-scalar-multiply
    source-carrier source-add source-scalar-multiply linear-inverse)
   (q1660147-maps-inverse-p
    source-carrier target-carrier linear-map linear-inverse)
   (q1660147-linear-norm-preserving-p
    source-carrier source-norm target-norm linear-map)))

(defun-sk q1660147-affine-compatibility-p
    (source-vector-carrier source-point-carrier source-vector-add-point
     target-vector-add-point map linear-map)
  (forall (v p)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1660147-member-p source-vector-carrier v)
      (q1660147-member-p source-point-carrier p))
     (equal
      (q1660147-apply1
       map
       (q1660147-apply2 source-vector-add-point v p))
      (q1660147-apply2
       target-vector-add-point
       (q1660147-apply1 linear-map v)

(defun q1660147-affine-isometry-lift-p
    (real-carrier
     source-vector-carrier source-vector-add source-scalar-multiply source-norm
     source-point-carrier source-vector-add-point
     target-vector-carrier target-vector-add target-scalar-multiply target-norm
     target-vector-add-point
     map linear-map linear-inverse)
  (and
   (q1660147-linear-isometry-equivalence-p
    real-carrier
    source-vector-carrier source-vector-add
    source-scalar-multiply source-norm
    target-vector-carrier target-vector-add
    target-scalar-multiply target-norm
    linear-map linear-inverse)

    source-vector-carrier source-point-carrier source-vector-add-point

(defun-sk q1660147-affine-isometry-lift-exists-p

     source-vector-carrier source-vector-add source-scalar-multiply source-norm
     source-point-carrier source-vector-add-point
     target-vector-carrier target-vector-add target-scalar-multiply target-norm

  (exists (linear-map linear-inverse)
    (q1660147-affine-isometry-lift-p

     source-scalar-multiply source-norm

     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-less

     target-vector-negate target-scalar-multiply target-norm)
    (q1660147-normed-affine-space-p
     target-vector-carrier target-vector-zero target-vector-add
     target-point-carrier target-vector-add-point target-point-subtract)
    (q1660147-isometry-equivalence-p

     target-point-carrier target-norm target-point-subtract

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1660147
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1660147), "Mazur–Ulam theorem": every bijective
-- isometry between real normed affine spaces is an affine isometry with the
-- same underlying forward and inverse maps. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set r
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

record RealNormedVectorSpace
  {r e : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (E : Set e) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e)) where

  field
    zeroV : E
    addV : E -> E -> E
    negateV : E -> E
    scaleV : R -> E -> E
    normV : E -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : E) ->
      addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : E) ->
      addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : E) ->
      addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) x ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) ==
      addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) x ==
      addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyV :
      (x : E) ->
      normV x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroV
    norm-addV :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normV x)

open RealNormedVectorSpace

record NormedAddTorsor
  {r e p : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  (vectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals E)
  (P : Set p) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e ⊔ p)) where

  field
    basePoint : P
    vadd : E -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> E

    zero-vadd :
      (point : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV vectors) point == point
    add-vadd :
      (u v : E) ->
      (point : P) ->
      vadd (addV vectors u v) point ==
      vadd u (vadd v point)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p1 p2 : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p1 p2) p2 == p1
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : E) ->
      (point : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v point) point == v

open NormedAddTorsor

distance :
  {r e p : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {vectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals E} ->
  NormedAddTorsor vectors P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {vectors = vectors} affine p q =
  normV vectors (vsub affine p q)

record IsometryEquiv
  {r e pe f pf : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  {PE : Set pe}
  {F : Set f}
  {PF : Set pf}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {sourceVectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals E}
  {targetVectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals F}
  (sourceAffine : NormedAddTorsor sourceVectors PE)
  (targetAffine : NormedAddTorsor targetVectors PF) :
  Set (r ⊔ e ⊔ pe ⊔ f ⊔ pf) where

  field
    forward : PE -> PF
    backward : PF -> PE
    forward-after-backward :
      (y : PF) ->
      forward (backward y) == y
    backward-after-forward :
      (x : PE) ->
      backward (forward x) == x
    forward-distance :
      (x y : PE) ->
      distance targetAffine (forward x) (forward y) ==
      distance sourceAffine x y

open IsometryEquiv

record LinearIsometryEquiv
  {r e f : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  {F : Set f}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  (source : RealNormedVectorSpace reals E)
  (target : RealNormedVectorSpace reals F) :
  Set (r ⊔ e ⊔ f) where

  field
    forwardLinear : E -> F
    backwardLinear : F -> E
    forward-after-backwardLinear :
      (y : F) ->
      forwardLinear (backwardLinear y) == y
    backward-after-forwardLinear :
      (x : E) ->
      backwardLinear (forwardLinear x) == x
    forward-addLinear :
      (x y : E) ->
      forwardLinear (addV source x y) ==
      addV target (forwardLinear x) (forwardLinear y)
    forward-scaleLinear :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      forwardLinear (scaleV source a x) ==
      scaleV target a (forwardLinear x)
    forward-normLinear :
      (x : E) ->
      normV target (forwardLinear x) ==
      normV source x

open LinearIsometryEquiv

record AffineIsometryEquiv
  {r e pe f pf : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  {PE : Set pe}
  {F : Set f}
  {PF : Set pf}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  (sourceVectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals E)
  (targetVectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals F)
  (sourceAffine : NormedAddTorsor sourceVectors PE)
  (targetAffine : NormedAddTorsor targetVectors PF) :
  Set (r ⊔ e ⊔ pe ⊔ f ⊔ pf) where

  field
    toIsometryEquiv :
      IsometryEquiv sourceAffine targetAffine
    linearPart :
      LinearIsometryEquiv sourceVectors targetVectors
    map-vadd :
      (v : E) ->
      (point : PE) ->
      forward toIsometryEquiv (vadd sourceAffine v point) ==
      vadd targetAffine
        (forwardLinear linearPart v)
        (forward toIsometryEquiv point)

open AffineIsometryEquiv

mazur-ulam-theorem :
  (r e pe f pf : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e ⊔ pe ⊔ f ⊔ pf))
mazur-ulam-theorem r e pe f pf =
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (sourceVectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals E) ->
  (PE : Set pe) ->
  (sourceAffine : NormedAddTorsor sourceVectors PE) ->
  (F : Set f) ->
  (targetVectors : RealNormedVectorSpace reals F) ->
  (PF : Set pf) ->
  (targetAffine : NormedAddTorsor targetVectors PF) ->
  (isometry : IsometryEquiv sourceAffine targetAffine) ->
  Exists
    (AffineIsometryEquiv
      sourceVectors targetVectors sourceAffine targetAffine)
    (\ affineIsometry ->
      Both
        ((x : PE) ->
          forward (toIsometryEquiv affineIsometry) x ==
          forward isometry x)
        ((y : PF) ->
          backward (toIsometryEquiv affineIsometry) y ==
          backward isometry y))

title: Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1660147 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1660147), "Mazur–Ulam theorem":
  every bijective isometry between real normed affine spaces is an affine
  isometry equivalence with the same underlying map. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory;

val q1660147_normed_real_vector_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1660147_normed_real_vector_space_def",
  ``q1660147_normed_real_vector_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q1660147_normed_add_torsor_def = new_definition (
  "q1660147_normed_add_torsor_def",
  ``q1660147_normed_add_torsor
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p) (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q1660147_isometry_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q1660147_isometry_equiv_def",
  ``q1660147_isometry_equiv
      (normE : 'e -> real) (vsubE : 'pe -> 'pe -> 'e)
      (normF : 'f -> real) (vsubF : 'pf -> 'pf -> 'f)
      (forward : 'pe -> 'pf) (inverse : 'pf -> 'pe) <=>
      (!p q.
        normF (vsubF (forward p) (forward q)) =
        normE (vsubE p q)) /\
      (!p. inverse (forward p) = p) /\
      (!q. forward (inverse q) = q)``);

val q1660147_linear_isometry_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q1660147_linear_isometry_equiv_def",
  ``q1660147_linear_isometry_equiv
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real)
      (forward : 'e -> 'f) (inverse : 'f -> 'e) <=>
      (!x y. forward (addE x y) = addF (forward x) (forward y)) /\
      (!a x. forward (smulE a x) = smulF a (forward x)) /\
      (!x. normF (forward x) = normE x) /\
      (!x. inverse (forward x) = x) /\
      (!y. forward (inverse y) = y)``);

val coe_toRealAffineIsometryEquiv =
  ``!(zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (vaddE : 'e -> 'pe -> 'pe) (vsubE : 'pe -> 'pe -> 'e)
      (vaddF : 'f -> 'pf -> 'pf) (vsubF : 'pf -> 'pf -> 'f)
      (forward : 'pe -> 'pf) (inverse : 'pf -> 'pe).
      q1660147_normed_real_vector_space
        zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q1660147_normed_real_vector_space
        zeroF addF negF smulF normF /\
      q1660147_normed_add_torsor zeroE addE vaddE vsubE /\
      q1660147_normed_add_torsor zeroF addF vaddF vsubF /\
      q1660147_isometry_equiv
        normE vsubE normF vsubF forward inverse
      ==>
      ?linear inverseLinear.
        q1660147_linear_isometry_equiv
          addE smulE normE addF smulF normF
          linear inverseLinear /\
        !p v.
          forward (vaddE v p) =
          vaddF (linear v) (forward p)``;

title: Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1660147
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1660147), "Mazur–Ulam theorem": every
  isometric equivalence between arbitrary real normed affine spaces is an
  affine isometry equivalence with the same underlying isometry. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  E and F range over SetMM normed vector spaces over RRfld. The arbitrary
  point carriers P and Q, together with A,D and B,C, respectively, present
  normed additive torsors: A and B are vector additions on points, while D
  and C are point differences. Their induced distances are the norms of point
  differences.

  Q1660147IsometryEquiv states that f and g are mutually inverse maps and that
  f preserves every induced distance. Q1660147LinearIsometryEquiv states that
  L and M are mutually inverse real-linear maps and that L preserves norms.
  The conclusion keeps L and M internally existentially quantified and adds
  the affine compatibility equation for the original map f. This is exactly
  the data of a real affine isometry equivalence whose underlying isometry
  equivalence is f (and hence has inverse g), matching the source equality
  `toRealAffineIsometryEquiv.toIsometryEquiv = f`.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a faithful
  bidirectional definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1660147NormedAddTorsor Q1660147IsometryEquiv
   Q1660147LinearIsometryEquiv Q1660147AffineCompatible $.

q1660147-normed-add-torsor-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1660147NormedAddTorsor E P A D ) $.
q1660147-isometry-equiv-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1660147IsometryEquiv E P D F Q C f g ) $.
q1660147-linear-isometry-equiv-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1660147LinearIsometryEquiv E F L M ) $.
q1660147-affine-compatible-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1660147AffineCompatible E P A F Q B f L ) $.

${
  $d A D E P p q u v $.

  q1660147-normed-add-torsor-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1660147NormedAddTorsor E P A D )
    <->
    (
      P =/= (/)
      /\
      A : ( ( Base ` E ) X. P ) --> P
      /\
      D : ( P X. P ) --> ( Base ` E )
      /\
      A. p e. P
        ( A ` <. ( 0g ` E ) , p >. ) = p
      /\
      A. u e. ( Base ` E )
        A. v e. ( Base ` E )
          A. p e. P
            (
              A
              `
              <. ( u ( +g ` E ) v ) , p >.
            )
            =
            (
              A
              `
              <. u , ( A ` <. v , p >. ) >.
            )
      /\
      A. p e. P
        A. q e. P
          (
            A
            `
            <. ( D ` <. p , q >. ) , q >.
          )
          =
          p
      /\
      A. v e. ( Base ` E )
        A. p e. P
          (
            D
            `
            <. ( A ` <. v , p >. ) , p >.
          )
          =
          v
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C D E F P Q f g p q r $.

  q1660147-isometry-equiv-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1660147IsometryEquiv E P D F Q C f g )
    <->
    (
      f : P -1-1-onto-> Q
      /\
      g : Q -1-1-onto-> P
      /\
      A. p e. P ( g ` ( f ` p ) ) = p
      /\
      A. r e. Q ( f ` ( g ` r ) ) = r
      /\
      A. p e. P
        A. q e. P
          (
            ( norm ` F )
            `
            (
              C
              `
              <. ( f ` p ) , ( f ` q ) >.
            )
          )
          =
          (
            ( norm ` E )
            `
            ( D ` <. p , q >. )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E F L M x y $.

  q1660147-linear-isometry-equiv-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1660147LinearIsometryEquiv E F L M )
    <->
    (
      L e. ( E LMHom F )
      /\
      M e. ( F LMHom E )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` E )
        ( M ` ( L ` x ) ) = x
      /\
      A. y e. ( Base ` F )
        ( L ` ( M ` y ) ) = y
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` E )
        (
          ( norm ` F )
          `
          ( L ` x )
        )
        =
        ( ( norm ` E ) ` x )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B E F L P Q f p v $.

  q1660147-affine-compatible-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1660147AffineCompatible E P A F Q B f L )
    <->
    A. v e. ( Base ` E )
      A. p e. P
        (
          f
          `
          ( A ` <. v , p >. )
        )
        =
        (
          B
          `
          <. ( L ` v ) , ( f ` p ) >.
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D E F L M P Q f g e h $.

  thousand-theorems-q1660147-mazur-ulam-theorem $a |-
    A. E e. { e e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` e ) = RRfld }
      A. F e. { h e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` h ) = RRfld }
        A. P A. Q A. A A. D A. B A. C A. f A. g
          (
            (
              ( Q1660147NormedAddTorsor E P A D )
              /\
              ( Q1660147NormedAddTorsor F Q B C )
              /\
              ( Q1660147IsometryEquiv E P D F Q C f g )
            )
            ->
            E. L E. M
              (
                ( Q1660147LinearIsometryEquiv E F L M )
                /\
                ( Q1660147AffineCompatible E P A F Q B f L )
              )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q1660147_mazur_ulam_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1660147
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1660147), "Mazur–Ulam theorem": every isometric
% equivalence between real normed affine spaces is an affine isometry
% equivalence with the same underlying map. This file contains no proof.

mazur_ulam_theorem_Q1660147[
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  PE: TYPE+,
  PF: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  smulF: [real, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real],
  point_vaddE: [E, PE -> PE],
  vsubE: [PE, PE -> E],
  point_vaddF: [F, PF -> PF],
  vsubF: [PF, PF -> F],
  forward: [PE -> PF],
  inverse: [PF -> PE]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  normed_real_vector_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):

      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):

      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):

  normed_real_vector_space_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):

      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: F):
        smulF(a * b, x) = smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(0, x) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulF(a, zeroF) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):

      AND (FORALL (x: F):

      AND (FORALL (x: F):

      AND (FORALL (x: F):

      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):

  normed_add_torsor_E: bool =
    (FORALL (p: PE):

  isometry_equivalence: bool =
    (FORALL (p: PE):

  linear_isometry_equivalence(
      linear_part: [E -> F],

  coe_toRealAffineIsometryEquiv: bool =
    (normed_real_vector_space_E

      AND normed_add_torsor_E
      AND normed_add_torsor_F

          AND FORALL (v: E), (p: PE):

module

public import Mathlib.SetTheory.Game.Nim

@[expose] public section

universe u

open SetTheory
open scoped PGame

namespace Q1687147

/-- Every impartial game is equivalent to the Nim game determined by its Grundy value. -/
theorem sprague_grundy_theorem_statement (G : PGame.{u}) [G.Impartial] :
    PGame.nim (Nimber.toOrdinal (PGame.grundyValue G)) ≈ G := sorry
