title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1687147
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1687147), "Sprague-Grundy theorem": every
  impartial well-founded normal-play game is equivalent to the canonical game
  of Nim at its Grundy nimber. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Wellfounded.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Inductive q1687147_player : Type :=
| q1687147_left
| q1687147_right.

Definition q1687147_other (p : q1687147_player) : q1687147_player :=
  match p with
  | q1687147_left => q1687147_right
  | q1687147_right => q1687147_left
  end.

Record q1687147_game_system : Type := {
  q1687147_game : Type;
  q1687147_move :
    q1687147_player -> q1687147_game -> q1687147_game -> Prop;
  q1687147_move_well_founded :
    well_founded
      (fun child parent : q1687147_game =>
        exists p : q1687147_player,
          q1687147_move p parent child);
  q1687147_neg :
    q1687147_game -> q1687147_game;
  q1687147_neg_moves :
    forall (p : q1687147_player)
           (x y : q1687147_game),
      q1687147_move p (q1687147_neg x) y <->
      exists z : q1687147_game,
        q1687147_move (q1687147_other p) x z /\
        y = q1687147_neg z
}.

Arguments q1687147_game _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1687147_move _ _ _ _ : assert.
Arguments q1687147_neg _ _ : assert.

(* Winning in the disjunctive sum of two games: on one's own turn one may
   move in either component, while on the opponent's turn every legal reply
   must leave a winning position. *)
Inductive q1687147_sum_wins
    (S : q1687147_game_system)
    (winner : q1687147_player) :
    q1687147_player ->
    q1687147_game S ->
    q1687147_game S ->
    Prop :=
| q1687147_sum_wins_move_first :
    forall x x' z : q1687147_game S,
      q1687147_move S winner x x' ->
      q1687147_sum_wins S winner (q1687147_other winner) x' z ->
      q1687147_sum_wins S winner winner x z
| q1687147_sum_wins_move_second :
    forall x z z' : q1687147_game S,
      q1687147_move S winner z z' ->
      q1687147_sum_wins S winner (q1687147_other winner) x z' ->
      q1687147_sum_wins S winner winner x z
| q1687147_sum_wins_opponent_turn :
    forall x z : q1687147_game S,
      (forall x' : q1687147_game S,
        q1687147_move S (q1687147_other winner) x x' ->
        q1687147_sum_wins S winner winner x' z) ->
      (forall z' : q1687147_game S,
        q1687147_move S (q1687147_other winner) z z' ->
        q1687147_sum_wins S winner winner x z') ->
      q1687147_sum_wins S winner (q1687147_other winner) x z.

Definition q1687147_game_equiv
    (S : q1687147_game_system)
    (x y : q1687147_game S) : Prop :=
  forall (context : q1687147_game S)
         (winner turn : q1687147_player),
    q1687147_sum_wins S winner turn x context <->
    q1687147_sum_wins S winner turn y context.

Inductive q1687147_impartial
    (S : q1687147_game_system) :
    q1687147_game S -> Prop :=
| q1687147_impartial_intro :
    forall x : q1687147_game S,
      q1687147_game_equiv S (q1687147_neg S x) x ->
      (forall (p : q1687147_player) (y : q1687147_game S),
        q1687147_move S p x y ->
        q1687147_impartial S y) ->
      q1687147_impartial S x.

Record q1687147_nimber_model
    (S : q1687147_game_system) : Type := {
  q1687147_nimber : Type;
  q1687147_nimber_lt :
    q1687147_nimber -> q1687147_nimber -> Prop;
  q1687147_nimber_lt_well_founded :
    well_founded q1687147_nimber_lt;
  q1687147_nimber_lt_irrefl :
    forall a : q1687147_nimber,
      ~ q1687147_nimber_lt a a;
  q1687147_nimber_lt_trans :
    forall a b c : q1687147_nimber,
      q1687147_nimber_lt a b ->
      q1687147_nimber_lt b c ->
      q1687147_nimber_lt a c;
  q1687147_nimber_lt_total :
    forall a b : q1687147_nimber,
      a = b \/
      q1687147_nimber_lt a b \/
      q1687147_nimber_lt b a;

  q1687147_grundy :
    q1687147_game S -> q1687147_nimber;
  q1687147_grundy_excluded :
    forall x : q1687147_game S,
      ~ exists y : q1687147_game S,
          q1687147_move S q1687147_right x y /\
          q1687147_grundy y = q1687147_grundy x;
  q1687147_grundy_covers_lower :
    forall (x : q1687147_game S) (a : q1687147_nimber),
      q1687147_nimber_lt a (q1687147_grundy x) ->
      exists y : q1687147_game S,
        q1687147_move S q1687147_right x y /\
        q1687147_grundy y = a;
  q1687147_grundy_least_excluded :
    forall (x : q1687147_game S) (a : q1687147_nimber),
      (~ exists y : q1687147_game S,
          q1687147_move S q1687147_right x y /\
          q1687147_grundy y = a) ->
      q1687147_grundy x = a \/
      q1687147_nimber_lt (q1687147_grundy x) a;

  q1687147_nim :
    q1687147_nimber -> q1687147_game S;
  q1687147_nim_moves :
    forall (p : q1687147_player)
           (a : q1687147_nimber)
           (y : q1687147_game S),
      q1687147_move S p (q1687147_nim a) y <->
      exists b : q1687147_nimber,
        q1687147_nimber_lt b a /\
        y = q1687147_nim b
}.

Arguments q1687147_nimber {_} _.
Arguments q1687147_grundy {_} _ _.
Arguments q1687147_nim {_} _ _.

Theorem q1687147_nim_grundy_equiv :
  forall (S : q1687147_game_system)
         (N : q1687147_nimber_model S)
         (x : q1687147_game S),
    q1687147_impartial S x ->
    q1687147_game_equiv S
      (q1687147_nim N (q1687147_grundy N x))
      x.
Admitted.

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1687147,
  "Sprague–Grundy theorem": every set-sized well-founded game that is
  recursively impartial with separate Left and Right options is
  Conway-equivalent to the Nim game indexed by its ordinal Grundy value. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
  imports "ZF.WF" "ZF.Sum" "ZF.Ordinal"
begin

definition q1687147_grundy_assignment :: "[i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_grundy_assignment(V, right_moves, grundy) \<equiv>
    function(grundy) \<and>
    domain(grundy) = V \<and>
    (\<forall>v\<in>V.
      Ord(grundy`v) \<and>
      (\<forall>y\<in>V.
        \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves \<longrightarrow> grundy`y \<noteq> grundy`v) \<and>
      (\<forall>\<beta>\<in>grundy`v.
        \<exists>y\<in>V. \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves \<and> grundy`y = \<beta>))"

definition q1687147_game_left_move :: "[i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_game_left_move(left_moves, right_moves, p, q) \<equiv>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inl(y) \<and> q = Inl(v) \<and> \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> left_moves) \<or>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inr(y) \<and> q = Inr(v) \<and> \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves)"

definition q1687147_game_right_move :: "[i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_game_right_move(left_moves, right_moves, p, q) \<equiv>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inl(y) \<and> q = Inl(v) \<and> \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves) \<or>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inr(y) \<and> q = Inr(v) \<and> \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> left_moves)"

definition q1687147_game_conway_order :: "[i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_game_conway_order(V, left_moves, right_moves, leq) \<equiv>
    leq \<subseteq> (V + V) * (V + V) \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>V + V. \<forall>q\<in>V + V.
      (\<langle>p,q\<rangle> \<in> leq) \<longleftrightarrow>
        ((\<forall>p'\<in>V + V.
            q1687147_game_left_move(left_moves, right_moves, p', p)
            \<longrightarrow> \<langle>q,p'\<rangle> \<notin> leq) \<and>
         (\<forall>q'\<in>V + V.
            q1687147_game_right_move(left_moves, right_moves, q', q)
            \<longrightarrow> \<langle>q',p\<rangle> \<notin> leq)))"

definition q1687147_impartial_assignment :: "[i, i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_impartial_assignment(V, left_moves, right_moves, leq, impartial) \<equiv>
    impartial \<subseteq> V \<and>
    (\<forall>v\<in>V.
      (v \<in> impartial) \<longleftrightarrow>
        (\<langle>Inr(v),Inl(v)\<rangle> \<in> leq \<and>
         \<langle>Inl(v),Inr(v)\<rangle> \<in> leq \<and>
         (\<forall>y\<in>V.
           (\<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> left_moves \<or>
            \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves)
           \<longrightarrow> y \<in> impartial)))"

definition q1687147_impartial :: "[i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_impartial(V, left_moves, right_moves, x) \<equiv>
    (\<exists>leq impartial.
      q1687147_game_conway_order(V, left_moves, right_moves, leq) \<and>
      q1687147_impartial_assignment(
        V, left_moves, right_moves, leq, impartial) \<and>
      x \<in> impartial)"

definition q1687147_tagged_left_move :: "[i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_tagged_left_move(left_moves, right_moves, p, q) \<equiv>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inl(Inl(y)) \<and> q = Inl(Inl(v)) \<and>
      \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> left_moves) \<or>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inl(Inr(y)) \<and> q = Inl(Inr(v)) \<and>
      \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves) \<or>
    (\<exists>\<beta> \<alpha>. p = Inr(\<beta>) \<and> q = Inr(\<alpha>) \<and> \<beta> \<in> \<alpha>)"

definition q1687147_tagged_right_move :: "[i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_tagged_right_move(left_moves, right_moves, p, q) \<equiv>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inl(Inl(y)) \<and> q = Inl(Inl(v)) \<and>
      \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> right_moves) \<or>
    (\<exists>y v.
      p = Inl(Inr(y)) \<and> q = Inl(Inr(v)) \<and>
      \<langle>y,v\<rangle> \<in> left_moves) \<or>
    (\<exists>\<beta> \<alpha>. p = Inr(\<beta>) \<and> q = Inr(\<alpha>) \<and> \<beta> \<in> \<alpha>)"

definition q1687147_conway_order :: "[i, i, i, i, i] \<Rightarrow> o" where
  "q1687147_conway_order(V, left_moves, right_moves, \<alpha>, leq) \<equiv>
    leq \<subseteq> ((V + V) + succ(\<alpha>)) * ((V + V) + succ(\<alpha>)) \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>(V + V) + succ(\<alpha>). \<forall>q\<in>(V + V) + succ(\<alpha>).
      (\<langle>p,q\<rangle> \<in> leq) \<longleftrightarrow>
        ((\<forall>p'\<in>(V + V) + succ(\<alpha>).
            q1687147_tagged_left_move(left_moves, right_moves, p', p)
            \<longrightarrow>
            \<langle>q,p'\<rangle> \<notin> leq) \<and>
         (\<forall>q'\<in>(V + V) + succ(\<alpha>).
            q1687147_tagged_right_move(left_moves, right_moves, q', q)
            \<longrightarrow>
            \<langle>q',p\<rangle> \<notin> leq)))"

theorem q1687147_sprague_grundy:
  assumes "x \<in> V"
    and "left_moves \<subseteq> V * V"
    and "right_moves \<subseteq> V * V"
    and "wf(left_moves \<union> right_moves)"
    and "q1687147_impartial(V, left_moves, right_moves, x)"
  shows
    "\<exists>grundy leq.
      q1687147_grundy_assignment(V, right_moves, grundy) \<and>
      q1687147_conway_order(
        V, left_moves, right_moves, grundy`x, leq) \<and>
      \<langle>Inr(grundy`x), Inl(Inl(x))\<rangle> \<in> leq \<and>
      \<langle>Inl(Inl(x)), Inr(grundy`x)\<rangle> \<in> leq"
  sorry

end

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1687147,
  "Sprague–Grundy theorem": every well-founded impartial combinatorial game is
  equivalent to the Nim game indexed by its minimum-excluded Grundy nimber.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1687147_SPRAGUE_GRUNDY_THEOREM =
  `let is_strict_well_order =
     \(lt:N->N->bool).
       WF lt /\
       (!a:N. ~(lt a a)) /\
       (!a b c:N. lt a b /\ lt b c ==> lt a c) /\
       (!a b:N. lt a b \/ a = b \/ lt b a) in
   let is_mex =
     \(lt:N->N->bool) (s:N->bool) (n:N).
       ~(n IN s) /\ (!m:N. lt m n ==> m IN s) in
   let is_impartial_game_model =
     \(move:A->A->bool) (lt:N->N->bool)
      (nim:N->A) (grundy:A->N) (game_le:A->A->bool).
       WF move /\
       is_strict_well_order lt /\
       (!a:N. !y:A.
          move y (nim a) <=> ?b:N. lt b a /\ y = nim b) /\
       (!x:A.
          is_mex lt
            {n:N | ?y:A. move y x /\ grundy y = n}
            (grundy x)) /\
       (!x y:A.
          game_le x y <=>
          (!u:A. move u x ==> ~(game_le y u)) /\
          (!v:A. move v y ==> ~(game_le v x))) in
   !move:A->A->bool.
   !lt:N->N->bool.
   !nim:N->A.
   !grundy:A->N.
   !game_le:A->A->bool.
     is_impartial_game_model move lt nim grundy game_le
     ==> !x:A.
           game_le (nim (grundy x)) x /\
           game_le x (nim (grundy x))`;;

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1687147,
;; "Sprague–Grundy theorem": every arbitrary well-founded impartial game is
;; equivalent to the game of Nim indexed by its recursively defined Grundy
;; value. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent arbitrary, potentially infinite carriers,
;; move relations, ordinal well-orders, and recursively characterized semantic
;; predicates. No carrier is enumerated or restricted to finite game trees.

(defun q1687147-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q1687147-relation-p (relation left right)
  (if (apply$ relation (list left right)) t nil))

(defun q1687147-map-value (map object)
  (apply$ map (list object)))

(defun q1687147-option-p (left-move right-move parent child)
  (or
   (q1687147-relation-p left-move parent child)
   (q1687147-relation-p right-move parent child)))

;; A game carrier is closed under both kinds of moves, and the union of its
;; move relations is well-founded. Well-foundedness is expressed by the
;; equivalent least-element property for every arbitrary tame subset.

(defun-sk q1687147-moves-closed-p
    (carrier left-move right-move)
  (forall (parent child)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1687147-member-p carrier parent)
      (q1687147-option-p
       left-move right-move parent child))
     (q1687147-member-p carrier child))))

(defun-sk q1687147-subset-of-p (carrier subset)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q1687147-member-p subset object)
     (q1687147-member-p carrier object))))

(defun-sk q1687147-subset-nonempty-p (carrier subset)
  (exists (object)
    (and
     (q1687147-member-p carrier object)
     (q1687147-member-p subset object))))

(defun-sk q1687147-no-subset-option-p
    (subset left-move right-move object)
  (forall (child)
    (implies
     (q1687147-option-p
      left-move right-move object child)
     (not (q1687147-member-p subset child)))))

(defun q1687147-subset-minimal-p
    (carrier subset left-move right-move object)
  (and
   (q1687147-member-p carrier object)
   (q1687147-member-p subset object)
   (q1687147-no-subset-option-p
    subset left-move right-move object)))

(defun-sk q1687147-subset-minimal-exists-p
    (carrier subset left-move right-move)
  (exists (object)
    (q1687147-subset-minimal-p
     carrier subset left-move right-move object)))

(defun-sk q1687147-game-well-founded-p
    (carrier left-move right-move)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp subset)
      (q1687147-subset-of-p carrier subset)
      (q1687147-subset-nonempty-p carrier subset))
     (q1687147-subset-minimal-exists-p
      carrier subset left-move right-move))))

(defun q1687147-game-p
    (carrier left-move right-move root)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left-move)
   (tamep-functionp right-move)
   (q1687147-member-p carrier root)
   (q1687147-moves-closed-p
    carrier left-move right-move)
   (q1687147-game-well-founded-p
    carrier left-move right-move)))

;; Nimber values are represented by an arbitrary strict well-order. Every
;; such well-order is isomorphic to an ordinal, so this preserves the source's
;; ordinal-indexed Nim games without imposing ACL2's executable ordinal bound.

(defun-sk q1687147-strict-order-laws-p (carrier less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1687147-member-p carrier x)
      (not (q1687147-relation-p less x x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1687147-member-p carrier x)
       (q1687147-member-p carrier y))
      (or
       (q1687147-relation-p less x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q1687147-relation-p less y x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1687147-member-p carrier x)
       (q1687147-member-p carrier y)
       (q1687147-member-p carrier z)
       (q1687147-relation-p less x y)
       (q1687147-relation-p less y z))
      (q1687147-relation-p less x z)))))

(defun-sk q1687147-no-smaller-subset-member-p
    (subset less object)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
     (q1687147-member-p subset other)
     (not (q1687147-relation-p less other object)))))

(defun q1687147-least-subset-member-p
    (carrier subset less object)
  (and
   (q1687147-member-p carrier object)
   (q1687147-member-p subset object)
   (q1687147-no-smaller-subset-member-p
    subset less object)))

(defun-sk q1687147-least-subset-member-exists-p
    (carrier subset less)
  (exists (object)
    (q1687147-least-subset-member-p
     carrier subset less object)))

(defun-sk q1687147-order-well-founded-p (carrier less)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp subset)
      (q1687147-subset-of-p carrier subset)
      (q1687147-subset-nonempty-p carrier subset))
     (q1687147-least-subset-member-exists-p
      carrier subset less))))

(defun q1687147-well-order-p (carrier less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (q1687147-strict-order-laws-p carrier less)
   (q1687147-order-well-founded-p carrier less)))

;; Positions combine the source game, its formal negative, and Nim positions.
;; Negation swaps left and right moves, while Nim(o) has every smaller ordinal
;; as both a left and a right option.

(defun q1687147-positive-position (node)
  (list :source :positive node))

(defun q1687147-negative-position (node)
  (list :source :negative node))

(defun q1687147-nim-position (ordinal)
  (list :nim ordinal))

(defun q1687147-positive-position-p (position)
  (and
   (true-listp position)
   (equal (len position) 3)
   (equal (car position) :source)
   (equal (cadr position) :positive)))

(defun q1687147-negative-position-p (position)
  (and
   (true-listp position)
   (equal (len position) 3)
   (equal (car position) :source)
   (equal (cadr position) :negative)))

(defun q1687147-nim-position-p (position)
  (and
   (true-listp position)
   (equal (len position) 2)
   (equal (car position) :nim)))

(defun q1687147-position-p
    (game-carrier ordinal-carrier position)
  (cond
   ((q1687147-positive-position-p position)
    (q1687147-member-p game-carrier (caddr position)))
   ((q1687147-negative-position-p position)
    (q1687147-member-p game-carrier (caddr position)))
   ((q1687147-nim-position-p position)
    (q1687147-member-p ordinal-carrier (cadr position)))
   (t nil)))

(defun q1687147-position-left-move-p
    (left-move right-move ordinal-less parent child)
  (cond
   ((q1687147-positive-position-p parent)
    (and
     (q1687147-positive-position-p child)
     (q1687147-relation-p
      left-move (caddr parent) (caddr child))))
   ((q1687147-negative-position-p parent)
    (and
     (q1687147-negative-position-p child)
     (q1687147-relation-p
      right-move (caddr parent) (caddr child))))
   ((q1687147-nim-position-p parent)
    (and
     (q1687147-nim-position-p child)
     (q1687147-relation-p
      ordinal-less (cadr child) (cadr parent))))
   (t nil)))

(defun q1687147-position-right-move-p
    (left-move right-move ordinal-less parent child)
  (cond
   ((q1687147-positive-position-p parent)
    (and
     (q1687147-positive-position-p child)
     (q1687147-relation-p
      right-move (caddr parent) (caddr child))))
   ((q1687147-negative-position-p parent)
    (and
     (q1687147-negative-position-p child)
     (q1687147-relation-p
      left-move (caddr parent) (caddr child))))
   ((q1687147-nim-position-p parent)
    (and
     (q1687147-nim-position-p child)
     (q1687147-relation-p
      ordinal-less (cadr child) (cadr parent))))
   (t nil)))

;; Conway's recursive order is characterized by its exact defining equation:
;; G <= H iff no left option of G is >= H and no right option of H is <= G.
;; On well-founded games this equation uniquely defines the source relation.

(defun q1687147-game-le-p (game-le left right)
  (q1687147-relation-p game-le left right))

(defun-sk q1687147-no-left-refutation-p
    (game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
     game-le left right)
  (forall (option)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1687147-position-p
       game-carrier ordinal-carrier option)
      (q1687147-position-left-move-p
       left-move right-move ordinal-less left option))
     (not (q1687147-game-le-p game-le right option)))))

(defun-sk q1687147-no-right-refutation-p
    (game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
     game-le left right)
  (forall (option)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1687147-position-p
       game-carrier ordinal-carrier option)
      (q1687147-position-right-move-p
       left-move right-move ordinal-less right option))
     (not (q1687147-game-le-p game-le option left)))))

(defun q1687147-game-le-equation-p
    (game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
     game-le left right)
  (iff
   (q1687147-game-le-p game-le left right)
   (and
    (q1687147-no-left-refutation-p
     game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
     game-le left right)
    (q1687147-no-right-refutation-p
     game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
     game-le left right))))

(defun-sk q1687147-game-le-semantics-p
    (game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
     game-le)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1687147-position-p
       game-carrier ordinal-carrier left)
      (q1687147-position-p
       game-carrier ordinal-carrier right))
     (q1687147-game-le-equation-p
      game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move ordinal-less
      game-le left right))))

(defun q1687147-game-equiv-p (game-le left right)
  (and
   (q1687147-game-le-p game-le left right)
   (q1687147-game-le-p game-le right left)))

;; The source's Impartial class says that a game is equivalent to its negative
;; and that each of its left and right options is recursively impartial.

(defun-sk q1687147-all-options-impartial-p
    (left-move right-move impartial node)
  (forall (child)
    (implies
     (q1687147-option-p left-move right-move node child)
     (q1687147-member-p impartial child))))

(defun q1687147-impartial-equation-p
    (left-move right-move game-le impartial node)
  (iff
   (q1687147-member-p impartial node)
   (and
    (q1687147-game-equiv-p
     game-le
     (q1687147-positive-position node)
     (q1687147-negative-position node))
    (q1687147-all-options-impartial-p
     left-move right-move impartial node))))

(defun-sk q1687147-impartial-semantics-p
    (game-carrier left-move right-move game-le impartial)
  (forall (node)
    (implies
     (q1687147-member-p game-carrier node)
     (q1687147-impartial-equation-p
      left-move right-move game-le impartial node))))

;; The right Grundy value is the minimum excluded ordinal: it is absent from
;; the right-option values, and every smaller ordinal occurs among them.

(defun-sk q1687147-grundy-value-absent-p
    (right-move grundy node value)
  (forall (child)
    (implies
     (q1687147-relation-p right-move node child)
     (not
      (equal
       (q1687147-map-value grundy child)
       value)))))

(defun-sk q1687147-lower-grundy-value-attained-p
    (right-move grundy node value)
  (exists (child)
    (and
     (q1687147-relation-p right-move node child)
     (equal
      (q1687147-map-value grundy child)
      value))))

(defun-sk q1687147-all-lower-grundy-values-attained-p
    (ordinal-carrier ordinal-less right-move grundy node value)
  (forall (lower)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1687147-member-p ordinal-carrier lower)
      (q1687147-relation-p ordinal-less lower value))
     (q1687147-lower-grundy-value-attained-p
      right-move grundy node lower))))

(defun q1687147-grundy-equation-p
    (ordinal-carrier ordinal-less right-move grundy node)
  (let ((value (q1687147-map-value grundy node)))
    (and
     (q1687147-member-p ordinal-carrier value)
     (q1687147-grundy-value-absent-p
      right-move grundy node value)
     (q1687147-all-lower-grundy-values-attained-p
      ordinal-carrier ordinal-less right-move
      grundy node value))))

(defun-sk q1687147-grundy-semantics-p
    (game-carrier ordinal-carrier ordinal-less right-move grundy)
  (forall (node)
    (implies
     (q1687147-member-p game-carrier node)
     (q1687147-grundy-equation-p
      ordinal-carrier ordinal-less right-move grundy node))))

;; All structures and recursive semantic objects remain universally
;; quantified inside the statement. The hypotheses are precisely their
;; defining equations and the source assumption that the root is impartial.

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1687147-sprague-grundy-theorem-statement ()
  (forall
    (game-carrier left-move right-move root
     ordinal-carrier ordinal-less game-le impartial grundy)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1687147-game-p
       game-carrier left-move right-move root)
      (q1687147-well-order-p
       ordinal-carrier ordinal-less)
      (tamep-functionp game-le)
      (tamep-functionp impartial)
      (tamep-functionp grundy)
      (q1687147-game-le-semantics-p
       game-carrier ordinal-carrier left-move right-move
       ordinal-less game-le)
      (q1687147-impartial-semantics-p
       game-carrier left-move right-move game-le impartial)
      (q1687147-grundy-semantics-p
       game-carrier ordinal-carrier ordinal-less right-move grundy)
      (q1687147-member-p impartial root))
     (q1687147-game-equiv-p
      game-le
      (q1687147-nim-position
       (q1687147-map-value grundy root))
      (q1687147-positive-position root)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1687147
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1687147), "Sprague–Grundy theorem": every
-- impartial combinatorial game is equivalent to the Nim game indexed by its
-- minimum-excluded Grundy value. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Set p where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
Not {p} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : left-proposition
    second : right-proposition

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  left-case  : left-proposition -> Either left-proposition right-proposition
  right-case : right-proposition -> Either left-proposition right-proposition

record LogicalEquivalence
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor logically-equivalent
  field
    forward  : left-proposition -> right-proposition
    backward : right-proposition -> left-proposition

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

-- A universe-polymorphic inductive Conway game. The two arbitrary small
-- indexing types enumerate its left and right options.
data IGame (g : Level) : Set (lsuc g) where
  game :
    {LeftMoves RightMoves : Set g} ->
    (LeftMoves -> IGame g) ->
    (RightMoves -> IGame g) ->
    IGame g

data Player : Set where
  left right : Player

MoveType :
  {g : Level} ->
  Player ->
  IGame g ->
  Set g
MoveType left (game {LeftMoves} {RightMoves} left-options right-options) =
  LeftMoves
MoveType right (game {LeftMoves} {RightMoves} left-options right-options) =
  RightMoves

move :
  {g : Level} ->
  (player : Player) ->
  (x : IGame g) ->
  MoveType player x ->
  IGame g
move left (game left-options right-options) index =
  left-options index
move right (game left-options right-options) index =
  right-options index

negate :
  {g : Level} ->
  IGame g ->
  IGame g
negate (game left-options right-options) =
  game
    (\ right-index -> negate (right-options right-index))
    (\ left-index -> negate (left-options left-index))

Equivalent :
  {g r : Level} ->
  (IGame g -> IGame g -> Set r) ->
  IGame g ->
  IGame g ->
  Set r
Equivalent less-or-equal x y =
  Both
    (less-or-equal x y)
    (less-or-equal y x)

-- This bidirectional law is Conway's recursive definition of game order:
-- x <= y exactly when no left option of x is >= y and no right option of y
-- is <= x.
record ConwayOrder
  {g r : Level}
  (less-or-equal : IGame g -> IGame g -> Set r) :
  Set (lsuc g ⊔ r) where

  field
    characterization :
      (x y : IGame g) ->
      LogicalEquivalence
        (less-or-equal x y)
        (Both
          ((left-index : MoveType left x) ->
            Not (less-or-equal y (move left x left-index)))
          ((right-index : MoveType right y) ->
            Not (less-or-equal (move right y right-index) x)))

-- Impartiality is hereditary and identifies a game with its conjugate, as in
-- the source IGame.Impartial structure.
Impartial :
  {g r : Level} ->
  (IGame g -> IGame g -> Set r) ->
  IGame g ->
  Set (lsuc g ⊔ r)
Impartial less-or-equal
  x@(game {LeftMoves} {RightMoves} left-options right-options) =
  Both
    (Equivalent less-or-equal x (negate x))
    (Both
      ((left-index : LeftMoves) ->
        Impartial less-or-equal (left-options left-index))
      ((right-index : RightMoves) ->
        Impartial less-or-equal (right-options right-index)))

data Accessible
  {a r : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (strictly-less : A -> A -> Set r)
  (x : A) :
  Set (a ⊔ r) where

  accessible :
    ((y : A) ->
      strictly-less y x ->
      Accessible strictly-less y) ->
    Accessible strictly-less x

WellFounded :
  {a r : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A -> Set r) ->
  Set (a ⊔ r)
WellFounded {A = A} strictly-less =
  (x : A) ->
  Accessible strictly-less x

-- Nimbers form a strict linear well-order. This record presents the fixed
-- source Nimber type up to an order-preserving change of representation.
record StrictWellOrder
  {n s : Level}
  (Nimber : Set n)
  (strictly-less : Nimber -> Nimber -> Set s) :
  Set (lsuc n ⊔ s) where

  field
    irreflexive :
      (x : Nimber) ->
      Not (strictly-less x x)
    transitive :
      (x y z : Nimber) ->
      strictly-less x y ->
      strictly-less y z ->
      strictly-less x z
    trichotomy :
      (x y : Nimber) ->
      Either
        (strictly-less x y)
        (Either (x == y) (strictly-less y x))
    well-founded :
      WellFounded strictly-less

record Below
  {n s : Level}
  {Nimber : Set n}
  (strictly-less : Nimber -> Nimber -> Set s)
  (upper : Nimber) :
  Set (n ⊔ s) where

  constructor below
  field
    value   : Nimber
    smaller : strictly-less value upper

-- A Nim game indexed by o has, for either player, exactly one option
-- corresponding to every nimber strictly below o, and that option is the
-- recursively indexed Nim game.
record NimLaw
  {g n s : Level}
  {Nimber : Set n}
  (strictly-less : Nimber -> Nimber -> Set s)
  (nim : Nimber -> IGame g) :
  Set (lsuc g ⊔ n ⊔ s) where

  field
    move-bijection :
      (player : Player) ->
      (o : Nimber) ->
      Bijection
        (MoveType player (nim o))
        (Below strictly-less o)
    move-is-nim :
      (player : Player) ->
      (o : Nimber) ->
      (index : MoveType player (nim o)) ->
      move player (nim o) index
        ==
      nim
        (Below.value
          (Bijection.to (move-bijection player o) index))

-- These two clauses are the minimum-excluded definition of the right Grundy
-- value: the value itself is absent from the option values, while every
-- strictly smaller nimber occurs.
record GrundyLaw
  {g n s : Level}
  {Nimber : Set n}
  (strictly-less : Nimber -> Nimber -> Set s)
  (grundy : IGame g -> Nimber) :
  Set (lsuc g ⊔ n ⊔ s) where

  field
    excluded :
      (x : IGame g) ->
      (index : MoveType right x) ->
      Not
        (grundy (move right x index)
          ==
         grundy x)
    covers-smaller :
      (x : IGame g) ->
      (o : Nimber) ->
      strictly-less o (grundy x) ->
      Exists
        (MoveType right x)
        (\ index ->
          grundy (move right x index) == o)

sprague-grundy-theorem :
  {g n r s : Level} ->
  (Nimber : Set n) ->
  (less-or-equal : IGame g -> IGame g -> Set r) ->
  ConwayOrder less-or-equal ->
  (strictly-less : Nimber -> Nimber -> Set s) ->
  StrictWellOrder Nimber strictly-less ->
  (nim : Nimber -> IGame g) ->
  NimLaw strictly-less nim ->
  (grundy : IGame g -> Nimber) ->
  GrundyLaw strictly-less grundy ->
  Set (lsuc g ⊔ r)
sprague-grundy-theorem
  Nimber
  less-or-equal
  conway-order
  strictly-less
  nimber-order
  nim
  nim-law
  grundy
  grundy-law =
  (x : IGame _) ->
  Impartial less-or-equal x ->
  Equivalent less-or-equal (nim (grundy x)) x

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1687147, "Sprague–Grundy theorem": every well-founded impartial game is
  equivalent to the Nim game indexed by its recursively defined Grundy
  ordinal. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory relationTheory sumTheory;
open ordinalBasicTheory;

val q1687147_mex_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_mex_def",
  ``q1687147_mex (s : 'a ordinal set) = oleast a. a NOTIN s``
);

val q1687147_grundy_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_grundy_def",
  ``q1687147_grundy (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool) =
      (WFREC move
        (\rec g. q1687147_mex (IMAGE rec {h | move h g}))
        : 'a -> 'a ordinal)``
);

val q1687147_sum_move_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_sum_move_def",
  ``q1687147_sum_move
      (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (child : 'a + 'a ordinal)
      (parent : 'a + 'a ordinal) <=>
      (?g h.
        child = INL g /\ parent = INL h /\ move g h) \/
      (?b a.
        child = INR b /\ parent = INR a /\ b < a)``
);

val q1687147_pair_step_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_pair_step_def",
  ``q1687147_pair_step
      (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (child : 'a # 'a)
      (parent : 'a # 'a) <=>
      (move (FST child) (FST parent) /\
       SND child = SND parent) \/
      (FST child = FST parent /\
       move (SND child) (SND parent))``
);

val q1687147_order_state_step_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_order_state_step_def",
  ``q1687147_order_state_step
      (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (child : ('a # 'a) # bool)
      (parent : ('a # 'a) # bool) <=>
      q1687147_pair_step move (FST child) (FST parent)``
);

val q1687147_game_order_aux_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_game_order_aux_def",
  ``q1687147_game_order_aux (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool) =
      WFREC (q1687147_order_state_step move)
        (\rec state.
          let g = FST (FST state) in
          let h = SND (FST state) in
            if SND state then
              (!g'. move g' g ==> ~rec ((g', h), F)) /\
              (!h'. move h' h ==> ~rec ((g, h'), F))
            else
              (!h'. move h' h ==> ~rec ((g, h'), T)) /\
              (!g'. move g' g ==> ~rec ((g', h), T)))``
);

val q1687147_game_le_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_game_le_def",
  ``q1687147_game_le (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool) g h <=>
      q1687147_game_order_aux move ((g, h), T)``
);

val q1687147_game_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q1687147_game_equiv_def",
  ``q1687147_game_equiv (move : 'a -> 'a -> bool) g h <=>
      q1687147_game_le move g h /\
      q1687147_game_le move h g``
);

val IGame_Impartial_nim_grundy_equiv =
  ``!(move : 'a -> 'a -> bool) x.
      WF move
      ==>
      q1687147_game_equiv
        (q1687147_sum_move move)
        (INR (q1687147_grundy move x))
        (INL x)``;

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1687147
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1687147), "Sprague-Grundy theorem": every
  well-founded impartial combinatorial game is equivalent to the Nim game
  whose heap ordinal is its Grundy value. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  An IGame is represented by its set V of weak subpositions, its root r, and
  child-to-parent left and right move relations L and R. Q1687147Game requires
  every node to reach r, an ordinal rank decreasing along every move, and
  extensionality of the two option sets. These are exactly the set-sized
  well-founded extensional graphs generated by Lean's IGame constructor; no
  finiteness or countability restriction is imposed.

  Q1687147Positions adjoins a positive and a negative copy of every game
  position and a tagged position for every ordinal in a bounding ordinal H.
  The negative-copy move rules swap left and right moves, exactly encoding
  game negation. The ordinal positions have every smaller ordinal as both a
  left and a right move, exactly encoding nim. Q1687147Order is the defining
  well-founded recursion for the combinatorial-game relation a <= b: no left
  option of a is >= b and no right option of b is <= a.

  Q1687147Impartial says, at every subposition, that the negative copy and
  positive copy are game-equivalent. Since V is precisely the descendant
  closure of r, this is bidirectionally equivalent to Lean's inductive
  Impartial condition, including impartiality of every option. In particular,
  it does not replace the source notion by equality of left and right moves.

  Q1687147Grundy states the exact ordinal mex recursion on right options:
  G(v) is absent among their values and every smaller ordinal occurs. The
  final unproved assertion says that nim(G(r)) and r are mutually <=, which is
  precisely IGame.Impartial.nim_grundy_equiv.
$)

$c Q1687147Game Q1687147Positions Q1687147LeftMoves
   Q1687147RightMoves Q1687147Order Q1687147Grundy
   Q1687147Impartial Q1687147Equivalent $.

q1687147-game-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1687147Game V L R r ) $.
q1687147-positions-syntax $a
  class ( Q1687147Positions V H ) $.
q1687147-left-moves-syntax $a

q1687147-right-moves-syntax $a
  class ( Q1687147RightMoves V L R H ) $.
q1687147-order-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1687147Order V L R H E ) $.
q1687147-grundy-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1687147Grundy V R G ) $.
q1687147-impartial-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1687147Impartial V E ) $.
q1687147-equivalent-syntax $a
  wff ( Q1687147Equivalent E a b ) $.

${

  q1687147-game-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1687147Game V L R r )
    <->
    (
      r e. V

        ( L u. R ) C_ ( V X. V )
        /\

title: Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1687147,
% "Sprague–Grundy theorem": every impartial combinatorial game is equivalent
% to the Nim game indexed by its recursively defined Grundy nimber. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem[
  Game: TYPE+,
  Nimber: TYPE+,
  left_move: [Game, Game -> bool],
  right_move: [Game, Game -> bool],
  game_neg: [Game -> Game],
  nimber_lt: [Nimber, Nimber -> bool],
  nim: [Nimber -> Game],
  grundy: [Game -> Nimber],
  game_le: [Game, Game -> bool],
  impartial_game: [Game -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  game_set: TYPE = [Game -> bool]
  nimber_set: TYPE = [Nimber -> bool]

  is_move(parent, child: Game): bool =
    left_move(parent, child) OR right_move(parent, child)

  well_founded_game_trees: bool =
    FORALL (positions: game_set):
      (EXISTS (position: Game): positions(position))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (minimal_position: Game):
            positions(minimal_position)
              AND
            (FORALL (option: Game):
              is_move(minimal_position, option)
                IMPLIES NOT positions(option))

  strict_well_ordered_nimbers: bool =
    (FORALL (a: Nimber): NOT nimber_lt(a, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: Nimber):
      nimber_lt(a, b) AND nimber_lt(b, c)
        IMPLIES nimber_lt(a, c))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: Nimber):
      nimber_lt(a, b) OR a = b OR nimber_lt(b, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (values: nimber_set):
      (EXISTS (a: Nimber): values(a))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (least_value: Nimber):
            values(least_value)
              AND
            (FORALL (a: Nimber):
              values(a)
                IMPLIES NOT nimber_lt(a, least_value)))

  conway_order_equation: bool =
    FORALL (left_game, right_game: Game):
      game_le(left_game, right_game)
        IFF
          (FORALL (left_option: Game):
            left_move(left_game, left_option)
              IMPLIES NOT game_le(right_game, left_option))
          AND
          (FORALL (right_option: Game):
            right_move(right_game, right_option)
              IMPLIES NOT game_le(right_option, left_game))

  game_equivalent(left_game, right_game: Game): bool =
    game_le(left_game, right_game)
      AND game_le(right_game, left_game)

  game_negation_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (position: Game):
      game_neg(game_neg(position)) = position)
      AND
    (FORALL (position, option: Game):
      left_move(game_neg(position), option)
        IFF
          EXISTS (original_option: Game):
            right_move(position, original_option)
              AND option = game_neg(original_option))
      AND
    (FORALL (position, option: Game):
      right_move(game_neg(position), option)
        IFF
          EXISTS (original_option: Game):
            left_move(position, original_option)
              AND option = game_neg(original_option))

  recursive_impartiality_equation: bool =
    FORALL (position: Game):
      impartial_game(position)
        IFF
          game_equivalent(position, game_neg(position))
            AND
          (FORALL (left_option: Game):
            left_move(position, left_option)
              IMPLIES impartial_game(left_option))
            AND
          (FORALL (right_option: Game):
            right_move(position, right_option)
              IMPLIES impartial_game(right_option))

  nim_embedding_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: Nimber):
      nim(a) = nim(b) IMPLIES a = b)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: Nimber):
      game_neg(nim(a)) = nim(a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: Nimber), (option: Game):
      left_move(nim(a), option)
        IFF
          EXISTS (b: Nimber):
            nimber_lt(b, a) AND option = nim(b))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: Nimber), (option: Game):
      right_move(nim(a), option)
        IFF
          EXISTS (b: Nimber):
            nimber_lt(b, a) AND option = nim(b))

  option_grundy_values(position: Game): nimber_set =
    LAMBDA (value: Nimber):
      EXISTS (option: Game):
        right_move(position, option)
          AND value = grundy(option)

  is_minimum_excluded(values: nimber_set, value: Nimber): bool =
    NOT values(value)
      AND
    (FORALL (smaller: Nimber):
      nimber_lt(smaller, value) IMPLIES values(smaller))

  grundy_equation: bool =
    FORALL (position: Game):
      impartial_game(position)
        IMPLIES
          is_minimum_excluded(
            option_grundy_values(position),
            grundy(position))

  sprague_grundy_theorem: bool =
    (well_founded_game_trees
      AND strict_well_ordered_nimbers
      AND conway_order_equation
      AND game_negation_laws
      AND recursive_impartiality_equation
      AND nim_embedding_laws
      AND grundy_equation)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (position: Game):
        impartial_game(position)
          IMPLIES
            game_equivalent(
              nim(grundy(position)),
              position)
END Q1687147_sprague_grundy_theorem

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q17005116
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q17005116), "Birkhoff's representation theorem":
-- the canonical map from a finite distributive lattice to the powerset of its
-- sup-irreducible elements is an injective lattice homomorphism. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Order
public import Mathlib.Order.Interval.Finset.Basic
public import Mathlib.Order.Irreducible
public import Mathlib.Order.UpperLower.Closure

@[expose] public section

universe u

namespace Q17005116

variable {α : Type u} [DistribLattice α] [Fintype α] [@DecidablePred α SupIrred]

/-- The canonical Birkhoff map sends an element to the sup-irreducibles below it. -/
theorem birkhoffSet_statement :
    ∃ f : LatticeHom α (Set {a : α // SupIrred a}),
      Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ x a, a ∈ f x ↔ (a : α) ≤ x := sorry

end Q17005116

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q17005116
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q17005116), "Birkhoff's representation theorem":
  the canonical map from a finite distributive lattice to sets of its
  sup-irreducible elements preserves joins and meets. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q17005116_distributive_lattice (A : Type) : Type := {
  q17005116_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q17005116_join : A -> A -> A;
  q17005116_meet : A -> A -> A;
  q17005116_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q17005116_le x x;
  q17005116_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q17005116_le x y ->
      q17005116_le y z ->
      q17005116_le x z;
  q17005116_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q17005116_le x y ->
      q17005116_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q17005116_le_join_left :
    forall x y : A,
      q17005116_le x (q17005116_join x y);
  q17005116_le_join_right :
    forall x y : A,
      q17005116_le y (q17005116_join x y);
  q17005116_join_least :
    forall x y z : A,
      q17005116_le x z ->
      q17005116_le y z ->
      q17005116_le (q17005116_join x y) z;
  q17005116_meet_le_left :
    forall x y : A,
      q17005116_le (q17005116_meet x y) x;
  q17005116_meet_le_right :
    forall x y : A,
      q17005116_le (q17005116_meet x y) y;
  q17005116_meet_greatest :
    forall x y z : A,
      q17005116_le z x ->
      q17005116_le z y ->
      q17005116_le z (q17005116_meet x y);
  q17005116_meet_join_distrib_left :
    forall x y z : A,
      q17005116_meet x (q17005116_join y z) =
      q17005116_join
        (q17005116_meet x y) (q17005116_meet x z)
}.

Arguments q17005116_le {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q17005116_join {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q17005116_meet {A} _ _ _.

Record q17005116_finite_type (A : Type) : Type := {
  q17005116_enum : list A;
  q17005116_enum_nodup : NoDup q17005116_enum;
  q17005116_enum_complete :
    forall x : A, In x q17005116_enum
}.

Definition q17005116_is_bottom
    {A : Type}
    (L : q17005116_distributive_lattice A)
    (x : A) : Prop :=
  forall y : A, q17005116_le L x y.

Definition q17005116_sup_irreducible
    {A : Type}
    (L : q17005116_distributive_lattice A)
    (x : A) : Prop :=
  ~ q17005116_is_bottom L x /\
  forall y z : A,
    q17005116_join L y z = x ->
    y = x \/ z = x.

Definition q17005116_sup_irreducible_element
    {A : Type}
    (L : q17005116_distributive_lattice A) : Type :=
  {x : A | q17005116_sup_irreducible L x}.

Definition q17005116_set (X : Type) : Type :=
  X -> Prop.

Definition q17005116_set_equal
    {X : Type}
    (S T : q17005116_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X, S x <-> T x.

Definition q17005116_union
    {X : Type}
    (S T : q17005116_set X) : q17005116_set X :=
  fun x => S x \/ T x.

Definition q17005116_intersection
    {X : Type}
    (S T : q17005116_set X) : q17005116_set X :=
  fun x => S x /\ T x.

Definition q17005116_birkhoff_set
    {A : Type}
    (L : q17005116_distributive_lattice A)
    (a : A) :
    q17005116_set (q17005116_sup_irreducible_element L) :=
  fun p => q17005116_le L (proj1_sig p) a.

Definition q17005116_is_lattice_homomorphism
    {A X : Type}
    (L : q17005116_distributive_lattice A)
    (f : A -> q17005116_set X) : Prop :=
  (forall a b : A,
    q17005116_set_equal
      (f (q17005116_join L a b))
      (q17005116_union (f a) (f b))) /\
  forall a b : A,
    q17005116_set_equal
      (f (q17005116_meet L a b))
      (q17005116_intersection (f a) (f b)).

Theorem LatticeHom_birkhoffSet :
  forall (A : Type)
         (L : q17005116_distributive_lattice A)
         (_ : q17005116_finite_type A)
         (_ :
           forall x : A,
             {q17005116_sup_irreducible L x} +
             {~ q17005116_sup_irreducible L x}),
    @q17005116_is_lattice_homomorphism
      A (q17005116_sup_irreducible_element L) L
      (@q17005116_birkhoff_set A L) /\
    forall a b : A,
      q17005116_set_equal
        (@q17005116_birkhoff_set A L a)
        (@q17005116_birkhoff_set A L b) ->
      a = b.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q17005116
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q17005116), "Birkhoff's representation
  theorem": the canonical map from a finite distributive lattice to the
  powerset of its sup-irreducible elements is an injective lattice
  homomorphism. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q17005116_finite_distrib_lattice_on ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17005116_finite_distrib_lattice_on C meet join \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite C \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. \<forall>y \<in> C. meet x y \<in> C \<and> join x y \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. meet x x = x \<and> join x x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. \<forall>y \<in> C.
      meet x y = meet y x \<and> join x y = join y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. \<forall>y \<in> C. \<forall>z \<in> C.
      meet (meet x y) z = meet x (meet y z) \<and>
      join (join x y) z = join x (join y z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. \<forall>y \<in> C.
      meet x (join x y) = x \<and> join x (meet x y) = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. \<forall>y \<in> C. \<forall>z \<in> C.
      meet x (join y z) = join (meet x y) (meet x z) \<and>
      join x (meet y z) = meet (join x y) (join x z))"

definition q17005116_sup_irreducible_on ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17005116_sup_irreducible_on C meet join x \<longleftrightarrow>
    x \<in> C \<and>
    \<not> (\<forall>y \<in> C. meet x y = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>y \<in> C. \<forall>z \<in> C. join y z = x \<longrightarrow> y = x \<or> z = x)"

definition q17005116_birkhoff_set ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join x =
    {j \<in> C. q17005116_sup_irreducible_on C meet join j \<and> meet j x = j}"

theorem birkhoff_set_representation:
  fixes C :: "'a set"
    and meet join :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes "q17005116_finite_distrib_lattice_on C meet join"
  shows
    "inj_on (q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join) C \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C.
      q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join x
        \<subseteq> {j. q17005116_sup_irreducible_on C meet join j}) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> C. \<forall>y \<in> C.
      q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join (join x y) =
        q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join x \<union>
        q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join y \<and>
      q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join (meet x y) =
        q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join x \<inter>
        q17005116_birkhoff_set C meet join y)"
  sorry

end

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q17005116,
  "Birkhoff's representation theorem": every finite distributive lattice
  embeds by a lattice homomorphism into the powerset of its sup-irreducible
  elements. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q17005116_is_finite_distributive_lattice = new_definition
  `q17005116_is_finite_distributive_lattice
      (carrier:A->bool) (le_rel:A->A->bool)
      (inf_op:A->A->A) (sup_op:A->A->A) <=>
     FINITE carrier /\
     (!x. x IN carrier ==> le_rel x x) /\
     (!x y z.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier /\
        le_rel x y /\ le_rel y z
        ==> le_rel x z) /\
     (!x y.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ le_rel x y /\ le_rel y x
        ==> x = y) /\
     (!x y.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
        ==> inf_op x y IN carrier /\ sup_op x y IN carrier) /\
     (!x y z.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
        ==> (le_rel z (inf_op x y) <=> le_rel z x /\ le_rel z y)) /\
     (!x y z.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
        ==> (le_rel (sup_op x y) z <=> le_rel x z /\ le_rel y z)) /\
     (!x y z.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
        ==> inf_op x (sup_op y z) =
            sup_op (inf_op x y) (inf_op x z)) /\
     (!x y z.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
        ==> sup_op x (inf_op y z) =
            inf_op (sup_op x y) (sup_op x z))`;;

let q17005116_sup_irreducible = new_definition
  `q17005116_sup_irreducible carrier le_rel sup_op a <=>
     a IN carrier /\
     ~(!x. x IN carrier ==> le_rel a x) /\
     (!b c.
        b IN carrier /\ c IN carrier /\ sup_op b c = a
        ==> b = a \/ c = a)`;;

let Q17005116_BIRKHOFF_REPRESENTATION =
  `!(carrier:A->bool) (le_rel:A->A->bool)
    (inf_op:A->A->A) (sup_op:A->A->A).
      q17005116_is_finite_distributive_lattice
        carrier le_rel inf_op sup_op
      ==> ?birkhoff:A->A->bool.
            (!x a.
               x IN carrier
               ==> (birkhoff x a <=>
                    q17005116_sup_irreducible
                      carrier le_rel sup_op a /\
                    le_rel a x)) /\
            (!x y a.
               x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
               ==> (birkhoff (sup_op x y) a <=>
                    birkhoff x a \/ birkhoff y a)) /\
            (!x y a.
               x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
               ==> (birkhoff (inf_op x y) a <=>
                    birkhoff x a /\ birkhoff y a)) /\
            (!x y.
               x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\
               (!a. birkhoff x a <=> birkhoff y a)
               ==> x = y)`;;

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q17005116,
;; "Birkhoff's representation theorem": the canonical map from a finite
;; distributive lattice to the powerset of its sup-irreducible elements is an
;; injective lattice homomorphism. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A duplicate-free carrier list presents the source Fintype. Total operation
;; tables present meet and join extensionally on that carrier. The equational
;; lattice axioms induce exactly the source order, with x <= y iff x meet y = x.

(defun q17005116-table-value (x y table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal (list x y) table)))

(defun q17005116-op-row-total-p (x ys carrier table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (let ((entry (assoc-equal (list x (car ys)) table)))
      (and
       (consp entry)
       (member-equal (cdr entry) carrier)
       (q17005116-op-row-total-p
        x (cdr ys) carrier table)))))

(defun q17005116-op-total-p (xs carrier table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-op-row-total-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier table)
     (q17005116-op-total-p
      (cdr xs) carrier table))))

(defun q17005116-commutative-row-p (x ys table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (equal
      (q17005116-table-value x (car ys) table)
      (q17005116-table-value (car ys) x table))
     (q17005116-commutative-row-p
      x (cdr ys) table))))

(defun q17005116-commutative-p (xs carrier table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-commutative-row-p
      (car xs) carrier table)
     (q17005116-commutative-p
      (cdr xs) carrier table))))

(defun q17005116-associative-third-p (x y zs table)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (let ((z (car zs)))
      (and
       (equal
        (q17005116-table-value
         (q17005116-table-value x y table)
         z
         table)
        (q17005116-table-value
         x
         (q17005116-table-value y z table)
         table))
       (q17005116-associative-third-p
        x y (cdr zs) table)))))

(defun q17005116-associative-second-p
    (x ys carrier table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-associative-third-p
      x (car ys) carrier table)
     (q17005116-associative-second-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier table))))

(defun q17005116-associative-p (xs carrier table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-associative-second-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier table)
     (q17005116-associative-p
      (cdr xs) carrier table))))

(defun q17005116-absorption-row-p
    (x ys meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (let* ((y (car ys))
           (meet-xy
            (q17005116-table-value x y meet-table))
           (join-xy
            (q17005116-table-value x y join-table)))
      (and
       (equal
        (q17005116-table-value x join-xy meet-table)
        x)
       (equal
        (q17005116-table-value x meet-xy join-table)
        x)
       (q17005116-absorption-row-p
        x (cdr ys) meet-table join-table)))))

(defun q17005116-absorption-p
    (xs carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-absorption-row-p
      (car xs) carrier meet-table join-table)
     (q17005116-absorption-p
      (cdr xs) carrier meet-table join-table))))

(defun q17005116-distributive-third-p
    (x y zs meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (let ((z (car zs)))
      (and
       (equal
        (q17005116-table-value
         x
         (q17005116-table-value y z join-table)
         meet-table)
        (q17005116-table-value
         (q17005116-table-value x y meet-table)
         (q17005116-table-value x z meet-table)
         join-table))
       (q17005116-distributive-third-p
        x y (cdr zs) meet-table join-table)))))

(defun q17005116-distributive-second-p
    (x ys carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-distributive-third-p
      x (car ys) carrier meet-table join-table)
     (q17005116-distributive-second-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier meet-table join-table))))

(defun q17005116-distributive-p
    (xs carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-distributive-second-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
     (q17005116-distributive-p
      (cdr xs) carrier meet-table join-table))))

(defun q17005116-finite-distributive-lattice-p
    (carrier meet-table join-table)
  (and
   (true-listp carrier)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal carrier)
   (alistp meet-table)
   (alistp join-table)
   (q17005116-op-total-p carrier carrier meet-table)
   (q17005116-op-total-p carrier carrier join-table)
   (q17005116-commutative-p
    carrier carrier meet-table)
   (q17005116-commutative-p
    carrier carrier join-table)
   (q17005116-associative-p
    carrier carrier meet-table)
   (q17005116-associative-p
    carrier carrier join-table)
   (q17005116-absorption-p
    carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
   (q17005116-distributive-p
    carrier carrier meet-table join-table)))

(defun q17005116-le-p (x y meet-table)
  (equal
   (q17005116-table-value x y meet-table)
   x))

;; This is Mathlib's SupIrred definition: the element is not minimal, and a
;; join equal to it has one operand equal to it.

(defun q17005116-minimal-p (x ys meet-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (implies
      (q17005116-le-p (car ys) x meet-table)
      (equal (car ys) x))
     (q17005116-minimal-p
      x (cdr ys) meet-table))))

(defun q17005116-sup-irred-third-p
    (x y zs join-table)
  (if (endp zs)
      t
    (let ((z (car zs)))
      (and
       (implies
        (equal
         (q17005116-table-value y z join-table)
         x)
        (or (equal y x)
            (equal z x)))
       (q17005116-sup-irred-third-p
        x y (cdr zs) join-table)))))

(defun q17005116-sup-irred-second-p
    (x ys carrier join-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-sup-irred-third-p
      x (car ys) carrier join-table)
     (q17005116-sup-irred-second-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier join-table))))

(defun q17005116-sup-irred-p
    (x carrier meet-table join-table)
  (and
   (not
    (q17005116-minimal-p
     x carrier meet-table))
   (q17005116-sup-irred-second-p
    x carrier carrier join-table)))

;; The canonical Birkhoff set of x is the set of sup-irreducible j with j <= x.
;; Filtering the fixed carrier gives a canonical list for extensional set
;; equality and represents the full powerset of the finite subtype.

(defun q17005116-birkhoff-set
    (x remaining carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((j (car remaining)))
      (if
       (and
        (q17005116-sup-irred-p
         j carrier meet-table join-table)
        (q17005116-le-p j x meet-table))
       (cons
        j
        (q17005116-birkhoff-set
         x (cdr remaining) carrier meet-table join-table))
       (q17005116-birkhoff-set
        x (cdr remaining) carrier meet-table join-table)))))

(defun q17005116-set-union-over
    (remaining left right)
  (if (endp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((x (car remaining)))
      (if (or (member-equal x left)
              (member-equal x right))
          (cons
           x
           (q17005116-set-union-over
            (cdr remaining) left right))
        (q17005116-set-union-over
         (cdr remaining) left right)))))

(defun q17005116-set-intersection-over
    (remaining left right)
  (if (endp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((x (car remaining)))
      (if (and (member-equal x left)
               (member-equal x right))
          (cons
           x
           (q17005116-set-intersection-over
            (cdr remaining) left right))
        (q17005116-set-intersection-over
         (cdr remaining) left right)))))

(defun q17005116-lattice-hom-row-p
    (x ys carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (let* ((y (car ys))
           (set-x
            (q17005116-birkhoff-set
             x carrier carrier meet-table join-table))
           (set-y
            (q17005116-birkhoff-set
             y carrier carrier meet-table join-table))
           (meet-xy
            (q17005116-table-value x y meet-table))
           (join-xy
            (q17005116-table-value x y join-table)))
      (and
       (equal
        (q17005116-birkhoff-set
         meet-xy carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
        (q17005116-set-intersection-over
         carrier set-x set-y))
       (equal
        (q17005116-birkhoff-set
         join-xy carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
        (q17005116-set-union-over
         carrier set-x set-y))
       (q17005116-lattice-hom-row-p
        x (cdr ys) carrier meet-table join-table)))))

(defun q17005116-lattice-hom-p
    (xs carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-lattice-hom-row-p
      (car xs) carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
     (q17005116-lattice-hom-p
      (cdr xs) carrier meet-table join-table))))

(defun q17005116-injective-against-p
    (x ys carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp ys)
      t
    (and
     (implies
      (equal
       (q17005116-birkhoff-set
        x carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
       (q17005116-birkhoff-set
        (car ys) carrier carrier meet-table join-table))
      (equal x (car ys)))
     (q17005116-injective-against-p
      x (cdr ys) carrier meet-table join-table))))

(defun q17005116-injective-p
    (xs carrier meet-table join-table)
  (if (endp xs)
      t
    (and
     (q17005116-injective-against-p
      (car xs) (cdr xs) carrier meet-table join-table)
     (q17005116-injective-p
      (cdr xs) carrier meet-table join-table))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q17005116-birkhoff-s-representation-theorem-statement
    (carrier meet-table join-table)
  (implies
   (q17005116-finite-distributive-lattice-p
    carrier meet-table join-table)
   (and
    (q17005116-lattice-hom-p
     carrier carrier meet-table join-table)
    (q17005116-injective-p
     carrier carrier meet-table join-table))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q17005116
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q17005116), "Birkhoff's representation theorem":
-- the canonical map from a finite
-- distributive lattice to the powerset of its sup-irreducible elements is an
-- injective lattice homomorphism. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Decision
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  yes : A -> Decision A
  no  : Not A -> Decision A

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size : Nat
    encode : A -> Fin size
    decode : Fin size -> A
    encode-decode :
      (index : Fin size) ->
      encode (decode index) == index
    decode-encode :
      (x : A) ->
      decode (encode x) == x

record DistributiveLattice
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    join : A -> A -> A
    meet : A -> A -> A

    join-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      join (join x y) z == join x (join y z)
    join-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      join x y == join y x
    join-idempotent :
      (x : A) ->
      join x x == x

    meet-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      meet (meet x y) z == meet x (meet y z)
    meet-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      meet x y == meet y x
    meet-idempotent :
      (x : A) ->
      meet x x == x

    join-absorption :
      (x y : A) ->
      join x (meet x y) == x
    meet-absorption :
      (x y : A) ->
      meet x (join x y) == x

    join-distributes-over-meet :
      (x y z : A) ->
      join x (meet y z) ==
      meet (join x y) (join x z)
    meet-distributes-over-join :
      (x y z : A) ->
      meet x (join y z) ==
      join (meet x y) (meet x z)

open DistributiveLattice

LessOrEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  DistributiveLattice A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
LessOrEqual lattice x y =
  join lattice x y == y

record SupIrreducible
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (lattice : DistributiveLattice A)
  (x : A) :
  Set a where

  field
    not-least :
      Not ((y : A) -> LessOrEqual lattice x y)
    irreducible :
      (y z : A) ->
      join lattice y z == x ->
      (y == x) or (z == x)

record SupIrreducibleElement
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (lattice : DistributiveLattice A) :
  Set a where

  field
    value : A
    is-sup-irreducible : SupIrreducible lattice value

open SupIrreducibleElement

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Predicate {a} A =
  A -> Set a

SetEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
SetEqual {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) -> Iff (P x) (Q x)

Union :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Union P Q x =
  P x or Q x

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Intersection P Q x =
  P x and Q x

BirkhoffSet :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (lattice : DistributiveLattice A) ->
  A ->
  Predicate (SupIrreducibleElement lattice)
BirkhoffSet lattice x irreducible-element =
  LessOrEqual lattice (value irreducible-element) x

record IsInjectiveLatticeHomomorphism
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (lattice : DistributiveLattice A)
  (map :
    A ->
    Predicate (SupIrreducibleElement lattice)) :
  Set a where

  field
    map-join :
      (x y : A) ->
      SetEqual
        (map (join lattice x y))
        (Union (map x) (map y))
    map-meet :
      (x y : A) ->
      SetEqual
        (map (meet lattice x y))
        (Intersection (map x) (map y))
    injective :
      (x y : A) ->
      SetEqual (map x) (map y) ->
      x == y

birkhoff-s-representation-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
birkhoff-s-representation-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (lattice : DistributiveLattice A) ->
  Finite A ->
  ((x : A) -> Decision (SupIrreducible lattice x)) ->
  IsInjectiveLatticeHomomorphism lattice (BirkhoffSet lattice)

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q17005116, "Birkhoff's representation theorem": the canonical map from a
  finite distributive lattice to the powerset of its sup-irreducible elements
  is an injective lattice homomorphism. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q17005116_finite_distributive_lattice_def = new_definition (
  "q17005116_finite_distributive_lattice_def",
  ``q17005116_finite_distributive_lattice
      (carrier : 'a -> bool)

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q17005116
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q17005116), "Birkhoff's representation
  theorem": the canonical map from a finite distributive lattice to the
  powerset of its sup-irreducible elements is an injective lattice
  homomorphism. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  QBRKSupIrred K is the subtype carrier of the sup-irreducible elements of
  the lattice K. Its defining predicate is exactly the conjunction used by
  mathlib: the element is not a bottom element, and any binary join equal to
  it has one operand equal to it.

  QBRKBirkhoff K is the canonical map taking x to the set of sup-irreducible
  elements below x. SetMM's classical set comprehension makes the source
  DecidablePred dictionary implicit without changing this set or the map.

  The final declaration says that this canonical map is injective and
  preserves binary joins and meets as union and intersection. It is the
  single unproved $a corpus statement. All preceding $a declarations are
  syntax or faithful definitions, and this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c QBRKSupIrred QBRKBirkhoff $.

qbrk-sup-irreducible-syntax $a class ( QBRKSupIrred K ) $.
qbrk-birkhoff-map-syntax $a class ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) $.

${
  $d K a x y z $.

  qbrk-sup-irreducible-definition $a |- ( QBRKSupIrred K ) =
    {
      a e. ( Base ` K ) |
        (
          -. A. x e. ( Base ` K ) a ( le ` K ) x
          /\
          A. y e. ( Base ` K ) A. z e. ( Base ` K )
            (
              ( y ( join ` K ) z ) = a
              ->
              ( y = a \/ z = a )
            )
        )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d K a x $.

  qbrk-birkhoff-map-definition $a |- ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) =
    (
      x e. ( Base ` K ) |->
        { a e. ( QBRKSupIrred K ) | a ( le ` K ) x }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d K x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q17005116-birkhoff-representation $a |-
    A. K
      (
        (
          K e. DLat
          /\
          ( Base ` K ) e. Fin
        )
        ->
        (
          ( QBRKBirkhoff K )
            : ( Base ` K ) -1-1-> ~P ( QBRKSupIrred K )
          /\
          A. x e. ( Base ` K ) A. y e. ( Base ` K )
            (
              (
                ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) ` ( x ( join ` K ) y )
              )
              =
              (
                ( ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) ` x )
                u.
                ( ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) ` y )
              )
              /\
              (
                ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) ` ( x ( meet ` K ) y )
              )
              =
              (
                ( ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) ` x )
                i^i
                ( ( QBRKBirkhoff K ) ` y )
              )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q17005116,
:: "Birkhoff's representation theorem": the canonical map from a finite
:: distributive lattice to the powerset of its sup-irreducible elements sends
:: each element to the irreducibles below it and is an injective lattice
:: homomorphism. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2;
  requirements SUBSET, BOOLE;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for C being set,
      j,m being Function of [:C,C:],C st
    C is finite &
    (for x,y being set st x in C & y in C
      holds j.[x,y] = j.[y,x]) &
    (for x,y,z being set st x in C & y in C & z in C
      holds j.[j.[x,y],z] = j.[x,j.[y,z]]) &
    (for x,y being set st x in C & y in C
      holds m.[x,y] = m.[y,x]) &
    (for x,y,z being set st x in C & y in C & z in C
      holds m.[m.[x,y],z] = m.[x,m.[y,z]]) &
    (for x,y being set st x in C & y in C
      holds m.[x,j.[x,y]] = x) &
    (for x,y being set st x in C & y in C
      holds j.[x,m.[x,y]] = x) &
    (for x,y,z being set st x in C & y in C & z in C
      holds m.[x,j.[y,z]] = j.[m.[x,y],m.[x,z]])
    &
    (for x,y,z being set st x in C & y in C & z in C
      holds j.[x,m.[y,z]] = m.[j.[x,y],j.[x,z]])
  holds
    ex J being Subset of C, f being Function of C,bool J st
      (for p being set holds
        (p in J iff
          p in C &
          (ex x being set st x in C & j.[p,x] <> x) &
          (for x,y being set st x in C & y in C & j.[x,y] = p
            holds x = p or y = p))) &
      (for x,p being set st x in C holds
        (p in f.x iff p in J & j.[p,x] = x)) &
      f is one-to-one &
      (for x,y being set st x in C & y in C
        holds f.(j.[x,y]) = f.x \/ f.y &
          f.(m.[x,y]) = f.x /\ f.y)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q17005116
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q17005116), "Birkhoff's representation theorem":
% the canonical map from a finite distributive lattice to the powerset of its
% sup-irreducible elements is an injective lattice homomorphism. This file contains no proof.

Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem[
  A: TYPE,
  le_rel: [A, A -> bool],
  inf_op: [A, A -> A],
  sup_op: [A, A -> A]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[A]

  q17005116_partial_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)

  q17005116_lattice_laws: bool =
    q17005116_partial_order_laws
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(inf_op(x, y), x)
          AND le_rel(inf_op(x, y), y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(z, x) AND le_rel(z, y)
          IMPLIES le_rel(z, inf_op(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(x, sup_op(x, y))
          AND le_rel(y, sup_op(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(x, z) AND le_rel(y, z)
          IMPLIES le_rel(sup_op(x, y), z))

  q17005116_distributive_lattice_laws: bool =
    q17005116_lattice_laws
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        inf_op(x, sup_op(y, z)) =
          sup_op(inf_op(x, y), inf_op(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        sup_op(x, inf_op(y, z)) =
          inf_op(sup_op(x, y), sup_op(x, z)))

  q17005116_finite_distributive_lattice: bool =
    is_finite_type[A]
      AND q17005116_distributive_lattice_laws

  q17005116_minimal(a: A): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      le_rel(x, a) IMPLIES le_rel(a, x)

  q17005116_sup_irreducible(a: A): bool =
    NOT q17005116_minimal(a)
      AND (FORALL (b, c: A):
        sup_op(b, c) = a IMPLIES b = a OR c = a)

  q17005116_birkhoff_set(x: A): [A -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (a: A):
      q17005116_sup_irreducible(a)
        AND le_rel(a, x)

  q17005116_preserves_sup_and_inf: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, a: A):
      q17005116_birkhoff_set(sup_op(x, y))(a)
        IFF
      (q17005116_birkhoff_set(x)(a)
        OR q17005116_birkhoff_set(y)(a)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, a: A):
        q17005116_birkhoff_set(inf_op(x, y))(a)
          IFF
        (q17005116_birkhoff_set(x)(a)
          AND q17005116_birkhoff_set(y)(a)))

  q17005116_injective: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      (FORALL (a: A):
        q17005116_birkhoff_set(x)(a)
          IFF q17005116_birkhoff_set(y)(a))
        IMPLIES x = y

  birkhoff_s_representation_theorem: bool =
    q17005116_finite_distributive_lattice
      IMPLIES
        q17005116_preserves_sup_and_inf
          AND q17005116_injective
END Q17005116_birkhoff_s_representation_theorem
