Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q17098298
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q17098298), "Jacobson density theorem": for a
  semisimple left module over an arbitrary unital ring, every additive
  self-map commuting with all module endomorphisms agrees on any finite set
  with scalar multiplication by one ring element. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q17098298_unital_ring ::
    "'r::ring \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_unital_ring oneR \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a. oneR * a = a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. a * oneR = a)"

definition q17098298_module ::
    "'r::ring \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_module oneR smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a b x. smul (a + b) x = smul a x + smul b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. smul a (x + y) = smul a x + smul a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smul 0 x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. smul a 0 = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smul oneR x = x)"

definition q17098298_submodule ::
    "('r::ring \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      'm set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_submodule smul N \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> N \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> N. -x \<in> N) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> N. \<forall>y \<in> N. x + y \<in> N) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>x \<in> N. smul a x \<in> N)"

definition q17098298_semisimple_module ::
    "('r::ring \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_semisimple_module smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>N. q17098298_submodule smul N \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>P.
        q17098298_submodule smul P \<and>
        N \<inter> P = {0} \<and>
        (\<forall>x. \<exists>n \<in> N. \<exists>p \<in> P. x = n + p)))"

definition q17098298_additive_map ::
    "('m::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_additive_map f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y)"

definition q17098298_module_endomorphism ::
    "('r::ring \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      ('m \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_module_endomorphism smul g \<longleftrightarrow>
    q17098298_additive_map g \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. g (smul a x) = smul a (g x))"

definition q17098298_endomorphism_linear_map ::
    "('r::ring \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      ('m \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q17098298_endomorphism_linear_map smul f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q17098298_additive_map f \<and>
    (\<forall>g. q17098298_module_endomorphism smul g \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. f (g x) = g (f x)))"

theorem q17098298_jacobson_density:
  fixes oneR :: "'r::ring"
    and smul :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'm::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'm"
    and f :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm"
    and S :: "'m set"
  assumes ring_with_one: "q17098298_unital_ring oneR"
    and module: "q17098298_module oneR smul"
    and semisimple: "q17098298_semisimple_module smul"
    and endomorphism_linear:
      "q17098298_endomorphism_linear_map smul f"
    and finite_set: "finite S"
  shows "\<exists>r. \<forall>m \<in> S. f m = smul r m"
  sorry

end

title: Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q17098298
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q17098298), "Jacobson density theorem": on a
  semisimple left module, every endomorphism linear over the ring of
  module endomorphisms agrees on each finite set with multiplication by one
  scalar from the original ring. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q17098298_JACOBSON_DENSITY_THEOREM =
  `let is_ring =
     \(zeroR:'r) (oneR:'r) (addR:'r->'r->'r)
      (mulR:'r->'r->'r) (negR:'r->'r).
       (!x:'r. addR zeroR x = x) /\
       (!x:'r. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
       (!x y:'r. addR x y = addR y x) /\
       (!x y z:'r. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
       (!x:'r. mulR oneR x = x /\ mulR x oneR = x) /\
       (!x y z:'r. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
       (!x y z:'r.
          mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
       (!x y z:'r.
          mulR (addR x y) z = addR (mulR x z) (mulR y z)) in
   let is_add_comm_group =
     \(zeroM:'m) (addM:'m->'m->'m) (negM:'m->'m).
       (!x:'m. addM zeroM x = x) /\
       (!x:'m. addM (negM x) x = zeroM) /\
       (!x y:'m. addM x y = addM y x) /\
       (!x y z:'m. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) in
   let is_left_module =
     \(zeroR:'r) (oneR:'r) (addR:'r->'r->'r)
      (mulR:'r->'r->'r) (zeroM:'m) (addM:'m->'m->'m)
      (smul:'r->'m->'m).
       (!x:'m. smul oneR x = x) /\
       (!a b:'r. !x:'m. smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:'r. !x:'m.
          smul (addR a b) x = addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:'r. !x y:'m.
          smul a (addM x y) = addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x:'m. smul zeroR x = zeroM) /\
       (!a:'r. smul a zeroM = zeroM) in
   let is_submodule =
     \(zeroM:'m) (addM:'m->'m->'m) (negM:'m->'m)
      (smul:'r->'m->'m) (N:'m->bool).
       N zeroM /\
       (!x y:'m. N x /\ N y ==> N (addM x y)) /\
       (!x:'m. N x ==> N (negM x)) /\
       (!a:'r. !x:'m. N x ==> N (smul a x)) in
   let is_semisimple_module =
     \(zeroM:'m) (addM:'m->'m->'m) (negM:'m->'m)
      (smul:'r->'m->'m).
       !N:'m->bool.
         is_submodule zeroM addM negM smul N
         ==> ?K:'m->bool.
               is_submodule zeroM addM negM smul K /\
               (!x:'m. N x /\ K x <=> x = zeroM) /\
               (!x:'m.
                  ?n k:'m. N n /\ K k /\ x = addM n k) in
   let is_R_linear =
     \(zeroM:'m) (addM:'m->'m->'m) (smul:'r->'m->'m)
      (g:'m->'m).
       g zeroM = zeroM /\
       (!x y:'m. g (addM x y) = addM (g x) (g y)) /\
       (!a:'r. !x:'m. g (smul a x) = smul a (g x)) in
   let is_endomorphism_ring_linear =
     \(zeroM:'m) (addM:'m->'m->'m) (smul:'r->'m->'m)
      (f:'m->'m).
       f zeroM = zeroM /\
       (!x y:'m. f (addM x y) = addM (f x) (f y)) /\
       (!g:'m->'m.
          is_R_linear zeroM addM smul g
          ==> !x:'m. f (g x) = g (f x)) in
   !zeroR oneR:'r.
   !addR mulR:'r->'r->'r.
   !negR:'r->'r.
   !zeroM:'m.
   !addM:'m->'m->'m.
   !negM:'m->'m.
   !smul:'r->'m->'m.
   !f:'m->'m.
   !s:'m->bool.
     is_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_add_comm_group zeroM addM negM /\
     is_left_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM smul /\
     is_semisimple_module zeroM addM negM smul /\
     is_endomorphism_ring_linear zeroM addM smul f /\
     FINITE s
     ==> ?r:'r.
           !m:'m. m IN s ==> f m = smul r m`;;

        (q17098298-ring-add ring y x))))
     (implies
      (q17098298-ring-member-p ring x)
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p
        ring (q17098298-ring-negate ring x))
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-add
         ring x (q17098298-ring-zero ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-add
         ring x (q17098298-ring-negate ring x))
        (q17098298-ring-zero ring))
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-multiply
         ring x (q17098298-ring-one ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-multiply
         ring (q17098298-ring-one ring) x)
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring x)
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring y)
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-add
         ring (q17098298-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q17098298-ring-add
         ring x (q17098298-ring-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-multiply
         ring (q17098298-ring-multiply ring x y) z)
        (q17098298-ring-multiply
         ring x (q17098298-ring-multiply ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-multiply
         ring x (q17098298-ring-add ring y z))
        (q17098298-ring-add
         ring
         (q17098298-ring-multiply ring x y)
         (q17098298-ring-multiply ring x z)))
       (equal
        (q17098298-ring-multiply
         ring (q17098298-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q17098298-ring-add
         ring
         (q17098298-ring-multiply ring x z)
         (q17098298-ring-multiply ring y z))))))))

(defun q17098298-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (q17098298-ring-member-p
    ring (q17098298-ring-zero ring))
   (q17098298-ring-member-p
    ring (q17098298-ring-one ring))
   (q17098298-ring-laws-p ring)))

;; Additive commutative groups with a left action of the arbitrary ring.

(defun-sk q17098298-module-laws-p (ring module)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module v))
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p
        ring module
        (q17098298-module-add ring module u v))
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-add ring module u v)
        (q17098298-module-add ring module v u))))
     (implies
      (q17098298-module-member-p ring module u)
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p
        ring module
        (q17098298-module-negate ring module u))
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-add
         ring module u (q17098298-module-zero ring module))
        u)
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-add
         ring module u
         (q17098298-module-negate ring module u))
        (q17098298-module-zero ring module))
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-smul
         ring module (q17098298-ring-one ring) u)
        u)
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-smul
         ring module (q17098298-ring-zero ring) u)
        (q17098298-module-zero ring module))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module v)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module w))
      (equal
       (q17098298-module-add
        ring module
        (q17098298-module-add ring module u v)
        w)
       (q17098298-module-add
        ring module u
        (q17098298-module-add ring module v w))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module u))
      (q17098298-module-member-p
       ring module
       (q17098298-module-smul ring module a u)))
     (implies
      (q17098298-ring-member-p ring a)
      (equal
       (q17098298-module-smul
        ring module a (q17098298-module-zero ring module))
       (q17098298-module-zero ring module)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module v))
      (equal
       (q17098298-module-smul
        ring module a
        (q17098298-module-add ring module u v))
       (q17098298-module-add
        ring module
        (q17098298-module-smul ring module a u)
        (q17098298-module-smul ring module a v))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring b)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module u))
      (and
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-smul
         ring module (q17098298-ring-add ring a b) u)
        (q17098298-module-add
         ring module
         (q17098298-module-smul ring module a u)
         (q17098298-module-smul ring module b u)))
       (equal
        (q17098298-module-smul
         ring module (q17098298-ring-multiply ring a b) u)
        (q17098298-module-smul
         ring module a
         (q17098298-module-smul ring module b u))))))))

(defun q17098298-module-p (ring module)
  (and
   (q17098298-ring-p ring)
   (q17098298-module-member-p
    ring module (q17098298-module-zero ring module))
   (q17098298-module-laws-p ring module)))

;; Submodules are arbitrary predicates satisfying the full closure laws.

(defun-sk q17098298-submodule-laws-p
    (ring module submodule)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q17098298-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule x)
      (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-submodule-member-p
        ring module submodule x)
       (q17098298-submodule-member-p
        ring module submodule y))
      (q17098298-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule
       (q17098298-module-add ring module x y)))
     (implies
      (q17098298-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule x)
      (q17098298-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule
       (q17098298-module-negate ring module x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q17098298-submodule-member-p
        ring module submodule x))
      (q17098298-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule
       (q17098298-module-smul ring module a x))))))

(defun q17098298-submodule-p (ring module submodule)
  (and
   (q17098298-submodule-member-p
    ring module submodule
    (q17098298-module-zero ring module))
   (q17098298-submodule-laws-p ring module submodule)))

;; A complement has zero intersection with the given submodule and every
;; module element is a sum of one element from each submodule.

(defun-sk q17098298-decomposition-exists-p
    (ring module left-submodule right-submodule value)
  (exists (left-value right-value)
    (and
     (q17098298-submodule-member-p
      ring module left-submodule left-value)
     (q17098298-submodule-member-p
      ring module right-submodule right-value)
     (equal
      value
      (q17098298-module-add
       ring module left-value right-value)))))

(defun-sk q17098298-complement-laws-p
    (ring module left-submodule right-submodule)
  (forall (value)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-submodule-member-p
        ring module left-submodule value)
       (q17098298-submodule-member-p
        ring module right-submodule value))
      (equal value (q17098298-module-zero ring module)))
     (implies
      (q17098298-module-member-p ring module value)
      (q17098298-decomposition-exists-p
       ring module left-submodule right-submodule value)))))

(defun q17098298-complement-p
    (ring module left-submodule right-submodule)
  (and
   (q17098298-submodule-p
    ring module right-submodule)
   (q17098298-complement-laws-p
    ring module left-submodule right-submodule)))

(defun-sk q17098298-complement-exists-p
    (ring module submodule)
  (exists (complement)
    (q17098298-complement-p
     ring module submodule complement)))

(defun-sk q17098298-semisimple-laws-p (ring module)
  (forall (submodule)
    (implies
     (q17098298-submodule-p ring module submodule)
     (q17098298-complement-exists-p
      ring module submodule))))

(defun q17098298-semisimple-module-p (ring module)
  (and
   (q17098298-module-p ring module)
   (q17098298-semisimple-laws-p ring module)))

;; The endomorphism ring consists of all R-linear self-maps of the module.

(defun-sk q17098298-endomorphism-laws-p
    (ring module endomorphism)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x)
      (q17098298-module-member-p
       ring module
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module endomorphism x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module y))
      (equal
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module endomorphism
        (q17098298-module-add ring module x y))
       (q17098298-module-add
        ring module
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module endomorphism x)
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module endomorphism y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x))
      (equal
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module endomorphism
        (q17098298-module-smul ring module a x))
       (q17098298-module-smul
        ring module a
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module endomorphism x)))))))

(defun q17098298-endomorphism-p
    (ring module endomorphism)
  (q17098298-endomorphism-laws-p
   ring module endomorphism))

;; A member of End(End_R(M), M) is additive and commutes with every R-linear
;; endomorphism under the evaluation action.

(defun-sk q17098298-endomorphism-linear-laws-p
    (ring module linear-map)
  (forall (endomorphism x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x)
      (q17098298-module-member-p
       ring module
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module linear-map x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module y))
      (equal
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module linear-map
        (q17098298-module-add ring module x y))
       (q17098298-module-add
        ring module
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module linear-map x)
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module linear-map y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q17098298-endomorphism-p
        ring module endomorphism)
       (q17098298-module-member-p ring module x))
      (equal
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module linear-map
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module endomorphism x))
       (q17098298-linear-map-apply
        ring module endomorphism
        (q17098298-linear-map-apply
         ring module linear-map x)))))))

(defun q17098298-endomorphism-linear-map-p
    (ring module linear-map)
  (q17098298-endomorphism-linear-laws-p
   ring module linear-map))

;; Duplicate-free module-element lists are canonical representatives of the
;; source Finset. Only this source object is finite.

(defun q17098298-module-list-p (ring module values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q17098298-module-member-p
        ring module (car values))
       (q17098298-module-list-p
        ring module (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q17098298-finite-subset-p
    (ring module finite-subset)
  (and
   (true-listp finite-subset)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal finite-subset)
   (q17098298-module-list-p
    ring module finite-subset)))

;; The scalar witness remains existentially quantified inside the conclusion.

(defun-sk q17098298-scalar-agreement-p
    (ring module linear-map finite-subset scalar)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (member-equal value finite-subset)
     (equal
      (q17098298-linear-map-apply
       ring module linear-map value)
      (q17098298-module-smul
       ring module scalar value)))))

(defun-sk q17098298-scalar-agrees-on-finite-subset-p
    (ring module linear-map finite-subset)
  (exists (scalar)
    (and
     (q17098298-ring-member-p ring scalar)
     (q17098298-scalar-agreement-p
      ring module linear-map finite-subset scalar))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q17098298-jacobson-density-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (ring module linear-map finite-subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q17098298-semisimple-module-p ring module)
      (q17098298-endomorphism-linear-map-p
       ring module linear-map)
      (q17098298-finite-subset-p
       ring module finite-subset))
     (q17098298-scalar-agrees-on-finite-subset-p
      ring module linear-map finite-subset))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q17098298,
-- "Jacobson density theorem": on a semisimple module, every additive self-map
-- commuting with all module endomorphisms agrees on each finite subset with
-- scalar multiplication by one ring element. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Ring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ==
      addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR (negateR x) x == zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record AdditiveCommutativeGroup
  {m : Level}
  (M : Set m) :
  Set m where

  field
    zeroM : M
    addM : M -> M -> M
    negateM : M -> M

    add-associative :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z ==
      addM x (addM y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : M) ->
      addM zeroM x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : M) ->
      addM (negateM x) x == zeroM
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x (negateM x) == zeroM

record Module
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (ring : Ring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    scale : R -> M -> M

    one-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.oneR ring) x == x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.multiplyR ring a b) x ==
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scale :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.addR ring a b) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale b x)
    scale-add :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : M) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale a y)

record LinearEndomorphism
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    apply : M -> M
    map-zero :
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive
    map-add :
      (x y : M) ->
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
        (apply x)
        (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      apply (Module.scale module-structure a x) ==
      Module.scale module-structure a (apply x)

record EndomorphismLinearMap
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    apply : M -> M
    map-zero :
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive
    map-add :
      (x y : M) ->
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
        (apply x)
        (apply y)
    commutes-with-endomorphisms :
      (g : LinearEndomorphism module-structure) ->
      (x : M) ->
      apply (LinearEndomorphism.apply g x) ==
      LinearEndomorphism.apply g (apply x)

record Submodule
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    member : M -> Set m
    membership-propositional :
      (x : M) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u == v
    contains-zero :
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : M) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : M) ->
      member x ->
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM additive x)
    closed-under-scaling :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      member x ->
      member (Module.scale module-structure a x)

record DirectComplement
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  {module-structure : Module ring additive}
  (left right : Submodule module-structure) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    intersection-zero :
      (x : M) ->
      Submodule.member left x ->
      Submodule.member right x ->
      x == AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive
    spans :
      (x : M) ->
      Σ M
        (\ left-part ->
          Σ (Submodule.member left left-part)
            (\ _ ->
              Σ M
                (\ right-part ->
                  Σ (Submodule.member right right-part)
                    (\ _ ->
                      x ==
                      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
                        left-part right-part))))

IsSemisimpleModule :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M} ->
  Module ring additive ->
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m)
IsSemisimpleModule module-structure =
  (left : Submodule module-structure) ->
  Σ (Submodule module-structure)
    (\ right ->
      DirectComplement left right)

record FiniteSubset
  {m : Level}
  (M : Set m) :
  Set (lsuc m) where

  field
    size : Nat
    member : M -> Set m
    membership-propositional :
      (x : M) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u == v
    enumerate : Fin size -> M
    enumerate-member :
      (i : Fin size) ->
      member (enumerate i)
    exhaustive :
      (x : M) ->
      member x ->
      Σ (Fin size)
        (\ i ->
          enumerate i == x)
    no-duplicates :
      (i j : Fin size) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

jacobson-density-theorem : Setω
jacobson-density-theorem =
  {r m : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (ring : Ring R) ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  IsSemisimpleModule module-structure ->
  (f : EndomorphismLinearMap module-structure) ->
  (finite-subset : FiniteSubset M) ->
  Σ R
    (\ scalar ->
      (x : M) ->
      FiniteSubset.member finite-subset x ->
      EndomorphismLinearMap.apply f x ==
      Module.scale module-structure scalar x)

title: Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q17098298, "Jacobson density theorem": on an arbitrary semisimple left
  module, every self-map linear over the ring of module endomorphisms agrees
  on each finite subset with multiplication by one scalar. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q17098298_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q17098298_ring_def",
  ``q17098298_ring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a. addR (negR a) a = zeroR) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
      (!a. mulR a oneR = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) =
                 addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (addR a b) c =
                 addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c))``);

val q17098298_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q17098298_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q17098298_add_comm_group
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!x y. addM x y = addM y x) /\
      (!x y z. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) /\
      (!x. addM zeroM x = x) /\
      (!x. addM (negM x) x = zeroM)``);

val q17098298_module_def = new_definition (
  "q17098298_module_def",
  ``q17098298_module
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!x. smul oneR x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addR a b) x =
                 addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (addM x y) =
                 addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul zeroR x = zeroM) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroM = zeroM)``);

val q17098298_submodule_def = new_definition (
  "q17098298_submodule_def",
  ``q17098298_submodule
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (p : 'm -> bool) <=>
      p zeroM /\
      (!x y. p x /\ p y ==> p (addM x y)) /\

  "q17098298_complement_def",

      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (p : 'm -> bool) (q : 'm -> bool) <=>

      (!x. ?y z. p y /\ q z /\ x = addM y z)``);

  "q17098298_semisimple_module_def",
  ``q17098298_semisimple_module
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      q17098298_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
      q17098298_add_comm_group zeroM addM negM /\
      q17098298_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM smul /\
      !p : 'm -> bool.
        q17098298_submodule zeroM addM negM smul p
        ==>
        ?q : 'm -> bool.
          q17098298_submodule zeroM addM negM smul q /\
          q17098298_complement zeroM addM p q``);

val q17098298_linear_endomorphism_def = new_definition (
  "q17098298_linear_endomorphism_def",
  ``q17098298_linear_endomorphism
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (g : 'm -> 'm) <=>
      g zeroM = zeroM /\
      (!x y. g (addM x y) = addM (g x) (g y)) /\
      (!a x. g (smul a x) = smul a (g x))``);

val q17098298_endomorphism_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q17098298_endomorphism_linear_def",
  ``q17098298_endomorphism_linear
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (f : 'm -> 'm) <=>
      f zeroM = zeroM /\
      (!x y. f (addM x y) = addM (f x) (f y)) /\
      (!g : 'm -> 'm.
        q17098298_linear_endomorphism zeroM addM smul g
        ==>
        !x. f (g x) = g (f x))``);

val jacobson_density_statement =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (f : 'm -> 'm) (s : 'm set).
      q17098298_semisimple_module
        zeroR oneR addR mulR negR zeroM addM negM smul /\
      q17098298_endomorphism_linear zeroM addM smul f /\
      FINITE s
      ==>
      ?r : 'r. !m. m IN s ==> f m = smul r m``;

title: Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q17098298
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q17098298), "Jacobson density theorem": on
  every finite subset of a semisimple module, an endomorphism commuting with
  all module endomorphisms agrees with scalar multiplication by one ring
  element. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  R is an arbitrary ring and M is an arbitrary SetMM left R-module.
  Q17098298Semisimple M says that every submodule N has a complementary
  submodule P: their intersection is zero and every element of M is a sum of
  an element of N and an element of P. This is exactly the complemented
  submodule-lattice definition of Mathlib's IsSemisimpleModule R M.

  Q17098298EndLinear M f says that f is an additive endomorphism of M and
  commutes with every R-linear endomorphism g of M. The endomorphism ring
  Module.End R M acts on M by evaluation, so this condition is
  bidirectionally equivalent to f belonging to
  Module.End (Module.End R M) M.

  A SetMM member of Fin i^i ~P ( Base ` M ) is precisely a finite subset of
  M, matching Lean's Finset M. The witness r remains existentially quantified
  after that finite subset is chosen.

  All declarations preceding the final one are syntax or faithful
  bidirectional definitions. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q17098298Semisimple Q17098298EndLinear $.

q17098298-semisimple-syntax $a
  wff ( Q17098298Semisimple M ) $.

q17098298-end-linear-syntax $a
  wff ( Q17098298EndLinear M f ) $.

${
  $d M N P m n p $.

  q17098298-semisimple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q17098298Semisimple M )
    <->
    (
      M e. LMod
      /\
      A. N e. ( LSubSp ` M )
        E. P e. ( LSubSp ` M )
          (
            ( N i^i P ) = { ( 0g ` M ) }
            /\
            A. m e. ( Base ` M )
              E. n e. N
                E. p e. P
                  m = ( n ( +g ` M ) p )
          )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d M f g m $.

  q17098298-end-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q17098298EndLinear M f )
    <->
    (
      f e. ( M GrpHom M )
      /\
      A. g e. ( M LMHom M )
        A. m e. ( Base ` M )
          ( f ` ( g ` m ) ) = ( g ` ( f ` m ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d M R S f m r $.

  thousand-theorems-q17098298-jacobson-density-theorem $a |- (
    A. R e. Ring
      A. M
        (
          (
            ( Scalar ` M ) = R
            /\
            ( Q17098298Semisimple M )
          )
          ->
          A. f
            (
              ( Q17098298EndLinear M f )
              ->
              A. S e. ( Fin i^i ~P ( Base ` M ) )
                E. r e. ( Base ` R )
                  A. m e. S
                    ( f ` m ) = ( r ( .s ` M ) m )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q17098298,
:: "Jacobson density theorem": on a semisimple module over a ring, every
:: endomorphism-linear self-map agrees on each finite subset with scalar
:: multiplication by one ring element. This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, FINSET_1;
  notations XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, FINSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, BINOP_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R,M being non empty set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      oppR being UnOp of R,
      zeroM being Element of M,
      addM being BinOp of M,
      oppM being UnOp of M,
      smul being Function of [:R,M:],M,
      f being Function of M,M,
      S being finite Subset of M
  st
    (for a,b being Element of R holds addR.(a,b) = addR.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(a,b),c) = addR.(a,addR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds addR.(a,zeroR) = a) &
    (for a being Element of R holds addR.(a,oppR.a) = zeroR) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(a,b),c) = mulR.(a,mulR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      mulR.(oneR,a) = a & mulR.(a,oneR) = a) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,addR.(b,c)) =
        addR.(mulR.(a,b),mulR.(a,c)) &
      mulR.(addR.(a,b),c) =
        addR.(mulR.(a,c),mulR.(b,c))) &
    (for x,y being Element of M holds addM.(x,y) = addM.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of M holds
      addM.(addM.(x,y),z) = addM.(x,addM.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of M holds addM.(x,zeroM) = x) &
    (for x being Element of M holds addM.(x,oppM.x) = zeroM) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, x being Element of M holds
      smul.(addR.(a,b),x) =
        addM.(smul.(a,x),smul.(b,x))) &
    (for a being Element of R, x,y being Element of M holds
      smul.(a,addM.(x,y)) =
        addM.(smul.(a,x),smul.(a,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, x being Element of M holds
      smul.(mulR.(a,b),x) = smul.(a,smul.(b,x))) &
    (for x being Element of M holds smul.(oneR,x) = x) &
    (for U being Subset of M st
      zeroM in U &
      (for x,y being Element of M st x in U & y in U
        holds addM.(x,y) in U) &
      (for x being Element of M st x in U holds oppM.x in U) &
      (for a being Element of R, x being Element of M st x in U
        holds smul.(a,x) in U)
    holds
      ex W being Subset of M st
        zeroM in W &
        (for x,y being Element of M st x in W & y in W
          holds addM.(x,y) in W) &
        (for x being Element of M st x in W holds oppM.x in W) &
        (for a being Element of R, x being Element of M st x in W
          holds smul.(a,x) in W) &
        (for x being Element of M st x in U & x in W holds x = zeroM) &
        (for x being Element of M holds
          ex u,v being Element of M st
            u in U & v in W & x = addM.(u,v))) &
    (for x,y being Element of M holds
      f.(addM.(x,y)) = addM.(f.x,f.y)) &
    (for g being Function of M,M st
      (for x,y being Element of M holds
        g.(addM.(x,y)) = addM.(g.x,g.y)) &
      (for a being Element of R, x being Element of M holds
        g.(smul.(a,x)) = smul.(a,g.x))
    holds
      for x being Element of M holds f.(g.x) = g.(f.x))
  holds
    ex r being Element of R st
      for x being Element of M st x in S holds f.x = smul.(r,x)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
% Q17098298 (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q17098298), "Jacobson density theorem":
% on a semisimple module, an endomorphism-linear self-map agrees on every
% finite subset with scalar multiplication by some ring element. This file
% contains no proof.

Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem[
  R, M: TYPE+,
  zero_R, one_R: R,
  neg_R: [R -> R],
  add_R, mul_R: [R, R -> R],
  zero_M: M,
  neg_M: [M -> M],
  add_M: [M, M -> M],
  smul_R: [R, M -> M]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  submodule: TYPE = [M -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[M]

  ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: R):
      add_R(a, b) = add_R(b, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      add_R(add_R(a, b), c) = add_R(a, add_R(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      add_R(zero_R, a) = a
        AND add_R(a, zero_R) = a)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      add_R(neg_R(a), a) = zero_R
        AND add_R(a, neg_R(a)) = zero_R)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      mul_R(mul_R(a, b), c) = mul_R(a, mul_R(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      mul_R(one_R, a) = a
        AND mul_R(a, one_R) = a)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      mul_R(a, add_R(b, c))
        = add_R(mul_R(a, b), mul_R(a, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      mul_R(add_R(a, b), c)
        = add_R(mul_R(a, c), mul_R(b, c)))

  additive_commutative_group_laws_M: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      add_M(x, y) = add_M(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
      add_M(add_M(x, y), z) = add_M(x, add_M(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      add_M(zero_M, x) = x
        AND add_M(x, zero_M) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      add_M(neg_M(x), x) = zero_M
        AND add_M(x, neg_M(x)) = zero_M)

  module_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_laws_M
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R), (x, y: M):
      smul_R(a, add_M(x, y))
        = add_M(smul_R(a, x), smul_R(a, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
      smul_R(add_R(a, b), x)
        = add_M(smul_R(a, x), smul_R(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
      smul_R(mul_R(a, b), x)
        = smul_R(a, smul_R(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      smul_R(one_R, x) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      smul_R(zero_R, x) = zero_M)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      smul_R(a, zero_M) = zero_M)

  is_submodule(N: submodule): bool =
    N(zero_M)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      N(x) AND N(y) IMPLIES N(add_M(x, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      N(x) IMPLIES N(neg_M(x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R), (x: M):
      N(x) IMPLIES N(smul_R(a, x)))

  direct_complements(N, C: submodule): bool =
    is_submodule(N)
      AND is_submodule(C)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      N(x) AND C(x) IMPLIES x = zero_M)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      EXISTS (n, c: M):
        N(n) AND C(c) AND x = add_M(n, c))

  semisimple_module: bool =
    FORALL (N: submodule):
      is_submodule(N) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (C: submodule):
          direct_complements(N, C)

  is_R_linear(g: [M -> M]): bool =
    g(zero_M) = zero_M
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      g(add_M(x, y)) = add_M(g(x), g(y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R), (x: M):
      g(smul_R(a, x)) = smul_R(a, g(x)))

  is_endomorphism_ring_linear(f: [M -> M]): bool =
    f(zero_M) = zero_M
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      f(add_M(x, y)) = add_M(f(x), f(y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (g: [M -> M]):
      is_R_linear(g) IMPLIES
        (FORALL (x: M):
          f(g(x)) = g(f(x))))

  jacobson_density: bool =
    (ring_laws AND module_laws AND semisimple_module)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (f: [M -> M]), (s: finite_set[M]):
          is_endomorphism_ring_linear(f)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (r: R):
                FORALL (m: M):
                  member(m, s) IMPLIES
                    f(m) = smul_R(r, m)

END Q17098298_jacobson_density_theorem

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q172298
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q172298), "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite primary
-- decomposition of a submodule can be regrouped so that the radicals of its colon
-- ideals are pairwise distinct. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LocalizedModule.Submodule
public import Mathlib.Order.Irreducible
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.AssociatedPrime.Basic

@[expose] public section

open Ideal

open scoped Function

namespace Q172298

variable {R M : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]

/-- A primary decomposition can be regrouped to have pairwise distinct colon radicals. -/
theorem isPrimary_decomposition_pairwise_ne_radical_statement
    {N : Submodule R M} {s : Finset (Submodule R M)}
    (hs : s.inf id = N) (hs' : ∀ ⦃J⦄, J ∈ s → J.IsPrimary) :
    ∃ t : Finset (Submodule R M), t.inf id = N ∧ (∀ ⦃J⦄, J ∈ t → J.IsPrimary) ∧
      (t : Set (Submodule R M)).Pairwise
        ((· ≠ ·) on fun J ↦ (J.colon Set.univ).radical) := sorry

end Q172298

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q172298
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q172298), "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite
  primary decomposition of a submodule can be replaced by one with the same
  intersection and pairwise distinct radicals of the corresponding colon
  ideals. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q172298_comm_semiring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q172298_ring_zero : R;
  q172298_ring_one : R;
  q172298_ring_add : R -> R -> R;
  q172298_ring_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q172298_ring_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q172298_ring_add x (q172298_ring_add y z) =
      q172298_ring_add (q172298_ring_add x y) z;
  q172298_ring_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q172298_ring_add x y = q172298_ring_add y x;
  q172298_ring_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q172298_ring_add x q172298_ring_zero = x;
  q172298_ring_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q172298_ring_mul x (q172298_ring_mul y z) =
      q172298_ring_mul (q172298_ring_mul x y) z;
  q172298_ring_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q172298_ring_mul x y = q172298_ring_mul y x;
  q172298_ring_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q172298_ring_mul x q172298_ring_one = x;
  q172298_ring_mul_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q172298_ring_mul x q172298_ring_zero = q172298_ring_zero;
  q172298_ring_mul_add :
    forall x y z : R,
      q172298_ring_mul x (q172298_ring_add y z) =
      q172298_ring_add
        (q172298_ring_mul x y) (q172298_ring_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q172298_ring_zero {R} _.
Arguments q172298_ring_one {R} _.
Arguments q172298_ring_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q172298_ring_mul {R} _ _ _.

Record q172298_add_comm_monoid (M : Type) : Type := {
  q172298_module_zero : M;
  q172298_module_add : M -> M -> M;
  q172298_module_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : M,
      q172298_module_add x (q172298_module_add y z) =
      q172298_module_add (q172298_module_add x y) z;
  q172298_module_add_comm :
    forall x y : M,
      q172298_module_add x y = q172298_module_add y x;
  q172298_module_add_zero :
    forall x : M,
      q172298_module_add x q172298_module_zero = x
}.

Arguments q172298_module_zero {M} _.
Arguments q172298_module_add {M} _ _ _.

Record q172298_module
    (R M : Type)
    (SR : q172298_comm_semiring R)
    (AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M) : Type := {
  q172298_smul : R -> M -> M;
  q172298_one_smul :
    forall x : M,
      q172298_smul (q172298_ring_one SR) x = x;
  q172298_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : M),
      q172298_smul (q172298_ring_mul SR a b) x =
      q172298_smul a (q172298_smul b x);
  q172298_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : M),
      q172298_smul a (q172298_module_add AM x y) =
      q172298_module_add AM (q172298_smul a x) (q172298_smul a y);
  q172298_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : M),
      q172298_smul (q172298_ring_add SR a b) x =
      q172298_module_add AM (q172298_smul a x) (q172298_smul b x);
  q172298_zero_smul :
    forall x : M,
      q172298_smul (q172298_ring_zero SR) x =
      q172298_module_zero AM;
  q172298_smul_zero :
    forall a : R,
      q172298_smul a (q172298_module_zero AM) =
      q172298_module_zero AM
}.

Arguments q172298_smul {R M SR AM} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q172298_pow
    {R : Type} (SR : q172298_comm_semiring R)
    (r : R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q172298_ring_one SR
  | S k => q172298_ring_mul SR r (q172298_pow SR r k)
  end.

Record q172298_submodule
    (R M : Type)
    (SR : q172298_comm_semiring R)
    (AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M)
    (SM : q172298_module SR AM) : Type := {
  q172298_submodule_mem : M -> Prop;
  q172298_submodule_zero :
    q172298_submodule_mem (q172298_module_zero AM);
  q172298_submodule_add :
    forall x y : M,
      q172298_submodule_mem x ->
      q172298_submodule_mem y ->
      q172298_submodule_mem (q172298_module_add AM x y);
  q172298_submodule_smul :
    forall (r : R) (x : M),
      q172298_submodule_mem x ->
      q172298_submodule_mem (q172298_smul SM r x)
}.

Arguments q172298_submodule_mem {R M SR AM SM} _ _.

Definition q172298_submodule_equal
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (N P : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM) : Prop :=
  forall x : M,
    q172298_submodule_mem N x <-> q172298_submodule_mem P x.

Definition q172298_submodule_in
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (N : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM)
    (family : list (@q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM)) : Prop :=
  exists P : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM,
    In P family /\ q172298_submodule_equal N P.

Fixpoint q172298_submodule_nodup
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (family : list (@q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM)) : Prop :=
  match family with
  | nil => True
  | N :: rest =>
      ~ q172298_submodule_in N rest /\
      q172298_submodule_nodup rest
  end.

Record q172298_finite_submodules
    (R M : Type)
    (SR : q172298_comm_semiring R)
    (AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M)
    (SM : q172298_module SR AM) : Type := {
  q172298_elements : list (@q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM);
  q172298_elements_nodup :
    q172298_submodule_nodup q172298_elements
}.

Arguments q172298_elements {R M SR AM SM} _.

Definition q172298_infimum_equal
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (family : @q172298_finite_submodules R M SR AM SM)
    (N : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM) : Prop :=
  forall x : M,
    q172298_submodule_mem N x <->
    forall P : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM,
      q172298_submodule_in P (q172298_elements family) ->
      q172298_submodule_mem P x.

Definition q172298_is_primary
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (N : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM) : Prop :=
  ~ (forall x : M, q172298_submodule_mem N x) /\
  forall (r : R) (x : M),
    q172298_submodule_mem N (q172298_smul SM r x) ->
    q172298_submodule_mem N x \/
    exists n : nat,
      forall y : M,
        q172298_submodule_mem N
          (q172298_smul SM (q172298_pow SR r n) y).

Definition q172298_colon_radical_member
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (N : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM)
    (r : R) : Prop :=
  exists n : nat,
    forall x : M,
      q172298_submodule_mem N
        (q172298_smul SM (q172298_pow SR r n) x).

Definition q172298_colon_radical_equal
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (N P : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM) : Prop :=
  forall r : R,
    q172298_colon_radical_member N r <->
    q172298_colon_radical_member P r.

Definition q172298_pairwise_distinct_colon_radicals
    {R M : Type}
    {SR : q172298_comm_semiring R}
    {AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M}
    {SM : q172298_module SR AM}
    (family : @q172298_finite_submodules R M SR AM SM) : Prop :=
  forall I J : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM,
    q172298_submodule_in I (q172298_elements family) ->
    q172298_submodule_in J (q172298_elements family) ->
    ~ q172298_submodule_equal I J ->
    ~ q172298_colon_radical_equal I J.

Theorem Ideal_isPrimary_decomposition_pairwise_ne_radical :
  forall (R M : Type)
         (SR : q172298_comm_semiring R)
         (AM : q172298_add_comm_monoid M)
         (SM : q172298_module SR AM)
         (N : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM)
         (s : @q172298_finite_submodules R M SR AM SM),
    q172298_infimum_equal s N ->
    (forall J : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM,
      q172298_submodule_in J (q172298_elements s) ->
      q172298_is_primary J) ->
    exists t : @q172298_finite_submodules R M SR AM SM,
      q172298_infimum_equal t N /\
      (forall J : @q172298_submodule R M SR AM SM,
        q172298_submodule_in J (q172298_elements t) ->
        q172298_is_primary J) /\
      q172298_pairwise_distinct_colon_radicals t.
Admitted.

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q172298
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q172298), "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite
  primary decomposition of a submodule can be replaced by one with the same
  intersection whose primary components have pairwise distinct radical
  annihilator ideals. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q172298_comm_semiring ::
    "'r::{comm_semiring_0,one} itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q172298_comm_semiring TYPE('r) \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a::'r. 1 * a = a \<and> a * 1 = a)"

fun q172298_pow :: "'r::{one,times} \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'r" where
  "q172298_pow a 0 = 1"
| "q172298_pow a (Suc n) = a * q172298_pow a n"

definition q172298_module ::
    "('r::{comm_semiring_0,one} \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm)
      \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q172298_module smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. smul 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smul (a + b) x = smul a x + smul b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. smul a (x + y) = smul a x + smul a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smul 0 x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. smul a 0 = 0)"

definition q172298_submodule ::
    "('r::{comm_semiring_0,one} \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      'm set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q172298_submodule smul N \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> N \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> N. \<forall>y \<in> N. x + y \<in> N) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>x \<in> N. smul a x \<in> N)"

definition q172298_colon ::
    "('r::{comm_semiring_0,one} \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      'm set \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q172298_colon smul N = {a. \<forall>x. smul a x \<in> N}"

definition q172298_radical ::
    "'r::{comm_semiring_0,one} set \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q172298_radical I = {a. \<exists>n::nat. q172298_pow a n \<in> I}"

definition q172298_primary ::
    "('r::{comm_semiring_0,one} \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm)
      \<Rightarrow>
      'm set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q172298_primary smul Q \<longleftrightarrow>
    q172298_submodule smul Q \<and>
    Q \<noteq> UNIV \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. smul a x \<in> Q \<longrightarrow>
      x \<in> Q \<or> a \<in> q172298_radical (q172298_colon smul Q))"

theorem primary_decomposition_pairwise_ne_radical:
  fixes smul ::
      "'r::{comm_semiring_0,one} \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm"
    and N :: "'m set"
    and S :: "'m set set"
  assumes "q172298_comm_semiring TYPE('r)"
    and "q172298_module smul"
    and "q172298_submodule smul N"
    and "finite S"
    and "Inter S = N"
    and "\<forall>Q \<in> S. q172298_primary smul Q"
  shows "\<exists>T :: 'm set set.
    finite T \<and>
    Inter T = N \<and>
    (\<forall>Q \<in> T. q172298_primary smul Q) \<and>
    (\<forall>I \<in> T. \<forall>J \<in> T. I \<noteq> J \<longrightarrow>
      q172298_radical (q172298_colon smul I) \<noteq>
        q172298_radical (q172298_colon smul J))"
  sorry

end

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q172298,
  "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite primary decomposition of a submodule over
  a commutative semiring can be replaced by one whose component annihilator
  ideals have pairwise distinct radicals. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q172298_LASKER_NOETHER_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_semiring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R).
       (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
       (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
       (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
       (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
       (!a. mulR zeroR a = zeroR) /\
       (!a b. mulR a b = mulR b a) /\
       (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
       (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) =
                  addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) in
   let is_module =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (zeroM:M) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M).
       (!x. addM zeroM x = x) /\
       (!x y. addM x y = addM y x) /\
       (!x y z. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) /\
       (!a. smul a zeroM = zeroM) /\
       (!a x y. smul a (addM x y) =
                  addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x. smul zeroR x = zeroM) /\
       (!x. smul oneR x = x) /\
       (!a b x. smul (addR a b) x =
                   addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b x. smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) in
   let is_submodule =
     \(zeroM:M) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M) (J:M->bool).
       J zeroM /\
       (!x y. J x /\ J y ==> J (addM x y)) /\
       (!a x. J x ==> J (smul a x)) in
   let submodule_inf =
     \(family:(M->bool)->bool). \x:M. !J. family J ==> J x in
   let powerR =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (a:R) (n:num).
       ITLIST mulR (REPLICATE n a) oneR in
   let radical_colon =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (smul:R->M->M)
      (J:M->bool) (a:R).
       ?n:num. !x:M. J (smul (powerR oneR mulR a n) x) in
   let is_primary =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (smul:R->M->M) (J:M->bool).
       ~(J = (\x:M. T)) /\
       (!a:R. !x:M.
          J (smul a x)
          ==> J x \/ radical_colon oneR mulR smul J a) in
   !zeroR:R. !oneR:R. !addR:R->R->R. !mulR:R->R->R.
   !zeroM:M. !addM:M->M->M. !smul:R->M->M.
   !N:M->bool. !s:(M->bool)->bool.
     is_comm_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
     is_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM smul /\
     is_submodule zeroM addM smul N /\
     FINITE s /\
     (!J:M->bool. s J ==> is_submodule zeroM addM smul J) /\
     submodule_inf s = N /\
     (!J:M->bool.
        s J ==> is_primary oneR mulR smul J)
     ==> ?t:(M->bool)->bool.
           FINITE t /\
           (!J:M->bool. t J ==> is_submodule zeroM addM smul J) /\
           submodule_inf t = N /\
           (!J:M->bool.
              t J ==> is_primary oneR mulR smul J) /\
           (!I J:M->bool.
              t I /\ t J /\ ~(I = J)
              ==> ~(radical_colon oneR mulR smul I =
                    radical_colon oneR mulR smul J))`;;

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q172298,
;; "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite primary decomposition of a submodule can
;; be replaced by one whose colon-ideal radicals are pairwise distinct. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent the arbitrary semiring and module carriers,
;; their operations, and arbitrary submodule membership predicates. Finite
;; lists represent Finsets, with extensional equality used for submodules.

(defun q172298-member-p (predicate value)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list value))
      t
    nil))

(defun q172298-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun q172298-ring-add (addition left right)
  (q172298-binary-value addition left right))

(defun q172298-ring-mul (multiplication left right)
  (q172298-binary-value multiplication left right))

(defun q172298-module-add (addition left right)
  (q172298-binary-value addition left right))

(defun q172298-smul (scalar-action scalar vector)
  (q172298-binary-value scalar-action scalar vector))

(defun-sk q172298-commutative-semiring-laws-p
    (ring-carrier ring-zero ring-one ring-addition ring-multiplication)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q172298-member-p ring-carrier x)
      (and
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-add ring-addition x ring-zero)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-add ring-addition ring-zero x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x ring-one)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication ring-one x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x ring-zero)
        ring-zero)
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication ring-zero x)
        ring-zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier x)
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier y))
      (and
       (q172298-member-p
        ring-carrier
        (q172298-ring-add ring-addition x y))
       (q172298-member-p
        ring-carrier
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x y))
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-add ring-addition x y)
        (q172298-ring-add ring-addition y x))
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x y)
        (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier x)
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier y)
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-add
         ring-addition
         (q172298-ring-add ring-addition x y)
         z)
        (q172298-ring-add
         ring-addition
         x
         (q172298-ring-add ring-addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul
         ring-multiplication
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x y)
         z)
        (q172298-ring-mul
         ring-multiplication
         x
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul
         ring-multiplication
         x
         (q172298-ring-add ring-addition y z))
        (q172298-ring-add
         ring-addition
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x y)
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q172298-ring-mul
         ring-multiplication
         (q172298-ring-add ring-addition x y)
         z)
        (q172298-ring-add
         ring-addition
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication x z)
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q172298-commutative-semiring-p
    (ring-carrier ring-zero ring-one ring-addition ring-multiplication)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ring-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp ring-addition)
   (tamep-functionp ring-multiplication)
   (q172298-member-p ring-carrier ring-zero)
   (q172298-member-p ring-carrier ring-one)
   (q172298-commutative-semiring-laws-p
    ring-carrier
    ring-zero
    ring-one
    ring-addition
    ring-multiplication)))

(defun-sk q172298-module-laws-p
    (ring-carrier
     ring-zero
     ring-one
     ring-addition
     ring-multiplication
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     scalar-action)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q172298-member-p module-carrier x)
      (and
       (equal
        (q172298-module-add module-addition x module-zero)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-module-add module-addition module-zero x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-smul scalar-action ring-one x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q172298-smul scalar-action ring-zero x)
        module-zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier x)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier y))
      (and
       (q172298-member-p
        module-carrier
        (q172298-module-add module-addition x y))
       (equal
        (q172298-module-add module-addition x y)
        (q172298-module-add module-addition y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier x)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier y)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier z))
      (equal
       (q172298-module-add
        module-addition
        (q172298-module-add module-addition x y)
        z)
       (q172298-module-add
        module-addition
        x
        (q172298-module-add module-addition y z))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier a)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier x))
      (and
       (q172298-member-p
        module-carrier
        (q172298-smul scalar-action a x))
       (equal
        (q172298-smul scalar-action a module-zero)
        module-zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier a)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier x)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier y))
      (equal
       (q172298-smul
        scalar-action
        a
        (q172298-module-add module-addition x y))
       (q172298-module-add
        module-addition
        (q172298-smul scalar-action a x)
        (q172298-smul scalar-action a y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier a)
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier b)
       (q172298-member-p module-carrier x))
      (and
       (equal
        (q172298-smul
         scalar-action
         (q172298-ring-add ring-addition a b)
         x)
        (q172298-module-add
         module-addition
         (q172298-smul scalar-action a x)
         (q172298-smul scalar-action b x)))
       (equal
        (q172298-smul
         scalar-action
         (q172298-ring-mul ring-multiplication a b)
         x)
        (q172298-smul
         scalar-action
         a
         (q172298-smul scalar-action b x))))))))

(defun q172298-module-p
    (ring-carrier
     ring-zero
     ring-one
     ring-addition
     ring-multiplication
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     scalar-action)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp module-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp module-addition)
   (tamep-functionp scalar-action)
   (q172298-member-p module-carrier module-zero)
   (q172298-module-laws-p
    ring-carrier
    ring-zero
    ring-one
    ring-addition
    ring-multiplication
    module-carrier
    module-zero
    module-addition
    scalar-action)))

(defun-sk q172298-submodule-laws-p
    (ring-carrier
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     scalar-action
     submodule)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q172298-member-p submodule x)
      (q172298-member-p module-carrier x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p submodule x)
       (q172298-member-p submodule y))
      (q172298-member-p
       submodule
       (q172298-module-add module-addition x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q172298-member-p ring-carrier a)
       (q172298-member-p submodule x))
      (q172298-member-p
       submodule
       (q172298-smul scalar-action a x))))))

(defun q172298-submodule-p
    (ring-carrier
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     scalar-action
     submodule)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp submodule)
   (q172298-member-p submodule module-zero)
   (q172298-submodule-laws-p
    ring-carrier
    module-carrier
    module-zero
    module-addition
    scalar-action
    submodule)))

(defun-sk q172298-same-submodule-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q172298-member-p left x)
     (q172298-member-p right x))))

(defun q172298-not-same-as-any-p (submodule family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and
       (not
        (q172298-same-submodule-p submodule (car family)))
       (q172298-not-same-as-any-p submodule (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q172298-extensionally-nodup-p (family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and
       (q172298-not-same-as-any-p (car family) (cdr family))
       (q172298-extensionally-nodup-p (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q172298-all-submodules-p
    (ring-carrier
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     scalar-action
     family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and
       (q172298-submodule-p
        ring-carrier
        module-carrier
        module-zero
        module-addition
        scalar-action
        (car family))
       (q172298-all-submodules-p
        ring-carrier
        module-carrier
        module-zero
        module-addition
        scalar-action
        (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q172298-finite-submodules-p
    (ring-carrier
     module-carrier
     module-zero
     module-addition
     scalar-action
     family)
  (and
   (true-listp family)
   (q172298-all-submodules-p
    ring-carrier
    module-carrier
    module-zero
    module-addition
    scalar-action
    family)
   (q172298-extensionally-nodup-p family)))
