title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q172298,
-- "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite primary decomposition of a submodule can
-- be replaced by one whose colon-ideal radicals are pairwise distinct. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CommutativeSemiring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR zeroR x == zeroR
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

record AdditiveCommutativeMonoid
  {m : Level}
  (M : Set m) :
  Set m where

  field
    zeroM : M
    addM  : M -> M -> M

    add-associative :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : M) ->
      addM zeroM x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x

record Module
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    scale : R -> M -> M

    one-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring) x == x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) ->
      scale (CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring a b) x ==
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) ->
      scale (CommutativeSemiring.addR semiring a b) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale b x)
    scale-add :
      (a : R) (x y : M) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale a y)
    zero-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (CommutativeSemiring.zeroR semiring) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive
    scale-zero :
      (a : R) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive

record Submodule
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    member : M -> Set m
    membership-propositional :
      (x : M) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u == v
    contains-zero :
      member (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : M) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive x y)
    closed-under-scaling :
      (a : R) (x : M) ->
      member x ->
      member (Module.scale module-structure a x)

SubmoduleEqual :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {semiring : CommutativeSemiring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M}
  {module-structure : Module semiring additive} ->
  Submodule semiring additive module-structure ->
  Submodule semiring additive module-structure ->
  Set m
SubmoduleEqual {M = M} left-submodule right-submodule =
  (x : M) ->
  Iff
    (Submodule.member left-submodule x)
    (Submodule.member right-submodule x)

record FiniteSet
  {a e : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (Equivalent : A -> A -> Set e) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc e) where

  field
    size : Nat
    member : A -> Set e
    membership-propositional :
      (x : A) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u == v
    membership-extensional :
      (x y : A) ->
      Equivalent x y ->
      Iff (member x) (member y)
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    enumerate-member :
      (i : Fin size) ->
      member (enumerate i)
    exhaustive :
      (x : A) ->
      member x ->
      Exists (Fin size)
        (\ i -> Equivalent x (enumerate i))
    no-duplicates :
      (i j : Fin size) ->
      Equivalent (enumerate i) (enumerate j) ->
      i == j

power :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power semiring x zero =
  CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring
power semiring x (suc n) =
  CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring x
    (power semiring x n)

RadicalAnnihilator :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) ->
  Submodule semiring additive module-structure ->
  R ->
  Set m
RadicalAnnihilator {M = M}
    semiring additive module-structure submodule scalar =
  Exists Nat
    (\ exponent ->
      (x : M) ->
      Submodule.member submodule
        (Module.scale module-structure
          (power semiring scalar exponent)
          x))

record IsPrimary
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive)
  (submodule : Submodule semiring additive module-structure) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    proper :
      Not ((x : M) -> Submodule.member submodule x)
    primary-condition :
      (scalar : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      Submodule.member submodule
        (Module.scale module-structure scalar x) ->
      Submodule.member submodule x or
      RadicalAnnihilator
        semiring additive module-structure submodule scalar

FiniteSubmodules :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) ->
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m)
FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure =
  FiniteSet
    (Submodule semiring additive module-structure)
    SubmoduleEqual

Intersection :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {semiring : CommutativeSemiring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M}
  {module-structure : Module semiring additive} ->
  FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure ->
  M ->
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m)
Intersection {semiring = semiring}
    {additive = additive}
    {module-structure = module-structure}
    family x =
  (submodule : Submodule semiring additive module-structure) ->
  FiniteSet.member family submodule ->
  Submodule.member submodule x

IntersectionEqual :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {semiring : CommutativeSemiring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M}
  {module-structure : Module semiring additive} ->
  FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure ->
  Submodule semiring additive module-structure ->
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m)
IntersectionEqual {M = M} family submodule =
  (x : M) ->
  Iff
    (Intersection family x)
    (Submodule.member submodule x)

AllPrimary :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) ->
  FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure ->
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m)
AllPrimary semiring additive module-structure family =
  (submodule : Submodule semiring additive module-structure) ->
  FiniteSet.member family submodule ->
  IsPrimary semiring additive module-structure submodule

RadicalEqual :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) ->
  Submodule semiring additive module-structure ->
  Submodule semiring additive module-structure ->
  Set (r ⊔ m)
RadicalEqual {R = R}
    semiring additive module-structure left-submodule right-submodule =
  (scalar : R) ->
  Iff
    (RadicalAnnihilator
      semiring additive module-structure left-submodule scalar)
    (RadicalAnnihilator
      semiring additive module-structure right-submodule scalar)

PairwiseDistinctRadicals :
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) ->
  FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure ->
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m)
PairwiseDistinctRadicals
    semiring additive module-structure family =
  (left-submodule right-submodule :
    Submodule semiring additive module-structure) ->
  FiniteSet.member family left-submodule ->
  FiniteSet.member family right-submodule ->
  Not (SubmoduleEqual left-submodule right-submodule) ->
  Not
    (RadicalEqual
      semiring additive module-structure
      left-submodule right-submodule)

-- Lean: Ideal.isPrimary_decomposition_pairwise_ne_radical
lasker-noether-theorem : Setω
lasker-noether-theorem =
  {r m : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R) ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M) ->
  (module-structure : Module semiring additive) ->
  (N : Submodule semiring additive module-structure) ->
  (s : FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure) ->
  IntersectionEqual s N ->
  AllPrimary semiring additive module-structure s ->
  Exists
    (FiniteSubmodules semiring additive module-structure)
    (\ t ->
      IntersectionEqual t N and
      (AllPrimary semiring additive module-structure t and
      PairwiseDistinctRadicals
        semiring additive module-structure t))

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q172298, "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite primary decomposition of a
  submodule can be replaced by one whose colon-ideal radicals are pairwise
  distinct. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory pred_setTheory;

val q172298_comm_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q172298_comm_semiring_def",
  ``q172298_comm_semiring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a b. mulR a b = mulR b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a. mulR zeroR a = zeroR)``);

val q172298_module_def = new_definition (
  "q172298_module_def",
  ``q172298_module
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!x y. addM x y = addM y x) /\
      (!x y z. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) /\
      (!x. addM zeroM x = x) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (addM x y) = addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroM = zeroM) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addR a b) x = addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!x. smul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x. smul zeroR x = zeroM)``);

val q172298_submodule_def = new_definition (
  "q172298_submodule_def",
  ``q172298_submodule
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (N : 'm set) <=>
      zeroM IN N /\
      (!x y. x IN N /\ y IN N ==> addM x y IN N) /\
      (!a x. x IN N ==> smul a x IN N)``);

val q172298_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q172298_pow_def",
  ``q172298_pow (oneR : 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (a : 'r) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (mulR a) n oneR``);

val q172298_radical_colon_def = new_definition (
  "q172298_radical_colon_def",
  ``q172298_radical_colon
      (oneR : 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (N : 'm set) (a : 'r) <=>
      ?n : num.
        !x : 'm. smul (q172298_pow oneR mulR a n) x IN N``);

val q172298_primary_def = new_definition (
  "q172298_primary_def",
  ``q172298_primary
      (oneR : 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (N : 'm set) <=>
      q172298_submodule zeroM addM smul N /\
      ~(!x : 'm. x IN N) /\
      (!a : 'r. !x : 'm.
        smul a x IN N
        ==>
        x IN N \/ q172298_radical_colon oneR mulR smul N a)``);

val isPrimary_decomposition_pairwise_ne_radical =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (N : 'm set) (s : ('m set) set).
      q172298_comm_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
      q172298_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM smul /\
      q172298_submodule zeroM addM smul N /\
      FINITE s /\
      (!J. J IN s ==>
        q172298_primary oneR mulR zeroM addM smul J) /\
      (!x. x IN N <=> !J. J IN s ==> x IN J)
      ==>
      ?t : ('m set) set.
        FINITE t /\
        (!x. x IN N <=> !J. J IN t ==> x IN J) /\
        (!J. J IN t ==>
          q172298_primary oneR mulR zeroM addM smul J) /\
        (!I J.
          I IN t /\ J IN t /\ I <> J
          ==>
          ?a : 'r.
            q172298_radical_colon oneR mulR smul I a <>
            q172298_radical_colon oneR mulR smul J a)``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q172298
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q172298), "Lasker--Noether theorem": every
  finite primary decomposition of a submodule over a commutative-semiring
  semimodule can be replaced by one with the same intersection and pairwise
  distinct radicals of its full-module colon ideals. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's SLMod supplies arbitrary semimodules over arbitrary semirings.
  Requiring the multiplicative monoid of Scalar(W) to be commutative gives
  exactly the source's commutative-semiring scalar domain.

  Q172298Submodules W is the set of subsets of Base(W) containing zero and
  closed under vector addition and scalar multiplication. Q172298Inf W s is
  the intersection of the finite family s inside Base(W), including Base(W)
  for the empty family. Q172298Colon W J is the ideal of scalars sending every
  vector into J, exactly J.colon Set.univ in the Lean source, and
  Q172298Radical R I is the usual ideal radical defined by membership of a
  natural power. Q172298Primary W J is the source definition of a proper
  primary submodule.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q172298Submodules Q172298Inf Q172298Colon Q172298Radical
   Q172298Primary $.

q172298-submodules-syntax $a class ( Q172298Submodules W ) $.
q172298-inf-syntax $a class ( Q172298Inf W s ) $.
q172298-colon-syntax $a class ( Q172298Colon W J ) $.
q172298-radical-syntax $a class ( Q172298Radical R I ) $.
q172298-primary-syntax $a wff ( Q172298Primary W J ) $.

${
  $d J W r x y $.

  q172298-submodules-definition $a |- ( Q172298Submodules W ) =
    {
      J e. ~P ( Base ` W ) |
        (
          ( 0g ` W ) e. J
          /\
          (
            A. x e. J A. y e. J
              ( x ( +g ` W ) y ) e. J
            /\
            A. r e. ( Base ` ( Scalar ` W ) )
              A. x e. J
                ( r ( .s ` W ) x ) e. J
          )
        )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d J W s x $.

  q172298-inf-definition $a |- ( Q172298Inf W s ) =
    {
      x e. ( Base ` W ) |
        A. J e. s x e. J
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d J W r x $.

  q172298-colon-definition $a |- ( Q172298Colon W J ) =
    {
      r e. ( Base ` ( Scalar ` W ) ) |
        A. x e. ( Base ` W )
          ( r ( .s ` W ) x ) e. J
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d I R n r $.

  q172298-radical-definition $a |- ( Q172298Radical R I ) =
    {
      r e. ( Base ` R ) |
        E. n e. NN0
          ( n ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) ) r ) e. I
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d J W r x $.

  q172298-primary-definition $a |- (
    ( Q172298Primary W J )
    <->
    (
      J e. ( Q172298Submodules W )
      /\
      (
        J =/= ( Base ` W )
        /\
        A. r e. ( Base ` ( Scalar ` W ) )
          A. x e. ( Base ` W )
            (
              ( r ( .s ` W ) x ) e. J
              ->
              (
                x e. J
                \/
                r e.
                  (
                    Q172298Radical
                    ( Scalar ` W )
                    ( Q172298Colon W J )
                  )
              )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I J N W s t $.

  thousand-theorems-q172298-primary-decomposition-distinct-radicals $a |-
    A. W
      (
        (
          W e. SLMod
          /\
          ( mulGrp ` ( Scalar ` W ) ) e. CMnd
        )
        ->
        A. N e. ( Q172298Submodules W )
          A. s
            (
              (
                (
                  s e. Fin
                  /\
                  s C_ ( Q172298Submodules W )
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( Q172298Inf W s ) = N
                  /\
                  A. J e. s ( Q172298Primary W J )
                )
              )
              ->
              E. t
                (
                  (
                    t e. Fin
                    /\
                    t C_ ( Q172298Submodules W )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q172298Inf W t ) = N
                    /\
                    (
                      A. J e. t ( Q172298Primary W J )
                      /\
                      A. I e. t A. J e. t
                        (
                          I =/= J
                          ->
                          (
                            Q172298Radical
                            ( Scalar ` W )
                            ( Q172298Colon W I )
                          )
                          =/=
                          (
                            Q172298Radical
                            ( Scalar ` W )
                            ( Q172298Colon W J )
                          )
                        )
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
      )
  $.
$}

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1, REAL_1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
      COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, ALGSTR_0, BINOP_1, VECTSP_1, LATTICES, XBOOLE_0,
      SUBSET_1, ARYTM_1, RELAT_1, ARYTM_3, RLSUB_1, SUPINF_2, GROUP_1,

      FUNCT_2, FINSET_1, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
      XREAL_0, INT_1, NAT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, DOMAIN_1, BINOP_1,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being unital non empty doubleLoopStr,
      M being non empty ModuleStr over R,
      N being Subset of M,
      S being finite Subset of bool the carrier of M
  st
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      (a+b)+c = a+(b+c) & a+b = b+a & a+0.R = a &
      a+(-a) = 0.R & (-a)+a = 0.R &
      (a*b)*c = a*(b*c) & a*b = b*a &
      a*1.R = a & 1.R*a = a &
      a*(b+c) = a*b+a*c & (a+b)*c = a*c+b*c) &
    (for r being Element of R holds
      r * 0.R = 0.R & 0.R * r = 0.R) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of M holds
      (x+y)+z = x+(y+z) & x+y = y+x & x+0.M = x &
      x+(-x) = 0.M & (-x)+x = 0.M) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, x,y being Element of M holds
      a*(x+y) = a*x+a*y & (a+b)*x = a*x+b*x &
      (a*b)*x = a*(b*x) & 1.R*x = x) &
    (for r being Element of R, x being Element of M holds
      r*0.M = 0.M & 0.R*x = 0.M) &
    0.M in N &
    (for x,y being Element of M st x in N & y in N holds x+y in N) &
    (for r being Element of R, x being Element of M st x in N
      holds r*x in N) &
    N = {x where x is Element of M :
      for P being Subset of M st P in S holds x in P} &
    (for P being Subset of M st P in S holds
      0.M in P &
      (for x,y being Element of M st x in P & y in P holds x+y in P) &
      (for r being Element of R, x being Element of M st x in P
        holds r*x in P) &
      P <> the carrier of M &
      (for r being Element of R, x being Element of M st r*x in P
        holds x in P or
          ex n being Nat st
            for y being Element of M holds (r|^n)*y in P))
  holds
    ex T being finite Subset of bool the carrier of M st
      N = {x where x is Element of M :
        for P being Subset of M st P in T holds x in P} &
      (for P being Subset of M st P in T holds
        0.M in P &
        (for x,y being Element of M st x in P & y in P holds x+y in P) &
        (for r being Element of R, x being Element of M st x in P
          holds r*x in P) &
        P <> the carrier of M &
        (for r being Element of R, x being Element of M st r*x in P
          holds x in P or
            ex n being Nat st
              for y being Element of M holds (r|^n)*y in P)) &
      (for P,Q being Subset of M st
        P in T & Q in T & P <> Q
      holds
        {r where r is Element of R :
          ex n being Nat st
            for x being Element of M holds (r|^n)*x in P}
        <>
        {r where r is Element of R :
          ex n being Nat st
            for x being Element of M holds (r|^n)*x in Q})
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q172298,
% "Lasker–Noether theorem": a finite primary decomposition of a submodule can
% be replaced by one with the same intersection whose colon-ideal radicals are
% pairwise distinct. This file contains no proof.

Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem[
  R: TYPE+,
  M: TYPE+,
  zeroR, oneR: R,
  addR, mulR: [R, R -> R],
  zeroM: M,
  addM: [M, M -> M],
  smul: [R, M -> M]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  submodule: TYPE = [M -> bool]
  ideal: TYPE = [R -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[submodule]

  commutative_semiring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: R):
      addR(a, b) = addR(b, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      addR(addR(a, b), c) = addR(a, addR(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      addR(zeroR, a) = a
        AND addR(a, zeroR) = a)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: R):
      mulR(a, b) = mulR(b, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      mulR(mulR(a, b), c) = mulR(a, mulR(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      mulR(oneR, a) = a
        AND mulR(a, oneR) = a)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      mulR(a, addR(b, c)) =
        addR(mulR(a, b), mulR(a, c))
        AND
      mulR(addR(a, b), c) =
        addR(mulR(a, c), mulR(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      mulR(zeroR, a) = zeroR
        AND mulR(a, zeroR) = zeroR)

  additive_commutative_monoid_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      addM(x, y) = addM(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
      addM(addM(x, y), z) = addM(x, addM(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      addM(zeroM, x) = x
        AND addM(x, zeroM) = x)

  module_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_monoid_laws
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R), (x, y: M):
      smul(a, addM(x, y)) =
        addM(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
      smul(addR(a, b), x) =
        addM(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
      smul(mulR(a, b), x) =
        smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      smul(oneR, x) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      smul(zeroR, x) = zeroM)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R):
      smul(a, zeroM) = zeroM)

  is_submodule(N: submodule): bool =
    N(zeroM)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      N(x) AND N(y) IMPLIES N(addM(x, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R), (x: M):
      N(x) IMPLIES N(smul(a, x)))

  power(a: R, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      oneR
    ELSE
      mulR(power(a, exponent - 1), a)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  colon(N: submodule): ideal =
    LAMBDA (a: R):
      FORALL (x: M): N(smul(a, x))

  radical(I: ideal): ideal =
    LAMBDA (a: R):
      EXISTS (exponent: nat):
        I(power(a, exponent))

  full_submodule: submodule =
    LAMBDA (x: M): TRUE

  is_primary(Q: submodule): bool =
    is_submodule(Q)
      AND Q /= full_submodule
      AND
    (FORALL (a: R), (x: M):
      Q(smul(a, x)) IMPLIES
        Q(x)
          OR
        (EXISTS (exponent: nat):
          FORALL (y: M):
            Q(smul(power(a, exponent), y))))

  finite_infimum(family: finite_set[submodule]): submodule =
    LAMBDA (x: M):
      FORALL (Q: submodule):
        member(Q, family) IMPLIES Q(x)

  pairwise_distinct_colon_radicals(
      family: finite_set[submodule]): bool =
    FORALL (I, J: submodule):
      member(I, family)
        AND member(J, family)
        AND I /= J
      IMPLIES radical(colon(I)) /= radical(colon(J))

  isPrimary_decomposition_pairwise_ne_radical: bool =
    (commutative_semiring_laws AND module_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (N: submodule),
          (s: finite_set[submodule]):
        is_submodule(N)
          AND finite_infimum(s) = N
          AND
        (FORALL (Q: submodule):
          member(Q, s) IMPLIES is_primary(Q))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (t: finite_set[submodule]):
            finite_infimum(t) = N
              AND
            (FORALL (Q: submodule):
              member(Q, t) IMPLIES is_primary(Q))
              AND pairwise_distinct_colon_radicals(t)
END Q172298_lasker_noether_theorem

title: Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1727461
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1727461), "Intersecting secants theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, two secants through a common
  point and meeting four cospherical points have equal products of distances
  from that point to their endpoints. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q1727461_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q1727461_zero : V;
  q1727461_add : V -> V -> V;
  q1727461_neg : V -> V;
  q1727461_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q1727461_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q1727461_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1727461_add x (q1727461_add y z) =
      q1727461_add (q1727461_add x y) z;
  q1727461_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q1727461_add x y = q1727461_add y x;
  q1727461_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q1727461_add x q1727461_zero = x;
  q1727461_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q1727461_add x (q1727461_neg x) = q1727461_zero;

  q1727461_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q1727461_smul 1 x = x;
  q1727461_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1727461_smul (a * b) x =
      q1727461_smul a (q1727461_smul b x);
  q1727461_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1727461_smul a (q1727461_add x y) =
      q1727461_add (q1727461_smul a x) (q1727461_smul a y);
  q1727461_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1727461_smul (a + b) x =
      q1727461_add (q1727461_smul a x) (q1727461_smul b x);

  q1727461_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1727461_inner (q1727461_add x y) z =
      q1727461_inner x z + q1727461_inner y z;
  q1727461_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1727461_inner (q1727461_smul a x) y =
      a * q1727461_inner x y;
  q1727461_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q1727461_inner x y = q1727461_inner y x;
  q1727461_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q1727461_inner x x;
  q1727461_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q1727461_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q1727461_zero
}.

Arguments q1727461_zero {V} _.
Arguments q1727461_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1727461_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q1727461_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1727461_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q1727461_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q1727461_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q1727461_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q1727461_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q1727461_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q1727461_vadd (q1727461_zero E) p = p;
  q1727461_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q1727461_vadd (q1727461_add E x y) p =
      q1727461_vadd x (q1727461_vadd y p);
  q1727461_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q1727461_vsub (q1727461_vadd x p) p = x;
  q1727461_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q1727461_vadd (q1727461_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q1727461_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q1727461_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q1727461_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q1727461_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q1727461_inner E x x).

Definition q1727461_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q1727461_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q1727461_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q1727461_norm E (q1727461_vsub A p q).

Definition q1727461_cospherical_four
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q1727461_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q1727461_affine_torsor V P E)
    (a b c d : P) : Prop :=
  exists (center : P) (radius : R),
    q1727461_dist A a center = radius /\
    q1727461_dist A b center = radius /\
    q1727461_dist A c center = radius /\
    q1727461_dist A d center = radius.

Definition q1727461_angle
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q1727461_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q1727461_affine_torsor V P E)
    (a p b : P) : R :=
  let x := q1727461_vsub A a p in
  let y := q1727461_vsub A b p in
  acos
    (q1727461_inner E x y /
      (q1727461_norm E x * q1727461_norm E y)).

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_mul_dist_eq_mul_dist_of_cospherical_of_angle_eq_zero :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q1727461_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q1727461_affine_torsor V P E)
         (a b c d p : P),
    q1727461_cospherical_four A a b c d ->
    a <> b ->
    c <> d ->
    q1727461_angle A a p b = 0 ->
    q1727461_angle A c p d = 0 ->
    q1727461_dist A a p * q1727461_dist A b p =
      q1727461_dist A c p * q1727461_dist A d p.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1727461 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1727461), "Intersecting secants
  theorem": four cospherical points on two nondegenerate zero-angle secants
  through a point have equal products of distances to that point. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1727461,
  "Intersecting secants theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine
  space, two same-direction secants through a common point and with
  cospherical endpoints have equal products of endpoint distances. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q1727461_INTERSECTING_SECANTS_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!q:P. vadd zero q = q) /\
       (!v w:V. !q:P.
          vadd (add v w) q = vadd v (vadd w q)) /\
       (!v:V. !q:P. vsub (vadd v q) q = v) /\
       (!q r:P. vadd (vsub q r) r = q) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (q:P) (r:P).
       norm inner (vsub q r) in
  let zero_angle =
    \(zero:V) (inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (q1:P) (q2:P) (q3:P).
       ~(vsub q1 q2 = zero) /\
       ~(vsub q3 q2 = zero) /\
       inner (vsub q1 q2) (vsub q3 q2) =
         norm inner (vsub q1 q2) * norm inner (vsub q3 q2) in
  let cospherical_four =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (a:P) (b:P) (c:P) (d:P).
       ?center:P. ?radius:real.
         distance inner vsub a center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub b center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub c center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub d center = radius in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !a b c d p:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    cospherical_four inner vsub a b c d /\
    ~(a = b) /\
    ~(c = d) /\
    zero_angle zero inner vsub a p b /\
    zero_angle zero inner vsub c p d
    ==>
    distance inner vsub a p * distance inner vsub b p =
    distance inner vsub c p * distance inner vsub d p`;;

       real vector-space point-space a center)
      (q1727461-squared-distance
       real vector-space point-space c center))
     (equal
      (q1727461-squared-distance
       real vector-space point-space a center)
      (q1727461-squared-distance

;; With distinct endpoints, Mathlib's unoriented angle at p is zero exactly

(defun-sk q1727461-angle-zero-p
    (real vector-space point-space left vertex right)
  (exists (scale)
    (let ((left-vector
           (q1727461-vsub

;; the source products of distances because all distances are nonnegative.
(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q1727461-intersecting-secants-theorem-statement
    (real vector-space point-space)
  (forall (a b c d p)
    (implies
     (and

      (q1727461-p-member-p point-space a)
      (q1727461-p-member-p point-space b)
      (q1727461-p-member-p point-space c)
      (q1727461-p-member-p point-space d)
      (q1727461-p-member-p point-space p)
      (q1727461-cospherical-four-p
       real vector-space point-space a b c d)
      (not (equal a b))
      (not (equal c d))
      (q1727461-angle-zero-p
       real vector-space point-space a p b)
      (q1727461-angle-zero-p
       real vector-space point-space c p d))
     (equal
      (q1727461-r-mul

        real vector-space point-space a p)
       (q1727461-squared-distance
        real vector-space point-space b p))
      (q1727461-r-mul
       real
       (q1727461-squared-distance
        real vector-space point-space c p)
       (q1727461-squared-distance
        real vector-space point-space d p))))))

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) and (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictPositive reals x =
  (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) and
  (x != zeroR reals)

record RealInnerProductAngleSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm v)
    norm-square :
      (v : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm v) (norm v) == inner v v

    vectorAngle : V -> V -> R
    angle-zero-characterization :
      (u v : V) ->
      Iff
        (vectorAngle u v == zeroR reals)
        ((u != zeroV) and
          ((v != zeroV) and
            Exists R
              (\ scale ->
                (StrictPositive reals scale) and
                (u == scaleV scale v))))

open RealInnerProductAngleSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine p q =
  norm space (vsub affine p q)

angleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
angleAt {space = space} affine a p b =
  vectorAngle space
    (vsub affine a p)
    (vsub affine b p)

CosphericalFour :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
CosphericalFour {R} {P = P} reals space affine a b c d =
  Exists P
    (\ center ->
      (distance affine a center == distance affine b center)
      and
      ((distance affine a center == distance affine c center)
      and
      (distance affine a center == distance affine d center)))

intersecting-secants-theorem : Set1
intersecting-secants-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b c d p : P) ->
  CosphericalFour reals space affine a b c d ->
  a != b ->
  c != d ->
  angleAt affine a p b == zeroR reals ->
  angleAt affine c p d == zeroR reals ->
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine a p)
    (distance affine b p)
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine c p)
    (distance affine d p)

title: Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1727461 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1727461), "Intersecting secants
  theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, two pairs of
  distinct cospherical points lying on same-direction rays from a point have
  equal products of their distances from that point. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q1727461_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1727461_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q1727461_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q1727461_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q1727461_norm_def",
  ``q1727461_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q1727461_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q1727461_dist_def",
  ``q1727461_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q1727461_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q1727461_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q1727461_angle_def",
  ``q1727461_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p)
      (z : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub x y) (vsub z y) /
          (q1727461_norm inner (vsub x y) *
           q1727461_norm inner (vsub z y)))``);

val q1727461_cospherical_four_def = new_definition (
  "q1727461_cospherical_four_def",
  ``q1727461_cospherical_four
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a : 'p)
      (b : 'p)
      (c : 'p)
      (d : 'p) <=>
      ?centre : 'p. ?radius : real.
        q1727461_dist inner vsub a centre = radius /\
        q1727461_dist inner vsub b centre = radius /\
        q1727461_dist inner vsub c centre = radius /\
        q1727461_dist inner vsub d centre = radius``);

val mul_dist_eq_mul_dist_of_cospherical_of_angle_eq_zero =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a b c d p : 'p).
      q1727461_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q1727461_cospherical_four inner vsub a b c d /\
      a <> b /\
      c <> d /\
      q1727461_angle inner vsub a p b = 0 /\
      q1727461_angle inner vsub c p d = 0
      ==>
      q1727461_dist inner vsub a p *
          q1727461_dist inner vsub b p =
        q1727461_dist inner vsub c p *
          q1727461_dist inner vsub d p``;

title: Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1727461
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1727461), "Intersecting secants theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, two zero-angle secants
  through four cospherical points have equal products of distances from
  their common point. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces. The predicate
  W Q1727461RealInnerProductSpace explicitly requires a generalized
  pre-Hilbert structure over RRfld, the normed-module laws, and the defining
  equality between the norm and the square root of the self inner product.
  It is therefore the SetMM rendering of the source NormedAddCommGroup and
  InnerProductSpace real typeclass package, without a finite-dimensionality
  restriction. Choosing the common point P as an affine origin identifies
  the source normed affine torsor with this vector presentation while
  preserving differences, distances, angles, and spheres.

  W Q1727461Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q1727461Dist A B is its
  norm, and W Q1727461Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When
  either ray is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention;
  otherwise it is the arccosine of the normalized inner product.

  W Q1727461Cospherical A B C D states that the four points have a common
  center and a common nonnegative real distance from it. This is equivalent
  to the source predicate Cospherical {A, B, C, D}.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit
  bidirectional definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  Q1727461RealInnerProductSpace
  Q1727461Ray Q1727461Dist Q1727461Angle Q1727461Cospherical
$.

q1727461-real-inner-product-space-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q1727461RealInnerProductSpace ) $.
q1727461-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q1727461Ray A B ) $.
q1727461-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q1727461Dist A B ) $.
q1727461-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q1727461Angle A B C ) $.
q1727461-cospherical-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q1727461Cospherical A B C D ) $.

${
  $d W x $.

  q1727461-real-inner-product-space-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q1727461RealInnerProductSpace )
    <->
    (
      (
        W e. PreHil
        /\
        W e. NrmMod
      )
      /\
      (
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
        /\
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          =
          (
            x e. ( Base ` W ) |->
              ( sqrt ` ( x ( .i ` W ) x ) )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

q1727461-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q1727461Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q1727461-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q1727461Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q1727461Ray A B )
) $.

q1727461-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q1727461Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q1727461Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q1727461Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q1727461Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q1727461Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q1727461Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q1727461Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D O R W $.

  q1727461-cospherical-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q1727461Cospherical A B C D )
    <->
    E. O e. ( Base ` W )
      E. R e. RR
        (
          0 <_ R
          /\
          (
            ( ( W Q1727461Dist A O ) = R )
            /\
            (
              ( ( W Q1727461Dist B O ) = R )
              /\
              (
                ( ( W Q1727461Dist C O ) = R )
                /\
                ( ( W Q1727461Dist D O ) = R )
              )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D P W $.

  thousand-theorems-q1727461-intersecting-secants $a |- A. W
    (
      ( W Q1727461RealInnerProductSpace )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            A. D e. ( Base ` W )
              A. P e. ( Base ` W )
                (
                  (
                    ( W Q1727461Cospherical A B C D )
                    /\
                    (
                      A =/= B
                      /\
                      (
                        C =/= D
                        /\
                        (
                          ( W Q1727461Angle A P B ) = 0
                          /\
                          ( W Q1727461Angle C P D ) = 0
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      ( W Q1727461Dist A P )
                      x.
                      ( W Q1727461Dist B P )
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      ( W Q1727461Dist C P )
                      x.
                      ( W Q1727461Dist D P )
                    )
                  )
                )
    )
  $.
$}

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of "Intersecting secants theorem" from
:: Thousand Theorems artifact Q1727461
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q1727461). Four cospherical points in a real
:: inner-product affine space, forming two distinct endpoint pairs whose rays

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, BHSP_1, PRE_TOPC, SUBSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FUNCT_1, RELAT_1,

::$P-
theorem

      ||.O-A.|| = radius & ||.O-B.|| = radius &
      ||.O-C.|| = radius & ||.O-D.|| = radius) &

title: Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1727461
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1727461), "Intersecting secants theorem": cospherical
% points forming two distinct endpoint pairs on same-direction rays from a
% common point have equal products of distances to that point. This file
% contains no proof.

Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  squared_distance(p, q: P): real =
    inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  distance_value(length: real, p, q: P): bool =
    0 <= length
      AND length * length = squared_distance(p, q)

  on_sphere(p, center: P, radius: real): bool =
    distance_value(radius, p, center)

  cospherical(a, b, c, d: P): bool =
    EXISTS (center: P), (radius: real):
      on_sphere(a, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(b, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(c, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(d, center, radius)

  angle_at_is_zero(a, p, b: P): bool =
    EXISTS (pa, pb: real):
      distance_value(pa, a, p)
        AND distance_value(pb, b, p)
        AND 0 < pa
        AND 0 < pb
        AND inner(vsub(a, p), vsub(b, p)) = pa * pb

  distance_product_identity(a, b, c, d, p: P): bool =
    EXISTS (ap, bp, cp, dp: real):
      distance_value(ap, a, p)
        AND distance_value(bp, b, p)
        AND distance_value(cp, c, p)
        AND distance_value(dp, d, p)
        AND ap * bp = cp * dp

  intersecting_secants_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, c, d, p: P):
        (cospherical(a, b, c, d)
          AND a /= b
          AND c /= d
          AND angle_at_is_zero(a, p, b)
          AND angle_at_is_zero(c, p, d))
        IMPLIES distance_product_identity(a, b, c, d, p)
END Q1727461_intersecting_secants_theorem

    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M] [FiniteDimensional ℝ M]

title: Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1752621
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1752621), "Sylvester's law of inertia": every
  quadratic form on a finite-dimensional real vector space is isometrically
  equivalent to a sum of squares weighted by -1, 0, or 1. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1752621_real_vector_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q1752621_zero : V;
  q1752621_add : V -> V -> V;
  q1752621_neg : V -> V;
  q1752621_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q1752621_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1752621_add x (q1752621_add y z) =
      q1752621_add (q1752621_add x y) z;
  q1752621_add_comm :
    forall x y : V,
      q1752621_add x y = q1752621_add y x;
  q1752621_zero_add :
    forall x : V, q1752621_add q1752621_zero x = x;
  q1752621_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q1752621_add x q1752621_zero = x;
  q1752621_neg_add :
    forall x : V,
      q1752621_add (q1752621_neg x) x = q1752621_zero;
  q1752621_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q1752621_add x (q1752621_neg x) = q1752621_zero;
  q1752621_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q1752621_smul 1 x = x;
  q1752621_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1752621_smul (a * b) x =
      q1752621_smul a (q1752621_smul b x);
  q1752621_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q1752621_smul (a + b) x =
      q1752621_add
        (q1752621_smul a x) (q1752621_smul b x);
  q1752621_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1752621_smul a (q1752621_add x y) =
      q1752621_add
        (q1752621_smul a x) (q1752621_smul a y);
  q1752621_zero_smul :
    forall x : V, q1752621_smul 0 x = q1752621_zero;
  q1752621_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1752621_smul a q1752621_zero = q1752621_zero
}.

Arguments q1752621_zero {V} _.
Arguments q1752621_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q1752621_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q1752621_smul {V} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q1752621_vector_sum
    {V : Type}
    (VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> V) -> V :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> V) -> V with
  | O => fun _ => q1752621_zero VS
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q1752621_add VS
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1752621_vector_sum V VS k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q1752621_vector_sum {V} VS n _.

Fixpoint q1752621_real_sum
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> R) -> R :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> R) -> R with
  | O => fun _ => 0
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        terms Fin.F1 +
        @q1752621_real_sum k (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i))
  end.

Record q1752621_finite_dimensional
    {V : Type}
    (VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V) : Type := {
  q1752621_dimension : nat;
  q1752621_basis : Fin.t q1752621_dimension -> V;
  q1752621_basis_spans :
    forall x : V,
      exists coefficients : Fin.t q1752621_dimension -> R,
        x =
        q1752621_vector_sum VS q1752621_dimension
          (fun i =>
            q1752621_smul VS
              (coefficients i) (q1752621_basis i));
  q1752621_basis_independent :
    forall coefficients : Fin.t q1752621_dimension -> R,
      q1752621_vector_sum VS q1752621_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q1752621_smul VS
            (coefficients i) (q1752621_basis i)) =
      q1752621_zero VS ->
      forall i : Fin.t q1752621_dimension,
        coefficients i = 0
}.

Arguments q1752621_dimension {V VS} _.

Record q1752621_bilinear_form
    {V : Type}
    (VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V) : Type := {
  q1752621_bilinear_apply : V -> V -> R;
  q1752621_bilinear_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1752621_bilinear_apply (q1752621_add VS x y) z =
      q1752621_bilinear_apply x z +
      q1752621_bilinear_apply y z;
  q1752621_bilinear_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1752621_bilinear_apply (q1752621_smul VS a x) y =
      a * q1752621_bilinear_apply x y;
  q1752621_bilinear_add_right :
    forall x y z : V,
      q1752621_bilinear_apply x (q1752621_add VS y z) =
      q1752621_bilinear_apply x y +
      q1752621_bilinear_apply x z;
  q1752621_bilinear_smul_right :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q1752621_bilinear_apply x (q1752621_smul VS a y) =
      a * q1752621_bilinear_apply x y
}.

Arguments q1752621_bilinear_apply {V VS} _ _ _.

Record q1752621_quadratic_form
    {V : Type}
    (VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V) : Type := {
  q1752621_quadratic_apply : V -> R;
  q1752621_quadratic_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : V),
      q1752621_quadratic_apply (q1752621_smul VS a x) =
      (a * a) * q1752621_quadratic_apply x;
  q1752621_quadratic_has_companion :
    exists B : q1752621_bilinear_form VS,
      forall x y : V,
        q1752621_quadratic_apply (q1752621_add VS x y) =
        q1752621_quadratic_apply x +
        q1752621_quadratic_apply y +
        q1752621_bilinear_apply B x y
}.

Arguments q1752621_quadratic_apply {V VS} _ _.

Definition q1752621_quadratic_value
    {V : Type}
    {VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V}
    (Q : q1752621_quadratic_form VS)
    (x : V) : R :=
  q1752621_quadratic_apply Q x.

Record q1752621_linear_equiv_coordinates
    {V : Type}
    (VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V)
    (n : nat) : Type := {
  q1752621_to_coordinates : V -> Fin.t n -> R;
  q1752621_from_coordinates : (Fin.t n -> R) -> V;
  q1752621_from_to :
    forall x : V,
      q1752621_from_coordinates
        (q1752621_to_coordinates x) = x;
  q1752621_to_from :
    forall (coordinates : Fin.t n -> R) (i : Fin.t n),
      q1752621_to_coordinates
        (q1752621_from_coordinates coordinates) i =
      coordinates i;
  q1752621_to_add :
    forall (x y : V) (i : Fin.t n),
      q1752621_to_coordinates
        (q1752621_add VS x y) i =
      q1752621_to_coordinates x i +
      q1752621_to_coordinates y i;
  q1752621_to_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : V) (i : Fin.t n),
      q1752621_to_coordinates
        (q1752621_smul VS a x) i =
      a * q1752621_to_coordinates x i
}.

Arguments q1752621_to_coordinates {V VS n} _ _ _.

Definition q1752621_weighted_sum_squares
    {n : nat}
    (weights coordinates : Fin.t n -> R) : R :=
  @q1752621_real_sum n
    (fun i => weights i * coordinates i * coordinates i).

Definition q1752621_equivalent_to_weighted_sum_squares
    {V : Type}
    {VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V}
    {n : nat}
    (Q : q1752621_quadratic_form VS)
    (weights : Fin.t n -> R) : Prop :=
  exists e : q1752621_linear_equiv_coordinates VS n,
    forall x : V,
      q1752621_quadratic_value Q x =
      q1752621_weighted_sum_squares
        weights (q1752621_to_coordinates e x).

Theorem QuadraticForm_equivalent_one_zero_neg_one_weighted_sum_squared :
  forall (V : Type)
         (VS : q1752621_real_vector_space V)
         (D : q1752621_finite_dimensional VS)
         (Q : q1752621_quadratic_form VS),
    exists weights : Fin.t (q1752621_dimension D) -> R,
      (forall i : Fin.t (q1752621_dimension D),
        weights i = (-1)%R \/
        weights i = 0%R \/
        weights i = 1%R) /\
      q1752621_equivalent_to_weighted_sum_squares Q weights.
Admitted.

title: Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1752621,
  "Sylvester's law of inertia": every quadratic form on a finite-dimensional
  real vector space is equivalent to a diagonal weighted sum of squares whose
  weights are -1, 0, or 1. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q1752621_bilinear ::
    "('e::real_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1752621_bilinear B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y z. B (x + y) z = B x z + B y z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. B (a *\<^sub>R x) y = a * B x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. B x (y + z) = B x y + B x z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. B x (a *\<^sub>R y) = a * B x y)"

definition q1752621_quadratic_form ::
    "('e::real_vector \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1752621_quadratic_form Q \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> real.
      q1752621_bilinear B \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. B x y = B y x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x. Q x = B x x))"

definition q1752621_linear_combination ::
    "('e::real_vector \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q1752621_linear_combination c S =
    (\<Sum>b\<in>S. c b *\<^sub>R b)"

definition q1752621_basis ::
    "'e::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1752621_basis S \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite S \<and>
    (\<forall>c :: 'e \<Rightarrow> real.
      q1752621_linear_combination c S = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>b\<in>S. c b = 0)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>c :: 'e \<Rightarrow> real.
      q1752621_linear_combination c S = x)"

definition q1752621_finite_dimensional ::
    "'e::real_vector itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1752621_finite_dimensional _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>S :: 'e set. q1752621_basis S)"

theorem sylvester_s_law_of_inertia:
  fixes Q :: "'e::real_vector \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes finite_dimensional:
      "q1752621_finite_dimensional TYPE('e)"
    and quadratic_form:
      "q1752621_quadratic_form Q"
  shows "\<exists>S w coord.
    q1752621_basis S \<and>
    (\<forall>b\<in>S. w b = -1 \<or> w b = 0 \<or> w b = 1) \<and>
    (\<forall>x.
      q1752621_linear_combination (coord x) S = x \<and>
      Q x = (\<Sum>b\<in>S. w b * (coord x b)\<^sup>2))"
  sorry

end

title: Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1752621
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q1752621), "Sylvester's law of inertia":
  every quadratic form on a finite-dimensional real vector space has a basis
  in which it is a weighted sum of squares with every weight equal to -1, 0,
  or 1. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1752621_SYLVESTERS_LAW_OF_INERTIA =
 `let real_vector_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
      (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x:V. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
      (!a:real. smul a zero = zero) in
  let symmetric_bilinear =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V) (B:V->V->real).
      (!x y z:V. B (add x y) z = B x z + B y z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V. B (smul a x) y = a * B x y) /\
      (!x y z:V. B x (add y z) = B x y + B x z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V. B x (smul a y) = a * B x y) /\
      (!x y:V. B x y = B y x) in
  let real_quadratic_form =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V) (q:V->real).
      ?B:V->V->real.
        symmetric_bilinear add smul B /\
        (!x:V. q x = B x x) in
  let basis_of_dimension =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (n:num) (basis:num->V).
      (!x:V.
         ?!c:num->real.
           (!i:num. n <= i ==> c i = &0) /\
           x = iterate add {i:num | i < n}
                 (\i:num. smul (c i) (basis i))) in
  let finite_dimensional =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
      ?n:num. ?basis:num->V.
        basis_of_dimension zero add smul n basis in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !q:V->real.
    real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
    real_quadratic_form add smul q /\
    finite_dimensional zero add smul
    ==>
    ?n:num. ?w:num->real. ?diagonal_basis:num->V.
      basis_of_dimension zero add smul n diagonal_basis /\
      (!i:num.
         i < n
         ==> w i = -- &1 \/ w i = &0 \/ w i = &1) /\
      (!c:num->real.
         q (iterate add {i:num | i < n}
              (\i:num. smul (c i) (diagonal_basis i))) =
         sum {i:num | i < n} (\i:num. w i * (c i) pow 2))`;;

title: Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1752621,
;; "Sylvester's law of inertia": every finite-dimensional real quadratic form
;; is linearly equivalent to a weighted sum of squares with weights -1, 0, or
;; 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A finite-dimensional real quadratic form becomes a symmetric matrix after
;; choosing a basis. Its equivalence to a weighted sum of squares is exactly
;; congruence
;;
;;                     A = transpose(T) diag(w) T
;;
;; for an invertible matrix T. The scalar field below is an arbitrary real
;; closed ordered field. Real closed fields have the same first-order theory,
;; so the resulting finite matrix sentence is equivalent to the source
;; statement over the real numbers. The carrier remains unbounded; only the
;; matrices are finite, as required by finite dimensionality.

;; Conservative generic symbols for the scalar field.

(defstub q1752621-scalar-p (x) t)
(defstub q1752621-zero () t)
(defstub q1752621-one () t)
(defstub q1752621-add (x y) t)
(defstub q1752621-mul (x y) t)
(defstub q1752621-neg (x) t)
(defstub q1752621-inv (x) t)
(defstub q1752621-lt (x y) t)

;; Field and order laws.

(defun-sk q1752621-field-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p x)
       (q1752621-scalar-p y))
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p (q1752621-add x y))
       (q1752621-scalar-p (q1752621-mul x y))
       (equal (q1752621-add x y)
              (q1752621-add y x))
       (equal (q1752621-mul x y)
              (q1752621-mul y x))))
     (implies
      (q1752621-scalar-p x)
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p (q1752621-neg x))
       (q1752621-scalar-p (q1752621-inv x))
       (equal (q1752621-add x (q1752621-zero)) x)
       (equal (q1752621-add x (q1752621-neg x))
              (q1752621-zero))
       (equal (q1752621-mul x (q1752621-one)) x)
       (implies
        (not (equal x (q1752621-zero)))
        (equal (q1752621-mul x (q1752621-inv x))
               (q1752621-one)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p x)
       (q1752621-scalar-p y)
       (q1752621-scalar-p z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1752621-add (q1752621-add x y) z)
        (q1752621-add x (q1752621-add y z)))
       (equal
        (q1752621-mul (q1752621-mul x y) z)
        (q1752621-mul x (q1752621-mul y z)))
       (equal
        (q1752621-mul x (q1752621-add y z))
        (q1752621-add
         (q1752621-mul x y)
         (q1752621-mul x z))))))))

(defun q1752621-field-p ()
  (and
   (q1752621-scalar-p (q1752621-zero))
   (q1752621-scalar-p (q1752621-one))
   (not (equal (q1752621-zero) (q1752621-one)))
   (q1752621-field-laws-p)))

(defun-sk q1752621-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1752621-scalar-p x)
      (not (q1752621-lt x x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p x)
       (q1752621-scalar-p y))
      (and
       (or
        (q1752621-lt x y)
        (equal x y)
        (q1752621-lt y x))
       (not
        (and
         (q1752621-lt x y)
         (q1752621-lt y x)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p x)
       (q1752621-scalar-p y)
       (q1752621-scalar-p z)
       (q1752621-lt x y)
       (q1752621-lt y z))
      (q1752621-lt x z))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p x)
       (q1752621-scalar-p y)
       (q1752621-scalar-p z)
       (q1752621-lt x y))
      (q1752621-lt
       (q1752621-add x z)
       (q1752621-add y z)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p x)
       (q1752621-scalar-p y)
       (q1752621-lt (q1752621-zero) x)
       (q1752621-lt (q1752621-zero) y))
      (q1752621-lt
       (q1752621-zero)
       (q1752621-mul x y))))))

(defun q1752621-ordered-field-p ()
  (and
   (q1752621-field-p)
   (q1752621-order-laws-p)
   (q1752621-lt (q1752621-zero) (q1752621-one))))

;; Real-closedness: nonnegative scalars are squares and every odd-degree
;; polynomial has a root. All witnesses remain existential in the statement.

(defun-sk q1752621-has-square-root-p (x)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (q1752621-scalar-p root)
     (equal (q1752621-mul root root) x))))

(defun-sk q1752621-nonnegative-scalars-are-squares-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1752621-scalar-p x)
      (not (q1752621-lt x (q1752621-zero))))
     (q1752621-has-square-root-p x))))

(defun q1752621-scalar-list-p (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1752621-scalar-p (car values))
       (q1752621-scalar-list-p (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1752621-positive-odd-degree-polynomial-p (coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (q1752621-scalar-list-p coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (q1752621-zero)))
   (evenp (len coefficients))))

;; Coefficients are in ascending degree order.

(defun q1752621-polynomial-eval (coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q1752621-add
       (car coefficients)
       (q1752621-mul
        x
        (q1752621-polynomial-eval (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (q1752621-zero)))

(defun-sk q1752621-polynomial-has-root-p (coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (q1752621-scalar-p root)
     (equal
      (q1752621-polynomial-eval coefficients root)
      (q1752621-zero)))))

(defun-sk q1752621-odd-degree-polynomials-have-roots-p ()
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (q1752621-positive-odd-degree-polynomial-p coefficients)
     (q1752621-polynomial-has-root-p coefficients))))

(defun q1752621-real-closed-field-p ()
  (and
   (q1752621-ordered-field-p)
   (q1752621-nonnegative-scalars-are-squares-p)
   (q1752621-odd-degree-polynomials-have-roots-p)))

;; Finite vectors and matrices over the scalar carrier.

(defun q1752621-range-from (start count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (q1752621-range-from (+ 1 start) (- count 1)))))
