title: Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q1752621, "Sylvester's law of inertia": every
-- quadratic form on a finite-dimensional real vector space is linearly
-- equivalent to a weighted sum of squares with weights -1, 0, or 1. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

vectorZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n
vectorZero reals i =
  zeroR reals

vectorAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorAdd reals x y i =
  addR reals (x i) (y i)

vectorScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorScale reals scalar x i =
  multiplyR reals scalar (x i)

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} term =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} term =
  addR reals
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> term (fsuc i)))

record VectorSpace
  {m : Level}
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (M-carrier : Set m) : Set (lsuc m) where
  field
    zeroM : M-carrier
    addM : M-carrier -> M-carrier -> M-carrier
    negateM : M-carrier -> M-carrier
    scaleM : R -> M-carrier -> M-carrier

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M-carrier) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M-carrier) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-zeroM :
      (x : M-carrier) ->
      addM x zeroM == x
    add-inverseM :
      (x : M-carrier) ->
      addM x (negateM x) == zeroM

    scale-oneM :
      (x : M-carrier) ->
      scaleM (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associativeM :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : M-carrier) ->
      scaleM (multiplyR reals a b) x ==
      scaleM a (scaleM b x)
    scale-addM :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : M-carrier) ->
      scaleM a (addM x y) ==
      addM (scaleM a x) (scaleM a y)
    add-scaleM :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : M-carrier) ->
      scaleM (addR reals a b) x ==
      addM (scaleM a x) (scaleM b x)

open VectorSpace

record LinearEquivalence
  {m : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {M : Set m}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : VectorSpace reals M)
  (n : Nat) : Set (lsuc m) where
  field
    coordinates :
      M -> Vector R n
    rebuild :
      Vector R n -> M
    coordinates-after-rebuild :
      (x : Vector R n) ->
      VectorEqual (coordinates (rebuild x)) x
    rebuild-after-coordinates :
      (x : M) ->
      rebuild (coordinates x) == x
    coordinates-add :
      (x y : M) ->
      VectorEqual
        (coordinates (addM space x y))
        (vectorAdd reals (coordinates x) (coordinates y))
    coordinates-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      VectorEqual
        (coordinates (scaleM space a x))
        (vectorScale reals a (coordinates x))

record FiniteDimensional
  {m : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {M : Set m}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : VectorSpace reals M) : Set (lsuc m) where
  field
    dimension :
      Nat
    linear-coordinates :
      LinearEquivalence reals space dimension

open FiniteDimensional

record QuadraticForm
  {m : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {M : Set m}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : VectorSpace reals M) : Set (lsuc m) where
  field
    evaluate :
      M -> R
    associated :
      M -> M -> R
    associated-add-left :
      (x y z : M) ->
      associated (addM space x y) z ==
      addR reals (associated x z) (associated y z)
    associated-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : M) ->
      associated (scaleM space a x) y ==
      multiplyR reals a (associated x y)
    associated-add-right :
      (x y z : M) ->
      associated x (addM space y z) ==
      addR reals (associated x y) (associated x z)
    associated-scale-right :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : M) ->
      associated x (scaleM space a y) ==
      multiplyR reals a (associated x y)
    associated-symmetric :
      (x y : M) ->
      associated x y == associated y x
    evaluate-associated :
      (x : M) ->
      evaluate x == associated x x

open QuadraticForm

weightedSumSquares :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
weightedSumSquares reals weights x =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR reals
        (weights i)
        (multiplyR reals (x i) (x i)))

record Equivalent
  {m : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {M : Set m}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : VectorSpace reals M)
  (quadratic : QuadraticForm reals space)
  (n : Nat)
  (weights : Fin n -> R) : Set (lsuc m) where
  field
    coordinate-change :
      LinearEquivalence reals space n
    preserves-quadratic-form :
      (x : M) ->
      evaluate quadratic x ==
      weightedSumSquares reals weights
        (LinearEquivalence.coordinates coordinate-change x)

WeightIsOneZeroNegOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
WeightIsOneZeroNegOne reals weight =
  Either
    (weight == negateR reals (oneR reals))
    (Either
      (weight == zeroR reals)
      (weight == oneR reals))

record SylvesterNormalForm
  {m : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {M : Set m}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : VectorSpace reals M)
  (finite-dimensional : FiniteDimensional reals space)
  (quadratic : QuadraticForm reals space) : Set (lsuc m) where
  field
    weights :
      Fin (dimension finite-dimensional) -> R
    weights-are-one-zero-neg-one :
      (i : Fin (dimension finite-dimensional)) ->
      WeightIsOneZeroNegOne reals (weights i)
    equivalent-weighted-sum-squares :
      Equivalent reals space quadratic
        (dimension finite-dimensional) weights

sylvesters-law-of-inertia : Setω
sylvesters-law-of-inertia =
  {m : Level} ->
  (R : Set) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : VectorSpace reals M) ->
  (finite-dimensional : FiniteDimensional reals space) ->
  (quadratic : QuadraticForm reals space) ->
  SylvesterNormalForm reals space finite-dimensional quadratic

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1752621, "Sylvester's law of inertia": every
  finite-dimensional real quadratic form is linearly equivalent to a
  diagonal weighted sum of squares whose weights are -1, 0, or 1. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;

val QuadraticForm_equivalent_one_zero_neg_one_weighted_sum_squared =
  ``let matrix_eq =
      \n : num.
      \A B : num -> num -> real.
        !i j : num.
          i < n /\ j < n ==> A i j = B i j
    in
    let matrix_mul =
      \n : num.
      \A B : num -> num -> real.
      \i j : num.
        SIGMA (\k : num. A i k * B k j) (count n)
    in
    let matrix_transpose =
      \A : num -> num -> real.
      \i j : num.
        A j i
    in
    let matrix_one =
      \n : num.
      \i j : num.
        if i < n /\ j < n /\ i = j then 1 else 0
    in
    let matrix_symmetric =
      \n : num.
      \A : num -> num -> real.
        !i j : num.
          i < n /\ j < n ==> A i j = A j i
    in
    let matrix_invertible =
      \n : num.
      \A : num -> num -> real.
        ?Ainv : num -> num -> real.
          matrix_eq n (matrix_mul n A Ainv) (matrix_one n) /\
          matrix_eq n (matrix_mul n Ainv A) (matrix_one n)
    in
    let diagonal =
      \n : num.
      \w : num -> real.
      \i j : num.
        if i < n /\ j < n /\ i = j then w i else 0
    in
      !n : num.
      !A : num -> num -> real.
        matrix_symmetric n A
        ==>
        ?w : num -> real.
        ?P : num -> num -> real.
          (!i : num.
             i < n ==> w i = -1 \/ w i = 0 \/ w i = 1) /\
          matrix_invertible n P /\
          matrix_eq n
            (matrix_mul n (matrix_transpose P)
              (matrix_mul n (diagonal n w) P))
            A``;

title: Q1752621_sylvester_s_law_of_inertia
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
% Q1752621 (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1752621), "Sylvester's law of inertia":
% every quadratic form on a finite-dimensional real vector space is linearly
% equivalent to a weighted sum of squares with weights -1, 0, or 1. This file
% contains no proof.

sylvesters_law_of_inertia_Q1752621[
  n: nat,
  V: TYPE+,
  zeroV: V,
  addV: [V, V -> V],
  negV: [V -> V],
  smulV: [real, V -> V],
  Q: [V -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coordinate_map: TYPE = [V -> real_sequence]
  bilinear_map: TYPE = [V, V -> real]

  zero_sequence: real_sequence =
    (LAMBDA (index: nat): 0)

  sequence_add(x, y: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    (LAMBDA (index: nat): x(index) + y(index))

  sequence_scale(a: real, x: real_sequence): real_sequence =
    (LAMBDA (index: nat): a * x(index))

  supported_below_n(x: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      n <= index IMPLIES x(index) = 0

  real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      real_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V):
      addV(u, v) = addV(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        addV(addV(u, v), w) = addV(u, addV(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        addV(u, zeroV) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        addV(u, negV(u)) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        smulV(a, addV(u, v)) =
          addV(smulV(a, u), smulV(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        smulV(a + b, u) =
          addV(smulV(a, u), smulV(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        smulV(a * b, u) = smulV(a, smulV(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        smulV(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        smulV(0, u) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulV(a, zeroV) = zeroV)

  linear_coordinate_map(T: coordinate_map): bool =
    T(zeroV) = zero_sequence
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V):
        T(addV(u, v)) = sequence_add(T(u), T(v)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u: V):
        T(smulV(a, u)) = sequence_scale(a, T(u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        supported_below_n(T(u)))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V):
        T(u) = T(v) IMPLIES u = v)
      AND (FORALL (x: real_sequence):
        supported_below_n(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (u: V): T(u) = x)

  finite_dimensional_of_dimension_n: bool =
    EXISTS (coordinates: coordinate_map):
      linear_coordinate_map(coordinates)

  symmetric_bilinear(B: bilinear_map): bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      B(addV(u, v), w) = B(u, w) + B(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        B(smulV(a, u), v) = a * B(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V):
        B(u, v) = B(v, u))

  real_quadratic_form: bool =
    EXISTS (B: bilinear_map):
      symmetric_bilinear(B)
        AND (FORALL (v: V): Q(v) = B(v, v))

  weighted_sum_value(
      weights, coordinates: real_sequence): real =
    real_sum(
      (LAMBDA (index: nat):
        weights(index)
          * coordinates(index)
          * coordinates(index)),
      n)

  equivalent_to_weighted_sum_squares(
      T: coordinate_map,
      weights: real_sequence): bool =
    linear_coordinate_map(T)
      AND (FORALL (v: V):
        Q(v) = weighted_sum_value(weights, T(v)))

  sylvesters_law_of_inertia: bool =
    (vector_space_laws
      AND finite_dimensional_of_dimension_n
      AND real_quadratic_form)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS
          (weights: real_sequence),
          (isometry: coordinate_map):
        supported_below_n(weights)
          AND (FORALL (index: nat):
            index < n IMPLIES
              (weights(index) = -1
                OR weights(index) = 0
                OR weights(index) = 1))
          AND equivalent_to_weighted_sum_squares(
            isometry, weights)
END sylvesters_law_of_inertia_Q1752621

module

@[expose] public section

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1766814
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1766814), "Smn theorem": a total computable
  specialization function fixes the first natural-number input of a coded
  partial recursive program. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Arith.Peano_dec.

Module Q1766814_Smn.

Definition nat_pair (a b : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.ltb a b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b.

Definition nat_unpair (n : nat) : nat * nat :=
  let s := Nat.sqrt n in
  if Nat.ltb (n - s * s) s
  then (n - s * s, s)
  else (s, n - s * s - s).

Inductive code : Type :=
| Code_zero : code
| Code_succ : code
| Code_left : code
| Code_right : code
| Code_pair : code -> code -> code
| Code_comp : code -> code -> code
| Code_prec : code -> code -> code
| Code_rfind : code -> code.

Fixpoint code_encode (c : code) : nat :=
  match c with
  | Code_zero => 0
  | Code_succ => 1
  | Code_left => 2
  | Code_right => 3
  | Code_pair cf cg =>
      2 * (2 * nat_pair (code_encode cf) (code_encode cg)) + 4
  | Code_comp cf cg =>
      2 * (2 * nat_pair (code_encode cf) (code_encode cg) + 1) + 4
  | Code_prec cf cg =>
      2 * (2 * nat_pair (code_encode cf) (code_encode cg)) + 1 + 4
  | Code_rfind cf =>
      2 * (2 * code_encode cf + 1) + 1 + 4
  end.

Inductive evaluates : code -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
| Eval_zero :
    forall input,
      evaluates Code_zero input 0
| Eval_succ :
    forall input,
      evaluates Code_succ input (S input)
| Eval_left :
    forall input,
      evaluates Code_left input (fst (nat_unpair input))
| Eval_right :
    forall input,
      evaluates Code_right input (snd (nat_unpair input))
| Eval_pair :
    forall cf cg input left_value right_value,
      evaluates cf input left_value ->
      evaluates cg input right_value ->
      evaluates (Code_pair cf cg) input
        (nat_pair left_value right_value)
| Eval_comp :
    forall cf cg input middle output,
      evaluates cg input middle ->
      evaluates cf middle output ->
      evaluates (Code_comp cf cg) input output
| Eval_prec_zero :
    forall cf cg parameter output,
      evaluates cf parameter output ->
      evaluates (Code_prec cf cg) (nat_pair parameter 0) output
| Eval_prec_succ :
    forall cf cg parameter index previous output,
      evaluates (Code_prec cf cg) (nat_pair parameter index) previous ->
      evaluates cg
        (nat_pair parameter (nat_pair index previous)) output ->
      evaluates (Code_prec cf cg)
        (nat_pair parameter (S index)) output
| Eval_rfind :
    forall cf parameter start offset,
      evaluates cf (nat_pair parameter (offset + start)) 0 ->
      (forall i,
        (i < offset)%nat ->
        exists value,
          evaluates cf (nat_pair parameter (i + start)) value /\
          value <> 0) ->
      evaluates (Code_rfind cf) (nat_pair parameter start)
        (offset + start).

Definition computable2 (f : code -> nat -> code) : Prop :=
  exists program : code,
    forall (c : code) (n output : nat),
      evaluates program (nat_pair (code_encode c) n) output <->
      output = code_encode (f c n).

Theorem q1766814_smn :
  exists f : code -> nat -> code,
    computable2 f /\
    forall (c : code) (n x output : nat),
      evaluates (f c n) x output <->
      evaluates c (nat_pair n x) output.
Admitted.

End Q1766814_Smn.

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1766814,
  "Smn theorem": a computable specialization function transforms a code and a
  fixed first input into a code with the same partial evaluation. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1766814_smn_theorem
  imports Main
begin

datatype code =
    CZero
  | CSucc
  | CLeft
  | CRight
  | CPair code code
  | CComp code code
  | CPrec code code
  | CRfind code

definition nat_pair :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "nat_pair a b =
    (if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b)"

fun code_encode :: "code \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "code_encode CZero = 0"
| "code_encode CSucc = 1"
| "code_encode CLeft = 2"
| "code_encode CRight = 3"
| "code_encode (CPair cf cg) =
    2 * (2 * nat_pair (code_encode cf) (code_encode cg)) + 4"
| "code_encode (CComp cf cg) =
    2 * (2 * nat_pair (code_encode cf) (code_encode cg) + 1) + 4"
| "code_encode (CPrec cf cg) =
    2 * (2 * nat_pair (code_encode cf) (code_encode cg)) + 5"
| "code_encode (CRfind cf) = 2 * (2 * code_encode cf + 1) + 5"

inductive code_eval :: "code \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  eval_zero:
    "code_eval CZero x 0"
| eval_succ:
    "code_eval CSucc x (Suc x)"
| eval_left:
    "code_eval CLeft (nat_pair a b) a"
| eval_right:
    "code_eval CRight (nat_pair a b) b"
| eval_pair:
    "\<lbrakk>code_eval cf x y; code_eval cg x z\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> code_eval (CPair cf cg) x (nat_pair y z)"
| eval_comp:
    "\<lbrakk>code_eval cg x y; code_eval cf y z\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> code_eval (CComp cf cg) x z"
| eval_prec_zero:
    "code_eval cf a z
      \<Longrightarrow> code_eval (CPrec cf cg) (nat_pair a 0) z"
| eval_prec_succ:
    "\<lbrakk>code_eval (CPrec cf cg) (nat_pair a k) i;
      code_eval cg (nat_pair a (nat_pair k i)) z\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> code_eval (CPrec cf cg) (nat_pair a (Suc k)) z"
| eval_rfind:
    "\<lbrakk>code_eval cf (nat_pair a (m + k)) 0;
      \<And>j. j < k \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>z. code_eval cf (nat_pair a (m + j)) z \<and> z \<noteq> 0\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> code_eval (CRfind cf) (nat_pair a m) (m + k)"

definition computable2 :: "(code \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> code) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "computable2 f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>p. \<forall>c n y.
      code_eval p (nat_pair (code_encode c) n) y
        \<longleftrightarrow> y = code_encode (f c n))"

theorem smn:
  "\<exists>f :: code \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> code.
    computable2 f \<and>
    (\<forall>c n x y.
      code_eval (f c n) x y
        \<longleftrightarrow> code_eval c (nat_pair n x) y)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1766814,
  "Smn theorem": a computable specialization operation on partial-recursive
  program codes fixes the first component of a paired input while preserving
  partial evaluation. This file contains no proof.

let q1766814_code_INDUCT,q1766814_code_RECURSION = define_type
  "q1766814_code =
       Q1766814_Zero
     | Q1766814_Succ
     | Q1766814_Left
     | Q1766814_Right
     | Q1766814_Pair q1766814_code q1766814_code
     | Q1766814_Comp q1766814_code q1766814_code
     | Q1766814_Prec q1766814_code q1766814_code
     | Q1766814_Rfind q1766814_code";;

  `q1766814_pair a b =
     if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b`;;

let q1766814_encode = new_recursive_definition q1766814_code_RECURSION
  `(q1766814_encode Q1766814_Zero = 0) /\
   (q1766814_encode Q1766814_Succ = 1) /\
   (q1766814_encode Q1766814_Left = 2) /\
   (q1766814_encode Q1766814_Right = 3) /\
   (q1766814_encode (Q1766814_Pair c d) =
      4 + 4 * q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) (q1766814_encode d)) /\
   (q1766814_encode (Q1766814_Comp c d) =
      6 + 4 * q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) (q1766814_encode d)) /\
   (q1766814_encode (Q1766814_Prec c d) =
      5 + 4 * q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) (q1766814_encode d)) /\
   (q1766814_encode (Q1766814_Rfind c) =
      7 + 4 * q1766814_encode c)`;;

let q1766814_eval_RULES,q1766814_eval_INDUCT,q1766814_eval_CASES =
  new_inductive_definition
   `(!n:num. q1766814_eval Q1766814_Zero n 0) /\
    (!n:num. q1766814_eval Q1766814_Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b:num. q1766814_eval Q1766814_Left
                 (q1766814_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b:num. q1766814_eval Q1766814_Right
                 (q1766814_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q1766814_eval c n x /\ q1766814_eval d n y
       ==> q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Pair c d) n
             (q1766814_pair x y)) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q1766814_eval d n x /\ q1766814_eval c x y
       ==> q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Comp c d) n y) /\
    (!c d a y.
       q1766814_eval c a y
       ==> q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Prec c d)
             (q1766814_pair a 0) y) /\
    (!c d a k i y.
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Prec c d)
         (q1766814_pair a k) i /\
       q1766814_eval d (q1766814_pair a (q1766814_pair k i)) y
       ==> q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Prec c d)
             (q1766814_pair a (SUC k)) y) /\
    (!c a m.
       q1766814_eval c (q1766814_pair a m) 0
       ==> q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Rfind c)
             (q1766814_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z y.
       q1766814_eval c (q1766814_pair a m) (SUC z) /\
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Rfind c)
         (q1766814_pair a (SUC m)) y
       ==> q1766814_eval (Q1766814_Rfind c)
             (q1766814_pair a m) y)`;;

let q1766814_computable2 = new_definition
  `q1766814_computable2
      (f:q1766814_code->num->q1766814_code) <=>
     ?program:q1766814_code.
       !c n y.
         q1766814_eval program
           (q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) n) y <=>
         y = q1766814_encode (f c n)`;;

let Q1766814_SMN_THEOREM =
  `?f:q1766814_code->num->q1766814_code.

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1766814,
;; "Smn theorem": there exists a total computable program transformer that
;; fixes the first natural-number argument of every partial-recursive program.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Codes are transported along the source's denumeration Code <-> Nat.  The
;; decoder below follows ofNatCode: 0, 1, 2, and 3 are the four base codes,
;; while the two low bits above 3 select pair, composition, primitive
;; recursion, or minimization.  The bounded recursion is extensionally the
;; source decoder because every recursive code number is smaller than its
;; parent.

(defun q1766814-nat-pair (left right)
  (let ((left (nfix left))
        (right (nfix right)))
    (if (< left right)
        (+ (* right right) left)
      (+ (* left left) left right))))

(defun q1766814-isqrt-down (number candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) number)
        candidate
      (q1766814-isqrt-down number (- candidate 1)))))

(defun q1766814-isqrt (number)
  (let ((number (nfix number)))
    (q1766814-isqrt-down number number)))

(defun q1766814-nat-unpair (number)
  (let* ((number (nfix number))
         (root (q1766814-isqrt number))
         (remainder (- number (* root root))))
    (if (< remainder root)
        (cons remainder root)
      (cons root (- remainder root)))))

(defun q1766814-code-decode-aux (steps number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      :zero
    (let ((number (nfix number)))
      (cond
       ((equal number 0) :zero)
       ((equal number 1) :succ)
       ((equal number 2) :left)
       ((equal number 3) :right)
       (t
        (let* ((payload (- number 4))
               (low-bit (mod payload 2))
               (high-bit (mod (floor payload 2) 2))
               (subcode-pair-number (floor payload 4))
               (subcode-pair
                (q1766814-nat-unpair subcode-pair-number))
               (next-steps (- steps 1)))
          (cond
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :pair
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 1))
            (list
             :comp
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 1)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :prec
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           (t
            (list
             :rfind
             (q1766814-code-decode-aux
              next-steps subcode-pair-number))))))))))

(defun q1766814-code-decode (number)
  (q1766814-code-decode-aux
   (+ 1 (nfix number))
   number))

;; A successful bounded evaluation is (:some . value); NIL is undefined.
;; This is the source evaln definition, including its input bound.  Recursive
;; calls either decrease the fuel or move to a proper subcode.

(defun q1766814-some (value)
  (cons :some value))

(defun q1766814-some-p (result)
  (and (consp result)
       (equal (car result) :some)
       (natp (cdr result))))

(defun q1766814-evaln-measure (fuel code)
  (make-ord
   1
   (+ 1 (nfix fuel))
   (acl2-count code)))

(defun q1766814-evaln (fuel code input)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure (q1766814-evaln-measure fuel code)
    :well-founded-relation o<))
  (if (zp fuel)
      nil
    (let ((bound (- fuel 1)))
      (if (or (not (natp input))
              (< bound input))
          nil
        (cond
         ((equal code :zero)
          (q1766814-some 0))
         ((equal code :succ)
          (q1766814-some (+ input 1)))
         ((equal code :left)
          (q1766814-some
           (car (q1766814-nat-unpair input))))
         ((equal code :right)
          (q1766814-some
           (cdr (q1766814-nat-unpair input))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :pair))
          (let ((left
                 (q1766814-evaln
                  fuel (cadr code) input)))
            (if (q1766814-some-p left)
                (let ((right
                       (q1766814-evaln
                        fuel (caddr code) input)))
                  (if (q1766814-some-p right)
                      (q1766814-some
                       (q1766814-nat-pair
                        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
                    nil))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :comp))
          (let ((argument
                 (q1766814-evaln
                  fuel (caddr code) input)))
            (if (q1766814-some-p argument)
                (q1766814-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) (cdr argument))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :prec))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q1766814-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (counter (cdr arguments)))
            (if (zp counter)
                (q1766814-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) parameter)
              (let* ((predecessor (- counter 1))
                     (previous
                      (q1766814-evaln
                       bound
                       code
                       (q1766814-nat-pair
                        parameter predecessor))))
                (if (q1766814-some-p previous)
                    (q1766814-evaln
                     fuel
                     (caddr code)
                     (q1766814-nat-pair
                      parameter
                      (q1766814-nat-pair
                       predecessor
                       (cdr previous))))
                  nil)))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :rfind))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q1766814-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (start (cdr arguments))
                 (test
                  (q1766814-evaln
                   fuel
                   (cadr code)
                   (q1766814-nat-pair
                    parameter start))))
            (if (q1766814-some-p test)
                (if (equal (cdr test) 0)
                    (q1766814-some start)
                  (q1766814-evaln
                   bound
                   code
                   (q1766814-nat-pair
                    parameter (+ start 1))))
              nil)))
         (t nil))))))

;; DEFUN-SK keeps the source's unbounded quantifiers internal.  Existence of a
;; fuel is termination of the corresponding partial evaluation; agreement for
;; every possible natural output is equality of partial values.

(defun-sk q1766814-halts-with-p
    (program input output)
  (exists (fuel)
    (and
     (natp program)
     (natp input)
     (natp output)
     (natp fuel)
     (equal
      (q1766814-evaln
       fuel
       (q1766814-code-decode program)
       input)
      (q1766814-some output)))))

(defun-sk q1766814-partial-equal-p
    (left-program left-input right-program right-input)
  (forall (output)
    (implies
     (natp output)
     (iff
      (q1766814-halts-with-p
       left-program left-input output)
      (q1766814-halts-with-p
       right-program right-input output)))))

;; A transformer program receives pair(code-number,n) and returns the code
;; number for f c n.  Totality and the S-m-n evaluation equation remain inside
;; the quantified statement.  Since every natural decodes to a partial-
;; recursive Code, an internally quantified total transformer program is
;; equivalent to the source's existential Computable2 function.

(defun-sk q1766814-output-program-law-p
    (output-program source-program fixed-input)
  (forall (input)
    (implies
     (natp input)
     (q1766814-partial-equal-p
      output-program
      input
      source-program
      (q1766814-nat-pair fixed-input input)))))

(defun q1766814-output-program-valid-p
    (transformer source-program fixed-input output-program)
  (and
   (natp output-program)
   (q1766814-halts-with-p
    transformer
    (q1766814-nat-pair
     source-program fixed-input)
    output-program)
   (q1766814-output-program-law-p
    output-program source-program fixed-input)))

(defun-sk q1766814-transformer-entry-p
    (transformer source-program fixed-input)
  (exists (output-program)
    (q1766814-output-program-valid-p
     transformer source-program fixed-input output-program)))

(defun-sk q1766814-total-smn-transformer-p (transformer)
  (forall (source-program fixed-input)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp source-program)
      (natp fixed-input))
     (q1766814-transformer-entry-p
      transformer source-program fixed-input))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1766814-smn-theorem-statement ()
  (exists (transformer)
    (and
     (natp transformer)
     (q1766814-total-smn-transformer-p transformer))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1766814
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1766814), "Smn theorem": there exists a computable
-- program-specialization function whose evaluation fixes the first input of
-- every partial-recursive program. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1766814_smn_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _<_)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

-- The square pairing used by the source Nat.Partrec development.
pairNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
pairNat left right with left < right
... | true =
  right * right + left
... | false =
  left * left + left + right

-- Codes for the partial-recursive schemes used by the source development.
data Code : Set where
  zeroCode : Code
  successorCode : Code
  leftCode : Code
  rightCode : Code
  pairCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  composeCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  primitiveRecursionCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  minimizationCode : Code -> Code

-- A computable numerical encoding of program codes.
encodeCode : Code -> Nat
encodeCode zeroCode =
  0
encodeCode successorCode =
  1
encodeCode leftCode =
  2
encodeCode rightCode =
  3
encodeCode (pairCode firstCode secondCode) =
  2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode)) + 4
encodeCode (composeCode firstCode secondCode) =
  2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode) + 1) + 4
encodeCode (primitiveRecursionCode firstCode secondCode) =
  (2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode)) + 1) + 4
encodeCode (minimizationCode code) =
  (2 * (2 * encodeCode code + 1) + 1) + 4

-- Relational evaluation represents termination of a partial computation.
data Evaluates : Code -> Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  evaluates-zero :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates zeroCode input zero

  evaluates-successor :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates successorCode input (suc input)

  evaluates-left :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates leftCode (pairNat left right) left

  evaluates-right :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates rightCode (pairNat left right) right

  evaluates-pair :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input firstValue secondValue : Nat} ->
    Evaluates firstCode input firstValue ->
    Evaluates secondCode input secondValue ->
    Evaluates
      (pairCode firstCode secondCode)
      input
      (pairNat firstValue secondValue)

  evaluates-composition :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input intermediate output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates secondCode input intermediate ->
    Evaluates firstCode intermediate output ->
    Evaluates (composeCode firstCode secondCode) input output

  evaluates-primitive-zero :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates baseCode parameter output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter zero)
      output

  evaluates-primitive-successor :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter index previous output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter index)
      previous ->
    Evaluates
      stepCode
      (pairNat parameter (pairNat index previous))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter (suc index))
      output

  evaluates-minimization-zero :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) zero ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      start

  evaluates-minimization-successor :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start nonzeroValue output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) (suc nonzeroValue) ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter (suc start))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      output

-- Binary computability uses the same code interpretation and code encoding.
record Computable2 (function : Code -> Nat -> Code) : Set where
  constructor computed-by
  field
    program : Code
    computes :
      (code : Code) ->
      (argument : Nat) ->
      Evaluates
        program
        (pairNat (encodeCode code) argument)
        (encodeCode (function code argument))

SmnTheorem : Set
SmnTheorem =
  Exists
    (Code -> Nat -> Code)
    (\ specialize ->
      Computable2 specialize and
      ((code : Code) ->
       (fixed argument output : Nat) ->
       Iff
         (Evaluates (specialize code fixed) argument output)
         (Evaluates code (pairNat fixed argument) output)))

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1766814, "Smn theorem": a total computable specialization operation on
  program codes fixes the first component of a paired input while preserving
  the represented partial computation. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

Datatype:
  q1766814_code =
    Q1766814Zero
  | Q1766814Succ
  | Q1766814Left
  | Q1766814Right
  | Q1766814Pair q1766814_code q1766814_code
  | Q1766814Comp q1766814_code q1766814_code
  | Q1766814Prec q1766814_code q1766814_code
  | Q1766814Rfind q1766814_code
End

val q1766814_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q1766814_pair_def",
  ``q1766814_pair a b =
      if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b``
);

val q1766814_encode_def = Define`
  (q1766814_encode Q1766814Zero = 0) /\
  (q1766814_encode Q1766814Succ = 1) /\
  (q1766814_encode Q1766814Left = 2) /\
  (q1766814_encode Q1766814Right = 3) /\
  (q1766814_encode (Q1766814Pair c d) =
     4 * q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) (q1766814_encode d) + 4) /\
  (q1766814_encode (Q1766814Comp c d) =
     4 * q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) (q1766814_encode d) + 6) /\
  (q1766814_encode (Q1766814Prec c d) =
     4 * q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) (q1766814_encode d) + 5) /\
  (q1766814_encode (Q1766814Rfind c) =
     4 * q1766814_encode c + 7)
`;

val (q1766814_eval_rules, q1766814_eval_ind, q1766814_eval_cases) =
  Hol_reln`
    (!n. q1766814_eval Q1766814Zero n 0) /\
    (!n. q1766814_eval Q1766814Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b. q1766814_eval Q1766814Left (q1766814_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b. q1766814_eval Q1766814Right (q1766814_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q1766814_eval c n a /\ q1766814_eval d n b ==>
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814Pair c d) n (q1766814_pair a b)) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q1766814_eval d n a /\ q1766814_eval c a b ==>
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814Comp c d) n b) /\
    (!c d a b.
       q1766814_eval c a b ==>
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814Prec c d) (q1766814_pair a 0) b) /\
    (!c d a n r b.
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814Prec c d) (q1766814_pair a n) r /\
       q1766814_eval d
         (q1766814_pair a (q1766814_pair n r)) b ==>
       q1766814_eval
         (Q1766814Prec c d) (q1766814_pair a (SUC n)) b) /\
    (!c a m.
       q1766814_eval c (q1766814_pair a m) 0 ==>
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814Rfind c) (q1766814_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z r.
       q1766814_eval c (q1766814_pair a m) z /\ z <> 0 /\
       q1766814_eval
         (Q1766814Rfind c) (q1766814_pair a (SUC m)) r ==>
       q1766814_eval (Q1766814Rfind c) (q1766814_pair a m) r)
  `;

val q1766814_computable2_def = new_definition (
  "q1766814_computable2_def",
  ``q1766814_computable2 f <=>
      ?p. !c n.
        q1766814_eval p
          (q1766814_pair (q1766814_encode c) n)
          (q1766814_encode (f c n))``
);

val q1766814_smn_theorem =
  ``?f : q1766814_code -> num -> q1766814_code.
      q1766814_computable2 f /\
      !c n x y.
        (q1766814_eval (f c n) x y <=>
         q1766814_eval c (q1766814_pair n x) y)``;

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1766814
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1766814), "Smn theorem": there is a
  computable operation specializing a partial-recursive program code at its
  first natural-number argument while preserving its partial evaluation.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Nat.Partrec.Code is represented through its canonical bijection with NN0.
  Under this bijection the constructors have codes 0, 1, 2, 3,
  4*pair(c,d)+4, 4*pair(c,d)+6, 4*pair(c,d)+5, and 4*c+7. Q1766814Pair is
  Mathlib's exact Nat.pair function.

  Q1766814Eval c n y is the least relation closed under the operational rules
  for zero, successor, projections, pairing, composition, primitive
  recursion, and minimization. Thus it says that eval c n terminates with y.
  Q1766814Computable2 F says that the total binary function F on code-naturals
  is realized by one program code on paired inputs.

  The final pointwise biconditional over possible outputs is exactly equality
  of the two partial values in the Lean statement. All auxiliary $a
  declarations are syntax or faithful definitions; the final $a is the
  single unproved corpus statement, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c Q1766814Pair Q1766814CodePair Q1766814CodeComp $.
$c Q1766814CodePrec Q1766814CodeRfind $.
$c Q1766814Eval Q1766814Computable2 $.

q1766814-pair-syntax $a class ( Q1766814Pair a b ) $.
q1766814-code-pair-syntax $a class ( Q1766814CodePair a b ) $.
q1766814-code-comp-syntax $a class ( Q1766814CodeComp a b ) $.
q1766814-code-prec-syntax $a class ( Q1766814CodePrec a b ) $.
q1766814-code-rfind-syntax $a class ( Q1766814CodeRfind a ) $.
q1766814-eval-syntax $a wff ( Q1766814Eval c n y ) $.
q1766814-computable2-syntax $a wff ( Q1766814Computable2 F ) $.

q1766814-pair-definition $a |- (
  Q1766814Pair a b
  =
  if (
    a < b ,
    ( ( b x. b ) + a ) ,
    ( ( ( a x. a ) + a ) + b )
  )
) $.

q1766814-code-pair-definition $a |- (
  Q1766814CodePair a b
  =
  ( ( 4 x. ( Q1766814Pair a b ) ) + 4 )
) $.

q1766814-code-comp-definition $a |- (
  Q1766814CodeComp a b
  =
  ( ( 4 x. ( Q1766814Pair a b ) ) + 6 )
) $.

q1766814-code-prec-definition $a |- (
  Q1766814CodePrec a b
  =
  ( ( 4 x. ( Q1766814Pair a b ) ) + 5 )
) $.

q1766814-code-rfind-definition $a |- (
  Q1766814CodeRfind a
  =
  ( ( 4 x. a ) + 7 )
) $.

${
  $d R a b c i j k m n u v x y $.

  q1766814-eval-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1766814Eval c n y )
    <->
    A. R
      (
        (
          A. x e. NN0
            <. 0 , <. x , 0 >. >. e. R
          /\
          (
            A. x e. NN0
              <. 1 , <. x , ( x + 1 ) >. >. e. R
            /\
            (
              A. a e. NN0
                A. b e. NN0
                  <.
                    2 ,
                    <. ( Q1766814Pair a b ) , a >.

                A. a e. NN0

                    <.
                      3 ,
                      <. ( Q1766814Pair a b ) , b >.
                    >. e. R
                /\
                (
                  A. a e. NN0
                    A. b e. NN0
                      A. x e. NN0

                            (
                              (
                                <. a , <. x , u >. >. e. R
                                /\

                              )
                              ->
                              <.
                                ( Q1766814CodePair a b ) ,
                                <. x , ( Q1766814Pair u v ) >.
                              >. e. R
                            )
                  /\
                  (
                    A. a e. NN0
                      A. b e. NN0
                        A. x e. NN0
                          A. u e. NN0
                            A. v e. NN0
                              (
                                (
                                  <. b , <. x , u >. >. e. R
                                  /\
                                  <. a , <. u , v >. >. e. R
                                )
                                ->
                                <.
                                  ( Q1766814CodeComp a b ) ,
                                  <. x , v >.
                                >. e. R
                              )
                    /\
                    (
                      A. a e. NN0
                        A. b e. NN0
                          A. x e. NN0
                            A. v e. NN0
                              (
                                <. a , <. x , v >. >. e. R
                                ->
                                <.
                                  ( Q1766814CodePrec a b ) ,
                                  <. ( Q1766814Pair x 0 ) , v >.
                                >. e. R
                              )
                      /\
                      (
                        A. a e. NN0
                          A. b e. NN0
                            A. x e. NN0
                              A. k e. NN0
                                A. u e. NN0
                                  A. v e. NN0
                                    (
                                      (
                                        <.
                                          ( Q1766814CodePrec a b ) ,
                                          <.
                                            ( Q1766814Pair x k ) ,
                                            u
                                          >.
                                        >. e. R
                                        /\
                                        <.
                                          b ,
                                          <.
                                            (
                                              Q1766814Pair
                                                x
                                                ( Q1766814Pair k u )
                                            ) ,
                                            v
                                          >.
                                        >. e. R
                                      )
                                      ->
                                      <.
                                        ( Q1766814CodePrec a b ) ,
                                        <.
                                          ( Q1766814Pair x ( k + 1 ) ) ,
                                          v
                                        >.
                                      >. e. R
                                    )
                        /\
                        A. a e. NN0
                          A. x e. NN0
                            A. m e. NN0
                              A. j e. NN0
                                (
                                  (
                                    <.
                                      a ,
                                      <.
                                        (
                                          Q1766814Pair
                                            x
                                            ( m + j )
                                        ) ,
                                        0
                                      >.
                                    >. e. R
                                    /\
                                    A. i e. ( 0 ..^ j )
                                      E. u e. NN0
                                        (
                                          u =/= 0
                                          /\
                                          <.
                                            a ,
                                            <.
                                              (
                                                Q1766814Pair
                                                  x
                                                  ( m + i )
                                              ) ,
                                              u
                                            >.
                                          >. e. R
                                        )
                                  )
                                  ->
                                  <.
                                    ( Q1766814CodeRfind a ) ,
                                    <.
                                      ( Q1766814Pair x m ) ,
                                      ( m + j )
                                    >.
                                  >. e. R
                                )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        <. c , <. n , y >. >. e. R
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F c n p $.

  q1766814-computable2-definition $a |- (
    ( Q1766814Computable2 F )
    <->
    (
      F : ( NN0 X. NN0 ) --> NN0
      /\
      E. p e. NN0
        A. c e. NN0
          A. n e. NN0
            (

                p
                ( Q1766814Pair c n )
                ( F ` <. c , n >. )

${
  $d F c n x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q1766814-smn $a |- (
    E. F
      (
        ( Q1766814Computable2 F )
        /\
        A. c e. NN0
          A. n e. NN0
            A. x e. NN0
              A. y e. NN0
                (
                  (
                    Q1766814Eval
                      ( F ` <. c , n >. )

$}

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1766814,
:: "Smn theorem": a computable specialization operator transforms a program
:: and a fixed first input into a program with the same partial evaluation on
:: the paired input. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, INT_1, XCMPLX_0, CARD_1,
      SETFAM_1, XXREAL_0, BINOP_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1,
      NAT_D, SETFAM_1, XXREAL_0, BINOP_1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_D, SETFAM_1,
      BINOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  ex Eval being set,
     pairing,pairCode,compCode,precCode,specialize being BinOp of NAT st
    (for a,b being Nat holds
      (a < b implies pairing.(a,b) = b*b+a) &
      (not a < b implies pairing.(a,b) = a*a+a+b)) &
    (for cf,cg being Nat holds
      (cf < cg implies
        pairCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cg*cg+cf)+4 &
        compCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cg*cg+cf)+6 &
        precCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cg*cg+cf)+5) &
      (not cf < cg implies
        pairCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cf*cf+cf+cg)+4 &
        compCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cf*cf+cf+cg)+6 &
        precCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cf*cf+cf+cg)+5)) &
    Eval =
      meet {R where R is Subset of [:[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:] :
        (for x being Nat holds [[0,x],0] in R) &
        (for x being Nat holds [[1,x],x+1] in R) &
        (for a,b being Nat holds
          [[2,pairing.(a,b)],a] in R) &
        (for a,b being Nat holds
          [[3,pairing.(a,b)],b] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,x,y,z being Nat st
          [[cf,x],y] in R & [[cg,x],z] in R
         holds
          [[pairCode.(cf,cg),x],pairing.(y,z)] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,x,y,z being Nat st
          [[cg,x],y] in R & [[cf,y],z] in R
         holds
          [[compCode.(cf,cg),x],z] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,a,y being Nat st [[cf,a],y] in R
         holds
          [[precCode.(cf,cg),pairing.(a,0)],y] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,a,k,i,y being Nat st
          [[precCode.(cf,cg),pairing.(a,k)],i] in R &
          [[cg,pairing.(a,pairing.(k,i))],y] in R
         holds
          [[precCode.(cf,cg),pairing.(a,k+1)],y] in R) &
        (for cf,a,m,n being Nat st
          [[cf,pairing.(a,n+m)],0] in R &
          (for k being Nat st k < n holds
            ex z being Nat st z <> 0 &
              [[cf,pairing.(a,k+m)],z] in R)
         holds
          [[4*cf+7,pairing.(a,m)],n+m] in R)} &
    (ex e being Nat st
      for c,n,y being Nat holds
        ([[e,pairing.(c,n)],y] in Eval
          iff y = specialize.(c,n))) &
    (for c,n,x,y being Nat holds
      ([[specialize.(c,n),x],y] in Eval
        iff
       [[c,pairing.(n,x)],y] in Eval))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1766814_smn_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1766814,
% "Smn theorem": the S-m-n theorem gives a computable operation that
% specializes a partial-recursive program code at its first natural-number
% input. This file contains no proof.

smn_code_Q1766814: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  zero_code: zero_code?
  succ_code: succ_code?
  left_code: left_code?
  right_code: right_code?
  pair_code(pair_left, pair_right: smn_code_Q1766814): pair_code?
  comp_code(comp_outer, comp_inner: smn_code_Q1766814): comp_code?
  prec_code(prec_base, prec_step: smn_code_Q1766814): prec_code?
  rfind_code(rfind_body: smn_code_Q1766814): rfind_code?
END smn_code_Q1766814

Q1766814_smn_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING smn_code_Q1766814

  code: TYPE = smn_code_Q1766814
  evaluation_relation: TYPE = [code, nat, nat -> bool]
  code_transformer: TYPE = [code, nat -> code]

  nat_pair(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left < right THEN
      right * right + left
    ELSE
      left * left + left + right
    ENDIF

  code_encode(program: code): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES program OF
      zero_code: 0,
      succ_code: 1,
      left_code: 2,
      right_code: 3,
      pair_code(left_program, right_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(left_program),
          code_encode(right_program))) + 4,
      comp_code(outer_program, inner_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(outer_program),
          code_encode(inner_program)) + 1) + 4,
      prec_code(base_program, step_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(base_program),
          code_encode(step_program))) + 1 + 4,
      rfind_code(body_program):
        2 * (2 * code_encode(body_program) + 1) + 1 + 4
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE program BY <<

  evaluator_closed(candidate: evaluation_relation): bool =
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(zero_code, input, 0))
    AND
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(succ_code, input, input + 1))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(left_code, nat_pair(left, right), left))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(right_code, nat_pair(left, right), right))
    AND
    (FORALL (left_program, right_program: code),
            (input, left_value, right_value: nat):
      (candidate(left_program, input, left_value)
        AND candidate(right_program, input, right_value))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          pair_code(left_program, right_program),
          input,
          nat_pair(left_value, right_value)))
    AND
    (FORALL (outer_program, inner_program: code),
            (input, intermediate, output: nat):
      (candidate(inner_program, input, intermediate)
        AND candidate(outer_program, intermediate, output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          comp_code(outer_program, inner_program),
          input,
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, output: nat):
      candidate(base_program, parameter, output)
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, 0),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, index, previous, output: nat):
      (candidate(
          prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index),
          previous)
        AND candidate(
          step_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, nat_pair(index, previous)),
          output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index + 1),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (body_program: code),
            (parameter, start, offset: nat):
      (candidate(
          body_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, start + offset),
          0)
        AND
          (FORALL (earlier: nat):
            earlier < offset IMPLIES
              EXISTS (nonzero_value: nat):
                candidate(
                  body_program,
                  nat_pair(parameter, start + earlier),
                  nonzero_value)
                  AND nonzero_value /= 0))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          rfind_code(body_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, start),
          start + offset))

  evaluates(program: code, input, output: nat): bool =
    FORALL (candidate: evaluation_relation):
      evaluator_closed(candidate)
      IMPLIES candidate(program, input, output)

  computable_binary(transformer: code_transformer): bool =
    EXISTS (program: code):
      FORALL (source: code), (parameter: nat):
        evaluates(
          program,
          nat_pair(code_encode(source), parameter),
          code_encode(transformer(source, parameter)))

  smn: bool =
    EXISTS (transformer: code_transformer):
      computable_binary(transformer)
      AND
        (FORALL (source: code), (parameter, input, output: nat):
          evaluates(transformer(source, parameter), input, output)
          IFF
            evaluates(
              source,
              nat_pair(parameter, input),
              output))
END Q1766814_smn_theorem
