title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q179208
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q179208), "Cayley's theorem": every group acting
  faithfully on an arbitrary type is multiplicatively equivalent to the range
  of its induced action in the permutation group. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Record q179208_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q179208_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q179208_one : G;
  q179208_inv : G -> G;
  q179208_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q179208_mul x (q179208_mul y z) =
      q179208_mul (q179208_mul x y) z;
  q179208_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q179208_mul q179208_one x = x;
  q179208_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q179208_mul x q179208_one = x;
  q179208_inv_mul :
    forall x : G, q179208_mul (q179208_inv x) x = q179208_one;
  q179208_mul_inv :
    forall x : G, q179208_mul x (q179208_inv x) = q179208_one
}.

Arguments q179208_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q179208_one {G} _.
Arguments q179208_inv {G} _ _.

Record q179208_mul_action
    (G H : Type)
    (grp : q179208_group G) : Type := {
  q179208_act : G -> H -> H;
  q179208_one_act :
    forall x : H, q179208_act (q179208_one grp) x = x;
  q179208_mul_act :
    forall (g k : G) (x : H),
      q179208_act (q179208_mul grp g k) x =
      q179208_act g (q179208_act k x)
}.

Arguments q179208_act {G H grp} _ _ _.

Definition q179208_faithful_action
    {G H : Type}
    (grp : q179208_group G)
    (action : q179208_mul_action G H grp) : Prop :=
  forall g k : G,
    (forall x : H, q179208_act action g x = q179208_act action k x) ->
    g = k.

Record q179208_permutation (H : Type) : Type := {
  q179208_perm_apply : H -> H;
  q179208_perm_inverse : H -> H;
  q179208_perm_inverse_left :
    forall x : H,
      q179208_perm_inverse (q179208_perm_apply x) = x;
  q179208_perm_inverse_right :
    forall x : H,
      q179208_perm_apply (q179208_perm_inverse x) = x
}.

Arguments q179208_perm_apply {H} _ _.
Arguments q179208_perm_inverse {H} _ _.

Record q179208_action_range
    (G H : Type)
    (grp : q179208_group G)
    (action : q179208_mul_action G H grp) : Type := {
  q179208_range_permutation : q179208_permutation H;
  q179208_range_preimage : G;
  q179208_range_spec :
    forall x : H,
      q179208_perm_apply q179208_range_permutation x =
      q179208_act action q179208_range_preimage x
}.

Arguments q179208_range_permutation {G H grp action} _.
Arguments q179208_range_preimage {G H grp action} _.

Definition q179208_range_equal
    {G H : Type}
    {grp : q179208_group G}
    {action : q179208_mul_action G H grp}
    (p q : q179208_action_range G H grp action) : Prop :=
  forall x : H,
    q179208_perm_apply (q179208_range_permutation p) x =
    q179208_perm_apply (q179208_range_permutation q) x.

Definition q179208_range_product
    {G H : Type}
    {grp : q179208_group G}
    {action : q179208_mul_action G H grp}
    (p q r : q179208_action_range G H grp action) : Prop :=
  forall x : H,
    q179208_perm_apply (q179208_range_permutation r) x =
    q179208_perm_apply
      (q179208_range_permutation p)
      (q179208_perm_apply (q179208_range_permutation q) x).

Definition q179208_is_action_range_mul_equiv
    {G H : Type}
    (grp : q179208_group G)
    (action : q179208_mul_action G H grp) : Prop :=
  exists forward : G -> q179208_action_range G H grp action,
  exists backward : q179208_action_range G H grp action -> G,
    (forall (g : G) (x : H),
      q179208_perm_apply (q179208_range_permutation (forward g)) x =
      q179208_act action g x) /\
    (forall g k : G,
      q179208_range_product
        (forward g)
        (forward k)
        (forward (q179208_mul grp g k))) /\
    (forall p q : q179208_action_range G H grp action,
      q179208_range_equal p q ->
      backward p = backward q) /\
    (forall g : G, backward (forward g) = g) /\
    (forall p : q179208_action_range G H grp action,
      q179208_range_equal (forward (backward p)) p).

Theorem Equiv_Perm_subgroupOfMulAction :
  forall (G H : Type)
         (grp : q179208_group G)
         (action : q179208_mul_action G H grp),
    q179208_faithful_action grp action ->
    q179208_is_action_range_mul_equiv grp action.
Admitted.

title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q179208
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q179208), "Cayley's theorem": every group
  acting faithfully on an arbitrary type is isomorphic to the image subgroup
  of its induced permutation action. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q179208_action_range ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h \<Rightarrow> 'h) \<Rightarrow> ('h \<Rightarrow> 'h) set" where
  "q179208_action_range act = range act"

definition q179208_is_permutation_subgroup ::
    "('h \<Rightarrow> 'h) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179208_is_permutation_subgroup S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p \<in> S. bij p) \<and>
    id \<in> S \<and>
    (\<forall>p \<in> S. \<forall>q \<in> S. p \<circ> q \<in> S) \<and>
    (\<forall>p \<in> S. \<exists>q \<in> S.
      p \<circ> q = id \<and> q \<circ> p = id)"

definition q179208_isomorphism_onto_action_range ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h \<Rightarrow> 'h) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179208_isomorphism_onto_action_range act \<longleftrightarrow>
    q179208_is_permutation_subgroup (q179208_action_range act) \<and>
    bij_betw act UNIV (q179208_action_range act) \<and>
    act 0 = id \<and>
    (\<forall>g h. act (g + h) = act g \<circ> act h)"

theorem cayleys_theorem_for_faithful_action:
  fixes act :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'h \<Rightarrow> 'h"
  assumes action_identity: "act 0 = id"
    and action_composition: "\<And>g h. act (g + h) = act g \<circ> act h"
    and faithful: "inj act"
  shows "q179208_isomorphism_onto_action_range act"
  sorry

end

title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q179208,
;; "Cayley's theorem": a group acting faithfully on an arbitrary carrier is
;; multiplicatively equivalent to the image of its permutation action.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent arbitrary, potentially infinite carriers,
;; operations, and actions.  Equality of action rows is extensional on the
;; acted-on carrier.  The canonical action map is an injective homomorphism
;; into permutations exactly when its corestriction to its image is a
;; multiplicative equivalence.

(defun q179208-member-p (carrier element)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list element))
      t
    nil))

(defun q179208-unary-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun q179208-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Group structure on the acting carrier.

(defun-sk q179208-group-laws-p
    (group-carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q179208-member-p group-carrier x)
      (and
       (q179208-member-p
        group-carrier
        (q179208-unary-value inverse x))
       (equal
        (q179208-binary-value multiplication identity x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q179208-binary-value multiplication x identity)
        x)
       (equal
        (q179208-binary-value
         multiplication
         (q179208-unary-value inverse x)
         x)
        identity)
       (equal
        (q179208-binary-value
         multiplication
         x
         (q179208-unary-value inverse x))
        identity)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier x)
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier y))
      (q179208-member-p
       group-carrier
       (q179208-binary-value multiplication x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier x)
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier y)
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier z))
      (equal
       (q179208-binary-value
        multiplication
        (q179208-binary-value multiplication x y)
        z)
       (q179208-binary-value
        multiplication
        x
        (q179208-binary-value multiplication y z)))))))

(defun q179208-group-p
    (group-carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp group-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q179208-member-p group-carrier identity)
   (q179208-group-laws-p
    group-carrier multiplication inverse identity)))

;; Multiplicative action on the arbitrary point carrier.

(defun-sk q179208-action-laws-p
    (group-carrier point-carrier multiplication identity action)
  (forall (g k h)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier g)
       (q179208-member-p point-carrier h))
      (q179208-member-p
       point-carrier
       (q179208-binary-value action g h)))
     (implies
      (q179208-member-p point-carrier h)
      (equal
       (q179208-binary-value action identity h)
       h))
     (implies
      (and
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier g)
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier k)
       (q179208-member-p point-carrier h))
      (equal
       (q179208-binary-value
        action
        (q179208-binary-value multiplication g k)
        h)
       (q179208-binary-value
        action
        g
        (q179208-binary-value action k h)))))))

(defun q179208-action-p
    (group-carrier point-carrier multiplication identity action)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp point-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp action)
   (q179208-action-laws-p
    group-carrier
    point-carrier
    multiplication
    identity
    action)))

;; Two group elements determine the same permutation precisely when their
;; action rows agree at every point of H.

(defun-sk q179208-action-row-equal-p
    (point-carrier action left right)
  (forall (h)
    (implies
     (q179208-member-p point-carrier h)
     (equal
      (q179208-binary-value action left h)
      (q179208-binary-value action right h)))))

;; FaithfulSMul is injectivity of the map from group elements to action rows.
;; Its quantifier remains internal; no distinguishing-point witness is added
;; as an external parameter.

(defun-sk q179208-faithful-action-p
    (group-carrier point-carrier action)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179208-member-p group-carrier left)
      (q179208-member-p group-carrier right)
      (q179208-action-row-equal-p
       point-carrier action left right))
     (equal left right))))

;; Every action row is a permutation, with the row of g^-1 as inverse.

(defun-sk q179208-action-row-permutation-p
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     inverse
     action)
  (forall (g h)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179208-member-p group-carrier g)
      (q179208-member-p point-carrier h))
     (let ((inverse-g
            (q179208-unary-value inverse g)))
       (and
        (q179208-member-p
         point-carrier
         (q179208-binary-value action g h))
        (equal
         (q179208-binary-value
          action
          inverse-g
          (q179208-binary-value action g h))
         h)
        (equal
         (q179208-binary-value
          action
          g
          (q179208-binary-value action inverse-g h))
         h))))))

;; These are the laws of the canonical multiplicative equivalence from G to
;; the exact image of g |-> (h |-> g • h).  Multiplication in that image is
;; permutation composition, equality is extensional row equality, and
;; surjectivity is definitional because every image element is an action row.

(defun-sk q179208-canonical-range-mul-equiv-laws-p
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     identity
     action)
  (forall (g k h)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier g)
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier k))
      (iff
       (equal g k)
       (q179208-action-row-equal-p
        point-carrier action g k)))
     (implies
      (q179208-member-p point-carrier h)
      (equal
       (q179208-binary-value action identity h)
       h))
     (implies
      (and
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier g)
       (q179208-member-p group-carrier k)
       (q179208-member-p point-carrier h))
      (equal
       (q179208-binary-value
        action
        (q179208-binary-value multiplication g k)
        h)
       (q179208-binary-value
        action
        g
        (q179208-binary-value action k h)))))))

(defun q179208-canonical-range-mul-equiv-p
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     inverse
     identity
     action)
  (and
   (q179208-action-row-permutation-p
    group-carrier point-carrier inverse action)
   (q179208-canonical-range-mul-equiv-laws-p
    group-carrier
    point-carrier
    multiplication
    identity
    action)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q179208-cayley-s-theorem-statement
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     inverse
     identity
     action)
  (implies
   (and
    (q179208-group-p
     group-carrier multiplication inverse identity)
    (q179208-action-p
     group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     identity
     action)
    (q179208-faithful-action-p
     group-carrier point-carrier action))
   (q179208-canonical-range-mul-equiv-p
    group-carrier
    point-carrier
    multiplication
    inverse
    identity
    action)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q179208,
-- "Cayley's theorem": every group with a faithful action on a type is
-- multiplicatively isomorphic to the image subgroup of its permutation action.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q179208_cayley_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record Permutation {ℓ : Level} (X : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    forward          : X → X
    backward         : X → X
    backward-forward : (x : X) → backward (forward x) ≡ x
    forward-backward : (x : X) → forward (backward x) ≡ x

infix 4 _≈ₚ_

_≈ₚ_ :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {X : Set ℓ} →
  Permutation X →
  Permutation X →
  Set ℓ
p ≈ₚ q =
  (x : _) →
  Permutation.forward p x ≡ Permutation.forward q x

record FaithfulPermutationAction
  {ℓG ℓX : Level}
  {G : Set ℓG}
  (group : Group G)
  (X : Set ℓX) :
  Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX) where

  open Group group

  field
    action : G → Permutation X
    action-identity :
      (x : X) →
      Permutation.forward (action identity) x ≡ x
    action-multiply :
      (g h : G) →
      (x : X) →
      Permutation.forward (action (multiply g h)) x ≡
      Permutation.forward (action g)
        (Permutation.forward (action h) x)
    faithful :
      (g h : G) →
      action g ≈ₚ action h →
      g ≡ h

record ActionImage
  {ℓG ℓX : Level}
  {G : Set ℓG}
  {X : Set ℓX}
  {group : Group G}
  (representation : FaithfulPermutationAction group X) :
  Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX) where

  field
    permutation : Permutation X
    represented-by :
      Σ G
        (λ g →
          permutation ≈ₚ
          FaithfulPermutationAction.action representation g)

record MultiplicativeEquivalenceToImage
  {ℓG ℓX : Level}
  {G : Set ℓG}
  {X : Set ℓX}
  (group : Group G)
  (representation : FaithfulPermutationAction group X) :
  Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX) where

  open Group group
  open ActionImage

  field
    to-image : G → ActionImage representation
    from-image : ActionImage representation → G
    from-respects-extensional-equality :
      (u v : ActionImage representation) →
      permutation u ≈ₚ permutation v →
      from-image u ≡ from-image v
    from-to :
      (g : G) →
      from-image (to-image g) ≡ g
    to-from :
      (u : ActionImage representation) →
      permutation (to-image (from-image u)) ≈ₚ permutation u
    preserves-identity :
      (x : X) →
      Permutation.forward (permutation (to-image identity)) x ≡ x
    preserves-multiplication :
      (g h : G) →
      (x : X) →
      Permutation.forward
        (permutation (to-image (multiply g h))) x ≡
      Permutation.forward (permutation (to-image g))
        (Permutation.forward (permutation (to-image h)) x)

cayleys-theorem :
  (ℓG ℓX : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (ℓG ⊔ ℓX))
cayleys-theorem ℓG ℓX =
  {G : Set ℓG} →
  {X : Set ℓX} →
  (group : Group G) →
  (representation : FaithfulPermutationAction group X) →
  MultiplicativeEquivalenceToImage group representation

title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q179208, "Cayley's theorem": a group with a faithful action is isomorphic
  to the image of its action homomorphism in the symmetric group. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val cayley_permutation_group_def = new_definition (
  "cayley_permutation_group_def",
  ``cayley_permutation_group : ('a -> 'a) group =
      <| carrier := {p | BIJ p UNIV UNIV};
              op := (\f g. f o g);
              id := I
       |>``);

val subgroupOfMulAction =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (rho : 'a -> 'b -> 'b).
      Group g /\
      g.carrier = UNIV /\
      action rho g UNIV /\
      (!a b. (!x. rho a x = rho b x) ==> a = b)
      ==>
      GroupIso (\a. rho a) g
        (homo_image (\a. rho a) g
          (cayley_permutation_group : ('b -> 'b) group))``;

title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q179208
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q179208), "Cayley's theorem": every group with
  a faithful action is isomorphic, via its induced permutation representation,
  to that representation's range subgroup. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, A e. ( G GrpAct H ) says that A is a group action of the arbitrary
  group G on the arbitrary set H. Q179208ActionHom G H A is the curried map
  sending each group element g to the permutation h |-> A(g,h). Its being a
  one-to-one function into Base ` ( SymGrp ` H ) is exactly faithfulness.
  Restricting SymGrp ` H to the range of this homomorphism gives the range
  subgroup. The final declaration asserts that this same induced map is a
  group isomorphism onto that subgroup.

  The auxiliary declarations are syntax and a faithful definition. The final
  $a declaration is the unproved corpus statement; there is no $p statement.
$)

$c Q179208ActionHom $.

q179208-action-hom-syntax $a class ( Q179208ActionHom G H A ) $.

${
  $d A G H x y $.

  q179208-action-hom-definition $a |- ( Q179208ActionHom G H A ) =
    ( x e. ( Base ` G ) |->
      ( y e. H |-> ( A ` <. x , y >. ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A G H $.

  thousand-theorems-q179208-cayley-s-theorem $a |- (
    A. G A. H A. A
      (
        (
          A e. ( G GrpAct H )
          /\
          ( Q179208ActionHom G H A ) :
            ( Base ` G ) -1-1-> ( Base ` ( SymGrp ` H ) )
        )
        ->
        ( Q179208ActionHom G H A ) e.
          (
            G GrpIso
            (
              ( SymGrp ` H ) |`s
              ran ( Q179208ActionHom G H A )
            )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      MCART_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, BINOP_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for G being Group, H being set,
      A being Function of [:the carrier of G,H:],H st
    (for h being object st h in H holds A.[1_G,h] = h) &
    (for g1,g2 being Element of G, h being object st h in H holds
      A.[g1*g2,h] = A.[g1,A.[g2,h]]) &
    (for g1,g2 being Element of G st
      (for h being object st h in H holds A.[g1,h] = A.[g2,h])
      holds g1 = g2)
  holds
    ex rho being Function of the carrier of G,bool [:H,H:] st
      rho is one-to-one &
      (for g being Element of G holds
        ex p being Function of H,H st
          p = rho.g &
          p is one-to-one &
          rng p = H &
          for h being object st h in H holds p.h = A.[g,h]) &
      (for g1,g2 being Element of G,
          p1,p2,p12 being Function of H,H st
        p1 = rho.g1 & p2 = rho.g2 & p12 = rho.(g1*g2)
        holds p12 = p1*p2)

end;

title: Q179208_cayley_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q179208,
% "Cayley's theorem": every group acting faithfully on an arbitrary type is
% multiplicatively isomorphic to the image subgroup of its permutation action.
% This file contains no proof.

Q179208_cayley_s_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  H: TYPE,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G,
  action: [G, H -> H]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  self_map: TYPE = [H -> H]
  self_map_set: TYPE = [self_map -> bool]
  representation: TYPE = [G -> self_map]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  action_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (h: H):
      action(one, h) = h)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G), (h: H):
        action(mul(x, y), h) = action(x, action(y, h)))

  faithful_action: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: G):
      (FORALL (h: H):
        action(x, h) = action(y, h))
        IMPLIES x = y

  identity_map: self_map =
    LAMBDA (h: H): h

  compose(p, q: self_map): self_map =
    LAMBDA (h: H): p(q(h))

  action_map(x: G): self_map =
    LAMBDA (h: H): action(x, h)

  injective_map(p: self_map): bool =
    FORALL (h, k: H):
      p(h) = p(k) IMPLIES h = k

  surjective_map(p: self_map): bool =
    FORALL (k: H):
      EXISTS (h: H): p(h) = k

  permutation(p: self_map): bool =
    injective_map(p)
      AND surjective_map(p)

  action_range: self_map_set =
    LAMBDA (p: self_map):
      permutation(p)
        AND EXISTS (x: G): p = action_map(x)

  permutation_subgroup(carrier: self_map_set): bool =
    (FORALL (p: self_map):
      carrier(p) IMPLIES permutation(p))
      AND carrier(identity_map)
      AND (FORALL (p, q: self_map):
        carrier(p) AND carrier(q) IMPLIES
          carrier(compose(p, q)))
      AND (FORALL (p: self_map):
        carrier(p) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (q: self_map):
            carrier(q)
              AND compose(p, q) = identity_map
              AND compose(q, p) = identity_map)

  multiplicative_equivalence_to_range(f: representation): bool =
    (FORALL (x: G): action_range(f(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        f(x) = f(y) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (p: self_map):
        action_range(p) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: G): f(x) = p)
      AND f(one) = identity_map
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        f(mul(x, y)) = compose(f(x), f(y)))

  subgroupOfMulAction: bool =
    (group_laws AND action_laws AND faithful_action)
      IMPLIES
        (permutation_subgroup(action_range)
          AND EXISTS (f: representation):
            (FORALL (x: G):
              f(x) = action_map(x))
              AND multiplicative_equivalence_to_range(f))

END Q179208_cayley_s_theorem

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q179467
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q179467), "Fourier theorem": Fourier inversion holds
-- pointwise at continuity points for an integrable function with integrable Fourier
-- transform, and globally when the function is continuous. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.FourierTransform

@[expose] public section

open MeasureTheory

open scoped FourierTransform RealInnerProductSpace

namespace Q179467

variable {V E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
  [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V] [FiniteDimensional ℝ V]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : V → E}

/-- Fourier inversion at a continuity point. -/
theorem integrable_fourier_inversion
    (hf : Integrable f) (h'f : Integrable (𝓕 f)) {v : V}
    (hv : ContinuousAt f v) : 𝓕⁻ (𝓕 f) v = f v := sorry

/-- Fourier inversion for a continuous function. -/
theorem continuous_fourier_inversion
    (h : Continuous f) (hf : Integrable f) (h'f : Integrable (𝓕 f)) :
    𝓕⁻ (𝓕 f) = f := sorry

end Q179467

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q179467
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q179467), "Fourier theorem": Fourier inversion
  for integrable functions on finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces,
  pointwise at continuity points and globally for continuous functions.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q179467_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q179467_empty {A : Type} : q179467_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q179467_full {A : Type} : q179467_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q179467_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q179467_set A) : q179467_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q179467_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q179467_set A) : q179467_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q179467_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q179467_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q179467_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q179467_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q179467_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q179467_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q179467_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q179467_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q179467_set (q179467_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q179467_empty /\
  (forall E F : q179467_set A,
    q179467_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q179467_set A,
    C E -> C (q179467_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q179467_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q179467_countable_union E)).

Inductive q179467_ennreal : Type :=
| q179467_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q179467_ennreal
| q179467_ennreal_infinity : q179467_ennreal.

Arguments q179467_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q179467_ennreal_zero : q179467_ennreal :=
  q179467_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q179467_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q179467_ennreal_finite a _,
    q179467_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q179467_ennreal_infinity,
    q179467_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q179467_ennreal_le
    (x y : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q179467_ennreal_finite a _,
    q179467_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q179467_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q179467_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q179467_ennreal_infinity,
    q179467_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q179467_ennreal_infinity,
    q179467_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q179467_ennreal_add
    (x y : q179467_ennreal) : q179467_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q179467_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q179467_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q179467_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q179467_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q179467_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q179467_ennreal) : q179467_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q179467_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q179467_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q179467_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q179467_ennreal_finite a _, q179467_ennreal_infinity
  | q179467_ennreal_infinity, q179467_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q179467_ennreal_zero
      else q179467_ennreal_infinity
  | q179467_ennreal_infinity, q179467_ennreal_infinity =>
      q179467_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q179467_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q179467_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q179467_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q179467_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q179467_ennreal_add
        (q179467_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q179467_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q179467_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q179467_ennreal,
      values value -> q179467_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q179467_ennreal,
      (forall value : q179467_ennreal,
        values value -> q179467_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q179467_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q179467_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q179467_ennreal)
    (sum : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q179467_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q179467_ennreal_eq value
          (q179467_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q179467_ennreal_represents
    (x : q179467_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q179467_ennreal_eq x
      (q179467_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q179467_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q179467_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q179467_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q179467_measurable : q179467_set A -> Prop;
  q179467_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q179467_set A,
      q179467_same_set E F ->
      (q179467_measurable E <-> q179467_measurable F);
  q179467_measurable_empty :
    q179467_measurable q179467_empty;
  q179467_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q179467_set A,
      q179467_measurable E ->
      q179467_measurable (q179467_complement E);
  q179467_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q179467_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q179467_measurable (E n)) ->
      q179467_measurable (q179467_countable_union E);
  q179467_measure : q179467_set A -> q179467_ennreal;
  q179467_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q179467_set A,
      q179467_same_set E F ->
      q179467_ennreal_eq
        (q179467_measure E) (q179467_measure F);
  q179467_measure_empty :
    q179467_ennreal_eq
      (q179467_measure q179467_empty)
      q179467_ennreal_zero;
  q179467_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q179467_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q179467_measurable (E n)) ->
      q179467_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q179467_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q179467_measure (E n))
        (q179467_measure (q179467_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q179467_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q179467_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q179467_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q179467_set A,
    q179467_measurable mu null_set /\
    q179467_ennreal_eq
      (q179467_measure mu null_set)
      q179467_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q179467_normed_real_vector_space (G : Type) : Type := {
  q179467_zero : G;
  q179467_add : G -> G -> G;
  q179467_neg : G -> G;
  q179467_smul : R -> G -> G;
  q179467_norm : G -> R;
  q179467_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q179467_add x (q179467_add y z) =
      q179467_add (q179467_add x y) z;
  q179467_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q179467_add x y = q179467_add y x;
  q179467_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q179467_add x q179467_zero = x;
  q179467_add_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q179467_add x (q179467_neg x) = q179467_zero;
  q179467_one_smul :
    forall x : G, q179467_smul 1 x = x;
  q179467_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q179467_smul (a * b) x =
      q179467_smul a (q179467_smul b x);
  q179467_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q179467_smul (a + b) x =
      q179467_add (q179467_smul a x) (q179467_smul b x);
  q179467_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : G),
      q179467_smul a (q179467_add x y) =
      q179467_add (q179467_smul a x) (q179467_smul a y);
  q179467_zero_smul :
    forall x : G, q179467_smul 0 x = q179467_zero;
  q179467_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q179467_smul a q179467_zero = q179467_zero;
  q179467_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q179467_norm x;
  q179467_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q179467_norm x = 0 <-> x = q179467_zero;
  q179467_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q179467_norm (q179467_add x y) <=
      q179467_norm x + q179467_norm y;
  q179467_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : G),
      q179467_norm (q179467_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q179467_norm x
}.

Arguments q179467_zero {G} _.
Arguments q179467_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q179467_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q179467_smul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q179467_norm {G} _ _.

Definition q179467_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q179467_add V x (q179467_neg V y).

Record q179467_complex : Type := {
  q179467_re : R;
  q179467_im : R
}.

Definition q179467_czero : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re := 0; q179467_im := 0 |}.

Definition q179467_cone : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re := 1; q179467_im := 0 |}.

Definition q179467_ci : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re := 0; q179467_im := 1 |}.

Definition q179467_cadd
    (z w : q179467_complex) : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re := q179467_re z + q179467_re w;
     q179467_im := q179467_im z + q179467_im w |}.

Definition q179467_cmul
    (z w : q179467_complex) : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re :=
       q179467_re z * q179467_re w -
       q179467_im z * q179467_im w;
     q179467_im :=
       q179467_re z * q179467_im w +
       q179467_im z * q179467_re w |}.

Definition q179467_real_to_complex (x : R) : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re := x; q179467_im := 0 |}.

Definition q179467_complex_modulus (z : q179467_complex) : R :=
  sqrt
    (q179467_re z * q179467_re z +
     q179467_im z * q179467_im z).

Definition q179467_complex_exp (z : q179467_complex) : q179467_complex :=
  {| q179467_re := exp (q179467_re z) * cos (q179467_im z);
     q179467_im := exp (q179467_re z) * sin (q179467_im z) |}.

Record q179467_complex_normed_space
    {E : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q179467_csmul : q179467_complex -> E -> E;
  q179467_csmul_one :
    forall x : E, q179467_csmul q179467_cone x = x;
  q179467_csmul_mul :
    forall (a b : q179467_complex) (x : E),
      q179467_csmul (q179467_cmul a b) x =
      q179467_csmul a (q179467_csmul b x);
  q179467_csmul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : q179467_complex) (x : E),
      q179467_csmul (q179467_cadd a b) x =
      q179467_add V (q179467_csmul a x) (q179467_csmul b x);
  q179467_csmul_add_vector :
    forall (a : q179467_complex) (x y : E),
      q179467_csmul a (q179467_add V x y) =
      q179467_add V (q179467_csmul a x) (q179467_csmul a y);
  q179467_csmul_real :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q179467_csmul (q179467_real_to_complex a) x =
      q179467_smul V a x;
  q179467_norm_csmul :
    forall (a : q179467_complex) (x : E),
      q179467_norm V (q179467_csmul a x) =
      q179467_complex_modulus a * q179467_norm V x
}.

Arguments q179467_csmul {E V} _ _ _.

Record q179467_real_inner_product_space
    {V : Type}
    (N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V) : Type := {
  q179467_inner : V -> V -> R;
  q179467_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q179467_inner (q179467_add N x y) z =
      q179467_inner x z + q179467_inner y z;
  q179467_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q179467_inner (q179467_smul N a x) y =
      a * q179467_inner x y;
  q179467_inner_symmetric :
    forall x y : V, q179467_inner x y = q179467_inner y x;
  q179467_inner_norm_sq :
    forall x : V,
      q179467_inner x x = q179467_norm N x * q179467_norm N x
}.

Arguments q179467_inner {V N} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q179467_coordinate_sum
    {V : Type}
    (N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> V) -> V :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> V) -> V with
  | O => fun _ => q179467_zero N
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q179467_add N
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q179467_coordinate_sum V N k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q179467_coordinate_sum {V} N n _.

Record q179467_finite_dimensional
    {V : Type}
    {N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q179467_real_inner_product_space N) : Type := {
  q179467_dimension : nat;
  q179467_basis : Fin.t q179467_dimension -> V;
  q179467_coordinates : V -> Fin.t q179467_dimension -> R;
  q179467_coordinate_reconstruction :
    forall x : V,
      x =
      q179467_coordinate_sum N q179467_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q179467_smul N
            (q179467_coordinates x i) (q179467_basis i));
  q179467_coordinates_add :
    forall (x y : V) (i : Fin.t q179467_dimension),
      q179467_coordinates (q179467_add N x y) i =
      q179467_coordinates x i + q179467_coordinates y i;
  q179467_coordinates_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : V) (i : Fin.t q179467_dimension),
      q179467_coordinates (q179467_smul N a x) i =
      a * q179467_coordinates x i;
  q179467_basis_orthonormal :
    forall i j : Fin.t q179467_dimension,
      q179467_inner H (q179467_basis i) (q179467_basis j) =
      if Fin.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0
}.

Arguments q179467_dimension {V N H} _.
Arguments q179467_basis {V N H} _ _.
Arguments q179467_coordinates {V N H} _ _ _.

Definition q179467_open {V : Type}
    (N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (U : q179467_set V) : Prop :=
  forall x : V,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : V,
        q179467_norm N (q179467_sub N y x) < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q179467_borel_set {V : Type}
    (N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (S : q179467_set V) : Prop :=
  forall classes : q179467_set (q179467_set V),
    q179467_sigma_class classes ->
    (forall U : q179467_set V, q179467_open N U -> classes U) ->
    classes S.

Definition q179467_unit_coordinate_cube
    {V : Type}
    {N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V}
    {H : q179467_real_inner_product_space N}
    (D : q179467_finite_dimensional H) : q179467_set V :=
  fun x =>
    forall i : Fin.t (q179467_dimension D),
      0 < q179467_coordinates D x i <= 1.

Definition q179467_is_euclidean_lebesgue_measure
    {V : Type}
    {N : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V}
    {H : q179467_real_inner_product_space N}
    (D : q179467_finite_dimensional H)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space V) : Prop :=
  (forall S : q179467_set V,
      q179467_measurable mu S <-> q179467_borel_set N S) /\
  (forall (a : V) (S : q179467_set V),
      q179467_ennreal_eq
        (q179467_measure mu
          (fun x => S (q179467_add N a x)))
        (q179467_measure mu S)) /\
  q179467_ennreal_eq
    (q179467_measure mu (q179467_unit_coordinate_cube D))
    (q179467_ennreal_finite 1 Rle_0_1).

Definition q179467_vector_sequence_converges {G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (limit : G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q179467_norm V
          (q179467_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q179467_vector_sequence_cauchy {G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q179467_norm V
          (q179467_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q179467_complete {G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> G,
    q179467_vector_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : G,
      q179467_vector_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q179467_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q179467_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q179467_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q179467_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q179467_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q179467_measurable_simple {A G : Type}
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q179467_set A),
    q179467_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q179467_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q179467_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q179467_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q179467_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q179467_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q179467_nnreal_value : R;
  q179467_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q179467_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q179467_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q179467_nonnegative_real) : q179467_ennreal :=
  q179467_ennreal_finite
    (q179467_nnreal_value x)
    (q179467_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q179467_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q179467_ennreal)
    (value : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q179467_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q179467_set A),
    q179467_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q179467_ennreal_le
        (q179467_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q179467_ennreal_eq value
      (q179467_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q179467_ennreal_mul
            (q179467_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q179467_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q179467_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q179467_ennreal)
    (value : q179467_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q179467_ennreal_supremum
    (q179467_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q179467_norm_ennreal {G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x : G) : q179467_ennreal :=
  q179467_ennreal_finite
    (q179467_norm V x)
    (q179467_norm_nonnegative V x).

Definition q179467_integrable {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  q179467_ae_strongly_measurable V mu f /\
  exists value : q179467_ennreal,
    q179467_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q179467_norm_ennreal V (f x)) value /\
    q179467_ennreal_finite_value value.

Fixpoint q179467_vector_sum {G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => q179467_zero V
  | S k =>
      q179467_add V
        (q179467_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q179467_weighted_cell_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (cell : q179467_set A)
    (coefficient value : G) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q179467_zero V /\
    value = q179467_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q179467_ennreal_represents
      (q179467_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value = q179467_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q179467_simple_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q179467_set A),
    q179467_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q179467_weighted_cell_value
        V mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q179467_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q179467_l1_approximates {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q179467_ennreal,
        q179467_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q179467_norm_ennreal V
              (q179467_sub V (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q179467_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q179467_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q179467_standard_bochner_integral_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
         (integrals : nat -> G),
    (forall n : nat,
      q179467_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q179467_simple_integral_has_value
        V mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q179467_l1_approximates V mu approximants f /\
    q179467_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q179467_bochner_integral {A G : Type}
    (V : q179467_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : G :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : G,
            q179467_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits (q179467_zero V))
        (fun value : G =>
          q179467_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value)
  | right _ => q179467_zero V
  end.

Definition q179467_continuous_at
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) (v : V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : V,
        q179467_norm NV (q179467_sub NV w v) < delta ->
        q179467_norm NE
          (q179467_sub NE (f w) (f v)) < epsilon.

Definition q179467_continuous
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) : Prop :=
  forall v : V, q179467_continuous_at NV NE f v.

Definition q179467_fourier_character (t : R) : q179467_complex :=
  q179467_complex_exp
    (q179467_cmul
      (q179467_real_to_complex (- (2 * PI * t)))
      q179467_ci).

Definition q179467_inverse_fourier_character
    (t : R) : q179467_complex :=
  q179467_complex_exp
    (q179467_cmul
      (q179467_real_to_complex (2 * PI * t))
      q179467_ci).

Definition q179467_fourier_transform
    {V E : Type}
    {NV : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q179467_real_inner_product_space NV)
    {NE : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (CE : q179467_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space V)
    (f : V -> E) : V -> E :=
  fun w =>
    q179467_bochner_integral NE mu
      (fun x =>
        q179467_csmul CE
          (q179467_fourier_character
            (q179467_inner H x w))
          (f x)).

Definition q179467_inverse_fourier_transform
    {V E : Type}
    {NV : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q179467_real_inner_product_space NV)
    {NE : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (CE : q179467_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q179467_measure_space V)
    (f : V -> E) : V -> E :=
  fun v =>
    q179467_bochner_integral NE mu
      (fun w =>
        q179467_csmul CE
          (q179467_inverse_fourier_character
            (q179467_inner H w v))
          (f w)).

Theorem MeasureTheory_Integrable_fourier_inversion :
  forall (V E : Type)
         (NV : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
         (H : q179467_real_inner_product_space NV)
         (D : q179467_finite_dimensional H)
         (NE : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (CE : q179467_complex_normed_space NE)
         (mu : q179467_measure_space V)
         (f : V -> E) (v : V),
    q179467_is_euclidean_lebesgue_measure D mu ->
    q179467_complete NE ->
    q179467_integrable NE mu f ->
    q179467_integrable NE mu
      (q179467_fourier_transform H CE mu f) ->
    q179467_continuous_at NV NE f v ->
    q179467_inverse_fourier_transform H CE mu
      (q179467_fourier_transform H CE mu f) v = f v.
Admitted.

Theorem Continuous_fourier_inversion :
  forall (V E : Type)
         (NV : q179467_normed_real_vector_space V)
         (H : q179467_real_inner_product_space NV)
         (D : q179467_finite_dimensional H)
         (NE : q179467_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (CE : q179467_complex_normed_space NE)
         (mu : q179467_measure_space V)
         (f : V -> E),
    q179467_is_euclidean_lebesgue_measure D mu ->
    q179467_complete NE ->
    q179467_continuous NV NE f ->
    q179467_integrable NE mu f ->
    q179467_integrable NE mu
      (q179467_fourier_transform H CE mu f) ->
    forall v : V,
      q179467_inverse_fourier_transform H CE mu
        (q179467_fourier_transform H CE mu f) v = f v.
Admitted.

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q179467 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q179467), "Fourier theorem": Fourier
  inversion for integrable functions from a finite-dimensional real
  inner-product space to a complete complex normed space, pointwise at
  continuity points and globally for continuous functions. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q179467_fourier_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration" "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition q179467_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179467_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q179467_orthonormal_basis ::
    "'v::real_inner set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179467_orthonormal_basis B \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite_dimensional_vector_space
      ((*\<^sub>R) :: real \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v) B \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> B. \<forall>v \<in> B. inner u v = (if u = v then 1 else 0))"

definition q179467_parallelotope ::
    "'v::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q179467_parallelotope B =
    {(\<Sum>b\<in>B. c b *\<^sub>R b) | c. \<forall>b \<in> B. 0 \<le> c b \<and> c b < 1}"

definition q179467_lebesgue_measure ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179467_lebesgue_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
    sets M = sets borel \<and>
    (\<forall>a. distr M borel ((+) a) = M) \<and>
    (\<forall>B. q179467_orthonormal_basis B \<longrightarrow>
      measure M (q179467_parallelotope B) = 1)"

definition q179467_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179467_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
      (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f x))"

definition q179467_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179467_has_bochner_integral M f I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q179467_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (norm (f x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> I))"

definition q179467_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q179467_integrable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>I. q179467_has_bochner_integral M f I)"

definition q179467_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q179467_bochner_integral M f =
    (if \<exists>I. q179467_has_bochner_integral M f I
     then THE I. q179467_has_bochner_integral M f I
     else 0)"

definition q179467_fourier ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q179467_fourier M cscale f w =
    q179467_bochner_integral M
      (\<lambda>x. cscale (exp (- (\<i> * of_real (2 * pi * inner w x)))) (f x))"

definition q179467_fourier_inverse ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q179467_fourier_inverse M cscale f v =
    q179467_bochner_integral M
      (\<lambda>w. cscale (exp (\<i> * of_real (2 * pi * inner w v))) (f w))"

theorem fourier_inversion_at_continuity_point:
  fixes M :: "'v::real_inner measure"
    and cscale :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and v :: 'v
  assumes finite_dimensional:
      "\<exists>B. q179467_orthonormal_basis B"
    and lebesgue_measure: "q179467_lebesgue_measure M"
    and complex_space: "q179467_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and f_integrable: "q179467_integrable M f"
    and fourier_integrable:
      "q179467_integrable M (q179467_fourier M cscale f)"
    and continuous_at: "continuous (at v) f"
  shows
    "q179467_fourier_inverse M cscale (q179467_fourier M cscale f) v = f v"
  sorry

theorem continuous_fourier_inversion:
  fixes M :: "'v::real_inner measure"
    and cscale :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes finite_dimensional:
      "\<exists>B. q179467_orthonormal_basis B"
    and lebesgue_measure: "q179467_lebesgue_measure M"
    and complex_space: "q179467_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and continuous: "continuous_on UNIV f"
    and f_integrable: "q179467_integrable M f"
    and fourier_integrable:
      "q179467_integrable M (q179467_fourier M cscale f)"
  shows
    "q179467_fourier_inverse M cscale (q179467_fourier M cscale f) = f"
  sorry

end

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q179467,
  "Fourier theorem": Fourier inversion for integrable Banach-valued functions
  on finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces, pointwise at continuity
  points and extensionally for continuous functions. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let q179467_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q179467_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q179467_output;;
let q179467_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q179467_formatter path);;
let q179467_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q179467_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q179467_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q179467_formatter ();;
close_out q179467_output;;
if not q179467_loaded then failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q179467_FOURIER_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let cadd =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
   let cmul =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
         FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
   let cmod =
      \(z:real#real).
        sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in
   let cone = (&1,&0) in
   let czero = (&0,&0) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:V) /\
        (!s:V->bool. events s ==> events ((:V) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->V->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:V | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:V->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->V->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:V | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (P:V->bool).
        ?N:V->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:V | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let real_vector_space =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
       (smulV:real->V->V).
        (!x y:V. addV x y = addV y x) /\
        (!x y z:V. addV (addV x y) z = addV x (addV y z)) /\
        (!x:V. addV x zeroV = x) /\
        (!x:V. addV x (negV x) = zeroV) /\
        (!x:V. negV (negV x) = x) /\
        (!x:V. smulV (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real x:V.
           smulV (a * b) x = smulV a (smulV b x)) /\
        (!a b:real x:V.
           smulV (a + b) x = addV (smulV a x) (smulV b x)) /\
        (!a:real x y:V.
           smulV a (addV x y) = addV (smulV a x) (smulV a y)) /\
        (!x:V. smulV (&0) x = zeroV) /\
        (!a:real. smulV a zeroV = zeroV) in
   let real_inner_product =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (inner:V->V->real).
        (!x y z:V.
           inner (addV x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
        (!a:real x y:V.
           inner (smulV a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
        (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
        (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
        (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zeroV) in
   let vnorm =
      \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V).
        sqrt(inner x x) in
   let finite_linear_combination =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (n:num) (basis:num->V) (coeff:num->real) (x:V).
        ?partial:num->V.
          partial 0 = zeroV /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   addV (partial i) (smulV (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial n = x in
   let finite_dimensional =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V).
        ?n:num basis:num->V.
          (!x:V.
             ?coeff:num->real.
               finite_linear_combination
                 zeroV addV smulV n basis coeff x) /\
          (!coeff:num->real.
             finite_linear_combination
               zeroV addV smulV n basis coeff zeroV
             ==> !i. i < n ==> coeff i = &0) in
   let metric_open =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (s:V->bool).
        !x:V.
          x IN s
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:V.
                  vnorm inner (addV y (negV x)) < epsilon
                  ==> y IN s in
   let borel_space =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (events:(V->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:V->bool.
           metric_open addV negV inner s ==> events s) /\
        (!other:(V->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!s:V->bool.
              metric_open addV negV inner s ==> other s)
           ==> !s:V->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < epsilon in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (u:num->E) (l:E).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n
                ==> normE (addE (u n) (negE l)) < epsilon in
   let complex_normed_vector_space =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real).
        (!x y:E. addE x y = addE y x) /\
        (!x y z:E. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
        (!x:E. addE x zeroE = x) /\
        (!x:E. addE x (negE x) = zeroE) /\
        (!x:E. negE (negE x) = x) /\
        (!x:E. csmul cone x = x) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:E.
           csmul (cmul a b) x = csmul a (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:E.
           csmul (cadd a b) x =
           addE (csmul a x) (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a:real#real x y:E.
           csmul a (addE x y) =
           addE (csmul a x) (csmul a y)) /\
        (!x:E. csmul czero x = zeroE) /\
        (!a:real#real. csmul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
        (!x:E. &0 <= normE x) /\
        (!x:E. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
        (!a:real#real x:E.
           normE (csmul a x) = cmod a * normE x) /\
        (!x y:E. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
   let complete_space =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real).
        !u:num->E.
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                   N <= m /\ N <= n
                   ==> normE
                         (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon)
          ==> ?l:E. vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE u l in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (s:V->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:V)) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:V | s x = c}) in
   let simple_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (s:V->E).
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:V)) /\
        (!c:E. events {x:V | s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (h:V->real).
        ?s:num->V->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar events (s n)) /\
          (!x:V. scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:V->E).
        ?s:num->V->E.
          (!n. simple_vector events (s n)) /\
          (!x:V.
             vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE
               (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        ?g:V->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar events g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:V->E).
        ?g:V->E.
          strongly_measurable_vector
            events zeroE addE negE normE g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let integrable_simple_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (s:V->real).
        simple_scalar events s /\
        (!c:real.
           c IN IMAGE s (:V) /\ ~(c = &0)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:V | s x = c}))) in
   let integrable_simple_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (zeroE:E) (s:V->E).
        simple_vector events s /\
        (!c:E.
           c IN IMAGE s (:V) /\ ~(c = zeroE)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:V | s x = c}))) in
   let simple_scalar_integral =
      \(mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (s:V->real) (z:real).
        ?n:num enum:num->real partial:num->real.
          (!c:real.
             c IN IMAGE s (:V) <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = &0 /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 SND (mu {x:V | s x = enum i}) * enum i +
                 partial i) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_vector_integral =
      \(mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (s:V->E) (z:E).
        ?n:num enum:num->E partial:num->E.
          (!c:E.
             c IN IMAGE s (:V) <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = zeroE /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 addE
                   (csmul
                     (SND (mu {x:V | s x = enum i}),&0)
                     (enum i))
                   (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (u:real).
        !s:V->real z:real.
          integrable_simple_scalar events mu s /\
          (!x:V. &0 <= s x /\ s x <= h x) /\
          simple_scalar_integral mu s z
          ==> z <= u in
   let has_nonnegative_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (r:real).
        &0 <= r /\
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound events mu h r /\
        (!u:real.
           &0 <= u /\
           nonnegative_integral_upper_bound events mu h u
           ==> r <= u) in
   let scalar_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        ae_strongly_measurable_scalar events mu h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral events mu
             (\x:V. abs(h x)) r) in
   let vector_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:V->E).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector
          events mu zeroE addE negE normE h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral events mu
             (\x:V. normE(h x)) r) in
   let has_bochner_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (h:V->E) (z:E).
        ?s:num->V->E ints:num->E.
          (!n. integrable_simple_vector events mu zeroE (s n)) /\
          (!n. simple_vector_integral
                 mu zeroE addE csmul (s n) (ints n)) /\
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                   N <= n
                   ==> ?d:real.
                         has_nonnegative_integral events mu
                           (\x:V.
                              normE
                                (addE (s n x) (negE (h x)))) d /\
                         d < epsilon) /\
          vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE ints z in
   let bochner_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (h:V->E).
        if complete_space zeroE addE negE normE /\
           vector_integrable
             events mu zeroE addE negE normE h
        then @z:E.
               has_bochner_integral
                 events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE h z
        else zeroE in
   let normalized_add_haar_measure =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
       (inner:V->V->real)
       (events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real).
        (!a:V s:V->bool.
           events s ==> mu (IMAGE (addV a) s) = mu s) /\
        (!R:real.
           ~(FST
             (mu {x:V | vnorm inner x <= R}))) /\
        has_nonnegative_integral events mu
          (\x:V. exp(--pi * vnorm inner x pow 2)) (&1) in
   let continuous_at =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:V->E) (v:V).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !w:V.
                  vnorm inner (addV w (negV v)) < delta
                  ==> normE
                        (addE (f w) (negE (f v))) < epsilon in
   let continuous =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:V->E).
        !v:V.
          continuous_at
            addV negV inner addE negE normE f v in
   let fourier_character =
      \(inner:V->V->real) (sign:real) (v:V) (w:V).
        (cos(&2 * pi * inner v w),
         sign * sin(&2 * pi * inner v w)) in
   let fourier =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (inner:V->V->real) (f:V->E) (v:V).
        bochner_integral
          events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE
          (\w:V.
             csmul (fourier_character inner (-- &1) v w) (f w)) in
   let fourier_inv =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (inner:V->V->real) (f:V->E) (v:V).
        bochner_integral
          events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE
          (\w:V.
             csmul (fourier_character inner (&1) v w) (f w)) in
   !zeroV:V
    addV:V->V->V
    negV:V->V
    smulV:real->V->V
    inner:V->V->real
    events:(V->bool)->bool
    mu:(V->bool)->bool#real
    zeroE:E
    addE:E->E->E
    negE:E->E
    csmul:(real#real)->E->E
    normE:E->real.
      real_vector_space zeroV addV negV smulV /\
      real_inner_product zeroV addV smulV inner /\
      finite_dimensional zeroV addV smulV /\
      borel_space addV negV inner events /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      normalized_add_haar_measure
        zeroV addV negV inner events mu /\
      complex_normed_vector_space zeroE addE negE csmul normE /\
      complete_space zeroE addE negE normE
      ==>
      ((!f:V->E v:V.
          vector_integrable
            events mu zeroE addE negE normE f /\
          vector_integrable
            events mu zeroE addE negE normE
            (fourier
              events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner f) /\
          continuous_at
            addV negV inner addE negE normE f v
          ==> fourier_inv
                events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner
                (fourier
                  events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner f) v =
              f v) /\
       (!f:V->E.
          continuous
            addV negV inner addE negE normE f /\
          vector_integrable
            events mu zeroE addE negE normE f /\
          vector_integrable
            events mu zeroE addE negE normE
            (fourier
              events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner f)
          ==> fourier_inv
                events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner
                (fourier
                  events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner f) =
              f))`;;

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem

;; "Fourier theorem": for an integrable Banach-valued function on a
;; finite-dimensional real inner-product space whose Fourier transform is
;; integrable, Fourier inversion recovers the function at every continuity
;; point, and everywhere when the function is continuous. This file contains
;; no proof.
