(defun q179467-positive-p (real-type x)
  (q179467-less real-type (q179467-zero real-type) x))

(defun q179467-leq (real-type x y)
  (not (q179467-less real-type y x)))

(defun q179467-abs (real-type x)
  (if (q179467-less real-type x (q179467-zero real-type))
      (q179467-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q179467-natural-cast (type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q179467-zero type)
    (q179467-add
     type
     (q179467-one type)
     (q179467-natural-cast type (- n 1)))))

(defun q179467-integer-cast (type n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q179467-negate
       type
       (q179467-natural-cast type (- n)))
    (q179467-natural-cast type (nfix n))))


(defun q179467-vector-sum
    (real-type space basis coordinates vector n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q179467-zero space)
    (let ((i (- n 1)))
      (q179467-add
       space
       (q179467-vector-sum
        real-type space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q179467-smul
        real-type space
        (q179467-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q179467-basis-at basis i))))))


;; Complete ordered real field and its canonical complexification.

(defun-sk q179467-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p type x)
      (q179467-member-p type y)
      (q179467-member-p type z))
     (and
      (q179467-member-p type (q179467-add type x y))
      (q179467-member-p type (q179467-multiply type x y))
      (q179467-member-p type (q179467-negate type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q179467-zero type)))
       (q179467-member-p type (q179467-inverse type x)))
      (equal
       (q179467-add type (q179467-add type x y) z)
       (q179467-add type x (q179467-add type y z)))
      (equal (q179467-add type x y) (q179467-add type y x))
      (equal (q179467-add type x (q179467-zero type)) x)
      (equal
       (q179467-add type x (q179467-negate type x))
       (q179467-zero type))
      (equal
       (q179467-multiply type (q179467-multiply type x y) z)
       (q179467-multiply type x (q179467-multiply type y z)))
      (equal
       (q179467-multiply type x y)
       (q179467-multiply type y x))
      (equal (q179467-multiply type x (q179467-one type)) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q179467-zero type)))
       (equal
        (q179467-multiply type x (q179467-inverse type x))
        (q179467-one type)))
      (equal
       (q179467-multiply type x (q179467-add type y z))
       (q179467-add
        type
        (q179467-multiply type x y)
        (q179467-multiply type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q179467-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type x)
      (q179467-member-p real-type y)
      (q179467-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q179467-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q179467-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q179467-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q179467-less real-type x y)
        (q179467-less real-type y z))
       (q179467-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q179467-less real-type x y)
       (q179467-less
        real-type
        (q179467-add real-type x z)
        (q179467-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q179467-positive-p real-type x)
        (q179467-positive-p real-type y))
       (q179467-positive-p
        real-type
        (q179467-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun q179467-distance
    (real-type type x y)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (q179467-norm
   type
   (q179467-add type x (q179467-negate type y))))

(defun-sk q179467-norm-values-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p type x)
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type (q179467-norm type x))
      (q179467-leq
       real-type
       (q179467-zero real-type)
       (q179467-norm type x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q179467-norm type x)
        (q179467-zero real-type))
       (equal x (q179467-zero type)))))))

(defun-sk q179467-norm-triangle-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p type x)
      (q179467-member-p type y))
     (q179467-leq
      real-type
      (q179467-norm type (q179467-add type x y))
      (q179467-add
       real-type
       (q179467-norm type x)
       (q179467-norm type y))))))

(defun q179467-norm-laws-p (real-type type)
  (and
   (q179467-norm-values-p real-type type)
   (q179467-norm-triangle-p real-type type)))

(defun-sk q179467-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))
     (q179467-less
      real-type
      (q179467-distance
       real-type type
       (q179467-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-convergence-start-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q179467-convergence-tail-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q179467-converges-p
    (real-type type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q179467-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q179467-convergence-start-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m) (natp n) (natp start)
      (<= start m) (<= start n))
     (q179467-less
      real-type
      (q179467-distance
       real-type type
       (q179467-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q179467-sequence-at sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-cauchy-start-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q179467-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q179467-cauchy-p (real-type type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q179467-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q179467-cauchy-start-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-sequence-in-type-p (type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q179467-member-p
      type
      (q179467-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q179467-limit-exists-p
    (real-type type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q179467-member-p type limit)
     (q179467-converges-p
      real-type type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q179467-complete-p (real-type type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-sequence-in-type-p type sequence)
      (q179467-cauchy-p real-type type sequence))
     (q179467-limit-exists-p
      real-type type sequence))))

(defun-sk q179467-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q179467-less
      real-type x
      (q179467-natural-cast real-type n)))))

(defun-sk q179467-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p real-type x)
     (q179467-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q179467-real-norm-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (equal
       (q179467-norm real-type x)
       (q179467-abs real-type x))
      (equal (q179467-star real-type x) x)
      (equal
       (q179467-real-part real-type real-type x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q179467-imag-part real-type real-type x)
       (q179467-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q179467-of-real real-type real-type x)
       x)))))

(defun q179467-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q179467-member-p real-type (q179467-zero real-type))
   (q179467-member-p real-type (q179467-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q179467-zero real-type)
     (q179467-one real-type)))
   (q179467-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q179467-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q179467-positive-p real-type (q179467-one real-type))
   (q179467-real-norm-laws-p real-type)
   (q179467-complete-p real-type real-type)
   (q179467-archimedean-p real-type)))

(defun-sk q179467-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p complex-type z)
     (let* ((re (q179467-real-part real-type complex-type z))
            (im (q179467-imag-part real-type complex-type z))
            (re-z (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type re))
            (im-z
             (q179467-multiply
              complex-type
              (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type im)
              (q179467-imaginary-unit complex-type))))
       (and
        (q179467-member-p real-type re)
        (q179467-member-p real-type im)
        (equal z (q179467-add complex-type re-z im-z))
        (equal
         (q179467-star complex-type z)
         (q179467-add
          complex-type re-z
          (q179467-negate complex-type im-z)))
        (equal
         (q179467-multiply
          real-type
          (q179467-norm complex-type z)
          (q179467-norm complex-type z))
         (q179467-add
          real-type
          (q179467-multiply real-type re re)
          (q179467-multiply real-type im im))))))))

(defun-sk q179467-of-real-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type x)
      (q179467-member-p real-type y))
     (and
      (q179467-member-p
       complex-type
       (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type x))
      (equal
       (q179467-real-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       x)
      (equal
       (q179467-imag-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       (q179467-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q179467-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q179467-add real-type x y))
       (q179467-add
        complex-type
        (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type y)))
      (equal
       (q179467-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q179467-multiply real-type x y))
       (q179467-multiply
        complex-type
        (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type y)))))))

(defun q179467-complex-field-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (and
   (q179467-real-field-p real-type)
   (q179467-member-p complex-type (q179467-zero complex-type))
   (q179467-member-p complex-type (q179467-one complex-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q179467-zero complex-type)
     (q179467-one complex-type)))
   (q179467-field-laws-p complex-type)
   (q179467-of-real-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (equal
    (q179467-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q179467-zero real-type))
    (q179467-zero complex-type))
   (equal
    (q179467-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q179467-one real-type))
    (q179467-one complex-type))
   (equal
    (q179467-multiply
     complex-type
     (q179467-imaginary-unit complex-type)
     (q179467-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q179467-negate complex-type (q179467-one complex-type)))
   (equal
    (q179467-real-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q179467-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q179467-zero real-type))
   (equal
    (q179467-imag-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q179467-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q179467-one real-type))
   (q179467-complex-coordinate-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q179467-norm-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q179467-complete-p real-type complex-type)))

;; Real inner-product domains and complex Banach codomains.

(defun-sk q179467-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q179467-member-p scalar-type b)
      (q179467-member-p space x)
      (q179467-member-p space y)
      (q179467-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q179467-member-p space (q179467-add space x y))
      (q179467-member-p space (q179467-negate space x))
      (q179467-member-p
       space (q179467-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (equal
       (q179467-add space (q179467-add space x y) z)
       (q179467-add space x (q179467-add space y z)))
      (equal (q179467-add space x y) (q179467-add space y x))
      (equal (q179467-add space x (q179467-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q179467-add space x (q179467-negate space x))
       (q179467-zero space))
      (equal
       (q179467-smul
        scalar-type space (q179467-one scalar-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q179467-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q179467-multiply scalar-type a b) x)
       (q179467-smul
        scalar-type space a
        (q179467-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q179467-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q179467-add scalar-type a b) x)
       (q179467-add
        space
        (q179467-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q179467-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q179467-smul
        scalar-type space a (q179467-add space x y))
       (q179467-add
        space
        (q179467-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q179467-smul scalar-type space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q179467-normed-space-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q179467-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q179467-norm
       space
       (q179467-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (q179467-multiply
       real-type
       (q179467-norm scalar-type a)
       (q179467-norm space x))))))

(defun-sk q179467-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q179467-member-p space x)
      (q179467-member-p space y)
      (q179467-member-p space z))
     (let ((xy (q179467-inner scalar-type space x y))
           (xx (q179467-inner scalar-type space x x)))
       (and
        (q179467-member-p scalar-type xy)
        (equal
         (q179467-inner
          scalar-type space x (q179467-add space y z))
         (q179467-add
          scalar-type xy
          (q179467-inner scalar-type space x z)))
        (equal
         (q179467-inner
          scalar-type space x
          (q179467-smul scalar-type space a y))
         (q179467-multiply scalar-type a xy))
        (equal
         (q179467-inner scalar-type space y x)
         (q179467-star scalar-type xy))
        (equal
         (q179467-multiply
          real-type
          (q179467-norm space x)
          (q179467-norm space x))
         (q179467-real-part real-type scalar-type xx))
        (iff
         (equal xx (q179467-zero scalar-type))
         (equal x (q179467-zero space))))))))

(defun-sk q179467-real-smul-compatibility-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (r x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type r)
      (q179467-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q179467-smul real-type space r x)
      (q179467-smul
       complex-type space
       (q179467-of-real real-type complex-type r)
       x)))))

(defun-sk q179467-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (i j x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
      (q179467-member-p space (q179467-basis-at basis i)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp i) (natp j)
       (< i dimension) (< j dimension))
      (equal
       (q179467-inner
        real-type space
        (q179467-basis-at basis i)
        (q179467-basis-at basis j))
       (if (equal i j)
           (q179467-one real-type)
         (q179467-zero real-type))))
     (implies
      (q179467-member-p space x)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
        (q179467-member-p
         real-type
         (q179467-coordinate coordinates x i)))
       (equal
        x
        (q179467-vector-sum
         real-type space basis coordinates x dimension)))))))

(defun q179467-finite-real-inner-product-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (and
   (natp dimension)
   (q179467-member-p space (q179467-zero space))
   (q179467-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q179467-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q179467-normed-space-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q179467-inner-product-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q179467-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)))

(defun q179467-complex-banach-space-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (and
   (q179467-member-p space (q179467-zero space))
   (q179467-vector-space-laws-p complex-type space)
   (q179467-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q179467-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q179467-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q179467-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type real-type space)
   (q179467-real-smul-compatibility-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q179467-complete-p real-type space)))

(defun-sk q179467-sets-equal-on-p (space left right)

(defun-sk q179467-full-set-law-p (space)

(defun-sk q179467-countable-union-set-law-p (space)

     (q179467-set-member-p

(defun-sk q179467-open-ball-set-law-p (real-type space)
  (forall (center radius x)
    (iff
     (q179467-set-member-p
      (q179467-open-ball-set space center radius) x)
     (and
      (q179467-member-p space x)
      (q179467-member-p space center)

       (q179467-distance real-type space x center)

(defun-sk q179467-preimage-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function set x)
    (iff
     (q179467-set-member-p
      (q179467-preimage-set function set) x)
     (and
      (q179467-member-p domain x)
      (q179467-set-member-p
       set (q179467-function-at function x))))))

(defun-sk q179467-translate-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set shift x)
    (iff
     (q179467-set-member-p
      (q179467-translate-set space set shift) x)
     (and
      (q179467-member-p space x)
      (q179467-set-member-p
       set
       (q179467-add
        space x (q179467-negate space shift)))))))

(defun q179467-set-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type space)
  (and
   (q179467-full-set-law-p space)
   (q179467-complement-set-law-p space)
   (q179467-countable-union-set-law-p space)
   (q179467-open-ball-set-law-p real-type space)
   (q179467-translate-set-law-p space)))

(defun-sk q179467-sequence-measurable-p (family sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q179467-family-member-p
      family
      (q179467-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q179467-family-valid-sets-p (space family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q179467-family-member-p family set)
     (q179467-valid-set-p space set))))

(defun-sk q179467-family-extensional-p (space family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-family-member-p family left)
      (q179467-valid-set-p space right)
      (q179467-sets-equal-on-p space left right))
     (q179467-family-member-p family right))))

(defun-sk q179467-sigma-algebra-closure-p (space family)
  (forall (set sequence)
    (and
     (q179467-family-member-p family (q179467-full-set space))
     (implies
      (q179467-family-member-p family set)
      (q179467-family-member-p
       family (q179467-complement-set space set)))
     (implies
      (q179467-sequence-measurable-p family sequence)
      (q179467-family-member-p
       family
       (q179467-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun q179467-sigma-algebra-p (space family)
  (and
   (q179467-family-valid-sets-p space family)
   (q179467-family-extensional-p space family)
   (q179467-sigma-algebra-closure-p space family)))

(defun-sk q179467-balls-measurable-p
    (real-type space family)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p space center)
      (q179467-member-p real-type radius)
      (q179467-positive-p real-type radius))
     (q179467-family-member-p
      family
      (q179467-open-ball-set space center radius)))))

(defun-sk q179467-family-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q179467-family-member-p left set)
     (q179467-family-member-p right set))))

(defun-sk q179467-borel-minimal-p
    (real-type space borel)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-sigma-algebra-p space candidate)
      (q179467-balls-measurable-p
       real-type space candidate))
     (q179467-family-subset-p borel candidate))))

(defun q179467-borel-space-p
    (real-type space borel)
  (and
   (q179467-sigma-algebra-p space borel)
   (q179467-balls-measurable-p real-type space borel)
   (q179467-borel-minimal-p real-type space borel)))

(defun q179467-ennreal-p (real-type x)
  (or
   (equal x :q179467-top)
   (and
    (consp x)
    (equal (car x) :q179467-finite)
    (q179467-member-p real-type (cdr x))
    (q179467-leq
     real-type (q179467-zero real-type) (cdr x)))))

(defun q179467-ennreal-finite (x)
  (cons :q179467-finite x))

(defun q179467-ennreal-add (real-type x y)
  (if (or
       (equal x :q179467-top)
       (equal y :q179467-top))
      :q179467-top
    (q179467-ennreal-finite
     (q179467-add real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun q179467-ennreal-leq-p (real-type x y)
  (or
   (equal y :q179467-top)
   (and
    (not (equal x :q179467-top))
    (q179467-leq real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun-sk q179467-disjoint-sequence-p
    (space sequence)
  (forall (i j x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i) (natp j)
      (not (equal i j))
      (q179467-member-p space x))
     (not
      (and
       (q179467-set-member-p
        (q179467-sequence-at sequence i) x)
       (q179467-set-member-p
        (q179467-sequence-at sequence j) x))))))

(defun q179467-ennreal-partial-sum
    (real-type measure sequence n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q179467-ennreal-finite (q179467-zero real-type))
    (q179467-ennreal-add
     real-type
     (q179467-ennreal-partial-sum
      real-type measure sequence (- n 1))
     (q179467-measure-value
      measure
      (q179467-sequence-at sequence (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q179467-ennreal-upper-bound-p
    (real-type measure sequence bound)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q179467-ennreal-leq-p
      real-type
      (q179467-ennreal-partial-sum
       real-type measure sequence n)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q179467-ennreal-series-value-p
    (real-type measure sequence value)
  (forall (bound)
    (iff
     (q179467-ennreal-upper-bound-p
      real-type measure sequence bound)
     (q179467-ennreal-leq-p real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q179467-countable-additivity-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q179467-disjoint-sequence-p space sequence))
     (q179467-ennreal-series-value-p
      real-type
      measure
      sequence
      (q179467-measure-value
       measure
       (q179467-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun-sk q179467-measure-values-p (real-type measure)
  (forall (set)
    (q179467-ennreal-p
     real-type
     (q179467-measure-value measure set))))

(defun-sk q179467-measure-extensional-p (space measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-valid-set-p space left)
      (q179467-valid-set-p space right)
      (q179467-sets-equal-on-p space left right))
     (equal
      (q179467-measure-value measure left)
      (q179467-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q179467-empty-measurable-zero-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-family-member-p measurable set)
      (q179467-empty-on-p space set))
     (equal
      (q179467-measure-value measure set)
      (q179467-ennreal-finite
       (q179467-zero real-type))))))

(defun q179467-measure-space-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (and
   (q179467-sigma-algebra-p space measurable)
   (q179467-measure-values-p real-type measure)
   (q179467-measure-extensional-p space measure)
   (q179467-empty-measurable-zero-p
    real-type space measurable measure)
   (equal
    (q179467-measure-value
     measure
     (q179467-complement-set
      space (q179467-full-set space)))
    (q179467-ennreal-finite (q179467-zero real-type)))
   (q179467-countable-additivity-p
    real-type space measurable measure)))

(defun q179467-unit-coordinates-p
    (real-type coordinates x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      t
    (let ((c
           (q179467-coordinate
            coordinates x (- n 1))))
      (and
       (q179467-leq
        real-type (q179467-zero real-type) c)
       (q179467-less
        real-type c (q179467-one real-type))
       (q179467-unit-coordinates-p
        real-type coordinates x (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q179467-unit-cell-coordinate-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q179467-set-member-p
      (q179467-unit-cell-set
       space basis coordinates dimension)
      x)
     (and
      (q179467-member-p space x)
      (q179467-unit-coordinates-p
       real-type coordinates x dimension)))))

(defun-sk q179467-translation-invariant-p
    (space measurable measure)
  (forall (set shift)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-family-member-p measurable set)
      (q179467-member-p space shift))
     (equal
      (q179467-measure-value
       measure
       (q179467-translate-set space set shift))
      (q179467-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun q179467-volume-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension measurable measure)
  (and
   (q179467-borel-space-p real-type space measurable)
   (q179467-measure-space-p
    real-type space measurable measure)
   (q179467-unit-cell-coordinate-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
   (q179467-family-member-p
    measurable
    (q179467-unit-cell-set
     space basis coordinates dimension))
   (equal
    (q179467-measure-value
     measure
     (q179467-unit-cell-set
      space basis coordinates dimension))
    (q179467-ennreal-finite
     (q179467-one real-type)))
   (q179467-translation-invariant-p
    space measurable measure)))

;; Lebesgue lower integration and Bochner integration.

(defun-sk q179467-function-into-p
    (domain codomain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p domain x)
     (q179467-member-p
      codomain
      (q179467-function-at function x)))))

(defun-sk q179467-continuous-at-delta-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p domain y)
      (q179467-less
       real-type
       (q179467-distance real-type domain y x)
       delta))
     (q179467-less
      real-type
      (q179467-distance
       real-type codomain
       (q179467-function-at function y)
       (q179467-function-at function x))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-continuous-at-epsilon-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q179467-member-p real-type delta)
     (q179467-positive-p real-type delta)
     (q179467-continuous-at-delta-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q179467-continuous-at-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q179467-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q179467-continuous-at-epsilon-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-continuous-function-p
    (real-type domain codomain function)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p domain x)
      (q179467-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q179467-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q179467-continuous-at-epsilon-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk q179467-function-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (type f g set value x)
    (and
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at
       (q179467-function-add type f g) x)
      (q179467-add
       type
       (q179467-function-at f x)
       (q179467-function-at g x)))
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at
       (q179467-function-difference type f g) x)
      (q179467-add
       type
       (q179467-function-at f x)
       (q179467-negate
        type (q179467-function-at g x))))
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at
       (q179467-function-norm real-type type f) x)
      (q179467-norm type (q179467-function-at f x)))
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at
       (q179467-indicator-function real-type set) x)
      (if (q179467-set-member-p set x)
          (q179467-one real-type)
        (q179467-zero real-type))))))

(defun-sk q179467-fiber-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function value x)
    (iff
     (q179467-set-member-p
      (q179467-fiber-set function value)
      x)
     (and
      (q179467-member-p domain x)
      (equal (q179467-function-at function x) value)))))

(defun-sk q179467-measurable-function-p
    (real-type domain measurable codomain function)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p codomain center)
      (q179467-member-p real-type radius)
      (q179467-positive-p real-type radius))
     (q179467-family-member-p
      measurable
      (q179467-preimage-set
       function
       (q179467-open-ball-set
        codomain center radius))))))

(defun-sk q179467-nonnegative-values-p
    (real-type domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p domain x)
     (q179467-leq
      real-type
      (q179467-zero real-type)
      (q179467-function-at function x)))))

(defun q179467-nonnegative-measurable-p
    (real-type domain measurable function)
  (and
   (q179467-function-into-p
    domain real-type function)
   (q179467-measurable-function-p
    real-type domain measurable real-type function)
   (q179467-nonnegative-values-p
    real-type domain function)))

(defun-sk q179467-pointwise-leq-p
    (real-type domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p domain x)
     (q179467-leq
      real-type
      (q179467-function-at left x)
      (q179467-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q179467-functions-equal-on-p
    (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q179467-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at left x)
      (q179467-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q179467-lintegral-laws-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (f g set)
    (and
     (implies
      (q179467-functions-equal-on-p domain f g)
      (equal
       (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q179467-nonnegative-measurable-p
       real-type domain measurable f)
      (q179467-ennreal-p
       real-type
       (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral f)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q179467-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)
       (q179467-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable g)
       (q179467-pointwise-leq-p real-type domain f g))
      (q179467-ennreal-leq-p
       real-type
       (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q179467-family-member-p measurable set)
      (equal
       (q179467-lintegral-value
        lintegral
        (q179467-indicator-function real-type set))
       (q179467-measure-value measure set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q179467-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)
       (q179467-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable g))
      (equal
       (q179467-lintegral-value
        lintegral
        (q179467-function-add real-type f g))
       (q179467-ennreal-add
        real-type
        (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral f)
        (q179467-lintegral-value lintegral g)))))))

(defun q179467-simple-values-correct-p
    (domain measurable function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q179467-family-member-p
        measurable
        (q179467-fiber-set function (car values)))
       (q179467-simple-values-correct-p
        domain measurable function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q179467-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
    (space values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q179467-member-p space (car values))
       (q179467-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
        space (cdr values)))

(defun-sk q179467-simple-range-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies

      (q179467-function-at function x)

(defun-sk q179467-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q179467-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at function x)
      value))))

(defun q179467-simple-function-p
    (domain measurable space function)
  (and
   (q179467-function-into-p domain space function)
   (true-listp (q179467-simple-values function))
   (no-duplicatesp-equal (q179467-simple-values function))
   (q179467-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
    space (q179467-simple-values function))
   (q179467-simple-values-correct-p
    domain measurable function
    (q179467-simple-values function))
   (q179467-simple-range-values-p
    domain function
    (q179467-simple-values function))))

(defun q179467-simple-integrable-values-p
    (real-type domain measure zero function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (implies
        (not
         (q179467-value-attained-p
          domain function (car values)))
        (equal
         (q179467-measure-value
          measure
          (q179467-fiber-set function (car values)))
         (q179467-ennreal-finite
          (q179467-zero real-type))))
       (or
        (equal (car values) zero)
        (not
         (equal
          (q179467-measure-value
           measure
           (q179467-fiber-set function (car values)))
          :q179467-top)))
       (q179467-simple-integrable-values-p
        real-type domain measure zero function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q179467-simple-integral
    (real-type domain space measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q179467-add
       space
       (if (or
            (equal (car values) (q179467-zero space))
            (not
             (q179467-value-attained-p
              domain function (car values))))
           (q179467-zero space)
         (q179467-smul
          real-type space
          (cdr
           (q179467-measure-value
            measure
            (q179467-fiber-set function (car values))))
          (car values)))
       (q179467-simple-integral
        real-type domain space measure function (cdr values)))
    (q179467-zero space)))

(defun q179467-ennreal-scale
    (real-type scalar value)
  (if (equal scalar (q179467-zero real-type))
      (q179467-ennreal-finite
       (q179467-zero real-type))
    (if (equal value :q179467-top)
        :q179467-top
      (q179467-ennreal-finite
       (q179467-multiply
        real-type scalar (cdr value))))))

(defun q179467-simple-nonnegative-integral
    (real-type domain measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q179467-ennreal-add
       real-type
       (if
           (q179467-value-attained-p
            domain function (car values))
           (q179467-ennreal-scale
            real-type
            (car values)
            (q179467-measure-value
             measure
             (q179467-fiber-set function (car values))))
         (q179467-ennreal-finite
          (q179467-zero real-type)))
       (q179467-simple-nonnegative-integral
        real-type domain measure function (cdr values)))
    (q179467-ennreal-finite
     (q179467-zero real-type))))

(defun-sk q179467-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple)

      (q179467-simple-function-p
       domain measurable real-type simple)
      (q179467-nonnegative-values-p
       real-type domain simple)
      (q179467-pointwise-leq-p
       real-type domain simple function))
     (q179467-ennreal-leq-p
      real-type
      (q179467-simple-nonnegative-integral
       real-type domain measure simple
       (q179467-simple-values simple))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q179467-lintegral-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-ennreal-p real-type bound)
      (q179467-lintegral-upper-bound-p
       real-type domain measurable measure function bound))
     (q179467-ennreal-leq-p real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q179467-lintegral-supremum-laws-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-function-into-p

       real-type domain function))
     (let ((value
            (q179467-lintegral-value

        (q179467-ennreal-p real-type value)
        (q179467-lintegral-upper-bound-p
         real-type domain measurable measure function value)
        (q179467-lintegral-least-upper-bound-p
         real-type domain measurable measure function value))))))

(defun-sk q179467-simple-sequence-p
    (domain measurable space sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q179467-simple-function-p
      domain measurable space

(defun-sk q179467-pointwise-simple-limit-p

     (q179467-converges-p

      (q179467-sequence-at sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q179467-strongly-measurable-p
    (real-type domain measurable space function)

    (and

      domain measurable space sequence)

(defun-sk q179467-equal-outside-p
    (domain exceptional left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q179467-member-p domain x)
      (not (q179467-set-member-p exceptional x)))
     (equal
      (q179467-function-at left x)
      (q179467-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q179467-almost-everywhere-equal-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure left right)
  (exists (exceptional)
    (and
     (q179467-family-member-p measurable exceptional)
     (equal
      (q179467-measure-value measure exceptional)
      (q179467-ennreal-finite
       (q179467-zero real-type)))
     (q179467-equal-outside-p
      domain exceptional left right))))

(defun-sk q179467-aestrongly-measurable-p

(defun q179467-integrable-p

   (q179467-aestrongly-measurable-p
    real-type domain measurable measure space function)
   (not
    (equal
     (q179467-lintegral-value
      lintegral
      (q179467-function-norm real-type space function))
     :q179467-top))))

(defun q179467-l1-distance
    (real-type space lintegral left right)
  (q179467-lintegral-value
   lintegral
   (q179467-function-norm
    real-type space
    (q179467-function-difference space left right))))

(defun-sk q179467-l1-tail-p
    (real-type space lintegral sequence function epsilon start)

     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))

      real-type
      (q179467-l1-distance
       real-type space lintegral

(defun-sk q179467-l1-converges-p
    (real-type space lintegral sequence function)
  (forall (epsilon)

      (q179467-member-p real-type epsilon)

    (real-type domain measurable measure space sequence)

     (natp n)

       (and
        (q179467-simple-function-p

        (q179467-simple-integrable-values-p

  (forall (real-type domain space measure sequence n)

      real-type domain space measure

(defun q179467-bochner-approximation-p

   (q179467-l1-converges-p

        (q179467-character-value fourier-char x)
        (q179467-character-value fourier-char y)))
      (equal
       (q179467-norm
        complex-type
        (q179467-character-value fourier-char x))

(defun-sk q179467-character-continuity-delta-p

(defun-sk q179467-character-continuity-epsilon-p

(defun q179467-fourier-character-p

(defun-sk q179467-fourier-transform-correct-p

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q179467,
-- "Fourier theorem": Fourier inversion for integrable Banach-valued functions
-- on finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces, at continuity points and
-- globally for continuous functions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q179467_fourier_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

open CompleteOrderedField
open NormedVectorSpace
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure
open BochnerIntegration

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

sumVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
sumVector reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumVector reals (suc n) terms =
  addR reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumVector reals n (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

productVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
productVector reals zero terms =
  oneR reals
productVector reals (suc n) terms =
  multiplyR reals
    (terms fzero)
    (productVector reals n (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

vectorAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorAdd reals x y i =
  addR reals (x i) (y i)

vectorScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n
vectorScale reals scalar x i =
  multiplyR reals scalar (x i)

record RealInnerProductSpace
  (R V : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals) : Set1 where
  field
    inner :
      V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : V) ->
      inner (addE space x y) z ==
      addR reals (inner x z) (inner y z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      inner (scaleE space a x) y ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner x y)
    inner-symmetric :
      (x y : V) ->
      inner x y == inner y x
    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner x x)
    inner-definite :
      (x : V) ->
      inner x x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE space
    norm-square :
      (x : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (normE space x) (normE space x) ==
      inner x x

open RealInnerProductSpace

record FiniteDimensionalInnerProduct
  {R V : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals)
  (innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space) : Set1 where
  field
    dimension :
      Nat
    toCoordinates :
      V -> Vector R dimension
    fromCoordinates :
      Vector R dimension -> V
    coordinates-after-vector :
      (x : Vector R dimension) ->
      VectorEqual (toCoordinates (fromCoordinates x)) x
    vector-after-coordinates :
      (x : V) ->
      fromCoordinates (toCoordinates x) == x
    coordinates-add :
      (x y : V) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (addE space x y))
        (vectorAdd reals (toCoordinates x) (toCoordinates y))
    coordinates-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : V) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (scaleE space a x))
        (vectorScale reals a (toCoordinates x))
    coordinates-orthonormal :
      (x y : V) ->
      inner innerSpace x y ==
      sumVector reals dimension
        (\ i ->
          multiplyR reals
            (toCoordinates x i)
            (toCoordinates y i))

open FiniteDimensionalInnerProduct

NormOpen :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R V reals ->
  Predicate V ->
  Set
NormOpen {R = R} {reals = reals} space U =
  (x : _) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) radius ->
          U y))

data BorelGenerated
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals) :
  Predicate V -> Set1 where
  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate V} ->
    NormOpen space U ->
    BorelGenerated space U
  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated space emptySet
  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate V} ->
    BorelGenerated space S ->
    BorelGenerated space (complement S)
  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate V) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated space (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated space (countableUnion sets)
  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate V} ->
    ((x : V) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated space S ->
    BorelGenerated space T

record BorelSpace
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra V) : Set2 where
  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate V) ->
      BorelGenerated space S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate V) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated space S

CoordinatewiseOrdered :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
CoordinatewiseOrdered {n = n} reals lower upper =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (lower i) (upper i)

CoordinateBox :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals} ->
  {innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space} ->
  (finite : FiniteDimensionalInnerProduct reals space innerSpace) ->
  Vector R (dimension finite) ->
  Vector R (dimension finite) ->
  Predicate V
CoordinateBox {reals = reals} finite lower upper x =
  (i : Fin (dimension finite)) ->
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals
      (lower i)
      (toCoordinates finite x i))
    (StrictLess reals
      (toCoordinates finite x i)
      (upper i))

coordinateBoxVolume :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals} ->
  {innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space} ->
  (finite : FiniteDimensionalInnerProduct reals space innerSpace) ->
  Vector R (dimension finite) ->
  Vector R (dimension finite) ->
  R
coordinateBoxVolume {reals = reals} finite lower upper =
  productVector reals (dimension finite)
    (\ i -> subtractR reals (upper i) (lower i))

record EuclideanLebesguePresentation
  (R M V : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals)
  (innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space)
  (finite : FiniteDimensionalInnerProduct reals space innerSpace) : Set2 where
  field
    events :
      SigmaAlgebra V
    extended :
      ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals
    volume :
      Measure extended events
    borel-space :
      BorelSpace space events
    coordinate-box-volume-nonnegative :
      (lower upper : Vector R (dimension finite)) ->
      CoordinatewiseOrdered reals lower upper ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        (coordinateBoxVolume finite lower upper)
    volume-coordinate-box :
      (lower upper : Vector R (dimension finite)) ->
      (ordered : CoordinatewiseOrdered reals lower upper) ->
      outerMass volume (CoordinateBox finite lower upper) ==
      finiteM extended
        (coordinateBoxVolume finite lower upper)
        (coordinate-box-volume-nonnegative lower upper ordered)

open EuclideanLebesguePresentation

record ComplexNumber (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart :
      R
    imaginaryPart :
      R

open ComplexNumber

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

oneC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R
oneC reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

fromReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  ComplexNumber R
fromReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex (negateR reals a) (negateR reals b)

subtractC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
subtractC reals x y =
  addC reals x (negateC reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (negateR reals (multiplyR reals b d)))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

powerC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  Nat ->
  ComplexNumber R
powerC reals z zero =
  oneC reals
powerC reals z (suc n) =
  multiplyC reals (powerC reals z n) z

factorial :
  Nat ->
  Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirstC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (ComplexNumber R -> ComplexNumber R -> ComplexNumber R) ->
  (Nat -> ComplexNumber R) ->
  Nat ->
  ComplexNumber R
sumFirstC reals add terms zero =
  zeroC reals
sumFirstC reals add terms (suc n) =
  add (sumFirstC reals add terms n) (terms n)

record ComplexModulus
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    modulus :
      ComplexNumber R -> R
    modulus-nonnegative :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (modulus z)
    modulus-square :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      multiplyR reals (modulus z) (modulus z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexModulus

distanceC :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ComplexModulus reals ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  R
distanceC {reals = reals} complexModulus x y =
  modulus complexModulus (subtractC reals x y)

complexExponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  Nat ->
  ComplexNumber R
complexExponentialTerm reals z n =
  multiplyC reals
    (powerC reals z n)
    (fromReal reals
      (reciprocalR reals
        (fromNatR reals (factorial n))))

ComplexExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ComplexModulus reals ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  Set
ComplexExponentialValue reals complexModulus z value =
  SequentialLimit reals (distanceC complexModulus)
    (\ n ->
      sumFirstC reals (addC reals)
        (complexExponentialTerm reals z)
        n)
    value

sumFirstR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirstR reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirstR reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals (sumFirstR reals terms n) (terms n)

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerR reals x n) x

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  multiplyR reals
    (powerR reals (negateR reals (oneR reals)) n)
    (reciprocalR reals
      (fromNatR reals
        (suc ((suc (suc zero)) * n))))

record PiValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (pi : R) : Set where
  field
    pi-positive :
      Positive reals pi
    leibniz-series :
      SequentialLimit reals (distanceR reals)
        (\ n -> sumFirstR reals (leibnizTerm reals) n)
        (multiplyR reals pi
          (reciprocalR reals
            (fromNatR reals
              (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))))))

record ComplexNormedSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexModulus : ComplexModulus reals) : Set1 where
  field
    realSpace :
      NormedVectorSpace R E reals
    scaleC :
      ComplexNumber R -> E -> E
    scale-oneC :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleC (oneC reals) x == x
    scale-multiplyC :
      (a b : ComplexNumber R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleC (multiplyC reals a b) x ==
      scaleC a (scaleC b x)
    scale-add-scalarsC :
      (a b : ComplexNumber R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleC (addC reals a b) x ==
      addE realSpace (scaleC a x) (scaleC b x)
    scale-add-vectorsC :
      (a : ComplexNumber R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleC a (addE realSpace x y) ==
      addE realSpace (scaleC a x) (scaleC a y)
    scale-real :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleC (fromReal reals a) x ==
      scaleE realSpace a x
    norm-scaleC :
      (a : ComplexNumber R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE realSpace (scaleC a x) ==
      multiplyR reals
        (modulus complexModulus a)
        (normE realSpace x)

open ComplexNormedSpace

forwardPhase :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals} ->
  (innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space) ->
  R ->
  V ->
  V ->
  ComplexNumber R
forwardPhase {reals = reals} innerSpace pi frequency point =
  complex
    (zeroR reals)
    (negateR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (multiplyR reals (fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))) pi)
        (inner innerSpace frequency point)))

inversePhase :
  {R V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals} ->
  (innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space) ->
  R ->
  V ->
  V ->
  ComplexNumber R
inversePhase {reals = reals} innerSpace pi frequency point =
  complex
    (zeroR reals)
    (multiplyR reals
      (multiplyR reals (fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))) pi)
      (inner innerSpace frequency point))

record FourierKernel
  {R V : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexModulus : ComplexModulus reals)
  {space : NormedVectorSpace R V reals}
  (innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals space) : Set1 where
  field
    pi :
      R
    pi-value :
      PiValue reals pi
    forwardKernel :
      V -> V -> ComplexNumber R
    inverseKernel :
      V -> V -> ComplexNumber R
    forward-kernel-value :
      (frequency point : V) ->
      ComplexExponentialValue reals complexModulus
        (forwardPhase innerSpace pi frequency point)
        (forwardKernel frequency point)
    inverse-kernel-value :
      (frequency point : V) ->
      ComplexExponentialValue reals complexModulus
        (inversePhase innerSpace pi frequency point)
        (inverseKernel frequency point)

open FourierKernel

fourierTransform :
  {R M V E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexModulus : ComplexModulus reals} ->
  {domain : NormedVectorSpace R V reals} ->
  {innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals domain} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra V} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {measure : Measure extended events} ->
  (codomain : ComplexNormedSpace R E reals complexModulus) ->
  BochnerIntegration reals (realSpace codomain) events extended measure ->
  FourierKernel reals complexModulus innerSpace ->
  (V -> E) ->
  V ->
  E
fourierTransform codomain integration kernel f frequency =
  integralVector integration
    (\ point ->
      scaleC codomain
        (forwardKernel kernel frequency point)
        (f point))

inverseFourierTransform :
  {R M V E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexModulus : ComplexModulus reals} ->
  {domain : NormedVectorSpace R V reals} ->
  {innerSpace : RealInnerProductSpace R V reals domain} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra V} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  {measure : Measure extended events} ->
  (codomain : ComplexNormedSpace R E reals complexModulus) ->
  BochnerIntegration reals (realSpace codomain) events extended measure ->
  FourierKernel reals complexModulus innerSpace ->
  (V -> E) ->
  V ->
  E
inverseFourierTransform codomain integration kernel f point =
  integralVector integration
    (\ frequency ->
      scaleC codomain
        (inverseKernel kernel frequency point)
        (f frequency))

ContinuousAt :
  {R V E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (domain : NormedVectorSpace R V reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (V -> E) ->
  V ->
  Set
ContinuousAt {R = R} {V = V} reals domain codomain f point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((x : V) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE domain x point) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE codomain (f x) (f point))
            epsilon))

Continuous :
  {R V E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (domain : NormedVectorSpace R V reals) ->
  (codomain : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (V -> E) ->
  Set
Continuous {V = V} reals domain codomain f =
  (point : V) ->
  ContinuousAt reals domain codomain f point

FunctionEqual :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set
FunctionEqual {A = A} f g =
  (x : A) -> f x == g x

record FourierContext
  (R M V E : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    reals :
      CompleteOrderedField R
    real-number-presentation :
      RealNumberPresentation reals
    domain :
      NormedVectorSpace R V reals
    inner-space :
      RealInnerProductSpace R V reals domain
    finite-dimensional :
      FiniteDimensionalInnerProduct reals domain inner-space
    complex-modulus :
      ComplexModulus reals
    codomain :
      ComplexNormedSpace R E reals complex-modulus
    codomain-complete :
      Complete reals (distanceE (realSpace codomain))
    lebesgue :
      EuclideanLebesguePresentation
        R M V reals domain inner-space finite-dimensional
    integration :
      BochnerIntegration reals (realSpace codomain)
        (events lebesgue)
        (extended lebesgue)
        (volume lebesgue)
    kernel :
      FourierKernel reals complex-modulus inner-space

open FourierContext

IntegrableInContext :
  {R M V E : Set} ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V E) ->
  (V -> E) ->
  Set1
IntegrableInContext context f =
  VectorIntegrable
    (reals context)
    (realSpace (codomain context))
    (events (lebesgue context))
    (extended (lebesgue context))
    (volume (lebesgue context))
    (lowerIntegral (integration context))
    f

fourierInContext :
  {R M V E : Set} ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V E) ->
  (V -> E) ->
  V ->
  E
fourierInContext context =
  fourierTransform
    (codomain context)
    (integration context)
    (kernel context)

inverseFourierInContext :
  {R M V E : Set} ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V E) ->
  (V -> E) ->
  V ->
  E
inverseFourierInContext context =
  inverseFourierTransform
    (codomain context)
    (integration context)
    (kernel context)

fourier-inversion-at-continuity-point : Set2
fourier-inversion-at-continuity-point =
  (R M V E : Set) ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V E) ->
  (f : V -> E) ->
  IntegrableInContext context f ->
  IntegrableInContext context (fourierInContext context f) ->
  (point : V) ->
  ContinuousAt
    (reals context)
    (domain context)
    (realSpace (codomain context))
    f point ->
  inverseFourierInContext context
    (fourierInContext context f)
    point ==
  f point

continuous-fourier-inversion : Set2
continuous-fourier-inversion =
  (R M V E : Set) ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V E) ->
  (f : V -> E) ->
  Continuous
    (reals context)
    (domain context)
    (realSpace (codomain context))
    f ->
  IntegrableInContext context f ->
  IntegrableInContext context (fourierInContext context f) ->
  FunctionEqual
    (inverseFourierInContext context
      (fourierInContext context f))
    f

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q179467 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q179467), "Fourier theorem": Fourier
  inversion for integrable functions from a finite-dimensional real
  inner-product space to a complete complex normed space, at continuity
  points and globally for continuous functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory;
open measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q179467_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q179467_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero)``);

val q179467_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q179467_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      q179467_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm x = sqrt (inner x x)) /\
      ?n : num.
        ?basis : num -> 'v.
          (!j k.
            j IN count n /\ k IN count n ==>
            inner (basis j) (basis k) =
              if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
          !x.
            x =
              ITSET
                (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
                (count n) zero``);

val q179467_complex_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_complex_normed_space_def",
  ``q179467_complex_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      q179467_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = modu a * norm x)``);

val q179467_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_tendsto_def",
  ``q179467_tendsto
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (ell : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q179467_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_cauchy_def",
  ``q179467_cauchy
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !p q : num.
            N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
            norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q179467_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_complete_def",
  ``q179467_complete
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q179467_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell : 'a. q179467_tendsto add neg norm u ell``);

val q179467_metric_open_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_metric_open_def",
  ``q179467_metric_open
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (s : 'v set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q179467_volume_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_volume_measure_def",
  ``q179467_volume_measure
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m =
        sigma_sets UNIV {s | q179467_metric_open add neg norm s} /\
      ?n : num.
        ?basis : num -> 'v.
          (!j k.
            j IN count n /\ k IN count n ==>
            inner (basis j) (basis k) =
              if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
          (!x.
            x =
              ITSET
                (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
                (count n) zero) /\
          !a b : num -> real.
            (!k. k IN count n ==> a k <= b k) ==>
            measure m
              {x |
                !k.
                  k IN count n ==>
                  a k <= inner x (basis k) /\
                  inner x (basis k) < b k} =
            Normal
              (ITSET
                (\k acc. (b k - a k) * acc)
                (count n) 1)``);

val q179467_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q179467_measurable_simple
      (m : 'v m_space) (s : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'e. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q179467_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q179467_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'v -> 'e.
        (!n. q179467_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q179467_tendsto add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q179467_bochner_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_bochner_integrable_def",
  ``q179467_bochner_integrable
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      ?g : 'v -> 'e.
        q179467_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q179467_simple_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_simple_integral_def",
  ``q179467_simple_integral
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (s : 'v -> 'e) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add
            (smul
              (complex_of_real (real (measure m {x | s x = y}))) y)
            acc)
        (IMAGE s UNIV DELETE zero) zero``);

val q179467_bochner_approximates_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_bochner_approximates_def",
  ``q179467_bochner_approximates
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (s : num -> 'v -> 'e) (ell : 'e) <=>
      ?g : 'v -> 'e.
        q179467_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q179467_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (s n x)))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable m
            (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x)))))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral m
                (Normal o
                  (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x))))))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q179467_tendsto add neg norm
          (\n. q179467_simple_integral m zero add smul (s n))
          ell``);

val q179467_bochner_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_bochner_integral_def",
  ``q179467_bochner_integral
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) =
      if q179467_complete add neg norm /\
         q179467_bochner_integrable m add neg norm f
      then
        @ell : 'e.
          ?s : num -> 'v -> 'e.
            q179467_bochner_approximates
              m zero add neg smul norm f s ell
      else
        zero``);

val q179467_continuous_at_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_continuous_at_def",
  ``q179467_continuous_at
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) (v : 'v) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !w.
            normV (addV w (negV v)) < delta ==>
            normE (addE (f w) (negE (f v))) < epsilon``);

val q179467_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_continuous_def",
  ``q179467_continuous
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      !v.
        q179467_continuous_at
          addV negV normV addE negE normE f v``);

val q179467_fourier_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_fourier_def",
  ``q179467_fourier
      (m : 'v m_space) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (w : 'v) =
      q179467_bochner_integral
        m zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (\x.
          smulE
            (complex_exp
              (-(i * complex_of_real (2 * pi * inner w x))))
            (f x))``);

val q179467_fourier_inv_def = new_definition (
  "q179467_fourier_inv_def",
  ``q179467_fourier_inv
      (m : 'v m_space) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (v : 'v) =
      q179467_bochner_integral
        m zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (\w.
          smulE
            (complex_exp
              (i * complex_of_real (2 * pi * inner w v)))
            (f w))``);

val fourier_inversion =
  ``!(m : 'v m_space)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (v : 'v).
      q179467_real_inner_product_space
        zeroV addV negV smulV inner normV /\
      q179467_volume_measure
        m zeroV addV negV smulV inner normV /\
      q179467_complex_normed_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q179467_complete addE negE normE /\
      q179467_bochner_integrable m addE negE normE f /\
      q179467_bochner_integrable m addE negE normE
        (q179467_fourier
          m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE f) /\
      q179467_continuous_at
        addV negV normV addE negE normE f v
      ==>
      q179467_fourier_inv
        m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (q179467_fourier
          m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE f) v =
      f v``;

val continuous_fourier_inversion =
  ``!(m : 'v m_space)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e).
      q179467_real_inner_product_space
        zeroV addV negV smulV inner normV /\
      q179467_volume_measure
        m zeroV addV negV smulV inner normV /\
      q179467_complex_normed_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q179467_complete addE negE normE /\
      q179467_continuous
        addV negV normV addE negE normE f /\
      q179467_bochner_integrable m addE negE normE f /\
      q179467_bochner_integrable m addE negE normE
        (q179467_fourier
          m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE f)
      ==>
      q179467_fourier_inv
        m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (q179467_fourier
          m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE f) =
      f``;

title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q179467
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q179467), "Fourier theorem": for an
  integrable function from a finite-dimensional real inner-product space to
  a complex Banach space whose Fourier transform is integrable, inverse
  Fourier transformation recovers the function at each continuity point;
  for a continuous function it recovers the whole function. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q179467Volume is the translation-invariant Borel measure normalized so
  that the integral of exp(-pi * norm(x)^2) is one, matching mathlib's volume
  normalization on finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces.

  Q179467FunctionIntegrable encodes almost-everywhere strong measurability
  and finite L1 norm. Q179467Integral is the totalized Banach-valued Bochner
  integral defined by L1 limits of measurable finite-range functions.
  Q179467Fourier and Q179467FourierInv are the Banach-valued Bochner Fourier
  transform and inverse Fourier transform with kernels
  exp(-2*pi*i*inner(w,x)) and exp(2*pi*i*inner(w,x)), respectively.
  Q179467ContinuousAt is the usual open-set definition of continuity at a
  point.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a declaration directly packages the two indexed
  unproved statements. The root artifact contains no $p declaration; the
  included lib/set.mm supplies the proved standard library.
$)

   Q179467Gaussian Q179467Tendsto Q179467AEStrong

theorem
  for V being RealUnitarySpace,
       S being SigmaField of the carrier of V,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       X being ComplexBanachSpace,
       J being Relation of Funcs(the carrier of V,the carrier of X),
                           the carrier of X,
       f,F,G being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X
  st
    V is finite-dimensional &
    (ex n being Nat,
        u being Function of the carrier of V,REAL n,
        B being Subset-Family of the carrier of V,
        C being Subset of V st
      u is one-to-one &
      rng u = REAL n &
      (for x,y being Point of V holds
        u.(x+y) = u.x+u.y) &
      (for a being Real, x being Point of V holds
        u.(a*x) = a*u.x) &
      (for x being Point of V holds
        ex z being Element of REAL n st
          z = u.x & |.z.| = ||.x.||) &
      (for A being Subset of the carrier of V holds
        A in B iff
          ex c being Point of V, r being Real st
            0 < r &
            A = {x where x is Point of V: ||.x-c.|| < r}) &
      S = sigma(B) &
      C in S &
      C = {x where x is Point of V:
        ex z being Element of REAL n st
          z = u.x &
          for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
            0 <= z.i & z.i < 1} &
      M.C = 1 &
      (for A being Element of S, a being Point of V holds
        ex T being Element of S st
          T = {y where y is Point of V:
            ex x being Point of V st x in A & y = x+a} &
          M.T = M.A)) &
    (for g being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X,
         y being Point of X holds
      [g,y] in J iff
        ex N being Element of S,
           g0 being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X,
           Q being sequence of Funcs(the carrier of V,the carrier of X),
           I being sequence of X,
           E being Real_Sequence st
          M.N = 0 &
          (for x being Point of V st not x in N holds g0.x = g.x) &
          (for k being Nat holds
            ex q being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X,
               A being FinSequence of S,
               z being sequence of X,
               r being Real_Sequence,
               p being sequence of X,
               e being Function of the carrier of V,REAL st
              Q.k = q &
              p.0 = 0.X &
              (for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                p.(i+1) = p.i + ((r.i) qua Complex)*z.i) &
              I.k = p.(len A) &
              (for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                0 <= r.i & M.(A.(i+1)) = r.i) &
              (for i,j being Nat st
                  i < len A & j < len A & i <> j
                holds A.(i+1) misses A.(j+1)) &
              (for x being Point of V holds
                (ex i being Nat st
                  i < len A & x in A.(i+1) & q.x = z.i) or
                ((for i being Nat st i < len A holds not x in A.(i+1)) &
                  q.x = 0.X)) &
              (for x being Point of V holds
                e.x = ||.g0.x-q.x.||) &
              e is_integrable_on M &
              E.k = Integral(M,e)) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds |.E.k.| < e) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds ||.I.k-y.|| < e)) &
    (ex y being Point of X st [f,y] in J) &
    (ex y being Point of X st [F,y] in J) &
    (for w being Point of V holds
      ex h being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X st
        (for x being Point of V holds
          h.x = (cos(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,x])) -
            sin(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,x]))*<i>)*f.x) &
        [h,F.w] in J) &
    (for v being Point of V holds
      ex h being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X st
        (for w being Point of V holds
          h.w = (cos(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,v])) +
            sin(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,v]))*<i>)*F.w) &
        [h,G.v] in J)
  holds
    (for v being Point of V st
      (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
        ex d being Real st 0 < d &
          for x being Point of V st
            ||.x-v.|| < d
          holds ||.f.x-f.v.|| < e)
     holds G.v = f.v)
    &
    ((for v being Point of V holds
        for e being Real st 0 < e holds
          ex d being Real st 0 < d &
            for x being Point of V st
              ||.x-v.|| < d
            holds ||.f.x-f.v.|| < e)
      implies G = f)
proof
end;
