title: Q179467_fourier_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q179467,
% "Fourier theorem": Fourier inversion for integrable functions on arbitrary
% finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces, pointwise at continuity points
% and as a function for continuous functions. This file contains no proof.

fourier_theorem_Q179467[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool],
  zeroA: A,
  addA: [A, A -> A],
  negA: [A -> A],
  smulA: [real, A -> A],
  normA: [A -> real],
  innerA: [A, A -> real],
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  smulG: [real, G -> G],
  csmulG: [real, real, G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  g_function: TYPE = [A -> G]
  g_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> g_function]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  subG(x, y: G): G = addG(x, negG(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G): addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: G):
        smulG(a, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a + b, x) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a * b, x) = smulG(a, smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): smulG(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        normG(smulG(a, x)) = abs(a) * normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  converges_to_g(values: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normG(subG(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_g(values: g_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normG(
              subG(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_g: bool =
    FORALL (values: g_sequence):
      cauchy_g(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: G): converges_to_g(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND (FORALL (omega: A):
            carrier(omega) AND E(omega)
              IMPLIES measurable_cover(omega))
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) AND NOT property(omega))

  finite_g_sum(values: g_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_g_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_g_value(
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): G =
    finite_g_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroG
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_g_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  finite_simple_real_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_real_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: g_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_g(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_g(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: g_function):
      strongly_measurable_g(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      strongly_measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_g(function_value: g_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(normG(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  abs_enorm_real(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(abs(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_finite_integral_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M, Sigma, enorm_g(function_value), integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  has_finite_integral_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        abs_enorm_real(function_value),
        integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  integrable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_g(M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_real(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_real(
        M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_simple_g_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroG
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_simple_g_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        smulG(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_g_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_g_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: g_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_g(
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            subG(
              function_value(omega),
              approximant(omega))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      approximants: g_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_g(Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: g_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: g_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_g_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_g(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): G =
    IF complete_space_g
        AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: G):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroG
    ENDIF

  coordinate_vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coordinate_map: TYPE = [A -> coordinate_vector]
  reconstruction_map: TYPE = [coordinate_vector -> A]

  subA(x, y: A): A =
    addA(x, negA(y))

  coordinate_zero: coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  coordinate_add(
      left, right: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      left(index) + right(index)

  coordinate_scale(
      scalar: real,
      value: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      scalar * value(index)

  supported(
      value: coordinate_vector,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES value(index) = 0

  finite_coordinate_inner(
      left, right: coordinate_vector,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_coordinate_inner(left, right, count - 1)
        + left(count - 1) * right(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_inner_product_space_a: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      addA(x, y) = addA(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        addA(addA(x, y), z) =
          addA(x, addA(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        addA(x, zeroA) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        addA(x, negA(x)) = zeroA)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: A):
        smulA(a, addA(x, y)) =
          addA(smulA(a, x), smulA(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: A):
        smulA(a + b, x) =
          addA(smulA(a, x), smulA(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: A):
        smulA(a * b, x) =
          smulA(a, smulA(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        smulA(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        innerA(addA(x, y), z) =
          innerA(x, z) + innerA(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: A):
        innerA(smulA(a, x), y) =
          a * innerA(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        innerA(x, y) = innerA(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        0 <= innerA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        innerA(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroA)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        normA(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        normA(x) ^ 2 = innerA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: A):
        normA(smulA(a, x)) = abs(a) * normA(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        normA(addA(x, y)) <= normA(x) + normA(y))

  orthonormal_coordinate_system(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: coordinate_map,
      reconstruct: reconstruction_map): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      supported(coordinates(x), dimension))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        coordinates(addA(x, y)) =
          coordinate_add(coordinates(x), coordinates(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: A):
        coordinates(smulA(a, x)) =
          coordinate_scale(a, coordinates(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        reconstruct(coordinates(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (value: coordinate_vector):
        supported(value, dimension) IMPLIES
          coordinates(reconstruct(value)) = value)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        innerA(x, y) =
          finite_coordinate_inner(
            coordinates(x), coordinates(y), dimension))

  finite_dimensional_real_inner_product_space_a: bool =
    real_inner_product_space_a
      AND EXISTS
          (dimension: nat),
          (coordinates: coordinate_map),
          (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
        orthonormal_coordinate_system(
          dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)

  open_event(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: A):
        U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (y: A):
              (carrier(y)
                AND normA(subA(y, x)) < radius)
              IMPLIES U(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: event):
        open_event(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (U: event):
            open_event(U) IMPLIES Other(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (E: event):
            Sigma(E) IMPLIES Other(E))

  translated_event(E: event, shift: A): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      carrier(x) AND E(subA(x, shift))

  coordinate_unit_cube(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: coordinate_map): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      carrier(x)
        AND FORALL (index: nat):
          index < dimension IMPLIES
            0 <= coordinates(x)(index)
              AND coordinates(x)(index) < 1

  full_carrier: bool =
    FORALL (x: A): carrier(x)

  canonical_volume_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    full_carrier
      AND finite_dimensional_real_inner_product_space_a
      AND generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
      AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (E: event), (shift: A):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          M(translated_event(E, shift)) = M(E))
      AND EXISTS
          (dimension: nat),
          (coordinates: coordinate_map),
          (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
        orthonormal_coordinate_system(
          dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)
          AND M(coordinate_unit_cube(dimension, coordinates))
            = finite_measure_value(1)

  complex_product_re(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_re - left_im * right_im

  complex_product_im(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_im + left_im * right_re

  complex_norm_squared(
      real_part, imag_part: real): real =
    real_part ^ 2 + imag_part ^ 2

  complex_normed_space_g: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a, x) = csmulG(a, 0, x))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        csmulG(a_re, a_im, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, x),
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: G):
        csmulG(a_re + b_re, a_im + b_im, x) =
          addG(
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, x),
            csmulG(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: G):
        csmulG(
          complex_product_re(
            a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
          complex_product_im(
            a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
          x)
          =
            csmulG(
              a_re, a_im,
              csmulG(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        csmulG(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        csmulG(0, 0, x) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: G):
        normG(csmulG(a_re, a_im, x)) ^ 2 =
          complex_norm_squared(a_re, a_im)
            * normG(x) ^ 2)

  complex_banach_space_g: bool =
    complex_normed_space_g AND complete_space_g

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  fourier_kernel_smul(angle: real, value: G): G =
    csmulG(
      cosine_of_real(angle),
      sine_of_real(angle),
      value)

  fourier_transform(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (frequency: A):
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        LAMBDA (point: A):
          fourier_kernel_smul(
            -2 * pi * innerA(frequency, point),
            function_value(point)))

  inverse_fourier_transform(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (point: A):
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        LAMBDA (frequency: A):
          fourier_kernel_smul(
            2 * pi * innerA(frequency, point),
            function_value(frequency)))

  continuous_at_g(
      function_value: g_function,
      point: A): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (nearby: A):
          normA(subA(nearby, point)) < radius
            IMPLIES
              normG(
                subG(
                  function_value(nearby),
                  function_value(point)))
                < epsilon_value

  continuous_g(function_value: g_function): bool =
    FORALL (point: A):
      continuous_at_g(function_value, point)

  fourier_inversion_at_continuity_points: bool =
    complex_banach_space_g IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (function_value: g_function),
          (point: A):
        (canonical_volume_space(M, Sigma)
          AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
          AND integrable_g(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(
              M, Sigma, function_value))
          AND continuous_at_g(function_value, point))
        IMPLIES
          inverse_fourier_transform(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(
              M, Sigma, function_value))(point)
            = function_value(point)

  continuous_fourier_inversion: bool =
    complex_banach_space_g IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (function_value: g_function):
        (canonical_volume_space(M, Sigma)
          AND continuous_g(function_value)
          AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
          AND integrable_g(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(
              M, Sigma, function_value)))
        IMPLIES
          inverse_fourier_transform(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(
              M, Sigma, function_value))
            = function_value

  fourier_theorem: bool =
    fourier_inversion_at_continuity_points
      AND continuous_fourier_inversion
END fourier_theorem_Q179467

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q180345
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q180345), "Rational root theorem": for a polynomial
-- over a unique factorization domain, the numerator of a root in its fraction field
-- divides the constant coefficient, and its denominator divides the leading coefficient.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.NumDen
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Basic

@[expose] public section

open scoped Polynomial

section RationalRootTheorem

variable {A K : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A] [Field K]
variable [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]

open IsFractionRing Polynomial

/-- The numerator of a root divides the polynomial's constant coefficient. -/
theorem num_dvd_of_is_root {p : A[X]} {r : K} (hr : aeval r p = 0) :
    num A r ∣ p.coeff 0 := sorry

/-- The denominator of a root divides the polynomial's leading coefficient. -/
theorem den_dvd_of_is_root {p : A[X]} {r : K} (hr : aeval r p = 0) :
    (den A r : A) ∣ p.leadingCoeff := sorry

end RationalRootTheorem

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q180345), "Rational root theorem": for a
  polynomial over a unique factorization domain, the reduced numerator of a
  root in its fraction field divides the constant coefficient, and the
  reduced denominator divides the leading coefficient. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q180345_comm_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q180345_zero : R;
  q180345_one : R;
  q180345_add : R -> R -> R;
  q180345_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q180345_neg : R -> R;
  q180345_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q180345_add x (q180345_add y z) =
      q180345_add (q180345_add x y) z;
  q180345_add_comm :
    forall x y : R, q180345_add x y = q180345_add y x;
  q180345_add_zero :
    forall x : R, q180345_add x q180345_zero = x;
  q180345_add_neg :
    forall x : R, q180345_add x (q180345_neg x) = q180345_zero;
  q180345_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q180345_mul x (q180345_mul y z) =
      q180345_mul (q180345_mul x y) z;
  q180345_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R, q180345_mul x y = q180345_mul y x;
  q180345_mul_one :
    forall x : R, q180345_mul x q180345_one = x;
  q180345_mul_zero :
    forall x : R, q180345_mul x q180345_zero = q180345_zero;
  q180345_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : R,
      q180345_mul x (q180345_add y z) =
      q180345_add (q180345_mul x y) (q180345_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q180345_zero {R} _.
Arguments q180345_one {R} _.
Arguments q180345_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q180345_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q180345_neg {R} _ _.

Record q180345_domain
    {R : Type} (RR : q180345_comm_ring R) : Type := {
  q180345_domain_nontrivial :
    q180345_zero RR <> q180345_one RR;
  q180345_no_zero_divisors :
    forall x y : R,
      q180345_mul RR x y = q180345_zero RR ->
      x = q180345_zero RR \/ y = q180345_zero RR
}.

Record q180345_field
    {K : Type} (RK : q180345_comm_ring K) : Type := {
  q180345_inv : K -> K;
  q180345_field_nontrivial :
    q180345_zero RK <> q180345_one RK;
  q180345_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q180345_zero RK ->
      q180345_mul RK x (q180345_inv x) = q180345_one RK
}.

Arguments q180345_inv {K RK} _ _.

Record q180345_ring_hom
    {A K : Type}
    (RA : q180345_comm_ring A)
    (RK : q180345_comm_ring K) : Type := {
  q180345_embed : A -> K;
  q180345_embed_zero :
    q180345_embed (q180345_zero RA) = q180345_zero RK;
  q180345_embed_one :
    q180345_embed (q180345_one RA) = q180345_one RK;
  q180345_embed_add :
    forall a b : A,
      q180345_embed (q180345_add RA a b) =
      q180345_add RK (q180345_embed a) (q180345_embed b);
  q180345_embed_mul :
    forall a b : A,
      q180345_embed (q180345_mul RA a b) =
      q180345_mul RK (q180345_embed a) (q180345_embed b)
}.

Arguments q180345_embed {A K RA RK} _ _.

Definition q180345_divides
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A) (a b : A) : Prop :=
  exists c : A, b = q180345_mul RA a c.

Definition q180345_is_unit
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A) (a : A) : Prop :=
  exists b : A, q180345_mul RA a b = q180345_one RA.

Definition q180345_associated
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A) (a b : A) : Prop :=
  exists u : A,
    q180345_is_unit RA u /\ a = q180345_mul RA u b.

Definition q180345_irreducible
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A) (p : A) : Prop :=
  p <> q180345_zero RA /\
  ~ q180345_is_unit RA p /\
  forall a b : A,
    p = q180345_mul RA a b ->
    q180345_is_unit RA a \/ q180345_is_unit RA b.

Definition q180345_prime
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A) (p : A) : Prop :=
  p <> q180345_zero RA /\
  ~ q180345_is_unit RA p /\
  forall a b : A,
    q180345_divides RA p (q180345_mul RA a b) ->
    q180345_divides RA p a \/ q180345_divides RA p b.

Fixpoint q180345_product
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A)
    (factors : list A) : A :=
  match factors with
  | nil => q180345_one RA
  | factor :: rest =>
      q180345_mul RA factor (q180345_product RA rest)
  end.

Record q180345_unique_factorization_monoid
    {A : Type}
    (RA : q180345_comm_ring A)
    (DA : q180345_domain RA) : Type := {
  q180345_factorization_exists :
    forall a : A,
      a <> q180345_zero RA ->
      exists factors : list A,
        List.Forall (q180345_irreducible RA) factors /\
        q180345_associated RA a (q180345_product RA factors);
  q180345_irreducible_is_prime :
    forall p : A,
      q180345_irreducible RA p ->
      q180345_prime RA p
}.

Record q180345_fraction_field
    {A K : Type}
    (RA : q180345_comm_ring A)
    (DA : q180345_domain RA)
    (RK : q180345_comm_ring K)
    (FK : q180345_field RK)
    (E : q180345_ring_hom RA RK) : Type := {
  q180345_num : K -> A;
  q180345_den : K -> A;
  q180345_embed_injective :
    forall a b : A,
      q180345_embed E a = q180345_embed E b -> a = b;
  q180345_den_nonzero :
    forall r : K, q180345_den r <> q180345_zero RA;
  q180345_num_den_represents :
    forall r : K,
      q180345_embed E (q180345_num r) =
      q180345_mul RK r (q180345_embed E (q180345_den r));
  q180345_num_den_reduced :
    forall (r : K) (d : A),
      q180345_divides RA d (q180345_num r) ->
      q180345_divides RA d (q180345_den r) ->
      q180345_is_unit RA d
}.

Arguments q180345_num {A K RA DA RK FK E} _ _.
Arguments q180345_den {A K RA DA RK FK E} _ _.

Record q180345_polynomial
    {A : Type} (RA : q180345_comm_ring A) : Type := {
  q180345_coeff : nat -> A;
  q180345_nat_degree : nat;
  q180345_coeff_above_degree :
    forall n : nat,
      (q180345_nat_degree < n)%nat ->
      q180345_coeff n = q180345_zero RA;
  q180345_degree_spec :
    q180345_coeff q180345_nat_degree <> q180345_zero RA \/
    (q180345_nat_degree = 0 /\ q180345_coeff 0 = q180345_zero RA)
}.

Arguments q180345_coeff {A RA} _ _.
Arguments q180345_nat_degree {A RA} _.

Definition q180345_leading_coeff
    {A : Type} {RA : q180345_comm_ring A}
    (p : q180345_polynomial RA) : A :=
  q180345_coeff p (q180345_nat_degree p).

Fixpoint q180345_pow
    {K : Type} (RK : q180345_comm_ring K)
    (x : K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q180345_one RK
  | S exponent =>
      q180345_mul RK x (q180345_pow RK x exponent)
  end.

Fixpoint q180345_eval_terms
    {A K : Type}
    (RA : q180345_comm_ring A)
    (RK : q180345_comm_ring K)
    (E : q180345_ring_hom RA RK)
    (p : q180345_polynomial RA)
    (r : K)
    (degree : nat) : K :=
  match degree with
  | 0 => q180345_embed E (q180345_coeff p 0)
  | S previous =>
      q180345_add RK
        (@q180345_eval_terms A K RA RK E p r previous)
        (q180345_mul RK
          (q180345_embed E (q180345_coeff p (S previous)))
          (q180345_pow RK r (S previous)))
  end.

Definition q180345_aeval
    {A K : Type}
    (RA : q180345_comm_ring A)
    (RK : q180345_comm_ring K)
    (E : q180345_ring_hom RA RK)
    (p : q180345_polynomial RA)
    (r : K) : K :=

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q180345, "Rational root theorem": for a
  polynomial over a unique factorization domain, the reduced numerator and
  denominator of a root in its fraction field divide the constant and leading
  coefficients, respectively. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q180345_rational_root_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q180345_polynomial :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::zero) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345_polynomial c \<longleftrightarrow> finite {n. c n \<noteq> 0}"

definition q180345_eval ::
    "('a::zero \<Rightarrow> 'k::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'k" where
  "q180345_eval incl c r =
    (\<Sum>n\<in>{n. c n \<noteq> 0}. incl (c n) * r ^ n)"

definition q180345_lead_coeff :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::zero) \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q180345_lead_coeff c =
    (if {n. c n \<noteq> 0} = {} then 0 else c (Max {n. c n \<noteq> 0}))"

definition q180345_unit :: "'a::comm_monoid_mult \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345_unit u \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>v. u * v = 1)"

definition q180345_coprime :: "'a::comm_monoid_mult \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345_coprime a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>d. d dvd a \<longrightarrow> d dvd b \<longrightarrow> q180345_unit d)"

definition q180345_irreducible ::
    "'a::{comm_monoid_mult,zero} \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345_irreducible p \<longleftrightarrow>
    p \<noteq> 0 \<and> \<not> q180345_unit p \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. p = a * b \<longrightarrow> q180345_unit a \<or> q180345_unit b)"

definition q180345_prime :: "'a::{comm_monoid_mult,zero} \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    p \<noteq> 0 \<and> \<not> q180345_unit p \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. p dvd a * b \<longrightarrow> p dvd a \<or> p dvd b)"

locale q180345_fraction_field_ufd =
  fixes incl :: "'a::idom \<Rightarrow> 'k::field"
    and num :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and den :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes incl_zero: "incl 0 = 0"
    and incl_one: "incl 1 = 1"
    and incl_add: "incl (x + y) = incl x + incl y"
    and incl_mult: "incl (x * y) = incl x * incl y"
    and incl_inj: "incl x = incl y \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
    and num_den_rep:
      "den r \<noteq> 0 \<and> r = incl (num r) / incl (den r)"
    and num_den_reduced: "q180345_coprime (num r) (den r)"
    and factorization:
      "x \<noteq> 0 \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>u ps. q180345_unit u \<and>
          (\<forall>p\<in>set ps. q180345_irreducible p) \<and>
          x = u * prod_list ps"
    and irreducible_prime:
      "q180345_irreducible p \<Longrightarrow> q180345_prime p"
begin

theorem num_dvd_of_is_root:
  fixes c :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and r :: 'k
  assumes "q180345_polynomial c"
    and "q180345_eval incl c r = 0"
  shows "num r dvd c 0"
  sorry

theorem den_dvd_of_is_root:
  fixes c :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and r :: 'k
  assumes "q180345_polynomial c"
    and "q180345_eval incl c r = 0"
  shows "den r dvd q180345_lead_coeff c"
  sorry

end

end

let Q180345_NUM_DVD_OF_IS_ROOT =
  `!zeroA oneA:A. !addA mulA:A->A->A. !negA:A->A.
   !zeroK oneK:K. !addK mulK:K->K->K. !negK invK:K->K.
   !embed:A->K. !numK denK:K->A. !p:num->A. !r:K.
     let powerK =
       \x:K. \n:num. ITLIST mulK (REPLICATE n x) oneK in
     let is_integral_domain_A =
       (~(zeroA = oneA) /\
       (!x. addA zeroA x = x) /\
       (!x. addA (negA x) x = zeroA) /\
       (!x y. addA x y = addA y x) /\
       (!x y z. addA x (addA y z) = addA (addA x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulA oneA x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulA x y = mulA y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulA x (mulA y z) = mulA (mulA x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulA x (addA y z) =
                  addA (mulA x y) (mulA x z)) /\
       (!x y. mulA x y = zeroA ==> x = zeroA \/ y = zeroA)) in
     let unitA =
       \u:A. ?v:A. mulA u v = oneA in
     let dvdA =
       \d:A. \x:A. ?c:A. x = mulA d c in
     let associatesA =
       \x:A. \y:A. ?u:A. unitA u /\ y = mulA u x in
     let irreducibleA =
       \q:A.
         ~(q = zeroA) /\ ~unitA q /\
         (!x y. mulA x y = q ==> unitA x \/ unitA y) in
     let factorizationA =
       \x:A. \fs:A list.
         (!q. MEM q fs ==> irreducibleA q) /\
         (?u:A. unitA u /\ x = mulA u (ITLIST mulA fs oneA)) in
     let associated_listsA =
       \fs:A list. \gs:A list.
         LENGTH fs = LENGTH gs /\
         (?perm:num->num.
            BIJ perm {i | i < LENGTH fs} {i | i < LENGTH gs} /\
            (!i. i < LENGTH fs
                 ==> associatesA (EL i fs) (EL (perm i) gs))) in
     let is_ufd_A =
       (is_integral_domain_A /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zeroA) ==> ?fs:A list. factorizationA x fs) /\
       (!x:A. !fs:A list. !gs:A list.
          factorizationA x fs /\ factorizationA x gs
          ==> associated_listsA fs gs)) in
     let is_field_K =
       (~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x. addK zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulK x (addK y z) =
                  addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!x. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK)) in
     let is_fraction_field =
       (embed zeroA = zeroK /\
       embed oneA = oneK /\
       (!x y. embed (addA x y) = addK (embed x) (embed y)) /\
       (!x y. embed (mulA x y) = mulK (embed x) (embed y)) /\
       (!x y. embed x = embed y ==> x = y) /\
       (!x:K. ?a b:A.
          ~(b = zeroA) /\ mulK x (embed b) = embed a)) in
     let is_reduced_num_den =
       (!x:K.
          ~(denK x = zeroA) /\
          mulK x (embed (denK x)) = embed (numK x) /\
          (!d:A.
             dvdA d (numK x) /\ dvdA d (denK x) ==> unitA d)) in
     let polynomial =
       FINITE {n | ~(p n = zeroA)} in
     let is_root =
       iterate addK {n | ~(p n = zeroA)}
         (\n. mulK (embed (p n)) (powerK r n)) = zeroK in
     is_ufd_A /\ is_field_K /\ is_fraction_field /\
     is_reduced_num_den /\ polynomial /\ is_root
     ==> dvdA (numK r) (p 0)`;;

     let is_field_K =

       (!x y. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulK x (addK y z) =
                  addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!x. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK)) in
     let is_fraction_field =

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q180345,
;; "Rational root theorem": over an arbitrary unique factorization domain and
;; its fraction field, a polynomial root's reduced numerator divides the
;; constant coefficient and its reduced denominator divides the leading
;; coefficient. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative stubs represent arbitrary carrier predicates, constants,
;; operations, the fraction-field embedding, and reduced numerator and
;; denominator selectors. Every required algebraic and representation law is
;; explicit below; the stubs themselves supply no assumptions.

(defstub q180345-a-p (x) t)
(defstub q180345-a-zero () t)
(defstub q180345-a-one () t)
(defstub q180345-a-add (x y) t)
(defstub q180345-a-mul (x y) t)
(defstub q180345-a-neg (x) t)

(defstub q180345-k-p (x) t)
(defstub q180345-k-zero () t)
(defstub q180345-k-one () t)
(defstub q180345-k-add (x y) t)
(defstub q180345-k-mul (x y) t)
(defstub q180345-k-neg (x) t)
(defstub q180345-k-inv (x) t)

(defstub q180345-embed (x) t)
(defstub q180345-num (x) t)
(defstub q180345-den (x) t)

;; A commutative integral domain.

(defun-sk q180345-a-ring-laws-p ()
  (forall
   (x y z)
   (implies
    (and (q180345-a-p x)
         (q180345-a-p y)
         (q180345-a-p z))
    (and
     (q180345-a-p (q180345-a-add x y))
     (q180345-a-p (q180345-a-mul x y))
     (q180345-a-p (q180345-a-neg x))
     (equal
      (q180345-a-add (q180345-a-add x y) z)
      (q180345-a-add x (q180345-a-add y z)))
     (equal (q180345-a-add x y)
            (q180345-a-add y x))
     (equal (q180345-a-add x (q180345-a-zero))
            x)
     (equal (q180345-a-add x (q180345-a-neg x))
            (q180345-a-zero))
     (equal
      (q180345-a-mul (q180345-a-mul x y) z)
      (q180345-a-mul x (q180345-a-mul y z)))
     (equal (q180345-a-mul x y)
            (q180345-a-mul y x))
     (equal (q180345-a-mul x (q180345-a-one))
            x)
     (equal
      (q180345-a-mul x (q180345-a-add y z))
      (q180345-a-add
       (q180345-a-mul x y)
       (q180345-a-mul x z)))))))

(defun-sk q180345-a-no-zero-divisors-p ()
  (forall
   (x y)
   (implies
    (and (q180345-a-p x)
         (q180345-a-p y)
         (equal (q180345-a-mul x y)
                (q180345-a-zero)))
    (or (equal x (q180345-a-zero))
        (equal y (q180345-a-zero))))))

(defun q180345-a-integral-domain-p ()
  (and
   (q180345-a-p (q180345-a-zero))
   (q180345-a-p (q180345-a-one))
   (not (equal (q180345-a-zero)
               (q180345-a-one)))
   (q180345-a-ring-laws-p)
   (q180345-a-no-zero-divisors-p)))

;; Units, divisibility, prime elements, and the UFD factorization condition.

(defun-sk q180345-unit-p (object)
  (exists
   (inverse)
   (and
    (q180345-a-p object)
    (q180345-a-p inverse)
    (equal (q180345-a-mul object inverse)
           (q180345-a-one)))))

(defun-sk q180345-divides-p (divisor dividend)
  (exists
   (quotient)
   (and
    (q180345-a-p divisor)
    (q180345-a-p dividend)
    (q180345-a-p quotient)
    (equal (q180345-a-mul divisor quotient)
           dividend))))

(defun-sk q180345-prime-divisor-law-p (prime)
  (forall
   (x y)
   (implies
    (and
     (q180345-a-p x)
     (q180345-a-p y)
     (q180345-divides-p
      prime
      (q180345-a-mul x y)))
    (or (q180345-divides-p prime x)
        (q180345-divides-p prime y)))))

(defun q180345-prime-p (object)
  (and
   (q180345-a-p object)
   (not (equal object (q180345-a-zero)))
   (not (q180345-unit-p object))
   (q180345-prime-divisor-law-p object)))

(defun q180345-prime-list-p (factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (and
       (q180345-prime-p (car factors))
       (q180345-prime-list-p (cdr factors)))
    (equal factors nil)))

(defun q180345-product (factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (q180345-a-mul
       (car factors)
       (q180345-product (cdr factors)))
    (q180345-a-one)))

(defun-sk q180345-associates-p (left right)
  (exists
   (unit)
   (and
    (q180345-a-p left)
    (q180345-a-p right)
    (q180345-unit-p unit)
    (equal (q180345-a-mul unit right)
           left))))

(defun q180345-factorization-p (object factors)
  (and
   (true-listp factors)
   (q180345-prime-list-p factors)
   (q180345-associates-p
    object
    (q180345-product factors))))

(defun-sk q180345-factorization-exists-p (object)
  (exists
   (factors)
   (q180345-factorization-p object factors)))

(defun-sk q180345-every-nonzero-factors-p ()
  (forall
   (object)
   (implies
    (and
     (q180345-a-p object)
     (not (equal object (q180345-a-zero))))
    (q180345-factorization-exists-p object))))

;; In an integral domain, existence of finite factorizations into prime
;; elements is equivalent to unique factorization.
(defun q180345-unique-factorization-domain-p ()
  (and
   (q180345-a-integral-domain-p)
   (q180345-every-nonzero-factors-p)))

;; A field K, an injective ring embedding A -> K, and the condition that every
;; element of K is represented by a quotient of elements of A.

(defun-sk q180345-k-field-laws-p ()
  (forall
   (x y z)
   (implies
    (and (q180345-k-p x)
         (q180345-k-p y)
         (q180345-k-p z))
    (and
     (q180345-k-p (q180345-k-add x y))
     (q180345-k-p (q180345-k-mul x y))
     (q180345-k-p (q180345-k-neg x))
     (q180345-k-p (q180345-k-inv x))
     (equal
      (q180345-k-add (q180345-k-add x y) z)
      (q180345-k-add x (q180345-k-add y z)))
     (equal (q180345-k-add x y)
            (q180345-k-add y x))
     (equal (q180345-k-add x (q180345-k-zero))
            x)
     (equal (q180345-k-add x (q180345-k-neg x))
            (q180345-k-zero))
     (equal
      (q180345-k-mul (q180345-k-mul x y) z)
      (q180345-k-mul x (q180345-k-mul y z)))
     (equal (q180345-k-mul x y)
            (q180345-k-mul y x))
     (equal (q180345-k-mul x (q180345-k-one))
            x)
     (equal
      (q180345-k-mul x (q180345-k-add y z))
      (q180345-k-add
       (q180345-k-mul x y)
       (q180345-k-mul x z)))
     (implies
      (equal x (q180345-k-zero))
      (equal (q180345-k-inv x)
             (q180345-k-zero)))
     (implies
      (not (equal x (q180345-k-zero)))
      (equal (q180345-k-mul x (q180345-k-inv x))
             (q180345-k-one)))))))

(defun-sk q180345-k-no-zero-divisors-p ()
  (forall
   (x y)
   (implies
    (and (q180345-k-p x)
         (q180345-k-p y)
         (equal (q180345-k-mul x y)
                (q180345-k-zero)))
    (or (equal x (q180345-k-zero))
        (equal y (q180345-k-zero))))))

(defun q180345-field-p ()
  (and
   (q180345-k-p (q180345-k-zero))
   (q180345-k-p (q180345-k-one))
   (not (equal (q180345-k-zero)
               (q180345-k-one)))
   (q180345-k-field-laws-p)
   (q180345-k-no-zero-divisors-p)))

(defun-sk q180345-embedding-laws-p ()
  (forall
   (x y)
   (implies
    (and (q180345-a-p x)
         (q180345-a-p y))
    (and
     (q180345-k-p (q180345-embed x))
     (q180345-k-p (q180345-embed y))
     (equal
      (q180345-embed (q180345-a-add x y))
      (q180345-k-add
       (q180345-embed x)
       (q180345-embed y)))
     (equal
      (q180345-embed (q180345-a-mul x y))
      (q180345-k-mul
       (q180345-embed x)
       (q180345-embed y)))
     (equal
      (q180345-embed (q180345-a-neg x))
      (q180345-k-neg (q180345-embed x)))
     (implies
      (equal (q180345-embed x)
             (q180345-embed y))
      (equal x y))))))

(defun q180345-embedding-p ()
  (and
   (equal (q180345-embed (q180345-a-zero))
          (q180345-k-zero))
   (equal (q180345-embed (q180345-a-one))
          (q180345-k-one))
   (q180345-embedding-laws-p)))

(defun-sk q180345-fraction-representable-p (element)
  (exists
   (numerator denominator)
   (and
    (q180345-a-p numerator)
    (q180345-a-p denominator)
    (not (equal denominator (q180345-a-zero)))
    (equal
     (q180345-k-mul
      element
      (q180345-embed denominator))
     (q180345-embed numerator)))))

(defun-sk q180345-every-field-element-is-fraction-p ()
  (forall
   (element)
   (implies
    (q180345-k-p element)
    (q180345-fraction-representable-p element))))

(defun q180345-fraction-field-p ()
  (and
   (q180345-field-p)
   (q180345-embedding-p)
   (q180345-every-field-element-is-fraction-p)))

;; Reduced numerator and denominator selectors. Any two reduced presentations
;; differ by multiplication by a unit, so the two divisibility conclusions
;; are invariant under this target-native choice.

(defun-sk q180345-common-divisors-are-units-p (left right)
  (forall
   (divisor)
   (implies
    (and
     (q180345-a-p divisor)
     (q180345-divides-p divisor left)
     (q180345-divides-p divisor right))
    (q180345-unit-p divisor))))

(defun q180345-coprime-p (left right)
  (and
   (q180345-a-p left)
   (q180345-a-p right)
   (q180345-common-divisors-are-units-p left right)))

(defun-sk q180345-reduced-fraction-presentation-p ()
  (forall
   (element)
   (implies
    (q180345-k-p element)
    (and
     (q180345-a-p (q180345-num element))
     (q180345-a-p (q180345-den element))
     (not
      (equal (q180345-den element)
             (q180345-a-zero)))
     (equal
      (q180345-k-mul
       element
       (q180345-embed (q180345-den element)))
      (q180345-embed (q180345-num element)))
     (q180345-coprime-p
      (q180345-num element)
      (q180345-den element))))))

;; Canonical ascending coefficient lists are exactly finite-support
;; univariate polynomials: NIL is zero and a nonempty list has a nonzero final
;; coefficient.

(defun q180345-coefficient-list-p (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (q180345-a-p (car coefficients))
       (q180345-coefficient-list-p (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q180345-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (and
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (q180345-coefficient-list-p polynomial)
   (or
    (equal polynomial nil)
    (not
     (equal (car (last polynomial))
            (q180345-a-zero))))))

(defun q180345-polynomial-eval (polynomial root)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q180345-k-add
       (q180345-embed (car polynomial))
       (q180345-k-mul
        root
        (q180345-polynomial-eval
         (cdr polynomial)
         root)))
    (q180345-k-zero)))

(defun q180345-constant-coefficient (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (car polynomial)
    (q180345-a-zero)))

(defun q180345-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (car (last polynomial))
    (q180345-a-zero)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q180345-rational-root-theorem-statement
    (polynomial root)
  (implies
   (and
    (q180345-unique-factorization-domain-p)
    (q180345-fraction-field-p)
    (q180345-reduced-fraction-presentation-p)
    (q180345-polynomial-p polynomial)
    (q180345-k-p root)
    (equal
     (q180345-polynomial-eval polynomial root)
     (q180345-k-zero)))
   (and
    (q180345-divides-p
     (q180345-num root)
     (q180345-constant-coefficient polynomial))
    (q180345-divides-p
     (q180345-den root)
     (q180345-leading-coefficient polynomial)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q180345,
-- "Rational root theorem": a root in the fraction field of a unique factorization
-- domain has numerator dividing the constant coefficient and denominator dividing
-- the leading coefficient. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q180345_rational_root_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not P =
  P -> Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor conjunction
  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : P -> P or Q
  right : Q -> P or Q

data All
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  List A ->
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  all-empty :
    All P []

  all-cons :
    {x : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    P x ->
    All P xs ->
    All P (x ∷ xs)

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : A
    addR multiplyR : A -> A -> A
    negateR : A -> A

    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : A) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : A) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

record IntegralDomain
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing A
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    no-zero-divisors :
      (x y : A) ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      (x ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) or
      (y ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing K
    inverseF : K -> K
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (inverseF x) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring

record RingHom
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b}
  (domain : CommutativeRing A)
  (codomain : CommutativeRing B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : A -> B
    map-zero :
      map (CommutativeRing.zeroR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain
    map-one :
      map (CommutativeRing.oneR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR codomain
    map-add :
      (x y : A) ->
      map (CommutativeRing.addR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.addR codomain (map x) (map y)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) ->
      map (CommutativeRing.multiplyR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR codomain (map x) (map y)

Divides :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Divides ring divisor dividend =
  Σ _
    (λ quotient ->
      dividend ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring divisor quotient)

Unit :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Unit ring x =
  Σ _
    (λ inverse ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x inverse ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring)

Associated :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Associated ring x y =
  Σ _
    (λ unit-factor ->
      Unit ring unit-factor and
      (x ≡ CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring unit-factor y))

record Irreducible
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (p : A) :
  Set a where

  field
    nonzero :
      p ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    nonunit :
      Not (Unit ring p)
    factor-is-trivial :
      (x y : A) ->
      p ≡ CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ->
      Unit ring x or Unit ring y

record Prime
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (p : A) :
  Set a where

  field
    nonzero :
      p ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    nonunit :
      Not (Unit ring p)
    divides-product :
      (x y : A) ->
      Divides ring p (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y) ->
      Divides ring p x or Divides ring p y

product :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) ->
  List A ->
  A
product ring [] =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
product ring (x ∷ xs) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (product ring xs)

record UniqueFactorizationMonoid
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    factorization :
      (x : A) ->
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      Σ (List A)
        (λ factors ->
          All (Irreducible ring) factors and
          Associated ring x (product ring factors))
    irreducible-is-prime :
      (p : A) ->
      Irreducible ring p ->
      Prime ring p

Coprime :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Coprime ring x y =
  (common-divisor : _) ->
  Divides ring common-divisor x ->
  Divides ring common-divisor y ->
  Unit ring common-divisor

record FractionRing
  {a k : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {K : Set k}
  (domain : IntegralDomain A)
  (ufd : UniqueFactorizationMonoid (IntegralDomain.ring domain))
  (field-structure : Field K)
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
      (Field.ring field-structure)) :
  Set (a ⊔ k) where

  private
    base = IntegralDomain.ring domain
    extension = Field.ring field-structure

  field
    map-injective :
      (x y : A) ->
      RingHom.map algebra-map x ≡ RingHom.map algebra-map y ->
      x ≡ y
    numerator denominator : K -> A
    denominator-nonzero :
      (r : K) ->
      denominator r ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR base
    represents :
      (r : K) ->
      RingHom.map algebra-map (numerator r) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR extension r
        (RingHom.map algebra-map (denominator r))
    reduced :
      (r : K) ->
      Coprime base (numerator r) (denominator r)

data DegreeCorrect
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (coefficient : Nat -> A) :
  Nat ->
  Set a where

  zero-polynomial :
    ((n : Nat) ->
      coefficient n ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) ->
    DegreeCorrect ring coefficient zero

  nonzero-polynomial :
    {degree : Nat} ->
    coefficient degree ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
    ((offset : Nat) ->
      coefficient (degree + suc offset) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) ->
    DegreeCorrect ring coefficient degree

record Polynomial
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    coefficient : Nat -> A
    degree : Nat
    degree-correct :
      DegreeCorrect ring coefficient degree

constantCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} ->
  Polynomial ring ->
  A
constantCoefficient polynomial =
  Polynomial.coefficient polynomial zero

leadingCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} ->
  Polynomial ring ->
  A
leadingCoefficient polynomial =
  Polynomial.coefficient polynomial (Polynomial.degree polynomial)

evaluateFrom :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Polynomial base ->
  K ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  K
evaluateFrom {extension = extension}
  algebra-map polynomial root start zero =
  RingHom.map algebra-map
    (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial start)
evaluateFrom {extension = extension}
  algebra-map polynomial root start (suc count) =
  CommutativeRing.addR extension
    (RingHom.map algebra-map
      (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial start))
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR extension root
      (evaluateFrom algebra-map polynomial root (suc start) count))

evaluate :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Polynomial base ->
  K ->
  K
evaluate algebra-map polynomial root =
  evaluateFrom algebra-map polynomial root zero
    (Polynomial.degree polynomial)

IsRoot :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Polynomial base ->
  K ->
  Set k
IsRoot {extension = extension} algebra-map polynomial root =
  evaluate algebra-map polynomial root ≡
  CommutativeRing.zeroR extension

num-dvd-of-is-root :
  (a k : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ k))
num-dvd-of-is-root a k =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (domain : IntegralDomain A) ->
  (ufd :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)) ->
  (field-structure : Field K) ->
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
      (Field.ring field-structure)) ->
  (fractions :
    FractionRing domain ufd field-structure algebra-map) ->
  (polynomial :
    Polynomial (IntegralDomain.ring domain)) ->
  (root : K) ->
  IsRoot algebra-map polynomial root ->
  Divides
    (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
    (FractionRing.numerator fractions root)
    (constantCoefficient polynomial)

den-dvd-of-is-root :
  (a k : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ k))
den-dvd-of-is-root a k =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (domain : IntegralDomain A) ->
  (ufd :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)) ->
  (field-structure : Field K) ->
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
      (Field.ring field-structure)) ->
  (fractions :
    FractionRing domain ufd field-structure algebra-map) ->
  (polynomial :
    Polynomial (IntegralDomain.ring domain)) ->
  (root : K) ->
  IsRoot algebra-map polynomial root ->
  Divides
    (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
    (FractionRing.denominator fractions root)
    (leadingCoefficient polynomial)

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q180345, "Rational root theorem": over a unique factorization domain, the
  reduced numerator and denominator of a root in its fraction field divide,
  respectively, the polynomial's constant and leading coefficients. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q180345_integral_domain_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_integral_domain_def",
  ``q180345_integral_domain
      (zero : 'a) (one : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      zero <> one /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul one x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = zero ==> x = zero \/ y = zero)``);

val q180345_divides_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_divides_def",
  ``q180345_divides (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (a : 'a) b <=>
      ?c : 'a. mul a c = b``);

val q180345_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_unit_def",
  ``q180345_unit (one : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (u : 'a) <=>
      ?v : 'a. mul u v = one``);

val q180345_irreducible_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_irreducible_def",
  ``q180345_irreducible
      (zero : 'a) (one : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (q : 'a) <=>
      q <> zero /\
      ~q180345_unit one mul q /\
      !a b : 'a.
        mul a b = q ==>
        q180345_unit one mul a \/ q180345_unit one mul b``);

val q180345_prime_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_prime_def",
  ``q180345_prime
      (zero : 'a) (one : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (q : 'a) <=>
      q <> zero /\
      ~q180345_unit one mul q /\
      !a b : 'a.
        q180345_divides mul q (mul a b) ==>
        q180345_divides mul q a \/ q180345_divides mul q b``);

val q180345_ufd_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_ufd_def",
  ``q180345_ufd
      (zero : 'a) (one : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      q180345_integral_domain zero one add mul neg /\
      (!q : 'a.
         q180345_irreducible zero one mul q ==>
         q180345_prime zero one mul q) /\
      (!x : 'a.
         x <> zero ==>
         ?u : 'a. ?factors : 'a list.
           q180345_unit one mul u /\
           EVERY (q180345_irreducible zero one mul) factors /\
           x = mul u (FOLDL mul one factors))``);

val q180345_field_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_field_def",
  ``q180345_field
      (zero : 'k) (one : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (inv : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zero <> one /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul one x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul (inv x) x = one)``);

val q180345_fraction_context_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_fraction_context_def",
  ``q180345_fraction_context
      (Azero : 'a) (Aone : 'a)
      (Aadd : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (Amul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (Aneg : 'a -> 'a)
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) (num : 'k -> 'a) (den : 'k -> 'a) <=>
      q180345_field Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv /\
      embed Azero = Kzero /\
      embed Aone = Kone /\
      (!x y. embed (Aadd x y) = Kadd (embed x) (embed y)) /\
      (!x y. embed (Amul x y) = Kmul (embed x) (embed y)) /\
      (!x. embed (Aneg x) = Kneg (embed x)) /\
      (!x y. embed x = embed y ==> x = y) /\
      (!r : 'k.
         den r <> Azero /\
         Kmul r (embed (den r)) = embed (num r) /\
         !c : 'a.
           q180345_divides Amul c (num r) /\
           q180345_divides Amul c (den r)
           ==>
           q180345_unit Aone Amul c)``);

val q180345_polynomial_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_polynomial_def",
  ``q180345_polynomial (zero : 'a) (p : num -> 'a) <=>
      FINITE {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q180345_nat_degree_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_nat_degree_def",
  ``q180345_nat_degree (zero : 'a) (p : num -> 'a) =
      if (!n : num. p n = zero)
      then 0
      else MAX_SET {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q180345_leading_coeff_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_leading_coeff_def",
  ``q180345_leading_coeff (zero : 'a) (p : num -> 'a) =
      p (q180345_nat_degree zero p)``);

val q180345_poly_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q180345_poly_eval_def",
  ``q180345_poly_eval
      (Azero : 'a) (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) (p : num -> 'a) (r : 'k) =
      ITSET
        (\n acc.
           Kadd
             (Kmul (embed (p n)) (FUNPOW (Kmul r) n Kone))
             acc)
        {n : num | p n <> Azero}
        Kzero``);

val num_dvd_of_is_root =
  ``!(Azero : 'a) (Aone : 'a)
      (Aadd : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (Amul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (Aneg : 'a -> 'a)
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) (num : 'k -> 'a) (den : 'k -> 'a)
      (p : num -> 'a) (r : 'k).
      q180345_ufd Azero Aone Aadd Amul Aneg /\
      q180345_fraction_context
        Azero Aone Aadd Amul Aneg
        Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv embed num den /\
      q180345_polynomial Azero p /\
      q180345_poly_eval Azero Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul embed p r = Kzero
      ==>
      q180345_divides Amul (num r) (p 0)``;

val den_dvd_of_is_root =
  ``!(Azero : 'a) (Aone : 'a)
      (Aadd : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (Amul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (Aneg : 'a -> 'a)
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) (num : 'k -> 'a) (den : 'k -> 'a)
      (p : num -> 'a) (r : 'k).
      q180345_ufd Azero Aone Aadd Amul Aneg /\
      q180345_fraction_context
        Azero Aone Aadd Amul Aneg
        Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv embed num den /\
      q180345_polynomial Azero p /\
      q180345_poly_eval Azero Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul embed p r = Kzero
      ==>
      q180345_divides
        Amul (den r) (q180345_leading_coeff Azero p)``;

title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q180345), "Rational root theorem": over an
  arbitrary unique factorization domain, a root in its fraction field has
  reduced numerator dividing the constant coefficient and reduced denominator
  dividing the leading coefficient. This file contains no proof.

  The canonical fraction field Frac ` R represents the arbitrary fraction
  field in the source statement up to its canonical R-algebra isomorphism.
  Q180345Reduced selects coprime numerator-denominator representatives; all
  such representatives differ by a unit, so the two divisibility conclusions
  are equivalent to those for the source's normalized numerator and
  denominator.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$c Q180345Root Q180345Reduced Q180345Leading $.

q180345-root-syntax $a wff ( Q180345Root R P X ) $.
q180345-reduced-syntax $a wff ( Q180345Reduced R X A B ) $.
q180345-leading-syntax $a class ( Q180345Leading R P ) $.

${
  $d P Q R X k $.
  q180345-root-definition $a |- ( ( Q180345Root R P X ) <->
      E. Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` ( Frac ` R ) ) )
        ( ( A. k e. NN0
              ( ( coe1 ` Q ) ` k ) =
                [ <. ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` k ) , ( 1r ` R ) >. ]
                  ( R ~RL ( RLReg ` R ) ) )
          /\
          ( ( ( eval1 ` ( Frac ` R ) ) ` Q ) ` X ) =
            ( 0g ` ( Frac ` R ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B D R X $.
  q180345-reduced-definition $a |- ( ( Q180345Reduced R X A B ) <->
      ( ( A e. ( Base ` R ) /\ B e. ( RLReg ` R ) )
        /\
        ( X = [ <. A , B >. ] ( R ~RL ( RLReg ` R ) )
          /\
          A. D e. ( Base ` R )
            ( ( D ( ||r ` R ) A /\ D ( ||r ` R ) B ) ->
              D e. ( Unit ` R ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d P R $.
  q180345-leading-definition $a |- ( ( Q180345Leading R P ) =
      if ( P = ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` R ) ) ,
           ( 0g ` R ) ,
           ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` ( ( deg1 ` R ) ` P ) ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B P R X $.
  thousand-theorems-q180345-num-dvd-of-is-root $a |-
      A. R e. UFD
        A. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` R ) )
          A. X e. ( Base ` ( Frac ` R ) )
            ( ( Q180345Root R P X ) ->
              A. A e. ( Base ` R )
                A. B e. ( RLReg ` R )
                  ( ( Q180345Reduced R X A B ) ->
                    A ( ||r ` R ) ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` 0 ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B P R X $.
  thousand-theorems-q180345-den-dvd-of-is-root $a |-
      A. R e. UFD
        A. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` R ) )
          A. X e. ( Base ` ( Frac ` R ) )
            ( ( Q180345Root R P X ) ->
              A. A e. ( Base ` R )
                A. B e. ( RLReg ` R )
                  ( ( Q180345Reduced R X A B ) ->
                    B ( ||r ` R ) ( Q180345Leading R P ) ) ) $.
$}
