title: Q180345_rational_root_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345,
% "Rational root theorem": a reduced fraction root of a polynomial over a
% unique factorization domain has numerator dividing the constant coefficient
% and denominator dividing the leading coefficient. This file contains no proof.

Q180345_rational_root_theorem[
  A, K, Poly: TYPE+,
  zero_A, one_A: A,
  neg_A: [A -> A],
  add_A, mul_A: [A, A -> A],
  zero_K, one_K: K,
  neg_K: [K -> K],
  add_K, mul_K: [K, K -> K],
  inv_K: [K -> K],
  algebra_map: [A -> K],
  numerator, denominator: [K -> A],
  coefficient: [Poly, nat -> A],
  degree: [Poly -> nat]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  divides_A(divisor, value: A): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: A): value = mul_A(divisor, quotient)

  unit_A(value: A): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: A): mul_A(value, inverse) = one_A

  associated_A(left, right: A): bool =
    EXISTS (unit: A):
      unit_A(unit) AND left = mul_A(unit, right)

  irreducible_A(value: A): bool =
    NOT value = zero_A
      AND NOT unit_A(value)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: A):
        value = mul_A(left, right)
          IMPLIES unit_A(left) OR unit_A(right))

  prime_A(value: A): bool =
    irreducible_A(value)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: A):
        divides_A(value, mul_A(left, right))
          IMPLIES divides_A(value, left) OR divides_A(value, right))

  product_A(factors: list[A]): RECURSIVE A =
    CASES factors OF
      null: one_A,
      cons(head, tail): mul_A(head, product_A(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  all_irreducible_A(factors: list[A]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES factors OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        irreducible_A(head) AND all_irreducible_A(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  commutative_integral_domain_laws: bool =
    NOT one_A = zero_A
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): add_A(a, b) = add_A(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        add_A(add_A(a, b), c) = add_A(a, add_A(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: A): add_A(a, zero_A) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: A): add_A(a, neg_A(a)) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): mul_A(a, b) = mul_A(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        mul_A(mul_A(a, b), c) = mul_A(a, mul_A(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: A): mul_A(a, one_A) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        mul_A(a, add_A(b, c))
          = add_A(mul_A(a, b), mul_A(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        mul_A(a, b) = zero_A
          IMPLIES a = zero_A OR b = zero_A)

  unique_factorization_domain_laws: bool =
    commutative_integral_domain_laws
      AND (FORALL (value: A):
        NOT value = zero_A IMPLIES
          EXISTS (factors: list[A]):
            all_irreducible_A(factors)
              AND associated_A(value, product_A(factors)))
      AND (FORALL (value: A):
        irreducible_A(value) IMPLIES prime_A(value))

  field_laws: bool =
    NOT one_K = zero_K
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K): add_K(x, y) = add_K(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        add_K(add_K(x, y), z) = add_K(x, add_K(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K): add_K(x, zero_K) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: K): add_K(x, neg_K(x)) = zero_K)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K): mul_K(x, y) = mul_K(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mul_K(mul_K(x, y), z) = mul_K(x, mul_K(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K): mul_K(x, one_K) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mul_K(x, add_K(y, z))
          = add_K(mul_K(x, y), mul_K(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        NOT x = zero_K IMPLIES mul_K(x, inv_K(x)) = one_K)

  algebra_map_laws: bool =
    algebra_map(zero_A) = zero_K
      AND algebra_map(one_A) = one_K
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        algebra_map(add_A(a, b))
          = add_K(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        algebra_map(mul_A(a, b))
          = mul_K(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        algebra_map(a) = algebra_map(b) IMPLIES a = b)

  fraction_field_laws: bool =
    field_laws
      AND algebra_map_laws
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        EXISTS (num, den: A):
          NOT den = zero_A
            AND mul_K(x, algebra_map(den)) = algebra_map(num))

  reduced_num_den_laws: bool =
    FORALL (x: K):
      NOT denominator(x) = zero_A
        AND mul_K(x, algebra_map(denominator(x)))
          = algebra_map(numerator(x))
        AND (FORALL (factor: A):
          irreducible_A(factor) IMPLIES
            NOT (divides_A(factor, numerator(x))
              AND divides_A(factor, denominator(x))))

  finitely_supported(f: [nat -> A]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      FORALL (index: nat):
        index > bound IMPLIES f(index) = zero_A

  power_K(x: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one_K
    ELSE
      mul_K(power_K(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_sum(p: Poly, x: K, count: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_K
    ELSE
      add_K(
        polynomial_sum(p, x, count - 1),
        mul_K(
          algebra_map(coefficient(p, count - 1)),
          power_K(x, count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  evaluate(p: Poly, x: K): K =
    polynomial_sum(p, x, degree(p) + 1)

  leading_coefficient(p: Poly): A =
    coefficient(p, degree(p))

  polynomial_representation_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p, q: Poly):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        coefficient(p, index) = coefficient(q, index))
        IMPLIES p = q)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly), (index: nat):
        index > degree(p) IMPLIES coefficient(p, index) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly):
        degree(p) = 0
          OR NOT coefficient(p, degree(p)) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (f: [nat -> A]):
        finitely_supported(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (p: Poly):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              coefficient(p, index) = f(index))

  rational_root_context: bool =
    unique_factorization_domain_laws
      AND fraction_field_laws
      AND reduced_num_den_laws
      AND polynomial_representation_laws

  num_dvd_of_is_root: bool =
    rational_root_context IMPLIES
      FORALL (p: Poly), (root: K):
        evaluate(p, root) = zero_K IMPLIES
          divides_A(numerator(root), coefficient(p, 0))

  den_dvd_of_is_root: bool =
    rational_root_context IMPLIES
      FORALL (p: Poly), (root: K):
        evaluate(p, root) = zero_K IMPLIES
          divides_A(denominator(root), leading_coefficient(p))

END Q180345_rational_root_theorem

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q180345X
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q180345X), "Integral root theorem": every root in
-- the fraction field of a unique factorization domain of a monic polynomial
-- over that domain is an integer over the domain. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Eval.Algebra
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Basic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.UniqueFactorizationDomain.Defs

@[expose] public section

open scoped Polynomial

namespace Q180345X

variable {A K : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A] [Field K]
variable [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]

open IsLocalization Polynomial

/-- A root of a monic polynomial over a UFD is an integer over that domain. -/
theorem isInteger_of_is_root_of_monic {p : A[X]} (hp : Monic p) {r : K}
    (hr : aeval r p = 0) : IsInteger A r := sorry

end Q180345X

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345X
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q180345X), "Integral root theorem": every root in
  the fraction field of a unique factorization domain of a monic polynomial
  over that domain lies in the image of the domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.

Import ListNotations.
Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q180345x_commutative_ring (A : Type) : Type := {
  q180345x_zero : A;
  q180345x_one : A;
  q180345x_add : A -> A -> A;
  q180345x_mul : A -> A -> A;
  q180345x_neg : A -> A;
  q180345x_add_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q180345x_add x y = q180345x_add y x;
  q180345x_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q180345x_add (q180345x_add x y) z =
      q180345x_add x (q180345x_add y z);
  q180345x_add_zero :
    forall x : A,
      q180345x_add x q180345x_zero = x;
  q180345x_add_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q180345x_add x (q180345x_neg x) = q180345x_zero;
  q180345x_mul_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q180345x_mul x y = q180345x_mul y x;
  q180345x_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q180345x_mul (q180345x_mul x y) z =
      q180345x_mul x (q180345x_mul y z);
  q180345x_mul_one :
    forall x : A,
      q180345x_mul x q180345x_one = x;
  q180345x_mul_add :
    forall x y z : A,
      q180345x_mul x (q180345x_add y z) =
      q180345x_add
        (q180345x_mul x y) (q180345x_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q180345x_zero {A} _.
Arguments q180345x_one {A} _.
Arguments q180345x_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q180345x_mul {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q180345x_neg {A} _ _.

Record q180345x_integral_domain (A : Type) : Type := {
  q180345x_domain_ring : q180345x_commutative_ring A;
  q180345x_one_ne_zero :
    q180345x_one q180345x_domain_ring <>
    q180345x_zero q180345x_domain_ring;
  q180345x_no_zero_divisors :
    forall x y : A,
      q180345x_mul q180345x_domain_ring x y =
      q180345x_zero q180345x_domain_ring ->
      x = q180345x_zero q180345x_domain_ring \/
      y = q180345x_zero q180345x_domain_ring
}.

Arguments q180345x_domain_ring {A} _.

Record q180345x_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q180345x_field_ring : q180345x_commutative_ring K;
  q180345x_inv : K -> K;
  q180345x_field_one_ne_zero :
    q180345x_one q180345x_field_ring <>
    q180345x_zero q180345x_field_ring;
  q180345x_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q180345x_zero q180345x_field_ring ->
      q180345x_mul q180345x_field_ring x (q180345x_inv x) =
      q180345x_one q180345x_field_ring
}.

Arguments q180345x_field_ring {K} _.

Record q180345x_ring_hom
    {A K : Type}
    (RA : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (RK : q180345x_commutative_ring K) : Type := {
  q180345x_map : A -> K;
  q180345x_map_zero :
    q180345x_map (q180345x_zero RA) = q180345x_zero RK;
  q180345x_map_one :
    q180345x_map (q180345x_one RA) = q180345x_one RK;
  q180345x_map_add :
    forall x y : A,
      q180345x_map (q180345x_add RA x y) =
      q180345x_add RK (q180345x_map x) (q180345x_map y);
  q180345x_map_mul :
    forall x y : A,
      q180345x_map (q180345x_mul RA x y) =
      q180345x_mul RK (q180345x_map x) (q180345x_map y)
}.

Arguments q180345x_map {A K RA RK} _ _.

Definition q180345x_divides
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (a b : A) : Prop :=
  exists c : A, b = q180345x_mul R a c.

Definition q180345x_unit
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (u : A) : Prop :=
  exists v : A,
    q180345x_mul R u v = q180345x_one R.

Definition q180345x_associated
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (x y : A) : Prop :=
  exists u : A,
    q180345x_unit R u /\
    x = q180345x_mul R u y.

Definition q180345x_irreducible
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (p : A) : Prop :=
  p <> q180345x_zero R /\
  ~ q180345x_unit R p /\
  forall x y : A,
    p = q180345x_mul R x y ->
    q180345x_unit R x \/ q180345x_unit R y.

Definition q180345x_prime
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (p : A) : Prop :=
  p <> q180345x_zero R /\
  ~ q180345x_unit R p /\
  forall x y : A,
    q180345x_divides R p (q180345x_mul R x y) ->
    q180345x_divides R p x \/ q180345x_divides R p y.

Fixpoint q180345x_product
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A)
    (xs : list A) : A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => q180345x_one R
  | x :: rest =>
      q180345x_mul R x (q180345x_product R rest)
  end.

Record q180345x_unique_factorization_monoid
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q180345x_factorization :
    forall x : A,
      x <> q180345x_zero R ->
      exists factors : list A,
        Forall (q180345x_irreducible R) factors /\
        q180345x_associated R x (q180345x_product R factors);
  q180345x_irreducible_is_prime :
    forall p : A,
      q180345x_irreducible R p ->
      q180345x_prime R p
}.

Record q180345x_fraction_field
    {A K : Type}
    (D : q180345x_integral_domain A)
    (F : q180345x_field K)
    (embed :
      q180345x_ring_hom
        (q180345x_domain_ring D)
        (q180345x_field_ring F)) : Type := {
  q180345x_map_injective :
    forall x y : A,
      q180345x_map embed x = q180345x_map embed y ->
      x = y;
  q180345x_every_element_is_fraction :
    forall r : K,
      exists numerator denominator : A,
        denominator <>
          q180345x_zero (q180345x_domain_ring D) /\
        q180345x_map embed numerator =
          q180345x_mul
            (q180345x_field_ring F)
            r (q180345x_map embed denominator)
}.

Record q180345x_polynomial
    {A : Type}
    (R : q180345x_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q180345x_coefficient : nat -> A;
  q180345x_degree : nat;
  q180345x_degree_correct :
    ((forall n : nat,
        q180345x_coefficient n = q180345x_zero R) /\
      q180345x_degree = O) \/
    (q180345x_coefficient q180345x_degree <>
       q180345x_zero R /\
     forall n : nat,
       (q180345x_degree < n)%nat ->
       q180345x_coefficient n = q180345x_zero R)
}.

Arguments q180345x_coefficient {A R} _ _.
Arguments q180345x_degree {A R} _.

Fixpoint q180345x_evaluate_from
    {A K : Type}
    {RA : q180345x_commutative_ring A}
    {RK : q180345x_commutative_ring K}
    (embed : q180345x_ring_hom RA RK)
    (p : q180345x_polynomial RA)
    (r : K)
    (start count : nat) : K :=
  match count with
  | O => q180345x_map embed (q180345x_coefficient p start)
  | S remaining =>
      q180345x_add RK
        (q180345x_map embed (q180345x_coefficient p start))
        (q180345x_mul RK r
          (q180345x_evaluate_from
            embed p r (S start) remaining))
  end.

Definition q180345x_evaluate
    {A K : Type}
    {RA : q180345x_commutative_ring A}
    {RK : q180345x_commutative_ring K}
    (embed : q180345x_ring_hom RA RK)
    (p : q180345x_polynomial RA)
    (r : K) : K :=
  q180345x_evaluate_from
    embed p r O (q180345x_degree p).

Definition q180345x_monic
    {A : Type}
    {R : q180345x_commutative_ring A}
    (p : q180345x_polynomial R) : Prop :=
  q180345x_coefficient p (q180345x_degree p) =
  q180345x_one R.

Definition q180345x_is_root
    {A K : Type}
    {RA : q180345x_commutative_ring A}
    {RK : q180345x_commutative_ring K}
    (embed : q180345x_ring_hom RA RK)
    (p : q180345x_polynomial RA)
    (r : K) : Prop :=
  q180345x_evaluate embed p r = q180345x_zero RK.

Definition q180345x_is_integer
    {A K : Type}
    {RA : q180345x_commutative_ring A}
    {RK : q180345x_commutative_ring K}
    (embed : q180345x_ring_hom RA RK)
    (r : K) : Prop :=
  exists a : A, r = q180345x_map embed a.

Theorem isInteger_of_is_root_of_monic :
  forall
    (A K : Type)
    (D : q180345x_integral_domain A)
    (U :
      q180345x_unique_factorization_monoid
        (q180345x_domain_ring D))
    (F : q180345x_field K)
    (embed :
      q180345x_ring_hom
        (q180345x_domain_ring D)
        (q180345x_field_ring F))
    (FF : q180345x_fraction_field D F embed)
    (p : q180345x_polynomial (q180345x_domain_ring D))
    (r : K),
    q180345x_monic p ->
    q180345x_is_root embed p r ->
    q180345x_is_integer embed r.
Admitted.

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q180345X, "Integral root theorem": a root in a fraction field of a monic
  polynomial over a unique factorization domain lies in the embedded base
  domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q180345x_polynomial :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::zero) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345x_polynomial c \<longleftrightarrow> finite {n. c n \<noteq> 0}"

definition q180345x_eval ::
    "('a::zero \<Rightarrow> 'k::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'k" where
  "q180345x_eval incl c r =
    (\<Sum>n\<in>{n. c n \<noteq> 0}. incl (c n) * r ^ n)"

definition q180345x_lead_coeff :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::zero) \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q180345x_lead_coeff c =
    (if {n. c n \<noteq> 0} = {} then 0 else c (Max {n. c n \<noteq> 0}))"

definition q180345x_unit :: "'a::comm_monoid_mult \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345x_unit u \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>v. u * v = 1)"

definition q180345x_irreducible ::
    "'a::{comm_monoid_mult,zero} \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345x_irreducible p \<longleftrightarrow>
    p \<noteq> 0 \<and> \<not> q180345x_unit p \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. p = a * b \<longrightarrow> q180345x_unit a \<or> q180345x_unit b)"

definition q180345x_prime :: "'a::{comm_monoid_mult,zero} \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q180345x_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    p \<noteq> 0 \<and> \<not> q180345x_unit p \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. p dvd a * b \<longrightarrow> p dvd a \<or> p dvd b)"

locale q180345x_fraction_field_ufd =
  fixes incl :: "'a::idom \<Rightarrow> 'k::field"
  assumes incl_zero: "incl 0 = 0"
    and incl_one: "incl 1 = 1"
    and incl_add: "\<And>x y. incl (x + y) = incl x + incl y"
    and incl_mult: "\<And>x y. incl (x * y) = incl x * incl y"
    and incl_inj: "\<And>x y. incl x = incl y \<Longrightarrow> x = y"
    and fraction_field:
      "\<And>r. \<exists>a b. b \<noteq> 0 \<and> r = incl a / incl b"
    and factorization:
      "\<And>x. x \<noteq> 0 \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>u ps. q180345x_unit u \<and>
          (\<forall>p\<in>set ps. q180345x_irreducible p) \<and>
          x = u * prod_list ps"
    and irreducible_prime:
      "\<And>p. q180345x_irreducible p \<Longrightarrow> q180345x_prime p"
begin

theorem isInteger_of_is_root_of_monic:
  fixes c :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and r :: 'k
  assumes "q180345x_polynomial c"
    and "q180345x_lead_coeff c = 1"
    and "q180345x_eval incl c r = 0"
  shows "\<exists>a. r = incl a"
  oops

end

end

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345X,
  "Integral root theorem": a root in a fraction field of a monic polynomial
  over a unique factorization domain lies in the embedded domain. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q180345X_INTEGRAL_ROOT_THEOREM =
  `!zeroA:A. !oneA:A. !addA:A->A->A. !mulA:A->A->A. !negA:A->A.
   !zeroK:K. !oneK:K. !addK:K->K->K. !mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK:K->K. !invK:K->K. !embed:A->K.
   !p:num->A. !r:K.
     let powerK =
       \x:K. \n:num. ITLIST mulK (REPLICATE n x) oneK in
     let is_integral_domain_A =
       (~(zeroA = oneA) /\
       (!x. addA zeroA x = x) /\
       (!x. addA (negA x) x = zeroA) /\
       (!x y. addA x y = addA y x) /\
       (!x y z. addA x (addA y z) = addA (addA x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulA oneA x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulA x y = mulA y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulA x (mulA y z) = mulA (mulA x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulA x (addA y z) =
                  addA (mulA x y) (mulA x z)) /\
       (!x y. mulA x y = zeroA ==> x = zeroA \/ y = zeroA)) in
     let unitA =
       \u:A. ?v:A. mulA u v = oneA in
     let associatesA =
       \x:A. \y:A. ?u:A. unitA u /\ y = mulA u x in
     let irreducibleA =
       \q:A.
         ~(q = zeroA) /\ ~unitA q /\
         (!x y. mulA x y = q ==> unitA x \/ unitA y) in
     let factorizationA =
       \x:A. \fs:A list.
         (!q. MEM q fs ==> irreducibleA q) /\
         (?u:A. unitA u /\ x = mulA u (ITLIST mulA fs oneA)) in
     let associated_listsA =
       \fs:A list. \gs:A list.
         LENGTH fs = LENGTH gs /\
         (?perm:num->num.
            BIJ perm {i | i < LENGTH fs} {i | i < LENGTH gs} /\
            (!i. i < LENGTH fs
                 ==> associatesA (EL i fs) (EL (perm i) gs))) in
     let is_ufd_A =
       (is_integral_domain_A /\
       (!x:A. ~(x = zeroA) ==> ?fs:A list. factorizationA x fs) /\
       (!x:A. !fs:A list. !gs:A list.
          factorizationA x fs /\ factorizationA x gs
          ==> associated_listsA fs gs)) in
     let is_field_K =
       (~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x. addK zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulK x (addK y z) =
                  addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       (!x. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK)) in
     let is_fraction_field =
       (embed zeroA = zeroK /\
       embed oneA = oneK /\
       (!x y. embed (addA x y) = addK (embed x) (embed y)) /\
       (!x y. embed (mulA x y) = mulK (embed x) (embed y)) /\
       (!x y. embed x = embed y ==> x = y) /\
       (!x:K. ?a:A. ?b:A.
          ~(b = zeroA) /\ mulK x (embed b) = embed a)) in
     let polynomial =
       (FINITE {n | ~(p n = zeroA)}) in
     let monic =
       (?d:num.
         p d = oneA /\
         (!n. d < n ==> p n = zeroA)) in
     let is_root =
       (iterate addK {n | ~(p n = zeroA)}
         (\n. mulK (embed (p n)) (powerK r n)) = zeroK) in
     is_ufd_A /\ is_field_K /\ is_fraction_field /\
     polynomial /\ monic /\ is_root
     ==> ?a:A. r = embed a`;;

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q180345X,
;; "Integral root theorem": over an arbitrary unique factorization domain and
;; its fraction field, every root of a monic polynomial lies in the image of
;; the domain's canonical embedding. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative function symbols present arbitrary, potentially infinite
;; carriers and their operations, indexed by structure identifiers. The
;; declarations supply no algebraic laws: every ring, domain, field,
;; embedding, and fraction-field condition is stated explicitly below with
;; direct DEFUN-SK quantifiers.
;;
;; A UFD is presented by the equivalent characterization that every nonzero
;; element is a unit times a finite product of prime elements. Polynomials are
;; canonical ascending coefficient lists: NIL is zero, and a nonempty list has
;; nonzero final coefficient. Thus they are exactly finite-support univariate
;; polynomials, with no degree bound. Being an integer means that an internally
;; quantified domain element maps to the given fraction-field element.

(defstub q180345x-element-p (structure value) t)
(defstub q180345x-zero (structure) t)
(defstub q180345x-one (structure) t)
(defstub q180345x-add (structure left right) t)
(defstub q180345x-multiply (structure left right) t)
(defstub q180345x-negate (structure value) t)
(defstub q180345x-inverse (structure value) t)
(defstub q180345x-embed
  (small-structure large-structure value)
  t)

;; Commutative rings and integral domains.

(defun-sk q180345x-commutative-ring-laws-p (structure)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q180345x-element-p structure x)
      (q180345x-element-p structure y)
      (q180345x-element-p structure z))
     (let* ((zero (q180345x-zero structure))
            (one (q180345x-one structure))
            (x-plus-y (q180345x-add structure x y))
            (y-plus-z (q180345x-add structure y z))
            (x-times-y (q180345x-multiply structure x y))
            (y-times-z (q180345x-multiply structure y z))
            (negative-x (q180345x-negate structure x)))
       (and
        (q180345x-element-p structure x-plus-y)
        (q180345x-element-p structure x-times-y)
        (q180345x-element-p structure negative-x)
        (equal
         (q180345x-add structure x-plus-y z)
         (q180345x-add structure x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (q180345x-add structure y x))
        (equal (q180345x-add structure x zero) x)
        (equal (q180345x-add structure x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q180345x-multiply structure x-times-y z)
         (q180345x-multiply structure x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (q180345x-multiply structure y x))
        (equal (q180345x-multiply structure x one) x)
        (equal
         (q180345x-multiply structure x y-plus-z)
         (q180345x-add
          structure
          (q180345x-multiply structure x y)
          (q180345x-multiply structure x z))))))))

(defun-sk q180345x-no-zero-divisors-p (structure)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q180345x-element-p structure x)
      (q180345x-element-p structure y)
      (equal
       (q180345x-multiply structure x y)
       (q180345x-zero structure)))
     (or
      (equal x (q180345x-zero structure))
      (equal y (q180345x-zero structure))))))

(defun q180345x-integral-domain-p (structure)
  (and
   (q180345x-element-p structure (q180345x-zero structure))
   (q180345x-element-p structure (q180345x-one structure))
   (not
    (equal
     (q180345x-zero structure)
     (q180345x-one structure)))
   (q180345x-commutative-ring-laws-p structure)
   (q180345x-no-zero-divisors-p structure)))

;; Units, divisibility, primes, and the UFD factorization property.

(defun-sk q180345x-unit-p (structure object)
  (exists (inverse)
    (and
     (q180345x-element-p structure object)
     (q180345x-element-p structure inverse)
     (equal
      (q180345x-multiply structure object inverse)
      (q180345x-one structure)))))

(defun-sk q180345x-divides-p
    (structure divisor dividend)
  (exists (quotient)
    (and
     (q180345x-element-p structure divisor)
     (q180345x-element-p structure dividend)
     (q180345x-element-p structure quotient)
     (equal
      (q180345x-multiply structure divisor quotient)
      dividend))))

(defun-sk q180345x-prime-divisor-law-p
    (structure prime)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q180345x-element-p structure x)
      (q180345x-element-p structure y)
      (q180345x-divides-p
       structure
       prime
       (q180345x-multiply structure x y)))
     (or
      (q180345x-divides-p structure prime x)
      (q180345x-divides-p structure prime y)))))

(defun q180345x-prime-p (structure object)
  (and
   (q180345x-element-p structure object)
   (not (equal object (q180345x-zero structure)))
   (not (q180345x-unit-p structure object))
   (q180345x-prime-divisor-law-p structure object)))

(defun q180345x-prime-list-p (structure factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (and
       (q180345x-prime-p structure (car factors))
       (q180345x-prime-list-p structure (cdr factors)))
    (equal factors nil)))

(defun q180345x-product (structure factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (q180345x-multiply
       structure
       (car factors)
       (q180345x-product structure (cdr factors)))
    (q180345x-one structure)))

(defun-sk q180345x-associates-p
    (structure left right)
  (exists (unit)
    (and
     (q180345x-element-p structure left)
     (q180345x-element-p structure right)
     (q180345x-unit-p structure unit)
     (equal
      (q180345x-multiply structure unit right)
      left))))

(defun q180345x-factorization-p
    (structure object factors)
  (and
   (true-listp factors)
   (q180345x-prime-list-p structure factors)
   (q180345x-associates-p
    structure
    object
    (q180345x-product structure factors))))

(defun-sk q180345x-factorization-exists-p
    (structure object)
  (exists (factors)
    (q180345x-factorization-p structure object factors)))

(defun-sk q180345x-ufd-factorization-law-p (structure)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (and
      (q180345x-element-p structure object)
      (not (equal object (q180345x-zero structure))))
     (q180345x-factorization-exists-p structure object))))

(defun q180345x-unique-factorization-domain-p (structure)
  (and
   (q180345x-integral-domain-p structure)
   (q180345x-ufd-factorization-law-p structure)))

;; Fields, embeddings, and fraction-field presentations.

(defun-sk q180345x-field-inverse-laws-p (structure)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q180345x-element-p structure x)
     (let ((inverse-x (q180345x-inverse structure x)))
       (and
        (q180345x-element-p structure inverse-x)
        (implies
         (equal x (q180345x-zero structure))
         (equal inverse-x (q180345x-zero structure)))
        (implies
         (not (equal x (q180345x-zero structure)))
         (equal
          (q180345x-multiply structure x inverse-x)
          (q180345x-one structure))))))))

(defun q180345x-field-p (structure)
  (and
   (q180345x-integral-domain-p structure)
   (q180345x-field-inverse-laws-p structure)))

(defun-sk q180345x-embedding-laws-p
    (small-structure large-structure)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q180345x-element-p small-structure x)
      (q180345x-element-p small-structure y))
     (let ((map-x
            (q180345x-embed
             small-structure large-structure x))
           (map-y
            (q180345x-embed
             small-structure large-structure y)))
       (and
        (q180345x-element-p large-structure map-x)
        (equal
         (q180345x-embed
          small-structure
          large-structure
          (q180345x-add small-structure x y))
         (q180345x-add large-structure map-x map-y))
        (equal
         (q180345x-embed
          small-structure
          large-structure
          (q180345x-multiply small-structure x y))
         (q180345x-multiply large-structure map-x map-y))
        (equal
         (q180345x-embed
          small-structure
          large-structure
          (q180345x-zero small-structure))
         (q180345x-zero large-structure))
        (equal
         (q180345x-embed
          small-structure
          large-structure
          (q180345x-one small-structure))
         (q180345x-one large-structure))
        (implies
         (equal map-x map-y)
         (equal x y)))))))

(defun-sk q180345x-fraction-exists-p
    (small-structure large-structure element)
  (exists (numerator denominator)
    (and
     (q180345x-element-p small-structure numerator)
     (q180345x-element-p small-structure denominator)
     (not
      (equal
       denominator
       (q180345x-zero small-structure)))
     (equal
      (q180345x-multiply
       large-structure
       element
       (q180345x-embed
        small-structure large-structure denominator))
      (q180345x-embed
       small-structure large-structure numerator)))))

(defun-sk q180345x-fraction-surjectivity-p
    (small-structure large-structure)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q180345x-element-p large-structure element)
     (q180345x-fraction-exists-p
      small-structure large-structure element))))

(defun q180345x-fraction-field-p
    (small-structure large-structure)
  (and
   (q180345x-field-p large-structure)
   (q180345x-embedding-laws-p
    small-structure large-structure)
   (q180345x-fraction-surjectivity-p
    small-structure large-structure)))

;; Canonical univariate polynomials and evaluation through the embedding.

(defun q180345x-coefficient-list-p
    (structure coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (q180345x-element-p structure (car coefficients))
       (q180345x-coefficient-list-p
        structure (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q180345x-polynomial-p (structure polynomial)
  (and
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (q180345x-coefficient-list-p structure polynomial)
   (or
    (equal polynomial nil)
    (not
     (equal
      (car (last polynomial))
      (q180345x-zero structure))))))

(defun q180345x-polynomial-eval
    (small-structure large-structure polynomial root)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q180345x-add
       large-structure
       (q180345x-embed
        small-structure large-structure (car polynomial))
       (q180345x-multiply
        large-structure
        root
        (q180345x-polynomial-eval
         small-structure
         large-structure
         (cdr polynomial)
         root)))
    (q180345x-zero large-structure)))

(defun q180345x-leading-coefficient
    (structure polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (car (last polynomial))
    (q180345x-zero structure)))

(defun-sk q180345x-integer-p
    (small-structure large-structure root)
  (exists (integer)
    (and
     (q180345x-element-p small-structure integer)
     (equal
      root
      (q180345x-embed
       small-structure large-structure integer)))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q180345x-integral-root-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (small-structure large-structure polynomial root)
    (implies
     (and
      (q180345x-unique-factorization-domain-p
       small-structure)
      (q180345x-fraction-field-p
       small-structure large-structure)
      (q180345x-polynomial-p small-structure polynomial)
      (equal
       (q180345x-leading-coefficient
        small-structure polynomial)
       (q180345x-one small-structure))
      (q180345x-element-p large-structure root)
      (equal
       (q180345x-polynomial-eval
        small-structure large-structure polynomial root)
       (q180345x-zero large-structure)))
     (q180345x-integer-p
      small-structure large-structure root))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q180345X,
-- "Integral root theorem": over an arbitrary unique factorization domain and
-- its fraction field, every root of a monic polynomial lies in the image of
-- the domain's canonical embedding. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q180345X_integral_root_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not P =
  P -> Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor conjunction
  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : P -> P or Q
  right : Q -> P or Q

data All
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  List A ->
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  all-empty :
    All P []

  all-cons :
    {x : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    P x ->
    All P xs ->
    All P (x ∷ xs)

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : A
    addR multiplyR : A -> A -> A
    negateR : A -> A

    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : A) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : A) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

record IntegralDomain
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing A
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    no-zero-divisors :
      (x y : A) ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      (x ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) or
      (y ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing K
    inverseF : K -> K
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (inverseF x) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring

record RingHom
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b}
  (domain : CommutativeRing A)
  (codomain : CommutativeRing B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : A -> B
    map-zero :
      map (CommutativeRing.zeroR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain
    map-one :
      map (CommutativeRing.oneR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR codomain
    map-add :
      (x y : A) ->
      map (CommutativeRing.addR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.addR codomain (map x) (map y)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) ->
      map (CommutativeRing.multiplyR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR codomain (map x) (map y)

Divides :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Divides ring divisor dividend =
  Σ _
    (λ quotient ->
      dividend ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring divisor quotient)

Unit :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Unit ring x =
  Σ _
    (λ inverse ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x inverse ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring)

Associated :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Associated ring x y =
  Σ _
    (λ unit-factor ->
      Unit ring unit-factor and
      (x ≡ CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring unit-factor y))

record Irreducible
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (p : A) :
  Set a where

  field
    nonzero :
      p ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    nonunit :
      Not (Unit ring p)
    factor-is-trivial :
      (x y : A) ->
      p ≡ CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ->
      Unit ring x or Unit ring y

record Prime
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (p : A) :
  Set a where

  field
    nonzero :
      p ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    nonunit :
      Not (Unit ring p)
    divides-product :
      (x y : A) ->
      Divides ring p (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y) ->
      Divides ring p x or Divides ring p y

product :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) ->
  List A ->
  A
product ring [] =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
product ring (x ∷ xs) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (product ring xs)

record UniqueFactorizationMonoid
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    factorization :
      (x : A) ->
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      Σ (List A)
        (λ factors ->
          All (Irreducible ring) factors and
          Associated ring x (product ring factors))
    irreducible-is-prime :
      (p : A) ->
      Irreducible ring p ->
      Prime ring p

record FractionField
  {a k : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {K : Set k}
  (domain : IntegralDomain A)
  (field-structure : Field K)
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
      (Field.ring field-structure)) :
  Set (a ⊔ k) where

  private
    base = IntegralDomain.ring domain
    extension = Field.ring field-structure

  field
    map-injective :
      (x y : A) ->
      RingHom.map algebra-map x ≡ RingHom.map algebra-map y ->
      x ≡ y
    every-element-is-fraction :
      (r : K) ->
      Σ A
        (λ numerator ->
          Σ A
            (λ denominator ->
              denominator ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR base and
              (RingHom.map algebra-map numerator ≡
                CommutativeRing.multiplyR extension r
                  (RingHom.map algebra-map denominator))))

data DegreeCorrect
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (coefficient : Nat -> A) :
  Nat ->
  Set a where

  zero-polynomial :
    ((n : Nat) ->
      coefficient n ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) ->
    DegreeCorrect ring coefficient zero

  nonzero-polynomial :
    {degree : Nat} ->
    coefficient degree ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
    ((offset : Nat) ->
      coefficient (degree + suc offset) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) ->
    DegreeCorrect ring coefficient degree

record Polynomial
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    coefficient : Nat -> A
    degree : Nat
    degree-correct :
      DegreeCorrect ring coefficient degree

leadingCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} ->
  Polynomial ring ->
  A
leadingCoefficient polynomial =
  Polynomial.coefficient polynomial (Polynomial.degree polynomial)

evaluateFrom :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Polynomial base ->
  K ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  K
evaluateFrom {extension = extension}
  algebra-map polynomial root start zero =
  RingHom.map algebra-map
    (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial start)
evaluateFrom {extension = extension}
  algebra-map polynomial root start (suc count) =
  CommutativeRing.addR extension
    (RingHom.map algebra-map
      (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial start))
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR extension root
      (evaluateFrom algebra-map polynomial root (suc start) count))

evaluate :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Polynomial base ->
  K ->
  K
evaluate algebra-map polynomial root =
  evaluateFrom algebra-map polynomial root zero
    (Polynomial.degree polynomial)

Monic :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) ->
  Polynomial ring ->
  Set a
Monic ring polynomial =
  leadingCoefficient polynomial ≡
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring

IsRoot :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Polynomial base ->
  K ->
  Set k
IsRoot {extension = extension} algebra-map polynomial root =
  evaluate algebra-map polynomial root ≡
  CommutativeRing.zeroR extension

IsInteger :
  {a k : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {base : CommutativeRing A} ->
  {extension : CommutativeRing K} ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  K ->
  Set (a ⊔ k)
IsInteger {A = A} algebra-map root =
  Σ A
    (λ integer ->
      RingHom.map algebra-map integer ≡ root)

isInteger-of-is-root-of-monic :
  (a k : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ k))
isInteger-of-is-root-of-monic a k =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (domain : IntegralDomain A) ->
  (ufd :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)) ->
  (field-structure : Field K) ->
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (IntegralDomain.ring domain)
      (Field.ring field-structure)) ->
  FractionField domain field-structure algebra-map ->
  (polynomial :
    Polynomial (IntegralDomain.ring domain)) ->
  Monic (IntegralDomain.ring domain) polynomial ->
  (root : K) ->
  IsRoot algebra-map polynomial root ->
  IsInteger algebra-map root

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q180345X, "Integral root theorem": a root in the fraction field of a unique
  factorization domain of a monic polynomial over that domain is the image of
  an element of the domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q180345x_integral_domain_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_integral_domain_def",
  ``q180345x_integral_domain
      (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negA : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      zeroA <> oneA /\
      (!x y z. addA (addA x y) z = addA x (addA y z)) /\
      (!x y. addA x y = addA y x) /\
      (!x. addA zeroA x = x) /\
      (!x. addA (negA x) x = zeroA) /\
      (!x y z. mulA (mulA x y) z = mulA x (mulA y z)) /\
      (!x y. mulA x y = mulA y x) /\
      (!x. mulA oneA x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulA x (addA y z) = addA (mulA x y) (mulA x z)) /\
      (!x y. mulA x y = zeroA ==> x = zeroA \/ y = zeroA)``);

val q180345x_divides_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_divides_def",
  ``q180345x_divides (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (a : 'a) b <=>
      ?c : 'a. mulA a c = b``);

val q180345x_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_unit_def",
  ``q180345x_unit (oneA : 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (u : 'a) <=>
      ?v : 'a. mulA u v = oneA``);

val q180345x_irreducible_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_irreducible_def",
  ``q180345x_irreducible
      (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (q : 'a) <=>
      q <> zeroA /\
      ~q180345x_unit oneA mulA q /\
      !a b : 'a.
        mulA a b = q ==>
        q180345x_unit oneA mulA a \/ q180345x_unit oneA mulA b``);

val q180345x_prime_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_prime_def",
  ``q180345x_prime
      (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (q : 'a) <=>
      q <> zeroA /\
      ~q180345x_unit oneA mulA q /\
      !a b : 'a.
        q180345x_divides mulA q (mulA a b) ==>
        q180345x_divides mulA q a \/ q180345x_divides mulA q b``);

val q180345x_ufd_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_ufd_def",
  ``q180345x_ufd
      (zeroA : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (negA : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      q180345x_integral_domain zeroA oneA addA mulA negA /\
      (!q : 'a.
         q180345x_irreducible zeroA oneA mulA q ==>
         q180345x_prime zeroA oneA mulA q) /\
      (!x : 'a.
         x <> zeroA ==>
         ?u : 'a. ?factors : 'a list.
           q180345x_unit oneA mulA u /\
           EVERY (q180345x_irreducible zeroA oneA mulA) factors /\
           x = mulA u (FOLDL mulA oneA factors))``);

val q180345x_field_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_field_def",
  ``q180345x_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!x y z. addK (addK x y) z = addK x (addK y z)) /\
      (!x y. addK x y = addK y x) /\
      (!x. addK zeroK x = x) /\
      (!x. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
      (!x y z. mulK (mulK x y) z = mulK x (mulK y z)) /\
      (!x y. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
      (!x. mulK oneK x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulK x (addK y z) = addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
      (!x. x <> zeroK ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK)``);

val q180345x_fraction_field_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_fraction_field_def",
  ``q180345x_fraction_field
      (Azero : 'a) (Aone : 'a)
      (Aadd : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (Amul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (Aneg : 'a -> 'a)
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) <=>
      q180345x_field Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv /\
      embed Azero = Kzero /\
      embed Aone = Kone /\
      (!x y. embed (Aadd x y) = Kadd (embed x) (embed y)) /\
      (!x y. embed (Amul x y) = Kmul (embed x) (embed y)) /\
      (!x. embed (Aneg x) = Kneg (embed x)) /\
      (!x y. embed x = embed y ==> x = y) /\
      (!r : 'k.
         ?a b : 'a.
           b <> Azero /\
           Kmul r (embed b) = embed a)``);

val q180345x_polynomial_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_polynomial_def",
  ``q180345x_polynomial (zero : 'a) (p : num -> 'a) <=>
      FINITE {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q180345x_nat_degree_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_nat_degree_def",
  ``q180345x_nat_degree (zero : 'a) (p : num -> 'a) =
      if (!n : num. p n = zero)
      then 0
      else MAX_SET {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q180345x_leading_coeff_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_leading_coeff_def",
  ``q180345x_leading_coeff (zero : 'a) (p : num -> 'a) =
      p (q180345x_nat_degree zero p)``);

val q180345x_poly_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q180345x_poly_eval_def",
  ``q180345x_poly_eval
      (Azero : 'a) (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) (p : num -> 'a) (r : 'k) =
      ITSET
        (\n acc.
           Kadd
             (Kmul (embed (p n)) (FUNPOW (Kmul r) n Kone))
             acc)
        {n : num | p n <> Azero}
        Kzero``);

val isInteger_of_is_root_of_monic =
  ``!(Azero : 'a) (Aone : 'a)
      (Aadd : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (Amul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (Aneg : 'a -> 'a)
      (Kzero : 'k) (Kone : 'k)
      (Kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (Kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (Kneg : 'k -> 'k) (Kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (embed : 'a -> 'k) (p : num -> 'a) (r : 'k).
      q180345x_ufd Azero Aone Aadd Amul Aneg /\
      q180345x_fraction_field
        Azero Aone Aadd Amul Aneg
        Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul Kneg Kinv embed /\
      q180345x_polynomial Azero p /\
      q180345x_leading_coeff Azero p = Aone /\
      q180345x_poly_eval
        Azero Kzero Kone Kadd Kmul embed p r = Kzero
      ==>
      ?a : 'a. r = embed a``;

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345X
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q180345X), "Integral root theorem": over an
  arbitrary unique factorization domain, every root in its fraction field of
  a monic polynomial over the domain is the image of an element of the
  domain. This file contains no proof.

  The canonical fraction field Frac ` R represents the arbitrary fraction
  field in the source statement up to its canonical R-algebra isomorphism.
  SetMM's Monic1p ` R is the class of monic univariate polynomials over R.
  The conclusion writes the root as the fraction class of <A, 1>, which is
  exactly membership in the image of the base domain.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$c Q180345XRoot $.

q180345x-root-syntax $a wff ( Q180345XRoot R P X ) $.

${
  $d P Q R X k $.
  q180345x-root-definition $a |- ( ( Q180345XRoot R P X ) <->
      E. Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` ( Frac ` R ) ) )
        ( ( A. k e. NN0
              ( ( coe1 ` Q ) ` k ) =
                [ <. ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` k ) , ( 1r ` R ) >. ]
                  ( R ~RL ( RLReg ` R ) ) )
          /\
          ( ( ( eval1 ` ( Frac ` R ) ) ` Q ) ` X ) =
            ( 0g ` ( Frac ` R ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d A P R X $.
  thousand-theorems-q180345x-is-integer-of-is-root-of-monic $a |-
      A. R e. UFD
        A. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` R ) )
          A. X e. ( Base ` ( Frac ` R ) )
            ( ( P e. ( Monic1p ` R )
                /\ ( Q180345XRoot R P X ) ) ->
              E. A e. ( Base ` R )
                X = [ <. A , ( 1r ` R ) >. ]
                      ( R ~RL ( RLReg ` R ) ) ) $.
$}

title: Q180345X_integral_root_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q180345X,
% "Integral root theorem": every root in the fraction field of a monic polynomial
% over a unique factorization domain lies in the image of that domain. This file
% contains no proof.

Q180345X_integral_root_theorem[
  A, K, Poly: TYPE+,
  zero_A, one_A: A,
  neg_A: [A -> A],
  add_A, mul_A: [A, A -> A],
  zero_K, one_K: K,
  neg_K: [K -> K],
  add_K, mul_K: [K, K -> K],
  inv_K: [K -> K],
  algebra_map: [A -> K],
  coefficient: [Poly, nat -> A],
  degree: [Poly -> nat]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  divides_A(divisor, value: A): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: A): value = mul_A(divisor, quotient)

  unit_A(value: A): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: A): mul_A(value, inverse) = one_A

  associated_A(left, right: A): bool =
    EXISTS (unit: A):
      unit_A(unit) AND left = mul_A(unit, right)

  irreducible_A(value: A): bool =
    NOT value = zero_A
      AND NOT unit_A(value)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: A):
        value = mul_A(left, right)
          IMPLIES unit_A(left) OR unit_A(right))

  prime_A(value: A): bool =
    irreducible_A(value)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: A):
        divides_A(value, mul_A(left, right))
          IMPLIES divides_A(value, left) OR divides_A(value, right))

  product_A(factors: list[A]): RECURSIVE A =
    CASES factors OF
      null: one_A,
      cons(head, tail): mul_A(head, product_A(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  all_irreducible_A(factors: list[A]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES factors OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        irreducible_A(head) AND all_irreducible_A(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  commutative_integral_domain_laws: bool =
    NOT one_A = zero_A
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): add_A(a, b) = add_A(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        add_A(add_A(a, b), c) = add_A(a, add_A(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: A): add_A(a, zero_A) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: A): add_A(a, neg_A(a)) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A): mul_A(a, b) = mul_A(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        mul_A(mul_A(a, b), c) = mul_A(a, mul_A(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: A): mul_A(a, one_A) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: A):
        mul_A(a, add_A(b, c))
          = add_A(mul_A(a, b), mul_A(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        mul_A(a, b) = zero_A
          IMPLIES a = zero_A OR b = zero_A)

  unique_factorization_domain_laws: bool =
    commutative_integral_domain_laws
      AND (FORALL (value: A):
        NOT value = zero_A IMPLIES
          EXISTS (factors: list[A]):
            all_irreducible_A(factors)
              AND associated_A(value, product_A(factors)))
      AND (FORALL (value: A):
        irreducible_A(value) IMPLIES prime_A(value))

  field_laws: bool =
    NOT one_K = zero_K
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K): add_K(x, y) = add_K(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        add_K(add_K(x, y), z) = add_K(x, add_K(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K): add_K(x, zero_K) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: K): add_K(x, neg_K(x)) = zero_K)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: K): mul_K(x, y) = mul_K(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mul_K(mul_K(x, y), z) = mul_K(x, mul_K(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: K): mul_K(x, one_K) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
        mul_K(x, add_K(y, z))
          = add_K(mul_K(x, y), mul_K(x, z)))
      AND inv_K(zero_K) = zero_K
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        NOT x = zero_K IMPLIES mul_K(x, inv_K(x)) = one_K)

  algebra_map_laws: bool =
    algebra_map(zero_A) = zero_K
      AND algebra_map(one_A) = one_K
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        algebra_map(add_A(a, b))
          = add_K(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        algebra_map(mul_A(a, b))
          = mul_K(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
        algebra_map(a) = algebra_map(b) IMPLIES a = b)

  fraction_field_laws: bool =
    field_laws
      AND algebra_map_laws
      AND (FORALL (x: K):
        EXISTS (num, den: A):
          NOT den = zero_A
            AND mul_K(x, algebra_map(den)) = algebra_map(num))

  finitely_supported(f: [nat -> A]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      FORALL (index: nat):
        index > bound IMPLIES f(index) = zero_A

  power_K(x: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one_K
    ELSE
      mul_K(power_K(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_sum(p: Poly, x: K, count: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_K
    ELSE
      add_K(
        polynomial_sum(p, x, count - 1),
        mul_K(
          algebra_map(coefficient(p, count - 1)),
          power_K(x, count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  evaluate(p: Poly, x: K): K =
    polynomial_sum(p, x, degree(p) + 1)

  leading_coefficient(p: Poly): A =
    coefficient(p, degree(p))

  polynomial_representation_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p, q: Poly):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        coefficient(p, index) = coefficient(q, index))
        IMPLIES p = q)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly), (index: nat):
        index > degree(p) IMPLIES coefficient(p, index) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly):
        degree(p) = 0
          OR NOT coefficient(p, degree(p)) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (f: [nat -> A]):
        finitely_supported(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (p: Poly):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              coefficient(p, index) = f(index))

  monic(p: Poly): bool =
    leading_coefficient(p) = one_A

  is_integer_A(root: K): bool =
    EXISTS (value: A): root = algebra_map(value)

  integral_root_context: bool =
    unique_factorization_domain_laws
      AND fraction_field_laws
      AND polynomial_representation_laws

  isInteger_of_is_root_of_monic: bool =
    integral_root_context IMPLIES
      FORALL (p: Poly), (root: K):
        monic(p)
          AND evaluate(p, root) = zero_K
        IMPLIES is_integer_A(root)

END Q180345X_integral_root_theorem

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1816952
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1816952), "Schur's lemma": over an algebraically
  closed field, the finite-dimensional endomorphism space of a simple object
  in a linear preadditive category with kernels has dimension one. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q1816952_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q1816952_zero : K;
  q1816952_one : K;
  q1816952_add : K -> K -> K;
  q1816952_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q1816952_neg : K -> K;
  q1816952_inv : K -> K;
  q1816952_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1816952_add x (q1816952_add y z) =
      q1816952_add (q1816952_add x y) z;
  q1816952_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1816952_add x y = q1816952_add y x;
  q1816952_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q1816952_add x q1816952_zero = x;
  q1816952_add_neg :
    forall x : K, q1816952_add x (q1816952_neg x) = q1816952_zero;
  q1816952_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1816952_mul x (q1816952_mul y z) =
      q1816952_mul (q1816952_mul x y) z;
  q1816952_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q1816952_mul x y = q1816952_mul y x;
  q1816952_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q1816952_mul x q1816952_one = x;
  q1816952_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q1816952_mul x (q1816952_add y z) =
      q1816952_add
        (q1816952_mul x y) (q1816952_mul x z);
  q1816952_mul_inv :
    forall x : K, x <> q1816952_zero ->
      q1816952_mul x (q1816952_inv x) = q1816952_one;
  q1816952_nontrivial : q1816952_zero <> q1816952_one
}.

Arguments q1816952_zero {K} _.
Arguments q1816952_one {K} _.
Arguments q1816952_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1816952_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q1816952_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q1816952_inv {K} _ _.

Fixpoint q1816952_polynomial_eval
    {K : Type} (F : q1816952_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) (x : K) : K :=
  match coefficients with
  | nil => q1816952_zero F
  | cons c rest =>
      q1816952_add F c
        (q1816952_mul F x
          (q1816952_polynomial_eval F rest x))
  end.

Fixpoint q1816952_some_nonzero
    {K : Type} (F : q1816952_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | nil => False
  | cons c rest =>
      c <> q1816952_zero F \/
      q1816952_some_nonzero F rest
  end.

Definition q1816952_polynomial_nonconstant
    {K : Type} (F : q1816952_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | nil => False
  | cons _ positive_degree_coefficients =>
      q1816952_some_nonzero F positive_degree_coefficients
  end.

Definition q1816952_is_algebraically_closed
    {K : Type} (F : q1816952_field K) : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : list K,
    q1816952_polynomial_nonconstant F coefficients ->
    exists x : K,
      q1816952_polynomial_eval F coefficients x =
      q1816952_zero F.

Record q1816952_category : Type := {
  q1816952_obj : Type;
  q1816952_hom : q1816952_obj -> q1816952_obj -> Type;
  q1816952_id :
    forall X : q1816952_obj, q1816952_hom X X;
  q1816952_comp :
    forall X Y Z : q1816952_obj,
      q1816952_hom X Y ->
      q1816952_hom Y Z ->
      q1816952_hom X Z;
  q1816952_comp_id_left :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj) (f : q1816952_hom X Y),
      @q1816952_comp X X Y (q1816952_id X) f = f;
  q1816952_comp_id_right :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj) (f : q1816952_hom X Y),
      @q1816952_comp X Y Y f (q1816952_id Y) = f;
  q1816952_comp_assoc :
    forall (W X Y Z : q1816952_obj)
           (f : q1816952_hom W X)
           (g : q1816952_hom X Y)
           (h : q1816952_hom Y Z),
      @q1816952_comp W Y Z (@q1816952_comp W X Y f g) h =
      @q1816952_comp W X Z f (@q1816952_comp X Y Z g h)
}.

Arguments q1816952_obj _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1816952_hom _ _ _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q1816952_id {q} _.
Arguments q1816952_comp {q} {X Y Z} _ _.

Record q1816952_abelian_group (A : Type) : Type := {
  q1816952_ag_zero : A;
  q1816952_ag_add : A -> A -> A;
  q1816952_ag_neg : A -> A;
  q1816952_ag_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q1816952_ag_add x (q1816952_ag_add y z) =
      q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_ag_add x y) z;
  q1816952_ag_add_comm :
    forall x y : A, q1816952_ag_add x y = q1816952_ag_add y x;
  q1816952_ag_add_zero :
    forall x : A, q1816952_ag_add x q1816952_ag_zero = x;
  q1816952_ag_add_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q1816952_ag_add x (q1816952_ag_neg x) = q1816952_ag_zero
}.

Arguments q1816952_ag_zero {A} _.
Arguments q1816952_ag_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q1816952_ag_neg {A} _ _.

Record q1816952_preadditive (C : q1816952_category) : Type := {
  q1816952_hom_group :
    forall X Y : q1816952_obj C,
      q1816952_abelian_group (q1816952_hom C X Y);
  q1816952_comp_add_left :
    forall (W X Y : q1816952_obj C)
           (f g : q1816952_hom C W X)
           (h : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_comp
        (q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group W X) f g) h =
      q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group W Y)
        (q1816952_comp f h) (q1816952_comp g h);
  q1816952_comp_add_right :
    forall (W X Y : q1816952_obj C)
           (f : q1816952_hom C W X)
           (g h : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_comp f
        (q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group X Y) g h) =
      q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group W Y)
        (q1816952_comp f g) (q1816952_comp f h)
}.

Arguments q1816952_hom_group {C} _ _ _.

Definition q1816952_zero_morphism
    {C : q1816952_category}
    (P : q1816952_preadditive C)
    (X Y : q1816952_obj C) : q1816952_hom C X Y :=
  q1816952_ag_zero (q1816952_hom_group P X Y).

Record q1816952_linear
    {K : Type}
    (F : q1816952_field K)
    (C : q1816952_category)
    (P : q1816952_preadditive C) : Type := {
  q1816952_smul :
    forall X Y : q1816952_obj C,
      K -> q1816952_hom C X Y -> q1816952_hom C X Y;
  q1816952_one_smul :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C) (f : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_smul X Y (q1816952_one F) f = f;
  q1816952_mul_smul :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C) (a b : K)
           (f : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_smul X Y (q1816952_mul F a b) f =
      q1816952_smul X Y a (q1816952_smul X Y b f);
  q1816952_add_smul :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C) (a b : K)
           (f : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_smul X Y (q1816952_add F a b) f =
      q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group P X Y)
        (q1816952_smul X Y a f) (q1816952_smul X Y b f);
  q1816952_smul_add :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C) (a : K)
           (f g : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_smul X Y a
        (q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group P X Y) f g) =
      q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group P X Y)
        (q1816952_smul X Y a f) (q1816952_smul X Y a g);
  q1816952_zero_smul :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C) (f : q1816952_hom C X Y),
      q1816952_smul X Y (q1816952_zero F) f =
      q1816952_zero_morphism P X Y;
  q1816952_smul_zero :
    forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C) (a : K),
      q1816952_smul X Y a (q1816952_zero_morphism P X Y) =
      q1816952_zero_morphism P X Y;
  q1816952_smul_comp :
    forall (X Y Z : q1816952_obj C) (a : K)
           (f : q1816952_hom C X Y)
           (g : q1816952_hom C Y Z),
      q1816952_comp (q1816952_smul X Y a f) g =
      q1816952_smul X Z a (q1816952_comp f g);
  q1816952_comp_smul :
    forall (X Y Z : q1816952_obj C) (a : K)
           (f : q1816952_hom C X Y)
           (g : q1816952_hom C Y Z),
      q1816952_comp f (q1816952_smul Y Z a g) =
      q1816952_smul X Z a (q1816952_comp f g)
}.

Arguments q1816952_smul {K F C P} _ {X Y} _ _.

Definition q1816952_is_isomorphism
    {C : q1816952_category}
    {X Y : q1816952_obj C}
    (f : q1816952_hom C X Y) : Prop :=
  exists g : q1816952_hom C Y X,
    q1816952_comp f g = q1816952_id X /\
    q1816952_comp g f = q1816952_id Y.

Definition q1816952_is_monomorphism
    {C : q1816952_category}
    {X Y : q1816952_obj C}
    (f : q1816952_hom C X Y) : Prop :=
  forall (Z : q1816952_obj C)
         (g h : q1816952_hom C Z X),
    q1816952_comp g f = q1816952_comp h f -> g = h.

Definition q1816952_simple
    {C : q1816952_category}
    (P : q1816952_preadditive C)
    (X : q1816952_obj C) : Prop :=
  forall (Y : q1816952_obj C)
         (f : q1816952_hom C Y X),
    q1816952_is_monomorphism f ->
    (q1816952_is_isomorphism f <->
     f <> q1816952_zero_morphism P Y X).

Definition q1816952_is_kernel
    {C : q1816952_category}
    (P : q1816952_preadditive C)
    {X Y Kernel : q1816952_obj C}
    (f : q1816952_hom C X Y)
    (kernel_arrow : q1816952_hom C Kernel X) : Prop :=
  q1816952_comp kernel_arrow f =
    q1816952_zero_morphism P Kernel Y /\
  forall (T : q1816952_obj C)
         (t : q1816952_hom C T X),
    q1816952_comp t f = q1816952_zero_morphism P T Y ->
    exists u : q1816952_hom C T Kernel,
      q1816952_comp u kernel_arrow = t /\
      forall v : q1816952_hom C T Kernel,
        q1816952_comp v kernel_arrow = t -> v = u.

Definition q1816952_has_kernels
    {C : q1816952_category}
    (P : q1816952_preadditive C) : Prop :=
  forall (X Y : q1816952_obj C)
         (f : q1816952_hom C X Y),
    exists Kernel : q1816952_obj C,
    exists kernel_arrow : q1816952_hom C Kernel X,
      q1816952_is_kernel P f kernel_arrow.

Fixpoint q1816952_endomorphism_sum
    {C : q1816952_category}
    (P : q1816952_preadditive C)
    (X : q1816952_obj C)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> q1816952_hom C X X) ->
                q1816952_hom C X X :=
  match n as m
        return (Fin.t m -> q1816952_hom C X X) ->
               q1816952_hom C X X with
  | O => fun _ => q1816952_zero_morphism P X X
  | S m =>
      fun terms =>
        q1816952_ag_add (q1816952_hom_group P X X)
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q1816952_endomorphism_sum C P X m
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Definition q1816952_is_basis
    {K : Type}
    {F : q1816952_field K}
    {C : q1816952_category}
    {P : q1816952_preadditive C}
    (L : @q1816952_linear K F C P)
    (X : q1816952_obj C)
    (n : nat)
    (basis : Fin.t n -> q1816952_hom C X X) : Prop :=
  (forall f : q1816952_hom C X X,
    exists coefficients : Fin.t n -> K,
      f =
      @q1816952_endomorphism_sum C P X n
        (fun i => q1816952_smul L (coefficients i) (basis i))) /\
  (forall coefficients : Fin.t n -> K,
    @q1816952_endomorphism_sum C P X n
      (fun i => q1816952_smul L (coefficients i) (basis i)) =
    q1816952_zero_morphism P X X ->
    forall i : Fin.t n, coefficients i = q1816952_zero F).

Definition q1816952_finite_dimensional_endomorphisms
    {K : Type}
    {F : q1816952_field K}
    {C : q1816952_category}
    {P : q1816952_preadditive C}
    (L : @q1816952_linear K F C P)
    (X : q1816952_obj C) : Prop :=
  exists n : nat,
  exists basis : Fin.t n -> q1816952_hom C X X,
    @q1816952_is_basis K F C P L X n basis.

Definition q1816952_endomorphism_dimension_one
    {K : Type}
    {F : q1816952_field K}
    {C : q1816952_category}
    {P : q1816952_preadditive C}
    (L : @q1816952_linear K F C P)
    (X : q1816952_obj C) : Prop :=
  exists basis : Fin.t 1 -> q1816952_hom C X X,
    @q1816952_is_basis K F C P L X 1 basis.

Theorem CategoryTheory_finrank_endomorphism_simple_eq_one :
  forall (K : Type)
         (F : q1816952_field K)
         (C : q1816952_category)
         (P : q1816952_preadditive C)
         (L : @q1816952_linear K F C P)
         (X : q1816952_obj C),
    q1816952_is_algebraically_closed F ->
    q1816952_has_kernels P ->
    q1816952_simple P X ->
    q1816952_finite_dimensional_endomorphisms L X ->
    q1816952_endomorphism_dimension_one L X.
Admitted.
