(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1816952
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1816952), "Schur's lemma": over an
  algebraically closed field, the finite-dimensional endomorphism space of a
  simple object in a linear preadditive category with kernels is
  one-dimensional. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
  imports Main
begin

record ('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data =
  objects :: "'o set"
  arrows :: "'m set"
  source :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'o"
  target :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'o"
  identity :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  compose :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  zero_arrow :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  add_arrow :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  neg_arrow :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  scalar_arrow :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm"

definition q1816952_hom ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm set" where
  "q1816952_hom C X Y =
    {f \<in> arrows C. source C f = X \<and> target C f = Y}"

definition q1816952_is_category ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_category C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C.
      source C f \<in> objects C \<and> target C f \<in> objects C) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C.
      identity C X \<in> q1816952_hom C X X) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C Y Z.
        compose C g f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Z) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        compose C (identity C Y) f = f \<and>
        compose C f (identity C X) = f) \<and>
    (\<forall>W \<in> objects C. \<forall>X \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C W X.
      \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
      \<forall>h \<in> q1816952_hom C Y Z.
        compose C h (compose C g f) = compose C (compose C h g) f)"

definition q1816952_is_preadditive ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_preadditive C \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1816952_is_category C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      zero_arrow C X Y \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        neg_arrow C f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
          add_arrow C f g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        add_arrow C (zero_arrow C X Y) f = f \<and>
        add_arrow C f (zero_arrow C X Y) = f) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        add_arrow C f (neg_arrow C f) = zero_arrow C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
          add_arrow C f g = add_arrow C g f) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        \<forall>h \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
          add_arrow C (add_arrow C f g) h =
            add_arrow C f (add_arrow C g h))) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
      \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
      \<forall>h \<in> q1816952_hom C Y Z.
        compose C h (add_arrow C f g) =
          add_arrow C (compose C h f) (compose C h g)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
      \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C Y Z.
      \<forall>h \<in> q1816952_hom C Y Z.
        compose C (add_arrow C g h) f =
          add_arrow C (compose C g f) (compose C h f))"

definition q1816952_is_linear_category ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k::field) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_linear_category C \<longleftrightarrow>
    q1816952_is_preadditive C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C.
      (\<forall>a. \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        scalar_arrow C a f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y) \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        scalar_arrow C 0 f = zero_arrow C X Y \<and>
        scalar_arrow C 1 f = f) \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        scalar_arrow C (a + b) f =
          add_arrow C (scalar_arrow C a f) (scalar_arrow C b f)) \<and>
      (\<forall>a. \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
          scalar_arrow C a (add_arrow C f g) =
            add_arrow C (scalar_arrow C a f) (scalar_arrow C a g)) \<and>
      (\<forall>a b. \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
        scalar_arrow C (a * b) f =
          scalar_arrow C a (scalar_arrow C b f))) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>a. \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X Y.
      \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C Y Z.
        compose C g (scalar_arrow C a f) =
          scalar_arrow C a (compose C g f) \<and>
        compose C (scalar_arrow C a g) f =
          scalar_arrow C a (compose C g f))"

definition q1816952_is_algebraically_closed ::
    "'k::field itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_algebraically_closed _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>c :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {n. c n \<noteq> 0} \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>n>0. c n \<noteq> 0) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. (\<Sum>n\<in>{n. c n \<noteq> 0}. c n * x ^ n) = 0))"

definition q1816952_is_kernel ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_kernel C k f \<longleftrightarrow>
    k \<in> arrows C \<and> f \<in> arrows C \<and>
    target C k = source C f \<and>
    compose C f k = zero_arrow C (source C k) (target C f) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C. \<forall>h \<in> q1816952_hom C X (source C f).
      compose C f h = zero_arrow C X (target C f) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>!u.
        u \<in> q1816952_hom C X (source C k) \<and>
        compose C k u = h))"

definition q1816952_has_kernels ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_has_kernels C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>f \<in> arrows C. \<exists>k. q1816952_is_kernel C k f)"

definition q1816952_is_monomorphism ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_monomorphism C f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> arrows C \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> objects C.
      \<forall>g \<in> q1816952_hom C X (source C f).
      \<forall>h \<in> q1816952_hom C X (source C f).
        compose C f g = compose C f h \<longrightarrow> g = h)"

definition q1816952_is_isomorphism ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_isomorphism C f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> arrows C \<and>
    (\<exists>g \<in> q1816952_hom C (target C f) (source C f).
      compose C g f = identity C (source C f) \<and>
      compose C f g = identity C (target C f))"

definition q1816952_is_simple_object ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'o \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_is_simple_object C X \<longleftrightarrow>
    X \<in> objects C \<and>
    identity C X \<noteq> zero_arrow C X X \<and>
    (\<forall>Y \<in> objects C. \<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C Y X.
      q1816952_is_monomorphism C f \<longrightarrow>
        f = zero_arrow C Y X \<or> q1816952_is_isomorphism C f)"

fun q1816952_end_lincomb ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'o \<Rightarrow> ('k \<times> 'm) list \<Rightarrow> 'm" where
  "q1816952_end_lincomb C X [] = zero_arrow C X X"
| "q1816952_end_lincomb C X ((a, f) # xs) =
    add_arrow C (scalar_arrow C a f) (q1816952_end_lincomb C X xs)"

definition q1816952_finite_dimensional_end ::
    "('o, 'm, 'k::field) q1816952_linear_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'o \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1816952_finite_dimensional_end C X \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B :: 'm list.
      set B \<subseteq> q1816952_hom C X X \<and>
      (\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X X.
        \<exists>cs :: 'k list.
          length cs = length B \<and>
          q1816952_end_lincomb C X (zip cs B) = f))"

theorem q1816952_schur_s_lemma:
  fixes C :: "('o, 'm, 'k::field) q1816952_linear_category_data"
    and X :: 'o
  assumes "q1816952_is_linear_category C"
    and "q1816952_is_algebraically_closed (TYPE('k))"
    and "q1816952_has_kernels C"
    and "q1816952_is_simple_object C X"
    and "q1816952_finite_dimensional_end C X"
  shows "\<forall>f \<in> q1816952_hom C X X.
    \<exists>!c :: 'k. scalar_arrow C c (identity C X) = f"
  sorry

end

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1816952,
  "Schur's lemma": over an algebraically closed field, the finite-dimensional
  endomorphism space of a simple object in a linear preadditive category with
  kernels has dimension one. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q1816952_SCHUR_S_LEMMA =
  `let arrow =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool) (x:O) (y:O) (f:M).
       objects x /\ objects y /\ hom x y f in
   let is_field =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a:K. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:K. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:K. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a b c:K. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a:K. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a b:K. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a b c:K. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:K. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) in
   let power =
     \(oneK:K) (mulK:K->K->K) (a:K) (n:num).
       ITLIST mulK (REPLICATE n a) oneK in
   let is_polynomial =
     \(zeroK:K) (p:num->K). FINITE {n | ~(p n = zeroK)} in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K) (a:K).
       iterate addK {n | ~(p n = zeroK)}
         (\n. mulK (p n) (power oneK mulK a n)) in
   let is_algebraically_closed =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K).
       !p:num->K.
         is_polynomial zeroK p /\
         (?n:num. ~(n = 0) /\ ~(p n = zeroK))
         ==> ?a:K. polynomial_eval zeroK oneK addK mulK p a = zeroK in
   let is_category =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M).
       (!x y x' y':O. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f /\
          arrow objects hom x' y' f
          ==> x = x' /\ y = y') /\
       (!x:O.
          objects x
          ==> arrow objects hom x x (identity x)) /\
       (!x y z:O. !f g:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f /\
          arrow objects hom y z g
          ==> arrow objects hom x z (compose g f)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> compose (identity y) f = f /\
              compose f (identity x) = f) /\
       (!w x y z:O. !f g h:M.
          arrow objects hom w x f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g /\
          arrow objects hom y z h
          ==> compose h (compose g f) = compose (compose h g) f) in
   let is_preadditive =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M)
      (zero:O->O->M) (add:O->O->M->M->M) (neg:O->O->M->M).
       is_category objects hom identity compose /\
       (!x y:O.
          objects x /\ objects y
          ==> arrow objects hom x y (zero x y)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f g:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g
          ==> arrow objects hom x y (add x y f g)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> arrow objects hom x y (neg x y f)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> add x y (zero x y) f = f /\
              add x y (neg x y f) f = zero x y) /\
       (!x y:O. !f g:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g
          ==> add x y f g = add x y g f) /\
       (!x y:O. !f g h:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g /\
          arrow objects hom x y h
          ==> add x y f (add x y g h) =
              add x y (add x y f g) h) /\
       (!w x y:O. !f g h:M.
          arrow objects hom w x f /\
          arrow objects hom w x g /\
          arrow objects hom x y h
          ==> compose h (add w x f g) =
              add w y (compose h f) (compose h g)) /\
       (!w x y:O. !f g h:M.
          arrow objects hom w x f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g /\
          arrow objects hom x y h
          ==> compose (add x y g h) f =
              add w y (compose g f) (compose h f)) in
   let is_linear =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (compose:M->M->M) (zero:O->O->M)
      (add:O->O->M->M->M) (smul:O->O->K->M->M).
       (!x y:O. !a:K. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> arrow objects hom x y (smul x y a f)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> smul x y oneK f = f) /\
       (!x y:O. !a b:K. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> smul x y (mulK a b) f =
              smul x y a (smul x y b f)) /\
       (!x y:O. !a b:K. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> smul x y (addK a b) f =
              add x y (smul x y a f) (smul x y b f)) /\
       (!x y:O. !a:K. !f g:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g
          ==> smul x y a (add x y f g) =
              add x y (smul x y a f) (smul x y a g)) /\
       (!x y:O. !f:M.
          arrow objects hom x y f
          ==> smul x y zeroK f = zero x y) /\
       (!x y:O. !a:K.
          objects x /\ objects y
          ==> smul x y a (zero x y) = zero x y) /\
       (!w x y:O. !a:K. !f g:M.
          arrow objects hom w x f /\
          arrow objects hom x y g
          ==> compose g (smul w x a f) =
              smul w y a (compose g f) /\
              compose (smul x y a g) f =
              smul w y a (compose g f)) in
   let is_monic =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (compose:M->M->M) (x:O) (y:O) (f:M).
       arrow objects hom x y f /\
       !z:O. !g h:M.
         arrow objects hom z x g /\
         arrow objects hom z x h /\
         compose f g = compose f h
         ==> g = h in
   let is_isomorphism =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M)
      (x:O) (y:O) (f:M).
       arrow objects hom x y f /\
       ?g:M.
         arrow objects hom y x g /\
         compose g f = identity x /\
         compose f g = identity y in
   let is_simple =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (identity:O->M) (compose:M->M->M) (zero:O->O->M) (x:O).
       objects x /\
       ~(identity x = zero x x) /\
       !y:O. !f:M.
         is_monic objects hom compose y x f
         ==> f = zero y x \/
             is_isomorphism objects hom identity compose y x f in
   let is_kernel =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (compose:M->M->M) (zero:O->O->M)
      (kobject:O) (x:O) (y:O) (k:M) (f:M).
       arrow objects hom kobject x k /\
       arrow objects hom x y f /\
       compose f k = zero kobject y /\
       !z:O. !g:M.
         arrow objects hom z x g /\
         compose f g = zero z y
         ==> ?u:M.
               arrow objects hom z kobject u /\
               compose k u = g /\
               !v:M.
                 arrow objects hom z kobject v /\
                 compose k v = g
                 ==> v = u in
   let has_kernels =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (compose:M->M->M) (zero:O->O->M).
       !x y:O. !f:M.
         arrow objects hom x y f
         ==> ?kobject:O. ?k:M.
               objects kobject /\
               is_kernel objects hom compose zero kobject x y k f in
   let linear_combination =
     \(zero:O->O->M) (add:O->O->M->M->M)
      (smul:O->O->K->M->M) (x:O) (y:O)
      (n:num) (basis:num->M) (coeff:num->K) (v:M).
       ?partial:num->M.
         partial 0 = zero x y /\
         (!i:num.
            i < n
            ==> partial (SUC i) =
                add x y (partial i) (smul x y (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
         partial n = v in
   let has_dimension =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (zero:O->O->M) (add:O->O->M->M->M)
      (smul:O->O->K->M->M) (x:O) (y:O)
      (n:num) (basis:num->M).
       objects x /\ objects y /\
       (!i:num. i < n ==> arrow objects hom x y (basis i)) /\
       (!v:M.
          arrow objects hom x y v
          ==> ?coeff:num->K.
                linear_combination zero add smul x y n basis coeff v) /\
       (!v:M. !c d:num->K.
          arrow objects hom x y v /\
          linear_combination zero add smul x y n basis c v /\
          linear_combination zero add smul x y n basis d v
          ==> !i:num. i < n ==> c i = d i) in
   let finite_dimensional =
     \(objects:O->bool) (hom:O->O->M->bool)
      (zero:O->O->M) (add:O->O->M->M->M)
      (smul:O->O->K->M->M) (x:O) (y:O).
       ?n:num. ?basis:num->M.
         has_dimension objects hom zero add smul x y n basis in
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK invK:K->K.
   !objects:O->bool.
   !hom:O->O->M->bool.
   !identity:O->M.
   !compose:M->M->M.
   !zero:O->O->M.
   !add:O->O->M->M->M.
   !neg:O->O->M->M.
   !smul:O->O->K->M->M.
   !x:O.
     is_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     is_algebraically_closed zeroK oneK addK mulK /\
     is_preadditive objects hom identity compose zero add neg /\
     is_linear zeroK oneK addK mulK objects hom compose zero add smul /\
     has_kernels objects hom compose zero /\
     is_simple objects hom identity compose zero x /\
     finite_dimensional objects hom zero add smul x x
     ==> ?basis:num->M.
           has_dimension objects hom zero add smul x x 1 basis`;;

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1816952,
;; "Schur's lemma": in an algebraically closed-field linear preadditive
;; category with kernels, the finite-dimensional endomorphism space of a
;; simple object has dimension one. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent arbitrary fields, categories,
;; objects, morphisms, and operations. Tags select structures but do not
;; enumerate or otherwise restrict their carriers. All laws and all
;; existential data are stated below with unbounded DEFUN-SK quantifiers.

(defstub q1816952-field-element-p (field value) t)
(defstub q1816952-field-zero (field) t)
(defstub q1816952-field-one (field) t)
(defstub q1816952-field-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q1816952-field-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q1816952-field-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q1816952-field-inverse (field value) t)

(defstub q1816952-object-p (category object) t)
(defstub q1816952-hom-p (category source target morphism) t)
(defstub q1816952-identity (category object) t)
(defstub q1816952-compose
  (category source middle target first second)
  t)
(defstub q1816952-zero-hom (category source target) t)
(defstub q1816952-add-hom
  (category source target left right)
  t)
(defstub q1816952-negate-hom
  (category source target morphism)
  t)
(defstub q1816952-smul-hom
  (field category source target scalar morphism)
  t)

;; Fields and algebraic closedness.

(defun-sk q1816952-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field x)
       (q1816952-field-element-p field y))
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p
        field (q1816952-field-add field x y))
       (q1816952-field-element-p
        field (q1816952-field-multiply field x y))
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-add field x y)
        (q1816952-field-add field y x))
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-multiply field x y)
        (q1816952-field-multiply field y x))))
     (implies
      (q1816952-field-element-p field x)
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p
        field (q1816952-field-negate field x))
       (q1816952-field-element-p
        field (q1816952-field-inverse field x))
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-add
         field x (q1816952-field-zero field))
        x)
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-add
         field x (q1816952-field-negate field x))
        (q1816952-field-zero field))
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-multiply
         field x (q1816952-field-one field))
        x)
       (implies
        (equal x (q1816952-field-zero field))
        (equal
         (q1816952-field-inverse field x)
         (q1816952-field-zero field)))
       (implies
        (not (equal x (q1816952-field-zero field)))
        (equal
         (q1816952-field-multiply
          field x (q1816952-field-inverse field x))
         (q1816952-field-one field)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field x)
       (q1816952-field-element-p field y)
       (q1816952-field-element-p field z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-add
         field (q1816952-field-add field x y) z)
        (q1816952-field-add
         field x (q1816952-field-add field y z)))
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-multiply
         field (q1816952-field-multiply field x y) z)
        (q1816952-field-multiply
         field x (q1816952-field-multiply field y z)))
       (equal
        (q1816952-field-multiply
         field x (q1816952-field-add field y z))
        (q1816952-field-add
         field
         (q1816952-field-multiply field x y)
         (q1816952-field-multiply field x z))))))))

(defun q1816952-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q1816952-field-element-p
    field (q1816952-field-zero field))
   (q1816952-field-element-p
    field (q1816952-field-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1816952-field-zero field)
     (q1816952-field-one field)))
   (q1816952-field-laws-p field)))

;; Coefficient lists are the unrestricted finite-support representation of
;; polynomials, in increasing order of degree.

(defun q1816952-field-list-p (field values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field (car values))
       (q1816952-field-list-p field (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q1816952-polynomial-eval (field coefficients point)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q1816952-field-add
       field
       (car coefficients)
       (q1816952-field-multiply
        field
        point
        (q1816952-polynomial-eval
         field (cdr coefficients) point)))
    (q1816952-field-zero field)))

(defun q1816952-nonconstant-polynomial-p (field coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (q1816952-field-list-p field coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (q1816952-field-zero field)))))

(defun-sk q1816952-polynomial-root-exists-p
    (field coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (q1816952-field-element-p field root)
     (equal
      (q1816952-polynomial-eval field coefficients root)
      (q1816952-field-zero field)))))

(defun-sk q1816952-algebraically-closed-p (field)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (q1816952-nonconstant-polynomial-p field coefficients)
     (q1816952-polynomial-root-exists-p
      field coefficients))))

(defun q1816952-algebraically-closed-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q1816952-field-p field)
   (q1816952-algebraically-closed-p field)))

;; Category laws. COMPOSE(first, second) means first followed by second.

(defun-sk q1816952-category-laws-p (category)
  (forall (a b c d f g h)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
      (and
       (q1816952-object-p category a)
       (q1816952-object-p category b)))
     (implies
      (q1816952-object-p category a)
      (q1816952-hom-p
       category a a (q1816952-identity category a)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category b c g))
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p
        category a c
        (q1816952-compose category a b c f g))
       (equal
        (q1816952-compose
         category a a b (q1816952-identity category a) f)
        f)
       (equal
        (q1816952-compose
         category a b b f (q1816952-identity category b))
        f)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category b c g)
       (q1816952-hom-p category c d h))
      (equal
       (q1816952-compose
        category a c d
        (q1816952-compose category a b c f g)
        h)
       (q1816952-compose
        category a b d
        f
        (q1816952-compose category b c d g h)))))))

;; Every hom set is an additive commutative group, and composition is
;; additive in both variables.

(defun-sk q1816952-preadditive-laws-p (category)
  (forall (a b c f g h)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-object-p category a)
       (q1816952-object-p category b))
      (q1816952-hom-p
       category a b (q1816952-zero-hom category a b)))
     (implies
      (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p
        category a b (q1816952-negate-hom category a b f))
       (equal
        (q1816952-add-hom
         category a b f (q1816952-zero-hom category a b))
        f)
       (equal
        (q1816952-add-hom
         category a b f
         (q1816952-negate-hom category a b f))
        (q1816952-zero-hom category a b))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b g))
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p
        category a b (q1816952-add-hom category a b f g))
       (equal
        (q1816952-add-hom category a b f g)
        (q1816952-add-hom category a b g f))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b g)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b h))
      (equal
       (q1816952-add-hom
        category a b
        (q1816952-add-hom category a b f g)
        h)
       (q1816952-add-hom
        category a b
        f
        (q1816952-add-hom category a b g h))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b g)
       (q1816952-hom-p category b c h))
      (equal
       (q1816952-compose
        category a b c
        (q1816952-add-hom category a b f g)
        h)
       (q1816952-add-hom
        category a c
        (q1816952-compose category a b c f h)
        (q1816952-compose category a b c g h))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category b c g)
       (q1816952-hom-p category b c h))
      (equal
       (q1816952-compose
        category a b c
        f
        (q1816952-add-hom category b c g h))
       (q1816952-add-hom
        category a c
        (q1816952-compose category a b c f g)
        (q1816952-compose category a b c f h)))))))

;; The hom sets are vector spaces over FIELD and scalar multiplication is
;; compatible with composition.

(defun-sk q1816952-linear-laws-p (field category)
  (forall (a b c r s f g)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field r)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f))
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p
        category a b
        (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b r f))
       (equal
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b (q1816952-field-one field) f)
        f)
       (equal
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b r
         (q1816952-zero-hom category a b))
        (q1816952-zero-hom category a b))
       (equal
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b
         (q1816952-field-zero field)
         f)
        (q1816952-zero-hom category a b))
       (equal
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b
         (q1816952-field-negate field r)
         f)
        (q1816952-negate-hom
         category a b
         (q1816952-smul-hom
          field category a b r f)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field r)
       (q1816952-field-element-p field s)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b
         (q1816952-field-add field r s)
         f)
        (q1816952-add-hom
         category a b
         (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b r f)
         (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b s f)))
       (equal
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b
         (q1816952-field-multiply field r s)
         f)
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a b r
         (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b s f)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field r)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b g))
      (equal
       (q1816952-smul-hom
        field category a b r
        (q1816952-add-hom category a b f g))
       (q1816952-add-hom
        category a b
        (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b r f)
        (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b r g))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1816952-field-element-p field r)
       (q1816952-hom-p category a b f)
       (q1816952-hom-p category b c g))
      (and
       (equal
        (q1816952-compose
         category a b c
         (q1816952-smul-hom field category a b r f)
         g)
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a c r
         (q1816952-compose category a b c f g)))
       (equal
        (q1816952-compose
         category a b c
         f
         (q1816952-smul-hom field category b c r g))
        (q1816952-smul-hom
         field category a c r
         (q1816952-compose category a b c f g))))))))

(defun q1816952-linear-preadditive-category-p
    (field category)
  (and
   (q1816952-category-laws-p category)
   (q1816952-preadditive-laws-p category)
   (q1816952-linear-laws-p field category)))

;; Categorical isomorphisms, monomorphisms, and simplicity.

(defun-sk q1816952-isomorphism-p
    (category source target morphism)
  (exists (inverse)
    (and
     (q1816952-hom-p category target source inverse)
     (equal
      (q1816952-compose
       category source target source morphism inverse)
      (q1816952-identity category source))
     (equal
      (q1816952-compose
       category target source target inverse morphism)
      (q1816952-identity category target)))))

(defun-sk q1816952-monomorphism-p
    (category source target morphism)
  (forall (test-object left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1816952-object-p category test-object)
      (q1816952-hom-p category test-object source left)
      (q1816952-hom-p category test-object source right)
      (equal
       (q1816952-compose
        category test-object source target left morphism)
       (q1816952-compose
        category test-object source target right morphism)))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q1816952-simple-object-laws-p
    (category object)
  (forall (source morphism)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1816952-hom-p category source object morphism)
     (q1816952-monomorphism-p
       category source object morphism))
     (or
      (equal
       (q1816952-identity category source)
       (q1816952-zero-hom category source source))
      (q1816952-isomorphism-p
       category source object morphism)))))

(defun q1816952-simple-object-p (category object)
  (and
   (q1816952-object-p category object)
   (not
    (equal
     (q1816952-identity category object)
     (q1816952-zero-hom category object object)))
   (q1816952-simple-object-laws-p category object)))

;; Kernels are internal existential witnesses satisfying their unrestricted
;; universal property, including uniqueness of every factor.

(defun-sk q1816952-kernel-factor-unique-p
    (category source kernel-object kernel-arrow
     test-object test-arrow factor)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1816952-hom-p
       category test-object kernel-object candidate)
      (equal
       (q1816952-compose
        category test-object kernel-object source
        candidate kernel-arrow)
       test-arrow))
     (equal candidate factor))))

(defun-sk q1816952-kernel-factor-exists-p
    (category source kernel-object kernel-arrow
     test-object test-arrow)
  (exists (factor)
    (and
     (q1816952-hom-p
      category test-object kernel-object factor)
     (equal
      (q1816952-compose
       category test-object kernel-object source
       factor kernel-arrow)
      test-arrow)
     (q1816952-kernel-factor-unique-p
      category source kernel-object kernel-arrow
      test-object test-arrow factor))))

(defun-sk q1816952-kernel-universal-p
    (category source target morphism
     kernel-object kernel-arrow)
  (forall (test-object test-arrow)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1816952-hom-p
       category test-object source test-arrow)
      (equal
       (q1816952-compose
        category test-object source target
        test-arrow morphism)
       (q1816952-zero-hom
        category test-object target)))
     (q1816952-kernel-factor-exists-p
      category source kernel-object kernel-arrow
      test-object test-arrow))))

(defun-sk q1816952-kernel-exists-p
    (category source target morphism)
  (exists (kernel-object kernel-arrow)
    (and
     (q1816952-object-p category kernel-object)
     (q1816952-hom-p
      category kernel-object source kernel-arrow)
     (equal
      (q1816952-compose
       category kernel-object source target
       kernel-arrow morphism)
      (q1816952-zero-hom
       category kernel-object target))
     (q1816952-kernel-universal-p
      category source target morphism
      kernel-object kernel-arrow))))

(defun-sk q1816952-has-kernels-p (category)
  (forall (source target morphism)
    (implies
     (q1816952-hom-p category source target morphism)
     (q1816952-kernel-exists-p
      category source target morphism))))

;; Finite dimensionality is the internal existence of a finite basis of the
;; unrestricted endomorphism carrier. Coefficients are quantified inside the
;; spanning predicate rather than supplied as an external coordinate map.

(defun q1816952-endomorphism-list-p
    (category object morphisms)
  (if (consp morphisms)
      (and
       (q1816952-hom-p
        category object object (car morphisms))
       (q1816952-endomorphism-list-p
        category object (cdr morphisms)))
    (equal morphisms nil)))

(defun q1816952-all-zero-coefficients-p
    (field coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (equal
        (car coefficients)
        (q1816952-field-zero field))
       (q1816952-all-zero-coefficients-p
        field (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q1816952-linear-combination
    (field category object basis coefficients)
  (if (and (consp basis) (consp coefficients))
      (q1816952-add-hom
       category object object
       (q1816952-smul-hom
        field category object object
        (car coefficients) (car basis))
       (q1816952-linear-combination
        field category object
        (cdr basis) (cdr coefficients)))
    (q1816952-zero-hom category object object)))

(defun-sk q1816952-basis-coefficients-exist-p
    (field category object basis endomorphism)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (equal (len coefficients) (len basis))
     (q1816952-field-list-p field coefficients)
     (equal
      (q1816952-linear-combination
       field category object basis coefficients)
      endomorphism))))

(defun-sk q1816952-basis-spans-p
    (field category object basis)
  (forall (endomorphism)
    (implies
     (q1816952-hom-p
      category object object endomorphism)
     (q1816952-basis-coefficients-exist-p
      field category object basis endomorphism))))

(defun-sk q1816952-basis-independent-p
    (field category object basis)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp coefficients)
      (equal (len coefficients) (len basis))
      (q1816952-field-list-p field coefficients)
      (equal
       (q1816952-linear-combination
        field category object basis coefficients)
       (q1816952-zero-hom category object object)))
     (q1816952-all-zero-coefficients-p
      field coefficients))))

(defun q1816952-basis-p
    (field category object basis)
  (and
   (true-listp basis)
   (q1816952-endomorphism-list-p category object basis)
   (q1816952-basis-spans-p field category object basis)
   (q1816952-basis-independent-p
    field category object basis)))

(defun-sk q1816952-finite-dimensional-endomorphisms-p
    (field category object)
  (exists (basis)
    (q1816952-basis-p field category object basis)))

;; A vector space has dimension one exactly when a fixed nonzero vector is a
;; basis. Here that vector is the identity endomorphism. The unique scalar
;; witness is kept internal to the conclusion.

(defun-sk q1816952-scalar-representation-unique-p
    (field category object endomorphism scalar)
  (forall (other-scalar)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1816952-field-element-p field other-scalar)
      (equal
       (q1816952-smul-hom
        field category object object
        other-scalar
        (q1816952-identity category object))
       endomorphism))
     (equal other-scalar scalar))))

(defun-sk q1816952-scalar-representation-exists-p
    (field category object endomorphism)
  (exists (scalar)
    (and
     (q1816952-field-element-p field scalar)
     (equal
      (q1816952-smul-hom
       field category object object
       scalar
       (q1816952-identity category object))
      endomorphism)
     (q1816952-scalar-representation-unique-p
      field category object endomorphism scalar))))

(defun-sk q1816952-every-endomorphism-is-scalar-p
    (field category object)
  (forall (endomorphism)
    (implies
     (q1816952-hom-p
      category object object endomorphism)
     (q1816952-scalar-representation-exists-p
      field category object endomorphism))))

(defun q1816952-endomorphism-dimension-one-p
    (field category object)
  (and
   (q1816952-hom-p
    category object object
    (q1816952-identity category object))
   (not
    (equal
     (q1816952-identity category object)
     (q1816952-zero-hom category object object)))
   (q1816952-every-endomorphism-is-scalar-p
    field category object)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q1816952-schur-s-lemma-statement ()
  (forall (field category object)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1816952-algebraically-closed-field-p field)
      (q1816952-linear-preadditive-category-p
       field category)
      (q1816952-has-kernels-p category)
      (q1816952-simple-object-p category object)
      (q1816952-finite-dimensional-endomorphisms-p
       field category object))
     (q1816952-endomorphism-dimension-one-p
      field category object))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1816952,
-- "Schur's lemma": the endomorphism space of a simple object in a linear
-- category over an algebraically closed field has dimension one when it is
-- finite-dimensional and the category has kernels. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1816952_schur_s_lemma where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_ _↔_
infixr 2 _×_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not A =
  A → Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (sucN n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (sucN n)

record AbelianGroup
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zero : A
    add : A → A → A
    negate : A → A
    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero :
      (x : A) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : A) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

record Field
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set k where

  field
    additive-group : AbelianGroup K
    one : K
    multiply : K → K → K
    inverse : K → K
    one-not-zero :
      one ≠ AbelianGroup.zero additive-group
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) →
      multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) →
      multiply x one ≡ x
    inverse-zero :
      inverse (AbelianGroup.zero additive-group) ≡
      AbelianGroup.zero additive-group
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply x (AbelianGroup.add additive-group y z) ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group
        (multiply x y)
        (multiply x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ AbelianGroup.zero additive-group →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ one

evaluatePolynomial :
  {k : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  Field K →
  List K →
  K →
  K
evaluatePolynomial field-structure [] x =
  AbelianGroup.zero (Field.additive-group field-structure)
evaluatePolynomial field-structure (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  AbelianGroup.add
    (Field.additive-group field-structure)
    coefficient
    (Field.multiply field-structure x
      (evaluatePolynomial field-structure coefficients x))

data HasNonzeroCoefficient
  {k : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (field-structure : Field K) :
  List K →
  Set k where

  here :
    {coefficient : K} →
    {coefficients : List K} →
    coefficient ≠
      AbelianGroup.zero (Field.additive-group field-structure) →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient
      field-structure
      (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

  there :
    {coefficient : K} →
    {coefficients : List K} →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient field-structure coefficients →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient
      field-structure
      (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

data Nonconstant
  {k : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (field-structure : Field K) :
  List K →
  Set k where

  nonconstant :
    {constant : K} →
    {higher-coefficients : List K} →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient field-structure higher-coefficients →
    Nonconstant field-structure (constant ∷ higher-coefficients)

AlgebraicallyClosed :
  {k : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  Field K →
  Set k
AlgebraicallyClosed field-structure =
  (coefficients : List _) →
  Nonconstant field-structure coefficients →
  Σ _
    (λ root →
      evaluatePolynomial field-structure coefficients root ≡
      AbelianGroup.zero
        (Field.additive-group field-structure))

record VectorSpace
  {k v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (field-structure : Field K)
  (V : Set v)
  (additive-group : AbelianGroup V) :
  Set (k ⊔ v) where

  field
    scale : K → V → V
    scale-add :
      (a : K) →
      (x y : V) →
      scale a (AbelianGroup.add additive-group x y) ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group (scale a x) (scale a y)
    add-scale :
      (a b : K) →
      (x : V) →
      scale
        (AbelianGroup.add
          (Field.additive-group field-structure)
          a
          b)
        x
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.add additive-group (scale a x) (scale b x)
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : K) →
      (x : V) →
      scale (Field.multiply field-structure a b) x ≡
      scale a (scale b x)
    one-scale :
      (x : V) →
      scale (Field.one field-structure) x ≡ x

record Category
  {o h : Level}
  (Object : Set o) :
  Set (o ⊔ lsuc h) where

  infixr 7 _after_

  field
    Hom : Object → Object → Set h
    identity :
      (A : Object) →
      Hom A A
    _after_ :
      {A B C : Object} →
      Hom B C →
      Hom A B →
      Hom A C
    compose-associative :
      {A B C D : Object} →
      (f : Hom C D) →
      (g : Hom B C) →
      (h : Hom A B) →
      f after (g after h) ≡
      (f after g) after h
    identity-left :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      identity B after f ≡ f
    identity-right :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      f after identity A ≡ f

record Preadditive
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    hom-group :
      (A B : Object) →
      AbelianGroup (C.Hom A B)
    compose-add-left :
      {A B C : Object} →
      (f g : C.Hom B C) →
      (h : C.Hom A B) →
      C._after_
        (AbelianGroup.add (hom-group B C) f g)
        h
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.add
        (hom-group A C)
        (C._after_ f h)
        (C._after_ g h)
    compose-add-right :
      {A B C : Object} →
      (f : C.Hom B C) →
      (g h : C.Hom A B) →
      C._after_
        f
        (AbelianGroup.add (hom-group A B) g h)
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.add
        (hom-group A C)
        (C._after_ f g)
        (C._after_ f h)

ZeroMorphism :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object} →
  Preadditive category →
  (A B : Object) →
  Category.Hom category A B
ZeroMorphism preadditive A B =
  AbelianGroup.zero
    (Preadditive.hom-group preadditive A B)

record IsIso
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object)
  {A B : Object}
  (arrow : Category.Hom category A B) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    inverse : C.Hom B A
    inverse-after :
      C._after_ inverse arrow ≡ C.identity A
    after-inverse :
      C._after_ arrow inverse ≡ C.identity B

Monomorphism :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  {A B : Object} →
  Category.Hom category A B →
  Set (o ⊔ h)
Monomorphism {Object = Object} category {A} arrow =
  (X : Object) →
  (f g : Category.Hom category X A) →
  Category._after_ category arrow f ≡
  Category._after_ category arrow g →
  f ≡ g

Simple :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  (preadditive : Preadditive category) →
  Object →
  Set (o ⊔ h)
Simple {Object = Object} category preadditive X =
  (Y : Object) →
  (f : Category.Hom category Y X) →
  Monomorphism category f →
  IsIso category f ↔
  (f ≠ ZeroMorphism preadditive Y X)

record IsKernel
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  {category : Category {o} {h} Object}
  (preadditive : Preadditive category)
  {K A B : Object}
  (kernel-arrow : Category.Hom category K A)
  (arrow : Category.Hom category A B) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    annihilates :
      C._after_ arrow kernel-arrow ≡
      ZeroMorphism preadditive K B
    universal :
      (Y : Object) →
      (f : C.Hom Y A) →
      C._after_ arrow f ≡ ZeroMorphism preadditive Y B →
      Σ (C.Hom Y K)
        (λ lift →
          (C._after_ kernel-arrow lift ≡ f)
          ×
          ((other : C.Hom Y K) →
            C._after_ kernel-arrow other ≡ f →
            other ≡ lift))

HasKernels :
  {o h : Level} →
  {Object : Set o} →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  (preadditive : Preadditive category) →
  Set (o ⊔ h)
HasKernels {Object = Object} category preadditive =
  {A B : Object} →
  (f : Category.Hom category A B) →
  Σ Object
    (λ K →
      Σ (Category.Hom category K A)
        (λ kernel-arrow →
          IsKernel preadditive kernel-arrow f))

record LinearCategory
  {o h k : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  {K : Set k}
  (field-structure : Field K)
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object)
  (preadditive : Preadditive category) :
  Set (o ⊔ h ⊔ k) where

  private
    module C = Category category

  field
    hom-vector-space :
      (A B : Object) →
      VectorSpace
        field-structure
        (C.Hom A B)
        (Preadditive.hom-group preadditive A B)
    scale-after :
      {A B D : Object} →
      (scalar : K) →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      (g : C.Hom B D) →
      C._after_
        (VectorSpace.scale
          (hom-vector-space B D)
          scalar
          g)
        f
      ≡
      VectorSpace.scale
        (hom-vector-space A D)
        scalar
        (C._after_ g f)
    after-scale :
      {A B D : Object} →
      (scalar : K) →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      (g : C.Hom B D) →
      C._after_
        g
        (VectorSpace.scale
          (hom-vector-space A B)
          scalar
          f)
      ≡
      VectorSpace.scale
        (hom-vector-space A D)
        scalar
        (C._after_ g f)

sumFin :
  {v : Level} →
  {V : Set v} →
  AbelianGroup V →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → V) →
  V
sumFin group zeroN values =
  AbelianGroup.zero group
sumFin group (sucN n) values =
  AbelianGroup.add group
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin group n (λ i → values (fsuc i)))

linearCombination :
  {k v : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {V : Set v} →
  (field-structure : Field K) →
  (group : AbelianGroup V) →
  (space : VectorSpace field-structure V group) →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → V) →
  (Fin n → K) →
  V
linearCombination field-structure group space n basis coefficients =
  sumFin group n
    (λ i →
      VectorSpace.scale space (coefficients i) (basis i))

record HasBasis
  {k v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {V : Set v}
  (field-structure : Field K)
  (group : AbelianGroup V)
  (space : VectorSpace field-structure V group)
  (dimension : Nat) :
  Set (k ⊔ v) where

  field
    basis : Fin dimension → V
    linearly-independent :
      (coefficients : Fin dimension → K) →
      linearCombination
        field-structure group space dimension basis coefficients
      ≡
      AbelianGroup.zero group →
      (i : Fin dimension) →
      coefficients i ≡
      AbelianGroup.zero
        (Field.additive-group field-structure)
    spans :
      (v : V) →
      Σ (Fin dimension → K)
        (λ coefficients →
          linearCombination
            field-structure group space dimension basis coefficients
          ≡
          v)

FiniteDimensional :
  {k v : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {V : Set v} →
  (field-structure : Field K) →
  (group : AbelianGroup V) →
  VectorSpace field-structure V group →
  Set (k ⊔ v)
FiniteDimensional field-structure group space =
  Σ Nat
    (λ dimension →
      HasBasis field-structure group space dimension)

HasDimensionOne :
  {k v : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  {V : Set v} →
  (field-structure : Field K) →
  (group : AbelianGroup V) →
  VectorSpace field-structure V group →
  Set (k ⊔ v)
HasDimensionOne field-structure group space =
  HasBasis field-structure group space (sucN zeroN)

schur-s-lemma : Setω
schur-s-lemma =
  ∀ {o h k : Level} →
  (Object : Set o) →
  (category : Category {o} {h} Object) →
  (preadditive : Preadditive category) →
  (K : Set k) →
  (field-structure : Field K) →
  AlgebraicallyClosed field-structure →
  (linear :
    LinearCategory field-structure category preadditive) →
  HasKernels category preadditive →
  (X : Object) →
  Simple category preadditive X →
  FiniteDimensional
    field-structure
    (Preadditive.hom-group preadditive X X)
    (LinearCategory.hom-vector-space linear X X) →
  HasDimensionOne
    field-structure
    (Preadditive.hom-group preadditive X X)
    (LinearCategory.hom-vector-space linear X X)

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1816952, "Schur's lemma": over an algebraically closed field, the
  finite-dimensional endomorphism space of a simple object in a linear
  preadditive category with kernels is one-dimensional. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory;

val q1816952_hom_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_hom_def",
  ``q1816952_hom
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (f : 'mor) (X : 'obj) (Y : 'obj) <=>
      dom f = X /\ cod f = Y``);

val q1816952_field_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_field_def",
  ``q1816952_field
      (kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k) (kinv : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      kzero <> kone /\
      (!a b. kadd a b = kadd b a) /\
      (!a b c. kadd (kadd a b) c = kadd a (kadd b c)) /\
      (!a. kadd kzero a = a) /\
      (!a. kadd (kneg a) a = kzero) /\
      (!a b. kmul a b = kmul b a) /\
      (!a b c. kmul (kmul a b) c = kmul a (kmul b c)) /\
      (!a. kmul kone a = a) /\
      (!a b c. kmul a (kadd b c) = kadd (kmul a b) (kmul a c)) /\
      kinv kzero = kzero /\
      (!a. a <> kzero ==> kmul (kinv a) a = kone)``);

val q1816952_poly_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_poly_eval_def",
  ``q1816952_poly_eval
      (kzero : 'k) (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (coeffs : 'k list) (x : 'k) =
      FOLDR (\c acc. kadd c (kmul x acc)) kzero coeffs``);

val q1816952_algebraically_closed_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_algebraically_closed_def",
  ``q1816952_algebraically_closed
      (kzero : 'k) (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) <=>
      !coeffs : 'k list.
        1 < LENGTH coeffs /\ LAST coeffs <> kzero ==>
        ?x : 'k. q1816952_poly_eval kzero kadd kmul coeffs x = kzero``);

val q1816952_category_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_category_def",
  ``q1816952_category
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (id : 'obj -> 'mor) (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor) <=>
      (!X. q1816952_hom dom cod (id X) X X) /\
      (!X Y Z f g.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g Y Z ==>
        q1816952_hom dom cod (comp g f) X Z) /\
      (!X Y f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        comp (id Y) f = f /\ comp f (id X) = f) /\
      (!W X Y Z f g h.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f W X /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod h Y Z ==>
        comp h (comp g f) = comp (comp h g) f)``);

val q1816952_preadditive_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_preadditive_def",
  ``q1816952_preadditive
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor) (mneg : 'mor -> 'mor) <=>
      (!X Y. q1816952_hom dom cod (mzero X Y) X Y) /\
      (!X Y f g.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g X Y ==>
        q1816952_hom dom cod (madd f g) X Y) /\
      (!X Y f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        q1816952_hom dom cod (mneg f) X Y) /\
      (!X Y f g.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g X Y ==>
        madd f g = madd g f) /\
      (!X Y f g h.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod h X Y ==>
        madd (madd f g) h = madd f (madd g h)) /\
      (!X Y f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        madd (mzero X Y) f = f /\
        madd (mneg f) f = mzero X Y) /\
      (!X Y Z f g h.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod h Y Z ==>
        comp h (madd f g) = madd (comp h f) (comp h g)) /\
      (!X Y Z f g h.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f Y Z /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g Y Z /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod h X Y ==>
        comp (madd f g) h = madd (comp f h) (comp g h)) /\
      (!X Y Z f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        comp (mzero Y Z) f = mzero X Z) /\
      (!X Y Z f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f Y Z ==>
        comp f (mzero X Y) = mzero X Z)``);

val q1816952_linear_category_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_linear_category_def",
  ``q1816952_linear_category
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (smul : 'k -> 'mor -> 'mor) <=>
      (!X Y a f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        q1816952_hom dom cod (smul a f) X Y) /\
      (!X Y f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        smul kone f = f /\ smul kzero f = mzero X Y) /\
      (!X Y a b f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        smul (kadd a b) f = madd (smul a f) (smul b f)) /\
      (!X Y a b f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        smul (kmul a b) f = smul a (smul b f)) /\
      (!X Y a f g.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g X Y ==>
        smul a (madd f g) = madd (smul a f) (smul a g)) /\
      (!X Y Z a f g.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod g Y Z ==>
        comp g (smul a f) = smul a (comp g f) /\
        comp (smul a g) f = smul a (comp g f))``);

val q1816952_has_kernels_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_has_kernels_def",
  ``q1816952_has_kernels
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor) <=>
      !X Y f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y ==>
        ?K k.
          q1816952_hom dom cod k K X /\
          comp f k = mzero K Y /\
          !Z g.
            q1816952_hom dom cod g Z X /\
            comp f g = mzero Z Y ==>
            ?!l.
              q1816952_hom dom cod l Z K /\
              comp k l = g``);

val q1816952_mono_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_mono_def",
  ``q1816952_mono
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (f : 'mor) (X : 'obj) (Y : 'obj) <=>
      q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
      !Z g h.
        q1816952_hom dom cod g Z X /\
        q1816952_hom dom cod h Z X /\
        comp f g = comp f h ==>
        g = h``);

val q1816952_iso_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_iso_def",
  ``q1816952_iso
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (id : 'obj -> 'mor) (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (f : 'mor) (X : 'obj) (Y : 'obj) <=>
      q1816952_hom dom cod f X Y /\
      ?g.
        q1816952_hom dom cod g Y X /\
        comp g f = id X /\
        comp f g = id Y``);

val q1816952_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_simple_def",
  ``q1816952_simple
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (id : 'obj -> 'mor) (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor) (X : 'obj) <=>
      id X <> mzero X X /\
      !Y f.
        q1816952_mono dom cod comp f Y X ==>
        f = mzero Y X \/ q1816952_iso dom cod id comp f Y X``);

val q1816952_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_lincomb_def",
  ``q1816952_lincomb
      (kzero : 'k)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (smul : 'k -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (X : 'obj) (basis : 'mor list) (coeff : num -> 'k) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. madd acc (smul (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
        (mzero X X)
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q1816952_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_basis_def",
  ``q1816952_basis
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (kzero : 'k)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (smul : 'k -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (X : 'obj) (basis : 'mor list) <=>
      EVERY (\b. q1816952_hom dom cod b X X) basis /\
      ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
      (!coeff : num -> 'k.
        q1816952_lincomb kzero mzero madd smul X basis coeff =
          mzero X X ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = kzero) /\
      (!f.
        q1816952_hom dom cod f X X ==>
        ?coeff : num -> 'k.
          q1816952_lincomb kzero mzero madd smul X basis coeff = f)``);

val q1816952_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q1816952_finite_dimensional
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (kzero : 'k)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (smul : 'k -> 'mor -> 'mor) (X : 'obj) <=>
      ?basis : 'mor list.
        q1816952_basis dom cod kzero mzero madd smul X basis``);

val q1816952_one_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q1816952_one_dimensional_def",
  ``q1816952_one_dimensional
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (kzero : 'k)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (smul : 'k -> 'mor -> 'mor) (X : 'obj) <=>
      ?b : 'mor.
        q1816952_basis dom cod kzero mzero madd smul X [b]``);

val finrank_endomorphism_simple_eq_one =
  ``!(kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k) (kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (dom : 'mor -> 'obj) (cod : 'mor -> 'obj)
      (id : 'obj -> 'mor) (comp : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor)
      (mzero : 'obj -> 'obj -> 'mor)
      (madd : 'mor -> 'mor -> 'mor) (mneg : 'mor -> 'mor)
      (smul : 'k -> 'mor -> 'mor) (X : 'obj).
      q1816952_field kzero kone kadd kmul kneg kinv /\
      q1816952_algebraically_closed kzero kadd kmul /\
      q1816952_category dom cod id comp /\
      q1816952_preadditive dom cod comp mzero madd mneg /\
      q1816952_linear_category
        dom cod comp kzero kone kadd kmul mzero madd smul /\
      q1816952_has_kernels dom cod comp mzero /\
      q1816952_simple dom cod id comp mzero X /\
      q1816952_finite_dimensional
        dom cod kzero mzero madd smul X
      ==>
      q1816952_one_dimensional
        dom cod kzero mzero madd smul X``;

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1816952
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1816952), "Schur's lemma": in an
  algebraically closed-field-linear preadditive category with kernels, the
  finite-dimensional endomorphism space of a simple object has dimension one.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The category C is a native SetMM category. Z, P, and T encode respectively
  its zero morphisms, addition on hom-sets, and scalar multiplication by K.
  Q1816952HomSpace packages each actual hom-set as a SetMM left vector space.
  Q1816952LinearPreadditive requires all these vector-space laws and bilinearity
  of composition, so it is exactly the combined preadditive and K-linear
  structure used by the Lean source.

  Q1816952HasKernels expands the usual universal property for every morphism.
  Q1816952Simple is Mathlib's definition: every monomorphism into X is an
  isomorphism exactly when it is nonzero. Q1816952FiniteDimensional says that
  the actual endomorphism vector space has a finite basis. Q1816952AlgClosed
  is the usual nonconstant-polynomial root property over a SetMM field.

  Every declaration before the final assertion is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a assertion is the single unproved corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q1816952Zero Q1816952Add Q1816952SMul Q1816952Comp $.
$c Q1816952HomSpace Q1816952LinearPreadditive Q1816952Kernel
   Q1816952HasKernels Q1816952Simple Q1816952FiniteDimensional
   Q1816952AlgClosed $.

q1816952-zero-syntax $a class ( Q1816952Zero Z X Y ) $.
q1816952-add-syntax $a class ( Q1816952Add P X Y f g ) $.
q1816952-smul-syntax $a class ( Q1816952SMul T X Y a f ) $.
q1816952-comp-syntax $a class ( Q1816952Comp C X Y W g f ) $.
q1816952-hom-space-syntax
  $a class ( Q1816952HomSpace K C P T X Y ) $.

q1816952-linear-preadditive-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1816952LinearPreadditive K C Z P T ) $.
q1816952-kernel-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1816952Kernel C Z K k X Y f ) $.
q1816952-has-kernels-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1816952HasKernels C Z ) $.
q1816952-simple-syntax
  $a wff ( Q1816952Simple C Z X ) $.
q1816952-finite-dimensional-syntax

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1816952,
:: "Schur's lemma": over an algebraically closed field, the finite-dimensional
:: endomorphism space of a simple object in a linear preadditive category with
:: kernels has dimension one. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, TARSKI,
      RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, CARD_3, FINSET_1,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, VECTSP_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, BINOP_1, CAT_1, GRAPH_1, FUNCOP_1,
      POLYNOM5;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, XXREAL_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, MATRLIN,
      VECTSP_9, BINOP_1, GRAPH_1, CAT_1, POLYNOM5;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      XXREAL_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, MATRLIN, VECTSP_9, BINOP_1,
      FUNCOP_1, CAT_1, POLYNOM5;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, MATRLIN, VECTSP_9,
      CAT_1, POLYNOM5;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, CAT_1, POLYNOM5;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, CAT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, CAT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      C being Category,
      X being Object of C,
      A being BinOp of the carrier' of C,
      N being UnOp of the carrier' of C,
      Z being Function of [:the carrier of C,the carrier of C:],
        the carrier' of C,
      S being Function of [:the carrier of K,the carrier' of C:],
        the carrier' of C,
      V being finite-dimensional VectSp of K
  st
    K is algebraic-closed &
    (for a,b being Object of C holds Z.[a,b] in Hom(a,b)) &
    (for a,b being Object of C,
         f,g,h being Morphism of a,b st Hom(a,b) <> {}
    holds
      A.[f,g] in Hom(a,b) &
      N.f in Hom(a,b) &
      A.[f,g] = A.[g,f] &
      A.[A.[f,g],h] = A.[f,A.[g,h]] &
      A.[f,Z.[a,b]] = f &
      A.[f,N.f] = Z.[a,b]) &
    (for a,b being Object of C,
         f,g being Morphism of a,b,
         r,s being Element of K st Hom(a,b) <> {}
    holds
      S.[r,f] in Hom(a,b) &
      S.[r,A.[f,g]] = A.[S.[r,f],S.[r,g]] &
      S.[r+s,f] = A.[S.[r,f],S.[s,f]] &
      S.[r*s,f] = S.[r,S.[s,f]] &
      S.[1_K,f] = f) &
    (for a,b,c being Object of C,
         f1,f2,x being Morphism of a,b,
         g1,g2,y being Morphism of b,c st
      Hom(a,b) <> {} & Hom(b,c) <> {} &
      x = A.[f1,f2] & y = A.[g1,g2]
    holds
      g1*x = A.[g1*f1,g1*f2] &
      y*f1 = A.[g1*f1,g2*f1]) &
    (for a,b,c being Object of C,
         f,sf being Morphism of a,b,
         g,sg being Morphism of b,c,
         r being Element of K st
      Hom(a,b) <> {} & Hom(b,c) <> {} &
      sf = S.[r,f] & sg = S.[r,g]
    holds
      g*sf = S.[r,g*f] &
      sg*f = S.[r,g*f]) &
    (for a,b being Object of C,
         f being Morphism of a,b st Hom(a,b) <> {}
    holds
      ex x being Object of C,
         k being Morphism of x,a st
        Hom(x,a) <> {} &
        f*k = Z.[x,b] &
        (for d being Object of C,
             h being Morphism of d,a st
          Hom(d,a) <> {} & f*h = Z.[d,b]
        holds
          ex u being Morphism of d,x st
            Hom(d,x) <> {} & k*u = h &
            (for v being Morphism of d,x st k*v = h holds v = u))) &
    id X <> Z.[X,X] &
    (for y being Object of C,
         f being Morphism of y,X st
      Hom(y,X) <> {} & f is monic
    holds
      f = Z.[y,X] or f is invertible) &
    the carrier of V = Hom(X,X) &
    0.V = Z.[X,X] &
    (for v,w being Element of V,
         f,g being Morphism of X,X st
      Hom(X,X) <> {} & v = f & w = g
    holds v + w = A.[f,g]) &
    (for r being Element of K,
         v being Element of V,
         f being Morphism of X,X st
      Hom(X,X) <> {} & v = f
    holds r * v = S.[r,f])
  holds dim V = 1
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1816952_schur_s_lemma
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q1816952
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q1816952), "Schur's lemma": over an algebraically
% closed field, a simple object in a linear preadditive category with kernels
% and finite-dimensional endomorphisms has a one-dimensional endomorphism
% space. This file contains no proof.

Q1816952_schur_s_lemma[
  Object, Morphism, Scalar: TYPE+,
  X: Object,
  dom, cod: [Morphism -> Object],
  id_arrow: [Object -> Morphism],
  comp_arrow: [Morphism, Morphism -> Morphism],
  zero_arrow: [Object, Object -> Morphism],
  add_arrow: [Morphism, Morphism -> Morphism],
  neg_arrow: [Morphism -> Morphism],
  scale_arrow: [Scalar, Morphism -> Morphism],
  zero_scalar, one_scalar: Scalar,
  add_scalar, mul_scalar: [Scalar, Scalar -> Scalar],
  neg_scalar, inv_scalar: [Scalar -> Scalar]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  q1816952_hom(
      f: Morphism,
      source_object, target_object: Object): bool =
    dom(f) = source_object
      AND cod(f) = target_object

  q1816952_scalar_list_has_nonzero(
      coefficients: list[Scalar]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        head /= zero_scalar
          OR q1816952_scalar_list_has_nonzero(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  q1816952_nonconstant_polynomial(
      coefficients: list[Scalar]): bool =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(constant_coefficient, higher_coefficients):
        q1816952_scalar_list_has_nonzero(higher_coefficients)
    ENDCASES

  q1816952_polynomial_value(
      coefficients: list[Scalar],
      x: Scalar): RECURSIVE Scalar =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: zero_scalar,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_scalar(
          head,
          mul_scalar(
            x,
            q1816952_polynomial_value(tail, x)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  q1816952_field_laws: bool =
    zero_scalar /= one_scalar
      AND (FORALL (a, b: Scalar):
        add_scalar(a, b) = add_scalar(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: Scalar):
        add_scalar(add_scalar(a, b), c)
          = add_scalar(a, add_scalar(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: Scalar):
        add_scalar(a, zero_scalar) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: Scalar):
        add_scalar(a, neg_scalar(a)) = zero_scalar)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: Scalar):
        mul_scalar(a, b) = mul_scalar(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: Scalar):
        mul_scalar(mul_scalar(a, b), c)
          = mul_scalar(a, mul_scalar(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: Scalar):
        mul_scalar(a, one_scalar) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: Scalar):
        mul_scalar(a, add_scalar(b, c))
          = add_scalar(
              mul_scalar(a, b),
              mul_scalar(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: Scalar):
        a /= zero_scalar IMPLIES
          mul_scalar(a, inv_scalar(a)) = one_scalar)

  q1816952_algebraically_closed: bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: list[Scalar]):
      q1816952_nonconstant_polynomial(coefficients)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (root: Scalar):
            q1816952_polynomial_value(coefficients, root)
              = zero_scalar

  q1816952_category_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (A: Object):
      q1816952_hom(id_arrow(A), A, A))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object),
                  (f, g: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, B, C)
        IMPLIES
          q1816952_hom(comp_arrow(g, f), A, C))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C, D: Object),
                  (f, g, h: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, B, C)
          AND q1816952_hom(h, C, D)
        IMPLIES
          comp_arrow(h, comp_arrow(g, f))
            = comp_arrow(comp_arrow(h, g), f))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES comp_arrow(id_arrow(B), f) = f)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES comp_arrow(f, id_arrow(A)) = f)

  q1816952_preadditive_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (A, B: Object):
      q1816952_hom(zero_arrow(A, B), A, B))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES q1816952_hom(neg_arrow(f), A, B))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, A, B)
        IMPLIES q1816952_hom(add_arrow(f, g), A, B))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, A, B)
        IMPLIES add_arrow(f, g) = add_arrow(g, f))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f, g, h: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(h, A, B)
        IMPLIES
          add_arrow(add_arrow(f, g), h)
            = add_arrow(f, add_arrow(g, h)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES add_arrow(f, zero_arrow(A, B)) = f)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES
            add_arrow(f, neg_arrow(f))
              = zero_arrow(A, B))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object),
                  (f, g, h: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(h, B, C)
        IMPLIES
          comp_arrow(h, add_arrow(f, g))
            = add_arrow(
                comp_arrow(h, f),
                comp_arrow(h, g)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object),
                  (f, g, h: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, B, C)
          AND q1816952_hom(h, B, C)
        IMPLIES
          comp_arrow(add_arrow(g, h), f)
            = add_arrow(
                comp_arrow(g, f),
                comp_arrow(h, f)))

  q1816952_linear_category_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (A, B: Object),
            (a: Scalar),
            (f: Morphism):
      q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
        IMPLIES q1816952_hom(scale_arrow(a, f), A, B))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object),
                  (a: Scalar),
                  (f, g: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, A, B)
        IMPLIES
          scale_arrow(a, add_arrow(f, g))
            = add_arrow(
                scale_arrow(a, f),
                scale_arrow(a, g)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object),
                  (a, b: Scalar),
                  (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
        IMPLIES
          scale_arrow(add_scalar(a, b), f)
            = add_arrow(
                scale_arrow(a, f),
                scale_arrow(b, f)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object),
                  (a, b: Scalar),
                  (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
        IMPLIES
          scale_arrow(mul_scalar(a, b), f)
            = scale_arrow(a, scale_arrow(b, f)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES scale_arrow(one_scalar, f) = f)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES
            scale_arrow(zero_scalar, f)
              = zero_arrow(A, B))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object),
                  (a: Scalar),
                  (f, g: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, B, C)
        IMPLIES
          scale_arrow(a, comp_arrow(g, f))
            = comp_arrow(scale_arrow(a, g), f))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object),
                  (a: Scalar),
                  (f, g: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
          AND q1816952_hom(g, B, C)
        IMPLIES
          scale_arrow(a, comp_arrow(g, f))
            = comp_arrow(g, scale_arrow(a, f)))

  q1816952_is_monomorphism(m: Morphism): bool =
    FORALL (Z: Object), (f, g: Morphism):
      q1816952_hom(f, Z, dom(m))
        AND q1816952_hom(g, Z, dom(m))
        AND comp_arrow(m, f) = comp_arrow(m, g)
      IMPLIES f = g

  q1816952_is_isomorphism(m: Morphism): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: Morphism):
      q1816952_hom(inverse, cod(m), dom(m))
        AND comp_arrow(inverse, m) = id_arrow(dom(m))
        AND comp_arrow(m, inverse) = id_arrow(cod(m))

  q1816952_simple_object(A: Object): bool =
    id_arrow(A) /= zero_arrow(A, A)
      AND (FORALL (B: Object), (m: Morphism):
        q1816952_hom(m, B, A)
          AND q1816952_is_monomorphism(m)
        IMPLIES
          m = zero_arrow(B, A)
            OR q1816952_is_isomorphism(m))

  q1816952_has_kernels: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: Object), (f: Morphism):
      q1816952_hom(f, A, B)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (K: Object), (kernel_arrow: Morphism):
          q1816952_hom(kernel_arrow, K, A)
            AND comp_arrow(f, kernel_arrow)
              = zero_arrow(K, B)
            AND (FORALL (Z: Object), (g: Morphism):
              q1816952_hom(g, Z, A)
                AND comp_arrow(f, g) = zero_arrow(Z, B)
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (lift: Morphism):
                  q1816952_hom(lift, Z, K)
                    AND comp_arrow(kernel_arrow, lift) = g
                    AND (FORALL (other_lift: Morphism):
                      q1816952_hom(other_lift, Z, K)
                        AND comp_arrow(
                          kernel_arrow,
                          other_lift) = g
                      IMPLIES other_lift = lift))

  q1816952_linear_combination(

module

@[expose] public section

namespace Nat

/-- The positive divisors of `n` that are strictly smaller than `n`. -/
def properDivisors (n : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  {d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n | d ∣ n}

/-- A positive natural number equal to the sum of its proper divisors. -/
def Perfect (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (properDivisors n).sum id = n ∧ 0 < n

end Nat

/-- The Mersenne number with exponent `p`. -/
def mersenne (p : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  2 ^ p - 1

namespace Theorems100

namespace Nat

/-- Euler's direction of the Euclid–Euler theorem for even perfect numbers. -/
theorem eq_two_pow_mul_prime_mersenne_of_even_perfect {n : ℕ} (ev : Even n)
    (perf : Nat.Perfect n) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, Nat.Prime (mersenne (k + 1)) ∧ n = 2 ^ k * mersenne (k + 1) := sorry

end Nat

end Theorems100

  perfect natural number is a power of two times a prime Mersenne number.
  This file contains no proof.

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition q18206266_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Definition q18206266_mersenne (exponent : nat) : nat :=
  Nat.pow 2 exponent - 1.

Definition q18206266_sum_proper_divisors (n : nat) : nat :=
  fold_right Nat.add 0
    (filter
      (fun d : nat => Nat.eqb (Nat.modulo n d) 0)
      (seq 1 (n - 1))).

Definition q18206266_perfect (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q18206266_sum_proper_divisors n = n /\ (0 < n)%nat.

Theorem eq_two_pow_mul_prime_mersenne_of_even_perfect :
  forall n : nat,
    Nat.Even n ->
    q18206266_perfect n ->
    exists k : nat,
      q18206266_prime (q18206266_mersenne (k + 1)) /\
      n = Nat.pow 2 k * q18206266_mersenne (k + 1).
Admitted.
