-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q18206266), "Euclid–Euler theorem": every even
-- perfect natural number is 2^k times the prime Mersenne number 2^(k+1)-1
-- for some natural k. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q18206266_euclid_euler_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_ _member_
infixr 5 _and_
infixr 3 _or_
infixr 8 _^_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor conjunction
  field
    first : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : 2 <= n
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides n ->
      (d == 1) or (d == n)

data List (A : Set) : Set where
  nil : List A
  cons : A -> List A -> List A

data _member_ {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  here : {xs : List A} -> x member (cons x xs)
  there :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    x member xs ->
    x member (cons y xs)

data Bottom : Set where

data NoDuplicates {A : Set} : List A -> Set where
  no-duplicates-nil : NoDuplicates nil
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    (x member xs -> Bottom) ->
    NoDuplicates xs ->
    NoDuplicates (cons x xs)

sum : List Nat -> Nat
sum nil = zero
sum (cons x xs) = x + sum xs

record IsDivisorSum (n total : Nat) : Set where
  field
    divisors : List Nat
    exact-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      Iff (d member divisors) (d divides n)
    no-duplicate-divisors : NoDuplicates divisors
    sum-equation : sum divisors == total

_^_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
base ^ zero = 1
base ^ suc exponent = base * (base ^ exponent)

Even : Nat -> Set
Even n =
  Exists Nat (\ half -> n == half + half)

Perfect : Nat -> Set
Perfect n =
  (1 <= n) and IsDivisorSum n (2 * n)

mersenne : Nat -> Nat
mersenne exponent =
  (2 ^ exponent) - 1

euclid-euler-converse : Set
euclid-euler-converse =
  (n : Nat) ->
  Even n ->
  Perfect n ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ k ->
      Prime (mersenne (suc k)) and
      (n == (2 ^ k) * mersenne (suc k)))

title: Q18206266_euclid_euler_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q18206266,
% "Euclid–Euler theorem": every even perfect natural number is a power of two
% times a corresponding prime Mersenne number. This file contains no proof.

Q18206266_euclid_euler_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    divisor > 0
      AND EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  even_nat(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (half: nat): value = 2 * half

  mersenne(exponent: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      2 * mersenne(exponent - 1) + 1
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  divisor_sum_aux(value, bound: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF bound = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      divisor_sum_aux(value, bound - 1)
        + IF nat_divides(bound, value) THEN bound ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE bound

  divisor_sum(value: nat): nat =
    divisor_sum_aux(value, value)

  perfect_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value > 0 AND divisor_sum(value) = 2 * value

  eq_two_pow_mul_prime_mersenne_of_even_perfect: bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      (even_nat(value) AND perfect_nat(value))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (k: nat):
            prime_nat(mersenne(k + 1))
              AND value = 2 ^ k * mersenne(k + 1)
END Q18206266_euclid_euler_theorem

title: Q182505_bayes_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q182505
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q182505), "Bayes' theorem": for two measurable
  events in a finite measure space, conditional probability in one direction
  equals the inverse measure of the conditioning event times the reverse
  conditional probability times the other event's measure. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q182505_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q182505_empty {A : Type} : q182505_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q182505_full {A : Type} : q182505_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q182505_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q182505_set A) : q182505_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q182505_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q182505_set A) : q182505_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q182505_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q182505_set A) : q182505_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q182505_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q182505_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q182505_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q182505_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q182505_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q182505_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q182505_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q182505_ennreal : Type :=
| q182505_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q182505_ennreal
| q182505_ennreal_infinity : q182505_ennreal.

Arguments q182505_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q182505_ennreal_zero : q182505_ennreal :=
  q182505_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q182505_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q182505_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q182505_ennreal_finite a _,
    q182505_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q182505_ennreal_infinity,
    q182505_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q182505_ennreal_le
    (x y : q182505_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q182505_ennreal_finite a _,
    q182505_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q182505_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q182505_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q182505_ennreal_infinity,
    q182505_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q182505_ennreal_infinity,
    q182505_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q182505_ennreal_add
    (x y : q182505_ennreal) : q182505_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q182505_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q182505_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q182505_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q182505_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q182505_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q182505_ennreal) : q182505_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q182505_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q182505_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q182505_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q182505_ennreal_finite a _, q182505_ennreal_infinity
  | q182505_ennreal_infinity, q182505_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q182505_ennreal_zero
      else q182505_ennreal_infinity
  | q182505_ennreal_infinity, q182505_ennreal_infinity =>
      q182505_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q182505_ennreal_inv
    (x : q182505_ennreal) : q182505_ennreal :=
  match x with
  | q182505_ennreal_finite a ha =>
      match Rle_lt_or_eq_dec 0 a ha with
      | left hpositive =>
          q182505_ennreal_finite
            (/ a)
            (Rlt_le 0 (/ a) (Rinv_0_lt_compat a hpositive))
      | right _ => q182505_ennreal_infinity
      end
  | q182505_ennreal_infinity => q182505_ennreal_zero
  end.

Fixpoint q182505_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q182505_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q182505_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q182505_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q182505_ennreal_add
        (q182505_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q182505_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q182505_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q182505_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q182505_ennreal,
      values value -> q182505_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q182505_ennreal,
      (forall value : q182505_ennreal,
        values value -> q182505_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q182505_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q182505_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q182505_ennreal)
    (sum : q182505_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q182505_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q182505_ennreal_eq value
          (q182505_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q182505_ennreal_represents
    (x : q182505_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q182505_ennreal_eq x
      (q182505_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q182505_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q182505_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q182505_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q182505_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q182505_measurable : q182505_set A -> Prop;
  q182505_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q182505_set A,
      q182505_same_set E F ->
      (q182505_measurable E <-> q182505_measurable F);
  q182505_measurable_empty :
    q182505_measurable q182505_empty;
  q182505_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q182505_set A,
      q182505_measurable E ->
      q182505_measurable (q182505_complement E);
  q182505_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q182505_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q182505_measurable (E n)) ->
      q182505_measurable (q182505_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q182505_measurable {A} _ _.

Record q182505_measure {A : Type}
    (M : q182505_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q182505_measure_value :
    q182505_set A -> q182505_ennreal;
  q182505_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q182505_set A,
      q182505_same_set E F ->
      q182505_ennreal_eq
        (q182505_measure_value E)
        (q182505_measure_value F);
  q182505_measure_empty :
    q182505_ennreal_eq
      (q182505_measure_value q182505_empty)
      q182505_ennreal_zero;
  q182505_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q182505_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q182505_measurable M (E n)) ->
      q182505_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q182505_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q182505_measure_value (E n))
        (q182505_measure_value (q182505_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q182505_measure_value {A M} _ _.

Definition q182505_finite_measure {A : Type}
    {M : q182505_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q182505_measure M) : Prop :=
  q182505_ennreal_finite_value
    (q182505_measure_value mu q182505_full).

Definition q182505_conditional_probability {A : Type}
    {M : q182505_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q182505_measure M)
    (event given : q182505_set A) : q182505_ennreal :=
  q182505_ennreal_mul
    (q182505_ennreal_inv (q182505_measure_value mu given))
    (q182505_measure_value mu
      (q182505_intersection given event)).

Theorem cond_eq_inv_mul_cond_mul :
  forall (Omega : Type)
         (M : q182505_measurable_space Omega)
         (mu : q182505_measure M)
         (s t : q182505_set Omega),
    q182505_measurable M s ->
    q182505_measurable M t ->
    q182505_finite_measure mu ->
    q182505_ennreal_eq
      (q182505_conditional_probability mu t s)
      (q182505_ennreal_mul
        (q182505_ennreal_mul
          (q182505_ennreal_inv (q182505_measure_value mu s))
          (q182505_conditional_probability mu s t))
        (q182505_measure_value mu t)).
Admitted.

title: Q182505_bayes_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q182505
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q182505), "Bayes' theorem": for two measurable
  events in an arbitrary finite measure space, conditional probability is the
  inverse measure of the conditioning event times the intersection measure,
  and satisfies Bayes' identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q182505_bayes_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Measure_Space"
begin

definition q182505_conditional_probability ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  where
    "q182505_conditional_probability M t s =
      inverse (emeasure M s) * emeasure M (s \<inter> t)"

theorem bayes_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and s t :: "'a set"
  assumes finite_measure: "finite_measure M"
    and s_measurable: "s \<in> sets M"
    and t_measurable: "t \<in> sets M"
  shows
    "q182505_conditional_probability M t s =
      inverse (emeasure M s) *
        q182505_conditional_probability M s t * emeasure M t"
  sorry

end

title: Q182505_bayes_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q182505,
  "Bayes' theorem" (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q182505): for two measurable
  events in an arbitrary finite measure space, conditional probability obeys
  Bayes' identity, including zero-measure conditioning events. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q182505_BAYES_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let einv =
      \(x:bool#real).
        if FST x
        then ezero
        else if SND x = &0
        then etop
        else (F,inv(SND x)) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        {} IN events /\
        (UNIV:A->bool) IN events /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           u IN events ==> (UNIV:A->bool) DIFF u IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!u:A->bool. enonnegative (mu u)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum
                 (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let finite_measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        measure_space events mu /\
        ~(FST (mu (UNIV:A->bool))) in
   let conditional_probability =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (event:A->bool)
       (given:A->bool).
        emul (einv (mu given)) (mu (given INTER event)) in
   !events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    s:A->bool
    t:A->bool.
      finite_measure_space events mu /\
      s IN events /\
      t IN events
      ==>
      conditional_probability mu t s =
      emul
        (emul
          (einv (mu s))
          (conditional_probability mu s t))
        (mu t)`;;

title: Q182505_bayes_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q182505,
;; "Bayes' theorem": for measurable events in an arbitrary finite measure
;; space, conditional probabilities satisfy Bayes' inverse-prior identity.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, measurable families, measures, and natural-indexed
;; sequences are tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded
;; universal quantification, so sigma closure and countable additivity range
;; over arbitrary represented measurable sequences rather than an
;; unconstrained accessor. The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete ordered
;; field, hence a presentation of the standard real field rather than ACL2's
;; rational numbers; tagged finite nonnegative values plus top present ENNReal.

(defun q182505-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q182505-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q182505-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q182505-quoted nil)))

(defun q182505-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (q182505-term-list arguments)))

(defun q182505-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q182505-apply-term
   (q182505-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q182505-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q182505-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q182505-quoted nil))
    (q182505-quoted t)))

(defun q182505-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q182505-quoted t)
            (q182505-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q182505-quoted nil)))

(defun q182505-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q182505-quoted nil)
        (q182505-quoted t)))

(defun q182505-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q182505-quoted t)))

(defun q182505-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q182505-quoted t)
              (q182505-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q182505-quoted nil)
              (q182505-quoted t))))

(defun q182505-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q182505-quoted t)))

(defun q182505-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q182505-quoted nil)))

(defun q182505-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q182505-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q182505-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (q182505-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q182505-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q182505-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q182505-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Sets and arbitrary functions.

(defun q182505-set-subset-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q182505-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q182505-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q182505-set-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp left)
   (tamep-functionp right)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-set-subset-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q182505-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q182505-set-subset-p carrier set carrier)))

(defun q182505-set-equiv-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q182505-iff-term
     (q182505-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q182505-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q182505-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q182505-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q182505-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-set-equiv-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q182505-empty-set ()
  (list 'lambda '(x) (q182505-quoted nil)))

(defun q182505-full-set (carrier)
  (list 'lambda '(x)
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))))

(defun q182505-complement-set (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-and-terms
    (list
     (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q182505-not-term
      (q182505-static-apply-term set '(x)))))))

(defun q182505-intersection-set (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-and-terms
    (list
     (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q182505-static-apply-term left '(x))
     (q182505-static-apply-term right '(x))))))

(defun q182505-function-values-function
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-static-apply-term domain-carrier '(x))
    (q182505-static-apply-term
     codomain-carrier
     (list (q182505-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun q182505-function-p
    (domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-function-values-function
     domain-carrier codomain-carrier function)
    '(x))))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun q182505-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (q182505-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (q182505-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (q182505-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (q182505-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q182505-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (q182505-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q182505-implies-term
      (q182505-and-terms
       (list
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q182505-and-terms
       (list
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q182505-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (q182505-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (q182505-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q182505-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q182505-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q182505-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q182505-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q182505-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (q182505-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (q182505-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q182505-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q182505-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (q182505-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q182505-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q182505-quoted zero)))
        (q182505-implies-term
         (q182505-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q182505-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q182505-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q182505-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (q182505-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (q182505-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q182505-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q182505-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q182505-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (q182505-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (q182505-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (q182505-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q182505-implies-term
      (q182505-and-terms
       (list
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q182505-and-terms
       (list
        (q182505-not-term
         (q182505-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q182505-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (q182505-implies-term
         (q182505-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q182505-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q182505-implies-term
         xy
         (q182505-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q182505-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q182505-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q182505-implies-term
         (q182505-and-terms
          (list
           (q182505-static-apply-term
            less (list (q182505-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q182505-static-apply-term
            less (list (q182505-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q182505-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q182505-quoted zero)
           (q182505-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun q182505-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q182505-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q182505-not-term
     (q182505-static-apply-term
      less (list (q182505-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun q182505-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (q182505-member-p carrier upper)
   (q182505-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun q182505-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-and-terms
    (list
     (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q182505-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun q182505-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (q182505-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q182505-exists-p
    (q182505-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun q182505-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'q182505-upper-bound-p
         (q182505-quoted carrier)
         (q182505-quoted less)
         (q182505-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun q182505-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (q182505-exists-p
   (q182505-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun q182505-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'q182505-upper-bound-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          (q182505-quoted less)
          (q182505-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (q182505-not-term
     (q182505-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (q182505-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun q182505-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (q182505-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun q182505-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'q182505-valid-set-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'q182505-set-nonempty-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'q182505-bounded-above-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            (q182505-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'q182505-least-upper-bound-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          (q182505-quoted less)
          'set
          (q182505-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun q182505-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (q182505-member-p carrier zero)
   (q182505-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (q182505-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun q182505-scalar-absolute-value
    (less zero negate value)
  (if (q182505-binary-value less value zero)
      (q182505-unary-value negate value)
    value))
;; Sigma algebras.

(defun q182505-family-extensional-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'q182505-set-equiv-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (q182505-iff-term
     (q182505-static-apply-term family '(left))
     (q182505-static-apply-term family '(right))))))

(defun q182505-family-members-valid-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (list 'q182505-valid-set-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          'set))))

(defun q182505-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-family-extensional-function carrier family)
    '(left right))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-family-members-valid-function carrier family)
    '(set))))

(defun q182505-sequence-union-member-function (sequence x)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (q182505-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'natp 'n)
     (q182505-apply-term
      (q182505-static-apply-term sequence '(n))
      (list (q182505-quoted x)))))))

(defun q182505-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (q182505-exists-p
   (q182505-sequence-union-member-function sequence x)
   '(n)))

(defun q182505-sequence-union-set (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-and-terms
    (list
     (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (list 'q182505-sequence-union-member-p
           (q182505-quoted sequence)
           'x)))))

(defun q182505-sequence-of-sets-function (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (list 'q182505-valid-set-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          (q182505-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun q182505-sequence-of-sets-p (carrier sequence)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-sequence-of-sets-function carrier sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun q182505-sequence-members-family-function (family sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'n)
    (q182505-static-apply-term
     family
     (list (q182505-static-apply-term sequence '(n)))))))

(defun q182505-sequence-members-family-p
    (carrier family sequence)
  (and
   (q182505-sequence-of-sets-p carrier sequence)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-sequence-members-family-function family sequence)
    '(n))))

(defun q182505-sigma-complement-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-static-apply-term family '(set))
    (q182505-static-apply-term
     family
     (list
      (list 'q182505-complement-set
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            'set))))))

(defun q182505-sigma-union-function (carrier family)
  (list
   'lambda '(sequence)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'q182505-sequence-members-family-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          (q182505-quoted family)
          'sequence)
    (q182505-static-apply-term
     family
     (list
      (list 'q182505-sequence-union-set
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            'sequence))))))

(defun q182505-sigma-algebra-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (q182505-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
   (q182505-member-p family (q182505-empty-set))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-sigma-complement-function carrier family)
    '(set))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-sigma-union-function carrier family)
    '(sequence))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun q182505-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :q182505-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q182505-finite)
    (q182505-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (q182505-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun q182505-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q182505-finite value))

(defun q182505-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (q182505-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun q182505-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q182505-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q182505-top) t)
   (t
    (q182505-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q182505-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (q182505-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun q182505-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :q182505-top)
          (equal right :q182505-top))
      :q182505-top
    (q182505-ennreal-finite
     (q182505-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q182505-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :q182505-top)
        (equal right :q182505-top))
    :q182505-top)
   (t
    (q182505-ennreal-finite
     (q182505-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q182505-ennreal-inverse
    (value scalar-zero scalar-inverse)
  (cond
   ((equal value :q182505-top)
    (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((equal value (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
    :q182505-top)
   (t
    (q182505-ennreal-finite
     (q182505-unary-value scalar-inverse (cdr value))))))

(defun q182505-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (q182505-ennreal-add
     (q182505-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (q182505-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

(defun q182505-sum-upper-bound-function
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(count)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'count)
    (list 'q182505-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (list 'q182505-finite-ennreal-sum
                (q182505-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
                (q182505-quoted scalar-add))
          (q182505-quoted total)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-sum-upper-bound-p
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (q182505-universal-p
   (q182505-sum-upper-bound-function
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   '(count)))

(defun q182505-sum-least-function
    (sequence total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(bound)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'q182505-ennreal-p
            'bound
            (q182505-quoted scalar-carrier)
            (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
            (q182505-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'q182505-sum-upper-bound-p
            (q182505-quoted sequence)
            'bound
            (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
            (q182505-quoted scalar-add)
            (q182505-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'q182505-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (q182505-quoted total)
          'bound
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-countable-sum-p
    (sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (q182505-ennreal-p
    total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
   (q182505-sum-upper-bound-p
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-sum-least-function
     sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
    '(bound))))

;; Countably additive measures, including values on arbitrary subsets.

(defun q182505-measure-extensional-function (carrier measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'q182505-set-equiv-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          'left 'right)
    (list 'equal
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(left))
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(right))))))

(defun q182505-measure-values-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less carrier measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'q182505-valid-set-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          'set)
    (list 'q182505-ennreal-p
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(set))
          (q182505-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-measure-monotone-function
    (scalar-less carrier measurable measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (q182505-static-apply-term measurable '(left))
      (q182505-static-apply-term measurable '(right))
      (list 'q182505-set-subset-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            'left 'right)))
    (list 'q182505-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(left))
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(right))
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-measure-null-subset-function
    (scalar-zero carrier measurable measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (q182505-static-apply-term measurable '(left))
      (q182505-static-apply-term measurable '(right))
      (list 'q182505-set-subset-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            'left 'right)
      (list 'equal
            (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(right))
            (list 'q182505-ennreal-zero
                  (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)))))
    (list 'equal
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(left))
          (list 'q182505-ennreal-zero
                (q182505-quoted scalar-zero))))))

(defun q182505-measure-sequence-values (measure sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(n)
   (q182505-static-apply-term
    measure
    (list (q182505-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun q182505-disjoint-sets-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q182505-not-term
     (q182505-and-terms
      (list
       (q182505-static-apply-term left '(x))
       (q182505-static-apply-term right '(x))))))))

(defun q182505-disjoint-sets-p (carrier left right)
  (q182505-universal-p
   (q182505-disjoint-sets-function carrier left right)
   '(x)))

(defun q182505-pairwise-disjoint-function (carrier sequence)
  (list
   'lambda '(m n)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'natp 'm)
      (list 'natp 'n)
      (q182505-not-term (list 'equal 'm 'n))))
    (list 'q182505-disjoint-sets-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          (q182505-static-apply-term sequence '(m))
          (q182505-static-apply-term sequence '(n))))))

(defun q182505-pairwise-disjoint-p (carrier sequence)
  (q182505-universal-p
   (q182505-pairwise-disjoint-function carrier sequence)
   '(m n)))

(defun q182505-countable-additivity-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(sequence)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'q182505-sequence-members-family-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            (q182505-quoted measurable)
            'sequence)
      (list 'q182505-pairwise-disjoint-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            'sequence)))
    (list 'q182505-countable-sum-p
          (list 'q182505-measure-sequence-values
                (q182505-quoted measure)
                'sequence)
          (q182505-static-apply-term
           measure
           (list
            (list 'q182505-sequence-union-set
                  (q182505-quoted carrier)
                  'sequence)))
          (q182505-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-add)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-measurable-superset-lower-bound-function
    (carrier measurable measure set lower scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(superset)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (q182505-static-apply-term measurable '(superset))
      (list 'q182505-set-subset-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            (q182505-quoted set)
            'superset)))
    (list 'q182505-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (q182505-quoted lower)
          (q182505-static-apply-term measure '(superset))
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    (carrier measurable measure set lower scalar-less)
  (q182505-universal-p
   (q182505-measurable-superset-lower-bound-function
    carrier measurable measure set lower scalar-less)
   '(superset)))

(defun q182505-outer-value-lower-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure set)
  (list
   'lambda '(lower)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (q182505-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'q182505-ennreal-p
            'lower
            (q182505-quoted scalar-carrier)
            (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
            (q182505-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'q182505-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
            (q182505-quoted carrier)
            (q182505-quoted measurable)
            (q182505-quoted measure)
            (q182505-quoted set)
            'lower
            (q182505-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'q182505-ennreal-less-equal-p
          'lower
          (q182505-static-apply-term
           measure (list (q182505-quoted set)))
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q182505-outer-value-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure set)
  (and
   (q182505-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q182505-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    carrier measurable measure set
    (q182505-unary-value measure set)
    scalar-less)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-outer-value-lower-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure set)
    '(lower))))

(defun q182505-outer-values-function
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q182505-implies-term
    (list 'q182505-valid-set-p
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          'set)
    (list 'q182505-outer-value-p
          (q182505-quoted scalar-carrier)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-zero)
          (q182505-quoted scalar-less)
          (q182505-quoted carrier)
          (q182505-quoted measurable)
          (q182505-quoted measure)
          'set))))

(defun q182505-measure-space-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
  (and
   (q182505-sigma-algebra-p carrier measurable)
   (tamep-functionp measure)
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-measure-extensional-function carrier measure)
    '(left right))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-measure-values-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less carrier measure)
    '(set))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-measure-monotone-function
     scalar-less carrier measurable measure)
    '(left right))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-measure-null-subset-function
     scalar-zero carrier measurable measure)
    '(left right))
   (equal
    (q182505-unary-value measure (q182505-empty-set))
    (q182505-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-countable-additivity-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
    '(sequence))
   (q182505-universal-p
    (q182505-outer-values-function
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less
     carrier measurable measure)
    '(set))))

(defun q182505-finite-measure-p
    (carrier measure)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp measure)
   (not
    (equal
     (q182505-unary-value
      measure
      (q182505-full-set carrier))
     :q182505-top))))

;; On a measurable conditioning event, this is definitionally the application
;; of (measure conditioning)^-1 • measure.restrict conditioning.

(defun q182505-conditional-probability
    (scalar-zero scalar-multiply scalar-inverse
     carrier measure event conditioning)
  (q182505-ennreal-multiply
   (q182505-ennreal-inverse
    (q182505-unary-value measure conditioning)
    scalar-zero scalar-inverse)
   (q182505-unary-value
    measure
    (q182505-intersection-set carrier conditioning event))
   scalar-zero scalar-multiply))

(defun thousand-theorems-q182505-bayes-theorem-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum
     sample-carrier sample-measurable sample-measure
     s event-t)
  (implies
   (and
    (q182505-real-field-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less real-supremum)
    (q182505-measure-space-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     sample-carrier sample-measurable sample-measure)
    (q182505-finite-measure-p
     sample-carrier sample-measure)
    (q182505-member-p sample-measurable s)
    (q182505-member-p sample-measurable event-t))
   (equal
    (q182505-conditional-probability
     real-zero real-multiply real-inverse
     sample-carrier sample-measure event-t s)
    (q182505-ennreal-multiply
     (q182505-ennreal-multiply
      (q182505-ennreal-inverse
       (q182505-unary-value sample-measure s)
       real-zero real-inverse)
      (q182505-conditional-probability
       real-zero real-multiply real-inverse
       sample-carrier sample-measure s event-t)
      real-zero real-multiply)
     (q182505-unary-value sample-measure event-t)
     real-zero real-multiply))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q182505_bayes_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q182505,
-- "Bayes' theorem": for a finite measure and two measurable events, the
-- conditional mass of the second given the first equals the inverse mass of
-- the first times the conditional mass of the first given the second times
-- the mass of the second. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe --prop #-}

module Q182505_bayes_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_; Prop)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Prop p where

record Top {p : Level} : Prop p where
  constructor top

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Prop p ->
  Prop p
Not {p} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Prop p) :
  Prop (a ⊔ p) where

  witness :
    (value : A) ->
    P value ->
    Exists A P

infix 4 _==N_ _!=N_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

data _==N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  reflN : {n : Nat} -> n ==N n

_!=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m !=N n =
  Not (m ==N n)

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

-- A rational is the integer positivePart - negativePart divided by
-- suc denominatorCode. The relations below quotient this presentation.
record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart    : Nat
    negativePart    : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue : Rational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

oneQ : Rational
oneQ =
  rational (suc zero) zero zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

multiplyQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
multiplyQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N positivePart r) +N
     (negativePart q *N negativePart r))
    ((positivePart q *N negativePart r) +N
     (negativePart q *N positivePart r))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalEqual q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  ==N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLE : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalLE q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <=N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLT : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalLT q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

-- The fixed real object is the type of located lower Dedekind cuts of the
-- concrete rationals above. All cut laws are proof-irrelevant Prop fields.
record Real : Set1 where
  field
    lower :
      Rational ->
      Prop

    lower-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (lower q) (lower r)

    lower-inhabited :
      Exists Rational lower

    lower-proper :
      Exists Rational (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    lower-downward :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    lower-rounded :
      (q : Rational) ->
      lower q ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT q r) (lower r))

    lower-located :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

open Real

record NonnegativeReal : Set1 where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    real :
      Real

    nonnegative :
      (q : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      lower real q

open NonnegativeReal

-- ENNReal is a fixed concrete syntax interpreted extensionally as a
-- nonnegative lower cut. The operation constructors denote the canonical
-- extended-real sum, product, and inverse through ENNLower below.
data ENNReal : Set1 where
  finite     : NonnegativeReal -> ENNReal
  infinity   : ENNReal
  sumENN     : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal
  productENN : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal
  inverseENN : ENNReal -> ENNReal

ENNLower : ENNReal -> Rational -> Prop
ENNLower (finite x) r =
  lower (real x) r
ENNLower infinity r =
  Top
ENNLower (sumENN x y) r =
  Exists Rational
    (\ p ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ q ->
          Both
            (Both (ENNLower x p) (ENNLower y q))
            (RationalLT r (addQ p q))))
ENNLower (productENN x y) r =
  Either
    (RationalLT r zeroQ)
    (Exists Rational
      (\ p ->
        Exists Rational
          (\ q ->
            Both
              (Both
                (RationalLT zeroQ p)
                (Both
                  (RationalLT zeroQ q)
                  (Both (ENNLower x p) (ENNLower y q))))
              (RationalLT r (multiplyQ p q)))))
ENNLower (inverseENN x) r =
  Either
    (RationalLT r zeroQ)
    (Exists Rational
      (\ q ->
        Both
          (RationalLT r q)
          (Both
            (RationalLT zeroQ q)
            (Exists Rational
              (\ reciprocal ->
                Both
                  (RationalEqual (multiplyQ q reciprocal) oneQ)
                  (Exists Rational
                    (\ upperWitness ->
                      Both
                        (Not (ENNLower x upperWitness))
                        (RationalLT upperWitness reciprocal))))))))

ENNEqual : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNEqual x y =
  (r : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x r) (ENNLower y r)

ENNLE : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNLE x y =
  (r : Rational) ->
  ENNLower x r ->
  ENNLower y r

IsZeroENN : ENNReal -> Prop
IsZeroENN x =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x q) (RationalLT q zeroQ)

IsSupremum :
  {p : Level} ->
  (ENNReal -> Prop p) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero ⊔ p)
IsSupremum candidates bound =
  Both
    ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE x bound)
    ((upper : ENNReal) ->
      ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE x upper) ->
      ENNLE bound upper)

IsInfimum :
  {p : Level} ->
  (ENNReal -> Prop p) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero ⊔ p)
IsInfimum candidates bound =
  Both
    ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE bound x)
    ((lowerBound : ENNReal) ->
      ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE lowerBound x) ->
      ENNLE lowerBound bound)

data FiniteSum
  (terms : Nat -> ENNReal) :
  Nat ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero) where

  empty-sum :
    {value : ENNReal} ->
    IsZeroENN value ->
    FiniteSum terms zero value

  next-sum :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {partial total : ENNReal} ->
    FiniteSum terms n partial ->
    ENNEqual total (sumENN partial (terms n)) ->
    FiniteSum terms (suc n) total

CountableSum :
  (Nat -> ENNReal) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero)
CountableSum terms total =
  IsSupremum
    (\ value ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> FiniteSum terms n value))
    total

Event :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Event A =
  A -> Prop

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Whole :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A
Whole _ =
  Top

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Event A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop a
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

SameEvent :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop a
SameEvent {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Prop a
PairwiseDisjoint {a = a} {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i !=N j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom {a}

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    measurable :
      Event A ->
      Prop

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Event A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      SameEvent S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

-- A measure is represented by its outer mass, the outer-measure laws, and
-- Caratheodory measurability. Every law is Prop-valued and hence irrelevant.
record Measure
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    mass :
      Event A ->
      ENNReal

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      SameEvent S T ->
      ENNEqual (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-trimmed :
      (S : Event A) ->
      IsInfimum
        (\ value ->
          Exists (Event A)
            (\ T ->
              Both
                (measurable events T)
                (Both
                  (Subset S T)
                  (ENNEqual value (mass T)))))
        (mass S)

    mass-empty :
      IsZeroENN (mass Empty)

    mass-monotone :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      ENNLE (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      (sum : ENNReal) ->
      CountableSum (\ n -> mass (sets n)) sum ->
      ENNLE (mass (CountableUnion sets)) sum

    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      ENNEqual
        (mass T)
        (sumENN
          (mass (Intersection T S))
          (mass (Intersection T (Complement S))))

    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        (mass (CountableUnion sets))

open Measure

FiniteMeasure :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Prop
FiniteMeasure measure =
  Not (ENNEqual (mass measure Whole) infinity)

-- Restriction is canonical: its value at event is the original mass of the
-- intersection. It is a definition, not an additional theorem hypothesis.
restrictedMass :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  ENNReal
restrictedMass measure given event =
  mass measure (Intersection event given)

conditionalMass :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  ENNReal
conditionalMass measure given event =
  productENN
    (inverseENN (mass measure given))
    (restrictedMass measure given event)

bayes-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Prop (lsuc a)
bayes-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (s t : Event A) ->
  measurable events s ->
  measurable events t ->
  (measure : Measure events) ->
  FiniteMeasure measure ->
  ENNEqual
    (conditionalMass measure s t)
    (productENN
      (productENN
        (inverseENN (mass measure s))
        (conditionalMass measure t s))
      (mass measure t))

  ``q182505_cond
      (m : 'a m_space) (event : 'a set) (given : 'a set) =

title: Q182505_bayes_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q182505,
% "Bayes' theorem": conditional probabilities under an arbitrary finite measure
% satisfy the measure-theoretic Bayes identity for measurable events. This file
% contains no proof.

Q182505_bayes_theorem[Omega: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [Omega -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_product(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_inverse(value: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF finite_part(value) = 0 THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(1 / finite_part(value))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Omega): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Omega): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Omega): NOT E(omega)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Omega): E(omega) AND F(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Omega):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: Omega):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(M(full_event))

  conditional_probability(
      M: measure_map,
      observed, given: event): measure_value =
    measure_value_product(
      measure_value_inverse(M(given)),
      M(event_intersection(given, observed)))

  bayes_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (s, t: event):
      (finite_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND Sigma(s)
        AND Sigma(t))
      IMPLIES
        conditional_probability(M, t, s)
          = measure_value_product(
              measure_value_product(
                measure_value_inverse(M(s)),
                conditional_probability(M, s, t)),
              M(t))
END Q182505_bayes_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q188295
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q188295), "Fermat's little theorem": for a prime
  p, every nonzero residue modulo p raised to the power p - 1 equals one in
  the residue field. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Definition q188295_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Record q188295_zmod (p : nat) : Type := {
  q188295_zmod_val : nat;
  q188295_zmod_val_lt : (q188295_zmod_val < p)%nat
}.

Definition q188295_zmod_eq (p a b : nat) : Prop :=
  Nat.modulo a p = Nat.modulo b p.

Theorem pow_card_sub_one_eq_one :
  forall p : nat,
    q188295_prime p ->
    forall a : q188295_zmod p,
      ~ q188295_zmod_eq p (q188295_zmod_val p a) 0 ->
      q188295_zmod_eq p
        (Nat.pow (q188295_zmod_val p a) (p - 1))
        1.
Admitted.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun q188295-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (q188295-no-divisor-from-p number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun q188295-primep (number)
  (and (natp number)
       (< 1 number)
       (q188295-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

  (implies
   (and (q188295-primep p)
        (natp a)
        (< a p)
        (not (equal a 0)))
   (equal (mod (expt a (- p 1)) p)
          1)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q188295_fermat_s_little_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q188295
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q188295), "Fermat's little theorem": for a prime
-- modulus p, every nonzero residue class in ZMod p has (p - 1)-st power equal
-- to one. Natural representatives with equality modulo p encode those residue
-- classes. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q188295_fermat_s_little_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _-_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where

one : Nat
one =

    only-trivial-divisors :

power : Nat -> Nat -> Nat

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set

title: Q188295_fermat_s_little_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q188295,
% "Fermat's little theorem": in ZMod p for prime p, every nonzero residue
% class a satisfies a^(p - 1) = 1. This file contains no proof.

Q188295_fermat_s_little_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  residue(modulus: posnat): TYPE = below(modulus)

  zmod_equal(left, right: nat, modulus: posnat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) = (modulus :: int) * offset

  fermat_s_little_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (p: posnat):
      prime_nat(p) IMPLIES
        FORALL (a: residue(p)):
          a /= 0 IMPLIES
            zmod_equal((a :: nat) ^ (p - 1), 1, p)
END Q188295_fermat_s_little_theorem
