title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1893717
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1893717), "Rice's theorem": every computably
  decidable extensional property of partial-recursive natural-number functions
  that holds for one such function holds for all of them. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Module Q1893717_Rice.

(* The square pairing used by the source Nat.Partrec development. *)
Definition q1893717_nat_pair (a b : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.ltb a b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b.

(* Codes for a universal system of partial-recursive unary functions. *)
Inductive q1893717_code : Type :=
| Q1893717_Code_zero : q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_succ : q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_left : q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_right : q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_pair :
    q1893717_code -> q1893717_code -> q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_comp :
    q1893717_code -> q1893717_code -> q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_prec :
    q1893717_code -> q1893717_code -> q1893717_code
| Q1893717_Code_rfind :
    q1893717_code -> q1893717_code.

(* A computable numerical encoding of program codes. *)
Fixpoint q1893717_code_encode (c : q1893717_code) : nat :=
  match c with
  | Q1893717_Code_zero => 0
  | Q1893717_Code_succ => 1
  | Q1893717_Code_left => 2
  | Q1893717_Code_right => 3
  | Q1893717_Code_pair cf cg =>
      4 * q1893717_nat_pair
        (q1893717_code_encode cf) (q1893717_code_encode cg) + 4
  | Q1893717_Code_comp cf cg =>
      4 * q1893717_nat_pair
        (q1893717_code_encode cf) (q1893717_code_encode cg) + 6
  | Q1893717_Code_prec cf cg =>
      4 * q1893717_nat_pair
        (q1893717_code_encode cf) (q1893717_code_encode cg) + 5
  | Q1893717_Code_rfind cf =>
      4 * q1893717_code_encode cf + 7
  end.

(* Relational evaluation means that the coded computation terminates with
   the displayed output. *)
Inductive q1893717_evaluates :
    q1893717_code -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
| Q1893717_Eval_zero :
    forall input,
      q1893717_evaluates Q1893717_Code_zero input 0
| Q1893717_Eval_succ :
    forall input,
      q1893717_evaluates Q1893717_Code_succ input (S input)
| Q1893717_Eval_left :
    forall left right,
      q1893717_evaluates Q1893717_Code_left
        (q1893717_nat_pair left right) left
| Q1893717_Eval_right :
    forall left right,
      q1893717_evaluates Q1893717_Code_right
        (q1893717_nat_pair left right) right
| Q1893717_Eval_pair :
    forall cf cg input left_value right_value,
      q1893717_evaluates cf input left_value ->
      q1893717_evaluates cg input right_value ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_pair cf cg) input
        (q1893717_nat_pair left_value right_value)
| Q1893717_Eval_comp :
    forall cf cg input middle output,
      q1893717_evaluates cg input middle ->
      q1893717_evaluates cf middle output ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_comp cf cg) input output
| Q1893717_Eval_prec_zero :
    forall cf cg parameter output,
      q1893717_evaluates cf parameter output ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter 0) output
| Q1893717_Eval_prec_succ :
    forall cf cg parameter index previous output,
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter index) previous ->
      q1893717_evaluates cg
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter
          (q1893717_nat_pair index previous)) output ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter (S index)) output
| Q1893717_Eval_rfind_zero :
    forall cf parameter start,
      q1893717_evaluates cf
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter start) 0 ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_rfind cf)
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter start) start
| Q1893717_Eval_rfind_succ :
    forall cf parameter start nonzero_value output,
      q1893717_evaluates cf
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter start) (S nonzero_value) ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_rfind cf)
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter (S start)) output ->
      q1893717_evaluates (Q1893717_Code_rfind cf)
        (q1893717_nat_pair parameter start) output.

(* Partial functions are represented extensionally by their termination
   graphs. Program denotations are functional by the deterministic clauses
   above. *)
Definition q1893717_partial_function : Type :=
  nat -> nat -> Prop.

Definition q1893717_evaluate
    (c : q1893717_code) : q1893717_partial_function :=
  fun input output => q1893717_evaluates c input output.

Definition q1893717_same_partial_function
    (f g : q1893717_partial_function) : Prop :=
  forall input output, f input output <-> g input output.

Definition q1893717_partial_recursive
    (f : q1893717_partial_function) : Prop :=
  exists c : q1893717_code,
    q1893717_same_partial_function f (q1893717_evaluate c).

(* This record represents a set of partial functions independently of the
   chosen graph presentation. *)
Record q1893717_partial_property : Type := {
  q1893717_holds : q1893717_partial_function -> Prop;
  q1893717_holds_extensional :
    forall f g,
      q1893717_same_partial_function f g ->
      (q1893717_holds f <-> q1893717_holds g)
}.

(* A predicate on codes is computable when a coded program computes its
   total Boolean characteristic function. *)
Definition q1893717_computable_predicate
    (P : q1893717_code -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists decision : q1893717_code -> bool,
    (forall c, decision c = true <-> P c) /\
    exists program : q1893717_code,
      forall c output,
        q1893717_evaluates program
          (q1893717_code_encode c) output <->
        output = (if decision c then 1 else 0).

Theorem q1893717_rice :
  forall C : q1893717_partial_property,
    q1893717_computable_predicate
      (fun c => q1893717_holds C (q1893717_evaluate c)) ->
    forall f g : q1893717_partial_function,
      q1893717_partial_recursive f ->
      q1893717_partial_recursive g ->
      q1893717_holds C f ->
      q1893717_holds C g.
Admitted.

End Q1893717_Rice.

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1893717,
  "Rice's theorem": every computably decidable extensional property of unary
  partial-recursive functions that contains one such function contains them all.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym q1893717_registers = "nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
type_synonym q1893717_state = "nat \<times> q1893717_registers"
type_synonym q1893717_partial_function = "nat \<Rightarrow> nat option"

fun q1893717_encode_program :: "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_encode_program [] = 0"
| "q1893717_encode_program (instruction # program) =
    2 ^ instruction * (2 * q1893717_encode_program program + 1)"

definition q1893717_decode_program :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat list" where
  "q1893717_decode_program code =
    (if \<exists>program. q1893717_encode_program program = code
     then THE program. q1893717_encode_program program = code
     else [])"

definition q1893717_unpair :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<times> nat" where
  "q1893717_unpair code =
    (SOME pair. code =
      (fst pair + snd pair) * (fst pair + snd pair + 1) div 2 + snd pair)"

definition q1893717_instruction_tag :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_instruction_tag instruction =
    fst (q1893717_unpair instruction) mod 3"

definition q1893717_instruction_arguments :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_instruction_arguments instruction =
    snd (q1893717_unpair instruction)"

definition q1893717_instruction_register :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_instruction_register instruction =
    fst (q1893717_unpair (q1893717_instruction_arguments instruction))"

definition q1893717_instruction_rest :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_instruction_rest instruction =
    snd (q1893717_unpair (q1893717_instruction_arguments instruction))"

definition q1893717_instruction_target :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_instruction_target instruction =
    fst (q1893717_unpair (q1893717_instruction_rest instruction))"

definition q1893717_instruction_other_target :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1893717_instruction_other_target instruction =
    snd (q1893717_unpair (q1893717_instruction_rest instruction))"

definition q1893717_halted ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> q1893717_state \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1893717_halted program state \<longleftrightarrow>
    (case state of (pc, registers) \<Rightarrow>
      pc \<ge> length program \<or>
      q1893717_instruction_tag (program ! pc) = 0)"

definition q1893717_step ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> q1893717_state \<Rightarrow> q1893717_state" where
  "q1893717_step program state =
    (case state of (pc, registers) \<Rightarrow>
      if pc \<ge> length program then state
      else
        let instruction = program ! pc;
            tag = q1893717_instruction_tag instruction;
            r = q1893717_instruction_register instruction
        in if tag = 0 then state
           else if tag = 1 then
             (q1893717_instruction_target instruction,
              registers(r := Suc (registers r)))
           else if registers r = 0 then
             (q1893717_instruction_target instruction, registers)
           else
             (q1893717_instruction_other_target instruction,
              registers(r := registers r - 1)))"

definition q1893717_initial_state :: "nat \<Rightarrow> q1893717_state" where
  "q1893717_initial_state input =
    (0, (\<lambda>r. if r = 0 then input else 0))"

definition q1893717_reaches_halt ::
    "nat list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1893717_reaches_halt program input output \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>steps.
      let state =
        (q1893717_step program ^^ steps) (q1893717_initial_state input)
      in q1893717_halted program state \<and> snd state 0 = output)"

definition q1893717_eval :: "nat \<Rightarrow> q1893717_partial_function" where
  "q1893717_eval code input =
    (let program = q1893717_decode_program code
     in if \<exists>output. q1893717_reaches_halt program input output
        then Some (THE output. q1893717_reaches_halt program input output)
        else None)"

definition q1893717_partrec :: "q1893717_partial_function \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1893717_partrec f \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>code. q1893717_eval code = f)"

definition q1893717_computable_pred :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1893717_computable_pred predicate \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>code. \<forall>input.
      q1893717_eval code input =
        Some (if predicate input then 1 else 0))"

theorem rice:
  fixes C :: "q1893717_partial_function set"
    and f g :: q1893717_partial_function
  assumes decidable_property:
      "q1893717_computable_pred (\<lambda>code. q1893717_eval code \<in> C)"
    and f_partial_recursive: "q1893717_partrec f"
    and g_partial_recursive: "q1893717_partrec g"
    and f_has_property: "f \<in> C"
  shows "g \<in> C"
  sorry

end

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1893717,
  "Rice's theorem": a computably decidable extensional property of program
  semantics that holds for one partial-recursive function holds for every
  partial-recursive function. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q1893717_code_INDUCT,q1893717_code_RECURSION = define_type
  "q1893717_code =
       Q1893717_Zero
     | Q1893717_Succ
     | Q1893717_Left
     | Q1893717_Right
     | Q1893717_Pair q1893717_code q1893717_code
     | Q1893717_Comp q1893717_code q1893717_code
     | Q1893717_Prec q1893717_code q1893717_code
     | Q1893717_Rfind q1893717_code";;

let q1893717_pair = new_definition
  `q1893717_pair a b =
     ((a + b) * (a + b + 1)) DIV 2 + b`;;

let q1893717_encode = new_recursive_definition q1893717_code_RECURSION
  `(q1893717_encode Q1893717_Zero = 0) /\
   (q1893717_encode Q1893717_Succ = 1) /\
   (q1893717_encode Q1893717_Left = 2) /\
   (q1893717_encode Q1893717_Right = 3) /\
   (q1893717_encode (Q1893717_Pair c d) =
      4 + 4 * q1893717_pair
        (q1893717_encode c) (q1893717_encode d)) /\
   (q1893717_encode (Q1893717_Comp c d) =
      6 + 4 * q1893717_pair
        (q1893717_encode c) (q1893717_encode d)) /\
   (q1893717_encode (Q1893717_Prec c d) =
      5 + 4 * q1893717_pair
        (q1893717_encode c) (q1893717_encode d)) /\
   (q1893717_encode (Q1893717_Rfind c) =
      7 + 4 * q1893717_encode c)`;;

let q1893717_eval_RULES,q1893717_eval_INDUCT,q1893717_eval_CASES =
  new_inductive_definition
   `(!n:num. q1893717_eval Q1893717_Zero n 0) /\
    (!n:num. q1893717_eval Q1893717_Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b:num.
       q1893717_eval Q1893717_Left (q1893717_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b:num.
       q1893717_eval Q1893717_Right (q1893717_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q1893717_eval c n x /\ q1893717_eval d n y
       ==> q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Pair c d) n
             (q1893717_pair x y)) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q1893717_eval d n x /\ q1893717_eval c x y
       ==> q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Comp c d) n y) /\
    (!c d a y.
       q1893717_eval c a y
       ==> q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Prec c d)
             (q1893717_pair a 0) y) /\
    (!c d a k i y.
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Prec c d)
         (q1893717_pair a k) i /\
       q1893717_eval d (q1893717_pair a (q1893717_pair k i)) y
       ==> q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Prec c d)
             (q1893717_pair a (SUC k)) y) /\
    (!c a m.
       q1893717_eval c (q1893717_pair a m) 0
       ==> q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Rfind c)
             (q1893717_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z y.
       q1893717_eval c (q1893717_pair a m) (SUC z) /\
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Rfind c)
         (q1893717_pair a (SUC m)) y
       ==> q1893717_eval (Q1893717_Rfind c)
             (q1893717_pair a m) y)`;;

let q1893717_partrec = new_definition
  `q1893717_partrec (f:num->num->bool) <=>
     ?program:q1893717_code.
       !x y. f x y <=> q1893717_eval program x y`;;

let q1893717_computable_predicate = new_definition
  `q1893717_computable_predicate (p:q1893717_code->bool) <=>
     ?program:q1893717_code.
       !c y.
         q1893717_eval program (q1893717_encode c) y <=>
         (if p c then y = 1 else y = 0)`;;

let Q1893717_RICES_THEOREM =
  `!C:(num->num->bool)->bool.
   !f g:num->num->bool.
     q1893717_computable_predicate
       (\c. C (q1893717_eval c)) /\
     q1893717_partrec f /\
     q1893717_partrec g /\
     C f
     ==> C g`;;

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1893717,
;; "Rice's theorem": a computable extensional property of partial-recursive
;; unary natural-number functions that holds for one such function holds for
;; every such function. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Natural numbers are decoded exactly as Nat.Partrec.Code: 0, 1, 2, and 3
;; are the base codes, and the two low bits above 3 select pair, composition,
;; primitive recursion, or minimization. The bounded evaluator represents the
;; corresponding partial function; existence of a fuel is definedness.

(defun q1893717-nat-pair (left right)
  (let ((left (nfix left))
        (right (nfix right)))
    (if (< left right)
        (+ (* right right) left)
      (+ (* left left) left right))))

(defun q1893717-isqrt-down (number candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) number)
        candidate
      (q1893717-isqrt-down number (- candidate 1)))))

(defun q1893717-isqrt (number)
  (let ((number (nfix number)))
    (q1893717-isqrt-down number number)))

(defun q1893717-nat-unpair (number)
  (let* ((number (nfix number))
         (root (q1893717-isqrt number))
         (remainder (- number (* root root))))
    (if (< remainder root)
        (cons remainder root)
      (cons root (- remainder root)))))

(defun q1893717-code-decode-aux (steps number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      :zero
    (let ((number (nfix number)))
      (cond
       ((equal number 0) :zero)
       ((equal number 1) :succ)
       ((equal number 2) :left)
       ((equal number 3) :right)
       (t
        (let* ((payload (- number 4))
               (low-bit (mod payload 2))
               (high-bit (mod (floor payload 2) 2))
               (subcode-pair-number (floor payload 4))
               (subcode-pair
                (q1893717-nat-unpair subcode-pair-number))
               (next-steps (- steps 1)))
          (cond
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :pair
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 1))
            (list
             :comp
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 1)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :prec
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           (t
            (list
             :rfind
             (q1893717-code-decode-aux
              next-steps subcode-pair-number))))))))))

(defun q1893717-code-decode (number)
  (q1893717-code-decode-aux
   (+ 1 (nfix number))
   number))

(defun q1893717-some (value)
  (cons :some value))

(defun q1893717-some-p (result)
  (and (consp result)
       (equal (car result) :some)
       (natp (cdr result))))

(defun q1893717-evaln-measure (fuel code)
  (make-ord
   1
   (+ 1 (nfix fuel))
   (acl2-count code)))

(defun q1893717-evaln (fuel code input)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure (q1893717-evaln-measure fuel code)
    :well-founded-relation o<))
  (if (zp fuel)
      nil
    (let ((bound (- fuel 1)))
      (if (or (not (natp input))
              (< bound input))
          nil
        (cond
         ((equal code :zero)
          (q1893717-some 0))
         ((equal code :succ)
          (q1893717-some (+ input 1)))
         ((equal code :left)
          (q1893717-some
           (car (q1893717-nat-unpair input))))
         ((equal code :right)
          (q1893717-some
           (cdr (q1893717-nat-unpair input))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :pair))
          (let ((left
                 (q1893717-evaln
                  fuel (cadr code) input)))
            (if (q1893717-some-p left)
                (let ((right
                       (q1893717-evaln
                        fuel (caddr code) input)))
                  (if (q1893717-some-p right)
                      (q1893717-some
                       (q1893717-nat-pair
                        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
                    nil))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :comp))
          (let ((argument
                 (q1893717-evaln
                  fuel (caddr code) input)))
            (if (q1893717-some-p argument)
                (q1893717-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) (cdr argument))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :prec))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q1893717-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (counter (cdr arguments)))
            (if (zp counter)
                (q1893717-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) parameter)
              (let* ((predecessor (- counter 1))
                     (previous
                      (q1893717-evaln
                       bound
                       code
                       (q1893717-nat-pair
                        parameter predecessor))))
                (if (q1893717-some-p previous)
                    (q1893717-evaln
                     fuel
                     (caddr code)
                     (q1893717-nat-pair
                      parameter
                      (q1893717-nat-pair
                       predecessor
                       (cdr previous))))
                  nil)))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :rfind))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q1893717-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (start (cdr arguments))
                 (test
                  (q1893717-evaln
                   fuel
                   (cadr code)
                   (q1893717-nat-pair
                    parameter start))))
            (if (q1893717-some-p test)
                (if (equal (cdr test) 0)
                    (q1893717-some start)
                  (q1893717-evaln
                   bound
                   code
                   (q1893717-nat-pair
                    parameter (+ start 1))))
              nil)))
         (t nil))))))

;; DEFUN-SK supplies the source's unbounded quantifiers. Natural-number
;; conditions recover the source domains, while existential fuel and decider
;; witnesses remain internal. The generic membership predicate represents an
;; arbitrary class of program codes; extensionality below makes it descend to
;; a set of partial functions.

(defstub q1893717-class-member (class program) t)

(defun q1893717-class-member-p (class program)
  (if (q1893717-class-member class program)
      t
    nil))

(defun-sk q1893717-halts-with-p
    (program input output)
  (exists (fuel)
    (and
     (natp program)
     (natp input)
     (natp output)
     (natp fuel)
     (equal
      (q1893717-evaln
       fuel
       (q1893717-code-decode program)
       input)
      (q1893717-some output)))))

(defun-sk q1893717-program-graph-equal-p
    (left-program right-program)
  (forall (input output)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp input)
      (natp output))
     (iff
      (q1893717-halts-with-p
       left-program input output)
      (q1893717-halts-with-p
       right-program input output)))))

(defun q1893717-program-equivalent-p
    (left-program right-program)
  (and
   (natp left-program)
   (natp right-program)
   (q1893717-program-graph-equal-p
    left-program right-program)))

;; A class of codes represents a set of partial functions exactly when it is
;; invariant under equality of the partial input/output relations.

(defun-sk q1893717-extensional-class-p (class)
  (forall (left-program right-program)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-program)
      (natp right-program)
      (q1893717-program-equivalent-p
       left-program right-program))
     (iff
      (q1893717-class-member-p class left-program)
      (q1893717-class-member-p class right-program)))))

;; A decider program is total on program codes and returns the canonical
;; Boolean encoding 1 exactly on members and 0 exactly on nonmembers.

(defun q1893717-decider-entry-p
    (class decider program)
  (if (q1893717-class-member-p class program)
      (q1893717-halts-with-p decider program 1)
    (q1893717-halts-with-p decider program 0)))

(defun-sk q1893717-decider-law-p (class decider)
  (forall (program)
    (implies
     (natp program)
     (q1893717-decider-entry-p
      class decider program))))

(defun q1893717-total-decider-p (class decider)
  (and
   (natp decider)
   (q1893717-decider-law-p class decider)))

(defun-sk q1893717-computable-class-p (class)
  (exists (decider)
    (q1893717-total-decider-p class decider)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1893717-rice-theorem-statement
    (class f-program g-program)
  (implies
   (and
    (q1893717-extensional-class-p class)
    (q1893717-computable-class-p class)
    (natp f-program)
    (natp g-program)
    (q1893717-class-member-p class f-program))
   (q1893717-class-member-p class g-program)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1893717
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1893717), "Rice's theorem": every computably
-- decidable extensional property of partial-recursive natural-number functions
-- that holds for one such function holds for all of them. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1893717_rice_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (lzero; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _<_)

infix 4 _iff_
infix 4 _equivalent_

data Bottom : Set where

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

data Decision (A : Set) : Set where
  yes : A -> Decision A
  no : (A -> Bottom) -> Decision A

-- The square pairing used by the source Nat.Partrec development.
pairNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
pairNat left right with left < right
... | true =
  right * right + left
... | false =
  left * left + left + right

-- Codes for a universal system of partial-recursive natural-number functions.
data Code : Set where
  zeroCode : Code
  successorCode : Code
  leftCode : Code
  rightCode : Code
  pairCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  composeCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  primitiveRecursionCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  minimizationCode : Code -> Code

-- A computable numerical encoding of program codes.
encodeCode : Code -> Nat
encodeCode zeroCode =
  0
encodeCode successorCode =
  1
encodeCode leftCode =
  2
encodeCode rightCode =
  3
encodeCode (pairCode firstCode secondCode) =
  2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode)) + 4
encodeCode (composeCode firstCode secondCode) =
  2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode) + 1) + 4
encodeCode (primitiveRecursionCode firstCode secondCode) =
  (2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode)) + 1) + 4
encodeCode (minimizationCode code) =
  (2 * (2 * encodeCode code + 1) + 1) + 4

-- Relational evaluation represents termination with the displayed result.
data Evaluates : Code -> Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  evaluates-zero :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates zeroCode input zero

  evaluates-successor :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates successorCode input (suc input)

  evaluates-left :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates leftCode (pairNat left right) left

  evaluates-right :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates rightCode (pairNat left right) right

  evaluates-pair :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input firstValue secondValue : Nat} ->
    Evaluates firstCode input firstValue ->
    Evaluates secondCode input secondValue ->
    Evaluates
      (pairCode firstCode secondCode)
      input
      (pairNat firstValue secondValue)

  evaluates-composition :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input intermediate output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates secondCode input intermediate ->
    Evaluates firstCode intermediate output ->
    Evaluates (composeCode firstCode secondCode) input output

  evaluates-primitive-zero :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates baseCode parameter output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter zero)
      output

  evaluates-primitive-successor :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter index previous output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter index)
      previous ->
    Evaluates
      stepCode
      (pairNat parameter (pairNat index previous))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter (suc index))
      output

  evaluates-minimization-zero :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) zero ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      start

  evaluates-minimization-successor :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start nonzeroValue output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) (suc nonzeroValue) ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter (suc start))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      output

PartialFunction : Set (lsuc lzero)
PartialFunction =
  Nat -> Nat -> Set

evaluate : Code -> PartialFunction
evaluate code input output =
  Evaluates code input output

_equivalent_ : PartialFunction -> PartialFunction -> Set
f equivalent g =
  (input output : Nat) ->
  (f input output) iff (g input output)

-- This record represents a subset of extensional partial functions rather
-- than a predicate that can distinguish different graph presentations.
record PartialFunctionProperty : Set (lsuc lzero) where
  constructor function-property
  field
    holds : PartialFunction -> Set
    respects-equivalence :
      {f g : PartialFunction} ->
      f equivalent g ->
      (holds f) iff (holds g)

open PartialFunctionProperty using (holds)

Partrec : PartialFunction -> Set
Partrec function =
  Exists Code
    (\ code -> function equivalent evaluate code)

decisionBit : {A : Set} -> Decision A -> Nat
decisionBit (yes proof) =
  suc zero
decisionBit (no refutation) =
  zero

-- A predicate is computable when it has a decision procedure whose Boolean
-- characteristic function is computed by a partial-recursive program.
record ComputablePredicate (predicate : Code -> Set) : Set where
  constructor computable-predicate
  field
    decide : (code : Code) -> Decision (predicate code)
    characteristicProgram : Code
    computesCharacteristic :
      (code : Code) ->
      (output : Nat) ->
      (Evaluates
        characteristicProgram
        (encodeCode code)
        output)
      iff
      (output == decisionBit (decide code))

RiceTheorem : Set (lsuc lzero)
RiceTheorem =
  (C : PartialFunctionProperty) ->
  ComputablePredicate (\ code -> holds C (evaluate code)) ->
  (f g : PartialFunction) ->
  Partrec f ->
  Partrec g ->
  holds C f ->
  holds C g

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1893717, "Rice's theorem": a computably decidable semantic property of
  unary partial-recursive functions that contains one such function contains
  every unary partial-recursive function. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val _ = Datatype `
  q1893717_code =
      Q1893717Zero
    | Q1893717Succ
    | Q1893717Left
    | Q1893717Right
    | Q1893717Pair q1893717_code q1893717_code
    | Q1893717Comp q1893717_code q1893717_code
    | Q1893717Prec q1893717_code q1893717_code
    | Q1893717Rfind q1893717_code
`;

val q1893717_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q1893717_pair_def",
  ``q1893717_pair a b =
      if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b``
);

val q1893717_encode_def = Define`
  (q1893717_encode Q1893717Zero = 0) /\
  (q1893717_encode Q1893717Succ = 1) /\
  (q1893717_encode Q1893717Left = 2) /\
  (q1893717_encode Q1893717Right = 3) /\
  (q1893717_encode (Q1893717Pair c d) =
     4 * q1893717_pair (q1893717_encode c) (q1893717_encode d) + 4) /\
  (q1893717_encode (Q1893717Comp c d) =
     4 * q1893717_pair (q1893717_encode c) (q1893717_encode d) + 6) /\
  (q1893717_encode (Q1893717Prec c d) =
     4 * q1893717_pair (q1893717_encode c) (q1893717_encode d) + 5) /\
  (q1893717_encode (Q1893717Rfind c) =
     4 * q1893717_encode c + 7)
`;

val (q1893717_eval_rules, q1893717_eval_ind, q1893717_eval_cases) =
  Hol_reln`
    (!n. q1893717_eval Q1893717Zero n 0) /\
    (!n. q1893717_eval Q1893717Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b. q1893717_eval Q1893717Left (q1893717_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b. q1893717_eval Q1893717Right (q1893717_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q1893717_eval c n a /\ q1893717_eval d n b ==>
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717Pair c d) n (q1893717_pair a b)) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q1893717_eval d n a /\ q1893717_eval c a b ==>
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717Comp c d) n b) /\
    (!c d a b.
       q1893717_eval c a b ==>
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717Prec c d) (q1893717_pair a 0) b) /\
    (!c d a n r b.
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717Prec c d) (q1893717_pair a n) r /\
       q1893717_eval d
         (q1893717_pair a (q1893717_pair n r)) b ==>
       q1893717_eval
         (Q1893717Prec c d) (q1893717_pair a (SUC n)) b) /\
    (!c a m.
       q1893717_eval c (q1893717_pair a m) 0 ==>
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717Rfind c) (q1893717_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z r.
       q1893717_eval c (q1893717_pair a m) z /\ z <> 0 /\
       q1893717_eval
         (Q1893717Rfind c) (q1893717_pair a (SUC m)) r ==>
       q1893717_eval (Q1893717Rfind c) (q1893717_pair a m) r)
  `;

val q1893717_partrec_def = new_definition (
  "q1893717_partrec_def",
  ``q1893717_partrec f <=>
      ?program. !x y.
        (f x y <=> q1893717_eval program x y)``
);

val q1893717_computable_pred_def = new_definition (
  "q1893717_computable_pred_def",
  ``q1893717_computable_pred predicate <=>
      ?program. !c y.
        (q1893717_eval program (q1893717_encode c) y <=>
         if predicate c then y = 1 else y = 0)``
);

val q1893717_rice_theorem =
  ``!(C : (num -> num -> bool) -> bool)
      (f g : num -> num -> bool).
      q1893717_computable_pred (\c. C (q1893717_eval c)) /\
      q1893717_partrec f /\
      q1893717_partrec g /\
      C f
      ==>
      C g``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1893717), "Rice's theorem": every
  computably decidable property of partial-recursive program behavior that
  holds of one partial-recursive natural partial function holds of every such
  function. This file contains no proof.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Nat.Partrec.Code is represented through its canonical bijection with NN0.
  Under this bijection the constructors have codes 0, 1, 2, 3,
  4*pair(c,d)+4, 4*pair(c,d)+6, 4*pair(c,d)+5, and 4*c+7. Q1893717Pair is
  Mathlib's exact Nat.pair function.

  Q1893717Eval c n y is the least relation closed under the operational rules
  for zero, successor, projections, pairing, composition, primitive
  recursion, and minimization. Thus it says that eval c n terminates with y.

  Q1893717Graph c is the graph of the partial function evaluated by c.
  Q1893717PFun is the full set of partial functions from NN0 to NN0, encoded
  as single-valued relations. Q1893717Partrec f says that f is the graph of
  some program code. Q1893717ComputablePred C says that membership of an
  evaluated graph in C is decided by a total program with Boolean outputs,
  where false and true are represented by 0 and 1.

  The final declaration preserves the arbitrary set C and the internal
  program witnesses for partial recursiveness and decidability. All auxiliary
  $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions; the final $a is the
  single unproved corpus statement, and this database has no $p declaration.
$)

$c Q1893717CodePrec Q1893717CodeRfind $.

                            A. v e. NN0
                              (

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1893717,
:: "Rice's theorem": every computably decidable property of unary partial
:: recursive functions that contains one such function contains all of them.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, INT_1,
      XCMPLX_0, CARD_1, SETFAM_1, XXREAL_0;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0,
      NAT_1, NAT_D, SETFAM_1, XXREAL_0;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_D,
      SETFAM_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Eval being set,
      C being Subset of PFuncs(NAT,NAT),
      f,g being PartFunc of NAT,NAT st
    Eval =
      meet {R where R is Subset of [:[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:] :
        (for x being Nat holds [[0,x],0] in R) &
        (for x being Nat holds [[1,x],x+1] in R) &
        (for a,b being Nat holds
          [[2,(((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b],a] in R) &
        (for a,b being Nat holds
          [[3,(((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b],b] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,x,y,z being Nat st
          [[cf,x],y] in R & [[cg,x],z] in R
         holds
          [[4*((((cf+cg)*(cf+cg+1)) div 2)+cg)+4,x],
            (((y+z)*(y+z+1)) div 2)+z] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,x,y,z being Nat st
          [[cg,x],y] in R & [[cf,y],z] in R
         holds
          [[4*((((cf+cg)*(cf+cg+1)) div 2)+cg)+6,x],z] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,a,y being Nat st [[cf,a],y] in R
         holds
          [[4*((((cf+cg)*(cf+cg+1)) div 2)+cg)+5,
            (((a+0)*(a+0+1)) div 2)+0],y] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,a,k,i,y being Nat st
          [[4*((((cf+cg)*(cf+cg+1)) div 2)+cg)+5,
            (((a+k)*(a+k+1)) div 2)+k],i] in R &
          [[cg,
            (((a+((((k+i)*(k+i+1)) div 2)+i))*
              (a+((((k+i)*(k+i+1)) div 2)+i)+1)) div 2)+
                (((k+i)*(k+i+1)) div 2)+i],y] in R
         holds
          [[4*((((cf+cg)*(cf+cg+1)) div 2)+cg)+5,
            (((a+(k+1))*(a+(k+1)+1)) div 2)+(k+1)],y] in R) &
        (for cf,a,m,n being Nat st
          [[cf,
            (((a+(n+m))*(a+(n+m)+1)) div 2)+(n+m)],0] in R &
          (for k being Nat st k < n holds
            ex z being Nat st z <> 0 &
              [[cf,
                (((a+(k+m))*(a+(k+m)+1)) div 2)+(k+m)],z] in R)
         holds
          [[4*cf+7,(((a+m)*(a+m+1)) div 2)+m],n+m] in R)} &
    (ex p being Nat st
      for c being Nat holds
        ex b being Nat st
          (b = 0 or b = 1) &
          [[p,c],b] in Eval &
          ((ex h being PartFunc of NAT,NAT st
              h in C &
              (for x,y being Nat holds
                ([x,y] in h iff [[c,x],y] in Eval)))
            iff b = 1)) &
    (ex cf being Nat st
      for x,y being Nat holds
        ([x,y] in f iff [[cf,x],y] in Eval)) &
    (ex cg being Nat st
      for x,y being Nat holds
        ([x,y] in g iff [[cg,x],y] in Eval)) &
    f in C
  holds g in C
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1893717_rice_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1893717,
% "Rice's theorem": a computable property of program denotations that contains one
% partial-recursive natural-number function contains every such function. This file
% contains no proof.

rice_partial_value_Q1893717: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  rice_undefined: rice_undefined?
  rice_defined(rice_value: nat): rice_defined?
END rice_partial_value_Q1893717

rice_code_Q1893717: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  rice_zero_code: rice_zero_code?
  rice_succ_code: rice_succ_code?
  rice_left_code: rice_left_code?
  rice_right_code: rice_right_code?
  rice_pair_code(
    rice_pair_left,
    rice_pair_right: rice_code_Q1893717): rice_pair_code?
  rice_comp_code(
    rice_comp_outer,
    rice_comp_inner: rice_code_Q1893717): rice_comp_code?
  rice_prec_code(
    rice_prec_base,
    rice_prec_step: rice_code_Q1893717): rice_prec_code?
  rice_rfind_code(
    rice_rfind_body: rice_code_Q1893717): rice_rfind_code?
END rice_code_Q1893717

Q1893717_rice_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING rice_partial_value_Q1893717, rice_code_Q1893717

  code: TYPE = rice_code_Q1893717
  partial_value: TYPE = rice_partial_value_Q1893717
  partial_nat_function: TYPE = [nat -> partial_value]
  function_class: TYPE = [partial_nat_function -> bool]
  code_property: TYPE = [code -> bool]
  evaluation_relation: TYPE = [code, nat, nat -> bool]

  nat_pair(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left < right THEN
      right * right + left
    ELSE
      left * left + left + right
    ENDIF

  code_encode(program: code): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES program OF
      rice_zero_code: 0,
      rice_succ_code: 1,
      rice_left_code: 2,
      rice_right_code: 3,
      rice_pair_code(left_program, right_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(left_program),
          code_encode(right_program))) + 4,
      rice_comp_code(outer_program, inner_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(outer_program),
          code_encode(inner_program)) + 1) + 4,
      rice_prec_code(base_program, step_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(base_program),
          code_encode(step_program))) + 1 + 4,
      rice_rfind_code(body_program):
        2 * (2 * code_encode(body_program) + 1) + 1 + 4
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE program BY <<

  evaluator_closed(candidate: evaluation_relation): bool =
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(rice_zero_code, input, 0))
    AND
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(rice_succ_code, input, input + 1))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(rice_left_code, nat_pair(left, right), left))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(rice_right_code, nat_pair(left, right), right))
    AND
    (FORALL (left_program, right_program: code),
            (input, left_value, right_value: nat):
      (candidate(left_program, input, left_value)
        AND candidate(right_program, input, right_value))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          rice_pair_code(left_program, right_program),
          input,
          nat_pair(left_value, right_value)))
    AND
    (FORALL (outer_program, inner_program: code),
            (input, intermediate, output: nat):
      (candidate(inner_program, input, intermediate)
        AND candidate(outer_program, intermediate, output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          rice_comp_code(outer_program, inner_program),
          input,
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, output: nat):
      candidate(base_program, parameter, output)
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          rice_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, 0),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, index, previous, output: nat):
      (candidate(
          rice_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index),
          previous)
        AND candidate(
          step_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, nat_pair(index, previous)),
          output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          rice_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index + 1),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (body_program: code),
            (parameter, start, offset: nat):
      (candidate(
          body_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, start + offset),
          0)
        AND
          (FORALL (earlier: nat):
            earlier < offset IMPLIES
              EXISTS (nonzero_value: nat):
                candidate(
                  body_program,
                  nat_pair(parameter, start + earlier),
                  nonzero_value)
                  AND nonzero_value /= 0))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          rice_rfind_code(body_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, start),
          start + offset))

  evaluates(program: code, input, output: nat): bool =
    FORALL (candidate: evaluation_relation):
      evaluator_closed(candidate)
      IMPLIES candidate(program, input, output)

  computes(
    program: code,
    fn: partial_nat_function): bool =
    FORALL (input, output: nat):
      evaluates(program, input, output)
        IFF fn(input) = rice_defined(output)

  partial_recursive(fn: partial_nat_function): bool =
    EXISTS (program: code):
      computes(program, fn)

  code_in_class(program: code, C: function_class): bool =
    EXISTS (fn: partial_nat_function):
      computes(program, fn)
        AND C(fn)

  decides(decider: code, property: code_property): bool =
    FORALL (source: code), (output: nat):
      evaluates(decider, code_encode(source), output)
        IFF
          ((property(source) AND output = 1)
            OR ((NOT property(source)) AND output = 0))

  computable_predicate(property: code_property): bool =
    EXISTS (decider: code):
      decides(decider, property)

  rice: bool =
    FORALL (C: function_class),
           (f, g: partial_nat_function):
      (computable_predicate(
          LAMBDA (program: code):
            code_in_class(program, C))
        AND partial_recursive(f)
        AND partial_recursive(g)
        AND C(f))
      IMPLIES C(g)
END Q1893717_rice_s_theorem

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190391
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q190391), "Central limit theorem": independent
  identically distributed real random variables with a finite second moment
  have centered sums, scaled by the inverse square root of the sample size,
  converging in distribution to the centered Gaussian with their variance.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals RiemannInt List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q190391_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q190391_empty {A : Type} : q190391_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q190391_full {A : Type} : q190391_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q190391_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q190391_set A) : q190391_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q190391_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q190391_set A) : q190391_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q190391_preimage {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (E : q190391_set B) : q190391_set A :=
  fun x => E (f x).

Definition q190391_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q190391_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q190391_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q190391_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q190391_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q190391_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q190391_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Fixpoint q190391_sum_first
    (n : nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q190391_sum_first k f + f k
  end.

Definition q190391_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q190391_series_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (sum : R) : Prop :=
  q190391_sequence_converges
    (fun n => q190391_sum_first n u) sum.

Definition q190391_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q190391_set (q190391_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q190391_empty /\
  (forall E : q190391_set A,
    C E -> C (q190391_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q190391_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q190391_countable_union E)).

Definition q190391_open_real_set
    (U : q190391_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q190391_borel_set
    (E : q190391_set R) : Prop :=
  forall C : q190391_set (q190391_set R),
    q190391_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q190391_set R,
      q190391_open_real_set U -> C U) ->
    C E.

Record q190391_probability_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q190391_measurable : q190391_set A -> Prop;
  q190391_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q190391_set A,
      q190391_same_set E F ->
      (q190391_measurable E <-> q190391_measurable F);
  q190391_measurable_empty :
    q190391_measurable q190391_empty;
  q190391_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q190391_set A,
      q190391_measurable E ->
      q190391_measurable (q190391_complement E);
  q190391_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q190391_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q190391_measurable (E n)) ->
      q190391_measurable (q190391_countable_union E);
  q190391_measure : q190391_set A -> R;
  q190391_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q190391_set A,
      q190391_same_set E F ->
      q190391_measure E = q190391_measure F;
  q190391_measure_nonnegative :
    forall E : q190391_set A,
      q190391_measurable E ->
      0 <= q190391_measure E;
  q190391_measure_empty :
    q190391_measure q190391_empty = 0;
  q190391_measure_total :
    q190391_measure q190391_full = 1;
  q190391_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q190391_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q190391_measurable (E n)) ->
      q190391_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q190391_series_sum
        (fun n => q190391_measure (E n))
        (q190391_measure (q190391_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q190391_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q190391_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q190391_measurable_real_function {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall B : q190391_set R,
    q190391_borel_set B ->
    q190391_measurable P (q190391_preimage f B).

Definition q190391_almost_everywhere_equal {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f g : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q190391_set A,
    q190391_measurable P null_set /\
    q190391_measure P null_set = 0 /\
    forall x : A, ~ null_set x -> f x = g x.

Definition q190391_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q190391_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q190391_measurable P (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q190391_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q190391_simple_integral_below {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> R)
         (cells : nat -> q190391_set A),
    q190391_finite_partition P k cells /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat -> 0 <= coefficients i) /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      coefficients i <= f x) /\
    value =
      q190391_sum_first k
        (fun i => coefficients i * q190391_measure P (cells i)).

Definition q190391_least_upper_bound
    (values : R -> Prop) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  (forall value : R, values value -> value <= bound) /\
  (forall upper : R,
    (forall value : R, values value -> value <= upper) ->
    bound <= upper).

Definition q190391_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  q190391_least_upper_bound
    (q190391_simple_integral_below P f) value.

Definition q190391_positive_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax x 0.

Definition q190391_negative_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax (- x) 0.

Definition q190391_has_finite_lebesgue_integral {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  q190391_measurable_real_function P f /\
  exists positive_integral negative_integral : R,
    q190391_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral P
      (fun x => q190391_positive_part (f x))
      positive_integral /\
    q190391_nonnegative_lebesgue_integral P
      (fun x => q190391_negative_part (f x))
      negative_integral /\
    value = positive_integral - negative_integral.

Definition q190391_has_expectation {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) (mean : R) : Prop :=
  exists representative : A -> R,
    q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P f representative /\
    q190391_has_finite_lebesgue_integral P representative mean.

Definition q190391_mem_L2 {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists (representative : A -> R) (second_moment : R),
    q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P f representative /\
    q190391_measurable_real_function P representative /\
    q190391_has_finite_lebesgue_integral P
      (fun x => (representative x) ^ 2) second_moment.

Definition q190391_has_mean_and_variance {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f : A -> R) (mean variance : R) : Prop :=
  q190391_has_expectation P f mean /\
  q190391_has_expectation P
    (fun x => (f x - mean) ^ 2) variance.

Fixpoint q190391_finite_intersection {A : Type}
    (X : nat -> A -> R) (indices : list nat)
    (events : nat -> q190391_set R) : q190391_set A :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q190391_full
  | i :: rest =>
      fun x =>
        events i (X i x) /\
        q190391_finite_intersection X rest events x
  end.

Fixpoint q190391_finite_product
    (indices : list nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match indices with
  | nil => 1
  | i :: rest => f i * q190391_finite_product rest f
  end.

Definition q190391_independent_random_variables {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (X : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists representative : nat -> A -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      q190391_measurable_real_function P (representative n) /\
      q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P (X n) (representative n)) /\
    forall (indices : list nat)
           (events : nat -> q190391_set R),
      NoDup indices ->
      (forall i : nat,
        In i indices -> q190391_borel_set (events i)) ->
      q190391_measure P
        (q190391_finite_intersection representative indices events) =
      q190391_finite_product indices
        (fun i =>
          q190391_measure P
            (q190391_preimage (representative i) (events i))).

Definition q190391_identically_distributed {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (f g : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists f_representative g_representative : A -> R,
    q190391_measurable_real_function P f_representative /\
    q190391_measurable_real_function P g_representative /\
    q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P f f_representative /\
    q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P g g_representative /\
    forall B : q190391_set R,
      q190391_borel_set B ->
      q190391_measure P (q190391_preimage f_representative B) =
      q190391_measure P (q190391_preimage g_representative B).

Definition q190391_has_riemann_integral
    (f : R -> R) (a b value : R) : Prop :=
  exists integrable : Riemann_integrable f a b,
    @RiemannInt f a b integrable = value.

Definition q190391_tends_to_at_negative_infinity
    (f : R -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists cutoff : R,
      forall x : R,
        x <= cutoff ->
        Rabs (f x - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q190391_gaussian_density
    (mean variance x : R) : R :=
  exp (- ((x - mean) ^ 2) / (2 * variance)) /
  sqrt (2 * PI * variance).

Definition q190391_gaussian_cdf_value
    (mean variance t value : R) : Prop :=
  (variance = 0 /\
    value = if Rle_dec mean t then 1 else 0) \/
  (0 < variance /\
    exists finite_integral : R -> R,
      (forall a : R,
        q190391_has_riemann_integral
          (q190391_gaussian_density mean variance)
          a t (finite_integral a)) /\
      q190391_tends_to_at_negative_infinity
        finite_integral value).

Definition q190391_has_gaussian_law {A : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (Y : A -> R) (mean variance : R) : Prop :=
  exists representative : A -> R,
    q190391_measurable_real_function P representative /\
    q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P Y representative /\
    forall t : R,
      exists value : R,
        q190391_gaussian_cdf_value mean variance t value /\
        q190391_measure P
          (fun x => representative x <= t) = value.

Definition q190391_continuous_at
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs (f y - f x) < epsilon.

Definition q190391_tendsto_in_distribution {A B : Type}
    (P : q190391_probability_space A)
    (P' : q190391_probability_space B)
    (Z : nat -> A -> R) (Y : B -> R) : Prop :=
  exists (Z_representative : nat -> A -> R)
         (Y_representative : B -> R),
    (forall n : nat,
      q190391_measurable_real_function P (Z_representative n) /\
      q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P
        (Z n) (Z_representative n)) /\
    q190391_measurable_real_function P' Y_representative /\
    q190391_almost_everywhere_equal P' Y Y_representative /\
    forall t : R,
      q190391_continuous_at
        (fun s =>
          q190391_measure P'
            (fun x => Y_representative x <= s)) t ->
      q190391_sequence_converges
        (fun n =>
          q190391_measure P
            (fun x => Z_representative n x <= t))
        (q190391_measure P'
          (fun x => Y_representative x <= t)).

Theorem Q190391_canonical_statement :
  forall (Omega Omega' : Type)
         (P : q190391_probability_space Omega)
         (P' : q190391_probability_space Omega')
         (X : nat -> Omega -> R)
         (Y : Omega' -> R),
    q190391_mem_L2 P (X O) ->
    q190391_independent_random_variables P X ->
    (forall i : nat,
      q190391_identically_distributed P (X i) (X O)) ->
    forall mean variance : R,
      q190391_has_mean_and_variance P (X O) mean variance ->
      q190391_has_gaussian_law P' Y 0 variance ->
      q190391_tendsto_in_distribution P P'
        (fun (n : nat) (omega : Omega) =>
          / sqrt (INR n) *
          (q190391_sum_first n (fun k => X k omega) -
           INR n * mean))
        Y.
Admitted.

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q190391
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q190391), "Central limit theorem": independent
  identically distributed real random variables with a finite second moment,
  centered and scaled by the square root of the sample size, converge in
  distribution to the centered Gaussian law with their common variance. This
  includes the zero-variance case. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q190391_central_limit_theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral"
    "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition q190391_probability_measure :: "'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_probability_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
      emeasure M (space M) = 1"

definition q190391_measurable_representative ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_measurable_representative M f g \<longleftrightarrow>
      g \<in> borel_measurable M \<and> (AE x in M. f x = g x)"

definition q190391_has_law ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_has_law M f \<mu> \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>g. q190391_measurable_representative M f g \<and>
        distr M borel g = \<mu>)"

definition q190391_identically_distributed ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_identically_distributed M f g \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>f' g'.
        q190391_measurable_representative M f f' \<and>
        q190391_measurable_representative M g g' \<and>
        distr M borel f' = distr M borel g')"

definition q190391_mem_L2 ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_mem_L2 M f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>g. q190391_measurable_representative M f g \<and>
        integrable M (\<lambda>x. (g x)\<^sup>2))"

definition q190391_measurable_version ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "q190391_measurable_version M f =
      (SOME g. q190391_measurable_representative M f g)"

definition q190391_event ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q190391_event M f A = f -` A \<inter> space M"

definition q190391_joint_event ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      nat set \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> real set) \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q190391_joint_event M X J A =
      {\<omega> \<in> space M. \<forall>j\<in>J. X j \<omega> \<in> A j}"

definition q190391_independent ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_independent M X \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>X'.
        (\<forall>n. q190391_measurable_representative M (X n) (X' n)) \<and>
        (\<forall>J::nat set.
          finite J \<longrightarrow> J \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>A::nat \<Rightarrow> real set.
            (\<forall>j\<in>J. A j \<in> sets borel) \<longrightarrow>
            measure M (q190391_joint_event M X' J A) =
              prod
                (\<lambda>j. measure M (q190391_event M (X' j) (A j)))
                J)))"

definition q190391_expectation ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "q190391_expectation M f =
      integral\<^sup>L M (q190391_measurable_version M f)"

definition q190391_variance ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "q190391_variance M f =
      integral\<^sup>L M
        (\<lambda>x.
          (q190391_measurable_version M f x -
            q190391_expectation M f)\<^sup>2)"

definition q190391_standard_normal :: "real measure"
  where
    "q190391_standard_normal =
      density (lborel :: real measure)
        (\<lambda>x. ennreal
          ((1 / sqrt (2 * pi)) * exp (-(x\<^sup>2) / 2)))"

definition q190391_gaussian_real :: "real \<Rightarrow> real measure"
  where
    "q190391_gaussian_real v =
      distr q190391_standard_normal borel
        (\<lambda>z. sqrt (max v 0) * z)"

definition q190391_weak_convergence ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> real measure) \<Rightarrow> real measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_weak_convergence Ms M \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x.
        isCont (\<lambda>t. measure M {..t}) x \<longrightarrow>
        (\<lambda>n. measure (Ms n) {..x})
          \<longlonglongrightarrow> measure M {..x})"

definition q190391_tendsto_in_distribution ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      'b measure \<Rightarrow> ('b \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q190391_tendsto_in_distribution M Z N Y \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>Z' Y'.
        (\<forall>n. q190391_measurable_representative M (Z n) (Z' n)) \<and>
        q190391_measurable_representative N Y Y' \<and>
        q190391_weak_convergence
          (\<lambda>n. distr M borel (Z' n))
          (distr N borel Y'))"

theorem central_limit_theorem:
  fixes P :: "'a measure"
    and P' :: "'b measure"
    and X :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and Y :: "'b \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes P_probability: "q190391_probability_measure P"
    and P'_probability: "q190391_probability_measure P'"
    and Y_law:
      "q190391_has_law P' Y
        (q190391_gaussian_real (q190391_variance P (X 0)))"
    and X_second_moment: "q190391_mem_L2 P (X 0)"
    and X_independent: "q190391_independent P X"
    and X_identically_distributed:
      "\<And>i. q190391_identically_distributed P (X i) (X 0)"
  shows
    "q190391_tendsto_in_distribution P
      (\<lambda>n \<omega>.
        inverse (sqrt (real n)) *
          ((\<Sum>k<n. X k \<omega>) -
            real n * q190391_expectation P (X 0)))
      P' Y"
  sorry

end

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190391,
  "Central limit theorem": independent identically distributed real random
  variables with a finite second moment have inverse-square-root normalized
  centered partial sums converging in distribution to a centered Gaussian
  random variable with the same variance, including the zero-variance case.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let q190391_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q190391_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q190391_output;;
let q190391_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q190391_formatter path);;
let q190391_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q190391_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q190391_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q190391_formatter ();;
close_out q190391_output;;
if not q190391_loaded then failwith "Q190391: failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let Q190391_CENTRAL_LIMIT_THEOREM = `
  let seq_tends = \a l.
    !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(a n - l) < e in
  let sigma_space = \events:(A->bool)->bool.
    events UNIV /\
    (!s. events s ==> events (UNIV DIFF s)) /\
    (!s:num->A->bool. (!n. events (s n)) ==>
      events {x | ?n. x IN s n}) in
  let sigma_space' = \events:(B->bool)->bool.
    events UNIV /\
    (!s. events s ==> events (UNIV DIFF s)) /\
    (!s:num->B->bool. (!n. events (s n)) ==>
      events {x | ?n. x IN s n}) in
  let real_open = \u:real->bool.
    !x. x IN u ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
      !y. abs(y - x) < d ==> y IN u in
  let sigma_real = \events:(real->bool)->bool.
    events UNIV /\
    (!s. events s ==> events (UNIV DIFF s)) /\
    (!s:num->real->bool. (!n. events (s n)) ==>
      events {x | ?n. x IN s n}) in
  let real_events = \s:real->bool.
    !events. sigma_real events /\
      (!u. real_open u ==> events u) ==> events s in
  let probability = \events:(A->bool)->bool p.
    sigma_space events /\
    p UNIV = &1 /\
    (!s. events s ==> &0 <= p s) /\
    (!s:num->A->bool.
      (!n. events (s n)) /\
      (!i j. ~(i = j) ==> DISJOINT (s i) (s j))
      ==> seq_tends
            (\n. sum (0..n) (\k. p (s k)))
            (p {x | ?k. x IN s k})) in
  let probability' = \events:(B->bool)->bool p.
    sigma_space' events /\
    p UNIV = &1 /\
    (!s. events s ==> &0 <= p s) /\
    (!s:num->B->bool.
      (!n. events (s n)) /\
      (!i j. ~(i = j) ==> DISJOINT (s i) (s j))
      ==> seq_tends
            (\n. sum (0..n) (\k. p (s k)))
            (p {x | ?k. x IN s k})) in
  let probability_real = \p:(real->bool)->real.
    sigma_real real_events /\
    p UNIV = &1 /\
    (!s. real_events s ==> &0 <= p s) /\
    (!s:num->real->bool.
      (!n. real_events (s n)) /\
      (!i j. ~(i = j) ==> DISJOINT (s i) (s j))
      ==> seq_tends
            (\n. sum (0..n) (\k. p (s k)))
            (p {x | ?k. x IN s k})) in
  let measurable = \events:(A->bool)->bool f:A->real.
    !s. real_events s ==> events {x | f x IN s} in
  let measurable' = \events:(B->bool)->bool f:B->real.
    !s. real_events s ==> events {x | f x IN s} in
  let ae_equal = \events:(A->bool)->bool p f g.
    ?n. events n /\ p n = &0 /\
      !x. ~(x IN n) ==> f x = g x in
  let ae_equal' = \events:(B->bool)->bool p f g.
    ?n. events n /\ p n = &0 /\
      !x. ~(x IN n) ==> f x = g x in
  let map_law = \events:(A->bool)->bool p f law.
    probability_real law /\
    ?g. measurable events g /\ ae_equal events p f g /\
      !s. real_events s ==> law s = p {x | g x IN s} in
  let map_law' = \events:(B->bool)->bool p f law.
    probability_real law /\
    ?g. measurable' events g /\ ae_equal' events p f g /\
      !s. real_events s ==> law s = p {x | g x IN s} in
  let simple_scalar = \s:real->real.
    FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
    !c. real_events {x | s x = c} in
  let integrable_simple_scalar =
      \law:(real->bool)->real s:real->real.
    simple_scalar s /\
    !x. &0 <= s x in
  let simple_scalar_integral =
      \law:(real->bool)->real s:real->real.
    @z. ?values.
      FINITE values /\
      IMAGE s UNIV SUBSET values /\
      z = sum values (\c. c * law {x | s x = c}) in
  let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
      \law:(real->bool)->real h:real->real b.
    !s. integrable_simple_scalar law s /\
      (!x. s x <= h x)
      ==> simple_scalar_integral law s <= b in
  let has_nonnegative_integral =
      \law:(real->bool)->real h:real->real i.
    (!x. &0 <= h x) /\
    nonnegative_integral_upper_bound law h i /\
    !b. nonnegative_integral_upper_bound law h b ==> i <= b in
  let strongly_measurable_scalar = \h:real->real.
    ?s:num->real->real.
      (!n. simple_scalar (s n)) /\
      !x. seq_tends (\n. s n x) (h x) in
  let almost_everywhere =
      \law:(real->bool)->real predicate:real->bool.
    ?n. real_events n /\ law n = &0 /\
      {x | ~(predicate x)} SUBSET n in
  let ae_strongly_measurable =
      \law:(real->bool)->real h:real->real.
    ?g. strongly_measurable_scalar g /\
      almost_everywhere law (\x. h x = g x) in
  let positive_part = \x. max x (&0) in
  let negative_part = \x. max (--x) (&0) in
  let scalar_integrable = \law:(real->bool)->real h:real->real.
    ae_strongly_measurable law h /\
    (?ip. has_nonnegative_integral law (\x. positive_part (h x)) ip) /\
    (?ineg. has_nonnegative_integral law (\x. negative_part (h x)) ineg) in
  let has_real_integral =
      \law:(real->bool)->real h:real->real i.
    ?ip ineg.
      has_nonnegative_integral law (\x. positive_part (h x)) ip /\
      has_nonnegative_integral law (\x. negative_part (h x)) ineg /\
      i = ip - ineg in
  let real_integral = \law:(real->bool)->real h:real->real.
    if scalar_integrable law h
    then @i. has_real_integral law h i
    else &0 in
  let l2_law = \law:(real->bool)->real.
    scalar_integrable law (\x. x) /\
    scalar_integrable law (\x. x pow 2) /\
    (let m = real_integral law (\x. x) in
     scalar_integrable law (\x. (x - m) pow 2)) in
  let mem_l2 = \events:(A->bool)->bool p f:A->real.
    ?law. map_law events p f law /\ l2_law law in
  let ident_distrib = \events:(A->bool)->bool p f g.
    ?law. map_law events p f law /\ map_law events p g law in
  let independent_sequence =
      \events:(A->bool)->bool p X:num->A->real.
    ?V:num->A->real.
      (!i. measurable events (V i) /\ ae_equal events p (X i) (V i)) /\
      !inds sets.
        FINITE (inds:num->bool) /\
        (!i. i IN inds ==> real_events (sets i))
        ==> p (INTERS (IMAGE (\i. {x | V i x IN sets i}) inds)) =
            product inds (\i. p {x | V i x IN sets i}) in
  let continuous_real = \h:real->real.
    !x e. &0 < e ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
      !y. abs(y - x) < d ==> abs(h y - h x) < e in
  let bounded_continuous = \h:real->real.
    continuous_real h /\ ?c. !x. abs(h x) <= c in
  let weak_tends =
      \laws:num->(real->bool)->real limit:(real->bool)->real.
    (!n. probability_real (laws n)) /\
    probability_real limit /\
    !h. bounded_continuous h ==>
      seq_tends
        (\n. real_integral (laws n) h)
        (real_integral limit h) in
  let centered_gaussian = \law:(real->bool)->real variance.
    probability_real law /\
    &0 <= variance /\
    !t.
      real_integral law (\x. cos(t * x)) =
        exp (--(variance * t pow 2) / &2) /\
      real_integral law (\x. sin(t * x)) = &0 in
  let has_centered_gaussian_law =
      \events:(B->bool)->bool p Y:B->real variance.
    ?law. map_law' events p Y law /\ centered_gaussian law variance in
  let tends_in_distribution =
      \events:(A->bool)->bool p f:num->A->real
       events':(B->bool)->bool p' Y:B->real.
    ?laws limit.
      (!n. map_law events p (f n) (laws n)) /\
      map_law' events' p' Y limit /\
      weak_tends laws limit in
  !events:(A->bool)->bool p:(A->bool)->real
   events':(B->bool)->bool p':(B->bool)->real
   X:num->A->real Y:B->real.
    probability events p /\ probability' events' p'
    ==>
    let law0 = @law. map_law events p (X 0) law /\ l2_law law in
    let mean = real_integral law0 (\x. x) in
    let variance = real_integral law0 (\x. (x - mean) pow 2) in
    has_centered_gaussian_law events' p' Y variance /\
    mem_l2 events p (X 0) /\
    independent_sequence events p X /\
    (!i. ident_distrib events p (X i) (X 0))
    ==>
    tends_in_distribution
      events p
      (\n x.
        inv(sqrt(&n)) *
        (sum {k | k < n} (\k. X k x) - &n * mean))
      events' p' Y
`;;

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q190391,
;; "Central limit theorem": square-integrable independent identically
;; distributed real random variables have centered partial sums, normalized
;; by the square root of the sample size, converging in distribution to a
;; centered Gaussian variable with the variance of the first summand,
;; including the zero-variance case. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, functions, sigma algebras, and operations are tame APPLY$
;; function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification, and
;; inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal existential
;; witnesses. The scalar structure is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence
;; a presentation of the real field. The measure on an arbitrary subset is
;; characterized as the infimum of the measures of its measurable supersets,
;; so null exceptional sets use outer-measure semantics. Measurability is
;; defined through upper-ray preimages, lintegral is the supremum of integrals
;; of measurable finite-range simple functions below the integrand, and the
;; real integral is defined from positive and negative parts. Weak convergence
;; is rendered by its equivalent bounded-continuous-test-function
;; characterization along the sequential filter.

(defun q190391-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q190391-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q190391-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q190391-quoted nil)))

(defun q190391-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (q190391-term-list arguments)))

(defun q190391-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q190391-apply-term
   (q190391-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q190391-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q190391-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q190391-quoted nil))
    (q190391-quoted t)))

(defun q190391-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q190391-quoted t)
            (q190391-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q190391-quoted nil)))

(defun q190391-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q190391-quoted nil)
        (q190391-quoted t)))

(defun q190391-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q190391-quoted t)))

(defun q190391-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q190391-quoted t)
              (q190391-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q190391-quoted nil)
              (q190391-quoted t))))

(defun q190391-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q190391-quoted t)))

(defun q190391-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q190391-quoted nil)))

(defun q190391-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q190391-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q190391-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (q190391-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q190391-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q190391-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q190391-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))
