;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, used as an abstract presentation of R.

(defun q190391-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((xy-add (q190391-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add (q190391-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul (q190391-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul (q190391-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q190391-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (q190391-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q190391-implies-term
      (q190391-and-terms
       (list
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q190391-and-terms
       (list
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q190391-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (q190391-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (q190391-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q190391-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q190391-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q190391-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q190391-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q190391-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (q190391-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (q190391-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q190391-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q190391-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (q190391-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q190391-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q190391-quoted zero)))
        (q190391-implies-term
         (q190391-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q190391-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q190391-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q190391-quoted one)))
        (list 'equal
              (q190391-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (q190391-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q190391-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q190391-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q190391-order-laws-function
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (let ((xy (q190391-static-apply-term less '(x y)))
        (yx (q190391-static-apply-term less '(y x)))
        (yz (q190391-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q190391-implies-term
      (q190391-and-terms
       (list
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q190391-and-terms
       (list
        (q190391-not-term
         (q190391-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q190391-or-terms
         (list xy yx (list 'equal 'x 'y)))
        (q190391-implies-term
         (q190391-and-terms (list xy yz))
         (q190391-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q190391-implies-term
         xy
         (q190391-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q190391-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q190391-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q190391-implies-term
         (q190391-and-terms
          (list
           (q190391-static-apply-term
            less (list (q190391-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q190391-static-apply-term
            less (list (q190391-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q190391-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q190391-quoted zero)
           (q190391-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))))))))))

(defun q190391-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q190391-implies-term
    (q190391-and-terms
     (list
      (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q190391-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q190391-not-term
     (q190391-static-apply-term
      less (list (q190391-quoted upper) 'x))))))

(defun q190391-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set upper)
  (and
   (q190391-member-p carrier upper)
   (q190391-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q190391-universal-p
    (q190391-upper-bound-function carrier less set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun q190391-set-nonempty-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q190391-and-terms
    (list
     (q190391-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q190391-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun q190391-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (q190391-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q190391-exists-p
    (q190391-set-nonempty-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun q190391-bounded-above-function
    (carrier less set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'q190391-upper-bound-p
         (q190391-quoted carrier)
         (q190391-quoted less)
         (q190391-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun q190391-bounded-above-p (carrier less set)
  (q190391-exists-p
   (q190391-bounded-above-function carrier less set)
   '(upper)))

(defun q190391-least-upper-bound-function
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (q190391-implies-term
    (list 'q190391-upper-bound-p
          (q190391-quoted carrier)
          (q190391-quoted less)
          (q190391-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (q190391-not-term
     (q190391-static-apply-term
      less (list 'upper (q190391-quoted supremum)))))))

(defun q190391-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (q190391-upper-bound-p carrier less set supremum)
   (q190391-universal-p
    (q190391-least-upper-bound-function
     carrier less set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun q190391-completeness-function
    (carrier less supremum-operation)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q190391-implies-term
    (q190391-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'q190391-valid-set-p
            (q190391-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'q190391-set-nonempty-p
            (q190391-quoted carrier) 'set)
      (list 'q190391-bounded-above-p
            (q190391-quoted carrier)
            (q190391-quoted less)
            'set)))
    (list 'q190391-least-upper-bound-p
          (q190391-quoted carrier)
          (q190391-quoted less)
          'set
          (q190391-static-apply-term
           supremum-operation '(set))))))

(defun q190391-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less supremum)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (tamep-functionp supremum)
   (q190391-member-p carrier zero)
   (q190391-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q190391-universal-p
    (q190391-field-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))
   (q190391-universal-p
    (q190391-order-laws-function
     carrier zero add multiply less)
    '(x y z))
   (q190391-universal-p
    (q190391-completeness-function
     carrier less supremum)
    '(set))
   (q190391-binary-value less zero one)))

(defun q190391-scalar-absolute-value
    (less zero negate value)
  (if (q190391-binary-value less value zero)
      (q190391-unary-value negate value)
    value))

;; Extended nonnegative reals and countable sums.

(defun q190391-ennreal-p
    (value scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)
  (or
   (equal value :q190391-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q190391-finite)
    (q190391-member-p scalar-carrier (cdr value))
    (not
     (q190391-binary-value scalar-less (cdr value) scalar-zero)))))

(defun q190391-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q190391-finite value))

(defun q190391-ennreal-zero (scalar-zero)
  (q190391-ennreal-finite scalar-zero))

(defun q190391-ennreal-less-p (left right scalar-less)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q190391-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q190391-top) t)
   (t
    (q190391-binary-value scalar-less (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q190391-ennreal-less-equal-p (left right scalar-less)
  (not (q190391-ennreal-less-p right left scalar-less)))

(defun q190391-ennreal-add (left right scalar-add)
  (if (or (equal left :q190391-top)
          (equal right :q190391-top))
      :q190391-top
    (q190391-ennreal-finite
     (q190391-binary-value scalar-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q190391-ennreal-multiply
    (left right scalar-zero scalar-multiply)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q190391-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
        (equal right (q190391-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)))
    (q190391-ennreal-zero scalar-zero))
   ((or (equal left :q190391-top)
        (equal right :q190391-top))
    :q190391-top)
   (t
    (q190391-ennreal-finite
     (q190391-binary-value
      scalar-multiply (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q190391-finite-ennreal-sum
    (sequence count scalar-zero scalar-add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q190391-ennreal-zero scalar-zero)
    (q190391-ennreal-add
     (q190391-finite-ennreal-sum
      sequence (- count 1) scalar-zero scalar-add)
     (q190391-unary-value sequence (- count 1))
     scalar-add)))

(defun q190391-sum-upper-bound-function
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(count)
   (q190391-implies-term
    (list 'natp 'count)
    (list 'q190391-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (list 'q190391-finite-ennreal-sum
                (q190391-quoted sequence)
                'count
                (q190391-quoted scalar-zero)
                (q190391-quoted scalar-add))
          (q190391-quoted total)
          (q190391-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q190391-sum-upper-bound-p
    (sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (q190391-universal-p
   (q190391-sum-upper-bound-function
    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   '(count)))

(defun q190391-sum-least-function
    (sequence total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
  (list
   'lambda '(bound)
   (q190391-implies-term
    (q190391-and-terms
     (list
      (list 'q190391-ennreal-p
            'bound
            (q190391-quoted scalar-carrier)
            (q190391-quoted scalar-zero)
            (q190391-quoted scalar-less))
      (list 'q190391-sum-upper-bound-p
            (q190391-quoted sequence)
            'bound
            (q190391-quoted scalar-zero)
            (q190391-quoted scalar-add)
            (q190391-quoted scalar-less))))
    (list 'q190391-ennreal-less-equal-p
          (q190391-quoted total)
          'bound
          (q190391-quoted scalar-less)))))

(defun q190391-countable-sum-p
    (sequence total

  (and
   (tamep-functionp sequence)
   (q190391-ennreal-p
    total scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-less)

    sequence total scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
   (q190391-universal-p
    (q190391-sum-least-function
     sequence total
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-less)
    '(bound))))

     (q190391-static-apply-term
      real-multiply
      (list (q190391-quoted t-value) 'x))))))

    (real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate

(defun q190391-has-law-p

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q190391,
-- "Central limit theorem": centered sums of independent identically distributed
-- square-integrable real random variables converge weakly, through their
-- pushforward laws, to the canonical centered Gaussian law of their variance.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q190391_central_limit_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField

record ExactMeasurableSpace (A : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    event :
      Predicate A ->
      Set1
    event-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      event S ->
      event T
    event-empty :
      event emptySet
    event-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      event S ->
      event (complement S)
    event-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> event (sets n)) ->
      event (countableUnion sets)

open ExactMeasurableSpace

data RealBorelEvent
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Predicate R -> Set1 where
  generated-open :
    {U : Predicate R} ->
    MetricOpenReal reals U ->
    RealBorelEvent reals U
  generated-empty :
    RealBorelEvent reals emptySet
  generated-complement :
    {S : Predicate R} ->
    RealBorelEvent reals S ->
    RealBorelEvent reals (complement S)
  generated-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> RealBorelEvent reals (sets n)) ->
    RealBorelEvent reals (countableUnion sets)
  generated-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate R} ->
    ((x : R) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    RealBorelEvent reals S ->
    RealBorelEvent reals T

realBorelEvents :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ExactMeasurableSpace R
realBorelEvents reals =
  record
    { event = RealBorelEvent reals
    ; event-congruent =
        \ S T equivalenceS measurableS ->
          generated-congruent equivalenceS measurableS
    ; event-empty = generated-empty
    ; event-complement =
        \ S measurableS -> generated-complement measurableS
    ; event-countable-union = generated-countable-union
    }

record ExactProbabilityMeasure
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A) : Set2 where
  field
    measure :
      Predicate A ->
      R
    measure-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measure S == measure T
    measure-empty :
      measure emptySet == zeroR reals
    measure-nonnegative :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (measure S)
    measure-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (measure S) (measure T)
    measure-below-measurable-superset :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      event events T ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (measure S) (measure T)
    measure-is-measurable-envelope-infimum :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (lower : R) ->
      ((T : Predicate A) ->
        event events T ->
        Subset S T ->
        lessOrEqualR reals lower (measure T)) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals lower (measure S)
    subset-of-measurable-null-is-null :
      (S N : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S N ->
      event events N ->
      measure N == zeroR reals ->
      measure S == zeroR reals
    measure-congruent-outside-null :
      (S T N : Predicate A) ->
      event events N ->
      measure N == zeroR reals ->
      ((x : A) -> Not (N x) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measure S == measure T
    measure-countable-additive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> event events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ x y -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x y))
        (\ count -> sumFirst reals (\ n -> measure (sets n)) count)
        (measure (countableUnion sets))
    measure-total :
      measure wholeSet == oneR reals

open ExactProbabilityMeasure

ExactMeasurableFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  ExactMeasurableSpace A ->
  ExactMeasurableSpace B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set1
ExactMeasurableFunction source target f =
  (S : Predicate _) ->
  event target S ->
  event source (preimage f S)

record AlmostEverywhere
  {R A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : ExactMeasurableSpace A}
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (property : Predicate A) : Set2 where
  field
    exceptional-set :
      Predicate A
    exceptional-set-measurable :
      event events exceptional-set
    exceptional-set-null :
      measure probability exceptional-set == zeroR reals
    property-off-exceptional-set :
      (x : A) ->
      Not (exceptional-set x) ->
      property x

record AEMeasurableReal
  {R A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : ExactMeasurableSpace A}
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : A -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    measurable-representative :
      A -> R
    representative-measurable :
      ExactMeasurableFunction
        events
        (realBorelEvents reals)
        measurable-representative
    equal-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere probability
        (\ x -> f x == measurable-representative x)

open AEMeasurableReal

record JordanParts
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (f positivePart negativePart : A -> R) : Set where
  field
    positive-part-nonnegative :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (positivePart x)
    negative-part-nonnegative :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (negativePart x)
    parts-disjoint :
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyR reals (positivePart x) (negativePart x) ==
      zeroR reals
    parts-difference :
      (x : A) ->
      f x == subtractR reals (positivePart x) (negativePart x)

record SimpleNonnegativeFunction
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : A -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    simple-cutoff :
      Nat
    simple-index :
      A -> Nat
    simple-values :
      Nat -> R
    simple-index-within :
      (x : A) ->
      simple-index x <=N simple-cutoff
    simple-fibers-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simple-cutoff ->
      event events (\ x -> simple-index x == i)
    simple-values-nonnegative :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simple-cutoff ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (simple-values i)
    simple-below-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere probability
        (\ x ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (simple-values (simple-index x))
            (f x))

open SimpleNonnegativeFunction

simpleLebesgueIntegral :
  {R A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : ExactMeasurableSpace A}
  {probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events}
  {f : A -> R} ->
  SimpleNonnegativeFunction reals events probability f ->
  R
simpleLebesgueIntegral {reals = reals} {probability = probability} simple =
  sumFirst reals
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR reals
        (simple-values simple i)
        (measure probability (\ x -> simple-index simple x == i)))
    (suc (simple-cutoff simple))

record ExactLowerIntegralValue
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (value : R) : Set2 where
  field
    function-nonnegative-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere probability
        (\ x -> lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (f x))
    upper-bound-for-simple-integrals :
      (simple : SimpleNonnegativeFunction reals events probability f) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (simpleLebesgueIntegral simple) value
    least-upper-bound-for-simple-integrals :
      (upper : R) ->
      ((simple : SimpleNonnegativeFunction reals events probability f) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals (simpleLebesgueIntegral simple) upper) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals value upper

record ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (value : R) : Set2 where
  field
    ae-measurable :
      AEMeasurableReal probability f
    positive-part :
      A -> R
    negative-part :
      A -> R
    canonical-parts :
      JordanParts reals f positive-part negative-part
    positive-integral-value :
      R
    negative-integral-value :
      R
    positive-integral :
      ExactLowerIntegralValue
        reals events probability positive-part positive-integral-value
    negative-integral :
      ExactLowerIntegralValue
        reals events probability negative-part negative-integral-value
    integral-difference :
      value ==
      subtractR reals positive-integral-value negative-integral-value

square :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiplyR reals x x

record MemLpTwo
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : A -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    square-integral-value :
      R
    square-integrable :
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals events probability
        (\ x -> square reals (f x))
        square-integral-value
    mean-value :
      R
    mean-integral :
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals events probability f mean-value
    variance-value :
      R
    variance-integral :
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals events probability
        (\ x -> square reals (subtractR reals (f x) mean-value))
        variance-value
    variance-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) variance-value

open MemLpTwo

data Member {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  member-here :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)
  member-there :
    {y : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates {A : Set} : List A -> Set where
  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates []
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Not (Member x xs) ->
    NoDuplicates xs ->
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

finiteIntersection :
  {R A : Set} ->
  (X : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
  List Nat ->
  Predicate A
finiteIntersection X sets [] =
  wholeSet
finiteIntersection X sets (i ∷ indices) =
  intersection
    (preimage (X i) (sets i))
    (finiteIntersection X sets indices)

finiteMeasureProduct :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {events : ExactMeasurableSpace A} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events ->
  (representatives : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
  List Nat ->
  R
finiteMeasureProduct reals probability representatives sets [] =
  oneR reals
finiteMeasureProduct reals probability representatives sets (i ∷ indices) =
  multiplyR reals
    (measure probability (preimage (representatives i) (sets i)))
    (finiteMeasureProduct
      reals probability representatives sets indices)

record IndependentFunctions
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (X : Nat -> A -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    coordinate-ae-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      AEMeasurableReal probability (X i)
    independent-finite-cylinders :
      (representatives :
        (i : Nat) -> AEMeasurableReal probability (X i)) ->
      (indices : List Nat) ->
      NoDuplicates indices ->
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate R) ->
      ((i : Nat) ->
        Member i indices ->
        RealBorelEvent reals (sets i)) ->
      measure probability
        (finiteIntersection
          (\ i -> measurable-representative (representatives i))
          sets indices) ==
      finiteMeasureProduct reals probability
        (\ i -> measurable-representative (representatives i))
        sets indices

record IdenticallyDistributed
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f g : A -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    first-ae-measurable :
      AEMeasurableReal probability f
    second-ae-measurable :
      AEMeasurableReal probability g
    equal-pushforward-masses :
      (first-representative : AEMeasurableReal probability f) ->
      (second-representative : AEMeasurableReal probability g) ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      RealBorelEvent reals S ->
      measure probability
        (preimage
          (measurable-representative first-representative)
          S) ==
      measure probability
        (preimage
          (measurable-representative second-representative)
          S)

RealLaw :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Set2
RealLaw reals =
  ExactProbabilityMeasure reals (realBorelEvents reals)

record ExactPushforwardLaw
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : A -> R)
  (law : RealLaw reals) : Set2 where
  field
    pushforward-ae-measurable :
      AEMeasurableReal probability f
    pushforward-on-borel-events :
      (representative : AEMeasurableReal probability f) ->
      (S : Predicate R) ->
      RealBorelEvent reals S ->
      measure law S ==
      measure probability
        (preimage (measurable-representative representative) S)

powerSeriesPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerSeriesPartialSum =
  sumFirst

record ExponentialValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (x value : R) : Set1 where
  field
    terms :
      Nat -> R
    first-term :
      terms zero == oneR reals
    successive-terms :
      (n : Nat) ->
      terms (suc n) ==
      multiplyR reals
        (multiplyR reals (terms n) x)
        (reciprocalR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n)))
    series-limit :
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ a b -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals a b))
        (powerSeriesPartialSum reals terms)
        value

record CosineValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (x value : R) : Set1 where
  field
    terms :
      Nat -> R
    first-term :
      terms zero == oneR reals
    successive-terms :
      (n : Nat) ->
      terms (suc n) ==
      multiplyR reals
        (negateR reals
          (multiplyR reals (terms n) (square reals x)))
        (reciprocalR reals
          (multiplyR reals
            (fromNatR reals (suc (n + n)))
            (fromNatR reals (suc (suc (n + n))))))
    series-limit :
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ a b -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals a b))
        (powerSeriesPartialSum reals terms)
        value

record SineValue
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (x value : R) : Set1 where
  field
    terms :
      Nat -> R
    first-term :
      terms zero == x
    successive-terms :
      (n : Nat) ->
      terms (suc n) ==
      multiplyR reals
        (negateR reals
          (multiplyR reals (terms n) (square reals x)))
        (reciprocalR reals
          (multiplyR reals
            (fromNatR reals (suc (suc (n + n))))
            (fromNatR reals (suc (suc (suc (n + n)))))))
    series-limit :
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ a b -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals a b))
        (powerSeriesPartialSum reals terms)
        value

record GaussianCosineWitness
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (Y : A -> R)
  (t variance : R) : Set2 where
  field
    cosine-values :
      A -> R
    cosine-values-canonical :
      (x : A) ->
      CosineValue reals
        (multiplyR reals t (Y x))
        (cosine-values x)
    cosine-integral-value :
      R
    cosine-integral :
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals events probability
        cosine-values
        cosine-integral-value
    gaussian-exponential :
      ExponentialValue reals
        (negateR reals
          (multiplyR reals
            (multiplyR reals variance (square reals t))
            (reciprocalR reals (fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))))))
        cosine-integral-value

record GaussianSineWitness
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (Y : A -> R)
  (t : R) : Set2 where
  field
    sine-values :
      A -> R
    sine-values-canonical :
      (x : A) ->
      SineValue reals
        (multiplyR reals t (Y x))
        (sine-values x)
    sine-integral :
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals events probability
        sine-values
        (zeroR reals)

record HasCanonicalCenteredGaussianLaw
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (probability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (Y : A -> R)
  (variance : R) : Set2 where
  field
    gaussian-ae-measurable :
      AEMeasurableReal probability Y
    gaussian-variance-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) variance
    zero-variance-is-dirac :
      variance == zeroR reals ->
      AlmostEverywhere probability (\ x -> Y x == zeroR reals)
    gaussian-cosine-characteristic :
      (t : R) ->
      GaussianCosineWitness reals events probability Y t variance
    gaussian-sine-characteristic :
      (t : R) ->
      GaussianSineWitness reals events probability Y t

record WeakTestWitness
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (laws : Nat -> RealLaw reals)
  (limitLaw : RealLaw reals)
  (test : R -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    approximating-integrals :
      Nat -> R
    approximating-integral-definitions :
      (n : Nat) ->
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals
        (realBorelEvents reals)
        (laws n)
        test
        (approximating-integrals n)
    limit-integral :
      R
    limit-integral-definition :
      ExactLebesgueIntegralValue
        reals
        (realBorelEvents reals)
        limitLaw
        test
        limit-integral
    integral-limit :
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ a b -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals a b))
        approximating-integrals
        limit-integral

record ExactWeakConvergence
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (laws : Nat -> RealLaw reals)
  (limitLaw : RealLaw reals) : Set2 where
  field
    bounded-continuous-tests :
      (test : R -> R) ->
      Bounded reals test ->
      ((x : R) ->
        (epsilon : R) ->
        Positive reals epsilon ->
        Exists R
          (\ delta ->
            Both
              (Positive reals delta)
              ((y : R) ->
                StrictLess reals
                  (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals y x))
                  delta ->
                StrictLess reals
                  (absoluteR reals
                    (subtractR reals (test y) (test x)))
                  epsilon))) ->
      WeakTestWitness reals laws limitLaw test

record TendstoInDistribution
  {R A B : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (sourceEvents : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (sourceProbability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals sourceEvents)
  (targetEvents : ExactMeasurableSpace B)
  (targetProbability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals targetEvents)
  (randomVariables : Nat -> A -> R)
  (limitVariable : B -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    approximating-laws :
      Nat -> RealLaw reals
    limit-law :
      RealLaw reals
    approximating-laws-are-pushforwards :
      (n : Nat) ->
      ExactPushforwardLaw
        reals sourceEvents sourceProbability
        (randomVariables n)
        (approximating-laws n)
    limit-law-is-pushforward :
      ExactPushforwardLaw
        reals targetEvents targetProbability
        limitVariable
        limit-law
    pushforward-laws-converge-weakly :
      ExactWeakConvergence reals approximating-laws limit-law

partialSum :
  {R A : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  A ->
  R
partialSum reals X zero x =
  zeroR reals
partialSum reals X (suc n) x =
  addR reals (partialSum reals X n x) (X n x)

record PositiveSquareRootNormalizedValue
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (X : Nat -> A -> R)
  (mean : R)
  (normalized : Nat -> A -> R)
  (n : Nat)
  (x : A) : Set1 where
  field
    root :
      R
    root-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) root
    root-square :
      square reals root == fromNatR reals (suc n)
    normalized-value :
      normalized (suc n) x ==
      multiplyR reals
        (reciprocalR reals root)
        (subtractR reals
          (partialSum reals X (suc n) x)
          (multiplyR reals
            (fromNatR reals (suc n))
            mean))

record NormalizedCenteredSums
  {R A : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (X : Nat -> A -> R)
  (mean : R)
  (normalized : Nat -> A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    zero-sum-value :
      (x : A) ->
      normalized zero x == zeroR reals
    positive-sum-values :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (x : A) ->
      PositiveSquareRootNormalizedValue
        reals X mean normalized n x

record CentralLimitConclusion
  {R A B : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (sourceEvents : ExactMeasurableSpace A)
  (sourceProbability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals sourceEvents)
  (targetEvents : ExactMeasurableSpace B)
  (targetProbability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals targetEvents)
  (X : Nat -> A -> R)
  (mean : R)
  (Y : B -> R) : Set2 where
  field
    normalized-centered-sums :
      Nat -> A -> R
    normalized-centered-definition :
      NormalizedCenteredSums
        reals X mean normalized-centered-sums
    normalized-laws-converge-to-Y :
      TendstoInDistribution
        reals
        sourceEvents sourceProbability
        targetEvents targetProbability
        normalized-centered-sums Y

central-limit-theorem : Set2
central-limit-theorem =
  (R A B : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (sourceEvents : ExactMeasurableSpace A) ->
  (sourceProbability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals sourceEvents) ->
  (targetEvents : ExactMeasurableSpace B) ->
  (targetProbability : ExactProbabilityMeasure reals targetEvents) ->
  (X : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  (Y : B -> R) ->
  (hX : MemLpTwo reals sourceEvents sourceProbability (X zero)) ->
  HasCanonicalCenteredGaussianLaw
    reals targetEvents targetProbability Y (variance-value hX) ->
  IndependentFunctions reals sourceEvents sourceProbability X ->
  ((i : Nat) ->
    IdenticallyDistributed
      reals sourceEvents sourceProbability (X i) (X zero)) ->
  CentralLimitConclusion
    reals
    sourceEvents sourceProbability
    targetEvents targetProbability
    X
    (mean-value hX)
    Y

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q190391 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q190391), "Central limit theorem":
  independent identically distributed square-integrable real random variables,
  centered and normalized by the square root of the sample size, converge in
  distribution to the Gaussian law with their common variance. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory iterateTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory measureTheory borelTheory;
open lebesgueTheory lebesgue_measureTheory probabilityTheory;

val q190391_ae_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_ae_measurable_def",
  ``q190391_ae_measurable (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) <=>
      ?X' : 'a -> real.
        random_variable X' p borel /\
        (AE w::p. X w = X' w)``);

val q190391_representative_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_representative_def",
  ``q190391_representative (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) =
      @X' : 'a -> real.
        random_variable X' p borel /\
        (AE w::p. X w = X' w)``);

val q190391_mem_lp_two_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_mem_lp_two_def",
  ``q190391_mem_lp_two (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) <=>
      q190391_ae_measurable p X /\
      integrable p
        (\w. Normal ((q190391_representative p X w) pow 2))``);

val q190391_independent_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_independent_def",
  ``q190391_independent
      (p : 'a p_space) (X : num -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?X' : num -> 'a -> real.
        (!i.
          random_variable (X' i) p borel /\
          (AE w::p. X i w = X' i w)) /\
        indep_vars p X' (\i. borel) UNIV``);

val q190391_has_law_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_has_law_def",
  ``q190391_has_law
      (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) (law : real measure) <=>
      ?X' : 'a -> real.
        random_variable X' p borel /\
        (AE w::p. X w = X' w) /\
        !s. s IN subsets borel ==> distribution p X' s = law s``);

val q190391_ident_distrib_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_ident_distrib_def",
  ``q190391_ident_distrib
      (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) (Y : 'a -> real) <=>
      ?law : real measure.
        q190391_has_law p X law /\
        q190391_has_law p Y law``);

val q190391_mean_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_mean_def",
  ``q190391_mean (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) =
      real
        (integral p
          (Normal o q190391_representative p X))``);

val q190391_variance_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_variance_def",
  ``q190391_variance (p : 'a p_space) (X : 'a -> real) =
      real
        (integral p
          (\w.
            Normal
              ((q190391_representative p X w -
                q190391_mean p X) pow 2)))``);

val q190391_gaussian_law_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_gaussian_law_def",
  ``q190391_gaussian_law (v : real) : real measure =
      if v <= 0 then
        (\s. if s IN subsets borel /\ (0 : real) IN s then 1 else 0)
      else
        density_measure lborel
          (Normal o
            (\x.
              (1 / sqrt (2 * pi * v)) *
              exp (-((x pow 2) / (2 * v)))))``);

val q190391_tendsto_in_distribution_def = new_definition (
  "q190391_tendsto_in_distribution_def",
  ``q190391_tendsto_in_distribution
      (p : 'a p_space) (p' : 'b p_space)
      (Zs : num -> 'a -> real) (Y : 'b -> real) <=>
      ?laws : num -> real measure.
      ?target_law : real measure.
        (!n. q190391_has_law p (Zs n) (laws n)) /\
        q190391_has_law p' Y target_law /\
        !f. f IN bounded_continuous euclidean ==>
          (((\n.
              integral
                (space borel, subsets borel, laws n)
                (Normal o f)) -->
            integral
              (space borel, subsets borel, target_law)
              (Normal o f))
           sequentially)``);

val central_limit_theorem =
  ``!(p : 'a p_space) (p' : 'b p_space)
      (X : num -> 'a -> real) (Y : 'b -> real).
      prob_space p /\
      prob_space p' /\
      q190391_has_law p' Y
        (q190391_gaussian_law (q190391_variance p (X 0))) /\
      q190391_mem_lp_two p (X 0) /\
      q190391_independent p X /\
      (!i. q190391_ident_distrib p (X i) (X 0))
      ==>
      q190391_tendsto_in_distribution p p'
        (\n w.
          inv (sqrt (&n)) *
          (SIGMA (\k. X k w) (count n) -
           &n * q190391_mean p (X 0)))
        Y``;

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190391
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q190391), "Central limit theorem":
  independent identically distributed real random variables with a finite
  second moment have centered inverse-square-root normalized partial sums
  converging in distribution to the zero-mean Gaussian law with their
  variance. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  M and N range over arbitrary SetMM probability measures, so their sample
  spaces and sigma-algebras remain arbitrary. Q190391AERep records a Borel
  measurable representative equal to a real-valued function off a measurable
  null set. Q190391Map is the resulting pushforward probability measure.

  Q190391MemLpTwo is the real L^2 condition: a measurable representative has
  integrable square. Over a probability measure this is equivalent to Lean's
  MemLp at exponent 2. Q190391Mean and Q190391Variance use the unique
  representative-independent real integral and centered-square integral;
  under Q190391MemLpTwo they agree with Mathlib's integral and variance.

  Q190391Independent is the finite-family product characterization of
  independence, using the outer measure induced by M so that the definition
  applies to the source's arbitrary functions before measurable
  representatives are selected. Q190391IdentDistrib requires equal
  pushforward laws and retains almost-everywhere measurability.

  Q190391GaussianReal characterizes the zero-mean real Gaussian probability
  measure of any nonnegative variance by its characteristic function,
  including the zero-variance Dirac case. Q190391HasGaussianLaw says that Y
  has exactly this pushforward law.

  Q190391Normalized is the sequence

    n |-> (sqrt n)^(-1) * (sum_(k < n) X_k - n * integral X_0).

  Its inverse-square-root factor is explicitly zero at n = 0, matching Lean's
  totalized inverse, since division by zero has a different junk value in
  SetMM.

  Q190391TendstoInDistribution expands convergence of its pushforward laws by
  the bounded-continuous-test-function characterization of weak convergence.
  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. Every

:: "Central limit theorem": independent identically distributed real random
:: variables with finite second moment have centered sums, scaled by the inverse
:: square root of the sample size, converging in distribution to the Gaussian
:: law with their common variance. This file contains no proof.

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Omega,Omega1 being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      Sigma1 being SigmaField of Omega1,
      P being Probability of Sigma,
      P1 being Probability of Sigma1,
      X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL),
      Y being Function of Omega1,REAL
  st
    ex XM being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL),
       XM0 being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
       FXM0 being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets,
       YM being random_variable of Sigma1,Borel_Sets,
       NY being Element of Sigma1
    st
      XM is Sigma-Random-Variable-Family &
      XM0 = XM.0 &
      FXM0 = XM0 &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex XMn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
           Nn being Element of Sigma
        st
          XMn = XM.n &
          P.Nn = 0 &
          for omega being Element of Omega st not omega in Nn holds
            X.n.omega = XMn.omega) &
      P1.NY = 0 &
      (for omega being Element of Omega1 st not omega in NY holds
        Y.omega = YM.omega) &
      XM0 is_integrable_on P &
      (abs(XM0) to_power 2) is_integrable_on P2M(P) &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex XMn,XMzero being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
           FXMn,FXMzero being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets
        st
          XMn = XM.n &
          XMzero = XM.0 &
          FXMn = XMn &
          FXMzero = XMzero &
          probability(FXMn,P) = probability(FXMzero,P)) &
      (for k being Nat,
           I being one-to-one FinSequence of NAT,
           B being FinSequence of Borel_Sets,
           E being FinSequence of Sigma,
           q being FinSequence of REAL
        st 0 < k &
           len I = k & len B = k & len E = k & len q = k &
           (for j being Nat st j in Seg k holds
             E.j = (XM.(I.j))"(B.j) &
             q.j = (P.(E.j) qua Real))
        holds P.(meet rng E) = Product q) &
      ((variance(XM0,P) = 0 &
        for A being Element of Borel_Sets holds
          (0 in A implies (probability(YM,P1)).A = 1) &
          (not 0 in A implies (probability(YM,P1)).A = 0))
       or
       (0 < variance(XM0,P) &
        ex g being Function of REAL,REAL
        st
          g is_integrable_on B-Meas &
          (for x being Real holds
            g.x =
              exp_R.(-(x^2)/(2*variance(XM0,P))) /
                sqrt(2*PI*variance(XM0,P))) &
          for A being Element of Borel_Sets holds
            (probability(YM,P1)).A = Integral(B-Meas,g|A)))
  holds
    ex XM0 being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
       YM being random_variable of Sigma1,Borel_Sets,
       ZM being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL),
       NX0 being Element of Sigma,
       NY being Element of Sigma1
    st
      P.NX0 = 0 &
      (for omega being Element of Omega st not omega in NX0 holds
        (X.0).omega = XM0.omega) &
      XM0 is_integrable_on P &
      P1.NY = 0 &
      (for omega being Element of Omega1 st not omega in NY holds
        Y.omega = YM.omega) &
      ZM is Sigma-Random-Variable-Family &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex ZMn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
           NZn being Element of Sigma
        st
          ZMn = ZM.n &
          P.NZn = 0 &
          for omega being Element of Omega st not omega in NZn holds
            ex s being FinSequence of REAL
            st
              len s = n &
              (for j being Nat st j in dom s holds
                s.j = X.(j-'1).omega) &
              ZMn.omega =
                (Sum s - (n qua Real)*expect(XM0,P)) /
                  sqrt(n qua Real)) &
      for u being Function of R^1,R^1
        st (for V being Subset of R^1 st V in the topology of R^1 holds
              u"V in the topology of R^1) &
           ex C being Real st
             for x being Point of R^1 holds |.u.x.| <= C
      holds
        ex uR being Function of REAL,REAL,
           a being Function of NAT,REAL,
           b being Real
        st
          uR = u &
          (for n being Nat holds
            ex ZMn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma,
               FZMn being random_variable of Sigma,Borel_Sets
            st
              ZMn = ZM.n &
              FZMn = ZMn &
              a.n = Integral(P2M(probability(FZMn,P)),uR)) &
          b = Integral(P2M(probability(YM,P1)),uR) &
          for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
            ex N being Nat
            st for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              |.a.n-b.| < epsilon
proof
end;

title: Q190391_central_limit_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190391,
% "Central limit theorem": independent identically distributed real random variables
% with a square-integrable first term have centered square-root-normalized laws
% converging to the canonical centered Gaussian law with their variance.
% This file contains no proof.

Q190391_central_limit_theorem[
  sample_space: TYPE+,
  limit_sample_space: TYPE+
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [sample_space -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  probability_measure: TYPE = [event -> real]
  random_variable: TYPE = [sample_space -> real]
  random_variable_family: TYPE = [nat -> random_variable]

  limit_event: TYPE = [limit_sample_space -> bool]
  limit_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> limit_event]
  limit_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [limit_event -> bool]
  limit_probability_measure: TYPE = [limit_event -> real]
  limit_random_variable: TYPE = [limit_sample_space -> real]

  real_event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_event]
  real_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [real_event -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  index_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  absolute_value(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN x ELSE -x ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN 0 ELSE numerator / denominator ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            absolute_value(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  sine_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  exponential_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(x ^ index, factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): sine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): NOT A(omega)

  event_intersection(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): A(omega) AND B(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  limit_full_event: limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space): TRUE

  limit_empty_event: limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space): FALSE

  limit_event_complement(A: limit_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space): NOT A(omega)

  limit_countable_union(events: limit_event_sequence): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  real_full_event: real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real): TRUE

  real_event_complement(A: real_event): real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real): NOT A(value)

  real_countable_union(events: real_event_sequence): real_event =
    LAMBDA (value: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(value)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  limit_pairwise_disjoint(events: limit_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: limit_sample_space):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  limit_pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: limit_event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: limit_sample_space):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  distinct_below(indices: index_sequence, count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        indices(left_index) /= indices(right_index)

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_limit_sigma_algebra(Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(limit_full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(limit_event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(limit_countable_union(events)))

  is_real_sigma_algebra(Sigma: real_sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(real_full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(real_event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: real_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(real_countable_union(events)))

  contains_real_lower_rays(Sigma: real_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      Sigma(LAMBDA (value: real): value <= bound)

  borel_event(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (Sigma: real_sigma_algebra):
      (is_real_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
        AND contains_real_lower_rays(Sigma))
      IMPLIES Sigma(A)

  is_probability_measure(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND M(empty_event) = 0
      AND M(full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES 0 <= M(A) AND M(A) <= 1)
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
                count),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  is_limit_probability_measure(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_limit_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND M(limit_empty_event) = 0
      AND M(limit_full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES 0 <= M(A) AND M(A) <= 1)
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND limit_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
                count),
            M(limit_countable_union(events))))

  preimage_event(X: random_variable, A: real_event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space): A(X(omega))

  limit_preimage_event(
      X: limit_random_variable,
      A: real_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space): A(X(omega))

  measurable_random_variable(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      borel_event(A) IMPLIES Sigma(preimage_event(X, A))

  measurable_limit_random_variable(
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      borel_event(A) IMPLIES Sigma(limit_preimage_event(X, A))

  almost_everywhere_equal(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X, Y: random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (null_set: event):
      Sigma(null_set)
        AND M(null_set) = 0
        AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
          NOT null_set(omega) IMPLIES X(omega) = Y(omega))

  limit_almost_everywhere_equal(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X, Y: limit_random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (null_set: limit_event):
      Sigma(null_set)
        AND M(null_set) = 0
        AND (FORALL (omega: limit_sample_space):
          NOT null_set(omega) IMPLIES X(omega) = Y(omega))

  almost_everywhere_measurable(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (version: random_variable):
      measurable_random_variable(Sigma, version)
        AND almost_everywhere_equal(M, Sigma, X, version)

  limit_almost_everywhere_measurable(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable): bool =
    EXISTS (version: limit_random_variable):
      measurable_limit_random_variable(Sigma, version)
        AND limit_almost_everywhere_equal(M, Sigma, X, version)

  measurable_version(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): random_variable =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (version: random_variable):
        measurable_random_variable(Sigma, version)
          AND almost_everywhere_equal(M, Sigma, X, version))

  limit_measurable_version(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable): limit_random_variable =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (version: limit_random_variable):
        measurable_limit_random_variable(Sigma, version)
          AND limit_almost_everywhere_equal(M, Sigma, X, version))

  simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: sample_space): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(omega)
            THEN coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  limit_simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: limit_event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: limit_sample_space): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      limit_simple_value(
        coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(omega)
            THEN coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE 0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) >= 0 AND Sigma(pieces(index)))
      AND (FORALL (omega: sample_space):
        0 <= simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
          AND simple_value(coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
            <= X(omega))

  limit_nonnegative_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: limit_event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    limit_pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) >= 0 AND Sigma(pieces(index)))
      AND (FORALL (omega: limit_sample_space):
        0 <= limit_simple_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
          AND limit_simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega) <= X(omega))

  simple_integral(
      M: probability_measure,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        coefficients(index) * M(pieces(index)),
      count)

  limit_simple_integral(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: limit_event_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        coefficients(index) * M(pieces(index)),
      count)

  nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      upper: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      nonnegative_simple_minorant(
        Sigma, X, coefficients, pieces, count)
      IMPLIES
        simple_integral(M, coefficients, pieces, count) <= upper

  limit_nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable,
      upper: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: limit_event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      limit_nonnegative_simple_minorant(
        Sigma, X, coefficients, pieces, count)
      IMPLIES
        limit_simple_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count) <= upper

  has_nonnegative_integral(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (omega: sample_space): X(omega) >= 0)
      AND value >= 0
      AND nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(M, Sigma, X, value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: real):
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(M, Sigma, X, upper)
          IMPLIES value <= upper)

  limit_has_nonnegative_integral(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (omega: limit_sample_space): X(omega) >= 0)
      AND value >= 0
      AND limit_nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, X, value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: real):
        limit_nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, X, upper)
        IMPLIES value <= upper)

  positive_part(X: random_variable): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF X(omega) >= 0 THEN X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  negative_part(X: random_variable): random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
      IF X(omega) <= 0 THEN -X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  limit_positive_part(
      X: limit_random_variable): limit_random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
      IF X(omega) >= 0 THEN X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  limit_negative_part(
      X: limit_random_variable): limit_random_variable =
    LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
      IF X(omega) <= 0 THEN -X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  has_expectation(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, X)
      AND LET version: random_variable =
        measurable_version(M, Sigma, X)
      IN
        EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: real):
          has_nonnegative_integral(
            M, Sigma, positive_part(version), positive_integral)
          AND has_nonnegative_integral(
            M, Sigma, negative_part(version), negative_integral)
          AND value = positive_integral - negative_integral

  limit_has_expectation(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      X: limit_random_variable,
      value: real): bool =
    limit_almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, X)
      AND LET version: limit_random_variable =
        limit_measurable_version(M, Sigma, X)
      IN
        EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: real):
          limit_has_nonnegative_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            limit_positive_part(version),
            positive_integral)
          AND limit_has_nonnegative_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            limit_negative_part(version),
            negative_integral)
          AND value = positive_integral - negative_integral

  expectation(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, value))

  square_integrable(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): bool =
    almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, X)
      AND EXISTS (second_moment: real):
        has_nonnegative_integral(
          M,
          Sigma,
          (LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
            measurable_version(M, Sigma, X)(omega) ^ 2),
          second_moment)

  variance(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable): real =
    LET mean: real = expectation(M, Sigma, X) IN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          has_nonnegative_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            (LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
              (measurable_version(M, Sigma, X)(omega)
                - mean) ^ 2),
            value))

  distribution_value(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable,
      A: real_event): real =
    M(preimage_event(measurable_version(M, Sigma, X), A))

  identically_distributed(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X, Y: random_variable): bool =
    almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, X)
      AND almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, Y)
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        borel_event(A) IMPLIES
          distribution_value(M, Sigma, X, A)
            = distribution_value(M, Sigma, Y, A))

  finite_preimage_intersection(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable_family,
      indices: index_sequence,
      sets: real_event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE event =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      full_event
    ELSE
      event_intersection(
        finite_preimage_intersection(
          M, Sigma, X, indices, sets, count - 1),
        preimage_event(
          measurable_version(
            M, Sigma, X(indices(count - 1))),
          sets(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_probability_product(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable_family,
      indices: index_sequence,
      sets: real_event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      finite_probability_product(
        M, Sigma, X, indices, sets, count - 1)
        * distribution_value(
            M,
            Sigma,
            X(indices(count - 1)),
            sets(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  independent_family(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable_family): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, X(index)))
      AND FORALL
          (indices: index_sequence),
          (sets: real_event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        (distinct_below(indices, count)
          AND (FORALL (position: nat):
            position < count IMPLIES borel_event(sets(position))))
        IMPLIES
          M(finite_preimage_intersection(
            M, Sigma, X, indices, sets, count))
            = finite_probability_product(
                M, Sigma, X, indices, sets, count)

  partial_sum(
      X: random_variable_family,
      count: nat,
      omega: sample_space): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      partial_sum(X, count - 1, omega)
        + X(count - 1)(omega)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  natural_square_root(count: nat): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (root: real):
        root >= 0 AND root * root = (count :: real))

  inverse_natural_square_root(count: nat): real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 / natural_square_root(count)
    ENDIF

  normalized_centered_sum(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: random_variable_family,
      count: nat): random_variable =
    LET mean: real = expectation(M, Sigma, X(0)) IN
      LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
        inverse_natural_square_root(count)
          * (partial_sum(X, count, omega)
              - (count :: real) * mean)

  has_centered_gaussian_law(
      M: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma: limit_sigma_algebra,
      Y: limit_random_variable,
      variance_value: real): bool =
    limit_almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, Y)
      AND LET nonnegative_variance: real =
        IF variance_value >= 0 THEN variance_value ELSE 0 ENDIF
      IN
        FORALL (t: real):
          EXISTS (real_part, imaginary_part: real):
            limit_has_expectation(
              M,
              Sigma,
              (LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
                cosine(t * Y(omega))),
              real_part)
            AND limit_has_expectation(
              M,
              Sigma,
              (LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
                sine(t * Y(omega))),
              imaginary_part)
            AND real_part
              = exponential(
                  -(nonnegative_variance * t ^ 2) / 2)
            AND imaginary_part = 0

  tendsto_in_distribution(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      Z: random_variable_family,
      M_limit: limit_probability_measure,
      Sigma_limit: limit_sigma_algebra,
      Y: limit_random_variable): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, Z(index)))
      AND limit_almost_everywhere_measurable(
        M_limit, Sigma_limit, Y)
      AND FORALL (t: real):
        EXISTS
            (real_parts, imaginary_parts: real_sequence),
            (limit_real_part, limit_imaginary_part: real):
          (FORALL (index: nat):
            has_expectation(
              M,
              Sigma,
              (LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
                cosine(t * Z(index)(omega))),
              real_parts(index))
            AND has_expectation(
              M,
              Sigma,
              (LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
                sine(t * Z(index)(omega))),
              imaginary_parts(index)))
          AND limit_has_expectation(
            M_limit,
            Sigma_limit,
            (LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
              cosine(t * Y(omega))),
            limit_real_part)
          AND limit_has_expectation(
            M_limit,
            Sigma_limit,
            (LAMBDA (omega: limit_sample_space):
              sine(t * Y(omega))),
            limit_imaginary_part)
          AND converges_to(real_parts, limit_real_part)
          AND converges_to(
            imaginary_parts, limit_imaginary_part)

  tendsto_to_centered_gaussian(
      M: probability_measure,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      Z: random_variable_family,
      variance_value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      almost_everywhere_measurable(M, Sigma, Z(index)))
      AND LET nonnegative_variance: real =
        IF variance_value >= 0 THEN variance_value ELSE 0 ENDIF
      IN
        FORALL (t: real):
          EXISTS
              (real_parts, imaginary_parts: real_sequence):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              has_expectation(
                M,
                Sigma,
                (LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
                  cosine(t * Z(index)(omega))),
                real_parts(index))
              AND has_expectation(
                M,
                Sigma,
                (LAMBDA (omega: sample_space):
                  sine(t * Z(index)(omega))),
                imaginary_parts(index)))
            AND converges_to(
              real_parts,
              exponential(
                -(nonnegative_variance * t ^ 2) / 2))
            AND converges_to(imaginary_parts, 0)

  central_limit_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: probability_measure),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (X: random_variable_family):
      (is_probability_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND square_integrable(M, Sigma, X(0))
        AND independent_family(M, Sigma, X)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          identically_distributed(
            M, Sigma, X(index), X(0))))
      IMPLIES
        tendsto_to_centered_gaussian(
          M,
          Sigma,
          (LAMBDA (count: nat):
            normalized_centered_sum(M, Sigma, X, count)),
          variance(M, Sigma, X(0)))
END Q190391_central_limit_theorem

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q190556
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q190556), "De Moivre's theorem": raising
-- `cos z + sin z * I` to a natural-number power multiplies the complex
-- argument by that natural number. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric

@[expose] public section

namespace Q190556

/-- De Moivre's formula for complex sine and cosine. -/
theorem de_moivre_s_theorem (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (Complex.cos z + Complex.sin z * Complex.I) ^ n =
      Complex.cos (↑n * z) + Complex.sin (↑n * z) * Complex.I := sorry

end Q190556

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190556
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q190556), "De Moivre's theorem": for every
  natural exponent and complex argument, the corresponding power of
  cos(z) + i sin(z) equals cos(nz) + i sin(nz). This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q190556_C := (R * R)%type.

Definition q190556_of_R (x : R) : q190556_C := (x, 0).

Definition q190556_of_nat (n : nat) : q190556_C :=
  q190556_of_R (INR n).

Definition q190556_I : q190556_C := (0, 1).

Definition q190556_add (z w : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q190556_neg (z : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q190556_sub (z w : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  q190556_add z (q190556_neg w).

Definition q190556_mul (z w : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q190556_inv (z : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  (fst z / (fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2),
   - snd z / (fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2)).

Definition q190556_div (z w : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  q190556_mul z (q190556_inv w).

Fixpoint q190556_pow (z : q190556_C) (n : nat) : q190556_C :=
  match n with
  | O => q190556_of_R 1
  | S k => q190556_mul z (q190556_pow z k)
  end.

Definition q190556_exp (z : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  (exp (fst z) * cos (snd z),
   exp (fst z) * sin (snd z)).

Definition q190556_sin (z : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  q190556_div
    (q190556_mul
      (q190556_sub
        (q190556_exp (q190556_mul (q190556_neg z) q190556_I))
        (q190556_exp (q190556_mul z q190556_I)))
      q190556_I)
    (q190556_of_R 2).

Definition q190556_cos (z : q190556_C) : q190556_C :=
  q190556_div
    (q190556_add
      (q190556_exp (q190556_mul z q190556_I))
      (q190556_exp (q190556_mul (q190556_neg z) q190556_I)))
    (q190556_of_R 2).

Theorem cos_add_sin_mul_I_pow :
  forall (n : nat) (z : q190556_C),
    q190556_pow
      (q190556_add
        (q190556_cos z)
        (q190556_mul (q190556_sin z) q190556_I))
      n =
    q190556_add
      (q190556_cos (q190556_mul (q190556_of_nat n) z))
      (q190556_mul
        (q190556_sin (q190556_mul (q190556_of_nat n) z))
        q190556_I).
Admitted.
