(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q190556
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q190556), "De Moivre's theorem": for every
  natural exponent and complex argument, the corresponding power of cosine
  plus sine times the imaginary unit equals the same expression at the
  exponent-scaled argument. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem de_moivre_s_theorem:
  fixes n :: nat
    and z :: complex
  shows "(cos z + sin z * \<i>) ^ n =
    cos (of_nat n * z) + sin (of_nat n * z) * \<i>"
  sorry

end

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190556,
  "De Moivre's theorem": every natural power of cos(z) + sin(z)i equals
  cos(nz) + sin(nz)i for standard complex sine and cosine defined from the
  power-series exponential. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q190556_DE_MOIVRE_S_THEOREM =
  `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
   let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
   let ci = ((&0:real),(&1:real)) in
   let cneg =
     \(z:real#real). (--(FST z),--(SND z)) in
   let cadd =
     \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
   let csub =
     \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       cadd z (cneg w) in
   let cmul =
     \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
        FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
   let cscale =
     \(a:real) (z:real#real).
       (a * FST z,a * SND z) in
   let cnorm =
     \(z:real#real).
       sqrt(FST z * FST z + SND z * SND z) in
   let cpow =
     \(z:real#real) (n:num).
       @w:real#real.
         ?p:num->real#real.
           p 0 = cone /\
           (!m:num. p (SUC m) = cmul z (p m)) /\
           p n = w in
   let cexp =
     \(z:real#real).
       @w:real#real.
         ?s:num->real#real.
           s 0 = czero /\
           (!m:num.
              s (SUC m) =
              cadd (s m)
                (cscale (inv(&(FACT m))) (cpow z m))) /\
           (!epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon
              ==> ?N:num. !m:num.
                    N <= m
                    ==> cnorm (csub (s m) w) < epsilon) in
   let ccos =
     \(z:real#real).
       cscale (inv(&2))
         (cadd (cexp (cmul z ci))
               (cexp (cneg (cmul z ci)))) in
   let csin =
     \(z:real#real).
       cscale (inv(&2))
         (cmul
           (csub (cexp (cneg (cmul z ci)))
                 (cexp (cmul z ci)))
           ci) in
   !n:num. !z:real#real.
     cpow (cadd (ccos z) (cmul (csin z) ci)) n =
     cadd (ccos (cscale (&n) z))
          (cmul (csin (cscale (&n) z)) ci)`;;

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q190556,
;; "De Moivre's theorem": for every natural n and complex z, the nth power
;; of cos(z) + sin(z)*i equals cos(n*z) + sin(n*z)*i. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers. Complex
;; numbers are explicit real/imaginary pairs, with their usual field
;; operations. The sine and cosine interfaces are fixed to the standard
;; entire functions by convergence of their full power series. Thus the
;; statement below retains the source's natural and complex quantifiers and
;; its pointwise equality, rather than replacing it by a bounded or
;; coefficient-only surrogate.

(defstub q190556-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q190556-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q190556-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q190556-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q190556-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q190556-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q190556-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q190556-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q190556-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q190556-cos (real value) t)
(defstub q190556-sin (real value) t)

(defun q190556-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q190556-r-add
   real left (q190556-r-negate real right)))

(defun q190556-r-absolute-value (real value)
  (if (q190556-r-less
       real value (q190556-r-zero real))
      (q190556-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun q190556-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q190556-r-member-p real value)
   (q190556-r-less
    real (q190556-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q190556-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q190556-r-less real right left)))

(defun-sk q190556-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q190556-r-member-p real x)
      (q190556-r-member-p real y)
      (q190556-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q190556-r-zero real))
            (one (q190556-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q190556-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q190556-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q190556-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q190556-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q190556-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q190556-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q190556-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q190556-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q190556-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q190556-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q190556-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q190556-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q190556-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q190556-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q190556-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q190556-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q190556-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q190556-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q190556-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q190556-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q190556-r-multiply real x yz-add)
         (q190556-r-add
          real
          (q190556-r-multiply real x y)
          (q190556-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q190556-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q190556-r-member-p real x)
      (q190556-r-member-p real y)
      (q190556-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q190556-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q190556-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q190556-r-less real x y)
         (q190556-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q190556-r-less real x y)
          (q190556-r-less real y z))
         (q190556-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q190556-r-less real x y)
         (q190556-r-less
          real
          (q190556-r-add real x z)
          (q190556-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q190556-r-less real zero x)
          (q190556-r-less real zero y))
         (q190556-r-less
          real zero
          (q190556-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q190556-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q190556-r-member-p real x)
     (q190556-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q190556-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q190556-r-member-p real x)
      (q190556-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q190556-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q190556-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q190556-r-member-p real bound)
     (q190556-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q190556-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q190556-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q190556-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q190556-r-member-p real bound)
       (q190556-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q190556-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q190556-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q190556-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q190556-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q190556-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q190556-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q190556-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q190556-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q190556-r-zero real))
        (one (q190556-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q190556-r-member-p real zero)
     (q190556-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q190556-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q190556-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q190556-r-less real zero one)
     (q190556-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Complex arithmetic over the presented real field.

(defun q190556-c-member-p (real value)
  (and
   (consp value)
   (q190556-r-member-p real (car value))
   (q190556-r-member-p real (cdr value))))

(defun q190556-c-zero (real)
  (cons (q190556-r-zero real)
        (q190556-r-zero real)))

(defun q190556-c-one (real)
  (cons (q190556-r-one real)
        (q190556-r-zero real)))

(defun q190556-c-I (real)
  (cons (q190556-r-zero real)
        (q190556-r-one real)))

(defun q190556-c-of-real (real value)
  (cons value (q190556-r-zero real)))

(defun q190556-c-add (real left right)
  (cons
   (q190556-r-add real (car left) (car right))
   (q190556-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun q190556-c-negate (real value)
  (cons
   (q190556-r-negate real (car value))
   (q190556-r-negate real (cdr value))))

(defun q190556-c-subtract (real left right)
  (q190556-c-add
   real left (q190556-c-negate real right)))

(defun q190556-c-multiply (real left right)
  (let ((a (car left))
        (b (cdr left))
        (c (car right))
        (d (cdr right)))
    (cons
     (q190556-r-subtract
      real
      (q190556-r-multiply real a c)
      (q190556-r-multiply real b d))
     (q190556-r-add
      real
      (q190556-r-multiply real a d)
      (q190556-r-multiply real b c)))))

(defun q190556-r-nat (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q190556-r-zero real)
    (q190556-r-add
     real
     (q190556-r-one real)
     (q190556-r-nat real (- n 1)))))

(defun q190556-r-factorial (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q190556-r-one real)
    (q190556-r-multiply
     real
     (q190556-r-nat real n)
     (q190556-r-factorial real (- n 1)))))

(defun q190556-c-power (real base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q190556-c-one real)
    (q190556-c-multiply
     real
     base
     (q190556-c-power real base (- exponent 1)))))

;; Canonical Taylor coefficients and partial sums for complex cosine and sine.

(defun q190556-r-alternating-unit (real index)
  (if (evenp index)
      (q190556-r-one real)
    (q190556-r-negate real (q190556-r-one real))))

(defun q190556-r-series-coefficient
    (real degree)
  (q190556-r-multiply
   real
   (q190556-r-alternating-unit
    real (floor degree 2))
   (q190556-r-inverse
    real (q190556-r-factorial real degree))))

(defun q190556-cosine-term (real z degree)
  (if (and (natp degree) (evenp degree))
      (q190556-c-multiply
       real
       (q190556-c-of-real
        real
        (q190556-r-series-coefficient real degree))
       (q190556-c-power real z degree))
    (q190556-c-zero real)))

(defun q190556-sine-term (real z degree)
  (if (and (natp degree) (oddp degree))
      (q190556-c-multiply
       real
       (q190556-c-of-real
        real
        (q190556-r-series-coefficient real degree))
       (q190556-c-power real z degree))
    (q190556-c-zero real)))

(defun q190556-cosine-prefix (real z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (q190556-c-zero real)
    (let ((degree (- terms 1)))
      (q190556-c-add
       real
       (q190556-cosine-prefix real z degree)
       (q190556-cosine-term real z degree)))))

(defun q190556-sine-prefix (real z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (q190556-c-zero real)
    (let ((degree (- terms 1)))
      (q190556-c-add
       real
       (q190556-sine-prefix real z degree)
       (q190556-sine-term real z degree)))))

(defun q190556-c-close-p (real left right epsilon)
  (and
   (q190556-r-less
    real
    (q190556-r-absolute-value
     real
     (q190556-r-subtract
      real (car left) (car right)))
    epsilon)
   (q190556-r-less
    real
    (q190556-r-absolute-value
     real
     (q190556-r-subtract
      real (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    epsilon)))

(defun-sk q190556-cosine-tail-p
    (real z epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (q190556-c-close-p
      real
      (q190556-cosine-prefix real z terms)
      (q190556-cos real z)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q190556-cosine-cutoff-exists-p
    (real z epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q190556-cosine-tail-p
      real z epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q190556-cosine-converges-at-p (real z)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q190556-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q190556-cosine-cutoff-exists-p
      real z epsilon))))

(defun q190556-cosine-value-p (real z)
  (and
   (q190556-c-member-p real (q190556-cos real z))
   (q190556-cosine-converges-at-p real z)))

(defun-sk q190556-cosine-series-laws-p (real)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q190556-c-member-p real z)
     (q190556-cosine-value-p real z))))

(defun-sk q190556-sine-tail-p
    (real z epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff terms))
     (q190556-c-close-p
      real
      (q190556-sine-prefix real z terms)
      (q190556-sin real z)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q190556-sine-cutoff-exists-p
    (real z epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q190556-sine-tail-p
      real z epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q190556-sine-converges-at-p (real z)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q190556-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q190556-sine-cutoff-exists-p
      real z epsilon))))

(defun q190556-sine-value-p (real z)
  (and
   (q190556-c-member-p real (q190556-sin real z))
   (q190556-sine-converges-at-p real z)))

(defun-sk q190556-sine-series-laws-p (real)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q190556-c-member-p real z)
     (q190556-sine-value-p real z))))

(defun q190556-de-moivre-identity-p (real n z)
  (let* ((imaginary-unit (q190556-c-I real))
         (cis-z
          (q190556-c-add
           real
           (q190556-cos real z)
           (q190556-c-multiply
            real
            (q190556-sin real z)
            imaginary-unit)))
         (real-n (q190556-r-nat real n))
         (n-times-z
          (q190556-c-multiply
           real
           (q190556-c-of-real real real-n)
           z)))
    (equal
     (q190556-c-power real cis-z n)
     (q190556-c-add
      real
      (q190556-cos real n-times-z)
      (q190556-c-multiply
       real
       (q190556-sin real n-times-z)
       imaginary-unit)))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q190556-de-moivre-s-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (real n z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q190556-real-field-p real)
      (q190556-cosine-series-laws-p real)
      (q190556-sine-series-laws-p real)
      (natp n)
      (q190556-c-member-p real z))
     (q190556-de-moivre-identity-p real n z))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190556
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q190556), "De Moivre's theorem": natural powers
-- of cos z + i sin z equal cos (n z) + i sin (n z) for every complex z.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR absoluteValueR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteValueR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteValueR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteValueR x == negateR x

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLessR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLessR reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

oneC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
oneC reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

imaginaryUnit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
imaginaryUnit reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (oneR reals)

fromNatC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
fromNatC reals n =
  complex (fromNatR reals n) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
subtractC reals x y =
  addC reals x (negateC reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

scaleC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
scaleC reals scalar (complex a b) =
  complex
    (multiplyR reals scalar a)
    (multiplyR reals scalar b)

powerC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
powerC reals z zero =
  oneC reals
powerC reals z (suc n) =
  multiplyC reals (powerC reals z n) z

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
exponentialTerm reals z n =
  scaleC reals
    (inverseR reals (fromNatR reals (factorial n)))
    (powerC reals z n)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
exponentialPartialSum reals z zero =
  zeroC reals
exponentialPartialSum reals z (suc n) =
  addC reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals z n)
    (exponentialTerm reals z n)

ConvergesC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ConvergesC {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ threshold ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      threshold <=N n ->
      (StrictLessR reals
        (absoluteValueR reals
          (subtractR reals
            (realPart (sequence n))
            (realPart limit)))
        epsilon)
      and
      (StrictLessR reals
        (absoluteValueR reals
          (subtractR reals
            (imaginaryPart (sequence n))
            (imaginaryPart limit)))
        epsilon))

record StandardComplexExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where
  field
    exponential : Complex R -> Complex R
    exponential-is-power-series :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      ConvergesC reals
        (exponentialPartialSum reals z)
        (exponential z)

open StandardComplexExponential

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

halfR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
halfR reals =
  inverseR reals (fromNatR reals twoN)

cosineC :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardComplexExponential reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
cosineC reals standardExponential z =
  scaleC reals
    (halfR reals)
    (addC reals
      (exponential standardExponential
        (multiplyC reals z (imaginaryUnit reals)))
      (exponential standardExponential
        (multiplyC reals
          (negateC reals z)
          (imaginaryUnit reals))))

sineC :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardComplexExponential reals ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
sineC reals standardExponential z =
  scaleC reals
    (halfR reals)
    (multiplyC reals
      (subtractC reals
        (exponential standardExponential
          (multiplyC reals
            (negateC reals z)
            (imaginaryUnit reals)))
        (exponential standardExponential
          (multiplyC reals z (imaginaryUnit reals))))
      (imaginaryUnit reals))

de-moivre-s-theorem : Set1
de-moivre-s-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (standardExponential : StandardComplexExponential reals) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  powerC reals
    (addC reals
      (cosineC reals standardExponential z)
      (multiplyC reals
        (sineC reals standardExponential z)
        (imaginaryUnit reals)))
    n
  ==
  addC reals
    (cosineC reals standardExponential
      (multiplyC reals (fromNatC reals n) z))
    (multiplyC reals
      (sineC reals standardExponential
        (multiplyC reals (fromNatC reals n) z))
      (imaginaryUnit reals))

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q190556, "De Moivre's theorem": for every natural number n and complex z,
  the nth power of cos z plus sin z times the imaginary unit equals the same
  cosine-sine expression at the complex-scaled argument n * z. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory complexTheory;

val de_moivre_s_theorem =
  ``!n : num. !z : complex.
      let ccos =
        \w : complex.
          (complex_exp (w * i) + complex_exp (-w * i)) / 2
      in
      let csin =
        \w : complex.
          (complex_exp (-w * i) - complex_exp (w * i)) * i / 2
      in
        (ccos z + csin z * i) pow n =
        ccos (complex_of_real (&n) * z) +
          csin (complex_of_real (&n) * z) * i``;

title: Q190556_de_moivre_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q190556,
% "De Moivre's theorem": for every complex number z and natural number n, the
% nth power of cos(z) + sin(z)i equals cos(nz) + sin(nz)i. This file contains
% no proof.

de_moivre_s_theorem_Q190556: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_i: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 1 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_scale(scalar: real, x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := scalar * real_part(x),
       imag_part := scalar * imag_part(x) #)

  complex_power(x: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  nat_factorial(n: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      n * nat_factorial(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  complex_exp_partial(
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          complex_exp_partial(z, count - 1),
          complex_scale(
            1 / (nat_factorial(k) :: real),
            complex_power(z, k)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  complex_converges_to(
      sequence: complex_sequence,
      value: complex): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(real_part(sequence(index)) - real_part(value)) < eps
              AND abs(imag_part(sequence(index)) - imag_part(value)) < eps

  complex_exp(z: complex): complex =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: complex):
        complex_converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            complex_exp_partial(z, count),
          value))

  complex_sine(z: complex): complex =
    complex_scale(
      1 / 2,
      complex_mul(
        complex_sub(
          complex_exp(
            complex_mul(complex_neg(z), complex_i)),
          complex_exp(complex_mul(z, complex_i))),
        complex_i))

  complex_cosine(z: complex): complex =
    complex_scale(
      1 / 2,
      complex_add(
        complex_exp(complex_mul(z, complex_i)),
        complex_exp(
          complex_mul(complex_neg(z), complex_i))))

  cos_add_sin_mul_I_pow: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (z: complex):
      complex_power(
        complex_add(
          complex_cosine(z),
          complex_mul(complex_sine(z), complex_i)),
        n)
      =
      LET nz: complex = complex_scale(n :: real, z) IN
        complex_add(
          complex_cosine(nz),
          complex_mul(complex_sine(nz), complex_i))
END de_moivre_s_theorem_Q190556

-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Decomposition.Lebesgue

@[expose] public section

namespace MeasureTheory.Measure.Q191693

variable {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]

/-- Lebesgue's decomposition theorem for an s-finite and a sigma-finite measure. -/
