title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q191693
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q191693), "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem":
  every s-finite measure has a measurable extended-nonnegative density plus
  a singular part with respect to any sigma-finite measure. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q191693_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q191693_empty {A : Type} : q191693_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q191693_full {A : Type} : q191693_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q191693_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q191693_set A) : q191693_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q191693_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q191693_set A) : q191693_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q191693_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q191693_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q191693_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q191693_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q191693_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q191693_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q191693_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q191693_ennreal : Type :=
| q191693_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q191693_ennreal
| q191693_ennreal_infinity : q191693_ennreal.

Arguments q191693_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q191693_ennreal_zero : q191693_ennreal :=
  q191693_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q191693_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q191693_ennreal_finite a _,
    q191693_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q191693_ennreal_infinity,
    q191693_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q191693_ennreal_le
    (x y : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q191693_ennreal_finite a _,
    q191693_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q191693_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q191693_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q191693_ennreal_infinity,
    q191693_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q191693_ennreal_infinity,
    q191693_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q191693_ennreal_add
    (x y : q191693_ennreal) : q191693_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q191693_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q191693_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q191693_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q191693_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q191693_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q191693_ennreal) : q191693_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q191693_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q191693_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q191693_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q191693_ennreal_finite a _, q191693_ennreal_infinity
  | q191693_ennreal_infinity, q191693_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q191693_ennreal_zero
      else q191693_ennreal_infinity
  | q191693_ennreal_infinity, q191693_ennreal_infinity =>
      q191693_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q191693_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q191693_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q191693_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q191693_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q191693_ennreal_add
        (q191693_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q191693_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q191693_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q191693_ennreal,
      values value -> q191693_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q191693_ennreal,
      (forall value : q191693_ennreal,
        values value -> q191693_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q191693_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q191693_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q191693_ennreal)
    (sum : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q191693_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q191693_ennreal_eq value
          (q191693_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q191693_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (value : R) (nonnegative : 0 <= value),
    q191693_ennreal_eq x
      (q191693_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Record q191693_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q191693_measurable : q191693_set A -> Prop;
  q191693_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q191693_set A,
      q191693_same_set E F ->
      (q191693_measurable E <-> q191693_measurable F);
  q191693_measurable_empty :
    q191693_measurable q191693_empty;
  q191693_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q191693_set A,
      q191693_measurable E ->
      q191693_measurable (q191693_complement E);
  q191693_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q191693_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q191693_measurable (E n)) ->
      q191693_measurable (q191693_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q191693_measurable {A} _ _.

Record q191693_measure {A : Type}
    (m : q191693_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q191693_measure_value : q191693_set A -> q191693_ennreal;
  q191693_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q191693_set A,
      q191693_same_set E F ->
      q191693_ennreal_eq
        (q191693_measure_value E)
        (q191693_measure_value F);
  q191693_measure_empty :
    q191693_ennreal_eq
      (q191693_measure_value q191693_empty)
      q191693_ennreal_zero;
  q191693_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q191693_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q191693_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q191693_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q191693_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q191693_measure_value (E n))
        (q191693_measure_value (q191693_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q191693_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Definition q191693_finite_measure {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q191693_measure m) : Prop :=
  q191693_ennreal_finite_value
    (q191693_measure_value mu q191693_full).

Definition q191693_s_finite {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q191693_measure m) : Prop :=
  exists components : nat -> q191693_measure m,
    (forall n : nat, q191693_finite_measure (components n)) /\
    forall E : q191693_set A,
      q191693_measurable m E ->
      q191693_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q191693_measure_value (components n) E)
        (q191693_measure_value mu E).

Definition q191693_sigma_finite {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q191693_measure m) : Prop :=
  exists cover : nat -> q191693_set A,
    (forall n : nat, q191693_measurable m (cover n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q191693_ennreal_finite_value
        (q191693_measure_value mu (cover n))) /\
    forall x : A, exists n : nat, cover n x.

Definition q191693_ennreal_below_real
    (x : q191693_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q191693_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q191693_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q191693_measurable_ennreal_function {A : Type}
    (m : q191693_measurable_space A)
    (f : A -> q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall bound : R,
    q191693_measurable m
      (fun x => q191693_ennreal_below_real (f x) bound).

Definition q191693_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (m : q191693_measurable_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q191693_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q191693_measurable m (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q191693_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Record q191693_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q191693_nnreal_value : R;
  q191693_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q191693_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q191693_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q191693_nonnegative_real) : q191693_ennreal :=
  q191693_ennreal_finite
    (q191693_nnreal_value x)
    (q191693_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q191693_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q191693_measure m)
    (f : A -> q191693_ennreal)
    (value : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q191693_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q191693_set A),
    q191693_finite_partition m k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q191693_ennreal_le
        (q191693_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q191693_ennreal_eq value
      (q191693_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q191693_ennreal_mul
            (q191693_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q191693_measure_value mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q191693_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q191693_measure m)
    (f : A -> q191693_ennreal)
    (value : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q191693_ennreal_supremum
    (q191693_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q191693_indicator {A : Type}
    (E : q191693_set A)
    (f : A -> q191693_ennreal)
    (x : A) : q191693_ennreal :=
  if excluded_middle_informative (E x)
  then f x
  else q191693_ennreal_zero.

Definition q191693_set_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q191693_measure m)
    (E : q191693_set A)
    (f : A -> q191693_ennreal)
    (value : q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q191693_lintegral_has_value mu
    (q191693_indicator E f) value.

Definition q191693_mutually_singular {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu nu : q191693_measure m) : Prop :=
  exists E : q191693_set A,
    q191693_measurable m E /\
    q191693_ennreal_eq
      (q191693_measure_value mu (q191693_complement E))
      q191693_ennreal_zero /\
    q191693_ennreal_eq
      (q191693_measure_value nu E)
      q191693_ennreal_zero.

Definition q191693_lebesgue_decomposition {A : Type}
    {m : q191693_measurable_space A}
    (mu singular nu : q191693_measure m)
    (f : A -> q191693_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q191693_measurable_ennreal_function m f /\
  q191693_mutually_singular singular nu /\
  forall E : q191693_set A,
    q191693_measurable m E ->
    exists density_value : q191693_ennreal,
      q191693_set_lintegral_has_value
        nu E f density_value /\
      q191693_ennreal_eq
        (q191693_measure_value mu E)
        (q191693_ennreal_add
          (q191693_measure_value singular E)
          density_value).

Theorem haveLebesgueDecomposition_of_sigmaFinite :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (m : q191693_measurable_space Alpha)
         (mu nu : q191693_measure m),
    q191693_s_finite mu ->
    q191693_sigma_finite nu ->
    exists (singular : q191693_measure m)
           (f : Alpha -> q191693_ennreal),
      q191693_lebesgue_decomposition mu singular nu f.
Admitted.

title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q191693,
  "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem": an s-finite measure relative to a
  sigma-finite measure on the same arbitrary measurable space decomposes into
  a mutually singular measure and a measure given by a measurable ennreal
  density. This file contains no proof.
*)
theory Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Radon_Nikodym"
begin

definition q191693_same_measurable_space ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q191693_same_measurable_space M N \<longleftrightarrow>
    sets M = sets N \<and> space M = UNIV \<and> space N = UNIV"

definition q191693_s_finite :: "'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q191693_s_finite M \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>F :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure.
      (\<forall>n. q191693_same_measurable_space M (F n) \<and>
        finite_measure (F n)) \<and>
      (\<forall>A \<in> sets M.
        emeasure M A = (\<Sum>n. emeasure (F n) A)))"

definition q191693_mutually_singular ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q191693_mutually_singular M N \<longleftrightarrow>
    q191693_same_measurable_space M N \<and>
    (\<exists>A \<in> sets M. emeasure M A = 0 \<and> emeasure N (- A) = 0)"

definition q191693_decomposition_witness ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q191693_decomposition_witness M N S f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q191693_same_measurable_space M N \<and>
    q191693_same_measurable_space M S \<and>
    f \<in> borel_measurable N \<and>
    q191693_mutually_singular S N \<and>
    (\<forall>A \<in> sets M.
      emeasure M A = emeasure S A + emeasure (density N f) A)"

definition have_lebesgue_decomposition_of_sigma_finite ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "have_lebesgue_decomposition_of_sigma_finite M N \<longleftrightarrow>
    (q191693_same_measurable_space M N \<longrightarrow>
      q191693_s_finite M \<longrightarrow>
      sigma_finite_measure N \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>S f. q191693_decomposition_witness M N S f))"

end

title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q191693,
  "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem": every s-finite measure decomposes,
  relative to a sigma-finite measure, into a mutually singular measure and
  a measure with a measurable extended-nonnegative density. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q191693_LEBESGUE_S_DECOMPOSITION_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let eembed =
      \(z:bool#real).
        if FST z then &1 else SND z / (&1 + SND z) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        {} IN events /\
        (UNIV:A->bool) IN events /\
        (!s. s IN events ==> (UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let measure_equal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (nu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !s:A->bool. s IN events ==> mu s = nu s in
   let finite_measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        measure_space events mu /\ ~(FST (mu (UNIV:A->bool))) in
   let sfinite_measure =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        measure_space events mu /\
        ?parts:num->(A->bool)->bool#real.
          (!n. finite_measure_space events (parts n)) /\
          (!s:A->bool.
             s IN events
             ==> esum (\n. parts n s) (mu s)) in
   let sigma_finite_measure =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        measure_space events mu /\
        ?sets:num->A->bool.
          (!n. sets n IN events /\ ~(FST (mu (sets n)))) /\
          {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n} = (UNIV:A->bool) in
   let sequence_etends =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n)) /\
        (!e. &0 < e
             ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                          ==> abs(eembed (u n) - eembed l) < e) in
   let simple_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool#real).
        (!x. enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s (UNIV:A->bool)) /\
        (!c:bool#real. {x:A | s x = c} IN events) in
   let strongly_measurable_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->bool#real).
        (!x. enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?s:num->A->bool#real.
          (!n. simple_ennreal events (s n)) /\
          (!x. sequence_etends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x. x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n enum partial.
          (!x. x IN items <=> ?i. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (s:A->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s (UNIV:A->bool))
          (\c. emul c (mu {x:A | s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v. p v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!v. p v ==> ele v w)
             ==> ele z w) in
   let lintegral =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (f:A->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v. ?s:A->bool#real.
                   simple_ennreal events s /\
                   (!x. ele (s x) (f x)) /\
                   simple_lintegral mu s v)
            z in
   let with_density =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (nu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (f:A->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool).
        lintegral events nu
          (\x:A. if x IN s then f x else ezero) in
   let measure_add =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (nu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (s:A->bool).
        eadd (mu s) (nu s) in
   let mutually_singular =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (nu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        ?s:A->bool.
          s IN events /\
          mu ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s) = ezero /\
          nu s = ezero in
   !events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    nu:(A->bool)->bool#real.
      sfinite_measure events mu /\
      sigma_finite_measure events nu
      ==>
      ?xi:(A->bool)->bool#real
       f:A->bool#real.
        measure_space events xi /\
        strongly_measurable_ennreal events f /\
        mutually_singular events xi nu /\
        measure_equal events mu
          (measure_add xi (with_density events nu f))`;;

title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q191693,
;; "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem": on an arbitrary measurable space, every
;; s-finite measure has a decomposition relative to every sigma-finite measure
;; into a mutually singular measure and a measure with measurable density.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The conservative interfaces below range over unrestricted ACL2 objects.
;; Their laws explicitly present a complete ordered real field, extended
;; nonnegative reals, arbitrary sets and functions, a sigma algebra,
;; countably additive measures, and the lower Lebesgue integral.  S-finiteness
;; is represented by a countable sum of finite measures, sigma-finiteness by a
;; countable measurable finite-measure cover, and both decomposition witnesses
;; remain internally existential.

;; Real scalars and arbitrary mathematical objects.

(defstub q191693-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q191693-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q191693-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q191693-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q191693-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q191693-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q191693-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q191693-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q191693-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q191693-domain-member-p (domain value) t)
(defstub q191693-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q191693-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q191693-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q191693-measure-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q191693-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q191693-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q191693-lintegral-value
  (lintegral domain measurable measure function) t)

(defun q191693-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q191693-r-less real right left)))

(defun-sk q191693-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-r-member-p real x)
      (q191693-r-member-p real y)
      (q191693-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q191693-r-zero real))
            (one (q191693-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q191693-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q191693-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q191693-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q191693-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q191693-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q191693-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q191693-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q191693-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q191693-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q191693-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q191693-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q191693-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q191693-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q191693-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q191693-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q191693-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q191693-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q191693-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q191693-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q191693-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q191693-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q191693-r-multiply
          real x (q191693-r-add real y z))
         (q191693-r-add
          real
          (q191693-r-multiply real x y)
          (q191693-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q191693-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-r-member-p real x)
      (q191693-r-member-p real y)
      (q191693-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q191693-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q191693-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q191693-r-less real x y)
         (q191693-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q191693-r-less real x y)
          (q191693-r-less real y z))
         (q191693-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q191693-r-less real x y)
         (q191693-r-less
          real
          (q191693-r-add real x z)
          (q191693-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q191693-r-less real zero x)
          (q191693-r-less real zero y))
         (q191693-r-less
          real zero
          (q191693-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q191693-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q191693-r-member-p real x)
     (q191693-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q191693-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-r-member-p real x)
      (q191693-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q191693-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q191693-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q191693-r-member-p real bound)
     (q191693-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q191693-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q191693-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q191693-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q191693-r-member-p real bound)
       (q191693-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q191693-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q191693-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q191693-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q191693-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q191693-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q191693-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q191693-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q191693-r-zero real))
        (one (q191693-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q191693-r-member-p real zero)
     (q191693-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q191693-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q191693-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q191693-r-less real zero one)
     (q191693-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q191693-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q191693-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q191693-finite)
    (q191693-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q191693-r-leq
     real (q191693-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q191693-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q191693-finite value))

(defun q191693-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q191693-ennreal-finite (q191693-r-zero real)))

(defun q191693-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q191693-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q191693-top) t)
   (t (q191693-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q191693-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q191693-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q191693-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q191693-top)
          (equal right :q191693-top))
      :q191693-top
    (q191693-ennreal-finite
     (q191693-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q191693-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q191693-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q191693-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q191693-top)
        (equal right :q191693-top))
    :q191693-top)
   (t
    (q191693-ennreal-finite
     (q191693-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

;; Sets, sigma algebras, and countably additive measures.

(defun-sk q191693-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q191693-set-member-p set x)
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q191693-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q191693-set-member-p left x)
      (q191693-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q191693-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q191693-set-member-p set x)
     (and (q191693-domain-member-p domain x) nil))))

(defun-sk q191693-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q191693-set-member-p complement x)
     (and
      (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not (q191693-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q191693-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q191693-valid-set-p
      domain
      (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q191693-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q191693-set-member-p
      (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q191693-sequence-union-set-p
    (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q191693-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q191693-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q191693-family-extensional-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q191693-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q191693-family-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q191693-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q191693-measurable-empty-exists-p (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q191693-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q191693-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q191693-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q191693-measurable-complements-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q191693-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q191693-sequence-measurable-p (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q191693-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q191693-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q191693-measurable-sequence-unions-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q191693-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence))
     (q191693-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q191693-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q191693-family-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q191693-family-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q191693-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q191693-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q191693-measurable-sequence-unions-p domain measurable)))

(defun-sk q191693-disjoint-sets-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q191693-set-member-p left x)
      (q191693-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q191693-pairwise-disjoint-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n)))
     (q191693-disjoint-sets-p
      (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q191693-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q191693-ennreal-zero real)
    (q191693-ennreal-add
     real
     (q191693-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q191693-measure-value
      measure
      (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q191693-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q191693-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q191693-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q191693-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q191693-ennreal-p real total)
     (q191693-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q191693-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q191693-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q191693-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q191693-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value measure left)
      (q191693-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-values-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-valid-set-p domain set)
      (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set))
     (q191693-ennreal-p
      real (q191693-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q191693-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value measure empty)
      (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q191693-countably-additive-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q191693-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q191693-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence)
      (q191693-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q191693-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q191693-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun q191693-measure-space-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q191693-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q191693-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q191693-measure-values-p real domain measurable measure)
   (q191693-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q191693-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)))

;; Finite, s-finite, and sigma-finite measures.

(defun-sk q191693-universe-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q191693-set-member-p set x)
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q191693-finite-measure-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (exists (universe)
    (and
     (q191693-universe-set-p domain universe)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable universe)
     (q191693-ennreal-less
      real
      (q191693-measure-value measure universe)
      :q191693-top))))

(defun-sk q191693-finite-measure-sequence-p
    (real domain measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (let ((measure
            (q191693-measure-sequence-value sequence n)))
       (and
        (q191693-measure-space-p
         real domain measurable measure)
        (q191693-finite-measure-p
         real domain measurable measure))))))

(defun q191693-measure-sequence-prefix-sum
    (real sequence set count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q191693-ennreal-zero real)
    (q191693-ennreal-add
     real
     (q191693-measure-sequence-prefix-sum
      real sequence set (1- count))
     (q191693-measure-value
      (q191693-measure-sequence-value sequence (1- count))
      set))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-sequence-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real sequence set bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q191693-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q191693-measure-sequence-prefix-sum
       real sequence set count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-sequence-sum-value-p
    (real sequence set total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q191693-ennreal-p real total)
     (q191693-measure-sequence-sum-upper-bound-p
      real sequence set total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q191693-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q191693-measure-sequence-sum-upper-bound-p
        real sequence set bound))
      (q191693-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-is-sequence-sum-p
    (real measurable sequence measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q191693-measure-sequence-sum-value-p
      real sequence set
      (q191693-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q191693-s-finite-measure-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (exists (sequence)
    (and
     (q191693-finite-measure-sequence-p
      real domain measurable sequence)
     (q191693-measure-is-sequence-sum-p
      real measurable sequence measure))))

(defun-sk q191693-sequence-covers-domain-p
    (domain sequence)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q191693-sequence-union-member-p sequence x))))

(defun-sk q191693-sequence-has-finite-measure-p
    (real measurable measure sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (and
      (q191693-measurable-set-p
       measurable
       (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence n))
      (q191693-ennreal-less
       real
       (q191693-measure-value
        measure
        (q191693-set-sequence-value sequence n))
       :q191693-top)))))

(defun-sk q191693-sigma-finite-measure-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (exists (sequence)
    (and
     (q191693-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
     (q191693-sequence-covers-domain-p domain sequence)
     (q191693-sequence-has-finite-measure-p
      real measurable measure sequence))))

;; Measurable extended-nonnegative-real functions.

(defun-sk q191693-ennreal-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q191693-ennreal-p
      real (q191693-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q191693-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q191693-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q191693-ennreal-less
       real threshold
       (q191693-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q191693-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q191693-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q191693-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q191693-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q191693-ennreal-p real threshold)
      (q191693-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

;; The lower Lebesgue integral is the supremum of integrals of measurable
;; finite-range simple functions below the integrand.

(defun-sk q191693-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q191693-function-value function x)
      value))))

(defun q191693-values-attained-p
    (domain function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q191693-value-attained-p
        domain function (car values))
       (q191693-values-attained-p
        domain function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q191693-ennreal-value-list-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q191693-ennreal-p real (car values))
       (q191693-ennreal-value-list-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q191693-range-in-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
     (member-equal
      (q191693-function-value function x)
      values))))

(defun-sk q191693-fiber-set-p
    (domain function value set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q191693-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q191693-function-value function x)
       value)))))

(defun q191693-fiber-list-p
    (domain function values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (consp fibers)
       (q191693-fiber-set-p
        domain function (car values) (car fibers))
       (q191693-fiber-list-p
        domain function (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (equal fibers nil)))

(defun q191693-finite-simple-integral
    (real measure values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (q191693-ennreal-add
       real
       (q191693-ennreal-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q191693-measure-value measure (car fibers)))
       (q191693-finite-simple-integral
        real measure (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))

(defun q191693-simple-function-data-p
    (real domain measurable function values fibers)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (true-listp fibers)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q191693-ennreal-value-list-p real values)
   (q191693-values-attained-p domain function values)
   (q191693-range-in-values-p domain function values)
   (q191693-fiber-list-p domain function values fibers)
   (q191693-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    real domain measurable function)))

(defun-sk q191693-simple-below-p
    (real domain simple function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q191693-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q191693-function-value simple x)
      (q191693-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q191693-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values fibers)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-simple-function-data-p
       real domain measurable simple values fibers)
      (q191693-simple-below-p
       real domain simple function))
     (q191693-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q191693-finite-simple-integral
       real measure values fibers)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q191693-lintegral-value-p
    (real domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q191693-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q191693-ennreal-p real value)
     (q191693-lintegral-upper-bound-p
      real domain measurable measure function value)
     (implies
      (and
       (q191693-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q191693-lintegral-upper-bound-p
        real domain measurable measure function bound))
      (q191693-ennreal-leq real value bound)))))

(defun-sk q191693-lintegral-operation-p
    (real domain measurable lintegral)
  (forall (measure function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-measure-space-p
       real domain measurable measure)
      (q191693-ennreal-function-p real domain function))
     (q191693-lintegral-value-p
      real domain measurable measure function
      (q191693-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure function)))))

;; Measure equality, addition, absolute continuity, and mutual singularity.

(defun-sk q191693-measure-equal-p
    (domain measurable left right)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value left set)
      (q191693-measure-value right set)))))

(defun-sk q191693-measure-addition-p
    (real measurable left right total)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value total set)
      (q191693-ennreal-add
       real
       (q191693-measure-value left set)
       (q191693-measure-value right set))))))

(defun-sk q191693-absolutely-continuous-p
    (real measurable mu nu)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
      (equal
       (q191693-measure-value nu set)
       (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value mu set)
      (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q191693-mutually-singular-p
    (real domain measurable left right)
  (exists (set complement)
    (and
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q191693-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable complement)
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value left set)
      (q191693-ennreal-zero real))
     (equal
      (q191693-measure-value right complement)
      (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))))

;; The measure with density f has value integral (1_s f) dnu on each
;; measurable set s.

(defun-sk q191693-restricted-density-function-p
    (real domain set density restricted)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q191693-ennreal-function-p real domain restricted)
     (implies
      (q191693-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q191693-function-value restricted x)
       (if (q191693-set-member-p set x)
           (q191693-function-value density x)
         (q191693-ennreal-zero real)))))))

(defun-sk q191693-with-density-value-p
    (real domain measurable base density lintegral set value)
  (exists (restricted)
    (and
     (q191693-restricted-density-function-p
      real domain set density restricted)
     (equal
      value
      (q191693-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable base restricted)))))

(defun-sk q191693-with-density-values-p
    (real domain measurable base density density-measure lintegral)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q191693-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q191693-with-density-value-p
      real domain measurable base density lintegral set
      (q191693-measure-value density-measure set)))))

(defun q191693-with-density-p
    (real domain measurable base density density-measure lintegral)
  (and
   (q191693-measure-space-p
    real domain measurable density-measure)
   (q191693-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    real domain measurable density)
   (q191693-with-density-values-p
    real domain measurable base density density-measure lintegral)))

;; HaveLebesgueDecomposition is the source existential package.

(defun q191693-decomposition-singular-part (package)
  (nth 0 package))

(defun q191693-decomposition-derivative (package)
  (nth 1 package))

(defun q191693-decomposition-density-measure (package)
  (nth 2 package))

(defun q191693-decomposition-package-p
    (real domain measurable mu nu lintegral package)
  (let ((singular-part
         (q191693-decomposition-singular-part package))
        (derivative
         (q191693-decomposition-derivative package))
        (density-measure
         (q191693-decomposition-density-measure package)))
    (and
     (true-listp package)
     (equal (len package) 3)
     (q191693-measure-space-p
      real domain measurable singular-part)
     (q191693-with-density-p
      real domain measurable nu derivative density-measure lintegral)
     (q191693-mutually-singular-p
      real domain measurable singular-part nu)
     (q191693-measure-addition-p
      real measurable singular-part density-measure mu))))

(defun-sk q191693-have-lebesgue-decomposition-p
    (real domain measurable mu nu lintegral)
  (exists (package)
    (q191693-decomposition-package-p
     real domain measurable mu nu lintegral package)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q191693-lebesgue-decomposition-statement ()
  (forall (real domain measurable mu nu lintegral)
    (implies
     (and
      (q191693-real-field-p real)
      (q191693-measure-space-p
       real domain measurable mu)
      (q191693-measure-space-p
       real domain measurable nu)
      (q191693-lintegral-operation-p
       real domain measurable lintegral)
      (q191693-s-finite-measure-p
       real domain measurable mu)
      (q191693-sigma-finite-measure-p
       real domain measurable nu))
     (q191693-have-lebesgue-decomposition-p
      real domain measurable mu nu lintegral))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q191693,
-- "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem": every s-finite measure has a
-- decomposition relative to any sigma-finite measure into a mutually singular
-- measure and a measure with measurable extended-nonnegative density. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

-- A rational is the integer positivePart - negativePart divided by
-- suc denominatorCode. Equality and order below quotient this presentation.
record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart   : Nat
    negativePart   : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue : Rational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

multiplyQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
multiplyQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N positivePart r) +N
     (negativePart q *N negativePart r))
    ((positivePart q *N negativePart r) +N
     (negativePart q *N positivePart r))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalEqual q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  ==
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLE : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalLE q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <=N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLT : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalLT q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

-- Reals are located lower Dedekind cuts of the concrete rationals.
record DedekindReal : Set1 where
  field
    lower :
      Rational ->
      Set

    lower-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (lower q) (lower r)

    lower-inhabited :
      Exists Rational lower

    lower-proper :
      Exists Rational (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    lower-downward :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    lower-rounded :
      (q : Rational) ->
      lower q ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT q r) (lower r))

    lower-located :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

open DedekindReal

record NonnegativeReal : Set1 where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    real :
      DedekindReal

    nonnegative :
      (q : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      lower real q

open NonnegativeReal

data ENNReal : Set1 where
  finite     : NonnegativeReal -> ENNReal
  infinity   : ENNReal
  sumENN     : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal
  productENN : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal

-- Every constructor is interpreted by its complete rational lower cut.
-- Product convolution is total: infinity times an extensionally zero value
-- has the zero cut without requiring a decision that the second value is zero.
ENNLower : ENNReal -> Rational -> Set
ENNLower (finite x) r =
  lower (real x) r
ENNLower infinity r =
  Top
ENNLower (sumENN x y) r =
  Exists Rational
    (\ p ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ q ->
          Both
            (Both (ENNLower x p) (ENNLower y q))
            (RationalLT r (addQ p q))))
ENNLower (productENN x y) r =
  Either
    (RationalLT r zeroQ)
    (Exists Rational
      (\ p ->
        Exists Rational
          (\ q ->
            Both
              (Both
                (RationalLT zeroQ p)
                (Both
                  (RationalLT zeroQ q)
                  (Both (ENNLower x p) (ENNLower y q))))
              (RationalLT r (multiplyQ p q)))))

ENNEqual : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Set
ENNEqual x y =
  (r : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x r) (ENNLower y r)

ENNLE : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Set
ENNLE x y =
  (r : Rational) ->
  ENNLower x r ->
  ENNLower y r

ENNStrictLess : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Set
ENNStrictLess x y =
  Both (ENNLE x y) (Not (ENNEqual x y))

IsZeroENN : ENNReal -> Set
IsZeroENN x =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x q) (RationalLT q zeroQ)

-- The canonical operation graphs are equality to total semantic constructors.
ENNAdd : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Set
ENNAdd x y z =
  ENNEqual z (sumENN x y)

ENNMultiply : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Set
ENNMultiply x y z =
  ENNEqual z (productENN x y)

IsSupremum :
  {p : Level} ->
  (ENNReal -> Set p) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set (lsuc lzero ⊔ p)
IsSupremum candidates bound =
  Both
    ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE x bound)
    ((upper : ENNReal) ->
      ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE x upper) ->
      ENNLE bound upper)

IsInfimum :
  {p : Level} ->
  (ENNReal -> Set p) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set (lsuc lzero ⊔ p)
IsInfimum candidates bound =
  Both
    ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE bound x)
    ((lowerBound : ENNReal) ->
      ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE lowerBound x) ->
      ENNLE lowerBound bound)

data FiniteSum
  (terms : Nat -> ENNReal) :
  Nat ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set1 where

  empty-sum :
    {value : ENNReal} ->
    IsZeroENN value ->
    FiniteSum terms zero value

  next-sum :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {partial total : ENNReal} ->
    FiniteSum terms n partial ->
    ENNAdd partial (terms n) total ->
    FiniteSum terms (suc n) total

CountableSum :
  (Nat -> ENNReal) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set1
CountableSum terms total =
  IsSupremum
    (\ value ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> FiniteSum terms n value))
    total

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Whole :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Whole _ =
  Top

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

SamePredicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
SamePredicate {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set a
PairwiseDisjoint {a = a} {A = A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom {a}

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where
  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A ->
      Set

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

-- A measure is presented concretely by its outer mass together with the
-- outer-measure and Caratheodory laws. Countable additivity is stated with the
-- canonical extended-real countable sum above.
record Measure
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    mass :
      Predicate A ->
      ENNReal

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      ENNEqual (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-trimmed :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      IsInfimum
        (\ value ->
          Exists (Predicate A)
            (\ T ->
              Both
                (measurable events T)
                (Both
                  (Subset S T)
                  (ENNEqual value (mass T)))))
        (mass S)

    mass-empty :
      IsZeroENN (mass Empty)

    mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      ENNLE (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      (sum : ENNReal) ->
      CountableSum (\ n -> mass (sets n)) sum ->
      ENNLE (mass (CountableUnion sets)) sum

    measurable-caratheodory :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      ENNAdd
        (mass (Intersection T S))
        (mass (Intersection T (Complement S)))
        (mass T)

    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        (mass (CountableUnion sets))

open Measure

MeasureEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Measure events ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
MeasureEqual {A = A} {events = events} mu nu =
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  measurable events S ->
  ENNEqual (mass mu S) (mass nu S)

AbsolutelyContinuous :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Measure events ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
AbsolutelyContinuous {A = A} mu nu =
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  IsZeroENN (mass nu S) ->
  IsZeroENN (mass mu S)

MutuallySingular :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Measure events ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
MutuallySingular {A = A} {events = events} mu nu =
  Exists (Predicate A)
    (\ S ->
      Both
        (measurable events S)
        (Both
          (IsZeroENN (mass mu (Complement S)))
          (IsZeroENN (mass nu S))))

MeasurableENN :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  (A -> ENNReal) ->
  Set1
MeasurableENN events f =
  (c : ENNReal) ->
  Both
    (measurable events (\ x -> ENNLE (f x) c))
    (measurable events (\ x -> ENNStrictLess c (f x)))

record IndexedSimpleBelowOn
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (S : Predicate A)
  (f : A -> ENNReal) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    cutoff :
      Nat

    index :
      A ->
      Nat

    index-bounded :
      (x : A) ->
      index x <=N cutoff

    simpleValues :
      Nat ->
      ENNReal

    measurable-fibers :
      (n : Nat) ->
      measurable events (\ x -> index x == n)

    below-on-set :
      (x : A) ->
      Both
        (S x -> ENNLE (simpleValues (index x)) (f x))
        (Not (S x) -> IsZeroENN (simpleValues (index x)))

open IndexedSimpleBelowOn

SimpleIntegralValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (nu : Measure events) ->
  {S : Predicate A} ->
  {f : A -> ENNReal} ->
  IndexedSimpleBelowOn events S f ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set1
SimpleIntegralValue nu simple value =
  Exists (Nat -> ENNReal)
    (\ products ->
      Both
        ((n : Nat) ->
          ENNMultiply
            (simpleValues simple n)
            (mass nu (\ x -> index simple x == n))
            (products n))
        (FiniteSum products (suc (cutoff simple)) value))

SimpleIntegralCandidate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> ENNReal) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
SimpleIntegralCandidate nu S f value =
  Exists (IndexedSimpleBelowOn _ S f)
    (\ simple -> SimpleIntegralValue nu simple value)

LowerIntegralOnValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> ENNReal) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
LowerIntegralOnValue nu S f value =
  IsSupremum
    (SimpleIntegralCandidate nu S f)
    value

-- A measure has the canonical withDensity values when every measurable-set
-- value is the lower integral of the density over that set.
DefinesWithDensity :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  (A -> ENNReal) ->
  Measure events ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
DefinesWithDensity {A = A} {events = events} nu f rho =
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  measurable events S ->
  LowerIntegralOnValue nu S f (mass rho S)

-- Since measures are trimmed, measurable-set equality is canonical measure
-- equality. This relation therefore states exactly nu.withDensity f = rho.
WithDensity :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  (A -> ENNReal) ->
  Measure events ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
WithDensity {events = events} nu f rho =
  Exists (Measure events)
    (\ weighted ->
      Both
        (DefinesWithDensity nu f weighted)
        (MeasureEqual weighted rho))

MeasureAdd :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Measure events ->
  Measure events ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
MeasureAdd {A = A} mu nu total =
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  ENNAdd (mass mu S) (mass nu S) (mass total S)

FiniteMeasure :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Measure events ->
  Set
FiniteMeasure mu =
  Not (ENNEqual (mass mu Whole) infinity)

record SFiniteMeasure
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (mu : Measure events) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    finiteParts :
      Nat ->
      Measure events

    finiteParts-finite :
      (n : Nat) ->
      FiniteMeasure (finiteParts n)

    finiteParts-sum-to-measure :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      CountableSum
        (\ n -> mass (finiteParts n) S)
        (mass mu S)

record SigmaFiniteMeasure
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (nu : Measure events) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    spanningSets :
      Nat ->
      Predicate A

    spanningSets-measurable :
      (n : Nat) ->
      measurable events (spanningSets n)

    spanningSets-finite :
      (n : Nat) ->
      Not (ENNEqual (mass nu (spanningSets n)) infinity)

    spanningSets-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> spanningSets n x)

-- The source theorem's typeclass contains a Lebesgue decomposition. Its
-- internal density is the Radon-Nikodym derivative selected by that instance.
record HaveLebesgueDecomposition
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (mu nu : Measure events) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    singularPart :
      Measure events

    derivative :
      A ->
      ENNReal

    derivative-measurable :
      MeasurableENN events derivative

    densityPart :
      Measure events

    density-part-definition :
      DefinesWithDensity nu derivative densityPart

    singular-part-mutually-singular :
      MutuallySingular singularPart nu

    decomposition-equation :
      MeasureAdd singularPart densityPart mu

open HaveLebesgueDecomposition

lebesgue-decomposition-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
lebesgue-decomposition-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (mu nu : Measure events) ->
  SFiniteMeasure mu ->
  SigmaFiniteMeasure nu ->
  HaveLebesgueDecomposition mu nu

title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q191693, "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem": an s-finite measure admits,
  relative to a sigma-finite measure, a decomposition into a mutually singular
  measure and a measure with a nonnegative measurable density. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q191693_sfinite_def = new_definition (
  "q191693_sfinite_def",
  ``q191693_sfinite (mu : 'a m_space) <=>
      ?parts : num -> 'a set -> extreal.
        (!n.
          measure_space
            (m_space mu, measurable_sets mu, parts n) /\
          parts n (m_space mu) <> PosInf) /\
        !s.
          s IN measurable_sets mu ==>
          measure mu s = suminf (\n. parts n s)``);

val q191693_mutually_singular_def = new_definition (
  "q191693_mutually_singular_def",
  ``q191693_mutually_singular
      (xi : 'a m_space) (nu : 'a m_space) <=>
      ?s : 'a set.
        s IN measurable_sets nu /\
        measure xi s = 0 /\
        measure nu (m_space nu DIFF s) = 0``);

val q191693_decomposition_witness_def = new_definition (
  "q191693_decomposition_witness_def",
  ``q191693_decomposition_witness
      (mu : 'a m_space) (nu : 'a m_space)
      (xi : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> extreal) <=>
      measure_space xi /\
      m_space xi = m_space mu /\
      measurable_sets xi = measurable_sets mu /\
      f IN measurable (m_space nu, measurable_sets nu) Borel /\
      (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
      q191693_mutually_singular xi nu /\
      !s.
        s IN measurable_sets mu ==>
        measure mu s =
          measure xi s + measure (density nu f) s``);

val q191693_have_lebesgue_decomposition_def = new_definition (
  "q191693_have_lebesgue_decomposition_def",
  ``q191693_have_lebesgue_decomposition
      (mu : 'a m_space) (nu : 'a m_space) <=>
      ?xi f. q191693_decomposition_witness mu nu xi f``);

val lebesgue_decomposition_theorem =
  ``!(mu : 'a m_space) (nu : 'a m_space).
      measure_space mu /\
      measure_space nu /\
      m_space mu = UNIV /\
      m_space nu = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets mu = measurable_sets nu /\
      q191693_sfinite mu /\
      sigma_finite nu
      ==>
      q191693_have_lebesgue_decomposition mu nu``;

title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q191693
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q191693), "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem":
  every s-finite measure has a decomposition, relative to any sigma-finite
  measure on the same measurable space, into a mutually singular measure and
  a measure with measurable extended-nonnegative density. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q191693Simple and Q191693SimpleIntegral describe finite-range measurable
  extended-nonnegative simple functions and their integrals.
  Q191693LIntegral is the lower Lebesgue integral, defined as the supremum of
  the integrals of simple functions bounded by its argument.

  Q191693SFinite says that a measure is a countable pointwise sum of finite
  measures on the same sigma-algebra. Q191693SigmaFinite says that the carrier
  is covered by a countable family of measurable sets of finite measure.
  Q191693Measurable states measurability into the extended nonnegative reals,
  Q191693WithDensityValue is the value on a measurable set of the measure
  obtained by weighting N by F, and Q191693MutuallySingular expands the
  standard measure-theoretic predicate.

  Q191693HaveDecomposition keeps both source witnesses internal: a measure S
  on the same sigma-algebra and a measurable density F, with S mutually
  singular to N and M equal pointwise to S plus the density measure.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  root artifact contains no local $p declaration.
$)

$c Q191693Simple Q191693SimpleIntegral Q191693LIntegral
   Q191693Measurable Q191693WithDensityValue
   Q191693SFinite Q191693SigmaFinite Q191693MutuallySingular
   Q191693HaveDecomposition $.

q191693-simple-syntax $a wff ( Q191693Simple M G ) $.
q191693-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q191693SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q191693-lintegral-syntax $a class ( Q191693LIntegral M H ) $.
q191693-measurable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q191693Measurable M F ) $.
q191693-with-density-value-syntax
  $a class ( Q191693WithDensityValue N F A ) $.
q191693-sfinite-syntax $a wff ( Q191693SFinite M ) $.
q191693-sigma-finite-syntax $a wff ( Q191693SigmaFinite N ) $.
q191693-mutually-singular-syntax
  $a wff ( Q191693MutuallySingular M N ) $.
q191693-have-decomposition-syntax
  $a wff ( Q191693HaveDecomposition M N ) $.

${
  $d G M $.

  q191693-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q191693Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q191693-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q191693SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q191693-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q191693LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q191693Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M
                ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q191693SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M $.

  q191693-measurable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q191693Measurable M F )
    <->
    (
      F : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      F e.
        (
          dom M
          MblFnM
          (
            sigaGen `
            ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F N x $.

  q191693-with-density-value-definition $a |- (
    Q191693WithDensityValue N F A
  ) =
    (
      Q191693LIntegral
      N
      ( x e. U. dom N |->
        if
        (
          x e. A ,
          ( F ` x ) ,
          0
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A F M n $.

  q191693-sfinite-definition $a |- (
    ( Q191693SFinite M )
    <->
    E. F
      (
        F Fn NN0
        /\
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( F ` n ) e. U. ran measures
              /\
              (
                dom ( F ` n ) = dom M
                /\
                ( ( F ` n ) ` U. dom M ) < +oo
              )
            )
          /\
          A. A e. dom M
            ( M ` A )
            =
            ( sum^ ` ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( F ` n ) ` A ) ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F N n $.

  q191693-sigma-finite-definition $a |- (
    ( Q191693SigmaFinite N )
    <->
    E. F e. ( ( dom N ) ^m NN0 )
      (
        A. n e. NN0
          ( ( N ` ( F ` n ) ) < +oo )
        /\
        U. ran F = U. dom N
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A M N $.

  q191693-mutually-singular-definition $a |- (
    ( Q191693MutuallySingular M N )
    <->
    (
      dom M = dom N
      /\
      E. A e. dom N
        (
          ( M ` ( U. dom N \ A ) ) = 0
          /\
          ( N ` A ) = 0
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F M N S $.

  q191693-have-decomposition-definition $a |- (
