title: Q191693_lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q191693,
% "Lebesgue's decomposition theorem": on an arbitrary, possibly empty,
% measurable carrier, every s-finite measure admits, relative to any
% sigma-finite measure, a sum decomposition into a mutually singular measure
% and a measure with measurable extended-nonnegative density.
% This file contains no proof.

lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem_Q191693[
  A: TYPE,
  carrier: [A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  measure_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_map]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_finite(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  event_on_carrier(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event =
    carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): E(omega) AND F(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES event_on_carrier(E))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_finite(M(full_event))

  measure_sum(
      components: measure_sequence,
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES
        extended_nonnegative_sum(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            components(index)(E),
          M(E))

  s_finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND EXISTS (components: measure_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          finite_measure(components(index), Sigma))
          AND measure_sum(components, M, Sigma)

  sigma_finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND EXISTS (cover: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          Sigma(cover(index))
            AND measure_value_is_finite(M(cover(index))))
          AND (FORALL (omega: A):
            carrier(omega) IMPLIES
              EXISTS (index: nat):
                cover(index)(omega))

  measure_equal(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      left, right: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES left(E) = right(E)

  measure_add(left, right: measure_map): measure_map =
    LAMBDA (E: event):
      measure_value_add(left(E), right(E))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  sublevel_event(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(function_value(omega))
        AND finite_part(function_value(omega)) <= bound

  measurable_nonnegative_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        0 <= bound IMPLIES
          Sigma(sublevel_event(function_value, bound)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: measure_value):
        has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))

  restricted_function(
      E: event,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF E(omega) THEN
        function_value(omega)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  with_density(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): measure_map =
    LAMBDA (E: event):
      IF Sigma(E) THEN
        lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M,
          Sigma,
          restricted_function(E, function_value))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  mutually_singular(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (support: event):
      Sigma(support)
        AND measure_value_is_zero(
          M(event_complement(support)))
        AND measure_value_is_zero(N(support))

  decomposition_pair: TYPE =
    [# singular_component: measure_map,
       density_component: nonnegative_function #]

  is_lebesgue_decomposition(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      decomposition: decomposition_pair): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND is_measure(N, Sigma)
      AND is_measure(
        singular_component(decomposition), Sigma)
      AND measurable_nonnegative_function(
        Sigma, density_component(decomposition))
      AND mutually_singular(
        singular_component(decomposition), N, Sigma)
      AND measure_equal(
        Sigma,
        M,
        measure_add(
          singular_component(decomposition),
          with_density(
            N, Sigma, density_component(decomposition))))

  have_lebesgue_decomposition(
      M, N: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (decomposition: decomposition_pair):
      is_lebesgue_decomposition(
        M, N, Sigma, decomposition)

  lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (M, N: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      (s_finite_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND sigma_finite_measure(N, Sigma))
      IMPLIES
        have_lebesgue_decomposition(M, N, Sigma)
END lebesgue_s_decomposition_theorem_Q191693

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q192760
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q192760), "Fundamental theorem of algebra":
  the complex numbers are algebraically closed, expressed by the fact that
  every nonconstant complex polynomial has a complex root.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals.

Import ListNotations.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q192760_C : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q192760_zero : q192760_C := (0, 0).

Definition q192760_add (z w : q192760_C) : q192760_C :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q192760_mul (z w : q192760_C) : q192760_C :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Fixpoint q192760_eval
    (coefficients : list q192760_C) (z : q192760_C) : q192760_C :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => q192760_zero
  | coefficient :: higher_coefficients =>
      q192760_add coefficient
        (q192760_mul z (q192760_eval higher_coefficients z))
  end.

Fixpoint q192760_some_nonzero
    (coefficients : list q192760_C) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => False
  | coefficient :: higher_coefficients =>
      coefficient <> q192760_zero \/
      q192760_some_nonzero higher_coefficients
  end.

Definition q192760_nonconstant
    (coefficients : list q192760_C) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => False
  | _ :: positive_degree_coefficients =>
      q192760_some_nonzero positive_degree_coefficients
  end.

Definition q192760_is_algebraically_closed : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : list q192760_C,
    q192760_nonconstant coefficients ->
    exists z : q192760_C,
      q192760_eval coefficients z = q192760_zero.

Theorem Complex_isAlgClosed :
  q192760_is_algebraically_closed.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q192760
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q192760), "Fundamental theorem of algebra":
  every nonconstant polynomial over the complex numbers has a complex root.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q192760_FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_ALGEBRA =
  `let complex_zero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
   let complex_add =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       (FST x + FST y,SND x + SND y) in
   let complex_mul =
     \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
       (FST x * FST y - SND x * SND y,
        FST x * SND y + SND x * FST y) in
   let polynomial_value =
     \(p:(real#real)list) (z:real#real).
       ITLIST
         (\a value. complex_add a (complex_mul z value))
         p complex_zero in
   !p:(real#real)list.
     (?u v:real#real. ~(polynomial_value p u = polynomial_value p v))
     ==> ?z:real#real. polynomial_value p z = complex_zero`;;

title: Q192760_fundamental_theorem_of_algebra
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q192760,
;; "Fundamental theorem of algebra": every nonconstant polynomial over the
;; complex numbers has a complex root. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Scalars are presented as an arbitrary real closed ordered field. Complex
;; numbers are pairs of scalars, and univariate polynomials are finite
;; coefficient lists in ascending degree order. An ordered field is real
;; closed exactly when its complexification is algebraically closed; thus this
;; is a bidirectionally equivalent first-order rendering of
;; Complex.isAlgClosed for the usual complex numbers.
;;
;; FN-EQUAL against a constant-true function supplies unbounded universal
;; quantification. Its negation supplies the complex root existentially inside
;; the statement, rather than exposing a root or root selector as a parameter.
;; Every reified function uses only ACL2 primitives, loop scions, and APPLY$
;; calls on quoted tame functions. Finite Horner traces certify evaluation.

(defun q192760-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q192760-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q192760-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q192760-quoted nil)))

(defun q192760-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   (q192760-quoted function)
   (q192760-term-list arguments)))

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q192760
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q192760), "Fundamental theorem of algebra":
-- every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has a complex root.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q192760_fundamental_theorem_of_algebra where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

Polynomial : Set -> Set
Polynomial R =
  List (Complex R)

evaluate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
evaluate reals [] z =
  zeroC reals
evaluate reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients) z =
  addC reals coefficient
    (multiplyC reals z (evaluate reals coefficients z))

data HasNonzeroCoefficient
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Polynomial R ->
  Set where

  here :
    {coefficient : Complex R} ->
    {coefficients : Polynomial R} ->
    coefficient != zeroC reals ->
    HasNonzeroCoefficient reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

  there :
    {coefficient : Complex R} ->
    {coefficients : Polynomial R} ->
    HasNonzeroCoefficient reals coefficients ->
    HasNonzeroCoefficient reals (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

Nonconstant :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set
Nonconstant reals [] =
  Bottom
Nonconstant reals (constant ∷ higher-coefficients) =
  HasNonzeroCoefficient reals higher-coefficients

AlgebraicallyClosedComplex :
  (R : Set) ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Set
AlgebraicallyClosedComplex R reals =
  (coefficients : Polynomial R) ->
  Nonconstant reals coefficients ->
  Exists (Complex R)
    (\ root ->
      evaluate reals coefficients root == zeroC reals)

fundamental-theorem-of-algebra : Set1
fundamental-theorem-of-algebra =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  AlgebraicallyClosedComplex R reals

title: Q192760_fundamental_theorem_of_algebra
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q192760
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q192760), "Fundamental theorem of algebra":
% every nonconstant complex polynomial has a complex root. This file contains no proof.

Q192760_fundamental_theorem_of_algebra: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: [nat -> complex],
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET k: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          polynomial_value(coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(coefficients(k), complex_power(z, k)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  complex_is_algebraically_closed: bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: [nat -> complex]), (degree: nat):
      (0 < degree
        AND NOT (coefficients(degree) = complex_zero))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (z: complex):
          polynomial_value(coefficients, z, degree + 1)
            = complex_zero
END Q192760_fundamental_theorem_of_algebra

title: Q193286_rolle_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193286
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q193286), "Rolle's theorem": a continuous real
  function with equal values at the endpoints of a nondegenerate closed
  interval has derivative zero at some interior point, where the derivative
  is totalized to zero at nondifferentiable points. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q193286_set : Type := R -> Prop.

Definition q193286_closed_interval
    (a b : R) : q193286_set :=
  fun x : R => a <= x /\ x <= b.

Definition q193286_open_interval
    (a b : R) : q193286_set :=
  fun x : R => a < x /\ x < b.

Definition q193286_continuous_within_at
    (f : R -> R) (s : q193286_set) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        s y ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs (f y - f x) < epsilon.

Definition q193286_continuous_on
    (f : R -> R) (s : q193286_set) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    s x ->
    q193286_continuous_within_at f s x.

Definition q193286_deriv
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists derivative : R,
            derivable_pt_lim f x derivative) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun derivative : R =>
          derivable_pt_lim f x derivative)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Theorem exists_deriv_eq_zero :
  forall (f : R -> R) (a b : R),
    a < b ->
    q193286_continuous_on f
      (q193286_closed_interval a b) ->
    f a = f b ->
    exists c : R,
      q193286_open_interval a b c /\
      q193286_deriv f c = 0.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193286,
  "Rolle's theorem": a real function continuous on a closed interval with
  equal endpoint values has an interior point where its derivative, totalized
  to zero at nondifferentiable points, is zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q193286_ROLLE_S_THEOREM =
  `let continuous_on_interval =
      \(f:real->real) (a:real) (b:real).
        !x:real.
          a <= x /\ x <= b
          ==> !epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon
                ==> ?delta:real.
                      &0 < delta /\
                      !y:real.
                        a <= y /\ y <= b /\ abs(y - x) < delta
                        ==> abs(f y - f x) < epsilon in
   let has_derivative_at =
      \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !y:real.
                  &0 < abs(y - x) /\ abs(y - x) < delta
                  ==> abs((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < epsilon in
   let total_derivative =
      \(f:real->real) (x:real).
        if (?d:real. has_derivative_at f d x)
        then (@d:real. has_derivative_at f d x)
        else &0 in
   !(f:real->real) a b.
     a < b /\
     continuous_on_interval f a b /\
     f a = f b
     ==> ?c. a < c /\ c < b /\ total_derivative f c = &0`;;

;; Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real field, and expand continuity

(defun q193286-abs (r-type x)

(defun q193286-in-closed-interval-p (r-type a b x)

     (q193286-real-p r-type (q193286-one r-type))

       (q193286-real-p r-type (q193286-inv r-type x))))

title: Q193286_rolle_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q193286,
-- "Rolle's theorem": a real function continuous on a nondegenerate closed
-- interval with equal endpoint values has an interior point where its
-- totalized derivative is zero. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q193286_rolle_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtractR reals center radius) point)
    (StrictLess reals point (addR reals center radius))

ClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ClosedInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals lower point)
    (lessOrEqualR reals point upper)

OpenInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
OpenInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower point)
    (StrictLess reals point upper)

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R} reals function domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          CloseTo reals (function point) epsilon (function y)))

ContinuousOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
ContinuousOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals function domain point

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point y =
  divideR reals
    (subtractR reals (function y) (function point))
    (subtractR reals y point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          y != point ->
          CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals function point y)))

TotalizedDerivativeEqualsZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
TotalizedDerivativeEqualsZero {R} reals function point =
  (derivative : R) ->
  DerivativeAt reals function point derivative ->
  derivative == zeroR reals

exists-deriv-eq-zero : Set2
exists-deriv-eq-zero =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  (a b : R) ->
  StrictLess reals a b ->
  ContinuousOn reals f (ClosedInterval reals a b) ->
  f a == f b ->
  Exists R
    (\ c ->
      Both
        (OpenInterval reals a b c)
        (TotalizedDerivativeEqualsZero reals f c))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q193286, "Rolle's theorem": a real function continuous on a closed interval
  with equal endpoint values has an interior point where its totalized
  derivative, defined to be zero at nondifferentiable points, is zero. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory derivativeTheory;

val exists_deriv_eq_zero =
  ``let deriv0 =
      \f : real -> real.
        \x : real.
          if f differentiable (at x) then vector_derivative f (at x) else 0
    in
      !(f : real -> real) (a : real) (b : real).
        a < b /\
        f continuous_on interval [a,b] /\
        f a = f b
        ==>
        ?c : real.
          a < c /\ c < b /\
          deriv0 f c = 0``;

$(

title: Q193286_rolle_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193286,
% "Rolle's theorem": a real function continuous on a nondegenerate closed
% interval with equal endpoint values has an interior point where its total
% derivative is zero. The total derivative is zero at nondifferentiable points.
% This file contains no proof.

Q193286_rolle_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]

  in_closed_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a <= x AND x <= b

  in_open_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a < x AND x < b

  continuous_on_closed_interval(
      f: real_function,
      a, b: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
            EXISTS (delta: posreal):
              FORALL (y: real):
                (in_closed_interval(y, a, b)
                  AND abs(y - x) < delta)
                  IMPLIES
                    abs(f(y) - f(x)) < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (h: real):
          (h /= 0 AND abs(h) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(x + h) - f(x)
                  - derivative * h)
                < epsilon_value * abs(h)

  differentiable_at(f: real_function, x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  deriv(f: real_function, x: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  exists_deriv_eq_zero: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function), (a, b: real):
      (a < b
        AND continuous_on_closed_interval(f, a, b)
        AND f(a) = f(b))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (c: real):
          in_open_interval(c, a, b)
            AND deriv(f, c) = 0
END Q193286_rolle_s_theorem

title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1933521
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1933521), "Kleene's recursion theorem": every
  binary partial-recursive operation on a program code and a natural input has
  a code whose partial evaluation is extensionally the operation applied to
  that same code. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Arith.Peano_dec.

Module Q1933521_Kleene_Recursion.

Definition q1933521_nat_pair (a b : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.ltb a b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b.

Definition q1933521_nat_unpair (n : nat) : nat * nat :=
  let s := Nat.sqrt n in
  if Nat.ltb (n - s * s) s
  then (n - s * s, s)
  else (s, n - s * s - s).

Inductive q1933521_code : Type :=
| Q1933521_Code_zero : q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_succ : q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_left : q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_right : q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_pair :
    q1933521_code -> q1933521_code -> q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_comp :
    q1933521_code -> q1933521_code -> q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_prec :
    q1933521_code -> q1933521_code -> q1933521_code
| Q1933521_Code_rfind :
    q1933521_code -> q1933521_code.

Fixpoint q1933521_code_encode (c : q1933521_code) : nat :=
  match c with
  | Q1933521_Code_zero => 0
  | Q1933521_Code_succ => 1
  | Q1933521_Code_left => 2
  | Q1933521_Code_right => 3
  | Q1933521_Code_pair cf cg =>
      2 * (2 * q1933521_nat_pair
        (q1933521_code_encode cf)
        (q1933521_code_encode cg)) + 4
  | Q1933521_Code_comp cf cg =>
      2 * (2 * q1933521_nat_pair
        (q1933521_code_encode cf)
        (q1933521_code_encode cg) + 1) + 4
  | Q1933521_Code_prec cf cg =>
      2 * (2 * q1933521_nat_pair
        (q1933521_code_encode cf)
        (q1933521_code_encode cg)) + 1 + 4
  | Q1933521_Code_rfind cf =>
      2 * (2 * q1933521_code_encode cf + 1) + 1 + 4
  end.

Inductive q1933521_evaluates :
    q1933521_code -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
| Q1933521_Eval_zero :
    forall input,
      q1933521_evaluates Q1933521_Code_zero input 0
| Q1933521_Eval_succ :
    forall input,
      q1933521_evaluates Q1933521_Code_succ input (S input)
| Q1933521_Eval_left :
    forall input,
      q1933521_evaluates Q1933521_Code_left input
        (fst (q1933521_nat_unpair input))
| Q1933521_Eval_right :
    forall input,
      q1933521_evaluates Q1933521_Code_right input
        (snd (q1933521_nat_unpair input))
| Q1933521_Eval_pair :
    forall cf cg input left_value right_value,
      q1933521_evaluates cf input left_value ->
      q1933521_evaluates cg input right_value ->
      q1933521_evaluates (Q1933521_Code_pair cf cg) input
        (q1933521_nat_pair left_value right_value)
| Q1933521_Eval_comp :
    forall cf cg input middle output,
      q1933521_evaluates cg input middle ->
      q1933521_evaluates cf middle output ->
      q1933521_evaluates (Q1933521_Code_comp cf cg) input output
| Q1933521_Eval_prec_zero :
    forall cf cg parameter output,
      q1933521_evaluates cf parameter output ->
      q1933521_evaluates (Q1933521_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q1933521_nat_pair parameter 0) output
| Q1933521_Eval_prec_succ :
    forall cf cg parameter index previous output,
      q1933521_evaluates (Q1933521_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q1933521_nat_pair parameter index) previous ->
      q1933521_evaluates cg
        (q1933521_nat_pair parameter
          (q1933521_nat_pair index previous)) output ->
      q1933521_evaluates (Q1933521_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q1933521_nat_pair parameter (S index)) output
| Q1933521_Eval_rfind :
    forall cf parameter start offset,
      q1933521_evaluates cf
        (q1933521_nat_pair parameter (offset + start)) 0 ->
      (forall i,
        (i < offset)%nat ->
        exists value,
          q1933521_evaluates cf
            (q1933521_nat_pair parameter (i + start)) value /\
          value <> 0) ->
      q1933521_evaluates (Q1933521_Code_rfind cf)
        (q1933521_nat_pair parameter start) (offset + start).

Record q1933521_partial_function : Type := {
  q1933521_graph : nat -> nat -> Prop;
  q1933521_graph_functional :
    forall input first second,
      q1933521_graph input first ->
      q1933521_graph input second ->
      first = second
}.

Arguments q1933521_graph _ _ _.

Definition q1933521_partrec2
    (f : q1933521_code -> q1933521_partial_function) : Prop :=
  exists program : q1933521_code,
    forall (c : q1933521_code) (input output : nat),
      q1933521_evaluates program
        (q1933521_nat_pair (q1933521_code_encode c) input) output <->
      q1933521_graph (f c) input output.

Theorem q1933521_kleene_second_recursion :
  forall f : q1933521_code -> q1933521_partial_function,
    q1933521_partrec2 f ->
    exists c : q1933521_code,
      forall input output : nat,
        q1933521_evaluates c input output <->
        q1933521_graph (f c) input output.
Proof.
Admitted.

End Q1933521_Kleene_Recursion.

title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1933521,
  "Kleene's recursion theorem": every binary partial-recursive function of a
  program code and a natural input has a code whose unary partial evaluation
  equals the function specialized to that same code. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
  imports Main
begin

datatype q1933521_code =
    Q1933521_Zero
  | Q1933521_Succ
  | Q1933521_Left
  | Q1933521_Right
  | Q1933521_Pair q1933521_code q1933521_code
  | Q1933521_Comp q1933521_code q1933521_code
  | Q1933521_Prec q1933521_code q1933521_code
  | Q1933521_Rfind q1933521_code

definition q1933521_nat_pair :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1933521_nat_pair a b =
    (if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b)"

fun q1933521_code_encode :: "q1933521_code \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q1933521_code_encode Q1933521_Zero = 0"
| "q1933521_code_encode Q1933521_Succ = 1"
| "q1933521_code_encode Q1933521_Left = 2"
| "q1933521_code_encode Q1933521_Right = 3"
| "q1933521_code_encode (Q1933521_Pair cf cg) =
    2 * (2 * q1933521_nat_pair
      (q1933521_code_encode cf) (q1933521_code_encode cg)) + 4"
| "q1933521_code_encode (Q1933521_Comp cf cg) =
    2 * (2 * q1933521_nat_pair
      (q1933521_code_encode cf) (q1933521_code_encode cg) + 1) + 4"
| "q1933521_code_encode (Q1933521_Prec cf cg) =
    2 * (2 * q1933521_nat_pair
      (q1933521_code_encode cf) (q1933521_code_encode cg)) + 5"
| "q1933521_code_encode (Q1933521_Rfind cf) =
    2 * (2 * q1933521_code_encode cf + 1) + 5"

inductive q1933521_code_eval ::
    "q1933521_code \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  eval_zero:
    "q1933521_code_eval Q1933521_Zero x 0"
| eval_succ:
    "q1933521_code_eval Q1933521_Succ x (Suc x)"
| eval_left:
    "q1933521_code_eval Q1933521_Left (q1933521_nat_pair a b) a"
| eval_right:
    "q1933521_code_eval Q1933521_Right (q1933521_nat_pair a b) b"
| eval_pair:
    "\<lbrakk>q1933521_code_eval cf x y; q1933521_code_eval cg x z\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q1933521_code_eval
        (Q1933521_Pair cf cg) x (q1933521_nat_pair y z)"
| eval_comp:
    "\<lbrakk>q1933521_code_eval cg x y; q1933521_code_eval cf y z\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q1933521_code_eval (Q1933521_Comp cf cg) x z"
| eval_prec_zero:
    "q1933521_code_eval cf a z
      \<Longrightarrow> q1933521_code_eval
        (Q1933521_Prec cf cg) (q1933521_nat_pair a 0) z"
| eval_prec_succ:
    "\<lbrakk>q1933521_code_eval
        (Q1933521_Prec cf cg) (q1933521_nat_pair a k) i;
      q1933521_code_eval cg
        (q1933521_nat_pair a (q1933521_nat_pair k i)) z\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q1933521_code_eval
        (Q1933521_Prec cf cg) (q1933521_nat_pair a (Suc k)) z"
| eval_rfind:
    "\<lbrakk>q1933521_code_eval cf (q1933521_nat_pair a (m + k)) 0;
      \<And>j. j < k \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>z. q1933521_code_eval cf
          (q1933521_nat_pair a (m + j)) z \<and> z \<noteq> 0\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q1933521_code_eval
        (Q1933521_Rfind cf) (q1933521_nat_pair a m) (m + k)"

type_synonym q1933521_partial_function = "nat \<Rightarrow> nat option"

definition q1933521_partrec2 ::
    "(q1933521_code \<Rightarrow> q1933521_partial_function) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q1933521_partrec2 f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>program. \<forall>c n y.
      q1933521_code_eval program
        (q1933521_nat_pair (q1933521_code_encode c) n) y
        \<longleftrightarrow> f c n = Some y)"

theorem kleene_second_recursion:
  fixes f :: "q1933521_code \<Rightarrow> q1933521_partial_function"
  assumes "q1933521_partrec2 f"
  shows "\<exists>c. \<forall>n y.
    q1933521_code_eval c n y \<longleftrightarrow> f c n = Some y"
  sorry

end

title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1933521,
  "Kleene's recursion theorem": every partial-recursive operation on a program
  code and a natural input has a code whose partial evaluation agrees
  extensionally with the operation applied to that same code. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let q1933521_code_INDUCT,q1933521_code_RECURSION = define_type
  "q1933521_code =
       Q1933521_Zero
     | Q1933521_Succ
     | Q1933521_Left
     | Q1933521_Right
     | Q1933521_Pair q1933521_code q1933521_code
     | Q1933521_Comp q1933521_code q1933521_code
     | Q1933521_Prec q1933521_code q1933521_code
     | Q1933521_Rfind q1933521_code";;

let q1933521_pair = new_definition
  `q1933521_pair a b =
     if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b`;;

let q1933521_encode = new_recursive_definition q1933521_code_RECURSION
  `(q1933521_encode Q1933521_Zero = 0) /\
   (q1933521_encode Q1933521_Succ = 1) /\
   (q1933521_encode Q1933521_Left = 2) /\
   (q1933521_encode Q1933521_Right = 3) /\
   (q1933521_encode (Q1933521_Pair c d) =
      4 + 4 * q1933521_pair
        (q1933521_encode c) (q1933521_encode d)) /\
   (q1933521_encode (Q1933521_Comp c d) =
      6 + 4 * q1933521_pair
        (q1933521_encode c) (q1933521_encode d)) /\
   (q1933521_encode (Q1933521_Prec c d) =
      5 + 4 * q1933521_pair
        (q1933521_encode c) (q1933521_encode d)) /\
   (q1933521_encode (Q1933521_Rfind c) =
      7 + 4 * q1933521_encode c)`;;

let q1933521_eval_RULES,q1933521_eval_INDUCT,q1933521_eval_CASES =
  new_inductive_definition
   `(!n:num. q1933521_eval Q1933521_Zero n 0) /\
    (!n:num. q1933521_eval Q1933521_Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b:num.
       q1933521_eval Q1933521_Left (q1933521_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b:num.
       q1933521_eval Q1933521_Right (q1933521_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q1933521_eval c n x /\ q1933521_eval d n y
       ==> q1933521_eval (Q1933521_Pair c d) n
             (q1933521_pair x y)) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q1933521_eval d n x /\ q1933521_eval c x y
       ==> q1933521_eval (Q1933521_Comp c d) n y) /\
    (!c d a y.
       q1933521_eval c a y
       ==> q1933521_eval (Q1933521_Prec c d)
             (q1933521_pair a 0) y) /\
    (!c d a k i y.
       q1933521_eval (Q1933521_Prec c d)
         (q1933521_pair a k) i /\
       q1933521_eval d (q1933521_pair a (q1933521_pair k i)) y
       ==> q1933521_eval (Q1933521_Prec c d)
             (q1933521_pair a (SUC k)) y) /\
    (!c a m k.
       q1933521_eval c (q1933521_pair a (m + k)) 0 /\
       (!j. j < k
            ==> ?z. q1933521_eval c
                       (q1933521_pair a (m + j)) z /\
                    ~(z = 0))
       ==> q1933521_eval (Q1933521_Rfind c)
             (q1933521_pair a m) (m + k))`;;

let q1933521_partrec2 = new_definition
  `q1933521_partrec2
      (f:q1933521_code->num->num->bool) <=>
     ?program:q1933521_code.
       !c n y.
         q1933521_eval program
           (q1933521_pair (q1933521_encode c) n) y <=>
         f c n y`;;

let Q1933521_KLEENES_RECURSION_THEOREM =
  `!f:q1933521_code->num->num->bool.
     q1933521_partrec2 f
     ==> ?c:q1933521_code.
           !n y. q1933521_eval c n y <=> f c n y`;;

title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1933521,
;; "Kleene's recursion theorem": every partial-recursive binary program has a
;; program whose unary partial evaluation equals the binary program applied to
;; its own code and the same input. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Codes are transported along the source's denumeration Code <-> Nat.  The
;; decoder below follows ofNatCode: 0, 1, 2, and 3 are the four base codes,
;; while the two low bits above 3 select pair, composition, primitive
;; recursion, or minimization.  The bounded recursion is extensionally the
;; source decoder because every recursive code number is smaller than its
;; parent.

(defun q1933521-nat-pair (left right)
  (let ((left (nfix left))
        (right (nfix right)))
    (if (< left right)
        (+ (* right right) left)
      (+ (* left left) left right))))

(defun q1933521-isqrt-down (number candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) number)
        candidate
      (q1933521-isqrt-down number (- candidate 1)))))

(defun q1933521-isqrt (number)
  (let ((number (nfix number)))
    (q1933521-isqrt-down number number)))

(defun q1933521-nat-unpair (number)
  (let* ((number (nfix number))
         (root (q1933521-isqrt number))
         (remainder (- number (* root root))))
    (if (< remainder root)
        (cons remainder root)
      (cons root (- remainder root)))))

(defun q1933521-code-decode-aux (steps number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      :zero
    (let ((number (nfix number)))
      (cond
       ((equal number 0) :zero)
       ((equal number 1) :succ)
       ((equal number 2) :left)
       ((equal number 3) :right)
       (t
        (let* ((payload (- number 4))
               (low-bit (mod payload 2))
               (high-bit (mod (floor payload 2) 2))
               (subcode-pair-number (floor payload 4))
               (subcode-pair
                (q1933521-nat-unpair subcode-pair-number))
               (next-steps (- steps 1)))
          (cond
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :pair
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 1))
            (list
             :comp
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 1)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :prec
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           (t
            (list
             :rfind
             (q1933521-code-decode-aux
              next-steps subcode-pair-number))))))))))

(defun q1933521-code-decode (number)
  (q1933521-code-decode-aux
   (+ 1 (nfix number))
   number))

;; A successful bounded evaluation is (:some . value); NIL is undefined.
;; This is the source evaln definition, including its input bound.  Recursive
;; calls either decrease the fuel or move to a proper subcode.

(defun q1933521-some (value)
  (cons :some value))

(defun q1933521-some-p (result)
  (and (consp result)
       (equal (car result) :some)
       (natp (cdr result))))

(defun q1933521-evaln-measure (fuel code)
  (make-ord
   1
   (+ 1 (nfix fuel))
   (acl2-count code)))

(defun q1933521-evaln (fuel code input)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure (q1933521-evaln-measure fuel code)
    :well-founded-relation o<))
  (if (zp fuel)
      nil
    (let ((bound (- fuel 1)))
      (if (or (not (natp input))
              (< bound input))
          nil
        (cond
         ((equal code :zero)
          (q1933521-some 0))
         ((equal code :succ)
          (q1933521-some (+ input 1)))
         ((equal code :left)
          (q1933521-some
           (car (q1933521-nat-unpair input))))
         ((equal code :right)
          (q1933521-some
           (cdr (q1933521-nat-unpair input))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :pair))
          (let ((left
                 (q1933521-evaln
                  fuel (cadr code) input)))
            (if (q1933521-some-p left)
                (let ((right
                       (q1933521-evaln
                        fuel (caddr code) input)))
                  (if (q1933521-some-p right)
                      (q1933521-some
                       (q1933521-nat-pair
                        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
                    nil))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :comp))
          (let ((argument
                 (q1933521-evaln
                  fuel (caddr code) input)))
            (if (q1933521-some-p argument)
                (q1933521-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) (cdr argument))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :prec))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q1933521-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (counter (cdr arguments)))
            (if (zp counter)
                (q1933521-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) parameter)
              (let* ((predecessor (- counter 1))
                     (previous
                      (q1933521-evaln
                       bound
                       code
                       (q1933521-nat-pair
                        parameter predecessor))))
                (if (q1933521-some-p previous)
                    (q1933521-evaln
                     fuel
                     (caddr code)
                     (q1933521-nat-pair
                      parameter
                      (q1933521-nat-pair
                       predecessor
                       (cdr previous))))
                  nil)))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :rfind))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q1933521-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (start (cdr arguments))
                 (test
                  (q1933521-evaln
                   fuel
                   (cadr code)
                   (q1933521-nat-pair
                    parameter start))))
            (if (q1933521-some-p test)
                (if (equal (cdr test) 0)
                    (q1933521-some start)
                  (q1933521-evaln
                   bound
                   code
                   (q1933521-nat-pair
                    parameter (+ start 1))))
              nil)))
         (t nil))))))

;; DEFUN-SK supplies the source's unbounded quantifiers. Existence of a fuel is
;; termination of the corresponding partial evaluation; agreement for every
;; natural output is equality of deterministic partial values, including
;; divergence.

(defun-sk q1933521-halts-with-p
    (program input output)
  (exists (fuel)
    (and
     (natp program)
     (natp input)
     (natp output)
     (natp fuel)
     (equal
      (q1933521-evaln
       fuel
       (q1933521-code-decode program)
       input)
      (q1933521-some output)))))

(defun-sk q1933521-partial-equal-p
    (left-program left-input right-program right-input)
  (forall (output)
    (implies
     (natp output)
     (iff
      (q1933521-halts-with-p
       left-program left-input output)
      (q1933521-halts-with-p
       right-program right-input output)))))

;; A natural number denotes a source Code through the exact denumeration above.
;; Thus a binary program denotes a Partrec2 function of a program code and an
;; input. The fixed-program witness remains existentially quantified inside
;; the statement, and the input law compares both defined values and
;; divergence at every natural-number input.

(defun-sk q1933521-fixed-point-input-law-p
    (functional-program fixed-program)
  (forall (input)
    (implies
     (natp input)
     (q1933521-partial-equal-p
      fixed-program
      input
      functional-program
      (q1933521-nat-pair fixed-program input)))))

(defun-sk q1933521-fixed-program-exists-p (functional-program)
  (exists (fixed-program)
    (and
     (natp fixed-program)
     (q1933521-fixed-point-input-law-p
      functional-program fixed-program))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1933521-kleene-recursion-theorem-statement
    (functional-program)
  (implies
   (natp functional-program)
   (q1933521-fixed-program-exists-p functional-program)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1933521
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q1933521), "Kleene's recursion theorem": every
-- binary partial-recursive function of a program code and a natural number
-- has a code whose evaluation equals the function applied to that code.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (lzero; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _<_)

infix 4 _iff_
infix 4 _equivalent_

record _iff_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

-- The square pairing used by the source Nat.Partrec development.
pairNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
pairNat left right with left < right
... | true =
  right * right + left
... | false =
  left * left + left + right

-- Codes for the partial-recursive schemes used by the source development.
data Code : Set where
  zeroCode : Code
  successorCode : Code
  leftCode : Code
  rightCode : Code
  pairCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  composeCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  primitiveRecursionCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  minimizationCode : Code -> Code

-- A computable numerical encoding of program codes.
encodeCode : Code -> Nat
encodeCode zeroCode =
  0
encodeCode successorCode =
  1
encodeCode leftCode =
  2
encodeCode rightCode =
  3
encodeCode (pairCode firstCode secondCode) =
  2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode)) + 4
encodeCode (composeCode firstCode secondCode) =
  2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode) + 1) + 4
encodeCode (primitiveRecursionCode firstCode secondCode) =
  (2 * (2 * pairNat (encodeCode firstCode) (encodeCode secondCode)) + 1) + 4
encodeCode (minimizationCode code) =
  (2 * (2 * encodeCode code + 1) + 1) + 4

-- Relational evaluation represents termination with the displayed result.
data Evaluates : Code -> Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  evaluates-zero :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates zeroCode input zero

  evaluates-successor :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates successorCode input (suc input)

  evaluates-left :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates leftCode (pairNat left right) left

  evaluates-right :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates rightCode (pairNat left right) right

  evaluates-pair :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input firstValue secondValue : Nat} ->
    Evaluates firstCode input firstValue ->
    Evaluates secondCode input secondValue ->
    Evaluates
      (pairCode firstCode secondCode)
      input
      (pairNat firstValue secondValue)

  evaluates-composition :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input intermediate output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates secondCode input intermediate ->
    Evaluates firstCode intermediate output ->
    Evaluates (composeCode firstCode secondCode) input output

  evaluates-primitive-zero :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates baseCode parameter output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter zero)
      output

  evaluates-primitive-successor :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter index previous output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter index)
      previous ->
    Evaluates
      stepCode
      (pairNat parameter (pairNat index previous))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter (suc index))
      output

  evaluates-minimization-zero :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) zero ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      start

  evaluates-minimization-successor :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start nonzeroValue output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) (suc nonzeroValue) ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter (suc start))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      output

PartialFunction : Set (lsuc lzero)
PartialFunction =
  Nat -> Nat -> Set

evaluate : Code -> PartialFunction
evaluate code input output =
  Evaluates code input output

_equivalent_ : PartialFunction -> PartialFunction -> Set
firstFunction equivalent secondFunction =
  (input output : Nat) ->
  (firstFunction input output) iff (secondFunction input output)

-- Binary partial recursiveness uses the source code encoding and the same
-- universal evaluator.
Partrec2 : (Code -> PartialFunction) -> Set
Partrec2 function =
  Exists Code
    (\ program ->
      (code : Code) ->
      (input output : Nat) ->
      (Evaluates
        program
        (pairNat (encodeCode code) input)
        output)
      iff
      (function code input output))

KleeneSecondRecursionTheorem : Set (lsuc lzero)
KleeneSecondRecursionTheorem =
  (function : Code -> PartialFunction) ->
  Partrec2 function ->
  Exists Code
    (\ code ->
      (evaluate code) equivalent (function code))

title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1933521, "Kleene's recursion theorem": every binary partial-recursive
  function on source-style program codes and natural-number inputs has a code
  whose unary evaluation is obtained by feeding that same code to the
  function. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val _ = Datatype `
  q1933521_code =
      Q1933521Zero
    | Q1933521Succ
    | Q1933521Left
    | Q1933521Right
    | Q1933521Pair q1933521_code q1933521_code
    | Q1933521Comp q1933521_code q1933521_code
    | Q1933521Prec q1933521_code q1933521_code
    | Q1933521Rfind q1933521_code
`;

val q1933521_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q1933521_pair_def",
  ``q1933521_pair a b =
      if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b``
);

val q1933521_encode_def = Define`
  (q1933521_encode Q1933521Zero = 0) /\
  (q1933521_encode Q1933521Succ = 1) /\
  (q1933521_encode Q1933521Left = 2) /\
  (q1933521_encode Q1933521Right = 3) /\
  (q1933521_encode (Q1933521Pair c d) =
     4 * q1933521_pair (q1933521_encode c) (q1933521_encode d) + 4) /\
  (q1933521_encode (Q1933521Comp c d) =
     4 * q1933521_pair (q1933521_encode c) (q1933521_encode d) + 6) /\
  (q1933521_encode (Q1933521Prec c d) =
     4 * q1933521_pair (q1933521_encode c) (q1933521_encode d) + 5) /\
  (q1933521_encode (Q1933521Rfind c) =
     4 * q1933521_encode c + 7)
`;

val (q1933521_eval_rules, q1933521_eval_ind, q1933521_eval_cases) =
  Hol_reln`
    (!n. q1933521_eval Q1933521Zero n 0) /\
    (!n. q1933521_eval Q1933521Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b. q1933521_eval Q1933521Left (q1933521_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b. q1933521_eval Q1933521Right (q1933521_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q1933521_eval c n a /\ q1933521_eval d n b ==>
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Pair c d) n (q1933521_pair a b)) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q1933521_eval d n a /\ q1933521_eval c a b ==>
       q1933521_eval (Q1933521Comp c d) n b) /\
    (!c d a b.
       q1933521_eval c a b ==>
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Prec c d) (q1933521_pair a 0) b) /\
    (!c d a n r b.
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Prec c d) (q1933521_pair a n) r /\
       q1933521_eval d
         (q1933521_pair a (q1933521_pair n r)) b ==>
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Prec c d) (q1933521_pair a (SUC n)) b) /\
    (!c a m.
       q1933521_eval c (q1933521_pair a m) 0 ==>
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Rfind c) (q1933521_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z r.
       q1933521_eval c (q1933521_pair a m) z /\ z <> 0 /\
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Rfind c) (q1933521_pair a (SUC m)) r ==>
       q1933521_eval
         (Q1933521Rfind c) (q1933521_pair a m) r)
  `;

val q1933521_partrec2_def = new_definition (
  "q1933521_partrec2_def",
  ``q1933521_partrec2 f <=>
      ?program. !c n y.
        (f c n = SOME y <=>
         q1933521_eval program
           (q1933521_pair (q1933521_encode c) n) y)``
);

val q1933521_kleene_recursion_theorem =
  ``!f : q1933521_code -> num -> num option.
      q1933521_partrec2 f
      ==>
      ?c. !n y.
        (q1933521_eval c n y <=> f c n = SOME y)``;

:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1933521

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Eval being set,
      pairing,pairCode,compCode,precCode being BinOp of NAT,
      f being PartFunc of [:NAT,NAT:],NAT st
    (for a,b being Nat holds
      (a < b implies pairing.(a,b) = b*b+a) &
      (not a < b implies pairing.(a,b) = a*a+a+b)) &
    (for cf,cg being Nat holds
      (cf < cg implies
        pairCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cg*cg+cf)+4 &
        compCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cg*cg+cf)+6 &
        precCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cg*cg+cf)+5) &
      (not cf < cg implies
        pairCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cf*cf+cf+cg)+4 &
        compCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cf*cf+cf+cg)+6 &
        precCode.(cf,cg) = 4*(cf*cf+cf+cg)+5)) &
    Eval =
      meet {R where R is Subset of [:[:NAT,NAT:],NAT:] :
        (for x being Nat holds [[0,x],0] in R) &
        (for x being Nat holds [[1,x],x+1] in R) &
        (for a,b being Nat holds
          [[2,pairing.(a,b)],a] in R) &
        (for a,b being Nat holds
          [[3,pairing.(a,b)],b] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,x,y,z being Nat st
          [[cf,x],y] in R & [[cg,x],z] in R

          [[pairCode.(cf,cg),x],pairing.(y,z)] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,x,y,z being Nat st
          [[cg,x],y] in R & [[cf,y],z] in R
         holds
          [[compCode.(cf,cg),x],z] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,a,y being Nat st [[cf,a],y] in R
         holds
          [[precCode.(cf,cg),pairing.(a,0)],y] in R) &
        (for cf,cg,a,k,i,y being Nat st
          [[precCode.(cf,cg),pairing.(a,k)],i] in R &
          [[cg,pairing.(a,pairing.(k,i))],y] in R
         holds
          [[precCode.(cf,cg),pairing.(a,k+1)],y] in R) &
        (for cf,a,m,n being Nat st
          [[cf,pairing.(a,n+m)],0] in R &
          (for k being Nat st k < n holds
            ex z being Nat st z <> 0 &
              [[cf,pairing.(a,k+m)],z] in R)
         holds
          [[4*cf+7,pairing.(a,m)],n+m] in R)} &
    (ex cf being Nat st
      for c,x,y being Nat holds
        ([[cf,pairing.(c,x)],y] in Eval iff [[c,x],y] in f))
  holds
    ex c being Nat st
      for x,y being Nat holds
        ([[c,x],y] in Eval iff [[c,x],y] in f)
