title: Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1933521,
% "Kleene's recursion theorem": every binary partial-recursive function of a
% program code and a natural input has a code whose partial evaluation agrees
% with the function specialized to that same code. This file contains no proof.

kleene_partial_value_Q1933521: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  kleene_undefined: kleene_undefined?
  kleene_defined(kleene_value: nat): kleene_defined?
END kleene_partial_value_Q1933521

kleene_code_Q1933521: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  kleene_zero_code: kleene_zero_code?
  kleene_succ_code: kleene_succ_code?
  kleene_left_code: kleene_left_code?
  kleene_right_code: kleene_right_code?
  kleene_pair_code(
    kleene_pair_left,
    kleene_pair_right: kleene_code_Q1933521): kleene_pair_code?
  kleene_comp_code(
    kleene_comp_outer,
    kleene_comp_inner: kleene_code_Q1933521): kleene_comp_code?
  kleene_prec_code(
    kleene_prec_base,
    kleene_prec_step: kleene_code_Q1933521): kleene_prec_code?
  kleene_rfind_code(
    kleene_rfind_body: kleene_code_Q1933521): kleene_rfind_code?
END kleene_code_Q1933521

Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING kleene_partial_value_Q1933521, kleene_code_Q1933521

  code: TYPE = kleene_code_Q1933521
  partial_value: TYPE = kleene_partial_value_Q1933521
  binary_partial_function: TYPE = [code, nat -> partial_value]
  evaluation_relation: TYPE = [code, nat, nat -> bool]

  nat_pair(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left < right THEN
      right * right + left
    ELSE
      left * left + left + right
    ENDIF

  code_encode(program: code): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES program OF
      kleene_zero_code: 0,
      kleene_succ_code: 1,
      kleene_left_code: 2,
      kleene_right_code: 3,
      kleene_pair_code(left_program, right_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(left_program),
          code_encode(right_program))) + 4,
      kleene_comp_code(outer_program, inner_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(outer_program),
          code_encode(inner_program)) + 1) + 4,
      kleene_prec_code(base_program, step_program):
        2 * (2 * nat_pair(
          code_encode(base_program),
          code_encode(step_program))) + 1 + 4,
      kleene_rfind_code(body_program):
        2 * (2 * code_encode(body_program) + 1) + 1 + 4
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE program BY <<

  evaluator_closed(candidate: evaluation_relation): bool =
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(kleene_zero_code, input, 0))
    AND
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(kleene_succ_code, input, input + 1))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(kleene_left_code, nat_pair(left, right), left))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(kleene_right_code, nat_pair(left, right), right))
    AND
    (FORALL (left_program, right_program: code),
            (input, left_value, right_value: nat):
      (candidate(left_program, input, left_value)
        AND candidate(right_program, input, right_value))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          kleene_pair_code(left_program, right_program),
          input,
          nat_pair(left_value, right_value)))
    AND
    (FORALL (outer_program, inner_program: code),
            (input, intermediate, output: nat):
      (candidate(inner_program, input, intermediate)
        AND candidate(outer_program, intermediate, output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          kleene_comp_code(outer_program, inner_program),
          input,
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, output: nat):
      candidate(base_program, parameter, output)
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          kleene_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, 0),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, index, previous, output: nat):
      (candidate(
          kleene_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index),
          previous)
        AND candidate(
          step_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, nat_pair(index, previous)),
          output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          kleene_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index + 1),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (body_program: code),
            (parameter, start, offset: nat):
      (candidate(
          body_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, start + offset),
          0)
        AND
          (FORALL (earlier: nat):
            earlier < offset IMPLIES
              EXISTS (nonzero_value: nat):
                candidate(
                  body_program,
                  nat_pair(parameter, start + earlier),
                  nonzero_value)
                  AND nonzero_value /= 0))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          kleene_rfind_code(body_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, start),
          start + offset))

  evaluates(program: code, input, output: nat): bool =
    FORALL (candidate: evaluation_relation):
      evaluator_closed(candidate)
      IMPLIES candidate(program, input, output)

  computes_binary(
    program: code,
    fn: binary_partial_function): bool =
    FORALL (source: code), (input, output: nat):
      evaluates(
        program,
        nat_pair(code_encode(source), input),
        output)
      IFF fn(source, input) = kleene_defined(output)

  partial_recursive_binary(fn: binary_partial_function): bool =
    EXISTS (program: code):
      computes_binary(program, fn)

  kleene_second_recursion_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (fn: binary_partial_function):
      partial_recursive_binary(fn)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (program: code):
          FORALL (input, output: nat):
            evaluates(program, input, output)
            IFF fn(program, input) = kleene_defined(output)
END Q1933521_kleene_s_recursion_theorem

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q193878
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q193878), "Chinese remainder theorem": a finite
-- family of pairwise coprime ideals in a commutative ring yields a ring equivalence
-- between the quotient by their infimum and the product of their quotients.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Subalgebra.Operations
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Ring.Fin
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Quotient.Basic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Quotient.Basic

@[expose] public section

namespace Q193878

open Function

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]

/-- The Chinese remainder theorem for a finite pairwise coprime family of ideals. -/
noncomputable def quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient_statement (f : ι → Ideal R)
    (hf : Pairwise (IsCoprime on f)) : (R ⧸ ⨅ i, f i) ≃+* ∀ i, R ⧸ f i := sorry

end Q193878

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193878
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q193878), "Chinese remainder theorem": for a
  finite family of pairwise comaximal ideals in a commutative ring, the
  quotient by their intersection is canonically isomorphic to the product of
  the quotient rings. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q193878_commutative_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q193878_zero : R;
  q193878_one : R;
  q193878_add : R -> R -> R;
  q193878_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q193878_neg : R -> R;
  q193878_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q193878_add x (q193878_add y z) =
      q193878_add (q193878_add x y) z;
  q193878_add_comm :
    forall x y : R, q193878_add x y = q193878_add y x;
  q193878_add_zero :
    forall x : R, q193878_add x q193878_zero = x;
  q193878_add_neg :
    forall x : R, q193878_add x (q193878_neg x) = q193878_zero;
  q193878_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q193878_mul x (q193878_mul y z) =
      q193878_mul (q193878_mul x y) z;
  q193878_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R, q193878_mul x y = q193878_mul y x;
  q193878_mul_one :
    forall x : R, q193878_mul x q193878_one = x;
  q193878_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : R,
      q193878_mul x (q193878_add y z) =
      q193878_add (q193878_mul x y) (q193878_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q193878_zero {R} _.
Arguments q193878_one {R} _.
Arguments q193878_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q193878_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q193878_neg {R} _ _.

Definition q193878_sub
    {R : Type} (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R)
    (x y : R) : R :=
  q193878_add CR x (q193878_neg CR y).

Record q193878_ideal
    (R : Type) (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R) : Type := {
  q193878_ideal_mem : R -> Prop;
  q193878_ideal_zero :
    q193878_ideal_mem (q193878_zero CR);
  q193878_ideal_add :
    forall x y : R,
      q193878_ideal_mem x ->
      q193878_ideal_mem y ->
      q193878_ideal_mem (q193878_add CR x y);
  q193878_ideal_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q193878_ideal_mem x ->
      q193878_ideal_mem (q193878_neg CR x);
  q193878_ideal_mul :
    forall a x : R,
      q193878_ideal_mem x ->
      q193878_ideal_mem (q193878_mul CR a x)
}.

Arguments q193878_ideal_mem {R CR} _ _.

Definition q193878_is_finite (index : Type) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list index,
    forall i : index, In i enumeration.

Definition q193878_ideals_comaximal
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q193878_commutative_ring R}
    (I J : @q193878_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  exists x y : R,
    q193878_ideal_mem I x /\
    q193878_ideal_mem J y /\
    q193878_add CR x y = q193878_one CR.

Definition q193878_pairwise_comaximal
    {R index : Type}
    {CR : q193878_commutative_ring R}
    (ideals : index -> @q193878_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  forall i j : index,
    i <> j ->
    q193878_ideals_comaximal (ideals i) (ideals j).

Definition q193878_ideal_quotient_equal
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q193878_commutative_ring R}
    (I : @q193878_ideal R CR)
    (x y : R) : Prop :=
  q193878_ideal_mem I (q193878_sub CR x y).

Definition q193878_intersection_quotient_equal
    {R index : Type}
    {CR : q193878_commutative_ring R}
    (ideals : index -> @q193878_ideal R CR)
    (x y : R) : Prop :=
  forall i : index,
    q193878_ideal_quotient_equal (ideals i) x y.

Definition q193878_product_quotient_equal
    {R index : Type}
    {CR : q193878_commutative_ring R}
    (ideals : index -> @q193878_ideal R CR)
    (x y : index -> R) : Prop :=
  forall i : index,
    q193878_ideal_quotient_equal (ideals i) (x i) (y i).

Definition q193878_relation_ring_isomorphism
    (source target : Type)
    (source_equal : source -> source -> Prop)
    (target_equal : target -> target -> Prop)
    (source_zero : source)
    (target_zero : target)
    (source_one : source)
    (target_one : target)
    (source_add : source -> source -> source)
    (target_add : target -> target -> target)
    (source_mul : source -> source -> source)
    (target_mul : target -> target -> target)
    (source_neg : source -> source)
    (target_neg : target -> target)
    (forward : source -> target) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : source,
      source_equal x y ->
      target_equal (forward x) (forward y)) /\
  target_equal (forward source_zero) target_zero /\
  target_equal (forward source_one) target_one /\
  (forall x y : source,
      target_equal
        (forward (source_add x y))
        (target_add (forward x) (forward y))) /\
  (forall x y : source,
      target_equal
        (forward (source_mul x y))
        (target_mul (forward x) (forward y))) /\
  (forall x : source,
      target_equal (forward (source_neg x)) (target_neg (forward x))) /\
  exists backward : target -> source,
    (forall x y : target,
        target_equal x y ->
        source_equal (backward x) (backward y)) /\
    (forall x : source,
        source_equal (backward (forward x)) x) /\
    forall y : target,
      target_equal (forward (backward y)) y.

Definition q193878_product_zero
    {R index : Type}
    (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R) : index -> R :=
  fun _ => q193878_zero CR.

Definition q193878_product_one
    {R index : Type}
    (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R) : index -> R :=
  fun _ => q193878_one CR.

Definition q193878_product_add
    {R index : Type}
    (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R)
    (x y : index -> R) : index -> R :=
  fun i => q193878_add CR (x i) (y i).

Definition q193878_product_mul
    {R index : Type}
    (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R)
    (x y : index -> R) : index -> R :=
  fun i => q193878_mul CR (x i) (y i).

Definition q193878_product_neg
    {R index : Type}
    (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R)
    (x : index -> R) : index -> R :=
  fun i => q193878_neg CR (x i).

Definition q193878_diagonal
    {R index : Type} (x : R) : index -> R :=
  fun _ => x.

Definition q193878_canonical_quotient_ring_isomorphism
    {R index : Type}
    (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R)
    (ideals : index -> @q193878_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  @q193878_relation_ring_isomorphism
    R (index -> R)
    (q193878_intersection_quotient_equal ideals)
    (q193878_product_quotient_equal ideals)
    (q193878_zero CR)
    (q193878_product_zero CR)
    (q193878_one CR)
    (q193878_product_one CR)
    (q193878_add CR)
    (q193878_product_add CR)
    (q193878_mul CR)
    (q193878_product_mul CR)
    (q193878_neg CR)
    (q193878_product_neg CR)
    q193878_diagonal.

Theorem Ideal_quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient :
  forall (R : Type)
         (CR : q193878_commutative_ring R)
         (index : Type)
         (ideals : index -> @q193878_ideal R CR),
    q193878_is_finite index ->
    q193878_pairwise_comaximal ideals ->
    @q193878_canonical_quotient_ring_isomorphism R index CR ideals.
Admitted.

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q193878
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q193878), "Chinese remainder theorem":
  pairwise coprime ideals indexed by a finite carrier in a commutative ring
  yield a canonical ring isomorphism from the quotient by their intersection
  to the product of the individual quotient rings. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
  imports "HOL-Algebra.Chinese_Remainder"
begin

definition q193878_ideal_intersection ::
    "('a, 'b) ring_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q193878_ideal_intersection R K I =
      {x \<in> carrier R. \<forall>i \<in> K. x \<in> I i}"

definition q193878_quotient_product ::
    "('a, 'b) ring_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) ring"
  where
    "q193878_quotient_product R K I =
      \<lparr>carrier = PiE K (\<lambda>i. carrier (R Quot I i)),
       mult = (\<lambda>f g. restrict
         (\<lambda>i. f i \<otimes>\<^bsub>R Quot I i\<^esub> g i) K),
       one = restrict (\<lambda>i. \<one>\<^bsub>R Quot I i\<^esub>) K,
       zero = restrict (\<lambda>i. \<zero>\<^bsub>R Quot I i\<^esub>) K,
       add = (\<lambda>f g. restrict
         (\<lambda>i. f i \<oplus>\<^bsub>R Quot I i\<^esub> g i) K)\<rparr>"

theorem chinese_remainder_theorem:
  fixes R :: "('a, 'b) ring_scheme"
    and K :: "'i set"
    and I :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  assumes "cring R"
    and "finite K"
    and "\<And>i. i \<in> K \<Longrightarrow> ideal (I i) R"
    and "\<And>i j. i \<in> K \<Longrightarrow> j \<in> K \<Longrightarrow> i \<noteq> j \<Longrightarrow>
      I i <+>\<^bsub>R\<^esub> I j = carrier R"
  shows "\<exists>h. h \<in> ring_iso
      (R Quot (q193878_ideal_intersection R K I))
      (q193878_quotient_product R K I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> carrier R.
      h (q193878_ideal_intersection R K I +>\<^bsub>R\<^esub> a) =
        restrict (\<lambda>i. I i +>\<^bsub>R\<^esub> a) K)"
  oops

end

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193878,
  "Chinese remainder theorem": for a finite family of pairwise coprime ideals
  in a commutative ring, the canonical map from the quotient by their
  intersection to the product of the individual quotients is a ring
  isomorphism. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q193878_CHINESE_REMAINDER_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_ring =
     \(zero:R) (oneR:R) (add:R->R->R) (mul:R->R->R) (neg:R->R).
       (!x. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
       (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x. mul oneR x = x) /\
       (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
       (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
       (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) in
   let is_ideal =
     \(zero:R) (add:R->R->R) (mul:R->R->R) (neg:R->R)
      (ideal:R->bool).
       ideal zero /\
       (!x y. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (add x y)) /\
       (!x. ideal x ==> ideal (neg x)) /\
       (!a x. ideal x ==> ideal (mul a x)) in
   let sub =
     \(add:R->R->R) (neg:R->R) (x:R) (y:R). add x (neg y) in
   let ideal_coset =
     \(sub:R->R->R) (ideal:R->bool) (x:R).
       \y:R. ideal (sub y x) in
   let ideal_inf =
     \(indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool).
       \x:R. !i:K. indices i ==> ideals i x in
   let quotient_carrier =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool) (ideal:R->bool) (c:R->bool).
       ?x:R. c = coset_fn ideal x in
   let choose_representative =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool) (ideal:R->bool) (c:R->bool).
       @x:R. c = coset_fn ideal x in
   let quotient_zero =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool) (ideal:R->bool) (zero:R).
       coset_fn ideal zero in
   let quotient_one =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool) (ideal:R->bool) (oneR:R).
       coset_fn ideal oneR in
   let quotient_neg =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool)
      (repr_fn:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R)
      (neg:R->R) (ideal:R->bool) (c:R->bool).
       coset_fn ideal (neg (repr_fn ideal c)) in
   let quotient_add =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool)
      (repr_fn:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R)
      (add:R->R->R) (ideal:R->bool) (c:R->bool) (d:R->bool).
       coset_fn ideal
         (add (repr_fn ideal c) (repr_fn ideal d)) in
   let quotient_mul =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool)
      (repr_fn:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R)
      (mul:R->R->R) (ideal:R->bool) (c:R->bool) (d:R->bool).
       coset_fn ideal
         (mul (repr_fn ideal c) (repr_fn ideal d)) in
   let product_carrier =
     \(quotient_carrier:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->bool)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool) (q:K->R->bool).
       !i:K.
         (indices i ==> quotient_carrier (ideals i) (q i)) /\
         (~indices i ==> q i = (\x:R. T)) in
   let product_zero =
     \(quotient_zero:(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool).
       \i:K. if indices i then quotient_zero (ideals i) else (\x:R. T) in
   let product_one =
     \(quotient_one:(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool).
       \i:K. if indices i then quotient_one (ideals i) else (\x:R. T) in
   let product_neg =
     \(quotient_neg:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool) (q:K->R->bool).
       \i:K. if indices i then quotient_neg (ideals i) (q i)
             else (\x:R. T) in
   let product_add =
     \(quotient_add:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool)
      (q:K->R->bool) (r:K->R->bool).
       \i:K. if indices i then quotient_add (ideals i) (q i) (r i)
             else (\x:R. T) in
   let product_mul =
     \(quotient_mul:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool)
      (q:K->R->bool) (r:K->R->bool).
       \i:K. if indices i then quotient_mul (ideals i) (q i) (r i)
             else (\x:R. T) in
   let canonical_map =
     \(coset_fn:(R->bool)->R->R->bool)
      (repr_fn:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R)
      (indices:K->bool) (ideals:K->R->bool) (inf_ideal:R->bool)
      (c:R->bool).
       \i:K.
         if indices i
         then coset_fn (ideals i) (repr_fn inf_ideal c)
         else (\x:R. T) in
   let is_ring_isomorphism =
     \(source:(R->bool)->bool) (target:(K->R->bool)->bool)
      (source_zero:R->bool) (source_one:R->bool)
      (source_add:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (source_mul:(R->bool)->(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (source_neg:(R->bool)->R->bool)
      (target_zero:K->R->bool) (target_one:K->R->bool)
      (target_add:(K->R->bool)->(K->R->bool)->K->R->bool)
      (target_mul:(K->R->bool)->(K->R->bool)->K->R->bool)
      (target_neg:(K->R->bool)->K->R->bool)
      (phi:(R->bool)->K->R->bool).
       (!c. source c ==> target (phi c)) /\
       (!c d. source c /\ source d /\ phi c = phi d ==> c = d) /\
       (!q. target q ==> ?c. source c /\ phi c = q) /\
       phi source_zero = target_zero /\
       phi source_one = target_one /\
       (!c. source c ==> phi (source_neg c) = target_neg (phi c)) /\
       (!c d.
          source c /\ source d
          ==> phi (source_add c d) = target_add (phi c) (phi d)) /\
       (!c d.
          source c /\ source d
          ==> phi (source_mul c d) = target_mul (phi c) (phi d)) in
   !zero:R. !oneR:R. !add:R->R->R. !mul:R->R->R. !neg:R->R.
   !indices:K->bool. !ideals:K->R->bool.
     is_comm_ring zero oneR add mul neg /\
     FINITE indices /\
     (!i. indices i ==> is_ideal zero add mul neg (ideals i)) /\
     (!i j.
        indices i /\ indices j /\ ~(i = j)
        ==> ?a b. ideals i a /\ ideals j b /\ add a b = oneR)
     ==> let sub0 = sub add neg in
         let coset0 = ideal_coset sub0 in
         let inf_ideal = ideal_inf indices ideals in
         let qcarrier = quotient_carrier coset0 in
         let repr = choose_representative coset0 in
         let qzero = \ideal. quotient_zero coset0 ideal zero in
         let qone = \ideal. quotient_one coset0 ideal oneR in
         let qneg = quotient_neg coset0 repr neg in
         let qadd = quotient_add coset0 repr add in
         let qmul = quotient_mul coset0 repr mul in
         let pcarrier = product_carrier qcarrier indices ideals in
         let pzero = product_zero qzero indices ideals in
         let pone = product_one qone indices ideals in
         let pneg = product_neg qneg indices ideals in
         let padd = product_add qadd indices ideals in
         let pmul = product_mul qmul indices ideals in
         let crt = canonical_map coset0 repr indices ideals inf_ideal in
         is_ring_isomorphism
           (qcarrier inf_ideal) pcarrier
           (qzero inf_ideal) (qone inf_ideal)
           (qadd inf_ideal) (qmul inf_ideal) (qneg inf_ideal)
           pzero pone padd pmul pneg crt`;;

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q193878,
;; "Chinese remainder theorem": pairwise coprime ideals in a commutative ring
;; give the canonical ring equivalence from the quotient by their intersection
;; to the product of the individual quotient rings. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A finite index type is transported along a bijection to a duplicate-free
;; list. The aligned IDEALS list therefore represents the complete ideal
;; family without restricting the ring carrier. Ring operations and ideal
;; predicates remain arbitrary tame APPLY$ function objects.
;;
;; Quotients are represented exactly by congruence of ring representatives.
;; The canonical map sends one representative to the same representative in
;; every coordinate. Its preservation of zero, one, addition, and
;; multiplication is definitional, so being a ring equivalence reduces to
;; reflecting quotient equality and being surjective.

(defun q193878-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object))
      t
    nil))

;; Exact commutative-ring laws on an arbitrary carrier. Trivial rings are
;; allowed, as in the Lean CommRing hypothesis.

(defun-sk q193878-commutative-ring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q193878-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q193878-member-p
        carrier
        (apply$ negate (list x)))
       (equal
        (apply$ add (list x zero))
        x)
       (equal
        (apply$ add (list zero x))
        x)
       (equal
        (apply$ add (list x (apply$ negate (list x))))
        zero)
       (equal
        (apply$ add (list (apply$ negate (list x)) x))
        zero)
       (equal
        (apply$ multiply (list x one))
        x)
       (equal
        (apply$ multiply (list one x))
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q193878-member-p carrier x)
       (q193878-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q193878-member-p
        carrier
        (apply$ add (list x y)))
       (q193878-member-p
        carrier
        (apply$ multiply (list x y)))
       (equal
        (apply$ add (list x y))
        (apply$ add (list y x)))
       (equal
        (apply$ multiply (list x y))
        (apply$ multiply (list y x)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q193878-member-p carrier x)
       (q193878-member-p carrier y)
       (q193878-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (apply$ add
                (list (apply$ add (list x y)) z))
        (apply$ add
                (list x (apply$ add (list y z)))))
       (equal
        (apply$ multiply
                (list (apply$ multiply (list x y)) z))
        (apply$ multiply
                (list x (apply$ multiply (list y z)))))
       (equal
        (apply$ multiply
                (list x (apply$ add (list y z))))
        (apply$ add
                (list (apply$ multiply (list x y))
                      (apply$ multiply (list x z)))))
       (equal
        (apply$ multiply
                (list (apply$ add (list x y)) z))
        (apply$ add
                (list (apply$ multiply (list x z))
                      (apply$ multiply (list y z))))))))))

(defun q193878-commutative-ring-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (q193878-member-p carrier zero)
   (q193878-member-p carrier one)
   (q193878-commutative-ring-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate)))

;; An ideal is an arbitrary predicate contained in the carrier, containing
;; zero, closed under addition and negation, and absorbing multiplication.

(defun-sk q193878-ideal-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate ideal)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q193878-member-p ideal x)
      (and
       (q193878-member-p carrier x)
       (q193878-member-p
        ideal
        (apply$ negate (list x)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q193878-member-p ideal x)
       (q193878-member-p ideal y))
      (q193878-member-p
       ideal
       (apply$ add (list x y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q193878-member-p carrier x)
       (q193878-member-p ideal y))
      (q193878-member-p
       ideal
       (apply$ multiply (list x y)))))))

(defun q193878-ideal-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate ideal)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q193878-member-p ideal zero)
   (q193878-ideal-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate ideal)))

(defun q193878-ideal-family-p
    (carrier zero add multiply negate ideals)
  (if (consp ideals)
      (and
       (q193878-ideal-p
        carrier zero add multiply negate (car ideals))
       (q193878-ideal-family-p
        carrier zero add multiply negate (cdr ideals)))
    (equal ideals nil)))

;; Two ideals are coprime exactly when their sum contains one.

(defun-sk q193878-coprime-p (left right one add)
  (exists (left-element right-element)
    (and
     (q193878-member-p left left-element)
     (q193878-member-p right right-element)
     (equal
      (apply$ add (list left-element right-element))
      one))))

(defun q193878-coprime-with-list-p
    (ideal remaining one add)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (q193878-coprime-p
        ideal (car remaining) one add)
       (q193878-coprime-with-list-p
        ideal (cdr remaining) one add))
    (equal remaining nil)))

(defun q193878-pairwise-coprime-p (ideals one add)
  (if (consp ideals)
      (and
       (q193878-coprime-with-list-p
        (car ideals) (cdr ideals) one add)
       (q193878-pairwise-coprime-p
        (cdr ideals) one add))
    (equal ideals nil)))

;; Equality in the quotient by the intersection, and equality of all
;; coordinate images in the product of quotient rings.

(defun q193878-all-ideals-contain-p (ideals object)
  (if (consp ideals)
      (and
       (q193878-member-p (car ideals) object)
       (q193878-all-ideals-contain-p
        (cdr ideals) object))
    (equal ideals nil)))

(defun q193878-intersection-congruent-p
    (ideals add negate left right)
  (q193878-all-ideals-contain-p
   ideals
   (apply$
    add
    (list left (apply$ negate (list right))))))

(defun q193878-product-images-congruent-p
    (ideals add negate left right)
  (q193878-all-ideals-contain-p
   ideals
   (apply$
    add
    (list left (apply$ negate (list right))))))

(defun-sk q193878-canonical-reflects-equality-p
    (carrier ideals add negate)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q193878-member-p carrier left)
      (q193878-member-p carrier right))
     (iff
      (q193878-intersection-congruent-p
       ideals add negate left right)
      (q193878-product-images-congruent-p
       ideals add negate left right)))))

;; Every element of the finite product of quotient rings has an aligned list
;; of representatives. Surjectivity says that one ring element is congruent
;; to each representative modulo the corresponding ideal.

(defun q193878-all-carrier-members-p (carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q193878-member-p carrier (car values))
       (q193878-all-carrier-members-p
        carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q193878-coordinate-congruent-p
    (ideals values add negate representative)
  (if (consp ideals)
      (and
       (consp values)
       (q193878-member-p
        (car ideals)
        (apply$
         add
         (list
          representative
          (apply$ negate (list (car values))))))
       (q193878-coordinate-congruent-p
        (cdr ideals)
        (cdr values)
        add
        negate
        representative))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q193878-solution-exists-p
    (carrier ideals values add negate)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q193878-member-p carrier representative)
     (q193878-coordinate-congruent-p
      ideals values add negate representative))))

(defun-sk q193878-canonical-surjective-p
    (carrier ideals add negate)
  (forall (values)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp values)
      (equal (len values) (len ideals))
      (q193878-all-carrier-members-p carrier values))
     (q193878-solution-exists-p
      carrier ideals values add negate))))

(defun q193878-canonical-quotient-ring-equivalence-p
    (carrier ideals add negate)
  (and
   (q193878-canonical-reflects-equality-p
    carrier ideals add negate)
   (q193878-canonical-surjective-p
    carrier ideals add negate)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q193878-chinese-remainder-theorem-statement
    (indices ideals carrier zero one add multiply negate)
  (implies
   (and
    (true-listp indices)
    (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)
    (true-listp ideals)
    (equal (len indices) (len ideals))
    (q193878-commutative-ring-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate)
    (q193878-ideal-family-p
     carrier zero add multiply negate ideals)
    (q193878-pairwise-coprime-p
     ideals one add))
   (q193878-canonical-quotient-ring-equivalence-p
    carrier ideals add negate)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q193878,
-- "Chinese remainder theorem": pairwise coprime ideals in a commutative ring
-- give a canonical ring isomorphism from the quotient by their intersection
-- to the product of the individual quotient rings. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 4 _×_
infix 4 _≠_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
_≠_ {a} x y =
  x ≡ y → Bottom {a}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size       : Nat
    equivalence : Bijection A (Fin size)

record CommutativeRing
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR : R → R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record Ideal
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    member : R → Set r
    membership-propositional :
      (x : R) →
      (u v : member x) →
      u ≡ v
    contains-zero :
      member (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : R) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : R) →
      member x →
      member (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (a x : R) →
      member x →
      member (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring a x)

difference :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  R →
  R
difference ring x y =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring x
    (CommutativeRing.negateR ring y)

IsCoprime :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  Ideal ring →
  Ideal ring →
  Set r
IsCoprime {R = R} {ring = ring} left-ideal right-ideal =
  Σ R
    (λ x →
      Ideal.member left-ideal x ×
      Σ R
        (λ y →
          Ideal.member right-ideal y ×
          (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y ≡
           CommutativeRing.oneR ring)))

PairwiseCoprime :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  (Index → Ideal ring) →
  Set (r ⊔ i)
PairwiseCoprime ideals =
  (i j : _) →
  i ≠ j →
  IsCoprime (ideals i) (ideals j)

IntersectionQuotientRelated :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  (ideals : Index → Ideal ring) →
  R →
  R →
  Set (r ⊔ i)
IntersectionQuotientRelated ring ideals x y =
  (i : _) →
  Ideal.member (ideals i) (difference ring x y)

ProductQuotientRelated :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  (ideals : Index → Ideal ring) →
  (Index → R) →
  (Index → R) →
  Set (r ⊔ i)
ProductQuotientRelated ring ideals f g =
  (i : _) →
  Ideal.member (ideals i) (difference ring (f i) (g i))

constantFamily :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  R →
  Index →
  R
constantFamily x _ =
  x

pointwiseZero :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Index →
  R
pointwiseZero ring _ =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

pointwiseOne :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Index →
  R
pointwiseOne ring _ =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring

pointwiseAdd :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (Index → R) →
  (Index → R) →
  Index →
  R
pointwiseAdd ring f g i =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring (f i) (g i)

pointwiseMultiply :
  {r i : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (Index → R) →
  (Index → R) →
  Index →
  R
pointwiseMultiply ring f g i =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring (f i) (g i)

record QuotientRingEquiv
  {a b p q : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (domain-related : A → A → Set p)
  (codomain-related : B → B → Set q)
  (domain-zero domain-one : A)
  (domain-add domain-multiply : A → A → A)
  (codomain-zero codomain-one : B)
  (codomain-add codomain-multiply : B → B → B)
  (forward : A → B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ p ⊔ q) where

  field
    inverse :
      B → A
    forward-congruent :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-related x y →
      codomain-related (forward x) (forward y)
    inverse-congruent :
      (x y : B) →
      codomain-related x y →
      domain-related (inverse x) (inverse y)
    map-zero :
      codomain-related (forward domain-zero) codomain-zero
    map-one :
      codomain-related (forward domain-one) codomain-one
    map-add :
      (x y : A) →
      codomain-related
        (forward (domain-add x y))
        (codomain-add (forward x) (forward y))
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      codomain-related
        (forward (domain-multiply x y))
        (codomain-multiply (forward x) (forward y))
    inverse-forward :
      (x : A) →
      domain-related (inverse (forward x)) x
    forward-inverse :
      (y : B) →
      codomain-related (forward (inverse y)) y

-- Lean: Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient
chinese-remainder-theorem :
  (r i : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ i))
chinese-remainder-theorem r i =
  {R : Set r} →
  {Index : Set i} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  (finite-index : Finite Index) →
  (ideals : Index → Ideal ring) →
  PairwiseCoprime ideals →
  QuotientRingEquiv
    R
    (Index → R)
    (IntersectionQuotientRelated ring ideals)
    (ProductQuotientRelated ring ideals)
    (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    (CommutativeRing.oneR ring)
    (CommutativeRing.addR ring)
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring)
    (pointwiseZero ring)
    (pointwiseOne ring)
    (pointwiseAdd ring)
    (pointwiseMultiply ring)
    constantFamily

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q193878, "Chinese remainder theorem": for a possibly empty finite
  pairwise-coprime family of ideals in a commutative ring, the quotient by
  their intersection is canonically ring-isomorphic to the product of the
  individual quotients. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q193878_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_comm_ring_def",
  ``q193878_comm_ring
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))``);

val q193878_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_ideal_def",
  ``q193878_ideal
      (zero : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) <=>
      zero IN ideal /\
      (!x y. x IN ideal /\ y IN ideal ==> add x y IN ideal) /\
      (!x. x IN ideal ==> neg x IN ideal) /\
      (!a x. x IN ideal ==> mul a x IN ideal)``);

val q193878_class_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_class_def",
  ``q193878_class
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) (r : 'r) =
      {x | add x (neg r) IN ideal}``);

val q193878_quotient_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_quotient_carrier_def",
  ``q193878_quotient_carrier
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) =
      {cls | ?r. cls = q193878_class add neg ideal r}``);

val q193878_representative_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_representative_def",
  ``q193878_representative
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) (cls : 'r set) =
      @r. cls = q193878_class add neg ideal r``);

val q193878_quotient_add_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_quotient_add_def",
  ``q193878_quotient_add
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) (cls1 : 'r set) (cls2 : 'r set) =
      q193878_class add neg ideal
        (add
          (q193878_representative add neg ideal cls1)
          (q193878_representative add neg ideal cls2))``);

val q193878_quotient_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_quotient_mul_def",
  ``q193878_quotient_mul
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (ideal : 'r set)
      (cls1 : 'r set) (cls2 : 'r set) =
      q193878_class add neg ideal
        (mul
          (q193878_representative add neg ideal cls1)
          (q193878_representative add neg ideal cls2))``);

val q193878_quotient_neg_def = new_definition (
  "q193878_quotient_neg_def",
  ``q193878_quotient_neg
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) (cls : 'r set) =
      q193878_class add neg ideal
        (neg (q193878_representative add neg ideal cls))``);

val quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (indices : 'i set) (ideals : 'i -> 'r set).
      q193878_comm_ring zero oneR add mul neg /\
      FINITE indices /\
      (!i.
        i IN indices ==>
        q193878_ideal zero add mul neg (ideals i)) /\
      (!i j.
        i IN indices /\ j IN indices /\ i <> j ==>
        ?a b. a IN ideals i /\ b IN ideals j /\ add a b = oneR)
      ==>
      let infI = {x | !i. i IN indices ==> x IN ideals i} in
      let source = q193878_quotient_carrier add neg infI in
      let target =
        {g : 'i -> 'r set |
          (!i.
            i IN indices ==>
            g i IN q193878_quotient_carrier add neg (ideals i)) /\
          (!i. ~(i IN indices) ==> g i = {})}
      in
      ?e : 'r set -> 'i -> 'r set.
        BIJ e source target /\
        (!r.
          e (q193878_class add neg infI r) =
          (\i.
            if i IN indices
            then q193878_class add neg (ideals i) r
            else {})) /\
        e (q193878_class add neg infI zero) =
          (\i.
            if i IN indices
            then q193878_class add neg (ideals i) zero
            else {}) /\
        e (q193878_class add neg infI oneR) =
          (\i.
            if i IN indices
            then q193878_class add neg (ideals i) oneR
            else {}) /\
        (!cls1 cls2.
          cls1 IN source /\ cls2 IN source ==>
          e (q193878_quotient_add add neg infI cls1 cls2) =
            (\i.
              if i IN indices
              then
                q193878_quotient_add add neg (ideals i)
                  (e cls1 i) (e cls2 i)
              else {})) /\
        (!cls1 cls2.
          cls1 IN source /\ cls2 IN source ==>
          e (q193878_quotient_mul add mul neg infI cls1 cls2) =
            (\i.
              if i IN indices
              then
                q193878_quotient_mul add mul neg (ideals i)
                  (e cls1 i) (e cls2 i)
              else {})) /\
        (!cls.
          cls IN source ==>
          e (q193878_quotient_neg add neg infI cls) =
            (\i.
              if i IN indices
              then q193878_quotient_neg add neg (ideals i) (e cls i)
              else {}))``;

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193878
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q193878), "Chinese remainder theorem":
  for a finite family of pairwise coprime ideals in an arbitrary commutative
  ring, the canonical map from the quotient by their intersection to the
  product of the individual quotient rings is a ring isomorphism. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K is the carrier of the arbitrary finite index type, and F is the
  corresponding family of left ideals of the commutative ring R. Pairwise
  coprimality is expressed by the sum of each pair of distinct ideals being
  the whole ring carrier.

  The class abstraction in the left quotient is the bounded intersection of
  the ideals. Bounding it by Base ` R is essential for the empty family, when
  the intersection is the top ideal. The structure product Xs_ on the right
  is the dependent product of the individual quotient rings. The quantified
  RingIso witness sends the class of each x modulo the intersection to the
  function whose i-th value is the class of x modulo F ` i. Thus the final
  assertion renders the canonical equivalence
  Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient without supplying a proof.
$)

${
  $d E F K R i j x $.

  thousand-theorems-q193878-chinese-remainder-theorem $a |- (
    A. R e. CRing A. K e. Fin A. F
      (
        (
          F e. ( K --> ( LIdeal ` R ) )
          /\
          A. i e. K A. j e. ( K \ { i } )
            (
              ( F ` i )
              ( LSSum ` R )
              ( F ` j )
            ) = ( Base ` R )
        )
        ->
        E. E e.
          (
            (
              R /s
              (
                R ~QG
                { x e. ( Base ` R ) |
                  A. i e. K x e. ( F ` i )
                }
              )
            )
            RingIso
            (
              R Xs_
              (
                i e. K |->
                  (
                    R /s
                    ( R ~QG ( F ` i ) )
                  )
              )
            )
          )
          A. x e. ( Base ` R )
            (
              E
              `
              [ x ]
              (
                R ~QG
                { x e. ( Base ` R ) |
                  A. i e. K x e. ( F ` i )
                }
              )
            )
            =
            (
              i e. K |->
                [ x ] ( R ~QG ( F ` i ) )
            )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q193878
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q193878), "Chinese remainder theorem": a finite family
% of pairwise coprime ideals in a commutative ring yields the canonical ring
% equivalence from the quotient by their intersection to the product of the
% individual quotient rings. This file contains no proof.

Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem[
  R: TYPE+,
  Index: TYPE,
  zero, one: R,
  neg: [R -> R],
  add, mul: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index]

  ideal: TYPE = [R -> bool]
  ideal_family: TYPE = [Index -> ideal]
  product_representative: TYPE = [Index -> R]

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(zero, x) = x
          AND add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(neg(x), x) = zero
          AND add(x, neg(x)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(x, add(y, z)) =
          add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(add(x, y), z) =
          add(mul(x, z), mul(y, z)))

  is_ideal(I: ideal): bool =
    I(zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        I(x) AND I(y) IMPLIES I(add(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(neg(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(mul(a, x)))

  coprime(I, J: ideal): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: R):
      I(x) AND J(y) AND add(x, y) = one

  pairwise_coprime(ideals: ideal_family): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: Index):
      i /= j IMPLIES coprime(ideals(i), ideals(j))

  difference(x, y: R): R =
    add(x, neg(y))

  intersection_quotient_related(
      ideals: ideal_family,
      x, y: R): bool =
    FORALL (i: Index):
      ideals(i)(difference(x, y))

  product_quotient_related(
      ideals: ideal_family,
      values, other: product_representative): bool =
    FORALL (i: Index):
      ideals(i)(difference(values(i), other(i)))

  constant_family(x: R): product_representative =
    LAMBDA (i: Index): x

  pointwise_zero: product_representative =
    LAMBDA (i: Index): zero

  pointwise_one: product_representative =
    LAMBDA (i: Index): one

  pointwise_neg(
      values: product_representative): product_representative =
    LAMBDA (i: Index): neg(values(i))

  pointwise_add(
      values, other: product_representative): product_representative =
    LAMBDA (i: Index): add(values(i), other(i))

  pointwise_mul(
      values, other: product_representative): product_representative =
    LAMBDA (i: Index): mul(values(i), other(i))

  canonical_map_is_ring_equivalence(
      ideals: ideal_family,
      inverse: [product_representative -> R]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      intersection_quotient_related(ideals, x, y)
        IMPLIES
          product_quotient_related(
            ideals, constant_family(x), constant_family(y)))
      AND (FORALL (values, other: product_representative):
        product_quotient_related(ideals, values, other)
          IMPLIES
            intersection_quotient_related(
              ideals, inverse(values), inverse(other)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        intersection_quotient_related(
          ideals, inverse(constant_family(x)), x))
      AND (FORALL (values: product_representative):
        product_quotient_related(
          ideals, constant_family(inverse(values)), values))
      AND constant_family(zero) = pointwise_zero
      AND constant_family(one) = pointwise_one
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        constant_family(neg(x)) =
          pointwise_neg(constant_family(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        constant_family(add(x, y)) =
          pointwise_add(constant_family(x), constant_family(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        constant_family(mul(x, y)) =
          pointwise_mul(constant_family(x), constant_family(y)))

  chinese_remainder_theorem: bool =
    (is_finite_type[Index] AND commutative_ring_laws)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (ideals: ideal_family):
          ((FORALL (i: Index): is_ideal(ideals(i)))
            AND pairwise_coprime(ideals))
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (inverse: [product_representative -> R]):
              canonical_map_is_ring_equivalence(ideals, inverse))
END Q193878_chinese_remainder_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193910
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q193910), "Euler's theorem": natural numbers
  coprime to a modulus have their Euler-totient power congruent to one modulo
  that modulus. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Definition q193910_euler_totient (n : nat) : nat :=
  List.length
    (List.filter
       (fun k : nat => Nat.eqb (Nat.gcd k n) 1)
       (List.seq 0 n)).

Definition q193910_mod_eq (n a b : nat) : Prop :=
  Nat.modulo a n = Nat.modulo b n.

Theorem nat_mod_eq_pow_totient :
  forall x n : nat,
    Nat.gcd x n = 1 ->
    q193910_mod_eq n (Nat.pow x (q193910_euler_totient n)) 1.
Admitted.

theory Q193910_euler_s_theorem

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q193910,
;; "Euler's theorem": for natural numbers x and n, coprimality implies that x
;; raised to Euler's totient of n is congruent to 1 modulo n. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun q193910-gcd (a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix a) (nfix b))))
  (if (and (natp a) (natp b))
      (cond ((equal a 0) b)
            ((equal b 0) a)
            ((< a b)
             (q193910-gcd a (- b a)))
            (t
             (q193910-gcd (- a b) b)))
    0))

(defun q193910-totient-count (k n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix k)))
  (if (and (natp k) (natp n))
      (if (equal k 0)
          0
        (+ (if (equal (q193910-gcd (- k 1) n) 1)
               1
             0)
           (q193910-totient-count (- k 1) n)))
    0))

(defun q193910-totient (n)
  (if (natp n)
      (q193910-totient-count n n)
    0))

(defun q193910-congruent-p (x y n)
  (and (integerp x)
       (integerp y)
       (natp n)
       (if (equal n 0)
           (equal x y)
         (equal (mod x n) (mod y n)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q193910-euler-s-theorem-statement (x n)
  (implies (and (natp x)
                (natp n)
                (equal (q193910-gcd x n) 1))
           (q193910-congruent-p
            (expt x (q193910-totient n))
            1
            n)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q193910_euler_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193910
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q193910), "Euler's theorem": if two natural
-- numbers are coprime, raising the first to the totient of the second is
-- congruent to one modulo the second. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q193910_euler_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; mod-helper)

infixr 8 _^_

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

_^_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
base ^ zero =
  one
base ^ suc exponent =
  base * (base ^ exponent)

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

gcdWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
gcdWithFuel zero a b =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a zero =
  a
gcdWithFuel (suc fuel) a (suc b) =
  gcdWithFuel fuel (suc b) (naturalMod a (suc b))

naturalGCD : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalGCD a b =
  gcdWithFuel (suc (a + b)) a b

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc b) =
  false
natEqual (suc a) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc a) (suc b) =
  natEqual a b

Coprime : Nat -> Nat -> Set
Coprime a b =
  naturalGCD a b == one

coprimeBool : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
coprimeBool a b =
  natEqual (naturalGCD a b) one

indicator : Bool -> Nat
indicator false =
  zero
indicator true =
  one

countCoprimeThrough : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
countCoprimeThrough n zero =
  zero
countCoprimeThrough n (suc bound) =
  countCoprimeThrough n bound +
  indicator (coprimeBool (suc bound) n)

totient : Nat -> Nat
totient n =
  countCoprimeThrough n n

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus lhs rhs =
  naturalMod lhs modulus == naturalMod rhs modulus

euler-s-theorem : Set
euler-s-theorem =
  (x n : Nat) ->
  Coprime x n ->
  ModEq n (x ^ totient n) one

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 is SetMM's class of natural numbers. SetMM's native Euler phi function
  is defined on positive integers, while Mathlib's Nat.totient is total and
  has value zero at zero. Q193910Phi is the corresponding totalization on
  NN0. Q193910ModEq is Mathlib's total Nat.ModEq: at modulus zero it compares
  the original naturals, and at a positive modulus it compares SetMM
  remainders. For natural numbers, gcd equal to one is Nat.Coprime.

  The auxiliary $a assertions are faithful definitions, and the final $a is
  the unproved corpus statement. This root file contains no $p proof
  declaration.
$)

$c Q193910Phi Q193910ModEq $.

q193910-phi-syntax $a class Q193910Phi $.
q193910-mod-eq-syntax $a wff ( Q193910ModEq A B M ) $.

${
  q193910-phi-definition $a |-
    Q193910Phi =
      ( n e. NN0 |-> if ( n = 0 , 0 , ( phi ` n ) ) )
  $.
$}

q193910-mod-eq-definition $a |- (
  ( Q193910ModEq A B M )
  <->
  if (
    M = 0 ,
    A ,
    ( A mod M )
  )

) $.

Q193910_euler_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q193910,
% "Euler's theorem": if natural numbers x and n are coprime, then x raised to
% Euler's totient of n is congruent to 1 modulo n. This file contains no proof.

Q193910_euler_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[nat]

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  is_nat_gcd(gcd_value, left, right: nat): bool =
    nat_divides(gcd_value, left)
      AND nat_divides(gcd_value, right)
      AND (FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, left) AND nat_divides(divisor, right)
          IMPLIES nat_divides(divisor, gcd_value))

  is_euler_totient(phi, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (coprime_residues: finite_set[nat]):
      phi = card(coprime_residues)
        AND (FORALL (value: nat):
          coprime_residues(value) IFF
            value < modulus AND is_nat_gcd(1, value, modulus))

  nat_congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) = (modulus :: int) * offset

  euler_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (x, n, phi: nat):
      is_nat_gcd(1, x, n) AND is_euler_totient(phi, n)
        IMPLIES nat_congruent(x ^ phi, 1, n)
END Q193910_euler_s_theorem

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1966978
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q1966978), "Lévy continuity theorem": weak
  convergence of Borel probability measures on a finite-dimensional real
  inner-product space is equivalent to pointwise convergence of their
  characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q1966978_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q1966978_empty {A : Type} : q1966978_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q1966978_full {A : Type} : q1966978_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q1966978_complement {A : Type}
    (U : q1966978_set A) : q1966978_set A :=
  fun x => ~ U x.

Definition q1966978_countable_union {A : Type}
    (U : nat -> q1966978_set A) : q1966978_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, U n x.

Definition q1966978_preimage {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (U : q1966978_set B) : q1966978_set A :=
  fun x => U (f x).

Definition q1966978_same_set {A : Type}
    (U W : q1966978_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x <-> W x.

Definition q1966978_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U W : q1966978_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (U x /\ W x).

Definition q1966978_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U : nat -> q1966978_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q1966978_disjoint (U i) (U j).

Fixpoint q1966978_real_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q1966978_real_partial_sum u k + u k
  end.

Definition q1966978_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Record q1966978_complex : Type := {
  q1966978_re : R;
  q1966978_im : R
}.

Definition q1966978_complex_distance
    (z w : q1966978_complex) : R :=
  sqrt
    ((q1966978_re z - q1966978_re w) ^ 2 +
     (q1966978_im z - q1966978_im w) ^ 2).

Definition q1966978_complex_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> q1966978_complex)
    (limit : q1966978_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q1966978_complex_distance (u n) limit < epsilon.

Record q1966978_real_inner_product_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q1966978_zero : E;
  q1966978_add : E -> E -> E;
  q1966978_neg : E -> E;
  q1966978_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q1966978_inner : E -> E -> R;
  q1966978_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1966978_add x (q1966978_add y z) =
      q1966978_add (q1966978_add x y) z;
  q1966978_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q1966978_add x y = q1966978_add y x;
  q1966978_zero_add :
    forall x : E, q1966978_add q1966978_zero x = x;
  q1966978_neg_add :
    forall x : E, q1966978_add (q1966978_neg x) x = q1966978_zero;
  q1966978_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q1966978_smul 1 x = x;
  q1966978_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1966978_smul (a * b) x =
      q1966978_smul a (q1966978_smul b x);
  q1966978_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q1966978_smul (a + b) x =
      q1966978_add (q1966978_smul a x) (q1966978_smul b x);
  q1966978_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q1966978_smul a (q1966978_add x y) =
      q1966978_add (q1966978_smul a x) (q1966978_smul a y);
  q1966978_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q1966978_smul 0 x = q1966978_zero;
  q1966978_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q1966978_smul a q1966978_zero = q1966978_zero;
  q1966978_neg_eq_smul :
    forall x : E, q1966978_neg x = q1966978_smul (-1) x;
  q1966978_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : E,
      q1966978_inner (q1966978_add x y) z =
      q1966978_inner x z + q1966978_inner y z;
  q1966978_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q1966978_inner (q1966978_smul a x) y =
      a * q1966978_inner x y;
  q1966978_inner_symm :
    forall x y : E, q1966978_inner x y = q1966978_inner y x;
  q1966978_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q1966978_inner x x;
  q1966978_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q1966978_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q1966978_zero;
  q1966978_finite_orthonormal_basis :
    exists (dimension : nat) (basis : nat -> E),
      (forall i j : nat,

  q1966978_integral_nonnegative :
    forall f : E -> R,

      q1966978_bounded f ->

  q1966978_integral_monotone_convergence :
    forall (f : nat -> E -> R) (g : E -> R),
      (forall n : nat, q1966978_measurable_real_function V (f n)) ->
      q1966978_measurable_real_function V g ->

Arguments q1966978_probability_measure E V : clear implicits.

Definition q1966978_weak_tendsto {E : Type}
    {V : q1966978_real_inner_product_space E}

    q1966978_bounded f ->
    q1966978_real_sequence_converges

Definition q1966978_characteristic_function {E : Type}
    {V : q1966978_real_inner_product_space E}
    (mu : q1966978_probability_measure E V)

  {|

      q1966978_integral mu
        (fun x => cos (q1966978_inner V x t));
    q1966978_im :=

Theorem q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q1966978_real_inner_product_space E)
         (mu : nat -> q1966978_probability_measure E V)
         (mu0 : q1966978_probability_measure E V),
    q1966978_weak_tendsto mu mu0 <->
    forall t : E,

title: Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1966978
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q1966978), "Lévy continuity theorem": for Borel
  probability measures on an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product
  space, weak convergence is equivalent to pointwise convergence of their
  characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
  imports "HOL-Probability.Levy"
begin

definition q1966978_probability_measure ::
    "'a::euclidean_space measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1966978_probability_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
      sets M = sets borel \<and> emeasure M UNIV = 1"

definition q1966978_weak_convergence ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::euclidean_space measure) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q1966978_weak_convergence M M0 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>f :: 'a \<Rightarrow> real.
        bounded (range f) \<and> continuous_on UNIV f \<longrightarrow>
        (\<lambda>n. integral\<^sup>L (M n) f)
          \<longlonglongrightarrow> integral\<^sup>L M0 f)"

definition q1966978_characteristic_function ::
    "'a::euclidean_space measure \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> complex"
  where
    "q1966978_characteristic_function M t =
      integral\<^sup>L M (\<lambda>x. iexp (inner t x))"

theorem levy_continuity_theorem:
  fixes M :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::euclidean_space measure"
    and M0 :: "'a measure"
  assumes M_probability: "\<And>n. q1966978_probability_measure (M n)"
    and M0_probability: "q1966978_probability_measure M0"
  shows
    "q1966978_weak_convergence M M0 \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>t :: 'a.
        (\<lambda>n. q1966978_characteristic_function (M n) t)
          \<longlonglongrightarrow> q1966978_characteristic_function M0 t)"
  sorry

end

title: Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1966978,
  "Lévy continuity theorem": weak convergence of probability measures on a
  finite-dimensional real inner-product space is equivalent to pointwise
  convergence of their characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q1966978_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q1966978_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q1966978_output;;
let q1966978_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q1966978_formatter path);;

  Toploop.use_file q1966978_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;

if not q1966978_loaded then
  failwith "Q1966978: failed to load Library/transc.ml";;

let Q1966978_LEVY_CONTINUITY_THEOREM = `
  let seq_tends = \(u:num->real) (z:real).
    !epsilon:real.
      &0 < epsilon
      ==> ?N:num. !n:num. N <= n ==> abs(u n - z) < epsilon in
  let complex_seq_tends = \(u:num->real#real) (z:real#real).
    seq_tends (\n. FST(u n)) (FST z) /\
    seq_tends (\n. SND(u n)) (SND z) in
  let real_inner_product_space =
      \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E)
       (smul:real->E->E) (inner:E->E->real) (norm:E->real).
    (!x y:E. add x y = add y x) /\
    (!x y z:E. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
    (!x:E. add x zero = x) /\
    (!x:E. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
    (!x:E. smul (&1) x = x) /\
    (!a b:real. !x:E. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
    (!a b:real. !x:E. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
    (!a:real. !x y:E. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
    (!x y:E. inner x y = inner y x) /\
    (!x y z:E. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
    (!a:real. !x y:E. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
    (!x:E. &0 <= inner x x) /\
    (!x:E. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
    (!x:E. norm x = sqrt(inner x x)) in
  let finite_dimensional =
      \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E).
    ?d:num basis:num->E.
      !x:E.
        ?coeff:num->real partial:num->E.
          partial 0 = zero /\
          (!i:num.
             i < d
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 add (partial i) (smul (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial d = x in
  let open_set = \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
                   (u:E->bool).
    !x:E.
      x IN u
      ==> ?epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon /\
            !y:E. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u in
  let sigma_algebra = \(events:(E->bool)->bool).
    events (:E) /\
    (!s:E->bool. events s ==> events ((:E) DIFF s)) /\
    (!sets:num->E->bool.
       (!n:num. events (sets n))
       ==> events {x:E | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
  let borel_event = \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
                     (s:E->bool).
    !events:(E->bool)->bool.
      sigma_algebra events /\
      (!u:E->bool. open_set add neg norm u ==> events u)
      ==> events s in
  let borel_space = \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
                     (events:(E->bool)->bool).
    !s:E->bool. events s <=> borel_event add neg norm s in
  let probability = \(events:(E->bool)->bool)
                     (mu:(E->bool)->real).
    sigma_algebra events /\
    mu {} = &0 /\
    mu (:E) = &1 /\
    (!s:E->bool. events s ==> &0 <= mu s) /\
    (!sets:num->E->bool.
       (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
       (!i j:num. ~(i = j) ==> DISJOINT (sets i) (sets j))
       ==> seq_tends
             (\N:num. sum {k:num | k < N} (\k. mu (sets k)))
             (mu {x:E | ?k:num. x IN sets k})) in
  let continuous = \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
                    (h:E->real).
    !x:E epsilon:real.
      &0 < epsilon
      ==> ?delta:real.
            &0 < delta /\
            !y:E.
              norm (add y (neg x)) < delta
              ==> abs(h y - h x) < epsilon in
  let bounded_continuous =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real) (h:E->real).
    continuous add neg norm h /\
    ?bound:real. !x:E. abs(h x) <= bound in
  let simple_function = \(events:(E->bool)->bool) (s:E->real).
    (!x:E. &0 <= s x) /\
    FINITE (IMAGE s (:E)) /\
    (!c:real. events {x:E | s x = c}) in
  let simple_integral = \(mu:(E->bool)->real) (s:E->real).
    sum (IMAGE s (:E)) (\c:real. c * mu {x:E | s x = c}) in
  let lintegral_upper =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool) (mu:(E->bool)->real)
       (h:E->real) (upper:real).
    !s:E->real.
      simple_function events s /\
      (!x:E. s x <= h x)
      ==> simple_integral mu s <= upper in
  let has_lintegral =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool) (mu:(E->bool)->real)
       (h:E->real) (z:real).
    &0 <= z /\
    lintegral_upper events mu h z /\
    (!upper:real.
       &0 <= upper /\
       lintegral_upper events mu h upper
       ==> z <= upper) in
  let lintegral =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool) (mu:(E->bool)->real) (h:E->real).
    @z:real. has_lintegral events mu h z in
  let integral =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool) (mu:(E->bool)->real) (h:E->real).
    lintegral events mu (\x:E. if &0 <= h x then h x else &0) -
    lintegral events mu (\x:E. if h x < &0 then --(h x) else &0) in
  let weak_tends =
      \(add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (norm:E->real)
       (events:(E->bool)->bool)
       (mu:num->(E->bool)->real) (mu0:(E->bool)->real).
    !h:E->real.
      bounded_continuous add neg norm h
      ==> seq_tends
            (\n:num. integral events (mu n) h)
            (integral events mu0 h) in
  let char_fun =
      \(events:(E->bool)->bool) (inner:E->E->real)
       (mu:(E->bool)->real) (t:E).
    (integral events mu (\x:E. cos(inner t x)),
     integral events mu (\x:E. sin(inner t x))) in
  !zero:E
   add:E->E->E
   neg:E->E
   smul:real->E->E
   inner:E->E->real
   norm:E->real
   events:(E->bool)->bool
   mu:num->(E->bool)->real
   mu0:(E->bool)->real.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner norm /\
    finite_dimensional zero add smul /\
    borel_space add neg norm events /\
    (!n:num. probability events (mu n)) /\
    probability events mu0
    ==>
    (weak_tends add neg norm events mu mu0 <=>
     !t:E.
       complex_seq_tends
         (\n:num. char_fun events inner (mu n) t)
         (char_fun events inner mu0 t))
`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1966978,
;; "Lévy continuity theorem": for probability measures on an arbitrary
;; finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra,
;; weak convergence is equivalent to pointwise convergence of the complex
;; characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Types, sets, functions, measures, and sequences are unrestricted ACL2
;; objects interpreted by conservative interfaces.  The predicates below
;; explicitly impose a complete ordered real field, a finite-dimensional real
;; inner-product space, its Borel sigma algebra, countably additive probability
;; measures, exact bounded Lebesgue integration, and the power-series sine and
;; cosine used by the characteristic function.  No carrier is made finite:
;; only the internally quantified basis has finite length.

(defun q1966978-leq (real x y)
  (not (q1966978-less real y x)))

(defun q1966978-positive-p (real x)
  (and
   (q1966978-member-p real x)
   (q1966978-less real (q1966978-zero real) x)))

(defun q1966978-nonnegative-p (real x)
  (and
   (q1966978-member-p real x)
   (q1966978-leq real (q1966978-zero real) x)))

(defun q1966978-subtract (type x y)
  (q1966978-add type x (q1966978-negate type y)))

(defun q1966978-absolute-value (real x)
  (if (q1966978-less real x (q1966978-zero real))
      (q1966978-negate real x)
    x))

(defun q1966978-natural-cast (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1966978-zero real)
    (q1966978-add
     real
     (q1966978-natural-cast real (- n 1))
     (q1966978-one real))))

(defun q1966978-power (real x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1966978-one real)
    (q1966978-multiply
     real x (q1966978-power real x (- n 1)))))

(defun q1966978-factorial (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q1966978-one real)
    (q1966978-multiply
     real
     (q1966978-natural-cast real n)
     (q1966978-factorial real (- n 1)))))

(defun q1966978-divide (real x y)
  (q1966978-multiply real x (q1966978-inverse real y)))

(defun q1966978-alternating (real k x)
  (if (equal (mod (nfix k) 2) 0)
      x
    (q1966978-negate real x)))

(defun q1966978-cosine-partial-sum (real count x)

(defun q1966978-sine-partial-sum (real count x)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.

(defun-sk q1966978-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p real x)
      (q1966978-member-p real y)
      (q1966978-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q1966978-zero real))
           (one (q1966978-one real)))
       (and
        (q1966978-member-p real (q1966978-add real x y))
        (q1966978-member-p real (q1966978-multiply real x y))
        (q1966978-member-p real (q1966978-negate real x))
        (q1966978-member-p real (q1966978-inverse real x))
        (equal
         (q1966978-add real (q1966978-add real x y) z)
         (q1966978-add real x (q1966978-add real y z)))
        (equal (q1966978-add real x y)
               (q1966978-add real y x))
        (equal (q1966978-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q1966978-add real x (q1966978-negate real x))
               zero)
        (equal
         (q1966978-multiply
          real (q1966978-multiply real x y) z)
         (q1966978-multiply
          real x (q1966978-multiply real y z)))
        (equal (q1966978-multiply real x y)
               (q1966978-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q1966978-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q1966978-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q1966978-multiply
           real x (q1966978-inverse real x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q1966978-multiply
          real x (q1966978-add real y z))
         (q1966978-add
          real
          (q1966978-multiply real x y)
          (q1966978-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q1966978-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p real x)
      (q1966978-member-p real y)
      (q1966978-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q1966978-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q1966978-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q1966978-less real x y)
         (q1966978-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1966978-less real x y)
          (q1966978-less real y z))
         (q1966978-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q1966978-less real x y)
         (q1966978-less
          real
          (q1966978-add real x z)
          (q1966978-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q1966978-less real zero x)
          (q1966978-less real zero y))
         (q1966978-less
          real zero (q1966978-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q1966978-real-set-nonempty-p (real set)

(defun-sk q1966978-bounded-above-p (real set)
