;; The finite-dimensional real inner-product space.  The orthonormal basis and
;; coordinate map are internal existential witnesses, as in the source's
;; FiniteDimensional typeclass rather than additional theorem parameters.

(defun-sk q1966978-vector-space-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p real a)
      (q1966978-member-p real b)
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (q1966978-member-p space y)
      (q1966978-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p space (q1966978-add space x y))
      (q1966978-member-p space (q1966978-negate space x))
      (q1966978-member-p
       space (q1966978-smul real space a x))
      (equal
       (q1966978-add space (q1966978-add space x y) z)
       (q1966978-add space x (q1966978-add space y z)))
      (equal (q1966978-add space x y)
             (q1966978-add space y x))
      (equal (q1966978-add space x (q1966978-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q1966978-add space x (q1966978-negate space x))
       (q1966978-zero space))
      (equal
       (q1966978-smul real space (q1966978-one real) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q1966978-smul
        real space (q1966978-multiply real a b) x)
       (q1966978-smul
        real space a (q1966978-smul real space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1966978-smul
        real space (q1966978-add real a b) x)
       (q1966978-add
        space
        (q1966978-smul real space a x)
        (q1966978-smul real space b x)))
      (equal
       (q1966978-smul
        real space a (q1966978-add space x y))
       (q1966978-add
        space
        (q1966978-smul real space a x)
        (q1966978-smul real space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q1966978-inner-product-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p real a)
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (q1966978-member-p space y)
      (q1966978-member-p space z))
     (let ((xy (q1966978-inner real space x y))
           (xx (q1966978-inner real space x x)))
       (and
        (q1966978-member-p real xy)
        (q1966978-nonnegative-p real xx)
        (equal
         (q1966978-inner
          real space x (q1966978-add space y z))
         (q1966978-add
          real xy (q1966978-inner real space x z)))
        (equal
         (q1966978-inner
          real space x (q1966978-smul real space a y))
         (q1966978-multiply real a xy))
        (equal
         (q1966978-inner real space y x)
         xy)
        (iff
         (equal xx (q1966978-zero real))
         (equal x (q1966978-zero space)))
        (q1966978-member-p
         real (q1966978-norm real space x))
        (q1966978-nonnegative-p
         real (q1966978-norm real space x))
        (equal
         (q1966978-multiply
          real
          (q1966978-norm real space x)
          (q1966978-norm real space x))
         xx))))))

(defun q1966978-vector-sum
    (real space basis coordinates vector count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q1966978-zero space)
    (let ((i (- count 1)))
      (q1966978-add
       space
       (q1966978-vector-sum
        real space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q1966978-smul
        real space
        (q1966978-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q1966978-basis-at basis i))))))

(defun-sk q1966978-orthonormal-basis-p
    (real space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (i j x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
      (q1966978-member-p
       space (q1966978-basis-at basis i)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp i) (natp j)
       (< i dimension) (< j dimension))
      (equal
       (q1966978-inner
        real space
        (q1966978-basis-at basis i)
        (q1966978-basis-at basis j))
       (if (equal i j)
           (q1966978-one real)
         (q1966978-zero real))))
     (implies
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
        (q1966978-member-p
         real (q1966978-coordinate coordinates x i)))
       (equal
        x
        (q1966978-vector-sum
         real space basis coordinates x dimension)))))))

(defun-sk q1966978-finite-basis-exists-p (real space)

      (q1966978-less
       real
       (q1966978-distance real space y x)
       radius))
     (q1966978-less
      real
      (q1966978-absolute-value
       real
       (q1966978-subtract
        real
        (q1966978-function-at function y)
        (q1966978-function-at function x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1966978-continuity-radius-p
    (real space function x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q1966978-positive-p real radius)
     (q1966978-continuity-ball-p
      real space function x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q1966978-continuous-function-p
    (real space function)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (q1966978-positive-p real epsilon))
     (q1966978-continuity-radius-p
      real space function x epsilon))))

(defun q1966978-bounded-continuous-p
    (real space family function)
  (and
   (q1966978-real-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-bounded-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-continuous-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-measurable-function-p
    real space family function)))

;; Exact bounded Lebesgue integration.  A nonnegative bounded measurable
;; function is integrated as the supremum of the integrals of all measurable
;; finite-range nonnegative simple functions below it.  Signed integrals are
;; the difference of the positive- and negative-part lower integrals.

(defun q1966978-values-nonnegative-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q1966978-nonnegative-p real (car values))
       (q1966978-values-nonnegative-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q1966978-range-in-values-p
    (space function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1966978-member-p space x)
     (member-equal
      (q1966978-function-at function x)
      values))))

(defun q1966978-simple-function-p
    (real space family function values)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q1966978-values-nonnegative-p real values)
   (q1966978-real-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-measurable-function-p
    real space family function)
   (q1966978-range-in-values-p
    space function values)))

(defun-sk q1966978-fiber-constructor-laws-p (space)
  (forall (function value x)
    (iff
     (q1966978-set-member-p
      (q1966978-fiber-set space function value)
      x)
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (equal
       (q1966978-function-at function x)
       value)))))

(defun q1966978-simple-integral
    (real space measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q1966978-add
       real
       (q1966978-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q1966978-measure-value
         measure
         (q1966978-fiber-set
          space function (car values))))
       (q1966978-simple-integral
        real space measure function (cdr values)))
    (q1966978-zero real)))

(defun-sk q1966978-simple-below-p
    (real space simple function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1966978-member-p space x)
     (q1966978-leq
      real
      (q1966978-function-at simple x)
      (q1966978-function-at function x)))))

(defun-sk q1966978-nonnegative-function-p
    (real space function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q1966978-member-p space x)
     (q1966978-nonnegative-p
      real (q1966978-function-at function x)))))

(defun q1966978-nonnegative-bounded-measurable-p
    (real space family function)
  (and
   (q1966978-real-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-nonnegative-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-bounded-function-p real space function)
   (q1966978-measurable-function-p
    real space family function)))

(defun-sk q1966978-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real space family measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-simple-function-p
       real space family simple values)
      (q1966978-simple-below-p
       real space simple function))
     (q1966978-leq
      real
      (q1966978-simple-integral
       real space measure simple values)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q1966978-lintegral-least-p
    (real space family measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-member-p real bound)
      (q1966978-lintegral-upper-bound-p
       real space family measure function bound))
     (q1966978-leq real value bound))))

(defun q1966978-lintegral-value-p
    (real space family measure function value)
  (and
   (q1966978-nonnegative-bounded-measurable-p
    real space family function)
   (q1966978-nonnegative-p real value)
   (q1966978-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    real space family measure function value)
   (q1966978-lintegral-least-p
    real space family measure function value)))

(defun-sk q1966978-lintegral-operation-p
    (real space family measure)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q1966978-nonnegative-bounded-measurable-p
      real space family function)
     (q1966978-lintegral-value-p
      real space family measure function
      (q1966978-lintegral-value measure function)))))

(defun-sk q1966978-function-constructor-laws-p
    (real space)
  (forall (function frequency x)
    (and
     (implies
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (equal
       (q1966978-function-at
        (q1966978-zero-function real space) x)
       (q1966978-zero real)))
     (implies
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (equal
       (q1966978-function-at
        (q1966978-positive-part-function real function) x)
       (let ((value
              (q1966978-function-at function x)))
         (if (q1966978-less
              real value (q1966978-zero real))
             (q1966978-zero real)
           value))))
     (implies
      (q1966978-member-p space x)
      (equal
       (q1966978-function-at
        (q1966978-negative-part-function real function) x)
       (let ((value
              (q1966978-function-at function x)))
         (if (q1966978-less
              real value (q1966978-zero real))
             (q1966978-negate real value)
           (q1966978-zero real)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1966978-member-p space frequency)
       (q1966978-member-p space x))
      (equal
       (q1966978-function-at
        (q1966978-cos-inner-function
         real space frequency)
        x)
       (q1966978-cosine
        real
        (q1966978-inner real space x frequency))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q1966978-member-p space frequency)
       (q1966978-member-p space x))
      (equal
       (q1966978-function-at
        (q1966978-sin-inner-function
         real space frequency)
        x)
       (q1966978-sine
        real
        (q1966978-inner real space x frequency)))))))

(defun-sk q1966978-positive-negative-valid-p
    (real space family)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q1966978-real-function-p real space function)
      (q1966978-bounded-function-p real space function)
      (q1966978-measurable-function-p
       real space family function))
     (and
      (q1966978-nonnegative-bounded-measurable-p
       real space family
       (q1966978-positive-part-function real function))
      (q1966978-nonnegative-bounded-measurable-p
       real space family
       (q1966978-negative-part-function real function))))))

(defun q1966978-real-integral-value (real measure function)
  (q1966978-subtract
   real
   (q1966978-lintegral-value
    measure
    (q1966978-positive-part-function real function))
   (q1966978-lintegral-value
    measure
    (q1966978-negative-part-function real function))))

(defun-sk q1966978-sequence-lintegral-operation-p
    (real space family measure-sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q1966978-lintegral-operation-p
      real space family
      (q1966978-measure-at measure-sequence n)))))

;; The real and imaginary parts of Mathlib's
;;   charFun μ t = integral x, exp(inner x t * I) dμ
;; are respectively the integrals of cos(inner x t) and sin(inner x t).

(defun q1966978-charfun-real
    (real space measure frequency)
  (q1966978-real-integral-value
   real measure
   (q1966978-cos-inner-function
    real space frequency)))

(defun q1966978-charfun-imag
    (real space measure frequency)
  (q1966978-real-integral-value
   real measure
   (q1966978-sin-inner-function
    real space frequency)))

(defun-sk q1966978-character-integrands-valid-p
    (real space family)
  (forall (frequency)
    (implies
     (q1966978-member-p space frequency)
     (and
      (q1966978-real-function-p
       real space
       (q1966978-cos-inner-function
        real space frequency))
      (q1966978-bounded-function-p
       real space
       (q1966978-cos-inner-function
        real space frequency))
      (q1966978-measurable-function-p
       real space family
       (q1966978-cos-inner-function
        real space frequency))
      (q1966978-real-function-p
       real space
       (q1966978-sin-inner-function
        real space frequency))
      (q1966978-bounded-function-p
       real space
       (q1966978-sin-inner-function
        real space frequency))
      (q1966978-measurable-function-p
       real space family
       (q1966978-sin-inner-function
        real space frequency))))))

;; Weak convergence is the standard bounded-continuous-test-function
;; characterization of the weak topology on probability measures.

(defun-sk q1966978-integral-convergence-tail-p
    (real measure-sequence limit-measure function epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start n))
     (q1966978-less
      real
      (q1966978-absolute-value
       real
       (q1966978-subtract
        real
        (q1966978-real-integral-value
         real
         (q1966978-measure-at measure-sequence n)
         function)
        (q1966978-real-integral-value
         real limit-measure function)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1966978-integral-convergence-start-p
    (real measure-sequence limit-measure function epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1966978-integral-convergence-tail-p
      real measure-sequence limit-measure
      function epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q1966978-integral-converges-p
    (real measure-sequence limit-measure function)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1966978-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1966978-integral-convergence-start-p
      real measure-sequence limit-measure
      function epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1966978-weak-convergence-p
    (real space family measure-sequence limit-measure)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q1966978-bounded-continuous-p
      real space family function)
     (q1966978-integral-converges-p
      real measure-sequence limit-measure function))))

;; Complex convergence is represented by simultaneous convergence of real and
;; imaginary coordinates.  This is exactly the product/Euclidean topology on
;; C, not a replacement of C by a proper subdomain.

(defun-sk q1966978-charfun-convergence-tail-p
    (real space measure-sequence limit-measure
     frequency epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start n))
     (and
      (q1966978-less
       real
       (q1966978-absolute-value
        real
        (q1966978-subtract
         real
         (q1966978-charfun-real
          real space
          (q1966978-measure-at measure-sequence n)
          frequency)
         (q1966978-charfun-real
          real space limit-measure frequency)))
       epsilon)
      (q1966978-less
       real
       (q1966978-absolute-value
        real
        (q1966978-subtract
         real
         (q1966978-charfun-imag
          real space
          (q1966978-measure-at measure-sequence n)
          frequency)
         (q1966978-charfun-imag
          real space limit-measure frequency)))
       epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q1966978-charfun-convergence-start-p
    (real space measure-sequence limit-measure frequency epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q1966978-charfun-convergence-tail-p
      real space measure-sequence limit-measure
      frequency epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q1966978-charfun-converges-p
    (real space measure-sequence limit-measure frequency)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q1966978-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q1966978-charfun-convergence-start-p
      real space measure-sequence limit-measure
      frequency epsilon))))

(defun-sk q1966978-pointwise-charfun-convergence-p
    (real space measure-sequence limit-measure)
  (forall (frequency)
    (implies
     (q1966978-member-p space frequency)
     (q1966978-charfun-converges-p
      real space measure-sequence limit-measure frequency))))

(defun q1966978-canonical-context-p
    (real space borel measure-sequence limit-measure)
  (and
   (q1966978-real-structure-p real)
   (q1966978-finite-inner-product-space-p real space)
   (q1966978-set-constructor-laws-p real space)
   (q1966978-borel-space-p real space borel)
   (q1966978-upper-ray-constructor-laws-p real space)
   (q1966978-fiber-constructor-laws-p space)
   (q1966978-function-constructor-laws-p real space)
   (q1966978-positive-negative-valid-p real space borel)
   (q1966978-trigonometric-sequence-laws-p real)
   (q1966978-trigonometric-laws-p real)
   (q1966978-character-integrands-valid-p
    real space borel)
   (q1966978-probability-measure-p
    real space borel limit-measure)
   (q1966978-probability-measure-sequence-p
    real space borel measure-sequence)
   (q1966978-lintegral-operation-p
    real space borel limit-measure)
   (q1966978-sequence-lintegral-operation-p
    real space borel measure-sequence)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q1966978-canonical-statement
    (real space borel measure-sequence limit-measure)
  (implies
   (q1966978-canonical-context-p
    real space borel measure-sequence limit-measure)
   (iff
    (q1966978-weak-convergence-p
     real space borel measure-sequence limit-measure)
    (q1966978-pointwise-charfun-convergence-p
     real space measure-sequence limit-measure))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q1966978,
-- "Lévy continuity theorem": weak convergence of probability measures on a
-- finite-dimensional real inner-product space is equivalent to pointwise
-- convergence of their characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A = A -> Set

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) -> S x -> T x

emptySet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
emptySet _ =
  Bottom

wholeSet :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
wholeSet _ =
  Top

complement :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
complement S x =
  Not (S x)

intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

countableUnion :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
countableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

preimage :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate A
preimage f S x =
  S (f x)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

SequentialLimit :
  {R A : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (A -> A -> R) ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  A ->
  Set
SequentialLimit reals distance values limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance (values n) limit) epsilon)

record NormedRealInnerProductSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE :
      E
    addE :
      E -> E -> E
    negateE :
      E -> E
    scaleE :
      R -> E -> E
    normE :
      E -> R
    innerE :
      E -> E -> R

    addE-commutative :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    addE-associative :
      (x y z : E) -> addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    addE-zero :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    addE-inverse :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE
    scaleE-one :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scaleE-multiply :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scaleE-add-scalars :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)
    scaleE-add-vectors :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)

    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : E) ->
      innerE (addE x y) z ==
      addR reals (innerE x z) (innerE y z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      innerE (scaleE a x) y ==
      multiplyR reals a (innerE x y)
    inner-symmetric :
      (x y : E) ->
      innerE x y == innerE y x
    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (innerE x x)
    inner-definite :
      (x : E) ->
      innerE x x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-square :
      (x : E) ->
      multiplyR reals (normE x) (normE x) == innerE x x
    norm-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-triangle :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))

open NormedRealInnerProductSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Vector :
  Set ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Vector R n =
  Fin n -> R

VectorEqual :
  {R : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector R n ->
  Set
VectorEqual {n = n} x y =
  (i : Fin n) -> x i == y i

sumVector :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
sumVector reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumVector reals (suc n) terms =
  addR reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumVector reals n (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

record FiniteDimensional
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals) : Set1 where
  field
    dimension :
      Nat
    toCoordinates :
      E -> Vector R dimension
    fromCoordinates :
      Vector R dimension -> E
    coordinates-after-vector :
      (x : Vector R dimension) ->
      VectorEqual (toCoordinates (fromCoordinates x)) x
    vector-after-coordinates :
      (x : E) ->
      fromCoordinates (toCoordinates x) == x
    coordinates-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (addE space x y))
        (\ i -> addR reals (toCoordinates x i) (toCoordinates y i))
    coordinates-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      VectorEqual
        (toCoordinates (scaleE space a x))
        (\ i -> multiplyR reals a (toCoordinates x i))
    coordinates-orthonormal :
      (x y : E) ->
      innerE space x y ==
      sumVector reals dimension
        (\ i ->
          multiplyR reals
            (toCoordinates x i)
            (toCoordinates y i))

NormOpen :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
NormOpen {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space U =
  (x : E) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : E) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) radius ->
          U y))

record SigmaAlgebra (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A ->
      Set
    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T
    measurable-empty :
      measurable emptySet
    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (complement S)
    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (countableUnion sets)

open SigmaAlgebra

data BorelGenerated
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals) :
  Predicate E -> Set1 where
  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate E} ->
    NormOpen space U ->
    BorelGenerated space U
  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated space emptySet
  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate E} ->
    BorelGenerated space S ->
    BorelGenerated space (complement S)
  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate E) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated space (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated space (countableUnion sets)
  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate E} ->
    ((x : E) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated space S ->
    BorelGenerated space T

record BorelSpace
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) : Set2 where
  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      BorelGenerated space S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated space S

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
PairwiseDisjoint sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  (x : _) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals (sumFirst reals terms n) (terms n)

record ProbabilityMeasure
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) : Set1 where
  field
    mass :
      Predicate E ->
      R
    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate E) ->
      ((x : E) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
      mass S == mass T
    mass-empty :
      mass emptySet == zeroR reals
    mass-nonnegative :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (mass S)
    countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate E) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ x y -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x y))
        (\ count -> sumFirst reals (\ n -> mass (sets n)) count)
        (mass (countableUnion sets))
    total-mass-one :
      mass wholeSet == oneR reals

open ProbabilityMeasure

MeasurableFunction :
  {A B : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  SigmaAlgebra B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set1
MeasurableFunction source target f =
  (S : Predicate _) ->
  measurable target S ->
  measurable source (preimage f S)

Bounded :
  {R A : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set
Bounded {R = R} {A = A} reals f =
  Exists R (\ bound ->
    (x : A) ->
    lessOrEqualR reals (absoluteR reals (f x)) bound)

ContinuousReal :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals ->
  (E -> R) ->
  Set
ContinuousReal {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space f =
  (x : E) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((y : E) ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceE space y x) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals (f y) (f x)))
            epsilon))

record BoundedContinuous
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals)
  (f : E -> R) : Set where
  field
    bounded :
      Bounded reals f
    continuous :
      ContinuousReal space f

MetricOpenReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
MetricOpenReal {R = R} reals U =
  (x : R) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : R) ->
          StrictLess reals
            (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals y x))
            radius ->
          U y))

BorelMeasurableReal :
  {R E : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  SigmaAlgebra E ->
  (E -> R) ->
  Set1
BorelMeasurableReal reals events f =
  (U : Predicate _) ->
  MetricOpenReal reals U ->
  measurable events (preimage f U)

record SimpleFunctionBelow
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E)
  (f : E -> R) : Set where
  field
    simpleCutoff :
      Nat
    simpleIndex :
      E -> Nat
    simpleValues :
      Nat -> R
    simpleIndexWithin :
      (x : E) ->
      simpleIndex x <=N simpleCutoff
    simpleFiberMeasurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simpleCutoff ->
      measurable events (\ x -> simpleIndex x == i)
    simplePointwiseBelow :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (simpleValues (simpleIndex x)) (f x)

open SimpleFunctionBelow

simpleIntegral :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  ProbabilityMeasure reals events ->
  {f : E -> R} ->
  SimpleFunctionBelow reals events f ->
  R
simpleIntegral {reals = reals} measure simple =
  sumFirst reals
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR reals
        (simpleValues simple i)
        (mass measure (\ x -> simpleIndex simple x == i)))
    (suc (simpleCutoff simple))

record SimpleIntegralCandidate
  {R E : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E}
  (measure : ProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : E -> R)
  (candidate : R) : Set where
  field
    candidateSimple :
      SimpleFunctionBelow reals events f
    candidateEquation :
      candidate == simpleIntegral measure candidateSimple

record IsSupremum
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (P : Predicate R)
  (supremum : R) : Set where
  field
    supremumUpperBound :
      (x : R) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals x supremum
    supremumLeast :
      (upper : R) ->
      ((x : R) ->
        P x ->
        lessOrEqualR reals x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals supremum upper

record LebesgueIntegralValue
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E)
  (measure : ProbabilityMeasure reals events)
  (f : E -> R)
  (value : R) : Set1 where
  field
    measurable-function :
      BorelMeasurableReal reals events f
    bounded-function :
      Bounded reals f
    value-is-integral :
      IsSupremum reals
        (\ candidate ->
          SimpleIntegralCandidate measure f candidate)
        value

record RealIntegration
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) : Set2 where
  field
    integral :
      ProbabilityMeasure reals events ->
      (E -> R) ->
      R
    integral-definition :
      (measure : ProbabilityMeasure reals events) ->
      (f : E -> R) ->
      BorelMeasurableReal reals events f ->
      Bounded reals f ->
      LebesgueIntegralValue reals events measure f (integral measure f)
    integral-unique :
      (measure : ProbabilityMeasure reals events) ->
      (f : E -> R) ->
      (value : R) ->
      LebesgueIntegralValue reals events measure f value ->
      integral measure f == value

open RealIntegration

record ComplexNumber (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart :
      R
    imaginaryPart :
      R

open ComplexNumber

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

oneC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R
oneC reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex (addR reals a c) (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex (negateR reals a) (negateR reals b)

subtractC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
subtractC reals x y =
  addC reals x (negateC reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

powerC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  Nat ->
  ComplexNumber R
powerC reals z zero =
  oneC reals
powerC reals z (suc n) =
  multiplyC reals (powerC reals z n) z

factorial :
  Nat ->
  Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

fromReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  ComplexNumber R
fromReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexExponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  Nat ->
  ComplexNumber R
complexExponentialTerm reals z n =
  multiplyC reals
    (powerC reals z n)
    (fromReal reals
      (reciprocalR reals (fromNatR reals (factorial n))))

sumFirstC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> ComplexNumber R) ->
  Nat ->
  ComplexNumber R
sumFirstC reals terms zero =
  zeroC reals
sumFirstC reals terms (suc n) =
  addC reals (sumFirstC reals terms n) (terms n)

record ComplexAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    modulus :
      ComplexNumber R -> R
    modulus-nonnegative :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (modulus z)
    modulus-square :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      multiplyR reals (modulus z) (modulus z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))
    expC :
      ComplexNumber R -> ComplexNumber R
    expC-series :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ x y -> modulus (subtractC reals x y))
        (\ n -> sumFirstC reals (complexExponentialTerm reals z) n)
        (expC z)

open ComplexAnalysis

integralC :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  RealIntegration reals events ->
  ProbabilityMeasure reals events ->
  (E -> ComplexNumber R) ->
  ComplexNumber R
integralC integration measure f =
  complex
    (integral integration measure (\ x -> realPart (f x)))
    (integral integration measure (\ x -> imaginaryPart (f x)))

characteristicFunction :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals) ->
  (complexAnalysis : ComplexAnalysis reals) ->
  RealIntegration reals events ->
  ProbabilityMeasure reals events ->
  E ->
  ComplexNumber R
characteristicFunction {reals = reals}
  space complexAnalysis integration measure t =
  integralC integration measure
    (\ x ->
      expC complexAnalysis
        (complex
          (zeroR reals)
          (innerE space x t)))

WeakConvergence :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  (space : NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals) ->
  RealIntegration reals events ->
  (Nat -> ProbabilityMeasure reals events) ->
  ProbabilityMeasure reals events ->
  Set
WeakConvergence {reals = reals} space integration measures limitMeasure =
  (test : _) ->
  BoundedContinuous space test ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (\ x y -> absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x y))
    (\ n -> integral integration (measures n) test)
    (integral integration limitMeasure test)

record LevyContext (R E : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    reals :
      CompleteOrderedField R
    space :
      NormedRealInnerProductSpace R E reals
    finite-dimensional :
      FiniteDimensional reals space
    events :
      SigmaAlgebra E
    borel-space :
      BorelSpace space events
    integration :
      RealIntegration reals events
    complex-analysis :
      ComplexAnalysis reals

open LevyContext

levy-continuity-theorem : Set2
levy-continuity-theorem =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (context : LevyContext R E) ->
  (measures :
    Nat -> ProbabilityMeasure (reals context) (events context)) ->
  (limitMeasure :
    ProbabilityMeasure (reals context) (events context)) ->
  Iff
    (WeakConvergence
      (space context)
      (integration context)
      measures
      limitMeasure)
    ((t : E) ->
      SequentialLimit
        (reals context)
        (\ x y ->
          modulus (complex-analysis context)
            (subtractC (reals context) x y))
        (\ n ->
          characteristicFunction
            (space context)
            (complex-analysis context)
            (integration context)
            (measures n)
            t)
        (characteristicFunction
          (space context)
          (complex-analysis context)
          (integration context)
          limitMeasure
          t))

title: Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q1966978 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q1966978), "Lévy continuity theorem":
  weak convergence of Borel probability measures on a finite-dimensional
  real inner-product space is equivalent to pointwise convergence of their
  characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory iterateTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open complexTheory topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;
open probabilityTheory;

val q1966978_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q1966978_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero)``);

val q1966978_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q1966978_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      q1966978_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm x = sqrt (inner x x)) /\
      ?n : num.
        ?basis : num -> 'v.
          (!j k.
            j IN count n /\ k IN count n ==>
            inner (basis j) (basis k) =
              if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
          !x.
            x =
              ITSET
                (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
                (count n) zero``);

val q1966978_metric_open_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_metric_open_def",
  ``q1966978_metric_open
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (s : 'v set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q1966978_probability_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_probability_measure_def",
  ``q1966978_probability_measure
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (m : 'v m_space) <=>
      prob_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m =
        sigma_sets UNIV {s | q1966978_metric_open add neg norm s}``);

val q1966978_bounded_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_bounded_continuous_def",
  ``q1966978_bounded_continuous
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (f : 'v -> real) <=>
      (!x epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < delta ==>
            abs (f y - f x) < epsilon) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\ !x. abs (f x) <= C``);

val q1966978_real_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_real_integral_def",
  ``q1966978_real_integral (m : 'v m_space) (f : 'v -> real) =
      real (integral m (\x. Normal (f x)))``);

val q1966978_tendsto_real_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_tendsto_real_def",
  ``q1966978_tendsto_real (u : num -> real) (ell : real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> abs (u n - ell) < epsilon``);

val q1966978_tendsto_complex_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_tendsto_complex_def",
  ``q1966978_tendsto_complex (u : num -> complex) (ell : complex) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> modu (u n - ell) < epsilon``);

val q1966978_weak_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_weak_tendsto_def",
  ``q1966978_weak_tendsto
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real)
      (mu : num -> 'v m_space) (mu0 : 'v m_space) <=>
      !f : 'v -> real.
        q1966978_bounded_continuous add neg norm f ==>
        q1966978_tendsto_real
          (\n. q1966978_real_integral (mu n) f)
          (q1966978_real_integral mu0 f)``);

val q1966978_char_fun_def = new_definition (
  "q1966978_char_fun_def",
  ``q1966978_char_fun
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (m : 'v m_space) (t : 'v) =
      complex_of_real
        (q1966978_real_integral m (\x. cos (inner x t))) +
      i * complex_of_real
        (q1966978_real_integral m (\x. sin (inner x t)))``);

val levy_continuity_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real)
      (mu : num -> 'v m_space) (mu0 : 'v m_space).
      q1966978_real_inner_product_space
        zero add neg smul inner norm /\
      (!n. q1966978_probability_measure add neg norm (mu n)) /\
      q1966978_probability_measure add neg norm mu0
      ==>
      (q1966978_weak_tendsto add neg norm mu mu0 <=>
       !t : 'v.
         q1966978_tendsto_complex
           (\n. q1966978_char_fun inner (mu n) t)
           (q1966978_char_fun inner mu0 t))``;

title: Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1966978
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q1966978), "Lévy continuity theorem": for
  probability measures on an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product
  space, weak convergence of a sequence is equivalent to pointwise convergence
  of its characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V ranges over SetMM real pre-Hilbert spaces with finite dimension, exactly
  the finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces of the Lean statement.
  Q1966978ProbabilityData says that P is an NN0-indexed sequence and Q is a
  limit probability measure, all on the Borel sigma-algebra of V's norm
  topology.

  Q1966978BoundedContinuous is the class of bounded continuous real-valued
  functions on V. Q1966978WeakTendsto requires sequential convergence of their
  real integrals, the bounded-continuous-test-function characterization of the
  weak topology on probability measures.

  Q1966978Integral defines real- or complex-valued integrals as limits of
  SetMM simple integrals along L1-approximating measurable finite-range
  functions. This construction is valid for the complete codomains RRfld and
