begin

::$P-
theorem
  for V being RealUnitarySpace,
      S being SigmaField of the carrier of V,
      M being Function of NAT,Funcs(S,REAL),
      M0 being Probability of S
  st
    V is finite-dimensional &
    S = BorelSets(TopSpaceNorm RUSp2RNSp V) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex Mn being Probability of S st M.n = Mn)
  holds
    ((for f being Function of the carrier of V,REAL
        st
          (for x being Point of V, e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex d being Real st 0 < d &
              for y being Point of V st ||.y-x.|| < d holds
                |.f.y-f.x.| < e) &
          (ex C being Real st
            for x being Point of V holds |.f.x.| <= C)
        holds
          ex a being Real_Sequence, b being Real st
            (for n being Nat holds
              ex Mn being Probability of S st
                M.n = Mn &
                f is_integrable_on P2M(Mn) &
                a.n = Integral(P2M(Mn),f)) &
            f is_integrable_on P2M(M0) &
            b = Integral(P2M(M0),f) &
            for e being Real st 0 < e holds
              ex N being Nat st
                for n being Nat st N <= n holds |.a.n-b.| < e)
     iff
     (for t being Point of V holds
        ex c,s being Function of the carrier of V,REAL st
        ex aCos,aSin being Real_Sequence st
        ex bCos,bSin being Real st
          (for x being Point of V holds
            c.x = cos.((the scalar of V).[x,t]) &
            s.x = sin.((the scalar of V).[x,t])) &
          (for n being Nat holds
            ex Mn being Probability of S st
              M.n = Mn &
              c is_integrable_on P2M(Mn) &
              s is_integrable_on P2M(Mn) &
              aCos.n = Integral(P2M(Mn),c) &
              aSin.n = Integral(P2M(Mn),s)) &
          c is_integrable_on P2M(M0) &
          s is_integrable_on P2M(M0) &
          bCos = Integral(P2M(M0),c) &
          bSin = Integral(P2M(M0),s) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex N being Nat st
              for n being Nat st N <= n holds |.aCos.n-bCos.| < e) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex N being Nat st
              for n being Nat st N <= n holds |.aSin.n-bSin.| < e)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q1966978,
% "Lévy continuity theorem": weak convergence of Borel probability measures on a
% finite-dimensional real inner-product space is equivalent to pointwise
% convergence of their characteristic functions. This file contains no proof.

Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  innerE: [E, E -> real],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  probability_measure: TYPE = [event -> real]
  probability_measure_sequence: TYPE =
    [nat -> probability_measure]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [E -> real]
  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]

  complex: TYPE =
    [# real_part: real, imaginary_part: real #]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  finite_linear_combination(
      basis: vector_sequence,
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_linear_combination(
          basis, coefficients, count - 1),
        smulE(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          basis(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_inner_product_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        negE(x) = smulE(-1, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        innerE(x, y) = innerE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        innerE(addE(x, y), z) =
          innerE(x, z) + innerE(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        innerE(smulE(a, x), y) =
          a * innerE(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= innerE(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        innerE(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) * normE(x) = innerE(x, x))

  finite_dimensional: bool =
    EXISTS (dimension: nat), (basis: vector_sequence):
      FORALL (x: E):
        EXISTS (coefficients: coefficient_sequence):
          finite_linear_combination(
            basis, coefficients, dimension) = x

  open_event(event_value: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      event_value(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
          FORALL (y: E):
            normE(subE(y, x)) < epsilon_value IMPLIES
              event_value(y)

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): FALSE

  event_complement(event_value: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: E): NOT event_value(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (event_value: event):
        Sigma(event_value) IMPLIES
          Sigma(event_complement(event_value)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  contains_open_events(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (event_value: event):
      open_event(event_value) IMPLIES Sigma(event_value)

  borel_event(event_value: event): bool =
    FORALL (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      (is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
        AND contains_open_events(Sigma))
      IMPLIES Sigma(event_value)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: E):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: E):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  finite_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  is_probability_measure(
      measure_value: probability_measure): bool =
    measure_value(empty_event) = 0
      AND measure_value(full_event) = 1
      AND (FORALL (event_value: event):
        borel_event(event_value) IMPLIES
          0 <= measure_value(event_value))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            borel_event(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  measure_value(events(index)),
                count),
            measure_value(countable_union(events))))

  simple_value(
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: E): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      simple_value(
        coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
            coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  nonnegative_simple_minorant(
      function_value: real_function,
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) >= 0
            AND borel_event(pieces(index)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= simple_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count, x)
          AND simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, x)
            <= function_value(x))

  simple_integral(
      measure_value: probability_measure,
      coefficients: coefficient_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        coefficients(index)
          * measure_value(pieces(index)),
      count)

  nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
      measure_value: probability_measure,
      function_value: real_function,
      upper: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: coefficient_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      nonnegative_simple_minorant(
        function_value, coefficients, pieces, count)
      IMPLIES
        simple_integral(
          measure_value, coefficients, pieces, count)
          <= upper

  has_nonnegative_integral(
      measure_value: probability_measure,
      function_value: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (x: E): 0 <= function_value(x))
      AND 0 <= value
      AND nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
        measure_value, function_value, value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: real):
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
          measure_value, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES value <= upper)

  positive_part(function_value: real_function):
      real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      IF 0 <= function_value(x) THEN
        function_value(x)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  negative_part(function_value: real_function):
      real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      IF function_value(x) <= 0 THEN
        -function_value(x)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  has_integral(
      measure_value: probability_measure,
      function_value: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: real):
      has_nonnegative_integral(
        measure_value,
        positive_part(function_value),
        positive_integral)
      AND has_nonnegative_integral(
        measure_value,
        negative_part(function_value),
        negative_integral)
      AND value = positive_integral - negative_integral

  integral(
      measure_value: probability_measure,
      function_value: real_function): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        has_integral(
          measure_value, function_value, value))

  continuous(function_value: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: E), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta_value: posreal):
        FORALL (y: E):
          normE(subE(y, x)) < delta_value IMPLIES
            abs(function_value(y) - function_value(x))
              < epsilon_value

  bounded(function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      0 <= bound
        AND (FORALL (x: E):
          abs(function_value(x)) <= bound)

  bounded_continuous(
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    bounded(function_value)
      AND continuous(function_value)

  weakly_converges(
      measures: probability_measure_sequence,
      limit_measure: probability_measure): bool =
    FORALL (function_value: real_function):
      bounded_continuous(function_value) IMPLIES
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            integral(measures(index), function_value),
          integral(limit_measure, function_value))

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial_sum(
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + alternating_sign(index)
            * x ^ (2 * index + 1)
            / (factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial_sum(
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + alternating_sign(index)
            * x ^ (2 * index)
            / (factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial_sum(count, x),
          value))

  characteristic_function(
      measure_value: probability_measure,
      t: E): complex =
    (#
      real_part :=
        integral(
          measure_value,
          LAMBDA (x: E):
            cosine(innerE(t, x))),
      imaginary_part :=
        integral(
          measure_value,
          LAMBDA (x: E):
            sine(innerE(t, x)))
    #)

  converges_to_complex(
      values: complex_sequence,
      limit: complex): bool =
    converges_to_real(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        real_part(values(index)),
      real_part(limit))
      AND converges_to_real(
        LAMBDA (index: nat):
          imaginary_part(values(index)),
        imaginary_part(limit))

  levy_continuity_theorem: bool =
    (real_inner_product_space
      AND finite_dimensional)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL
          (measures: probability_measure_sequence),
          (limit_measure: probability_measure):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            is_probability_measure(measures(index)))
          AND is_probability_measure(limit_measure))
        IMPLIES
          (weakly_converges(measures, limit_measure)
            IFF
              (FORALL (t: E):
                converges_to_complex(
                  LAMBDA (index: nat):
                    characteristic_function(
                      measures(index), t),
                  characteristic_function(
                    limit_measure, t)))))
END Q1966978_levy_continuity_theorem

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2027347
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2027347), "Optional stopping theorem": under a
-- sigma-finite filtration, a strongly adapted integrable real-valued process is a
-- submartingale exactly when expected stopped values are monotone for ordered bounded
-- stopping times. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Probability.Notation
public import Mathlib.Probability.Process.HittingTime
public import Mathlib.Probability.Martingale.Basic

@[expose] public section

open scoped NNReal ENNReal MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

namespace MeasureTheory

variable {Ω : Type*} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω} {𝒢 : Filtration ℕ m0}
  {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}

/-- The optional stopping theorem for real-valued discrete-time submartingales. -/
theorem submartingale_iff_expected_stoppedValue_mono [SigmaFiniteFiltration μ 𝒢]
    (hadp : StronglyAdapted 𝒢 f) (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (f i) μ) :
    Submartingale f 𝒢 μ ↔ ∀ τ π : Ω → ℕ∞, IsStoppingTime 𝒢 τ → IsStoppingTime 𝒢 π →
      τ ≤ π → (∃ N : ℕ, ∀ x, π x ≤ N) →
        μ[stoppedValue f τ] ≤ μ[stoppedValue f π] := sorry

end MeasureTheory

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2027347
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2027347), "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly
  adapted integrable real process is a submartingale exactly when expectations
  of its stopped values are monotone for ordered bounded stopping times. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2027347_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q2027347_empty {A : Type} : q2027347_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q2027347_full {A : Type} : q2027347_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q2027347_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q2027347_set A) : q2027347_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q2027347_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2027347_set A) : q2027347_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q2027347_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q2027347_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q2027347_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q2027347_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q2027347_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2027347_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q2027347_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Record q2027347_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q2027347_measurable : q2027347_set A -> Prop;
  q2027347_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q2027347_set A,
      q2027347_same_set E F ->
      (q2027347_measurable E <-> q2027347_measurable F);
  q2027347_measurable_empty :
    q2027347_measurable q2027347_empty;
  q2027347_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q2027347_set A,
      q2027347_measurable E ->
      q2027347_measurable (q2027347_complement E);
  q2027347_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q2027347_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2027347_measurable (E n)) ->
      q2027347_measurable (q2027347_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q2027347_measurable {A} _ _.

Inductive q2027347_ennreal : Type :=
| q2027347_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q2027347_ennreal
| q2027347_ennreal_infinity : q2027347_ennreal.

Arguments q2027347_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_zero : q2027347_ennreal :=
  q2027347_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q2027347_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2027347_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2027347_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q2027347_ennreal_infinity,
    q2027347_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_le
    (x y : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2027347_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2027347_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q2027347_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q2027347_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q2027347_ennreal_infinity,
    q2027347_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q2027347_ennreal_infinity,
    q2027347_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_add
    (x y : q2027347_ennreal) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2027347_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2027347_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2027347_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q2027347_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q2027347_ennreal) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2027347_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2027347_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2027347_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q2027347_ennreal_finite a _, q2027347_ennreal_infinity
  | q2027347_ennreal_infinity, q2027347_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q2027347_ennreal_zero
      else q2027347_ennreal_infinity
  | q2027347_ennreal_infinity, q2027347_ennreal_infinity =>
      q2027347_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q2027347_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q2027347_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q2027347_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q2027347_ennreal_add
        (q2027347_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q2027347_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q2027347_ennreal,
      values value -> q2027347_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q2027347_ennreal,
      (forall value : q2027347_ennreal,
        values value -> q2027347_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q2027347_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q2027347_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q2027347_ennreal)
    (sum : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2027347_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q2027347_ennreal_eq value
          (q2027347_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_represents
    (x : q2027347_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q2027347_ennreal_eq x
      (q2027347_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q2027347_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q2027347_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q2027347_measure {A : Type}
    (M : q2027347_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q2027347_measure_value :
    q2027347_set A -> q2027347_ennreal;
  q2027347_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q2027347_set A,
      q2027347_same_set E F ->
      q2027347_ennreal_eq
        (q2027347_measure_value E)
        (q2027347_measure_value F);
  q2027347_measure_empty :
    q2027347_ennreal_eq
      (q2027347_measure_value q2027347_empty)
      q2027347_ennreal_zero;
  q2027347_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q2027347_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2027347_measurable M (E n)) ->
      q2027347_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q2027347_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q2027347_measure_value (E n))
        (q2027347_measure_value (q2027347_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q2027347_measure_value {A M} _ _.

Definition q2027347_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q2027347_set A,
    q2027347_measurable M null_set /\
    q2027347_ennreal_eq
      (q2027347_measure_value mu null_set)
      q2027347_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Definition q2027347_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q2027347_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (M : q2027347_measurable_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q2027347_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q2027347_measurable M (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q2027347_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q2027347_measurable_simple_real {A : Type}
    (M : q2027347_measurable_space A)
    (s : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> R)
         (cells : nat -> q2027347_set A),
    q2027347_finite_partition M k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q2027347_strongly_measurable_real {A : Type}
    (M : q2027347_measurable_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      q2027347_measurable_simple_real M (approximants n)) /\
    forall x : A,
      q2027347_real_sequence_converges
        (fun n => approximants n x) (f x).

Definition q2027347_ae_strongly_measurable_real {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      q2027347_measurable_simple_real M (approximants n)) /\
    q2027347_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q2027347_real_sequence_converges
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q2027347_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q2027347_nnreal_value : R;
  q2027347_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q2027347_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q2027347_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q2027347_nonnegative_real) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  q2027347_ennreal_finite
    (q2027347_nnreal_value x)
    (q2027347_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q2027347_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (f : A -> q2027347_ennreal)
    (value : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q2027347_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q2027347_set A),
    q2027347_finite_partition M k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q2027347_ennreal_le
        (q2027347_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q2027347_ennreal_eq value
      (q2027347_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q2027347_ennreal_mul
            (q2027347_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q2027347_measure_value mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q2027347_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (f : A -> q2027347_ennreal)
    (value : q2027347_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2027347_ennreal_supremum
    (q2027347_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q2027347_absolute_ennreal
    (x : R) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  q2027347_ennreal_finite (Rabs x) (Rabs_pos x).

Definition q2027347_positive_ennreal
    (x : R) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  q2027347_ennreal_finite (Rmax x 0) (Rmax_r x 0).

Definition q2027347_negative_ennreal
    (x : R) : q2027347_ennreal :=
  q2027347_ennreal_finite (Rmax (- x) 0) (Rmax_r (- x) 0).

Definition q2027347_integrable_real {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  q2027347_ae_strongly_measurable_real mu f /\
  exists value : q2027347_ennreal,
    q2027347_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q2027347_absolute_ennreal (f x)) value /\
    q2027347_ennreal_finite_value value.

Definition q2027347_bochner_integral_has_value {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (f : A -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists (positive_integral negative_integral : q2027347_ennreal)
         (positive_value negative_value : R),
    q2027347_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q2027347_positive_ennreal (f x))
      positive_integral /\
    q2027347_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q2027347_negative_ennreal (f x))
      negative_integral /\
    q2027347_ennreal_represents
      positive_integral positive_value /\
    q2027347_ennreal_represents
      negative_integral negative_value /\
    value = positive_value - negative_value.

Record q2027347_integrated_measure {A : Type}
    (M : q2027347_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q2027347_underlying_measure : q2027347_measure M;
  q2027347_integral : (A -> R) -> R;
  q2027347_integral_of_integrable :
    forall f : A -> R,
      q2027347_integrable_real q2027347_underlying_measure f ->
      q2027347_bochner_integral_has_value
        q2027347_underlying_measure f (q2027347_integral f);
  q2027347_integral_of_nonintegrable :
    forall f : A -> R,
      ~ q2027347_integrable_real q2027347_underlying_measure f ->
      q2027347_integral f = 0
}.

Arguments q2027347_underlying_measure {A M} _.
Arguments q2027347_integral {A M} _ _.

Definition q2027347_indicator {A : Type}
    (E : q2027347_set A) (f : A -> R) : A -> R :=
  fun x =>
    if excluded_middle_informative (E x) then f x else 0.

Definition q2027347_set_integral {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_integrated_measure M)
    (E : q2027347_set A) (f : A -> R) : R :=
  q2027347_integral mu (q2027347_indicator E f).

Record q2027347_filtration {A : Type}
    (ambient : q2027347_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q2027347_filtration_level : nat -> q2027347_measurable_space A;
  q2027347_filtration_subambient :
    forall (n : nat) (E : q2027347_set A),
      q2027347_measurable (q2027347_filtration_level n) E ->
      q2027347_measurable ambient E;
  q2027347_filtration_mono :
    forall (n m : nat) (E : q2027347_set A),
      (n <= m)%nat ->
      q2027347_measurable (q2027347_filtration_level n) E ->
      q2027347_measurable (q2027347_filtration_level m) E
}.

Arguments q2027347_filtration_level {A ambient} _ _.

Definition q2027347_sigma_finite_on {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (S : q2027347_measurable_space A) : Prop :=
  exists covering : nat -> q2027347_set A,
    (forall n : nat,
      q2027347_measurable S (covering n) /\
      q2027347_ennreal_finite_value
        (q2027347_measure_value mu (covering n))) /\
    forall x : A, exists n : nat, covering n x.

Definition q2027347_sigma_finite_filtration {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_measure M)
    (F : q2027347_filtration M) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    q2027347_sigma_finite_on mu
      (q2027347_filtration_level F n).

Definition q2027347_strongly_adapted {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (F : q2027347_filtration M)
    (f : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    q2027347_strongly_measurable_real
      (q2027347_filtration_level F n) (f n).

Definition q2027347_submartingale {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2027347_integrated_measure M)
    (F : q2027347_filtration M)
    (f : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  q2027347_strongly_adapted F f /\
  (forall n : nat,
    q2027347_integrable_real
      (q2027347_underlying_measure mu) (f n)) /\
  forall (n m : nat) (E : q2027347_set A),
    (n <= m)%nat ->
    q2027347_measurable (q2027347_filtration_level F n) E ->
    q2027347_set_integral mu E (f n) <=
    q2027347_set_integral mu E (f m).

Inductive q2027347_enat : Type :=
| q2027347_enat_finite : nat -> q2027347_enat
| q2027347_enat_infinity : q2027347_enat.

Definition q2027347_enat_le
    (x y : q2027347_enat) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2027347_enat_finite n, q2027347_enat_finite m =>
      (n <= m)%nat
  | q2027347_enat_finite _, q2027347_enat_infinity => True
  | q2027347_enat_infinity, q2027347_enat_finite _ => False
  | q2027347_enat_infinity, q2027347_enat_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q2027347_stopping_time {A : Type}
    {M : q2027347_measurable_space A}
    (F : q2027347_filtration M)
    (tau : A -> q2027347_enat) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    q2027347_measurable (q2027347_filtration_level F n)
      (fun x =>
        q2027347_enat_le (tau x)
          (q2027347_enat_finite n)).

Definition q2027347_stopping_time_le {A : Type}
    (tau pi : A -> q2027347_enat) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, q2027347_enat_le (tau x) (pi x).

Definition q2027347_bounded_stopping_time {A : Type}
    (pi : A -> q2027347_enat) : Prop :=
  exists N : nat,
    forall x : A,
      q2027347_enat_le (pi x) (q2027347_enat_finite N).

Definition q2027347_stopped_value {A : Type}
    (f : nat -> A -> R)
    (tau : A -> q2027347_enat) : A -> R :=
  fun x =>
    match tau x with
    | q2027347_enat_finite n => f n x
    | q2027347_enat_infinity => 0
    end.

Theorem MeasureTheory_submartingale_iff_expected_stoppedValue_mono :
  forall (Omega : Type)
         (M : q2027347_measurable_space Omega)
         (mu : q2027347_integrated_measure M)
         (F : q2027347_filtration M)
         (f : nat -> Omega -> R),
    q2027347_sigma_finite_filtration
      (q2027347_underlying_measure mu) F ->
    q2027347_strongly_adapted F f ->
    (forall n : nat,
      q2027347_integrable_real
        (q2027347_underlying_measure mu) (f n)) ->
    (q2027347_submartingale mu F f <->
      forall tau pi : Omega -> q2027347_enat,
        q2027347_stopping_time F tau ->
        q2027347_stopping_time F pi ->
        q2027347_stopping_time_le tau pi ->
        q2027347_bounded_stopping_time pi ->
        q2027347_integral mu (q2027347_stopped_value f tau) <=
        q2027347_integral mu (q2027347_stopped_value f pi)).
Admitted.

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2027347,
  "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly adapted integrable real-valued
  discrete-time process is a submartingale exactly when expected stopped values
  are monotone for every ordered pair of bounded stopping times. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral" "HOL-Library.Extended_Nat"
begin

definition q2027347_filtration ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2027347_filtration M F \<longleftrightarrow>
    space M = UNIV \<and>
    (\<forall>n. space (F n) = UNIV \<and> sets (F n) \<subseteq> sets M) \<and>
    (\<forall>i j. i \<le> j \<longrightarrow> sets (F i) \<subseteq> sets (F j))"

definition q2027347_filtered_measure ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure" where
  "q2027347_filtered_measure M F n =
    measure_of UNIV (sets (F n)) (emeasure M)"

definition q2027347_sigma_finite_filtration ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2027347_sigma_finite_filtration M F \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>n. sigma_finite_measure (q2027347_filtered_measure M F n))"

definition q2027347_strongly_adapted ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2027347_strongly_adapted F f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>n. f n \<in> borel_measurable (F n))"

definition q2027347_stopping_time ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> enat) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2027347_stopping_time F T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>n. Measurable.pred (F n) (\<lambda>x. T x \<le> enat n))"

definition q2027347_stopped_value ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> enat) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2027347_stopped_value f T x =
    (case T x of enat n \<Rightarrow> f n x | \<infinity> \<Rightarrow> f 0 x)"

definition q2027347_submartingale ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2027347_submartingale M F f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2027347_strongly_adapted F f \<and>
    (\<forall>n. integrable M (f n)) \<and>
    (\<forall>i j A.
      i \<le> j \<longrightarrow>
      A \<in> sets (F i) \<longrightarrow>
      set_lebesgue_integral M A (f i) \<le>
        set_lebesgue_integral M A (f j))"

theorem submartingale_iff_expected_stopped_value_mono:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and F :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a measure"
    and f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes filtration: "q2027347_filtration M F"
    and sigma_finite: "q2027347_sigma_finite_filtration M F"
    and adapted: "q2027347_strongly_adapted F f"
    and integrable: "\<forall>n. integrable M (f n)"
  shows
    "q2027347_submartingale M F f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>T S.
        q2027347_stopping_time F T \<longrightarrow>
        q2027347_stopping_time F S \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x. T x \<le> S x) \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>N::nat. \<forall>x. S x \<le> enat N) \<longrightarrow>
        lebesgue_integral M (q2027347_stopped_value f T) \<le>
          lebesgue_integral M (q2027347_stopped_value f S))"
  sorry

end

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2027347,
  "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly adapted integrable real-valued
  process over a sigma-finite filtration is a submartingale exactly when
  expected stopped values are monotone for ordered bounded stopping times.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2027347_OPTIONAL_STOPPING_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let eembed =
      \(z:bool#real).
        if FST z then &1 else SND z / (&1 + SND z) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        (!s. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) in
   let measure_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!s:A->bool. s SUBSET carrier ==> enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let filtration =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (FF:num->(A->bool)->bool).
        (!n. sigma_algebra carrier (FF n) /\ FF n SUBSET events) /\
        (!m n. m <= n ==> FF m SUBSET FF n) in
   let sigma_finite_filtration =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (FF:num->(A->bool)->bool).
        !n. ?cover:num->A->bool.
          (!k. cover k IN FF n /\ ~(FST (mu (cover k)))) /\
          (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> ?k. x IN cover k) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:A->bool).
        ?N:A->bool.
          N IN events /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:A | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let sequence_etends =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n)) /\
        (!e. &0 < e
             ==> ?N. !n. N <= n
                          ==> abs(eembed (u n) - eembed l) < e) in
   let simple_ennreal =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:bool#real. {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c} IN events) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real)
       (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x. x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n enum partial.
          (!x. x IN items <=> ?i. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool#real)
       (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s carrier)
          (\c. emul c (mu {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(P:(bool#real)->bool)
       (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v. P v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!v. P v ==> ele v w)
             ==> ele z w) in
   let lintegral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v. ?s:A->bool#real.
                   simple_ennreal carrier events s /\
                   (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> ele (s x) (h x)) /\
                   simple_lintegral carrier mu s v)
            z in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real. {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c} IN events) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (h:A->real).
        ?s:num->A->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->real).
        ?g:A->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu (\x:A. h x = g x) in
   let scalar_integrable =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->real).
        ae_strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events mu h /\
        ~(FST
            (lintegral carrier events mu
              (\x:A. (F,abs(h x))))) in
   let real_integral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:A->real).
        SND
          (lintegral carrier events mu
            (\x:A. (F,max (h x) (&0)))) -
        SND
          (lintegral carrier events mu
            (\x:A. (F,max (--(h x)) (&0)))) in
   let set_integral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool)
       (h:A->real).
        real_integral carrier events mu
          (\x:A. if x IN s then h x else &0) in
   let strongly_adapted =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (FF:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (X:num->A->real).
        !n. strongly_measurable_scalar carrier (FF n) (X n) in
   let submartingale =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (FF:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (X:num->A->real).
        strongly_adapted carrier FF X /\
        (!n. scalar_integrable carrier events mu (X n)) /\
        (!i j s.
           i <= j /\ s IN FF i
           ==> set_integral carrier events mu s (X i) <=
               set_integral carrier events mu s (X j)) in
   let enat_le =
      \(s:num option) (t:num option).
        t = NONE \/
        ?m n. s = SOME m /\ t = SOME n /\ m <= n in
   let stopping_time =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (FF:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (tau:A->num option).
        !n. {x:A | x IN carrier /\ enat_le (tau x) (SOME n)} IN FF n in
   let stopped_value =
      \(X:num->A->real)
       (tau:A->num option)
       (x:A).
        X (@n:num. tau x = SOME n) x in
   !carrier:A->bool
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    FF:num->(A->bool)->bool
    X:num->A->real.
      measure_space carrier events mu /\
      filtration carrier events FF /\
      sigma_finite_filtration carrier mu FF /\
      strongly_adapted carrier FF X /\
      (!n. scalar_integrable carrier events mu (X n))
      ==>
      (submartingale carrier events mu FF X <=>
       !tau pi:A->num option.
         stopping_time carrier FF tau /\
         stopping_time carrier FF pi /\
         (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> enat_le (tau x) (pi x)) /\
         (?N. !x:A. x IN carrier ==> enat_le (pi x) (SOME N))
         ==> real_integral carrier events mu (stopped_value X tau) <=
             real_integral carrier events mu (stopped_value X pi))`;;

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2027347,
;; "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly adapted integrable real-valued
;; process is a submartingale if and only if its stopped-value expectations
;; are monotone for every ordered pair of stopping times whose later member
;; is uniformly bounded. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces give identifiers to arbitrary carriers, subsets,
;; functions, and sequences.  No carrier or function is replaced by a finite
;; table or restricted to an APPLY$ class.  The hypotheses below characterize
;; the real field, sigma algebra, measure, lower integral, real integral,
;; almost-everywhere predicates, and Bochner integration exactly.  Every
;; unbounded quantifier below is a direct DEFUN-SK binder.

;; Real numbers and arbitrary mathematical objects.

(defstub q2027347-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q2027347-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q2027347-domain-member-p (domain value) t)
(defstub q2027347-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q2027347-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q2027347-function-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q2027347-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q2027347-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q2027347-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q2027347-lintegral-value
  (lintegral domain measurable measure function) t)
(defstub q2027347-integral-value
  (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function) t)

(defun q2027347-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2027347-r-less real right left)))

(defun q2027347-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q2027347-r-less real value (q2027347-r-zero real))
      (q2027347-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-r-member-p real x)
      (q2027347-r-member-p real y)
      (q2027347-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q2027347-r-zero real))
            (one (q2027347-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q2027347-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q2027347-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q2027347-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q2027347-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q2027347-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q2027347-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q2027347-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q2027347-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q2027347-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q2027347-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q2027347-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q2027347-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q2027347-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q2027347-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q2027347-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q2027347-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q2027347-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q2027347-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q2027347-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q2027347-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q2027347-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q2027347-r-multiply
          real x (q2027347-r-add real y z))
         (q2027347-r-add
          real
          (q2027347-r-multiply real x y)
          (q2027347-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-r-member-p real x)
      (q2027347-r-member-p real y)
      (q2027347-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q2027347-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q2027347-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q2027347-r-less real x y)
         (q2027347-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2027347-r-less real x y)
          (q2027347-r-less real y z))
         (q2027347-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q2027347-r-less real x y)
         (q2027347-r-less
          real
          (q2027347-r-add real x z)
          (q2027347-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2027347-r-less real zero x)
          (q2027347-r-less real zero y))
         (q2027347-r-less
          real zero
          (q2027347-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q2027347-r-member-p real x)
     (q2027347-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-r-member-p real x)
      (q2027347-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q2027347-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q2027347-r-member-p real bound)
     (q2027347-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2027347-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q2027347-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2027347-r-member-p real bound)
       (q2027347-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q2027347-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q2027347-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q2027347-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q2027347-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q2027347-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q2027347-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q2027347-r-zero real))
        (one (q2027347-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q2027347-r-member-p real zero)
     (q2027347-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q2027347-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q2027347-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q2027347-r-less real zero one)
     (q2027347-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q2027347-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q2027347-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q2027347-finite)
    (q2027347-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q2027347-r-leq
     real (q2027347-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q2027347-finite value))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q2027347-ennreal-finite (q2027347-r-zero real)))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q2027347-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q2027347-top) t)
   (t (q2027347-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2027347-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q2027347-top)
          (equal right :q2027347-top))
      :q2027347-top
    (q2027347-ennreal-finite
     (q2027347-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q2027347-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q2027347-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q2027347-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q2027347-top)
        (equal right :q2027347-top))
    :q2027347-top)
   (t
    (q2027347-ennreal-finite
     (q2027347-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-to-real (real value)
  (if (and (consp value)
           (equal (car value) :q2027347-finite))
      (cdr value)
    (q2027347-r-zero real)))

;; Sets, sigma algebras, and measures.

(defun-sk q2027347-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q2027347-set-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-set-member-p left x)
     (q2027347-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q2027347-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2027347-set-member-p left x)
      (q2027347-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
     (and (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x) nil))))

(defun-sk q2027347-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p complement x)
     (and
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not (q2027347-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2027347-valid-set-p
      domain
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2027347-set-member-p
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q2027347-sequence-union-set-p
    (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2027347-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-family-extensional-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q2027347-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-family-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q2027347-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-empty-exists-p (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q2027347-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q2027347-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-complements-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q2027347-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2027347-sequence-measurable-p (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q2027347-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-sequence-unions-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q2027347-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence))
     (q2027347-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q2027347-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q2027347-family-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q2027347-family-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q2027347-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q2027347-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q2027347-measurable-sequence-unions-p domain measurable)))

(defun-sk q2027347-disjoint-sets-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q2027347-set-member-p left x)
      (q2027347-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-pairwise-disjoint-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n)))
     (q2027347-disjoint-sets-p
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q2027347-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q2027347-ennreal-zero real)
    (q2027347-ennreal-add
     real
     (q2027347-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q2027347-measure-value
      measure
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q2027347-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2027347-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2027347-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-p real total)
     (q2027347-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2027347-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q2027347-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q2027347-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q2027347-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q2027347-measure-value measure left)
      (q2027347-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measure-values-p (real domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2027347-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q2027347-ennreal-p
      real (q2027347-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q2027347-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q2027347-measure-value measure empty)
      (q2027347-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-countably-additive-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q2027347-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q2027347-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence)
      (q2027347-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q2027347-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q2027347-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    (real measurable measure set lower)
  (forall (superset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable superset)
      (q2027347-set-subset-p set superset))
     (q2027347-ennreal-leq
      real lower
      (q2027347-measure-value measure superset)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-outer-measure-value-p
    (real measurable measure set)
  (forall (lower)
    (and
     (q2027347-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
      real measurable measure set
      (q2027347-measure-value measure set))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2027347-ennreal-p real lower)
       (q2027347-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
        real measurable measure set lower))
      (q2027347-ennreal-leq
       real lower
       (q2027347-measure-value measure set))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-outer-measure-values-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2027347-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q2027347-outer-measure-value-p
      real measurable measure set))))

(defun q2027347-measure-space-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q2027347-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q2027347-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q2027347-measure-values-p real domain measure)
   (q2027347-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q2027347-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)
   (q2027347-outer-measure-values-p
    real domain measurable measure)))

(defun q2027347-null-set-p (real domain measure set)
  (and
   (q2027347-valid-set-p domain set)
   (equal
    (q2027347-measure-value measure set)
    (q2027347-ennreal-zero real))))

;; Typed functions and measurability through upper-ray preimages.

(defun-sk q2027347-real-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2027347-r-member-p
      real (q2027347-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-ennreal-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2027347-ennreal-p
      real (q2027347-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-real-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2027347-r-less
       real threshold
       (q2027347-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2027347-ennreal-less
       real threshold
       (q2027347-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-real-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q2027347-real-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2027347-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-real-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q2027347-real-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q2027347-r-member-p real threshold)
      (q2027347-real-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q2027347-ennreal-p real threshold)
      (q2027347-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-disagreement-set-p
    (domain left right set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (equal
        (q2027347-function-value left x)
        (q2027347-function-value right x)))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-ae-equal-p
    (real domain measure left right)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q2027347-disagreement-set-p domain left right set)
     (q2027347-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q2027347-ae-real-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q2027347-real-function-p real domain function)
     (q2027347-measurable-real-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q2027347-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

(defun-sk q2027347-ae-ennreal-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q2027347-measurable-ennreal-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q2027347-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

;; The lower Lebesgue integral as the supremum of measurable finite-range
;; simple functions below the integrand.

(defun-sk q2027347-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q2027347-function-value function x)
      value))))

(defun q2027347-values-attained-p
    (domain function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q2027347-value-attained-p
        domain function (car values))
       (q2027347-values-attained-p
        domain function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q2027347-ennreal-value-list-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q2027347-ennreal-p real (car values))
       (q2027347-ennreal-value-list-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q2027347-range-in-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (member-equal
      (q2027347-function-value function x)
      values))))

(defun-sk q2027347-fiber-set-p
    (domain function value set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q2027347-function-value function x)
       value)))))

(defun q2027347-fiber-list-p
    (domain function values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (consp fibers)
       (q2027347-fiber-set-p
        domain function (car values) (car fibers))
       (q2027347-fiber-list-p
        domain function (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (equal fibers nil)))

(defun q2027347-finite-simple-integral
    (real measure values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (q2027347-ennreal-add
       real
       (q2027347-ennreal-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q2027347-measure-value measure (car fibers)))
       (q2027347-finite-simple-integral
        real measure (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (q2027347-ennreal-zero real)))

(defun q2027347-simple-function-data-p
    (real domain measurable function values fibers)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (true-listp fibers)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q2027347-ennreal-value-list-p real values)
   (q2027347-values-attained-p domain function values)
   (q2027347-range-in-values-p domain function values)
   (q2027347-fiber-list-p domain function values fibers)
   (q2027347-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    real domain measurable function)))

(defun-sk q2027347-simple-below-p
    (real domain simple function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2027347-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2027347-function-value simple x)
      (q2027347-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values fibers)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2027347-simple-function-data-p
       real domain measurable simple values fibers)
      (q2027347-simple-below-p
       real domain simple function))
     (q2027347-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2027347-finite-simple-integral
       real measure values fibers)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2027347-lintegral-value-p
    (real domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q2027347-ennreal-p real value)
     (q2027347-lintegral-upper-bound-p
      real domain measurable measure function value)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2027347-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q2027347-lintegral-upper-bound-p
        real domain measurable measure function bound))
      (q2027347-ennreal-leq real value bound)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-lintegral-operation-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q2027347-lintegral-value-p
      real domain measurable measure function
      (q2027347-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure function)))))

;; The real Bochner integral, specialized to real-valued functions.

(defun-sk q2027347-enorm-function-p
    (real domain function enorm-function)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain enorm-function)
     (implies
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q2027347-function-value enorm-function x)
       (q2027347-ennreal-finite
        (q2027347-r-abs
         real
         (q2027347-function-value function x))))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-integrable-enorm-exists-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
  (exists (enorm-function)
    (and
     (q2027347-enorm-function-p
      real domain function enorm-function)
     (q2027347-ennreal-less
      real
      (q2027347-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure enorm-function)
      :q2027347-top))))

(defun q2027347-integrable-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
  (and
   (q2027347-ae-real-measurable-p
    real domain measurable measure function)
   (q2027347-integrable-enorm-exists-p
    real domain measurable measure lintegral function)))

(defun-sk q2027347-positive-part-function-p
    (real domain function positive)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain positive)
     (implies
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q2027347-function-value positive x)
       (q2027347-ennreal-finite
        (if
            (q2027347-r-less
             real
             (q2027347-function-value function x)
             (q2027347-r-zero real))
            (q2027347-r-zero real)
          (q2027347-function-value function x))))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-negative-part-function-p
    (real domain function negative)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q2027347-ennreal-function-p real domain negative)
     (implies
      (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
      (let ((negated
             (q2027347-r-negate
              real
              (q2027347-function-value function x))))
        (equal
         (q2027347-function-value negative x)
         (q2027347-ennreal-finite
          (if
              (q2027347-r-less
               real negated (q2027347-r-zero real))
              (q2027347-r-zero real)
            negated))))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-real-integral-witness-exists-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function value)
  (exists (positive negative)
    (and
     (q2027347-positive-part-function-p
      real domain function positive)
     (q2027347-negative-part-function-p
      real domain function negative)
     (equal
      value
      (q2027347-r-add
       real
       (q2027347-ennreal-to-real
        real
        (q2027347-lintegral-value
         lintegral domain measurable measure positive))
       (q2027347-r-negate
        real
        (q2027347-ennreal-to-real
         real
         (q2027347-lintegral-value
          lintegral domain measurable measure negative))))))))

(defun q2027347-real-integral-value-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function value)
  (and
   (q2027347-r-member-p real value)
   (if
       (q2027347-integrable-p
        real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
       (q2027347-real-integral-witness-exists-p
        integral real domain measurable measure
        lintegral function value)
     (equal value (q2027347-r-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-real-integral-operation-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q2027347-real-function-p real domain function)
     (q2027347-real-integral-value-p
      integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function
      (q2027347-integral-value
       integral real domain measurable measure
       lintegral function)))))

;; Filtrations and process fibers are represented by conservative object
;; constructors.  Their pointwise meanings are imposed by direct quantified
;; laws, rather than generated function terms.

(defstub q2027347-filtration-level (filtration index) t)
(defstub q2027347-process-fiber (process index) t)
(defstub q2027347-restricted-function (set function zero) t)
(defstub q2027347-stopping-level-set
  (domain stopping-time index) t)
(defstub q2027347-stopped-function
  (stopping-time process zero) t)

(defun-sk q2027347-process-fiber-operation-p ()
  (forall (process n x)
    (equal
     (q2027347-function-value
      (q2027347-process-fiber process n) x)
     (q2027347-function-value process (cons n x)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-restricted-function-operation-p (real)
  (forall (set function x)
    (equal
     (q2027347-function-value
      (q2027347-restricted-function
       set function (q2027347-r-zero real))
      x)
     (if (q2027347-set-member-p set x)
         (q2027347-function-value function x)
       (q2027347-r-zero real)))))

;; Sigma-finite filtrations.

(defun-sk q2027347-filtration-levels-p (domain filtration)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2027347-sigma-algebra-p
      domain (q2027347-filtration-level filtration n)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-filtration-contained-p
    (measurable filtration)
  (forall (n set)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (q2027347-measurable-set-p
       (q2027347-filtration-level filtration n) set))
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2027347-filtration-monotone-p (filtration)
  (forall (i j set)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i)
      (natp j)
      (<= i j)
      (q2027347-measurable-set-p
       (q2027347-filtration-level filtration i) set))
     (q2027347-measurable-set-p
      (q2027347-filtration-level filtration j) set))))

(defun q2027347-filtration-p
    (domain measurable filtration)
  (and
   (q2027347-filtration-levels-p domain filtration)
   (q2027347-filtration-contained-p measurable filtration)
   (q2027347-filtration-monotone-p filtration)))

(defun-sk q2027347-sigma-cover-levels-p
    (real measurable measure sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (let ((set (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence n)))
       (and
        (q2027347-measurable-set-p measurable set)
        (not
         (equal
          (q2027347-measure-value measure set)
          :q2027347-top)))))))

(defun-sk q2027347-sigma-cover-index-exists-p
    (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2027347-set-member-p
      (q2027347-set-sequence-value sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q2027347-sigma-cover-covers-p
    (domain sequence)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2027347-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2027347-sigma-cover-index-exists-p sequence x))))

(defun q2027347-sigma-finite-cover-p
    (real domain measurable measure sequence)
  (and
   (q2027347-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
   (q2027347-sigma-cover-levels-p
    real measurable measure sequence)
   (q2027347-sigma-cover-covers-p domain sequence)))

(defun-sk q2027347-sigma-finite-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (exists (sequence)
    (q2027347-sigma-finite-cover-p
     real domain measurable measure sequence)))

(defun-sk q2027347-filtration-level-sigma-finite-p
    (real domain measure filtration n)
  (exists (sequence)
    (q2027347-sigma-finite-cover-p
     real domain
     (q2027347-filtration-level filtration n)
     measure sequence)))

(defun-sk q2027347-sigma-finite-filtration-p
    (real domain measure filtration)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2027347-filtration-level-sigma-finite-p
      real domain measure filtration n))))

;; Strong adaptation and integrability of the real-valued process.

(defun-sk q2027347-real-process-p
    (real domain process)
  (forall (n)

      real domain (q2027347-process-fiber process n)))))

(defun-sk q2027347-strongly-adapted-p
    (real domain filtration process)

(defun-sk q2027347-process-integrable-p

(defun q2027347-process-context-p

;; The submartingale predicate uses the equivalent set-integral
;; characterization: for i <= j and every set measurable at time i, the
;; integral of f_i over that set is at most the integral of f_j.

(defun q2027347-set-integral-value
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral

(defun-sk q2027347-submartingale-set-integrals-p

;; Stopping times Ω -> ℕ∞, including the top value.

(defun q2027347-extended-natural-p (value)
  (or (natp value)
      (equal value :q2027347-nat-top)))

(defun q2027347-extended-natural-leq (left right)

(defun-sk q2027347-stopping-values-p

(defun-sk q2027347-stopping-levels-measurable-p

      (q2027347-stopping-level-set
