title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2027347,
-- "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly adapted integrable real process is a
-- submartingale exactly when expected stopped values are monotone for ordered
-- bounded stopping times. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
open import Support.Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
open import Support.Q1153584_monotone_convergence_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open SigmaAlgebra
open Measure

record IffLevel
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where
  field
    forward :
      P -> Q
    backward :
      Q -> P

record ClassicalLogic : Set1 where
  field
    excluded-middle :
      (P : Set) ->
      Either P (Not P)

open ClassicalLogic

indicator :
  {A R : Set} ->
  (logic : ClassicalLogic) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Predicate A ->
  A ->
  R
indicator logic reals S x with excluded-middle logic (S x)
... | left _ =
  oneR reals
... | right _ =
  zeroR reals

setIntegral :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (logic : ClassicalLogic) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> R) ->
  R
setIntegral logic reals extended presentation measure S f =
  realIntegral reals extended presentation measure
    (\ x ->
      multiplyR reals
        (indicator logic reals S x)
        (f x))

record Filtration
  (A : Set)
  (base : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    at :
      Nat ->
      SigmaAlgebra A

    included-in-base :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable (at n) S ->
      measurable base S

    increasing :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N j ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable (at i) S ->
      measurable (at j) S

open Filtration

record SigmaFiniteAt
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended base)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set1 where
  field
    spanning-sets :
      Nat ->
      Predicate A

    spanning-sets-measurable :
      (n : Nat) ->
      measurable events (spanning-sets n)

    spanning-sets-finite :
      (n : Nat) ->
      outerMass measure (spanning-sets n) != infinityM extended

    spanning-sets-cover :
      (x : A) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> spanning-sets n x)

record SigmaFiniteFiltration
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended base)
  (filtration : Filtration A base) : Set1 where
  field
    sigma-finite-at :
      (n : Nat) ->
      SigmaFiniteAt measure (at filtration n)

data ExtendedNat : Set where
  finiteNat : Nat -> ExtendedNat
  infinityNat : ExtendedNat

ExtendedNatLE :
  ExtendedNat ->
  ExtendedNat ->
  Set
ExtendedNatLE (finiteNat m) (finiteNat n) =
  m <=N n
ExtendedNatLE (finiteNat m) infinityNat =
  Top
ExtendedNatLE infinityNat (finiteNat n) =
  Bottom
ExtendedNatLE infinityNat infinityNat =
  Top

StoppingTime :
  Set ->
  Set
StoppingTime A =
  A ->
  ExtendedNat

IsStoppingTime :
  {A : Set} ->
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  Filtration A base ->
  StoppingTime A ->
  Set
IsStoppingTime filtration tau =
  (n : Nat) ->
  measurable (at filtration n)
    (\ x -> ExtendedNatLE (tau x) (finiteNat n))

StoppingTimeLE :
  {A : Set} ->
  StoppingTime A ->
  StoppingTime A ->
  Set
StoppingTimeLE {A = A} tau pi =
  (x : A) ->
  ExtendedNatLE (tau x) (pi x)

BoundedStoppingTime :
  {A : Set} ->
  StoppingTime A ->
  Set
BoundedStoppingTime {A = A} tau =
  Exists Nat
    (\ bound ->
      (x : A) ->
      ExtendedNatLE (tau x) (finiteNat bound))

stoppedValue :
  {A R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  StoppingTime A ->
  A ->
  R
stoppedValue reals process tau x with tau x
... | finiteNat n =
  process n x
... | infinityNat =
  zeroR reals

ExpectedStoppedValue :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended base) ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  StoppingTime A ->
  R
ExpectedStoppedValue reals extended presentation measure process tau =
  realIntegral reals extended presentation measure
    (stoppedValue reals process tau)

StronglyAdapted :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  Filtration A base ->
  (Nat -> A -> R) ->
  Set
StronglyAdapted reals filtration process =
  (n : Nat) ->
  MeasurableOrder
    (at filtration n)
    (lessOrEqualR reals)
    (process n)

record Submartingale
  {A R M : Set}
  {base : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (logic : ClassicalLogic)
  (presentation : ENNRealPresentation extended)
  (measure : Measure extended base)
  (filtration : Filtration A base)
  (process : Nat -> A -> R) : Set1 where
  field
    strongly-adapted :
      StronglyAdapted reals filtration process

    integrable-values :
      (n : Nat) ->
      RealIntegrable reals base extended measure (process n)

    set-integral-monotone :
      (i j : Nat) ->
      i <=N j ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable (at filtration i) S ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (setIntegral logic reals extended presentation measure S (process i))
        (setIntegral logic reals extended presentation measure S (process j))

optional-stopping-theorem : Set2
optional-stopping-theorem =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (base : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (presentation : ENNRealPresentation extended) ->
  (measure : Measure extended base) ->
  (filtration : Filtration A base) ->
  SigmaFiniteFiltration measure filtration ->
  (logic : ClassicalLogic) ->
  (process : Nat -> A -> R) ->
  StronglyAdapted reals filtration process ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    RealIntegrable reals base extended measure (process n)) ->
  IffLevel
    (Submartingale logic presentation measure filtration process)
    ((tau pi : StoppingTime A) ->
      IsStoppingTime filtration tau ->
      IsStoppingTime filtration pi ->
      StoppingTimeLE tau pi ->
      BoundedStoppingTime pi ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (ExpectedStoppedValue
          reals extended presentation measure process tau)
        (ExpectedStoppedValue
          reals extended presentation measure process pi))

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2027347, "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly adapted integrable
  real-valued process is a submartingale exactly when expected stopped values
  are monotone at ordered bounded stopping times. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory;
open lebesgueTheory martingaleTheory probabilityTheory;

val optional_stopping_theorem =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (a : num -> 'a algebra)
      (f : num -> 'a -> real).
      let strongly_adapted =
        \g : num -> 'a -> real.
          !n. g n IN measurable (a n) borel
      in
      let is_stopping_time =
        \tau : 'a -> num option.
          !n.
            {x | ?k. tau x = SOME k /\ k <= n} IN subsets (a n)
      in
      let stopping_time_le =
        \tau pi : 'a -> num option.
          !x.
            case pi x of
              NONE => T
            | SOME j =>
                case tau x of
                  NONE => F
                | SOME i => i <= j
      in
      let bounded_stopping_time =
        \pi : 'a -> num option.
          ?N. !x.
            case pi x of
              NONE => F
            | SOME n => n <= N
      in
      let stopped_value =
        \g : num -> 'a -> real.
        \tau : 'a -> num option.
        \x.
          case tau x of
            NONE => g 0 x
          | SOME n => g n x
      in
        m_space m = UNIV /\
        sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\
        strongly_adapted f /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o f n))
        ==>
        (sub_martingale m a (\n x. Normal (f n x)) <=>
         !tau pi.
           is_stopping_time tau /\
           is_stopping_time pi /\
           stopping_time_le tau pi /\
           bounded_stopping_time pi
           ==>
           expectation m (Normal o stopped_value f tau) <=
           expectation m (Normal o stopped_value f pi))``;

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2027347
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2027347), "Optional stopping theorem":
  under a sigma-finite filtration, a strongly adapted integrable real-valued
  process is a submartingale exactly when expected stopped values are monotone
  for every ordered pair of bounded stopping times. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q2027347Filtration says that F is an increasing NN0-indexed family of
  sub-sigma-algebras of the measurable space of M.

  Q2027347SigmaFiniteFiltration says that at every filtration level the sample
  space has a countable cover by level-measurable sets of finite M-measure.
  This is the sigma-finiteness of M viewed on that sub-sigma-algebra.

  Q2027347StronglyAdapted requires each real-valued X_n to be measurable for
  the nth filtration sigma-algebra. For real-valued functions this is
  equivalent to strong measurability. Q2027347FunctionIntegrable is almost-
  everywhere strong measurability together with finite L1 norm, and
  Q2027347Integrable applies it to every process slice.

  Q2027347Integral is the totalized real Bochner integral defined by limits of
  simple integrals along L1-approximating measurable finite-range functions.
  Q2027347SetIntegral is the integral of the zero extension from an event.
  Q2027347Submartingale uses the equivalent set-integral characterization:
  adaptedness, integrability, and monotonicity of these integrals on every
  earlier-filtration event. Under Q2027347SigmaFiniteFiltration this is
  equivalent to the conditional-expectation definition in the Lean source.

  A stopping time maps the sample space to NN0* = NN0 u. { +oo }, with
  { x | T(x) <= n } measurable at level n. Q2027347StoppingLe is pointwise
  order, and Q2027347Bounded keeps the natural bound existentially quantified
  inside the stopping-time condition. Q2027347Stopped evaluates X at a finite
  stopping value and uses index 0 at +oo, representing the arbitrary natural
  index selected by stoppedValue there. In the final assertion the boundedness
  and order hypotheses force both stopping times to be finite.

  The final $a declaration is the translated equivalence. All preceding $a
  declarations are syntax or faithful definitions; there is no $p statement.
$)

$c Q2027347Filtration Q2027347SigmaFiniteFiltration
   Q2027347StronglyAdapted Q2027347SeqTendsto
   Q2027347Simple Q2027347SimpleIntegral Q2027347LIntegral
   Q2027347AEStrong Q2027347Diff Q2027347L1Distance
   Q2027347FunctionIntegrable Q2027347HasIntegral Q2027347Integral
   Q2027347Integrable Q2027347SetIntegral
   Q2027347Submartingale Q2027347Stopping Q2027347StoppingLe
   Q2027347Bounded Q2027347Stopped $.

q2027347-filtration-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347Filtration M F ) $.
q2027347-sigma-finite-filtration-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347SigmaFiniteFiltration M F ) $.
q2027347-strongly-adapted-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347StronglyAdapted M F X ) $.
q2027347-seq-tendsto-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347SeqTendsto W S z ) $.
q2027347-simple-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347Simple M G ) $.
q2027347-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q2027347-lintegral-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347LIntegral M H ) $.
q2027347-aestrong-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347AEStrong M H ) $.
q2027347-diff-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347Diff M H K ) $.
q2027347-l1-distance-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347L1Distance M H K ) $.
q2027347-function-integrable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347FunctionIntegrable M H ) $.
q2027347-has-integral-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347HasIntegral M H y ) $.
q2027347-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347Integral M H ) $.
q2027347-integrable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347Integrable M X ) $.
q2027347-set-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347SetIntegral M H A ) $.
q2027347-submartingale-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347Submartingale M F X ) $.
q2027347-stopping-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347Stopping M F T ) $.
q2027347-stopping-le-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347StoppingLe M T S ) $.
q2027347-bounded-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2027347Bounded M T ) $.
q2027347-stopped-syntax
  $a class ( Q2027347Stopped M X T ) $.

${
  $d F M i j $.

  q2027347-filtration-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2027347Filtration M F )
    <->
    (
      F : NN0 --> ( sigAlgebra ` U. dom M )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. NN0 ( F ` i ) C_ dom M
        /\
        A. i e. NN0 A. j e. NN0
          (
            i <_ j
            ->
            ( F ` i ) C_ ( F ` j )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C F M k n $.

  q2027347-sigma-finite-filtration-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2027347SigmaFiniteFiltration M F )
    <->
    A. n e. NN0
      E. C e. ( ( F ` n ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. k e. NN0 ( M ` ( C ` k ) ) < +oo
          /\
          U. ran C = U. dom M
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M X n $.

  q2027347-strongly-adapted-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2027347StronglyAdapted M F X )
    <->
    (
      X : NN0 --> ( RR ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      A. n e. NN0
        ( X ` n ) e. ( ( F ` n ) MblFnM BrSiga )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S W z $.

  q2027347-seq-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2027347SeqTendsto W S z )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) z
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q2027347-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2027347Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q2027347-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q2027347SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q2027347-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q2027347LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q2027347Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M
                ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q2027347SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N s n x $.

  q2027347-aestrong-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2027347AEStrong M H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( RR ^m U. dom M )
      /\
      E. s e. ( ( RR ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            (

${
  $d A C F H M N S T X i j k n x $.

  thousand-theorems-q2027347-optional-stopping $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures

                    (

                          M ( Q2027347Stopped M X T ) )
                        <_
                        ( Q2027347Integral
                          M ( Q2027347Stopped M X S ) )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2027347,
:: "Optional stopping theorem": under a sigma-finite discrete-time filtration,
:: a strongly adapted integrable real-valued process is a submartingale exactly
:: when expected stopped values are monotone for ordered bounded stopping times.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, PARTFUN1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, ARYTM_3, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1,
      FUNCT_2, VALUED_0, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_2, NAT_1,
      CARD_3, CARD_1, ZFMISC_1, PROB_3, PROB_4, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3,
      FUNCOP_1, FINANCE1, FINANCE3, REAL_1, SETFAM_1, XCMPLX_0, ARYTM_1,
      VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, INTEGRA5, COMPLEX1, MEASURE8;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, CARD_1,
      NUMBERS, XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0,
      VALUED_0, SUPINF_2, PROB_1, PROB_2, PROB_3, MEASURE1, MEASURE6, MESFUNC1,
      PROB_4, MESFUNC6, MESFUNC5, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FINANCE1,
      FINANCE3, REAL_1, VALUED_1, EXTREAL1, COMPLEX1, MEASURE8;
 constructors REAL_1, MESFUNC6, MEASURE6, PROB_3, PROB_4, MESFUNC1,
      MESFUNC5, RELSET_1, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FINANCE1, FINANCE3,
      SETFAM_1, EXTREAL1, XXREAL_3, FUNCOP_1, COMPLEX1, MEASURE8;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3,
      ORDINAL1, MEASURE1, FUNCOP_1, FINANCE1, FINANCE3, VALUED_0, FUNCT_2,
      RELAT_1, NUMBERS, PROB_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1, CARD_1, MEMBERED,
      RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, XCMPLX_0;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, ARITHM, REAL;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, VALUED_0;
 equalities PROB_1, RANDOM_2, PROB_4, RELAT_1, FINANCE3;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1;

begin

:: MML's integral functors are typed over nonempty carriers.  This is their
:: exact conservative extension to partial real functions on the empty
:: carrier, where every Lebesgue integral is zero.
definition
  let Omega be empty set;
  let Sigma be SigmaField of Omega;
  let M be sigma_Measure of Sigma;
  let f be PartFunc of Omega,REAL;
  func Integral(M,f) -> ExtReal equals
    0;
  correctness;
end;

definition
  let Omega be empty set;
  let Sigma be SigmaField of Omega;
  let M be sigma_Measure of Sigma;
  let f be PartFunc of Omega,REAL;
  pred f is_integrable_on M means
    Integral(M,f) = 0;
end;

::$P-
theorem
  (for Omega being empty set,
       Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
       M being sigma_Measure of Sigma,
       F being Function of NAT,bool Sigma,
       X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL)
   st
     (for n being Element of NAT holds
       ex Fn being SigmaField of Omega st Fn = F.n) &
     (for n,m being Element of NAT,
          Fn,Fm being SigmaField of Omega
       st n <= m & Fn = F.n & Fm = F.m
       holds Fn c= Fm) &
     (for n being Element of NAT,
          Fn being SigmaField of Omega st Fn = F.n
       holds
         ex E being Set_Sequence of Fn st
           (for k being Nat holds M.(E.k) < +infty) &
           Union E = Omega) &
     (for n being Element of NAT,
          Fn being SigmaField of Omega,
          Xn being Function of Omega,REAL
       st Fn = F.n & Xn = X.n
       holds
         Xn is (Fn,Borel_Sets)-random_variable-like &
         Xn is_integrable_on M)
   holds
     ((for n,m being Element of NAT,
           Fn,Fm being SigmaField of Omega,
           A being Element of Fn,
           Xn,Xm being Function of Omega,REAL
         st n <= m & Fn = F.n & Fm = F.m &
            Xn = X.n & Xm = X.m
         holds
           Integral(M,Xn|A) <= Integral(M,Xm|A))
      iff
      (for tau,rho being Function of Omega,ExtREAL st
         (for w being Element of Omega st w in Omega holds
            tau.w = +infty or
              ex k being Nat st tau.w = k) &
         (for w being Element of Omega st w in Omega holds
            rho.w = +infty or
              ex k being Nat st rho.w = k) &
         (for n being Element of NAT,
              Fn being SigmaField of Omega st Fn = F.n
           holds
             ex A being Element of Fn st
               A = {w where w is Element of Omega :
                 w in Omega & tau.w <= n}) &
         (for n being Element of NAT,
              Fn being SigmaField of Omega st Fn = F.n
           holds
             ex A being Element of Fn st
               A = {w where w is Element of Omega :
                 w in Omega & rho.w <= n}) &
         (for w being Element of Omega st w in Omega
            holds tau.w <= rho.w) &
         (ex N being Nat st
            for w being Element of Omega st w in Omega
              holds rho.w <= N)
       holds
         ex Ztau,Zpi being Function of Omega,REAL st
           Ztau is (Sigma,Borel_Sets)-random_variable-like &
           Zpi is (Sigma,Borel_Sets)-random_variable-like &
           Ztau is_integrable_on M &
           Zpi is_integrable_on M &
           (for w being Element of Omega st w in Omega holds
              (tau.w = +infty implies Ztau.w = 0) &
              (for k being Nat st tau.w = k holds
                Ztau.w = X.k.w)) &
           (for w being Element of Omega st w in Omega holds
              (rho.w = +infty implies Zpi.w = 0) &
              (for k being Nat st rho.w = k holds
                Zpi.w = X.k.w)) &
           Integral(M,Ztau) <= Integral(M,Zpi))))
  &
  (for Omega being non empty set,
       Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
       M being sigma_Measure of Sigma,
       F being Filtration of NAT,Sigma,
       X being Function of NAT,Funcs(Omega,REAL)
   st
     (for n being Element of NAT holds
       ex E being Set_Sequence of El_Filtration(n,F) st
         (for k being Nat holds M.(E.k) < +infty) &
         Union E = Omega) &
     X is Sigma-Random-Variable-Family &
     (for n being Element of NAT,
          Xn being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
       st Xn = X.n
       holds
         Xn is_integrable_on M &
         Xn is
           (El_Filtration(n,F),Borel_Sets)-random_variable-like)
   holds
     ((for n,m being Element of NAT,
           A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F),
           Xn,Xm being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma
         st n <= m & Xn = X.n & Xm = X.m
         holds
           Integral(M,Xn|A) <= Integral(M,Xm|A))
      iff
      (for tau,rho being Function of Omega,ExtREAL st
         (for w being Element of Omega holds
            tau.w = +infty or
              ex k being Nat st tau.w = k) &
         (for w being Element of Omega holds
            rho.w = +infty or
              ex k being Nat st rho.w = k) &
         (for n being Element of NAT holds
            ex A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F) st
              A = {w where w is Element of Omega : tau.w <= n}) &
         (for n being Element of NAT holds
            ex A being Element of El_Filtration(n,F) st
              A = {w where w is Element of Omega : rho.w <= n}) &
         (for w being Element of Omega holds tau.w <= rho.w) &
         (ex N being Nat st
            for w being Element of Omega holds rho.w <= N)
       holds
         ex Ztau,Zpi being Real-Valued-Random-Variable of Sigma st
           Ztau is_integrable_on M &
           Zpi is_integrable_on M &
           (for w being Element of Omega holds
              (tau.w = +infty implies Ztau.w = 0) &
              (for k being Nat st tau.w = k holds
                Ztau.w = X.k.w)) &
           (for w being Element of Omega holds
              (rho.w = +infty implies Zpi.w = 0) &
              (for k being Nat st rho.w = k holds
                Zpi.w = X.k.w)) &
           Integral(M,Ztau) <= Integral(M,Zpi))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q2027347_optional_stopping_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q2027347,
% "Optional stopping theorem": a strongly adapted integrable real process is a
% submartingale exactly when expected stopped values are monotone for every
% ordered pair of bounded stopping times. This file contains no proof.

optional_stopping_theorem_Q2027347[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  process: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  filtration: TYPE = [nat -> sigma_algebra]

  extended_nat: TYPE =
    [# finite_flag: bool, finite_index: nat #]
  stopping_time: TYPE = [A -> extended_nat]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_finite(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  scale_measure_value(
      coefficient: real,
      value: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF coefficient = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(coefficient * finite_part(value))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  event_subset(left, right: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND left(omega)
        IMPLIES right(omega)

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property_value: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) AND NOT property_value(omega))

  sublevel_event(
      X: real_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND X(omega) <= bound

  measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      Sigma(sublevel_event(X, bound))

  ae_measurable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            X(omega) = measurable_version(omega))

  positive_part(X: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF X(omega) >= 0 THEN X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  negative_part(X: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF X(omega) <= 0 THEN -X(omega) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  finite_simple_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            X(omega) =
              finite_simple_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              X(omega)))

  measurable_nonnegative_simple_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) >= 0
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  nonnegative_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_nonnegative_simple_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          0 <= finite_simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
          AND finite_simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, omega)
              <= X(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        scale_measure_value(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: real_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        nonnegative_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, X, coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    (FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES X(omega) >= 0)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, X, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(M, Sigma, X, upper)
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  has_expectation(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    EXISTS
        (measurable_version: real_function),
        (positive_value, negative_value: real):
      measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            X(omega) = measurable_version(omega))
        AND has_nonnegative_integral(
          M,
          Sigma,
          positive_part(measurable_version),
          finite_measure_value(positive_value))
        AND has_nonnegative_integral(
          M,
          Sigma,
          negative_part(measurable_version),
          finite_measure_value(negative_value))
        AND value = positive_value - negative_value

  integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (value: real):
      has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, value)

  expectation_le(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X, Y: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (x_value, y_value: real):
      has_expectation(M, Sigma, X, x_value)
        AND has_expectation(M, Sigma, Y, y_value)
        AND x_value <= y_value

  sub_sigma_algebra(
      smaller, larger: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      smaller(E) IMPLIES larger(E)

  filtration_on(
      F: filtration,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        is_sigma_algebra(F(index))
          AND sub_sigma_algebra(F(index), Sigma))
      AND (FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
        left_index <= right_index IMPLIES
          sub_sigma_algebra(
            F(left_index), F(right_index)))

  finite_measure_value_at(
      M: measure_map,
      E: event): bool =
    measure_value_is_finite(M(E))

  sigma_finite(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    EXISTS (cover: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        Sigma(cover(index))
          AND finite_measure_value_at(M, cover(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              cover(index)(omega))

  sigma_finite_filtration(
      M: measure_map,
      F: filtration): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      sigma_finite(M, F(index))

  strongly_adapted(
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      strongly_measurable_real(F(index), X(index))

  integrable_process(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      integrable(M, Sigma, X(index))

  restricted_variable(
      X: real_function,
      E: event): real_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) AND E(omega) THEN
        X(omega)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  submartingale(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      X: process,
      F: filtration): bool =
    strongly_adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)
      AND (FORALL
          (left_index, right_index: nat),
          (E: event):
        (left_index <= right_index
          AND F(left_index)(E))
        IMPLIES
          expectation_le(
            M,
            Sigma,
            restricted_variable(X(left_index), E),
            restricted_variable(X(right_index), E)))

  canonical_extended_nat(value: extended_nat): bool =
    finite_flag(value)
      OR finite_index(value) = 0

  extended_nat_le(left, right: extended_nat): bool =
    IF finite_flag(left) THEN
      NOT finite_flag(right)
        OR finite_index(left) <= finite_index(right)
    ELSE
      NOT finite_flag(right)
    ENDIF

  stopping_time_le(
      tau, pi: stopping_time): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        extended_nat_le(tau(omega), pi(omega))

  stopped_by_event(
      tau: stopping_time,
      index: nat): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND finite_flag(tau(omega))
        AND finite_index(tau(omega)) <= index

  stopping_time_wrt(
      tau: stopping_time,
      F: filtration): bool =
    (FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_extended_nat(tau(omega)))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        F(index)(stopped_by_event(tau, index)))

  bounded_stopping_time(
      pi: stopping_time): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          extended_nat_le(
            pi(omega),
            (# finite_flag := TRUE,
               finite_index := bound #))

  stopped_value(
      X: process,
      tau: stopping_time): real_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) AND finite_flag(tau(omega)) THEN
        X(finite_index(tau(omega)))(omega)
      ELSE
        0
      ENDIF

  optional_stopping_context(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      F: filtration,
      X: process): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND filtration_on(F, Sigma)
      AND sigma_finite_filtration(M, F)
      AND strongly_adapted(X, F)
      AND integrable_process(M, Sigma, X)

  optional_stopping_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (F: filtration),
        (X: process):
      optional_stopping_context(M, Sigma, F, X)
      IMPLIES
        (submartingale(M, Sigma, X, F)
          IFF
            (FORALL (tau, pi: stopping_time):
              (stopping_time_wrt(tau, F)
                AND stopping_time_wrt(pi, F)
                AND stopping_time_le(tau, pi)
                AND bounded_stopping_time(pi))
              IMPLIES
                expectation_le(
                  M,
                  Sigma,
                  stopped_value(X, tau),
                  stopped_value(X, pi))))
END optional_stopping_theorem_Q2027347

title: Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q203565
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q203565), "Solutions of a general cubic equation":
-- over a field with invertible 2 and 3 and a primitive cube root of unity, Cardano's
-- auxiliary quantities characterize exactly the three roots of a cubic.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public section

namespace Theorems100

universe u

/-- A commutative field, presented by its operations and defining laws. -/
class Field (K : Type u) where
  zero : K
  one : K
  add : K → K → K
  mul : K → K → K
  neg : K → K
  inv : K → K
  zero_ne_one : zero ≠ one
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_comm : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  zero_add : ∀ x, add zero x = x
  add_left_neg : ∀ x, add (neg x) x = zero
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_comm : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  one_mul : ∀ x, mul one x = x
  left_distrib : ∀ x y z, mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)
  inv_zero : inv zero = zero
  mul_inv_cancel : ∀ x, x ≠ zero → mul x (inv x) = one

/-- Subtraction in the explicitly presented field. -/
def fieldSub {K : Type u} [Field K] (x y : K) : K :=
  Field.add x (Field.neg y)

/-- Division in the explicitly presented field. -/
def fieldDiv {K : Type u} [Field K] (x y : K) : K :=
  Field.mul x (Field.inv y)

/-- Natural powers in the explicitly presented field. -/
def fieldPow {K : Type u} [Field K] (x : K) : Nat → K
  | 0 => Field.one
  | n + 1 => Field.mul (fieldPow x n) x

/-- The canonical image of a natural number in the explicitly presented field. -/
def fieldNat {K : Type u} [Field K] : Nat → K
  | 0 => Field.zero
  | n + 1 => Field.add (fieldNat n) Field.one

/-- An element whose multiplicative inverse is explicitly available. -/
class Invertible {K : Type u} [Field K] (x : K) where
  inverse : K
  inverse_mul_self : Field.mul inverse x = Field.one
  self_mul_inverse : Field.mul x inverse = Field.one

/-- An element is a primitive `n`th root when its powers equal one exactly at multiples of `n`. -/
def IsPrimitiveRoot {K : Type u} [Field K] (ω : K) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  fieldPow ω n = Field.one ∧
    ∀ m, fieldPow ω m = Field.one ↔ ∃ k, m = n * k

variable {K : Type u} [Field K] (a b c d : K) {ω p q r s t : K}
variable [Invertible (fieldNat (K := K) 2)] [Invertible (fieldNat (K := K) 3)]

/-- The roots of a cubic polynomial whose Cardano parameter `p` is nonzero. -/
theorem cubic_eq_zero_iff (ha : a ≠ Field.zero) (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω 3)
    (hp : p =
      fieldDiv
        (fieldSub
          (Field.mul (Field.mul (fieldNat 3) a) c)
          (fieldPow b 2))
        (Field.mul (fieldNat 9) (fieldPow a 2)))
    (hp_nonzero : p ≠ Field.zero)
    (hq : q =
      fieldDiv
        (fieldSub
          (fieldSub
            (Field.mul (Field.mul (Field.mul (fieldNat 9) a) b) c)
            (Field.mul (fieldNat 2) (fieldPow b 3)))
          (Field.mul (Field.mul (fieldNat 27) (fieldPow a 2)) d))
        (Field.mul (fieldNat 54) (fieldPow a 3)))
    (hr : fieldPow r 2 = Field.add (fieldPow q 2) (fieldPow p 3))
    (hs3 : fieldPow s 3 = Field.add q r)
    (ht : Field.mul t s = p)
    (x : K) :
    Field.add
          (Field.add
            (Field.add
              (Field.mul a (fieldPow x 3))
              (Field.mul b (fieldPow x 2)))
            (Field.mul c x))
          d =
        Field.zero ↔
      x =
          fieldSub
            (fieldSub s t)
            (fieldDiv b (Field.mul (fieldNat 3) a)) ∨
        x =
            fieldSub
              (fieldSub
                (Field.mul s ω)
                (Field.mul t (fieldPow ω 2)))
              (fieldDiv b (Field.mul (fieldNat 3) a)) ∨
          x =
            fieldSub
              (fieldSub
                (Field.mul s (fieldPow ω 2))
                (Field.mul t ω))
              (fieldDiv b (Field.mul (fieldNat 3) a)) := sorry

end Theorems100

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q203565
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q203565), "Solutions of a general cubic equation":
  over a field where 2 and 3 are invertible and a primitive cube root of unity
  exists, the roots of a cubic with nonzero Cardano parameter are exactly the
  three stated Cardano expressions. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q203565_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q203565_zero : K;
  q203565_one : K;
  q203565_add : K -> K -> K;
  q203565_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q203565_neg : K -> K;
  q203565_inv : K -> K;
  q203565_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q203565_add x (q203565_add y z) =
      q203565_add (q203565_add x y) z;
  q203565_add_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q203565_add x y = q203565_add y x;
  q203565_add_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q203565_add x q203565_zero = x;
  q203565_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q203565_add x (q203565_neg x) = q203565_zero;
  q203565_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q203565_mul x (q203565_mul y z) =
      q203565_mul (q203565_mul x y) z;
  q203565_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q203565_mul x y = q203565_mul y x;
  q203565_mul_one :
    forall x : K,
      q203565_mul x q203565_one = x;
  q203565_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q203565_mul x (q203565_add y z) =
      q203565_add
        (q203565_mul x y)
        (q203565_mul x z);
  q203565_inv_zero :
    q203565_inv q203565_zero = q203565_zero;
  q203565_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q203565_zero ->
      q203565_mul x (q203565_inv x) = q203565_one;
  q203565_nontrivial :
    q203565_zero <> q203565_one
}.

Arguments q203565_zero {K} _.
Arguments q203565_one {K} _.
Arguments q203565_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q203565_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q203565_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q203565_inv {K} _ _.

Definition q203565_sub
    {K : Type} (F : q203565_field K) (x y : K) : K :=
  q203565_add F x (q203565_neg F y).

Definition q203565_div
    {K : Type} (F : q203565_field K) (x y : K) : K :=
  q203565_mul F x (q203565_inv F y).

Fixpoint q203565_pow
    {K : Type} (F : q203565_field K) (x : K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q203565_one F
  | S m => q203565_mul F x (q203565_pow F x m)
  end.

Fixpoint q203565_of_nat
    {K : Type} (F : q203565_field K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q203565_zero F
  | S m => q203565_add F (q203565_of_nat F m) (q203565_one F)
  end.

Definition q203565_invertible
    {K : Type} (F : q203565_field K) (x : K) : Prop :=
  exists y : K,
    q203565_mul F x y = q203565_one F.

Definition q203565_is_primitive_root
    {K : Type} (F : q203565_field K) (omega : K) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q203565_pow F omega n = q203565_one F /\
  forall k : nat,
    q203565_pow F omega k = q203565_one F <->
    exists m : nat, k = n * m.

Module Theorems100.

Theorem cubic_eq_zero_iff :
  forall
    (K : Type)
    (F : q203565_field K)
    (a b c d omega p q r s t x : K),
    q203565_invertible F (q203565_of_nat F 2) ->
    q203565_invertible F (q203565_of_nat F 3) ->
    a <> q203565_zero F ->
    q203565_is_primitive_root F omega 3 ->
    p =
      q203565_div F
        (q203565_sub F
          (q203565_mul F
            (q203565_mul F (q203565_of_nat F 3) a) c)
          (q203565_pow F b 2))
        (q203565_mul F
          (q203565_of_nat F 9)
          (q203565_pow F a 2)) ->
    p <> q203565_zero F ->
    q =
      q203565_div F
        (q203565_sub F
          (q203565_sub F
            (q203565_mul F
              (q203565_mul F
                (q203565_mul F (q203565_of_nat F 9) a) b)
              c)
            (q203565_mul F
              (q203565_of_nat F 2)
              (q203565_pow F b 3)))
          (q203565_mul F
            (q203565_mul F
              (q203565_of_nat F 27)
              (q203565_pow F a 2))
            d))
        (q203565_mul F
          (q203565_of_nat F 54)
          (q203565_pow F a 3)) ->
    q203565_pow F r 2 =
      q203565_add F
        (q203565_pow F q 2)
        (q203565_pow F p 3) ->
    q203565_pow F s 3 = q203565_add F q r ->
    q203565_mul F t s = p ->
    (q203565_add F
      (q203565_add F
        (q203565_add F
          (q203565_mul F a (q203565_pow F x 3))
          (q203565_mul F b (q203565_pow F x 2)))
        (q203565_mul F c x))
      d = q203565_zero F
     <->
     x =
       q203565_sub F
         (q203565_sub F s t)
         (q203565_div F b
           (q203565_mul F (q203565_of_nat F 3) a))
     \/
     x =
       q203565_sub F
         (q203565_sub F
           (q203565_mul F s omega)
           (q203565_mul F t (q203565_pow F omega 2)))
         (q203565_div F b
           (q203565_mul F (q203565_of_nat F 3) a))
     \/
     x =
       q203565_sub F
         (q203565_sub F
           (q203565_mul F s (q203565_pow F omega 2))
           (q203565_mul F t omega))
         (q203565_div F b
           (q203565_mul F (q203565_of_nat F 3) a))).
Admitted.

End Theorems100.

(*

  Q203565 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q203565), "Solutions of a general
  cubic equation": Cardano data characterize the three roots of a cubic over
  a field in which 2 and 3 are invertible. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation
  imports Main
begin

definition q203565_is_primitive_cube_root :: "'a::field \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q203565_is_primitive_cube_root w \<longleftrightarrow>
    w ^ 3 = 1 \<and> (\<forall>n::nat. w ^ n = 1 \<longrightarrow> 3 dvd n)"

theorem q203565_cubic_eq_zero_iff:
  fixes a b c d omega p q r s t x :: "'a::field"
  assumes two_nonzero: "(2::'a) \<noteq> 0"
    and three_nonzero: "(3::'a) \<noteq> 0"
    and a_nonzero: "a \<noteq> 0"
    and omega_primitive: "q203565_is_primitive_cube_root omega"
    and p_def: "p = (3 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (9 * a ^ 2)"
    and p_nonzero: "p \<noteq> 0"
    and q_def:
      "q = (9 * a * b * c - 2 * b ^ 3 - 27 * a ^ 2 * d) / (54 * a ^ 3)"
    and r_square: "r ^ 2 = q ^ 2 + p ^ 3"
    and s_cube: "s ^ 3 = q + r"
    and ts_product: "t * s = p"
  shows "a * x ^ 3 + b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d = 0 \<longleftrightarrow>
    x = s - t - b / (3 * a) \<or>
    x = s * omega - t * omega ^ 2 - b / (3 * a) \<or>
    x = s * omega ^ 2 - t * omega - b / (3 * a)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q203565,
  "Solutions of a general cubic equation": over an arbitrary field in which
  2 and 3 are nonzero, a primitive cube root of unity and the stated auxiliary
  root data characterize exactly the three roots of a general cubic. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q203565_CUBIC_EQ_ZERO_IFF =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (neg:A->A) (invA:A->A).
       ~(zeroA = oneA) /\
       (!u. add zeroA u = u) /\
       (!u. add (neg u) u = zeroA) /\
       (!u v. add u v = add v u) /\
       (!u v w. add u (add v w) = add (add u v) w) /\
       (!u. mul oneA u = u) /\
       (!u v. mul u v = mul v u) /\
       (!u v w. mul u (mul v w) = mul (mul u v) w) /\
       (!u v w. mul u (add v w) =
                add (mul u v) (mul u w)) /\
       invA zeroA = zeroA /\
       (!u. ~(u = zeroA) ==> mul (invA u) u = oneA) in
   !zeroA oneA:A. !add mul:A->A->A. !neg invA:A->A.
   !a b c d omega p q r s t x:A.
     let power =
       \u:A. \n:num. ITLIST mul (REPLICATE n u) oneA in
     let sub =
       \u:A. \v:A. add u (neg v) in
     let divide =
       \u:A. \v:A. mul u (invA v) in
     let two = add oneA oneA in
     let three = add two oneA in
     let nine = mul three three in
     let twentyseven = mul nine three in
     let fiftyfour = mul two twentyseven in
     let is_primitive_cube_root =
       \u:A.
         power u 3 = oneA /\
         (!n:num. power u n = oneA ==> ?k:num. n = 3 * k) in
     is_field zeroA oneA add mul neg invA /\
     ~(two = zeroA) /\
     ~(three = zeroA) /\
     ~(a = zeroA) /\
     is_primitive_cube_root omega /\
     p =
       divide
         (sub (mul (mul three a) c) (power b 2))
         (mul nine (power a 2)) /\
     ~(p = zeroA) /\
     q =
       divide
         (sub
           (sub (mul (mul (mul nine a) b) c)
                (mul two (power b 3)))
           (mul (mul twentyseven (power a 2)) d))
         (mul fiftyfour (power a 3)) /\
     power r 2 = add (power q 2) (power p 3) /\
     power s 3 = add q r /\
     mul t s = p
     ==>
     (add
        (add
          (add (mul a (power x 3)) (mul b (power x 2)))
          (mul c x))
        d = zeroA
      <=>
      x = sub (sub s t) (divide b (mul three a)) \/
      x =
        sub
          (sub (mul s omega) (mul t (power omega 2)))
          (divide b (mul three a)) \/
      x =
        sub
          (sub (mul s (power omega 2)) (mul t omega))
          (divide b (mul three a)))`;;

title: Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q203565,
;; "Solutions of a general cubic equation": Cardano's characterization of the
;; roots of a cubic over an arbitrary field with invertible 2 and 3 and a
;; primitive cube root of unity. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative function symbols present an arbitrary, potentially infinite
;; field indexed by FIELD. The declarations supply no laws; every field axiom
;; used by the source statement is explicit in Q203565-FIELD-P.

(defstub q203565-element-p (field value) t)
(defstub q203565-zero (field) t)
(defstub q203565-one (field) t)
(defstub q203565-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q203565-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q203565-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q203565-inverse (field value) t)

(defun-sk q203565-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q203565-element-p field x)
      (q203565-element-p field y)
      (q203565-element-p field z))
     (let* ((zero (q203565-zero field))
            (one (q203565-one field))
            (x-plus-y (q203565-add field x y))
            (y-plus-z (q203565-add field y z))
            (x-times-y (q203565-multiply field x y))
            (y-times-z (q203565-multiply field y z))
            (negative-x (q203565-negate field x))
            (inverse-x (q203565-inverse field x)))
       (and
        (q203565-element-p field x-plus-y)
        (q203565-element-p field x-times-y)
        (q203565-element-p field negative-x)
        (q203565-element-p field inverse-x)
        (equal
         (q203565-add field x-plus-y z)
         (q203565-add field x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (q203565-add field y x))
        (equal (q203565-add field x zero) x)
        (equal (q203565-add field x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q203565-multiply field x-times-y z)
         (q203565-multiply field x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (q203565-multiply field y x))
        (equal (q203565-multiply field x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q203565-multiply field x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q203565-multiply field x y-plus-z)
         (q203565-add
          field
          (q203565-multiply field x y)
          (q203565-multiply field x z))))))))

(defun q203565-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q203565-element-p field (q203565-zero field))
   (q203565-element-p field (q203565-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (q203565-zero field)
     (q203565-one field)))
   (q203565-field-laws-p field)))

(defun q203565-subtract (field left right)
  (q203565-add
   field
   left
   (q203565-negate field right)))

(defun q203565-divide (field numerator denominator)
  (q203565-multiply
   field
   numerator
   (q203565-inverse field denominator)))

(defun q203565-nat (field number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix number)))
  (if (zp number)
      (q203565-zero field)
    (q203565-add
     field
     (q203565-one field)
     (q203565-nat field (- number 1)))))

(defun q203565-power (field base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q203565-one field)
    (q203565-multiply
     field
     base
     (q203565-power field base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun q203565-primitive-cube-root-p (field omega)
  (and
   (equal
    (q203565-power field omega 3)
    (q203565-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     omega
     (q203565-one field)))
   (not
    (equal
     (q203565-power field omega 2)
     (q203565-one field)))))

(defun q203565-p-value (field a b c)
  (let* ((three (q203565-nat field 3))
         (nine (q203565-nat field 9))
         (three-a-c
          (q203565-multiply
           field
           (q203565-multiply field three a)
           c))
         (b-squared (q203565-power field b 2))
         (numerator
          (q203565-subtract field three-a-c b-squared))
         (denominator
          (q203565-multiply
           field
           nine
           (q203565-power field a 2))))
    (q203565-divide field numerator denominator)))

(defun q203565-q-value (field a b c d)
  (let* ((two (q203565-nat field 2))
         (nine (q203565-nat field 9))
         (twenty-seven (q203565-nat field 27))
         (fifty-four (q203565-nat field 54))
         (term-one
          (q203565-multiply
           field
           (q203565-multiply
            field
            (q203565-multiply field nine a)
            b)
           c))
         (term-two
          (q203565-multiply
           field
           two
           (q203565-power field b 3)))
         (term-three
          (q203565-multiply
           field
           (q203565-multiply
            field
            twenty-seven
            (q203565-power field a 2))
           d))
         (numerator
          (q203565-subtract
           field
           (q203565-subtract field term-one term-two)
           term-three))
         (denominator
          (q203565-multiply
           field
           fifty-four
           (q203565-power field a 3))))
    (q203565-divide field numerator denominator)))

(defun q203565-cubic-value (field a b c d x)
  (q203565-add
   field
   (q203565-add
    field
    (q203565-add
     field
     (q203565-multiply
      field a (q203565-power field x 3))
     (q203565-multiply
      field b (q203565-power field x 2)))
    (q203565-multiply field c x))
   d))

(defun q203565-root-shift (field a b)
  (q203565-divide
   field
   b
   (q203565-multiply
    field
    (q203565-nat field 3)
    a)))

(defun q203565-first-root (field a b s tm)
  (q203565-subtract
   field
   (q203565-subtract field s tm)
   (q203565-root-shift field a b)))

(defun q203565-second-root (field a b omega s tm)
  (q203565-subtract
   field
   (q203565-subtract
    field
    (q203565-multiply field s omega)
    (q203565-multiply
     field
     tm
     (q203565-power field omega 2)))
   (q203565-root-shift field a b)))

(defun q203565-third-root (field a b omega s tm)
  (q203565-subtract
   field
   (q203565-subtract
    field
    (q203565-multiply
     field
     s
     (q203565-power field omega 2))
    (q203565-multiply field tm omega))
   (q203565-root-shift field a b)))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q203565-solutions-of-a-general-cubic-equation-statement
    ()
  (forall (field a b c d omega p q r s tm x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q203565-field-p field)
      (q203565-element-p field a)
      (q203565-element-p field b)
      (q203565-element-p field c)
      (q203565-element-p field d)
      (q203565-element-p field omega)
      (q203565-element-p field p)
      (q203565-element-p field q)
      (q203565-element-p field r)
      (q203565-element-p field s)
      (q203565-element-p field tm)
      (q203565-element-p field x)
      (not
       (equal
        (q203565-nat field 2)
        (q203565-zero field)))
      (not
       (equal
        (q203565-nat field 3)
        (q203565-zero field)))
      (not
       (equal
        a
        (q203565-zero field)))
      (q203565-primitive-cube-root-p field omega)
      (equal p (q203565-p-value field a b c))
      (not
       (equal
        p
        (q203565-zero field)))
      (equal q (q203565-q-value field a b c d))
      (equal
       (q203565-power field r 2)
       (q203565-add
        field
        (q203565-power field q 2)
        (q203565-power field p 3)))
      (equal
       (q203565-power field s 3)
       (q203565-add field q r))
      (equal
       (q203565-multiply field tm s)
       p))
     (iff
      (equal
       (q203565-cubic-value field a b c d x)
       (q203565-zero field))
      (or
       (equal
        x
        (q203565-first-root field a b s tm))
       (equal
        x
        (q203565-second-root field a b omega s tm))
       (equal
        x
        (q203565-third-root field a b omega s tm)))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q203565,
-- "Solutions of a general cubic equation": Cardano's three-root characterization
-- over a field of characteristic neither two nor three. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _iff_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : P -> P or Q
  right : Q -> P or Q

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : P -> Q
    backward : Q -> P

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroF oneF : K
    addF multiplyF : K -> K -> K
    negateF inverseF : K -> K

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addF x y == addF y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addF (addF x y) z == addF x (addF y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addF x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addF x (negateF x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyF x y == multiplyF y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyF (multiplyF x y) z ==
      multiplyF x (multiplyF y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyF x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyF x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyF x (addF y z) ==
      addF (multiplyF x y) (multiplyF x z)

    inverse-zero :
      inverseF zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiplyF x (inverseF x) == oneF

open Field

subtractF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
subtractF fieldStructure x y =
  addF fieldStructure x (negateF fieldStructure y)

divideF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
divideF fieldStructure x y =
  multiplyF fieldStructure x (inverseF fieldStructure y)

fromNatF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  Nat ->
  K
fromNatF fieldStructure zero =
  zeroF fieldStructure
fromNatF fieldStructure (suc n) =
  addF fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure n) (oneF fieldStructure)

powerF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  Nat ->
  K
powerF fieldStructure x zero =
  oneF fieldStructure
powerF fieldStructure x (suc n) =
  multiplyF fieldStructure (powerF fieldStructure x n) x

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

nineN : Nat
nineN =
  threeN * threeN

twentySevenN : Nat
twentySevenN =
  threeN * nineN

fiftyFourN : Nat
fiftyFourN =
  twoN * twentySevenN

record Invertible
  {a : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  (fieldStructure : Field K)
  (x : K) :
  Set a where

  field
    inverse-value : K
    inverse-times-value :
      multiplyF fieldStructure inverse-value x == oneF fieldStructure

record PrimitiveCubeRoot
  {a : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  (fieldStructure : Field K)
  (omega : K) :
  Set a where

  field
    omega-cubed-is-one :
      powerF fieldStructure omega threeN == oneF fieldStructure
    omega-is-not-one :
      omega != oneF fieldStructure

cubicPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
cubicPolynomial fieldStructure a b c d x =
  addF fieldStructure
    (addF fieldStructure
      (addF fieldStructure
        (multiplyF fieldStructure a (powerF fieldStructure x threeN))
        (multiplyF fieldStructure b (powerF fieldStructure x twoN)))
      (multiplyF fieldStructure c x))
    d

pValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
pValue fieldStructure a b c =
  divideF fieldStructure
    (subtractF fieldStructure
      (multiplyF fieldStructure
        (multiplyF fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure threeN) a)
        c)
      (powerF fieldStructure b twoN))
    (multiplyF fieldStructure
      (fromNatF fieldStructure nineN)
      (powerF fieldStructure a twoN))

qValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
qValue fieldStructure a b c d =
  divideF fieldStructure
    (subtractF fieldStructure
      (subtractF fieldStructure
        (multiplyF fieldStructure
          (multiplyF fieldStructure
            (multiplyF fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure nineN) a)
            b)
          c)
        (multiplyF fieldStructure
          (fromNatF fieldStructure twoN)
          (powerF fieldStructure b threeN)))
      (multiplyF fieldStructure
        (multiplyF fieldStructure
          (fromNatF fieldStructure twentySevenN)
          (powerF fieldStructure a twoN))
        d))
    (multiplyF fieldStructure
      (fromNatF fieldStructure fiftyFourN)
      (powerF fieldStructure a threeN))

rootShift :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
rootShift fieldStructure a b =
  divideF fieldStructure b
    (multiplyF fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure threeN) a)

solutions-of-a-general-cubic-equation :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
solutions-of-a-general-cubic-equation a =
  (K : Set a) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  (two-invertible :
    Invertible fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure twoN)) ->
  (three-invertible :
    Invertible fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure threeN)) ->
  (a b c d omega p q r s t x : K) ->
  a != zeroF fieldStructure ->
  PrimitiveCubeRoot fieldStructure omega ->
  p == pValue fieldStructure a b c ->
  p != zeroF fieldStructure ->
  q == qValue fieldStructure a b c d ->
  powerF fieldStructure r twoN ==
    addF fieldStructure
      (powerF fieldStructure q twoN)
      (powerF fieldStructure p threeN) ->
  powerF fieldStructure s threeN ==
    addF fieldStructure q r ->
  multiplyF fieldStructure t s == p ->
  (cubicPolynomial fieldStructure a b c d x == zeroF fieldStructure)
  iff
  ((x ==
      subtractF fieldStructure
        (subtractF fieldStructure s t)
        (rootShift fieldStructure a b))
    or
    (x ==
      subtractF fieldStructure
        (subtractF fieldStructure
          (multiplyF fieldStructure s omega)
          (multiplyF fieldStructure t (powerF fieldStructure omega twoN)))
        (rootShift fieldStructure a b))
    or
    (x ==
      subtractF fieldStructure
        (subtractF fieldStructure
          (multiplyF fieldStructure s (powerF fieldStructure omega twoN))
          (multiplyF fieldStructure t omega))
        (rootShift fieldStructure a b)))

title: Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q203565, "Solutions of a general cubic equation": Cardano's three-root
  characterization over an arbitrary field in which 2 and 3 are invertible,
  with a primitive cube root of unity and the specified auxiliary roots. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory;

val q203565_field_def = new_definition (
  "q203565_field_def",
  ``q203565_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zeroK x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zeroK) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneK x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!x. x <> zeroK ==> mul (invK x) x = oneK)``);

val q203565_numeral_def = new_definition (
  "q203565_numeral_def",
  ``q203565_numeral
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (add oneK) n zeroK``);

val q203565_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q203565_pow_def",
  ``q203565_pow
      (oneK : 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (x : 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (mul x) n oneK``);

val q203565_sub_def = new_definition (
  "q203565_sub_def",
  ``q203565_sub
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (neg : 'k -> 'k) (x : 'k) y =
      add x (neg y)``);

val q203565_div_def = new_definition (
  "q203565_div_def",
  ``q203565_div
      (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) (x : 'k) y =
      mul x (invK y)``);

val q203565_primitive_cube_root_def = new_definition (
  "q203565_primitive_cube_root_def",
  ``q203565_primitive_cube_root
      (oneK : 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (omega : 'k) <=>
      q203565_pow oneK mul omega 3 = oneK /\
      !m : num.
        0 < m /\ m < 3 ==> q203565_pow oneK mul omega m <> oneK``);

val Theorems100_cubic_eq_zero_iff =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) oneK
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (a : 'k) b c d omega p q r s t x.
      q203565_field zeroK oneK add mul neg invK /\
      q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 2 <> zeroK /\
      q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 3 <> zeroK /\
      a <> zeroK /\
      q203565_primitive_cube_root oneK mul omega /\
      p =
        q203565_div mul invK
          (q203565_sub add neg
            (mul (mul (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 3) a) c)
            (q203565_pow oneK mul b 2))
          (mul
            (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 9)
            (q203565_pow oneK mul a 2)) /\
      p <> zeroK /\
      q =
        q203565_div mul invK
          (q203565_sub add neg
            (q203565_sub add neg
              (mul
                (mul
                  (mul (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 9) a)
                  b)
                c)
              (mul
                (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 2)
                (q203565_pow oneK mul b 3)))
            (mul
              (mul
                (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 27)
                (q203565_pow oneK mul a 2))
              d))
          (mul
            (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 54)
            (q203565_pow oneK mul a 3)) /\
      q203565_pow oneK mul r 2 =
        add
          (q203565_pow oneK mul q 2)
          (q203565_pow oneK mul p 3) /\
      q203565_pow oneK mul s 3 = add q r /\
      mul t s = p
      ==>
      (add
        (add
          (add
            (mul a (q203565_pow oneK mul x 3))
            (mul b (q203565_pow oneK mul x 2)))
          (mul c x))
        d = zeroK
      <=>
      x =
        q203565_sub add neg
          (q203565_sub add neg s t)
          (q203565_div mul invK b
            (mul (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 3) a)) \/
      x =
        q203565_sub add neg
          (q203565_sub add neg
            (mul s omega)
            (mul t (q203565_pow oneK mul omega 2)))
          (q203565_div mul invK b
            (mul (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 3) a)) \/
      x =
        q203565_sub add neg
          (q203565_sub add neg
            (mul s (q203565_pow oneK mul omega 2))
            (mul t omega))
          (q203565_div mul invK b
            (mul (q203565_numeral zeroK oneK add 3) a)))``;

title: Q203565_solutions_of_a_general_cubic_equation
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q203565
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q203565), "Solutions of a general cubic
  equation": Cardano's characterization of the three roots of a cubic over an
  arbitrary field in which 2 and 3 are invertible. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K ranges over bundled SetMM fields and all lowercase variables range over
  Base ` K. Q203565Nat is the natural-number cast N |-> N * 1 in K;
  Q203565Pow is the natural power in the multiplicative monoid of K. The
  remaining abbreviations are exactly the field operations.

  Nonvanishing of Q203565Nat K 2 and Q203565Nat K 3 is equivalent to the
  source assumptions Invertible (2 : K) and Invertible (3 : K). For a cube
  root of unity in a field, w ^ 3 = 1 together with w =/= 1 is equivalent to
  IsPrimitiveRoot w 3. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement; there is no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q203565Add Q203565Mul Q203565Neg Q203565Sub Q203565Div $.
$c Q203565Nat Q203565Pow $.

:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems artifact Q203565
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q203565), "Solutions of a general cubic
:: equation": Cardano's root characterization over a field with invertible
:: two and three, a primitive cube root of unity, and radical witnesses.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, CARD_1, FUNCT_1, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0, ARYTM_3,

    DOMAIN_1, BINOP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, NEWTON;
  registrations STRUCT_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, RELAT_1, VECTSP_1,
    INT_3, SUBSET_1, XBOOLE_0, NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities ALGSTR_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      a,b,c,d,p,q,r,s,t,w,x being Element of K st
    1.K + 1.K <> 0.K &
    1.K + 1.K + 1.K <> 0.K &
    a <> 0.K &
    w * w * w = 1.K &
    w <> 1.K &
    p = ((1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * a * c - b * b) /
      ((1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (a * a)) &
    p <> 0.K &
    q = ((1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * a * b * c -
      (1.K + 1.K) * (b * b * b) -
      (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (a * a) * d) /
      ((1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (a * a * a)) &
    r * r = q * q + p * p * p &
    s * s * s = q + r &
    t * s = p
