Inductive q208416_term (variables : nat) : Type :=
| q208416_var : Fin.t variables -> q208416_term variables
| q208416_empty : q208416_term variables
| q208416_pair :
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_term variables
| q208416_omega : q208416_term variables
| q208416_powerset :
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_term variables
| q208416_union :
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_term variables.

Arguments q208416_var {variables} _.
Arguments q208416_empty {variables}.
Arguments q208416_pair {variables} _ _.
Arguments q208416_omega {variables}.
Arguments q208416_powerset {variables} _.
Arguments q208416_union {variables} _.

Inductive q208416_formula (variables : nat) : Type :=
| q208416_falsum : q208416_formula variables
| q208416_equal :
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_formula variables
| q208416_member :
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_term variables ->
    q208416_formula variables
| q208416_implies :
    q208416_formula variables ->
    q208416_formula variables ->
    q208416_formula variables
| q208416_forall :
    q208416_formula (S variables) ->
    q208416_formula variables.

Arguments q208416_falsum {variables}.
Arguments q208416_equal {variables} _ _.
Arguments q208416_member {variables} _ _.
Arguments q208416_implies {variables} _ _.
Arguments q208416_forall {variables} _.

Fixpoint q208416_term_map
    {n m : nat}
    (rho : Fin.t n -> Fin.t m)
    (t : q208416_term n) : q208416_term m :=
  match t with
  | q208416_var i => q208416_var (rho i)
  | q208416_empty => q208416_empty
  | q208416_pair x y =>
      q208416_pair
        (q208416_term_map rho x)
        (q208416_term_map rho y)
  | q208416_omega => q208416_omega
  | q208416_powerset x =>
      q208416_powerset (q208416_term_map rho x)
  | q208416_union x =>
      q208416_union (q208416_term_map rho x)
  end.

Definition q208416_lift_substitution
    {n m : nat}
    (sigma : Fin.t n -> q208416_term m)
    (i : Fin.t (S n)) : q208416_term (S m) :=
  Fin.caseS' i
    (fun _ => q208416_term (S m))
    (q208416_var Fin.F1)
    (fun j =>
       q208416_term_map Fin.FS (sigma j)).

Fixpoint q208416_term_substitute
    {n m : nat}
    (sigma : Fin.t n -> q208416_term m)
    (t : q208416_term n) : q208416_term m :=
  match t with
  | q208416_var i => sigma i
  | q208416_empty => q208416_empty
  | q208416_pair x y =>
      q208416_pair
        (q208416_term_substitute sigma x)
        (q208416_term_substitute sigma y)
  | q208416_omega => q208416_omega
  | q208416_powerset x =>
      q208416_powerset (q208416_term_substitute sigma x)
  | q208416_union x =>
      q208416_union (q208416_term_substitute sigma x)
  end.

Fixpoint q208416_formula_substitute
    {n m : nat}
    (sigma : Fin.t n -> q208416_term m)
    (phi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula m :=
  match phi with
  | q208416_falsum => q208416_falsum
  | q208416_equal x y =>
      q208416_equal
        (q208416_term_substitute sigma x)
        (q208416_term_substitute sigma y)
  | q208416_member x y =>
      q208416_member
        (q208416_term_substitute sigma x)
        (q208416_term_substitute sigma y)
  | q208416_implies psi chi =>
      q208416_implies
        (q208416_formula_substitute sigma psi)
        (q208416_formula_substitute sigma chi)
  | q208416_forall psi =>
      q208416_forall
        (q208416_formula_substitute
           (q208416_lift_substitution sigma) psi)
  end.

Definition q208416_formula_map
    {n m : nat}
    (rho : Fin.t n -> Fin.t m)
    (phi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula m :=
  q208416_formula_substitute
    (fun i => q208416_var (rho i)) phi.

Definition q208416_weaken_term
    {n : nat}
    (t : q208416_term n) : q208416_term (S n) :=
  q208416_term_map Fin.FS t.

Definition q208416_weaken_formula
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula (S n) :=
  q208416_formula_map Fin.FS phi.

Definition q208416_substitute_zero_map
    {n : nat}
    (t : q208416_term n)
    (i : Fin.t (S n)) : q208416_term n :=
  Fin.caseS' i
    (fun _ => q208416_term n)
    t
    (fun j => q208416_var j).

Definition q208416_substitute_zero
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S n))
    (t : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_formula_substitute
    (q208416_substitute_zero_map t) phi.

Definition q208416_not
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_implies phi q208416_falsum.

Definition q208416_and
    {n : nat}
    (phi psi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_not (q208416_implies phi (q208416_not psi)).

Definition q208416_or
    {n : nat}
    (phi psi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_implies (q208416_not phi) psi.

Definition q208416_iff
    {n : nat}
    (phi psi : q208416_formula n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_and
    (q208416_implies phi psi)
    (q208416_implies psi phi).

Definition q208416_exists
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S n)) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_not (q208416_forall (q208416_not phi)).

Definition q208416_v0 {n : nat} : q208416_term (S n) :=
  q208416_var Fin.F1.

Definition q208416_v1 {n : nat} : q208416_term (S (S n)) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS Fin.F1).

Definition q208416_v2 {n : nat} : q208416_term (S (S (S n))) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS (Fin.FS Fin.F1)).

Definition q208416_v3 {n : nat} :
    q208416_term (S (S (S (S n)))) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS (Fin.FS (Fin.FS Fin.F1))).

Definition q208416_shift1
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n) : q208416_term (S n) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS i).

Definition q208416_shift2
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n) : q208416_term (S (S n)) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS (Fin.FS i)).

Definition q208416_shift3
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n) : q208416_term (S (S (S n))) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS (Fin.FS (Fin.FS i))).

Definition q208416_shift4
    {n : nat}
    (i : Fin.t n) : q208416_term (S (S (S (S n)))) :=
  q208416_var (Fin.FS (Fin.FS (Fin.FS (Fin.FS i)))).

Definition q208416_subset
    {n : nat}
    (x y : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term x))
       (q208416_member q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term y))).

Definition q208416_is_transitive
    {n : nat}
    (z : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term z))
       (q208416_subset q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term z))).

Definition q208416_epsilon_trichotomy
    {n : nat}
    (z : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term z))
       (q208416_forall
          (q208416_implies
             (q208416_member q208416_v0
                (q208416_weaken_term
                   (q208416_weaken_term z)))
             (q208416_or
                (q208416_equal q208416_v1 q208416_v0)
                (q208416_or
                   (q208416_member q208416_v1 q208416_v0)
                   (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)))))).

Definition q208416_epsilon_well_founded
    {n : nat}
    (z : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_subset q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term z))
       (q208416_implies
          (q208416_not
             (q208416_equal q208416_v0 q208416_empty))
          (q208416_exists
             (q208416_and
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
                (q208416_forall
                   (q208416_implies
                      (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
                      (q208416_not
                         (q208416_member
                            q208416_v0 q208416_v1)))))))).

Definition q208416_is_ordinal
    {n : nat}
    (z : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_and
    (q208416_and
       (q208416_epsilon_trichotomy z)
       (q208416_epsilon_well_founded z))
    (q208416_is_transitive z).

Definition q208416_is_limit
    {n : nat}
    (z : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_and
    (q208416_member q208416_empty z)
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_implies
          (q208416_member q208416_v0
             (q208416_weaken_term z))
          (q208416_exists
             (q208416_and
                (q208416_member q208416_v0
                   (q208416_weaken_term
                      (q208416_weaken_term z)))
                (q208416_member q208416_v1 q208416_v0))))).

Definition q208416_axiom_emptyset : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_not
       (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_empty)).

Definition q208416_axiom_ordered_pairs : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_forall
          (q208416_forall
             (q208416_iff
                (q208416_equal
                   (q208416_pair q208416_v3 q208416_v2)
                   (q208416_pair q208416_v1 q208416_v0))
                (q208416_and
                   (q208416_equal q208416_v3 q208416_v1)
                   (q208416_equal q208416_v2 q208416_v0)))))).

Definition q208416_axiom_extensionality : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_implies
          (q208416_forall
             (q208416_iff
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)))
          (q208416_equal q208416_v1 q208416_v0))).

Definition q208416_axiom_union : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_iff
          (q208416_member q208416_v0
             (q208416_union q208416_v1))
          (q208416_exists
             (q208416_and
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
                (q208416_member q208416_v1 q208416_v0))))).

Definition q208416_axiom_powerset : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_iff
          (q208416_member q208416_v0
             (q208416_powerset q208416_v1))
          (q208416_forall
             (q208416_implies
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2))))).

Definition q208416_axiom_infinity : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_and
    (q208416_is_limit q208416_omega)
    (q208416_and
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_is_ordinal q208416_v0)
             (q208416_equal
                (q208416_weaken_term q208416_omega)
                q208416_v0)))
       (q208416_forall
          (q208416_implies
             (q208416_is_ordinal q208416_v0)
             (q208416_implies
                (q208416_is_limit q208416_v0)
                (q208416_subset
                   (q208416_weaken_term q208416_omega)
                   q208416_v0))))).

Definition q208416_axiom_regularity : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_not
          (q208416_equal q208416_v0 q208416_empty))
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
             (q208416_forall
                (q208416_implies
                   (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
                   (q208416_not
                      (q208416_member
                         q208416_v0 q208416_v1))))))).

Definition q208416_is_chain
    {n : nat}
    (y z : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_and
    (q208416_subset y z)
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_forall
          (q208416_implies
             (q208416_and
                (q208416_member q208416_v1
                   (q208416_weaken_term
                      (q208416_weaken_term y)))
                (q208416_member q208416_v0
                   (q208416_weaken_term
                      (q208416_weaken_term y))))
             (q208416_or
                (q208416_subset q208416_v1 q208416_v0)
                (q208416_subset q208416_v0 q208416_v1))))).

Definition q208416_zorns_lemma : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_not
          (q208416_equal q208416_v0 q208416_empty))
       (q208416_implies
          (q208416_forall
             (q208416_implies
                (q208416_is_chain q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
                (q208416_member
                   (q208416_union q208416_v0)
                   q208416_v1)))
          (q208416_exists
             (q208416_and
                (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
                (q208416_forall
                   (q208416_implies
                      (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
                      (q208416_implies
                         (q208416_subset
                            q208416_v1 q208416_v0)
                         (q208416_equal
                            q208416_v1 q208416_v0)))))))).

Definition q208416_instantiate2
    {n m : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S (S n)))
    (y x : q208416_term m)
    (parameters : Fin.t n -> q208416_term m) :
    q208416_formula m :=
  q208416_formula_substitute
    (fun i =>
       Fin.caseS' i
         (fun _ => q208416_term m)
         y
         (fun j =>
            Fin.caseS' j
              (fun _ => q208416_term m)
              x
              parameters)) phi.

Definition q208416_collection_antecedent
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S (S n))) :
    q208416_formula (S n) :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_instantiate2
             phi q208416_v0 q208416_v1
             q208416_shift3))).

Definition q208416_collection_forward
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S (S n))) :
    q208416_formula (S (S n)) :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v2)
             (q208416_instantiate2
                phi q208416_v0 q208416_v1
                q208416_shift4)))).

Definition q208416_collection_backward
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S (S n))) :
    q208416_formula (S (S n)) :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_member q208416_v0 q208416_v3)
             (q208416_instantiate2
                phi q208416_v1 q208416_v0
                q208416_shift4)))).

Fixpoint q208416_close_all
    (n : nat) : q208416_formula n -> q208416_formula 0 :=
  match n as k return q208416_formula k -> q208416_formula 0 with
  | 0 => fun phi => phi
  | S k =>
      fun phi => @q208416_close_all k (q208416_forall phi)
  end.

Definition q208416_axiom_collection
    {n : nat}
    (phi : q208416_formula (S (S n))) : q208416_formula 0 :=
  @q208416_close_all n
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_implies
          (q208416_collection_antecedent phi)
          (q208416_exists
             (q208416_and
                (q208416_collection_forward phi)
                (q208416_collection_backward phi))))).

Definition q208416_ZFC
    (sentence : q208416_formula 0) : Prop :=
  sentence = q208416_axiom_emptyset \/
  sentence = q208416_axiom_ordered_pairs \/
  sentence = q208416_axiom_extensionality \/
  sentence = q208416_axiom_union \/
  sentence = q208416_axiom_powerset \/
  sentence = q208416_axiom_infinity \/
  sentence = q208416_axiom_regularity \/
  sentence = q208416_zorns_lemma \/
  exists (n : nat) (phi : q208416_formula (S (S n))),
    sentence = q208416_axiom_collection phi.

Definition q208416_is_functional
    {n : nat}
    (f : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_forall
       (q208416_forall
          (q208416_forall
             (q208416_implies
                (q208416_and
                   (q208416_member
                      (q208416_pair q208416_v3 q208416_v1)
                      (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift4 f))
                   (q208416_member
                      (q208416_pair q208416_v2 q208416_v0)
                      (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift4 f)))
                (q208416_implies
                   (q208416_equal q208416_v3 q208416_v2)
                   (q208416_equal q208416_v1 q208416_v0)))))).

Definition q208416_is_total
    {n : nat}
    (f domain codomain : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term domain))
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_member q208416_v0
                (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 codomain))
             (q208416_member
                (q208416_pair q208416_v1 q208416_v0)
                (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 f))))).

Definition q208416_is_surjective
    {n : nat}
    (f domain codomain : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_member q208416_v0
          (q208416_weaken_term codomain))
       (q208416_exists
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_member q208416_v0
                (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 domain))
             (q208416_member
                (q208416_pair q208416_v0 q208416_v1)
                (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 f))))).

Definition q208416_is_function_from_to
    {n : nat}
    (f domain codomain : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_and
    (q208416_is_functional f)
    (q208416_is_total f domain codomain).

Definition q208416_at_most
    {n : nat}
    (x y : q208416_term n) : q208416_formula n :=
  q208416_exists
    (q208416_exists
       (q208416_and
          (q208416_and
             (q208416_subset q208416_v1
                (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 y))
             (q208416_is_function_from_to
                q208416_v0 q208416_v1
                (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 x)))
          (q208416_is_surjective
             q208416_v0 q208416_v1
             (q208416_term_substitute q208416_shift2 x)))).

Definition q208416_CH : q208416_formula 0 :=
  q208416_forall
    (q208416_implies
       (q208416_is_ordinal q208416_v0)
       (q208416_or
          (q208416_at_most
             q208416_v0 q208416_omega)
          (q208416_at_most
             (q208416_powerset q208416_omega)
             q208416_v0))).

Unset Implicit Arguments.

Inductive q208416_derivation :
    forall n : nat,
      (q208416_formula n -> Prop) ->
      q208416_formula n ->
      Type :=
| q208416_prf_axiom :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (A : q208416_formula n),
      Gamma A ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma A
| q208416_prf_implies_intro :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (A B : q208416_formula n),
      q208416_derivation n
        (fun C => C = A \/ Gamma C) B ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_implies A B)
| q208416_prf_implies_elim :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (A B : q208416_formula n),
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_implies A B) ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma A ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma B
| q208416_prf_classical_absurd :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (A : q208416_formula n),
      q208416_derivation n
        (fun C => C = q208416_not A \/ Gamma C)
        q208416_falsum ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma A
| q208416_prf_forall_intro :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (A : q208416_formula (S n)),
      q208416_derivation (S n)
        (fun B =>
           exists C : q208416_formula n,
             Gamma C /\ B = q208416_weaken_formula C)
        A ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_forall A)
| q208416_prf_forall_elim :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (A : q208416_formula (S n))
      (t : q208416_term n),
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_forall A) ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_substitute_zero A t)
| q208416_prf_reflexivity :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (t : q208416_term n),
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_equal t t)
| q208416_prf_equality_substitution :
    forall (n : nat)
      (Gamma : q208416_formula n -> Prop)
      (s t : q208416_term n)
      (phi : q208416_formula (S n)),
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_equal s t) ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_substitute_zero phi s) ->
      q208416_derivation n Gamma
        (q208416_substitute_zero phi t).

Definition q208416_provable
    (T : q208416_formula 0 -> Prop)
    (phi : q208416_formula 0) : Prop :=
  inhabited (q208416_derivation 0 T phi).

Definition q208416_independent
    (T : q208416_formula 0 -> Prop)
    (phi : q208416_formula 0) : Prop :=
  ~ q208416_provable T phi /\
  ~ q208416_provable T (q208416_not phi).

Theorem independence_of_CH :
  q208416_independent q208416_ZFC q208416_CH.
Admitted.

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q208416
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q208416), "Independence of the continuum
  hypothesis": the Flypitch first-order sentence expressing CH and its
  negation are both unprovable from its formulation of ZFC. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
  imports Main
begin

datatype q208416_term =
    Q208416_Var nat
  | Q208416_Empty
  | Q208416_Pair q208416_term q208416_term
  | Q208416_Omega
  | Q208416_Powerset q208416_term
  | Q208416_Union q208416_term

datatype q208416_formula =
    Q208416_False
  | Q208416_Eq q208416_term q208416_term
  | Q208416_Mem q208416_term q208416_term
  | Q208416_Imp q208416_formula q208416_formula
  | Q208416_All q208416_formula

definition q208416_not :: "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_not A = Q208416_Imp A Q208416_False"

definition q208416_and ::
    "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_and A B =
    q208416_not (Q208416_Imp A (q208416_not B))"

definition q208416_or ::
    "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_or A B = Q208416_Imp (q208416_not A) B"

definition q208416_iff ::
    "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_iff A B =
    q208416_and (Q208416_Imp A B) (Q208416_Imp B A)"

definition q208416_ex :: "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_ex A = q208416_not (Q208416_All (q208416_not A))"

primrec q208416_lift_term_at ::
    "q208416_term \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_term" where
  "q208416_lift_term_at (Q208416_Var k) n m =
    Q208416_Var (if m \<le> k then k + n else k)"
| "q208416_lift_term_at Q208416_Empty n m = Q208416_Empty"
| "q208416_lift_term_at (Q208416_Pair s t) n m =
    Q208416_Pair
      (q208416_lift_term_at s n m)
      (q208416_lift_term_at t n m)"
| "q208416_lift_term_at Q208416_Omega n m = Q208416_Omega"
| "q208416_lift_term_at (Q208416_Powerset t) n m =
    Q208416_Powerset (q208416_lift_term_at t n m)"
| "q208416_lift_term_at (Q208416_Union t) n m =
    Q208416_Union (q208416_lift_term_at t n m)"

primrec q208416_subst_term ::
    "q208416_term \<Rightarrow> q208416_term \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_term" where
  "q208416_subst_term (Q208416_Var k) s n =
    (if k < n then Q208416_Var k
     else if k = n then q208416_lift_term_at s n 0
     else Q208416_Var (k - 1))"
| "q208416_subst_term Q208416_Empty s n = Q208416_Empty"
| "q208416_subst_term (Q208416_Pair t u) s n =
    Q208416_Pair
      (q208416_subst_term t s n)
      (q208416_subst_term u s n)"
| "q208416_subst_term Q208416_Omega s n = Q208416_Omega"
| "q208416_subst_term (Q208416_Powerset t) s n =
    Q208416_Powerset (q208416_subst_term t s n)"
| "q208416_subst_term (Q208416_Union t) s n =
    Q208416_Union (q208416_subst_term t s n)"

primrec q208416_lift_formula_at ::
    "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_lift_formula_at Q208416_False n m = Q208416_False"
| "q208416_lift_formula_at (Q208416_Eq s t) n m =
    Q208416_Eq
      (q208416_lift_term_at s n m)
      (q208416_lift_term_at t n m)"
| "q208416_lift_formula_at (Q208416_Mem s t) n m =
    Q208416_Mem
      (q208416_lift_term_at s n m)
      (q208416_lift_term_at t n m)"
| "q208416_lift_formula_at (Q208416_Imp A B) n m =
    Q208416_Imp
      (q208416_lift_formula_at A n m)
      (q208416_lift_formula_at B n m)"
| "q208416_lift_formula_at (Q208416_All A) n m =
    Q208416_All (q208416_lift_formula_at A n (Suc m))"

primrec q208416_subst_formula ::
    "q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_term \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_subst_formula Q208416_False s n = Q208416_False"
| "q208416_subst_formula (Q208416_Eq t u) s n =
    Q208416_Eq
      (q208416_subst_term t s n)
      (q208416_subst_term u s n)"
| "q208416_subst_formula (Q208416_Mem t u) s n =
    Q208416_Mem
      (q208416_subst_term t s n)
      (q208416_subst_term u s n)"
| "q208416_subst_formula (Q208416_Imp A B) s n =
    Q208416_Imp
      (q208416_subst_formula A s n)
      (q208416_subst_formula B s n)"
| "q208416_subst_formula (Q208416_All A) s n =
    Q208416_All (q208416_subst_formula A s (Suc n))"

primrec q208416_term_bounded :: "nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_term \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q208416_term_bounded n (Q208416_Var k) = (k < n)"
| "q208416_term_bounded n Q208416_Empty = True"
| "q208416_term_bounded n (Q208416_Pair s t) =
    (q208416_term_bounded n s \<and> q208416_term_bounded n t)"
| "q208416_term_bounded n Q208416_Omega = True"
| "q208416_term_bounded n (Q208416_Powerset t) =
    q208416_term_bounded n t"
| "q208416_term_bounded n (Q208416_Union t) =
    q208416_term_bounded n t"

primrec q208416_formula_bounded ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q208416_formula_bounded n Q208416_False = True"
| "q208416_formula_bounded n (Q208416_Eq s t) =
    (q208416_term_bounded n s \<and> q208416_term_bounded n t)"
| "q208416_formula_bounded n (Q208416_Mem s t) =
    (q208416_term_bounded n s \<and> q208416_term_bounded n t)"
| "q208416_formula_bounded n (Q208416_Imp A B) =
    (q208416_formula_bounded n A \<and> q208416_formula_bounded n B)"
| "q208416_formula_bounded n (Q208416_All A) =
    q208416_formula_bounded (Suc n) A"

primrec q208416_alls :: "nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_alls 0 A = A"
| "q208416_alls (Suc n) A = Q208416_All (q208416_alls n A)"

definition q208416_subset ::
    "q208416_term \<Rightarrow> q208416_term \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_subset s t =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (Q208416_Mem
          (Q208416_Var 0) (q208416_lift_term_at s 1 0))
        (Q208416_Mem
          (Q208416_Var 0) (q208416_lift_term_at t 1 0)))"

definition q208416_transitive_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_transitive_formula =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
        (q208416_subset (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1)))"

definition q208416_epsilon_trichotomy_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_epsilon_trichotomy_formula =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
        (Q208416_All
          (Q208416_Imp
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
            (q208416_or
              (q208416_or
                (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0))
                (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0)))
              (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))))))"

definition q208416_epsilon_well_founded_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_epsilon_well_founded_formula =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (q208416_subset (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
        (Q208416_Imp
          (q208416_not
            (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 0) Q208416_Empty))
          (q208416_ex
            (q208416_and
              (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
              (Q208416_All
                (Q208416_Imp
                  (Q208416_Mem
                    (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
                  (q208416_not
                    (Q208416_Mem
                      (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1)))))))))"

definition q208416_ordinal_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_ordinal_formula =
    q208416_and
      (q208416_and
        q208416_epsilon_trichotomy_formula
        q208416_epsilon_well_founded_formula)
      q208416_transitive_formula"

definition q208416_axiom_emptyset :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_emptyset =
    Q208416_All
      (q208416_not
        (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) Q208416_Empty))"

definition q208416_axiom_pair :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_pair =
    Q208416_All (Q208416_All (Q208416_All (Q208416_All
      (q208416_iff
        (Q208416_Eq
          (Q208416_Pair (Q208416_Var 3) (Q208416_Var 2))
          (Q208416_Pair (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0)))
        (q208416_and
          (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 3) (Q208416_Var 1))
          (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 2) (Q208416_Var 0)))))))"

definition q208416_axiom_extensionality :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_extensionality =
    Q208416_All (Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (Q208416_All
          (q208416_iff
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))))
        (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0))))"

definition q208416_axiom_union :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_union =
    Q208416_All (Q208416_All
      (q208416_iff
        (Q208416_Mem
          (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Union (Q208416_Var 1)))
        (q208416_ex
          (q208416_and
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0))))))"

definition q208416_axiom_powerset :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_powerset =
    Q208416_All (Q208416_All
      (q208416_iff
        (Q208416_Mem
          (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Powerset (Q208416_Var 1)))
        (Q208416_All
          (Q208416_Imp
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))))))"

definition q208416_axiom_infinity :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_infinity =
    q208416_and
      (q208416_and
        (Q208416_Mem Q208416_Empty Q208416_Omega)
        (Q208416_All
          (Q208416_Imp
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) Q208416_Omega)
            (q208416_ex
              (q208416_and
                (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) Q208416_Omega)
                (Q208416_Mem
                  (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0)))))))
      (q208416_and
        (q208416_ex
          (q208416_and
            q208416_ordinal_formula
            (Q208416_Eq Q208416_Omega (Q208416_Var 0))))
        (Q208416_All
          (Q208416_Imp
            q208416_ordinal_formula
            (Q208416_Imp
              (q208416_and
                (Q208416_Mem Q208416_Empty (Q208416_Var 0))
                (Q208416_All
                  (Q208416_Imp
                    (Q208416_Mem
                      (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
                    (q208416_ex
                      (q208416_and
                        (Q208416_Mem
                          (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
                        (Q208416_Mem
                          (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0)))))))
              (q208416_subset
                Q208416_Omega (Q208416_Var 0))))))"

definition q208416_axiom_regularity :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_axiom_regularity =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (q208416_not
          (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 0) Q208416_Empty))
        (q208416_ex
          (q208416_and
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
            (Q208416_All
              (Q208416_Imp
                (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
                (q208416_not
                  (Q208416_Mem
                    (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))))))))"

definition q208416_zorns_lemma :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_zorns_lemma =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (q208416_not
          (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 0) Q208416_Empty))
        (Q208416_Imp
          (Q208416_All
            (Q208416_Imp
              (q208416_and
                (q208416_subset
                  (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
                (Q208416_All (Q208416_All
                  (Q208416_Imp
                    (q208416_and
                      (Q208416_Mem
                        (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 2))
                      (Q208416_Mem
                        (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2)))
                    (q208416_or
                      (q208416_subset
                        (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0))
                      (q208416_subset
                        (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1)))))))
              (Q208416_Mem
                (Q208416_Union (Q208416_Var 0))
                (Q208416_Var 1))))
          (q208416_ex
            (q208416_and
              (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
              (Q208416_All
                (Q208416_Imp
                  (Q208416_Mem
                    (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
                  (Q208416_Imp
                    (q208416_subset
                      (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0))
                    (Q208416_Eq
                      (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0)))))))))"

definition q208416_collection_axiom ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula" where
  "q208416_collection_axiom n phi =
    q208416_alls (Suc n)
      (Q208416_Imp
        (Q208416_All
          (Q208416_Imp
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
            (q208416_ex (q208416_lift_formula_at phi 1 2))))
        (q208416_ex
          (q208416_and
            (Q208416_All
              (Q208416_Imp
                (Q208416_Mem
                  (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
                (q208416_ex
                  (q208416_and
                    (Q208416_Mem
                      (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
                    (q208416_lift_formula_at phi 2 2)))))
            (Q208416_All
              (Q208416_Imp
                (Q208416_Mem
                  (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
                (q208416_ex
                  (q208416_and
                    (Q208416_Mem
                      (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 3))
                    (q208416_subst_formula
                      (q208416_lift_formula_at phi 3 2)
                      (Q208416_Var 1) 0))))))))"

definition q208416_ZFC :: "q208416_formula set" where
  "q208416_ZFC =
    {q208416_axiom_emptyset,
     q208416_axiom_pair,
     q208416_axiom_extensionality,
     q208416_axiom_union,
     q208416_axiom_powerset,
     q208416_axiom_infinity,
     q208416_axiom_regularity,
     q208416_zorns_lemma}
    \<union>
    {A. \<exists>n phi.
      q208416_formula_bounded (n + 2) phi \<and>
      A = q208416_collection_axiom n phi}"

definition q208416_is_func_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_is_func_formula =
    Q208416_All (Q208416_All (Q208416_All (Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (q208416_and
          (Q208416_Mem
            (Q208416_Pair (Q208416_Var 3) (Q208416_Var 1))
            (Q208416_Var 4))
          (Q208416_Mem
            (Q208416_Pair (Q208416_Var 2) (Q208416_Var 0))
            (Q208416_Var 4)))
        (Q208416_Imp
          (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 3) (Q208416_Var 2))
          (Q208416_Eq (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0)))))))"

definition q208416_is_total_reversed_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_is_total_reversed_formula =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 2))
        (q208416_ex
          (q208416_and
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 4))
            (Q208416_Mem
              (Q208416_Pair
                (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 0))
              (Q208416_Var 2)))))"

definition q208416_is_reversed_function_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_is_reversed_function_formula =
    q208416_and
      q208416_is_func_formula
      q208416_is_total_reversed_formula"

definition q208416_at_most_formula :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_at_most_formula =
    q208416_ex (q208416_ex
      (q208416_and
        (q208416_and
          (q208416_subset
            (Q208416_Var 1) (Q208416_Var 3))
          q208416_is_reversed_function_formula)
        (Q208416_All
          (Q208416_Imp
            (Q208416_Mem (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 3))
            (q208416_ex
              (q208416_and
                (Q208416_Mem
                  (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 3))
                (Q208416_Mem
                  (Q208416_Pair
                    (Q208416_Var 0) (Q208416_Var 1))
                  (Q208416_Var 2))))))))"

definition q208416_CH :: q208416_formula where
  "q208416_CH =
    Q208416_All
      (Q208416_Imp
        q208416_ordinal_formula
        (q208416_or
          (q208416_subst_formula
            q208416_at_most_formula Q208416_Omega 1)
          (q208416_subst_formula
            q208416_at_most_formula
            (Q208416_Powerset Q208416_Omega) 0)))"

inductive q208416_prf ::
    "q208416_formula set \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  axm:
    "A \<in> Gamma \<Longrightarrow> q208416_prf Gamma A"
| impI:
    "q208416_prf (insert A Gamma) B \<Longrightarrow>
      q208416_prf Gamma (Q208416_Imp A B)"
| impE:
    "\<lbrakk>q208416_prf Gamma (Q208416_Imp A B);
      q208416_prf Gamma A\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
      q208416_prf Gamma B"
| falsumE:
    "q208416_prf (insert (q208416_not A) Gamma) Q208416_False \<Longrightarrow>
      q208416_prf Gamma A"
| allI:
    "q208416_prf
      ((\<lambda>A. q208416_lift_formula_at A 1 0) ` Gamma) A \<Longrightarrow>
      q208416_prf Gamma (Q208416_All A)"
| allE:
    "q208416_prf Gamma (Q208416_All A) \<Longrightarrow>
      q208416_prf Gamma (q208416_subst_formula A t 0)"
| refl:
    "q208416_prf Gamma (Q208416_Eq t t)"
| subst:
    "\<lbrakk>q208416_prf Gamma (Q208416_Eq s t);
      q208416_prf Gamma (q208416_subst_formula A s 0)\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
      q208416_prf Gamma (q208416_subst_formula A t 0)"

definition q208416_provable ::
    "q208416_formula set \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q208416_provable T A \<longleftrightarrow> q208416_prf T A"

definition q208416_independent ::
    "q208416_formula set \<Rightarrow> q208416_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q208416_independent T A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<not> q208416_provable T A \<and>
     \<not> q208416_provable T (q208416_not A))"

theorem independence_of_CH:
  "q208416_independent q208416_ZFC q208416_CH"
  sorry

end

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q208416,
  "Independence of the continuum hypothesis": ZFC has a countable model
  satisfying the continuum hypothesis and a countable model satisfying its
  negation, equivalently neither CH nor its negation is provable in ZFC.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Logic/fol.ml";;

let Q208416_INDEPENDENCE_OF_THE_CONTINUUM_HYPOTHESIS =
  `let interp =
     \(member:num->num->bool).
       (UNIV:num->bool,
        (\(f:num) (args:num list). @x:num. T),
        (\(p:num) (args:num list).
           (p = 0 /\ ?x y:num. args = [x; y] /\ x = y) \/
           (p = 1 /\ ?x y:num. args = [x; y] /\ member x y))) in
   let set_formula =
     \p:form.
       functions_form p = {} /\
       predicates_form p SUBSET {(0,2),(1,2)} in
   let empty_set =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (e:num).
       !x:num. ~(member x e) in
   let pair_set =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (x:num) (y:num) (p:num).
       !z:num. member z p <=> z = x \/ z = y in
   let union_set =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (x:num) (u:num).
       !z:num. member z u <=> ?y:num. member y x /\ member z y in
   let powerset =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (x:num) (p:num).
       !z:num. member z p <=> !y:num. member y z ==> member y x in
   let successor_set =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (x:num) (s:num).
       !z:num. member z s <=> member z x \/ z = x in
   let inductive_set =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (i:num).
       (?e:num. empty_set member e /\ member e i) /\
       (!x:num.
          member x i
          ==> ?s:num. successor_set member x s /\ member s i) in
   let is_omega =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (w:num).
       inductive_set member w /\
       !i:num.
         inductive_set member i
         ==> !x:num. member x w ==> member x i in
   let is_ordinal =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (a:num).
       (!x y:num. member x a /\ member y x ==> member y a) /\
       (!x:num. member x a ==> ~(member x x)) /\
       (!x y z:num.
          member x a /\ member y a /\ member z a /\
          member x y /\ member y z
          ==> member x z) /\
       (!x y:num.
          member x a /\ member y a
          ==> member x y \/ x = y \/ member y x) /\
       (!s:num.
          (!x:num. member x s ==> member x a) /\
          (?x:num. member x s)
          ==> ?x:num.
                member x s /\
                !y:num. member y s ==> y = x \/ member x y) in
   let unordered_pair =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (x:num) (y:num) (u:num).
       !z:num. member z u <=> z = x \/ z = y in
   let ordered_pair =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (x:num) (y:num) (p:num).
       ?u v:num.
         unordered_pair member x x u /\
         unordered_pair member x y v /\
         unordered_pair member u v p in
   let relates =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (r:num) (x:num) (y:num).
       ?p:num. member p r /\ ordered_pair member x y p in
   let is_function =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (f:num) (a:num) (b:num).
       (!p:num.
          member p f
          ==> ?x y:num.
                member x a /\ member y b /\
                ordered_pair member x y p) /\
       (!x:num.
          member x a
          ==> ?y:num.
                member y b /\ relates member f x y /\
                !y':num.
                  member y' b /\ relates member f x y'
                  ==> y' = y) in
   let is_injection =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (f:num) (a:num) (b:num).
       is_function member f a b /\
       !x x' y:num.
         member x a /\ member x' a /\ member y b /\
         relates member f x y /\ relates member f x' y
         ==> x = x' in
   let is_surjection =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (f:num) (a:num) (b:num).
       is_function member f a b /\
       !y:num.
         member y b
         ==> ?x:num. member x a /\ relates member f x y in
   let is_bijection =
     \(member:num->num->bool) (f:num) (a:num) (b:num).
       is_injection member f a b /\ is_surjection member f a b in
   let zf_model =
     \(member:num->num->bool).
       (!x y:num.
          (!z:num. member z x <=> member z y)
          ==> x = y) /\
       (?e:num. empty_set member e) /\
       (!x y:num. ?p:num. pair_set member x y p) /\
       (!x:num. ?u:num. union_set member x u) /\
       (!x:num. ?p:num. powerset member x p) /\
       (?i:num. inductive_set member i) /\
       (!x:num.
          (?y:num. member y x)
          ==> ?y:num.
                member y x /\
                !z:num. member z x ==> ~(member z y)) /\
       (!p:form v:num->num a:num.
          set_formula p /\ valuation (interp member) v
          ==> ?b:num.
                !x:num.
                  member x b <=>
                  member x a /\
                  holds (interp member) (valmod (0,x) v) p) /\
       (!p:form v:num->num a:num.
          set_formula p /\ valuation (interp member) v /\
          (!x:num.
             member x a
             ==> ?y:num.
                   holds (interp member)
                     (valmod (1,y) (valmod (0,x) v)) p /\
                   !y':num.
                     holds (interp member)
                       (valmod (1,y') (valmod (0,x) v)) p
                     ==> y' = y)
          ==> ?b:num.
                !y:num.
                  member y b <=>
                  ?x:num.
                    member x a /\
                    holds (interp member)
                      (valmod (1,y) (valmod (0,x) v)) p) in
   let choice_model =
     \(member:num->num->bool).
       !x:num.
         ?a f:num.
           is_ordinal member a /\
           is_surjection member f a x in
   let zfc_model =
     \(member:num->num->bool).
       zf_model member /\ choice_model member in
   let continuum_hypothesis =
     \(member:num->num->bool).
       ?omega pomega:num.
         is_omega member omega /\
         powerset member omega pomega /\
         !x:num.
           (?f:num. is_injection member f omega x) /\
           (?g:num. is_injection member g x pomega)
           ==> (?h:num. is_bijection member h x omega) \/
               (?h:num. is_bijection member h x pomega) in
   (?member:num->num->bool.
      zfc_model member /\ continuum_hypothesis member) /\
   (?member:num->num->bool.
      zfc_model member /\ ~(continuum_hypothesis member))`;;

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q208416
;; (thousand-theorems__acl2__Q208416), "Independence of the continuum
;; hypothesis": in the fixed first-order language of the Flypitch
;; formalization, neither its continuum-hypothesis sentence nor its negation
;; is derivable from its ZFC theory. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; The fixed language has equality, one binary membership relation, constants
;; for the empty set and omega, binary ordered pairing, and unary powerset and
;; union functions. Variables are unbounded de Bruijn indices.

(defun q208416-var (index)
  (list 'q208416-var (nfix index)))

(defun q208416-empty ()
  (list 'q208416-empty))

(defun q208416-omega ()
  (list 'q208416-omega))

(defun q208416-pair (left right)
  (list 'q208416-pair left right))

(defun q208416-powerset (term)
  (list 'q208416-powerset term))

(defun q208416-union (term)
  (list 'q208416-union term))

(defun q208416-false ()
  (list 'q208416-false))

(defun q208416-equal (left right)
  (list 'q208416-equal left right))

(defun q208416-member (element set)
  (list 'q208416-member element set))

(defun q208416-implies (antecedent consequent)
  (list 'q208416-implies antecedent consequent))

(defun q208416-forall (body)
  (list 'q208416-forall body))

;; These are exactly the classical derived connectives used by the source.

(defun q208416-not (formula)
  (q208416-implies formula (q208416-false)))

(defun q208416-and (left right)
  (q208416-not
   (q208416-implies left (q208416-not right))))

(defun q208416-or (left right)
  (q208416-implies (q208416-not left) right))

(defun q208416-iff (left right)
  (q208416-and
   (q208416-implies left right)
   (q208416-implies right left)))

(defun q208416-exists (body)
  (q208416-not
   (q208416-forall (q208416-not body))))

(defun q208416-term-p (term)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 2)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-var))
    (natp (cadr term)))
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 1)
     (or
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-empty)
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-omega)))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 3)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-pair))
    (and
     (q208416-term-p (cadr term))
     (q208416-term-p (caddr term))))
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 2)
     (or
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-powerset)
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-union)))
    (q208416-term-p (cadr term)))
   (t nil)))

(defun q208416-formula-p (formula)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 1)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-false))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 3)
     (or
      (equal (car formula) 'q208416-equal)
      (equal (car formula) 'q208416-member)))
    (and
     (q208416-term-p (cadr formula))
     (q208416-term-p (caddr formula))))
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 3)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-implies))
    (and
     (q208416-formula-p (cadr formula))
     (q208416-formula-p (caddr formula))))
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 2)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-forall))
    (q208416-formula-p (cadr formula)))
   (t nil)))

;; Bounded formulas are the source's BOUNDED_FORMULA objects: every de
;; Bruijn index is below the number of available variables.

(defun q208416-bounded-term-p (depth term)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 2)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-var))
    (and
     (natp (cadr term))
     (< (cadr term) (nfix depth))))
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 1)
     (or
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-empty)
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-omega)))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 3)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-pair))
    (and
     (q208416-bounded-term-p depth (cadr term))
     (q208416-bounded-term-p depth (caddr term))))
   ((and
     (true-listp term)
     (equal (len term) 2)
     (or
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-powerset)
      (equal (car term) 'q208416-union)))
    (q208416-bounded-term-p depth (cadr term)))
   (t nil)))

(defun q208416-bounded-formula-p (depth formula)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 1)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-false))
    t)
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 3)
     (or
      (equal (car formula) 'q208416-equal)
      (equal (car formula) 'q208416-member)))
    (and
     (q208416-bounded-term-p depth (cadr formula))
     (q208416-bounded-term-p depth (caddr formula))))
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 3)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-implies))
    (and
     (q208416-bounded-formula-p depth (cadr formula))
     (q208416-bounded-formula-p depth (caddr formula))))
   ((and
     (true-listp formula)
     (equal (len formula) 2)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-forall))
    (q208416-bounded-formula-p
     (+ 1 (nfix depth))
     (cadr formula)))
   (t nil)))

;; Capture-avoiding lift and substitution are the operations appearing in the
;; source proof rules and in the collection and CH formulas.

(defun q208416-lift-term (term amount cutoff)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-var))
    (if (<= (nfix cutoff) (nfix (cadr term)))
        (q208416-var (+ (nfix (cadr term)) (nfix amount)))
      (q208416-var (cadr term))))
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-pair))
    (q208416-pair
     (q208416-lift-term (cadr term) amount cutoff)
     (q208416-lift-term (caddr term) amount cutoff)))
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-powerset))
    (q208416-powerset
     (q208416-lift-term (cadr term) amount cutoff)))
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-union))
    (q208416-union
     (q208416-lift-term (cadr term) amount cutoff)))
   (t term)))

(defun q208416-lift-formula (formula amount cutoff)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-equal))
    (q208416-equal
     (q208416-lift-term (cadr formula) amount cutoff)
     (q208416-lift-term (caddr formula) amount cutoff)))
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-member))
    (q208416-member
     (q208416-lift-term (cadr formula) amount cutoff)
     (q208416-lift-term (caddr formula) amount cutoff)))
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-implies))
    (q208416-implies
     (q208416-lift-formula (cadr formula) amount cutoff)
     (q208416-lift-formula (caddr formula) amount cutoff)))
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-forall))
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-lift-formula
      (cadr formula) amount (+ 1 (nfix cutoff)))))
   (t formula)))

(defun q208416-substitute-term (term replacement index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-var))
    (let ((variable (nfix (cadr term)))
          (index (nfix index)))
      (cond
       ((< variable index)
        (q208416-var variable))
       ((< index variable)
        (q208416-var (- variable 1)))
       (t
        (q208416-lift-term replacement index 0)))))
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-pair))
    (q208416-pair
     (q208416-substitute-term (cadr term) replacement index)
     (q208416-substitute-term (caddr term) replacement index)))
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-powerset))
    (q208416-powerset
     (q208416-substitute-term (cadr term) replacement index)))
   ((and
     (consp term)
     (equal (car term) 'q208416-union))
    (q208416-union
     (q208416-substitute-term (cadr term) replacement index)))
   (t term)))

(defun q208416-substitute-formula (formula replacement index)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
  (cond
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-equal))
    (q208416-equal
     (q208416-substitute-term
      (cadr formula) replacement index)
     (q208416-substitute-term
      (caddr formula) replacement index)))
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-member))
    (q208416-member
     (q208416-substitute-term
      (cadr formula) replacement index)
     (q208416-substitute-term
      (caddr formula) replacement index)))
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-implies))
    (q208416-implies
     (q208416-substitute-formula
      (cadr formula) replacement index)
     (q208416-substitute-formula
      (caddr formula) replacement index)))
   ((and
     (consp formula)
     (equal (car formula) 'q208416-forall))
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-substitute-formula
      (cadr formula) replacement (+ 1 (nfix index)))))
   (t formula)))

(defun q208416-repeat-forall (count formula)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      formula
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-repeat-forall (- (nfix count) 1) formula))))

;; Set-theoretic formula abbreviations from the fixed source language.

(defun q208416-subset-formula (left right)
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-member
     (q208416-var 0)
     (q208416-lift-term left 1 0))
    (q208416-member
     (q208416-var 0)
     (q208416-lift-term right 1 0)))))

(defun q208416-transitive-formula ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
    (q208416-subset-formula
     (q208416-var 0)
     (q208416-var 1)))))

(defun q208416-epsilon-trichotomy-formula ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-implies
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
      (q208416-or
       (q208416-or
        (q208416-equal (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0))
        (q208416-member (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0)))
       (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))))))))

(defun q208416-epsilon-well-founded-formula ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-subset-formula
     (q208416-var 0)
     (q208416-var 1))
    (q208416-implies
     (q208416-not
      (q208416-equal (q208416-var 0) (q208416-empty)))
     (q208416-exists
      (q208416-and
       (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
       (q208416-forall
        (q208416-implies
         (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
         (q208416-not
          (q208416-member
           (q208416-var 0)
           (q208416-var 1)))))))))))

(defun q208416-ordinal-formula ()
  (q208416-and
   (q208416-and
    (q208416-epsilon-trichotomy-formula)
    (q208416-epsilon-well-founded-formula))
   (q208416-transitive-formula)))

;; The eight fixed ZFC axioms used by the source.

(defun q208416-emptyset-axiom ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-not
    (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-empty)))))

(defun q208416-ordered-pairs-axiom ()
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   4
   (q208416-iff
    (q208416-equal
     (q208416-pair (q208416-var 3) (q208416-var 2))
     (q208416-pair (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0)))
    (q208416-and
     (q208416-equal (q208416-var 3) (q208416-var 1))
     (q208416-equal (q208416-var 2) (q208416-var 0))))))

(defun q208416-extensionality-axiom ()
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   2
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-iff
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))))
    (q208416-equal (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0)))))

(defun q208416-union-axiom ()
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   2
   (q208416-iff
    (q208416-member
     (q208416-var 0)
     (q208416-union (q208416-var 1)))
    (q208416-exists
     (q208416-and
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0)))))))

(defun q208416-powerset-axiom ()
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   2
   (q208416-iff
    (q208416-member
     (q208416-var 0)
     (q208416-powerset (q208416-var 1)))
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-implies
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2)))))))

(defun q208416-limit-property (ordinal)
  (q208416-and
   (q208416-member (q208416-empty) ordinal)
   (q208416-forall
    (q208416-implies
     (q208416-member
      (q208416-var 0)
      (q208416-lift-term ordinal 1 0))
     (q208416-exists
      (q208416-and
       (q208416-member
        (q208416-var 0)
        (q208416-lift-term ordinal 2 0))
       (q208416-member
        (q208416-var 1)
        (q208416-var 0))))))))

(defun q208416-infinity-axiom ()
  (q208416-and
   (q208416-limit-property (q208416-omega))
   (q208416-and
    (q208416-exists
     (q208416-and
      (q208416-ordinal-formula)
      (q208416-equal (q208416-omega) (q208416-var 0))))
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-implies
      (q208416-ordinal-formula)
      (q208416-implies
       (q208416-limit-property (q208416-var 0))
       (q208416-subset-formula
        (q208416-omega)
        (q208416-var 0))))))))

(defun q208416-regularity-axiom ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-not
     (q208416-equal (q208416-var 0) (q208416-empty)))
    (q208416-exists
     (q208416-and
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
      (q208416-forall
       (q208416-implies
        (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
        (q208416-not
         (q208416-member
          (q208416-var 0)
          (q208416-var 1))))))))))

(defun q208416-chain-formula ()
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   2
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-and
     (q208416-member (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 2))
     (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2)))
    (q208416-or
     (q208416-subset-formula
      (q208416-var 1)
      (q208416-var 0))
     (q208416-subset-formula
      (q208416-var 0)
      (q208416-var 1))))))

(defun q208416-zorn-axiom ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-not
     (q208416-equal (q208416-var 0) (q208416-empty)))
    (q208416-implies
     (q208416-forall
      (q208416-implies
       (q208416-and
        (q208416-subset-formula
         (q208416-var 0)
         (q208416-var 1))
        (q208416-chain-formula))
       (q208416-member
        (q208416-union (q208416-var 0))
        (q208416-var 1))))
     (q208416-exists
      (q208416-and
       (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
       (q208416-forall
        (q208416-implies
         (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
         (q208416-implies
          (q208416-subset-formula
           (q208416-var 1)
           (q208416-var 0))
          (q208416-equal
           (q208416-var 1)
           (q208416-var 0)))))))))))

;; Strong collection is an unbounded schema over every natural arity and
;; every bounded formula with n+2 free variables.

(defun q208416-collection-axiom (parameter-count phi)
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   (+ 1 (nfix parameter-count))
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-forall
     (q208416-implies
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
      (q208416-exists
       (q208416-lift-formula phi 1 2))))
    (q208416-exists
     (q208416-and
      (q208416-forall
       (q208416-implies
        (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
        (q208416-exists
         (q208416-and
          (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
          (q208416-lift-formula phi 2 2)))))
      (q208416-forall
       (q208416-implies
        (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
        (q208416-exists
         (q208416-and
          (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 3))
          (q208416-substitute-formula
           (q208416-lift-formula phi 3 2)
           (q208416-var 1)
           0))))))))))

;; A finite witness records membership in the infinite ZFC theory without
;; turning the collection schema into a finite list.

(defun q208416-zfc-membership-witness-p (formula witness)
  (cond
   ((equal witness 'q208416-emptyset)
    (equal formula (q208416-emptyset-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-ordered-pairs)
    (equal formula (q208416-ordered-pairs-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-extensionality)
    (equal formula (q208416-extensionality-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-union)
    (equal formula (q208416-union-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-powerset)
    (equal formula (q208416-powerset-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-infinity)
    (equal formula (q208416-infinity-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-regularity)
    (equal formula (q208416-regularity-axiom)))
   ((equal witness 'q208416-zorn)
    (equal formula (q208416-zorn-axiom)))
   ((and
     (true-listp witness)
     (equal (len witness) 3)
     (equal (car witness) 'q208416-collection))
    (let ((parameter-count (cadr witness))
          (phi (caddr witness)))
      (and
       (natp parameter-count)
       (q208416-bounded-formula-p
        (+ 2 parameter-count) phi)
       (equal
        formula
        (q208416-collection-axiom parameter-count phi)))))
   (t nil)))

;; Context descriptors and their witnesses implement insertion and the image
;; of a context under one-variable lifting, exactly as in the source rules.

(defun q208416-context-p (context)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count context)))
  (cond
   ((equal context '(q208416-zfc)) t)
   ((and
     (true-listp context)
     (equal (len context) 3)
     (equal (car context) 'q208416-insert))
    (and
     (q208416-formula-p (cadr context))
     (q208416-context-p (caddr context))))
   ((and
     (true-listp context)
     (equal (len context) 2)
     (equal (car context) 'q208416-lift))
    (q208416-context-p (cadr context)))
   (t nil)))

(defun q208416-context-member-witness-p
    (context formula witness)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count context)))
  (cond
   ((equal context '(q208416-zfc))
    (q208416-zfc-membership-witness-p formula witness))
   ((and
     (consp context)
     (equal (car context) 'q208416-insert))
    (cond
     ((equal witness '(q208416-here))
      (equal formula (cadr context)))
     ((and
       (true-listp witness)
       (equal (len witness) 2)
       (equal (car witness) 'q208416-there))
      (q208416-context-member-witness-p
       (caddr context) formula (cadr witness)))
     (t nil)))
   ((and
     (consp context)
     (equal (car context) 'q208416-lift)
     (true-listp witness)
     (equal (len witness) 3)
     (equal (car witness) 'q208416-lifted))
    (let ((original (cadr witness))
          (prior-witness (caddr witness)))
      (and
       (equal
        formula
        (q208416-lift-formula original 1 0))
       (q208416-context-member-witness-p
        (cadr context) original prior-witness))))
   (t nil)))

;; This fuelled checker is a direct finite-tree presentation of the eight
;; constructors of Flypitch's PRF relation. ACL2's unbounded existential below
;; ranges over all finite proof trees; no proof is supplied in this file.

(defun q208416-proof-p-fuel
    (context conclusion proof fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      nil
    (let ((next-fuel (- (nfix fuel) 1)))
      (cond
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 2)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-axiom))
        (q208416-context-member-witness-p
         context conclusion (cadr proof)))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 4)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-imp-intro))
        (let ((antecedent (cadr proof))
              (consequent (caddr proof))
              (subproof (cadddr proof)))
          (and
           (q208416-formula-p antecedent)
           (q208416-formula-p consequent)
           (equal
            conclusion
            (q208416-implies antecedent consequent))
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            (list 'q208416-insert antecedent context)
            consequent subproof next-fuel))))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 4)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-imp-elim))
        (let ((antecedent (cadr proof))
              (implication-proof (caddr proof))
              (antecedent-proof (cadddr proof)))
          (and
           (q208416-formula-p antecedent)
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            context
            (q208416-implies antecedent conclusion)
            implication-proof
            next-fuel)
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            context antecedent antecedent-proof next-fuel))))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-falsum-elim))
        (let ((formula (cadr proof))
              (subproof (caddr proof)))
          (and
           (q208416-formula-p formula)
           (equal conclusion formula)
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            (list
             'q208416-insert
             (q208416-not formula)
             context)
            (q208416-false)
            subproof
            next-fuel))))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 3)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-all-intro))
        (let ((body (cadr proof))
              (subproof (caddr proof)))
          (and
           (q208416-formula-p body)
           (equal conclusion (q208416-forall body))
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            (list 'q208416-lift context)
            body subproof next-fuel))))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 4)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-all-elim))
        (let ((body (cadr proof))
              (term (caddr proof))
              (subproof (cadddr proof)))
          (and
           (q208416-formula-p body)
           (q208416-term-p term)
           (equal
            conclusion
            (q208416-substitute-formula body term 0))
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            context
            (q208416-forall body)
            subproof
            next-fuel))))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 2)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-reflexivity))
        (let ((term (cadr proof)))
          (and
           (q208416-term-p term)
           (equal
            conclusion
            (q208416-equal term term)))))
       ((and
         (true-listp proof)
         (equal (len proof) 6)
         (equal (car proof) 'q208416-substitution))
        (let ((left (cadr proof))
              (right (caddr proof))
              (formula (cadddr proof))
              (equality-proof (car (cddddr proof)))
              (left-proof (cadr (cddddr proof))))
          (and
           (q208416-term-p left)
           (q208416-term-p right)
           (q208416-formula-p formula)
           (equal
            conclusion
            (q208416-substitute-formula formula right 0))
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            context
            (q208416-equal left right)
            equality-proof
            next-fuel)
           (q208416-proof-p-fuel
            context
            (q208416-substitute-formula formula left 0)
            left-proof
            next-fuel))))
       (t nil)))))

(defun q208416-proof-p (context conclusion proof)
  (and
   (q208416-context-p context)
   (q208416-formula-p conclusion)
   (q208416-proof-p-fuel
    context conclusion proof (+ 1 (acl2-count proof)))))

(defun-sk q208416-zfc-provable-p (formula)
  (exists (proof)
    (q208416-proof-p
     '(q208416-zfc) formula proof)))

;; The continuum hypothesis sentence is the exact source formula:
;; every ordinal x has cardinality at most omega or at least the powerset of
;; omega, with cardinal comparison expressed by partial surjections.

(defun q208416-is-function-formula ()
  (q208416-repeat-forall
   4
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-and
     (q208416-member
      (q208416-pair (q208416-var 3) (q208416-var 1))
      (q208416-var 4))
     (q208416-member
      (q208416-pair (q208416-var 2) (q208416-var 0))
      (q208416-var 4)))
    (q208416-implies
     (q208416-equal (q208416-var 3) (q208416-var 2))
     (q208416-equal (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0))))))

(defun q208416-is-total-reversed-formula ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 2))
    (q208416-exists
     (q208416-and
      (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 4))
      (q208416-member
       (q208416-pair (q208416-var 1) (q208416-var 0))
       (q208416-var 2)))))))

(defun q208416-is-function-reversed-formula ()
  (q208416-and
   (q208416-is-function-formula)
   (q208416-is-total-reversed-formula)))

(defun q208416-at-most-formula ()
  (q208416-exists
   (q208416-exists
    (q208416-and
     (q208416-and
      (q208416-subset-formula
       (q208416-var 1)
       (q208416-var 3))
      (q208416-is-function-reversed-formula))
     (q208416-forall
      (q208416-implies
       (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 3))
       (q208416-exists
        (q208416-and
         (q208416-member (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 3))
         (q208416-member
          (q208416-pair (q208416-var 0) (q208416-var 1))
          (q208416-var 2))))))))))

(defun q208416-continuum-hypothesis-formula ()
  (q208416-forall
   (q208416-implies
    (q208416-ordinal-formula)
    (q208416-or
     (q208416-substitute-formula
      (q208416-at-most-formula)
      (q208416-omega)
      1)
     (q208416-substitute-formula
      (q208416-at-most-formula)
      (q208416-powerset (q208416-omega))
      0)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q208416-independence-of-ch-statement ()
  (and
   (not
    (q208416-zfc-provable-p
     (q208416-continuum-hypothesis-formula)))
   (not
    (q208416-zfc-provable-p
     (q208416-not
      (q208416-continuum-hypothesis-formula))))))
