title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q208416, "Independence of the continuum hypothesis":
-- by first-order completeness, neither CH nor its negation is a semantic
-- consequence of the source ZFC theory. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 4 _and_
infixr 3 _or_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

NotEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
NotEqual left right =
  Not (left == right)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (left : Set a)
  (right : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor conjunction
  field
    first : left
    second : right

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (left : Set a)
  (right : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left-disjunct : left -> left or right
  right-disjunct : right -> left or right

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (left : Set a)
  (right : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : left -> right
    backward : right -> left

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    evidence : property value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Environment : Set -> Nat -> Set
Environment A n =
  Fin n -> A

extend :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Environment A n ->
  A ->
  Environment A (suc n)
extend environment new-value fzero =
  new-value
extend environment new-value (fsuc index) =
  environment index

extend-two :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Environment A n ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Environment A (suc (suc n))
extend-two environment first-value second-value =
  extend (extend environment first-value) second-value

data Term (free-variables : Nat) : Set where
  var-term : Fin free-variables -> Term free-variables
  empty-term : Term free-variables
  ordered-pair-term :
    Term free-variables ->
    Term free-variables ->
    Term free-variables
  omega-term : Term free-variables
  power-set-term : Term free-variables -> Term free-variables
  union-term : Term free-variables -> Term free-variables

data Formula (free-variables : Nat) : Set where
  falsum : Formula free-variables
  equal :
    Term free-variables ->
    Term free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables
  member :
    Term free-variables ->
    Term free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables
  implication :
    Formula free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables ->
    Formula free-variables
  universal :
    Formula (suc free-variables) ->
    Formula free-variables

record SetStructure : Set₁ where
  field
    Carrier : Set
    membership : Carrier -> Carrier -> Set
    empty-set : Carrier
    ordered-pair : Carrier -> Carrier -> Carrier
    omega : Carrier
    power-set : Carrier -> Carrier
    union-set : Carrier -> Carrier

open SetStructure

InterpretTerm :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Environment (Carrier structure) n ->
  Term n ->
  Carrier structure
InterpretTerm structure environment (var-term index) =
  environment index
InterpretTerm structure environment empty-term =
  empty-set structure
InterpretTerm structure environment (ordered-pair-term left right) =
  ordered-pair structure
    (InterpretTerm structure environment left)
    (InterpretTerm structure environment right)
InterpretTerm structure environment omega-term =
  omega structure
InterpretTerm structure environment (power-set-term set-term) =
  power-set structure
    (InterpretTerm structure environment set-term)
InterpretTerm structure environment (union-term family-term) =
  union-set structure
    (InterpretTerm structure environment family-term)

Satisfies :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Environment (Carrier structure) n ->
  Formula n ->
  Set
Satisfies structure environment falsum =
  Bottom
Satisfies structure environment (equal left right) =
  InterpretTerm structure environment left ==
  InterpretTerm structure environment right
Satisfies structure environment (member element set-term) =
  membership structure
    (InterpretTerm structure environment element)
    (InterpretTerm structure environment set-term)
Satisfies structure environment (implication antecedent consequent) =
  Satisfies structure environment antecedent ->
  Satisfies structure environment consequent
Satisfies structure environment (universal body) =
  (value : Carrier structure) ->
  Satisfies structure (extend environment value) body

Subset :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
Subset structure left right =
  (element : Carrier structure) ->
  membership structure element left ->
  membership structure element right

Nonempty :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
Nonempty structure set =
  NotEqual set (empty-set structure)

TransitiveSet :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
TransitiveSet structure set =
  (element : Carrier structure) ->
  membership structure element set ->
  Subset structure element set

MembershipTrichotomous :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
MembershipTrichotomous structure set =
  (left right : Carrier structure) ->
  membership structure left set ->
  membership structure right set ->
  ((left == right) or membership structure left right) or
  membership structure right left

MembershipWellFounded :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
MembershipWellFounded structure set =
  (subset : Carrier structure) ->
  Subset structure subset set ->
  Nonempty structure subset ->
  Exists (Carrier structure)
    (\ least ->
      membership structure least subset and
      ((other : Carrier structure) ->
       membership structure other subset ->
       Not (membership structure other least)))

Ordinal :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
Ordinal structure set =
  (MembershipTrichotomous structure set and
   MembershipWellFounded structure set) and
  TransitiveSet structure set

LimitProperty :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
LimitProperty structure set =
  membership structure (empty-set structure) set and
  ((element : Carrier structure) ->
   membership structure element set ->
   Exists (Carrier structure)
     (\ successor ->
       membership structure successor set and
       membership structure element successor))

ChainIn :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
ChainIn structure chain ambient =
  Subset structure chain ambient and
  ((left right : Carrier structure) ->
   membership structure left chain ->
   membership structure right chain ->
   Subset structure left right or
   Subset structure right left)

FunctionalGraph :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
FunctionalGraph structure graph =
  (input-one input-two output-one output-two : Carrier structure) ->
  membership structure
    (ordered-pair structure input-one output-one) graph ->
  membership structure
    (ordered-pair structure input-two output-two) graph ->
  input-one == input-two ->
  output-one == output-two

TotalFromTo :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
TotalFromTo structure graph domain codomain =
  (input : Carrier structure) ->
  membership structure input domain ->
  Exists (Carrier structure)
    (\ output ->
      membership structure output codomain and
      membership structure
        (ordered-pair structure input output) graph)

SurjectiveFromTo :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
SurjectiveFromTo structure graph domain codomain =
  (output : Carrier structure) ->
  membership structure output codomain ->
  Exists (Carrier structure)
    (\ input ->
      membership structure input domain and
      membership structure
        (ordered-pair structure input output) graph)

AtMost :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Carrier structure ->
  Set
AtMost structure smaller larger =
  Exists (Carrier structure)
    (\ domain ->
      Subset structure domain larger and
      Exists (Carrier structure)
        (\ graph ->
          FunctionalGraph structure graph and
          (TotalFromTo structure graph domain smaller and
           SurjectiveFromTo structure graph domain smaller)))

ContinuumHypothesis :
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  Set
ContinuumHypothesis structure =
  (ordinal : Carrier structure) ->
  Ordinal structure ordinal ->
  AtMost structure ordinal (omega structure) or
  AtMost structure (power-set structure (omega structure)) ordinal

record ModelsZFC (structure : SetStructure) : Set where
  field
    empty-set-axiom :
      (element : Carrier structure) ->
      Not (membership structure element (empty-set structure))

    ordered-pair-axiom :
      (left-one right-one left-two right-two : Carrier structure) ->
      (ordered-pair structure left-one right-one ==
       ordered-pair structure left-two right-two) iff
      ((left-one == left-two) and (right-one == right-two))

    extensionality :
      (left right : Carrier structure) ->
      ((element : Carrier structure) ->
       membership structure element left iff
       membership structure element right) ->
      left == right

    strong-collection :
      (parameter-count : Nat) ->
      (formula : Formula (suc (suc parameter-count))) ->
      (parameters : Environment (Carrier structure) parameter-count) ->
      (source-set : Carrier structure) ->
      ((input : Carrier structure) ->
       membership structure input source-set ->
       Exists (Carrier structure)
         (\ output ->
           Satisfies structure
             (extend-two parameters input output)
             formula)) ->
      Exists (Carrier structure)
        (\ collection ->
          ((input : Carrier structure) ->
           membership structure input source-set ->
           Exists (Carrier structure)
             (\ output ->
               membership structure output collection and
               Satisfies structure
                 (extend-two parameters input output)
                 formula)) and
          ((output : Carrier structure) ->
           membership structure output collection ->
           Exists (Carrier structure)
             (\ input ->
               membership structure input source-set and
               Satisfies structure
                 (extend-two parameters input output)
                 formula)))

    union-axiom :
      (family element : Carrier structure) ->
      membership structure element (union-set structure family) iff
      Exists (Carrier structure)
        (\ member-set ->
          membership structure member-set family and
          membership structure element member-set)

    power-set-axiom :
      (set subset : Carrier structure) ->
      membership structure subset (power-set structure set) iff
      Subset structure subset set

    infinity-limit :
      LimitProperty structure (omega structure)

    infinity-ordinal :
      Exists (Carrier structure)
        (\ ordinal ->
          Ordinal structure ordinal and
          (omega structure == ordinal))

    infinity-least :
      (ordinal : Carrier structure) ->
      Ordinal structure ordinal ->
      LimitProperty structure ordinal ->
      Subset structure (omega structure) ordinal

    regularity :
      (set : Carrier structure) ->
      Nonempty structure set ->
      Exists (Carrier structure)
        (\ least ->
          membership structure least set and
          ((other : Carrier structure) ->
           membership structure other set ->
           Not (membership structure other least)))

    zorns-lemma :
      (set : Carrier structure) ->
      Nonempty structure set ->
      ((chain : Carrier structure) ->
       ChainIn structure chain set ->
       membership structure (union-set structure chain) set) ->
      Exists (Carrier structure)
        (\ maximal ->
          membership structure maximal set and
          ((other : Carrier structure) ->
           membership structure other set ->
           Subset structure maximal other ->
           maximal == other))

ZFC-Entails :
  (property : (structure : SetStructure) -> Set) ->
  Set₁
ZFC-Entails property =
  (structure : SetStructure) ->
  ModelsZFC structure ->
  property structure

independence-of-the-continuum-hypothesis : Set₁
independence-of-the-continuum-hypothesis =
  Not (ZFC-Entails ContinuumHypothesis) and
  Not
    (ZFC-Entails
      (\ structure ->
        Not (ContinuumHypothesis structure)))

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q208416 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q208416), "Independence of the continuum
  hypothesis": countable first-order models of ZFC witness both CH and its
  negation, equivalently neither CH nor its negation is derivable from ZFC.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory pred_setTheory;

val q208416_pair_num_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_pair_num_def",
  ``q208416_pair_num i j =
      ((i + j) * (i + j + 1)) DIV 2 + j``);

val q208416_valuation_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_valuation_def",
  ``q208416_valuation (M : num set) (v : num -> num) <=>
      !i. v i IN M``);

val q208416_tarski_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_tarski_def",
  ``q208416_tarski
      (mem : num -> num -> bool)
      (M : num set)
      (sat : (num -> num) -> num -> bool) <=>
      (!v i j.
         q208416_valuation M v ==>
         (sat v (5 * q208416_pair_num i j) <=> v i = v j)) /\
      (!v i j.
         q208416_valuation M v ==>
         (sat v (5 * q208416_pair_num i j + 1) <=>
          mem (v i) (v j))) /\
      (!v p.
         q208416_valuation M v ==>
         (sat v (5 * p + 2) <=> ~sat v p)) /\
      (!v p q.
         q208416_valuation M v ==>
         (sat v (5 * q208416_pair_num p q + 3) <=>
          sat v p /\ sat v q)) /\
      (!v i p.
         q208416_valuation M v ==>
         (sat v (5 * q208416_pair_num i p + 4) <=>
          ?x. x IN M /\ sat ((i =+ x) v) p))``);

val q208416_internal_subset_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_internal_subset_def",
  ``q208416_internal_subset
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) a b <=>
      a IN M /\ b IN M /\
      !x. x IN M /\ mem x a ==> mem x b``);

val q208416_empty_object_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_empty_object_def",
  ``q208416_empty_object
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) e <=>
      e IN M /\ !x. x IN M ==> ~mem x e``);

val q208416_singleton_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_singleton_def",
  ``q208416_singleton
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) x s <=>
      x IN M /\ s IN M /\
      !z. z IN M ==> (mem z s <=> z = x)``);

val q208416_unordered_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_unordered_pair_def",
  ``q208416_unordered_pair
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) x y p <=>
      x IN M /\ y IN M /\ p IN M /\
      !z. z IN M ==> (mem z p <=> z = x \/ z = y)``);

val q208416_ordered_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_ordered_pair_def",
  ``q208416_ordered_pair
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) x y p <=>
      ?sx xy.
        q208416_singleton mem M x sx /\
        q208416_unordered_pair mem M x y xy /\
        q208416_unordered_pair mem M sx xy p``);

val q208416_relates_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_relates_def",
  ``q208416_relates
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) f x y <=>
      ?p.
        p IN M /\
        q208416_ordered_pair mem M x y p /\
        mem p f``);

val q208416_function_between_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_function_between_def",
  ``q208416_function_between
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) f a b <=>
      f IN M /\ a IN M /\ b IN M /\
      (!p.
         p IN M /\ mem p f ==>
         ?x y.
           x IN M /\ y IN M /\
           mem x a /\ mem y b /\
           q208416_ordered_pair mem M x y p) /\
      (!x.
         x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
         ?y.
           y IN M /\ mem y b /\
           q208416_relates mem M f x y) /\
      (!x y z.
         x IN M /\ y IN M /\ z IN M /\
         mem x a /\ mem y b /\ mem z b /\
         q208416_relates mem M f x y /\
         q208416_relates mem M f x z
         ==> y = z)``);

val q208416_injection_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_injection_def",
  ``q208416_injection
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) f a b <=>
      q208416_function_between mem M f a b /\
      !x x' y.
        x IN M /\ x' IN M /\ y IN M /\
        mem x a /\ mem x' a /\ mem y b /\
        q208416_relates mem M f x y /\
        q208416_relates mem M f x' y
        ==> x = x'``);

val q208416_successor_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_successor_def",
  ``q208416_successor
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) x s <=>
      x IN M /\ s IN M /\
      !z. z IN M ==> (mem z s <=> mem z x \/ z = x)``);

val q208416_inductive_object_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_inductive_object_def",
  ``q208416_inductive_object
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) i <=>
      i IN M /\
      (?e. q208416_empty_object mem M e /\ mem e i) /\
      !x.
        x IN M /\ mem x i ==>
        ?s. q208416_successor mem M x s /\ mem s i``);

val q208416_omega_object_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_omega_object_def",
  ``q208416_omega_object
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) omega <=>
      q208416_inductive_object mem M omega /\
      !i.
        q208416_inductive_object mem M i ==>
        q208416_internal_subset mem M omega i``);

val q208416_powerset_object_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_powerset_object_def",
  ``q208416_powerset_object
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) a p <=>
      a IN M /\ p IN M /\
      !x.
        x IN M ==>
        (mem x p <=> q208416_internal_subset mem M x a)``);

val q208416_choice_function_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_choice_function_def",
  ``q208416_choice_function
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) a f <=>
      a IN M /\ f IN M /\
      (!p.
         p IN M /\ mem p f ==>
         ?x y.
           x IN M /\ y IN M /\
           mem x a /\ mem y x /\
           q208416_ordered_pair mem M x y p) /\
      (!x.
         x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
         ?y.
           y IN M /\ mem y x /\
           q208416_relates mem M f x y) /\
      (!x y z.
         x IN M /\ y IN M /\ z IN M /\
         q208416_relates mem M f x y /\
         q208416_relates mem M f x z
         ==> y = z)``);

val q208416_zfc_model_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_zfc_model_def",
  ``q208416_zfc_model
      (mem : num -> num -> bool)
      (M : num set)
      (sat : (num -> num) -> num -> bool) <=>
      q208416_tarski mem M sat /\
      (!x y.
         x IN M /\ y IN M /\
         (!z. z IN M ==> (mem z x <=> mem z y))
         ==> x = y) /\
      (?e. q208416_empty_object mem M e) /\
      (!x y.
         x IN M /\ y IN M ==>
         ?p. q208416_unordered_pair mem M x y p) /\
      (!a.
         a IN M ==>
         ?u.
           u IN M /\
           !z.
             z IN M ==>
             (mem z u <=>
              ?y. y IN M /\ mem y a /\ mem z y)) /\
      (!a.
         a IN M ==>
         ?p. q208416_powerset_object mem M a p) /\
      (?i. q208416_inductive_object mem M i) /\
      (!a.
         a IN M /\ (?x. x IN M /\ mem x a) ==>
         ?x.
           x IN M /\ mem x a /\
           !y. y IN M /\ mem y a ==> ~mem y x) /\
      (!phi v a.
         q208416_valuation M v /\ a IN M ==>
         ?b.
           b IN M /\
           !x.
             x IN M ==>
             (mem x b <=>
              mem x a /\ sat ((0 =+ x) v) phi)) /\
      (!phi v a.
         q208416_valuation M v /\ a IN M /\
         (!x.
            x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
            ?y.
              y IN M /\
              sat ((1 =+ y) ((0 =+ x) v)) phi /\
              (!y'.
                 y' IN M /\
                 sat ((1 =+ y') ((0 =+ x) v)) phi
                 ==> y' = y))
         ==>
         ?b.
           b IN M /\
           !y.
             y IN M ==>
             (mem y b <=>
              ?x.
                x IN M /\ mem x a /\
                sat ((1 =+ y) ((0 =+ x) v)) phi)) /\
      (!a.
         a IN M /\
         (!x.
            x IN M /\ mem x a ==>
            ?y. y IN M /\ mem y x)
         ==>
         ?f. q208416_choice_function mem M a f)``);

val q208416_CH_def = new_definition (
  "q208416_CH_def",
  ``q208416_CH
      (mem : num -> num -> bool) (M : num set) <=>
      ?omega p.
        q208416_omega_object mem M omega /\
        q208416_powerset_object mem M omega p /\
        !x.
          x IN M /\ q208416_internal_subset mem M x p
          ==>
          (?f. q208416_injection mem M f x omega) \/
          (?f. q208416_injection mem M f p x)``);

val independence_of_CH =
  ``(?M : num set.
       ?mem : num -> num -> bool.
       ?sat : (num -> num) -> num -> bool.
         q208416_zfc_model mem M sat /\
         q208416_CH mem M) /\
    (?M : num set.
       ?mem : num -> num -> bool.
       ?sat : (num -> num) -> num -> bool.
         q208416_zfc_model mem M sat /\
         ~q208416_CH mem M)``;

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q208416
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q208416), "Independence of the continuum
  hypothesis": ZFC has a model satisfying the continuum hypothesis and a
  model satisfying its negation, equivalently neither CH nor its negation is
  provable in ZFC. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's Godel-coded formulas and satisfaction operation are used with an
  arbitrary domain D and arbitrary binary membership relation R.  Q208416Valid
  says that every valuation in D satisfies a coded formula.  Q208416ZFCModel
  requires a nonempty relational model whose carrier relation is extensional,
  and which satisfies the standard pure-membership ZF axioms, every instance
  of Replacement, and the displayed closed Choice sentence.  The explicit
  Q208416Extensional condition is essential because SetMM's coded equality =g
  means equality of R-predecessors; extensionality makes it coincide with
  ambient equality on D.  Thus the ambient equalities used below for ordinal
  trichotomy, pairs, and function uniqueness have the same meaning as coded
  equality in Choice and Replacement.  Over ZF, Replacement is equivalent to
  the source's strong Collection scheme, Choice is equivalent to its Zorn
  axiom, and the source's primitive empty-set, ordered-pair, union, powerset,
  and omega symbols form a conservative definitional extension.

  Q208416CH is entirely internal to the relational model.  Its ordinals,
  least limit ordinal, powerset, ordered pairs, functions, and surjections are
  all interpreted through R.  The comparison Q208416AtMost A B says that an
  internally represented subset of B surjects onto A, matching the source
  definition.  Thus Q208416CH states that every internal ordinal A satisfies
  A <= omega or P(omega) <= A.

  By first-order completeness, the two internal model existences in the final
  unproved $a assertion are respectively equivalent to non-provability of
  not-CH and non-provability of CH in the source theory.
$)

$c
  Q208416Choice Q208416Valid Q208416Extensional Q208416ZFCModel
  Q208416Subset Q208416Transitive Q208416Trichotomous
  Q208416WellFounded Q208416Ordinal Q208416Empty
  Q208416Limit Q208416Omega Q208416Power
  Q208416Singleton Q208416UnorderedPair Q208416OrderedPair
  Q208416SurjSubset Q208416AtMost Q208416CH
$.

q208416-choice-syntax $a class Q208416Choice $.
q208416-valid-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Valid D R U ) $.
q208416-extensional-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Extensional D R ) $.
q208416-zfc-model-syntax $a wff ( Q208416ZFCModel D R ) $.
q208416-subset-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Subset D R A B ) $.
q208416-transitive-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Transitive D R A ) $.
q208416-trichotomous-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Trichotomous D R A ) $.
q208416-well-founded-syntax $a wff ( Q208416WellFounded D R A ) $.
q208416-ordinal-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Ordinal D R A ) $.
q208416-empty-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Empty D R A ) $.
q208416-limit-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Limit D R A B ) $.
q208416-omega-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Omega D R A ) $.
q208416-power-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Power D R A B ) $.
q208416-singleton-syntax $a wff ( Q208416Singleton D R A B ) $.
q208416-unordered-pair-syntax
  $a wff ( Q208416UnorderedPair D R A B C ) $.
q208416-ordered-pair-syntax
  $a wff ( Q208416OrderedPair D R A B C ) $.
q208416-surj-subset-syntax
  $a wff ( Q208416SurjSubset D R F A B ) $.
q208416-at-most-syntax $a wff ( Q208416AtMost D R A B ) $.
q208416-ch-syntax $a wff ( Q208416CH D R ) $.

q208416-valid-definition $a |- (
  ( Q208416Valid D R U )
  <->
  ( ( ( ( D Sat R ) ` _om ) ` U ) = ( D ^m _om ) )
) $.

${
  $d D R x y z $.
  q208416-extensional-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Extensional D R )
    <->
    A. x e. D A. y e. D
      (
        A. z e. D
          (
            <. z , x >. e. R
            <->
            <. z , y >. e. R
          )
        ->
        x = y
      )
  ) $.
$}

$(
  This is the closed pure-membership Choice sentence used in the ZFC model
  predicate.  Variable indices are: 0 family, 1 and 2 family members,
  3 selected element, and 4 choice set.
$)
q208416-choice-definition $a |- Q208416Choice =
  A.g (/) (
    (
      (
        A.g 1o (
          ( 1o e.g (/) )
          ->g
          E.g 2o ( 2o e.g 1o )
        )
        /\g
        A.g 1o A.g 2o (
          (
            (
              ( 1o e.g (/) )
              /\g
              ( 2o e.g (/) )
            )
            /\g
            -.g ( 1o =g 2o )
          )
          ->g
          -.g E.g 3o (
            ( 3o e.g 1o )
            /\g
            ( 3o e.g 2o )
          )
        )
      )
      ->g
      E.g 4o A.g 1o (
        ( 1o e.g (/) )
        ->g
        E.g 3o (
          (
            ( 3o e.g 1o )
            /\g
            ( 3o e.g 4o )
          )
          /\g
          A.g 2o (
            (
              ( 2o e.g 1o )
              /\g
              ( 2o e.g 4o )
            )
            ->g
            ( 2o =g 3o )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.

${
  $d D R u $.
  q208416-zfc-model-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416ZFCModel D R )
    <->
    (
      (
        (
          D =/= (/)
          /\
          R C_ ( D X. D )
        )
        /\
        ( Q208416Extensional D R )
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          ( Q208416Valid D R AxPow )
          /\
          ( Q208416Valid D R AxUn )
        )
        /\
        (
          (
            ( Q208416Valid D R AxReg )
            /\
            ( Q208416Valid D R AxInf )
          )
          /\
          A. u e. ( Fmla ` _om )
            ( Q208416Valid D R ( AxRep ` u ) )
        )
        /\
        ( Q208416Valid D R Q208416Choice )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A B x $.
  q208416-subset-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Subset D R A B )
    <->
    (
      (
        A e. D
        /\
        B e. D
      )
      /\
      A. x e. D
        (
          <. x , A >. e. R
          ->
          <. x , B >. e. R
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A x y $.
  q208416-transitive-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Transitive D R A )
    <->
    (
      A e. D
      /\
      A. x e. D
        (
          <. x , A >. e. R
          ->
          A. y e. D
            (
              <. y , x >. e. R
              ->
              <. y , A >. e. R
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A x y $.
  q208416-trichotomous-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Trichotomous D R A )
    <->
    A. x e. D A. y e. D
      (
        (
          <. x , A >. e. R
          /\
          <. y , A >. e. R
        )
        ->
        (
          x = y
          \/
          (
            <. x , y >. e. R
            \/
            <. y , x >. e. R
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A s x y $.
  q208416-well-founded-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416WellFounded D R A )
    <->
    A. s e. D
      (
        (
          ( Q208416Subset D R s A )
          /\
          E. x e. D <. x , s >. e. R
        )
        ->
        E. x e. D
          (
            <. x , s >. e. R
            /\
            A. y e. D
              (
                <. y , s >. e. R
                ->
                -. <. y , x >. e. R
              )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

q208416-ordinal-definition $a |- (
  ( Q208416Ordinal D R A )
  <->
  (
    ( Q208416Transitive D R A )
    /\
    (
      ( Q208416WellFounded D R A )
      /\
      ( Q208416Trichotomous D R A )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d D R A x $.
  q208416-empty-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Empty D R A )
    <->
    (
      A e. D
      /\
      A. x e. D -. <. x , A >. e. R
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A B x y $.
  q208416-limit-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Limit D R A B )
    <->
    (
      (
        ( Q208416Empty D R A )
        /\
        <. A , B >. e. R
      )
      /\
      A. x e. D
        (
          <. x , B >. e. R
          ->
          E. y e. D
            (
              <. y , B >. e. R
              /\
              <. x , y >. e. R
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A a e $.
  q208416-omega-definition $a |- (
    ( Q208416Omega D R A )
    <->
    (
      (
        A e. D
        /\
        ( Q208416Ordinal D R A )
      )
      /\
      E. e e. D
        (
          ( Q208416Limit D R e A )
          /\
          A. a e. D
            (
              (
                ( Q208416Ordinal D R a )
                /\
                ( Q208416Limit D R e a )
              )
              ->
              ( Q208416Subset D R A a )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D R A B x $.

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q208416,
:: "Independence of the continuum hypothesis": over the exact free first-order
:: de Bruijn term and formula syntax, neither the fixed CH sentence nor its
:: negation is derivable from the fixed Flypitch ZFC theory. This file contains
:: no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, MCART_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1,
    FINSUB_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, CARD_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, MCART_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSET_1, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1,
    XTUPLE_0, XXREAL_0, BINOP_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM, REAL;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for Term,Formula being non empty set,
      TVar being Function of NAT,Term,
      TEmpty,TOmega being Element of Term,
      TPair being Function of [:Term,Term:],Term,
      TPowerset,TUnion being Function of Term,Term,
      FFalse being Element of Formula,
      FEq,FMem being Function of [:Term,Term:],Formula,
      FImp being Function of [:Formula,Formula:],Formula,
      FAll being Function of Formula,Formula,
      FNeg,FEx being Function of Formula,Formula,
      FAnd,FOr,FIff being Function of [:Formula,Formula:],Formula,
      termRank being Function of Term,NAT,
      formulaRank being Function of Formula,NAT,
      liftTerm being Function of [:Term,NAT,NAT:],Term,
      substTerm being Function of [:Term,Term,NAT:],Term,
      liftFormula being Function of [:Formula,NAT,NAT:],Formula,
      substFormula being Function of [:Formula,Term,NAT:],Formula,
      termBounded being Relation of NAT,Term,
      formulaBounded being Relation of NAT,Formula,
      allClosure being Function of [:NAT,Formula:],Formula,
      subsetFormula being Function of [:Term,Term:],Formula,
      transitiveFormula,epsilonTrichotomyFormula,
        epsilonWellFoundedFormula,ordinalFormula being Element of Formula,
      axiomEmptyset,axiomOrderedPairs,axiomExtensionality,
        axiomUnion,axiomPowerset,axiomInfinity,axiomRegularity,
        zornsLemma being Element of Formula,
      collectionAxiom being Function of [:NAT,Formula:],Formula,
      ZFC being Subset of Formula,
      isFunctionFormula,isTotalReversedFormula,
        isReversedFunctionFormula,atMostFormula,CH being Element of Formula,
      liftOne being Function of Formula,Formula,
      liftContext being Function of bool Formula,bool Formula,
      provable being Relation of bool Formula,Formula
  st
    Term = rng TVar \/ {TEmpty,TOmega} \/ rng TPair \/
      rng TPowerset \/ rng TUnion &
    Formula = {FFalse} \/ rng FEq \/ rng FMem \/ rng FImp \/ rng FAll &

    TVar is one-to-one &
    TPair is one-to-one &
    TPowerset is one-to-one &
    TUnion is one-to-one &
    TEmpty <> TOmega &
    rng TVar misses {TEmpty,TOmega} &
    rng TPair misses {TEmpty,TOmega} &
    rng TPowerset misses {TEmpty,TOmega} &
    rng TUnion misses {TEmpty,TOmega} &
    rng TVar misses rng TPair &
    rng TVar misses rng TPowerset &
    rng TVar misses rng TUnion &
    rng TPair misses rng TPowerset &
    rng TPair misses rng TUnion &
    rng TPowerset misses rng TUnion &

    FEq is one-to-one &
    FMem is one-to-one &
    FImp is one-to-one &
    FAll is one-to-one &
    {FFalse} misses rng FEq &
    {FFalse} misses rng FMem &
    {FFalse} misses rng FImp &
    {FFalse} misses rng FAll &
    rng FEq misses rng FMem &
    rng FEq misses rng FImp &
    rng FEq misses rng FAll &
    rng FMem misses rng FImp &
    rng FMem misses rng FAll &
    rng FImp misses rng FAll &

    (for n being Nat holds termRank.(TVar.n) = 0) &
    termRank.TEmpty = 0 & termRank.TOmega = 0 &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      termRank.(TPair.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1) &
    (for t being Element of Term holds
      termRank.(TPowerset.t) = termRank.t + 1 &
      termRank.(TUnion.t) = termRank.t + 1) &
    formulaRank.FFalse = 0 &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      formulaRank.(FEq.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1 &
      formulaRank.(FMem.(s,t)) = termRank.s + termRank.t + 1) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula holds
      formulaRank.(FImp.(A,B)) = formulaRank.A + formulaRank.B + 1) &
    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      formulaRank.(FAll.A) = formulaRank.A + 1) &

    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      FNeg.A = FImp.(A,FFalse) &
      FEx.A = FNeg.(FAll.(FNeg.A))) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula holds
      FAnd.(A,B) = FNeg.(FImp.(A,FNeg.B)) &
      FOr.(A,B) = FImp.(FNeg.A,B) &
      FIff.(A,B) = FAnd.(FImp.(A,B),FImp.(B,A))) &

    (for k,n,m being Nat holds
      (m <= k implies liftTerm.[TVar.k,n,m] = TVar.(k+n)) &
      (not m <= k implies liftTerm.[TVar.k,n,m] = TVar.k)) &
    (for n,m being Nat holds
      liftTerm.[TEmpty,n,m] = TEmpty &
      liftTerm.[TOmega,n,m] = TOmega) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term,n,m being Nat holds
      liftTerm.[TPair.(s,t),n,m] =
        TPair.(liftTerm.[s,n,m],liftTerm.[t,n,m])) &
    (for t being Element of Term,n,m being Nat holds
      liftTerm.[TPowerset.t,n,m] =
        TPowerset.(liftTerm.[t,n,m]) &
      liftTerm.[TUnion.t,n,m] = TUnion.(liftTerm.[t,n,m])) &

    (for k,n being Nat,s being Element of Term holds
      (k < n implies substTerm.[TVar.k,s,n] = TVar.k) &
      (k = n implies substTerm.[TVar.k,s,n] =
        liftTerm.[s,n,0]) &
      (n < k implies substTerm.[TVar.k,s,n] = TVar.(k-1))) &
    (for s being Element of Term,n being Nat holds
      substTerm.[TEmpty,s,n] = TEmpty &
      substTerm.[TOmega,s,n] = TOmega) &
    (for s,t,u being Element of Term,n being Nat holds
      substTerm.[TPair.(t,u),s,n] =
        TPair.(substTerm.[t,s,n],substTerm.[u,s,n])) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term,n being Nat holds
      substTerm.[TPowerset.t,s,n] =
        TPowerset.(substTerm.[t,s,n]) &
      substTerm.[TUnion.t,s,n] = TUnion.(substTerm.[t,s,n])) &

    (for n,m being Nat holds liftFormula.[FFalse,n,m] = FFalse) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term,n,m being Nat holds
      liftFormula.[FEq.(s,t),n,m] =
        FEq.(liftTerm.[s,n,m],liftTerm.[t,n,m]) &
      liftFormula.[FMem.(s,t),n,m] =
        FMem.(liftTerm.[s,n,m],liftTerm.[t,n,m])) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula,n,m being Nat holds
      liftFormula.[FImp.(A,B),n,m] =
        FImp.(liftFormula.[A,n,m],liftFormula.[B,n,m])) &
    (for A being Element of Formula,n,m being Nat holds
      liftFormula.[FAll.A,n,m] =
        FAll.(liftFormula.[A,n,m+1])) &

    (for s being Element of Term,n being Nat holds
      substFormula.[FFalse,s,n] = FFalse) &
    (for s,t,u being Element of Term,n being Nat holds
      substFormula.[FEq.(t,u),s,n] =
        FEq.(substTerm.[t,s,n],substTerm.[u,s,n]) &
      substFormula.[FMem.(t,u),s,n] =
        FMem.(substTerm.[t,s,n],substTerm.[u,s,n])) &
    (for A,B being Element of Formula,s being Element of Term,
        n being Nat holds
      substFormula.[FImp.(A,B),s,n] =
        FImp.(substFormula.[A,s,n],substFormula.[B,s,n])) &
    (for A being Element of Formula,s being Element of Term,
        n being Nat holds
      substFormula.[FAll.A,s,n] =
        FAll.(substFormula.[A,s,n+1])) &

    (for b,k being Nat holds
      ([b,TVar.k] in termBounded iff k < b)) &
    (for b being Nat holds
      [b,TEmpty] in termBounded & [b,TOmega] in termBounded) &
    (for b being Nat,s,t being Element of Term holds
      ([b,TPair.(s,t)] in termBounded iff
        [b,s] in termBounded & [b,t] in termBounded)) &
    (for b being Nat,t being Element of Term holds
      ([b,TPowerset.t] in termBounded iff [b,t] in termBounded) &
      ([b,TUnion.t] in termBounded iff [b,t] in termBounded)) &
    (for b being Nat holds [b,FFalse] in formulaBounded) &
    (for b being Nat,s,t being Element of Term holds
      ([b,FEq.(s,t)] in formulaBounded iff
        [b,s] in termBounded & [b,t] in termBounded) &
      ([b,FMem.(s,t)] in formulaBounded iff
        [b,s] in termBounded & [b,t] in termBounded)) &
    (for b being Nat,A,B being Element of Formula holds
      ([b,FImp.(A,B)] in formulaBounded iff
        [b,A] in formulaBounded & [b,B] in formulaBounded)) &
    (for b being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      ([b,FAll.A] in formulaBounded iff
        [b+1,A] in formulaBounded)) &

    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      allClosure.(0,A) = A) &
    (for n being Nat,A being Element of Formula holds
      allClosure.(n+1,A) = FAll.(allClosure.(n,A))) &
    (for s,t being Element of Term holds
      subsetFormula.(s,t) =
        FAll.(FImp.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,liftTerm.[s,1,0]),
          FMem.(TVar.0,liftTerm.[t,1,0])))) &

    transitiveFormula =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        subsetFormula.(TVar.0,TVar.1))) &
    epsilonTrichotomyFormula =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        FAll.(FImp.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
          FOr.(FOr.(
            FEq.(TVar.1,TVar.0),
            FMem.(TVar.1,TVar.0)),
            FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1)))))) &
    epsilonWellFoundedFormula =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        subsetFormula.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
        FImp.(
          FNeg.(FEq.(TVar.0,TEmpty)),
          FEx.(FAnd.(
            FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
            FAll.(FImp.(
              FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
              FNeg.(FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1))))))))) &
    ordinalFormula =
      FAnd.(FAnd.(epsilonTrichotomyFormula,
        epsilonWellFoundedFormula),transitiveFormula) &

    axiomEmptyset =
      FAll.(FNeg.(FMem.(TVar.0,TEmpty))) &
    axiomOrderedPairs =
      FAll.(FAll.(FAll.(FAll.(
        FIff.(
          FEq.(TPair.(TVar.3,TVar.2),TPair.(TVar.1,TVar.0)),
          FAnd.(FEq.(TVar.3,TVar.1),FEq.(TVar.2,TVar.0))))))) &
    axiomExtensionality =
      FAll.(FAll.(FImp.(
        FAll.(FIff.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1))),
        FEq.(TVar.1,TVar.0)))) &
    axiomUnion =
      FAll.(FAll.(FIff.(
        FMem.(TVar.0,TUnion.(TVar.1)),
        FEx.(FAnd.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
          FMem.(TVar.1,TVar.0)))))) &
    axiomPowerset =
      FAll.(FAll.(FIff.(
        FMem.(TVar.0,TPowerset.(TVar.1)),
        FAll.(FImp.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2)))))) &
    axiomInfinity =
      FAnd.(
        FAnd.(
          FMem.(TEmpty,TOmega),
          FAll.(FImp.(
            FMem.(TVar.0,TOmega),
            FEx.(FAnd.(
              FMem.(TVar.0,TOmega),
              FMem.(TVar.1,TVar.0)))))),
        FAnd.(
          FEx.(FAnd.(
            ordinalFormula,
            FEq.(TOmega,TVar.0))),
          FAll.(FImp.(
            ordinalFormula,
            FImp.(
              FAnd.(
                FMem.(TEmpty,TVar.0),
                FAll.(FImp.(
                  FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
                  FEx.(FAnd.(
                    FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
                    FMem.(TVar.1,TVar.0)))))),
              subsetFormula.(TOmega,TVar.0)))))) &
    axiomRegularity =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        FNeg.(FEq.(TVar.0,TEmpty)),
        FEx.(FAnd.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
          FAll.(FImp.(
            FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
            FNeg.(FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1)))))))) &
    zornsLemma =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        FNeg.(FEq.(TVar.0,TEmpty)),
        FImp.(
          FAll.(FImp.(
            FAnd.(
              subsetFormula.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
              FAll.(FAll.(FImp.(
                FAnd.(
                  FMem.(TVar.1,TVar.2),
                  FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2)),
                FOr.(
                  subsetFormula.(TVar.1,TVar.0),
                  subsetFormula.(TVar.0,TVar.1)))))),
            FMem.(TUnion.(TVar.0),TVar.1))),
          FEx.(FAnd.(
            FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
            FAll.(FImp.(
              FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
              FImp.(
                subsetFormula.(TVar.1,TVar.0),
                FEq.(TVar.1,TVar.0))))))))) &

    (for n being Nat,phi being Element of Formula holds
      collectionAxiom.(n,phi) =
        allClosure.(n+1,FImp.(
          FAll.(FImp.(
            FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
            FEx.(liftFormula.[phi,1,2]))),
          FEx.(FAnd.(
            FAll.(FImp.(
              FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
              FEx.(FAnd.(
                FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
                liftFormula.[phi,2,2])))),
            FAll.(FImp.(
              FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.1),
              FEx.(FAnd.(
                FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.3),
                substFormula.[
                  liftFormula.[phi,3,2],TVar.1,0]))))))))) &
    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      (A in ZFC iff
        A = axiomEmptyset or A = axiomOrderedPairs or
        A = axiomExtensionality or A = axiomUnion or
        A = axiomPowerset or A = axiomInfinity or
        A = axiomRegularity or A = zornsLemma or
        ex n being Nat,phi being Element of Formula st
          [n+2,phi] in formulaBounded &
          A = collectionAxiom.(n,phi))) &

    isFunctionFormula =
      FAll.(FAll.(FAll.(FAll.(FImp.(
        FAnd.(
          FMem.(TPair.(TVar.3,TVar.1),TVar.4),
          FMem.(TPair.(TVar.2,TVar.0),TVar.4)),
        FImp.(
          FEq.(TVar.3,TVar.2),
          FEq.(TVar.1,TVar.0))))))) &
    isTotalReversedFormula =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.2),
        FEx.(FAnd.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.4),
          FMem.(TPair.(TVar.1,TVar.0),TVar.2))))) &
    isReversedFunctionFormula =
      FAnd.(isFunctionFormula,isTotalReversedFormula) &
    atMostFormula =
      FEx.(FEx.(FAnd.(
        FAnd.(
          subsetFormula.(TVar.1,TVar.3),
          isReversedFunctionFormula),
        FAll.(FImp.(
          FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.3),
          FEx.(FAnd.(
            FMem.(TVar.0,TVar.3),
            FMem.(TPair.(TVar.0,TVar.1),TVar.2)))))))) &
    CH =
      FAll.(FImp.(
        ordinalFormula,
        FOr.(
          substFormula.[atMostFormula,TOmega,1],
          substFormula.[atMostFormula,TPowerset.TOmega,0]))) &

    (for A being Element of Formula holds
      liftOne.A = liftFormula.[A,1,0]) &
    (for Gamma being Subset of Formula,B being Element of Formula holds
      (B in liftContext.Gamma iff
        ex A being Element of Formula st
          A in Gamma & B = liftOne.A)) &
    (for Gamma being Subset of Formula,A being Element of Formula holds
      ([Gamma,A] in provable iff
        for P being Relation of bool Formula,Formula st
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C being Element of Formula st
            C in Delta holds [Delta,C] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C,D being Element of Formula st
            [Delta \/ {C},D] in P
            holds [Delta,FImp.(C,D)] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C,D being Element of Formula st
            [Delta,FImp.(C,D)] in P & [Delta,C] in P
            holds [Delta,D] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C being Element of Formula st
            [Delta \/ {FNeg.C},FFalse] in P
            holds [Delta,C] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C being Element of Formula st
            [liftContext.Delta,C] in P
            holds [Delta,FAll.C] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C being Element of Formula,
              t being Element of Term st
            [Delta,FAll.C] in P
            holds [Delta,substFormula.[C,t,0]] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,t being Element of Term holds
            [Delta,FEq.(t,t)] in P) &
          (for Delta being Subset of Formula,C being Element of Formula,
              s,t being Element of Term st
            [Delta,FEq.(s,t)] in P &
            [Delta,substFormula.[C,s,0]] in P
            holds [Delta,substFormula.[C,t,0]] in P)
        holds [Gamma,A] in P))
  holds
    not [ZFC,CH] in provable &
    not [ZFC,FNeg.CH] in provable
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q208416,
% "Independence of the continuum hypothesis": neither the fixed first-order
% sentence expressing CH nor its negation is derivable from the fixed ZFC theory.
% This file contains no proof.

q208416_term: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  q208416_var(variable_index: nat): q208416_var?
  q208416_empty: q208416_empty?
  q208416_pair(pair_left, pair_right: q208416_term): q208416_pair?
  q208416_omega: q208416_omega?
  q208416_powerset(powerset_arg: q208416_term): q208416_powerset?
  q208416_union(union_arg: q208416_term): q208416_union?
END q208416_term

q208416_formula: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  IMPORTING q208416_term
  q208416_false: q208416_false?
  q208416_eq(equal_left, equal_right: q208416_term): q208416_eq?
  q208416_mem(member_left, member_right: q208416_term): q208416_mem?
  q208416_imp(
      implication_left,
      implication_right: q208416_formula): q208416_imp?
  q208416_all(universal_body: q208416_formula): q208416_all?
END q208416_formula

Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING q208416_term, q208416_formula

  term: TYPE = q208416_term
  fm: TYPE = q208416_formula
  formula_set: TYPE = [fm -> bool]

  variable(index: nat): term =
    q208416_var(index)

  negate(A: fm): fm =
    q208416_imp(A, q208416_false)

  conjoin(A, B: fm): fm =
    negate(q208416_imp(A, negate(B)))

  disjoin(A, B: fm): fm =
    q208416_imp(negate(A), B)

  biconditional(A, B: fm): fm =
    conjoin(q208416_imp(A, B), q208416_imp(B, A))

  existential(A: fm): fm =
    negate(q208416_all(negate(A)))

  lift_term_at(
      t: term,
      amount: nat,
      cutoff: nat): RECURSIVE term =
    CASES t OF
      q208416_var(index):
        q208416_var(
          IF cutoff <= index THEN index + amount ELSE index ENDIF),
      q208416_empty:
        q208416_empty,
      q208416_pair(left, right):
        q208416_pair(
          lift_term_at(left, amount, cutoff),
          lift_term_at(right, amount, cutoff)),
      q208416_omega:
        q208416_omega,
      q208416_powerset(arg):
        q208416_powerset(lift_term_at(arg, amount, cutoff)),
      q208416_union(arg):
        q208416_union(lift_term_at(arg, amount, cutoff))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  substitute_term(
      t: term,
      replacement: term,
      index: nat): RECURSIVE term =
    CASES t OF
      q208416_var(variable_index):
        IF variable_index < index THEN
          q208416_var(variable_index)
        ELSIF variable_index = index THEN
          lift_term_at(replacement, index, 0)
        ELSE
          q208416_var(variable_index - 1)
        ENDIF,
      q208416_empty:
        q208416_empty,
      q208416_pair(left, right):
        q208416_pair(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index)),
      q208416_omega:
        q208416_omega,
      q208416_powerset(arg):
        q208416_powerset(
          substitute_term(arg, replacement, index)),
      q208416_union(arg):
        q208416_union(
          substitute_term(arg, replacement, index))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  lift_formula_at(
      A: fm,
      amount: nat,
      cutoff: nat): RECURSIVE fm =
    CASES A OF
      q208416_false:
        q208416_false,
      q208416_eq(left, right):
        q208416_eq(
          lift_term_at(left, amount, cutoff),
          lift_term_at(right, amount, cutoff)),
      q208416_mem(left, right):
        q208416_mem(
          lift_term_at(left, amount, cutoff),
          lift_term_at(right, amount, cutoff)),
      q208416_imp(left, right):
        q208416_imp(
          lift_formula_at(left, amount, cutoff),
          lift_formula_at(right, amount, cutoff)),
      q208416_all(body):
        q208416_all(
          lift_formula_at(body, amount, cutoff + 1))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE A BY <<

  substitute_formula(
      A: fm,
      replacement: term,
      index: nat): RECURSIVE fm =
    CASES A OF
      q208416_false:
        q208416_false,
      q208416_eq(left, right):
        q208416_eq(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index)),
      q208416_mem(left, right):
        q208416_mem(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index)),
      q208416_imp(left, right):
        q208416_imp(
          substitute_formula(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_formula(right, replacement, index)),
      q208416_all(body):
        q208416_all(
          substitute_formula(body, replacement, index + 1))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE A BY <<

  term_bounded(bound: nat, t: term): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES t OF
      q208416_var(index):
        index < bound,
      q208416_empty:
        TRUE,
      q208416_pair(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right),
      q208416_omega:
        TRUE,
      q208416_powerset(arg):
        term_bounded(bound, arg),
      q208416_union(arg):
        term_bounded(bound, arg)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  formula_bounded(bound: nat, A: fm): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES A OF
      q208416_false:
        TRUE,
      q208416_eq(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right),
      q208416_mem(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right),
      q208416_imp(left, right):
        formula_bounded(bound, left)
          AND formula_bounded(bound, right),
      q208416_all(body):
        formula_bounded(bound + 1, body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE A BY <<

  universal_closure(count: nat, A: fm): RECURSIVE fm =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      A
    ELSE
      q208416_all(universal_closure(count - 1, A))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  subset_formula(left, right: term): fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        q208416_mem(
          variable(0),
          lift_term_at(left, 1, 0)),
        q208416_mem(
          variable(0),
          lift_term_at(right, 1, 0))))

  transitive_formula: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
        subset_formula(variable(0), variable(1))))

  epsilon_trichotomy_formula: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
        q208416_all(
          q208416_imp(
            q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
            disjoin(
              disjoin(
                q208416_eq(variable(1), variable(0)),
                q208416_mem(variable(1), variable(0))),
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)))))))

  epsilon_well_founded_formula: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        subset_formula(variable(0), variable(1)),
        q208416_imp(
          negate(q208416_eq(variable(0), q208416_empty)),
          existential(
            conjoin(
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
              q208416_all(
                q208416_imp(
                  q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
                  negate(
                    q208416_mem(
                      variable(0), variable(1))))))))))

  ordinal_formula: fm =
    conjoin(
      conjoin(
        epsilon_trichotomy_formula,
        epsilon_well_founded_formula),
      transitive_formula)

  axiom_emptyset: fm =
    q208416_all(
      negate(
        q208416_mem(variable(0), q208416_empty)))

  axiom_ordered_pairs: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_all(
        q208416_all(
          q208416_all(
            biconditional(
              q208416_eq(
                q208416_pair(variable(3), variable(2)),
                q208416_pair(variable(1), variable(0))),
              conjoin(
                q208416_eq(variable(3), variable(1)),
                q208416_eq(variable(2), variable(0))))))))

  axiom_extensionality: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_all(
        q208416_imp(
          q208416_all(
            biconditional(
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)))),
          q208416_eq(variable(1), variable(0)))))

  axiom_union: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_all(
        biconditional(
          q208416_mem(
            variable(0),
            q208416_union(variable(1))),
          existential(
            conjoin(
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
              q208416_mem(variable(1), variable(0)))))))

  axiom_powerset: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_all(
        biconditional(
          q208416_mem(
            variable(0),
            q208416_powerset(variable(1))),
          q208416_all(
            q208416_imp(
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)))))))

  axiom_infinity: fm =
    conjoin(
      conjoin(
        q208416_mem(q208416_empty, q208416_omega),
        q208416_all(
          q208416_imp(
            q208416_mem(variable(0), q208416_omega),
            existential(
              conjoin(
                q208416_mem(variable(0), q208416_omega),
                q208416_mem(variable(1), variable(0))))))),
      conjoin(
        existential(
          conjoin(
            ordinal_formula,
            q208416_eq(q208416_omega, variable(0)))),
        q208416_all(
          q208416_imp(
            ordinal_formula,
            q208416_imp(
              conjoin(
                q208416_mem(q208416_empty, variable(0)),
                q208416_all(
                  q208416_imp(
                    q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
                    existential(
                      conjoin(
                        q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
                        q208416_mem(
                          variable(1), variable(0))))))),
              subset_formula(
                q208416_omega, variable(0)))))))

  axiom_regularity: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        negate(
          q208416_eq(variable(0), q208416_empty)),
        existential(
          conjoin(
            q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
            q208416_all(
              q208416_imp(
                q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
                negate(
                  q208416_mem(
                    variable(0), variable(1)))))))))

  zorns_lemma: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        negate(
          q208416_eq(variable(0), q208416_empty)),
        q208416_imp(
          q208416_all(
            q208416_imp(
              conjoin(
                subset_formula(variable(0), variable(1)),
                q208416_all(
                  q208416_all(
                    q208416_imp(
                      conjoin(
                        q208416_mem(variable(1), variable(2)),
                        q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2))),
                      disjoin(
                        subset_formula(
                          variable(1), variable(0)),
                        subset_formula(
                          variable(0), variable(1))))))),
              q208416_mem(
                q208416_union(variable(0)),
                variable(1)))),
          existential(
            conjoin(
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
              q208416_all(
                q208416_imp(
                  q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
                  q208416_imp(
                    subset_formula(
                      variable(1), variable(0)),
                    q208416_eq(
                      variable(1), variable(0))))))))))

  collection_axiom(
      parameter_count: nat,
      phi: fm): fm =
    universal_closure(
      parameter_count + 1,
      q208416_imp(
        q208416_all(
          q208416_imp(
            q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
            existential(
              lift_formula_at(phi, 1, 2)))),
        existential(
          conjoin(
            q208416_all(
              q208416_imp(
                q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
                existential(
                  conjoin(
                    q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
                    lift_formula_at(phi, 2, 2))))),
            q208416_all(
              q208416_imp(
                q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(1)),
                existential(
                  conjoin(
                    q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(3)),
                    substitute_formula(
                      lift_formula_at(phi, 3, 2),
                      variable(1),
                      0)))))))))

  ZFC(A: fm): bool =
    A = axiom_emptyset
      OR A = axiom_ordered_pairs
      OR A = axiom_extensionality
      OR A = axiom_union
      OR A = axiom_powerset
      OR A = axiom_infinity
      OR A = axiom_regularity
      OR A = zorns_lemma
      OR
        EXISTS
            (parameter_count: nat),
            (phi: fm):
          formula_bounded(parameter_count + 2, phi)
            AND A = collection_axiom(parameter_count, phi)

  is_function_formula: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_all(
        q208416_all(
          q208416_all(
            q208416_imp(
              conjoin(
                q208416_mem(
                  q208416_pair(variable(3), variable(1)),
                  variable(4)),
                q208416_mem(
                  q208416_pair(variable(2), variable(0)),
                  variable(4))),
              q208416_imp(
                q208416_eq(variable(3), variable(2)),
                q208416_eq(variable(1), variable(0))))))))

  is_total_reversed_formula: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(2)),
        existential(
          conjoin(
            q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(4)),
            q208416_mem(
              q208416_pair(variable(1), variable(0)),
              variable(2))))))

  is_reversed_function_formula: fm =
    conjoin(
      is_function_formula,
      is_total_reversed_formula)

  at_most_formula: fm =
    existential(
      existential(
        conjoin(
          conjoin(
            subset_formula(variable(1), variable(3)),
            is_reversed_function_formula),
          q208416_all(
            q208416_imp(
              q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(3)),
              existential(
                conjoin(
                  q208416_mem(variable(0), variable(3)),
                  q208416_mem(
                    q208416_pair(
                      variable(0), variable(1)),
                    variable(2)))))))))

  CH: fm =
    q208416_all(
      q208416_imp(
        ordinal_formula,
        disjoin(
          substitute_formula(
            at_most_formula,
            q208416_omega,
            1),
          substitute_formula(
            at_most_formula,
            q208416_powerset(q208416_omega),
            0))))

  insert_formula(A: fm, Gamma: formula_set): formula_set =
    LAMBDA (B: fm):
      B = A OR Gamma(B)

  lifted_context(Gamma: formula_set): formula_set =
    LAMBDA (B: fm):
      EXISTS (A: fm):
        Gamma(A)
          AND B = lift_formula_at(A, 1, 0)

  prf(Gamma: formula_set, A: fm): INDUCTIVE bool =
    Gamma(A)
      OR
    (EXISTS (antecedent, consequent: fm):
      A = q208416_imp(antecedent, consequent)
        AND prf(
          insert_formula(antecedent, Gamma),
          consequent))
      OR
    (EXISTS (antecedent: fm):
      prf(Gamma, q208416_imp(antecedent, A))
        AND prf(Gamma, antecedent))
      OR
    prf(
      insert_formula(negate(A), Gamma),
      q208416_false)
      OR
    (EXISTS (body: fm):
      A = q208416_all(body)
        AND prf(lifted_context(Gamma), body))
      OR
    (EXISTS (body: fm), (t: term):
      prf(Gamma, q208416_all(body))
        AND A = substitute_formula(body, t, 0))
      OR
    (EXISTS (t: term):
      A = q208416_eq(t, t))
      OR
    (EXISTS
        (left, right: term),
        (body: fm):
      prf(Gamma, q208416_eq(left, right))
        AND prf(
          Gamma,
          substitute_formula(body, left, 0))
        AND A =
          substitute_formula(body, right, 0))

  provable(T: formula_set, A: fm): bool =
    prf(T, A)

  independent(T: formula_set, A: fm): bool =
    NOT provable(T, A)
      AND NOT provable(T, negate(A))

  independence_of_CH: bool =
    independent(ZFC, CH)
END Q208416_independence_of_the_continuum_hypothesis

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2093886
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2093886), "Primitive element theorem": every
-- finite-dimensional separable field extension is generated by one element.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Derivative
public import Mathlib.FieldTheory.IntermediateField.Adjoin.Defs
public import Mathlib.FieldTheory.Minpoly.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Defs

@[expose] public section

namespace Q2093886

variable (F E : Type*) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [FiniteDimensional F E]

/-- A finite-dimensional extension whose minimal polynomials are separable has a primitive
element. -/
theorem exists_primitive_element_statement
    (hsep : ∀ x : E, IsCoprime (minpoly F x) (Polynomial.derivative (minpoly F x))) :
    ∃ α : E, IntermediateField.adjoin F {α} = ⊤ := sorry

end Q2093886

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2093886
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2093886), "Primitive element theorem": every
  finite-dimensional separable field extension is generated over its base
  field by a single element. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Import ListNotations.

Record q2093886_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q2093886_zero : K;
  q2093886_one : K;
  q2093886_add : K -> K -> K;
  q2093886_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q2093886_neg : K -> K;
  q2093886_inv : K -> K;
  q2093886_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2093886_add x (q2093886_add y z) =
      q2093886_add (q2093886_add x y) z;
  q2093886_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q2093886_add x y = q2093886_add y x;
  q2093886_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q2093886_add x q2093886_zero = x;
  q2093886_add_neg :
    forall x : K, q2093886_add x (q2093886_neg x) = q2093886_zero;
  q2093886_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2093886_mul x (q2093886_mul y z) =
      q2093886_mul (q2093886_mul x y) z;
  q2093886_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q2093886_mul x y = q2093886_mul y x;
  q2093886_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q2093886_mul x q2093886_one = x;
  q2093886_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2093886_mul x (q2093886_add y z) =
      q2093886_add
        (q2093886_mul x y) (q2093886_mul x z);
  q2093886_inv_zero :
    q2093886_inv q2093886_zero = q2093886_zero;
  q2093886_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q2093886_zero ->
      q2093886_mul x (q2093886_inv x) = q2093886_one;
  q2093886_nontrivial : q2093886_zero <> q2093886_one
}.

Arguments q2093886_zero {K} _.
Arguments q2093886_one {K} _.
Arguments q2093886_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q2093886_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q2093886_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q2093886_inv {K} _ _.

Record q2093886_field_algebra
    (F E : Type)
    (FF : q2093886_field F)
    (FE : q2093886_field E) : Type := {
  q2093886_embed : F -> E;
  q2093886_embed_zero :
    q2093886_embed (q2093886_zero FF) = q2093886_zero FE;
  q2093886_embed_one :
    q2093886_embed (q2093886_one FF) = q2093886_one FE;
  q2093886_embed_add :
    forall a b : F,
      q2093886_embed (q2093886_add FF a b) =
      q2093886_add FE (q2093886_embed a) (q2093886_embed b);
  q2093886_embed_mul :
    forall a b : F,
      q2093886_embed (q2093886_mul FF a b) =
      q2093886_mul FE (q2093886_embed a) (q2093886_embed b);
  q2093886_embed_injective :
    forall a b : F,
      q2093886_embed a = q2093886_embed b -> a = b
}.

Arguments q2093886_embed {F E FF FE} _ _.

Fixpoint q2093886_nat_mul
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (n : nat) (x : K) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q2093886_zero FK
  | S m => q2093886_add FK x (q2093886_nat_mul FK m x)
  end.

Definition q2093886_polynomial (K : Type) : Type := list K.

Definition q2093886_polynomial_zero
    {K : Type} : q2093886_polynomial K :=
  [].

Definition q2093886_polynomial_one
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K) : q2093886_polynomial K :=
  [q2093886_one FK].

Fixpoint q2093886_polynomial_add
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (p q : q2093886_polynomial K) : q2093886_polynomial K :=
  match p, q with
  | [], _ => q
  | _, [] => p
  | a :: p', b :: q' =>
      q2093886_add FK a b ::
      q2093886_polynomial_add FK p' q'
  end.

Fixpoint q2093886_polynomial_mul
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (p q : q2093886_polynomial K) : q2093886_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: p' =>
      q2093886_polynomial_add FK
        (map (fun b => q2093886_mul FK a b) q)
        (q2093886_zero FK ::
          q2093886_polynomial_mul FK p' q)
  end.

Fixpoint q2093886_polynomial_derivative_aux
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (degree : nat)
    (p : q2093886_polynomial K) : q2093886_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      q2093886_nat_mul FK degree coefficient ::
      q2093886_polynomial_derivative_aux FK (S degree) rest
  end.

Definition q2093886_polynomial_derivative
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (p : q2093886_polynomial K) : q2093886_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | _ :: rest =>
      q2093886_polynomial_derivative_aux FK 1 rest
  end.

Definition q2093886_polynomial_equiv
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (p q : q2093886_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    nth n p (q2093886_zero FK) =
    nth n q (q2093886_zero FK).

Definition q2093886_polynomial_nonzero
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (p : q2093886_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  exists n : nat,
    nth n p (q2093886_zero FK) <> q2093886_zero FK.

Definition q2093886_polynomial_separable
    {K : Type}
    (FK : q2093886_field K)
    (p : q2093886_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  exists a b : q2093886_polynomial K,
    q2093886_polynomial_equiv FK
      (q2093886_polynomial_add FK
        (q2093886_polynomial_mul FK a p)
        (q2093886_polynomial_mul FK b
          (q2093886_polynomial_derivative FK p)))
      (q2093886_polynomial_one FK).

Fixpoint q2093886_polynomial_eval
    {F E : Type}
    {FF : q2093886_field F}
    {FE : q2093886_field E}
    (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE)
    (p : q2093886_polynomial F)
    (x : E) : E :=
  match p with
  | [] => q2093886_zero FE
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      q2093886_add FE
        (q2093886_embed A coefficient)
        (q2093886_mul FE x
          (q2093886_polynomial_eval A rest x))
  end.

Fixpoint q2093886_linear_combination
    {F E : Type}
    {FF : q2093886_field F}
    {FE : q2093886_field E}
    (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE)
    (coefficients : list F)
    (vectors : list E) : E :=
  match coefficients, vectors with
  | a :: coefficients', x :: vectors' =>
      q2093886_add FE
        (q2093886_mul FE (q2093886_embed A a) x)
        (q2093886_linear_combination A coefficients' vectors')
  | _, _ => q2093886_zero FE
  end.

Definition q2093886_finite_dimensional
    {F E : Type}
    {FF : q2093886_field F}
    {FE : q2093886_field E}
    (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE) : Prop :=
  exists spanning_family : list E,
    forall x : E,
      exists coefficients : list F,
        length coefficients = length spanning_family /\
        q2093886_linear_combination A coefficients spanning_family = x.

Definition q2093886_is_separable
    {F E : Type}
    {FF : q2093886_field F}
    {FE : q2093886_field E}
    (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    exists p : q2093886_polynomial F,
      q2093886_polynomial_nonzero FF p /\
      q2093886_polynomial_separable FF p /\
      q2093886_polynomial_eval A p x = q2093886_zero FE.

Inductive q2093886_generated
    {F E : Type}
    {FF : q2093886_field F}
    {FE : q2093886_field E}
    (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE)
    (alpha : E) : E -> Prop :=
  | q2093886_generated_base :
      forall a : F,
        q2093886_generated A alpha (q2093886_embed A a)
  | q2093886_generated_element :
      q2093886_generated A alpha alpha
  | q2093886_generated_add :
      forall x y : E,
        q2093886_generated A alpha x ->
        q2093886_generated A alpha y ->
        q2093886_generated A alpha (q2093886_add FE x y)
  | q2093886_generated_mul :
      forall x y : E,
        q2093886_generated A alpha x ->
        q2093886_generated A alpha y ->
        q2093886_generated A alpha (q2093886_mul FE x y)
  | q2093886_generated_neg :
      forall x : E,
        q2093886_generated A alpha x ->
        q2093886_generated A alpha (q2093886_neg FE x)
  | q2093886_generated_inv :
      forall x : E,
        q2093886_generated A alpha x ->
        q2093886_generated A alpha (q2093886_inv FE x).

Definition q2093886_generates_extension
    {F E : Type}
    {FF : q2093886_field F}
    {FE : q2093886_field E}
    (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE)
    (alpha : E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E, q2093886_generated A alpha x.

Theorem Field_exists_primitive_element :
  forall (F E : Type)
         (FF : q2093886_field F)
         (FE : q2093886_field E)
         (A : @q2093886_field_algebra F E FF FE),
    q2093886_finite_dimensional A ->
    q2093886_is_separable A ->
    exists alpha : E,
      q2093886_generates_extension A alpha.
Admitted.

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2093886,
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2093886), "Primitive element theorem": every
  finite-dimensional separable field extension is generated over its base field by
  a single element. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym 'a q2093886_poly = "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q2093886_is_field_embedding ::
    "('f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2093886_is_field_embedding emb \<longleftrightarrow>
    emb 0 = 0 \<and>
    emb 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. emb (a + b) = emb a + emb b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. emb (a * b) = emb a * emb b)"

definition q2093886_poly_support ::
    "'a::zero q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "q2093886_poly_support p = {n. p n \<noteq> 0}"

definition q2093886_is_poly ::
    "'a::zero q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2093886_is_poly p \<longleftrightarrow> finite (q2093886_poly_support p)"

definition q2093886_poly_zero ::
    "'a::zero q2093886_poly" where
  "q2093886_poly_zero = (\<lambda>_. 0)"

definition q2093886_poly_one ::
    "'a::zero_neq_one q2093886_poly" where
  "q2093886_poly_one = (\<lambda>n. if n = 0 then 1 else 0)"

definition q2093886_poly_add ::
    "'a::plus q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q2093886_poly" where
  "q2093886_poly_add p q = (\<lambda>n. p n + q n)"

definition q2093886_poly_mul ::
    "'a::comm_semiring_1 q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q2093886_poly" where
  "q2093886_poly_mul p q =
    (\<lambda>n. \<Sum>i\<le>n. p i * q (n - i))"

definition q2093886_poly_deriv ::
    "'a::comm_semiring_1 q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q2093886_poly" where
  "q2093886_poly_deriv p =
    (\<lambda>n. of_nat (Suc n) * p (Suc n))"

definition q2093886_poly_eval ::
    "('f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field) \<Rightarrow>
      'f q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q2093886_poly_eval emb p x =
    (\<Sum>n\<in>q2093886_poly_support p. emb (p n) * x ^ n)"

definition q2093886_poly_coprime ::
    "'f::field q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'f q2093886_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2093886_poly_coprime p q \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2093886_is_poly p \<and>
    q2093886_is_poly q \<and>
    (\<exists>a b.
      q2093886_is_poly a \<and>
      q2093886_is_poly b \<and>
      q2093886_poly_add
        (q2093886_poly_mul a p)
        (q2093886_poly_mul b q) = q2093886_poly_one)"

definition q2093886_separable_extension ::
    "('f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2093886_separable_extension emb \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>p :: 'f q2093886_poly.
      q2093886_is_poly p \<and>
      p \<noteq> q2093886_poly_zero \<and>
      q2093886_poly_eval emb p x = 0 \<and>
      q2093886_poly_coprime p (q2093886_poly_deriv p))"

definition q2093886_finite_dimensional ::
    "('f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2093886_finite_dimensional emb \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B :: 'e set.
      finite B \<and>
      (\<forall>x. \<exists>c :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'f.
        x = (\<Sum>b\<in>B. emb (c b) * b)))"

definition q2093886_intermediate_field ::
    "('f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2093886_intermediate_field emb K \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a. emb a \<in> K) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>K. \<forall>y\<in>K. x + y \<in> K) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>K. -x \<in> K) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>K. \<forall>y\<in>K. x * y \<in> K) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>K. inverse x \<in> K)"

definition q2093886_adjoin_simple ::
    "('f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e set" where
  "q2093886_adjoin_simple emb alpha =
    \<Inter>{K. q2093886_intermediate_field emb K \<and> alpha \<in> K}"

theorem q2093886_primitive_element_theorem:
  fixes emb :: "'f::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::field"
  assumes "q2093886_is_field_embedding emb"
    and "q2093886_finite_dimensional emb"
    and "q2093886_separable_extension emb"
  shows "\<exists>alpha :: 'e.
    q2093886_adjoin_simple emb alpha = UNIV"
  sorry

end

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2093886,
  "Primitive element theorem": every finite-dimensional separable field
  extension is generated by one element. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2093886_PRIMITIVE_ELEMENT_THEOREM =
  `let is_field_F =
     \(zeroF0:F) (unitF0:F) (addF0:F->F->F) (mulF0:F->F->F)
      (negF0:F->F) (invF0:F->F).
       ~(zeroF0 = unitF0) /\
       (!x:F. addF0 zeroF0 x = x) /\
       (!x:F. addF0 (negF0 x) x = zeroF0) /\
       (!x y:F. addF0 x y = addF0 y x) /\
       (!x y z:F. addF0 x (addF0 y z) = addF0 (addF0 x y) z) /\
       (!x:F. mulF0 unitF0 x = x) /\
       (!x y:F. mulF0 x y = mulF0 y x) /\
       (!x y z:F. mulF0 x (mulF0 y z) = mulF0 (mulF0 x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:F.
          mulF0 x (addF0 y z) =
          addF0 (mulF0 x y) (mulF0 x z)) /\
       invF0 zeroF0 = zeroF0 /\
       (!x:F. ~(x = zeroF0) ==> mulF0 (invF0 x) x = unitF0) in
   let is_field_E =
     \(zeroE0:E) (unitE0:E) (addE0:E->E->E) (mulE0:E->E->E)
      (negE0:E->E) (invE0:E->E).
       ~(zeroE0 = unitE0) /\
       (!x:E. addE0 zeroE0 x = x) /\
       (!x:E. addE0 (negE0 x) x = zeroE0) /\
       (!x y:E. addE0 x y = addE0 y x) /\
       (!x y z:E. addE0 x (addE0 y z) = addE0 (addE0 x y) z) /\
       (!x:E. mulE0 unitE0 x = x) /\
       (!x y:E. mulE0 x y = mulE0 y x) /\
       (!x y z:E. mulE0 x (mulE0 y z) = mulE0 (mulE0 x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:E.
          mulE0 x (addE0 y z) =
          addE0 (mulE0 x y) (mulE0 x z)) /\
       invE0 zeroE0 = zeroE0 /\
       (!x:E. ~(x = zeroE0) ==> mulE0 (invE0 x) x = unitE0) in
   let is_field_embedding =
     \(zeroF:F) (oneF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (mulF:F->F->F)
      (zeroE:E) (oneE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (mulE:E->E->E)
      (embedding:F->E).
       embedding zeroF = zeroE /\
       embedding oneF = oneE /\
       (!x y:F.
          embedding (addF x y) = addE (embedding x) (embedding y)) /\
       (!x y:F.
          embedding (mulF x y) = mulE (embedding x) (embedding y)) /\
       (!x y:F. embedding x = embedding y ==> x = y) in
   let field_power =
     \(unitE:E) (mul:E->E->E) (x:E) (n:num).
       ITLIST mul (REPLICATE n x) unitE in
   let is_polynomial =
     \(zeroF:F) (p:num->F). FINITE {n | ~(p n = zeroF)} in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(zeroF:F). \n:num. zeroF in
   let polynomial_one =
     \(zeroF:F) (oneF:F). \n:num. if n = 0 then oneF else zeroF in
   let polynomial_add =
     \(addF:F->F->F) (p:num->F) (q:num->F).
       \n:num. addF (p n) (q n) in
   let polynomial_mul =
     \(addF:F->F->F) (mulF:F->F->F) (p:num->F) (q:num->F).
       \n:num.
         iterate addF (0..n) (\i:num. mulF (p i) (q (n - i))) in
   let natural_multiple =
     \(zeroF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (n:num) (x:F).
       ITLIST addF (REPLICATE n x) zeroF in
   let polynomial_derivative =
     \(zeroF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (p:num->F).
       \n:num. natural_multiple zeroF addF (n + 1) (p (n + 1)) in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(zeroF:F) (oneE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (mulE:E->E->E)
      (embedding:F->E) (p:num->F) (x:E).
       iterate addE {n | ~(p n = zeroF)}
         (\n:num. mulE (embedding (p n)) (field_power oneE mulE x n)) in
   let is_separable_polynomial =
     \(zeroF:F) (oneF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (mulF:F->F->F)
      (p:num->F).
       is_polynomial zeroF p /\
