       ~(p = polynomial_zero zeroF) /\
       ?a b:num->F.
         is_polynomial zeroF a /\
         is_polynomial zeroF b /\
         polynomial_add addF
           (polynomial_mul addF mulF a p)
           (polynomial_mul addF mulF b
             (polynomial_derivative zeroF addF p)) =
         polynomial_one zeroF oneF in
   let is_separable_extension =
     \(zeroF:F) (oneF:F) (addF:F->F->F) (mulF:F->F->F)
      (oneE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (mulE:E->E->E)
      (embedding:F->E).
       !x:E.
         ?p:num->F.
           is_separable_polynomial zeroF oneF addF mulF p /\
           polynomial_eval zeroF oneE addE mulE embedding p x =
           embedding zeroF in
   let finite_linear_combination =
     \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (mulE:E->E->E)
      (embedding:F->E) (n:num) (basis:num->E)
      (coeff:num->F) (x:E).
       ?partial:num->E.
         partial 0 = zeroE /\
         (!i:num.
            i < n
            ==> partial (SUC i) =
                addE (partial i) (mulE (embedding (coeff i)) (basis i))) /\
         partial n = x in
   let is_finite_dimensional =
     \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (mulE:E->E->E) (embedding:F->E).
       ?n:num. ?basis:num->E.
         !x:E. ?coeff:num->F.
           finite_linear_combination
             zeroE addE mulE embedding n basis coeff x in
   let is_subfield =
     \(zeroE:E) (oneE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (mulE:E->E->E)
      (negE:E->E) (invE:E->E) (subfield:E->bool).
       subfield zeroE /\
       subfield oneE /\
       (!x:E.
          subfield x
          ==> subfield (negE x) /\ subfield (invE x)) /\
       (!x y:E.
          subfield x /\ subfield y
          ==> subfield (addE x y) /\ subfield (mulE x y)) in
   !zeroF oneF:F. !addF mulF:F->F->F. !negF invF:F->F.
   !zeroE oneE:E. !addE mulE:E->E->E. !negE invE:E->E.
   !embedding:F->E.
     is_field_F zeroF oneF addF mulF negF invF /\
     is_field_E zeroE oneE addE mulE negE invE /\
     is_field_embedding
       zeroF oneF addF mulF zeroE oneE addE mulE embedding /\
     is_finite_dimensional zeroE addE mulE embedding /\
     is_separable_extension
       zeroF oneF addF mulF oneE addE mulE embedding
     ==> ?alpha:E.
           !subfield:E->bool.
             is_subfield zeroE oneE addE mulE negE invE subfield /\
             (!a:F. subfield (embedding a)) /\
             subfield alpha
             ==> !x:E. subfield x`;;

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2093886,
;; "Primitive element theorem": every finite-dimensional separable field
;; extension is generated by one element. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary fields and their embedding are represented by tame predicates and
;; operations. DEFUN-SK keeps finite dimensionality, separability witnesses,
;; the primitive element, and all polynomial coefficients internally
;; quantified with the same alternating scopes as the source statement.

(defun q2093886-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun q2093886-unary (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q2093886-binary (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Fields and the field embedding.

(defun-sk q2093886-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2093886-member-p carrier x)
      (q2093886-member-p carrier y)
      (q2093886-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (q2093886-member-p
       carrier (q2093886-binary add x y))
      (q2093886-member-p
       carrier (q2093886-binary multiply x y))
      (q2093886-member-p
       carrier (q2093886-unary negate x))
      (q2093886-member-p
       carrier (q2093886-unary inverse x))
      (equal
       (q2093886-binary
        add (q2093886-binary add x y) z)
       (q2093886-binary
        add x (q2093886-binary add y z)))
      (equal
       (q2093886-binary add x y)
       (q2093886-binary add y x))
      (equal (q2093886-binary add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q2093886-binary add x (q2093886-unary negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (q2093886-binary
        multiply (q2093886-binary multiply x y) z)
       (q2093886-binary
        multiply x (q2093886-binary multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (q2093886-binary multiply x y)
       (q2093886-binary multiply y x))
      (equal (q2093886-binary multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (equal x zero)
       (equal (q2093886-unary inverse x) zero))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (q2093886-binary
         multiply x (q2093886-unary inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (q2093886-binary
        multiply x (q2093886-binary add y z))
       (q2093886-binary
        add
        (q2093886-binary multiply x y)
        (q2093886-binary multiply x z)))))))

(defun q2093886-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q2093886-member-p carrier zero)
   (q2093886-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q2093886-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)))

(defun-sk q2093886-embedding-laws-p
    (small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2093886-member-p small-carrier x)
      (q2093886-member-p small-carrier y))
     (and
      (q2093886-member-p
       large-carrier (q2093886-unary embedding x))
      (q2093886-member-p
       large-carrier (q2093886-unary embedding y))
      (equal
       (q2093886-unary
        embedding (q2093886-binary small-add x y))
       (q2093886-binary
        large-add
        (q2093886-unary embedding x)
        (q2093886-unary embedding y)))
      (equal
       (q2093886-unary
        embedding (q2093886-binary small-multiply x y))
       (q2093886-binary
        large-multiply
        (q2093886-unary embedding x)
        (q2093886-unary embedding y)))
      (equal
       (q2093886-unary embedding small-zero)
       large-zero)
      (equal
       (q2093886-unary embedding small-one)
       large-one)
      (implies
       (equal
        (q2093886-unary embedding x)
        (q2093886-unary embedding y))
       (equal x y))))))

(defun q2093886-field-embedding-p
    (small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp embedding)
   (q2093886-embedding-laws-p
    small-carrier large-carrier
    small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
    large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)))

;; Finite coefficient lists and exact polynomial arithmetic.

(defun q2093886-all-members-p (objects carrier)
  (if (consp objects)
      (and
       (q2093886-member-p carrier (car objects))
       (q2093886-all-members-p (cdr objects) carrier))
    (equal objects nil)))

(defun q2093886-coefficient-list-p (coefficients carrier)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (q2093886-all-members-p coefficients carrier)))

(defun q2093886-polynomial-p (coefficients carrier zero)
  (and
   (q2093886-coefficient-list-p coefficients carrier)
   (consp coefficients)
   (not (equal (car (last coefficients)) zero))))

(defun q2093886-natural-multiple (count object zero add)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (q2093886-binary
     add
     object
     (q2093886-natural-multiple
      (- count 1) object zero add))))

(defun q2093886-polynomial-eval
    (coefficients point embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q2093886-binary
       large-add
       (q2093886-unary embedding (car coefficients))
       (q2093886-binary
        large-multiply
        point
        (q2093886-polynomial-eval
         (cdr coefficients)
         point
         embedding
         large-zero
         large-add
         large-multiply)))
    large-zero))

(defun q2093886-product-coefficient
    (index left right zero add multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count left)))
  (if (consp left)
      (q2093886-binary
       add
       (if (< (nfix index) (len right))
           (q2093886-binary
            multiply
            (car left)
            (nth (nfix index) right))
         zero)
       (if (zp index)
           zero
         (q2093886-product-coefficient
          (- index 1)
          (cdr left)
          right
          zero
          add
          multiply)))
    zero))

(defun q2093886-product-coefficients-equal-p
    (index product left right zero add multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count product)))
  (if (consp product)
      (and
       (equal
        (car product)
        (q2093886-product-coefficient
         index left right zero add multiply))
       (q2093886-product-coefficients-equal-p
        (+ 1 (nfix index))
        (cdr product)
        left
        right
        zero
        add
        multiply))
    (equal product nil)))

(defun q2093886-polynomial-product-equal-p
    (product left right zero add multiply)
  (and
   (equal
    (len product)
    (- (+ (len left) (len right)) 1))
   (q2093886-product-coefficients-equal-p
    0 product left right zero add multiply)))

(defun-sk q2093886-irreducible-factor-law-p
    (polynomial carrier zero add multiply)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2093886-polynomial-p left carrier zero)
      (q2093886-polynomial-p right carrier zero)
      (q2093886-polynomial-product-equal-p
       polynomial left right zero add multiply))
     (or
      (equal (len left) 1)
      (equal (len right) 1)))))

(defun q2093886-irreducible-p
    (polynomial carrier zero add multiply)
  (and
   (q2093886-polynomial-p polynomial carrier zero)
   (< 1 (len polynomial))
   (q2093886-irreducible-factor-law-p
    polynomial carrier zero add multiply)))

(defun q2093886-derivative-nonzero-from-p
    (coefficients index zero add)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (or
       (not
        (equal
         (q2093886-natural-multiple
          index (car coefficients) zero add)
         zero))
       (q2093886-derivative-nonzero-from-p
        (cdr coefficients)
        (+ 1 (nfix index))
        zero
        add))
    nil))

(defun q2093886-derivative-nonzero-p
    (polynomial zero add)
  (q2093886-derivative-nonzero-from-p
   (cdr polynomial) 1 zero add))

;; Finite dimensionality is existence of a finite spanning family.

(defun q2093886-linear-combination
    (coefficients generators embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (if (and (consp coefficients) (consp generators))
      (q2093886-binary
       large-add
       (q2093886-binary
        large-multiply
        (q2093886-unary embedding (car coefficients))
        (car generators))
       (q2093886-linear-combination
        (cdr coefficients)
        (cdr generators)
        embedding
        large-zero
        large-add
        large-multiply))
    large-zero))

(defun q2093886-linear-combination-witness-p
    (coefficients target generators small-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (and
   (q2093886-coefficient-list-p coefficients small-carrier)
   (equal (len coefficients) (len generators))
   (equal
    (q2093886-linear-combination
     coefficients generators embedding
     large-zero large-add large-multiply)
    target)))

(defun-sk q2093886-has-linear-combination-p
    (target generators small-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (q2093886-linear-combination-witness-p
     coefficients target generators small-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(defun-sk q2093886-spans-extension-p
    (generators small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2093886-member-p large-carrier x)
     (q2093886-has-linear-combination-p
      x generators small-carrier
      embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply))))

(defun q2093886-finite-spanning-witness-p
    (generators small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (and
   (true-listp generators)
   (q2093886-all-members-p generators large-carrier)
   (q2093886-spans-extension-p
    generators small-carrier large-carrier
    embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(defun-sk q2093886-finite-dimensional-p
    (small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (exists (generators)
    (q2093886-finite-spanning-witness-p
     generators small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

;; A monic irreducible annihilator is the minimal polynomial. For an
;; irreducible polynomial, nonzero derivative is equivalent to separability.

(defun q2093886-separable-polynomial-for-p
    (polynomial point
     small-carrier small-zero small-one small-add small-multiply
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (and
   (q2093886-polynomial-p polynomial small-carrier small-zero)
   (< 1 (len polynomial))
   (equal (car (last polynomial)) small-one)
   (q2093886-irreducible-p
    polynomial small-carrier small-zero small-add small-multiply)
   (q2093886-derivative-nonzero-p
    polynomial small-zero small-add)
   (equal
    (q2093886-polynomial-eval
     polynomial point embedding
     large-zero large-add large-multiply)
    large-zero)))

(defun-sk q2093886-has-separable-polynomial-p
    (point
     small-carrier small-zero small-one small-add small-multiply
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (exists (polynomial)
    (q2093886-separable-polynomial-for-p
     polynomial point
     small-carrier small-zero small-one small-add small-multiply
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(defun-sk q2093886-separable-extension-p
    (small-carrier small-zero small-one small-add small-multiply
     large-carrier embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2093886-member-p large-carrier x)
     (q2093886-has-separable-polynomial-p
      x
      small-carrier small-zero small-one small-add small-multiply
      embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply))))

;; A primitive element is one whose polynomial values exhaust the extension.

(defun q2093886-polynomial-representation-witness-p
    (coefficients target point small-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (and
   (q2093886-coefficient-list-p coefficients small-carrier)
   (equal
    (q2093886-polynomial-eval
     coefficients point embedding
     large-zero large-add large-multiply)
    target)))

(defun-sk q2093886-has-polynomial-representation-p
    (target point small-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (q2093886-polynomial-representation-witness-p
     coefficients target point small-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(defun-sk q2093886-generated-by-point-p
    (point small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2093886-member-p large-carrier x)
     (q2093886-has-polynomial-representation-p
      x point small-carrier
      embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply))))

(defun q2093886-primitive-element-p
    (point small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (and
   (q2093886-member-p large-carrier point)
   (q2093886-generated-by-point-p
    point small-carrier large-carrier
    embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(defun-sk q2093886-primitive-element-exists-p
    (small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
  (exists (point)
    (q2093886-primitive-element-p
     point small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q2093886-primitive-element-theorem-statement
    (small-carrier small-add small-multiply small-negate small-inverse
     small-zero small-one
     large-carrier large-add large-multiply large-negate large-inverse
     large-zero large-one embedding)
  (implies
   (and
    (q2093886-field-p
     small-carrier small-add small-multiply
     small-negate small-inverse small-zero small-one)
    (q2093886-field-p
     large-carrier large-add large-multiply
     large-negate large-inverse large-zero large-one)
    (q2093886-field-embedding-p
     small-carrier large-carrier
     small-add small-multiply small-zero small-one
     large-add large-multiply large-zero large-one embedding)
    (q2093886-finite-dimensional-p
     small-carrier large-carrier
     embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)
    (q2093886-separable-extension-p
     small-carrier small-zero small-one small-add small-multiply
     large-carrier embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply))
   (q2093886-primitive-element-exists-p
    small-carrier large-carrier
    embedding large-zero large-add large-multiply)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2093886,
-- "Primitive element theorem": every finite-dimensional separable field
-- extension is generated over its base field by one element. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2093886PrimitiveElementTheorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 2 _×_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : A
    addR multiplyR : A -> A -> A
    negateR : A -> A

    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : A) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : A) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing A
    inverseF : A -> A
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    inverse-zero :
      inverseF (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : A) ->
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (inverseF x) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring

record RingHom
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b}
  (domain : CommutativeRing A)
  (codomain : CommutativeRing B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    map : A -> B
    map-zero :
      map (CommutativeRing.zeroR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain
    map-one :
      map (CommutativeRing.oneR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR codomain
    map-add :
      (x y : A) ->
      map (CommutativeRing.addR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.addR codomain (map x) (map y)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) ->
      map (CommutativeRing.multiplyR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR codomain (map x) (map y)

sumFin :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (Fin n -> A) ->
  A
sumFin ring zero values =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
sumFin ring (suc n) values =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin ring n (λ i -> values (fsuc i)))

linearCombination :
  {f e : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (base : CommutativeRing F) ->
  (extension : CommutativeRing E) ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (Fin n -> E) ->
  (Fin n -> F) ->
  E
linearCombination base extension algebra-map n vectors coefficients =
  sumFin extension n
    (λ i ->
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR extension
        (RingHom.map algebra-map (coefficients i))
        (vectors i))

record HasBasis
  {f e : Level}
  {F : Set f}
  {E : Set e}
  (base : CommutativeRing F)
  (extension : CommutativeRing E)
  (algebra-map : RingHom base extension)
  (dimension : Nat) :
  Set (f ⊔ e) where

  field
    basis : Fin dimension -> E
    linearly-independent :
      (coefficients : Fin dimension -> F) ->
      linearCombination
        base extension algebra-map dimension basis coefficients
      ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR extension ->
      (i : Fin dimension) ->
      coefficients i ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR base
    spans :
      (x : E) ->
      Σ (Fin dimension -> F)
        (λ coefficients ->
          linearCombination
            base extension algebra-map dimension basis coefficients
          ≡
          x)

FiniteDimensional :
  {f e : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (base : CommutativeRing F) ->
  (extension : CommutativeRing E) ->
  RingHom base extension ->
  Set (f ⊔ e)
FiniteDimensional base extension algebra-map =
  Σ Nat
    (λ dimension ->
      HasBasis base extension algebra-map dimension)

record Polynomial
  {f : Level}
  (F : Set f)
  (field-structure : Field F) :
  Set f where

  private
    ring = Field.ring field-structure

  field
    coefficient : Nat -> F
    bound : Nat
    zero-after-bound :
      (offset : Nat) ->
      coefficient (bound + suc offset) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

evaluateFrom :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  A ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  A
evaluateFrom ring coefficient x start zero =
  coefficient start
evaluateFrom ring coefficient x start (suc count) =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (coefficient start)
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x
      (evaluateFrom ring coefficient x (suc start) count))

evaluate :
  {f e : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (base-field : Field F) ->
  (extension-field : Field E) ->
  RingHom
    (Field.ring base-field)
    (Field.ring extension-field) ->
  Polynomial F base-field ->
  E ->
  E
evaluate base-field extension-field algebra-map polynomial x =
  evaluateFrom
    (Field.ring extension-field)
    (λ n ->
      RingHom.map algebra-map
        (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial n))
    x
    zero
    (Polynomial.bound polynomial)

natScale :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  Nat ->
  A ->
  A
natScale ring zero x =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
natScale ring (suc n) x =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring x (natScale ring n x)

derivativeCoefficient :
  {f : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {field-structure : Field F} ->
  Polynomial F field-structure ->
  Nat ->
  F
derivativeCoefficient {field-structure = field-structure} polynomial n =
  natScale
    (Field.ring field-structure)
    (suc n)
    (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial (suc n))

multiplyCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Nat ->
  A
multiplyCoefficient ring left right zero =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring (left zero) (right zero)
multiplyCoefficient ring left right (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring (left zero) (right (suc n)))
    (multiplyCoefficient ring (λ i -> left (suc i)) right n)

unitCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing A ->
  Nat ->
  A
unitCoefficient ring zero =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
unitCoefficient ring (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

NonzeroPolynomial :
  {f : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {field-structure : Field F} ->
  Polynomial F field-structure ->
  Set f
NonzeroPolynomial {field-structure = field-structure} polynomial =
  Σ Nat
    (λ n ->
      Polynomial.coefficient polynomial n ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring field-structure))

CoprimeWithDerivative :
  {f : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {field-structure : Field F} ->
  Polynomial F field-structure ->
  Set f
CoprimeWithDerivative
  {field-structure = field-structure}
  polynomial =
  Σ (Polynomial _ field-structure)
    (λ left ->
      Σ (Polynomial _ field-structure)
        (λ right ->
          (n : Nat) ->
          CommutativeRing.addR ring
            (multiplyCoefficient ring
              (Polynomial.coefficient left)
              (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial)
              n)
            (multiplyCoefficient ring
              (Polynomial.coefficient right)
              (derivativeCoefficient polynomial)
              n)
          ≡
          unitCoefficient ring n))
  where
  ring = Field.ring field-structure

SeparableElement :
  {f e : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (base-field : Field F) ->
  (extension-field : Field E) ->
  RingHom
    (Field.ring base-field)
    (Field.ring extension-field) ->
  E ->
  Set (f ⊔ e)
SeparableElement base-field extension-field algebra-map x =
  Σ (Polynomial _ base-field)
    (λ polynomial ->
      NonzeroPolynomial polynomial
      ×
      ((evaluate
          base-field
          extension-field
          algebra-map
          polynomial
          x
        ≡
        CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring extension-field))
       ×
       CoprimeWithDerivative polynomial))

record Subfield
  {e : Level}
  {E : Set e}
  (field-structure : Field E) :
  Set (lsuc e) where

  private
    ring = Field.ring field-structure

  field
    member : E -> Set e
    contains-zero :
      member (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    contains-one :
      member (CommutativeRing.oneR ring)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : E) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : E) ->
      member x ->
      member (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)
    closed-under-multiplication :
      (x y : E) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y)
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : E) ->
      member x ->
      member (Field.inverseF field-structure x)

GeneratedBy :
  {f e : Level} ->
  {F : Set f} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (base-field : Field F) ->
  (extension-field : Field E) ->
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)) ->
  E ->
  E ->
  Set (f ⊔ lsuc e)
GeneratedBy base-field extension-field algebra-map generator x =
  (subfield : Subfield extension-field) ->
  ((a : _) ->
    Subfield.member subfield (RingHom.map algebra-map a)) ->
  Subfield.member subfield generator ->
  Subfield.member subfield x

the-primitive-element-theorem : Setω
the-primitive-element-theorem =
  ∀ {f e : Level} ->
  (F : Set f) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (base-field : Field F) ->
  (extension-field : Field E) ->
  (algebra-map :
    RingHom
      (Field.ring base-field)
      (Field.ring extension-field)) ->
  FiniteDimensional
    (Field.ring base-field)
    (Field.ring extension-field)
    algebra-map ->
  ((x : E) ->
    SeparableElement
      base-field
      extension-field
      algebra-map
      x) ->
  Σ E
    (λ generator ->
      (x : E) ->
      GeneratedBy
        base-field
        extension-field
        algebra-map
        generator
        x)

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2093886, "Primitive element theorem": every finite-dimensional separable
  field extension is generated over its base field by one element. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q2093886_field_def = new_definition (
  "q2093886_field_def",
  ``q2093886_field
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (invA : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      zero <> oneA /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneA x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      invA zero = zero /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul (invA x) x = oneA)``);

val q2093886_field_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q2093886_field_embedding_def",
  ``q2093886_field_embedding
      (Fzero : 'f) (Fone : 'f)
      (Fadd : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (Fmul : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (Fneg : 'f -> 'f)
      (Ezero : 'e) (Eone : 'e)
      (Eadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (Emul : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (Eneg : 'e -> 'e) (embed : 'f -> 'e) <=>
      embed Fzero = Ezero /\
      embed Fone = Eone /\
      (!x y. embed (Fadd x y) = Eadd (embed x) (embed y)) /\
      (!x y. embed (Fmul x y) = Emul (embed x) (embed y)) /\
      (!x. embed (Fneg x) = Eneg (embed x)) /\
      (!x y. embed x = embed y ==> x = y)``);

val q2093886_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q2093886_lincomb_def",
  ``q2093886_lincomb
      (Ezero : 'e) (Eadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (Emul : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (embed : 'f -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) (coeff : num -> 'f) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. Eadd acc (Emul (embed (coeff i)) (EL i basis)))
        Ezero
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q2093886_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q2093886_basis_def",
  ``q2093886_basis
      (Fzero : 'f)
      (Ezero : 'e) (Eadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (Emul : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (embed : 'f -> 'e)
      (basis : 'e list) <=>
      ALL_DISTINCT basis /\
      (!coeff : num -> 'f.
        q2093886_lincomb Ezero Eadd Emul embed basis coeff = Ezero ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = Fzero) /\
      (!x : 'e.
        ?coeff : num -> 'f.
          q2093886_lincomb Ezero Eadd Emul embed basis coeff = x)``);

  "q2093886_separable_extension_def",

      (zero : 'e) (oneE : 'e)

      (neg : 'e -> 'e) (invE : 'e -> 'e) (subset : 'e -> bool) <=>

      subset oneE /\

      (Eneg : 'e -> 'e) (Einv : 'e -> 'e)
      (embed : 'f -> 'e) (alpha : 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !subset : 'e -> bool.
        q2093886_subfield
          Ezero Eone Eadd Emul Eneg Einv subset /\
        (!c : 'f. subset (embed c)) /\
        subset alpha
        ==>
        subset x``);

val exists_primitive_element =
  ``!(Fzero : 'f) (Fone : 'f)
      (Fadd : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (Fmul : 'f -> 'f -> 'f)
      (Fneg : 'f -> 'f) (Finv : 'f -> 'f)
      (Ezero : 'e) (Eone : 'e)
      (Eadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (Emul : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (Eneg : 'e -> 'e) (Einv : 'e -> 'e)
      (embed : 'f -> 'e).
      q2093886_field Fzero Fone Fadd Fmul Fneg Finv /\
      q2093886_field Ezero Eone Eadd Emul Eneg Einv /\
      q2093886_field_embedding
        Fzero Fone Fadd Fmul Fneg
        Ezero Eone Eadd Emul Eneg embed /\
      q2093886_finite_dimensional
        Fzero Ezero Eadd Emul embed /\
      q2093886_separable_extension
        Fzero Fone Fadd Fmul
        Ezero Eone Eadd Emul embed
      ==>
      ?alpha : 'e.
        !x : 'e.
          q2093886_generated_field
            Ezero Eone Eadd Emul Eneg Einv embed alpha x``;

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2093886
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2093886), "Primitive element theorem":
  every finite-dimensional separable extension of fields has an element
  generating the entire extension field over the base field. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A is an arbitrary field homomorphism from F to E, representing the algebra
  structure in the source theorem. Q2093886ExtensionModule is E as an
  F-vector space, with scalar action c . x = A(c) * x.

  Q2093886MapPolynomial maps polynomial coefficients along A.
  Q2093886FiniteDimensional says that the resulting vector space has a finite
  basis. Q2093886Separable says that every element of E is annihilated by a
  nonzero polynomial over F which is coprime to its formal derivative. Over a
  field this is equivalent to every element being separable over F.

  Q2093886Generates says that every element of E is a quotient of values at a
  of two F-polynomials, with nonzero denominator. This is equivalent to the
  simple intermediate field F(a) being all of E. Every declaration below is
  an unproved $a statement encoding; this database contains no $p proof.
$)

$c Q2093886ExtensionModule Q2093886MapPolynomial
   Q2093886FiniteDimensional Q2093886Separable Q2093886Generates $.

q2093886-extension-module-syntax
  $a class ( Q2093886ExtensionModule F E A ) $.
q2093886-map-polynomial-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2093886MapPolynomial F E A P Q ) $.
q2093886-finite-dimensional-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2093886FiniteDimensional F E A ) $.
q2093886-separable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2093886Separable F E A ) $.
q2093886-generates-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2093886Generates F E A a ) $.

${
  $d A E F a x $.

  q2093886-extension-module-definition $a |- (
    Q2093886ExtensionModule F E A
  ) = (
    {
      <.
        ( Base ` ndx ) ,
        ( Base ` E )
      >. ,
      <.
        ( +g ` ndx ) ,
        ( +g ` E )
      >. ,
      <.
        ( Scalar ` ndx ) ,
        F
      >.
    }
    u.
    {
      <.
        ( .s ` ndx ) ,
        (
          a e. ( Base ` F ) ,
          x e. ( Base ` E )
          |->
          ( ( A ` a ) ( .r ` E ) x )
        )
      >.
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E F P Q k $.

  q2093886-map-polynomial-definition $a |- (
    Q2093886MapPolynomial F E A P Q
  ) <->
  (
    P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
    /\
    (
      Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` E ) )
      /\
      A. k e. NN0
        (
          ( ( coe1 ` Q ) ` k )
          =
          ( A ` ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` k ) )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E F b $.

  q2093886-finite-dimensional-definition $a |- (
    Q2093886FiniteDimensional F E A
  ) <->
  (
    E. b e. (
      LBasis ` ( Q2093886ExtensionModule F E A )
    )
      b e. Fin
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E F P Q U V x $.

  q2093886-separable-definition $a |- (
    Q2093886Separable F E A
  ) <->
  (
    A. x e. ( Base ` E )
      E. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
        (
          P =/= ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
          /\
          E. Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` E ) )
            (
              ( Q2093886MapPolynomial F E A P Q )
              /\
              (
                ( ( ( eval1 ` E ) ` Q ) ` x )
                =
                ( 0g ` E )
                /\
                E. U e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                  E. V e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                    (
                      (
                        U
                        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                        P
                      )
                      ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                      (
                        V
                        ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                        (
                          ( ( ( 1o mPSDer F ) ` (/) ) ` P )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                    =
                    ( 1r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
              )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E F P Q R S a x $.

  q2093886-generates-definition $a |- (
    Q2093886Generates F E A a
  ) <->
  (
    a e. ( Base ` E )
    /\
    A. x e. ( Base ` E )
      E. P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
        E. Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
          E. R e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` E ) )
            E. S e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` E ) )
              (
                ( Q2093886MapPolynomial F E A P R )
                /\
                (
                  ( Q2093886MapPolynomial F E A Q S )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( ( ( eval1 ` E ) ` S ) ` a )
                    =/=
                    ( 0g ` E )
                    /\
                    x
                    =
                    (
                      ( ( ( eval1 ` E ) ` R ) ` a )
                      ( /r ` E )
                      ( ( ( eval1 ` E ) ` S ) ` a )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E F a $.

  thousand-theorems-q2093886-primitive-element-theorem $a |-
    A. F e. Field
      A. E e. Field
        A. A e. ( F RingHom E )
          (
            (
              ( Q2093886FiniteDimensional F E A )
              /\
              ( Q2093886Separable F E A )
            )
            ->
            E. a e. ( Base ` E )
              ( Q2093886Generates F E A a )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q2093886_primitive_element_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2093886
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q2093886), "Primitive element theorem": every
% finite-dimensional separable field extension is generated over its base field
% by one element. This file contains no proof.

primitive_element_theorem_Q2093886[
  F, E: TYPE+,
  zeroF, oneF: F,
  addF, mulF: [F, F -> F],
  negF, invF: [F -> F],
  zeroE, oneE: E,
  addE, mulE: [E, E -> E],
  negE, invE: [E -> E],
  algebra_map: [F -> E]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  field_laws_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F): addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F): addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F): mulF(x, y) = mulF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        mulF(mulF(x, y), z) = mulF(x, mulF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): mulF(x, oneF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        mulF(x, addF(y, z)) =
          addF(mulF(x, y), mulF(x, z)))
      AND NOT (zeroF = oneF)
      AND invF(zeroF) = zeroF
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        NOT (x = zeroF) IMPLIES mulF(x, invF(x)) = oneF)

  field_laws_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E): addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E): mulE(x, y) = mulE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        mulE(mulE(x, y), z) = mulE(x, mulE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): mulE(x, oneE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        mulE(x, addE(y, z)) =
          addE(mulE(x, y), mulE(x, z)))
      AND NOT (zeroE = oneE)
      AND invE(zeroE) = zeroE
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        NOT (x = zeroE) IMPLIES mulE(x, invE(x)) = oneE)

  algebra_embedding_laws: bool =
    algebra_map(zeroF) = zeroE
      AND algebra_map(oneF) = oneE
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        algebra_map(addF(x, y)) =
          addE(algebra_map(x), algebra_map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        algebra_map(mulF(x, y)) =
          mulE(algebra_map(x), algebra_map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        algebra_map(x) = algebra_map(y) IMPLIES x = y)

  same_length(coefficients: list[F], basis: list[E]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES basis OF
      null:
        CASES coefficients OF
          null: TRUE,
          cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail): FALSE
        ENDCASES,
      cons(vector, vector_tail):
        CASES coefficients OF
          null: FALSE,
          cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail):
            same_length(coefficient_tail, vector_tail)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE basis BY <<

  linear_combination(
      coefficients: list[F],
      basis: list[E]): RECURSIVE E =
    CASES basis OF
      null: zeroE,
      cons(vector, vector_tail):
        CASES coefficients OF
          null: zeroE,
          cons(coefficient, coefficient_tail):
            addE(
              mulE(algebra_map(coefficient), vector),
              linear_combination(coefficient_tail, vector_tail))
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE basis BY <<

  finite_dimensional_extension: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: list[E]):
      FORALL (x: E):
        EXISTS (coefficients: list[F]):
          same_length(coefficients, basis)
            AND linear_combination(coefficients, basis) = x

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: list[F],
      x: E): RECURSIVE E =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: zeroE,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        addE(
          algebra_map(coefficient),
          mulE(x, polynomial_value(tail, x)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  polynomial_derivative_value(
      coefficients: list[F],
      x: E): RECURSIVE E =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: zeroE,
      cons(coefficient, tail):
        addE(
          polynomial_value(tail, x),
          mulE(x, polynomial_derivative_value(tail, x)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  separable_extension: bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      EXISTS (polynomial: list[F]):
        polynomial_value(polynomial, x) = zeroE
          AND NOT (
            polynomial_derivative_value(polynomial, x) = zeroE)

  is_intermediate_field(subfield: [E -> bool]): bool =
    subfield(zeroE)
      AND subfield(oneE)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        subfield(x) AND subfield(y) IMPLIES
          subfield(addE(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        subfield(x) IMPLIES subfield(negE(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        subfield(x) AND subfield(y) IMPLIES
          subfield(mulE(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        subfield(x) IMPLIES subfield(invE(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a: F):
        subfield(algebra_map(a)))

  is_primitive_element(alpha: E): bool =
    FORALL (subfield: [E -> bool]):
      is_intermediate_field(subfield)
        AND subfield(alpha)
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (x: E): subfield(x))

  primitive_element_theorem: bool =
    (field_laws_F
      AND field_laws_E
      AND algebra_embedding_laws
      AND finite_dimensional_extension
      AND separable_extension)
    IMPLIES
      (EXISTS (alpha: E):
        is_primitive_element(alpha))
END primitive_element_theorem_Q2093886

title: Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2096184
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2096184), "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform
-- preserves the integral inner product of Hilbert-valued Schwartz functions on a
-- finite-dimensional real inner-product space. This file contains no proof.

import Mathlib.Analysis.Distribution.SchwartzSpace.Fourier

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2096184
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2096184), "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier
  transform preserves the integral complex inner product of Hilbert-valued
  Schwartz functions on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals List ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2096184_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q2096184_empty {A : Type} : q2096184_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q2096184_full {A : Type} : q2096184_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q2096184_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q2096184_set A) : q2096184_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q2096184_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2096184_set A) : q2096184_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q2096184_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q2096184_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q2096184_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q2096184_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q2096184_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2096184_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q2096184_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q2096184_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q2096184_set (q2096184_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q2096184_empty /\
  (forall E F : q2096184_set A,
    q2096184_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q2096184_set A,
    C E -> C (q2096184_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q2096184_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q2096184_countable_union E)).

Inductive q2096184_ennreal : Type :=
| q2096184_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q2096184_ennreal
| q2096184_ennreal_infinity : q2096184_ennreal.

Arguments q2096184_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_zero : q2096184_ennreal :=
  q2096184_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q2096184_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2096184_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2096184_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q2096184_ennreal_infinity,
    q2096184_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_le
    (x y : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2096184_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2096184_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q2096184_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q2096184_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q2096184_ennreal_infinity,
    q2096184_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q2096184_ennreal_infinity,
    q2096184_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_add
    (x y : q2096184_ennreal) : q2096184_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2096184_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2096184_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2096184_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q2096184_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q2096184_ennreal) : q2096184_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2096184_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2096184_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2096184_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q2096184_ennreal_finite a _, q2096184_ennreal_infinity
  | q2096184_ennreal_infinity, q2096184_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q2096184_ennreal_zero
      else q2096184_ennreal_infinity
  | q2096184_ennreal_infinity, q2096184_ennreal_infinity =>
      q2096184_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q2096184_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q2096184_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q2096184_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q2096184_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q2096184_ennreal_add
        (q2096184_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q2096184_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q2096184_ennreal,
      values value -> q2096184_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q2096184_ennreal,
      (forall value : q2096184_ennreal,
        values value -> q2096184_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q2096184_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q2096184_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q2096184_ennreal)
    (sum : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2096184_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q2096184_ennreal_eq value
          (q2096184_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_represents
    (x : q2096184_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q2096184_ennreal_eq x
      (q2096184_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q2096184_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q2096184_ennreal_represents x value.

      (q2096184_measurable E <-> q2096184_measurable F);
  q2096184_measurable_empty :
    q2096184_measurable q2096184_empty;
  q2096184_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q2096184_set A,
      q2096184_measurable E ->
      q2096184_measurable (q2096184_complement E);
  q2096184_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q2096184_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2096184_measurable (E n)) ->
      q2096184_measurable (q2096184_countable_union E);
  q2096184_measure : q2096184_set A -> q2096184_ennreal;
  q2096184_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q2096184_set A,
      q2096184_same_set E F ->
      q2096184_ennreal_eq
        (q2096184_measure E) (q2096184_measure F);
  q2096184_measure_empty :
    q2096184_ennreal_eq
      (q2096184_measure q2096184_empty)

  q2096184_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q2096184_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2096184_measurable (E n)) ->
      q2096184_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q2096184_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q2096184_measure (E n))
        (q2096184_measure (q2096184_countable_union E))
}.

Definition q2096184_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q2096184_set A,
    q2096184_measurable mu null_set /\
    q2096184_ennreal_eq

  q2096184_zero : G;
  q2096184_add : G -> G -> G;
  q2096184_neg : G -> G;
  q2096184_smul : R -> G -> G;
  q2096184_norm : G -> R;
  q2096184_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q2096184_add x (q2096184_add y z) =
      q2096184_add (q2096184_add x y) z;
  q2096184_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q2096184_add x y = q2096184_add y x;
  q2096184_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q2096184_add x q2096184_zero = x;
  q2096184_add_neg :

      q2096184_add x (q2096184_neg x) = q2096184_zero;

  q2096184_mul_smul :

Definition q2096184_sub {G : Type}

Record q2096184_complex : Type := {
  q2096184_re : R;
  q2096184_im : R
}.

Definition q2096184_czero : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re := 0; q2096184_im := 0 |}.

Definition q2096184_cone : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re := 1; q2096184_im := 0 |}.

Definition q2096184_ci : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re := 0; q2096184_im := 1 |}.

Definition q2096184_cadd
    (z w : q2096184_complex) : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re := q2096184_re z + q2096184_re w;
     q2096184_im := q2096184_im z + q2096184_im w |}.

Definition q2096184_cneg
    (z : q2096184_complex) : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re := - q2096184_re z;
     q2096184_im := - q2096184_im z |}.

Definition q2096184_csub
    (z w : q2096184_complex) : q2096184_complex :=
  q2096184_cadd z (q2096184_cneg w).

Definition q2096184_cmul
    (z w : q2096184_complex) : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re :=
       q2096184_re z * q2096184_re w -
       q2096184_im z * q2096184_im w;
     q2096184_im :=
       q2096184_re z * q2096184_im w +
       q2096184_im z * q2096184_re w |}.

  {| q2096184_re := x; q2096184_im := 0 |}.

    (z : q2096184_complex) : q2096184_complex :=
  {| q2096184_re := q2096184_re z;
     q2096184_im := - q2096184_im z |}.

     q2096184_im z * q2096184_im z).

     q2096184_im := exp (q2096184_re z) * sin (q2096184_im z) |}.
