  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q2096184_set A),
    q2096184_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q2096184_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q2096184_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q2096184_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q2096184_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q2096184_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q2096184_nnreal_value : R;
  q2096184_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q2096184_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q2096184_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q2096184_nonnegative_real) : q2096184_ennreal :=
  q2096184_ennreal_finite
    (q2096184_nnreal_value x)
    (q2096184_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q2096184_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q2096184_ennreal)
    (value : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q2096184_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q2096184_set A),
    q2096184_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q2096184_ennreal_le
        (q2096184_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q2096184_ennreal_eq value
      (q2096184_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q2096184_ennreal_mul
            (q2096184_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q2096184_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q2096184_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q2096184_ennreal)
    (value : q2096184_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2096184_ennreal_supremum
    (q2096184_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q2096184_norm_ennreal {G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x : G) : q2096184_ennreal :=
  q2096184_ennreal_finite
    (q2096184_norm V x)
    (q2096184_norm_nonnegative V x).

Definition q2096184_integrable {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  q2096184_ae_strongly_measurable V mu f /\
  exists value : q2096184_ennreal,
    q2096184_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q2096184_norm_ennreal V (f x)) value /\
    q2096184_ennreal_finite_value value.

Fixpoint q2096184_vector_sum {G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => q2096184_zero V
  | S k =>
      q2096184_add V
        (q2096184_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q2096184_weighted_cell_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (cell : q2096184_set A)
    (coefficient value : G) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q2096184_zero V /\
    value = q2096184_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q2096184_ennreal_represents
      (q2096184_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value = q2096184_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q2096184_simple_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q2096184_set A),
    q2096184_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q2096184_weighted_cell_value
        V mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q2096184_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q2096184_l1_approximates {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q2096184_ennreal,
        q2096184_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q2096184_norm_ennreal V
              (q2096184_sub V (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q2096184_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q2096184_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q2096184_standard_bochner_integral_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
         (integrals : nat -> G),
    (forall n : nat,
      q2096184_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q2096184_simple_integral_has_value
        V mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q2096184_l1_approximates V mu approximants f /\
    q2096184_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q2096184_bochner_integral {A G : Type}
    (V : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : G :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : G,
            q2096184_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits (q2096184_zero V))
        (fun value : G =>
          q2096184_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value)
  | right _ => q2096184_zero V
  end.

Definition q2096184_continuous_at
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) (v : V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : V,
        q2096184_norm NV (q2096184_sub NV w v) < delta ->
        q2096184_norm NE
          (q2096184_sub NE (f w) (f v)) < epsilon.

Definition q2096184_continuous
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) : Prop :=
  forall v : V, q2096184_continuous_at NV NE f v.

Definition q2096184_has_directional_derivative
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) (direction : V)
    (derivative : V -> E) : Prop :=
  forall (x : V) (epsilon : R),
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall t : R,
        Rabs t < delta ->
        q2096184_norm NE
          (q2096184_sub NE
            (q2096184_sub NE
              (f (q2096184_add NV x
                (q2096184_smul NV t direction)))
              (f x))
            (q2096184_smul NE t (derivative x)))
        <= epsilon * Rabs t.

Definition q2096184_schwartz
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (VH : q2096184_real_inner_product_space NV)
    (D : q2096184_finite_dimensional VH)
    (NE : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) : Prop :=
  exists derivatives :
      list (Fin.t (q2096184_dimension D)) -> V -> E,
    derivatives nil = f /\
    (forall (directions : list (Fin.t (q2096184_dimension D)))
            (i : Fin.t (q2096184_dimension D)),
      q2096184_has_directional_derivative NV NE
        (derivatives directions)
        (q2096184_basis D i)
        (derivatives (cons i directions))) /\
    (forall directions,
      q2096184_continuous NV NE (derivatives directions)) /\
    forall (directions : list (Fin.t (q2096184_dimension D)))
           (power : nat),
      exists bound : R,
        0 <= bound /\
        forall x : V,
          (1 + q2096184_norm NV x) ^ power *
            q2096184_norm NE (derivatives directions x)
          <= bound.

Fixpoint q2096184_complex_sum
    (u : nat -> q2096184_complex)
    (n : nat) : q2096184_complex :=
  match n with
  | O => q2096184_czero
  | S k =>
      q2096184_cadd
        (q2096184_complex_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q2096184_complex_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> q2096184_complex)
    (limit : q2096184_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q2096184_complex_modulus
          (q2096184_csub (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q2096184_complex_norm_ennreal
    (z : q2096184_complex) : q2096184_ennreal :=
  q2096184_ennreal_finite
    (q2096184_complex_modulus z)
    (sqrt_pos
      (q2096184_re z * q2096184_re z +
       q2096184_im z * q2096184_im z)).

Definition q2096184_complex_weighted_cell_value
    {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (cell : q2096184_set A)
    (coefficient value : q2096184_complex) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q2096184_czero /\
    value = q2096184_czero) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q2096184_ennreal_represents
      (q2096184_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value =
      q2096184_cmul
        (q2096184_real_to_complex mass) coefficient.

Definition q2096184_complex_simple_integral_has_value
    {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> q2096184_complex)
    (value : q2096184_complex) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients terms : nat -> q2096184_complex)
         (cells : nat -> q2096184_set A),
    q2096184_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q2096184_complex_weighted_cell_value
        mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q2096184_complex_sum terms k.

Definition q2096184_complex_l1_approximates
    {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> q2096184_complex)
    (f : A -> q2096184_complex) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q2096184_ennreal,
        q2096184_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q2096184_complex_norm_ennreal
              (q2096184_csub (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q2096184_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q2096184_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q2096184_standard_complex_bochner_integral_value
    {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q2096184_complex)
    (value : q2096184_complex) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> q2096184_complex)
         (integrals : nat -> q2096184_complex),
    (forall n : nat,
      q2096184_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q2096184_complex_simple_integral_has_value
        mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q2096184_complex_l1_approximates mu approximants f /\
    q2096184_complex_sequence_converges integrals value.

Definition q2096184_complex_bochner_integral
    {A : Type}
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q2096184_complex) : q2096184_complex :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : q2096184_complex,
            q2096184_standard_complex_bochner_integral_value
              mu f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits q2096184_czero)
        (fun value : q2096184_complex =>
          q2096184_standard_complex_bochner_integral_value
            mu f value)
  | right _ => q2096184_czero
  end.

Definition q2096184_fourier_character (t : R) : q2096184_complex :=
  q2096184_complex_exp
    (q2096184_cmul
      (q2096184_real_to_complex (- (2 * PI * t)))
      q2096184_ci).

Definition q2096184_fourier_transform
    {V E : Type}
    {NV : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q2096184_real_inner_product_space NV)
    {NE : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (CE : q2096184_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q2096184_measure_space V)
    (f : V -> E) : V -> E :=
  fun w =>
    q2096184_bochner_integral NE mu
      (fun x =>
        q2096184_csmul CE
          (q2096184_fourier_character
            (q2096184_inner H x w))
          (f x)).

Theorem SchwartzMap_integral_inner_fourier_fourier :
  forall (V Hilbert : Type)
         (NV : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space V)
         (VH : q2096184_real_inner_product_space NV)
         (D : q2096184_finite_dimensional VH)
         (NH : q2096184_normed_real_vector_space Hilbert)
         (CH : q2096184_complex_normed_space NH)
         (IH : q2096184_complex_inner_product_space CH)
         (mu : q2096184_measure_space V)
         (f g : V -> Hilbert),
    q2096184_is_euclidean_lebesgue_measure D mu ->
    q2096184_complete NH ->
    @q2096184_schwartz V Hilbert NV VH D NH f ->
    @q2096184_schwartz V Hilbert NV VH D NH g ->
    q2096184_complex_bochner_integral mu
      (fun xi =>
        q2096184_hinner IH
          (q2096184_fourier_transform VH CH mu f xi)
          (q2096184_fourier_transform VH CH mu g xi))
    =
    q2096184_complex_bochner_integral mu
      (fun x => q2096184_hinner IH (f x) (g x)).
Admitted.

title: Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q2096184, "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform preserves the
  integrated complex inner product of arbitrary Hilbert-space-valued Schwartz
  functions on a finite-dimensional real inner product space. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration" "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition q2096184_complex_hilbert_space ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'h::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'h) \<Rightarrow>
      ('h \<Rightarrow> 'h \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2096184_complex_hilbert_space cscale cinner \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. cinner (x + y) z = cinner x z + cinner y z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. cinner (cscale a x) y = cnj a * cinner x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. cinner x (y + z) = cinner x y + cinner x z) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. cinner x (cscale a y) = a * cinner x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. cinner x y = cnj (cinner y x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cinner x x = of_real (norm x ^ 2))"

definition q2096184_orthonormal_basis ::
    "'v::real_inner set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2096184_orthonormal_basis B \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite_dimensional_vector_space
      ((*\<^sub>R) :: real \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v) B \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> B. \<forall>v \<in> B. inner u v = (if u = v then 1 else 0))"

definition q2096184_parallelotope ::
    "'v::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q2096184_parallelotope B =
    {(\<Sum>b\<in>B. c b *\<^sub>R b) | c. \<forall>b \<in> B. 0 \<le> c b \<and> c b < 1}"

definition q2096184_lebesgue_measure ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2096184_lebesgue_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
    sets M = sets borel \<and>
    (\<forall>a. distr M borel ((+) a) = M) \<and>
    (\<forall>B. q2096184_orthonormal_basis B \<longrightarrow>
      measure M (q2096184_parallelotope B) = 1)"

fun q2096184_iterated_directional_derivative ::
    "('v::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'h::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow>
      'v list \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'h" where
  "q2096184_iterated_directional_derivative f [] x = f x"
| "q2096184_iterated_directional_derivative f (v # vs) x =
    frechet_derivative
      (q2096184_iterated_directional_derivative f vs) (at x) v"

definition q2096184_schwartz ::
    "('v::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'h::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2096184_schwartz f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>vs x.
      q2096184_iterated_directional_derivative f vs differentiable (at x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>vs n. \<exists>C::real. 0 \<le> C \<and>
      (\<forall>x. (1 + norm x) ^ n *
        norm (q2096184_iterated_directional_derivative f vs x) \<le> C))"

definition q2096184_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2096184_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
      (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f x))"

definition q2096184_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2096184_has_bochner_integral M f I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2096184_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b.
      (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (norm (f x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> I))"

definition q2096184_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'b" where
  "q2096184_bochner_integral M f =
    (if \<exists>I. q2096184_has_bochner_integral M f I
     then THE I. q2096184_has_bochner_integral M f I
     else 0)"

definition q2096184_fourier ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'h::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'h) \<Rightarrow>
      'v::{real_inner,real_normed_vector} measure \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'h) \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'h" where
  "q2096184_fourier cscale M f xi =
    q2096184_bochner_integral M
      (\<lambda>x. cscale
        (exp (- (\<i> * of_real (2 * pi * inner x xi)))) (f x))"

theorem integral_inner_fourier_fourier:
  fixes M :: "'v::{real_inner,real_normed_vector} measure"
    and cscale ::
      "complex \<Rightarrow> 'h::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'h"
    and cinner :: "'h \<Rightarrow> 'h \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and f g :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'h"
  assumes finite_dimensional: "\<exists>B. q2096184_orthonormal_basis B"
    and lebesgue_measure: "q2096184_lebesgue_measure M"
    and hilbert_space: "q2096184_complex_hilbert_space cscale cinner"
    and f_schwartz: "q2096184_schwartz f"
    and g_schwartz: "q2096184_schwartz g"
  shows
    "q2096184_bochner_integral M
        (\<lambda>xi. cinner (q2096184_fourier cscale M f xi)
          (q2096184_fourier cscale M g xi)) =
      q2096184_bochner_integral M
        (\<lambda>x. cinner (f x) (g x))"
  sorry

end

title: Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2096184,
  "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform preserves the integral of the
  pointwise complex inner product of Schwartz maps on a finite-dimensional
  real inner-product space. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q2096184_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q2096184_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q2096184_output;;
let q2096184_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q2096184_formatter path);;
let q2096184_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q2096184_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q2096184_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q2096184_formatter ();;
close_out q2096184_output;;
if not q2096184_loaded then failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q2096184_PLANCHEREL_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let cadd =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
   let cmul =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
         FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
   let cnj =
      \(z:real#real). (FST z,--(SND z)) in
   let cmod =
      \(z:real#real).
        sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in
   let cone = (&1,&0) in
   let czero = (&0,&0) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:V) /\
        (!s:V->bool. events s ==> events ((:V) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->V->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:V | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:V->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->V->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:V | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (P:V->bool).
        ?N:V->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:V | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let real_vector_space =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
       (smulV:real->V->V).
        (!x y:V. addV x y = addV y x) /\
        (!x y z:V. addV (addV x y) z = addV x (addV y z)) /\
        (!x:V. addV x zeroV = x) /\
        (!x:V. addV x (negV x) = zeroV) /\
        (!x:V. negV (negV x) = x) /\
        (!x:V. smulV (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real x:V.
           smulV (a * b) x = smulV a (smulV b x)) /\
        (!a b:real x:V.
           smulV (a + b) x = addV (smulV a x) (smulV b x)) /\
        (!a:real x y:V.
           smulV a (addV x y) = addV (smulV a x) (smulV a y)) /\
        (!x:V. smulV (&0) x = zeroV) /\
        (!a:real. smulV a zeroV = zeroV) in
   let real_inner_product =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (innerV:V->V->real).
        (!x y z:V.
           innerV (addV x y) z = innerV x z + innerV y z) /\
        (!a:real x y:V.
           innerV (smulV a x) y = a * innerV x y) /\
        (!x y:V. innerV x y = innerV y x) /\
        (!x:V. &0 <= innerV x x) /\
        (!x:V. innerV x x = &0 <=> x = zeroV) in
   let vnorm =
      \(innerV:V->V->real) (x:V).
        sqrt(innerV x x) in
   let finite_linear_combination =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (n:num) (basis:num->V) (coeff:num->real) (x:V).
        ?partial:num->V.
          partial 0 = zeroV /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   addV (partial i) (smulV (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial n = x in
   let finite_dimensional =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V).
        ?n:num basis:num->V.
          (!x:V.
             ?coeff:num->real.
               finite_linear_combination
                 zeroV addV smulV n basis coeff x) /\
          (!coeff:num->real.
             finite_linear_combination
               zeroV addV smulV n basis coeff zeroV
             ==> !i. i < n ==> coeff i = &0) in
   let metric_open =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (innerV:V->V->real)
       (s:V->bool).
        !x:V.
          x IN s
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:V.
                  vnorm innerV (addV y (negV x)) < epsilon
                  ==> y IN s in
   let borel_space =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (innerV:V->V->real)
       (events:(V->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:V->bool.
           metric_open addV negV innerV s ==> events s) /\
        (!other:(V->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!s:V->bool.
              metric_open addV negV innerV s ==> other s)
           ==> !s:V->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let complex_vector_space =
      \(zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H).
        (!x y:H. addH x y = addH y x) /\
        (!x y z:H. addH (addH x y) z = addH x (addH y z)) /\
        (!x:H. addH x zeroH = x) /\
        (!x:H. addH x (negH x) = zeroH) /\
        (!x:H. negH (negH x) = x) /\
        (!x:H. csmul cone x = x) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:H.
           csmul (cmul a b) x = csmul a (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:H.
           csmul (cadd a b) x =
           addH (csmul a x) (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a:real#real x y:H.
           csmul a (addH x y) =
           addH (csmul a x) (csmul a y)) /\
        (!x:H. csmul czero x = zeroH) /\
        (!a:real#real. csmul a zeroH = zeroH) in
   let complex_inner_product =
      \(zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real).
        (!x y z:H.
           innerH (addH x y) z =
           cadd (innerH x z) (innerH y z)) /\
        (!a:real#real x y:H.
           innerH (csmul a x) y =
           cmul (cnj a) (innerH x y)) /\
        (!x y:H. innerH x y = cnj (innerH y x)) /\
        (!x:H.
           SND (innerH x x) = &0 /\
           &0 <= FST (innerH x x)) /\
        (!x:H. innerH x x = czero <=> x = zeroH) in
   let hnorm =
      \(innerH:H->H->real#real) (x:H).
        sqrt(FST (innerH x x)) in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < epsilon in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (u:num->H) (l:H).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n
                ==> hnorm innerH (addH (u n) (negH l)) < epsilon in
   let complete_space =
      \(zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real).
        !u:num->H.
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                   N <= m /\ N <= n
                   ==> hnorm innerH
                         (addH (u m) (negH (u n))) < epsilon)
          ==> ?l:H.
                vector_tends zeroH addH negH innerH u l in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (s:V->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:V)) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:V | s x = c}) in
   let simple_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (s:V->H).
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:V)) /\
        (!c:H. events {x:V | s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (h:V->real).
        ?s:num->V->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar events (s n)) /\
          (!x:V. scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (h:V->H).
        ?s:num->V->H.
          (!n. simple_vector events (s n)) /\
          (!x:V.
             vector_tends zeroH addH negH innerH
               (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        ?g:V->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar events g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (h:V->H).
        ?g:V->H.
          strongly_measurable_vector
            events zeroH addH negH innerH g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let integrable_simple_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (s:V->real).
        simple_scalar events s /\
        (!c:real.
           c IN IMAGE s (:V) /\ ~(c = &0)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:V | s x = c}))) in
   let integrable_simple_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (zeroH:H) (s:V->H).
        simple_vector events s /\
        (!c:H.
           c IN IMAGE s (:V) /\ ~(c = zeroH)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:V | s x = c}))) in
   let simple_scalar_integral =
      \(mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (s:V->real) (z:real).
        ?n:num enum:num->real partial:num->real.
          (!c:real.
             c IN IMAGE s (:V) <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = &0 /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 SND (mu {x:V | s x = enum i}) * enum i +
                 partial i) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_vector_integral =
      \(mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H) (s:V->H) (z:H).
        ?n:num enum:num->H partial:num->H.
          (!c:H.
             c IN IMAGE s (:V) <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = zeroH /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 addH
                   (csmul
                     (SND (mu {x:V | s x = enum i}),&0)
                     (enum i))
                   (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (u:real).
        !s:V->real z:real.
          integrable_simple_scalar events mu s /\
          (!x:V. &0 <= s x /\ s x <= h x) /\
          simple_scalar_integral mu s z
          ==> z <= u in
   let has_nonnegative_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (r:real).
        &0 <= r /\
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound events mu h r /\
        (!u:real.
           &0 <= u /\
           nonnegative_integral_upper_bound events mu h u
           ==> r <= u) in
   let scalar_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        ae_strongly_measurable_scalar events mu h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral events mu
             (\x:V. abs(h x)) r) in
   let vector_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (h:V->H).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector
          events mu zeroH addH negH innerH h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral events mu
             (\x:V. hnorm innerH (h x)) r) in
   let has_bochner_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (h:V->H) (z:H).
        ?s:num->V->H ints:num->H.
          (!n. integrable_simple_vector events mu zeroH (s n)) /\
          (!n. simple_vector_integral
                 mu zeroH addH csmul (s n) (ints n)) /\
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                   N <= n
                   ==> ?d:real.
                         has_nonnegative_integral events mu
                           (\x:V.
                              hnorm innerH
                                (addH (s n x) (negH (h x)))) d /\
                         d < epsilon) /\
          vector_tends zeroH addH negH innerH ints z in
   let bochner_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (h:V->H).
        if complete_space zeroH addH negH innerH /\
           vector_integrable
             events mu zeroH addH negH innerH h
        then @z:H.
               has_bochner_integral
                 events mu zeroH addH negH csmul innerH h z
        else zeroH in
   let has_real_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (z:real).
        ?p n:real.
          has_nonnegative_integral events mu
            (\x:V. (abs(h x) + h x) / &2) p /\
          has_nonnegative_integral events mu
            (\x:V. (abs(h x) - h x) / &2) n /\
          z = p - n in
   let real_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        if scalar_integrable events mu h
        then @z:real. has_real_integral events mu h z
        else &0 in
   let complex_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real#real).
        scalar_integrable events mu (\x. FST (h x)) /\
        scalar_integrable events mu (\x. SND (h x)) in
   let complex_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real#real).
        if complex_integrable events mu h
        then (real_integral events mu (\x. FST (h x)),
              real_integral events mu (\x. SND (h x)))
        else czero in
   let normalized_add_haar_measure =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
       (innerV:V->V->real)
       (events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real).
        (!a:V s:V->bool.
           events s ==> mu (IMAGE (addV a) s) = mu s) /\
        (!R:real.
           ~(FST
             (mu {x:V | vnorm innerV x <= R}))) /\
        has_nonnegative_integral events mu
          (\x:V. exp(--pi * vnorm innerV x pow 2)) (&1) in
   let real_linear =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (addH:H->H->H) (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (L:V->H).
        (!x y:V. L (addV x y) = addH (L x) (L y)) /\
        (!a:real x:V. L (smulV a x) = csmul (a,&0) (L x)) in
   let has_frechet_derivative =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (innerV:V->V->real)
       (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real)
       (f:V->H) (L:V->H) (x:V).
        real_linear addV smulV addH csmul L /\
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?delta:real.
                 &0 < delta /\
                 !h:V.
                   vnorm innerV h < delta
                   ==> hnorm innerH
                         (addH
                           (addH (f (addV x h)) (negH (f x)))
                           (negH (L h)))
                       <= epsilon * vnorm innerV h) in
   let replace_direction =
      \(u:num->V) (i:num) (v:V) (j:num).
        if j = i then v else u j in
   let extend_direction =
      \(u:num->V) (n:num) (v:V) (i:num).
        if i < n then u i else v in
   let iterated_derivative_family =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (innerV:V->V->real)
       (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real)
       (f:V->H) (D:num->V->(num->V)->H).
        (!x:V u:num->V. D 0 x u = f x) /\
        (!n x:V u v:num->V.
           (!i. i < n ==> u i = v i)
           ==> D n x u = D n x v) /\
        (!n x:V u:num->V.
           has_frechet_derivative
             addV smulV innerV addH negH csmul innerH
             (\y:V. D n y u)
             (\h:V. D (SUC n) x (extend_direction u n h))
             x) /\
        (!n x:V u:num->V i:num a b:V.
           i < n
           ==> D n x (replace_direction u i (addV a b)) =
               addH
                 (D n x (replace_direction u i a))
                 (D n x (replace_direction u i b))) /\
        (!n x:V u:num->V i:num r:real a:V.
           i < n
           ==> D n x (replace_direction u i (smulV r a)) =
               csmul (r,&0)
                 (D n x (replace_direction u i a))) in
   let schwartz =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (innerV:V->V->real)
       (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real) (f:V->H).
        ?D:num->V->(num->V)->H.
          iterated_derivative_family
            addV smulV innerV addH negH csmul innerH f D /\
          (!n k:num.
             ?C:real.
               &0 <= C /\
               !x:V u:num->V.
                 (!i. i < n ==> vnorm innerV (u i) <= &1)
                 ==> (&1 + vnorm innerV x) pow k *
                     hnorm innerH (D n x u) <= C) in
   let fourier_character =
      \(innerV:V->V->real) (sign:real) (v:V) (w:V).
        (cos(&2 * pi * innerV v w),
         sign * sin(&2 * pi * innerV v w)) in
   let fourier =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroH:H) (addH:H->H->H) (negH:H->H)
       (csmul:(real#real)->H->H)
       (innerH:H->H->real#real)
       (innerV:V->V->real) (f:V->H) (v:V).
        bochner_integral
          events mu zeroH addH negH csmul innerH
          (\w:V.
             csmul (fourier_character innerV (-- &1) v w) (f w)) in
   !zeroV:V
    addV:V->V->V
    negV:V->V
    smulV:real->V->V
    innerV:V->V->real
    events:(V->bool)->bool
    mu:(V->bool)->bool#real
    zeroH:H
    addH:H->H->H
    negH:H->H
    csmul:(real#real)->H->H
    innerH:H->H->real#real.
      real_vector_space zeroV addV negV smulV /\
      real_inner_product zeroV addV smulV innerV /\
      finite_dimensional zeroV addV smulV /\
      borel_space addV negV innerV events /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      normalized_add_haar_measure
        zeroV addV negV innerV events mu /\
      complex_vector_space zeroH addH negH csmul /\
      complex_inner_product zeroH addH csmul innerH /\
      complete_space zeroH addH negH innerH
      ==>
      !f g:V->H.
        schwartz
          addV smulV innerV addH negH csmul innerH f /\
        schwartz
          addV smulV innerV addH negH csmul innerH g
        ==>
        complex_integral events mu
          (\xi:V.
             innerH
               (fourier
                 events mu zeroH addH negH csmul innerH innerV f xi)
               (fourier
                 events mu zeroH addH negH csmul innerH innerV g xi)) =
        complex_integral events mu
          (\x:V. innerH (f x) (g x))`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2096184,
;; "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform preserves the integral of the
;; pointwise complex inner product of arbitrary Hilbert-valued Schwartz maps
;; on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space. This file contains no
;; proof.

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

(defstub q2096184-point-sequence (function-sequence point) t)
(defstub q2096184-simple-integral-sequence
  (real-type domain space measure function-sequence) t)

(defun q2096184-positive-p (real-type x)
  (q2096184-less real-type (q2096184-zero real-type) x))

(defun q2096184-leq (real-type x y)
  (not (q2096184-less real-type y x)))

(defun q2096184-abs (real-type x)
  (if (q2096184-less real-type x (q2096184-zero real-type))
      (q2096184-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q2096184-natural-cast (type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2096184-zero type)
    (q2096184-add
     type
     (q2096184-one type)
     (q2096184-natural-cast type (- n 1)))))

(defun q2096184-integer-cast (type n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q2096184-negate
       type
       (q2096184-natural-cast type (- n)))
    (q2096184-natural-cast type (nfix n))))

(defun q2096184-real-power (real-type x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2096184-one real-type)
    (q2096184-multiply
     real-type x
     (q2096184-real-power real-type x (- n 1)))))

(defun q2096184-vector-sum
    (real-type space basis coordinates vector n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2096184-zero space)
    (let ((i (- n 1)))
      (q2096184-add
       space
       (q2096184-vector-sum
        real-type space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q2096184-smul
        real-type space
        (q2096184-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q2096184-basis-at basis i))))))

(defun q2096184-zero-multiindex (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons 0 (q2096184-zero-multiindex (- n 1)))))

(defun q2096184-natural-list-p (alpha n)
  (if (zp n)
      (equal alpha nil)
    (and
     (consp alpha)
     (natp (car alpha))
     (q2096184-natural-list-p (cdr alpha) (- n 1)))))

(defun q2096184-increment-multiindex (alpha i)
  (if (consp alpha)
      (if (zp i)
          (cons (+ 1 (nfix (car alpha))) (cdr alpha))
        (cons
         (car alpha)
         (q2096184-increment-multiindex (cdr alpha) (- i 1))))
    nil))

(defun q2096184-multiindex-degree (alpha)
  (if (consp alpha)
      (+ (nfix (car alpha))
         (q2096184-multiindex-degree (cdr alpha)))
    0))

;; Complete ordered real field and its canonical complexification.

(defun-sk q2096184-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p type x)
      (q2096184-member-p type y)
      (q2096184-member-p type z))
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p type (q2096184-add type x y))
      (q2096184-member-p type (q2096184-multiply type x y))
      (q2096184-member-p type (q2096184-negate type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q2096184-zero type)))
       (q2096184-member-p type (q2096184-inverse type x)))
      (equal
       (q2096184-add type (q2096184-add type x y) z)
       (q2096184-add type x (q2096184-add type y z)))
      (equal (q2096184-add type x y) (q2096184-add type y x))
      (equal (q2096184-add type x (q2096184-zero type)) x)
      (equal
       (q2096184-add type x (q2096184-negate type x))
       (q2096184-zero type))
      (equal
       (q2096184-multiply type (q2096184-multiply type x y) z)
       (q2096184-multiply type x (q2096184-multiply type y z)))
      (equal
       (q2096184-multiply type x y)
       (q2096184-multiply type y x))
      (equal (q2096184-multiply type x (q2096184-one type)) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q2096184-zero type)))
       (equal
        (q2096184-multiply type x (q2096184-inverse type x))
        (q2096184-one type)))
      (equal
       (q2096184-multiply type x (q2096184-add type y z))
       (q2096184-add
        type
        (q2096184-multiply type x y)
        (q2096184-multiply type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p real-type x)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type y)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q2096184-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q2096184-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q2096184-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q2096184-less real-type x y)
        (q2096184-less real-type y z))
       (q2096184-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q2096184-less real-type x y)
       (q2096184-less
        real-type
        (q2096184-add real-type x z)
        (q2096184-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q2096184-positive-p real-type x)
        (q2096184-positive-p real-type y))
       (q2096184-positive-p
        real-type
        (q2096184-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun q2096184-distance
    (real-type type x y)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (q2096184-norm
   type
   (q2096184-add type x (q2096184-negate type y))))

(defun-sk q2096184-norm-values-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p type x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p real-type (q2096184-norm type x))
      (q2096184-leq
       real-type
       (q2096184-zero real-type)
       (q2096184-norm type x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q2096184-norm type x)
        (q2096184-zero real-type))
       (equal x (q2096184-zero type)))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-norm-triangle-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p type x)
      (q2096184-member-p type y))
     (q2096184-leq
      real-type
      (q2096184-norm type (q2096184-add type x y))
      (q2096184-add
       real-type
       (q2096184-norm type x)
       (q2096184-norm type y))))))

(defun q2096184-norm-laws-p (real-type type)
  (and
   (q2096184-norm-values-p real-type type)
   (q2096184-norm-triangle-p real-type type)))

(defun-sk q2096184-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))
     (q2096184-less
      real-type
      (q2096184-distance
       real-type type
       (q2096184-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2096184-convergence-start-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q2096184-convergence-tail-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q2096184-converges-p
    (real-type type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q2096184-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q2096184-convergence-start-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2096184-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m) (natp n) (natp start)
      (<= start m) (<= start n))
     (q2096184-less
      real-type
      (q2096184-distance
       real-type type
       (q2096184-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q2096184-sequence-at sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2096184-cauchy-start-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q2096184-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q2096184-cauchy-p (real-type type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q2096184-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q2096184-cauchy-start-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2096184-sequence-in-type-p (type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2096184-member-p
      type
      (q2096184-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-limit-exists-p
    (real-type type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q2096184-member-p type limit)
     (q2096184-converges-p
      real-type type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q2096184-complete-p (real-type type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-sequence-in-type-p type sequence)
      (q2096184-cauchy-p real-type type sequence))
     (q2096184-limit-exists-p
      real-type type sequence))))

(defun-sk q2096184-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2096184-less
      real-type x
      (q2096184-natural-cast real-type n)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p real-type x)
     (q2096184-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q2096184-real-norm-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (equal
       (q2096184-norm real-type x)
       (q2096184-abs real-type x))
      (equal (q2096184-star real-type x) x)
      (equal
       (q2096184-real-part real-type real-type x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q2096184-imag-part real-type real-type x)
       (q2096184-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q2096184-of-real real-type real-type x)
       x)))))

(defun q2096184-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q2096184-member-p real-type (q2096184-zero real-type))
   (q2096184-member-p real-type (q2096184-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q2096184-zero real-type)
     (q2096184-one real-type)))
   (q2096184-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q2096184-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q2096184-positive-p real-type (q2096184-one real-type))
   (q2096184-real-norm-laws-p real-type)
   (q2096184-complete-p real-type real-type)
   (q2096184-archimedean-p real-type)))

(defun-sk q2096184-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p complex-type z)
     (let* ((re (q2096184-real-part real-type complex-type z))
            (im (q2096184-imag-part real-type complex-type z))
            (re-z (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type re))
            (im-z
             (q2096184-multiply
              complex-type
              (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type im)
              (q2096184-imaginary-unit complex-type))))
       (and
        (q2096184-member-p real-type re)
        (q2096184-member-p real-type im)
        (equal z (q2096184-add complex-type re-z im-z))
        (equal
         (q2096184-star complex-type z)
         (q2096184-add
          complex-type re-z
          (q2096184-negate complex-type im-z)))
        (equal
         (q2096184-multiply
          real-type
          (q2096184-norm complex-type z)
          (q2096184-norm complex-type z))
         (q2096184-add
          real-type
          (q2096184-multiply real-type re re)
          (q2096184-multiply real-type im im))))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-of-real-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p real-type x)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type y))
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p
       complex-type
       (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type x))
      (equal
       (q2096184-real-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       x)
      (equal
       (q2096184-imag-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       (q2096184-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q2096184-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q2096184-add real-type x y))
       (q2096184-add
        complex-type
        (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type y)))
      (equal
       (q2096184-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q2096184-multiply real-type x y))
       (q2096184-multiply
        complex-type
        (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type y)))))))

(defun q2096184-complex-field-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (and
   (q2096184-real-field-p real-type)
   (q2096184-member-p complex-type (q2096184-zero complex-type))
   (q2096184-member-p complex-type (q2096184-one complex-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q2096184-zero complex-type)
     (q2096184-one complex-type)))
   (q2096184-field-laws-p complex-type)
   (q2096184-of-real-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (equal
    (q2096184-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q2096184-zero real-type))
    (q2096184-zero complex-type))
   (equal
    (q2096184-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q2096184-one real-type))
    (q2096184-one complex-type))
   (equal
    (q2096184-multiply
     complex-type
     (q2096184-imaginary-unit complex-type)
     (q2096184-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q2096184-negate complex-type (q2096184-one complex-type)))
   (equal
    (q2096184-real-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q2096184-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q2096184-zero real-type))
   (equal
    (q2096184-imag-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q2096184-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q2096184-one real-type))
   (q2096184-complex-coordinate-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q2096184-norm-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q2096184-complete-p real-type complex-type)))

;; Real and complex inner-product spaces.

(defun-sk q2096184-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q2096184-member-p scalar-type b)
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (q2096184-member-p space y)
      (q2096184-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space (q2096184-add space x y))
      (q2096184-member-p space (q2096184-negate space x))
      (q2096184-member-p
       space (q2096184-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (equal
       (q2096184-add space (q2096184-add space x y) z)
       (q2096184-add space x (q2096184-add space y z)))
      (equal (q2096184-add space x y) (q2096184-add space y x))
      (equal (q2096184-add space x (q2096184-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q2096184-add space x (q2096184-negate space x))
       (q2096184-zero space))
      (equal
       (q2096184-smul
        scalar-type space (q2096184-one scalar-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q2096184-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q2096184-multiply scalar-type a b) x)
       (q2096184-smul
        scalar-type space a
        (q2096184-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q2096184-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q2096184-add scalar-type a b) x)
       (q2096184-add
        space
        (q2096184-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q2096184-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q2096184-smul
        scalar-type space a (q2096184-add space x y))
       (q2096184-add
        space
        (q2096184-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q2096184-smul scalar-type space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-normed-space-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q2096184-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q2096184-norm
       space
       (q2096184-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (q2096184-multiply
       real-type
       (q2096184-norm scalar-type a)
       (q2096184-norm space x))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (q2096184-member-p space y)
      (q2096184-member-p space z))
     (let ((xy (q2096184-inner scalar-type space x y))
           (xx (q2096184-inner scalar-type space x x)))
       (and
        (q2096184-member-p scalar-type xy)
        (equal
         (q2096184-inner
          scalar-type space x (q2096184-add space y z))
         (q2096184-add
          scalar-type xy
          (q2096184-inner scalar-type space x z)))
        (equal
         (q2096184-inner
          scalar-type space x
          (q2096184-smul scalar-type space a y))
         (q2096184-multiply scalar-type a xy))
        (equal
         (q2096184-inner scalar-type space y x)
         (q2096184-star scalar-type xy))
        (equal
         (q2096184-multiply
          real-type
          (q2096184-norm space x)
          (q2096184-norm space x))
         (q2096184-real-part real-type scalar-type xx))
        (iff
         (equal xx (q2096184-zero scalar-type))
         (equal x (q2096184-zero space))))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-real-smul-compatibility-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (r x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p real-type r)
      (q2096184-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q2096184-smul real-type space r x)
      (q2096184-smul
       complex-type space
       (q2096184-of-real real-type complex-type r)
       x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (i j x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
      (q2096184-member-p space (q2096184-basis-at basis i)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp i) (natp j)
       (< i dimension) (< j dimension))
      (equal
       (q2096184-inner
        real-type space
        (q2096184-basis-at basis i)
        (q2096184-basis-at basis j))
       (if (equal i j)
           (q2096184-one real-type)
         (q2096184-zero real-type))))
     (implies
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
        (q2096184-member-p
         real-type
         (q2096184-coordinate coordinates x i)))
       (equal
        x
        (q2096184-vector-sum
         real-type space basis coordinates x dimension)))))))

(defun q2096184-finite-real-inner-product-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (and
   (natp dimension)
   (q2096184-member-p space (q2096184-zero space))
   (q2096184-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q2096184-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q2096184-normed-space-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q2096184-inner-product-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q2096184-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)))

(defun q2096184-complex-hilbert-space-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (and
   (q2096184-member-p space (q2096184-zero space))
   (q2096184-vector-space-laws-p complex-type space)
   (q2096184-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q2096184-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q2096184-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q2096184-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type real-type space)
   (q2096184-real-smul-compatibility-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q2096184-inner-product-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q2096184-complete-p real-type space)))

;; Borel sigma algebra and normalized translation-invariant volume.

(defun-sk q2096184-countable-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-sequence-at sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q2096184-valid-set-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-set-member-p set x)
     (q2096184-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q2096184-sets-equal-on-p (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p space x)
     (iff
      (q2096184-set-member-p left x)
      (q2096184-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-empty-on-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p space x)
     (not (q2096184-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-full-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-full-set space) x)
     (q2096184-member-p space x))))

(defun-sk q2096184-complement-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-complement-set space set) x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (not (q2096184-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-countable-union-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (sequence x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-countable-union-set space sequence) x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (q2096184-countable-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-open-ball-set-law-p (real-type space)
  (forall (center radius x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-open-ball-set space center radius) x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (q2096184-member-p space center)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type radius)
      (q2096184-less
       real-type
       (q2096184-distance real-type space x center)
       radius)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-preimage-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function set x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-preimage-set function set) x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p domain x)
      (q2096184-set-member-p
       set (q2096184-function-at function x))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-translate-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (set shift x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-translate-set space set shift) x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (q2096184-set-member-p
       set
       (q2096184-add
        space x (q2096184-negate space shift)))))))

(defun q2096184-set-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type space)
  (and
   (q2096184-full-set-law-p space)
   (q2096184-complement-set-law-p space)
   (q2096184-countable-union-set-law-p space)
   (q2096184-open-ball-set-law-p real-type space)
   (q2096184-translate-set-law-p space)))

(defun-sk q2096184-sequence-measurable-p (family sequence)

    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2096184-family-member-p
      family
      (q2096184-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-family-valid-sets-p (space family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2096184-family-member-p family set)
     (q2096184-valid-set-p space set))))

(defun-sk q2096184-family-extensional-p (space family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-family-member-p family left)
      (q2096184-valid-set-p space right)
      (q2096184-sets-equal-on-p space left right))
     (q2096184-family-member-p family right))))

(defun-sk q2096184-sigma-algebra-closure-p (space family)
  (forall (set sequence)
    (and
     (q2096184-family-member-p family (q2096184-full-set space))
     (implies
      (q2096184-family-member-p family set)
      (q2096184-family-member-p
       family (q2096184-complement-set space set)))
     (implies
      (q2096184-sequence-measurable-p family sequence)
      (q2096184-family-member-p
       family
       (q2096184-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun q2096184-sigma-algebra-p (space family)
  (and
   (q2096184-family-valid-sets-p space family)
   (q2096184-family-extensional-p space family)
   (q2096184-sigma-algebra-closure-p space family)))

(defun-sk q2096184-balls-measurable-p
    (real-type space family)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space center)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type radius)
      (q2096184-positive-p real-type radius))
     (q2096184-family-member-p
      family
      (q2096184-open-ball-set space center radius)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-family-subset-p (left right)

    (implies

     (q2096184-family-member-p right set))))

(defun-sk q2096184-borel-minimal-p

  (forall (candidate)
    (implies

      (q2096184-sigma-algebra-p space candidate)
      (q2096184-balls-measurable-p
       real-type space candidate))
     (q2096184-family-subset-p borel candidate))))

(defun q2096184-borel-space-p
    (real-type space borel)
  (and
   (q2096184-sigma-algebra-p space borel)
   (q2096184-balls-measurable-p real-type space borel)
   (q2096184-borel-minimal-p real-type space borel)))

(defun q2096184-ennreal-p (real-type x)
  (or
   (equal x :q2096184-top)
   (and
    (consp x)
    (equal (car x) :q2096184-finite)
    (q2096184-member-p real-type (cdr x))
    (q2096184-leq
     real-type (q2096184-zero real-type) (cdr x)))))

(defun q2096184-ennreal-finite (x)
  (cons :q2096184-finite x))

(defun q2096184-ennreal-add (real-type x y)
  (if (or
       (equal x :q2096184-top)
       (equal y :q2096184-top))
      :q2096184-top
    (q2096184-ennreal-finite
     (q2096184-add real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun q2096184-ennreal-leq-p (real-type x y)
  (or
   (equal y :q2096184-top)
   (and
    (not (equal x :q2096184-top))
    (q2096184-leq real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-disjoint-sequence-p
    (space sequence)
  (forall (i j x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp i) (natp j)
      (not (equal i j))
      (q2096184-member-p space x))
     (not
      (and
       (q2096184-set-member-p
        (q2096184-sequence-at sequence i) x)
       (q2096184-set-member-p
        (q2096184-sequence-at sequence j) x))))))

(defun q2096184-ennreal-partial-sum
    (real-type measure sequence n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2096184-ennreal-finite (q2096184-zero real-type))
    (q2096184-ennreal-add
     real-type
     (q2096184-ennreal-partial-sum
      real-type measure sequence (- n 1))
     (q2096184-measure-value
      measure
      (q2096184-sequence-at sequence (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-ennreal-upper-bound-p
    (real-type measure sequence bound)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2096184-ennreal-leq-p
      real-type
      (q2096184-ennreal-partial-sum
       real-type measure sequence n)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2096184-ennreal-series-value-p
    (real-type measure sequence value)
  (forall (bound)
    (iff
     (q2096184-ennreal-upper-bound-p
      real-type measure sequence bound)
     (q2096184-ennreal-leq-p real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q2096184-countable-additivity-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q2096184-disjoint-sequence-p space sequence))
     (q2096184-ennreal-series-value-p
      real-type
      measure
      sequence
      (q2096184-measure-value
       measure
       (q2096184-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-measure-values-p (real-type measure)
  (forall (set)
    (q2096184-ennreal-p
     real-type
     (q2096184-measure-value measure set))))

(defun-sk q2096184-measure-extensional-p (space measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-valid-set-p space left)
      (q2096184-valid-set-p space right)
      (q2096184-sets-equal-on-p space left right))
     (equal
      (q2096184-measure-value measure left)
      (q2096184-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-empty-measurable-zero-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-family-member-p measurable set)
      (q2096184-empty-on-p space set))
     (equal
      (q2096184-measure-value measure set)
      (q2096184-ennreal-finite
       (q2096184-zero real-type))))))

(defun q2096184-measure-space-p
    (real-type space measurable measure)
  (and
   (q2096184-sigma-algebra-p space measurable)
   (q2096184-measure-values-p real-type measure)
   (q2096184-measure-extensional-p space measure)
   (q2096184-empty-measurable-zero-p
    real-type space measurable measure)
   (equal
    (q2096184-measure-value
     measure
     (q2096184-complement-set
      space (q2096184-full-set space)))
    (q2096184-ennreal-finite (q2096184-zero real-type)))
   (q2096184-countable-additivity-p
    real-type space measurable measure)))

(defun q2096184-unit-coordinates-p
    (real-type coordinates x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      t
    (let ((c
           (q2096184-coordinate
            coordinates x (- n 1))))
      (and
       (q2096184-leq
        real-type (q2096184-zero real-type) c)
       (q2096184-less
        real-type c (q2096184-one real-type))
       (q2096184-unit-coordinates-p
        real-type coordinates x (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-unit-cell-coordinate-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-unit-cell-set
       space basis coordinates dimension)
      x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p space x)
      (q2096184-unit-coordinates-p
       real-type coordinates x dimension)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-translation-invariant-p
    (space measurable measure)
  (forall (set shift)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-family-member-p measurable set)
      (q2096184-member-p space shift))
     (equal
      (q2096184-measure-value
       measure
       (q2096184-translate-set space set shift))
      (q2096184-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun q2096184-volume-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension measurable measure)
  (and
   (q2096184-borel-space-p real-type space measurable)
   (q2096184-measure-space-p
    real-type space measurable measure)
   (q2096184-unit-cell-coordinate-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
   (q2096184-family-member-p
    measurable
    (q2096184-unit-cell-set
     space basis coordinates dimension))
   (equal
    (q2096184-measure-value
     measure
     (q2096184-unit-cell-set
      space basis coordinates dimension))
    (q2096184-ennreal-finite
     (q2096184-one real-type)))
   (q2096184-translation-invariant-p
    space measurable measure)))

;; Lebesgue lower integration and Bochner integration.

(defun-sk q2096184-function-into-p
    (domain codomain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p domain x)
     (q2096184-member-p
      codomain
      (q2096184-function-at function x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-continuous-at-delta-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p domain y)
      (q2096184-less
       real-type
       (q2096184-distance real-type domain y x)
       delta))
     (q2096184-less
      real-type
      (q2096184-distance
       real-type codomain
       (q2096184-function-at function y)
       (q2096184-function-at function x))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2096184-continuous-at-epsilon-p
    (real-type domain codomain function x epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q2096184-member-p real-type delta)
     (q2096184-positive-p real-type delta)
     (q2096184-continuous-at-delta-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q2096184-continuous-function-p
    (real-type domain codomain function)
  (forall (x epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p domain x)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q2096184-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q2096184-continuous-at-epsilon-p
      real-type domain codomain function x epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2096184-function-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (type f g set value x)
    (and
     (equal
      (q2096184-function-at
       (q2096184-function-add type f g) x)
      (q2096184-add
       type
       (q2096184-function-at f x)
       (q2096184-function-at g x)))
     (equal
      (q2096184-function-at
       (q2096184-function-difference type f g) x)
      (q2096184-add
       type
       (q2096184-function-at f x)
       (q2096184-negate
        type (q2096184-function-at g x))))
     (equal
      (q2096184-function-at
       (q2096184-function-norm real-type type f) x)
      (q2096184-norm type (q2096184-function-at f x)))
     (equal
      (q2096184-function-at
       (q2096184-indicator-function real-type set) x)
      (if (q2096184-set-member-p set x)
          (q2096184-one real-type)
        (q2096184-zero real-type))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-fiber-set-law-p (domain)
  (forall (function value x)
    (iff
     (q2096184-set-member-p
      (q2096184-fiber-set function value)
      x)
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p domain x)
      (equal (q2096184-function-at function x) value)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-measurable-function-p
    (real-type domain measurable codomain function)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-member-p codomain center)
      (q2096184-member-p real-type radius)
      (q2096184-positive-p real-type radius))
     (q2096184-family-member-p
      measurable
      (q2096184-preimage-set
       function
       (q2096184-open-ball-set
        codomain center radius))))))

(defun-sk q2096184-nonnegative-values-p
    (real-type domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p domain x)
     (q2096184-leq
      real-type
      (q2096184-zero real-type)
      (q2096184-function-at function x)))))

(defun q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
    (real-type domain measurable function)
  (and
   (q2096184-function-into-p
    domain real-type function)
   (q2096184-measurable-function-p
    real-type domain measurable real-type function)
   (q2096184-nonnegative-values-p
    real-type domain function)))

(defun-sk q2096184-pointwise-leq-p
    (real-type domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p domain x)
     (q2096184-leq
      real-type
      (q2096184-function-at left x)
      (q2096184-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-functions-equal-on-p
    (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2096184-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q2096184-function-at left x)
      (q2096184-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q2096184-lintegral-laws-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (f g set)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2096184-functions-equal-on-p domain f g)
      (equal
       (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
       real-type domain measurable f)
      (q2096184-ennreal-p
       real-type
       (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral f)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)
       (q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable g)
       (q2096184-pointwise-leq-p real-type domain f g))
      (q2096184-ennreal-leq-p
       real-type
       (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q2096184-family-member-p measurable set)
      (equal
       (q2096184-lintegral-value
        lintegral
        (q2096184-indicator-function real-type set))
       (q2096184-measure-value measure set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)
       (q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable g))
      (equal
       (q2096184-lintegral-value
        lintegral
        (q2096184-function-add real-type f g))
       (q2096184-ennreal-add
        real-type
        (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral f)
        (q2096184-lintegral-value lintegral g)))))))

(defun q2096184-simple-values-correct-p

       (q2096184-family-member-p

        (q2096184-fiber-set function (car values)))

(defun q2096184-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
    (space values)
  (if (consp values)

       (q2096184-member-p space (car values))

(defun-sk q2096184-simple-range-values-p

      (q2096184-function-at function x)

    (domain measurable space function)
  (and
   (q2096184-function-into-p domain space function)
   (true-listp (q2096184-simple-values function))
   (no-duplicatesp-equal (q2096184-simple-values function))
   (q2096184-simple-listed-values-in-space-p
    space (q2096184-simple-values function))
   (q2096184-simple-values-correct-p
    domain measurable function
    (q2096184-simple-values function))
   (q2096184-simple-range-values-p
    domain function
    (q2096184-simple-values function))))

(defun q2096184-simple-integrable-values-p
    (real-type domain measure zero function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (implies
        (not
         (q2096184-value-attained-p
          domain function (car values)))
        (equal
         (q2096184-measure-value
          measure
          (q2096184-fiber-set function (car values)))
         (q2096184-ennreal-finite
          (q2096184-zero real-type))))
       (or
        (equal (car values) zero)
        (not
         (equal
          (q2096184-measure-value
           measure
           (q2096184-fiber-set function (car values)))
          :q2096184-top)))
       (q2096184-simple-integrable-values-p
        real-type domain measure zero function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q2096184-simple-integral
    (real-type domain space measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q2096184-add
       space
       (if (or
            (equal (car values) (q2096184-zero space))
            (not
             (q2096184-value-attained-p
              domain function (car values))))
           (q2096184-zero space)
         (q2096184-smul
          real-type space
          (cdr
           (q2096184-measure-value
            measure
            (q2096184-fiber-set function (car values))))
          (car values)))
       (q2096184-simple-integral
        real-type domain space measure function (cdr values)))
    (q2096184-zero space)))

(defun q2096184-ennreal-scale
    (real-type scalar value)
  (if (equal scalar (q2096184-zero real-type))
      (q2096184-ennreal-finite
       (q2096184-zero real-type))
    (if (equal value :q2096184-top)
        :q2096184-top
      (q2096184-ennreal-finite
       (q2096184-multiply
        real-type scalar (cdr value))))))

(defun q2096184-simple-nonnegative-integral
    (real-type domain measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q2096184-ennreal-add
       real-type
       (if
           (q2096184-value-attained-p
            domain function (car values))
           (q2096184-ennreal-scale
            real-type
            (car values)
            (q2096184-measure-value
             measure
             (q2096184-fiber-set function (car values))))
         (q2096184-ennreal-finite
          (q2096184-zero real-type)))
       (q2096184-simple-nonnegative-integral
        real-type domain measure function (cdr values)))
    (q2096184-ennreal-finite
     (q2096184-zero real-type))))

(defun-sk q2096184-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2096184-simple-function-p

      (q2096184-nonnegative-values-p

      (q2096184-pointwise-leq-p
       real-type domain simple function))
     (q2096184-ennreal-leq-p
      real-type
      (q2096184-simple-nonnegative-integral
       real-type domain measure simple
       (q2096184-simple-values simple))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2096184-lintegral-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies

      (q2096184-ennreal-p real-type bound)
      (q2096184-lintegral-upper-bound-p
       real-type domain measurable measure function bound))
     (q2096184-ennreal-leq-p real-type value bound))))

(defun-sk q2096184-lintegral-supremum-laws-p
    (real-type domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q2096184-nonnegative-measurable-p
      real-type domain measurable function)
     (let ((value
            (q2096184-lintegral-value

       (and
        (q2096184-ennreal-p real-type value)
        (q2096184-lintegral-upper-bound-p

        (q2096184-lintegral-least-upper-bound-p

      domain measurable space

(defun-sk q2096184-pointwise-simple-limit-p

  (forall (sequence x n)
