title: Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2096184,
-- "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform preserves the integral of the
-- pointwise complex inner product of Hilbert-valued Schwartz functions on a
-- finite-dimensional real inner-product space. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2096184_plancherel_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Support.Fourier
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

open CompleteOrderedField
open NormedVectorSpace
open ComplexNumber
open ComplexModulus
open ComplexNormedSpace
open FourierContext
open EuclideanLebesguePresentation
open BochnerIntegration

conjugateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  ComplexNumber R ->
  ComplexNumber R
conjugateC reals z =
  complex (realPart z) (negateR reals (imaginaryPart z))

emptyVector :
  {A : Set} ->
  Vector A zero
emptyVector ()

prependVector :
  {A : Set} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  A ->
  Vector A n ->
  Vector A (suc n)
prependVector x xs fzero =
  x
prependVector x xs (fsuc i) =
  xs i

record ComplexHilbertStructure
  {R M V H : Set}
  (context : FourierContext R M V H) : Set1 where
  field
    innerH :
      H -> H -> ComplexNumber R

    inner-add-left :
      (x y z : H) ->
      innerH
        (addE (realSpace (codomain context)) x y)
        z ==
      addC (reals context) (innerH x z) (innerH y z)

    inner-scale-left :
      (a : ComplexNumber R) ->
      (x y : H) ->
      innerH (scaleC (codomain context) a x) y ==
      multiplyC (reals context)
        (conjugateC (reals context) a)
        (innerH x y)

    inner-add-right :
      (x y z : H) ->
      innerH x
        (addE (realSpace (codomain context)) y z) ==
      addC (reals context) (innerH x y) (innerH x z)

    inner-scale-right :
      (a : ComplexNumber R) ->
      (x y : H) ->
      innerH x (scaleC (codomain context) a y) ==
      multiplyC (reals context) a (innerH x y)

    inner-conjugate-symmetry :
      (x y : H) ->
      innerH x y ==
      conjugateC (reals context) (innerH y x)

    inner-nonnegative :
      (x : H) ->
      lessOrEqualR (reals context)
        (zeroR (reals context))
        (realPart (innerH x x))

    inner-definite :
      (x : H) ->
      innerH x x == zeroC (reals context) ->
      x == zeroE (realSpace (codomain context))

    inner-norm-square :
      (x : H) ->
      realPart (innerH x x) ==
      multiplyR (reals context)
        (normE (realSpace (codomain context)) x)
        (normE (realSpace (codomain context)) x)

open ComplexHilbertStructure

DirectionalDerivative :
  {R M V H : Set} ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V H) ->
  (V -> H) ->
  V ->
  V ->
  H ->
  Set
DirectionalDerivative {R = R} context f point direction derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive (reals context) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive (reals context) delta)
        ((t : R) ->
          Positive (reals context) (absoluteR (reals context) t) ->
          StrictLess (reals context)
            (absoluteR (reals context) t)
            delta ->
          StrictLess (reals context)
            (distanceE (realSpace (codomain context))
              (scaleE (realSpace (codomain context))
                (reciprocalR (reals context) t)
                (subtractE (realSpace (codomain context))
                  (f
                    (addE (domain context) point
                      (scaleE (domain context) t direction)))
                  (f point)))
              derivative)
            epsilon))

UnitDirections :
  {R M V H : Set} ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V H) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector V n ->
  Set
UnitDirections context {n = n} directions =
  (i : Fin n) ->
  lessOrEqualR (reals context)
    (normE (domain context) (directions i))
    (oneR (reals context))

record SchwartzMap
  {R M V H : Set}
  (context : FourierContext R M V H) : Set1 where
  field
    function :
      V -> H

    derivatives :
      (n : Nat) ->
      V ->
      Vector V n ->
      H

    derivative-zero :
      (x : V) ->
      derivatives zero x emptyVector == function x

    derivative-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (directions : Vector V n) ->
      (x direction : V) ->
      DirectionalDerivative context
        (\ y -> derivatives n y directions)
        x
        direction
        (derivatives (suc n) x
          (prependVector direction directions))

    derivatives-continuous :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (directions : Vector V n) ->
      Continuous
        (reals context)
        (domain context)
        (realSpace (codomain context))
        (\ x -> derivatives n x directions)

    rapidly-decreasing :
      (n weight : Nat) ->
      Exists R
        (\ bound ->
          Both
            (lessOrEqualR (reals context)
              (zeroR (reals context))
              bound)
            ((x : V) ->
              (directions : Vector V n) ->
              UnitDirections context directions ->
              lessOrEqualR (reals context)
                (multiplyR (reals context)
                  (powerR (reals context)
                    (addR (reals context)
                      (oneR (reals context))
                      (normE (domain context) x))
                    weight)
                  (normE (realSpace (codomain context))
                    (derivatives n x directions)))
                bound))

open SchwartzMap

record PlancherelContext
  (R M V H : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    fourier-context :
      FourierContext R M V H

    hilbert-space :
      ComplexHilbertStructure fourier-context

    scalar-space :
      ComplexNormedSpace R (ComplexNumber R)
        (reals fourier-context)
        (complex-modulus fourier-context)

    scalar-zero :
      zeroE (realSpace scalar-space) ==
      zeroC (reals fourier-context)

    scalar-add :
      (x y : ComplexNumber R) ->
      addE (realSpace scalar-space) x y ==
      addC (reals fourier-context) x y

    scalar-negate :
      (x : ComplexNumber R) ->
      negateE (realSpace scalar-space) x ==
      negateC (reals fourier-context) x

    scalar-real-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      scaleE (realSpace scalar-space) a z ==
      multiplyC (reals fourier-context)
        (fromReal (reals fourier-context) a)
        z

    scalar-complex-scale :
      (a z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      scaleC scalar-space a z ==
      multiplyC (reals fourier-context) a z

    scalar-norm :
      (z : ComplexNumber R) ->
      normE (realSpace scalar-space) z ==
      modulus (complex-modulus fourier-context) z

    scalar-complete :
      Complete
        (reals fourier-context)
        (distanceE (realSpace scalar-space))

    scalar-integration :
      BochnerIntegration
        (reals fourier-context)
        (realSpace scalar-space)
        (events (lebesgue fourier-context))
        (extended (lebesgue fourier-context))
        (volume (lebesgue fourier-context))

open PlancherelContext

scalarIntegral :
  {R M V H : Set} ->
  (context : PlancherelContext R M V H) ->
  (V -> ComplexNumber R) ->
  ComplexNumber R
scalarIntegral context =
  integralVector (scalar-integration context)

plancherel-theorem : Set2
plancherel-theorem =
  (R M V H : Set) ->
  (context : PlancherelContext R M V H) ->
  (f g : SchwartzMap (fourier-context context)) ->
  scalarIntegral context
    (\ frequency ->
      innerH (hilbert-space context)
        (fourierInContext (fourier-context context)
          (function f)
          frequency)
        (fourierInContext (fourier-context context)
          (function g)
          frequency)) ==
  scalarIntegral context
    (\ point ->
      innerH (hilbert-space context)
        (function f point)
        (function g point))

title: Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2096184, "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform preserves the
  integral inner product of Schwartz functions on a finite-dimensional real
  inner-product space with values in a complex Hilbert space. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open complexTheory topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q2096184_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q2096184_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero)``);

val q2096184_orthonormal_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_orthonormal_basis_def",
  ``q2096184_orthonormal_basis
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (n : num) (basis : num -> 'v) <=>
      (!j k.
        j IN count n /\ k IN count n ==>
        inner (basis j) (basis k) = if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
      !x.
        x =
          ITSET
            (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
            (count n) zero``);

val q2096184_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q2096184_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      q2096184_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm x = sqrt (inner x x)) /\
      ?n basis. q2096184_orthonormal_basis zero add smul inner n basis``);

val q2096184_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_cauchy_def",
  ``q2096184_cauchy
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !p q : num.
            N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
            norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q2096184_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_tendsto_def",
  ``q2096184_tendsto
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (ell : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q2096184_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_complete_def",
  ``q2096184_complete
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q2096184_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell : 'a. q2096184_tendsto add neg norm u ell``);

val q2096184_complex_hilbert_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_complex_hilbert_space_def",
  ``q2096184_complex_hilbert_space
      (zero : 'h) (add : 'h -> 'h -> 'h) (neg : 'h -> 'h)
      (smul : complex -> 'h -> 'h)
      (inner : 'h -> 'h -> complex) (norm : 'h -> real) <=>
      q2096184_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = conj (inner y x)) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = conj a * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= RE (inner x x)) /\
      (!x. IM (inner x x) = 0) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm x = sqrt (RE (inner x x))) /\
      q2096184_complete add neg norm``);

val q2096184_metric_open_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_metric_open_def",
  ``q2096184_metric_open
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (s : 'v set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q2096184_volume_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_volume_measure_def",
  ``q2096184_volume_measure
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m =
        sigma_sets UNIV {s | q2096184_metric_open add neg norm s} /\
      ?n basis.
        q2096184_orthonormal_basis zero add smul inner n basis /\
        !a b : num -> real.
          (!k. k IN count n ==> a k <= b k) ==>
          measure m
            {x |
              !k.
                k IN count n ==>
                a k <= inner x (basis k) /\
                inner x (basis k) < b k} =
          Normal
            (ITSET
              (\k acc. (b k - a k) * acc)
              (count n) 1)``);

val q2096184_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q2096184_measurable_simple
      (m : 'v m_space) (s : 'v -> 'a) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'a. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q2096184_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q2096184_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (f : 'v -> 'a) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'v -> 'a.
        (!n. q2096184_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q2096184_tendsto add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q2096184_bochner_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_bochner_integrable_def",
  ``q2096184_bochner_integrable
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (f : 'v -> 'a) <=>
      ?g : 'v -> 'a.
        q2096184_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q2096184_simple_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_simple_integral_def",
  ``q2096184_simple_integral
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (smul : complex -> 'a -> 'a) (s : 'v -> 'a) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add
            (smul
              (complex_of_real (real (measure m {x | s x = y}))) y)
            acc)
        (IMAGE s UNIV DELETE zero) zero``);

val q2096184_bochner_approximates_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_bochner_approximates_def",
  ``q2096184_bochner_approximates
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (smul : complex -> 'a -> 'a) (norm : 'a -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'a) (s : num -> 'v -> 'a) (ell : 'a) <=>
      ?g : 'v -> 'a.
        q2096184_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q2096184_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (s n x)))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable m
            (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x)))))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral m
                (Normal o
                  (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x))))))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q2096184_tendsto add neg norm
          (\n. q2096184_simple_integral m zero add smul (s n))
          ell``);

val q2096184_bochner_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_bochner_integral_def",
  ``q2096184_bochner_integral
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (smul : complex -> 'a -> 'a) (norm : 'a -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'a) =
      if q2096184_complete add neg norm /\
         q2096184_bochner_integrable m add neg norm f
      then
        @ell : 'a.
          ?s : num -> 'v -> 'a.
            q2096184_bochner_approximates
              m zero add neg smul norm f s ell
      else
        zero``);

val q2096184_has_coordinate_derivatives_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_has_coordinate_derivatives_def",
  ``q2096184_has_coordinate_derivatives
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (basis : num -> 'v) (n : num)
      (addH : 'h -> 'h -> 'h) (negH : 'h -> 'h)
      (smulH : complex -> 'h -> 'h) (normH : 'h -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'h) (D : num list -> 'v -> 'h) <=>
      D [] = f /\
      !is j x.
        EVERY (\k. k < n) is /\ j < n ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !t : real.
              0 < abs t /\ abs t < delta ==>
              normH
                (addH
                  (smulH (complex_of_real (inv t))
                    (addH
                      (D is (addV x (smulV t (basis j))))
                      (negH (D is x))))
                  (negH (D (j::is) x))) <
              epsilon``);

val q2096184_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_continuous_def",
  ``q2096184_continuous
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (addH : 'h -> 'h -> 'h) (negH : 'h -> 'h)
      (normH : 'h -> real) (h : 'v -> 'h) <=>
      !x epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y.
            normV (addV y (smulV (-1) x)) < delta ==>
            normH (addH (h y) (negH (h x))) < epsilon``);

val q2096184_schwartz_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_schwartz_def",
  ``q2096184_schwartz
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v) (innerV : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (addH : 'h -> 'h -> 'h) (negH : 'h -> 'h)
      (smulH : complex -> 'h -> 'h) (normH : 'h -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'h) <=>
      ?n basis D.
        q2096184_orthonormal_basis
          zeroV addV smulV innerV n basis /\
        q2096184_has_coordinate_derivatives
          addV smulV basis n addH negH smulH normH f D /\
        (!is.
          EVERY (\k. k < n) is ==>
          q2096184_continuous
            addV smulV normV addH negH normH (D is)) /\
        !p is.
          EVERY (\k. k < n) is ==>
          ?C : real.
            0 <= C /\
            !x.
              (1 + normV x) pow p * normH (D is x) <= C``);

val q2096184_fourier_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_fourier_def",
  ``q2096184_fourier
      (m : 'v m_space) (innerV : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (zeroH : 'h) (addH : 'h -> 'h -> 'h) (negH : 'h -> 'h)
      (smulH : complex -> 'h -> 'h) (normH : 'h -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'h) (xi : 'v) =
      q2096184_bochner_integral
        m zeroH addH negH smulH normH
        (\x.
          smulH
            (complex_exp
              (-(i * complex_of_real (2 * pi * innerV x xi))))
            (f x))``);

val q2096184_complex_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q2096184_complex_integral_def",
  ``q2096184_complex_integral
      (m : 'v m_space) (f : 'v -> complex) =
      q2096184_bochner_integral
        m 0 (\x y. x + y) (\x. -x) (\a x. a * x) modu f``);

val integral_inner_fourier_fourier =
  ``!(m : 'v m_space)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v) (innerV : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (zeroH : 'h) (addH : 'h -> 'h -> 'h) (negH : 'h -> 'h)
      (smulH : complex -> 'h -> 'h)
      (innerH : 'h -> 'h -> complex) (normH : 'h -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'h) (g : 'v -> 'h).
      q2096184_real_inner_product_space
        zeroV addV negV smulV innerV normV /\
      q2096184_volume_measure
        m zeroV addV negV smulV innerV normV /\
      q2096184_complex_hilbert_space
        zeroH addH negH smulH innerH normH /\
      q2096184_schwartz
        zeroV addV smulV innerV normV
        addH negH smulH normH f /\
      q2096184_schwartz
        zeroV addV smulV innerV normV
        addH negH smulH normH g
      ==>
      q2096184_complex_integral m
        (\xi.
          innerH
            (q2096184_fourier
              m innerV zeroH addH negH smulH normH f xi)
            (q2096184_fourier
              m innerV zeroH addH negH smulH normH g xi)) =
      q2096184_complex_integral m (\x. innerH (f x) (g x))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2096184
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2096184), "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier
  transform preserves the integral of the pointwise complex inner product
  for Schwartz maps from a finite-dimensional real inner-product space into
  a complex Hilbert space. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q2096184Volume is the translation-invariant Borel measure normalized so
  that the integral of exp(-pi * norm(x)^2) is one, matching mathlib's volume
  normalization on finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces.

  Q2096184Schwartz uses an orthonormal coordinate map from V to R^dim(V).
  Q2096184Jet records every iterated coordinate partial derivative as a
  continuous H-valued function. Its final clause requires every derivative
  to decay faster than every inverse polynomial. This is the standard
  coordinate characterization of an H-valued Schwartz map and is invariant
  under the internally quantified orthonormal coordinate choice.

  Q2096184Fourier is the H-valued Bochner integral of
  exp(-2*pi*i*inner(w,x)) times F(x). The vector and complex integrals are
  defined by L1-approximation with measurable finite-range functions and
  totalized by zero outside complete Bochner-integrable cases, as Lean's
  integral is. SetMM's inner product is linear in its first slot, opposite
  to mathlib's convention, so the arguments are swapped in Q2096184Pairing.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

title: Q2096184_plancherel_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2096184,
% "Plancherel theorem": the Fourier transform preserves the integrated complex
% inner product of Schwartz functions valued in an arbitrary complex Hilbert
% space on an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space. This file
% contains no proof.

plancherel_theorem_Q2096184[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool],
  zeroA: A,
  addA: [A, A -> A],
  negA: [A -> A],
  smulA: [real, A -> A],
  normA: [A -> real],
  innerA: [A, A -> real],
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  smulG: [real, G -> G],
  csmulG: [real, real, G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real],
  innerG_re: [G, G -> real],
  innerG_im: [G, G -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  g_function: TYPE = [A -> G]
  g_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> g_function]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  subG(x, y: G): G = addG(x, negG(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G): addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: G):
        smulG(a, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a + b, x) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a * b, x) = smulG(a, smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): smulG(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        normG(smulG(a, x)) = abs(a) * normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  converges_to_g(values: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normG(subG(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_g(values: g_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normG(
              subG(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_g: bool =
    FORALL (values: g_sequence):
      cauchy_g(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: G): converges_to_g(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND (FORALL (omega: A):
            carrier(omega) AND E(omega)
              IMPLIES measurable_cover(omega))
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) AND NOT property(omega))

  finite_g_sum(values: g_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_g_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_g_value(
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): G =
    finite_g_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroG
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_g_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  finite_simple_real_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_real_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: g_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_g(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_g(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: g_function):
      strongly_measurable_g(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      strongly_measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_g(function_value: g_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(normG(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  abs_enorm_real(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(abs(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_finite_integral_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M, Sigma, enorm_g(function_value), integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  has_finite_integral_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        abs_enorm_real(function_value),
        integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  integrable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_g(M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_real(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_real(
        M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_simple_g_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroG
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_simple_g_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        smulG(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_g_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_g_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: g_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_g(
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            subG(
              function_value(omega),
              approximant(omega))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      approximants: g_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_g(Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: g_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: g_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_g_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_g(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): G =
    IF complete_space_g
        AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: G):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroG
    ENDIF

  coordinate_vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coordinate_map: TYPE = [A -> coordinate_vector]
  reconstruction_map: TYPE = [coordinate_vector -> A]

  subA(x, y: A): A =
    addA(x, negA(y))

  coordinate_zero: coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  coordinate_add(
      left, right: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      left(index) + right(index)

  coordinate_scale(
      scalar: real,
      value: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      scalar * value(index)

  supported(
      value: coordinate_vector,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES value(index) = 0

  finite_coordinate_inner(
      left, right: coordinate_vector,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_coordinate_inner(left, right, count - 1)
        + left(count - 1) * right(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_inner_product_space_a: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      addA(x, y) = addA(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        addA(addA(x, y), z) =
          addA(x, addA(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        addA(x, zeroA) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        addA(x, negA(x)) = zeroA)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: A):
        smulA(a, addA(x, y)) =
          addA(smulA(a, x), smulA(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: A):
        smulA(a + b, x) =
          addA(smulA(a, x), smulA(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: A):
        smulA(a * b, x) =
          smulA(a, smulA(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        smulA(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        innerA(addA(x, y), z) =
          innerA(x, z) + innerA(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: A):
        innerA(smulA(a, x), y) =
          a * innerA(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        innerA(x, y) = innerA(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        0 <= innerA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        innerA(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroA)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        normA(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        normA(x) ^ 2 = innerA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: A):
        normA(smulA(a, x)) = abs(a) * normA(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        normA(addA(x, y)) <= normA(x) + normA(y))

  orthonormal_coordinate_system(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: coordinate_map,
      reconstruct: reconstruction_map): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      supported(coordinates(x), dimension))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        coordinates(addA(x, y)) =
          coordinate_add(coordinates(x), coordinates(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: A):
        coordinates(smulA(a, x)) =
          coordinate_scale(a, coordinates(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        reconstruct(coordinates(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (value: coordinate_vector):
        supported(value, dimension) IMPLIES
          coordinates(reconstruct(value)) = value)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        innerA(x, y) =
          finite_coordinate_inner(
            coordinates(x), coordinates(y), dimension))

  finite_dimensional_real_inner_product_space_a: bool =
    real_inner_product_space_a
      AND EXISTS
          (dimension: nat),
          (coordinates: coordinate_map),
          (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
        orthonormal_coordinate_system(
          dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)

  open_event(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: A):
        U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (y: A):
              (carrier(y)
                AND normA(subA(y, x)) < radius)
              IMPLIES U(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: event):
        open_event(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (U: event):
            open_event(U) IMPLIES Other(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (E: event):
            Sigma(E) IMPLIES Other(E))

  translated_event(E: event, shift: A): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      carrier(x) AND E(subA(x, shift))

  coordinate_unit_cube(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: coordinate_map): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      carrier(x)
        AND FORALL (index: nat):
          index < dimension IMPLIES
            0 <= coordinates(x)(index)
              AND coordinates(x)(index) < 1

  full_carrier: bool =
    FORALL (x: A): carrier(x)

  canonical_volume_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    full_carrier
      AND finite_dimensional_real_inner_product_space_a
      AND generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
      AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (E: event), (shift: A):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          M(translated_event(E, shift)) = M(E))
      AND EXISTS
          (dimension: nat),
          (coordinates: coordinate_map),
          (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
        orthonormal_coordinate_system(
          dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)
          AND M(coordinate_unit_cube(dimension, coordinates))
            = finite_measure_value(1)

  complex_product_re(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_re - left_im * right_im

  complex_product_im(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_im + left_im * right_re

  complex_norm_squared(
      real_part, imag_part: real): real =
    real_part ^ 2 + imag_part ^ 2

  complex_normed_space_g: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a, x) = csmulG(a, 0, x))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        csmulG(a_re, a_im, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, x),
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: G):
        csmulG(a_re + b_re, a_im + b_im, x) =
          addG(
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, x),
            csmulG(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: G):
        csmulG(
          complex_product_re(
            a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
          complex_product_im(
            a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
          x)
          =
            csmulG(
              a_re, a_im,
              csmulG(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        csmulG(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        csmulG(0, 0, x) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: G):
        normG(csmulG(a_re, a_im, x)) ^ 2 =
          complex_norm_squared(a_re, a_im)
            * normG(x) ^ 2)

  complex_banach_space_g: bool =
    complex_normed_space_g AND complete_space_g

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  fourier_kernel_smul(angle: real, value: G): G =
    csmulG(
      cosine_of_real(angle),
      sine_of_real(angle),
      value)

  fourier_transform(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (frequency: A):
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        LAMBDA (point: A):
          fourier_kernel_smul(
            -2 * pi * innerA(frequency, point),
            function_value(point)))

  continuous_at_g(
      function_value: g_function,
      point: A): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (nearby: A):
          normA(subA(nearby, point)) < radius
            IMPLIES
              normG(
                subG(
                  function_value(nearby),
                  function_value(point)))
                < epsilon_value

  continuous_g(function_value: g_function): bool =
    FORALL (point: A):
      continuous_at_g(function_value, point)

  complex_inner_product_space_g: bool =
    complex_normed_space_g
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        innerG_re(addG(x, y), z) =
          innerG_re(x, z) + innerG_re(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        innerG_im(addG(x, y), z) =
          innerG_im(x, z) + innerG_im(y, z))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        innerG_re(csmulG(a_re, a_im, x), y) =
          a_re * innerG_re(x, y)
            + a_im * innerG_im(x, y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        innerG_im(csmulG(a_re, a_im, x), y) =
          a_re * innerG_im(x, y)
            - a_im * innerG_re(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        innerG_re(x, addG(y, z)) =
          innerG_re(x, y) + innerG_re(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        innerG_im(x, addG(y, z)) =
          innerG_im(x, y) + innerG_im(x, z))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        innerG_re(x, csmulG(a_re, a_im, y)) =
          a_re * innerG_re(x, y)
            - a_im * innerG_im(x, y))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        innerG_im(x, csmulG(a_re, a_im, y)) =
          a_re * innerG_im(x, y)
            + a_im * innerG_re(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        innerG_re(x, y) = innerG_re(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        innerG_im(x, y) = -innerG_im(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        innerG_im(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        0 <= innerG_re(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        (innerG_re(x, x) = 0
          AND innerG_im(x, x) = 0)
          IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(x) ^ 2 = innerG_re(x, x))

  complex_hilbert_space_g: bool =
    complex_inner_product_space_g AND complete_space_g

  multiindex: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  derivative_family: TYPE = [multiindex -> g_function]

  zero_multiindex: multiindex =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  supported_multiindex(
      alpha: multiindex,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES alpha(index) = 0

  increment_multiindex(
      alpha: multiindex,
      changed_index: nat): multiindex =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      IF index = changed_index THEN
        alpha(index) + 1
      ELSE
        alpha(index)
      ENDIF

  coordinate_unit(index: nat): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (other: nat):
      IF other = index THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF

  coordinate_basis_vector(
      reconstruct: reconstruction_map,
      index: nat): A =
    reconstruct(coordinate_unit(index))

  has_coordinate_partial_derivative(
      derivatives: derivative_family,
      alpha: multiindex,
      index: nat,
      basis_vector: A,
      point: A): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (step: real):
          step /= 0 AND abs(step) < delta IMPLIES
            normG(
              subG(
                smulG(
                  1 / step,
                  subG(
                    derivatives(alpha)(
                      addA(point, smulA(step, basis_vector))),
                    derivatives(alpha)(point))),
                derivatives(
                  increment_multiindex(alpha, index))(point)))
              < epsilon_value

  schwartz_derivative_family(
      dimension: nat,
      reconstruct: reconstruction_map,
      function_value: g_function,
      derivatives: derivative_family): bool =
    (FORALL (point: A):
      derivatives(zero_multiindex)(point) =
        function_value(point))
      AND (FORALL (alpha: multiindex), (index: nat):
        supported_multiindex(alpha, dimension)
          AND index < dimension
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (point: A):
            has_coordinate_partial_derivative(
              derivatives,
              alpha,
              index,
              coordinate_basis_vector(reconstruct, index),
              point))
      AND (FORALL (alpha: multiindex):
        supported_multiindex(alpha, dimension)
          IMPLIES continuous_g(derivatives(alpha)))
      AND (FORALL (alpha: multiindex), (weight: nat):
        supported_multiindex(alpha, dimension)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
              FORALL (point: A):
                (1 + normA(point)) ^ weight
                    * normG(derivatives(alpha)(point))
                  <= bound)

  schwartz_map(function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (dimension: nat),
        (coordinates: coordinate_map),
        (reconstruct: reconstruction_map),
        (derivatives: derivative_family):
      orthonormal_coordinate_system(
        dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)
        AND schwartz_derivative_family(
          dimension,
          reconstruct,
          function_value,
          derivatives)

  positive_part(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (point: A):
      IF carrier(point) THEN
        finite_measure_value(
          IF function_value(point) < 0 THEN
            0
          ELSE
            function_value(point)
          ENDIF)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  negative_part(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (point: A):
      IF carrier(point) THEN
        finite_measure_value(
          IF function_value(point) < 0 THEN
            -function_value(point)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_real_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function,
      integral_value: real): bool =
    EXISTS (positive_integral, negative_integral: nonneg_real):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        positive_part(function_value),
        finite_measure_value(positive_integral))
        AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M,
          Sigma,
          negative_part(function_value),
          finite_measure_value(negative_integral))
        AND integral_value =
          positive_integral - negative_integral

  real_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): real =
    IF integrable_real(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: real):
          has_real_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  inner_integrand_re(
      left, right: g_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (point: A):
      innerG_re(left(point), right(point))

  inner_integrand_im(
      left, right: g_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (point: A):
      innerG_im(left(point), right(point))

  integral_inner_equal(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      left_first, left_second,
      right_first, right_second: g_function): bool =
    real_integral(
      M, Sigma,
      inner_integrand_re(left_first, left_second))
      =
    real_integral(
      M, Sigma,
      inner_integrand_re(right_first, right_second))
      AND
    real_integral(
      M, Sigma,
      inner_integrand_im(left_first, left_second))
      =
    real_integral(
      M, Sigma,
      inner_integrand_im(right_first, right_second))

  plancherel_theorem: bool =
    complex_hilbert_space_g IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (f, g: g_function):
        (canonical_volume_space(M, Sigma)
          AND schwartz_map(f)
          AND schwartz_map(g))
        IMPLIES
          integral_inner_equal(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(M, Sigma, f),
            fourier_transform(M, Sigma, g),
            f,
            g)
END plancherel_theorem_Q2096184

    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {X : Type}
    (XS : q20971632_vector_space F X)
    (terms : list (K * X)) : X :=
  match terms with
  | [] => q20971632_vzero XS
  | (a, x) :: rest =>
      q20971632_vadd XS
        (q20971632_smul XS a x)
        (q20971632_linear_combination XS rest)

Definition q20971632_finite_dimensional
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {X : Type}
    (XS : q20971632_vector_space F X) : Prop :=
  exists generators : list X,
    forall x : X,
      exists terms : list (K * X),
        Forall (fun term => In (snd term) generators) terms /\

Definition q20971632_nontrivial
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {X : Type}
    (XS : q20971632_vector_space F X) : Prop :=

Definition q20971632_linear_span
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {X : Type}
    (XS : q20971632_vector_space F X)
    (S : X -> Prop)
    (x : X) : Prop :=
  forall P : X -> Prop,
    P (q20971632_vzero XS) ->
    (forall u v : X,
      P u -> P v -> P (q20971632_vadd XS u v)) ->
    (forall u : X,
      P u -> P (q20971632_vneg XS u)) ->
    (forall (a : K) (u : X),
      P u -> P (q20971632_smul XS a u)) ->

Fixpoint q20971632_derived_series
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L : Type}
    (LS : q20971632_vector_space F L)
    (LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS)

  match n with
  | O => fun _ => True
  | S m =>
      fun z =>
        q20971632_linear_span LS
          (fun b =>
            exists x y : L,
              @q20971632_derived_series K F L LS LA m x /\
              @q20971632_derived_series K F L LS LA m y /\
              b = q20971632_bracket LA x y)

    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L : Type}
    (LS : q20971632_vector_space F L)
    (LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS) : Prop :=
  exists n : nat,
    forall x : L,
      @q20971632_derived_series K F L LS LA n x ->
      x = q20971632_vzero LS.

Definition q20971632_deviation
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L V : Type}
    {LS : q20971632_vector_space F L}
    {LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS}
    {VS : q20971632_vector_space F V}
    (M : @q20971632_lie_module K F L V LS LA VS)
    (x : L) (lambda : K) (v : V) : V :=
  q20971632_vadd VS
    (q20971632_action M x v)
    (q20971632_vneg VS (q20971632_smul VS lambda v)).

Fixpoint q20971632_iterated_deviation
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L V : Type}
    {LS : q20971632_vector_space F L}
    {LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS}
    {VS : q20971632_vector_space F V}
    (M : @q20971632_lie_module K F L V LS LA VS)

  match n with
  | O => v
  | S m =>
      q20971632_deviation M x lambda
        (q20971632_iterated_deviation M x lambda m v)
  end.

Definition q20971632_generalized_eigenvector
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L V : Type}
    {LS : q20971632_vector_space F L}
    {LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS}
    {VS : q20971632_vector_space F V}
    (M : @q20971632_lie_module K F L V LS LA VS)
    (x : L) (lambda : K) (v : V) : Prop :=
  exists n : nat,
    q20971632_iterated_deviation M x lambda n v =
    q20971632_vzero VS.

Fixpoint q20971632_sum_generalized_vectors
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {V : Type}
    (VS : q20971632_vector_space F V)
    (terms : list (K * V)) : V :=
  match terms with
  | [] => q20971632_vzero VS
  | (_, v) :: rest =>
      q20971632_vadd VS v
        (q20971632_sum_generalized_vectors VS rest)
  end.

Definition q20971632_is_triangularizable
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L V : Type}
    {LS : q20971632_vector_space F L}
    {LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS}
    {VS : q20971632_vector_space F V}
    (M : @q20971632_lie_module K F L V LS LA VS) : Prop :=
  forall (x : L) (v : V),
    exists terms : list (K * V),
      v = q20971632_sum_generalized_vectors VS terms /\
      Forall
        (fun term =>
          q20971632_generalized_eigenvector
            M x (fst term) (snd term))
        terms.

Record q20971632_linear_functional
    {K : Type}
    {F : q20971632_field K}
    {L : Type}
    (LS : q20971632_vector_space F L) : Type := {
  q20971632_functional_apply : L -> K;
  q20971632_functional_add :
    forall x y : L,
      q20971632_functional_apply (q20971632_vadd LS x y) =
      q20971632_add F
        (q20971632_functional_apply x)
        (q20971632_functional_apply y);
  q20971632_functional_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : L),
      q20971632_functional_apply (q20971632_smul LS a x) =
      q20971632_mul F a (q20971632_functional_apply x)
}.

Arguments q20971632_functional_apply {K F L LS} _ _.

Theorem q20971632_lies_theorem :
  forall
    (K : Type)
    (F : q20971632_field K)
    (L : Type)
    (LS : q20971632_vector_space F L)
    (LA : q20971632_lie_algebra LS)
    (V : Type)
    (VS : q20971632_vector_space F V)
    (M : @q20971632_lie_module K F L V LS LA VS),
    q20971632_char_zero F ->
    q20971632_finite_dimensional VS ->
    q20971632_nontrivial VS ->
    @q20971632_is_solvable K F L LS LA ->
    q20971632_is_triangularizable M ->
    exists chi : q20971632_linear_functional LS,
      exists v : V,
        v <> q20971632_vzero VS /\
        forall x : L,
          q20971632_action M x v =
          q20971632_smul VS
            (q20971632_functional_apply chi x) v.
Admitted.

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q20971632
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q20971632), "Lie's theorem": a finite nonzero
  triangularizable module of a solvable Lie algebra over a characteristic-zero
  field has a nonzero common weight vector. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q20971632_char_zero ::
    "'k::field itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_char_zero TYPE('k) \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>m n :: nat.
      (of_nat m :: 'k) = of_nat n \<longrightarrow> m = n)"

definition q20971632_module ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'a::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_module smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. smul 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smul (a + b) x = smul a x + smul b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. smul a (x + y) = smul a x + smul a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smul 0 x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. smul a 0 = 0)"

definition q20971632_subspace ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'a::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_subspace smul S \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> S \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> S. -x \<in> S) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> S. \<forall>y \<in> S. x + y \<in> S) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>x \<in> S. smul a x \<in> S)"

definition q20971632_span ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'a::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q20971632_span smul A =
    \<Inter>{S. q20971632_subspace smul S \<and> A \<subseteq> S}"

definition q20971632_lie_algebra ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'l \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_lie_algebra smul bracket \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y z. bracket (x + y) z = bracket x z + bracket y z) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. bracket x (y + z) = bracket x y + bracket x z) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. bracket x x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z.
      bracket x (bracket y z) =
        bracket (bracket x y) z + bracket y (bracket x z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. bracket x (smul a y) = smul a (bracket x y))"

definition q20971632_lie_module ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'l \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_lie_module smulL smulV bracket act \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y v. act (x + y) v = act x v + act y v) \<and>
    (\<forall>x v w. act x (v + w) = act x v + act x w) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y v.
      act x (act y v) = act (bracket x y) v + act y (act x v)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x v. act (smulL a x) v = smulV a (act x v)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x v. act x (smulV a v) = smulV a (act x v))"

primrec q20971632_derived_series ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'l \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'l set" where
  "q20971632_derived_series smul bracket 0 = UNIV"
| "q20971632_derived_series smul bracket (Suc n) =
    q20971632_span smul
      {z. \<exists>x \<in> q20971632_derived_series smul bracket n.
        \<exists>y \<in> q20971632_derived_series smul bracket n.
          z = bracket x y}"

definition q20971632_solvable ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'l \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_solvable smul bracket \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>n. q20971632_derived_series smul bracket n = {0})"

definition q20971632_finite_module ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'a::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_finite_module smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>B. finite B \<and> q20971632_span smul B = UNIV)"

primrec q20971632_iterate ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q20971632_iterate f 0 v = v"
| "q20971632_iterate f (Suc n) v =
    f (q20971632_iterate f n v)"

definition q20971632_triangularizable ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_triangularizable smul act \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x.
      q20971632_span smul
        {v. \<exists>mu n.
          q20971632_iterate
            (\<lambda>w. act x w - smul mu w) n v = 0}
        = UNIV)"

definition q20971632_linear_functional ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'l) \<Rightarrow>
      ('l \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q20971632_linear_functional smul chi \<longleftrightarrow>
    chi 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. chi (x + y) = chi x + chi y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. chi (smul a x) = a * chi x)"

theorem q20971632_lies_theorem:
  fixes smulL :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> 'l::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'l"
    and smulV :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and bracket :: "'l \<Rightarrow> 'l \<Rightarrow> 'l"
    and act :: "'l \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes char_zero: "q20971632_char_zero TYPE('k)"
    and module_L: "q20971632_module smulL"
    and module_V: "q20971632_module smulV"
    and lie_algebra: "q20971632_lie_algebra smulL bracket"
    and lie_module: "q20971632_lie_module smulL smulV bracket act"
    and finite_V: "q20971632_finite_module smulV"
    and nontrivial_V: "\<exists>v :: 'v. v \<noteq> 0"
    and solvable_L: "q20971632_solvable smulL bracket"
    and triangularizable:
      "q20971632_triangularizable smulV act"
  shows "\<exists>chi :: 'l \<Rightarrow> 'k. \<exists>v :: 'v.
    q20971632_linear_functional smulL chi \<and>
    v \<noteq> 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. act x v = smulV (chi x) v)"
  sorry

end

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q20971632
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q20971632), "Lie's theorem": a nonzero
  finite-dimensional triangularizable module for a solvable Lie algebra over
  a characteristic-zero field has a nonzero common weight vector. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q20971632_LIES_THEOREM =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k)
      (mulK:'k->'k->'k) (negK:'k->'k) (invK:'k->'k).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a:'k. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:'k. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:'k. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a b c:'k. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
       (!a:'k. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a b:'k. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a b c:'k. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
       (!a b c:'k.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:'k. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) in
   let has_characteristic_zero =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k).
       !m n:num.
         ITLIST addK (REPLICATE m oneK) zeroK =
         ITLIST addK (REPLICATE n oneK) zeroK
         ==> m = n in
   let is_vector_space_L =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k)
      (mulK:'k->'k->'k) (zeroL:'l) (addL:'l->'l->'l)
      (negL:'l->'l) (smulL:'k->'l->'l).
       (!x:'l. addL zeroL x = x) /\
       (!x:'l. addL (negL x) x = zeroL) /\
       (!x y:'l. addL x y = addL y x) /\
       (!x y z:'l. addL (addL x y) z = addL x (addL y z)) /\
       (!x:'l. smulL oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:'k. !x:'l.
          smulL (mulK a b) x = smulL a (smulL b x)) /\
       (!a b:'k. !x:'l.
          smulL (addK a b) x = addL (smulL a x) (smulL b x)) /\
       (!a:'k. !x y:'l.
          smulL a (addL x y) = addL (smulL a x) (smulL a y)) /\
       (!x:'l. smulL zeroK x = zeroL) /\
       (!a:'k. smulL a zeroL = zeroL) in
   let is_vector_space_V =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k)
      (mulK:'k->'k->'k) (zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v)
      (negV:'v->'v) (smulV:'k->'v->'v).
       (!v:'v. addV zeroV v = v) /\
       (!v:'v. addV (negV v) v = zeroV) /\
       (!v w:'v. addV v w = addV w v) /\
       (!u v w:'v. addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)) /\
       (!v:'v. smulV oneK v = v) /\
       (!a b:'k. !v:'v.
          smulV (mulK a b) v = smulV a (smulV b v)) /\
       (!a b:'k. !v:'v.
          smulV (addK a b) v = addV (smulV a v) (smulV b v)) /\
       (!a:'k. !v w:'v.
          smulV a (addV v w) = addV (smulV a v) (smulV a w)) /\
       (!v:'v. smulV zeroK v = zeroV) /\
       (!a:'k. smulV a zeroV = zeroV) in
   let is_lie_algebra =
     \(zeroL:'l) (addL:'l->'l->'l) (smulL:'k->'l->'l)
      (bracket:'l->'l->'l).
       (!x:'l. bracket x x = zeroL) /\
       (!x y z:'l.
          bracket (addL x y) z =
          addL (bracket x z) (bracket y z)) /\
       (!x y z:'l.
          bracket x (addL y z) =
          addL (bracket x y) (bracket x z)) /\
       (!a:'k. !x y:'l.
          bracket (smulL a x) y = smulL a (bracket x y)) /\
       (!a:'k. !x y:'l.
          bracket x (smulL a y) = smulL a (bracket x y)) /\
       (!x y z:'l.
          bracket x (bracket y z) =
          addL (bracket (bracket x y) z)
               (bracket y (bracket x z))) in
   let is_lie_module =
     \(addL:'l->'l->'l) (smulL:'k->'l->'l)
      (addV:'v->'v->'v) (negV:'v->'v)
      (smulV:'k->'v->'v) (bracket:'l->'l->'l)
      (act:'l->'v->'v).
       (!x y:'l. !v:'v.
          act (addL x y) v = addV (act x v) (act y v)) /\
       (!x:'l. !v w:'v.
          act x (addV v w) = addV (act x v) (act x w)) /\
       (!a:'k. !x:'l. !v:'v.
          act (smulL a x) v = smulV a (act x v)) /\
       (!a:'k. !x:'l. !v:'v.
          act x (smulV a v) = smulV a (act x v)) /\
       (!x y:'l. !v:'v.
          act (bracket x y) v =
          addV (act x (act y v)) (negV (act y (act x v)))) in
   let is_subspace_L =
     \(zeroL:'l) (addL:'l->'l->'l) (smulL:'k->'l->'l)
      (p:'l->bool).
       p zeroL /\
       (!x y:'l. p x /\ p y ==> p (addL x y)) /\
       (!a:'k. !x:'l. p x ==> p (smulL a x)) in
   let is_solvable =
     \(zeroL:'l) (addL:'l->'l->'l) (smulL:'k->'l->'l)
      (bracket:'l->'l->'l).
       ?n:num. ?series:num->'l->bool.
         (!x:'l. series 0 x) /\
         (!i:num.
            i <= n ==> is_subspace_L zeroL addL smulL (series i)) /\
         (!i:num.
            i < n
            ==> !x y:'l.
                  series i x /\ series i y
                  ==> series (SUC i) (bracket x y)) /\
         (!x:'l. series n x <=> x = zeroL) in
   let is_basis_V =
     \(zeroK:'k) (zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v)
      (smulV:'k->'v->'v) (n:num) (b:num->'v).
       (!c:num->'k.
          iterate addV {i:num | i < n} (\i. smulV (c i) (b i)) =
          zeroV
          ==> !i:num. i < n ==> c i = zeroK) /\
       (!v:'v.
          ?c:num->'k.
            v = iterate addV {i:num | i < n}
                  (\i. smulV (c i) (b i))) in
   let is_finite_dimensional =
     \(zeroK:'k) (zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v)
      (smulV:'k->'v->'v).
       ?n:num. ?b:num->'v.
         is_basis_V zeroK zeroV addV smulV n b in
   let is_triangularizable =
     \(zeroK:'k) (zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v)
      (smulV:'k->'v->'v) (act:'l->'v->'v).
       !x:'l.
         ?n:num. ?b:num->'v.
           is_basis_V zeroK zeroV addV smulV n b /\
           !j:num.
             j < n
             ==> ?c:num->'k.
                   act x (b j) =
                   iterate addV {i:num | i <= j}
                     (\i. smulV (c i) (b i)) in
   !zeroK oneK:'k.
   !addK mulK:'k->'k->'k.
   !negK invK:'k->'k.
   !zeroL:'l.
   !addL:'l->'l->'l.
   !negL:'l->'l.
   !smulL:'k->'l->'l.
   !bracket:'l->'l->'l.
   !zeroV:'v.
   !addV:'v->'v->'v.
   !negV:'v->'v.
   !smulV:'k->'v->'v.
   !act:'l->'v->'v.
     is_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     has_characteristic_zero zeroK oneK addK /\
     is_vector_space_L
       zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroL addL negL smulL /\
     is_vector_space_V
       zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroV addV negV smulV /\
     is_lie_algebra zeroL addL smulL bracket /\
     is_lie_module addL smulL addV negV smulV bracket act /\
     is_solvable zeroL addL smulL bracket /\
     is_finite_dimensional zeroK zeroV addV smulV /\
     is_triangularizable zeroK zeroV addV smulV act /\
     (?v:'v. ~(v = zeroV))
     ==> ?chi:'l->'k. ?v:'v.
           chi zeroL = zeroK /\
           (!x y:'l. chi (addL x y) = addK (chi x) (chi y)) /\
           (!a:'k. !x:'l. chi (smulL a x) = mulK a (chi x)) /\
           ~(v = zeroV) /\
           (!x:'l. act x v = smulV (chi x) v)`;;

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q20971632,
;; "Lie's theorem": a nonzero finite-dimensional triangularizable module over
;; a solvable Lie algebra in characteristic zero has a nonzero vector on which
;; every Lie element acts by some scalar. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Structure tags index arbitrary, unbounded carriers and operations.  The
;; field, vector-space, Lie-algebra, representation, finiteness, solvability,
;; and triangularizability laws are all explicit below.

(defstub q20971632-field-member-p (field value) t)

(defstub q20971632-field-inverse (field value) t)

(defstub q20971632-vector-zero (field space) t)
(defstub q20971632-vector-add (field space left right) t)
(defstub q20971632-vector-negate (field space value) t)
