;; Fields of characteristic zero.

(defun-sk q20971632-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field x)
       (q20971632-field-member-p field y))
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p
        field (q20971632-field-add field x y))
       (q20971632-field-member-p
        field (q20971632-field-multiply field x y))
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-add field x y)
        (q20971632-field-add field y x))
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-multiply field x y)
        (q20971632-field-multiply field y x))))
     (implies
      (q20971632-field-member-p field x)
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p
        field (q20971632-field-negate field x))
       (q20971632-field-member-p
        field (q20971632-field-inverse field x))
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-add
         field x (q20971632-field-zero field))
        x)
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-add
         field x (q20971632-field-negate field x))
        (q20971632-field-zero field))
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-multiply
         field x (q20971632-field-one field))
        x)
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-multiply
         field x (q20971632-field-zero field))
        (q20971632-field-zero field))
       (implies
        (not (equal x (q20971632-field-zero field)))
        (equal
         (q20971632-field-multiply
          field x (q20971632-field-inverse field x))
         (q20971632-field-one field)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field x)
       (q20971632-field-member-p field y)
       (q20971632-field-member-p field z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-add
         field (q20971632-field-add field x y) z)
        (q20971632-field-add
         field x (q20971632-field-add field y z)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-multiply
         field (q20971632-field-multiply field x y) z)
        (q20971632-field-multiply
         field x (q20971632-field-multiply field y z)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-field-multiply
         field x (q20971632-field-add field y z))
        (q20971632-field-add
         field
         (q20971632-field-multiply field x y)
         (q20971632-field-multiply field x z))))))))

(defun q20971632-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q20971632-field-member-p
    field (q20971632-field-zero field))
   (q20971632-field-member-p
    field (q20971632-field-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (q20971632-field-zero field)
     (q20971632-field-one field)))
   (q20971632-field-laws-p field)))

(defun q20971632-natural-multiple-of-one (field n)
  (if (zp n)
      (q20971632-field-zero field)
    (q20971632-field-add
     field
     (q20971632-field-one field)
     (q20971632-natural-multiple-of-one field (- n 1)))))

(defun-sk q20971632-characteristic-zero-p (field)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (integerp n) (< 0 n))
     (not
      (equal
       (q20971632-natural-multiple-of-one field n)
       (q20971632-field-zero field))))))

;; Vector spaces over FIELD.  The same interface is used for the Lie algebra
;; carrier and for its module carrier.

(defun-sk q20971632-vector-space-laws-p (field space)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space u)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space v))
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p
        field space (q20971632-vector-add field space u v))
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-add field space u v)
        (q20971632-vector-add field space v u))))
     (implies
      (q20971632-vector-member-p field space u)
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p
        field space (q20971632-vector-negate field space u))
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-add
         field space u (q20971632-vector-zero field space))
        u)
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-add
         field space u
         (q20971632-vector-negate field space u))
        (q20971632-vector-zero field space))
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field space (q20971632-field-one field) u)
        u)
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field space (q20971632-field-zero field) u)
        (q20971632-vector-zero field space))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space u)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space v)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space w))
      (equal
       (q20971632-vector-add
        field space (q20971632-vector-add field space u v) w)
       (q20971632-vector-add
        field space u (q20971632-vector-add field space v w))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field a)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space u))
      (q20971632-vector-member-p
       field space (q20971632-vector-smul field space a u)))
     (implies
      (q20971632-field-member-p field a)
      (equal
       (q20971632-vector-smul
        field space a (q20971632-vector-zero field space))
       (q20971632-vector-zero field space)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field a)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space u)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space v))
      (equal
       (q20971632-vector-smul
        field space a (q20971632-vector-add field space u v))
       (q20971632-vector-add
        field space
        (q20971632-vector-smul field space a u)
        (q20971632-vector-smul field space a v))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field a)
       (q20971632-field-member-p field b)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space u))
      (and
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field space (q20971632-field-add field a b) u)
        (q20971632-vector-add
         field space
         (q20971632-vector-smul field space a u)
         (q20971632-vector-smul field space b u)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field space (q20971632-field-multiply field a b) u)
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field space a
         (q20971632-vector-smul field space b u))))))))

(defun q20971632-vector-space-p (field space)
  (and
   (q20971632-field-p field)
   (q20971632-vector-member-p
    field space (q20971632-vector-zero field space))
   (q20971632-vector-space-laws-p field space)))

;; Lie algebra structure: a bilinear alternating bracket satisfying Jacobi.

(defun-sk q20971632-lie-algebra-laws-p (field lie-algebra)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra y))
      (q20971632-vector-member-p
       field lie-algebra
       (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x y)))
     (implies
      (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
      (equal
       (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x x)
       (q20971632-vector-zero field lie-algebra)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra y)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-bracket
         field lie-algebra
         (q20971632-vector-add field lie-algebra x y)
         z)
        (q20971632-vector-add
         field lie-algebra
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x z)
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra y z)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-bracket
         field lie-algebra
         x
         (q20971632-vector-add field lie-algebra y z))
        (q20971632-vector-add
         field lie-algebra
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x y)
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x z)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-bracket
         field lie-algebra x
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra y z))
        (q20971632-vector-add
         field lie-algebra
         (q20971632-lie-bracket
          field lie-algebra
          (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x y)
          z)
         (q20971632-lie-bracket
          field lie-algebra y
          (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x z))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field a)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra y))
      (and
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-bracket
         field lie-algebra
         (q20971632-vector-smul field lie-algebra a x)
         y)
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field lie-algebra a
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x y)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-bracket
         field lie-algebra x
         (q20971632-vector-smul field lie-algebra a y))
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field lie-algebra a
         (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x y))))))))

(defun q20971632-lie-algebra-p (field lie-algebra)
  (and
   (q20971632-vector-space-p field lie-algebra)
   (q20971632-lie-algebra-laws-p field lie-algebra)))

;; Lie module structure.  ACTION([x,y],v) is the commutator of the two
;; action endomorphisms.

(defun-sk q20971632-lie-module-laws-p
    (field lie-algebra module)
  (forall (a x y u v)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field module u))
      (q20971632-vector-member-p
       field module
       (q20971632-lie-action
        field lie-algebra module x u)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra y)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field module u))
      (equal
       (q20971632-lie-action
        field lie-algebra module
        (q20971632-vector-add field lie-algebra x y)
        u)
       (q20971632-vector-add
        field module
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module x u)
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module y u))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field module u)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field module v))
      (equal
       (q20971632-lie-action
        field lie-algebra module x
        (q20971632-vector-add field module u v))
       (q20971632-vector-add
        field module
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module x u)
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module x v))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field a)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field module u))
      (and
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module
         (q20971632-vector-smul field lie-algebra a x)
         u)
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field module a
         (q20971632-lie-action
          field lie-algebra module x u)))
       (equal
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module x
         (q20971632-vector-smul field module a u))
        (q20971632-vector-smul
         field module a
         (q20971632-lie-action
          field lie-algebra module x u)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra x)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field lie-algebra y)
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field module u))
      (equal
       (q20971632-lie-action
        field lie-algebra module
        (q20971632-lie-bracket field lie-algebra x y)
        u)
       (q20971632-vector-add
        field module
        (q20971632-lie-action
         field lie-algebra module x
         (q20971632-lie-action
          field lie-algebra module y u))
        (q20971632-vector-negate
         field module
         (q20971632-lie-action
          field lie-algebra module y
          (q20971632-lie-action
           field lie-algebra module x u)))))))))

(defun q20971632-lie-module-p
    (field lie-algebra module)
  (and
   (q20971632-lie-algebra-p field lie-algebra)
   (q20971632-vector-space-p field module)
   (q20971632-lie-module-laws-p
    field lie-algebra module)))

;; Finite bases and finite linear combinations represent precisely the
;; source's finite-dimensional module hypothesis.

(defun q20971632-field-list-p (field values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q20971632-field-member-p field (car values))
       (q20971632-field-list-p field (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q20971632-vector-list-p (field space values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q20971632-vector-member-p field space (car values))
       (q20971632-vector-list-p field space (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q20971632-linear-combination
    (field space coefficients vectors)
  (if (and (consp coefficients) (consp vectors))
      (q20971632-vector-add
       field space
       (q20971632-vector-smul
        field space (car coefficients) (car vectors))
       (q20971632-linear-combination
        field space (cdr coefficients) (cdr vectors)))
    (q20971632-vector-zero field space)))

(defun q20971632-all-zero-coefficients-p (field coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (equal
        (car coefficients)
        (q20971632-field-zero field))
       (q20971632-all-zero-coefficients-p
        field (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun-sk q20971632-basis-independent-p
    (field space basis)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp coefficients)
      (equal (len coefficients) (len basis))
      (q20971632-field-list-p field coefficients)
      (equal
       (q20971632-linear-combination
        field space coefficients basis)
       (q20971632-vector-zero field space)))
     (q20971632-all-zero-coefficients-p
      field coefficients))))

(defun-sk q20971632-coordinate-list-exists-p
    (field space basis value)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (equal (len coefficients) (len basis))
     (q20971632-field-list-p field coefficients)
     (equal
      (q20971632-linear-combination
       field space coefficients basis)
      value))))

(defun-sk q20971632-basis-spans-p
    (field space basis)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q20971632-vector-member-p field space value)
     (q20971632-coordinate-list-exists-p
      field space basis value))))

(defun q20971632-basis-p (field space basis)
  (and
   (true-listp basis)
   (q20971632-vector-list-p field space basis)
   (q20971632-basis-independent-p field space basis)
   (q20971632-basis-spans-p field space basis)))

(defun-sk q20971632-finite-dimensional-p (field space)
  (exists (basis)
    (q20971632-basis-p field space basis)))

(defun-sk q20971632-nontrivial-space-p (field space)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q20971632-vector-member-p field space value)
     (not
      (equal
       value
       (q20971632-vector-zero field space))))))

;; The derived series is represented extensionally.  A level-zero expression
;; denotes any Lie-algebra element.  At successor level, finite expression
;; trees generate exactly the linear span of brackets from the prior level.

(defun q20971632-derived-expression-p
    (field lie-algebra level expression)
  (cond
   ((zp level)
    (and
     (true-listp expression)
     (equal (len expression) 2)
     (equal (car expression) :q20971632-atom)
     (q20971632-vector-member-p
      field lie-algebra (cadr expression))))
   ((atom expression) nil)
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-zero)
    (and
     (true-listp expression)
     (equal (len expression) 1)))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-add)
    (and
     (true-listp expression)
     (equal (len expression) 3)
     (q20971632-derived-expression-p
      field lie-algebra level (cadr expression))
     (q20971632-derived-expression-p
      field lie-algebra level (caddr expression))))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-smul)
    (and
     (true-listp expression)
     (equal (len expression) 3)
     (q20971632-field-member-p field (cadr expression))
     (q20971632-derived-expression-p
      field lie-algebra level (caddr expression))))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-bracket)
    (and
     (true-listp expression)
     (equal (len expression) 3)
     (q20971632-derived-expression-p
      field lie-algebra (- level 1) (cadr expression))
     (q20971632-derived-expression-p
      field lie-algebra (- level 1) (caddr expression))))
   (t nil)))

(defun q20971632-derived-expression-value
    (field lie-algebra level expression)
  (cond
   ((zp level)
    (if (consp expression)
        (cadr expression)
      (q20971632-vector-zero field lie-algebra)))
   ((atom expression)
    (q20971632-vector-zero field lie-algebra))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-zero)
    (q20971632-vector-zero field lie-algebra))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-add)
    (q20971632-vector-add
     field lie-algebra
     (q20971632-derived-expression-value
      field lie-algebra level (cadr expression))
     (q20971632-derived-expression-value
      field lie-algebra level (caddr expression))))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-smul)
    (q20971632-vector-smul
     field lie-algebra
     (cadr expression)
     (q20971632-derived-expression-value
      field lie-algebra level (caddr expression))))
   ((equal (car expression) :q20971632-bracket)
    (q20971632-lie-bracket
     field lie-algebra
     (q20971632-derived-expression-value
      field lie-algebra (- level 1) (cadr expression))
     (q20971632-derived-expression-value
      field lie-algebra (- level 1) (caddr expression))))
   (t
    (q20971632-vector-zero field lie-algebra))))

(defun-sk q20971632-derived-member-p
    (field lie-algebra level value)
  (exists (expression)
    (and
     (q20971632-derived-expression-p
      field lie-algebra level expression)
     (equal
      (q20971632-derived-expression-value
       field lie-algebra level expression)
      value))))

(defun-sk q20971632-derived-level-zero-p
    (field lie-algebra level)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q20971632-derived-member-p
      field lie-algebra level value)
     (equal
      value
      (q20971632-vector-zero field lie-algebra)))))

(defun-sk q20971632-solvable-p (field lie-algebra)
  (exists (level)
    (and
     (natp level)
     (q20971632-derived-level-zero-p
      field lie-algebra level))))

;; A finite-dimensional endomorphism is triangularizable exactly when it has
;; an ordered basis for which every basis vector is sent into its prefix span.

(defun q20971632-list-prefix (count values)
  (if (or (zp count) (atom values))
      nil
    (cons
     (car values)
     (q20971632-list-prefix (- count 1) (cdr values)))))

(defun-sk q20971632-prefix-span-member-p
    (field space basis count value)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (let ((prefix
           (q20971632-list-prefix count basis)))
      (and
       (true-listp coefficients)
       (equal (len coefficients) (len prefix))
       (q20971632-field-list-p field coefficients)
       (equal
        (q20971632-linear-combination
         field space coefficients prefix)
        value)))))

(defun-sk q20971632-upper-triangular-action-p
    (field lie-algebra module lie-element basis)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (< index (len basis)))
     (q20971632-prefix-span-member-p
      field module basis (+ 1 index)
      (q20971632-lie-action
       field lie-algebra module
       lie-element (nth index basis))))))

(defun-sk q20971632-action-triangularizable-p
    (field lie-algebra module lie-element)
  (exists (basis)
    (and
     (q20971632-basis-p field module basis)
     (q20971632-upper-triangular-action-p
      field lie-algebra module lie-element basis))))

(defun-sk q20971632-triangularizable-module-p
    (field lie-algebra module)
  (forall (lie-element)
    (implies
     (q20971632-vector-member-p
      field lie-algebra lie-element)
     (q20971632-action-triangularizable-p
      field lie-algebra module lie-element))))

;; For a fixed nonzero vector, each Lie element has an internal scalar
;; eigenvalue witness.  Nonzeroness makes that scalar unique, and the linear
;; action laws make the resulting assignment a linear functional.

(defun-sk q20971632-eigenvalue-exists-p
    (field lie-algebra module vector lie-element)
  (exists (scalar)
    (and
     (q20971632-field-member-p field scalar)
     (equal
      (q20971632-lie-action
       field lie-algebra module lie-element vector)
      (q20971632-vector-smul
       field module scalar vector)))))

(defun-sk q20971632-common-eigenvector-p
    (field lie-algebra module vector)
  (forall (lie-element)
    (implies
     (q20971632-vector-member-p
      field lie-algebra lie-element)
     (q20971632-eigenvalue-exists-p
      field lie-algebra module vector lie-element))))

(defun-sk q20971632-nontrivial-weight-space-exists-p
    (field lie-algebra module)
  (exists (vector)
    (and
     (q20971632-vector-member-p field module vector)
     (not
      (equal
       vector
       (q20971632-vector-zero field module)))

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q20971632,
-- "Lie's theorem": a finite nontrivial triangularizable module over a solvable Lie
-- algebra in characteristic zero has a nonzero common weight vector. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q20971632_lie_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
  renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Empty : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not A = A → Empty

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _∧_

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y = Not (x ≡ y)

record _∧_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    left  : A
    right : B

data Truth {a : Level} : Set a where
  truth : Truth

record Field
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set k where

  field
    zero one : K
    add multiply : K → K → K
    negate inverse : K → K

    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : K) →
      add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : K) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : K) →
      add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : K) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) →
      multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : K) →
      multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : K) →
      multiply x one ≡ x
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : K) →
      multiply zero x ≡ zero
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : K) →
      multiply x zero ≡ zero

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply (add x y) z ≡
      add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)

    zero-not-one :
      zero ≠ one
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zero ≡ zero
    inverse-left :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ zero →
      multiply (inverse x) x ≡ one
    inverse-right :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ zero →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ one

natCast :
  {k : Level} {K : Set k} →
  Field K →
  Nat →
  K
natCast scalarField zeroN =
  Field.zero scalarField
natCast scalarField (sucN n) =
  Field.add scalarField (natCast scalarField n) (Field.one scalarField)

record CharacteristicZero
  {k : Level} {K : Set k}
  (scalarField : Field K) :
  Set k where

  field
    nat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) →
      natCast scalarField m ≡ natCast scalarField n →
      m ≡ n

record AdditiveCommutativeGroup
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zero : A
    add : A → A → A
    negate : A → A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) →
      add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

record VectorSpace
  {k a : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (scalarField : Field K)
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (k ⊔ a) where

  field
    additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup A
    smul : K → A → A

    one-smul :
      (x : A) →
      smul (Field.one scalarField) x ≡ x
    multiply-smul :
      (r s : K) (x : A) →
      smul (Field.multiply scalarField r s) x ≡ smul r (smul s x)
    add-smul :
      (r s : K) (x : A) →
      smul (Field.add scalarField r s) x ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive (smul r x) (smul s x)
    smul-add :
      (r : K) (x y : A) →
      smul r (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive x y) ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive (smul r x) (smul r y)
    zero-smul :
      (x : A) →
      smul (Field.zero scalarField) x ≡ AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive
    smul-zero :
      (r : K) →
      smul r (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive) ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive

zeroOf :
  {k a : Level} {K : Set k} {scalarField : Field K} {A : Set a} →
  VectorSpace scalarField A →
  A
zeroOf space =
  AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero (VectorSpace.additive space)

addOf :
  {k a : Level} {K : Set k} {scalarField : Field K} {A : Set a} →
  VectorSpace scalarField A →
  A →
  A →
  A
addOf space =
  AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add (VectorSpace.additive space)

negateOf :
  {k a : Level} {K : Set k} {scalarField : Field K} {A : Set a} →
  VectorSpace scalarField A →
  A →
  A
negateOf space =
  AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negate (VectorSpace.additive space)

smulOf :
  {k a : Level} {K : Set k} {scalarField : Field K} {A : Set a} →
  VectorSpace scalarField A →
  K →
  A →
  A
smulOf =
  VectorSpace.smul

record LieAlgebra
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (scalarField : Field K)
  (L : Set l) :
  Set (k ⊔ l) where

  field
    space : VectorSpace scalarField L
    bracket : L → L → L

    bracket-add-left :
      (x y z : L) →
      bracket (addOf space x y) z ≡
      addOf space (bracket x z) (bracket y z)
    bracket-add-right :
      (x y z : L) →
      bracket x (addOf space y z) ≡
      addOf space (bracket x y) (bracket x z)
    bracket-self :
      (x : L) →
      bracket x x ≡ zeroOf space
    leibniz-jacobi :
      (x y z : L) →
      bracket x (bracket y z) ≡
      addOf space (bracket (bracket x y) z) (bracket y (bracket x z))
    bracket-smul-right :
      (r : K) (x y : L) →
      bracket x (smulOf space r y) ≡ smulOf space r (bracket x y)

record LieRepresentation
  {k l v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  (algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L)
  (V : Set v) :
  Set (k ⊔ l ⊔ v) where

  field
    space : VectorSpace scalarField V
    action : L → V → V

    action-add-left :
      (x y : L) (w : V) →
      action (addOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra) x y) w ≡
      addOf space (action x w) (action y w)
    action-add-right :
      (x : L) (u w : V) →
      action x (addOf space u w) ≡
      addOf space (action x u) (action x w)
    action-leibniz :
      (x y : L) (w : V) →
      action x (action y w) ≡
      addOf space
        (action (LieAlgebra.bracket algebra x y) w)
        (action y (action x w))
    action-smul-left :
      (r : K) (x : L) (w : V) →
      action (smulOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra) r x) w ≡
      smulOf space r (action x w)
    action-smul-right :
      (r : K) (x : L) (w : V) →
      action x (smulOf space r w) ≡
      smulOf space r (action x w)

record LinearFunctional
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  (space : VectorSpace scalarField L) :
  Set (k ⊔ l) where

  field
    apply : L → K
    map-add :
      (x y : L) →
      apply (addOf space x y) ≡ Field.add scalarField (apply x) (apply y)
    map-smul :
      (r : K) (x : L) →
      apply (smulOf space r x) ≡ Field.multiply scalarField r (apply x)

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  first : {n : Nat} → Fin (sucN n)
  next  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (sucN n)

data InSpan
  {k a : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {A : Set a}
  (space : VectorSpace scalarField A)
  {n : Nat}
  (generators : Fin n → A) :
  A →
  Set (k ⊔ a) where

  span-generator :
    (i : Fin n) →
    InSpan space generators (generators i)
  span-zero :
    InSpan space generators (zeroOf space)
  span-add :
    {x y : A} →
    InSpan space generators x →
    InSpan space generators y →
    InSpan space generators (addOf space x y)
  span-negate :
    {x : A} →
    InSpan space generators x →
    InSpan space generators (negateOf space x)
  span-smul :
    (r : K) {x : A} →
    InSpan space generators x →
    InSpan space generators (smulOf space r x)

FiniteGenerated :
  {k a : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {A : Set a} →
  VectorSpace scalarField A →
  Set (k ⊔ a)
FiniteGenerated {A = A} space =
  Σ Nat (λ n →
    Σ (Fin n → A) (λ generators →
      (x : A) → InSpan space generators x))

NontrivialSpace :
  {k a : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {A : Set a} →
  VectorSpace scalarField A →
  Set a
NontrivialSpace {A = A} space =
  Σ A (λ x → x ≠ zeroOf space)

data DerivedStep
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  (algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L)
  (P : L → Set (k ⊔ l)) :
  L →
  Set (k ⊔ l) where

  derived-bracket :
    {x y : L} →
    P x →
    P y →
    DerivedStep algebra P (LieAlgebra.bracket algebra x y)
  derived-zero :
    DerivedStep algebra P (zeroOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra))
  derived-add :
    {x y : L} →
    DerivedStep algebra P x →
    DerivedStep algebra P y →
    DerivedStep algebra P (addOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra) x y)
  derived-negate :
    {x : L} →
    DerivedStep algebra P x →
    DerivedStep algebra P (negateOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra) x)
  derived-smul :
    (r : K) {x : L} →
    DerivedStep algebra P x →
    DerivedStep algebra P (smulOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra) r x)

Derived :
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l} →
  LieAlgebra scalarField L →
  Nat →
  L →
  Set (k ⊔ l)
Derived algebra zeroN x =
  Truth
Derived algebra (sucN n) x =
  DerivedStep algebra (Derived algebra n) x

IsSolvable :
  {k l : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l} →
  LieAlgebra scalarField L →
  Set (k ⊔ l)
IsSolvable {L = L} algebra =
  Σ Nat (λ n →
    (x : L) →
    Derived algebra n x →
    x ≡ zeroOf (LieAlgebra.space algebra))

shiftedAction :
  {k l v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  {V : Set v}
  {algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L} →
  LieRepresentation algebra V →
  L →
  K →
  V →
  V
shiftedAction representation x scalar w =
  addOf (LieRepresentation.space representation)
    (LieRepresentation.action representation x w)
    (negateOf (LieRepresentation.space representation)
      (smulOf (LieRepresentation.space representation) scalar w))

iterateShift :
  {k l v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  {V : Set v}
  {algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L} →
  LieRepresentation algebra V →
  L →
  K →
  Nat →
  V →
  V
iterateShift representation x scalar zeroN w =
  w
iterateShift representation x scalar (sucN n) w =
  shiftedAction representation x scalar
    (iterateShift representation x scalar n w)

GeneralizedEigenvector :
  {k l v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  {V : Set v}
  {algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L} →
  (representation : LieRepresentation algebra V) →
  L →
  K →
  V →
  Set v
GeneralizedEigenvector representation x scalar w =
  Σ Nat (λ n →
    iterateShift representation x scalar n w ≡
    zeroOf (LieRepresentation.space representation))

data InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan
  {k l v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  {V : Set v}
  {algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L}
  (representation : LieRepresentation algebra V)
  (x : L) :
  V →
  Set (k ⊔ l ⊔ v) where

  generalized-vector :
    (scalar : K) (w : V) →
    GeneralizedEigenvector representation x scalar w →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x w
  generalized-span-zero :
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x
      (zeroOf (LieRepresentation.space representation))
  generalized-span-add :
    {u w : V} →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x u →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x w →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x
      (addOf (LieRepresentation.space representation) u w)
  generalized-span-negate :
    {w : V} →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x w →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x
      (negateOf (LieRepresentation.space representation) w)
  generalized-span-smul :
    (r : K) {w : V} →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x w →
    InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x
      (smulOf (LieRepresentation.space representation) r w)

IsTriangularizable :
  {k l v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {L : Set l}
  {V : Set v}
  {algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L} →
  LieRepresentation algebra V →
  Set (k ⊔ l ⊔ v)
IsTriangularizable {L = L} {V = V} representation =
  (x : L) →
  (w : V) →
  InGeneralizedEigenspaceSpan representation x w

lies-theorem :
  (k l v : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ l ⊔ v))
lies-theorem k l v =
  (K : Set k) →
  (scalarField : Field K) →
  CharacteristicZero scalarField →
  (L : Set l) →
  (algebra : LieAlgebra scalarField L) →
  (V : Set v) →
  (representation : LieRepresentation algebra V) →
  FiniteGenerated (LieRepresentation.space representation) →
  NontrivialSpace (LieRepresentation.space representation) →
  IsSolvable algebra →
  IsTriangularizable representation →
  Σ (LinearFunctional (LieAlgebra.space algebra)) (λ weight →
    Σ V (λ w →
      (w ≠ zeroOf (LieRepresentation.space representation)) ∧
      ((x : L) →
        LieRepresentation.action representation x w ≡
        smulOf (LieRepresentation.space representation)
          (LinearFunctional.apply weight x) w)))

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q20971632, "Lie's theorem": a nonzero finite-dimensional triangularizable
  module over a solvable Lie algebra over a characteristic-zero field has a
  nonzero common weight vector for some linear functional. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q20971632_field_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_field_def",
  ``q20971632_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK zeroK a = a) /\
      (!a. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK oneK a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK a (addK b c) =
                 addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK)``);

val q20971632_nsmul_one_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_nsmul_one_def",
  ``q20971632_nsmul_one
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (addK oneK) n zeroK``);

val q20971632_char_zero_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_char_zero_def",
  ``q20971632_char_zero
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) <=>
      !n. q20971632_nsmul_one zeroK oneK addK n = zeroK ==> n = 0``);

val q20971632_vector_space_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_vector_space_def",
  ``q20971632_vector_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!u v. addV u v = addV v u) /\
      (!u v w. addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)) /\
      (!v. addV zeroV v = v) /\
      (!v. addV (negV v) v = zeroV) /\
      (!v. smulV oneK v = v) /\
      (!a b v. smulV (mulK a b) v = smulV a (smulV b v)) /\
      (!a b v. smulV (addK a b) v =
                 addV (smulV a v) (smulV b v)) /\
      (!a u v. smulV a (addV u v) =
                 addV (smulV a u) (smulV a v)) /\
      (!v. smulV zeroK v = zeroV) /\
      (!a. smulV a zeroV = zeroV)``);

val q20971632_lie_algebra_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_lie_algebra_def",
  ``q20971632_lie_algebra
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroL : 'l) (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (negL : 'l -> 'l)
      (smulL : 'k -> 'l -> 'l)
      (bracket : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) <=>
      q20971632_vector_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroL addL negL smulL /\
      (!x. bracket x x = zeroL) /\
      (!x y z. bracket (addL x y) z =
                 addL (bracket x z) (bracket y z)) /\
      (!x y z. bracket x (addL y z) =
                 addL (bracket x y) (bracket x z)) /\
      (!a x y. bracket (smulL a x) y = smulL a (bracket x y)) /\
      (!a x y. bracket x (smulL a y) = smulL a (bracket x y)) /\
      (!x y z.
        bracket x (bracket y z) =
        addL (bracket (bracket x y) z) (bracket y (bracket x z)))``);

val q20971632_lie_module_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_lie_module_def",
  ``q20971632_lie_module
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroL : 'l) (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (smulL : 'k -> 'l -> 'l) (bracket : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (action : 'l -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      q20971632_vector_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroV addV negV smulV /\
      (!x y v. action (addL x y) v =
                 addV (action x v) (action y v)) /\
      (!x u v. action x (addV u v) =
                 addV (action x u) (action x v)) /\
      (!a x v. action (smulL a x) v = smulV a (action x v)) /\
      (!a x v. action x (smulV a v) = smulV a (action x v)) /\
      (!x. action x zeroV = zeroV) /\
      (!v. action zeroL v = zeroV) /\
      (!x y v.
        action (bracket x y) v =
        addV (action x (action y v)) (negV (action y (action x v))))``);

val q20971632_subspace_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_subspace_def",
  ``q20971632_subspace
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (U : 'v set) <=>
      zeroV IN U /\
      (!u v. u IN U /\ v IN U ==> addV u v IN U) /\
      (!v. v IN U ==> negV v IN U) /\
      (!a v. v IN U ==> smulV a v IN U)``);

val q20971632_span_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_span_def",
  ``q20971632_span
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (s : 'v set) =
      {v |
        !U : 'v set.
          q20971632_subspace zeroV addV negV smulV U /\
          s SUBSET U
          ==>
          v IN U}``);

val q20971632_solvable_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_solvable_def",
  ``q20971632_solvable
      (zeroL : 'l) (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (negL : 'l -> 'l)
      (smulL : 'k -> 'l -> 'l) (bracket : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) <=>
      ?D : num -> 'l set.
        D 0 = UNIV /\
        (!n.
          D (SUC n) =
          q20971632_span zeroL addL negL smulL
            {z | ?x y. x IN D n /\ y IN D n /\ z = bracket x y}) /\
        ?n. D n = {zeroL}``);

val q20971632_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_lincomb_def",
  ``q20971632_lincomb
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (basis : 'v list) (coeff : num -> 'k) =
      FOLDL
        (\acc i. addV acc (smulV (coeff i) (EL i basis)))
        zeroV
        (GENLIST (\i. i) (LENGTH basis))``);

val q20971632_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_basis_def",
  ``q20971632_basis
      (zeroK : 'k)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (basis : 'v list) <=>
      (!coeff : num -> 'k.
        q20971632_lincomb zeroV addV smulV basis coeff = zeroV
        ==>
        !i. i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = zeroK) /\
      (!v : 'v.
        ?coeff : num -> 'k.
          q20971632_lincomb zeroV addV smulV basis coeff = v)``);

val q20971632_finite_dimensional_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_finite_dimensional_def",
  ``q20971632_finite_dimensional
      (zeroK : 'k)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      ?basis : 'v list.
        q20971632_basis zeroK zeroV addV smulV basis``);

val q20971632_triangularizable_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_triangularizable_def",
  ``q20971632_triangularizable
      (zeroK : 'k)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (action : 'l -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      !x : 'l.
        ?basis : 'v list.
          q20971632_basis zeroK zeroV addV smulV basis /\
          !j.
            j < LENGTH basis
            ==>
            ?coeff : num -> 'k.
              action x (EL j basis) =
                q20971632_lincomb zeroV addV smulV basis coeff /\
              !i. j < i /\ i < LENGTH basis ==> coeff i = zeroK``);

val q20971632_linear_functional_def = new_definition (
  "q20971632_linear_functional_def",
  ``q20971632_linear_functional
      (zeroK : 'k) (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroL : 'l) (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (smulL : 'k -> 'l -> 'l) (chi : 'l -> 'k) <=>
      chi zeroL = zeroK /\
      (!x y. chi (addL x y) = addK (chi x) (chi y)) /\
      (!a x. chi (smulL a x) = mulK a (chi x))``);

val lie_s_theorem_statement =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroL : 'l) (addL : 'l -> 'l -> 'l) (negL : 'l -> 'l)
      (smulL : 'k -> 'l -> 'l) (bracket : 'l -> 'l -> 'l)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (action : 'l -> 'v -> 'v).
      q20971632_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
      q20971632_char_zero zeroK oneK addK /\
      q20971632_lie_algebra
        zeroK oneK addK mulK
        zeroL addL negL smulL bracket /\
      q20971632_lie_module
        zeroK oneK addK mulK
        zeroL addL smulL bracket
        zeroV addV negV smulV action /\
      q20971632_finite_dimensional zeroK zeroV addV smulV /\
      (?v : 'v. v <> zeroV) /\
      q20971632_solvable zeroL addL negL smulL bracket /\
      q20971632_triangularizable zeroK zeroV addV smulV action
      ==>
      ?chi : 'l -> 'k.
        q20971632_linear_functional
          zeroK addK mulK zeroL addL smulL chi /\
        ?v : 'v.
          v <> zeroV /\
          !x : 'l. action x v = smulV (chi x) v``;

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q20971632
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q20971632), "Lie's theorem": every nonzero
  finite-dimensional triangularizable module over a solvable Lie algebra
  over an arbitrary characteristic-zero field has a nonzero common weight
  vector for some linear functional on the Lie algebra. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q20971632LieAlgebra K L B expands the additive, scalar-bilinear,
  alternating, and Jacobi laws for the bracket B on the K-vector space L.
  Q20971632LieModule K L V B A similarly expands the bilinear Lie action A
  and its representation identity.

  Q20971632Solvable L B says that the derived series, formed by taking the
  linear span of all brackets at each successor stage, reaches the zero
  subspace after finitely many stages. Q20971632GenEigen V A x c v says that
  v is killed by a finite power of the operator A(x,-)-c. The
  Q20971632Triangularizable condition requires every vector, for every x, to
  be a finite sum of such generalized eigenvectors (with possibly different
  eigenvalues). This is the elementwise form of the source condition that
  the supremum of all maximal generalized eigenspaces is the whole module.

  Finite dimensionality is existence of a finite SetMM linear basis. In the
  conclusion, f is a SetMM linear map L -> K and the nonzero vector v lies in
  its common weight space. Thus the conclusion is equivalent to existence of
  a linear functional whose weight space is nontrivial.

  The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful bidirectional
  definitions, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q20971632LieAlgebra Q20971632LieModule Q20971632FiniteDimensional
   Q20971632Solvable Q20971632GenEigen Q20971632Triangularizable $.

q20971632-lie-algebra-syntax
  $a wff ( Q20971632LieAlgebra K L B ) $.
q20971632-lie-module-syntax
  $a wff ( Q20971632LieModule K L V B A ) $.
q20971632-finite-dimensional-syntax
  $a wff ( Q20971632FiniteDimensional V ) $.
q20971632-solvable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q20971632Solvable L B ) $.
q20971632-generalized-eigenvector-syntax
  $a wff ( Q20971632GenEigen V A x c v ) $.
q20971632-triangularizable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q20971632Triangularizable K L V A ) $.

${
  $d A B K L V a x y z $.

  q20971632-lie-algebra-definition $a |- (
    ( Q20971632LieAlgebra K L B )
    <->
    (
      K e. Field
      /\
      L e. LVec
      /\
      ( Scalar ` L ) = K
      /\
      B : ( ( Base ` L ) X. ( Base ` L ) ) --> ( Base ` L )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` L )
        A. y e. ( Base ` L )
          A. z e. ( Base ` L )
            A. a e. ( Base ` K )
              (
                (
                  B ` <. ( x ( +g ` L ) y ) , z >.
                )
                =
                (
                  ( B ` <. x , z >. )
                  ( +g ` L )
                  ( B ` <. y , z >. )
                )
                /\
                (
                  B ` <. x , ( y ( +g ` L ) z ) >.
                )
                =
                (
                  ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                  ( +g ` L )
                  ( B ` <. x , z >. )
                )
                /\
                (
                  B ` <. ( a ( .s ` L ) x ) , y >.
                )
                =
                (
                  a
                  ( .s ` L )
                  ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                )
                /\
                (
                  B ` <. x , ( a ( .s ` L ) y ) >.
                )
                =
                (
                  a
                  ( .s ` L )
                  ( B ` <. x , y >. )
                )
                /\
                ( B ` <. x , x >. ) = ( 0g ` L )
                /\
                (
                  B ` <. x , ( B ` <. y , z >. ) >.
                )
                =
                (
                  ( B ` <. ( B ` <. x , y >. ) , z >. )
                  ( +g ` L )
                  ( B ` <. y , ( B ` <. x , z >. ) >. )
                )
              )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B K L V a v w x y $.

  q20971632-lie-module-definition $a |- (
    ( Q20971632LieModule K L V B A )
    <->
    (
      V e. LVec
      /\
      ( Scalar ` V ) = K
      /\
      A : ( ( Base ` L ) X. ( Base ` V ) ) --> ( Base ` V )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` L )
        A. y e. ( Base ` L )
          A. v e. ( Base ` V )
            A. w e. ( Base ` V )
              A. a e. ( Base ` K )
                (
                  (
                    A ` <. ( x ( +g ` L ) y ) , v >.
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( A ` <. x , v >. )
                    ( +g ` V )
                    ( A ` <. y , v >. )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    A ` <. x , ( v ( +g ` V ) w ) >.
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( A ` <. x , v >. )
                    ( +g ` V )
                    ( A ` <. x , w >. )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    A ` <. ( a ( .s ` L ) x ) , v >.
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    a
                    ( .s ` V )
                    ( A ` <. x , v >. )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    A ` <. x , ( a ( .s ` V ) v ) >.
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    a
                    ( .s ` V )
                    ( A ` <. x , v >. )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    A ` <. x , ( A ` <. y , v >. ) >.
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( A ` <. ( B ` <. x , y >. ) , v >. )
                    ( +g ` V )
                    ( A ` <. y , ( A ` <. x , v >. ) >. )
                  )
                )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d V b $.

  q20971632-finite-dimensional-definition $a |- (
    ( Q20971632FiniteDimensional V )
    <->
    E. b e. ( LBasis ` V )
      b e. Fin
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B D L n j x y z $.

  q20971632-solvable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q20971632Solvable L B )
    <->
    E. n e. NN0
      E. D e. ( ( ~P ( Base ` L ) ) ^m ( 0 ... n ) )
        (
          ( D ` 0 ) = ( Base ` L )
          /\
          ( D ` n ) = { ( 0g ` L ) }
          /\
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
            (
              D ` ( j + 1 )
            )
            =
            (
              ( LSpan ` L )
              `
              {
                z e. ( Base ` L ) |
                  E. x e. ( D ` j )
                    E. y e. ( D ` j )
                      z = ( B ` <. x , y >. )
              }
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A V c n t v x j $.

  q20971632-generalized-eigenvector-definition $a |- (
    ( Q20971632GenEigen V A x c v )
    <->
    E. n e. NN0
      E. t e. ( ( Base ` V ) ^m ( 0 ... n ) )
        (
          ( t ` 0 ) = v
          /\
          ( t ` n ) = ( 0g ` V )
          /\
          A. j e. ( 0 ..^ n )
            (
              t ` ( j + 1 )
            )
            =
            (
              ( A ` <. x , ( t ` j ) >. )
              ( -g ` V )
              (
                c
                ( .s ` V )
                ( t ` j )
              )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A K L V W c i v w x $.

  q20971632-triangularizable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q20971632Triangularizable K L V A )
    <->
    A. x e. ( Base ` L )
      A. v e. ( Base ` V )
        E. W e. Fin
          E. c e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m W )
            E. w e. ( ( Base ` V ) ^m W )
              (
                v = ( V gsum w )
                /\
                A. i e. W
                  (
                    Q20971632GenEigen
                    V
                    A
                    x
                    ( c ` i )
                    ( w ` i )
                  )
              )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B K L V f v x $.

  thousand-theorems-q20971632-lie-theorem $a |-
    A. K A. L A. V A. B A. A
      (
        (
          ( Q20971632LieAlgebra K L B )
          /\
          ( Q20971632LieModule K L V B A )
          /\
          ( chr ` K ) = 0
          /\
          ( Q20971632FiniteDimensional V )
          /\
          E. v e. ( Base ` V )
            v =/= ( 0g ` V )
          /\
          ( Q20971632Solvable L B )
          /\
          ( Q20971632Triangularizable K L V A )
        )
        ->
        E. f e. ( L LMHom ( ringLMod ` K ) )
          E. v e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              v =/= ( 0g ` V )
              /\
              A. x e. ( Base ` L )
                (
                  A ` <. x , v >.
                )
                =
                (
                  ( f ` x )
                  ( .s ` V )
                  v
                )
            )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q20971632,
:: "Lie's theorem": if every individual action endomorphism is triangularizable,
:: a solvable Lie algebra over a characteristic-zero field acting on a
:: nontrivial finite-dimensional module has a nonzero common weight vector.
:: The triangularizing basis may depend on the Lie algebra element. This file
:: contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, CARD_3,
      FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_3, FINSEQ_4, BINOP_1,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, VECTSP_1,
      MATRLIN, VECTSP11, RING_3, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2,
      XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, BINOP_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, NAT_1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
      FINSEQ_3, FINSEQ_4, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, XXREAL_0,
      RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_9, MATRLIN, RING_3;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      BINOP_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_3, FINSEQ_4, XXREAL_0,
      RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_7, MATRLIN,
      VECTSP_9, RING_3;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1,
      FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_3, FINSEQ_4, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_4,
      VECTSP_7, MATRLIN, VECTSP_9, VECTSP11, RING_3;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, BINOP_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
      FINSEQ_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, BINOP_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      L being VectSp of K,
      V being non trivial finite-dimensional VectSp of K,
      bracket being Function of
        [:the carrier of L,the carrier of L:],the carrier of L,
      action being Function of
        [:the carrier of L,the carrier of V:],the carrier of V
  st
    Char K = 0 &
    (for x,y,z being Element of L holds
      bracket/.[x+y,z] = bracket/.[x,z] + bracket/.[y,z] &
      bracket/.[x,y+z] = bracket/.[x,y] + bracket/.[x,z]) &
    (for a being Element of K, x,y being Element of L holds
      bracket/.[a*x,y] = a*bracket/.[x,y] &
      bracket/.[x,a*y] = a*bracket/.[x,y]) &
    (for x being Element of L holds bracket/.[x,x] = 0.L) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of L holds
      bracket/.[x,bracket/.[y,z]] +
        bracket/.[y,bracket/.[z,x]] +
        bracket/.[z,bracket/.[x,y]] = 0.L) &
    (for x,y being Element of L, v being Element of V holds
      action/.[x+y,v] = action/.[x,v] + action/.[y,v]) &
    (for x being Element of L, v,w being Element of V holds
      action/.[x,v+w] = action/.[x,v] + action/.[x,w]) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of L,
         v being Element of V holds
      action/.[a*x,v] = a*action/.[x,v] &
      action/.[x,a*v] = a*action/.[x,v]) &
    (for x,y being Element of L, v being Element of V holds
      action/.[bracket/.[x,y],v] =
        action/.[x,action/.[y,v]] - action/.[y,action/.[x,v]]) &
    (ex n being Nat,
        D being FinSequence of bool the carrier of L st
      len D = n + 1 &
      D/.1 = the carrier of L &
      D/.(n+1) = {0.L} &
      (for i being Nat st i in dom D holds
        0.L in D/.i &
        (for x,y being Element of L st x in D/.i & y in D/.i
          holds x+y in D/.i) &
        (for a being Element of K, x being Element of L st x in D/.i
          holds a*x in D/.i)) &
      (for i being Nat st 1 <= i & i < len D holds
        D/.(i+1) c= D/.i &
        for x,y being Element of L st x in D/.i & y in D/.i
          holds bracket/.[x,y] in D/.(i+1))) &
    :: Per-operator triangularizability: b is quantified after x.
    (for x being Element of L holds
      ex b being OrdBasis of V st
        for i,j being Nat st
          i in dom b & j in dom b & i < j
        holds (action/.[x,b/.i] |-- b)/.j = 0.K)
  holds
    ex chi being Function of the carrier of L,the carrier of K,
       v being Element of V st
      (for x,y being Element of L holds chi/.(x+y) = chi/.x + chi/.y) &
      (for a being Element of K, x being Element of L holds
        chi/.(a*x) = a*chi/.x) &
      v <> 0.V &
      for x being Element of L holds action/.[x,v] = chi/.x*v
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q20971632,
% "Lie's theorem": a finite-dimensional nontrivial Lie module for a solvable Lie
% algebra over a characteristic-zero field, with triangularizable action, has a
% nonzero common weight vector.
% This file contains no proof.

Q20971632_lie_s_theorem[
  K, L, V: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  zeroL: L,
  negL: [L -> L],
  addL: [L, L -> L],
  smulL: [K, L -> L],
  bracketL: [L, L -> L],
  zeroV: V,
  negV: [V -> V],
  addV: [V, V -> V],
  smulV: [K, V -> V],
  action: [L, V -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  l_set: TYPE = [L -> bool]
  v_set: TYPE = [V -> bool]

  field_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K): addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K): addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K): addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K): mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K): mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        NOT (a = zeroK) IMPLIES mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND NOT (zeroK = oneK)

  nat_cast(n: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      zeroK
    ELSE
      addK(nat_cast(n - 1), oneK)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  characteristic_zero: bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      nat_cast(m) = nat_cast(n) IMPLIES m = n

  additive_group_L: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: L): addL(x, y) = addL(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        addL(addL(x, y), z) = addL(x, addL(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L): addL(x, zeroL) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: L): addL(x, negL(x)) = zeroL)

  module_L: bool =
    additive_group_L
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: L):
        smulL(a, addL(x, y)) =
          addL(smulL(a, x), smulL(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: L):
        smulL(addK(a, b), x) =
          addL(smulL(a, x), smulL(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: L):
        smulL(mulK(a, b), x) = smulL(a, smulL(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L): smulL(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: L): smulL(zeroK, x) = zeroL)
      AND (FORALL (a: K): smulL(a, zeroL) = zeroL)

  lie_algebra_laws: bool =
    module_L
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        bracketL(addL(x, y), z) =
          addL(bracketL(x, z), bracketL(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        bracketL(x, addL(y, z)) =
          addL(bracketL(x, y), bracketL(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L): bracketL(x, x) = zeroL)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: L):
        bracketL(x, bracketL(y, z)) =
          addL(bracketL(bracketL(x, y), z),
               bracketL(y, bracketL(x, z))))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: L):
        bracketL(x, smulL(a, y)) = smulL(a, bracketL(x, y)))

  additive_group_V: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): addV(u, v) = addV(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        addV(addV(u, v), w) = addV(u, addV(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (v: V): addV(v, zeroV) = v)
      AND (FORALL (v: V): addV(v, negV(v)) = zeroV)

  module_V: bool =
    additive_group_V
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (u, v: V):
        smulV(a, addV(u, v)) =
          addV(smulV(a, u), smulV(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (v: V):
        smulV(addK(a, b), v) =
          addV(smulV(a, v), smulV(b, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (v: V):
        smulV(mulK(a, b), v) = smulV(a, smulV(b, v)))
      AND (FORALL (v: V): smulV(oneK, v) = v)
      AND (FORALL (v: V): smulV(zeroK, v) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: K): smulV(a, zeroV) = zeroV)

  lie_module_laws: bool =
    module_V
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L), (v: V):
        action(addL(x, y), v) =
          addV(action(x, v), action(y, v)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L), (u, v: V):
        action(x, addV(u, v)) =
          addV(action(x, u), action(x, v)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L), (v: V):
        action(x, action(y, v)) =
          addV(action(bracketL(x, y), v),
               action(y, action(x, v))))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: L), (v: V):
        action(smulL(a, x), v) = smulV(a, action(x, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: L), (v: V):
        action(x, smulV(a, v)) = smulV(a, action(x, v)))

  is_l_subspace(S: l_set): bool =
    S(zeroL)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: L):
        S(x) AND S(y) IMPLIES S(addL(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: L):
        S(x) IMPLIES S(negL(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: L):
        S(x) IMPLIES S(smulL(a, x)))

  l_span(S: l_set): l_set =
    LAMBDA (x: L):
      FORALL (U: l_set):
        (is_l_subspace(U)
          AND (FORALL (y: L): S(y) IMPLIES U(y)))
        IMPLIES U(x)

  is_v_subspace(S: v_set): bool =
    S(zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V):
        S(u) AND S(v) IMPLIES S(addV(u, v)))
      AND (FORALL (v: V):
        S(v) IMPLIES S(negV(v)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (v: V):
        S(v) IMPLIES S(smulV(a, v)))

  v_span(S: v_set): v_set =
    LAMBDA (v: V):
      FORALL (U: v_set):
        (is_v_subspace(U)
          AND (FORALL (w: V): S(w) IMPLIES U(w)))
        IMPLIES U(v)

  finite_dimensional_V: bool =
    EXISTS (generator_count: nat), (generators: [nat -> V]):
      FORALL (v: V):
        v_span(
          LAMBDA (w: V):
            EXISTS (i: nat):
              i < generator_count AND w = generators(i))(v)

  nontrivial_V: bool =
    EXISTS (v: V): NOT (v = zeroV)

  derived_step(I: l_set): l_set =
    l_span(
      LAMBDA (z: L):
        EXISTS (x, y: L):
          I(x) AND I(y) AND z = bracketL(x, y))

  solvable_L: bool =
    EXISTS (length: nat), (series: [nat -> l_set]):
      (FORALL (x: L): series(0)(x))
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < length IMPLIES
            (FORALL (x: L):
              series(i + 1)(x) IFF derived_step(series(i))(x)))
        AND (FORALL (x: L):
          series(length)(x) IFF x = zeroL)

  shifted_action(x: L, eigenvalue: K, v: V): V =
    addV(action(x, v), negV(smulV(eigenvalue, v)))

  shifted_power(
      x: L,
      eigenvalue: K,
      exponent: nat,
      v: V): RECURSIVE V =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      v
    ELSE
      shifted_action(
        x,
        eigenvalue,
        shifted_power(x, eigenvalue, exponent - 1, v))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  generalized_weight_vector_for(x: L, v: V): bool =
    EXISTS (eigenvalue: K), (exponent: nat):
      shifted_power(x, eigenvalue, exponent, v) = zeroV

  triangularizable_action: bool =
    FORALL (x: L), (v: V):
      v_span(
        LAMBDA (w: V):
          generalized_weight_vector_for(x, w))(v)

  linear_weight(chi: [L -> K]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: L):
      chi(addL(x, y)) = addK(chi(x), chi(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: L):
        chi(smulL(a, x)) = mulK(a, chi(x)))

  lies_theorem: bool =
    (field_laws
      AND characteristic_zero
      AND lie_algebra_laws
      AND lie_module_laws
      AND finite_dimensional_V
      AND nontrivial_V
      AND solvable_L
      AND triangularizable_action)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (chi: [L -> K]), (v: V):
        linear_weight(chi)
          AND NOT (v = zeroV)
          AND (FORALL (x: L):
            action(x, v) = smulV(chi(x), v))

END Q20971632_lie_s_theorem
