title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q213603
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q213603), "Ceva's theorem": over an arbitrary
  normed field and normed affine torsor, three concurrent cevians of an
  affine-independent triangle have cyclic distance ratios whose product is
  one. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q213603_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q213603_kzero : K;
  q213603_kone : K;
  q213603_kadd : K -> K -> K;
  q213603_kmul : K -> K -> K;
  q213603_kneg : K -> K;
  q213603_kinv : K -> K;
  q213603_knorm : K -> R;

  q213603_kzero_ne_one :
    q213603_kzero <> q213603_kone;
  q213603_kadd_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q213603_kadd a (q213603_kadd b c) =
      q213603_kadd (q213603_kadd a b) c;
  q213603_kadd_comm :
    forall a b : K,
      q213603_kadd a b = q213603_kadd b a;
  q213603_kadd_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q213603_kadd a q213603_kzero = a;
  q213603_kadd_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q213603_kadd a (q213603_kneg a) = q213603_kzero;
  q213603_kmul_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q213603_kmul a (q213603_kmul b c) =
      q213603_kmul (q213603_kmul a b) c;
  q213603_kmul_comm :
    forall a b : K,
      q213603_kmul a b = q213603_kmul b a;
  q213603_kmul_one :
    forall a : K,
      q213603_kmul a q213603_kone = a;
  q213603_kleft_distrib :
    forall a b c : K,
      q213603_kmul a (q213603_kadd b c) =
      q213603_kadd
        (q213603_kmul a b) (q213603_kmul a c);
  q213603_kinv_zero :
    q213603_kinv q213603_kzero = q213603_kzero;
  q213603_kmul_inv :
    forall a : K,
      a <> q213603_kzero ->
      q213603_kmul a (q213603_kinv a) = q213603_kone;

  q213603_knorm_nonnegative :
    forall a : K,
      0 <= q213603_knorm a;
  q213603_knorm_eq_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q213603_knorm a = 0 <-> a = q213603_kzero;
  q213603_knorm_add_le :
    forall a b : K,
      q213603_knorm (q213603_kadd a b) <=
      q213603_knorm a + q213603_knorm b;
  q213603_knorm_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q213603_knorm (q213603_kmul a b) =
      q213603_knorm a * q213603_knorm b;
  q213603_knorm_one :
    q213603_knorm q213603_kone = 1;
  q213603_knorm_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q213603_knorm (q213603_kneg a) = q213603_knorm a
}.

Arguments q213603_kzero {K} _.
Arguments q213603_kone {K} _.
Arguments q213603_kadd {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q213603_kmul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q213603_kneg {K} _ _.
Arguments q213603_kinv {K} _ _.
Arguments q213603_knorm {K} _ _.

Record q213603_seminormed_space
    (K V : Type)
    (F : q213603_normed_field K) : Type := {
  q213603_vzero : V;
  q213603_vadd : V -> V -> V;
  q213603_vneg : V -> V;
  q213603_smul : K -> V -> V;
  q213603_vnorm : V -> R;

  q213603_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q213603_vadd x (q213603_vadd y z) =
      q213603_vadd (q213603_vadd x y) z;
  q213603_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : V,
      q213603_vadd x y = q213603_vadd y x;
  q213603_vadd_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q213603_vadd x q213603_vzero = x;
  q213603_vadd_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q213603_vadd x (q213603_vneg x) = q213603_vzero;

  q213603_one_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q213603_smul (q213603_kone F) x = x;
  q213603_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : V),
      q213603_smul (q213603_kmul F a b) x =
      q213603_smul a (q213603_smul b x);
  q213603_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : V),
      q213603_smul (q213603_kadd F a b) x =
      q213603_vadd
        (q213603_smul a x) (q213603_smul b x);
  q213603_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : V),
      q213603_smul a (q213603_vadd x y) =
      q213603_vadd
        (q213603_smul a x) (q213603_smul a y);
  q213603_zero_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q213603_smul (q213603_kzero F) x = q213603_vzero;
  q213603_smul_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q213603_smul a q213603_vzero = q213603_vzero;

  q213603_vnorm_nonnegative :
    forall x : V,
      0 <= q213603_vnorm x;
  q213603_vnorm_zero :
    q213603_vnorm q213603_vzero = 0;
  q213603_vnorm_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q213603_vnorm (q213603_vneg x) = q213603_vnorm x;
  q213603_vnorm_add_le :
    forall x y : V,
      q213603_vnorm (q213603_vadd x y) <=
      q213603_vnorm x + q213603_vnorm y;
  q213603_vnorm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : V),
      q213603_vnorm (q213603_smul a x) =
      q213603_knorm F a * q213603_vnorm x
}.

Arguments q213603_vzero {K V F} _.
Arguments q213603_vadd {K V F} _ _ _.
Arguments q213603_vneg {K V F} _ _.
Arguments q213603_smul {K V F} _ _ _.
Arguments q213603_vnorm {K V F} _ _.

Record q213603_normed_add_torsor
    (K V P : Type)
    (F : q213603_normed_field K)
    (S : @q213603_seminormed_space K V F) : Type := {
  q213603_vadd_point : V -> P -> P;
  q213603_vsub_point : P -> P -> V;
  q213603_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P,
      q213603_vadd_point (q213603_vzero S) p = p;
  q213603_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q213603_vadd_point (q213603_vadd S x y) p =
      q213603_vadd_point x (q213603_vadd_point y p);
  q213603_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q213603_vsub_point (q213603_vadd_point x p) p = x;
  q213603_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q213603_vadd_point (q213603_vsub_point p q) q = p;
  q213603_dist_eq_zero_implies_eq :
    forall p q : P,
      q213603_vnorm S (q213603_vsub_point p q) = 0 ->
      p = q
}.

Arguments q213603_vadd_point {K V P F S} _ _ _.
Arguments q213603_vsub_point {K V P F S} _ _ _.

Definition q213603_dist
    {K V P : Type}
    {F : q213603_normed_field K}
    {S : @q213603_seminormed_space K V F}
    (A : @q213603_normed_add_torsor K V P F S)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q213603_vnorm S (q213603_vsub_point A p q).

Definition q213603_mem_line
    {K V P : Type}
    {F : q213603_normed_field K}
    {S : @q213603_seminormed_space K V F}
    (A : @q213603_normed_add_torsor K V P F S)
    (a b x : P) : Prop :=
  exists r : K,
    x =
      q213603_vadd_point A
        (q213603_smul S r (q213603_vsub_point A b a)) a.

Definition q213603_affine_independent_triangle
    {K V P : Type}
    {F : q213603_normed_field K}
    {S : @q213603_seminormed_space K V F}
    (A : @q213603_normed_add_torsor K V P F S)
    (t0 t1 t2 : P) : Prop :=
  forall a b : K,
    q213603_vadd S
      (q213603_smul S a (q213603_vsub_point A t1 t0))
      (q213603_smul S b (q213603_vsub_point A t2 t0)) =
      q213603_vzero S ->
    a = q213603_kzero F /\ b = q213603_kzero F.

Theorem q213603_cevas_theorem :
  forall (K V P : Type)
         (F : q213603_normed_field K)
         (S : @q213603_seminormed_space K V F)
         (A : @q213603_normed_add_torsor K V P F S)
         (t0 t1 t2 p0 p1 p2 concurrent_point : P),
    q213603_affine_independent_triangle A t0 t1 t2 ->
    p0 <> t2 ->
    p1 <> t0 ->
    p2 <> t1 ->
    q213603_mem_line A t1 t2 p0 ->
    q213603_mem_line A t2 t0 p1 ->
    q213603_mem_line A t0 t1 p2 ->
    q213603_mem_line A t0 p0 concurrent_point ->
    q213603_mem_line A t1 p1 concurrent_point ->
    q213603_mem_line A t2 p2 concurrent_point ->
    (q213603_dist A t1 p0 / q213603_dist A p0 t2) *
      (q213603_dist A t2 p1 / q213603_dist A p1 t0) *
      (q213603_dist A t0 p2 / q213603_dist A p2 t1) = 1.
Admitted.

title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q213603
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q213603), "Ceva's theorem": in a triangle over
  an arbitrary normed field and normed affine torsor, three concurrent cevians
  give a cyclic product of distance ratios equal to one. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

datatype q213603_fin3 = Q0 | Q1 | Q2

fun q213603_succ :: "q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> q213603_fin3" where
  "q213603_succ Q0 = Q1"
| "q213603_succ Q1 = Q2"
| "q213603_succ Q2 = Q0"

definition q213603_succ2 :: "q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> q213603_fin3" where
  "q213603_succ2 i = q213603_succ (q213603_succ i)"

definition q213603_sum3_field ::
    "(q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> 'k::field) \<Rightarrow> 'k" where
  "q213603_sum3_field f = f Q0 + f Q1 + f Q2"

definition q213603_sum3_vector ::
    "(q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add) \<Rightarrow> 'v" where
  "q213603_sum3_vector f = f Q0 + f Q1 + f Q2"

definition q213603_prod3 ::
    "(q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q213603_prod3 f = f Q0 * f Q1 * f Q2"

definition q213603_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q213603_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b)"

definition q213603_seminormed_add_comm_group ::
    "('v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q213603_seminormed_add_comm_group vnorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    vnorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>v. 0 \<le> vnorm v) \<and>
    (\<forall>v. vnorm (-v) = vnorm v) \<and>
    (\<forall>v w. vnorm (v + w) \<le> vnorm v + vnorm w)"

definition q213603_normed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('k \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q213603_normed_space knorm vnorm smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a v w. smul a (v + w) = smul a v + smul a w) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b v. smul (a + b) v = smul a v + smul b v) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b v. smul (a * b) v = smul a (smul b v)) \<and>
    (\<forall>v. smul 1 v = v) \<and>
    (\<forall>a v. vnorm (smul a v) = knorm a * vnorm v)"

definition q213603_normed_add_torsor ::
    "('v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'p::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'p) \<Rightarrow>
      ('p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q213603_normed_add_torsor vnorm vadd vsub \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p. vadd 0 p = p) \<and>
    (\<forall>v w p. vadd (v + w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) \<and>
    (\<forall>p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) \<and>
    (\<forall>v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) \<and>
    (\<forall>p q. dist p q = vnorm (vsub p q))"

definition q213603_affine_independent_triangle ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow>
      ('p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow>
      (q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> 'p) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q213603_affine_independent_triangle smul vsub points \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>w :: q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      q213603_sum3_field w = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      q213603_sum3_vector
        (\<lambda>i. smul (w i) (vsub (points i) (points Q0))) = 0
      \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>i. w i = 0))"

definition q213603_line ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p) \<Rightarrow>
      ('p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow>
      'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p set" where
  "q213603_line smul vadd vsub a b =
    {x. \<exists>r. x = vadd (smul r (vsub b a)) a}"

theorem q213603_cevas_theorem:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and vnorm :: "'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and smul :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and vadd :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'p::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and points :: "q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and side_point :: "q213603_fin3 \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and concurrent_point :: 'p
  assumes normed_field: "q213603_normed_field knorm"
    and seminormed_group: "q213603_seminormed_add_comm_group vnorm"
    and normed_space: "q213603_normed_space knorm vnorm smul"
    and normed_torsor: "q213603_normed_add_torsor vnorm vadd vsub"
    and triangle:
      "q213603_affine_independent_triangle smul vsub points"
    and denominators_nonzero:
      "\<forall>i. side_point i \<noteq> points (q213603_succ2 i)"
    and side_membership:
      "\<forall>i. side_point i \<in>
        q213603_line smul vadd vsub
          (points (q213603_succ i)) (points (q213603_succ2 i))"
    and concurrence:
      "\<forall>i. concurrent_point \<in>
        q213603_line smul vadd vsub (points i) (side_point i)"
  shows
    "q213603_prod3
      (\<lambda>i.
        dist (points (q213603_succ i)) (side_point i) /
        dist (side_point i) (points (q213603_succ2 i))) = 1"
  sorry

end

title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q213603
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q213603), "Ceva's theorem": for an affinely
  independent triangle over an arbitrary normed field, concurrent lines from
  the vertices through points on the opposite side-lines give a product of
  three nonzero-denominator distance ratios equal to one. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q213603_CEVA_S_THEOREM =
 `let normed_field =
    \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
     (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K) (normK:K->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:K. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:K. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:K. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:K. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:K. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:K. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:K. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:K. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:K. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:K. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:K. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a:K. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
       (!a b:K. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:K. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) in
  let seminormed_add_comm_group =
    \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (normV:V->real).
       (!x y z:V. addV x (addV y z) = addV (addV x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. addV x y = addV y x) /\
       (!x:V. addV zeroV x = x) /\
       (!x:V. addV (negV x) x = zeroV) /\
       normV zeroV = &0 /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= normV x) /\
       (!x:V. normV (negV x) = normV x) /\
       (!x y:V. normV (addV x y) <= normV x + normV y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K) (normK:K->real)
     (addV:V->V->V) (smul:K->V->V) (normV:V->real).
       (!x:V. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:V. smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:V.
          smul (addK a b) x = addV (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:K. !x y:V.
          smul a (addV x y) = addV (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:K. !x:V. normV (smul a x) <= normK a * normV x) in
  let metric_affine_torsor =
    \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (normV:V->real)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!q:P. vadd zeroV q = q) /\
       (!v w:V. !q:P.
          vadd (addV v w) q = vadd v (vadd w q)) /\
       (!v:V. !q:P. vsub (vadd v q) q = v) /\
       (!q r:P. vadd (vsub q r) r = q) /\
       (!q r:P. normV (vsub q r) = &0 <=> q = r) in
  let affine_independent_triangle =
    \(zeroK:K) (zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smul:K->V->V)
     (vsub:P->P->V) (t0:P) (t1:P) (t2:P).
       !a b:K.
         addV (smul a (vsub t1 t0)) (smul b (vsub t2 t0)) = zeroV
         ==> a = zeroK /\ b = zeroK in
  let on_line =
    \(smul:K->V->V) (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (a:P) (b:P) (x:P).
       ?r:K. vadd (smul r (vsub b a)) a = x in
  let distance =
    \(normV:V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (q:P) (r:P).
       normV (vsub q r) in
  !zeroK oneK:K.
  !addK mulK:K->K->K.
  !negK invK:K->K.
  !normK:K->real.
  !zeroV:V.
  !addV:V->V->V.
  !negV:V->V.
  !normV:V->real.
  !smul:K->V->V.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !t0 t1 t2 p0 p1 p2 p':P.
    normed_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    seminormed_add_comm_group zeroV addV negV normV /\
    normed_space oneK addK mulK normK addV smul normV /\
    metric_affine_torsor zeroV addV normV vadd vsub /\
    affine_independent_triangle zeroK zeroV addV smul vsub t0 t1 t2 /\
    ~(p0 = t2) /\ ~(p1 = t0) /\ ~(p2 = t1) /\
    on_line smul vadd vsub t1 t2 p0 /\
    on_line smul vadd vsub t2 t0 p1 /\
    on_line smul vadd vsub t0 t1 p2 /\
    on_line smul vadd vsub t0 p0 p' /\
    on_line smul vadd vsub t1 p1 p' /\
    on_line smul vadd vsub t2 p2 p'
    ==>
    (distance normV vsub t1 p0 / distance normV vsub p0 t2) *
    (distance normV vsub t2 p1 / distance normV vsub p1 t0) *
    (distance normV vsub t0 p2 / distance normV vsub p2 t1) = &1`;;

title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q213603,
;; "Ceva's theorem": in an affinely independent triangle over an arbitrary
;; normed field, three concurrent cevians give a product of distance ratios
;; equal to one when the three denominators are nonzero. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative symbols represent the source's real norm values, arbitrary
;; normed scalar field, seminormed vector space, and affine metric torsor.
;; Every carrier restriction and structural law is explicit below.

(defstub q213603-r-member-p (real x) t)
(defstub q213603-r-set-member-p (real set x) t)
(defstub q213603-k-member-p (scalar-field x) t)
(defstub q213603-v-member-p (vector-space x) t)
(defstub q213603-p-member-p (point-space x) t)

(defstub q213603-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q213603-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q213603-r-add (real x y) t)
(defstub q213603-r-mul (real x y) t)
(defstub q213603-r-neg (real x) t)
(defstub q213603-r-inv (real x) t)
(defstub q213603-r-less (real x y) t)

(defstub q213603-k-zero (scalar-field) t)
(defstub q213603-k-one (scalar-field) t)
(defstub q213603-k-add (scalar-field x y) t)
(defstub q213603-k-mul (scalar-field x y) t)
(defstub q213603-k-neg (scalar-field x) t)
(defstub q213603-k-inv (scalar-field x) t)
(defstub q213603-k-norm (real scalar-field x) t)

(defstub q213603-v-zero (vector-space) t)
(defstub q213603-v-add (vector-space x y) t)
(defstub q213603-v-neg (vector-space x) t)
(defstub q213603-v-smul (scalar-field vector-space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q213603-v-norm (real vector-space vector) t)

(defstub q213603-vadd
  (vector-space point-space vector point)
  t)
(defstub q213603-vsub
  (vector-space point-space left-point right-point)
  t)

(defun q213603-r-leq (real x y)
  (not (q213603-r-less real y x)))

(defun q213603-r-div (real x y)
  (q213603-r-mul real x (q213603-r-inv real y)))

(defun-sk q213603-real-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-r-member-p real x)
      (q213603-r-member-p real y)
      (q213603-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q213603-r-zero real))
           (one (q213603-r-one real)))
       (and
        (q213603-r-member-p real (q213603-r-add real x y))
        (q213603-r-member-p real (q213603-r-mul real x y))
        (q213603-r-member-p real (q213603-r-neg real x))
        (q213603-r-member-p real (q213603-r-inv real x))
        (equal
         (q213603-r-add real (q213603-r-add real x y) z)
         (q213603-r-add real x (q213603-r-add real y z)))
        (equal (q213603-r-add real x y)
               (q213603-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q213603-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q213603-r-add real x (q213603-r-neg real x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q213603-r-mul real (q213603-r-mul real x y) z)
         (q213603-r-mul real x (q213603-r-mul real y z)))
        (equal (q213603-r-mul real x y)
               (q213603-r-mul real y x))
        (equal (q213603-r-mul real x one) x)
        (equal (q213603-r-mul real x zero) zero)
        (equal
         (q213603-r-mul real x (q213603-r-add real y z))
         (q213603-r-add
          real
          (q213603-r-mul real x y)
          (q213603-r-mul real x z)))
        (equal (q213603-r-inv real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q213603-r-mul real x (q213603-r-inv real x))
          one))
        (not (q213603-r-less real x x))
        (or (equal x y)
            (q213603-r-less real x y)
            (q213603-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q213603-r-less real x y)
          (q213603-r-less real y z))
         (q213603-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q213603-r-less real x y)
         (q213603-r-less
          real
          (q213603-r-add real x z)
          (q213603-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q213603-r-less real zero x)
          (q213603-r-less real zero y))
         (q213603-r-less
          real zero (q213603-r-mul real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q213603-r-set-valid-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q213603-r-set-member-p real set x)
     (q213603-r-member-p real x))))

(defun-sk q213603-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q213603-r-member-p real x)
     (q213603-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q213603-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-r-member-p real x)
      (q213603-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q213603-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q213603-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q213603-r-member-p real bound)
     (q213603-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q213603-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q213603-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q213603-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q213603-r-member-p real bound)
       (q213603-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q213603-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q213603-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q213603-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q213603-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-r-set-valid-p real set)
      (q213603-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q213603-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q213603-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q213603-real-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q213603-r-zero real))
        (one (q213603-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q213603-r-member-p real zero)
     (q213603-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q213603-r-less real zero one)
     (q213603-real-field-laws-p real)
     (q213603-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

(defun-sk q213603-scalar-field-laws-p (scalar-field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field x)
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field y)
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field z))
     (let ((zero (q213603-k-zero scalar-field))
           (one (q213603-k-one scalar-field)))
       (and
        (q213603-k-member-p
         scalar-field (q213603-k-add scalar-field x y))
        (q213603-k-member-p
         scalar-field (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x y))
        (q213603-k-member-p
         scalar-field (q213603-k-neg scalar-field x))
        (q213603-k-member-p
         scalar-field (q213603-k-inv scalar-field x))
        (equal
         (q213603-k-add
          scalar-field (q213603-k-add scalar-field x y) z)
         (q213603-k-add
          scalar-field x (q213603-k-add scalar-field y z)))
        (equal (q213603-k-add scalar-field x y)
               (q213603-k-add scalar-field y x))
        (equal (q213603-k-add scalar-field x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q213603-k-add scalar-field x
                        (q213603-k-neg scalar-field x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q213603-k-mul
          scalar-field (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x y) z)
         (q213603-k-mul
          scalar-field x (q213603-k-mul scalar-field y z)))
        (equal (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x y)
               (q213603-k-mul scalar-field y x))
        (equal (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x one) x)
        (equal (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x zero) zero)
        (equal
         (q213603-k-mul
          scalar-field x (q213603-k-add scalar-field y z))
         (q213603-k-add
          scalar-field
          (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x y)
          (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x z)))
        (equal (q213603-k-inv scalar-field zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q213603-k-mul
           scalar-field x (q213603-k-inv scalar-field x))
          one)))))))

(defun-sk q213603-scalar-norm-laws-p (real scalar-field)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field x)
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field y))
     (let ((zero-k (q213603-k-zero scalar-field))
           (one-k (q213603-k-one scalar-field))
           (zero-r (q213603-r-zero real))
           (one-r (q213603-r-one real))
           (norm-x (q213603-k-norm real scalar-field x))
           (norm-y (q213603-k-norm real scalar-field y)))
       (and
        (q213603-r-member-p real norm-x)
        (q213603-r-member-p real norm-y)
        (q213603-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
        (equal
         (equal norm-x zero-r)
         (equal x zero-k))
        (equal
         (q213603-k-norm real scalar-field one-k)
         one-r)
        (equal
         (q213603-k-norm
          real scalar-field (q213603-k-neg scalar-field x))
         norm-x)
        (equal
         (q213603-k-norm
          real scalar-field (q213603-k-mul scalar-field x y))
         (q213603-r-mul real norm-x norm-y))
        (q213603-r-leq
         real
         (q213603-k-norm
          real scalar-field (q213603-k-add scalar-field x y))
         (q213603-r-add real norm-x norm-y)))))))

(defun q213603-normed-field-p (real scalar-field)
  (let ((zero (q213603-k-zero scalar-field))
        (one (q213603-k-one scalar-field)))
    (and
     (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field zero)
     (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q213603-scalar-field-laws-p scalar-field)
     (q213603-scalar-norm-laws-p real scalar-field))))

(defun-sk q213603-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-field vector-space)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field a)
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field b)
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space u)
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space v)
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space w))
     (let ((zero-v (q213603-v-zero vector-space))
           (one-k (q213603-k-one scalar-field)))
       (and
        (q213603-v-member-p
         vector-space (q213603-v-add vector-space u v))
        (q213603-v-member-p
         vector-space (q213603-v-neg vector-space u))
        (q213603-v-member-p
         vector-space
         (q213603-v-smul scalar-field vector-space a u))
        (equal
         (q213603-v-add
          vector-space (q213603-v-add vector-space u v) w)
         (q213603-v-add
          vector-space u (q213603-v-add vector-space v w)))
        (equal (q213603-v-add vector-space u v)
               (q213603-v-add vector-space v u))
        (equal (q213603-v-add vector-space u zero-v) u)
        (equal
         (q213603-v-add
          vector-space u (q213603-v-neg vector-space u))
         zero-v)
        (equal
         (q213603-v-smul scalar-field vector-space one-k u)
         u)
        (equal
         (q213603-v-smul
          scalar-field vector-space
          (q213603-k-mul scalar-field a b)
          u)
         (q213603-v-smul
          scalar-field vector-space a
          (q213603-v-smul
           scalar-field vector-space b u)))
        (equal
         (q213603-v-smul
          scalar-field vector-space
          (q213603-k-add scalar-field a b)
          u)
         (q213603-v-add
          vector-space
          (q213603-v-smul
           scalar-field vector-space a u)
          (q213603-v-smul
           scalar-field vector-space b u)))
        (equal
         (q213603-v-smul
          scalar-field vector-space a
          (q213603-v-add vector-space u v))
         (q213603-v-add
          vector-space
          (q213603-v-smul
           scalar-field vector-space a u)
          (q213603-v-smul
           scalar-field vector-space a v))))))))

(defun-sk q213603-vector-norm-laws-p
    (real scalar-field vector-space)
  (forall (a u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field a)
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space u)
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space v))
     (let ((zero-r (q213603-r-zero real))
           (zero-v (q213603-v-zero vector-space))
           (norm-u (q213603-v-norm real vector-space u))
           (norm-v (q213603-v-norm real vector-space v)))
       (and
        (q213603-r-member-p real norm-u)
        (q213603-r-member-p real norm-v)
        (q213603-r-leq real zero-r norm-u)
        (equal
         (equal norm-u zero-r)
         (equal u zero-v))
        (equal
         (q213603-v-norm
          real vector-space (q213603-v-neg vector-space u))
         norm-u)
        (q213603-r-leq
         real
         (q213603-v-norm
          real vector-space (q213603-v-add vector-space u v))
         (q213603-r-add real norm-u norm-v))
        (equal
         (q213603-v-norm
          real vector-space
          (q213603-v-smul scalar-field vector-space a u))
         (q213603-r-mul
          real
          (q213603-k-norm real scalar-field a)
          norm-u)))))))

(defun-sk q213603-point-space-nonempty-p (point-space)
  (exists (point)
    (q213603-p-member-p point-space point)))

(defun-sk q213603-affine-torsor-laws-p
    (vector-space point-space)
  (forall (u v p q r)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space u)
      (q213603-v-member-p vector-space v)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space p)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space q)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space r))
     (let ((zero-v (q213603-v-zero vector-space)))
       (and
        (q213603-p-member-p
         point-space
         (q213603-vadd vector-space point-space u p))
        (q213603-v-member-p
         vector-space
         (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space p q))
        (equal
         (q213603-vadd vector-space point-space zero-v p)
         p)
        (equal
         (q213603-vadd
          vector-space point-space
          (q213603-v-add vector-space u v)
          p)
         (q213603-vadd
          vector-space point-space u
          (q213603-vadd vector-space point-space v p)))
        (equal
         (q213603-vadd
          vector-space point-space
          (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space p q)
          q)
         p)
        (equal
         (q213603-vsub
          vector-space point-space
          (q213603-vadd vector-space point-space u p)
          p)
         u)
        (equal
         (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space p r)
         (q213603-v-add
          vector-space
          (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space p q)
          (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space q r))))))))

(defun q213603-context-p
    (real scalar-field vector-space point-space)
  (and
   (q213603-real-p real)
   (q213603-normed-field-p real scalar-field)
   (q213603-v-member-p
    vector-space (q213603-v-zero vector-space))
   (q213603-vector-space-laws-p scalar-field vector-space)
   (q213603-vector-norm-laws-p
    real scalar-field vector-space)
   (q213603-point-space-nonempty-p point-space)
   (q213603-affine-torsor-laws-p vector-space point-space)))

;; This is the affine line through first and second, with its scalar parameter
;; existentially quantified inside the predicate.
(defun-sk q213603-line-member-p
    (scalar-field vector-space point-space point first second)
  (exists (parameter)
    (and
     (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field parameter)
     (equal
      point
      (q213603-vadd
       vector-space point-space
       (q213603-v-smul
        scalar-field vector-space parameter
        (q213603-vsub
         vector-space point-space second first))
       first)))))

;; For three points over a field, affine independence is equivalent to linear
;; independence of the two displacement vectors based at the first point.
(defun-sk q213603-triangle-independent-p
    (scalar-field vector-space point-space t0 t1 t2)
  (forall (a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field a)
      (q213603-k-member-p scalar-field b)
      (equal
       (q213603-v-add
        vector-space
        (q213603-v-smul
         scalar-field vector-space a
         (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space t1 t0))
        (q213603-v-smul
         scalar-field vector-space b
         (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space t2 t0)))
       (q213603-v-zero vector-space)))
     (and
      (equal a (q213603-k-zero scalar-field))
      (equal b (q213603-k-zero scalar-field))))))

(defun q213603-distance
    (real vector-space point-space first second)
  (q213603-v-norm
   real vector-space
   (q213603-vsub vector-space point-space first second)))

(defun q213603-distance-ratio
    (real vector-space point-space first middle last)
  (q213603-r-div
   real
   (q213603-distance
    real vector-space point-space first middle)
   (q213603-distance
    real vector-space point-space middle last)))

(defun q213603-ceva-conclusion-p
    (real vector-space point-space t0 t1 t2 p0 p1 p2)
  (equal
   (q213603-r-mul
    real
    (q213603-distance-ratio
     real vector-space point-space t1 p0 t2)
    (q213603-r-mul
     real
     (q213603-distance-ratio
      real vector-space point-space t2 p1 t0)
     (q213603-distance-ratio
      real vector-space point-space t0 p2 t1)))
   (q213603-r-one real)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q213603-cevas-theorem-statement
    (real scalar-field vector-space point-space)
  (forall (t0 t1 t2 p0 p1 p2 concurrent-point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q213603-context-p
       real scalar-field vector-space point-space)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space t0)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space t1)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space t2)
      (q213603-p-member-p point-space p0)

title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q213603,
-- "Ceva's theorem": in a normed affine space, three points on the cyclic
-- opposite-side lines of an affine-independent triangle, whose vertex lines
-- meet at one point, have product of the three distance ratios equal to one.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q213603_ceva_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record RealLine (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

record RealLineEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : RealLine R)
  (target : RealLine S) :
  Set1 where

  field
    toR : R -> S
    fromR : S -> R
    to-fromR :
      (y : S) ->
      toR (fromR y) == y
    from-toR :
      (x : R) ->
      fromR (toR x) == x
    to-zeroR :
      toR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    to-oneR :
      toR (oneR source) == oneR target
    to-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      toR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (toR x) (toR y)
    to-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      toR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (toR x) (toR y)
    to-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      toR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (toR x)
    to-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      toR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (toR x)
    to-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      toR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (toR x)
    to-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (toR x) (toR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set2 where

  field
    equivalent-real-line :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : RealLine S) ->
      RealLineEquivalence reals other

record NormedField
  (K R : Set)
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK reciprocalK : K -> K
    normK : K -> R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) == oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)
    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroK
    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK (negateK x) == normK x
    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))
    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)

open NormedField

record SeminormedSpace
  (K R V : Set)
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (scalars : NormedField K R reals) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : K -> V -> V
    normV : V -> R

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) ->
      addV x y == addV y x
    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-zeroV :
      (x : V) ->
      addV x zeroV == x
    add-inverseV :
      (x : V) ->
      addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (oneK scalars) x == x
    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyK scalars a b) x ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b x)
    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) ==
      addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)
    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scaleV (addK scalars a b) x ==
      addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

    norm-nonnegativeV :
      (x : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normV x)
    norm-zeroV :
      normV zeroV == zeroR reals
    norm-negateV :
      (x : V) ->
      normV (negateV x) == normV x
    norm-addV :
      (x y : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normV (addV x y))
        (addR reals (normV x) (normV y))
    norm-scaleV :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      normV (scaleV a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normV x)

open SeminormedSpace

record NormedAffineSpace
  {K R V : Set}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {scalars : NormedField K R reals}
  (vectors : SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V
    distance : P -> P -> R

    zero-vadd :
      (point : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV vectors) point == point
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (point : P) ->
      vadd (addV vectors u v) point ==
      vadd u (vadd v point)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (point : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v point) point == v

    distance-nonnegative :
      (p q : P) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (distance p q)
    distance-self :
      (p : P) ->
      distance p p == zeroR reals
    distance-separates :
      (p q : P) ->
      distance p q == zeroR reals ->
      p == q
    distance-symmetric :
      (p q : P) ->
      distance p q == distance q p
    distance-triangle :
      (p q r : P) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance p r)
        (addR reals (distance p q) (distance q r))
    distance-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      distance p q == normV vectors (vsub p q)

open NormedAffineSpace

data Fin3 : Set where
  index0 index1 index2 : Fin3

next : Fin3 -> Fin3
next index0 = index1
next index1 = index2
next index2 = index0

next2 : Fin3 -> Fin3
next2 i =
  next (next i)

record Triangle
  {K R V P : Set}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {scalars : NormedField K R reals}
  (vectors : SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars)
  (affine : NormedAffineSpace vectors P) :
  Set where

  field
    points : Fin3 -> P
    affine-independent :
      (a b : K) ->
      addV vectors
        (scaleV vectors a
          (vsub affine (points index1) (points index0)))
        (scaleV vectors b
          (vsub affine (points index2) (points index0)))
      ==
      zeroV vectors ->
      Both (a == zeroK scalars) (b == zeroK scalars)

open Triangle

OnAffineLine :
  {K R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NormedField K R reals} ->
  (vectors : SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars) ->
  (affine : NormedAffineSpace vectors P) ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
OnAffineLine {K = K} vectors affine a b x =
  Exists K
    (\ r ->
      x ==
      vadd affine
        (scaleV vectors r (vsub affine b a))
        a)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

product3 :
  {R : Set} ->
  RealLine R ->
  (Fin3 -> R) ->
  R
product3 reals f =
  multiplyR reals
    (f index0)
    (multiplyR reals (f index1) (f index2))

cevas-theorem : Set2
cevas-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (K V P : Set) ->
  (scalars : NormedField K R reals) ->
  (vectors : SeminormedSpace K R V reals scalars) ->
  (affine : NormedAffineSpace vectors P) ->
  (triangle : Triangle vectors affine) ->
  (sidePoint : Fin3 -> P) ->
  (concurrencePoint : P) ->
  ((i : Fin3) ->
    sidePoint i != points triangle (next2 i)) ->
  ((i : Fin3) ->
    OnAffineLine vectors affine
      (points triangle (next i))
      (points triangle (next2 i))
      (sidePoint i)) ->
  ((i : Fin3) ->
    OnAffineLine vectors affine
      (points triangle i)
      (sidePoint i)
      concurrencePoint) ->
  product3 reals
    (\ i ->
      divideR reals
        (distance affine
          (points triangle (next i))
          (sidePoint i))
        (distance affine
          (sidePoint i)
          (points triangle (next2 i))))
  ==
  oneR reals

title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q213603 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q213603), "Ceva's theorem": over an
  arbitrary normed field, three concurrent cevians of an affinely independent
  triangle have cyclic distance ratios whose product is one. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory;

val q213603_normed_affine_context_def = new_definition (
  "q213603_normed_affine_context_def",
  ``q213603_normed_affine_context
      (kzero : 'k)
      (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k)
      (kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (knorm : 'k -> real)
      (vzero : 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vneg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vnorm : 'v -> real)
      (padd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (psub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      kzero <> kone /\
      (!a b. kadd a b = kadd b a) /\
      (!a b c. kadd (kadd a b) c = kadd a (kadd b c)) /\
      (!a. kadd kzero a = a) /\
      (!a. kadd (kneg a) a = kzero) /\
      (!a b. kmul a b = kmul b a) /\
      (!a b c. kmul (kmul a b) c = kmul a (kmul b c)) /\
      (!a. kmul kone a = a) /\
      (!a b c. kmul a (kadd b c) =
          kadd (kmul a b) (kmul a c)) /\
      kinv kzero = kzero /\
      (!a. a <> kzero ==> kmul (kinv a) a = kone) /\
      (!a. 0 <= knorm a) /\
      (!a. (knorm a = 0 <=> a = kzero)) /\
      (!a. knorm (kneg a) = knorm a) /\
      (!a b. knorm (kadd a b) <= knorm a + knorm b) /\
      (!a b. knorm (kmul a b) = knorm a * knorm b) /\
      (!x y. vadd x y = vadd y x) /\
      (!x y z. vadd (vadd x y) z = vadd x (vadd y z)) /\
      (!x. vadd vzero x = x) /\
      (!x. vadd (vneg x) x = vzero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= vnorm x) /\
      vnorm vzero = 0 /\
      (!x. vnorm (vneg x) = vnorm x) /\
      (!x y. vnorm (vadd x y) <= vnorm x + vnorm y) /\
      (!x. smul kone x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (kmul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (kadd a b) x =
          vadd (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (vadd x y) =
          vadd (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!a x. vnorm (smul a x) = knorm a * vnorm x) /\
      (!p. padd vzero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. padd (vadd u v) p = padd u (padd v p)) /\
      (!p q. padd (psub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. psub (padd v p) p = v) /\
      (!p q. (vnorm (psub p q) = 0 <=> p = q))``);

val q213603_triangle_def = new_definition (
  "q213603_triangle_def",
  ``q213603_triangle
      (kzero : 'k)
      (vzero : 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (psub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (t0 : 'p)
      (t1 : 'p)
      (t2 : 'p) <=>
      !a b.
        vadd (smul a (psub t1 t0)) (smul b (psub t2 t0)) = vzero
        ==> a = kzero /\ b = kzero``);

val q213603_mem_line_def = new_definition (
  "q213603_mem_line_def",
  ``q213603_mem_line
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (padd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (psub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a : 'p)
      (b : 'p)
      (x : 'p) <=>
      ?r : 'k. x = padd (smul r (psub b a)) a``);

val q213603_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q213603_dist_def",
  ``q213603_dist
      (vnorm : 'v -> real)
      (psub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p : 'p)
      (q : 'p) =
      vnorm (psub p q)``);

val ceva_s_theorem =
  ``!(kzero : 'k)
      (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k)
      (kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (knorm : 'k -> real)
      (vzero : 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vneg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vnorm : 'v -> real)
      (padd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (psub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (t0 t1 t2 p0 p1 p2 p' : 'p).
      q213603_normed_affine_context
        kzero kone kadd kmul kneg kinv knorm
        vzero vadd vneg smul vnorm padd psub /\
      q213603_triangle kzero vzero vadd smul psub t0 t1 t2 /\
      p0 <> t2 /\ p1 <> t0 /\ p2 <> t1 /\
      q213603_mem_line smul padd psub t1 t2 p0 /\
      q213603_mem_line smul padd psub t2 t0 p1 /\
      q213603_mem_line smul padd psub t0 t1 p2 /\
      q213603_mem_line smul padd psub t0 p0 p' /\
      q213603_mem_line smul padd psub t1 p1 p' /\
      q213603_mem_line smul padd psub t2 p2 p'
      ==>
      q213603_dist vnorm psub t1 p0 /
          q213603_dist vnorm psub p0 t2 *
        (q213603_dist vnorm psub t2 p1 /
          q213603_dist vnorm psub p1 t0) *
        (q213603_dist vnorm psub t0 p2 /
          q213603_dist vnorm psub p2 t1) = 1``;

title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q213603
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q213603), "Ceva's theorem": over an arbitrary
  normed field, three concurrent cevians of an affine-independent triangle
  satisfy the product-of-distance-ratios form of Ceva's theorem. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K ranges over bundled SetMM normed fields and W over arbitrary normed vector
  spaces with scalar field K. Choosing any affine origin identifies the
  source's normed affine torsor with Base ` W while preserving affine lines
  and distances. Conversely, Base ` W is itself such a torsor. Although the
  source initially gives W a seminorm, its metric torsor structure makes that
  seminorm definite, so this presentation does not strengthen the domain.

  Q213603Line K W A B X says that X is an arbitrary K-affine combination of
  A and B. Q213603Dist W A B is the norm of B minus A.
  Q213603Noncol K W A B C says that A, B, C are affine-independent: A and B
  are distinct and C is not on their affine line. Thus A, B, C present exactly
  the source object Affine.Triangle K P.

  X, Y, and Z are the source function p at indices 0, 1, and 2, respectively,
  and P is p'. The three inequalities are precisely the nonzero-denominator
  assumptions. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement; all preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful
  definitions, and this file adds no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q213603Line Q213603Dist Q213603Noncol $.

q213603-line-syntax $a wff ( Q213603Line K W A B X ) $.
q213603-distance-syntax $a class ( Q213603Dist W A B ) $.
q213603-noncollinear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q213603Noncol K W A B C ) $.

${
  $d A B K W X x $.

  q213603-line-definition $a |- (
    ( Q213603Line K W A B X )
    <->
    E. x e. ( Base ` K )
      X
      =
      (

:: artifact Q213603 (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q213603). Over an arbitrary
:: normed field, three side points with concurrent cevians have cyclic product
:: of the corresponding distance ratios equal to one. This file contains no
:: proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5, VECTSP_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, BINOP_1;

      REAL_1, COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1;

 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      V being VectSp of K,
      kNorm being Function of K,REAL,
      vNorm being Function of V,REAL,
      A,B,C,X,Y,Z,P being Element of V st
    (for a being Element of K holds 0 <= kNorm.a) &
    (for a being Element of K holds
      kNorm.a = 0 iff a = 0.K) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      kNorm.(a+b) <= kNorm.a + kNorm.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      kNorm.(a*b) = kNorm.a * kNorm.b) &
    (for x being Element of V holds 0 <= vNorm.x) &
    (for x being Element of V holds
      vNorm.x = 0 iff x = 0.V) &
    (for x,y being Element of V holds
      vNorm.(x+y) <= vNorm.x + vNorm.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of V holds
      vNorm.(a*x) = kNorm.a * vNorm.x) &
    (for r,s being Element of K st
      r*(B-A) + s*(C-A) = 0.V
      holds r = 0.K & s = 0.K) &
    X <> C & Y <> A & Z <> B &
    (ex r being Element of K st X = B + r*(C-B)) &
    (ex r being Element of K st Y = C + r*(A-C)) &
    (ex r being Element of K st Z = A + r*(B-A)) &
    (ex r being Element of K st P = A + r*(X-A)) &
    (ex r being Element of K st P = B + r*(Y-B)) &
    (ex r being Element of K st P = C + r*(Z-C))
  holds
    (vNorm.(B-X) / vNorm.(X-C)) *
      (vNorm.(C-Y) / vNorm.(Y-A)) *
      (vNorm.(A-Z) / vNorm.(Z-B)) = 1
proof
end;
