title: Q213603_ceva_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q213603
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q213603), "Ceva's theorem": in a triangle over an
% arbitrary normed field, three side points whose cevians share a point have
% cyclic product of the corresponding distance ratios equal to one. This file
% contains no proof.

Q213603_ceva_s_theorem[
  K: TYPE+,
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  kzero: K,
  kone: K,
  kadd: [K, K -> K],
  kmul: [K, K -> K],
  kneg: [K -> K],
  kinv: [K -> K],
  knorm: [K -> real],
  vzero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  smul: [K, V -> V],
  vnorm: [V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  normed_field_laws: bool =
    kzero /= kone
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        kadd(kadd(a, b), c) = kadd(a, kadd(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        kadd(a, b) = kadd(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        kadd(a, kzero) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        kadd(a, kneg(a)) = kzero)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        kmul(kmul(a, b), c) = kmul(a, kmul(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        kmul(a, b) = kmul(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        kmul(a, kone) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        kmul(a, kadd(b, c)) =
          kadd(kmul(a, b), kmul(a, c)))
      AND kinv(kzero) = kzero
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= kzero IMPLIES kmul(a, kinv(a)) = kone)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        0 <= knorm(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        knorm(a) = 0 IFF a = kzero)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        knorm(kadd(a, b)) <= knorm(a) + knorm(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        knorm(kmul(a, b)) = knorm(a) * knorm(b))

  normed_vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V):
        vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        vadd(u, vzero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        vadd(u, vneg(u)) = vzero)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (u, v: V):
        smul(a, vadd(u, v)) =
          vadd(smul(a, u), smul(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (u: V):
        smul(kadd(a, b), u) =
          vadd(smul(a, u), smul(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (u: V):
        smul(kmul(a, b), u) = smul(a, smul(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        smul(kone, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        smul(kzero, u) = vzero)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smul(a, vzero) = vzero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        vneg(u) = smul(kneg(kone), u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        0 <= vnorm(u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        vnorm(u) = 0 IFF u = vzero)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V):
        vnorm(vadd(u, v)) <= vnorm(u) + vnorm(v))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (u: V):
        vnorm(smul(a, u)) = knorm(a) * vnorm(u))

  metric_affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P):
      point_vadd(vzero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        vnorm(vsub(p, q)) = 0 IFF p = q)

  source_context: bool =
    normed_field_laws
      AND normed_vector_space_laws
      AND metric_affine_torsor_laws

  distance(p, q: P): real =
    vnorm(vsub(p, q))

  on_line(x, a, b: P): bool =
    EXISTS (r: K):
      x = point_vadd(smul(r, vsub(b, a)), a)

  triangle_points_affinely_independent(t0, t1, t2: P): bool =
    FORALL (a, b: K):
      vadd(
        smul(a, vsub(t1, t0)),
        smul(b, vsub(t2, t0))) = vzero
      IMPLIES a = kzero AND b = kzero

  ceva_statement: bool =
    source_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (t0, t1, t2, p0, p1, p2, common: P):
        (triangle_points_affinely_independent(t0, t1, t2)
          AND p0 /= t2
          AND p1 /= t0
          AND p2 /= t1
          AND on_line(p0, t1, t2)
          AND on_line(p1, t2, t0)
          AND on_line(p2, t0, t1)
          AND on_line(common, t0, p0)
          AND on_line(common, t1, p1)
          AND on_line(common, t2, p2))
        IMPLIES
          (distance(t1, p0) / distance(p0, t2))
            * (distance(t2, p1) / distance(p1, t0))
            * (distance(t0, p2) / distance(p2, t1))
          = 1)
END Q213603_ceva_s_theorem

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q220680
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q220680), "Banach fixed-point theorem": a contraction on
-- a complete extended metric space has a fixed point approached by its iterates with an
-- explicit geometric error bound. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Setoid.Basic
public import Mathlib.Dynamics.FixedPoints.Topology
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Lipschitz

@[expose] public section

open NNReal Topology ENNReal Filter Function

variable {α : Type*}

namespace Q220680

/-- A map is contracting with constant `K` when `K < 1` and it is `K`-Lipschitz. -/
def ContractingWith [EMetricSpace α] (K : ℝ≥0) (f : α → α) :=
  K < 1 ∧ LipschitzWith K f

open EMetric Set

/-- Banach's fixed-point theorem with convergence and an explicit error estimate. -/
theorem exists_fixedPoint [EMetricSpace α] [CompleteSpace α] {K : ℝ≥0} {f : α → α}
    (hf : ContractingWith K f) (x : α) (hx : edist x (f x) ≠ ∞) :
    ∃ y, IsFixedPt f y ∧ Tendsto (fun n ↦ f^[n] x) atTop (𝓝 y) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, edist (f^[n] x) y ≤ edist x (f x) * (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n / (1 - K) := sorry

end Q220680

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q220680
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q220680), "Banach fixed-point theorem": a
  contraction on a complete extended metric space, started from a point with
  finite initial displacement, has a fixed point; its iterates converge to
  that point and satisfy the geometric error estimate. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Inductive q220680_ennreal : Type :=
| q220680_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q220680_ennreal
| q220680_ennreal_infinity : q220680_ennreal.

Arguments q220680_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q220680_ennreal_zero : q220680_ennreal :=
  q220680_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q220680_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q220680_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q220680_ennreal_finite a _,
    q220680_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q220680_ennreal_infinity,
    q220680_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q220680_ennreal_le
    (x y : q220680_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q220680_ennreal_finite a _,
    q220680_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q220680_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q220680_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q220680_ennreal_infinity,
    q220680_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q220680_ennreal_infinity,
    q220680_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q220680_ennreal_add
    (x y : q220680_ennreal) : q220680_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q220680_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q220680_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q220680_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q220680_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q220680_ennreal_scale
    (coefficient : R)
    (x : q220680_ennreal) : q220680_ennreal :=
  match x with
  | q220680_ennreal_finite value _ =>
      q220680_ennreal_finite
        (Rmax (coefficient * value) 0)
        (Rmax_r (coefficient * value) 0)
  | q220680_ennreal_infinity =>
      if Req_EM_T coefficient 0
      then q220680_ennreal_zero
      else q220680_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q220680_ennreal_lt_real
    (x : q220680_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q220680_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q220680_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q220680_ennreal_is_finite
    (x : q220680_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q220680_ennreal_finite _ _ => True
  | q220680_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Record q220680_nnreal : Type := {
  q220680_nnreal_value : R;
  q220680_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q220680_nnreal_value
}.

Record q220680_emetric_space (Alpha : Type) : Type := {
  q220680_edist : Alpha -> Alpha -> q220680_ennreal;
  q220680_edist_self :
    forall x : Alpha,
      q220680_ennreal_eq
        (q220680_edist x x) q220680_ennreal_zero;
  q220680_edist_comm :
    forall x y : Alpha,
      q220680_ennreal_eq
        (q220680_edist x y) (q220680_edist y x);
  q220680_edist_triangle :
    forall x y z : Alpha,
      q220680_ennreal_le
        (q220680_edist x z)
        (q220680_ennreal_add
          (q220680_edist x y) (q220680_edist y z));
  q220680_edist_eq_zero :
    forall x y : Alpha,
      q220680_ennreal_eq
        (q220680_edist x y) q220680_ennreal_zero <->
      x = y
}.

Arguments q220680_edist {Alpha} _ _ _.

Definition q220680_sequence_converges
    {Alpha : Type}
    (E : q220680_emetric_space Alpha)
    (u : nat -> Alpha) (limit : Alpha) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q220680_ennreal_lt_real
          (q220680_edist E (u n) limit) epsilon.

Definition q220680_sequence_cauchy
    {Alpha : Type}
    (E : q220680_emetric_space Alpha)
    (u : nat -> Alpha) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q220680_ennreal_lt_real
          (q220680_edist E (u m) (u n)) epsilon.

Definition q220680_complete
    {Alpha : Type}
    (E : q220680_emetric_space Alpha) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> Alpha,
    q220680_sequence_cauchy E u ->
    exists limit : Alpha,
      q220680_sequence_converges E u limit.

Fixpoint q220680_iterate
    {Alpha : Type}
    (f : Alpha -> Alpha) (n : nat) (x : Alpha) : Alpha :=
  match n with
  | O => x
  | S k => f (q220680_iterate f k x)
  end.

Definition q220680_contracting_with
    {Alpha : Type}
    (E : q220680_emetric_space Alpha)
    (K : q220680_nnreal)
    (f : Alpha -> Alpha) : Prop :=
  q220680_nnreal_value K < 1 /\
  forall x y : Alpha,
    q220680_ennreal_le
      (q220680_edist E (f x) (f y))
      (q220680_ennreal_scale
        (q220680_nnreal_value K)
        (q220680_edist E x y)).

Theorem ContractingWith_exists_fixedPoint :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (E : q220680_emetric_space Alpha)
         (K : q220680_nnreal)
         (f : Alpha -> Alpha)
         (x : Alpha),
    q220680_complete E ->
    q220680_contracting_with E K f ->
    q220680_ennreal_is_finite
      (q220680_edist E x (f x)) ->
    exists y : Alpha,
      f y = y /\
      q220680_sequence_converges E
        (fun n : nat => q220680_iterate f n x) y /\
      forall n : nat,
        q220680_ennreal_le
          (q220680_edist E (q220680_iterate f n x) y)
          (q220680_ennreal_scale
            (((q220680_nnreal_value K) ^ n) /
              (1 - q220680_nnreal_value K))
            (q220680_edist E x (f x))).
Admitted.

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q220680
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q220680), "Banach fixed-point theorem": a
  contraction on a complete extended metric space has a fixed point approached
  by its iterates with a geometric error bound. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym q220680_ennreal = "real option"

definition q220680_enonnegative :: "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_enonnegative x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (case x of None \<Rightarrow> True | Some r \<Rightarrow> 0 \<le> r)"

definition q220680_ezero :: q220680_ennreal where
  "q220680_ezero = Some 0"

definition q220680_eone :: q220680_ennreal where
  "q220680_eone = Some 1"

definition q220680_eof_real :: "real \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_eof_real r = Some (max 0 r)"

definition q220680_ele ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_ele x y \<longleftrightarrow>
    (case y of
      None \<Rightarrow> True
    | Some b \<Rightarrow> (case x of None \<Rightarrow> False | Some a \<Rightarrow> a \<le> b))"

definition q220680_elt ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_elt x y \<longleftrightarrow> q220680_ele x y \<and> x \<noteq> y"

definition q220680_eadd ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_eadd x y =
    (case x of
      None \<Rightarrow> None
    | Some a \<Rightarrow> (case y of None \<Rightarrow> None | Some b \<Rightarrow> Some (a + b)))"

definition q220680_emul ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_emul x y =
    (case x of
      None \<Rightarrow>
        (case y of None \<Rightarrow> None
        | Some b \<Rightarrow> if b = 0 then q220680_ezero else None)
    | Some a \<Rightarrow>
        (case y of None \<Rightarrow> if a = 0 then q220680_ezero else None
        | Some b \<Rightarrow> Some (a * b)))"

definition q220680_esub ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_esub x y =
    (case x of
      None \<Rightarrow> (case y of None \<Rightarrow> q220680_ezero | Some b \<Rightarrow> None)
    | Some a \<Rightarrow>
        (case y of None \<Rightarrow> q220680_ezero | Some b \<Rightarrow> Some (max 0 (a - b))))"

definition q220680_einv :: "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_einv x =
    (case x of
      None \<Rightarrow> q220680_ezero
    | Some a \<Rightarrow> if a = 0 then None else Some (inverse a))"

definition q220680_ediv ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_ediv x y = q220680_emul x (q220680_einv y)"

primrec q220680_epow ::
    "q220680_ennreal \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal" where
  "q220680_epow x 0 = q220680_eone"
| "q220680_epow x (Suc n) = q220680_emul (q220680_epow x n) x"

definition q220680_emetric_space ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_emetric_space edist \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. q220680_enonnegative (edist x y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. edist x x = q220680_ezero) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. edist x y = q220680_ezero \<longleftrightarrow> x = y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. edist x y = edist y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z.
      q220680_ele (edist x z) (q220680_eadd (edist x y) (edist y z)))"

definition q220680_tendsto ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_tendsto edist u y \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>\<epsilon> :: real. 0 < \<epsilon> \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
        q220680_elt (edist (u n) y) (q220680_eof_real \<epsilon>)))"

definition q220680_complete ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_complete edist \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a.
      (\<forall>\<epsilon> :: real. 0 < \<epsilon> \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>N. \<forall>m \<ge> N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
          q220680_elt (edist (u m) (u n)) (q220680_eof_real \<epsilon>))) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>y. q220680_tendsto edist u y))"

definition q220680_contracting_with ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q220680_contracting_with K edist f \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<le> K \<and> K < 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>x y.
      q220680_ele (edist (f x) (f y))
        (q220680_emul (q220680_eof_real K) (edist x y)))"

theorem banach_fixed_point_theorem:
  fixes edist :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> q220680_ennreal"
    and K :: real
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and x :: 'a
  assumes emetric: "q220680_emetric_space edist"
    and complete: "q220680_complete edist"
    and contracting: "q220680_contracting_with K edist f"
    and finite_displacement: "edist x (f x) \<noteq> None"
  shows "\<exists>y.
    f y = y \<and>
    q220680_tendsto edist (\<lambda>n. (f ^^ n) x) y \<and>
    (\<forall>n :: nat.
      q220680_ele (edist ((f ^^ n) x) y)
        (q220680_ediv
          (q220680_emul (edist x (f x))
            (q220680_epow (q220680_eof_real K) n))
          (q220680_esub q220680_eone (q220680_eof_real K))))"
  sorry

end

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q220680,
  "Banach fixed-point theorem": a contraction on a complete extended metric
  space has a fixed point approached by its iterates with the standard
  geometric error bound. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q220680_BANACH_FIXED_POINT_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(z:bool#real) (w:bool#real).
        FST w \/ (~(FST z) /\ SND z <= SND w) in
   let elt =
      \(z:bool#real) (w:bool#real).
        ~(FST z) /\ (FST w \/ SND z < SND w) in
   let eadd =
      \(z:bool#real) (w:bool#real).
        if FST z \/ FST w
        then etop
        else (F,SND z + SND w) in
   let escale =
      \(c:real) (z:bool#real).
        if c = &0
        then ezero
        else if FST z
        then etop
        else (F,c * SND z) in
   let emetric_space =
      \(edist:A->A->bool#real).
        (!x y:A. enonnegative (edist x y)) /\
        (!x y:A. edist x y = ezero <=> x = y) /\
        (!x y:A. edist x y = edist y x) /\
        (!x y z:A.
           ele (edist x z) (eadd (edist x y) (edist y z))) in
   let emetric_tends =
      \(edist:A->A->bool#real) (u:num->A) (y:A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n ==> elt (edist (u n) y) (F,e) in
   let emetric_cauchy =
      \(edist:A->A->bool#real) (u:num->A).
        !e:real.
          &0 < e
          ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                N <= m /\ N <= n
                ==> elt (edist (u m) (u n)) (F,e) in
   let complete_emetric_space =
      \(edist:A->A->bool#real).
        !u:num->A.
          emetric_cauchy edist u
          ==> ?y:A. emetric_tends edist u y in
   let contracting_with =
      \(K:real) (edist:A->A->bool#real) (f:A->A).
        &0 <= K /\
        K < &1 /\
        !x y:A.
          ele (edist (f x) (f y)) (escale K (edist x y)) in
   let iterate_from =
      \(f:A->A) (x:A) (u:num->A).
        u 0 = x /\
        !n:num. u (SUC n) = f (u n) in
   !edist:A->A->bool#real.
   !f:A->A.
   !K:real.
   !x:A.
     emetric_space edist /\
     complete_emetric_space edist /\
     contracting_with K edist f /\
     ~(FST (edist x (f x)))
     ==> ?y:A. ?u:num->A.
           f y = y /\
           iterate_from f x u /\
           emetric_tends edist u y /\
           !n:num.
             ele (edist (u n) y)
               (F,SND (edist x (f x)) * K pow n / (&1 - K))`;;

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q220680,
;; "Banach fixed-point theorem": a contraction on a complete extended metric
;; space has a fixed point approached by its iterates, with the stated
;; geometric extended-distance error bound. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative application interfaces present arbitrary carriers, maps,
;; distances, subsets, and sequences. A Dedekind-complete ordered field
;; presents the real numbers. Its nonnegative cone with an adjoined top
;; element presents the extended nonnegative reals. All typing, field,
;; extended-metric, completeness, and contraction laws used by the source
;; theorem are explicit in the statement predicate.

(defstub q220680-apply1 (function x) t)
(defstub q220680-apply2 (function x y) t)

(defun q220680-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (q220680-apply1 carrier x) t nil))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

(defun-sk q220680-real-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p carrier x)
      (q220680-member-p carrier y)
      (q220680-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q220680-apply2 add x y))
            (yz-add (q220680-apply2 add y z))
            (xy-multiply (q220680-apply2 multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (q220680-apply2 multiply y z))
            (negative-x (q220680-apply1 negate x))
            (inverse-x (q220680-apply1 inverse x)))
       (and
        (q220680-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q220680-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (q220680-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (q220680-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (q220680-apply2 add xy-add z)
         (q220680-apply2 add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q220680-apply2 add y x))
        (equal (q220680-apply2 add x zero) x)
        (equal (q220680-apply2 add x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q220680-apply2 multiply xy-multiply z)
         (q220680-apply2 multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal xy-multiply (q220680-apply2 multiply y x))
        (equal (q220680-apply2 multiply x one) x)
        (equal (q220680-apply1 inverse zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q220680-apply2 multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q220680-apply2 multiply x yz-add)
         (q220680-apply2
          add
          (q220680-apply2 multiply x y)
          (q220680-apply2 multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q220680-real-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p carrier x)
      (q220680-member-p carrier y)
      (q220680-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q220680-apply2 less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (q220680-apply2 less x y)
       (q220680-apply2 less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q220680-apply2 less x y)
        (q220680-apply2 less y z))
       (q220680-apply2 less x z))
      (implies
       (q220680-apply2 less x y)
       (q220680-apply2
        less
        (q220680-apply2 add x z)
        (q220680-apply2 add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q220680-apply2 less zero x)
        (q220680-apply2 less zero y))
       (q220680-apply2
        less zero (q220680-apply2 multiply x y)))))))

(defun q220680-real-leq (less left right)
  (not (q220680-apply2 less right left)))

(defun q220680-real-subtract (add negate left right)
  (q220680-apply2
   add left (q220680-apply1 negate right)))

(defun-sk q220680-real-set-valid-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q220680-apply1 set x)
     (q220680-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q220680-real-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q220680-member-p carrier x)
     (q220680-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q220680-real-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p carrier x)
      (q220680-apply1 set x))
     (q220680-real-leq less x bound))))

(defun-sk q220680-real-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q220680-member-p carrier bound)
     (q220680-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q220680-real-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q220680-member-p carrier supremum)
     (q220680-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q220680-member-p carrier bound)
       (q220680-real-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (q220680-real-leq less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q220680-real-supremum-exists-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q220680-real-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q220680-real-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-real-set-valid-p carrier set)
      (q220680-real-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q220680-real-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (q220680-real-supremum-exists-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q220680-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (q220680-member-p carrier zero)
   (q220680-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q220680-real-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q220680-real-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (q220680-apply2 less zero one)
   (q220680-real-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Canonical extended nonnegative reals over the presented real field.

(defun q220680-ennreal-finite (value)
  (list :q220680-finite value))

(defun q220680-ennreal-top ()
  :q220680-top)

(defun q220680-ennreal-zero (real-zero)
  (q220680-ennreal-finite real-zero))

(defun q220680-ennreal-one (real-one)
  (q220680-ennreal-finite real-one))

(defun q220680-ennreal-finite-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (equal (car value) :q220680-finite)
   (q220680-member-p real-carrier (cadr value))
   (q220680-real-leq real-less real-zero (cadr value))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (or
   (equal value (q220680-ennreal-top))
   (q220680-ennreal-finite-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less value)))

(defun q220680-ennreal-leq (real-less left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right (q220680-ennreal-top)) t)
   ((equal left (q220680-ennreal-top)) nil)
   (t
    (q220680-real-leq
     real-less (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-less (real-less left right)
  (and
   (q220680-ennreal-leq real-less left right)
   (not (equal left right))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-add (real-add left right)
  (if (or
       (equal left (q220680-ennreal-top))
       (equal right (q220680-ennreal-top)))
      (q220680-ennreal-top)
    (q220680-ennreal-finite
     (q220680-apply2
      real-add (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-multiply
    (real-zero real-multiply left right)
  (cond
   ((or
     (equal left (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
     (equal right (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero)))
    (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
   ((or
     (equal left (q220680-ennreal-top))
     (equal right (q220680-ennreal-top)))
    (q220680-ennreal-top))
   (t
    (q220680-ennreal-finite
     (q220680-apply2
      real-multiply (cadr left) (cadr right))))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-subtract
    (real-zero real-add real-negate real-less left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left (q220680-ennreal-top))
    (if (equal right (q220680-ennreal-top))
        (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero)
      (q220680-ennreal-top)))
   ((equal right (q220680-ennreal-top))
    (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
   ((q220680-apply2 real-less (cadr left) (cadr right))
    (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
   (t
    (q220680-ennreal-finite
     (q220680-real-subtract
      real-add real-negate
      (cadr left) (cadr right))))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-inverse
    (real-zero real-inverse value)
  (cond
   ((equal value (q220680-ennreal-top))
    (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
   ((equal value (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
    (q220680-ennreal-top))
   (t
    (q220680-ennreal-finite
     (q220680-apply1 real-inverse (cadr value))))))

(defun q220680-ennreal-divide
    (real-zero real-multiply real-inverse numerator denominator)
  (q220680-ennreal-multiply
   real-zero real-multiply
   numerator
   (q220680-ennreal-inverse
    real-zero real-inverse denominator)))

(defun q220680-ennreal-power
    (real-zero real-one real-multiply base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q220680-ennreal-one real-one)
    (q220680-ennreal-multiply
     real-zero real-multiply
     base
     (q220680-ennreal-power
      real-zero real-one real-multiply
      base (1- exponent)))))

;; Extended metric spaces and sequential completeness.

(defun q220680-edistance (edistance x y)
  (q220680-apply2 edistance x y))

(defun-sk q220680-emetric-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     space-carrier edistance)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p space-carrier x)
      (q220680-member-p space-carrier y)
      (q220680-member-p space-carrier z))
     (let ((dxy (q220680-edistance edistance x y))
           (dyz (q220680-edistance edistance y z))
           (dxz (q220680-edistance edistance x z)))
       (and
        (q220680-ennreal-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-less dxy)
        (q220680-ennreal-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-less dyz)
        (q220680-ennreal-p
         real-carrier real-zero real-less dxz)
        (equal
         (q220680-edistance edistance x x)
         (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
        (equal dxy (q220680-edistance edistance y x))
        (iff
         (equal dxy (q220680-ennreal-zero real-zero))
         (equal x y))
        (q220680-ennreal-leq
         real-less
         dxz
         (q220680-ennreal-add
          real-add dxy dyz)))))))

(defun q220680-emetric-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     space-carrier edistance)
  (q220680-emetric-laws-p
   real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
   space-carrier edistance))

(defun-sk q220680-sequence-typed-p
    (space-carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q220680-member-p
      space-carrier
      (q220680-apply1 sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q220680-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-less edistance sequence epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q220680-ennreal-less
      real-less
      (q220680-edistance
       edistance
       (q220680-apply1 sequence m)
       (q220680-apply1 sequence n))
      (q220680-ennreal-finite epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q220680-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-less edistance sequence epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q220680-cauchy-tail-p
      real-less edistance sequence epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q220680-cauchy-sequence-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     edistance sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p real-carrier epsilon)
      (q220680-apply2 real-less real-zero epsilon))
     (q220680-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      real-less edistance sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q220680-convergence-tail-p
    (real-less edistance sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q220680-ennreal-less
      real-less
      (q220680-edistance
       edistance
       (q220680-apply1 sequence n)
       limit)
      (q220680-ennreal-finite epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q220680-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-less edistance sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q220680-convergence-tail-p
      real-less edistance sequence
      limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q220680-sequence-converges-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     edistance sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p real-carrier epsilon)
      (q220680-apply2 real-less real-zero epsilon))
     (q220680-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      real-less edistance sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q220680-sequence-limit-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     space-carrier edistance sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q220680-member-p space-carrier limit)
     (q220680-sequence-converges-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      edistance sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q220680-complete-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     space-carrier edistance)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-sequence-typed-p
       space-carrier sequence)
      (q220680-cauchy-sequence-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       edistance sequence))
     (q220680-sequence-limit-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less
      space-carrier edistance sequence))))

;; Contracting maps and their iterates.

(defun-sk q220680-map-typed-p (space-carrier map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q220680-member-p space-carrier x)
     (q220680-member-p
      space-carrier
      (q220680-apply1 map x)))))

(defun-sk q220680-lipschitz-with-p
    (real-zero real-multiply real-less
     space-carrier edistance map k)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p space-carrier x)
      (q220680-member-p space-carrier y))
     (q220680-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q220680-edistance
       edistance
       (q220680-apply1 map x)
       (q220680-apply1 map y))
      (q220680-ennreal-multiply
       real-zero real-multiply
       (q220680-ennreal-finite k)
       (q220680-edistance edistance x y))))))

(defun q220680-contracting-with-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-multiply real-less
     space-carrier edistance map k)
  (and
   (q220680-member-p real-carrier k)
   (q220680-real-leq real-less real-zero k)
   (q220680-apply2 real-less k real-one)
   (q220680-map-typed-p space-carrier map)
   (q220680-lipschitz-with-p
    real-zero real-multiply real-less
    space-carrier edistance map k)))

(defun q220680-iterate (map n x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      x
    (q220680-apply1
     map
     (q220680-iterate map (1- n) x))))

(defun-sk q220680-orbit-convergence-tail-p
    (real-less edistance map start limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q220680-ennreal-less
      real-less
      (q220680-edistance
       edistance
       (q220680-iterate map n start)
       limit)
      (q220680-ennreal-finite epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q220680-orbit-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-less edistance map start limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q220680-orbit-convergence-tail-p
      real-less edistance map start limit
      epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q220680-orbit-converges-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     edistance map start limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q220680-member-p real-carrier epsilon)
      (q220680-apply2 real-less real-zero epsilon))
     (q220680-orbit-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      real-less edistance map start limit epsilon))))

(defun q220680-geometric-bound
    (real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     edistance map k start n)
  (let* ((initial-distance
          (q220680-edistance
           edistance start (q220680-apply1 map start)))
         (coefficient
          (q220680-ennreal-finite k))
         (coefficient-power
          (q220680-ennreal-power
           real-zero real-one real-multiply
           coefficient n))
         (denominator
          (q220680-ennreal-subtract
           real-zero real-add real-negate real-less
           (q220680-ennreal-one real-one)
           coefficient)))
    (q220680-ennreal-divide
     real-zero real-multiply real-inverse
     (q220680-ennreal-multiply
      real-zero real-multiply
      initial-distance coefficient-power)
     denominator)))

(defun-sk q220680-geometric-error-bound-p
    (real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     edistance map k start limit)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q220680-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q220680-edistance
       edistance
       (q220680-iterate map n start)
       limit)
      (q220680-geometric-bound
       real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
       real-negate real-inverse real-less
       edistance map k start n)))))

(defun q220680-fixed-point-conclusion-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q220680,
-- "Banach fixed-point theorem": a contraction on a complete extended metric
-- space, from a point with finite initial displacement, has a fixed point to
-- which its iterates converge with the stated geometric error bound. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) -> addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) -> Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

StrictLessR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLessR reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    realValue :
      R
    realValue-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) realValue

open NonnegativeReal

record ExtendedNonnegativeReals
  (R M : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroNN oneNN :
      NonnegativeReal reals
    zeroNN-value :
      realValue zeroNN == zeroR reals
    oneNN-value :
      realValue oneNN == oneR reals

    addNN multiplyNN subtractNN divideNN :
      NonnegativeReal reals ->
      NonnegativeReal reals ->
      NonnegativeReal reals
    addNN-value :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue (addNN x y) ==
      addR reals (realValue x) (realValue y)
    multiplyNN-value :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue (multiplyNN x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (realValue x) (realValue y)
    subtractNN-of-le :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (realValue y) (realValue x) ->
      realValue (subtractNN x y) ==
      addR reals (realValue x) (negateR reals (realValue y))
    subtractNN-of-ge :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y) ->
      subtractNN x y == zeroNN
    divideNN-positive :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) (realValue y) ->
      realValue (divideNN x y) ==
      multiplyR reals (realValue x) (reciprocalR reals (realValue y))

    zeroM oneM infinityM :
      M
    addM multiplyM subtractM divideM :
      M ->
      M ->
      M
    lessOrEqualM :
      M ->
      M ->
      Set
    finiteM :
      NonnegativeReal reals ->
      M

    zeroM-finite :
      zeroM == finiteM zeroNN
    oneM-finite :
      oneM == finiteM oneNN
    infinity-not-finite :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      infinityM != finiteM x
    finite-extensional :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x == realValue y ->
      finiteM x == finiteM y
    finite-injective :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      finiteM x == finiteM y ->
      realValue x == realValue y
    finite-or-infinity :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (x == infinityM)
        (Exists (NonnegativeReal reals) (\ y -> x == finiteM y))

    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x x
    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z
    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) -> Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)
    zero-leastM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM zeroM x
    infinity-greatestM :
      (x : M) -> lessOrEqualM x infinityM
    finite-orderM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualM (finiteM x) (finiteM y))
        (lessOrEqualR reals (realValue x) (realValue y))

    finite-addM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      addM (finiteM x) (finiteM y) == finiteM (addNN x y)
    finite-multiplyM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      multiplyM (finiteM x) (finiteM y) == finiteM (multiplyNN x y)
    finite-subtractM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      subtractM (finiteM x) (finiteM y) == finiteM (subtractNN x y)
    finite-divideM :
      (x y : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      divideM (finiteM x) (finiteM y) == finiteM (divideNN x y)

    add-infinity-leftM :
      (x : M) -> addM infinityM x == infinityM
    add-infinity-rightM :
      (x : M) -> addM x infinityM == infinityM
    multiply-zero-leftM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM zeroM x == zeroM
    multiply-zero-rightM :
      (x : M) -> multiplyM x zeroM == zeroM
    multiply-infinity-positive-leftM :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      multiplyM infinityM (finiteM x) == infinityM
    multiply-infinity-positive-rightM :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      multiplyM (finiteM x) infinityM == infinityM

open ExtendedNonnegativeReals

StrictLessM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set
StrictLessM extended x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualM extended x y) (x != y)

record ExtendedMetricSpace
  {a : Level}
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (A : Set a) : Set (lsuc a) where
  field
    edist :
      A ->
      A ->
      M
    edist-self :
      (x : A) ->
      edist x x == zeroM extended
    edist-symmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      edist x y == edist y x
    edist-triangle :
      (x y z : A) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (edist x z)
        (addM extended (edist x y) (edist y z))
    edist-eq-zero :
      (x y : A) ->
      Iff
        (edist x y == zeroM extended)
        (x == y)

open ExtendedMetricSpace

EventuallyAtTop :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
EventuallyAtTop P =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      P n)

Tendsto :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R M : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  ExtendedMetricSpace extended A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  A ->
  Set
Tendsto {R = R} {reals = reals} {extended = extended}
  metric sequence limit =
  (epsilon : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) (realValue epsilon) ->
  EventuallyAtTop
    (\ n ->
      StrictLessM extended
        (edist metric (sequence n) limit)
        (finiteM extended epsilon))

CauchySequence :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R M : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  ExtendedMetricSpace extended A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} {extended = extended}
  metric sequence =
  (epsilon : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) (realValue epsilon) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLessM extended
        (edist metric (sequence m) (sequence n))
        (finiteM extended epsilon))

Complete :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R M : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  ExtendedMetricSpace extended A ->
  Set a
Complete {A = A} metric =
  (sequence : Nat -> A) ->
  CauchySequence metric sequence ->
  Exists A (\ limit -> Tendsto metric sequence limit)

ContractingWith :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R M : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  ExtendedMetricSpace extended A ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  (A -> A) ->
  Set a
ContractingWith {A = A} {reals = reals} {extended = extended}
  metric constant function =
  Both
    (StrictLessR reals
      (realValue constant)
      (oneR reals))
    ((x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (edist metric (function x) (function y))
        (multiplyM extended
          (finiteM extended constant)
          (edist metric x y)))

iterate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A) ->
  Nat ->
  A ->
  A
iterate function zero x =
  x
iterate function (suc n) x =
  function (iterate function n x)

powerM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  M ->
  Nat ->
  M
powerM extended x zero =
  oneM extended
powerM extended x (suc n) =
  multiplyM extended (powerM extended x n) x

banach-fixed-point-theorem :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc lzero) ⊔ lsuc a)
banach-fixed-point-theorem a =
  (R M : Set) ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (metric : ExtendedMetricSpace extended A) ->
  Complete metric ->
  (constant : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  (function : A -> A) ->
  ContractingWith metric constant function ->
  (start : A) ->
  edist metric start (function start) != infinityM extended ->
  Exists A
    (\ fixedPoint ->
      Both
        (function fixedPoint == fixedPoint)
        (Both
          (Tendsto metric
            (\ n -> iterate function n start)
            fixedPoint)
          ((n : Nat) ->
            lessOrEqualM extended
              (edist metric
                (iterate function n start)
                fixedPoint)
              (divideM extended
                (multiplyM extended
                  (edist metric start (function start))
                  (powerM extended
                    (finiteM extended constant)
                    n))
                (subtractM extended
                  (oneM extended)
                  (finiteM extended constant))))))

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q220680, "Banach fixed-point theorem": a contraction on a complete extended
  metric space has a fixed point approached by its iterates with the standard
  geometric error bound. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory extrealTheory;

val q220680_emetric_space_def = new_definition (
  "q220680_emetric_space_def",
  ``q220680_emetric_space (edist : 'a -> 'a -> extreal) <=>
      (!x y : 'a. 0 <= edist x y) /\
      (!x y : 'a. (edist x y = 0) <=> (x = y)) /\
      (!x y : 'a. edist x y = edist y x) /\
      (!x y z : 'a. edist x z <= edist x y + edist y z)``);

val q220680_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q220680_tendsto_def",
  ``q220680_tendsto
      (edist : 'a -> 'a -> extreal) (u : num -> 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> edist (u n) y < Normal epsilon``);

val q220680_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q220680_cauchy_def",
  ``q220680_cauchy
      (edist : 'a -> 'a -> extreal) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          edist (u m) (u n) < Normal epsilon``);

val q220680_complete_emetric_space_def = new_definition (
  "q220680_complete_emetric_space_def",
  ``q220680_complete_emetric_space
      (edist : 'a -> 'a -> extreal) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q220680_cauchy edist u ==>
        ?y : 'a. q220680_tendsto edist u y``);

val q220680_contracting_with_def = new_definition (
  "q220680_contracting_with_def",
  ``q220680_contracting_with
      (k : real) (edist : 'a -> 'a -> extreal) (f : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      0 <= k /\
      k < 1 /\
      !x y : 'a.
        edist (f x) (f y) <= Normal k * edist x y``);

val ContractingWith_exists_fixedPoint =
  ``!(edist : 'a -> 'a -> extreal)
      (f : 'a -> 'a) (k : real) (x : 'a).
      q220680_emetric_space edist /\
      q220680_complete_emetric_space edist /\
      q220680_contracting_with k edist f /\
      edist x (f x) <> PosInf
      ==>
      ?y : 'a.
        f y = y /\
        q220680_tendsto edist (\n. FUNPOW f n x) y /\
        !n : num.
          edist (FUNPOW f n x) y <=
          edist x (f x) * Normal (k pow n) / Normal (1 - k)``;

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q220680
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q220680), "Banach fixed-point theorem": a
  contraction on a complete extended metric space has a fixed point approached
  by the iterates from any starting point at finite distance from its image,
  with the explicit geometric extended-distance bound. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  D e. ( *Met ` X ) is SetMM's native extended metric on the arbitrary
  carrier X, so distances take values in the extended reals and may equal
  +oo. The complete-space hypothesis uses the complete uniform space induced
  by D; its topology is the extended-metric topology.

  K ranges over all finite nonnegative reals, and K < 1 together with the
  displayed Lipschitz inequality is exactly ContractingWith K f. IterComp is
  SetMM's native finite-iteration operator, including the identity iterate at
  n = 0. The relation ~~>t expresses convergence of that iterate sequence in
  the topology induced by D. Extended-real multiplication *e and division /e
  render the source error estimate; 1 - K is positive and finite.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. This
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d D K X f n u v x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q220680-banach-fixed-point $a |-
    A. X A. D A. K e. ( 0 [,) +oo ) A. f A. x
      (
        (
          D e. ( *Met ` X )
          /\
          (
            ( toUnifSp ` ( metUnif ` D ) ) e. CUnifSp
            /\
            (
              f : X --> X
              /\
              x e. X
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            K < 1
            /\
            (
              A. u e. X A. v e. X
                (
                  ( ( f ` u ) D ( f ` v ) )
                  <_
                  ( K *e ( u D v ) )
                )
              /\
              ( x D ( f ` x ) ) =/= +oo
            )
          )
          ->
          E. y e. X
            (
              ( f ` y ) = y
              /\
              (
                ( n e. NN0 |->
                    (
                      ( ( IterComp ` f ) ` n )
                      `
                      x
                    )
                )
                (
                  ~~>t
                  `
                  ( unifTop ` ( metUnif ` D ) )
                )
                y
                /\
                A. n e. NN0
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        ( ( IterComp ` f ) ` n )
                        `
                        x
                      )
                      D
                      y
                    )
                    <_
                    (
                      (
                        ( x D ( f ` x ) )
                        *e
                        ( K ^ n )
                      )
                      /e
                      ( 1 - K )
                    )
                  )
              )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

theorem
  for X being non empty set,
      d being Function of [:X,X:],ExtREAL,
      f being Function of X,X,
      K being Real,
      x being Element of X st
    (for a,b being Element of X holds
      (0 qua ExtReal) <= d.[a,b] &
      (d.[a,b] = (0 qua ExtReal) iff a = b) &
      d.[a,b] = d.[b,a]) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of X holds
      d.[a,c] <= d.[a,b] + d.[b,c]) &
    (for s being sequence of X st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            d.[s.m,s.n] < (epsilon qua ExtReal))
     holds ex z being Element of X st
       for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
         ex N being Nat st
           for n being Nat st N <= n holds
             d.[s.n,z] < (epsilon qua ExtReal)) &
    0 <= K & K < 1 &
    (for a,b being Element of X holds
      d.[f.a,f.b] <= (K qua ExtReal) * d.[a,b]) &
    d.[x,f.x] <> +infty
  holds
    ex y being Element of X,
       u being sequence of X st
      f.y = y &
      u.0 = x &
      (for n being Nat holds u.(n+1) = f.(u.n)) &
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for n being Nat st N <= n holds
            d.[u.n,y] < (epsilon qua ExtReal)) &
      for n being Nat holds
        d.[u.n,y] <=
          (d.[x,f.x] * ((K |^ n) qua ExtReal)) /
            ((1-K) qua ExtReal)
proof
end;

title: Q220680_banach_fixed_point_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q220680,
% "Banach fixed-point theorem": a contraction on a complete extended metric space has a
% fixed point approached by its iterates with the standard geometric error bound.
% This file contains no proof.

banach_fixed_point_theorem_Q220680[A: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  ennreal: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]

  extended_distance: TYPE = [A, A -> ennreal]
  self_map: TYPE = [A -> A]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> A]

  zero_ennreal: ennreal =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_ennreal: ennreal =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_ennreal(value: real): ennreal =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_ennreal(value: ennreal): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  ennreal_is_zero(value: ennreal): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  finite_distance(value: ennreal): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)

  ennreal_le(left, right: ennreal): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(left)
      AND canonical_ennreal(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  ennreal_add(left, right: ennreal): ennreal =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_ennreal
    ELSE
      finite_ennreal(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  edist_lt_real(value: ennreal, bound: real): bool =
    finite_distance(value)
      AND finite_part(value) < bound

  edist_le_real(value: ennreal, bound: real): bool =
    finite_distance(value)
      AND finite_part(value) <= bound

  edist_le_scaled(
      output_distance: ennreal,
      scale: real,
      input_distance: ennreal): bool =
    canonical_ennreal(output_distance)
      AND canonical_ennreal(input_distance)
      AND IF infinite_flag(input_distance) THEN
        IF scale = 0 THEN
          ennreal_is_zero(output_distance)
        ELSE
          TRUE
        ENDIF
      ELSE
        NOT infinite_flag(output_distance)
          AND finite_part(output_distance)
            <= scale * finite_part(input_distance)
      ENDIF

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  emetric_space_laws(edist: extended_distance): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      canonical_ennreal(edist(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        ennreal_is_zero(edist(x, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        edist(x, y) = edist(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        ennreal_le(
          edist(x, z),
          ennreal_add(edist(x, y), edist(y, z))))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        ennreal_is_zero(edist(x, y)) IFF x = y)

  converges(
      values: point_sequence,
      limit_value: A,
      edist: extended_distance): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            edist_lt_real(
              edist(values(index), limit_value),
              epsilon_value)

  cauchy(
      values: point_sequence,
      edist: extended_distance): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            edist_lt_real(
              edist(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index)),
              epsilon_value)

  complete_space(edist: extended_distance): bool =
    FORALL (values: point_sequence):
      cauchy(values, edist) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit_value: A):
          converges(values, limit_value, edist)

  contracting_with(
      scale: real,
      f: self_map,
      edist: extended_distance): bool =
    scale >= 0
      AND scale < 1
      AND FORALL (x, y: A):
        edist_le_scaled(
          edist(f(x), f(y)),
          scale,
          edist(x, y))

  iterate(f: self_map, x: A, count: nat): RECURSIVE A =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      x
    ELSE
      f(iterate(f, x, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  iterates(f: self_map, x: A): point_sequence =
    LAMBDA (count: nat):
      iterate(f, x, count)

  geometric_bound(
      initial_distance: ennreal,
      scale: real,
      count: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      finite_part(initial_distance) * scale ^ count,
      1 - scale)

  banach_fixed_point_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (edist: extended_distance),
        (scale: real),
        (f: self_map),
        (x: A):
      (emetric_space_laws(edist)
        AND complete_space(edist)
        AND contracting_with(scale, f, edist)
        AND finite_distance(edist(x, f(x))))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (y: A):
          f(y) = y
            AND converges(iterates(f, x), y, edist)
            AND FORALL (count: nat):
              edist_le_real(
                edist(iterate(f, x, count), y),
                geometric_bound(
                  edist(x, f(x)),
                  scale,
                  count))
END banach_fixed_point_theorem_Q220680

module

title: Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226625
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2226625), "Commandino's theorem": for a
  positive-dimensional simplex in an affine space over a characteristic-zero
  division ring, the vertex-to-centroid vector is the dimension scalar times
  the centroid-to-opposite-face-centroid vector. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Inductive q2226625_fin : nat -> Type :=
| q2226625_fzero : forall n : nat, q2226625_fin (S n)
| q2226625_fsucc :
    forall n : nat, q2226625_fin n -> q2226625_fin (S n).

Arguments q2226625_fzero {n}.
Arguments q2226625_fsucc {n} _.

Fixpoint q2226625_fin_sum
    {A : Type}
    (add : A -> A -> A)
    (zero : A)
    (n : nat) : (q2226625_fin n -> A) -> A :=
  match n as m return (q2226625_fin m -> A) -> A with
  | O => fun _ => zero
  | S m =>
      fun f =>
        add
          (f q2226625_fzero)
          (@q2226625_fin_sum A add zero m
            (fun i => f (q2226625_fsucc i)))
  end.

Fixpoint q2226625_fin_sum_except
    {A : Type}
    (add : A -> A -> A)
    (zero : A)
    (n : nat)
    (i : q2226625_fin n) :
    (q2226625_fin n -> A) -> A :=
  match i in q2226625_fin m
        return (q2226625_fin m -> A) -> A with
  | @q2226625_fzero m =>
      fun f =>
        @q2226625_fin_sum A add zero m
          (fun j => f (q2226625_fsucc j))
  | @q2226625_fsucc m i' =>
      fun f =>
        add
          (f q2226625_fzero)
          (@q2226625_fin_sum_except A add zero m i'
            (fun j => f (q2226625_fsucc j)))
  end.

Record q2226625_division_ring (K : Type) : Type := {
  q2226625_zero : K;
  q2226625_one : K;
  q2226625_add : K -> K -> K;
  q2226625_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q2226625_neg : K -> K;
  q2226625_inv : K -> K;

  q2226625_zero_ne_one :
    q2226625_zero <> q2226625_one;
  q2226625_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2226625_add x (q2226625_add y z) =
      q2226625_add (q2226625_add x y) z;
  q2226625_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q2226625_add x y = q2226625_add y x;
  q2226625_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q2226625_add x q2226625_zero = x;
  q2226625_zero_add :
    forall x : K, q2226625_add q2226625_zero x = x;
  q2226625_add_neg :
    forall x : K, q2226625_add x (q2226625_neg x) = q2226625_zero;
  q2226625_neg_add :
    forall x : K, q2226625_add (q2226625_neg x) x = q2226625_zero;

  q2226625_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2226625_mul x (q2226625_mul y z) =
      q2226625_mul (q2226625_mul x y) z;
  q2226625_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q2226625_mul x q2226625_one = x;
  q2226625_one_mul :
    forall x : K, q2226625_mul q2226625_one x = x;
  q2226625_mul_zero :
    forall x : K, q2226625_mul x q2226625_zero = q2226625_zero;
  q2226625_zero_mul :
    forall x : K, q2226625_mul q2226625_zero x = q2226625_zero;
  q2226625_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2226625_mul x (q2226625_add y z) =
      q2226625_add (q2226625_mul x y) (q2226625_mul x z);
  q2226625_right_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2226625_mul (q2226625_add x y) z =
      q2226625_add (q2226625_mul x z) (q2226625_mul y z);

  q2226625_inv_zero :
    q2226625_inv q2226625_zero = q2226625_zero;
  q2226625_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q2226625_zero ->
      q2226625_mul x (q2226625_inv x) = q2226625_one;
  q2226625_inv_mul :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q2226625_zero ->
      q2226625_mul (q2226625_inv x) x = q2226625_one
}.

Arguments q2226625_zero {K} _.
Arguments q2226625_one {K} _.
Arguments q2226625_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226625_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226625_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q2226625_inv {K} _ _.

Fixpoint q2226625_nat_cast
    {K : Type}
    (F : q2226625_division_ring K)
    (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q2226625_zero F
  | S m =>
      q2226625_add F (q2226625_nat_cast F m) (q2226625_one F)
  end.

Definition q2226625_char_zero
    {K : Type}
    (F : q2226625_division_ring K) : Prop :=
  forall m n : nat,
    q2226625_nat_cast F m = q2226625_nat_cast F n ->
    m = n.

Record q2226625_module
    (K V : Type)
    (F : q2226625_division_ring K) : Type := {
  q2226625_vec_zero : V;
  q2226625_vec_add : V -> V -> V;
  q2226625_vec_neg : V -> V;
  q2226625_smul : K -> V -> V;

  q2226625_vec_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q2226625_vec_add x (q2226625_vec_add y z) =
      q2226625_vec_add (q2226625_vec_add x y) z;
  q2226625_vec_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q2226625_vec_add x y = q2226625_vec_add y x;
  q2226625_vec_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q2226625_vec_add x q2226625_vec_zero = x;
  q2226625_vec_zero_add :
    forall x : V, q2226625_vec_add q2226625_vec_zero x = x;
  q2226625_vec_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q2226625_vec_add x (q2226625_vec_neg x) = q2226625_vec_zero;
  q2226625_vec_neg_add :
    forall x : V,
      q2226625_vec_add (q2226625_vec_neg x) x = q2226625_vec_zero;

  q2226625_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q2226625_smul (q2226625_one F) x = x;
  q2226625_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : V),
      q2226625_smul (q2226625_mul F a b) x =
      q2226625_smul a (q2226625_smul b x);
  q2226625_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : V),
      q2226625_smul (q2226625_add F a b) x =
      q2226625_vec_add
        (q2226625_smul a x) (q2226625_smul b x);
  q2226625_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : V),
      q2226625_smul a (q2226625_vec_add x y) =
      q2226625_vec_add
        (q2226625_smul a x) (q2226625_smul a y);
  q2226625_zero_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q2226625_smul (q2226625_zero F) x = q2226625_vec_zero;
  q2226625_smul_zero :
    forall a : K, q2226625_smul a q2226625_vec_zero = q2226625_vec_zero
}.

Arguments q2226625_vec_zero {K V F} _.
Arguments q2226625_vec_add {K V F} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226625_vec_neg {K V F} _ _.
Arguments q2226625_smul {K V F} _ _ _.

Record q2226625_affine_space
    (K V P : Type)
    (F : q2226625_division_ring K)
    (M : @q2226625_module K V F) : Type := {
  q2226625_point_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q2226625_point_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q2226625_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P,
      q2226625_point_vadd (q2226625_vec_zero M) p = p;
  q2226625_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q2226625_point_vadd (q2226625_vec_add M x y) p =
      q2226625_point_vadd x (q2226625_point_vadd y p);
  q2226625_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q2226625_point_vsub (q2226625_point_vadd x p) p = x;
  q2226625_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q2226625_point_vadd (q2226625_point_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q2226625_point_vadd {K V P F M} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226625_point_vsub {K V P F M} _ _ _.

Definition q2226625_affine_independent
    {K V P : Type}
    {F : q2226625_division_ring K}
    {M : @q2226625_module K V F}
    (A : @q2226625_affine_space K V P F M)
    (n : nat)
    (points : q2226625_fin (S n) -> P) : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : q2226625_fin (S n) -> K,
    @q2226625_fin_sum K
      (q2226625_add F) (q2226625_zero F) (S n) coefficients =
      q2226625_zero F ->
    @q2226625_fin_sum V
      (q2226625_vec_add M) (q2226625_vec_zero M) (S n)
      (fun j =>
        q2226625_smul M (coefficients j)
          (q2226625_point_vsub A
            (points j) (points q2226625_fzero))) =
      q2226625_vec_zero M ->
    forall j : q2226625_fin (S n),
      coefficients j = q2226625_zero F.

Record q2226625_simplex
    (K V P : Type)
    (F : q2226625_division_ring K)
    (M : @q2226625_module K V F)
    (A : @q2226625_affine_space K V P F M)
    (n : nat) : Type := {
  q2226625_points : q2226625_fin (S n) -> P;
  q2226625_independent :
    @q2226625_affine_independent K V P F M
      A n q2226625_points
}.

Arguments q2226625_points {K V P F M A n} _ _.

Definition q2226625_centroid
    {K V P : Type}
    {F : q2226625_division_ring K}
    {M : @q2226625_module K V F}
    (A : @q2226625_affine_space K V P F M)
    (n : nat)
    (points : q2226625_fin (S n) -> P) : P :=
  q2226625_point_vadd A
    (q2226625_smul M
      (q2226625_inv F (q2226625_nat_cast F (S n)))
      (@q2226625_fin_sum V
        (q2226625_vec_add M) (q2226625_vec_zero M) (S n)
        (fun j =>
          q2226625_point_vsub A
            (points j) (points q2226625_fzero))))
    (points q2226625_fzero).

Definition q2226625_face_opposite_centroid
    {K V P : Type}
    {F : q2226625_division_ring K}
    {M : @q2226625_module K V F}
    (A : @q2226625_affine_space K V P F M)
    (n : nat)
    (points : q2226625_fin (S n) -> P)
    (i : q2226625_fin (S n)) : P :=
  q2226625_point_vadd A
    (q2226625_smul M
      (q2226625_inv F (q2226625_nat_cast F n))
      (@q2226625_fin_sum_except V
        (q2226625_vec_add M) (q2226625_vec_zero M) (S n) i
        (fun j =>
          q2226625_point_vsub A (points j) (points i))))
    (points i).

Theorem q2226625_point_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub :
  forall (K V P : Type)
         (F : q2226625_division_ring K)
         (M : @q2226625_module K V F)
         (A : @q2226625_affine_space K V P F M)
         (n : nat),
    n <> O ->
    q2226625_char_zero F ->
    forall (s : @q2226625_simplex K V P F M A n)
           (i : q2226625_fin (S n)),
      q2226625_point_vsub A
        (q2226625_points s i)
        (@q2226625_centroid K V P F M
          A n (q2226625_points s)) =
      q2226625_smul M (q2226625_nat_cast F n)
        (q2226625_point_vsub A
          (@q2226625_centroid K V P F M
            A n (q2226625_points s))
          (@q2226625_face_opposite_centroid K V P F M
            A n (q2226625_points s) i)).
Admitted.

title: Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226625
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2226625), "Commandino's theorem": for an
  n-simplex in an affine space over a characteristic-zero division ring, the
  vector from a vertex to the centroid is n times the vector from the centroid
  to the centroid of the opposite face. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

locale q2226625_affine_space =
  fixes scale :: "'k::{division_ring,ring_char_0} \<Rightarrow> 'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and vadd :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes scale_right_distrib:
      "scale a (u + v) = scale a u + scale a v"
    and scale_left_distrib:
      "scale (a + b) v = scale a v + scale b v"
    and scale_assoc:
      "scale a (scale b v) = scale (a * b) v"
    and scale_one:
      "scale 1 v = v"
    and vadd_zero:
      "vadd 0 p = p"
    and vadd_add:
      "vadd (u + v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)"
    and vsub_vadd:
      "vsub (vadd v p) p = v"
    and vadd_vsub:

definition q2226625_centroid ::

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226625
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q2226625), "Commandino's theorem": in an
  n-simplex over a characteristic-zero division ring, the
  centroid-to-vertex vector is n times the opposite-face-centroid-to-centroid
  vector. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2226625_COMMANDINOS_THEOREM =
 `!zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK invK:K->K.
   !zeroV:V.
   !addV:V->V->V.
   !negV:V->V.
   !smul:K->V->V.
   !vadd:V->P->P.
   !vsub:P->P->V.
   !nat_cast:num->K.
   !ksum:num->(num->K)->K.
   !vsum:num->(num->V)->V.
   !n:num.
   !points:num->P.
   !i:num.
     let is_nat_cast = (
       nat_cast 0 = zeroK /\
       (!m:num.
          nat_cast (SUC m) = addK (nat_cast m) oneK)) in
     let is_ksum = (
       (!f:num->K. ksum 0 f = zeroK) /\
       (!m:num. !f:num->K.
          ksum (SUC m) f = addK (ksum m f) (f m))) in
     let is_vsum = (
       (!f:num->V. vsum 0 f = zeroV) /\
       (!m:num. !f:num->V.
          vsum (SUC m) f = addV (vsum m f) (f m))) in
     let is_division_ring = (
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a:K. addK zeroK a = a /\ addK a zeroK = a) /\
       (!a b:K. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
       (!a:K.
          addK (negK a) a = zeroK /\
          addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
       (!a:K. mulK oneK a = a /\ mulK a oneK = a) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK a (addK b c) =
          addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK (addK a b) c =
          addK (mulK a c) (mulK b c)) /\
       (!a:K.
          mulK zeroK a = zeroK /\ mulK a zeroK = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:K.
          ~(a = zeroK)
          ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK /\
              mulK (invK a) a = oneK)) in
     let has_characteristic_zero = (
       !a b:num. nat_cast a = nat_cast b ==> a = b) in
     let is_add_comm_group = (
       (!x:V. addV zeroV x = x /\ addV x zeroV = x) /\
       (!x y:V. addV x y = addV y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          addV (addV x y) z = addV x (addV y z)) /\
       (!x:V.
          addV (negV x) x = zeroV /\
          addV x (negV x) = zeroV)) in
     let is_module = (
       (!x:V. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:V.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:K. !x:V.
          smul (addK a b) x =
          addV (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:K. !x y:V.
          smul a (addV x y) =
          addV (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x:V. smul zeroK x = zeroV) /\
       (!a:K. smul a zeroV = zeroV)) in
     let is_affine_space = (
       (!p:P. vadd zeroV p = p) /\
       (!x y:V. !p:P.
          vadd (addV x y) p = vadd x (vadd y p)) /\
       (!x:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd x p) p = x) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p)) in
     let affine_independent = (
       !coeff:num->K.
         ksum (n + 1) coeff = zeroK /\
         vsum (n + 1)
           (\j:num.
              smul (coeff j) (vsub (points j) (points 0))) =
           zeroV
         ==> !j:num. j < n + 1 ==> coeff j = zeroK) in
     let centroid =
       vadd
         (smul (invK (nat_cast (n + 1)))
           (vsum (n + 1)
             (\j:num. vsub (points j) (points 0))))
         (points 0) in
     let face_opposite_centroid =
       vadd
         (smul (invK (nat_cast n))
           (vsum (n + 1)
             (\j:num.
                if j = i
                then zeroV
                else vsub (points j) (points 0))))
         (points 0) in
     is_nat_cast /\
     is_ksum /\
     is_vsum /\
     is_division_ring /\
     has_characteristic_zero /\
     is_add_comm_group /\
     is_module /\
     is_affine_space /\
     affine_independent /\
     ~(n = 0) /\
     i < n + 1
     ==>
     vsub (points i) centroid =
     smul (nat_cast n)
       (vsub centroid face_opposite_centroid)`;;
