title: Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226625,
-- "Commandino's theorem": in a positive-dimensional simplex, the vector from
-- a vertex to the centroid is the dimension times the vector from the centroid
-- to the centroid of the opposite face. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

foldFin :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  (A -> A -> A) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> A) ->
  A
foldFin neutral combine {zero} values =
  neutral
foldFin neutral combine {suc n} values =
  combine
    (values fzero)
    (foldFin neutral combine (\ i -> values (fsuc i)))

record DivisionRing
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set k where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK inverseK : K -> K

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-zero-leftK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK zeroK x == x
    add-inverse-leftK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK (negateK x) x == zeroK

    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-one-leftK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK oneK x == x
    multiply-one-rightK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zero-leftK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK zeroK x == zeroK
    multiply-zero-rightK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK

    distribute-leftK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    distribute-rightK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (addK x y) z ==
      addK (multiplyK x z) (multiplyK y z)

    inverse-zeroK :
      inverseK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-inverseK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (inverseK x) == oneK
    inverse-multiplyK :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK (inverseK x) x == oneK

open DivisionRing

natCast :
  {k : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  DivisionRing K ->
  Nat ->
  K
natCast ring zero =
  zeroK ring
natCast ring (suc n) =
  addK ring (natCast ring n) (oneK ring)

CharZero :
  {k : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  DivisionRing K ->
  Set k
CharZero ring =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  natCast ring m == natCast ring n ->
  m == n

sumK :
  {k : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  (ring : DivisionRing K) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  K
sumK ring =
  foldFin (zeroK ring) (addK ring)

record AdditiveCommutativeGroup
  {v : Level}
  (V : Set v) :
  Set v where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V

    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : V) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)
    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : V) ->
      addV x y == addV y x
    add-zero-leftV :
      (x : V) ->
      addV zeroV x == x
    add-inverse-leftV :
      (x : V) ->
      addV (negateV x) x == zeroV

open AdditiveCommutativeGroup

sumV :
  {v : Level} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> V) ->
  V
sumV vectors =
  foldFin (zeroV vectors) (addV vectors)

record LeftModule
  {k v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {V : Set v}
  (ring : DivisionRing K)
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) :
  Set (k ⊔ v) where

  field
    scale : K -> V -> V

    one-scale :
      (x : V) ->
      scale (oneK ring) x == x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scale (multiplyK ring a b) x ==
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scalars :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : V) ->
      scale (addK ring a b) x ==
      addV vectors (scale a x) (scale b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : V) ->
      scale a (addV vectors x y) ==
      addV vectors (scale a x) (scale a y)

open LeftModule

record AffineSpace
  {v p : Level}
  {V : Set v}
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V)
  (P : Set p) :
  Set (v ⊔ p) where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (point : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV vectors) point == point
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (point : P) ->
      vadd (addV vectors u v) point ==
      vadd u (vadd v point)
    vsub-vadd :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vadd-vsub :
      (u : V) ->
      (point : P) ->
      vsub (vadd u point) point == u

open AffineSpace

weightedDisplacement :
  {k v p : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  (ring : DivisionRing K) ->
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) ->
  (module-structure : LeftModule ring vectors) ->
  (affine : AffineSpace vectors P) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (points : Fin (suc n) -> P) ->
  (coefficients : Fin (suc n) -> K) ->
  V
weightedDisplacement ring vectors module-structure affine points coefficients =
  sumV vectors
    (\ i ->
      scale module-structure
        (coefficients i)
        (vsub affine (points i) (points fzero)))

AffineIndependent :
  {k v p : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  (ring : DivisionRing K) ->
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) ->
  (module-structure : LeftModule ring vectors) ->
  (affine : AffineSpace vectors P) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc n) -> P) ->
  Set (k ⊔ v)
AffineIndependent ring vectors module-structure affine points =
  (coefficients : Fin _ -> _) ->
  sumK ring coefficients == zeroK ring ->
  weightedDisplacement
    ring vectors module-structure affine points coefficients
    ==
    zeroV vectors ->
  (i : Fin _) ->
  coefficients i == zeroK ring

record Simplex
  {k v p : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {V : Set v}
  {P : Set p}
  (ring : DivisionRing K)
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V)
  (module-structure : LeftModule ring vectors)
  (affine : AffineSpace vectors P)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set (k ⊔ v ⊔ p) where

  field
    points :
      Fin (suc n) ->
      P
    independent :
      AffineIndependent
        ring vectors module-structure affine points

open Simplex

centroid :
  {k v p : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  (ring : DivisionRing K) ->
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) ->
  (module-structure : LeftModule ring vectors) ->
  (affine : AffineSpace vectors P) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc n) -> P) ->
  P
centroid ring vectors module-structure affine {n} points =
  vadd affine
    (scale module-structure
      (inverseK ring (natCast ring (suc n)))
      (sumV vectors
        (\ i -> vsub affine (points i) (points fzero))))
    (points fzero)

faceOppositeCentroid :
  {k v p : Level} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  (ring : DivisionRing K) ->
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) ->
  (module-structure : LeftModule ring vectors) ->
  (affine : AffineSpace vectors P) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  n != zero ->
  (points : Fin (suc n) -> P) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  P
faceOppositeCentroid
  ring vectors module-structure affine {n} nonzero points i =
  vadd affine
    (scale module-structure
      (inverseK ring (natCast ring n))
      (sumV vectors
        (\ j -> vsub affine (points j) (points i))))
    (points i)

commandinos-theorem :
  (k v p : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ v ⊔ p))
commandinos-theorem k v p =
  (K : Set k) ->
  (ring : DivisionRing K) ->
  CharZero ring ->
  (V : Set v) ->
  (vectors : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) ->
  (module-structure : LeftModule ring vectors) ->
  (P : Set p) ->
  (affine : AffineSpace vectors P) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (nonzero : n != zero) ->
  (simplex : Simplex ring vectors module-structure affine n) ->
  (i : Fin (suc n)) ->
  vsub affine
    (points simplex i)
    (centroid
      ring vectors module-structure affine
      (points simplex))
  ==
  scale module-structure
    (natCast ring n)
    (vsub affine
      (centroid
        ring vectors module-structure affine
        (points simplex))
      (faceOppositeCentroid
        ring vectors module-structure affine
        nonzero
        (points simplex)
        i))

title: Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2226625 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q2226625), "Commandino's theorem":
  in an arbitrary characteristic-zero division-ring affine space, a simplex
  centroid divides each median in the dimension-to-one ratio. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val commandinos_theorem =
  ``!(kzero : 'k)
      (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k)
      (kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (vzero : 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vneg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (padd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (psub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (n : num)
      (points : num -> 'p)
      (i : num).
      let nat_cast =
        \(m : num).
          ITSET (\j acc. kadd kone acc) {j : num | j < m} kzero
      in
      let scalar_sum =
        \(w : num -> 'k) (s : num set).
          ITSET (\j acc. kadd (w j) acc) s kzero
      in
      let vector_sum =
        \(f : num -> 'v) (s : num set).
          ITSET (\j acc. vadd (f j) acc) s vzero
      in
      let indices = {j : num | j < n + 1}
      in
      let opposite_indices = {j : num | j < n + 1 /\ j <> i}
      in
      let affine_independent =
        !w : num -> 'k.
          scalar_sum w indices = kzero /\
          vector_sum
            (\j. smul (w j) (psub (points j) (points 0)))
            indices = vzero
          ==>
          !j. j IN indices ==> w j = kzero
      in
      let centroid =
        padd
          (smul (kinv (nat_cast (n + 1)))
            (vector_sum
              (\j. psub (points j) (points 0))
              indices))
          (points 0)
      in
      let face_opposite_centroid =
        padd
          (smul (kinv (nat_cast n))
            (vector_sum
              (\j. psub (points j) (points i))
              opposite_indices))
          (points i)
      in
        kone <> kzero /\
        (!a b. kadd a b = kadd b a) /\
        (!a b c. kadd (kadd a b) c = kadd a (kadd b c)) /\
        (!a. kadd kzero a = a) /\
        (!a. kadd (kneg a) a = kzero) /\
        (!a b c. kmul (kmul a b) c = kmul a (kmul b c)) /\
        (!a. kmul kone a = a) /\
        (!a. kmul a kone = a) /\
        (!a b c.
          kmul a (kadd b c) = kadd (kmul a b) (kmul a c)) /\
        (!a b c.
          kmul (kadd a b) c = kadd (kmul a c) (kmul b c)) /\
        kinv kzero = kzero /\
        (!a.
          a <> kzero ==>
          kmul (kinv a) a = kone /\ kmul a (kinv a) = kone) /\
        (!m r. nat_cast m = nat_cast r ==> m = r) /\
        (!x y. vadd x y = vadd y x) /\
        (!x y z. vadd (vadd x y) z = vadd x (vadd y z)) /\
        (!x. vadd vzero x = x) /\
        (!x. vadd (vneg x) x = vzero) /\
        (!x. smul kone x = x) /\
        (!a b x. smul (kmul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b x.
          smul (kadd a b) x = vadd (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a x y.
          smul a (vadd x y) = vadd (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
        (!p. padd vzero p = p) /\
        (!u v p. padd (vadd u v) p = padd u (padd v p)) /\
        (!p q. padd (psub p q) q = p) /\
        (!v p. psub (padd v p) p = v) /\
        n <> 0 /\
        i < n + 1 /\
        affine_independent
        ==>
        psub (points i) centroid =
          smul (nat_cast n)
            (psub centroid face_opposite_centroid)``;

title: Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226625
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2226625), "Commandino's theorem": for a
  positive-dimensional simplex over a characteristic-zero division ring, the
  vector from a vertex to the simplex centroid is the dimension scalar times
  the vector from the centroid to the opposite-face centroid. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K is an arbitrary division ring of characteristic zero, V is an arbitrary
  left K-module, n is a positive natural number, and F lists n+1 affinely
  independent vertices. Q2226625NatCast is the repeated-addition embedding of
  natural numbers into K. Q2226625AffineIndependent uses the finite-relation
  characterization: coefficients summing to zero and having zero weighted
  vector sum must all vanish.

  Choosing any affine origin identifies the source affine torsor with Base ` V
  while preserving point differences, affine independence, and centroids.
  Conversely, Base ` V is itself an affine torsor. Q2226625Centroid is the
  equal-weight average of all n+1 vertices, and
  Q2226625FaceOppositeCentroid is the equal-weight average of the n vertices
  other than i.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. Every
  preceding $a declaration is syntax or a faithful definition, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  Q2226625NatCast Q2226625CharZero Q2226625AffineIndependent
  Q2226625Centroid Q2226625FaceOppositeCentroid
$.

q2226625-natural-cast-syntax
  $a class ( Q2226625NatCast K N ) $.
q2226625-characteristic-zero-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2226625CharZero K ) $.
q2226625-affine-independent-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2226625AffineIndependent K V I F ) $.
q2226625-centroid-syntax
  $a class ( Q2226625Centroid K V N F ) $.
q2226625-face-opposite-centroid-syntax
  $a class ( Q2226625FaceOppositeCentroid K V N F I ) $.

q2226625-natural-cast-definition $a |-
  ( Q2226625NatCast K N )
  =
  ( N ( .g ` K ) ( 1r ` K ) )
$.

${
  $d K m $.

  q2226625-characteristic-zero-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2226625CharZero K )
    <->
    A. m e. NN
      ( Q2226625NatCast K m ) =/= ( 0g ` K )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F I K V c j $.

  q2226625-affine-independent-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2226625AffineIndependent K V I F )
    <->
    A. c e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m I )
      (
        (
          (
            K gsum
              ( j e. I |-> ( c ` j ) )
          )
          =
          ( 0g ` K )
          /\
          (
            V gsum
              (
                j e. I |->
                  (
                    ( c ` j )
                    ( .s ` V )
                    ( F ` j )
                  )
              )
          )
          =
          ( 0g ` V )
        )
        ->
        A. j e. I
          ( c ` j ) = ( 0g ` K )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K N V j $.

  q2226625-centroid-definition $a |-
    ( Q2226625Centroid K V N F )
    =
    (
      (
        ( 1r ` K )
        ( /r ` K )
        ( Q2226625NatCast K ( N + 1 ) )
      )
      ( .s ` V )
      (
        V gsum
          (
            j e. ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) |->
              ( F ` j )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F I K N V j $.

  q2226625-face-opposite-centroid-definition $a |-
    ( Q2226625FaceOppositeCentroid K V N F I )
    =
    (
      (
        ( 1r ` K )
        ( /r ` K )
        ( Q2226625NatCast K N )
      )
      ( .s ` V )
      (
        V gsum
          (
            j e. ( ( 0 ..^ ( N + 1 ) ) \ { I } ) |->
              ( F ` j )
          )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F K V i j n $.

  thousand-theorems-q2226625-commandino-s-theorem $a |-
    A. K e. DivRing
      A. V e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = K }
        A. n e. NN
          A. F e.
            (
              ( Base ` V )
              ^m
              ( 0 ..^ ( n + 1 ) )
            )
            (
              (
                ( Q2226625CharZero K )
                /\
                (
                  Q2226625AffineIndependent
                  K
                  V
                  ( 0 ..^ ( n + 1 ) )
                  F
                )
              )
              ->
              A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( n + 1 ) )
                (
                  (
                    ( F ` i )
                    ( +g ` V )
                    (
                      ( -g ` V )
                      `
                      ( Q2226625Centroid K V n F )
                    )
                  )
                  =
                  (
                    ( Q2226625NatCast K n )
                    ( .s ` V )
                    (
                      ( Q2226625Centroid K V n F )
                      ( +g ` V )
                      (
                        ( -g ` V )
                        `
                        (
                          Q2226625FaceOppositeCentroid
                          K
                          V
                          n
                          F
                          i
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
  $.
$}

      ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, RING_3, FINSOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1,
      RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_3, FINSEQ_4, NUMBERS, NAT_1,
      XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat, K being Skew-Field,
      V being LeftMod of K,
      p being FinSequence of the carrier of V, i being Nat st
    1 <= n &
    (for m being Nat, z being FinSequence of the carrier of K st
      1 <= m & len z = m &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom z holds z/.j = the OneF of K)
     holds (the addF of K) "**" z <> the ZeroF of K) &
    len p = n + 1 &
    (for w being FinSequence of the carrier of K,
         t being FinSequence of the carrier of V st
       len w = len p & len t = len p &
       (the addF of K) "**" w = the ZeroF of K &
       (for j being Nat st j in dom t holds
         t/.j = (w/.j) * (p/.j)) &
       (the addF of V) "**" t = the ZeroF of V
     holds
       for j being Nat st j in dom w holds w/.j = the ZeroF of K) &
    i in dom p
  holds

       c,f being Element of V,
       r,s being FinSequence of the carrier of K,

      len r = n + 1 &

      (the addF of K) "**" r = a &
      len s = n &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom s holds s/.j = the OneF of K) &
      (the addF of K) "**" s = b &
      q = Del(p,i) &
      len q = n &
      len u = len p &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom u holds
        u/.j = a" * (p/.j)) &
      (the addF of V) "**" u = c &
      len v = len q &
      (for j being Nat st j in dom v holds
        v/.j = b" * (q/.j)) &
      (the addF of V) "**" v = f &
      p/.i - c = b * (c - f)

end;

title: Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226625,
% "Commandino's theorem": in a simplex over a characteristic-zero division ring,
% the vector from the centroid to a vertex is the dimension times the vector from
% the opposite-face centroid to the simplex centroid. This file contains no proof.

Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem[
  K, V, P: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  zeroV: V,
  negV: [V -> V],
  addV: [V, V -> V],
  smul: [K, V -> V],
  vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  scalar_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> K]
  vector_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> V]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> P]

  division_ring_laws: bool =
    zeroK /= oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mulK(oneK, a) = a
          AND mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(addK(a, b), c) =
          addK(mulK(a, c), mulK(b, c)))
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES
          mulK(invK(a), a) = oneK
            AND mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)

  nat_cast(value: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      zeroK
    ELSE
      addK(nat_cast(value - 1), oneK)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  characteristic_zero: bool =
    FORALL (left, right: nat):
      nat_cast(left) = nat_cast(right) IMPLIES left = right

  module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V):
      addV(u, v) = addV(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        addV(addV(u, v), w) = addV(u, addV(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        addV(u, zeroV) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        addV(u, negV(u)) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (u, v: V):
        smul(a, addV(u, v)) =
          addV(smul(a, u), smul(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (u: V):
        smul(addK(a, b), u) =
          addV(smul(a, u), smul(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (u: V):
        smul(mulK(a, b), u) =
          smul(a, smul(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        smul(oneK, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V):
        smul(zeroK, u) = zeroV)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smul(a, zeroV) = zeroV)

  affine_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P):
      vadd(zeroV, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        vadd(addV(u, v), p) =
          vadd(u, vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  scalar_sum(
      values: scalar_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroK
    ELSE
      addK(
        scalar_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  vector_sum(
      values: vector_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE V =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroV
    ELSE
      addV(
        vector_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  affinely_independent(
      dimension: nat,
      points: point_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: scalar_sequence):
      scalar_sum(coefficients, dimension + 1) = zeroK
        AND vector_sum(
          (LAMBDA (index: nat):
            smul(
              coefficients(index),
              vsub(points(index), points(0)))),
          dimension + 1) = zeroV
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          index <= dimension IMPLIES
            coefficients(index) = zeroK)

  centroid(
      dimension: nat,
      points: point_sequence): P =
    vadd(
      smul(
        invK(nat_cast(dimension + 1)),
        vector_sum(
          (LAMBDA (index: nat):
            vsub(points(index), points(0))),
          dimension + 1)),
      points(0))

  face_opposite_centroid(
      dimension: nat,
      points: point_sequence,
      vertex: nat): P =
    vadd(
      smul(
        invK(nat_cast(dimension)),
        vector_sum(
          (LAMBDA (index: nat):
            IF index = vertex THEN
              zeroV
            ELSE
              vsub(points(index), points(vertex))
            ENDIF),
          dimension + 1)),
      points(vertex))

  algebraic_affine_context: bool =
    division_ring_laws
      AND characteristic_zero
      AND module_laws
      AND affine_space_laws

  commandinos_theorem: bool =
    algebraic_affine_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL
          (dimension: nat),
          (points: point_sequence),
          (vertex: nat):
        0 < dimension
          AND vertex <= dimension
          AND affinely_independent(dimension, points)
        IMPLIES
          vsub(
            points(vertex),
            centroid(dimension, points))
          =
          smul(
            nat_cast(dimension),
            vsub(
              centroid(dimension, points),
              face_opposite_centroid(
                dimension,
                points,
                vertex))))
END Q2226625_commandino_s_theorem

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2226677), "Gelfand–Mazur theorem": a complete

-- algebra-equivalent to the complex numbers. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Equiv

  dist_eq _ _ := rfl
  norm_mul := Complex.norm_mul

namespace Q2226677

variable {A : Type*} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] [CompleteSpace A]

/-- The Gelfand–Mazur algebra equivalence for a complete complex normed ring. -/
noncomputable def algEquivComplexOfComplete_statement

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226677
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2226677), "Gelfand-Mazur theorem": the natural
  complex algebra map into a complete normed complex algebra in which every
  nonzero element is a unit is an algebra equivalence. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2226677_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q2226677_czero : q2226677_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q2226677_cone : q2226677_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q2226677_cadd
    (z w : q2226677_complex) : q2226677_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q2226677_cmul
    (z w : q2226677_complex) : q2226677_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q2226677_cmodulus
    (z : q2226677_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Record q2226677_normed_complex_algebra (A : Type) : Type := {
  q2226677_zero : A;
  q2226677_one : A;
  q2226677_add : A -> A -> A;
  q2226677_mul : A -> A -> A;
  q2226677_neg : A -> A;
  q2226677_algebra_map : q2226677_complex -> A;
  q2226677_norm : A -> R;

  q2226677_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2226677_add x (q2226677_add y z) =
      q2226677_add (q2226677_add x y) z;
  q2226677_add_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q2226677_add x y = q2226677_add y x;
  q2226677_add_zero :
    forall x : A,
      q2226677_add x q2226677_zero = x;
  q2226677_add_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q2226677_add x (q2226677_neg x) = q2226677_zero;

  q2226677_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2226677_mul x (q2226677_mul y z) =
      q2226677_mul (q2226677_mul x y) z;
  q2226677_mul_one_left :
    forall x : A,
      q2226677_mul q2226677_one x = x;
  q2226677_mul_one_right :
    forall x : A,
      q2226677_mul x q2226677_one = x;
  q2226677_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2226677_mul x (q2226677_add y z) =
      q2226677_add
        (q2226677_mul x y) (q2226677_mul x z);
  q2226677_right_distrib :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2226677_mul (q2226677_add x y) z =
      q2226677_add
        (q2226677_mul x z) (q2226677_mul y z);

  q2226677_algebra_map_zero :
    q2226677_algebra_map q2226677_czero = q2226677_zero;
  q2226677_algebra_map_one :
    q2226677_algebra_map q2226677_cone = q2226677_one;
  q2226677_algebra_map_add :
    forall z w : q2226677_complex,
      q2226677_algebra_map (q2226677_cadd z w) =
      q2226677_add
        (q2226677_algebra_map z) (q2226677_algebra_map w);
  q2226677_algebra_map_mul :
    forall z w : q2226677_complex,
      q2226677_algebra_map (q2226677_cmul z w) =
      q2226677_mul
        (q2226677_algebra_map z) (q2226677_algebra_map w);
  q2226677_algebra_map_central :
    forall (z : q2226677_complex) (x : A),
      q2226677_mul (q2226677_algebra_map z) x =
      q2226677_mul x (q2226677_algebra_map z);

  q2226677_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : A,
      0 <= q2226677_norm x;
  q2226677_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : A,
      q2226677_norm x = 0 <-> x = q2226677_zero;
  q2226677_norm_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q2226677_norm (q2226677_neg x) = q2226677_norm x;
  q2226677_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : A,
      q2226677_norm (q2226677_add x y) <=
      q2226677_norm x + q2226677_norm y;
  q2226677_norm_mul_le :
    forall x y : A,
      q2226677_norm (q2226677_mul x y) <=
      q2226677_norm x * q2226677_norm y;
  q2226677_norm_smul :
    forall (z : q2226677_complex) (x : A),
      q2226677_norm
        (q2226677_mul (q2226677_algebra_map z) x) =
      q2226677_cmodulus z * q2226677_norm x
}.

Arguments q2226677_zero {A} _.
Arguments q2226677_one {A} _.
Arguments q2226677_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226677_mul {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226677_neg {A} _ _.
Arguments q2226677_algebra_map {A} _ _.
Arguments q2226677_norm {A} _ _.

Definition q2226677_sub
    {A : Type}
    (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A)
    (x y : A) : A :=
  q2226677_add B x (q2226677_neg B y).

Definition q2226677_dist
    {A : Type}
    (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A)
    (x y : A) : R :=
  q2226677_norm B (q2226677_sub B x y).

Definition q2226677_sequence_converges
    {A : Type}
    (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A)
    (u : nat -> A) (limit : A) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q2226677_dist B (u n) limit < epsilon.

Definition q2226677_sequence_cauchy
    {A : Type}
    (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A)
    (u : nat -> A) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q2226677_dist B (u m) (u n) < epsilon.

Definition q2226677_complete
    {A : Type}
    (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> A,
    q2226677_sequence_cauchy B u ->
    exists limit : A,
      q2226677_sequence_converges B u limit.

Definition q2226677_is_unit
    {A : Type}
    (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A)
    (x : A) : Prop :=
  exists inverse : A,
    q2226677_mul B x inverse = q2226677_one B /\
    q2226677_mul B inverse x = q2226677_one B.

Theorem NormedRing_algEquivComplexOfComplete :
  forall (A : Type)
         (B : q2226677_normed_complex_algebra A),
    q2226677_complete B ->
    (forall a : A,
      q2226677_is_unit B a <-> a <> q2226677_zero B) ->
    exists inverse : A -> q2226677_complex,
      (forall z : q2226677_complex,
        inverse (q2226677_algebra_map B z) = z) /\
      (forall a : A,
        q2226677_algebra_map B (inverse a) = a).
Admitted.

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q2226677 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2226677), "Gelfand–Mazur theorem":
  the natural embedding of the complex numbers into a complete complex normed
  algebra in which precisely the nonzero elements are units is a complex
  algebra equivalence. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q2226677_normed_ring ::
    "'a::{ring_1,real_normed_vector} itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2226677_normed_ring _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y :: 'a. norm (x * y) \<le> norm x * norm y)"

definition q2226677_complex_normed_algebra ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'a::{ring_1,real_normed_vector} \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2226677_complex_normed_algebra scaleC \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. scaleC 0 x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scaleC 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>z x y. scaleC z (x + y) = scaleC z x + scaleC z y) \<and>
    (\<forall>z w x. scaleC (z + w) x = scaleC z x + scaleC w x) \<and>
    (\<forall>z w x. scaleC (z * w) x = scaleC z (scaleC w x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>z x y. scaleC z (x * y) = scaleC z x * y) \<and>
    (\<forall>z x y. scaleC z (x * y) = x * scaleC z y) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. scaleC (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>z x. norm (scaleC z x) \<le> norm z * norm x)"

definition q2226677_complex_alg_equiv ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'a::{ring_1,real_normed_vector} \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> complex) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2226677_complex_alg_equiv scaleC f g \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z. f z = scaleC z 1) \<and>
    f 0 = 0 \<and>
    f 1 = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>z w. f (z + w) = f z + f w) \<and>
    (\<forall>z w. f (z * w) = f z * f w) \<and>
    (\<forall>c z. f (c * z) = scaleC c (f z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>z. g (f z) = z) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. f (g x) = x)"

theorem gelfand_mazur_theorem:
  fixes scaleC ::
    "complex \<Rightarrow> 'a::{ring_1,real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes normed_ring: "q2226677_normed_ring TYPE('a)"
    and complex_algebra: "q2226677_complex_normed_algebra scaleC"
    and division:
      "\<forall>a :: 'a. (\<exists>b. a * b = 1 \<and> b * a = 1) \<longleftrightarrow> a \<noteq> 0"
  shows "\<exists>f :: complex \<Rightarrow> 'a. \<exists>g :: 'a \<Rightarrow> complex.
    q2226677_complex_alg_equiv scaleC f g"
  sorry

end

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226677,
  "Gelfand–Mazur theorem": the canonical complex scalar embedding into a
  complete complex normed division algebra is an algebra isomorphism. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let q2226677_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q2226677_formatter =
  Format.formatter_of_out_channel q2226677_output;;
let q2226677_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q2226677_formatter path);;
let q2226677_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q2226677_formatter "Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q2226677_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q2226677_formatter ();;
close_out q2226677_output;;
if not q2226677_loaded then failwith "Unable to load complex library";;

let Q2226677_GELFAND_MAZUR_THEOREM =
 `let normed_ring =
    \(zero:A) (oneA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
     (neg:A->A) (normA:A->real).
       (!x y z:A. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x y z:A. mul x (mul y z) = mul (mul x y) z) /\
       (!x:A. mul oneA x = x /\ mul x oneA = x) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mul (add x y) z = add (mul x z) (mul y z)) /\
       normA zero = &0 /\
       (!x:A. &0 <= normA x) /\
       (!x:A. normA x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. normA (neg x) = normA x) /\
       (!x y:A. normA (add x y) <= normA x + normA y) /\
       (!x y:A. normA (mul x y) <= normA x * normA y) in
  let complex_normed_algebra =
    \(zero:A) (oneA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
     (normA:A->real) (algebra_map:complex->A).
       algebra_map (Cx(&0)) = zero /\
       algebra_map (Cx(&1)) = oneA /\
       (!z w:complex.
          algebra_map (z + w) = add (algebra_map z) (algebra_map w)) /\
       (!z w:complex.
          algebra_map (z * w) = mul (algebra_map z) (algebra_map w)) /\
       (!z:complex. !x:A.
          mul (algebra_map z) x = mul x (algebra_map z)) /\
       (!z:complex. !x:A.
          normA (mul (algebra_map z) x) <= norm z * normA x) in
  let tends_to =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (normA:A->real)
     (u:num->A) (x:A).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
               N <= n
               ==> normA (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon in
  let complete_space =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (normA:A->real).
       !u:num->A.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                  N <= m /\ N <= n
                  ==> normA (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?x:A. tends_to add neg normA u x in
  let is_unit =
    \(oneA:A) (mul:A->A->A) (x:A).
       ?y:A. mul x y = oneA /\ mul y x = oneA in
  !zero oneA:A.

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226677,
;; "Gelfand–Mazur theorem": a complete complex normed ring whose nonzero
;; elements are exactly its units is algebra-equivalent to the complex
;; numbers through the natural scalar map. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary real, complex, and algebra
;; carriers. A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers;
;; real/imaginary coordinates and the Euclidean norm present the complex
;; numbers. All ring, normed-algebra, completeness, unit, and typing laws
;; used by the source declaration are explicit in the statement predicate.

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

     (let* ((zero (q2226677-r-zero real))

            (xy-add (q2226677-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q2226677-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q2226677-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q2226677-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q2226677-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q2226677-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q2226677-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q2226677-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q2226677-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q2226677-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q2226677-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q2226677-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q2226677-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q2226677-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q2226677-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q2226677-r-multiply real xy-mul z)

        (equal (q2226677-r-multiply real x one) x)

          one))
        (equal

          real x (q2226677-r-add real y z))
         (q2226677-r-add
          real
          (q2226677-r-multiply real x y)

(defun-sk q2226677-r-order-laws-p (real)

     (and

      (q2226677-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q2226677-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q2226677-r-less real x x))

        (implies
         (and
          (q2226677-r-less real x y)
          (q2226677-r-less real y z))
         (q2226677-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q2226677-r-less real x y)
         (q2226677-r-less
          real
          (q2226677-r-add real x z)
          (q2226677-r-add real y z)))
        (implies

          (q2226677-r-less real zero x)
          (q2226677-r-less real zero y))

          (q2226677-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q2226677-a-unit-p (algebra element)

     (equal

      (q2226677-c-member-p complex right)

   (q2226677-algebra-map-injective-p complex algebra)
   (q2226677-algebra-map-surjective-p complex algebra)))

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226677,
-- "Gelfand–Mazur theorem": the canonical scalar map from the complex numbers
-- to a complete complex normed ring whose nonzero elements are exactly its
-- units is an algebra equivalence. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<successor : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  successor<successor :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <N n ->
    suc m <N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) :
  Set1 where

  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set2 where

  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

oneC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
oneC reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

record ComplexNorm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    normC : Complex R -> R
    norm-nonnegativeC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normC z)
    norm-zeroC :
      normC (zeroC reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC z == zeroR reals ->
      z == zeroC reals
    norm-negateC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC (negateC reals z) == normC z
    norm-addC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normC (addC reals z w))
        (addR reals (normC z) (normC w))
    norm-multiplyC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      normC (multiplyC reals z w) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC w)
    norm-squareC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexNorm

record NormedRing
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    zeroA oneA : A
    addA multiplyA : A -> A -> A
    negateA : A -> A
    normA : A -> R

    add-commutativeA :
      (x y : A) ->
      addA x y == addA y x
    add-associativeA :
      (x y z : A) ->
      addA (addA x y) z == addA x (addA y z)
    add-zeroA :
      (x : A) ->
      addA x zeroA == x
    add-inverseA :
      (x : A) ->
      addA x (negateA x) == zeroA

    multiply-associativeA :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyA (multiplyA x y) z ==
      multiplyA x (multiplyA y z)
    multiply-one-leftA :
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyA oneA x == x
    multiply-one-rightA :
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyA x oneA == x
    distribute-leftA :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyA x (addA y z) ==
      addA (multiplyA x y) (multiplyA x z)
    distribute-rightA :
      (x y z : A) ->
      multiplyA (addA x y) z ==
      addA (multiplyA x z) (multiplyA y z)

    norm-nonnegativeA :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normA x)
    norm-zeroA :
      normA zeroA == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyA :
      (x : A) ->
      normA x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroA
    norm-negateA :
      (x : A) ->
      normA (negateA x) == normA x
    norm-addA :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normA (addA x y))
        (addR reals (normA x) (normA y))
    norm-multiplyA :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normA (multiplyA x y))
        (multiplyR reals (normA x) (normA y))

open NormedRing

subtractA :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRing reals A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
subtractA ring x y =
  addA ring x (negateA ring y)

distanceA :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRing reals A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  R
distanceA ring x y =
  normA ring (subtractA ring x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRing reals A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  A ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} ring sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <N suc n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceA ring (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRing reals A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} ring sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <N suc m ->
      cutoff <N suc n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceA ring (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Complete :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRing reals A ->
  Set a
Complete {A = A} ring =
  (sequence : Nat -> A) ->
  CauchySequence ring sequence ->
  Exists A (\ limit -> SequentialLimit ring sequence limit)

record NormedComplexAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {A : Set a}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals)
  (ring : NormedRing reals A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    scalarMap : Complex R -> A
    map-zero :
      scalarMap (zeroC reals) == zeroA ring
    map-one :
      scalarMap (oneC reals) == oneA ring
    map-add :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      scalarMap (addC reals z w) ==
      addA ring (scalarMap z) (scalarMap w)
    map-multiply :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      scalarMap (multiplyC reals z w) ==
      multiplyA ring (scalarMap z) (scalarMap w)
    scalar-central :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      (x : A) ->
      multiplyA ring (scalarMap z) x ==
      multiplyA ring x (scalarMap z)
    norm-scalar-multiply :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normA ring (multiplyA ring (scalarMap z) x))
        (multiplyR reals (normC complexNorm z) (normA ring x))

open NormedComplexAlgebra

IsUnit :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedRing reals A ->
  A ->
  Set a
IsUnit {A = A} ring x =
  Σ A
    (\ inverse ->
      Both
        (multiplyA ring x inverse == oneA ring)
        (multiplyA ring inverse x == oneA ring))

record AlgebraEquivalenceViaScalarMap
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {A : Set a}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals}
  {ring : NormedRing reals A}
  (algebra : NormedComplexAlgebra reals complexNorm ring) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    inverse : A -> Complex R
    inverse-after-scalar-map :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      inverse (scalarMap algebra z) == z
    scalar-map-after-inverse :
      (x : A) ->
      scalarMap algebra (inverse x) == x

gelfand-mazur-theorem :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc lzero) ⊔ lsuc a)
gelfand-mazur-theorem a =
  (R : Set) ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (ring : NormedRing reals A) ->
  (algebra : NormedComplexAlgebra reals complexNorm ring) ->
  Complete ring ->
  ((a : A) -> Iff (IsUnit ring a) (a != zeroA ring)) ->
  AlgebraEquivalenceViaScalarMap algebra

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2226677, "Gelfand–Mazur theorem": the scalar embedding of the complex
  numbers into a complete complex normed division algebra is an algebra
  isomorphism. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val q2226677_normed_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q2226677_normed_ring_def",
  ``q2226677_normed_ring
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneA x = x) /\
      (!x. mul x oneA = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      (!x y z. mul (add x y) z = add (mul x z) (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!x y. norm (mul x y) <= norm x * norm y)``);

val q2226677_complex_normed_algebra_def = new_definition (
  "q2226677_complex_normed_algebra_def",
  ``q2226677_complex_normed_algebra
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (norm : 'a -> real)
      (algebraMap : complex -> 'a) <=>
      algebraMap 0 = zero /\
      algebraMap 1 = oneA /\
      (!z w. algebraMap (z + w) = add (algebraMap z) (algebraMap w)) /\
      (!z w. algebraMap (z * w) = mul (algebraMap z) (algebraMap w)) /\
      (!z. algebraMap (-z) = neg (algebraMap z)) /\
      (!z x. mul (algebraMap z) x = mul x (algebraMap z)) /\
      (!z x. norm (mul (algebraMap z) x) <= modu z * norm x)``);

val q2226677_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q2226677_tendsto_def",
  ``q2226677_tendsto
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg x)) < epsilon``);

val q2226677_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q2226677_cauchy_def",
  ``q2226677_cauchy
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q2226677_complete_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2226677_complete_space_def",
  ``q2226677_complete_space
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q2226677_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?x : 'a. q2226677_tendsto add neg norm u x``);

val q2226677_is_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q2226677_is_unit_def",
  ``q2226677_is_unit
      (oneA : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (a : 'a) <=>
      ?b : 'a. mul a b = oneA /\ mul b a = oneA``);

val NormedRing_algEquivComplexOfComplete =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (norm : 'a -> real)
      (algebraMap : complex -> 'a).
      q2226677_normed_ring zero oneA add mul neg norm /\
      q2226677_complex_normed_algebra
        zero oneA add mul neg norm algebraMap /\
      q2226677_complete_space add neg norm /\
      (!a : 'a.
        q2226677_is_unit oneA mul a <=> a <> zero)
      ==>
      ?inverse : 'a -> complex.
        (!z : complex. inverse (algebraMap z) = z) /\
        (!a : 'a. algebraMap (inverse a) = a)``;

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226677
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2226677), "Gelfand-Mazur theorem": a complete
  complex normed algebra in which the units are exactly the nonzero elements
  is algebra-equivalent to the complex numbers. The conclusion uses the
  equivalent target-native statement that the canonical complex scalar map is
  a bijection. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's native NrmRing requires a multiplicative norm, which is stronger
  than Lean's NormedRing. Q2226677NormedRing instead combines the ring and
  normed-additive-group structures with precisely the source inequality
  norm(x * y) <= norm(x) * norm(y); no normalization of norm(1) is assumed.

  Membership in NrmMod and AssAlg supplies the compatible complex normed
  module and associative-algebra structures, while CMetSp supplies
  completeness. Since algSc is the canonical algebra homomorphism, its being

title: Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q2226677
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q2226677), "Gelfand-Mazur theorem": the canonical
% complex scalar map into a complete complex normed ring whose nonzero
% elements are exactly its units is an algebra equivalence. This file
% contains no proof.

Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem[
  A: TYPE+,
  zero_A, one_A: A,
  neg_A: [A -> A],
  add_A, mul_A: [A, A -> A],
  norm_A: [A -> real],
  algebra_map: [[# real_part: real, imag_part: real #] -> A]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  a_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> A]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_neg(z: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(z),
       imag_part := -imag_part(z) #)

  complex_add(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(z) + real_part(w),
       imag_part := imag_part(z) + imag_part(w) #)

  complex_mul(z, w: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(z) * real_part(w)
           - imag_part(z) * imag_part(w),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(z) * imag_part(w)
           + imag_part(z) * real_part(w) #)

  complex_norm_squared(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  sub_A(x, y: A): A =
    add_A(x, neg_A(y))

  ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      add_A(x, y) = add_A(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        add_A(add_A(x, y), z) =
          add_A(x, add_A(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        add_A(zero_A, x) = x
          AND add_A(x, zero_A) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        add_A(neg_A(x), x) = zero_A
          AND add_A(x, neg_A(x)) = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        mul_A(mul_A(x, y), z) =
          mul_A(x, mul_A(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        mul_A(one_A, x) = x
          AND mul_A(x, one_A) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        mul_A(x, add_A(y, z)) =
          add_A(mul_A(x, y), mul_A(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        mul_A(add_A(x, y), z) =
          add_A(mul_A(x, z), mul_A(y, z)))

  algebra_map_laws: bool =
    algebra_map(complex_zero) = zero_A
      AND algebra_map(complex_one) = one_A
      AND (FORALL (z: complex):
        algebra_map(complex_neg(z)) =
          neg_A(algebra_map(z)))
      AND (FORALL (z, w: complex):
        algebra_map(complex_add(z, w)) =
          add_A(algebra_map(z), algebra_map(w)))
      AND (FORALL (z, w: complex):
        algebra_map(complex_mul(z, w)) =
          mul_A(algebra_map(z), algebra_map(w)))
      AND (FORALL (z: complex), (x: A):
        mul_A(algebra_map(z), x) =
          mul_A(x, algebra_map(z)))

  normed_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      0 <= norm_A(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        norm_A(x) = 0 IFF x = zero_A)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        norm_A(neg_A(x)) = norm_A(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        norm_A(add_A(x, y)) <=
          norm_A(x) + norm_A(y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        norm_A(mul_A(x, y)) <=
          norm_A(x) * norm_A(y))

  normed_complex_algebra_laws: bool =
    FORALL (z: complex), (x: A):
      norm_A(mul_A(algebra_map(z), x)) ^ 2 <=
        complex_norm_squared(z) * norm_A(x) ^ 2

  converges(values: a_sequence, limit: A): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            norm_A(sub_A(values(index), limit)) <
              epsilon_value

  cauchy(values: a_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index
            AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            norm_A(
              sub_A(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index))) <
              epsilon_value

  complete_space: bool =
    FORALL (values: a_sequence):
      cauchy(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: A):
          converges(values, limit)

  is_unit(x: A): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: A):
      mul_A(x, inverse) = one_A
        AND mul_A(inverse, x) = one_A

  division_algebra_condition: bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      is_unit(x) IFF x /= zero_A

  complex_banach_division_algebra: bool =
    ring_laws
      AND algebra_map_laws
      AND normed_ring_laws
      AND normed_complex_algebra_laws
      AND complete_space
      AND division_algebra_condition

  canonical_map_is_algebra_equivalence(
      inverse_map: [A -> complex]): bool =
    (FORALL (z: complex):
      inverse_map(algebra_map(z)) = z)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        algebra_map(inverse_map(x)) = x)
      AND algebra_map_laws

  gelfand_mazur_theorem: bool =
    complex_banach_division_algebra IMPLIES
      EXISTS (inverse_map: [A -> complex]):
        canonical_map_is_algebra_equivalence(inverse_map)
END Q2226677_gelfand_mazur_theorem

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q2226786, "Sperner's theorem": every finite
;; antichain of subsets of a finite set has cardinality at most the middle
;; binomial coefficient. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Duplicate-free true lists enumerate finite types and their finite subsets.
;; Extensional equality below makes the representation independent of list
;; order. Thus the valid families represent exactly Finset (Finset alpha).

(defun q2226786-carrier-p (carrier)
  (and (true-listp carrier)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal carrier)))

(defun q2226786-subset-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and (member-equal (car left) right)
           (q2226786-subset-p (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun q2226786-finite-subset-p (set carrier)
  (and (true-listp set)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal set)
       (q2226786-subset-p set carrier)))

(defun q2226786-set-equal-p (left right)
  (and (q2226786-subset-p left right)
       (q2226786-subset-p right left)))

(defun q2226786-set-distinct-from-family-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (not (q2226786-set-equal-p set (car family)))
           (q2226786-set-distinct-from-family-p
            set (cdr family)))
    t))

(defun q2226786-family-p (family carrier)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q2226786-finite-subset-p (car family) carrier)
           (q2226786-set-distinct-from-family-p
            (car family) (cdr family))
           (q2226786-family-p (cdr family) carrier))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q2226786-incomparable-with-family-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (not (q2226786-subset-p set (car family)))
           (not (q2226786-subset-p (car family) set))
           (q2226786-incomparable-with-family-p
            set (cdr family)))
    t))

(defun q2226786-antichain-p (family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q2226786-incomparable-with-family-p
            (car family) (cdr family))
           (q2226786-antichain-p (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q2226786-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (q2226786-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) k)
       (q2226786-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q2226786-sperners-theorem-statement
    (carrier family)
  (implies
   (and (q2226786-carrier-p carrier)
        (q2226786-family-p family carrier)
        (q2226786-antichain-p family))
   (<=
    (len family)
    (q2226786-binomial-coefficient
     (len carrier)
     (floor (len carrier) 2)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226786,
-- "Sperner's theorem": an inclusion antichain of subsets of an n-element
-- finite set has at most choose n (floor (n / 2)) members. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2226786_sperner_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _<=_ _is-subset-of_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Subset A =
  A -> Bool

data IsTrue : Bool -> Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

_is-subset-of_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Set a
_is-subset-of_ {A = A} left right =
  (x : A) ->
  IsTrue (left x) ->
  IsTrue (right x)

SameSubset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Subset A ->
  Subset A ->
  Set a
SameSubset {A = A} left right =
  (x : A) ->
  left x == right x

record FiniteFamily
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> Subset A
    no-duplicates :
      (left-index right-index : Fin size) ->
      SameSubset (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

open FiniteFamily

Antichain :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  FiniteFamily A ->
  Set a
Antichain family =
  (left-index right-index : Fin (size family)) ->
  Not (left-index == right-index) ->
  Not
    (enumerate family left-index
      is-subset-of
     enumerate family right-index)

sperner-s-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
sperner-s-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Bijection A (Fin n) ->
  (family : FiniteFamily A) ->
  Antichain family ->
  size family <= choose n (half n)

    (for S,T being Subset of X st S in A & T in A & S c= T holds S = T)
  holds
    (card A qua Nat) <= n choose m
proof

title: Q2226786_sperner_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226786,
% "Sperner's theorem": an inclusion antichain of subsets of an n-element type
% has cardinality at most the middle binomial coefficient. This file contains no proof.

Q2226786_sperner_s_theorem[n: nat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  Element: TYPE = below(n)

  IMPORTING finite_sets[Element], finite_sets_of_sets[Element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[Element]
  finite_family: TYPE = finite_set[element_set]

  subset_of(A, B: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: Element): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  inclusion_antichain(family: finite_family): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: element_set):
      family(A) AND family(B) AND subset_of(A, B)
        IMPLIES A = B

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  sperner_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (family: finite_family):
      inclusion_antichain(family)
      IMPLIES
        card(family)
          <= binomial_coefficient(
            n,
            ndiv(n, 2))
END Q2226786_sperner_s_theorem

title: Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226800
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2226800), "Schur-Zassenhaus theorem": a normal
  subgroup whose order is coprime to its index has a left complement.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q2226800_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q2226800_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q2226800_one : G;
  q2226800_inv : G -> G;
  q2226800_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q2226800_mul x (q2226800_mul y z) =
      q2226800_mul (q2226800_mul x y) z;
  q2226800_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q2226800_mul q2226800_one x = x;
  q2226800_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q2226800_mul x q2226800_one = x;
  q2226800_inv_mul :
    forall x : G,
      q2226800_mul (q2226800_inv x) x = q2226800_one;
  q2226800_mul_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q2226800_mul x (q2226800_inv x) = q2226800_one
}.

Arguments q2226800_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226800_one {G} _.
Arguments q2226800_inv {G} _ _.

Record q2226800_subgroup
    {G : Type} (grp : q2226800_group G) : Type := {
  q2226800_mem : G -> Prop;
  q2226800_subgroup_one :
    q2226800_mem (q2226800_one grp);
  q2226800_subgroup_mul :
    forall x y : G,
      q2226800_mem x ->
      q2226800_mem y ->
      q2226800_mem (q2226800_mul grp x y);
  q2226800_subgroup_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q2226800_mem x ->
      q2226800_mem (q2226800_inv grp x)
}.

Arguments q2226800_mem {G grp} _ _.

Definition q2226800_normal
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall g n : G,
    q2226800_mem N n ->
    q2226800_mem N
      (q2226800_mul grp
        (q2226800_mul grp g n)
        (q2226800_inv grp g)).

Definition q2226800_has_finite_subgroup_card
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list G,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : G, In x xs <-> q2226800_mem N x) /\
    length xs = n.

Definition q2226800_nat_subgroup_card
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q2226800_has_finite_subgroup_card N n \/
  (n = 0 /\
   forall m : nat, ~ q2226800_has_finite_subgroup_card N m).

Definition q2226800_same_left_coset
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp)
    (x y : G) : Prop :=
  q2226800_mem N
    (q2226800_mul grp (q2226800_inv grp x) y).

Fixpoint q2226800_coset_reps_nodup
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp)
    (xs : list G) : Prop :=
  match xs with
  | nil => True
  | x :: rest =>
      (forall y : G,
        In y rest -> ~ q2226800_same_left_coset N x y) /\
      q2226800_coset_reps_nodup N rest
  end.

Definition q2226800_has_finite_index
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists reps : list G,
    q2226800_coset_reps_nodup N reps /\
    (forall x : G,
      exists r : G,
        In r reps /\ q2226800_same_left_coset N x r) /\
    length reps = n.

Definition q2226800_nat_index
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  q2226800_has_finite_index N n \/
  (n = 0 /\
   forall m : nat, ~ q2226800_has_finite_index N m).

Definition q2226800_order_coprime_to_index
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (N : q2226800_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  exists order index : nat,
    q2226800_nat_subgroup_card N order /\
    q2226800_nat_index N index /\
    Nat.gcd order index = 1.

Definition q2226800_is_left_complement
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q2226800_group G}
    (H N : q2226800_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall g : G,
    exists h n : G,
      q2226800_mem H h /\
      q2226800_mem N n /\
      q2226800_mul grp h n = g /\
      forall h' n' : G,
        q2226800_mem H h' ->
        q2226800_mem N n' ->
        q2226800_mul grp h' n' = g ->
        h' = h /\ n' = n.

Theorem Subgroup_exists_left_complement_of_coprime :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q2226800_group G)
         (N : q2226800_subgroup grp),
    q2226800_normal N ->
    q2226800_order_coprime_to_index N ->
    exists H : q2226800_subgroup grp,
      q2226800_is_left_complement H N.
Admitted.

title: Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226800
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2226800),
  "Schur–Zassenhaus theorem": a normal subgroup whose order is coprime to its
  index has a subgroup forming a left complement with unique factorization.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q2226800_is_subgroup :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2226800_is_subgroup H \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> H \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. -x \<in> H) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<forall>y \<in> H. x + y \<in> H)"

definition q2226800_is_normal_subgroup :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2226800_is_normal_subgroup N \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2226800_is_subgroup N \<and>
    (\<forall>g. \<forall>n \<in> N. g + n + (-g) \<in> N)"

definition q2226800_right_cosets :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q2226800_right_cosets N =
    (\<lambda>g. (\<lambda>n. n + g) ` N) ` UNIV"

definition q2226800_subgroup_index :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q2226800_subgroup_index N = card (q2226800_right_cosets N)"

definition q2226800_is_left_complement ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2226800_is_left_complement H N \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2226800_is_subgroup H \<and>
    q2226800_is_subgroup N \<and>
    bij_betw (\<lambda>(h, n). h + n) (H \<times> N) UNIV"

theorem q2226800_schur_zassenhaus:
  fixes N :: "'g::group_add set"
  assumes normal_N: "q2226800_is_normal_subgroup N"
    and coprime_order_index:
      "coprime (card N) (q2226800_subgroup_index N)"
  shows "\<exists>H :: 'g set. q2226800_is_left_complement H N"
  sorry

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226800,
;; "Schur-Zassenhaus theorem": a normal subgroup of an arbitrary group whose
;; cardinality is coprime to its index has a left complement. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic interfaces represent an arbitrary group and arbitrary
;; subgroup predicates. Every group, subgroup, normality, cardinality, and
;; complement law used by the statement is explicit below.

(defstub q2226800-carrier-member-p (group element) t)
(defstub q2226800-multiply (group left right) t)
(defstub q2226800-invert (group element) t)
(defstub q2226800-identity (group) t)
(defstub q2226800-subgroup-member-p (subgroup element) t)

(defun-sk q2226800-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2226800-carrier-member-p group x)
      (and
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p
        group
        (q2226800-invert group x))
       (equal
        (q2226800-multiply
         group
         (q2226800-identity group)
         x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q2226800-multiply
         group
         x
         (q2226800-identity group))
        x)
       (equal
        (q2226800-multiply
         group
         (q2226800-invert group x)
         x)
        (q2226800-identity group))
       (equal
        (q2226800-multiply
         group
         x
         (q2226800-invert group x))
        (q2226800-identity group))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p group x)
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p group y))
      (q2226800-carrier-member-p
       group
       (q2226800-multiply group x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p group x)
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p group y)
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p group z))
      (equal
       (q2226800-multiply
        group
        (q2226800-multiply group x y)
        z)
       (q2226800-multiply
        group
        x
        (q2226800-multiply group y z)))))))

(defun q2226800-group-p (group)
  (and
   (q2226800-carrier-member-p
    group
    (q2226800-identity group))
   (q2226800-group-laws-p group)))

(defun-sk q2226800-subgroup-laws-p (group subgroup)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup x)
      (and
       (q2226800-carrier-member-p group x)
       (q2226800-subgroup-member-p
        subgroup
        (q2226800-invert group x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup x)
       (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup y))
      (q2226800-subgroup-member-p
       subgroup
       (q2226800-multiply group x y))))))

(defun q2226800-subgroup-p (group subgroup)
  (and
   (q2226800-group-p group)
   (q2226800-subgroup-member-p
    subgroup
    (q2226800-identity group))
   (q2226800-subgroup-laws-p group subgroup)))

(defun-sk q2226800-normal-p (group subgroup)
  (forall (group-element subgroup-element)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2226800-carrier-member-p group group-element)
      (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup subgroup-element))
     (q2226800-subgroup-member-p
      subgroup
      (q2226800-multiply
       group
       (q2226800-multiply
        group
        group-element
        subgroup-element)
       (q2226800-invert group group-element))))))

;; For a subgroup, coprimality of Nat.card N and the index has exactly three
;; forms. N may be the whole group (index one), N may be trivial (cardinality
;; one), or both N and the ambient group are finite. Exact duplicate-free
;; enumerations express the finite case without restricting the arbitrary
;; carrier in the other two cases.

(defun-sk q2226800-whole-subgroup-p (group subgroup)
  (forall (element)
    (iff
     (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup element)
     (q2226800-carrier-member-p group element))))

(defun-sk q2226800-trivial-subgroup-p (group subgroup)
  (forall (element)
    (iff
     (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup element)
     (equal element (q2226800-identity group)))))

(defun-sk q2226800-exact-carrier-enumeration-p
    (group elements)
  (forall (element)
    (iff
     (if (member-equal element elements) t nil)
     (q2226800-carrier-member-p group element))))

(defun-sk q2226800-exact-subgroup-enumeration-p
    (subgroup elements)
  (forall (element)
    (iff
     (if (member-equal element elements) t nil)
     (q2226800-subgroup-member-p subgroup element))))

(defun q2226800-finite-carrier-certificate-p
    (group elements)
  (and
   (true-listp elements)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal elements)
   (q2226800-exact-carrier-enumeration-p
    group elements)))

(defun q2226800-finite-subgroup-certificate-p
    (subgroup elements)
  (and
   (true-listp elements)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal elements)
   (q2226800-exact-subgroup-enumeration-p
    subgroup elements)))

(defun q2226800-gcd (a b)
  (declare (xargs :measure (+ (nfix a) (nfix b))))
  (if (and (natp a) (natp b))
      (cond
       ((equal a 0) b)
       ((equal b 0) a)
       ((< a b)
        (q2226800-gcd a (- b a)))
       (t
        (q2226800-gcd (- a b) b)))

(defun-sk q2226800-finite-coprime-card-index-p

    (and

      group carrier-elements)

      subgroup subgroup-elements)

(defun q2226800-coprime-card-index-p
    (group subgroup)

(defun-sk q2226800-list-subgroup-laws-p
