-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2226800,
-- "Schur-Zassenhaus theorem": a normal subgroup whose order is coprime to its
-- index has a subgroup forming a left multiplicative complement. This file
-- contains no proof.

module Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _∣_
infixr 5 _×_

data ⊥ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    divides-equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

Coprime : Nat → Nat → Set
Coprime m n =
  (d : Nat) →
  d ∣ m →
  d ∣ n →
  d ≡ suc zero

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

InfiniteCard :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  Set ℓ →
  Set ℓ
InfiniteCard {ℓ} A =
  (count : Nat) →
  Bijection A (Fin count) →
  ⊥ {ℓ}

data NatCard
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Nat →
  Set ℓ where

  finite-card :
    {count : Nat} →
    Bijection A (Fin count) →
    NatCard A count

  infinite-card :
    {count : Nat} →
    count ≡ zero →
    InfiniteCard A →
    NatCard A count

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity :
      member (Group.identity structure)
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) →
      member x →
      member (Group.inverse structure x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (Group.multiply structure x y)

open SubgroupOf

SubgroupCarrier :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
SubgroupCarrier {G = G} H =
  Σ G (member H)

record Normal
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (N : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    closed-under-conjugation :
      (g n : G) →
      member N n →
      member N
        (Group.multiply structure
          (Group.multiply structure g n)
          (Group.inverse structure g))

SameLeftCoset :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
SameLeftCoset structure H x y =
  member H
    (Group.multiply structure
      (Group.inverse structure x)
      y)

record CosetTransversal
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (H : SubgroupOf structure)
  (count : Nat) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    representative :
      Fin count →
      G
    covers :
      (x : G) →
      Σ (Fin count)
        (λ i →
          SameLeftCoset structure H (representative i) x)
    unique :
      (i j : Fin count) →
      SameLeftCoset
        structure H (representative i) (representative j) →
      i ≡ j

InfiniteIndex :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
InfiniteIndex {ℓ = ℓ} structure H =
  (count : Nat) →
  CosetTransversal structure H count →
  ⊥ {ℓ}

data Index
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (H : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Nat →
  Set ℓ where

  finite-index :
    {count : Nat} →
    CosetTransversal structure H count →
    Index structure H count

  infinite-index :
    {count : Nat} →
    count ≡ zero →
    InfiniteIndex structure H →
    Index structure H count

record IsComplement'
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (H K : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    factorization :
      (g : G) →
      Σ G
        (λ h →
          member H h ×
          Σ G
            (λ k →
              member K k ×
              (Group.multiply structure h k ≡ g)))
    factorization-unique :
      (h₁ k₁ h₂ k₂ : G) →
      member H h₁ →
      member K k₁ →
      member H h₂ →
      member K k₂ →
      Group.multiply structure h₁ k₁ ≡
        Group.multiply structure h₂ k₂ →
      (h₁ ≡ h₂) × (k₁ ≡ k₂)

-- Lean: Subgroup.exists_left_complement'_of_coprime
schur-zassenhaus-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
schur-zassenhaus-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (N : SubgroupOf structure) →
  Normal structure N →
  (subgroup-order subgroup-index : Nat) →
  NatCard (SubgroupCarrier N) subgroup-order →
  Index structure N subgroup-index →
  Coprime subgroup-order subgroup-index →
  Σ (SubgroupOf structure)
    (λ H → IsComplement' structure H N)

title: Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2226800, "Schur–Zassenhaus theorem": a normal subgroup whose natural
  cardinality is coprime to its index has a subgroup complement, so every
  group element has a unique factorization with the complement factor first.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory gcdTheory groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val q2226800_nat_card_def = new_definition(
  "q2226800_nat_card_def",
  ``q2226800_nat_card (s : 'a set) =
      if FINITE s then CARD s else 0``);

val q2226800_index_def = new_definition(
  "q2226800_index_def",
  ``q2226800_index (g : 'a group) (n : 'a group) =
      q2226800_nat_card (CosetPartition g n)``);

val q2226800_is_left_complement_def = new_definition(
  "q2226800_is_left_complement_def",
  ``q2226800_is_left_complement
      (g : 'a group) (h : 'a group) (n : 'a group) <=>
      Subgroup h g /\
      Subgroup n g /\
      BIJ
        (\p. g.op (FST p) (SND p))
        (h.carrier CROSS n.carrier)
        g.carrier``);

val Subgroup_exists_left_complement_of_coprime =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (n : 'a group).
      Group g /\
      normal_subgroup n g /\
      gcd
        (q2226800_nat_card n.carrier)
        (q2226800_index g n) = 1
      ==>
      ?h : 'a group.
        q2226800_is_left_complement g h n``;

title: Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226800
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2226800), "Schur-Zassenhaus theorem": a
  normal subgroup whose order is coprime to its index has a left complement.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. Grp is an arbitrary group, N e. ( NrmSGrp ` G ) is a
  normal subgroup, and H e. ( SubGrp ` G ) is a subgroup. Lean's Nat.card
  returns zero for an infinite type, whereas SetMM's # returns +oo for an
  infinite set. Q2226800Card and Q2226800Index therefore preserve the source's
  zero-on-infinite convention for the order of N and the cardinality of its
  left-coset quotient.

  The conclusion says that every element g of G has a unique factorization
  g = h n with h in H and n in N. This is exactly the source definition of
  Subgroup.IsComplement' H N as bijectivity of multiplication H x N -> G.
  The auxiliary definitions and final corpus declaration are unproved $a
  statements; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q2226800Card Q2226800Index $.

q2226800-card-syntax $a class ( Q2226800Card N ) $.
q2226800-index-syntax $a class ( Q2226800Index G N ) $.

${
  q2226800-card-definition $a |- ( Q2226800Card N ) =
    if (
      N e. Fin
      ,
      ( # ` N )
      ,
      0
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G N $.

  q2226800-index-definition $a |- ( Q2226800Index G N ) =
    if (
      ( ( Base ` G ) /. ( G ~QG N ) ) e. Fin
      ,
      ( # ` ( ( Base ` G ) /. ( G ~QG N ) ) )
      ,
      0
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H N g h i j n $.

  thousand-theorems-q2226800-schur-zassenhaus $a |- (
    A. G A. N
      (
        (
          G e. Grp
          /\
          N e. ( NrmSGrp ` G )
          /\
          (
            ( Q2226800Card N )
            gcd
            ( Q2226800Index G N )
          )
          =
          1
        )
        ->
        E. H e. ( SubGrp ` G )
          A. g e. ( Base ` G )
            E. h e. H E. n e. N
              (
                ( h ( +g ` G ) n ) = g
                /\
                A. i e. H A. j e. N
                  (
                    ( i ( +g ` G ) j ) = g
                    ->
                    (
                      i = h
                      /\
                      j = n
                    )
                  )
              )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226800,
% "Schur-Zassenhaus theorem": a normal subgroup whose cardinality is coprime
% to its index has a subgroup giving a unique left-factor decomposition.
% This file contains no proof.

Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G,
  N: [G -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  element_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[G], finite_sets[element_set]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  is_subgroup(H: element_set): bool =
    H(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        H(x) AND H(y) IMPLIES H(mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES H(inv(x)))

  is_normal_subgroup(H: element_set): bool =
    is_subgroup(H)
      AND (FORALL (g, x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES
          H(mul(mul(g, x), inv(g))))

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: nat):
      value = divisor * factor

  nat_coprime(left, right: nat): bool =
    FORALL (divisor: nat):
      nat_divides(divisor, left)
        AND nat_divides(divisor, right)
        IMPLIES divisor = 1

  exact_finite_carrier(
      H: element_set,
      carrier: finite_set[G]): bool =
    FORALL (x: G):
      carrier(x) IFF H(x)

  subgroup_cardinality(
      H: element_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    (EXISTS (carrier: finite_set[G]):
      exact_finite_carrier(H, carrier)
        AND cardinality = card(carrier))
      OR
    (cardinality = 0
      AND NOT
        EXISTS (carrier: finite_set[G]):
          exact_finite_carrier(H, carrier))

  left_coset(g: G, H: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      EXISTS (h: G):
        H(h) AND x = mul(g, h)

  exact_left_coset_family(
      H: element_set,
      family: finite_set[element_set]): bool =
    FORALL (C: element_set):
      family(C) IFF
        EXISTS (g: G):
          C = left_coset(g, H)

  subgroup_index(
      H: element_set,
      index: nat): bool =
    (EXISTS (family: finite_set[element_set]):
      exact_left_coset_family(H, family)
        AND index = card(family))
      OR
    (index = 0
      AND NOT
        EXISTS (family: finite_set[element_set]):
          exact_left_coset_family(H, family))

  is_left_complement(H, K: element_set): bool =
    is_subgroup(H)
      AND is_subgroup(K)
      AND (FORALL (g: G):
        EXISTS (h, k: G):
          H(h)
            AND K(k)
            AND mul(h, k) = g)
      AND (FORALL (h1, k1, h2, k2: G):
        H(h1)
          AND K(k1)
          AND H(h2)
          AND K(k2)
          AND mul(h1, k1) = mul(h2, k2)
          IMPLIES h1 = h2 AND k1 = k2)

  schur_zassenhaus_theorem: bool =
    (group_laws
      AND is_normal_subgroup(N)
      AND (EXISTS (order, index: nat):
        subgroup_cardinality(N, order)
          AND subgroup_index(N, index)
          AND nat_coprime(order, index)))
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (H: element_set):
        is_left_complement(H, N)

END Q2226800_schur_zassenhaus_theorem

title: Q2226868_geometric_mean_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226868
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2226868), "Geometric mean theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the square of a right triangle's
  altitude to the hypotenuse equals the product of the two hypotenuse segments.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q2226868_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q2226868_zero : V;
  q2226868_add : V -> V -> V;
  q2226868_neg : V -> V;
  q2226868_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q2226868_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q2226868_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q2226868_add x (q2226868_add y z) =
      q2226868_add (q2226868_add x y) z;
  q2226868_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q2226868_add x y = q2226868_add y x;
  q2226868_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q2226868_add x q2226868_zero = x;
  q2226868_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q2226868_add x (q2226868_neg x) = q2226868_zero;

  q2226868_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q2226868_smul 1 x = x;
  q2226868_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q2226868_smul (a * b) x =
      q2226868_smul a (q2226868_smul b x);
  q2226868_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q2226868_smul a (q2226868_add x y) =
      q2226868_add (q2226868_smul a x) (q2226868_smul a y);
  q2226868_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q2226868_smul (a + b) x =
      q2226868_add (q2226868_smul a x) (q2226868_smul b x);

  q2226868_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q2226868_inner (q2226868_add x y) z =
      q2226868_inner x z + q2226868_inner y z;
  q2226868_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q2226868_inner (q2226868_smul a x) y =
      a * q2226868_inner x y;
  q2226868_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q2226868_inner x y = q2226868_inner y x;
  q2226868_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q2226868_inner x x;
  q2226868_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q2226868_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q2226868_zero
}.

Arguments q2226868_zero {V} _.
Arguments q2226868_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226868_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q2226868_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226868_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q2226868_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q2226868_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q2226868_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q2226868_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q2226868_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q2226868_vadd (q2226868_zero E) p = p;
  q2226868_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q2226868_vadd (q2226868_add E x y) p =
      q2226868_vadd x (q2226868_vadd y p);
  q2226868_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q2226868_vsub (q2226868_vadd x p) p = x;
  q2226868_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q2226868_vadd (q2226868_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q2226868_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q2226868_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q2226868_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q2226868_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q2226868_inner E x x).

Definition q2226868_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2226868_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2226868_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q2226868_norm E (q2226868_vsub A p q).

Definition q2226868_angle
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2226868_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2226868_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p1 p2 p3 : P) : R :=
  let x := q2226868_vsub A p1 p2 in
  let y := q2226868_vsub A p3 p2 in
  acos
    (q2226868_inner E x y /
      (q2226868_norm E x * q2226868_norm E y)).

Definition q2226868_strictly_between
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2226868_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2226868_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p1 p4 p3 : P) : Prop :=
  (exists t : R,
    0 <= t /\
    t <= 1 /\
    p4 =
      q2226868_vadd A
        (q2226868_smul E t (q2226868_vsub A p3 p1)) p1) /\
  p4 <> p1 /\
  p4 <> p3.

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_dist_sq_eq_dist_mul_dist_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q2226868_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q2226868_affine_torsor V P E)
         (p1 p2 p3 p4 : P),
    q2226868_strictly_between A p1 p4 p3 ->
    q2226868_angle A p1 p4 p2 = PI / 2 ->
    q2226868_angle A p1 p2 p3 = PI / 2 ->
    q2226868_dist A p2 p4 * q2226868_dist A p2 p4 =
      q2226868_dist A p1 p4 * q2226868_dist A p3 p4.
Admitted.

let Q2226868_GEOMETRIC_MEAN_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!p:P. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:V. !p:P.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!v:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (p:P) (q:P).
       norm inner (vsub p q) in
  let point_angle =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p1:P) (p2:P) (p3:P).
       acs (inner (vsub p1 p2) (vsub p3 p2) /
            (norm inner (vsub p1 p2) *
             norm inner (vsub p3 p2))) in
  let strictly_between =
    \(smul:real->V->V) (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p1:P) (p4:P) (p3:P).
       (?t:real.
          &0 <= t /\
          t <= &1 /\
          p4 = vadd (smul t (vsub p3 p1)) p1) /\
       ~(p4 = p1) /\
       ~(p4 = p3) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !p1 p2 p3 p4:P.

    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    strictly_between smul vadd vsub p1 p4 p3 /\
    point_angle inner vsub p1 p4 p2 = pi / &2 /\
    point_angle inner vsub p1 p2 p3 = pi / &2
    ==>
    distance inner vsub p2 p4 pow 2 =
    distance inner vsub p1 p4 * distance inner vsub p3 p4`;;

(defun-sk q2226868-strictly-between-p

      (q2226868-context-p real vector-space point-space)

      (q2226868-strictly-between-p

      (q2226868-right-angle-p
       real vector-space point-space p1 p4 p2)
      (q2226868-right-angle-p

      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and oneR != zeroR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (squareRootR x)
    square-root-squareR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      multiplyR (squareRootR x) (squareRootR x) == x
    square-root-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      squareRootR x == zeroR
    square-root-uniqueR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      multiplyR y y == x ->
      y == squareRootR x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {reals = reals} {space = space} affine p q =
  squareRootR reals
    (inner space (vsub affine p q) (vsub affine p q))

RightAngleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
RightAngleAt reals space affine a vertex c =
  inner space
    (vsub affine a vertex)
    (vsub affine c vertex)
  ==
  zeroR reals

StrictBetween :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
StrictBetween reals space affine endpoint1 middle endpoint2 =
  endpoint1 != endpoint2
  and
  Exists _
    (\ t ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      (StrictLess reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      middle ==
        vadd affine
          (scaleV space t (vsub affine endpoint2 endpoint1))
          endpoint1))

geometric-mean-theorem : Set1
geometric-mean-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (p1 p2 p3 p4 : P) ->
  StrictBetween reals space affine p1 p4 p3 ->
  RightAngleAt reals space affine p1 p4 p2 ->
  RightAngleAt reals space affine p1 p2 p3 ->
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine p2 p4)
    (distance affine p2 p4)
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine p1 p4)
    (distance affine p3 p4)

title: Q2226868_geometric_mean_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2226868 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q2226868), "Geometric mean theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the squared altitude of
  a right triangle equals the product of the two hypotenuse-segment lengths.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q2226868_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2226868_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q2226868_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q2226868_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q2226868_norm_def",
  ``q2226868_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q2226868_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q2226868_dist_def",
  ``q2226868_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p : 'p)
      (q : 'p) =
      q2226868_norm inner (vsub p q)``);

val q2226868_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q2226868_angle_def",
  ``q2226868_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p : 'p)
      (q : 'p)
      (r : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub p q) (vsub r q) /
          (q2226868_norm inner (vsub p q) *
           q2226868_norm inner (vsub r q)))``);

val q2226868_strictly_between_def = new_definition (
  "q2226868_strictly_between_def",
  ``q2226868_strictly_between
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p1 : 'p)
      (p4 : 'p)
      (p3 : 'p) <=>
      p1 <> p3 /\
      ?t : real.
        0 < t /\ t < 1 /\
        p4 = vadd (smul t (vsub p3 p1)) p1``);

val geometric_mean_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p1 p2 p3 p4 : 'p).
      q2226868_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q2226868_strictly_between smul vadd vsub p1 p4 p3 /\
      q2226868_angle inner vsub p1 p4 p2 = pi / 2 /\
      q2226868_angle inner vsub p1 p2 p3 = pi / 2
      ==>
      q2226868_dist inner vsub p2 p4 pow 2 =
        q2226868_dist inner vsub p1 p4 *
          q2226868_dist inner vsub p3 p4``;

title: Q2226868_geometric_mean_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226868
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2226868), "Geometric mean theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, if a point lies strictly between
  the endpoints of a right triangle's hypotenuse and is the foot of the
  perpendicular from the right-angle vertex, then the squared altitude equals
  the product of the two hypotenuse segments. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces represented by SetMM
  CPreHil structures whose scalar field is RRfld. Choosing any point as an
  affine origin identifies the source normed affine torsor with this vector
  presentation while preserving affine combinations, distances, and angles.

  W Q2226868Ray A B is the vector from B to A, and W Q2226868Dist A B is its
  norm. W Q2226868Angle A B C is the source's total unoriented angle at B: it
  is pi/2 when either ray is zero and otherwise is the arccosine of the
  normalized real inner product.

  W Q2226868StrictBetween A B C says that B is distinct from both endpoints
  and is the affine combination (1-t)A+tC for a real t strictly between zero
  and one. Thus it exactly renders Sbtw RR A B C, including its endpoint
  strictness conditions.

  In the final assertion A, B, C, D correspond respectively to the source
  points p1, p2, p3, p4. Its three hypotheses and distance-product conclusion
  reproduce the complete proposition of the canonical Mathlib declaration.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit faithful
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  Q2226868Ray Q2226868Dist Q2226868Angle Q2226868StrictBetween
$.

q2226868-ray-syntax
  $a class ( W Q2226868Ray A B ) $.
q2226868-distance-syntax
  $a class ( W Q2226868Dist A B ) $.
q2226868-angle-syntax
  $a class ( W Q2226868Angle A B C ) $.
q2226868-strict-between-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q2226868StrictBetween A B C ) $.

q2226868-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q2226868Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q2226868-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q2226868Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q2226868Ray A B )
) $.

q2226868-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q2226868Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q2226868Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q2226868Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q2226868Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q2226868Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q2226868Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q2226868Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C W t $.

  q2226868-strict-between-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q2226868StrictBetween A B C )
    <->
    (
      ( B =/= A /\ B =/= C )
      /\
      E. t e. ( 0 (,) 1 )
        B
        =
        (
          ( ( 1 - t ) ( .s ` W ) A )
          ( +g ` W )
          ( t ( .s ` W ) C )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D W $.

  thousand-theorems-q2226868-geometric-mean-theorem $a |- A. W
    (
      (
        W e. CPreHil
        /\
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
      )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            A. D e. ( Base ` W )
              (
                (
                  ( W Q2226868StrictBetween A D C )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( W Q2226868Angle A D B ) = ( _pi / 2 )
                    /\
                    ( W Q2226868Angle A B C ) = ( _pi / 2 )
                  )
                )
                ->
                (
                  ( ( W Q2226868Dist B D ) ^ 2 )
                  =
                  (
                    ( W Q2226868Dist A D )
                    x.
                    ( W Q2226868Dist C D )
                  )
                )
              )
    )
  $.
$}

title: Q2226868_geometric_mean_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2226868
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q2226868), "Geometric mean theorem": in a real
% inner-product affine space, the altitude to a right triangle's hypotenuse has
% squared length equal to the product of the two hypotenuse segments. This file
% contains no proof.

Q2226868_geometric_mean_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V],
  distance: [P, P -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  distance_laws: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: P):
      0 <= distance(p, q)
        AND distance(p, q) ^ 2 =
          inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws
      AND inner_product_laws
      AND affine_torsor_laws
      AND distance_laws

  strictly_between(p1, p4, p3: P): bool =
    p4 /= p1
      AND p4 /= p3
      AND EXISTS (t: real):
        0 <= t
          AND t <= 1
          AND p4 =
            point_vadd(scale(t, vsub(p3, p1)), p1)

  right_angle(p1, vertex, p3: P): bool =
    inner(vsub(p1, vertex), vsub(p3, vertex)) = 0

  geometric_mean_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (p1, p2, p3, p4: P):
        (strictly_between(p1, p4, p3)
          AND right_angle(p1, p4, p2)
          AND right_angle(p1, p2, p3))
        IMPLIES
          distance(p2, p4) ^ 2 =
            distance(p1, p4) * distance(p3, p4)
END Q2226868_geometric_mean_theorem

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2253746
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2253746), "Bertrand's ballot theorem": when one
-- candidate receives more votes than another, the probability that the leading
-- candidate stays strictly ahead throughout the count is their vote-count difference
-- divided by the total number of votes. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Probability.UniformOn

@[expose] public section

open Set ProbabilityTheory MeasureTheory

open scoped ENNReal

namespace Q2253746

/-- Lists whose every nonempty suffix has positive integer sum. -/
def staysPositive : Set (List ℤ) :=
  {l | ∀ l₂, l₂ ≠ [] → l₂ <:+ l → 0 < l₂.sum}

/-- Vote lists with exactly `p` entries equal to `1` and `q` entries equal to `-1`. -/
def countedSequence (p q : ℕ) : Set (List ℤ) :=
  {l | l.count 1 = p ∧ l.count (-1) = q ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x = (1 : ℤ) ∨ x = -1}

/-- Bertrand's ballot theorem for uniformly distributed vote-counting sequences. -/
theorem ballot_problem :
    letI : MeasurableSpace (List ℤ) := ⊤
    ∀ q p, q < p →

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2253746
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2253746), "Bertrand's ballot theorem":
  among vote sequences with p votes for one candidate and q < p for the
  other, the uniform probability of a strictly positive running lead is
  (p - q) / (p + q). This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List ZArith Reals Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.

Fixpoint q2253746_sum (l : list Z) : Z :=
  match l with
  | [] => 0%Z
  | x :: xs => (x + q2253746_sum xs)%Z
  end.

Fixpoint q2253746_nonempty_suffixes
    (l : list Z) : list (list Z) :=
  match l with
  | [] => []
  | _ :: xs => l :: q2253746_nonempty_suffixes xs
  end.

Definition q2253746_stays_positiveb (l : list Z) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun suffix => Z.ltb 0%Z (q2253746_sum suffix))
    (q2253746_nonempty_suffixes l).

Definition q2253746_stays_positive (l : list Z) : Prop :=
  q2253746_stays_positiveb l = true.

Fixpoint q2253746_vote_sequences (n : nat) : list (list Z) :=
  match n with
  | O => [[]]
  | S k =>
      map (cons 1%Z) (q2253746_vote_sequences k) ++
      map (cons (-1)%Z) (q2253746_vote_sequences k)
  end.

Definition q2253746_counted_sequenceb
    (p q : nat) (l : list Z) : bool :=
  andb
    (Nat.eqb (count_occ Z.eq_dec l 1%Z) p)
    (andb
      (Nat.eqb (count_occ Z.eq_dec l (-1)%Z) q)
      (forallb
        (fun x => orb (Z.eqb x 1%Z) (Z.eqb x (-1)%Z))
        l)).

Definition q2253746_counted_sequence
    (p q : nat) (l : list Z) : Prop :=
  q2253746_counted_sequenceb p q l = true.

Definition q2253746_counted_sequences
    (p q : nat) : list (list Z) :=
  filter
    (q2253746_counted_sequenceb p q)
    (q2253746_vote_sequences (p + q)).

Definition q2253746_uniform_probability
    (p q : nat) : R :=
  (INR
      (length
        (filter
          q2253746_stays_positiveb
          (q2253746_counted_sequences p q))) /
    INR (length (q2253746_counted_sequences p q)))%R.

Theorem ballot_problem :
  forall q p : nat,
    (q < p)%nat ->
    q2253746_uniform_probability p q =
      (INR (p - q) / INR (p + q))%R.
Admitted.

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2253746,
  "Bertrand's ballot theorem": among vote lists with p entries equal to 1 and q
  entries equal to -1, where q < p, the uniform probability that every nonempty
  suffix has positive sum is (p - q) / (p + q). This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q2253746_stays_positive :: "int list set" where
  "q2253746_stays_positive =
    {xs. \<forall>ys. ys \<noteq> [] \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>zs. xs = zs @ ys) \<longrightarrow> 0 < sum_list ys}"

definition q2253746_counted_sequence :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int list set" where
  "q2253746_counted_sequence p q =
    {xs. count_list xs 1 = p \<and>
      count_list xs (-1) = q \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> set xs. x = 1 \<or> x = -1)}"

definition q2253746_uniform_probability :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2253746_uniform_probability S A =
    real (card (S \<inter> A)) / real (card S)"

theorem ballot_problem:
  fixes q p :: nat
  assumes "q < p"
  shows
    "q2253746_uniform_probability
      (q2253746_counted_sequence p q) q2253746_stays_positive =
      real (p - q) / real (p + q)"
  sorry

end

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2253746,
  "Bertrand's ballot theorem": among lists with p entries equal to +1 and q
  entries equal to -1, the uniform probability that every nonempty suffix has
  positive sum is (p - q) / (p + q) when q < p. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2253746_BERTRANDS_BALLOT_THEOREM =
  `let counted_sequence =
     \p:num. \q:num. \l:int list.
       LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = &1) l) = p /\
       LENGTH (FILTER (\x:int. x = -- &1) l) = q /\
       ALL (\x:int. x = &1 \/ x = -- &1) l in
   let stays_positive =
     \l:int list.
       !s:int list.
         ~(s = []) /\
         (?prefix:int list. l = APPEND prefix s)
         ==> &0 < ITLIST (+) s (&0) in
   !q p:num.
     q < p
     ==>
     let sequences =
       {l:int list | counted_sequence p q l} in
     let positive_sequences =
       {l:int list | l IN sequences /\ stays_positive l} in
     ((&(CARD positive_sequences) / &(CARD sequences)):real) =
     (&p - &q) / (&p + &q)`;;

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q2253746, "Bertrand's ballot theorem": when
;; candidate A receives p votes and candidate B receives q votes with q < p,
;; the uniform probability that every nonempty suffix of the count has
;; positive A-minus-B sum is (p - q) / (p + q). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; These are exactly the lists of length n over the integer votes 1 and -1.
(defun q2253746-prepend-vote-to-each (vote sequences)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (cons (cons vote (car sequences))
            (q2253746-prepend-vote-to-each
             vote (cdr sequences)))
    nil))

(defun q2253746-vote-sequences (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list nil)
    (let ((shorter
           (q2253746-vote-sequences (- n 1))))
      (append
       (q2253746-prepend-vote-to-each 1 shorter)
       (q2253746-prepend-vote-to-each -1 shorter)))))

(defun q2253746-vote-list-p (votes)
  (if (consp votes)
      (and (or (equal (car votes) 1)
               (equal (car votes) -1))
           (q2253746-vote-list-p (cdr votes)))
    (equal votes nil)))

(defun q2253746-count-vote (vote votes)
  (if (consp votes)
      (+ (if (equal (car votes) vote) 1 0)
         (q2253746-count-vote vote (cdr votes)))
    0))

(defun q2253746-counted-sequence-p (votes p q)
  (and (q2253746-vote-list-p votes)
       (equal (q2253746-count-vote 1 votes) p)
       (equal (q2253746-count-vote -1 votes) q)))

(defun q2253746-integer-list-sum (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (car values)
         (q2253746-integer-list-sum (cdr values)))
    0))

;; Recursing through the tails checks every nonempty suffix, matching
;; Ballot.staysPositive in the Lean source.
(defun q2253746-stays-positive-p (votes)
  (if (consp votes)
      (and (< 0 (q2253746-integer-list-sum votes))
           (q2253746-stays-positive-p (cdr votes)))
    (equal votes nil)))

(defun q2253746-count-all (sequences p q)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (+ (if (q2253746-counted-sequence-p
              (car sequences) p q)
             1
           0)
         (q2253746-count-all (cdr sequences) p q))
    0))

(defun q2253746-count-positive (sequences p q)
  (if (consp sequences)
      (+ (if (and
              (q2253746-counted-sequence-p
               (car sequences) p q)
              (q2253746-stays-positive-p
               (car sequences)))
             1
           0)
         (q2253746-count-positive
          (cdr sequences) p q))
    0))

(defun q2253746-all-countings (p q)
  (if (and (natp p) (natp q))
      (q2253746-count-all
       (q2253746-vote-sequences (+ p q)) p q)
    0))

(defun q2253746-positive-countings (p q)
  (if (and (natp p) (natp q))
      (q2253746-count-positive
       (q2253746-vote-sequences (+ p q)) p q)
    0))

(defun q2253746-uniform-positive-probability (p q)
  (let ((total (q2253746-all-countings p q)))
    (if (equal total 0)
        0
      (/ (q2253746-positive-countings p q)
         total))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q2253746-bertrands-ballot-theorem-statement
    (q p)
  (implies
   (and (natp q)
        (natp p)
        (< q p))
   (equal
    (q2253746-uniform-positive-probability p q)
    (/ (- p q) (+ p q)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2253746,
-- "Bertrand's ballot theorem": the uniform proportion of fixed A/B vote sequences
-- whose every nonempty suffix has positive A-minus-B sum. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<_
infixr 5 _++_
infixr 6 _and_

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-successor :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero < suc n
  successor-less-successor :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m < n ->
    suc m < suc n

data Vote : Set where
  A B : Vote

_and_ : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
true and condition = condition
false and condition = false

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero = true
natEqual zero (suc n) = false
natEqual (suc m) zero = false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) = natEqual m n

lessThan : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
lessThan zero zero = false
lessThan zero (suc n) = true
lessThan (suc m) zero = false
lessThan (suc m) (suc n) = lessThan m n

_++_ : {X : Set} -> List X -> List X -> List X
[] ++ ys = ys
(x ∷ xs) ++ ys = x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

mapList :
  {X Y : Set} ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  List X ->
  List Y
mapList function [] = []
mapList function (x ∷ xs) =
  function x ∷ mapList function xs

prependA : List Vote -> List Vote
prependA votes = A ∷ votes

prependB : List Vote -> List Vote
prependB votes = B ∷ votes

allVoteSequences : Nat -> List (List Vote)
allVoteSequences zero = [] ∷ []
allVoteSequences (suc n) =
  mapList prependA (allVoteSequences n) ++
  mapList prependB (allVoteSequences n)

countA : List Vote -> Nat
countA [] = zero
countA (A ∷ votes) = suc (countA votes)
countA (B ∷ votes) = countA votes

countB : List Vote -> Nat
countB [] = zero
countB (A ∷ votes) = countB votes
countB (B ∷ votes) = suc (countB votes)

hasVoteCounts : Nat -> Nat -> List Vote -> Bool
hasVoteCounts p q votes =
  natEqual (countA votes) p and
  natEqual (countB votes) q

staysPositive : List Vote -> Bool
staysPositive [] = true
staysPositive (A ∷ votes) =
  lessThan (countB votes) (suc (countA votes)) and
  staysPositive votes
staysPositive (B ∷ votes) =
  lessThan (suc (countB votes)) (countA votes) and
  staysPositive votes

validSequence : Nat -> Nat -> List Vote -> Bool
validSequence p q votes =
  hasVoteCounts p q votes and staysPositive votes

filterList :
  {X : Set} ->
  (X -> Bool) ->
  List X ->
  List X
filterList predicate [] = []
filterList predicate (x ∷ xs) with predicate x
... | true = x ∷ filterList predicate xs
... | false = filterList predicate xs

length : {X : Set} -> List X -> Nat
length [] = zero
length (x ∷ xs) = suc (length xs)

allCountings : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
allCountings p q =
  length
    (filterList
      (hasVoteCounts p q)
      (allVoteSequences (p + q)))

validCountings : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
validCountings p q =
  length
    (filterList
      (validSequence p q)
      (allVoteSequences (p + q)))

bertrands-ballot-theorem : Set
bertrands-ballot-theorem =
  (q p : Nat) ->
  q < p ->
  (p + q) * validCountings p q ==
  (p - q) * allCountings p q

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2253746, "Bertrand's ballot theorem": when candidate A receives p votes
  and candidate B receives q votes with q < p, the uniform proportion of
  countings whose every nonempty suffix has positive A-minus-B sum is
  (p - q) / (p + q). This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q2253746_int_sum_def = Define`
  (q2253746_int_sum ([] : int list) = 0) /\
  (q2253746_int_sum (x::xs) = x + q2253746_int_sum xs)
`;

val q2253746_stays_positive_def = Define`
  (q2253746_stays_positive ([] : int list) = T) /\
  (q2253746_stays_positive (x::xs) =
     (0 < q2253746_int_sum (x::xs) /\
      q2253746_stays_positive xs))
`;

val q2253746_counted_sequence_def = new_definition (
  "q2253746_counted_sequence_def",
  ``q2253746_counted_sequence (p : num) (q : num) (votes : int list) <=>
      LENGTH (FILTER (\x : int. x = 1) votes) = p /\
      LENGTH (FILTER (\x : int. x = -1) votes) = q /\
      EVERY (\x : int. x = 1 \/ x = -1) votes``);

val q2253746_counted_sequences_def = new_definition (
  "q2253746_counted_sequences_def",
  ``q2253746_counted_sequences (p : num) (q : num) =
      {votes : int list | q2253746_counted_sequence p q votes}``);

val q2253746_positive_sequences_def = new_definition (
  "q2253746_positive_sequences_def",
  ``q2253746_positive_sequences (p : num) (q : num) =
      {votes : int list |
         q2253746_counted_sequence p q votes /\
         q2253746_stays_positive votes}``);

val ballot_problem =
  ``!q p : num.
      q < p
      ==>
      CARD (q2253746_positive_sequences p q) * (p + q) =
        (p - q) * CARD (q2253746_counted_sequences p q)``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2253746), "Bertrand's ballot theorem": for
  natural numbers q < p, the uniform probability of integer vote lists with
  p entries equal to +1 and q entries equal to -1 whose every nonempty suffix
  has positive sum is (p - q) / (p + q). This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A Lean list of integers is represented by a SetMM word over ZZ, hence by a
  function on a half-open finite ordinal in the same list order.
  Q2253746Counted p q is exactly countedSequence p q: its entries are +1 or
  -1, with the two prescribed occurrence counts.

  Q2253746StaysPositive is exactly staysPositive. For every valid starting
  index k, the sum over k ..^ length is the sum of the corresponding nonempty
  suffix. The empty word satisfies the predicate vacuously, as in the source.

  Q2253746UniformOn S T is the finite uniform measure of T inside S, expressed
  in the extended reals as the cardinality of S intersect T divided by the
  cardinality of S. Under q < p, Q2253746Counted p q is nonempty, so this is
  definitionally the source uniformOn value under the canonical embedding of
  nonnegative finite reals into extended nonnegative reals.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q2253746Counted Q2253746StaysPositive Q2253746UniformOn $.

q2253746-counted-syntax $a class ( Q2253746Counted p q ) $.
q2253746-stays-positive-syntax $a class Q2253746StaysPositive $.
q2253746-uniform-on-syntax $a
  class ( Q2253746UniformOn S T ) $.

${
  $d i p q w $.

  q2253746-counted-definition $a |- (
    Q2253746Counted p q
  ) =
    { w e. Word ZZ |
      (
        (
          ( # `
            { i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) ) | ( w ` i ) = 1 }
          ) = p
          /\
          ( # `
            { i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) ) | ( w ` i ) = -u 1 }
          ) = q
        )
        /\
        A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) )
          ( ( w ` i ) = 1 \/ ( w ` i ) = -u 1 )
      )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d i k w $.

  q2253746-stays-positive-definition $a |-
    Q2253746StaysPositive =
    { w e. Word ZZ |
      A. k e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) )
        0 < sum_ i e. ( k ..^ ( # ` w ) ) ( w ` i )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  q2253746-uniform-on-definition $a |- (
    Q2253746UniformOn S T
  ) =
    (
      ( # ` ( S i^i T ) )
      /e
      ( # ` S )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d i k p q w $.

  thousand-theorems-q2253746-bertrand-ballot $a |-
    A. q e. NN0
      A. p e. NN0
        (
          q < p
          ->
          (
            (
              Q2253746UniformOn
                ( Q2253746Counted p q )
                Q2253746StaysPositive
            )
            =
            ( ( p - q ) /e ( p + q ) )

title: Q2253746_bertrand_s_ballot_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2253746,
% "Bertrand's ballot theorem": when p > q, exactly the fraction (p - q) / (p + q)
% of vote sequences keep candidate A strictly ahead throughout. This file contains no proof.

bertrands_ballot_theorem_Q2253746: THEORY
BEGIN
  % A bounded binary natural encodes a vote sequence, with its
  % least-significant bit representing the first vote counted.
  a_votes(code, prefix_length: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF prefix_length = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      (IF mod(code, 2) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
        + a_votes(ndiv(code, 2), prefix_length - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE prefix_length

  b_votes(code, prefix_length: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF prefix_length = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      (IF mod(code, 2) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
        + b_votes(ndiv(code, 2), prefix_length - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE prefix_length

  all_sequence(code, p, q: nat): bool =
    code < 2 ^ (p + q)
      AND a_votes(code, p + q) = p
      AND b_votes(code, p + q) = q

  strictly_ahead(code, length: nat): bool =
    FORALL (prefix_length: nat):
      (0 < prefix_length AND prefix_length <= length)
        IMPLIES
          a_votes(code, prefix_length)
            > b_votes(code, prefix_length)

  valid_sequence(code, p, q: nat): bool =
    all_sequence(code, p, q)
      AND strictly_ahead(code, p + q)

  count_below(limit: nat, property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  all_countings(p, q: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      2 ^ (p + q),
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): all_sequence(code, p, q)))

  valid_countings(p, q: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      2 ^ (p + q),
      (LAMBDA (code: nat): valid_sequence(code, p, q)))

  bertrands_ballot_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: nat):
      q < p IMPLIES
        (p + q) * valid_countings(p, q)
          = (p - q) * all_countings(p, q)
END bertrands_ballot_theorem_Q2253746
