  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q226014
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q226014), "Poincaré recurrence theorem": for a
  conservative measurable dynamical system, almost every point of a
  null-measurable set returns to that set infinitely often. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q226014_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q226014_empty {A : Type} : q226014_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q226014_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q226014_set A) : q226014_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q226014_union {A : Type}
    (E F : q226014_set A) : q226014_set A :=
  fun x => E x \/ F x.

Definition q226014_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q226014_set A) : q226014_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q226014_preimage {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (E : q226014_set B) : q226014_set A :=
  fun x => E (f x).

Definition q226014_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q226014_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q226014_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q226014_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q226014_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q226014_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j ->
    q226014_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q226014_symmetric_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q226014_set A) : q226014_set A :=
  fun x => (E x /\ ~ F x) \/ (F x /\ ~ E x).

Inductive q226014_ennreal : Type :=
| q226014_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q226014_ennreal
| q226014_ennreal_infinity : q226014_ennreal.

Arguments q226014_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q226014_ennreal_zero : q226014_ennreal :=
  q226014_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q226014_ennreal_equiv
    (x y : q226014_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q226014_ennreal_finite a _,
    q226014_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q226014_ennreal_infinity,
    q226014_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q226014_ennreal_le
    (x y : q226014_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q226014_ennreal_finite a _,
    q226014_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q226014_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q226014_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q226014_ennreal_infinity,
    q226014_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q226014_ennreal_infinity,
    q226014_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q226014_ennreal_add
    (x y : q226014_ennreal) : q226014_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q226014_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q226014_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q226014_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q226014_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q226014_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q226014_ennreal) (n : nat) : q226014_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q226014_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q226014_ennreal_add
        (q226014_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q226014_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q226014_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q226014_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q226014_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q226014_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q226014_ennreal,
      (forall value : q226014_ennreal,
          values value ->
          q226014_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q226014_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q226014_ennreal_infimum
    (values : q226014_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q226014_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q226014_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q226014_ennreal_le bound value) /\
  (forall lower : q226014_ennreal,
      (forall value : q226014_ennreal,
          values value ->
          q226014_ennreal_le lower value) ->
      q226014_ennreal_le lower bound).

Definition q226014_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q226014_ennreal)
    (total : q226014_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q226014_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q226014_ennreal_equiv
          value (q226014_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    total.

Record q226014_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q226014_measurable : q226014_set A -> Prop;
  q226014_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q226014_set A,
      q226014_same_set E F ->
      (q226014_measurable E <-> q226014_measurable F);
  q226014_measurable_empty :
    q226014_measurable q226014_empty;
  q226014_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q226014_set A,
      q226014_measurable E ->
      q226014_measurable (q226014_complement E);
  q226014_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q226014_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q226014_measurable (E n)) ->
      q226014_measurable (q226014_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q226014_measurable {A} _ _.

Record q226014_measure
    (A : Type) (M : q226014_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q226014_measure_value :
    q226014_set A -> q226014_ennreal;
  q226014_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q226014_set A,
      q226014_same_set E F ->
      q226014_ennreal_equiv
        (q226014_measure_value E)
        (q226014_measure_value F);
  q226014_measure_empty :
    q226014_ennreal_equiv
      (q226014_measure_value q226014_empty)
      q226014_ennreal_zero;
  q226014_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q226014_set A,
      (forall x : A, E x -> F x) ->
      q226014_ennreal_le
        (q226014_measure_value E)
        (q226014_measure_value F);
  q226014_measure_canonical_outer_extension :
    forall E : q226014_set A,
      q226014_ennreal_infimum
        (fun value =>
          exists measurable_superset : q226014_set A,
            (forall x : A, E x -> measurable_superset x) /\
            q226014_measurable M measurable_superset /\
            q226014_ennreal_equiv
              value (q226014_measure_value measurable_superset))
        (q226014_measure_value E);
  q226014_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall (E : nat -> q226014_set A)
           (total : q226014_ennreal),
      q226014_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q226014_measure_value (E n)) total ->
      q226014_ennreal_le
        (q226014_measure_value (q226014_countable_union E))
        total;
  q226014_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q226014_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q226014_measurable M (E n)) ->
      q226014_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q226014_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q226014_measure_value (E n))
        (q226014_measure_value (q226014_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q226014_measure_value {A M} _ _.

Definition q226014_measurable_map
    {A B : Type}
    (MA : q226014_measurable_space A)
    (MB : q226014_measurable_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall E : q226014_set B,
    q226014_measurable MB E ->
    q226014_measurable MA (q226014_preimage f E).

Definition q226014_null_measurable_set
    {A : Type}
    (M : q226014_measurable_space A)
    (mu : @q226014_measure A M)
    (E : q226014_set A) : Prop :=
  exists measurable_version : q226014_set A,
    q226014_measurable M measurable_version /\
    q226014_ennreal_equiv
      (q226014_measure_value mu
        (q226014_symmetric_difference E measurable_version))
      q226014_ennreal_zero.

Definition q226014_quasi_measure_preserving
    {A : Type}
    (M : q226014_measurable_space A)
    (mu : @q226014_measure A M)
    (f : A -> A) : Prop :=
  q226014_measurable_map M M f /\
  forall E : q226014_set A,
    q226014_ennreal_equiv
      (q226014_measure_value mu E)
      q226014_ennreal_zero ->
    q226014_ennreal_equiv
      (q226014_measure_value mu (q226014_preimage f E))
      q226014_ennreal_zero.

Fixpoint q226014_iterate
    {A : Type} (f : A -> A) (n : nat) (x : A) : A :=
  match n with
  | O => x
  | S k => f (q226014_iterate f k x)
  end.

Definition q226014_frequently_at_top
    (P : nat -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall lower_bound : nat,
    exists n : nat,
      (lower_bound <= n)%nat /\ P n.

Definition q226014_almost_everywhere
    {A : Type}
    {M : q226014_measurable_space A}
    (mu : @q226014_measure A M)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  q226014_ennreal_equiv
    (q226014_measure_value mu (fun x => ~ P x))
    q226014_ennreal_zero.

Definition q226014_conservative
    {A : Type}
    (M : q226014_measurable_space A)
    (mu : @q226014_measure A M)
    (f : A -> A) : Prop :=
  @q226014_quasi_measure_preserving A M mu f /\
  forall E : q226014_set A,
    q226014_measurable M E ->
    ~ q226014_ennreal_equiv
        (q226014_measure_value mu E)
        q226014_ennreal_zero ->
    exists x : A,
      E x /\
      exists n : nat,
        n <> O /\
        E (q226014_iterate f n x).

Theorem q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem :
  forall (A : Type)
         (M : q226014_measurable_space A)
         (f : A -> A)
         (s : q226014_set A)
         (mu : @q226014_measure A M),
    @q226014_conservative A M mu f ->
    @q226014_null_measurable_set A M mu s ->
    q226014_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        s x ->
        q226014_frequently_at_top
          (fun n => s (q226014_iterate f n x))).
Admitted.

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q226014
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q226014), "Poincaré recurrence theorem": for a
  conservative nonsingular measurable self-map of an arbitrary measure space,
  almost every point of a null-measurable set returns to that set infinitely
  often. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complete_Measure"
begin

definition q226014_quasi_measure_preserving ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q226014_quasi_measure_preserving M f \<longleftrightarrow>
      f \<in> measurable M M \<and>
      (\<forall>N \<in> null_sets M. f -` N \<in> null_sets M)"

definition q226014_null_measurable_set ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q226014_null_measurable_set M s \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>t \<in> sets M. \<exists>N \<in> null_sets M.
        (s - t) \<union> (t - s) \<subseteq> N)"

definition q226014_conservative ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q226014_conservative M f \<longleftrightarrow>
      q226014_quasi_measure_preserving M f \<and>
      (\<forall>u \<in> sets M.
        emeasure M u \<noteq> 0 \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>x \<in> u. \<exists>m :: nat.
          m \<noteq> 0 \<and> (f ^^ m) x \<in> u))"

theorem poincare_recurrence_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'a measure"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and s :: "'a set"
  assumes full_space: "space M = UNIV"
    and conservative: "q226014_conservative M f"
    and null_measurable: "q226014_null_measurable_set M s"
  shows
    "AE x in M.
      x \<in> s \<longrightarrow>
      frequently (\<lambda>n :: nat. (f ^^ n) x \<in> s) at_top"
  sorry

end

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q226014
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q226014), "Poincare recurrence theorem":
  for a conservative nonsingular self-map of an arbitrary measure space,
  almost every point of a null-measurable set returns to it infinitely often.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q226014_POINCARE_RECURRENCE_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           events u ==> events ((:A) DIFF u)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!u:A->bool. events u ==> enonnegative (mu u)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum
                 (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let null_set =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (u:A->bool).
        ?z:A->bool.
          events z /\
          u SUBSET z /\
          mu z = ezero in
   let null_measurable_set =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (u:A->bool).
        ?v:A->bool.
          events v /\
          null_set events mu
            ((u DIFF v) UNION (v DIFF u)) in
   let measurable_map =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (f:A->A).
        !u:A->bool.
          events u ==> events {x:A | f x IN u} in
   let quasi_measure_preserving =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->A).
        measurable_map events f /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           events u /\ mu u = ezero
           ==> mu {x:A | f x IN u} = ezero) in
   let conservative =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->A).
        quasi_measure_preserving events mu f /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           events u /\ ~(mu u = ezero)
           ==> ?x:A.
                 x IN u /\
                 ?m:num.
                   ~(m = 0) /\
                   ITER m f x IN u) in
   let frequently_at_top =
      \(p:num->bool).
        !N:num. ?n:num. N <= n /\ p n in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (p:A->bool).
        null_set events mu {x:A | ~(p x)} in
   !events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    f:A->A
    s:A->bool.
      measure_space events mu /\
      conservative events mu f /\
      null_measurable_set events mu s
      ==>
      almost_everywhere events mu
        (\x:A.
           x IN s
           ==> frequently_at_top
                 (\n:num. ITER n f x IN s))`;;

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q226014,
;; "Poincaré recurrence theorem": for a conservative nonsingular measurable
;; self-map, almost every point of a null-measurable set returns to that set
;; infinitely often. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The source proposition uses its measure only through null sets: positivity
;; in conservativity, absolute continuity, null-measurability, and the
;; almost-everywhere conclusion.  Accordingly, MEASURE is presented by its
;; complete sigma-ideal of null sets.  The explicit ideal laws below are
;; bidirectionally equivalent to a measure for this proposition: every measure
;; supplies such an ideal, while any such ideal is realized by the measure
;; taking value zero on ideal members and infinity otherwise.  Thus no real
;; values, arbitrary sets, or functions are replaced by finite data.

(defstub q226014-domain-member-p (domain object) t)
(defstub q226014-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q226014-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q226014-measure-null-p (measure set) t)
(defstub q226014-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q226014-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)

;; Extensional sets over the arbitrary carrier.

(defun-sk q226014-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-set-member-p set x)
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q226014-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q226014-set-member-p left x)
      (q226014-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q226014-set-subset-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q226014-set-member-p left x))
     (q226014-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q226014-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (not (q226014-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q226014-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q226014-set-member-p complement x)
      (not (q226014-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q226014-symmetric-difference-set-p
    (domain left right difference)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q226014-set-member-p difference x)
      (not
       (iff
        (q226014-set-member-p left x)
        (q226014-set-member-p right x)))))))

(defun-sk q226014-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q226014-valid-set-p
      domain
      (q226014-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q226014-sequence-member-exists-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q226014-set-member-p
      (q226014-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q226014-sequence-union-set-p (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q226014-set-member-p union x)
      (q226014-sequence-member-exists-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q226014-preimage-set-p
    (domain function set preimage)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q226014-set-member-p preimage x)
      (q226014-set-member-p
       set
       (q226014-function-value function x))))))

;; Sigma-algebra laws for the source MeasurableSpace.

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-extensional-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-valid-set-p domain left)
      (q226014-valid-set-p domain right)
      (q226014-set-equiv-p domain left right))
     (iff
      (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-empty-exists-p (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q226014-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain complement)
     (q226014-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-complements-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q226014-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q226014-sequence-measurable-p (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q226014-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q226014-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain union)
     (q226014-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-sequence-unions-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q226014-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence))
     (q226014-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q226014-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q226014-measurable-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q226014-measurable-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q226014-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q226014-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q226014-measurable-sequence-unions-p domain measurable)))

;; The null-set sigma-ideal of the measure.

(defun-sk q226014-null-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-valid-set-p domain left)
      (q226014-valid-set-p domain right)
      (q226014-set-equiv-p domain left right))
     (iff
      (q226014-measure-null-p measure left)
      (q226014-measure-null-p measure right)))))

(defun-sk q226014-null-valid-p (domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure set)
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q226014-empty-null-p (domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q226014-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure empty))))

(defun-sk q226014-null-hereditary-p (domain measure)
  (forall (subset set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-valid-set-p domain subset)
      (q226014-measure-null-p measure set)
      (q226014-set-subset-p domain subset set))
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure subset))))

(defun-sk q226014-sequence-null-p (measure sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q226014-measure-null-p
      measure
      (q226014-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q226014-null-countable-unions-p (domain measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q226014-sequence-null-p measure sequence)
      (q226014-valid-set-p domain union)
      (q226014-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure union))))

(defun q226014-measure-null-ideal-p (domain measure)
  (and
   (q226014-null-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q226014-null-valid-p domain measure)
   (q226014-empty-null-p domain measure)
   (q226014-null-hereditary-p domain measure)
   (q226014-null-countable-unions-p domain measure)))

(defun q226014-measure-space-p (domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q226014-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q226014-measure-null-ideal-p domain measure)))

;; NullMeasurableSet: equality to a measurable set modulo a null symmetric
;; difference.

(defun-sk q226014-null-measurable-witness-exists-p
    (domain measurable measure set)
  (exists (representative difference)
    (and
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable representative)
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain difference)
     (q226014-symmetric-difference-set-p
      domain set representative difference)
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure difference))))

(defun q226014-null-measurable-set-p
    (domain measurable measure set)
  (and
   (q226014-valid-set-p domain set)
   (q226014-null-measurable-witness-exists-p
    domain measurable measure set)))

;; Measurable nonsingular self-maps and their iterates.

(defun-sk q226014-self-map-p (domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q226014-domain-member-p
      domain
      (q226014-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-preimage-exists-p
    (domain measurable function set)
  (exists (preimage)
    (and
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain preimage)
     (q226014-preimage-set-p domain function set preimage)
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable preimage))))

(defun-sk q226014-measurable-map-p
    (domain measurable function)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q226014-measurable-preimage-exists-p
      domain measurable function set))))

(defun-sk q226014-null-preimage-exists-p
    (domain measure function set)
  (exists (preimage)
    (and
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain preimage)
     (q226014-preimage-set-p domain function set preimage)
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure preimage))))

(defun-sk q226014-nonsingular-map-p
    (domain measure function)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure set)
     (q226014-null-preimage-exists-p
      domain measure function set))))

(defun q226014-quasi-measure-preserving-p
    (domain measurable measure function)
  (and
   (q226014-self-map-p domain function)
   (q226014-measurable-map-p domain measurable function)
   (q226014-nonsingular-map-p domain measure function)))

(defun q226014-iterate (function n x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      x
    (q226014-function-value
     function
     (q226014-iterate function (1- n) x))))

;; Conservativity is the exact source structure field: every measurable
;; non-null set contains a point returning under a nonzero iterate.

(defun-sk q226014-return-witness-exists-p
    (domain function set)
  (exists (x m)
    (and
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q226014-set-member-p set x)
     (natp m)
     (not (equal m 0))
     (q226014-set-member-p
      set
      (q226014-iterate function m x)))))

(defun-sk q226014-conservative-return-law-p
    (domain measurable measure function)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-measurable-set-p measurable set)
      (not (q226014-measure-null-p measure set)))
     (q226014-return-witness-exists-p
      domain function set))))

(defun q226014-conservative-p
    (domain measurable measure function)
  (and
   (q226014-quasi-measure-preserving-p
    domain measurable measure function)
   (q226014-conservative-return-law-p
    domain measurable measure function)))

;; Frequently atTop on natural iteration indices: beyond every lower bound
;; there is a return time.

(defun-sk q226014-return-after-exists-p
    (function set x lower)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (<= lower n)
     (q226014-set-member-p
      set
      (q226014-iterate function n x)))))

(defun-sk q226014-frequently-returns-p
    (function set x)
  (forall (lower)
    (implies
     (natp lower)
     (q226014-return-after-exists-p
      function set x lower))))

;; The complement of the almost-everywhere implication consists precisely of
;; points in S that fail to return frequently.

(defun-sk q226014-recurrence-failure-set-p
    (domain function set failure)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q226014-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q226014-set-member-p failure x)
      (and
       (q226014-set-member-p set x)
       (not
        (q226014-frequently-returns-p
         function set x)))))))

(defun-sk q226014-ae-recurrence-p
    (domain measure function set)
  (exists (failure)
    (and
     (q226014-valid-set-p domain failure)
     (q226014-recurrence-failure-set-p
      domain function set failure)
     (q226014-measure-null-p measure failure))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q226014-poincare-recurrence-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (domain measurable measure function set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q226014-measure-space-p domain measurable measure)
      (q226014-conservative-p
       domain measurable measure function)
      (q226014-null-measurable-set-p
       domain measurable measure set))
     (q226014-ae-recurrence-p
      domain measure function set))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q226014,
-- "Poincaré recurrence theorem": for a conservative nonsingular self-map,
-- almost every point of a null-measurable set returns to that set infinitely
-- often. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Support.Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

preimage :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> A) ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
preimage f S x =
  S (f x)

iterate :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> A) ->
  Nat ->
  A ->
  A
iterate f zero x =
  x
iterate f (suc n) x =
  f (iterate f n x)

FrequentlyAtTop :
  {A : Set} ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
FrequentlyAtTop sequence S =
  (cutoff : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Both
        (cutoff <=N n)
        (S (sequence n)))

MeasurableMap :
  {A : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  (A -> A) ->
  Set1
MeasurableMap events f =
  (S : Predicate _) ->
  measurable events S ->
  measurable events (preimage f S)

record NullMeasurableSet
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (S : Predicate A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measurable-version :
      Predicate A
    measurable-version-is-measurable :
      measurable events measurable-version
    agrees-almost-everywhere :
      AlmostEverywhere measure
        (\ x -> Iff (S x) (measurable-version x))

record QuasiMeasurePreserving
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    measurable-map :
      MeasurableMap events f
    preimage-of-null-is-null :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass measure S == zeroM extended ->
      outerMass measure (preimage f S) == zeroM extended

record Conservative
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> A) :
  Set1 where

  field
    quasi-measure-preserving :
      QuasiMeasurePreserving measure f
    measurable-positive-set-has-return :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      Not (outerMass measure S == zeroM extended) ->
      Exists A
        (\ x ->
          Both
            (S x)
            (Exists Nat
              (\ n ->
                Both
                  (Not (n == zero))
                  (S (iterate f n x)))))

poincare-recurrence-theorem : Set2
poincare-recurrence-theorem =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (f : A -> A) ->
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  Conservative measure f ->
  NullMeasurableSet measure S ->
  AlmostEverywhere measure
    (\ x ->
      S x ->
      FrequentlyAtTop
        (\ n -> iterate f n x)
        S)

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q226014, "Poincaré recurrence theorem": for a conservative nonsingular
  self-map of a measure space and a null-measurable set, almost every point in
  the set returns to it infinitely often. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory;

val q226014_null_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q226014_null_measurable_def",
  ``q226014_null_measurable (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) <=>
      ?t.
        t IN measurable_sets m /\
        almost_everywhere m (\x. (x IN s <=> x IN t))``);

val q226014_conservative_def = new_definition (
  "q226014_conservative_def",
  ``q226014_conservative (m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      f IN measurable
        (m_space m,measurable_sets m)
        (m_space m,measurable_sets m) /\
      (!t.
         t IN measurable_sets m /\ measure m t = 0 ==>
         measure m (PREIMAGE f t) = 0) /\
      (!t.
         t IN measurable_sets m /\ measure m t <> 0 ==>
         ?x k.
           x IN t /\
           k <> 0 /\
           FUNPOW f k x IN t)``);

val poincare_recurrence_theorem =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> 'a) (s : 'a set).
      q226014_conservative m f /\
      q226014_null_measurable m s
      ==>
      almost_everywhere m
        (\x.
           x IN s ==>
           !N. ?n. N <= n /\ FUNPOW f n x IN s)``;

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q226014
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q226014), "Poincare recurrence theorem": for
  a conservative measurable self-map of an arbitrary measure space, almost
  every point lying in a null-measurable set returns to that set at
  arbitrarily large natural iterates. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q226014Measure evaluates the outer measure induced by M, retaining arbitrary
  subsets of the carrier. Q226014NullMeasurable says that a set agrees with a
  measurable set up to an outer-null symmetric difference.

  Q226014Iterates is the unique NN0-indexed sequence beginning at x and
  repeatedly applying F. Q226014Conservative expands the source structure:
  F is measurable and nonsingular, and every measurable set of nonzero
  measure contains a point returning to it under a positive iterate.
  Q226014Frequently expands frequent membership along the natural-number
  atTop filter as membership at some index beyond every prescribed index.

  All declarations below are syntax, bidirectional definitions, or the final
  unproved $a statement. There are no $p declarations in this file.
$)

$c Q226014Measure Q226014NullMeasurable Q226014Iterates
   Q226014Conservative Q226014Frequently $.

q226014-measure-syntax
  $a class ( Q226014Measure M A ) $.
q226014-null-measurable-syntax
  $a wff ( Q226014NullMeasurable M S ) $.
q226014-iterates-syntax
  $a class ( Q226014Iterates M F x ) $.
q226014-conservative-syntax
  $a wff ( Q226014Conservative M F ) $.
q226014-frequently-syntax
  $a wff ( Q226014Frequently M F S x ) $.

${
  $d A M $.

  q226014-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q226014Measure M A
  ) =
    ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A )
  $.
$}

${
  $d M S T $.

  q226014-null-measurable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q226014NullMeasurable M S )
    <->
    E. T e. dom M
      (
        Q226014Measure
        M
        ( ( S \ T ) u. ( T \ S ) )
      ) = 0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G M n x $.

  q226014-iterates-definition $a |- (
    Q226014Iterates M F x
  ) =
    (
      iota_ G e. ( ( U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          ( G ` 0 ) = x
          /\
          A. n e. NN0
            ( G ` ( n + 1 ) ) = ( F ` ( G ` n ) )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A F M n x $.

  q226014-conservative-definition $a |- (
    ( Q226014Conservative M F )
    <->
    (
      F e. ( dom M MblFnM dom M )
      /\
      (
        A. A e. ~P ( U. dom M )
          (
            ( Q226014Measure M A ) = 0
            ->
            (
              Q226014Measure
              M
              ( `' F " A )
            ) = 0
          )
        /\
        A. A e. dom M
          (
            ( Q226014Measure M A ) =/= 0
            ->
            E. x e. A
              E. n e. NN
                ( ( Q226014Iterates M F x ) ` n ) e. A
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M N S n x $.

  q226014-frequently-definition $a |- (
    ( Q226014Frequently M F S x )
    <->
    A. N e. NN0
      E. n e. NN0
        (
          N <_ n
          /\
          ( ( Q226014Iterates M F x ) ` n ) e. S
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F G M N S T n x $.

  thousand-theorems-q226014-poincare-recurrence $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. F e. ( ( U. dom M ) ^m ( U. dom M ) )
        A. S e. ~P ( U. dom M )
          (
            (
              ( Q226014Conservative M F )
              /\
              ( Q226014NullMeasurable M S )
            )
            ->
            (
              Q226014Measure
              M
              {
                x e. S |
                  -. ( Q226014Frequently M F S x )
              }
            ) = 0
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q226014,
% "Poincaré recurrence theorem": for a conservative measurable dynamical system,
% almost every point of a null-measurable set returns to that set infinitely often.
% This file contains no proof.

Q226014_poincare_recurrence_theorem[Alpha: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [Alpha -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      0 <= finite_part(value)
    ENDIF

  event_subset(A, B: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: Alpha):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: Alpha): FALSE

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: Alpha): TRUE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: Alpha):
      NOT A(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: Alpha):
      EXISTS (n: nat):
        events(n)(x)

  symmetric_difference(A, B: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: Alpha):
      (A(x) AND NOT B(x)) OR (B(x) AND NOT A(x))

  preimage(f: [Alpha -> Alpha], A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: Alpha):
      A(f(x))

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i /= j IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: Alpha):
          NOT (events(i)(x) AND events(j)(x))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          Sigma(events(n)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(mu: measure_map, Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND mu(empty_event) = zero_measure_value
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(mu(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (n: nat):
            Sigma(events(n)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (n: nat):
              mu(events(n)),
            mu(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      mu: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event): bool =
    EXISTS (N: event):
      Sigma(N)
        AND mu(N) = zero_measure_value
        AND event_subset(A, N)

  null_measurable_set(
      mu: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event): bool =
    EXISTS (B: event):
      Sigma(B)
        AND null_event(
          mu,
          Sigma,
          symmetric_difference(A, B))

  measurable_map(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: [Alpha -> Alpha]): bool =
    FORALL (A: event):
      Sigma(A) IMPLIES
        Sigma(preimage(f, A))

  quasi_measure_preserving(
      mu: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: [Alpha -> Alpha]): bool =
    measurable_map(Sigma, f)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        null_event(mu, Sigma, A)
        IMPLIES
          null_event(
            mu,
            Sigma,
            preimage(f, A)))

  iterate(
      f: [Alpha -> Alpha],
      count: nat,
      x: Alpha): RECURSIVE Alpha =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      x
    ELSE
      f(iterate(f, count - 1, x))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  conservative(
      mu: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: [Alpha -> Alpha]): bool =
    quasi_measure_preserving(mu, Sigma, f)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        (Sigma(A)
          AND mu(A) /= zero_measure_value)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: Alpha), (count: nat):
            A(x)
              AND count /= 0
              AND A(iterate(f, count, x)))

  returns_infinitely_often(
      f: [Alpha -> Alpha],
      A: event,
      x: Alpha): bool =
    FORALL (cutoff: nat):
      EXISTS (count: nat):
        cutoff <= count
          AND A(iterate(f, count, x))

  almost_everywhere(

    {V P : Type}

  theorem": four cospherical points on two straight-angle chords through a
  point have equal products of distances to that point. This file contains no

theory Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

locale q2266397_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q2266397_vadd :: "'v::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q2266397_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q2266397_zero_vadd:
      "q2266397_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q2266397_add_vadd:
      "q2266397_vadd (u + v) p =
        q2266397_vadd u (q2266397_vadd v p)"
    and q2266397_vadd_vsub:
      "q2266397_vadd (q2266397_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q2266397_vsub_vadd:
      "q2266397_vsub (q2266397_vadd v p) p = v"
begin

definition q2266397_dist :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2266397_dist p q = norm (q2266397_vsub p q)"

definition q2266397_angle :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2266397_angle a p b =
    arccos (inner (q2266397_vsub a p) (q2266397_vsub b p) /
      (norm (q2266397_vsub a p) * norm (q2266397_vsub b p)))"

definition q2266397_cospherical :: "'p set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2266397_cospherical S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>center radius.
      \<forall>x \<in> S. q2266397_dist x center = radius)"

theorem intersecting_chords_theorem:
  fixes a b c d p :: 'p
  assumes cospherical:
      "q2266397_cospherical {a, b, c, d}"
    and first_straight_angle:
      "q2266397_angle a p b = pi"
    and second_straight_angle:
      "q2266397_angle c p d = pi"
  shows
      "q2266397_dist a p * q2266397_dist b p =
        q2266397_dist c p * q2266397_dist d p"

end

end

(*

  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q2266397), "Intersecting chords theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, two straight-angle chords
  through a point in the same sphere have equal products of segment lengths.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2266397_INTERSECTING_CHORDS_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!p:P. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:V. !p:P.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!v:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (p:P) (q:P).
       norm inner (vsub p q) in
  let straight_angle =
    \(zero:V) (smul:real->V->V) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p1:P) (p2:P) (p3:P).
       ~(vsub p1 p2 = zero) /\
       ?r:real.
         r < &0 /\
         vsub p3 p2 = smul r (vsub p1 p2) in
  let cospherical =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (a:P) (b:P) (c:P) (d:P).
       ?center:P. ?radius:real.
         distance inner vsub a center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub b center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub c center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub d center = radius in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !a b c d p:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    cospherical inner vsub a b c d /\
    straight_angle zero smul vsub a p b /\
    straight_angle zero smul vsub c p d
    ==>
    distance inner vsub a p * distance inner vsub b p =
    distance inner vsub c p * distance inner vsub d p`;;

     (let ((zero-v (q2266397-v-zero real vector-space)))
       (and
        (q2266397-p-member-p
         point-space
         (q2266397-vadd real vector-space point-space u p))
        (q2266397-v-member-p
         vector-space

        (equal

         p)
        (equal

          real vector-space point-space
          (q2266397-v-add real vector-space u v)
          p)
         (q2266397-vadd
          real vector-space point-space u
          (q2266397-vadd real vector-space point-space v p)))
        (equal
         (q2266397-vadd
          real vector-space point-space
          (q2266397-vsub real vector-space point-space p q)
          q)
         p)
        (equal
         (q2266397-vsub
          real vector-space point-space
          (q2266397-vadd real vector-space point-space u p)
          p)
         u)

          real vector-space

(defun q2266397-context-p (real vector-space point-space)

   (q2266397-real-p real)
   (q2266397-v-member-p
    vector-space (q2266397-v-zero real vector-space))
   (q2266397-vector-space-laws-p real vector-space)
   (q2266397-inner-product-laws-p real vector-space)

   (q2266397-affine-torsor-laws-p real vector-space point-space)))

(defun q2266397-squared-distance
    (real vector-space point-space left right)

     (q2266397-p-member-p point-space center)
     (equal
      (q2266397-squared-distance
       real vector-space point-space a center)
      (q2266397-squared-distance
       real vector-space point-space b center))
     (equal
      (q2266397-squared-distance
       real vector-space point-space a center)
      (q2266397-squared-distance
       real vector-space point-space c center))
     (equal

       real vector-space point-space a center)

       (q2266397-r-less real (q2266397-r-zero real) scale)

        left-vector
        (q2266397-v-smul
         real vector-space
         (q2266397-r-neg real scale)
         right-vector))))))

;; Equality of products of squared distances is equivalent to equality of
;; the source products of distances because all distances are nonnegative.
(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q2266397-intersecting-chords-theorem-statement
    (real vector-space point-space)
  (forall (a b c d p)

     (and
      (q2266397-context-p real vector-space point-space)
      (q2266397-p-member-p point-space a)
      (q2266397-p-member-p point-space b)
      (q2266397-p-member-p point-space c)
      (q2266397-p-member-p point-space d)
      (q2266397-p-member-p point-space p)

       real vector-space point-space a b c d)
      (q2266397-angle-pi-p
       real vector-space point-space a p b)
      (q2266397-angle-pi-p
       real vector-space point-space c p d))

      (q2266397-r-mul

        real vector-space point-space a p)
       (q2266397-squared-distance
        real vector-space point-space b p))

       real
       (q2266397-squared-distance
        real vector-space point-space c p)

        real vector-space point-space d p))))))

title: Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2266397
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q2266397), "Intersecting chords theorem": in a
-- real inner-product affine space, two pairs of cospherical points forming
-- straight angles at a common point have equal products of distances.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) and (oneR != zeroR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictPositive reals x =
  (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) and (x != zeroR reals)

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm v)
    norm-square :
      (v : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm v) (norm v) == inner v v
    norm-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      norm v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV
    norm-negate :
      (v : V) ->
      norm (negateV v) == norm v

    piR : R
    vectorAngle : V -> V -> R

    angle-equals-pi-characterization :
      (u v : V) ->
      Iff
        (vectorAngle u v == piR)
        ((u != zeroV)
        and
        Exists R
          (\ t ->
            StrictPositive reals t
            and
            (u ==
              scaleV (negateR reals t) v)))

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine p q =
  norm space (vsub affine p q)

angleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
angleAt {space = space} affine a p b =
  vectorAngle space
    (vsub affine a p)
    (vsub affine b p)

StraightAngleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
StraightAngleAt reals space affine a p b =
  angleAt affine a p b == piR space

CosphericalFour :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
CosphericalFour {R} {P = P} reals space affine a b c d =
  Exists P
    (\ center ->
      Exists R
        (\ radius ->
          (distance affine a center == radius)
          and
          ((distance affine b center == radius)
          and
          ((distance affine c center == radius)
          and
          (distance affine d center == radius)))))

intersecting-chords-theorem : Set1
intersecting-chords-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b c d p : P) ->
  CosphericalFour reals space affine a b c d ->
  StraightAngleAt reals space affine a p b ->
  StraightAngleAt reals space affine c p d ->
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine a p)
    (distance affine b p)
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine c p)
    (distance affine d p)

title: Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2266397 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q2266397), "Intersecting chords
  theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, two chords
  through a common point whose endpoints are cospherical and form straight
  angles have equal products of endpoint distances from that point. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q2266397_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2266397_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q2266397_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q2266397_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q2266397_norm_def",
  ``q2266397_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q2266397_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q2266397_dist_def",
  ``q2266397_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q2266397_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q2266397_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q2266397_angle_def",
  ``q2266397_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p)
      (z : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub x y) (vsub z y) /
          (q2266397_norm inner (vsub x y) *
           q2266397_norm inner (vsub z y)))``);

val q2266397_cospherical_four_def = new_definition (
  "q2266397_cospherical_four_def",
  ``q2266397_cospherical_four
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a : 'p)
      (b : 'p)
      (c : 'p)
      (d : 'p) <=>
      ?centre : 'p. ?radius : real.
        q2266397_dist inner vsub a centre = radius /\
        q2266397_dist inner vsub b centre = radius /\
        q2266397_dist inner vsub c centre = radius /\
        q2266397_dist inner vsub d centre = radius``);

val q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a b c d p : 'p).
      q2266397_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q2266397_cospherical_four inner vsub a b c d /\
      q2266397_angle inner vsub a p b = pi /\
      q2266397_angle inner vsub c p d = pi
      ==>
      q2266397_dist inner vsub a p *
          q2266397_dist inner vsub b p =
        q2266397_dist inner vsub c p *
          q2266397_dist inner vsub d p``;

title: Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2266397
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2266397), "Intersecting chords theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, two straight chords
  through four cospherical points have equal products of distances from
  their common point. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces. The predicate
  W Q2266397RealInnerProductSpace explicitly requires a generalized
  pre-Hilbert structure over RRfld, the normed-module laws, and the defining
  equality between the norm and the square root of the self inner product.
  It is therefore the SetMM rendering of the source NormedAddCommGroup and
  InnerProductSpace real typeclass package, without a finite-dimensionality
  restriction. Choosing the common point P as an affine origin identifies
  the source normed affine torsor with this vector presentation while
  preserving differences, distances, angles, and spheres.

  W Q2266397Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q2266397Dist A B is its
  norm, and W Q2266397Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When
  either ray is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention;
  otherwise it is the arccosine of the normalized inner product.

  W Q2266397Cospherical A B C D states that the four points have a common
  center and a common nonnegative real distance from it. This is equivalent
  to the source predicate Cospherical {A, B, C, D}.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit
  bidirectional definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  Q2266397RealInnerProductSpace
  Q2266397Ray Q2266397Dist Q2266397Angle Q2266397Cospherical
$.

q2266397-real-inner-product-space-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q2266397RealInnerProductSpace ) $.
q2266397-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q2266397Ray A B ) $.
q2266397-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q2266397Dist A B ) $.
q2266397-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q2266397Angle A B C ) $.
q2266397-cospherical-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q2266397Cospherical A B C D ) $.

${
  $d W x $.

  q2266397-real-inner-product-space-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q2266397RealInnerProductSpace )
    <->
    (
      (
        W e. PreHil
        /\
        W e. NrmMod
      )
      /\
      (
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
        /\
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          =
          (
            x e. ( Base ` W ) |->
              ( sqrt ` ( x ( .i ` W ) x ) )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

q2266397-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q2266397Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q2266397-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q2266397Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q2266397Ray A B )
) $.

q2266397-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q2266397Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q2266397Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q2266397Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q2266397Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q2266397Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q2266397Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q2266397Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D O R W $.

  q2266397-cospherical-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q2266397Cospherical A B C D )
    <->
    E. O e. ( Base ` W )
      E. R e. RR
        (
          0 <_ R
          /\
          (
            ( ( W Q2266397Dist A O ) = R )
            /\
            (
              ( ( W Q2266397Dist B O ) = R )
              /\
              (
                ( ( W Q2266397Dist C O ) = R )
                /\
                ( ( W Q2266397Dist D O ) = R )
              )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C D P W $.

  thousand-theorems-q2266397-intersecting-chords $a |- A. W
    (
      ( W Q2266397RealInnerProductSpace )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            A. D e. ( Base ` W )
              A. P e. ( Base ` W )
                (
                  (
                    ( W Q2266397Cospherical A B C D )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( W Q2266397Angle A P B ) = _pi
                      /\
                      ( W Q2266397Angle C P D ) = _pi
                    )
                  )
                  ->

title: Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2266397
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q2266397), "Intersecting chords theorem": four
% cospherical points whose two pairs subtend angle pi at a common point have
% equal products of their distances from that point. This file contains no proof.

Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  squared_distance(p, q: P): real =
    inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  distance_value(length: real, p, q: P): bool =
    0 <= length
      AND length * length = squared_distance(p, q)

  on_sphere(p, center: P, radius: real): bool =
    distance_value(radius, p, center)

  cospherical(a, b, c, d: P): bool =
    EXISTS (center: P), (radius: real):
      on_sphere(a, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(b, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(c, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(d, center, radius)

  angle_at_is_pi(a, p, b: P): bool =
    EXISTS (pa, pb: real):
      distance_value(pa, p, a)
        AND distance_value(pb, p, b)
        AND 0 < pa
        AND 0 < pb
        AND inner(vsub(a, p), vsub(b, p)) = -(pa * pb)

  distance_product_identity(a, b, c, d, p: P): bool =
    EXISTS (ap, bp, cp, dp: real):
      distance_value(ap, a, p)
        AND distance_value(bp, b, p)
        AND distance_value(cp, c, p)
        AND distance_value(dp, d, p)
        AND ap * bp = cp * dp

  intersecting_chords_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, c, d, p: P):
        (cospherical(a, b, c, d)
          AND angle_at_is_pi(a, p, b)
          AND angle_at_is_pi(c, p, d))
        IMPLIES distance_product_identity(a, b, c, d, p)
END Q2266397_intersecting_chords_theorem

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2267175
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the squared distance from a
  point to a tangent point of a sphere equals the product of its
  distances to two points where a secant through it meets the sphere.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q2267175_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q2267175_zero : V;
  q2267175_add : V -> V -> V;
  q2267175_neg : V -> V;
  q2267175_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q2267175_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q2267175_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q2267175_add x (q2267175_add y z) =
      q2267175_add (q2267175_add x y) z;
  q2267175_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q2267175_add x y = q2267175_add y x;
  q2267175_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q2267175_add x q2267175_zero = x;
  q2267175_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q2267175_add x (q2267175_neg x) = q2267175_zero;

  q2267175_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q2267175_smul 1 x = x;
  q2267175_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q2267175_smul (a * b) x =
      q2267175_smul a (q2267175_smul b x);
  q2267175_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q2267175_smul a (q2267175_add x y) =
      q2267175_add (q2267175_smul a x) (q2267175_smul a y);
  q2267175_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q2267175_smul (a + b) x =
      q2267175_add (q2267175_smul a x) (q2267175_smul b x);

  q2267175_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q2267175_inner (q2267175_add x y) z =
      q2267175_inner x z + q2267175_inner y z;
  q2267175_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q2267175_inner (q2267175_smul a x) y =
      a * q2267175_inner x y;
  q2267175_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q2267175_inner x y = q2267175_inner y x;
  q2267175_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q2267175_inner x x;
  q2267175_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q2267175_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q2267175_zero
}.

Arguments q2267175_zero {V} _.
Arguments q2267175_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q2267175_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q2267175_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q2267175_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q2267175_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q2267175_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q2267175_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q2267175_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q2267175_vadd (q2267175_zero E) p = p;
  q2267175_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q2267175_vadd (q2267175_add E x y) p =
      q2267175_vadd x (q2267175_vadd y p);
  q2267175_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q2267175_vsub (q2267175_vadd x p) p = x;
  q2267175_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q2267175_vadd (q2267175_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q2267175_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q2267175_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q2267175_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q2267175_inner E x x).

Definition q2267175_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2267175_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q2267175_norm E (q2267175_vsub A p q).

Record q2267175_sphere (P : Type) : Type := {
  q2267175_center : P;
  q2267175_radius : R
}.

Arguments q2267175_center {P} _.
Arguments q2267175_radius {P} _.

Definition q2267175_mem_sphere
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2267175_affine_torsor V P E)
    (s : q2267175_sphere P)
    (x : P) : Prop :=
  q2267175_dist A x (q2267175_center s) = q2267175_radius s.

Definition q2267175_mem_line
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2267175_affine_torsor V P E)
    (a b p : P) : Prop :=
  exists lambda : R,
    p =
      q2267175_vadd A
        (q2267175_smul E lambda (q2267175_vsub A b a)) a.

Definition q2267175_is_tangent_at
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q2267175_affine_torsor V P E)
    (s : q2267175_sphere P)
    (t p : P) : Prop :=
  q2267175_mem_sphere A s t /\
  q2267175_inner E
    (q2267175_vsub A p t)
    (q2267175_vsub A t (q2267175_center s)) = 0.

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_Sphere_dist_sq_eq_mul_dist_of_tangent_and_secant :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q2267175_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q2267175_affine_torsor V P E)
         (a b t p : P)
         (s : q2267175_sphere P),
    q2267175_mem_sphere A s a ->
    q2267175_mem_sphere A s b ->
    q2267175_mem_line A a b p ->
    q2267175_is_tangent_at A s t p ->
    q2267175_dist A p t ^ 2 =
      q2267175_dist A p a * q2267175_dist A p b.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2267175 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem":
  in a real inner-product affine space, the squared distance along a tangent
  line equals the product of the distances from the same point to two sphere
  intersections on a secant line. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

record 'p q2267175_sphere =
  q2267175_center :: 'p
  q2267175_radius :: real

locale q2267175_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q2267175_vadd :: "'v::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q2267175_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q2267175_zero_vadd:
      "q2267175_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q2267175_add_vadd:
      "q2267175_vadd (u + v) p =
        q2267175_vadd u (q2267175_vadd v p)"
    and q2267175_vadd_vsub:
      "q2267175_vadd (q2267175_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q2267175_vsub_vadd:
      "q2267175_vsub (q2267175_vadd v p) p = v"
begin

definition q2267175_dist :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2267175_dist p q = norm (q2267175_vsub p q)"

definition q2267175_sphere_mem ::
    "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p q2267175_sphere \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2267175_sphere_mem x s \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2267175_dist x (q2267175_center s) = q2267175_radius s"

definition q2267175_line_mem ::
    "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2267175_line_mem x a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>r::real.
      x = q2267175_vadd (r *\<^sub>R q2267175_vsub a b) b)"

definition q2267175_is_tangent_at_line ::
    "'p q2267175_sphere \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2267175_is_tangent_at_line s t p \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2267175_sphere_mem t s \<and>
    q2267175_line_mem t p t \<and>
    (\<forall>x. q2267175_line_mem x p t \<longrightarrow>
      inner (q2267175_vsub x t)
        (q2267175_vsub t (q2267175_center s)) = 0)"

theorem tangent_secant_theorem:
  fixes a b t p :: 'p
    and s :: "'p q2267175_sphere"
  assumes first_secant_intersection:
      "q2267175_sphere_mem a s"
    and second_secant_intersection:
      "q2267175_sphere_mem b s"
    and point_on_secant:
      "q2267175_line_mem p a b"
    and tangent_at_t:
      "q2267175_is_tangent_at_line s t p"
  shows
      "q2267175_dist p t ^ 2 =
        q2267175_dist p a * q2267175_dist p b"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2267175
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the squared distance from a point
  to a tangent point of a sphere equals the product of its distances to two
  sphere points on a secant line. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2267175_TANGENT_SECANT_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!q:P. vadd zero q = q) /\
       (!v w:V. !q:P.
          vadd (add v w) q = vadd v (vadd w q)) /\
       (!v:V. !q:P. vsub (vadd v q) q = v) /\
       (!q r:P. vadd (vsub q r) r = q) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (v:V). sqrt (inner v v) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (q:P) (r:P).
       norm inner (vsub q r) in
  let affine_line =
    \(smul:real->V->V) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (q:P) (r:P) (x:P).
       ?c:real. vsub x q = smul c (vsub r q) in
  let sphere_mem =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (center:P) (radius:real) (x:P).
       distance inner vsub x center = radius in
  let tangent_at =
    \(smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
     (vsub:P->P->V) (center:P) (radius:real)
     (t:P) (p:P).
       sphere_mem inner vsub center radius t /\
       affine_line smul vsub p t t /\
       (!x:P.
          affine_line smul vsub p t x
          ==> inner (vsub x t) (vsub t center) = &0) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !center:P.
  !radius:real.
  !a b t p:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    sphere_mem inner vsub center radius a /\
    sphere_mem inner vsub center radius b /\
    affine_line smul vsub a b p /\
    tangent_at smul inner vsub center radius t p
    ==>
    distance inner vsub p t pow 2 =
    distance inner vsub p a * distance inner vsub p b`;;
