content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2267175
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem": in a real
-- Euclidean affine space, the squared distance from a point to a tangent point
-- of a sphere equals the product of its distances to two sphere points on a
-- secant line. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR squareRootR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and oneR != zeroR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

    square-root-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (squareRootR x)
    square-root-squareR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      multiplyR (squareRootR x) (squareRootR x) == x
    square-root-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      squareRootR x == zeroR
    square-root-uniqueR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      multiplyR y y == x ->
      y == squareRootR x

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {reals = reals} {space = space} affine p q =
  squareRootR reals
    (inner space (vsub affine p q) (vsub affine p q))

OnAffineLine :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
OnAffineLine {R} space affine a b x =
  Exists R
    (\ scalar ->
      x ==
      vadd affine
        (scaleV space scalar (vsub affine b a))
        a)

record Sphere {R P : Set} : Set where
  constructor sphere
  field
    center : P
    radius : R

open Sphere

OnSphere :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  Sphere {R} {P} ->
  P ->
  Set
OnSphere affine s x =
  distance affine x (center s) == radius s

record IsTangentAt
  {R V P : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P)
  (s : Sphere {R} {P})
  (t p : P) :
  Set where

  field
    tangent-point-on-sphere :
      OnSphere affine s t
    tangent-point-on-line :
      OnAffineLine space affine p t t
    line-is-orthogonal-to-radius :
      (x : P) ->
      OnAffineLine space affine p t x ->
      inner space
        (vsub affine x t)
        (vsub affine t (center s))
      ==
      zeroR reals

tangent-secant-theorem : Set1
tangent-secant-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b t p : P) ->
  (s : Sphere {R} {P}) ->
  OnSphere affine s a ->
  OnSphere affine s b ->
  OnAffineLine space affine a b p ->
  IsTangentAt space affine s t p ->
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine p t)
    (distance affine p t)
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine p a)
    (distance affine p b)

title: Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2267175 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the squared distance from
  a point to a tangent point of a sphere equals the product of its distances
  to two sphere points on a secant line. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q2267175_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2267175_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q2267175_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q2267175_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q2267175_norm_def",
  ``q2267175_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q2267175_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q2267175_dist_def",
  ``q2267175_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q2267175_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q2267175_on_sphere_def = new_definition (
  "q2267175_on_sphere_def",
  ``q2267175_on_sphere
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (centre : 'p)
      (radius : real)
      (x : 'p) <=>
      q2267175_dist inner vsub x centre = radius``);

val q2267175_on_line_def = new_definition (
  "q2267175_on_line_def",
  ``q2267175_on_line
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a : 'p)
      (b : 'p)
      (x : 'p) <=>
      ?r : real. x = vadd (smul r (vsub b a)) a``);

val q2267175_is_tangent_at_def = new_definition (
  "q2267175_is_tangent_at_def",
  ``q2267175_is_tangent_at
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (centre : 'p)
      (radius : real)
      (t : 'p)
      (p : 'p) <=>
      q2267175_on_sphere inner vsub centre radius t /\
      q2267175_on_line smul vadd vsub p t t /\
      (!x.
         q2267175_on_line smul vadd vsub p t x
         ==>
         inner (vsub x t) (vsub t centre) = 0)``);

val q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (centre : 'p)
      (radius : real)
      (a b t p : 'p).
      q2267175_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q2267175_on_sphere inner vsub centre radius a /\
      q2267175_on_sphere inner vsub centre radius b /\
      q2267175_on_line smul vadd vsub a b p /\
      q2267175_is_tangent_at
        smul inner vadd vsub centre radius t p
      ==>
      q2267175_dist inner vsub p t pow 2 =
        q2267175_dist inner vsub p a *
        q2267175_dist inner vsub p b``;

title: Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2267175
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, the squared distance from a
  point to a tangent point of a sphere equals the product of its distances
  to two sphere points on a secant line. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces represented by SetMM
  CPreHil structures whose scalar field is RRfld. Choosing an affine origin
  identifies the source normed affine torsor with this vector presentation
  while preserving differences, distances, affine lines, spheres, and
  orthogonality.

  W Q2267175Dist A B is the norm distance from A to B. W Q2267175Line A B P
  says that P lies in the affine span of A and B. W Q2267175Sphere O R is
  the sphere record with center O and arbitrary real radius R, represented
  by its membership set.

  W Q2267175Tangent O R T P states that T lies on that sphere and the
  direction from T to P is orthogonal to the radius from O to T. For the
  affine line through P and T, this is equivalent to the source structure
  IsTangentAt: T belongs to the sphere and line, and the whole line lies in
  the affine hyperplane through T orthogonal to the radius.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit
  bidirectional definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q2267175Dist Q2267175Line Q2267175Sphere Q2267175Tangent $.

q2267175-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q2267175Dist A B ) $.
q2267175-line-syntax $a wff ( W Q2267175Line A B P ) $.
q2267175-sphere-syntax $a class ( W Q2267175Sphere O R ) $.
q2267175-tangent-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q2267175Tangent O R T P ) $.

q2267175-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q2267175Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( B ( -g ` W ) A )
) $.

${
  $d A B P W x $.

  q2267175-line-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q2267175Line A B P )
    <->
    E. x e. RR
      P
      =
      (
        ( x ( .s ` W ) A )
        ( +g ` W )
        ( ( 1 - x ) ( .s ` W ) B )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d O R W X $.

  q2267175-sphere-definition $a |- (
    W Q2267175Sphere O R
  ) = {
    X e. ( Base ` W ) |
      ( W Q2267175Dist X O ) = R
  } $.
$}

q2267175-tangent-definition $a |- (
  ( W Q2267175Tangent O R T P )
  <->
  (
    T e. ( W Q2267175Sphere O R )
    /\
    (
      (
        ( P ( -g ` W ) T )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( T ( -g ` W ) O )
      )
      =
      0
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B O P R T W $.

  thousand-theorems-q2267175-tangent-secant $a |- A. W
    (
      (
        W e. CPreHil
        /\
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
      )
      ->
      A. O e. ( Base ` W )
        A. R e. RR
          A. A e. ( Base ` W )
            A. B e. ( Base ` W )
              A. T e. ( Base ` W )
                A. P e. ( Base ` W )
                  (
                    (
                      A e. ( W Q2267175Sphere O R )
                      /\
                      (
                        B e. ( W Q2267175Sphere O R )
                        /\
                        (
                          ( W Q2267175Line A B P )
                          /\
                          ( W Q2267175Tangent O R T P )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                    ->
                    (
                      ( ( W Q2267175Dist P T ) ^ 2 )
                      =
                      (
                        ( W Q2267175Dist P A )
                        x.
                        ( W Q2267175Dist P B )
                      )
                    )
                  )
    )
  $.
$}
