title: Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2267175
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q2267175), "Tangent-secant theorem": in an arbitrary
% real Euclidean affine space, the squared tangent distance equals the product
% of the two secant distances through the same point. This file contains no proof.

Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  sphere: TYPE = [# center: P, radius: real #]

  squared_distance(p, q: P): real =
    inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  distance_value(length: real, p, q: P): bool =
    0 <= length
      AND length * length = squared_distance(p, q)

  on_sphere(p: P, s: sphere): bool =
    distance_value(radius(s), p, center(s))

  on_line(x, a, b: P): bool =
    EXISTS (r: real):
      x = point_vadd(scale(r, vsub(b, a)), a)

  tangent_at_on_line(s: sphere, t, p: P): bool =
    on_sphere(t, s)
      AND on_line(t, p, t)
      AND (FORALL (x: P):
        on_line(x, p, t) IMPLIES
          inner(vsub(x, t), vsub(t, center(s))) = 0)

  tangent_secant_distance_identity(a, b, t, p: P): bool =
    EXISTS (pt, pa, pb: real):
      distance_value(pt, p, t)
        AND distance_value(pa, p, a)
        AND distance_value(pb, p, b)
        AND pt * pt = pa * pb

  tangent_secant_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, t, p: P), (s: sphere):
        (on_sphere(a, s)
          AND on_sphere(b, s)
          AND on_line(p, a, b)
          AND tangent_at_on_line(s, t, p))
        IMPLIES tangent_secant_distance_identity(a, b, t, p)
END Q2267175_tangent_secant_theorem

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2275191
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2275191), "Lebesgue differentiation theorem":
-- normalized local lower Lebesgue integrals of an almost-everywhere measurable
-- function converge almost everywhere to its value along a Vitali family. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Covering.VitaliFamily
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Average

@[expose] public section

open MeasureTheory Filter TopologicalSpace
open scoped ENNReal MeasureTheory Topology

namespace Q2275191

variable {α : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α] {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α}
  (v : VitaliFamily μ)

/-- Lebesgue differentiation for lower integrals along a Vitali family. -/
theorem ae_tendsto_lintegral_div [SecondCountableTopology α] [BorelSpace α]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
    (h'f : (∫⁻ y, f y ∂μ) ≠ ∞) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun a => (∫⁻ y in a, f y ∂μ) / μ a)
      (v.filterAt x) (𝓝 (f x)) := sorry

end Q2275191

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2275191
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2275191), "Lebesgue differentiation theorem":
  for an almost-everywhere measurable extended-nonnegative function with
  finite lower integral, its normalized integrals over sets shrinking to a
  point along a Vitali family converge almost everywhere to the function.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2275191_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q2275191_empty {A : Type} : q2275191_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q2275191_full {A : Type} : q2275191_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q2275191_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q2275191_set A) : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q2275191_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q2275191_set A) : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q2275191_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q2275191_set A) : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ ~ F x.

Definition q2275191_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2275191_set A) : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q2275191_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q2275191_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q2275191_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_sequence {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q2275191_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Record q2275191_pseudo_metric_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q2275191_dist : A -> A -> R;
  q2275191_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : A, 0 <= q2275191_dist x y;
  q2275191_dist_self :
    forall x : A, q2275191_dist x x = 0;
  q2275191_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : A, q2275191_dist x y = q2275191_dist y x;
  q2275191_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2275191_dist x z <=
      q2275191_dist x y + q2275191_dist y z
}.

Arguments q2275191_dist {A} _ _ _.

Definition q2275191_open_ball {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x => q2275191_dist M x center < radius.

Definition q2275191_closed_ball {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x => q2275191_dist M x center <= radius.

Definition q2275191_open {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (U : q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      q2275191_subset
        (q2275191_open_ball M x epsilon) U.

Definition q2275191_nonempty_interior {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (E : q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  exists (x : A) (epsilon : R),
    0 < epsilon /\
    q2275191_subset
      (q2275191_open_ball M x epsilon) E.

Definition q2275191_second_countable {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q2275191_set A,
    (forall n : nat, q2275191_open M (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q2275191_set A) (x : A),
      q2275191_open M U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\ q2275191_subset (basis n) U.

Inductive q2275191_ennreal : Type :=
| q2275191_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q2275191_ennreal
| q2275191_ennreal_infinity : q2275191_ennreal.

Arguments q2275191_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_zero : q2275191_ennreal :=
  q2275191_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q2275191_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity,
    q2275191_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_le
    (x y : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q2275191_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity,
    q2275191_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_lt
    (x y : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite b _ => a < b
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q2275191_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_below_real
    (x : q2275191_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_above_real
    (x : q2275191_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite value _ => bound < value
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_add
    (x y : q2275191_ennreal) : q2275191_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2275191_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q2275191_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q2275191_ennreal) : q2275191_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2275191_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a _, q2275191_ennreal_infinity
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity, q2275191_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q2275191_ennreal_zero
      else q2275191_ennreal_infinity
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity, q2275191_ennreal_infinity =>
      q2275191_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q2275191_div_nonnegative
    (a b : R) (ha : 0 <= a) (hb : 0 <= b)
    (hb0 : b <> 0) : 0 <= a / b :=
  eq_ind_r
    (fun value : R => 0 <= value)
    (Rmult_le_pos a (/ b) ha
      (Rlt_le 0 (/ b)
        (Rinv_0_lt_compat b
          (match Rle_lt_or_eq_dec 0 b hb with
           | left positive => positive
           | right zero =>
               False_rect (0 < b) (hb0 (eq_sym zero))
           end))))
    (Rdiv_def a b).

Definition q2275191_ennreal_div
    (x y : q2275191_ennreal) : q2275191_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      match Req_EM_T b 0 with
      | left _ =>
          match Req_EM_T a 0 with
          | left _ => q2275191_ennreal_zero
          | right _ => q2275191_ennreal_infinity
          end
      | right hb0 =>
          q2275191_ennreal_finite
            (a / b)
            (@q2275191_div_nonnegative a b ha hb hb0)
      end
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q2275191_ennreal_infinity =>
      q2275191_ennreal_zero
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity,
    q2275191_ennreal_finite _ _ =>
      q2275191_ennreal_infinity
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity,
    q2275191_ennreal_infinity =>
      q2275191_ennreal_zero
  end.

Fixpoint q2275191_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q2275191_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q2275191_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q2275191_ennreal_add
        (q2275191_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q2275191_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q2275191_ennreal,
      values value -> q2275191_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q2275191_ennreal,
      (forall value : q2275191_ennreal,
        values value -> q2275191_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q2275191_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q2275191_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (sum : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2275191_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q2275191_ennreal_eq value
          (q2275191_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q2275191_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q2275191_measurable : q2275191_set A -> Prop;
  q2275191_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_same_set E F ->
      (q2275191_measurable E <-> q2275191_measurable F);
  q2275191_measurable_empty :
    q2275191_measurable q2275191_empty;
  q2275191_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_measurable E ->
      q2275191_measurable (q2275191_complement E);
  q2275191_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q2275191_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2275191_measurable (E n)) ->
      q2275191_measurable (q2275191_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q2275191_measurable {A} _ _.

Definition q2275191_borel_measurable {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (E : q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  forall sigma : q2275191_measurable_space A,
    (forall U : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_open M U ->
      q2275191_measurable sigma U) ->
    q2275191_measurable sigma E.

Definition q2275191_borel_space {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (m : q2275191_measurable_space A) : Prop :=
  forall E : q2275191_set A,
    q2275191_measurable m E <->
    q2275191_borel_measurable M E.

Record q2275191_measure {A : Type}
    (m : q2275191_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q2275191_measure_value : q2275191_set A -> q2275191_ennreal;
  q2275191_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_same_set E F ->
      q2275191_ennreal_eq
        (q2275191_measure_value E)
        (q2275191_measure_value F);
  q2275191_measure_empty :
    q2275191_ennreal_eq
      (q2275191_measure_value q2275191_empty)
      q2275191_ennreal_zero;
  q2275191_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_subset E F ->
      q2275191_ennreal_le
        (q2275191_measure_value E)
        (q2275191_measure_value F);
  q2275191_measure_trim :
    forall E : q2275191_set A,
      exists F : q2275191_set A,
        q2275191_measurable m F /\
        q2275191_subset E F /\
        q2275191_ennreal_eq
          (q2275191_measure_value F)
          (q2275191_measure_value E);
  q2275191_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall E : nat -> q2275191_set A,
      exists total : q2275191_ennreal,
        q2275191_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q2275191_measure_value (E n)) total /\
        q2275191_ennreal_le
          (q2275191_measure_value
            (q2275191_countable_union E))
          total;
  q2275191_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q2275191_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2275191_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_sequence E ->
      q2275191_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q2275191_measure_value (E n))
        (q2275191_measure_value
          (q2275191_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q2275191_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Definition q2275191_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q2275191_set A,
    q2275191_measurable m null_set /\
    q2275191_ennreal_eq
      (q2275191_measure_value mu null_set)
      q2275191_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Definition q2275191_locally_finite {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    exists U : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_open M U /\
      U x /\
      q2275191_ennreal_lt
        (q2275191_measure_value mu U)
        q2275191_ennreal_infinity.

Definition q2275191_measurable_ennreal_function {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall bound : R,
    q2275191_measurable m
      (fun x => q2275191_ennreal_below_real (f x) bound).

Definition q2275191_ae_measurable_ennreal_function {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists g : A -> q2275191_ennreal,
    q2275191_measurable_ennreal_function mu g /\
    q2275191_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x => q2275191_ennreal_eq (f x) (g x)).

Definition q2275191_finite_partition {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q2275191_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q2275191_measurable m (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q2275191_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Record q2275191_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q2275191_nnreal_value : R;
  q2275191_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q2275191_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q2275191_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q2275191_nonnegative_real) : q2275191_ennreal :=
  q2275191_ennreal_finite
    (q2275191_nnreal_value x)
    (q2275191_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q2275191_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (value : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q2275191_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q2275191_set A),
    q2275191_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q2275191_ennreal_le
        (q2275191_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q2275191_ennreal_eq value
      (q2275191_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q2275191_ennreal_mul
            (q2275191_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q2275191_measure_value mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q2275191_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (value : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2275191_ennreal_supremum
    (q2275191_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q2275191_lintegral_not_infinite {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : q2275191_ennreal,
    q2275191_lintegral_has_value mu f value /\
    ~ q2275191_ennreal_eq
        value q2275191_ennreal_infinity.

Definition q2275191_indicator {A : Type}
    (E : q2275191_set A)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (x : A) : q2275191_ennreal :=
  if excluded_middle_informative (E x)
  then f x
  else q2275191_ennreal_zero.

Definition q2275191_restricted_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m)
    (f : A -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (E : q2275191_set A)
    (value : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2275191_lintegral_has_value mu
    (q2275191_indicator E f) value.

Definition q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_selected {A : Type}
    (selected : q2275191_set (A * q2275191_set A)) : Prop :=
  forall p q : A * q2275191_set A,
    selected p ->
    selected q ->
    p <> q ->
    q2275191_disjoint (snd p) (snd q).

Definition q2275191_selected_union {A : Type}
    (selected : q2275191_set (A * q2275191_set A))
    : q2275191_set A :=
  fun x =>
    exists p : A * q2275191_set A,
      selected p /\ snd p x.

Record q2275191_vitali_family {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    (mu : q2275191_measure m) : Type := {
  q2275191_sets_at :
    A -> q2275191_set (q2275191_set A);
  q2275191_vitali_measurable :
    forall (x : A) (E : q2275191_set A),
      q2275191_sets_at x E ->
      q2275191_measurable m E;
  q2275191_vitali_nonempty_interior :
    forall (x : A) (E : q2275191_set A),
      q2275191_sets_at x E ->
      q2275191_nonempty_interior M E;
  q2275191_vitali_nontrivial :
    forall (x : A) (epsilon : R),
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists E : q2275191_set A,
        q2275191_sets_at x E /\
        q2275191_subset E
          (q2275191_closed_ball M x epsilon);
  q2275191_vitali_covering :
    forall (s : q2275191_set A)
           (family : A -> q2275191_set (q2275191_set A)),
      (forall (x : A) (E : q2275191_set A),
        s x ->
        family x E ->
        q2275191_sets_at x E) ->
      (forall (x : A) (epsilon : R),
        s x ->
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists E : q2275191_set A,
          family x E /\
          q2275191_subset E
            (q2275191_closed_ball M x epsilon)) ->
      exists selected :
          q2275191_set (A * q2275191_set A),
        (forall p : A * q2275191_set A,
          selected p -> s (fst p)) /\
        q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_selected selected /\
        (forall p : A * q2275191_set A,
          selected p -> family (fst p) (snd p)) /\
        q2275191_ennreal_eq
          (q2275191_measure_value mu
            (q2275191_difference s
              (q2275191_selected_union selected)))
          q2275191_ennreal_zero
}.

Arguments q2275191_sets_at {A M m mu} _ _ _.

Definition q2275191_eventually_vitali {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    {mu : q2275191_measure m}
    (v : q2275191_vitali_family M mu)
    (x : A)
    (P : q2275191_set A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon /\
    forall E : q2275191_set A,
      q2275191_sets_at v x E ->
      q2275191_subset E
        (q2275191_closed_ball M x epsilon) ->
      P E.

Definition q2275191_tendsto_vitali_ennreal {A : Type}
    (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space A)
    {m : q2275191_measurable_space A}
    {mu : q2275191_measure m}
    (v : q2275191_vitali_family M mu)
    (x : A)
    (u : q2275191_set A -> q2275191_ennreal)
    (limit : q2275191_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match limit with
  | q2275191_ennreal_finite value _ =>
      forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        @q2275191_eventually_vitali A M m mu v x
          (fun E =>
            match u E with
            | q2275191_ennreal_finite term _ =>
                Rabs (term - value) < epsilon
            | q2275191_ennreal_infinity => False
            end)
  | q2275191_ennreal_infinity =>
      forall bound : R,
        @q2275191_eventually_vitali A M m mu v x
          (fun E =>
            q2275191_ennreal_above_real (u E) bound)
  end.

Theorem VitaliFamily_ae_tendsto_lintegral_div :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (M : q2275191_pseudo_metric_space Alpha)
         (m : q2275191_measurable_space Alpha)
         (mu : q2275191_measure m)
         (v : q2275191_vitali_family M mu)
         (f : Alpha -> q2275191_ennreal),
    q2275191_second_countable M ->
    q2275191_borel_space M m ->
    q2275191_locally_finite M mu ->
    q2275191_ae_measurable_ennreal_function mu f ->
    q2275191_lintegral_not_infinite mu f ->
    exists restricted_integral :
        q2275191_set Alpha -> q2275191_ennreal,
      (forall E : q2275191_set Alpha,
        q2275191_restricted_lintegral_has_value
          mu f E (restricted_integral E)) /\
      q2275191_almost_everywhere mu
        (fun x =>
          @q2275191_tendsto_vitali_ennreal
            Alpha M m mu v x
            (fun E =>
              q2275191_ennreal_div
                (restricted_integral E)
                (q2275191_measure_value mu E))
            (f x)).
Admitted.

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2275191,
  "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": an almost-everywhere measurable
  extended-nonnegative function with finite lower integral is recovered almost
  everywhere as the limit of its local integral averages along a Vitali family.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Set_Integral"
begin

definition q2275191_pseudometric ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_pseudometric d \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. d x x = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. 0 \<le> d x y) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. d x y = d y x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y z. d x z \<le> d x y + d y z)"

definition q2275191_ball ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q2275191_ball d x r = {y. d y x < r}"

definition q2275191_cball ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q2275191_cball d x r = {y. d y x \<le> r}"

definition q2275191_open ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_open d U \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> U. \<exists>r > 0. q2275191_ball d x r \<subseteq> U)"

definition q2275191_interior ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q2275191_interior d A =
      {x. \<exists>r > 0. q2275191_ball d x r \<subseteq> A}"

definition q2275191_second_countable ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_second_countable d \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>B :: 'a set set.
        countable B \<and>
        (\<forall>A \<in> B. q2275191_open d A) \<and>
        (\<forall>U x. q2275191_open d U \<longrightarrow> x \<in> U \<longrightarrow>
          (\<exists>A \<in> B. x \<in> A \<and> A \<subseteq> U)))"

definition q2275191_borel_measure ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_borel_measure d M \<longleftrightarrow>
      space M = UNIV \<and>
      sets M = sigma_sets UNIV {U. q2275191_open d U}"

definition q2275191_locally_finite ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_locally_finite d M \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. \<exists>U. q2275191_open d U \<and> x \<in> U \<and>
        emeasure M U < \<infinity>)"

definition q2275191_outer_null ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_outer_null M A \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>N \<in> sets M. A \<subseteq> N \<and> emeasure M N = 0)"

definition q2275191_vitali_family ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a set set) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_vitali_family d M V \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x A. A \<in> V x \<longrightarrow>
        A \<in> sets M \<and> q2275191_interior d A \<noteq> {}) \<and>
      (\<forall>x r. 0 < r \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>A \<in> V x. A \<subseteq> q2275191_cball d x r)) \<and>
      (\<forall>s F.
        (\<forall>x \<in> s. F x \<subseteq> V x) \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x \<in> s. \<forall>r > 0.
          \<exists>A \<in> F x. A \<subseteq> q2275191_cball d x r) \<longrightarrow>
        (\<exists>T :: ('a \<times> 'a set) set.
          (\<forall>p \<in> T. fst p \<in> s) \<and>
          pairwise (\<lambda>p q. disjnt (snd p) (snd q)) T \<and>
          (\<forall>p \<in> T. snd p \<in> F (fst p)) \<and>
          q2275191_outer_null M
            (s - (\<Union>p\<in>T. snd p))))"

definition q2275191_filter_at ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a set set) \<Rightarrow>
      'a \<Rightarrow> ('a set) filter"
  where
    "q2275191_filter_at d V x =
      (INF r\<in>{r::real. 0 < r}.
        principal {A. A \<in> V x \<and> A \<subseteq> q2275191_cball d x r})"

definition q2275191_ae_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q2275191_ae_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>g \<in> borel_measurable M. AE x in M. f x = g x)"

definition q2275191_set_lintegral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  where
    "q2275191_set_lintegral M f A =
      nn_integral M (\<lambda>x. indicator A x * f x)"

theorem lebesgue_differentiation_theorem:
  fixes d :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and M :: "'a measure"
    and V :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a set set"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  assumes pseudometric:
      "q2275191_pseudometric d"
    and second_countable:
      "q2275191_second_countable d"
    and borel_measure:
      "q2275191_borel_measure d M"
    and locally_finite:
      "q2275191_locally_finite d M"
    and vitali_family:
      "q2275191_vitali_family d M V"
    and f_ae_measurable:
      "q2275191_ae_measurable M f"
    and f_finite:
      "nn_integral M f \<noteq> \<infinity>"
  shows
      "AE x in M.
        filterlim
          (\<lambda>A. q2275191_set_lintegral M f A / emeasure M A)
          (nhds (f x))
          (q2275191_filter_at d V x)"
  sorry

end

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2275191,
  "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": for an a.e.-measurable extended-
  nonnegative function with finite integral, its integral averages over sets
  shrinking along a Vitali family converge to the function almost everywhere.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2275191_LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let einv =
      \(x:bool#real).
        if FST x
        then ezero
        else if SND x = &0
        then etop
        else (F,&1 / SND x) in
   let ediv =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real). emul x (einv y) in
   let eembed =
      \(z:bool#real).
        if FST z then &1 else SND z / (&1 + SND z) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let outer_measure =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s t:A->bool. s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool total:bool#real.
           esum (\n. mu (sets n)) total
           ==> ele (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) total) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        outer_measure mu /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           ?t:A->bool.
             events t /\
             s SUBSET t /\
             mu t = mu s) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real) (p:A->bool).
        ?n:A->bool.
          events n /\
          mu n = ezero /\
          {x:A | ~(p x)} SUBSET n in
   let is_pseudometric =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        (!x y:A. &0 <= d x y) /\
        (!x:A. d x x = &0) /\
        (!x y:A. d x y = d y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let open_ball =
      \(d:A->A->real) (x:A) (r:real).
        {y:A | d y x < r} in
   let closed_ball =
      \(d:A->A->real) (x:A) (r:real).
        {y:A | d y x <= r} in
   let metric_open =
      \(d:A->A->real) (u:A->bool).
        !x:A.
          x IN u
          ==> ?r:real.
                &0 < r /\
                open_ball d x r SUBSET u in
   let second_countable =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        ?basis:(A->bool)->bool.
          COUNTABLE basis /\
          (!b:A->bool. b IN basis ==> metric_open d b) /\
          (!u:A->bool x:A.
             metric_open d u /\ x IN u
             ==> ?b:A->bool.
                   b IN basis /\ x IN b /\ b SUBSET u) in
   let borel_space =
      \(d:A->A->real) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!u:A->bool. metric_open d u ==> events u) /\
        (!other:(A->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!u:A->bool. metric_open d u ==> other u)
           ==> !s:A->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let locally_finite_measure =
      \(d:A->A->real) (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !x:A.
          ?u:A->bool.
            metric_open d u /\
            x IN u /\
            ~(FST (mu u)) in
   let interior_nonempty =
      \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
        ?x:A r:real.
          &0 < r /\
          open_ball d x r SUBSET s in
   let fine_subfamily_on =
      \(d:A->A->real)
       (sets_at:A->(A->bool)->bool)
       (f:A->(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->bool).
        (!x:A a:A->bool.
           x IN s /\ f x a ==> sets_at x a) /\
        (!x:A.
           x IN s
           ==> !r:real.
                 &0 < r
                 ==> ?a:A->bool.
                       f x a /\
                       a SUBSET closed_ball d x r) in
   let disjoint_subfamily_cover =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:A->bool).
        ?chosen:(A#(A->bool))->bool.
          (!p:A#(A->bool).
             p IN chosen
             ==> FST p IN s /\ f (FST p) (SND p)) /\
          (!p q:A#(A->bool).
             p IN chosen /\ q IN chosen /\ ~(p = q)
             ==> DISJOINT (SND p) (SND q)) /\
          mu
            (s DIFF
             {y:A |
                ?p:A#(A->bool).
                  p IN chosen /\ y IN SND p}) = ezero in
   let vitali_family =
      \(d:A->A->real)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (sets_at:A->(A->bool)->bool).
        (!x:A a:A->bool.
           sets_at x a
           ==> events a /\ interior_nonempty d a) /\
        (!x:A r:real.
           &0 < r
           ==> ?a:A->bool.
                 sets_at x a /\
                 a SUBSET closed_ball d x r) /\
        (!f:A->(A->bool)->bool s:A->bool.
           fine_subfamily_on d sets_at f s
           ==> disjoint_subfamily_cover events mu f s) in
   let sequence_etends =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n)) /\
        (!e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> ?n:num.
                 !k:num.
                   n <= k
                   ==> abs(eembed (u k) - eembed l) < e) in
   let simple_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s (UNIV:A->bool)) /\
        (!c:bool#real. events {x:A | s x = c}) in
   let measurable_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (f:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. enonnegative (f x)) /\
        ?s:num->A->bool#real.
          (!n. simple_ennreal events (s n)) /\
          (!x:A. sequence_etends (\n. s n x) (f x)) in
   let aemeasurable_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. enonnegative (f x)) /\
        ?g:A->bool#real.
          measurable_ennreal events g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x:A. f x = g x) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x:bool#real. x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n:num enum:num->bool#real partial:num->bool#real.
          (!x:bool#real.
             x IN items <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s (UNIV:A->bool))
          (\c:bool#real. emul c (mu {x:A | s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\
           (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele v w)
           ==> ele z w) in
   let lintegral =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v:bool#real.
               ?s:A->bool#real.
                 simple_ennreal events s /\
                 (!x:A. ele (s x) (f x)) /\
                 simple_lintegral mu s v)
            z in
   let set_lintegral =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->bool#real)
       (a:A->bool).
        lintegral events mu
          (\x:A. if x IN a then f x else ezero) in
   let tends_along_vitali =
      \(d:A->A->real)
       (sets_at:A->(A->bool)->bool)
       (x:A)
       (g:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (l:bool#real).
        enonnegative l /\
        (!a:A->bool. sets_at x a ==> enonnegative (g a)) /\
        (!e:real.
           &0 < e
           ==> ?r:real.
                 &0 < r /\
                 !a:A->bool.
                   sets_at x a /\
                   a SUBSET closed_ball d x r
                   ==> abs(eembed (g a) - eembed l) < e) in
   !d:A->A->real
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    sets_at:A->(A->bool)->bool
    f:A->bool#real.
      is_pseudometric d /\
      second_countable d /\
      borel_space d events /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      locally_finite_measure d mu /\
      vitali_family d events mu sets_at /\
      aemeasurable_ennreal events mu f /\
      ~(lintegral events mu f = etop)
      ==>
      almost_everywhere events mu
        (\x:A.
           tends_along_vitali d sets_at x
             (\a:A->bool.
                ediv (set_lintegral events mu f a) (mu a))
             (f x))`;;

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2275191,
;; "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": normalized lower Lebesgue integrals
;; along a Vitali family converge almost everywhere to an almost-everywhere
;; measurable extended-nonnegative function of finite integral.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The conservative interfaces range over unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The
;; predicates below explicitly impose the complete ordered real field,
;; extended-nonnegative-real, pseudometric, Borel, measure, lower-integral,
;; local-finiteness, and Vitali-family laws used in the source statement.

(defstub q2275191-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q2275191-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q2275191-domain-member-p (domain value) t)
(defstub q2275191-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q2275191-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q2275191-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q2275191-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q2275191-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q2275191-distance-value (distance left right) t)
(defstub q2275191-family-member-p (families point set) t)
(defstub q2275191-selection-member-p (selection center set) t)
(defstub q2275191-lintegral-value
  (lintegral real domain measurable measure function) t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the reals.

(defun q2275191-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2275191-r-less real right left)))

(defun q2275191-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q2275191-r-add real left (q2275191-r-negate real right)))

(defun q2275191-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q2275191-r-less real value (q2275191-r-zero real))
      (q2275191-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-r-member-p real x)
      (q2275191-r-member-p real y)
      (q2275191-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q2275191-r-zero real))
            (one (q2275191-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q2275191-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q2275191-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q2275191-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q2275191-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q2275191-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q2275191-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q2275191-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q2275191-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q2275191-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q2275191-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q2275191-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q2275191-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q2275191-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q2275191-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q2275191-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q2275191-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q2275191-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q2275191-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q2275191-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q2275191-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q2275191-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q2275191-r-multiply
          real x (q2275191-r-add real y z))
         (q2275191-r-add
          real
          (q2275191-r-multiply real x y)
          (q2275191-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-r-member-p real x)
      (q2275191-r-member-p real y)
      (q2275191-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q2275191-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q2275191-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q2275191-r-less real x y)
         (q2275191-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2275191-r-less real x y)
          (q2275191-r-less real y z))
         (q2275191-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q2275191-r-less real x y)
         (q2275191-r-less
          real
          (q2275191-r-add real x z)
          (q2275191-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2275191-r-less real zero x)
          (q2275191-r-less real zero y))
         (q2275191-r-less
          real zero
          (q2275191-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q2275191-r-member-p real x)
     (q2275191-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-r-member-p real x)
      (q2275191-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q2275191-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q2275191-r-member-p real bound)
     (q2275191-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2275191-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q2275191-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2275191-r-member-p real bound)
       (q2275191-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q2275191-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q2275191-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q2275191-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q2275191-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q2275191-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q2275191-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q2275191-r-zero real))
        (one (q2275191-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q2275191-r-member-p real zero)
     (q2275191-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q2275191-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q2275191-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q2275191-r-less real zero one)
     (q2275191-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals with the source conventions 0 * infinity = 0,
;; 0 / 0 = 0, and infinity / infinity = 0.

(defun q2275191-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q2275191-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q2275191-finite)
    (q2275191-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q2275191-r-leq
     real (q2275191-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q2275191-finite value))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q2275191-ennreal-finite (q2275191-r-zero real)))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q2275191-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q2275191-top) t)
   (t (q2275191-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2275191-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q2275191-top)
          (equal right :q2275191-top))
      :q2275191-top
    (q2275191-ennreal-finite
     (q2275191-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q2275191-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q2275191-top)
        (equal right :q2275191-top))
    :q2275191-top)
   (t
    (q2275191-ennreal-finite
     (q2275191-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-divide (real numerator denominator)
  (cond
   ((equal numerator (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
    (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
   ((equal denominator (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
    :q2275191-top)
   ((equal denominator :q2275191-top)
    (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
   ((equal numerator :q2275191-top)
    :q2275191-top)
   (t
    (q2275191-ennreal-finite
     (q2275191-r-multiply
      real
      (cdr numerator)
      (q2275191-r-inverse real (cdr denominator)))))))

;; Arbitrary subsets, sigma algebras, and countably additive measures.

(defun-sk q2275191-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-set-member-p set x)
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q2275191-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p left x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-subset-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p left x))
     (q2275191-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q2275191-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (not (q2275191-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p complement x)
      (not (q2275191-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2275191-valid-set-p
      domain (q2275191-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2275191-set-member-p
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q2275191-sequence-union-set-p (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p union x)
      (q2275191-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-sequence-p
    (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-sigma-extensional-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q2275191-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-sigma-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q2275191-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-empty-exists-p
    (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q2275191-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q2275191-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-complements-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q2275191-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q2275191-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-unions-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q2275191-measurable-sequence-p measurable sequence))
     (q2275191-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q2275191-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q2275191-sigma-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q2275191-sigma-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q2275191-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q2275191-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q2275191-measurable-unions-p domain measurable)))

(defun-sk q2275191-disjoint-sets-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q2275191-set-member-p left x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-pairwise-disjoint-sequence-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and (natp m) (natp n) (not (equal m n)))
     (q2275191-disjoint-sets-p
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q2275191-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q2275191-ennreal-zero real)
    (q2275191-ennreal-add
     real
     (q2275191-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q2275191-measure-value
      measure
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q2275191-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2275191-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2275191-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2275191-ennreal-p real total)
     (q2275191-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2275191-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q2275191-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q2275191-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q2275191-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q2275191-measure-value measure left)
      (q2275191-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measure-values-p (real domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2275191-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q2275191-ennreal-p
      real (q2275191-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q2275191-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q2275191-measure-value measure empty)
      (q2275191-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-countably-additive-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q2275191-measurable-sequence-p measurable sequence)
      (q2275191-pairwise-disjoint-sequence-p sequence)
      (q2275191-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q2275191-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q2275191-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun q2275191-measure-space-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q2275191-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q2275191-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q2275191-measure-values-p real domain measure)
   (q2275191-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q2275191-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)))

;; Null sets use outer-measure semantics: an arbitrary set is null when it is
;; contained in a measurable set of measure zero.

(defun-sk q2275191-null-cover-p
    (real domain measurable measure bad-set)
  (exists (cover)
    (and
     (q2275191-valid-set-p domain bad-set)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable cover)
     (q2275191-subset-p domain bad-set cover)
     (equal
      (q2275191-measure-value measure cover)
      (q2275191-ennreal-zero real)))))

;; Pseudometric topology, second countability, its Borel sigma algebra, and
;; local finiteness.

(defun-sk q2275191-pseudometric-laws-p
    (real domain distance)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain y)
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain z))
     (let ((dxy (q2275191-distance-value distance x y))
           (dyz (q2275191-distance-value distance y z))
           (dxz (q2275191-distance-value distance x z)))
       (and
        (q2275191-r-member-p real dxy)
        (q2275191-r-member-p real dyz)
        (q2275191-r-member-p real dxz)
        (q2275191-r-leq real (q2275191-r-zero real) dxy)
        (equal
         (q2275191-distance-value distance x x)
         (q2275191-r-zero real))
        (equal dxy (q2275191-distance-value distance y x))
        (q2275191-r-leq
         real dxz (q2275191-r-add real dxy dyz)))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-open-ball-p
    (real domain distance center radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p set x)
      (q2275191-r-less
       real
       (q2275191-distance-value distance x center)
       radius)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-closed-ball-subset-p
    (real domain distance center radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-r-leq
       real
       (q2275191-distance-value distance x center)
       radius))
     (q2275191-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q2275191-set-subset-closed-ball-p
    (real domain distance set center radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p set x))
     (q2275191-r-leq
      real
      (q2275191-distance-value distance x center)
      radius))))

(defun-sk q2275191-open-radius-exists-p
    (real domain distance set x)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q2275191-r-member-p real radius)
     (q2275191-r-less
      real (q2275191-r-zero real) radius)
     (q2275191-closed-ball-subset-p
      real domain distance x radius set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-metric-open-interior-p
    (real domain distance set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p set x))
     (q2275191-open-radius-exists-p
      real domain distance set x))))

(defun q2275191-metric-open-p (real domain distance set)
  (and
   (q2275191-valid-set-p domain set)
   (q2275191-metric-open-interior-p
    real domain distance set)))

(defun-sk q2275191-basis-open-p
    (real domain distance basis)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2275191-metric-open-p
      real domain distance
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value basis n)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-basis-refinement-exists-p
    (domain basis set x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2275191-set-member-p
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value basis n)
      x)
     (q2275191-subset-p
      domain
      (q2275191-set-sequence-value basis n)
      set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-basis-refines-p
    (real domain distance basis)
  (forall (set x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-metric-open-p real domain distance set)
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p set x))
     (q2275191-basis-refinement-exists-p
      domain basis set x))))

(defun q2275191-second-countable-basis-p
    (real domain distance basis)
  (and
   (q2275191-set-sequence-p domain basis)
   (q2275191-basis-open-p real domain distance basis)
   (q2275191-basis-refines-p real domain distance basis)))

(defun-sk q2275191-second-countable-p
    (real domain distance)
  (exists (basis)
    (q2275191-second-countable-basis-p
     real domain distance basis)))

(defun-sk q2275191-all-opens-measurable-p
    (real domain distance measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2275191-metric-open-p real domain distance set)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-borel-minimal-p
    (real domain distance measurable)
  (forall (other set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-sigma-algebra-p domain other)
      (q2275191-all-opens-measurable-p
       real domain distance other)
      (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable set))
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p other set))))

(defun q2275191-borel-space-p
    (real domain distance measurable)
  (and
   (q2275191-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q2275191-all-opens-measurable-p
    real domain distance measurable)
   (q2275191-borel-minimal-p
    real domain distance measurable)))

(defun-sk q2275191-finite-ball-exists-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure x)
  (exists (radius ball)
    (and
     (q2275191-r-member-p real radius)
     (q2275191-r-less
      real (q2275191-r-zero real) radius)
     (q2275191-open-ball-p
      real domain distance x radius ball)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable ball)
     (not
      (equal
       (q2275191-measure-value measure ball)
       :q2275191-top)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-locally-finite-measure-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2275191-finite-ball-exists-p
      real domain distance measurable measure x))))

;; Almost-everywhere measurable extended-nonnegative functions.

(defun-sk q2275191-ennreal-function-p
    (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2275191-ennreal-p
      real (q2275191-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-upper-ray-preimage-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p set x)
      (q2275191-ennreal-less
       real threshold
       (q2275191-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-upper-ray-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q2275191-upper-ray-preimage-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-measurable-upper-rays-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (implies
     (q2275191-ennreal-p real threshold)
     (q2275191-upper-ray-preimage-exists-p
      real domain measurable function threshold))))

(defun q2275191-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (and
   (q2275191-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
   (q2275191-measurable-upper-rays-p
    real domain measurable function)))

(defun-sk q2275191-difference-set-p
    (domain left right bad)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p bad x)
      (not
       (equal
        (q2275191-function-value left x)
        (q2275191-function-value right x)))))))

(defun q2275191-ae-equal-data-p
    (real domain measurable measure left right bad cover)
  (and
   (q2275191-valid-set-p domain bad)
   (q2275191-difference-set-p domain left right bad)
   (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable cover)
   (q2275191-subset-p domain bad cover)
   (equal
    (q2275191-measure-value measure cover)
    (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))))

(defun-sk q2275191-ae-equal-p
    (real domain measurable measure left right)
  (exists (bad cover)
    (q2275191-ae-equal-data-p
     real domain measurable measure left right bad cover)))

(defun-sk q2275191-aemeasurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q2275191-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q2275191-measurable-ennreal-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q2275191-ae-equal-p
      real domain measurable measure function representative))))

;; The lower Lebesgue integral is the least upper bound of integrals of
;; measurable finite-range simple functions below the integrand.

(defun-sk q2275191-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (equal (q2275191-function-value function x) value))))

(defun q2275191-values-attained-p
    (domain function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q2275191-value-attained-p
        domain function (car values))
       (q2275191-values-attained-p
        domain function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q2275191-ennreal-value-list-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q2275191-ennreal-p real (car values))
       (q2275191-ennreal-value-list-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q2275191-range-in-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (member-equal
      (q2275191-function-value function x)
      values))))

(defun-sk q2275191-fiber-set-p
    (domain function value set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q2275191-set-member-p set x)
      (equal
       (q2275191-function-value function x)
       value)))))

(defun q2275191-fiber-list-p
    (domain measurable function values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (consp fibers)
       (q2275191-fiber-set-p
        domain function (car values) (car fibers))
       (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable (car fibers))
       (q2275191-fiber-list-p
        domain measurable function (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (equal fibers nil)))

(defun q2275191-simple-integral
    (real measure values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (q2275191-ennreal-add
       real
       (q2275191-ennreal-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q2275191-measure-value measure (car fibers)))
       (q2275191-simple-integral
        real measure (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (q2275191-ennreal-zero real)))

(defun q2275191-simple-function-data-p
    (real domain measurable function values fibers)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (true-listp fibers)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q2275191-ennreal-value-list-p real values)
   (q2275191-values-attained-p domain function values)
   (q2275191-range-in-values-p domain function values)
   (q2275191-fiber-list-p
    domain measurable function values fibers)))

(defun-sk q2275191-simple-below-p
    (real domain simple function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2275191-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2275191-function-value simple x)
      (q2275191-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values fibers)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-simple-function-data-p
       real domain measurable simple values fibers)
      (q2275191-simple-below-p
       real domain simple function))
     (q2275191-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2275191-simple-integral
       real measure values fibers)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2275191-lintegral-least-p
    (real domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-ennreal-p real bound)
      (q2275191-lintegral-upper-bound-p
       real domain measurable measure function bound))
     (q2275191-ennreal-leq real value bound))))

(defun q2275191-lintegral-result-p
    (real domain measurable measure function value)
  (and
   (q2275191-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
   (q2275191-ennreal-p real value)
   (q2275191-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    real domain measurable measure function value)
   (q2275191-lintegral-least-p
    real domain measurable measure function value)))

(defun-sk q2275191-lintegral-operation-p
    (real domain measurable lintegral)
  (forall (measure function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-measure-space-p
       real domain measurable measure)
      (q2275191-ennreal-function-p real domain function))
     (q2275191-lintegral-result-p
      real domain measurable measure function
      (q2275191-lintegral-value
       lintegral real domain measurable measure function)))))

;; Function-space closure supplies the exact indicator restriction used to
;; express the set lower integral.  DEFCHOOSE keeps this auxiliary internal.

(defun-sk q2275191-restricted-function-p
    (real domain function set restricted)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q2275191-ennreal-function-p real domain restricted)
     (implies
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q2275191-function-value restricted x)
       (if (q2275191-set-member-p set x)
           (q2275191-function-value function x)
         (q2275191-ennreal-zero real)))))))

(defun-sk q2275191-restriction-exists-p
    (real domain function set)
  (exists (restricted)
    (q2275191-restricted-function-p
     real domain function set restricted)))

(defun-sk q2275191-function-space-closure-p
    (real domain)
  (forall (function set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
      (q2275191-valid-set-p domain set))
     (q2275191-restriction-exists-p
      real domain function set))))

(defchoose q2275191-restricted-function
    (restricted)
    (real domain function set)
  (q2275191-restricted-function-p
   real domain function set restricted))

(defun q2275191-normalized-integral
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function set)
  (q2275191-ennreal-divide
   real
   (q2275191-lintegral-value
    lintegral real domain measurable measure
    (q2275191-restricted-function
     real domain function set))
   (q2275191-measure-value measure set)))

;; Full Vitali-family structure: measurable sets with nonempty interior, fine
;; at every point, and the disjoint covering property for every fine
;; point-indexed subfamily, with an outer-null uncovered remainder.

(defun-sk q2275191-family-subset-p
    (left right point)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2275191-family-member-p left point set)
     (q2275191-family-member-p right point set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-fine-set-exists-p
    (real domain distance families point radius)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q2275191-family-member-p families point set)
     (q2275191-set-subset-closed-ball-p
      real domain distance set point radius))))

(defun-sk q2275191-family-fine-at-p
    (real domain distance families point)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-r-member-p real radius)
      (q2275191-r-less
       real (q2275191-r-zero real) radius))
     (q2275191-fine-set-exists-p
      real domain distance families point radius))))

(defun-sk q2275191-interior-nonempty-p
    (real domain distance set)
  (exists (center radius)
    (and
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain center)
     (q2275191-r-member-p real radius)
     (q2275191-r-less
      real (q2275191-r-zero real) radius)
     (q2275191-closed-ball-subset-p
      real domain distance center radius set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-selection-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (selection)
  (forall (left-center left-set right-center right-set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-selection-member-p
       selection left-center left-set)
      (q2275191-selection-member-p
       selection right-center right-set)
      (or
       (not (equal left-center right-center))
       (not (equal left-set right-set))))
     (q2275191-disjoint-sets-p left-set right-set))))

(defun-sk q2275191-point-covered-p (selection point)
  (exists (center set)
    (and
     (q2275191-selection-member-p selection center set)
     (q2275191-set-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q2275191-subfamilies-fine-on-source-p
    (real domain distance families source subfamilies)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p source x))
     (and
      (q2275191-family-subset-p subfamilies families x)
      (q2275191-family-fine-at-p
       real domain distance subfamilies x)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-selection-valid-p
    (domain source subfamilies selection)
  (forall (center set)
    (implies
     (q2275191-selection-member-p selection center set)
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain center)
      (q2275191-set-member-p source center)
      (q2275191-family-member-p subfamilies center set)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-uncovered-in-null-cover-p
    (domain source selection null-cover)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-set-member-p source x)
      (not (q2275191-point-covered-p selection x)))
     (q2275191-set-member-p null-cover x))))

(defun q2275191-vitali-covering-data-p
    (real domain measurable measure source subfamilies selection null-cover)
  (and
   (q2275191-selection-pairwise-disjoint-p selection)
   (q2275191-selection-valid-p
    domain source subfamilies selection)
   (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable null-cover)
   (equal
    (q2275191-measure-value measure null-cover)
    (q2275191-ennreal-zero real))
   (q2275191-uncovered-in-null-cover-p
    domain source selection null-cover)))

(defun-sk q2275191-vitali-covering-exists-p
    (real domain measurable measure source subfamilies)
  (exists (selection null-cover)
    (q2275191-vitali-covering-data-p
     real domain measurable measure source subfamilies
     selection null-cover)))

(defun-sk q2275191-vitali-covering-property-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure families)
  (forall (source subfamilies)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-valid-set-p domain source)
      (q2275191-subfamilies-fine-on-source-p
       real domain distance families source subfamilies))
     (q2275191-vitali-covering-exists-p
      real domain measurable measure source subfamilies))))

(defun-sk q2275191-family-regions-p
    (real domain distance measurable families)
  (forall (x set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q2275191-family-member-p families x set))
     (and
      (q2275191-valid-set-p domain set)
      (q2275191-measurable-set-p measurable set)
      (q2275191-interior-nonempty-p
       real domain distance set)))))

(defun-sk q2275191-family-fine-everywhere-p
    (real domain distance families)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2275191-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q2275191-family-fine-at-p
      real domain distance families x))))

(defun q2275191-vitali-family-p
    (real domain distance measurable measure families)
  (and
