title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2275191,
-- "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": along a Vitali family, normalized set
-- lower integrals of an almost-everywhere measurable nonnegative function
-- converge to its value almost everywhere. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List)
open import Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure
open NonnegativeReal
open Filter

infix 4 _!=1_

_!=1_ :
  {A : Set1} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set1
x !=1 y =
  Not1 (x == y)

record BothLarge (A : Set) (B : Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor both-large
  field
    small-part : A
    large-part : B

record ExistsLarge (A : Set) (P : A -> Set1) : Set1 where
  constructor witness-large
  field
    large-value    : A
    large-property : P large-value

record ExistsHigh (A : Set1) (P : A -> Set) : Set1 where
  constructor witness-high
  field
    high-value    : A
    high-property : P high-value

record PseudoMetricSpace
  (R A : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    distance :
      A -> A -> R
    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (distance x y)
    distance-self :
      (x : A) ->
      distance x x == zeroR reals
    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      distance x y == distance y x
    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance x z)
        (addR reals (distance x y) (distance y z))

open PseudoMetricSpace

ClosedBall :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  A ->
  R ->
  Predicate A
ClosedBall {reals = reals} metric center radius x =
  lessOrEqualR reals (distance metric x center) radius

OpenBall :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  A ->
  R ->
  Predicate A
OpenBall {reals = reals} metric center radius x =
  StrictLess reals (distance metric x center) radius

MetricOpen :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
MetricOpen {R = R} {A = A} {reals = reals} metric U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        (Subset (OpenBall metric x radius) U))

InteriorNonempty :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
InteriorNonempty {R = R} {A = A} {reals = reals} metric S =
  Exists A
    (\ x ->
      Exists R
        (\ radius ->
          Both
            (Positive reals radius)
            (Subset (OpenBall metric x radius) S)))

record SecondCountableMetric
  {R A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals) : Set2 where
  field
    countable-basis :
      Nat -> Predicate A
    basis-open :
      (n : Nat) ->
      MetricOpen metric (countable-basis n)
    basis-refines :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      MetricOpen metric U ->
      (x : A) ->
      U x ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Both
            (countable-basis n x)
            (Subset (countable-basis n) U))

data BorelGenerated
  {R A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals) :
  Predicate A -> Set1 where

  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate A} ->
    MetricOpen metric U ->
    BorelGenerated metric U

  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated metric emptySet

  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate A} ->
    BorelGenerated metric S ->
    BorelGenerated metric (complement S)

  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated metric (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated metric (countableUnion sets)

  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate A} ->
    ((x : A) -> Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated metric S ->
    BorelGenerated metric T

record BorelSpace
  {R A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) : Set2 where
  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      BorelGenerated metric S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated metric S

IsLocallyFiniteMeasure :
  {R M A : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Set
IsLocallyFiniteMeasure {R = R} {A = A} {reals = reals}
  {extended = extended} metric measure =
  (x : A) ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        (outerMass measure (ClosedBall metric x radius) !=
          infinityM extended))

record IndexedSimpleBelowM
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (f : A -> M) : Set where
  field
    simple-cutoff :
      Nat
    simple-index :
      A -> Nat
    simple-values :
      Nat -> M
    simple-index-within :
      (x : A) ->
      simple-index x <=N simple-cutoff
    simple-fiber-measurable :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simple-cutoff ->
      measurable events (\ x -> simple-index x == i)
    simple-below :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended
        (simple-values (simple-index x))
        (f x)

open IndexedSimpleBelowM

indexedSimpleIntegralM :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  {f : A -> M} ->
  IndexedSimpleBelowM events extended f ->
  M
indexedSimpleIntegralM extended measure simple =
  sumThroughM extended
    (\ i ->
      multiplyM extended
        (simple-values simple i)
        (outerMass measure
          (\ x -> simple-index simple x == i)))
    (simple-cutoff simple)

record SimpleIntegralCandidateM
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> M)
  (candidate : M) : Set where
  field
    candidate-simple :
      IndexedSimpleBelowM events extended f
    candidate-equation :
      candidate ==
      indexedSimpleIntegralM extended measure candidate-simple

canonicalLIntegralM :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  Measure extended events ->
  (A -> M) ->
  M
canonicalLIntegralM extended measure f =
  supremumM extended
    (\ candidate ->
      SimpleIntegralCandidateM extended measure f candidate)

MeasurableOrder :
  {A V : Set} ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (A -> V) ->
  Set
MeasurableOrder events le f =
  (ray : OrderRay _) ->
  measurable events (\ x -> RayContains le ray (f x))

AEMeasurableOrder :
  {A R M V : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  Measure extended events ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (A -> V) ->
  Set
AEMeasurableOrder {A = A} events measure le f =
  Exists (A -> _)
    (\ representative ->
      Both
        (MeasurableOrder events le representative)
        (AlmostEverywhere measure
          (\ x -> f x == representative x)))

record MeasureRestriction
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set2 where
  field
    restrict :
      Measure extended events ->
      Predicate A ->
      Measure extended events
    restrict-on-measurable :
      (measure : Measure extended events) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      (T : Predicate A) ->
      outerMass (restrict measure S) T ==
      outerMass measure (intersection T S)

open MeasureRestriction

SetLIntegral :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals} ->
  MeasureRestriction events extended ->
  Measure extended events ->
  Predicate A ->
  (A -> M) ->
  M
SetLIntegral {extended = extended} restrictions measure S f =
  canonicalLIntegralM extended (restrict restrictions measure S) f

record ENNRealReciprocal
  {R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) : Set1 where
  field
    reciprocalM :
      M -> M
    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalM (zeroM extended) == infinityM extended
    reciprocal-infinity :
      reciprocalM (infinityM extended) == zeroM extended
    reciprocal-finite-zero :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x == zeroR reals ->
      reciprocalM (finiteNN extended x) == infinityM extended
    reciprocal-finite-positive :
      (x : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
      realValue x != zeroR reals ->
      Exists (NonnegativeReal reals)
        (\ inverse ->
          Both
            (realValue inverse ==
              reciprocalR reals (realValue x))
            (reciprocalM (finiteNN extended x) ==
              finiteNN extended inverse))

open ENNRealReciprocal

divideM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealReciprocal extended ->
  M ->
  M ->
  M
divideM extended reciprocal x y =
  multiplyM extended x (reciprocalM reciprocal y)

SetFamily :
  Set ->
  Set1
SetFamily A =
  Predicate A -> Set

SelectedUnion :
  {A I : Set} ->
  (I -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
SelectedUnion {I = I} selected x =
  Exists I (\ i -> selected i x)

SetDifference :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
SetDifference S T x =
  Both (S x) (Not (T x))

record CoveringSelection
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (S : Predicate A)
  (family : A -> SetFamily A) : Set1 where
  field
    selected-index :
      Set
    selected-center :
      selected-index -> A
    selected-region :
      selected-index -> Predicate A
    selected-centers-in-S :
      (i : selected-index) ->
      S (selected-center i)
    selected-pairwise-disjoint :
      (i j : selected-index) ->
      i != j ->
      (x : A) ->
      selected-region i x ->
      selected-region j x ->
      Bottom
    selected-from-family :
      (i : selected-index) ->
      family (selected-center i) (selected-region i)
    covers-almost-all :
      outerMass measure
        (SetDifference S (SelectedUnion selected-region)) ==
      zeroM extended

ExistsCovering :
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (S : Predicate A)
  (family : A -> SetFamily A) ->
  Set1
ExistsCovering measure S family =
  CoveringSelection measure S family

record Filter1 (I : Set1) : Set2 where
  field
    eventually1 :
      (I -> Set) -> Set1
    eventually-whole1 :
      eventually1 (\ _ -> Top)
    eventually-upward1 :
      (P Q : I -> Set) ->
      eventually1 P ->
      ((i : I) -> P i -> Q i) ->
      eventually1 Q
    eventually-intersection1 :
      (P Q : I -> Set) ->
      eventually1 P ->
      eventually1 Q ->
      eventually1 (\ i -> Both (P i) (Q i))

open Filter1

FilterAtSmall :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals) ->
  (setsAt : A -> SetFamily A) ->
  A ->
  (Predicate A -> Set) ->
  Set1
FilterAtSmall {R = R} {reals = reals} metric setsAt x P =
  ExistsLarge R
    (\ radius ->
      BothLarge
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((S : Predicate _) ->
          setsAt x S ->
          Subset S (ClosedBall metric x radius) ->
          P S))

record VitaliFamily
  {R M A : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events) : Set3 where
  field
    setsAt :
      A -> SetFamily A
    sets-measurable :
      (x : A) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      setsAt x S ->
      measurable events S
    sets-interior-nonempty :
      (x : A) ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      setsAt x S ->
      InteriorNonempty metric S
    nontrivial :
      (x : A) ->
      (radius : R) ->
      Positive reals radius ->
      ExistsHigh (Predicate A)
        (\ S ->
          Both
            (setsAt x S)
            (Subset S (ClosedBall metric x radius)))
    covering :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      (family : A -> SetFamily A) ->
      ((x : A) ->
        S x ->
        (T : Predicate A) ->
        family x T ->
        setsAt x T) ->
      ((x : A) ->
        S x ->
        (radius : R) ->
        Positive reals radius ->
        ExistsHigh (Predicate A)
          (\ T ->
            Both
              (family x T)
              (Subset T (ClosedBall metric x radius)))) ->
      ExistsCovering measure S family
    filterAt :
      A -> Filter1 (Predicate A)
    filterAt-small :
      (x : A) ->
      (P : Predicate A -> Set) ->
      Iff1
        (eventually1 (filterAt x) P)
        (FilterAtSmall metric setsAt x P)

open VitaliFamily

TendstoM1 :
  {I R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  Filter1 (Predicate I) ->
  (Predicate I -> M) ->
  M ->
  Set1
TendstoM1 extended source-filter function limit =
  (rays : List (OrderRay _)) ->
  BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays limit ->
  eventually1 source-filter
    (\ i ->
      BasicContains (lessOrEqualM extended) rays (function i))

record AlmostEverywhereLarge
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (property : A -> Set1) : Set1 where
  field
    exceptional-set :
      Predicate A
    exceptional-null :
      outerMass measure exceptional-set == zeroM extended
    property-off-exceptional :
      (x : A) ->
      Not (exceptional-set x) ->
      property x

lebesgue-differentiation-theorem : Set3
lebesgue-differentiation-theorem =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals) ->
  SecondCountableMetric metric ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  BorelSpace metric events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (reciprocal : ENNRealReciprocal extended) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  IsLocallyFiniteMeasure metric measure ->
  (restrictions : MeasureRestriction events extended) ->
  (vitali : VitaliFamily metric events extended measure) ->
  (f : A -> M) ->
  AEMeasurableOrder events measure (lessOrEqualM extended) f ->
  canonicalLIntegralM extended measure f != infinityM extended ->
  AlmostEverywhereLarge measure
    (\ x ->
      TendstoM1 extended (filterAt vitali x)
        (\ S ->
          divideM extended reciprocal
            (SetLIntegral restrictions measure S f)
            (outerMass measure S))
        (f x))

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2275191, "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": for a nonnegative
  almost-everywhere measurable function with finite lower integral, its
  restricted lower-integral averages along any Vitali family converge almost
  everywhere to the function. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q2275191_pseudo_metric_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_pseudo_metric_def",
  ``q2275191_pseudo_metric
      (space : 'a set) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x. x IN space ==> dist x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. x IN space /\ y IN space ==> 0 <= dist x y) /\
      (!x y. x IN space /\ y IN space ==> dist x y = dist y x) /\
      (!x y z.
        x IN space /\ y IN space /\ z IN space ==>
        dist x z <= dist x y + dist y z)``);

val q2275191_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_closed_ball_def",
  ``q2275191_closed_ball
      (space : 'a set) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real)
      (x : 'a) (radius : real) =
      {y | y IN space /\ dist y x <= radius}``);

val q2275191_open_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_open_def",
  ``q2275191_open
      (space : 'a set) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (u : 'a set) <=>
      u SUBSET space /\
      !x.
        x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            y IN space /\ dist y x < epsilon ==>
            y IN u``);

val q2275191_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_second_countable_def",
  ``q2275191_second_countable
      (space : 'a set) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?basis : ('a set) set.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!v. v IN basis ==> q2275191_open space dist v) /\
        !u x.
          q2275191_open space dist u /\ x IN u ==>
          ?v.
            v IN basis /\
            x IN v /\
            v SUBSET u``);

val q2275191_borel_space_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_borel_space_def",
  ``q2275191_borel_space
      (m : 'a m_space) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      measurable_sets m =
        subsets
          (sigma (m_space m)
            {u : 'a set |
              q2275191_open (m_space m) dist u})``);

val q2275191_locally_finite_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_locally_finite_def",
  ``q2275191_locally_finite
      (m : 'a m_space) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      !x.
        x IN m_space m ==>
        ?u : 'a set.
          q2275191_open (m_space m) dist u /\
          x IN u /\
          measure m u <> PosInf``);

val q2275191_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_outer_measure_def",
  ``q2275191_outer_measure (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) =
      inf
        {r : extreal |
          ?t : 'a set.
            s SUBSET t /\
            t IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m t = r}``);

val q2275191_nonempty_interior_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_nonempty_interior_def",
  ``q2275191_nonempty_interior
      (space : 'a set) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) <=>
      ?u y.
        q2275191_open space dist u /\
        y IN u /\
        u SUBSET s``);

val q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_snd_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_snd_def",
  ``q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_snd
      (t : ('a # ('a set)) set) <=>
      !p q.
        p IN t /\ q IN t /\ p <> q ==>
        DISJOINT (SND p) (SND q)``);

val q2275191_vitali_family_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_vitali_family_def",
  ``q2275191_vitali_family
      (m : 'a m_space) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real)
      (setsAt : 'a -> ('a set) set) <=>
      (!x s.
        x IN m_space m /\ s IN setsAt x ==>
        s IN measurable_sets m) /\
      (!x s.
        x IN m_space m /\ s IN setsAt x ==>
        q2275191_nonempty_interior (m_space m) dist s) /\
      (!x epsilon.
        x IN m_space m /\ 0 < epsilon ==>
        ?s.
          s IN setsAt x /\
          s SUBSET
            q2275191_closed_ball (m_space m) dist x epsilon) /\
      (!s subfamily.
        s SUBSET m_space m /\
        (!x.
          x IN s ==>
          subfamily x SUBSET setsAt x) /\
        (!x epsilon.
          x IN s /\ 0 < epsilon ==>
          ?t.
            t IN subfamily x /\
            t SUBSET
              q2275191_closed_ball
                (m_space m) dist x epsilon)
        ==>
        ?t : ('a # ('a set)) set.
          (!p. p IN t ==> FST p IN s) /\
          q2275191_pairwise_disjoint_snd t /\
          (!p. p IN t ==> SND p IN subfamily (FST p)) /\
          q2275191_outer_measure m
            (s DIFF BIGUNION (IMAGE SND t)) = Normal 0)``);

val q2275191_ae_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_ae_measurable_def",
  ``q2275191_ae_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> extreal) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> extreal.
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= g x) /\
        g IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q2275191_ennreal_div_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_ennreal_div_def",
  ``q2275191_ennreal_div (x : extreal) (y : extreal) =
      if y = PosInf then Normal 0
      else if y = Normal 0 then
        if x = Normal 0 then Normal 0 else PosInf
      else x / y``);

val q2275191_lintegral_on_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_lintegral_on_def",
  ``q2275191_lintegral_on
      (m : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> extreal) (s : 'a set) =
      pos_fn_integral m
        (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x)``);

val q2275191_tendsto_filterAt_def = new_definition (
  "q2275191_tendsto_filterAt_def",
  ``q2275191_tendsto_filterAt
      (space : 'a set) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real)
      (setsAt : 'a -> ('a set) set) (x : 'a)
      (u : ('a set) -> extreal) (ell : extreal) <=>
      (ell = PosInf /\
       !bound : real.
         ?delta : real.
           0 < delta /\
           !a.
             a IN setsAt x /\
             a SUBSET q2275191_closed_ball space dist x delta
             ==>
             Normal bound < u a) \/
      (?limit : real.
        ell = Normal limit /\
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !a.
              a IN setsAt x /\
              a SUBSET q2275191_closed_ball space dist x delta
              ==>
              Normal (limit - epsilon) < u a /\
              u a < Normal (limit + epsilon))``);

val ae_tendsto_lintegral_div =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real)
      (setsAt : 'a -> ('a set) set) (f : 'a -> extreal).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q2275191_pseudo_metric (m_space m) dist /\
      q2275191_second_countable (m_space m) dist /\
      q2275191_borel_space m dist /\
      q2275191_locally_finite m dist /\
      q2275191_vitali_family m dist setsAt /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
      q2275191_ae_measurable m f /\
      pos_fn_integral m f <> PosInf
      ==>
      (AE x::m.
        q2275191_tendsto_filterAt
          (m_space m) dist setsAt x
          (\a.
            q2275191_ennreal_div
              (q2275191_lintegral_on m f a)
              (measure m a))
          (f x))``;

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2275191
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2275191), "Lebesgue differentiation
  theorem": for an almost-everywhere measurable extended-nonnegative
  function with finite lower integral, its normalized integrals over the
  sets of a Vitali family converge to the function almost everywhere.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The definitions below expand the structures used by Lean's
  VitaliFamily.ae_tendsto_lintegral_div.  Q2275191PseudoMetric restricts
  SetMM's extended pseudometrics to finite real distances, matching Lean's
  PseudoMetricSpace.  Every topological notion below uses the pseudometric
  topology ( topGen ` ran ( ball ` D ) ) generated directly by its balls.
  Q2275191VitaliFamily includes measurability, nonempty interior, arbitrarily
  small closed sets, and the full covering axiom for arbitrary subfamilies.
  Q2275191TendstoAt uses the closed-ball basis that characterizes
  VitaliFamily.filterAt.  The lower integral, restriction to a set,
  almost-everywhere measurability, local finiteness, and total
  extended-nonnegative division are explicit.

  All declarations are syntax, bidirectional definitions, or the final
  unproved $a statement.  There are no $p declarations in this file.
$)

$c Q2275191PseudoMetric Q2275191ClosedBall Q2275191Measure Q2275191LocallyFinite
   Q2275191VitaliFamily Q2275191Simple Q2275191SimpleIntegral
   Q2275191LIntegral Q2275191SetLIntegral Q2275191AEMeasurable
   Q2275191EDiv Q2275191TendstoAt $.

q2275191-pseudometric-syntax $a
  wff ( Q2275191PseudoMetric D X ) $.
q2275191-closed-ball-syntax $a
  class ( Q2275191ClosedBall D X x e ) $.
q2275191-measure-syntax $a
  class ( Q2275191Measure M A ) $.
q2275191-locally-finite-syntax $a
  wff ( Q2275191LocallyFinite M J ) $.
q2275191-vitali-family-syntax $a
  wff ( Q2275191VitaliFamily M D V ) $.
q2275191-simple-syntax $a
  wff ( Q2275191Simple M G ) $.
q2275191-simple-integral-syntax $a
  class ( Q2275191SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q2275191-lintegral-syntax $a
  class ( Q2275191LIntegral M H ) $.
q2275191-set-lintegral-syntax $a
  class ( Q2275191SetLIntegral M H A ) $.
q2275191-aemeasurable-syntax $a
  wff ( Q2275191AEMeasurable M H ) $.
q2275191-ediv-syntax $a
  class ( Q2275191EDiv A B ) $.
q2275191-tendsto-at-syntax $a
  wff ( Q2275191TendstoAt M D V H x z ) $.

${
  $d D X $.

  q2275191-pseudometric-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2275191PseudoMetric D X )
    <->
    (
      D e. ( PsMet ` X )
      /\
      D e. ( RR ^m ( X X. X ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D X e x y $.

  q2275191-closed-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q2275191ClosedBall D X x e
  ) =
    { y e. X | ( x D y ) <_ e }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A M $.

  q2275191-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q2275191Measure M A
  ) =
    ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A )
  $.
$}

${
  $d J M U x $.

  q2275191-locally-finite-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2275191LocallyFinite M J )
    <->
    A. x e. U. dom M
      E. U e. J
        (
          x e. U
          /\
          ( M ` U ) < +oo
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A D M T U V X e f p q s x $.

  q2275191-vitali-family-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2275191VitaliFamily M D V )
    <->
    (
      V e. ( ( ~P ( ~P ( U. dom M ) ) ) ^m ( U. dom M ) )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. U. dom M
          A. A e. ( V ` x )
            (
              A e. dom M
              /\
              E. U e. ( topGen ` ran ( ball ` D ) )
                (
                  U =/= (/)
                  /\
                  U C_ A
                )
            )
        /\
        (
          A. x e. U. dom M
            A. e e. RR
              (
                0 < e
                ->
                E. A e. ( V ` x )
                  A C_ (
                    Q2275191ClosedBall D ( U. dom M ) x e
                  )
              )
          /\
          A. s e. ~P ( U. dom M )
            A. f e.
              ( ( ~P ( ~P ( U. dom M ) ) ) ^m ( U. dom M ) )
              (
                (
                  A. x e. s
                    ( f ` x ) C_ ( V ` x )
                  /\
                  A. x e. s
                    A. e e. RR
                      (
                        0 < e
                        ->
                        E. A e. ( f ` x )
                          A C_ (
                            Q2275191ClosedBall
                            D
                            ( U. dom M )
                            x
                            e
                          )
                      )
                )
                ->
                E. T e.
                  ~P ( ( U. dom M ) X. ~P ( U. dom M ) )
                  (
                    A. p e. T
                      ( 1st ` p ) e. s
                    /\
                    (
                      A. p e. T
                        A. q e. T
                          (
                            p =/= q
                            ->
                            (
                              ( 2nd ` p ) i^i ( 2nd ` q )
                            ) = (/)
                          )
                      /\
                      (
                        A. p e. T
                          ( 2nd ` p ) e. ( f ` ( 1st ` p ) )
                        /\
                        (
                          Q2275191Measure
                          M
                          (
                            s
                            \
                            U_ p e. T ( 2nd ` p )
                          )
                        ) = 0
                      )
                    )
                  )
              )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q2275191-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2275191Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q2275191-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q2275191SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q2275191-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q2275191LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q2275191Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M
                ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q2275191SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A H M x $.

  q2275191-set-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q2275191SetLIntegral M H A
  ) =
    (
      Q2275191LIntegral
      M
      (
        x e. U. dom M |->
          if ( x e. A , ( H ` x ) , 0 )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M N x $.

  q2275191-aemeasurable-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2275191AEMeasurable M H )
    <->
    (
      H : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      E. G
        (
          G e.
            (
              dom M
              MblFnM
              (
                sigaGen `
                ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
              )
            )
          /\
          E. N e. dom M
            (
              ( M ` N ) = 0
              /\
              A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                ( H ` x ) = ( G ` x )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B $.

  q2275191-ediv-definition $a |- (
    Q2275191EDiv A B
  ) =
    if (
      B = 0 ,
      if ( A = 0 , 0 , +oo ) ,
      if (
        B = +oo ,
        0 ,
        if ( A = +oo , +oo , ( A / B ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A D H J M U V X e x z $.

  q2275191-tendsto-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2275191TendstoAt M D V H x z )
    <->
    (
      H : ~P ( U. dom M ) --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      A. U e.
        ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
        (
          z e. U
          ->
          E. e e. RR
            (
              0 < e
              /\
              A. A e. ( V ` x )
                (
                  A C_ (
                    Q2275191ClosedBall D ( U. dom M ) x e
                  )
                  ->
                  ( H ` A ) e. U
                )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A D F G H J M N T U V X e f p q s x y z $.

  thousand-theorems-q2275191-lebesgue-differentiation-theorem $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran measures
      A. D
        A. V e.
          ( ( ~P ( ~P ( U. dom M ) ) ) ^m ( U. dom M ) )
          A. F e. ( ( 0 [,] +oo ) ^m ( U. dom M ) )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( Q2275191PseudoMetric D ( U. dom M ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( topGen ` ran ( ball ` D ) ) e. 2ndc
                    /\
                    dom M =
                      ( sigaGen ` ( topGen ` ran ( ball ` D ) ) )
                  )
                )
                /\
                (
                  ( Q2275191LocallyFinite M
                      ( topGen ` ran ( ball ` D ) ) )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q2275191VitaliFamily M D V )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( Q2275191AEMeasurable M F )
                      /\
                      ( Q2275191LIntegral M F ) =/= +oo
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
              ->
              E. N e. dom M
                (
                  ( M ` N ) = 0
                  /\
                  A. x e. ( U. dom M \ N )
                    (
                      Q2275191TendstoAt
                      M
                      D
                      V
                      (
                        A e. ~P ( U. dom M ) |->
                          (
                            Q2275191EDiv
                            ( Q2275191SetLIntegral M F A )
                            ( Q2275191Measure M A )
                          )
                      )
                      x
                      ( F ` x )
                    )
                )
            )
  $.
$}

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2275191,
:: "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": for an almost-everywhere measurable
:: nonnegative extended-real function with finite lower integral, normalized
:: lower integrals over a Vitali family converge almost everywhere to the
:: function value. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1,
      METRIC_1, TOPMETR, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3,
      MEASURE4, MEASURE8, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_1,
      SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, NAT_1, REAL_1, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, SETFAM_1, VALUED_0;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XXREAL_3, XREAL_0, REAL_1, EXTREAL1,
      NAT_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1, METRIC_1, TOPMETR, WAYBEL23,
      TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE8,
      VALUED_0, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2;
 constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, REAL_1, EXTREAL1, NAT_1, PRE_TOPC,
      METRIC_1, TOPMETR, PCOMPS_1, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, MEASURE1,
      MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE8, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5,
      SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
      NAT_1, CARD_1, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1, METRIC_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE4, MEASURE8, MESFUNC1,
      MESFUNC5, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, VALUED_0;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, MEASURE3, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, STRUCT_0, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_2;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
       V being Function of X,bool bool X,
       f being Function of X,ExtREAL
   holds Mu.{} = 0)
  &
  (for M being PseudoMetricSpace,
       S being SigmaField of the carrier of M,
       Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
       V being Function of the carrier of M,bool bool the carrier of M,
       f being Function of the carrier of M,ExtREAL
   st
     TopSpaceMetr M is second-countable &
     S = BorelSets(TopSpaceMetr M) &
     (for x being Point of M holds
        ex r being Real, A being Element of S st
          0 < r & A = Ball(x,r) & Mu.A < +infty) &
     (for x being Point of M, A being Subset of M st
        A in V.x holds A in S) &
     (for x being Point of M, A being Element of S st
        A in V.x holds
          ex y being Point of M, r being Real st
            0 < r & Ball(y,r) c= A) &
     (for x being Point of M, eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
        ex A being Element of S st
          A in V.x & A c= cl_Ball(x,eps)) &
     (for s being Subset of M,
          G being Function of the carrier of M,bool bool the carrier of M
      st
        (for x being Point of M st x in s holds G.x c= V.x) &
        (for x being Point of M st x in s holds
           for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
             ex A being Element of S st
               A in G.x & A c= cl_Ball(x,eps))
      holds
        ex I being set,
           c being Function of I,the carrier of M,
           A being Function of I,bool the carrier of M st
          (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
             c.i in s & A.i in G.(c.i)) &
          (for i,j being Element of I st
             i in I & j in I & i <> j holds A.i misses A.j) &
          (C_Meas Mu).(s \ union rng A) = 0) &
     (ex X being Element of COM(S,Mu) st
        X = the carrier of M & f is X-measurable) &
     f is nonnegative &
     integral+(COM(Mu),f) <> +infty
   holds
     ex N being Element of S st
       Mu.N = 0 &
       for x being Point of M st not x in N holds
         (for l being ExtReal st l < f.x holds
            ex r being Real st
              0 < r &
              for A being Element of S st
                A in V.x & A c= cl_Ball(x,r) holds
                  (((Mu.A = +infty or
                       (Mu.A = 0 & integral+(COM(Mu),f|A) = 0)) &
                      l < 0) or
                   (Mu.A = 0 & integral+(COM(Mu),f|A) <> 0 &
                      l < +infty) or
                   (Mu.A <> 0 & Mu.A <> +infty &
                      l < integral+(COM(Mu),f|A) / Mu.A))) &
         (for u being ExtReal st f.x < u holds
            ex r being Real st
              0 < r &
              for A being Element of S st
                A in V.x & A c= cl_Ball(x,r) holds
                  (((Mu.A = +infty or
                       (Mu.A = 0 & integral+(COM(Mu),f|A) = 0)) &
                      0 < u) or
                   (Mu.A <> 0 & Mu.A <> +infty &
                      integral+(COM(Mu),f|A) / Mu.A < u))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q2275191,
% "Lebesgue differentiation theorem": normalized lower Lebesgue integrals along
% a Vitali family converge almost everywhere to an extended-nonnegative
% function with finite integral. This file contains no proof.

lebesgue_differentiation_theorem_Q2275191[
  X: TYPE,
  carrier: [X -> bool],
  distance: [X, X -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  event_family: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  point_event_family: TYPE = [X -> event_family]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  selection: TYPE = [X, event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [X -> measure_value]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(x))

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_divide(
      numerator, denominator: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(numerator) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF measure_value_is_zero(denominator) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(denominator) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(numerator) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(numerator) / finite_part(denominator))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): carrier(x)

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      E(x) IMPLIES carrier(x)

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND NOT E(x)

  event_difference(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND E(x) AND NOT F(x)

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      E(x) IMPLIES F(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: X):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: X):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  disjoint_events(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      NOT (E(x) AND F(x))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND event_subset(E, measurable_cover)
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [X -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (x: X):
        carrier(x) AND NOT property(x))

  pseudo_metric_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
        distance(x, y) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) IMPLIES
          distance(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
          distance(x, y) = distance(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z)
          IMPLIES
            distance(x, z)
              <= distance(x, y) + distance(y, z))

  open_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND distance(x, center) < radius

  closed_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND distance(x, center) <= radius

  metric_open(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) AND U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
            event_subset(
              open_ball(x, epsilon_value),
              U)

  second_countable_metric: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        metric_open(basis(index)))
        AND (FORALL (U: event), (x: X):
          metric_open(U) AND carrier(x) AND U(x)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (index: nat):
                basis(index)(x)
                  AND event_subset(basis(index), U))

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: event):
        metric_open(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (other_sigma: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(other_sigma)
          AND (FORALL (U: event):
            metric_open(U) IMPLIES other_sigma(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (E: event):
            Sigma(E) IMPLIES other_sigma(E))

  locally_finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
          Sigma(open_ball(x, epsilon_value))
            AND canonical_measure_value(
              M(open_ball(x, epsilon_value)))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(
              M(open_ball(x, epsilon_value)))

  sublevel_event(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(function_value(x))
        AND finite_part(function_value(x)) <= bound

  measurable_nonnegative_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        0 <= bound IMPLIES
          Sigma(sublevel_event(function_value, bound)))

  ae_measurable_nonnegative_function(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_version: nonnegative_function):
        measurable_nonnegative_function(
          Sigma, measurable_version)
          AND almost_everywhere(
            M,
            Sigma,
            LAMBDA (x: X):
              function_value(x)
                = measurable_version(x))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: X): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x),
            function_value(x)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: measure_value):
        has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))

  restrict_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      E: event): nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      IF E(x) THEN
        function_value(x)
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  normalized_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      E: event): measure_value =
    measure_value_divide(
      lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        restrict_nonnegative_function(function_value, E)),
      M(E))

  family_subset(left, right: event_family): bool =
    FORALL (E: event):
      left(E) IMPLIES right(E)

  interior_nonempty(E: event): bool =
    EXISTS (center: X), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      carrier(center)
        AND event_subset(
          open_ball(center, epsilon_value),
          E)

  family_fine_at(
      family: event_family,
      x: X): bool =
    carrier(x)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (E: event):
          family(E)
            AND event_subset(
              E, closed_ball(x, epsilon_value))

  selection_union(selected: selection): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (center: X), (E: event):
        selected(center, E) AND E(x)

  selection_pairwise_disjoint(
      selected: selection): bool =
    FORALL
        (left_center: X), (left_event: event),
        (right_center: X), (right_event: event):
      (selected(left_center, left_event)
        AND selected(right_center, right_event)
        AND (left_center /= right_center
          OR left_event /= right_event))
      IMPLIES
        disjoint_events(left_event, right_event)

  is_vitali_family(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      sets_at: point_event_family): bool =
    (FORALL (x: X), (E: event):
      carrier(x) AND sets_at(x)(E)
        IMPLIES Sigma(E))
      AND (FORALL (x: X), (E: event):
        carrier(x) AND sets_at(x)(E)
          IMPLIES interior_nonempty(E))
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) IMPLIES
          family_fine_at(sets_at(x), x))
      AND (FORALL
          (source: event),
          (subfamilies: point_event_family):
        (carrier_event(source)
          AND (FORALL (x: X):
            source(x) IMPLIES
              family_subset(
                subfamilies(x), sets_at(x)))
          AND (FORALL (x: X):
            source(x) IMPLIES
              family_fine_at(subfamilies(x), x)))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (selected: selection):
            (FORALL (center: X), (E: event):
              selected(center, E)
                IMPLIES source(center))
              AND selection_pairwise_disjoint(selected)
              AND (FORALL (center: X), (E: event):
                selected(center, E)
                  IMPLIES subfamilies(center)(E))
              AND null_event(
                M,
                Sigma,
                event_difference(
                  source,
                  selection_union(selected))))

  eventually_filter_at(
      sets_at: point_event_family,
      x: X,
      property: [event -> bool]): bool =
    carrier(x)
      AND EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
        FORALL (E: event):
          sets_at(x)(E)
            AND event_subset(
              E, closed_ball(x, epsilon_value))
          IMPLIES property(E)

  vitali_converges_measure_value(
      values: [event -> measure_value],
      sets_at: point_event_family,
      x: X,
      limit: measure_value): bool =
    carrier(x)
      AND canonical_measure_value(limit)
      AND IF infinite_flag(limit) THEN
        FORALL (bound: real):
          eventually_filter_at(
            sets_at,
            x,
            LAMBDA (E: event):
              canonical_measure_value(values(E))
                AND (infinite_flag(values(E))
                  OR bound < finite_part(values(E))))
      ELSE
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          eventually_filter_at(
            sets_at,
            x,
            LAMBDA (E: event):
              canonical_measure_value(values(E))
                AND NOT infinite_flag(values(E))
                AND abs(finite_part(values(E))
                  - finite_part(limit))
                  < epsilon_value)
      ENDIF

  ae_tendsto_lintegral_div: bool =
    pseudo_metric_space
      AND second_countable_metric
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (sets_at: point_event_family),
          (function_value: nonnegative_function):
        (is_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
          AND locally_finite_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND is_vitali_family(M, Sigma, sets_at)
          AND ae_measurable_nonnegative_function(
            M, Sigma, function_value)
          AND NOT infinite_flag(
            lower_lebesgue_integral(
              M, Sigma, function_value)))
        IMPLIES
          almost_everywhere(
            M,
            Sigma,
            LAMBDA (x: X):
              vitali_converges_measure_value(
                LAMBDA (E: event):
                  normalized_integral(
                    M, Sigma, function_value, E),
                sets_at,
                x,
                function_value(x)))
END lebesgue_differentiation_theorem_Q2275191

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q22952648,
-- "Uncountability of the continuum": the real numbers, represented by located
-- Dedekind cuts of the rationals, admit no injection into the natural numbers.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q22952648_uncountability_of_the_continuum where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _<N_ _<Z_ _<Q_

data Bottom : Set where

data Top : Set where
  trivial : Top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<successor :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <N suc n
  successor<successor :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <N n ->
    suc m <N suc n

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

scale : Int -> Nat -> Int
scale (pos m) n =
  pos (m * n)
scale (negsuc m) n =
  negative (suc m * n)

_<Z_ : Int -> Int -> Set
pos m <Z pos n =
  m <N n
pos m <Z negsuc n =
  Bottom
negsuc m <Z pos n =
  Top
negsuc m <Z negsuc n =
  n <N m

record Fraction : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator             : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Fraction using (numerator; denominator-minus-one)

denominator : Fraction -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

_<Q_ : Fraction -> Fraction -> Set
q <Q r =
  scale (numerator q) (denominator r) <Z
  scale (numerator r) (denominator q)

-- A located lower Dedekind cut is a concrete presentation of a real number.
record DedekindReal : Set₁ where
  field
    lower :
      Fraction -> Set

    inhabited :
      Exists Fraction lower

    proper :
      Exists Fraction (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    downward-closed :
      (q r : Fraction) ->
      q <Q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    rounded :
      (q : Fraction) ->
      Iff
        (lower q)
        (Exists Fraction
          (\ r -> Both (q <Q r) (lower r)))

    located :
      (q r : Fraction) ->
      q <Q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

open DedekindReal using (lower)

-- Equality of reals is extensional equality of their rational lower cuts.
SameReal : DedekindReal -> DedekindReal -> Set
SameReal x y =
  (q : Fraction) ->
  Iff (lower x q) (lower y q)

InjectiveToNat :
  (DedekindReal -> Nat) ->
  Set₁
InjectiveToNat encode =
  (x y : DedekindReal) ->
  encode x == encode y ->
  SameReal x y

CountableReals : Set₁
CountableReals =
  Exists (DedekindReal -> Nat) InjectiveToNat

uncountability-of-the-continuum : Set₁
uncountability-of-the-continuum =
  Not CountableReals

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2379132
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2379132), "Going-up and going-down theorems":
-- the two indexed going-up results, the prime-spectrum characterization of
-- going-down, and the localized-spectrum surjectivity criterion.
-- This file contains no proofs.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Maps
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Prime
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.IntegralClosure.Algebra.Defs

@[expose] public section

namespace Q2379132

variable {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]

def HasGoingDownStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ p q : Ideal R, p.IsPrime → q.IsPrime → p ≤ q →
    ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime → Q.comap (algebraMap R S) = q →
      ∃ P : Ideal S, P.IsPrime ∧ P ≤ Q ∧ P.comap (algebraMap R S) = p

def PrimeSpectrumComapIsGeneralizingStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
    ∀ p : Ideal R, p.IsPrime → p ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap R S) →
      ∃ P : Ideal S, P.IsPrime ∧ P ≤ Q ∧ P.comap (algebraMap R S) = p

def LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjectiveStatement (Q : Ideal S) : Prop :=
  ∀ p : Ideal R, p.IsPrime → p ≤ Q.comap (algebraMap R S) →
    ∃ P : Ideal S, P.IsPrime ∧ P ≤ Q ∧ P.comap (algebraMap R S) = p

/-- A prime ideal containing the algebra-map kernel has a prime ideal lying over it. -/
theorem exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain_statement
    [IsDomain S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.comap (algebraMap R S) = P := sorry

/-- General going-up above an already chosen prime ideal upstairs. -/
theorem exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime_statement
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime]
    (I : Ideal S) [I.IsPrime] (hIP : I.comap (algebraMap R S) ≤ P) :
    ∃ Q ≥ I, Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.comap (algebraMap R S) = P := sorry

/-- Going-down is exactly generalization lifting along contraction on prime spectra. -/
theorem hasGoingDown_iff_generalizingMap_primeSpectrumComap_statement :
    HasGoingDownStatement (R := R) (S := S) ↔
      PrimeSpectrumComapIsGeneralizingStatement (R := R) (S := S) := sorry

/-- Surjectivity on every pair of local prime spectra implies going-down. -/
theorem hasGoingDown_of_comap_localRingHom_surjective_statement
    (H : ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
      LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjectiveStatement (R := R) Q) :
    HasGoingDownStatement (R := R) (S := S) := sorry

end Q2379132

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2379132
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2379132), "Going-up and going-down theorems".
  It states the two indexed going-up results, the prime-spectrum
  characterization of going-down, and the localized-spectrum surjectivity
  criterion. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Import ListNotations.

Record q2379132_commutative_ring (A : Type) : Type := {
  q2379132_zero : A;
  q2379132_one : A;
  q2379132_add : A -> A -> A;
  q2379132_mul : A -> A -> A;
  q2379132_neg : A -> A;
  q2379132_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2379132_add x (q2379132_add y z) =
      q2379132_add (q2379132_add x y) z;
  q2379132_add_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q2379132_add x y = q2379132_add y x;
  q2379132_add_zero :
    forall x : A,
      q2379132_add x q2379132_zero = x;
  q2379132_add_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q2379132_add x (q2379132_neg x) = q2379132_zero;
  q2379132_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2379132_mul x (q2379132_mul y z) =
      q2379132_mul (q2379132_mul x y) z;
  q2379132_mul_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q2379132_mul x y = q2379132_mul y x;
  q2379132_mul_one :
    forall x : A,
      q2379132_mul x q2379132_one = x;
  q2379132_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : A,
      q2379132_mul x (q2379132_add y z) =
      q2379132_add
        (q2379132_mul x y) (q2379132_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q2379132_zero {A} _.
Arguments q2379132_one {A} _.
Arguments q2379132_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q2379132_mul {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q2379132_neg {A} _ _.

Record q2379132_integral_domain
    {A : Type}
    (RA : q2379132_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q2379132_domain_nontrivial :
    q2379132_zero RA <> q2379132_one RA;
  q2379132_domain_no_zero_divisors :
    forall x y : A,
      q2379132_mul RA x y = q2379132_zero RA ->
      x = q2379132_zero RA \/ y = q2379132_zero RA
}.

Record q2379132_ring_hom
    {R S : Type}
    (RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R)
    (RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S) : Type := {
  q2379132_map : R -> S;
  q2379132_map_zero :
    q2379132_map (q2379132_zero RR) = q2379132_zero RS;
  q2379132_map_one :
    q2379132_map (q2379132_one RR) = q2379132_one RS;
  q2379132_map_add :
    forall x y : R,
      q2379132_map (q2379132_add RR x y) =
      q2379132_add RS (q2379132_map x) (q2379132_map y);
  q2379132_map_mul :
    forall x y : R,
      q2379132_map (q2379132_mul RR x y) =
      q2379132_mul RS (q2379132_map x) (q2379132_map y)
}.

Arguments q2379132_map {R S RR RS} _ _.

Record q2379132_ideal
    {A : Type}
    (RA : q2379132_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q2379132_ideal_mem : A -> Prop;
  q2379132_ideal_zero :
    q2379132_ideal_mem (q2379132_zero RA);
  q2379132_ideal_add :
    forall x y : A,
      q2379132_ideal_mem x ->
      q2379132_ideal_mem y ->
      q2379132_ideal_mem (q2379132_add RA x y);
  q2379132_ideal_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q2379132_ideal_mem x ->
      q2379132_ideal_mem (q2379132_neg RA x);
  q2379132_ideal_mul :
    forall a x : A,
      q2379132_ideal_mem x ->
      q2379132_ideal_mem (q2379132_mul RA a x)
}.

Arguments q2379132_ideal_mem {A RA} _ _.

Definition q2379132_is_prime_ideal
    {A : Type}
    {RA : q2379132_commutative_ring A}
    (I : @q2379132_ideal A RA) : Prop :=
  ~ q2379132_ideal_mem I (q2379132_one RA) /\
  forall x y : A,
    q2379132_ideal_mem I (q2379132_mul RA x y) ->
    q2379132_ideal_mem I x \/ q2379132_ideal_mem I y.

Fixpoint q2379132_polynomial_eval
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (coefficients : list R)
    (x : S) : S :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => q2379132_zero RS
  | coefficient :: rest =>
      q2379132_add RS
        (q2379132_map f coefficient)
        (q2379132_mul RS x
          (q2379132_polynomial_eval f rest x))
  end.

Definition q2379132_is_integral_hom
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS) : Prop :=
  forall x : S,
    exists coefficients : list R,
      q2379132_polynomial_eval
        f (coefficients ++ [q2379132_one RR]) x =
      q2379132_zero RS.

Definition q2379132_kernel_contained
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (P : @q2379132_ideal R RR) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q2379132_map f x = q2379132_zero RS ->
    q2379132_ideal_mem P x.

Definition q2379132_contraction_equal
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS)
    (P : @q2379132_ideal R RR) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q2379132_ideal_mem Q (q2379132_map f x) <->
    q2379132_ideal_mem P x.

Definition q2379132_ideal_included
    {A : Type}
    {RA : q2379132_commutative_ring A}
    (I J : @q2379132_ideal A RA) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    q2379132_ideal_mem I x ->
    q2379132_ideal_mem J x.

Definition q2379132_ideal_below_contraction
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (P : @q2379132_ideal R RR)
    (Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q2379132_ideal_mem P x ->
    q2379132_ideal_mem Q (q2379132_map f x).

Definition q2379132_contraction_included_in_ideal
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS)
    (P : @q2379132_ideal R RR) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q2379132_ideal_mem Q (q2379132_map f x) ->
    q2379132_ideal_mem P x.

Definition q2379132_has_going_down
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS) : Prop :=
  forall p q : @q2379132_ideal R RR,
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal p ->
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal q ->
    q2379132_ideal_included p q ->
    forall Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal Q ->
      q2379132_contraction_equal f Q q ->
      exists P : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
        q2379132_is_prime_ideal P /\
        q2379132_ideal_included P Q /\
        q2379132_contraction_equal f P p.

Definition q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS) : Prop :=
  forall Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal Q ->
    forall p : @q2379132_ideal R RR,
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal p ->
      q2379132_ideal_below_contraction f p Q ->
      exists P : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
        q2379132_is_prime_ideal P /\
        q2379132_ideal_included P Q /\
        q2379132_contraction_equal f P p.

Definition q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective
    {R S : Type}
    {RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R}
    {RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S}
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS) : Prop :=
  forall p : @q2379132_ideal R RR,
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal p ->
    q2379132_ideal_below_contraction f p Q ->
    exists P : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal P /\
      q2379132_ideal_included P Q /\
      q2379132_contraction_equal f P p.

Theorem Ideal_exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain :
  forall
    (R S : Type)
    (RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R)
    (RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S)
    (DS : q2379132_integral_domain RS)
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (P : @q2379132_ideal R RR),
    q2379132_is_integral_hom f ->
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal P ->
    q2379132_kernel_contained f P ->
    exists Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal Q /\
      q2379132_contraction_equal f Q P.
Admitted.

Theorem Ideal_exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime :
  forall
    (R S : Type)
    (RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R)
    (RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S)
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS)
    (P : @q2379132_ideal R RR)
    (I : @q2379132_ideal S RS),
    q2379132_is_integral_hom f ->
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal P ->
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal I ->
    q2379132_contraction_included_in_ideal f I P ->
    exists Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
      q2379132_ideal_included I Q /\
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal Q /\
      q2379132_contraction_equal f Q P.
Admitted.

Theorem Algebra_HasGoingDown_iff_generalizingMap_primeSpectrumComap :
  forall
    (R S : Type)
    (RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R)
    (RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S)
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS),
    q2379132_has_going_down f <->
    q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap f.
Admitted.

Theorem Algebra_HasGoingDown_of_comap_localRingHom_surjective :
  forall
    (R S : Type)
    (RR : q2379132_commutative_ring R)
    (RS : q2379132_commutative_ring S)
    (f : q2379132_ring_hom RR RS),
    (forall Q : @q2379132_ideal S RS,
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal Q ->
      q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective f Q) ->
    q2379132_has_going_down f.
Admitted.

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2379132
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2379132), "Going-up and going-down theorems".
  It states the two indexed going-up results, the prime-spectrum
  characterization of going-down, and the localized-spectrum surjectivity
  criterion. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
  imports Main
begin

record 'a q2379132_comm_ring_data =
  q2379132_zero :: 'a
  q2379132_one :: 'a
  q2379132_add :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  q2379132_mul :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  q2379132_neg :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q2379132_is_comm_ring ::
    "'a q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_is_comm_ring R \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y z.
      q2379132_add R (q2379132_add R x y) z =
        q2379132_add R x (q2379132_add R y z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. q2379132_add R x y = q2379132_add R y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. q2379132_add R (q2379132_zero R) x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. q2379132_add R (q2379132_neg R x) x =
      q2379132_zero R) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z.
      q2379132_mul R (q2379132_mul R x y) z =
        q2379132_mul R x (q2379132_mul R y z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. q2379132_mul R x y = q2379132_mul R y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. q2379132_mul R (q2379132_one R) x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z.
      q2379132_mul R x (q2379132_add R y z) =
        q2379132_add R
          (q2379132_mul R x y) (q2379132_mul R x z))"

definition q2379132_is_integral_domain ::
    "'a q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_is_integral_domain R \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2379132_is_comm_ring R \<and>
    q2379132_zero R \<noteq> q2379132_one R \<and>
    (\<forall>x y.
      q2379132_mul R x y = q2379132_zero R \<longrightarrow>
        x = q2379132_zero R \<or> y = q2379132_zero R)"

definition q2379132_is_ring_hom ::
    "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      's q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_is_ring_hom R S f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f (q2379132_zero R) = q2379132_zero S \<and>
    f (q2379132_one R) = q2379132_one S \<and>
    (\<forall>x y.
      f (q2379132_add R x y) = q2379132_add S (f x) (f y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y.
      f (q2379132_mul R x y) = q2379132_mul S (f x) (f y))"

definition q2379132_is_ideal ::
    "'a q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_is_ideal R I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2379132_zero R \<in> I \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>I. \<forall>y\<in>I. q2379132_add R x y \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>I. q2379132_neg R x \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>x\<in>I. q2379132_mul R a x \<in> I)"

definition q2379132_is_prime_ideal ::
    "'a q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_is_prime_ideal R P \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2379132_is_ideal R P \<and>
    q2379132_one R \<notin> P \<and>
    (\<forall>x y.
      q2379132_mul R x y \<in> P \<longrightarrow> x \<in> P \<or> y \<in> P)"

fun q2379132_poly_eval ::
    "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      's q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> 'r list \<Rightarrow> 's \<Rightarrow> 's" where
  "q2379132_poly_eval R S f [] x = q2379132_zero S"
| "q2379132_poly_eval R S f (c # cs) x =
    q2379132_add S (f c)
      (q2379132_mul S x (q2379132_poly_eval R S f cs x))"

definition q2379132_is_integral_extension ::
    "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      's q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_is_integral_extension R S f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>coeffs :: 'r list.
      coeffs \<noteq> [] \<and>
      last coeffs = q2379132_one R \<and>
      q2379132_poly_eval R S f coeffs x = q2379132_zero S)"

definition q2379132_contraction ::
    "('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> 's set \<Rightarrow> 'r set" where
  "q2379132_contraction f Q = {x. f x \<in> Q}"

definition q2379132_has_going_down ::
    "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      's q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_has_going_down R S f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p q Q.
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal R p \<and>
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal R q \<and>
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal S Q \<and>
      p \<subseteq> q \<and> q2379132_contraction f Q = q
      \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>P.
        q2379132_is_prime_ideal S P \<and>
        P \<subseteq> Q \<and> q2379132_contraction f P = p))"

definition q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap ::
    "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      's q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow> ('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap R S f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>Q p.
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal S Q \<and>
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal R p \<and>
      p \<subseteq> q2379132_contraction f Q
      \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>P.
        q2379132_is_prime_ideal S P \<and>
        P \<subseteq> Q \<and> q2379132_contraction f P = p))"

(*
  Under the canonical correspondence for localization at a prime, the prime
  spectrum of R_p is the set of prime ideals of R contained in p. Thus this
  predicate is exactly surjectivity of Spec(S_Q) -> Spec(R_{f^-1 Q}).
*)
definition q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective ::
    "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      's q2379132_comm_ring_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('r \<Rightarrow> 's) \<Rightarrow> 's set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective R S f Q \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p.
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal R p \<and>
      p \<subseteq> q2379132_contraction f Q
      \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>P.
        q2379132_is_prime_ideal S P \<and>
        P \<subseteq> Q \<and> q2379132_contraction f P = p))"

theorem q2379132_exists_ideal_over_prime:
  fixes R :: "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and S :: "'s q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and f :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 's"
    and P :: "'r set"
  assumes "q2379132_is_comm_ring R"
    and "q2379132_is_integral_domain S"
    and "q2379132_is_ring_hom R S f"
    and "q2379132_is_integral_extension R S f"
    and "q2379132_is_prime_ideal R P"
    and "{x. f x = q2379132_zero S} \<subseteq> P"
  shows "\<exists>Q :: 's set.
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal S Q \<and>
    q2379132_contraction f Q = P"
  sorry

theorem q2379132_exists_ideal_over_prime_above:
  fixes R :: "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and S :: "'s q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and f :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 's"
    and P :: "'r set"
    and I :: "'s set"
  assumes "q2379132_is_comm_ring R"
    and "q2379132_is_comm_ring S"
    and "q2379132_is_ring_hom R S f"
    and "q2379132_is_integral_extension R S f"
    and "q2379132_is_prime_ideal R P"
    and "q2379132_is_prime_ideal S I"
    and "q2379132_contraction f I \<subseteq> P"
  shows "\<exists>Q :: 's set.
    I \<subseteq> Q \<and>
    q2379132_is_prime_ideal S Q \<and>
    q2379132_contraction f Q = P"
