theorem q2379132_going_down_iff_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap:
  fixes R :: "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and S :: "'s q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and f :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 's"
  assumes "q2379132_is_comm_ring R"
    and "q2379132_is_comm_ring S"
    and "q2379132_is_ring_hom R S f"
  shows "q2379132_has_going_down R S f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap R S f"
  sorry

theorem q2379132_has_going_down_of_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective:
  fixes R :: "'r q2379132_comm_ring_data"
    and S :: "'s q2379132_comm_ring_data"

    and "q2379132_is_comm_ring S"
    and "q2379132_is_ring_hom R S f"
    and "\<forall>Q.
      q2379132_is_prime_ideal S Q \<longrightarrow>

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2379132,
  "Going-up and going-down theorems". It states the two indexed going-up
  results, the prime-spectrum characterization of going-down, and the
  localized-spectrum surjectivity criterion. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2379132_GOING_UP =
  `let is_commring_R =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
       (!x. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
       (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
       (!x y z. addR x (addR y z) = addR (addR x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulR x (mulR y z) = mulR (mulR x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulR x (addR y z) =
                addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) in
   let is_commring_S =
     \(zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
      (negS:S->S).
       (!x. addS zeroS x = x) /\
       (!x. addS (negS x) x = zeroS) /\
       (!x y. addS x y = addS y x) /\
       (!x y z. addS x (addS y z) = addS (addS x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulS oneS x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulS x y = mulS y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulS x (mulS y z) = mulS (mulS x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulS x (addS y z) =
                addS (mulS x y) (mulS x z)) in
   let is_domain_S =
     \(zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (mulS:S->S->S).
       ~(zeroS = oneS) /\
       (!x y. mulS x y = zeroS ==> x = zeroS \/ y = zeroS) in
   let is_ring_hom =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
      (f:R->S).
       f zeroR = zeroS /\
       f oneR = oneS /\
       (!x y. f (addR x y) = addS (f x) (f y)) /\
       (!x y. f (mulR x y) = mulS (f x) (f y)) in
   let is_ideal_R =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (P:R->bool).
       P zeroR /\
       (!x. P x ==> P (negR x)) /\
       (!x y. P x /\ P y ==> P (addR x y)) /\
       (!a x. P x ==> P (mulR a x)) in
   let is_ideal_S =
     \(zeroS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
      (negS:S->S) (Q:S->bool).
       Q zeroS /\
       (!x. Q x ==> Q (negS x)) /\
       (!x y. Q x /\ Q y ==> Q (addS x y)) /\
       (!a x. Q x ==> Q (mulS a x)) in
   let is_prime_R =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (P:R->bool).
       is_ideal_R zeroR addR mulR negR P /\
       ~(P oneR) /\
       (!x y. P (mulR x y) ==> P x \/ P y) in
   let is_prime_S =
     \(zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
      (negS:S->S) (Q:S->bool).
       is_ideal_S zeroS addS mulS negS Q /\
       ~(Q oneS) /\
       (!x y. Q (mulS x y) ==> Q x \/ Q y) in
   let power_S =
     \(oneS:S) (mulS:S->S->S) (x:S) (n:num).
       ITLIST mulS (REPLICATE n x) oneS in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(zeroR:R) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
      (oneS:S) (f:R->S) (p:num->R) (x:S).
       iterate addS {n | ~(p n = zeroR)}
         (\n. mulS (f (p n)) (power_S oneS mulS x n)) in
   let is_integral =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (zeroS:S) (oneS:S)
      (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S) (f:R->S).
       !x:S.
         ?p:num->R.
           FINITE {n | ~(p n = zeroR)} /\
           (?d:num.
              p d = oneR /\
              (!n:num. d < n ==> p n = zeroR)) /\
           polynomial_eval zeroR addS mulS oneS f p x = zeroS in
   !zeroR oneR:R. !addR mulR:R->R->R. !negR:R->R.
   !zeroS oneS:S. !addS mulS:S->S->S. !negS:S->S.
   !f:R->S. !P:R->bool.
     is_commring_R zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_commring_S zeroS oneS addS mulS negS /\
     is_domain_S zeroS oneS mulS /\
     is_ring_hom zeroR oneR addR mulR
       zeroS oneS addS mulS f /\
     is_integral zeroR oneR zeroS oneS addS mulS f /\
     is_prime_R zeroR oneR addR mulR negR P /\
     (!x:R. f x = zeroS ==> P x)
     ==>
     ?Q:S->bool.
       is_prime_S zeroS oneS addS mulS negS Q /\
       (!x:R. Q (f x) <=> P x)`;;

let q2379132_commring = new_definition
 `q2379132_commring
    (zero:A) (oneA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) <=>
    (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
    (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
    (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
    (!x y z:A. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
    (!x:A. mul oneA x = x) /\
    (!x y:A. mul x y = mul y x) /\
    (!x y z:A. mul x (mul y z) = mul (mul x y) z) /\
    (!x y z:A. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))`;;

let q2379132_ring_hom = new_definition
 `q2379132_ring_hom
    (zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
    (zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
    (f:R->S) <=>
    f zeroR = zeroS /\
    f oneR = oneS /\
    (!x y:R. f (addR x y) = addS (f x) (f y)) /\
    (!x y:R. f (mulR x y) = mulS (f x) (f y))`;;

let q2379132_ideal = new_definition
 `q2379132_ideal
    (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
    (ideal:A->bool) <=>
    ideal zero /\
    (!x:A. ideal x ==> ideal (neg x)) /\
    (!x y:A. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (add x y)) /\
    (!a x:A. ideal x ==> ideal (mul a x))`;;

let q2379132_prime_ideal = new_definition
 `q2379132_prime_ideal
    (zero:A) (oneA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
    (ideal:A->bool) <=>
    q2379132_ideal zero add mul neg ideal /\
    ~(ideal oneA) /\
    (!x y:A. ideal (mul x y) ==> ideal x \/ ideal y)`;;

let q2379132_polynomial_eval = new_definition
 `q2379132_polynomial_eval
    (zeroS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
    (f:R->S) (coefficients:R list) (x:S) =
    ITLIST (\c acc. addS (f c) (mulS x acc)) coefficients zeroS`;;

let q2379132_integral_extension = new_definition
 `q2379132_integral_extension
    (oneR:R) (zeroS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S)
    (f:R->S) <=>
    !x:S.
      ?coefficients:R list.
        ~(coefficients = []) /\
        LAST coefficients = oneR /\
        q2379132_polynomial_eval
          zeroS addS mulS f coefficients x = zeroS`;;

let q2379132_ideal_included = new_definition
 `q2379132_ideal_included (smaller:A->bool) (larger:A->bool) <=>
    !x:A. smaller x ==> larger x`;;

let q2379132_contraction_equal = new_definition
 `q2379132_contraction_equal
    (f:R->S) (upstairs:S->bool) (downstairs:R->bool) <=>
    !x:R. upstairs (f x) <=> downstairs x`;;

let q2379132_contraction_included_in_ideal = new_definition
 `q2379132_contraction_included_in_ideal
    (f:R->S) (upstairs:S->bool) (downstairs:R->bool) <=>
    !x:R. upstairs (f x) ==> downstairs x`;;

let q2379132_ideal_below_contraction = new_definition
 `q2379132_ideal_below_contraction
    (f:R->S) (downstairs:R->bool) (upstairs:S->bool) <=>
    !x:R. downstairs x ==> upstairs (f x)`;;

let q2379132_has_going_down = new_definition
 `q2379132_has_going_down
    (zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
    (zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S) (negS:S->S)
    (f:R->S) <=>
    !p q:R->bool.
      q2379132_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR p /\
      q2379132_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR q /\
      q2379132_ideal_included p q
      ==>
      !Q:S->bool.
        q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS Q /\
        q2379132_contraction_equal f Q q
        ==>
        ?P:S->bool.
          q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS P /\
          q2379132_ideal_included P Q /\
          q2379132_contraction_equal f P p`;;

let q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap = new_definition
 `q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap
    (zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
    (zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S) (negS:S->S)
    (f:R->S) <=>
    !Q:S->bool.
      q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS Q
      ==>
      !p:R->bool.
        q2379132_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR p /\
        q2379132_ideal_below_contraction f p Q
        ==>
        ?P:S->bool.
          q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS P /\
          q2379132_ideal_included P Q /\
          q2379132_contraction_equal f P p`;;

let q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective = new_definition
 `q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective
    (zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
    (zeroS:S) (oneS:S) (addS:S->S->S) (mulS:S->S->S) (negS:S->S)
    (f:R->S) (Q:S->bool) <=>
    !p:R->bool.
      q2379132_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR p /\
      q2379132_ideal_below_contraction f p Q
      ==>
      ?P:S->bool.
        q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS P /\
        q2379132_ideal_included P Q /\
        q2379132_contraction_equal f P p`;;

let Q2379132_GENERAL_GOING_UP =
 `!zeroR oneR:R. !addR mulR:R->R->R. !negR:R->R.
  !zeroS oneS:S. !addS mulS:S->S->S. !negS:S->S.
  !f:R->S. !P:R->bool. !upstairsIdeal:S->bool.
    q2379132_commring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
    q2379132_commring zeroS oneS addS mulS negS /\
    q2379132_ring_hom
      zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroS oneS addS mulS f /\
    q2379132_integral_extension oneR zeroS addS mulS f /\
    q2379132_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR P /\
    q2379132_prime_ideal
      zeroS oneS addS mulS negS upstairsIdeal /\
    q2379132_contraction_included_in_ideal f upstairsIdeal P
    ==>
    ?Q:S->bool.
      q2379132_ideal_included upstairsIdeal Q /\
      q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS Q /\
      q2379132_contraction_equal f Q P`;;

let Q2379132_GOING_DOWN_IFF_GENERALIZING =
 `!zeroR oneR:R. !addR mulR:R->R->R. !negR:R->R.
  !zeroS oneS:S. !addS mulS:S->S->S. !negS:S->S.
  !f:R->S.
    q2379132_commring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
    q2379132_commring zeroS oneS addS mulS negS /\
    q2379132_ring_hom
      zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroS oneS addS mulS f
    ==>
    (q2379132_has_going_down
       zeroR oneR addR mulR negR zeroS oneS addS mulS negS f
     <=>
     q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap
       zeroR oneR addR mulR negR zeroS oneS addS mulS negS f)`;;

let Q2379132_GOING_DOWN_FROM_LOCAL_SURJECTIVITY =
 `!zeroR oneR:R. !addR mulR:R->R->R. !negR:R->R.
  !zeroS oneS:S. !addS mulS:S->S->S. !negS:S->S.
  !f:R->S.
    q2379132_commring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
    q2379132_commring zeroS oneS addS mulS negS /\
    q2379132_ring_hom
      zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroS oneS addS mulS f /\
    (!Q:S->bool.
      q2379132_prime_ideal zeroS oneS addS mulS negS Q
      ==>
      q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective
        zeroR oneR addR mulR negR
        zeroS oneS addS mulS negS f Q)
    ==>
    q2379132_has_going_down
      zeroR oneR addR mulR negR zeroS oneS addS mulS negS f`;;

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2379132,
;; "Going-up and going-down theorems". It states the two indexed going-up
;; results, the prime-spectrum characterization of going-down, and the
;; localized-spectrum surjectivity criterion. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent arbitrary ring carriers, operations,
;; homomorphisms, and ideal-membership predicates. The structure tags do not
;; enumerate or otherwise restrict any carrier or ideal.

(defstub q2379132-carrier-p (ring value) t)
(defstub q2379132-zero (ring) t)
(defstub q2379132-one (ring) t)
(defstub q2379132-add (ring left right) t)
(defstub q2379132-mul (ring left right) t)
(defstub q2379132-neg (ring value) t)
(defstub q2379132-map (hom value) t)
(defstub q2379132-ideal-member-p (ideal ring value) t)

(defun-sk q2379132-commutative-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2379132-carrier-p ring x)
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring (q2379132-neg ring x))
       (equal (q2379132-add ring x (q2379132-zero ring)) x)
       (equal (q2379132-add ring (q2379132-zero ring) x) x)
       (equal
        (q2379132-add ring x (q2379132-neg ring x))
        (q2379132-zero ring))
       (equal
        (q2379132-add ring (q2379132-neg ring x) x)
        (q2379132-zero ring))
       (equal (q2379132-mul ring x (q2379132-one ring)) x)
       (equal (q2379132-mul ring (q2379132-one ring) x) x)
       (equal
        (q2379132-mul ring x (q2379132-zero ring))
        (q2379132-zero ring))
       (equal
        (q2379132-mul ring (q2379132-zero ring) x)
        (q2379132-zero ring))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring x)
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring y))
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring (q2379132-add ring x y))
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring (q2379132-mul ring x y))
       (equal
        (q2379132-add ring x y)
        (q2379132-add ring y x))
       (equal
        (q2379132-mul ring x y)
        (q2379132-mul ring y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring x)
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring y)
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q2379132-add ring (q2379132-add ring x y) z)
        (q2379132-add ring x (q2379132-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q2379132-mul ring (q2379132-mul ring x y) z)
        (q2379132-mul ring x (q2379132-mul ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q2379132-mul ring x (q2379132-add ring y z))
        (q2379132-add
         ring
         (q2379132-mul ring x y)
         (q2379132-mul ring x z)))
       (equal
        (q2379132-mul ring (q2379132-add ring x y) z)
        (q2379132-add
         ring
         (q2379132-mul ring x z)
         (q2379132-mul ring y z))))))))

(defun q2379132-commutative-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (q2379132-carrier-p ring (q2379132-zero ring))
   (q2379132-carrier-p ring (q2379132-one ring))
   (q2379132-commutative-ring-laws-p ring)))

(defun-sk q2379132-no-zero-divisors-p (ring)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2379132-carrier-p ring x)
      (q2379132-carrier-p ring y)
      (equal
       (q2379132-mul ring x y)
       (q2379132-zero ring)))
     (or
      (equal x (q2379132-zero ring))
      (equal y (q2379132-zero ring))))))

(defun q2379132-domain-p (ring)
  (and
   (q2379132-commutative-ring-p ring)
   (not (equal
         (q2379132-zero ring)
         (q2379132-one ring)))
   (q2379132-no-zero-divisors-p ring)))

(defun-sk q2379132-ring-homomorphism-laws-p
    (source target hom)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2379132-carrier-p source x)
      (q2379132-carrier-p
       target
       (q2379132-map hom x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p source x)
       (q2379132-carrier-p source y))
      (and
       (equal
        (q2379132-map hom (q2379132-add source x y))
        (q2379132-add
         target
         (q2379132-map hom x)
         (q2379132-map hom y)))
       (equal
        (q2379132-map hom (q2379132-mul source x y))
        (q2379132-mul
         target
         (q2379132-map hom x)
         (q2379132-map hom y))))))))

(defun q2379132-ring-homomorphism-p (source target hom)
  (and
   (equal
    (q2379132-map hom (q2379132-zero source))
    (q2379132-zero target))
   (equal
    (q2379132-map hom (q2379132-one source))
    (q2379132-one target))
   (q2379132-ring-homomorphism-laws-p source target hom)))

(defun-sk q2379132-ideal-laws-p (ring ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2379132-ideal-member-p ideal ring x)
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring x)
       (q2379132-ideal-member-p
        ideal ring (q2379132-neg ring x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2379132-ideal-member-p ideal ring x)
       (q2379132-ideal-member-p ideal ring y))
      (q2379132-ideal-member-p
       ideal ring (q2379132-add ring x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2379132-carrier-p ring a)
       (q2379132-ideal-member-p ideal ring x))
      (q2379132-ideal-member-p
       ideal ring (q2379132-mul ring a x))))))

(defun q2379132-ideal-p (ring ideal)
  (and
   (q2379132-ideal-member-p
    ideal ring (q2379132-zero ring))
   (q2379132-ideal-laws-p ring ideal)))

(defun-sk q2379132-prime-multiplication-law-p (ring ideal)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2379132-carrier-p ring x)
      (q2379132-carrier-p ring y)
      (q2379132-ideal-member-p
       ideal ring (q2379132-mul ring x y)))
     (or
      (q2379132-ideal-member-p ideal ring x)
      (q2379132-ideal-member-p ideal ring y)))))

(defun q2379132-coefficients-in-ring-p (ring coefficients)

(defun q2379132-polynomial-eval

(defun-sk q2379132-integral-element-p

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2379132,
-- "Going-up and going-down theorems". It states the two indexed going-up
-- results, the prime-spectrum characterization of going-down, and the
-- localized-spectrum surjectivity criterion. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A → Bottom {a}

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → A or B
  right : B → A or B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

finToNat :
  {n : Nat} →
  Fin n →
  Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

last :
  (n : Nat) →
  Fin (suc n)
last zero =
  fzero
last (suc n) =
  fsuc (last n)

record CommutativeRing
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR : R → R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record RingHom
  {r s : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {S : Set s}
  (domain : CommutativeRing R)
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) :
  Set (r ⊔ s) where

  field
    map : R → S
    map-zero :
      map (CommutativeRing.zeroR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain
    map-one :
      map (CommutativeRing.oneR domain) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR codomain
    map-add :
      (x y : R) →
      map (CommutativeRing.addR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.addR codomain (map x) (map y)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : R) →
      map (CommutativeRing.multiplyR domain x y) ≡
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR codomain (map x) (map y)

record Ideal
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    member : R → Set r
    membership-propositional :
      (x : R) →
      (u v : member x) →
      u ≡ v
    contains-zero :
      member (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : R) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : R) →
      member x →
      member (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (a x : R) →
      member x →
      member (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring a x)

IsPrime :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  Ideal ring →
  Set r
IsPrime {R = R} {ring = ring} ideal =
  Not (Ideal.member ideal (CommutativeRing.oneR ring)) and
  ((x y : R) →
    Ideal.member ideal (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y) →
    Ideal.member ideal x or Ideal.member ideal y)

IsDomain :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Set r
IsDomain {R = R} ring =
  Not
    (CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≡
     CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
  and
  ((x y : R) →
    CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y ≡
    CommutativeRing.zeroR ring →
    (x ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring) or
    (y ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring))

power :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
power ring x zero =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
power ring x (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (power ring x n)

sumFin :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → R) →
  R
sumFin ring zero values =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
sumFin ring (suc n) values =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin ring n (λ i → values (fsuc i)))

evaluatePolynomial :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin (suc n) → R) →
  S →
  S
evaluatePolynomial domain codomain hom n coefficients x =
  sumFin codomain (suc n)
    (λ i →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR codomain
        (RingHom.map hom (coefficients i))
        (power codomain x (finToNat i)))

IsIntegral :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Set (r ⊔ s)
IsIntegral {R = R} {S = S} domain codomain hom =
  (x : S) →
  Σ Nat
    (λ degree →
      Σ (Fin (suc degree) → R)
        (λ coefficients →
          (coefficients (last degree) ≡
           CommutativeRing.oneR domain)
          and
          (evaluatePolynomial
             domain codomain hom degree coefficients x
           ≡
           CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain)))

KernelContainedIn :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  {domain : CommutativeRing R} →
  {codomain : CommutativeRing S} →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Ideal domain →
  Set (r ⊔ s)
KernelContainedIn {R = R} {codomain = codomain} hom ideal =
  (x : R) →
  RingHom.map hom x ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR codomain →
  Ideal.member ideal x

ContractionEqual :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  {domain : CommutativeRing R} →
  {codomain : CommutativeRing S} →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Ideal codomain →
  Ideal domain →
  Set (r ⊔ s)
ContractionEqual {R = R} hom upstairs downstairs =
  (x : R) →
  Iff
    (Ideal.member upstairs (RingHom.map hom x))
    (Ideal.member downstairs x)

IdealIncluded :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} →
  Ideal ring →
  Ideal ring →
  Set r
IdealIncluded {R = R} smaller larger =
  (x : R) →
  Ideal.member smaller x →
  Ideal.member larger x

ContractionIncludedInIdeal :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  {domain : CommutativeRing R} →
  {codomain : CommutativeRing S} →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Ideal codomain →
  Ideal domain →
  Set (r ⊔ s)
ContractionIncludedInIdeal {R = R} hom upstairs downstairs =
  (x : R) →
  Ideal.member upstairs (RingHom.map hom x) →
  Ideal.member downstairs x

IdealBelowContraction :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  {domain : CommutativeRing R} →
  {codomain : CommutativeRing S} →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Ideal domain →
  Ideal codomain →
  Set (r ⊔ s)
IdealBelowContraction {R = R} hom downstairs upstairs =
  (x : R) →
  Ideal.member downstairs x →
  Ideal.member upstairs (RingHom.map hom x)

HasGoingDown :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
HasGoingDown domain codomain hom =
  (p q : Ideal domain) →
  IsPrime p →
  IsPrime q →
  IdealIncluded p q →
  (Q : Ideal codomain) →
  IsPrime Q →
  ContractionEqual hom Q q →
  Σ (Ideal codomain)
    (λ P →
      IsPrime P and
      (IdealIncluded P Q and
       ContractionEqual hom P p))

GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap domain codomain hom =
  (Q : Ideal codomain) →
  IsPrime Q →
  (p : Ideal domain) →
  IsPrime p →
  IdealBelowContraction hom p Q →
  Σ (Ideal codomain)
    (λ P →
      IsPrime P and
      (IdealIncluded P Q and
       ContractionEqual hom P p))

LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective :
  {r s : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {S : Set s} →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  RingHom domain codomain →
  Ideal codomain →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective domain codomain hom Q =
  (p : Ideal domain) →
  IsPrime p →
  IdealBelowContraction hom p Q →
  Σ (Ideal codomain)
    (λ P →
      IsPrime P and
      (IdealIncluded P Q and
       ContractionEqual hom P p))

-- Lean: Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain
going-up-and-going-down-theorems :
  (r s : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
going-up-and-going-down-theorems r s =
  (R : Set r) →
  (S : Set s) →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  (algebra-map : RingHom domain codomain) →
  IsDomain codomain →
  IsIntegral domain codomain algebra-map →
  (P : Ideal domain) →
  IsPrime P →
  KernelContainedIn algebra-map P →
  Σ (Ideal codomain)
    (λ Q →
      IsPrime Q and
      ContractionEqual algebra-map Q P)

-- Lean: Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime
general-going-up-above-prime :
  (r s : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
general-going-up-above-prime r s =
  (R : Set r) →
  (S : Set s) →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  (algebra-map : RingHom domain codomain) →
  IsIntegral domain codomain algebra-map →
  (P : Ideal domain) →
  IsPrime P →
  (I : Ideal codomain) →
  IsPrime I →
  ContractionIncludedInIdeal algebra-map I P →
  Σ (Ideal codomain)
    (λ Q →
      IdealIncluded I Q and
      (IsPrime Q and
       ContractionEqual algebra-map Q P))

-- Lean: Algebra.HasGoingDown.iff_generalizingMap_primeSpectrumComap
going-down-iff-generalizing-prime-spectrum-comap :
  (r s : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
going-down-iff-generalizing-prime-spectrum-comap r s =
  (R : Set r) →
  (S : Set s) →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  (algebra-map : RingHom domain codomain) →
  Iff
    (HasGoingDown domain codomain algebra-map)
    (GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap domain codomain algebra-map)

-- Lean: Algebra.HasGoingDown.of_comap_localRingHom_surjective
going-down-from-local-prime-spectrum-surjectivity :
  (r s : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ s))
going-down-from-local-prime-spectrum-surjectivity r s =
  (R : Set r) →
  (S : Set s) →
  (domain : CommutativeRing R) →
  (codomain : CommutativeRing S) →
  (algebra-map : RingHom domain codomain) →
  ((Q : Ideal codomain) →
    IsPrime Q →
    LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective
      domain codomain algebra-map Q) →
  HasGoingDown domain codomain algebra-map

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2379132, "Going-up and going-down theorems". It states the two indexed
  going-up results, the prime-spectrum characterization of going-down, and
  the localized-spectrum surjectivity criterion. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open listTheory;

val q2379132_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q2379132_comm_ring_def",
  ``q2379132_comm_ring
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneA x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))``);

val q2379132_integral_domain_def = new_definition (
  "q2379132_integral_domain_def",
  ``q2379132_integral_domain
      (zero : 'a) (oneA : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      q2379132_comm_ring zero oneA add mul neg /\
      zero <> oneA /\
      (!x y. mul x y = zero ==> x = zero \/ y = zero)``);

val q2379132_ring_hom_def = new_definition (
  "q2379132_ring_hom_def",
  ``q2379132_ring_hom
      (Rzero : 'r) (Rone : 'r)
      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (Szero : 's) (Sone : 's)
      (Sadd : 's -> 's -> 's) (Smul : 's -> 's -> 's)
      (f : 'r -> 's) <=>
      f Rzero = Szero /\
      f Rone = Sone /\
      (!x y. f (Radd x y) = Sadd (f x) (f y)) /\
      (!x y. f (Rmul x y) = Smul (f x) (f y))``);

val q2379132_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q2379132_ideal_def",
  ``q2379132_ideal
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (idealA : 'a -> bool) <=>
      idealA zero /\
      (!x y. idealA x /\ idealA y ==> idealA (add x y)) /\
      (!x. idealA x ==> idealA (neg x)) /\
      (!a x. idealA x ==> idealA (mul a x))``);

      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (idealA : 'a -> bool) <=>

val q2379132_ideal_included_def = new_definition (

val q2379132_contraction_equal_def = new_definition (

  ``q2379132_contraction_equal

      (f : 'r -> 's) (downstairs : 'r -> bool)

val q2379132_has_going_down_def = new_definition (
  "q2379132_has_going_down_def",
  ``q2379132_has_going_down
      (Rzero : 'r) (Rone : 'r)
      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (Rneg : 'r -> 'r)

      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)

          ==>

val q2379132_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective_def = new_definition (

      (Szero : 's) (Sone : 's)
      (Sadd : 's -> 's -> 's) (Smul : 's -> 's -> 's)

val exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain =
  ``!(Rzero : 'r) (Rone : 'r)
      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (Rneg : 'r -> 'r)
      (Szero : 's) (Sone : 's)
      (Sadd : 's -> 's -> 's) (Smul : 's -> 's -> 's)
      (Sneg : 's -> 's) (f : 'r -> 's) (P : 'r -> bool).
      q2379132_comm_ring Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg /\
      q2379132_integral_domain Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg /\
      q2379132_ring_hom
        Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Szero Sone Sadd Smul f /\
      q2379132_integral_extension Rone Szero Sadd Smul f /\
      q2379132_prime_ideal Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg P /\
      (!r. f r = Szero ==> P r)
      ==>
      ?Q : 's -> bool.
        q2379132_prime_ideal Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg Q /\
        q2379132_contraction_equal f Q P``;

val exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime =
  ``!(Rzero : 'r) (Rone : 'r)
      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (Rneg : 'r -> 'r)
      (Szero : 's) (Sone : 's)
      (Sadd : 's -> 's -> 's) (Smul : 's -> 's -> 's)
      (Sneg : 's -> 's) (f : 'r -> 's)
      (P : 'r -> bool) (I : 's -> bool).
      q2379132_comm_ring Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg /\
      q2379132_comm_ring Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg /\
      q2379132_ring_hom
        Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Szero Sone Sadd Smul f /\
      q2379132_integral_extension Rone Szero Sadd Smul f /\
      q2379132_prime_ideal Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg P /\
      q2379132_prime_ideal Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg I /\
      q2379132_contraction_included_in_ideal f I P
      ==>
      ?Q : 's -> bool.
        q2379132_ideal_included I Q /\
        q2379132_prime_ideal Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg Q /\
        q2379132_contraction_equal f Q P``;

val has_going_down_iff_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap =
  ``!(Rzero : 'r) (Rone : 'r)
      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (Rneg : 'r -> 'r)
      (Szero : 's) (Sone : 's)
      (Sadd : 's -> 's -> 's) (Smul : 's -> 's -> 's)
      (Sneg : 's -> 's) (f : 'r -> 's).
      q2379132_comm_ring Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg /\
      q2379132_comm_ring Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg /\
      q2379132_ring_hom
        Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Szero Sone Sadd Smul f
      ==>
      (q2379132_has_going_down
         Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg
         Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg f
       <=>
       q2379132_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap
         Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg

val has_going_down_of_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective =
  ``!(Rzero : 'r) (Rone : 'r)
      (Radd : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (Rmul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)

      (Sadd : 's -> 's -> 's) (Smul : 's -> 's -> 's)

      q2379132_comm_ring Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Rneg /\
      q2379132_comm_ring Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg /\
      q2379132_ring_hom
        Rzero Rone Radd Rmul Szero Sone Sadd Smul f /\
      (!Q : 's -> bool.
        q2379132_prime_ideal Szero Sone Sadd Smul Sneg Q
        ==>

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2379132
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2379132), "Going-up and going-down
  theorems". It states the two indexed going-up results, the prime-spectrum
  characterization of going-down, and the localized-spectrum surjectivity
  criterion. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q2379132MapPolynomial says that Q is obtained from P by applying the ring
  homomorphism A coefficientwise. Q2379132IntegralExtension says that every
  element of S is a root of such a transported monic polynomial over R. This
  is the usual elementwise definition of an integral R-algebra structure on S.

  Q2379132HasGoingDown is the prime-ideal lifting property: if p is contained
  in q and Q contracts to q, then some P contained in Q contracts to p.
  Q2379132GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap gives the equivalent pointwise
  generalizing-map condition. Q2379132LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective is
  the same lifting condition at one fixed prime Q, corresponding to
  surjectivity after localization at Q and its contraction.

  Every declaration introduced below by this root artifact is an unproved $a
  statement encoding, and the root artifact adds no $p proof. The imported
  lib/set.mm supplies the library's existing proofs.
$)

$c Q2379132MapPolynomial Q2379132IntegralExtension
   Q2379132HasGoingDown Q2379132GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap
   Q2379132LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective $.

q2379132-map-polynomial-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2379132MapPolynomial R S A P Q ) $.
q2379132-integral-extension-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2379132IntegralExtension R S A ) $.
q2379132-has-going-down-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2379132HasGoingDown R S A ) $.
q2379132-generalizing-prime-spectrum-comap-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2379132GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap R S A ) $.
q2379132-local-prime-spectrum-comap-surjective-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2379132LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective R S A Q ) $.

${
  $d A P Q R S k $.

  q2379132-map-polynomial-definition $a |- (
    Q2379132MapPolynomial R S A P Q
  ) <->
  (
    P e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` R ) )
    /\
    (
      Q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` S ) )
      /\
      A. k e. NN0
        (
          ( ( coe1 ` Q ) ` k )
          =
          ( A ` ( ( coe1 ` P ) ` k ) )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R S p q x $.

  q2379132-integral-extension-definition $a |- (
    Q2379132IntegralExtension R S A
  ) <->
  (
    A. x e. ( Base ` S )
      E. p e. ( Monic1p ` R )
        E. q e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` S ) )
          (
            ( Q2379132MapPolynomial R S A p q )
            /\
            (
              ( ( ( eval1 ` S ) ` q ) ` x )
              =
              ( 0g ` S )
            )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R S i j p q $.

  q2379132-has-going-down-definition $a |- (
    Q2379132HasGoingDown R S A
  ) <->
  (
    A. p e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
      A. q e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
        A. i e. ( PrmIdeal ` S )
          (
            (
              p C_ q
              /\
              ( ( `' A " i ) = q )
            )
            ->
            E. j e. ( PrmIdeal ` S )
              (
                j C_ i
                /\
                ( ( `' A " j ) = p )
              )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A R S i j p $.

  q2379132-generalizing-prime-spectrum-comap-definition $a |- (
    Q2379132GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap R S A
  ) <->
  (
    A. i e. ( PrmIdeal ` S )
      A. p e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
        (
          p C_ ( `' A " i )
          ->
          E. j e. ( PrmIdeal ` S )
            (
              j C_ i
              /\
              ( ( `' A " j ) = p )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A Q R S j p $.

  q2379132-local-prime-spectrum-comap-surjective-definition $a |- (
    Q2379132LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective R S A Q
  ) <->
  (
    A. p e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
      (
        p C_ ( `' A " Q )
        ->
        E. j e. ( PrmIdeal ` S )
          (
            j C_ Q
            /\
            ( ( `' A " j ) = p )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a p q r s $.

  thousand-theorems-q2379132-going-up-and-going-down-theorems $a |-
    A. r e. CRing
      A. s e. IDomn
        A. a e. ( r RingHom s )
          A. p e. ( PrmIdeal ` r )
            (
              (
                ( Q2379132IntegralExtension r s a )
                /\
                ( ( `' a " { ( 0g ` s ) } ) C_ p )
              )
              ->
              E. q e. ( PrmIdeal ` s )
                ( ( `' a " q ) = p )
            )
  $.
$}

${
  $d a i p q r s $.

  thousand-theorems-q2379132-going-up-above-prime $a |-
    A. r e. CRing
      A. s e. CRing
        A. a e. ( r RingHom s )
          A. p e. ( PrmIdeal ` r )
            A. i e. ( PrmIdeal ` s )
              (
                (
                  ( Q2379132IntegralExtension r s a )
                  /\
                  ( ( `' a " i ) C_ p )
                )
                ->
                E. q e. ( PrmIdeal ` s )
                  (
                    i C_ q
                    /\
                    ( ( `' a " q ) = p )
                  )
              )
  $.
$}

${
  $d a r s $.

  thousand-theorems-q2379132-going-down-iff-generalizing $a |-
    A. r e. CRing
      A. s e. CRing
        A. a e. ( r RingHom s )
          (
            ( Q2379132HasGoingDown r s a )
            <->
            ( Q2379132GeneralizingPrimeSpectrumComap r s a )
          )
  $.
$}

${
  $d a i r s $.

  thousand-theorems-q2379132-going-down-from-local-surjectivity $a |-
    A. r e. CRing
      A. s e. CRing
        A. a e. ( r RingHom s )
          (
            (
              A. i e. ( PrmIdeal ` s )
                (
                  Q2379132LocalPrimeSpectrumComapSurjective
                    r s a i
                )
            )
            ->
            ( Q2379132HasGoingDown r s a )
          )
  $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being comRing,
      S being domRing,
      h being Function of R,S,
      P being Ideal of R
  st h is additive multiplicative unity-preserving &
     P <> the carrier of R &
     (for a,b being Element of R st a*b in P holds a in P or b in P) &
     (for x being Element of R st h.x = 0.S holds x in P) &
     (for s being Element of S holds
        ex p being Polynomial of R,
           q being Polynomial of S st
          LC p = 1.R &
          (for i being Nat holds q.i = h.(p.i)) &
          eval(q,s) = 0.S)
  holds ex Q being Ideal of S st
    Q <> the carrier of S &
    (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in Q holds a in Q or b in Q) &
    h"Q = P
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for R,S being comRing,
      h being Function of R,S,
      P being Ideal of R,
      I being Ideal of S
  st h is additive multiplicative unity-preserving &
     P <> the carrier of R &
     (for a,b being Element of R st a*b in P holds a in P or b in P) &
     I <> the carrier of S &
     (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in I holds a in I or b in I) &
     h"I c= P &
     (for s being Element of S holds
        ex p being Polynomial of R,
           q being Polynomial of S st
          LC p = 1.R &
          (for i being Nat holds q.i = h.(p.i)) &
          eval(q,s) = 0.S)
  holds ex Q being Ideal of S st
    I c= Q &
    Q <> the carrier of S &
    (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in Q holds a in Q or b in Q) &
    h"Q = P
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for R,S being comRing,
      h being Function of R,S
  st h is additive multiplicative unity-preserving
  holds
    ((for p,q being Ideal of R st
        p <> the carrier of R &
        (for a,b being Element of R st a*b in p holds a in p or b in p) &
        q <> the carrier of R &
        (for a,b being Element of R st a*b in q holds a in q or b in q) &
        p c= q
      holds
        for Q being Ideal of S st
          Q <> the carrier of S &
          (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in Q holds a in Q or b in Q) &
          h"Q = q
        holds
          ex P being Ideal of S st
            P <> the carrier of S &
            (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in P holds a in P or b in P) &
            P c= Q &
            h"P = p)
     iff
     (for Q being Ideal of S st
        Q <> the carrier of S &
        (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in Q holds a in Q or b in Q)
      holds
        for p being Ideal of R st
          p <> the carrier of R &
          (for a,b being Element of R st a*b in p holds a in p or b in p) &
          p c= h"Q
        holds
          ex P being Ideal of S st
            P <> the carrier of S &
            (for a,b being Element of S st a*b in P holds a in P or b in P) &
            P c= Q &
            h"P = p))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2379132
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q2379132), "Going-up and going-down theorems".
% It states the two indexed going-up results, the prime-spectrum
% characterization of going-down, and the localized-spectrum surjectivity
% criterion. This file contains no proof.

Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems[
  R, S: TYPE+,
  zero_R, one_R: R,
  neg_R: [R -> R],
  add_R, mul_R: [R, R -> R],
  zero_S, one_S: S,
  neg_S: [S -> S],
  add_S, mul_S: [S, S -> S],
  algebra_map: [R -> S]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  ideal_R: TYPE = [R -> bool]
  ideal_S: TYPE = [S -> bool]

  commutative_ring_R: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      add_R(add_R(a, b), c) = add_R(a, add_R(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        add_R(a, b) = add_R(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        add_R(zero_R, a) = a
          AND add_R(a, zero_R) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        add_R(neg_R(a), a) = zero_R
          AND add_R(a, neg_R(a)) = zero_R)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mul_R(mul_R(a, b), c) = mul_R(a, mul_R(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        mul_R(a, b) = mul_R(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mul_R(one_R, a) = a
          AND mul_R(a, one_R) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mul_R(a, add_R(b, c))
          = add_R(mul_R(a, b), mul_R(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mul_R(add_R(a, b), c)
          = add_R(mul_R(a, c), mul_R(b, c)))

  commutative_ring_S: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b, c: S):
      add_S(add_S(a, b), c) = add_S(a, add_S(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: S):
        add_S(a, b) = add_S(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: S):
        add_S(zero_S, a) = a
          AND add_S(a, zero_S) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: S):
        add_S(neg_S(a), a) = zero_S
          AND add_S(a, neg_S(a)) = zero_S)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: S):
        mul_S(mul_S(a, b), c) = mul_S(a, mul_S(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: S):
        mul_S(a, b) = mul_S(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: S):
        mul_S(one_S, a) = a
          AND mul_S(a, one_S) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: S):
        mul_S(a, add_S(b, c))
          = add_S(mul_S(a, b), mul_S(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: S):
        mul_S(add_S(a, b), c)
          = add_S(mul_S(a, c), mul_S(b, c)))

  ring_homomorphism: bool =
    algebra_map(zero_R) = zero_S
      AND algebra_map(one_R) = one_S
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        algebra_map(add_R(a, b))
          = add_S(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        algebra_map(mul_R(a, b))
          = mul_S(algebra_map(a), algebra_map(b)))

  integral_domain_S: bool =
    commutative_ring_S
      AND one_S /= zero_S
      AND (FORALL (a, b: S):
        mul_S(a, b) = zero_S
          IMPLIES a = zero_S OR b = zero_S)

  polynomial_value(
      coefficients: list[R],
      x: S): RECURSIVE S =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: zero_S,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_S(
          algebra_map(head),
          mul_S(x, polynomial_value(tail, x)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  monic_coefficients(coefficients: list[R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        CASES tail OF
          null: head = one_R,
          cons(next, rest): monic_coefficients(tail)
        ENDCASES
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  integral_element(x: S): bool =
    EXISTS (coefficients: list[R]):
      monic_coefficients(coefficients)
        AND polynomial_value(coefficients, x) = zero_S

  integral_algebra: bool =
    FORALL (x: S):
      integral_element(x)

  is_ideal_R(I: ideal_R): bool =
    I(zero_R)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        I(a) AND I(b) IMPLIES I(add_R(a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        I(a) IMPLIES I(neg_R(a)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        I(b) IMPLIES I(mul_R(a, b)))

  is_ideal_S(I: ideal_S): bool =
    I(zero_S)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: S):
        I(a) AND I(b) IMPLIES I(add_S(a, b)))
      AND (FORALL (a: S):
        I(a) IMPLIES I(neg_S(a)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: S):
        I(b) IMPLIES I(mul_S(a, b)))

  is_prime_R(P: ideal_R): bool =
    is_ideal_R(P)
      AND NOT P(one_R)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        P(mul_R(a, b)) IMPLIES P(a) OR P(b))

  is_prime_S(Q: ideal_S): bool =
    is_ideal_S(Q)
      AND NOT Q(one_S)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: S):
        Q(mul_S(a, b)) IMPLIES Q(a) OR Q(b))

  kernel_contained_in(P: ideal_R): bool =
    FORALL (a: R):
      algebra_map(a) = zero_S IMPLIES P(a)

  contracts_to(Q: ideal_S, P: ideal_R): bool =
    FORALL (a: R):
      Q(algebra_map(a)) IFF P(a)

  ideal_included_R(I, J: ideal_R): bool =
    FORALL (a: R):
      I(a) IMPLIES J(a)

  ideal_included_S(I, J: ideal_S): bool =
    FORALL (a: S):
      I(a) IMPLIES J(a)

  contraction_included_in_ideal(
      Q: ideal_S,
      P: ideal_R): bool =
    FORALL (a: R):
      Q(algebra_map(a)) IMPLIES P(a)

  ideal_below_contraction(
      P: ideal_R,
      Q: ideal_S): bool =
    FORALL (a: R):
      P(a) IMPLIES Q(algebra_map(a))

  has_going_down: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: ideal_R):
      is_prime_R(p)
        AND is_prime_R(q)
        AND ideal_included_R(p, q)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (Q: ideal_S):
            is_prime_S(Q)
              AND contracts_to(Q, q)
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (P: ideal_S):
                  is_prime_S(P)
                    AND ideal_included_S(P, Q)
                    AND contracts_to(P, p)

  generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap: bool =
    FORALL (Q: ideal_S):
      is_prime_S(Q)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (p: ideal_R):
            is_prime_R(p)
              AND ideal_below_contraction(p, Q)
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (P: ideal_S):
                  is_prime_S(P)
                    AND ideal_included_S(P, Q)
                    AND contracts_to(P, p)

  local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective(Q: ideal_S): bool =
    FORALL (p: ideal_R):
      is_prime_R(p)
        AND ideal_below_contraction(p, Q)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (P: ideal_S):
            is_prime_S(P)
              AND ideal_included_S(P, Q)
              AND contracts_to(P, p)

  exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain: bool =
    (commutative_ring_R
      AND integral_domain_S
      AND ring_homomorphism
      AND integral_algebra)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (P: ideal_R):
        is_prime_R(P)
          AND kernel_contained_in(P)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (Q: ideal_S):
              is_prime_S(Q)
                AND contracts_to(Q, P)

  exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime: bool =
    (commutative_ring_R
      AND commutative_ring_S
      AND ring_homomorphism
      AND integral_algebra)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (P: ideal_R, I: ideal_S):
        is_prime_R(P)
          AND is_prime_S(I)
          AND contraction_included_in_ideal(I, P)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (Q: ideal_S):
              ideal_included_S(I, Q)
                AND is_prime_S(Q)
                AND contracts_to(Q, P)

  has_going_down_iff_generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap: bool =
    (commutative_ring_R
      AND commutative_ring_S
      AND ring_homomorphism)
    IMPLIES
      (has_going_down IFF generalizing_prime_spectrum_comap)

  has_going_down_of_local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective: bool =
    (commutative_ring_R
      AND commutative_ring_S
      AND ring_homomorphism
      AND
        (FORALL (Q: ideal_S):
          is_prime_S(Q)
            IMPLIES local_prime_spectrum_comap_surjective(Q)))
    IMPLIES has_going_down

END Q2379132_going_up_and_going_down_theorems

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q245098
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q245098), "Intermediate value theorem": a function
-- continuous on a closed interval takes every value in the ordered interval from
-- its value at the left endpoint to its value at the right endpoint. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue

@[expose] public section

open Set

universe u v

namespace Q245098

variable {α : Type u} [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [TopologicalSpace α]
  [OrderTopology α] [DenselyOrdered α]
variable {δ : Type v} [LinearOrder δ] [TopologicalSpace δ] [OrderClosedTopology δ]

/-- The intermediate value theorem on a closed interval, in the case `f a ≤ t ≤ f b`. -/
theorem intermediate_value_Icc {a b : α} (hab : a ≤ b) {f : α → δ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Icc a b)) : Icc (f a) (f b) ⊆ f '' Icc a b := sorry

end Q245098

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q245098
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q245098), "Intermediate value theorem": a
  continuous function on a closed interval in a densely ordered conditionally
  complete linear order takes every value between its endpoint values. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q245098_set (X : Type) : Type := X -> Prop.

Definition q245098_subset
    {X : Type}
    (U V : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X, U x -> V x.

Record q245098_linear_order (X : Type) : Type := {
  q245098_le : X -> X -> Prop;
  q245098_le_refl :
    forall x : X, q245098_le x x;
  q245098_le_antisym :
    forall x y : X,
      q245098_le x y -> q245098_le y x -> x = y;
  q245098_le_trans :
    forall x y z : X,
      q245098_le x y -> q245098_le y z -> q245098_le x z;
  q245098_le_total :
    forall x y : X, q245098_le x y \/ q245098_le y x
}.

Arguments q245098_le {X} _ _ _.

Definition q245098_lt
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (x y : X) : Prop :=
  q245098_le O x y /\ ~ q245098_le O y x.

Definition q245098_nonempty
    {X : Type}
    (s : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  exists x : X, s x.

Definition q245098_bounded_above
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (s : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  exists upper : X,
    forall x : X, s x -> q245098_le O x upper.

Definition q245098_bounded_below
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (s : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  exists lower : X,
    forall x : X, s x -> q245098_le O lower x.

Definition q245098_is_lub
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (s : q245098_set X)
    (upper : X) : Prop :=
  (forall x : X, s x -> q245098_le O x upper) /\
  (forall bound : X,
    (forall x : X, s x -> q245098_le O x bound) ->
    q245098_le O upper bound).

Definition q245098_is_glb
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (s : q245098_set X)
    (lower : X) : Prop :=
  (forall x : X, s x -> q245098_le O lower x) /\
  (forall bound : X,
    (forall x : X, s x -> q245098_le O bound x) ->
    q245098_le O bound lower).

Record q245098_conditionally_complete
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X) : Type := {
  q245098_exists_lub :
    forall s : q245098_set X,
      q245098_nonempty s ->
      q245098_bounded_above O s ->
      exists upper : X, q245098_is_lub O s upper;
  q245098_exists_glb :
    forall s : q245098_set X,
      q245098_nonempty s ->
      q245098_bounded_below O s ->
      exists lower : X, q245098_is_glb O s lower
}.

Definition q245098_densely_ordered
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X) : Prop :=
  forall x y : X,
    q245098_lt O x y ->
    exists z : X,
      q245098_lt O x z /\ q245098_lt O z y.

Record q245098_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q245098_is_open : q245098_set X -> Prop;
  q245098_open_ext :
    forall U V : q245098_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q245098_is_open U <-> q245098_is_open V);
  q245098_open_univ :
    q245098_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q245098_open_inter :
    forall U V : q245098_set X,
      q245098_is_open U ->
      q245098_is_open V ->
      q245098_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q245098_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q245098_set (q245098_set X),
      (forall U : q245098_set X,
        family U -> q245098_is_open U) ->
      q245098_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q245098_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q245098_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q245098_neighborhood
    {X : Type}
    (T : q245098_topological_space X)
    (x : X)
    (U : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  exists V : q245098_set X,
    q245098_is_open T V /\
    V x /\
    q245098_subset V U.

Definition q245098_generated_order_open
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (U : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  forall T : q245098_topological_space X,
    (forall a : X,
      q245098_is_open T
        (fun x : X => q245098_lt O a x)) ->
    (forall a : X,
      q245098_is_open T
        (fun x : X => q245098_lt O x a)) ->
    q245098_is_open T U.

Definition q245098_order_topology
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (T : q245098_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  forall U : q245098_set X,
    q245098_is_open T U <->
    q245098_generated_order_open O U.

Definition q245098_order_closed_topology
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (T : q245098_topological_space X) : Prop :=
  forall x y : X,
    ~ q245098_le O x y ->
    exists U V : q245098_set X,
      q245098_neighborhood T x U /\
      q245098_neighborhood T y V /\
      forall u v : X,
        U u -> V v -> ~ q245098_le O u v.

Definition q245098_closed_interval
    {X : Type}
    (O : q245098_linear_order X)
    (a b : X) : q245098_set X :=
  fun x : X =>
    q245098_le O a x /\ q245098_le O x b.

Definition q245098_continuous_within_at
    {X Y : Type}
    (TX : q245098_topological_space X)
    (TY : q245098_topological_space Y)
    (f : X -> Y)
    (s : q245098_set X)
    (x : X) : Prop :=
  forall V : q245098_set Y,
    q245098_neighborhood TY (f x) V ->
    exists U : q245098_set X,
      q245098_neighborhood TX x U /\
      forall y : X, s y -> U y -> V (f y).

Definition q245098_continuous_on
    {X Y : Type}
    (TX : q245098_topological_space X)
    (TY : q245098_topological_space Y)
    (f : X -> Y)
    (s : q245098_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X,
    s x ->
    q245098_continuous_within_at TX TY f s x.

Theorem intermediate_value_Icc :
  forall (Alpha Delta : Type)
         (OA : q245098_linear_order Alpha)
         (CCA : q245098_conditionally_complete OA)
         (DenseA : q245098_densely_ordered OA)
         (TA : q245098_topological_space Alpha)
         (OrderTA : q245098_order_topology OA TA)
         (OD : q245098_linear_order Delta)
         (TD : q245098_topological_space Delta)
         (ClosedTD : q245098_order_closed_topology OD TD)
         (a b : Alpha)
         (f : Alpha -> Delta),
    q245098_le OA a b ->
    q245098_continuous_on TA TD f
      (q245098_closed_interval OA a b) ->
    forall y : Delta,
      q245098_le OD (f a) y ->
      q245098_le OD y (f b) ->
      exists x : Alpha,
        q245098_closed_interval OA a b x /\
        f x = y.
Admitted.

(*

  between its endpoint values. This file contains no proof.

theory Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
  imports "HOL.Topological_Spaces"
