theorem q245098_intermediate_value_Icc:
  fixes a b :: "'a::{conditionally_complete_linorder,dense_linorder,linorder_topology}"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'b::{linorder,topological_space}"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "closed ({(x, y). x \<le> y} :: ('b \<times> 'b) set)"
    and "continuous_on {a..b} f"
  shows "{f a..f b} \<subseteq> f ` {a..b}"
  sorry

end

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q245098,
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q245098), "Intermediate value theorem": a
  continuous function on a closed interval in a dense conditionally complete
  linear order attains every value between its endpoint values. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q245098_INTERMEDIATE_VALUE_THEOREM =
  `let strict =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (x:A) (y:A). le x y /\ ~(x = y) in
   let is_linear_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y \/ le y x) in
   let bounded_above =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool).
       ?u:A. !x:A. x IN s ==> le x u in
   let bounded_below =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool).
       ?l:A. !x:A. x IN s ==> le l x in
   let is_lub =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (u:A).
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x u) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x v) ==> le u v) in
   let is_glb =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (l:A).
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> le l x) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> le v x) ==> le v l) in
   let is_conditionally_complete_linear_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       is_linear_order le /\
       (!s:A->bool.
          ~(s = {}) /\ bounded_above le s
          ==> ?u:A. is_lub le s u) /\
       (!s:A->bool.
          ~(s = {}) /\ bounded_below le s
          ==> ?l:A. is_glb le s l) in
   let is_densely_ordered =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       !x y:A.
         strict le x y
         ==> ?z:A. strict le x z /\ strict le z y in
   let is_topology =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (:A) /\
       (!family:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!u:A->bool. u IN family ==> open_sets u)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS family)) /\
       (!u v:A->bool.
          open_sets u /\ open_sets v
          ==> open_sets (u INTER v)) in
   let is_order_topology =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       is_topology open_sets /\
       (!a:A. open_sets {x:A | strict le x a}) /\
       (!a:A. open_sets {x:A | strict le a x}) /\
       (!candidate:(A->bool)->bool.
          is_topology candidate /\
          (!a:A. candidate {x:A | strict le x a}) /\
          (!a:A. candidate {x:A | strict le a x})
          ==> !u:A->bool. open_sets u ==> candidate u) in
   let is_linear_order_d =
     \(le:D->D->bool).
       (!x:D. le x x) /\
       (!x y:D. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:D. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
       (!x y:D. le x y \/ le y x) in
   let is_topology_d =
     \(open_sets:(D->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (:D) /\
       (!family:(D->bool)->bool.
          (!u:D->bool. u IN family ==> open_sets u)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS family)) /\
       (!u v:D->bool.
          open_sets u /\ open_sets v
          ==> open_sets (u INTER v)) in
   let is_order_closed_topology =
     \(le:D->D->bool) (open_sets:(D->bool)->bool).
       is_topology_d open_sets /\
       (!x y:D.
          ~le x y
          ==> ?u v:D->bool.
                open_sets u /\ open_sets v /\
                x IN u /\ y IN v /\
                (!x' y':D.
                   x' IN u /\ y' IN v ==> ~le x' y')) in
   let continuous_on =
     \(open_a:(A->bool)->bool) (open_d:(D->bool)->bool)
      (f:A->D) (s:A->bool).
       !u:D->bool.
         open_d u
         ==> ?v:A->bool.
               open_a v /\
               (!x:A. x IN s ==> (f x IN u <=> x IN v)) in
   !le_a:A->A->bool.
   !open_a:(A->bool)->bool.
   !le_d:D->D->bool.
   !open_d:(D->bool)->bool.
   !f:A->D.
   !a b:A.
     is_conditionally_complete_linear_order le_a /\
     is_densely_ordered le_a /\
     is_order_topology le_a open_a /\
     is_linear_order_d le_d /\
     is_order_closed_topology le_d open_d /\
     le_a a b /\
     continuous_on open_a open_d f {x:A | le_a a x /\ le_a x b}
     ==> !t:D.
           le_d (f a) t /\ le_d t (f b)
           ==> ?x:A.
                 le_a a x /\ le_a x b /\ f x = t`;;

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q245098,
;; "Intermediate value theorem": a function continuous on a closed interval
;; in a dense conditionally complete linear order attains every ordered value
;; between its endpoint values. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ predicates and functions present arbitrary carriers, sets,
;; relations, and maps. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded universal quantification;
;; inequality with a constant-false function supplies internal existential
;; quantification. The domain topology is definitionally eliminated in favor
;; of the interval basis for its OrderTopology. The codomain topology is
;; presented by its neighborhood relation, with the standard neighborhood
;; axioms and the separation condition equivalent to closedness of <=.

(defun q245098-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q245098-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q245098-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q245098-quoted nil)))

(defun q245098-apply-term (function-term arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        function-term
        (q245098-term-list arguments)))

(defun q245098-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (q245098-apply-term
   (q245098-quoted function)
   arguments))

(defun q245098-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q245098-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q245098-quoted nil))
    (q245098-quoted t)))

(defun q245098-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q245098-quoted nil)
        (q245098-quoted t)))

(defun q245098-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q245098-quoted t)))

(defun q245098-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q245098-quoted t)
              (q245098-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q245098-quoted nil)
              (q245098-quoted t))))

(defun q245098-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q245098-quoted t)))

(defun q245098-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q245098-quoted nil)))

(defun q245098-booleanized-function (function formals)
  (list
   'lambda formals
   (list
    'if
    (q245098-static-apply-term function formals)
    (q245098-quoted t)
    (q245098-quoted nil))))

(defun q245098-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((booleanized
         (q245098-booleanized-function function formals))
        (always-true (q245098-true-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp booleanized)
         (tamep-functionp always-true)
         (fn-equal booleanized always-true))))

(defun q245098-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((booleanized
         (q245098-booleanized-function function formals))
        (always-false (q245098-false-function formals)))
    (and (tamep-functionp function)
         (tamep-functionp booleanized)
         (tamep-functionp always-false)
         (not (fn-equal booleanized always-false)))))

(defun q245098-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q245098-relation-p (relation left right)
  (if (apply$ relation (list left right)) t nil))

(defun q245098-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q245098-le-p (relation left right)
  (q245098-relation-p relation left right))

(defun q245098-lt-p (relation left right)
  (and
   (q245098-le-p relation left right)
   (not (q245098-le-p relation right left))))

;; Arbitrary represented subsets.

(defun q245098-valid-set-row-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term set '(x))
    (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x)))))

(defun q245098-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-valid-set-row-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

(defun q245098-subset-row-function (carrier left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term left '(x))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term right '(x)))))

(defun q245098-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q245098-valid-set-p carrier left)
   (q245098-valid-set-p carrier right)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-subset-row-function carrier left right)
    '(x))))

(defun q245098-intersection-term (left-term right-term)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (q245098-apply-term left-term '(x))
     (q245098-apply-term right-term '(x))))))

(defun q245098-set-nonempty-row-function (carrier set)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
     (q245098-static-apply-term set '(x))))))

(defun q245098-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (q245098-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q245098-exists-p
    (q245098-set-nonempty-row-function carrier set)
    '(x))))

;; Linear orders.

(defun q245098-order-reflexive-row-function (carrier le)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q245098-static-apply-term le '(x x)))))

(defun q245098-order-antisymmetric-row-function (carrier le)
  (list
   'lambda '(x y)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term le '(x y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term le '(y x))))
    (list 'equal 'x 'y))))

(defun q245098-order-transitive-row-function (carrier le)
  (list
   'lambda '(x y z)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(z))
      (q245098-static-apply-term le '(x y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term le '(y z))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term le '(x z)))))

(defun q245098-order-total-row-function (carrier le)
  (list
   'lambda '(x y)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(y))))
    (list 'if
          (q245098-static-apply-term le '(x y))
          (q245098-quoted t)
          (q245098-static-apply-term le '(y x))))))

(defun q245098-linear-order-p (carrier le)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp le)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-order-reflexive-row-function carrier le)
    '(x))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-order-antisymmetric-row-function carrier le)
    '(x y))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-order-transitive-row-function carrier le)
    '(x y z))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-order-total-row-function carrier le)
    '(x y))))

;; Density and conditional completeness of the domain order.

(defun q245098-between-witness-function (carrier le left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(middle)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(middle))
     (list 'q245098-lt-p
           (q245098-quoted le)
           (q245098-quoted left)
           'middle)
     (list 'q245098-lt-p
           (q245098-quoted le)
           'middle
           (q245098-quoted right))))))

(defun q245098-density-row-function (carrier le)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(left))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(right))
      (list 'q245098-lt-p
            (q245098-quoted le)
            'left
            'right)))
    (list 'q245098-exists-p
          (list 'q245098-between-witness-function
                (q245098-quoted carrier)
                (q245098-quoted le)
                'left
                'right)
          (q245098-quoted '(middle))))))

(defun q245098-dense-order-p (carrier le)
  (q245098-universal-p
   (q245098-density-row-function carrier le)
   '(left right)))

(defun q245098-upper-bound-row-function
    (carrier le set upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     le (list 'x (q245098-quoted upper))))))

(defun q245098-upper-bound-p
    (carrier le set upper)
  (and
   (q245098-member-p carrier upper)
   (q245098-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-upper-bound-row-function
     carrier le set upper)
    '(x))))

(defun q245098-lower-bound-row-function
    (carrier le set lower)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term set '(x))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     le (list (q245098-quoted lower) 'x)))))

(defun q245098-lower-bound-p
    (carrier le set lower)
  (and
   (q245098-member-p carrier lower)
   (q245098-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-lower-bound-row-function
     carrier le set lower)
    '(x))))

(defun q245098-bounded-above-witness-function
    (carrier le set)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (list 'q245098-upper-bound-p
         (q245098-quoted carrier)
         (q245098-quoted le)
         (q245098-quoted set)
         'upper)))

(defun q245098-bounded-above-p (carrier le set)
  (q245098-exists-p
   (q245098-bounded-above-witness-function
    carrier le set)
   '(upper)))

(defun q245098-bounded-below-witness-function
    (carrier le set)
  (list
   'lambda '(lower)
   (list 'q245098-lower-bound-p
         (q245098-quoted carrier)
         (q245098-quoted le)
         (q245098-quoted set)
         'lower)))

(defun q245098-bounded-below-p (carrier le set)
  (q245098-exists-p
   (q245098-bounded-below-witness-function
    carrier le set)
   '(lower)))

(defun q245098-least-upper-bound-row-function
    (carrier le set supremum)
  (list
   'lambda '(upper)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (list 'q245098-upper-bound-p
          (q245098-quoted carrier)
          (q245098-quoted le)
          (q245098-quoted set)
          'upper)
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     le (list (q245098-quoted supremum) 'upper)))))

(defun q245098-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier le set supremum)
  (and
   (q245098-upper-bound-p carrier le set supremum)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-least-upper-bound-row-function
     carrier le set supremum)
    '(upper))))

(defun q245098-greatest-lower-bound-row-function
    (carrier le set infimum)
  (list
   'lambda '(lower)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (list 'q245098-lower-bound-p
          (q245098-quoted carrier)
          (q245098-quoted le)
          (q245098-quoted set)
          'lower)
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     le (list 'lower (q245098-quoted infimum))))))

(defun q245098-greatest-lower-bound-p
    (carrier le set infimum)
  (and
   (q245098-lower-bound-p carrier le set infimum)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-greatest-lower-bound-row-function
     carrier le set infimum)
    '(lower))))

(defun q245098-supremum-witness-function
    (carrier le set)
  (list
   'lambda '(supremum)
   (list 'q245098-least-upper-bound-p
         (q245098-quoted carrier)
         (q245098-quoted le)
         (q245098-quoted set)
         'supremum)))

(defun q245098-infimum-witness-function
    (carrier le set)
  (list
   'lambda '(infimum)
   (list 'q245098-greatest-lower-bound-p
         (q245098-quoted carrier)
         (q245098-quoted le)
         (q245098-quoted set)
         'infimum)))

(defun q245098-has-supremum-p (carrier le set)
  (q245098-exists-p
   (q245098-supremum-witness-function
    carrier le set)
   '(supremum)))

(defun q245098-has-infimum-p (carrier le set)
  (q245098-exists-p
   (q245098-infimum-witness-function
    carrier le set)
   '(infimum)))

(defun q245098-completeness-row-function (carrier le)
  (list
   'lambda '(set)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (q245098-implies-term
      (q245098-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'q245098-valid-set-p
              (q245098-quoted carrier) 'set)
        (list 'q245098-set-nonempty-p
              (q245098-quoted carrier) 'set)
        (list 'q245098-bounded-above-p
              (q245098-quoted carrier)
              (q245098-quoted le)
              'set)))
      (list 'q245098-has-supremum-p
            (q245098-quoted carrier)
            (q245098-quoted le)
            'set))
     (q245098-implies-term
      (q245098-and-terms
       (list
        (list 'q245098-valid-set-p
              (q245098-quoted carrier) 'set)
        (list 'q245098-set-nonempty-p
              (q245098-quoted carrier) 'set)
        (list 'q245098-bounded-below-p
              (q245098-quoted carrier)
              (q245098-quoted le)
              'set)))
      (list 'q245098-has-infimum-p
            (q245098-quoted carrier)
            (q245098-quoted le)
            'set))))))

(defun q245098-conditionally-complete-order-p
    (carrier le)
  (and
   (q245098-linear-order-p carrier le)
   (q245098-set-nonempty-p carrier carrier)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-completeness-row-function carrier le)
    '(set))))

;; Neighborhood-system presentation of the codomain topology.

(defun q245098-neighborhood-welltyped-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x set)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term neighborhood '(x set))
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (list 'q245098-valid-set-p
            (q245098-quoted carrier)
            'set))))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-full-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     neighborhood
     (list 'x (q245098-quoted carrier))))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-member-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x set)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term neighborhood '(x set))))
    (q245098-apply-term 'set '(x)))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-intersection-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x left right)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term neighborhood '(x left))
      (q245098-static-apply-term neighborhood '(x right))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     neighborhood
     (list
      'x
      (q245098-intersection-term 'left 'right))))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-upward-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x small large)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term neighborhood '(x small))
      (list 'q245098-subset-p
            (q245098-quoted carrier)
            'small
            'large)))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     neighborhood '(x large)))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-local-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood refinement set)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term refinement '(y))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     neighborhood
     (list 'y (q245098-quoted set))))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-local-witness-function
    (carrier neighborhood x set)
  (list
   'lambda '(refinement)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'q245098-valid-set-p
           (q245098-quoted carrier)
           'refinement)
     (q245098-static-apply-term
      neighborhood
      (list (q245098-quoted x) 'refinement))
     (list 'q245098-universal-p
           (list 'q245098-neighborhood-local-row-function
                 (q245098-quoted carrier)
                 (q245098-quoted neighborhood)
                 'refinement
                 (q245098-quoted set))
           (q245098-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-locality-row-function
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x set)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term neighborhood '(x set))
    (list 'q245098-exists-p
          (list 'q245098-neighborhood-local-witness-function
                (q245098-quoted carrier)
                (q245098-quoted neighborhood)
                'x
                'set)
          (q245098-quoted '(refinement))))))

(defun q245098-neighborhood-space-p
    (carrier neighborhood)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp neighborhood)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-neighborhood-welltyped-row-function
     carrier neighborhood)
    '(x set))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-neighborhood-full-row-function
     carrier neighborhood)
    '(x))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-neighborhood-member-row-function
     carrier neighborhood)
    '(x set))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-neighborhood-intersection-row-function
     carrier neighborhood)
    '(x left right))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-neighborhood-upward-row-function
     carrier neighborhood)
    '(x small large))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-neighborhood-locality-row-function
     carrier neighborhood)
    '(x set))))

;; Closedness of the codomain order relation.

(defun q245098-separated-pair-row-function
    (carrier le left right)
  (list
   'lambda '(u v)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(u))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(v))
      (q245098-static-apply-term left '(u))
      (q245098-static-apply-term right '(v))))
    (q245098-not-term
     (q245098-static-apply-term le '(u v))))))

(defun q245098-order-separation-witness-function
    (carrier le neighborhood x y)
  (list
   'lambda '(left right)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'q245098-valid-set-p
           (q245098-quoted carrier)
           'left)
     (list 'q245098-valid-set-p
           (q245098-quoted carrier)
           'right)
     (q245098-static-apply-term
      neighborhood
      (list (q245098-quoted x) 'left))
     (q245098-static-apply-term
      neighborhood
      (list (q245098-quoted y) 'right))
     (list 'q245098-universal-p
           (list 'q245098-separated-pair-row-function
                 (q245098-quoted carrier)
                 (q245098-quoted le)
                 'left
                 'right)
           (q245098-quoted '(u v)))))))

(defun q245098-order-closed-row-function
    (carrier le neighborhood)
  (list
   'lambda '(x y)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (q245098-not-term
       (q245098-static-apply-term le '(x y)))))
    (list 'q245098-exists-p
          (list 'q245098-order-separation-witness-function
                (q245098-quoted carrier)
                (q245098-quoted le)
                (q245098-quoted neighborhood)
                'x
                'y)
          (q245098-quoted '(left right))))))

(defun q245098-order-closed-topology-p
    (carrier le neighborhood)
  (and
   (q245098-linear-order-p carrier le)
   (q245098-neighborhood-space-p carrier neighborhood)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-order-closed-row-function
     carrier le neighborhood)
    '(x y))))

;; The order-topology neighborhood basis on the domain.

(defun q245098-order-basic-subset-row-function
    (carrier le set has-lower lower has-upper upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (q245098-implies-term
       (q245098-quoted has-lower)
       (list 'q245098-lt-p
             (q245098-quoted le)
             (q245098-quoted lower)
             'y))
      (q245098-implies-term
       (q245098-quoted has-upper)
       (list 'q245098-lt-p
             (q245098-quoted le)
             'y
             (q245098-quoted upper)))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term set '(y)))))

(defun q245098-order-neighborhood-witness-function
    (carrier le x set)
  (list
   'lambda '(has-lower lower has-upper upper)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'booleanp 'has-lower)
     (list 'booleanp 'has-upper)
     (q245098-implies-term
      'has-lower
      (q245098-and-terms
       (list
        (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(lower))
        (list 'q245098-lt-p
              (q245098-quoted le)
              'lower
              (q245098-quoted x)))))
     (q245098-implies-term
      'has-upper
      (q245098-and-terms
       (list
        (q245098-static-apply-term carrier '(upper))
        (list 'q245098-lt-p
              (q245098-quoted le)
              (q245098-quoted x)
              'upper))))
     (list 'q245098-universal-p
           (list 'q245098-order-basic-subset-row-function
                 (q245098-quoted carrier)
                 (q245098-quoted le)
                 (q245098-quoted set)
                 'has-lower
                 'lower
                 'has-upper
                 'upper)
           (q245098-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun q245098-order-neighborhood-p
    (carrier le x set)
  (and
   (q245098-member-p carrier x)
   (q245098-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q245098-exists-p
    (q245098-order-neighborhood-witness-function
     carrier le x set)
    '(has-lower lower has-upper upper))))

;; Functions and continuity on the source closed interval.

(defun q245098-function-values-row-function
    (domain codomain function)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term domain '(x))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     codomain
     (list (q245098-static-apply-term function '(x)))))))

(defun q245098-function-p
    (domain codomain function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-function-values-row-function
     domain codomain function)
    '(x))))

(defun q245098-in-icc-p (carrier le a b x)
  (and
   (q245098-member-p carrier x)
   (q245098-le-p le a x)
   (q245098-le-p le x b)))

(defun q245098-continuity-image-row-function
    (alpha alpha-le function a b target
           has-lower lower has-upper upper)
  (list
   'lambda '(y)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term alpha '(y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       alpha-le (list (q245098-quoted a) 'y))
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       alpha-le (list 'y (q245098-quoted b)))
      (q245098-implies-term
       (q245098-quoted has-lower)
       (list 'q245098-lt-p
             (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
             (q245098-quoted lower)
             'y))
      (q245098-implies-term
       (q245098-quoted has-upper)
       (list 'q245098-lt-p
             (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
             'y
             (q245098-quoted upper)))))
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     target
     (list (q245098-static-apply-term function '(y)))))))

(defun q245098-continuity-witness-function
    (alpha alpha-le function a b x target)
  (list
   'lambda '(has-lower lower has-upper upper)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (list 'booleanp 'has-lower)
     (list 'booleanp 'has-upper)
     (q245098-implies-term
      'has-lower
      (q245098-and-terms
       (list
        (q245098-static-apply-term alpha '(lower))
        (list 'q245098-lt-p
              (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
              'lower
              (q245098-quoted x)))))
     (q245098-implies-term
      'has-upper
      (q245098-and-terms
       (list
        (q245098-static-apply-term alpha '(upper))
        (list 'q245098-lt-p
              (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
              (q245098-quoted x)
              'upper))))
     (list 'q245098-universal-p
           (list 'q245098-continuity-image-row-function
                 (q245098-quoted alpha)
                 (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
                 (q245098-quoted function)
                 (q245098-quoted a)
                 (q245098-quoted b)
                 (q245098-quoted target)
                 'has-lower
                 'lower
                 'has-upper
                 'upper)
           (q245098-quoted '(y)))))))

(defun q245098-continuity-target-row-function
    (alpha alpha-le delta-neighborhood
           function a b x)
  (list
   'lambda '(target)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-static-apply-term
     delta-neighborhood
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       function (list (q245098-quoted x)))
      'target))
    (list 'q245098-exists-p
          (list 'q245098-continuity-witness-function
                (q245098-quoted alpha)
                (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
                (q245098-quoted function)
                (q245098-quoted a)
                (q245098-quoted b)
                (q245098-quoted x)
                'target)
          (q245098-quoted
           '(has-lower lower has-upper upper))))))

(defun q245098-continuity-point-row-function
    (alpha alpha-le delta-neighborhood function a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term alpha '(x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       alpha-le (list (q245098-quoted a) 'x))
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       alpha-le (list 'x (q245098-quoted b)))))
    (list 'q245098-universal-p
          (list 'q245098-continuity-target-row-function
                (q245098-quoted alpha)
                (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
                (q245098-quoted delta-neighborhood)
                (q245098-quoted function)
                (q245098-quoted a)
                (q245098-quoted b)
                'x)
          (q245098-quoted '(target))))))

(defun q245098-continuous-on-icc-p
    (alpha alpha-le delta-neighborhood function a b)
  (q245098-universal-p
   (q245098-continuity-point-row-function
    alpha alpha-le delta-neighborhood function a b)
   '(x)))

;; The image inclusion conclusion, with both quantifiers internal.

(defun q245098-image-witness-function
    (alpha alpha-le function a b target)
  (list
   'lambda '(x)
   (q245098-and-terms
    (list
     (q245098-static-apply-term alpha '(x))
     (q245098-static-apply-term
      alpha-le (list (q245098-quoted a) 'x))
     (q245098-static-apply-term
      alpha-le (list 'x (q245098-quoted b)))
     (list 'equal
           (q245098-static-apply-term function '(x))
           (q245098-quoted target))))))

(defun q245098-intermediate-value-row-function
    (delta delta-le function alpha alpha-le a b)
  (list
   'lambda '(target)
   (q245098-implies-term
    (q245098-and-terms
     (list
      (q245098-static-apply-term delta '(target))
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       delta-le
       (list
        (q245098-static-apply-term
         function (list (q245098-quoted a)))
        'target))
      (q245098-static-apply-term
       delta-le
       (list
        'target
        (q245098-static-apply-term
         function (list (q245098-quoted b)))))))
    (list 'q245098-exists-p
          (list 'q245098-image-witness-function
                (q245098-quoted alpha)
                (q245098-quoted alpha-le)
                (q245098-quoted function)
                (q245098-quoted a)
                (q245098-quoted b)
                'target)
          (q245098-quoted '(x))))))

;; intermediate_value_Icc
(defun thousand-theorems-q245098-intermediate-value-icc-statement
    (alpha alpha-le delta delta-le delta-neighborhood f a b)
  (implies
   (and
    (q245098-conditionally-complete-order-p alpha alpha-le)
    (q245098-dense-order-p alpha alpha-le)
    (q245098-order-closed-topology-p
     delta delta-le delta-neighborhood)
    (q245098-member-p alpha a)
    (q245098-member-p alpha b)
    (q245098-le-p alpha-le a b)
    (q245098-function-p alpha delta f)
    (q245098-continuous-on-icc-p
     alpha alpha-le delta-neighborhood f a b))
   (q245098-universal-p
    (q245098-intermediate-value-row-function
     delta delta-le f alpha alpha-le a b)
    '(target))))

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q245098,
-- "Intermediate value theorem": a function continuous on a closed interval
-- in a dense conditionally complete linear order takes every target value
-- between its endpoint values. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor iff
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Pair
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor pair
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record LinearOrder
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    lessOrEqual :
      A ->
      A ->
      Set a

    order-reflexive :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqual x x

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : A) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z

    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y

    order-total :
      (x y : A) ->
      Either
        (lessOrEqual x y)
        (lessOrEqual y x)

    order-decidable :
      (x y : A) ->
      Either
        (lessOrEqual x y)
        (Not (lessOrEqual x y))

open LinearOrder

StrictLess :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
StrictLess order x y =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual order x y)
    (Not (x == y))

UpperBound :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
UpperBound {A = A} order P upper =
  (x : A) ->
  P x ->
  lessOrEqual order x upper

LowerBound :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
LowerBound {A = A} order P lower =
  (x : A) ->
  P x ->
  lessOrEqual order lower x

BoundedAbove :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
BoundedAbove {A = A} order P =
  Exists A (UpperBound order P)

BoundedBelow :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
BoundedBelow {A = A} order P =
  Exists A (LowerBound order P)

Nonempty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
Nonempty {A = A} P =
  Exists A P

IsLeastUpperBound :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
IsLeastUpperBound {A = A} order P supremum =
  Both
    (UpperBound order P supremum)
    ((upper : A) ->
      UpperBound order P upper ->
      lessOrEqual order supremum upper)

IsGreatestLowerBound :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
IsGreatestLowerBound {A = A} order P infimum =
  Both
    (LowerBound order P infimum)
    ((lower : A) ->
      LowerBound order P lower ->
      lessOrEqual order lower infimum)

record ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    linearOrder :
      LinearOrder A

    supremum infimum :
      (A -> Set a) ->
      A

    supremum-property :
      (P : A -> Set a) ->
      Nonempty P ->
      BoundedAbove linearOrder P ->
      IsLeastUpperBound linearOrder P (supremum P)

    infimum-property :
      (P : A -> Set a) ->
      Nonempty P ->
      BoundedBelow linearOrder P ->
      IsGreatestLowerBound linearOrder P (infimum P)

open ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder

record DenselyOrdered
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (order : LinearOrder A) :
  Set a where

  field
    dense :
      (x y : A) ->
      StrictLess order x y ->
      Exists A
        (\ z ->
          Both
            (StrictLess order x z)
            (StrictLess order z y))

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      (A -> Set a) ->
      A ->
      Set a

    close-congruent :
      (U V : A -> Set a) ->
      ((x : A) -> Iff (U x) (V x)) ->
      (x : A) ->
      Iff (close U x) (close V x)

    close-empty :
      (x : A) ->
      close (\ _ -> Bottom {a}) x ->
      Bottom {a}

    subset-close :
      (U : A -> Set a) ->
      (x : A) ->
      U x ->
      close U x

    close-monotone :
      (U V : A -> Set a) ->
      ((x : A) -> U x -> V x) ->
      (x : A) ->
      close U x ->
      close V x

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : A -> Set a) ->
      (x : A) ->
      close (\ y -> Either (U y) (V y)) x ->
      Either (close U x) (close V x)

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : A -> Set a) ->
      (x : A) ->
      Either (close U x) (close V x) ->
      close (\ y -> Either (U y) (V y)) x

    close-idempotent :
      (U : A -> Set a) ->
      (x : A) ->
      close (close U) x ->
      close U x

open TopologicalSpace

Open :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
Open {A = A} topology U =
  (x : A) ->
  close topology (\ y -> Not (U y)) x ->
  Not (U x)

WholeNeighborhood :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
WholeNeighborhood {A = A} U =
  (y : A) ->
  U y

LeftRayNeighborhood :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
LeftRayNeighborhood {A = A} order U x =
  Exists A
    (\ upper ->
      Both
        (StrictLess order x upper)
        ((y : A) ->
          StrictLess order y upper ->
          U y))

RightRayNeighborhood :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
RightRayNeighborhood {A = A} order U x =
  Exists A
    (\ lower ->
      Both
        (StrictLess order lower x)
        ((y : A) ->
          StrictLess order lower y ->
          U y))

OpenIntervalNeighborhood :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  Set a
OpenIntervalNeighborhood {A = A} order U x =
  Exists A
    (\ lower ->
      Exists A
        (\ upper ->
          Both
            (StrictLess order lower x)
            (Both
              (StrictLess order x upper)
              ((y : A) ->
                StrictLess order lower y ->
                StrictLess order y upper ->
                U y))))

OrderOpen :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set a
OrderOpen {A = A} order U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  Either
    (WholeNeighborhood U)
    (Either
      (LeftRayNeighborhood order U x)
      (Either
        (RightRayNeighborhood order U x)
        (OpenIntervalNeighborhood order U x)))

record OrderTopology
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (order : LinearOrder A)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    open-iff-order-open :
      (U : A -> Set a) ->
      Iff
        (Open topology U)
        (OrderOpen order U)

ProductOpen :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  TopologicalSpace B ->
  (Pair A B -> Set (a ⊔ b)) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
ProductOpen {a = a} {b = b} {A = A} {B = B}
  topologyA topologyB W =
  (point : Pair A B) ->
  W point ->
  Exists (A -> Set a)
    (\ U ->
      Exists (B -> Set b)
        (\ V ->
          Both
            (Open topologyA U)
            (Both
              (Open topologyB V)
              (Both
                (U (Pair.first point))
                (Both
                  (V (Pair.second point))
                  ((x : A) ->
                    (y : B) ->
                    U x ->
                    V y ->
                    W (pair x y)))))))

record OrderClosedTopology
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (order : LinearOrder A)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    order-relation-closed :
      ProductOpen topology topology
        (\ point ->
          Not
            (lessOrEqual order
              (Pair.first point)
              (Pair.second point)))

InClosedInterval :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  LinearOrder A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
InClosedInterval order lower upper x =
  Both
    (lessOrEqual order lower x)
    (lessOrEqual order x upper)

ContinuousOn :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  TopologicalSpace B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
ContinuousOn {a = a} {b = b} {A = A} {B = B}
  topologyA topologyB function domain =
  (x : A) ->
  domain x ->
  (V : B -> Set b) ->
  Open topologyB V ->
  V (function x) ->
  Exists (A -> Set a)
    (\ U ->
      Both
        (Open topologyA U)
        (Both
          (U x)
          ((y : A) ->
            domain y ->
            U y ->
            V (function y))))

intermediate-value-Icc : Setω
intermediate-value-Icc =
  (a d : Level) ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (D : Set d) ->
  (completeOrderA : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder A) ->
  DenselyOrdered (linearOrder completeOrderA) ->
  (topologyA : TopologicalSpace A) ->
  OrderTopology (linearOrder completeOrderA) topologyA ->
  (orderD : LinearOrder D) ->
  (topologyD : TopologicalSpace D) ->
  OrderClosedTopology orderD topologyD ->
  (lower upper : A) ->
  lessOrEqual (linearOrder completeOrderA) lower upper ->
  (function : A -> D) ->
  ContinuousOn topologyA topologyD function
    (InClosedInterval
      (linearOrder completeOrderA)
      lower
      upper) ->
  (value : D) ->
  lessOrEqual orderD (function lower) value ->
  lessOrEqual orderD value (function upper) ->
  Exists A
    (\ x ->
      Both
        (InClosedInterval
          (linearOrder completeOrderA)
          lower
          upper
          x)
        (function x == value))

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q245098, "Intermediate value theorem": a continuous map from a closed
  interval in a dense conditionally complete linear order attains every value
  between its endpoint values. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory;

val q245098_linear_order_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_linear_order_def",
  ``q245098_linear_order (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x)``);

val q245098_strict_order_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_strict_order_def",
  ``q245098_strict_order (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) x y <=>
      leq x y /\ x <> y``);

val q245098_dense_order_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_dense_order_def",
  ``q245098_dense_order (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      !x y.
        q245098_strict_order leq x y
        ==>
        ?z.
          q245098_strict_order leq x z /\
          q245098_strict_order leq z y``);

val q245098_conditionally_complete_linear_order_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_conditionally_complete_linear_order_def",
  ``q245098_conditionally_complete_linear_order
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      q245098_linear_order leq /\
      (!s : 'a set.
        ((?x. x IN s) /\
         (?bound. !x. x IN s ==> leq x bound))
        ==>
        ?sup.
          (!x. x IN s ==> leq x sup) /\
          !z. (!x. x IN s ==> leq x z) ==> leq sup z) /\
      (!s : 'a set.
        ((?x. x IN s) /\
         (?bound. !x. x IN s ==> leq bound x))
        ==>
        ?inf.
          (!x. x IN s ==> leq inf x) /\
          !z. (!x. x IN s ==> leq z x) ==> leq z inf)``);

val q245098_order_basic_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_order_basic_def",
  ``q245098_order_basic
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (lower : 'a set) (upper : 'a set) =
      {x |
        (!l. l IN lower ==> q245098_strict_order leq l x) /\
        (!u. u IN upper ==> q245098_strict_order leq x u)}``);

val q245098_order_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_order_topology_def",
  ``q245098_order_topology
      (top : 'a topology) (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      !U.
        open_in top U <=>
        !x.
          x IN U ==>
          ?lower upper.
            FINITE lower /\
            FINITE upper /\
            x IN q245098_order_basic leq lower upper /\
            q245098_order_basic leq lower upper SUBSET U``);

val q245098_order_closed_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_order_closed_topology_def",
  ``q245098_order_closed_topology
      (top : 'a topology) (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      !x y.
        ~leq x y
        ==>
        ?U V.
          open_in top U /\
          open_in top V /\
          x IN U /\
          y IN V /\
          !u v. u IN U /\ v IN V ==> ~leq u v``);

val q245098_continuous_on_def = new_definition (
  "q245098_continuous_on_def",
  ``q245098_continuous_on
      (topA : 'a topology) (topD : 'd topology)
      (f : 'a -> 'd) (s : 'a set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        !V.
          open_in topD V /\ f x IN V
          ==>
          ?U.
            open_in topA U /\
            x IN U /\
            !y. y IN s /\ y IN U ==> f y IN V``);

val intermediate_value_Icc =
  ``!(topA : 'a topology) (topD : 'd topology)
      (leA : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (leD : 'd -> 'd -> bool)
      (a : 'a) (b : 'a) (f : 'a -> 'd).
      q245098_conditionally_complete_linear_order leA /\
      q245098_dense_order leA /\
      q245098_order_topology topA leA /\
      q245098_linear_order leD /\
      q245098_order_closed_topology topD leD /\
      leA a b /\
      q245098_continuous_on topA topD f
        {x | leA a x /\ leA x b}
      ==>
      !y.
        leD (f a) y /\ leD y (f b)
        ==>
        ?x.
          leA a x /\ leA x b /\
          f x = y``;

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q245098
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q245098), "Intermediate value theorem": a
  continuous function from a closed interval in a conditionally complete
  densely ordered space with its order topology to a linearly ordered space
  with closed order relation attains every value between its endpoint values.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q245098LinearOrder states that R is a reflexive, antisymmetric, transitive,
  total relation on X. Q245098Dense gives an internal point between every
  strictly ordered pair. Q245098CondComplete states that every nonempty subset
  bounded above has a least upper bound and every nonempty subset bounded
  below has a greatest lower bound.

  Q245098OrderClosed states that K is a topology on Y and that S is closed in
  the product topology. The domain topology in the final assertion is the
  SetMM order topology generated by R. Continuity is imposed on the restriction
  of F to the relation-defined closed interval. All auxiliary $a declarations
  are syntax or faithful definitions; the final $a assertion is unproved.
$)

$c Q245098LinearOrder Q245098Dense Q245098CondComplete
   Q245098OrderClosed $.

q245098-linear-order-syntax
  $a wff ( Q245098LinearOrder R X ) $.
q245098-dense-syntax
  $a wff ( Q245098Dense R X ) $.
q245098-cond-complete-syntax
  $a wff ( Q245098CondComplete R X ) $.
q245098-order-closed-syntax
  $a wff ( Q245098OrderClosed S Y K ) $.

${
  $d R X x y z $.

  q245098-linear-order-definition $a |- (
    ( Q245098LinearOrder R X )
    <->
    (
      R C_ ( X X. X )
      /\
      A. x e. X A. y e. X A. z e. X
        (
          x R x
          /\
          (
            ( ( x R y /\ y R x ) -> x = y )
            /\
            (
              ( ( x R y /\ y R z ) -> x R z )
              /\
              ( x R y \/ y R x )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d R X x y z $.

  q245098-dense-definition $a |- (
    ( Q245098Dense R X )
    <->
    A. x e. X A. y e. X
      (
        ( x R y /\ x =/= y )
        ->
        E. z e. X
          (
            ( x R z /\ x =/= z )
            /\
            ( z R y /\ z =/= y )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d R T X l s u x $.

  q245098-cond-complete-definition $a |- (
    ( Q245098CondComplete R X )
    <->
    A. T e. ~P X
      (
        T =/= (/)
        ->
        (
          (
            E. u e. X A. x e. T x R u
            ->
            E. s e. X
              (
                A. x e. T x R s
                /\
                A. u e. X
                  ( A. x e. T x R u -> s R u )
              )
          )
          /\
          (
            E. l e. X A. x e. T l R x
            ->
            E. s e. X
              (
                A. x e. T s R x
                /\
                A. l e. X
                  ( A. x e. T l R x -> l R s )
              )
          )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K S Y $.

  q245098-order-closed-definition $a |- (
    ( Q245098OrderClosed S Y K )
    <->
    (
      K e. ( TopOn ` Y )
      /\
      ( ( Y X. Y ) \ S ) e. ( K tX K )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F K R S X Y a b c t x $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q245098-intermediate-value-theorem $a |-
    A. X A. Y A. R A. S A. K A. F
      A. a e. X A. b e. X
        (
          (
            (
              ( Q245098LinearOrder R X )
              /\
              (
                ( Q245098Dense R X )
                /\
                ( Q245098CondComplete R X )
              )
            )
            /\
            (
              ( Q245098LinearOrder S Y )
              /\
              ( Q245098OrderClosed S Y K )
            )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              (
                F : X --> Y
                /\
                a R b
              )
              /\
              (
                F |` { x e. X | ( a R x /\ x R b ) }
              )
              e.
              (
                (
                  ( ordTop ` R )
                  |`t
                  { x e. X | ( a R x /\ x R b ) }
                )
                Cn
                K
              )
            )
            ->
            A. t e. Y
              (
                ( ( F ` a ) S t /\ t S ( F ` b ) )
                ->
                E. c e. X
                  (
                    ( a R c /\ c R b )
                    /\
                    ( F ` c ) = t
                  )
              )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem

environ

  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,

  constructors SETFAM_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2;

theorem
  for A,D being non empty set,
      leA being Relation of A,A,
      leD being Relation of D,D,
      TA being Subset-Family of A,
      TD being Subset-Family of D,
      f being Function of A,D,
      a,b being Element of A st

    (for x,y being Element of A st
      [x,y] in leA & [y,x] in leA holds x = y) &

    (for G being Subset-Family of A st G c= TA holds union G in TA) &
    (for x being Element of A holds

    (for x being Element of A holds

    (for T being Subset-Family of A st

      (for U,V being Subset of A st U in T & V in T holds U /\ V in T) &

title: Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q245098,
% "Intermediate value theorem": a function continuous on a closed interval in
% a densely ordered conditionally complete linear order attains every value
% between its endpoint values in a linearly ordered space with closed order.
% This file contains no proof.

Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem[
  alpha: TYPE,
  delta: TYPE,
  le_alpha: [alpha, alpha -> bool],
  le_delta: [delta, delta -> bool],
  open_alpha: [[alpha -> bool] -> bool],
  open_delta: [[delta -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  alpha_set: TYPE = [alpha -> bool]
  delta_set: TYPE = [delta -> bool]
  alpha_set_family: TYPE = [alpha_set -> bool]
  delta_set_family: TYPE = [delta_set -> bool]
  alpha_delta_function: TYPE = [alpha -> delta]

  empty_alpha_set: alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): FALSE

  whole_alpha_set: alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): TRUE

  alpha_intersection(A, B: alpha_set): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): A(x) AND B(x)

  alpha_union(F: alpha_set_family): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha):
      EXISTS (U: alpha_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  alpha_subset(A, B: alpha_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  empty_delta_set: delta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: delta): FALSE

  whole_delta_set: delta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: delta): TRUE

  delta_intersection(A, B: delta_set): delta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: delta): A(x) AND B(x)

  delta_union(F: delta_set_family): delta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: delta):
      EXISTS (U: delta_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  delta_subset(A, B: delta_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: delta):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  lt_alpha(x, y: alpha): bool =
    le_alpha(x, y) AND NOT le_alpha(y, x)

  lt_delta(x, y: delta): bool =
    le_delta(x, y) AND NOT le_delta(y, x)

  alpha_linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: alpha):
      le_alpha(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: alpha):
      le_alpha(x, y) AND le_alpha(y, z)
        IMPLIES le_alpha(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: alpha):
      le_alpha(x, y) AND le_alpha(y, x)
        IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: alpha):
      le_alpha(x, y) OR le_alpha(y, x))

  delta_linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: delta):
      le_delta(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: delta):
      le_delta(x, y) AND le_delta(y, z)
        IMPLIES le_delta(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: delta):
      le_delta(x, y) AND le_delta(y, x)
        IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: delta):
      le_delta(x, y) OR le_delta(y, x))

  nonempty_alpha_set(S: alpha_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: alpha):
      S(x)

  upper_bound(S: alpha_set, u: alpha): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_alpha(x, u)

  lower_bound(S: alpha_set, l: alpha): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_alpha(l, x)

  bounded_above(S: alpha_set): bool =
    EXISTS (u: alpha):
      upper_bound(S, u)

  bounded_below(S: alpha_set): bool =
    EXISTS (l: alpha):
      lower_bound(S, l)

  least_upper_bound(S: alpha_set, s: alpha): bool =
    upper_bound(S, s)
      AND
    (FORALL (u: alpha):
      upper_bound(S, u) IMPLIES le_alpha(s, u))

  greatest_lower_bound(S: alpha_set, i: alpha): bool =
    lower_bound(S, i)
      AND
    (FORALL (l: alpha):
      lower_bound(S, l) IMPLIES le_alpha(l, i))

  conditionally_complete_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (S: alpha_set):
      nonempty_alpha_set(S) AND bounded_above(S)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (s: alpha):
            least_upper_bound(S, s))
      AND
    (FORALL (S: alpha_set):
      nonempty_alpha_set(S) AND bounded_below(S)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (i: alpha):
            greatest_lower_bound(S, i))

  densely_ordered_law: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: alpha):
      lt_alpha(x, y)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (z: alpha):
            lt_alpha(x, z) AND lt_alpha(z, y)

  alpha_topology_laws(
      candidate_open: [alpha_set -> bool]): bool =
    candidate_open(empty_alpha_set)
      AND candidate_open(whole_alpha_set)
      AND
    (FORALL (A, B: alpha_set):
      candidate_open(A) AND candidate_open(B)
        IMPLIES candidate_open(alpha_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
    (FORALL (F: alpha_set_family):
      (FORALL (U: alpha_set):
        F(U) IMPLIES candidate_open(U))
        IMPLIES candidate_open(alpha_union(F)))

  delta_topology_laws(
      candidate_open: [delta_set -> bool]): bool =
    candidate_open(empty_delta_set)
      AND candidate_open(whole_delta_set)
      AND
    (FORALL (A, B: delta_set):
      candidate_open(A) AND candidate_open(B)
        IMPLIES candidate_open(delta_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
    (FORALL (F: delta_set_family):
      (FORALL (U: delta_set):
        F(U) IMPLIES candidate_open(U))
        IMPLIES candidate_open(delta_union(F)))

  alpha_upper_ray(a: alpha): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha):
      lt_alpha(a, x)

  alpha_lower_ray(a: alpha): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha):
      lt_alpha(x, a)

  contains_order_subbasis(
      candidate_open: [alpha_set -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (a: alpha):
      candidate_open(alpha_upper_ray(a)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: alpha):
      candidate_open(alpha_lower_ray(a)))

  generated_order_open(U: alpha_set): bool =
    FORALL (candidate_open: [alpha_set -> bool]):
      alpha_topology_laws(candidate_open)
        AND contains_order_subbasis(candidate_open)
        IMPLIES candidate_open(U)

  alpha_order_topology_law: bool =
    alpha_topology_laws(open_alpha)
      AND
    (FORALL (U: alpha_set):
      open_alpha(U) IFF generated_order_open(U))

  delta_order_closed_topology_law: bool =
    delta_topology_laws(open_delta)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: delta):
      NOT le_delta(x, y)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U, V: delta_set):
            open_delta(U)
              AND U(x)
              AND open_delta(V)
              AND V(y)
              AND
            (FORALL (u, v: delta):
              U(u) AND V(v)
                IMPLIES NOT le_delta(u, v)))

  in_closed_interval(x, a, b: alpha): bool =
    le_alpha(a, x) AND le_alpha(x, b)

  continuous_on_closed_interval(
      f: alpha_delta_function,
      a, b: alpha): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha):
      in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (V: delta_set):
            open_delta(V) AND V(f(x))
              IMPLIES
                EXISTS (U: alpha_set):
                  open_alpha(U)
                    AND U(x)
                    AND
                  (FORALL (z: alpha):
                    in_closed_interval(z, a, b) AND U(z)
                      IMPLIES V(f(z)))

  structure_laws: bool =
    alpha_linear_order_laws
      AND conditionally_complete_laws
      AND densely_ordered_law
      AND alpha_order_topology_law
      AND delta_linear_order_laws
      AND delta_order_closed_topology_law

  intermediate_value_Icc: bool =
    structure_laws
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
            (f: alpha_delta_function),
            (a, b: alpha):
          (le_alpha(a, b)
            AND continuous_on_closed_interval(f, a, b))
            IMPLIES
              FORALL (y: delta):
                (le_delta(f(a), y) AND le_delta(y, f(b)))
                  IMPLIES
                    EXISTS (x: alpha):
                      in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
                        AND f(x) = y
END Q245098_intermediate_value_theorem

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q2471737
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2471737), "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)":
-- over a strictly ordered field, the convex hull of a set is the union of the convex
-- hulls of its finite affine-independent subsets. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Hull
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.AffineSpace.Independent

public section

open Set Finset

universe u

namespace Q2471737

variable {𝕜 : Type*} {E : Type u} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜]
  [AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E]

/-- Carathéodory's convexity theorem. -/
theorem convexHull_eq_union {s : Set E} : convexHull 𝕜 s =
    ⋃ (t : Finset E) (_ : ↑t ⊆ s) (_ : AffineIndependent 𝕜 ((↑) : t → E)), convexHull 𝕜 ↑t :=
  sorry

end Q2471737

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2471737
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2471737), "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)":
  over a linearly ordered field, the convex hull of a set is the union of the
  convex hulls of its finite affine-independent subsets. This file contains no

*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
