Record q2471737_linear_ordered_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q2471737_zero : K;
  q2471737_one : K;
  q2471737_add : K -> K -> K;
  q2471737_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q2471737_neg : K -> K;
  q2471737_inv : K -> K;
  q2471737_le : K -> K -> Prop;
  q2471737_zero_ne_one :
    q2471737_zero <> q2471737_one;
  q2471737_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2471737_add x (q2471737_add y z) =
      q2471737_add (q2471737_add x y) z;
  q2471737_add_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q2471737_add x y = q2471737_add y x;
  q2471737_add_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q2471737_add x q2471737_zero = x;
  q2471737_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q2471737_add x (q2471737_neg x) = q2471737_zero;
  q2471737_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2471737_mul x (q2471737_mul y z) =
      q2471737_mul (q2471737_mul x y) z;
  q2471737_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q2471737_mul x y = q2471737_mul y x;
  q2471737_mul_one :
    forall x : K,
      q2471737_mul x q2471737_one = x;
  q2471737_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2471737_mul x (q2471737_add y z) =
      q2471737_add
        (q2471737_mul x y) (q2471737_mul x z);
  q2471737_inv_zero :
    q2471737_inv q2471737_zero = q2471737_zero;
  q2471737_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q2471737_zero ->
      q2471737_mul x (q2471737_inv x) = q2471737_one;
  q2471737_le_refl :
    forall x : K,
      q2471737_le x x;
  q2471737_le_trans :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2471737_le x y ->
      q2471737_le y z ->
      q2471737_le x z;
  q2471737_le_antisym :
    forall x y : K,
      q2471737_le x y ->
      q2471737_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q2471737_le_total :
    forall x y : K,
      q2471737_le x y \/ q2471737_le y x;
  q2471737_add_le_add_left :
    forall x y z : K,
      q2471737_le x y ->
      q2471737_le
        (q2471737_add z x) (q2471737_add z y);
  q2471737_mul_nonnegative :
    forall x y : K,
      q2471737_le q2471737_zero x ->
      q2471737_le q2471737_zero y ->
      q2471737_le q2471737_zero (q2471737_mul x y)
}.

Arguments q2471737_zero {K} _.
Arguments q2471737_one {K} _.
Arguments q2471737_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q2471737_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q2471737_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q2471737_inv {K} _ _.
Arguments q2471737_le {K} _ _ _.

Record q2471737_module
    (K E : Type)
    (fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K) : Type := {
  q2471737_vzero : E;
  q2471737_vadd : E -> E -> E;
  q2471737_vneg : E -> E;
  q2471737_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q2471737_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q2471737_vadd x (q2471737_vadd y z) =
      q2471737_vadd (q2471737_vadd x y) z;
  q2471737_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : E,
      q2471737_vadd x y = q2471737_vadd y x;
  q2471737_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q2471737_vadd x q2471737_vzero = x;
  q2471737_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q2471737_vadd x (q2471737_vneg x) = q2471737_vzero;
  q2471737_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q2471737_smul (q2471737_one fld) x = x;
  q2471737_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q2471737_smul (q2471737_mul fld a b) x =
      q2471737_smul a (q2471737_smul b x);
  q2471737_add_smul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q2471737_smul (q2471737_add fld a b) x =
      q2471737_vadd
        (q2471737_smul a x) (q2471737_smul b x);
  q2471737_smul_add :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q2471737_smul a (q2471737_vadd x y) =
      q2471737_vadd
        (q2471737_smul a x) (q2471737_smul a y)
}.

Arguments q2471737_vzero {K E fld} _.
Arguments q2471737_vadd {K E fld} _ _ _.
Arguments q2471737_vneg {K E fld} _ _.
Arguments q2471737_smul {K E fld} _ _ _.

Definition q2471737_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q2471737_subset {A : Type}
    (S T : q2471737_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q2471737_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q2471737_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q2471737_finite_set {A : Type}
    (S : q2471737_set A) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list A,
    NoDup enumeration /\
    forall x : A, S x <-> In x enumeration.

Fixpoint q2471737_scalar_sum
    {K I : Type}
    (fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K)
    (indices : list I)
    (weights : I -> K) : K :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q2471737_zero fld
  | cons i rest =>
      q2471737_add fld
        (weights i) (q2471737_scalar_sum fld rest weights)
  end.

Fixpoint q2471737_weighted_sum
    {K E I : Type}
    {fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K}
    (V : @q2471737_module K E fld)
    (indices : list I)
    (weights : I -> K)
    (points : I -> E) : E :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q2471737_vzero V
  | cons i rest =>
      q2471737_vadd V
        (q2471737_smul V (weights i) (points i))
        (q2471737_weighted_sum V rest weights points)
  end.

Definition q2471737_affine_independent_set
    {K E : Type}
    (fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K)
    (V : @q2471737_module K E fld)
    (S : q2471737_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (weights : E -> K) (support : list E),
    NoDup support ->
    (forall x : E,
      weights x <> q2471737_zero fld ->
      S x /\ In x support) ->
    q2471737_scalar_sum fld support weights =
      q2471737_zero fld ->
    q2471737_weighted_sum V support weights (fun x => x) =
      q2471737_vzero V ->
    forall x : E, S x -> weights x = q2471737_zero fld.

Definition q2471737_convex
    {K E : Type}
    (fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K)
    (V : @q2471737_module K E fld)
    (S : q2471737_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : E) (a b : K),
    S x ->
    S y ->
    q2471737_le fld (q2471737_zero fld) a ->
    q2471737_le fld (q2471737_zero fld) b ->
    q2471737_add fld a b = q2471737_one fld ->
    S
      (q2471737_vadd V
        (q2471737_smul V a x)
        (q2471737_smul V b y)).

Definition q2471737_convex_hull
    {K E : Type}
    (fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K)
    (V : @q2471737_module K E fld)
    (S : q2471737_set E) : q2471737_set E :=
  fun x =>
    forall C : q2471737_set E,
      @q2471737_convex K E fld V C ->
      q2471737_subset S C ->
      C x.

Theorem convexHull_eq_union :
  forall (K E : Type)
         (fld : q2471737_linear_ordered_field K)
         (V : @q2471737_module K E fld)
         (S : q2471737_set E),
    q2471737_same_set
      (@q2471737_convex_hull K E fld V S)
      (fun x : E =>
        exists T : q2471737_set E,
          q2471737_finite_set T /\
          q2471737_subset T S /\
          @q2471737_affine_independent_set K E fld V T /\
          @q2471737_convex_hull K E fld V T x).
Admitted.

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2471737,
  "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)": over a linearly ordered field, the
  convex hull of a set is the union of the convex hulls of its finite
  affine-independent subsets. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
  imports Main
begin

definition q2471737_module ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2471737_module smult \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. smult a (x + y) = smult a x + smult a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a + b) x = smult a x + smult b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a * b) x = smult a (smult b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smult 1 x = x)"

definition q2471737_affine_independent ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2471737_affine_independent smult T \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>w :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<longrightarrow>
      {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> T \<longrightarrow>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. w y) = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. smult (w y) y) = 0 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>y. w y = 0))"

definition q2471737_convex_hull ::
    "('k::linordered_field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      'e set \<Rightarrow> 'e set" where
  "q2471737_convex_hull smult S =
    {x. \<exists>w :: 'e \<Rightarrow> 'k.
      finite {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<and>
      {y. w y \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> S \<and>
      (\<forall>y. 0 \<le> w y) \<and>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. w y) = 1 \<and>
      (\<Sum>y\<in>{y. w y \<noteq> 0}. smult (w y) y) = x}"

theorem convexHull_eq_union:
  fixes smult :: "'k::linordered_field \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and S :: "'e set"
  assumes module: "q2471737_module smult"
  shows "q2471737_convex_hull smult S =
    {x. \<exists>T :: 'e set.
      finite T \<and>
      T \<subseteq> S \<and>
      q2471737_affine_independent smult T \<and>
      x \<in> q2471737_convex_hull smult T}"
  sorry

end

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2471737,
  "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)": over a linearly ordered field, the
  convex hull of a set in a module is the union of the convex hulls of its
  finite affinely independent subsets. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2471737_CARATHEODORY_CONVEX_HULL =
 `let linear_ordered_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (le:A->A->bool).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       (!a:A. le a a) /\
       (!a b:A. le a b /\ le b a ==> a = b) /\
       (!a b c:A. le a b /\ le b c ==> le a c) /\
       (!a b:A. le a b \/ le b a) /\
       (!a b c:A. le a b ==> le (addK a c) (addK b c)) /\
       (!a b:A.
          le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b ==> le zeroK (mulK a b)) in
  let module_over =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x y z:B. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:B. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:B. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let affine_independent =
    \(zeroK:A) (addK:A->A->A)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (t:B->bool).
       !w:B->A.
         iterate addK t w = zeroK /\
         iterate addE t (\x:B. smul (w x) x) = zeroE
         ==> !x:B. x IN t ==> w x = zeroK in
  let convex_set =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (le:A->A->bool)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (s:B->bool).
       !x y:B. !a b:A.
         x IN s /\ y IN s /\
         le zeroK a /\ le zeroK b /\ addK a b = oneK
         ==> addE (smul a x) (smul b y) IN s in
  let convex_hull =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A) (addK:A->A->A) (le:A->A->bool)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (u:B->bool).
       {x:B |
          !s:B->bool.
            u SUBSET s /\
            convex_set zeroK oneK addK le addE smul s
            ==> x IN s} in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !le:A->A->bool.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smul:A->B->B.
  !s:B->bool.
    linear_ordered_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK le /\
    module_over zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroE addE negE smul
    ==>
    convex_hull zeroK oneK addK le addE smul s =
    {x:B |
       ?t:B->bool.
         FINITE t /\
         t SUBSET s /\
         affine_independent zeroK addK zeroE addE smul t /\
         x IN convex_hull zeroK oneK addK le addE smul t}`;;

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2471737,
;; "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)": the convex hull of a set is the
;; union of the convex hulls of its finite affine-independent subsets. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Relative to an arbitrary basis, every vector over a field is uniquely a
;; finite-support coordinate map. Conversely, finite-support maps over any
;; basis-label carrier form a vector space. Linear equivalences preserve and
;; reflect convex hulls and affine independence, so this presentation is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source theorem without imposing finite
;; dimension. A vector is a duplicate-free true list of (label coefficient)
;; pairs, with nonzero coefficients.
;;
;; Convex combinations carry exact finite accumulator certificates. Affine
;; independence carries a finite coordinate minor and a left inverse for that
;; minor. Such a minor exists exactly when the finite family of differences
;; from its first point is linearly independent. Every function object passed
;; to FN-EQUAL contains only ACL2 primitives, fixed LOOP$ scions, and direct
;; APPLY$ calls on quoted tame functions.

(defun q2471737-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q2471737-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q2471737-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q2471737-quoted nil)))

(defun q2471737-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (q2471737-quoted function)
        (q2471737-term-list arguments)))

(defun q2471737-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q2471737-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q2471737-quoted nil))
    (q2471737-quoted t)))

(defun q2471737-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q2471737-quoted t)
            (q2471737-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q2471737-quoted nil)))

(defun q2471737-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q2471737-quoted nil)
        (q2471737-quoted t)))

(defun q2471737-boolean-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q2471737-quoted t)
        (q2471737-quoted nil)))

(defun q2471737-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if
        hypothesis
        (q2471737-boolean-term conclusion)
        (q2471737-quoted t)))

(defun q2471737-iff-term (left right)
  (q2471737-and-terms
   (list
    (q2471737-implies-term left right)
    (q2471737-implies-term right left))))

(defun q2471737-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q2471737-quoted t)))

(defun q2471737-false-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q2471737-quoted nil)))

(defun q2471737-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q2471737-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q2471737-exists-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-false (q2471737-false-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-false)
     (not (fn-equal function always-false)))))

(defun q2471737-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q2471737-range-term (count)
  (list 'from-to-by
        (q2471737-quoted 0)
        (list 'binary-+ count (q2471737-quoted -1))
        (q2471737-quoted 1)))

(defun q2471737-index-tuple-function ()
  (list
   'lambda '(index)
   (list 'cons 'index (q2471737-quoted nil))))

(defun q2471737-index-tuples-term (count)
  (list 'collect$
        (q2471737-quoted
         (q2471737-index-tuple-function))
        (q2471737-range-term count)))

(defun q2471737-nth-term (index values)
  (list 'nth index values))

;; Exact first-order laws of a nontrivial linearly ordered field.

(defun q2471737-field-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (let* ((xy-add
          (q2471737-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (yz-add
          (q2471737-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (xy-mul
          (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (yz-mul
          (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x
          (q2471737-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x
          (q2471737-static-apply-term inverse '(x))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q2471737-implies-term
      (q2471737-and-terms
       (list
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))
      (q2471737-and-terms
       (list
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-add))
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier (list xy-mul))
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (q2471737-static-apply-term carrier (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q2471737-static-apply-term add (list xy-add 'z))
              (q2471737-static-apply-term add (list 'x yz-add)))
        (list 'equal xy-add
              (q2471737-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q2471737-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q2471737-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q2471737-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q2471737-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply (list xy-mul 'z))
              (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-mul)))
        (list 'equal xy-mul
              (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q2471737-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q2471737-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x yz-add))
              (q2471737-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q2471737-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))
        (q2471737-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q2471737-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q2471737-quoted zero)))
        (q2471737-implies-term
         (q2471737-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q2471737-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q2471737-static-apply-term
                multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q2471737-quoted one)))
        (q2471737-not-term
         (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(x x)))
        (q2471737-implies-term
         (q2471737-and-terms
          (list
           (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(x y))
           (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(y z))))
         (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(x z)))
        (q2471737-or-terms
         (list
          (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(x y))
          (list 'equal 'x 'y)
          (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(y x))))
        (q2471737-implies-term
         (q2471737-static-apply-term less '(x y))
         (q2471737-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q2471737-static-apply-term add '(x z))
           (q2471737-static-apply-term add '(y z)))))
        (q2471737-implies-term
         (q2471737-and-terms
          (list
           (q2471737-static-apply-term
            less (list (q2471737-quoted zero) 'x))
           (q2471737-static-apply-term
            less (list (q2471737-quoted zero) 'y))))
         (q2471737-static-apply-term
          less
          (list
           (q2471737-quoted zero)
           xy-mul)))))))))

(defun q2471737-linearly-ordered-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (let ((laws
         (q2471737-field-laws-function

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2471737,
-- "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)": over a linearly ordered field, the
-- convex hull of a set in a vector space is the union of the convex hulls of
-- its finite affine-independent subsets. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record LogicalEquivalence
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor logically-equivalent
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record LinearOrderedField
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set (lsuc k) where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK inverseK : K -> K
    lessOrEqualK : K -> K -> Set k

    one-not-zero :
      oneK != zeroK

    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x zeroK == zeroK
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    inverse-zero :
      inverseK zeroK == zeroK
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (inverseK x) == oneK

    order-reflexive :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK y z ->
      lessOrEqualK x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : K) ->
      (lessOrEqualK x y) or (lessOrEqualK y x)
    add-order :
      (x y z : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK x y ->
      lessOrEqualK (addK z x) (addK z y)
    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK x ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK y ->
      lessOrEqualK zeroK (multiplyK x y)
    zero-less-than-one :
      (lessOrEqualK zeroK oneK) and (zeroK != oneK)

open LinearOrderedField

record VectorSpace
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K)
  (E : Set e) :
  Set (lsuc (k ⊔ e)) where

  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : K -> E -> E

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-one :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneK orderedField) x == x
    scale-associative :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK orderedField a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectors :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalars :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK orderedField a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)
    scale-zero-vector :
      (a : K) ->
      scaleE a zeroE == zeroE
    scale-zero-scalar :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (zeroK orderedField) x == zeroE

open VectorSpace

sumScalars :
  {k : Level}
  {K : Set k} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  K
sumScalars orderedField {zero} coefficients =
  zeroK orderedField
sumScalars orderedField {suc n} coefficients =
  addK orderedField
    (coefficients fzero)
    (sumScalars orderedField (\ i -> coefficients (fsuc i)))

sumScaled :
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e}
  {orderedField : LinearOrderedField K} ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  (Fin n -> E) ->
  E
sumScaled space {zero} coefficients points =
  zeroE space
sumScaled space {suc n} coefficients points =
  addE space
    (scaleE space (coefficients fzero) (points fzero))
    (sumScaled space
      (\ i -> coefficients (fsuc i))
      (\ i -> points (fsuc i)))

Injective :
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective f =
  (x y : _) ->
  f x == f y ->
  x == y

AffineIndependent :
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> E) ->
  Set (k ⊔ e)
AffineIndependent {K = K} orderedField space {n} points =
  (coefficients : Fin n -> K) ->
  sumScalars orderedField coefficients == zeroK orderedField ->
  sumScaled space coefficients points == zeroE space ->
  (i : Fin n) ->
  coefficients i == zeroK orderedField

ConvexCombination :
  {k e : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set (k ⊔ e)
ConvexCombination {K = K} orderedField space {n} points x =
  Exists (Fin n -> K)
    (\ coefficients ->
      ((i : Fin n) ->
        lessOrEqualK orderedField
          (zeroK orderedField)
          (coefficients i))
      and
      ((sumScalars orderedField coefficients == oneK orderedField)
      and
      (sumScaled space coefficients points == x)))

ConvexHull :
  {k e p : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  (E -> Set p) ->
  E ->
  Set (k ⊔ e ⊔ p)
ConvexHull {E = E} orderedField space subset x =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Exists (Fin n -> E)
        (\ points ->
          ((i : Fin n) -> subset (points i))
          and
          ConvexCombination orderedField space points x))

FiniteIndependentHull :
  {k e p : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  (E -> Set p) ->
  E ->
  Set (k ⊔ e ⊔ p)
FiniteIndependentHull {E = E} orderedField space subset x =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      Exists (Fin n -> E)
        (\ points ->
          Injective points
          and
          (((i : Fin n) -> subset (points i))
          and
          (AffineIndependent orderedField space points
          and
          ConvexCombination orderedField space points x))))

SameSubset :
  {e p q : Level}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (E -> Set p) ->
  (E -> Set q) ->
  Set (e ⊔ p ⊔ q)
SameSubset {E = E} lhs rhs =
  (x : E) ->
  LogicalEquivalence (lhs x) (rhs x)

caratheodory-convex-hull : Setω
caratheodory-convex-hull =
  {k e p : Level} ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (orderedField : LinearOrderedField K) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (space : VectorSpace orderedField E) ->
  (subset : E -> Set p) ->
  SameSubset
    (ConvexHull orderedField space subset)
    (FiniteIndependentHull orderedField space subset)

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2471737 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q2471737), "Carathéodory's theorem
  (convex hull)": the convex hull of a set in a module over a linear ordered
  field is the union of the convex hulls of its finite affine-independent
  subsets. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val convexHull_eq_union =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (one : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (recip : 'r -> 'r)
      (leq : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (vzero : 'e) (vadd : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (vneg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : 'r -> 'e -> 'e) (s : 'e set).
      let q2471737_field_axioms = (
        ~(one = zero) /\
        (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
        (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
        (!x. mul x one = x) /\
        (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
        (!x. ~(x = zero) ==> mul x (recip x) = one) /\
        (!x. leq x x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
        (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x) /\
        (!x y z. leq x y ==> leq (add z x) (add z y)) /\
        (!x y. leq zero x /\ leq zero y ==> leq zero (mul x y)))
      in
      let q2471737_module_axioms = (
        (!x y. vadd x y = vadd y x) /\
        (!x y z. vadd (vadd x y) z = vadd x (vadd y z)) /\
        (!x. vadd x vzero = x) /\
        (!x. vadd x (vneg x) = vzero) /\
        (!x. smul one x = x) /\
        (!a b x. smul (mul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
        (!a b x. smul (add a b) x = vadd (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
        (!a x y. smul a (vadd x y) = vadd (smul a x) (smul a y)))
      in
      let q2471737_scalar_sum = (
        \(w : 'e -> 'r) (t : 'e set).
          ITSET (\x acc. add (w x) acc) t zero)
      in
      let q2471737_vector_sum = (
        \(w : 'e -> 'r) (t : 'e set).
          ITSET (\x acc. vadd (smul (w x) x) acc) t vzero)
      in
      let q2471737_affine_independent = (
        \(t : 'e set).
          FINITE t /\
          !w : 'e -> 'r.
            q2471737_scalar_sum w t = zero /\
            q2471737_vector_sum w t = vzero
            ==>
            !x. x IN t ==> w x = zero)
      in
      let q2471737_convex_hull = (
        \(s : 'e set).
          {p : 'e |
            ?t : 'e set. ?w : 'e -> 'r.
              FINITE t /\
              t SUBSET s /\
              (!x. x IN t ==> leq zero (w x)) /\
              q2471737_scalar_sum w t = one /\
              q2471737_vector_sum w t = p})
      in
        q2471737_field_axioms /\
        q2471737_module_axioms
        ==>
        q2471737_convex_hull s =
        {p : 'e |
          ?t : 'e set.
            t SUBSET s /\
            q2471737_affine_independent t /\
            p IN q2471737_convex_hull t}``;

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2471737
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2471737), "Carathéodory's theorem (convex
  hull)": over an ordered field, the convex hull of an arbitrary subset of a
  module is the union of the convex hulls of its finite affine-independent
  subsets. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q2471737AffineIndependent K V T says that the finite subset T of the module
  V is affine-independent over K: any scalar coefficients on T whose sum and
  weighted vector sum both vanish are all zero.

  Q2471737ConvexHull K V S is the set of all finite convex combinations of
  points of the arbitrary subset S. The finite carrier W, coefficient
  function c, and point function p remain internally existentially quantified.

  The final declaration writes the indexed union extensionally: a point lies
  on the right exactly when it lies in the convex hull of some finite
  affine-independent subset T of S. It is the single unproved corpus $a
  statement. All preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful
  definitions, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q2471737AffineIndependent Q2471737ConvexHull $.

q2471737-affine-independent-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2471737AffineIndependent K V T ) $.
q2471737-convex-hull-syntax
  $a class ( Q2471737ConvexHull K V S ) $.

${
  $d K T V c i $.

  q2471737-affine-independent-definition $a |-
    (
      ( Q2471737AffineIndependent K V T )
      <->
      A. c e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m T )
        (
          (
            (
              K gsum
                ( i e. T |-> ( c ` i ) )
            )
            =
            ( 0g ` K )
            /\
            (
              V gsum
                (
                  i e. T |->
                    (
                      ( c ` i )
                      ( .s ` V )
                      i
                    )
                )
            )
            =
            ( 0g ` V )
          )
          ->
          A. i e. T
            ( c ` i ) = ( 0g ` K )
        )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d K S V W c i p x $.

  q2471737-convex-hull-definition $a |-
    ( Q2471737ConvexHull K V S )
    =
    {
      x e. ( Base ` V ) |
        E. W e. Fin
          E. c e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m W )
            E. p e. ( S ^m W )
              (
                A. i e. W
                  ( 0g ` K ) ( le ` K ) ( c ` i )
                /\
                (
                  (
                    K gsum
                      ( i e. W |-> ( c ` i ) )
                  )
                  =
                  ( 1r ` K )
                  /\
                  x
                  =
                  (
                    V gsum
                      (
                        i e. W |->
                          (
                            ( c ` i )
                            ( .s ` V )
                            ( p ` i )
                          )
                      )
                  )
                )
              )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d K S T V x $.

  thousand-theorems-q2471737-caratheodory-convex-hull $a |-
    A. K e. oField
      A. V e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = K }
        A. S e. ~P ( Base ` V )
          ( Q2471737ConvexHull K V S )
          =
          {
            x e. ( Base ` V ) |
              E. T e. ( ~P S i^i Fin )
                (
                  ( Q2471737AffineIndependent K V T )
                  /\
                  x e. ( Q2471737ConvexHull K V T )
                )
          }
  $.
$}

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2471737,
:: "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)": over an ordered field, every point
:: in the convex hull of an arbitrary subset of a vector space lies in the
:: convex hull of a finite affinely independent subset. This file contains no
:: proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, PARTFUN1, CARD_3, STRUCT_0,

      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, NUMBERS, NAT_1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2,
      REALALG1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, RLVECT_1,
      GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, ALGSTR_1, REALALG1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_4, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1,
      GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, ALGSTR_1, REALALG1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, REALALG1;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field, P being Subset of K,
      V being VectSp of K, S being Subset of V st
    P is positive_cone
  holds
    for x being Element of V holds
      (ex a being FinSequence of the carrier of V,
          w being FinSequence of the carrier of K,
          t being FinSequence of the carrier of V st
        len a = len w & len w = len t &
        rng a c= S &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom w holds w/.k in P) &
        Sum w = 1_K &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom t holds
          t/.k = (w/.k) * (a/.k)) &
        Sum t = x)
      iff
      (ex a being FinSequence of the carrier of V,
          w being FinSequence of the carrier of K,
          t being FinSequence of the carrier of V st
        a is one-to-one &
        len a = len w & len w = len t &
        rng a c= S &
        (for c being FinSequence of the carrier of K,
            u being FinSequence of the carrier of V st
          len c = len a & len a = len u &
          Sum c = 0.K &
          (for k being Nat st k in dom u holds
            u/.k = (c/.k) * (a/.k)) &
          Sum u = 0.V
        holds
          for k being Nat st k in dom c holds c/.k = 0.K) &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom w holds w/.k in P) &
        Sum w = 1_K &
        (for k being Nat st k in dom t holds
          t/.k = (w/.k) * (a/.k)) &
        Sum t = x)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q2471737,
% "Carathéodory's theorem (convex hull)": over any linearly ordered field and
% module, a set's convex hull is the union of the convex hulls of its finite
% affine-independent subsets. This file contains no proof.

Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroK, oneK: K,
  negK, invK: [K -> K],
  addK, mulK: [K, K -> K],
  leK: [K, K -> bool],
  zeroE: E,
  negE: [E -> E],
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  smul: [K, E -> E]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  scalar_family: TYPE = [E -> K]
  vector_family: TYPE = [E -> E]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[E]

  additive_group_laws_K: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      addK(x, y) = addK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      addK(addK(x, y), z) = addK(x, addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      addK(x, zeroK) = x
        AND addK(x, negK(x)) = zeroK)

  field_multiplication_laws: bool =
    zeroK /= oneK
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      mulK(x, y) = mulK(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(mulK(x, y), z) = mulK(x, mulK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mulK(x, oneK) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mulK(x, addK(y, z)) =
        addK(mulK(x, y), mulK(x, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      x /= zeroK IMPLIES mulK(x, invK(x)) = oneK)

  linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: K):
      leK(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      leK(x, y) AND leK(y, z) IMPLIES leK(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(x, y) AND leK(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(x, y) OR leK(y, x))

  strictly_ordered_ring_laws: bool =
    leK(zeroK, oneK)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      leK(x, y) IMPLIES
        leK(addK(x, z), addK(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      leK(zeroK, x) AND leK(zeroK, y)
        IMPLIES leK(zeroK, mulK(x, y)))

  linearly_ordered_field_laws: bool =
    additive_group_laws_K
      AND field_multiplication_laws
      AND linear_order_laws
      AND strictly_ordered_ring_laws

  additive_commutative_group_laws_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      addE(x, zeroE) = x
        AND addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  module_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_laws_E
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
      smul(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
      smul(addK(a, b), x) =
        addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
      smul(mulK(a, b), x) =
        smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      smul(oneK, x) = x)

  scalar_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[E],
      values: scalar_family,
      total: K): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> K]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zeroK
          AND
        (FORALL (n: below(card(support))):
          partial_sums(n + 1) =
            addK(
              partial_sums(n),
              values(enumeration(n))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  vector_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[E],
      values: vector_family,
      total: E): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> E]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = zeroE
          AND
        (FORALL (n: below(card(support))):
          partial_sums(n + 1) =
            addE(
              partial_sums(n),
              values(enumeration(n))))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  affine_independent(support: finite_set[E]): bool =
    FORALL (weight: scalar_family):
      (scalar_sum_value(support, weight, zeroK)
        AND
      vector_sum_value(
        support,
        (LAMBDA (x: E): smul(weight(x), x)),
        zeroE))
      IMPLIES
        (FORALL (x: E):
          member(x, support) IMPLIES weight(x) = zeroK)

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  finite_point_subset(
      support: finite_set[E],
      A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      member(x, support) IMPLIES A(x)

  finite_set_as_point_set(
      support: finite_set[E]): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      member(x, support)

  convex(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (a, b: K):
      A(x)
        AND A(y)
        AND leK(zeroK, a)
        AND leK(zeroK, b)
        AND addK(a, b) = oneK
      IMPLIES
        A(addE(smul(a, x), smul(b, y)))

  convex_hull(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      FORALL (C: point_set):
        convex(C) AND point_subset(A, C) IMPLIES C(x)

  convexHull_eq_union: bool =
    (linearly_ordered_field_laws AND module_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: point_set), (x: E):
        convex_hull(S)(x)
          IFF
        EXISTS (support: finite_set[E]):
          finite_point_subset(support, S)
            AND affine_independent(support)
            AND convex_hull(
              finite_set_as_point_set(support))(x)
END Q2471737_carath_odory_s_theorem_convex_hull

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2525646
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2525646), "Jordan-Hölder theorem": two finite
  composition series in a Jordan-Hölder lattice with the same least and
  greatest elements have equivalent successive factors. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q2525646_lattice (X : Type) : Type := {
  q2525646_le : X -> X -> Prop;
  q2525646_sup : X -> X -> X;
  q2525646_inf : X -> X -> X;
  q2525646_le_refl :
    forall x : X, q2525646_le x x;
  q2525646_le_trans :
    forall x y z : X,
      q2525646_le x y ->
      q2525646_le y z ->
      q2525646_le x z;
  q2525646_le_antisym :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_le x y ->
      q2525646_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q2525646_le_sup_left :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_le x (q2525646_sup x y);
  q2525646_le_sup_right :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_le y (q2525646_sup x y);
  q2525646_sup_least :
    forall x y z : X,
      q2525646_le x z ->
      q2525646_le y z ->
      q2525646_le (q2525646_sup x y) z;
  q2525646_inf_le_left :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_le (q2525646_inf x y) x;
  q2525646_inf_le_right :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_le (q2525646_inf x y) y;
  q2525646_inf_greatest :
    forall x y z : X,
      q2525646_le z x ->
      q2525646_le z y ->
      q2525646_le z (q2525646_inf x y)
}.

Arguments q2525646_le {X} _ _ _.
Arguments q2525646_sup {X} _ _ _.
Arguments q2525646_inf {X} _ _ _.

Definition q2525646_lt
    {X : Type}
    (L : q2525646_lattice X)
    (x y : X) : Prop :=
  q2525646_le L x y /\ ~ q2525646_le L y x.

Record q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice
    (X : Type)
    (L : q2525646_lattice X) : Type := {
  q2525646_is_maximal : X -> X -> Prop;
  q2525646_lt_of_is_maximal :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_is_maximal x y ->
      q2525646_lt L x y;
  q2525646_sup_eq_of_is_maximal :
    forall x y z : X,
      q2525646_is_maximal x z ->
      q2525646_is_maximal y z ->
      x <> y ->
      q2525646_sup L x y = z;
  q2525646_is_maximal_inf_left_of_is_maximal_sup :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_is_maximal x (q2525646_sup L x y) ->
      q2525646_is_maximal y (q2525646_sup L x y) ->
      q2525646_is_maximal (q2525646_inf L x y) x;
  q2525646_iso : (X * X)%type -> (X * X)%type -> Prop;
  q2525646_iso_symm :
    forall p q : (X * X)%type,
      q2525646_iso p q ->
      q2525646_iso q p;
  q2525646_iso_trans :
    forall p q r : (X * X)%type,
      q2525646_iso p q ->
      q2525646_iso q r ->
      q2525646_iso p r;
  q2525646_second_iso :
    forall x y : X,
      q2525646_is_maximal x (q2525646_sup L x y) ->
      q2525646_iso
        (x, q2525646_sup L x y)
        (q2525646_inf L x y, y)
}.

Arguments q2525646_is_maximal {X L} _ _ _.
Arguments q2525646_iso {X L} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q2525646_fin_cast_succ
    {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : Fin.t (S n) :=
  match i in Fin.t k return Fin.t (S k) with
  | @Fin.F1 k => @Fin.F1 (S k)
  | @Fin.FS k j => @Fin.FS (S k) (q2525646_fin_cast_succ j)
  end.

Fixpoint q2525646_fin_last (n : nat) : Fin.t (S n) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => Fin.F1
  | S k => Fin.FS (q2525646_fin_last k)
  end.

Record q2525646_composition_series
    (X : Type)
    (L : q2525646_lattice X)
    (J : @q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice X L) : Type := {
  q2525646_series_length : nat;
  q2525646_series_term :
    Fin.t (S q2525646_series_length) -> X;
  q2525646_series_step :
    forall i : Fin.t q2525646_series_length,
      q2525646_is_maximal J
        (q2525646_series_term (q2525646_fin_cast_succ i))
        (q2525646_series_term (Fin.FS i))
}.

Arguments q2525646_series_length {X L J} _.
Arguments q2525646_series_term {X L J} _ _.

Definition q2525646_series_head
    {X : Type}
    {L : q2525646_lattice X}
    {J : @q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice X L}
    (s : @q2525646_composition_series X L J) : X :=
  q2525646_series_term s Fin.F1.

Definition q2525646_series_last
    {X : Type}
    {L : q2525646_lattice X}
    {J : @q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice X L}
    (s : @q2525646_composition_series X L J) : X :=
  q2525646_series_term s
    (q2525646_fin_last (q2525646_series_length s)).

Record q2525646_bijection (A B : Type) : Type := {
  q2525646_bijection_forward : A -> B;
  q2525646_bijection_backward : B -> A;
  q2525646_bijection_left_inverse :
    forall x : A,
      q2525646_bijection_backward
        (q2525646_bijection_forward x) = x;
  q2525646_bijection_right_inverse :
    forall y : B,
      q2525646_bijection_forward
        (q2525646_bijection_backward y) = y
}.

Arguments q2525646_bijection_forward {A B} _ _.

Definition q2525646_series_equivalent
    {X : Type}
    {L : q2525646_lattice X}
    {J : @q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice X L}
    (s1 s2 : @q2525646_composition_series X L J) : Prop :=
  exists f :
      q2525646_bijection
        (Fin.t (q2525646_series_length s1))
        (Fin.t (q2525646_series_length s2)),
    forall i : Fin.t (q2525646_series_length s1),
      q2525646_iso J
        (q2525646_series_term s1 (q2525646_fin_cast_succ i),
         q2525646_series_term s1 (Fin.FS i))
        (q2525646_series_term s2
           (q2525646_fin_cast_succ
             (q2525646_bijection_forward f i)),
         q2525646_series_term s2
           (Fin.FS (q2525646_bijection_forward f i))).

Theorem CompositionSeries_jordan_holder :
  forall (X : Type)
         (L : q2525646_lattice X)
         (J : @q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice X L)
         (s1 s2 : @q2525646_composition_series X L J),
    q2525646_series_head s1 = q2525646_series_head s2 ->
    q2525646_series_last s1 = q2525646_series_last s2 ->
    q2525646_series_equivalent s1 s2.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2525646,
  "Jordan–Hölder theorem": composition series with the same least and greatest
  terms are equivalent up to a bijection preserving the factor relation.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym 'a q2525646_series = "nat \<times> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a)"

definition q2525646_length :: "'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q2525646_length s = fst s"

definition q2525646_term :: "'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q2525646_term s = snd s"

definition q2525646_head :: "'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q2525646_head s = q2525646_term s 0"

definition q2525646_last :: "'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q2525646_last s = q2525646_term s (q2525646_length s)"

definition q2525646_composition_series ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2525646_composition_series IsMaximal s \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i < q2525646_length s.
      IsMaximal (q2525646_term s i) (q2525646_term s (Suc i)))"

definition q2525646_equivalent ::
    "(('a \<times> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<times> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> 'a q2525646_series \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2525646_equivalent Iso s1 s2 \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>f :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat.
      bij_betw f {..<q2525646_length s1} {..<q2525646_length s2} \<and>
      (\<forall>i < q2525646_length s1.
        Iso (q2525646_term s1 i, q2525646_term s1 (Suc i))
          (q2525646_term s2 (f i), q2525646_term s2 (Suc (f i)))))"

locale q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice =
  fixes IsMaximal :: "'a::lattice \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
    and Iso :: "('a \<times> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<times> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes lt_of_isMaximal:
      "IsMaximal x y \<Longrightarrow> x < y"
    and sup_eq_of_isMaximal:
      "\<lbrakk>IsMaximal x z; IsMaximal y z; x \<noteq> y\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> sup x y = z"
    and isMaximal_inf_left_of_isMaximal_sup:
      "\<lbrakk>IsMaximal x (sup x y); IsMaximal y (sup x y)\<rbrakk>
        \<Longrightarrow> IsMaximal (inf x y) x"
    and iso_symm:
      "Iso p q \<Longrightarrow> Iso q p"
    and iso_trans:
      "\<lbrakk>Iso p q; Iso q r\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> Iso p r"
    and second_iso:
      "IsMaximal x (sup x y)
        \<Longrightarrow> Iso (x, sup x y) (inf x y, y)"
begin

theorem q2525646_jordan_holder:
  assumes series1: "q2525646_composition_series IsMaximal s1"
    and series2: "q2525646_composition_series IsMaximal s2"
    and same_head: "q2525646_head s1 = q2525646_head s2"
    and same_last: "q2525646_last s1 = q2525646_last s2"
  shows "q2525646_equivalent Iso s1 s2"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2525646,
  "Jordan–Hölder theorem": two finite composition series with the same least
  and greatest elements in a Jordan-Hölder lattice have equivalent adjacent
  factors up to a bijection. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2525646_JORDAN_HOLDER_THEOREM =
  `let is_lattice =
     \(le_rel:A->A->bool) (inf_op:A->A->A) (sup_op:A->A->A).
       (!x. le_rel x x) /\
       (!x y z. le_rel x y /\ le_rel y z ==> le_rel x z) /\
       (!x y. le_rel x y /\ le_rel y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y.
          le_rel (inf_op x y) x /\
          le_rel (inf_op x y) y /\
          (!z. le_rel z x /\ le_rel z y ==> le_rel z (inf_op x y))) /\
       (!x y.
          le_rel x (sup_op x y) /\
          le_rel y (sup_op x y) /\
          (!z. le_rel x z /\ le_rel y z ==> le_rel (sup_op x y) z)) in
   let jordan_holder_lattice =
     \(le_rel:A->A->bool) (inf_op:A->A->A) (sup_op:A->A->A)
      (is_maximal:A->A->bool) (iso:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool).
       is_lattice le_rel inf_op sup_op /\
       (!x y.
          is_maximal x y ==> le_rel x y /\ ~(x = y)) /\
       (!x y z.
          is_maximal x z /\ is_maximal y z /\ ~(x = y)
          ==> sup_op x y = z) /\
       (!x y.
          is_maximal x (sup_op x y) /\
          is_maximal y (sup_op x y)
          ==> is_maximal (inf_op x y) x) /\
       (!p q. iso p q ==> iso q p) /\
       (!p q r. iso p q /\ iso q r ==> iso p r) /\
       (!x y.
          is_maximal x (sup_op x y)
          ==> iso (x,sup_op x y) (inf_op x y,y)) in
   let composition_series =
     \(is_maximal:A->A->bool) (n:num) (s:num->A).
       !i. i < n ==> is_maximal (s i) (s (SUC i)) in
   let equivalent_series =
     \(iso:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool)
      (n:num) (s:num->A) (m:num) (t:num->A).
       ?f:num->num.
         (!i. i < n ==> f i < m) /\
         (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ f i = f j ==> i = j) /\
         (!j. j < m ==> ?i. i < n /\ f i = j) /\
         (!i.
            i < n
            ==> iso (s i,s (SUC i))
                    (t (f i),t (SUC (f i)))) in
   !(le_rel:A->A->bool) (inf_op:A->A->A) (sup_op:A->A->A)
    (is_maximal:A->A->bool) (iso:(A#A)->(A#A)->bool)
    (n:num) (s:num->A) (m:num) (t:num->A).
      jordan_holder_lattice
        le_rel inf_op sup_op is_maximal iso /\
      composition_series is_maximal n s /\
      composition_series is_maximal m t /\
      s 0 = t 0 /\
      s n = t m
      ==> equivalent_series iso n s m t`;;

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2525646,
;; "Jordan–Hölder theorem": in any Jordan-Holder lattice, two finite nonempty
;; composition series with the same head and last element have their successive
;; factors matched bijectively by the lattice's pair-isomorphism relation. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The carrier, meet, join, maximality relation, and pair-isomorphism relation
;; are arbitrary tame APPLY$ function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies unbounded
;; universal quantification over the ACL2 universe. Equational lattice laws are
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source Lattice structure, with x <= y
;; represented by meet(x,y)=x. A composition series is intrinsically finite, so
;; a nonempty list is exactly its finite-indexed family of lattice elements.
;; Enumerating every permutation of its factor indices is exactly the internal
;; existential bijection in CompositionSeries.Equivalent.

(defun q2525646-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q2525646-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q2525646-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q2525646-quoted nil)))

(defun q2525646-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   (q2525646-quoted function)
   (q2525646-term-list arguments)))

(defun q2525646-static-predicate-term (function arguments)
  (list
   'if
   (q2525646-static-apply-term function arguments)
   (q2525646-quoted t)
   (q2525646-quoted nil)))

(defun q2525646-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q2525646-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q2525646-quoted nil))
    (q2525646-quoted t)))

(defun q2525646-not-term (term)
  (list
   'if
   term
   (q2525646-quoted nil)
   (q2525646-quoted t)))

(defun q2525646-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q2525646-quoted t)))

(defun q2525646-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q2525646-quoted t)))

(defun q2525646-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q2525646-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q2525646-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun q2525646-binary-p (relation left right)
  (if (apply$ relation (list left right)) t nil))

(defun q2525646-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

;; Equational presentation of an arbitrary lattice.

(defun q2525646-lattice-laws-function (carrier meet join)
  (let* ((x-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(x)))
         (y-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(y)))
         (z-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(z)))
         (meet-xx
          (q2525646-static-apply-term meet '(x x)))
         (join-xx
          (q2525646-static-apply-term join '(x x)))
         (meet-xy
          (q2525646-static-apply-term meet '(x y)))
         (join-xy
          (q2525646-static-apply-term join '(x y)))
         (meet-yx
          (q2525646-static-apply-term meet '(y x)))
         (join-yx
          (q2525646-static-apply-term join '(y x)))
         (meet-yz
          (q2525646-static-apply-term meet '(y z)))
         (join-yz
          (q2525646-static-apply-term join '(y z))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q2525646-and-terms
      (list
       (q2525646-implies-term
        x-in
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier (list meet-xx))
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier (list join-xx))
          (list 'equal meet-xx 'x)
          (list 'equal join-xx 'x))))
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms (list x-in y-in))
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier (list meet-xy))
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier (list join-xy))
          (list 'equal meet-xy meet-yx)
          (list 'equal join-xy join-yx)
          (list
           'equal
           (q2525646-static-apply-term
            meet
            (list 'x join-xy))
           'x)
          (list
           'equal
           (q2525646-static-apply-term
            join
            (list 'x meet-xy))
           'x))))
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms (list x-in y-in z-in))
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list
          (list
           'equal
           (q2525646-static-apply-term meet (list meet-xy 'z))
           (q2525646-static-apply-term meet (list 'x meet-yz)))
          (list
           'equal
           (q2525646-static-apply-term join (list join-xy 'z))
           (q2525646-static-apply-term join (list 'x join-yz)))))))))))

(defun q2525646-lattice-p (carrier meet join)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp meet)
   (tamep-functionp join)
   (q2525646-universal-p
    (q2525646-lattice-laws-function carrier meet join)
    '(x y z))))

;; The IsMaximal axioms and second-isomorphism axiom from
;; JordanHolderLattice.

(defun q2525646-jh-max-laws-function
    (carrier meet join maximal iso)
  (let* ((x-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(x)))
         (y-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(y)))
         (z-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(z)))
         (meet-xy
          (q2525646-static-apply-term meet '(x y)))
         (join-xy
          (q2525646-static-apply-term join '(x y)))
         (max-xy
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term maximal '(x y)))
         (max-xz
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term maximal '(x z)))
         (max-yz
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term maximal '(y z)))
         (max-x-join
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term
           maximal
           (list 'x join-xy)))
         (max-y-join
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term
           maximal
           (list 'y join-xy)))
         (pair-x-join
          (list 'cons 'x join-xy))
         (pair-meet-y
          (list 'cons meet-xy 'y)))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(x y z)
     (q2525646-and-terms
      (list
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms (list x-in y-in max-xy))
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list
          (list 'equal meet-xy 'x)
          (q2525646-not-term (list 'equal 'x 'y)))))
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list
          x-in
          y-in
          z-in
          max-xz
          max-yz
          (q2525646-not-term (list 'equal 'x 'y))))
        (list 'equal join-xy 'z))
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list x-in y-in max-x-join max-y-join))
        (q2525646-static-predicate-term
         maximal
         (list meet-xy 'x)))
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms (list x-in y-in max-x-join))
        (q2525646-static-predicate-term
         iso
         (list pair-x-join pair-meet-y))))))))

;; Iso is a symmetric and transitive relation on ordered pairs. ACL2 cons pairs
;; are the direct uncurried presentation of the source X x X arguments.

(defun q2525646-jh-iso-laws-function (carrier iso)
  (let* ((a-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(a)))
         (b-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(b)))
         (c-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(c)))
         (d-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(d)))
         (e-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(e)))
         (f-in
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term carrier '(f)))
         (pair-ab (list 'cons 'a 'b))
         (pair-cd (list 'cons 'c 'd))
         (pair-ef (list 'cons 'e 'f))
         (iso-ab-cd
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term
           iso
           (list pair-ab pair-cd)))
         (iso-cd-ef
          (q2525646-static-predicate-term
           iso
           (list pair-cd pair-ef))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(a b c d e f)
     (q2525646-and-terms
      (list
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list a-in b-in c-in d-in iso-ab-cd))
        (q2525646-static-predicate-term
         iso
         (list pair-cd pair-ab)))
       (q2525646-implies-term
        (q2525646-and-terms
         (list
          a-in b-in c-in d-in e-in f-in
          iso-ab-cd iso-cd-ef))
        (q2525646-static-predicate-term
         iso
         (list pair-ab pair-ef))))))))

(defun q2525646-jordan-holder-lattice-p
    (carrier meet join maximal iso)
  (and
   (q2525646-lattice-p carrier meet join)
   (tamep-functionp maximal)
   (tamep-functionp iso)
   (q2525646-universal-p
    (q2525646-jh-max-laws-function
     carrier meet join maximal iso)
    '(x y z))
   (q2525646-universal-p
    (q2525646-jh-iso-laws-function carrier iso)
    '(a b c d e f))))

;; Nonempty finite series whose consecutive elements satisfy IsMaximal.

(defun q2525646-series-elements-p (carrier series)
  (if (consp series)
      (and
       (q2525646-member-p carrier (car series))
       (q2525646-series-elements-p carrier (cdr series)))
    t))

(defun q2525646-series-steps-p (maximal series)
  (if (and (consp series) (consp (cdr series)))
      (and
       (q2525646-binary-p
        maximal
        (car series)
        (car (cdr series)))
       (q2525646-series-steps-p maximal (cdr series)))
    t))

(defun q2525646-composition-series-p
    (carrier maximal series)
  (and
   (true-listp series)
   (consp series)
   (q2525646-series-elements-p carrier series)
   (q2525646-series-steps-p maximal series)))

(defun q2525646-series-last (series)
  (car (last series)))

;; Exact finite presentation of the existential equivalence of factor lists.

(defun q2525646-factor-indices-aux (index count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     index
     (q2525646-factor-indices-aux (+ 1 index) (- count 1)))))

(defun q2525646-factor-indices (series)
  (q2525646-factor-indices-aux 0 (- (len series) 1)))

(defun q2525646-insert-at-splits (item prefix suffix)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len suffix)))
  (if (consp suffix)
      (cons
       (append prefix (cons item suffix))
       (q2525646-insert-at-splits
        item
        (append prefix (list (car suffix)))
        (cdr suffix)))
    (list (append prefix (list item)))))

(defun q2525646-insert-into-permutations (item permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (append
       (q2525646-insert-at-splits
        item nil (car permutations))
       (q2525646-insert-into-permutations
        item (cdr permutations)))
    nil))

(defun q2525646-permutations (items)
  (if (consp items)
      (q2525646-insert-into-permutations
       (car items)
       (q2525646-permutations (cdr items)))
    (list nil)))

(defun q2525646-factor-pairs-iso-p
    (iso source target permutation)
  (if (and (consp (cdr source)) (consp permutation))
      (let ((target-index (car permutation)))
        (and
         (q2525646-binary-p
          iso
          (cons (car source) (car (cdr source)))
          (cons
           (nth target-index target)
           (nth (+ 1 target-index) target)))
         (q2525646-factor-pairs-iso-p
          iso
          (cdr source)
          target
          (cdr permutation))))
    (and
     (not (consp (cdr source)))
     (not (consp permutation)))))

(defun q2525646-some-factor-permutation-p
    (iso source target permutations)
  (if (consp permutations)
      (or
       (q2525646-factor-pairs-iso-p
        iso source target (car permutations))
       (q2525646-some-factor-permutation-p
        iso source target (cdr permutations)))
    nil))

(defun q2525646-equivalent-p (iso source target)
  (and
   (equal (len source) (len target))
   (q2525646-some-factor-permutation-p
    iso
    source
    target
    (q2525646-permutations
     (q2525646-factor-indices source)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q2525646-jordan-holder-theorem-statement
    (carrier meet join maximal iso series-1 series-2)
  (implies
   (and
    (q2525646-jordan-holder-lattice-p
     carrier meet join maximal iso)
    (q2525646-composition-series-p
     carrier maximal series-1)
    (q2525646-composition-series-p
     carrier maximal series-2)
    (equal (car series-1) (car series-2))
    (equal
     (q2525646-series-last series-1)
     (q2525646-series-last series-2)))
   (q2525646-equivalent-p iso series-1 series-2)))

;; Admission-time tameness audit for every reified universal law.

(defun q2525646-all-reified-functions-tame-p ()
  (let ((unary '(lambda (x) (quote t)))
        (binary '(lambda (x y) x)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp
      (q2525646-true-function '(x)))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q2525646-lattice-laws-function
       unary binary binary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q2525646-jh-max-laws-function
       unary binary binary binary binary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q2525646-jh-iso-laws-function
       unary binary)))))

(value-triple
 (if (q2525646-all-reified-functions-tame-p)
     :itpeval-tame-reified-functions-checked
   (er hard 'q2525646-tameness
       "A reified statement function is not tame.")))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2525646
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q2525646), "Jordan–Hölder theorem": composition
-- series with the same least and greatest elements are equivalent in any
-- Jordan–Hölder lattice. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Pair
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    left  : A
    right : B

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

castSucc :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
castSucc {zero} ()
castSucc {suc n} fzero =
  fzero
castSucc {suc n} (fsuc i) =
  fsuc (castSucc i)

lastIndex :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Fin (suc n)
lastIndex zero =
  fzero
lastIndex (suc n) =
  fsuc (lastIndex n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record Lattice
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    le  : X -> X -> Set a
    inf : X -> X -> X
    sup : X -> X -> X

    le-propositional :
      (x y : X) ->
      (p q : le x y) ->
      p == q

    le-refl :
      (x : X) ->
      le x x
    le-trans :
      (x y z : X) ->
      le x y ->
      le y z ->
      le x z
    le-antisym :
      (x y : X) ->
      le x y ->
      le y x ->
      x == y

    inf-le-left :
      (x y : X) ->
      le (inf x y) x
    inf-le-right :
      (x y : X) ->
      le (inf x y) y
    le-inf :
      (x y z : X) ->
      le x y ->
      le x z ->
      le x (inf y z)

    le-sup-left :
      (x y : X) ->
      le x (sup x y)
    le-sup-right :
      (x y : X) ->
      le y (sup x y)
    sup-le :
      (x y z : X) ->
      le x z ->
      le y z ->
      le (sup x y) z

StrictLess :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Lattice X ->
  X ->
  X ->
  Set a
StrictLess lattice x y =
  Both
    (Lattice.le lattice x y)
    (Not (x == y))

record JordanHolderLattice
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  (lattice : Lattice X) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  open Lattice lattice

  field
    IsMaximal : X -> X -> Set a

    isMaximal-propositional :
      (x y : X) ->
      (p q : IsMaximal x y) ->
      p == q

    lt-of-isMaximal :
      {x y : X} ->
      IsMaximal x y ->
      StrictLess lattice x y

    sup-eq-of-isMaximal :
      {x y z : X} ->
      IsMaximal x z ->
      IsMaximal y z ->
      Not (x == y) ->
      sup x y == z

    isMaximal-inf-left-of-isMaximal-sup :
      {x y : X} ->
      IsMaximal x (sup x y) ->
      IsMaximal y (sup x y) ->
      IsMaximal (inf x y) x

    Iso :
      Pair X X ->
      Pair X X ->
      Set a

    iso-propositional :
      (p q : Pair X X) ->
      (h k : Iso p q) ->
      h == k

    iso-symmetric :
      {p q : Pair X X} ->
      Iso p q ->
      Iso q p

    iso-transitive :
      {p q r : Pair X X} ->
      Iso p q ->
      Iso q r ->
      Iso p r

    second-isomorphism :
      {x y : X} ->
      IsMaximal x (sup x y) ->
      Iso
        (x , sup x y)
        (inf x y , y)

record CompositionSeries
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {lattice : Lattice X}
  (structure : JordanHolderLattice lattice) :
  Set a where

  field
    length : Nat
    term   : Fin (suc length) -> X
    step   :
      (i : Fin length) ->
      JordanHolderLattice.IsMaximal structure
        (term (castSucc i))
        (term (fsuc i))

head :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {lattice : Lattice X} ->
  {structure : JordanHolderLattice lattice} ->
  CompositionSeries structure ->
  X
head series =
  CompositionSeries.term series fzero

last :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {lattice : Lattice X} ->
  {structure : JordanHolderLattice lattice} ->
  (series : CompositionSeries structure) ->
  X
last series =
  CompositionSeries.term series
    (lastIndex (CompositionSeries.length series))

Equivalent :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {lattice : Lattice X} ->
  {structure : JordanHolderLattice lattice} ->
  CompositionSeries structure ->
  CompositionSeries structure ->
  Set a
Equivalent {structure = structure} left-series right-series =
  Σ
    (Bijection
      (Fin (CompositionSeries.length left-series))
      (Fin (CompositionSeries.length right-series)))
    (\ factor-bijection ->
      (i : Fin (CompositionSeries.length left-series)) ->
      JordanHolderLattice.Iso structure
        (CompositionSeries.term left-series (castSucc i) ,
         CompositionSeries.term left-series (fsuc i))
        (CompositionSeries.term right-series
           (castSucc (Bijection.to factor-bijection i)) ,
         CompositionSeries.term right-series
           (fsuc (Bijection.to factor-bijection i))))

-- Lean: CompositionSeries.jordan_holder
jordan-holder :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
jordan-holder a =
  {X : Set a} ->
  (lattice : Lattice X) ->
  (structure : JordanHolderLattice lattice) ->
  (left-series right-series : CompositionSeries structure) ->
  head left-series == head right-series ->
  last left-series == last right-series ->
  Equivalent left-series right-series

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2525646, "Jordan–Hölder theorem": finite composition series with common
  endpoints in a Jordan–Hölder lattice have isomorphic factors up to a
  bijection of their step indices. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice_def = new_definition (
  "q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice_def",
  ``q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (meet : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (join : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (is_maximal : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (iso : ('a # 'a) -> ('a # 'a) -> bool) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y. leq (meet x y) x /\ leq (meet x y) y) /\
      (!x y z. leq z x /\ leq z y ==> leq z (meet x y)) /\
      (!x y. leq x (join x y) /\ leq y (join x y)) /\
      (!x y z. leq x z /\ leq y z ==> leq (join x y) z) /\
      (!x y. is_maximal x y ==> leq x y /\ x <> y) /\
      (!x y z.
         is_maximal x z /\ is_maximal y z /\ x <> y ==>
         join x y = z) /\
      (!x y.
         is_maximal x (join x y) /\ is_maximal y (join x y) ==>
         is_maximal (meet x y) x) /\
      (!p q. iso p q ==> iso q p) /\
      (!p q r. iso p q /\ iso q r ==> iso p r) /\
      (!x y.
         is_maximal x (join x y) ==>
         iso (x, join x y) (meet x y, y))``);

val q2525646_composition_series_def = new_definition (
  "q2525646_composition_series_def",
  ``q2525646_composition_series
      (is_maximal : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (n : num) (s : num -> 'a) <=>
      !i. i < n ==> is_maximal (s i) (s (SUC i))``);

val q2525646_equivalent_def = new_definition (
  "q2525646_equivalent_def",
  ``q2525646_equivalent
      (iso : ('a # 'a) -> ('a # 'a) -> bool)
      (n1 : num) (s1 : num -> 'a) (n2 : num) (s2 : num -> 'a) <=>
      ?e : num -> num.
        (!i. i < n1 ==> e i < n2) /\
        (!i j. i < n1 /\ j < n1 /\ e i = e j ==> i = j) /\
        (!j. j < n2 ==> ?i. i < n1 /\ e i = j) /\
        (!i.
           i < n1 ==>
           iso (s1 i, s1 (SUC i))
             (s2 (e i), s2 (SUC (e i))))``);

val CompositionSeries_jordan_holder =
  ``!(leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (meet : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (join : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (is_maximal : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (iso : ('a # 'a) -> ('a # 'a) -> bool)
      (n1 : num) (s1 : num -> 'a) (n2 : num) (s2 : num -> 'a).
      q2525646_jordan_holder_lattice leq meet join is_maximal iso /\
      q2525646_composition_series is_maximal n1 s1 /\
      q2525646_composition_series is_maximal n2 s2 /\
      s1 0 = s2 0 /\
      s1 n1 = s2 n2
      ==>
      q2525646_equivalent iso n1 s1 n2 s2``;

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2525646
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2525646), "Jordan–Hölder theorem":
  in an arbitrary Jordan–Hölder lattice, any two finite composition series with
  the same least and greatest elements have bijectively matched successive
  factors up to the lattice's factor-isomorphism relation. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K is a SetMM lattice. M is the maximal-step relation on its carrier, and I
  is the factor-isomorphism relation on pairs of carrier elements.
  Q2525646JHL states exactly the JordanHolderLattice laws used by the Lean
  source: maximal steps are strict, distinct maximal predecessors have join
  equal to their common successor, meets inherit maximality, I is symmetric
  and transitive, and the second isomorphism law holds.

  A composition series is represented by a nonempty SetMM word over the
  lattice carrier whose adjacent entries satisfy M. Its factor indices form
  the finite ordinal 0 ..^ (#s - 1). Q2525646Equivalent internally quantifies
  a bijection between the two factor-index ordinals and requires I-related
  adjacent pairs at corresponding indices.

  The declarations preceding the final assertion are syntax or faithful
  bidirectional definitions. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q2525646JHL Q2525646Series Q2525646Equivalent $.

q2525646-jhl-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2525646JHL K M I ) $.
q2525646-series-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2525646Series K M s ) $.
q2525646-equivalent-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2525646Equivalent I s t ) $.

${
  $d I K M p q r x y z $.

  q2525646-jhl-definition $a |- (
    Q2525646JHL K M I
  ) <->
  (
    K e. Lat
    /\
    (
      M C_ ( ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K ) )
      /\
      (
        I C_ (
          ( ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K ) )
          X.
          ( ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K ) )
        )
        /\
        (
          A. x e. ( Base ` K )
            A. y e. ( Base ` K )
              (
                x M y
                ->
                (
                  x ( le ` K ) y
                  /\
                  x =/= y
                )
              )
          /\
          (
            A. x e. ( Base ` K )
              A. y e. ( Base ` K )
                A. z e. ( Base ` K )
                  (
                    (
                      x M z
                      /\
                      (
                        y M z
                        /\
                        x =/= y
                      )
                    )
                    ->
                    ( x ( join ` K ) y ) = z
                  )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. ( Base ` K )
                A. y e. ( Base ` K )
                  (
                    (
                      x M ( x ( join ` K ) y )
                      /\
                      y M ( x ( join ` K ) y )
                    )
                    ->
                    ( x ( meet ` K ) y ) M x
                  )
              /\
              (
                A. p e. (
                  ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K )
                )
                  A. q e. (
                    ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K )
                  )
                    (
                      p I q
                      ->
                      q I p
                    )
                /\
                (
                  A. p e. (
                    ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K )
                  )
                    A. q e. (
                      ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K )
                    )
                      A. r e. (
                        ( Base ` K ) X. ( Base ` K )
                      )
                        (
                          (
                            p I q
                            /\

:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q2525646), "Jordan–Hölder theorem": in any
:: Jordan–Hölder lattice, two finite composition series with the same initial
:: and terminal elements have equivalent factors up to a bijection. This file
:: contains no proof.
