  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1,
    NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, NAT_D, FINSEQ_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, MEMBERED;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for C being set,
      j,m being Function of [:C,C:],C,
      R,S being (Relation of C),
      J being Subset of [:[:C,C:],[:C,C:]:],
      s1,s2 being FinSequence of C st
    (for x being Element of C holds [x,x] in R) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of C st
      [x,y] in R & [y,z] in R holds [x,z] in R) &
    (for x,y being Element of C st
      [x,y] in R & [y,x] in R holds x = y) &
    (for x,y being Element of C holds
      [x,j.[x,y]] in R & [y,j.[x,y]] in R) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of C st
      [x,z] in R & [y,z] in R holds [j.[x,y],z] in R) &
    (for x,y being Element of C holds
      [m.[x,y],x] in R & [m.[x,y],y] in R) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of C st
      [z,x] in R & [z,y] in R holds [z,m.[x,y]] in R) &
    (for x,y being Element of C st [x,y] in S holds
      [x,y] in R & x <> y) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of C st
      [x,z] in S & [y,z] in S & x <> y
      holds j.[x,y] = z) &
    (for x,y being Element of C st
      [x,j.[x,y]] in S & [y,j.[x,y]] in S
      holds [m.[x,y],x] in S) &
    (for a,b being Element of [:C,C:] st [a,b] in J
      holds [b,a] in J) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of [:C,C:] st
      [a,b] in J & [b,c] in J holds [a,c] in J) &
    (for x,y being Element of C st [x,j.[x,y]] in S
      holds [[x,j.[x,y]],[m.[x,y],y]] in J) &
    len s1 <> 0 & len s2 <> 0 &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg (len s1 -' 1)
      holds [s1.i,s1.(i+1)] in S) &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg (len s2 -' 1)
      holds [s2.i,s2.(i+1)] in S) &

end;

title: Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2525646,
% "Jordan–Hölder theorem": composition series with the same head and last term
% are equivalent in any Jordan–Hölder lattice. This file contains no proof.

Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem[
  X: TYPE,
  le_rel: [X, X -> bool],
  inf_op: [X, X -> X],
  sup_op: [X, X -> X],
  is_maximal: [X, X -> bool],
  factor_iso: [X, X, X, X -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  strict_less(x, y: X): bool =
    le_rel(x, y) AND x /= y

  lattice_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: X): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        le_rel(inf_op(x, y), x)
          AND le_rel(inf_op(x, y), y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        le_rel(z, x) AND le_rel(z, y)
          IMPLIES le_rel(z, inf_op(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        le_rel(x, sup_op(x, y))
          AND le_rel(y, sup_op(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        le_rel(x, z) AND le_rel(y, z)
          IMPLIES le_rel(sup_op(x, y), z))

  jordan_holder_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      is_maximal(x, y) IMPLIES strict_less(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        is_maximal(x, z)
          AND is_maximal(y, z)
          AND x /= y
        IMPLIES sup_op(x, y) = z)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        is_maximal(x, sup_op(x, y))
          AND is_maximal(y, sup_op(x, y))
        IMPLIES is_maximal(inf_op(x, y), x))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c, d: X):
        factor_iso(a, b, c, d)
          IMPLIES factor_iso(c, d, a, b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c, d, e, f: X):
        factor_iso(a, b, c, d)
          AND factor_iso(c, d, e, f)
        IMPLIES factor_iso(a, b, e, f))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        is_maximal(x, sup_op(x, y))
          IMPLIES
            factor_iso(
              x,
              sup_op(x, y),
              inf_op(x, y),
              y))

  composition_series(
      series_length: nat,
      series: [nat -> X]): bool =
    FORALL (i: nat):
      i < series_length
        IMPLIES is_maximal(series(i), series(i + 1))

  bounded_bijection(
      map: [nat -> nat],
      left_length, right_length: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (i: nat):
      i < left_length IMPLIES map(i) < right_length)
      AND (FORALL (i, j: nat):
        i < left_length
          AND j < left_length
          AND map(i) = map(j)
        IMPLIES i = j)
      AND (FORALL (j: nat):
        j < right_length
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (i: nat):
              i < left_length AND map(i) = j)

  equivalent(
      left_length, right_length: nat,
      left_series, right_series: [nat -> X]): bool =
    EXISTS (factor_map: [nat -> nat]):
      bounded_bijection(
        factor_map,
        left_length,
        right_length)
        AND (FORALL (i: nat):
          i < left_length
            IMPLIES
              factor_iso(
                left_series(i),
                left_series(i + 1),
                right_series(factor_map(i)),
                right_series(factor_map(i) + 1)))

  jordan_holder_theorem: bool =
    lattice_laws
      AND jordan_holder_laws
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL (left_length, right_length: nat),
              (left_series, right_series: [nat -> X]):
        composition_series(left_length, left_series)
          AND composition_series(right_length, right_series)
          AND left_series(0) = right_series(0)
          AND left_series(left_length) =
            right_series(right_length)
        IMPLIES
          equivalent(
            left_length,
            right_length,
            left_series,
            right_series))
END Q2525646_jordan_h_lder_theorem

module

@[expose] public section

title: Q253214_heine_borel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q253214
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q253214), "Heine–Borel theorem": in a proper
  Hausdorff pseudometric space, a set is compact if and only if it is closed
  and bounded. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q253214_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q253214_pseudo_metric_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q253214_dist : X -> X -> R;
  q253214_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : X, 0 <= q253214_dist x y;
  q253214_dist_self :
    forall x : X, q253214_dist x x = 0;
  q253214_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : X,
      q253214_dist x y = q253214_dist y x;
  q253214_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : X,
      q253214_dist x z <=
      q253214_dist x y + q253214_dist y z
}.

Arguments q253214_dist {X} _ _ _.

Definition q253214_is_open
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (U : q253214_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : X,
        q253214_dist M x y < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q253214_is_closed
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q253214_set X) : Prop :=
  q253214_is_open M (fun x : X => ~ S x).

Definition q253214_is_compact
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q253214_set X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q253214_set (q253214_set X),
    (forall U : q253214_set X,
      cover U -> q253214_is_open M U) ->
    (forall x : X,
      S x ->
      exists U : q253214_set X, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q253214_set X),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        S x ->
        exists U : q253214_set X,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q253214_is_bounded
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q253214_set X) : Prop :=
  exists bound : R,
    forall x y : X,
      S x ->
      S y ->
      q253214_dist M x y <= bound.

Definition q253214_closed_ball
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (center : X)
    (radius : R) : q253214_set X :=
  fun x : X => q253214_dist M x center <= radius.

Definition q253214_t2_space
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X) : Prop :=
  forall x y : X,
    x <> y ->
    exists U V : q253214_set X,
      q253214_is_open M U /\
      q253214_is_open M V /\
      U x /\
      V y /\
      forall z : X, ~ (U z /\ V z).

Definition q253214_proper_space
    {X : Type}
    (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X) : Prop :=
  forall (center : X) (radius : R),
    q253214_is_compact M
      (q253214_closed_ball M center radius).

Theorem q253214_heine_borel_theorem :
  forall (X : Type)
         (M : q253214_pseudo_metric_space X),
    q253214_t2_space M ->
    q253214_proper_space M ->
    forall S : q253214_set X,
      q253214_is_compact M S <->
      q253214_is_closed M S /\
      q253214_is_bounded M S.
Admitted.

theory Q253214_heine_borel_theorem

begin

theorem heine_borel_theorem:

title: Q253214_heine_borel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q253214,
  "Heine–Borel theorem": in a proper Hausdorff pseudometric space, a subset is
  compact if and only if it is closed and bounded. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q253214_HEINE_BOREL_THEOREM =
 `let is_pseudometric =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
      (!x y:A.
         x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
         ==> &0 <= d x y) /\
      (!x:A.
         x IN carrier
         ==> d x x = &0) /\
      (!x y:A.
         x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
         ==> d x y = d y x) /\
      (!x y z:A.
         x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
         ==> d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let metric_open =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real) (u:A->bool).
      u SUBSET carrier /\
      !x:A.
        x IN u
        ==> ?epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon /\
              !y:A.
                y IN carrier /\ d x y < epsilon
                ==> y IN u in
   let metric_closed =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
      s SUBSET carrier /\
      metric_open carrier d (carrier DIFF s) in
   let metric_compact =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
      s SUBSET carrier /\
      !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
        (!u:A->bool.
           u IN cover
           ==> metric_open carrier d u) /\
        s SUBSET UNIONS cover
        ==> ?finite_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
              finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
              FINITE finite_cover /\
              s SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let metric_bounded =
    \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
      ?bound:real.
        !x y:A.
          x IN s /\ y IN s
          ==> d x y <= bound in
   let hausdorff_metric_space =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
      !x y:A.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ ~(x = y)
        ==> ?u v:A->bool.
              metric_open carrier d u /\
              metric_open carrier d v /\
              x IN u /\
              y IN v /\
              u INTER v = {} in
   let proper_metric_space =
    \(carrier:A->bool) (d:A->A->real).
      !x:A.
        x IN carrier
        ==> !radius:real.
              metric_compact carrier d
                {y:A | y IN carrier /\ d y x <= radius} in
   !carrier:A->bool.
   !d:A->A->real.
   !s:A->bool.
     is_pseudometric carrier d /\
     hausdorff_metric_space carrier d /\
     proper_metric_space carrier d /\
     s SUBSET carrier
     ==> (metric_compact carrier d s <=>
          metric_closed carrier d s /\
          metric_bounded d s)`;;

title: Q253214_heine_borel_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q253214,
;; "Heine–Borel theorem": in an arbitrary proper metric space, a set is
;; compact if and only if it is closed and bounded. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ functions represent the arbitrary carrier, metric, sets, and
;; open covers. DEFUN-SK supplies all unbounded quantifiers and keeps radius,
;; cover, and finite-subcover witnesses inside their source scopes. Distances
;; are rounded rational upper cuts representing arbitrary finite nonnegative
;; real values rather than a restriction to rational-valued metrics.

(defun q253214-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q253214-distance-lt-p (distance left right radius)
  (if (apply$ distance (list left right radius)) t nil))

(defun q253214-positive-rational-p (radius)
  (and (rationalp radius)
       (< 0 radius)))

;; Extensional subsets and arbitrary families of subsets.

(defun-sk q253214-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q253214-member-p set x)
     (q253214-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q253214-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q253214-set-contained-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q253214-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q253214-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q253214-member-p left x)
      (q253214-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q253214-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q253214-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q253214-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q253214-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q253214-member-p family left)
      (q253214-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q253214-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q253214-member-p family set)
     (q253214-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q253214-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q253214-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q253214-family-members-valid-p carrier family)))

;; Rounded rational upper cuts for genuine real-valued metrics.

(defun-sk q253214-distance-finite-p (distance left right)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q253214-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q253214-distance-lt-p
      distance left right radius))))

(defun-sk q253214-distance-rounded-p
    (distance left right radius)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q253214-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (rationalp radius)
     (< smaller radius)
     (q253214-distance-lt-p
      distance left right smaller))))

(defun-sk q253214-positive-distance-p (distance left right)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q253214-positive-rational-p radius)
     (not
      (q253214-distance-lt-p
       distance left right radius)))))

(defun-sk q253214-metric-laws-p (carrier distance)
  (forall (x y z q r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q253214-member-p carrier x)
      (q253214-member-p carrier y)
      (q253214-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (implies
       (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q253214-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x y r))
      (implies
       (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q253214-distance-rounded-p
        distance x y q))
      (q253214-distance-finite-p distance x y)
      (iff
       (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q253214-distance-lt-p distance y x q))
      (iff
       (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x x q)
       (q253214-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (not (equal x y))
       (q253214-positive-distance-p distance x y))
      (implies
       (and
        (q253214-positive-rational-p r)
        (q253214-positive-rational-p s)
        (q253214-distance-lt-p distance x y r)
        (q253214-distance-lt-p distance y z s))
       (q253214-distance-lt-p
        distance x z (+ r s)))))))

(defun q253214-metric-space-p (carrier distance)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp distance)
   (q253214-metric-laws-p carrier distance)))

;; The topology induced by the metric.

(defun-sk q253214-metric-ball-subset-p
    (carrier distance center radius set)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q253214-member-p carrier point)
      (q253214-distance-lt-p
       distance center point radius))
     (q253214-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q253214-open-radius-exists-p
    (carrier distance set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q253214-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q253214-metric-ball-subset-p
      carrier distance center radius set))))

title: Q253214_heine_borel_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q253214,
-- "Heine–Borel theorem": in a proper metric space, a set is compact if and
-- only if it is closed and bounded. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q253214_heine_borel_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat) renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} →
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real line.
record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zero one :
      R

    add multiply :
      R →
      R →
      R

    negate reciprocal :
      R →
      R

    lessOrEqual :
      R →
      R →
      Set r

    fromNat :
      Nat →
      R

    one-not-zero :
      one ≠ zero

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      add x y ≡ add y x

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)

    add-zero :
      (x : R) →
      add x zero ≡ x

    add-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiply x y ≡ multiply y x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)

    multiply-one :
      (x : R) →
      multiply x one ≡ x

    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) →
      multiply x zero ≡ zero

    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡ add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)

    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zero →
      multiply x (reciprocal x) ≡ one

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqual x x

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y z →
      lessOrEqual x z

    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y x →
      x ≡ y

    order-total :
      (x y : R) →
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)

    add-order :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)

    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqual zero x →
      lessOrEqual zero y →
      lessOrEqual zero (multiply x y)

    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqual zero one × zero ≠ one

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNat zeroN ≡ zero

    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) →
      fromNat (sucN n) ≡ add (fromNat n) one

    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNat m ≡ fromNat n →
      m ≡ n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat (λ n → lessOrEqual x (fromNat n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R → Set r) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R (λ upper → (x : R) → P x → lessOrEqual x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqual x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) → P x → lessOrEqual x upper) →
            lessOrEqual supremum upper))

open RealLine

StrictLess :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RealLine R →
  R →
  R →
  Set r
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqual reals x y × x ≠ y

record MetricSpace
  {r a : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (r ⊔ a) where

  field
    distance :
      X →
      X →
      R

    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : X) →
      lessOrEqual reals (zero reals) (distance x y)

    distance-self :
      (x : X) →
      distance x x ≡ zero reals

    distance-zero-only :
      (x y : X) →
      distance x y ≡ zero reals →
      x ≡ y

    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : X) →
      distance x y ≡ distance y x

    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : X) →
      lessOrEqual reals
        (distance x z)
        (add reals (distance x y) (distance y z))

open MetricSpace

Subset :
  {a p : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Subset {p = p} X =
  X → Set p

Family :
  {a p : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Family {p = p} X =
  Subset {p = p} X → Set p

Complement :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Subset {p = p} X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

IsOpen :
  {r a : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  MetricSpace reals X →
  Subset {p = r} X →
  Set (r ⊔ a)
IsOpen {R = R} {X = X} {reals = reals} metric U =
  (center : X) →
  U center →
  Σ R
    (λ radius →
      StrictLess reals (zero reals) radius
      ×
      ((point : X) →
        StrictLess reals (distance metric center point) radius →
        U point))

IsClosed :
  {r a : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  MetricSpace reals X →
  Subset {p = r} X →
  Set (r ⊔ a)
IsClosed metric U =
  IsOpen metric (Complement U)

Covers :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Family {p = p} X →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Covers {p = p} {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  Σ (Subset {p = p} X)
    (λ V →
      cover V × V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a p : Level} →
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset {p = p} X →
  Family {p = p} X →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
FiniteSubcover {p = p} {X = X} U cover =
  Σ (List (Subset {p = p} X))
    (λ selected →
      ((V : Subset {p = p} X) →
        Member V selected →
        cover V)
      ×
      ((x : X) →
        U x →
        Σ (Subset {p = p} X)
          (λ V →
            Member V selected × V x)))

Compact :
  {r a : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  MetricSpace reals X →
  Subset {p = r} X →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc r)
Compact {r = r} {X = X} metric U =
  (cover : Family {p = r} X) →
  ((V : Subset {p = r} X) →
    cover V →
    IsOpen metric V) →
  Covers U cover →
  FiniteSubcover U cover

IsBounded :
  {r a : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  MetricSpace reals X →
  Subset {p = r} X →
  Set (r ⊔ a)
IsBounded {R = R} {X = X} {reals = reals} metric U =
  Σ R
    (λ bound →
      (x y : X) →
      U x →
      U y →
      lessOrEqual reals (distance metric x y) bound)

ClosedBall :
  {r a : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  MetricSpace reals X →
  X →
  R →
  Subset {p = r} X
ClosedBall {reals = reals} metric center radius point =
  lessOrEqual reals (distance metric center point) radius

Proper :
  {r a : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {X : Set a} →
  {reals : RealLine R} →
  MetricSpace reals X →
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc r)
Proper {R = R} {X = X} metric =
  (center : X) →
  (radius : R) →
  Compact metric (ClosedBall metric center radius)

heine-borel-theorem :
  {r a : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ a))
heine-borel-theorem {r} {a} =
  (R : Set r) →
  (reals : RealLine R) →
  (X : Set a) →
  (metric : MetricSpace reals X) →
  Proper metric →
  (U : Subset {p = r} X) →
  Iff
    (Compact metric U)
    (IsClosed metric U × IsBounded metric U)

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q253214 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q253214), "Heine–Borel theorem": in a
  proper metric space, a set is compact if and only if it is closed and
  bounded. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory metricTheory realTheory;

val q253214_is_bounded_def = new_definition (
  "q253214_is_bounded_def",
  ``q253214_is_bounded (m : 'a metric) (s : 'a set) <=>
      ?c.
        !x y.
          x IN s /\ y IN s
          ==>
          dist m (x,y) <= c``);

val q253214_proper_space_def = new_definition (
  "q253214_proper_space_def",
  ``q253214_proper_space (m : 'a metric) <=>
      !x r.
        compact_in (mtopology m) (mcball m (x,r))``);

val Metric_isCompact_iff_isClosed_bounded =
  ``!(m : 'a metric) (s : 'a set).
      q253214_proper_space m
      ==>
      (compact_in (mtopology m) s <=>
       closed_in (mtopology m) s /\
       q253214_is_bounded m s)``;

title: Q253214_heine_borel_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q253214
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q253214), "Heine--Borel theorem": in an
  arbitrary proper Hausdorff real-valued pseudometric space, a subset is
  compact if and only if it is closed and bounded. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q253214MetricTopology D is the topology generated by the open balls of the
  pseudometric D. Q253214Bounded D S says that all pairwise distances in S
  have a common real upper bound, the pseudometric characterization of the
  source bornological boundedness predicate.

  Q253214Proper X D says that every closed ball with center in X and arbitrary
  real radius is compact in the induced subspace topology. This is exactly the
  proper-space hypothesis used by the Lean theorem. The final assertion ranges
  over an arbitrary carrier X, real-valued pseudometric D, and subset S of X;
  Haus is SetMM's Hausdorff-space class, Clsd its closed-set operator, and Comp
  its compact-space class.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions. There are no
  $p declarations in this root statement file; the included SetMM library is
  a separately verified dependency.
$)

$c Q253214MetricTopology Q253214Bounded Q253214Proper $.

q253214-metric-topology-syntax
  $a class ( Q253214MetricTopology D ) $.
q253214-bounded-syntax
  $a wff ( Q253214Bounded D S ) $.
q253214-proper-syntax
  $a wff ( Q253214Proper X D ) $.

${
  q253214-metric-topology-definition $a |- (
    Q253214MetricTopology D
  ) = (
    topGen ` ran ( ball ` D )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D S c x y $.

  q253214-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( Q253214Bounded D S )
    <->
    E. c e. RR
      A. x e. S
        A. y e. S
          ( x D y ) <_ c
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D X p r y $.

  q253214-proper-definition $a |- (
    ( Q253214Proper X D )
    <->
    A. p e. X
      A. r e. RR
        (
          ( Q253214MetricTopology D )
          |`t
          { y e. X | ( p D y ) <_ r }
        ) e. Comp
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D S X $.

  thousand-theorems-q253214-heine-borel $a |-
    A. X A. D A. S
      (
        (
          (
            D e. ( PsMet ` X )
            /\
            ran D C_ RR
          )
          /\
          (
            ( Q253214MetricTopology D ) e. Haus
            /\
            ( Q253214Proper X D )
          )
          /\
          S C_ X
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            ( Q253214MetricTopology D )
            |`t
            S
          ) e. Comp
          <->
          (
            S e. ( Clsd ` ( Q253214MetricTopology D ) )
            /\
            ( Q253214Bounded D S )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q253214_heine_borel_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q253214,
% "Heine–Borel theorem": in a proper Hausdorff pseudometric space, an arbitrary
% set is compact exactly when it is closed and bounded. This file contains no proof.

heine_borel_theorem_Q253214[
  X: TYPE,
  carrier: [X -> bool],
  distance: [X, X -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]

  carrier_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      S(x) IMPLIES carrier(x)

  subset_of(S, T: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND S(x) IMPLIES T(x)

  disjoint_sets(S, T: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES NOT (S(x) AND T(x))

  pseudometric_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
        distance(x, y) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) IMPLIES distance(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES
          distance(x, y) = distance(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND carrier(z) IMPLIES
          distance(x, z)
            <= distance(x, y) + distance(y, z))

  metric_open(U: point_set): bool =
    carrier_set(U)
      AND FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) AND U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: real):
            radius > 0
              AND FORALL (y: X):
                carrier(y)
                  AND distance(x, y) < radius
                IMPLIES U(y)

  hausdorff_space: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: X):
      carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND x /= y IMPLIES
        EXISTS (U, V: point_set):
          metric_open(U)
            AND metric_open(V)
            AND U(x)
            AND V(y)
            AND disjoint_sets(U, V)

  metric_closed(S: point_set): bool =
    carrier_set(S)
      AND metric_open(
        LAMBDA (x: X):
          carrier(x) AND NOT S(x))

  open_cover(cover: set_family, S: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES metric_open(U))
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        carrier(x) AND S(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: point_set):
            cover(U) AND U(x))

  finite_subcover(
      cover: set_family,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: X):
          carrier(x) AND S(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_set(S: point_set): bool =
    carrier_set(S)
      AND FORALL (cover: set_family):
        open_cover(cover, S) IMPLIES
          finite_subcover(cover, S)

  bounded_set(S: point_set): bool =
    carrier_set(S)
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        FORALL (x, y: X):
          carrier(x) AND carrier(y) AND S(x) AND S(y)
            IMPLIES distance(x, y) <= bound

  closed_ball(center: X, radius: real): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      carrier(x) AND distance(x, center) <= radius

  proper_space: bool =
    FORALL (center: X), (radius: real):
      carrier(center) IMPLIES
        compact_set(closed_ball(center, radius))

  heine_borel_theorem: bool =
    (pseudometric_space
      AND hausdorff_space
      AND proper_space)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: point_set):
        carrier_set(S) IMPLIES
          (compact_set(S)
            IFF (metric_closed(S) AND bounded_set(S)))
END heine_borel_theorem_Q253214

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q25378690
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q25378690), "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": a family of
-- Markov transition kernels on successive dependent coordinates uniquely extends
-- finite initial trajectories to a Markov kernel on infinite trajectories with
-- the prescribed finite-dimensional marginals. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.IonescuTulcea.PartialTraj

@[expose] public section

open Finset MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

variable {X : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (X n)]

namespace ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.Q25378690

/-- The Ionescu-Tulcea theorem for a sequence of Markov kernels on dependent state spaces. -/
theorem ionescu_tulcea_theorem
    (κ : (n : ℕ) → Kernel (Π i : Iic n, X i) (X (n + 1)))
    [∀ n, IsMarkovKernel (κ n)] (a : ℕ) :
    ∃! η : Kernel (Π i : Iic a, X i) (Π n, X n),
      IsMarkovKernel η ∧
        ∀ b : ℕ, η.map (fun (x : Π n, X n) (i : Iic b) ↦ x i.1) =
          partialTraj κ a b := sorry

end ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.Q25378690

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q25378690
   (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q25378690), "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem":
   measurable Markov kernels on successive trajectory prefixes extend to a
   Markov kernel on infinite trajectories with the prescribed
   finite-dimensional distributions. This file contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition Event (A : Type) := A -> Prop.
Definition SigmaAlgebra (A : Type) := Event A -> Prop.

Definition empty_event {A : Type} : Event A := fun _ => False.
Definition full_event {A : Type} : Event A := fun _ => True.
Definition event_complement {A : Type} (E : Event A) : Event A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.
Definition countable_union {A : Type} (E : nat -> Event A) : Event A :=
  fun x => exists n, E n x.

Definition pairwise_disjoint {A : Type} (E : nat -> Event A) : Prop :=
  forall i j x, i <> j -> ~ (E i x /\ E j x).

Record IsSigmaAlgebra {A : Type} (M : SigmaAlgebra A) : Prop := {
  sigma_empty : M empty_event;
  sigma_ext :
    forall E F, M E -> (forall x, E x <-> F x) -> M F;
  sigma_complement :
    forall E, M E -> M (event_complement E);
  sigma_countable_union :
    forall E, (forall n, M (E n)) -> M (countable_union E)
}.

Inductive Borel : Event R -> Prop :=
| borel_open_ray :
    forall c : R, Borel (fun x => x < c)
| borel_empty :
    Borel empty_event
| borel_ext :
    forall E F, Borel E -> (forall x, E x <-> F x) -> Borel F
| borel_complement :
    forall E, Borel E -> Borel (event_complement E)
| borel_countable_union :
    forall E, (forall n, Borel (E n)) -> Borel (countable_union E).

Definition MeasurableFunction {A B : Type}
    (MA : SigmaAlgebra A) (MB : SigmaAlgebra B) (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall E, MB E -> MA (fun x => E (f x)).

Definition Bounded {A : Type} (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists C : R, 0 <= C /\ forall x, Rabs (f x) <= C.

Definition Nonnegative {A : Type} (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x, 0 <= f x.

Definition IncreasingSequence {A : Type} (f : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall n x, f n x <= f (S n) x.

Definition ConvergesTo (u : nat -> R) (l : R) : Prop :=
  forall eps : R, 0 < eps ->
    exists N : nat, forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat -> Rabs (u n - l) < eps.

Fixpoint partial_sum (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => u O
  | S m => partial_sum u m + u (S m)
  end.

Definition IsIndicator {A : Type} (E : Event A) (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x, (E x /\ f x = 1) \/ (~ E x /\ f x = 0).

Record ProbabilityMeasure (A : Type) (M : SigmaAlgebra A) : Type := {
  probability_mass : Event A -> R;
  probability_integral : (A -> R) -> R;

  probability_mass_ext :
    forall E F, M E -> M F ->
      (forall x, E x <-> F x) ->
      probability_mass E = probability_mass F;
  probability_mass_empty :
    probability_mass empty_event = 0;
  probability_mass_full :
    probability_mass full_event = 1;
  probability_mass_nonnegative :
    forall E, M E -> 0 <= probability_mass E;
  probability_mass_countably_additive :
    forall E, (forall n, M (E n)) ->
      pairwise_disjoint E ->
      ConvergesTo
        (fun n => partial_sum (fun k => probability_mass (E k)) n)
        (probability_mass (countable_union E));

  probability_integral_ext :
    forall f g, MeasurableFunction M Borel f ->
      MeasurableFunction M Borel g ->
      Bounded f -> Bounded g ->
      (forall x, f x = g x) ->
      probability_integral f = probability_integral g;
  probability_integral_indicator :
    forall E f, M E -> IsIndicator E f ->
      probability_integral f = probability_mass E;
  probability_integral_add :
    forall f g, MeasurableFunction M Borel f ->
      MeasurableFunction M Borel g ->
      Bounded f -> Bounded g ->
      probability_integral (fun x => f x + g x) =
        probability_integral f + probability_integral g;
  probability_integral_scale :
    forall (c : R) f, MeasurableFunction M Borel f ->
      Bounded f ->
      probability_integral (fun x => c * f x) =
        c * probability_integral f;
  probability_integral_nonnegative :
    forall f, MeasurableFunction M Borel f ->
      Bounded f -> Nonnegative f ->
      0 <= probability_integral f;
  probability_integral_monotone_convergence :
    forall (f : nat -> A -> R) g,
      (forall n, MeasurableFunction M Borel (f n)) ->
      MeasurableFunction M Borel g ->
      (forall n, Bounded (f n)) ->
      Bounded g ->
      (forall n, Nonnegative (f n)) ->
      IncreasingSequence f ->
      (forall x, ConvergesTo (fun n => f n x) (g x)) ->
      ConvergesTo (fun n => probability_integral (f n))
        (probability_integral g)
}.

Arguments probability_mass {A M} _ _.
Arguments probability_integral {A M} _ _.

Record MarkovKernel (A B : Type)
    (MA : SigmaAlgebra A) (MB : SigmaAlgebra B) : Type := {
  kernel_at : A -> ProbabilityMeasure B MB;
  kernel_mass_measurable :
    forall E, MB E ->
      MeasurableFunction MA Borel
        (fun x => probability_mass (kernel_at x) E);
  kernel_integral_measurable :
    forall f, MeasurableFunction MB Borel f ->
      Bounded f ->
      MeasurableFunction MA Borel
        (fun x => probability_integral (kernel_at x) f)
}.

Arguments kernel_at {A B MA MB} _ _.

Inductive ProductSigma {A B : Type}
    (MA : SigmaAlgebra A) (MB : SigmaAlgebra B) : SigmaAlgebra (A * B) :=
| product_left :
    forall E, MA E -> ProductSigma MA MB (fun z => E (fst z))
| product_right :
    forall E, MB E -> ProductSigma MA MB (fun z => E (snd z))
| product_empty :
    ProductSigma MA MB empty_event
| product_ext :
    forall E F, ProductSigma MA MB E ->
      (forall z, E z <-> F z) ->
      ProductSigma MA MB F
| product_complement :
    forall E, ProductSigma MA MB E ->
      ProductSigma MA MB (event_complement E)
| product_countable_union :
    forall E, (forall n, ProductSigma MA MB (E n)) ->
      ProductSigma MA MB (countable_union E).

Fixpoint Prefix (X : nat -> Type) (n : nat) : Type :=
  match n with
  | O => X O
  | S m => (Prefix X m * X (S m))%type
  end.

Fixpoint PrefixSigma (X : nat -> Type)
    (MX : forall n, SigmaAlgebra (X n)) (n : nat)
    : SigmaAlgebra (Prefix X n) :=
  match n as k return SigmaAlgebra (Prefix X k) with
  | O => MX O
  | S m => ProductSigma (PrefixSigma X MX m) (MX (S m))
  end.

Definition Path (X : nat -> Type) := forall n : nat, X n.

Fixpoint restrict_path (X : nat -> Type) (n : nat)
    (omega : Path X) : Prefix X n :=
  match n as k return Prefix X k with
  | O => omega O
  | S m => (restrict_path X m omega, omega (S m))
  end.

Inductive PathSigma (X : nat -> Type)
    (MX : forall n, SigmaAlgebra (X n)) : SigmaAlgebra (Path X) :=
| path_cylinder :
    forall n E, PrefixSigma X MX n E ->
      PathSigma X MX (fun omega => E (restrict_path X n omega))
| path_empty :
    PathSigma X MX empty_event
| path_ext :
    forall E F, PathSigma X MX E ->
      (forall omega, E omega <-> F omega) ->
      PathSigma X MX F
| path_complement :
    forall E, PathSigma X MX E ->
      PathSigma X MX (event_complement E)
| path_countable_union :
    forall E, (forall n, PathSigma X MX (E n)) ->
      PathSigma X MX (countable_union E).

Inductive FiniteTrajectoryExpectation
    (X : nat -> Type)
    (MX : forall n, SigmaAlgebra (X n))
    (kappa : forall n,
      MarkovKernel (Prefix X n) (X (S n))
        (PrefixSigma X MX n) (MX (S n)))
    : forall a b, Prefix X a -> (Prefix X b -> R) -> R -> Prop :=
| finite_expectation_refl :
    forall a (x : Prefix X a) (f : Prefix X a -> R),
      FiniteTrajectoryExpectation X MX kappa a a x f (f x)
| finite_expectation_step :
    forall a b (x : Prefix X a) (f : Prefix X b -> R)
      (g : X (S a) -> R),
      MeasurableFunction (MX (S a)) Borel g ->
      Bounded g ->
      (forall y,
        FiniteTrajectoryExpectation X MX kappa
          (S a) b (x, y) f (g y)) ->
      FiniteTrajectoryExpectation X MX kappa a b x f
        (probability_integral (kernel_at (kappa a) x) g).

Theorem ionescu_tulcea_traj :
  forall (X : nat -> Type)
    (MX : forall n, SigmaAlgebra (X n)),
    (forall n, IsSigmaAlgebra (MX n)) ->
    forall (kappa : forall n,
      MarkovKernel (Prefix X n) (X (S n))
        (PrefixSigma X MX n) (MX (S n))),
    exists traj : forall a,
      MarkovKernel (Prefix X a) (Path X)
        (PrefixSigma X MX a) (PathSigma X MX),
      forall (a : nat) (x : Prefix X a) (b : nat)
        (f : Prefix X b -> R),
        (a <= b)%nat ->
        MeasurableFunction (PrefixSigma X MX b) Borel f ->
        Bounded f ->
        exists r : R,
          FiniteTrajectoryExpectation X MX kappa a b x f r /\
          probability_integral (kernel_at (traj a) x)
            (fun omega => f (restrict_path X b omega)) = r.
Admitted.

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q25378690, "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": a sequence of Markov kernels depending
  measurably on each finite history determines a Markov kernel from every
  initial history to infinite trajectories, with the prescribed iterated
  finite-dimensional marginals. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
  imports "HOL.Complex_Main"
begin

type_synonym 'a q25378690_measurable_space = "'a set \<times> 'a set set"
type_synonym 'a q25378690_probability = "'a set \<Rightarrow> real"

definition q25378690_space ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q25378690_space M = fst M"

definition q25378690_sets ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> 'a set set" where
  "q25378690_sets M = snd M"

definition q25378690_sigma_field ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q25378690_sigma_field \<Omega> A \<longleftrightarrow>
    A \<subseteq> Pow \<Omega> \<and>
    {} \<in> A \<and>
    (\<forall>E \<in> A. \<Omega> - E \<in> A) \<and>
    (\<forall>E :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. E n \<in> A) \<longrightarrow> (\<Union>n. E n) \<in> A)"

definition q25378690_measurable_space ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q25378690_measurable_space M \<longleftrightarrow>
    q25378690_sigma_field (q25378690_space M) (q25378690_sets M)"

definition q25378690_generated ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set" where
  "q25378690_generated \<Omega> G =
    \<Inter>{A. q25378690_sigma_field \<Omega> A \<and> G \<subseteq> A}"

definition q25378690_pie ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set" where
  "q25378690_pie I F =
    {x. (\<forall>i \<in> I. x i \<in> F i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i. i \<notin> I \<longrightarrow> x i = undefined)}"

definition q25378690_restrict ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a)" where
  "q25378690_restrict x I =
    (\<lambda>i. if i \<in> I then x i else undefined)"

definition q25378690_update ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a)" where
  "q25378690_update x i y =
    (\<lambda>j. if j = i then y else x j)"

definition q25378690_cylinders ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a q25378690_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set set" where
  "q25378690_cylinders I M =
    {C. \<exists>i \<in> I. \<exists>E \<in> q25378690_sets (M i).
      C = {x \<in> q25378690_pie I
        (\<lambda>j. q25378690_space (M j)). x i \<in> E}}"

definition q25378690_product_space ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a q25378690_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q25378690_measurable_space" where
  "q25378690_product_space I M =
    (q25378690_pie I (\<lambda>i. q25378690_space (M i)),
     q25378690_generated
       (q25378690_pie I (\<lambda>i. q25378690_space (M i)))
       (q25378690_cylinders I M))"

definition q25378690_probability_measure ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     'a q25378690_probability \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q25378690_probability_measure M \<mu> \<longleftrightarrow>
    q25378690_measurable_space M \<and>
    (\<forall>E. \<mu> E = \<mu> (E \<inter> q25378690_space M)) \<and>
    \<mu> {} = 0 \<and>
    \<mu> (q25378690_space M) = 1 \<and>
    (\<forall>E \<in> q25378690_sets M. 0 \<le> \<mu> E \<and> \<mu> E \<le> 1) \<and>
    (\<forall>E :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. E n \<in> q25378690_sets M) \<and>
      (\<forall>i j. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow> E i \<inter> E j = {})
      \<longrightarrow>
      \<mu> (\<Union>n. E n) =
        Sup (range (\<lambda>n. sum (\<lambda>i. \<mu> (E i)) {0..<n})))"

definition q25378690_markov_kernel ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     'b q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b q25378690_probability) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q25378690_markov_kernel A B K \<longleftrightarrow>
    q25378690_measurable_space A \<and>
    q25378690_measurable_space B \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> q25378690_space A.
      q25378690_probability_measure B (K x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>E \<in> q25378690_sets B. \<forall>r :: real.
      {x \<in> q25378690_space A. r < K x E} \<in> q25378690_sets A)"

definition q25378690_nn_integral ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     'a q25378690_probability \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q25378690_nn_integral M \<mu> f =
    Sup {sum
      (\<lambda>r. r * \<mu> {x \<in> q25378690_space M. g x = r})
      (g ` q25378690_space M) |g.
      finite (g ` q25378690_space M) \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> q25378690_space M. 0 \<le> g x \<and> g x \<le> f x) \<and>
      (\<forall>r. {x \<in> q25378690_space M. g x = r}
        \<in> q25378690_sets M)}"

definition q25378690_return ::
    "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a q25378690_probability" where
  "q25378690_return x E = (if x \<in> E then 1 else 0)"

definition q25378690_bind ::
    "'a q25378690_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     'a q25378690_probability \<Rightarrow>
     ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b q25378690_probability) \<Rightarrow>
     'b q25378690_probability" where
  "q25378690_bind M \<mu> K E =
    q25378690_nn_integral M \<mu> (\<lambda>x. K x E)"

definition q25378690_extend ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a q25378690_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     (nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
       'a q25378690_probability) \<Rightarrow>
     nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
     (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) q25378690_probability" where
  "q25378690_extend M \<kappa> n \<omega> E =
    \<kappa> n \<omega>
      {y \<in> q25378690_space (M (Suc n)).
        q25378690_update \<omega> (Suc n) y \<in> E}"

primrec q25378690_partial ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a q25378690_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     (nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
       'a q25378690_probability) \<Rightarrow>
     nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
     (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) q25378690_probability" where
  "q25378690_partial M \<kappa> a 0 \<omega> =
    q25378690_return \<omega>"
| "q25378690_partial M \<kappa> a (Suc m) \<omega> =
    q25378690_bind
      (q25378690_product_space {0..<Suc a + m} M)
      (q25378690_partial M \<kappa> a m \<omega>)
      (q25378690_extend M \<kappa> (a + m))"

definition q25378690_ionescu_tulcea ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a q25378690_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     (nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
       'a q25378690_probability) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q25378690_ionescu_tulcea M \<kappa> \<longleftrightarrow>
    ((\<forall>n. q25378690_measurable_space (M n)) \<and>
     (\<forall>n. q25378690_markov_kernel
      (q25378690_product_space {0..<Suc n} M)
      (M (Suc n)) (\<kappa> n)))
    \<longrightarrow>
    (\<exists>traj ::
      nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
        (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) q25378690_probability.
      (\<forall>a. q25378690_markov_kernel
        (q25378690_product_space {0..<Suc a} M)
        (q25378690_product_space UNIV M) (traj a)) \<and>
      (\<forall>a m \<omega> E.
        \<omega> \<in> q25378690_space
          (q25378690_product_space {0..<Suc a} M) \<and>
        E \<in> q25378690_sets
          (q25378690_product_space {0..<Suc a + m} M)
        \<longrightarrow>
        traj a \<omega>
          {x \<in> q25378690_space (q25378690_product_space UNIV M).
            q25378690_restrict x {0..<Suc a + m} \<in> E} =
        q25378690_partial M \<kappa> a m \<omega> E))"

end

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q25378690,
  "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": a measurable family of Markov kernels on
  successively typed finite trajectories extends to a probability kernel on
  infinite trajectories with the prescribed prefix and transition laws. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let Q25378690_IONESCU_TULCEA_THEOREM =
 `let seq_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        (!s:A->bool. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) in
   let history_sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:(num->A)->bool)
       (events:((num->A)->bool)->bool).
        (!s:(num->A)->bool. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s:(num->A)->bool.
           s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->(num->A)->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:num->A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) in
   let generated_history_events =
      \(carrier:(num->A)->bool)
       (generators:((num->A)->bool)->bool)
       (s:(num->A)->bool).
        !events:((num->A)->bool)->bool.
          history_sigma_algebra carrier events /\
          (!g:(num->A)->bool. g IN generators ==> g IN events)
          ==> s IN events in
   let typed_prefix =
      \(states:num->A->bool) (n:num) (h:num->A).
        !i. i <= n ==> h i IN states i in
   let typed_path =
      \(states:num->A->bool) (x:num->A).
        !i. x i IN states i in
   let prefix_carrier =
      \(states:num->A->bool) (n:num).
        {h:num->A | typed_prefix states n h} in
   let path_carrier =
      \(states:num->A->bool).
        {x:num->A | typed_path states x} in
   let prefix_generators =
      \(states:num->A->bool)
       (state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (n:num).
        {c:(num->A)->bool |
          ?i u.
            i <= n /\
            u IN state_events i /\
            c = {h:num->A |
                   typed_prefix states n h /\ h i IN u}} in
   let path_generators =
      \(states:num->A->bool)
       (state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool).
        {c:(num->A)->bool |
          ?i u.
            u IN state_events i /\
            c = {x:num->A |
                   typed_path states x /\ x i IN u}} in
   let prefix_events =
      \(states:num->A->bool)
       (state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (n:num).
        generated_history_events
          (prefix_carrier states n)
          (prefix_generators states state_events n) in
   let path_events =
      \(states:num->A->bool)
       (state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool).
        generated_history_events
          (path_carrier states)
          (path_generators states state_events) in
   let state_probability_measure =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->real).
        (!s:A->bool. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) /\
        mu {} = &0 /\
        mu carrier = &1 /\
        (!s:A->bool. s IN events ==> &0 <= mu s) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> seq_tends
                 (\N. sum {k:num | k < N} (\k. mu (sets k)))
                 (mu {x:A | ?k. x IN sets k})) in
   let path_probability_measure =
      \(carrier:(num->A)->bool)
       (events:((num->A)->bool)->bool)
       (mu:((num->A)->bool)->real).
        (!s:(num->A)->bool. s IN events ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        {} IN events /\
        carrier IN events /\
        (!s:(num->A)->bool.
           s IN events ==> carrier DIFF s IN events) /\
        (!sets:num->(num->A)->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events)
           ==> {x:num->A | ?n. x IN sets n} IN events) /\
        mu {} = &0 /\
        mu carrier = &1 /\
        (!s:(num->A)->bool. s IN events ==> &0 <= mu s) /\
        (!sets:num->(num->A)->bool.
           (!n. sets n IN events) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> seq_tends
                 (\N. sum {k:num | k < N} (\k. mu (sets k)))
                 (mu {x:num->A | ?k. x IN sets k})) in
   let history_measurable_real =
      \(carrier:(num->A)->bool)
       (events:((num->A)->bool)->bool)
       (f:(num->A)->real).
        !r. {x:num->A | x IN carrier /\ f x <= r} IN events in
   let unit_interval_integral =
      \(carrier:(num->A)->bool)
       (events:((num->A)->bool)->bool)
       (mu:((num->A)->bool)->real)
       (f:(num->A)->real)
       (z:real).
        history_measurable_real carrier events f /\
        (!x:num->A. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= f x /\ f x <= &1) /\
        seq_tends
          (\m. inv(&(2 EXP m)) *
               sum {k:num | 1 <= k /\ k <= 2 EXP m}
                 (\k. mu {x:num->A |
                            x IN carrier /\
                            &k / &(2 EXP m) <= f x}))
          z in
   let markov_kernel_family =
      \(states:num->A->bool)
       (state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (kernel:num->(num->A)->(A->bool)->real).
        (!n. sigma_algebra (states n) (state_events n)) /\
        (!m n x:A.
           x IN states m /\ x IN states n ==> m = n) /\
        (!n h:num->A.
           typed_prefix states n h
           ==> state_probability_measure
                 (states (SUC n))
                 (state_events (SUC n))
                 (kernel n h)) /\
        (!n u.
           u IN state_events (SUC n)
           ==> history_measurable_real
                 (prefix_carrier states n)
                 (prefix_events states state_events n)
                 (\h:num->A. kernel n h u)) /\
        (!n h g:num->A.
           typed_prefix states n h /\
           typed_prefix states n g /\
           (!i. i <= n ==> h i = g i)
           ==> !u:A->bool. kernel n h u = kernel n g u) in
   let trajectory_kernel =
      \(states:num->A->bool)
       (state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool)
       (kernel:num->(num->A)->(A->bool)->real)
       (a:num)
       (eta:(num->A)->((num->A)->bool)->real).
        (!h:num->A.
           typed_prefix states a h
           ==> path_probability_measure
                 (path_carrier states)
                 (path_events states state_events)
                 (eta h)) /\
        (!w:(num->A)->bool.
           w IN path_events states state_events
           ==> history_measurable_real
                 (prefix_carrier states a)
                 (prefix_events states state_events a)
                 (\h:num->A. eta h w)) /\
        (!h g:num->A.
           typed_prefix states a h /\
           typed_prefix states a g /\
           (!i. i <= a ==> h i = g i)
           ==> !w:(num->A)->bool. eta h w = eta g w) /\
        (!h:num->A.
           typed_prefix states a h
           ==> !c:(num->A)->bool.
                 c IN prefix_events states state_events a
                 ==> eta h
                       {x:num->A |
                          typed_path states x /\ x IN c} =
                     (if h IN c then &1 else &0)) /\
        (!h:num->A.
           typed_prefix states a h
           ==> !n c u.
                 a <= n /\
                 c IN prefix_events states state_events n /\
                 u IN state_events (SUC n)
                 ==> unit_interval_integral
                       (path_carrier states)
                       (path_events states state_events)
                       (eta h)
                       (\x:num->A.
                          if x IN c then kernel n x u else &0)
                       (eta h
                         {x:num->A |
                            typed_path states x /\
                            x IN c /\
                            x (SUC n) IN u})) in
   !states:num->A->bool
    state_events:num->(A->bool)->bool
    kernel:num->(num->A)->(A->bool)->real.
      markov_kernel_family states state_events kernel
      ==> ?traj:num->(num->A)->((num->A)->bool)->real.
            !a. trajectory_kernel
                  states state_events kernel a (traj a)`;;

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q25378690,
;; "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": arbitrary measurable state spaces and a family of
;; Markov transition kernels determine a Markov kernel on infinite trajectories
;; whose every finite-coordinate marginal is the iterated finite trajectory.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; All mathematical carriers, sets, functions, measures, and kernels below are
;; unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The predicates impose the full sigma-algebra,
;; countable-additivity, measurability, dependent-product, and finite-iteration
;; interfaces used by the source.  No carrier is enumerated or made finite.

(defstub q25378690-domain-member-p (domain object) t)
(defstub q25378690-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q25378690-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q25378690-sequence-at (sequence index) t)
(defstub q25378690-measurable-set-p (sigma set) t)

(defstub q25378690-ennreal-member-p (ennreal value) t)
(defstub q25378690-ennreal-zero (ennreal) t)
(defstub q25378690-ennreal-one (ennreal) t)
(defstub q25378690-ennreal-add (ennreal left right) t)
(defstub q25378690-ennreal-multiply (ennreal left right) t)
(defstub q25378690-ennreal-leq (ennreal left right) t)

(defstub q25378690-empty-set (domain) t)
(defstub q25378690-full-set (domain) t)
(defstub q25378690-complement-set (domain set) t)
(defstub q25378690-countable-union-set (domain sequence) t)
(defstub q25378690-upper-preimage-set
  (ennreal domain function threshold) t)

(defstub q25378690-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q25378690-lintegral-value
  (lintegral ennreal domain sigma measure function) t)

(defstub q25378690-state-domain (spaces index) t)
(defstub q25378690-state-sigma (spaces index) t)
(defstub q25378690-history-domain (spaces last-index) t)
(defstub q25378690-history-sigma (spaces last-index) t)
(defstub q25378690-trajectory-domain (spaces) t)
(defstub q25378690-trajectory-sigma (spaces) t)

(defstub q25378690-history-coordinate
  (spaces last-index history index) t)
(defstub q25378690-trajectory-coordinate
  (spaces trajectory index) t)
(defstub q25378690-history-restrict
  (spaces from-index to-index history) t)
(defstub q25378690-trajectory-restrict
  (spaces to-index trajectory) t)
(defstub q25378690-history-extend
  (spaces last-index history next-state) t)

(defstub q25378690-history-coordinate-cylinder
  (spaces last-index index state-set) t)
(defstub q25378690-trajectory-coordinate-cylinder
  (spaces index state-set) t)
(defstub q25378690-prefix-cylinder
  (spaces last-index history-set) t)
(defstub q25378690-step-section-set
  (spaces last-index history-set history) t)

(defstub q25378690-kernel-measure (kernel input) t)
(defstub q25378690-kernel-mass-function (kernel event) t)
(defstub q25378690-transition-kernel (transitions index) t)
(defstub q25378690-partial-kernel
  (spaces transitions start-index last-index) t)
(defstub q25378690-step-integrand
  (spaces transitions last-index history-set) t)
(defstub q25378690-step-measure
  (spaces transitions lintegral last-index history-measure) t)

;; Extended nonnegative real arithmetic, including countable sums as suprema
;; of finite partial sums.

(defun-sk q25378690-ennreal-order-laws-p (ennreal)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal x)
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal y)
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal z))
     (and
      (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal x x)
      (implies
       (and
        (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal x y)
        (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal y x))
       (equal x y))
      (implies
       (and
        (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal x y)
        (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal y z))
       (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal x z))
      (or
       (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal x y)
       (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal y x))))))

(defun-sk q25378690-ennreal-operation-laws-p (ennreal)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal x)
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal y)
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal z))
     (let ((zero (q25378690-ennreal-zero ennreal))
           (one (q25378690-ennreal-one ennreal)))
       (and
        (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
         ennreal (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal x y))
        (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
         ennreal (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x y))
        (equal
         (q25378690-ennreal-add
          ennreal (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal x y) z)
         (q25378690-ennreal-add
          ennreal x (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal y z)))
        (equal
         (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal x y)
         (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal y x))
        (equal (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q25378690-ennreal-multiply
          ennreal (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x y) z)
         (q25378690-ennreal-multiply
          ennreal x (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal y z)))
        (equal
         (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x y)
         (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal y x))
        (equal (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x one) x)
        (equal (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x zero) zero)
        (equal
         (q25378690-ennreal-multiply
          ennreal x (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal y z))
         (q25378690-ennreal-add
          ennreal
          (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x y)
          (q25378690-ennreal-multiply ennreal x z)))
        (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal zero x)
        (implies
         (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal x y)
         (q25378690-ennreal-leq
          ennreal
          (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal x z)
          (q25378690-ennreal-add ennreal y z))))))))

(defun q25378690-ennreal-structure-p (ennreal)
  (and
   (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
    ennreal (q25378690-ennreal-zero ennreal))
   (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
    ennreal (q25378690-ennreal-one ennreal))
   (not
    (equal
     (q25378690-ennreal-zero ennreal)
     (q25378690-ennreal-one ennreal)))
   (q25378690-ennreal-order-laws-p ennreal)
   (q25378690-ennreal-operation-laws-p ennreal)))

(defun q25378690-value-prefix-sum
    (ennreal value-function count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q25378690-ennreal-zero ennreal)
    (q25378690-ennreal-add
     ennreal
     (q25378690-value-prefix-sum
      ennreal value-function (- count 1))
     (q25378690-function-at value-function (- count 1)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-prefix-sums-bounded-p
    (ennreal value-function bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q25378690-ennreal-leq
      ennreal
      (q25378690-value-prefix-sum
       ennreal value-function count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q25378690-countable-sum-p
    (ennreal value-function total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal total)
     (q25378690-prefix-sums-bounded-p
      ennreal value-function total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal bound)
       (q25378690-prefix-sums-bounded-p
        ennreal value-function bound))
      (q25378690-ennreal-leq ennreal total bound)))))

;; Arbitrary sets and sigma algebras.

(defun-sk q25378690-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q25378690-set-member-p set x)
     (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q25378690-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q25378690-set-member-p left x)
      (q25378690-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q25378690-valid-set-p
      domain (q25378690-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-measurable-sequence-p (sigma sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q25378690-measurable-set-p
      sigma (q25378690-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-pairwise-disjoint-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n)))
     (not
      (and
       (q25378690-set-member-p
        (q25378690-sequence-at sequence m) x)
       (q25378690-set-member-p
        (q25378690-sequence-at sequence n) x))))))

(defun-sk q25378690-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q25378690-set-member-p
      (q25378690-sequence-at sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q25378690-basic-set-constructor-laws-p (domain)
  (forall (set sequence x)
    (and
     (iff
      (q25378690-set-member-p
       (q25378690-empty-set domain) x)
      nil)
     (iff
      (q25378690-set-member-p
       (q25378690-full-set domain) x)
      (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x))
     (implies
      (q25378690-valid-set-p domain set)
      (iff
       (q25378690-set-member-p
        (q25378690-complement-set domain set) x)
       (and
        (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x)
        (not (q25378690-set-member-p set x)))))
     (implies
      (q25378690-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (iff
       (q25378690-set-member-p
        (q25378690-countable-union-set domain sequence) x)
       (and
        (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x)
        (q25378690-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))))

(defun-sk q25378690-sigma-extensional-p (domain sigma)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q25378690-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q25378690-measurable-set-p sigma left)
      (q25378690-measurable-set-p sigma right)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-sigma-members-valid-p (domain sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q25378690-measurable-set-p sigma set)
     (q25378690-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q25378690-sigma-complements-p (domain sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q25378690-measurable-set-p sigma set)
     (q25378690-measurable-set-p
      sigma (q25378690-complement-set domain set)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-sigma-countable-unions-p (domain sigma)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q25378690-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q25378690-measurable-sequence-p sigma sequence))
     (q25378690-measurable-set-p
      sigma
      (q25378690-countable-union-set domain sequence)))))

(defun q25378690-sigma-algebra-p (domain sigma)
  (and
   (q25378690-basic-set-constructor-laws-p domain)
   (q25378690-sigma-extensional-p domain sigma)
   (q25378690-sigma-members-valid-p domain sigma)
   (q25378690-measurable-set-p
    sigma (q25378690-empty-set domain))
   (q25378690-sigma-complements-p domain sigma)
   (q25378690-sigma-countable-unions-p domain sigma)))

;; Countably additive probability measures.

(defstub q25378690-measure-sequence-values
  (measure sequence) t)

(defun-sk q25378690-measure-sequence-values-laws-p ()
  (forall (measure sequence n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (q25378690-function-at
       (q25378690-measure-sequence-values measure sequence) n)
      (q25378690-measure-value
       measure (q25378690-sequence-at sequence n))))))

(defun-sk q25378690-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q25378690-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q25378690-measure-value measure left)
      (q25378690-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-measure-values-p
    (ennreal sigma measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q25378690-measurable-set-p sigma set)
     (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
      ennreal (q25378690-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-countably-additive-p
    (ennreal domain sigma measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q25378690-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q25378690-measurable-sequence-p sigma sequence)
      (q25378690-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence))
     (q25378690-countable-sum-p
      ennreal
      (q25378690-measure-sequence-values measure sequence)
      (q25378690-measure-value
       measure
       (q25378690-countable-union-set domain sequence))))))

(defun q25378690-probability-measure-p
    (ennreal domain sigma measure)
  (and
   (q25378690-sigma-algebra-p domain sigma)
   (q25378690-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q25378690-measure-values-p ennreal sigma measure)
   (equal
    (q25378690-measure-value
     measure (q25378690-empty-set domain))
    (q25378690-ennreal-zero ennreal))
   (q25378690-countably-additive-p
    ennreal domain sigma measure)
   (equal
    (q25378690-measure-value
     measure (q25378690-full-set domain))
    (q25378690-ennreal-one ennreal))))

;; Measurable ENNReal-valued functions and a lower-Lebesgue-integral interface.

(defun-sk q25378690-ennreal-function-p
    (ennreal domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
      ennreal (q25378690-function-at function x)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-upper-preimage-laws-p
    (ennreal domain)
  (forall (function threshold x)
    (iff
     (q25378690-set-member-p
      (q25378690-upper-preimage-set
       ennreal domain function threshold)
      x)
     (and
      (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (q25378690-ennreal-leq
        ennreal
        (q25378690-function-at function x)
        threshold))))))

(defun-sk q25378690-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    (ennreal domain sigma function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q25378690-ennreal-function-p ennreal domain function)
     (implies
      (q25378690-ennreal-member-p ennreal threshold)
      (q25378690-measurable-set-p
       sigma
       (q25378690-upper-preimage-set
        ennreal domain function threshold))))))

(defun-sk q25378690-lintegral-values-p
    (lintegral ennreal domain sigma measure)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q25378690-measurable-ennreal-function-p
      ennreal domain sigma function)
     (q25378690-ennreal-member-p
      ennreal
      (q25378690-lintegral-value
       lintegral ennreal domain sigma measure function)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-functions-pointwise-leq-p
    (ennreal domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q25378690-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q25378690-ennreal-leq
      ennreal
      (q25378690-function-at left x)
      (q25378690-function-at right x)))))

(defun-sk q25378690-lintegral-monotone-p
    (lintegral ennreal domain sigma measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q25378690-measurable-ennreal-function-p
       ennreal domain sigma left)
      (q25378690-measurable-ennreal-function-p
       ennreal domain sigma right)
      (q25378690-functions-pointwise-leq-p
       ennreal domain left right))
     (q25378690-ennreal-leq
