  Q25378690, "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": a sequence of Markov kernels on
  successive measurable state spaces determines a Markov kernel on infinite
  trajectories with the recursively specified finite marginals. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;
open probabilityTheory;

val q25378690_history_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_history_carrier_def",
  ``q25378690_history_carrier
      (spaces : num -> 'x algebra) (n : num) =
      {h : (num -> 'x) | !i. i <= n ==> h i IN space (spaces i)}``);

val q25378690_path_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_path_carrier_def",
  ``q25378690_path_carrier (spaces : num -> 'x algebra) =
      {x : (num -> 'x) | !i. x i IN space (spaces i)}``);

val q25378690_history_space_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_history_space_def",
  ``q25378690_history_space
      (spaces : num -> 'x algebra) (n : num) =
      sigma
        (q25378690_history_carrier spaces n)
        {c : (num -> 'x) set |
          ?i s.
            i <= n /\
            s IN subsets (spaces i) /\
            c =
              {h |
                h IN q25378690_history_carrier spaces n /\
                h i IN s}}``);

val q25378690_path_space_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_path_space_def",
  ``q25378690_path_space (spaces : num -> 'x algebra) =
      sigma
        (q25378690_path_carrier spaces)
        {c : (num -> 'x) set |
          ?i s.
            s IN subsets (spaces i) /\
            c =
              {x |
                x IN q25378690_path_carrier spaces /\
                x i IN s}}``);

val q25378690_same_history_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_same_history_def",
  ``q25378690_same_history (n : num)
      (h : num -> 'x) (h' : num -> 'x) <=>
      !i. i <= n ==> h i = h' i``);

val q25378690_update_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_update_def",
  ``q25378690_update (h : num -> 'x) (n : num) (y : 'x) =
      \i. if i = n then y else h i``);

val q25378690_markov_kernel_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_markov_kernel_def",
  ``q25378690_markov_kernel
      (source : 'a algebra) (target : 'b algebra)
      (k : 'a -> 'b m_space) <=>
      sigma_algebra source /\
      sigma_algebra target /\
      (!x.
        x IN space source ==>
        prob_space (k x) /\
        m_space (k x) = space target /\
        measurable_sets (k x) = subsets target) /\
      (!s.
        s IN subsets target ==>
        (\x. measure (k x) s) IN measurable source Borel)``);

val q25378690_history_extensional_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_history_extensional_def",
  ``q25378690_history_extensional
      (spaces : num -> 'x algebra) (n : num)
      (k : (num -> 'x) -> 'y) <=>
      !h h'.
        h IN q25378690_history_carrier spaces n /\
        h' IN q25378690_history_carrier spaces n /\
        q25378690_same_history n h h'
        ==>
        k h = k h'``);

val q25378690_finite_family_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_finite_family_def",
  ``q25378690_finite_family
      (spaces : num -> 'x algebra)
      (kappa : num -> (num -> 'x) -> 'x m_space)
      (a : num) (x : num -> 'x)
      (mu : num -> (num -> 'x) m_space) <=>
      (!b.
        prob_space (mu b) /\
        m_space (mu b) =
          q25378690_history_carrier spaces b /\
        measurable_sets (mu b) =
          subsets (q25378690_history_space spaces b)) /\
      (!b s.
        b <= a /\
        s IN subsets (q25378690_history_space spaces b)
        ==>
        measure (mu b) s =
          if x IN s then 1 else 0) /\
      (!b s.
        a <= b /\
        s IN subsets (q25378690_history_space spaces (b + 1))
        ==>
        measure (mu (b + 1)) s =
          pos_fn_integral
            (mu b)
            (\h.
              measure
                (kappa b h)
                {y |
                  y IN space (spaces (b + 1)) /\
                  q25378690_update h (b + 1) y IN s}))``);

val q25378690_traj_witness_def = new_definition (
  "q25378690_traj_witness_def",
  ``q25378690_traj_witness
      (spaces : num -> 'x algebra)
      (kappa : num -> (num -> 'x) -> 'x m_space)
      (traj : num -> (num -> 'x) -> (num -> 'x) m_space) <=>
      !a.
        q25378690_markov_kernel
          (q25378690_history_space spaces a)
          (q25378690_path_space spaces)
          (traj a) /\
        q25378690_history_extensional spaces a (traj a) /\
        !x.
          x IN q25378690_history_carrier spaces a ==>
          ?mu : num -> (num -> 'x) m_space.
            q25378690_finite_family spaces kappa a x mu /\
            !b s.
              s IN subsets (q25378690_history_space spaces b)
              ==>
              distr (traj a x) I s = measure (mu b) s``);

val ionescu_tulcea_theorem =
  ``!(spaces : num -> 'x algebra)
      (kappa : num -> (num -> 'x) -> 'x m_space).
      (!n. sigma_algebra (spaces n)) /\
      (!n.
        q25378690_markov_kernel
          (q25378690_history_space spaces n)
          (spaces (n + 1))
          (kappa n)) /\
      (!n.
        q25378690_history_extensional spaces n (kappa n))
      ==>
      ?traj : num -> (num -> 'x) -> (num -> 'x) m_space.
        q25378690_traj_witness spaces kappa traj``;

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q25378690
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q25378690), "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": an
  arbitrary sequence of history-dependent Markov kernels determines, from
  every finite initial history, a Markov kernel on infinite dependent
  trajectories with the prescribed iterated finite-dimensional marginals.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  S is a sequence of sigma-algebras, one for each natural-numbered state
  space. Q25378690Prefix and Q25378690Path are SetMM dependent function
  spaces. Their sigma-algebras are generated by all measurable coordinate
  cylinders, so no common carrier or finite-table encoding is imposed.

  Q25378690Markov S T K says that K maps every point of the source measurable
  space S to a probability measure on T and that evaluation on every
  T-measurable set is S-measurable. Q25378690LIntegral is the lower Lebesgue
  integral, explicitly defined through extended-nonnegative simple functions.

  Q25378690FiniteLaws S K a x F states the finite-prefix recursion. Through
  cutoff a, F is the Dirac law at the corresponding restriction of the input
  history x. Each later law is obtained by integrating the next kernel K(b)
  against F(b). The final assertion internally quantifies a trajectory kernel
  and requires all its finite-prefix marginals to equal these recursive laws.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q25378690Prefix Q25378690Path
   Q25378690PrefixSigma Q25378690PathSigma
   Q25378690Restrict Q25378690Append Q25378690ENNSigma
   Q25378690Markov Q25378690Simple
   Q25378690SimpleIntegral Q25378690LIntegral
   Q25378690FiniteLaws $.

q25378690-prefix-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690Prefix S n ) $.
q25378690-path-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690Path S ) $.
q25378690-prefix-sigma-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S n ) $.
q25378690-path-sigma-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690PathSigma S ) $.
q25378690-restrict-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690Restrict x n ) $.
q25378690-append-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690Append h n y ) $.
q25378690-enn-sigma-syntax
  $a class Q25378690ENNSigma $.
q25378690-markov-syntax
  $a wff ( Q25378690Markov S T K ) $.
q25378690-simple-syntax
  $a wff ( Q25378690Simple M G ) $.
q25378690-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q25378690-lintegral-syntax
  $a class ( Q25378690LIntegral M H ) $.
q25378690-finite-laws-syntax
  $a wff ( Q25378690FiniteLaws S K a x F ) $.

${
  $d S i n $.

  q25378690-prefix-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690Prefix S n )
    =
    X_ i e. ( 0 ... n ) U. ( S ` i )
  $.
$}

${
  $d S i $.

  q25378690-path-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690Path S )
    =
    X_ i e. NN0 U. ( S ` i )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B S i n x $.

  q25378690-prefix-sigma-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S n )
    =
    (
      sigaGen `
      { A e. ~P ( Q25378690Prefix S n ) |
        E. i e. ( 0 ... n )
          E. B e. ( S ` i )
            A =
            { x e. ( Q25378690Prefix S n ) |
              ( x ` i ) e. B
            }
      }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B S i x $.

  q25378690-path-sigma-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690PathSigma S )
    =
    (
      sigaGen `
      { A e. ~P ( Q25378690Path S ) |
        E. i e. NN0
          E. B e. ( S ` i )
            A =
            { x e. ( Q25378690Path S ) |
              ( x ` i ) e. B
            }
      }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d n x $.

  q25378690-restrict-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690Restrict x n )
    =
    ( x |` ( 0 ... n ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d h n y $.

  q25378690-append-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690Append h n y )
    =
    ( h u. { <. ( n + 1 ) , y >. } )
  $.
$}

q25378690-enn-sigma-definition $a |-
  Q25378690ENNSigma
  =
  (
    sigaGen `
    ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
  )
$.

${
  $d B K S T x $.

  q25378690-markov-definition $a |- (
    ( Q25378690Markov S T K )
    <->
    (
      K : U. S --> Prob
      /\
      (
        A. x e. U. S
          dom ( K ` x ) = T
        /\
        A. B e. T
          ( x e. U. S |-> ( ( K ` x ) ` B ) )
          e. ( S MblFnM Q25378690ENNSigma )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q25378690-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q25378690Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e. ( dom M MblFnM Q25378690ENNSigma )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q25378690-simple-integral-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690SimpleIntegral M G )
    =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M u v $.

  q25378690-lintegral-definition $a |-
    ( Q25378690LIntegral M H )
    =
    sup
    (
      { v e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q25378690Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. u e. U. dom M
                ( G ` u ) <_ ( H ` u )
              /\
              v = ( Q25378690SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d B F K S a b h x y $.
  $d B F K S a b x y $.
  $d B F K S b h x y $.
  $d B F S a b x $.

  q25378690-finite-laws-definition $a |- (
    ( Q25378690FiniteLaws S K a x F )
    <->
    (
      F : NN0 --> Prob
      /\
      (
        A. b e. NN0
          dom ( F ` b ) = ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S b )
        /\
        (
          A. b e. ( 0 ... a )
            A. B e. ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S b )
              ( ( F ` b ) ` B )
              =
              if
              (
                ( Q25378690Restrict x b ) e. B ,
                1 ,
                0
              )
          /\
          A. b e. NN0
            (
              a <_ b
              ->
              A. B e. ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S ( b + 1 ) )
                ( ( F ` ( b + 1 ) ) ` B )
                =
                (
                  Q25378690LIntegral
                  ( F ` b )
                  (
                    h e. ( Q25378690Prefix S b ) |->
                    (
                      ( ( K ` b ) ` h )
                      `
                      { y e. U. ( S ` ( b + 1 ) ) |
                        ( Q25378690Append h b y ) e. B
                      }
                    )
                  )
                )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B F K S T a b n x y $.
  $d B F K S T a b x y $.
  $d B F K S T b x y $.
  $d B K S T a n x y $.
  $d B K S T a x y $.
  $d K S T a n $.

  thousand-theorems-q25378690-ionescu-tulcea-theorem $a |-
    A. S
      A. K
        (
          (
            S : NN0 --> U. ran sigAlgebra
            /\
            (
              K Fn NN0
              /\
              A. n e. NN0
                (
                  Q25378690Markov
                  ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S n )
                  ( S ` ( n + 1 ) )
                  ( K ` n )
                )
            )
          )
          ->
          A. a e. NN0
            E. T
              (
                (
                  Q25378690Markov
                  ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S a )
                  ( Q25378690PathSigma S )
                  T
                )
                /\
                A. x e. ( Q25378690Prefix S a )
                  E. F
                    (
                      ( Q25378690FiniteLaws S K a x F )
                      /\
                      A. b e. NN0
                        A. B e. ( Q25378690PrefixSigma S b )
                          (
                            ( T ` x )
                            `
                            { y e. ( Q25378690Path S ) |
                              ( Q25378690Restrict y b ) e. B
                            }
                          )
                          =
                          ( ( F ` b ) ` B )
                    )
              )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q25378690,
:: "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": measurable Markov kernels on arbitrary successive
:: state spaces determine a probability kernel on infinite trajectories with
:: the prescribed finite-prefix transition laws. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE6, SUBSET_1,
      PARTFUN1, TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ZFMISC_1, CARD_1,
      CARD_3, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, SETFAM_1, PBOOLE, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2,
      MESFUNC5, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, VALUED_0, XCMPLX_0,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, CARD_3,
      NUMBERS, NAT_1, XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, VALUED_0,
      PBOOLE, PROB_1, PROB_2, MEASURE1, MEASURE6, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1,
      MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_2;
 constructors TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, NAT_1, PROB_1, PROB_2, MEASURE1,
      MEASURE6, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, SUPINF_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELSET_1,
      ORDINAL1, CARD_1, CARD_3, NAT_1, MEMBERED, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
      XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3, VALUED_0, PARTFUN1, MEASURE1, PROB_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, ARITHM, REAL;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PROB_1,
      MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5;
 equalities TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PROB_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for X being Function,
      S,F,C being Function,
      H being SigmaField of product X,
      D being Subset-Family of product X,
      K being Function,
      a being Nat
  st
    dom X = NAT &
    dom S = NAT &
    dom F = NAT &
    dom C = NAT &
    dom K = NAT &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex Xn being set,
         Sn being SigmaField of Xn,
         Fn being SigmaField of product (X|(n+1)),
         Cn being Subset-Family of product (X|(n+1))
      st
        Xn = X.n &
        Sn = S.n &
        Fn = F.n &
        Cn = C.n &
        Cn c= Fn &
        (for Gn being SigmaField of product (X|(n+1))
          st Cn c= Gn holds Fn c= Gn) &
        (for E being Subset of product (X|(n+1)) holds
          E in Cn iff
          ex i being Nat,
             Xi being set,
             Si being SigmaField of Xi,
             A being Element of Si
          st
            i <= n &
            Xi = X.i &
            Si = S.i &
            (for z being Element of product (X|(n+1)) holds
              z in E iff
              z in product (X|(n+1)) & z.i in A))) &
    D c= H &
    (for G being SigmaField of product X st D c= G holds H c= G) &
    (for E being Subset of product X holds
      E in D iff
      ex i being Nat,
         Xi being set,
         Si being SigmaField of Xi,
         A being Element of Si
      st
        Xi = X.i &
        Si = S.i &
        (for z being Element of product X holds
          z in E iff z in product X & z.i in A)) &
    (for n being Nat holds
      ex Xn1 being set,
         Sn1 being SigmaField of Xn1,
         Fn being SigmaField of product (X|(n+1)),
         Kn being Function of product (X|(n+1)),Funcs(Sn1,ExtREAL)
      st
        Xn1 = X.(n+1) &
        Sn1 = S.(n+1) &
        Fn = F.n &
        Kn = K.n &
        (for x being set st x in product (X|(n+1)) holds
          ex P being sigma_Measure of Sn1 st P = Kn.x & P.Xn1 = 1) &
        (for A being Element of Sn1 holds
          ex g being PartFunc of product (X|(n+1)),ExtREAL
          st
            dom g = product (X|(n+1)) &
            (for r being Element of REAL holds
              ex E being Element of Fn st
                for y being Element of product (X|(n+1)) holds
                  y in E iff
                  y in product (X|(n+1)) & g.y < r) &
            (for x being set,
                 P being sigma_Measure of Sn1
              st x in product (X|(n+1)) & P = Kn.x
              holds g.x = P.A)))
  holds
    ex Fa being SigmaField of product (X|(a+1)),
       T being Function of product (X|(a+1)),Funcs(H,ExtREAL)
    st
      Fa = F.a &
      (for x being set st x in product (X|(a+1)) holds
        ex Q being sigma_Measure of H
        st Q = T.x & Q.(product X) = 1) &
      (for A being Element of H holds
        ex g being PartFunc of product (X|(a+1)),ExtREAL
        st
          dom g = product (X|(a+1)) &
          (for r being Element of REAL holds
            ex E being Element of Fa st
              for y being Element of product (X|(a+1)) holds
                y in E iff
                y in product (X|(a+1)) & g.y < r) &
          (for x being set,
               Q being sigma_Measure of H
            st x in product (X|(a+1)) & Q = T.x
            holds g.x = Q.A)) &
      (for x being Function st x in product (X|(a+1)) holds
        ex M being Function st
          dom M = NAT &
          (for n being Nat,
               Fn being SigmaField of product (X|(n+1))
            st Fn = F.n
            holds ex Pn being sigma_Measure of Fn
              st Pn = M.n & Pn.(product (X|(n+1))) = 1) &
          (for n being Nat,
               Fn being SigmaField of product (X|(n+1)),
               Pn being sigma_Measure of Fn,
               A being Element of Fn
            st n <= a & Fn = F.n & Pn = M.n
            holds
              (x|(n+1) in A implies Pn.A = 1) &
              (not x|(n+1) in A implies Pn.A = 0)) &
          (for n being Nat,
               Y being non empty set,
               Xn1 being set,
               Sn1 being SigmaField of Xn1,
               Fn being SigmaField of Y,
               Fn1 being SigmaField of product (X|(n+2)),
               Kn being Function of product (X|(n+1)),Funcs(Sn1,ExtREAL),
               Pn being sigma_Measure of Fn,
               Pn1 being sigma_Measure of Fn1,
               B being Element of Fn,
               A being Element of Sn1,
               E being Element of Fn1,
               g being PartFunc of Y,ExtREAL
            st
              a <= n &
              Y = product (X|(n+1)) &
              Xn1 = X.(n+1) &
              Sn1 = S.(n+1) &
              Fn = F.n &
              Fn1 = F.(n+1) &
              Kn = K.n &
              Pn = M.n &
              Pn1 = M.(n+1) &
              (for z being Element of product (X|(n+2)) holds
                z in E iff
                z in product (X|(n+2)) &
                z|(n+1) in B & z.(n+1) in A) &
              dom g = Y &
              g is nonnegative &
              (for y being Element of Y,
                   P being sigma_Measure of Sn1
                st P = Kn.y
                holds g.y = P.A)
            holds Pn1.E = integral+(Pn,g|B)) &
          (for n being Nat,
               Fn being SigmaField of product (X|(n+1)),
               Pn being sigma_Measure of Fn,
               Q being sigma_Measure of H,
               A being Element of Fn,
               E being Element of H
            st
              Fn = F.n &
              Pn = M.n &
              Q = T.x &
              (for z being Element of product X holds
                z in E iff
                z in product X & z|(n+1) in A)
            holds Q.E = Pn.A))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q25378690_ionescu_tulcea_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q25378690,
% "Ionescu-Tulcea theorem": iterating measurable Markov kernels yields a
% measurable probability kernel on infinite trajectories with the prescribed
% finite-dimensional distributions. This file contains no proof.

ionescu_tulcea_theorem_Q25378690[S: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  state_event: TYPE = [S -> bool]
  state_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> state_event]
  state_event_family: TYPE = [nat -> state_event]
  state_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [state_event -> bool]
  state_sigma_family: TYPE = [nat -> state_sigma_algebra]
  state_family: TYPE = [nat -> state_event]

  trajectory: TYPE = [nat -> S]
  trajectory_event: TYPE = [trajectory -> bool]
  trajectory_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> trajectory_event]
  trajectory_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [trajectory_event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_state_function: TYPE = [S -> measure_value]

  state_measure: TYPE = [state_event -> measure_value]
  path_measure: TYPE = [trajectory_event -> measure_value]
  state_kernel_family: TYPE =
    [nat -> [trajectory -> state_measure]]
  path_kernel: TYPE = [trajectory -> path_measure]
  path_kernel_family: TYPE = [nat -> path_kernel]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  one_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 1 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_is_one(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 1

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  empty_state_event: state_event =
    LAMBDA (value: S): FALSE

  state_complement(
      domain, E: state_event): state_event =
    LAMBDA (value: S):
      domain(value) AND NOT E(value)

  state_countable_union(
      domain: state_event,
      events: state_event_sequence): state_event =
    LAMBDA (value: S):
      domain(value)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(value)

  state_event_subset(E, F: state_event): bool =
    FORALL (value: S):
      E(value) IMPLIES F(value)

  state_pairwise_disjoint(
      domain: state_event,
      events: state_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (value: S):
          domain(value) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(value)
              AND events(right_index)(value))

  is_state_sigma_algebra(
      domain: state_event,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: state_event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES state_event_subset(E, domain))
      AND Sigma(domain)
      AND (FORALL (E: state_event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          Sigma(state_complement(domain, E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: state_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES
            Sigma(state_countable_union(domain, events)))

  is_state_measure(
      domain: state_event,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      M: state_measure): bool =
    is_state_sigma_algebra(domain, Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_state_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: state_event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: state_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND state_pairwise_disjoint(domain, events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(state_countable_union(domain, events))))

  is_state_probability_measure(
      domain: state_event,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      M: state_measure): bool =
    is_state_measure(domain, Sigma, M)
      AND measure_value_is_one(M(domain))

  valid_prefix(
      fiber: state_family,
      last_index: nat,
      x: trajectory): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= last_index IMPLIES fiber(index)(x(index))

  valid_path(
      fiber: state_family,
      x: trajectory): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat): fiber(index)(x(index))

  prefix_equivalent(
      last_index: nat,
      x, y: trajectory): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= last_index IMPLIES x(index) = y(index)

  prefix_domain(
      fiber: state_family,
      last_index: nat): trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
      valid_prefix(fiber, last_index, x)

  path_domain(fiber: state_family): trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory): valid_path(fiber, x)

  empty_trajectory_event: trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory): FALSE

  trajectory_complement(
      domain, E: trajectory_event): trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
      domain(x) AND NOT E(x)

  trajectory_countable_union(
      domain: trajectory_event,
      events: trajectory_event_sequence):
      trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
      domain(x)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  trajectory_event_subset(
      E, F: trajectory_event): bool =
    FORALL (x: trajectory):
      E(x) IMPLIES F(x)

  trajectory_pairwise_disjoint(
      domain: trajectory_event,
      events: trajectory_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: trajectory):
          domain(x) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(x)
              AND events(right_index)(x))

  is_trajectory_sigma_algebra(
      domain: trajectory_event,
      Sigma: trajectory_sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: trajectory_event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES trajectory_event_subset(E, domain))
      AND Sigma(domain)
      AND (FORALL (E: trajectory_event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          Sigma(trajectory_complement(domain, E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: trajectory_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES
            Sigma(trajectory_countable_union(domain, events)))

  prefix_coordinate_event(
      fiber: state_family,
      last_index, coordinate: nat,
      E: state_event): trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
      valid_prefix(fiber, last_index, x)
        AND E(x(coordinate))

  path_coordinate_event(
      fiber: state_family,
      coordinate: nat,
      E: state_event): trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
      valid_path(fiber, x)
        AND E(x(coordinate))

  contains_prefix_coordinate_generators(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      last_index: nat,
      Sigma: trajectory_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (coordinate: nat), (E: state_event):
      coordinate <= last_index
        AND fiber_sigma(coordinate)(E)
      IMPLIES
        Sigma(
          prefix_coordinate_event(
            fiber, last_index, coordinate, E))

  contains_path_coordinate_generators(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      Sigma: trajectory_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (coordinate: nat), (E: state_event):
      fiber_sigma(coordinate)(E)
        IMPLIES
          Sigma(path_coordinate_event(fiber, coordinate, E))

  prefix_product_sigma(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      last_index: nat): trajectory_sigma_algebra =
    LAMBDA (E: trajectory_event):
      FORALL (candidate: trajectory_sigma_algebra):
        (is_trajectory_sigma_algebra(
            prefix_domain(fiber, last_index), candidate)
          AND contains_prefix_coordinate_generators(
            fiber, fiber_sigma, last_index, candidate))
        IMPLIES candidate(E)

  path_product_sigma(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family):
      trajectory_sigma_algebra =
    LAMBDA (E: trajectory_event):
      FORALL (candidate: trajectory_sigma_algebra):
        (is_trajectory_sigma_algebra(
            path_domain(fiber), candidate)
          AND contains_path_coordinate_generators(
            fiber, fiber_sigma, candidate))
        IMPLIES candidate(E)

  is_path_measure(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      M: path_measure): bool =
    is_trajectory_sigma_algebra(
      path_domain(fiber),
      path_product_sigma(fiber, fiber_sigma))
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_trajectory_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: trajectory_event):
        path_product_sigma(fiber, fiber_sigma)(E)
          IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: trajectory_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            path_product_sigma(fiber, fiber_sigma)(
              events(index)))
          AND trajectory_pairwise_disjoint(
            path_domain(fiber), events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(trajectory_countable_union(
              path_domain(fiber), events))))

  is_path_probability_measure(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      M: path_measure): bool =
    is_path_measure(fiber, fiber_sigma, M)
      AND measure_value_is_one(M(path_domain(fiber)))

  state_measure_equal(
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      left, right: state_measure): bool =
    FORALL (E: state_event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES left(E) = right(E)

  path_measure_equal(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      left, right: path_measure): bool =
    FORALL (E: trajectory_event):
      path_product_sigma(fiber, fiber_sigma)(E)
        IMPLIES left(E) = right(E)

  measurable_measure_value_on_prefix(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      last_index: nat,
      f: [trajectory -> measure_value]): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      bound >= 0 IMPLIES
        prefix_product_sigma(
          fiber, fiber_sigma, last_index)(
            LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
              valid_prefix(fiber, last_index, x)
                AND measure_value_le(
                  f(x), finite_measure_value(bound)))

  is_markov_state_kernel_family(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      K: state_kernel_family): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat), (x: trajectory):
      valid_prefix(fiber, index, x)
        IMPLIES
          is_state_probability_measure(
            fiber(index + 1),
            fiber_sigma(index + 1),
            K(index)(x)))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat), (x, y: trajectory):
        valid_prefix(fiber, index, x)
          AND valid_prefix(fiber, index, y)
          AND prefix_equivalent(index, x, y)
        IMPLIES
          state_measure_equal(
            fiber_sigma(index + 1),
            K(index)(x),
            K(index)(y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (index: nat),
          (E: state_event):
        fiber_sigma(index + 1)(E)
          IMPLIES
            measurable_measure_value_on_prefix(
              fiber,
              fiber_sigma,
              index,
              LAMBDA (x: trajectory): K(index)(x)(E)))

  is_markov_path_kernel(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      last_index: nat,
      K: path_kernel): bool =
    (FORALL (x: trajectory):
      valid_prefix(fiber, last_index, x)
        IMPLIES
          is_path_probability_measure(
            fiber, fiber_sigma, K(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: trajectory):
        valid_prefix(fiber, last_index, x)
          AND valid_prefix(fiber, last_index, y)
          AND prefix_equivalent(last_index, x, y)
        IMPLIES
          path_measure_equal(
            fiber, fiber_sigma, K(x), K(y)))
      AND (FORALL (E: trajectory_event):
        path_product_sigma(fiber, fiber_sigma)(E)
          IMPLIES
            measurable_measure_value_on_prefix(
              fiber,
              fiber_sigma,
              last_index,
              LAMBDA (x: trajectory): K(x)(E)))

  state_pairwise_disjoint_below(
      domain: state_event,
      events: state_event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (value: S):
          domain(value) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(value)
              AND events(right_index)(value))

  finite_simple_state_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: state_event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      value: S): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_state_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, value),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(value) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_state_data(
      domain: state_event,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: state_event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    state_pairwise_disjoint_below(domain, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_state_minorant(
      domain: state_event,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      f: nonnegative_state_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: state_event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (value: S):
      domain(value) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(f(value)))
      AND measurable_simple_state_data(
        domain, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (value: S):
        domain(value) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_state_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, value),
            f(value)))

  finite_simple_state_integral(
      M: state_measure,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: state_event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_state_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  state_integral_upper_bound(
      domain: state_event,
      M: state_measure,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      f: nonnegative_state_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: state_event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_state_minorant(
          domain, Sigma, f, coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_state_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_state_integral(
      domain: state_event,
      M: state_measure,
      Sigma: state_sigma_algebra,
      f: nonnegative_state_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    (FORALL (value: S):
      domain(value) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(f(value)))
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND state_integral_upper_bound(
        domain, M, Sigma, f, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        state_integral_upper_bound(
          domain, M, Sigma, f, upper)
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  update_coordinate(
      x: trajectory,
      coordinate: nat,
      value: S): trajectory =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      IF index = coordinate THEN value ELSE x(index) ENDIF

  tail_cylinder_probability_value(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      K: state_kernel_family,
      sets: state_event_family,
      prefix: trajectory,
      current_index: nat,
      steps: nat,
      probability: measure_value): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF steps = 0 THEN
      probability = one_measure_value
    ELSE
      EXISTS (continuation: nonnegative_state_function):
        (FORALL (value: S):
          (fiber(current_index + 1)(value)
            AND sets(current_index + 1)(value)
          IMPLIES
            tail_cylinder_probability_value(
              fiber,
              fiber_sigma,
              K,
              sets,
              update_coordinate(
                prefix, current_index + 1, value),
              current_index + 1,
              steps - 1,
              continuation(value)))
          AND
          (NOT (fiber(current_index + 1)(value)
            AND sets(current_index + 1)(value))
          IMPLIES
            continuation(value) = zero_measure_value))
        AND has_lower_state_integral(
          fiber(current_index + 1),
          K(current_index)(prefix),
          fiber_sigma(current_index + 1),
          continuation,
          probability)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE steps

  finite_coordinate_cylinder(
      fiber: state_family,
      last_index: nat,
      sets: state_event_family): trajectory_event =
    LAMBDA (x: trajectory):
      valid_path(fiber, x)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index <= last_index IMPLIES sets(index)(x(index)))

  measurable_sets_through(
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      last_index: nat,
      sets: state_event_family): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= last_index IMPLIES
        fiber_sigma(index)(sets(index))

  initial_coordinates_in_sets(
      last_index: nat,
      prefix: trajectory,
      sets: state_event_family): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      index <= last_index IMPLIES sets(index)(prefix(index))

  iterated_cylinder_probability_value(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      K: state_kernel_family,
      sets: state_event_family,
      prefix: trajectory,
      last_initial_index: nat,
      steps: nat,
      probability: measure_value): bool =
    IF initial_coordinates_in_sets(
        last_initial_index, prefix, sets) THEN
      tail_cylinder_probability_value(
        fiber,
        fiber_sigma,
        K,
        sets,
        prefix,
        last_initial_index,
        steps,
        probability)
    ELSE
      probability = zero_measure_value
    ENDIF

  measurable_space_family(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      is_state_sigma_algebra(
        fiber(index), fiber_sigma(index))

  trajectory_kernel_has_marginals(
      fiber: state_family,
      fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family,
      K: state_kernel_family,
      last_initial_index: nat,
      eta: path_kernel): bool =
    is_markov_path_kernel(
      fiber,
      fiber_sigma,
      last_initial_index,
      eta)
      AND (FORALL
          (prefix: trajectory),
          (sets: state_event_family),
          (steps: nat):
        (valid_prefix(
            fiber, last_initial_index, prefix)
          AND measurable_sets_through(
            fiber_sigma,
            last_initial_index + steps,
            sets))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (expected_probability: measure_value):
            iterated_cylinder_probability_value(
              fiber,
              fiber_sigma,
              K,
              sets,
              prefix,
              last_initial_index,
              steps,
              expected_probability)
            AND eta(prefix)(
              finite_coordinate_cylinder(
                fiber,
                last_initial_index + steps,
                sets))
              = expected_probability)

  ionescu_tulcea_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (fiber: state_family),
        (fiber_sigma: state_sigma_family),
        (K: state_kernel_family):
      (measurable_space_family(fiber, fiber_sigma)
        AND is_markov_state_kernel_family(
          fiber, fiber_sigma, K))
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (last_initial_index: nat):
          EXISTS (eta: path_kernel):
            trajectory_kernel_has_marginals(
              fiber,
              fiber_sigma,
              K,
              last_initial_index,
              eta)
            AND (FORALL (candidate: path_kernel):
              trajectory_kernel_has_marginals(
                fiber,
                fiber_sigma,
                K,
                last_initial_index,
                candidate)
              IMPLIES
                FORALL
                    (prefix: trajectory),
                    (E: trajectory_event):
                  (valid_prefix(
                      fiber,
                      last_initial_index,
                      prefix)
                    AND path_product_sigma(
                      fiber,
                      fiber_sigma)(E))
                  IMPLIES
                    candidate(prefix)(E) = eta(prefix)(E))
END ionescu_tulcea_theorem_Q25378690

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q257387
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q257387), "Vitali theorem": a set containing one
-- representative from each rational-difference class in `[0, 1]` is not
-- Lebesgue measurable. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Set

namespace Q257387

/-- The rational-difference equivalence class of a point of `[0, 1]`. -/
def rationalClass (x : {x : ℝ // x ∈ Icc 0 1}) : Set ℝ :=
  {y | (x : ℝ) - y ∈ range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)}

/-- Two points of `[0, 1]` are equivalent when they have the same
rational-difference class. -/
def vS : Setoid {x : ℝ // x ∈ Icc 0 1} :=
  Setoid.ker rationalClass

/-- The quotient of `[0, 1]` by rational difference. -/
def vT : Type :=
  Quotient vS

/-- A chosen representative of each rational-difference class. -/
def vRep : vT → {x : ℝ // x ∈ Icc 0 1} :=
  Quotient.out

/-- The Vitali set formed by the chosen representatives. -/
def vitaliSet : Set ℝ :=
  {x | ∃ t : vT, (vRep t : ℝ) = x}

/-- The Vitali set is not Lebesgue measurable. -/
theorem vitaliSet_not_measurable : ¬MeasurableSet vitaliSet := sorry

end Q257387

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q257387
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q257387), "Vitali theorem": a classically chosen
  transversal in [0,1] for equivalence modulo rational translation is not
  measurable in the standard Borel sigma-algebra on the real line. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals QArith ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q257387_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q257387_empty {A : Type} : q257387_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q257387_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q257387_set A) : q257387_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q257387_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q257387_set A) : q257387_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q257387_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q257387_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q257387_open_real_set
    (U : q257387_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : R, Rabs (y - x) < radius -> U y.

Definition q257387_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q257387_set (q257387_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q257387_empty /\
  (forall E F : q257387_set A,
    q257387_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q257387_set A,
    C E ->
    C (q257387_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q257387_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q257387_countable_union E)).

Definition q257387_borel_set
    (E : q257387_set R) : Prop :=
  forall C : q257387_set (q257387_set R),
    q257387_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q257387_set R,
      q257387_open_real_set U ->
      C U) ->
    C E.

Definition q257387_unit_interval
    (x : R) : Prop :=
  0 <= x /\ x <= 1.

Definition q257387_rational_equivalent
    (x y : R) : Prop :=
  exists q : Q, x - y = Q2R q.

Definition q257387_is_vitali_selector
    (V : q257387_set R) : Prop :=
  (forall y : R,
    V y ->
    q257387_unit_interval y) /\
  (forall x : R,
    q257387_unit_interval x ->
    exists y : R,
      V y /\
      q257387_rational_equivalent x y) /\
  (forall y z : R,
    V y ->
    V z ->
    q257387_rational_equivalent y z ->
    y = z).

Definition q257387_vitaliSet : q257387_set R :=
  epsilon
    (inhabits (fun _ : R => False))
    q257387_is_vitali_selector.

Theorem vitaliSet_not_measurable :
  ~ q257387_borel_set q257387_vitaliSet.
Admitted.

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q257387
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q257387), "Vitali theorem": choosing one real
  from every equivalence class of [0,1] modulo rational differences produces a
  Vitali set that is not Lebesgue measurable. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q257387_vitali_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition q257387_unit_interval :: "real set"
  where "q257387_unit_interval = {0..1}"

definition q257387_rational_difference :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q257387_rational_difference x y \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>q :: rat. x - y = of_rat q)"

definition q257387_equivalence_class :: "real \<Rightarrow> real set"
  where
    "q257387_equivalence_class x =
      {y \<in> q257387_unit_interval. q257387_rational_difference y x}"

definition q257387_vitali_classes :: "real set set"
  where
    "q257387_vitali_classes =
      q257387_equivalence_class ` q257387_unit_interval"

definition q257387_vitali_representative :: "real set \<Rightarrow> real"
  where
    "q257387_vitali_representative C = (SOME x. x \<in> C)"

definition q257387_vitali_set :: "real set"
  where
    "q257387_vitali_set =
      q257387_vitali_representative ` q257387_vitali_classes"

theorem vitaliSet_not_measurable:
  "q257387_vitali_set \<notin> sets lborel"
  sorry

end

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q257387,
  "Vitali theorem": the choice-defined set containing one representative of
  each rational-translation class in the real unit interval is not Borel
  measurable. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q257387_VITALI_THEOREM =
 `let is_rational =
      \x:real.
        ?m n:num. ~(n = 0) /\ abs x = &m / &n in
   let unit_interval =
      {x:real | &0 <= x /\ x <= &1} in
   let representative =
      \x:real.
        @y:real.
          y IN unit_interval /\ is_rational (x - y) in
   let vitali_set =
      IMAGE representative unit_interval in
   let open_real =
      \u:real->bool.
        !x:real.
          x IN u
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:real.
                  abs (y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN u in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \events:(real->bool)->bool.
        events {} /\
        events (:real) /\
        (!s:real->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:real) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->real->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:real | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let borel_measurable =
      \s:real->bool.
        !events:(real->bool)->bool.
          sigma_algebra events /\
          (!u:real->bool. open_real u ==> events u)
          ==> events s in
   ~(borel_measurable vitali_set)`;;

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q257387,
;; "Vitali theorem": a set obtained by choosing one representative from each
;; rational-translation class in the real interval [0,1] is not Borel
;; measurable. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary real-field and set codes.  The
;; predicates below explicitly characterize a Dedekind-complete ordered field,
;; its order topology, the Borel sigma algebra, and the fixed representative
;; choice used to define the source Vitali set.

(defstub q257387-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q257387-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q257387-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q257387-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q257387-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q257387-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q257387-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q257387-r-less (real left right) t)

(defstub q257387-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q257387-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q257387-family-member-p (family set) t)

(defstub q257387-borel-family (real) t)
(defstub q257387-selected-representative (real value) t)
(defstub q257387-vitali-set-code (real) t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.

(defun q257387-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q257387-r-less real right left)))

(defun q257387-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q257387-r-add
   real left (q257387-r-negate real right)))

(defun-sk q257387-valid-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q257387-set-member-p set x)
     (q257387-r-member-p real x))))

(defun-sk q257387-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real x)
      (q257387-r-member-p real y)
      (q257387-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q257387-r-zero real))
            (one (q257387-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q257387-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q257387-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q257387-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q257387-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q257387-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q257387-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q257387-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q257387-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q257387-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q257387-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q257387-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q257387-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q257387-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q257387-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q257387-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q257387-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q257387-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q257387-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q257387-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q257387-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q257387-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q257387-r-multiply
          real x (q257387-r-add real y z))
         (q257387-r-add
          real
          (q257387-r-multiply real x y)
          (q257387-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q257387-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real x)
      (q257387-r-member-p real y)
      (q257387-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q257387-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q257387-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q257387-r-less real x y)
         (q257387-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q257387-r-less real x y)
          (q257387-r-less real y z))
         (q257387-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q257387-r-less real x y)
         (q257387-r-less
          real
          (q257387-r-add real x z)
          (q257387-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q257387-r-less real zero x)
          (q257387-r-less real zero y))
         (q257387-r-less
          real zero
          (q257387-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q257387-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q257387-r-member-p real x)
     (q257387-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q257387-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real x)
      (q257387-set-member-p set x))
     (q257387-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q257387-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q257387-r-member-p real bound)
     (q257387-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q257387-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q257387-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q257387-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q257387-r-member-p real bound)
       (q257387-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q257387-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q257387-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q257387-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q257387-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-valid-set-p real set)
      (q257387-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q257387-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q257387-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q257387-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q257387-r-zero real))
        (one (q257387-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q257387-r-member-p real zero)
     (q257387-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q257387-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q257387-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q257387-r-less real zero one)
     (q257387-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Exact embedding of ACL2 rationals into the presented real field.

(defun q257387-natural-cast (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q257387-r-zero real)
    (q257387-r-add
     real
     (q257387-r-one real)
     (q257387-natural-cast real (1- n)))))

(defun q257387-integer-cast (real n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q257387-r-negate
       real
       (q257387-natural-cast real (- n)))
    (q257387-natural-cast real (nfix n))))

(defun q257387-rational-cast (real q)
  (if (rationalp q)
      (q257387-r-multiply
       real
       (q257387-integer-cast real (numerator q))
       (q257387-r-inverse
        real
        (q257387-integer-cast real (denominator q))))
    (q257387-r-zero real)))

(defun-sk q257387-rational-cast-injective-p (real)
  (forall (q r)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp q)
      (rationalp r)
      (equal
       (q257387-rational-cast real q)
       (q257387-rational-cast real r)))
     (equal q r))))

;; Arbitrary subsets and sigma algebras over the real carrier.

(defun-sk q257387-set-equiv-p (real left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q257387-r-member-p real x)
     (iff
      (q257387-set-member-p left x)
      (q257387-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q257387-empty-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q257387-set-member-p set x)
     (and (q257387-r-member-p real x) nil))))

(defun-sk q257387-complement-set-p
    (real set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q257387-set-member-p complement x)
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real x)
      (not (q257387-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q257387-set-sequence-p (real sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q257387-valid-set-p
      real
      (q257387-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q257387-sequence-union-member-p
    (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q257387-set-member-p
      (q257387-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q257387-sequence-union-set-p
    (real sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q257387-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real x)
      (q257387-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q257387-family-extensional-p
    (real family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q257387-set-equiv-p real left right)
     (iff
      (q257387-family-member-p family left)
      (q257387-family-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q257387-family-valid-p (real family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q257387-family-member-p family set)
     (q257387-valid-set-p real set))))

(defun-sk q257387-empty-member-exists-p
    (real family)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q257387-empty-set-p real empty)
     (q257387-family-member-p family empty))))

(defun-sk q257387-complement-member-exists-p
    (real family set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q257387-complement-set-p real set complement)
     (q257387-family-member-p family complement))))

(defun-sk q257387-family-complements-p
    (real family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q257387-family-member-p family set)
     (q257387-complement-member-exists-p
      real family set))))

(defun-sk q257387-family-sequence-p (family sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q257387-family-member-p
      family
      (q257387-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q257387-union-member-exists-p
    (real family sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q257387-sequence-union-set-p real sequence union)
     (q257387-family-member-p family union))))

(defun-sk q257387-family-sequence-unions-p
    (real family)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-set-sequence-p real sequence)
      (q257387-family-sequence-p family sequence))
     (q257387-union-member-exists-p
      real family sequence))))

(defun q257387-sigma-algebra-p (real family)
  (and
   (q257387-family-extensional-p real family)
   (q257387-family-valid-p real family)
   (q257387-empty-member-exists-p real family)
   (q257387-family-complements-p real family)
   (q257387-family-sequence-unions-p real family)))

;; The order topology and its generated Borel sigma algebra.

(defun-sk q257387-open-neighborhood-p
    (real set point lower upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real x)
      (q257387-r-less real lower x)
      (q257387-r-less real x upper))
     (q257387-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q257387-open-neighborhood-exists-p
    (real set point)
  (exists (lower upper)
    (and
     (q257387-r-member-p real lower)
     (q257387-r-member-p real upper)
     (q257387-r-less real lower point)
     (q257387-r-less real point upper)
     (q257387-open-neighborhood-p
      real set point lower upper))))

(defun-sk q257387-open-set-p (real set)
  (forall (point)
    (and
     (q257387-valid-set-p real set)
     (implies
      (and
       (q257387-r-member-p real point)
       (q257387-set-member-p set point))
      (q257387-open-neighborhood-exists-p
       real set point)))))

(defun-sk q257387-family-contains-open-sets-p
    (real family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q257387-open-set-p real set)
     (q257387-family-member-p family set))))

(defun-sk q257387-borel-minimal-p
    (real borel)
  (forall (family set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-sigma-algebra-p real family)
      (q257387-family-contains-open-sets-p real family)
      (q257387-family-member-p borel set))
     (q257387-family-member-p family set))))

(defun q257387-borel-space-p (real)
  (let ((borel (q257387-borel-family real)))
    (and
     (q257387-sigma-algebra-p real borel)
     (q257387-family-contains-open-sets-p real borel)
     (q257387-borel-minimal-p real borel))))

;; The source setoid relation: x and y differ by a rational real number.

(defun-sk q257387-rationally-related-p
    (real x y)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (equal
      (q257387-r-subtract real x y)
      (q257387-rational-cast real q)))))

(defun q257387-unit-interval-member-p (real x)
  (and
   (q257387-r-member-p real x)
   (q257387-r-leq real (q257387-r-zero real) x)
   (q257387-r-leq real x (q257387-r-one real))))

;; SELECTED-REPRESENTATIVE is the fixed Classical.choose representative from
;; each quotient class.  The first law puts it in the same class and in
;; [0,1]; the second says that it depends only on the quotient class.

(defun-sk q257387-representative-value-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q257387-unit-interval-member-p real x)
     (let ((representative
            (q257387-selected-representative real x)))
       (and
        (q257387-unit-interval-member-p real representative)
        (q257387-rationally-related-p
         real x representative))))))

(defun-sk q257387-representative-class-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-unit-interval-member-p real x)
      (q257387-unit-interval-member-p real y)
      (q257387-rationally-related-p real x y))
     (equal
      (q257387-selected-representative real x)
      (q257387-selected-representative real y)))))

(defun q257387-representative-choice-p (real)
  (and
   (q257387-representative-value-laws-p real)
   (q257387-representative-class-laws-p real)))

(defun-sk q257387-representative-preimage-exists-p
    (real representative)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q257387-unit-interval-member-p real x)
     (equal
      (q257387-selected-representative real x)
      representative))))

(defun-sk q257387-vitali-set-p (real)
  (forall (representative)
    (iff
     (q257387-set-member-p
      (q257387-vitali-set-code real)
      representative)
     (and
      (q257387-r-member-p real representative)
      (q257387-representative-preimage-exists-p
       real representative)))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q257387-vitali-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (real)
    (implies
     (and
      (q257387-real-field-p real)
      (q257387-rational-cast-injective-p real)
      (q257387-borel-space-p real)
      (q257387-representative-choice-p real)
      (q257387-valid-set-p
       real (q257387-vitali-set-code real))
      (q257387-vitali-set-p real))
     (not
      (q257387-family-member-p
       (q257387-borel-family real)
       (q257387-vitali-set-code real))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q257387,
-- "Vitali theorem": the quotient-selected Vitali subset of the fixed real
-- unit interval is not Borel measurable. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q257387_vitali_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Set p where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
Not {p} A =
  A -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Set p)
  (B : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Set p)
  (B : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Set p)
  (B : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

data Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  witness :
    (value : A) ->
    P value ->
    Exists A P

infix 4 _==N_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

data _==N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  reflN : {n : Nat} -> n ==N n

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

-- Rationals are integer numerators over positive denominators.  The
-- equality and order relations quotient this concrete presentation.
record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart    : Nat
    negativePart    : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue : Rational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

oneQ : Rational
oneQ =
  rational (suc zero) zero zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

negateQ : Rational -> Rational
negateQ q =
  rational
    (negativePart q)
    (positivePart q)
    (denominatorCode q)

subtractQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
subtractQ q r =
  addQ q (negateQ r)

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalEqual q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  ==N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLT : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalLT q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

-- The real line is fixed internally as the type of finite located lower
-- Dedekind cuts of the rationals.
record DedekindReal : Set1 where
  field
    lower :
      Rational ->
      Set

    lower-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (lower q) (lower r)

    lower-inhabited :
      Exists Rational lower

    lower-proper :
      Exists Rational (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    lower-downward :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    lower-rounded :
      (q : Rational) ->
      lower q ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT q r) (lower r))

    lower-located :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

open DedekindReal

RealEqual : DedekindReal -> DedekindReal -> Set
RealEqual x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (lower x q) (lower y q)

RealLess : DedekindReal -> DedekindReal -> Set
RealLess x y =
  Exists Rational
    (\ q ->
      Both
        (Not (lower x q))
        (lower y q))

-- This says exactly that x - y is the image of a rational: if x = y + c,
-- then q < x precisely when q - c < y.
RationalDifference : DedekindReal -> DedekindReal -> Set
RationalDifference x y =
  Exists Rational
    (\ c ->
      (q : Rational) ->
      Iff
        (lower x q)
        (lower y (subtractQ q c)))

InUnitInterval : DedekindReal -> Set
InUnitInterval x =
  Both
    ((q : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      lower x q)
    ((q : Rational) ->
      lower x q ->
      RationalLT q oneQ)

record UnitPoint : Set1 where
  constructor unit-point
  field
    realValue :
      DedekindReal

    liesInUnitInterval :
      InUnitInterval realValue

open UnitPoint

VitaliRelated : UnitPoint -> UnitPoint -> Set
VitaliRelated x y =
  RationalDifference (realValue x) (realValue y)

-- Safe Agda has no native quotient type.  This record is an exact quotient
-- presentation of [0,1] by rational difference, together with the
-- representative selector corresponding to Lean's vT, vRep, and vRep_spec.
-- The Vitali set below is derived from this selector rather than supplied as
-- an external transversal, and the final proposition binds the selector
-- internally.
record VitaliQuotientSelection : Set2 where
  field
    Class :
      Set1

    classOf :
      UnitPoint ->
      Class

    classOf-equality :
      (x y : UnitPoint) ->
      Iff
        (classOf x ≡ classOf y)
        (VitaliRelated x y)

    representative :
      Class ->
      UnitPoint

    representative-class :
      (class : Class) ->
      classOf (representative class) ≡ class

open VitaliQuotientSelection

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Predicate {a} A =
  A -> Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Empty {a} _ =
  Bottom {a}

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

SamePredicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
SamePredicate {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (S x) (T x)

OrderOpen :
  Predicate DedekindReal ->
  Set1
OrderOpen U =
  (x : DedekindReal) ->
  U x ->
  Exists DedekindReal
    (\ lowerBound ->
      Exists DedekindReal
        (\ upperBound ->
          Both
            (RealLess lowerBound x)
            (Both
              (RealLess x upperBound)
              ((y : DedekindReal) ->
                RealLess lowerBound y ->
                RealLess y upperBound ->
                U y))))

-- This is the Borel sigma-algebra generated by the order topology of the
-- fixed Dedekind real line.  It is the target counterpart of Lean's
-- MeasureTheory.MeasurableSet on ℝ.
data MeasurableSet :
  Predicate DedekindReal ->
  Set2 where

  measurable-open :
    {U : Predicate DedekindReal} ->
    OrderOpen U ->
    MeasurableSet U

  measurable-empty :
    MeasurableSet Empty

  measurable-complement :
    {S : Predicate DedekindReal} ->
    MeasurableSet S ->
    MeasurableSet (Complement S)

  measurable-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate DedekindReal) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> MeasurableSet (sets n)) ->
    MeasurableSet (CountableUnion sets)

  measurable-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate DedekindReal} ->
    SamePredicate S T ->
    MeasurableSet S ->
    MeasurableSet T

vitaliSet :
  VitaliQuotientSelection ->
  Predicate DedekindReal
vitaliSet selection x =
  Exists
    (Class selection)
    (\ class ->
      RealEqual
        (realValue (representative selection class))
        x)

vitaliSet-not-measurable : Set2
vitaliSet-not-measurable =
  (selection : VitaliQuotientSelection) ->
  Not (MeasurableSet (vitaliSet selection))

  Q257387 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q257387), "Vitali theorem": a set obtained
  by choosing one representative from each rational-difference equivalence
  class in the real interval [0,1] is not Lebesgue measurable. This file
  contains no proof.

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory ratTheory realTheory real_of_ratTheory;
open measureTheory borelTheory;

val vitaliSet_not_measurable =
  ``let equivalent =
      \x y : real.
        0 <= x /\ x <= 1 /\
        0 <= y /\ y <= 1 /\
        ?q : rat. x - y = real_of_rat q

    let representative =
      \x : real. @y : real. equivalent x y

    let vitaliSet =

      ~(vitaliSet IN measurable_sets lborel)``;

title: Q257387_vitali_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q257387,
% "Vitali theorem": the set obtained by choosing one representative from every
% rational-difference class in the real unit interval is not Borel measurable.
% This file contains no proof.

Q257387_vitali_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_set]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [real_set -> bool]

  empty_set: real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): FALSE

  full_set: real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real): TRUE

  set_complement(value: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      NOT value(x)

  countable_union(values: real_set_sequence): real_set =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        values(index)(x)

  open_set(value: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      value(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: real):
            abs(y - x) < radius IMPLIES value(y)

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(empty_set)
      AND Sigma(full_set)
      AND (FORALL (value: real_set):
        Sigma(value) IMPLIES
          Sigma(set_complement(value)))
      AND (FORALL (values: real_set_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          Sigma(values(index)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(values)))

  contains_open_sets(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (value: real_set):
      open_set(value) IMPLIES Sigma(value)

  borel_measurable(value: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      (is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
        AND contains_open_sets(Sigma))
      IMPLIES Sigma(value)

  unit_interval(x: real): bool =
    0 <= x AND x <= 1

  rational_difference_class(
      representative_source: real): real_set =
    LAMBDA (candidate: real):
      unit_interval(candidate)
        AND rational?(
          representative_source - candidate)

  vitali_representative(source: real): real =
    epsilon(rational_difference_class(source))

  vitali_set: real_set =
    LAMBDA (candidate: real):
      EXISTS (source: real):
        unit_interval(source)
          AND candidate = vitali_representative(source)

  vitaliSet_not_measurable: bool =
    NOT borel_measurable(vitali_set)
END Q257387_vitali_theorem
