-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q258374
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q258374), "Carathéodory's theorem (measure theory)":
-- for every outer measure, the sets that split every test set additively form
-- a measurable space. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.OfFunction
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.PiSystem

@[expose] public section

open Set

namespace MeasureTheory
namespace Q258374

universe u

/-- The sets satisfying Carathéodory's splitting criterion form a measurable space. -/
theorem caratheodory_theorem_statement {α : Type u} (m : OuterMeasure α) :
    ∃ M : MeasurableSpace α, ∀ s : Set α,
      MeasurableSet[M] s ↔ ∀ t : Set α, m t = m (t ∩ s) + m (t \ s) := sorry

end Q258374
end MeasureTheory

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q258374
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q258374), "Carathéodory's theorem (measure
  theory)": the subsets satisfying the Carathéodory splitting criterion for
  an outer measure form a measurable space. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q258374_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q258374_empty {A : Type} : q258374_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q258374_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q258374_set A) : q258374_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q258374_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q258374_set A) : q258374_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q258374_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q258374_set A) : q258374_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ ~ F x.

Definition q258374_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q258374_set A) : q258374_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q258374_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q258374_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q258374_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q258374_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Inductive q258374_ennreal : Type :=
| q258374_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q258374_ennreal
| q258374_ennreal_infinity : q258374_ennreal.

Arguments q258374_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q258374_ennreal_zero : q258374_ennreal :=
  q258374_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q258374_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q258374_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q258374_ennreal_finite a _,
    q258374_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q258374_ennreal_infinity,
    q258374_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q258374_ennreal_le
    (x y : q258374_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q258374_ennreal_finite a _,
    q258374_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q258374_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q258374_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q258374_ennreal_infinity,
    q258374_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q258374_ennreal_infinity,
    q258374_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q258374_ennreal_add
    (x y : q258374_ennreal) : q258374_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q258374_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q258374_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q258374_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q258374_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q258374_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q258374_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q258374_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q258374_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q258374_ennreal_add
        (q258374_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q258374_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q258374_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q258374_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q258374_ennreal,
      values value -> q258374_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q258374_ennreal,
      (forall value : q258374_ennreal,
        values value -> q258374_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q258374_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q258374_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q258374_ennreal)
    (sum : q258374_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q258374_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q258374_ennreal_eq value
          (q258374_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q258374_outer_measure (A : Type) : Type := {
  q258374_outer_measure_value :
    q258374_set A -> q258374_ennreal;
  q258374_outer_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q258374_set A,
      q258374_same_set E F ->
      q258374_ennreal_eq
        (q258374_outer_measure_value E)
        (q258374_outer_measure_value F);
  q258374_outer_measure_empty :
    q258374_ennreal_eq
      (q258374_outer_measure_value q258374_empty)
      q258374_ennreal_zero;
  q258374_outer_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q258374_set A,
      q258374_subset E F ->
      q258374_ennreal_le
        (q258374_outer_measure_value E)
        (q258374_outer_measure_value F);
  q258374_outer_measure_countably_subadditive :
    forall E : nat -> q258374_set A,
      exists total : q258374_ennreal,
        q258374_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q258374_outer_measure_value (E n)) total /\
        q258374_ennreal_le
          (q258374_outer_measure_value
            (q258374_countable_union E))
          total
}.

Arguments q258374_outer_measure_value {A} _ _.

Record q258374_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q258374_measurable : q258374_set A -> Prop;
  q258374_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q258374_set A,
      q258374_same_set E F ->
      (q258374_measurable E <-> q258374_measurable F);
  q258374_measurable_empty :
    q258374_measurable q258374_empty;
  q258374_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q258374_set A,
      q258374_measurable E ->
      q258374_measurable (q258374_complement E);
  q258374_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q258374_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q258374_measurable (E n)) ->
      q258374_measurable (q258374_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q258374_measurable {A} _ _.

Definition q258374_is_caratheodory {A : Type}
    (mu : q258374_outer_measure A)
    (S : q258374_set A) : Prop :=
  forall T : q258374_set A,
    q258374_ennreal_eq
      (q258374_outer_measure_value mu T)
      (q258374_ennreal_add
        (q258374_outer_measure_value mu
          (q258374_intersection T S))
        (q258374_outer_measure_value mu
          (q258374_difference T S))).

Theorem MeasureTheory_OuterMeasure_caratheodory :
  forall (Alpha : Type) (mu : q258374_outer_measure Alpha),
    exists M : q258374_measurable_space Alpha,
      forall S : q258374_set Alpha,
        q258374_measurable M S <->
        q258374_is_caratheodory mu S.
Admitted.

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q258374,
  "Carathéodory's theorem (measure theory)": the sets satisfying the
  Carathéodory splitting criterion for an outer measure form a measurable
  space. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Caratheodory"
begin

definition q258374_caratheodory_sets ::
    "('a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> 'a set set"
  where
    "q258374_caratheodory_sets m =
      {s. \<forall>t. m t = m (t \<inter> s) + m (t - s)}"

theorem q258374_caratheodory:
  fixes m :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
  assumes outer_measure: "outer_measure_space (Pow UNIV) m"
  shows "sigma_algebra UNIV (q258374_caratheodory_sets m)"
  sorry

end

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q258374,
  "Carathéodory's theorem (measure theory)": every outer measure admits a
  measurable space whose measurable sets are exactly those satisfying
  Carathéodory's splitting criterion. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q258374_CARATHEODORY_S_THEOREM_MEASURE_THEORY =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let outer_measure =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s t:A->bool. s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           ?total:bool#real.
             esum (\n. mu (sets n)) total /\
             ele (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) total) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   !mu:(A->bool)->bool#real.
      outer_measure mu
      ==> ?events:(A->bool)->bool.
            sigma_algebra events /\
            (!s:A->bool.
               events s <=>
               !t:A->bool.
                 mu t =
                 eadd (mu (t INTER s)) (mu (t DIFF s)))`;;

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q258374,
;; "Carathéodory's theorem (measure theory)": for an outer measure, the sets
;; satisfying Carathéodory's splitting criterion form a measurable space.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Function objects are represented by arbitrary tags interpreted through
;; conservative application interfaces.  Carrier predicates and every
;; algebraic, order, set, and outer-measure law are explicit below.

(defstub q258374-apply1 (function argument) t)
(defstub q258374-apply2 (function left right) t)

(defun q258374-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (q258374-apply1 carrier value) t nil))

;; A Dedekind-complete linearly ordered field presents the real numbers.

(defun-sk q258374-real-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q258374-member-p carrier x)
      (q258374-member-p carrier y)
      (q258374-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q258374-apply2 add x y))
            (yz-add (q258374-apply2 add y z))
            (xy-mul (q258374-apply2 multiply x y))
            (yz-mul (q258374-apply2 multiply y z))
            (neg-x (q258374-apply1 negate x))
            (inv-x (q258374-apply1 inverse x)))
       (and
        (q258374-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q258374-member-p carrier xy-mul)
        (q258374-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (q258374-member-p carrier inv-x)
        (equal
         (q258374-apply2 add xy-add z)
         (q258374-apply2 add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q258374-apply2 add y x))
        (equal (q258374-apply2 add x zero) x)
        (equal (q258374-apply2 add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q258374-apply2 multiply xy-mul z)
         (q258374-apply2 multiply x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q258374-apply2 multiply y x))
        (equal (q258374-apply2 multiply x one) x)
        (equal
         (q258374-apply2 multiply x yz-add)
         (q258374-apply2
          add
          (q258374-apply2 multiply x y)
          (q258374-apply2 multiply x z)))
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inv-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (q258374-apply2 multiply x inv-x) one))
        (not (q258374-apply2 less x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q258374-apply2 less x y)
         (q258374-apply2 less y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q258374-apply2 less x y)
          (q258374-apply2 less y z))
         (q258374-apply2 less x z))
        (implies
         (q258374-apply2 less x y)
         (q258374-apply2
          less
          (q258374-apply2 add x z)
          (q258374-apply2 add y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q258374-apply2 less zero x)
          (q258374-apply2 less zero y))
         (q258374-apply2
          less zero (q258374-apply2 multiply x y))))))))

(defun q258374-real-leq (less left right)
  (not (q258374-apply2 less right left)))

(defun-sk q258374-real-set-valid-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q258374-apply1 set x)
     (q258374-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q258374-real-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q258374-member-p carrier x)
     (q258374-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q258374-real-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q258374-member-p carrier x)
      (q258374-apply1 set x))
     (q258374-real-leq less x bound))))

(defun-sk q258374-real-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q258374-member-p carrier bound)
     (q258374-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q258374-real-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q258374-member-p carrier supremum)
     (q258374-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-member-p carrier bound)
       (q258374-real-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (q258374-real-leq less supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q258374-real-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q258374-real-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q258374-real-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q258374-real-set-valid-p carrier set)
      (q258374-real-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q258374-real-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (q258374-real-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q258374-real-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (q258374-member-p carrier zero)
   (q258374-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q258374-apply2 less zero one)
   (q258374-real-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
   (q258374-real-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Extended nonnegative reals are represented canonically as a nonnegative
;; real value or a distinguished top element.

(defun q258374-ennreal-finite (value)
  (list :q258374-finite value))

(defun q258374-ennreal-top ()
  :q258374-top)

(defun q258374-ennreal-zero (real-zero)
  (q258374-ennreal-finite real-zero))

(defun q258374-ennreal-finite-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (equal (car value) :q258374-finite)
   (q258374-member-p real-carrier (cadr value))
   (q258374-real-leq real-less real-zero (cadr value))))

(defun q258374-ennreal-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less value)
  (or
   (equal value (q258374-ennreal-top))
   (q258374-ennreal-finite-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less value)))

(defun q258374-ennreal-leq (real-less left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right (q258374-ennreal-top)) t)
   ((equal left (q258374-ennreal-top)) nil)
   (t
    (q258374-real-leq
     real-less (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

(defun q258374-ennreal-add (real-add left right)
  (if
      (or
       (equal left (q258374-ennreal-top))
       (equal right (q258374-ennreal-top)))
      (q258374-ennreal-top)
    (q258374-ennreal-finite
     (q258374-apply2 real-add (cadr left) (cadr right)))))

;; Arbitrary subsets of the point carrier and their standard operations.

(defun-sk q258374-set-p (point-carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q258374-apply1 set x)
     (q258374-member-p point-carrier x))))

(defun-sk q258374-set-equivalent-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q258374-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q258374-apply1 left x)
      (q258374-apply1 right x)))))

(defun-sk q258374-subset-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q258374-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q258374-apply1 left x))
     (q258374-apply1 right x))))

(defun-sk q258374-family-values-are-sets-p
    (point-carrier family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q258374-set-p
      point-carrier (q258374-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q258374-family-member-exists-p (family x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q258374-apply1
      (q258374-apply1 family n) x))))

(defun-sk q258374-set-operation-laws-p
    (point-carrier empty-set complement intersection difference union-family)
  (forall (left right family x)
    (and
     (q258374-set-p point-carrier empty-set)
     (implies
      (q258374-member-p point-carrier x)
      (not (q258374-apply1 empty-set x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier right)
       (q258374-set-equivalent-p
        point-carrier left right))
      (equal left right))
     (implies
      (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
      (and
       (q258374-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q258374-apply1 complement left))
       (implies
        (q258374-member-p point-carrier x)
        (iff
         (q258374-apply1
          (q258374-apply1 complement left) x)
         (not (q258374-apply1 left x))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier right))
      (and
       (q258374-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q258374-apply2 intersection left right))
       (q258374-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q258374-apply2 difference left right))
       (implies
        (q258374-member-p point-carrier x)
        (and
         (iff
          (q258374-apply1
           (q258374-apply2 intersection left right) x)
          (and
           (q258374-apply1 left x)
           (q258374-apply1 right x)))
         (iff
          (q258374-apply1
           (q258374-apply2 difference left right) x)
          (and
           (q258374-apply1 left x)
           (not (q258374-apply1 right x))))))))
     (implies
      (q258374-family-values-are-sets-p
       point-carrier family)
      (and
       (q258374-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q258374-apply1 union-family family))
       (implies
        (q258374-member-p point-carrier x)
        (iff
         (q258374-apply1
          (q258374-apply1 union-family family) x)
         (q258374-family-member-exists-p family x))))))))

;; Infinite sums are least upper bounds of finite partial sums in ENNReal.

(defun q258374-measure-partial-sum
    (real-zero real-add measure family count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q258374-ennreal-zero real-zero)
    (q258374-ennreal-add
     real-add
     (q258374-measure-partial-sum
      real-zero real-add measure family (1- count))
     (q258374-apply1
      measure (q258374-apply1 family (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q258374-measure-series-upper-bound-p
    (real-zero real-add real-less measure family bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q258374-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q258374-measure-partial-sum
       real-zero real-add measure family count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q258374-measure-series-sum-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     measure family total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q258374-ennreal-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less total)
     (q258374-measure-series-upper-bound-p
      real-zero real-add real-less measure family total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-ennreal-p
        real-carrier real-zero real-less bound)
       (q258374-measure-series-upper-bound-p
        real-zero real-add real-less measure family bound))
      (q258374-ennreal-leq real-less total bound)))))

;; The outer-measure predicate records exactly zero on the empty set,
;; monotonicity, extensionality, and countable subadditivity.

(defun-sk q258374-outer-measure-basic-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-less
     point-carrier empty-set measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (implies
      (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
      (q258374-ennreal-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-less
       (q258374-apply1 measure left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier right)
       (q258374-set-equivalent-p
        point-carrier left right))
      (equal
       (q258374-apply1 measure left)
       (q258374-apply1 measure right)))
     (equal
      (q258374-apply1 measure empty-set)
      (q258374-ennreal-zero real-zero))
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q258374-set-p point-carrier right)
       (q258374-subset-p
        point-carrier left right))
      (q258374-ennreal-leq
       real-less
       (q258374-apply1 measure left)
       (q258374-apply1 measure right))))))

(defun-sk q258374-countable-subadditivity-instance-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     measure family union)
  (exists (total)
    (and
     (q258374-measure-series-sum-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
      measure family total)
     (q258374-ennreal-leq
      real-less
      (q258374-apply1 measure union)
      total))))

(defun-sk q258374-outer-measure-countable-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier union-family measure)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (q258374-family-values-are-sets-p
      point-carrier family)
     (q258374-countable-subadditivity-instance-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
      measure family
      (q258374-apply1 union-family family)))))

(defun q258374-outer-measure-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
     point-carrier empty-set union-family measure)
  (and
   (q258374-outer-measure-basic-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-less
    point-carrier empty-set measure)
   (q258374-outer-measure-countable-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
    point-carrier union-family measure)))

;; Carathéodory measurability is the source criterion
;; m(t) = m(t intersection s) + m(t difference s), for every set t.

(defun-sk q258374-caratheodory-splitting-p
    (real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure set)
  (forall (test)
    (implies
     (q258374-set-p point-carrier test)
     (equal
      (q258374-apply1 measure test)
      (q258374-ennreal-add
       real-add
       (q258374-apply1
        measure (q258374-apply2 intersection test set))
       (q258374-apply1
        measure (q258374-apply2 difference test set)))))))

(defun q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
    (real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure set)
  (and
   (q258374-set-p point-carrier set)
   (q258374-caratheodory-splitting-p
    real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure set)))

(defun-sk q258374-family-caratheodory-p
    (real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
      real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure
      (q258374-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q258374-caratheodory-extensional-p
    (real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q258374-set-p point-carrier left)
      (q258374-set-p point-carrier right)
      (q258374-set-equivalent-p
       point-carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure left)
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure right)))))

(defun-sk q258374-caratheodory-space-laws-p
    (real-add point-carrier complement intersection difference union-family
     measure)
  (forall (set family)
    (and
     (implies
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure set)
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure
       (q258374-apply1 complement set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q258374-family-values-are-sets-p
        point-carrier family)
       (q258374-family-caratheodory-p
        real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure family))
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure
       (q258374-apply1 union-family family))))))

(defun q258374-caratheodory-measurable-space-p
    (real-add point-carrier empty-set complement intersection difference
     union-family measure)
  (and
   (q258374-caratheodory-extensional-p
    real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure)
   (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
    real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure empty-set)
   (q258374-caratheodory-space-laws-p
    real-add point-carrier complement intersection difference union-family
    measure)))

(defun-sk q258374-caratheodory-characterization-p
    (real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q258374-set-p point-carrier set)
     (iff
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-set-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure set)
      (q258374-caratheodory-splitting-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure set)))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q258374-caratheodorys-theorem-measure-theory-statement
    ()
  (forall
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate
     real-inverse real-less point-carrier empty-set complement intersection
     difference union-family measure)
    (implies
     (and
      (q258374-real-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply real-negate
       real-inverse real-less)
      (q258374-set-operation-laws-p
       point-carrier empty-set complement intersection difference
       union-family)
      (q258374-outer-measure-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-add real-less
       point-carrier empty-set union-family measure))
     (and
      (q258374-caratheodory-characterization-p
       real-add point-carrier intersection difference measure)
      (q258374-caratheodory-measurable-space-p
       real-add point-carrier empty-set complement intersection difference
       union-family measure)))))

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q258374,
-- "Carathéodory's theorem (measure theory)": under classical logic, every
-- outer measure determines the measurable space of sets satisfying
-- Carathéodory's splitting criterion. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe --prop #-}

module Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_; Prop)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Prop p where

record Top {p : Level} : Prop p where
  constructor top

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Prop p ->
  Prop p
Not {p} A =
  A -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

ExcludedMiddle :
  (p : Level) ->
  Prop (lsuc p)
ExcludedMiddle p =
  (P : Prop p) ->
  Either P (Not P)

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Prop p) :
  Prop (a ⊔ p) where

  witness :
    (value : A) ->
    P value ->
    Exists A P

infix 4 _==N_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

data _==N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  reflN : {n : Nat} -> n ==N n

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

-- Rationals are represented by an integer numerator and a positive
-- denominator. Equality and order below quotient this presentation.
record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart    : Nat
    negativePart    : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue : Rational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalEqual q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  ==N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLT : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalLT q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

-- Finite real values are located lower Dedekind cuts of the rationals.
record DedekindReal : Set1 where
  field
    lower :
      Rational ->
      Prop

    lower-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (lower q) (lower r)

    lower-inhabited :
      Exists Rational lower

    lower-proper :
      Exists Rational (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    lower-downward :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    lower-rounded :
      (q : Rational) ->
      lower q ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT q r) (lower r))

    lower-located :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

open DedekindReal

record NonnegativeReal : Set1 where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    real :
      DedekindReal

    nonnegative :
      (q : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      lower real q

open NonnegativeReal

-- The syntax is interpreted extensionally by lower cuts. The operation
-- constructors give exact extended-nonnegative-real addition and countable
-- summation; countable summation is therefore total, as it is in Lean.
data ENNReal : Set1 where
  zeroENN         : ENNReal
  finite          : NonnegativeReal -> ENNReal
  infinity        : ENNReal
  sumENN          : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal
  countableSumENN : (Nat -> ENNReal) -> ENNReal

mutual
  ENNLower : ENNReal -> Rational -> Prop
  ENNLower zeroENN q =
    RationalLT q zeroQ
  ENNLower (finite x) q =
    lower (real x) q
  ENNLower infinity q =
    Top
  ENNLower (sumENN x y) q =
    Exists Rational
      (\ r ->
        Exists Rational
          (\ s ->
            Both
              (Both (ENNLower x r) (ENNLower y s))
              (RationalLT q (addQ r s))))
  ENNLower (countableSumENN terms) q =
    Exists Nat (\ n -> FinitePrefixLower terms n q)

  data FinitePrefixLower
    (terms : Nat -> ENNReal) :
    Nat ->
    Rational ->
    Prop where

    empty-prefix-lower :
      {q : Rational} ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      FinitePrefixLower terms zero q

    next-prefix-lower :
      {n : Nat} ->
      {p r q : Rational} ->
      FinitePrefixLower terms n p ->
      ENNLower (terms n) r ->
      RationalLT q (addQ p r) ->
      FinitePrefixLower terms (suc n) q

ENNEqual : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNEqual x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x q) (ENNLower y q)

ENNLE : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNLE x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  ENNLower x q ->
  ENNLower y q

IsZeroENN : ENNReal -> Prop
IsZeroENN x =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x q) (RationalLT q zeroQ)

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Predicate A =
  A -> Prop

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

Difference :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Difference S T =
  Intersection S (Complement T)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop a
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

SamePredicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop a
SamePredicate {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (S x) (T x)

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A ->
      Prop

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record OuterMeasure
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    mass :
      Predicate A ->
      ENNReal

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      ENNEqual (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-empty :
      IsZeroENN (mass Empty)

    mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      Subset S T ->
      ENNLE (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-countable-subadditive :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ENNLE
        (mass (CountableUnion sets))
        (countableSumENN (\ n -> mass (sets n)))

open OuterMeasure

IsCaratheodory :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  OuterMeasure A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
IsCaratheodory {A = A} outer S =
  (T : Predicate A) ->
  ENNEqual
    (mass outer T)
    (sumENN
      (mass outer (Intersection T S))
      (mass outer (Difference T S)))

CaratheodoryMeasurableSpace :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (outer : OuterMeasure A) ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
CaratheodoryMeasurableSpace {A = A} outer =
  Exists
    (SigmaAlgebra A)
    (\ caratheodory ->
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      Iff
        (measurable caratheodory S)
        (IsCaratheodory outer S))

caratheodory-s-theorem-measure-theory :
  {a : Level} ->
  Prop (lsuc a)
caratheodory-s-theorem-measure-theory {a} =
  ExcludedMiddle lzero ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (outer : OuterMeasure A) ->
  CaratheodoryMeasurableSpace outer

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q258374 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q258374), "Carathéodory's theorem
  (measure theory)": the Carathéodory measurable space of an arbitrary outer
  measure consists exactly of the sets satisfying the outer-measure splitting
  criterion. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;

val q258374_caratheodory_def = new_definition (
  "q258374_caratheodory_def",
  ``q258374_caratheodory (m : 'a set -> extreal) =
      ((UNIV : 'a set),
       {s : 'a set |
         !t : 'a set.
           m t = m (t INTER s) + m (t DIFF s)})``);

val caratheodory_measurable_space =
  ``!(m : 'a set -> extreal).
      outer_measure_space (UNIV, POW UNIV, m)
      ==>
      sigma_algebra (q258374_caratheodory m) /\
      !s : 'a set.
        (s IN subsets (q258374_caratheodory m) <=>
         !t : 'a set.
           m t = m (t INTER s) + m (t DIFF s))``;

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q258374
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q258374), "Carathéodory's theorem (measure
  theory)": the sets satisfying Carathéodory's splitting criterion for an
  arbitrary outer measure form a sigma-algebra. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q258374OuterMeasure X O says that O is an extended-nonnegative-valued outer
  measure on every subset of the arbitrary base set X: it vanishes on the
  empty set, is monotone, and is countably subadditive for every NN0-indexed
  sequence of subsets.

  Q258374Caratheodory X O is the family of subsets E of X such that every
  test set A is split additively by E:

    O(A) = O(A intersect E) + O(A difference E).

  The final unproved $a statement says that this exact family is a
  sigma-algebra on X and restates its membership criterion. All preceding
  root-artifact $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and the
  root artifact declares no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q258374OuterMeasure Q258374Caratheodory $.

q258374-outer-measure-syntax
  $a wff ( Q258374OuterMeasure X O ) $.
q258374-caratheodory-syntax
  $a class ( Q258374Caratheodory X O ) $.

${
  $d A B F O X n $.

  q258374-outer-measure-definition $a |- (
    ( Q258374OuterMeasure X O )
    <->
    (
      O : ~P X --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        (
          ( O ` (/) ) = 0
          /\
          A. A e. ~P X
            A. B e. ~P X
              (
                A C_ B
                ->
                ( O ` A ) <_ ( O ` B )
              )
        )
        /\
        A. F e. ( ( ~P X ) ^m NN0 )
          ( O ` U. ran F )
          <_
          sum* n e. NN0 ( O ` ( F ` n ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E O X $.

  q258374-caratheodory-definition $a |- (
    Q258374Caratheodory X O
    =
    { E e. ~P X |
      A. A e. ~P X
        ( O ` A )
        =
        (
          ( O ` ( A i^i E ) )
          +e
          ( O ` ( A \ E ) )
        )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A E O X $.

  thousand-theorems-q258374-caratheodory-measure-theory $a |-
    A. X A. O
      (
        (
          X e. _V
          /\
          ( Q258374OuterMeasure X O )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( Q258374Caratheodory X O )
            e. ( sigAlgebra ` X )
          /\
          A. E e. ~P X
            (
              E e. ( Q258374Caratheodory X O )
              <->
              A. A e. ~P X
                ( O ` A )
                =
                (
                  ( O ` ( A i^i E ) )
                  +e
                  ( O ` ( A \ E ) )
                )
            )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q258374_carath_odory_s_theorem_measure_theory
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q258374,
% "Carathéodory's theorem (measure theory)": the Carathéodory-measurable sets of an
% arbitrary outer measure form a measurable space. This file contains no proof.

caratheodory_theorem_measure_theory_Q258374[X: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  event_family: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  outer_measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_add(
      left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      (# infinite_flag := FALSE,
         finite_part := finite_part(left) + finite_part(right) #)
    ENDIF

  measure_value_le(
      left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  event_subset(left, right: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      left(x) IMPLIES right(x)

  event_intersection(left, right: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      left(x) AND right(x)

  event_difference(left, right: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      left(x) AND NOT right(x)

  event_complement(value: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      NOT value(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        events(index)(x)

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_outer_measure(mu: outer_measure_map): bool =
    (FORALL (value: event):
      canonical_measure_value(mu(value)))
      AND mu(empty_event) = zero_measure_value
      AND (FORALL (left, right: event):
        event_subset(left, right) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(mu(left), mu(right)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        EXISTS (total: measure_value):
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              mu(events(index)),
            total)
            AND measure_value_le(
              mu(countable_union(events)),
              total))

  is_sigma_algebra(family: event_family): bool =
    family(empty_event)
      AND (FORALL (value: event):
        family(value) IMPLIES
          family(event_complement(value)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          family(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          family(countable_union(events)))

  caratheodory_measurable(
      mu: outer_measure_map,
      value: event): bool =
    FORALL (test: event):
      mu(test) =
        measure_value_add(
          mu(event_intersection(test, value)),
          mu(event_difference(test, value)))

  caratheodory_family(
      mu: outer_measure_map): event_family =
    LAMBDA (value: event):
      caratheodory_measurable(mu, value)

  caratheodory_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (mu: outer_measure_map):
      is_outer_measure(mu) IMPLIES
        is_sigma_algebra(caratheodory_family(mu))
END caratheodory_theorem_measure_theory_Q258374
