title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2631152
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2631152), "Carathéodory's extension theorem":
  the measure induced by a sigma-subadditive extended-nonnegative additive
  content on a semiring agrees with that content on every semiring set when
  the semiring generates the ambient measurable space. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2631152_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q2631152_empty {A : Type} : q2631152_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q2631152_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q2631152_set A) : q2631152_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q2631152_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q2631152_set A) : q2631152_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q2631152_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q2631152_set A) : q2631152_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ ~ F x.

Definition q2631152_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q2631152_set A) : q2631152_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q2631152_finite_union {A : Type}
    (n : nat) (E : nat -> q2631152_set A) : q2631152_set A :=
  fun x => exists i : nat, (i < n)%nat /\ E i x.

Definition q2631152_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q2631152_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q2631152_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q2631152_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q2631152_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q2631152_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q2631152_pairwise_disjoint_below {A : Type}
    (n : nat) (E : nat -> q2631152_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    (i < n)%nat ->
    (j < n)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q2631152_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q2631152_distinct_below {A : Type}
    (n : nat) (E : nat -> q2631152_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    (i < n)%nat ->
    (j < n)%nat ->
    q2631152_same_set (E i) (E j) ->
    i = j.

Inductive q2631152_ennreal : Type :=
| q2631152_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q2631152_ennreal
| q2631152_ennreal_infinity : q2631152_ennreal.

Arguments q2631152_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q2631152_ennreal_zero : q2631152_ennreal :=
  q2631152_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q2631152_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2631152_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2631152_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q2631152_ennreal_infinity,
    q2631152_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q2631152_ennreal_le
    (x y : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q2631152_ennreal_finite a _,
    q2631152_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q2631152_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q2631152_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q2631152_ennreal_infinity,
    q2631152_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q2631152_ennreal_infinity,
    q2631152_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q2631152_ennreal_add
    (x y : q2631152_ennreal) : q2631152_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q2631152_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q2631152_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q2631152_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q2631152_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q2631152_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q2631152_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q2631152_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q2631152_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q2631152_ennreal_add
        (q2631152_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q2631152_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q2631152_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q2631152_ennreal,
      values value -> q2631152_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q2631152_ennreal,
      (forall value : q2631152_ennreal,
        values value -> q2631152_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q2631152_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q2631152_ennreal_infimum
    (values : q2631152_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q2631152_ennreal,
      values value -> q2631152_ennreal_le bound value) /\
  (forall lower : q2631152_ennreal,
      (forall value : q2631152_ennreal,
        values value -> q2631152_ennreal_le lower value) ->
      q2631152_ennreal_le lower bound).

Definition q2631152_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q2631152_ennreal)
    (sum : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2631152_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q2631152_ennreal_eq value
          (q2631152_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q2631152_ennreal_finite_sum
    {A : Type}
    (m : q2631152_set A -> q2631152_ennreal)
    (E : nat -> q2631152_set A)
    (n : nat) : q2631152_ennreal :=
  q2631152_ennreal_partial_sum (fun i => m (E i)) n.

Record q2631152_set_semiring
    (A : Type) (C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)) : Prop := {
  q2631152_semiring_extensional :
    forall E F : q2631152_set A,
      q2631152_same_set E F ->
      C E ->
      C F;
  q2631152_semiring_empty :
    C q2631152_empty;
  q2631152_semiring_intersection :
    forall E F : q2631152_set A,
      C E ->
      C F ->
      C (q2631152_intersection E F);
  q2631152_semiring_difference :
    forall E F : q2631152_set A,
      C E ->
      C F ->
      exists (n : nat) (pieces : nat -> q2631152_set A),
        q2631152_distinct_below n pieces /\
        (forall i : nat, (i < n)%nat -> C (pieces i)) /\
        q2631152_pairwise_disjoint_below n pieces /\
        q2631152_same_set
          (q2631152_difference E F)
          (q2631152_finite_union n pieces)
}.

Record q2631152_add_content
    (A : Type) (C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)) : Type := {
  q2631152_content_value :
    q2631152_set A -> q2631152_ennreal;
  q2631152_content_extensional :
    forall E F : q2631152_set A,
      q2631152_same_set E F ->
      q2631152_ennreal_eq
        (q2631152_content_value E)
        (q2631152_content_value F);
  q2631152_content_empty :
    q2631152_ennreal_eq
      (q2631152_content_value q2631152_empty)
      q2631152_ennreal_zero;
  q2631152_content_finitely_additive :
    forall (n : nat) (E : nat -> q2631152_set A),
      q2631152_distinct_below n E ->
      (forall i : nat, (i < n)%nat -> C (E i)) ->
      q2631152_pairwise_disjoint_below n E ->
      C (q2631152_finite_union n E) ->
      q2631152_ennreal_eq
        (q2631152_content_value
          (q2631152_finite_union n E))
        (q2631152_ennreal_finite_sum
          q2631152_content_value E n)
}.

Arguments q2631152_content_value {A C} _ _.

Definition q2631152_sigma_subadditive
    {A : Type} {C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)}
    (m : @q2631152_add_content A C) : Prop :=
  forall E : nat -> q2631152_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q2631152_countable_union E) ->
    exists total : q2631152_ennreal,
      q2631152_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q2631152_content_value m (E n))
        total /\
      q2631152_ennreal_le
        (q2631152_content_value m
          (q2631152_countable_union E))
        total.

Record q2631152_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q2631152_measurable : q2631152_set A -> Prop;
  q2631152_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q2631152_set A,
      q2631152_same_set E F ->
      (q2631152_measurable E <-> q2631152_measurable F);
  q2631152_measurable_empty :
    q2631152_measurable q2631152_empty;
  q2631152_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q2631152_set A,
      q2631152_measurable E ->
      q2631152_measurable (q2631152_complement E);
  q2631152_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q2631152_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2631152_measurable (E n)) ->
      q2631152_measurable (q2631152_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q2631152_measurable {A} _ _.

Inductive q2631152_generated_measurable
    {A : Type}
    (C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A))
    : q2631152_set A -> Prop :=
| q2631152_generated_basic :
    forall E : q2631152_set A,
      C E ->
      q2631152_generated_measurable C E
| q2631152_generated_empty :
    q2631152_generated_measurable C q2631152_empty
| q2631152_generated_extensional :
    forall E F : q2631152_set A,
      q2631152_generated_measurable C E ->
      q2631152_same_set E F ->
      q2631152_generated_measurable C F
| q2631152_generated_complement :
    forall E : q2631152_set A,
      q2631152_generated_measurable C E ->
      q2631152_generated_measurable C
        (q2631152_complement E)
| q2631152_generated_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q2631152_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q2631152_generated_measurable C (E n)) ->
      q2631152_generated_measurable C
        (q2631152_countable_union E).

Definition q2631152_is_generated_by
    {A : Type}
    (M : q2631152_measurable_space A)
    (C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)) : Prop :=
  forall E : q2631152_set A,
    q2631152_measurable M E <->
    q2631152_generated_measurable C E.

Definition q2631152_cover_cost
    {A : Type} {C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)}
    (m : @q2631152_add_content A C)
    (S : q2631152_set A)
    (cost : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists cover : nat -> q2631152_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (cover n)) /\
    q2631152_subset S (q2631152_countable_union cover) /\
    q2631152_ennreal_series_sum
      (fun n => q2631152_content_value m (cover n))
      cost.

Definition q2631152_induced_outer_measure_has_value
    {A : Type} {C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)}
    (m : @q2631152_add_content A C)
    (S : q2631152_set A)
    (value : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2631152_ennreal_infimum
    (q2631152_cover_cost m S)
    value.

Definition q2631152_generated_measure_has_value
    {A : Type} {C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set A)}
    (_M : q2631152_measurable_space A)
    (m : @q2631152_add_content A C)
    (S : q2631152_set A)
    (value : q2631152_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q2631152_induced_outer_measure_has_value m S value.

Theorem MeasureTheory_AddContent_measure_eq :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (C : q2631152_set (q2631152_set Alpha))
         (M : q2631152_measurable_space Alpha)
         (m : @q2631152_add_content Alpha C)
         (S : q2631152_set Alpha),
    @q2631152_set_semiring Alpha C ->
    q2631152_is_generated_by M C ->
    q2631152_sigma_subadditive m ->
    C S ->
    exists value : q2631152_ennreal,
      q2631152_generated_measure_has_value M m S value /\
      q2631152_ennreal_eq
        value (q2631152_content_value m S).
Admitted.

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2631152,
  "Carathéodory's extension theorem": the measure constructed from a
  sigma-subadditive additive content on a generating semiring agrees with that
  content on every set in the semiring. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Caratheodory"
begin

definition q2631152_set_semiring :: "'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2631152_set_semiring C \<longleftrightarrow>
    {} \<in> C \<and>
    (\<forall>s \<in> C. \<forall>t \<in> C. s \<inter> t \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>s \<in> C. \<forall>t \<in> C.
      \<exists>I. finite I \<and> I \<subseteq> C \<and> disjoint I \<and>
        s - t = \<Union>I)"

definition q2631152_add_content ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2631152_add_content C m \<longleftrightarrow>
    m {} = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>I. finite I \<longrightarrow> I \<subseteq> C \<longrightarrow> disjoint I \<longrightarrow>
      \<Union>I \<in> C \<longrightarrow> m (\<Union>I) = (\<Sum>u\<in>I. m u))"

definition q2631152_sigma_subadditive ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> ('a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2631152_sigma_subadditive C m \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>F :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>i. F i \<in> C) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<Union>i. F i) \<in> C \<longrightarrow>
      m (\<Union>i. F i) \<le> (\<Sum>i. m (F i)))"

definition q2631152_generated_measure ::
    "'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure" where
  "q2631152_generated_measure A C m =
    measure_of UNIV A (emeasure (extend_measure UNIV C id m))"

theorem q2631152_caratheodory_extension_agrees:
  fixes A C :: "'a set set"
    and m :: "'a set \<Rightarrow> ennreal"
    and s :: "'a set"
  assumes semiring: "q2631152_set_semiring C"
    and content: "q2631152_add_content C m"
    and sigma_subadditive: "q2631152_sigma_subadditive C m"
    and generated: "A = sigma_sets UNIV C"
    and hs: "s \<in> C"
  shows "emeasure (q2631152_generated_measure A C m) s = m s"
  sorry

end

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2631152
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q2631152), "Carathéodory's extension theorem":
  a sigma-subadditive additive content on a semiring of sets agrees, on every
  semiring set, with its Carathéodory measure on the generated sigma-algebra.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q2631152_CARATHEODORY_S_EXTENSION_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(n:num) (u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) = eadd (partial i) (u i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let is_infimum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v. p v ==> enonnegative v /\ ele z v) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!v. p v ==> ele w v)
             ==> ele w z) in
   let set_semiring =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool).
        C {} /\
        (!s t:A->bool.
           C s /\ C t ==> C (s INTER t)) /\
        (!s t:A->bool.
           C s /\ C t
           ==> ?n:num pieces:num->A->bool.
                 (!i. i < n ==> C (pieces i)) /\
                 (!i j.
                    i < n /\ j < n /\ ~(i = j)
                    ==> DISJOINT (pieces i) (pieces j)) /\
                 s DIFF t =
                   {x:A | ?i:num. i < n /\ x IN pieces i}) in
   let additive_content =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (m:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (m s)) /\
        m {} = ezero /\
        (!n:num sets:num->A->bool.
           (!i. i < n ==> C (sets i)) /\
           (!i j.
              i < n /\ j < n /\ ~(i = j)
              ==> DISJOINT (sets i) (sets j)) /\
           C {x:A | ?i:num. i < n /\ x IN sets i}
           ==> ?total:bool#real.
                 finite_esum n (\i. m (sets i)) total /\
                 m {x:A | ?i:num. i < n /\ x IN sets i} =
                 total) in
   let sigma_subadditive =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (m:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !sets:num->A->bool.
          (!n. C (sets n)) /\
          C {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}
          ==> ?total:bool#real.
                esum (\n. m (sets n)) total /\
                ele (m {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) total in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let generated_event =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool).
        !events:(A->bool)->bool.
          sigma_algebra events /\
          (!u:A->bool. C u ==> events u)
          ==> events s in
   let generated_space =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:A->bool. events s <=> generated_event C s) in
   let extended_content =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (m:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_infimum
            (\v:bool#real.
               ?t:A->bool.
                 C t /\ s SUBSET t /\ v = m t)
            z in
   let cover_sum =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (m:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool) (v:bool#real).
        ?sets:num->A->bool.
          s SUBSET {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n} /\
          esum (\n. extended_content C m (sets n)) v in
   let induced_outer_value =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (m:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_infimum (cover_sum C m s) z in
   let trimmed_outer_value =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (outer:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_infimum
            (\v:bool#real.
               ?t:A->bool.
                 events t /\ s SUBSET t /\ v = outer t)
            z in
   let caratheodory_measure =
      \(C:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (m:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool).
        trimmed_outer_value events (induced_outer_value C m) s in
   !C:(A->bool)->bool
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    m:(A->bool)->bool#real
    s:A->bool.
      set_semiring C /\
      additive_content C m /\
      generated_space C events /\
      sigma_subadditive C m /\
      C s
      ==> caratheodory_measure C events m s = m s`;;

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2631152,
;; "Carathéodory's extension theorem": the measure constructed from a
;; sigma-subadditive additive content on a semiring of sets agrees with that
;; content on every set of the semiring. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Arbitrary function, predicate, set, and family objects are represented by
;; tags interpreted through conservative application interfaces.  The
;; predicates below impose all typing, set, semiring, real-number, content,
;; generated-sigma-algebra, and countable-cover laws explicitly.

(defstub q2631152-apply1 (function argument) t)
(defstub q2631152-apply2 (function left right) t)

(defstub q2631152-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q2631152-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q2631152-empty-set (point-carrier) t)
(defstub q2631152-complement-set (point-carrier set) t)
(defstub q2631152-intersection-set (point-carrier left right) t)
(defstub q2631152-difference-set (point-carrier left right) t)
(defstub q2631152-union-set (point-carrier left right) t)
(defstub q2631152-countable-union-set (point-carrier family) t)

;; A Dedekind-complete linearly ordered field presents the real numbers.

(defun q2631152-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2631152-r-less real right left)))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-r-member-p real x)
      (q2631152-r-member-p real y)
      (q2631152-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q2631152-r-zero real))
            (one (q2631152-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q2631152-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q2631152-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q2631152-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q2631152-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q2631152-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q2631152-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q2631152-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q2631152-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q2631152-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q2631152-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q2631152-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q2631152-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q2631152-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q2631152-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q2631152-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q2631152-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q2631152-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q2631152-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q2631152-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q2631152-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q2631152-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q2631152-r-multiply
          real x (q2631152-r-add real y z))
         (q2631152-r-add
          real
          (q2631152-r-multiply real x y)
          (q2631152-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-r-member-p real x)
      (q2631152-r-member-p real y)
      (q2631152-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q2631152-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q2631152-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q2631152-r-less real x y)
         (q2631152-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2631152-r-less real x y)
          (q2631152-r-less real y z))
         (q2631152-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q2631152-r-less real x y)
         (q2631152-r-less
          real
          (q2631152-r-add real x z)
          (q2631152-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2631152-r-less real zero x)
          (q2631152-r-less real zero y))
         (q2631152-r-less
          real zero
          (q2631152-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q2631152-r-member-p real x)
     (q2631152-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-r-member-p real x)
      (q2631152-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q2631152-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q2631152-r-member-p real bound)
     (q2631152-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2631152-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q2631152-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2631152-r-member-p real bound)
       (q2631152-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q2631152-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q2631152-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q2631152-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q2631152-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q2631152-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q2631152-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q2631152-r-zero real))
        (one (q2631152-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q2631152-r-member-p real zero)
     (q2631152-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q2631152-r-less real zero one)
     (q2631152-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q2631152-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q2631152-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals are represented canonically by a nonnegative
;; real value or a distinguished top element.

(defun q2631152-ennreal-finite (real value)
  (list :q2631152-finite real value))

(defun q2631152-ennreal-top (real)
  (list :q2631152-top real))

(defun q2631152-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q2631152-ennreal-finite real (q2631152-r-zero real)))

(defun q2631152-ennreal-finite-p (real value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 3)
   (equal (car value) :q2631152-finite)
   (equal (cadr value) real)
   (q2631152-r-member-p real (caddr value))
   (q2631152-r-leq
    real (q2631152-r-zero real) (caddr value))))

(defun q2631152-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value (q2631152-ennreal-top real))
   (q2631152-ennreal-finite-p real value)))

(defun q2631152-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal right (q2631152-ennreal-top real)) t)
   ((equal left (q2631152-ennreal-top real)) nil)
   (t
    (q2631152-r-leq real (caddr left) (caddr right)))))

(defun q2631152-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if
      (or
       (equal left (q2631152-ennreal-top real))
       (equal right (q2631152-ennreal-top real)))
      (q2631152-ennreal-top real)
    (q2631152-ennreal-finite
     real
     (q2631152-r-add real (caddr left) (caddr right)))))

;; Arbitrary subsets of the point carrier and their operations.

(defun q2631152-point-member-p (point-carrier value)
  (if (q2631152-apply1 point-carrier value) t nil))

(defun-sk q2631152-set-p (point-carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2631152-apply1 set x)
     (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x))))

(defun-sk q2631152-set-equivalent-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
     (iff
      (q2631152-apply1 left x)
      (q2631152-apply1 right x)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-subset-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q2631152-apply1 left x))
     (q2631152-apply1 right x))))

(defun-sk q2631152-disjoint-p
    (point-carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
     (not
      (and
       (q2631152-apply1 left x)
       (q2631152-apply1 right x))))))

(defun-sk q2631152-family-values-are-sets-p
    (point-carrier family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2631152-set-p
      point-carrier (q2631152-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-family-member-exists-p (family x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2631152-apply1 (q2631152-apply1 family n) x))))

(defun-sk q2631152-set-extensionality-p (point-carrier)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-set-p point-carrier left)
      (q2631152-set-p point-carrier right)
      (q2631152-set-equivalent-p point-carrier left right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q2631152-basic-set-operation-laws-p (point-carrier)
  (forall (left right x)
    (and
     (q2631152-set-p
      point-carrier (q2631152-empty-set point-carrier))
     (implies
      (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
      (not
       (q2631152-apply1
        (q2631152-empty-set point-carrier) x)))
     (implies
      (q2631152-set-p point-carrier left)
      (and
       (q2631152-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q2631152-complement-set point-carrier left))
       (implies
        (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
        (iff
         (q2631152-apply1
          (q2631152-complement-set point-carrier left) x)
         (not (q2631152-apply1 left x))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2631152-set-p point-carrier left)
       (q2631152-set-p point-carrier right))
      (and
       (q2631152-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q2631152-intersection-set
         point-carrier left right))
       (q2631152-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q2631152-difference-set point-carrier left right))
       (q2631152-set-p
        point-carrier
        (q2631152-union-set point-carrier left right))
       (implies
        (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
        (and
         (iff
          (q2631152-apply1
           (q2631152-intersection-set
            point-carrier left right)
           x)
          (and
           (q2631152-apply1 left x)
           (q2631152-apply1 right x)))
         (iff
          (q2631152-apply1
           (q2631152-difference-set
            point-carrier left right)
           x)
          (and
           (q2631152-apply1 left x)
           (not (q2631152-apply1 right x))))
         (iff
          (q2631152-apply1
           (q2631152-union-set point-carrier left right)
           x)
          (or
           (q2631152-apply1 left x)
           (q2631152-apply1 right x))))))))))

(defun-sk q2631152-countable-union-laws-p (point-carrier)
  (forall (family x)
    (implies
     (q2631152-family-values-are-sets-p
      point-carrier family)
     (and
      (q2631152-set-p
       point-carrier
       (q2631152-countable-union-set
        point-carrier family))
      (implies
       (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
       (iff
        (q2631152-apply1
         (q2631152-countable-union-set
          point-carrier family)
         x)
        (q2631152-family-member-exists-p family x)))))))

(defun q2631152-set-interface-p (point-carrier)
  (and
   (q2631152-set-extensionality-p point-carrier)
   (q2631152-basic-set-operation-laws-p point-carrier)
   (q2631152-countable-union-laws-p point-carrier)))

;; Finite lists represent the genuinely finite decompositions in the source
;; definition of a semiring of sets and of finite additivity.

(defun q2631152-set-list-p (point-carrier sets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sets)))
  (if (endp sets)
      (equal sets nil)
    (and
     (q2631152-set-p point-carrier (car sets))
     (q2631152-set-list-p point-carrier (cdr sets)))))

(defun q2631152-all-in-family-p (family sets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sets)))
  (if (endp sets)
      (equal sets nil)
    (and
     (q2631152-apply1 family (car sets))
     (q2631152-all-in-family-p family (cdr sets)))))

(defun q2631152-disjoint-from-list-p
    (point-carrier set sets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sets)))
  (if (endp sets)
      (equal sets nil)
    (and
     (q2631152-disjoint-p
      point-carrier set (car sets))
     (q2631152-disjoint-from-list-p
      point-carrier set (cdr sets)))))

(defun q2631152-pairwise-disjoint-list-p
    (point-carrier sets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sets)))
  (if (endp sets)
      (equal sets nil)
    (and
     (q2631152-disjoint-from-list-p
      point-carrier (car sets) (cdr sets))
     (q2631152-pairwise-disjoint-list-p
      point-carrier (cdr sets)))))

(defun q2631152-finite-union
    (point-carrier sets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sets)))
  (if (endp sets)
      (q2631152-empty-set point-carrier)
    (q2631152-union-set
     point-carrier
     (car sets)
     (q2631152-finite-union point-carrier (cdr sets)))))

(defun q2631152-finite-content-sum
    (real content sets)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count sets)))
  (if (endp sets)
      (q2631152-ennreal-zero real)
    (q2631152-ennreal-add
     real
     (q2631152-apply1 content (car sets))
     (q2631152-finite-content-sum
      real content (cdr sets)))))

;; A semiring contains the empty set, is closed under intersection, and each
;; difference is a finite pairwise-disjoint union of semiring members.

(defun-sk q2631152-difference-decomposition-exists-p
    (point-carrier semiring left right)
  (exists (parts)
    (and
     (true-listp parts)
     (no-duplicatesp-equal parts)
     (q2631152-set-list-p point-carrier parts)
     (q2631152-all-in-family-p semiring parts)
     (q2631152-pairwise-disjoint-list-p
      point-carrier parts)
     (equal
      (q2631152-difference-set
       point-carrier left right)
      (q2631152-finite-union point-carrier parts)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-semiring-members-are-sets-p
    (point-carrier semiring)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2631152-apply1 semiring set)
     (q2631152-set-p point-carrier set))))

(defun-sk q2631152-semiring-closure-p
    (point-carrier semiring)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-apply1 semiring left)
      (q2631152-apply1 semiring right))
     (and
      (q2631152-apply1
       semiring
       (q2631152-intersection-set
        point-carrier left right))
      (q2631152-difference-decomposition-exists-p
       point-carrier semiring left right)))))

(defun q2631152-set-semiring-p
    (point-carrier semiring)
  (and
   (q2631152-semiring-members-are-sets-p
    point-carrier semiring)
   (q2631152-apply1
    semiring (q2631152-empty-set point-carrier))
   (q2631152-semiring-closure-p
    point-carrier semiring)))

;; The given measurable space is exactly the sigma algebra generated by the
;; semiring, expressed by its universal minimality property.

(defun-sk q2631152-sigma-members-are-sets-p
    (point-carrier sigma)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2631152-apply1 sigma set)
     (q2631152-set-p point-carrier set))))

(defun-sk q2631152-family-values-in-sigma-p
    (sigma family)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2631152-apply1
      sigma (q2631152-apply1 family n)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-sigma-closure-p
    (point-carrier sigma)
  (forall (set family)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2631152-apply1 sigma set)
      (q2631152-apply1
       sigma
       (q2631152-complement-set point-carrier set)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q2631152-family-values-are-sets-p
        point-carrier family)
       (q2631152-family-values-in-sigma-p sigma family))
      (q2631152-apply1
       sigma
       (q2631152-countable-union-set
        point-carrier family))))))

(defun q2631152-sigma-algebra-p
    (point-carrier sigma)
  (and
   (q2631152-sigma-members-are-sets-p
    point-carrier sigma)
   (q2631152-apply1
    sigma (q2631152-empty-set point-carrier))
   (q2631152-sigma-closure-p point-carrier sigma)))

(defun-sk q2631152-family-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2631152-apply1 left set)
     (q2631152-apply1 right set))))

(defun-sk q2631152-generated-minimal-p
    (point-carrier semiring measurable-space)
  (forall (other)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-sigma-algebra-p
       point-carrier other)
      (q2631152-family-subset-p semiring other))
     (q2631152-family-subset-p
      measurable-space other))))

(defun q2631152-generated-measurable-space-p
    (point-carrier semiring measurable-space)
  (and
   (q2631152-sigma-algebra-p
    point-carrier measurable-space)
   (q2631152-family-subset-p
    semiring measurable-space)
   (q2631152-generated-minimal-p
    point-carrier semiring measurable-space)))

;; Countable sums in ENNReal are least upper bounds of their finite partial
;; sums.

(defun q2631152-series-partial-sum
    (real values count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q2631152-ennreal-zero real)
    (q2631152-ennreal-add
     real
     (q2631152-series-partial-sum
      real values (1- count))
     (q2631152-apply1 values (1- count)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-series-values-p (real values)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q2631152-ennreal-p
      real (q2631152-apply1 values n)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-series-upper-bound-p
    (real values bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q2631152-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2631152-series-partial-sum
       real values count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q2631152-series-sum-p
    (real values total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2631152-series-values-p real values)
     (q2631152-ennreal-p real total)
     (q2631152-series-upper-bound-p
      real values total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2631152-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q2631152-series-upper-bound-p
        real values bound))
      (q2631152-ennreal-leq
       real total bound)))))

;; An AddContent is zero on the empty set and finitely additive on finite
;; pairwise-disjoint semiring families whose union is in the semiring.

(defun-sk q2631152-content-values-p
    (real point-carrier content)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q2631152-set-p point-carrier set)
     (q2631152-ennreal-p
      real (q2631152-apply1 content set)))))

(defun-sk q2631152-content-finite-additivity-p
    (real point-carrier semiring content)
  (forall (parts)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp parts)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal parts)
      (q2631152-set-list-p point-carrier parts)
      (q2631152-all-in-family-p semiring parts)
      (q2631152-pairwise-disjoint-list-p
       point-carrier parts)
      (q2631152-apply1
       semiring
       (q2631152-finite-union
        point-carrier parts)))
     (equal
      (q2631152-apply1
       content
       (q2631152-finite-union
        point-carrier parts))
      (q2631152-finite-content-sum
       real content parts)))))

(defun q2631152-add-content-p
    (real point-carrier semiring content)
  (and
   (q2631152-content-values-p
    real point-carrier content)
   (equal
    (q2631152-apply1
     content (q2631152-empty-set point-carrier))
    (q2631152-ennreal-zero real))
   (q2631152-content-finite-additivity-p
    real point-carrier semiring content)))

(defun-sk q2631152-content-family-values-p
    (real content family values)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (q2631152-apply1 values n)
      (q2631152-apply1
       content (q2631152-apply1 family n))))))

(defun-sk q2631152-content-series-sum-exists-p
    (real content family)
  (exists (values total)
    (and
     (q2631152-content-family-values-p
      real content family values)
     (q2631152-series-sum-p real values total))))

(defun-sk q2631152-content-series-bounds-union-p
    (real point-carrier content family union)
  (exists (values total)
    (and
     (q2631152-content-family-values-p
      real content family values)
     (q2631152-series-sum-p real values total)
     (q2631152-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q2631152-apply1 content union)
      total))))

(defun-sk q2631152-sigma-subadditive-content-p
    (real point-carrier semiring content)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-family-values-are-sets-p
       point-carrier family)
      (q2631152-family-values-in-sigma-p
       semiring family)
      (q2631152-apply1
       semiring
       (q2631152-countable-union-set
        point-carrier family)))
     (q2631152-content-series-bounds-union-p
      real
      point-carrier
      content
      family
      (q2631152-countable-union-set
       point-carrier family)))))

;; The induced outer-measure value is the infimum of the sums of all
;; countable semiring covers.  This is the value used by the Carathéodory
;; measure and by its trim to the generated measurable space.

(defun-sk q2631152-family-covers-set-p
    (point-carrier family target)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-point-member-p point-carrier x)
      (q2631152-apply1 target x))
     (q2631152-apply1
      (q2631152-countable-union-set
       point-carrier family)
      x))))

(defun q2631152-cover-cost-p
    (real point-carrier semiring content target
     family values total)
  (and
   (q2631152-family-values-are-sets-p
    point-carrier family)
   (q2631152-family-values-in-sigma-p
    semiring family)
   (q2631152-family-covers-set-p
    point-carrier family target)
   (q2631152-content-family-values-p
    real content family values)
   (q2631152-series-sum-p real values total)))

(defun-sk q2631152-cover-cost-lower-bound-p
    (real point-carrier semiring content target lower)
  (forall (family values total)
    (implies
     (q2631152-cover-cost-p
      real point-carrier semiring content target
      family values total)
     (q2631152-ennreal-leq real lower total))))

(defun-sk q2631152-induced-outer-measure-value-p
    (real point-carrier semiring content target value)
  (forall (lower)
    (and
     (q2631152-ennreal-p real value)
     (q2631152-cover-cost-lower-bound-p
      real point-carrier semiring content target value)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2631152-ennreal-p real lower)
       (q2631152-cover-cost-lower-bound-p
        real point-carrier semiring content target lower))
      (q2631152-ennreal-leq real lower value)))))

(defun q2631152-constructed-measure-value-p
    (real point-carrier semiring measurable-space
     content target value)
  (and
   (q2631152-apply1 measurable-space target)
   (q2631152-induced-outer-measure-value-p
    real point-carrier semiring content target value)))

(defun-sk q2631152-constructed-measure-agrees-p
    (real point-carrier semiring measurable-space
     content target)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q2631152-constructed-measure-value-p
      real point-carrier semiring measurable-space
      content target value)
     (equal value (q2631152-apply1 content target)))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q2631152-caratheodorys-extension-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall
    (real point-carrier semiring measurable-space content target)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2631152-real-field-p real)
      (q2631152-set-interface-p point-carrier)
      (q2631152-set-semiring-p
       point-carrier semiring)
      (q2631152-generated-measurable-space-p
       point-carrier semiring measurable-space)
      (q2631152-add-content-p
       real point-carrier semiring content)
      (q2631152-sigma-subadditive-content-p
       real point-carrier semiring content)
      (q2631152-apply1 semiring target))
     (q2631152-constructed-measure-agrees-p
      real point-carrier semiring measurable-space
      content target))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2631152,
-- "Carathéodory's extension theorem": a sigma-subadditive ENNReal-valued
-- additive content on a set semiring agrees there with the canonical measure
-- generated by countable covers when the semiring generates the measurable
-- space. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe --prop #-}

module Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_; Prop)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Prop p where

record Top {p : Level} : Prop p where
  constructor top

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Prop p ->
  Prop p
Not {p} A =
  A -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Prop p) :
  Prop (a ⊔ p) where

  witness :
    (value : A) ->
    P value ->
    Exists A P

infix 4 _==N_ _!=N_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

data _==N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  reflN : {n : Nat} -> n ==N n

_!=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m !=N n =
  Not (m ==N n)

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

-- Rationals are represented by an integer numerator and a positive
-- denominator. Equality and order quotient this presentation.
record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart    : Nat
    negativePart    : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue : Rational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalEqual q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  ==N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLT : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalLT q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

-- Finite nonnegative reals are located lower Dedekind cuts of the rationals.
record DedekindReal : Set1 where
  field
    lower :
      Rational ->
      Prop

    lower-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (lower q) (lower r)

    lower-inhabited :
      Exists Rational lower

    lower-proper :
      Exists Rational (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    lower-downward :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    lower-rounded :
      (q : Rational) ->
      lower q ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT q r) (lower r))

    lower-located :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

open DedekindReal

record NonnegativeReal : Set1 where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    real :
      DedekindReal

    nonnegative :
      (q : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      lower real q

open NonnegativeReal

-- Constructors are interpreted extensionally by rational lower cuts.
data ENNReal : Set1 where
  zeroENN         : ENNReal
  finite          : NonnegativeReal -> ENNReal
  infinity        : ENNReal
  sumENN          : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal
  countableSumENN : (Nat -> ENNReal) -> ENNReal

mutual
  ENNLower : ENNReal -> Rational -> Prop
  ENNLower zeroENN q =
    RationalLT q zeroQ
  ENNLower (finite x) q =
    lower (real x) q
  ENNLower infinity q =
    Top
  ENNLower (sumENN x y) q =
    Exists Rational
      (\ r ->
        Exists Rational
          (\ s ->
            Both
              (Both (ENNLower x r) (ENNLower y s))
              (RationalLT q (addQ r s))))
  ENNLower (countableSumENN terms) q =
    Exists Nat (\ n -> FinitePrefixLower terms n q)

  data FinitePrefixLower
    (terms : Nat -> ENNReal) :
    Nat ->
    Rational ->
    Prop where

    empty-prefix-lower :
      {q : Rational} ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      FinitePrefixLower terms zero q

    next-prefix-lower :
      {n : Nat} ->
      {p r q : Rational} ->
      FinitePrefixLower terms n p ->
      ENNLower (terms n) r ->
      RationalLT q (addQ p r) ->
      FinitePrefixLower terms (suc n) q

ENNEqual : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNEqual x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x q) (ENNLower y q)

ENNLE : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNLE x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  ENNLower x q ->
  ENNLower y q

IsZeroENN : ENNReal -> Prop
IsZeroENN x =
  ENNEqual x zeroENN

IsInfimum :
  {p : Level} ->
  (ENNReal -> Prop p) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero ⊔ p)
IsInfimum candidates bound =
  Both
    ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE bound x)
    ((lowerBound : ENNReal) ->
      ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE lowerBound x) ->
      ENNLE lowerBound bound)

finiteSumENN :
  (Nat -> ENNReal) ->
  Nat ->
  ENNReal
finiteSumENN terms zero =
  zeroENN
finiteSumENN terms (suc n) =
  sumENN (finiteSumENN terms n) (terms n)

Event :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Event A =
  A -> Prop

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

Difference :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Difference S T =
  Intersection S (Complement T)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Event A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

FiniteUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Event A
FiniteUnion cutoff sets x =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n -> Both (n <N cutoff) (sets n x))

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop a
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

SameEvent :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop a
SameEvent {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (S x) (T x)

PairwiseDisjointBelow :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Prop a
PairwiseDisjointBelow {a = a} {A = A} cutoff sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i <N cutoff ->
  j <N cutoff ->
  i !=N j ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets i x ->
  sets j x ->
  Bottom {a}

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    measurable :
      Event A ->
      Prop

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Event A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      SameEvent S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

data GeneratedMeasurable
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (C : Event A -> Prop) :
  Event A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  generated-basic :
    {S : Event A} ->
    C S ->
    GeneratedMeasurable C S

  generated-empty :
    GeneratedMeasurable C Empty

  generated-complement :
    {S : Event A} ->
    GeneratedMeasurable C S ->
    GeneratedMeasurable C (Complement S)

  generated-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> GeneratedMeasurable C (sets n)) ->
    GeneratedMeasurable C (CountableUnion sets)

  generated-congruent :
    {S T : Event A} ->
    SameEvent S T ->
    GeneratedMeasurable C S ->
    GeneratedMeasurable C T

Generates :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  (Event A -> Prop) ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Generates {A = A} events C =
  (S : Event A) ->
  Iff
    (measurable events S)
    (GeneratedMeasurable C S)

record IsSetSemiring
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (C : Event A -> Prop) :
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    empty-member :
      C Empty

    intersection-member :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      C S ->
      C T ->
      C (Intersection S T)

    difference-finite-disjoint-union :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      C S ->
      C T ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ cutoff ->
          Exists
            (Nat -> Event A)
            (\ pieces ->
              Both
                ((n : Nat) ->
                  n <N cutoff ->
                  C (pieces n))
                (Both
                  (PairwiseDisjointBelow cutoff pieces)
                  (SameEvent
                    (Difference S T)
                    (FiniteUnion cutoff pieces)))))

record AddContent
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (C : Event A -> Prop) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    content :
      Event A ->
      ENNReal

    content-congruent :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      SameEvent S T ->
      ENNEqual (content S) (content T)

    content-empty :
      IsZeroENN (content Empty)

    content-finitely-additive :
      (cutoff : Nat) ->
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> n <N cutoff -> C (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjointBelow cutoff sets ->
      C (FiniteUnion cutoff sets) ->
      ENNEqual
        (content (FiniteUnion cutoff sets))
        (finiteSumENN (\ n -> content (sets n)) cutoff)

open AddContent

IsSigmaSubadditive :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {C : Event A -> Prop} ->
  AddContent C ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
IsSigmaSubadditive {C = C} m =
  (sets : Nat -> Event _) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> C (sets n)) ->
  C (CountableUnion sets) ->
  ENNLE
    (content m (CountableUnion sets))
    (countableSumENN (\ n -> content m (sets n)))

CountableCover :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Event A -> Prop) ->
  Event A ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Prop a
CountableCover C S sets =
  Both
    ((n : Nat) -> C (sets n))
    (Subset S (CountableUnion sets))

CoverCost :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {C : Event A -> Prop} ->
  AddContent C ->
  Event A ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
CoverCost {C = C} m S value =
  Exists
    (Nat -> Event _)
    (\ sets ->
      Both
        (CountableCover C S sets)
        (ENNEqual
          value
          (countableSumENN (\ n -> content m (sets n)))))

InducedOuterValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {C : Event A -> Prop} ->
  AddContent C ->
  Event A ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
InducedOuterValue m S value =
  IsInfimum (CoverCost m S) value

-- On a measurable set, the trimmed Carathéodory measure has the same value
-- as the induced outer measure. Thus this relation is the target-native
-- presentation of the source's canonical generated measure at that set.
CanonicalMeasureValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {C : Event A -> Prop} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  AddContent C ->
  Event A ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
CanonicalMeasureValue events m S value =
  Both
    (measurable events S)
    (InducedOuterValue m S value)

caratheodory-s-extension-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Prop (lsuc a)
caratheodory-s-extension-theorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (C : Event A -> Prop) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (m : AddContent C) ->
  IsSetSemiring C ->
  Generates events C ->
  IsSigmaSubadditive m ->
  (S : Event A) ->
  C S ->
  CanonicalMeasureValue events m S (content m S)

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2631152 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q2631152), "Carathéodory's extension
  theorem": a nonnegative sigma-subadditive additive content on a set
  semiring induces a measure on the generated sigma-algebra that agrees with
  the content on every set of the semiring. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory iterateTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;

val q2631152_add_content_def = new_definition (
  "q2631152_add_content_def",
  ``q2631152_add_content
      (C : 'a set set) (mu : 'a set -> extreal) <=>
      (!u. 0 <= mu u) /\
      mu {} = 0 /\
      !I : 'a set set.
        I SUBSET C /\
        FINITE I /\
        disjoint I /\
        BIGUNION I IN C
        ==>
        mu (BIGUNION I) = SIGMA mu I``);

val q2631152_sigma_subadditive_def = new_definition (
  "q2631152_sigma_subadditive_def",
  ``q2631152_sigma_subadditive
      (C : 'a set set) (mu : 'a set -> extreal) <=>
      !f : num -> 'a set.
        (!i. f i IN C) /\
        BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV) IN C
        ==>
        mu (BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV)) <= suminf (mu o f)``);

val q2631152_generated_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q2631152_generated_measure_def",
  ``q2631152_generated_measure
      (a : 'a algebra) (C : 'a set set) (mu : 'a set -> extreal) =
      (space a,
       subsets a,
       outer_measure mu (countable_covers C))``);

val caratheodory_extension_measure_eq =
  ``!(a : 'a algebra) (C : 'a set set)
      (mu : 'a set -> extreal) (s : 'a set).
      a = sigma UNIV C /\
      semiring (UNIV,C) /\
      q2631152_add_content C mu /\
      q2631152_sigma_subadditive C mu /\
      s IN C
      ==>
      measure (q2631152_generated_measure a C mu) s = mu s``;

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2631152
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2631152), "Carathéodory's extension
  theorem": the canonical measure induced by a sigma-subadditive
  extended-nonnegative additive content on a set semiring agrees with that
  content on every set of the semiring, when the measurable structure is
  generated by the semiring. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q2631152SetSemiring X C states that C is a semiring of subsets of the
  arbitrary carrier X: it contains the empty set, is closed under
  intersections, and every difference of two members is a finite disjoint
  union of members.

  Q2631152AddContent X C m states that m is an extended-nonnegative-valued
  function on all subsets of X, vanishes at the empty set, and is finitely
  additive whenever a finite disjoint family in C has union in C.
  Q2631152SigmaSubadditive C m is the source's countable subadditivity
  condition for sequences whose terms and union belong to C.

  Q2631152Outer C m A is the induced outer-measure value: the infimum of the
  extended sums of m over all NN0-indexed C-covers of A. Q2631152Measure
  X C m M is the uniquely determined measure on M whose values on measurable
  sets are those outer-measure values. Under
  M = sigaGen ( C union { X } ) this is the carrier-relative SetMM rendering
  of MeasureTheory.AddContent.measure: adjoining X preserves the generated
  sigma-algebra while ensuring that its ambient carrier is all of X.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q2631152SetSemiring Q2631152AddContent
   Q2631152SigmaSubadditive Q2631152Outer Q2631152Measure $.

q2631152-set-semiring-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2631152SetSemiring X C ) $.
q2631152-add-content-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2631152AddContent X C m ) $.
q2631152-sigma-subadditive-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2631152SigmaSubadditive C m ) $.
q2631152-outer-syntax
  $a class ( Q2631152Outer C m A ) $.
q2631152-measure-syntax
  $a class ( Q2631152Measure X C m M ) $.

${
  $d A B C I X $.
  $d A B C X $.
  $d A B I X $.
  $d A C I X $.
  $d B C I X $.

  q2631152-set-semiring-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2631152SetSemiring X C )
    <->
    (
      C C_ ~P X
      /\
      (
        (/) e. C
        /\
        (
          A. A e. C A. B e. C
            ( A i^i B ) e. C
          /\
          A. A e. C A. B e. C
            E. I e. Fin
              (
                I C_ C
                /\
                (
                  A. A e. I A. B e. I
                    (
                      A =/= B
                      ->
                      ( A i^i B ) = (/)
                    )
                  /\
                  ( A \ B ) = U. I
                )
              )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C I X m $.
  $d A B C I X $.
  $d A B C I m $.
  $d A B C X m $.
  $d A B I X m $.

  q2631152-add-content-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2631152AddContent X C m )
    <->
    (
      m : ~P X --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        ( m ` (/) ) = 0
        /\
        A. I e. Fin
          (
            (
              I C_ C
              /\
              (
                A. A e. I A. B e. I
                  (
                    A =/= B
                    ->
                    ( A i^i B ) = (/)
                  )
                /\
                U. I e. C
              )
            )
            ->
            ( m ` U. I )
            =
            sum* A e. I ( m ` A )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C F m n $.

  q2631152-sigma-subadditive-definition $a |- (
    ( Q2631152SigmaSubadditive C m )
    <->
    A. F e. ( C ^m NN0 )
      (
        U. ran F e. C
        ->
        ( m ` U. ran F )
        <_
        sum* n e. NN0 ( m ` ( F ` n ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A C F m n y $.
  $d A C F m y $.
  $d A C m n y $.

  q2631152-outer-definition $a |- (
    Q2631152Outer C m A
  ) =
    inf
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. F e. ( C ^m NN0 )
          (
            A C_ U. ran F
            /\
            y =
            sum* n e. NN0 ( m ` ( F ` n ) )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A C M N X m $.
  $d A C M X m $.
  $d A C M N m $.

  q2631152-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q2631152Measure X C m M
  ) =
    (
      iota_ N e. ( measures ` M )
        A. A e. M
          ( N ` A ) = ( Q2631152Outer C m A )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A B C F I M N X m n s y $.

  thousand-theorems-q2631152-caratheodory-extension-theorem $a |-
    A. X A. C A. M A. m A. s
      (
        (
          X e. _V
          /\
          (
            M = ( sigaGen ` ( C u. { X } ) )
            /\
            (
              M e. ( sigAlgebra ` X )
              /\
              (
                ( Q2631152SetSemiring X C )
                /\
                (
                  ( Q2631152AddContent X C m )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q2631152SigmaSubadditive C m )
                    /\
                    s e. C
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          ( Q2631152Measure X C m M )
            e. ( measures ` M )
          /\
          (
            ( ( Q2631152Measure X C m M ) ` s )
            =
            ( m ` s )
          )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q2631152_caratheodory_s_extension_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2631152,
% "Carathéodory's extension theorem": a sigma-subadditive extended-nonnegative-real
% additive content on a generating set semiring agrees there with the measure
% obtained by taking infima of countable cover costs. This file contains no proof.

caratheodory_s_extension_theorem_Q2631152[A: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  set_family: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  content_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): FALSE

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: A): TRUE

  event_subset(left, right: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      left(x) IMPLIES right(x)

  event_intersection(left, right: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      left(x) AND right(x)

  event_union(left, right: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      left(x) OR right(x)

  event_complement(source: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      NOT source(x)

  event_difference(left, right: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      left(x) AND NOT right(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        events(index)(x)

  finite_union(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE event =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      empty_event
    ELSE
      event_union(
        finite_union(events, count - 1),
        events(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: A):
          NOT (events(left_index)(x)
            AND events(right_index)(x))

  finite_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_measure_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_set_semiring(C: set_family): bool =
    C(empty_event)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: event):
        C(left) AND C(right) IMPLIES
          C(event_intersection(left, right)))
      AND (FORALL (left, right: event):
        C(left) AND C(right) IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (pieces: event_sequence),
              (count: nat):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < count IMPLIES C(pieces(index)))
              AND pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
              AND event_difference(left, right)
                = finite_union(pieces, count))

  is_add_content(
      C: set_family,
      content: content_map): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      canonical_measure_value(content(E)))
      AND measure_value_is_zero(content(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            index < count IMPLIES C(pieces(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
          AND C(finite_union(pieces, count)))
        IMPLIES
          content(finite_union(pieces, count))
            = finite_measure_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  content(pieces(index)),
                count))

  is_sigma_subadditive(
      C: set_family,
      content: content_map): bool =
    FORALL (pieces: event_sequence):
      ((FORALL (index: nat):
          C(pieces(index)))
        AND C(countable_union(pieces)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (total: measure_value):
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              content(pieces(index)),
            total)
            AND measure_value_le(
              content(countable_union(pieces)),
              total)

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(empty_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          Sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_generated_sigma(
      C: set_family,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        C(E) IMPLIES Sigma(E))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (E: event):
            C(E) IMPLIES Other(E)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (E: event):
            Sigma(E) IMPLIES Other(E))

  countable_cover_cost(
      C: set_family,
      content: content_map,
      target: event,
      cost: measure_value): bool =
    EXISTS (cover: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        C(cover(index)))
        AND event_subset(

        AND extended_nonnegative_sum(

            content(cover(index)),

  is_infimum_cover_cost(
      C: set_family,
      content: content_map,
      target: event,
      infimum_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(infimum_value)
      AND (FORALL (cost: measure_value):

          C, content, target, cost)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(infimum_value, cost))
      AND (FORALL (lower_bound: measure_value):
        (canonical_measure_value(lower_bound)
          AND (FORALL (cost: measure_value):
            countable_cover_cost(
              C, content, target, cost)
            IMPLIES
              measure_value_le(lower_bound, cost)))
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            lower_bound,
            infimum_value))

  caratheodory_extension_agrees: bool =
    FORALL
        (C: set_family),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (content: content_map),
        (s: event):

        AND is_generated_sigma(C, Sigma)
        AND is_sigma_subadditive(C, content)
        AND C(s))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q26708
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q26708), "Binomial theorem": in every
  commutative semiring, a natural power of a sum equals the finite binomial
  expansion. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q26708_comm_semiring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q26708_zero : R;
  q26708_one : R;
  q26708_add : R -> R -> R;
  q26708_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q26708_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q26708_add x (q26708_add y z) =
      q26708_add (q26708_add x y) z;
  q26708_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q26708_add x y = q26708_add y x;
  q26708_add_zero_left :
    forall x : R, q26708_add q26708_zero x = x;
  q26708_add_zero_right :
    forall x : R, q26708_add x q26708_zero = x;
  q26708_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q26708_mul x (q26708_mul y z) =
      q26708_mul (q26708_mul x y) z;
  q26708_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q26708_mul x y = q26708_mul y x;
  q26708_mul_one_left :
    forall x : R, q26708_mul q26708_one x = x;
  q26708_mul_one_right :
    forall x : R, q26708_mul x q26708_one = x;
  q26708_mul_zero_left :
    forall x : R, q26708_mul q26708_zero x = q26708_zero;
  q26708_mul_zero_right :
    forall x : R, q26708_mul x q26708_zero = q26708_zero;
  q26708_mul_add_left :
    forall x y z : R,
      q26708_mul x (q26708_add y z) =
      q26708_add (q26708_mul x y) (q26708_mul x z);
  q26708_mul_add_right :
    forall x y z : R,
      q26708_mul (q26708_add x y) z =
      q26708_add (q26708_mul x z) (q26708_mul y z)
}.

Arguments q26708_zero {R} _.
Arguments q26708_one {R} _.
Arguments q26708_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q26708_mul {R} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q26708_pow
    {R : Type} (SR : q26708_comm_semiring R)
    (x : R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q26708_one SR
  | S k => q26708_mul SR x (q26708_pow SR x k)
  end.

Fixpoint q26708_nat_cast
    {R : Type} (SR : q26708_comm_semiring R)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q26708_zero SR
  | S k => q26708_add SR (q26708_nat_cast SR k) (q26708_one SR)
  end.

Fixpoint q26708_choose (n k : nat) : nat :=
  match n, k with
  | _, O => 1
  | O, S _ => 0
  | S n', S k' =>
      q26708_choose n' k' + q26708_choose n' (S k')
  end.

Fixpoint q26708_sum_upto
    {R : Type} (SR : q26708_comm_semiring R)
    (f : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => f O
  | S k => q26708_add SR (q26708_sum_upto SR f k) (f (S k))
  end.

Theorem add_pow :
  forall
      (R : Type)
      (SR : q26708_comm_semiring R)
      (x y : R)
      (n : nat),
    q26708_pow SR (q26708_add SR x y) n =
    q26708_sum_upto SR
      (fun m : nat =>
        q26708_mul SR
          (q26708_mul SR
            (q26708_pow SR x m)
            (q26708_pow SR y (Nat.sub n m)))
          (q26708_nat_cast SR (q26708_choose n m)))
      n.
Admitted.

(*

  "Binomial theorem": the binomial expansion holds for two elements of an
  arbitrary commutative semiring. This file contains no proof.

let Q26708_BINOMIAL_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_semiring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R).
       (!a:R. addR zeroR a = a /\ addR a zeroR = a) /\
       (!a b:R. addR a b = addR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
       (!a:R. mulR oneR a = a /\ mulR a oneR = a) /\
       (!a b:R. mulR a b = mulR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
       (!a:R. mulR zeroR a = zeroR /\ mulR a zeroR = zeroR) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) in
   let powerR =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (a:R) (k:num).
       ITLIST mulR (REPLICATE k a) oneR in
   let natcastR =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (k:num).
       ITLIST addR (REPLICATE k oneR) zeroR in
   let sumR =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (n:num) (f:num->R).
       ITSET (\k a. addR (f k) a) (0..n) zeroR in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !x y:R.
   !n:num.
     is_comm_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR
     ==>
     powerR oneR mulR (addR x y) n =
       sumR zeroR addR n
         (\m:num.
            mulR
              (mulR
                (powerR oneR mulR x m)
                (powerR oneR mulR y (n - m)))
              (natcastR zeroR oneR addR (binom(n,m))))`;;

(in-package "ACL2")

(defstub q26708-multiply (semiring left right) t)

(defun-sk q26708-commutative-semiring-laws-p (semiring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q26708-member-p semiring x)
      (let ((zero (q26708-zero semiring))
            (one (q26708-one semiring)))
        (and
         (equal (q26708-add semiring x zero) x)
         (equal (q26708-add semiring zero x) x)
         (equal (q26708-multiply semiring x one) x)
         (equal (q26708-multiply semiring one x) x)
         (equal (q26708-multiply semiring x zero) zero)
         (equal (q26708-multiply semiring zero x) zero))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q26708-member-p semiring x)
       (q26708-member-p semiring y))
      (and
       (q26708-member-p
        semiring
        (q26708-add semiring x y))
       (q26708-member-p
        semiring
        (q26708-multiply semiring x y))
       (equal
        (q26708-add semiring x y)
        (q26708-add semiring y x))
       (equal
        (q26708-multiply semiring x y)
        (q26708-multiply semiring y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q26708-member-p semiring x)
       (q26708-member-p semiring y)
       (q26708-member-p semiring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q26708-add
         semiring
         (q26708-add semiring x y)
         z)
        (q26708-add
         semiring
         x
         (q26708-add semiring y z)))
       (equal
        (q26708-multiply
         semiring
         (q26708-multiply semiring x y)
         z)
        (q26708-multiply
         semiring
         x
         (q26708-multiply semiring y z)))
       (equal
        (q26708-multiply
         semiring
         x
         (q26708-add semiring y z))
        (q26708-add
         semiring
         (q26708-multiply semiring x y)
         (q26708-multiply semiring x z)))
       (equal
        (q26708-multiply
         semiring
         (q26708-add semiring x y)
         z)
        (q26708-add
         semiring
         (q26708-multiply semiring x z)
         (q26708-multiply semiring y z))))))))

(defun q26708-commutative-semiring-p (semiring)
  (and
   (q26708-member-p semiring (q26708-zero semiring))
   (q26708-member-p semiring (q26708-one semiring))
   (q26708-commutative-semiring-laws-p semiring)))

(defun q26708-r-power (semiring base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q26708-one semiring)
    (q26708-multiply
     semiring
     base
     (q26708-r-power semiring base (1- exponent)))))

(defun q26708-r-nat (semiring n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q26708-zero semiring)
    (q26708-add
     semiring
     (q26708-one semiring)
     (q26708-r-nat semiring (1- n)))))

(defun q26708-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (not (natp k))
          (< n k))
      0
    (if (or (zp k)
            (equal n k))
        1
      (+ (q26708-binomial-coefficient (1- n) (1- k))
         (q26708-binomial-coefficient (1- n) k)))))

(defun q26708-binomial-term (semiring x y n m)
  (q26708-multiply
   semiring
   (q26708-multiply
    semiring
    (q26708-r-power semiring x m)
    (q26708-r-power semiring y (- n m)))
   (q26708-r-nat
    semiring

;; this the same finite sum as Lean's Finset.range (n + 1).

(defun q26708-binomial-sum (semiring x y n count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q26708-zero semiring)

      (q26708-add
       semiring
       (q26708-binomial-term semiring x y n m)
       (q26708-binomial-sum
        semiring x y n (1- count))))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q26708-binomial-theorem-statement
    (semiring x y n)

   (and
    (q26708-commutative-semiring-p semiring)
    (q26708-member-p semiring x)
    (q26708-member-p semiring y)
    (natp n))
   (equal
    (q26708-r-power
     semiring
     (q26708-add semiring x y)
     n)
    (q26708-binomial-sum
     semiring x y n (+ n 1)))))
