-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q26708,
-- "Binomial theorem": in every commutative semiring, the nth power of a sum
-- equals the binomial-coefficient-weighted finite sum. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q26708_binomial_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)

record CommutativeSemiring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR zeroR x == zeroR
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  oneN
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

natCast :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Nat ->
  R
natCast semiring zero =
  CommutativeSemiring.zeroR semiring
natCast semiring (suc n) =
  CommutativeSemiring.addR semiring
    (natCast semiring n)
    (CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring)

power :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power semiring x zero =
  CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring
power semiring x (suc n) =
  CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring
    (power semiring x n)
    x

sumThrough :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough semiring zero terms =
  terms zero
sumThrough semiring (suc n) terms =
  CommutativeSemiring.addR semiring
    (sumThrough semiring n terms)
    (terms (suc n))

binomial-theorem : Setω
binomial-theorem =
  {r : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R) ->
  (x y : R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  power semiring
    (CommutativeSemiring.addR semiring x y)
    n
  ==
  sumThrough semiring n
    (\ m ->
      CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring
        (CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring
          (power semiring x m)
          (power semiring y (n - m)))
        (natCast semiring (choose n m)))

(*

  nth power of x + y equals the finite sum of the corresponding binomial
  terms. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory listTheory;

val q26708_comm_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q26708_comm_semiring_def",
  ``q26708_comm_semiring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a b. mulR a b = mulR b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a. mulR zeroR a = zeroR)``);

val q26708_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q26708_pow_def",
  ``q26708_pow
      (oneR : 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (x : 'r) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (mulR x) n oneR``);

val q26708_nat_cast_def = new_definition (
  "q26708_nat_cast_def",
  ``q26708_nat_cast
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (addR oneR) n zeroR``);

val q26708_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q26708_sum_def",
  ``q26708_sum
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (f : num -> 'r) (n : num) =
      FOLDR addR zeroR (GENLIST f (SUC n))``);

val q26708_choose_def = new_definition (
  "q26708_choose_def",
  ``q26708_choose (n : num) (m : num) =
      FACT n DIV (FACT m * FACT (n - m))``);

val add_pow =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (x : 'r) (y : 'r) (n : num).
      q26708_comm_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR
      ==>
      q26708_pow oneR mulR (addR x y) n =
      q26708_sum zeroR addR
        (\m.
          mulR
            (mulR
              (q26708_pow oneR mulR x m)
              (q26708_pow oneR mulR y (n - m)))
            (q26708_nat_cast zeroR oneR addR (q26708_choose n m)))
        n``;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being unital non empty doubleLoopStr,
      x,y being Element of R, n being Nat
  st
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) &
      a + b = b + a &
      a + 0.R = a &
      (a * b) * c = a * (b * c) &
      a * b = b * a &
      a * 1.R = a &
      1.R * a = a &
      a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c &
      (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c &

      len partial = n + 2 &

      (for k being Nat st k <= n holds
        partial/.(k + 2) =

      (x + y)|^n = partial/.(n + 2)
proof

title: Q26708_binomial_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q26708,
% "Binomial theorem": in every commutative semiring, the nth power of a sum
% equals the finite binomial expansion. This file contains no proof.

Q26708_binomial_theorem[
  R: TYPE+,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  powerR(x: R, n: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      oneR
    ELSE
      mulR(powerR(x, n - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_cast(n: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      zeroR
    ELSE
      addR(nat_cast(n - 1), oneR)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  nat_sub(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m <= n THEN n - m ELSE 0 ENDIF

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  binomial_sum(x, y: R, n, count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroR
    ELSE
      LET m: nat = count - 1 IN
        addR(
          binomial_sum(x, y, n, count - 1),
          mulR(
            mulR(powerR(x, m), powerR(y, nat_sub(n, m))),
            nat_cast(binomial_coefficient(n, m))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  commutative_semiring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      addR(addR(a, b), c) = addR(a, addR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R): addR(a, b) = addR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R): addR(a, zeroR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(mulR(a, b), c) = mulR(a, mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R): mulR(a, b) = mulR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R): mulR(a, oneR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(a, addR(b, c)) =
          addR(mulR(a, b), mulR(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(addR(a, b), c) =
          addR(mulR(a, c), mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R): mulR(a, zeroR) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (a: R): mulR(zeroR, a) = zeroR)

  binomial_theorem: bool =
    commutative_semiring_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (x, y: R), (n: nat):
        powerR(addR(x, y), n) =
          binomial_sum(x, y, n, n + 1))
END Q26708_binomial_theorem

title: Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2734084
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2734084), "Bohr–Mollerup theorem": a positive
  log-convex real function on the positive reals, normalized at one and
  satisfying the Gamma recurrence, equals the Gamma function there. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals
  ClassicalEpsilon
  Arith.Factorial.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2734084_set : Type := R -> Prop.

Definition q2734084_positive_reals : q2734084_set :=
  fun x : R => 0 < x.

Definition q2734084_convex_set
    (s : q2734084_set) : Prop :=
  forall x y a b : R,
    s x ->
    s y ->
    0 <= a ->
    0 <= b ->
    a + b = 1 ->
    s (a * x + b * y).

Definition q2734084_log_convex_on_positive
    (f : R -> R) : Prop :=
  q2734084_convex_set q2734084_positive_reals /\
  forall x y a b : R,
    q2734084_positive_reals x ->
    q2734084_positive_reals y ->
    0 <= a ->
    0 <= b ->
    a + b = 1 ->
    ln (f (a * x + b * y)) <=
      a * ln (f x) + b * ln (f y).

Fixpoint q2734084_rising_product
    (x : R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => x
  | S k =>
      q2734084_rising_product x k * (x + INR (S k))
  end.

Definition q2734084_euler_gamma_sequence
    (x : R) (n : nat) : R :=
  let m := S n in
  INR (fact m) *
    exp (x * ln (INR m)) /
    q2734084_rising_product x m.

Definition q2734084_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q2734084_Gamma (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0)
    (fun limit : R =>
      q2734084_sequence_converges
        (q2734084_euler_gamma_sequence x) limit).

Theorem eq_Gamma_of_log_convex :
  forall f : R -> R,
    q2734084_log_convex_on_positive f ->
    (forall y : R,
      0 < y ->
      f (y + 1) = y * f y) ->
    (forall y : R,
      0 < y ->
      0 < f y) ->
    f 1 = 1 ->
    forall x : R,
      0 < x ->
      f x = q2734084_Gamma x.
Admitted.

title: Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2734084,
  "Bohr–Mollerup theorem": every positive real-valued log-convex function on the
  positive reals satisfying the Gamma recurrence and normalized to one at one
  agrees with the real Gamma function on the positive reals. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Gamma_Function"
begin

theorem bohr_mollerup_theorem:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes log_convex: "convex_on {0<..} (ln \<circ> f)"
    and recurrence: "\<And>y. 0 < y \<Longrightarrow> f (y + 1) = y * f y"
    and positive: "\<And>y. 0 < y \<Longrightarrow> 0 < f y"
    and normalized: "f 1 = 1"
  shows "\<forall>x \<in> {0<..}. f x = Gamma x"
  sorry

end

title: Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2734084,
;; "Bohr–Mollerup theorem": every positive log-convex real function normalized
;; at one and satisfying the Gamma recurrence equals the Gamma function on the
;; positive reals. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; An arbitrary Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.
;; The standard exponential is its full power-series limit, logarithm is the
;; inverse of exponential on the positive reals, and Gamma on the positive
;; reals is its full Euler-limit value
;;
;;   lim_m m! * m^x / (x * (x+1) * ... * (x+m)).
;;
;; Thus no real is replaced by a rational value or finite approximation.
;; FUNCTION-VALUE retains the source's arbitrary function argument, while all
;; hypotheses and the equality conclusion remain under their source scopes.

(defstub q2734084-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-generic-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q2734084-r-exponential (real value) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-logarithm (real value) t)
(defstub q2734084-r-gamma (real value) t)
(defstub q2734084-function-value (real function argument) t)

(defun q2734084-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q2734084-r-add
   real left (q2734084-r-negate real right)))

(defun q2734084-r-divide (real numerator denominator)
  (q2734084-r-multiply
   real numerator (q2734084-r-inverse real denominator)))

(defun q2734084-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2734084-r-less real right left)))

(defun q2734084-r-absolute-value (real value)
  (if (q2734084-r-less
       real value (q2734084-r-zero real))
      (q2734084-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun q2734084-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q2734084-r-member-p real value)
   (q2734084-r-less
    real (q2734084-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q2734084-r-nonnegative-p (real value)
  (and
   (q2734084-r-member-p real value)
   (q2734084-r-leq
    real (q2734084-r-zero real) value)))

;; Complete ordered-field presentation.

(defun-sk q2734084-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2734084-r-member-p real x)
      (q2734084-r-member-p real y)
      (q2734084-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q2734084-r-zero real))
            (one (q2734084-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q2734084-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q2734084-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q2734084-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q2734084-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q2734084-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q2734084-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q2734084-r-member-p real zero)
        (q2734084-r-member-p real one)
        (q2734084-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q2734084-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q2734084-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q2734084-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q2734084-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q2734084-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q2734084-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q2734084-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q2734084-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q2734084-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q2734084-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q2734084-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q2734084-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q2734084-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q2734084-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q2734084-r-multiply
          real x (q2734084-r-add real y z))
         (q2734084-r-add
          real
          (q2734084-r-multiply real x y)
          (q2734084-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2734084-r-member-p real x)
      (q2734084-r-member-p real y)
      (q2734084-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q2734084-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q2734084-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q2734084-r-less real x y)
         (q2734084-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2734084-r-less real x y)
          (q2734084-r-less real y z))
         (q2734084-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q2734084-r-less real x y)
         (q2734084-r-less
          real
          (q2734084-r-add real x z)
          (q2734084-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2734084-r-less real zero x)
          (q2734084-r-less real zero y))
         (q2734084-r-less
          real zero
          (q2734084-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun q2734084-r-singleton-set (real value)
  (list :q2734084-singleton real value))

(defun q2734084-r-set-member-p (real set value)
  (if
      (and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 3)
       (equal (car set) :q2734084-singleton)
       (equal (cadr set) real))
      (equal value (caddr set))
    (q2734084-r-generic-set-member-p real set value)))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-valid-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2734084-r-set-member-p real set x)
     (q2734084-r-member-p real x))))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q2734084-r-member-p real x)
     (q2734084-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2734084-r-member-p real x)
      (q2734084-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q2734084-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q2734084-r-member-p real bound)
     (q2734084-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-least-upper-bound-p
    (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q2734084-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q2734084-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q2734084-r-member-p real bound)
       (q2734084-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q2734084-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q2734084-r-least-upper-bound-p
     real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q2734084-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2734084-r-valid-set-p real set)
      (q2734084-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q2734084-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q2734084-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q2734084-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q2734084-r-zero real))
        (one (q2734084-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q2734084-r-member-p real zero)
     (q2734084-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q2734084-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q2734084-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q2734084-r-less real zero one)
     (q2734084-r-set-nonempty-p
      real (q2734084-r-singleton-set real zero))
     (q2734084-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Standard exponential and logarithm.

(defun q2734084-natural-cast (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2734084-r-zero real)
    (q2734084-r-add
     real
     (q2734084-natural-cast real (1- n))
     (q2734084-r-one real))))

(defun q2734084-natural-factorial (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2734084-r-one real)
    (q2734084-r-multiply
     real
     (q2734084-natural-cast real n)
     (q2734084-natural-factorial real (1- n)))))

(defun q2734084-natural-power (real x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2734084-r-one real)
    (q2734084-r-multiply
     real x
     (q2734084-natural-power real x (1- n)))))

(defun q2734084-exponential-partial-sum (real x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2734084-r-one real)
    (q2734084-r-add
     real
     (q2734084-exponential-partial-sum real x (1- n))
     (q2734084-r-divide
      real
      (q2734084-natural-power real x n)
      (q2734084-natural-factorial real n)))))

(defun-sk q2734084-exponential-tail-close-p
    (real x value epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start n))
     (q2734084-r-less
      real
      (q2734084-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q2734084-r-subtract
        real
        (q2734084-exponential-partial-sum real x n)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2734084-exponential-cutoff-exists-p
    (real x value epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q2734084-exponential-tail-close-p
      real x value epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q2734084-exponential-limit-p
    (real x value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q2734084-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q2734084-exponential-cutoff-exists-p
      real x value epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2734084-standard-exponential-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q2734084-r-member-p real x)
     (and
      (q2734084-r-positive-p
       real (q2734084-r-exponential real x))
      (q2734084-exponential-limit-p
       real x (q2734084-r-exponential real x))))))

(defun-sk q2734084-standard-logarithm-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (implies
      (q2734084-r-member-p real x)
      (equal
       (q2734084-r-logarithm
        real (q2734084-r-exponential real x))
       x))
     (implies
      (q2734084-r-positive-p real x)
      (and
       (q2734084-r-member-p
        real (q2734084-r-logarithm real x))
       (equal
        (q2734084-r-exponential
         real (q2734084-r-logarithm real x))
        x))))))

;; The standard Gamma function on the positive reals via Euler's limit.

(defun q2734084-rising-product (real x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      x
    (q2734084-r-multiply
     real
     (q2734084-rising-product real x (1- n))
     (q2734084-r-add
      real x (q2734084-natural-cast real n)))))

(defun q2734084-euler-gamma-term (real x n)
  (let* ((m (+ 1 (nfix n)))
         (m-real (q2734084-natural-cast real m))
         (m-to-x
          (q2734084-r-exponential
           real
           (q2734084-r-multiply
            real x (q2734084-r-logarithm real m-real)))))
    (q2734084-r-divide
     real
     (q2734084-r-multiply
      real
      (q2734084-natural-factorial real m)
      m-to-x)
     (q2734084-rising-product real x m))))

(defun-sk q2734084-gamma-tail-close-p
    (real x value epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start n))
     (q2734084-r-less
      real
      (q2734084-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q2734084-r-subtract
        real
        (q2734084-euler-gamma-term real x n)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q2734084-gamma-cutoff-exists-p
    (real x value epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)

title: Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2734084,
-- "Bohr–Mollerup theorem": a positive log-convex real function normalized at
-- one and satisfying the Gamma functional equation agrees with the Gamma
-- function on the positive reals. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x

    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR

    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x

    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))

    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)

    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

powerNatR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerNatR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerNatR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerNatR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divideR reals
    (powerNatR reals x n)
    (fromNatR reals (factorial n))

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x zero =
  zeroR reals
exponentialPartialSum reals x (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x n)
    (exponentialTerm reals x n)

sumThrough :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumThrough reals terms zero =
  terms zero
sumThrough reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (sumThrough reals terms n)
    (terms (suc n))

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

logGammaSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (logarithm : R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
logGammaSequence reals logarithm x n =
  subtractR reals
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        x
        (logarithm (fromNatR reals n)))
      (logarithm (fromNatR reals (factorial n))))
    (sumThrough reals
      (\ m ->
        logarithm
          (addR reals x (fromNatR reals m)))
      n)

record StandardGammaAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential logarithm gamma :
      R ->
      R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (exponentialPartialSum reals x)
        (exponential x)

    exponential-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals (exponential x)

    logarithm-zero :
      logarithm (zeroR reals) == zeroR reals

    logarithm-exponential :
      (x : R) ->
      logarithm (exponential x) == x

    exponential-logarithm :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals x ->
      exponential (logarithm x) == x

    gamma-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals x ->
      Positive reals (gamma x)

    gamma-euler-limit :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals x ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (logGammaSequence reals logarithm x)
        (logarithm (gamma x))

open StandardGammaAnalysis

ConvexLogOnPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardGammaAnalysis reals ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
ConvexLogOnPositive {R = R} reals analysis f =
  (x y a b : R) ->
  Positive reals x ->
  Positive reals y ->
  Nonnegative reals a ->
  Nonnegative reals b ->
  addR reals a b == oneR reals ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (logarithm analysis
      (f
        (addR reals
          (multiplyR reals a x)
          (multiplyR reals b y))))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a (logarithm analysis (f x)))
      (multiplyR reals b (logarithm analysis (f y))))

bohr-mollerup-theorem : Set1
bohr-mollerup-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardGammaAnalysis reals) ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  ConvexLogOnPositive reals analysis f ->
  ((y : R) ->
    Positive reals y ->
    f (addR reals y (oneR reals)) ==
    multiplyR reals y (f y)) ->
  ((y : R) ->
    Positive reals y ->
    Positive reals (f y)) ->
  f (oneR reals) == oneR reals ->
  (x : R) ->
  Positive reals x ->
  f x == gamma analysis x

  a positive log-convex real function satisfying the Gamma functional equation
  and normalized at one equals the Gamma function on the positive reals. This

*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory real_sigmaTheory;
open seqTheory transcTheory derivativeTheory;

val q2734084_gamma_seq_def = new_definition (
  "q2734084_gamma_seq_def",
  ``q2734084_gamma_seq (x : real) (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then 0
      else
        ((&n : real) rpow x) * &(FACT n) /
          real_sigma$product (count (n + 1)) (\m. x + &m)``);

val q2734084_gamma_def = new_definition (
  "q2734084_gamma_def",
  ``q2734084_gamma (x : real) =
      lim (q2734084_gamma_seq x)``);

val bohr_mollerup_theorem =
  ``!f : real -> real.
      (ln o f) convex_on {x : real | 0 < x} /\
      (!y. 0 < y ==> f (y + 1) = y * f y) /\
      (!y. 0 < y ==> 0 < f y) /\
      f 1 = 1
      ==>
      !x. 0 < x ==> f x = q2734084_gamma x``;

${

    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      (

title: Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2734084,
% "Bohr–Mollerup theorem": every positive-valued log-convex real function on
% the positive reals, normalized at one and satisfying the Gamma recurrence,
% agrees there with the Gamma function. This file contains no proof.

Q2734084_bohr_mollerup_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  rising_product(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      rising_product(x, count - 1)
        * (x + ((count - 1) :: real))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  gamma_approximation(x: real, index: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      (nat_factorial(index) :: real)
        * real_power(index :: real, x),
      rising_product(x, index + 1))

  gamma_function(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          converges_to(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              gamma_approximation(x, index),
            value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  positive_reals_convex: bool =
    FORALL (x, y, a, b: real):
      (0 < x

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q276082,
% "Wilson's theorem": for every prime natural number p, (p - 1)! is congruent
% to -1 modulo p. This file contains no proof.

Q276082_wilson_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat): value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  nat_factorial(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      value * nat_factorial(value - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  int_congruent(left, right: int, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      left - right = (modulus :: int) * offset

  wilsons_lemma: bool =
    FORALL (p: nat):
      prime_nat(p)
        IMPLIES int_congruent(
          nat_factorial(p - 1) :: int,
          -1,
          p)

END Q276082_wilson_s_theorem

module

namespace Q282649

variable (R : Type*) [CommRing R]

/-- The generalized pentagonal number `k * (3 * k - 1) / 2`. -/
def pentagonal (k : ℤ) : ℕ :=
  (k * (3 * k - 1) / 2).toNat

open Classical in
/-- The signed power series supported on the generalized pentagonal numbers. -/
noncomputable def pentagonalSeries : R⟦X⟧ :=
  .mk fun n ↦ if h : ∃ k, pentagonal k = n then

  else
    0

theorem pentagonal_number_theorem_statement :
    HasProd (fun n ↦ (1 - X ^ (n + 1) : R⟦X⟧)) (pentagonalSeries R) := sorry

end Q282649

  q282649_one : R;
  q282649_add : R -> R -> R;
  q282649_mul : R -> R -> R;

  q282649_add_assoc :

  q282649_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,

  q282649_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q282649_add x q282649_zero = x;
  q282649_add_neg :
    forall x : R,

  q282649_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q282649_mul x (q282649_mul y z) =

  q282649_is_open : q282649_set A -> Prop;
  q282649_open_extensional :

  q282649_open_full :
    q282649_is_open (fun _ : A => True);
  q282649_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q282649_set A,
      q282649_is_open U ->
      q282649_is_open V ->
      q282649_is_open (fun x : A => U x /\ V x);

    forall family : q282649_set A -> Prop,
      (forall U : q282649_set A,

      q282649_is_open
        (fun x : A =>

Definition q282649_ps_one {R : Type}
    (CR : q282649_commutative_ring R) : q282649_power_series R :=

    (CR : q282649_commutative_ring R)
    (a b : q282649_power_series R)

  | O => q282649_mul CR (a O) (b total)

    (a : q282649_power_series R)
    (n : nat) : q282649_power_series R :=

    (CR : q282649_commutative_ring R)
    (n : nat) : q282649_power_series R :=

    (CR : q282649_commutative_ring R)

definition q282649_fps_finite_prod ::
    "'a::comm_ring \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a q282649_fps) \<Rightarrow>
      nat set \<Rightarrow> 'a q282649_fps"
  where
    "q282649_fps_finite_prod u f s =
      q282649_fps_list_prod u f (sorted_list_of_set s)"

definition q282649_pentagonal :: "int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q282649_pentagonal k = nat (k * (3 * k - 1) div 2)"

definition q282649_neg_one_pow ::
    "'a::comm_ring \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  where
    "q282649_neg_one_pow u k = (if even k then u else -u)"

definition q282649_pentagonal_series ::
    "'a::comm_ring \<Rightarrow> 'a q282649_fps"
  where
  "q282649_pentagonal_series u =
    (\<lambda>n.
      if \<exists>k::int. q282649_pentagonal k = n
      then q282649_neg_one_pow u (SOME k. q282649_pentagonal k = n)
      else 0)"

definition q282649_has_prod ::
    "'a::{comm_ring,topological_space} \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a q282649_fps) \<Rightarrow>
      'a q282649_fps \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q282649_has_prod u f p \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>k. ((\<lambda>s. q282649_fps_finite_prod u f s k) \<longlongrightarrow> p k)
        (finite_subsets_at_top UNIV))"

theorem pentagonal_number_theorem:
  fixes u :: "'a::{comm_ring,topological_space}"
  assumes unit: "\<And>x. u * x = x"
  shows "q282649_has_prod u
    (\<lambda>n. q282649_fps_sub
      (q282649_fps_one u)
      (q282649_fps_pow u (q282649_fps_X u) (n + 1)))
    (q282649_pentagonal_series u)"
  oops

end

title: Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q282649
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q282649), "Pentagonal number theorem": over
  an arbitrary commutative ring, the finite products of 1 - X^(n+1) converge
  coefficientwise in the induced product topology to the formal power series
  supported on generalized pentagonal numbers with alternating signs. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let Q282649_PENTAGONAL_NUMBER_THEOREM =
  `let is_commutative_ring =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A) (negA:A->A).
       (!x:A. addA zeroA x = x /\ addA x zeroA = x) /\
       (!x y:A. addA x y = addA y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. addA (addA x y) z = addA x (addA y z)) /\
       (!x:A. addA (negA x) x = zeroA /\ addA x (negA x) = zeroA) /\
       (!x:A. mulA oneA x = x /\ mulA x oneA = x) /\
       (!x y:A. mulA x y = mulA y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. mulA (mulA x y) z = mulA x (mulA y z)) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mulA x (addA y z) = addA (mulA x y) (mulA x z)) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mulA (addA x y) z = addA (mulA x z) (mulA y z)) in
   let is_topology =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (UNIV:A->bool) /\
       (!family:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!U:A->bool. U IN family ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS family)) /\
       (!U V:A->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let cauchy_mul =
     \(addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (p:num->A) (q:num->A).
       \n:num.
         iterate addA {i:num | i <= n}
           (\i. mulA (p i) (q (n - i))) in
   let factor =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (negA:A->A) (m:num).
       \d:num.
         if d = 0 then oneA
         else if d = m + 1 then negA oneA
         else zeroA in
   let finite_product =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (negA:A->A) (s:num->bool).
       iterate (cauchy_mul addA mulA) s (factor zeroA oneA negA) in
   let is_pentagonal_index =
     \(n:num) (k:int).
       (&2:int) * &n = k * ((&3:int) * k - &1) in
   let pentagonal_series =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (negA:A->A).
       \n:num.
         if ?k:int. is_pentagonal_index n k then
           let k = @k:int. is_pentagonal_index n k in
           if EVEN (num_of_int (abs k)) then oneA else negA oneA
         else zeroA in
   let has_product_in_pi_topology =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool)
      (partial_product:(num->bool)->num->A)
      (target:num->A).
       !d:num. !U:A->bool.
         open_sets U /\ target d IN U
         ==> ?s0:num->bool.
               FINITE s0 /\
               !s:num->bool.
                 FINITE s /\ s0 SUBSET s
                 ==> partial_product s d IN U in
   !zeroA oneA:A.
   !addA mulA:A->A->A.
   !negA:A->A.
   !open_sets:(A->bool)->bool.
     is_commutative_ring zeroA oneA addA mulA negA /\
     is_topology open_sets
     ==>
     has_product_in_pi_topology
       open_sets
       (finite_product zeroA oneA addA mulA negA)
       (pentagonal_series zeroA oneA negA)`;;

title: Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q282649,
;; "Pentagonal number theorem": over every commutative ring, the formal
;; power-series product of (1 - X^(n+1)) has the generalized-pentagonal
;; coefficients with alternating signs. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A carrier identifier and conservative operation interfaces present an
;; arbitrary commutative ring. Every ring law used by the source type class is
;; explicit in the statement predicate; the carrier is neither enumerated nor
;; restricted to ACL2's built-in numeric domains.

(defstub q282649-member-p (ring value) t)
(defstub q282649-zero (ring) t)
(defstub q282649-one (ring) t)
(defstub q282649-add (ring left right) t)
(defstub q282649-multiply (ring left right) t)
(defstub q282649-negate (ring value) t)

(defun-sk q282649-commutative-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q282649-member-p ring x)
      (q282649-member-p ring y)
      (q282649-member-p ring z))
     (let ((xy-add (q282649-add ring x y))
           (yz-add (q282649-add ring y z))
           (xy-multiply (q282649-multiply ring x y))
           (yz-multiply (q282649-multiply ring y z)))
       (and
        (q282649-member-p ring (q282649-negate ring x))
        (q282649-member-p ring xy-add)
        (q282649-member-p ring xy-multiply)
        (equal
         (q282649-add ring xy-add z)
         (q282649-add ring x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q282649-add ring y x))
        (equal (q282649-add ring x (q282649-zero ring)) x)
        (equal
         (q282649-add ring x (q282649-negate ring x))
         (q282649-zero ring))
        (equal
         (q282649-multiply ring xy-multiply z)
         (q282649-multiply ring x yz-multiply))
        (equal xy-multiply (q282649-multiply ring y x))
        (equal (q282649-multiply ring x (q282649-one ring)) x)
        (equal
         (q282649-multiply ring x yz-add)
         (q282649-add
          ring
          (q282649-multiply ring x y)
          (q282649-multiply ring x z))))))))

(defun q282649-commutative-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (q282649-member-p ring (q282649-zero ring))
   (q282649-member-p ring (q282649-one ring))
   (q282649-commutative-ring-laws-p ring)))

;; The generalized pentagonal number indexed by an integer k is
;; k(3k-1)/2. The product is always even, so this exact ACL2 rational
;; expression is an integer and agrees with Mathlib's natural-valued map.

(defun q282649-pentagonal (k)
  (if (integerp k)
      (/ (* k (- (* 3 k) 1)) 2)
    0))

(defun-sk q282649-pentagonal-index-exists-p (degree)
  (exists (k)
    (and
     (integerp k)
     (equal (q282649-pentagonal k) degree))))

(defchoose q282649-pentagonal-index
    (k)
    (degree)
  (and
   (integerp k)
   (equal (q282649-pentagonal k) degree)))

(defun q282649-neg-one-pow (ring k)
  (if (evenp k)
      (q282649-one ring)
    (q282649-negate ring (q282649-one ring))))

(defun q282649-pentagonal-series-coefficient (ring degree)
  (if (q282649-pentagonal-index-exists-p degree)
      (q282649-neg-one-pow
       ring
       (q282649-pentagonal-index degree))
    (q282649-zero ring)))

;; Duplicate-free natural lists are exact representatives of finite subsets
;; of N. The recursive coefficient is the coefficient of the finite product
;; over that set. Multiplication by (1 - X^(n+1)) sends coefficient d to
;; old(d) - old(d-(n+1)), which is exact formal-power-series convolution.

(defun q282649-all-natural-p (values)
  (if (endp values)
      t
    (and
     (natp (car values))
     (q282649-all-natural-p (cdr values)))))

(defun q282649-finite-natural-set-p (values)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (q282649-all-natural-p values)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)))

(defun q282649-finite-product-coefficient (ring finite-set degree)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count finite-set)))
  (if (endp finite-set)
      (if (equal degree 0)
          (q282649-one ring)
        (q282649-zero ring))
    (let* ((factor-degree (+ 1 (car finite-set)))
           (remaining-coefficient
            (q282649-finite-product-coefficient
             ring (cdr finite-set) degree)))
      (if (<= factor-degree degree)
          (q282649-add
           ring
           remaining-coefficient
           (q282649-negate
            ring
            (q282649-finite-product-coefficient
             ring
             (cdr finite-set)
             (- degree factor-degree))))
        remaining-coefficient))))

(defun-sk q282649-eventually-correct-at-cutoff-p
    (ring degree cutoff)
  (forall (finite-set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q282649-finite-natural-set-p finite-set)
      (subsetp-equal cutoff finite-set))
     (equal
      (q282649-finite-product-coefficient
       ring finite-set degree)
      (q282649-pentagonal-series-coefficient
       ring degree)))))

(defun-sk q282649-coefficient-cutoff-exists-p (ring degree)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (q282649-finite-natural-set-p cutoff)
     (q282649-eventually-correct-at-cutoff-p
      ring degree cutoff))))

;; The source HasProd assertion is polymorphic over every topology on the
;; coefficient ring. In the coefficientwise topology, eventual equality of
;; each coefficient implies convergence for every topology. Conversely,
;; specializing that universal source assertion to the discrete coefficient
;; topology yields exactly this coefficientwise eventual-equality predicate.
;; Thus the following universal closure is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source statement, while avoiding any finite or weaker model of topology.

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q282649-pentagonal-number-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (ring degree)
    (implies
     (and
      (q282649-commutative-ring-p ring)
      (natp degree))
     (q282649-coefficient-cutoff-exists-p
      ring degree))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q282649,
-- "Pentagonal number theorem": over an arbitrary commutative ring with an
-- arbitrary coefficient topology, the unordered finite-subset product net
-- of (1 - X^(n+1)) converges coefficientwise to the generalized pentagonal
-- power series. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; negsuc; pos)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor truth

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A → Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

Predicate :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Predicate {a} A =
  A → Set a

Whole :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Predicate A
Whole _ =
  Top

Intersection :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Predicate A →
  Predicate A →
  Predicate A
Intersection P Q x =
  P x × Q x

Subset :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Predicate A →
  Predicate A →
  Set a
Subset {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) →
  P x →
  Q x

record NeighborhoodRefinement
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (near : A → Predicate A → Set a)
  (x : A)
  (U : Predicate A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    refinement :
      Predicate A

    refinement-near :
      near x refinement

    refinement-stays-near :
      (y : A) →
      refinement y →
      near y U

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    neighborhood :
      A →
      Predicate A →
      Set a

    neighborhood-contains :
      (x : A) →
      (U : Predicate A) →
      neighborhood x U →
      U x

    neighborhood-whole :
      (x : A) →
      neighborhood x Whole

    neighborhood-upward :
      (x : A) →
      (U V : Predicate A) →
      neighborhood x U →
      Subset U V →
      neighborhood x V

    neighborhood-intersection :
      (x : A) →
      (U V : Predicate A) →
      neighborhood x U →
      neighborhood x V →
      neighborhood x (Intersection U V)

    neighborhood-local :
      (x : A) →
      (U : Predicate A) →
      neighborhood x U →
      NeighborhoodRefinement neighborhood x U

open TopologicalSpace

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R →
      R →
      R

    negateR :
      R →
      R

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)

    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR zeroR x ≡ x

    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x

    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) →
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR

    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x

    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

open CommutativeRing

data Member (x : Nat) : List Nat → Set where
  at-head :
    {xs : List Nat} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : Nat} →
    {xs : List Nat} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates : List Nat → Set where
  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates []

  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : Nat} →
    {xs : List Nat} →
    Not (Member x xs) →
    NoDuplicates xs →
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

record FiniteSubsetNat : Set where
  field
    elements      : List Nat
    no-duplicates : NoDuplicates elements

open FiniteSubsetNat

FiniteSubsetIncluded :
  FiniteSubsetNat →
  FiniteSubsetNat →
  Set
FiniteSubsetIncluded child parent =
  (n : Nat) →
  Member n (elements child) →
  Member n (elements parent)

EventuallyFiniteSubsets :
  {p : Level} →
  (FiniteSubsetNat → Set p) →
  Set p
EventuallyFiniteSubsets P =
  Exists FiniteSubsetNat
    (λ cutoff →
      (subset : FiniteSubsetNat) →
      FiniteSubsetIncluded cutoff subset →
      P subset)

PowerSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
PowerSeries R =
  Nat → R

subtractR :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  R →
  R
subtractR ring x y =
  addR ring x (negateR ring y)

sumUpTo :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (Nat → R) →
  Nat →
  R
sumUpTo ring summand zero =
  summand zero
sumUpTo ring summand (suc n) =
  addR ring
    (sumUpTo ring summand n)
    (summand (suc n))

oneSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R
oneSeries ring zero =
  oneR ring
oneSeries ring (suc n) =
  zeroR ring

xSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R
xSeries ring zero =
  zeroR ring
xSeries ring (suc zero) =
  oneR ring
xSeries ring (suc (suc n)) =
  zeroR ring

addSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R
addSeries ring left right n =
  addR ring (left n) (right n)

negateSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R
negateSeries ring series n =
  negateR ring (series n)

subtractSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R
subtractSeries ring left right =
  addSeries ring left (negateSeries ring right)

multiplySeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R →
  PowerSeries R
multiplySeries ring left right n =
  sumUpTo ring
    (λ i →
      multiplyR ring
        (left i)
        (right (n - i)))
    n

powerSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R →
  Nat →
  PowerSeries R
powerSeries ring series zero =
  oneSeries ring
powerSeries ring series (suc exponent) =
  multiplySeries ring
    (powerSeries ring series exponent)
    series

oneMinusXPow :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Nat →
  PowerSeries R
oneMinusXPow ring n =
  subtractSeries ring
    (oneSeries ring)
    (powerSeries ring (xSeries ring) (suc n))

productSeriesList :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (Nat → PowerSeries R) →
  List Nat →
  PowerSeries R
productSeriesList ring factors [] =
  oneSeries ring
productSeriesList ring factors (n ∷ ns) =
  multiplySeries ring
    (factors n)
    (productSeriesList ring factors ns)

finiteSubsetProduct :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (Nat → PowerSeries R) →
  FiniteSubsetNat →
  PowerSeries R
finiteSubsetProduct ring factors subset =
  productSeriesList ring factors (elements subset)

half :
  Nat →
  Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

threeTimes :
  Nat →
  Nat
threeTimes n =
  n + (n + n)

pentagonal :
  Int →
  Nat
pentagonal (pos n) =
  half (n * (threeTimes n - suc zero))
pentagonal (negsuc n) =
  half ((suc n) * suc (threeTimes (suc n)))

negOnePowNat :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Nat →
  R
negOnePowNat ring zero =
  oneR ring
negOnePowNat ring (suc n) =
  negateR ring (negOnePowNat ring n)

negOnePowInt :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Int →
  R
negOnePowInt ring (pos n) =
  negOnePowNat ring n
negOnePowInt ring (negsuc n) =
  negOnePowNat ring (suc n)

natEqual :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

data Maybe
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  nothing :
    Maybe A

  just :
    A →
    Maybe A

firstJust :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Maybe A →
  Maybe A →
  Maybe A
firstJust (just x) other =
  just x
firstJust nothing other =
  other

coefficientAtCandidate :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Nat →
  Int →
  Maybe R
coefficientAtCandidate ring target k
  with natEqual (pentagonal k) target
... | true =
  just (negOnePowInt ring k)
... | false =
  nothing

searchPentagonalCoefficient :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Maybe R
searchPentagonalCoefficient ring target zero =
  firstJust
    (coefficientAtCandidate ring target (pos zero))
    (coefficientAtCandidate ring target (negsuc zero))
searchPentagonalCoefficient ring target (suc bound) =
  firstJust
    (coefficientAtCandidate ring target (pos (suc bound)))
    (firstJust
      (coefficientAtCandidate ring target (negsuc (suc bound)))
      (searchPentagonalCoefficient ring target bound))

pentagonalSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  PowerSeries R
pentagonalSeries ring n
  with searchPentagonalCoefficient ring n n
... | just coefficient =
  coefficient
... | nothing =
  zeroR ring

PiTopologyTendsto :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace R →
  (FiniteSubsetNat → PowerSeries R) →
  PowerSeries R →
  Set (lsuc a)
PiTopologyTendsto {R = R} topology values limit =
  (degree : Nat) →
  (U : Predicate R) →
  neighborhood topology (limit degree) U →
  EventuallyFiniteSubsets
    (λ subset →
      U (values subset degree))

HasProd :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  TopologicalSpace R →
  (Nat → PowerSeries R) →
  PowerSeries R →
  Set (lsuc a)
HasProd ring topology factors limit =
  PiTopologyTendsto topology
    (finiteSubsetProduct ring factors)
    limit

-- Lean: PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.hasProd_one_sub_X_pow
pentagonal-number-theorem :
  {a : Level} →
  Set (lsuc a)
pentagonal-number-theorem {a} =
  (R : Set a) →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  (topology : TopologicalSpace R) →
  HasProd ring topology
    (oneMinusXPow ring)
    (pentagonalSeries ring)

title: Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q282649, "Pentagonal number theorem": over an arbitrary commutative ring
  with an arbitrary topology, the infinite product of the formal power series
  1 - X^(n+1) converges coefficientwise to the generalized pentagonal series.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory integerTheory listTheory pred_setTheory topologyTheory;

val q282649_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_comm_ring_def",
  ``q282649_comm_ring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r) (z : 'r).
         addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r). addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!(x : 'r). addR zeroR x = x) /\
      (!(x : 'r). addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r) (z : 'r).
         mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r). mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!(x : 'r). mulR oneR x = x) /\
      (!(x : 'r) (y : 'r) (z : 'r).
         mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z))``);

val q282649_series_one_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_series_one_def",
  ``q282649_series_one (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r) =
      (\n : num. if n = 0 then oneR else zeroR)``);

val q282649_series_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_series_mul_def",
  ``q282649_series_mul
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (f : num -> 'r) (g : num -> 'r) =
      (\n : num.
        FOLDR addR zeroR
          (GENLIST (\i. mulR (f i) (g (n - i))) (SUC n)))``);

val q282649_one_sub_X_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_one_sub_X_pow_def",
  ``q282649_one_sub_X_pow
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r) (negR : 'r -> 'r) (n : num) =
      (\k : num.
        if k = 0 then oneR
        else if k = SUC n then negR oneR
        else zeroR)``);

val q282649_series_finprod_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_series_finprod_def",
  ``q282649_series_finprod
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (f : num -> num -> 'r) (s : num set) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc. q282649_series_mul zeroR addR mulR (f i) acc)
        s
        (q282649_series_one zeroR oneR)``);

val q282649_pentagonal_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_pentagonal_def",
  ``q282649_pentagonal (k : int) =
      if 0 <= k then
        let n = Num k in n * (3 * n - 1) DIV 2
      else
        let n = Num (ABS k) in n * (3 * n + 1) DIV 2``);

val q282649_neg_one_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_neg_one_pow_def",
  ``q282649_neg_one_pow (oneR : 'r) (negR : 'r -> 'r) (k : int) =
      if EVEN (Num (ABS k)) then oneR else negR oneR``);

val q282649_pentagonal_series_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_pentagonal_series_def",
  ``q282649_pentagonal_series
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r) (negR : 'r -> 'r) =
      (\n : num.
        if ?k : int. q282649_pentagonal k = n then
          q282649_neg_one_pow oneR negR
            (@k : int. q282649_pentagonal k = n)
        else
          zeroR)``);

val q282649_has_prod_pi_def = new_definition (
  "q282649_has_prod_pi_def",
  ``q282649_has_prod_pi
      (top : 'r topology)
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (f : num -> num -> 'r) (a : num -> 'r) <=>
      !k : num. !u : 'r set.
        open_in top u /\ a k IN u ==>
        ?s0 : num set.
          FINITE s0 /\
          !s : num set.
            FINITE s /\ s0 SUBSET s ==>
            q282649_series_finprod zeroR oneR addR mulR f s k IN u``);

val hasProd_one_sub_X_pow =
  ``!(top : 'r topology)
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r).
      q282649_comm_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
      topspace top = UNIV
      ==>
      q282649_has_prod_pi top zeroR oneR addR mulR
        (q282649_one_sub_X_pow zeroR oneR negR)
        (q282649_pentagonal_series zeroR oneR negR)``;

title: Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q282649
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q282649), "Pentagonal number theorem": over
  every commutative ring with an arbitrary topology on its carrier, the
  finite-subset net of products of the formal power series
  1 - X^(n + 1) converges in the coefficientwise product topology to the
  signed series supported on the generalized pentagonal numbers. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A formal power series over R is represented extensionally by its coefficient
  function NN0 --> Base(R). Q282649Partial R S is the coefficient function of

    product_(n in S) (1 - X^(n + 1)).

  Its kth coefficient is the sum over subsets T of S whose selected exponents
  sum to k, with sign (-1)^|T|. This is the finite distributive expansion of
  the product and is valid over every commutative ring.

  Q282649PentIndex k is the unique n >= 0 for which k is one of

    n(3n - 1)/2  or  n(3n + 1)/2.

  These two branches respectively encode the nonnegative and negative integer
  indices in k(3k - 1)/2. Since (-1)^(-n) = (-1)^n, Q282649Series R is exactly
  the source pentagonalSeries coefficient function.

  Q282649HasProd R J expands HasProd as convergence of the net indexed by
  finite subsets of NN0 ordered by inclusion. The topology is SetMM's indexed
  product of the arbitrary coefficient topology J, exactly the Pi topology on
  formal power series used by PowerSeries.WithPiTopology.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or transparent definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c Q282649Partial Q282649PentIndex Q282649Series Q282649HasProd $.

q282649-partial-syntax
  $a class ( Q282649Partial R S ) $.
q282649-pentagonal-index-syntax
  $a class ( Q282649PentIndex k ) $.
q282649-series-syntax
  $a class ( Q282649Series R ) $.
q282649-has-product-syntax
  $a wff ( Q282649HasProd R J ) $.

${
  $d R S T k n $.

  q282649-partial-definition $a |- (
    Q282649Partial R S
  ) = (
    k e. NN0 |->
      R gsum
        (
          T e.
            {
              T e. ~P S |
              ( sum_ n e. T ( n + 1 ) ) = k
            }
          |->
            (
              ( # ` T )
              ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) )
              ( ( -g ` R ) ` ( 1r ` R ) )
            )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d k n $.

  q282649-pentagonal-index-definition $a |- (
    Q282649PentIndex k
  ) = (
    iota_ n e. NN0
      (
        ( 2 x. k ) = ( n x. ( ( 3 x. n ) - 1 ) )
        \/
        ( 2 x. k ) = ( n x. ( ( 3 x. n ) + 1 ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d R k n $.

  q282649-series-definition $a |- (
    Q282649Series R
  ) = (
    k e. NN0 |->
      if (
        E. n e. NN0
          (
            ( 2 x. k ) = ( n x. ( ( 3 x. n ) - 1 ) )
            \/
            ( 2 x. k ) = ( n x. ( ( 3 x. n ) + 1 ) )
          )
        ,
        (
          ( Q282649PentIndex k )
          ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) )
          ( ( -g ` R ) ` ( 1r ` R ) )
        )
        ,
        ( 0g ` R )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d J O R S T n $.

  q282649-has-product-definition $a |- (
    ( Q282649HasProd R J )
    <->
    A. O e. ( Xt_ ` ( n e. NN0 |-> J ) )
      (
        ( Q282649Series R ) e. O
        ->
        E. S e. ( ~P NN0 i^i Fin )
          A. T e. ( ~P NN0 i^i Fin )
            (
              S C_ T
              ->
              ( Q282649Partial R T ) e. O
            )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d J R $.

  thousand-theorems-q282649-pentagonal-number-theorem $a |-
    A. R e. CRing
      A. J e. ( TopOn ` ( Base ` R ) )
        ( Q282649HasProd R J )
  $.
$}

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q282649,
:: "Pentagonal number theorem": over an arbitrary commutative ring with an
:: arbitrary coefficient topology, the finite-subset product net of
:: 1 - X^(n+1) converges coefficientwise to the signed generalized-pentagonal

environ

      WSIERP_1, PREPOWER, SERIES_1, PARTFUN3, BINOM, SETWISEO, RECDEF_1,

      VFUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, XXREAL_0, CARD_1, NUMBERS, INT_1,
      BINOP_2, MEMBERED, NEWTON, AFINSQ_1, VALUED_1, POWER, FINSET_1,
      AFINSQ_2, VALUED_0, FUNCT_1, ALGSTR_0, ALGSTR_1, RLVECT_1,
