 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1, REALSET1;
 expansions TARSKI, VECTSP_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being commutative Ring,
      tau being Subset-Family of R
  st
    the carrier of R in tau &
    (for U,V being Subset of R st U in tau & V in tau
      holds U /\ V in tau) &
    (for G being Subset-Family of R st G c= tau
      holds union G in tau)
  holds
    ex pent being Function of INT,NAT,
       X,P being Element of Formal-Series R,
       x,p being sequence of R,
       powers being Function of NAT,Formal-Series R,
       products being Function of Fin NAT,Formal-Series R,
       productCoeff being Function of [:Fin NAT,NAT:],R
    st
      X = x &
      P = p &
      (for k being Integer holds
        (0 <= k implies
          pent.k = (k * (3*k - 1)) div 2) &
        (k < 0 implies
          pent.k = ((-k) * (3*(-k) + 1)) div 2)) &
      (for n being Nat holds
        (n = 1 implies x.n = 1.R) &
        (n <> 1 implies x.n = 0.R)) &
      (for k being Integer holds
        (k is even implies p.(pent.k) = 1.R) &
        (k is odd implies p.(pent.k) = -1.R)) &
      (for n being Nat st
        not ex k being Integer st pent.k = n
        holds p.n = 0.R) &
      powers.0 = 1.(Formal-Series R) &
      (for n being Nat holds
        ex q,r being sequence of R st
          powers.n = q &
          powers.(n + 1) = r &
          for j being Nat holds
            ex terms being FinSequence of the carrier of R st
              len terms = j + 1 &
              r.j = Sum terms &
              for k being Nat st k in dom terms holds
                ex qk,xk being Element of R st
                  q.(k -' 1) = qk &
                  x.(j + 1 -' k) = xk &
                  terms.k = qk * xk) &
      products.{} = 1.(Formal-Series R) &
      (for A being Element of Fin NAT,
           n being Nat st not n in A
        holds
          ex a,q,f,b being sequence of R st
            products.A = a &
            powers.(n + 1) = q &
            products.(A \/ {n}) = b &
            (for i being Nat holds
              ex qi,fi being Element of R st
                q.i = qi &
                f.i = fi &
                (i = 0 implies fi = 1.R + -qi) &
                (i <> 0 implies fi = -qi)) &
            (for j being Nat holds
              ex terms being FinSequence of the carrier of R st
                len terms = j + 1 &
                b.j = Sum terms &
                for k being Nat st k in dom terms holds
                  ex ak,fk being Element of R st
                    a.(k -' 1) = ak &
                    f.(j + 1 -' k) = fk &
                    terms.k = ak * fk)) &
      (for A being Element of Fin NAT,
           n being Nat
        holds
          ex q being sequence of R st
            products.A = q & productCoeff.(A,n) = q.n) &
      for n being Nat,
          U being Subset of R st U in tau & p.n in U
      holds
        ex A0 being Element of Fin NAT st
          for A being Element of Fin NAT st A0 c= A
          holds productCoeff.(A,n) in U
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q282649,
% "Pentagonal number theorem": over an arbitrary commutative ring, the
% coefficientwise infinite product of 1 - X^(n+1) is the pentagonal power
% series in the product topology. This file contains no proof.

Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem[
  R: TYPE+,
  zeroR, oneR: R,
  negR: [R -> R],
  addR, mulR: [R, R -> R],
  openR: [[R -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  coefficient_set: TYPE = [R -> bool]
  coefficient_set_family: TYPE = [coefficient_set -> bool]
  series: TYPE = [nat -> R]
  factor_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> series]

  empty_coefficient_set: coefficient_set =
    LAMBDA (x: R): FALSE

  full_coefficient_set: coefficient_set =
    LAMBDA (x: R): TRUE

  coefficient_intersection(
      left, right: coefficient_set): coefficient_set =
    LAMBDA (x: R):
      left(x) AND right(x)

  coefficient_union(
      family: coefficient_set_family): coefficient_set =
    LAMBDA (x: R):
      EXISTS (U: coefficient_set):
        family(U) AND U(x)

  topology_laws: bool =
    openR(empty_coefficient_set)
      AND openR(full_coefficient_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (left, right: coefficient_set):
          openR(left) AND openR(right)
            IMPLIES openR(coefficient_intersection(left, right)))
      AND
        (FORALL (family: coefficient_set_family):
          (FORALL (U: coefficient_set):
            family(U) IMPLIES openR(U))
          IMPLIES openR(coefficient_union(family)))

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        addR(x, negR(x)) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(x, addR(y, z)) =
          addR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))

  ring_sum(values: [nat -> R], count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroR
    ELSE
      addR(
        ring_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  series_zero: series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat): zeroR

  series_one: series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 0 THEN oneR ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  series_negate(value: series): series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      negR(value(degree))

  series_add(left, right: series): series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      addR(left(degree), right(degree))

  series_subtract(left, right: series): series =
    series_add(left, series_negate(right))

  series_multiply(left, right: series): series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      ring_sum(
        (LAMBDA (index: nat):
          IF index <= degree THEN
            mulR(left(index), right(degree - index))
          ELSE
            zeroR
          ENDIF),
        degree + 1)

  X_power(exponent: nat): series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = exponent THEN oneR ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  one_sub_X_pow(index: nat): series =
    series_subtract(series_one, X_power(index + 1))

  contains_index(index: nat, indices: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        index = head OR contains_index(index, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  no_duplicate_indices(indices: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT contains_index(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_indices(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  index_subset(left, right: list[nat]): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      contains_index(index, left)
        IMPLIES contains_index(index, right)

  finite_series_product(
      factors: factor_sequence,
      indices: list[nat]): RECURSIVE series =
    CASES indices OF
      null: series_one,
      cons(head, tail):
        series_multiply(
          factors(head),
          finite_series_product(factors, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  pentagonal_relation(k: int, degree: nat): bool =
    2 * (degree :: int) = k * (3 * k - 1)

  pentagonal_witness(degree: nat): int =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (k: int):
        pentagonal_relation(k, degree))

  integer_neg_one_pow(k: int): R =
    IF EXISTS (j: int): k = 2 * j THEN
      oneR
    ELSE
      negR(oneR)
    ENDIF

  pentagonal_series: series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF EXISTS (k: int):
          pentagonal_relation(k, degree)
      THEN
        integer_neg_one_pow(pentagonal_witness(degree))
      ELSE
        zeroR
      ENDIF

  has_product(
      factors: factor_sequence,
      limit: series): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat), (U: coefficient_set):
      (openR(U) AND U(limit(degree)))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (base: list[nat]):
            no_duplicate_indices(base)
              AND
                (FORALL (indices: list[nat]):
                  (no_duplicate_indices(indices)
                    AND index_subset(base, indices))
                  IMPLIES
                    U(finite_series_product(
                      factors,
                      indices)(degree)))

  hasProd_one_sub_X_pow: bool =
    (commutative_ring_laws AND topology_laws)
      IMPLIES
        has_product(one_sub_X_pow, pentagonal_series)
END Q282649_pentagonal_number_theorem

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q285719
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q285719), "Thales's theorem": the angle subtended
-- at a point by the endpoints of a sphere's diameter is a right angle exactly
-- when that point lies on the sphere, with right angles encoded by zero inner
-- product. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.AddTorsor
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Defs

@[expose] public section

namespace Q285719

variable {V : Type*} {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
  [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P]

structure Sphere (P : Type*) where
  center : P
  radius : ℝ

namespace Sphere

/-- Membership in the metric sphere with the bundled center and radius. -/
def Mem {P : Type*} [MetricSpace P] (s : Sphere P) (p : P) : Prop :=
  dist p s.center = s.radius

instance {P : Type*} [MetricSpace P] : Membership P (Sphere P) where
  mem s p := s.Mem p

/-- The endpoints lie oppositely about the center, equivalently their midpoint is the center. -/
structure IsDiameter {V P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [MetricSpace P]
    [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s : Sphere P) (p₁ p₃ : P) : Prop where
  left_mem : p₁ ∈ s
  endpoints_opposite : (p₁ -ᵥ s.center : V) = -(p₃ -ᵥ s.center : V)

end Sphere

/-- Thales's theorem, with a right angle represented by orthogonality. -/
theorem thales_theorem {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} {s : Sphere P}
    (hd : s.IsDiameter (V := V) p₁ p₃) :
    inner ℝ (p₁ -ᵥ p₂ : V) (p₃ -ᵥ p₂ : V) = 0 ↔ p₂ ∈ s := sorry

end Q285719

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q285719
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q285719), "Thales's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, if two points are endpoints of a diameter
  of a sphere, the angle they subtend at a third point is pi/2 exactly when
  that third point lies on the sphere. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q285719_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q285719_zero : V;
  q285719_add : V -> V -> V;
  q285719_neg : V -> V;
  q285719_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q285719_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q285719_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q285719_add x (q285719_add y z) =
      q285719_add (q285719_add x y) z;
  q285719_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q285719_add x y = q285719_add y x;
  q285719_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q285719_add x q285719_zero = x;
  q285719_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q285719_add x (q285719_neg x) = q285719_zero;

  q285719_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q285719_smul 1 x = x;
  q285719_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q285719_smul (a * b) x =
      q285719_smul a (q285719_smul b x);
  q285719_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q285719_smul a (q285719_add x y) =
      q285719_add (q285719_smul a x) (q285719_smul a y);
  q285719_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q285719_smul (a + b) x =
      q285719_add (q285719_smul a x) (q285719_smul b x);

  q285719_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q285719_inner (q285719_add x y) z =
      q285719_inner x z + q285719_inner y z;
  q285719_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q285719_inner (q285719_smul a x) y =
      a * q285719_inner x y;
  q285719_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q285719_inner x y = q285719_inner y x;
  q285719_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q285719_inner x x;
  q285719_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q285719_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q285719_zero
}.

Arguments q285719_zero {V} _.
Arguments q285719_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q285719_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q285719_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q285719_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q285719_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q285719_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q285719_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q285719_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q285719_vadd (q285719_zero E) p = p;
  q285719_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q285719_vadd (q285719_add E x y) p =
      q285719_vadd x (q285719_vadd y p);
  q285719_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q285719_vsub (q285719_vadd x p) p = x;
  q285719_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q285719_vadd (q285719_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q285719_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q285719_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q285719_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q285719_inner E x x).

Definition q285719_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q285719_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q285719_norm E (q285719_vsub A p q).

Definition q285719_midpoint
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q285719_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : P :=
  q285719_vadd A
    (q285719_smul E (1 / 2) (q285719_vsub A p q)) q.

Record q285719_sphere (P : Type) : Type := {
  q285719_center : P;
  q285719_radius : R
}.

Arguments q285719_center {P} _.
Arguments q285719_radius {P} _.

Definition q285719_mem_sphere
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q285719_affine_torsor V P E)
    (s : q285719_sphere P)
    (p : P) : Prop :=
  q285719_dist A p (q285719_center s) = q285719_radius s.

Definition q285719_is_diameter
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q285719_affine_torsor V P E)
    (s : q285719_sphere P)
    (p1 p3 : P) : Prop :=
  q285719_mem_sphere A s p1 /\
  q285719_midpoint A p1 p3 = q285719_center s.

Definition q285719_angle_eq_pi_div_two
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q285719_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p1 p2 p3 : P) : Prop :=
  q285719_inner E
    (q285719_vsub A p1 p2)
    (q285719_vsub A p3 p2) = 0.

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_Sphere_thales_theorem :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q285719_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q285719_affine_torsor V P E)
         (p1 p2 p3 : P)
         (s : q285719_sphere P),
    q285719_is_diameter A s p1 p3 ->
    (q285719_angle_eq_pi_div_two A p1 p2 p3 <->
     q285719_mem_sphere A s p2).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q285719,
  "Thales's theorem": in a real inner-product affine space, if two points are
  endpoints of a sphere diameter, then the angle at a third point is a right
  angle exactly when that point lies on the sphere. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q285719_thales_s_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

record 'p q285719_sphere =
  q285719_center :: 'p
  q285719_radius :: real

locale q285719_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q285719_vadd :: "'v::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q285719_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q285719_zero_vadd:
      "q285719_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q285719_add_vadd:
      "q285719_vadd (u + v) p = q285719_vadd u (q285719_vadd v p)"
    and q285719_vadd_vsub:
      "q285719_vadd (q285719_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q285719_vsub_vadd:
      "q285719_vsub (q285719_vadd v p) p = v"
begin

definition q285719_dist :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q285719_dist p q = norm (q285719_vsub p q)"

definition q285719_midpoint :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p" where
  "q285719_midpoint p q =
    q285719_vadd ((1 / 2) *\<^sub>R q285719_vsub p q) q"

definition q285719_angle :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q285719_angle p1 p2 p3 =
    arccos (inner (q285719_vsub p1 p2) (q285719_vsub p3 p2) /
      (norm (q285719_vsub p1 p2) * norm (q285719_vsub p3 p2)))"

definition q285719_sphere_mem :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p q285719_sphere \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q285719_sphere_mem p s \<longleftrightarrow>
    q285719_dist p (q285719_center s) = q285719_radius s"

definition q285719_is_diameter ::
    "'p q285719_sphere \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q285719_is_diameter s p1 p3 \<longleftrightarrow>
    q285719_sphere_mem p1 s \<and>
    q285719_midpoint p1 p3 = q285719_center s"

theorem thales_theorem:
  fixes p1 p2 p3 :: 'p
    and s :: "'p q285719_sphere"
  assumes "q285719_is_diameter s p1 p3"
  shows
    "q285719_angle p1 p2 p3 = pi / 2 \<longleftrightarrow>
      q285719_sphere_mem p2 s"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q285719
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q285719), "Thales's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, an angle subtended by a sphere's diameter is
  right exactly when its vertex lies on the sphere. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/transc.ml";;

let Q285719_THALES_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!p:P. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:V. !p:P.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!v:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (p:P) (q:P).
       norm inner (vsub p q) in
  let point_angle =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p1:P) (p2:P) (p3:P).
       acs (inner (vsub p1 p2) (vsub p3 p2) /
            (norm inner (vsub p1 p2) * norm inner (vsub p3 p2))) in
  let sphere_mem =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (center:P) (radius:real) (p:P).
       distance inner vsub p center = radius in
  let is_diameter =
    \(neg:V->V) (inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (center:P) (radius:real) (p1:P) (p3:P).
       sphere_mem inner vsub center radius p3 /\
       vsub p1 center = neg (vsub p3 center) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !center:P.
  !radius:real.
  !p1 p2 p3:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    is_diameter neg inner vsub center radius p1 p3
    ==>
    (point_angle inner vsub p1 p2 p3 = pi / &2 <=>
     sphere_mem inner vsub center radius p2)`;;

        (equal

(defun-sk q285719-point-space-nonempty-p (point-space)
  (exists (point)
    (q285719-p-member-p point-space point)))

(defun-sk q285719-affine-torsor-laws-p
    (real vector-space point-space)
  (forall (u v p q r)
    (implies
     (and (q285719-v-member-p vector-space u)
          (q285719-v-member-p vector-space v)
          (q285719-p-member-p point-space p)
          (q285719-p-member-p point-space q)
          (q285719-p-member-p point-space r))
     (let ((zero-v (q285719-v-zero real vector-space)))
       (and
        (q285719-p-member-p
         point-space
         (q285719-vadd real vector-space point-space u p))
        (q285719-v-member-p
         vector-space
         (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space p q))
        (equal
         (q285719-vadd real vector-space point-space zero-v p)
         p)
        (equal
         (q285719-vadd
          real vector-space point-space
          (q285719-v-add real vector-space u v) p)
         (q285719-vadd
          real vector-space point-space u
          (q285719-vadd real vector-space point-space v p)))
        (equal
         (q285719-vadd
          real vector-space point-space
          (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space p q) q)
         p)
        (equal
         (q285719-vsub
          real vector-space point-space
          (q285719-vadd real vector-space point-space u p) p)
         u)
        (equal
         (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space p r)
         (q285719-v-add
          real vector-space
          (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space p q)
          (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space q r))))))))

(defun q285719-context-p (real vector-space point-space)
  (and
   (q285719-real-p real)
   (q285719-v-member-p
    vector-space (q285719-v-zero real vector-space))
   (q285719-vector-space-laws-p real vector-space)
   (q285719-inner-product-laws-p real vector-space)
   (q285719-point-space-nonempty-p point-space)
   (q285719-affine-torsor-laws-p real vector-space point-space)))

(defun q285719-norm-squared (real vector-space vector)
  (q285719-inner real vector-space vector vector))

;; A metric-sphere membership equation is rendered without square roots.
;; Nonnegativity of the radius makes this exactly dist(point,center)=radius.
(defun q285719-sphere-member-p
    (real vector-space point-space center radius point)
  (let ((displacement
         (q285719-vsub
          real vector-space point-space point center)))
    (and
     (q285719-r-member-p real radius)
     (q285719-r-leq real (q285719-r-zero real) radius)
     (equal
      (q285719-norm-squared real vector-space displacement)
      (q285719-r-mul real radius radius)))))

;; Under the affine torsor laws, opposite center-displacement vectors are
;; equivalent to midpoint(p1,p3)=center. Together with left membership this
;; is exactly the source structure Sphere.IsDiameter.
(defun q285719-is-diameter-p
    (real vector-space point-space center radius p1 p3)
  (and
   (q285719-sphere-member-p
    real vector-space point-space center radius p1)
   (equal
    (q285719-vsub
     real vector-space point-space p1 center)
    (q285719-v-neg
     real vector-space
     (q285719-vsub
      real vector-space point-space p3 center)))))

;; Mathlib's angle is pi/2 exactly when the two rays have zero inner product,
;; including its degenerate zero-ray convention.
(defun q285719-right-angle-p
    (real vector-space point-space p1 p2 p3)
  (equal
   (q285719-inner
    real vector-space
    (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space p1 p2)
    (q285719-vsub real vector-space point-space p3 p2))
   (q285719-r-zero real)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q285719-thales-theorem-statement
    (real vector-space point-space)
  (forall (center radius p1 p2 p3)
    (implies
     (and
      (q285719-context-p real vector-space point-space)
      (q285719-p-member-p point-space center)
      (q285719-p-member-p point-space p1)
      (q285719-p-member-p point-space p2)
      (q285719-p-member-p point-space p3)
      (q285719-is-diameter-p
       real vector-space point-space center radius p1 p3))
     (iff
      (q285719-right-angle-p
       real vector-space point-space p1 p2 p3)
      (q285719-sphere-member-p
       real vector-space point-space center radius p2)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q285719
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q285719), "Thales's theorem": in a real
-- Euclidean affine space, the angle subtended by a sphere's diameter is pi
-- divided by two exactly at points on the sphere. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q285719_thales_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) and (oneR != zeroR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record RealInnerProductAngleSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm v)
    norm-square :
      (v : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm v) (norm v) == inner v v
    norm-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      norm v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV
    norm-negate :
      (v : V) ->
      norm (negateV v) == norm v

    pi halfPi : R
    cosine : R -> R
    vectorAngle : V -> V -> R

    half-pi-doubles :
      addR reals halfPi halfPi == pi
    cosine-half-pi :
      cosine halfPi == zeroR reals

    vector-angle-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      vectorAngle u v == vectorAngle v u
    vector-angle-zero-left :
      (v : V) ->
      vectorAngle zeroV v == halfPi
    vector-angle-zero-right :
      (v : V) ->
      vectorAngle v zeroV == halfPi
    vector-angle-nonnegative :
      (u v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (vectorAngle u v)
    vector-angle-at-most-pi :
      (u v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (vectorAngle u v) pi
    vector-angle-cosine :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v ==
      multiplyR reals
        (multiplyR reals (norm u) (norm v))
        (cosine (vectorAngle u v))
    right-angle-characterization :
      (u v : V) ->
      Iff
        (vectorAngle u v == halfPi)
        (inner u v == zeroR reals)

open RealInnerProductAngleSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine p q =
  norm space (vsub affine p q)

angleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
angleAt {space = space} affine p q r =
  vectorAngle space
    (vsub affine p q)
    (vsub affine r q)

twoR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
twoR reals =
  fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))

halfR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
halfR reals =
  inverseR reals (twoR reals)

midpoint :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P
midpoint {reals = reals} {space = space} affine p q =
  vadd affine
    (scaleV space (halfR reals) (vsub affine p q))
    q

record Sphere {R P : Set} : Set where
  constructor sphere
  field
    center : P
    radius : R

open Sphere

OnSphere :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  Sphere {R} {P} ->
  P ->
  Set
OnSphere affine s p =
  distance affine p (center s) == radius s

IsDiameter :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  Sphere {R} {P} ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
IsDiameter affine s p1 p3 =
  OnSphere affine s p1
  and
  (OnSphere affine s p3
  and
  (midpoint affine p1 p3 == center s))

thales-theorem : Set1
thales-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (s : Sphere {R} {P}) ->
  (p1 p2 p3 : P) ->
  IsDiameter affine s p1 p3 ->
  Iff
    (angleAt affine p1 p2 p3 == halfPi space)
    (OnSphere affine s p2)

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q285719, "Thales's theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine
  space, diameter endpoints subtend a right angle at exactly the points on
  the sphere, with the right-angle condition represented by equivalent
  inner-product orthogonality. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory;

val q285719_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q285719_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q285719_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q285719_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q285719_norm_def",
  ``q285719_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q285719_mem_sphere_def = new_definition (
  "q285719_mem_sphere_def",
  ``q285719_mem_sphere
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (center : 'p)
      (radius : real)
      (p : 'p) <=>
      q285719_norm inner (vsub p center) = radius``);

val q285719_is_diameter_def = new_definition (
  "q285719_is_diameter_def",
  ``q285719_is_diameter
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (center : 'p)
      (radius : real)
      (p1 : 'p)
      (p3 : 'p) <=>
      q285719_mem_sphere inner vsub center radius p3 /\
      vsub p1 center = neg (vsub p3 center)``);

val thales_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (center p1 p2 p3 : 'p)
      (radius : real).
      q285719_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q285719_is_diameter neg inner vsub center radius p1 p3
      ==>
      (inner (vsub p1 p2) (vsub p3 p2) = 0 <=>
       q285719_mem_sphere inner vsub center radius p2)``;

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q285719
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q285719), "Thales's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, if two points are diameter endpoints of a
  sphere, then the angle they subtend at a third point is a right angle if
  and only if that third point lies on the sphere. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces represented by SetMM
  CPreHil structures whose scalar field is RRfld. Choosing any point as an
  affine origin identifies the source's normed affine torsor with this vector
  presentation while preserving spheres, midpoints, distances, and angles.

  W Q285719Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q285719Dist A B is its norm,
  and W Q285719Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When either
  ray is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention; otherwise
  it is the arccosine of the normalized inner product.

  W Q285719Sphere O R is the sphere with center O and radius R.
  W Q285719Mid A C is the affine midpoint of A and C, and
  W Q285719IsDiameter O R A C says that A lies on that sphere and the
  midpoint of A and C is O. This is exactly the source Sphere.IsDiameter
  structure with the sphere record represented by its center-radius pair;
  C's membership follows from the equal distances to the midpoint.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and the database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  Q285719Ray Q285719Dist Q285719Angle
  Q285719Sphere Q285719Mid Q285719IsDiameter
$.

q285719-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q285719Ray A B ) $.
q285719-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q285719Dist A B ) $.
q285719-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q285719Angle A B C ) $.
q285719-sphere-syntax $a class ( W Q285719Sphere O R ) $.
q285719-midpoint-syntax $a class ( W Q285719Mid A C ) $.
q285719-is-diameter-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q285719IsDiameter O R A C ) $.

q285719-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q285719Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q285719-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q285719Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q285719Ray A B )
) $.

q285719-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q285719Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q285719Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q285719Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q285719Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q285719Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q285719Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q285719Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d O R W X $.

  q285719-sphere-definition $a |- (
    W Q285719Sphere O R
  ) = {
    X e. ( Base ` W ) |
      ( W Q285719Dist X O ) = R
  } $.
$}

q285719-midpoint-definition $a |- (
  W Q285719Mid A C
) = (
  ( 1 / 2 )
  ( .s ` W )
  ( A ( +g ` W ) C )
) $.

q285719-is-diameter-definition $a |- (
  ( W Q285719IsDiameter O R A C )
  <->
  (
    A e. ( W Q285719Sphere O R )
    /\
    ( W Q285719Mid A C ) = O
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C O R W $.

  thousand-theorems-q285719-thales-theorem $a |- A. W
    (
      (
        W e. CPreHil
        /\
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
      )
      ->
      A. O e. ( Base ` W )
        A. R e. RR
          A. A e. ( Base ` W )
            A. B e. ( Base ` W )
              A. C e. ( Base ` W )
                (
                  ( W Q285719IsDiameter O R A C )
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      ( W Q285719Angle A B C )
                      =
                      ( _pi / 2 )
                    )
                    <->
                    B e. ( W Q285719Sphere O R )
                  )
                )
    )
  $.
$}

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem

:: Statement-only formalization of "Thales's theorem" from Thousand Theorems
:: artifact Q285719 (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q285719). In an arbitrary real
:: inner-product affine space, the angle subtended by diameter endpoints is
:: PI/2 exactly at the points of their sphere. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, BHSP_1, PRE_TOPC, SUBSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FUNCT_1, RELAT_1,

title: Q285719_thales_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q285719,
% "Thales's theorem": diameter endpoints of a sphere in a real inner-product
% affine space subtend a right angle exactly at the points on the sphere.
% This file contains no proof.

Q285719_thales_s_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  sphere: TYPE = [# center: P, radius: real #]

  squared_norm(u: V): real =
    inner(u, u)

  on_sphere(p: P, s: sphere): bool =
    0 <= radius(s)
      AND radius(s) * radius(s) =
        squared_norm(vsub(p, center(s)))

  affine_midpoint(p, q: P): P =
    point_vadd(scale(1 / 2, vsub(q, p)), p)

  is_diameter(s: sphere, p1, p3: P): bool =
    on_sphere(p1, s)
      AND affine_midpoint(p1, p3) = center(s)

  right_angle_at(p1, p2, p3: P): bool =
    inner(vsub(p1, p2), vsub(p3, p2)) = 0

  thales_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p1, p2, p3: P), (s: sphere):
        is_diameter(s, p1, p3) IMPLIES
          (right_angle_at(p1, p2, p3) IFF on_sphere(p2, s)))
END Q285719_thales_s_theorem

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q288465
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q288465), "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for any group
-- action and point, the point's orbit is equivalent to the acting group modulo
-- the point's stabilizer. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Coset.Basic
public import Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupAction.Basic

@[expose] public section

universe u v

namespace Q288465

variable {β : Type v}

/-- The orbit of a point is equivalent to the acting group modulo its stabilizer. -/
noncomputable def orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer_statement
    (α : Type u) [Group α] [MulAction α β] (b : β) :
    MulAction.orbit α b ≃ α ⧸ MulAction.stabilizer α b := sorry

end Q288465

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q288465
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q288465), "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for an
  arbitrary group action, the orbit of a point is equivalent to the quotient
  of the acting group by that point's stabilizer. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Record q288465_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q288465_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q288465_one : G;
  q288465_inv : G -> G;
  q288465_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q288465_mul x (q288465_mul y z) =
      q288465_mul (q288465_mul x y) z;
  q288465_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q288465_mul q288465_one x = x;
  q288465_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q288465_mul x q288465_one = x;
  q288465_inv_mul :
    forall x : G, q288465_mul (q288465_inv x) x = q288465_one;
  q288465_mul_inv :
    forall x : G, q288465_mul x (q288465_inv x) = q288465_one
}.

Arguments q288465_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q288465_one {G} _.
Arguments q288465_inv {G} _ _.

Record q288465_mul_action
    (G X : Type)
    (grp : q288465_group G) : Type := {
  q288465_act : G -> X -> X;
  q288465_one_act :
    forall x : X, q288465_act (q288465_one grp) x = x;
  q288465_mul_act :
    forall (g h : G) (x : X),
      q288465_act (q288465_mul grp g h) x =
      q288465_act g (q288465_act h x)
}.

Arguments q288465_act {G X grp} _ _ _.

Definition q288465_orbit
    {G X : Type}
    {grp : q288465_group G}
    (action : q288465_mul_action G X grp)
    (b y : X) : Prop :=
  exists g : G, q288465_act action g b = y.

Definition q288465_stabilizer
    {G X : Type}
    {grp : q288465_group G}
    (action : q288465_mul_action G X grp)
    (b : X)
    (g : G) : Prop :=
  q288465_act action g b = b.

Definition q288465_orbit_type
    {G X : Type}
    {grp : q288465_group G}
    (action : q288465_mul_action G X grp)
    (b : X) : Type :=
  { y : X | q288465_orbit action b y }.

Definition q288465_orbit_equal
    {G X : Type}
    {grp : q288465_group G}
    {action : q288465_mul_action G X grp}
    {b : X}
    (x y : q288465_orbit_type action b) : Prop :=
  proj1_sig x = proj1_sig y.

Definition q288465_quotient_equal
    {G X : Type}
    (grp : q288465_group G)
    (action : q288465_mul_action G X grp)
    (b : X)
    (g h : G) : Prop :=
  q288465_stabilizer action b
    (q288465_mul grp (q288465_inv grp g) h).

Definition q288465_setoid_equivalent
    (A B : Type)
    (equalA : A -> A -> Prop)
    (equalB : B -> B -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists forward : A -> B, exists backward : B -> A,
    (forall x y : A,
      equalA x y -> equalB (forward x) (forward y)) /\
    (forall x y : B,
      equalB x y -> equalA (backward x) (backward y)) /\
    (forall x : A, equalA (backward (forward x)) x) /\
    (forall y : B, equalB (forward (backward y)) y).

Theorem MulAction_orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer :
  forall (G X : Type)
         (grp : q288465_group G)
         (action : q288465_mul_action G X grp)
         (b : X),
    q288465_setoid_equivalent
      (q288465_orbit_type action b)
      G
      q288465_orbit_equal
      (q288465_quotient_equal grp action b).
Admitted.

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q288465
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q288465), "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for a
  group acting on a type, the orbit of a point is canonically equivalent to
  the quotient of the group by that point's stabilizer. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q288465_orbit ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'x) \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'x set"
  where
    "q288465_orbit act b = {x. \<exists>g. act g b = x}"

definition q288465_stabilizer ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'x) \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'g set"
  where
    "q288465_stabilizer act b = {g. act g b = b}"

definition q288465_left_coset ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g set"
  where
    "q288465_left_coset H g = (\<lambda>h. g + h) ` H"

definition q288465_quotient_stabilizer ::
    "('g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'x) \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'g set set"
  where
    "q288465_quotient_stabilizer act b =
      q288465_left_coset (q288465_stabilizer act b) ` UNIV"

theorem orbit_stabilizer_equivalence:
  fixes act :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'x \<Rightarrow> 'x"
    and b :: "'x"
  assumes action_zero: "\<And>x. act 0 x = x"
    and action_add: "\<And>g h x. act (g + h) x = act g (act h x)"
  shows "\<exists>to_orbit :: 'g set \<Rightarrow> 'x.
    bij_betw to_orbit
      (q288465_quotient_stabilizer act b)
      (q288465_orbit act b) \<and>
    (\<forall>g. to_orbit
      (q288465_left_coset (q288465_stabilizer act b) g) = act g b)"
  sorry

end

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q288465,
;; "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for an arbitrary group action, the orbit of a
;; point is canonically equivalent to the quotient of the group by that
;; point's stabilizer. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, operations, and actions are tame function objects.
;; Each unbounded quantifier is flattened to one tuple variable and checked
;; with FN-EQUAL.

(defun q288465-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q288465-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'cons
       (car terms)
       (q288465-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q288465-quoted nil)))

(defun q288465-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list
   'apply$
   (q288465-quoted function)
   (q288465-term-list arguments)))

(defun q288465-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list
       'if
       (car terms)
       (q288465-and-terms (cdr terms))
       (q288465-quoted nil))
    (q288465-quoted t)))

(defun q288465-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list
   'if
   hypothesis
   conclusion
   (q288465-quoted t)))

(defun q288465-iff-term (left right)
  (list
   'if
   left
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q288465-quoted t)
    (q288465-quoted nil))
   (list
    'if
    right
    (q288465-quoted nil)
    (q288465-quoted t))))

(defun q288465-nth-term (index tuple)
  (list 'nth (q288465-quoted index) tuple))

(defun q288465-tuple-of-length-term (tuple length)
  (q288465-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'true-listp tuple)
    (list
     'equal
     (list 'len tuple)
     (q288465-quoted length)))))

(defun q288465-member-term (carrier object)
  (q288465-apply-term carrier (list object)))

(defun q288465-mul-term (multiplication left right)
  (q288465-apply-term multiplication (list left right)))

(defun q288465-inv-term (inverse object)
  (q288465-apply-term inverse (list object)))

(defun q288465-action-term (action group-element point)
  (q288465-apply-term action (list group-element point)))

(defun q288465-true-function ()
  (list 'lambda '(tuple) (q288465-quoted t)))

(defun q288465-universal-p (condition)
  (let ((always-true (q288465-true-function)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp condition)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal condition always-true))))

(defun q288465-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object))
      t
    nil))

;; Group structure on the acting carrier.

(defun q288465-group-laws-function
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (let* ((x (q288465-nth-term 0 'tuple))
         (y (q288465-nth-term 1 'tuple))
         (z (q288465-nth-term 2 'tuple))
         (x-in (q288465-member-term carrier x))
         (y-in (q288465-member-term carrier y))
         (z-in (q288465-member-term carrier z))
         (inv-x (q288465-inv-term inverse x))
         (xy (q288465-mul-term multiplication x y))
         (unary-hypothesis
          (q288465-and-terms
           (list
            (q288465-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 1)
            x-in)))
         (binary-hypothesis
          (q288465-and-terms
           (list
            (q288465-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 2)
            x-in
            y-in)))
         (ternary-hypothesis
          (q288465-and-terms
           (list
            (q288465-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 3)
            x-in
            y-in
            z-in))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(tuple)
     (q288465-and-terms
      (list
       (q288465-implies-term
        unary-hypothesis
        (q288465-and-terms
         (list
          (q288465-member-term carrier inv-x)
          (list
           'equal
           (q288465-mul-term
            multiplication x (q288465-quoted identity))
           x)
          (list
           'equal
           (q288465-mul-term
            multiplication (q288465-quoted identity) x)
           x)
          (list
           'equal
           (q288465-mul-term multiplication x inv-x)
           (q288465-quoted identity))
          (list
           'equal
           (q288465-mul-term multiplication inv-x x)
           (q288465-quoted identity)))))
       (q288465-implies-term
        binary-hypothesis
        (q288465-member-term carrier xy))
       (q288465-implies-term
        ternary-hypothesis
        (list
         'equal
         (q288465-mul-term
          multiplication
          (q288465-mul-term multiplication x y)
          z)
         (q288465-mul-term
          multiplication
          x
          (q288465-mul-term multiplication y z)))))))))

(defun q288465-group-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q288465-member-p carrier identity)
   (q288465-universal-p
    (q288465-group-laws-function
     carrier multiplication inverse identity))))

;; Multiplicative action on an arbitrary point carrier.

(defun q288465-action-laws-function
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     identity
     action)
  (let* ((g (q288465-nth-term 0 'tuple))
         (h (q288465-nth-term 1 'tuple))
         (x (q288465-nth-term 2 'tuple))
         (unary-x (q288465-nth-term 0 'tuple))
         (g-in (q288465-member-term group-carrier g))
         (h-in (q288465-member-term group-carrier h))
         (x-in (q288465-member-term point-carrier x))
         (unary-x-in
          (q288465-member-term point-carrier unary-x))
         (binary-hypothesis
          (q288465-and-terms
           (list
            (q288465-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 2)
            g-in
            (q288465-member-term point-carrier h))))
         (ternary-hypothesis
          (q288465-and-terms
           (list
            (q288465-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 3)
            g-in
            h-in
            x-in))))
    (list
     'lambda
     '(tuple)
     (q288465-and-terms
      (list
       (q288465-implies-term
        (q288465-and-terms
         (list
          (q288465-tuple-of-length-term 'tuple 1)
          unary-x-in))
        (list
         'equal
         (q288465-action-term
          action
          (q288465-quoted identity)
          unary-x)
         unary-x))
       (q288465-implies-term
        binary-hypothesis
        (q288465-member-term
         point-carrier
         (q288465-action-term action g h)))
       (q288465-implies-term
        ternary-hypothesis
        (list
         'equal
         (q288465-action-term
          action
          (q288465-mul-term multiplication g h)
          x)
         (q288465-action-term
          action
          g
          (q288465-action-term action h x)))))))))

(defun q288465-action-p
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     identity
     action)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp point-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp action)
   (q288465-universal-p
    (q288465-action-laws-function
     group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     identity
     action))))

;; The orbit is the exact range of g |-> g action base-point inside the point
;; carrier. The left-coset quotient relation for the stabilizer identifies g
;; and h exactly when g^-1*h fixes the base point.

(defun-sk q288465-orbit-member-p
    (group-carrier point-carrier action base-point point)
  (exists (g)
    (and
     (q288465-member-p point-carrier point)
     (q288465-member-p group-carrier g)
     (equal
      (apply$ action (list g base-point))
      point))))

(defun q288465-stabilizer-coset-equivalent-p
    (group-carrier multiplication inverse action base-point g h)
  (and
   (q288465-member-p group-carrier g)
   (q288465-member-p group-carrier h)
   (equal
    (apply$
     action
     (list
      (apply$
       multiplication
       (list (apply$ inverse (list g)) h))
      base-point))
    base-point)))

;; The inverse of the Lean equivalence is the canonical map [g] |-> g action
;; base-point. It maps every quotient representative into the orbit, identifies
;; exactly the representatives in the same stabilizer coset, and reaches every
;; orbit point.

(defun-sk q288465-canonical-map-into-orbit-p
    (group-carrier point-carrier action base-point)
  (forall (g)
    (implies
     (q288465-member-p group-carrier g)
     (q288465-orbit-member-p
      group-carrier
      point-carrier
      action
      base-point
      (apply$ action (list g base-point))))))

(defun-sk q288465-canonical-map-equality-p
    (group-carrier multiplication inverse action base-point)
  (forall (g h)
    (implies
     (and
      (q288465-member-p group-carrier g)
      (q288465-member-p group-carrier h))
     (iff
      (q288465-stabilizer-coset-equivalent-p
       group-carrier
       multiplication
       inverse
       action
       base-point
       g
       h)
      (equal
       (apply$ action (list g base-point))
       (apply$ action (list h base-point)))))))

(defun-sk q288465-canonical-preimage-exists-p
    (group-carrier action base-point point)
  (exists (g)
    (and
     (q288465-member-p group-carrier g)
     (equal
      (apply$ action (list g base-point))
      point))))

(defun-sk q288465-canonical-map-surjective-p
    (group-carrier point-carrier action base-point)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q288465-orbit-member-p
      group-carrier point-carrier action base-point point)
     (q288465-canonical-preimage-exists-p
      group-carrier action base-point point))))

(defun q288465-canonical-orbit-quotient-equivalence-p
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     inverse
     action
     base-point)
  (and
   (q288465-canonical-map-into-orbit-p
    group-carrier point-carrier action base-point)
   (q288465-canonical-map-equality-p
    group-carrier multiplication inverse action base-point)
   (q288465-canonical-map-surjective-p
    group-carrier point-carrier action base-point)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q288465-orbit-stabilizer-theorem-statement
    (group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     inverse
     identity
     action
     base-point)
  (implies
   (and
    (q288465-group-p
     group-carrier multiplication inverse identity)
    (q288465-action-p
     group-carrier
     point-carrier
     multiplication
     identity
     action)
   (q288465-member-p point-carrier base-point))
   (q288465-canonical-orbit-quotient-equivalence-p
    group-carrier

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q288465,
-- "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for a group acting on a type and a point, the
-- point's orbit is equivalent to the quotient by its stabilizer.
-- This file contains no proof.

module Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record Action
  {ℓG ℓX : Level}
  {G : Set ℓG}
  (group : Group G)
  (X : Set ℓX) :
  Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX) where

  open Group group

  field
    act          : G → X → X
    act-identity : (x : X) → act identity x ≡ x
    act-multiply :
      (g h : G) →
      (x : X) →
      act (multiply g h) x ≡ act g (act h x)

record OrbitElement
  {ℓG ℓX : Level}
  {G : Set ℓG}
  {X : Set ℓX}
  {group : Group G}
  (action : Action group X)
  (point : X) :
  Set (ℓG ⊔ ℓX) where

  field
    value : X
    reachable :
      Σ G (λ g → Action.act action g point ≡ value)

OrbitEqual :
  {ℓG ℓX : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓG} →
  {X : Set ℓX} →
  {group : Group G} →
  (action : Action group X) →
  (point : X) →
  OrbitElement action point →
  OrbitElement action point →
  Set ℓX
OrbitEqual action point x y =
  OrbitElement.value x ≡ OrbitElement.value y

StabilizerQuotientRelated :
  {ℓG ℓX : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓG} →
  {X : Set ℓX} →
  (group : Group G) →
  (action : Action group X) →
  (point : X) →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓX
StabilizerQuotientRelated group action point g h =
  Action.act action
    (Group.multiply group (Group.inverse group g) h)
    point
  ≡ point

record SetoidEquivalence
  {a b r s : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (_≈A_ : A → A → Set r)
  (_≈B_ : B → B → Set s) :
  Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ r ⊔ s) where

  field
    forward : A → B
    backward : B → A
    forward-congruent :
      (x y : A) →
      x ≈A y →
      forward x ≈B forward y
    backward-congruent :
      (x y : B) →
      x ≈B y →
      backward x ≈A backward y
    backward-forward :
      (x : A) →
      backward (forward x) ≈A x
    forward-backward :
      (y : B) →
      forward (backward y) ≈B y

orbit-stabilizer-theorem :
  (ℓG ℓX : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (ℓG ⊔ ℓX))
orbit-stabilizer-theorem ℓG ℓX =
  {G : Set ℓG} →
  {X : Set ℓX} →
  (group : Group G) →
  (action : Action group X) →
  (point : X) →
  SetoidEquivalence
    (OrbitElement action point)
    G
    (OrbitEqual action point)
    (StabilizerQuotientRelated group action point)

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q288465, "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for a group acting on a type, the orbit
  of a point is canonically bijective with the left cosets of its stabilizer.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (f : 'a -> 'b -> 'b) (b : 'b).
      Group g /\ (g act UNIV) f
      ==>
      ?e : 'b -> 'a set.
        BIJ e
          (orbit f g b)
          (IMAGE (left_coset g (stabilizer f g b)) g.carrier) /\
        !a. a IN g.carrier ==>
            e (f a b) = left_coset g (stabilizer f g b) a``;

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q288465
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q288465), "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for an
  arbitrary group action and point, the point's orbit is in bijection with
  the left-coset quotient of the group by the point stabilizer. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q288465Stabilizer G Y A b is the subgroup carrier of elements of G fixing
  b under the action A. Q288465OrbitRel G Y A is the orbit equivalence
  relation on Y. Q288465OrbitMap G Y A b sends the left coset of g modulo
  the stabilizer to A(g,b).

  The final $a assertion says that this canonical map is a bijection from the
  left-coset quotient onto the orbit of b. Its inverse is the equivalence from
  the orbit to the quotient represented by
  MulAction.orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer. The auxiliary $a declarations are
  syntax or faithful definitions; this file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q288465Stabilizer Q288465OrbitRel Q288465OrbitMap $.

q288465-stabilizer-syntax $a class
  ( Q288465Stabilizer G Y A b ) $.
q288465-orbit-rel-syntax $a class
  ( Q288465OrbitRel G Y A ) $.
q288465-orbit-map-syntax $a class
  ( Q288465OrbitMap G Y A b ) $.

${
  $d A G Y b u $.

  q288465-stabilizer-definition $a |-
    ( Q288465Stabilizer G Y A b )
    =
    { u e. ( Base ` G ) | ( A ` <. u , b >. ) = b }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A G Y g x y $.

  q288465-orbit-rel-definition $a |-
    ( Q288465OrbitRel G Y A )
    =
    { <. x , y >. |
      (
        { x , y } C_ Y
        /\
        E. g e. ( Base ` G ) ( A ` <. g , x >. ) = y
      )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d A G Y b g $.

  q288465-orbit-map-definition $a |-
    ( Q288465OrbitMap G Y A b )
    =
    ran
    (
      g e. ( Base ` G )
      |->
      <.
        [ g ] ( G ~QG ( Q288465Stabilizer G Y A b ) )
        ,
        ( A ` <. g , b >. )
      >.
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A G Y b $.

  thousand-theorems-q288465-orbit-stabilizer-theorem $a |- (
    A. G A. Y A. A A. b
      (
        (
          A e. ( G GrpAct Y )
          /\
          b e. Y
        )
        ->
        ( Q288465OrbitMap G Y A b )
        :
        (
          ( Base ` G )
          /.
          ( G ~QG ( Q288465Stabilizer G Y A b ) )
        )
        -1-1-onto->
        [ b ] ( Q288465OrbitRel G Y A )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q288465
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q288465), "Orbit-stabilizer theorem": for any group
% action and point, the point's orbit is canonically bijective to the left-coset
% quotient of the acting group by the point's stabilizer. This file contains no proof.

Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  X: TYPE,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G,
  action: [G, X -> X]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  group_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  coset_point_relation: TYPE = [group_set, X -> bool]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (g, h, k: G):
      mul(mul(g, h), k) = mul(g, mul(h, k)))
      AND (FORALL (g: G):
        mul(one, g) = g
          AND mul(g, one) = g)
      AND (FORALL (g: G):
        mul(inv(g), g) = one
          AND mul(g, inv(g)) = one)

  action_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: X):
      action(one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (g, h: G), (x: X):
        action(mul(g, h), x) = action(g, action(h, x)))

  orbit(b: X): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (g: G):
        x = action(g, b)

  stabilizer(b: X): group_set =
    LAMBDA (g: G):
      action(g, b) = b

  left_coset(g: G, H: group_set): group_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      EXISTS (h: G):
        H(h) AND x = mul(g, h)

  quotient_stabilizer(b: X): [group_set -> bool] =
    LAMBDA (C: group_set):
      EXISTS (g: G):
        C = left_coset(g, stabilizer(b))

  canonical_relation(C: group_set, x, b: X): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G):
      C = left_coset(g, stabilizer(b))
        AND x = action(g, b)

  is_bijection(
      relation: coset_point_relation,
      b: X): bool =
    (FORALL (C: group_set), (x: X):
      relation(C, x) IMPLIES
        quotient_stabilizer(b)(C) AND orbit(b)(x))
      AND (FORALL (C: group_set):
        quotient_stabilizer(b)(C) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: X):
            orbit(b)(x) AND relation(C, x))
      AND (FORALL (C: group_set), (x, y: X):
        quotient_stabilizer(b)(C)
          AND orbit(b)(x)
          AND orbit(b)(y)
          AND relation(C, x)
          AND relation(C, y)
          IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        orbit(b)(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (C: group_set):
            quotient_stabilizer(b)(C) AND relation(C, x))
      AND (FORALL (C, D: group_set), (x: X):
        quotient_stabilizer(b)(C)
          AND quotient_stabilizer(b)(D)
          AND orbit(b)(x)
          AND relation(C, x)
          AND relation(D, x)
          IMPLIES C = D)

  orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer: bool =
    (group_laws AND action_laws)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (b: X):
          is_bijection(
            LAMBDA (C: group_set), (x: X):
              canonical_relation(C, x, b),
            b)

END Q288465_orbit_stabilizer_theorem

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q2919401), "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial
-- real-valued absolute value on the rationals is equivalent either to the standard

module

public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Ostrowski

@[expose] public section

namespace Q2919401

/-- Ostrowski's theorem for nontrivial real-valued absolute values on `ℚ`. -/
theorem ostrowski_statement (f : AbsoluteValue ℚ ℝ) (hf_nontriv : f.IsNontrivial) :
    f ≈ Rat.AbsoluteValue.real ∨
