title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2919401
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q2919401), "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial
  real-valued absolute value on the rationals is equivalent either to the
  standard absolute value or, for a unique prime p, to the p-adic absolute
  value. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Arith.PeanoNat QArith.QArith Reals.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q2919401_is_absolute_value (v : Q -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : Q, Qeq x y -> v x = v y) /\
  (forall x y : Q, v (Qmult x y) = v x * v y) /\
  (forall x : Q, 0 <= v x) /\
  (forall x : Q, v x = 0 <-> Qeq x 0%Q) /\
  (forall x y : Q, v (Qplus x y) <= v x + v y).

Definition q2919401_is_nontrivial (v : Q -> R) : Prop :=
  exists x : Q, ~ Qeq x 0%Q /\ v x <> 1.

Definition q2919401_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1%nat \/ d = p.

Definition q2919401_p_order
    (p n k : nat) : Prop :=
  n <> 0%nat /\
  Nat.divide (Nat.pow p k) n /\
  ~ Nat.divide (Nat.pow p (S k)) n.

Definition q2919401_real_power
    (base exponent : R) : R :=
  if Rlt_dec 0 base
  then Rpower base exponent
  else 0.

Definition q2919401_equivalent_to_real
    (v : Q -> R) : Prop :=
  exists c : R,
    0 < c /\
    forall x : Q,
      q2919401_real_power (v x) c = Rabs (Q2R x).

Definition q2919401_equivalent_to_padic
    (v : Q -> R) (p : nat) : Prop :=
  exists c : R,
    0 < c /\
    forall x : Q,
      (Qeq x 0%Q /\ q2919401_real_power (v x) c = 0) \/
      (~ Qeq x 0%Q /\
       exists numerator_order denominator_order : nat,
         q2919401_p_order
           p (Z.abs_nat (Qnum x)) numerator_order /\
         q2919401_p_order
           p (Pos.to_nat (Qden x)) denominator_order /\
         q2919401_real_power (v x) c =
           powerRZ
             (INR p)
             (Z.of_nat denominator_order -
              Z.of_nat numerator_order)%Z).

Theorem Rat_AbsoluteValue_equiv_real_or_padic :
  forall f : Q -> R,
    q2919401_is_absolute_value f ->
    q2919401_is_nontrivial f ->
    q2919401_equivalent_to_real f \/
    exists p : nat,
      q2919401_prime p /\
      q2919401_equivalent_to_padic f p /\
      forall q : nat,
        q2919401_prime q ->
        q2919401_equivalent_to_padic f q ->
        q = p.
Admitted.

title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2919401
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q2919401), "Ostrowski's theorem": every
  nontrivial real-valued absolute value on the rational numbers is equivalent
  either to the usual absolute value or to the p-adic absolute value for a
  unique prime p. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q2919401_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2919401_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    2 \<le> p \<and> (\<forall>d::nat. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

definition q2919401_is_absolute_value :: "(rat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2919401_is_absolute_value f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x * y) = f x * f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> f x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. f x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) \<le> f x + f y)"

definition q2919401_is_nontrivial :: "(rat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2919401_is_nontrivial f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>x::rat. x \<noteq> 0 \<and> f x \<noteq> 1)"

definition q2919401_is_equiv ::
    "(rat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> (rat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q2919401_is_equiv f g \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y::rat. f x \<le> f y \<longleftrightarrow> g x \<le> g y)"

definition q2919401_real_absolute_value :: "rat \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2919401_real_absolute_value x = \<bar>of_rat x\<bar>"

definition q2919401_multiplicity :: "int \<Rightarrow> int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q2919401_multiplicity p a =
    (if finite {n. p ^ n dvd a} then Max {n. p ^ n dvd a} else 0)"

definition q2919401_padic_absolute_value :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rat \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q2919401_padic_absolute_value p x =
    (if x = 0 then 0 else
      let a = fst (quotient_of x);
          b = snd (quotient_of x)
      in real p powi
        (int (q2919401_multiplicity (int p) b) -
          int (q2919401_multiplicity (int p) a)))"

theorem ostrowski_s_theorem:
  fixes f :: "rat \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "q2919401_is_absolute_value f"
    and "q2919401_is_nontrivial f"
  shows
    "q2919401_is_equiv f q2919401_real_absolute_value \<or>
      (\<exists>!p::nat. q2919401_prime p \<and>
        q2919401_is_equiv f (q2919401_padic_absolute_value p))"
  sorry

end

title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2919401,
;; "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial real-valued absolute value on the
;; rationals is equivalent either to the standard absolute value or, for a
;; unique prime, to the corresponding p-adic absolute value. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; An Archimedean ordered-field presentation is used for the real codomain.
;; This is bidirectionally equivalent here: every such field order-embeds in
;; R, every real-valued absolute value is an instance, and the conclusion
;; depends only on the induced order on Q.  The valuation itself remains an
;; arbitrary function on all rationals.  Equivalence is encoded exactly as in
;; AbsoluteValue.IsEquiv: equality of the two induced orders on Q.

(defstub q2919401-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q2919401-r-less (real left right) t)

(defstub q2919401-absolute-value (valuation rational) t)

(defun q2919401-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q2919401-r-less real right left)))

(defun-sk q2919401-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2919401-r-member-p real x)
      (q2919401-r-member-p real y)
      (q2919401-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q2919401-r-zero real))
            (one (q2919401-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q2919401-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q2919401-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q2919401-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q2919401-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q2919401-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q2919401-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q2919401-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q2919401-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q2919401-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q2919401-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q2919401-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q2919401-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q2919401-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q2919401-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q2919401-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q2919401-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q2919401-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q2919401-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q2919401-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q2919401-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q2919401-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q2919401-r-multiply
          real x (q2919401-r-add real y z))
         (q2919401-r-add
          real
          (q2919401-r-multiply real x y)
          (q2919401-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q2919401-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2919401-r-member-p real x)
      (q2919401-r-member-p real y)
      (q2919401-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q2919401-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q2919401-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q2919401-r-less real x y)
         (q2919401-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2919401-r-less real x y)
          (q2919401-r-less real y z))
         (q2919401-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q2919401-r-less real x y)
         (q2919401-r-less
          real
          (q2919401-r-add real x z)
          (q2919401-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q2919401-r-less real zero x)
          (q2919401-r-less real zero y))
         (q2919401-r-less
          real zero
          (q2919401-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun q2919401-r-nat (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q2919401-r-zero real)
    (q2919401-r-add
     real
     (q2919401-r-one real)
     (q2919401-r-nat real (1- n)))))

(defun-sk q2919401-archimedean-bound-exists-p (real value)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q2919401-r-less
      real value (q2919401-r-nat real n)))))

(defun-sk q2919401-r-archimedean-p (real)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q2919401-r-member-p real value)
     (q2919401-archimedean-bound-exists-p real value))))

(defun q2919401-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q2919401-r-zero real))
        (one (q2919401-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q2919401-r-member-p real zero)
     (q2919401-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q2919401-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q2919401-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q2919401-r-less real zero one)
     (q2919401-r-archimedean-p real))))

;; The hypotheses defining an AbsoluteValue Q R.

(defun-sk q2919401-absolute-value-laws-p (real valuation)
  (forall (q r)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp q) (rationalp r))
     (let* ((zero (q2919401-r-zero real))
            (one (q2919401-r-one real))
            (fq (q2919401-absolute-value valuation q))
            (fr (q2919401-absolute-value valuation r)))
       (and
        (q2919401-r-member-p real fq)
        (q2919401-r-member-p real fr)
        (q2919401-r-leq real zero fq)
        (iff (equal fq zero) (equal q 0))
        (implies (equal q 1) (equal fq one))
        (equal
         (q2919401-absolute-value valuation (* q r))
         (q2919401-r-multiply real fq fr))
        (q2919401-r-leq
         real
         (q2919401-absolute-value valuation (+ q r))
         (q2919401-r-add real fq fr)))))))

(defun q2919401-absolute-value-p (real valuation)
  (q2919401-absolute-value-laws-p real valuation))

(defun-sk q2919401-nontrivial-absolute-value-p (real valuation)
  (exists (q)
    (and
     (rationalp q)
     (not (equal q 0))
     (not
      (equal
       (q2919401-absolute-value valuation q)
       (q2919401-r-one real))))))

;; Primality and the exact order induced by the p-adic norm.  For nonzero
;; rationals x and y, |x|_p <= |y|_p exactly when v_p(x) >= v_p(y).
;; The latter comparison is expressed without bounding the valuation:
;; every power of p dividing the cross-product for y also divides the
;; cross-product for x.

(defun-sk q2919401-prime-factor-law-p (p)
  (forall (d)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp d)
      (< 0 d)
      (equal (mod p d) 0))
     (or (equal d 1) (equal d p)))))

(defun q2919401-prime-p (p)
  (and
   (natp p)
   (< 1 p)
   (q2919401-prime-factor-law-p p)))

(defun-sk q2919401-valuation-geq-p (p a b)
  (forall (k)
    (implies
     (natp k)
     (implies
      (equal (mod b (expt p k)) 0)
      (equal (mod a (expt p k)) 0)))))

(defun q2919401-padic-leq-p (p x y)
  (if (equal x 0)
      t
    (if (equal y 0)
        nil
      (q2919401-valuation-geq-p
       p
       (*
        (abs (numerator x))
        (denominator y))
       (*
        (abs (numerator y))
        (denominator x))))))

;; The two alternatives in Ostrowski's theorem.

(defun-sk q2919401-equivalent-to-standard-p (real valuation)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp x) (rationalp y))
     (iff
      (q2919401-r-leq
       real
       (q2919401-absolute-value valuation x)
       (q2919401-absolute-value valuation y))
      (<= (abs x) (abs y))))))

(defun-sk q2919401-equivalent-to-padic-p (real valuation p)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and (rationalp x) (rationalp y))
     (iff
      (q2919401-r-leq
       real
       (q2919401-absolute-value valuation x)
       (q2919401-absolute-value valuation y))
      (q2919401-padic-leq-p p x y)))))

(defun-sk q2919401-padic-prime-unique-p (real valuation p)
  (forall (q)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2919401-prime-p q)
      (q2919401-equivalent-to-padic-p real valuation q))
     (equal q p))))

(defun-sk q2919401-unique-padic-prime-exists-p (real valuation)
  (exists (p)
    (and
     (q2919401-prime-p p)
     (q2919401-equivalent-to-padic-p real valuation p)
     (q2919401-padic-prime-unique-p real valuation p))))

;; Rat.AbsoluteValue.equiv_real_or_padic
(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q2919401-ostrowski-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (real valuation)
    (implies
     (and
      (q2919401-real-field-p real)
      (q2919401-absolute-value-p real valuation)
      (q2919401-nontrivial-absolute-value-p real valuation))
     (or
      (q2919401-equivalent-to-standard-p real valuation)
      (q2919401-unique-padic-prime-exists-p real valuation)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2919401,
-- "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial real-valued absolute value on the
-- rationals is equivalent either to the usual absolute value or uniquely to
-- a p-adic absolute value for a prime p. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUnique (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  field
    unique-value    : A
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness      : (other : A) -> P other -> other == unique-value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two :
      suc (suc zero) <=N p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == suc zero) or (d == p)

natPred : Nat -> Nat
natPred zero =
  zero
natPred (suc n) =
  n

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  suc zero
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPower base exponent

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  zero
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

natLessOrEqualBool : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natLessOrEqualBool zero n =
  true
natLessOrEqualBool (suc m) zero =
  false
natLessOrEqualBool (suc m) (suc n) =
  natLessOrEqualBool m n

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

intNegate : Int -> Int
intNegate (pos n) =
  negativeNat n
intNegate (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

intDifference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
intDifference zero zero =
  pos zero
intDifference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
intDifference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
intDifference (suc m) (suc n) =
  intDifference m n

intAdd : Int -> Int -> Int
intAdd (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
intAdd (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  intDifference m (suc n)
intAdd (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  intDifference n (suc m)
intAdd (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

intMultiply : Int -> Int -> Int
intMultiply (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
intMultiply (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

intAbsolute : Int -> Nat
intAbsolute (pos n) =
  n
intAbsolute (negsuc n) =
  suc n

data IntLessOrEqual : Int -> Int -> Set where
  positive<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    IntLessOrEqual (pos m) (pos n)
  negative<=positive :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (pos n)
  negative<=negative :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    n <=N m ->
    IntLessOrEqual (negsuc m) (negsuc n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator : Int
    denominator-minus-one : Nat

open Rational

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator q =
  suc (denominator-minus-one q)

rationalZero : Rational
rationalZero =
  fraction (pos zero) zero

rationalOne : Rational
rationalOne =
  fraction (pos (suc zero)) zero

rationalFromNat : Nat -> Rational
rationalFromNat n =
  fraction (pos n) zero

rationalNegate : Rational -> Rational
rationalNegate q =
  fraction
    (intNegate (numerator q))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

rationalAdd : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
rationalAdd x y =
  fraction
    (intAdd
      (intMultiply (numerator x) (pos (denominator y)))
      (intMultiply (numerator y) (pos (denominator x))))
    (natPred (denominator x * denominator y))

rationalSubtract : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
rationalSubtract x y =
  rationalAdd x (rationalNegate y)

rationalMultiply : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
rationalMultiply x y =
  fraction
    (intMultiply (numerator x) (numerator y))
    (natPred (denominator x * denominator y))

rationalPower : Rational -> Nat -> Rational
rationalPower base zero =
  rationalOne
rationalPower base (suc exponent) =
  rationalMultiply base (rationalPower base exponent)

rationalDivideByPositiveNat : Rational -> Nat -> Rational
rationalDivideByPositiveNat q divisor =
  fraction
    (numerator q)
    (natPred (denominator q * divisor))

rationalUnitFraction : Nat -> Rational
rationalUnitFraction denominator-minus-one =
  fraction (pos (suc zero)) denominator-minus-one

rationalAbsolute : Rational -> Rational
rationalAbsolute q =
  fraction
    (pos (intAbsolute (numerator q)))
    (denominator-minus-one q)

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalEqual x y =
  intMultiply (numerator x) (pos (denominator y)) ==
  intMultiply (numerator y) (pos (denominator x))

RationalLessOrEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Set
RationalLessOrEqual x y =
  IntLessOrEqual
    (intMultiply (numerator x) (pos (denominator y)))
    (intMultiply (numerator y) (pos (denominator x)))

RationalDistance : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
RationalDistance x y =
  rationalAbsolute (rationalSubtract x y)

Real : Set
Real =
  Nat -> Rational

constantReal : Rational -> Real
constantReal q n =
  q

realZero : Real
realZero =
  constantReal rationalZero

realOne : Real
realOne =
  constantReal rationalOne

realNegate : Real -> Real
realNegate x n =
  rationalNegate (x n)

realAdd : Real -> Real -> Real
realAdd x y n =
  rationalAdd (x n) (y n)

realMultiply : Real -> Real -> Real
realMultiply x y n =
  rationalMultiply (x n) (y n)

RealCauchy : Real -> Set
RealCauchy x =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RationalLessOrEqual
        (RationalDistance (x m) (x n))
        (rationalUnitFraction precision))

RealEqual : Real -> Real -> Set
RealEqual x y =
  (precision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RationalLessOrEqual
        (RationalDistance (x n) (y n))
        (rationalUnitFraction precision))

RealLess : Real -> Real -> Set
RealLess x y =
  Exists Nat
    (\ precision ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ cutoff ->
          (n : Nat) ->
          cutoff <=N n ->
          RationalLessOrEqual
            (rationalAdd (x n) (rationalUnitFraction precision))
            (y n)))

RealLessOrEqual : Real -> Real -> Set
RealLessOrEqual x y =
  Not (RealLess y x)

exponentialPartialSum : Rational -> Nat -> Rational
exponentialPartialSum point zero =
  rationalOne
exponentialPartialSum point (suc n) =
  rationalAdd
    (exponentialPartialSum point n)
    (rationalDivideByPositiveNat
      (rationalPower point (suc n))
      (factorial (suc n)))

exponentialSequence : Real -> Real
exponentialSequence x n =
  exponentialPartialSum (x n) n

RealExponential : Real -> Real -> Set
RealExponential x result =
  RealCauchy x
  and
  RealCauchy (exponentialSequence x)
  and
  RealCauchy result
  and
  RealEqual result (exponentialSequence x)

RealLogarithm : Real -> Real -> Set
RealLogarithm base logarithm =
  RealLess realZero base
  and
  RealExponential logarithm base

RealRpow : Real -> Real -> Real -> Set
RealRpow base exponent result =
  RealCauchy base
  and
  RealCauchy exponent
  and
  RealCauchy result
  and
  (((RealEqual base realZero)
    and
    (RealLess realZero exponent)
    and
    (RealEqual result realZero))
  or
  ((RealLess realZero base)
    and
    Exists Real
      (\ logarithm ->
        RealLogarithm base logarithm
        and
        RealExponential
          (realMultiply exponent logarithm)
          result)))

valuationBound : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
valuationBound p zero fuel =
  zero
valuationBound p (suc n) zero =
  zero
valuationBound p (suc n) (suc fuel) with naturalMod (suc n) p
... | zero =
  suc (valuationBound p (naturalDiv (suc n) p) fuel)
... | suc remainder =
  zero

padicValuationNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
padicValuationNat p n =
  valuationBound p n n

padicMagnitudeFromValuations : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Rational
padicMagnitudeFromValuations p numerator-valuation denominator-valuation
  with natLessOrEqualBool numerator-valuation denominator-valuation
... | true =
  rationalFromNat
    (naturalPower p (denominator-valuation - numerator-valuation))
... | false =
  rationalUnitFraction
    (natPred
      (naturalPower p (numerator-valuation - denominator-valuation)))

padicMagnitude : Nat -> Rational -> Rational
padicMagnitude p q with numerator q
... | pos zero =
  rationalZero
... | pos (suc n) =
  padicMagnitudeFromValuations p
    (padicValuationNat p (suc n))
    (padicValuationNat p (denominator q))
... | negsuc n =
  padicMagnitudeFromValuations p
    (padicValuationNat p (suc n))
    (padicValuationNat p (denominator q))

standardAbsoluteValue : Rational -> Real
standardAbsoluteValue q =
  constantReal (rationalAbsolute q)

padicAbsoluteValue : Nat -> Rational -> Real
padicAbsoluteValue p q =
  constantReal (padicMagnitude p q)

record AbsoluteValue : Set where
  field
    apply : Rational -> Real
    value-is-real :
      (x : Rational) ->
      RealCauchy (apply x)
    respects-rational-equality :
      (x y : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual x y ->
      RealEqual (apply x) (apply y)
    nonnegative :
      (x : Rational) ->
      RealLessOrEqual realZero (apply x)
    zero-exactly :
      (x : Rational) ->
      Iff
        (RealEqual (apply x) realZero)
        (RationalEqual x rationalZero)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : Rational) ->
      RealEqual
        (apply (rationalMultiply x y))
        (realMultiply (apply x) (apply y))
    triangle-inequality :
      (x y : Rational) ->
      RealLessOrEqual
        (apply (rationalAdd x y))
        (realAdd (apply x) (apply y))

open AbsoluteValue

IsNontrivial : AbsoluteValue -> Set
IsNontrivial absolute-value =
  Exists Rational
    (\ x ->
      Not (RationalEqual x rationalZero)
      and
      Not (RealEqual (apply absolute-value x) realOne))

PositiveReal : Real -> Set
PositiveReal x =
  RealCauchy x
  and
  RealLess realZero x

EquivalentToStandard : AbsoluteValue -> Set
EquivalentToStandard absolute-value =
  Exists Real
    (\ exponent ->
      PositiveReal exponent
      and
      ((x : Rational) ->
        RealRpow
          (apply absolute-value x)
          exponent
          (standardAbsoluteValue x)))

EquivalentToPadic : AbsoluteValue -> Nat -> Set
EquivalentToPadic absolute-value p =
  Exists Real
    (\ exponent ->
      PositiveReal exponent
      and
      ((x : Rational) ->
        RealRpow
          (apply absolute-value x)
          exponent
          (padicAbsoluteValue p x)))

ostrowski-theorem : Set
ostrowski-theorem =
  (absolute-value : AbsoluteValue) ->
  IsNontrivial absolute-value ->
  EquivalentToStandard absolute-value
  or
  ExistsUnique Nat
    (\ p ->
      Prime p
      and
      EquivalentToPadic absolute-value p)

title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q2919401, "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial real-valued absolute
  value on the rationals is equivalent either to the usual Archimedean
  absolute value or uniquely to a p-adic absolute value. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory integerTheory primeTheory ratTheory
     realTheory real_of_ratTheory transcTheory;

val q2919401_absolute_value_def = new_definition (
  "q2919401_absolute_value_def",
  ``q2919401_absolute_value (f : rat -> real) <=>
      (!q. 0 <= f q) /\
      (!q. (f q = 0 <=> q = 0q)) /\
      (!q r. f (q * r) = f q * f r) /\
      (!q r. f (q + r) <= f q + f r)``);

val q2919401_nontrivial_def = new_definition (
  "q2919401_nontrivial_def",
  ``q2919401_nontrivial (f : rat -> real) <=>
      ?q : rat. q <> 0q /\ f q <> 1``);

val q2919401_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q2919401_equiv_def",
  ``q2919401_equiv (f : rat -> real) (g : rat -> real) <=>
      ?c : real. 0 < c /\ !q : rat. f q powr c = g q``);

val q2919401_real_def = new_definition (
  "q2919401_real_def",
  ``q2919401_real (q : rat) = abs (real_of_rat q)``);

val q2919401_padic_def = new_definition (
  "q2919401_padic_def",
  ``q2919401_padic (p : num) (q : rat) =
      if q = 0q then 0
      else
        ((&p : real) pow prime_power_index p (RATD q)) /
        ((&p : real) pow prime_power_index p (Num (RATN q)))``);

val equiv_real_or_padic =
  ``!f : rat -> real.
      q2919401_absolute_value f /\
      q2919401_nontrivial f
      ==>
      q2919401_equiv f q2919401_real \/
      ?!p : num.
        prime p /\
        q2919401_equiv f (q2919401_padic p)``;

title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2919401
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q2919401), "Ostrowski's theorem":
  every nontrivial real-valued absolute value on the rational numbers is
  order-equivalent either to the usual absolute value or to the p-adic
  absolute value for a unique prime p. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q2919401Nontrivial states that an absolute value differs from one at some
  nonzero rational. Q2919401Equivalent is the source notion of equivalence:
  the two absolute values induce the same ordering of all pairs of rationals.
  Q2919401Padic is the canonical p-adic absolute value, using the integer
  p-adic valuation pCnt. Every declaration below is an unproved $a statement
  encoding; this database contains no $p proof.
$)

$c Q2919401Nontrivial Q2919401Equivalent Q2919401Padic $.

q2919401-nontrivial-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2919401Nontrivial f ) $.
q2919401-equivalent-syntax
  $a wff ( Q2919401Equivalent f g ) $.
q2919401-padic-syntax
  $a class ( Q2919401Padic p ) $.

${
  $d f x $.

  q2919401-nontrivial-definition $a |- (
    Q2919401Nontrivial f
  ) <->
  E. x e. QQ
    (
      x =/= 0
      /\
      ( f ` x ) =/= 1
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d f g x y $.

  q2919401-equivalent-definition $a |- (
    Q2919401Equivalent f g
  ) <->
  A. x e. QQ
    A. y e. QQ
      (
        ( ( f ` x ) <_ ( f ` y ) )
        <->
        ( ( g ` x ) <_ ( g ` y ) )
      )
  $.
$}

${
  $d p x $.

  q2919401-padic-definition $a |- (
    Q2919401Padic p
  ) = (
    x e. QQ |->
      if (
        x = 0 ,
        0 ,
        ( p ^ -u ( p pCnt x ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f p $.

  thousand-theorems-q2919401-ostrowski-s-theorem $a |-
    A. f e. ( AbsVal ` ( CCfld |`s QQ ) )
      (
        ( Q2919401Nontrivial f )
        ->
        (
          ( Q2919401Equivalent f ( abs |` QQ ) )
          \/
          E! p e. Prime
            ( Q2919401Equivalent f ( Q2919401Padic p ) )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q2919401,
:: "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial real-valued absolute value on the
:: rationals is equivalent to the usual absolute value or to the p-adic
:: absolute value for a unique prime p. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, FUNCT_7,
      NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3, REAL_1, INT_1, INT_2, NAT_1, VALUED_0, RAT_1, NEWTON,
      PREPOWER, POWER, BINOP_2;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, INT_1,
      INT_2, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, RAT_1,
      BINOP_2;
 constructors ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, REAL_1,
      COMPLEX1,
      INT_1, INT_2, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, RAT_1,
      BINOP_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, NEWTON, PREPOWER, RAT_1,
      BINOP_2;
 requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of RAT,REAL st
    (for x being Element of RAT holds 0 <= f.x) &
    (for x being Element of RAT holds (f.x = 0 iff x = 0)) &
    (for x,y being Element of RAT holds f.(x*y) = f.x * f.y) &
    (for x,y being Rational holds
      f.(In(x+y,RAT)) <= f.(In(x,RAT)) + f.(In(y,RAT))) &
    (ex x being Element of RAT st x <> 0 & f.x <> 1)
  holds
    (ex c being Real st 0 < c &
      for x being Element of RAT holds
        (f.x) to_power c = |.x.|) or
    (ex p being Prime st
      (ex c being Real st
        0 < c &
        for x being Element of RAT st x <> 0 holds
          ex k,a,b being Integer st
            b <> 0 &
            not (p qua Integer) divides a &
            not (p qua Integer) divides b &
            x = ((a qua Real) / (b qua Real)) *
              ((p qua Real) to_power (k qua Real)) &
            (f.x) to_power c =
              (p qua Real) to_power (-(k qua Real))) &
      for q being Prime st
        (ex d being Real st
          0 < d &
          for x being Element of RAT st x <> 0 holds
            ex k,a,b being Integer st
              b <> 0 &
              not (q qua Integer) divides a &
              not (q qua Integer) divides b &
              x = ((a qua Real) / (b qua Real)) *
                ((q qua Real) to_power (k qua Real)) &
              (f.x) to_power d =
                (q qua Real) to_power (-(k qua Real)))
      holds q = p)
proof
end;
::$P+

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q2919401,
% "Ostrowski's theorem": every nontrivial real-valued absolute value on the
% rationals is equivalent either to the standard absolute value or uniquely to
% a normalized p-adic absolute value for a prime p. This file contains no proof.

Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  rational_absolute_value: TYPE = [rat -> real]

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  absolute_real(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN x ELSE -x ENDIF

  standard_absolute_value(q: rat): real =
    absolute_real(q)

  is_absolute_value(v: rational_absolute_value): bool =
    (FORALL (x: rat): v(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: rat): v(x) = 0 IFF x = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: rat):
        v(x * y) = v(x) * v(y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: rat):
        v(x + y) <= v(x) + v(y))

  is_nontrivial(v: rational_absolute_value): bool =
    EXISTS (x: rat):
      v(x) /= 0 AND v(x) /= 1

  equivalent_absolute_values(
      left, right: rational_absolute_value): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: rat):
      (left(x) <= left(y)) IFF (right(x) <= right(y))

  reciprocal_nat(value: nat): real =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 / (value :: real)
    ENDIF

  normalized_padic_absolute_value(
      p: nat, v: rational_absolute_value): bool =
    prime_nat(p)
      AND is_absolute_value(v)
      AND v(p :: rat) = reciprocal_nat(p)
      AND (FORALL (q: nat):
        (prime_nat(q) AND q /= p)
          IMPLIES v(q :: rat) = 1)

  equivalent_to_padic_at(
      v: rational_absolute_value, p: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (padic_value: rational_absolute_value):
      normalized_padic_absolute_value(p, padic_value)
        AND equivalent_absolute_values(v, padic_value)

  uniquely_equivalent_to_a_padic_value(
      v: rational_absolute_value): bool =
    EXISTS (p: nat):
      equivalent_to_padic_at(v, p)
        AND (FORALL (q: nat):
          equivalent_to_padic_at(v, q) IMPLIES q = p)

  ostrowski_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (v: rational_absolute_value):
      (is_absolute_value(v) AND is_nontrivial(v))
        IMPLIES
          equivalent_absolute_values(v, standard_absolute_value)
            OR uniquely_equivalent_to_a_padic_value(v)
END Q2919401_ostrowski_s_theorem

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3007384
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3007384), "Post's theorem": on an arbitrary
  primitively codable type, a decidable predicate is computable exactly when
  it and its complement are recursively enumerable. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Arith.Peano_dec.

Module Q3007384_Post.

Definition q3007384_nat_pair (a b : nat) : nat :=
  if Nat.ltb a b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b.

Definition q3007384_nat_unpair (n : nat) : nat * nat :=
  let s := Nat.sqrt n in
  if Nat.ltb (n - s * s) s
  then (n - s * s, s)
  else (s, n - s * s - s).

Inductive q3007384_code : Type :=
| Q3007384_Code_zero : q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_succ : q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_left : q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_right : q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_pair :
    q3007384_code -> q3007384_code -> q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_comp :
    q3007384_code -> q3007384_code -> q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_prec :
    q3007384_code -> q3007384_code -> q3007384_code
| Q3007384_Code_rfind :
    q3007384_code -> q3007384_code.

Inductive q3007384_primitive_recursive_code :
    q3007384_code -> Prop :=
| Q3007384_PR_zero :
    q3007384_primitive_recursive_code Q3007384_Code_zero
| Q3007384_PR_succ :
    q3007384_primitive_recursive_code Q3007384_Code_succ
| Q3007384_PR_left :
    q3007384_primitive_recursive_code Q3007384_Code_left
| Q3007384_PR_right :
    q3007384_primitive_recursive_code Q3007384_Code_right
| Q3007384_PR_pair :
    forall cf cg,
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code cf ->
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code cg ->
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code
        (Q3007384_Code_pair cf cg)
| Q3007384_PR_comp :
    forall cf cg,
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code cf ->
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code cg ->
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code
        (Q3007384_Code_comp cf cg)
| Q3007384_PR_prec :
    forall cf cg,
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code cf ->
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code cg ->
      q3007384_primitive_recursive_code
        (Q3007384_Code_prec cf cg).

Inductive q3007384_evaluates :
    q3007384_code -> nat -> nat -> Prop :=
| Q3007384_Eval_zero :
    forall input,
      q3007384_evaluates Q3007384_Code_zero input 0
| Q3007384_Eval_succ :
    forall input,
      q3007384_evaluates Q3007384_Code_succ input (S input)
| Q3007384_Eval_left :
    forall input,
      q3007384_evaluates Q3007384_Code_left input
        (fst (q3007384_nat_unpair input))
| Q3007384_Eval_right :
    forall input,
      q3007384_evaluates Q3007384_Code_right input
        (snd (q3007384_nat_unpair input))
| Q3007384_Eval_pair :
    forall cf cg input left_value right_value,
      q3007384_evaluates cf input left_value ->
      q3007384_evaluates cg input right_value ->
      q3007384_evaluates (Q3007384_Code_pair cf cg) input
        (q3007384_nat_pair left_value right_value)
| Q3007384_Eval_comp :
    forall cf cg input middle output,
      q3007384_evaluates cg input middle ->
      q3007384_evaluates cf middle output ->
      q3007384_evaluates (Q3007384_Code_comp cf cg) input output
| Q3007384_Eval_prec_zero :
    forall cf cg parameter output,
      q3007384_evaluates cf parameter output ->
      q3007384_evaluates (Q3007384_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q3007384_nat_pair parameter 0) output
| Q3007384_Eval_prec_succ :
    forall cf cg parameter index previous output,
      q3007384_evaluates (Q3007384_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q3007384_nat_pair parameter index) previous ->
      q3007384_evaluates cg
        (q3007384_nat_pair parameter
          (q3007384_nat_pair index previous)) output ->
      q3007384_evaluates (Q3007384_Code_prec cf cg)
        (q3007384_nat_pair parameter (S index)) output
| Q3007384_Eval_rfind :
    forall cf parameter start offset,
      q3007384_evaluates cf
        (q3007384_nat_pair parameter (offset + start)) 0 ->
      (forall i,
        (i < offset)%nat ->
        exists value,
          q3007384_evaluates cf
            (q3007384_nat_pair parameter (i + start)) value /\
          value <> 0) ->
      q3007384_evaluates (Q3007384_Code_rfind cf)
        (q3007384_nat_pair parameter start) (offset + start).

Definition q3007384_option_encode
    {A : Type}
    (encode : A -> nat)
    (value : option A) : nat :=
  match value with
  | None => 0
  | Some a => S (encode a)
  end.

Record q3007384_primcodable (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3007384_encode : A -> nat;
  q3007384_decode : nat -> option A;
  q3007384_decode_encode :
    forall a,
      q3007384_decode (q3007384_encode a) = Some a;
  q3007384_decode_program : q3007384_code;
  q3007384_decode_program_primitive :
    q3007384_primitive_recursive_code q3007384_decode_program;
  q3007384_decode_computable :
    forall input output,
      q3007384_evaluates q3007384_decode_program input output <->
      output =
        q3007384_option_encode q3007384_encode
          (q3007384_decode input)
}.

Arguments q3007384_encode {A} _ _.
Arguments q3007384_decode {A} _ _.

Definition q3007384_computable_predicate
    {A : Type}
    (coding : q3007384_primcodable A)
    (p : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists decision : A -> bool,
    (forall a, decision a = true <-> p a) /\
    exists program : q3007384_code,
      forall a output,
        q3007384_evaluates program
          (q3007384_encode coding a) output <->
        output = if decision a then 1 else 0.

Definition q3007384_recursively_enumerable
    {A : Type}
    (coding : q3007384_primcodable A)
    (p : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists program : q3007384_code,
    forall a,
      p a <->
      exists output,
        q3007384_evaluates program
          (q3007384_encode coding a) output.

Theorem q3007384_post :
  forall
    (A : Type)
    (coding : q3007384_primcodable A)
    (p : A -> Prop),
    (forall a, {p a} + {~ p a}) ->
    q3007384_computable_predicate coding p <->
    q3007384_recursively_enumerable coding p /\
    q3007384_recursively_enumerable coding (fun a => ~ p a).
Admitted.

End Q3007384_Post.

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3007384 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3007384), "Post's theorem":
  on any primitively codable carrier, a predicate is computable exactly when
  it and its complement are recursively enumerable. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q3007384_post_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q3007384_triangle :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q3007384_triangle n = (n * Suc n) div 2"

definition q3007384_pair :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q3007384_pair m n = q3007384_triangle (m + n) + m"

definition q3007384_unpair :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<times> nat" where
  "q3007384_unpair n =
    (SOME p. q3007384_pair (fst p) (snd p) = n)"

fun q3007384_prec_total ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q3007384_prec_total f g z 0 = f z"
| "q3007384_prec_total f g z (Suc n) =
    g (q3007384_pair z
      (q3007384_pair n (q3007384_prec_total f g z n)))"

inductive q3007384_primrec :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  prim_zero: "q3007384_primrec (\<lambda>_. 0)"
| prim_succ: "q3007384_primrec Suc"
| prim_left: "q3007384_primrec (\<lambda>n. fst (q3007384_unpair n))"
| prim_right: "q3007384_primrec (\<lambda>n. snd (q3007384_unpair n))"
| prim_pair:
    "q3007384_primrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_primrec g \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_primrec (\<lambda>n. q3007384_pair (f n) (g n))"
| prim_comp:
    "q3007384_primrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_primrec g \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_primrec (\<lambda>n. f (g n))"
| prim_prec:
    "q3007384_primrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_primrec g \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_primrec
        (\<lambda>n. q3007384_prec_total f g
          (fst (q3007384_unpair n)) (snd (q3007384_unpair n)))"

fun q3007384_prec_partial ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat option) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat option) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat option" where
  "q3007384_prec_partial f g z 0 = f z"
| "q3007384_prec_partial f g z (Suc n) =
    (case q3007384_prec_partial f g z n of
      None \<Rightarrow> None
    | Some i \<Rightarrow> g (q3007384_pair z (q3007384_pair n i)))"

definition q3007384_rfind ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat option) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat option" where
  "q3007384_rfind f a =
    (if \<exists>n.
        f (q3007384_pair a n) = Some 0 \<and>
        (\<forall>m<n. f (q3007384_pair a m) \<noteq> None)
     then Some (LEAST n.
        f (q3007384_pair a n) = Some 0 \<and>
        (\<forall>m<n. f (q3007384_pair a m) \<noteq> None))
     else None)"

inductive q3007384_partrec :: "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat option) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  part_zero: "q3007384_partrec (\<lambda>_. Some 0)"
| part_succ: "q3007384_partrec (\<lambda>n. Some (Suc n))"
| part_left:
    "q3007384_partrec (\<lambda>n. Some (fst (q3007384_unpair n)))"
| part_right:
    "q3007384_partrec (\<lambda>n. Some (snd (q3007384_unpair n)))"
| part_pair:
    "q3007384_partrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec g \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec
        (\<lambda>n. case f n of
          None \<Rightarrow> None
        | Some x \<Rightarrow>
            (case g n of
              None \<Rightarrow> None
            | Some y \<Rightarrow> Some (q3007384_pair x y)))"
| part_comp:
    "q3007384_partrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec g \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec
        (\<lambda>n. case g n of None \<Rightarrow> None | Some x \<Rightarrow> f x)"
| part_prec:
    "q3007384_partrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec g \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec
        (\<lambda>n. q3007384_prec_partial f g
          (fst (q3007384_unpair n)) (snd (q3007384_unpair n)))"
| part_rfind:
    "q3007384_partrec f \<Longrightarrow>
      q3007384_partrec (q3007384_rfind f)"

definition q3007384_primcodable ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3007384_primcodable A encode decode \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a\<in>A. decode (encode a) = Some a) \<and>
    (\<forall>n a. decode n = Some a \<longrightarrow> a \<in> A) \<and>
    q3007384_primrec
      (\<lambda>n. case decode n of
        None \<Rightarrow> 0
      | Some a \<Rightarrow> if a \<in> A then Suc (encode a) else 0)"

definition q3007384_computable_pred ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3007384_computable_pred A encode decode p \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3007384_partrec
      (\<lambda>n. case decode n of
        None \<Rightarrow> None
      | Some a \<Rightarrow>
          if a \<in> A then Some (if p a then 1 else 0) else None)"

definition q3007384_re_pred ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option) \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3007384_re_pred A encode decode p \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3007384_partrec
      (\<lambda>n. case decode n of
        None \<Rightarrow> None
      | Some a \<Rightarrow>
          if a \<in> A \<and> p a then Some 0 else None)"

theorem q3007384_post_s_theorem:
  fixes A :: "'a set"
    and encode :: "'a \<Rightarrow> nat"
    and decode :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a option"
    and p :: "'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes "q3007384_primcodable A encode decode"
  shows
    "q3007384_computable_pred A encode decode p \<longleftrightarrow>
      q3007384_re_pred A encode decode p \<and>
      q3007384_re_pred A encode decode (\<lambda>a. \<not> p a)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3007384
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3007384), "Post's theorem": on an arbitrary
  primcodable domain, a decidable predicate is computable exactly when it and
  its complement are recursively enumerable. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3007384_POSTS_THEOREM =
  let q3007384_code_INDUCT,q3007384_code_RECURSION = define_type
    "q3007384_code =
       Q3007384_Zero
     | Q3007384_Succ
     | Q3007384_Left
     | Q3007384_Right
     | Q3007384_Pair q3007384_code q3007384_code
     | Q3007384_Comp q3007384_code q3007384_code
     | Q3007384_Prec q3007384_code q3007384_code
     | Q3007384_Rfind q3007384_code" in

  let _ = new_definition
    `q3007384_pair a b =
       ((a + b) * (a + b + 1)) DIV 2 + b` in

  let _,_,_ = new_inductive_definition
   `(!n:num. q3007384_eval Q3007384_Zero n 0) /\
    (!n:num. q3007384_eval Q3007384_Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b:num.
       q3007384_eval Q3007384_Left (q3007384_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b:num.
       q3007384_eval Q3007384_Right (q3007384_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q3007384_eval c n x /\ q3007384_eval d n y
       ==> q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Pair c d) n
             (q3007384_pair x y)) /\
    (!c d n x y.
       q3007384_eval d n x /\ q3007384_eval c x y
       ==> q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Comp c d) n y) /\
    (!c d a y.
       q3007384_eval c a y
       ==> q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Prec c d)
             (q3007384_pair a 0) y) /\
    (!c d a k i y.
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Prec c d)
         (q3007384_pair a k) i /\
       q3007384_eval d
         (q3007384_pair a (q3007384_pair k i)) y
       ==> q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Prec c d)
             (q3007384_pair a (SUC k)) y) /\
    (!c a m.
       q3007384_eval c (q3007384_pair a m) 0
       ==> q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Rfind c)
             (q3007384_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z y.
       q3007384_eval c (q3007384_pair a m) (SUC z) /\
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Rfind c)
         (q3007384_pair a (SUC m)) y
       ==> q3007384_eval (Q3007384_Rfind c)
             (q3007384_pair a m) y)` in

  let _ = new_recursive_definition q3007384_code_RECURSION
  `(q3007384_primitive Q3007384_Zero <=> T) /\
   (q3007384_primitive Q3007384_Succ <=> T) /\
   (q3007384_primitive Q3007384_Left <=> T) /\
   (q3007384_primitive Q3007384_Right <=> T) /\
   (q3007384_primitive (Q3007384_Pair c d) <=>
      q3007384_primitive c /\ q3007384_primitive d) /\
   (q3007384_primitive (Q3007384_Comp c d) <=>
      q3007384_primitive c /\ q3007384_primitive d) /\
   (q3007384_primitive (Q3007384_Prec c d) <=>
      q3007384_primitive c /\ q3007384_primitive d) /\
   (q3007384_primitive (Q3007384_Rfind c) <=> F)` in

  let _ = new_definition
    `q3007384_primcodable
      (encode:A->num) (decode:num->A option) <=>
     (!a:A. decode (encode a) = SOME a) /\
     (?encode_program:q3007384_code.
        q3007384_primitive encode_program /\
        !a:A. !y:num.
          q3007384_eval encode_program (encode a) y <=>
          y = encode a) /\
     (?decode_program:q3007384_code.
        q3007384_primitive decode_program /\
        !n y:num.
          q3007384_eval decode_program n y <=>
          (decode n = NONE /\ y = 0) \/
          (?a:A. decode n = SOME a /\ y = SUC (encode a)))` in

  let _ = new_definition
    `q3007384_computable_predicate
      (encode:A->num) (p:A->bool) <=>
     ?program:q3007384_code.
       !a:A. !y:num.
         q3007384_eval program (encode a) y <=>
         (if p a then y = 1 else y = 0)` in

  let _ = new_definition
    `q3007384_re_predicate (encode:A->num) (p:A->bool) <=>
     ?program:q3007384_code.
       !a:A. !y:num.
         q3007384_eval program (encode a) y <=>
         p a /\ y = 0` in

  `!encode:A->num.
   !decode:num->A option.
   !p:A->bool.
     q3007384_primcodable encode decode
     ==> (q3007384_computable_predicate encode p <=>
          q3007384_re_predicate encode p /\
          q3007384_re_predicate encode (\a:A. ~(p a)))`;;

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3007384,
;; "Post's theorem": on any primcodable domain, a decidable predicate is
;; computable exactly when it and its complement are recursively enumerable.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Natural numbers are decoded exactly as Nat.Partrec.Code: 0, 1, 2, and 3
;; are the base codes, and the two low bits above 3 select pair, composition,
;; primitive recursion, or minimization. The bounded evaluator represents the
;; corresponding partial function; existence of a fuel is definedness.

(defun q3007384-nat-pair (left right)
  (let ((left (nfix left))
        (right (nfix right)))
    (if (< left right)
        (+ (* right right) left)
      (+ (* left left) left right))))

(defun q3007384-isqrt-down (number candidate)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix candidate)))
  (if (zp candidate)
      0
    (if (<= (* candidate candidate) number)
        candidate
      (q3007384-isqrt-down number (- candidate 1)))))

(defun q3007384-isqrt (number)
  (let ((number (nfix number)))
    (q3007384-isqrt-down number number)))

(defun q3007384-nat-unpair (number)
  (let* ((number (nfix number))
         (root (q3007384-isqrt number))
         (remainder (- number (* root root))))
    (if (< remainder root)
        (cons remainder root)
      (cons root (- remainder root)))))

(defun q3007384-code-decode-aux (steps number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      :zero
    (let ((number (nfix number)))
      (cond
       ((equal number 0) :zero)
       ((equal number 1) :succ)
       ((equal number 2) :left)
       ((equal number 3) :right)
       (t
        (let* ((payload (- number 4))
               (low-bit (mod payload 2))
               (high-bit (mod (floor payload 2) 2))
               (subcode-pair-number (floor payload 4))
               (subcode-pair
                (q3007384-nat-unpair subcode-pair-number))
               (next-steps (- steps 1)))
          (cond
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :pair
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 0)
                 (equal high-bit 1))
            (list
             :comp
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           ((and (equal low-bit 1)
                 (equal high-bit 0))
            (list
             :prec
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (car subcode-pair))
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps (cdr subcode-pair))))
           (t
            (list
             :rfind
             (q3007384-code-decode-aux
              next-steps subcode-pair-number))))))))))

(defun q3007384-code-decode (number)
  (q3007384-code-decode-aux
   (+ 1 (nfix number))
   number))

;; Codes with no minimization node are exactly the primitive-recursive
;; fragment used to present the encoded image of a Primcodable type.

(defun q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux (steps code)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      nil
    (let ((next-steps (- steps 1)))
      (cond
       ((equal code :zero) t)
       ((equal code :succ) t)
       ((equal code :left) t)
       ((equal code :right) t)
       ((and (consp code)
             (equal (car code) :pair))
        (and
         (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
          next-steps (cadr code))
         (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
          next-steps (caddr code))))
       ((and (consp code)
             (equal (car code) :comp))
        (and
         (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
          next-steps (cadr code))
         (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
          next-steps (caddr code))))
       ((and (consp code)
             (equal (car code) :prec))
        (and
         (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
          next-steps (cadr code))
         (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
          next-steps (caddr code))))
       (t nil)))))

(defun q3007384-primrec-program-p (program)
  (and
   (natp program)
   (let ((code (q3007384-code-decode program)))
     (q3007384-primrec-code-p-aux
      (+ 1 (acl2-count code))
      code))))

(defun q3007384-some (value)
  (cons :some value))

(defun q3007384-some-p (result)
  (and (consp result)
       (equal (car result) :some)
       (natp (cdr result))))

(defun q3007384-evaln-measure (fuel code)
  (make-ord
   1
   (+ 1 (nfix fuel))
   (acl2-count code)))

(defun q3007384-evaln (fuel code input)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure (q3007384-evaln-measure fuel code)
    :well-founded-relation o<))
  (if (zp fuel)
      nil
    (let ((bound (- fuel 1)))
      (if (or (not (natp input))
              (< bound input))
          nil
        (cond
         ((equal code :zero)
          (q3007384-some 0))
         ((equal code :succ)
          (q3007384-some (+ input 1)))
         ((equal code :left)
          (q3007384-some
           (car (q3007384-nat-unpair input))))
         ((equal code :right)
          (q3007384-some
           (cdr (q3007384-nat-unpair input))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :pair))
          (let ((left
                 (q3007384-evaln
                  fuel (cadr code) input)))
            (if (q3007384-some-p left)
                (let ((right
                       (q3007384-evaln
                        fuel (caddr code) input)))
                  (if (q3007384-some-p right)
                      (q3007384-some
                       (q3007384-nat-pair
                        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
                    nil))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :comp))
          (let ((argument
                 (q3007384-evaln
                  fuel (caddr code) input)))
            (if (q3007384-some-p argument)
                (q3007384-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) (cdr argument))
              nil)))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :prec))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q3007384-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (counter (cdr arguments)))
            (if (zp counter)
                (q3007384-evaln
                 fuel (cadr code) parameter)
              (let* ((predecessor (- counter 1))
                     (previous
                      (q3007384-evaln
                       bound
                       code
                       (q3007384-nat-pair
                        parameter predecessor))))
                (if (q3007384-some-p previous)
                    (q3007384-evaln
                     fuel
                     (caddr code)
                     (q3007384-nat-pair
                      parameter
                      (q3007384-nat-pair
                       predecessor
                       (cdr previous))))
                  nil)))))
         ((and (consp code)
               (equal (car code) :rfind))
          (let* ((arguments
                  (q3007384-nat-unpair input))
                 (parameter (car arguments))
                 (start (cdr arguments))
                 (test
                  (q3007384-evaln
                   fuel
                   (cadr code)
                   (q3007384-nat-pair
                    parameter start))))
            (if (q3007384-some-p test)
                (if (equal (cdr test) 0)
                    (q3007384-some start)
                  (q3007384-evaln
                   bound
                   code
                   (q3007384-nat-pair
                    parameter (+ start 1))))
              nil)))
         (t nil))))))

;; The source's arbitrary Primcodable type is transported along its encoding
;; to a decidable carrier of natural-number codes. The generic carrier and
;; predicate symbols retain the universally arbitrary domain and decidable
;; predicate; tags permit independent presentations without finite tables.

(defstub q3007384-carrier-member (carrier element) t)
(defstub q3007384-predicate (predicate element) t)

(defun q3007384-carrier-member-p (carrier element)
  (if (q3007384-carrier-member carrier element)
      t
    nil))

(defun q3007384-predicate-p (predicate element)
  (if (q3007384-predicate predicate element)
      t
    nil))

;; Existence of fuel is definedness of the exact partial-recursive evaluator.
;; DEFUN-SK keeps every program, fuel, output, and unbounded input quantifier
;; inside the corresponding source notion.

(defun-sk q3007384-halts-with-p
    (program input output)
  (exists (fuel)
    (and
     (natp program)
     (natp input)
     (natp output)
     (natp fuel)
     (equal
      (q3007384-evaln
       fuel
       (q3007384-code-decode program)
       input)
      (q3007384-some output)))))

(defun-sk q3007384-halts-p (program input)
  (exists (output)
    (and
     (natp output)
     (q3007384-halts-with-p
      program input output))))

;; A carrier decider presents the encoded image of the Primcodable domain.
;; It returns the standard Boolean code 1 exactly on the image and 0 off it.

(defun q3007384-carrier-decider-entry-p
    (carrier decider element)
  (if (q3007384-carrier-member-p carrier element)
      (q3007384-halts-with-p decider element 1)
    (q3007384-halts-with-p decider element 0)))

(defun-sk q3007384-carrier-decider-law-p
    (carrier decider)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (natp element)
     (q3007384-carrier-decider-entry-p
      carrier decider element))))

(defun q3007384-primcodable-presentation-p
    (carrier carrier-decider)
  (and
   (q3007384-primrec-program-p carrier-decider)
   (q3007384-carrier-decider-law-p
    carrier carrier-decider)))

;; ComputablePred means that one program computes the Boolean indicator on
;; every element of the encoded carrier.

(defun q3007384-predicate-decider-entry-p
    (predicate decider element)
  (if (q3007384-predicate-p predicate element)
      (q3007384-halts-with-p decider element 1)
    (q3007384-halts-with-p decider element 0)))

(defun-sk q3007384-predicate-decider-law-p
    (carrier predicate decider)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp element)
      (q3007384-carrier-member-p carrier element))
     (q3007384-predicate-decider-entry-p
      predicate decider element))))

(defun q3007384-predicate-decider-p
    (carrier predicate decider)
  (and
   (natp decider)
   (q3007384-predicate-decider-law-p
    carrier predicate decider)))

(defun-sk q3007384-computable-predicate-p
    (carrier predicate)
  (exists (decider)
    (q3007384-predicate-decider-p
     carrier predicate decider)))

;; REPred is the existence of a partial-recursive program whose domain,
;; restricted to the encoded carrier, is exactly the predicate.

(defun-sk q3007384-re-law-p
    (carrier predicate recognizer)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp element)
      (q3007384-carrier-member-p carrier element))
     (iff
      (q3007384-predicate-p predicate element)
      (q3007384-halts-p recognizer element)))))

(defun q3007384-recognizer-p
    (carrier predicate recognizer)
  (and
   (natp recognizer)
   (q3007384-re-law-p
    carrier predicate recognizer)))

(defun-sk q3007384-re-predicate-p
    (carrier predicate)
  (exists (recognizer)
    (q3007384-recognizer-p
     carrier predicate recognizer)))

(defun-sk q3007384-complement-re-law-p
    (carrier predicate recognizer)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp element)
      (q3007384-carrier-member-p carrier element))
     (iff
      (not (q3007384-predicate-p predicate element))
      (q3007384-halts-p recognizer element)))))

(defun q3007384-complement-recognizer-p
    (carrier predicate recognizer)
  (and
   (natp recognizer)
   (q3007384-complement-re-law-p
    carrier predicate recognizer)))

(defun-sk q3007384-complement-re-predicate-p
    (carrier predicate)
  (exists (recognizer)
    (q3007384-complement-recognizer-p
     carrier predicate recognizer)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3007384-post-s-theorem-statement
    (carrier carrier-decider predicate)
  (implies
   (q3007384-primcodable-presentation-p
    carrier carrier-decider)
   (iff
    (q3007384-computable-predicate-p
     carrier predicate)
    (and
     (q3007384-re-predicate-p
      carrier predicate)
     (q3007384-complement-re-predicate-p
      carrier predicate)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3007384
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q3007384), "Post's theorem": on every primcodable
-- domain, a decidable predicate is computable exactly when it and its
-- complement are recursively enumerable. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3007384_post_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _<_)

infixr 3 _and_
infix 4 _iff_

data Bottom {p : Level} : Set p where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
Not {p} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {p}

record _and_
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : left-proposition
    second : right-proposition

record _iff_
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : left-proposition -> right-proposition
    backward : right-proposition -> left-proposition

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

data Maybe {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  none : Maybe A
  some : A -> Maybe A

data Decision {p : Level} (proposition : Set p) : Set p where
  yes : proposition -> Decision proposition
  no  : Not proposition -> Decision proposition

-- The square pairing used by Mathlib's natural-number computability model.
pairNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
pairNat left right with left < right
... | true =
  right * right + left
... | false =
  left * left + left + right

-- Codes for the zero, successor, projections, pairing, composition,
-- primitive-recursion, and minimization schemes of partial recursion.
data Code : Set where
  zeroCode               : Code
  successorCode          : Code
  leftCode               : Code
  rightCode              : Code
  pairCode               : Code -> Code -> Code
  composeCode            : Code -> Code -> Code
  primitiveRecursionCode : Code -> Code -> Code
  minimizationCode       : Code -> Code

-- The codes not using minimization are exactly the primitive-recursive
-- fragment needed by Mathlib's Primcodable structure.
data PrimitiveCode : Code -> Set where
  primrec-zero :
    PrimitiveCode zeroCode
  primrec-successor :
    PrimitiveCode successorCode
  primrec-left :
    PrimitiveCode leftCode
  primrec-right :
    PrimitiveCode rightCode
  primrec-pair :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    PrimitiveCode firstCode ->
    PrimitiveCode secondCode ->
    PrimitiveCode (pairCode firstCode secondCode)
  primrec-composition :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    PrimitiveCode firstCode ->
    PrimitiveCode secondCode ->
    PrimitiveCode (composeCode firstCode secondCode)
  primrec-recursion :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    PrimitiveCode baseCode ->
    PrimitiveCode stepCode ->
    PrimitiveCode (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)

-- Relational evaluation represents termination with the displayed result.
data Evaluates : Code -> Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  evaluates-zero :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates zeroCode input zero

  evaluates-successor :
    {input : Nat} ->
    Evaluates successorCode input (suc input)

  evaluates-left :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates leftCode (pairNat left right) left

  evaluates-right :
    {left right : Nat} ->
    Evaluates rightCode (pairNat left right) right

  evaluates-pair :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input firstValue secondValue : Nat} ->
    Evaluates firstCode input firstValue ->
    Evaluates secondCode input secondValue ->
    Evaluates
      (pairCode firstCode secondCode)
      input
      (pairNat firstValue secondValue)

  evaluates-composition :
    {firstCode secondCode : Code} ->
    {input intermediate output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates secondCode input intermediate ->
    Evaluates firstCode intermediate output ->
    Evaluates (composeCode firstCode secondCode) input output

  evaluates-primitive-zero :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates baseCode parameter output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter zero)
      output

  evaluates-primitive-successor :
    {baseCode stepCode : Code} ->
    {parameter index previous output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter index)
      previous ->
    Evaluates
      stepCode
      (pairNat parameter (pairNat index previous))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (primitiveRecursionCode baseCode stepCode)
      (pairNat parameter (suc index))
      output

  evaluates-minimization-zero :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) zero ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      start

  evaluates-minimization-successor :
    {code : Code} ->
    {parameter start nonzeroValue output : Nat} ->
    Evaluates code (pairNat parameter start) (suc nonzeroValue) ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter (suc start))
      output ->
    Evaluates
      (minimizationCode code)
      (pairNat parameter start)
      output

encodeMaybe :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Nat) ->
  Maybe A ->
  Nat
encodeMaybe encode none =
  zero
encodeMaybe encode (some value) =
  suc (encode value)

-- This is the target-native presentation of Mathlib's Primcodable structure:
-- an Encodable retraction for which encoding after optional decoding is a
-- primitive-recursive natural-number function.
record Primcodable
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    encode :
      A -> Nat
    decode :
      Nat -> Maybe A
    decode-encode :
      (value : A) ->
      decode (encode value) == some value
    prim-program :
      Code
    program-is-primrec :
      PrimitiveCode prim-program
    computes-encoded-decode :
      (input output : Nat) ->
      (Evaluates prim-program input output) iff
      (output == encodeMaybe encode (decode input))

open Primcodable using (encode)

decisionBit :
  {p : Level} ->
  {proposition : Set p} ->
  Decision proposition ->
  Nat
decisionBit (yes proof) =
  suc zero
decisionBit (no refutation) =
  zero

-- This reproduces ComputablePred: some decision procedure has a total
-- partial-recursive Boolean characteristic function.
record ComputablePredicate
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (coding : Primcodable A)
  (predicate : A -> Set) :
  Set a where

  constructor computable-predicate
  field
    decide :
      (value : A) ->
      Decision (predicate value)
    characteristic-program :
      Code
    computes-characteristic :
      (value : A) ->
      (output : Nat) ->
      (Evaluates
        characteristic-program
        (encode coding value)
        output) iff
      (output == decisionBit (decide value))

-- This is REPred in domain form: the predicate holds exactly when a
-- partial-recursive program terminates on the encoded input.
RecursivelyEnumerable :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Primcodable A ->
  (A -> Set) ->
  Set a
RecursivelyEnumerable {A = A} coding predicate =
  Exists Code
    (\ program ->
      (value : A) ->
      (predicate value) iff
      Exists Nat
        (\ output ->
          Evaluates program (encode coding value) output))

PostTheorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
PostTheorem {a} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (coding : Primcodable A) ->
  (predicate : A -> Set) ->
  ((value : A) -> Decision (predicate value)) ->
  (ComputablePredicate coding predicate) iff
  ((RecursivelyEnumerable coding predicate) and
   (RecursivelyEnumerable coding (\ value -> Not (predicate value))))

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3007384, "Post's theorem": on an arbitrary Primcodable carrier, a predicate
  is computable exactly when both it and its complement are recursively
  enumerable. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val _ = Datatype `
  q3007384_code =
      Q3007384Zero
    | Q3007384Succ
    | Q3007384Left
    | Q3007384Right
    | Q3007384Pair q3007384_code q3007384_code
    | Q3007384Comp q3007384_code q3007384_code
    | Q3007384Prec q3007384_code q3007384_code
    | Q3007384Rfind q3007384_code
`;

val q3007384_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q3007384_pair_def",
  ``q3007384_pair a b =
      if a < b then b * b + a else a * a + a + b``
);

val (q3007384_eval_rules, q3007384_eval_ind, q3007384_eval_cases) =
  Hol_reln`
    (!n. q3007384_eval Q3007384Zero n 0) /\
    (!n. q3007384_eval Q3007384Succ n (SUC n)) /\
    (!a b. q3007384_eval Q3007384Left (q3007384_pair a b) a) /\
    (!a b. q3007384_eval Q3007384Right (q3007384_pair a b) b) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q3007384_eval c n a /\ q3007384_eval d n b ==>
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384Pair c d) n (q3007384_pair a b)) /\
    (!c d n a b.
       q3007384_eval d n a /\ q3007384_eval c a b ==>
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384Comp c d) n b) /\
    (!c d a b.
       q3007384_eval c a b ==>
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384Prec c d) (q3007384_pair a 0) b) /\
    (!c d a n r b.
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384Prec c d) (q3007384_pair a n) r /\
       q3007384_eval d
         (q3007384_pair a (q3007384_pair n r)) b ==>
       q3007384_eval
         (Q3007384Prec c d) (q3007384_pair a (SUC n)) b) /\
    (!c a m.
       q3007384_eval c (q3007384_pair a m) 0 ==>
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384Rfind c) (q3007384_pair a m) m) /\
    (!c a m z r.
       q3007384_eval c (q3007384_pair a m) z /\ z <> 0 /\
       q3007384_eval
         (Q3007384Rfind c) (q3007384_pair a (SUC m)) r ==>
       q3007384_eval (Q3007384Rfind c) (q3007384_pair a m) r)
  `;

val q3007384_primitive_code_def = Define`
  (q3007384_primitive_code Q3007384Zero = T) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code Q3007384Succ = T) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code Q3007384Left = T) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code Q3007384Right = T) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code (Q3007384Pair c d) =
     (q3007384_primitive_code c /\ q3007384_primitive_code d)) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code (Q3007384Comp c d) =
     (q3007384_primitive_code c /\ q3007384_primitive_code d)) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code (Q3007384Prec c d) =
     (q3007384_primitive_code c /\ q3007384_primitive_code d)) /\
  (q3007384_primitive_code (Q3007384Rfind c) = F)
`;

val q3007384_primrec_def = new_definition (
  "q3007384_primrec_def",
  ``q3007384_primrec f <=>
      ?program.
        q3007384_primitive_code program /\
        !n y. (q3007384_eval program n y <=> y = f n)``
);

val q3007384_primcodable_def = new_definition (
  "q3007384_primcodable_def",
  ``q3007384_primcodable encode decode <=>
      (!a. decode (encode a) = SOME a) /\
      q3007384_primrec
        (\n. case decode n of
               NONE => 0
             | SOME a => SUC (encode a))``
);

val q3007384_computable_pred_def = new_definition (
  "q3007384_computable_pred_def",
  ``q3007384_computable_pred encode predicate <=>
      ?program. !a y.
        (q3007384_eval program (encode a) y <=>
         if predicate a then y = 1 else y = 0)``
);

val q3007384_re_pred_def = new_definition (
  "q3007384_re_pred_def",
  ``q3007384_re_pred encode predicate <=>
      ?program. !a.
        (predicate a <=> ?y. q3007384_eval program (encode a) y)``
);

val q3007384_post_s_theorem =
  ``!(encode : 'a -> num) (decode : num -> 'a option)
      (predicate : 'a -> bool).
      q3007384_primcodable encode decode ==>
      (q3007384_computable_pred encode predicate <=>
       q3007384_re_pred encode predicate /\
       q3007384_re_pred encode (\a. ~predicate a))``;

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3007384
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3007384), "Post's theorem": on every
  Primcodable domain, a predicate is computable exactly when both it and its
  complement are recursively enumerable. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Nat.Partrec.Code is represented through its canonical bijection with NN0.
  Under this bijection the constructors have codes 0, 1, 2, 3,
  4*pair(c,d)+4, 4*pair(c,d)+6, 4*pair(c,d)+5, and 4*c+7. Q3007384Pair is
  Mathlib's exact Nat.pair function. Q3007384Eval c n y is the least relation
  closed under the operational rules for zero, successor, projections,
  pairing, composition, primitive recursion, and minimization, so it says
  that program c on input n terminates with output y.

  Q3007384PrimrecCodes is the least set of codes generated without
  minimization. Q3007384PrimcodableCarrier S says that S is a subset of NN0
  and the function sending n to n+1 on S and to 0 off S has a
  primitive-recursive code. This is exactly the Primcodable condition on the
  image S of Encodable.encode, since that function is
  encode(decode(n)) for the Option encoding. Conversely, every such S,
  regarded as a subtype of NN0, has the corresponding Primcodable instance.
  Thus quantifying over these carriers is bidirectionally equivalent to
  quantifying over arbitrary source Primcodable types, not a restriction to
  the natural-number type.

  Q3007384ComputablePred S P requires one program whose exact graph returns
  Boolean code 1 on P, Boolean code 0 on S \ P, and diverges outside S.
  Q3007384REPred S P requires one program whose exact graph returns the unit
  code 0 precisely on P. These are the encoded graphs in the source
  definitions of ComputablePred and REPred. SetMM is classical, so the
  source's external DecidablePred parameter adds no restriction and does not
  alter either side of the equivalence.

  Every auxiliary $a declaration is syntax or a faithful definition. The
  final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus statement, and this
  database contains no $p declaration.

:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3007384,
:: "Post's theorem": on an arbitrary primitive-recursively coded domain, a
:: predicate is computable exactly when it and its relative complement are
:: recursively enumerable. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, SUBSET_1, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_4,
      RELAT_1, TARSKI, FUNCOP_1, ORDINAL1, XXREAL_0, FINSET_1, CARD_1,

      FUNCT_2, LANG1, INT_1, MCART_1, CIRCUIT2, MSUALG_1, ORDINAL4, VALUED_2,

      ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, INT_1, FINSET_1, MCART_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCT_4, FUNCOP_1, GR_CY_1, FINSEQ_1,
      FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_4, VALUED_0, RVSUM_1, COMPUT_1, XXREAL_0, REAL_1,
      NAT_1, MARGREL1, DOMAIN_1, TURING_1;
 constructors DOMAIN_1, REAL_1, BINOP_2, FINSEQ_4, FINSOP_1, GR_CY_1,
      COMPUT_1, RECDEF_1, RELSET_1, XTUPLE_0, NAT_3, INT_6, TURING_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, FUNCOP_1, FINSET_1,
      NUMBERS, XREAL_0, INT_1, COMPUT_1, XTUPLE_0, CARD_1, NAT_1, VALUED_0,
      FINSEQ_1, INT_6, TURING_1;
 requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
 equalities FINSEQ_1, GR_CY_1, COMPUT_1, FUNCOP_1, ORDINAL1, TURING_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for D,A being Subset of NAT,
      r being Function of 1-tuples_on NAT,NAT st
    A c= D &
    r is primitive-recursive &
    (for n being Element of NAT holds
      (n in D iff r.<*n*> = n+1))
  holds
    ((ex T being TuringStr st
        the Symbols of T = {0,1} &
        for n being Element of NAT, t being Tape of T,
            s being All-State of T st
          s = [the InitS of T,0,t] & t storeData <*0,n*>

          (s is Accept-Halt iff n in D) &
          (n in D implies
            s is Accept-Halt &
            ex b,y being Element of NAT st
              (Result s)`2_3 = b &
              (Result s)`3_3 storeData <*b,y*> &
              ((n in A & y = 1) or (n in D \ A & y = 0))))
      iff
      (ex T being TuringStr st
        the Symbols of T = {0,1} &
        for n being Element of NAT, t being Tape of T,
            s being All-State of T st
          s = [the InitS of T,0,t] & t storeData <*0,n*>
        holds (s is Accept-Halt iff n in A)) &
      (ex T being TuringStr st
        the Symbols of T = {0,1} &
        for n being Element of NAT, t being Tape of T,
            s being All-State of T st
          s = [the InitS of T,0,t] & t storeData <*0,n*>
        holds (s is Accept-Halt iff n in D \ A)))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q3007384_post_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3007384
