% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q3007384), "Post's theorem": on a primitively
% codable type, a decidable predicate is computable exactly when it and its
% complement are recursively enumerable. This file contains no proof.

post_code_Q3007384: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  post_zero_code: post_zero_code?
  post_succ_code: post_succ_code?
  post_left_code: post_left_code?
  post_right_code: post_right_code?
  post_pair_code(
    post_pair_left,
    post_pair_right: post_code_Q3007384): post_pair_code?
  post_comp_code(
    post_comp_outer,
    post_comp_inner: post_code_Q3007384): post_comp_code?
  post_prec_code(
    post_prec_base,
    post_prec_step: post_code_Q3007384): post_prec_code?
  post_rfind_code(
    post_rfind_body: post_code_Q3007384): post_rfind_code?
END post_code_Q3007384

Q3007384_post_s_theorem[
  A: TYPE,
  encode: [A -> nat],
  decodes: [nat, A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING post_code_Q3007384

  code: TYPE = post_code_Q3007384
  predicate: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  evaluation_relation: TYPE = [code, nat, nat -> bool]
  nat_relation: TYPE = [nat, nat -> bool]

  nat_pair(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left < right THEN
      right * right + left
    ELSE
      left * left + left + right
    ENDIF

  evaluator_closed(candidate: evaluation_relation): bool =
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(post_zero_code, input, 0))
    AND
    (FORALL (input: nat):
      candidate(post_succ_code, input, input + 1))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(post_left_code, nat_pair(left, right), left))
    AND
    (FORALL (left, right: nat):
      candidate(post_right_code, nat_pair(left, right), right))
    AND
    (FORALL (left_program, right_program: code),
            (input, left_value, right_value: nat):
      (candidate(left_program, input, left_value)
        AND candidate(right_program, input, right_value))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          post_pair_code(left_program, right_program),
          input,
          nat_pair(left_value, right_value)))
    AND
    (FORALL (outer_program, inner_program: code),
            (input, intermediate, output: nat):
      (candidate(inner_program, input, intermediate)
        AND candidate(outer_program, intermediate, output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          post_comp_code(outer_program, inner_program),
          input,
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, output: nat):
      candidate(base_program, parameter, output)
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          post_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, 0),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (base_program, step_program: code),
            (parameter, index, previous, output: nat):
      (candidate(
          post_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index),
          previous)
        AND candidate(
          step_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, nat_pair(index, previous)),
          output))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          post_prec_code(base_program, step_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, index + 1),
          output))
    AND
    (FORALL (body_program: code),
            (parameter, start, offset: nat):
      (candidate(
          body_program,
          nat_pair(parameter, start + offset),
          0)
        AND
          (FORALL (earlier: nat):
            earlier < offset IMPLIES
              EXISTS (nonzero_value: nat):
                candidate(
                  body_program,
                  nat_pair(parameter, start + earlier),
                  nonzero_value)
                  AND nonzero_value /= 0))
      IMPLIES
        candidate(
          post_rfind_code(body_program),
          nat_pair(parameter, start),
          start + offset))

  evaluates(program: code, input, output: nat): bool =
    FORALL (candidate: evaluation_relation):
      evaluator_closed(candidate)
      IMPLIES candidate(program, input, output)

  primitive_code(program: code): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES program OF
      post_zero_code:
        TRUE,
      post_succ_code:
        TRUE,
      post_left_code:
        TRUE,
      post_right_code:
        TRUE,
      post_pair_code(left_program, right_program):
        primitive_code(left_program)
          AND primitive_code(right_program),
      post_comp_code(outer_program, inner_program):
        primitive_code(outer_program)
          AND primitive_code(inner_program),
      post_prec_code(base_program, step_program):
        primitive_code(base_program)
          AND primitive_code(step_program),
      post_rfind_code(body_program):
        FALSE
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE program BY <<

  primitive_recursive_graph(graph: nat_relation): bool =
    EXISTS (program: code):
      primitive_code(program)
        AND (FORALL (input, output: nat):
          evaluates(program, input, output)
            IFF graph(input, output))

  functional_decoding: bool =
    FORALL (input: nat), (left, right: A):
      decodes(input, left)
        AND decodes(input, right)
      IMPLIES left = right

  decode_encode_law: bool =
    FORALL (value: A):
      decodes(encode(value), value)

  reencode_after_decode(input, output: nat): bool =
    (output = 0
      AND NOT (EXISTS (value: A): decodes(input, value)))
    OR
    (EXISTS (value: A):
      decodes(input, value)
        AND output = encode(value) + 1)

  primcodable_structure: bool =
    functional_decoding
      AND decode_encode_law
      AND primitive_recursive_graph(reencode_after_decode)

  semidecides(program: code, p: predicate): bool =
    FORALL (input, output: nat):
      evaluates(program, input, output)
      IFF
        EXISTS (value: A):
          decodes(input, value)
            AND p(value)
            AND output = 0

  recursively_enumerable(p: predicate): bool =
    EXISTS (program: code):
      semidecides(program, p)

  decides(program: code, p: predicate): bool =
    FORALL (input, output: nat):
      evaluates(program, input, output)
      IFF
        EXISTS (value: A):
          decodes(input, value)
            AND
              ((p(value) AND output = 1)
                OR ((NOT p(value)) AND output = 0))

  computable_predicate(p: predicate): bool =
    EXISTS (program: code):
      decides(program, p)

  complement(p: predicate): predicate =
    LAMBDA (value: A): NOT p(value)

  post_s_theorem: bool =
    primcodable_structure
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (p: predicate):
        computable_predicate(p)
        IFF
          (recursively_enumerable(p)
            AND recursively_enumerable(complement(p)))
END Q3007384_post_s_theorem

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q303402
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q303402), "Rank–nullity theorem": for a linear
-- map, the rank of its range plus the rank of its kernel equals the rank of
-- its domain. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.RankNullity

@[expose] public section

universe u v

namespace Q303402

variable {R : Type v} {M M₁ : Type u} [Ring R]
variable [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup M₁]
variable [Module R M] [Module R M₁] [HasRankNullity.{u} R]

/-- The rank–nullity theorem for a linear map. -/
theorem rank_nullity_theorem_statement (f : M →ₗ[R] M₁) :
    Module.rank R (LinearMap.range f) + Module.rank R (LinearMap.ker f) =
      Module.rank R M := sorry

end Q303402

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q303402
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q303402), "Rank-nullity theorem": for a linear
  map of modules over a ring satisfying the rank-nullity property, the
  cardinal rank of its range plus that of its kernel equals the rank of its
  domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q303402_ring : Type := {
  q303402_ring_carrier : Type;
  q303402_zero : q303402_ring_carrier;
  q303402_one : q303402_ring_carrier;
  q303402_add :
    q303402_ring_carrier ->
    q303402_ring_carrier ->
    q303402_ring_carrier;
  q303402_mul :
    q303402_ring_carrier ->
    q303402_ring_carrier ->
    q303402_ring_carrier;
  q303402_neg :
    q303402_ring_carrier -> q303402_ring_carrier;
  q303402_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_add x (q303402_add y z) =
      q303402_add (q303402_add x y) z;
  q303402_add_comm :
    forall x y : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_add x y = q303402_add y x;
  q303402_zero_add :
    forall x : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_add q303402_zero x = x;
  q303402_add_zero :
    forall x : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_add x q303402_zero = x;
  q303402_neg_add :
    forall x : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_add (q303402_neg x) x = q303402_zero;
  q303402_add_neg :
    forall x : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_add x (q303402_neg x) = q303402_zero;
  q303402_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_mul x (q303402_mul y z) =
      q303402_mul (q303402_mul x y) z;
  q303402_one_mul :
    forall x : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_mul q303402_one x = x;
  q303402_mul_one :
    forall x : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_mul x q303402_one = x;
  q303402_mul_add :
    forall x y z : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_mul x (q303402_add y z) =
      q303402_add
        (q303402_mul x y) (q303402_mul x z);
  q303402_add_mul :
    forall x y z : q303402_ring_carrier,
      q303402_mul (q303402_add x y) z =
      q303402_add
        (q303402_mul x z) (q303402_mul y z)
}.

Arguments q303402_ring_carrier _ : clear implicits.

Record q303402_module (R : q303402_ring) : Type := {
  q303402_module_carrier : Type;
  q303402_mzero : q303402_module_carrier;
  q303402_madd :
    q303402_module_carrier ->
    q303402_module_carrier ->
    q303402_module_carrier;
  q303402_mneg :
    q303402_module_carrier -> q303402_module_carrier;
  q303402_smul :
    q303402_ring_carrier R ->
    q303402_module_carrier ->
    q303402_module_carrier;
  q303402_madd_assoc :
    forall x y z : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_madd x (q303402_madd y z) =
      q303402_madd (q303402_madd x y) z;
  q303402_madd_comm :
    forall x y : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_madd x y = q303402_madd y x;
  q303402_mzero_add :
    forall x : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_madd q303402_mzero x = x;
  q303402_madd_zero :
    forall x : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_madd x q303402_mzero = x;
  q303402_mneg_add :
    forall x : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_madd (q303402_mneg x) x = q303402_mzero;
  q303402_madd_neg :
    forall x : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_madd x (q303402_mneg x) = q303402_mzero;
  q303402_one_smul :
    forall x : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_smul (q303402_one R) x = x;
  q303402_mul_smul :
    forall (r s : q303402_ring_carrier R)
           (x : q303402_module_carrier),
      q303402_smul (q303402_mul R r s) x =
      q303402_smul r (q303402_smul s x);
  q303402_add_smul :
    forall (r s : q303402_ring_carrier R)
           (x : q303402_module_carrier),
      q303402_smul (q303402_add R r s) x =
      q303402_madd
        (q303402_smul r x) (q303402_smul s x);
  q303402_smul_add :
    forall (r : q303402_ring_carrier R)
           (x y : q303402_module_carrier),
      q303402_smul r (q303402_madd x y) =
      q303402_madd
        (q303402_smul r x) (q303402_smul r y);
  q303402_zero_smul :
    forall x : q303402_module_carrier,
      q303402_smul (q303402_zero R) x = q303402_mzero;
  q303402_smul_zero :
    forall r : q303402_ring_carrier R,
      q303402_smul r q303402_mzero = q303402_mzero
}.

Arguments q303402_module_carrier {R} _.
Arguments q303402_mzero {R} _.
Arguments q303402_madd {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q303402_mneg {R} _ _.
Arguments q303402_smul {R} _ _ _.

Record q303402_linear_map
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M N : q303402_module R) : Type := {
  q303402_linear_apply :
    q303402_module_carrier M ->
    q303402_module_carrier N;
  q303402_linear_map_add :
    forall x y : q303402_module_carrier M,
      q303402_linear_apply (q303402_madd M x y) =
      q303402_madd N
        (q303402_linear_apply x) (q303402_linear_apply y);
  q303402_linear_map_smul :
    forall (r : q303402_ring_carrier R)
           (x : q303402_module_carrier M),
      q303402_linear_apply (q303402_smul M r x) =
      q303402_smul N r (q303402_linear_apply x)
}.

Arguments q303402_linear_apply {R M N} _ _.

Fixpoint q303402_linear_combination
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    {I : Type}
    (vectors : I -> q303402_module_carrier M)
    (terms : list (I * q303402_ring_carrier R)) :
    q303402_module_carrier M :=
  match terms with
  | [] => q303402_mzero M
  | (i, r) :: rest =>
      q303402_madd M
        (q303402_smul M r (vectors i))
        (q303402_linear_combination M vectors rest)
  end.

Definition q303402_linearly_independent
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    {I : Type}
    (vectors : I -> q303402_module_carrier M) : Prop :=
  forall terms : list (I * q303402_ring_carrier R),
    NoDup (map (@fst I (q303402_ring_carrier R)) terms) ->
    q303402_linear_combination M vectors terms =
      q303402_mzero M ->
    Forall
      (fun term => snd term = q303402_zero R)
      terms.

Definition q303402_is_submodule
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop) : Prop :=
  S (q303402_mzero M) /\
  (forall x y : q303402_module_carrier M,
      S x -> S y -> S (q303402_madd M x y)) /\
  (forall x : q303402_module_carrier M,
      S x -> S (q303402_mneg M x)) /\
  (forall (r : q303402_ring_carrier R)
          (x : q303402_module_carrier M),
      S x -> S (q303402_smul M r x)).

Definition q303402_submodule_linearly_independent
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop)
    {I : Type}
    (vectors : I -> q303402_module_carrier M) : Prop :=
  (forall i : I, S (vectors i)) /\
  q303402_linearly_independent M vectors.

Definition q303402_quotient_linearly_independent
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop)
    {I : Type}
    (representatives : I -> q303402_module_carrier M) : Prop :=
  forall terms : list (I * q303402_ring_carrier R),
    NoDup (map (@fst I (q303402_ring_carrier R)) terms) ->
    S (q303402_linear_combination M representatives terms) ->
    Forall
      (fun term => snd term = q303402_zero R)
      terms.

Definition q303402_injective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A, f x = f y -> x = y.

Definition q303402_same_cardinality (A B : Type) : Prop :=
  exists forward : A -> B,
    q303402_injective forward /\
    forall y : B, exists x : A, forward x = y.

Record q303402_rank_representation
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R) : Type := {
  q303402_rank_index : Type;
  q303402_rank_vectors :
    q303402_rank_index -> q303402_module_carrier M;
  q303402_rank_independent :
    q303402_linearly_independent M q303402_rank_vectors;
  q303402_rank_dominates :
    forall (J : Type)
           (vectors : J -> q303402_module_carrier M),
      q303402_linearly_independent M vectors ->
      exists injection : J -> q303402_rank_index,
        q303402_injective injection
}.

Arguments q303402_rank_index {R M} _.

Record q303402_submodule_rank_representation
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop) : Type := {
  q303402_submodule_rank_index : Type;
  q303402_submodule_rank_vectors :
    q303402_submodule_rank_index ->
    q303402_module_carrier M;
  q303402_submodule_rank_independent :
    q303402_submodule_linearly_independent
      M S q303402_submodule_rank_vectors;
  q303402_submodule_rank_dominates :
    forall (J : Type)
           (vectors : J -> q303402_module_carrier M),
      q303402_submodule_linearly_independent M S vectors ->
      exists injection : J -> q303402_submodule_rank_index,
        q303402_injective injection
}.

Arguments q303402_submodule_rank_index {R M S} _.

Record q303402_quotient_rank_representation
    {R : q303402_ring}
    (M : q303402_module R)
    (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop) : Type := {
  q303402_quotient_rank_index : Type;
  q303402_quotient_rank_representatives :
    q303402_quotient_rank_index ->
    q303402_module_carrier M;
  q303402_quotient_rank_independent :
    q303402_quotient_linearly_independent
      M S q303402_quotient_rank_representatives;
  q303402_quotient_rank_dominates :
    forall (J : Type)
           (representatives : J -> q303402_module_carrier M),
      q303402_quotient_linearly_independent
        M S representatives ->
      exists injection : J -> q303402_quotient_rank_index,
        q303402_injective injection
}.

Arguments q303402_quotient_rank_index {R M S} _.

Record q303402_has_rank_nullity (R : q303402_ring) : Prop := {
  q303402_rank_attained :
    forall M : q303402_module R,
      exists rank : q303402_rank_representation M, True;
  q303402_submodule_rank_attained :
    forall (M : q303402_module R)
           (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop),
      q303402_is_submodule M S ->
      exists rank :
        q303402_submodule_rank_representation M S, True;
  q303402_quotient_rank_attained :
    forall (M : q303402_module R)
           (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop),
      q303402_is_submodule M S ->
      exists rank :
        q303402_quotient_rank_representation M S, True;
  q303402_rank_quotient_add_rank :
    forall (M : q303402_module R)
           (S : q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop),
      q303402_is_submodule M S ->
      forall
        (quotient_rank :
          q303402_quotient_rank_representation M S)
        (submodule_rank :
          q303402_submodule_rank_representation M S)
        (module_rank : q303402_rank_representation M),
        q303402_same_cardinality
          ((q303402_quotient_rank_index quotient_rank +
            q303402_submodule_rank_index submodule_rank)%type)
          (q303402_rank_index module_rank)
}.

Definition q303402_kernel
    {R : q303402_ring}
    {M N : q303402_module R}
    (f : q303402_linear_map M N) :
    q303402_module_carrier M -> Prop :=
  fun x =>
    q303402_linear_apply f x = q303402_mzero N.

Definition q303402_range
    {R : q303402_ring}
    {M N : q303402_module R}
    (f : q303402_linear_map M N) :
    q303402_module_carrier N -> Prop :=
  fun y =>
    exists x : q303402_module_carrier M,
      q303402_linear_apply f x = y.

Definition q303402_rank_range_add_rank_ker
    {R : q303402_ring}
    {M N : q303402_module R}
    (f : q303402_linear_map M N) : Prop :=
  forall
    (range_rank :
      q303402_submodule_rank_representation
        N (q303402_range f))
    (kernel_rank :
      q303402_submodule_rank_representation
        M (q303402_kernel f))
    (domain_rank : q303402_rank_representation M),
    q303402_same_cardinality
      ((q303402_submodule_rank_index range_rank +
        q303402_submodule_rank_index kernel_rank)%type)
      (q303402_rank_index domain_rank).

Theorem LinearMap_rank_range_add_rank_ker :
  forall (R : q303402_ring)
         (M M1 : q303402_module R)
         (f : q303402_linear_map M M1),
    q303402_has_rank_nullity R ->
    q303402_rank_range_add_rank_ker f.
Admitted.

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems artifact Q303402,
   "Rank–nullity theorem": cardinal-valued rank additivity for the range and
   kernel of a linear map of modules over an arbitrary unital ring, within one
   fixed cumulative type universe. This file contains no proof. *)

theory Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
  imports ZF.Cardinal_AC ZF.List ZF.Univ
begin

definition q303402_type_universe :: "i => o" where
  "q303402_type_universe(kappa) \<equiv>
     InfCard(kappa) \<and>
     nat < kappa \<and>
     (\<forall>I\<in>Vset(kappa). \<forall>F\<in>I -> Vset(kappa).
        \<Union>(F``I) \<in> Vset(kappa))"

definition q303402_add_comm_group ::
  "[i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_add_comm_group(A, z, gplus, gneg) \<equiv>
     z \<in> A \<and>
     gplus \<in> A*A -> A \<and>
     gneg \<in> A -> A \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. gplus`\<langle>z,x\<rangle> = x \<and> gplus`\<langle>x,z\<rangle> = x) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. gplus`\<langle>gneg`x,x\<rangle> = z \<and>
                gplus`\<langle>x,gneg`x\<rangle> = z) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. gplus`\<langle>x,y\<rangle> = gplus`\<langle>y,x\<rangle>) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. \<forall>z\<in>A.
        gplus`\<langle>gplus`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>,z\<rangle> =
        gplus`\<langle>x,gplus`\<langle>y,z\<rangle>\<rangle>)"

definition q303402_ring ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_ring(A, zr, unitR, rplus, rneg, rtimes) \<equiv>
     q303402_add_comm_group(A, zr, rplus, rneg) \<and>
     unitR \<in> A \<and>
     rtimes \<in> A*A -> A \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. rtimes`\<langle>unitR,x\<rangle> = x \<and> rtimes`\<langle>x,unitR\<rangle> = x) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. \<forall>z\<in>A.
        rtimes`\<langle>rtimes`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>,z\<rangle> =
        rtimes`\<langle>x,rtimes`\<langle>y,z\<rangle>\<rangle>) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. \<forall>z\<in>A.
        rtimes`\<langle>x,rplus`\<langle>y,z\<rangle>\<rangle> =
        rplus`\<langle>rtimes`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>,rtimes`\<langle>x,z\<rangle>\<rangle>) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. \<forall>z\<in>A.
        rtimes`\<langle>rplus`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>,z\<rangle> =
        rplus`\<langle>rtimes`\<langle>x,z\<rangle>,rtimes`\<langle>y,z\<rangle>\<rangle>)"

definition q303402_module ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i, i, i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_module(A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR, M, zeroM, addM, negM, smul) \<equiv>
     q303402_ring(A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR) \<and>
     q303402_add_comm_group(M, zeroM, addM, negM) \<and>
     smul \<in> A*M -> M \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>M. smul`\<langle>unitR,x\<rangle> = x) \<and>
     (\<forall>a\<in>A. \<forall>b\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>M.
        smul`\<langle>mulR`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>,x\<rangle> =
        smul`\<langle>a,smul`\<langle>b,x\<rangle>\<rangle>) \<and>
     (\<forall>a\<in>A. \<forall>b\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>M.
        smul`\<langle>addR`\<langle>a,b\<rangle>,x\<rangle> =
        addM`\<langle>smul`\<langle>a,x\<rangle>,smul`\<langle>b,x\<rangle>\<rangle>) \<and>
     (\<forall>a\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>M. \<forall>y\<in>M.
        smul`\<langle>a,addM`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>\<rangle> =
        addM`\<langle>smul`\<langle>a,x\<rangle>,smul`\<langle>a,y\<rangle>\<rangle>)"

definition q303402_lincomb ::
  "[i, i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_lincomb(zeroM, addM, smul, ps) \<equiv>
     list_rec(zeroM,
       \<lambda>p ps r. addM`\<langle>smul`p,r\<rangle>,
       ps)"

definition q303402_nodup :: "i => o" where
  "q303402_nodup(xs) \<equiv>
     \<forall>i\<in>length(xs). \<forall>j\<in>length(xs).
       nth(i,xs) = nth(j,xs) \<longrightarrow> i = j"

definition q303402_independent ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_independent(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul, S) \<equiv>
     S \<subseteq> M \<and>
     (\<forall>xs\<in>list(S).
        q303402_nodup(xs) \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>cs\<in>list(A).
          length(cs) = length(xs) \<longrightarrow>
          q303402_lincomb(zeroM, addM, smul, zip(cs,xs)) = zeroM \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>i\<in>length(cs). nth(i,cs) = zeroR)))"

definition q303402_rank ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_rank(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul) \<equiv>
     \<Union>{|S|. S \<in> {T \<in> Pow(M).
       q303402_independent(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul, T)}}"

definition q303402_submodule ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_submodule(A, M, zeroM, addM, negM, smul, N) \<equiv>
     N \<subseteq> M \<and>
     zeroM \<in> N \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>N. negM`x \<in> N) \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>N. \<forall>y\<in>N. addM`\<langle>x,y\<rangle> \<in> N) \<and>
     (\<forall>a\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>N. smul`\<langle>a,x\<rangle> \<in> N)"

definition q303402_coset ::
  "[i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_coset(N, addM, x) \<equiv>
     {addM`\<langle>x,n\<rangle>. n\<in>N}"

definition q303402_quotient ::
  "[i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_quotient(M, N, addM) \<equiv>
     {q303402_coset(N, addM, x). x\<in>M}"

definition q303402_quotient_zero ::
  "[i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_quotient_zero(N, addM, zeroM) \<equiv>
     q303402_coset(N, addM, zeroM)"

definition q303402_quotient_add ::
  "[i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_quotient_add(M, N, addM) \<equiv>
     let Q = q303402_quotient(M, N, addM) in
     {p \<in> (Q*Q)*Q.
       \<exists>X\<in>Q. \<exists>Y\<in>Q. \<exists>Z\<in>Q.
       p = \<langle>\<langle>X,Y\<rangle>,Z\<rangle> \<and>
       (\<exists>x\<in>M. \<exists>y\<in>M.
          X = q303402_coset(N, addM, x) \<and>
          Y = q303402_coset(N, addM, y) \<and>
          Z = q303402_coset(N, addM, addM`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>))}"

definition q303402_quotient_neg ::
  "[i, i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_quotient_neg(M, N, addM, negM) \<equiv>
     let Q = q303402_quotient(M, N, addM) in
     {p \<in> Q*Q.
       \<exists>X\<in>Q. \<exists>Z\<in>Q.
       p = \<langle>X,Z\<rangle> \<and>
       (\<exists>x\<in>M.
          X = q303402_coset(N, addM, x) \<and>
          Z = q303402_coset(N, addM, negM`x))}"

definition q303402_quotient_smul ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_quotient_smul(A, M, N, addM, smul) \<equiv>
     let Q = q303402_quotient(M, N, addM) in
     {p \<in> (A*Q)*Q.
       \<exists>a\<in>A. \<exists>X\<in>Q. \<exists>Z\<in>Q.
       p = \<langle>\<langle>a,X\<rangle>,Z\<rangle> \<and>
       (\<exists>x\<in>M.
          X = q303402_coset(N, addM, x) \<and>
          Z = q303402_coset(N, addM, smul`\<langle>a,x\<rangle>))}"

definition q303402_quotient_rank ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_quotient_rank(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul, N) \<equiv>
     q303402_rank(
       A, zeroR,
       q303402_quotient(M, N, addM),
       q303402_quotient_zero(N, addM, zeroM),
       q303402_quotient_add(M, N, addM),
       q303402_quotient_smul(A, M, N, addM, smul))"

definition q303402_has_rank_nullity ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_has_rank_nullity(kappa, A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR) \<equiv>
     \<forall>M zeroM addM negM smul.
       M \<in> Vset(kappa) \<and>
       q303402_module(A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR,
                      M, zeroM, addM, negM, smul)
       \<longrightarrow>
       ((\<exists>S\<in>Pow(M).
           q303402_independent(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul, S) \<and>
           |S| = q303402_rank(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul)) \<and>
        (\<forall>N\<in>Pow(M).
           q303402_submodule(A, M, zeroM, addM, negM, smul, N)
           \<longrightarrow>
           q303402_quotient_rank(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul, N) \<oplus>
           q303402_rank(A, zeroR, N, zeroM, addM, smul) =
           q303402_rank(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smul)))"

definition q303402_linear_map ::
  "[i, i, i, i, i, i, i, i] => o" where
  "q303402_linear_map(A, M, addM, smulM, N, addN, smulN, f) \<equiv>
     f \<in> M -> N \<and>
     (\<forall>x\<in>M. \<forall>y\<in>M.
        f`(addM`\<langle>x,y\<rangle>) = addN`\<langle>f`x,f`y\<rangle>) \<and>
     (\<forall>a\<in>A. \<forall>x\<in>M.
        f`(smulM`\<langle>a,x\<rangle>) = smulN`\<langle>a,f`x\<rangle>)"

definition q303402_kernel ::
  "[i, i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_kernel(M, zeroN, f) \<equiv>
     {x \<in> M. f`x = zeroN}"

definition q303402_range ::
  "[i, i] => i" where
  "q303402_range(M, f) \<equiv> f``M"

theorem Q303402_rank_nullity:
  assumes "q303402_type_universe(kappa)"
      and "M \<in> Vset(kappa)"
      and "N \<in> Vset(kappa)"
      and "q303402_ring(A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR)"
      and "q303402_module(A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR,
                          M, zeroM, addM, negM, smulM)"
      and "q303402_module(A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR,
                          N, zeroN, addN, negN, smulN)"
      and "q303402_has_rank_nullity(kappa, A, zeroR, unitR, addR, negR, mulR)"
      and "q303402_linear_map(A, M, addM, smulM, N, addN, smulN, f)"
  shows
    "q303402_rank(A, zeroR,
       q303402_range(M, f), zeroN, addN, smulN) \<oplus>
     q303402_rank(A, zeroR,
       q303402_kernel(M, zeroN, f), zeroM, addM, smulM) =
     q303402_rank(A, zeroR, M, zeroM, addM, smulM)"
  oops

end

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q303402,
  "Rank-nullity theorem": for a linear map between modules over a ring with
  the rank-nullity property, the cardinal ranks of its range and kernel add
  to the cardinal rank of its domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q303402_RANK_NULLITY_THEOREM =
  `let is_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R).
       (!a:R. addR zeroR a = a /\ addR a zeroR = a) /\
       (!a:R. addR (negR a) a = zeroR /\ addR a (negR a) = zeroR) /\
       (!a b:R. addR a b = addR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. addR a (addR b c) = addR (addR a b) c) /\
       (!a:R. mulR oneR a = a /\ mulR a oneR = a) /\
       (!a:R. mulR zeroR a = zeroR /\ mulR a zeroR = zeroR) /\
       (!a b c:R. mulR a (mulR b c) = mulR (mulR a b) c) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) in
   let is_moduleV =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (smulV:R->V->V).
       (!x:V. addV zeroV x = x /\ addV x zeroV = x) /\
       (!x:V. addV (negV x) x = zeroV /\ addV x (negV x) = zeroV) /\
       (!x y:V. addV x y = addV y x) /\
       (!x y z:V. addV x (addV y z) = addV (addV x y) z) /\
       (!x:V. smulV zeroR x = zeroV) /\
       (!a:R. smulV a zeroV = zeroV) /\
       (!x:V. smulV oneR x = x) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:V. smulV (mulR a b) x = smulV a (smulV b x)) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:V.
          smulV (addR a b) x = addV (smulV a x) (smulV b x)) /\
       (!a:R. !x y:V.
          smulV a (addV x y) = addV (smulV a x) (smulV a y)) in
   let is_moduleW =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (zeroW:W) (addW:W->W->W) (negW:W->W) (smulW:R->W->W).
       (!x:W. addW zeroW x = x /\ addW x zeroW = x) /\
       (!x:W. addW (negW x) x = zeroW /\ addW x (negW x) = zeroW) /\
       (!x y:W. addW x y = addW y x) /\
       (!x y z:W. addW x (addW y z) = addW (addW x y) z) /\
       (!x:W. smulW zeroR x = zeroW) /\
       (!a:R. smulW a zeroW = zeroW) /\
       (!x:W. smulW oneR x = x) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:W. smulW (mulR a b) x = smulW a (smulW b x)) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:W.
          smulW (addR a b) x = addW (smulW a x) (smulW b x)) /\
       (!a:R. !x y:W.
          smulW a (addW x y) = addW (smulW a x) (smulW a y)) in
   let is_linear_map =
     \(addV:V->V->V) (smulV:R->V->V)
      (addW:W->W->W) (smulW:R->W->W) (f:V->W).
       (!x y:V. f (addV x y) = addW (f x) (f y)) /\
       (!a:R. !x:V. f (smulV a x) = smulW a (f x)) in
   let is_submoduleV =
     \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
      (smulV:R->V->V) (P:V->bool).
       zeroV IN P /\
       (!x y:V. x IN P /\ y IN P ==> addV x y IN P) /\
       (!x:V. x IN P ==> negV x IN P) /\
       (!a:R. !x:V. x IN P ==> smulV a x IN P) in
   let is_submoduleW =
     \(zeroW:W) (addW:W->W->W) (negW:W->W)
      (smulW:R->W->W) (P:W->bool).
       zeroW IN P /\
       (!x y:W. x IN P /\ y IN P ==> addW x y IN P) /\
       (!x:W. x IN P ==> negW x IN P) /\
       (!a:R. !x:W. x IN P ==> smulW a x IN P) in
   let linear_independentV =
     \(zeroR:R) (zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:R->V->V)
      (S:V->bool).
       !c:V->R.
         FINITE {x:V | ~(c x = zeroR)} /\
         {x:V | ~(c x = zeroR)} SUBSET S /\
         iterate addV {x:V | ~(c x = zeroR)} (\x:V. smulV (c x) x) =
           zeroV
         ==> !x:V. x IN S ==> c x = zeroR in
   let linear_independentW =
     \(zeroR:R) (zeroW:W) (addW:W->W->W) (smulW:R->W->W)
      (S:W->bool).
       !c:W->R.
         FINITE {x:W | ~(c x = zeroR)} /\
         {x:W | ~(c x = zeroR)} SUBSET S /\
         iterate addW {x:W | ~(c x = zeroR)} (\x:W. smulW (c x) x) =
           zeroW
         ==> !x:W. x IN S ==> c x = zeroR in
   let rank_witnessV =
     \(zeroR:R) (zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:R->V->V)
      (P:V->bool) (B:V->bool).
       B SUBSET P /\
       linear_independentV zeroR zeroV addV smulV B /\
       (!C:V->bool.
          C SUBSET P /\
          linear_independentV zeroR zeroV addV smulV C
          ==> C <=_c B) in
   let rank_witnessW =
     \(zeroR:R) (zeroW:W) (addW:W->W->W) (smulW:R->W->W)
      (P:W->bool) (B:W->bool).
       B SUBSET P /\
       linear_independentW zeroR zeroW addW smulW B /\
       (!C:W->bool.
          C SUBSET P /\
          linear_independentW zeroR zeroW addW smulW C
          ==> C <=_c B) in
   let quotient_linear_independentV =
     \(zeroR:R) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:R->V->V)
      (N:V->bool) (P:V->bool) (S:V->bool).
       S SUBSET P /\
       (!c:V->R.
          FINITE {x:V | ~(c x = zeroR)} /\
          {x:V | ~(c x = zeroR)} SUBSET S /\
          iterate addV {x:V | ~(c x = zeroR)} (\x:V. smulV (c x) x)
            IN N
          ==> !x:V. x IN S ==> c x = zeroR) in
   let quotient_linear_independentW =
     \(zeroR:R) (addW:W->W->W) (smulW:R->W->W)
      (N:W->bool) (P:W->bool) (S:W->bool).
       S SUBSET P /\
       (!c:W->R.
          FINITE {x:W | ~(c x = zeroR)} /\
          {x:W | ~(c x = zeroR)} SUBSET S /\
          iterate addW {x:W | ~(c x = zeroR)} (\x:W. smulW (c x) x)
            IN N
          ==> !x:W. x IN S ==> c x = zeroR) in
   let quotient_rank_witnessV =
     \(zeroR:R) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:R->V->V)
      (N:V->bool) (P:V->bool) (B:V->bool).
       quotient_linear_independentV zeroR addV smulV N P B /\
       (!C:V->bool.
          quotient_linear_independentV zeroR addV smulV N P C
          ==> C <=_c B) in
   let quotient_rank_witnessW =
     \(zeroR:R) (addW:W->W->W) (smulW:R->W->W)
      (N:W->bool) (P:W->bool) (B:W->bool).
       quotient_linear_independentW zeroR addW smulW N P B /\
       (!C:W->bool.
          quotient_linear_independentW zeroR addW smulW N P C
          ==> C <=_c B) in
   let cardinal_sumVW =
     \(A:W->bool) (B:V->bool).
       {z:W+V |
          (?y:W. y IN A /\ z = INL y) \/
          (?x:V. x IN B /\ z = INR x)} in
   let cardinal_sumVV =
     \(A:V->bool) (B:V->bool).
       {z:V+V |
          (?x:V. x IN A /\ z = INL x) \/
          (?x:V. x IN B /\ z = INR x)} in
   let cardinal_sumWW =
     \(A:W->bool) (B:W->bool).
       {z:W+W |
          (?x:W. x IN A /\ z = INL x) \/
          (?x:W. x IN B /\ z = INR x)} in
   let has_rank_nullity =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R)
      (zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (smulV:R->V->V)
      (zeroW:W) (addW:W->W->W) (negW:W->W) (smulW:R->W->W).
       ~(zeroR = oneR) /\
       (!P:V->bool.
          is_submoduleV zeroV addV negV smulV P
          ==> ?B:V->bool.
                rank_witnessV zeroR zeroV addV smulV P B) /\
       (!P N:V->bool.
          is_submoduleV zeroV addV negV smulV P /\
          is_submoduleV zeroV addV negV smulV N /\
          N SUBSET P
          ==> ?BQ BN BP:V->bool.
                quotient_rank_witnessV zeroR addV smulV N P BQ /\
                rank_witnessV zeroR zeroV addV smulV N BN /\
                rank_witnessV zeroR zeroV addV smulV P BP /\
                cardinal_sumVV BQ BN =_c BP) /\
       (!P:W->bool.
          is_submoduleW zeroW addW negW smulW P
          ==> ?B:W->bool.
                rank_witnessW zeroR zeroW addW smulW P B) /\
       (!P N:W->bool.
          is_submoduleW zeroW addW negW smulW P /\
          is_submoduleW zeroW addW negW smulW N /\
          N SUBSET P
          ==> ?BQ BN BP:W->bool.
                quotient_rank_witnessW zeroR addW smulW N P BQ /\
                rank_witnessW zeroR zeroW addW smulW N BN /\
                rank_witnessW zeroR zeroW addW smulW P BP /\
                cardinal_sumWW BQ BN =_c BP) in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R.
   !zeroV:V.
   !addV:V->V->V.
   !negV:V->V.
   !smulV:R->V->V.
   !zeroW:W.
   !addW:W->W->W.
   !negW:W->W.
   !smulW:R->W->W.
   !f:V->W.
     is_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_moduleV zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroV addV negV smulV /\
     is_moduleW zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroW addW negW smulW /\
     is_linear_map addV smulV addW smulW f /\
     has_rank_nullity
       zeroR oneR zeroV addV negV smulV zeroW addW negW smulW
     ==> ?BR:W->bool. ?BK BM:V->bool.
           rank_witnessW zeroR zeroW addW smulW
             {y:W | ?x:V. f x = y} BR /\
           rank_witnessV zeroR zeroV addV smulV
             {x:V | f x = zeroW} BK /\
           rank_witnessV zeroR zeroV addV smulV (UNIV:V->bool) BM /\
           cardinal_sumVW BR BK =_c BM`;;

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q303402,
;; "Rank–nullity theorem": for an arbitrary linear map between arbitrary
;; modules over a ring satisfying HasRankNullity, the cardinal rank of the
;; range plus the cardinal rank of the kernel is the rank of the domain.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent arbitrary rings, modules, linear
;; maps, submodules, and rank-cardinal representatives.  Carrier predicates
;; and maps are unbounded; no module, set, function, or cardinal is encoded by
;; a finite table.

(defstub q303402-ring-member-p (ring value) t)
(defstub q303402-ring-zero (ring) t)
(defstub q303402-ring-one (ring) t)
(defstub q303402-ring-add (ring left right) t)
(defstub q303402-ring-multiply (ring left right) t)
(defstub q303402-ring-negate (ring value) t)

(defstub q303402-module-member-p (ring module value) t)
(defstub q303402-module-zero (ring module) t)
(defstub q303402-module-add (ring module left right) t)
(defstub q303402-module-negate (ring module value) t)
(defstub q303402-module-smul (ring module scalar value) t)

(defstub q303402-linear-map-apply
  (ring domain codomain linear-map value)
  t)

(defstub q303402-generic-submodule-member-p
  (ring module submodule value)
  t)

;; Each rank is represented by an arbitrary unary carrier.  Equality and
;; addition of these cardinal representatives are defined below by
;; equipotence and tagged disjoint union, so infinite ranks remain available.

(defstub q303402-module-rank-carrier (ring module) t)
(defstub q303402-submodule-rank-carrier (ring module submodule) t)
(defstub q303402-quotient-rank-carrier (ring module submodule) t)

;; Ring, module, and linear-map structure.

(defun-sk q303402-ring-laws-p (ring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring x)
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring y))
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p
        ring (q303402-ring-add ring x y))
       (q303402-ring-member-p
        ring (q303402-ring-multiply ring x y))
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-add ring x y)
        (q303402-ring-add ring y x))))
     (implies
      (q303402-ring-member-p ring x)
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p
        ring (q303402-ring-negate ring x))
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-add ring x (q303402-ring-zero ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-add
         ring x (q303402-ring-negate ring x))
        (q303402-ring-zero ring))
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-multiply ring x (q303402-ring-one ring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-multiply ring (q303402-ring-one ring) x)
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring x)
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring y)
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-add
         ring (q303402-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q303402-ring-add
         ring x (q303402-ring-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-multiply
         ring (q303402-ring-multiply ring x y) z)
        (q303402-ring-multiply
         ring x (q303402-ring-multiply ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-multiply
         ring x (q303402-ring-add ring y z))
        (q303402-ring-add
         ring
         (q303402-ring-multiply ring x y)
         (q303402-ring-multiply ring x z)))
       (equal
        (q303402-ring-multiply
         ring (q303402-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q303402-ring-add
         ring
         (q303402-ring-multiply ring x z)
         (q303402-ring-multiply ring y z))))))))

(defun q303402-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (q303402-ring-member-p ring (q303402-ring-zero ring))
   (q303402-ring-member-p ring (q303402-ring-one ring))
   (q303402-ring-laws-p ring)))

(defun-sk q303402-module-laws-p (ring module)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module v))
      (and
       (q303402-module-member-p
        ring module (q303402-module-add ring module u v))
       (equal
        (q303402-module-add ring module u v)
        (q303402-module-add ring module v u))))
     (implies
      (q303402-module-member-p ring module u)
      (and
       (q303402-module-member-p
        ring module (q303402-module-negate ring module u))
       (equal
        (q303402-module-add
         ring module u (q303402-module-zero ring module))
        u)
       (equal
        (q303402-module-add
         ring module u (q303402-module-negate ring module u))
        (q303402-module-zero ring module))
       (equal
        (q303402-module-smul
         ring module (q303402-ring-one ring) u)
        u)
       (equal
        (q303402-module-smul
         ring module (q303402-ring-zero ring) u)
        (q303402-module-zero ring module))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module v)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module w))
      (equal
       (q303402-module-add
        ring module (q303402-module-add ring module u v) w)
       (q303402-module-add
        ring module u (q303402-module-add ring module v w))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module u))
      (q303402-module-member-p
       ring module (q303402-module-smul ring module a u)))
     (implies
      (q303402-ring-member-p ring a)
      (equal
       (q303402-module-smul
        ring module a (q303402-module-zero ring module))
       (q303402-module-zero ring module)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module v))
      (equal
       (q303402-module-smul
        ring module a (q303402-module-add ring module u v))
       (q303402-module-add
        ring module
        (q303402-module-smul ring module a u)
        (q303402-module-smul ring module a v))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring b)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module u))
      (and
       (equal
        (q303402-module-smul
         ring module (q303402-ring-add ring a b) u)
        (q303402-module-add
         ring module
         (q303402-module-smul ring module a u)
         (q303402-module-smul ring module b u)))
       (equal
        (q303402-module-smul
         ring module (q303402-ring-multiply ring a b) u)
        (q303402-module-smul
         ring module a
         (q303402-module-smul ring module b u))))))))

(defun q303402-module-p (ring module)
  (and
   (q303402-ring-p ring)
   (q303402-module-member-p
    ring module (q303402-module-zero ring module))
   (q303402-module-laws-p ring module)))

(defun-sk q303402-linear-map-laws-p
    (ring domain codomain linear-map)
  (forall (a u v)
    (and
     (implies
      (q303402-module-member-p ring domain u)
      (q303402-module-member-p
       ring codomain
       (q303402-linear-map-apply
        ring domain codomain linear-map u)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-module-member-p ring domain u)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring domain v))
      (equal
       (q303402-linear-map-apply
        ring domain codomain linear-map
        (q303402-module-add ring domain u v))
       (q303402-module-add
        ring codomain
        (q303402-linear-map-apply
         ring domain codomain linear-map u)
        (q303402-linear-map-apply
         ring domain codomain linear-map v))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q303402-module-member-p ring domain u))
      (equal
       (q303402-linear-map-apply
        ring domain codomain linear-map
        (q303402-module-smul ring domain a u))
       (q303402-module-smul
        ring codomain a
        (q303402-linear-map-apply
         ring domain codomain linear-map u)))))))

(defun q303402-linear-map-p
    (ring domain codomain linear-map)
  (and
   (q303402-module-p ring domain)
   (q303402-module-p ring codomain)
   (q303402-linear-map-laws-p
    ring domain codomain linear-map)))

;; Kernel and range are distinguished submodule tags whose membership is
;; defined directly from the map, while all other submodule tags retain the
;; conservative generic membership interface.

(defun q303402-kernel-tag
    (ring domain codomain linear-map)
  (list :q303402-kernel ring domain codomain linear-map))

(defun q303402-range-tag
    (ring domain codomain linear-map)
  (list :q303402-range ring domain codomain linear-map))

(defun q303402-kernel-tag-p (submodule)
  (and
   (true-listp submodule)
   (equal (len submodule) 5)
   (equal (car submodule) :q303402-kernel)))

(defun q303402-range-tag-p (submodule)
  (and
   (true-listp submodule)
   (equal (len submodule) 5)
   (equal (car submodule) :q303402-range)))

(defun q303402-kernel-member-p
    (ring domain codomain linear-map value)
  (and
   (q303402-module-member-p ring domain value)
   (equal
    (q303402-linear-map-apply
     ring domain codomain linear-map value)
    (q303402-module-zero ring codomain))))

(defun-sk q303402-range-member-p
    (ring domain codomain linear-map value)
  (exists (preimage)
    (and
     (q303402-module-member-p ring codomain value)
     (q303402-module-member-p ring domain preimage)
     (equal
      (q303402-linear-map-apply
       ring domain codomain linear-map preimage)
      value))))

(defun q303402-submodule-member-p
    (ring module submodule value)
  (cond
   ((and
     (q303402-kernel-tag-p submodule)
     (equal ring (nth 1 submodule))
     (equal module (nth 2 submodule)))
    (q303402-kernel-member-p
     ring
     (nth 2 submodule)
     (nth 3 submodule)
     (nth 4 submodule)
     value))
   ((and
     (q303402-range-tag-p submodule)
     (equal ring (nth 1 submodule))
     (equal module (nth 3 submodule)))
    (q303402-range-member-p
     ring
     (nth 2 submodule)
     (nth 3 submodule)
     (nth 4 submodule)
     value))
   (t
    (q303402-generic-submodule-member-p
     ring module submodule value))))

(defun-sk q303402-submodule-laws-p (ring module submodule)
  (forall (a u v)
    (and
     (implies
      (q303402-submodule-member-p ring module submodule u)
      (and
       (q303402-module-member-p ring module u)
       (q303402-submodule-member-p
        ring module submodule
        (q303402-module-negate ring module u))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-submodule-member-p ring module submodule u)
       (q303402-submodule-member-p ring module submodule v))
      (q303402-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule
       (q303402-module-add ring module u v)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring a)
       (q303402-submodule-member-p ring module submodule u))
      (q303402-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule
       (q303402-module-smul ring module a u))))))

(defun q303402-submodule-p (ring module submodule)
  (and
   (q303402-module-p ring module)
   (q303402-submodule-member-p
    ring module submodule (q303402-module-zero ring module))
   (q303402-submodule-laws-p ring module submodule)))

;; Cardinal representatives and cardinal arithmetic.

(defun q303402-cardinal-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun q303402-cardinal-carrier-p (carrier)
  (tamep-functionp carrier))

(defun q303402-map-value (mapping value)
  (apply$ mapping (list value)))

(defun-sk q303402-map-total-p (source target mapping)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p source value)
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p
      target (q303402-map-value mapping value)))))

(defun-sk q303402-map-injective-p (source mapping)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-cardinal-member-p source left)
      (q303402-cardinal-member-p source right)
      (equal
       (q303402-map-value mapping left)
       (q303402-map-value mapping right)))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q303402-map-preimage-exists-p
    (source mapping target-value)
  (exists (source-value)
    (and
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p source source-value)
     (equal
      (q303402-map-value mapping source-value)
      target-value))))

(defun-sk q303402-map-surjective-p (source target mapping)
  (forall (target-value)
    (implies
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p target target-value)
     (q303402-map-preimage-exists-p
      source mapping target-value))))

(defun q303402-injection-p (source target mapping)
  (and
   (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p source)
   (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p target)
   (tamep-functionp mapping)
   (q303402-map-total-p source target mapping)
   (q303402-map-injective-p source mapping)))

(defun q303402-bijection-p (source target mapping)
  (and
   (q303402-injection-p source target mapping)
   (q303402-map-surjective-p source target mapping)))

(defun-sk q303402-cardinal-leq-p (left right)
  (exists (mapping)
    (q303402-injection-p left right mapping)))

(defun-sk q303402-cardinal-equal-p (left right)
  (exists (mapping)
    (q303402-bijection-p left right mapping)))

(defun q303402-left-summand (value)
  (list :q303402-left value))

(defun q303402-right-summand (value)
  (list :q303402-right value))

(defun q303402-sum-member-p (left right value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (or
    (and
     (equal (car value) :q303402-left)
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p left (cadr value)))
    (and
     (equal (car value) :q303402-right)
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p right (cadr value))))))

(defun-sk q303402-sum-map-total-p
    (left right target mapping)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q303402-sum-member-p left right value)
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p
      target (q303402-map-value mapping value)))))

(defun-sk q303402-sum-map-injective-p
    (left right mapping)
  (forall (first second)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-sum-member-p left right first)
      (q303402-sum-member-p left right second)
      (equal
       (q303402-map-value mapping first)
       (q303402-map-value mapping second)))
     (equal first second))))

(defun-sk q303402-sum-map-preimage-exists-p
    (left right mapping target-value)
  (exists (source-value)
    (and
     (q303402-sum-member-p left right source-value)
     (equal
      (q303402-map-value mapping source-value)
      target-value))))

(defun-sk q303402-sum-map-surjective-p
    (left right target mapping)
  (forall (target-value)
    (implies
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p target target-value)
     (q303402-sum-map-preimage-exists-p
      left right mapping target-value))))

(defun-sk q303402-cardinal-sum-equal-p (left right target)
  (exists (mapping)
    (and
     (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p left)
     (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p right)
     (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p target)
     (tamep-functionp mapping)
     (q303402-sum-map-total-p left right target mapping)
     (q303402-sum-map-injective-p left right mapping)
     (q303402-sum-map-surjective-p
      left right target mapping))))

;; Finite-support linear combinations are association lists from arbitrary
;; indices to scalars.  This keeps linear independence unbounded in the index
;; carrier while retaining the source's finite-support quantification.

(defun q303402-coefficient-list-p
    (ring index-carrier coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (consp (car coefficients))
       (q303402-cardinal-member-p
        index-carrier (caar coefficients))
       (q303402-ring-member-p ring (cdar coefficients))
       (not
        (assoc-equal
         (caar coefficients) (cdr coefficients)))
       (q303402-coefficient-list-p
        ring index-carrier (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun q303402-linear-combination
    (ring module family coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q303402-module-add
       ring module
       (q303402-module-smul
        ring module
        (cdar coefficients)
        (q303402-map-value family (caar coefficients)))
       (q303402-linear-combination
        ring module family (cdr coefficients)))
    (q303402-module-zero ring module)))

(defun q303402-subset-linear-combination
    (ring module coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q303402-module-add
       ring module
       (q303402-module-smul
        ring module (cdar coefficients) (caar coefficients))
       (q303402-subset-linear-combination
        ring module (cdr coefficients)))
    (q303402-module-zero ring module)))

(defun q303402-all-coefficients-zero-p (ring coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (and
       (equal (cdar coefficients) (q303402-ring-zero ring))
       (q303402-all-coefficients-zero-p
        ring (cdr coefficients)))
    (equal coefficients nil)))

(defun-sk q303402-family-total-to-module-p
    (ring module index-carrier family)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p index-carrier index)
     (q303402-module-member-p
      ring module (q303402-map-value family index)))))

(defun-sk q303402-family-total-to-submodule-p
    (ring module submodule index-carrier family)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p index-carrier index)
     (q303402-submodule-member-p
      ring module submodule
      (q303402-map-value family index)))))

(defun-sk q303402-linear-independent-laws-p
    (ring module index-carrier family)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-coefficient-list-p
       ring index-carrier coefficients)
      (equal
       (q303402-linear-combination
        ring module family coefficients)
       (q303402-module-zero ring module)))
     (q303402-all-coefficients-zero-p ring coefficients))))

(defun-sk q303402-quotient-linear-independent-laws-p
    (ring module submodule index-carrier family)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-coefficient-list-p
       ring index-carrier coefficients)
      (q303402-submodule-member-p
       ring module submodule
       (q303402-linear-combination
        ring module family coefficients)))
     (q303402-all-coefficients-zero-p ring coefficients))))

(defun q303402-linear-independent-family-p
    (ring module index-carrier family)
  (and
   (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p index-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q303402-family-total-to-module-p
    ring module index-carrier family)
   (q303402-linear-independent-laws-p
    ring module index-carrier family)))

(defun q303402-submodule-linear-independent-family-p
    (ring module submodule index-carrier family)
  (and
   (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p index-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q303402-family-total-to-submodule-p
    ring module submodule index-carrier family)
   (q303402-linear-independent-laws-p
    ring module index-carrier family)))

(defun q303402-quotient-linear-independent-family-p
    (ring module submodule index-carrier family)
  (and
   (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p index-carrier)
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q303402-family-total-to-module-p
    ring module index-carrier family)
   (q303402-quotient-linear-independent-laws-p
    ring module submodule index-carrier family)))

(defun-sk q303402-subset-of-module-p (ring module subset)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (q303402-cardinal-member-p subset value)
     (q303402-module-member-p ring module value))))

(defun-sk q303402-linear-independent-subset-laws-p
    (ring module subset)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-coefficient-list-p ring subset coefficients)
      (equal
       (q303402-subset-linear-combination
        ring module coefficients)
       (q303402-module-zero ring module)))
     (q303402-all-coefficients-zero-p ring coefficients))))

(defun q303402-linear-independent-subset-p
    (ring module subset)
  (and
   (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p subset)
   (q303402-subset-of-module-p ring module subset)
   (q303402-linear-independent-subset-laws-p
    ring module subset)))

;; Module.rank is characterized as the least cardinal upper bound of all
;; linearly independent families.  Submodule rank uses inherited operations;
;; quotient rank uses independence modulo the submodule, which is exactly
;; linear independence in the quotient module.

(defun-sk q303402-module-rank-upper-bound-p
    (ring module bound)
  (forall (index-carrier family)
    (implies
     (q303402-linear-independent-family-p
      ring module index-carrier family)
     (q303402-cardinal-leq-p index-carrier bound))))

(defun-sk q303402-module-rank-least-p
    (ring module rank)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p bound)
      (q303402-module-rank-upper-bound-p
       ring module bound))
     (q303402-cardinal-leq-p rank bound))))

(defun q303402-module-rank-spec-p (ring module)
  (let ((rank (q303402-module-rank-carrier ring module)))
    (and
     (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p rank)
     (q303402-module-rank-upper-bound-p ring module rank)
     (q303402-module-rank-least-p ring module rank))))

(defun-sk q303402-submodule-rank-upper-bound-p
    (ring module submodule bound)
  (forall (index-carrier family)
    (implies
     (q303402-submodule-linear-independent-family-p
      ring module submodule index-carrier family)
     (q303402-cardinal-leq-p index-carrier bound))))

(defun-sk q303402-submodule-rank-least-p
    (ring module submodule rank)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p bound)
      (q303402-submodule-rank-upper-bound-p
       ring module submodule bound))
     (q303402-cardinal-leq-p rank bound))))

(defun q303402-submodule-rank-spec-p
    (ring module submodule)
  (let
      ((rank
        (q303402-submodule-rank-carrier
         ring module submodule)))
    (and
     (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p rank)
     (q303402-submodule-rank-upper-bound-p
      ring module submodule rank)
     (q303402-submodule-rank-least-p
      ring module submodule rank))))

(defun-sk q303402-quotient-rank-upper-bound-p
    (ring module submodule bound)
  (forall (index-carrier family)
    (implies
     (q303402-quotient-linear-independent-family-p
      ring module submodule index-carrier family)
     (q303402-cardinal-leq-p index-carrier bound))))

(defun-sk q303402-quotient-rank-least-p
    (ring module submodule rank)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p bound)
      (q303402-quotient-rank-upper-bound-p
       ring module submodule bound))
     (q303402-cardinal-leq-p rank bound))))

(defun q303402-quotient-rank-spec-p
    (ring module submodule)
  (let
      ((rank
        (q303402-quotient-rank-carrier
         ring module submodule)))
    (and
     (q303402-cardinal-carrier-p rank)
     (q303402-quotient-rank-upper-bound-p
      ring module submodule rank)
     (q303402-quotient-rank-least-p
      ring module submodule rank))))

(defun-sk q303402-rank-semantics-p (ring)
  (forall (module submodule)
    (and
     (implies
      (q303402-module-p ring module)
      (q303402-module-rank-spec-p ring module))
     (implies
      (q303402-submodule-p ring module submodule)
      (and
       (q303402-submodule-rank-spec-p
        ring module submodule)
       (q303402-quotient-rank-spec-p
        ring module submodule))))))

;; This is the complete HasRankNullity package from the Lean source.  Its
;; first field says every module has an independent subset equipotent to its
;; rank; its second field gives quotient-rank plus submodule-rank equals
;; module-rank for every module and every submodule.

(defun-sk q303402-rank-attained-p (ring module)
  (exists (subset)
    (and
     (q303402-linear-independent-subset-p
      ring module subset)
     (q303402-cardinal-equal-p
      subset (q303402-module-rank-carrier ring module)))))

(defun-sk q303402-all-module-ranks-attained-p (ring)
  (forall (module)
    (implies
     (q303402-module-p ring module)
     (q303402-rank-attained-p ring module))))

(defun-sk q303402-rank-quotient-add-rank-p (ring)
  (forall (module submodule)
    (implies
     (q303402-submodule-p ring module submodule)
     (q303402-cardinal-sum-equal-p
      (q303402-quotient-rank-carrier
       ring module submodule)
      (q303402-submodule-rank-carrier
       ring module submodule)
      (q303402-module-rank-carrier ring module)))))

(defun q303402-has-rank-nullity-p (ring)
  (and
   (q303402-all-module-ranks-attained-p ring)
   (q303402-rank-quotient-add-rank-p ring)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q303402-rank-nullity-statement ()
  (forall (ring domain codomain linear-map)
    (implies
     (and
      (q303402-linear-map-p
       ring domain codomain linear-map)
      (q303402-rank-semantics-p ring)
      (q303402-has-rank-nullity-p ring))
     (q303402-cardinal-sum-equal-p
      (q303402-submodule-rank-carrier
       ring
       codomain
       (q303402-range-tag
        ring domain codomain linear-map))
      (q303402-submodule-rank-carrier
       ring
       domain
       (q303402-kernel-tag
        ring domain codomain linear-map))
      (q303402-module-rank-carrier ring domain)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q303402,
-- "Rank–nullity theorem": for a linear map over a ring satisfying rank-nullity,
-- the cardinal rank of its range plus that of its kernel equals the rank of its
-- domain. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ; _,_; fst; snd)

infixr 5 _sum_
infixr 5 _vcons_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

symmetry :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {x y : A} ->
  x == y ->
  y == x
symmetry refl =
  refl

transitivity :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {x y z : A} ->
  x == y ->
  y == z ->
  x == z
transitivity refl refl =
  refl

congruence :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (f : A -> B) ->
  {x y : A} ->
  x == y ->
  f x == f y
congruence f refl =
  refl

congruence-two :
  {a b c : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  {C : Set c} ->
  (f : A -> B -> C) ->
  {x x' : A} ->
  {y y' : B} ->
  x == x' ->
  y == y' ->
  f x y == f x' y'
congruence-two f refl refl =
  refl

data _sum_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A sum B
  right : B -> A sum B

record Injection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    apply :
      A -> B
    injective :
      (x y : A) ->
      apply x == apply y ->
      x == y

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward :
      A -> B
    backward :
      B -> A
    backward-forward :
      (x : A) ->
      backward (forward x) == x
    forward-backward :
      (y : B) ->
      forward (backward y) == y

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  first : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  next  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vec
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Nat ->
  Set a where

  empty :
    Vec A zero
  _vcons_ :
    {n : Nat} ->
    A ->
    Vec A n ->
    Vec A (suc n)

lookup :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec A n ->
  Fin n ->
  A
lookup (x vcons xs) first =
  x
lookup (x vcons xs) (next i) =
  lookup xs i

data NotMember
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec A n ->
  Set a where

  not-in-empty :
    NotMember x empty
  not-in-cons :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {y : A} ->
    {ys : Vec A n} ->
    Not (x == y) ->
    NotMember x ys ->
    NotMember x (y vcons ys)

data Distinct
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec A n ->
  Set a where

  distinct-empty :
    Distinct empty
  distinct-cons :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {x : A} ->
    {xs : Vec A n} ->
    NotMember x xs ->
    Distinct xs ->
    Distinct (x vcons xs)

record Ring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR (negateR x) x == zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record AdditiveCommutativeGroup
  {m : Level}
  (M : Set m) :
  Set m where

  field
    zeroM : M
    addM : M -> M -> M
    negateM : M -> M

    add-associative :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : M) ->
      addM zeroM x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : M) ->
      addM (negateM x) x == zeroM
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x (negateM x) == zeroM

record Module
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (ring : Ring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    scale :
      R -> M -> M
    one-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.oneR ring) x == x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.multiplyR ring a b) x ==
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.addR ring a b) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale b x)
    scale-add :
      (a : R) (x y : M) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale a y)
    zero-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Ring.zeroR ring) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive
    scale-zero :
      (a : R) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive

record LinearMap
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M N : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {source-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  {target-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup N}
  (source-module : Module ring source-additive)
  (target-module : Module ring target-additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    apply :
      M -> N
    map-zero :
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM source-additive) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM target-additive
    map-add :
      (x y : M) ->
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM source-additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM target-additive
        (apply x)
        (apply y)
    map-negate :
      (x : M) ->
      apply (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM source-additive x) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM target-additive (apply x)
    map-scale :
      (a : R) (x : M) ->
      apply (Module.scale source-module a x) ==
      Module.scale target-module a (apply x)

record Submodule
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    member :
      M -> Set m
    contains-zero :
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : M) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : M) ->
      member x ->
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM additive x)
    closed-under-scaling :
      (a : R) (x : M) ->
      member x ->
      member (Module.scale module-structure a x)

Kernel :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M N : Set m} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  {source-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M} ->
  {target-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup N} ->
  {source-module : Module ring source-additive} ->
  {target-module : Module ring target-additive} ->
  LinearMap source-module target-module ->
  M ->
  Set m
Kernel {target-additive = target-additive} linear-map x =
  LinearMap.apply linear-map x ==
  AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM target-additive

Range :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M N : Set m} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  {source-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M} ->
  {target-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup N} ->
  {source-module : Module ring source-additive} ->
  {target-module : Module ring target-additive} ->
  LinearMap source-module target-module ->
  N ->
  Set m
Range {M = M} linear-map y =
  Σ M (\ x -> LinearMap.apply linear-map x == y)

kernelSubmodule :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M N : Set m} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  {source-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M} ->
  {target-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup N} ->
  {source-module : Module ring source-additive} ->
  {target-module : Module ring target-additive} ->
  (linear-map : LinearMap source-module target-module) ->
  Submodule source-module
kernelSubmodule
    {source-additive = source-additive}
    {target-additive = target-additive}
    {source-module = source-module}
    {target-module = target-module}
    linear-map =
  record
    { member = Kernel linear-map
    ; contains-zero = LinearMap.map-zero linear-map
    ; closed-under-addition =
        \ x y hx hy ->
          transitivity
            (LinearMap.map-add linear-map x y)
            (transitivity
              (congruence-two
                (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM target-additive)
                hx hy)
              (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add-zero-left
                target-additive
                (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM target-additive)))
    ; closed-under-negation =
        \ x hx ->
          transitivity
            (LinearMap.map-negate linear-map x)
            (transitivity
              (congruence
                (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM target-additive)
                hx)
              (transitivity
                (symmetry
                  (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add-zero-right
                    target-additive
                    (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM target-additive
                      (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM target-additive))))
                (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add-inverse-left
                  target-additive
                  (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM target-additive))))
    ; closed-under-scaling =
        \ a x hx ->
          transitivity
            (LinearMap.map-scale linear-map a x)
            (transitivity
              (congruence
                (Module.scale target-module a)
                hx)
              (Module.scale-zero target-module a))
    }

rangeSubmodule :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M N : Set m} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  {source-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M} ->
  {target-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup N} ->
  {source-module : Module ring source-additive} ->
  {target-module : Module ring target-additive} ->
  (linear-map : LinearMap source-module target-module) ->
  Submodule target-module
rangeSubmodule
    {source-additive = source-additive}
    {target-additive = target-additive}
    {source-module = source-module}
    {target-module = target-module}
    linear-map =
  record
    { member = Range linear-map
    ; contains-zero =
        AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM source-additive ,
        LinearMap.map-zero linear-map
    ; closed-under-addition =
        \ y z hy hz ->
          AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM source-additive
            (fst hy) (fst hz) ,
          transitivity
            (LinearMap.map-add linear-map (fst hy) (fst hz))
            (congruence-two
              (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM target-additive)
              (snd hy) (snd hz))
    ; closed-under-negation =
        \ y hy ->
          AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM source-additive (fst hy) ,
          transitivity
            (LinearMap.map-negate linear-map (fst hy))
            (congruence
              (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negateM target-additive)
              (snd hy))
    ; closed-under-scaling =
        \ a y hy ->
          Module.scale source-module a (fst hy) ,
          transitivity
            (LinearMap.map-scale linear-map a (fst hy))
            (congruence
              (Module.scale target-module a)
              (snd hy))
    }

linearCombination :
  {r m i : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  (vectors : I -> M) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vec I n ->
  Vec R n ->
  M
linearCombination additive module-structure vectors empty empty =
  AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive
linearCombination additive module-structure vectors
    (index vcons indices) (coefficient vcons coefficients) =
  AdditiveCommutativeGroup.addM additive
    (Module.scale module-structure coefficient (vectors index))
    (linearCombination additive module-structure vectors
      indices coefficients)

LinearIndependent :
  {r m i : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  (vectors : I -> M) ->
  Set (r ⊔ m ⊔ i)
LinearIndependent {R = R} {I = I} {ring = ring}
    additive module-structure vectors =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (indices : Vec I n) ->
  (coefficients : Vec R n) ->
  Distinct indices ->
  linearCombination additive module-structure vectors
    indices coefficients ==
    AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zeroM additive ->
  (position : Fin n) ->
  lookup coefficients position == Ring.zeroR ring

QuotientLinearIndependent :
  {r m i : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {M : Set m} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M} ->
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  Submodule module-structure ->
  (I -> M) ->
  Set (r ⊔ m ⊔ i)
QuotientLinearIndependent
    {R = R} {I = I} {ring = ring} {additive = additive}
    module-structure submodule vectors =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (indices : Vec I n) ->
  (coefficients : Vec R n) ->
  Distinct indices ->
  Submodule.member submodule
    (linearCombination additive module-structure vectors
      indices coefficients) ->
  (position : Fin n) ->
  lookup coefficients position == Ring.zeroR ring

record RankData
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M)
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    Index :
      Set m
    vectors :
      Index -> M
    linearly-independent :
      LinearIndependent additive module-structure vectors
    maximal :
      {J : Set m} ->
      (other-vectors : J -> M) ->
      LinearIndependent additive module-structure other-vectors ->
      Injection J Index

record SubmoduleRankData
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  (module-structure : Module ring additive)
  (submodule : Submodule module-structure) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    Index :
      Set m
    vectors :
      Index -> M
    vectors-belong :
      (i : Index) ->
      Submodule.member submodule (vectors i)
    linearly-independent :
      LinearIndependent additive module-structure vectors
    maximal :
      {J : Set m} ->
      (other-vectors : J -> M) ->
      ((j : J) ->
        Submodule.member submodule (other-vectors j)) ->
      LinearIndependent additive module-structure other-vectors ->
      Injection J Index

record QuotientRankData
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  {ring : Ring R}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M}
  (module-structure : Module ring additive)
  (submodule : Submodule module-structure) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    Index :
      Set m
    representatives :
      Index -> M
    quotient-linearly-independent :
      QuotientLinearIndependent
        module-structure submodule representatives
    maximal :
      {J : Set m} ->
      (other-representatives : J -> M) ->
      QuotientLinearIndependent
        module-structure submodule other-representatives ->
      Injection J Index

record HasRankNullity
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : Ring R) :
  Set (r ⊔ lsuc m) where

  field
    module-rank :
      (M : Set m) ->
      (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
      (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
      RankData additive module-structure
    submodule-rank :
      (M : Set m) ->
      (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
      (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
      (submodule : Submodule module-structure) ->
      SubmoduleRankData module-structure submodule
    quotient-rank :
      (M : Set m) ->
      (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
      (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
      (submodule : Submodule module-structure) ->
      QuotientRankData module-structure submodule
    rank-quotient-add-rank :
      (M : Set m) ->
      (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
      (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
      (submodule : Submodule module-structure) ->
      Bijection
        (QuotientRankData.Index
          (quotient-rank M additive module-structure submodule)
          sum
        SubmoduleRankData.Index
          (submodule-rank M additive module-structure submodule))
        (RankData.Index
          (module-rank M additive module-structure))

ModuleRankIndex :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  (rank-nullity : HasRankNullity {m = m} ring) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  Set m
ModuleRankIndex rank-nullity M additive module-structure =
  RankData.Index
    (HasRankNullity.module-rank rank-nullity
      M additive module-structure)

SubmoduleRankIndex :
  {r m : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {ring : Ring R} ->
  (rank-nullity : HasRankNullity {m = m} ring) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
