  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  Submodule module-structure ->
  Set m
SubmoduleRankIndex rank-nullity M additive module-structure submodule =
  SubmoduleRankData.Index
    (HasRankNullity.submodule-rank rank-nullity
      M additive module-structure submodule)

-- Lean: LinearMap.rank_range_add_rank_ker
rank-nullity-theorem : Setω
rank-nullity-theorem =
  {r m : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (M M1 : Set m) ->
  (ring : Ring R) ->
  (source-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M) ->
  (target-additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup M1) ->
  (source-module : Module ring source-additive) ->
  (target-module : Module ring target-additive) ->
  (has-rank-nullity : HasRankNullity {m = m} ring) ->
  (linear-map : LinearMap source-module target-module) ->
  Bijection
    (SubmoduleRankIndex has-rank-nullity
      M1 target-additive target-module
      (rangeSubmodule linear-map)
      sum
    SubmoduleRankIndex has-rank-nullity
      M source-additive source-module
      (kernelSubmodule linear-map))
    (ModuleRankIndex has-rank-nullity
      M source-additive source-module)

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q303402, "Rank–nullity theorem": for a linear map between modules over an
  arbitrary ring satisfying the rank-nullity condition, the cardinal rank of
  its range plus the cardinal rank of its kernel equals the cardinal rank of
  its domain. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open cardinalTheory pred_setTheory;

val q303402_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_ring_def",
  ``q303402_ring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a. addR (negR a) a = zeroR) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
      (!a. mulR a oneR = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) =
                 addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (addR a b) c =
                 addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c))``);

val q303402_module_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_module_def",
  ``q303402_module
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!x y. addM x y = addM y x) /\
      (!x y z. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) /\
      (!x. addM zeroM x = x) /\
      (!x. addM (negM x) x = zeroM) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (addM x y) =
                 addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addR a b) x =
                 addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!x. smul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x. smul zeroR x = zeroM) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroM = zeroM)``);

val q303402_linear_map_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_linear_map_def",
  ``q303402_linear_map
      (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (smulM : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (addN : 'n -> 'n -> 'n) (smulN : 'r -> 'n -> 'n)
      (f : 'm -> 'n) <=>
      (!x y. f (addM x y) = addN (f x) (f y)) /\
      (!a x. f (smulM a x) = smulN a (f x))``);

val q303402_submodule_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_submodule_def",
  ``q303402_submodule
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (s : 'm set) <=>
      zeroM IN s /\
      (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> addM x y IN s) /\
      (!x. x IN s ==> negM x IN s) /\
      (!a x. x IN s ==> smul a x IN s)``);

val q303402_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_lincomb_def",
  ``q303402_lincomb
      (zeroR : 'r) (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (s : 'm set) (coeff : 'm -> 'r) =
      ITSET
        (\x acc. addM (smul (coeff x) x) acc)
        {x | x IN s /\ coeff x <> zeroR}
        zeroM``);

val q303402_linear_independent_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_linear_independent_def",
  ``q303402_linear_independent
      (zeroR : 'r) (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (s : 'm set) <=>
      !coeff : 'm -> 'r.
        FINITE {x | x IN s /\ coeff x <> zeroR} /\
        q303402_lincomb zeroR zeroM addM smul s coeff = zeroM
        ==>
        !x. x IN s ==> coeff x = zeroR``);

val q303402_rank_witness_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_rank_witness_def",
  ``q303402_rank_witness
      (zeroR : 'r) (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (carrier : 'm set) (b : 'm set) <=>
      b SUBSET carrier /\
      q303402_linear_independent zeroR zeroM addM smul b /\
      (!s : 'm set.
        s SUBSET carrier /\
        q303402_linear_independent zeroR zeroM addM smul s
        ==>
        s <<= b)``);

val q303402_coset_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_coset_def",
  ``q303402_coset
      (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (s : 'm set) (x : 'm) =
      {y | addM y (negM x) IN s}``);

val q303402_quotient_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_quotient_carrier_def",
  ``q303402_quotient_carrier
      (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm) (s : 'm set) =
      {c : 'm set | ?x. c = q303402_coset addM negM s x}``);

val q303402_representative_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_representative_def",
  ``q303402_representative
      (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (s : 'm set) (c : 'm set) =
      @x. c = q303402_coset addM negM s x``);

val q303402_quotient_add_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_quotient_add_def",
  ``q303402_quotient_add
      (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (s : 'm set) (c : 'm set) (d : 'm set) =
      q303402_coset addM negM s
        (addM
          (q303402_representative addM negM s c)
          (q303402_representative addM negM s d))``);

val q303402_quotient_smul_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_quotient_smul_def",
  ``q303402_quotient_smul
      (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) (s : 'm set)
      (a : 'r) (c : 'm set) =
      q303402_coset addM negM s
        (smul a (q303402_representative addM negM s c))``);

val q303402_has_rank_nullity_def = new_definition (
  "q303402_has_rank_nullity_def",
  ``q303402_has_rank_nullity
      (zeroR : 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      !s : 'm set.
        q303402_submodule zeroM addM negM smul s
        ==>
        ?bq : ('m set) set.
        ?bs bm : 'm set.
          q303402_rank_witness
            zeroR
            (q303402_coset addM negM s zeroM)
            (q303402_quotient_add addM negM s)
            (q303402_quotient_smul addM negM smul s)
            (q303402_quotient_carrier addM negM s) bq /\
          q303402_rank_witness zeroR zeroM addM smul s bs /\
          q303402_rank_witness zeroR zeroM addM smul UNIV bm /\
          (IMAGE INL bq UNION IMAGE INR bs) =~ bm``);

val LinearMap_rank_range_add_rank_ker =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) (negM : 'm -> 'm)
      (smulM : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (zeroN : 'n) (addN : 'n -> 'n -> 'n) (negN : 'n -> 'n)
      (smulN : 'r -> 'n -> 'n)
      (f : 'm -> 'n).
      q303402_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
      q303402_module zeroR oneR addR mulR
        zeroM addM negM smulM /\
      q303402_module zeroR oneR addR mulR
        zeroN addN negN smulN /\
      q303402_linear_map addM smulM addN smulN f /\
      q303402_has_rank_nullity zeroR zeroM addM negM smulM /\
      q303402_has_rank_nullity zeroR zeroN addN negN smulN
      ==>
      ?br : 'n set.
      ?bk bm : 'm set.
        q303402_rank_witness zeroR zeroN addN smulN
          {y | ?x. f x = y} br /\
        q303402_rank_witness zeroR zeroM addM smulM
          {x | f x = zeroN} bk /\
        q303402_rank_witness zeroR zeroM addM smulM UNIV bm /\
        (IMAGE INL br UNION IMAGE INR bk) =~ bm``;

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q303402
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q303402), "Rank-nullity theorem": for a
  linear map between arbitrary modules over a ring satisfying
  HasRankNullity, the cardinal rank of its range plus the cardinal rank of
  its kernel equals the cardinal rank of its domain. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q303402Rank M is the supremum of the SetMM card values of all linearly
  independent subsets of the SetMM left module M. This is the universe-free
  set-theoretic rendering of mathlib's cardinal-valued Module.rank. Cardinal
  addition is represented by card applied to the tagged disjoint union |_| .

  Q303402HasRankNullity R retains both fields of mathlib's HasRankNullity:
  every set-sized left R-module has a linearly independent subset attaining
  its rank, and for every submodule N of M the cardinal rank of M / N plus
  the rank of N equals the rank of M. SetMM's restricted structures M |`s N,
  U |`s ran F, and M |`s ( `' F " { ( 0g ` U ) } ) represent respectively
  a submodule, the range of F, and the kernel of F with their inherited
  module structures.

  The two definitions and the final theorem are unproved $a assertions.
  This database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q303402Rank Q303402HasRankNullity $.

q303402-rank-syntax
  $a class ( Q303402Rank M ) $.

q303402-has-rank-nullity-syntax
  $a wff ( Q303402HasRankNullity R ) $.

q303402-rank-definition $a |- (
  Q303402Rank M
  )
  =
  U. ( card " ( LIndS ` M ) ) $.

${
  $d M N R S v $.

  q303402-has-rank-nullity-definition $a |- (
    ( Q303402HasRankNullity R )
    <->
    (
      R e. Ring
      /\
      (
        A. M e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = R }
          E. S e. ( LIndS ` M )
            ( card ` S ) = ( Q303402Rank M )
        /\
        A. M e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = R }
          A. N e. ( LSubSp ` M )
            (
              card
              `
              (
                (
                  Q303402Rank
                  ( M /s ( M ~QG N ) )
                )
                |_|
                (
                  Q303402Rank
                  ( M |`s N )
                )
              )
            )
            =
            ( Q303402Rank M )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M R U $.

  thousand-theorems-q303402-rank-nullity-theorem $a |- (
    A. R A. M A. U A. F
      (
        (
          ( Q303402HasRankNullity R )
          /\
          (
            M e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = R }
            /\
            (
              U e. { v e. LMod | ( Scalar ` v ) = R }
              /\
              F e. ( M LMHom U )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          card
          `
          (
            (
              Q303402Rank
              ( U |`s ran F )
            )
            |_|
            (
              Q303402Rank
              (
                M |`s
                ( `' F " { ( 0g ` U ) } )
              )
            )
          )
        )
        =
        ( Q303402Rank M )
      )
  ) $.
$}

      FUNCT_4, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, CARD_1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQOP,
      STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_2, VECTSP_1, FUNCT_7, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_5,
      VECTSP_6, VECTSP_7, MOD_2, MATRLIN, VECTSP_9, LOPBAN_1, CARD_2,

 constructors NAT_1, FINSEQOP, HAHNBAN, VECTSP_6, VECTSP_7, MOD_2, VECTSP_9,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being Ring holds
  for M,M1 being VectSp of R,
      f being linear-transformation of M,M1,
      CR,CK,CM being Cardinal st
    R is non degenerated &
    (for V being VectSp of R holds
      ex C being Cardinal st
        (for A being Subset of V st A is linearly-independent
          holds card A c= C) &
        ex A being Subset of V st
          A is linearly-independent & card A = C) &
    (for V being VectSp of R, N being Subspace of V,
         CQ,CN,CV being Cardinal st
      ((for A being Subset of V/N st A is linearly-independent
          holds card A c= CQ) &
       (ex A being Subset of V/N st
          A is linearly-independent & card A = CQ)) &
      ((for A being Subset of N st A is linearly-independent
          holds card A c= CN) &
       (ex A being Subset of N st
          A is linearly-independent & card A = CN)) &
      ((for A being Subset of V st A is linearly-independent
          holds card A c= CV) &
       (ex A being Subset of V st
          A is linearly-independent & card A = CV))
     holds CQ +` CN = CV) &
    ((for A being Subset of im f st A is linearly-independent
        holds card A c= CR) &
     (ex A being Subset of im f st
        A is linearly-independent & card A = CR)) &
    ((for A being Subset of ker f st A is linearly-independent
        holds card A c= CK) &
     (ex A being Subset of ker f st
        A is linearly-independent & card A = CK)) &
    ((for A being Subset of M st A is linearly-independent
        holds card A c= CM) &
     (ex A being Subset of M st
        A is linearly-independent & card A = CM))
  holds CR +` CK = CM
proof
end;

title: Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q303402,
% "Rank–nullity theorem": for a linear map of modules over a ring satisfying
% the universe-wide rank-nullity class, the cardinal ranks of its range and
% kernel add to the cardinal rank of its domain. This file contains no proof.

Q303402_rank_nullity_support: THEORY
BEGIN

  ring_structure[R: TYPE+]: TYPE =
    [# rzero: R,
       rone: R,
       radd: [R, R -> R],
       rmul: [R, R -> R],
       rneg: [R -> R] #]

  module_structure[R, X: TYPE+]: TYPE =
    [# mzero: X,
       madd: [X, X -> X],
       mneg: [X -> X],
       msmul: [R, X -> X] #]

  ring_laws[R: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R]): bool =
    rzero(ring) /= rone(ring)
    AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
       radd(ring)(radd(ring)(a, b), c) =
         radd(ring)(a, radd(ring)(b, c))
       AND radd(ring)(a, b) = radd(ring)(b, a)
       AND radd(ring)(rzero(ring), a) = a
       AND radd(ring)(rneg(ring)(a), a) = rzero(ring)
       AND rmul(ring)(rmul(ring)(a, b), c) =
         rmul(ring)(a, rmul(ring)(b, c))
       AND rmul(ring)(rone(ring), a) = a
       AND rmul(ring)(a, rone(ring)) = a
       AND rmul(ring)(a, radd(ring)(b, c)) =
         radd(ring)(rmul(ring)(a, b), rmul(ring)(a, c))
       AND rmul(ring)(radd(ring)(a, b), c) =
         radd(ring)(rmul(ring)(a, c), rmul(ring)(b, c)))

  module_laws[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: X), (a, b: R):
       madd(module)(madd(module)(x, y), z) =
         madd(module)(x, madd(module)(y, z))
       AND madd(module)(x, y) = madd(module)(y, x)
       AND madd(module)(mzero(module), x) = x
       AND madd(module)(mneg(module)(x), x) = mzero(module)
       AND msmul(module)(radd(ring)(a, b), x) =
         madd(module)(msmul(module)(a, x), msmul(module)(b, x))
       AND msmul(module)(a, madd(module)(x, y)) =
         madd(module)(msmul(module)(a, x), msmul(module)(a, y))
       AND msmul(module)(rmul(ring)(a, b), x) =
         msmul(module)(a, msmul(module)(b, x))
       AND msmul(module)(rone(ring), x) = x)

  subset[X: TYPE+](
      smaller: [X -> bool],
      larger: [X -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (x: X): smaller(x) IMPLIES larger(x))

  submodule[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      carrier: [X -> bool]): bool =
    carrier(mzero(module))
    AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
      carrier(x) AND carrier(y) IMPLIES carrier(madd(module)(x, y)))
    AND (FORALL (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES carrier(mneg(module)(x)))
    AND (FORALL (a: R), (x: X):
      carrier(x) IMPLIES carrier(msmul(module)(a, x)))

  linear_combination[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      coefficients: [nat -> R],
      values: [nat -> X],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE X =
    IF count = 0
    THEN mzero(module)
    ELSE madd(module)(
           linear_combination[R, X](
             ring, module, coefficients, values, count - 1),
           msmul(module)(coefficients(count - 1), values(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
    MEASURE count

  coefficients_zero[R: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      coefficients: [nat -> R],
      count: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (i: nat):
      i < count IMPLIES coefficients(i) = rzero(ring))

  distinct_prefix[X: TYPE+](
      values: [nat -> X],
      count: nat): bool =
    (FORALL (i, j: nat):
      i < count AND j < count AND values(i) = values(j)
        IMPLIES i = j)

  prefix_in[X: TYPE+](
      values: [nat -> X],
      count: nat,
      carrier: [X -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (i: nat): i < count IMPLIES carrier(values(i)))

  linear_independent[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      carrier: [X -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL
        (values: [nat -> X]),
        (coefficients: [nat -> R]),
        (count: nat):
      prefix_in[X](values, count, carrier)
      AND distinct_prefix[X](values, count)
      AND linear_combination[R, X](
        ring, module, coefficients, values, count) = mzero(module)
      IMPLIES coefficients_zero[R](ring, coefficients, count))

  injects[X, Y: TYPE+](
      source: [X -> bool],
      target: [Y -> bool],
      mapping: [X -> Y]): bool =
    (FORALL (x: X): source(x) IMPLIES target(mapping(x)))
    AND (FORALL (x1, x2: X):
      source(x1) AND source(x2) AND mapping(x1) = mapping(x2)
        IMPLIES x1 = x2)

  rank_witness[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      basis: [X -> bool],
      carrier: [X -> bool]): bool =
    subset[X](basis, carrier)
    AND linear_independent[R, X](ring, module, basis)
    AND (FORALL (independent_set: [X -> bool]):
      subset[X](independent_set, carrier)
      AND linear_independent[R, X](ring, module, independent_set)
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (embedding: [X -> X]):
          injects[X, X](independent_set, basis, embedding)))

  same_coset[R, X: TYPE+](
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      normal: [X -> bool],
      x: X,
      y: X): bool =
    normal(madd(module)(x, mneg(module)(y)))

  quotient_representatives[R, X: TYPE+](
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      normal: [X -> bool],
      representatives: [X -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      representatives(x) AND representatives(y)
      AND same_coset[R, X](module, normal, x, y)
        IMPLIES x = y)

  quotient_linear_independent[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      normal: [X -> bool],
      representatives: [X -> bool]): bool =
    quotient_representatives[R, X](module, normal, representatives)
    AND (FORALL
        (values: [nat -> X]),
        (coefficients: [nat -> R]),
        (count: nat):
      prefix_in[X](values, count, representatives)
      AND distinct_prefix[X](values, count)
      AND normal(linear_combination[R, X](
        ring, module, coefficients, values, count))
      IMPLIES coefficients_zero[R](ring, coefficients, count))

  cardinal_sum_le[X, Y, Z: TYPE+](
      left: [X -> bool],
      right: [Y -> bool],
      target: [Z -> bool]): bool =
    (EXISTS
        (left_embedding: [X -> Z]),
        (right_embedding: [Y -> Z]):
      injects[X, Z](left, target, left_embedding)
      AND injects[Y, Z](right, target, right_embedding)
      AND (FORALL (x: X), (y: Y):
        left(x) AND right(y)
          IMPLIES left_embedding(x) /= right_embedding(y)))

  cardinal_le_sum[Z, X, Y: TYPE+](
      source: [Z -> bool],
      left: [X -> bool],
      right: [Y -> bool]): bool =
    (EXISTS
        (uses_left: [Z -> bool]),
        (left_embedding: [Z -> X]),
        (right_embedding: [Z -> Y]):
      (FORALL (z: Z):
        source(z) IMPLIES
          IF uses_left(z)
          THEN left(left_embedding(z))
          ELSE right(right_embedding(z))
          ENDIF)
      AND (FORALL (z1, z2: Z):
        source(z1) AND source(z2)
        AND uses_left(z1) = uses_left(z2)
        AND (IF uses_left(z1)
             THEN left_embedding(z1) = left_embedding(z2)
             ELSE right_embedding(z1) = right_embedding(z2)
             ENDIF)
          IMPLIES z1 = z2))

  rank_sum_equal[R, X, Y, Z: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      left_module: module_structure[R, X],
      left_carrier: [X -> bool],
      right_module: module_structure[R, Y],
      right_carrier: [Y -> bool],
      total_module: module_structure[R, Z],
      total_carrier: [Z -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL
        (left_set: [X -> bool]),
        (right_set: [Y -> bool]):
      subset[X](left_set, left_carrier)
      AND linear_independent[R, X](ring, left_module, left_set)
      AND subset[Y](right_set, right_carrier)
      AND linear_independent[R, Y](ring, right_module, right_set)
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (total_set: [Z -> bool]):
          subset[Z](total_set, total_carrier)
          AND linear_independent[R, Z](ring, total_module, total_set)
          AND cardinal_sum_le[X, Y, Z](
            left_set, right_set, total_set)))
    AND
    (FORALL (total_set: [Z -> bool]):
      subset[Z](total_set, total_carrier)
      AND linear_independent[R, Z](ring, total_module, total_set)
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS
            (left_set: [X -> bool]),
            (right_set: [Y -> bool]):
          subset[X](left_set, left_carrier)
          AND linear_independent[R, X](ring, left_module, left_set)
          AND subset[Y](right_set, right_carrier)
          AND linear_independent[R, Y](ring, right_module, right_set)
          AND cardinal_le_sum[Z, X, Y](
            total_set, left_set, right_set)))

  quotient_rank_sum_equal[R, X: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      module: module_structure[R, X],
      normal: [X -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL
        (quotient_set: [X -> bool]),
        (normal_set: [X -> bool]):
      quotient_linear_independent[R, X](
        ring, module, normal, quotient_set)
      AND subset[X](normal_set, normal)
      AND linear_independent[R, X](ring, module, normal_set)
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS (total_set: [X -> bool]):
          linear_independent[R, X](ring, module, total_set)
          AND cardinal_sum_le[X, X, X](
            quotient_set, normal_set, total_set)))
    AND
    (FORALL (total_set: [X -> bool]):
      linear_independent[R, X](ring, module, total_set)
      IMPLIES
        (EXISTS
            (quotient_set: [X -> bool]),
            (normal_set: [X -> bool]):
          quotient_linear_independent[R, X](
            ring, module, normal, quotient_set)
          AND subset[X](normal_set, normal)
          AND linear_independent[R, X](ring, module, normal_set)
          AND cardinal_le_sum[X, X, X](
            total_set, quotient_set, normal_set)))

  linear_map_laws[R, X, Y: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      domain_module: module_structure[R, X],
      codomain_module: module_structure[R, Y],
      linear_map: [X -> Y]): bool =
    (FORALL (x1, x2: X), (a: R):
      linear_map(madd(domain_module)(x1, x2)) =
        madd(codomain_module)(linear_map(x1), linear_map(x2))
      AND linear_map(msmul(domain_module)(a, x1)) =
        msmul(codomain_module)(a, linear_map(x1)))

  kernel[R, X, Y: TYPE+](
      codomain_module: module_structure[R, Y],
      linear_map: [X -> Y],
      x: X): bool =
    linear_map(x) = mzero(codomain_module)

  range[R, X, Y: TYPE+](
      linear_map: [X -> Y],
      y: Y): bool =
    (EXISTS (x: X): linear_map(x) = y)

  rank_range_add_rank_ker_for[R, X, Y: TYPE+](
      ring: ring_structure[R],
      domain_module: module_structure[R, X],
      codomain_module: module_structure[R, Y],
      linear_map: [X -> Y]): bool =
    (ring_laws[R](ring)
     AND module_laws[R, X](ring, domain_module)
     AND module_laws[R, Y](ring, codomain_module)
     AND linear_map_laws[R, X, Y](
       ring, domain_module, codomain_module, linear_map))
    IMPLIES
      rank_sum_equal[R, Y, X, X](
        ring,
        codomain_module,
        (LAMBDA (y: Y): range[R, X, Y](linear_map, y)),
        domain_module,
        (LAMBDA (x: X):
          kernel[R, X, Y](codomain_module, linear_map, x)),
        domain_module,
        (LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE))

END Q303402_rank_nullity_support

Q303402_has_rank_nullity[
  (IMPORTING Q303402_rank_nullity_support)
  Base: TYPE+,
  zero_R, one_R: Base,
  add_R, mul_R: [Base, Base -> Base],
  neg_R: [Base -> Base]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  ASSUMING
    exists_set_linearIndependent[Carrier: TYPE+]: ASSUMPTION
      FORALL (module: module_structure[Base, Carrier]):
        module_laws[Base, Carrier](
          (# rzero := zero_R,
             rone := one_R,
             radd := add_R,
             rmul := mul_R,
             rneg := neg_R #),
          module)
        IMPLIES
          (EXISTS (basis: [Carrier -> bool]):
            rank_witness[Base, Carrier](
              (# rzero := zero_R,
                 rone := one_R,
                 radd := add_R,
                 rmul := mul_R,
                 rneg := neg_R #),
              module,
              basis,
              (LAMBDA (x: Carrier): TRUE)))

    rank_quotient_add_rank[Carrier: TYPE+]: ASSUMPTION
      FORALL
          (module: module_structure[Base, Carrier]),
          (normal: [Carrier -> bool]):
        module_laws[Base, Carrier](
          (# rzero := zero_R,
             rone := one_R,
             radd := add_R,
             rmul := mul_R,
             rneg := neg_R #),
          module)
        AND submodule[Base, Carrier](
          (# rzero := zero_R,
             rone := one_R,
             radd := add_R,
             rmul := mul_R,
             rneg := neg_R #),
          module,
          normal)
        IMPLIES
          quotient_rank_sum_equal[Base, Carrier](
            (# rzero := zero_R,
               rone := one_R,
               radd := add_R,
               rmul := mul_R,
               rneg := neg_R #),
            module,
            normal)
  ENDASSUMING

END Q303402_has_rank_nullity

Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem[
  Base, Domain, Codomain: TYPE+,
  zero_R, one_R: Base,
  add_R, mul_R: [Base, Base -> Base],
  neg_R: [Base -> Base],
  zero_Domain: Domain,
  add_Domain: [Domain, Domain -> Domain],
  neg_Domain: [Domain -> Domain],
  smul_Domain: [Base, Domain -> Domain],
  zero_Codomain: Codomain,
  add_Codomain: [Codomain, Codomain -> Codomain],
  neg_Codomain: [Codomain -> Codomain],
  smul_Codomain: [Base, Codomain -> Codomain],
  linear_map: [Domain -> Codomain],
  Evidence: THEORY Q303402_has_rank_nullity[
    Base, zero_R, one_R, add_R, mul_R, neg_R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  IMPORTING Q303402_rank_nullity_support

  selected_ring: ring_structure[Base] =
    (# rzero := zero_R,
       rone := one_R,
       radd := add_R,
       rmul := mul_R,
       rneg := neg_R #)

  selected_domain_module: module_structure[Base, Domain] =
    (# mzero := zero_Domain,
       madd := add_Domain,
       mneg := neg_Domain,
       msmul := smul_Domain #)

  selected_codomain_module: module_structure[Base, Codomain] =
    (# mzero := zero_Codomain,
       madd := add_Codomain,
       mneg := neg_Codomain,
       msmul := smul_Codomain #)

  rank_nullity_statement: bool =
    rank_range_add_rank_ker_for[Base, Domain, Codomain](
      selected_ring,
      selected_domain_module,
      selected_codomain_module,
      linear_map)

END Q303402_rank_nullity_theorem

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q318767
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q318767), "Abel's theorem": convergence of coefficient
-- partial sums determines the boundary limit of the associated complex power series
-- within positive Stolz cones and of the real power series from the left. This file
-- contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed

@[expose] public section

open Filter Finset

open scoped Topology

namespace Q318767

namespace Complex

variable {f : ℕ → ℂ} {l : ℂ}

/-- Abel's limit theorem for a complex power series within a positive Stolz cone. -/
theorem tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_stolzCone
    (h : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, f i) atTop (𝓝 l))
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Tendsto (fun z ↦ ∑' n, f n * z ^ n)
      (𝓝[{z : ℂ | |z.im| < s * (1 - z.re)}] 1) (𝓝 l) := sorry

end Complex

namespace Real

variable {f : ℕ → ℝ} {l : ℝ}

/-- Abel's limit theorem for a real power series approaching `1` from the left. -/
theorem tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt
    (h : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∑ i ∈ range n, f i) atTop (𝓝 l)) :
    Tendsto (fun x ↦ ∑' n, f n * x ^ n) (𝓝[<] 1) (𝓝 l) := sorry

end Real

end Q318767

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q318767
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q318767), "Abel's theorem": convergence of the
  coefficient partial sums implies convergence of the associated complex
  power series within every positive Stolz cone at 1, and of the real power
  series as its argument approaches 1 from the left. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import
  Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon Arith.PeanoNat.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q318767_C : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q318767_czero : q318767_C := (0, 0).

Definition q318767_cone : q318767_C := (1, 0).

Definition q318767_cadd
    (z w : q318767_C) : q318767_C :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q318767_copp
    (z : q318767_C) : q318767_C :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q318767_csub
    (z w : q318767_C) : q318767_C :=
  q318767_cadd z (q318767_copp w).

Definition q318767_cmul
    (z w : q318767_C) : q318767_C :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q318767_cnorm
    (z : q318767_C) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z ^ 2 + snd z ^ 2).

Fixpoint q318767_cpow
    (z : q318767_C) (n : nat) : q318767_C :=
  match n with
  | O => q318767_cone
  | S k => q318767_cmul z (q318767_cpow z k)
  end.

Fixpoint q318767_cpartial_sum
    (terms : nat -> q318767_C) (n : nat) : q318767_C :=
  match n with
  | O => q318767_czero
  | S k =>
      q318767_cadd
        (q318767_cpartial_sum terms k) (terms k)
  end.

Definition q318767_csequence_converges
    (sequence : nat -> q318767_C)
    (limit : q318767_C) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q318767_cnorm
          (q318767_csub (sequence n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q318767_chas_sum
    (terms : nat -> q318767_C)
    (sum : q318767_C) : Prop :=
  q318767_csequence_converges
    (q318767_cpartial_sum terms) sum.

Definition q318767_ctsum
    (terms : nat -> q318767_C) : q318767_C :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists sum : q318767_C, q318767_chas_sum terms sum) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits q318767_czero)
        (fun sum : q318767_C => q318767_chas_sum terms sum)
  | right _ => q318767_czero
  end.

Definition q318767_complex_power_series
    (f : nat -> q318767_C) (z : q318767_C) : q318767_C :=
  q318767_ctsum
    (fun n : nat => q318767_cmul (f n) (q318767_cpow z n)).

Definition q318767_stolz_cone
    (s : R) (z : q318767_C) : Prop :=
  Rabs (snd z) < s * (1 - fst z).

Definition q318767_ctendsto_within_stolz_cone
    (g : q318767_C -> q318767_C)
    (s : R) (limit : q318767_C) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall z : q318767_C,
        q318767_stolz_cone s z ->
        q318767_cnorm (q318767_csub z q318767_cone) < delta ->
        q318767_cnorm (q318767_csub (g z) limit) < epsilon.

Theorem Complex_tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_stolzCone :
  forall (f : nat -> q318767_C) (l : q318767_C) (s : R),
    q318767_chas_sum f l ->
    0 < s ->
    q318767_ctendsto_within_stolz_cone
      (q318767_complex_power_series f) s l.
Admitted.

Fixpoint q318767_rpartial_sum
    (terms : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q318767_rpartial_sum terms k + terms k
  end.

Definition q318767_rsequence_converges
    (sequence : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (sequence n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q318767_rhas_sum
    (terms : nat -> R) (sum : R) : Prop :=
  q318767_rsequence_converges
    (q318767_rpartial_sum terms) sum.

Definition q318767_rtsum
    (terms : nat -> R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists sum : R, q318767_rhas_sum terms sum) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun sum : R => q318767_rhas_sum terms sum)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Definition q318767_real_power_series
    (f : nat -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  q318767_rtsum
    (fun n : nat => f n * x ^ n).

Definition q318767_rtendsto_from_left
    (g : R -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall x : R,
        x < 1 ->
        Rabs (x - 1) < delta ->
        Rabs (g x - limit) < epsilon.

Theorem Real_tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt :
  forall (f : nat -> R) (l : R),
    q318767_rhas_sum f l ->
    q318767_rtendsto_from_left
      (q318767_real_power_series f) l.
Admitted.

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q318767,
  "Abel's theorem": a convergent real or complex coefficient series determines
  the boundary limit of its power series, from the left in the real case and
  within every positive Stolz cone in the complex case. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q318767_abel_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition stolz_cone :: "real \<Rightarrow> complex set" where
  "stolz_cone s = {z. \<bar>Im z\<bar> < s * (1 - Re z)}"

theorem abel_stolz_cone:
  fixes f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and l :: complex
    and s :: real
  assumes "(\<lambda>n. \<Sum>i<n. f i) \<longlonglongrightarrow> l"
    and "0 < s"
  shows "((\<lambda>z. suminf (\<lambda>n. f n * z ^ n)) \<longlongrightarrow> l)
    (at 1 within stolz_cone s)"
  sorry

theorem abel_real_left:
  fixes f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
    and l :: real
  assumes "(\<lambda>n. \<Sum>i<n. f i) \<longlonglongrightarrow> l"
  shows "((\<lambda>x. suminf (\<lambda>n. f n * x ^ n)) \<longlongrightarrow> l)
    (at_left 1)"
  sorry

end

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q318767,
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q318767), "Abel's theorem": if the
  coefficient series converges at one, its complex power series tends to that
  sum within every positive Stolz cone, and its real power series tends to the
  sum from the left. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q318767_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q318767_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q318767_output;;
let q318767_previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q318767_formatter path);;
let q318767_complex_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q318767_formatter "Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q318767_previous_file_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q318767_formatter ();;
close_out q318767_output;;
if not q318767_complex_loaded then
  failwith "failed to load Complex/complexnumbers.ml";;

let Q318767_ABEL_S_THEOREM =
  `let complex_partial_sum =
     \(f:num->complex) (n:num).
       complex
         (sum(0,n) (\i:num. Re(f i)),
          sum(0,n) (\i:num. Im(f i))) in
   let complex_tends =
     \(u:num->complex) (l:complex).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?N:num.
               !n:num.
                 N <= n ==> norm(u n - l) < e in
   let complex_sums =
     \(f:num->complex) (l:complex).
       complex_tends (\n:num. complex_partial_sum f n) l in
   let complex_tsum =
     \(f:num->complex).
       if ?l:complex. complex_sums f l
       then @l:complex. complex_sums f l
       else Cx(&0) in
   let real_partial_sum =
     \(f:num->real) (n:num). sum(0,n) f in
   let real_tends =
     \(u:num->real) (l:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?N:num.
               !n:num.
                 N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < e in
   let real_sums =
     \(f:num->real) (l:real).
       real_tends (\n:num. real_partial_sum f n) l in
   let real_tsum =
     \(f:num->real).
       if ?l:real. real_sums f l
       then @l:real. real_sums f l
       else &0 in
   let complex_tends_within =
     \(g:complex->complex) (l:complex) (a:complex)
      (region:complex->bool).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !z:complex.
                 region z /\ norm(z - a) < d
                 ==> norm(g z - l) < e in
   let real_tends_from_left_at_one =
     \(g:real->real) (l:real).
       !e:real.
         &0 < e
         ==> ?d:real.
               &0 < d /\
               !x:real.
                 x < &1 /\ abs(x - &1) < d
                 ==> abs(g x - l) < e in
   let stolz_cone =
     \(s:real) (z:complex).
       abs(Im z) < s * (&1 - Re z) in
   ((!f:num->complex. !l:complex. !s:real.
       complex_sums f l /\ &0 < s
       ==>
       complex_tends_within
         (\z:complex.
            complex_tsum (\n:num. f n * z pow n))
         l (Cx(&1)) (stolz_cone s)) /\
    (!f:num->real. !l:real.
       real_sums f l
       ==>
       real_tends_from_left_at_one
         (\x:real. real_tsum (\n:num. f n * x pow n))
         l))`;;

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q318767,
;; "Abel's theorem": convergence of a real or complex coefficient series at
;; one implies convergence of its power-series sum to the same value from the
;; real left or within any positive-slope complex Stolz cone. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers up to the
;; unique ordered-field isomorphism. Complex numbers below are definitionally
;; pairs of real elements with the standard operations. Arbitrary coefficient
;; sequences and arbitrary subsets used by completeness are interpreted by
;; conservative interfaces; every required field, order, completeness, and
;; typing law is explicit in the statement predicates.

(defstub q318767-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q318767-zero (type) t)
(defstub q318767-one (type) t)
(defstub q318767-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q318767-multiply (type left right) t)
(defstub q318767-negate (type object) t)
(defstub q318767-inverse (type object) t)
(defstub q318767-less (type left right) t)
(defstub q318767-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q318767-sequence-at (sequence index) t)

(defun q318767-real-subtract (real-type x y)
  (q318767-add
   real-type x (q318767-negate real-type y)))

(defun q318767-real-positive-p (real-type x)
  (and
   (q318767-member-p real-type x)
   (q318767-less
    real-type (q318767-zero real-type) x)))

(defun q318767-real-leq-p (real-type x y)
  (and
   (q318767-member-p real-type x)
   (q318767-member-p real-type y)
   (not (q318767-less real-type y x))))

(defun q318767-real-absolute (real-type x)
  (if (q318767-less
       real-type x (q318767-zero real-type))
      (q318767-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q318767-real-square (real-type x)
  (q318767-multiply real-type x x))

(defun-sk q318767-field-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q318767-member-p real-type x)
      (q318767-member-p real-type y)
      (q318767-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (q318767-member-p
       real-type (q318767-add real-type x y))
      (q318767-member-p
       real-type (q318767-multiply real-type x y))
      (q318767-member-p
       real-type (q318767-negate real-type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q318767-zero real-type)))
       (q318767-member-p
        real-type (q318767-inverse real-type x)))
      (equal
       (q318767-add
        real-type (q318767-add real-type x y) z)
       (q318767-add
        real-type x (q318767-add real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q318767-add real-type x y)
       (q318767-add real-type y x))
      (equal
       (q318767-add
        real-type x (q318767-zero real-type))
       x)
      (equal
       (q318767-add
        real-type x (q318767-negate real-type x))
       (q318767-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q318767-multiply
        real-type (q318767-multiply real-type x y) z)
       (q318767-multiply
        real-type x (q318767-multiply real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q318767-multiply real-type x y)
       (q318767-multiply real-type y x))
      (equal
       (q318767-multiply
        real-type x (q318767-one real-type))
       x)
      (implies
       (equal x (q318767-zero real-type))
       (equal
        (q318767-inverse real-type x)
        (q318767-zero real-type)))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q318767-zero real-type)))
       (equal
        (q318767-multiply
         real-type x (q318767-inverse real-type x))
        (q318767-one real-type)))
      (equal
       (q318767-multiply
        real-type x (q318767-add real-type y z))
       (q318767-add
        real-type
        (q318767-multiply real-type x y)
        (q318767-multiply real-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q318767-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q318767-member-p real-type x)
      (q318767-member-p real-type y)
      (q318767-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q318767-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q318767-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q318767-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q318767-less real-type x y)
        (q318767-less real-type y z))
       (q318767-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q318767-less real-type x y)
       (q318767-less
        real-type
        (q318767-add real-type x z)
        (q318767-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q318767-less
         real-type (q318767-zero real-type) x)
        (q318767-less
         real-type (q318767-zero real-type) y))
       (q318767-less
        real-type
        (q318767-zero real-type)
        (q318767-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk q318767-valid-real-set-p (real-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q318767-set-member-p set x)
     (q318767-member-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-set-nonempty-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q318767-member-p real-type x)
     (q318767-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q318767-member-p real-type x)
      (q318767-set-member-p set x))
     (q318767-real-leq-p real-type x bound))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-set-bounded-above-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q318767-member-p real-type bound)
     (q318767-real-upper-bound-p
      real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q318767-member-p real-type bound)
      (q318767-real-upper-bound-p
       real-type set bound))
     (q318767-real-leq-p
      real-type supremum bound))))

(defun q318767-real-supremum-p
    (real-type set supremum)
  (and
   (q318767-member-p real-type supremum)
   (q318767-real-upper-bound-p
    real-type set supremum)
   (q318767-real-least-upper-bound-p
    real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk q318767-real-set-has-supremum-p
    (real-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q318767-real-supremum-p
     real-type set supremum)))

(defun-sk q318767-dedekind-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q318767-valid-real-set-p real-type set)
      (q318767-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (q318767-real-set-bounded-above-p
       real-type set))
     (q318767-real-set-has-supremum-p
      real-type set))))

(defun q318767-real-model-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q318767-member-p
    real-type (q318767-zero real-type))
   (q318767-member-p
    real-type (q318767-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q318767-zero real-type)
     (q318767-one real-type)))
   (q318767-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q318767-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q318767-less
    real-type
    (q318767-zero real-type)
    (q318767-one real-type))
   (q318767-dedekind-complete-p real-type)))

;; Complex numbers are ordered pairs (real-part . imaginary-part).

(defun q318767-complex-p (real-type z)
  (and
   (consp z)
   (q318767-member-p real-type (car z))
   (q318767-member-p real-type (cdr z))))

(defun q318767-complex-zero (real-type)
  (cons
   (q318767-zero real-type)
   (q318767-zero real-type)))

(defun q318767-complex-one (real-type)
  (cons
   (q318767-one real-type)
   (q318767-zero real-type)))

(defun q318767-complex-add (real-type z w)
  (cons
   (q318767-add real-type (car z) (car w))
   (q318767-add real-type (cdr z) (cdr w))))

(defun q318767-complex-negate (real-type z)
  (cons
   (q318767-negate real-type (car z))
   (q318767-negate real-type (cdr z))))

(defun q318767-complex-subtract (real-type z w)
  (q318767-complex-add
   real-type z (q318767-complex-negate real-type w)))

(defun q318767-complex-multiply (real-type z w)
  (cons
   (q318767-real-subtract
    real-type
    (q318767-multiply real-type (car z) (car w))
    (q318767-multiply real-type (cdr z) (cdr w)))
   (q318767-add
    real-type
    (q318767-multiply real-type (car z) (cdr w))
    (q318767-multiply real-type (cdr z) (car w)))))

(defun q318767-complex-norm-square (real-type z)
  (q318767-add
   real-type
   (q318767-real-square real-type (car z))
   (q318767-real-square real-type (cdr z))))

(defun q318767-complex-distance-less-p
    (real-type z w epsilon)
  (and
   (q318767-complex-p real-type z)
   (q318767-complex-p real-type w)
   (q318767-real-positive-p real-type epsilon)
   (q318767-less
    real-type
    (q318767-complex-norm-square
     real-type
     (q318767-complex-subtract real-type z w))
    (q318767-real-square real-type epsilon))))

(defun q318767-complex-power
    (real-type z exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q318767-complex-one real-type)
    (q318767-complex-multiply
     real-type
     z
     (q318767-complex-power
      real-type z (1- exponent)))))

(defun q318767-real-power
    (real-type x exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q318767-one real-type)
    (q318767-multiply
     real-type
     x
     (q318767-real-power
      real-type x (1- exponent)))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-sequence-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q318767-member-p
      real-type
      (q318767-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q318767-complex-sequence-p
    (real-type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q318767-complex-p
      real-type
      (q318767-sequence-at sequence n)))))

;; Prefix sums use exactly the indices 0,...,count-1.

(defun q318767-real-coefficient-prefix
    (real-type sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q318767-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- count)))
      (q318767-add
       real-type
       (q318767-real-coefficient-prefix
        real-type sequence index)
       (q318767-sequence-at sequence index)))))

(defun q318767-complex-coefficient-prefix
    (real-type sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q318767-complex-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- count)))
      (q318767-complex-add
       real-type
       (q318767-complex-coefficient-prefix
        real-type sequence index)
       (q318767-sequence-at sequence index)))))

(defun q318767-real-series-prefix
    (real-type sequence x count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q318767-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- count)))
      (q318767-add
       real-type
       (q318767-real-series-prefix
        real-type sequence x index)
       (q318767-multiply
        real-type
        (q318767-sequence-at sequence index)
        (q318767-real-power
         real-type x index))))))

(defun q318767-complex-series-prefix
    (real-type sequence z count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q318767-complex-zero real-type)
    (let ((index (1- count)))
      (q318767-complex-add
       real-type
       (q318767-complex-series-prefix
        real-type sequence z index)
       (q318767-complex-multiply
        real-type
        (q318767-sequence-at sequence index)
        (q318767-complex-power
         real-type z index))))))

;; Metric convergence of coefficient partial sums at the natural-number
;; filter ATTOP.

(defun-sk q318767-real-coefficient-tail-p
    (real-type sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (q318767-less
      real-type
      (q318767-real-absolute
       real-type
       (q318767-real-subtract
        real-type
        (q318767-real-coefficient-prefix
         real-type sequence count)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-coefficient-cutoff-p
    (real-type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q318767-real-coefficient-tail-p
      real-type sequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q318767-real-coefficients-converge-p
    (real-type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q318767-real-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (q318767-real-coefficient-cutoff-p
      real-type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q318767-complex-coefficient-tail-p
    (real-type sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (q318767-complex-distance-less-p
      real-type
      (q318767-complex-coefficient-prefix
       real-type sequence count)
      limit
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q318767-complex-coefficient-cutoff-p
    (real-type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q318767-complex-coefficient-tail-p
      real-type sequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q318767-complex-coefficients-converge-p
    (real-type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q318767-real-positive-p real-type epsilon)
     (q318767-complex-coefficient-cutoff-p
      real-type sequence limit epsilon))))

;; Exact convergence and totalized TSUM for the power series at a point.

(defun-sk q318767-real-series-tail-p
    (real-type sequence x limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp count)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff count))
     (q318767-less
      real-type
      (q318767-real-absolute
       real-type
       (q318767-real-subtract
        real-type

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q318767,
-- "Abel's theorem": a convergent real or complex coefficient series gives a
-- power series tending to the same sum from the real left or within any
-- positive-width complex Stolz cone at one. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q318767_abel_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

squareR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
squareR reals x =
  multiplyR reals x x

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

RealClose :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
RealClose reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x center))
    radius

sumFirstR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirstR reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirstR reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (sumFirstR reals terms n)
    (terms n)

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerR reals x n) x

RealSequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RealSequentialLimit reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      RealClose reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

RealPowerSeriesSumAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
RealPowerSeriesSumAt reals coefficients x limit =
  RealSequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirstR reals
        (\ i ->
          multiplyR reals
            (coefficients i)
            (powerR reals x i))
        n)
    limit

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals x y =
  complex
    (addR reals (realPart x) (realPart y))
    (addR reals (imaginaryPart x) (imaginaryPart y))

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals x =
  complex
    (negateR reals (realPart x))
    (negateR reals (imaginaryPart x))

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals x y =
  complexAdd reals x (complexNegate reals y)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals x y =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals (realPart x) (realPart y))
      (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart x) (imaginaryPart y)))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals (realPart x) (imaginaryPart y))
      (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart x) (realPart y)))

complexPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
complexPower reals z zero =
  complexOne reals
complexPower reals z (suc n) =
  complexMultiply reals (complexPower reals z n) z

complexNormSquared :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
complexNormSquared reals z =
  addR reals
    (squareR reals (realPart z))
    (squareR reals (imaginaryPart z))

ComplexClose :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ComplexClose reals center radius z =
  StrictLess reals
    (complexNormSquared reals (complexSubtract reals z center))
    (squareR reals radius)

sumFirstC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Nat ->
  Complex R
sumFirstC reals terms zero =
  complexZero reals
sumFirstC reals terms (suc n) =
  complexAdd reals
    (sumFirstC reals terms n)
    (terms n)

ComplexSequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ComplexSequentialLimit reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      ComplexClose reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

ComplexPowerSeriesSumAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ComplexPowerSeriesSumAt reals coefficients z limit =
  ComplexSequentialLimit reals
    (\ n ->
      sumFirstC reals
        (\ i ->
          complexMultiply reals
            (coefficients i)
            (complexPower reals z i))
        n)
    limit

StolzCone :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
StolzCone reals s z =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteR reals (imaginaryPart z))
    (multiplyR reals s
      (subtractR reals (oneR reals) (realPart z)))

ComplexPowerSeriesTendsWithinStolzCone :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  R ->
  Set
ComplexPowerSeriesTendsWithinStolzCone {R = R}
  reals coefficients limit s =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((z : Complex R) ->
          StolzCone reals s z ->
          ComplexClose reals (complexOne reals) delta z ->
          Exists (Complex R)
            (\ value ->
              Both
                (ComplexPowerSeriesSumAt reals coefficients z value)
                (ComplexClose reals limit epsilon value))))

RealPowerSeriesTendsFromLeft :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RealPowerSeriesTendsFromLeft {R = R} reals coefficients limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((x : R) ->
          StrictLess reals x (oneR reals) ->
          RealClose reals (oneR reals) delta x ->
          Exists R
            (\ value ->
              Both
                (RealPowerSeriesSumAt reals coefficients x value)
                (RealClose reals limit epsilon value))))

complex-tendsto-tsum-power-series-within-stolz-cone : Set1
complex-tendsto-tsum-power-series-within-stolz-cone =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (coefficients : Nat -> Complex R) ->
  (limit : Complex R) ->
  ComplexSequentialLimit reals
    (\ n -> sumFirstC reals coefficients n)
    limit ->
  (s : R) ->
  Positive reals s ->
  ComplexPowerSeriesTendsWithinStolzCone
    reals coefficients limit s

real-tendsto-tsum-power-series-within-left : Set1
real-tendsto-tsum-power-series-within-left =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (coefficients : Nat -> R) ->
  (limit : R) ->
  RealSequentialLimit reals
    (\ n -> sumFirstR reals coefficients n)
    limit ->
  RealPowerSeriesTendsFromLeft reals coefficients limit

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q318767 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q318767), "Abel's theorem": a power
  series whose coefficient series converges at 1 tends to that sum within
  every positive Stolz cone, with the corresponding real left-limit
  statement. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val q318767_complex_partial_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_complex_partial_sum_def",
  ``q318767_complex_partial_sum (f : num -> complex) n =
      ITSET (\i acc. f i + acc) (count n) (0 : complex)``);

val q318767_real_partial_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_real_partial_sum_def",
  ``q318767_real_partial_sum (f : num -> real) n =
      ITSET (\i acc. f i + acc) (count n) (0 : real)``);

val q318767_complex_tendsto_seq_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_complex_tendsto_seq_def",
  ``q318767_complex_tendsto_seq (u : num -> complex) (l : complex) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> modu (u n - l) < epsilon``);

val q318767_real_tendsto_seq_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_real_tendsto_seq_def",
  ``q318767_real_tendsto_seq (u : num -> real) (l : real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> abs (u n - l) < epsilon``);

val q318767_complex_tsum_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_complex_tsum_def",
  ``q318767_complex_tsum (f : num -> complex) =
      if ?l : complex.
           q318767_complex_tendsto_seq
             (q318767_complex_partial_sum f) l
      then
        @l : complex.
          q318767_complex_tendsto_seq
            (q318767_complex_partial_sum f) l
      else 0``);

val q318767_real_tsum_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_real_tsum_def",
  ``q318767_real_tsum (f : num -> real) =
      if ?l : real.
           q318767_real_tendsto_seq
             (q318767_real_partial_sum f) l
      then
        @l : real.
          q318767_real_tendsto_seq
            (q318767_real_partial_sum f) l
      else 0``);

val q318767_stolz_cone_def = new_definition (
  "q318767_stolz_cone_def",
  ``q318767_stolz_cone (s : real) (z : complex) <=>
      abs (IM z) < s * (1 - RE z)``);

val Complex_tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_stolzCone =
  ``!(f : num -> complex) (l : complex) (s : real).
      q318767_complex_tendsto_seq
        (q318767_complex_partial_sum f) l /\
      0 < s
      ==>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !z : complex.
            q318767_stolz_cone s z /\
            modu (z - 1) < delta
            ==>
            modu
              (q318767_complex_tsum
                 (\n. f n * z pow n) -
               l) < epsilon``;

val Real_tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt =
  ``!(f : num -> real) (l : real).
      q318767_real_tendsto_seq
        (q318767_real_partial_sum f) l
      ==>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !x : real.
            x < 1 /\
            abs (x - 1) < delta
            ==>
            abs

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q318767
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q318767), "Abel's theorem": convergence of
  the coefficient partial sums implies that the associated complex power
  series tends to the same limit as its argument approaches one within every
  positive-width Stolz cone; for real coefficients, the power series tends
  to that limit as its argument approaches one from the left. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q318767Partial is the sum of F(i) over i in {0, ..., M - 1}, matching the
  finite range sum in the Lean hypotheses. Q318767Power is the infinite sum
  of F(n) Z^n. Q318767CoeffLimit gives the epsilon form of convergence of the
  partial sums at infinity.

  Q318767ComplexLimit is the epsilon-delta form of convergence relative to
  the Stolz cone |Im(z)| < S (1 - Re(z)). Q318767RealLimit is the analogous
  relative limit on the real half-line x < 1. Thus the two final assertions
  render respectively the complex theorem and its real left-limit
  specialization from the Lean source. They are unproved $a assertions and
  this file has no $p statement.

  SetMM's unbounded sum denotes the series limit when it converges and the
  empty set otherwise, while Lean's tsum is totalized. Under
  Q318767CoeffLimit the coefficients are bounded, so Q318767Power converges
  whenever |Z| < 1. A sufficiently small neighborhood of 1 inside either a
  positive-width Stolz cone or the real set x < 1 lies in that unit disk, so
  the nonconvergent branch is never observed by the limit assertions.
$)

$c
  Q318767Partial
  Q318767Power
  Q318767CoeffLimit
  Q318767ComplexLimit
  Q318767RealLimit
$.

q318767-partial-syntax $a class ( Q318767Partial F M ) $.
q318767-power-syntax $a class ( Q318767Power F Z ) $.
q318767-coeff-limit-syntax $a wff ( Q318767CoeffLimit F L ) $.
q318767-complex-limit-syntax $a wff ( Q318767ComplexLimit F L S ) $.
q318767-real-limit-syntax $a wff ( Q318767RealLimit F L ) $.

${
  $d F M n $.

  q318767-partial-definition $a |- ( Q318767Partial F M ) =
    sum_ n e. ( 0 ..^ M ) ( F ` n )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F Z n $.

  q318767-power-definition $a |- ( Q318767Power F Z ) =
    sum_ n e. NN0 ( ( F ` n ) x. ( Z ^ n ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F L M N e $.

  q318767-coeff-limit-definition $a |- (
    ( Q318767CoeffLimit F L )
    <->
    A. e e. RR+
      E. N e. NN0
        A. M e. ( ZZ>= ` N )
          ( abs ` ( ( Q318767Partial F M ) - L ) ) < e
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L S d e z $.

  q318767-complex-limit-definition $a |- (
    ( Q318767ComplexLimit F L S )
    <->
    A. e e. RR+
      E. d e. RR+
        A. z e. CC
          (
            (
              ( abs ` ( Im ` z ) ) < ( S x. ( 1 - ( Re ` z ) ) )
              /\
              ( abs ` ( z - 1 ) ) < d
            )
            ->
            ( abs ` ( ( Q318767Power F z ) - L ) ) < e
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L d e x $.

  q318767-real-limit-definition $a |- (
    ( Q318767RealLimit F L )
    <->
    A. e e. RR+
      E. d e. RR+
        A. x e. RR
          (
            (
              x < 1
              /\
              ( abs ` ( x - 1 ) ) < d
            )
            ->
            ( abs ` ( ( Q318767Power F x ) - L ) ) < e
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F L S $.

  thousand-theorems-q318767-complex-abel $a |-
    A. F e. ( CC ^m NN0 )
      A. L e. CC
        A. S e. RR
          (
            (
              ( Q318767CoeffLimit F L )
              /\
              0 < S
            )
            ->
            ( Q318767ComplexLimit F L S )
          )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F L $.

  thousand-theorems-q318767-real-abel $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      A. L e. RR
        (
          ( Q318767CoeffLimit F L )
          ->
          ( Q318767RealLimit F L )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q318767_abel_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q318767,
% "Abel's theorem": convergent coefficient sums determine the boundary limit of
% real power series from the left and complex power series within Stolz cones.
% This file contains no proof.

Q318767_abel_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> complex]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_power(z: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(z, exponent - 1), z)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  complex_distance_squared(x, y: complex): real =
    (real_part(x) - real_part(y)) ^ 2
      + (imag_part(x) - imag_part(y)) ^ 2

  complex_coefficient_partial_sum(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      complex_add(
        complex_coefficient_partial_sum(coefficients, count - 1),
        coefficients(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  complex_power_series_partial_sum(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          complex_power_series_partial_sum(
            coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            coefficients(index),
            complex_power(z, index)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_complex(
      sequence: complex_sequence,
      value: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            complex_distance_squared(sequence(index), value)
              < epsilon_value ^ 2

  complex_series_sum(sequence: complex_sequence): complex =
    IF EXISTS (value: complex):
         converges_to_complex(sequence, value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: complex):
          converges_to_complex(sequence, value))
    ELSE
      complex_zero
    ENDIF

  complex_power_series_value(
      coefficients: complex_sequence,
      z: complex): complex =
    complex_series_sum(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        complex_power_series_partial_sum(
          coefficients, z, count))

  in_stolz_cone(z: complex, aperture: real): bool =
    abs(imag_part(z))
      < aperture * (1 - real_part(z))

  tends_to_within_stolz_cone(
      function_value: [complex -> complex],
      limit_value: complex,
      aperture: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (z: complex):
          (in_stolz_cone(z, aperture)
            AND complex_distance_squared(z, complex_one)
              < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            complex_distance_squared(
              function_value(z), limit_value)
                < epsilon_value ^ 2

  complex_abel_stolz_cone: bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: complex_sequence),
        (limit_value: complex),
        (aperture: real):
      (converges_to_complex(
          (LAMBDA (count: nat):
            complex_coefficient_partial_sum(
              coefficients, count)),
          limit_value)
        AND 0 < aperture)
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_within_stolz_cone(
          (LAMBDA (z: complex):
            complex_power_series_value(coefficients, z)),
          limit_value,
          aperture)

  real_coefficient_partial_sum(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      real_coefficient_partial_sum(coefficients, count - 1)
        + coefficients(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_power_series_partial_sum(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        real_power_series_partial_sum(
          coefficients, x, count - 1)
          + coefficients(index) * x ^ index
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      sequence: real_sequence,
      value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_series_sum(sequence: real_sequence): real =
    IF EXISTS (value: real):
         converges_to_real(sequence, value)
    THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          converges_to_real(sequence, value))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power_series_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      x: real): real =
    real_series_sum(
      LAMBDA (count: nat):
        real_power_series_partial_sum(coefficients, x, count))

  tends_to_from_left(
      function_value: [real -> real],
      limit_value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (x: real):
          (x < 1 AND abs(x - 1) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(function_value(x) - limit_value)
              < epsilon_value

  real_abel_from_left: bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (limit_value: real):
      converges_to_real(
        (LAMBDA (count: nat):
          real_coefficient_partial_sum(
            coefficients, count)),
        limit_value)
      IMPLIES
        tends_to_from_left(
          (LAMBDA (x: real):
            real_power_series_value(coefficients, x)),
          limit_value)
END Q318767_abel_s_theorem
