title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3229335
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3229335), "Borel–Carathéodory theorem": an
  analytic complex-valued function on a disk whose real part is bounded above
  satisfies the Borel–Carathéodory pointwise norm estimate. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3229335_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q3229335_zero : q3229335_complex := (0, 0).

Definition q3229335_add
    (z w : q3229335_complex) : q3229335_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q3229335_neg
    (z : q3229335_complex) : q3229335_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q3229335_sub
    (z w : q3229335_complex) : q3229335_complex :=
  q3229335_add z (q3229335_neg w).

Definition q3229335_mul
    (z w : q3229335_complex) : q3229335_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q3229335_norm_sq
    (z : q3229335_complex) : R :=
  fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z.

Definition q3229335_norm
    (z : q3229335_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (q3229335_norm_sq z).

Definition q3229335_open_ball_zero
    (radius : R) (z : q3229335_complex) : Prop :=
  q3229335_norm z < radius.

Definition q3229335_has_complex_derivative_within_ball_at
    (f : q3229335_complex -> q3229335_complex)
    (radius : R)
    (z derivative : q3229335_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q3229335_complex,
        q3229335_open_ball_zero radius w ->
        q3229335_norm (q3229335_sub w z) < delta ->
        q3229335_norm
          (q3229335_sub
            (q3229335_sub (f w) (f z))
            (q3229335_mul derivative (q3229335_sub w z)))
        <= epsilon * q3229335_norm (q3229335_sub w z).

Definition q3229335_differentiable_on_ball
    (f : q3229335_complex -> q3229335_complex)
    (radius : R) : Prop :=
  forall z : q3229335_complex,
    q3229335_open_ball_zero radius z ->
    exists derivative : q3229335_complex,
      q3229335_has_complex_derivative_within_ball_at
        f radius z derivative.

Definition q3229335_maps_real_part_below
    (f : q3229335_complex -> q3229335_complex)
    (radius bound : R) : Prop :=
  forall z : q3229335_complex,
    q3229335_open_ball_zero radius z ->
    fst (f z) <= bound.

Theorem Complex_borelCaratheodory :
  forall (f : q3229335_complex -> q3229335_complex)
         (M R0 : R)
         (z : q3229335_complex),
    0 < M ->
    q3229335_differentiable_on_ball f R0 ->
    q3229335_maps_real_part_below f R0 M ->
    0 < R0 ->
    q3229335_open_ball_zero R0 z ->
    q3229335_norm (f z) <=
      2 * M * q3229335_norm z / (R0 - q3229335_norm z) +
      q3229335_norm (f q3229335_zero) *
        (R0 + q3229335_norm z) / (R0 - q3229335_norm z).
Admitted.

title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3229335 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3229335),
  "Borel–Carathéodory theorem": for positive real M and positive radius R, a
  complex-differentiable function on the open disc of radius R whose real part
  is bounded above by M satisfies the Borel–Carathéodory norm estimate at every
  point of the disc. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complex_Analysis_Basics"
begin

theorem q3229335_borel_caratheodory:
  fixes f :: "complex \<Rightarrow> complex"
    and M R :: real
    and z :: complex
  assumes positive_bound: "0 < M"
    and differentiable: "f holomorphic_on ball 0 R"
    and real_part_bound: "\<forall>w \<in> ball 0 R. Re (f w) \<le> M"
    and positive_radius: "0 < R"
    and point_in_disc: "z \<in> ball 0 R"
  shows
    "norm (f z) \<le>
      2 * M * norm z / (R - norm z) +
      norm (f 0) * (R + norm z) / (R - norm z)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3229335
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3229335), "Borel–Carathéodory theorem": a
  complex-differentiable function on an open ball centered at zero whose real
  part is bounded above by a positive constant satisfies the
  Borel–Carathéodory norm estimate at every point of the ball. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q3229335_BOREL_CARATHEODORY_THEOREM =
 `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cadd =
    \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
      (FST x + FST y,SND x + SND y) in
  let csub =
    \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
      (FST x - FST y,SND x - SND y) in
  let cmul =
    \(x:real#real) (y:real#real).
      (FST x * FST y - SND x * SND y,
       FST x * SND y + SND x * FST y) in
  let cnorm =
    \(x:real#real).
      sqrt(FST x * FST x + SND x * SND x) in
  let open_ball_zero =
    \(R:real) (x:real#real).
      cnorm x < R in
  let complex_differentiable_at =
    \(f:(real#real)->real#real) (x:real#real).
      ?d:real#real.
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !h:real#real.
                  cnorm h < delta
                  ==> cnorm
                        (csub
                          (csub (f (cadd x h)) (f x))
                          (cmul d h))
                      <= epsilon * cnorm h in
  let complex_differentiable_on_open_ball =
    \(f:(real#real)->real#real) (R:real).
      !x:real#real.
        open_ball_zero R x
        ==> complex_differentiable_at f x in
  !(f:(real#real)->real#real) (M:real) (R:real) (z:real#real).
    &0 < M /\
    complex_differentiable_on_open_ball f R /\
    (!x:real#real. open_ball_zero R x ==> FST(f x) <= M) /\
    &0 < R /\
    open_ball_zero R z
    ==> cnorm(f z)
        <= &2 * M * cnorm z / (R - cnorm z) +
           cnorm(f czero) * (R + cnorm z) / (R - cnorm z)`;;

      (q3229335-r-member-p real y)
      (q3229335-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q3229335-r-zero real))
            (one (q3229335-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q3229335-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q3229335-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q3229335-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q3229335-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q3229335-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q3229335-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q3229335-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q3229335-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q3229335-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q3229335-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q3229335-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q3229335-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3229335-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q3229335-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q3229335-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q3229335-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q3229335-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q3229335-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q3229335-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q3229335-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3229335-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3229335-r-multiply
          real x (q3229335-r-add real y z))
         (q3229335-r-add
          real
          (q3229335-r-multiply real x y)
          (q3229335-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229335-r-member-p real x)
      (q3229335-r-member-p real y)
      (q3229335-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q3229335-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q3229335-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q3229335-r-less real x y)
         (q3229335-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3229335-r-less real x y)
          (q3229335-r-less real y z))
         (q3229335-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q3229335-r-less real x y)
         (q3229335-r-less
          real
          (q3229335-r-add real x z)
          (q3229335-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3229335-r-less real zero x)
          (q3229335-r-less real zero y))
         (q3229335-r-less
          real zero
          (q3229335-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q3229335-r-member-p real x)
     (q3229335-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229335-r-member-p real x)
      (q3229335-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q3229335-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3229335-r-member-p real bound)
     (q3229335-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q3229335-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q3229335-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3229335-r-member-p real bound)
       (q3229335-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q3229335-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q3229335-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3229335-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229335-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q3229335-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q3229335-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q3229335-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q3229335-r-zero real))
        (one (q3229335-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q3229335-r-member-p real zero)
     (q3229335-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q3229335-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q3229335-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q3229335-r-less real zero one)
     (q3229335-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; The nonnegative square root and the standard complex field represented by
;; real/imaginary coordinate pairs.

(defstub q3229335-r-square-root (real square-root value) t)

(defun-sk q3229335-r-square-root-laws-p
    (real square-root)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229335-r-member-p real x)
      (q3229335-r-leq
       real (q3229335-r-zero real) x))

            (q3229335-r-square-root
             real square-root x)))

        (q3229335-r-member-p real root)
        (q3229335-r-leq
         real (q3229335-r-zero real) root)
        (equal
         (q3229335-r-multiply real root root)
         x))))))

(defun q3229335-complex-p (real value)
  (and
   (consp value)
   (q3229335-r-member-p real (car value))
   (q3229335-r-member-p real (cdr value))))

(defun q3229335-c-zero (real)
  (cons
   (q3229335-r-zero real)
   (q3229335-r-zero real)))

(defun q3229335-c-add (real left right)
  (cons
   (q3229335-r-add real (car left) (car right))
   (q3229335-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun q3229335-c-negate (real value)
  (cons
   (q3229335-r-negate real (car value))
   (q3229335-r-negate real (cdr value))))

(defun q3229335-c-subtract (real left right)
  (q3229335-c-add
   real left (q3229335-c-negate real right)))

(defun q3229335-c-multiply (real left right)
  (cons
   (q3229335-r-subtract
    real
    (q3229335-r-multiply
     real (car left) (car right))
    (q3229335-r-multiply
     real (cdr left) (cdr right)))
   (q3229335-r-add
    real
    (q3229335-r-multiply
     real (car left) (cdr right))
    (q3229335-r-multiply
     real (cdr left) (car right)))))

(defun q3229335-c-norm-square (real value)
  (q3229335-r-add
   real
   (q3229335-r-multiply
    real (car value) (car value))
   (q3229335-r-multiply
    real (cdr value) (cdr value))))

(defun q3229335-c-norm (real square-root value)
  (q3229335-r-square-root
   real square-root
   (q3229335-c-norm-square real value)))

(defun q3229335-c-distance
    (real square-root left right)
  (q3229335-c-norm
   real square-root
   (q3229335-c-subtract real left right)))

;; Arbitrary total functions C -> C and the source open ball centered at zero.

(defstub q3229335-function-value (function argument) t)

(defun-sk q3229335-function-typed-p (real function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3229335-complex-p real x)
     (q3229335-complex-p
      real (q3229335-function-value function x)))))

(defun q3229335-open-ball-member-p
    (real square-root radius x)
  (and
   (q3229335-complex-p real x)
   (q3229335-r-less
    real
    (q3229335-c-norm real square-root x)
    radius)))

;; This is exactly MapsTo f (ball 0 R) {w | w.re <= M}.

(defun-sk q3229335-real-part-bounded-on-ball-p
    (real square-root function radius bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3229335-open-ball-member-p
      real square-root radius x)
     (q3229335-r-leq
      real
      (car (q3229335-function-value function x))
      bound))))

;; Complex Frechet differentiability within the open ball. For C -> C, every
;; complex-linear derivative is multiplication by one complex number. The
;; epsilon-delta remainder condition is the standard equivalent definition of
;; HasFDerivWithinAt, with the within-ball quantifier retained.

(defun-sk q3229335-derivative-within-radius-p
    (real square-root function ball-radius point
          derivative epsilon delta)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229335-open-ball-member-p
       real square-root ball-radius y)
      (q3229335-r-less
       real
       (q3229335-c-distance
        real square-root y point)
       delta))
     (let* ((increment
             (q3229335-c-subtract real y point))
            (remainder
             (q3229335-c-subtract
              real
              (q3229335-c-subtract
               real
               (q3229335-function-value function y)
               (q3229335-function-value function point))
              (q3229335-c-multiply
               real derivative increment))))
       (q3229335-r-leq
        real
        (q3229335-c-norm
         real square-root remainder)
        (q3229335-r-multiply
         real epsilon
         (q3229335-c-norm
          real square-root increment)))))))

(defun-sk q3229335-derivative-within-delta-exists-p
    (real square-root function ball-radius point
          derivative epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q3229335-r-positive-p real delta)
     (q3229335-derivative-within-radius-p
      real square-root function ball-radius point
      derivative epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q3229335-has-derivative-within-at-p
    (real square-root function ball-radius point derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q3229335-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q3229335-derivative-within-delta-exists-p
      real square-root function ball-radius point
      derivative epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3229335-differentiable-within-at-p
    (real square-root function ball-radius point)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (q3229335-complex-p real derivative)
     (q3229335-has-derivative-within-at-p
      real square-root function ball-radius point derivative))))

(defun-sk q3229335-differentiable-on-ball-p
    (real square-root function radius)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q3229335-open-ball-member-p
      real square-root radius point)
     (q3229335-differentiable-within-at-p
      real square-root function radius point))))

(defun q3229335-bound-right-hand-side
    (real square-root function radius bound z)
  (let* ((norm-z
          (q3229335-c-norm real square-root z))
         (denominator
          (q3229335-r-subtract real radius norm-z))
         (first-numerator
          (q3229335-r-multiply
           real
           (q3229335-r-multiply
            real
            (q3229335-r-two real)
            bound)
           norm-z))
         (second-numerator
          (q3229335-r-multiply
           real
           (q3229335-c-norm
            real square-root
            (q3229335-function-value
             function (q3229335-c-zero real)))
           (q3229335-r-add real radius norm-z))))
    (q3229335-r-add
     real
     (q3229335-r-divide
      real first-numerator denominator)
     (q3229335-r-divide
      real second-numerator denominator))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q3229335-borel-caratheodory-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (real square-root function bound radius z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229335-real-field-p real)
      (q3229335-r-square-root-laws-p
       real square-root)
      (q3229335-function-typed-p real function)
      (q3229335-r-positive-p real bound)
      (q3229335-r-positive-p real radius)
      (q3229335-complex-p real z)
      (q3229335-differentiable-on-ball-p
       real square-root function radius)
      (q3229335-real-part-bounded-on-ball-p
       real square-root function radius bound)
      (q3229335-open-ball-member-p
       real square-root radius z))
     (q3229335-r-leq
      real
      (q3229335-c-norm

title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3229335,
-- "Borel–Carathéodory theorem": a holomorphic complex function on a ball whose
-- real part is bounded above satisfies the canonical interior norm estimate.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

twoR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
twoR reals =
  fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

zeroC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
subtractC reals z w =
  addC reals z (negateC reals w)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

record ComplexNorm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    normC : Complex R -> R
    norm-nonnegativeC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normC z)
    norm-zeroC :
      normC (zeroC reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC z == zeroR reals ->
      z == zeroC reals
    norm-negateC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC (negateC reals z) == normC z
    norm-addC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normC (addC reals z w))
        (addR reals (normC z) (normC w))
    norm-multiplyC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      normC (multiplyC reals z w) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC w)
    norm-squareC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexNorm

SetOf : Set -> Set1
SetOf A =
  A -> Set

OpenBallAtZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ComplexNorm reals ->
  R ->
  SetOf (Complex R)
OpenBallAtZero reals complexNorm radius z =
  StrictLess reals (normC complexNorm z) radius

DerivativeRemainder :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
DerivativeRemainder reals f derivative point y =
  subtractC reals
    (subtractC reals (f y) (f point))
    (multiplyC reals
      (subtractC reals y point)
      derivative)

HasComplexDerivativeWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
HasComplexDerivativeWithinAt {R = R}
  reals complexNorm f U point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((y : Complex R) ->
          U y ->
          StrictLess reals
            (normC complexNorm (subtractC reals y point))
            delta ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normC complexNorm
              (DerivativeRemainder
                reals f derivative point y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (normC complexNorm
                (subtractC reals y point)))))

DifferentiableWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithinAt
  reals complexNorm f U point =
  Exists (Complex _)
    (HasComplexDerivativeWithinAt
      reals complexNorm f U point)

DifferentiableOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  Set
DifferentiableOn {R = R}
  reals complexNorm f U =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  U point ->
  DifferentiableWithinAt
    reals complexNorm f U point

MapsRealPartAtMost :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  SetOf (Complex R) ->
  R ->
  Set
MapsRealPartAtMost {R = R} reals f U bound =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  U point ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (realPart (f point)) bound

BorelCaratheodoryBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ComplexNorm reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  (Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  Complex R ->
  R
BorelCaratheodoryBound reals complexNorm bound radius f z =
  addR reals
    (divideR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (multiplyR reals (twoR reals) bound)
        (normC complexNorm z))
      (subtractR reals radius (normC complexNorm z)))
    (divideR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (normC complexNorm (f (zeroC reals)))
        (addR reals radius (normC complexNorm z)))
      (subtractR reals radius (normC complexNorm z)))

borel-caratheodory-theorem : Set1
borel-caratheodory-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (f : Complex R -> Complex R) ->
  (bound radius : R) ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  Positive reals bound ->
  DifferentiableOn reals complexNorm f
    (OpenBallAtZero reals complexNorm radius) ->
  MapsRealPartAtMost reals f
    (OpenBallAtZero reals complexNorm radius)
    bound ->
  Positive reals radius ->
  OpenBallAtZero reals complexNorm radius z ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (normC complexNorm (f z))
    (BorelCaratheodoryBound
      reals complexNorm bound radius f z)

title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3229335 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3229335), "Borel–Carathéodory theorem":
  a complex-differentiable function on an open disk whose real part is
  bounded above satisfies the Borel–Carathéodory norm estimate there.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory complexTheory;

val q3229335_in_open_disk_def = new_definition (
  "q3229335_in_open_disk_def",
  ``q3229335_in_open_disk (R : real) (z : complex) <=>
      modu z < R``);

val q3229335_complex_differentiable_on_disk_def = new_definition (
  "q3229335_complex_differentiable_on_disk_def",
  ``q3229335_complex_differentiable_on_disk
      (f : complex -> complex) (R : real) <=>
      !x : complex.
        q3229335_in_open_disk R x ==>
        ?deriv : complex.
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !h : complex.
                0 < modu h /\ modu h < delta
                ==>
                modu (f (x + h) - f x - h * deriv) <
                  epsilon * modu h``);

val q3229335_maps_real_part_below_def = new_definition (
  "q3229335_maps_real_part_below_def",
  ``q3229335_maps_real_part_below
      (f : complex -> complex) (R : real) (M : real) <=>
      !x : complex.
        q3229335_in_open_disk R x ==>
        RE (f x) <= M``);

val borelCaratheodory =
  ``!(f : complex -> complex) (M : real) (R : real) (z : complex).
      0 < M /\
      q3229335_complex_differentiable_on_disk f R /\
      q3229335_maps_real_part_below f R M /\
      0 < R /\
      q3229335_in_open_disk R z
      ==>
      modu (f z) <=
        2 * M * modu z / (R - modu z) +
        modu (f 0) * (R + modu z) / (R - modu z)``;

title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3229335
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3229335), "Borel-Caratheodory theorem":
  if 0 < M and 0 < R, a complex function differentiable on the open ball
  of radius R about zero and mapping that ball into the half-plane Re(w) <= M
  satisfies the canonical two-term norm bound at every point of the ball.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The complete canonical source proposition has arbitrary f : CC -> CC,
  M R : RR, and z : CC. Its five hypotheses are, in order, 0 < M;
  complex differentiability of f on ball(0,R); MapsTo f ball(0,R)
  { w | Re(w) <= M }; 0 < R; and z in ball(0,R). Its conclusion is

    |f(z)| <= 2*M*|z|/(R-|z|)
              + |f(0)|*(R+|z|)/(R-|z|).

  Q3229335Ball is exactly ball(0,R), the open complex ball centered at zero.
  Q3229335HasComplexDerivWithinAt is the epsilon-delta Frechet derivative
  condition within a set; in one complex dimension the derivative acts on an
  increment by complex multiplication. Q3229335DifferentiableOn quantifies
  such a derivative at every point of the ball. Q3229335RealPartBound is
  exactly the displayed MapsTo condition.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies over arbitrary total functions
  from CC to CC, real M and R, and complex z. Every preceding $a declaration
  is syntax or an explicit faithful definition; this database has no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c Q3229335Ball Q3229335HasComplexDerivWithinAt
   Q3229335DifferentiableOn Q3229335RealPartBound $.

q3229335-ball-syntax
  $a class ( Q3229335Ball R ) $.
q3229335-has-complex-deriv-within-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3229335HasComplexDerivWithinAt F S x D ) $.
q3229335-differentiable-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3229335DifferentiableOn F S ) $.
q3229335-real-part-bound-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3229335RealPartBound F R M ) $.

${
  $d R x $.

  q3229335-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q3229335Ball R
  ) = {
    x e. CC |
      ( abs ` x ) < R
  } $.
$}

${
  $d D F S d e x y $.

  q3229335-has-complex-deriv-within-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3229335HasComplexDerivWithinAt F S x D )
    <->
    (
      D e. CC
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                abs
                `
                (
                  (
                    ( F ` y )
                    -
                    ( F ` x )
                  )
                  -
                  (
                    ( y - x )
                    x.
                    D
                  )
                )
              )
              <_
              (
                e
                x.
                ( abs ` ( y - x ) )
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S d x $.

  q3229335-differentiable-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3229335DifferentiableOn F S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      E. d e. CC
        ( Q3229335HasComplexDerivWithinAt F S x d )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F M R x $.

  q3229335-real-part-bound-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3229335RealPartBound F R M )
    <->
    A. x e. ( Q3229335Ball R )
      ( Re ` ( F ` x ) ) <_ M
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d f m r z $.

  thousand-theorems-q3229335-borel-caratheodory $a |-
    A. f e. ( CC ^m CC )
      A. m e. RR
        A. r e. RR
          A. z e. CC
            (
              (
                0 < m
                /\
                (
                  ( Q3229335DifferentiableOn
                    f
                    ( Q3229335Ball r )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q3229335RealPartBound f r m )
                    /\
                    (
                      0 < r
                      /\
                      z e. ( Q3229335Ball r )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
              ->
              (
                ( abs ` ( f ` z ) )
                <_
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( 2 x. m )
                      x.
                      ( abs ` z )
                    )
                    /
                    (
                      r
                      -
                      ( abs ` z )
                    )
                  )
                  +
                  (
                    (
                      ( abs ` ( f ` 0 ) )
                      x.
                      (
                        r
                        +
                        ( abs ` z )
                      )
                    )
                    /
                    (
                      r
                      -
                      ( abs ` z )
                    )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
  $.
$}

title: Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3229335
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q3229335), "Borel–Carathéodory theorem": an analytic
% complex function whose real part is bounded on an open disc satisfies the
% classical interior norm bound. This file contains no proof.

Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> complex]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(x) * real_part(y)
           - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
           + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_norm_squared(x: complex): real =
    real_part(x) ^ 2 + imag_part(x) ^ 2

  complex_norm(x: complex): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        0 <= value
          AND value ^ 2 = complex_norm_squared(x))

  in_open_ball_zero(x: complex, radius: real): bool =
    complex_norm(x) < radius

  has_complex_derivative_at(
      f: complex_function,
      derivative: complex,
      point: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: complex):
          (y /= point
            AND complex_norm(complex_sub(y, point)) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            complex_norm(
              complex_sub(
                complex_sub(f(y), f(point)),
                complex_mul(
                  derivative,
                  complex_sub(y, point))))
              < epsilon_value
                  * complex_norm(complex_sub(y, point))

  complex_differentiable_at(
      f: complex_function,
      point: complex): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: complex):
      has_complex_derivative_at(f, derivative, point)

  complex_differentiable_on_open_ball(
      f: complex_function,
      radius: real): bool =
    FORALL (point: complex):
      in_open_ball_zero(point, radius)
        IMPLIES complex_differentiable_at(f, point)

  real_part_bounded_on_open_ball(
      f: complex_function,
      radius, bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (point: complex):
      in_open_ball_zero(point, radius)
        IMPLIES real_part(f(point)) <= bound

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  borel_caratheodory_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (f: complex_function),
        (M, R: real),
        (z: complex):
      (0 < M
        AND complex_differentiable_on_open_ball(f, R)
        AND real_part_bounded_on_open_ball(f, R, M)
        AND 0 < R
        AND in_open_ball_zero(z, R))
      IMPLIES
        complex_norm(f(z))
          <= safe_div(
               2 * M * complex_norm(z),
               R - complex_norm(z))
             + safe_div(
                 complex_norm(f(complex_zero))
                   * (R + complex_norm(z)),
                 R - complex_norm(z))
END Q3229335_borel_caratheodory_theorem

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3229352
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3229352), "Vitali covering theorem": a fine
-- family of closed sets satisfying a uniform measure comparison has a
-- countable disjoint subfamily covering the given set almost everywhere.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Covering.VitaliFamily
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Pairwise.Lattice

@[expose] public section

variable {α ι : Type*}

open Set Metric MeasureTheory TopologicalSpace Filter
open scoped NNReal ENNReal Topology

namespace Q3229352

/-- The measurable Vitali covering theorem. -/
theorem vitali_covering_theorem
    [PseudoMetricSpace α] [MeasurableSpace α] [OpensMeasurableSpace α]
    [SecondCountableTopology α] (μ : Measure α) [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ]
    (s : Set α) (t : Set ι) (C : ℝ≥0) (r : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → α)
    (B : ι → Set α) (hB : ∀ a ∈ t, B a ⊆ closedBall (c a) (r a))
    (μB : ∀ a ∈ t, μ (closedBall (c a) (3 * r a)) ≤ C * μ (B a))
    (ht : ∀ a ∈ t, (interior (B a)).Nonempty)
    (h't : ∀ a ∈ t, IsClosed (B a))
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ a ∈ t, r a ≤ ε ∧ c a = x) :
    ∃ u ⊆ t, u.Countable ∧ u.PairwiseDisjoint B ∧
      μ (s \ ⋃ a ∈ u, B a) = 0 := sorry

end Q3229352

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3229352
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3229352), "Vitali covering theorem": a fine
  family of closed sets in a second-countable pseudo-metric measure space,
  satisfying a uniform measure bound on triple-radius closed balls, has a
  countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily covering the given set up to a null
  set. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3229352_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q3229352_empty {A : Type} : q3229352_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q3229352_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q3229352_set A) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q3229352_intersection {A : Type}
    (E F : q3229352_set A) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ F x.

Definition q3229352_difference {A : Type}
    (E F : q3229352_set A) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => E x /\ ~ F x.

Definition q3229352_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q3229352_set A) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q3229352_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q3229352_subset {A : Type}
    (E F : q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x -> F x.

Definition q3229352_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q3229352_pairwise_disjoint_sequence {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q3229352_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q3229352_ennreal : Type :=
| q3229352_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q3229352_ennreal
| q3229352_ennreal_infinity : q3229352_ennreal.

Arguments q3229352_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q3229352_ennreal_zero : q3229352_ennreal :=
  q3229352_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q3229352_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q3229352_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3229352_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3229352_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q3229352_ennreal_infinity,
    q3229352_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q3229352_ennreal_le
    (x y : q3229352_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3229352_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3229352_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q3229352_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q3229352_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q3229352_ennreal_infinity,
    q3229352_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q3229352_ennreal_infinity,
    q3229352_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q3229352_ennreal_add
    (x y : q3229352_ennreal) : q3229352_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q3229352_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q3229352_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q3229352_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q3229352_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q3229352_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q3229352_ennreal) : q3229352_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q3229352_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q3229352_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q3229352_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q3229352_ennreal_finite a _, q3229352_ennreal_infinity
  | q3229352_ennreal_infinity, q3229352_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q3229352_ennreal_zero
      else q3229352_ennreal_infinity
  | q3229352_ennreal_infinity, q3229352_ennreal_infinity =>
      q3229352_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q3229352_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q3229352_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q3229352_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q3229352_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q3229352_ennreal_add
        (q3229352_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q3229352_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q3229352_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q3229352_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q3229352_ennreal,
      values value -> q3229352_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q3229352_ennreal,
      (forall value : q3229352_ennreal,
        values value -> q3229352_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q3229352_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q3229352_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q3229352_ennreal)
    (sum : q3229352_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q3229352_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q3229352_ennreal_eq value
          (q3229352_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q3229352_nnreal : Type := {
  q3229352_nnreal_value : R;
  q3229352_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q3229352_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q3229352_ennreal_of_nnreal
    (x : q3229352_nnreal) : q3229352_ennreal :=
  q3229352_ennreal_finite
    (q3229352_nnreal_value x)
    (q3229352_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Record q3229352_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3229352_measurable : q3229352_set A -> Prop;
  q3229352_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q3229352_set A,
      q3229352_same_set E F ->
      (q3229352_measurable E <-> q3229352_measurable F);
  q3229352_measurable_empty :
    q3229352_measurable q3229352_empty;
  q3229352_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q3229352_set A,
      q3229352_measurable E ->
      q3229352_measurable (q3229352_complement E);
  q3229352_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q3229352_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q3229352_measurable (E n)) ->
      q3229352_measurable (q3229352_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q3229352_measurable {A} _ _.

Record q3229352_measure (A : Type)
    (m : q3229352_measurable_space A) : Type := {
  q3229352_measure_value : q3229352_set A -> q3229352_ennreal;
  q3229352_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q3229352_set A,
      q3229352_same_set E F ->
      q3229352_ennreal_eq
        (q3229352_measure_value E)
        (q3229352_measure_value F);
  q3229352_measure_empty :
    q3229352_ennreal_eq
      (q3229352_measure_value q3229352_empty)
      q3229352_ennreal_zero;
  q3229352_measure_monotone :
    forall E F : q3229352_set A,
      q3229352_subset E F ->
      q3229352_ennreal_le
        (q3229352_measure_value E)
        (q3229352_measure_value F);
  q3229352_measure_trim :
    forall E : q3229352_set A,
      exists F : q3229352_set A,
        q3229352_measurable m F /\
        q3229352_subset E F /\
        q3229352_ennreal_eq
          (q3229352_measure_value F)
          (q3229352_measure_value E);
  q3229352_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall E : nat -> q3229352_set A,
      exists total : q3229352_ennreal,
        q3229352_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q3229352_measure_value (E n)) total /\
        q3229352_ennreal_le
          (q3229352_measure_value (q3229352_countable_union E))
          total;
  q3229352_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q3229352_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q3229352_measurable m (E n)) ->
      q3229352_pairwise_disjoint_sequence E ->
      q3229352_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q3229352_measure_value (E n))
        (q3229352_measure_value (q3229352_countable_union E));
  q3229352_measure_caratheodory :
    forall E S : q3229352_set A,
      q3229352_measurable m E ->
      q3229352_ennreal_eq
        (q3229352_measure_value S)
        (q3229352_ennreal_add
          (q3229352_measure_value (q3229352_intersection S E))
          (q3229352_measure_value (q3229352_difference S E)))
}.

Arguments q3229352_measure_value {A m} _ _.

Record q3229352_pseudo_metric_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3229352_dist : A -> A -> R;
  q3229352_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : A, 0 <= q3229352_dist x y;
  q3229352_dist_self :
    forall x : A, q3229352_dist x x = 0;
  q3229352_dist_comm :
    forall x y : A, q3229352_dist x y = q3229352_dist y x;
  q3229352_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : A,
      q3229352_dist x z <=
      q3229352_dist x y + q3229352_dist y z
}.

Arguments q3229352_dist {A} _ _ _.

Definition q3229352_open_ball {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => q3229352_dist d x center < radius.

Definition q3229352_closed_ball {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (center : A) (radius : R) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => q3229352_dist d x center <= radius.

Definition q3229352_is_open {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (E : q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    E x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      q3229352_subset (q3229352_open_ball d x epsilon) E.

Definition q3229352_is_closed {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (E : q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  q3229352_is_open d (q3229352_complement E).

Definition q3229352_interior {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (E : q3229352_set A) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x =>
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      q3229352_subset (q3229352_open_ball d x epsilon) E.

Definition q3229352_opens_measurable {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (m : q3229352_measurable_space A) : Prop :=
  forall E : q3229352_set A,
    q3229352_is_open d E ->
    q3229352_measurable m E.

Definition q3229352_second_countable {A : Type}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q3229352_set A,
    (forall n : nat, q3229352_is_open d (basis n)) /\
    forall (E : q3229352_set A) (x : A),
      q3229352_is_open d E ->
      E x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\ q3229352_subset (basis n) E.

Definition q3229352_locally_finite_measure {A : Type}
    {m : q3229352_measurable_space A}
    (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space A)
    (mu : q3229352_measure m) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    exists E : q3229352_set A,
      q3229352_is_open d E /\
      E x /\
      ~ q3229352_ennreal_eq
          (q3229352_measure_value mu E)
          q3229352_ennreal_infinity.

Definition q3229352_countable_set {A : Type}
    (E : q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  exists code : A -> nat,
    forall x y : A,
      E x ->
      E y ->
      code x = code y ->
      x = y.

Definition q3229352_pairwise_disjoint_family {I A : Type}
    (u : q3229352_set I)
    (B : I -> q3229352_set A) : Prop :=
  forall a b : I,
    u a ->
    u b ->
    a <> b ->
    q3229352_disjoint (B a) (B b).

Definition q3229352_family_union {I A : Type}
    (u : q3229352_set I)
    (B : I -> q3229352_set A) : q3229352_set A :=
  fun x => exists a : I, u a /\ B a x.

Theorem Vitali_exists_disjoint_covering_ae :
  forall (Alpha Iota : Type)
         (d : q3229352_pseudo_metric_space Alpha)
         (m : q3229352_measurable_space Alpha)
         (mu : q3229352_measure m)
         (s : q3229352_set Alpha)
         (t : q3229352_set Iota)
         (C : q3229352_nnreal)
         (r : Iota -> R)
         (c : Iota -> Alpha)
         (B : Iota -> q3229352_set Alpha),
    q3229352_opens_measurable d m ->
    q3229352_second_countable d ->
    q3229352_locally_finite_measure d mu ->
    (forall a : Iota,
      t a ->
      q3229352_subset
        (B a) (q3229352_closed_ball d (c a) (r a))) ->
    (forall a : Iota,
      t a ->
      q3229352_ennreal_le
        (q3229352_measure_value mu
          (q3229352_closed_ball d (c a) (3 * r a)))
        (q3229352_ennreal_mul
          (q3229352_ennreal_of_nnreal C)
          (q3229352_measure_value mu (B a)))) ->
    (forall a : Iota,
      t a ->
      exists x : Alpha, q3229352_interior d (B a) x) ->
    (forall a : Iota,
      t a ->
      q3229352_is_closed d (B a)) ->
    (forall x : Alpha,
      s x ->
      forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists a : Iota,
          t a /\ r a <= epsilon /\ c a = x) ->
    exists u : q3229352_set Iota,
      q3229352_subset u t /\
      q3229352_countable_set u /\
      q3229352_pairwise_disjoint_family u B /\
      q3229352_ennreal_eq
        (q3229352_measure_value mu
          (q3229352_difference s (q3229352_family_union u B)))
        q3229352_ennreal_zero.
Admitted.

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3229352,
  "Vitali covering theorem": a fine family of closed sets in a second-countable
  pseudometric measure space, satisfying a uniform enlarged-ball measure bound,
  has a countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily covering the given set almost
  everywhere. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Borel_Space" "HOL-Analysis.Measure_Space"
begin

definition q3229352_pseudometric ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_pseudometric d \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. d x x = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. 0 \<le> d x y) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. d x y = d y x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y z. d x z \<le> d x y + d y z)"

definition q3229352_ball ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q3229352_ball d x radius = {y. d y x < radius}"

definition q3229352_cball ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q3229352_cball d x radius = {y. d y x \<le> radius}"

definition q3229352_open ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_open d U \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> U. \<exists>radius > 0. q3229352_ball d x radius \<subseteq> U)"

definition q3229352_closed ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_closed d A \<longleftrightarrow> q3229352_open d (- A)"

definition q3229352_interior ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q3229352_interior d A =
      {x. \<exists>radius > 0. q3229352_ball d x radius \<subseteq> A}"

definition q3229352_second_countable ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_second_countable d \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>basis :: 'a set set.
        countable basis \<and>
        (\<forall>A \<in> basis. q3229352_open d A) \<and>
        (\<forall>U x. q3229352_open d U \<longrightarrow> x \<in> U \<longrightarrow>
          (\<exists>A \<in> basis. x \<in> A \<and> A \<subseteq> U)))"

definition q3229352_opens_measurable ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_opens_measurable d M \<longleftrightarrow>
      space M = UNIV \<and>
      (\<forall>U. q3229352_open d U \<longrightarrow> U \<in> sets M)"

definition q3229352_locally_finite ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_locally_finite d M \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. \<exists>U. q3229352_open d U \<and> x \<in> U \<and>
        emeasure M U < \<infinity>)"

definition q3229352_outer_null ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q3229352_outer_null M A \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>N \<in> sets M. A \<subseteq> N \<and> emeasure M N = 0)"

theorem vitali_covering_theorem:
  fixes d :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and M :: "'a measure"
    and s :: "'a set"
    and t :: "'i set"
    and C :: real
    and r :: "'i \<Rightarrow> real"
    and c :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and B :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  assumes pseudometric:
      "q3229352_pseudometric d"
    and second_countable:
      "q3229352_second_countable d"
    and opens_measurable:
      "q3229352_opens_measurable d M"
    and locally_finite:
      "q3229352_locally_finite d M"
    and C_nonnegative:
      "0 \<le> C"
    and contained_in_ball:
      "\<And>a. a \<in> t \<Longrightarrow>
        B a \<subseteq> q3229352_cball d (c a) (r a)"
    and enlarged_ball_bound:
      "\<And>a. a \<in> t \<Longrightarrow>
        emeasure M (q3229352_cball d (c a) (3 * r a))
          \<le> ennreal C * emeasure M (B a)"
    and nonempty_interior:
      "\<And>a. a \<in> t \<Longrightarrow> q3229352_interior d (B a) \<noteq> {}"
    and closed:
      "\<And>a. a \<in> t \<Longrightarrow> q3229352_closed d (B a)"
    and fine:
      "\<And>x epsilon. x \<in> s \<Longrightarrow> 0 < epsilon \<Longrightarrow>
        \<exists>a \<in> t. r a \<le> epsilon \<and> c a = x"
  shows
      "\<exists>u \<subseteq> t.
        countable u \<and>
        pairwise (\<lambda>a b. disjnt (B a) (B b)) u \<and>
        q3229352_outer_null M (s - (\<Union>a\<in>u. B a))"
  sorry

end

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3229352,
  "Vitali covering theorem": a fine family of closed sets in a second-countable
  pseudometric space, satisfying a uniform measure-growth bound, has a
  countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily covering the given set almost
  everywhere. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3229352_VITALI_COVERING_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let outer_measure =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s t:A->bool. s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           ?total:bool#real.
             esum (\n. mu (sets n)) total /\
             ele (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) total) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        outer_measure mu /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           ?t:A->bool.
             events t /\
             s SUBSET t /\
             mu t = mu s) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum (\n. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let is_pseudometric =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        (!x y:A. &0 <= d x y) /\
        (!x:A. d x x = &0) /\
        (!x y:A. d x y = d y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let open_ball =
      \(d:A->A->real) (x:A) (radius:real).
        {y:A | d y x < radius} in
   let closed_ball =
      \(d:A->A->real) (x:A) (radius:real).
        {y:A | d y x <= radius} in
   let metric_open =
      \(d:A->A->real) (u:A->bool).
        !x:A.
          x IN u
          ==> ?radius:real.
                &0 < radius /\
                open_ball d x radius SUBSET u in
   let metric_closed =
      \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
        metric_open d ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s) in
   let interior_nonempty =
      \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
        ?x:A radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          open_ball d x radius SUBSET s in
   let second_countable =
      \(d:A->A->real).
        ?basis:(A->bool)->bool.
          COUNTABLE basis /\
          (!b:A->bool. b IN basis ==> metric_open d b) /\
          (!u:A->bool x:A.
             metric_open d u /\ x IN u
             ==> ?b:A->bool.
                   b IN basis /\ x IN b /\ b SUBSET u) in
   let opens_measurable =
      \(d:A->A->real) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        !u:A->bool. metric_open d u ==> events u in
   let locally_finite_measure =
      \(d:A->A->real) (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !x:A.
          ?u:A->bool.
            metric_open d u /\
            x IN u /\
            ~(FST (mu u)) in
   !d:A->A->real
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    s:A->bool
    t:J->bool
    C:real
    radius:J->real
    center:J->A
    B:J->A->bool.
      is_pseudometric d /\
      second_countable d /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      opens_measurable d events /\
      locally_finite_measure d mu /\
      &0 <= C /\
      (!a:J.
         a IN t
         ==> B a SUBSET closed_ball d (center a) (radius a)) /\
      (!a:J.
         a IN t
         ==> ele
               (mu (closed_ball d (center a) (&3 * radius a)))
               (emul (F,C) (mu (B a)))) /\
      (!a:J.
         a IN t
         ==> interior_nonempty d (B a)) /\
      (!a:J.
         a IN t
         ==> metric_closed d (B a)) /\
      (!x:A.
         x IN s
         ==> !epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon
               ==> ?a:J.
                     a IN t /\
                     radius a <= epsilon /\
                     center a = x)
      ==>
      ?u:J->bool.
        u SUBSET t /\
        COUNTABLE u /\
        (!a b:J.
           a IN u /\ b IN u /\ ~(a = b)
           ==> DISJOINT (B a) (B b)) /\
        mu
          (s DIFF
           {x:A |
              ?a:J.
                a IN u /\ x IN B a}) = ezero`;;

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3229352,
;; "Vitali covering theorem": in an arbitrary second-countable pseudometric
;; measurable space with a locally finite measure, a fine family of closed
;; sets satisfying the stated ball and measure bounds has a countable
;; pairwise-disjoint subfamily covering the given set almost everywhere.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces range over unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The
;; predicates below explicitly present the source's real numbers, arbitrary
;; carriers, extensional sets and functions, pseudometric topology, sigma
;; algebra, outer-measure semantics, and all theorem hypotheses.  The
;; disjoint countable subfamily remains internally existential.

;; Arbitrary carriers, sets, functions, families, sequences, and measures.

(defstub q3229352-carrier-member-p (carrier value) t)
(defstub q3229352-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q3229352-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q3229352-family-value (family index) t)
(defstub q3229352-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q3229352-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q3229352-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q3229352-distance-value (distance left right) t)
(defstub q3229352-closed-ball-value
  (real carrier distance center radius) t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

(defstub q3229352-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q3229352-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defun q3229352-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q3229352-r-less real right left)))

(defun q3229352-r-three (real)
  (q3229352-r-add
   real
   (q3229352-r-one real)
   (q3229352-r-add
    real
    (q3229352-r-one real)
    (q3229352-r-one real))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-r-member-p real x)
      (q3229352-r-member-p real y)
      (q3229352-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q3229352-r-zero real))
            (one (q3229352-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q3229352-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q3229352-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q3229352-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q3229352-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q3229352-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q3229352-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q3229352-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q3229352-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q3229352-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q3229352-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q3229352-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q3229352-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3229352-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q3229352-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q3229352-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q3229352-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q3229352-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q3229352-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q3229352-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q3229352-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3229352-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3229352-r-multiply
          real x (q3229352-r-add real y z))
         (q3229352-r-add
          real
          (q3229352-r-multiply real x y)
          (q3229352-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-r-member-p real x)
      (q3229352-r-member-p real y)
      (q3229352-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q3229352-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q3229352-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q3229352-r-less real x y)
         (q3229352-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3229352-r-less real x y)
          (q3229352-r-less real y z))
         (q3229352-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q3229352-r-less real x y)
         (q3229352-r-less
          real
          (q3229352-r-add real x z)
          (q3229352-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3229352-r-less real zero x)
          (q3229352-r-less real zero y))
         (q3229352-r-less
          real zero
          (q3229352-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q3229352-r-member-p real x)
     (q3229352-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-r-member-p real x)
      (q3229352-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q3229352-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3229352-r-member-p real bound)
     (q3229352-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q3229352-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q3229352-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3229352-r-member-p real bound)
       (q3229352-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q3229352-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q3229352-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3229352-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q3229352-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q3229352-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q3229352-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q3229352-r-zero real))
        (one (q3229352-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q3229352-r-member-p real zero)
     (q3229352-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q3229352-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q3229352-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q3229352-r-less real zero one)
     (q3229352-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Canonical extended nonnegative reals over the presented real field.

(defun q3229352-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q3229352-finite value))

(defun q3229352-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q3229352-ennreal-finite (q3229352-r-zero real)))

(defun q3229352-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q3229352-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q3229352-finite)
    (q3229352-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q3229352-r-leq
     real (q3229352-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q3229352-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q3229352-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q3229352-top) t)
   (t (q3229352-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q3229352-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q3229352-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q3229352-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or
       (equal left :q3229352-top)
       (equal right :q3229352-top))
      :q3229352-top
    (q3229352-ennreal-finite
     (q3229352-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q3229352-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or
     (equal left (q3229352-ennreal-zero real))
     (equal right (q3229352-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q3229352-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or
     (equal left :q3229352-top)
     (equal right :q3229352-top))
    :q3229352-top)
   (t
    (q3229352-ennreal-finite
     (q3229352-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

;; Extensional arbitrary sets and exact set operations.

(defun-sk q3229352-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3229352-set-member-p set x)
     (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q3229352-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q3229352-set-member-p left x)
      (q3229352-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-set-extensionality-p (carrier)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q3229352-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q3229352-subset-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (q3229352-set-member-p left x))
     (q3229352-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q3229352-empty-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q3229352-set-member-p set x)
     (and (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x) nil))))

(defun-sk q3229352-complement-set-p
    (carrier set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q3229352-set-member-p complement x)
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (not (q3229352-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-intersection-set-p
    (carrier left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q3229352-set-member-p intersection x)
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (q3229352-set-member-p left x)
      (q3229352-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-difference-set-p
    (carrier left right difference)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q3229352-set-member-p difference x)
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (q3229352-set-member-p left x)
      (not (q3229352-set-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-set-sequence-p (carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3229352-valid-set-p
      carrier
      (q3229352-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q3229352-set-member-p
      (q3229352-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q3229352-sequence-union-set-p
    (carrier sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q3229352-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (q3229352-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

;; The pseudometric and its induced topology.

(defun-sk q3229352-pseudometric-laws-p
    (real carrier distance)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier y)
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier z))
     (let ((dxy (q3229352-distance-value distance x y))
           (dyz (q3229352-distance-value distance y z))
           (dxz (q3229352-distance-value distance x z))
           (zero (q3229352-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (q3229352-r-member-p real dxy)
        (q3229352-r-member-p real dyz)
        (q3229352-r-member-p real dxz)
        (q3229352-r-leq real zero dxy)
        (equal
         (q3229352-distance-value distance x x)
         zero)
        (equal dxy (q3229352-distance-value distance y x))
        (q3229352-r-leq
         real
         dxz
         (q3229352-r-add real dxy dyz)))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-open-ball-contained-p
    (real carrier distance center radius set)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier y)
      (q3229352-r-less
       real
       (q3229352-distance-value distance center y)
       radius))
     (q3229352-set-member-p set y))))

(defun-sk q3229352-open-radius-exists-p
    (real carrier distance center set)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q3229352-r-member-p real radius)
     (q3229352-r-less
      real (q3229352-r-zero real) radius)
     (q3229352-open-ball-contained-p
      real carrier distance center radius set))))

(defun-sk q3229352-open-set-p
    (real carrier distance set)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
       (q3229352-set-member-p set x))
      (q3229352-open-radius-exists-p
       real carrier distance x set)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-closed-set-p
    (real carrier distance set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q3229352-complement-set-p carrier set complement)
     (q3229352-open-set-p
      real carrier distance complement))))

(defun-sk q3229352-interior-nonempty-p
    (real carrier distance set)
  (exists (open-subset x)
    (and
     (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
     (q3229352-open-set-p
      real carrier distance open-subset)
     (q3229352-set-member-p open-subset x)
     (q3229352-subset-p carrier open-subset set))))

(defun-sk q3229352-closed-ball-set-p
    (real carrier distance center radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (implies
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
      (iff
       (q3229352-set-member-p set x)
       (q3229352-r-leq
        real
        (q3229352-distance-value distance center x)
        radius))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-closed-ball-operation-p
    (real carrier distance)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier center)
      (q3229352-r-member-p real radius))
     (q3229352-closed-ball-set-p
      real carrier distance center radius
      (q3229352-closed-ball-value
       real carrier distance center radius)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-basis-entries-open-p
    (real carrier distance basis)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3229352-open-set-p
      real carrier distance
      (q3229352-set-sequence-value basis n)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-basis-refinement-exists-p
    (carrier basis open-set x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q3229352-set-member-p
      (q3229352-set-sequence-value basis n)
      x)
     (q3229352-subset-p
      carrier
      (q3229352-set-sequence-value basis n)
      open-set))))

(defun-sk q3229352-countable-basis-p
    (real carrier distance basis)
  (forall (open-set x)
    (and
     (q3229352-basis-entries-open-p
      real carrier distance basis)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3229352-open-set-p
        real carrier distance open-set)
       (q3229352-carrier-member-p carrier x)
       (q3229352-set-member-p open-set x))
      (q3229352-basis-refinement-exists-p
       carrier basis open-set x)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-second-countable-p

(defun-sk q3229352-measurable-family-extensional-p

(defun-sk q3229352-measurable-family-valid-p

(defun-sk q3229352-measurable-complement-exists-p

(defun-sk q3229352-measurable-complements-p

(defun-sk q3229352-sequence-measurable-p

;; Countable sums of extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q3229352-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q3229352-ennreal-zero real)
    (q3229352-ennreal-add
     real
     (q3229352-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q3229352-measure-value
      measure
      (q3229352-set-sequence-value
       sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q3229352-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q3229352-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q3229352-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q3229352-ennreal-p real total)
     (q3229352-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3229352-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q3229352-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q3229352-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-measure-values-p
    (real carrier measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q3229352-ennreal-p
      real (q3229352-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-measure-extensional-p
    (carrier measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q3229352-set-equiv-p carrier left right)
     (equal
      (q3229352-measure-value measure left)
      (q3229352-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real carrier measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q3229352-empty-set-p carrier empty)
     (equal
      (q3229352-measure-value measure empty)
      (q3229352-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-measure-monotone-p
    (real carrier measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q3229352-subset-p carrier left right))
     (q3229352-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q3229352-measure-value measure left)
      (q3229352-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q3229352-subadditive-instance-p
    (real measure sequence union)
  (exists (total)
    (and
     (q3229352-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (q3229352-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q3229352-measure-value measure union)
      total))))

(defun-sk q3229352-countably-subadditive-p
    (real carrier measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-set-sequence-p carrier sequence)
      (q3229352-sequence-union-set-p
       carrier sequence union))
     (q3229352-subadditive-instance-p
      real measure sequence union))))

(defun-sk q3229352-caratheodory-instance-p
    (real carrier measure measurable-set arbitrary-set)
  (exists (inside outside)
    (and
     (q3229352-intersection-set-p
      carrier arbitrary-set measurable-set inside)
     (q3229352-difference-set-p
      carrier arbitrary-set measurable-set outside)
     (equal
      (q3229352-measure-value measure arbitrary-set)
      (q3229352-ennreal-add
       real
       (q3229352-measure-value measure inside)
       (q3229352-measure-value measure outside))))))

(defun-sk q3229352-measurable-caratheodory-p
    (real carrier measurable measure)
  (forall (measurable-set arbitrary-set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3229352-measurable-set-p
       measurable measurable-set)
      (q3229352-valid-set-p carrier arbitrary-set))
     (q3229352-caratheodory-instance-p
      real carrier measure measurable-set arbitrary-set))))

   (q3229352-measure-monotone-p real carrier measure)

;; Exact conclusion: an internal subset u of t is countable and pairwise

(defun-sk q3229352-countable-coding-p
    (index-carrier set coding)
  (forall (a b)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q3229352-carrier-member-p index-carrier a)

       (q3229352-carrier-member-p index-carrier a)
       (q3229352-carrier-member-p index-carrier b)
       (q3229352-set-member-p set a)

        (q3229352-function-value coding a)
