title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3229352,
-- "Vitali covering theorem": a fine family of closed sets satisfying a
-- uniform measure-growth bound has a countable pairwise-disjoint subfamily
-- covering the given set almost everywhere. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Support.Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem
open import Support.Q2275191_lebesgue_differentiation_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

OpensMeasurableMetric :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  Set1
OpensMeasurableMetric metric events =
  (U : Predicate _) ->
  MetricOpen metric U ->
  measurable events U

IsClosedMetric :
  {A R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace R A reals ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
IsClosedMetric metric S =
  MetricOpen metric (complement S)

record ElementOf
  {I : Set}
  (S : Predicate I) : Set where
  constructor member
  field
    element    : I
    membership : S element

open ElementOf

record CountableSubset
  {I : Set}
  (S : Predicate I) : Set where
  field
    code :
      ElementOf S -> Nat
    code-injective :
      (x y : ElementOf S) ->
      code x == code y ->
      element x == element y

SubfamilyUnion :
  {A I : Set} ->
  Predicate I ->
  (I -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
SubfamilyUnion {I = I} indices family x =
  Exists I
    (\ i ->
      Both
        (indices i)
        (family i x))

SetPairwiseDisjoint :
  {A I : Set} ->
  Predicate I ->
  (I -> Predicate A) ->
  Set
SetPairwiseDisjoint {A = A} {I = I} indices family =
  (i j : I) ->
  indices i ->
  indices j ->
  i != j ->
  (x : A) ->
  family i x ->
  family j x ->
  Bottom

threeR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
threeR reals =
  fromNatR reals (suc (suc (suc zero)))

record VitaliCoveringConclusion
  {A I R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  {extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (S : Predicate A)
  (familyIndices : Predicate I)
  (family : I -> Predicate A) : Set1 where
  field
    selected :
      Predicate I
    selected-in-family :
      Subset selected familyIndices
    selected-countable :
      CountableSubset selected
    selected-pairwise-disjoint :
      SetPairwiseDisjoint selected family
    covers-almost-everywhere :
      outerMass measure
        (SetDifference S (SubfamilyUnion selected family))
      ==
      zeroM extended

vitali-covering-theorem : Set2
vitali-covering-theorem =
  (A I R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace R A reals) ->
  SecondCountableMetric metric ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  OpensMeasurableMetric metric events ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  IsLocallyFiniteMeasure metric measure ->
  (S : Predicate A) ->
  (familyIndices : Predicate I) ->
  (constant : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  (radius : I -> R) ->
  (center : I -> A) ->
  (family : I -> Predicate A) ->
  ((i : I) ->
    familyIndices i ->
    Subset
      (family i)
      (ClosedBall metric (center i) (radius i))) ->
  ((i : I) ->
    familyIndices i ->
    lessOrEqualM extended
      (outerMass measure
        (ClosedBall metric (center i)
          (multiplyR reals (threeR reals) (radius i))))
      (multiplyM extended
        (finiteNN extended constant)
        (outerMass measure (family i)))) ->
  ((i : I) ->
    familyIndices i ->
    InteriorNonempty metric (family i)) ->
  ((i : I) ->
    familyIndices i ->
    IsClosedMetric metric (family i)) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    S x ->
    (epsilon : R) ->
    Positive reals epsilon ->
    Exists I
      (\ i ->
        Both
          (familyIndices i)
          (Both
            (lessOrEqualR reals (radius i) epsilon)
            (center i == x)))) ->
  VitaliCoveringConclusion measure S familyIndices family

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3229352, "Vitali covering theorem": a fine family of closed sets satisfying
  a uniform enlarged-ball measure bound has a countable pairwise-disjoint
  subfamily covering the given set up to a null remainder. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory cardinalTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;

val q3229352_pseudo_metric_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_pseudo_metric_def",
  ``q3229352_pseudo_metric (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x. d x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. 0 <= d x y) /\
      (!x y. d x y = d y x) /\
      (!x y z. d x z <= d x y + d y z)``);

val q3229352_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_closed_ball_def",
  ``q3229352_closed_ball
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (x : 'a) (radius : real) =
      {y | d y x <= radius}``);

val q3229352_open_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_open_def",
  ``q3229352_open (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (u : 'a set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. d y x < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q3229352_closed_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_closed_def",
  ``q3229352_closed (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) <=>
      q3229352_open d (UNIV DIFF s)``);

val q3229352_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_second_countable_def",
  ``q3229352_second_countable (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      ?basis : ('a set) set.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!v. v IN basis ==> q3229352_open d v) /\
        !u x.
          q3229352_open d u /\ x IN u ==>
          ?v.
            v IN basis /\
            x IN v /\
            v SUBSET u``);

val q3229352_opens_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_opens_measurable_def",
  ``q3229352_opens_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      !u.
        q3229352_open d u ==>
        u IN measurable_sets m``);

val q3229352_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_outer_measure_def",
  ``q3229352_outer_measure (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) =
      inf
        {value : extreal |
          ?measurable_superset : 'a set.
            s SUBSET measurable_superset /\
            measurable_superset IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m measurable_superset = value}``);

val q3229352_locally_finite_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_locally_finite_def",
  ``q3229352_locally_finite
      (m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      !x.
        ?u : 'a set.
          q3229352_open d u /\
          x IN u /\
          measure m u <> PosInf``);

val q3229352_nonempty_interior_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_nonempty_interior_def",
  ``q3229352_nonempty_interior
      (d : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) <=>
      ?u x.
        q3229352_open d u /\
        x IN u /\
        u SUBSET s``);

val q3229352_pairwise_disjoint_def = new_definition (
  "q3229352_pairwise_disjoint_def",
  ``q3229352_pairwise_disjoint
      (u : 'i set) (B : 'i -> 'a set) <=>
      !a b.
        a IN u /\ b IN u /\ a <> b ==>
        DISJOINT (B a) (B b)``);

val exists_disjoint_covering_ae =
  ``!(m : 'a m_space) (d : 'a -> 'a -> real)
      (s : 'a set) (t : 'i set) (C : real)
      (r : 'i -> real) (c : 'i -> 'a) (B : 'i -> 'a set).
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      q3229352_pseudo_metric d /\
      q3229352_second_countable d /\
      q3229352_opens_measurable m d /\
      q3229352_locally_finite m d /\
      0 <= C /\
      (!a.
        a IN t ==>
        B a SUBSET q3229352_closed_ball d (c a) (r a)) /\
      (!a.
        a IN t ==>
        q3229352_outer_measure m
          (q3229352_closed_ball d (c a) (3 * r a)) <=
        Normal C * q3229352_outer_measure m (B a)) /\
      (!a.
        a IN t ==>
        q3229352_nonempty_interior d (B a)) /\
      (!a.
        a IN t ==>
        q3229352_closed d (B a)) /\
      (!x epsilon.
        x IN s /\ 0 < epsilon ==>
        ?a.
          a IN t /\
          r a <= epsilon /\
          c a = x)
      ==>
      ?u : 'i set.
        u SUBSET t /\
        COUNTABLE u /\
        q3229352_pairwise_disjoint u B /\
        q3229352_outer_measure m
          (s DIFF BIGUNION (IMAGE B u)) = Normal 0``;

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3229352,
:: "Vitali covering theorem": a fine family of closed sets with nonempty
:: interiors and a uniform measure bound admits a countable pairwise-disjoint
:: subfamily covering the given set almost everywhere. This file contains no

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,

      NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XXREAL_3, XREAL_0, REAL_1,

      NAT_1, CARD_1, CARD_3, MEMBERED, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, PCOMPS_1,

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for X being empty set,
       S being SigmaField of X,
       Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
       s being Subset of X,
       T being empty set,
       C being Real,
       r being Function of T,REAL,
       c being Function of T,X,
       B being Function of T,bool X
   st 0 <= C
   holds
     ex U being countable Subset of T st
       (for i,j being Element of T st
          i in U & j in U & i <> j holds B.i misses B.j) &
       (C_Meas Mu).(s \ union (B.:U)) = 0)
  &
  (for M being PseudoMetricSpace,
       S being SigmaField of the carrier of M,
       Mu being sigma_Measure of S,
       s being Subset of M,
       T being set,
       C being Real,
       r being Function of T,REAL,
       c being Function of T,the carrier of M,
       B being Function of T,bool the carrier of M
   st
     TopSpaceMetr M is second-countable &
     (for O being Subset of TopSpaceMetr M st
        O in the topology of TopSpaceMetr M holds O in S) &
     (for x being Point of M holds
        ex rho being Real, A being Element of S st
          0 < rho & A = Ball(x,rho) & Mu.A < +infty) &
     0 <= C &
     (for a being Element of T st a in T holds
        ex x being Point of M,
           ra being Real,
           A,D,E being Element of S,
           A0 being Subset of TopSpaceMetr M st
          x = c.a &
          ra = r.a &
          A = B.a &
          D = cl_Ball(x,ra) &
          E = cl_Ball(x,3*ra) &
          A0 = A &
          A c= D &
          Mu.E <= (C qua ExtReal) * Mu.A &
          Int A0 <> {} &
          A0` in the topology of TopSpaceMetr M) &
     (for x being Point of M st x in s holds
        for eps being Real st 0 < eps holds
          ex a being Element of T,
             ra being Real,
             y being Point of M st
            a in T & ra = r.a & y = c.a & ra <= eps & y = x)
   holds
     ex U being countable Subset of T st
       (for i,j being Element of T st
          i in U & j in U & i <> j holds B.i misses B.j) &
       (C_Meas Mu).(s \ union (B.:U)) = 0)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q3229352_vitali_covering_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q3229352,
% "Vitali covering theorem": a fine indexed family of closed sets satisfying
% a uniform enlarged-ball measure bound has a countable pairwise-disjoint
% subfamily covering the source set almost everywhere. This file contains no proof.

vitali_covering_theorem_Q3229352[
  X: TYPE+,
  point_carrier: [X -> bool],
  I: TYPE+,
  index_carrier: [I -> bool],
  distance: [X, X -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]
  index_set: TYPE = [I -> bool]
  indexed_events: TYPE = [I -> event]
  center_function: TYPE = [I -> X]
  radius_function: TYPE = [I -> real]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(value)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_scale(
      factor: real,
      value: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF factor <= 0 OR measure_value_is_zero(value) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(factor * finite_part(value))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      E(x) IMPLIES point_carrier(x)

  carrier_index_set(A: index_set): bool =
    FORALL (a: I):
      A(a) IMPLIES index_carrier(a)

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x)

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      FALSE

  event_subset(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      point_carrier(x) AND E(x) IMPLIES F(x)

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x) AND NOT E(x)

  event_intersection(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x) AND E(x) AND F(x)

  event_difference(E, F: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x) AND E(x) AND NOT F(x)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (n: nat):
          events(n)(x)

  disjoint_events(E, F: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      point_carrier(x) IMPLIES
        NOT (E(x) AND F(x))

  index_subset(A, B: index_set): bool =
    FORALL (a: I):
      index_carrier(a) AND A(a) IMPLIES B(a)

  countable_index_set(A: index_set): bool =
    carrier_index_set(A)
      AND EXISTS (code: [I -> nat]):
        FORALL (a, b: I):
          index_carrier(a)
            AND index_carrier(b)
            AND A(a)
            AND A(b)
            AND code(a) = code(b)
          IMPLIES a = b

  indexed_events_well_typed(B: indexed_events): bool =
    FORALL (a: I):
      index_carrier(a) IMPLIES carrier_event(B(a))

  centers_well_typed(c: center_function): bool =
    FORALL (a: I):
      index_carrier(a) IMPLIES point_carrier(c(a))

  indexed_union(
      selected: index_set,
      B: indexed_events): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x)
        AND EXISTS (a: I):
          index_carrier(a)
            AND selected(a)
            AND B(a)(x)

  selected_pairwise_disjoint(
      selected: index_set,
      B: indexed_events): bool =
    FORALL (a, b: I):
      index_carrier(a)
        AND index_carrier(b)
        AND selected(a)
        AND selected(b)
        AND a /= b
      IMPLIES disjoint_events(B(a), B(b))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            abs(values(n) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (n: nat):
        bound < values(n)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (n: nat):
        finite_part(values(n)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(n)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (n: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(n)))
          OR ((FORALL (n: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(n)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(n)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          Sigma(events(n)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  outer_measure_laws(M: measure_map): bool =
    measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        carrier_event(E) IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (E, F: event):
        carrier_event(E)
          AND carrier_event(F)
          AND event_subset(E, F)
        IMPLIES measure_value_le(M(E), M(F)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          carrier_event(events(n)))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (total: measure_value):
            extended_nonnegative_sum(
              LAMBDA (n: nat):
                M(events(n)),
              total)
              AND measure_value_le(
                M(countable_union(events)),
                total))

  caratheodory_measurable(
      M: measure_map,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND FORALL (test: event):
        carrier_event(test) IMPLIES
          M(test) =
            measure_value_add(
              M(event_intersection(test, E)),
              M(event_difference(test, E)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND outer_measure_laws(M)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          caratheodory_measurable(M, E))

  pseudo_metric_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      point_carrier(x) AND point_carrier(y)
        IMPLIES distance(x, y) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        point_carrier(x) IMPLIES
          distance(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        point_carrier(x) AND point_carrier(y)
          IMPLIES distance(x, y) = distance(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        point_carrier(x)
          AND point_carrier(y)
          AND point_carrier(z)
        IMPLIES
          distance(x, z)
            <= distance(x, y) + distance(y, z))

  open_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x)
        AND distance(x, center) < radius

  closed_ball(center: X, radius: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      point_carrier(x)
        AND distance(x, center) <= radius

  metric_open(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: X):
        point_carrier(x) AND U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
            event_subset(
              open_ball(x, epsilon_value),
              U)

  metric_closed(E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND metric_open(event_complement(E))

  interior_nonempty(E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS
          (x: X),
          (epsilon_value: posreal):
        point_carrier(x)
          AND event_subset(
            open_ball(x, epsilon_value),
            E)

  second_countable_metric: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: event_sequence):
      (FORALL (n: nat):
        metric_open(basis(n)))
        AND (FORALL (U: event), (x: X):
          metric_open(U)
            AND point_carrier(x)
            AND U(x)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (n: nat):
              basis(n)(x)
                AND event_subset(basis(n), U))

  opens_measurable(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (U: event):
      metric_open(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U)

  locally_finite_measure(
      M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      point_carrier(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
          NOT infinite_flag(
            M(open_ball(x, epsilon_value)))

  family_fine_on(
      source: event,
      family: index_set,
      r: radius_function,
      c: center_function): bool =
    FORALL
        (x: X),
        (epsilon_value: posreal):
      point_carrier(x) AND source(x)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (a: I):
          index_carrier(a)
            AND family(a)
            AND r(a) <= epsilon_value
            AND c(a) = x

  vitali_covering_statement: bool =
    pseudo_metric_space
      AND second_countable_metric
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (source: event),
          (family: index_set),
          (C: real),
          (r: radius_function),
          (c: center_function),
          (B: indexed_events):
        (is_measure(M, Sigma)
          AND opens_measurable(Sigma)
          AND locally_finite_measure(M)
          AND carrier_event(source)
          AND carrier_index_set(family)
          AND centers_well_typed(c)
          AND indexed_events_well_typed(B)
          AND C >= 0
          AND (FORALL (a: I):
            index_carrier(a) AND family(a) IMPLIES
              event_subset(
                B(a),
                closed_ball(c(a), r(a))))
          AND (FORALL (a: I):
            index_carrier(a) AND family(a) IMPLIES
              measure_value_le(
                M(closed_ball(c(a), 3 * r(a))),
                measure_value_scale(C, M(B(a)))))
          AND (FORALL (a: I):
            index_carrier(a) AND family(a) IMPLIES
              interior_nonempty(B(a)))
          AND (FORALL (a: I):
            index_carrier(a) AND family(a) IMPLIES
              metric_closed(B(a)))
          AND family_fine_on(source, family, r, c))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (selected: index_set):
            index_subset(selected, family)
              AND countable_index_set(selected)
              AND selected_pairwise_disjoint(selected, B)
              AND measure_value_is_zero(
                M(event_difference(
                  source,
                  indexed_union(selected, B))))
END vitali_covering_theorem_Q3229352

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q33481
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q33481), "Arrow's impossibility theorem": every social
-- welfare function on at least three alternatives that satisfies weak Pareto and
-- independence of irrelevant alternatives is dictatorial. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card

@[expose] public section

namespace Q33481

universe u v

/-- A preference order is a reflexive, total, transitive binary relation. -/
structure PreferenceOrder (α : Type u) where
  rel : α → α → Prop
  refl : ∀ x, rel x x
  total : ∀ x y, rel x y ∨ rel y x
  trans : ∀ {x y z}, rel x y → rel y z → rel x z

instance {α : Type u} : CoeFun (PreferenceOrder α) (fun _ ↦ α → α → Prop) :=
  ⟨PreferenceOrder.rel⟩

/-- The strict part of a preference order. -/
def StrictPreference {α : Type u} (r : PreferenceOrder α) (x y : α) : Prop :=
  r x y ∧ ¬r y x

/-- Two preference orders rank a specified pair in the same strict way. -/
def SameStrictOrder {α : Type u} (r r' : PreferenceOrder α) (x y : α) : Prop :=
  (StrictPreference r x y ↔ StrictPreference r' x y) ∧
    (StrictPreference r y x ↔ StrictPreference r' y x)

/-- The weak Pareto condition on a finite set of alternatives. -/
def WeakPareto {α : Type u} {ι : Type v}
    (f : (ι → PreferenceOrder α) → PreferenceOrder α) (X : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X, ∀ R : ι → PreferenceOrder α,
    (∀ i : ι, StrictPreference (R i) x y) → StrictPreference (f R) x y

/-- Independence of irrelevant alternatives on a finite set of alternatives. -/
def IndependentOfIrrelevantAlternatives {α : Type u} {ι : Type v}
    (f : (ι → PreferenceOrder α) → PreferenceOrder α) (X : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∀ R R' : ι → PreferenceOrder α, ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X,
    (∀ i : ι, SameStrictOrder (R i) (R' i) x y) →
      SameStrictOrder (f R) (f R') x y

/-- A social welfare function is dictatorial on a finite set of alternatives. -/
def IsDictatorship {α : Type u} {ι : Type v}
    (f : (ι → PreferenceOrder α) → PreferenceOrder α) (X : Finset α) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : ι, ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X, ∀ R : ι → PreferenceOrder α,
    StrictPreference (R i) x y → StrictPreference (f R) x y

/-- Arrow's impossibility theorem for a finite electorate and at least three alternatives. -/
theorem arrow_s_impossibility_theorem {α : Type u} {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    {f : (ι → PreferenceOrder α) → PreferenceOrder α} {X : Finset α}
    (hwp : WeakPareto f X) (hiia : IndependentOfIrrelevantAlternatives f X)
    (hX : 3 ≤ X.card) : IsDictatorship f X := sorry

end Q33481

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q33481
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q33481), "Arrow's impossibility theorem":
  for at least three alternatives and finitely many voters, every social
  welfare function on total preorders satisfying weak Pareto and independence
  of irrelevant alternatives is a dictatorship. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Polymorphic Record q33481_preference_order@{u}
    (A : Type@{u}) : Type@{u+1} := {
  q33481_preferred_or_tied : A -> A -> Prop;
  q33481_preference_refl :
    forall x : A, q33481_preferred_or_tied x x;
  q33481_preference_total :
    forall x y : A,
      q33481_preferred_or_tied x y \/
      q33481_preferred_or_tied y x;
  q33481_preference_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q33481_preferred_or_tied x y ->
      q33481_preferred_or_tied y z ->
      q33481_preferred_or_tied x z
}.

Arguments q33481_preferred_or_tied {A} _ _ _.

Polymorphic Definition q33481_strictly_prefers@{u}
    {A : Type@{u}}
    (R : q33481_preference_order A)
    (x y : A) : Prop :=
  q33481_preferred_or_tied R x y /\
  ~ q33481_preferred_or_tied R y x.

Polymorphic Record q33481_finset@{u} (A : Type@{u}) : Type@{u+1} := {
  q33481_finset_elements : list A;
  q33481_finset_nodup : NoDup q33481_finset_elements
}.

Arguments q33481_finset_elements {A} _.

Polymorphic Definition q33481_mem@{u}
    {A : Type@{u}} (x : A) (X : q33481_finset A) : Prop :=
  In x (q33481_finset_elements X).

Polymorphic Definition q33481_card@{u}
    {A : Type@{u}} (X : q33481_finset A) : nat :=
  length (q33481_finset_elements X).

Polymorphic Record q33481_finite_type@{u}
    (I : Type@{u}) : Type@{u+1} := {
  q33481_enumeration : list I;
  q33481_enumeration_nodup : NoDup q33481_enumeration;
  q33481_enumeration_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q33481_enumeration
}.

Polymorphic Definition q33481_same_pair_order@{u}
    {A : Type@{u}}
    (R R' : q33481_preference_order A)
    (x y : A) : Prop :=
  (q33481_strictly_prefers R x y <->
   q33481_strictly_prefers R' x y) /\
  (q33481_strictly_prefers R y x <->
   q33481_strictly_prefers R' y x).

Polymorphic Definition q33481_weak_pareto@{u v}
    {A : Type@{u}}
    {I : Type@{v}}
    (f : (I -> q33481_preference_order A) ->
         q33481_preference_order A)
    (X : q33481_finset A) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : A),
    q33481_mem x X ->
    q33481_mem y X ->
    forall R : I -> q33481_preference_order A,
      (forall i : I, q33481_strictly_prefers (R i) x y) ->
      q33481_strictly_prefers (f R) x y.

Polymorphic Definition q33481_independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives@{u v}
    {A : Type@{u}}
    {I : Type@{v}}
    (f : (I -> q33481_preference_order A) ->
         q33481_preference_order A)
    (X : q33481_finset A) : Prop :=
  forall (R R' : I -> q33481_preference_order A)
         (x y : A),
    q33481_mem x X ->
    q33481_mem y X ->
    (forall i : I, q33481_same_pair_order (R i) (R' i) x y) ->
    q33481_same_pair_order (f R) (f R') x y.

Polymorphic Definition q33481_is_dictatorship@{u v}
    {A : Type@{u}}
    {I : Type@{v}}
    (f : (I -> q33481_preference_order A) ->
         q33481_preference_order A)
    (X : q33481_finset A) : Prop :=
  exists i : I,
    forall (x y : A),
      q33481_mem x X ->
      q33481_mem y X ->
      forall R : I -> q33481_preference_order A,
        q33481_strictly_prefers (R i) x y ->
        q33481_strictly_prefers (f R) x y.

Polymorphic Theorem arrow@{u v} :
  forall (A : Type@{u})
         (I : Type@{v})
         (_ : q33481_finite_type I)
         (X : q33481_finset A)
         (f : (I -> q33481_preference_order A) ->
              q33481_preference_order A),
    q33481_weak_pareto f X ->
    q33481_independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives f X ->
    (3 <= q33481_card X)%nat ->
    q33481_is_dictatorship f X.
Admitted.

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q33481
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q33481), "Arrow's impossibility theorem": for
  a finite electorate and at least three alternatives, weak Pareto and
  independence of irrelevant alternatives force a social welfare function to
  be dictatorial. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q33481_preference_order :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q33481_preference_order r \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. r x x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. r x y \<or> r y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. r x y \<longrightarrow> r y z \<longrightarrow> r x z)"

definition q33481_strict_preference ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q33481_strict_preference r x y \<longleftrightarrow> r x y \<and> \<not> r y x"

definition q33481_valid_profile ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q33481_valid_profile I R \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>i\<in>I. q33481_preference_order (R i)) \<and>
    (\<forall>i. i \<notin> I \<longrightarrow> R i = (\<lambda>x y. False))"

definition q33481_social_welfare_function ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow>
      (('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "q33481_social_welfare_function I F \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>R. q33481_valid_profile I R \<longrightarrow> q33481_preference_order (F R))"

definition q33481_same_pairwise_order ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q33481_same_pairwise_order r s x y \<longleftrightarrow>
    (q33481_strict_preference r x y \<longleftrightarrow> q33481_strict_preference s x y) \<and>
    (q33481_strict_preference r y x \<longleftrightarrow> q33481_strict_preference s y x)"

definition q33481_weak_pareto ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow>
      (('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "q33481_weak_pareto I A F \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. \<forall>R.
      q33481_valid_profile I R \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>i\<in>I. q33481_strict_preference (R i) x y) \<longrightarrow>
      q33481_strict_preference (F R) x y)"

definition q33481_independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow>
      (('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "q33481_independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives I A F \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>R R'. q33481_valid_profile I R \<longrightarrow> q33481_valid_profile I R' \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A.
        (\<forall>i\<in>I. q33481_same_pairwise_order (R i) (R' i) x y) \<longrightarrow>
        q33481_same_pairwise_order (F R) (F R') x y))"

definition q33481_is_dictatorship ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow>
      (('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "q33481_is_dictatorship I A F \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>i\<in>I. \<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>y\<in>A. \<forall>R.
      q33481_valid_profile I R \<longrightarrow>
      q33481_strict_preference (R i) x y \<longrightarrow>
      q33481_strict_preference (F R) x y)"

theorem q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem:
  assumes finite_voters: "finite I"
    and finite_alternatives: "finite A"
    and three_alternatives: "3 \<le> card A"
    and welfare_function: "q33481_social_welfare_function I F"
    and weak_pareto: "q33481_weak_pareto I A F"
    and independence: "q33481_independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives I A F"
  shows "q33481_is_dictatorship I A F"
  sorry

end

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q33481,
  "Arrow's impossibility theorem": every social welfare function on a finite
  electorate and at least three alternatives that satisfies weak Pareto and
  independence of irrelevant alternatives is dictatorial. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q33481_ARROWS_IMPOSSIBILITY_THEOREM =
  `let is_preference_order =
     \(r:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. r x x) /\
       (!x y:A. r x y \/ r y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. r x y /\ r y z ==> r x z) in
   let strictly_prefers =
     \(r:A->A->bool) (x:A) (y:A).
       r x y /\ ~(r y x) in
   let is_profile =
     \(voters:V->bool) (R:V->A->A->bool).
       !i:V. i IN voters ==> is_preference_order (R i) in
   let same_pair_order =
     \(r:A->A->bool) (r':A->A->bool) (x:A) (y:A).
       (strictly_prefers r x y <=> strictly_prefers r' x y) /\
       (strictly_prefers r y x <=> strictly_prefers r' y x) in
   let is_social_welfare_function =
     \(voters:V->bool)
      (f:(V->A->A->bool)->A->A->bool).
       (!R:V->A->A->bool.
          is_profile voters R
          ==> is_preference_order (f R)) /\
       (!R R':V->A->A->bool.
          is_profile voters R /\
          is_profile voters R' /\
          (!i:V.
             i IN voters
             ==> !x y:A. R i x y <=> R' i x y)
          ==> !x y:A. f R x y <=> f R' x y) in
   let weak_pareto =
     \(voters:V->bool) (alternatives:A->bool)
      (f:(V->A->A->bool)->A->A->bool).
       !x y:A. !R:V->A->A->bool.
         x IN alternatives /\
         y IN alternatives /\
         is_profile voters R /\
         (!i:V. i IN voters ==> strictly_prefers (R i) x y)
         ==> strictly_prefers (f R) x y in
   let independent_of_irrelevant_alternatives =
     \(voters:V->bool) (alternatives:A->bool)
      (f:(V->A->A->bool)->A->A->bool).
       !R R':V->A->A->bool. !x y:A.
         is_profile voters R /\
         is_profile voters R' /\
         x IN alternatives /\
         y IN alternatives /\
         (!i:V.
            i IN voters
            ==> same_pair_order (R i) (R' i) x y)
         ==> same_pair_order (f R) (f R') x y in
   let is_dictatorship =
     \(voters:V->bool) (alternatives:A->bool)
      (f:(V->A->A->bool)->A->A->bool).
       ?i:V.
         i IN voters /\
         !x y:A. !R:V->A->A->bool.
           x IN alternatives /\
           y IN alternatives /\
           is_profile voters R /\
           strictly_prefers (R i) x y
           ==> strictly_prefers (f R) x y in
   !voters:V->bool.
   !alternatives:A->bool.
   !f:(V->A->A->bool)->A->A->bool.
     FINITE voters /\
     FINITE alternatives /\
     3 <= CARD alternatives /\
     is_social_welfare_function voters f /\
     weak_pareto voters alternatives f /\
     independent_of_irrelevant_alternatives voters alternatives f
     ==> is_dictatorship voters alternatives f`;;

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q33481
;; (thousand-theorems__acl2__Q33481), "Arrow's impossibility theorem": every
;; social welfare function on a finite electorate and at least three
;; alternatives that satisfies weak Pareto and independence of irrelevant
;; alternatives is dictatorial. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; STATES is an arbitrary, potentially infinite carrier.  INDIVIDUALS is a
;; duplicate-free enumeration of the source Fintype, and a profile is the
;; corresponding list of arbitrary APPLY$ preference relations.  The
;; conservative welfare interface represents an arbitrary function from such
;; profiles to preference relations; all typing and order laws are explicit.

(defstub q33481-state-member-p (states value) t)
(defstub q33481-welfare-order (welfare profile) t)

(defun q33481-relation-holds-p (relation left right)
  (if (apply$ relation (list left right))
      t
    nil))

(defun-sk q33481-preference-order-laws-p (states relation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q33481-state-member-p states x)
      (q33481-relation-holds-p relation x x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q33481-state-member-p states x)
       (q33481-state-member-p states y))
      (or
       (q33481-relation-holds-p relation x y)
       (q33481-relation-holds-p relation y x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q33481-state-member-p states x)
       (q33481-state-member-p states y)
       (q33481-state-member-p states z)
       (q33481-relation-holds-p relation x y)
       (q33481-relation-holds-p relation y z))
      (q33481-relation-holds-p relation x z)))))

(defun q33481-preference-order-p (states relation)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp relation)
   (q33481-preference-order-laws-p states relation)))

(defun q33481-individual-type-p (individuals)
  (and
   (true-listp individuals)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal individuals)))

(defun q33481-alternatives-in-states-p (states alternatives)
  (if (consp alternatives)
      (and
       (q33481-state-member-p states (car alternatives))
       (q33481-alternatives-in-states-p
        states (cdr alternatives)))
    (equal alternatives nil)))

(defun q33481-alternative-set-p (states alternatives)
  (and
   (true-listp alternatives)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal alternatives)
   (q33481-alternatives-in-states-p states alternatives)))

(defun q33481-profile-p (states individuals profile)
  (if (consp individuals)
      (and
       (consp profile)
       (q33481-preference-order-p states (car profile))
       (q33481-profile-p
        states (cdr individuals) (cdr profile)))
    (equal profile nil)))

(defun q33481-strictly-prefers-p
    (relation preferred dispreferred)
  (and
   (q33481-relation-holds-p
    relation preferred dispreferred)
   (not
    (q33481-relation-holds-p
     relation dispreferred preferred))))

;; Agreement on both directions of the weak relation is equivalent, for total
;; preorders, to agreement on the strict and indifferent ordering of the pair.

(defun q33481-same-order-on-pair-p
    (left-relation right-relation x y)
  (and
   (iff
    (q33481-relation-holds-p left-relation x y)
    (q33481-relation-holds-p right-relation x y))
   (iff
    (q33481-relation-holds-p left-relation y x)
    (q33481-relation-holds-p right-relation y x))))

(defun q33481-all-individuals-strictly-prefer-p
    (profile x y)
  (if (consp profile)
      (and
       (q33481-strictly-prefers-p (car profile) x y)
       (q33481-all-individuals-strictly-prefer-p
        (cdr profile) x y))
    (equal profile nil)))

(defun q33481-profiles-same-order-on-pair-p
    (left-profile right-profile x y)
  (if (consp left-profile)
      (and
       (consp right-profile)
       (q33481-same-order-on-pair-p
        (car left-profile) (car right-profile) x y)
       (q33481-profiles-same-order-on-pair-p
        (cdr left-profile) (cdr right-profile) x y))
    (equal right-profile nil)))

(defun-sk q33481-social-welfare-function-p
    (states individuals welfare)
  (forall (profile)
    (implies
     (q33481-profile-p states individuals profile)
     (q33481-preference-order-p
      states
      (q33481-welfare-order welfare profile)))))

(defun-sk q33481-weak-pareto-p
    (states individuals alternatives welfare)
  (forall (x y profile)
    (implies
     (and
      (member-equal x alternatives)
      (member-equal y alternatives)
      (q33481-profile-p states individuals profile)
      (q33481-all-individuals-strictly-prefer-p
       profile x y))
     (q33481-strictly-prefers-p
      (q33481-welfare-order welfare profile)
      x y))))

(defun-sk q33481-independence-of-irrelevant-alternatives-p
    (states individuals alternatives welfare)
  (forall (left-profile right-profile x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (member-equal x alternatives)
      (member-equal y alternatives)
      (q33481-profile-p
       states individuals left-profile)
      (q33481-profile-p
       states individuals right-profile)
      (q33481-profiles-same-order-on-pair-p
       left-profile right-profile x y))
     (q33481-same-order-on-pair-p
      (q33481-welfare-order welfare left-profile)
      (q33481-welfare-order welfare right-profile)
      x y))))

(defun-sk q33481-dictator-at-p
    (states individuals alternatives welfare dictator-index)
  (forall (x y profile)
    (implies
     (and
      (member-equal x alternatives)
      (member-equal y alternatives)
      (q33481-profile-p states individuals profile)
      (q33481-strictly-prefers-p
       (nth dictator-index profile) x y))
     (q33481-strictly-prefers-p
      (q33481-welfare-order welfare profile)
      x y))))

(defun-sk q33481-dictatorship-p
    (states individuals alternatives welfare)
  (exists (dictator-index)
    (and
     (natp dictator-index)
     (< dictator-index (len individuals))
     (q33481-dictator-at-p
      states individuals alternatives welfare dictator-index))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q33481-arrows-impossibility-theorem-statement
    (states individuals alternatives welfare)
  (implies
   (and
    (q33481-individual-type-p individuals)
    (q33481-alternative-set-p states alternatives)
    (<= 3 (len alternatives))
    (q33481-social-welfare-function-p
     states individuals welfare)
    (q33481-weak-pareto-p
     states individuals alternatives welfare)
    (q33481-independence-of-irrelevant-alternatives-p
     states individuals alternatives welfare))
   (q33481-dictatorship-p
    states individuals alternatives welfare)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q33481
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q33481), "Arrow's impossibility theorem": every
-- social welfare function on at least three alternatives that satisfies Weak
-- Pareto and independence of irrelevant alternatives is dictatorial. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

infixr 4 _×_
infix  2 _↔_

data Bottom {p : Level} : Set p where

Not :
  {p : Level} →
  Set p →
  Set p
Not {p} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {p}

record _×_
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : left-proposition
    second : right-proposition

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  left-case  : left-proposition → Either left-proposition right-proposition
  right-case : right-proposition → Either left-proposition right-proposition

record _↔_
  {p q : Level}
  (left-proposition : Set p)
  (right-proposition : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : left-proposition → right-proposition
    backward : right-proposition → left-proposition

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (property : A → Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value     : A
    satisfies : property value

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size        : Nat
    enumeration : Bijection A (Fin size)

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size → A
    injective :
      (i j : Fin size) →
      enumerate i ≡ enumerate j →
      i ≡ j

open FiniteSubset

Member :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  FiniteSubset A →
  A →
  Set a
Member subset x =
  Exists (Fin (size subset))
    (λ index → enumerate subset index ≡ x)

AtLeastThree :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  FiniteSubset A →
  Set
AtLeastThree subset =
  Exists Nat
    (λ remaining →
      size subset ≡ suc (suc (suc remaining)))

record PreferenceOrder
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    relation :
      A →
      A →
      Set a
    reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      relation x x
    total :
      (x y : A) →
      Either (relation x y) (relation y x)
    transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      relation x y →
      relation y z →
      relation x z

open PreferenceOrder

StrictPreference :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  PreferenceOrder A →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
StrictPreference order x y =
  relation order x y
  ×
  Not (relation order y x)

SameOrderOnPair :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  PreferenceOrder A →
  PreferenceOrder A →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
SameOrderOnPair left-order right-order x y =
  (StrictPreference left-order x y
    ↔
   StrictPreference right-order x y)
  ×
  (StrictPreference left-order y x
    ↔
   StrictPreference right-order y x)

SocialWelfareFunction :
  {a i : Level} →
  Set i →
  Set a →
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc a)
SocialWelfareFunction Individuals Alternatives =
  (Individuals → PreferenceOrder Alternatives) →
  PreferenceOrder Alternatives

WeakPareto :
  {a i : Level} →
  {Alternatives : Set a} →
  {Individuals : Set i} →
  SocialWelfareFunction Individuals Alternatives →
  FiniteSubset Alternatives →
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc a)
WeakPareto {Alternatives = Alternatives} {Individuals = Individuals}
  social-choice alternatives =
  (x y : Alternatives) →
  Member alternatives x →
  Member alternatives y →
  (profile : Individuals → PreferenceOrder Alternatives) →
  ((individual : Individuals) →
    StrictPreference (profile individual) x y) →
  StrictPreference (social-choice profile) x y

IndependentOfIrrelevantAlternatives :
  {a i : Level} →
  {Alternatives : Set a} →
  {Individuals : Set i} →
  SocialWelfareFunction Individuals Alternatives →
  FiniteSubset Alternatives →
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc a)
IndependentOfIrrelevantAlternatives
  {Alternatives = Alternatives}
  {Individuals = Individuals}
  social-choice alternatives =
  (left-profile right-profile :
    Individuals → PreferenceOrder Alternatives) →
  (x y : Alternatives) →
  Member alternatives x →
  Member alternatives y →
  ((individual : Individuals) →
    SameOrderOnPair
      (left-profile individual)
      (right-profile individual)
      x
      y) →
  SameOrderOnPair
    (social-choice left-profile)
    (social-choice right-profile)
    x
    y

IsDictatorship :
  {a i : Level} →
  {Alternatives : Set a} →
  {Individuals : Set i} →
  SocialWelfareFunction Individuals Alternatives →
  FiniteSubset Alternatives →
  Set (i ⊔ lsuc a)
IsDictatorship {Alternatives = Alternatives} {Individuals = Individuals}
  social-choice alternatives =
  Exists Individuals
    (λ dictator →
      (x y : Alternatives) →
      Member alternatives x →
      Member alternatives y →
      (profile : Individuals → PreferenceOrder Alternatives) →
      StrictPreference (profile dictator) x y →
      StrictPreference (social-choice profile) x y)

arrow-impossibility-theorem :
  {a i : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ i))
arrow-impossibility-theorem {a} {i} =
  (Alternatives : Set a) →
  (Individuals : Set i) →
  Finite Individuals →
  (alternatives : FiniteSubset Alternatives) →
  (social-choice :
    SocialWelfareFunction Individuals Alternatives) →
  WeakPareto social-choice alternatives →
  IndependentOfIrrelevantAlternatives social-choice alternatives →
  AtLeastThree alternatives →
  IsDictatorship social-choice alternatives

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q33481, "Arrow's impossibility theorem": every social welfare function on
  a finite electorate and at least three alternatives that satisfies weak
  Pareto and independence of irrelevant alternatives is a dictatorship.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val q33481_preference_order_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_preference_order_def",
  ``q33481_preference_order (r : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x. r x x) /\
      (!x y. r x y \/ r y x) /\
      (!x y z. r x y /\ r y z ==> r x z)``);

val q33481_profile_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_profile_def",
  ``q33481_profile
      (V : 'i set) (R : 'i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      !i. i IN V ==> q33481_preference_order (R i)``);

val q33481_same_profile_on_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_same_profile_on_def",
  ``q33481_same_profile_on
      (V : 'i set)
      (R : 'i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (R' : 'i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      !i. i IN V ==> R i = R' i``);

val q33481_strict_preference_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_strict_preference_def",
  ``q33481_strict_preference
      (r : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (x : 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      r x y /\ ~r y x``);

val q33481_same_order_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_same_order_def",
  ``q33481_same_order
      (r : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (r' : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (x : 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      (q33481_strict_preference r x y <=>
       q33481_strict_preference r' x y) /\
      (q33481_strict_preference r y x <=>
       q33481_strict_preference r' y x)``);

val q33481_social_welfare_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_social_welfare_def",
  ``q33481_social_welfare
      (f : ('i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) -> 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (V : 'i set) <=>
      (!R. q33481_profile V R ==>
           q33481_preference_order (f R)) /\
      (!R R'.
         q33481_profile V R /\
         q33481_profile V R' /\
         q33481_same_profile_on V R R'
         ==>
         f R = f R')``);

val q33481_weak_pareto_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_weak_pareto_def",
  ``q33481_weak_pareto
      (f : ('i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) -> 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (V : 'i set) (X : 'a set) <=>
      !x y R.
        x IN X /\
        y IN X /\
        q33481_profile V R /\
        (!i. i IN V ==> q33481_strict_preference (R i) x y)
        ==>
        q33481_strict_preference (f R) x y``);

val q33481_ind_of_irr_alts_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_ind_of_irr_alts_def",
  ``q33481_ind_of_irr_alts
      (f : ('i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) -> 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (V : 'i set) (X : 'a set) <=>
      !R R' x y.
        q33481_profile V R /\
        q33481_profile V R' /\
        x IN X /\
        y IN X /\
        (!i. i IN V ==> q33481_same_order (R i) (R' i) x y)
        ==>
        q33481_same_order (f R) (f R') x y``);

val q33481_is_dictatorship_def = new_definition (
  "q33481_is_dictatorship_def",
  ``q33481_is_dictatorship
      (f : ('i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) -> 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (V : 'i set) (X : 'a set) <=>
      ?i.
        i IN V /\
        !x y R.
          x IN X /\
          y IN X /\
          q33481_profile V R /\
          q33481_strict_preference (R i) x y
          ==>
          q33481_strict_preference (f R) x y``);

val arrow =
  ``!(V : 'i set) (X : 'a set)
      (f : ('i -> 'a -> 'a -> bool) -> 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      FINITE V /\
      FINITE X /\
      q33481_social_welfare f V /\
      q33481_weak_pareto f V X /\
      q33481_ind_of_irr_alts f V X /\
      3 <= CARD X
      ==>
      q33481_is_dictatorship f V X``;

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q33481
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q33481), "Arrow's impossibility theorem":
  every social welfare function on a finite electorate and at least three
  designated alternatives that satisfies weak Pareto and independence of
  irrelevant alternatives is a dictatorship on those alternatives. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A preference order on A is represented by a reflexive, total, transitive
  relation on A. Q33481PrefOrders A is the set of all such relations, and
  Q33481Profiles A I is the full set of I-indexed preference profiles.
  Strict preference is the asymmetric part of a preference order.

  Weak Pareto, independence of irrelevant alternatives, and dictatorship
  are expanded with the same quantifier scopes as the Lean source and are
  restricted only to the finite set X of designated alternatives. The
  ambient alternative set A remains arbitrary. All declarations before the
  final assertion are syntax or faithful definitions; the final $a is the
  unproved corpus statement, and there are no $p declarations.
$)

$c Q33481PrefOrder Q33481PrefOrders Q33481Profiles Q33481Strict
   Q33481SameOrder Q33481WeakPareto Q33481IIA Q33481Dictatorship $.

q33481-pref-order-syntax $a
  wff ( Q33481PrefOrder A R ) $.
q33481-pref-orders-syntax $a
  class ( Q33481PrefOrders A ) $.
q33481-profiles-syntax $a
  class ( Q33481Profiles A I ) $.
q33481-strict-syntax $a
  wff ( Q33481Strict R A B ) $.
q33481-same-order-syntax $a
  wff ( Q33481SameOrder R Q A B ) $.
q33481-weak-pareto-syntax $a
  wff ( Q33481WeakPareto A I X F ) $.
q33481-iia-syntax $a
  wff ( Q33481IIA A I X F ) $.
q33481-dictatorship-syntax $a
  wff ( Q33481Dictatorship A I X F ) $.

${
  $d A R x y z $.

  q33481-pref-order-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481PrefOrder A R )
    <->
    (
      R C_ ( A X. A )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. A x R x
        /\
        (
          A. x e. A A. y e. A ( x R y \/ y R x )
          /\
          A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
            ( ( x R y /\ y R z ) -> x R z )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A r $.

  q33481-pref-orders-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481PrefOrders A )
    =
    { r e. ~P ( A X. A ) | ( Q33481PrefOrder A r ) }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A I $.

  q33481-profiles-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481Profiles A I ) = ( ( Q33481PrefOrders A ) ^m I )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B R $.

  q33481-strict-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481Strict R A B )
    <->
    ( A R B /\ -. B R A )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B Q R $.

  q33481-same-order-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481SameOrder R Q A B )
    <->
    (
      ( ( Q33481Strict R A B ) <-> ( Q33481Strict Q A B ) )
      /\
      ( ( Q33481Strict R B A ) <-> ( Q33481Strict Q B A ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F I X i r x y $.

  q33481-weak-pareto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481WeakPareto A I X F )
    <->
    A. x e. X A. y e. X A. r e. ( Q33481Profiles A I )
      (
        A. i e. I ( Q33481Strict ( r ` i ) x y )
        ->
        ( Q33481Strict ( F ` r ) x y )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F I X i q r x y $.

  q33481-iia-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481IIA A I X F )
    <->
    A. r e. ( Q33481Profiles A I )
      A. q e. ( Q33481Profiles A I )
        A. x e. X A. y e. X
          (
            A. i e. I
              ( Q33481SameOrder ( r ` i ) ( q ` i ) x y )
            ->
            ( Q33481SameOrder ( F ` r ) ( F ` q ) x y )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F I X i r x y $.

  q33481-dictatorship-definition $a |- (
    ( Q33481Dictatorship A I X F )
    <->
    E. i e. I A. x e. X A. y e. X
      A. r e. ( Q33481Profiles A I )
        (
          ( Q33481Strict ( r ` i ) x y )
          ->
          ( Q33481Strict ( F ` r ) x y )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a f j s $.

  thousand-theorems-q33481-arrow-impossibility $a |- (
    A. a A. j A. s A. f
      (
        (
          (
            (
              j e. Fin
              /\
              ( s e. Fin /\ s C_ a )
            )
            /\
            (
              3 <_ ( # ` s )
              /\
              f : ( Q33481Profiles a j ) --> ( Q33481PrefOrders a )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( Q33481WeakPareto a j s f )
            /\
            ( Q33481IIA a j s f )
          )
        )
        ->
        ( Q33481Dictatorship a j s f )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q33481,
:: "Arrow's impossibility theorem": on a finite electorate and a finite set
:: of at least three alternatives, every social welfare function on arbitrary
:: weak preference orders satisfying weak Pareto and independence of irrelevant
:: alternatives is dictatorial on that set. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, FINSET_1, CARD_1,
    XXREAL_0, TARSKI, ARYTM_1, RELAT_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_2, ORDERS_1,
    WELLORD1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, ARYTM_3, ARROW;
  notations ORDERS_1, RELAT_1, RELAT_2, RELSET_1, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1,
    TARSKI, FINSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, ZFMISC_1,
    ORDINAL1, NAT_1, NUMBERS, FINSEQ_1, XCMPLX_0, WELLORD1, ARROW;
  constructors XXREAL_0, FUNCT_2, REAL_1, FINSEQ_1, INT_1, RELAT_2,
    PARTFUN1, WELLORD1, RELSET_1, ARROW;
  registrations RELSET_1, FINSET_1, INT_1, XREAL_0, XBOOLE_0, ORDINAL1,
    ARROW;
  requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;
  definitions FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for U being non empty set,
      I being finite set,
      X being finite Subset of U,
      f being Function of Funcs(I,LinPreorders U),LinPreorders U st
    card X >= 3 &
    (for p being Element of Funcs(I,LinPreorders U),
         x,y being Element of U st
       x in X & y in X &
       (for i being Element of I st i in I holds not [y,x] in p.i)
     holds x <_f.p, y) &
    (for p,p9 being Element of Funcs(I,LinPreorders U),
         x,y being Element of U st
       x in X & y in X &
       (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
         (not [y,x] in p.i iff not [y,x] in p9.i) &
         (not [x,y] in p.i iff not [x,y] in p9.i))
     holds
       (x <_f.p, y iff x <_f.p9, y) &
       (y <_f.p, x iff y <_f.p9, x))
  holds
    ex d being Element of I st d in I &
      for p being Element of Funcs(I,LinPreorders U),
          x,y being Element of U st
        x in X & y in X & not [y,x] in p.d
      holds x <_f.p, y
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q33481,
% "Arrow's impossibility theorem": for at least three alternatives, every social
% welfare function on a finite electorate satisfying Weak Pareto and independence
% of irrelevant alternatives is dictatorial. This file contains no proof.

Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem[
  Alternative: TYPE,
  Voter: TYPE
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Alternative]

  preference_relation: TYPE = [Alternative, Alternative -> bool]

  is_preference_order(r: preference_relation): bool =
    (FORALL (x: Alternative): r(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: Alternative): r(x, y) OR r(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Alternative):
      r(x, y) AND r(y, z) IMPLIES r(x, z))

  preference_order: TYPE =
    {r: preference_relation | is_preference_order(r)}

  profile: TYPE = [Voter -> preference_order]
  social_welfare_function: TYPE = [profile -> preference_order]

  strictly_prefers(
      r: preference_order,
      x, y: Alternative): bool =
    r(x, y) AND NOT r(y, x)

  same_pairwise_order(
      r, s: preference_order,
      x, y: Alternative): bool =
    (strictly_prefers(r, x, y) IFF strictly_prefers(s, x, y))
      AND
    (strictly_prefers(r, y, x) IFF strictly_prefers(s, y, x))

  weak_pareto(
      f: social_welfare_function,
      X: finite_set[Alternative]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: Alternative), (R: profile):
      (member(x, X)
        AND member(y, X)
        AND
          (FORALL (i: Voter):
            strictly_prefers(R(i), x, y)))
      IMPLIES strictly_prefers(f(R), x, y)

  independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives(
      f: social_welfare_function,
      X: finite_set[Alternative]): bool =
    FORALL (R, S: profile), (x, y: Alternative):
      (member(x, X)
        AND member(y, X)
        AND
          (FORALL (i: Voter):
            same_pairwise_order(R(i), S(i), x, y)))
      IMPLIES same_pairwise_order(f(R), f(S), x, y)

  is_dictatorship(
      f: social_welfare_function,
      X: finite_set[Alternative]): bool =
    EXISTS (i: Voter):
      FORALL (x, y: Alternative), (R: profile):
        (member(x, X)
          AND member(y, X)
          AND strictly_prefers(R(i), x, y))
        IMPLIES strictly_prefers(f(R), x, y)

  arrow: bool =
    is_finite_type[Voter]
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
            (f: social_welfare_function),
            (X: finite_set[Alternative]):
          (weak_pareto(f, X)
            AND independence_of_irrelevant_alternatives(f, X)
            AND 3 <= card(X))
          IMPLIES is_dictatorship(f, X)
END Q33481_arrow_s_impossibility_theorem

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3526996
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3526996), "Kolmogorov extension theorem": every
-- projective family of finite measures on finite products of Polish spaces has
-- a projective-limit measure on the full product. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.ProjectiveFamilyContent
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.RegularityCompacts
public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.OuterMeasure.OfAddContent

@[expose] public section

open Set

namespace MeasureTheory

variable {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Type*} [∀ i, MeasurableSpace (α i)]
  [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (α i)] [∀ i, BorelSpace (α i)]
  [∀ i, PolishSpace (α i)]
  {P : ∀ J : Finset ι, Measure (Π j : J, α j)}
  [∀ I, IsFiniteMeasure (P I)]

/-- Sigma-subadditivity needed to construct the projective-limit measure from
the projective-family content. -/
theorem projectiveFamilyContent_iUnion_le_sum_Q3526996
    (hP : IsProjectiveMeasureFamily P)
    ⦃f : ℕ → Set (Π i, α i)⦄
    (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ measurableCylinders α)
    (hf_Union : (⋃ i, f i) ∈ measurableCylinders α) :
    projectiveFamilyContent hP (⋃ i, f i) ≤
      ∑' i, projectiveFamilyContent hP (f i) := sorry

/-- The canonical projective-limit measure obtained from the projective-family content. -/
noncomputable def projectiveLimit_Q3526996
    (P : ∀ J : Finset ι, Measure (Π j : J, α j))
    [∀ I, IsFiniteMeasure (P I)] (hP : IsProjectiveMeasureFamily P) :
    Measure (Π i, α i) :=
  (projectiveFamilyContent hP).measure isSetSemiring_measurableCylinders
    generateFrom_measurableCylinders.symm.le
    (projectiveFamilyContent_iUnion_le_sum_Q3526996 hP)

/-- The Kolmogorov extension theorem: the canonical projective-limit measure
has the prescribed finite-dimensional marginals. -/
theorem isProjectiveLimit_projectiveLimit_Q3526996
    (hP : IsProjectiveMeasureFamily P) :
    IsProjectiveLimit (projectiveLimit_Q3526996 P hP) P := sorry

end MeasureTheory

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3526996
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3526996), "Kolmogorov extension theorem": every
  projectively consistent family of finite measures on finite products of
  Polish spaces extends to a measure on the full product with the prescribed
  finite-dimensional marginals. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3526996_event (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q3526996_empty {A : Type} : q3526996_event A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q3526996_full {A : Type} : q3526996_event A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q3526996_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q3526996_event A) : q3526996_event A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q3526996_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q3526996_event A) : q3526996_event A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q3526996_same_event {A : Type}
    (E F : q3526996_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q3526996_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q3526996_event A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j ->
    forall x : A, ~ (E i x /\ E j x).

Record q3526996_metric_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3526996_dist : A -> A -> R;
  q3526996_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : A, 0 <= q3526996_dist x y;
  q3526996_dist_eq_zero :
    forall x y : A, q3526996_dist x y = 0 <-> x = y;
  q3526996_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : A, q3526996_dist x y = q3526996_dist y x;
  q3526996_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : A,
      q3526996_dist x z <=
      q3526996_dist x y + q3526996_dist y z
}.

Arguments q3526996_dist {A} _ _ _.

Definition q3526996_metric_open {A : Type}
    (d : q3526996_metric_space A)
    (U : q3526996_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : A, q3526996_dist d x y < epsilon -> U y.

Definition q3526996_metric_converges {A : Type}
    (d : q3526996_metric_space A)
    (u : nat -> A) (x : A) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat, (N <= n)%nat ->
        q3526996_dist d (u n) x < epsilon.

Definition q3526996_metric_cauchy {A : Type}
    (d : q3526996_metric_space A)
    (u : nat -> A) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R, 0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q3526996_dist d (u m) (u n) < epsilon.

Definition q3526996_complete {A : Type}
    (d : q3526996_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> A,
    q3526996_metric_cauchy d u ->
    exists x : A, q3526996_metric_converges d u x.

Definition q3526996_second_countable {A : Type}
    (d : q3526996_metric_space A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q3526996_event A,
    (forall n : nat, q3526996_metric_open d (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q3526996_event A) (x : A),
      q3526996_metric_open d U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\
        forall y : A, basis n y -> U y.

Record q3526996_polish_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3526996_polish_metric : q3526996_metric_space A;
  q3526996_polish_complete :
    q3526996_complete q3526996_polish_metric;
  q3526996_polish_second_countable :
    q3526996_second_countable q3526996_polish_metric
}.

Inductive q3526996_borel {A : Type}
    (S : q3526996_polish_space A)
    : q3526996_event A -> Prop :=
| q3526996_borel_open :
    forall U : q3526996_event A,
      q3526996_metric_open (q3526996_polish_metric S) U ->
      q3526996_borel S U
| q3526996_borel_empty :
    q3526996_borel S q3526996_empty
| q3526996_borel_ext :
    forall E F : q3526996_event A,
      q3526996_borel S E ->
      q3526996_same_event E F ->
      q3526996_borel S F
| q3526996_borel_complement :
    forall E : q3526996_event A,
      q3526996_borel S E ->
      q3526996_borel S (q3526996_complement E)
| q3526996_borel_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q3526996_event A,
      (forall n : nat, q3526996_borel S (E n)) ->
      q3526996_borel S (q3526996_countable_union E).

Record q3526996_finite_set (I : Type) : Type := {
  q3526996_finite_member : I -> Prop;
  q3526996_finite_enumeration :
    exists enumeration : list I,
      forall i : I,
        q3526996_finite_member i <-> In i enumeration
}.

Arguments q3526996_finite_member {I} _ _.

Definition q3526996_finite_subset {I : Type}
    (J K : q3526996_finite_set I) : Prop :=
  forall i : I,
    q3526996_finite_member J i ->
    q3526996_finite_member K i.

Record q3526996_finite_tuple
    {I : Type} (alpha : I -> Type)
    (J : q3526996_finite_set I) : Type := {
  q3526996_finite_tuple_value :
    forall i : I, q3526996_finite_member J i -> alpha i;
  q3526996_finite_tuple_membership_irrelevant :
    forall (i : I)
      (p q : q3526996_finite_member J i),
      q3526996_finite_tuple_value i p =
      q3526996_finite_tuple_value i q
}.

Arguments q3526996_finite_tuple_value
  {I alpha J} _ i _.

Definition q3526996_finite_restrict
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    {J K : q3526996_finite_set I}
    (hJK : q3526996_finite_subset J K)
    (x : q3526996_finite_tuple alpha K)
    : q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J :=
  {|
    q3526996_finite_tuple_value :=
      fun i hi =>
        q3526996_finite_tuple_value x i (hJK i hi);
    q3526996_finite_tuple_membership_irrelevant :=
      fun i p q =>
        q3526996_finite_tuple_membership_irrelevant
          x i (hJK i p) (hJK i q)
  |}.

Definition q3526996_full_tuple
    {I : Type} (alpha : I -> Type) : Type :=
  forall i : I, alpha i.

Definition q3526996_full_restrict
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    (J : q3526996_finite_set I)
    (x : q3526996_full_tuple alpha)
    : q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J :=
  {|
    q3526996_finite_tuple_value := fun i _ => x i;
    q3526996_finite_tuple_membership_irrelevant :=
      fun _ _ _ => eq_refl
  |}.

Inductive q3526996_finite_measurable
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    (spaces : forall i : I, q3526996_polish_space (alpha i))
    (J : q3526996_finite_set I)
    : q3526996_event (q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J) -> Prop :=
| q3526996_finite_measurable_coordinate :
    forall (i : I)
      (hi : q3526996_finite_member J i)
      (E : q3526996_event (alpha i)),
      q3526996_borel (spaces i) E ->
      @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J
        (fun x =>
          E (q3526996_finite_tuple_value x i hi))
| q3526996_finite_measurable_empty :
    @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J q3526996_empty
| q3526996_finite_measurable_ext :
    forall E F :
      q3526996_event (q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J),
      @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J E ->
      q3526996_same_event E F ->
      @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J F
| q3526996_finite_measurable_complement :
    forall E :
      q3526996_event (q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J),
      @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J E ->
      @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J
        (q3526996_complement E)
| q3526996_finite_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E :
      nat -> q3526996_event (q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J),
      (forall n : nat,
        @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J (E n)) ->
      @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J
        (q3526996_countable_union E).

Inductive q3526996_product_measurable
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    (spaces : forall i : I, q3526996_polish_space (alpha i))
    : q3526996_event (q3526996_full_tuple alpha) -> Prop :=
| q3526996_product_measurable_coordinate :
    forall (i : I) (E : q3526996_event (alpha i)),
      q3526996_borel (spaces i) E ->
      @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces
        (fun x => E (x i))
| q3526996_product_measurable_empty :
    @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces q3526996_empty
| q3526996_product_measurable_ext :
    forall E F : q3526996_event (q3526996_full_tuple alpha),
      @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces E ->
      q3526996_same_event E F ->
      @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces F
| q3526996_product_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q3526996_event (q3526996_full_tuple alpha),
      @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces E ->
      @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces
        (q3526996_complement E)
| q3526996_product_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat ->
      q3526996_event (q3526996_full_tuple alpha),
      (forall n : nat,
        @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces (E n)) ->
      @q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces
        (q3526996_countable_union E).

Inductive q3526996_ennreal : Type :=
| q3526996_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q3526996_ennreal
| q3526996_ennreal_infinity : q3526996_ennreal.

Arguments q3526996_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q3526996_ennreal_zero : q3526996_ennreal :=
  q3526996_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q3526996_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q3526996_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3526996_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3526996_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q3526996_ennreal_infinity,
    q3526996_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q3526996_ennreal_le
    (x y : q3526996_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3526996_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3526996_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q3526996_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q3526996_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q3526996_ennreal_infinity,
    q3526996_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q3526996_ennreal_infinity,
    q3526996_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q3526996_ennreal_add
    (x y : q3526996_ennreal) : q3526996_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q3526996_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q3526996_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q3526996_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q3526996_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q3526996_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q3526996_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q3526996_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q3526996_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q3526996_ennreal_add
        (q3526996_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q3526996_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q3526996_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q3526996_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q3526996_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q3526996_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q3526996_ennreal,
      (forall value : q3526996_ennreal,
        values value ->
        q3526996_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q3526996_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q3526996_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q3526996_ennreal)
    (sum : q3526996_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q3526996_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q3526996_ennreal_eq value
          (q3526996_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Record q3526996_measure {A : Type}
    (M : q3526996_event A -> Prop) : Type := {
  q3526996_measure_value :
    q3526996_event A -> q3526996_ennreal;
  q3526996_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q3526996_event A,
      q3526996_same_event E F ->
      q3526996_ennreal_eq
        (q3526996_measure_value E)
        (q3526996_measure_value F);
  q3526996_measure_empty :
    q3526996_ennreal_eq
      (q3526996_measure_value q3526996_empty)
      q3526996_ennreal_zero;
  q3526996_measure_countably_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q3526996_event A,
      (forall n : nat, M (E n)) ->
      q3526996_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q3526996_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q3526996_measure_value (E n))
        (q3526996_measure_value
          (q3526996_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q3526996_measure_value {A M} _ _.

Definition q3526996_finite_measure
    {A : Type} {M : q3526996_event A -> Prop}
    (mu : q3526996_measure M) : Prop :=
  exists value : R,
    exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
      q3526996_ennreal_eq
        (q3526996_measure_value mu q3526996_full)
        (q3526996_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q3526996_measure_family
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    (spaces : forall i : I, q3526996_polish_space (alpha i))
    : Type :=
  forall J : q3526996_finite_set I,
    q3526996_measure
      (@q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J).

Definition q3526996_is_projective_measure_family
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    {spaces : forall i : I, q3526996_polish_space (alpha i)}
    (P : q3526996_measure_family spaces) : Prop :=
  forall (K J : q3526996_finite_set I)
    (hJK : q3526996_finite_subset J K)
    (E : q3526996_event (q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J)),
    @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J E ->
    q3526996_ennreal_eq
      (q3526996_measure_value (P J) E)
      (q3526996_measure_value (P K)
        (fun x =>
          E (q3526996_finite_restrict hJK x))).

Definition q3526996_is_projective_limit
    {I : Type} {alpha : I -> Type}
    {spaces : forall i : I, q3526996_polish_space (alpha i)}
    (mu : q3526996_measure
      (@q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces))
    (P : q3526996_measure_family spaces) : Prop :=
  forall (J : q3526996_finite_set I)
    (E : q3526996_event (q3526996_finite_tuple alpha J)),
    @q3526996_finite_measurable I alpha spaces J E ->
    q3526996_ennreal_eq
      (q3526996_measure_value mu
        (fun x => E (q3526996_full_restrict J x)))
      (q3526996_measure_value (P J) E).

Theorem MeasureTheory_isProjectiveLimit_projectiveLimit :
  forall (I : Type) (alpha : I -> Type)
    (spaces : forall i : I,
      q3526996_polish_space (alpha i))
    (P : q3526996_measure_family spaces),
    (forall J : q3526996_finite_set I,
      q3526996_finite_measure (P J)) ->
    q3526996_is_projective_measure_family P ->
    exists mu : q3526996_measure
      (@q3526996_product_measurable I alpha spaces),
      q3526996_is_projective_limit mu P.
Admitted.

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3526996, "Kolmogorov extension theorem": every projective family of finite
  measures on the finite products of Polish coordinate spaces has a measure
  on the full dependent product with exactly those finite-dimensional
  marginals. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
  imports "HOL.Complex_Main"
begin

type_synonym 'a q3526996_measurable_space = "'a set \<times> 'a set set"
type_synonym 'a q3526996_finite_measure = "'a set \<Rightarrow> real"

definition q3526996_space ::
    "'a q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q3526996_space M = fst M"

definition q3526996_sets ::
    "'a q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> 'a set set" where
  "q3526996_sets M = snd M"

definition q3526996_sigma_field ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3526996_sigma_field \<Omega> A \<longleftrightarrow>
    A \<subseteq> Pow \<Omega> \<and>
    {} \<in> A \<and>
    (\<forall>E \<in> A. \<Omega> - E \<in> A) \<and>
    (\<forall>E :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. E n \<in> A) \<longrightarrow> (\<Union>n. E n) \<in> A)"

definition q3526996_generated ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set" where
  "q3526996_generated \<Omega> G =
    \<Inter>{A. q3526996_sigma_field \<Omega> A \<and> G \<subseteq> A}"

definition q3526996_measurable_space ::
    "'a q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> bool" where
