  "q3526996_measurable_space M \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3526996_sigma_field (q3526996_space M) (q3526996_sets M)"

definition q3526996_real_borel_sets :: "real set set" where
  "q3526996_real_borel_sets =
    q3526996_generated UNIV {U :: real set. open U}"

definition q3526996_standard_borel_space ::
    "'a q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3526996_standard_borel_space M \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3526996_measurable_space M \<and>
    (\<exists>code :: 'a \<Rightarrow> real.
      inj_on code (q3526996_space M) \<and>
      code ` q3526996_space M \<in> q3526996_real_borel_sets \<and>
      (\<forall>A.
        A \<in> q3526996_sets M \<longleftrightarrow>
        A \<subseteq> q3526996_space M \<and>
        (\<exists>B \<in> q3526996_real_borel_sets.
          A = q3526996_space M \<inter> code -` B)))"

definition q3526996_pie ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) set" where
  "q3526996_pie I X =
    {x. (\<forall>i \<in> I. x i \<in> X i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i. i \<notin> I \<longrightarrow> x i = undefined)}"

definition q3526996_restrict ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a)" where
  "q3526996_restrict x I =
    (\<lambda>i. if i \<in> I then x i else undefined)"

definition q3526996_product_space ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a q3526996_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_measurable_space" where
  "q3526996_product_space I M =
    (q3526996_pie I (\<lambda>i. q3526996_space (M i)),
     q3526996_generated
       (q3526996_pie I (\<lambda>i. q3526996_space (M i)))
       {C. \<exists>i \<in> I. \<exists>E \<in> q3526996_sets (M i).
         C = {x \<in> q3526996_pie I
           (\<lambda>j. q3526996_space (M j)). x i \<in> E}})"

definition q3526996_is_finite_measure ::
    "'a q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     'a q3526996_finite_measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3526996_is_finite_measure M \<mu> \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3526996_measurable_space M \<and>
    (\<forall>E. \<mu> E = \<mu> (E \<inter> q3526996_space M)) \<and>
    \<mu> {} = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>E \<in> q3526996_sets M. 0 \<le> \<mu> E) \<and>
    (\<forall>E :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. E n \<in> q3526996_sets M) \<and>
      (\<forall>i j. i \<noteq> j \<longrightarrow> E i \<inter> E j = {})
      \<longrightarrow>
      summable (\<lambda>n. \<mu> (E n)) \<and>
      \<mu> (\<Union>n. E n) = suminf (\<lambda>n. \<mu> (E n)))"

definition q3526996_pushforward ::
    "'a q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     'b q3526996_measurable_space \<Rightarrow>
     ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow>
     'a q3526996_finite_measure \<Rightarrow>
     'b q3526996_finite_measure" where
  "q3526996_pushforward A B f \<mu> E =
    \<mu> {x \<in> q3526996_space A.
      f x \<in> E \<inter> q3526996_space B}"

definition q3526996_projective_measure_family ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a q3526996_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_finite_measure) \<Rightarrow>
     bool" where
  "q3526996_projective_measure_family M P \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>J. finite J \<longrightarrow>
      q3526996_is_finite_measure
        (q3526996_product_space J M) (P J)) \<and>
    (\<forall>J K. J \<subseteq> K \<longrightarrow> finite K \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>E \<in> q3526996_sets (q3526996_product_space J M).
        P J E =
          q3526996_pushforward
            (q3526996_product_space K M)
            (q3526996_product_space J M)
            (\<lambda>x. q3526996_restrict x J) (P K) E))"

definition q3526996_is_projective_limit ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a q3526996_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_finite_measure) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_finite_measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3526996_is_projective_limit M P \<mu> \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3526996_is_finite_measure
      (q3526996_product_space UNIV M) \<mu> \<and>
    (\<forall>J. finite J \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>E \<in> q3526996_sets (q3526996_product_space J M).
        q3526996_pushforward
          (q3526996_product_space UNIV M)
          (q3526996_product_space J M)
          (\<lambda>x. q3526996_restrict x J) \<mu> E = P J E))"

definition q3526996_projective_limit ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'a q3526996_measurable_space) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_finite_measure) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_finite_measure" where
  "q3526996_projective_limit M P =
    (SOME \<mu>. q3526996_is_projective_limit M P \<mu>)"

theorem kolmogorov_extension_theorem:
  fixes M :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a q3526996_measurable_space"
    and P ::
      "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a) q3526996_finite_measure"
  assumes polish_coordinates:
      "\<forall>i. q3526996_standard_borel_space (M i)"
    and projective:
      "q3526996_projective_measure_family M P"
  shows
      "q3526996_is_projective_limit M P
        (q3526996_projective_limit M P)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3526996,
  "Kolmogorov extension theorem": a projective family of finite measures on
  the finite products of arbitrary Polish coordinate spaces has a measure on
  the full product with exactly those finite-dimensional marginals. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q3526996_KOLMOGOROV_EXTENSION_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(space:(I->V)->bool)
       (events:((I->V)->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events space /\
        (!s:(I->V)->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET space) /\
        (!s:(I->V)->bool.
           events s ==> events (space DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->(I->V)->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:I->V | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let product_space =
      \(carrier:I->V->bool) (J:I->bool).
        {x:I->V | !i:I. i IN J ==> carrier i (x i)} in
   let metric_space_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real).
        (!x y:V.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==> &0 <= d x y) /\
        (!x y:V.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
           ==> (d x y = &0 <=> x = y)) /\
        (!x y:V.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier
           ==> d x y = d y x) /\
        (!x y z:V.
           x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier
           ==> d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let metric_open_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real) (u:V->bool).
        u SUBSET carrier /\
        (!x:V.
           x IN u
           ==> ?epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon /\
                 !y:V.
                   y IN carrier /\ d y x < epsilon
                   ==> y IN u) in
   let metric_tends_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real)
       (u:num->V) (l:V).
        l IN carrier /\
        (!n:num. u n IN carrier) /\
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num.
                 !n:num.
                   N <= n ==> d (u n) l < epsilon) in
   let cauchy_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real) (u:num->V).
        (!n:num. u n IN carrier) /\
        (!epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num.
                 !m n:num.
                   N <= m /\ N <= n
                   ==> d (u m) (u n) < epsilon) in
   let complete_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real).
        !u:num->V.
          cauchy_on carrier d u
          ==> ?l:V. metric_tends_on carrier d u l in
   let second_countable_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real).
        ?basis:(V->bool)->bool.
          COUNTABLE basis /\
          (!b:V->bool.
             b IN basis ==> metric_open_on carrier d b) /\
          (!u:V->bool x:V.
             metric_open_on carrier d u /\ x IN u
             ==> ?b:V->bool.
                   b IN basis /\ x IN b /\ b SUBSET u) in
   let polish_space_on =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real).
        metric_space_on carrier d /\
        complete_on carrier d /\
        second_countable_on carrier d in
   let borel_events =
      \(carrier:V->bool) (d:V->V->real) (s:V->bool).
        !events:(V->bool)->bool.
          (events {} /\
           events carrier /\
           (!u:V->bool. events u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
           (!u:V->bool.
              events u ==> events (carrier DIFF u)) /\
           (!sets:num->V->bool.
              (!n. events (sets n))
              ==> events {x:V | ?n:num. x IN sets n})) /\
          (!u:V->bool.
             metric_open_on carrier d u ==> events u)
          ==> events s in
   let product_events =
      \(carrier:I->V->bool) (d:I->V->V->real)
       (J:I->bool) (s:(I->V)->bool).
        !events:((I->V)->bool)->bool.
          sigma_algebra (product_space carrier J) events /\
          (!i:I u:V->bool.
             i IN J /\ borel_events (carrier i) (d i) u
             ==> events
                   {x:I->V |
                      x IN product_space carrier J /\
                      x i IN u})
          ==> events s in
   let measure_space =
      \(space:(I->V)->bool)
       (events:((I->V)->bool)->bool)
       (mu:((I->V)->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra space events /\
        (!s:(I->V)->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        (!s:(I->V)->bool. mu s = mu (s INTER space)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->(I->V)->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n:num.
              ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum
                 (\n:num. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:I->V | ?n:num. x IN sets n})) in
   let finite_measure_space =
      \(space:(I->V)->bool)
       (events:((I->V)->bool)->bool)
       (mu:((I->V)->bool)->bool#real).
        measure_space space events mu /\
        ~(FST (mu space)) in
   let projective_measure_family =
      \(carrier:I->V->bool) (d:I->V->V->real)
       (P:(I->bool)->((I->V)->bool)->bool#real).
        (!J:I->bool.
           FINITE J
           ==> finite_measure_space
                 (product_space carrier J)
                 (product_events carrier d J)
                 (P J)) /\
        (!K J:I->bool s:(I->V)->bool.
           FINITE K /\
           FINITE J /\
           K SUBSET J /\
           product_events carrier d K s
           ==> P J (s INTER product_space carrier J) = P K s) in
   let is_projective_limit =
      \(carrier:I->V->bool) (d:I->V->V->real)
       (mu:((I->V)->bool)->bool#real)
       (P:(I->bool)->((I->V)->bool)->bool#real).
        measure_space
          (product_space carrier (:I))
          (product_events carrier d (:I))
          mu /\
        (!J:I->bool s:(I->V)->bool.
           FINITE J /\
           product_events carrier d J s
           ==> mu
                 (s INTER product_space carrier (:I)) =
               P J s) in
   let projective_limit =
      \(carrier:I->V->bool) (d:I->V->V->real)
       (P:(I->bool)->((I->V)->bool)->bool#real).
        @mu:((I->V)->bool)->bool#real.
          is_projective_limit carrier d mu P in
   !carrier:I->V->bool
    d:I->V->V->real
    P:(I->bool)->((I->V)->bool)->bool#real.
      (!i:I. polish_space_on (carrier i) (d i)) /\
      projective_measure_family carrier d P
      ==>
      is_projective_limit
        carrier d (projective_limit carrier d P) P`;;

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3526996,
;; "Kolmogorov extension theorem": a projectively consistent family of finite
;; measures on all finite products of arbitrary Polish Borel coordinate spaces
;; extends to a measure on the unrestricted dependent product with exactly
;; those finite-dimensional marginals. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Carriers, sets, functions, topologies, sigma algebras, and measures are
;; unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The quantified predicates below impose the real
;; field, metric, Polish, Borel, dependent-product, and countable-additivity
;; laws explicitly.  Finite coordinate sets are represented by finite lists,
;; but neither the index carrier nor any coordinate carrier is made finite.

(defstub q3526996-domain-member-p (domain object) t)
(defstub q3526996-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q3526996-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q3526996-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q3526996-sequence-at (sequence index) t)
(defstub q3526996-open-set-p (topology set) t)
(defstub q3526996-measurable-set-p (sigma set) t)

(defstub q3526996-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q3526996-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q3526996-empty-set (domain) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-set (domain) t)
(defstub q3526996-complement-set (domain set) t)
(defstub q3526996-intersection-set (domain left right) t)
(defstub q3526996-countable-union-set (domain sequence) t)
(defstub q3526996-arbitrary-union-set (domain family) t)

(defstub q3526996-measure-value (measure set) t)

(defstub q3526996-state-domain (spaces index) t)
(defstub q3526996-state-topology (spaces index) t)
(defstub q3526996-state-sigma (spaces index) t)
(defstub q3526996-metric-distance (metric left right) t)
(defstub q3526996-open-ball (real domain metric center radius) t)

(defstub q3526996-finite-product-domain (spaces index-set) t)
(defstub q3526996-finite-product-sigma (spaces index-set) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-product-domain (spaces index-domain) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-product-sigma (spaces index-domain) t)
(defstub q3526996-finite-coordinate
  (spaces index-set tuple index) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-coordinate
  (spaces index-domain tuple index) t)
(defstub q3526996-finite-restrict
  (spaces larger-set smaller-set tuple) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-restrict
  (spaces index-domain index-set tuple) t)
(defstub q3526996-finite-coordinate-cylinder
  (spaces index-set index state-set) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-coordinate-cylinder
  (spaces index-domain index state-set) t)
(defstub q3526996-finite-restriction-preimage
  (spaces larger-set smaller-set set) t)
(defstub q3526996-full-restriction-preimage
  (spaces index-domain index-set set) t)

(defstub q3526996-family-measure (measure-family index-set) t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers used for both
;; metric distances and the finite values of the source's finite measures.

(defun q3526996-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q3526996-r-less real right left)))

(defun q3526996-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q3526996-r-member-p real value)
   (q3526996-r-less
    real (q3526996-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q3526996-r-nonnegative-p (real value)
  (and
   (q3526996-r-member-p real value)
   (q3526996-r-leq
    real (q3526996-r-zero real) value)))

(defun-sk q3526996-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3526996-r-member-p real x)
      (q3526996-r-member-p real y)
      (q3526996-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q3526996-r-zero real))
            (one (q3526996-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q3526996-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q3526996-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q3526996-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q3526996-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q3526996-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q3526996-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q3526996-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q3526996-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q3526996-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q3526996-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q3526996-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q3526996-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3526996-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q3526996-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q3526996-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q3526996-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q3526996-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q3526996-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q3526996-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q3526996-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3526996-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3526996-r-multiply
          real x (q3526996-r-add real y z))
         (q3526996-r-add
          real
          (q3526996-r-multiply real x y)
          (q3526996-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3526996-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3526996-r-member-p real x)
      (q3526996-r-member-p real y)
      (q3526996-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q3526996-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q3526996-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q3526996-r-less real x y)
         (q3526996-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3526996-r-less real x y)
          (q3526996-r-less real y z))
         (q3526996-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q3526996-r-less real x y)
         (q3526996-r-less
          real
          (q3526996-r-add real x z)
          (q3526996-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3526996-r-less real zero x)
          (q3526996-r-less real zero y))
         (q3526996-r-less
          real zero
          (q3526996-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q3526996-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q3526996-r-member-p real x)

(defun-sk q3526996-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3526996-r-member-p real bound)
     (q3526996-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q3526996-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q3526996-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q3526996-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3526996-r-member-p real bound)
       (q3526996-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q3526996-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q3526996-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)

    (q3526996-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3526996-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)

      (q3526996-r-set-nonempty-p real set)

(defun q3526996-real-field-p (real)

        (one (q3526996-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q3526996-r-member-p real zero)

     (not (equal zero one))
     (q3526996-r-field-laws-p real)

(defun-sk q3526996-valid-set-p (domain set)

  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q3526996-set-member-p left x)
      (q3526996-set-member-p right x)))))

  (forall (x)
    (implies

      (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)

     (q3526996-set-member-p right x))))

      (natp m)
      (natp n)

     (not
      (and
       (q3526996-set-member-p
        (q3526996-sequence-at sequence m) x)
       (q3526996-set-member-p
        (q3526996-sequence-at sequence n) x))))))

     (q3526996-set-member-p

(defun-sk q3526996-family-union-member-p (family x)

    (and
     (q3526996-family-member-p family set)

(defun-sk q3526996-basic-set-constructor-laws-p (domain)
  (forall (left right sequence family x)
    (and
     (iff
      (q3526996-set-member-p
       (q3526996-empty-set domain) x)
      nil)
     (iff
      (q3526996-set-member-p
       (q3526996-full-set domain) x)
      (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x))
     (implies
      (q3526996-valid-set-p domain left)
      (iff
       (q3526996-set-member-p
        (q3526996-complement-set domain left) x)
       (and
        (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
        (not (q3526996-set-member-p left x)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3526996-valid-set-p domain left)
       (q3526996-valid-set-p domain right))
      (iff
       (q3526996-set-member-p
        (q3526996-intersection-set domain left right) x)
       (and
        (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
        (q3526996-set-member-p left x)
        (q3526996-set-member-p right x))))
     (implies
      (q3526996-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (iff
       (q3526996-set-member-p
        (q3526996-countable-union-set domain sequence) x)
       (and
        (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
        (q3526996-sequence-union-member-p sequence x))))
     (implies
      (q3526996-family-valid-p domain family)
      (iff
       (q3526996-set-member-p
        (q3526996-arbitrary-union-set domain family) x)
       (and
        (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
        (q3526996-family-union-member-p family x)))))))

(defun-sk q3526996-topology-members-valid-p (domain topology)

(defun q3526996-sigma-algebra-p (domain sigma)

;; Finite, countably additive measures.  Since every value lies in the real
;; carrier, this is the finite-measure specialization of ENNReal-valued measure.

(defun q3526996-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q3526996-r-zero real)
    (q3526996-r-add
     real
     (q3526996-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (- count 1))
     (q3526996-measure-value
      measure
      (q3526996-sequence-at sequence (- count 1))))))

(defun-sk q3526996-measure-prefix-sums-bounded-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q3526996-r-leq
      real
      (q3526996-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q3526996-measure-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q3526996-r-member-p real total)
     (q3526996-measure-prefix-sums-bounded-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3526996-r-member-p real bound)
       (q3526996-measure-prefix-sums-bounded-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q3526996-r-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q3526996-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q3526996-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q3526996-measure-value measure left)
      (q3526996-measure-value measure right)))))

  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q3526996-measurable-set-p sigma set)
     (q3526996-r-nonnegative-p
      real (q3526996-measure-value measure set)))))

    (real domain sigma measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3526996-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q3526996-measurable-sequence-p sigma sequence)
      (q3526996-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence))
     (q3526996-measure-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q3526996-measure-value
       measure
       (q3526996-countable-union-set domain sequence))))))

(defun q3526996-finite-measure-p
    (real domain sigma measure)
  (and
   (q3526996-sigma-algebra-p domain sigma)
   (q3526996-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q3526996-measure-values-p real sigma measure)
   (equal
    (q3526996-measure-value
     measure (q3526996-empty-set domain))
    (q3526996-r-zero real))
   (q3526996-countably-additive-p
    real domain sigma measure)))

(defun-sk q3526996-metric-laws-p (real domain metric)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q3526996-domain-member-p domain y)
      (q3526996-domain-member-p domain z))
     (let ((dxy (q3526996-metric-distance metric x y))
           (dyx (q3526996-metric-distance metric y x))
           (dxz (q3526996-metric-distance metric x z))
           (dyz (q3526996-metric-distance metric y z)))
       (and
        (q3526996-r-nonnegative-p real dxy)
        (q3526996-r-nonnegative-p real dyx)
        (q3526996-r-nonnegative-p real dxz)
        (q3526996-r-nonnegative-p real dyz)
        (iff
         (equal dxy (q3526996-r-zero real))
         (equal x y))
        (equal dxy dyx)
        (q3526996-r-leq
         real dxz
         (q3526996-r-add real dxy dyz)))))))

  (forall (center radius x)
    (implies
     (and

      (q3526996-r-positive-p real radius))
     (iff
      (q3526996-set-member-p
       (q3526996-open-ball
        real domain metric center radius)
       x)
      (and
       (q3526996-domain-member-p domain x)
       (q3526996-r-less
        real
        (q3526996-metric-distance metric center x)
        radius))))))

  (forall (x)
    (implies

(defun-sk q3526996-finite-coordinate-typing-p

      (q3526996-domain-member-p

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3526996,
-- "Kolmogorov extension theorem": a projective family of finite Borel measures
-- on finite subproducts of Polish spaces extends to a measure on the full
-- dependent product with exactly those finite-dimensional marginals. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe --prop #-}

module Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_; Prop; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Bottom {p : Level} : Prop p where

record Top {p : Level} : Prop p where
  constructor top

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Prop p ->
  Prop p
Not {p} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {p}

record Both
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (A : Prop p)
  (B : Prop q) :
  Prop (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Prop p) :
  Prop (a ⊔ p) where

  witness :
    (value : A) ->
    P value ->
    Exists A P

infix 4 _==N_ _!=N_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixl 6 _+N_
infixl 7 _*N_

data _==N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  reflN : {n : Nat} -> n ==N n

_!=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m !=N n =
  Not (m ==N n)

_+N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero +N n =
  n
suc m +N n =
  suc (m +N n)

_*N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
zero *N n =
  zero
suc m *N n =
  n +N (m *N n)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Prop
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record Rational : Set where
  constructor rational
  field
    positivePart    : Nat
    negativePart    : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open Rational

denominatorValue : Rational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

denominatorProductCode : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductCode d e =
  d +N (e +N (d *N e))

zeroQ : Rational
zeroQ =
  rational zero zero zero

addQ : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addQ q r =
  rational
    ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (positivePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    ((negativePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
     (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
    (denominatorProductCode (denominatorCode q) (denominatorCode r))

RationalEqual : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalEqual q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  ==N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLE : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalLE q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <=N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

RationalLT : Rational -> Rational -> Prop
RationalLT q r =
  ((positivePart q *N denominatorValue r) +N
   (negativePart r *N denominatorValue q))
  <N
  ((positivePart r *N denominatorValue q) +N
   (negativePart q *N denominatorValue r))

record NonnegativeCut : Set1 where
  field
    lower :
      Rational ->
      Prop

    lower-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (lower q) (lower r)

    lower-inhabited :
      Exists Rational lower

    lower-proper :
      Exists Rational (\ q -> Not (lower q))

    lower-downward :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      lower r ->
      lower q

    lower-rounded :
      (q : Rational) ->
      lower q ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT q r) (lower r))

    lower-located :
      (q r : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (lower q) (Not (lower r))

    nonnegative :
      (q : Rational) ->
      RationalLT q zeroQ ->
      lower q

open NonnegativeCut

data ENNReal : Set1 where
  zeroENN : ENNReal
  finite  : NonnegativeCut -> ENNReal
  infinity : ENNReal
  sumENN  : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> ENNReal

ENNLower : ENNReal -> Rational -> Prop
ENNLower zeroENN q =
  RationalLT q zeroQ
ENNLower (finite x) q =
  lower x q
ENNLower infinity q =
  Top
ENNLower (sumENN x y) r =
  Exists Rational
    (\ p ->
      Exists Rational
        (\ q ->
          Both
            (Both (ENNLower x p) (ENNLower y q))
            (RationalLT r (addQ p q))))

ENNEqual : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNEqual x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  Iff (ENNLower x q) (ENNLower y q)

ENNLE : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNLE x y =
  (q : Rational) ->
  ENNLower x q ->
  ENNLower y q

ENNStrictLess : ENNReal -> ENNReal -> Prop
ENNStrictLess x y =
  Both (ENNLE x y) (Not (ENNEqual x y))

IsZeroENN : ENNReal -> Prop
IsZeroENN x =
  ENNEqual x zeroENN

IsSupremum :
  {p : Level} ->
  (ENNReal -> Prop p) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero ⊔ p)
IsSupremum candidates bound =
  Both
    ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE x bound)
    ((upper : ENNReal) ->
      ((x : ENNReal) -> candidates x -> ENNLE x upper) ->
      ENNLE bound upper)

data FiniteSum
  (terms : Nat -> ENNReal) :
  Nat ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero) where

  empty-sum :
    FiniteSum terms zero zeroENN

  next-sum :
    {n : Nat} ->
    {partial total : ENNReal} ->
    FiniteSum terms n partial ->
    ENNEqual total (sumENN partial (terms n)) ->
    FiniteSum terms (suc n) total

CountableSum :
  (Nat -> ENNReal) ->
  ENNReal ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero)
CountableSum terms total =
  IsSupremum
    (\ value ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> FiniteSum terms n value))
    total

Event :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
Event A =
  A -> Prop

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Whole :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A
Whole _ =
  Top

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Event A
Intersection S T x =
  Both (S x) (T x)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Event A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop a
Subset {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  S x ->
  T x

SameEvent :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Event A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop a
SameEvent {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (S x) (T x)

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Event A) ->
  Prop a
PairwiseDisjoint {a = a} {A = A} sets =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m !=N n ->
  (x : A) ->
  sets m x ->
  sets n x ->
  Bottom {a}

Preimage :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Event B ->
  Event A
Preimage f E x =
  E (f x)

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    measurable :
      Event A ->
      Prop

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Event A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      SameEvent S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

record Measure
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (events : Event A -> Prop p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    mass :
      Event A ->
      ENNReal

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Event A) ->
      SameEvent S T ->
      ENNEqual (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-empty :
      IsZeroENN (mass Empty)

    mass-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      CountableSum
        (\ n -> mass (sets n))
        (mass (CountableUnion sets))

open Measure

FiniteMeasure :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {events : Event A -> Prop p} ->
  Measure events ->
  Prop
FiniteMeasure measure =
  Not (ENNEqual (mass measure Whole) infinity)

record MetricSpace
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    distance :
      A ->
      A ->
      ENNReal

    distance-finite :
      (x y : A) ->
      Not (ENNEqual (distance x y) infinity)

    distance-self :
      (x : A) ->
      IsZeroENN (distance x x)

    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : A) ->
      ENNEqual (distance x y) (distance y x)

    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : A) ->
      ENNLE
        (distance x z)
        (sumENN (distance x y) (distance y z))

    distance-separates :
      (x y : A) ->
      IsZeroENN (distance x y) ->
      x == y

open MetricSpace

PositiveFinite : ENNReal -> Prop
PositiveFinite radius =
  Both
    (ENNStrictLess zeroENN radius)
    (Not (ENNEqual radius infinity))

OpenBall :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  MetricSpace A ->
  A ->
  ENNReal ->
  Event A
OpenBall metric center radius x =
  ENNStrictLess (distance metric x center) radius

MetricOpen :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  MetricSpace A ->
  Event A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
MetricOpen {A = A} metric U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  Exists ENNReal
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (PositiveFinite radius)
        (Subset (OpenBall metric x radius) U))

SequentialLimit :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  MetricSpace A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  A ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero)
SequentialLimit metric sequence limit =
  (epsilon : ENNReal) ->
  PositiveFinite epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      ENNStrictLess
        (distance metric (sequence n) limit)
        epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  MetricSpace A ->
  (Nat -> A) ->
  Prop (lsuc lzero)
CauchySequence metric sequence =
  (epsilon : ENNReal) ->
  PositiveFinite epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      ENNStrictLess
        (distance metric (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

CompleteMetric :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  MetricSpace A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero)
CompleteMetric {A = A} metric =
  (sequence : Nat -> A) ->
  CauchySequence metric sequence ->
  Exists A
    (\ limit ->
      SequentialLimit metric sequence limit)

record SecondCountableMetric
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (metric : MetricSpace A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    countable-basis :
      Nat ->
      Event A

    basis-open :
      (n : Nat) ->
      MetricOpen metric (countable-basis n)

    basis-refines :
      (U : Event A) ->
      MetricOpen metric U ->
      (x : A) ->
      U x ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Both
            (countable-basis n x)
            (Subset (countable-basis n) U))

record PolishSpace
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (metric : MetricSpace A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    complete :
      CompleteMetric metric

    second-countable :
      SecondCountableMetric metric

data BorelGenerated
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (metric : MetricSpace A) :
  Event A ->
  Prop (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  borel-open :
    {U : Event A} ->
    MetricOpen metric U ->
    BorelGenerated metric U

  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated metric Empty

  borel-complement :
    {S : Event A} ->
    BorelGenerated metric S ->
    BorelGenerated metric (Complement S)

  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Event A) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated metric (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated metric (CountableUnion sets)

  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Event A} ->
    SameEvent S T ->
    BorelGenerated metric S ->
    BorelGenerated metric T

record BorelSpace
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (metric : MetricSpace A)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Event A) ->
      BorelGenerated metric S ->
      measurable events S

    measurable-borel :
      (S : Event A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated metric S

record FiniteWitness
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size :
      Nat

    enumerate :
      Fin size ->
      A

    locate :
      A ->
      Fin size

    enumerate-locate :
      (x : A) ->
      enumerate (locate x) == x

    locate-enumerate :
      (k : Fin size) ->
      locate (enumerate k) == k

record FiniteCoordinates
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    Carrier :
      Set i

    carrier-finite :
      FiniteWitness Carrier

    coordinate :
      Carrier ->
      I

    coordinate-injective :
      (j k : Carrier) ->
      coordinate j == coordinate k ->
      j == k

open FiniteCoordinates

record CoordinateInclusion
  {i : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  (J K : FiniteCoordinates I) :
  Set i where

  field
    include :
      Carrier J ->
      Carrier K

    coordinate-preserving :
      (j : Carrier J) ->
      coordinate K (include j) == coordinate J j

open CoordinateInclusion

transport :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : I -> Set a} ->
  {x y : I} ->
  x == y ->
  A x ->
  A y
transport {A = A} refl value =
  value

FiniteSection :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  (A : I -> Set a) ->
  FiniteCoordinates I ->
  Set (i ⊔ a)
FiniteSection A J =
  (j : Carrier J) ->
  A (coordinate J j)

FullSection :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  (I -> Set a) ->
  Set (i ⊔ a)
FullSection {I = I} A =
  (i : I) ->
  A i

restrictSection :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : I -> Set a} ->
  {J K : FiniteCoordinates I} ->
  CoordinateInclusion J K ->
  FiniteSection A K ->
  FiniteSection A J
restrictSection {A = A} inclusion section j =
  transport {A = A}
    (coordinate-preserving inclusion j)
    (section (include inclusion j))

projectSection :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : I -> Set a} ->
  (J : FiniteCoordinates I) ->
  FullSection A ->
  FiniteSection A J
projectSection J section j =
  section (coordinate J j)

data FiniteProductMeasurable
  {i a : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  (A : I -> Set a)
  (spaces : (i : I) -> SigmaAlgebra (A i))
  (J : FiniteCoordinates I) :
  Event (FiniteSection A J) ->
  Prop (i ⊔ a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  finite-coordinate-event :
    (j : Carrier J) ->
    (E : Event (A (coordinate J j))) ->
    measurable (spaces (coordinate J j)) E ->
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J
      (\ section -> E (section j))

  finite-empty :
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J Empty

  finite-complement :
    {S : Event (FiniteSection A J)} ->
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J S ->
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J (Complement S)

  finite-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Event (FiniteSection A J)) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J (sets n)) ->
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J (CountableUnion sets)

  finite-congruent :
    {S T : Event (FiniteSection A J)} ->
    SameEvent S T ->
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J S ->
    FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J T

data FullProductMeasurable
  {i a : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  (A : I -> Set a)
  (spaces : (i : I) -> SigmaAlgebra (A i)) :
  Event (FullSection A) ->
  Prop (i ⊔ a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  full-coordinate-event :
    (i : I) ->
    (E : Event (A i)) ->
    measurable (spaces i) E ->
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces
      (\ section -> E (section i))

  full-empty :
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces Empty

  full-complement :
    {S : Event (FullSection A)} ->
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces S ->
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces (Complement S)

  full-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Event (FullSection A)) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      FullProductMeasurable A spaces (sets n)) ->
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces (CountableUnion sets)

  full-congruent :
    {S T : Event (FullSection A)} ->
    SameEvent S T ->
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces S ->
    FullProductMeasurable A spaces T

IsProjectiveMeasureFamily :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : I -> Set a} ->
  {spaces : (i : I) -> SigmaAlgebra (A i)} ->
  ((J : FiniteCoordinates I) ->
    Measure (FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J)) ->
  Prop (lsuc i ⊔ a)
IsProjectiveMeasureFamily {A = A} {spaces = spaces} family =
  (J K : FiniteCoordinates _) ->
  (inclusion : CoordinateInclusion J K) ->
  (E : Event (FiniteSection A J)) ->
  FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J E ->
  ENNEqual
    (mass (family K)
      (Preimage (restrictSection {A = A} inclusion) E))
    (mass (family J) E)

IsProjectiveLimit :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : I -> Set a} ->
  {spaces : (i : I) -> SigmaAlgebra (A i)} ->
  Measure (FullProductMeasurable A spaces) ->
  ((J : FiniteCoordinates I) ->
    Measure (FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J)) ->
  Prop (lsuc i ⊔ a)
IsProjectiveLimit {A = A} {spaces = spaces} limit family =
  (J : FiniteCoordinates _) ->
  (E : Event (FiniteSection A J)) ->
  FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J E ->
  ENNEqual
    (mass limit (Preimage (projectSection J) E))
    (mass (family J) E)

record ProjectiveLimitWitness
  {i a : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {A : I -> Set a}
  {spaces : (i : I) -> SigmaAlgebra (A i)}
  (family :
    (J : FiniteCoordinates I) ->
    Measure (FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J)) :
  Set (lsuc i ⊔ a ⊔ lsuc lzero) where

  field
    projective-limit :
      Measure (FullProductMeasurable A spaces)

    has-prescribed-marginals :
      IsProjectiveLimit projective-limit family

kolmogorov-extension-theorem : Setω
kolmogorov-extension-theorem =
  {i a : Level} ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (A : I -> Set a) ->
  (spaces : (index : I) -> SigmaAlgebra (A index)) ->
  (metrics : (index : I) -> MetricSpace (A index)) ->
  ((index : I) -> BorelSpace (metrics index) (spaces index)) ->
  ((index : I) -> PolishSpace (metrics index)) ->
  (family :
    (J : FiniteCoordinates I) ->
    Measure (FiniteProductMeasurable A spaces J)) ->
  ((J : FiniteCoordinates I) -> FiniteMeasure (family J)) ->
  IsProjectiveMeasureFamily family ->
  ProjectiveLimitWitness family

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3526996, "Kolmogorov extension theorem": a projectively consistent family
  of finite measures on finite products of Polish Borel spaces has a measure
  on the full dependent product with exactly those marginals. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory optionTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory borelTheory;

val q3526996_metric_on_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_metric_on_def",
  ``q3526996_metric_on
      (carrier : 'x set) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real) <=>
      (!x y.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier ==>
        0 <= dist x y /\
        (dist x y = 0 <=> x = y) /\
        dist x y = dist y x) /\
      (!x y z.
        x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier ==>
        dist x z <= dist x y + dist y z)``);

val q3526996_open_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_open_def",
  ``q3526996_open
      (carrier : 'x set) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real) (s : 'x set) <=>
      s SUBSET carrier /\
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            y IN carrier /\ dist x y < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q3526996_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_cauchy_def",
  ``q3526996_cauchy
      (carrier : 'x set) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real)
      (u : num -> 'x) <=>
      (!n. u n IN carrier) /\
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !m n.
            N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
            dist (u m) (u n) < epsilon``);

val q3526996_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_tendsto_def",
  ``q3526996_tendsto
      (carrier : 'x set) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real)
      (u : num -> 'x) (x : 'x) <=>
      x IN carrier /\
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n. N <= n ==> dist (u n) x < epsilon``);

val q3526996_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_complete_def",
  ``q3526996_complete
      (carrier : 'x set) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'x.
        q3526996_cauchy carrier dist u ==>
        ?x. q3526996_tendsto carrier dist u x``);

val q3526996_separable_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_separable_def",
  ``q3526996_separable
      (carrier : 'x set) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real) <=>
      ?u : num -> 'x.
        !x epsilon.
          x IN carrier /\ 0 < epsilon ==>
          ?n. u n IN carrier /\ dist x (u n) < epsilon``);

val q3526996_polish_borel_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_polish_borel_space_def",
  ``q3526996_polish_borel_space
      (a : 'x algebra) (dist : 'x -> 'x -> real) <=>
      sigma_algebra a /\
      q3526996_metric_on (space a) dist /\
      q3526996_complete (space a) dist /\
      q3526996_separable (space a) dist /\
      a =
        sigma
          (space a)
          {s : 'x set |
             q3526996_open (space a) dist s}``);

val q3526996_finite_product_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_finite_product_carrier_def",
  ``q3526996_finite_product_carrier
      (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra) (J : 'i set) =
      {p : ('i -> 'x option) |
         !i.
           if i IN J then
             ?x. p i = SOME x /\ x IN space (spaces i)
           else
             p i = NONE}``);

val q3526996_path_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_path_carrier_def",
  ``q3526996_path_carrier (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra) =
      {p : ('i -> 'x option) |
         !i. ?x. p i = SOME x /\ x IN space (spaces i)}``);

val q3526996_finite_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_finite_product_space_def",
  ``q3526996_finite_product_space
      (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra) (J : 'i set) =
      sigma
        (q3526996_finite_product_carrier spaces J)
        {c : ('i -> 'x option) set |
           ?i s.
             i IN J /\
             s IN subsets (spaces i) /\
             c =
               {p |
                  p IN q3526996_finite_product_carrier spaces J /\
                  ?x. p i = SOME x /\ x IN s}}``);

val q3526996_path_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_path_space_def",
  ``q3526996_path_space (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra) =
      sigma
        (q3526996_path_carrier spaces)
        {c : ('i -> 'x option) set |
           ?i s.
             s IN subsets (spaces i) /\
             c =
               {p |
                  p IN q3526996_path_carrier spaces /\
                  ?x. p i = SOME x /\ x IN s}}``);

val q3526996_restrict_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_restrict_def",
  ``q3526996_restrict
      (J : 'i set) (p : 'i -> 'x option) =
      \i. if i IN J then p i else NONE``);

val q3526996_projective_measure_family_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_projective_measure_family_def",
  ``q3526996_projective_measure_family
      (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra)
      (P : 'i set -> ('i -> 'x option) m_space) <=>
      (!J.
        FINITE J ==>
        measure_space (P J) /\
        m_space (P J) =
          q3526996_finite_product_carrier spaces J /\
        measurable_sets (P J) =
          subsets (q3526996_finite_product_space spaces J) /\
        ~(measure (P J) (m_space (P J)) = PosInf)) /\
      (!J K.
        FINITE J /\ FINITE K /\ J SUBSET K ==>
        !s.
          s IN subsets (q3526996_finite_product_space spaces J) ==>
          measure
            (P K)
            {p |
               p IN q3526996_finite_product_carrier spaces K /\
               q3526996_restrict J p IN s} =
          measure (P J) s)``);

val q3526996_is_projective_limit_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_is_projective_limit_def",
  ``q3526996_is_projective_limit
      (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra)
      (P : 'i set -> ('i -> 'x option) m_space)
      (mu : ('i -> 'x option) m_space) <=>
      measure_space mu /\
      m_space mu = q3526996_path_carrier spaces /\
      measurable_sets mu = subsets (q3526996_path_space spaces) /\
      !J s.
        FINITE J /\
        s IN subsets (q3526996_finite_product_space spaces J)
        ==>
        measure
          mu
          {p |
             p IN q3526996_path_carrier spaces /\
             q3526996_restrict J p IN s} =
        measure (P J) s``);

val q3526996_projective_limit_def = new_definition (
  "q3526996_projective_limit_def",
  ``q3526996_projective_limit
      (spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra)
      (P : 'i set -> ('i -> 'x option) m_space) =
      @mu : ('i -> 'x option) m_space.
        q3526996_is_projective_limit spaces P mu``);

val kolmogorov_extension_theorem =
  ``!(spaces : 'i -> 'x algebra)
      (dist : 'i -> 'x -> 'x -> real)
      (P : 'i set -> ('i -> 'x option) m_space).
      (!i. q3526996_polish_borel_space (spaces i) (dist i)) /\
      q3526996_projective_measure_family spaces P
      ==>
      q3526996_is_projective_limit
        spaces P (q3526996_projective_limit spaces P)``;

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3526996
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3526996), "Kolmogorov extension theorem": a
  finite projective family of measures on the finite coordinate products of
  an arbitrarily indexed family of Polish spaces has a measure on the full
  dependent product with exactly those finite-dimensional marginals. This
  file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  D assigns a SetMM complete metric-space structure to every index, and the
  separate second-countability hypothesis makes each coordinate Polish. Its
  Borel sigma-algebra is generated by TopOpen. Q3526996Space is the unrestricted
  dependent function space over any index subset J. Q3526996Sigma is generated
  by its measurable coordinate cylinders; explicitly adjoining the whole
  product preserves that sigma-algebra and gives the correct singleton carrier
  when J is empty.

  Q3526996ProjectiveFamily requires P(J) to be a finite measure on every finite
  coordinate product and states consistency under every restriction J subset
  K. Q3526996IsProjectiveLimit says that a measure on the full product has all
  those finite-dimensional marginals. Q3526996ProjectiveLimit selects the
  unique such measure by definite description, matching the source's named
  noncomputable projectiveLimit construction while keeping the witness
  internal.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q3526996Space Q3526996Sigma Q3526996Cylinder
   Q3526996ProjectiveFamily Q3526996IsProjectiveLimit
   Q3526996ProjectiveLimit $.

q3526996-space-syntax
  $a class ( Q3526996Space D J ) $.
q3526996-sigma-syntax
  $a class ( Q3526996Sigma D J ) $.
q3526996-cylinder-syntax
  $a class ( Q3526996Cylinder D K J A ) $.
q3526996-projective-family-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3526996ProjectiveFamily I D P ) $.
q3526996-is-projective-limit-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3526996IsProjectiveLimit I D P M ) $.
q3526996-projective-limit-syntax
  $a class ( Q3526996ProjectiveLimit I D P ) $.

${
  $d D J i $.

  q3526996-space-definition $a |-
    ( Q3526996Space D J )
    =
    X_ i e. J U. ( TopOpen ` ( D ` i ) )
  $.
$}
