title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3526996,
:: "Kolmogorov extension theorem": every projectively consistent family of
:: finite Borel measures on finite products of arbitrary Polish coordinate
:: spaces has a measure on the full product with exactly those finite-
:: dimensional marginals. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE6, SUBSET_1,
      PARTFUN1, TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ZFMISC_1, CARD_1,
      CARD_3, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, SETFAM_1, PBOOLE, FINSET_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC,
      METRIC_1, TOPMETR, PCOMPS_1, TBSP_1, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, REAL_1,
      XXREAL_0,
      XXREAL_2, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2, VALUED_0, XCMPLX_0, ARYTM_1,
      ARYTM_3;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, CARD_3,
      FINSET_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XXREAL_3, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, REAL_1,
      XREAL_0, VALUED_0, PBOOLE, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, METRIC_1, TOPMETR,
      PCOMPS_1, TBSP_1, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, PROB_2, MEASURE1, MEASURE6,
      EXTREAL1, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2;
 constructors TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, FINSET_1, NAT_1, REAL_1, STRUCT_0,
      PRE_TOPC,
      METRIC_1, TOPMETR, PCOMPS_1, TBSP_1, WAYBEL23, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, PROB_2,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE6, EXTREAL1, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, RELSET_1,
      ORDINAL1, CARD_1, CARD_3, FINSET_1, NAT_1, MEMBERED, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
      XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XXREAL_3, VALUED_0, PARTFUN1, STRUCT_0,
      PRE_TOPC, METRIC_1, PCOMPS_1, TBSP_1, MEASURE1, PROB_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, ARITHM, REAL;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PROB_1, TBSP_1;
 equalities TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, PROB_1, STRUCT_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for I being set,
      X,S,F,C,P being Function,
      H being SigmaField of product X,
      D being Subset-Family of product X
  st
    dom X = I &
    dom S = I &
    dom F = bool I &
    dom C = bool I &
    dom P = bool I &
    (for i being object st i in I holds
      (X.i = {} &
       ex Si being SigmaField of X.i st
         Si = S.i & Si = {{}})
      or
      ex M being non empty MetrSpace,
         Si being SigmaField of the carrier of M
      st
        X.i = the carrier of M &
        Si = S.i &
        (for q being Function of NAT,the carrier of M st
          (for r being Real st 0 < r holds
            ex n being Nat st
              for k,l being Nat st n <= k & n <= l holds
                dist(q.k,q.l) < r)
         holds
          ex x being Point of M st
            for r being Real st 0 < r holds
              ex n being Nat st
                for k being Nat st n <= k holds dist(q.k,x) < r) &
        TopSpaceMetr M is second-countable &
        Si = BorelSets(TopSpaceMetr M)) &
    D c= H &
    (for G being SigmaField of product X st D c= G holds H c= G) &
    (for E being Subset of product X holds
      E in D iff
      ex i being object,
         Xi being set,
         Si being SigmaField of Xi,
         A being Element of Si
      st
        i in I &
        Xi = X.i &
        Si = S.i &
        (for z being Element of product X holds
          z in E iff z in product X & z.i in A)) &
    (for K being finite Subset of I holds
      ex FK being SigmaField of product (X|K),
         CK being Subset-Family of product (X|K),
         PK being sigma_Measure of FK
      st
        FK = F.K &
        CK = C.K &
        PK = P.K &
        CK c= FK &
        (for G being SigmaField of product (X|K)
          st CK c= G holds FK c= G) &
        (for E being Subset of product (X|K) holds
          E in CK iff
          ex i being object,
             Xi being set,
             Si being SigmaField of Xi,
             A being Element of Si
          st
            i in K &
            Xi = X.i &
            Si = S.i &
            (for z being Element of product (X|K) holds
              z in E iff z in product (X|K) & z.i in A)) &
        PK.(product (X|K)) < +infty) &
    (for K,L being finite Subset of I st K c= L holds
      ex FK being SigmaField of product (X|K),
         FL being SigmaField of product (X|L),
         PK being sigma_Measure of FK,
         PL being sigma_Measure of FL
      st
        FK = F.K &
        FL = F.L &
        PK = P.K &
        PL = P.L &
        for A being Element of FK holds
          ex E being Element of FL st
            (for z being Element of product (X|L) holds
              z in E iff z in product (X|L) & z|K in A) &
            PL.E = PK.A)
  holds
    ex Mu being sigma_Measure of H st
      for K being finite Subset of I holds
        ex FK being SigmaField of product (X|K),
           PK being sigma_Measure of FK
        st
          FK = F.K &
          PK = P.K &
          for A being Element of FK holds
            ex E being Element of H st
              (for z being Element of product X holds
                z in E iff z in product X & z|K in A) &
              Mu.E = PK.A
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q3526996_kolmogorov_extension_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3526996,
% "Kolmogorov extension theorem": a projectively consistent family of finite
% measures on finite products of an arbitrary indexed family of Polish Borel
% spaces extends to a measure on the full product with those marginals. This
% file contains no proof.

kolmogorov_extension_theorem_Q3526996[
  Index: TYPE,
  Value: TYPE+,
  fiber: [Index -> [Value -> bool]],
  distance: [Index -> [Value, Value -> real]],
  fiber_sigma: [Index -> [[Value -> bool] -> bool]]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index]

  point_event: TYPE = [Value -> bool]
  point_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_event]
  point_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [point_event -> bool]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> Value]

  assignment: TYPE = [Index -> Value]
  assignment_event: TYPE = [assignment -> bool]
  assignment_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> assignment_event]
  assignment_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [assignment_event -> bool]

  finite_index_set: TYPE = finite_set[Index]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  measure_map: TYPE = [assignment_event -> measure_value]
  finite_measure_family: TYPE = [finite_index_set -> measure_map]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  point_event_subset(left, right: point_event): bool =
    FORALL (value: Value):
      left(value) IMPLIES right(value)

  fiber_event(index: Index): point_event =
    LAMBDA (value: Value):
      fiber(index)(value)

  empty_point_event: point_event =
    LAMBDA (value: Value): FALSE

  point_complement(
      index: Index,
      event: point_event): point_event =
    LAMBDA (value: Value):
      fiber(index)(value) AND NOT event(value)

  point_countable_union(
      index: Index,
      events: point_event_sequence): point_event =
    LAMBDA (value: Value):
      fiber(index)(value)
        AND EXISTS (number: nat): events(number)(value)

  is_point_sigma_algebra(
      index: Index,
      Sigma: point_sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (event: point_event):
      Sigma(event) IMPLIES
        point_event_subset(event, fiber_event(index)))
      AND Sigma(fiber_event(index))
      AND (FORALL (event: point_event):
        Sigma(event) IMPLIES
          Sigma(point_complement(index, event)))
      AND (FORALL (events: point_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (number: nat): Sigma(events(number)))
          IMPLIES
            Sigma(point_countable_union(index, events)))

  metric_space_at(index: Index): bool =
    (FORALL (left, right: Value):
      fiber(index)(left) AND fiber(index)(right)
        IMPLIES distance(index)(left, right) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (value: Value):
        fiber(index)(value)
          IMPLIES distance(index)(value, value) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: Value):
        fiber(index)(left) AND fiber(index)(right)
          IMPLIES
            distance(index)(left, right)
              = distance(index)(right, left))
      AND (FORALL (left, middle, right: Value):
        fiber(index)(left)
          AND fiber(index)(middle)
          AND fiber(index)(right)
        IMPLIES
          distance(index)(left, right)
            <= distance(index)(left, middle)
              + distance(index)(middle, right))
      AND (FORALL (left, right: Value):
        fiber(index)(left) AND fiber(index)(right)
          IMPLIES
            (distance(index)(left, right) = 0
              IFF left = right))

  cauchy_at(
      index: Index,
      values: point_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (number: nat):
      fiber(index)(values(number)))
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (left_number, right_number: nat):
            cutoff <= left_number
              AND cutoff <= right_number
            IMPLIES
              distance(index)(
                values(left_number),
                values(right_number)) < epsilon_value)

  converges_at(
      index: Index,
      values: point_sequence,
      limit: Value): bool =
    fiber(index)(limit)
      AND (FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
          FORALL (number: nat):
            cutoff <= number IMPLIES
              distance(index)(
                values(number), limit) < epsilon_value)

  complete_at(index: Index): bool =
    FORALL (values: point_sequence):
      cauchy_at(index, values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: Value):
          converges_at(index, values, limit)

  separable_at(index: Index): bool =
    EXISTS (dense_values: point_sequence):
      FORALL (value: Value):
        fiber(index)(value) IMPLIES
          FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
            EXISTS (number: nat):
              fiber(index)(dense_values(number))
                AND distance(index)(
                  dense_values(number), value) < epsilon_value

  open_ball(
      index: Index,
      center: Value,
      radius: real): point_event =
    LAMBDA (value: Value):
      fiber(index)(value)
        AND distance(index)(value, center) < radius

  metric_open_at(
      index: Index,
      event: point_event): bool =
    point_event_subset(event, fiber_event(index))
      AND FORALL (value: Value):
        fiber(index)(value) AND event(value) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (epsilon_value: posreal):
            point_event_subset(
              open_ball(index, value, epsilon_value),
              event)

  generated_borel_sigma_at(
      index: Index,
      Sigma: point_sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_point_sigma_algebra(index, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (event: point_event):
        metric_open_at(index, event) IMPLIES Sigma(event))
      AND (FORALL (other: point_sigma_algebra):
        (is_point_sigma_algebra(index, other)
          AND (FORALL (event: point_event):
            metric_open_at(index, event) IMPLIES other(event)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (event: point_event):
            Sigma(event) IMPLIES other(event))

  polish_borel_family: bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      metric_space_at(index)
        AND complete_at(index)
        AND separable_at(index)
        AND generated_borel_sigma_at(
          index, fiber_sigma(index))

  valid_on(
      indices: finite_index_set,
      value: assignment): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      indices(index) IMPLIES fiber(index)(value(index))

  valid_path(value: assignment): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      fiber(index)(value(index))

  finite_domain(
      indices: finite_index_set): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      valid_on(indices, value)

  full_domain: assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      valid_path(value)

  empty_assignment_event: assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment): FALSE

  assignment_event_subset(
      left, right: assignment_event): bool =
    FORALL (value: assignment):
      left(value) IMPLIES right(value)

  assignment_complement(
      domain, event: assignment_event): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      domain(value) AND NOT event(value)

  assignment_countable_union(
      domain: assignment_event,
      events: assignment_event_sequence): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      domain(value)
        AND EXISTS (number: nat): events(number)(value)

  assignment_pairwise_disjoint(
      domain: assignment_event,
      events: assignment_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_number, right_number: nat):
      left_number /= right_number IMPLIES
        FORALL (value: assignment):
          domain(value) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_number)(value)
              AND events(right_number)(value))

  is_assignment_sigma_algebra(
      domain: assignment_event,
      Sigma: assignment_sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (event: assignment_event):
      Sigma(event) IMPLIES
        assignment_event_subset(event, domain))
      AND Sigma(domain)
      AND (FORALL (event: assignment_event):
        Sigma(event) IMPLIES
          Sigma(assignment_complement(domain, event)))
      AND (FORALL (events: assignment_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (number: nat): Sigma(events(number)))
          IMPLIES
            Sigma(assignment_countable_union(domain, events)))

  finite_coordinate_event(
      indices: finite_index_set,
      index: Index,
      event: point_event): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      valid_on(indices, value)
        AND event(value(index))

  full_coordinate_event(
      index: Index,
      event: point_event): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      valid_path(value)
        AND event(value(index))

  contains_finite_coordinate_generators(
      indices: finite_index_set,
      Sigma: assignment_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index), (event: point_event):
      indices(index) AND fiber_sigma(index)(event)
        IMPLIES
          Sigma(finite_coordinate_event(
            indices, index, event))

  contains_full_coordinate_generators(
      Sigma: assignment_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index), (event: point_event):
      fiber_sigma(index)(event)
        IMPLIES
          Sigma(full_coordinate_event(index, event))

  finite_product_sigma(
      indices: finite_index_set): assignment_sigma_algebra =
    LAMBDA (event: assignment_event):
      FORALL (candidate: assignment_sigma_algebra):
        (is_assignment_sigma_algebra(
            finite_domain(indices), candidate)
          AND contains_finite_coordinate_generators(
            indices, candidate))
        IMPLIES candidate(event)

  full_product_sigma: assignment_sigma_algebra =
    LAMBDA (event: assignment_event):
      FORALL (candidate: assignment_sigma_algebra):
        (is_assignment_sigma_algebra(
            full_domain, candidate)
          AND contains_full_coordinate_generators(candidate))
        IMPLIES candidate(event)

  is_assignment_measure(
      domain: assignment_event,
      Sigma: assignment_sigma_algebra,
      M: measure_map): bool =
    is_assignment_sigma_algebra(domain, Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(
        M(empty_assignment_event))
      AND (FORALL (event: assignment_event):
        Sigma(event) IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(M(event)))
      AND (FORALL (events: assignment_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (number: nat): Sigma(events(number)))
          AND assignment_pairwise_disjoint(domain, events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (number: nat):
              M(events(number)),
            M(assignment_countable_union(
              domain, events))))

  is_finite_product_measure(
      indices: finite_index_set,
      M: measure_map): bool =
    is_assignment_measure(
      finite_domain(indices),
      finite_product_sigma(indices),
      M)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(
        M(finite_domain(indices)))

  is_full_product_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    is_assignment_measure(
      full_domain,
      full_product_sigma,
      M)

  finite_index_subset(
      smaller, larger: finite_index_set): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      smaller(index) IMPLIES larger(index)

  lifted_finite_event(
      larger: finite_index_set,
      event: assignment_event): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      valid_on(larger, value) AND event(value)

  cylinder_event(
      event: assignment_event): assignment_event =
    LAMBDA (value: assignment):
      valid_path(value) AND event(value)

  is_projective_measure_family(
      measures: finite_measure_family): bool =
    (FORALL (indices: finite_index_set):
      is_finite_product_measure(
        indices, measures(indices)))
      AND (FORALL
          (smaller, larger: finite_index_set),
          (event: assignment_event):
        (finite_index_subset(smaller, larger)
          AND finite_product_sigma(smaller)(event))
        IMPLIES
          measures(smaller)(event)
            = measures(larger)(
                lifted_finite_event(larger, event)))

  is_projective_limit(
      M: measure_map,
      measures: finite_measure_family): bool =
    is_full_product_measure(M)
      AND (FORALL
          (indices: finite_index_set),
          (event: assignment_event):
        finite_product_sigma(indices)(event)
          IMPLIES
            M(cylinder_event(event))
              = measures(indices)(event))

  kolmogorov_extension_theorem: bool =
    polish_borel_family
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (measures: finite_measure_family):
          is_projective_measure_family(measures)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (M: measure_map):
                is_projective_limit(M, measures)
END kolmogorov_extension_theorem_Q3526996

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3527102
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3527102), "Kruskal–Katona theorem": among
-- uniform finite set families, a colex initial segment of no greater cardinality
-- has shadow no larger than that of the compared family. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.Colex
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SetFamily.Compression.UV
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Fin

@[expose] public section

open Nat
open scoped FinsetFamily

namespace Finset
namespace Q3527102

open Colex

variable {r n : ℕ} {𝒜 𝒞 : Finset <| Finset <| Fin n}

/-- The Kruskal–Katona shadow bound for an initial segment of the colex order. -/
theorem kruskal_katona_statement
    (h𝒜r : (𝒜 : Set (Finset (Fin n))).Sized r) (h𝒞𝒜 : #𝒞 ≤ #𝒜)
    (h𝒞 : IsInitSeg 𝒞 r) : #(∂ 𝒞) ≤ #(∂ 𝒜) := sorry

end Q3527102
end Finset

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527102
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527102), "Kruskal-Katona theorem": among
  uniform families of subsets of a finite ordinal, a colex initial segment
  has a lower shadow no larger than that of any family of at least the same
  cardinality. This file contains no proof.
*)

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Definition q3527102_uniform
    {n : nat} (family : {set {set 'I_n}}) (r : nat) : Prop :=
  forall A : {set 'I_n},
    A \in family ->
    #|A| = r.

Definition q3527102_colex_lt
    {n : nat} (A B : {set 'I_n}) : Prop :=
  A <> B /\
  forall a : 'I_n,
    a \in A ->
    a \notin B ->
    exists b : 'I_n,
      b \in B /\
      b \notin A /\
      (val a <= val b)%nat.

Definition q3527102_is_initial_segment
    {n : nat} (family : {set {set 'I_n}}) (r : nat) : Prop :=
  q3527102_uniform family r /\
  forall A B : {set 'I_n},
    A \in family ->
    q3527102_colex_lt B A /\ #|B| = r ->
    B \in family.

Definition q3527102_shadow
    {n : nat} (family : {set {set 'I_n}}) : {set {set 'I_n}} :=
  [set B : {set 'I_n} |
    [exists A : {set 'I_n},
      (A \in family) &&
      [exists x : 'I_n,
        (x \in A) && (B == A :\ x)]]].

Theorem kruskal_katona :
  forall (n r : nat) (family initial : {set {set 'I_n}}),
    q3527102_uniform family r ->
    (#|initial| <= #|family|)%nat ->
    q3527102_is_initial_segment initial r ->
    (#|q3527102_shadow initial| <= #|q3527102_shadow family|)%nat.
Admitted.

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527102,
  "Kruskal–Katona theorem": among uniform finite set families of bounded
  natural subsets, a colexicographic initial segment has no larger one-step
  shadow than any family with at least as many members. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

theory Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q3527102_family_on :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527102_family_on n F \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite F \<and> F \<subseteq> Pow {..<n}"

definition q3527102_uniform_family_on ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527102_uniform_family_on n r F \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3527102_family_on n F \<and> (\<forall>S \<in> F. card S = r)"

definition q3527102_colex_less :: "nat set \<Rightarrow> nat set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527102_colex_less S T \<longleftrightarrow>
    S \<noteq> T \<and>
    (\<forall>a \<in> S - T. \<exists>b \<in> T - S. a < b)"

definition q3527102_initial_colex_segment_on ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527102_initial_colex_segment_on n r C \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3527102_uniform_family_on n r C \<and>
    (\<forall>S \<in> C. \<forall>T.
      T \<subseteq> {..<n} \<longrightarrow>
      card T = r \<longrightarrow>
      q3527102_colex_less T S \<longrightarrow>
      T \<in> C)"

definition q3527102_shadow :: "nat set set \<Rightarrow> nat set set" where
  "q3527102_shadow F =
    {T. \<exists>S \<in> F. \<exists>a \<in> S. T = S - {a}}"

theorem q3527102_kruskal_katona:
  fixes n r :: nat
    and A C :: "nat set set"
  assumes uniform_A: "q3527102_uniform_family_on n r A"
    and size_C_le_A: "card C \<le> card A"
    and initial_C: "q3527102_initial_colex_segment_on n r C"
  shows "card (q3527102_shadow C) \<le> card (q3527102_shadow A)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527102,
  "Kruskal-Katona theorem": among finite families of r-element subsets of
  Fin n, an initial colex segment has no larger shadow than any family with
  at least as many members. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3527102_KRUSKAL_KATONA_THEOREM =
  `let fin_n_set =
     \(n:num) (s:num->bool).
       FINITE s /\ s SUBSET {i:num | i < n} in
   let uniform_family =
     \(n:num) (r:num) (family:(num->bool)->bool).
       FINITE family /\
       (!s:num->bool. s IN family ==> fin_n_set n s /\ CARD s = r) in
   let colex_le =
     \(s:num->bool) (t:num->bool).
       s = t \/
       (?m:num.
          m IN t /\ ~(m IN s) /\
          (!j:num. m < j ==> (j IN s <=> j IN t))) in
   let initial_colex_segment =
     \(n:num) (r:num) (family:(num->bool)->bool).
       uniform_family n r family /\
       (!s t:num->bool.
          s IN family /\
          fin_n_set n t /\
          CARD t = r /\
          colex_le t s
          ==> t IN family) in
   let shadow =
     \(family:(num->bool)->bool).
       {t:num->bool |
          ?a:num. ~(a IN t) /\ (a INSERT t) IN family} in
   !n r:num.
   !family initial:(num->bool)->bool.
     uniform_family n r family /\
     CARD initial <= CARD family /\
     initial_colex_segment n r initial
     ==> CARD (shadow initial) <= CARD (shadow family)`;;

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q3527102, "Kruskal-Katona theorem": among
;; families of r-element subsets of Fin n, a
;; colexicographic initial segment has shadow no larger than that of any family
;; with at least as many members. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Fin n element is represented by a natural below n. Duplicate-free true
;; lists represent finite subsets, and outer lists contain no two
;; extensionally equal subsets. Hence valid outer lists represent exactly
;; Finset (Finset (Fin n)), independently of list order.

(defun q3527102-fin-element-p (x n)
  (and (natp x)
       (< x n)))

(defun q3527102-fin-set-elements-p (set n)
  (if (consp set)
      (and (q3527102-fin-element-p (car set) n)
           (q3527102-fin-set-elements-p (cdr set) n))
    (equal set nil)))

(defun q3527102-fin-set-p (set n)
  (and (true-listp set)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal set)
       (q3527102-fin-set-elements-p set n)))

(defun q3527102-subset-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and (member-equal (car left) right)
           (q3527102-subset-p (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun q3527102-set-equal-p (left right)
  (and (q3527102-subset-p left right)
       (q3527102-subset-p right left)))

(defun q3527102-family-member-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (or (q3527102-set-equal-p set (car family))
          (q3527102-family-member-p set (cdr family)))
    nil))

(defun q3527102-set-distinct-from-family-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (not (q3527102-set-equal-p set (car family)))
           (q3527102-set-distinct-from-family-p set (cdr family)))
    t))

(defun q3527102-family-p (family n)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q3527102-fin-set-p (car family) n)
           (q3527102-set-distinct-from-family-p
            (car family) (cdr family))
           (q3527102-family-p (cdr family) n))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q3527102-sized-family-p (family r)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (equal (len (car family)) r)
           (q3527102-sized-family-p (cdr family) r))
    t))

;; This is Mathlib's colex non-strict relation specialized to Fin n:
;; every element of LEFT \ RIGHT is bounded above by an element of
;; RIGHT \ LEFT.

(defun q3527102-colex-witness-p (a left right)
  (if (consp right)
      (or (and (not (member-equal (car right) left))
               (<= a (car right)))
          (q3527102-colex-witness-p a left (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun q3527102-colex-le-aux-p (remaining left right)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (or (member-equal (car remaining) right)
           (q3527102-colex-witness-p
            (car remaining) left right))
       (q3527102-colex-le-aux-p
        (cdr remaining) left right))
    t))

(defun q3527102-colex-le-p (left right)
  (q3527102-colex-le-aux-p left left right))

(defun q3527102-colex-lt-p (left right)
  (and (not (q3527102-set-equal-p left right))
       (q3527102-colex-le-p left right)))

;; Enumerate every subset of Fin n. This is used only to express the universal
;; downward-closure clause in IsInitSeg; it does not restrict the source
;; domain, which is already the finite type Fin n.

(defun q3527102-fin-range (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (append (q3527102-fin-range (- n 1))
            (list (- n 1)))))

(defun q3527102-prepend-to-each (x sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (cons (cons x (car sets))
            (q3527102-prepend-to-each x (cdr sets)))
    nil))

(defun q3527102-powerset (carrier)
  (if (consp carrier)
      (let ((tail-powerset
             (q3527102-powerset (cdr carrier))))
        (append
         tail-powerset
         (q3527102-prepend-to-each
          (car carrier) tail-powerset)))
    (list nil)))

(defun q3527102-all-lower-r-sets-present-p
    (set candidates family r)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (equal (len (car candidates)) r)
             (q3527102-colex-lt-p (car candidates) set))
        (q3527102-family-member-p (car candidates) family))
       (q3527102-all-lower-r-sets-present-p
        set (cdr candidates) family r))
    t))

(defun q3527102-initial-segment-members-p
    (remaining-family whole-family candidates r)
  (if (consp remaining-family)
      (and
       (q3527102-all-lower-r-sets-present-p
        (car remaining-family) candidates whole-family r)
       (q3527102-initial-segment-members-p
        (cdr remaining-family) whole-family candidates r))
    t))

(defun q3527102-initial-segment-p (family n r)
  (and
   (q3527102-sized-family-p family r)
   (q3527102-initial-segment-members-p
    family
    family
    (q3527102-powerset (q3527102-fin-range n))
    r)))

;; The shadow is the extensional family of every one-element erasure.

(defun q3527102-erase-one (a set)
  (if (consp set)
      (if (equal a (car set))
          (cdr set)
        (cons (car set)
              (q3527102-erase-one a (cdr set))))
    nil))

(defun q3527102-family-insert (set family)
  (if (q3527102-family-member-p set family)
      family
    (cons set family)))

(defun q3527102-shadow-of-set-aux (remaining set shadow)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (q3527102-shadow-of-set-aux
       (cdr remaining)
       set
       (q3527102-family-insert
        (q3527102-erase-one (car remaining) set)
        shadow))
    shadow))

(defun q3527102-shadow-aux (family shadow)
  (if (consp family)
      (q3527102-shadow-aux
       (cdr family)
       (q3527102-shadow-of-set-aux
        (car family) (car family) shadow))
    shadow))

(defun q3527102-shadow (family)
  (q3527102-shadow-aux family nil))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3527102-kruskal-katona-statement
    (n r family-a family-c)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (natp r)
    (q3527102-family-p family-a n)
    (q3527102-family-p family-c n)
    (q3527102-sized-family-p family-a r)
    (<= (len family-c) (len family-a))
    (q3527102-initial-segment-p family-c n r))
   (<=
    (len (q3527102-shadow family-c))
    (len (q3527102-shadow family-a)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527102
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q3527102), "Kruskal–Katona theorem": if A is a
-- family of r-subsets of Fin n and C is a colex initial segment of r-subsets
-- with no more members than A, then C's shadow has no more members than A's
-- shadow. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 5 _L::_
infixr 6 _&&_
infix 4 _<=_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  VNil  : Vec A zero
  _V::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

data List (A : Set) : Set where
  LNil  : List A
  _L::_ : A -> List A -> List A

Subset : Nat -> Set
Subset n =
  Vec Bool n

Family : Nat -> Set
Family n =
  Subset n -> Bool

data IsTrue : Bool -> Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

_&&_ : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
true && right =
  right
false && right =
  false

bool-implies : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
bool-implies false right =
  true
bool-implies true right =
  right

bool-lt : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
bool-lt false false =
  false
bool-lt false true =
  true
bool-lt true right =
  false

nat-equal : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
nat-equal zero zero =
  true
nat-equal zero (suc right) =
  false
nat-equal (suc left) zero =
  false
nat-equal (suc left) (suc right) =
  nat-equal left right

map-list :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  List A ->
  List B
map-list function LNil =
  LNil
map-list function (item L:: items) =
  function item L:: map-list function items

append :
  {A : Set} ->
  List A ->
  List A ->
  List A
append LNil right =
  right
append (item L:: items) right =
  item L:: append items right

all-subsets : (n : Nat) -> List (Subset n)
all-subsets zero =
  VNil L:: LNil
all-subsets (suc n) =
  append
    (map-list (\ tail -> false V:: tail) (all-subsets n))
    (map-list (\ tail -> true V:: tail) (all-subsets n))

count-where :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Bool) ->
  List A ->
  Nat
count-where predicate LNil =
  zero
count-where predicate (item L:: items) with predicate item
... | false =
  count-where predicate items
... | true =
  suc (count-where predicate items)

any-list :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Bool) ->
  List A ->
  Bool
any-list predicate LNil =
  false
any-list predicate (item L:: items) with predicate item
... | true =
  true
... | false =
  any-list predicate items

subset-cardinality :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Nat
subset-cardinality VNil =
  zero
subset-cardinality (false V:: tail) =
  subset-cardinality tail
subset-cardinality (true V:: tail) =
  suc (subset-cardinality tail)

same-subset :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
same-subset VNil VNil =
  true
same-subset (false V:: left) (false V:: right) =
  same-subset left right
same-subset (false V:: left) (true V:: right) =
  false
same-subset (true V:: left) (false V:: right) =
  false
same-subset (true V:: left) (true V:: right) =
  same-subset left right

subset-of :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
subset-of VNil VNil =
  true
subset-of (left V:: left-tail) (right V:: right-tail) =
  bool-implies left right && subset-of left-tail right-tail

colex-lt :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
colex-lt VNil VNil =
  false
colex-lt
  (left V:: left-tail)
  (right V:: right-tail)
  with same-subset left-tail right-tail
... | true =
  bool-lt left right
... | false =
  colex-lt left-tail right-tail

remove-one :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
remove-one smaller larger =
  subset-of smaller larger &&
  nat-equal
    (suc (subset-cardinality smaller))
    (subset-cardinality larger)

family-size :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Family n ->
  Nat
family-size n family =
  count-where family (all-subsets n)

shadow-member :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Family n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
shadow-member n family smaller =
  any-list
    (\ larger -> family larger && remove-one smaller larger)
    (all-subsets n)

shadow-size :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Family n ->
  Nat
shadow-size n family =
  count-where (shadow-member n family) (all-subsets n)

Sized :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Family n ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Sized {n} family r =
  (subset : Subset n) ->
  IsTrue (family subset) ->
  subset-cardinality subset == r

record IsInitialColexSegment
  {n : Nat}
  (family : Family n)
  (r : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    sized :
      Sized family r

    downward-closed :
      (larger smaller : Subset n) ->
      IsTrue (family larger) ->
      IsTrue (colex-lt smaller larger) ->
      subset-cardinality smaller == r ->
      IsTrue (family smaller)

kruskal-katona-theorem :
  Set
kruskal-katona-theorem =
  (n r : Nat) ->
  (A C : Family n) ->
  Sized A r ->
  family-size n C <= family-size n A ->
  IsInitialColexSegment C r ->
  shadow-size n C <= shadow-size n A

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527102, "Kruskal–Katona theorem": among uniform families of subsets of
  Fin n, a no-larger initial segment of colex has no larger lower shadow.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val q3527102_colex_le_def = new_definition (
  "q3527102_colex_le_def",
  ``q3527102_colex_le (s : num set) (t : num set) <=>
      !a. a IN s /\ ~(a IN t) ==>
          ?b. b IN t /\ ~(b IN s) /\ a <= b``);

val q3527102_colex_lt_def = new_definition (
  "q3527102_colex_lt_def",
  ``q3527102_colex_lt (s : num set) (t : num set) <=>
      q3527102_colex_le s t /\ s <> t``);

val q3527102_uniform_family_def = new_definition (
  "q3527102_uniform_family_def",
  ``q3527102_uniform_family
      (n : num) (r : num) (family : (num set) set) <=>
      FINITE family /\
      !s. s IN family ==>
          FINITE s /\ s SUBSET count n /\ CARD s = r``);

val q3527102_is_colex_initial_segment_def = new_definition (
  "q3527102_is_colex_initial_segment_def",
  ``q3527102_is_colex_initial_segment
      (n : num) (r : num) (family : (num set) set) <=>
      q3527102_uniform_family n r family /\
      !s t.
        s IN family /\
        FINITE t /\
        t SUBSET count n /\
        CARD t = r /\
        q3527102_colex_lt t s
        ==>
        t IN family``);

val q3527102_shadow_def = new_definition (
  "q3527102_shadow_def",
  ``q3527102_shadow (family : (num set) set) =
      {t : num set |
         ?s a. s IN family /\ a IN s /\ t = s DELETE a}``);

val kruskal_katona =
  ``!n r : num. !family initial : (num set) set.
      q3527102_uniform_family n r family /\
      CARD initial <= CARD family /\
      q3527102_is_colex_initial_segment n r initial
      ==>
      CARD (q3527102_shadow initial) <=
      CARD (q3527102_shadow family)``;

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527102
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527102), "Kruskal–Katona theorem":
  among
  r-uniform families of subsets of an n-element ordered set, an initial
  segment of colex order has no larger lower shadow than any family of at
  least the same cardinality. This root artifact file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The finite ordered type Fin n is represented by SetMM's canonical finite
  ordinal 0 ..^ n. Q3527102ColexLe A B says that A precedes or equals B in
  colex order: when they differ, the greatest element at which membership
  differs belongs to B.

  Q3527102Shadow n F is the lower shadow of F, consisting of the subsets
  obtained by deleting one element from a member of F. Q3527102IsInitSeg
  states both r-uniformity and downward closure among all r-element subsets
  of 0 ..^ n in colex order.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding local $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions. This
  root artifact declares no local $p statement; imported lib/set.mm contains
  its standard library proofs.
$)

$c Q3527102ColexLe Q3527102Shadow Q3527102IsInitSeg $.

q3527102-colex-le-syntax $a
  wff ( Q3527102ColexLe A B ) $.
q3527102-shadow-syntax $a
  class ( Q3527102Shadow n F ) $.
q3527102-is-init-seg-syntax $a
  wff ( Q3527102IsInitSeg n r C ) $.

${
  $d A B j k $.

  q3527102-colex-le-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527102ColexLe A B )
    <->
    (
      A = B
      \/
      E. k e. B
        (
          -. k e. A
          /\
          A. j e. NN0
            (
              k < j
              ->
              ( j e. A <-> j e. B )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F n s t $.

  q3527102-shadow-definition $a |- (
    Q3527102Shadow n F
  ) = {
    s e. ~P ( 0 ..^ n ) |
    E. t e. F
      (
        s C_ t
        /\
        ( ( # ` s ) + 1 ) = ( # ` t )
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d C a b n r $.

  q3527102-is-init-seg-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527102IsInitSeg n r C )
    <->
    (
      C C_ ~P ( 0 ..^ n )
      /\
      (
        A. a e. C ( # ` a ) = r
        /\
        A. a e. C

title: Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q3527102,
% "Kruskal–Katona theorem": among uniform families of subsets of Fin n, a
% colex initial segment of no greater cardinality has no larger shadow. This
% file contains no proof.

Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem[n: nat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element: TYPE = below(n)
  element_set: TYPE = [element -> bool]
  finite_family: TYPE = [element_set -> bool]

  has_cardinality(member_set: element_set, r: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [below(r) -> (member_set)]):
      bijective?(enumeration)

  uniform_family(family: finite_family, r: nat): bool =
    FORALL (member_set: element_set):
      family(member_set) IMPLIES has_cardinality(member_set, r)

  colex_lt(left, right: element_set): bool =
    EXISTS (pivot: element):
      right(pivot)
        AND NOT left(pivot)
        AND
          (FORALL (larger: element):
            pivot < larger IMPLIES
              (left(larger) IFF right(larger)))

  colex_le(left, right: element_set): bool =
    left = right OR colex_lt(left, right)

  initial_colex_segment(family: finite_family, r: nat): bool =
    uniform_family(family, r)
      AND
        (FORALL (included_set, earlier_set: element_set):
          family(included_set)
            AND has_cardinality(earlier_set, r)
            AND colex_le(earlier_set, included_set)
          IMPLIES family(earlier_set))

  insert_element(
      inserted_element: element,
      member_set: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (candidate: element):
      candidate = inserted_element OR member_set(candidate)

  shadow(family: finite_family): finite_family =
    LAMBDA (smaller_set: element_set):
      EXISTS (removed_element: element):
        NOT smaller_set(removed_element)
          AND family(insert_element(removed_element, smaller_set))

  cardinality_le(smaller, larger: finite_family): bool =
    EXISTS (embedding: [(smaller) -> (larger)]):
      injective?(embedding)

  kruskal_katona_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (r: nat), (family, initial_segment: finite_family):
      (uniform_family(family, r)
        AND cardinality_le(initial_segment, family)
        AND initial_colex_segment(initial_segment, r))
      IMPLIES
        cardinality_le(shadow(initial_segment), shadow(family))
END Q3527102_kruskal_katona_theorem

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3527118
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3527118), "Mahler's theorem": every continuous
-- function on the p-adic integers with values in a complete ultrametric normed
-- module is the sum of its Mahler series. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.ForwardDiff
public import Mathlib.NumberTheory.Padics.PadicIntegers
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Nonarchimedean
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Algebra

@[expose] public section

open IsUltrametricDist
open scoped fwdDiff

variable {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]

namespace Q3527118

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [Module ℤ_[p] E] [IsBoundedSMul ℤ_[p] E]
  [IsUltrametricDist E] [CompleteSpace E]

/--
Mahler's theorem, with the Mahler basis characterized as the continuous extension of the
natural-number binomial coefficient functions.
-/
theorem mahler_theorem_statement :
    ∃ b : ℕ → C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p]),
      (∀ k n : ℕ, b k (n : ℤ_[p]) = (n.choose k : ℤ_[p])) ∧
      ∀ f : C(ℤ_[p], E),
        HasSum
          (fun n ↦ b n • ContinuousMap.const ℤ_[p] (Δ_[1]^[n] f 0))
          f := sorry

end Q3527118

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527118
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527118), "Mahler's theorem": every continuous
  function from the p-adic integers to a complete nonarchimedean normed
  p-adic module is the uniform sum of its Mahler series, whose coefficients
  are its iterated forward differences at zero. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3527118_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1%nat \/ d = p.

Fixpoint q3527118_nat_choose
    (n k : nat) {struct n} : nat :=
  match n with
  | O =>
      match k with
      | O => 1
      | S _ => 0
      end
  | S m =>
      match k with
      | O => 1
      | S j =>
          q3527118_nat_choose m j +
          q3527118_nat_choose m (S j)
      end
  end.

Record q3527118_padic_integers
    (p : nat) (Zp : Type) : Type := {
  q3527118_pzero : Zp;
  q3527118_pone : Zp;
  q3527118_padd : Zp -> Zp -> Zp;
  q3527118_pmul : Zp -> Zp -> Zp;
  q3527118_pneg : Zp -> Zp;
  q3527118_pnorm : Zp -> R;
  q3527118_nat_cast : nat -> Zp;
  q3527118_choose : Zp -> nat -> Zp;

  q3527118_padd_assoc :
    forall x y z : Zp,
      q3527118_padd x (q3527118_padd y z) =
      q3527118_padd (q3527118_padd x y) z;
  q3527118_padd_comm :
    forall x y : Zp, q3527118_padd x y = q3527118_padd y x;
  q3527118_padd_zero :
    forall x : Zp, q3527118_padd x q3527118_pzero = x;
  q3527118_padd_neg :
    forall x : Zp,
      q3527118_padd x (q3527118_pneg x) = q3527118_pzero;
  q3527118_pmul_assoc :
    forall x y z : Zp,
      q3527118_pmul x (q3527118_pmul y z) =
      q3527118_pmul (q3527118_pmul x y) z;
  q3527118_pmul_comm :
    forall x y : Zp, q3527118_pmul x y = q3527118_pmul y x;
  q3527118_pmul_one :
    forall x : Zp, q3527118_pmul x q3527118_pone = x;
  q3527118_pmul_add :
    forall x y z : Zp,
      q3527118_pmul x (q3527118_padd y z) =
      q3527118_padd
        (q3527118_pmul x y) (q3527118_pmul x z);

  q3527118_pnorm_nonnegative :
    forall x : Zp, 0 <= q3527118_pnorm x;
  q3527118_pnorm_eq_zero :
    forall x : Zp,
      q3527118_pnorm x = 0 <-> x = q3527118_pzero;
  q3527118_pnorm_neg :
    forall x : Zp,
      q3527118_pnorm (q3527118_pneg x) = q3527118_pnorm x;
  q3527118_pnorm_add_ultrametric :
    forall x y : Zp,
      q3527118_pnorm (q3527118_padd x y) <=
      Rmax (q3527118_pnorm x) (q3527118_pnorm y);
  q3527118_pnorm_mul :
    forall x y : Zp,
      q3527118_pnorm (q3527118_pmul x y) =
      q3527118_pnorm x * q3527118_pnorm y;
  q3527118_pnorm_one :
    q3527118_pnorm q3527118_pone = 1;

  q3527118_nat_cast_zero :
    q3527118_nat_cast 0 = q3527118_pzero;
  q3527118_nat_cast_one :
    q3527118_nat_cast 1 = q3527118_pone;
  q3527118_nat_cast_add :
    forall m n : nat,
      q3527118_nat_cast (m + n) =
      q3527118_padd (q3527118_nat_cast m) (q3527118_nat_cast n);
  q3527118_nat_cast_mul :
    forall m n : nat,
      q3527118_nat_cast (m * n) =
      q3527118_pmul (q3527118_nat_cast m) (q3527118_nat_cast n);

  q3527118_padic_ball_divisibility :
    forall (x : Zp) (k : nat),
      q3527118_pnorm x <= (/ INR p) ^ k <->
      exists y : Zp,
        x =
        q3527118_pmul
          (q3527118_nat_cast (Nat.pow p k)) y;

  q3527118_padic_complete :
    forall u : nat -> Zp,
      (forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists N : nat,
          forall m n : nat,
            (N <= m)%nat ->
            (N <= n)%nat ->
            q3527118_pnorm
              (q3527118_padd
                (u m) (q3527118_pneg (u n))) < epsilon) ->
      exists limit : Zp,
        forall epsilon : R,
          0 < epsilon ->
          exists N : nat,
            forall n : nat,
              (N <= n)%nat ->
              q3527118_pnorm
                (q3527118_padd
                  (u n) (q3527118_pneg limit)) < epsilon;
  q3527118_nat_cast_dense :
    forall (x : Zp) (epsilon : R),
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists n : nat,
        q3527118_pnorm
          (q3527118_padd
            x (q3527118_pneg (q3527118_nat_cast n))) < epsilon;

  q3527118_choose_nat :
    forall m k : nat,
      q3527118_choose (q3527118_nat_cast m) k =
      q3527118_nat_cast (q3527118_nat_choose m k);
  q3527118_choose_continuous :
    forall (k : nat) (x : Zp) (epsilon : R),
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall y : Zp,
          q3527118_pnorm
            (q3527118_padd y (q3527118_pneg x)) < delta ->
          q3527118_pnorm
            (q3527118_padd
              (q3527118_choose y k)
              (q3527118_pneg (q3527118_choose x k))) < epsilon
}.

Arguments q3527118_pzero {p Zp} _.
Arguments q3527118_pone {p Zp} _.
Arguments q3527118_padd {p Zp} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527118_pmul {p Zp} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527118_pneg {p Zp} _ _.
Arguments q3527118_pnorm {p Zp} _ _.
Arguments q3527118_nat_cast {p Zp} _ _.
Arguments q3527118_choose {p Zp} _ _ _.

Record q3527118_padic_banach_module
    (p : nat) (Zp E : Type)
    (P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp) : Type := {
  q3527118_vzero : E;
  q3527118_vadd : E -> E -> E;
  q3527118_vneg : E -> E;
  q3527118_smul : Zp -> E -> E;
  q3527118_vnorm : E -> R;

  q3527118_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q3527118_vadd x (q3527118_vadd y z) =
      q3527118_vadd (q3527118_vadd x y) z;
  q3527118_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : E, q3527118_vadd x y = q3527118_vadd y x;
  q3527118_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E, q3527118_vadd x q3527118_vzero = x;
  q3527118_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q3527118_vadd x (q3527118_vneg x) = q3527118_vzero;

  q3527118_smul_one :
    forall x : E, q3527118_smul (q3527118_pone P) x = x;
  q3527118_smul_mul :
    forall (a b : Zp) (x : E),
      q3527118_smul (q3527118_pmul P a b) x =
      q3527118_smul a (q3527118_smul b x);
  q3527118_smul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : Zp) (x : E),
      q3527118_smul (q3527118_padd P a b) x =
      q3527118_vadd (q3527118_smul a x) (q3527118_smul b x);
  q3527118_smul_add_vector :
    forall (a : Zp) (x y : E),
      q3527118_smul a (q3527118_vadd x y) =
      q3527118_vadd (q3527118_smul a x) (q3527118_smul a y);

  q3527118_vnorm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q3527118_vnorm x;
  q3527118_vnorm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q3527118_vnorm x = 0 <-> x = q3527118_vzero;
  q3527118_vnorm_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q3527118_vnorm (q3527118_vneg x) = q3527118_vnorm x;
  q3527118_vnorm_add_ultrametric :
    forall x y : E,
      q3527118_vnorm (q3527118_vadd x y) <=
      Rmax (q3527118_vnorm x) (q3527118_vnorm y);
  q3527118_vnorm_smul_le :
    forall (a : Zp) (x : E),
      q3527118_vnorm (q3527118_smul a x) <=
      q3527118_pnorm P a * q3527118_vnorm x;

  q3527118_module_complete :
    forall u : nat -> E,
      (forall epsilon : R,
        0 < epsilon ->
        exists N : nat,
          forall m n : nat,
            (N <= m)%nat ->
            (N <= n)%nat ->
            q3527118_vnorm
              (q3527118_vadd
                (u m) (q3527118_vneg (u n))) < epsilon) ->
      exists limit : E,
        forall epsilon : R,
          0 < epsilon ->
          exists N : nat,
            forall n : nat,
              (N <= n)%nat ->
              q3527118_vnorm
                (q3527118_vadd
                  (u n) (q3527118_vneg limit)) < epsilon
}.

Arguments q3527118_vzero {p Zp E P} _.
Arguments q3527118_vadd {p Zp E P} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527118_vneg {p Zp E P} _ _.
Arguments q3527118_smul {p Zp E P} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527118_vnorm {p Zp E P} _ _.

Definition q3527118_psub
    {p : nat} {Zp : Type}
    (P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp)
    (x y : Zp) : Zp :=
  q3527118_padd P x (q3527118_pneg P y).

Definition q3527118_vsub
    {p : nat} {Zp E : Type}
    {P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp}
    (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q3527118_vadd V x (q3527118_vneg V y).

Definition q3527118_continuous
    {p : nat} {Zp E : Type}
    {P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp}
    (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
    (f : Zp -> E) : Prop :=
  forall (x : Zp) (epsilon : R),
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : Zp,
        q3527118_pnorm P (q3527118_psub P y x) < delta ->
        q3527118_vnorm V
          (q3527118_vsub V (f y) (f x)) < epsilon.

Fixpoint q3527118_fwd_diff_iter
    {p : nat} {Zp E : Type}
    {P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp}
    (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
    (f : Zp -> E) (n : nat) (x : Zp) : E :=
  match n with
  | O => f x
  | S k =>
      q3527118_vsub V
        (q3527118_fwd_diff_iter V f k
          (q3527118_padd P x (q3527118_pone P)))
        (q3527118_fwd_diff_iter V f k x)
  end.

Definition q3527118_mahler_term
    {p : nat} {Zp E : Type}
    {P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp}
    (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
    (f : Zp -> E) (n : nat) (x : Zp) : E :=
  q3527118_smul V
    (q3527118_choose P x n)
    (q3527118_fwd_diff_iter V f n (q3527118_pzero P)).

Fixpoint q3527118_finite_sum
    {p : nat} {Zp E : Type}
    {P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp}
    (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
    (terms : nat -> Zp -> E)
    (indices : list nat) (x : Zp) : E :=
  match indices with
  | nil => q3527118_vzero V
  | cons n rest =>
      q3527118_vadd V
        (terms n x) (q3527118_finite_sum V terms rest x)
  end.

Definition q3527118_contains
    (base candidate : list nat) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat, In n base -> In n candidate.

Definition q3527118_has_uniform_sum
    {p : nat} {Zp E : Type}
    {P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp}
    (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
    (terms : nat -> Zp -> E)
    (sum : Zp -> E) : Prop :=
  (forall n : nat, q3527118_continuous V (terms n)) /\
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists base : list nat,
      NoDup base /\
      forall indices : list nat,
        NoDup indices ->
        q3527118_contains base indices ->
        forall x : Zp,
          q3527118_vnorm V
            (q3527118_vsub V
              (q3527118_finite_sum V terms indices x)
              (sum x)) < epsilon.

Module PadicInt.

Theorem hasSum_mahler :
  forall (p : nat),
    q3527118_prime p ->
    forall (Zp E : Type)
           (P : q3527118_padic_integers p Zp)
           (V : @q3527118_padic_banach_module p Zp E P)
           (f : Zp -> E),
      q3527118_continuous V f ->
      q3527118_has_uniform_sum V
        (q3527118_mahler_term V f) f.
Admitted.

End PadicInt.

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527118 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527118), "Mahler's theorem":
  the Mahler series of a continuous function on the p-adic integers, with
  coefficients given by iterated forward differences at zero, sums uniformly
  to that function in every complete ultrametric normed module. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym q3527118_padic_int = "nat \<Rightarrow> int"

definition q3527118_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    1 < p \<and> (\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

definition q3527118_padic_valid ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_padic_valid p x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>n. 0 \<le> x n \<and> x n < int (p ^ Suc n)) \<and>
    (\<forall>n m. m \<le> n \<longrightarrow>
      x n mod int (p ^ Suc m) = x m)"

definition q3527118_padic_zero :: q3527118_padic_int where
  "q3527118_padic_zero = (\<lambda>n. 0)"

definition q3527118_padic_nat ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_padic_nat p a =
    (\<lambda>n. int a mod int (p ^ Suc n))"

definition q3527118_padic_one ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_padic_one p = q3527118_padic_nat p 1"

definition q3527118_padic_add ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_padic_add p x y =
    (\<lambda>n. (x n + y n) mod int (p ^ Suc n))"

definition q3527118_padic_neg ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_padic_neg p x =
    (\<lambda>n. (- x n) mod int (p ^ Suc n))"

definition q3527118_padic_sub ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_padic_sub p x y =
    q3527118_padic_add p x (q3527118_padic_neg p y)"

definition q3527118_padic_mul ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_padic_mul p x y =
    (\<lambda>n. (x n * y n) mod int (p ^ Suc n))"

definition q3527118_padic_valuation ::
    "q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q3527118_padic_valuation x = (LEAST n. x n \<noteq> 0)"

definition q3527118_padic_norm ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q3527118_padic_norm p x =
    (if x = q3527118_padic_zero then 0
     else inverse ((real p) ^ q3527118_padic_valuation x))"

definition q3527118_padic_dist ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow>
      real" where
  "q3527118_padic_dist p x y =
    q3527118_padic_norm p (q3527118_padic_sub p x y)"

definition q3527118_complete ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_complete normE \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>N. \<forall>m \<ge> N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
        normE (u m - u n) < epsilon) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. \<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>N. \<forall>n \<ge> N.
        normE (u n - x) < epsilon))"

definition q3527118_continuous ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_continuous p normE f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. q3527118_padic_valid p x \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>delta > 0. \<forall>y.
        q3527118_padic_valid p y \<longrightarrow>
        q3527118_padic_dist p y x < delta \<longrightarrow>
        normE (f y - f x) < epsilon))"

definition q3527118_padic_continuous ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int) \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "q3527118_padic_continuous p g \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. q3527118_padic_valid p x \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>delta > 0. \<forall>y.
        q3527118_padic_valid p y \<longrightarrow>
        q3527118_padic_dist p y x < delta \<longrightarrow>
        q3527118_padic_dist p (g y) (g x) < epsilon))"

definition q3527118_normed_module ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_normed_module p normE smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> normE x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. normE x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. normE (-x) = normE x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. normE (x + y) \<le> max (normE x) (normE y)) \<and>
    q3527118_complete normE \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smul (q3527118_padic_one p) x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smul q3527118_padic_zero x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. q3527118_padic_valid p a \<longrightarrow> smul a 0 = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x y. q3527118_padic_valid p a \<longrightarrow>
      smul a (x + y) = smul a x + smul a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x.
      q3527118_padic_valid p a \<longrightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_valid p b \<longrightarrow>
      smul (q3527118_padic_add p a b) x = smul a x + smul b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x.
      q3527118_padic_valid p a \<longrightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_valid p b \<longrightarrow>
      smul (q3527118_padic_mul p a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. q3527118_padic_valid p a \<longrightarrow>
      normE (smul a x) \<le> q3527118_padic_norm p a * normE x)"

definition q3527118_mahler_characterizes ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_mahler_characterizes p k g \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. q3527118_padic_valid p x \<longrightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_valid p (g x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. \<not> q3527118_padic_valid p x \<longrightarrow>
      g x = q3527118_padic_zero) \<and>
    q3527118_padic_continuous p g \<and>
    (\<forall>m. g (q3527118_padic_nat p m) =
      q3527118_padic_nat p (m choose k))"

definition q3527118_mahler ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow>
      q3527118_padic_int" where
  "q3527118_mahler p k =
    (THE g. q3527118_mahler_characterizes p k g)"

primrec q3527118_fwd_diff ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q3527118_fwd_diff p f 0 x = f x"
| "q3527118_fwd_diff p f (Suc n) x =
    q3527118_fwd_diff p f n
      (q3527118_padic_add p x (q3527118_padic_one p)) -
    q3527118_fwd_diff p f n x"

definition q3527118_mahler_term ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow>
      (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q3527118_mahler_term p smul f n x =
    smul (q3527118_mahler p n x)
      (q3527118_fwd_diff p f n q3527118_padic_zero)"

definition q3527118_has_sum_in_continuous_maps ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527118_has_sum_in_continuous_maps p normE term f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>n. q3527118_continuous p normE (term n)) \<and>
    (\<forall>epsilon > 0. \<exists>S0 :: nat set.
      finite S0 \<and>
      (\<forall>S. finite S \<longrightarrow> S0 \<subseteq> S \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x. q3527118_padic_valid p x \<longrightarrow>
          normE ((\<Sum>n\<in>S. term n x) - f x) < epsilon)))"

theorem hasSum_mahler:
  fixes p :: nat
    and normE :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and smul :: "q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "q3527118_padic_int \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes prime: "q3527118_prime p"
    and normed_module:
      "q3527118_normed_module TYPE('e) p normE smul"
    and continuous: "q3527118_continuous p normE f"
  shows "q3527118_has_sum_in_continuous_maps p normE
    (q3527118_mahler_term p smul f) f"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527118,
  "Mahler's theorem": the Mahler series of a continuous function on the
  p-adic integers, with coefficients given by iterated forward differences,
  converges uniformly to that function. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/binomial.ml";;

let Q3527118_MAHLER_S_THEOREM =
 `let padic_nat_distance =
      \p:num. \m n:num.
        if m = n then &0
        else
          let d = if m <= n then n - m else m - n in
          inv
            ((&p) pow
             (@k:num.
                (p EXP k) divides d /\
                ~((p EXP (SUC k)) divides d))) in
   let complete_metric =
      \(metric:P->P->real).
        !u:num->P.
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num.
                   !m n:num.
                     N <= m /\ N <= n
                     ==> metric (u m) (u n) < epsilon)
          ==> ?limit:P.
                !epsilon:real.
                  &0 < epsilon
                  ==> ?N:num.
                        !n:num.
                          N <= n
                          ==> metric (u n) limit < epsilon in
   let padic_integer_model =
      \p:num.
       \(pzero:P) (pone:P) (padd:P->P->P) (pneg:P->P)
       (pmul:P->P->P) (of_num:num->P) (pdist:P->P->real).
        (!x y:P. padd x y = padd y x) /\
        (!x y z:P. padd (padd x y) z = padd x (padd y z)) /\
        (!x:P. padd x pzero = x) /\
        (!x:P. padd x (pneg x) = pzero) /\
        (!x y:P. pmul x y = pmul y x) /\
        (!x y z:P. pmul (pmul x y) z = pmul x (pmul y z)) /\
        (!x:P. pmul x pone = x) /\
        (!x y z:P.
           pmul x (padd y z) =
           padd (pmul x y) (pmul x z)) /\
        of_num 0 = pzero /\
        of_num 1 = pone /\
        (!m n:num. of_num (m + n) = padd (of_num m) (of_num n)) /\
        (!m n:num. of_num (m * n) = pmul (of_num m) (of_num n)) /\
        (!x y:P. &0 <= pdist x y) /\
        (!x y:P. pdist x y = &0 <=> x = y) /\
        (!x y:P. pdist x y = pdist y x) /\
        (!x y z:P.
           pdist x z <= max (pdist x y) (pdist y z)) /\
        (!x y z:P.
           pdist (padd x z) (padd y z) = pdist x y) /\
        (!x y:P.
           pdist pzero (pmul x y) =
           pdist pzero x * pdist pzero y) /\
        complete_metric pdist /\
        (!x:P. !epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?n:num. pdist (of_num n) x < epsilon) /\
        (!m n:num.
           pdist (of_num m) (of_num n) =
           padic_nat_distance p m n) in
   let mahler_basis =
      \(of_num:num->P) (pdist:P->P->real) (mahler:num->P->P).
        (!k n:num.
           mahler k (of_num n) = of_num (binom (n,k))) /\
        (!k:num. !x:P. !epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?delta:real.
                 &0 < delta /\
                 !y:P.
                   pdist y x < delta
                   ==> pdist (mahler k y) (mahler k x) < epsilon) in
   let normed_add_comm_group =
      \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
        (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
        (!x:A. norm (neg x) = norm x) in
   let ultrametric_norm =
      \(add:A->A->A) (norm:A->real).
        !x y:A. norm (add x y) <= max (norm x) (norm y) in
   let complete_normed_group =
      \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
        !u:num->A.
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num.
                   !m n:num.
                     N <= m /\ N <= n
                     ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
          ==> ?limit:A.
                !epsilon:real.
                  &0 < epsilon
                  ==> ?N:num.
                        !n:num.
                          N <= n
                          ==> norm
                                (add (u n) (neg limit)) < epsilon in
   let module_over_padic_integers =
      \(pzero:P) (pone:P) (padd:P->P->P) (pmul:P->P->P)
       (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (smul:P->A->A).
        (!x:A. smul pone x = x) /\
        (!r s:P. !x:A.
           smul (pmul r s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
        (!r s:P. !x:A.
           smul (padd r s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
        (!r:P. !x y:A.
           smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
        (!x:A. smul pzero x = zero) /\
        (!r:P. smul r zero = zero) in
   let bounded_padic_smul =
      \(pzero:P) (pdist:P->P->real)
       (smul:P->A->A) (norm:A->real).
        !r:P. !x:A.
          norm (smul r x) <= pdist pzero r * norm x in
   let continuous_function =
      \(pdist:P->P->real)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (f:P->A).
        !x:P. !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !y:P.
                  pdist y x < delta
                  ==> norm (add (f y) (neg (f x))) < epsilon in
   let forward_difference =
      \(pone:P) (padd:P->P->P)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (f:P->A) (n:num).
        (@differences:num->P->A.
           differences 0 = f /\
           (!k:num. !x:P.
              differences (SUC k) x =
              add (differences k (padd x pone))
                  (neg (differences k x)))) n in
   let mahler_term =
      \(pzero:P) (pone:P) (padd:P->P->P)
       (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:P->A->A)
       (mahler:num->P->P) (f:P->A) (n:num) (x:P).
        smul (mahler n x)
          ((forward_difference pone padd add neg f n) pzero) in
   let partial_sum =
      \(pzero:P) (pone:P) (padd:P->P->P)
       (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
       (smul:P->A->A) (mahler:num->P->P)
       (f:P->A) (n:num) (x:P).
        (@sums:num->P->A.
           (!y:P. sums 0 y = zero) /\
           (!k:num. !y:P.
              sums (SUC k) y =
              add (sums k y)
                (mahler_term
                  pzero pone padd add neg smul mahler f k y))) n x in
   !p:num.
   !pzero:P.
   !pone:P.
   !padd:P->P->P.
   !pneg:P->P.
   !pmul:P->P->P.
   !of_num:num->P.
   !pdist:P->P->real.
   !mahler:num->P->P.
   !zero:A.
   !add:A->A->A.
   !neg:A->A.
   !smul:P->A->A.
   !norm:A->real.
   !f:P->A.
     prime p /\
     padic_integer_model
       p pzero pone padd pneg pmul of_num pdist /\
     mahler_basis of_num pdist mahler /\
     normed_add_comm_group zero add neg norm /\
     ultrametric_norm add norm /\
     complete_normed_group add neg norm /\
     module_over_padic_integers
       pzero pone padd pmul zero add smul /\
     bounded_padic_smul pzero pdist smul norm /\
     continuous_function pdist add neg norm f
     ==> !epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?N:num.
                 !n:num.
                   N <= n
                   ==> !x:P.
                         norm
                           (add
                             (partial_sum
                               pzero pone padd zero add neg smul
                               mahler f n x)
                             (neg (f x))) < epsilon`;;

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527118,
;; "Mahler's theorem": every continuous function from the p-adic integers to a
;; complete nonarchimedean normed p-adic-integer module is the uniform sum of
;; its Mahler series with forward-difference coefficients. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Rational upper cuts represent real-valued norms exactly: NORM-LT(x,q)
;; means ||x|| < q for rational q. The p-adic carrier is characterized as the
;; complete separated completion of the integers for the p-adic norm. Thus its
;; abstract presentation is unique up to the canonical isometric ring
;; isomorphism with Z_p; it is not a finite or rational approximation.
;;
;; APPLY$ function objects retain arbitrary carriers, operations, sequences,
;; and continuous functions. The final HasSum predicate uses the unbounded net
;; of all finite subsets of the natural numbers and uniform convergence on
;; Z_p, exactly matching HasSum in the continuous-map norm.

(defun q3527118-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list value)) t nil))

(defun q3527118-unary (function value)
  (apply$ function (list value)))

(defun q3527118-binary (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun q3527118-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and (rationalp value)
       (< 0 value)))

;; Primality of the p-adic prime.

(defun q3527118-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (q3527118-no-divisor-from-p number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun q3527118-prime-p (number)
  (and (natp number)
       (< 1 number)
       (q3527118-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

;; Nonnegative real norms represented by rounded rational upper cuts.

(defun q3527118-norm-lt-p (norm-lt object bound)
  (if (apply$ norm-lt (list object bound)) t nil))

(defun-sk q3527118-norm-finite-p (norm-lt object)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound))))

(defun-sk q3527118-norm-positive-p (norm-lt object)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound)
     (not (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound)))))

(defun-sk q3527118-norm-rounded-p (norm-lt object bound)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (< smaller bound)
     (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object smaller))))

(defun-sk q3527118-norm-cut-laws-p (carrier zero norm-lt)
  (forall (object bound larger)
    (implies
     (q3527118-member-p carrier object)
     (and
      (implies
       (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound)
       (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound))
      (implies
       (and
        (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound)
        (rationalp larger)
        (< bound larger))
       (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object larger))
      (implies
       (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound)
       (q3527118-norm-rounded-p norm-lt object bound))
      (q3527118-norm-finite-p norm-lt object)
      (iff
       (equal object zero)
       (not (q3527118-norm-positive-p norm-lt object)))
      (implies
       (equal object zero)
       (iff
        (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt object bound)
        (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound)))))))

(defun-sk q3527118-product-norm-lt-p
    (left-norm-lt right-norm-lt left right bound)
  (exists (left-bound right-bound)
    (and
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p left-bound)
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p right-bound)
     (q3527118-norm-lt-p
      left-norm-lt left left-bound)
     (q3527118-norm-lt-p
      right-norm-lt right right-bound)
     (< (* left-bound right-bound) bound))))

;; The p-adic integer ring.

(defun-sk q3527118-commutative-ring-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527118-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q3527118-binary add x y))
            (yz-add (q3527118-binary add y z))
            (xy-multiply (q3527118-binary multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (q3527118-binary multiply y z))
            (negative-x (q3527118-unary negate x)))
       (and
        (q3527118-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q3527118-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (q3527118-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary add xy-add z)
         (q3527118-binary add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3527118-binary add y x))
        (equal (q3527118-binary add x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary add x negative-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary multiply xy-multiply z)
         (q3527118-binary multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal
         xy-multiply
         (q3527118-binary multiply y x))
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary multiply x one)
         x)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary multiply x yz-add)
         (q3527118-binary
          add
          (q3527118-binary multiply x y)
          (q3527118-binary multiply x z))))))))

(defun q3527118-ring-nat (add zero one number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix number)))
  (if (zp number)
      zero
    (q3527118-binary
     add
     one
     (q3527118-ring-nat add zero one (1- number)))))

(defun q3527118-ring-int (add negate zero one integer)
  (if (integerp integer)
      (if (< integer 0)
          (q3527118-unary
           negate
           (q3527118-ring-nat
            add zero one (- integer)))
        (q3527118-ring-nat add zero one integer))
    zero))

(defun-sk q3527118-integer-padic-norm-lt-p
    (prime integer bound)
  (exists (exponent)
    (and
     (integerp integer)
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound)
     (natp exponent)
     (integerp
      (/ integer (expt prime exponent)))
     (< (/ 1 (expt prime exponent)) bound))))

(defun-sk q3527118-padic-norm-laws-p
    (prime carrier add multiply negate zero one norm-lt)
  (forall (x y bound integer)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527118-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier y))
     (let ((xy-add (q3527118-binary add x y))
           (xy-multiply (q3527118-binary multiply x y))
           (negative-x (q3527118-unary negate x)))
       (and
        (iff
         (q3527118-norm-lt-p
          norm-lt negative-x bound)
         (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt x bound))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt x bound)
          (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt y bound))
         (q3527118-norm-lt-p
          norm-lt xy-add bound))
        (iff
         (q3527118-norm-lt-p
          norm-lt xy-multiply bound)
         (q3527118-product-norm-lt-p
          norm-lt norm-lt x y bound))
        (implies
         (integerp integer)
         (iff
          (q3527118-norm-lt-p
           norm-lt
           (q3527118-ring-int
            add negate zero one integer)
           bound)
          (q3527118-integer-padic-norm-lt-p
           prime integer bound))))))))

    (add negate norm-lt left right bound)
  (q3527118-norm-lt-p
   norm-lt
   (q3527118-binary
    add left (q3527118-unary negate right))
   bound))
