;; Complete nonarchimedean normed modules over the presented Z_p.

(defun-sk q3527118-module-laws-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-one
     carrier add negate zero smul)
  (forall (scalar other-scalar x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527118-member-p scalar-carrier scalar)
      (q3527118-member-p scalar-carrier other-scalar)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q3527118-binary add x y))
            (yz-add (q3527118-binary add y z))
            (negative-x (q3527118-unary negate x))
            (scalar-x (q3527118-binary smul scalar x)))
       (and
        (q3527118-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q3527118-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (q3527118-member-p carrier scalar-x)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary add xy-add z)
         (q3527118-binary add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3527118-binary add y x))
        (equal (q3527118-binary add x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary add x negative-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary smul scalar-one x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary
          smul
          (q3527118-binary
           scalar-multiply scalar other-scalar)
          x)
         (q3527118-binary
          smul scalar
          (q3527118-binary smul other-scalar x)))
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary
          smul
          (q3527118-binary
           scalar-add scalar other-scalar)
          x)
         (q3527118-binary
          add
          scalar-x
          (q3527118-binary smul other-scalar x)))
        (equal
         (q3527118-binary smul scalar xy-add)
         (q3527118-binary
          add
          scalar-x
          (q3527118-binary smul scalar y))))))))

(defun-sk q3527118-ultrametric-norm-laws-p
    (carrier add negate norm-lt)
  (forall (x y bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527118-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527118-member-p carrier y))
     (and
      (iff
       (q3527118-norm-lt-p
        norm-lt (q3527118-unary negate x) bound)

      (implies
       (and
        (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt x bound)
        (q3527118-norm-lt-p norm-lt y bound))

        norm-lt
        (q3527118-binary add x y)

(defun-sk q3527118-bounded-smul-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-norm-lt
     carrier smul norm-lt)
  (forall (scalar x bound)

      (q3527118-member-p scalar-carrier scalar)

      (q3527118-product-norm-lt-p

(defun q3527118-banach-module-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-one

   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp smul)
   (tamep-functionp norm-lt)

   (q3527118-module-laws-p
    scalar-carrier scalar-add scalar-multiply scalar-one

;; Continuity in the norm topologies.

(defun-sk q3527118-continuity-ball-p
    (domain-carrier domain-add domain-negate domain-norm-lt
     codomain-add codomain-negate codomain-norm-lt
     function point output-bound input-bound)

       codomain-add codomain-negate codomain-norm-lt

;; The Mahler basis is the unique continuous extension of n |-> choose(n,k).

(defun q3527118-binomial (number index)
  (declare
   (xargs :measure
          (+ (nfix number) (nfix index))))
  (cond
   ((or (not (natp number))
        (not (natp index)))
    0)
   ((zp index) 1)
   ((zp number) 0)
   ((< number index) 0)
   (t
    (+
     (q3527118-binomial
      (1- number) (1- index))
     (q3527118-binomial
      (1- number) index)))))

(defun-sk q3527118-mahler-typed-p
    (padic-carrier mahler)
  (forall (index x)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (q3527118-member-p padic-carrier x))
     (q3527118-member-p
      padic-carrier
      (q3527118-binary mahler index x)))))

      output-bound))))

(defun-sk q3527118-mahler-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate padic-norm-lt
     mahler index point output-bound)
  (exists (input-bound)
    (and
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p input-bound)
     (q3527118-mahler-continuity-ball-p
      padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate padic-norm-lt
      mahler index point output-bound input-bound))))

(defun-sk q3527118-mahler-continuous-p
    (padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate padic-norm-lt mahler)
  (forall (index point output-bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (q3527118-member-p padic-carrier point)
      (q3527118-positive-rational-p output-bound))

      padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate padic-norm-lt

    (padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate

  (and
   (tamep-functionp mahler)
   (q3527118-mahler-typed-p
    padic-carrier mahler)
   (q3527118-mahler-natural-values-p
    padic-add padic-zero padic-one mahler)
   (q3527118-mahler-continuous-p
    padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate

;; Iterated forward differences at zero, expressed by the exact finite
;; alternating-binomial formula.

(defun q3527118-forward-coefficient (number index)
  (let ((magnitude (q3527118-binomial number index)))
    (if (equal (mod (- number index) 2) 0)
        magnitude
      (- magnitude))))

(defun q3527118-forward-difference-prefix
    (number count function
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-zero module-smul)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      module-zero
    (let* ((index (1- count))
           (coefficient
            (q3527118-ring-int
             padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
             (q3527118-forward-coefficient number index)))
           (function-value
            (q3527118-unary
             function
             (q3527118-ring-nat
              padic-add padic-zero padic-one index)))
           (term
            (q3527118-binary
             module-smul coefficient function-value)))
      (q3527118-binary
       module-add
       (q3527118-forward-difference-prefix
        number index function
        padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
        module-add module-zero module-smul)
       term))))

(defun q3527118-forward-difference
    (number function
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-zero module-smul)
  (q3527118-forward-difference-prefix
   number (+ 1 (nfix number)) function
   padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
   module-add module-zero module-smul))

(defun q3527118-mahler-term
    (index point function mahler
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-zero module-smul)
  (q3527118-binary
   module-smul
   (q3527118-binary mahler index point)
   (q3527118-forward-difference
    index function
    padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
    module-add module-zero module-smul)))

;; Finite subsets of N and their Mahler sums.

(defun q3527118-natural-list-p (indices)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (natp (car indices))
       (q3527118-natural-list-p (cdr indices)))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun q3527118-finite-natural-set-p (indices)
  (and
   (true-listp indices)
   (q3527118-natural-list-p indices)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)))

(defun q3527118-subset-equal-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (q3527118-subset-equal-p (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun q3527118-mahler-finite-sum
    (indices point function mahler
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-zero module-smul)
  (if (consp indices)
      (q3527118-binary
       module-add
       (q3527118-mahler-term
        (car indices) point function mahler
        padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
        module-add module-zero module-smul)
       (q3527118-mahler-finite-sum
        (cdr indices) point function mahler
        padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
        module-add module-zero module-smul))
    module-zero))

(defun-sk q3527118-has-sum-tail-p
    (padic-carrier
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-negate module-zero module-smul module-norm-lt
     function mahler bound base-set)
  (forall (indices point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527118-finite-natural-set-p indices)
      (q3527118-subset-equal-p base-set indices)
      (q3527118-member-p padic-carrier point))
     (q3527118-distance-lt-p
      module-add module-negate module-norm-lt
      (q3527118-mahler-finite-sum
       indices point function mahler
       padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
       module-add module-zero module-smul)
      (q3527118-unary function point)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q3527118-has-sum-base-exists-p
    (padic-carrier
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-negate module-zero module-smul module-norm-lt
     function mahler bound)
  (exists (base-set)
    (and
     (q3527118-finite-natural-set-p base-set)
     (q3527118-has-sum-tail-p
      padic-carrier
      padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
      module-add module-negate module-zero module-smul module-norm-lt
      function mahler bound base-set))))

(defun-sk q3527118-mahler-has-sum-p
    (padic-carrier
     padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
     module-add module-negate module-zero module-smul module-norm-lt
     function mahler)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q3527118-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q3527118-has-sum-base-exists-p
      padic-carrier
      padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one
      module-add module-negate module-zero module-smul module-norm-lt
      function mahler bound))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3527118-mahler-s-theorem-statement
    (prime
     padic-carrier padic-add padic-multiply padic-negate
     padic-zero padic-one padic-norm-lt
     module-carrier module-add module-negate module-zero
     module-smul module-norm-lt
     mahler function)
  (implies
   (and
    (q3527118-padic-integers-p
     prime
     padic-carrier padic-add padic-multiply padic-negate
     padic-zero padic-one padic-norm-lt)
    (q3527118-banach-module-p
     padic-carrier padic-add padic-multiply padic-one
     padic-norm-lt
     module-carrier module-add module-negate module-zero
     module-smul module-norm-lt)
    (q3527118-mahler-basis-p
     padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate
     padic-zero padic-one padic-norm-lt mahler)
    (tamep-functionp function)
    (q3527118-continuous-map-p
     padic-carrier padic-add padic-negate padic-norm-lt
     module-carrier module-add module-negate module-norm-lt
     function))
   (q3527118-mahler-has-sum-p
    padic-carrier
    padic-add padic-negate padic-zero padic-one

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527118,
-- "Mahler's theorem": the canonical Mahler series of a continuous function
-- on the p-adic integers converges uniformly to that function. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_ _dividesN_ _dividesI_

data Bottom : Set where

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

record _dividesN_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotientN : Nat
    equationN : divisor * quotientN == dividend

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two :
      suc (suc zero) <=N p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d dividesN p ->
      Either (d == suc zero) (d == p)

naturalPower : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalPower base zero =
  suc zero
naturalPower base (suc exponent) =
  base * naturalPower base exponent

natPred : Nat -> Nat
natPred zero =
  zero
natPred (suc n) =
  n

negativeNat : Nat -> Int
negativeNat zero =
  pos zero
negativeNat (suc n) =
  negsuc n

intNegate : Int -> Int
intNegate (pos n) =
  negativeNat n
intNegate (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc n)

intDifference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
intDifference zero zero =
  pos zero
intDifference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
intDifference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
intDifference (suc m) (suc n) =
  intDifference m n

intAdd : Int -> Int -> Int
intAdd (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m + n)
intAdd (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  intDifference m (suc n)
intAdd (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  intDifference n (suc m)
intAdd (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

intMultiply : Int -> Int -> Int
intMultiply (pos m) (pos n) =
  pos (m * n)
intMultiply (pos m) (negsuc n) =
  negativeNat (m * suc n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (pos n) =
  negativeNat (suc m * n)
intMultiply (negsuc m) (negsuc n) =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

intSubtract : Int -> Int -> Int
intSubtract x y =
  intAdd x (intNegate y)

record _dividesI_ (divisor dividend : Int) : Set where
  field
    quotientI : Int
    equationI : intMultiply divisor quotientI == dividend

-- Positive rationals use positive numerator and denominator codes.  Their
-- cross-multiplication relations quotient this concrete representation.
record PositiveRational : Set where
  constructor positive-rational
  field
    numeratorCode   : Nat
    denominatorCode : Nat

open PositiveRational

numeratorValue : PositiveRational -> Nat
numeratorValue q =
  suc (numeratorCode q)

denominatorValue : PositiveRational -> Nat
denominatorValue q =
  suc (denominatorCode q)

RationalEqual : PositiveRational -> PositiveRational -> Set
RationalEqual q r =
  numeratorValue q * denominatorValue r ==
  numeratorValue r * denominatorValue q

RationalLT : PositiveRational -> PositiveRational -> Set
RationalLT q r =
  numeratorValue q * denominatorValue r
    <N
  numeratorValue r * denominatorValue q

divideByPadicPower :
  PositiveRational ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  PositiveRational
divideByPadicPower q p k =
  positive-rational
    (numeratorCode q)
    (natPred (denominatorValue q * naturalPower p k))

-- This is a fixed extensional construction of the nonnegative real line:
-- finite located upper Dedekind cuts of the positive rationals.
record Magnitude : Set1 where
  field
    upper :
      PositiveRational ->
      Set

    upper-respects-rational-equality :
      (q r : PositiveRational) ->
      RationalEqual q r ->
      Iff (upper q) (upper r)

    upper-inhabited :
      Exists PositiveRational upper

    upper-upward :
      (q r : PositiveRational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      upper q ->
      upper r

    upper-rounded :
      (q : PositiveRational) ->
      upper q ->
      Exists PositiveRational
        (\ r -> Both (RationalLT r q) (upper r))

    upper-located :
      (q r : PositiveRational) ->
      RationalLT q r ->
      Either (upper r) (Not (upper q))

open Magnitude

MagnitudeEqual : Magnitude -> Magnitude -> Set
MagnitudeEqual x y =
  (q : PositiveRational) ->
  Iff (upper x q) (upper y q)

-- A p-adic integer is represented by a formal sum sum_i a_i p^i with
-- integer coefficients.  PadicEqual below is the extensional quotient
-- relation identifying series congruent modulo every p^k.
PadicInteger : Nat -> Set
PadicInteger p =
  Nat -> Int

padicZero : (p : Nat) -> PadicInteger p
padicZero p n =
  pos zero

padicOne : (p : Nat) -> PadicInteger p
padicOne p zero =
  pos (suc zero)
padicOne p (suc n) =
  pos zero

padicFromNat : (p : Nat) -> Nat -> PadicInteger p
padicFromNat p n zero =
  pos n
padicFromNat p n (suc k) =
  pos zero

padicAdd :
  (p : Nat) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p
padicAdd p x y n =
  intAdd (x n) (y n)

padicNegate :
  (p : Nat) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p
padicNegate p x n =
  intNegate (x n)

convolutionAux :
  (p : Nat) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Int
convolutionAux p x y i j zero =
  intMultiply (x i) (y j)
convolutionAux p x y i j (suc count) =
  intAdd
    (intMultiply (x i) (y j))
    (convolutionAux p x y (suc i) (natPred j) count)

padicMultiply :
  (p : Nat) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p
padicMultiply p x y n =
  convolutionAux p x y zero n n

padicPrefix :
  (p : Nat) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  Nat ->
  Int
padicPrefix p x zero =
  pos zero
padicPrefix p x (suc k) =
  intAdd
    (padicPrefix p x k)
    (intMultiply (x k) (pos (naturalPower p k)))

PadicCongruent :
  (p : Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  Set
PadicCongruent p k x y =
  pos (naturalPower p k)
    dividesI
  intSubtract (padicPrefix p x k) (padicPrefix p y k)

PadicEqual :
  (p : Nat) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  Set
PadicEqual p x y =
  (k : Nat) ->
  PadicCongruent p k x y

PadicContinuous :
  (p : Nat) ->
  (PadicInteger p -> PadicInteger p) ->
  Set
PadicContinuous p function =
  (x : PadicInteger p) ->
  (outputPrecision : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ inputPrecision ->
      (y : PadicInteger p) ->
      PadicCongruent p inputPrecision y x ->
      PadicCongruent p outputPrecision
        (function y)
        (function x))

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose zero zero =
  suc zero
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) zero =
  suc zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

MahlerExtension :
  (p : Nat) ->
  (Nat -> PadicInteger p -> PadicInteger p) ->
  Set
MahlerExtension p basis =
  Both
    ((k : Nat) ->
      (x y : PadicInteger p) ->
      PadicEqual p x y ->
      PadicEqual p (basis k x) (basis k y))
    (Both
      ((k : Nat) ->
        PadicContinuous p (basis k))
      ((k n : Nat) ->
        PadicEqual p
          (basis k (padicFromNat p n))
          (padicFromNat p (choose n k))))

-- The canonical basis is characterized internally, rather than supplied as
-- a theorem parameter: it is the unique continuous extension of binomial
-- coefficients from the dense natural numbers.
record CanonicalMahler
  (p : Nat)
  (basis : Nat -> PadicInteger p -> PadicInteger p) :
  Set where

  field
    extension-properties :
      MahlerExtension p basis

    unique-extension :
      (other : Nat -> PadicInteger p -> PadicInteger p) ->
      MahlerExtension p other ->
      (k : Nat) ->
      (x : PadicInteger p) ->
      PadicEqual p (other k x) (basis k x)

record PAdicBanachModule (p : Nat) (E : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE :
      E
    addE :
      E -> E -> E
    negateE :
      E -> E
    scaleE :
      PadicInteger p -> E -> E
    normE :
      E -> Magnitude

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-respects-padicsE :
      (a b : PadicInteger p) ->
      PadicEqual p a b ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE a x == scaleE b x
    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (padicOne p) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : PadicInteger p) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (padicMultiply p a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : PadicInteger p) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (padicAdd p a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : PadicInteger p) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-zero-scalarE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (padicZero p) x == zeroE
    scale-zero-vectorE :
      (a : PadicInteger p) ->
      scaleE a zeroE == zeroE

    norm-zero-exactlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      Iff
        ((q : PositiveRational) -> upper (normE x) q)
        (x == zeroE)
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      MagnitudeEqual (normE (negateE x)) (normE x)
    norm-ultrametricE :
      (x y : E) ->
      (q : PositiveRational) ->
      upper (normE x) q ->
      upper (normE y) q ->
      upper (normE (addE x y)) q

    -- PadicCongruent p k a 0 says |a|_p <= p^(-k), so this is exactly
    -- the bounded scalar-action inequality in rational upper-cut form.
    norm-scale-boundedE :
      (a : PadicInteger p) ->
      (x : E) ->
      (k : Nat) ->
      (q : PositiveRational) ->
      PadicCongruent p k a (padicZero p) ->
      upper (normE x) q ->
      upper (normE (scaleE a x))
        (divideByPadicPower q p k)

    completeE :
      (sequence : Nat -> E) ->
      ((epsilon : PositiveRational) ->
        Exists Nat
          (\ cutoff ->
            (m n : Nat) ->
            cutoff <=N m ->
            cutoff <=N n ->
            upper
              (normE
                (addE (sequence m) (negateE (sequence n))))
              epsilon)) ->
      Exists E
        (\ limit ->
          (epsilon : PositiveRational) ->
          Exists Nat
            (\ cutoff ->
              (n : Nat) ->
              cutoff <=N n ->
              upper
                (normE
                  (addE (sequence n) (negateE limit)))
                epsilon))

open PAdicBanachModule

subtractE :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {E : Set} ->
  PAdicBanachModule p E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

record ContinuousPadicMap
  {p : Nat}
  {E : Set}
  (space : PAdicBanachModule p E)
  (function : PadicInteger p -> E) :
  Set where

  field
    respects-padic-equality :
      (x y : PadicInteger p) ->
      PadicEqual p x y ->
      function x == function y

    continuous :
      (x : PadicInteger p) ->
      (epsilon : PositiveRational) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ precision ->
          (y : PadicInteger p) ->
          PadicCongruent p precision y x ->
          upper
            (normE space
              (subtractE space (function y) (function x)))
            epsilon)

forwardDifference :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {E : Set} ->
  PAdicBanachModule p E ->
  Nat ->
  (PadicInteger p -> E) ->
  PadicInteger p ->
  E
forwardDifference space zero f x =
  f x
forwardDifference {p = p} space (suc n) f x =
  subtractE space
    (forwardDifference space n f
      (padicAdd p x (padicOne p)))
    (forwardDifference space n f x)

data Member {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  here  : {xs : List A} -> Member x (x ∷ xs)
  there : {y : A} {xs : List A} -> Member x xs -> Member x (y ∷ xs)

NoDuplicates : {A : Set} -> List A -> Set
NoDuplicates [] =
  Top
NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs) =
  Both (Not (Member x xs)) (NoDuplicates xs)

SubsetList : {A : Set} -> List A -> List A -> Set
SubsetList [] ys =
  Top
SubsetList (x ∷ xs) ys =
  Both (Member x ys) (SubsetList xs ys)

sumFunctions :
  {E X : Set} ->
  E ->
  (E -> E -> E) ->
  (Nat -> X -> E) ->
  List Nat ->
  X ->
  E
sumFunctions zeroValue addValue term [] x =
  zeroValue
sumFunctions zeroValue addValue term (n ∷ ns) x =
  addValue
    (term n x)
    (sumFunctions zeroValue addValue term ns x)

UniformHasSum :
  {E X : Set} ->
  E ->
  (E -> E -> E) ->
  (E -> E -> E) ->
  (E -> Magnitude) ->
  (Nat -> X -> E) ->
  (X -> E) ->
  Set
UniformHasSum zeroValue addValue subtractValue normValue term total =
  (epsilon : PositiveRational) ->
  Exists (List Nat)
    (\ base ->
      Both
        (NoDuplicates base)
        ((indices : List Nat) ->
          NoDuplicates indices ->
          SubsetList base indices ->
          (x : _) ->
          upper
            (normValue
              (subtractValue
                (sumFunctions
                  zeroValue addValue term indices x)
                (total x)))
            epsilon))

MahlerExpansion :
  {p : Nat} ->
  {E : Set} ->
  PAdicBanachModule p E ->
  (PadicInteger p -> E) ->
  Set
MahlerExpansion {p = p} space f =
  Exists
    (Nat -> PadicInteger p -> PadicInteger p)
    (\ mahler ->
      Both
        (CanonicalMahler p mahler)
        (UniformHasSum
          (zeroE space)
          (addE space)
          (subtractE space)
          (normE space)
          (\ n x ->
            scaleE space
              (mahler n x)
              (forwardDifference space n f (padicZero p)))
          f))

mahler-s-theorem : Set1
mahler-s-theorem =
  (p : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  (E : Set) ->
  (space : PAdicBanachModule p E) ->
  (f : PadicInteger p -> E) ->
  ContinuousPadicMap space f ->
  MahlerExpansion space f

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527118 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3527118), "Mahler's theorem": the
  Mahler series of a continuous function from the p-adic integers to a
  complete nonarchimedean normed module, with iterated forward differences
  as coefficients, sums uniformly to the function. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory combinTheory combinatoricsTheory;
open pred_setTheory realTheory;

val q3527118_padicVal_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_padicVal_def",
  ``q3527118_padicVal (p : num) (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then 0
      else MAX_SET {k : num | (p EXP k) divides n}``);

val q3527118_nat_padic_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_nat_padic_norm_def",
  ``q3527118_nat_padic_norm (p : num) (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then 0
      else inv (&(p EXP q3527118_padicVal p n))``);

val q3527118_sub_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_sub_def",
  ``q3527118_sub
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) (x : 'a) y =
      add x (neg y)``);

val q3527118_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_cauchy_def",
  ``q3527118_cauchy
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          norm (q3527118_sub add neg (u m) (u n)) < epsilon``);

val q3527118_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_tendsto_def",
  ``q3527118_tendsto
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==>
          norm (q3527118_sub add neg (u n) x) < epsilon``);

val q3527118_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_complete_def",
  ``q3527118_complete
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q3527118_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?x : 'a. q3527118_tendsto add neg norm u x``);

val q3527118_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_continuous_def",
  ``q3527118_continuous
      (addA : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (negA : 'a -> 'a)
      (normA : 'a -> real)
      (addB : 'b -> 'b -> 'b) (negB : 'b -> 'b)
      (normB : 'b -> real) (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      !x : 'a. !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y : 'a.
            normA (q3527118_sub addA negA y x) < delta ==>
            normB (q3527118_sub addB negB (f y) (f x)) < epsilon``);

val q3527118_padic_int_context_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_padic_int_context_def",
  ``q3527118_padic_int_context
      (p : num)
      (zeroZ : 'z) (oneZ : 'z)
      (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (mulZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z)
      (negZ : 'z -> 'z) (normZ : 'z -> real)
      (natCast : num -> 'z) <=>
      zeroZ <> oneZ /\
      (!x y. addZ x y = addZ y x) /\
      (!x y z. addZ (addZ x y) z = addZ x (addZ y z)) /\
      (!x. addZ zeroZ x = x) /\
      (!x. addZ (negZ x) x = zeroZ) /\
      (!x y. mulZ x y = mulZ y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulZ (mulZ x y) z = mulZ x (mulZ y z)) /\
      (!x. mulZ oneZ x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulZ x (addZ y z) = addZ (mulZ x y) (mulZ x z)) /\
      natCast 0 = zeroZ /\
      (!n. natCast (SUC n) = addZ (natCast n) oneZ) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normZ x) /\
      (!x. normZ x = 0 <=> x = zeroZ) /\
      (!x. normZ (negZ x) = normZ x) /\
      (!x y. normZ (mulZ x y) = normZ x * normZ y) /\
      (!x y.
        normZ (addZ x y) <= max (normZ x) (normZ y)) /\
      (!x. normZ x <= 1) /\
      (!n. normZ (natCast n) = q3527118_nat_padic_norm p n) /\
      (!x : 'z. !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?n : num.
          normZ (q3527118_sub addZ negZ x (natCast n)) < epsilon) /\
      q3527118_complete addZ negZ normZ``);

val q3527118_normed_module_context_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_normed_module_context_def",
  ``q3527118_normed_module_context
      (zeroZ : 'z) (oneZ : 'z)
      (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (mulZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z)
      (normZ : 'z -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (smul : 'z -> 'e -> 'e) <=>
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x. normE x = 0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
      (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y.
        normE (addE x y) <= max (normE x) (normE y)) /\
      (!x. smul oneZ x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulZ a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addZ a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul zeroZ x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smul a x) <= normZ a * normE x) /\
      q3527118_complete addE negE normE``);

val q3527118_mahler_characterizes_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_mahler_characterizes_def",
  ``q3527118_mahler_characterizes
      (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (negZ : 'z -> 'z)
      (normZ : 'z -> real) (natCast : num -> 'z)
      (n : num) (g : 'z -> 'z) <=>
      q3527118_continuous
        addZ negZ normZ addZ negZ normZ g /\
      !m : num. g (natCast m) = natCast (binomial m n)``);

val q3527118_mahler_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_mahler_def",
  ``q3527118_mahler
      (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (negZ : 'z -> 'z)
      (normZ : 'z -> real) (natCast : num -> 'z) (n : num) =
      @g : 'z -> 'z.
        q3527118_mahler_characterizes
          addZ negZ normZ natCast n g``);

val q3527118_fwdDiff_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_fwdDiff_def",
  ``q3527118_fwdDiff
      (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (oneZ : 'z)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (g : 'z -> 'e) (x : 'z) =
      q3527118_sub addE negE (g (addZ x oneZ)) (g x)``);

val q3527118_fwdDiff_iter_zero_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_fwdDiff_iter_zero_def",
  ``q3527118_fwdDiff_iter_zero
      (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (oneZ : 'z) (zeroZ : 'z)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (f : 'z -> 'e) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (q3527118_fwdDiff addZ oneZ addE negE) n f zeroZ``);

val q3527118_finite_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_finite_sum_def",
  ``q3527118_finite_sum
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (term : num -> 'a) (s : num set) =
      ITSET (\n acc. add (term n) acc) s zero``);

val q3527118_uniform_hasSum_def = new_definition (
  "q3527118_uniform_hasSum_def",
  ``q3527118_uniform_hasSum
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (term : num -> 'z -> 'e) (f : 'z -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?s0 : num set.
          FINITE s0 /\
          !s : num set.
            FINITE s /\ s0 SUBSET s ==>
            !x : 'z.
              normE
                (q3527118_sub addE negE
                  (q3527118_finite_sum
                    zeroE addE (\n. term n x) s)
                  (f x)) < epsilon``);

val PadicInt_hasSum_mahler =
  ``!p : num.
      !(zeroZ : 'z) (oneZ : 'z)
        (addZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z) (mulZ : 'z -> 'z -> 'z)
        (negZ : 'z -> 'z) (normZ : 'z -> real)
        (natCast : num -> 'z)
        (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
        (normE : 'e -> real) (smul : 'z -> 'e -> 'e)
        (f : 'z -> 'e).
        prime p /\
        q3527118_padic_int_context
          p zeroZ oneZ addZ mulZ negZ normZ natCast /\
        q3527118_normed_module_context
          zeroZ oneZ addZ mulZ normZ
          zeroE addE negE normE smul /\
        q3527118_continuous
          addZ negZ normZ addE negE normE f
        ==>
        q3527118_uniform_hasSum
          zeroE addE negE normE
          (\n x.
            smul
              (q3527118_mahler addZ negZ normZ natCast n x)
              (q3527118_fwdDiff_iter_zero
                addZ oneZ zeroZ addE negE f n))
          f``;

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527118
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527118), "Mahler's theorem": for every
  prime p, every complete ultrametric normed additive commutative group that
  is a bounded module over the p-adic integers, and every continuous
  p-adic-integer-valued-domain function f, the Mahler series whose nth
  coefficient is the nth forward difference of f at zero converges uniformly
  to f. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q3527118PadicInt p P characterizes the p-adic integer ring as a complete
  ultrametric commutative normed ring with dense integer image and with the
  p-adic norm on that image. This is the completion characterization of

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527118,
:: "Mahler's theorem": the Mahler series formed from the iterated forward
:: differences of a continuous function on the p-adic integers, valued in a
:: complete ultrametric normed module, converges uniformly to that function.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3,
      REAL_1, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, CARD_1, ORDINAL1, ORDINAL2,
      VALUED_0, VALUED_1, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
      XREAL_0, REAL_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, NEWTON,
      PREPOWER, POWER, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
 constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, CARD_1,
      REAL_1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, NEWTON, PREPOWER, POWER,
      BINOP_2, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
      NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2, NEWTON, PREPOWER, FINSET_1, FINSUB_1;
 requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for p being Prime,
      P,E being non empty set,
      zeroP,oneP being Element of P,
      addP,mulP being BinOp of P,
      oppP being UnOp of P,
      normP being Function of P,REAL,
      embedZ being Function of INT,P,
      zeroE being Element of E,
      addE being BinOp of E,
      oppE being UnOp of E,
      smul being Function of [:P,E:],E,
      normE being Function of E,REAL,
      f being Function of P,E
  st
    zeroP <> oneP &
    (for x,y being Element of P holds
      addP.(x,y) = addP.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of P holds
      addP.(addP.(x,y),z) = addP.(x,addP.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      addP.(x,zeroP) = x) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      addP.(x,oppP.x) = zeroP) &
    (for x,y being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,y) = mulP.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of P holds
      mulP.(mulP.(x,y),z) = mulP.(x,mulP.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,oneP) = x) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,zeroP) = zeroP) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of P holds
      mulP.(x,addP.(y,z)) =
        addP.(mulP.(x,y),mulP.(x,z))) &
    normP.zeroP = 0 &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      0 <= normP.x) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      (normP.x = 0 iff x = zeroP)) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      normP.(oppP.x) = normP.x) &
    (for x,y being Element of P holds
      normP.(addP.(x,y)) <= max(normP.x,normP.y)) &
    (for x,y being Element of P holds
      normP.(mulP.(x,y)) = normP.x * normP.y) &
    (for x being Element of P holds
      normP.x <= 1) &
    embedZ.0 = zeroP &
    embedZ.1 = oneP &
    (for a,b being Element of INT holds
      embedZ.(a+b) = addP.(embedZ.a,embedZ.b)) &
    (for a,b being Element of INT holds
      embedZ.(a*b) = mulP.(embedZ.a,embedZ.b)) &
    embedZ is one-to-one &
    (for z being Element of INT st z <> 0 holds
      ex k being Nat, u being Integer st
        z = ((p |^ k) qua Integer) * u &
        not (p qua Integer) divides u &
        normP.(embedZ.z) =
          (p qua Real) to_power (-(k qua Real))) &
    (for x being Element of P, epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex z being Element of INT st
        normP.(addP.(x,oppP.(embedZ.z))) < epsilon) &
    (for u being Function of NAT,P st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normP.(addP.(u.m,oppP.(u.n))) < epsilon)
     holds
      ex x being Element of P st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex N being Nat st
            for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              normP.(addP.(u.n,oppP.x)) < epsilon) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,y) = addE.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of E holds
      addE.(addE.(x,y),z) = addE.(x,addE.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,zeroE) = x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      addE.(x,oppE.x) = zeroE) &
    (for a being Element of P, x,y being Element of E holds
      smul.(a,addE.(x,y)) =
        addE.(smul.(a,x),smul.(a,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of P, x being Element of E holds
      smul.(addP.(a,b),x) =
        addE.(smul.(a,x),smul.(b,x))) &
    (for a,b being Element of P, x being Element of E holds
      smul.(mulP.(a,b),x) = smul.(a,smul.(b,x))) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      smul.(oneP,x) = x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      smul.(zeroP,x) = zeroE) &
    (for a being Element of P holds
      smul.(a,zeroE) = zeroE) &
    normE.zeroE = 0 &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      0 <= normE.x) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      (normE.x = 0 iff x = zeroE)) &
    (for x being Element of E holds
      normE.(oppE.x) = normE.x) &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      normE.(addE.(x,y)) <= max(normE.x,normE.y)) &
    (for a being Element of P, x being Element of E holds
      normE.(smul.(a,x)) <= normP.a * normE.x) &
    (for u being Function of NAT,E st
      (for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for m,n being Nat st N <= m & N <= n holds
            normE.(addE.(u.m,oppE.(u.n))) < epsilon)
     holds
      ex x being Element of E st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex N being Nat st
            for n being Nat st N <= n holds
              normE.(addE.(u.n,oppE.x)) < epsilon) &
    (for x being Element of P, epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
      ex delta being Real st
        0 < delta &
        for y being Element of P st
          normP.(addP.(y,oppP.x)) < delta
        holds
          normE.(addE.(f.y,oppE.(f.x))) < epsilon)
  holds
    ex mahler being Function of [:P,NAT:],P,
       D being sequence of Funcs(P,E),
       sums being Function of Fin NAT,Funcs(P,E) st
      (for n being Nat, x being Element of P,
           epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for y being Element of P st
            normP.(addP.(y,oppP.x)) < delta
          holds
            normP.(addP.(mahler.(y,n),oppP.(mahler.(x,n)))) <
              epsilon) &
      (for m,n being Nat holds
        mahler.(embedZ.(m qua Integer),n) =
          embedZ.((m choose n) qua Integer)) &
      (for d0 being Function of P,E st d0 = D.0 holds
        d0 = f) &
      (for n being Nat,
           dn,dn1 being Function of P,E st
         dn = D.n & dn1 = D.(n+1)
       holds
         for x being Element of P holds
           dn1.x =
             addE.(dn.(addP.(x,oneP)),oppE.(dn.x))) &
      (for s0 being Function of P,E st s0 = sums.{} holds
        for x being Element of P holds s0.x = zeroE) &
      (for A being Element of Fin NAT,
           n being Nat st not n in A holds
        for sA,sAn,dn being Function of P,E st
          sA = sums.A & sAn = sums.(A \/ {n}) & dn = D.n
        holds
          for x being Element of P holds
            sAn.x =
              addE.(sA.x,smul.(mahler.(x,n),dn.zeroP))) &
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex A0 being Element of Fin NAT st
          for A being Element of Fin NAT st A0 c= A holds
            for sA being Function of P,E st sA = sums.A holds
              for x being Element of P holds
                normE.(addE.(sA.x,oppE.(f.x))) < epsilon
proof
end;

title: Q3527118_mahler_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3527118
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q3527118), "Mahler's theorem": every continuous
% function on the p-adic integers with values in a complete nonarchimedean
% normed module is the sum of its Mahler series. This file contains no proof.

mahler_s_theorem_Q3527118[
  p: nat,
  Zp: TYPE+,
  zeroZ, oneZ: Zp,
  addZ, mulZ: [Zp, Zp -> Zp],
  negZ: [Zp -> Zp],
  natCastZ: [nat -> Zp],
  normZ: [Zp -> real],
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [Zp, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  zp_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> Zp]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  zp_function: TYPE = [Zp -> Zp]
  e_function: TYPE = [Zp -> E]

  subZ(x, y: Zp): Zp =
    addZ(x, negZ(y))

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  padic_radius(level: nat): real =
    IF p ^ level = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 / ((p ^ level) :: real)
    ENDIF

  congruent_mod(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (left_multiple, right_multiple: nat):
      left + left_multiple * modulus =
        right + right_multiple * modulus

  zp_commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: Zp):
      addZ(addZ(x, y), z) = addZ(x, addZ(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Zp):
        addZ(x, y) = addZ(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: Zp):
        addZ(x, zeroZ) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: Zp):
        addZ(x, negZ(x)) = zeroZ)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: Zp):
        mulZ(mulZ(x, y), z) = mulZ(x, mulZ(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Zp):
        mulZ(x, y) = mulZ(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: Zp):
        mulZ(x, oneZ) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: Zp):
        mulZ(x, addZ(y, z)) =
          addZ(mulZ(x, y), mulZ(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: Zp):
        mulZ(x, zeroZ) = zeroZ)

  natural_embedding_laws: bool =
    natCastZ(0) = zeroZ
      AND natCastZ(1) = oneZ
      AND (FORALL (n: nat):
        natCastZ(n + 1) = addZ(natCastZ(n), oneZ))
      AND (FORALL (m, n: nat):
        natCastZ(m + n) = addZ(natCastZ(m), natCastZ(n)))
      AND (FORALL (m, n: nat):
        natCastZ(m * n) = mulZ(natCastZ(m), natCastZ(n)))

  zp_norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: Zp):
      0 <= normZ(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: Zp):
        normZ(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroZ)
      AND (FORALL (x: Zp):
        normZ(negZ(x)) = normZ(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Zp):
        normZ(addZ(x, y)) <=
          IF normZ(x) >= normZ(y) THEN normZ(x) ELSE normZ(y) ENDIF)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: Zp):
        normZ(mulZ(x, y)) <= normZ(x) * normZ(y))
      AND normZ(oneZ) = 1

  zp_converges(values: zp_sequence, limit: Zp): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normZ(subZ(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  zp_cauchy(values: zp_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            normZ(
              subZ(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index))) < epsilon_value

  zp_complete: bool =
    FORALL (values: zp_sequence):
      zp_cauchy(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: Zp):
          zp_converges(values, limit)

  natural_embedding_is_dense: bool =
    FORALL (x: Zp), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (n: nat):
        normZ(subZ(x, natCastZ(n))) < epsilon_value

  natural_embedding_has_padic_metric: bool =
    FORALL (m, n, level: nat):
      normZ(subZ(natCastZ(m), natCastZ(n)))
          <= padic_radius(level)
        IFF
          congruent_mod(m, n, p ^ level)

  padic_integer_context: bool =
    prime_nat(p)
      AND zp_commutative_ring_laws
      AND natural_embedding_laws
      AND zp_norm_laws
      AND zp_complete
      AND natural_embedding_is_dense
      AND natural_embedding_has_padic_metric

  continuous_zp_to_zp(f: zp_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: Zp), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta_value: posreal):
        FORALL (y: Zp):
          normZ(subZ(y, x)) < delta_value
            IMPLIES
              normZ(subZ(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value

  continuous_zp_to_e(f: e_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: Zp), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta_value: posreal):
        FORALL (y: Zp):
          normZ(subZ(y, x)) < delta_value
            IMPLIES
              normE(subE(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value

  mahler_basis_context(basis: [nat, Zp -> Zp]): bool =
    (FORALL (degree: nat):
      continuous_zp_to_zp(
        LAMBDA (x: Zp): basis(degree, x)))
      AND (FORALL (degree, n: nat):
        basis(degree, natCastZ(n)) =
          natCastZ(binomial_coefficient(n, degree)))

  e_additive_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  zp_module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: Zp), (x, y: E):
      smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: Zp), (x: E):
        smulE(addZ(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: Zp), (x: E):
        smulE(mulZ(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneZ, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(zeroZ, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: Zp):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)

  e_nonarchimedean_norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: E):
      0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <=
          IF normE(x) >= normE(y) THEN normE(x) ELSE normE(y) ENDIF)
      AND (FORALL (a: Zp), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) <= normZ(a) * normE(x))

  e_converges(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  e_cauchy(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                values(left_index),
                values(right_index))) < epsilon_value

  e_complete: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      e_cauchy(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          e_converges(values, limit)

  padic_banach_module_context: bool =
    e_additive_group_laws
      AND zp_module_laws
      AND e_nonarchimedean_norm_laws
      AND e_complete

  forward_difference_iterate(
      f: e_function,
      degree: nat,
      x: Zp): RECURSIVE E =
    IF degree = 0 THEN
      f(x)
    ELSE
      subE(
        forward_difference_iterate(
          f, degree - 1, addZ(x, oneZ)),
        forward_difference_iterate(
          f, degree - 1, x))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE degree

  mahler_term(
      basis: [nat, Zp -> Zp],
      f: e_function,
      degree: nat,
      x: Zp): E =
    smulE(
      basis(degree, x),
      forward_difference_iterate(
        f, degree, zeroZ))

  mahler_partial_sum(
      basis: [nat, Zp -> Zp],
      f: e_function,
      count: nat,
      x: Zp): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        mahler_partial_sum(basis, f, count - 1, x),
        mahler_term(basis, f, count - 1, x))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  mahler_series_converges_uniformly_to(
      basis: [nat, Zp -> Zp],
      f: e_function): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            FORALL (x: Zp):
              normE(
                subE(
                  mahler_partial_sum(basis, f, count, x),
                  f(x))) < epsilon_value

  mahler_s_theorem: bool =
    (padic_integer_context
      AND padic_banach_module_context)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (basis: [nat, Zp -> Zp]):
        mahler_basis_context(basis)
          AND FORALL (f: e_function):
            continuous_zp_to_e(f)
              IMPLIES
                mahler_series_converges_uniformly_to(
                  basis, f)
END mahler_s_theorem_Q3527118
