title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527166
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527166), "Steinhaus theorem": in a locally
  compact topological group, the quotient of a positive-measure measurable
  set by itself is a neighborhood of the identity for an inner-regular Haar
  measure. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3527166_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q3527166_empty {A : Type} : q3527166_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q3527166_full {A : Type} : q3527166_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q3527166_complement {A : Type}
    (S : q3527166_set A) : q3527166_set A :=
  fun x => ~ S x.

Definition q3527166_countable_union {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q3527166_set A) : q3527166_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, S n x.

Definition q3527166_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q3527166_subset {A : Type}
    (S T : q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q3527166_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S T : q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (S x /\ T x).

Definition q3527166_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q3527166_disjoint (S i) (S j).

Record q3527166_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q3527166_one : G;
  q3527166_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q3527166_inv : G -> G;
  q3527166_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q3527166_mul x (q3527166_mul y z) =
      q3527166_mul (q3527166_mul x y) z;
  q3527166_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q3527166_mul q3527166_one x = x;
  q3527166_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q3527166_mul x q3527166_one = x;
  q3527166_inv_mul :
    forall x : G,
      q3527166_mul (q3527166_inv x) x = q3527166_one;
  q3527166_mul_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q3527166_mul x (q3527166_inv x) = q3527166_one
}.

Arguments q3527166_one {G} _.
Arguments q3527166_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527166_inv {G} _ _.

Record q3527166_topological_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3527166_is_open : q3527166_set (q3527166_set A);
  q3527166_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_same_set U V ->
      (q3527166_is_open U <-> q3527166_is_open V);
  q3527166_open_full :
    q3527166_is_open q3527166_full;
  q3527166_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_is_open U ->
      q3527166_is_open V ->
      q3527166_is_open (fun x => U x /\ V x);
  q3527166_open_union :
    forall family : q3527166_set (q3527166_set A),
      (forall U : q3527166_set A,
        family U -> q3527166_is_open U) ->
      q3527166_is_open
        (fun x =>
          exists U : q3527166_set A,
            family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q3527166_is_open {A} _ _.

Definition q3527166_neighborhood {A : Type}
    (T : q3527166_topological_space A)
    (x : A) (S : q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  exists U : q3527166_set A,
    q3527166_is_open T U /\
    U x /\
    q3527166_subset U S.

Definition q3527166_is_topological_group {G : Type}
    (group : q3527166_group G)
    (T : q3527166_topological_space G) : Prop :=
  (forall (x y : G) (W : q3527166_set G),
      q3527166_is_open T W ->
      W (q3527166_mul group x y) ->
      exists U V : q3527166_set G,
        q3527166_is_open T U /\
        q3527166_is_open T V /\
        U x /\
        V y /\
        forall u v : G,
          U u ->
          V v ->
          W (q3527166_mul group u v)) /\
  forall (x : G) (W : q3527166_set G),
    q3527166_is_open T W ->
    W (q3527166_inv group x) ->
    exists U : q3527166_set G,
      q3527166_is_open T U /\
      U x /\
      forall u : G,
        U u -> W (q3527166_inv group u).

Definition q3527166_is_compact {A : Type}
    (T : q3527166_topological_space A)
    (K : q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q3527166_set (q3527166_set A),
    (forall U : q3527166_set A,
      cover U -> q3527166_is_open T U) ->
    (forall x : A,
      K x ->
      exists U : q3527166_set A,
        cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q3527166_set A),
      (forall U : q3527166_set A,
        In U finite_cover -> cover U) /\
      forall x : A,
        K x ->
        exists U : q3527166_set A,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q3527166_locally_compact {A : Type}
    (T : q3527166_topological_space A) : Prop :=
  forall (x : A) (N : q3527166_set A),
    q3527166_neighborhood T x N ->
    exists K : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_neighborhood T x K /\
      q3527166_subset K N /\
      q3527166_is_compact T K.

Record q3527166_sigma_class (A : Type)
    (C : q3527166_set (q3527166_set A)) : Prop := {
  q3527166_sigma_extensional :
    forall S T : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_same_set S T ->
      C S ->
      C T;
  q3527166_sigma_empty :
    C q3527166_empty;
  q3527166_sigma_complement :
    forall S : q3527166_set A,
      C S -> C (q3527166_complement S);
  q3527166_sigma_countable_union :
    forall S : nat -> q3527166_set A,
      (forall n : nat, C (S n)) ->
      C (q3527166_countable_union S)
}.

Definition q3527166_borel_set {A : Type}
    (T : q3527166_topological_space A)
    (S : q3527166_set A) : Prop :=
  forall C : q3527166_set (q3527166_set A),
    q3527166_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_is_open T U -> C U) ->
    C S.

Inductive q3527166_ennreal : Type :=
| q3527166_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q3527166_ennreal
| q3527166_ennreal_infinity : q3527166_ennreal.

Arguments q3527166_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q3527166_ennreal_zero : q3527166_ennreal :=
  q3527166_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q3527166_ennreal_le
    (x y : q3527166_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3527166_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3527166_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q3527166_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q3527166_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q3527166_ennreal_infinity,
    q3527166_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q3527166_ennreal_infinity,
    q3527166_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q3527166_ennreal_lt
    (x y : q3527166_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3527166_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3527166_ennreal_finite b _ => a < b
  | q3527166_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q3527166_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q3527166_ennreal_add
    (x y : q3527166_ennreal) : q3527166_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q3527166_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q3527166_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q3527166_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q3527166_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q3527166_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q3527166_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q3527166_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q3527166_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q3527166_ennreal_add
        (q3527166_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q3527166_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q3527166_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q3527166_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q3527166_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q3527166_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  forall upper : q3527166_ennreal,
    (forall value : q3527166_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q3527166_ennreal_le value upper) ->
    q3527166_ennreal_le bound upper.

Definition q3527166_ennreal_infimum
    (values : q3527166_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q3527166_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q3527166_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q3527166_ennreal_le bound value) /\
  forall lower : q3527166_ennreal,
    (forall value : q3527166_ennreal,
      values value ->
      q3527166_ennreal_le lower value) ->
    q3527166_ennreal_le lower bound.

Definition q3527166_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q3527166_ennreal)
    (sum : q3527166_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q3527166_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        value = q3527166_ennreal_partial_sum u n)
    sum.

Record q3527166_measure {A : Type}
    (T : q3527166_topological_space A) : Type := {
  q3527166_measure_value :
    q3527166_set A -> q3527166_ennreal;
  q3527166_measure_extensional :
    forall S U : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_same_set S U ->
      q3527166_measure_value S =
      q3527166_measure_value U;
  q3527166_measure_empty :
    q3527166_measure_value q3527166_empty =
    q3527166_ennreal_zero;
  q3527166_measure_monotone :
    forall S U : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_subset S U ->
      q3527166_ennreal_le
        (q3527166_measure_value S)
        (q3527166_measure_value U);
  q3527166_measure_borel_trimmed :
    forall S : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_ennreal_infimum
        (fun value =>
          exists U : q3527166_set A,
            q3527166_subset S U /\
            q3527166_borel_set T U /\
            value = q3527166_measure_value U)
        (q3527166_measure_value S);
  q3527166_measure_countable_subadditive :
    forall S : nat -> q3527166_set A,
      exists total : q3527166_ennreal,
        q3527166_ennreal_series_sum
          (fun n => q3527166_measure_value (S n))
          total /\
        q3527166_ennreal_le
          (q3527166_measure_value
            (q3527166_countable_union S))
          total;
  q3527166_measure_countable_additive :
    forall S : nat -> q3527166_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q3527166_borel_set T (S n)) ->
      q3527166_pairwise_disjoint S ->
      q3527166_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q3527166_measure_value (S n))
        (q3527166_measure_value
          (q3527166_countable_union S))
}.

Arguments q3527166_measure_value {A T} _ _.

Record q3527166_is_haar_measure {G : Type}
    (group : q3527166_group G)
    (T : q3527166_topological_space G)
    (mu : q3527166_measure T) : Prop := {
  q3527166_haar_left_invariant :
    forall (g : G) (S : q3527166_set G),
      q3527166_borel_set T S ->
      q3527166_measure_value mu
        (fun x : G => S (q3527166_mul group g x)) =
      q3527166_measure_value mu S;
  q3527166_haar_finite_on_compact :
    forall K : q3527166_set G,
      q3527166_is_compact T K ->
      q3527166_ennreal_lt
        (q3527166_measure_value mu K)
        q3527166_ennreal_infinity;
  q3527166_haar_positive_on_nonempty_open :
    forall U : q3527166_set G,
      q3527166_is_open T U ->
      (exists x : G, U x) ->
      q3527166_measure_value mu U <>
      q3527166_ennreal_zero
}.

Definition q3527166_inner_regular {A : Type}
    (T : q3527166_topological_space A)
    (mu : q3527166_measure T) : Prop :=
  forall (S : q3527166_set A) (r : q3527166_ennreal),
    q3527166_borel_set T S ->
    q3527166_ennreal_lt r
      (q3527166_measure_value mu S) ->
    exists K : q3527166_set A,
      q3527166_subset K S /\
      q3527166_is_compact T K /\
      q3527166_ennreal_lt r
        (q3527166_measure_value mu K).

Definition q3527166_set_quotient {G : Type}
    (group : q3527166_group G)
    (S U : q3527166_set G) : q3527166_set G :=
  fun z =>
    exists x y : G,
      S x /\
      U y /\
      z = q3527166_mul group x (q3527166_inv group y).

Theorem MeasureTheory_Measure_div_mem_nhds_one_of_haar_pos :
  forall (G : Type)
         (group : q3527166_group G)
         (T : q3527166_topological_space G)
         (mu : q3527166_measure T)
         (E : q3527166_set G),
    @q3527166_is_topological_group G group T ->
    @q3527166_locally_compact G T ->
    @q3527166_is_haar_measure G group T mu ->
    @q3527166_inner_regular G T mu ->
    @q3527166_borel_set G T E ->
    q3527166_ennreal_lt q3527166_ennreal_zero
      (@q3527166_measure_value G T mu E) ->
    @q3527166_neighborhood G T
      (q3527166_one group)
      (@q3527166_set_quotient G group E E).
Admitted.

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527166,
  "Steinhaus theorem": every measurable set of positive inner-regular left Haar
  measure in a locally compact topological group has a quotient set that is a
  neighborhood of the identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Borel_Space" "HOL-Analysis.Measure_Space"
begin

definition q3527166_topological_group ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527166_topological_group mult ginv e \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y z. mult (mult x y) z = mult x (mult y z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. mult e x = x \<and> mult x e = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. mult (ginv x) x = e \<and> mult x (ginv x) = e) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV
      (\<lambda>p :: 'a \<times> 'a. mult (fst p) (snd p)) \<and>
    continuous_on UNIV ginv"

definition q3527166_locally_compact ::
    "'a::topological_space itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527166_locally_compact _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x :: 'a. \<forall>N.
      eventually (\<lambda>y. y \<in> N) (nhds x) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>K. eventually (\<lambda>y. y \<in> K) (nhds x) \<and>
        K \<subseteq> N \<and> compact K))"

definition q3527166_left_haar_measure ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527166_left_haar_measure mult M \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>g A. A \<in> sets M \<longrightarrow>
      emeasure M (mult g ` A) = emeasure M A) \<and>
    (\<forall>K. compact K \<longrightarrow> emeasure M K < \<infinity>) \<and>
    (\<forall>U. open U \<longrightarrow> U \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow> 0 < emeasure M U)"

definition q3527166_inner_regular ::
    "'a::topological_space measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527166_inner_regular M \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>A \<in> sets M. \<forall>r.
      r < emeasure M A \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>K. K \<subseteq> A \<and> compact K \<and> r < emeasure M K))"

definition q3527166_quotient_set ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q3527166_quotient_set mult ginv E =
    {z. \<exists>x \<in> E. \<exists>y \<in> E. z = mult x (ginv y)}"

theorem q3527166_steinhaus_theorem:
  fixes mult :: "'a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and ginv :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
    and e :: "'a"
    and M :: "'a measure"
    and E :: "'a set"
  assumes topological_group:
      "q3527166_topological_group mult ginv e"
    and locally_compact:
      "q3527166_locally_compact TYPE('a)"
    and borel_space:
      "sets M = sets (borel :: 'a measure)"
    and haar_measure:
      "q3527166_left_haar_measure mult M"
    and inner_regular:
      "q3527166_inner_regular M"
    and measurable_set:
      "E \<in> sets M"
    and positive_measure:
      "0 < emeasure M E"
  shows
    "eventually
      (\<lambda>z. z \<in> q3527166_quotient_set mult ginv E)
      (nhds e)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527166
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3527166), "Steinhaus theorem": a measurable
  set of positive inner-regular left Haar measure in a locally compact
  topological group has its quotient set as a neighborhood of the identity.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3527166_STEINHAUS_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let etop = (T,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let elt =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        enonnegative x /\
        enonnegative y /\
        ele x y /\
        ~(x = y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then etop
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n:num. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\ (!n:num. ele (u n) w)
           ==> ele z w) in
   let esum =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        ?partial:num->bool#real.
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!n:num. partial (SUC n) = eadd (partial n) (u n)) /\
          esup_sequence partial z in
   let is_infimum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele z v) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\
           (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele w v)
           ==> ele w z) in
   let is_topology =
      \(opens:(A->bool)->bool).
        opens {} /\
        opens (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!collection:(A->bool)->bool.
           (!u:A->bool. u IN collection ==> opens u)
           ==> opens (UNIONS collection)) /\
        (!u v:A->bool.
           opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v)) in
   let is_neighborhood =
      \(opens:(A->bool)->bool) (x:A) (s:A->bool).
        ?u:A->bool.
          opens u /\
          x IN u /\
          u SUBSET s in
   let is_compact =
      \(opens:(A->bool)->bool) (k:A->bool).
        !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> opens u) /\
          k SUBSET UNIONS cover
          ==> ?subcover:(A->bool)->bool.
                subcover SUBSET cover /\
                FINITE subcover /\
                k SUBSET UNIONS subcover in
   let locally_compact =
      \(opens:(A->bool)->bool).
        !x:A. !n:A->bool.
          is_neighborhood opens x n
          ==> ?k:A->bool.
                is_neighborhood opens x k /\
                k SUBSET n /\
                is_compact opens k in
   let group_axioms =
      \(oneG:A) (gmul:A->A->A) (ginv:A->A).
        (!x y z:A. gmul x (gmul y z) = gmul (gmul x y) z) /\
        (!x:A. gmul oneG x = x) /\
        (!x:A. gmul x oneG = x) /\
        (!x:A. gmul (ginv x) x = oneG) /\
        (!x:A. gmul x (ginv x) = oneG) in
   let compatible_group_topology =
      \(gmul:A->A->A) (ginv:A->A)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
        (!x y:A. !u:A->bool.
           opens u /\ gmul x y IN u
           ==> ?v w:A->bool.
                 opens v /\
                 opens w /\
                 x IN v /\
                 y IN w /\
                 (!a b:A.
                    a IN v /\ b IN w ==> gmul a b IN u)) /\
        (!x:A. !u:A->bool.
           opens u /\ ginv x IN u
           ==> ?v:A->bool.
                 opens v /\
                 x IN v /\
                 (!a:A. a IN v ==> ginv a IN u)) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (UNIV:A->bool) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let borel_space =
      \(opens:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> events u) /\
        (!other:(A->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> other u)
           ==> !s:A->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let outer_measure =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!s t:A->bool.
           s SUBSET t ==> ele (mu s) (mu t)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool. !total:bool#real.
           esum (\n:num. mu (sets n)) total
           ==> ele
                 (mu {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n})
                 total) in
   let canonical_extension =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !s:A->bool.
          ?z:bool#real.
            is_infimum
              (\v:bool#real.
                 ?t:A->bool.
                   events t /\
                   s SUBSET t /\
                   v = mu t)
              z /\
            ele z (mu s) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        outer_measure mu /\
        canonical_extension events mu /\
        (!s t:A->bool.
           events s
           ==> mu t =
               eadd (mu (t INTER s)) (mu (t DIFF s))) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n:num.
              ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> esum
                 (\n:num. mu (sets n))
                 (mu {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n})) in
   let is_haar_measure =
      \(gmul:A->A->A)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        (!g:A. !s:A->bool.
           events s ==> mu {x:A | gmul g x IN s} = mu s) /\
        (!k:A->bool.
           is_compact opens k ==> ~(mu k = etop)) /\
        (!u:A->bool.
           opens u /\ ~(u = {}) ==> ~(mu u = ezero)) in
   let inner_regular =
      \(opens:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        !s:A->bool.
          events s
          ==> !r:bool#real.
                elt r (mu s)
                ==> ?k:A->bool.
                      k SUBSET s /\
                      is_compact opens k /\
                      elt r (mu k) in
   let set_div =
      \(gmul:A->A->A) (ginv:A->A)
       (s:A->bool) (t:A->bool).
        {z:A |
           ?x y:A.
             x IN s /\
             y IN t /\
             z = gmul x (ginv y)} in
   !oneG:A.
   !gmul:A->A->A.
   !ginv:A->A.
   !opens:(A->bool)->bool.
   !events:(A->bool)->bool.
   !mu:(A->bool)->bool#real.
   !e:A->bool.
     group_axioms oneG gmul ginv /\
     is_topology opens /\
     compatible_group_topology gmul ginv opens /\
     locally_compact opens /\
     borel_space opens events /\
     measure_space events mu /\
     is_haar_measure gmul opens events mu /\
     inner_regular opens events mu /\
     events e /\
     ~(mu e = ezero)
     ==> is_neighborhood
           opens oneG (set_div gmul ginv e e)`;;

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527166,
;; "Steinhaus theorem": in a locally compact topological group, the quotient
;; E/E of a measurable positive-measure set is a neighborhood of the identity
;; for every inner-regular left Haar measure. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The interfaces below present arbitrary carriers, sets, indexed families,
;; group operations, topologies, Borel sigma algebras, and measures.  Every
;; structural law used by the source declaration is an explicit hypothesis of
;; the final predicate.  Extended nonnegative reals are represented exactly as
;; a nonnegative element of a Dedekind-complete ordered field or a top element.

;; A presentation of the real field.

(defstub q3527166-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q3527166-r-subset-member-p (real subset value) t)

(defun q3527166-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q3527166-r-less real right left)))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527166-r-member-p real x)
      (q3527166-r-member-p real y)
      (q3527166-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q3527166-r-zero real))
            (one (q3527166-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q3527166-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q3527166-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q3527166-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q3527166-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q3527166-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q3527166-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q3527166-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q3527166-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q3527166-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q3527166-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q3527166-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q3527166-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3527166-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q3527166-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q3527166-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q3527166-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q3527166-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q3527166-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q3527166-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q3527166-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3527166-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3527166-r-multiply
          real x (q3527166-r-add real y z))
         (q3527166-r-add
          real
          (q3527166-r-multiply real x y)
          (q3527166-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527166-r-member-p real x)
      (q3527166-r-member-p real y)
      (q3527166-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q3527166-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q3527166-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q3527166-r-less real x y)
         (q3527166-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527166-r-less real x y)
          (q3527166-r-less real y z))
         (q3527166-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q3527166-r-less real x y)
         (q3527166-r-less
          real
          (q3527166-r-add real x z)
          (q3527166-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527166-r-less real zero x)
          (q3527166-r-less real zero y))
         (q3527166-r-less
          real zero
          (q3527166-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-subset-nonempty-p (real subset)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q3527166-r-member-p real x)
     (q3527166-r-subset-member-p real subset x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-upper-bound-p (real subset bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527166-r-member-p real x)
      (q3527166-r-subset-member-p real subset x))
     (q3527166-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-bounded-above-p (real subset)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3527166-r-member-p real bound)
     (q3527166-r-upper-bound-p real subset bound))))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-supremum-p (real subset supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q3527166-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q3527166-r-upper-bound-p real subset supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527166-r-member-p real bound)
       (q3527166-r-upper-bound-p real subset bound))
      (q3527166-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-has-supremum-p (real subset)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q3527166-r-supremum-p real subset supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527166-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527166-r-subset-nonempty-p real subset)
      (q3527166-r-bounded-above-p real subset))
     (q3527166-r-has-supremum-p real subset))))

(defun q3527166-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q3527166-r-zero real))
        (one (q3527166-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q3527166-r-member-p real zero)
     (q3527166-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q3527166-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q3527166-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q3527166-r-less real zero one)
     (q3527166-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; The extended nonnegative reals over this real-field presentation.

(defun q3527166-enn-zero (real)
  (list :finite (q3527166-r-zero real)))

(defun q3527166-enn-top ()
  (list :top))

(defun q3527166-enn-finite (value)
  (list :finite value))

(defun q3527166-enn-finite-p (real value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (equal (car value) :finite)
   (q3527166-r-member-p real (cadr value))
   (q3527166-r-leq
    real (q3527166-r-zero real) (cadr value))))

(defun q3527166-enn-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value (q3527166-enn-top))
   (q3527166-enn-finite-p real value)))

(defun q3527166-enn-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left (q3527166-enn-top)) nil)
   ((equal right (q3527166-enn-top))
    (q3527166-enn-finite-p real left))
   ((and
     (q3527166-enn-finite-p real left)
     (q3527166-enn-finite-p real right))
    (q3527166-r-less real (cadr left) (cadr right)))
   (t nil)))

(defun q3527166-enn-leq (real left right)
  (not (q3527166-enn-less real right left)))

(defun q3527166-enn-add (real left right)
  (if (and
       (q3527166-enn-finite-p real left)
       (q3527166-enn-finite-p real right))
      (q3527166-enn-finite
       (q3527166-r-add real (cadr left) (cadr right)))
    (q3527166-enn-top)))

;; Arbitrary groups and arbitrary subsets of their carrier.

(defstub q3527166-carrier-p (group value) t)
(defstub q3527166-one (group) t)
(defstub q3527166-mul (group left right) t)
(defstub q3527166-inv (group value) t)

(defstub q3527166-set-member-p (group set value) t)
(defstub q3527166-empty-set (group) t)
(defstub q3527166-univ-set (group) t)
(defstub q3527166-inter-set (group left right) t)
(defstub q3527166-union-set (group left right) t)
(defstub q3527166-complement-set (group set) t)
(defstub q3527166-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q3527166-family-union-set (group family) t)
(defstub q3527166-sequence-set (sequence index) t)
(defstub q3527166-sequence-union-set (group sequence) t)
(defstub q3527166-left-translate-set (group element set) t)

(defun-sk q3527166-set-p (group set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527166-set-member-p group set x)
     (q3527166-carrier-p group x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-subset-p (group left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527166-set-member-p group left x)
     (q3527166-set-member-p group right x))))

(defun q3527166-set-equiv-p (group left right)
  (and
   (q3527166-subset-p group left right)
   (q3527166-subset-p group right left)))

(defun-sk q3527166-set-nonempty-p (group set)
  (exists (x)
    (q3527166-set-member-p group set x)))

(defun-sk q3527166-disjoint-p (group left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q3527166-set-member-p group left x)
      (q3527166-set-member-p group right x)))))

(defun-sk q3527166-family-union-member-p (group family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q3527166-family-member-p family set)
     (q3527166-set-member-p group set x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-sequence-union-member-p (group sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q3527166-set-member-p
      group (q3527166-sequence-set sequence n) x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-left-translate-member-p
    (group element set x)
  (exists (y)
    (and
     (q3527166-carrier-p group y)
     (q3527166-set-member-p group set y)
     (equal x (q3527166-mul group element y)))))

(defun-sk q3527166-empty-univ-laws-p (group)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (not
      (q3527166-set-member-p
       group (q3527166-empty-set group) x))
     (iff
      (q3527166-set-member-p
       group (q3527166-univ-set group) x)
      (q3527166-carrier-p group x)))))

(defun-sk q3527166-binary-set-laws-p (group)
  (forall (x left right)
    (and
     (iff
      (q3527166-set-member-p
       group (q3527166-inter-set group left right) x)
      (and
       (q3527166-set-member-p group left x)
       (q3527166-set-member-p group right x)))
     (iff
      (q3527166-set-member-p
       group (q3527166-union-set group left right) x)
      (or
       (q3527166-set-member-p group left x)
       (q3527166-set-member-p group right x))))))

(defun-sk q3527166-complement-law-p (group)
  (forall (x set)
    (iff
     (q3527166-set-member-p
      group (q3527166-complement-set group set) x)
     (and
      (q3527166-carrier-p group x)
      (not (q3527166-set-member-p group set x))))))

(defun-sk q3527166-family-union-law-p (group)
  (forall (x family)
    (iff
     (q3527166-set-member-p
      group (q3527166-family-union-set group family) x)
     (q3527166-family-union-member-p group family x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-sequence-union-law-p (group)
  (forall (x sequence)
    (iff
     (q3527166-set-member-p
      group (q3527166-sequence-union-set group sequence) x)
     (q3527166-sequence-union-member-p group sequence x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-left-translate-law-p (group)
  (forall (x element set)
    (implies
     (q3527166-carrier-p group element)
     (iff
      (q3527166-set-member-p
       group
       (q3527166-left-translate-set group element set)
       x)
      (q3527166-left-translate-member-p
       group element set x)))))

(defun q3527166-set-operation-laws-p (group)
  (and
   (q3527166-empty-univ-laws-p group)
   (q3527166-binary-set-laws-p group)
   (q3527166-complement-law-p group)
   (q3527166-family-union-law-p group)
   (q3527166-sequence-union-law-p group)
   (q3527166-left-translate-law-p group)))

(defun-sk q3527166-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527166-carrier-p group x)
      (q3527166-carrier-p group y)
      (q3527166-carrier-p group z))
     (let ((one (q3527166-one group))
           (xy (q3527166-mul group x y))
           (yz (q3527166-mul group y z))
           (x-inv (q3527166-inv group x)))
       (and
        (q3527166-carrier-p group one)
        (q3527166-carrier-p group xy)
        (q3527166-carrier-p group x-inv)
        (equal
         (q3527166-mul group xy z)
         (q3527166-mul group x yz))
        (equal (q3527166-mul group one x) x)
        (equal (q3527166-mul group x one) x)
        (equal (q3527166-mul group x-inv x) one)
        (equal (q3527166-mul group x x-inv) one))))))

;; Topological spaces and compact subsets.

(defstub q3527166-open-p (topology group set) t)

(defun-sk q3527166-open-family-p (topology group family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q3527166-family-member-p family set)
     (q3527166-open-p topology group set))))

(defun-sk q3527166-topology-laws-p (topology group)
  (forall (left right family)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527166-open-p topology group left)
      (q3527166-set-p group left))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527166-set-equiv-p group left right)
       (q3527166-open-p topology group left))
      (q3527166-open-p topology group right))
     (q3527166-open-p
      topology group (q3527166-empty-set group))
     (q3527166-open-p
      topology group (q3527166-univ-set group))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527166-open-p topology group left)
       (q3527166-open-p topology group right))
      (q3527166-open-p
       topology group
       (q3527166-inter-set group left right)))
     (implies
      (q3527166-open-family-p topology group family)
      (q3527166-open-p
       topology group
       (q3527166-family-union-set group family))))))

(defun q3527166-member-of-set-list-p (group sets x)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q3527166-set-member-p group (car sets) x)
       (q3527166-member-of-set-list-p group (cdr sets) x))
    nil))

(defun q3527166-list-from-family-p (family sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q3527166-family-member-p family (car sets))
       (q3527166-list-from-family-p family (cdr sets)))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun-sk q3527166-list-covers-p (group sets covered)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527166-set-member-p group covered x)
     (q3527166-member-of-set-list-p group sets x))))

(defun-sk q3527166-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (group family covered)
  (exists (sets)
    (and
     (true-listp sets)
     (q3527166-list-from-family-p family sets)
     (q3527166-list-covers-p group sets covered))))

(defun-sk q3527166-compact-p (topology group set)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527166-open-family-p topology group family)
      (q3527166-subset-p
       group set

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527166,
-- "Steinhaus theorem": in a locally compact topological group, the quotient
-- set E / E of a measurable positive-measure set is a neighborhood of the
-- identity for an inner-regular Haar measure. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)

open CompleteOrderedField
open SigmaAlgebra
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open Measure

record Group (G : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    identity :
      G
    multiply :
      G -> G -> G
    inverse :
      G -> G
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : G) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    identity-left :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply identity x == x
    identity-right :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply x identity == x
    inverse-left :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply (inverse x) x == identity
    inverse-right :
      (x : G) ->
      multiply x (inverse x) == identity

open Group

record NeighborhoodRefinement
  {G : Set}
  (near : G -> Predicate G -> Set)
  (x : G)
  (U : Predicate G) :
  Set1 where

  field
    refinement :
      Predicate G
    refinement-near :
      near x refinement
    refinement-stays-near :
      (y : G) ->
      refinement y ->
      near y U

record TopologicalSpace (G : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    neighborhood :
      G ->
      Predicate G ->
      Set
    neighborhood-contains :
      (x : G) ->
      (U : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      U x
    neighborhood-whole :
      (x : G) ->
      neighborhood x wholeSet
    neighborhood-upward :
      (x : G) ->
      (U V : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      Subset U V ->
      neighborhood x V
    neighborhood-intersection :
      (x : G) ->
      (U V : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      neighborhood x V ->
      neighborhood x (intersection U V)
    neighborhood-local :
      (x : G) ->
      (U : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      NeighborhoodRefinement neighborhood x U

open TopologicalSpace

Open :
  {G : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace G ->
  Predicate G ->
  Set
Open {G = G} topology U =
  (x : G) ->
  U x ->
  neighborhood topology x U

record CoverWitness
  {G : Set}
  (family : Predicate G -> Set)
  (x : G) :
  Set1 where

  field
    member-set :
      Predicate G
    member-is-selected :
      family member-set
    member-contains-point :
      member-set x

data FiniteSubfamily
  {G : Set}
  (family : Predicate G -> Set) :
  Set2 where

  no-sets :
    FiniteSubfamily family

  add-set :
    (U : Predicate G) ->
    family U ->
    FiniteSubfamily family ->
    FiniteSubfamily family

CoveredByFinite :
  {G : Set} ->
  {family : Predicate G -> Set} ->
  FiniteSubfamily family ->
  Predicate G
CoveredByFinite no-sets x =
  Bottom
CoveredByFinite (add-set U selected rest) x =
  Either (U x) (CoveredByFinite rest x)

record FiniteSubcover
  {G : Set}
  (family : Predicate G -> Set)
  (K : Predicate G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    selected-sets :
      FiniteSubfamily family
    selected-sets-cover :
      Subset K (CoveredByFinite selected-sets)

Compact :
  {G : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace G ->
  Predicate G ->
  Set2
Compact {G = G} topology K =
  (family : Predicate G -> Set) ->
  ((U : Predicate G) ->
    family U ->
    Open topology U) ->
  ((x : G) ->
    K x ->
    CoverWitness family x) ->
  FiniteSubcover family K

record ProductNeighborhood
  {G : Set}
  (group : Group G)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  (x y : G)
  (W : Predicate G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    left-neighborhood :
      Predicate G
    right-neighborhood :
      Predicate G
    left-is-near :
      neighborhood topology x left-neighborhood
    right-is-near :
      neighborhood topology y right-neighborhood
    products-stay-in-W :
      (u v : G) ->
      left-neighborhood u ->
      right-neighborhood v ->
      W (multiply group u v)

record InverseNeighborhood
  {G : Set}
  (group : Group G)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  (x : G)
  (W : Predicate G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    source-neighborhood :
      Predicate G
    source-is-near :
      neighborhood topology x source-neighborhood
    inverses-stay-in-W :
      (u : G) ->
      source-neighborhood u ->
      W (inverse group u)

record IsTopologicalGroup
  {G : Set}
  (group : Group G)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    multiplication-continuous :
      (x y : G) ->
      (W : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood topology (multiply group x y) W ->
      ProductNeighborhood group topology x y W
    inversion-continuous :
      (x : G) ->
      (W : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood topology (inverse group x) W ->
      InverseNeighborhood group topology x W

data BorelGenerated
  {G : Set}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G) :
  Predicate G ->
  Set1 where

  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate G} ->
    Open topology U ->
    BorelGenerated topology U

  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated topology emptySet

  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate G} ->
    BorelGenerated topology S ->
    BorelGenerated topology (complement S)

  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate G) ->
    ((n : Nat) ->
      BorelGenerated topology (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated topology (countableUnion sets)

  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate G} ->
    ((x : G) ->
      Iff (S x) (T x)) ->
    BorelGenerated topology S ->
    BorelGenerated topology T

record BorelSpace
  {G : Set}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    borel-is-measurable :
      (S : Predicate G) ->
      BorelGenerated topology S ->
      measurable events S
    measurable-is-borel :
      (S : Predicate G) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated topology S

record CompactNeighborhoodWithin
  {G : Set}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  (x : G)
  (N : Predicate G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    compact-neighborhood :
      Predicate G
    compact-neighborhood-near :
      neighborhood topology x compact-neighborhood
    compact-neighborhood-contained :
      Subset compact-neighborhood N
    compact-neighborhood-compact :
      Compact topology compact-neighborhood

record LocallyCompactSpace
  {G : Set}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G) :
  Set2 where

  field
    local-compact-neighborhood :
      (x : G) ->
      (N : Predicate G) ->
      neighborhood topology x N ->
      CompactNeighborhoodWithin topology x N

leftTranslate :
  {G : Set} ->
  Group G ->
  G ->
  Predicate G ->
  Predicate G
leftTranslate group g S x =
  S (multiply group (inverse group g) x)

quotientSet :
  {G : Set} ->
  Group G ->
  Predicate G ->
  Predicate G ->
  Predicate G
quotientSet {G = G} group S T z =
  Exists G
    (\ x ->
      Both
        (S x)
        (Exists G
          (\ y ->
            Both
              (T y)
              (z == multiply group x (inverse group y)))))

Nonempty :
  {G : Set} ->
  Predicate G ->
  Set
Nonempty {G = G} S =
  Exists G S

StrictLessM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set
StrictLessM extended x y =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualM extended x y)
    (x != y)

record IsHaarMeasure
  {R M G : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (group : Group G)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra G}
  (measure : Measure extended events) :
  Set2 where

  field
    left-invariant :
      (g : G) ->
      (S : Predicate G) ->
      outerMass measure (leftTranslate group g S) ==
      outerMass measure S
    finite-on-compact :
      (K : Predicate G) ->
      Compact topology K ->
      outerMass measure K != infinityM extended
    positive-on-nonempty-open :
      (U : Predicate G) ->
      Open topology U ->
      Nonempty U ->
      outerMass measure U != zeroM extended

record InnerCompactApproximation
  {R M G : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra G}
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (U : Predicate G)
  (r : M) :
  Set2 where

  field
    compact-subset :
      Predicate G
    compact-subset-contained :
      Subset compact-subset U
    compact-subset-is-compact :
      Compact topology compact-subset
    compact-subset-mass-above :
      StrictLessM extended r (outerMass measure compact-subset)

record InnerRegular
  {R M G : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G)
  {events : SigmaAlgebra G}
  (measure : Measure extended events) :
  Set2 where

  field
    inner-regular :
      (U : Predicate G) ->
      measurable events U ->
      (r : M) ->
      StrictLessM extended r (outerMass measure U) ->
      InnerCompactApproximation extended topology measure U r

steinhaus-theorem : Set2
steinhaus-theorem =
  (R M G : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (group : Group G) ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace G) ->
  IsTopologicalGroup group topology ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra G) ->
  BorelSpace topology events ->
  LocallyCompactSpace topology ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  IsHaarMeasure extended group topology measure ->
  InnerRegular extended topology measure ->
  (E : Predicate G) ->
  measurable events E ->
  StrictLessM extended
    (zeroM extended)
    (outerMass measure E) ->
  neighborhood topology
    (identity group)
    (quotientSet group E E)

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527166 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3527166), "Steinhaus theorem": every
  measurable set of positive inner-regular Haar measure in a locally compact
  topological group has a quotient set that is a neighborhood of the identity.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory extrealTheory topologyTheory sigma_algebraTheory;
open measureTheory borelTheory;

val q3527166_group_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_group_def",
  ``q3527166_group
      (one : 'g) (mul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (inv : 'g -> 'g) <=>
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul one x = x /\ mul x one = x) /\
      (!x. mul (inv x) x = one /\ mul x (inv x) = one)``);

val q3527166_topological_group_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_topological_group_def",
  ``q3527166_topological_group
      (top : 'g topology) (mul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (inv : 'g -> 'g) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      (!x y u.
        open_in top u /\ mul x y IN u ==>
        ?v w.
          open_in top v /\ x IN v /\
          open_in top w /\ y IN w /\
          !x' y'. x' IN v /\ y' IN w ==> mul x' y' IN u) /\
      continuous_map (top,top) inv``);

val q3527166_borel_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_borel_measure_def",
  ``q3527166_borel_measure (top : 'g topology) (m : 'g m_space) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m = subsets (general_borel top)``);

val q3527166_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_outer_measure_def",
  ``q3527166_outer_measure (m : 'g m_space) (s : 'g set) =
      inf
        {r : extreal |
          ?t : 'g set.
            s SUBSET t /\
            t IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m t = r}``);

val q3527166_neighborhood_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_neighborhood_def",
  ``q3527166_neighborhood
      (top : 'g topology) (x : 'g) (s : 'g set) <=>
      ?u. open_in top u /\ x IN u /\ u SUBSET s``);

val q3527166_locally_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_locally_compact_def",
  ``q3527166_locally_compact (top : 'g topology) <=>
      !x n.
        q3527166_neighborhood top x n ==>
        ?k.
          q3527166_neighborhood top x k /\
          k SUBSET n /\
          compact_in top k``);

val q3527166_haar_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_haar_measure_def",
  ``q3527166_haar_measure
      (top : 'g topology) (mul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (m : 'g m_space) <=>
      (!a s.
        q3527166_outer_measure m {x | mul a x IN s} =
        q3527166_outer_measure m s) /\
      (!k.
        compact_in top k ==>
        q3527166_outer_measure m k <> PosInf) /\
      (!u.
        open_in top u /\ u <> {} ==>
        0 < q3527166_outer_measure m u)``);

val q3527166_inner_regular_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_inner_regular_def",
  ``q3527166_inner_regular (top : 'g topology) (m : 'g m_space) <=>
      !u.
        u IN measurable_sets m ==>
        !r : extreal.
          r < q3527166_outer_measure m u ==>
          ?k.
            k SUBSET u /\
            compact_in top k /\
            r < q3527166_outer_measure m k``);

val q3527166_div_set_def = new_definition (
  "q3527166_div_set_def",
  ``q3527166_div_set
      (mul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (inv : 'g -> 'g) (s : 'g set) =
      {z | ?x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ z = mul x (inv y)}``);

val div_mem_nhds_one_of_haar_pos =
  ``!(one : 'g) (mul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (inv : 'g -> 'g)
      (top : 'g topology) (m : 'g m_space) (e : 'g set).
      q3527166_group one mul inv /\
      q3527166_topological_group top mul inv /\
      q3527166_borel_measure top m /\
      q3527166_locally_compact top /\
      q3527166_haar_measure top mul m /\
      q3527166_inner_regular top m /\
      e IN measurable_sets m /\
      0 < q3527166_outer_measure m e
      ==>
      q3527166_neighborhood top one
        (q3527166_div_set mul inv e)``;

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527166
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527166), "Steinhaus theorem": in an
  arbitrary locally compact topological group with a Borel inner-regular Haar
  measure, the pointwise quotient E / E of every measurable positive-measure
  set E contains a neighborhood of the group identity. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  G ranges over arbitrary SetMM topological groups. SetMM writes the group
  operation, inverse, and identity as +g, -g, and 0g even when the group is
  viewed multiplicatively. Q3527166Quotient therefore renders the source
  pointwise quotient E / E as all x * y^-1 with x,y in E.

  Q3527166Haar expands Mathlib's IsHaarMeasure class: M is a measure on the
  Borel sigma-algebra generated by G's topology, its induced outer measure is
  left-translation invariant, it is finite on compact sets, and it is
  positive on nonempty open sets. Q3527166InnerRegular is exactly Mathlib's
  InnerRegularWRT approximation property for compact subsets of measurable
  sets. Membership of TopOpen G in N-Locally Comp is SetMM's arbitrary-
  neighborhood formulation of local compactness.

  Q3527166Neighborhood says that a set contains an open set containing the
  specified point, equivalently that it belongs to that point's neighborhood
  filter. The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement.
  All preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful bidirectional
  definitions, and this root file contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q3527166Measure Q3527166Translate Q3527166Haar
   Q3527166InnerRegular Q3527166Quotient Q3527166Neighborhood $.

q3527166-measure-syntax $a class ( Q3527166Measure M A ) $.
q3527166-translate-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527166Translate G a A ) $.
q3527166-haar-syntax $a wff ( Q3527166Haar G M ) $.
q3527166-inner-regular-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527166InnerRegular G M ) $.
q3527166-quotient-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527166Quotient G E ) $.
q3527166-neighborhood-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527166Neighborhood G x S ) $.

${
  $d A M $.

  q3527166-measure-definition $a |- (
    Q3527166Measure M A
  ) = ( ( toOMeas ` M ) ` A ) $.
$}

${
  $d A G a x y $.

  q3527166-translate-definition $a |- (
    Q3527166Translate G a A
  ) = {
    y e. ( Base ` G ) |
      E. x e. A y = ( a ( +g ` G ) x )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G M a b k u $.

  q3527166-haar-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527166Haar G M )
    <->
    (
      M e.
        (
          measures
          `
          ( sigaGen ` ( TopOpen ` G ) )
        )
      /\
      (
        A. a e. ( Base ` G ) A. b e. ~P ( Base ` G )
          (
            ( Q3527166Measure M ( Q3527166Translate G a b ) )
            =
            ( Q3527166Measure M b )
          )
        /\
        (
          A. k e. ~P ( Base ` G )
            (
              (
                ( ( TopOpen ` G ) |`t k ) e. Comp
                ->
                ( Q3527166Measure M k ) e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
              )
            )
          /\
          A. u e. ( TopOpen ` G )
            (
              u =/= (/)
              ->
              0 < ( Q3527166Measure M u )
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M b k r $.

  q3527166-inner-regular-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527166InnerRegular G M )
    <->
    A. b e. dom M A. r e. ( 0 [,] +oo )
      (
        r < ( Q3527166Measure M b )
        ->
        E. k e. ~P ( Base ` G )
          (
            (
              k C_ b
              /\
              ( ( TopOpen ` G ) |`t k ) e. Comp
            )
            /\
            r < ( Q3527166Measure M k )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d E G x y z $.

  q3527166-quotient-definition $a |- (
    Q3527166Quotient G E
  ) = {
    z e. ( Base ` G ) |
      E. x e. E E. y e. E
        z =
        (
          x
          ( +g ` G )
          ( ( -g ` G ) ` y )
        )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G S u x $.

  q3527166-neighborhood-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527166Neighborhood G x S )
    <->
    E. u e. ( TopOpen ` G )
      (
        x e. u
        /\
        u C_ S
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d e g m $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527166-steinhaus $a |-
    A. g e. TopGrp A. m A. e
      (
        (
          (
            ( TopOpen ` g ) e. N-Locally Comp
            /\
            ( Q3527166Haar g m )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( Q3527166InnerRegular g m )
            /\
            (
              e e. dom m
              /\
              0 < ( Q3527166Measure m e )
            )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          Q3527166Neighborhood
          g
          ( 0g ` g )
          ( Q3527166Quotient g e )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q3527166_steinhaus_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527166,
% "Steinhaus theorem": in a locally compact topological group, the quotient of
% a measurable positive-measure set by itself is a neighborhood of the identity
% for an inner-regular Haar measure. This file contains no proof.

steinhaus_theorem_Q3527166[
  G: TYPE+,
  one: G,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  open_sets: [[G -> bool] -> bool],
  measurable_sets: [[G -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY

BEGIN

  point_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]

  empty_set: point_set = LAMBDA (x: G): FALSE
  full_set: point_set = LAMBDA (x: G): TRUE

  subset_of(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  disjoint(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): NOT (A(x) AND B(x))

  intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): A(x) AND B(x)

  complement(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): NOT A(x)

  union_of_family(F: set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): EXISTS (A: point_set): F(A) AND A(x)

  union_of_sequence(S: set_sequence): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): EXISTS (n: nat): S(n)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(S: set_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: nat): i /= j IMPLIES disjoint(S(i), S(j))

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: G):
      mul(one, x) = x AND mul(x, one) = x)
    AND
    (FORALL (x: G):
      mul(inv(x), x) = one AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  topology_laws: bool =
    open_sets(empty_set)
    AND open_sets(full_set)
    AND
    (FORALL (F: set_family):
      (FORALL (A: point_set): F(A) IMPLIES open_sets(A))
      IMPLIES open_sets(union_of_family(F)))
    AND
    (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
      open_sets(A) AND open_sets(B)
      IMPLIES open_sets(intersection(A, B)))

  multiplication_continuous: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: G), (U: point_set):
      open_sets(U) AND U(mul(x, y))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (V, W: point_set):
          open_sets(V) AND open_sets(W)
          AND V(x) AND W(y)
          AND
          (FORALL (a, b: G):
            V(a) AND W(b) IMPLIES U(mul(a, b)))

  inversion_continuous: bool =
    FORALL (x: G), (U: point_set):
      open_sets(U) AND U(inv(x))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (V: point_set):
          open_sets(V) AND V(x)
          AND (FORALL (a: G): V(a) IMPLIES U(inv(a)))

  neighborhood(S: point_set, x: G): bool =
    EXISTS (U: point_set):
      open_sets(U) AND U(x) AND subset_of(U, S)

  open_cover(C: set_family, K: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set): C(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
    AND
    (FORALL (x: G):
      K(x) IMPLIES EXISTS (U: point_set): C(U) AND U(x))

  has_finite_subcover(C: set_family, K: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (n: nat), (chosen: [below(n) -> point_set]):
      (FORALL (i: below(n)): C(chosen(i)))
      AND
      (FORALL (x: G):
        K(x) IMPLIES EXISTS (i: below(n)): chosen(i)(x))

  compact(K: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: set_family):
      open_cover(C, K) IMPLIES has_finite_subcover(C, K)

  locally_compact_space: bool =
    FORALL (x: G), (N: point_set):
      neighborhood(N, x)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (K: point_set):
          neighborhood(K, x) AND subset_of(K, N) AND compact(K)

  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(empty_set)
    AND Sigma(full_set)
    AND
    (FORALL (A: point_set):
      Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(complement(A)))
    AND
    (FORALL (S: set_sequence):
      (FORALL (n: nat): Sigma(S(n)))
      IMPLIES Sigma(union_of_sequence(S)))

  borel_space: bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(measurable_sets)
    AND
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      open_sets(U) IMPLIES measurable_sets(U))
    AND
    (FORALL (Sigma: sigma_algebra):
      is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND
      (FORALL (U: point_set): open_sets(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A: point_set): measurable_sets(A) IMPLIES Sigma(A)))

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]

  canonical_value(v: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(v)
    THEN finite_part(v) = 0
    ELSE finite_part(v) >= 0
    ENDIF

  mv_zero: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  mv_infinity: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  mv_finite(r: nonneg_real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := r #)

  mv_le(a, b: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_value(a) AND canonical_value(b)
    AND
    (infinite_flag(b)
     OR
     (NOT infinite_flag(a)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(b)
      AND finite_part(a) <= finite_part(b)))

  mv_lt(a, b: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_value(a) AND canonical_value(b)
    AND
    ((NOT infinite_flag(a) AND infinite_flag(b))
     OR
     (NOT infinite_flag(a)
      AND NOT infinite_flag(b)
      AND finite_part(a) < finite_part(b)))

  mv_positive(a: measure_value): bool =
    mv_lt(mv_zero, a)

  mv_is_finite(a: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_value(a) AND NOT infinite_flag(a)

  mv_add(a, b: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(a) OR infinite_flag(b)
    THEN mv_infinity
    ELSE
      (# infinite_flag := FALSE,
         finite_part := finite_part(a) + finite_part(b) #)
    ENDIF

  finite_real_sum(a: [nat -> nonneg_real], n: nat): RECURSIVE nonneg_real =
    IF n = 0
    THEN 0
    ELSE finite_real_sum(a, n - 1) + a(n - 1)
    ENDIF
    MEASURE n

  converges_to_real(a: [nat -> nonneg_real], r: nonneg_real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: posreal):
      EXISTS (N: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          n >= N IMPLIES abs(finite_real_sum(a, n) - r) < epsilon

  unbounded_above(a: [nat -> nonneg_real]): bool =
    FORALL (r: nonneg_real):
      EXISTS (n: nat): finite_real_sum(a, n) > r

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
    a: [nat -> measure_value],
    total: measure_value
  ): bool =
    (FORALL (n: nat): canonical_value(a(n)))
    AND canonical_value(total)
    AND
    ((infinite_flag(total)
      AND
      ((EXISTS (n: nat): infinite_flag(a(n)))
       OR
       ((FORALL (n: nat): NOT infinite_flag(a(n)))
        AND unbounded_above(
          LAMBDA (n: nat):
            finite_part(a(n))))))
     OR
     (NOT infinite_flag(total)
      AND
      (FORALL (n: nat): NOT infinite_flag(a(n)))
      AND
      converges_to_real(
        LAMBDA (n: nat): finite_part(a(n)),
        finite_part(total))))

  measure_map: TYPE = [point_set -> measure_value]

  outer_measure_laws(M: measure_map): bool =
    (FORALL (A: point_set): canonical_value(M(A)))
    AND M(empty_set) = mv_zero
    AND
    (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
      subset_of(A, B) IMPLIES mv_le(M(A), M(B)))
    AND
    (FORALL (S: set_sequence):
      EXISTS (total: measure_value):
        extended_nonnegative_sum(
          LAMBDA (n: nat): M(S(n)),
          total)
        AND mv_le(M(union_of_sequence(S)), total))

  caratheodory_measurable(M: measure_map, E: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (A: point_set):
      M(A) = mv_add(
        M(intersection(A, E)),
        M(intersection(A, complement(E))))

  canonical_outer_extension(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (A: point_set), (lower_bound: measure_value):
      canonical_value(lower_bound)
      AND
      (FORALL (B: point_set):
        measurable_sets(B) AND subset_of(A, B)
        IMPLIES mv_le(lower_bound, M(B)))
      IMPLIES mv_le(lower_bound, M(A))

  is_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    outer_measure_laws(M)
    AND canonical_outer_extension(M)
    AND
    (FORALL (E: point_set):
      measurable_sets(E) IMPLIES caratheodory_measurable(M, E))

  left_translate_preimage(g: G, A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): A(mul(g, x))

  finite_on_compacts(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (K: point_set):
      compact(K) IMPLIES mv_is_finite(M(K))

  left_invariant(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (g: G), (A: point_set):
      M(left_translate_preimage(g, A)) = M(A)

  positive_on_nonempty_open_sets(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (U: point_set):
      open_sets(U) AND (EXISTS (x: G): U(x))
      IMPLIES mv_positive(M(U))

  is_haar_measure(M: measure_map): bool =
    finite_on_compacts(M)
    AND left_invariant(M)
    AND positive_on_nonempty_open_sets(M)

  inner_regular(M: measure_map): bool =
    FORALL (U: point_set):
      measurable_sets(U)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (r: measure_value):
          mv_lt(r, M(U))
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (K: point_set):
              subset_of(K, U)
              AND compact(K)
              AND mv_lt(r, M(K))

  quotient_set(E: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (g: G):
      EXISTS (x, y: G):
        E(x) AND E(y) AND g = mul(x, inv(y))

  steinhaus_theorem: bool =
    group_laws
    AND topology_laws
    AND multiplication_continuous
    AND inversion_continuous
    AND locally_compact_space
    AND borel_space
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (M: measure_map), (E: point_set):
        is_measure(M)
        AND is_haar_measure(M)
        AND inner_regular(M)
        AND measurable_sets(E)
        AND mv_positive(M(E))
        IMPLIES neighborhood(quotient_set(E), one)

END steinhaus_theorem_Q3527166

title: Q3527189_lattice_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527189
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527189), "Lattice theorem": Noether's third
  isomorphism theorem for arbitrary groups, identifying (G/N)/(M/N) with G/M
  for normal subgroups N contained in M. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Record q3527189_group : Type := {
  q3527189_carrier : Type;
  q3527189_one : q3527189_carrier;
  q3527189_mul :
    q3527189_carrier -> q3527189_carrier -> q3527189_carrier;
  q3527189_inv : q3527189_carrier -> q3527189_carrier;
  q3527189_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : q3527189_carrier,
      q3527189_mul x (q3527189_mul y z) =
      q3527189_mul (q3527189_mul x y) z;
  q3527189_one_mul :
    forall x : q3527189_carrier, q3527189_mul q3527189_one x = x;
  q3527189_mul_one :
    forall x : q3527189_carrier, q3527189_mul x q3527189_one = x;
  q3527189_inv_mul :
    forall x : q3527189_carrier,
      q3527189_mul (q3527189_inv x) x = q3527189_one;
  q3527189_mul_inv :
    forall x : q3527189_carrier,
      q3527189_mul x (q3527189_inv x) = q3527189_one
}.

Arguments q3527189_carrier _ : clear implicits.
Arguments q3527189_one {q}.
Arguments q3527189_mul {q} _ _.
Arguments q3527189_inv {q} _.

Definition q3527189_subgroup (G : q3527189_group) : Type :=
  q3527189_carrier G -> Prop.

Definition q3527189_is_subgroup
    (G : q3527189_group) (S : q3527189_subgroup G) : Prop :=
  S q3527189_one /\
  (forall x y : q3527189_carrier G,
      S x -> S y -> S (q3527189_mul x y)) /\
  (forall x : q3527189_carrier G,
      S x -> S (q3527189_inv x)).

Definition q3527189_subgroup_le
    {G : q3527189_group}
    (A B : q3527189_subgroup G) : Prop :=
  forall x : q3527189_carrier G, A x -> B x.

Definition q3527189_normal_subgroup
    (G : q3527189_group) (N : q3527189_subgroup G) : Prop :=
  q3527189_is_subgroup G N /\
  forall g n : q3527189_carrier G,
    N n ->
    N (q3527189_mul (q3527189_mul g n) (q3527189_inv g)).

Definition q3527189_top_subgroup
    (G : q3527189_group) : q3527189_subgroup G :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q3527189_group_homomorphism
    (G H : q3527189_group)
    (f : q3527189_carrier G -> q3527189_carrier H) : Prop :=
  f q3527189_one = q3527189_one /\
  forall x y : q3527189_carrier G,
    f (q3527189_mul x y) = q3527189_mul (f x) (f y).

Definition q3527189_quotient_equal
    (G : q3527189_group)
    (N : q3527189_subgroup G)
    (x y : q3527189_carrier G) : Prop :=
  N (q3527189_mul (q3527189_inv x) y).

Definition q3527189_relation_map_isomorphism
    (G H : q3527189_group)
    (A : q3527189_subgroup G)
    (C : q3527189_subgroup H)
    (source_equal :
      q3527189_carrier G -> q3527189_carrier G -> Prop)
    (target_equal :
      q3527189_carrier H -> q3527189_carrier H -> Prop)
    (forward : q3527189_carrier G -> q3527189_carrier H) : Prop :=
  q3527189_group_homomorphism G H forward /\
  (forall x : q3527189_carrier G, A x -> C (forward x)) /\
  (forall x y : q3527189_carrier G,
      A x -> A y -> source_equal x y ->
      target_equal (forward x) (forward y)) /\
  exists backward : q3527189_carrier H -> q3527189_carrier G,
    (forall y : q3527189_carrier H, C y -> A (backward y)) /\
    (forall y z : q3527189_carrier H,
      C y -> C z -> target_equal y z ->
      source_equal (backward y) (backward z)) /\
    (forall x : q3527189_carrier G,
      A x -> source_equal (backward (forward x)) x) /\
    (forall y : q3527189_carrier H,
      C y -> target_equal (forward (backward y)) y).

Definition q3527189_quotient_image_member
    (G : q3527189_group)
    (N M : q3527189_subgroup G)
    (x : q3527189_carrier G) : Prop :=
  exists m : q3527189_carrier G,
    M m /\ q3527189_quotient_equal G N x m.

Definition q3527189_double_quotient_equal
    (G : q3527189_group)
    (N M : q3527189_subgroup G)
    (x y : q3527189_carrier G) : Prop :=
  q3527189_quotient_image_member G N M
    (q3527189_mul (q3527189_inv x) y).

Theorem QuotientGroup_quotientQuotientEquivQuotient :
  forall (G : q3527189_group)
         (N M : q3527189_subgroup G),
    q3527189_normal_subgroup G N ->
    q3527189_normal_subgroup G M ->
    q3527189_subgroup_le N M ->
    q3527189_relation_map_isomorphism
      G G
      (q3527189_top_subgroup G)
      (q3527189_top_subgroup G)
      (q3527189_double_quotient_equal G N M)
      (q3527189_quotient_equal G M)
      (fun x : q3527189_carrier G => x).
Admitted.

(*

  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527189), "Lattice theorem": Noether's third
  isomorphism theorem identifies (G/N)/(M/N) canonically with G/M for normal
  subgroups N contained in M. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527189_lattice_theorem
  imports "HOL-Algebra.Coset"
begin

definition q3527189_factor_subgroup ::
    "('a, 'b) monoid_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set"
  where
    "q3527189_factor_subgroup G N M =
      rcosets\<^bsub>G\<lparr>carrier := M\<rparr>\<^esub> N"

definition q3527189_canonical_map :: "'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  where
    "q3527189_canonical_map X = \<Union>X"

theorem q3527189_quotient_quotient_equiv_quotient:
  fixes G :: "('a, 'b) monoid_scheme"
    and N M :: "'a set"
  assumes group_G: "group G"
    and normal_N: "N \<lhd> G"
    and normal_M: "M \<lhd> G"
    and nested: "N \<subseteq> M"
  shows "q3527189_canonical_map \<in>
      iso ((G Mod N) Mod (q3527189_factor_subgroup G N M)) (G Mod M) \<and>
    (\<forall>g \<in> carrier G.
      q3527189_canonical_map
        (r_coset (G Mod N) (q3527189_factor_subgroup G N M)
          (r_coset G N g)) =
      r_coset G M g)"
  oops

end

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527189,
;; "Lattice theorem": Noether's third isomorphism theorem, giving the canonical
;; multiplicative equivalence (G/N)/(M/N) with G/M when N and M are normal
;; subgroups of G and N is contained in M. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ function objects represent the arbitrary carrier, operation,
;; inverse, and subgroup predicates. DEFUN-SK keeps all element and
;; representative quantifiers internal to the statement.

(defun q3527189-member-p (predicate element)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list element))
      t
    nil))

(defun q3527189-multiply (multiplication left right)
  (apply$ multiplication (list left right)))

(defun q3527189-invert (inverse element)
  (apply$ inverse (list element)))

(defun-sk q3527189-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q3527189-member-p left element)
     (q3527189-member-p right element))))

(defun-sk q3527189-group-laws-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527189-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q3527189-member-p
        carrier
        (q3527189-invert inverse x))
       (equal
        (q3527189-multiply multiplication identity x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q3527189-multiply multiplication x identity)
        x)
       (equal
        (q3527189-multiply
         multiplication
         (q3527189-invert inverse x)
         x)
        identity)
       (equal
        (q3527189-multiply
         multiplication
         x
         (q3527189-invert inverse x))
        identity)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527189-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527189-member-p carrier y))
      (q3527189-member-p
       carrier
       (q3527189-multiply multiplication x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527189-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527189-member-p carrier y)
       (q3527189-member-p carrier z))
      (equal
       (q3527189-multiply
        multiplication
        (q3527189-multiply multiplication x y)
        z)
       (q3527189-multiply
        multiplication
        x
        (q3527189-multiply multiplication y z)))))))

(defun q3527189-group-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q3527189-member-p carrier identity)
   (q3527189-group-laws-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity)))

(defun q3527189-subgroup-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp subgroup)
   (q3527189-group-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity)
   (q3527189-subset-p subgroup carrier)
   (q3527189-group-p
    subgroup multiplication inverse identity)))

(defun-sk q3527189-normal-laws-p
    (carrier subgroup multiplication inverse)
  (forall (conjugator element)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527189-member-p carrier conjugator)
      (q3527189-member-p subgroup element))
     (q3527189-member-p
      subgroup
      (q3527189-multiply
       multiplication
       (q3527189-multiply multiplication conjugator element)
       (q3527189-invert inverse conjugator))))))

(defun q3527189-normal-subgroup-p
    (carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
  (and
   (q3527189-subgroup-p
    carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup)
   (q3527189-normal-laws-p
    carrier subgroup multiplication inverse)))

;; Equality of representatives modulo a normal subgroup K is
;; x^-1*y in K.

(defun q3527189-quotient-equivalent-p
    (subgroup multiplication inverse x y)
  (q3527189-member-p
   subgroup
   (q3527189-multiply
    multiplication
    (q3527189-invert inverse x)
    y)))

;; An element of M.map(mk N) is an N-coset having a representative in M.
;; The existential representative is internal, matching Subgroup.map.

(defun-sk q3527189-mapped-m-member-p
    (subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse element)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q3527189-member-p subgroup-m representative)
     (q3527189-quotient-equivalent-p
      subgroup-n
      multiplication
      inverse
      representative
      element))))

;; Representatives x and y determine equal elements of
;; (G/N)/(M.map(mk N)) precisely when [x^-1*y]_N belongs to M.map(mk N).

(defun q3527189-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
    (subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse x y)
  (q3527189-mapped-m-member-p
   subgroup-n
   subgroup-m
   multiplication
   inverse
   (q3527189-multiply
    multiplication
    (q3527189-invert inverse x)
    y)))

;; Both directions of the canonical equivalence are induced by the identity
;; on G-representatives, but their domains and equality relations differ.

(defun q3527189-canonical-forward (representative)
  representative)

(defun q3527189-canonical-inverse (representative)
  representative)

;; These laws are the quotient-presentation form of a MulEquiv. They state
;; that the canonical forward and inverse maps are well-defined, inverse on
;; equivalence classes (hence bijective), and preserve quotient multiplication.

(defun-sk q3527189-canonical-multiplicative-equivalence-p
    (carrier subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527189-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q3527189-member-p
        carrier
        (q3527189-canonical-forward x))
       (q3527189-member-p
        carrier
        (q3527189-canonical-inverse x))
       (q3527189-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-n
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q3527189-canonical-inverse
         (q3527189-canonical-forward x))
        x)
       (q3527189-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q3527189-canonical-forward
         (q3527189-canonical-inverse x))
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527189-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527189-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (implies
        (q3527189-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse x y)
        (q3527189-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-m
         multiplication
         inverse
         (q3527189-canonical-forward x)
         (q3527189-canonical-forward y)))
       (implies
        (q3527189-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-m multiplication inverse x y)
        (q3527189-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
         subgroup-n
         subgroup-m
         multiplication
         inverse
         (q3527189-canonical-inverse x)
         (q3527189-canonical-inverse y)))
       (q3527189-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q3527189-canonical-forward
         (q3527189-multiply multiplication x y))
        (q3527189-multiply
         multiplication
         (q3527189-canonical-forward x)
         (q3527189-canonical-forward y)))
       (q3527189-iterated-quotient-equivalent-p
        subgroup-n
        subgroup-m
        multiplication
        inverse
        (q3527189-canonical-inverse
         (q3527189-multiply multiplication x y))
        (q3527189-multiply
         multiplication
         (q3527189-canonical-inverse x)
         (q3527189-canonical-inverse y))))))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3527189-lattice-theorem-statement
    (carrier
     multiplication
     inverse
     identity
     subgroup-n
     subgroup-m)
  (implies
   (and
    (q3527189-normal-subgroup-p
     carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup-n)
    (q3527189-normal-subgroup-p
     carrier multiplication inverse identity subgroup-m)
    (q3527189-subset-p subgroup-n subgroup-m))
   (q3527189-canonical-multiplicative-equivalence-p
    carrier subgroup-n subgroup-m multiplication inverse)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q
