content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527189,
-- "Lattice theorem": Noether's third isomorphism theorem gives the canonical
-- group isomorphism (G / N) / (M / N) ≅ G / M for normal subgroups N contained
-- in M. This file contains no proof.

module Q3527189_lattice_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _⊆_
infixr 5 _×_

data ⊤ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where
  tt : ⊤

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity :
      member (Group.identity structure)
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) →
      member x →
      member (Group.inverse structure x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (Group.multiply structure x y)

_⊆_ :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
H ⊆ K =
  (x : _) →
  SubgroupOf.member H x →
  SubgroupOf.member K x

record Normal
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  {structure : Group G}
  (N : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    closed-under-conjugation :
      (g n : G) →
      SubgroupOf.member N n →
      SubgroupOf.member N
        (Group.multiply structure
          (Group.multiply structure g n)
          (Group.inverse structure g))

record RestrictedMulEquiv
  {a b p q r s : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (domain-member : A → Set p)
  (codomain-member : B → Set q)
  (domain-related : A → A → Set r)
  (codomain-related : B → B → Set s)
  (domain-multiply : A → A → A)
  (codomain-multiply : B → B → B)
  (forward : A → B) :
  Set (a ⊔ b ⊔ p ⊔ q ⊔ r ⊔ s) where

  field
    inverse :
      (y : B) →
      codomain-member y →
      A
    forward-closed :
      (x : A) →
      domain-member x →
      codomain-member (forward x)
    inverse-closed :
      (y : B) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      domain-member (inverse y hy)
    forward-congruent :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-member x →
      domain-member y →
      domain-related x y →
      codomain-related (forward x) (forward y)
    inverse-congruent :
      (x y : B) →
      (hx : codomain-member x) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      codomain-related x y →
      domain-related (inverse x hx) (inverse y hy)
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      domain-member x →
      domain-member y →
      codomain-related
        (forward (domain-multiply x y))
        (codomain-multiply (forward x) (forward y))
    inverse-forward :
      (x : A) →
      (hx : domain-member x) →
      domain-related
        (inverse (forward x) (forward-closed x hx))
        x
    forward-inverse :
      (y : B) →
      (hy : codomain-member y) →
      codomain-related (forward (inverse y hy)) y

QuotientRelated :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
QuotientRelated structure N x y =
  SubgroupOf.member N

(*

  Q3527189, "Lattice theorem": Noether's third isomorphism theorem for groups,
  stating that for normal subgroups N contained in M, the quotient of G/N by
  the image of M is isomorphic to G/M. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open groupTheory pred_setTheory;

val quotientQuotientEquivQuotient =
  ``!(g : 'a group) (n : 'a group) (m : 'a group).
      Group g /\
      normal_subgroup n g /\
      normal_subgroup m g /\
      Subgroup n m
      ==>
      ?e : ('a set) set -> 'a set.
        GroupIso e
          (quotient_group
            (quotient_group g n)
            (homo_image
              (left_coset g n.carrier)
              m
              (quotient_group g n)))
          (quotient_group g m) /\
        !x. x IN g.carrier ==>
          e
            (left_coset
              (quotient_group g n)
              (homo_image
                (left_coset g n.carrier)
                m
                (quotient_group g n)).carrier
              (left_coset g n.carrier x)) =
          left_coset g m.carrier x``;

title: Q3527189_lattice_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527189,
% "Lattice theorem": Noether's third isomorphism theorem for arbitrary groups,
% canonically identifying (G/N)/(M/N) with G/M when N and M are normal and N is contained in M.
% This file contains no proof.

Q3527189_lattice_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  group_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]
  quotient_set: TYPE = [group_set -> bool]
  iterated_quotient_relation: TYPE =
    [quotient_set, group_set -> bool]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  subset_of(A, B: group_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G): A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  is_subgroup(A: group_set): bool =
    A(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        A(x) AND A(y) IMPLIES A(mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        A(x) IMPLIES A(inv(x)))

  is_normal_subgroup(A: group_set): bool =
    is_subgroup(A)
      AND (FORALL (g, x: G):
        A(x) IMPLIES
          A(mul(mul(g, x), inv(g))))

  left_coset(g: G, A: group_set): group_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):
      EXISTS (a: G):
        A(a) AND x = mul(g, a)

  is_coset(A: group_set, C: group_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G): C = left_coset(g, A)

  quotient_product(
      A: group_set,
      C, D, E: group_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: G):
      C = left_coset(x, A)
        AND D = left_coset(y, A)
        AND E = left_coset(mul(x, y), A)

  iterated_left_coset(
      N, M: group_set,
      g: G): quotient_set =
    LAMBDA (C: group_set):
      EXISTS (m: G):
        M(m) AND C = left_coset(mul(g, m), N)

  is_iterated_coset(
      N, M: group_set,
      Q: quotient_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G):
      Q = iterated_left_coset(N, M, g)

  iterated_quotient_product(
      N, M: group_set,
      Q1, Q2, Q3: quotient_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: G):
      Q1 = iterated_left_coset(N, M, x)
        AND Q2 = iterated_left_coset(N, M, y)
        AND Q3 = iterated_left_coset(N, M, mul(x, y))

  canonical_relation(
      N, M: group_set,
      Q: quotient_set,
      C: group_set): bool =
    EXISTS (g: G):
      Q = iterated_left_coset(N, M, g)
        AND C = left_coset(g, M)

  is_bijection(
      relation: iterated_quotient_relation,
      domain: [quotient_set -> bool],
      codomain: [group_set -> bool]): bool =
    (FORALL (Q: quotient_set), (C: group_set):
      relation(Q, C) IMPLIES domain(Q) AND codomain(C))
      AND (FORALL (Q: quotient_set):
        domain(Q) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (C: group_set):
            codomain(C) AND relation(Q, C))
      AND (FORALL (Q: quotient_set), (C, D: group_set):
        domain(Q)
          AND codomain(C)
          AND codomain(D)
          AND relation(Q, C)
          AND relation(Q, D)
          IMPLIES C = D)
      AND (FORALL (C: group_set):
        codomain(C) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (Q: quotient_set):
            domain(Q) AND relation(Q, C))
      AND (FORALL (Q, R: quotient_set), (C: group_set):
        domain(Q)
          AND domain(R)
          AND codomain(C)
          AND relation(Q, C)
          AND relation(R, C)
          IMPLIES Q = R)

  preserves_quotient_product(
      N, M: group_set,
      relation: iterated_quotient_relation): bool =
    FORALL (Q1, Q2, Q3: quotient_set),
           (C1, C2, C3: group_set):
      iterated_quotient_product(N, M, Q1, Q2, Q3)
        AND relation(Q1, C1)
        AND relation(Q2, C2)
        AND relation(Q3, C3)
        IMPLIES quotient_product(M, C1, C2, C3)

  quotientQuotientEquivQuotient: bool =
    FORALL (N, M: group_set):
      (group_laws
        AND is_normal_subgroup(N)
        AND is_normal_subgroup(M)
        AND subset_of(N, M))
      IMPLIES
        (is_bijection(
          LAMBDA (Q: quotient_set), (C: group_set):
            canonical_relation(N, M, Q, C),
          LAMBDA (Q: quotient_set):
            is_iterated_coset(N, M, Q),
          LAMBDA (C: group_set):
            is_coset(M, C))
          AND preserves_quotient_product(
            N,
            M,
            LAMBDA (Q: quotient_set), (C: group_set):
              canonical_relation(N, M, Q, C)))

END Q3527189_lattice_theorem

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527205
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527205), "Dimension theorem for vector spaces":
  over a semiring satisfying invariant basis number, any two bases of the same
  module have index types of equal cardinality. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q3527205_semiring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q3527205_zero : R;
  q3527205_one : R;
  q3527205_add : R -> R -> R;
  q3527205_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q3527205_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527205_add x (q3527205_add y z) =
      q3527205_add (q3527205_add x y) z;
  q3527205_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q3527205_add x y = q3527205_add y x;
  q3527205_zero_add :
    forall x : R, q3527205_add q3527205_zero x = x;
  q3527205_add_zero :
    forall x : R, q3527205_add x q3527205_zero = x;
  q3527205_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527205_mul x (q3527205_mul y z) =
      q3527205_mul (q3527205_mul x y) z;
  q3527205_one_mul :
    forall x : R, q3527205_mul q3527205_one x = x;
  q3527205_mul_one :
    forall x : R, q3527205_mul x q3527205_one = x;
  q3527205_mul_add :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527205_mul x (q3527205_add y z) =
      q3527205_add
        (q3527205_mul x y) (q3527205_mul x z);
  q3527205_add_mul :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527205_mul (q3527205_add x y) z =
      q3527205_add
        (q3527205_mul x z) (q3527205_mul y z);
  q3527205_zero_mul :
    forall x : R, q3527205_mul q3527205_zero x = q3527205_zero;
  q3527205_mul_zero :
    forall x : R, q3527205_mul x q3527205_zero = q3527205_zero
}.

Arguments q3527205_zero {R} _.
Arguments q3527205_one {R} _.
Arguments q3527205_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527205_mul {R} _ _ _.

Record q3527205_module
    {R : Type}
    (S : q3527205_semiring R)
    (M : Type) : Type := {
  q3527205_mzero : M;
  q3527205_madd : M -> M -> M;
  q3527205_smul : R -> M -> M;
  q3527205_madd_assoc :
    forall x y z : M,
      q3527205_madd x (q3527205_madd y z) =
      q3527205_madd (q3527205_madd x y) z;
  q3527205_madd_comm :
    forall x y : M,
      q3527205_madd x y = q3527205_madd y x;
  q3527205_mzero_add :
    forall x : M, q3527205_madd q3527205_mzero x = x;
  q3527205_madd_zero :
    forall x : M, q3527205_madd x q3527205_mzero = x;
  q3527205_one_smul :
    forall x : M, q3527205_smul (q3527205_one S) x = x;
  q3527205_mul_smul :
    forall (r s : R) (x : M),
      q3527205_smul (q3527205_mul S r s) x =
      q3527205_smul r (q3527205_smul s x);
  q3527205_add_smul :
    forall (r s : R) (x : M),
      q3527205_smul (q3527205_add S r s) x =
      q3527205_madd
        (q3527205_smul r x) (q3527205_smul s x);
  q3527205_smul_add :
    forall (r : R) (x y : M),
      q3527205_smul r (q3527205_madd x y) =
      q3527205_madd
        (q3527205_smul r x) (q3527205_smul r y);
  q3527205_zero_smul :
    forall x : M,
      q3527205_smul (q3527205_zero S) x = q3527205_mzero;
  q3527205_smul_zero :
    forall r : R,
      q3527205_smul r q3527205_mzero = q3527205_mzero
}.

Arguments q3527205_mzero {R S M} _.
Arguments q3527205_madd {R S M} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527205_smul {R S M} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q3527205_linear_combination
    {R M : Type}
    {S : q3527205_semiring R}
    (V : q3527205_module S M)
    {I : Type}
    (vectors : I -> M)
    (terms : list (I * R)) : M :=
  match terms with
  | nil => q3527205_mzero V
  | (i, r) :: rest =>
      q3527205_madd V
        (q3527205_smul V r (vectors i))
        (q3527205_linear_combination V vectors rest)
  end.

Definition q3527205_exact_finite_support
    {R : Type}
    {S : q3527205_semiring R}
    {I : Type}
    (coefficients : I -> R)
    (terms : list (I * R)) : Prop :=
  NoDup (map (@fst I R) terms) /\
  Forall
    (fun term => snd term = coefficients (fst term))
    terms /\
  forall i : I,
    In i (map (@fst I R) terms) <->
    coefficients i <> q3527205_zero S.

Definition q3527205_represents
    {R M : Type}
    {S : q3527205_semiring R}
    (V : q3527205_module S M)
    {I : Type}
    (vectors : I -> M)
    (x : M)
  (coefficients : I -> R) : Prop :=
  exists terms : list (I * R),
    @q3527205_exact_finite_support R S I coefficients terms /\
    q3527205_linear_combination V vectors terms = x.

Record q3527205_basis
    {R M : Type}
    {S : q3527205_semiring R}
    (V : q3527205_module S M)
    (I : Type) : Type := {
  q3527205_basis_vector : I -> M;
  q3527205_basis_representation :
    forall x : M,
      exists coefficients : I -> R,
        q3527205_represents
          V q3527205_basis_vector x coefficients /\
        forall other : I -> R,
          q3527205_represents
            V q3527205_basis_vector x other ->
          forall i : I, other i = coefficients i
}.

Arguments q3527205_basis_vector {R M S V I} _ _.

Record q3527205_fin_linear_equiv
    {R : Type}
    (S : q3527205_semiring R)
    (n m : nat) : Type := {
  q3527205_fin_forward : (Fin.t n -> R) -> (Fin.t m -> R);
  q3527205_fin_backward : (Fin.t m -> R) -> (Fin.t n -> R);
  q3527205_fin_forward_add :
    forall (x y : Fin.t n -> R) (i : Fin.t m),
      q3527205_fin_forward
        (fun j => q3527205_add S (x j) (y j)) i =
      q3527205_add S
        (q3527205_fin_forward x i)
        (q3527205_fin_forward y i);
  q3527205_fin_forward_smul :
    forall (r : R) (x : Fin.t n -> R) (i : Fin.t m),
      q3527205_fin_forward
        (fun j => q3527205_mul S r (x j)) i =
      q3527205_mul S r (q3527205_fin_forward x i);
  q3527205_fin_left_inverse :
    forall (x : Fin.t n -> R) (i : Fin.t n),
      q3527205_fin_backward (q3527205_fin_forward x) i = x i;
  q3527205_fin_right_inverse :
    forall (y : Fin.t m -> R) (i : Fin.t m),
      q3527205_fin_forward (q3527205_fin_backward y) i = y i
}.

Record q3527205_invariant_basis_number
    {R : Type}
    (S : q3527205_semiring R) : Prop := {
  q3527205_eq_of_fin_equiv :
    forall n m : nat,
      q3527205_fin_linear_equiv S n m -> n = m
}.

Definition q3527205_bijection (A B : Type) : Prop :=
  exists (forward : A -> B) (backward : B -> A),
    (forall x : A, backward (forward x) = x) /\
    (forall y : B, forward (backward y) = y).

Theorem mk_eq_mk_of_basis :
  forall (R M I I' : Type)
         (S : q3527205_semiring R)
         (V : q3527205_module S M)
         (v : q3527205_basis V I)
         (v' : q3527205_basis V I'),
    q3527205_invariant_basis_number S ->
    q3527205_bijection I I'.
Admitted.

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527205,
  canonical artifact thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527205, "Dimension theorem
  for vector spaces": over a semiring with invariant basis number, any two
  indexed bases of the same semimodule have equipotent index types. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
  imports Main
begin

definition q3527205_module ::
    "('r::semiring_1 \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527205_module smult \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. smult a (x + y) = smult a x + smult a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a + b) x = smult a x + smult b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smult 0 x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. smult a 0 = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. smult (a * b) x = smult a (smult b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. smult 1 x = x)"

definition q3527205_finitely_supported ::
    "('i \<Rightarrow> 'r::zero) set" where
  "q3527205_finitely_supported =
    {c. finite {i. c i \<noteq> 0}}"

definition q3527205_linear_combination ::
    "('r::semiring_1 \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> 'm" where
  "q3527205_linear_combination smult b c =
    (\<Sum>i\<in>{i. c i \<noteq> 0}. smult (c i) (b i))"

definition q3527205_basis ::
    "('r::semiring_1 \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'm) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527205_basis smult b \<longleftrightarrow>
    bij_betw (q3527205_linear_combination smult b)
      q3527205_finitely_supported UNIV"

definition q3527205_free_vectors ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'r::semiring_1) set" where
  "q3527205_free_vectors n =
    {x. \<forall>i. n \<le> i \<longrightarrow> x i = 0}"

definition q3527205_free_linear_equiv ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      ((nat \<Rightarrow> 'r::semiring_1) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'r)) \<Rightarrow>
      bool" where
  "q3527205_free_linear_equiv n m f \<longleftrightarrow>
    bij_betw f (q3527205_free_vectors n) (q3527205_free_vectors m) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>q3527205_free_vectors n.
      \<forall>y\<in>q3527205_free_vectors n.
        f (\<lambda>i. x i + y i) = (\<lambda>i. f x i + f y i)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>x\<in>q3527205_free_vectors n.
      f (\<lambda>i. a * x i) = (\<lambda>i. a * f x i))"

definition q3527205_invariant_basis_number ::
    "'r::semiring_1 itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527205_invariant_basis_number TYPE('r) \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>n m.
      (\<exists>f :: (nat \<Rightarrow> 'r) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'r).
        q3527205_free_linear_equiv n m f) \<longrightarrow>
      n = m)"

theorem mk_eq_mk_of_basis:
  fixes smult :: "'r::semiring_1 \<Rightarrow> 'm::comm_monoid_add \<Rightarrow> 'm"
    and v :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'm"
    and v' :: "'j \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  assumes module: "q3527205_module smult"
    and invariant_basis_number:
      "q3527205_invariant_basis_number TYPE('r)"
    and basis_v: "q3527205_basis smult v"
    and basis_v': "q3527205_basis smult v'"
  shows "ordIso2 (card_of (UNIV :: 'i set)) (card_of (UNIV :: 'j set))"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527205,
  "Dimension theorem for vector spaces": over a semiring with invariant basis
  number, any two bases of the same module have equipotent index types. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3527205_DIMENSION_THEOREM_FOR_VECTOR_SPACES =
  `let is_semiring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R).
       (!a:R. addR zeroR a = a /\ addR a zeroR = a) /\
       (!a b:R. addR a b = addR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
       (!a:R. mulR oneR a = a /\ mulR a oneR = a) /\
       (!a b c:R. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) /\
       (!a:R. mulR zeroR a = zeroR /\ mulR a zeroR = zeroR) in
   let is_module =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (zeroM:M) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M).
       (!x:M. addM zeroM x = x /\ addM x zeroM = x) /\
       (!x y:M. addM x y = addM y x) /\
       (!x y z:M. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) /\
       (!x:M. smul zeroR x = zeroM) /\
       (!a:R. smul a zeroM = zeroM) /\
       (!x:M. smul oneR x = x) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:M.
          smul (addR a b) x = addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:R. !x y:M.
          smul a (addM x y) = addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a b:R. !x:M.
          smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) in
   let finite_tuple =
     \(zeroR:R) (n:num) (x:num->R).
       !i:num. n <= i ==> x i = zeroR in
   let finite_free_linear_equiv =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (n:num) (m:num) (f:(num->R)->(num->R)).
       (!x:num->R.
          finite_tuple zeroR n x
          ==> finite_tuple zeroR m (f x)) /\
       (!x y:num->R.
          finite_tuple zeroR n x /\ finite_tuple zeroR n y
          ==> f (\i:num. addR (x i) (y i)) =
              (\i:num. addR (f x i) (f y i))) /\
       (!a:R. !x:num->R.
          finite_tuple zeroR n x
          ==> f (\i:num. mulR a (x i)) =
              (\i:num. mulR a (f x i))) /\
       (!y:num->R.
          finite_tuple zeroR m y
          ==> ?!x:num->R.
                finite_tuple zeroR n x /\ f x = y) in
   let invariant_basis_number =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R).
       !n m:num.
         (?f:(num->R)->(num->R).
            finite_free_linear_equiv zeroR addR mulR n m f)
         ==> n = m in
   let is_basisI =
     \(zeroR:R) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M)
      (index:I->bool) (basis:I->M).
       !x:M.
         ?!c:I->R.
           FINITE {i:I | ~(c i = zeroR)} /\
           {i:I | ~(c i = zeroR)} SUBSET index /\
           x = iterate addM {i:I | ~(c i = zeroR)}
                 (\i:I. smul (c i) (basis i)) in
   let is_basisJ =
     \(zeroR:R) (addM:M->M->M) (smul:R->M->M)
      (index:J->bool) (basis:J->M).
       !x:M.
         ?!c:J->R.
           FINITE {j:J | ~(c j = zeroR)} /\
           {j:J | ~(c j = zeroR)} SUBSET index /\
           x = iterate addM {j:J | ~(c j = zeroR)}
                 (\j:J. smul (c j) (basis j)) in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !zeroM:M.
   !addM:M->M->M.
   !smul:R->M->M.
   !indexI:I->bool.
   !indexJ:J->bool.
   !basisI:I->M.
   !basisJ:J->M.
     is_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
     is_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM smul /\
     invariant_basis_number zeroR addR mulR /\
     is_basisI zeroR addM smul indexI basisI /\
     is_basisJ zeroR addM smul indexJ basisJ
     ==> indexI =_c indexJ`;;

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527205,
;; "Dimension theorem for vector spaces": any two bases of the same module
;; over a semiring with invariant basis number have equinumerous index types.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, operations, and maps are tame APPLY$ function objects.
;; DEFUN-SK keeps all element, finite-free-module, and bijection quantifiers
;; inside the statement.

(defun q3527205-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun q3527205-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q3527205-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Semirings, including the trivial semiring allowed by Lean's Semiring class.

(defun-sk q3527205-semiring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527205-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527205-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527205-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (q3527205-member-p
       carrier (q3527205-binary-value add x y))
      (q3527205-member-p
       carrier (q3527205-binary-value multiply x y))
      (equal
       (q3527205-binary-value
        add (q3527205-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q3527205-binary-value
        add x (q3527205-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal
       (q3527205-binary-value add x y)
       (q3527205-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (q3527205-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q3527205-binary-value
        multiply (q3527205-binary-value multiply x y) z)
       (q3527205-binary-value
        multiply x (q3527205-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal (q3527205-binary-value multiply one x) x)
      (equal (q3527205-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (equal
       (q3527205-binary-value
        multiply x (q3527205-binary-value add y z))
       (q3527205-binary-value
        add
        (q3527205-binary-value multiply x y)
        (q3527205-binary-value multiply x z)))
      (equal
       (q3527205-binary-value
        multiply (q3527205-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q3527205-binary-value
        add
        (q3527205-binary-value multiply x z)
        (q3527205-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal (q3527205-binary-value multiply zero x) zero)
      (equal (q3527205-binary-value multiply x zero) zero)))))

(defun q3527205-semiring-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (q3527205-member-p carrier zero)
   (q3527205-member-p carrier one)
   (q3527205-semiring-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply)))

;; Additive commutative monoids with a semiring action.

(defun-sk q3527205-module-laws-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add smul)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p carrier u)
       (q3527205-member-p carrier v)
       (q3527205-member-p carrier w))
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p
        carrier (q3527205-binary-value add u v))
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value
         add (q3527205-binary-value add u v) w)
        (q3527205-binary-value
         add u (q3527205-binary-value add v w)))
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value add u v)
        (q3527205-binary-value add v u))
       (equal (q3527205-binary-value add u zero) u)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p scalar-carrier a)
       (q3527205-member-p scalar-carrier b)
       (q3527205-member-p carrier u)
       (q3527205-member-p carrier v))
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p
        carrier (q3527205-binary-value smul a u))
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value smul scalar-one u)
        u)
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value
         smul (q3527205-binary-value scalar-multiply a b) u)
        (q3527205-binary-value
         smul a (q3527205-binary-value smul b u)))
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value
         smul (q3527205-binary-value scalar-add a b) u)
        (q3527205-binary-value
         add
         (q3527205-binary-value smul a u)
         (q3527205-binary-value smul b u)))
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value
         smul a (q3527205-binary-value add u v))
        (q3527205-binary-value
         add
         (q3527205-binary-value smul a u)
         (q3527205-binary-value smul a v)))
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value smul a zero)
        zero)
       (equal
        (q3527205-binary-value smul scalar-zero u)
        zero))))))

(defun q3527205-module-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add smul)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp smul)
   (q3527205-member-p carrier zero)
   (q3527205-module-laws-p
    scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
    carrier zero add smul)))

;; A canonical finite-support coordinate vector is a sorted list of
;; (index coefficient) pairs with distinct indices and nonzero coefficients.

(defun q3527205-sparse-entry-p
    (entry index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
  (and
   (true-listp entry)
   (equal (len entry) 2)
   (q3527205-member-p index-carrier (nth 0 entry))
   (q3527205-member-p scalar-carrier (nth 1 entry))
   (not (equal (nth 1 entry) scalar-zero))))

(defun q3527205-sparse-entries-p
    (entries index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
  (if (consp entries)
      (and
       (q3527205-sparse-entry-p
        (car entries) index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
       (q3527205-sparse-entries-p
        (cdr entries) index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero))
    (equal entries nil)))

(defun q3527205-sparse-sorted-p (entries)
  (if (and (consp entries) (consp (cdr entries)))
      (and
       (not
        (equal
         (nth 0 (car entries))
         (nth 0 (cadr entries))))
       (lexorder
        (nth 0 (car entries))
        (nth 0 (cadr entries)))
       (q3527205-sparse-sorted-p (cdr entries)))
    t))

(defun q3527205-sparse-vector-p
    (vector index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
  (and
   (true-listp vector)
   (q3527205-sparse-entries-p
    vector index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal (strip-cars vector))
   (q3527205-sparse-sorted-p vector)))

(defun q3527205-coordinate-value
    (vector index scalar-zero)
  (let ((entry (assoc-equal index vector)))
    (if entry (nth 1 entry) scalar-zero)))

;; A basis package is (index-carrier coordinates realize).  COORDINATES and
;; REALIZE are inverse maps between the module and canonical finite-support
;; coordinate vectors, and COORDINATES is linear.

(defun q3527205-basis-index-carrier (basis)
  (nth 0 basis))

(defun q3527205-basis-coordinates (basis)
  (nth 1 basis))

(defun q3527205-basis-realize (basis)
  (nth 2 basis))

(defun-sk q3527205-basis-laws-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
     module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul
     index-carrier coordinates realize)
  (forall (a u v coordinate index)
    (and
     (equal
      (q3527205-unary-value coordinates module-zero)
      nil)
     (implies
      (q3527205-member-p module-carrier u)
      (and
       (q3527205-sparse-vector-p
        (q3527205-unary-value coordinates u)
        index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
       (equal
        (q3527205-unary-value
         realize (q3527205-unary-value coordinates u))
        u)))
     (implies
      (q3527205-sparse-vector-p
       coordinate index-carrier scalar-carrier scalar-zero)
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p
        module-carrier
        (q3527205-unary-value realize coordinate))
       (equal
        (q3527205-unary-value
         coordinates
         (q3527205-unary-value realize coordinate))
        coordinate)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p module-carrier u)
       (q3527205-member-p module-carrier v)
       (q3527205-member-p index-carrier index))
      (equal
       (q3527205-coordinate-value
        (q3527205-unary-value
         coordinates
         (q3527205-binary-value module-add u v))
        index scalar-zero)
       (q3527205-binary-value
        scalar-add
        (q3527205-coordinate-value
         (q3527205-unary-value coordinates u)
         index scalar-zero)
        (q3527205-coordinate-value
         (q3527205-unary-value coordinates v)
         index scalar-zero))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p scalar-carrier a)
       (q3527205-member-p module-carrier u)
       (q3527205-member-p index-carrier index))
      (equal
       (q3527205-coordinate-value
        (q3527205-unary-value
         coordinates
         (q3527205-binary-value module-smul a u))
        index scalar-zero)
       (q3527205-binary-value
        scalar-multiply
        a
        (q3527205-coordinate-value
         (q3527205-unary-value coordinates u)
         index scalar-zero)))))))

(defun q3527205-basis-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
     module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul basis)
  (let ((index-carrier
         (q3527205-basis-index-carrier basis))
        (coordinates
         (q3527205-basis-coordinates basis))
        (realize
         (q3527205-basis-realize basis)))
    (and
     (true-listp basis)
     (equal (len basis) 3)
     (tamep-functionp index-carrier)
     (tamep-functionp coordinates)
     (tamep-functionp realize)
     (q3527205-basis-laws-p
      scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
      module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul
      index-carrier coordinates realize))))

;; Finite free modules R^N are canonical scalar lists of length N.

(defun q3527205-all-members-p (carrier objects)
  (if (consp objects)
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p carrier (car objects))
       (q3527205-all-members-p carrier (cdr objects)))
    (equal objects nil)))

(defun q3527205-scalar-vector-p
    (vector length scalar-carrier)
  (and
   (natp length)
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) length)
   (q3527205-all-members-p scalar-carrier vector)))

(defun q3527205-zero-vector (length scalar-zero)
  (if (zp length)
      nil
    (cons
     scalar-zero
     (q3527205-zero-vector (- length 1) scalar-zero))))

(defun q3527205-vector-add (add left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (q3527205-binary-value add (car left) (car right))
       (q3527205-vector-add add (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun q3527205-vector-smul (multiply scalar vector)
  (if (consp vector)
      (cons
       (q3527205-binary-value multiply scalar (car vector))
       (q3527205-vector-smul multiply scalar (cdr vector)))
    nil))

(defun-sk q3527205-finite-linear-equiv-laws-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
     source-length target-length forward inverse)
  (forall (a x z y w)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
       x source-length scalar-carrier)
      (and
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        (q3527205-unary-value forward x)
        target-length scalar-carrier)
       (equal
        (q3527205-unary-value
         inverse (q3527205-unary-value forward x))
        x)))
     (implies
      (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
       y target-length scalar-carrier)
      (and
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        (q3527205-unary-value inverse y)
        source-length scalar-carrier)
       (equal
        (q3527205-unary-value
         forward (q3527205-unary-value inverse y))
        y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        x source-length scalar-carrier)
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        z source-length scalar-carrier))
      (equal
       (q3527205-unary-value
        forward (q3527205-vector-add scalar-add x z))
       (q3527205-vector-add
        scalar-add
        (q3527205-unary-value forward x)
        (q3527205-unary-value forward z))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        y target-length scalar-carrier)
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        w target-length scalar-carrier))
      (equal
       (q3527205-unary-value
        inverse (q3527205-vector-add scalar-add y w))
       (q3527205-vector-add
        scalar-add
        (q3527205-unary-value inverse y)
        (q3527205-unary-value inverse w))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p scalar-carrier a)
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        x source-length scalar-carrier))
      (equal
       (q3527205-unary-value
        forward
        (q3527205-vector-smul scalar-multiply a x))
       (q3527205-vector-smul
        scalar-multiply a
        (q3527205-unary-value forward x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p scalar-carrier a)
       (q3527205-scalar-vector-p
        y target-length scalar-carrier))
      (equal
       (q3527205-unary-value
        inverse
        (q3527205-vector-smul scalar-multiply a y))
       (q3527205-vector-smul
        scalar-multiply a
        (q3527205-unary-value inverse y)))))))

(defun q3527205-finite-linear-equiv-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
     source-length target-length forward inverse)
  (and
   (natp source-length)
   (natp target-length)
   (tamep-functionp forward)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q3527205-finite-linear-equiv-laws-p
    scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
    source-length target-length forward inverse)))

;; Invariant basis number: linearly equivalent finite free modules R^M and
;; R^N have equal finite ranks.

(defun-sk q3527205-invariant-basis-number-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply)
  (forall (m n forward inverse)
    (implies
     (q3527205-finite-linear-equiv-p
      scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
      m n forward inverse)
     (equal m n))))

;; Lifted cardinal equality is the internal existence of a bijection between
;; the two arbitrary index carriers.

(defun-sk q3527205-bijection-laws-p
    (source target forward inverse)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527205-member-p source x)
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p
        target (q3527205-unary-value forward x))
       (equal
        (q3527205-unary-value
         inverse (q3527205-unary-value forward x))
        x)))
     (implies
      (q3527205-member-p target y)
      (and
       (q3527205-member-p
        source (q3527205-unary-value inverse y))
       (equal
        (q3527205-unary-value
         forward (q3527205-unary-value inverse y))
        y))))))

(defun q3527205-bijection-p
    (source target forward inverse)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp source)
   (tamep-functionp target)
   (tamep-functionp forward)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q3527205-bijection-laws-p
    source target forward inverse)))

(defun-sk q3527205-bijection-exists-p (source target)
  (exists (forward inverse)
    (q3527205-bijection-p
     source target forward inverse)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3527205-dimension-theorem-statement
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul
     basis-left basis-right)
  (implies
   (and
    (q3527205-semiring-p
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply)
    (q3527205-invariant-basis-number-p
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply)
    (q3527205-module-p
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul)
    (q3527205-basis-p
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
     module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul basis-left)
    (q3527205-basis-p
     scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-add scalar-multiply
     module-carrier module-zero module-add module-smul basis-right))
   (q3527205-bijection-exists-p
    (q3527205-basis-index-carrier basis-left)
    (q3527205-basis-index-carrier basis-right))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527205,
-- "Dimension theorem for vector spaces": over a semiring with invariant basis
-- number, any two bases of the same module have equipotent index types. This
-- file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  first : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  next  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward :
      A -> B
    backward :
      B -> A
    backward-forward :
      (x : A) ->
      backward (forward x) == x
    forward-backward :
      (y : B) ->
      forward (backward y) == y

record Semiring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR zeroR x == zeroR
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record AdditiveCommutativeMonoid
  {m : Level}
  (M : Set m) :
  Set m where

  field
    zeroM : M
    addM : M -> M -> M

    add-associative :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z == addM x (addM y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y == addM y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : M) ->
      addM zeroM x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM == x

record Module
  {r m : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (ring : Semiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M) :
  Set (r ⊔ m) where

  field
    scale :
      R -> M -> M
    one-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Semiring.oneR ring) x == x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) ->
      scale (Semiring.multiplyR ring a b) x ==
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scale :
      (a b : R) (x : M) ->
      scale (Semiring.addR ring a b) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale b x)
    scale-add :
      (a : R) (x y : M) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive x y) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale a y)
    zero-scale :
      (x : M) ->
      scale (Semiring.zeroR ring) x ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive
    scale-zero :
      (a : R) ->
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive) ==
      AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroM additive

record FiniteCoefficients
  {r i : Level}
  (I : Set i)
  (R : Set r)
  (ring : Semiring R) :
  Set (r ⊔ i) where

  field
    value :
      I -> R
    support-size :
      Nat
    support :
      Fin support-size -> I
    zero-outside-support :
      (index : I) ->
      Not
        (Σ (Fin support-size)
          (\ position -> support position == index)) ->
      value index == Semiring.zeroR ring

CoefficientsEqual :
  {r i : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {ring : Semiring R} ->
  FiniteCoefficients I R ring ->
  FiniteCoefficients I R ring ->
  Set (r ⊔ i)
CoefficientsEqual {I = I} left right =
  (index : I) ->
  FiniteCoefficients.value left index ==
  FiniteCoefficients.value right index

record Basis
  {r m i : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {M : Set m}
  (I : Set i)
  (ring : Semiring R)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M)
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) :
  Set (r ⊔ m ⊔ i) where

  field
    coordinates :
      M -> FiniteCoefficients I R ring
    rebuild :
      FiniteCoefficients I R ring -> M
    coordinates-after-rebuild :
      (coefficients : FiniteCoefficients I R ring) ->
      CoefficientsEqual
        (coordinates (rebuild coefficients))
        coefficients
    rebuild-after-coordinates :
      (x : M) ->
      rebuild (coordinates x) == x
    rebuild-congruent :
      (left right : FiniteCoefficients I R ring) ->
      CoefficientsEqual left right ->
      rebuild left == rebuild right
    coordinates-add :
      (x y : M) ->
      (index : I) ->
      FiniteCoefficients.value
        (coordinates
          (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addM additive x y))
        index ==
      Semiring.addR ring
        (FiniteCoefficients.value (coordinates x) index)
        (FiniteCoefficients.value (coordinates y) index)
    coordinates-scale :
      (scalar : R) ->
      (x : M) ->
      (index : I) ->
      FiniteCoefficients.value
        (coordinates (Module.scale module-structure scalar x))
        index ==
      Semiring.multiplyR ring scalar
        (FiniteCoefficients.value (coordinates x) index)

PointwiseEqual :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
PointwiseEqual {A = A} f g =
  (x : A) -> f x == g x

PowerVector :
  {r : Level} ->
  Set r ->
  Nat ->
  Set r
PowerVector R n =
  Fin n -> R

record PowerLinearEquivalence
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : Semiring R)
  (n m : Nat) :
  Set r where

  field
    forward :
      PowerVector R n -> PowerVector R m
    backward :
      PowerVector R m -> PowerVector R n
    forward-congruent :
      (x y : PowerVector R n) ->
      PointwiseEqual x y ->
      PointwiseEqual (forward x) (forward y)
    backward-congruent :
      (x y : PowerVector R m) ->
      PointwiseEqual x y ->
      PointwiseEqual (backward x) (backward y)
    backward-forward :
      (x : PowerVector R n) ->
      PointwiseEqual (backward (forward x)) x
    forward-backward :
      (y : PowerVector R m) ->
      PointwiseEqual (forward (backward y)) y
    forward-add :
      (x y : PowerVector R n) ->
      PointwiseEqual
        (forward
          (\ i -> Semiring.addR ring (x i) (y i)))
        (\ j ->
          Semiring.addR ring (forward x j) (forward y j))
    forward-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : PowerVector R n) ->
      PointwiseEqual
        (forward
          (\ i -> Semiring.multiplyR ring a (x i)))
        (\ j ->
          Semiring.multiplyR ring a (forward x j))

record InvariantBasisNumber
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (ring : Semiring R) :
  Set r where

  field
    finite-free-ranks-unique :
      (n m : Nat) ->
      PowerLinearEquivalence ring n m ->
      n == m

dimension-theorem-for-vector-spaces : Setω
dimension-theorem-for-vector-spaces =
  {r m i j : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (ring : Semiring R) ->
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M) ->
  (module-structure : Module ring additive) ->
  InvariantBasisNumber ring ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (J : Set j) ->
  (first-basis : Basis I ring additive module-structure) ->
  (second-basis : Basis J ring additive module-structure) ->
  Bijection I J

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527205, "Dimension theorem for vector spaces": over a semiring with
  invariant basis number, any two bases of the same module have equipotent
  index carriers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q3527205_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q3527205_semiring_def",
  ``q3527205_semiring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
      (!a. mulR a oneR = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR zeroR a = zeroR) /\
      (!a. mulR a zeroR = zeroR)``);

val q3527205_module_def = new_definition (
  "q3527205_module_def",
  ``q3527205_module
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!x y. addM x y = addM y x) /\
      (!x y z. addM (addM x y) z = addM x (addM y z)) /\
      (!x. addM zeroM x = x) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (addM x y) = addM (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (addR a b) x = addM (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (mulR a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!x. smul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x. smul zeroR x = zeroM) /\
      (!a. smul a zeroM = zeroM)``);

val q3527205_lincomb_def = new_definition (
  "q3527205_lincomb_def",
  ``q3527205_lincomb
      (zeroR : 'r) (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (basis : 'i -> 'm) (coeff : 'i -> 'r) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc. addM (smul (coeff i) (basis i)) acc)
        {i | coeff i <> zeroR}
        zeroM``);

val q3527205_basis_def = new_definition (
  "q3527205_basis_def",
  ``q3527205_basis
      (zeroR : 'r) (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (basis : 'i -> 'm) <=>
      (!coeff coeff' : 'i -> 'r.
        FINITE {i | coeff i <> zeroR} /\
        FINITE {i | coeff' i <> zeroR} /\
        q3527205_lincomb zeroR zeroM addM smul basis coeff =
          q3527205_lincomb zeroR zeroM addM smul basis coeff'
        ==>
        coeff = coeff') /\
      (!x : 'm.
        ?coeff : 'i -> 'r.
          FINITE {i | coeff i <> zeroR} /\
          q3527205_lincomb zeroR zeroM addM smul basis coeff = x)``);

val q3527205_fin_linear_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q3527205_fin_linear_equiv_def",
  ``q3527205_fin_linear_equiv
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (n : num) (m : num)
      (f : 'r list -> 'r list) (g : 'r list -> 'r list) <=>
      (!xs. LENGTH xs = n ==> LENGTH (f xs) = m) /\
      (!ys. LENGTH ys = m ==> LENGTH (g ys) = n) /\
      f (REPLICATE n zeroR) = REPLICATE m zeroR /\
      (!xs ys.
        LENGTH xs = n /\ LENGTH ys = n
        ==>
        f (MAP2 addR xs ys) = MAP2 addR (f xs) (f ys)) /\
      (!a xs.
        LENGTH xs = n
        ==>
        f (MAP (mulR a) xs) = MAP (mulR a) (f xs)) /\
      (!xs. LENGTH xs = n ==> g (f xs) = xs) /\
      (!ys. LENGTH ys = m ==> f (g ys) = ys)``);

val q3527205_invariant_basis_number_def = new_definition (
  "q3527205_invariant_basis_number_def",
  ``q3527205_invariant_basis_number
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      !n m f g.
        q3527205_fin_linear_equiv zeroR addR mulR n m f g
        ==>
        n = m``);

val mk_eq_mk_of_basis =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (zeroM : 'm) (addM : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (smul : 'r -> 'm -> 'm)
      (basis_i : 'i -> 'm) (basis_j : 'j -> 'm).
      q3527205_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
      q3527205_module zeroR oneR addR mulR zeroM addM smul /\
      q3527205_invariant_basis_number zeroR addR mulR /\
      q3527205_basis zeroR zeroM addM smul basis_i /\
      q3527205_basis zeroR zeroM addM smul basis_j
      ==>
      ?e : 'i -> 'j. BIJ e UNIV UNIV``;

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527205
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527205), "Dimension theorem for vector
  spaces": any two indexed bases of an arbitrary semimodule over a semiring
  with invariant basis number have equipollent index sets. This file contains
  no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's SLMod supplies arbitrary semimodules over arbitrary semirings.
  Q3527205FiniteSupport R I is the set of finitely supported coefficient
  functions from I to the carrier of R. Q3527205LinearEquiv R I J F says that
  F is a bijective additive and R-linear map between the corresponding free
  semimodules. Q3527205InvariantBasisNumber R is exactly the source property
  that linearly equivalent finite free R-semimodules have equal finite ranks.

  Q3527205IndexedBasis W I B says that B maps I into the carrier of W and that
  finite R-linear combination along B is a bijection onto W. This is the
  coefficient-map characterization of mathlib's Basis I R W. Equality of the
  lifted cardinals of I and J is rendered set-theoretically as equipollence
  I ~~ J.

  The final declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q3527205FiniteSupport Q3527205LinearEquiv Q3527205IndexedBasis
   Q3527205InvariantBasisNumber $.

q3527205-finite-support-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527205FiniteSupport R I ) $.

q3527205-linear-equiv-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527205LinearEquiv R I J F ) $.

q3527205-indexed-basis-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527205IndexedBasis W I B ) $.

q3527205-invariant-basis-number-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527205InvariantBasisNumber R ) $.

${
  $d I R f $.

  q3527205-finite-support-definition $a |- (
    Q3527205FiniteSupport R I
  ) = {
    f e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m I ) |
      f finSupp ( 0g ` R )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d F I J R a f g $.

  q3527205-linear-equiv-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527205LinearEquiv R I J F )
    <->
    (
      F :
        ( Q3527205FiniteSupport R I )
        -1-1-onto->
        ( Q3527205FiniteSupport R J )
      /\
      (
        A. f e. ( Q3527205FiniteSupport R I )
          A. g e. ( Q3527205FiniteSupport R I )
            (
              F ` ( f oF ( +g ` R ) g )
            )
            =
            (
              ( F ` f ) oF ( +g ` R ) ( F ` g )
            )
        /\
        A. a e. ( Base ` R )
          A. f e. ( Q3527205FiniteSupport R I )
            (
              F `
              (
                ( I X. { a } ) oF ( .r ` R ) f
              )
            )
            =
            (
              ( J X. { a } ) oF ( .r ` R ) ( F ` f )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B I W f $.

  q3527205-indexed-basis-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527205IndexedBasis W I B )
    <->
    (
      B : I --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      (
        f e. ( Q3527205FiniteSupport ( Scalar ` W ) I )
        |->
        (
          W gsum
          (
            f oF ( .s ` W ) B
          )
        )
      )
      :
      ( Q3527205FiniteSupport ( Scalar ` W ) I )
      -1-1-onto->
      ( Base ` W )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F R m n $.

  q3527205-invariant-basis-number-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527205InvariantBasisNumber R )
    <->
    (
      R e. SRing
      /\
      A. n e. NN0
        A. m e. NN0
          A. F
            (
              (
                Q3527205LinearEquiv
                R
                ( 0 ..^ n )
                ( 0 ..^ m )
                F
              )
              ->
              n = m
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B C I J R W $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527205-dimension-theorem-for-vector-spaces $a |- (
    A. R A. W A. I A. J A. B A. C
      (
        (
          (
            ( Q3527205InvariantBasisNumber R )
            /\
            (
              W e. SLMod
              /\
              ( Scalar ` W ) = R
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            ( Q3527205IndexedBasis W I B )
            /\
            ( Q3527205IndexedBasis W J C )
          )
        )
        ->
        I ~~ J
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems artifact Q3527205,
:: "Dimension theorem for vector spaces": two bases of the same semimodule
:: over an invariant-basis-number semiring have equal cardinality.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, CARD_1;
notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, CARD_1;
constructors RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ZFMISC_1, BINOP_1, FINSET_1,
      FINSEQ_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, CARD_1;
registrations XBOOLE_0, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1, FINSEQ_1,
      ORDINAL1, NAT_1, CARD_1;
requirements SUBSET, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R,M being non empty set,
      I,J being set,
      zeroR,oneR being Element of R,
      addR,mulR being BinOp of R,
      zeroM being Element of M,
      addM being BinOp of M,
      smul being Function of [:R,M:],M,
      v being Function of I,M,
      w being Function of J,M,
      reprV being Function of M,Funcs(I,R),
      reprW being Function of M,Funcs(J,R)
  st
    (for a,b being Element of R holds addR.(a,b) = addR.(b,a)) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      addR.(addR.(a,b),c) = addR.(a,addR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds addR.(a,zeroR) = a) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      mulR.(mulR.(a,b),c) = mulR.(a,mulR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      mulR.(oneR,a) = a & mulR.(a,oneR) = a) &
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,addR.(b,c)) = addR.(mulR.(a,b),mulR.(a,c)) &
      mulR.(addR.(a,b),c) = addR.(mulR.(a,c),mulR.(b,c))) &
    (for a being Element of R holds
      mulR.(a,zeroR) = zeroR & mulR.(zeroR,a) = zeroR) &
    (for x,y being Element of M holds addM.(x,y) = addM.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of M holds
      addM.(addM.(x,y),z) = addM.(x,addM.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of M holds addM.(x,zeroM) = x) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, x being Element of M holds
      smul.(addR.(a,b),x) = addM.(smul.(a,x),smul.(b,x))) &
    (for a being Element of R, x,y being Element of M holds
      smul.(a,addM.(x,y)) = addM.(smul.(a,x),smul.(a,y))) &
    (for a,b being Element of R, x being Element of M holds
      smul.(mulR.(a,b),x) = smul.(a,smul.(b,x))) &
    (for x being Element of M holds
      smul.(oneR,x) = x & smul.(zeroR,x) = zeroM) &
    (for a being Element of R holds smul.(a,zeroM) = zeroM) &
    (for m,n being Nat,
         F being Function of Funcs(Seg m,R),Funcs(Seg n,R),
         G being Function of Funcs(Seg n,R),Funcs(Seg m,R)
      st
        (for f being Function of Seg m,R holds G.(F.f) = f) &
        (for g being Function of Seg n,R holds F.(G.g) = g) &
        (for f,g,h being Function of Seg m,R,
             Ff,Fg,Fh being Function of Seg n,R st
          Ff = F.f & Fg = F.g & Fh = F.h &
          (for i being Nat st i in Seg m holds h.i = addR.(f.i,g.i))
          holds
            for j being Nat st j in Seg n holds
              Fh.j = addR.(Ff.j,Fg.j)) &
        (for a being Element of R,
             f,h being Function of Seg m,R,
             Ff,Fh being Function of Seg n,R st
          Ff = F.f & Fh = F.h &
          (for i being Nat st i in Seg m holds h.i = mulR.(a,f.i))
          holds
            for j being Nat st j in Seg n holds
              Fh.j = mulR.(a,Ff.j)) &
        (for f,g,h being Function of Seg n,R,
             Gf,Gg,Gh being Function of Seg m,R st
          Gf = G.f & Gg = G.g & Gh = G.h &
          (for j being Nat st j in Seg n holds h.j = addR.(f.j,g.j))
          holds
            for i being Nat st i in Seg m holds
              Gh.i = addR.(Gf.i,Gg.i)) &
        (for a being Element of R,
             f,h being Function of Seg n,R,
             Gf,Gh being Function of Seg m,R st
          Gf = G.f & Gh = G.h &
          (for j being Nat st j in Seg n holds h.j = mulR.(a,f.j))
          holds
            for i being Nat st i in Seg m holds
              Gh.i = mulR.(a,Gf.i))
      holds m = n) &
    (for x being Element of M holds

title: Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527205,
% "Dimension theorem for vector spaces": over a semiring with invariant basis
% number, any two bases of the same module have bijective index types. This file
% contains no proof.

Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces[
  R, M: TYPE+,
  I, J: TYPE,
  zeroR, oneR: R,
  addR, mulR: [R, R -> R],
  zeroM: M,
  addM: [M, M -> M],
  smul: [R, M -> M],
  basisI: [I -> M],
  basisJ: [J -> M]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  r_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> R]

  zero_sequence: r_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): zeroR

  sequence_add(x, y: r_sequence): r_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): addR(x(index), y(index))

  sequence_scale(a: R, x: r_sequence): r_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): mulR(a, x(index))

  supported_below(count: nat, x: r_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      count <= index IMPLIES x(index) = zeroR

  semiring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: R):
      addR(a, b) = addR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        addR(addR(a, b), c) = addR(a, addR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        addR(zeroR, a) = a
          AND addR(a, zeroR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(mulR(a, b), c) = mulR(a, mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(oneR, a) = a
          AND mulR(a, oneR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(a, addR(b, c)) =
          addR(mulR(a, b), mulR(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(addR(a, b), c) =
          addR(mulR(a, c), mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(zeroR, a) = zeroR
          AND mulR(a, zeroR) = zeroR)

  module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      addM(x, y) = addM(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
        addM(addM(x, y), z) = addM(x, addM(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        addM(zeroM, x) = x
          AND addM(x, zeroM) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
        smul(mulR(a, b), x) = smul(a, smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        smul(oneR, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R), (x: M):
        smul(addR(a, b), x) =
          addM(smul(a, x), smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (x, y: M):
        smul(a, addM(x, y)) =
          addM(smul(a, x), smul(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: M):
        smul(zeroR, x) = zeroM)
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        smul(a, zeroM) = zeroM)

  finite_free_linear(
      source_size, target_size: nat,
      map: [r_sequence -> r_sequence]): bool =
    map(zero_sequence) = zero_sequence
      AND (FORALL (x: r_sequence):
        supported_below(source_size, x)
          IMPLIES supported_below(target_size, map(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: r_sequence):
        supported_below(source_size, x)
          AND supported_below(source_size, y)
        IMPLIES
          map(sequence_add(x, y)) =
            sequence_add(map(x), map(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R), (x: r_sequence):
        supported_below(source_size, x)
        IMPLIES
          map(sequence_scale(a, x)) =
            sequence_scale(a, map(x)))

  finite_free_isomorphism(
      source_size, target_size: nat,
      map: [r_sequence -> r_sequence]): bool =
    finite_free_linear(source_size, target_size, map)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: r_sequence):
        supported_below(source_size, x)
          AND supported_below(source_size, y)
          AND map(x) = map(y)
        IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (y: r_sequence):
        supported_below(target_size, y)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: r_sequence):
            supported_below(source_size, x)
              AND map(x) = y)

  invariant_basis_number: bool =
    zeroR /= oneR
      AND (FORALL (source_size, target_size: nat):
        (EXISTS (map: [r_sequence -> r_sequence]):
          finite_free_isomorphism(
            source_size, target_size, map))
        IMPLIES source_size = target_size)

  member_I(index: I, indices: list[I]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        index = head OR member_I(index, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  no_duplicates_I(indices: list[I]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT member_I(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicates_I(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  finitely_supported_I(
      coefficients: [I -> R],
      support: list[I]): bool =
    no_duplicates_I(support)
      AND (FORALL (index: I):
        coefficients(index) /= zeroR
          IFF member_I(index, support))

  linear_combination_I(
      coefficients: [I -> R],
      support: list[I]): RECURSIVE M =
    CASES support OF
      null: zeroM,
      cons(head, tail):
        addM(
          smul(coefficients(head), basisI(head)),
          linear_combination_I(coefficients, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE support BY <<

  is_basis_I: bool =
    FORALL (x: M):
      EXISTS (coefficients: [I -> R]), (support: list[I]):
        finitely_supported_I(coefficients, support)
          AND linear_combination_I(coefficients, support) = x
          AND (FORALL
              (other_coefficients: [I -> R]),
              (other_support: list[I]):
            finitely_supported_I(
              other_coefficients, other_support)
              AND linear_combination_I(
                other_coefficients, other_support) = x
            IMPLIES other_coefficients = coefficients)

  member_J(index: J, indices: list[J]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        index = head OR member_J(index, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  no_duplicates_J(indices: list[J]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT member_J(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicates_J(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  finitely_supported_J(
      coefficients: [J -> R],
      support: list[J]): bool =
    no_duplicates_J(support)
      AND (FORALL (index: J):
        coefficients(index) /= zeroR
          IFF member_J(index, support))

  linear_combination_J(
      coefficients: [J -> R],
      support: list[J]): RECURSIVE M =
    CASES support OF
      null: zeroM,
      cons(head, tail):
        addM(
          smul(coefficients(head), basisJ(head)),
          linear_combination_J(coefficients, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE support BY <<

  is_basis_J: bool =
    FORALL (x: M):
      EXISTS (coefficients: [J -> R]), (support: list[J]):
        finitely_supported_J(coefficients, support)
          AND linear_combination_J(coefficients, support) = x
          AND (FORALL
              (other_coefficients: [J -> R]),
              (other_support: list[J]):
            finitely_supported_J(
              other_coefficients, other_support)
              AND linear_combination_J(
                other_coefficients, other_support) = x
            IMPLIES other_coefficients = coefficients)

  bijective_index_map(map: [I -> J]): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: I):
      map(x) = map(y) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (y: J):
        EXISTS (x: I): map(x) = y)

  dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces: bool =
    (semiring_laws
      AND module_laws
      AND invariant_basis_number
      AND is_basis_I
      AND is_basis_J)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (index_equivalence: [I -> J]):
        bijective_index_map(index_equivalence)

END Q3527205_dimension_theorem_for_vector_spaces

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3527215
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3527215), "Hilbert projection theorem": every point
-- in a real inner product space has a nearest point in any nonempty complete convex set.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs

public section

namespace Q3527215

variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]

/-- A nonempty complete convex set contains a point attaining the infimum of the distance
from any point in the ambient real inner product space. -/
theorem exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex {K : Set F} (ne : K.Nonempty)
    (h₁ : IsComplete K) (h₂ : Convex ℝ K) :
    ∀ u : F, ∃ v ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ = ⨅ w : K, ‖u - w‖ := sorry

title: Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527215
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527215), "Hilbert projection theorem": every
  point in a real inner-product space has a closest point in each nonempty
  complete convex subset, attaining the infimum of the distance.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q3527215_real_inner_product_space (F : Type) : Type := {
  q3527215_zero : F;
  q3527215_add : F -> F -> F;
  q3527215_neg : F -> F;
  q3527215_smul : R -> F -> F;
  q3527215_inner : F -> F -> R;

  q3527215_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : F,
      q3527215_add x (q3527215_add y z) =
      q3527215_add (q3527215_add x y) z;
  q3527215_add_comm :
    forall x y : F, q3527215_add x y = q3527215_add y x;
  q3527215_add_zero :
    forall x : F, q3527215_add x q3527215_zero = x;
  q3527215_add_neg :
    forall x : F,
      q3527215_add x (q3527215_neg x) = q3527215_zero;

  q3527215_one_smul :
    forall x : F, q3527215_smul 1 x = x;
  q3527215_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : F),
      q3527215_smul (a * b) x =
      q3527215_smul a (q3527215_smul b x);
  q3527215_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : F),
      q3527215_smul (a + b) x =
      q3527215_add
        (q3527215_smul a x) (q3527215_smul b x);
  q3527215_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : F),
      q3527215_smul a (q3527215_add x y) =
      q3527215_add
        (q3527215_smul a x) (q3527215_smul a y);
  q3527215_zero_smul :
    forall x : F, q3527215_smul 0 x = q3527215_zero;
  q3527215_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q3527215_smul a q3527215_zero = q3527215_zero;

  q3527215_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : F,
      q3527215_inner (q3527215_add x y) z =
      q3527215_inner x z + q3527215_inner y z;
  q3527215_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : F),
      q3527215_inner (q3527215_smul a x) y =
      a * q3527215_inner x y;
  q3527215_inner_symm :
    forall x y : F, q3527215_inner x y = q3527215_inner y x;
  q3527215_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : F, 0 <= q3527215_inner x x;
  q3527215_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : F,
      q3527215_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q3527215_zero
}.

Arguments q3527215_zero {F} _.
Arguments q3527215_add {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527215_neg {F} _ _.
Arguments q3527215_smul {F} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527215_inner {F} _ _ _.

Definition q3527215_sub
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (x y : F) : F :=
  q3527215_add H x (q3527215_neg H y).

Definition q3527215_norm
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (x : F) : R :=
  sqrt (q3527215_inner H x x).

Definition q3527215_sequence_converges
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (sequence : nat -> F)
    (limit : F) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q3527215_norm H
          (q3527215_sub H (sequence n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q3527215_sequence_cauchy
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (sequence : nat -> F) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q3527215_norm H
          (q3527215_sub H (sequence m) (sequence n)) < epsilon.

Definition q3527215_nonempty
    {F : Type}
    (K : F -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists x : F, K x.

Definition q3527215_is_complete
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (K : F -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall sequence : nat -> F,
    (forall n : nat, K (sequence n)) ->
    q3527215_sequence_cauchy H sequence ->
    exists limit : F,
      K limit /\
      q3527215_sequence_converges H sequence limit.

Definition q3527215_is_convex
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (K : F -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : F) (a b : R),
    K x ->
    K y ->
    0 <= a ->
    0 <= b ->
    a + b = 1 ->
    K
      (q3527215_add H
        (q3527215_smul H a x)
        (q3527215_smul H b y)).

Definition q3527215_is_distance_infimum
    {F : Type}
    (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
    (K : F -> Prop)
    (u : F)
    (distance_infimum : R) : Prop :=
  (forall w : F,
    K w ->
    distance_infimum <=
      q3527215_norm H (q3527215_sub H u w)) /\
  forall lower_bound : R,
    (forall w : F,
      K w ->
      lower_bound <=
        q3527215_norm H (q3527215_sub H u w)) ->
    lower_bound <= distance_infimum.

Theorem exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex :
  forall (F : Type)
         (H : q3527215_real_inner_product_space F)
         (K : F -> Prop),
    q3527215_nonempty K ->
    q3527215_is_complete H K ->
    q3527215_is_convex H K ->
    forall u : F,
      exists v : F,
        K v /\
        q3527215_is_distance_infimum H K u
          (q3527215_norm H (q3527215_sub H u v)).
Admitted.

title: Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527215,
  "Hilbert projection theorem": every point in a real inner-product space has
  a nearest point in each nonempty complete convex subset. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q3527215_HILBERT_PROJECTION_THEOREM =
 `let real_vector_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (smul:real->V->V).
      (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:V.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let real_inner_product =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V)
     (inner:V->V->real).
      (!x y z:V.
         inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:V.
         inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let induced_norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (norm:V->real).
      !x:V.
        &0 <= norm x /\
        norm x * norm x = inner x x in
  let sub =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (x:V) (y:V).
      add x (neg y) in
  let cauchy_sequence =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (norm:V->real)
     (s:num->V).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
              N <= m /\ N <= n
              ==> norm (sub add neg (s m) (s n)) < epsilon in
  let tends_to =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (norm:V->real)
     (s:num->V) (v:V).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
              N <= n
              ==> norm (sub add neg (s n) v) < epsilon in
  let complete_subset =
    \(add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V) (norm:V->real)
     (K:V->bool).
      !s:num->V.
        (!n:num. K (s n)) /\
        cauchy_sequence add neg norm s
        ==> ?v:V. K v /\ tends_to add neg norm s v in
  let convex_subset =
    \(add:V->V->V) (smul:real->V->V) (K:V->bool).
      !x y:V. !a b:real.
        K x /\ K y /\
        &0 <= a /\ &0 <= b /\ a + b = &1
        ==> K (add (smul a x) (smul b y)) in
  !zero:V. !add:V->V->V. !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V. !inner:V->V->real.
  !norm:V->real. !K:V->bool.
    real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
    real_inner_product zero add smul inner /\
    induced_norm inner norm /\
    (?x:V. K x) /\
    complete_subset add neg norm K /\
    convex_subset add smul K
    ==> !u:V.
          ?v:V.
            K v /\
            norm (sub add neg u v) =
              inf {d:real |
                     ?w:V.
                       K w /\ d = norm (sub add neg u w)}`;;
