content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527215,
;; "Hilbert projection theorem": every point in a real inner-product space has
;; a nearest point in each nonempty complete convex subset. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative application interfaces present arbitrary scalar and vector
;; carriers, operations, subsets, and sequences. The real scalars are encoded
;; as a Dedekind-complete ordered field. All typing, algebraic, order,
;; inner-product, convexity, and subset-completeness assumptions are explicit.
;;
;; Squared norms are used throughout. In a real inner-product space,
;; ||x|| <= ||y|| iff <x,x> <= <y,y>, so the final nearest-point condition is
;; equivalent to equality with the infimum in the Lean source.

(defstub q3527215-apply1 (function x) t)
(defstub q3527215-apply2 (function x y) t)

(defun q3527215-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (q3527215-apply1 carrier x) t nil))

;; A presentation of the real numbers as a complete ordered field.

(defun-sk q3527215-real-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527215-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527215-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q3527215-apply2 add x y))
            (yz-add (q3527215-apply2 add y z))
            (xy-multiply (q3527215-apply2 multiply x y))
            (yz-multiply (q3527215-apply2 multiply y z))
            (negative-x (q3527215-apply1 negate x))
            (inverse-x (q3527215-apply1 inverse x)))
       (and
        (q3527215-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q3527215-member-p carrier xy-multiply)
        (q3527215-member-p carrier negative-x)
        (q3527215-member-p carrier inverse-x)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 add xy-add z)
         (q3527215-apply2 add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3527215-apply2 add y x))
        (equal (q3527215-apply2 add x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 add x negative-x)
         zero)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 multiply xy-multiply z)
         (q3527215-apply2 multiply x yz-multiply))
        (equal
         xy-multiply
         (q3527215-apply2 multiply y x))
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 multiply x one)
         x)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply1 inverse zero)
         zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3527215-apply2 multiply x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 multiply x yz-add)
         (q3527215-apply2
          add
          (q3527215-apply2 multiply x y)
          (q3527215-apply2 multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-order-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527215-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527215-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q3527215-apply2 less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (q3527215-apply2 less x y)
       (q3527215-apply2 less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q3527215-apply2 less x y)
        (q3527215-apply2 less y z))
       (q3527215-apply2 less x z))
      (implies
       (q3527215-apply2 less x y)
       (q3527215-apply2
        less
        (q3527215-apply2 add x z)
        (q3527215-apply2 add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q3527215-apply2 less zero x)
        (q3527215-apply2 less zero y))
       (q3527215-apply2
        less
        zero
        (q3527215-apply2 multiply x y)))))))

(defun q3527215-real-leq-p (less left right)
  (not (q3527215-apply2 less right left)))

(defun q3527215-positive-real-p
    (carrier zero less value)
  (and
   (q3527215-member-p carrier value)
   (q3527215-apply2 less zero value)))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-set-valid-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527215-apply1 set x)
     (q3527215-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q3527215-member-p carrier x)
     (q3527215-apply1 set x))))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527215-apply1 set x))
     (q3527215-real-leq-p less x bound))))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3527215-member-p carrier bound)
     (q3527215-real-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p carrier bound)
      (q3527215-real-upper-bound-p
       carrier less set bound))
     (q3527215-real-leq-p less supremum bound))))

(defun q3527215-real-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (and
   (q3527215-member-p carrier supremum)
   (q3527215-real-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)
   (q3527215-real-least-upper-bound-p
    carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-supremum-exists-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q3527215-real-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527215-real-complete-p (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-real-set-valid-p carrier set)
      (q3527215-real-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q3527215-real-bounded-above-p
       carrier less set))
     (q3527215-real-supremum-exists-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q3527215-real-field-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse less)
  (and
   (q3527215-member-p carrier zero)
   (q3527215-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q3527215-apply2 less zero one)
   (q3527215-real-field-laws-p
    carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
   (q3527215-real-order-laws-p
    carrier zero add multiply less)
   (q3527215-real-complete-p carrier less)))

;; Real inner-product spaces. No completeness assumption is imposed on the
;; ambient vector space; the source assumes completeness only of the subset.

(defun-sk q3527215-vector-space-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-one real-add real-multiply
     space-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate scalar-multiply)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p real-carrier a)
      (q3527215-member-p real-carrier b)
      (q3527215-member-p space-carrier x)
      (q3527215-member-p space-carrier y)
      (q3527215-member-p space-carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q3527215-apply2 vector-add x y))
            (yz-add (q3527215-apply2 vector-add y z))
            (negative-x (q3527215-apply1 vector-negate x))
            (a-times-x
             (q3527215-apply2 scalar-multiply a x))
            (b-times-x
             (q3527215-apply2 scalar-multiply b x)))
       (and
        (q3527215-member-p space-carrier xy-add)
        (q3527215-member-p space-carrier negative-x)
        (q3527215-member-p space-carrier a-times-x)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 vector-add xy-add z)
         (q3527215-apply2 vector-add x yz-add))
        (equal
         xy-add
         (q3527215-apply2 vector-add y x))
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 vector-add x vector-zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 vector-add x negative-x)
         vector-zero)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2 scalar-multiply real-one x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2
          scalar-multiply
          (q3527215-apply2 real-multiply a b)
          x)
         (q3527215-apply2
          scalar-multiply a b-times-x))
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2
          scalar-multiply
          (q3527215-apply2 real-add a b)
          x)
         (q3527215-apply2
          vector-add a-times-x b-times-x))
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2
          scalar-multiply a xy-add)
         (q3527215-apply2
          vector-add
          a-times-x
          (q3527215-apply2
           scalar-multiply a y))))))))

(defun-sk q3527215-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
     space-carrier vector-zero vector-add scalar-multiply inner)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p real-carrier a)
      (q3527215-member-p space-carrier x)
      (q3527215-member-p space-carrier y)
      (q3527215-member-p space-carrier z))
     (let ((inner-xy (q3527215-apply2 inner x y))
           (inner-xx (q3527215-apply2 inner x x)))
       (and
        (q3527215-member-p real-carrier inner-xy)
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2
          inner
          (q3527215-apply2 vector-add x y)
          z)
         (q3527215-apply2
          real-add
          (q3527215-apply2 inner x z)
          (q3527215-apply2 inner y z)))
        (equal
         (q3527215-apply2
          inner
          (q3527215-apply2 scalar-multiply a x)
          y)
         (q3527215-apply2
          real-multiply a inner-xy))
        (equal
         inner-xy
         (q3527215-apply2 inner y x))
        (q3527215-real-leq-p
         real-less real-zero inner-xx)
        (iff
         (equal inner-xx real-zero)
         (equal x vector-zero)))))))

(defun q3527215-real-inner-product-space-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     space-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate
     scalar-multiply inner)
  (and
   (q3527215-real-field-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
    real-negate real-inverse real-less)
   (q3527215-member-p space-carrier vector-zero)
   (q3527215-vector-space-laws-p
    real-carrier real-one real-add real-multiply
    space-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate
    scalar-multiply)
   (q3527215-inner-product-laws-p
    real-carrier real-zero real-add real-multiply real-less
    space-carrier vector-zero vector-add scalar-multiply inner)))

(defun q3527215-vector-subtract
    (vector-add vector-negate x y)
  (q3527215-apply2
   vector-add x (q3527215-apply1 vector-negate y)))

(defun q3527215-norm-square
    (vector-add vector-negate inner x y)
  (let ((difference
         (q3527215-vector-subtract
          vector-add vector-negate x y)))
    (q3527215-apply2 inner difference difference)))

(defun q3527215-distance-lt-p
    (real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
     x y epsilon)
  (q3527215-apply2
   real-less
   (q3527215-norm-square
    vector-add vector-negate inner x y)
   (q3527215-apply2 real-multiply epsilon epsilon)))

;; Arbitrary subsets, convexity, and completeness in the induced norm metric.

(defun-sk q3527215-vector-set-valid-p
    (space-carrier subset)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527215-apply1 subset x)
     (q3527215-member-p space-carrier x))))

(defun-sk q3527215-vector-set-nonempty-p
    (space-carrier subset)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q3527215-member-p space-carrier x)
     (q3527215-apply1 subset x))))

(defun-sk q3527215-convex-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-less
     vector-add scalar-multiply subset)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-member-p real-carrier a)
      (q3527215-member-p real-carrier b)
      (q3527215-real-leq-p real-less real-zero a)
      (q3527215-real-leq-p real-less real-zero b)
      (equal
       (q3527215-apply2 real-add a b)
       real-one)
      (q3527215-apply1 subset x)
      (q3527215-apply1 subset y))
     (q3527215-apply1
      subset
      (q3527215-apply2
       vector-add
       (q3527215-apply2 scalar-multiply a x)
       (q3527215-apply2 scalar-multiply b y))))))

(defun-sk q3527215-subset-sequence-p (subset sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3527215-apply1
      subset (q3527215-apply1 sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q3527215-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
     sequence epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff m)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q3527215-distance-lt-p
      real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
      (q3527215-apply1 sequence m)
      (q3527215-apply1 sequence n)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527215-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
     sequence epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q3527215-cauchy-tail-p
      real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
      sequence epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q3527215-cauchy-sequence-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
     vector-add vector-negate inner sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q3527215-positive-real-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less epsilon)
     (q3527215-cauchy-cutoff-exists-p
      real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
      sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527215-convergence-tail-p
    (real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
     sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q3527215-distance-lt-p
      real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
      (q3527215-apply1 sequence n)
      limit
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527215-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
    (real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
     sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q3527215-convergence-tail-p
      real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
      sequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q3527215-sequence-converges-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
     vector-add vector-negate inner sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q3527215-positive-real-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-less epsilon)
     (q3527215-convergence-cutoff-exists-p
      real-multiply real-less vector-add vector-negate inner
      sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527215-subset-limit-exists-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
     vector-add vector-negate inner subset sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q3527215-apply1 subset limit)
     (q3527215-sequence-converges-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
      vector-add vector-negate inner sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q3527215-complete-subset-p
    (real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
     vector-add vector-negate inner subset)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527215-subset-sequence-p subset sequence)
      (q3527215-cauchy-sequence-p
       real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
       vector-add vector-negate inner sequence))
     (q3527215-subset-limit-exists-p
      real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
      vector-add vector-negate inner subset sequence))))

;; The conclusion: each ambient point has an internally existentially
;; quantified member of K whose distance is no greater than that of every
;; other member of K.

(defun-sk q3527215-nearest-point-p
    (real-less vector-add vector-negate inner subset u v)
  (forall (w)
    (implies
     (q3527215-apply1 subset w)
     (q3527215-real-leq-p
      real-less
      (q3527215-norm-square
       vector-add vector-negate inner u v)
      (q3527215-norm-square
       vector-add vector-negate inner u w)))))

(defun-sk q3527215-nearest-point-exists-p
    (real-less vector-add vector-negate inner subset u)
  (exists (v)
    (and
     (q3527215-apply1 subset v)
     (q3527215-nearest-point-p
      real-less vector-add vector-negate inner subset u v))))

(defun-sk q3527215-all-points-have-nearest-p
    (space-carrier real-less vector-add vector-negate inner subset)
  (forall (u)
    (implies
     (q3527215-member-p space-carrier u)
     (q3527215-nearest-point-exists-p
      real-less vector-add vector-negate inner subset u))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3527215-hilbert-projection-theorem-statement
    (real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     space-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate
     scalar-multiply inner subset)
  (implies
   (and
    (q3527215-real-inner-product-space-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-multiply
     real-negate real-inverse real-less
     space-carrier vector-zero vector-add vector-negate
     scalar-multiply inner)
    (q3527215-vector-set-valid-p space-carrier subset)
    (q3527215-vector-set-nonempty-p space-carrier subset)
    (q3527215-complete-subset-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-multiply real-less
     vector-add vector-negate inner subset)
    (q3527215-convex-p
     real-carrier real-zero real-one real-add real-less
     vector-add scalar-multiply subset))
   (q3527215-all-points-have-nearest-p
    space-carrier real-less vector-add vector-negate inner subset)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527215,
-- "Hilbert projection theorem": every point in a real inner-product space has a
-- distance-minimizing point in each nonempty complete convex subset. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A = A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y = Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) -> Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) -> fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) -> fromNatR m == fromNatR n -> m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record RealInnerProductSpace
  (R F : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroF : F
    addF : F -> F -> F
    negateF : F -> F
    scaleF : R -> F -> F
    innerF : F -> F -> R
    normF : F -> R

    add-commutativeF :
      (x y : F) -> addF x y == addF y x
    add-associativeF :
      (x y z : F) ->
      addF (addF x y) z == addF x (addF y z)
    add-zeroF :
      (x : F) -> addF x zeroF == x
    add-inverseF :
      (x : F) -> addF x (negateF x) == zeroF

    scale-oneF :
      (x : F) -> scaleF (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associativeF :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : F) ->
      scaleF (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleF a (scaleF b x)
    scale-add-vectorsF :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : F) ->
      scaleF a (addF x y) == addF (scaleF a x) (scaleF a y)
    scale-add-scalarsF :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : F) ->
      scaleF (addR reals a b) x == addF (scaleF a x) (scaleF b x)

    inner-add-leftF :
      (x y z : F) ->
      innerF (addF x y) z ==
      addR reals (innerF x z) (innerF y z)
    inner-scale-leftF :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : F) ->
      innerF (scaleF a x) y ==
      multiplyR reals a (innerF x y)
    inner-symmetricF :
      (x y : F) -> innerF x y == innerF y x
    inner-nonnegativeF :
      (x : F) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (innerF x x)
    inner-definiteF :
      (x : F) ->
      innerF x x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroF

    norm-nonnegativeF :
      (x : F) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normF x)
    norm-squareF :
      (x : F) ->
      multiplyR reals (normF x) (normF x) == innerF x x

open RealInnerProductSpace

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

subtractF :
  {R F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  F ->
  F ->
  F
subtractF space x y =
  addF space x (negateF space y)

distanceF :
  {R F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  F ->
  F ->
  R
distanceF space x y =
  normF space (subtractF space x y)

SequentialLimit :
  {R F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  (Nat -> F) ->
  F ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distanceF space (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

CauchySequence :
  {R F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  (Nat -> F) ->
  Set
CauchySequence {R = R} {reals = reals} space sequence =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (m n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N m ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (distanceF space (sequence m) (sequence n))
        epsilon)

Nonempty :
  {F : Set} ->
  (F -> Set) ->
  Set
Nonempty {F} K =
  Exists F K

IsComplete :
  {R F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  (F -> Set) ->
  Set
IsComplete {F = F} space K =
  (sequence : Nat -> F) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> K (sequence n)) ->
  CauchySequence space sequence ->
  Exists F
    (\ limit ->
      Both
        (K limit)
        (SequentialLimit space sequence limit))

Convex :
  {R F : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  (F -> Set) ->
  Set
Convex {R = R} {F = F} reals space K =
  (x y : F) ->
  K x ->
  K y ->
  (t : R) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  lessOrEqualR reals t (oneR reals) ->
  K
    (addF space
      (scaleF space t x)
      (scaleF space (subtractR reals (oneR reals) t) y))

IsInfimumDistance :
  {R F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealInnerProductSpace R F reals ->
  F ->
  (F -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsInfimumDistance {R = R} {F = F} {reals = reals} space u K infimum =
  Both
    ((w : F) -> K w -> lessOrEqualR reals infimum (distanceF space u w))
    ((lower : R) ->
      ((w : F) -> K w -> lessOrEqualR reals lower (distanceF space u w)) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals lower infimum)

hilbert-projection-theorem : Set1
hilbert-projection-theorem =
  (R F : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace R F reals) ->
  (K : F -> Set) ->
  Nonempty K ->
  IsComplete space K ->
  Convex reals space K ->
  (u : F) ->
  Exists F
    (\ v ->
      Both
        (K v)
        (IsInfimumDistance space u K (distanceF space u v)))

title: Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527215 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3527215), "Hilbert projection theorem":
  every point in a real inner-product space has a nearest point in each
  nonempty complete convex subset. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val q3527215_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q3527215_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero))``);

val q3527215_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_norm_def",
  ``q3527215_norm (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (x : 'e) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q3527215_sub_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_sub_def",
  ``q3527215_sub
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) x y =
      add x (neg y)``);

val q3527215_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_cauchy_def",
  ``q3527215_cauchy
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !m n : num.
          N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
          q3527215_norm inner
            (q3527215_sub add neg (u m) (u n)) < epsilon``);

val q3527215_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_tendsto_def",
  ``q3527215_tendsto
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (x : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==>
          q3527215_norm inner
            (q3527215_sub add neg (u n) x) < epsilon``);

val q3527215_complete_subset_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_complete_subset_def",
  ``q3527215_complete_subset
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (s : 'e -> bool) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        (!n. s (u n)) /\
        q3527215_cauchy add neg inner u
        ==>
        ?x : 'e.
          s x /\ q3527215_tendsto add neg inner u x``);

val q3527215_convex_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_convex_def",
  ``q3527215_convex
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (s : 'e -> bool) <=>
      !x y a b.
        s x /\ s y /\ 0 <= a /\ 0 <= b /\ a + b = 1
        ==>
        s (add (smul a x) (smul b y))``);

val q3527215_distance_value_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_distance_value_def",
  ``q3527215_distance_value
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real) (s : 'e -> bool)
      (u : 'e) (r : real) <=>
      ?w : 'e.
        s w /\
        r =
          q3527215_norm inner
            (q3527215_sub add neg u w)``);

val q3527215_is_infimum_def = new_definition (
  "q3527215_is_infimum_def",
  ``q3527215_is_infimum (P : real -> bool) (a : real) <=>
      (!r. P r ==> a <= r) /\
      (!b. (!r. P r ==> b <= r) ==> b <= a)``);

val exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (inner : 'e -> 'e -> real)
      (s : 'e -> bool).
      q3527215_real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
      (?x : 'e. s x) /\
      q3527215_complete_subset add neg inner s /\
      q3527215_convex add smul s
      ==>
      !u : 'e.
        ?v : 'e.
          s v /\
          q3527215_is_infimum
            (q3527215_distance_value add neg inner s u)
            (q3527215_norm inner
              (q3527215_sub add neg u v))``;

title: Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527215
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527215), "Hilbert projection theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product space, every nonempty complete convex
  subset contains, for each ambient point, a point attaining the infimum of
  the norm distance. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  ` W ` is an arbitrary real pre-Hilbert space; no completeness assumption is
  placed on the ambient space.  For ` K C_ ( Base ` W ) `, membership of the
  induced metric structure ` W |`s K ` in ` CMetSp ` says exactly that ` K `
  is complete in the inherited metric.  The predicate below is the usual
  real convexity condition.
$)

$c Q3527215Convex $.

q3527215-convex-syntax $a
  wff ( Q3527215Convex W K )
$.

${
  $d K W t x y $.

  q3527215-convex-definition $a
    |- (
      ( Q3527215Convex W K )
      <->
      A. x e. K A. y e. K A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        (
          (
            ( t ( .s ` W ) x )
            ( +g ` W )
            ( ( 1 - t ) ( .s ` W ) y )
          )
          e. K
        )
    )
  $.
$}

$(
  The displayed infimum is taken over the norm distances from ` u ` to all
  points of ` K `.  The minimizing point ` v ` remains an internal
  existential witness, as in the source statement.
$)

${
  $d K W u v w $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q3527215 $a
    |- A. W
      (
        ( W e. CPreHil /\ ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld )
        ->
        A. K e. ~P ( Base ` W )
          (
            (
              K =/= (/)
              /\
              ( ( W |`s K ) e. CMetSp /\ ( Q3527215Convex W K ) )
            )
            ->
            A. u e. ( Base ` W )
              E. v e. K
                (
                  ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( u ( -g ` W ) v ) )
                  =
                  inf
                    (
                      ran
                        (
                          w e. K |->
                            ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( u ( -g ` W ) w ) )
                        )
                      ,
                      RR
                      ,
                      <
                    )
                )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q3527215_hilbert_projection_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527215
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q3527215), "Hilbert projection theorem": every point
% in a real inner-product space has a distance-minimizing point in each nonempty
% complete convex subset. This file contains no proof.

hilbert_projection_theorem_Q3527215[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  innerE: [E, E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  distance(x, y: E): real =
    normE(subE(x, y))

  additive_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)

  real_module_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
      smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
        addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)

  norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: E):
      0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = abs(a) * normE(x))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      innerE(addE(x, y), z) =
        innerE(x, z) + innerE(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        innerE(smulE(a, x), y) = a * innerE(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        innerE(x, y) = innerE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= innerE(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        innerE(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) ^ 2 = innerE(x, x))

  real_inner_product_space: bool =
    additive_group_laws
      AND real_module_laws
      AND norm_laws
      AND inner_product_laws

  converges(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            distance(values(index), limit) < epsilon_value

  cauchy(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index
          IMPLIES
            distance(
              values(left_index),
              values(right_index)) < epsilon_value

  nonempty_set(K: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: E):
      K(x)

  complete_subset(K: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      ((FORALL (index: nat):
          K(values(index)))
        AND cauchy(values))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          K(limit) AND converges(values, limit)

  convex_subset(K: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (t: real):
      K(x)
        AND K(y)
        AND 0 <= t
        AND t <= 1
      IMPLIES
        K(addE(
          smulE(t, x),
          smulE(1 - t, y)))

  is_infimum_distance(
      K: point_set,
      u: E,
      infimum_value: real): bool =
    (FORALL (w: E):
      K(w) IMPLIES
        infimum_value <= distance(u, w))
      AND (FORALL (lower_bound: real):
        (FORALL (w: E):
          K(w) IMPLIES
            lower_bound <= distance(u, w))
        IMPLIES lower_bound <= infimum_value)

  hilbert_projection_theorem: bool =
    real_inner_product_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (K: point_set):
        (nonempty_set(K)
          AND complete_subset(K)
          AND convex_subset(K))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (u: E):
            EXISTS (v: E):
              K(v)
                AND is_infimum_distance(
                  K, u, distance(u, v))
END hilbert_projection_theorem_Q3527215

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527217
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527217), "M. Riesz extension theorem": a real
  linear functional on a subspace, nonnegative on its intersection with a
  pointed cone and satisfying the extension density condition, extends to a
  global linear functional nonnegative on the cone. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q3527217_real_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q3527217_zero : E;
  q3527217_add : E -> E -> E;
  q3527217_neg : E -> E;
  q3527217_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q3527217_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q3527217_add x (q3527217_add y z) =
      q3527217_add (q3527217_add x y) z;
  q3527217_add_comm :
    forall x y : E,
      q3527217_add x y = q3527217_add y x;
  q3527217_zero_add :
    forall x : E,
      q3527217_add q3527217_zero x = x;
  q3527217_add_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q3527217_add x q3527217_zero = x;
  q3527217_neg_add :
    forall x : E,
      q3527217_add (q3527217_neg x) x = q3527217_zero;
  q3527217_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q3527217_add x (q3527217_neg x) = q3527217_zero;
  q3527217_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q3527217_smul 1 x = x;
  q3527217_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q3527217_smul (a * b) x =
      q3527217_smul a (q3527217_smul b x);
  q3527217_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q3527217_smul (a + b) x =
      q3527217_add
        (q3527217_smul a x) (q3527217_smul b x);
  q3527217_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q3527217_smul a (q3527217_add x y) =
      q3527217_add
        (q3527217_smul a x) (q3527217_smul a y);
  q3527217_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q3527217_smul 0 x = q3527217_zero;
  q3527217_smul_zero :
    forall a : R,
      q3527217_smul a q3527217_zero = q3527217_zero
}.

Arguments q3527217_zero {E} _.
Arguments q3527217_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527217_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q3527217_smul {E} _ _ _.

Record q3527217_subspace
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527217_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q3527217_subspace_pred : E -> Prop;
  q3527217_subspace_zero :
    q3527217_subspace_pred (q3527217_zero V);
  q3527217_subspace_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q3527217_subspace_pred x ->
      q3527217_subspace_pred y ->
      q3527217_subspace_pred (q3527217_add V x y);
  q3527217_subspace_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q3527217_subspace_pred x ->
      q3527217_subspace_pred (q3527217_smul V a x)
}.

Arguments q3527217_subspace_pred {E V} _ _.

Definition q3527217_subspace_carrier
    {E : Type}
    {V : q3527217_real_vector_space E}
    (P : q3527217_subspace V) : Type :=
  {x : E | q3527217_subspace_pred P x}.

Definition q3527217_subspace_add_value
    {E : Type}
    {V : q3527217_real_vector_space E}
    {P : q3527217_subspace V}
    (x y : q3527217_subspace_carrier P) :
    q3527217_subspace_carrier P :=
  exist _ (q3527217_add V (proj1_sig x) (proj1_sig y))
    (q3527217_subspace_add P
      (proj1_sig x) (proj1_sig y) (proj2_sig x) (proj2_sig y)).

Definition q3527217_subspace_smul_value
    {E : Type}
    {V : q3527217_real_vector_space E}
    {P : q3527217_subspace V}
    (a : R) (x : q3527217_subspace_carrier P) :
    q3527217_subspace_carrier P :=
  exist _ (q3527217_smul V a (proj1_sig x))
    (q3527217_subspace_smul P a (proj1_sig x) (proj2_sig x)).

Record q3527217_pointed_cone
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527217_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q3527217_cone_pred : E -> Prop;
  q3527217_cone_zero :
    q3527217_cone_pred (q3527217_zero V);
  q3527217_cone_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q3527217_cone_pred x ->
      q3527217_cone_pred y ->
      q3527217_cone_pred (q3527217_add V x y);
  q3527217_cone_smul_nonnegative :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      0 <= a ->
      q3527217_cone_pred x ->
      q3527217_cone_pred (q3527217_smul V a x)
}.

Arguments q3527217_cone_pred {E V} _ _.

Record q3527217_partial_linear_functional
    {E : Type}
    {V : q3527217_real_vector_space E}
    (P : q3527217_subspace V) : Type := {
  q3527217_partial_apply : q3527217_subspace_carrier P -> R;
  q3527217_partial_apply_membership_irrelevant :
    forall (x : E)
           (hx hy : q3527217_subspace_pred P x),
      q3527217_partial_apply (exist _ x hx) =
      q3527217_partial_apply (exist _ x hy);
  q3527217_partial_map_add :
    forall x y : q3527217_subspace_carrier P,
      q3527217_partial_apply
        (q3527217_subspace_add_value x y) =
      q3527217_partial_apply x + q3527217_partial_apply y;
  q3527217_partial_map_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : q3527217_subspace_carrier P),
      q3527217_partial_apply
        (q3527217_subspace_smul_value a x) =
      a * q3527217_partial_apply x
}.

Arguments q3527217_partial_apply {E V P} _ _.

Record q3527217_linear_functional
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527217_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q3527217_linear_apply : E -> R;
  q3527217_linear_map_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q3527217_linear_apply (q3527217_add V x y) =
      q3527217_linear_apply x + q3527217_linear_apply y;
  q3527217_linear_map_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q3527217_linear_apply (q3527217_smul V a x) =
      a * q3527217_linear_apply x
}.

Arguments q3527217_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Theorem riesz_extension :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q3527217_real_vector_space E)
         (s : q3527217_pointed_cone V)
         (P : q3527217_subspace V)
         (f : q3527217_partial_linear_functional P),
    (forall x : q3527217_subspace_carrier P,
      q3527217_cone_pred s (proj1_sig x) ->
      0 <= q3527217_partial_apply f x) ->
    (forall y : E,
      exists x : q3527217_subspace_carrier P,
        q3527217_cone_pred s
          (q3527217_add V (proj1_sig x) y)) ->
    exists g : q3527217_linear_functional V,
      (forall x : q3527217_subspace_carrier P,
        q3527217_linear_apply g (proj1_sig x) =
        q3527217_partial_apply f x) /\
      forall x : E,
        q3527217_cone_pred s x ->
        0 <= q3527217_linear_apply g x.
Admitted.

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527217,
  "M. Riesz extension theorem": a real-linear functional on a subspace that
  is nonnegative on its intersection with an additive cone extends to the
  whole real vector space as a linear functional nonnegative on that cone,
  provided the subspace plus the cone covers the space. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q3527217_real_subspace :: "'a::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527217_real_subspace p \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> p \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> p. \<forall>y \<in> p. x + y \<in> p) \<and>
    (\<forall>a::real. \<forall>x \<in> p. scaleR a x \<in> p)"

definition q3527217_additive_cone :: "'a::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527217_additive_cone s \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> s \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> s. \<forall>y \<in> s. x + y \<in> s) \<and>
    (\<forall>a::real. 0 \<le> a \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x \<in> s. scaleR a x \<in> s))"

definition q3527217_linear_on ::
    "'a::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527217_linear_on p f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x \<in> p. \<forall>y \<in> p. f (x + y) = f x + f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a::real. \<forall>x \<in> p. f (scaleR a x) = a * f x)"

theorem q3527217_m_riesz_extension:
  fixes p s :: "'a::real_vector set"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes subspace: "q3527217_real_subspace p"
    and cone: "q3527217_additive_cone s"
    and linear_on: "q3527217_linear_on p f"
    and nonnegative: "\<forall>x \<in> p. x \<in> s \<longrightarrow> 0 \<le> f x"
    and generating: "\<forall>y. \<exists>x \<in> p. x + y \<in> s"
  shows "\<exists>g :: 'a \<Rightarrow> real.
    q3527217_linear_on UNIV g \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> p. g x = f x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> s. 0 \<le> g x)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527217
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3527217), "M. Riesz extension theorem":
  a linear functional on a subspace that is nonnegative on its intersection
  with a convex cone containing zero extends to the whole real vector space
  and remains nonnegative on the cone, provided the subspace plus the cone
  covers the ambient space. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3527217_M_RIESZ_EXTENSION_THEOREM =
 `let real_vector_space =
    \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (smul:real->E->E).
      (!x y z:E. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y:E. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x:E. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x:E. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x:E. smul (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:E.
         smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:E.
         smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:E.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) in
  let real_subspace =
    \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (neg:E->E) (smul:real->E->E)
     (p:E->bool).
      zero IN p /\
      (!x y:E. x IN p /\ y IN p ==> add x y IN p) /\
      (!x:E. x IN p ==> neg x IN p) /\
      (!a:real. !x:E. x IN p ==> smul a x IN p) in
  let pointed_cone =
    \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E) (s:E->bool).
      zero IN s /\
      (!x y:E. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> add x y IN s) /\
      (!a:real. &0 <= a ==> !x:E. x IN s ==> smul a x IN s) in
  let linear_on =
    \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E)
     (p:E->bool) (f:E->real).
      f zero = &0 /\
      (!x y:E.
         x IN p /\ y IN p ==> f (add x y) = f x + f y) /\
      (!a:real. !x:E.
         x IN p ==> f (smul a x) = a * f x) in
  let linear_functional =
    \(zero:E) (add:E->E->E) (smul:real->E->E)
     (g:E->real).
      g zero = &0 /\
      (!x y:E. g (add x y) = g x + g y) /\
      (!a:real. !x:E. g (smul a x) = a * g x) in
  !zero:E.
  !add:E->E->E.
  !neg:E->E.
  !smul:real->E->E.
  !p:E->bool.
  !s:E->bool.
  !f:E->real.
    real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
    real_subspace zero add neg smul p /\
    pointed_cone zero add smul s /\
    linear_on zero add smul p f /\
    (!x:E. x IN p /\ x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\
    (!y:E. ?x:E. x IN p /\ add x y IN s)
    ==>
    ?g:E->real.
      linear_functional zero add smul g /\
      (!x:E. x IN p ==> g x = f x) /\
      (!x:E. x IN s ==> &0 <= g x)`;;

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527217,
;; "M. Riesz extension theorem": a real-linear functional on a subspace that
;; is nonnegative on its intersection with a pointed cone extends to the whole
;; vector space as a linear functional nonnegative on that cone, provided the
;; subspace plus the cone covers the space. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; A context tag presents an arbitrary real vector space. A
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real scalars up to their unique
;; ordered-field isomorphism. Cone, subspace, partial-functional, and extension
;; tags are interpreted by conservative generic symbols; no carrier, set, or
;; function is replaced by a finite table. Every algebraic, order, typing,
;; closure, linearity, and theorem hypothesis is explicit below.

;; The complete linearly ordered real field.

(defstub q3527217-real-member-p (ctx value) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-one (ctx) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-add (ctx left right) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-multiply (ctx left right) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-negate (ctx value) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-inverse (ctx value) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-less (ctx left right) t)
(defstub q3527217-real-set-member-p (ctx set-tag value) t)

(defun q3527217-real-leq (ctx left right)
  (not (q3527217-real-less ctx right left)))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-field-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx y)
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx z))
     (let* ((zero (q3527217-real-zero ctx))
            (one (q3527217-real-one ctx))
            (xy-add (q3527217-real-add ctx x y))
            (yz-add (q3527217-real-add ctx y z))
            (xy-mul (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x y))
            (yz-mul (q3527217-real-multiply ctx y z))
            (neg-x (q3527217-real-negate ctx x))
            (inv-x (q3527217-real-inverse ctx x)))
       (and
        (q3527217-real-member-p ctx xy-add)
        (q3527217-real-member-p ctx xy-mul)
        (q3527217-real-member-p ctx neg-x)
        (q3527217-real-member-p ctx inv-x)
        (equal
         (q3527217-real-add ctx xy-add z)
         (q3527217-real-add ctx x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3527217-real-add ctx y x))
        (equal (q3527217-real-add ctx x zero) x)
        (equal (q3527217-real-add ctx x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q3527217-real-multiply ctx xy-mul z)
         (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x yz-mul))
        (equal
         xy-mul
         (q3527217-real-multiply ctx y x))
        (equal
         (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x one)
         x)
        (equal
         (q3527217-real-inverse ctx zero)
         zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3527217-real-multiply
          ctx x (q3527217-real-add ctx y z))
         (q3527217-real-add
          ctx
          (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x y)
          (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-order-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx y)
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q3527217-real-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (not (q3527217-real-less ctx x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q3527217-real-less ctx x y)
         (q3527217-real-less ctx y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527217-real-less ctx x y)
          (q3527217-real-less ctx y z))
         (q3527217-real-less ctx x z))
        (implies
         (q3527217-real-less ctx x y)
         (q3527217-real-less
          ctx
          (q3527217-real-add ctx x z)
          (q3527217-real-add ctx y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527217-real-less ctx zero x)
          (q3527217-real-less ctx zero y))
         (q3527217-real-less
          ctx
          zero
          (q3527217-real-multiply ctx x y))))))))

(defun-sk q3527217-valid-real-set-p (ctx set-tag)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527217-real-set-member-p ctx set-tag x)
     (q3527217-real-member-p ctx x))))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-set-nonempty-p (ctx set-tag)

    (and
     (q3527217-real-member-p ctx x)

(defun-sk q3527217-real-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set-tag bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx x)
      (q3527217-real-set-member-p ctx set-tag x))
     (q3527217-real-leq ctx x bound))))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-bounded-above-p (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3527217-real-member-p ctx bound)
     (q3527217-real-upper-bound-p
      ctx set-tag bound))))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (ctx set-tag supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx bound)
      (q3527217-real-upper-bound-p
       ctx set-tag bound))

(defun q3527217-real-supremum-p
    (ctx set-tag supremum)
  (and
   (q3527217-real-member-p ctx supremum)
   (q3527217-real-upper-bound-p
    ctx set-tag supremum)
   (q3527217-real-least-upper-bound-p
    ctx set-tag supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-supremum-exists-p
    (ctx set-tag)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q3527217-real-supremum-p
     ctx set-tag supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527217-real-dedekind-complete-p (ctx)
  (forall (set-tag)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-valid-real-set-p ctx set-tag)
      (q3527217-real-set-nonempty-p ctx set-tag)
      (q3527217-real-bounded-above-p ctx set-tag))
     (q3527217-real-supremum-exists-p
      ctx set-tag))))

(defun q3527217-real-field-p (ctx)
  (let ((zero (q3527217-real-zero ctx))
        (one (q3527217-real-one ctx)))
    (and
     (q3527217-real-member-p ctx zero)
     (q3527217-real-member-p ctx one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q3527217-real-less ctx zero one)
     (q3527217-real-field-laws-p ctx)
     (q3527217-real-order-laws-p ctx)
     (q3527217-real-dedekind-complete-p ctx))))

;; The arbitrary additive commutative group and real module.

(defstub q3527217-vector-member-p (ctx value) t)
(defstub q3527217-vector-zero (ctx) t)
(defstub q3527217-vector-add (ctx left right) t)
(defstub q3527217-vector-negate (ctx value) t)
(defstub q3527217-vector-smul (ctx scalar vector) t)

(defun-sk q3527217-add-comm-group-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx y)
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx z))
     (let ((zero (q3527217-vector-zero ctx)))
       (and
        (q3527217-vector-member-p
         ctx (q3527217-vector-add ctx x y))
        (q3527217-vector-member-p
         ctx (q3527217-vector-negate ctx x))
        (equal

          ctx (q3527217-vector-add ctx x y) z)

          ctx x (q3527217-vector-add ctx y z)))
        (equal

(defun-sk q3527217-module-laws-p (ctx)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx a)
      (q3527217-real-member-p ctx b)
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx y))
     (and
      (q3527217-vector-member-p
       ctx (q3527217-vector-smul ctx a x))
      (equal
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx (q3527217-real-one ctx) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx (q3527217-real-multiply ctx a b) x)
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx a (q3527217-vector-smul ctx b x)))
      (equal
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx (q3527217-real-add ctx a b) x)
       (q3527217-vector-add
        ctx
        (q3527217-vector-smul ctx a x)
        (q3527217-vector-smul ctx b x)))
      (equal
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx a (q3527217-vector-add ctx x y))
       (q3527217-vector-add
        ctx
        (q3527217-vector-smul ctx a x)
        (q3527217-vector-smul ctx a y)))
      (equal
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx (q3527217-real-zero ctx) x)
       (q3527217-vector-zero ctx))
      (equal
       (q3527217-vector-smul
        ctx a (q3527217-vector-zero ctx))
       (q3527217-vector-zero ctx))))))

(defun q3527217-real-vector-space-p (ctx)
  (and
   (q3527217-vector-member-p
    ctx (q3527217-vector-zero ctx))
   (q3527217-add-comm-group-laws-p ctx)
   (q3527217-module-laws-p ctx)))

;; Arbitrary pointed cones and linear subspaces.

(defstub q3527217-cone-member-p
  (ctx cone-tag vector)
  t)

(defstub q3527217-subspace-member-p
  (ctx subspace-tag vector)
  t)

(defun-sk q3527217-pointed-cone-laws-p
    (ctx cone-tag)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527217-cone-member-p ctx cone-tag x)
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx x))
     (q3527217-cone-member-p
      ctx cone-tag (q3527217-vector-zero ctx))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527217-cone-member-p ctx cone-tag x)
       (q3527217-cone-member-p ctx cone-tag y))
      (q3527217-cone-member-p
       ctx cone-tag
       (q3527217-vector-add ctx x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527217-real-member-p ctx a)
       (q3527217-real-leq
        ctx (q3527217-real-zero ctx) a)
       (q3527217-cone-member-p ctx cone-tag x))
      (q3527217-cone-member-p
       ctx cone-tag
       (q3527217-vector-smul ctx a x))))))

(defun-sk q3527217-subspace-laws-p
    (ctx subspace-tag)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527217-subspace-member-p
       ctx subspace-tag x)
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx x))
     (q3527217-subspace-member-p
      ctx subspace-tag (q3527217-vector-zero ctx))
     (implies

       (q3527217-subspace-member-p
        ctx subspace-tag x)
       (q3527217-subspace-member-p
        ctx subspace-tag y))
      (q3527217-subspace-member-p
       ctx subspace-tag
       (q3527217-vector-add ctx x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527217-real-member-p ctx a)
       (q3527217-subspace-member-p
        ctx subspace-tag x))
      (q3527217-subspace-member-p
       ctx subspace-tag
       (q3527217-vector-smul ctx a x))))))

;; The source LinearPMap is represented by its arbitrary subspace domain and
;; its scalar-valued function tag. Extension tags use the same value
;; interface, while the existential quantifier below keeps the extension
;; witness internal to the theorem conclusion.

(defstub q3527217-functional-value
  (ctx functional-tag vector)
  t)

(defun-sk q3527217-partial-linear-functional-p
    (ctx subspace-tag functional-tag)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527217-subspace-member-p
       ctx subspace-tag x)
      (q3527217-real-member-p
       ctx
       (q3527217-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag x)))

        ctx functional-tag

       (q3527217-real-add
        ctx
        (q3527217-functional-value

        (q3527217-functional-value
         ctx functional-tag y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527217-real-member-p ctx a)

        ctx subspace-tag x))
      (equal
       (q3527217-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag

       (q3527217-real-multiply
        ctx
        a
        (q3527217-functional-value
         ctx functional-tag x)))))))

(defun-sk q3527217-full-linear-functional-p
    (ctx functional-tag)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx x)
      (q3527217-real-member-p
       ctx
       (q3527217-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx x)
       (q3527217-vector-member-p ctx y))
      (equal
       (q3527217-functional-value
        ctx functional-tag
        (q3527217-vector-add ctx x y))
       (q3527217-real-add
        ctx
        (q3527217-functional-value
         ctx functional-tag x)
        (q3527217-functional-value

     (implies
      (and
       (q3527217-real-member-p ctx a)

;; The two source hypotheses: nonnegativity on domain intersect cone, and
;; for every y an x in the domain with x + y in the cone.

(defun-sk q3527217-partial-nonnegative-on-cone-p
    (ctx cone-tag subspace-tag functional-tag)
  (forall (x)

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527217,
-- "M. Riesz extension theorem": a real-linear functional on a subspace that is
-- nonnegative on a pointed cone extends to a global real-linear functional
-- nonnegative on that cone under the stated cone-generation condition.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set r

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    order-propositionalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      (left-proof right-proof : lessOrEqualR x y) ->
      left-proof == right-proof

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      Not (x == zeroR) ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either
        (lessOrEqualR x y)
        (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR)
        (Not (zeroR == oneR))

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      ((x : R) -> (p q : P x) -> p == q) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

record RealVectorSpace
  {r e : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (E : Set e) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e)) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals

  field
    zeroV :
      E

    addV :
      E ->
      E ->
      E

    negateV :
      E ->
      E

    scaleV :
      R ->
      E ->
      E

    add-commutativeV :
      (x y : E) ->
      addV x y == addV y x

    add-associativeV :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addV (addV x y) z == addV x (addV y z)

    add-zeroV :
      (x : E) ->
      addV x zeroV == x

    add-inverseV :
      (x : E) ->
      addV x (negateV x) == zeroV

    scale-oneV :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleV oneR x == x

    scale-associativeV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR a b) x == scaleV a (scaleV b x)

    scale-add-vectorsV :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleV a (addV x y) == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV a y)

    scale-add-scalarsV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleV (addR a b) x == addV (scaleV a x) (scaleV b x)

record Subspace
  {r e : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals E) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e)) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals
  open RealVectorSpace space

  field
    memberS :
      E ->
      Set e

    member-propositionalS :
      (x : E) ->
      (left-proof right-proof : memberS x) ->
      left-proof == right-proof

    zero-memberS :
      memberS zeroV

    add-memberS :
      (x y : E) ->
      memberS x ->
      memberS y ->
      memberS (addV x y)

    scale-memberS :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      memberS x ->
      memberS (scaleV a x)

record PointedCone
  {r e : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals E) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e)) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals
  open RealVectorSpace space

  field
    memberC :
      E ->
      Set e

    member-propositionalC :
      (x : E) ->
      (left-proof right-proof : memberC x) ->
      left-proof == right-proof

    zero-memberC :
      memberC zeroV

    add-memberC :
      (x y : E) ->
      memberC x ->
      memberC y ->
      memberC (addV x y)

    nonnegative-scale-memberC :
      (a : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR a ->
      (x : E) ->
      memberC x ->
      memberC (scaleV a x)

record PartialLinearFunctional
  {r e : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals E) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e)) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals
  open RealVectorSpace space

  field
    domain :
      Subspace reals space

    applyP :
      (x : E) ->
      Subspace.memberS domain x ->
      R

    apply-proof-independentP :
      (x : E) ->
      (left-proof right-proof : Subspace.memberS domain x) ->
      applyP x left-proof == applyP x right-proof

    map-zeroP :
      applyP zeroV (Subspace.zero-memberS domain) == zeroR

    map-addP :
      (x y : E) ->
      (x-member : Subspace.memberS domain x) ->
      (y-member : Subspace.memberS domain y) ->
      applyP
        (addV x y)
        (Subspace.add-memberS domain x y x-member y-member)
      ==
      addR (applyP x x-member) (applyP y y-member)

    map-scaleP :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      (x-member : Subspace.memberS domain x) ->
      applyP
        (scaleV a x)
        (Subspace.scale-memberS domain a x x-member)
      ==
      multiplyR a (applyP x x-member)

record GlobalLinearFunctional
  {r e : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {E : Set e}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals E) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e)) where

  open CompleteOrderedField reals
  open RealVectorSpace space

  field
    applyG :
      E ->
      R

    map-zeroG :
      applyG zeroV == zeroR

    map-addG :
      (x y : E) ->
      applyG (addV x y) == addR (applyG x) (applyG y)

    map-scaleG :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      applyG (scaleV a x) == multiplyR a (applyG x)

m-riesz-extension-theorem :
  (r e : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ e))
m-riesz-extension-theorem r e =
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (space : RealVectorSpace reals E) ->
  (cone : PointedCone reals space) ->
  (f : PartialLinearFunctional reals space) ->
  ((x : E) ->
    (x-member : Subspace.memberS (PartialLinearFunctional.domain f) x) ->
    PointedCone.memberC cone x ->
    CompleteOrderedField.lessOrEqualR reals
      (CompleteOrderedField.zeroR reals)
      (PartialLinearFunctional.applyP f x x-member)) ->
  ((y : E) ->
    Exists E
      (\ x ->
        Both
          (Subspace.memberS (PartialLinearFunctional.domain f) x)
          (PointedCone.memberC cone
            (RealVectorSpace.addV space x y)))) ->
  Exists
    (GlobalLinearFunctional reals space)
    (\ g ->
      Both
        ((x : E) ->
          (x-member : Subspace.memberS
            (PartialLinearFunctional.domain f) x) ->
          GlobalLinearFunctional.applyG g x ==
          PartialLinearFunctional.applyP f x x-member)
        ((x : E) ->
          PointedCone.memberC cone x ->
          CompleteOrderedField.lessOrEqualR reals
            (CompleteOrderedField.zeroR reals)
            (GlobalLinearFunctional.applyG g x)))

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527217 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3527217), "M. Riesz extension theorem":
  a real-linear functional on a subspace that is nonnegative on a generating
  cone extends to a global real-linear functional nonnegative on that cone.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory;

val q3527217_real_vector_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3527217_real_vector_space_def",
  ``q3527217_real_vector_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y))``);

val q3527217_subspace_def = new_definition (
  "q3527217_subspace_def",
  ``q3527217_subspace
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (domain : 'v -> bool) <=>
      domain zero /\
      (!x y. domain x /\ domain y ==> domain (add x y)) /\
      (!a x. domain x ==> domain (smul a x))``);

val q3527217_pointed_cone_def = new_definition (
  "q3527217_pointed_cone_def",
  ``q3527217_pointed_cone
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (cone : 'v -> bool) <=>
      cone zero /\
      (!x y. cone x /\ cone y ==> cone (add x y)) /\
      (!a x. 0 <= a /\ cone x ==> cone (smul a x))``);

val q3527217_linear_on_def = new_definition (
  "q3527217_linear_on_def",
  ``q3527217_linear_on
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (domain : 'v -> bool) (f : 'v -> real) <=>
      (!x y.
        domain x /\ domain y ==>
        f (add x y) = f x + f y) /\
      (!a x.
        domain x ==>
        f (smul a x) = a * f x)``);

val q3527217_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q3527217_linear_def",
  ``q3527217_linear
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (g : 'v -> real) <=>
      (!x y. g (add x y) = g x + g y) /\
      (!a x. g (smul a x) = a * g x)``);

val riesz_extension =
  ``!(zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (domain : 'v -> bool) (cone : 'v -> bool)
      (f : 'v -> real).
      q3527217_real_vector_space zero add neg smul /\
      q3527217_subspace zero add smul domain /\
      q3527217_pointed_cone zero add smul cone /\
      q3527217_linear_on add smul domain f /\
      (!x. domain x /\ cone x ==> 0 <= f x) /\
      (!y. ?x. domain x /\ cone (add x y))
      ==>
      ?g : 'v -> real.
        q3527217_linear add smul g /\
        (!x. domain x ==> g x = f x) /\
        !x. cone x ==> 0 <= g x``;

content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527217
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527217), "M. Riesz extension theorem": a
  real-linear functional defined on a subspace, nonnegative on its
  intersection with a pointed convex cone and satisfying the stated
  cofinality condition, extends to a real-linear functional on the whole
  space that is nonnegative on the cone. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q3527217PointedCone V s states that V is a real vector space and s is a
  pointed cone in V: s contains zero and is closed under addition and
  multiplication by every nonnegative real scalar.

  Mathlib's partial linear map f : E ->l.[RR] RR is represented by its domain
  p in LSubSp(V) together with
  f in ((V |`s p) LMHom (ringLMod ` RRfld)). This is the defining data of the
  bundled source object, so universally quantifying p and f preserves the
  source quantification. The dense hypothesis is rendered verbatim as
  every y in V admitting x in p with x + y in s. The extending functional g
  remains internally existentially quantified.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. The
  preceding $a declarations are syntax and a faithful definition, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q3527217PointedCone $.

q3527217-pointed-cone-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527217PointedCone V s ) $.

${
  $d V s a x y $.

  q3527217-pointed-cone-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527217PointedCone V s )
    <->
    (
      V e. LVec
      /\
      ( Scalar ` V ) = RRfld
      /\
      s C_ ( Base ` V )
      /\
      ( 0g ` V ) e. s
      /\
      A. x e. s
        A. y e. s
          ( x ( +g ` V ) y ) e. s
      /\
      A. a e. RR
        (
          0 <_ a
          ->
          A. x e. s
            ( a ( .s ` V ) x ) e. s
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d V f g p s x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527217-m-riesz-extension $a |-
    A. V
      A. s
        (
          ( Q3527217PointedCone V s )
          ->
          A. p e. ( LSubSp ` V )
            A. f
              (
                (
                  f e.
                    (
                      ( V |`s p )
                      LMHom
                      ( ringLMod ` RRfld )
                    )
                  /\
                  A. x e. p
                    (
                      x e. s
                      ->
                      0 <_ ( f ` x )
                    )
                  /\
                  A. y e. ( Base ` V )
                    E. x e. p
                      ( x ( +g ` V ) y ) e. s
                )
                ->
                E. g
                  (
                    g e.
                      (
                        V
                        LMHom
                        ( ringLMod ` RRfld )
                      )
                    /\
                    A. x e. p
                      ( g ` x ) = ( f ` x )
                    /\
                    A. x e. s
                      0 <_ ( g ` x )
                  )
              )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527217
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q3527217), "M. Riesz extension theorem": a real-linear
% functional on a subspace, nonnegative on its intersection with a pointed cone,
% extends to the whole vector space while remaining nonnegative on the cone,
% provided every vector can be shifted into the cone from the subspace.

Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  functional: TYPE = [E -> real]

  full_space(x: E): bool =
    TRUE

  real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(zeroE, x) = x
          AND addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(negE(x), x) = zeroE
          AND addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) = smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(0, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)

  is_subspace(p: point_set): bool =
    p(zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        p(x) AND p(y) IMPLIES p(addE(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        p(x) IMPLIES p(smulE(a, x)))

  is_pointed_cone(s: point_set): bool =
    s(zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        s(x) AND s(y) IMPLIES s(addE(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        0 <= a AND s(x) IMPLIES s(smulE(a, x)))

  linear_on(p: point_set, f: functional): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      p(x) AND p(y) IMPLIES
        f(addE(x, y)) = f(x) + f(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        p(x) IMPLIES f(smulE(a, x)) = a * f(x))

  nonnegative_on(
      p, s: point_set,
      f: functional): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      p(x) AND s(x) IMPLIES 0 <= f(x)

  every_vector_shifts_into_cone(
      p, s: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: E):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        p(x) AND s(addE(x, y))

  extends(
      p: point_set,
      f, g: functional): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      p(x) IMPLIES g(x) = f(x)

  m_riesz_extension_theorem: bool =
    real_vector_space IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (s, p: point_set),
          (f: functional):
        (is_pointed_cone(s)
          AND is_subspace(p)
          AND linear_on(p, f)
          AND nonnegative_on(p, s, f)
          AND every_vector_shifts_into_cone(p, s))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (g: functional):
            linear_on(full_space, g)
              AND extends(p, f, g)
              AND nonnegative_on(full_space, s, g)
END Q3527217_m_riesz_extension_theorem
