title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527219
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527219), "Weierstrass preparation theorem":
  a power series over a complete commutative local ring whose residue-series
  image is nonzero factors as a distinguished polynomial times a unit power
  series. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q3527219_commutative_ring (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3527219_zero : A;
  q3527219_one : A;
  q3527219_add : A -> A -> A;
  q3527219_mul : A -> A -> A;
  q3527219_neg : A -> A;
  q3527219_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q3527219_add x (q3527219_add y z) =
      q3527219_add (q3527219_add x y) z;
  q3527219_add_comm :
    forall x y : A, q3527219_add x y = q3527219_add y x;
  q3527219_add_zero :
    forall x : A, q3527219_add x q3527219_zero = x;
  q3527219_add_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q3527219_add x (q3527219_neg x) = q3527219_zero;
  q3527219_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q3527219_mul x (q3527219_mul y z) =
      q3527219_mul (q3527219_mul x y) z;
  q3527219_mul_comm :
    forall x y : A, q3527219_mul x y = q3527219_mul y x;
  q3527219_mul_one :
    forall x : A, q3527219_mul x q3527219_one = x;
  q3527219_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : A,
      q3527219_mul x (q3527219_add y z) =
      q3527219_add
        (q3527219_mul x y) (q3527219_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q3527219_zero {A} _.
Arguments q3527219_one {A} _.
Arguments q3527219_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527219_mul {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527219_neg {A} _ _.

Definition q3527219_sub
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (x y : A) : A :=
  q3527219_add R x (q3527219_neg R y).

Definition q3527219_is_unit
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (x : A) : Prop :=
  exists y : A,
    q3527219_mul R x y = q3527219_one R /\
    q3527219_mul R y x = q3527219_one R.

Record q3527219_ideal
    (A : Type) (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q3527219_ideal_mem : A -> Prop;
  q3527219_ideal_zero :
    q3527219_ideal_mem (q3527219_zero R);
  q3527219_ideal_add :
    forall x y : A,
      q3527219_ideal_mem x ->
      q3527219_ideal_mem y ->
      q3527219_ideal_mem (q3527219_add R x y);
  q3527219_ideal_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q3527219_ideal_mem x ->
      q3527219_ideal_mem (q3527219_neg R x);
  q3527219_ideal_mul :
    forall a x : A,
      q3527219_ideal_mem x ->
      q3527219_ideal_mem (q3527219_mul R a x)
}.

Arguments q3527219_ideal_mem {A R} _ _.

Record q3527219_local_ring
    (A : Type) (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q3527219_maximal_ideal : @q3527219_ideal A R;
  q3527219_maximal_ideal_proper :
    ~ q3527219_ideal_mem q3527219_maximal_ideal
        (q3527219_one R);
  q3527219_unit_of_not_mem_maximal :
    forall x : A,
      ~ q3527219_ideal_mem q3527219_maximal_ideal x ->
      q3527219_is_unit R x
}.

Arguments q3527219_maximal_ideal {A R} _.

Fixpoint q3527219_sum_products
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (terms : list (A * A)) : A :=
  match terms with
  | nil => q3527219_zero R
  | (x, y) :: rest =>
      q3527219_add R
        (q3527219_mul R x y)
        (q3527219_sum_products R rest)
  end.

Definition q3527219_ideal_product
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (I J : A -> Prop) (x : A) : Prop :=
  exists terms : list (A * A),
    Forall
      (fun term : A * A =>
        I (fst term) /\ J (snd term))
      terms /\
    x = q3527219_sum_products R terms.

Fixpoint q3527219_ideal_power
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (I : A -> Prop) (n : nat) : A -> Prop :=
  match n with
  | O => fun _ => True
  | S k =>
      fun x => q3527219_ideal_product R I
        (q3527219_ideal_power R I k) x
  end.

Definition q3527219_congruent_mod_power
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (I : @q3527219_ideal A R)
    (n : nat) (x y : A) : Prop :=
  q3527219_ideal_power R (q3527219_ideal_mem I) n
    (q3527219_sub R x y).

Record q3527219_is_adic_complete
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (I : @q3527219_ideal A R) : Prop := {
  q3527219_adic_hausdorff :
    forall x : A,
      (forall n : nat,
        @q3527219_congruent_mod_power A R I n x
          (q3527219_zero R)) ->
      x = q3527219_zero R;
  q3527219_adic_precomplete :
    forall sequence : nat -> A,
      (forall m n : nat,
        m <= n ->
        @q3527219_congruent_mod_power A R I m
          (sequence m) (sequence n)) ->
      exists limit : A,
        forall n : nat,
          @q3527219_congruent_mod_power A R I n
            (sequence n) limit
}.

Definition q3527219_power_series (A : Type) : Type :=
  nat -> A.

Definition q3527219_power_series_equal
    {A : Type} (p q : q3527219_power_series A) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat, p n = q n.

Definition q3527219_power_series_one
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A) :
    q3527219_power_series A :=
  fun n =>
    match n with
    | O => q3527219_one R
    | S _ => q3527219_zero R
    end.

Fixpoint q3527219_power_series_mul_coeff
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (p q : q3527219_power_series A) (n : nat) : A :=
  match n with
  | O => q3527219_mul R (p O) (q O)
  | S k =>
      q3527219_add R
        (q3527219_power_series_mul_coeff R p
          (fun j => q (S j)) k)
        (q3527219_mul R (p (S k)) (q O))
  end.

Definition q3527219_power_series_mul
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (p q : q3527219_power_series A) :
    q3527219_power_series A :=
  fun n => q3527219_power_series_mul_coeff R p q n.

Definition q3527219_power_series_unit
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (h : q3527219_power_series A) : Prop :=
  exists inverse : q3527219_power_series A,
    q3527219_power_series_equal
      (q3527219_power_series_mul R h inverse)
      (q3527219_power_series_one R) /\
    q3527219_power_series_equal
      (q3527219_power_series_mul R inverse h)
      (q3527219_power_series_one R).

Record q3527219_polynomial
    (A : Type) (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A) : Type := {
  q3527219_polynomial_coeff : nat -> A;
  q3527219_polynomial_finite :
    exists bound : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        bound < n ->
        q3527219_polynomial_coeff n = q3527219_zero R
}.

Arguments q3527219_polynomial_coeff {A R} _ _.

Definition q3527219_polynomial_to_power_series
    {A : Type} {R : q3527219_commutative_ring A}
    (f : @q3527219_polynomial A R) :
    q3527219_power_series A :=
  q3527219_polynomial_coeff f.

Definition q3527219_is_distinguished_at
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (I : @q3527219_ideal A R)
    (f : @q3527219_polynomial A R) : Prop :=
  exists degree : nat,
    q3527219_polynomial_coeff f degree = q3527219_one R /\
    (forall n : nat,
      degree < n ->
      q3527219_polynomial_coeff f n = q3527219_zero R) /\
    forall n : nat,
      n < degree ->
      q3527219_ideal_mem I
        (q3527219_polynomial_coeff f n).

Definition q3527219_is_weierstrass_factorization
    {A : Type} (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
    (I : @q3527219_ideal A R)
    (g : q3527219_power_series A)
    (f : @q3527219_polynomial A R)
    (h : q3527219_power_series A) : Prop :=
  @q3527219_is_distinguished_at A R I f /\
  q3527219_power_series_unit R h /\
  q3527219_power_series_equal g
    (q3527219_power_series_mul R
      (q3527219_polynomial_to_power_series f) h).

Theorem PowerSeries_exists_isWeierstrassFactorization :
  forall (A : Type)
         (R : q3527219_commutative_ring A)
         (L : @q3527219_local_ring A R),
    @q3527219_is_adic_complete A R
      (q3527219_maximal_ideal L) ->
    forall g : q3527219_power_series A,
      ~ (forall n : nat,
        q3527219_ideal_mem (q3527219_maximal_ideal L) (g n)) ->
      exists (f : @q3527219_polynomial A R)
             (h : q3527219_power_series A),
        @q3527219_is_weierstrass_factorization A R
          (q3527219_maximal_ideal L) g f h.
Admitted.

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527219
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527219), "Weierstrass preparation theorem":
  over a commutative local ring complete in its maximal-ideal adic topology,
  a power series nonzero modulo the maximal ideal factors as a distinguished
  polynomial times a unit power series. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q3527219_is_unit :: "'a::comm_ring_1 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527219_is_unit a \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>b. a * b = 1)"

definition q3527219_maximal_ideal :: "'a::comm_ring_1 set" where
  "q3527219_maximal_ideal = {a. \<not> q3527219_is_unit a}"

fun q3527219_ideal_power_member ::
    "'a::comm_ring_1 set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527219_ideal_power_member I 0 x = True"
| "q3527219_ideal_power_member I (Suc n) x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>k (a :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) (b :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a).
      x = (\<Sum>i<k. a i * b i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i<k. a i \<in> I \<and> q3527219_ideal_power_member I n (b i)))"

definition q3527219_is_adic_complete ::
    "'a::comm_ring_1 set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527219_is_adic_complete I \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. (\<forall>n. q3527219_ideal_power_member I n x) \<longrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a.
      (\<forall>m n. m \<le> n \<longrightarrow>
        q3527219_ideal_power_member I m (s m - s n)) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>L. \<forall>n. q3527219_ideal_power_member I n (s n - L)))"

definition q3527219_fps_mul ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::comm_ring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q3527219_fps_mul f h n = (\<Sum>i\<le>n. f i * h (n - i))"

definition q3527219_fps_is_unit ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::comm_ring_1) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527219_fps_is_unit h \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>k. \<forall>n.
      q3527219_fps_mul h k n = (if n = 0 then 1 else 0))"

definition q3527219_is_distinguished ::
    "'a::comm_ring_1 set \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527219_is_distinguished I f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>d.
      f d = 1 \<and>
      (\<forall>i>d. f i = 0) \<and>
      (\<forall>i<d. f i \<in> I))"

theorem q3527219_weierstrass_preparation:
  fixes g :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::comm_ring_1"
  assumes nontrivial: "0 \<noteq> (1::'a)"
    and local:
      "\<forall>a b :: 'a. a + b = 1 \<longrightarrow>
        q3527219_is_unit a \<or> q3527219_is_unit b"
    and complete:
      "q3527219_is_adic_complete
        (q3527219_maximal_ideal :: 'a set)"
    and residue_nonzero:
      "\<exists>n. g n \<notin> (q3527219_maximal_ideal :: 'a set)"
  shows "\<exists>f h :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a.
    q3527219_is_distinguished q3527219_maximal_ideal f \<and>
    q3527219_fps_is_unit h \<and>
    (\<forall>n. g n = q3527219_fps_mul f h n)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527219
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3527219), "Weierstrass preparation theorem":
  over a complete local commutative ring, every formal power series
  nonzero modulo the maximal ideal factors as a distinguished polynomial times
  a unit power series. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3527219_WEIERSTRASS_PREPARATION_THEOREM =
  `let is_commutative_ring =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (negA:A->A).
       (!x:A. addA zeroA x = x) /\
       (!x:A. addA (negA x) x = zeroA) /\
       (!x y:A. addA x y = addA y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. addA x (addA y z) = addA (addA x y) z) /\
       (!x:A. mulA oneA x = x) /\
       (!x y:A. mulA x y = mulA y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. mulA x (mulA y z) = mulA (mulA x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          mulA x (addA y z) = addA (mulA x y) (mulA x z)) in
   let is_unit =
     \(oneA:A) (mulA:A->A->A) (x:A).
       ?y:A. mulA x y = oneA in
   let is_ideal =
     \(zeroA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (negA:A->A) (ideal:A->bool).
       ideal zeroA /\
       (!x:A. ideal x ==> ideal (negA x)) /\
       (!x y:A. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (addA x y)) /\
       (!a x:A. ideal x ==> ideal (mulA a x)) in
   let is_local_ring =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A).
       ~(zeroA = oneA) /\
       (!x y:A.
          addA x y = oneA
          ==> is_unit oneA mulA x \/ is_unit oneA mulA y) in
   let maximal_ideal =
     \(oneA:A) (mulA:A->A->A).
       \x:A. ~(is_unit oneA mulA x) in
   let finite_sum =
     \(zeroA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (k:num) (term:num->A).
       ITLIST addA (list_of_seq term k) zeroA in
   let finite_product =
     \(oneA:A) (mulA:A->A->A) (k:num) (term:num->A).
       ITLIST mulA (list_of_seq term k) oneA in
   let ideal_power_mem =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (ideal:A->bool) (n:num) (x:A).
       ?k:num. ?coefficient:num->A. ?factor:num->num->A.
         x =
           finite_sum zeroA addA k
             (\i:num.
                mulA (coefficient i)
                  (finite_product oneA mulA n (factor i))) /\
         (!i j:num.
            i < k /\ j < n ==> ideal (factor i j)) in
   let is_adically_complete =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (negA:A->A) (ideal:A->bool).
       (!x:A.
          (!n:num.
             ideal_power_mem zeroA oneA addA mulA ideal n x)
          ==> x = zeroA) /\
       (!sequence:num->A.
          (!m n:num.
             m <= n
             ==> ideal_power_mem
                   zeroA oneA addA mulA ideal m
                   (addA (sequence m) (negA (sequence n))))
          ==> ?limit:A.
                !n:num.
                  ideal_power_mem
                    zeroA oneA addA mulA ideal n
                    (addA (sequence n) (negA limit))) in
   let is_polynomial =
     \(zeroA:A) (polynomial:num->A).
       FINITE {n:num | ~(polynomial n = zeroA)} in
   let is_distinguished_polynomial =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (ideal:A->bool)
      (polynomial:num->A).
       is_polynomial zeroA polynomial /\
       ?degree:num.
         polynomial degree = oneA /\
         (!n:num. degree < n ==> polynomial n = zeroA) /\
         (!n:num. n < degree ==> ideal (polynomial n)) in
   let power_series_one =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A).
       \n:num. if n = 0 then oneA else zeroA in
   let power_series_mul =
     \(zeroA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (left:num->A) (right:num->A).
       \n:num.
         finite_sum zeroA addA (SUC n)
           (\i:num. mulA (left i) (right (n - i))) in
   let is_unit_power_series =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (addA:A->A->A) (mulA:A->A->A)
      (series:num->A).
       ?inverse:num->A.
         power_series_mul zeroA addA mulA series inverse =
           power_series_one zeroA oneA /\
         power_series_mul zeroA addA mulA inverse series =
           power_series_one zeroA oneA in
   !zeroA oneA:A.
   !addA mulA:A->A->A.
   !negA:A->A.
   !g:num->A.
     let maximal =
       maximal_ideal oneA mulA in
     is_commutative_ring zeroA oneA addA mulA negA /\
     is_local_ring zeroA oneA addA mulA /\
     is_adically_complete
       zeroA oneA addA mulA negA maximal /\
     (?n:num. ~(maximal (g n)))
     ==>
     ?f:num->A. ?h:num->A.
       is_distinguished_polynomial zeroA oneA maximal f /\
       is_unit_power_series zeroA oneA addA mulA h /\
       g = power_series_mul zeroA addA mulA f h`;;

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527219,
;; "Weierstrass preparation theorem": every power series over an arbitrary
;; commutative local ring complete and separated for its maximal-ideal adic
;; filtration, whose residue series is nonzero, factors as a distinguished
;; polynomial times a unit power series. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame ACL2 function objects represent arbitrary carriers, operations,
;; ideals, and coefficient functions.  They are not finite tables.  Every
;; algebraic, local-ring, ideal-power, completeness, and typing condition used
;; by the source theorem is explicit below.

(defun q3527219-member-p (predicate value)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list value)) t nil))

(defun q3527219-unary-value (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun q3527219-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun q3527219-negate (negation value)
  (q3527219-unary-value negation value))

(defun q3527219-add (addition left right)
  (q3527219-binary-value addition left right))

(defun q3527219-multiply (multiplication left right)
  (q3527219-binary-value multiplication left right))

(defun q3527219-coeff (series n)
  (q3527219-unary-value series n))

;; Commutative rings.

(defun-sk q3527219-commutative-ring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527219-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p
        carrier (q3527219-negate negation x))
       (equal (q3527219-add addition x zero) x)
       (equal (q3527219-add addition zero x) x)
       (equal
        (q3527219-add
         addition x (q3527219-negate negation x))
        zero)
       (equal
        (q3527219-add
         addition (q3527219-negate negation x) x)
        zero)
       (equal (q3527219-multiply multiplication x one) x)
       (equal (q3527219-multiply multiplication one x) x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527219-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p
        carrier (q3527219-add addition x y))
       (q3527219-member-p
        carrier (q3527219-multiply multiplication x y))
       (equal
        (q3527219-add addition x y)
        (q3527219-add addition y x))
       (equal
        (q3527219-multiply multiplication x y)
        (q3527219-multiply multiplication y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527219-member-p carrier y)
       (q3527219-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q3527219-add
         addition (q3527219-add addition x y) z)
        (q3527219-add
         addition x (q3527219-add addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q3527219-multiply
         multiplication
         (q3527219-multiply multiplication x y)
         z)
        (q3527219-multiply
         multiplication
         x
         (q3527219-multiply multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q3527219-multiply
         multiplication
         x
         (q3527219-add addition y z))
        (q3527219-add
         addition
         (q3527219-multiply multiplication x y)
         (q3527219-multiply multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q3527219-multiply
         multiplication
         (q3527219-add addition x y)
         z)
        (q3527219-add
         addition
         (q3527219-multiply multiplication x z)
         (q3527219-multiply multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q3527219-commutative-ring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp negation)
   (q3527219-member-p carrier zero)
   (q3527219-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q3527219-commutative-ring-laws-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)))

;; The source maximal ideal.  In a commutative local ring it is precisely the
;; set of nonunits; this characterization is bidirectionally equivalent to
;; the usual unique-maximal-ideal definition.

(defun-sk q3527219-ring-unit-p
    (carrier one multiplication value)
  (exists (inverse)
    (and
     (q3527219-member-p carrier inverse)
     (equal
      (q3527219-multiply multiplication value inverse)
      one))))

(defun-sk q3527219-ideal-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527219-member-p ideal x)
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527219-member-p
        ideal (q3527219-negate negation x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p ideal x)
       (q3527219-member-p ideal y))
      (q3527219-member-p
       ideal (q3527219-add addition x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p carrier a)
       (q3527219-member-p ideal x))
      (q3527219-member-p
       ideal (q3527219-multiply multiplication a x))))))

(defun q3527219-ideal-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q3527219-member-p ideal zero)
   (q3527219-ideal-laws-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)))

(defun-sk q3527219-nonunits-exactly-ideal-p
    (carrier one multiplication ideal)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527219-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q3527219-member-p ideal x)
      (not
       (q3527219-ring-unit-p
        carrier one multiplication x))))))

(defun q3527219-commutative-local-ring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation maximal-ideal)
  (and
   (q3527219-commutative-ring-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
   (q3527219-ideal-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation maximal-ideal)
   (not (q3527219-member-p maximal-ideal one))
   (q3527219-nonunits-exactly-ideal-p
    carrier one multiplication maximal-ideal)))

;; Membership in I^n is represented exactly by an unbounded finite sum of
;; products of n elements of I.  The n = 0 power is the whole ring.

(defun q3527219-ideal-factor-list-p (ideal n factors)
  (and
   (true-listp factors)
   (equal (len factors) (nfix n))
   (if (consp factors)
       (and
        (q3527219-member-p ideal (car factors))
        (q3527219-ideal-factor-list-p
         ideal (- (nfix n) 1) (cdr factors)))
     (zp n))))

(defun q3527219-product-list
    (one multiplication factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (q3527219-multiply
       multiplication
       (car factors)
       (q3527219-product-list
        one multiplication (cdr factors)))
    one))

(defun q3527219-ideal-product-list-p
    (ideal n products)
  (if (consp products)
      (and
       (q3527219-ideal-factor-list-p
        ideal n (car products))
       (q3527219-ideal-product-list-p
        ideal n (cdr products)))
    (equal products nil)))

(defun q3527219-sum-products
    (zero one addition multiplication products)
  (if (consp products)
      (q3527219-add
       addition
       (q3527219-product-list
        one multiplication (car products))
       (q3527219-sum-products
        zero one addition multiplication (cdr products)))
    zero))

(defun-sk q3527219-positive-ideal-power-member-p
    (zero one addition multiplication ideal n value)
  (exists (products)
    (and
     (true-listp products)
     (q3527219-ideal-product-list-p ideal n products)
     (equal
      value
      (q3527219-sum-products
       zero one addition multiplication products)))))

(defun q3527219-ideal-power-member-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal n value)
  (and
   (natp n)
   (q3527219-member-p carrier value)
   (if (zp n)
       t
     (q3527219-positive-ideal-power-member-p
      zero one addition multiplication ideal n value))))

;; Mathlib's IsAdicComplete is exactly separatedness plus convergence of every
;; sequence satisfying f(m) = f(n) modulo I^m whenever m <= n.

(defun-sk q3527219-in-every-ideal-power-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal value)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3527219-ideal-power-member-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal n value))))

(defun-sk q3527219-adic-hausdorff-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527219-member-p carrier value)
      (q3527219-in-every-ideal-power-p
       carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal value))
     (equal value zero))))

(defun-sk q3527219-sequence-typed-p (carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3527219-member-p
      carrier (q3527219-coeff sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q3527219-adic-cauchy-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (<= m n))
     (q3527219-ideal-power-member-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal m
      (q3527219-add
       addition
       (q3527219-coeff sequence m)
       (q3527219-negate
        negation (q3527219-coeff sequence n)))))))

(defun-sk q3527219-adic-limit-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal sequence limit)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3527219-ideal-power-member-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal n
      (q3527219-add
       addition
       (q3527219-coeff sequence n)
       (q3527219-negate negation limit))))))

(defun-sk q3527219-adic-converges-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q3527219-member-p carrier limit)
     (q3527219-adic-limit-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication negation
      ideal sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q3527219-adic-precomplete-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp sequence)
      (q3527219-sequence-typed-p carrier sequence)
      (q3527219-adic-cauchy-p
       carrier zero one addition multiplication negation
       ideal sequence))
     (q3527219-adic-converges-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication negation
      ideal sequence))))

(defun q3527219-adic-complete-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (q3527219-adic-hausdorff-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication ideal)
   (q3527219-adic-precomplete-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal)))

;; Formal power series are arbitrary tame coefficient functions N -> A.

(defun q3527219-power-series-p (carrier series)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp series)
   (q3527219-sequence-typed-p carrier series)))

(defun-sk q3527219-residue-series-nonzero-p
    (maximal-ideal series)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (not
      (q3527219-member-p
       maximal-ideal (q3527219-coeff series n))))))

;; Finite coefficient lists in ascending degree order represent polynomials.

(defun q3527219-ring-list-p (carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q3527219-member-p carrier (car values))
       (q3527219-ring-list-p carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q3527219-polynomial-coeff (zero polynomial n)
  (if (< (nfix n) (len polynomial))
      (nth (nfix n) polynomial)
    zero))

(defun-sk q3527219-lower-coefficients-in-ideal-p
    (zero maximal-ideal polynomial)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (< n (- (len polynomial) 1)))
     (q3527219-member-p
      maximal-ideal
      (q3527219-polynomial-coeff zero polynomial n)))))

(defun q3527219-distinguished-polynomial-p
    (carrier zero one maximal-ideal polynomial)
  (and
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (consp polynomial)
   (q3527219-ring-list-p carrier polynomial)
   (equal (car (last polynomial)) one)
   (q3527219-lower-coefficients-in-ideal-p
    zero maximal-ideal polynomial)))

;; Coefficients of products are the exact finite Cauchy convolution.

(defun q3527219-series-product-prefix
    (zero addition multiplication left right n count)
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (let ((i (- (nfix count) 1)))
      (q3527219-add
       addition
       (q3527219-multiply
        multiplication
        (q3527219-coeff left i)
        (q3527219-coeff right (- (nfix n) i)))
       (q3527219-series-product-prefix
        zero addition multiplication left right
        n (- (nfix count) 1))))))

(defun q3527219-series-product-coeff
    (zero addition multiplication left right n)
  (q3527219-series-product-prefix
   zero addition multiplication left right
   (nfix n) (+ 1 (nfix n))))

(defun-sk q3527219-series-product-is-one-p
    (zero one addition multiplication left right)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (q3527219-series-product-coeff
       zero addition multiplication left right n)
      (if (zp n) one zero)))))

(defun-sk q3527219-power-series-unit-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication series)
  (exists (inverse)
    (and
     (q3527219-power-series-p carrier inverse)
     (q3527219-series-product-is-one-p
      zero one addition multiplication series inverse))))

;; A polynomial is coerced to a power series by zero extension before taking
;; the same Cauchy product.

(defun q3527219-polynomial-series-product-prefix
    (zero addition multiplication polynomial series n count)
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (let ((i (- (nfix count) 1)))
      (q3527219-add
       addition
       (q3527219-multiply
        multiplication
        (q3527219-polynomial-coeff zero polynomial i)
        (q3527219-coeff series (- (nfix n) i)))
       (q3527219-polynomial-series-product-prefix
        zero addition multiplication polynomial series
        n (- (nfix count) 1))))))

(defun q3527219-polynomial-series-product-coeff
    (zero addition multiplication polynomial series n)
  (q3527219-polynomial-series-product-prefix
   zero addition multiplication polynomial series
   (nfix n) (+ 1 (nfix n))))

(defun-sk q3527219-factorization-equality-p
    (zero addition multiplication series polynomial unit-series)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (equal
      (q3527219-coeff series n)
      (q3527219-polynomial-series-product-coeff
       zero addition multiplication polynomial unit-series n)))))

(defun-sk q3527219-weierstrass-factorization-exists-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication
             maximal-ideal series)
  (exists (polynomial unit-series)
    (and
     (q3527219-distinguished-polynomial-p
      carrier zero one maximal-ideal polynomial)
     (q3527219-power-series-p carrier unit-series)
     (q3527219-power-series-unit-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication unit-series)
     (q3527219-factorization-equality-p
      zero addition multiplication
      series polynomial unit-series))))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q3527219-weierstrass-preparation-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation
             maximal-ideal series)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527219-commutative-local-ring-p
       carrier zero one addition multiplication negation
       maximal-ideal)
      (q3527219-adic-complete-p
       carrier zero one addition multiplication negation
       maximal-ideal)
      (q3527219-power-series-p carrier series)
      (q3527219-residue-series-nonzero-p
       maximal-ideal series))
     (q3527219-weierstrass-factorization-exists-p
      carrier zero one addition multiplication
      maximal-ideal series))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527219,
-- "Weierstrass preparation theorem": a power series over a complete local
-- commutative ring whose residue-field image is nonzero factors as a
-- distinguished polynomial times a unit power series. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_ _≤_ _<_
infixr 3 _×_
infixr 2 _⊎_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _⊎_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → A ⊎ B
  right : B → A ⊎ B

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤ : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤  : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

_<_ :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Set
m < n =
  suc m ≤ n

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : A
    addR multiplyR : A → A → A
    negateR : A → A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) →
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : A) →
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : A) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

difference :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  A →
  A →
  A
difference ring x y =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring x
    (CommutativeRing.negateR ring y)

Unit :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  A →
  Set a
Unit {A = A} ring x =
  Σ A
    (λ inverse →
      (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x inverse ≡
       CommutativeRing.oneR ring)
      ×
      (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring inverse x ≡
       CommutativeRing.oneR ring))

record LocalRing
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    nontrivial :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    unit-or-unit-of-sum-one :
      (x y : A) →
      CommutativeRing.addR ring x y ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring →
      Unit ring x ⊎ Unit ring y

MaximalIdealMember :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} →
  LocalRing ring →
  A →
  Set a
MaximalIdealMember {ring = ring} local x =
  Not (Unit ring x)

data IdealPowerMember
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (ideal-member : A → Set a) :
  Nat →
  A →
  Set a where

  power-zero :
    {x : A} →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member zero x

  power-suc-zero :
    {n : Nat} →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member
      (suc n)
      (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)

  power-suc-add :
    {n : Nat} →
    {x y : A} →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member (suc n) x →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member (suc n) y →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member
      (suc n)
      (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)

  power-suc-negate :
    {n : Nat} →
    {x : A} →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member (suc n) x →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member
      (suc n)
      (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)

  power-suc-product :
    {n : Nat} →
    {x y : A} →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member n x →
    ideal-member y →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member
      (suc n)
      (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y)

  power-respects-equality :
    {n : Nat} →
    {x y : A} →
    x ≡ y →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member n x →
    IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member n y

record IsAdicComplete
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A)
  (ideal-member : A → Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    separated :
      (x : A) →
      ((n : Nat) →
        IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member n x) →
      x ≡ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

    precomplete :
      (sequence : Nat → A) →
      ((m n : Nat) →
        m ≤ n →
        IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member m
          (difference ring (sequence m) (sequence n))) →
      Σ A
        (λ limit →
          (n : Nat) →
          IdealPowerMember ring ideal-member n
            (difference ring (sequence n) limit))

PowerSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
PowerSeries A =
  Nat → A

oneSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  PowerSeries A
oneSeries ring zero =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
oneSeries ring (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

multiplySeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  PowerSeries A →
  PowerSeries A →
  PowerSeries A
multiplySeries ring leftSeries rightSeries zero =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring
    (leftSeries zero)
    (rightSeries zero)
multiplySeries ring leftSeries rightSeries (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring
      (leftSeries zero)
      (rightSeries (suc n)))
    (multiplySeries ring
      (λ i → leftSeries (suc i))
      rightSeries
      n)

UnitSeries :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing A →
  PowerSeries A →
  Set a
UnitSeries {A = A} ring series =
  Σ (PowerSeries A)
    (λ inverse →
      ((n : Nat) →
        multiplySeries ring series inverse n ≡
        oneSeries ring n)
      ×
      ((n : Nat) →
        multiplySeries ring inverse series n ≡
        oneSeries ring n))

record Polynomial
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) :
  Set a where

  field
    coefficient : Nat → A
    degree      : Nat
    zero-above-degree :
      (offset : Nat) →
      coefficient (degree + suc offset) ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

Distinguished :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} →
  (local : LocalRing ring) →
  Polynomial ring →
  Set a
Distinguished {ring = ring} local polynomial =
  (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial
      (Polynomial.degree polynomial)
    ≡ CommutativeRing.oneR ring)
  ×
  ((n : Nat) →
    n < Polynomial.degree polynomial →
    MaximalIdealMember local
      (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial n))

ResidueImageNonzero :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} →
  LocalRing ring →
  PowerSeries A →
  Set a
ResidueImageNonzero local series =
  Not
    ((n : Nat) →
      MaximalIdealMember local (series n))

WeierstrassFactorization :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {ring : CommutativeRing A} →
  (local : LocalRing ring) →
  PowerSeries A →
  Polynomial ring →
  PowerSeries A →
  Set a
WeierstrassFactorization {ring = ring} local series polynomial unit-series =
  Distinguished local polynomial
  ×
  UnitSeries ring unit-series
  ×
  ((n : Nat) →
    series n ≡
    multiplySeries ring
      (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial)
      unit-series
      n)

-- Lean: PowerSeries.exists_isWeierstrassFactorization
weierstrass-preparation-theorem :
  (a : Level) →
  Set (lsuc a)
weierstrass-preparation-theorem a =
  {A : Set a} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing A) →
  (local : LocalRing ring) →
  IsAdicComplete ring (MaximalIdealMember local) →
  (series : PowerSeries A) →
  ResidueImageNonzero local series →
  Σ (Polynomial ring)
    (λ polynomial →
      Σ (PowerSeries A)
        (λ unit-series →
          WeierstrassFactorization
            local
            series
            polynomial
            unit-series))

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527219 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3527219), "Weierstrass preparation
  theorem": a formal power series over a commutative local ring complete in
  its maximal-ideal adic topology and nonzero modulo that ideal factors as a
  distinguished polynomial times a unit power series. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q3527219_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_comm_ring_def",
  ``q3527219_comm_ring
      (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))``);

val q3527219_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_ideal_def",
  ``q3527219_ideal
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (ideal : 'a -> bool) <=>
      ideal zero /\
      (!x y. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (add x y)) /\
      (!x. ideal x ==> ideal (neg x)) /\
      (!a x. ideal x ==> ideal (mul a x))``);

val q3527219_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_unit_def",
  ``q3527219_unit
      (oneR : 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (x : 'a) <=>
      ?y : 'a. mul x y = oneR``);

val q3527219_local_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_local_ring_def",
  ``q3527219_local_ring
      (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (maximal : 'a -> bool) <=>
      q3527219_ideal zero add mul neg maximal /\
      ~maximal oneR /\
      (!x. ~maximal x ==> q3527219_unit oneR mul x)``);

val q3527219_ideal_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_ideal_pow_def",
  ``q3527219_ideal_pow
      (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (ideal : 'a -> bool) (n : num) (x : 'a) <=>
      ?terms : ('a # 'a list) list.
        x =
          FOLDL add zero
            (MAP
              (\term.
                mul (FST term)
                  (FOLDL mul oneR (SND term)))
              terms) /\
        EVERY
          (\term.
            LENGTH (SND term) = n /\
            EVERY ideal (SND term))
          terms``);

val q3527219_adic_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_adic_complete_def",
  ``q3527219_adic_complete
      (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (ideal : 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x.
        (!n. q3527219_ideal_pow zero oneR add mul ideal n x)
        ==>
        x = zero) /\
      (!f : num -> 'a.
        (!m n.
          m <= n
          ==>
          q3527219_ideal_pow zero oneR add mul ideal m
            (add (f m) (neg (f n))))
        ==>
        ?limit : 'a.
          !n.
            q3527219_ideal_pow zero oneR add mul ideal n
              (add (f n) (neg limit)))``);

val q3527219_series_one_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_series_one_def",
  ``q3527219_series_one (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a) =
      (\n : num. if n = 0 then oneR else zero)``);

val q3527219_series_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_series_mul_def",
  ``q3527219_series_mul
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (f : num -> 'a) (g : num -> 'a) =
      (\n : num.
        FOLDL add zero
          (GENLIST (\i. mul (f i) (g (n - i))) (SUC n)))``);

val q3527219_distinguished_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_distinguished_def",
  ``q3527219_distinguished
      (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (maximal : 'a -> bool) (p : num -> 'a) <=>
      ?d : num.
        p d = oneR /\
        (!n. d < n ==> p n = zero) /\
        (!n. n < d ==> maximal (p n))``);

val q3527219_series_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q3527219_series_unit_def",
  ``q3527219_series_unit
      (zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (h : num -> 'a) <=>
      ?u : num -> 'a.
        q3527219_series_mul zero add mul h u =
        q3527219_series_one zero oneR``);

val exists_isWeierstrassFactorization =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (neg : 'a -> 'a) (maximal : 'a -> bool)
      (g : num -> 'a).
      q3527219_comm_ring zero oneR add mul neg /\
      q3527219_local_ring zero oneR add mul neg maximal /\
      q3527219_adic_complete zero oneR add mul neg maximal /\
      (?n : num. ~maximal (g n))
      ==>
      ?p h : num -> 'a.
        q3527219_distinguished zero oneR maximal p /\
        q3527219_series_unit zero oneR add mul h /\
        g = q3527219_series_mul zero add mul p h``;

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527219
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527219), "Weierstrass preparation theorem":
  over a commutative local ring complete in its maximal-ideal adic topology,
  every power series nonzero modulo the maximal ideal factors as a
  distinguished polynomial times a unit power series. This file contains no
  proof.

  SetMM's Poly1 ` R is the finite-support univariate polynomial ring and
  PwSer1 ` R is the univariate formal-power-series ring over R; Poly1 ` R is
  represented as a subring of PwSer1 ` R. Q3527219MaximalIdeal R is the
  unique maximal ideal of the local ring R.

  Q3527219IdealPower uses multiplication in SetMM's semiring of ideals.
  Q3527219AdicComplete is exactly Mathlib's IsAdicComplete predicate:
  separatedness for all powers of the ideal together with convergence of
  every adic Cauchy sequence. Q3527219Distinguished says that the polynomial
  is monic and every coefficient below its degree lies in the maximal ideal.
  Nonvanishing after coefficientwise reduction to the residue field is
  expressed equivalently by the existence of a coefficient outside that
  ideal. Every declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; this
  database contains no $p proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$c Q3527219MaximalIdeal Q3527219IdealPower
   Q3527219AdicComplete Q3527219Distinguished $.

q3527219-maximal-ideal-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527219MaximalIdeal R ) $.
q3527219-ideal-power-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527219IdealPower R M n ) $.
q3527219-adic-complete-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527219AdicComplete R M ) $.
q3527219-distinguished-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527219Distinguished R M f ) $.

${
  q3527219-maximal-ideal-definition $a |- (
    Q3527219MaximalIdeal R
  ) = U. ( MaxIdeal ` R ) $.
$}

${
  $d M R n $.

  q3527219-ideal-power-definition $a |- (
    Q3527219IdealPower R M n
  ) = (
    n
    ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( IDLsrg ` R ) ) )
    M
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d L M R m n s x $.

  q3527219-adic-complete-definition $a |- (
    Q3527219AdicComplete R M
  ) <->
  (
    A. x e. ( Base ` R )
      (
        A. n e. NN0
          x e. ( Q3527219IdealPower R M n )
        ->
        x = ( 0g ` R )
      )
    /\
    A. s e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m NN0 )
      (
        A. m e. NN0
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              m <_ n
              ->
              (
                ( s ` m )
                ( +g ` R )
                ( ( -g ` R ) ` ( s ` n ) )
              )
              e. ( Q3527219IdealPower R M m )
            )
        ->
        E. L e. ( Base ` R )
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              ( s ` n )
              ( +g ` R )
              ( ( -g ` R ) ` L )
            )
            e. ( Q3527219IdealPower R M n )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d M R d f i $.

  q3527219-distinguished-definition $a |- (
    Q3527219Distinguished R M f
  ) <->
  E. d e. NN0
    (
      ( ( coe1 ` f ) ` d ) = ( 1r ` R )
      /\
      A. i e. NN0
        (
          (
            i < d
            ->
            ( ( coe1 ` f ) ` i ) e. M
          )
          /\
          (
            d < i
            ->
            ( ( coe1 ` f ) ` i ) = ( 0g ` R )
          )
        )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d R f g h n $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527219-weierstrass-preparation-theorem $a |-
    A. R e. ( CRing i^i LRing )
      (
        ( Q3527219AdicComplete R ( Q3527219MaximalIdeal R ) )
        ->
        A. g e. ( Base ` ( PwSer1 ` R ) )
          (
            E. n e. NN0
              -. ( ( coe1 ` g ) ` n )
                 e. ( Q3527219MaximalIdeal R )
            ->
            E. f e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` R ) )
              E. h e. ( Base ` ( PwSer1 ` R ) )
                (
                  ( Q3527219Distinguished
                    R ( Q3527219MaximalIdeal R ) f )
                  /\
                  h e. ( Unit ` ( PwSer1 ` R ) )
                  /\
                  g =
                    (
                      f
                      ( .r ` ( PwSer1 ` R ) )
                      h
                    )
                )
          )
      ) $.
$}

title: Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527219,
% "Weierstrass preparation theorem": over a complete local commutative ring,
% a formal power series with nonzero residue image is a distinguished polynomial
% times a unit formal power series. This file contains no proof.

Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem[
  A: TYPE+,
  zero, one: A,
  add, multiply: [A, A -> A],
  negate: [A -> A],
  maximal_ideal: [A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  power_series: TYPE = [nat -> A]

  polynomial: TYPE =
    [# polynomial_coefficient: [nat -> A],
       support_bound: nat #]

  subtract(x, y: A): A =
    add(x, negate(y))

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      add(x, zero) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      add(x, negate(x)) = zero)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      multiply(x, y) = multiply(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      multiply(multiply(x, y), z)
        = multiply(x, multiply(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      multiply(x, one) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
      multiply(x, add(y, z))
        = add(multiply(x, y), multiply(x, z)))

  ideal_laws(ideal: [A -> bool]): bool =
    ideal(zero)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      ideal(x) AND ideal(y) IMPLIES ideal(add(x, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      ideal(x) IMPLIES ideal(negate(x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (r, x: A):
      ideal(x) IMPLIES ideal(multiply(r, x)))

  ring_is_unit(x: A): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: A):
      multiply(x, inverse) = one

  local_ring_laws: bool =
    ideal_laws(maximal_ideal)
      AND NOT maximal_ideal(one)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: A):
      (NOT maximal_ideal(x)) IFF ring_is_unit(x))

  artifact_list_length(values: list[A]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        1 + artifact_list_length(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  artifact_ring_product(values: list[A]): RECURSIVE A =
    CASES values OF
      null: one,
      cons(head, tail):
        multiply(head, artifact_ring_product(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  artifact_all_in_maximal_ideal(values: list[A]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        maximal_ideal(head)
          AND artifact_all_in_maximal_ideal(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  artifact_sum_of_monomials(
      monomials: list[list[A]]): RECURSIVE A =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: zero,
      cons(head, tail):
        add(
          artifact_ring_product(head),
          artifact_sum_of_monomials(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  artifact_valid_monomials(
      monomials: list[list[A]],
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        artifact_list_length(head) = degree
          AND artifact_all_in_maximal_ideal(head)
          AND artifact_valid_monomials(tail, degree)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  maximal_ideal_power_member(power: nat, x: A): bool =
    IF power = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      EXISTS (monomials: list[list[A]]):
        artifact_valid_monomials(monomials, power)
          AND artifact_sum_of_monomials(monomials) = x
    ENDIF

  adic_cauchy(sequence: [nat -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (earlier_index, later_index: nat):
      earlier_index <= later_index
        IMPLIES
          maximal_ideal_power_member(
            earlier_index,
            subtract(
              sequence(earlier_index),
              sequence(later_index)))

  adic_converges_to(sequence: [nat -> A], limit_value: A): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      maximal_ideal_power_member(
        index,
        subtract(sequence(index), limit_value))

  adic_hausdorff: bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      (FORALL (power: nat):
        maximal_ideal_power_member(power, x))
        IMPLIES x = zero

  adic_precomplete: bool =
    FORALL (sequence: [nat -> A]):
      adic_cauchy(sequence)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (limit_value: A):
            adic_converges_to(sequence, limit_value)

  maximal_ideal_adic_complete: bool =
    adic_hausdorff AND adic_precomplete

  power_series_equal(left, right: power_series): bool =
    FORALL (degree: nat):
      left(degree) = right(degree)

  power_series_product_coefficient(
      left, right: power_series,
      degree, term_count: nat): RECURSIVE A =
    IF term_count = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = term_count - 1 IN
        add(
          power_series_product_coefficient(
            left, right, degree, term_count - 1),
          IF index <= degree THEN
            multiply(
              left(index),
              right(degree - index))
          ELSE
            zero
          ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE term_count

  power_series_multiply(
      left, right: power_series): power_series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      power_series_product_coefficient(
        left, right, degree, degree + 1)

  power_series_one: power_series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 0 THEN one ELSE zero ENDIF

  power_series_is_unit(value: power_series): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: power_series):
      power_series_equal(
        power_series_multiply(value, inverse),
        power_series_one)

  polynomial_is_distinguished(value: polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      polynomial_coefficient(value)(degree) = one
        AND
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        degree < index
          IMPLIES
            polynomial_coefficient(value)(index) = zero)
        AND
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < degree
          IMPLIES
            maximal_ideal(
              polynomial_coefficient(value)(index)))

  polynomial_as_power_series(value: polynomial): power_series =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      polynomial_coefficient(value)(degree)

  residue_image_nonzero(value: power_series): bool =
    EXISTS (degree: nat):
      NOT maximal_ideal(value(degree))

  is_weierstrass_factorization(
      g: power_series,
      distinguished_factor: polynomial,
      unit_factor: power_series): bool =
    polynomial_is_distinguished(distinguished_factor)
      AND power_series_is_unit(unit_factor)
      AND
    power_series_equal(
      g,
      power_series_multiply(
        polynomial_as_power_series(distinguished_factor),
        unit_factor))

  weierstrass_preparation_theorem: bool =
    (commutative_ring_laws
      AND local_ring_laws
      AND maximal_ideal_adic_complete)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (g: power_series):
          residue_image_nonzero(g)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS
                  (distinguished_factor: polynomial),
                  (unit_factor: power_series):
                is_weierstrass_factorization(
                  g,
                  distinguished_factor,
                  unit_factor)
END Q3527219_weierstrass_preparation_theorem

title: Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527230
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527230), "Von Staudt–Clausen theorem": for every
  natural number k, the even Bernoulli number B_(2k), corrected by the sum of
  1/p over primes p with p - 1 dividing 2k, is an integer. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List QArith.QArith
  ZArith.ZArith ZArith.Znumtheory.

Import ListNotations.

Definition q3527230_Q_of_nat (n : nat) : Q :=
  inject_Z (Z.of_nat n).

Fixpoint q3527230_choose (n k : nat) {struct n} : nat :=
  match n with
  | O =>
      match k with
      | O => 1
      | S _ => 0
      end
  | S m =>
      match k with
      | O => 1
      | S j => q3527230_choose m j + q3527230_choose m (S j)
      end
  end.

Fixpoint q3527230_Q_sum (count : nat) (f : nat -> Q) : Q :=
  match count with
  | O => 0
  | S n => Qplus (q3527230_Q_sum n f) (f n)
  end.

Fixpoint q3527230_bernoulli_prime_table (count : nat) : list Q :=
  match count with
  | O => []
  | S n =>
      let previous := q3527230_bernoulli_prime_table n in
      let next :=
        Qminus 1
          (q3527230_Q_sum n
            (fun k =>
              Qmult
                (Qdiv
                  (q3527230_Q_of_nat (q3527230_choose n k))
                  (q3527230_Q_of_nat (Nat.sub n k + 1)))
                (nth k previous 0%Q))) in
      previous ++ [next]
  end.

Definition q3527230_bernoulli_prime (n : nat) : Q :=
  nth n (q3527230_bernoulli_prime_table (S n)) 0%Q.

Fixpoint q3527230_Q_pow (x : Q) (n : nat) : Q :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S m => Qmult x (q3527230_Q_pow x m)
  end.

Definition q3527230_bernoulli (n : nat) : Q :=
  Qmult
    (q3527230_Q_pow (inject_Z (-1)) n)
    (q3527230_bernoulli_prime n).

Definition q3527230_prime_term (even_index p : nat) : Q :=
  match Znumtheory.prime_dec (Z.of_nat p) with
  | left _ =>
      if Nat.eq_dec (Nat.modulo even_index (Nat.sub p 1)) 0
      then Qdiv 1 (q3527230_Q_of_nat p)
      else 0
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Fixpoint q3527230_von_staudt_sum (bound even_index : nat) : Q :=
  match bound with
  | O => 0
  | S p =>
      Qplus
        (q3527230_von_staudt_sum p even_index)
        (q3527230_prime_term even_index p)
  end.

Theorem q3527230_von_staudt_clausen :
  forall k : nat,
    exists z : Z,
      Qeq
        (inject_Z z)
        (Qplus
          (q3527230_bernoulli (2 * k))
          (q3527230_von_staudt_sum (2 * k + 2) (2 * k))).
Admitted.

title: Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527230 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527230), "Von Staudt–Clausen
  theorem": for every natural number k, the Bernoulli number indexed by 2k,
  after adding the reciprocals of the relevant primes, is an integer. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
  imports Main HOL.Rat
begin

definition q3527230_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527230_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    2 \<le> p \<and> (\<forall>d::nat. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

fun q3527230_bernoulli_values :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rat list" where
  "q3527230_bernoulli_values 0 = []"
| "q3527230_bernoulli_values (Suc n) =
    q3527230_bernoulli_values n @
      [1 - (\<Sum>j<n.
        of_nat (n choose j) / of_nat (n - j + 1) *
          q3527230_bernoulli_values n ! j)]"

definition q3527230_bernoulli_positive :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rat" where
  "q3527230_bernoulli_positive n =
    q3527230_bernoulli_values (Suc n) ! n"

definition q3527230_bernoulli :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rat" where
  "q3527230_bernoulli n =
    (-1) ^ n * q3527230_bernoulli_positive n"

theorem q3527230_von_staudt_clausen:
  fixes k :: nat
  shows
    "\<exists>z::int.
      q3527230_bernoulli (2 * k) +
        (\<Sum>p<2 * k + 2.
          if q3527230_prime p \<and> p - 1 dvd 2 * k then
            (1::rat) / of_nat p
          else 0)
        = of_int z"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527230,
;; "Von Staudt-Clausen theorem": for every natural k, the even Bernoulli
;; number B_(2k) plus the sum of 1/p over primes p < 2k + 2 with p - 1
;; dividing 2k is an integer. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun q3527230-binomial-coefficient (n j)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp j)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp j) 1 0)
    (+ (q3527230-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) j)
       (q3527230-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) (- j 1)))))

;; This is the negative-first Bernoulli convention B_1 = -1/2 used by the
;; canonical Lean source. The recurrence computes exact rational values.

(defun q3527230-bernoulli-weighted-sum (row j values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (* (q3527230-binomial-coefficient row j)
            (car values))
         (q3527230-bernoulli-weighted-sum
          row (+ j 1) (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun q3527230-bernoulli-prefix (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list 1)
    (let* ((previous
            (q3527230-bernoulli-prefix (- n 1)))
           (weighted-sum
            (q3527230-bernoulli-weighted-sum
             (+ n 1) 0 previous))
           (next (/ (- weighted-sum) (+ n 1))))
      (append previous (list next)))))

(defun q3527230-bernoulli-number (n)
  (nth n (q3527230-bernoulli-prefix n)))

(defun q3527230-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (q3527230-no-divisor-from-p number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun q3527230-primep (number)
  (and (natp number)
       (< 1 number)
       (q3527230-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

;; Summing below LIMIT matches the Finset.range bound in the canonical source.

(defun q3527230-von-staudt-sum-below (limit twice-k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix limit)))
  (if (zp limit)
      0
    (let ((p (- limit 1)))
      (+ (q3527230-von-staudt-sum-below (- limit 1) twice-k)
         (if (and (q3527230-primep p)
                  (equal (mod twice-k (- p 1)) 0))
             (/ 1 p)
           0)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q3527230-von-staudt-clausen-statement (k)
  (implies
   (natp k)
   (let ((twice-k (* 2 k)))
     (integerp
      (+ (q3527230-bernoulli-number twice-k)
         (q3527230-von-staudt-sum-below (+ twice-k 2) twice-k))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527230
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q3527230), "Von Staudt–Clausen theorem": for
-- every natural parameter k, with no parity restriction on k, the Bernoulli
-- number B_(2k) plus the sum of 1/p over primes in the source range
-- p < 2k + 2 with p - 1 dividing 2k is an integer. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _equalInteger_ _equalRational_

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : P value

record IntegerRepresentative : Set where
  constructor difference
  field
    positivePart : Nat
    negativePart : Nat

zeroInteger : IntegerRepresentative
zeroInteger =
  difference zero zero

oneInteger : IntegerRepresentative
oneInteger =
  difference 1 zero

minusOneInteger : IntegerRepresentative
minusOneInteger =
  difference zero 1

addInteger :
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  IntegerRepresentative
addInteger (difference positive-left negative-left)
  (difference positive-right negative-right) =
  difference
    (positive-left + positive-right)
    (negative-left + negative-right)

negateInteger :
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  IntegerRepresentative
negateInteger (difference positive negative) =
  difference negative positive

multiplyInteger :
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  IntegerRepresentative
multiplyInteger (difference positive-left negative-left)
  (difference positive-right negative-right) =
  difference
    (positive-left * positive-right + negative-left * negative-right)
    (positive-left * negative-right + negative-left * positive-right)

scaleInteger :
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  Nat ->
  IntegerRepresentative
scaleInteger (difference positive negative) factor =
  difference (positive * factor) (negative * factor)

_equalInteger_ :
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  IntegerRepresentative ->
  Set
difference positive-left negative-left
  equalInteger
  difference positive-right negative-right =
  positive-left + negative-right == positive-right + negative-left

integerRepresentative : Int -> IntegerRepresentative
integerRepresentative (pos n) =
  difference n zero
integerRepresentative (negsuc n) =
  difference zero (suc n)

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator : IntegerRepresentative
    denominatorMinusOne : Nat

denominator : Rational -> Nat
denominator (fraction numerator-value denominator-minus-one) =
  suc denominator-minus-one

denominatorProductMinusOne : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
denominatorProductMinusOne left-minus-one right-minus-one =
  right-minus-one + left-minus-one * suc right-minus-one

zeroRational : Rational
zeroRational =
  fraction zeroInteger zero

oneRational : Rational
oneRational =
  fraction oneInteger zero

minusOneRational : Rational
minusOneRational =
  fraction minusOneInteger zero

naturalAsRational : Nat -> Rational
naturalAsRational n =
  fraction (difference n zero) zero

integerAsRational : Int -> Rational
integerAsRational z =
  fraction (integerRepresentative z) zero

addRational : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
addRational
  (fraction left-numerator left-denominator-minus-one)
  (fraction right-numerator right-denominator-minus-one) =
  fraction
    (addInteger
      (scaleInteger left-numerator
        (suc right-denominator-minus-one))
      (scaleInteger right-numerator
        (suc left-denominator-minus-one)))
    (denominatorProductMinusOne
      left-denominator-minus-one
      right-denominator-minus-one)

negateRational : Rational -> Rational
negateRational (fraction numerator-value denominator-minus-one) =
  fraction
    (negateInteger numerator-value)
    denominator-minus-one

subtractRational : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
subtractRational left right =
  addRational left (negateRational right)

multiplyRational : Rational -> Rational -> Rational
multiplyRational
  (fraction left-numerator left-denominator-minus-one)
  (fraction right-numerator right-denominator-minus-one) =
  fraction
    (multiplyInteger left-numerator right-numerator)
    (denominatorProductMinusOne
      left-denominator-minus-one
      right-denominator-minus-one)

divideByPositiveNatural : Rational -> Nat -> Rational
divideByPositiveNatural
  (fraction numerator-value denominator-minus-one)
  divisor-minus-one =
  fraction
    numerator-value
    (denominatorProductMinusOne
      denominator-minus-one
      divisor-minus-one)

oneOverNatural : Nat -> Rational
oneOverNatural zero =
  zeroRational
oneOverNatural (suc denominator-minus-one) =
  fraction oneInteger denominator-minus-one

_equalRational_ : Rational -> Rational -> Set
fraction left-numerator left-denominator-minus-one
  equalRational
  fraction right-numerator right-denominator-minus-one =
  scaleInteger left-numerator (suc right-denominator-minus-one)
    equalInteger
  scaleInteger right-numerator (suc left-denominator-minus-one)

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose zero zero =
  1
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) zero =
  1
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

snoc : List Rational -> Rational -> List Rational
snoc [] value =
  value ∷ []
snoc (head ∷ tail) value =
  head ∷ snoc tail value

lookupRational : Nat -> List Rational -> Rational
lookupRational zero [] =
  zeroRational
lookupRational zero (head ∷ tail) =
  head
lookupRational (suc index) [] =
  zeroRational
lookupRational (suc index) (head ∷ tail) =
  lookupRational index tail

weightedBernoulliSum :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  List Rational ->
  Rational
weightedBernoulliSum n k [] =
  zeroRational
weightedBernoulliSum n k (value ∷ values) =
  addRational
    (multiplyRational
      (divideByPositiveNatural
        (naturalAsRational (choose n k))
        (n - k))
      value)
    (weightedBernoulliSum n (suc k) values)

bernoulliPrimeValues : Nat -> List Rational
bernoulliPrimeValues zero =
  []
bernoulliPrimeValues (suc n)
  with bernoulliPrimeValues n
... | previous-values =
  snoc previous-values
    (subtractRational oneRational
      (weightedBernoulliSum n zero previous-values))

bernoulliPrime : Nat -> Rational
bernoulliPrime n =
  lookupRational n (bernoulliPrimeValues (suc n))

negativeOnePower : Nat -> Rational
negativeOnePower zero =
  oneRational
negativeOnePower (suc exponent) =
  multiplyRational minusOneRational
    (negativeOnePower exponent)

bernoulli : Nat -> Rational
bernoulli n =
  multiplyRational (negativeOnePower n) (bernoulliPrime n)

naturalEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
naturalEqual zero zero =
  true
naturalEqual zero (suc right) =
  false
naturalEqual (suc left) zero =
  false
naturalEqual (suc left) (suc right) =
  naturalEqual left right

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator-minus-one) =
  mod-helper zero denominator-minus-one numerator denominator-minus-one

dividesNatural : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
dividesNatural zero zero =
  true
dividesNatural zero (suc dividend) =
  false
dividesNatural (suc divisor-minus-one) dividend =
  naturalEqual
    (naturalMod dividend (suc divisor-minus-one))
    zero

noDivisorsBelow : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Bool
noDivisorsBelow value candidate zero =
  true
noDivisorsBelow value candidate (suc fuel)
  with dividesNatural candidate value
... | true =
  false
... | false =
  noDivisorsBelow value (suc candidate) fuel

isPrime : Nat -> Bool
isPrime zero =
  false
isPrime (suc zero) =
  false
isPrime value@(suc (suc n)) =
  noDivisorsBelow value 2 n

includedPrime : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
includedPrime p twice-k
  with isPrime p
... | false =
  false
... | true =
  dividesNatural (p - 1) twice-k

primeCorrectionTerm : Nat -> Nat -> Rational
primeCorrectionTerm twice-k p
  with includedPrime p twice-k
... | false =
  zeroRational
... | true =
  oneOverNatural p

primeCorrectionSum : Nat -> Nat -> Rational
primeCorrectionSum twice-k zero =
  zeroRational
primeCorrectionSum twice-k (suc exclusive-bound-minus-one) =
  addRational
    (primeCorrectionSum twice-k exclusive-bound-minus-one)
    (primeCorrectionTerm twice-k exclusive-bound-minus-one)

von-staudt-clausen-theorem : Set
von-staudt-clausen-theorem =
  (k : Nat) ->
  Exists Int
    (\ integer-value ->
      integerAsRational integer-value
        equalRational
      addRational
        (bernoulli (2 * k))
        (primeCorrectionSum (2 * k) (2 * k + 2)))

title: Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527230 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3527230), "Von Staudt–Clausen theorem":
  at every even natural index n, the Bernoulli number B_n plus the reciprocal
  sum over primes p < n + 2 with p - 1 dividing n is an integer. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinatoricsTheory dividesTheory integerTheory;
open pred_setTheory primeTheory ratTheory;

val q3527230_is_bernoulli_def = new_definition (
  "q3527230_is_bernoulli_def",
  ``q3527230_is_bernoulli (b : num -> rat) <=>
      !n : num.
        ITSET
          (\j : num. \acc : rat.
             rat_of_num (binomial n j) * b j + acc)
          (count n)
          0q =
        if n = 1 then 1q else 0q``);

val q3527230_bernoulli_def = new_definition (
  "q3527230_bernoulli_def",
  ``q3527230_bernoulli =
      (@b : num -> rat. q3527230_is_bernoulli b)``);

val q3527230_prime_correction_def = new_definition (
  "q3527230_prime_correction_def",
  ``q3527230_prime_correction (n : num) =
      ITSET
        (\p : num. \acc : rat. 1q / rat_of_num p + acc)
        {p : num |
          p < n + 2 /\
          prime p /\
          divides (p - 1) n}
        0q``);

val q3527230_is_integer_def = new_definition (
  "q3527230_is_integer_def",
  ``q3527230_is_integer (q : rat) <=>
      ?z : int. q = rat_of_int z``);

val von_staudt_clausen_theorem =
  ``!n : num.
      EVEN n ==>
      q3527230_is_integer
        (q3527230_bernoulli n +
         q3527230_prime_correction n)``;

title: Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527230
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527230), "Von Staudt-Clausen theorem": for
  every natural number k, the even-indexed Bernoulli number B_(2k), augmented
  by the sum of 1/p over primes p < 2k + 2 such that p - 1 divides 2k, is an
  integer. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 is SetMM's class of nonnegative integers. For N in NN0,
  ( N BernPoly 0 ) is the N-th Bernoulli number with B_1 = -1/2, matching the
  source convention. The half-open interval

    ( 0 ..^ ( ( 2 x. k ) + 2 ) )

  is exactly Lean's Finset.range (2 * k + 2). Inside the prime filter,
  SetMM integer subtraction agrees with the source natural subtraction because
  every prime is at least two. Membership of the resulting rational number in
  ZZ is equivalent to membership in Set.range Int.cast.

  The declaration below is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d k p $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527230-von-staudt-clausen $a
    |- A. k e. NN0
         (
           (
             ( ( 2 x. k ) BernPoly 0 )
             +
             sum_ p e.
               { p e. ( 0 ..^ ( ( 2 x. k ) + 2 ) ) |
                 ( p e. Prime /\ ( p - 1 ) || ( 2 x. k ) )
               }
               ( 1 / p )
           )
           e. ZZ
         )
  $.
$}

    RAT_1, NEWTON, FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, SQUARE_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, INT_2,

    NEWTON, FINSET_1, FRAENKEL;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for bernoulli being Function of NAT,RAT st
    bernoulli.0 = 1 &
    (for r being Nat
      ex recurrence being FinSequence of RAT st
        len recurrence = r + 1 &
        (for j being Nat st j <= r holds
          recurrence.(j + 1) =
            ((r + 2) choose j) * bernoulli.j) &
        (r + 2) * bernoulli.(r + 1) = -(Sum recurrence))
  holds
    for k being Nat
      ex primes being finite Subset of NAT,
         terms being FinSequence of RAT,
         z being Integer st
        primes =
          {p where p is Element of Seg (2 * k + 1) :
            p is prime & (p -' 1) divides (2 * k)} &
        len terms = len Sgm primes &
        (for i being Nat st i in dom terms holds
          terms.i =
            (1 qua Rational) / (((Sgm primes).i) qua Rational)) &
        bernoulli.(2 * k) + Sum terms = z
proof
end;
::$P+

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527230,
% "Von Staudt–Clausen theorem": each even Bernoulli number plus the sum of
% reciprocals of primes p with p - 1 dividing its index is an integer.
% This file contains no proof.

Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  binomial(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial(n - 1, k - 1) + binomial(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  safe_rat_div_nat(numerator: rat, denominator: nat): rat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / (denominator :: rat)
    ENDIF

  bernoulli_recurrence_sum(
      values: [nat -> rat],
      n, count: nat): RECURSIVE rat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        bernoulli_recurrence_sum(values, n, count - 1)
          + safe_rat_div_nat(
              binomial(n, index) :: rat,
              n - index + 1)
            * values(index)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_positive_bernoulli_sequence(values: [nat -> rat]): bool =
    FORALL (n: nat):
      values(n) =
        1 - bernoulli_recurrence_sum(values, n, n)

  positive_bernoulli: [nat -> rat] =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (values: [nat -> rat]):
        is_positive_bernoulli_sequence(values))

  negative_one_power(n: nat): RECURSIVE rat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -negative_one_power(n - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  bernoulli(n: nat): rat =
    negative_one_power(n) * positive_bernoulli(n)

  reciprocal_nat(value: nat): rat =
    safe_rat_div_nat(1, value)

  von_staudt_prime_sum(k, count: nat): RECURSIVE rat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET p: nat = count - 1 IN
        von_staudt_prime_sum(k, count - 1)
          + IF prime_nat(p)
                AND nat_divides(p - 1, 2 * k) THEN
              reciprocal_nat(p)
            ELSE
              0
            ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  von_staudt_clausen: bool =
    FORALL (k: nat):
      EXISTS (integer_value: int):
        bernoulli(2 * k)
          + von_staudt_prime_sum(k, 2 * k + 2)
          = (integer_value :: rat)

END Q3527230_von_staudt_clausen_theorem

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3527241), "Krull's principal ideal theorem":

module

public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.Height
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Ideal.IsPrincipal
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Noetherian.Basic

namespace Q3527241

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

/-- A prime ideal minimal over a principal ideal has height at most one. -/
theorem krulls_principal_ideal_theorem_statement
    (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrincipal] (p : Ideal R)
    (hp : p ∈ I.minimalPrimes) : p.height ≤ 1 := sorry
