title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527241
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527241), "Krull's principal ideal theorem":
  in a commutative Noetherian ring, every prime ideal minimal over a principal
  ideal has height at most one. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q3527241_commutative_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q3527241_zero : R;
  q3527241_one : R;
  q3527241_add : R -> R -> R;
  q3527241_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q3527241_neg : R -> R;
  q3527241_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527241_add x (q3527241_add y z) =
      q3527241_add (q3527241_add x y) z;
  q3527241_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q3527241_add x y = q3527241_add y x;
  q3527241_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q3527241_add x q3527241_zero = x;
  q3527241_add_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q3527241_add x (q3527241_neg x) = q3527241_zero;
  q3527241_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527241_mul x (q3527241_mul y z) =
      q3527241_mul (q3527241_mul x y) z;
  q3527241_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q3527241_mul x y = q3527241_mul y x;
  q3527241_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q3527241_mul x q3527241_one = x;
  q3527241_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : R,
      q3527241_mul x (q3527241_add y z) =
      q3527241_add
        (q3527241_mul x y) (q3527241_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q3527241_zero {R} _.
Arguments q3527241_one {R} _.
Arguments q3527241_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527241_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527241_neg {R} _ _.

Record q3527241_ideal
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R) : Type := {
  q3527241_ideal_mem : R -> Prop;
  q3527241_ideal_zero :
    q3527241_ideal_mem (q3527241_zero CR);
  q3527241_ideal_add :
    forall x y : R,
      q3527241_ideal_mem x ->
      q3527241_ideal_mem y ->
      q3527241_ideal_mem (q3527241_add CR x y);
  q3527241_ideal_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q3527241_ideal_mem x ->
      q3527241_ideal_mem (q3527241_neg CR x);
  q3527241_ideal_mul :
    forall a x : R,
      q3527241_ideal_mem x ->
      q3527241_ideal_mem (q3527241_mul CR a x)
}.

Arguments q3527241_ideal_mem {R CR} _ _.

Definition q3527241_ideal_le
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (I J : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q3527241_ideal_mem I x ->
    q3527241_ideal_mem J x.

Definition q3527241_ideal_lt
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (I J : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  q3527241_ideal_le I J /\ ~ q3527241_ideal_le J I.

Definition q3527241_is_prime
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (P : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  ~ q3527241_ideal_mem P (q3527241_one CR) /\
  forall x y : R,
    q3527241_ideal_mem P (q3527241_mul CR x y) ->
    q3527241_ideal_mem P x \/ q3527241_ideal_mem P y.

Fixpoint q3527241_linear_combination
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R)
    (coefficients generators : list R) : R :=
  match coefficients, generators with
  | coefficient :: coefficient_rest, generator :: generator_rest =>
      q3527241_add CR
        (q3527241_mul CR coefficient generator)
        (q3527241_linear_combination
          CR coefficient_rest generator_rest)
  | _, _ => q3527241_zero CR
  end.

Definition q3527241_generated_by
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (generators : list R)
    (I : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q3527241_ideal_mem I x <->
    exists coefficients : list R,
      length coefficients = length generators /\
      x = q3527241_linear_combination CR coefficients generators.

Definition q3527241_is_noetherian
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R} : Prop :=
  forall I : @q3527241_ideal R CR,
    exists generators : list R,
      q3527241_generated_by generators I.

Definition q3527241_is_principal
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (I : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  exists generator : R,
    forall x : R,
      q3527241_ideal_mem I x <->
      exists coefficient : R,
        x = q3527241_mul CR coefficient generator.

Definition q3527241_is_minimal_prime_over
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (I P : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  q3527241_is_prime P /\
  q3527241_ideal_le I P /\
  forall Q : @q3527241_ideal R CR,
    q3527241_is_prime Q ->
    q3527241_ideal_le I Q ->
    q3527241_ideal_le Q P ->
    q3527241_ideal_le P Q.

Definition q3527241_height_le_one
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R}
    (P : @q3527241_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  forall Q0 Q1 : @q3527241_ideal R CR,
    q3527241_is_prime Q0 ->
    q3527241_is_prime Q1 ->
    q3527241_ideal_lt Q0 Q1 ->
    q3527241_ideal_lt Q1 P ->
    False.

Theorem Ideal_height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes :
  forall (R : Type)
         (CR : q3527241_commutative_ring R),
    @q3527241_is_noetherian R CR ->
    forall I : @q3527241_ideal R CR,
      q3527241_is_principal I ->
      forall P : @q3527241_ideal R CR,
        q3527241_is_minimal_prime_over I P ->
        q3527241_height_le_one P.
Admitted.

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527241
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527241), "Krull's principal ideal theorem":
  in a commutative Noetherian ring, a prime ideal minimal over a principal
  ideal has height at most one. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
  imports "HOL-Algebra.Ideal"
begin

definition q3527241_is_noetherian_ring ::
    "('a, 'b) ring_scheme \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527241_is_noetherian_ring R \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>J. ideal J R \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>A \<subseteq> carrier R. finite A \<and> J = Idl\<^bsub>R\<^esub> A))"

definition q3527241_minimal_prime_over ::
    "('a, 'b) ring_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527241_minimal_prime_over R I p \<longleftrightarrow>
    primeideal p R \<and>
    I \<subseteq> p \<and>
    (\<forall>q. primeideal q R \<and> I \<subseteq> q \<and> q \<subseteq> p
      \<longrightarrow> p \<subseteq> q)"

definition q3527241_prime_height_at_most_one ::
    "('a, 'b) ring_scheme \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527241_prime_height_at_most_one R p \<longleftrightarrow>
    \<not> (\<exists>q r.
      primeideal q R \<and>
      primeideal r R \<and>
      q \<subset> r \<and>
      r \<subset> p)"

theorem q3527241_krull_principal_ideal:
  fixes R :: "('a, 'b) ring_scheme"
    and I p :: "'a set"
  assumes "cring R"
    and "q3527241_is_noetherian_ring R"
    and "principalideal I R"
    and "q3527241_minimal_prime_over R I p"
  shows "q3527241_prime_height_at_most_one R p"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527241
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3527241), "Krull's principal ideal theorem":
  in a commutative Noetherian ring, every prime ideal minimal over a principal
  ideal has height at most one. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q3527241_KRULLS_PRINCIPAL_IDEAL_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
       (!x. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
       (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
       (!x y z. addR x (addR y z) = addR (addR x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulR x (mulR y z) = mulR (mulR x y) z) /\
       (!x y z. mulR x (addR y z) =
                addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) in
   let is_ideal =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (j:R->bool).
       j zeroR /\
       (!x. j x ==> j (negR x)) /\
       (!x y. j x /\ j y ==> j (addR x y)) /\
       (!a x. j x ==> j (mulR a x)) in
   let ideal_subset =
     \(i:R->bool) (j:R->bool). !x:R. i x ==> j x in
   let finitely_generates_ideal =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (j:R->bool) (generators:R->bool).
       FINITE generators /\
       ideal_subset generators j /\
       (!other:R->bool.
          is_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR other /\
          ideal_subset generators other
          ==> ideal_subset j other) in
   let is_noetherian_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       !j:R->bool.
         is_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR j
         ==> ?generators:R->bool.
               finitely_generates_ideal
                 zeroR addR mulR negR j generators in
   let is_principal_ideal =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (j:R->bool).
       is_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR j /\
       ?a:R. !x:R. j x <=> ?r:R. x = mulR r a in
   let is_prime_ideal =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (p:R->bool).
       is_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR p /\
       ~(p oneR) /\
       (!x y. p (mulR x y) ==> p x \/ p y) in
   let strict_ideal_subset =
     \(i:R->bool) (j:R->bool).
       ideal_subset i j /\ ?x:R. j x /\ ~(i x) in
   let is_minimal_prime_over =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (i:R->bool) (p:R->bool).
       is_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR p /\
       ideal_subset i p /\
       (!q:R->bool.
          is_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR q /\
          ideal_subset i q /\
          ideal_subset q p
          ==> q = p) in
   let prime_height_at_most_one =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (p:R->bool).
       ~(?q:R->bool. ?l:R->bool.
           is_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR q /\
           is_prime_ideal zeroR oneR addR mulR negR l /\
           strict_ideal_subset l q /\
           strict_ideal_subset q p) in
   !zeroR:R. !oneR:R. !addR:R->R->R. !mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R. !ideal0:R->bool. !prime0:R->bool.
     is_comm_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_noetherian_ring zeroR addR mulR negR /\
     is_principal_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR ideal0 /\
     is_minimal_prime_over
       zeroR oneR addR mulR negR ideal0 prime0
     ==> prime_height_at_most_one
           zeroR oneR addR mulR negR prime0`;;

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527241,
;; "Krull's principal ideal theorem": in a commutative Noetherian ring, every
;; prime ideal minimal over a principal ideal has height at most one. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent the arbitrary ring carrier, operations, and
;; ideal membership predicates. No carrier or ideal is enumerated. Noetherianity
;; is expressed by finite generation of every ideal, with generators and their
;; coefficients kept under the statement's internal existential quantifiers.

(defun q3527241-member-p (predicate value)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list value))
      t
    nil))

(defun q3527241-unary-value (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun q3527241-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun q3527241-neg (negation value)
  (q3527241-unary-value negation value))

(defun q3527241-add (addition left right)
  (q3527241-binary-value addition left right))

(defun q3527241-mul (multiplication left right)
  (q3527241-binary-value multiplication left right))

(defun-sk q3527241-commutative-ring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p
        carrier (q3527241-neg negation x))
       (equal (q3527241-add addition x zero) x)
       (equal (q3527241-add addition zero x) x)
       (equal
        (q3527241-add addition x (q3527241-neg negation x))
        zero)
       (equal
        (q3527241-add addition (q3527241-neg negation x) x)
        zero)
       (equal (q3527241-mul multiplication x one) x)
       (equal (q3527241-mul multiplication one x) x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527241-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p
        carrier (q3527241-add addition x y))
       (q3527241-member-p
        carrier (q3527241-mul multiplication x y))
       (equal
        (q3527241-add addition x y)
        (q3527241-add addition y x))
       (equal
        (q3527241-mul multiplication x y)
        (q3527241-mul multiplication y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527241-member-p carrier y)
       (q3527241-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q3527241-add
         addition (q3527241-add addition x y) z)
        (q3527241-add
         addition x (q3527241-add addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q3527241-mul
         multiplication
         (q3527241-mul multiplication x y)
         z)
        (q3527241-mul
         multiplication
         x
         (q3527241-mul multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q3527241-mul
         multiplication
         x
         (q3527241-add addition y z))
        (q3527241-add
         addition
         (q3527241-mul multiplication x y)
         (q3527241-mul multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q3527241-mul
         multiplication
         (q3527241-add addition x y)
         z)
        (q3527241-add
         addition
         (q3527241-mul multiplication x z)
         (q3527241-mul multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q3527241-commutative-ring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp negation)
   (q3527241-member-p carrier zero)
   (q3527241-member-p carrier one)
   (q3527241-commutative-ring-laws-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)))

(defun-sk q3527241-ideal-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527241-member-p ideal x)
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
       (q3527241-member-p
        ideal (q3527241-neg negation x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p ideal x)
       (q3527241-member-p ideal y))
      (q3527241-member-p
       ideal (q3527241-add addition x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p carrier a)
       (q3527241-member-p ideal x))
      (q3527241-member-p
       ideal (q3527241-mul multiplication a x))))))

(defun q3527241-ideal-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q3527241-member-p ideal zero)
   (q3527241-ideal-laws-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)))

(defun-sk q3527241-ideal-included-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
     (implies
      (q3527241-member-p left x)
      (q3527241-member-p right x)))))

(defun q3527241-strict-ideal-included-p
    (carrier left right)
  (and
   (q3527241-ideal-included-p carrier left right)
   (not (q3527241-ideal-included-p carrier right left))))

(defun-sk q3527241-prime-multiplication-law-p
    (carrier multiplication ideal)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527241-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527241-member-p
       ideal (q3527241-mul multiplication x y)))
     (or
      (q3527241-member-p ideal x)
      (q3527241-member-p ideal y)))))

(defun q3527241-prime-ideal-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (q3527241-ideal-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
   (not (q3527241-member-p ideal one))
   (q3527241-prime-multiplication-law-p
    carrier multiplication ideal)))

(defun q3527241-ring-list-p (carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q3527241-member-p carrier (car values))
       (q3527241-ring-list-p carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q3527241-linear-combination
    (zero addition multiplication coefficients generators)
  (if (and (consp coefficients)
           (consp generators))
      (q3527241-add
       addition
       (q3527241-mul
        multiplication (car coefficients) (car generators))
       (q3527241-linear-combination
        zero
        addition
        multiplication
        (cdr coefficients)
        (cdr generators)))
    zero))

(defun-sk q3527241-generated-representation-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication generators value)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (equal (len coefficients) (len generators))
     (q3527241-ring-list-p carrier coefficients)
     (equal
      value
      (q3527241-linear-combination
       zero addition multiplication coefficients generators)))))

(defun-sk q3527241-generated-by-law-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication ideal generators)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527241-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q3527241-member-p ideal x)
      (q3527241-generated-representation-p
       carrier zero addition multiplication generators x)))))

(defun q3527241-generated-by-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication ideal generators)
  (and
   (true-listp generators)
   (q3527241-ring-list-p carrier generators)
   (q3527241-generated-by-law-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication ideal generators)))

(defun-sk q3527241-finitely-generated-ideal-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication ideal)
  (exists (generators)
    (q3527241-generated-by-p
     carrier zero addition multiplication ideal generators)))

(defun-sk q3527241-noetherian-p

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527241,
-- "Krull's principal ideal theorem": in a commutative Noetherian ring, every
-- prime ideal minimal over a principal ideal has height at most one. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} P =
  P -> Bottom {a}

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : P -> P or Q
  right : Q -> P or Q

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record Ideal
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    member : R -> Set a
    membership-propositional :
      (x : R) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u ≡ v
    contains-zero :
      member (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : R) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : R) ->
      member x ->
      member (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (r x : R) ->
      member x ->
      member (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring r x)

IdealIncludedIn :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set a
IdealIncludedIn {R = R} I J =
  (x : R) ->
  Ideal.member I x ->
  Ideal.member J x

StrictlyContained :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set a
StrictlyContained I J =
  IdealIncludedIn I J and
  Not (IdealIncludedIn J I)

data ContainsAll
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  {ring : CommutativeRing R}
  (I : Ideal ring) :
  List R ->
  Set a where

  contains-empty :
    ContainsAll I []

  contains-cons :
    {x : R} ->
    {xs : List R} ->
    Ideal.member I x ->
    ContainsAll I xs ->
    ContainsAll I (x ∷ xs)

GeneratesIdeal :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  List R ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set (lsuc a)
GeneratesIdeal {ring = ring} generators I =
  ContainsAll I generators and
  ((J : Ideal ring) ->
    ContainsAll J generators ->
    IdealIncludedIn I J)

IsNoetherianRing :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
IsNoetherianRing {R = R} ring =
  (I : Ideal ring) ->
  Σ (List R)
    (λ generators ->
      GeneratesIdeal generators I)

IsPrincipal :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set (lsuc a)
IsPrincipal {R = R} I =
  Σ R
    (λ generator ->
      GeneratesIdeal (generator ∷ []) I)

IsPrime :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set a
IsPrime {R = R} {ring = ring} p =
  Not (Ideal.member p (CommutativeRing.oneR ring)) and
  ((x y : R) ->
    Ideal.member p (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x y) ->
    Ideal.member p x or
    Ideal.member p y)

MinimalPrimeOver :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set (lsuc a)
MinimalPrimeOver {ring = ring} I p =
  IsPrime p and
  (IdealIncludedIn I p and
   ((q : Ideal ring) ->
     IsPrime q ->
     IdealIncludedIn I q ->
     IdealIncludedIn q p ->
     IdealIncludedIn p q))

HeightAtMostOne :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set (lsuc a)
HeightAtMostOne {a} {ring = ring} p =
  (q r : Ideal ring) ->
  IsPrime q ->
  IsPrime r ->
  StrictlyContained r q ->
  StrictlyContained q p ->
  Bottom {a}

-- Lean: Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
krull-s-principal-ideal-theorem :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
krull-s-principal-ideal-theorem a =
  (R : Set a) ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) ->
  IsNoetherianRing ring ->
  (I : Ideal ring) ->
  IsPrincipal I ->
  (p : Ideal ring) ->
  MinimalPrimeOver I p ->
  HeightAtMostOne p

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527241, "Krull's principal ideal theorem": in a commutative Noetherian
  ring, every prime ideal minimal over a principal ideal has height at most
  one. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val q3527241_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_comm_ring_def",
  ``q3527241_comm_ring
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))``);

val q3527241_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_ideal_def",
  ``q3527241_ideal
      (zero : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) <=>
      zero IN ideal /\
      (!x y. x IN ideal /\ y IN ideal ==> add x y IN ideal) /\
      (!x. x IN ideal ==> neg x IN ideal) /\
      (!a x. x IN ideal ==> mul a x IN ideal)``);

val q3527241_span_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_span_def",
  ``q3527241_span
      (zero : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (s : 'r set) =
      {x |
        !other : 'r set.
          q3527241_ideal zero add mul neg other /\
          s SUBSET other
          ==>
          x IN other}``);

val q3527241_noetherian_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_noetherian_def",
  ``q3527241_noetherian
      (zero : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      !ideal : 'r set.
        q3527241_ideal zero add mul neg ideal
        ==>
        ?s : 'r set.
          FINITE s /\
          q3527241_span zero add mul neg s = ideal``);

val q3527241_principal_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_principal_def",
  ``q3527241_principal
      (zero : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (ideal : 'r set) <=>
      ?a : 'r.
        ideal = q3527241_span zero add mul neg {a}``);

val q3527241_prime_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_prime_ideal_def",
  ``q3527241_prime_ideal
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (p : 'r set) <=>
      q3527241_ideal zero add mul neg p /\
      ~(oneR IN p) /\
      (!x y. mul x y IN p ==> x IN p \/ y IN p)``);

val q3527241_minimal_prime_over_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_minimal_prime_over_def",
  ``q3527241_minimal_prime_over
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (ideal : 'r set) (p : 'r set) <=>
      q3527241_prime_ideal zero oneR add mul neg p /\
      ideal SUBSET p /\
      (!q : 'r set.
        q3527241_prime_ideal zero oneR add mul neg q /\
        ideal SUBSET q /\
        q SUBSET p
        ==>
        p SUBSET q)``);

val q3527241_height_le_one_def = new_definition (
  "q3527241_height_le_one_def",
  ``q3527241_height_le_one
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (p : 'r set) <=>
      ~(?q r : 'r set.
        q3527241_prime_ideal zero oneR add mul neg q /\
        q3527241_prime_ideal zero oneR add mul neg r /\
        r PSUBSET q /\
        q PSUBSET p)``);

val Ideal_height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) (ideal : 'r set) (p : 'r set).
      q3527241_comm_ring zero oneR add mul neg /\
      q3527241_noetherian zero add mul neg /\
      q3527241_ideal zero add mul neg ideal /\
      q3527241_principal zero add mul neg ideal /\
      q3527241_minimal_prime_over zero oneR add mul neg ideal p
      ==>
      q3527241_height_le_one zero oneR add mul neg p``;

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527241
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527241), "Krull's principal ideal theorem":
  in a commutative Noetherian ring, every prime ideal minimal over a principal
  ideal has height at most one. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's LNoeR is the class of left-Noetherian rings; for the commutative
  rings quantified below this is exactly the source Noetherian-ring
  assumption. LPIdeal ` R is the class of ideals generated by one element.

  The antecedent after the prime-ideal binders says that p contains I and is
  inclusion-minimal among prime ideals containing I. The conclusion excludes
  prime ideals q and r with q properly contained in r and r properly contained
  in p. This absence of a three-prime strict chain is equivalent to the prime
  ideal p having height at most one.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement; this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d I R p q r $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527241-krull-principal-ideal-theorem $a |-
    A. R e. ( CRing i^i LNoeR )
      A. I e. ( LPIdeal ` R )
        A. p e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
          (
            (
              I C_ p
              /\
              A. q e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
                (
                  (
                    I C_ q
                    /\
                    q C_ p
                  )
                  ->
                  p C_ q
                )
            )
            ->
            A. q e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
              A. r e. ( PrmIdeal ` R )
                -.
                (
                  q C. r
                  /\
                  r C. p
                )
          )
  $.
$}

title: Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527241
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q3527241), "Krull's principal ideal theorem": in a
% commutative Noetherian ring, every prime ideal minimal over a principal ideal
% has height at most one. This file contains no proof.

Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem[
  R: TYPE+,
  zero, one: R,
  neg: [R -> R],
  add, mul: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  IMPORTING finite_sets[R]

  ideal: TYPE = [R -> bool]

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(zero, x) = x
          AND add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(neg(x), x) = zero
          AND add(x, neg(x)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(x, add(y, z)) =
          add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(add(x, y), z) =
          add(mul(x, z), mul(y, z)))

  is_ideal(I: ideal): bool =
    I(zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        I(x) AND I(y) IMPLIES I(add(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(neg(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(mul(a, x)))

  ideal_subset(I, J: ideal): bool =
    FORALL (x: R):
      I(x) IMPLIES J(x)

  strict_ideal_subset(I, J: ideal): bool =
    ideal_subset(I, J)
      AND NOT ideal_subset(J, I)

  generated_by(generators: finite_set[R], I: ideal): bool =
    is_ideal(I)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        member(x, generators) IMPLIES I(x))
      AND (FORALL (J: ideal):
        is_ideal(J)
          AND (FORALL (x: R):
            member(x, generators) IMPLIES J(x))
          IMPLIES ideal_subset(I, J))

  noetherian_ring: bool =
    FORALL (I: ideal):
      is_ideal(I)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (generators: finite_set[R]):
            generated_by(generators, I)

  is_principal(I: ideal): bool =
    is_ideal(I)
      AND EXISTS (generator: R):
        FORALL (x: R):
          I(x) IFF
            EXISTS (coefficient: R):
              x = mul(coefficient, generator)

  is_prime(P: ideal): bool =
    is_ideal(P)
      AND NOT P(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        P(mul(x, y)) IMPLIES P(x) OR P(y))

  minimal_prime_over(P, I: ideal): bool =
    is_prime(P)
      AND ideal_subset(I, P)
      AND (FORALL (Q: ideal):
        is_prime(Q)
          AND ideal_subset(I, Q)
          AND ideal_subset(Q, P)
          IMPLIES ideal_subset(P, Q))

  height_at_most_one(P: ideal): bool =
    NOT EXISTS (Q0, Q1: ideal):
      is_prime(Q0)
        AND is_prime(Q1)
        AND strict_ideal_subset(Q0, Q1)
        AND strict_ideal_subset(Q1, P)

  krulls_principal_ideal_theorem: bool =
    (commutative_ring_laws AND noetherian_ring)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (I, P: ideal):
          is_principal(I)
            AND minimal_prime_over(P, I)
            IMPLIES height_at_most_one(P)

END Q3527241_krull_s_principal_ideal_theorem

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q3527250
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q3527250), "Hadamard three-lines theorem": a bounded
-- function that is continuous on a closed vertical strip and complex differentiable on
-- its interior is bounded by the interpolation of its boundary suprema. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Taylor
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric

@[expose] public section

open Set Filter Function Complex Topology

-- These two instances reproduce the canonical complex normed-field instances, which are
-- unavailable through the statement checker's reduced Mathlib module graph.
noncomputable local instance : NormedField ℂ where
  dist_eq _ _ := rfl
  norm_mul := Complex.norm_mul

noncomputable local instance : NontriviallyNormedField ℂ where
  non_trivial := ⟨2, Complex.norm_two.symm ▸ one_lt_two⟩

/-- A function differentiable on a set and continuous on its closure. -/
structure DiffContOnCl (𝕜 : Type*) {E F : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    (f : E → F) (s : Set E) : Prop where
  protected differentiableOn : DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s
  protected continuousOn : ContinuousOn f (closure s)

namespace Complex
namespace HadamardThreeLines

/-- The order-theoretic inverse of the real exponential on a positive input. -/
noncomputable def realLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {y : ℝ | Real.exp y ≤ x}

/-- The canonical complex power for a nonnegative real base, including the standard zero branch. -/
noncomputable def realCpow (x : ℝ) (y : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  if x = 0 then if y = 0 then 1 else 0
  else Complex.exp (realLog x * y)

/-- The open vertical strip consisting of complex numbers whose real parts lie in `(a, b)`. -/
def verticalStrip (a b : ℝ) : Set ℂ := re ⁻¹' Ioo a b

/-- The closed vertical strip consisting of complex numbers whose real parts lie in `[a, b]`. -/
def verticalClosedStrip (a b : ℝ) : Set ℂ := re ⁻¹' Icc a b

/-- The supremum of the norm of `f` along the vertical line with real part `x`. -/
noncomputable def sSupNormIm {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : ℂ → E) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup ((norm ∘ f) '' (re ⁻¹' {x}))

/-- The interpolation of the boundary suprema on the vertical strip from `l` to `u`. -/
noncomputable def interpStrip' {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : ℂ → E) (l u : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  -- `sSupNormIm` is nonnegative, so `realCpow` agrees here with Mathlib's real-base
  -- specialization of `Complex.cpow`.
  if sSupNormIm f l = 0 ∨ sSupNormIm f u = 0 then
    0
  else
    realCpow (sSupNormIm f l) (1 - ((z - l) / (u - l))) *
      realCpow (sSupNormIm f u) ((z - l) / (u - l))

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]

/-- Hadamard's three-lines theorem on an arbitrary vertical strip. -/
lemma norm_le_interpStrip_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip {l u : ℝ} (hul : l < u)
    {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z ∈ verticalClosedStrip l u) (hd : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (verticalStrip l u))
    (hB : BddAbove ((norm ∘ f) '' verticalClosedStrip l u)) :
    ‖f z‖ ≤ ‖interpStrip' f l u z‖ := sorry

end HadamardThreeLines
end Complex

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527250
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527250), "Hadamard three-lines theorem":
  a bounded complex-differentiable function on a vertical strip is bounded
  by the logarithmic interpolation of its boundary-line norm suprema.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3527250_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q3527250_czero : q3527250_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q3527250_cone : q3527250_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q3527250_cadd
    (z w : q3527250_complex) : q3527250_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q3527250_cneg
    (z : q3527250_complex) : q3527250_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q3527250_csub
    (z w : q3527250_complex) : q3527250_complex :=
  q3527250_cadd z (q3527250_cneg w).

Definition q3527250_cmul
    (z w : q3527250_complex) : q3527250_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q3527250_cmodulus
    (z : q3527250_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Definition q3527250_vertical_strip
    (l u : R) (z : q3527250_complex) : Prop :=
  l < fst z /\ fst z < u.

Definition q3527250_vertical_closed_strip
    (l u : R) (z : q3527250_complex) : Prop :=
  l <= fst z /\ fst z <= u.

Record q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q3527250_zero : E;
  q3527250_add : E -> E -> E;
  q3527250_neg : E -> E;
  q3527250_smul : q3527250_complex -> E -> E;
  q3527250_norm : E -> R;

  q3527250_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q3527250_add x (q3527250_add y z) =
      q3527250_add (q3527250_add x y) z;
  q3527250_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q3527250_add x y = q3527250_add y x;
  q3527250_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q3527250_add x q3527250_zero = x;
  q3527250_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q3527250_add x (q3527250_neg x) = q3527250_zero;

  q3527250_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q3527250_smul q3527250_cone x = x;
  q3527250_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q3527250_complex) (x : E),
      q3527250_smul (q3527250_cmul a b) x =
      q3527250_smul a (q3527250_smul b x);
  q3527250_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q3527250_complex) (x : E),
      q3527250_smul (q3527250_cadd a b) x =
      q3527250_add
        (q3527250_smul a x) (q3527250_smul b x);
  q3527250_smul_add :
    forall (a : q3527250_complex) (x y : E),
      q3527250_smul a (q3527250_add x y) =
      q3527250_add
        (q3527250_smul a x) (q3527250_smul a y);
  q3527250_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q3527250_smul q3527250_czero x = q3527250_zero;
  q3527250_smul_zero :
    forall a : q3527250_complex,
      q3527250_smul a q3527250_zero = q3527250_zero;

  q3527250_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q3527250_norm x;
  q3527250_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q3527250_norm x = 0 <-> x = q3527250_zero;
  q3527250_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q3527250_norm (q3527250_add x y) <=
      q3527250_norm x + q3527250_norm y;
  q3527250_norm_smul :
    forall (a : q3527250_complex) (x : E),
      q3527250_norm (q3527250_smul a x) =
      q3527250_cmodulus a * q3527250_norm x
}.

Arguments q3527250_zero {E} _.
Arguments q3527250_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527250_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q3527250_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527250_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q3527250_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q3527250_add V x (q3527250_neg V y).

Record q3527250_complex_linear_map
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q3527250_linear_apply : q3527250_complex -> E;
  q3527250_linear_add :
    forall z w : q3527250_complex,
      q3527250_linear_apply (q3527250_cadd z w) =
      q3527250_add V
        (q3527250_linear_apply z) (q3527250_linear_apply w);
  q3527250_linear_smul :
    forall z w : q3527250_complex,
      q3527250_linear_apply (q3527250_cmul z w) =
      q3527250_smul V z (q3527250_linear_apply w);
  q3527250_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall z : q3527250_complex,
        q3527250_norm V (q3527250_linear_apply z) <=
        bound * q3527250_cmodulus z
}.

Arguments q3527250_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Definition q3527250_continuous_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (S : q3527250_complex -> Prop)
    (z : q3527250_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q3527250_complex,
        S w ->
        q3527250_cmodulus (q3527250_csub w z) < delta ->
        q3527250_norm V (q3527250_sub V (f w) (f z)) < epsilon.

Definition q3527250_continuous_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (S : q3527250_complex -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall z : q3527250_complex,
    S z -> q3527250_continuous_within_at V f S z.

Definition q3527250_has_frechet_deriv_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (S : q3527250_complex -> Prop)
    (z : q3527250_complex)
    (D : q3527250_complex_linear_map V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q3527250_complex,
        S w ->
        q3527250_cmodulus (q3527250_csub w z) < delta ->
        q3527250_norm V
          (q3527250_sub V
            (q3527250_sub V (f w) (f z))
            (q3527250_linear_apply D (q3527250_csub w z))) <=
        epsilon * q3527250_cmodulus (q3527250_csub w z).

Definition q3527250_differentiable_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (S : q3527250_complex -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall z : q3527250_complex,
    S z ->
    exists D : q3527250_complex_linear_map V,
      @q3527250_has_frechet_deriv_within_at E V f S z D.

Definition q3527250_diff_cont_on_closed_strip
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (l u : R) : Prop :=
  q3527250_differentiable_on V f
    (q3527250_vertical_strip l u) /\
  q3527250_continuous_on V f
    (q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u).

Definition q3527250_bounded_on_closed_strip
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (l u : R) : Prop :=
  exists bound : R,
    forall z : q3527250_complex,
      q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u z ->
      q3527250_norm V (f z) <= bound.

Definition q3527250_is_boundary_norm_supremum
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (x supremum : R) : Prop :=
  (forall z : q3527250_complex,
      fst z = x ->
      q3527250_norm V (f z) <= supremum) /\
  forall upper : R,
    (forall z : q3527250_complex,
      fst z = x ->
      q3527250_norm V (f z) <= upper) ->
    supremum <= upper.

Definition q3527250_sSupNormIm
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (x : R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0)
    (fun supremum : R =>
      q3527250_is_boundary_norm_supremum V f x supremum).

Definition q3527250_interp_strip_norm
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
    (l u : R)
    (z : q3527250_complex) : R :=
  let left := q3527250_sSupNormIm V f l in
  let right := q3527250_sSupNormIm V f u in
  let t := (fst z - l) / (u - l) in
  if Req_EM_T left 0 then 0
  else if Req_EM_T right 0 then 0
  else
    exp (ln left * (1 - t)) *
    exp (ln right * t).

Theorem Complex_HadamardThreeLines_norm_le_interpStrip_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q3527250_normed_complex_vector_space E)
         (l u : R)
         (f : q3527250_complex -> E)
         (z : q3527250_complex),
    l < u ->
    q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u z ->
    q3527250_diff_cont_on_closed_strip V f l u ->
    q3527250_bounded_on_closed_strip V f l u ->
    q3527250_norm V (f z) <=
      q3527250_interp_strip_norm V f l u z.
Admitted.

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527250, "Hadamard three-lines theorem": a bounded complex-differentiable
  complex-normed-space-valued function on a vertical strip is bounded at each point by
  the geometric interpolation of its boundary-line norm suprema. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complex_Transcendental"
begin

definition q3527250_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527250_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q3527250_has_complex_derivative ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527250_has_complex_derivative cscale f d z \<longleftrightarrow>
    ((\<lambda>w. cscale (inverse (w - z)) (f w - f z)) \<longlongrightarrow> d) (at z)"

definition q3527250_vertical_strip :: "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex set" where
  "q3527250_vertical_strip l u = {z. l < Re z \<and> Re z < u}"

definition q3527250_vertical_closed_strip ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex set" where
  "q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u = {z. l \<le> Re z \<and> Re z \<le> u}"

definition q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl cscale f l u \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> q3527250_vertical_strip l u.
      \<exists>d. q3527250_has_complex_derivative cscale f d z) \<and>
    continuous_on (q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u) f"

definition q3527250_sSup_norm_im ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q3527250_sSup_norm_im f x =
    Sup ((\<lambda>z. norm (f z)) ` {z. Re z = x})"

definition q3527250_interp_strip ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow>
      real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q3527250_interp_strip f l u z =
    (if q3527250_sSup_norm_im f l = 0 \<or>
        q3527250_sSup_norm_im f u = 0
     then 0
     else
       (of_real (q3527250_sSup_norm_im f l) :: complex) powr
         (1 - ((z - of_real l) / (of_real u - of_real l))) *
       (of_real (q3527250_sSup_norm_im f u) :: complex) powr
         ((z - of_real l) / (of_real u - of_real l)))"

theorem q3527250_hadamard_three_lines:
  fixes cscale ::
      "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and l u :: real
    and z :: complex
  assumes complex_space: "q3527250_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and strip_nonempty: "l < u"
    and z_in_strip: "z \<in> q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u"
    and diff_cont:
      "q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl cscale f l u"
    and bounded:
      "bdd_above
        ((\<lambda>w. norm (f w)) ` q3527250_vertical_closed_strip l u)"
  shows
    "norm (f z) \<le> norm (q3527250_interp_strip f l u z)"
  sorry

end

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527250,
  "Hadamard three-lines theorem": a bounded complex-differentiable function
  into an arbitrary complex normed space is bounded inside a vertical strip
  by the interpolation of its boundary-line supremum norms. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let q3527250_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q3527250_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q3527250_output;;
let q3527250_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q3527250_formatter path);;
let q3527250_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q3527250_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q3527250_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q3527250_formatter ();;
close_out q3527250_output;;
if not q3527250_loaded then
  failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q3527250_HADAMARD_THREE_LINES_THEOREM =
  `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
   let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
   let cadd =
     \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
   let cneg =
     \(z:real#real). (--(FST z),--(SND z)) in
   let csub =
     \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       (FST z - FST w,SND z - SND w) in
   let cmul =
     \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
       (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
        FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
   let cnorm =
     \(z:real#real).
       sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in
   let is_complex_normed_space =
     \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
      (smul:(real#real)->A->A) (normA:A->real).
       (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
       (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
       (!x:A. smul cone x = x) /\
       (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
          smul (cmul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
          smul (cadd a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!x:A. smul czero x = zero) /\
       (!a:real#real. !x y:A.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:real#real. smul a zero = zero) /\
       normA zero = &0 /\
       (!x:A. &0 <= normA x) /\
       (!x:A. normA x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. normA (neg x) = normA x) /\
       (!a:real#real. !x:A.
          normA (smul a x) = cnorm a * normA x) /\
       (!x y:A. normA (add x y) <= normA x + normA y) in
   let subA =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (x:A) (y:A). add x (neg y) in
   let vertical_closed_strip =
     \l u (z:real#real). l <= FST z /\ FST z <= u in
   let vertical_strip =
     \l u (z:real#real). l < FST z /\ FST z < u in
   let in_closure_of_vertical_strip =
     \(l:real) (u:real) (x:real#real).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?w:real#real.
               vertical_strip l u w /\
               cnorm(csub w x) < epsilon in
   let continuous_on_strip_closure =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (normA:A->real)
      (f:(real#real)->A) (l:real) (u:real).
       !x:real#real.
         in_closure_of_vertical_strip l u x
         ==> !epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !y:real#real.
                       in_closure_of_vertical_strip l u y /\
                       cnorm(csub y x) < delta
                       ==> normA (subA add neg (f y) (f x)) < epsilon in
   let complex_differentiable_within_strip_at =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:(real#real)->A->A)
      (normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A)
      (l:real) (u:real) (x:real#real).
       ?derivative:A.
         !epsilon:real.
           &0 < epsilon
           ==> ?delta:real.
                 &0 < delta /\
                 !y:real#real.
                   vertical_strip l u y /\
                   cnorm(csub y x) < delta
                   ==> normA
                         (subA add neg
                           (subA add neg (f y) (f x))
                           (smul (csub y x) derivative))
                       <= epsilon * cnorm(csub y x) in
   let differentiable_on_open_strip =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:(real#real)->A->A)
      (normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A) (l:real) (u:real).
       !x:real#real.
         vertical_strip l u x
         ==> complex_differentiable_within_strip_at
               add neg smul normA f l u x in
   let diff_cont_on_cl =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:(real#real)->A->A)
      (normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A) (l:real) (u:real).
       differentiable_on_open_strip add neg smul normA f l u /\
       continuous_on_strip_closure add neg normA f l u in
   let bounded_on_closed_strip =
     \(normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A) (l:real) (u:real).
       ?bound:real.
         !x:real#real.
           vertical_closed_strip l u x ==> normA (f x) <= bound in
   let sSupNormIm =
     \(normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A) (x:real).
       sup {r:real |
              ?w:real#real. FST w = x /\ r = normA (f w)} in
   let interpNorm =
     \(normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A)
      (l:real) (u:real) (z:real#real).
       let ml = sSupNormIm normA f l in
       let mu = sSupNormIm normA f u in
       let t = (FST z - l) / (u - l) in
       if ml = &0 \/ mu = &0
       then &0
       else exp((&1 - t) * ln ml) * exp(t * ln mu) in
   !(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
    (smul:(real#real)->A->A) (normA:A->real)
    (l:real) (u:real) (f:(real#real)->A) (z:real#real).
      is_complex_normed_space zero add neg smul normA /\
      l < u /\
      vertical_closed_strip l u z /\
      diff_cont_on_cl add neg smul normA f l u /\
      bounded_on_closed_strip normA f l u
      ==> normA (f z) <= interpNorm normA f l u z`;;

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527250,
;; "Hadamard three-lines theorem": a bounded complex-differentiable function
;; into an arbitrary complex normed space is bounded inside a vertical strip
;; by the geometric interpolation of its boundary-line suprema.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present arbitrary real and normed-space carriers,
;; operations, functions, and subsets.  The assumptions below explicitly
;; present a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real numbers; complex
;; numbers are real-coordinate pairs.  Continuity and complex
;; differentiability are expanded by epsilon-delta definitions.
;; Real subsets are first-order set objects with an arbitrary generic
;; membership interface and interpreted comprehension constructors.  In
;; particular, each boundary norm image below has membership definitionally
;; equal to its existential image condition.  The real supremum operation is
;; constrained by completeness to return its uniquely characterized least
;; upper bound.
;;
;; For positive real a and complex w, ‖a^w‖ = exp(Re(w) log(a)).  The final
;; bound uses this identity in both factors.  This is definitionally
;; equivalent to the norm of INTERPSTRIP' in the source, while its explicit
;; zero-boundary branch is preserved.

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

(defstub q3527250-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-generic-set-member-p (real set value) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-supremum (real set) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-square-root (real value) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-exponential (real value) t)
(defstub q3527250-r-logarithm (real value) t)

(defun q3527250-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q3527250-r-add
   real left (q3527250-r-negate real right)))

(defun q3527250-r-divide (real numerator denominator)
  (q3527250-r-multiply
   real numerator (q3527250-r-inverse real denominator)))

(defun q3527250-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q3527250-r-less real right left)))

(defun q3527250-r-absolute-value (real value)
  (if (q3527250-r-less
       real value (q3527250-r-zero real))
      (q3527250-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun q3527250-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q3527250-r-member-p real value)
   (q3527250-r-less
    real (q3527250-r-zero real) value)))

(defun-sk q3527250-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527250-r-member-p real x)
      (q3527250-r-member-p real y)
      (q3527250-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q3527250-r-zero real))
            (one (q3527250-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q3527250-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q3527250-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q3527250-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q3527250-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q3527250-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q3527250-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q3527250-r-member-p real zero)
        (q3527250-r-member-p real one)
        (q3527250-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q3527250-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q3527250-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q3527250-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q3527250-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q3527250-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q3527250-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q3527250-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q3527250-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q3527250-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q3527250-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q3527250-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q3527250-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q3527250-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q3527250-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q3527250-r-multiply
          real x (q3527250-r-add real y z))
         (q3527250-r-add
          real
          (q3527250-r-multiply real x y)
          (q3527250-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q3527250-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527250-r-member-p real x)
      (q3527250-r-member-p real y)
      (q3527250-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q3527250-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q3527250-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q3527250-r-less real x y)
         (q3527250-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527250-r-less real x y)
          (q3527250-r-less real y z))
         (q3527250-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q3527250-r-less real x y)
         (q3527250-r-less
          real
          (q3527250-r-add real x z)
          (q3527250-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q3527250-r-less real zero x)
          (q3527250-r-less real zero y))
         (q3527250-r-less
          real zero
          (q3527250-r-multiply real x y))))))))

;; Square root and the standard real exponential and logarithm.

(defun-sk q3527250-square-root-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527250-r-member-p real x)
     (let ((root (q3527250-r-square-root real x))
           (zero (q3527250-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (q3527250-r-member-p real root)
        (implies
         (q3527250-r-less real x zero)
         (equal root zero))
        (implies
         (not (q3527250-r-less real x zero))
         (and
          (q3527250-r-leq real zero root)
          (equal
           (q3527250-r-multiply real root root)
           x))))))))

(defun-sk q3527250-real-derivative-nearby-p
    (real function point derivative epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527250-r-member-p real y)
      (q3527250-r-less
       real
       (q3527250-r-absolute-value
        real
        (q3527250-r-subtract real y point))
       radius))
     (q3527250-r-leq
      real
      (q3527250-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q3527250-r-subtract
        real
        (q3527250-r-subtract
         real
         (q3527250-r-exponential real y)
         (q3527250-r-exponential real point))
        (q3527250-r-multiply
         real derivative
         (q3527250-r-subtract real y point))))
      (q3527250-r-multiply
       real epsilon
       (q3527250-r-absolute-value
        real
        (q3527250-r-subtract real y point)))))))

(defun-sk q3527250-real-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (real function point derivative epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q3527250-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q3527250-real-derivative-nearby-p
      real function point derivative epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q3527250-real-has-derivative-at-p
    (real function point derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q3527250-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q3527250-real-derivative-radius-exists-p
      real function point derivative epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527250-exponential-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527250-r-member-p real x)
     (and
      (q3527250-r-positive-p
       real (q3527250-r-exponential real x))
      (q3527250-real-has-derivative-at-p
       real
       'q3527250-r-exponential
       x
       (q3527250-r-exponential real x))))))

(defun q3527250-exponential-operation-p (real)
  (and
   (equal
    (q3527250-r-exponential
     real (q3527250-r-zero real))
    (q3527250-r-one real))
   (q3527250-exponential-laws-p real)))

(defun-sk q3527250-logarithm-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (implies
      (q3527250-r-member-p real x)
      (equal
       (q3527250-r-logarithm
        real (q3527250-r-exponential real x))
       x))
     (implies
      (q3527250-r-positive-p real x)
      (and
       (q3527250-r-member-p
        real (q3527250-r-logarithm real x))
       (equal
        (q3527250-r-exponential
         real (q3527250-r-logarithm real x))
        x))))))

;; Complex numbers are pairs (real-part . imaginary-part).

(defun q3527250-complex-p (real value)
  (and
   (consp value)
   (q3527250-r-member-p real (car value))
   (q3527250-r-member-p real (cdr value))))

(defun q3527250-c-zero (real)
  (cons
   (q3527250-r-zero real)
   (q3527250-r-zero real)))

(defun q3527250-c-one (real)
  (cons
   (q3527250-r-one real)
   (q3527250-r-zero real)))

(defun q3527250-c-of-real (real value)
  (cons value (q3527250-r-zero real)))

(defun q3527250-c-add (real left right)
  (cons
   (q3527250-r-add real (car left) (car right))
   (q3527250-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun q3527250-c-negate (real value)
  (cons
   (q3527250-r-negate real (car value))
   (q3527250-r-negate real (cdr value))))

(defun q3527250-c-subtract (real left right)
  (q3527250-c-add
   real left (q3527250-c-negate real right)))

(defun q3527250-c-multiply (real left right)
  (cons
   (q3527250-r-subtract
    real
    (q3527250-r-multiply real (car left) (car right))
    (q3527250-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right)))
   (q3527250-r-add
    real
    (q3527250-r-multiply real (car left) (cdr right))
    (q3527250-r-multiply real (cdr left) (car right)))))

(defun q3527250-c-norm (real value)
  (q3527250-r-square-root
   real
   (q3527250-r-add
    real
    (q3527250-r-multiply real (car value) (car value))
    (q3527250-r-multiply real (cdr value) (cdr value)))))

;; An arbitrary normed vector space over the represented complex numbers.

(defstub q3527250-e-member-p (space value) t)
(defstub q3527250-e-zero (space) t)
(defstub q3527250-e-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q3527250-e-negate (space value) t)
(defstub q3527250-e-smul (real space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q3527250-e-norm (real space value) t)

(defun q3527250-e-subtract (space left right)
  (q3527250-e-add
   space left (q3527250-e-negate space right)))

(defun-sk q3527250-normed-space-laws-p
    (real space)
  (forall (x y z a b)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527250-e-member-p space x)
       (q3527250-e-member-p space y)
       (q3527250-e-member-p space z))
      (let* ((zero-e (q3527250-e-zero space))
             (zero-r (q3527250-r-zero real))
             (xy-add (q3527250-e-add space x y))
             (yz-add (q3527250-e-add space y z))
             (neg-x (q3527250-e-negate space x))
             (norm-x (q3527250-e-norm real space x))
             (norm-y (q3527250-e-norm real space y)))
        (and
         (q3527250-e-member-p space xy-add)
         (q3527250-e-member-p space neg-x)
         (q3527250-r-member-p real norm-x)
         (q3527250-r-member-p real norm-y)
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-add space xy-add z)
          (q3527250-e-add space x yz-add))
         (equal xy-add (q3527250-e-add space y x))
         (equal (q3527250-e-add space x zero-e) x)
         (equal (q3527250-e-add space x neg-x) zero-e)
         (q3527250-r-leq real zero-r norm-x)
         (iff (equal norm-x zero-r)
              (equal x zero-e))
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-norm real space neg-x)
          norm-x)
         (q3527250-r-leq
          real
          (q3527250-e-norm real space xy-add)
          (q3527250-r-add real norm-x norm-y)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q3527250-complex-p real a)
       (q3527250-complex-p real b)
       (q3527250-e-member-p space x)
       (q3527250-e-member-p space y))
      (let ((zero-c (q3527250-c-zero real))
            (one-c (q3527250-c-one real))
            (zero-e (q3527250-e-zero space)))
        (and
         (q3527250-e-member-p
          space (q3527250-e-smul real space a x))
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-smul real space one-c x)
          x)
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-smul
           real space
           (q3527250-c-multiply real a b) x)
          (q3527250-e-smul
           real space a
           (q3527250-e-smul real space b x)))
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-smul
           real space
           (q3527250-c-add real a b) x)
          (q3527250-e-add
           space
           (q3527250-e-smul real space a x)
           (q3527250-e-smul real space b x)))
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-smul
           real space a
           (q3527250-e-add space x y))
          (q3527250-e-add
           space
           (q3527250-e-smul real space a x)
           (q3527250-e-smul real space a y)))
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-smul real space zero-c x)
          zero-e)
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-smul real space a zero-e)
          zero-e)
         (equal
          (q3527250-e-norm
           real space
           (q3527250-e-smul real space a x))
          (q3527250-r-multiply
           real
           (q3527250-c-norm real a)
           (q3527250-e-norm real space x)))))))))

(defun q3527250-normed-complex-space-p
    (real space)
  (and
   (q3527250-e-member-p
    space (q3527250-e-zero space))
   (q3527250-normed-space-laws-p real space)))

;; Arbitrary functions C -> E and the two vertical strips.

(defstub q3527250-function-value (function argument) t)

(defun-sk q3527250-function-typed-p
    (real space function)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q3527250-complex-p real z)
     (q3527250-e-member-p
      space (q3527250-function-value function z)))))

(defun q3527250-open-strip-p
    (real lower upper z)
  (and
   (q3527250-complex-p real z)
   (q3527250-r-less real lower (car z))
   (q3527250-r-less real (car z) upper)))

(defun q3527250-closed-strip-p
    (real lower upper z)
  (and
   (q3527250-complex-p real z)
   (q3527250-r-leq real lower (car z))
   (q3527250-r-leq real (car z) upper)))

;; Boundedness of ‖f‖ on the full closed strip.

(defun-sk q3527250-closed-strip-bound-p
    (real space function lower upper bound)
  (forall (w)
    (implies
     (q3527250-closed-strip-p real lower upper w)
     (q3527250-r-leq
      real
      (q3527250-e-norm
       real space (q3527250-function-value function w))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q3527250-bounded-on-closed-strip-p
    (real space function lower upper)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q3527250-r-member-p real bound)
     (q3527250-closed-strip-bound-p
      real space function lower upper bound))))

;; Continuity on the closed strip.

(defun-sk q3527250-continuity-nearby-p
    (real space function lower upper point epsilon radius)
  (forall (w)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527250-closed-strip-p real lower upper w)
      (q3527250-r-less
       real
       (q3527250-c-norm
        real (q3527250-c-subtract real w point))
       radius))
     (q3527250-r-less
      real
      (q3527250-e-norm
       real space
       (q3527250-e-subtract
        space
        (q3527250-function-value function w)
        (q3527250-function-value function point)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527250-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (real space function lower upper point epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q3527250-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q3527250-continuity-nearby-p
      real space function lower upper point epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q3527250-continuous-within-closed-at-p
    (real space function lower upper point)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q3527250-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q3527250-continuity-radius-exists-p
      real space function lower upper point epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527250-continuous-on-closed-strip-p
    (real space function lower upper)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q3527250-closed-strip-p
      real lower upper point)
     (q3527250-continuous-within-closed-at-p
      real space function lower upper point))))

;; Complex differentiability within the open strip.  A complex-linear map
;; C -> E is represented by its value at 1, so its value at h is h • derivative.

(defun-sk q3527250-derivative-nearby-p
    (real space function lower upper point derivative epsilon radius)
  (forall (w)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527250-open-strip-p real lower upper w)
      (q3527250-r-less
       real
       (q3527250-c-norm
        real (q3527250-c-subtract real w point))
       radius))
     (q3527250-r-leq
      real
      (q3527250-e-norm
       real space
       (q3527250-e-subtract
        space
        (q3527250-e-subtract
         space
         (q3527250-function-value function w)
         (q3527250-function-value function point))
        (q3527250-e-smul
         real space
         (q3527250-c-subtract real w point)
         derivative)))
      (q3527250-r-multiply
       real epsilon
       (q3527250-c-norm
        real (q3527250-c-subtract real w point)))))))

(defun-sk q3527250-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (real space function lower upper point derivative epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q3527250-r-positive-p real radius)
     (q3527250-derivative-nearby-p
      real space function lower upper point derivative epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q3527250-has-complex-derivative-within-p
    (real space function lower upper point derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q3527250-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q3527250-derivative-radius-exists-p
      real space function lower upper point derivative epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3527250-differentiable-within-open-at-p
    (real space function lower upper point)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (q3527250-e-member-p space derivative)
     (q3527250-has-complex-derivative-within-p
      real space function lower upper point derivative))))

(defun-sk q3527250-differentiable-on-open-strip-p
    (real space function lower upper)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q3527250-open-strip-p real lower upper point)
     (q3527250-differentiable-within-open-at-p
      real space function lower upper point))))

(defun q3527250-diff-cont-on-closed-p
    (real space function lower upper)
  (and
   (q3527250-differentiable-on-open-strip-p
    real space function lower upper)
   (q3527250-continuous-on-closed-strip-p
    real space function lower upper)))

;; The set {‖f(w)‖ : Re(w) = boundary} is represented by an interpreted
;; first-order constructor.  Its membership is exactly the following
;; existential image condition.

(defun-sk q3527250-line-norm-image-member-p
    (real space function boundary value)
  (exists (w)
    (and
     (q3527250-r-member-p real value)
     (q3527250-complex-p real w)
     (equal (car w) boundary)
     (equal
      (q3527250-e-norm
       real space (q3527250-function-value function w))
      value))))

(defun q3527250-line-norm-image-set
    (real space function boundary)
  (list
   :q3527250-line-norm-image
   real space function boundary))

(defun q3527250-r-singleton-set (real value)
  (list :q3527250-r-singleton real value))

(defun q3527250-r-set-member-p (real set value)
  (and
   (q3527250-r-member-p real value)
   (cond
    ((and
      (consp set)
      (equal (car set) :q3527250-line-norm-image))
     (and
      (true-listp set)
      (equal (len set) 5)
      (equal real (cadr set))
      (q3527250-line-norm-image-member-p
       real
       (caddr set)
       (cadddr set)
       (car (cddddr set))
       value)))
    ((and
      (consp set)
      (equal (car set) :q3527250-r-singleton))
     (and
      (true-listp set)
      (equal (len set) 3)
      (equal real (cadr set))
      (equal value (caddr set))))
    (t
     (q3527250-r-generic-set-member-p
      real set value)))))

(defun-sk q3527250-r-set-contained-in-reals-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies

(defun q3527250-r-valid-set-p (real set)
  (q3527250-r-set-contained-in-reals-p real set))

(defun-sk q3527250-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)

      (q3527250-r-member-p real x)
      (q3527250-r-set-member-p real set x))

(defun-sk q3527250-r-bounded-above-p (real set)

(defun-sk q3527250-r-supremum-p
    (real set supremum)

     (q3527250-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies

       (q3527250-r-member-p real bound)
       (q3527250-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q3527250-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

      (q3527250-r-valid-set-p real set)

      (q3527250-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q3527250-r-supremum-p

(defun q3527250-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q3527250-r-zero real))
        (one (q3527250-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q3527250-r-member-p real zero)
     (q3527250-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q3527250-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q3527250-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q3527250-r-less real zero one)

     ;; unconditional nonempty member, so completeness cannot be vacuous
     ;; merely because the generic membership interface is empty.
     (q3527250-r-set-nonempty-p
      real (q3527250-r-singleton-set real zero))

(defun q3527250-line-supremum
    (real space function boundary)
  (q3527250-r-supremum
   real
   (q3527250-line-norm-image-set
    real space function boundary)))

;; The norm of the source interpolation.  In the nonzero branch the two
;; least upper bounds are positive, so complex power reduces exactly to
;; exp(real-exponent * log(base)) after taking norms.

(defun q3527250-interpolation-bound
    (real left-supremum right-supremum parameter)

      (or
       (equal left-supremum (q3527250-r-zero real))
       (equal right-supremum (q3527250-r-zero real)))
      (q3527250-r-zero real)
    (q3527250-r-multiply
     real
     (q3527250-r-exponential
      real
      (q3527250-r-multiply
       real
       (q3527250-r-subtract
        real (q3527250-r-one real) parameter)
       (q3527250-r-logarithm real left-supremum)))
     (q3527250-r-exponential
      real

       real
       parameter
       (q3527250-r-logarithm real right-supremum))))))

         (q3527250-line-supremum
          real space function lower))
        (right-supremum
         (q3527250-line-supremum
          real space function upper))

         (q3527250-r-divide
          real
          (q3527250-r-subtract real (car z) lower)
          (q3527250-r-subtract real upper lower))))
    (q3527250-r-leq
     real
     (q3527250-e-norm
      real space (q3527250-function-value function z))
     (q3527250-interpolation-bound
      real left-supremum right-supremum parameter))))

    thousand-theorems-q3527250-hadamard-three-lines-theorem-statement

  (forall (real space function lower upper z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527250-real-field-p real)
      (q3527250-square-root-laws-p real)
      (q3527250-exponential-operation-p real)
      (q3527250-logarithm-laws-p real)
      (q3527250-normed-complex-space-p real space)
      (q3527250-function-typed-p real space function)
      (q3527250-r-member-p real lower)
      (q3527250-r-member-p real upper)
      (q3527250-r-less real lower upper)
      (q3527250-complex-p real z)
      (q3527250-closed-strip-p real lower upper z)
      (q3527250-diff-cont-on-closed-p
       real space function lower upper)
      (q3527250-bounded-on-closed-strip-p
