title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527250,
-- "Hadamard three-lines theorem": the norm of a bounded, closed-strip
-- continuous and interior-holomorphic function is bounded by the canonical
-- interpolation of its two vertical-line norm suprema. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <=N n
  suc<=suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

powerNatR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerNatR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerNatR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerNatR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirstR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirstR reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirstR reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (sumFirstR reals terms n)
    (terms n)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x n =
  sumFirstR reals
    (\ k ->
      divideR reals
        (powerNatR reals x k)
        (fromNatR reals (factorial k)))
    n

RealSequenceLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RealSequenceLimit {R = R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals exponent value =
  RealSequenceLimit reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals exponent)
    value

PositiveLogarithmValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
PositiveLogarithmValue reals base logarithm =
  Both
    (Positive reals base)
    (ExponentialValue reals logarithm base)

CanonicalPositiveRealPowerValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CanonicalPositiveRealPowerValue {R = R} reals base exponent value =
  Exists R
    (\ logarithm ->
      Both
        (PositiveLogarithmValue reals base logarithm)
        (ExponentialValue reals
          (multiplyR reals exponent logarithm)
          value))

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexFromReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
complexFromReal reals x =
  complex x (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

complexDivideByReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  R ->
  Complex R
complexDivideByReal reals (complex a b) denominator =
  complex
    (divideR reals a denominator)
    (divideR reals b denominator)

record ComplexNorm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    normC : Complex R -> R
    norm-nonnegativeC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normC z)
    norm-zeroC :
      normC (complexZero reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC z == zeroR reals ->
      z == complexZero reals
    norm-negateC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC (complexNegate reals z) == normC z
    norm-addC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normC (complexAdd reals z w))
        (addR reals (normC z) (normC w))
    norm-multiplyC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      normC (complexMultiply reals z w) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC w)
    norm-squareC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexNorm

record NormedComplexVectorSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals)
  (E : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : Complex R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexOne reals) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexMultiply reals a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexAdd reals a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC complexNorm a) (normE x)

open NormedComplexVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

InOpenVerticalStrip :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
InOpenVerticalStrip reals lower upper z =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower (realPart z))
    (StrictLess reals (realPart z) upper)

InClosedVerticalStrip :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
InClosedVerticalStrip reals lower upper z =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals lower (realPart z))
    (lessOrEqualR reals (realPart z) upper)

ContinuousWithinClosedStripAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinClosedStripAt {R = R} reals complexNorm space
  function lower upper point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((z : Complex R) ->
          InClosedVerticalStrip reals lower upper z ->
          StrictLess reals
            (normC complexNorm (complexSubtract reals z point))
            delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (normE space
              (subtractE space (function z) (function point)))
            epsilon))

ContinuousOnClosedStrip :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousOnClosedStrip {R = R} reals complexNorm space
  function lower upper =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  InClosedVerticalStrip reals lower upper point ->
  ContinuousWithinClosedStripAt
    reals complexNorm space function lower upper point

ComplexDifferentiableAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ComplexDifferentiableAt {R = R} {E = E}
  reals complexNorm space function point =
  Exists E
    (\ derivative ->
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Both
            (Positive reals delta)
            ((z : Complex R) ->
              StrictLess reals
                (normC complexNorm
                  (complexSubtract reals z point))
                delta ->
              lessOrEqualR reals
                (normE space
                  (subtractE space
                    (subtractE space
                      (function z)
                      (function point))
                    (scaleE space
                      (complexSubtract reals z point)
                      derivative)))
                (multiplyR reals epsilon
                  (normC complexNorm
                    (complexSubtract reals z point))))))

DifferentiableOnOpenStrip :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DifferentiableOnOpenStrip {R = R} reals complexNorm space
  function lower upper =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  InOpenVerticalStrip reals lower upper point ->
  ComplexDifferentiableAt reals complexNorm space function point

BoundedOnClosedStrip :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
BoundedOnClosedStrip {R = R} reals space function lower upper =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      (z : Complex R) ->
      InClosedVerticalStrip reals lower upper z ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE space (function z)) bound)

SupNormOnVerticalLine :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SupNormOnVerticalLine {R = R} reals space function line supremum =
  Both
    ((z : Complex R) ->
      realPart z == line ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE space (function z)) supremum)
    ((upperBound : R) ->
      ((z : Complex R) ->
        realPart z == line ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (normE space (function z))
          upperBound) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals supremum upperBound)

normalizedComplexParameter :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
normalizedComplexParameter reals lower upper z =
  complexDivideByReal reals
    (complexSubtract reals z (complexFromReal reals lower))
    (subtractR reals upper lower)

leftInterpolationExponent :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
leftInterpolationExponent reals lower upper z =
  complexSubtract reals
    (complexOne reals)
    (normalizedComplexParameter reals lower upper z)

CanonicalComplexPowerNormValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  R ->
  Set
CanonicalComplexPowerNormValue reals base exponent value =
  CanonicalPositiveRealPowerValue reals
    base
    (realPart exponent)
    value

ZeroBoundarySupremum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ZeroBoundarySupremum reals leftSupremum rightSupremum =
  Either
    (leftSupremum == zeroR reals)
    (rightSupremum == zeroR reals)

InterpStripPrimeNormBound :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (function : Complex R -> E) ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  (lower upper leftSupremum rightSupremum : R) ->
  Set
InterpStripPrimeNormBound {R = R} {E = E}
  reals space function z lower upper
  leftSupremum rightSupremum =
  Either
    (Both
      (ZeroBoundarySupremum reals leftSupremum rightSupremum)
      (lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE space (function z))
        (zeroR reals)))
    (Both
      (Not (ZeroBoundarySupremum reals leftSupremum rightSupremum))
      (Exists R
        (\ leftPowerNorm ->
          Both
            (CanonicalComplexPowerNormValue reals
              leftSupremum
              (leftInterpolationExponent reals lower upper z)
              leftPowerNorm)
            (Exists R
              (\ rightPowerNorm ->
                Both
                  (CanonicalComplexPowerNormValue reals
                    rightSupremum
                    (normalizedComplexParameter reals lower upper z)
                    rightPowerNorm)
                  (lessOrEqualR reals
                    (normE space (function z))
                    (multiplyR reals
                      leftPowerNorm
                      rightPowerNorm)))))))

SupremumInterpolationConclusion :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (function : Complex R -> E) ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
SupremumInterpolationConclusion {R = R} reals space function z lower upper =
  Exists R
    (\ leftSupremum ->
      Both
        (SupNormOnVerticalLine reals space
          function lower leftSupremum)
        (Exists R
          (\ rightSupremum ->
            Both
              (SupNormOnVerticalLine reals space
                function upper rightSupremum)
              (InterpStripPrimeNormBound reals space function z
                lower upper leftSupremum rightSupremum))))

hadamard-three-lines-theorem : Set2
hadamard-three-lines-theorem =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (function : Complex R -> E) ->
  (z : Complex R) ->
  (lower upper : R) ->
  StrictLess reals lower upper ->
  InClosedVerticalStrip reals lower upper z ->
  ContinuousOnClosedStrip
    reals complexNorm space function lower upper ->
  DifferentiableOnOpenStrip
    reals complexNorm space function lower upper ->
  BoundedOnClosedStrip reals space function lower upper ->
  SupremumInterpolationConclusion reals space
    function z lower upper

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527250, "Hadamard three-lines theorem": a bounded complex-differentiable
  function on a vertical strip is bounded by the complex interpolation of
  the suprema of its boundary norms. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val q3527250_normed_complex_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_normed_complex_space_def",
  ``q3527250_normed_complex_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = modu a * norm x)``);

val q3527250_in_vertical_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_in_vertical_strip_def",
  ``q3527250_in_vertical_strip (l : real) (u : real) (z : complex) <=>
      l < RE z /\ RE z < u``);

val q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip_def",
  ``q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip
      (l : real) (u : real) (z : complex) <=>
      l <= RE z /\ RE z <= u``);

val q3527250_continuous_on_closed_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_continuous_on_closed_strip_def",
  ``q3527250_continuous_on_closed_strip
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e)
      (l : real) (u : real) <=>
      !x.
        q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip l u x ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip l u y /\
              modu (y - x) < delta
              ==>
              norm (add (f y) (neg (f x))) < epsilon``);

val q3527250_complex_differentiable_on_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_complex_differentiable_on_strip_def",
  ``q3527250_complex_differentiable_on_strip
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (l : real) (u : real) <=>
      !x.
        q3527250_in_vertical_strip l u x ==>
        ?deriv : 'e.
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !h : complex.
                0 < modu h /\ modu h < delta
                ==>
                norm
                  (add
                    (add (f (x + h)) (neg (f x)))
                    (neg (smul h deriv))) <
                epsilon * modu h``);

val q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl_def",
  ``q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (l : real) (u : real) <=>
      q3527250_complex_differentiable_on_strip
        add neg smul norm f l u /\
      q3527250_continuous_on_closed_strip
        add neg norm f l u``);

val q3527250_bounded_on_closed_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_bounded_on_closed_strip_def",
  ``q3527250_bounded_on_closed_strip
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e)
      (l : real) (u : real) <=>
      ?B : real.
        !w.
          q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip l u w ==>
          norm (f w) <= B``);

val q3527250_sSupNormIm_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_sSupNormIm_def",
  ``q3527250_sSupNormIm
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e) (x : real) =
      sup
        (\r : real.
          ?w : complex.
            RE w = x /\ r = norm (f w))``);

val q3527250_positive_real_cpow_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_positive_real_cpow_def",
  ``q3527250_positive_real_cpow (r : real) (z : complex) =
      complex_exp (complex_of_real (ln r) * z)``);

val q3527250_interpStrip_def = new_definition (
  "q3527250_interpStrip_def",
  ``q3527250_interpStrip
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e)
      (l : real) (u : real) (z : complex) =
      let ml = q3527250_sSupNormIm norm f l in
      let mu = q3527250_sSupNormIm norm f u in
        if ml = 0 \/ mu = 0 then
          0
        else
          q3527250_positive_real_cpow ml
            (1 -
              (z - complex_of_real l) /
                (complex_of_real u - complex_of_real l)) *
          q3527250_positive_real_cpow mu
            ((z - complex_of_real l) /
              (complex_of_real u - complex_of_real l))``);

val norm_le_interpStrip_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (l : real) (u : real) (f : complex -> 'e) (z : complex).
      q3527250_normed_complex_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      l < u /\
      q3527250_in_vertical_closed_strip l u z /\
      q3527250_diff_cont_on_cl add neg smul norm f l u /\
      q3527250_bounded_on_closed_strip norm f l u
      ==>
      norm (f z) <=
        modu (q3527250_interpStrip norm f l u z)``;

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527250
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3527250), "Hadamard three-lines theorem":
  a bounded complex-differentiable vector-valued function on a vertical strip,
  continuous on its closure, is bounded at each point by the interpolated
  supremum norms on the two boundary lines. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q3527250OpenStrip and Q3527250ClosedStrip are the inverse images under the
  real-part map of the open and closed real intervals with endpoints l and u.
  Q3527250ClosureStrip is the actual topological closure of the open strip.

  Q3527250ContinuousOn is relative epsilon-delta continuity.
  Q3527250HasComplexDerivWithinAt is the one-dimensional Frechet definition
  within a set: D is the value of the complex-linear derivative, so its action
  on an increment h is h scalar-multiplied by D. Q3527250DiffContOnCl combines
  differentiability within the open strip with continuity on its closure.
  Under the theorem's assumption l < u, that closure is exactly
  Q3527250ClosedStrip.

  Q3527250SupNormIm is the real supremum of the norms of F on the complete
  vertical line with fixed real part. Q3527250Interp is exactly the source
  interpStrip' definition: it is zero if either boundary supremum is zero,
  and otherwise uses SetMM's complex-power operation with the normalized
  complex strip coordinate.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies over arbitrary SetMM complex
  normed vector spaces and functions on the full complex plane. Its preceding
  $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions only; there is no $p
  proof statement.
$)

$c Q3527250Sub Q3527250OpenStrip Q3527250ClosedStrip
   Q3527250ClosureStrip
   Q3527250ContinuousOn Q3527250HasComplexDerivWithinAt
   Q3527250DifferentiableOn Q3527250DiffContOnCl Q3527250BddAbove
   Q3527250SupNormIm Q3527250Interp $.

q3527250-sub-syntax $a class ( Q3527250Sub W x y ) $.
q3527250-open-strip-syntax $a class ( Q3527250OpenStrip l u ) $.
q3527250-closed-strip-syntax $a class ( Q3527250ClosedStrip l u ) $.
q3527250-closure-strip-syntax $a class ( Q3527250ClosureStrip l u ) $.
q3527250-continuous-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527250ContinuousOn W F S ) $.
q3527250-has-complex-deriv-within-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527250HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F S x D ) $.
q3527250-differentiable-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527250DifferentiableOn W F S ) $.
q3527250-diff-cont-on-cl-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527250DiffContOnCl W F l u ) $.
q3527250-bdd-above-syntax
  $a wff ( Q3527250BddAbove W F S ) $.
q3527250-ssup-norm-im-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527250SupNormIm W F x ) $.
q3527250-interp-syntax
  $a class ( Q3527250Interp W F l u z ) $.

${
  $d W x y $.

  q3527250-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q3527250Sub W x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` W )
    ( ( -g ` W ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d l u z $.

  q3527250-open-strip-definition $a |- (
    Q3527250OpenStrip l u
  ) = {
    z e. CC |
      (
        l < ( Re ` z )
        /\
        ( Re ` z ) < u
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d l u z $.

  q3527250-closed-strip-definition $a |- (
    Q3527250ClosedStrip l u
  ) = {
    z e. CC |
      (
        l <_ ( Re ` z )
        /\
        ( Re ` z ) <_ u
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d l u $.

  q3527250-closure-strip-definition $a |- (
    Q3527250ClosureStrip l u
  ) = (
    ( cls ` ( TopOpen ` CCfld ) )
    `
    ( Q3527250OpenStrip l u )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S W d e x y $.

  q3527250-continuous-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527250ContinuousOn W F S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  ( Q3527250Sub W ( F ` y ) ( F ` x ) )
                )
                <
                e
              )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D F S W d e x y $.

  q3527250-has-complex-deriv-within-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527250HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F S x D )
    <->
    (
      D e. ( Base ` W )
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  (
                    Q3527250Sub
                    W
                    ( Q3527250Sub W ( F ` y ) ( F ` x ) )
                    ( ( y - x ) ( .s ` W ) D )
                  )
                )
                <_
                ( e x. ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) )
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D F S W x $.

  q3527250-differentiable-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527250DifferentiableOn W F S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      E. D e. ( Base ` W )
        ( Q3527250HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F S x D )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F W l u $.

  q3527250-diff-cont-on-cl-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527250DiffContOnCl W F l u )
    <->
    (
      ( Q3527250DifferentiableOn
        W F ( Q3527250OpenStrip l u ) )
      /\
      ( Q3527250ContinuousOn
        W F ( Q3527250ClosureStrip l u ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B F S W z $.

  q3527250-bdd-above-definition $a |- (
    ( Q3527250BddAbove W F S )
    <->
    E. B e. RR
      A. z e. S
        (
          ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( F ` z ) )
          <_
          B
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F W x y $.

  q3527250-ssup-norm-im-definition $a |- (
    Q3527250SupNormIm W F x
  ) = sup (
    ran (
      y e. { y e. CC | ( Re ` y ) = x } |->
        ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( F ` y ) )
    )
    ,
    RR
    ,
    <
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F W l u z $.

  q3527250-interp-definition $a |- (
    Q3527250Interp W F l u z
  ) = if (
    (
      ( Q3527250SupNormIm W F l ) = 0
      \/
      ( Q3527250SupNormIm W F u ) = 0
    )
    ,
    0
    ,
    (
      (
        ( Q3527250SupNormIm W F l )
        ^c
        ( 1 - ( ( z - l ) / ( u - l ) ) )
      )
      x.
      (
        ( Q3527250SupNormIm W F u )
        ^c
        ( ( z - l ) / ( u - l ) )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F W l u z $.

  thousand-theorems-q3527250-hadamard-three-lines $a |-
    A. W e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = CCfld }
      A. F e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m CC )
        A. l e. RR
          A. u e. RR
            A. z e. CC
              (
                (
                  (
                    l < u
                    /\
                    z e. ( Q3527250ClosedStrip l u )
                  )
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q3527250DiffContOnCl W F l u )
                    /\
                    (
                      Q3527250BddAbove
                      W F ( Q3527250ClosedStrip l u )
                    )
                  )
                )
                ->
                (
                  ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( F ` z ) )
                  <_
                  ( abs ` ( Q3527250Interp W F l u z ) )
                )
              )
  $.
$}

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527250
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q3527250), "Hadamard three-lines theorem": the
:: norm of a bounded complex-analytic normed-space-valued function on a
:: vertical strip is bounded by the interpolation of its boundary suprema.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, ORDINAL1, STRUCT_0,
      ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, CLVECT_1,
      PREPOWER, POWER, SEQ_4;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
      COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC,
      RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, CLVECT_1, PREPOWER, POWER, SEQ_4,
      VALUED_0, VALUED_1;
 constructors FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
      XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1,
      NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, CLVECT_1, PREPOWER, POWER, SEQ_4, BINOP_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, MEMBERED,
      VALUED_0, VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, STRUCT_0,
      RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, CLVECT_1, PREPOWER,
      SEQ_4, FRAENKEL;
 requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1, NORMSP_0;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0,
      NORMSP_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1,
      NORMSP_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for E being ComplexNormSpace,
      f being Function of COMPLEX,the carrier of E,
      l,u being Real,
      z being Element of COMPLEX st
    l < u &
    l <= Re z & Re z <= u &
    (for w being Element of COMPLEX st l <= Re w & Re w <= u holds
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st
          0 < delta &
          for v being Element of COMPLEX st
            l <= Re v & Re v <= u & |.v-w.| < delta
          holds
            ||.f.v-f.w.|| < epsilon) &
    (for w being Element of COMPLEX st l < Re w & Re w < u holds
      ex d being Point of E st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for v being Element of COMPLEX st
              0 < |.v-w.| & |.v-w.| < delta
            holds
              ||.f.v-f.w-(v-w)*d.|| < epsilon * |.v-w.|) &
    (ex C being Real st
      for w being Element of COMPLEX st l <= Re w & Re w <= u holds
        ||.f.w.|| <= C)
  holds
    ex s1,s2 being Subset of REAL st
      s1 =
        {r where r is Real :
          ex w being Element of COMPLEX st
            Re w = l & r = ||.f.w.||} &
      s2 =
        {r where r is Real :
          ex w being Element of COMPLEX st
            Re w = u & r = ||.f.w.||} &
      (((upper_bound s1 = 0 or upper_bound s2 = 0) &
          ||.f.z.|| <= 0) or
        (upper_bound s1 <> 0 & upper_bound s2 <> 0 &
          ||.f.z.|| <=
            (upper_bound s1) to_power
              (1 - (Re z - l) / (u - l)) *
            (upper_bound s2) to_power
              ((Re z - l) / (u - l))))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527250,
% "Hadamard three-lines theorem": a bounded complex-differentiable function into an
% arbitrary complex normed vector space is bounded inside a vertical strip by the
% logarithmic interpolation of its boundary-line norm suprema. This file contains no proof.

Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  cscaleE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> E]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(x: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  nonnegative_square_root(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  complex_norm(z: complex): real =
    nonnegative_square_root(
      real_part(z) * real_part(z)
        + imag_part(z) * imag_part(z))

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  complex_normed_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) =
          addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        cscaleE(
          real_part(a), imag_part(a), addE(x, y))
          =
        addE(
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x),
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        cscaleE(
          real_part(complex_add(a, b)),
          imag_part(complex_add(a, b)),
          x)
          =
        addE(
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x),
          cscaleE(real_part(b), imag_part(b), x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        cscaleE(
          real_part(complex_mul(a, b)),
          imag_part(complex_mul(a, b)),
          x)
          =
        cscaleE(
          real_part(a),
          imag_part(a),
          cscaleE(real_part(b), imag_part(b), x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        cscaleE(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x))
          = complex_norm(a) * normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  in_open_vertical_strip(z: complex, lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower < real_part(z) AND real_part(z) < upper

  in_closed_vertical_strip(z: complex, lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower <= real_part(z) AND real_part(z) <= upper

  continuous_on_closed_strip(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      in_closed_vertical_strip(x, lower, upper)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
            EXISTS (delta: posreal):
              FORALL (y: complex):
                (in_closed_vertical_strip(y, lower, upper)
                  AND complex_norm(complex_sub(y, x)) < delta)
                  IMPLIES
                    normE(subE(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value

  has_complex_derivative_within_open_strip_at(
      f: complex_function,
      derivative: E,
      lower, upper: real,
      x: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: complex):
          (in_open_vertical_strip(y, lower, upper)
            AND complex_norm(complex_sub(y, x)) < delta)
            IMPLIES
              normE(
                subE(
                  subE(f(y), f(x)),
                  cscaleE(
                    real_part(complex_sub(y, x)),
                    imag_part(complex_sub(y, x)),
                    derivative)))
                <= epsilon_value
                  * complex_norm(complex_sub(y, x))

  differentiable_on_open_strip(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      in_open_vertical_strip(x, lower, upper)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (derivative: E):
            has_complex_derivative_within_open_strip_at(
              f, derivative, lower, upper, x)

  diff_cont_on_closed_strip(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    differentiable_on_open_strip(f, lower, upper)
      AND continuous_on_closed_strip(f, lower, upper)

  bounded_norm_on_closed_strip(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      FORALL (w: complex):
        in_closed_vertical_strip(w, lower, upper)
          IMPLIES normE(f(w)) <= bound

  upper_bound_for_line_norms(
      f: complex_function,
      line, bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (w: complex):
      real_part(w) = line
        IMPLIES normE(f(w)) <= bound

  is_line_norm_supremum(
      f: complex_function,
      line, value: real): bool =
    upper_bound_for_line_norms(f, line, value)
      AND FORALL (bound: real):
        upper_bound_for_line_norms(f, line, bound)
          IMPLIES value <= bound

  line_norm_supremum(
      f: complex_function,
      line: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        is_line_norm_supremum(f, line, value))

  strip_coordinate(
      z: complex,
      lower, upper: real): real =
    safe_div(real_part(z) - lower, upper - lower)

  interpolation_bound(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real,
      z: complex): real =
    LET left_value: real =
          line_norm_supremum(f, lower),
        right_value: real =
          line_norm_supremum(f, upper),
        coordinate: real =
          strip_coordinate(z, lower, upper)
    IN
      IF left_value = 0 OR right_value = 0 THEN
        0
      ELSE
        real_power(left_value, 1 - coordinate)
          * real_power(right_value, coordinate)
      ENDIF

  hadamard_three_lines: bool =
    complex_normed_vector_space
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
            (lower, upper: real),
            (f: complex_function),
            (z: complex):
          (lower < upper
            AND in_closed_vertical_strip(z, lower, upper)
            AND diff_cont_on_closed_strip(f, lower, upper)
            AND bounded_norm_on_closed_strip(f, lower, upper))
          IMPLIES
            normE(f(z))
              <= interpolation_bound(f, lower, upper, z)
END Q3527250_hadamard_three_lines_theorem

title: Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527263
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3527263), "Kleene fixed-point theorem": on a
  complete lattice, the least fixed point of an omega-Scott-continuous
  monotone endomap is the supremum of its finite iterates from bottom.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q3527263_complete_lattice (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3527263_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q3527263_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q3527263_le x x;
  q3527263_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q3527263_le x y ->
      q3527263_le y z ->
      q3527263_le x z;
  q3527263_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q3527263_le x y ->
      q3527263_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q3527263_bottom : A;
  q3527263_bottom_le :
    forall x : A, q3527263_le q3527263_bottom x;
  q3527263_supremum : (A -> Prop) -> A;
  q3527263_le_supremum :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (x : A),
      S x ->
      q3527263_le x (q3527263_supremum S);
  q3527263_supremum_le :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (upper : A),
      (forall x : A, S x -> q3527263_le x upper) ->
      q3527263_le (q3527263_supremum S) upper;
  q3527263_infimum : (A -> Prop) -> A;
  q3527263_infimum_le :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (x : A),
      S x ->
      q3527263_le (q3527263_infimum S) x;
  q3527263_le_infimum :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (lower : A),
      (forall x : A, S x -> q3527263_le lower x) ->
      q3527263_le lower (q3527263_infimum S)
}.

Arguments q3527263_le {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q3527263_bottom {A} _.
Arguments q3527263_supremum {A} _ _.
Arguments q3527263_infimum {A} _ _.

Record q3527263_order_hom
    (A : Type) (L : q3527263_complete_lattice A) : Type := {
  q3527263_hom_fun : A -> A;
  q3527263_hom_monotone :
    forall x y : A,
      q3527263_le L x y ->
      q3527263_le L (q3527263_hom_fun x) (q3527263_hom_fun y)
}.

Arguments q3527263_order_hom A L : clear implicits.
Arguments q3527263_hom_fun {A L} _ _.

Definition q3527263_range {A : Type}
    (u : nat -> A) : A -> Prop :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, x = u n.

Definition q3527263_increasing {A : Type}
    (L : q3527263_complete_lattice A)
    (u : nat -> A) : Prop :=
  forall n m : nat,
    Nat.le n m ->
    q3527263_le L (u n) (u m).

Definition q3527263_omega_scott_continuous
    {A : Type}
    (L : q3527263_complete_lattice A)
    (f : q3527263_order_hom A L) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> A,
    q3527263_increasing L u ->
    q3527263_hom_fun f
      (q3527263_supremum L (q3527263_range u)) =
    q3527263_supremum L
      (q3527263_range (fun n : nat => q3527263_hom_fun f (u n))).

Definition q3527263_lfp
    {A : Type}
    (L : q3527263_complete_lattice A)
    (f : q3527263_order_hom A L) : A :=
  q3527263_infimum L
    (fun x : A => q3527263_le L (q3527263_hom_fun f x) x).

Fixpoint q3527263_iterate
    {A : Type}
    (f : A -> A) (n : nat) (x : A) : A :=
  match n with
  | O => x
  | S k => f (q3527263_iterate f k x)
  end.

Module fixedPoints.

Theorem lfp_eq_sSup_iterate :
  forall (A : Type)
         (L : q3527263_complete_lattice A)
         (f : q3527263_order_hom A L),
    @q3527263_omega_scott_continuous A L f ->
    @q3527263_lfp A L f =
    q3527263_supremum L
      (q3527263_range
        (fun n : nat =>
          q3527263_iterate
            (q3527263_hom_fun f) n (q3527263_bottom L))).
Admitted.

End fixedPoints.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527263 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3527263), "Kleene fixed-point
  theorem": an omega-Scott-continuous endomap of a complete lattice has least
  fixed point equal to the supremum of its finite iterates from bottom. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q3527263_omega_scott_continuous ::
    "('a::complete_lattice \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3527263_omega_scott_continuous f \<longleftrightarrow>
    mono f \<and>
    (\<forall>M::nat \<Rightarrow> 'a. mono M \<longrightarrow>
      f (SUP n. M n) = (SUP n. f (M n)))"

theorem q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem:
  fixes f :: "'a::complete_lattice \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes omega_scott_continuous: "q3527263_omega_scott_continuous f"
  shows "lfp f = (SUP n::nat. (f ^^ n) bot)"
  sorry

end

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3527263
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q3527263), "Kleene fixed-point theorem": the
  least fixed point of an omega-Scott-
  continuous monotone self-map of a complete lattice is the supremum of its
  finite iterates from bottom. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q3527263_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q3527263_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q3527263_output;;
let q3527263_previous_file_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=

Hol_loader.file_loader := q3527263_previous_file_loader;;

close_out q3527263_output;;
if not q3527263_library_loaded then
  failwith "failed to load Library/iter.ml";;

let Q3527263_KLEENE_FIXED_POINT_THEOREM =
  `let is_partial_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) in
   let is_supremum =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (u:A).
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x u) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x v) ==> le u v) in
   let is_infimum =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (l:A).
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> le l x) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> le v x) ==> le v l) in
   let is_complete_lattice =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (sSup:(A->bool)->A) (sInf:(A->bool)->A).
       is_partial_order le /\
       (!s:A->bool. is_supremum le s (sSup s)) /\
       (!s:A->bool. is_infimum le s (sInf s)) in
   let is_monotone =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (f:A->A).
       !x y:A. le x y ==> le (f x) (f y) in
   let is_omega_scott_continuous =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (sSup:(A->bool)->A) (f:A->A).
       !c:num->A.
         (!m n:num. m <= n ==> le (c m) (c n))
         ==> f (sSup (IMAGE c (:num))) =
             sSup (IMAGE (\n:num. f (c n)) (:num)) in
   let least_fixed_point =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (sInf:(A->bool)->A) (f:A->A).
       sInf {x:A | le (f x) x} in
   !le:A->A->bool.
   !sSup:(A->bool)->A.
   !sInf:(A->bool)->A.
   !f:A->A.
     is_complete_lattice le sSup sInf /\
     is_monotone le f /\
     is_omega_scott_continuous le sSup f
     ==> least_fixed_point le sInf f =
         sSup
           (IMAGE
             (\n:num. ITER n f (sSup ({}:A->bool)))
             (:num))`;;

title: Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527263,
;; "Kleene fixed-point theorem": for an omega-Scott-continuous monotone
;; self-map of a complete lattice, the least fixed point is the supremum of
;; the finite iterates of bottom. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ function objects present the arbitrary carrier, order, subsets,
;; self-map, and omega-indexed chains.  The complete-lattice, monotonicity, and
;; omega-Scott-continuity laws are all explicit in the statement predicate.
;; DEFCHOOSE names uniquely characterized suprema and the least prefixed point;
;; these are conservative definitions, not externally supplied witnesses.

(defun q3527263-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun q3527263-le (order x y)
  (if (apply$ order (list x y)) t nil))

(defun q3527263-map-value (map x)
  (apply$ map (list x)))

(defun q3527263-set-member-p (set x)
  (if (apply$ set (list x)) t nil))

(defun q3527263-sequence-value (sequence n)
  (apply$ sequence (list n)))

;; Partial orders and arbitrary subsets of the carrier.

(defun-sk q3527263-order-reflexive-p (carrier order)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
     (q3527263-le order x x))))

(defun-sk q3527263-order-transitive-p (carrier order)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527263-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527263-member-p carrier z)
      (q3527263-le order x y)
      (q3527263-le order y z))
     (q3527263-le order x z))))

(defun-sk q3527263-order-antisymmetric-p (carrier order)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527263-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527263-le order x y)
      (q3527263-le order y x))
     (equal x y))))

(defun q3527263-partial-order-p (carrier order)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp order)
   (q3527263-order-reflexive-p carrier order)
   (q3527263-order-transitive-p carrier order)
   (q3527263-order-antisymmetric-p carrier order)))

(defun-sk q3527263-bottom-law-p (carrier order bottom)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
     (q3527263-le order bottom x))))

(defun-sk q3527263-valid-set-elements-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527263-set-member-p set x)
     (q3527263-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q3527263-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q3527263-valid-set-elements-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q3527263-upper-bound-p
    (carrier order set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527263-set-member-p set x))
     (q3527263-le order x bound))))

(defun-sk q3527263-least-upper-bound-minimal-p
    (carrier order set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527263-member-p carrier bound)
      (q3527263-upper-bound-p
       carrier order set bound))
     (q3527263-le order supremum bound))))

(defun q3527263-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier order set supremum)
  (and
   (q3527263-member-p carrier supremum)
   (q3527263-upper-bound-p
    carrier order set supremum)
   (q3527263-least-upper-bound-minimal-p
    carrier order set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527263-set-supremum-exists-p
    (carrier order set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q3527263-least-upper-bound-p
     carrier order set supremum)))

(defun-sk q3527263-all-set-suprema-exist-p
    (carrier order)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q3527263-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q3527263-set-supremum-exists-p
      carrier order set))))

(defun q3527263-complete-lattice-p
    (carrier order bottom)
  (and
   (q3527263-partial-order-p carrier order)
   (q3527263-member-p carrier bottom)
   (q3527263-bottom-law-p carrier order bottom)
   (q3527263-all-set-suprema-exist-p carrier order)))

;; The bundled order homomorphism is an arbitrary carrier-valued monotone map.

(defun-sk q3527263-map-typed-p (carrier map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
     (q3527263-member-p
      carrier
      (q3527263-map-value map x)))))

(defun-sk q3527263-map-monotone-p
    (carrier order map)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3527263-member-p carrier x)
      (q3527263-member-p carrier y)
      (q3527263-le order x y))
     (q3527263-le
      order
      (q3527263-map-value map x)
      (q3527263-map-value map y)))))

(defun q3527263-order-hom-p (carrier order map)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp map)
   (q3527263-map-typed-p carrier map)
   (q3527263-map-monotone-p carrier order map)))

;; Suprema of arbitrary increasing omega-chains.

title: Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527263
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q3527263), "Kleene fixed-point theorem": the
-- least fixed point of an omega-Scott-continuous order endomorphism of a
-- complete lattice is the supremum of its finite iterates from bottom.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Bottom {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

data NatLessOrEqual : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} →
    NatLessOrEqual zero n
  successors-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} →
    NatLessOrEqual m n →
    NatLessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n)

record CompleteLattice
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    lessOrEqual :
      A → A → Set ℓ

    order-reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y z →
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y x →
      x ≡ y

    supremum :
      (A → Set ℓ) → A
    supremum-upper :
      (P : A → Set ℓ) →
      (x : A) →
      P x →
      lessOrEqual x (supremum P)
    supremum-least :
      (P : A → Set ℓ) →
      (upper : A) →
      ((x : A) → P x → lessOrEqual x upper) →
      lessOrEqual (supremum P) upper

    infimum :
      (A → Set ℓ) → A
    infimum-lower :
      (P : A → Set ℓ) →
      (x : A) →
      P x →
      lessOrEqual (infimum P) x
    infimum-greatest :
      (P : A → Set ℓ) →
      (lower : A) →
      ((x : A) → P x → lessOrEqual lower x) →
      lessOrEqual lower (infimum P)

open CompleteLattice

record OrderEndomorphism
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    function :
      A → A
    monotone :
      (x y : A) →
      lessOrEqual lattice x y →
      lessOrEqual lattice (function x) (function y)

open OrderEndomorphism

record Chain
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    value :
      Nat → A
    increasing :
      (m n : Nat) →
      NatLessOrEqual m n →
      lessOrEqual lattice (value m) (value n)

open Chain

chainSupremum :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) →
  Chain lattice →
  A
chainSupremum lattice chain =
  supremum lattice
    (λ x → Σ Nat (λ n → x ≡ value chain n))

OmegaScottContinuous :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) →
  OrderEndomorphism lattice →
  Set ℓ
OmegaScottContinuous lattice endomorphism =
  (chain : Chain lattice) →
  function endomorphism (chainSupremum lattice chain) ≡
  supremum lattice
    (λ y →
      Σ Nat
        (λ n → y ≡ function endomorphism (value chain n)))

bottom :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  CompleteLattice A →
  A
bottom lattice =
  supremum lattice (λ _ → Bottom)

iterate :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (A → A) →
  Nat →
  A →
  A
iterate f zero x =
  x
iterate f (suc n) x =
  f (iterate f n x)

leastFixedPoint :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) →
  OrderEndomorphism lattice →
  A
leastFixedPoint lattice endomorphism =
  infimum lattice
    (λ x →
      lessOrEqual lattice (function endomorphism x) x)

iteratesSupremum :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) →
  OrderEndomorphism lattice →
  A
iteratesSupremum lattice endomorphism =
  supremum lattice
    (λ x →
      Σ Nat
        (λ n →
          x ≡
          iterate
            (function endomorphism)
            n
            (bottom lattice)))

KleeneFixedPointTheorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
KleeneFixedPointTheorem ℓ =
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) →
  (endomorphism : OrderEndomorphism lattice) →
  OmegaScottContinuous lattice endomorphism →
  leastFixedPoint lattice endomorphism ≡
  iteratesSupremum lattice endomorphism

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3527263, "Kleene fixed-point theorem": the least fixed point of an
  omega-Scott-continuous order endomorphism of a complete lattice is the
  supremum of its finite iterates from bottom. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

val q3527263_complete_lattice_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_complete_lattice_def",
  ``q3527263_complete_lattice
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (supR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a)
      (infR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a) <=>
      (!x. leR x x) /\
      (!x y z. leR x y ==> leR y z ==> leR x z) /\
      (!x y. leR x y ==> leR y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!P x. P x ==> leR x (supR P)) /\
      (!P upper.
         (!x. P x ==> leR x upper) ==>
         leR (supR P) upper) /\
      (!P x. P x ==> leR (infR P) x) /\
      (!P lower.
         (!x. P x ==> leR lower x) ==>
         leR lower (infR P))``);

val q3527263_order_endomorphism_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_order_endomorphism_def",
  ``q3527263_order_endomorphism
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (f : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      !x y. leR x y ==> leR (f x) (f y)``);

val q3527263_chain_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_chain_def",
  ``q3527263_chain
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (c : num -> 'a) <=>
      !m n : num. m <= n ==> leR (c m) (c n)``);

val q3527263_omega_scott_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_omega_scott_continuous_def",
  ``q3527263_omega_scott_continuous
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (supR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a)
      (f : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      !c : num -> 'a.
        q3527263_chain leR c ==>
        f (supR (\x. ?n : num. x = c n)) =
        supR (\y. ?n : num. y = f (c n))``);

val q3527263_bottom_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_bottom_def",
  ``q3527263_bottom (supR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a) =
      supR (\x : 'a. F)``);

val q3527263_lfp_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_lfp_def",
  ``q3527263_lfp
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (infR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a)
      (f : 'a -> 'a) =
      infR (\x. leR (f x) x)``);

val q3527263_iterates_supremum_def = new_definition (
  "q3527263_iterates_supremum_def",
  ``q3527263_iterates_supremum
      (supR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a) (f : 'a -> 'a) =
      supR
        (\x.
          ?n : num.
            x = FUNPOW f n (q3527263_bottom supR))``);

val lfp_eq_sSup_iterate =
  ``!(leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (supR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a)
      (infR : ('a -> bool) -> 'a)
      (f : 'a -> 'a).
      q3527263_complete_lattice leR supR infR /\
      q3527263_order_endomorphism leR f /\
      q3527263_omega_scott_continuous leR supR f
      ==>
      q3527263_lfp leR infR f =
      q3527263_iterates_supremum supR f``;

  least fixed point of an omega-Scott-continuous monotone self-map of an
  arbitrary complete lattice is the supremum of its finite iterates from

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q3527263OmegaScottContinuous(K,F) packages the source type of F as an order
  endomorphism and says that F preserves the supremum of every increasing
  natural-number-indexed chain. Q3527263Lfp(K,F) is the infimum of the
  pre-fixed points of F. Q3527263Iterates(K,F) is the unique sequence starting
  at bottom and obtained by repeatedly applying F. Thus its range is exactly
  the family indexed in Lean by n |-> f^[n] bottom.

  The declarations before the final assertion are syntax or bidirectional
  definitions. The final $a assertion is the unproved corpus statement; this
  root artifact itself contains no $p statement.
$)

$c Q3527263OmegaScottContinuous Q3527263Lfp Q3527263Iterates $.

  ( Q3527263OmegaScottContinuous K F ) $.

q3527263-lfp-syntax $a class

q3527263-iterates-syntax $a class
  ( Q3527263Iterates K F ) $.

$d C F K m n x y $.
q3527263-osc-definition $a |- ( ( Q3527263OmegaScottContinuous K F ) <->
  ( ( F : ( Base ` K ) --> ( Base ` K ) /\
      A. x e. ( Base ` K ) A. y e. ( Base ` K )
        ( x ( le ` K ) y ->
          ( F ` x ) ( le ` K ) ( F ` y ) ) ) /\
    A. C e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m NN0 )
      ( A. m e. NN0 A. n e. NN0
          ( m <_ n -> ( C ` m ) ( le ` K ) ( C ` n ) ) ->
        ( F ` ( ( lub ` K ) ` ran C ) ) =
          ( ( lub ` K ) ` ( F " ran C ) ) ) ) ) $.

$d F K x $.
q3527263-lfp-definition $a |- ( ( Q3527263Lfp K F ) =
  ( ( glb ` K ) `
    { x e. ( Base ` K ) | ( F ` x ) ( le ` K ) x } ) ) $.

$d F K S n $.
q3527263-iterates-definition $a |- ( ( Q3527263Iterates K F ) =
  ( iota_ S e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m NN0 )
    ( ( S ` 0 ) = ( 0. ` K ) /\
      A. n e. NN0
        ( S ` ( n + 1 ) ) = ( F ` ( S ` n ) ) ) ) ) $.

q3527263-kleene-fixed-point-theorem $a |- A. K A. F
  ( ( K e. CLat /\ ( Q3527263OmegaScottContinuous K F ) ) ->
    ( Q3527263Lfp K F ) =
      ( ( lub ` K ) ` ran ( Q3527263Iterates K F ) ) ) $.

title: Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3527263,
% "Kleene fixed-point theorem": an omega-Scott-continuous endomap of a complete
% lattice has least fixed point equal to the supremum of its finite iterates
% from bottom. This file contains no proof.

Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem[
  X: TYPE+,
  le_rel: [X, X -> bool],
  bottom: X,
  supremum: [[X -> bool] -> X],
  infimum: [[X -> bool] -> X],
  f: [X -> X]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  sequence: TYPE = [nat -> X]
  self_map: TYPE = [X -> X]

  upper_bound(S: element_set, u: X): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_rel(x, u)

  lower_bound(S: element_set, l: X): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_rel(l, x)

  least_upper_bound(S: element_set, s: X): bool =
    upper_bound(S, s)
      AND (FORALL (u: X):
        upper_bound(S, u) IMPLIES le_rel(s, u))

  greatest_lower_bound(S: element_set, i: X): bool =
    lower_bound(S, i)
      AND (FORALL (l: X):
        lower_bound(S, l) IMPLIES le_rel(l, i))

  partial_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: X): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)

  complete_lattice_laws: bool =
    partial_order_laws
      AND (FORALL (x: X): le_rel(bottom, x))
      AND (FORALL (S: element_set):
        least_upper_bound(S, supremum(S)))
      AND (FORALL (S: element_set):
        greatest_lower_bound(S, infimum(S)))

  monotone(g: self_map): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: X):
      le_rel(x, y) IMPLIES le_rel(g(x), g(y))

  increasing(values: sequence): bool =
    FORALL (m, n: nat):
      m <= n IMPLIES le_rel(values(m), values(n))

  sequence_range(values: sequence): element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (n: nat): x = values(n)

  omega_supremum(values: sequence): X =
    supremum(sequence_range(values))

  omega_scott_continuous(g: self_map): bool =
    monotone(g)
      AND (FORALL (values: sequence):
        increasing(values) IMPLIES
          g(omega_supremum(values)) =
            omega_supremum(
              LAMBDA (n: nat): g(values(n))))

  iterate(g: self_map, x: X, count: nat): RECURSIVE X =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      x
    ELSE
      g(iterate(g, x, count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  iterate_range(g: self_map, x: X): element_set =
    LAMBDA (y: X):
      EXISTS (n: nat): y = iterate(g, x, n)

  least_fixed_point(g: self_map): X =
    infimum(
      LAMBDA (x: X):
        le_rel(g(x), x))

  kleene_fixed_point_theorem: bool =
    complete_lattice_laws
      AND omega_scott_continuous(f)
    IMPLIES
      least_fixed_point(f) =
        supremum(iterate_range(f, bottom))
END Q3527263_kleene_fixed_point_theorem
