title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3984053
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q3984053), "Fourier inversion theorem": a
  continuous integrable function on a finite-dimensional real inner-product
  space is recovered pointwise by inverse Fourier transformation when its
  Fourier transform is integrable.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin Reals ClassicalDescription
  ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q3984053_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q3984053_empty {A : Type} : q3984053_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q3984053_full {A : Type} : q3984053_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q3984053_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q3984053_set A) : q3984053_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q3984053_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q3984053_set A) : q3984053_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q3984053_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q3984053_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q3984053_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q3984053_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q3984053_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q3984053_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q3984053_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q3984053_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q3984053_set (q3984053_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q3984053_empty /\
  (forall E F : q3984053_set A,
    q3984053_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q3984053_set A,
    C E -> C (q3984053_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q3984053_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q3984053_countable_union E)).

Inductive q3984053_ennreal : Type :=
| q3984053_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q3984053_ennreal
| q3984053_ennreal_infinity : q3984053_ennreal.

Arguments q3984053_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_zero : q3984053_ennreal :=
  q3984053_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q3984053_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3984053_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3984053_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q3984053_ennreal_infinity,
    q3984053_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_le
    (x y : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q3984053_ennreal_finite a _,
    q3984053_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q3984053_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q3984053_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q3984053_ennreal_infinity,
    q3984053_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q3984053_ennreal_infinity,
    q3984053_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_add
    (x y : q3984053_ennreal) : q3984053_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q3984053_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q3984053_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q3984053_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q3984053_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q3984053_ennreal) : q3984053_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q3984053_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q3984053_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q3984053_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q3984053_ennreal_finite a _, q3984053_ennreal_infinity
  | q3984053_ennreal_infinity, q3984053_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q3984053_ennreal_zero
      else q3984053_ennreal_infinity
  | q3984053_ennreal_infinity, q3984053_ennreal_infinity =>
      q3984053_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q3984053_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q3984053_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q3984053_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q3984053_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q3984053_ennreal_add
        (q3984053_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q3984053_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q3984053_ennreal,
      values value -> q3984053_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q3984053_ennreal,
      (forall value : q3984053_ennreal,
        values value -> q3984053_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q3984053_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q3984053_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q3984053_ennreal)
    (sum : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q3984053_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q3984053_ennreal_eq value
          (q3984053_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_represents
    (x : q3984053_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q3984053_ennreal_eq x
      (q3984053_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q3984053_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q3984053_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q3984053_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q3984053_measurable : q3984053_set A -> Prop;
  q3984053_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q3984053_set A,
      q3984053_same_set E F ->
      (q3984053_measurable E <-> q3984053_measurable F);
  q3984053_measurable_empty :
    q3984053_measurable q3984053_empty;
  q3984053_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q3984053_set A,
      q3984053_measurable E ->
      q3984053_measurable (q3984053_complement E);
  q3984053_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q3984053_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q3984053_measurable (E n)) ->
      q3984053_measurable (q3984053_countable_union E);
  q3984053_measure : q3984053_set A -> q3984053_ennreal;
  q3984053_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q3984053_set A,
      q3984053_same_set E F ->
      q3984053_ennreal_eq
        (q3984053_measure E) (q3984053_measure F);
  q3984053_measure_empty :
    q3984053_ennreal_eq
      (q3984053_measure q3984053_empty)
      q3984053_ennreal_zero;
  q3984053_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q3984053_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q3984053_measurable (E n)) ->
      q3984053_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q3984053_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q3984053_measure (E n))
        (q3984053_measure (q3984053_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q3984053_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q3984053_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q3984053_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q3984053_set A,
    q3984053_measurable mu null_set /\
    q3984053_ennreal_eq
      (q3984053_measure mu null_set)
      q3984053_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q3984053_normed_real_vector_space (G : Type) : Type := {
  q3984053_zero : G;
  q3984053_add : G -> G -> G;
  q3984053_neg : G -> G;
  q3984053_smul : R -> G -> G;
  q3984053_norm : G -> R;
  q3984053_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q3984053_add x (q3984053_add y z) =
      q3984053_add (q3984053_add x y) z;
  q3984053_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q3984053_add x y = q3984053_add y x;
  q3984053_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q3984053_add x q3984053_zero = x;
  q3984053_add_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q3984053_add x (q3984053_neg x) = q3984053_zero;
  q3984053_one_smul :
    forall x : G, q3984053_smul 1 x = x;
  q3984053_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q3984053_smul (a * b) x =
      q3984053_smul a (q3984053_smul b x);
  q3984053_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q3984053_smul (a + b) x =
      q3984053_add (q3984053_smul a x) (q3984053_smul b x);
  q3984053_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : G),
      q3984053_smul a (q3984053_add x y) =
      q3984053_add (q3984053_smul a x) (q3984053_smul a y);
  q3984053_zero_smul :
    forall x : G, q3984053_smul 0 x = q3984053_zero;
  q3984053_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q3984053_smul a q3984053_zero = q3984053_zero;
  q3984053_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q3984053_norm x;
  q3984053_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q3984053_norm x = 0 <-> x = q3984053_zero;
  q3984053_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q3984053_norm (q3984053_add x y) <=
      q3984053_norm x + q3984053_norm y;
  q3984053_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : G),
      q3984053_norm (q3984053_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q3984053_norm x
}.

Arguments q3984053_zero {G} _.
Arguments q3984053_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q3984053_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q3984053_smul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q3984053_norm {G} _ _.

Definition q3984053_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q3984053_add V x (q3984053_neg V y).

Record q3984053_complex : Type := {
  q3984053_re : R;
  q3984053_im : R
}.

Definition q3984053_czero : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re := 0; q3984053_im := 0 |}.

Definition q3984053_cone : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re := 1; q3984053_im := 0 |}.

Definition q3984053_ci : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re := 0; q3984053_im := 1 |}.

Definition q3984053_cadd
    (z w : q3984053_complex) : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re := q3984053_re z + q3984053_re w;
     q3984053_im := q3984053_im z + q3984053_im w |}.

Definition q3984053_cmul
    (z w : q3984053_complex) : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re :=
       q3984053_re z * q3984053_re w -
       q3984053_im z * q3984053_im w;
     q3984053_im :=
       q3984053_re z * q3984053_im w +
       q3984053_im z * q3984053_re w |}.

Definition q3984053_real_to_complex (x : R) : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re := x; q3984053_im := 0 |}.

Definition q3984053_complex_modulus (z : q3984053_complex) : R :=
  sqrt
    (q3984053_re z * q3984053_re z +
     q3984053_im z * q3984053_im z).

Definition q3984053_complex_exp (z : q3984053_complex) : q3984053_complex :=
  {| q3984053_re := exp (q3984053_re z) * cos (q3984053_im z);
     q3984053_im := exp (q3984053_re z) * sin (q3984053_im z) |}.

Record q3984053_complex_normed_space
    {E : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q3984053_csmul : q3984053_complex -> E -> E;
  q3984053_csmul_one :
    forall x : E, q3984053_csmul q3984053_cone x = x;
  q3984053_csmul_mul :
    forall (a b : q3984053_complex) (x : E),
      q3984053_csmul (q3984053_cmul a b) x =
      q3984053_csmul a (q3984053_csmul b x);
  q3984053_csmul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : q3984053_complex) (x : E),
      q3984053_csmul (q3984053_cadd a b) x =
      q3984053_add V (q3984053_csmul a x) (q3984053_csmul b x);
  q3984053_csmul_add_vector :
    forall (a : q3984053_complex) (x y : E),
      q3984053_csmul a (q3984053_add V x y) =
      q3984053_add V (q3984053_csmul a x) (q3984053_csmul a y);
  q3984053_csmul_real :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q3984053_csmul (q3984053_real_to_complex a) x =
      q3984053_smul V a x;
  q3984053_norm_csmul :
    forall (a : q3984053_complex) (x : E),
      q3984053_norm V (q3984053_csmul a x) =
      q3984053_complex_modulus a * q3984053_norm V x
}.

Arguments q3984053_csmul {E V} _ _ _.

Record q3984053_real_inner_product_space
    {V : Type}
    (N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V) : Type := {
  q3984053_inner : V -> V -> R;
  q3984053_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q3984053_inner (q3984053_add N x y) z =
      q3984053_inner x z + q3984053_inner y z;
  q3984053_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q3984053_inner (q3984053_smul N a x) y =
      a * q3984053_inner x y;
  q3984053_inner_symmetric :
    forall x y : V, q3984053_inner x y = q3984053_inner y x;
  q3984053_inner_norm_sq :
    forall x : V,
      q3984053_inner x x = q3984053_norm N x * q3984053_norm N x
}.

Arguments q3984053_inner {V N} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q3984053_coordinate_sum
    {V : Type}
    (N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> V) -> V :=
  match n as k return (Fin.t k -> V) -> V with
  | O => fun _ => q3984053_zero N
  | S k =>
      fun terms =>
        q3984053_add N
          (terms Fin.F1)
          (@q3984053_coordinate_sum V N k
            (fun i => terms (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Arguments q3984053_coordinate_sum {V} N n _.

Record q3984053_finite_dimensional
    {V : Type}
    {N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q3984053_real_inner_product_space N) : Type := {
  q3984053_dimension : nat;
  q3984053_basis : Fin.t q3984053_dimension -> V;
  q3984053_coordinates : V -> Fin.t q3984053_dimension -> R;
  q3984053_coordinate_reconstruction :
    forall x : V,
      x =
      q3984053_coordinate_sum N q3984053_dimension
        (fun i =>
          q3984053_smul N
            (q3984053_coordinates x i) (q3984053_basis i));
  q3984053_coordinates_add :
    forall (x y : V) (i : Fin.t q3984053_dimension),
      q3984053_coordinates (q3984053_add N x y) i =
      q3984053_coordinates x i + q3984053_coordinates y i;
  q3984053_coordinates_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : V) (i : Fin.t q3984053_dimension),
      q3984053_coordinates (q3984053_smul N a x) i =
      a * q3984053_coordinates x i;
  q3984053_basis_orthonormal :
    forall i j : Fin.t q3984053_dimension,
      q3984053_inner H (q3984053_basis i) (q3984053_basis j) =
      if Fin.eq_dec i j then 1 else 0
}.

Arguments q3984053_dimension {V N H} _.
Arguments q3984053_basis {V N H} _ _.
Arguments q3984053_coordinates {V N H} _ _ _.

Definition q3984053_open {V : Type}
    (N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (U : q3984053_set V) : Prop :=
  forall x : V,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : V,
        q3984053_norm N (q3984053_sub N y x) < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q3984053_borel_set {V : Type}
    (N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (S : q3984053_set V) : Prop :=
  forall classes : q3984053_set (q3984053_set V),
    q3984053_sigma_class classes ->
    (forall U : q3984053_set V, q3984053_open N U -> classes U) ->
    classes S.

Definition q3984053_unit_coordinate_cube
    {V : Type}
    {N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V}
    {H : q3984053_real_inner_product_space N}
    (D : q3984053_finite_dimensional H) : q3984053_set V :=
  fun x =>
    forall i : Fin.t (q3984053_dimension D),
      0 < q3984053_coordinates D x i <= 1.

Definition q3984053_is_euclidean_lebesgue_measure
    {V : Type}
    {N : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V}
    {H : q3984053_real_inner_product_space N}
    (D : q3984053_finite_dimensional H)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space V) : Prop :=
  (forall S : q3984053_set V,
      q3984053_measurable mu S <-> q3984053_borel_set N S) /\
  (forall (a : V) (S : q3984053_set V),
      q3984053_ennreal_eq
        (q3984053_measure mu
          (fun x => S (q3984053_add N a x)))
        (q3984053_measure mu S)) /\
  q3984053_ennreal_eq
    (q3984053_measure mu (q3984053_unit_coordinate_cube D))
    (q3984053_ennreal_finite 1 Rle_0_1).

Definition q3984053_vector_sequence_converges {G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (limit : G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q3984053_norm V
          (q3984053_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q3984053_vector_sequence_cauchy {G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q3984053_norm V
          (q3984053_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q3984053_complete {G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> G,
    q3984053_vector_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : G,
      q3984053_vector_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q3984053_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q3984053_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q3984053_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q3984053_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q3984053_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q3984053_measurable_simple {A G : Type}
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q3984053_set A),
    q3984053_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q3984053_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q3984053_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q3984053_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q3984053_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q3984053_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q3984053_nnreal_value : R;
  q3984053_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q3984053_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q3984053_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q3984053_nonnegative_real) : q3984053_ennreal :=
  q3984053_ennreal_finite
    (q3984053_nnreal_value x)
    (q3984053_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q3984053_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q3984053_ennreal)
    (value : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q3984053_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q3984053_set A),
    q3984053_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q3984053_ennreal_le
        (q3984053_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q3984053_ennreal_eq value
      (q3984053_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q3984053_ennreal_mul
            (q3984053_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q3984053_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q3984053_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q3984053_ennreal)
    (value : q3984053_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q3984053_ennreal_supremum
    (q3984053_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q3984053_norm_ennreal {G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x : G) : q3984053_ennreal :=
  q3984053_ennreal_finite
    (q3984053_norm V x)
    (q3984053_norm_nonnegative V x).

Definition q3984053_integrable {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  q3984053_ae_strongly_measurable V mu f /\
  exists value : q3984053_ennreal,
    q3984053_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q3984053_norm_ennreal V (f x)) value /\
    q3984053_ennreal_finite_value value.

Fixpoint q3984053_vector_sum {G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => q3984053_zero V
  | S k =>
      q3984053_add V
        (q3984053_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q3984053_weighted_cell_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (cell : q3984053_set A)
    (coefficient value : G) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q3984053_zero V /\
    value = q3984053_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q3984053_ennreal_represents
      (q3984053_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value = q3984053_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q3984053_simple_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q3984053_set A),
    q3984053_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q3984053_weighted_cell_value
        V mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q3984053_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q3984053_l1_approximates {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q3984053_ennreal,
        q3984053_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q3984053_norm_ennreal V
              (q3984053_sub V (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q3984053_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q3984053_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q3984053_standard_bochner_integral_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
         (integrals : nat -> G),
    (forall n : nat,
      q3984053_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q3984053_simple_integral_has_value
        V mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q3984053_l1_approximates V mu approximants f /\
    q3984053_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q3984053_bochner_integral {A G : Type}
    (V : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : G :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : G,
            q3984053_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits (q3984053_zero V))
        (fun value : G =>
          q3984053_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value)
  | right _ => q3984053_zero V
  end.

Definition q3984053_continuous_at
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) (v : V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : V,
        q3984053_norm NV (q3984053_sub NV w v) < delta ->
        q3984053_norm NE
          (q3984053_sub NE (f w) (f v)) < epsilon.

Definition q3984053_continuous
    {V E : Type}
    (NV : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V)
    (NE : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : V -> E) : Prop :=
  forall v : V, q3984053_continuous_at NV NE f v.

Definition q3984053_fourier_character (t : R) : q3984053_complex :=
  q3984053_complex_exp
    (q3984053_cmul
      (q3984053_real_to_complex (- (2 * PI * t)))
      q3984053_ci).

Definition q3984053_inverse_fourier_character
    (t : R) : q3984053_complex :=
  q3984053_complex_exp
    (q3984053_cmul
      (q3984053_real_to_complex (2 * PI * t))
      q3984053_ci).

Definition q3984053_fourier_transform
    {V E : Type}
    {NV : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q3984053_real_inner_product_space NV)
    {NE : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (CE : q3984053_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space V)
    (f : V -> E) : V -> E :=
  fun w =>
    q3984053_bochner_integral NE mu
      (fun x =>
        q3984053_csmul CE
          (q3984053_fourier_character
            (q3984053_inner H x w))
          (f x)).

Definition q3984053_inverse_fourier_transform
    {V E : Type}
    {NV : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V}
    (H : q3984053_real_inner_product_space NV)
    {NE : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (CE : q3984053_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q3984053_measure_space V)
    (f : V -> E) : V -> E :=
  fun v =>
    q3984053_bochner_integral NE mu
      (fun w =>
        q3984053_csmul CE
          (q3984053_inverse_fourier_character
            (q3984053_inner H w v))
          (f w)).

Theorem Continuous_fourier_inversion :
  forall (V E : Type)
         (NV : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space V)
         (H : q3984053_real_inner_product_space NV)
         (D : q3984053_finite_dimensional H)
         (NE : q3984053_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (CE : q3984053_complex_normed_space NE)
         (mu : q3984053_measure_space V)
         (f : V -> E),
    q3984053_is_euclidean_lebesgue_measure D mu ->
    q3984053_complete NE ->
    q3984053_continuous NV NE f ->
    q3984053_integrable NE mu f ->
    q3984053_integrable NE mu
      (q3984053_fourier_transform H CE mu f) ->
    forall v : V,
      q3984053_inverse_fourier_transform H CE mu
        (q3984053_fourier_transform H CE mu f) v = f v.
Admitted.

title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q3984053 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q3984053), "Fourier inversion theorem":
  the inverse Fourier transform of the Fourier transform of a continuous
  integrable function on a finite-dimensional real inner product space is the
  original function when its Fourier transform is also integrable. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration" "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
begin

definition q3984053_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3984053_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q3984053_orthonormal_basis ::
    "'v::real_inner set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3984053_orthonormal_basis B \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite_dimensional_vector_space
      ((*\<^sub>R) :: real \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'v) B \<and>
    (\<forall>u \<in> B. \<forall>v \<in> B. inner u v = (if u = v then 1 else 0))"

definition q3984053_parallelotope ::
    "'v::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q3984053_parallelotope B =
    {(\<Sum>b\<in>B. c b *\<^sub>R b) | c. \<forall>b \<in> B. 0 \<le> c b \<and> c b < 1}"

definition q3984053_lebesgue_measure ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3984053_lebesgue_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
    sets M = sets borel \<and>
    (\<forall>a. distr M borel ((+) a) = M) \<and>
    (\<forall>B. q3984053_orthonormal_basis B \<longrightarrow>
      measure M (q3984053_parallelotope B) = 1)"

definition q3984053_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3984053_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
      (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f x))"

definition q3984053_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3984053_has_bochner_integral M f I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3984053_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (norm (f x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> I))"

definition q3984053_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q3984053_integrable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    q3984053_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (norm (f x)) \<partial>M) < \<infinity>"

definition q3984053_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q3984053_bochner_integral M f =
    (if \<exists>I. q3984053_has_bochner_integral M f I
     then THE I. q3984053_has_bochner_integral M f I
     else 0)"

definition q3984053_fourier ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q3984053_fourier M cscale f w =
    q3984053_bochner_integral M
      (\<lambda>x. cscale (exp (- (\<i> * of_real (2 * pi * inner w x)))) (f x))"

definition q3984053_fourier_inverse ::
    "'v::real_inner measure \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q3984053_fourier_inverse M cscale f v =
    q3984053_bochner_integral M
      (\<lambda>w. cscale (exp (\<i> * of_real (2 * pi * inner w v))) (f w))"

theorem continuous_fourier_inversion:
  fixes M :: "'v::real_inner measure"
    and cscale :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes finite_dimensional:
      "\<exists>B. q3984053_orthonormal_basis B"
    and lebesgue_measure: "q3984053_lebesgue_measure M"
    and complex_space: "q3984053_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and continuous: "continuous_on UNIV f"
    and f_integrable: "q3984053_integrable M f"
    and fourier_integrable:
      "q3984053_integrable M (q3984053_fourier M cscale f)"
  shows
    "q3984053_fourier_inverse M cscale (q3984053_fourier M cscale f) = f"
  sorry

end

title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3984053,
  "Fourier inversion theorem": for a continuous integrable Banach-valued
  function on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space whose Fourier
  transform is integrable, inverse Fourier transformation recovers the
  function. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q3984053_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q3984053_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q3984053_output;;
let q3984053_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q3984053_formatter path);;
let q3984053_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q3984053_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q3984053_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q3984053_formatter ();;
if not q3984053_loaded then failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;
Format.pp_set_formatter_out_channel Format.std_formatter q3984053_output;;

let Q3984053_FOURIER_INVERSION_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let cadd =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
   let cmul =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
         FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
   let cmod =
      \(z:real#real).
        sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in
   let cone = (&1,&0) in
   let czero = (&0,&0) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:V) /\
        (!s:V->bool. events s ==> events ((:V) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->V->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:V | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:V->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->V->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:V | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (P:V->bool).
        ?N:V->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:V | ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let real_vector_space =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
       (smulV:real->V->V).
        (!x y:V. addV x y = addV y x) /\
        (!x y z:V. addV (addV x y) z = addV x (addV y z)) /\
        (!x:V. addV x zeroV = x) /\
        (!x:V. addV x (negV x) = zeroV) /\
        (!x:V. negV (negV x) = x) /\
        (!x:V. smulV (&1) x = x) /\
        (!a b:real x:V.
           smulV (a * b) x = smulV a (smulV b x)) /\
        (!a b:real x:V.
           smulV (a + b) x = addV (smulV a x) (smulV b x)) /\
        (!a:real x y:V.
           smulV a (addV x y) = addV (smulV a x) (smulV a y)) /\
        (!x:V. smulV (&0) x = zeroV) /\
        (!a:real. smulV a zeroV = zeroV) in
   let real_inner_product =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (inner:V->V->real).
        (!x y z:V.
           inner (addV x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
        (!a:real x y:V.
           inner (smulV a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
        (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
        (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
        (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zeroV) in
   let vnorm =
      \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V).
        sqrt(inner x x) in
   let finite_linear_combination =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V)
       (n:num) (basis:num->V) (coeff:num->real) (x:V).
        ?partial:num->V.
          partial 0 = zeroV /\
          (!i. i < n
               ==> partial (SUC i) =
                   addV (partial i) (smulV (coeff i) (basis i))) /\
          partial n = x in
   let finite_dimensional =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (smulV:real->V->V).
        ?n:num basis:num->V.
          (!x:V.
             ?coeff:num->real.
               finite_linear_combination
                 zeroV addV smulV n basis coeff x) /\
          (!coeff:num->real.
             finite_linear_combination
               zeroV addV smulV n basis coeff zeroV
             ==> !i. i < n ==> coeff i = &0) in
   let metric_open =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (s:V->bool).
        !x:V.
          x IN s
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:V.
                  vnorm inner (addV y (negV x)) < epsilon
                  ==> y IN s in
   let borel_space =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (events:(V->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:V->bool.
           metric_open addV negV inner s ==> events s) /\
        (!other:(V->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!s:V->bool.
              metric_open addV negV inner s ==> other s)
           ==> !s:V->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < epsilon in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (u:num->E) (l:E).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n
                ==> normE (addE (u n) (negE l)) < epsilon in
   let complex_normed_vector_space =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real).
        (!x y:E. addE x y = addE y x) /\
        (!x y z:E. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
        (!x:E. addE x zeroE = x) /\
        (!x:E. addE x (negE x) = zeroE) /\
        (!x:E. negE (negE x) = x) /\
        (!x:E. csmul cone x = x) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:E.
           csmul (cmul a b) x = csmul a (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:E.
           csmul (cadd a b) x =
           addE (csmul a x) (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a:real#real x y:E.
           csmul a (addE x y) =
           addE (csmul a x) (csmul a y)) /\
        (!x:E. csmul czero x = zeroE) /\
        (!a:real#real. csmul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
        (!x:E. &0 <= normE x) /\
        (!x:E. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
        (!a:real#real x:E.
           normE (csmul a x) = cmod a * normE x) /\
        (!x y:E. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
   let complete_space =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real).
        !u:num->E.
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                   N <= m /\ N <= n
                   ==> normE
                         (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon)
          ==> ?l:E. vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE u l in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (s:V->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:V)) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:V | s x = c}) in
   let simple_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (s:V->E).
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:V)) /\
        (!c:E. events {x:V | s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool) (h:V->real).
        ?s:num->V->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar events (s n)) /\
          (!x:V. scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:V->E).
        ?s:num->V->E.
          (!n. simple_vector events (s n)) /\
          (!x:V.
             vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE
               (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        ?g:V->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar events g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:V->E).
        ?g:V->E.
          strongly_measurable_vector
            events zeroE addE negE normE g /\
          almost_everywhere events mu (\x. h x = g x) in
   let integrable_simple_scalar =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (s:V->real).
        simple_scalar events s /\
        (!c:real.
           c IN IMAGE s (:V) /\ ~(c = &0)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:V | s x = c}))) in
   let integrable_simple_vector =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (zeroE:E) (s:V->E).
        simple_vector events s /\
        (!c:E.
           c IN IMAGE s (:V) /\ ~(c = zeroE)
           ==> ~(FST (mu {x:V | s x = c}))) in
   let simple_scalar_integral =
      \(mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (s:V->real) (z:real).
        ?n:num enum:num->real partial:num->real.
          (!c:real.
             c IN IMAGE s (:V) <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = &0 /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 SND (mu {x:V | s x = enum i}) * enum i +
                 partial i) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_vector_integral =
      \(mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (s:V->E) (z:E).
        ?n:num enum:num->E partial:num->E.
          (!c:E.
             c IN IMAGE s (:V) <=> ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = zeroE /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 addE
                   (csmul
                     (SND (mu {x:V | s x = enum i}),&0)
                     (enum i))
                   (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (u:real).
        !s:V->real z:real.
          integrable_simple_scalar events mu s /\
          (!x:V. &0 <= s x /\ s x <= h x) /\
          simple_scalar_integral mu s z
          ==> z <= u in
   let has_nonnegative_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real) (r:real).
        &0 <= r /\
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound events mu h r /\
        (!u:real.
           &0 <= u /\
           nonnegative_integral_upper_bound events mu h u
           ==> r <= u) in
   let scalar_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real) (h:V->real).
        ae_strongly_measurable_scalar events mu h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral events mu
             (\x:V. abs(h x)) r) in
   let vector_integrable =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:V->E).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector
          events mu zeroE addE negE normE h /\
        (?r:real.
           has_nonnegative_integral events mu
             (\x:V. normE(h x)) r) in
   let has_bochner_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (h:V->E) (z:E).
        ?s:num->V->E ints:num->E.
          (!n. integrable_simple_vector events mu zeroE (s n)) /\
          (!n. simple_vector_integral
                 mu zeroE addE csmul (s n) (ints n)) /\
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                   N <= n
                   ==> ?d:real.
                         has_nonnegative_integral events mu
                           (\x:V.
                              normE
                                (addE (s n x) (negE (h x)))) d /\
                         d < epsilon) /\
          vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE ints z in
   let bochner_integral =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (h:V->E).
        if complete_space zeroE addE negE normE /\
           vector_integrable
             events mu zeroE addE negE normE h
        then @z:E.
               has_bochner_integral
                 events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE h z
        else zeroE in
   let normalized_add_haar_measure =
      \(zeroV:V) (addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V)
       (inner:V->V->real)
       (events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real).
        (!a:V s:V->bool.
           events s ==> mu (IMAGE (addV a) s) = mu s) /\
        (!R:real.
           ~(FST
             (mu {x:V | vnorm inner x <= R}))) /\
        has_nonnegative_integral events mu
          (\x:V. exp(--pi * vnorm inner x pow 2)) (&1) in
   let continuous_at =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:V->E) (v:V).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !w:V.
                  vnorm inner (addV w (negV v)) < delta
                  ==> normE
                        (addE (f w) (negE (f v))) < epsilon in
   let continuous =
      \(addV:V->V->V) (negV:V->V) (inner:V->V->real)
       (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:V->E).
        !v:V.
          continuous_at
            addV negV inner addE negE normE f v in
   let fourier_character =
      \(inner:V->V->real) (sign:real) (v:V) (w:V).
        (cos(&2 * pi * inner v w),
         sign * sin(&2 * pi * inner v w)) in
   let fourier =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (inner:V->V->real) (f:V->E) (v:V).
        bochner_integral
          events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE
          (\w:V.
             csmul (fourier_character inner (-- &1) v w) (f w)) in
   let fourier_inv =
      \(events:(V->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(V->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (inner:V->V->real) (f:V->E) (v:V).
        bochner_integral
          events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE
          (\w:V.
             csmul (fourier_character inner (&1) v w) (f w)) in
   !zeroV:V
    addV:V->V->V
    negV:V->V
    smulV:real->V->V
    inner:V->V->real
    events:(V->bool)->bool
    mu:(V->bool)->bool#real
    zeroE:E
    addE:E->E->E
    negE:E->E
    csmul:(real#real)->E->E
    normE:E->real.
      real_vector_space zeroV addV negV smulV /\
      real_inner_product zeroV addV smulV inner /\
      finite_dimensional zeroV addV smulV /\
      borel_space addV negV inner events /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      normalized_add_haar_measure
        zeroV addV negV inner events mu /\
      complex_normed_vector_space zeroE addE negE csmul normE /\
      complete_space zeroE addE negE normE
      ==>
      !f:V->E.
        continuous
          addV negV inner addE negE normE f /\
        vector_integrable
          events mu zeroE addE negE normE f /\
        vector_integrable
          events mu zeroE addE negE normE
          (fourier
            events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner f)
        ==> fourier_inv
              events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner
              (fourier
                events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE inner f) =
            f`;;

title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3984053,
;; "Fourier inversion theorem": for a continuous integrable Banach-valued
;; function on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space whose Fourier
;; transform is integrable, inverse Fourier transformation recovers the
;; original function everywhere. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Mathematical objects are unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The conservative
;; interfaces below only provide application and constructor symbols; every
;; field, space, topology, measure, integral, and Fourier law used by the
;; statement is imposed explicitly by predicates below.

(defstub q3984053-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q3984053-zero (type) t)
(defstub q3984053-one (type) t)
(defstub q3984053-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q3984053-multiply (type left right) t)
(defstub q3984053-negate (type object) t)
(defstub q3984053-inverse (type object) t)
(defstub q3984053-less (type left right) t)
(defstub q3984053-norm (type object) t)
(defstub q3984053-smul (scalar-type space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q3984053-star (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q3984053-real-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q3984053-imag-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q3984053-of-real (real-type scalar-type real) t)
(defstub q3984053-imaginary-unit (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q3984053-inner (scalar-type space left right) t)
(defstub q3984053-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q3984053-sequence-at (sequence index) t)
(defstub q3984053-basis-at (basis index) t)
(defstub q3984053-coordinate (coordinates vector index) t)
(defstub q3984053-fourier-function (fourier function) t)
(defstub q3984053-fourier-inverse-function (fourier-inverse function) t)
(defstub q3984053-character-value (fourier-char real) t)
(defstub q3984053-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q3984053-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q3984053-open-ball-set (space center radius) t)
(defstub q3984053-preimage-set (function set) t)
(defstub q3984053-complement-set (carrier set) t)
(defstub q3984053-countable-union-set (carrier sequence) t)
(defstub q3984053-translate-set (space set shift) t)
(defstub q3984053-unit-cell-set (space basis coordinates dimension) t)
(defstub q3984053-fiber-set (function value) t)
(defstub q3984053-simple-values (function) t)
(defstub q3984053-indicator-function (real-type set) t)
(defstub q3984053-function-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q3984053-function-difference (type left right) t)
(defstub q3984053-function-norm (real-type type function) t)
(defstub q3984053-fourier-integrand
  (real-type scalar-type domain space fourier-char function frequency) t)
(defstub q3984053-inverse-fourier-integrand
  (real-type scalar-type domain space fourier-char function frequency) t)
(defstub q3984053-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q3984053-lintegral-value (lintegral function) t)
(defstub q3984053-bochner-integral-value (integral function) t)
(defstub q3984053-full-set (carrier) t)
(defstub q3984053-point-sequence (function-sequence point) t)
(defstub q3984053-simple-integral-sequence
  (real-type domain space measure function-sequence) t)

(defun q3984053-positive-p (real-type x)
  (q3984053-less real-type (q3984053-zero real-type) x))

(defun q3984053-leq (real-type x y)
  (not (q3984053-less real-type y x)))

(defun q3984053-abs (real-type x)
  (if (q3984053-less real-type x (q3984053-zero real-type))
      (q3984053-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q3984053-natural-cast (type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q3984053-zero type)
    (q3984053-add
     type
     (q3984053-one type)
     (q3984053-natural-cast type (- n 1)))))

(defun q3984053-integer-cast (type n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q3984053-negate
       type
       (q3984053-natural-cast type (- n)))
    (q3984053-natural-cast type (nfix n))))


(defun q3984053-vector-sum
    (real-type space basis coordinates vector n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q3984053-zero space)
    (let ((i (- n 1)))
      (q3984053-add
       space
       (q3984053-vector-sum
        real-type space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q3984053-smul
        real-type space
        (q3984053-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q3984053-basis-at basis i))))))


;; Complete ordered real field and its canonical complexification.

(defun-sk q3984053-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p type x)
      (q3984053-member-p type y)
      (q3984053-member-p type z))
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p type (q3984053-add type x y))
      (q3984053-member-p type (q3984053-multiply type x y))
      (q3984053-member-p type (q3984053-negate type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q3984053-zero type)))
       (q3984053-member-p type (q3984053-inverse type x)))
      (equal
       (q3984053-add type (q3984053-add type x y) z)
       (q3984053-add type x (q3984053-add type y z)))
      (equal (q3984053-add type x y) (q3984053-add type y x))
      (equal (q3984053-add type x (q3984053-zero type)) x)
      (equal
       (q3984053-add type x (q3984053-negate type x))
       (q3984053-zero type))
      (equal
       (q3984053-multiply type (q3984053-multiply type x y) z)
       (q3984053-multiply type x (q3984053-multiply type y z)))
      (equal
       (q3984053-multiply type x y)
       (q3984053-multiply type y x))
      (equal (q3984053-multiply type x (q3984053-one type)) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q3984053-zero type)))
       (equal
        (q3984053-multiply type x (q3984053-inverse type x))
        (q3984053-one type)))
      (equal
       (q3984053-multiply type x (q3984053-add type y z))
       (q3984053-add
        type
        (q3984053-multiply type x y)
        (q3984053-multiply type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p real-type x)
      (q3984053-member-p real-type y)
      (q3984053-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q3984053-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q3984053-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q3984053-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q3984053-less real-type x y)
        (q3984053-less real-type y z))
       (q3984053-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q3984053-less real-type x y)
       (q3984053-less
        real-type
        (q3984053-add real-type x z)
        (q3984053-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q3984053-positive-p real-type x)
        (q3984053-positive-p real-type y))
       (q3984053-positive-p
        real-type
        (q3984053-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun q3984053-distance
    (real-type type x y)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (q3984053-norm
   type
   (q3984053-add type x (q3984053-negate type y))))

(defun-sk q3984053-norm-values-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3984053-member-p type x)
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p real-type (q3984053-norm type x))
      (q3984053-leq
       real-type
       (q3984053-zero real-type)
       (q3984053-norm type x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q3984053-norm type x)
        (q3984053-zero real-type))
       (equal x (q3984053-zero type)))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-norm-triangle-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p type x)
      (q3984053-member-p type y))
     (q3984053-leq
      real-type
      (q3984053-norm type (q3984053-add type x y))
      (q3984053-add
       real-type
       (q3984053-norm type x)
       (q3984053-norm type y))))))

(defun q3984053-norm-laws-p (real-type type)
  (and
   (q3984053-norm-values-p real-type type)
   (q3984053-norm-triangle-p real-type type)))

(defun-sk q3984053-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))
     (q3984053-less
      real-type
      (q3984053-distance
       real-type type
       (q3984053-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3984053-convergence-start-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q3984053-convergence-tail-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q3984053-converges-p
    (real-type type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q3984053-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q3984053-convergence-start-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3984053-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m) (natp n) (natp start)
      (<= start m) (<= start n))
     (q3984053-less
      real-type
      (q3984053-distance
       real-type type
       (q3984053-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q3984053-sequence-at sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3984053-cauchy-start-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q3984053-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q3984053-cauchy-p (real-type type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q3984053-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q3984053-cauchy-start-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q3984053-sequence-in-type-p (type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q3984053-member-p
      type
      (q3984053-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q3984053-limit-exists-p
    (real-type type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q3984053-member-p type limit)
     (q3984053-converges-p
      real-type type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q3984053-complete-p (real-type type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-sequence-in-type-p type sequence)
      (q3984053-cauchy-p real-type type sequence))
     (q3984053-limit-exists-p
      real-type type sequence))))

(defun-sk q3984053-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q3984053-less
      real-type x
      (q3984053-natural-cast real-type n)))))

(defun-sk q3984053-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3984053-member-p real-type x)
     (q3984053-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q3984053-real-norm-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q3984053-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (equal
       (q3984053-norm real-type x)
       (q3984053-abs real-type x))
      (equal (q3984053-star real-type x) x)
      (equal
       (q3984053-real-part real-type real-type x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q3984053-imag-part real-type real-type x)
       (q3984053-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q3984053-of-real real-type real-type x)
       x)))))

(defun q3984053-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q3984053-member-p real-type (q3984053-zero real-type))
   (q3984053-member-p real-type (q3984053-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q3984053-zero real-type)
     (q3984053-one real-type)))
   (q3984053-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q3984053-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q3984053-positive-p real-type (q3984053-one real-type))
   (q3984053-real-norm-laws-p real-type)
   (q3984053-complete-p real-type real-type)
   (q3984053-archimedean-p real-type)))

(defun-sk q3984053-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q3984053-member-p complex-type z)
     (let* ((re (q3984053-real-part real-type complex-type z))
            (im (q3984053-imag-part real-type complex-type z))
            (re-z (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type re))
            (im-z
             (q3984053-multiply
              complex-type
              (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type im)
              (q3984053-imaginary-unit complex-type))))
       (and
        (q3984053-member-p real-type re)
        (q3984053-member-p real-type im)
        (equal z (q3984053-add complex-type re-z im-z))
        (equal
         (q3984053-star complex-type z)
         (q3984053-add
          complex-type re-z
          (q3984053-negate complex-type im-z)))
        (equal
         (q3984053-multiply
          real-type
          (q3984053-norm complex-type z)
          (q3984053-norm complex-type z))
         (q3984053-add
          real-type
          (q3984053-multiply real-type re re)
          (q3984053-multiply real-type im im))))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-of-real-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p real-type x)
      (q3984053-member-p real-type y))
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p
       complex-type
       (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type x))
      (equal
       (q3984053-real-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       x)
      (equal
       (q3984053-imag-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       (q3984053-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q3984053-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q3984053-add real-type x y))
       (q3984053-add
        complex-type
        (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type y)))
      (equal
       (q3984053-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q3984053-multiply real-type x y))
       (q3984053-multiply
        complex-type
        (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type y)))))))

(defun q3984053-complex-field-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (and
   (q3984053-real-field-p real-type)
   (q3984053-member-p complex-type (q3984053-zero complex-type))
   (q3984053-member-p complex-type (q3984053-one complex-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q3984053-zero complex-type)
     (q3984053-one complex-type)))
   (q3984053-field-laws-p complex-type)
   (q3984053-of-real-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (equal
    (q3984053-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q3984053-zero real-type))
    (q3984053-zero complex-type))
   (equal
    (q3984053-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q3984053-one real-type))
    (q3984053-one complex-type))
   (equal
    (q3984053-multiply
     complex-type
     (q3984053-imaginary-unit complex-type)
     (q3984053-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q3984053-negate complex-type (q3984053-one complex-type)))
   (equal
    (q3984053-real-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q3984053-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q3984053-zero real-type))
   (equal
    (q3984053-imag-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q3984053-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q3984053-one real-type))
   (q3984053-complex-coordinate-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q3984053-norm-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q3984053-complete-p real-type complex-type)))

;; Real inner-product domains and complex Banach codomains.

(defun-sk q3984053-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q3984053-member-p scalar-type b)
      (q3984053-member-p space x)
      (q3984053-member-p space y)
      (q3984053-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p space (q3984053-add space x y))
      (q3984053-member-p space (q3984053-negate space x))
      (q3984053-member-p
       space (q3984053-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (equal
       (q3984053-add space (q3984053-add space x y) z)
       (q3984053-add space x (q3984053-add space y z)))
      (equal (q3984053-add space x y) (q3984053-add space y x))
      (equal (q3984053-add space x (q3984053-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q3984053-add space x (q3984053-negate space x))
       (q3984053-zero space))
      (equal
       (q3984053-smul
        scalar-type space (q3984053-one scalar-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q3984053-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q3984053-multiply scalar-type a b) x)
       (q3984053-smul
        scalar-type space a
        (q3984053-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q3984053-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q3984053-add scalar-type a b) x)
       (q3984053-add
        space
        (q3984053-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q3984053-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q3984053-smul
        scalar-type space a (q3984053-add space x y))
       (q3984053-add
        space
        (q3984053-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q3984053-smul scalar-type space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-normed-space-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q3984053-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q3984053-norm
       space
       (q3984053-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (q3984053-multiply
       real-type
       (q3984053-norm scalar-type a)
       (q3984053-norm space x))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q3984053-member-p space x)
      (q3984053-member-p space y)
      (q3984053-member-p space z))
     (let ((xy (q3984053-inner scalar-type space x y))
           (xx (q3984053-inner scalar-type space x x)))
       (and
        (q3984053-member-p scalar-type xy)
        (equal
         (q3984053-inner
          scalar-type space x (q3984053-add space y z))
         (q3984053-add
          scalar-type xy
          (q3984053-inner scalar-type space x z)))
        (equal
         (q3984053-inner
          scalar-type space x
          (q3984053-smul scalar-type space a y))
         (q3984053-multiply scalar-type a xy))
        (equal
         (q3984053-inner scalar-type space y x)
         (q3984053-star scalar-type xy))
        (equal
         (q3984053-multiply
          real-type
          (q3984053-norm space x)
          (q3984053-norm space x))
         (q3984053-real-part real-type scalar-type xx))
        (iff
         (equal xx (q3984053-zero scalar-type))
         (equal x (q3984053-zero space))))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-real-smul-compatibility-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (r x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q3984053-member-p real-type r)
      (q3984053-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q3984053-smul real-type space r x)
      (q3984053-smul
       complex-type space
       (q3984053-of-real real-type complex-type r)
       x)))))

(defun-sk q3984053-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (forall (i j x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
      (q3984053-member-p space (q3984053-basis-at basis i)))
     (implies
      (and
       (natp i) (natp j)
       (< i dimension) (< j dimension))
      (equal
       (q3984053-inner
        real-type space
        (q3984053-basis-at basis i)
        (q3984053-basis-at basis j))
       (if (equal i j)
           (q3984053-one real-type)
         (q3984053-zero real-type))))
     (implies
      (q3984053-member-p space x)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
        (q3984053-member-p
         real-type
         (q3984053-coordinate coordinates x i)))
       (equal
        x
        (q3984053-vector-sum
         real-type space basis coordinates x dimension)))))))

(defun q3984053-finite-real-inner-product-space-p
    (real-type space basis coordinates dimension)
  (and
   (natp dimension)
   (q3984053-member-p space (q3984053-zero space))
   (q3984053-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q3984053-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q3984053-normed-space-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q3984053-inner-product-laws-p real-type real-type space)
   (q3984053-orthonormal-basis-laws-p
    real-type space basis coordinates dimension)))

(defun q3984053-complex-banach-space-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (and
   (q3984053-member-p space (q3984053-zero space))
   (q3984053-vector-space-laws-p complex-type space)
   (q3984053-vector-space-laws-p real-type space)
   (q3984053-norm-laws-p real-type space)
   (q3984053-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q3984053-normed-space-laws-p
    real-type real-type space)
   (q3984053-real-smul-compatibility-p
    real-type complex-type space)
   (q3984053-complete-p real-type space)))

;; Borel sigma algebra and normalized translation-invariant volume.

(defun-sk q3984053-countable-union-member-p (sequence x)

(defun-sk q3984053-valid-set-p (space set)

(defun-sk q3984053-sets-equal-on-p (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies

     (iff
      (q3984053-set-member-p left x)

(defun-sk q3984053-empty-on-p (space set)

     (not (q3984053-set-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q3984053-full-set-law-p (space)

(defun-sk q3984053-complement-set-law-p (space)

(defun-sk q3984053-countable-union-set-law-p (space)
  (forall (sequence x)

     (q3984053-set-member-p
      (q3984053-countable-union-set space sequence) x)

(defun-sk q3984053-open-ball-set-law-p (real-type space)

      (q3984053-open-ball-set space center radius) x)

      (q3984053-member-p space x)
      (q3984053-member-p space center)

(defun-sk q3984053-translate-set-law-p (space)

      (q3984053-translate-set space set shift) x)

      (q3984053-member-p space x)
      (q3984053-set-member-p

(defun q3984053-set-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type space)
  (and
   (q3984053-full-set-law-p space)
   (q3984053-complement-set-law-p space)
   (q3984053-countable-union-set-law-p space)

(defun-sk q3984053-sequence-measurable-p (family sequence)

(defun-sk q3984053-family-valid-sets-p (space family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies

(defun-sk q3984053-family-extensional-p (space family)

      (q3984053-family-member-p family left)

(defun-sk q3984053-sigma-algebra-closure-p (space family)

     (q3984053-family-member-p family (q3984053-full-set space))

      (q3984053-family-member-p family set)

       family (q3984053-complement-set space set)))
     (implies
      (q3984053-sequence-measurable-p family sequence)
      (q3984053-family-member-p
       family
       (q3984053-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun q3984053-sigma-algebra-p (space family)

(defun-sk q3984053-balls-measurable-p

(defun-sk q3984053-family-subset-p (left right)

(defun-sk q3984053-borel-minimal-p

(defun q3984053-borel-space-p
    (real-type space borel)
  (and
   (q3984053-sigma-algebra-p space borel)
   (q3984053-balls-measurable-p real-type space borel)
   (q3984053-borel-minimal-p real-type space borel)))

(defun q3984053-ennreal-p (real-type x)
  (or
   (equal x :q3984053-top)
   (and
    (consp x)
    (equal (car x) :q3984053-finite)
    (q3984053-member-p real-type (cdr x))
    (q3984053-leq
     real-type (q3984053-zero real-type) (cdr x)))))

(defun q3984053-ennreal-finite (x)

(defun q3984053-ennreal-add (real-type x y)
  (if (or
       (equal x :q3984053-top)
       (equal y :q3984053-top))
      :q3984053-top
    (q3984053-ennreal-finite
     (q3984053-add real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun q3984053-ennreal-leq-p (real-type x y)
  (or
   (equal y :q3984053-top)
   (and
    (not (equal x :q3984053-top))
    (q3984053-leq real-type (cdr x) (cdr y)))))

(defun-sk q3984053-disjoint-sequence-p

      (and
       (q3984053-set-member-p
        (q3984053-sequence-at sequence i) x)
       (q3984053-set-member-p
        (q3984053-sequence-at sequence j) x))))))

(defun q3984053-ennreal-partial-sum

  (if (zp n)
      (q3984053-ennreal-finite (q3984053-zero real-type))
    (q3984053-ennreal-add
     real-type
     (q3984053-ennreal-partial-sum
      real-type measure sequence (- n 1))
     (q3984053-measure-value
      measure
      (q3984053-sequence-at sequence (- n 1))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-ennreal-upper-bound-p

      (q3984053-ennreal-partial-sum

(defun-sk q3984053-ennreal-series-value-p

(defun-sk q3984053-countable-additivity-p

     (q3984053-ennreal-series-value-p
      real-type
      measure
      sequence
      (q3984053-measure-value
       measure
       (q3984053-countable-union-set space sequence))))))

(defun-sk q3984053-measure-values-p (real-type measure)

(defun-sk q3984053-empty-measurable-zero-p

(defun q3984053-measure-space-p

(defun q3984053-unit-coordinates-p

(defun-sk q3984053-unit-cell-coordinate-p

(defun-sk q3984053-function-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type)
  (forall (type f g set value x)
    (and
     (equal
      (q3984053-function-at
       (q3984053-function-add type f g) x)
      (q3984053-add
       type
       (q3984053-function-at f x)
       (q3984053-function-at g x)))
     (equal
      (q3984053-function-at
       (q3984053-function-difference type f g) x)
      (q3984053-add
       type
       (q3984053-function-at f x)
       (q3984053-negate
        type (q3984053-function-at g x))))
     (equal
      (q3984053-function-at
       (q3984053-function-norm real-type type f) x)
      (q3984053-norm type (q3984053-function-at f x)))
