title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q3984053,
-- "Fourier inversion theorem": a continuous integrable function from a
-- finite-dimensional real inner-product space to a complete complex normed
-- space is recovered by inverse Fourier transformation when its Fourier
-- transform is integrable. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem where

open import Support.Fourier

open ComplexNormedSpace
open FourierContext

fourier-inversion-theorem : Set2
fourier-inversion-theorem =
  (R M V E : Set) ->
  (context : FourierContext R M V E) ->
  (f : V -> E) ->
  Continuous
    (reals context)
    (domain context)
    (realSpace (codomain context))
    f ->
  IntegrableInContext context f ->
  IntegrableInContext context (fourierInContext context f) ->
  FunctionEqual
    (inverseFourierInContext context
      (fourierInContext context f))
    f

title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q3984053 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q3984053), "Fourier inversion theorem":
  a continuous integrable function from a finite-dimensional real
  inner-product space to a complete complex normed space equals the inverse
  Fourier transform of its integrable Fourier transform. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory;
open measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q3984053_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q3984053_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero)``);

val q3984053_real_inner_product_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_real_inner_product_space_def",
  ``q3984053_real_inner_product_space
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      q3984053_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!a x y. inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm x = sqrt (inner x x)) /\
      ?n : num.
        ?basis : num -> 'v.
          (!j k.
            j IN count n /\ k IN count n ==>
            inner (basis j) (basis k) =
              if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
          !x.
            x =
              ITSET
                (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
                (count n) zero``);

val q3984053_complex_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_complex_normed_space_def",
  ``q3984053_complex_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      q3984053_add_comm_group zero add neg /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = modu a * norm x)``);

val q3984053_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_tendsto_def",
  ``q3984053_tendsto
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (ell : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q3984053_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_cauchy_def",
  ``q3984053_cauchy
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !p q : num.
            N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
            norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q3984053_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_complete_def",
  ``q3984053_complete
      (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (norm : 'a -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'a.
        q3984053_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell : 'a. q3984053_tendsto add neg norm u ell``);

val q3984053_metric_open_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_metric_open_def",
  ``q3984053_metric_open
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (norm : 'v -> real) (s : 'v set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y.
            norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN s``);

val q3984053_volume_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_volume_measure_def",
  ``q3984053_volume_measure
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'v) (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (norm : 'v -> real) <=>
      measure_space m /\
      m_space m = UNIV /\
      measurable_sets m =
        sigma_sets UNIV {s | q3984053_metric_open add neg norm s} /\
      ?n : num.
        ?basis : num -> 'v.
          (!j k.
            j IN count n /\ k IN count n ==>
            inner (basis j) (basis k) =
              if j = k then 1 else 0) /\
          (!x.
            x =
              ITSET
                (\k acc. add (smul (inner x (basis k)) (basis k)) acc)
                (count n) zero) /\
          !a b : num -> real.
            (!k. k IN count n ==> a k <= b k) ==>
            measure m
              {x |
                !k.
                  k IN count n ==>
                  a k <= inner x (basis k) /\
                  inner x (basis k) < b k} =
            Normal
              (ITSET
                (\k acc. (b k - a k) * acc)
                (count n) 1)``);

val q3984053_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q3984053_measurable_simple
      (m : 'v m_space) (s : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'e. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q3984053_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q3984053_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'v -> 'e.
        (!n. q3984053_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q3984053_tendsto add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q3984053_bochner_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_bochner_integrable_def",
  ``q3984053_bochner_integrable
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      ?g : 'v -> 'e.
        q3984053_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q3984053_simple_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_simple_integral_def",
  ``q3984053_simple_integral
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (s : 'v -> 'e) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add
            (smul
              (complex_of_real (real (measure m {x | s x = y}))) y)
            acc)
        (IMAGE s UNIV DELETE zero) zero``);

val q3984053_bochner_approximates_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_bochner_approximates_def",
  ``q3984053_bochner_approximates
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (s : num -> 'v -> 'e) (ell : 'e) <=>
      ?g : 'v -> 'e.
        q3984053_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q3984053_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (s n x)))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable m
            (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x)))))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral m
                (Normal o
                  (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x))))))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q3984053_tendsto add neg norm
          (\n. q3984053_simple_integral m zero add smul (s n))
          ell``);

val q3984053_bochner_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_bochner_integral_def",
  ``q3984053_bochner_integral
      (m : 'v m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) =
      if q3984053_complete add neg norm /\
         q3984053_bochner_integrable m add neg norm f
      then
        @ell : 'e.
          ?s : num -> 'v -> 'e.
            q3984053_bochner_approximates
              m zero add neg smul norm f s ell
      else
        zero``);

val q3984053_continuous_at_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_continuous_at_def",
  ``q3984053_continuous_at
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) (v : 'v) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !w.
            normV (addV w (negV v)) < delta ==>
            normE (addE (f w) (negE (f v))) < epsilon``);

val q3984053_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_continuous_def",
  ``q3984053_continuous
      (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : 'v -> 'e) <=>
      !v.
        q3984053_continuous_at
          addV negV normV addE negE normE f v``);

val q3984053_fourier_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_fourier_def",
  ``q3984053_fourier
      (m : 'v m_space) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (w : 'v) =
      q3984053_bochner_integral
        m zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (\x.
          smulE
            (complex_exp
              (-(i * complex_of_real (2 * pi * inner w x))))
            (f x))``);

val q3984053_fourier_inv_def = new_definition (
  "q3984053_fourier_inv_def",
  ``q3984053_fourier_inv
      (m : 'v m_space) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e) (v : 'v) =
      q3984053_bochner_integral
        m zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (\w.
          smulE
            (complex_exp
              (i * complex_of_real (2 * pi * inner w v)))
            (f w))``);

val continuous_fourier_inversion =
  ``!(m : 'v m_space)
      (zeroV : 'v) (addV : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (negV : 'v -> 'v)
      (smulV : real -> 'v -> 'v) (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (normV : 'v -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'v -> 'e).
      q3984053_real_inner_product_space
        zeroV addV negV smulV inner normV /\
      q3984053_volume_measure
        m zeroV addV negV smulV inner normV /\
      q3984053_complex_normed_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q3984053_complete addE negE normE /\
      q3984053_continuous
        addV negV normV addE negE normE f /\
      q3984053_bochner_integrable m addE negE normE f /\
      q3984053_bochner_integrable m addE negE normE
        (q3984053_fourier
          m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE f)
      ==>
      q3984053_fourier_inv
        m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE
        (q3984053_fourier
          m inner zeroE addE negE smulE normE f) =
      f``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q3984053
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q3984053), "Fourier inversion theorem":
  for a continuous integrable function from a finite-dimensional real
  inner-product space to a complex Banach space, if its Fourier transform is
  integrable, then applying the inverse Fourier transform recovers the
  original function. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q3984053Volume is the translation-invariant Borel measure normalized so
  that the integral of exp(-pi * norm(x)^2) is one, matching mathlib's volume
  normalization on finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces.

  Q3984053FunctionIntegrable encodes almost-everywhere strong measurability
  and finite L1 norm. Q3984053Integral is the totalized Banach-valued
  Bochner integral defined by L1 limits of measurable finite-range functions.
  Q3984053Fourier and Q3984053FourierInv are the Bochner Fourier transform
  and inverse Fourier transform with kernels exp(-2*pi*i*inner(w,x)) and
  exp(2*pi*i*inner(w,x)), respectively.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus

theorem
  for V being RealUnitarySpace,
       S being SigmaField of the carrier of V,
       M being sigma_Measure of S,
       X being ComplexBanachSpace,
       J being Relation of Funcs(the carrier of V,the carrier of X),
                           the carrier of X,
       f,F,G being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X
  st
    V is finite-dimensional &
    (ex n being Nat,
        u being Function of the carrier of V,REAL n,
        B being Subset-Family of the carrier of V,
        C being Subset of V st
      u is one-to-one &
      rng u = REAL n &
      (for x,y being Point of V holds
        u.(x+y) = u.x+u.y) &
      (for a being Real, x being Point of V holds
        u.(a*x) = a*u.x) &
      (for x being Point of V holds
        ex z being Element of REAL n st
          z = u.x & |.z.| = ||.x.||) &
      (for A being Subset of the carrier of V holds
        A in B iff
          ex c being Point of V, r being Real st
            0 < r &
            A = {x where x is Point of V: ||.x-c.|| < r}) &
      S = sigma(B) &
      C in S &
      C = {x where x is Point of V:
        ex z being Element of REAL n st
          z = u.x &
          for i being Nat st i in Seg n holds
            0 <= z.i & z.i < 1} &
      M.C = 1 &
      (for A being Element of S, a being Point of V holds
        ex T being Element of S st
          T = {y where y is Point of V:
            ex x being Point of V st x in A & y = x+a} &
          M.T = M.A)) &
    (for g being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X,
         y being Point of X holds
      [g,y] in J iff
        ex Q being sequence of Funcs(the carrier of V,the carrier of X),
           I being sequence of X,
           E being Real_Sequence st
          (for k being Nat holds
            ex q being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X,
               A being FinSequence of S,
               z being sequence of X,
               r being Real_Sequence,
               p being sequence of X,
               e being Function of the carrier of V,REAL st
              Q.k = q &
              p.0 = 0.X &
              (for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                p.(i+1) = p.i + ((r.i) qua Complex)*z.i) &
              I.k = p.(len A) &
              (for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                0 <= r.i & M.(A.(i+1)) = r.i) &
              (for i,j being Nat st
                  i < len A & j < len A & i <> j
                holds A.(i+1) misses A.(j+1)) &
              (for x being Point of V holds
                (ex i being Nat st
                  i < len A & x in A.(i+1) & q.x = z.i) or
                ((for i being Nat st i < len A holds not x in A.(i+1)) &
                  q.x = 0.X)) &
              (for x being Point of V holds
                e.x = ||.g.x-q.x.||) &
              e is_integrable_on M &
              E.k = Integral(M,e)) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds |.E.k.| < e) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds ||.I.k-y.|| < e)) &
    (ex y being Point of X st [f,y] in J) &
    (ex y being Point of X st [F,y] in J) &
    (for w being Point of V holds
      ex h being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X st
        (for x being Point of V holds
          h.x = (cos(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,x])) -
            sin(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,x]))*<i>)*f.x) &
        [h,F.w] in J) &
    (for v being Point of V holds
      ex h being Function of the carrier of V,the carrier of X st
        (for w being Point of V holds
          h.w = (cos(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,v])) +
            sin(2*PI*((the scalar of V).[w,v]))*<i>)*F.w) &
        [h,G.v] in J) &
    (for v being Point of V holds
      for e being Real st 0 < e holds
        ex d being Real st 0 < d &
          for x being Point of V st
            ||.x-v.|| < d
          holds ||.f.x-f.v.|| < e)
  holds
    G = f
proof
end;

title: Q3984053_fourier_inversion_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q3984053,
% "Fourier inversion theorem": a continuous integrable function on an arbitrary
% finite-dimensional real inner-product space equals the inverse Fourier
% transform of its integrable Fourier transform. This file contains no proof.

fourier_inversion_theorem_Q3984053[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool],
  zeroA: A,
  addA: [A, A -> A],
  negA: [A -> A],
  smulA: [real, A -> A],
  normA: [A -> real],
  innerA: [A, A -> real],
  G: TYPE+,
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  smulG: [real, G -> G],
  csmulG: [real, real, G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_function: TYPE = [A -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  g_function: TYPE = [A -> G]
  g_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> g_function]
  g_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> G]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]

  subG(x, y: G): G = addG(x, negG(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G): addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) = addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: G):
        smulG(a, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a + b, x) =
          addG(smulG(a, x), smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a * b, x) = smulG(a, smulG(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G): smulG(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G): normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        normG(smulG(a, x)) = abs(a) * normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y)) <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  converges_to_g(values: g_sequence, limit: G): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normG(subG(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_g(values: g_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normG(
              subG(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_g: bool =
    FORALL (values: g_sequence):
      cauchy_g(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: G): converges_to_g(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      E: event): bool =
    carrier_event(E)
      AND EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
        Sigma(measurable_cover)
          AND (FORALL (omega: A):
            carrier(omega) AND E(omega)
              IMPLIES measurable_cover(omega))
          AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [A -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) AND NOT property(omega))

  finite_g_sum(values: g_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_g_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_g_value(
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): G =
    finite_g_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroG
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_g_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  finite_simple_real_value(
      coefficients: real_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          0
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_real_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))

  strongly_measurable_g(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: g_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_g(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_g(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: g_function):
      strongly_measurable_g(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  strongly_measurable_real(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: real_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_real(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            converges_to_real(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                approximants(index)(omega),
              function_value(omega)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: real_function):
      strongly_measurable_real(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            function_value(omega) =
              measurable_version(omega))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_g(function_value: g_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(normG(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  abs_enorm_real(function_value: real_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        finite_measure_value(abs(function_value(omega)))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  has_finite_integral_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M, Sigma, enorm_g(function_value), integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  has_finite_integral_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: measure_value):
      has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        abs_enorm_real(function_value),
        integral_value)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(integral_value)

  integrable_g(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_g(M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_real(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_real(M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND has_finite_integral_real(
        M, Sigma, function_value)

  integrable_simple_g_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_g_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroG
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: g_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroG
    ELSE
      addG(
        finite_simple_g_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        smulG(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_g_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: g_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_g_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            function_value(omega) =
              finite_simple_g_value(
                coefficients, pieces, count, omega))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_g_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: g_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_g(
          LAMBDA (omega: A):
            subG(
              function_value(omega),
              approximant(omega))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      approximants: g_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_g(Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function,
      integral_value: G): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: g_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: g_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_g_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_g(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): G =
    IF complete_space_g
        AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: G):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroG
    ENDIF

  coordinate_vector: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  coordinate_map: TYPE = [A -> coordinate_vector]
  reconstruction_map: TYPE = [coordinate_vector -> A]

  subA(x, y: A): A =
    addA(x, negA(y))

  coordinate_zero: coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat): 0

  coordinate_add(
      left, right: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      left(index) + right(index)

  coordinate_scale(
      scalar: real,
      value: coordinate_vector): coordinate_vector =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      scalar * value(index)

  supported(
      value: coordinate_vector,
      dimension: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      dimension <= index IMPLIES value(index) = 0

  finite_coordinate_inner(
      left, right: coordinate_vector,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_coordinate_inner(left, right, count - 1)
        + left(count - 1) * right(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_inner_product_space_a: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: A):
      addA(x, y) = addA(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        addA(addA(x, y), z) =
          addA(x, addA(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        addA(x, zeroA) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        addA(x, negA(x)) = zeroA)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: A):
        smulA(a, addA(x, y)) =
          addA(smulA(a, x), smulA(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: A):
        smulA(a + b, x) =
          addA(smulA(a, x), smulA(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: A):
        smulA(a * b, x) =
          smulA(a, smulA(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        smulA(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        innerA(addA(x, y), z) =
          innerA(x, z) + innerA(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: A):
        innerA(smulA(a, x), y) =
          a * innerA(x, y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        innerA(x, y) = innerA(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        0 <= innerA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        innerA(x, x) = 0 IFF x = zeroA)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        normA(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        normA(x) ^ 2 = innerA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: A):
        normA(smulA(a, x)) = abs(a) * normA(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        normA(addA(x, y)) <= normA(x) + normA(y))

  orthonormal_coordinate_system(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: coordinate_map,
      reconstruct: reconstruction_map): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A):
      supported(coordinates(x), dimension))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        coordinates(addA(x, y)) =
          coordinate_add(coordinates(x), coordinates(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: A):
        coordinates(smulA(a, x)) =
          coordinate_scale(a, coordinates(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: A):
        reconstruct(coordinates(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (value: coordinate_vector):
        supported(value, dimension) IMPLIES
          coordinates(reconstruct(value)) = value)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        innerA(x, y) =
          finite_coordinate_inner(
            coordinates(x), coordinates(y), dimension))

  finite_dimensional_real_inner_product_space_a: bool =
    real_inner_product_space_a
      AND EXISTS
          (dimension: nat),
          (coordinates: coordinate_map),
          (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
        orthonormal_coordinate_system(
          dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)

  open_event(U: event): bool =
    carrier_event(U)
      AND FORALL (x: A):
        U(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (y: A):
              (carrier(y)
                AND normA(subA(y, x)) < radius)
              IMPLIES U(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: event):
        open_event(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (U: event):
            open_event(U) IMPLIES Other(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (E: event):
            Sigma(E) IMPLIES Other(E))

  translated_event(E: event, shift: A): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      carrier(x) AND E(subA(x, shift))

  coordinate_unit_cube(
      dimension: nat,
      coordinates: coordinate_map): event =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      carrier(x)
        AND FORALL (index: nat):
          index < dimension IMPLIES
            0 <= coordinates(x)(index)
              AND coordinates(x)(index) < 1

  full_carrier: bool =
    FORALL (x: A): carrier(x)

  canonical_volume_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    full_carrier
      AND finite_dimensional_real_inner_product_space_a
      AND generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
      AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (E: event), (shift: A):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES
          M(translated_event(E, shift)) = M(E))
      AND EXISTS
          (dimension: nat),
          (coordinates: coordinate_map),
          (reconstruct: reconstruction_map):
        orthonormal_coordinate_system(
          dimension, coordinates, reconstruct)
          AND M(coordinate_unit_cube(dimension, coordinates))
            = finite_measure_value(1)

  complex_product_re(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_re - left_im * right_im

  complex_product_im(
      left_re, left_im, right_re, right_im: real): real =
    left_re * right_im + left_im * right_re

  complex_norm_squared(
      real_part, imag_part: real): real =
    real_part ^ 2 + imag_part ^ 2

  complex_normed_space_g: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: G):
        smulG(a, x) = csmulG(a, 0, x))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x, y: G):
        csmulG(a_re, a_im, addG(x, y)) =
          addG(
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, x),
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, y)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: G):
        csmulG(a_re + b_re, a_im + b_im, x) =
          addG(
            csmulG(a_re, a_im, x),
            csmulG(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im: real),
          (x: G):
        csmulG(
          complex_product_re(
            a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
          complex_product_im(
            a_re, a_im, b_re, b_im),
          x)
          =
            csmulG(
              a_re, a_im,
              csmulG(b_re, b_im, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        csmulG(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        csmulG(0, 0, x) = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL
          (a_re, a_im: real),
          (x: G):
        normG(csmulG(a_re, a_im, x)) ^ 2 =
          complex_norm_squared(a_re, a_im)
            * normG(x) ^ 2)

  complex_banach_space_g: bool =
    complex_normed_space_g AND complete_space_g

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index)
                * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  fourier_kernel_smul(angle: real, value: G): G =
    csmulG(
      cosine_of_real(angle),
      sine_of_real(angle),
      value)

  fourier_transform(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (frequency: A):
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        LAMBDA (point: A):
          fourier_kernel_smul(
            -2 * pi * innerA(frequency, point),
            function_value(point)))

  inverse_fourier_transform(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: g_function): g_function =
    LAMBDA (point: A):
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        LAMBDA (frequency: A):
          fourier_kernel_smul(
            2 * pi * innerA(frequency, point),
            function_value(frequency)))

  continuous_at_g(
      function_value: g_function,
      point: A): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (nearby: A):
          normA(subA(nearby, point)) < radius
            IMPLIES
              normG(
                subG(
                  function_value(nearby),
                  function_value(point)))
                < epsilon_value

  continuous_g(function_value: g_function): bool =
    FORALL (point: A):
      continuous_at_g(function_value, point)

  fourier_inversion_theorem: bool =
    complex_banach_space_g IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (M: measure_map),
          (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
          (function_value: g_function):
        (canonical_volume_space(M, Sigma)
          AND continuous_g(function_value)
          AND integrable_g(M, Sigma, function_value)
          AND integrable_g(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(
              M, Sigma, function_value)))
        IMPLIES
          inverse_fourier_transform(
            M,
            Sigma,
            fourier_transform(
              M, Sigma, function_value))
            = function_value
END fourier_inversion_theorem_Q3984053

From Stdlib Require Import Reals QArith.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Theorem niven :
  forall theta : R,
    (exists r : Q, theta = Q2R r * PI) ->
    (exists q : Q, cos theta = Q2R q) ->
    cos theta = -1 \/
    cos theta = - (1 / 2) \/
    cos theta = 0 \/
    cos theta = 1 / 2 \/

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4116459,
;; "Niven's theorem": the only rational cosine values at rational multiples
;; of pi are -1, -1/2, 0, 1/2, and 1. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; For rational q, existence of a rational r with q = cos(pi*r) is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the internal existence of a positive integer
;; n such that T_n(q) is 1 or -1. Forward, write r = a/n and use
;; T_n(cos(pi*a/n)) = cos(pi*a). Conversely, every real root of
;; T_n(x) = +/-1 is cos(pi*a/n) for an integer a. Thus the predicate below
;; preserves exactly the source hypotheses on theta and its rational cosine.

(defun q4116459-chebyshev-t (n x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (cond
   ((zp n) 1)
   ((equal n 1) x)
   (t
    (-
     (* (* 2 x)
        (q4116459-chebyshev-t (- n 1) x))
     (q4116459-chebyshev-t (- n 2) x)))))

(defun-sk q4116459-rational-cosine-at-rational-multiple-p (q)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (posp n)
     (or
      (equal (q4116459-chebyshev-t n q) 1)
      (equal (q4116459-chebyshev-t n q) -1)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q4116459-niven-s-theorem-statement (q)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp q)
    (q4116459-rational-cosine-at-rational-multiple-p q))
   (or
    (equal q -1)
    (equal q -1/2)
    (equal q 0)
    (equal q 1/2)
    (equal q 1))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q4116459_niven_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4116459
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q4116459), "Niven's theorem": a rational multiple
-- of pi with rational cosine has cosine equal to -1, -1/2, 0, 1/2, or 1.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q4116459_niven_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc oneN

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals y)

fromIntR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  R
fromIntR reals (pos n) =
  fromNatR reals n
fromIntR reals (negsuc n) =
  negateR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n))

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius x =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals x center))
    radius

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumFirst reals zero terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals (suc n) terms =
  addR reals
    (sumFirst reals n terms)
    (terms n)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  oneN
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

naturalPower :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
naturalPower reals x zero =
  oneR reals
naturalPower reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals
    (naturalPower reals x n)
    x

alternate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternate reals zero x =
  x
alternate reals (suc n) x =
  negateR reals (alternate reals n x)

evenExponent : Nat -> Nat
evenExponent n =
  n + n

oddExponent : Nat -> Nat
oddExponent n =
  suc (evenExponent n)

sineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
sineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divideR reals
      (naturalPower reals x (oddExponent n))
      (fromNatR reals (factorial (oddExponent n))))

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternate reals n
    (divideR reals
      (naturalPower reals x (evenExponent n))
      (fromNatR reals (factorial (evenExponent n))))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo {R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      CloseTo reals limit epsilon (sequence n))

SeriesHasSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SeriesHasSum reals terms value =
  ConvergesTo reals
    (\ n -> sumFirst reals n terms)
    value

record StandardTrigonometry
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    sine cosine : R -> R
    pi : R

    sine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (sineTerm reals x)
        (sine x)
    cosine-is-power-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SeriesHasSum reals
        (cosineTerm reals x)
        (cosine x)

    pi-positive :
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) pi
    sine-pi-zero :
      sine pi == zeroR reals
    pi-is-first-positive-sine-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      sine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqualR reals pi x

open StandardTrigonometry

rationalValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Int ->
  Nat ->
  R
rationalValue reals numerator denominatorMinusOne =
  divideR reals
    (fromIntR reals numerator)
    (fromNatR reals (suc denominatorMinusOne))

RationalReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
RationalReal reals x =
  Exists Int
    (\ numerator ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ denominatorMinusOne ->
          x ==
          rationalValue reals numerator denominatorMinusOne))

RationalMultipleOfPi :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardTrigonometry reals ->
  R ->
  Set
RationalMultipleOfPi reals trigonometry theta =
  Exists Int
    (\ numerator ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ denominatorMinusOne ->
          theta ==
          multiplyR reals
            (rationalValue reals numerator denominatorMinusOne)
            (pi trigonometry)))

FiveNivenValues :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
FiveNivenValues reals x =
  (x == negateR reals (oneR reals)) or
  ((x ==
    negateR reals
      (divideR reals
        (oneR reals)
        (fromNatR reals twoN))) or
  ((x == zeroR reals) or
  ((x ==
    divideR reals
      (oneR reals)
      (fromNatR reals twoN)) or
  (x == oneR reals))))

niven-s-theorem : Set1
niven-s-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (trigonometry : StandardTrigonometry reals) ->
  (theta : R) ->
  RationalMultipleOfPi reals trigonometry theta ->
  RationalReal reals (cosine trigonometry theta) ->
  FiveNivenValues reals (cosine trigonometry theta)

title: Q4116459_niven_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4116459
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q4116459), "Niven's theorem": if a real angle is a
% rational multiple of pi and has rational cosine, that cosine is one of
% -1, -1/2, 0, 1/2, or 1. This file contains no proof.

Q4116459_niven_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  cosine_partial(argument: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(argument, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              ((-1 :: real) ^ index) * argument ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  cosine(argument: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial(argument, count),
          value))

  is_pi(value: real): bool =
    3 < value
      AND value < 4
      AND cosine(value / 2) = 0

  pi: real =
    epsilon(LAMBDA (value: real): is_pi(value))

  rational_multiple_of_pi(theta: real): bool =
    EXISTS (r: real):
      rational?(r) AND theta = r * pi

  niven: bool =
    FORALL (theta: real):
      (rational_multiple_of_pi(theta)
        AND rational?(cosine(theta)))
      IMPLIES
        (cosine(theta) = -1
          OR cosine(theta) = ((-1 :: real) / 2)
          OR cosine(theta) = 0
          OR cosine(theta) = ((1 :: real) / 2)
          OR cosine(theta) = 1)
END Q4116459_niven_s_theorem

module

@[expose] public section

open Filter Asymptotics

namespace Q420714

  {r : α → ℕ → ℕ}

/-- The upper-bound part of the Akra-Bazzi theorem. -/
