title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q420714
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q420714), "Akra-Bazzi theorem": the upper-bound
  part of the theorem for divide-and-conquer recurrences with polynomially
  growing toll functions and asymptotically proportional subproblem sizes.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List Arith ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q420714_finite_nonempty_type (A : Type) : Type := {
  q420714_enum : list A;
  q420714_enum_nodup : NoDup q420714_enum;
  q420714_enum_complete :
    forall x : A, In x q420714_enum;
  q420714_inhabitant : A
}.

Arguments q420714_enum {A} _.

Fixpoint q420714_list_sum {A : Type}
    (elements : list A) (f : A -> R) : R :=
  match elements with
  | nil => 0
  | x :: rest => f x + q420714_list_sum rest f
  end.

Definition q420714_finite_sum {A : Type}
    (F : q420714_finite_nonempty_type A)
    (f : A -> R) : R :=
  q420714_list_sum (q420714_enum F) f.

Definition q420714_rpow (x exponent : R) : R :=
  if Req_EM_T x 0
  then if Req_EM_T exponent 0 then 1 else 0
  else Rpower x exponent.

Definition q420714_grows_polynomially (g : R -> R) : Prop :=
  forall beta : R,
    0 < beta < 1 ->
    exists lower_constant : R,
      0 < lower_constant /\
      exists upper_constant : R,
        0 < upper_constant /\
        exists threshold : R,
          forall x : R,
            threshold <= x ->
            forall u : R,
              beta * x <= u <= x ->
              lower_constant * g x <= g u <= upper_constant * g x.

Definition q420714_is_little_o_subproblem_error
    {A : Type}
    (b : A -> R)
    (r : A -> nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall i : A,
    forall constant : R,
      0 < constant ->
      exists threshold : nat,
        forall n : nat,
          (threshold <= n)%nat ->
          Rabs (INR (r i n) - b i * INR n) <=
          constant * Rabs (INR n / (ln (INR n)) ^ 2).

Record q420714_akra_bazzi_recurrence
    {A : Type}
    (F : q420714_finite_nonempty_type A)
    (T : nat -> R)
    (g : R -> R)
    (a b : A -> R)
    (r : A -> nat -> nat) : Type := {
  q420714_base_threshold : nat;
  q420714_base_threshold_positive :
    (0 < q420714_base_threshold)%nat;
  q420714_a_positive :
    forall i : A, 0 < a i;
  q420714_b_positive :
    forall i : A, 0 < b i;
  q420714_b_less_than_one :
    forall i : A, b i < 1;
  q420714_g_nonnegative :
    forall x : R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= g x;
  q420714_g_polynomial_growth :
    q420714_grows_polynomially g;
  q420714_recurrence_equation :
    forall n : nat,
      (q420714_base_threshold <= n)%nat ->
      T n =
      q420714_finite_sum F
        (fun i => a i * T (r i n)) +
      g (INR n);
  q420714_base_values_positive :
    forall n : nat,
      (n < q420714_base_threshold)%nat ->
      0 < T n;
  q420714_subproblem_decreases :
    forall (i : A) (n : nat),
      (q420714_base_threshold <= n)%nat ->
      (r i n < n)%nat;
  q420714_subproblem_approximation :
    q420714_is_little_o_subproblem_error b r
}.

Definition q420714_exponent {A : Type}
    (F : q420714_finite_nonempty_type A)
    (a b : A -> R) : R :=
  epsilon (inhabits 0)
    (fun exponent : R =>
      q420714_finite_sum F
        (fun i => a i * q420714_rpow (b i) exponent) = 1).

Fixpoint q420714_partial_sum
    (term : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q420714_partial_sum term k + term k
  end.

Definition q420714_asymptotic_bound {A : Type}
    (F : q420714_finite_nonempty_type A)
    (g : R -> R)
    (a b : A -> R)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  let exponent := q420714_exponent F a b in
  q420714_rpow (INR n) exponent +
  q420714_rpow (INR n) exponent *
    q420714_partial_sum
      (fun u =>
        g (INR u) /
        q420714_rpow (INR u) (exponent + 1))
      n.

Definition q420714_is_big_o_at_top
    (f h : nat -> R) : Prop :=
  exists constant : R,
    exists threshold : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (threshold <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (f n) <= constant * Rabs (h n).

Module AkraBazziRecurrence.

Theorem isBigO_asympBound :
  forall (A : Type)
         (F : q420714_finite_nonempty_type A)
         (T : nat -> R)
         (g : R -> R)
         (a b : A -> R)
         (r : A -> nat -> nat),
    q420714_akra_bazzi_recurrence F T g a b r ->
    q420714_is_big_o_at_top T
      (q420714_asymptotic_bound F g a b).
Admitted.

End AkraBazziRecurrence.

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q420714,
  "Akra–Bazzi theorem": the standard Akra–Bazzi expression is an asymptotic
  upper bound for every recurrence satisfying the theorem's hypotheses.
  This file contains no proof.
*)
theory Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
  imports "HOL-Library.Landau_Symbols"
begin

definition q420714_grows_polynomially :: "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q420714_grows_polynomially f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>b. 0 < b \<and> b < 1 \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>c1>0. \<exists>c2>0.
        eventually
          (\<lambda>x. \<forall>u. b * x \<le> u \<and> u \<le> x \<longrightarrow>
            c1 * f x \<le> f u \<and> f u \<le> c2 * f x)
          at_top))"

definition q420714_recurrence ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     (real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i::finite \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q420714_recurrence T g a b r \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>n0. 0 < n0 \<and>
      (\<forall>i. 0 < a i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i. 0 < b i) \<and>
      (\<forall>i. b i < 1) \<and>
      (\<forall>x\<ge>0. 0 \<le> g x) \<and>
      q420714_grows_polynomially g \<and>
      (\<forall>n. n0 \<le> n \<longrightarrow>
        T n = (\<Sum>i\<in>UNIV. a i * T (r i n)) + g (real n)) \<and>
      (\<forall>n<n0. 0 < T n) \<and>
      (\<forall>i n. n0 \<le> n \<longrightarrow> r i n < n) \<and>
      (\<forall>i. (\<lambda>n. real (r i n) - b i * real n)
        \<in> smallo at_top
          (\<lambda>n. real n / (ln (real n)) ^ 2)))"

definition q420714_p ::
    "('i::finite \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q420714_p a b =
    (THE p. (\<Sum>i\<in>UNIV. a i * (b i powr p)) = 1)"

definition q420714_asymp_bound ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i::finite \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('i \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q420714_asymp_bound g a b n =
    (let p = q420714_p a b
     in real n powr p +
       (real n powr p) *
         (\<Sum>u\<in>{0..<n}. g (real u) / (real u powr (p + 1))))"

theorem q420714_isBigO_asympBound:
  fixes T :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
    and g :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
    and a b :: "'i::finite \<Rightarrow> real"
    and r :: "'i \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat"
  assumes "q420714_recurrence T g a b r"
  shows "T \<in> bigo at_top (q420714_asymp_bound g a b)"
  sorry

end

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q420714,
  "Akra–Bazzi theorem": an Akra–Bazzi divide-and-conquer recurrence is
  asymptotically bounded above by its discrete sum-transform expression.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/transc.ml";;

let Q420714_AKRA_BAZZI_THEOREM =
 `let real_rpow =
      \(x:real) (q:real).
        if x = &0
        then if q = &0 then &1 else &0
        else exp(q * ln x) in
   let grows_polynomially =
      \(g:real->real).
        !beta:real.
          &0 < beta /\ beta < &1
          ==> ?c1 c2 threshold:real.
                &0 < c1 /\ &0 < c2 /\
                !x u:real.
                  threshold <= x /\
                  beta * x <= u /\ u <= x
                  ==> c1 * g x <= g u /\ g u <= c2 * g x in
   let little_o_sequence =
      \(f:num->real) (h:num->real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num.
                !n:num.
                  N <= n ==> abs(f n) <= epsilon * abs(h n) in
   let big_o_sequence =
      \(f:num->real) (h:num->real).
        ?C:real. ?N:num.
          &0 < C /\
          !n:num. N <= n ==> abs(f n) <= C * abs(h n) in
   let akra_exponent =
      \(a:A->real) (b:A->real).
        @p:real.
          sum (:A) (\i:A. a i * real_rpow (b i) p) = &1 in
   let asymp_bound =
      \(g:real->real) (a:A->real) (b:A->real) (n:num).
        let p = akra_exponent a b in
        real_rpow (&n) p *
        (&1 +
         sum {u:num | u < n}
           (\u:num. g (&u) / real_rpow (&u) (p + &1))) in
   !cost:num->real.
   !g:real->real.
   !a b:A->real.
   !r:A->num->num.
   !n0:num.
     FINITE (:A) /\
     0 < n0 /\
     (!i:A. &0 < a i) /\
     (!i:A. &0 < b i) /\
     (!i:A. b i < &1) /\
     (!x:real. &0 <= x ==> &0 <= g x) /\
     grows_polynomially g /\
     (!n:num.
        n0 <= n
        ==> cost n =
            sum (:A) (\i:A. a i * cost (r i n)) + g (&n)) /\
     (!n:num. n < n0 ==> &0 < cost n) /\
     (!i:A. !n:num. n0 <= n ==> r i n < n) /\
     (!i:A.
        little_o_sequence
          (\n:num. &(r i n) - b i * &n)
          (\n:num. &n / (ln(&n) pow 2)))
     ==> big_o_sequence cost (asymp_bound g a b)`;;

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q420714,
;; "Akra–Bazzi theorem": a finite-branch Akra–Bazzi recurrence is eventually
;; bounded above by its canonical power-and-sum asymptotic expression.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; A reified copy of the real numbers.  The laws below require it to be a
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field and characterize the analytic operations
;; used by the source statement.
(defstub q420714-real-p (real x) t)
(defstub q420714-zero (real) t)
(defstub q420714-one (real) t)
(defstub q420714-add (real x y) t)
(defstub q420714-mul (real x y) t)
(defstub q420714-neg (real x) t)
(defstub q420714-inv (real x) t)
(defstub q420714-less (real x y) t)
(defstub q420714-set-member-p (real-set x) t)
(defstub q420714-exp (real x) t)
(defstub q420714-log (real x) t)
(defstub q420714-rpow (real x y) t)

;; The recurrence data are arbitrary functions of the indicated source types.
(defstub q420714-t-at (t-function n) t)
(defstub q420714-g-at (g-function x) t)
(defstub q420714-a-at (a-function i) t)
(defstub q420714-b-at (b-function i) t)
(defstub q420714-r-at (r-function i n) t)

(defun q420714-sub (real x y)
  (q420714-add real x (q420714-neg real y)))

(defun q420714-div (real x y)
  (q420714-mul real x (q420714-inv real y)))

(defun q420714-leq (real x y)
  (or (equal x y)
      (q420714-less real x y)))

(defun q420714-positive-p (real x)
  (q420714-less real (q420714-zero real) x))

(defun q420714-nonnegative-p (real x)
  (q420714-leq real (q420714-zero real) x))

(defun q420714-abs (real x)
  (if (q420714-less real x (q420714-zero real))
      (q420714-neg real x)
    x))

(defun q420714-nat-cast (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q420714-zero real)
    (q420714-add
     real
     (q420714-one real)
     (q420714-nat-cast real (- (nfix n) 1)))))

(defun q420714-real-nat-power (real x n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q420714-one real)
    (q420714-mul
     real
     x
     (q420714-real-nat-power real x (- (nfix n) 1)))))

(defun q420714-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* (nfix n)
       (q420714-factorial (- (nfix n) 1)))))

(defun q420714-exp-prefix (real x terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      (q420714-zero real)
    (let* ((k (- (nfix terms) 1))
           (previous (q420714-exp-prefix real x k))
           (numerator (q420714-real-nat-power real x k))
           (denominator
            (q420714-nat-cast real (q420714-factorial k))))
      (q420714-add
       real
       previous
       (q420714-div real numerator denominator)))))

(defun-sk q420714-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (q420714-real-p real (q420714-zero real))
     (q420714-real-p real (q420714-one real))
     (not (equal (q420714-zero real) (q420714-one real)))
     (implies
      (q420714-real-p real x)
      (and
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-neg real x))
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-inv real x))
       (equal
        (q420714-add real x (q420714-zero real))
        x)
       (equal
        (q420714-add real x (q420714-neg real x))
        (q420714-zero real))
       (equal
        (q420714-mul real x (q420714-one real))
        x)
       (equal
        (q420714-inv real (q420714-zero real))
        (q420714-zero real))
       (implies
        (not (equal x (q420714-zero real)))
        (equal
         (q420714-mul real x (q420714-inv real x))
         (q420714-one real)))))
     (implies
      (and (q420714-real-p real x)
           (q420714-real-p real y))
      (and
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-add real x y))
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-mul real x y))
       (equal
        (q420714-add real x y)
        (q420714-add real y x))
       (equal
        (q420714-mul real x y)
        (q420714-mul real y x))))
     (implies
      (and (q420714-real-p real x)
           (q420714-real-p real y)
           (q420714-real-p real z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q420714-add real (q420714-add real x y) z)
        (q420714-add real x (q420714-add real y z)))
       (equal
        (q420714-mul real (q420714-mul real x y) z)
        (q420714-mul real x (q420714-mul real y z)))
       (equal
        (q420714-mul real x (q420714-add real y z))
        (q420714-add
         real
         (q420714-mul real x y)
         (q420714-mul real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q420714-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q420714-real-p real x)
      (not (q420714-less real x x)))
     (implies
      (and (q420714-real-p real x)
           (q420714-real-p real y))
      (or (q420714-less real x y)
          (equal x y)
          (q420714-less real y x)))
     (implies
      (and (q420714-real-p real x)
           (q420714-real-p real y)
           (q420714-real-p real z)
           (q420714-less real x y)
           (q420714-less real y z))
      (q420714-less real x z))
     (implies
      (and (q420714-real-p real x)
           (q420714-real-p real y)
           (q420714-real-p real z)
           (q420714-less real x y))
      (q420714-less
       real
       (q420714-add real x z)
       (q420714-add real y z)))
     (implies
      (and (q420714-real-p real x)
           (q420714-real-p real y)
           (q420714-less real (q420714-zero real) x)
           (q420714-less real (q420714-zero real) y))
      (q420714-less
       real
       (q420714-zero real)
       (q420714-mul real x y))))))

(defun-sk q420714-valid-real-set-p (real real-set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q420714-set-member-p real-set x)
     (q420714-real-p real x))))

(defun-sk q420714-real-set-nonempty-p (real-set)
  (exists (x)
    (q420714-set-member-p real-set x)))

(defun-sk q420714-is-upper-bound-p (real real-set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q420714-set-member-p real-set x)
     (q420714-leq real x upper))))

(defun-sk q420714-real-set-bounded-above-p (real real-set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (q420714-real-p real upper)
     (q420714-is-upper-bound-p real real-set upper))))

(defun-sk q420714-is-least-upper-bound-p
  (real real-set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-real-p real upper)
      (q420714-is-upper-bound-p real real-set upper))
     (q420714-leq real supremum upper))))

(defun q420714-is-supremum-p (real real-set supremum)
  (and
   (q420714-real-p real supremum)
   (q420714-is-upper-bound-p real real-set supremum)
   (q420714-is-least-upper-bound-p real real-set supremum)))

(defun-sk q420714-supremum-exists-p (real real-set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q420714-is-supremum-p real real-set supremum)))

(defun-sk q420714-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (real-set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-valid-real-set-p real real-set)
      (q420714-real-set-nonempty-p real-set)
      (q420714-real-set-bounded-above-p real real-set))
     (q420714-supremum-exists-p real real-set))))

(defun-sk q420714-exp-tail-p (real x epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and (natp terms)
          (<= cutoff terms))
     (q420714-less
      real
      (q420714-abs
       real
       (q420714-sub
        real
        (q420714-exp-prefix real x terms)
        (q420714-exp real x)))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q420714-exp-cutoff-exists-p (real x epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q420714-exp-tail-p real x epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q420714-exp-converges-p (real x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-real-p real epsilon)
      (q420714-positive-p real epsilon))
     (q420714-exp-cutoff-exists-p real x epsilon))))

(defun-sk q420714-analytic-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q420714-real-p real x)
      (and
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-exp real x))
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-log real x))
       (q420714-positive-p real (q420714-exp real x))
       (q420714-exp-converges-p real x)
       (equal
        (q420714-log real (q420714-exp real x))
        x)
       (if (equal x (q420714-zero real))
           (equal
            (q420714-log real x)
            (q420714-zero real))
         (equal
          (q420714-exp real (q420714-log real x))
          (q420714-abs real x)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q420714-real-p real x)
       (q420714-real-p real y))
      (and
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-rpow real x y))
       (implies
        (q420714-nonnegative-p real x)
        (equal
         (q420714-rpow real x y)
         (if (equal x (q420714-zero real))
             (if (equal y (q420714-zero real))
                 (q420714-one real)
               (q420714-zero real))
           (q420714-exp
            real
            (q420714-mul real (q420714-log real x) y))))))))))

(defun q420714-real-model-p (real)
  (and
   (q420714-field-laws-p real)
   (q420714-order-laws-p real)
   (q420714-dedekind-complete-p real)
   (q420714-analytic-laws-p real)))

;; The duplicate-free nonempty list alpha is a concrete presentation of the
;; arbitrary nonempty finite branch type from the Lean statement.
(defun q420714-finite-nonempty-carrier-p (alpha)
  (and
   (true-listp alpha)
   (consp alpha)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal alpha)))

(defun-sk q420714-functions-typed-p
  (real alpha t-function g-function a-function b-function r-function)
  (forall (i n x)
    (and
     (implies
      (natp n)
      (q420714-real-p real (q420714-t-at t-function n)))
     (implies
      (q420714-real-p real x)
      (q420714-real-p real (q420714-g-at g-function x)))
     (implies
      (member-equal i alpha)
      (and
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-a-at a-function i))
       (q420714-real-p real (q420714-b-at b-function i))))
     (implies
      (and (member-equal i alpha)
           (natp n))
      (natp (q420714-r-at r-function i n))))))

(defun-sk q420714-coefficients-p (real alpha a-function b-function)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (member-equal i alpha)
     (and
      (q420714-positive-p real (q420714-a-at a-function i))
      (q420714-positive-p real (q420714-b-at b-function i))
      (q420714-less
       real
       (q420714-b-at b-function i)
       (q420714-one real))))))

(defun-sk q420714-g-nonnegative-p (real g-function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-real-p real x)
      (q420714-nonnegative-p real x))
     (q420714-nonnegative-p
      real
      (q420714-g-at g-function x)))))

(defun-sk q420714-growth-tail-p
  (real g-function beta c1 c2 cutoff)
  (forall (x u)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-real-p real x)
      (q420714-real-p real u)
      (q420714-leq real cutoff x)
      (q420714-leq
       real
       (q420714-mul real beta x)
       u)
      (q420714-leq real u x))
     (and
      (q420714-leq
       real
       (q420714-mul
        real
        c1
        (q420714-g-at g-function x))
       (q420714-g-at g-function u))
      (q420714-leq
       real
       (q420714-g-at g-function u)
       (q420714-mul
        real
        c2
        (q420714-g-at g-function x)))))))

(defun-sk q420714-growth-cutoff-exists-p
  (real g-function beta c1 c2)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (q420714-real-p real cutoff)
     (q420714-growth-tail-p
      real g-function beta c1 c2 cutoff))))

(defun-sk q420714-growth-constants-exist-p
  (real g-function beta)
  (exists (c1 c2)
    (and
     (q420714-real-p real c1)
     (q420714-real-p real c2)
     (q420714-positive-p real c1)
     (q420714-positive-p real c2)
     (q420714-growth-cutoff-exists-p
      real g-function beta c1 c2))))

(defun-sk q420714-grows-polynomially-p (real g-function)
  (forall (beta)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-real-p real beta)
      (q420714-positive-p real beta)
      (q420714-less real beta (q420714-one real)))
     (q420714-growth-constants-exist-p
      real g-function beta))))

(defun q420714-branch-sum
  (real alpha t-function a-function r-function n)
  (if (endp alpha)
      (q420714-zero real)
    (q420714-add
     real
     (q420714-mul
      real
      (q420714-a-at a-function (car alpha))
      (q420714-t-at
       t-function
       (q420714-r-at r-function (car alpha) n)))
     (q420714-branch-sum
      real
      (cdr alpha)
      t-function
      a-function
      r-function
      n))))

(defun-sk q420714-recurrence-equation-p
  (real alpha t-function g-function a-function r-function n0)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= n0 n))
     (equal
      (q420714-t-at t-function n)
      (q420714-add
       real
       (q420714-branch-sum
        real alpha t-function a-function r-function n)
       (q420714-g-at
        g-function
        (q420714-nat-cast real n)))))))

(defun-sk q420714-base-positive-p (real t-function n0)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (< n n0))
     (q420714-positive-p
      real
      (q420714-t-at t-function n)))))

(defun-sk q420714-recursive-arguments-smaller-p
  (alpha r-function n0)
  (forall (i n)
    (implies
     (and
      (member-equal i alpha)
      (natp n)
      (<= n0 n))
     (< (q420714-r-at r-function i n) n))))

(defun-sk q420714-little-o-tail-p
  (real b-function r-function i epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= cutoff n))
     (q420714-leq
      real
      (q420714-abs
       real
       (q420714-sub
        real
        (q420714-nat-cast
         real
         (q420714-r-at r-function i n))
        (q420714-mul
         real
         (q420714-b-at b-function i)
         (q420714-nat-cast real n))))
      (q420714-mul
       real
       epsilon
       (q420714-abs
        real
        (q420714-div
         real
         (q420714-nat-cast real n)
         (q420714-real-nat-power
          real
          (q420714-log
           real
           (q420714-nat-cast real n))
          2))))))))

(defun-sk q420714-little-o-cutoff-exists-p
  (real b-function r-function i epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q420714-little-o-tail-p
      real b-function r-function i epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q420714-branch-approximation-p
  (real b-function r-function i)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q420714-real-p real epsilon)
      (q420714-positive-p real epsilon))
     (q420714-little-o-cutoff-exists-p
      real b-function r-function i epsilon))))

(defun-sk q420714-all-branch-approximations-p
  (real alpha b-function r-function)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (member-equal i alpha)
     (q420714-branch-approximation-p
      real b-function r-function i))))

(defun q420714-akra-bazzi-recurrence-p
  (real alpha t-function g-function a-function b-function r-function n0)
  (and
   (natp n0)
   (< 0 n0)
   (q420714-finite-nonempty-carrier-p alpha)
   (q420714-functions-typed-p
    real alpha t-function g-function a-function b-function r-function)
   (q420714-coefficients-p real alpha a-function b-function)
   (q420714-g-nonnegative-p real g-function)
   (q420714-grows-polynomially-p real g-function)
   (q420714-recurrence-equation-p
    real alpha t-function g-function a-function r-function n0)
   (q420714-base-positive-p real t-function n0)
   (q420714-recursive-arguments-smaller-p alpha r-function n0)
   (q420714-all-branch-approximations-p
    real alpha b-function r-function)))

(defun q420714-coefficient-power-sum
  (real alpha a-function b-function p)
  (if (endp alpha)
      (q420714-zero real)
    (q420714-add
     real
     (q420714-mul
      real
      (q420714-a-at a-function (car alpha))
      (q420714-rpow
       real
       (q420714-b-at b-function (car alpha))
       p))
     (q420714-coefficient-power-sum
      real
      (cdr alpha)
      a-function
      b-function
      p))))

(defun q420714-p-equation-p
  (real alpha a-function b-function p)
  (equal
   (q420714-coefficient-power-sum
    real alpha a-function b-function p)
   (q420714-one real)))

(defun q420714-asymp-series-sum (real g-function p n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q420714-zero real)
    (let* ((u (- (nfix n) 1))
           (u-real (q420714-nat-cast real u))
           (p-plus-one
            (q420714-add real p (q420714-one real)))
           (term
            (q420714-div
             real
             (q420714-g-at g-function u-real)
             (q420714-rpow real u-real p-plus-one))))
      (q420714-add
       real
       (q420714-asymp-series-sum real g-function p u)
       term))))

(defun q420714-asymp-bound (real g-function p n)
  (q420714-mul
   real
   (q420714-rpow
    real
    (q420714-nat-cast real n)
    p)
   (q420714-add
    real
    (q420714-one real)
    (q420714-asymp-series-sum
     real g-function p n))))

(defun-sk q420714-big-o-tail-p
  (real t-function g-function p constant cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n)
          (<= cutoff n))
     (q420714-leq
      real
      (q420714-abs
       real
       (q420714-t-at t-function n))
      (q420714-mul
       real
       constant
       (q420714-abs
        real
        (q420714-asymp-bound
         real g-function p n)))))))

(defun-sk q420714-big-o-cutoff-exists-p
  (real t-function g-function p constant)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q420714-big-o-tail-p
      real t-function g-function p constant cutoff))))

(defun-sk q420714-is-big-o-p
  (real t-function g-function p)
  (exists (constant)
    (and
     (q420714-real-p real constant)
     (q420714-positive-p real constant)
     (q420714-big-o-cutoff-exists-p
      real t-function g-function p constant))))

;; Keeping p under this existential mirrors the fact that Mathlib defines it
;; internally as the unique solution of sum_i a_i * b_i^p = 1.
(defun-sk q420714-asymptotic-upper-bound-p
  (real alpha t-function g-function a-function b-function)
  (exists (p)
    (and
     (q420714-real-p real p)
     (q420714-p-equation-p
      real alpha a-function b-function p)
     (q420714-is-big-o-p
      real t-function g-function p))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q420714-akra-bazzi-theorem
  (real alpha t-function g-function a-function b-function r-function n0)
  (implies
   (and
    (q420714-real-model-p real)
    (q420714-akra-bazzi-recurrence-p
     real
     alpha
     t-function
     g-function
     a-function
     b-function
     r-function
     n0))
   (q420714-asymptotic-upper-bound-p
    real
    alpha
    t-function
    g-function
    a-function
    b-function)))

:q

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q420714,
-- "Akra–Bazzi theorem": a real-valued divide-and-conquer recurrence satisfying
-- the Akra–Bazzi positivity, growth, and approximation hypotheses is big-O of
-- its canonical asymptotic bound. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<N_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<succ : {n : Nat} -> zero <N suc n
  succ<succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <N n -> suc m <N suc n

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=     : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  succ<=succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

Nonnegative :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Nonnegative reals x =
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x

powerNatR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerNatR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerNatR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerNatR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divideR reals
    (powerNatR reals x n)
    (fromNatR reals (factorial n))

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x zero =
  zeroR reals
exponentialPartialSum reals x (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x n)
    (exponentialTerm reals x n)

RealSequenceLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RealSequenceLimit {R = R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals exponent value =
  RealSequenceLimit reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals exponent)
    value

record StandardRealAnalysis (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    algebra :
      CompleteOrderedField R
    logarithm :
      R -> R
    realPower :
      R -> R -> R

    logarithm-zero :
      logarithm (zeroR algebra) == zeroR algebra
    logarithm-positive :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive algebra x ->
      ExponentialValue algebra (logarithm x) x

    realPower-zero-zero :
      realPower (zeroR algebra) (zeroR algebra) == oneR algebra
    realPower-zero-nonzero :
      (q : R) ->
      q != zeroR algebra ->
      realPower (zeroR algebra) q == zeroR algebra
    realPower-positive :
      (x q : R) ->
      Positive algebra x ->
      ExponentialValue algebra
        (multiplyR algebra (logarithm x) q)
        (realPower x q)

open StandardRealAnalysis

sumFin :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin reals {zero} terms =
  zeroR reals
sumFin reals {suc n} terms =
  addR reals
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin reals (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

partialSumR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
partialSumR reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
partialSumR reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (partialSumR reals terms n)
    (terms n)

EventuallyNat :
  (Nat -> Set) ->
  Set
EventuallyNat property =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      property n)

EventuallyReal :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
EventuallyReal {R = R} reals property =
  Exists R
    (\ cutoff ->
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals cutoff x ->
      property x)

IsLittleONat :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
IsLittleONat {R = R} reals f h =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  EventuallyNat
    (\ n ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (absoluteR reals (f n))
        (multiplyR reals epsilon (absoluteR reals (h n))))

IsBigONat :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Set
IsBigONat {R = R} reals f h =
  Exists R
    (\ constant ->
      Both
        (Nonnegative reals constant)
        (EventuallyNat
          (\ n ->
            lessOrEqualR reals
              (absoluteR reals (f n))
              (multiplyR reals constant
                (absoluteR reals (h n))))))

GrowsPolynomially :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  Set
GrowsPolynomially {R = R} reals g =
  (scale : R) ->
  Positive reals scale ->
  StrictLess reals scale (oneR reals) ->
  Exists R
    (\ lowerConstant ->
      Both
        (Positive reals lowerConstant)
        (Exists R
          (\ upperConstant ->
            Both
              (Positive reals upperConstant)
              (EventuallyReal reals
                (\ x ->
                  (u : R) ->
                  lessOrEqualR reals
                    (multiplyR reals scale x)
                    u ->
                  lessOrEqualR reals u x ->
                  Both
                    (lessOrEqualR reals
                      (multiplyR reals lowerConstant (g x))
                      (g u))
                    (lessOrEqualR reals
                      (g u)
                      (multiplyR reals upperConstant (g x))))))))

recurrenceSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  {branchCount : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc branchCount) -> R) ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  (Fin (suc branchCount) -> Nat -> Nat) ->
  Nat ->
  R
recurrenceSum analysis coefficients cost subproblem n =
  sumFin (algebra analysis)
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR (algebra analysis)
        (coefficients i)
        (cost (subproblem i n)))

distanceScale :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis R ->
  Nat ->
  R
distanceScale analysis n =
  divideR reals
    (fromNatR reals n)
    (powerNatR reals
      (logarithm analysis (fromNatR reals n))
      (suc (suc zero)))
  where
    reals = algebra analysis

record AkraBazziRecurrence
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  {branchCount : Nat}
  (cost : Nat -> R)
  (toll : R -> R)
  (coefficient shrink : Fin (suc branchCount) -> R)
  (subproblem : Fin (suc branchCount) -> Nat -> Nat) :
  Set where

  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    baseCutoff :
      Nat
    baseCutoff-positive :
      zero <N baseCutoff

    coefficient-positive :
      (i : Fin (suc branchCount)) ->
      Positive reals (coefficient i)
    shrink-positive :
      (i : Fin (suc branchCount)) ->
      Positive reals (shrink i)
    shrink-less-than-one :
      (i : Fin (suc branchCount)) ->
      StrictLess reals (shrink i) (oneR reals)

    toll-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      Nonnegative reals x ->
      Nonnegative reals (toll x)
    toll-grows-polynomially :
      GrowsPolynomially reals toll

    recurrence :
      (n : Nat) ->
      baseCutoff <=N n ->
      cost n ==
      addR reals
        (recurrenceSum analysis coefficient cost subproblem n)
        (toll (fromNatR reals n))

    base-cost-positive :
      (n : Nat) ->
      n <N baseCutoff ->
      Positive reals (cost n)

    subproblem-smaller :
      (i : Fin (suc branchCount)) ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      baseCutoff <=N n ->
      subproblem i n <N n

    subproblem-approximates-shrink :
      (i : Fin (suc branchCount)) ->
      IsLittleONat reals
        (\ n ->
          subtractR reals
            (fromNatR reals (subproblem i n))
            (multiplyR reals
              (shrink i)
              (fromNatR reals n)))
        (distanceScale analysis)

coefficientPowerSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  {branchCount : Nat} ->
  (Fin (suc branchCount) -> R) ->
  (Fin (suc branchCount) -> R) ->
  R ->
  R
coefficientPowerSum analysis coefficient shrink exponent =
  sumFin reals
    (\ i ->
      multiplyR reals
        (coefficient i)
        (realPower analysis (shrink i) exponent))
  where
    reals = algebra analysis

asymptoticBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  StandardRealAnalysis R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
asymptoticBound analysis toll exponent n =
  addR reals
    nPower
    (multiplyR reals nPower
      (partialSumR reals
        (\ u ->
          divideR reals
            (toll (fromNatR reals u))
            (realPower analysis
              (fromNatR reals u)
              (addR reals exponent (oneR reals))))
        n))
  where
    reals = algebra analysis
    nPower =
      realPower analysis (fromNatR reals n) exponent

record AkraBazziUpperBound
  {R : Set}
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R)
  {branchCount : Nat}
  (cost : Nat -> R)
  (toll : R -> R)
  (coefficient shrink : Fin (suc branchCount) -> R) :
  Set where

  private
    reals = algebra analysis

  field
    exponent :
      R
    exponent-equation :
      coefficientPowerSum analysis coefficient shrink exponent ==
      oneR reals
    cost-is-big-o :
      IsBigONat reals cost
        (asymptoticBound analysis toll exponent)

akra-bazzi-theorem : Set1
akra-bazzi-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis R) ->
  (branchCount : Nat) ->
  (cost : Nat -> R) ->
  (toll : R -> R) ->
  (coefficient shrink : Fin (suc branchCount) -> R) ->
  (subproblem : Fin (suc branchCount) -> Nat -> Nat) ->
  AkraBazziRecurrence
    analysis cost toll coefficient shrink subproblem ->
  AkraBazziUpperBound
    analysis cost toll coefficient shrink

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q420714, "Akra–Bazzi theorem": a recurrence with positive coefficients,
  contracting branches, polynomially growing toll, and lower-order rounding
  errors is big-O of its Akra-Bazzi asymptotic bound. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory;

val q420714_real_rpow_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_real_rpow_def",
  ``q420714_real_rpow (x : real) (p : real) =
      if x = 0 then if p = 0 then 1 else 0 else x rpow p``);

val q420714_finite_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_finite_sum_def",
  ``q420714_finite_sum (s : 'i set) (f : 'i -> real) =
      ITSET (\i acc. f i + acc) s 0``);

val q420714_little_o_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_little_o_def",
  ``q420714_little_o (f : num -> real) (h : num -> real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num. !n : num.
          N <= n ==> abs (f n) <= epsilon * abs (h n)``);

val q420714_grows_polynomially_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_grows_polynomially_def",
  ``q420714_grows_polynomially (g : real -> real) <=>
      !beta : real.
        0 < beta /\ beta < 1 ==>
        ?c1 c2 : real.

val q420714_akra_bazzi_recurrence_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_akra_bazzi_recurrence_def",
  ``q420714_akra_bazzi_recurrence
      (T : num -> real) (g : real -> real)
      (a : 'i -> real) (b : 'i -> real)
      (r : 'i -> num -> num) <=>
      ?n0 : num.
        0 < n0 /\
        (!i : 'i. 0 < a i) /\
        (!i : 'i. 0 < b i) /\
        (!i : 'i. b i < 1) /\
        (!x : real. 0 <= x ==> 0 <= g x) /\
        q420714_grows_polynomially g /\
        (!n : num.

          q420714_little_o

val q420714_exponent_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_exponent_def",
  ``q420714_exponent (a : 'i -> real) (b : 'i -> real) =
      @p : real.
        q420714_finite_sum UNIV
          (\i : 'i. a i * q420714_real_rpow (b i) p) = 1``);

val q420714_asymp_bound_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_asymp_bound_def",
  ``q420714_asymp_bound
      (g : real -> real) (a : 'i -> real) (b : 'i -> real)
      (n : num) =
      let p = q420714_exponent a b in
        q420714_real_rpow (&n) p +
        q420714_real_rpow (&n) p *
          ITSET
            (\u acc.
              g (&u) /

val q420714_is_big_o_def = new_definition (
  "q420714_is_big_o_def",
  ``q420714_is_big_o (f : num -> real) (h : num -> real) <=>
