val AkraBazziRecurrence_isBigO_asympBound =
  ``!(T : num -> real) (g : real -> real)
      (a : 'i -> real) (b : 'i -> real)
      (r : 'i -> num -> num).
      FINITE (UNIV : 'i set) /\
      q420714_akra_bazzi_recurrence T g a b r
      ==>
      q420714_is_big_o T (q420714_asymp_bound g a b)``;

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q420714
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q420714), "Akra-Bazzi theorem": every
  real-valued recurrence over an arbitrary finite nonempty family, with
  positive coefficients, contraction factors strictly between zero and one,
  a nonnegative polynomially growing toll function, and lower-order rounding
  perturbations, is eventually bounded in norm by a constant multiple of its
  Akra-Bazzi asymptotic bound. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q420714Rpow is real exponentiation on the nonnegative bases used below,
  including Mathlib's values at zero. Q420714Exponent is the unique real p
  satisfying sum_i a_i b_i^p = 1. Q420714Asymp expands the source definition
  n^p + n^p sum_{u < n} g(u) / u^(p+1). The quotient is explicitly zero when
  its denominator is zero, matching Lean's total division.

  Q420714GrowsPolynomially, Q420714SmallError, and Q420714Recurrence expand
  every field of the Lean AkraBazziRecurrence structure. Q420714BigO is the
  norm inequality definition of Big-O along the natural-number atTop filter.
  The final $a assertion is the translated corpus statement. All $a
  declarations here are unproved syntax, definitions, or the final statement;
  this file has no $p proof.
$)

$c
  Q420714Rpow
  Q420714Exponent
  Q420714Asymp
  Q420714GrowsPolynomially
  Q420714SmallError
  Q420714Recurrence
  Q420714BigO
$.

q420714-rpow-syntax $a class ( Q420714Rpow x y ) $.
q420714-exponent-syntax $a class ( Q420714Exponent I A B ) $.
q420714-asymp-syntax $a class ( Q420714Asymp I G A B n ) $.
q420714-grows-syntax $a wff ( Q420714GrowsPolynomially G ) $.
q420714-small-error-syntax $a wff ( Q420714SmallError I B R ) $.
q420714-recurrence-syntax $a wff ( Q420714Recurrence I T G A B R ) $.
q420714-big-o-syntax $a wff ( Q420714BigO T H ) $.

${
  $d x y $.

  q420714-rpow-definition $a |- (
    Q420714Rpow x y
  ) = if (
    x = 0
    ,
    if ( y = 0 , 1 , 0 )
    ,
    ( exp ` ( ( log ` x ) x. y ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I A B i p $.

  q420714-exponent-definition $a |- (
    Q420714Exponent I A B
  ) = (
    iota_ p e. RR
      (
        sum_ i e. I
          ( ( A ` i ) x. ( Q420714Rpow ( B ` i ) p ) )
      )
      =
      1
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I G A B n p u $.

  q420714-asymp-definition $a |- (
    Q420714Asymp I G A B n
  ) = (
    ( Q420714Rpow n ( Q420714Exponent I A B ) )
    +
    (
      ( Q420714Rpow n ( Q420714Exponent I A B ) )
      x.
      sum_ u e. ( 0 ..^ n )
        if (
          (
            Q420714Rpow
              u
              ( ( Q420714Exponent I A B ) + 1 )
          )
          =
          0
          ,
          0
          ,
          (
            ( G ` u )
            /
            (
              Q420714Rpow
                u
                ( ( Q420714Exponent I A B ) + 1 )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G b c d m u x $.

  q420714-grows-definition $a |- (
    ( Q420714GrowsPolynomially G )
    <->
    A. b e. RR
      (
        ( 0 < b /\ b < 1 )
        ->
        E. c e. RR+
          E. d e. RR+
            E. m e. RR
              A. x e. RR
                (
                  m <_ x
                  ->
                  A. u e. RR
                    (
                      (
                        ( b x. x ) <_ u
                        /\
                        u <_ x
                      )
                      ->
                      (
                        ( c x. ( G ` x ) ) <_ ( G ` u )
                        /\
                        ( G ` u ) <_ ( d x. ( G ` x ) )
                      )
                    )
                )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I B R e i m n $.

  q420714-small-error-definition $a |- (
    ( Q420714SmallError I B R )
    <->
    A. i e. I
      A. e e. RR+
        E. m e. NN0
          A. n e. ( ZZ>= ` m )
            (
              abs
              `
              (
                ( ( R ` i ) ` n )
                -
                ( ( B ` i ) x. n )
              )
            )
            <_
            (
              e
              x.
              (
                abs
                `
                (
                  n
                  /
                  ( ( log ` n ) ^ 2 )
                )
              )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I T G A B R i m n x $.

  q420714-recurrence-definition $a |- (
    ( Q420714Recurrence I T G A B R )
    <->
    E. m e. NN0
      (
        0 < m
        /\
        A. i e. I
          (
            0 < ( A ` i )
            /\
            0 < ( B ` i )
            /\
            ( B ` i ) < 1
          )
        /\
        A. x e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
          0 <_ ( G ` x )
        /\
        ( Q420714GrowsPolynomially G )
        /\
        A. n e. ( ZZ>= ` m )
          (
            ( T ` n )
            =
            (
              sum_ i e. I
                (
                  ( A ` i )
                  x.
                  ( T ` ( ( R ` i ) ` n ) )
                )
              +
              ( G ` n )
            )
          )
        /\
        A. n e. NN0
          (
            n < m
            ->
            0 < ( T ` n )
          )
        /\
        A. i e. I
          A. n e. ( ZZ>= ` m )
            ( ( R ` i ) ` n ) < n
        /\
        ( Q420714SmallError I B R )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d T H c m n $.

  q420714-big-o-definition $a |- (
    ( Q420714BigO T H )
    <->
    E. c e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
      E. m e. NN0
        A. n e. ( ZZ>= ` m )
          (
            ( abs ` ( T ` n ) )
            <_
            ( c x. ( abs ` ( H ` n ) ) )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I T G A B R n $.

  thousand-theorems-q420714-akra-bazzi-upper-bound $a |-
    A. I e. Fin
      A. T e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
        A. G e. ( RR ^m RR )
          A. A e. ( RR ^m I )
            A. B e. ( RR ^m I )
              A. R e. ( ( NN0 ^m NN0 ) ^m I )
                (
                  (
                    I =/= (/)
                    /\
                    ( Q420714Recurrence I T G A B R )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    Q420714BigO
                      T
                      ( n e. NN0 |-> ( Q420714Asymp I G A B n ) )
                  )
                )
  $.
$}

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q420714,
:: "Akra-Bazzi theorem": the recurrence satisfying the Akra-Bazzi positivity,
:: polynomial-growth, and rounding hypotheses has the prescribed asymptotic
:: upper bound. This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, RVSUM_1, ZFMISC_1, PREPOWER, SIN_COS,
    BINOP_1, BINOP_2, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQOP, SETWISEO, SETWOP_2,
    FINSOP_1, FUNCT_7, ORDINAL4, CARD_3, TAYLOR_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, NAT_D, VALUED_0,
    VALUED_1, BINOP_2, SETWISEO, BINOP_1, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_4, FINSOP_1, FINSEQOP, SETWOP_2, RVSUM_1,
    PREPOWER, SIN_COS, TAYLOR_1;
  constructors FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, REAL_1,
    COMPLEX1, NAT_1, NAT_D, VALUED_1, BINOP_1, SETWISEO, BINOP_2,
    FINSEQOP, FINSEQ_4, FINSOP_1, SETWOP_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2,
    RVSUM_1, PREPOWER, SIN_COS, TAYLOR_1, ZFMISC_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1,
    XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, BINOP_2, FUNCOP_1, FINSEQ_1,
    FINSEQ_2, FINSEQ_4, RVSUM_1, PREPOWER, SIN_COS;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TAYLOR_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for k,n0 being Nat,
      T being Function of NAT,REAL,
      g being Function of REAL,REAL,
      a,b being Function of Seg k,REAL,
      r being Function of [:Seg k,NAT:],NAT st
    0 < k &
    0 < n0 &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg k holds
      0 < a.i & 0 < b.i & b.i < 1) &
    (for x being Real st 0 <= x holds 0 <= g.x) &
    (for q being Real st 0 < q & q < 1 holds
      ex c1,c2 being Real st
        0 < c1 & 0 < c2 &
        ex X being Real st
          for x,u being Real st
            X <= x & q*x <= u & u <= x
          holds c1*g.x <= g.u & g.u <= c2*g.x) &
    (for n being Nat st n0 <= n holds
      ex terms being FinSequence of REAL st
        len terms = k &
        (for i being Nat st i in Seg k holds
          terms.i = a.i * T.(r.([i,n]))) &
        T.n = Sum terms + g.(n qua Real)) &
    (for n being Nat st n < n0 holds 0 < T.n) &
    (for i,n being Nat st i in Seg k & n0 <= n holds
      r.([i,n]) < n) &
    (for i being Nat st i in Seg k holds
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex N being Nat st
          for n being Nat st N <= n holds
            |.(r.([i,n]) qua Real) - b.i*(n qua Real).| <=
              epsilon *
                |.(n qua Real) /
                  (ln.(n qua Real) * ln.(n qua Real)).|)
  holds
    ex p being Real,
       coeffs being FinSequence of REAL st
      len coeffs = k &
      (for i being Nat st i in Seg k holds
        coeffs.i = a.i * (b.i #R p)) &
      Sum coeffs = 1 &
      ex C being Real, N being Nat st
        0 <= C & 0 < N &
        for n being Nat st N <= n holds
          ex inner being FinSequence of REAL st
            len inner = n &
            (for j being Nat st j in Seg n holds
              ((j = 1 & p + 1 = 0) implies
                inner.j = g.0) &
              ((j = 1 & p + 1 <> 0) implies
                inner.j = 0) &
              (1 < j implies
                inner.j =
                  g.((j-'1) qua Real) /
                    (((j-'1) qua Real) #R (p + 1)))) &
            |.T.n.| <=
              C * |.((n qua Real) #R p) * (1 + Sum inner).|
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q420714,
% "Akra–Bazzi theorem": an Akra–Bazzi divide-and-conquer recurrence is Big-O of
% n^p times one plus its real-power weighted cost prefix sum, where p is the
% exponent satisfying the Akra–Bazzi coefficient equation. This file contains no proof.

Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem[
  I: TYPE+,
  T: [nat -> real],
  g: [real -> real],
  a, b: [I -> real],
  r: [I, nat -> nat],
  n0: nat
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[I]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  real_power(base, exponent: real): real =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      real_exponential(exponent * natural_log(base))
    ELSIF base = 0 AND exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  full_index_set(carrier: finite_set[I]): bool =
    FORALL (i: I): member(i, carrier)

  index_sum_value(values: [I -> real], total: real): bool =
    EXISTS
      (carrier: finite_set[I]),
      (enumeration: [below(card(carrier)) -> (carrier)]),
      (partial_sums: [upto(card(carrier)) -> real]):
        full_index_set(carrier)
          AND bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = 0
          AND
            (FORALL (k: below(card(carrier))):
              partial_sums(k + 1) =
                partial_sums(k) + values(enumeration(k)))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(carrier))

  index_sum(values: [I -> real]): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (total: real):
        index_sum_value(values, total))

  prefix_sum(
      cost: [real -> real],
      exponent: real,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        prefix_sum(cost, exponent, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              cost(index :: real),
              real_power(index :: real, exponent + 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  asymptotic_bound(
      cost: [real -> real],
      exponent: real,
      n: nat): real =
    real_power(n :: real, exponent)
      * (1 + prefix_sum(cost, exponent, n))

  grows_polynomially(cost: [real -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (scale: real):
      0 < scale AND scale < 1 IMPLIES
        EXISTS (lower_constant, upper_constant: real):
          lower_constant > 0
            AND upper_constant > 0
            AND EXISTS (threshold: real):
              FORALL (x, u: real):
                threshold <= x
                  AND scale * x <= u
                  AND u <= x
                IMPLIES
                  lower_constant * cost(x) <= cost(u)
                    AND cost(u) <= upper_constant * cost(x)

  branch_approximation: bool =
    FORALL (i: I), (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (n: nat):
          cutoff <= n IMPLIES
            abs((r(i, n) :: real) - b(i) * (n :: real))
              <= epsilon_value
                * abs(
                    safe_div(
                      n :: real,
                      natural_log(n :: real) ^ 2))

  recurrence_assumptions: bool =
    is_finite_type[I]
      AND n0 > 0
      AND (FORALL (i: I): a(i) > 0)
      AND (FORALL (i: I): b(i) > 0 AND b(i) < 1)
      AND (FORALL (x: real): x >= 0 IMPLIES g(x) >= 0)
      AND grows_polynomially(g)
      AND
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          n0 <= n IMPLIES
            T(n) =
              index_sum(
                LAMBDA (i: I):
                  a(i) * T(r(i, n)))
                + g(n :: real))
      AND
        (FORALL (n: nat):
          n < n0 IMPLIES T(n) > 0)
      AND
        (FORALL (i: I), (n: nat):
          n0 <= n IMPLIES r(i, n) < n)
      AND branch_approximation

  akra_bazzi_exponent: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (exponent: real):
        index_sum(
          LAMBDA (i: I):
            a(i) * real_power(b(i), exponent))
          = 1)

  is_big_o_of_asymptotic_bound(exponent: real): bool =
    EXISTS (constant: real), (cutoff: nat):
      FORALL (n: nat):
        cutoff <= n IMPLIES
          abs(T(n))
            <= constant
              * abs(asymptotic_bound(g, exponent, n))

  isBigO_asympBound: bool =
    recurrence_assumptions IMPLIES
      is_big_o_of_asymptotic_bound(akra_bazzi_exponent)
END Q420714_akra_bazzi_theorem

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q422187
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q422187), "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language
-- over an arbitrary alphabet is regular if and only if the set of its left
-- quotients is finite. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Computability.DFA
public import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Basic

@[expose] public section

universe u

namespace Language
namespace Q422187

variable {α : Type u}

/-- The left quotient of `L` by `x` consists of suffixes `y` with `x ++ y ∈ L`. -/
def leftQuotient (L : Language α) (x : List α) : Language α := { y | x ++ y ∈ L }

/-- The Myhill–Nerode characterization of regular languages by left quotients. -/
theorem myhill_nerode_statement (L : Language α) :
    L.IsRegular ↔ (Set.range (leftQuotient L)).Finite := sorry

end Q422187
end Language

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q422187
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q422187), "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language over
  an arbitrary alphabet is regular if and only if its family of left quotients
  by finite words is finite. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Module Q422187_MyhillNerode.

Definition q422187_language (Alphabet : Type) : Type :=
  list Alphabet -> Prop.

Definition q422187_language_equiv
    {Alphabet : Type}
    (L K : q422187_language Alphabet) : Prop :=
  forall word : list Alphabet, L word <-> K word.

Definition q422187_left_quotient
    {Alphabet : Type}
    (L : q422187_language Alphabet)
    (prefix : list Alphabet) : q422187_language Alphabet :=
  fun suffix => L (prefix ++ suffix).

Record q422187_finite_type (X : Type) : Type := {
  q422187_enumeration : list X;
  q422187_enumeration_complete :
    forall x : X, In x q422187_enumeration
}.

Record q422187_dfa (Alphabet State : Type) : Type := {
  q422187_step : State -> Alphabet -> State;
  q422187_start : State;
  q422187_accepting : State -> Prop
}.

Arguments q422187_step {Alphabet State} _ _ _.
Arguments q422187_start {Alphabet State} _.
Arguments q422187_accepting {Alphabet State} _ _.

Fixpoint q422187_eval_from
    {Alphabet State : Type}
    (M : q422187_dfa Alphabet State)
    (state : State)
    (word : list Alphabet) : State :=
  match word with
  | [] => state
  | symbol :: rest =>
      q422187_eval_from M (q422187_step M state symbol) rest
  end.

Definition q422187_accepts
    {Alphabet State : Type}
    (M : q422187_dfa Alphabet State) : q422187_language Alphabet :=
  fun word =>
    q422187_accepting M
      (q422187_eval_from M (q422187_start M) word).

Definition q422187_is_regular
    {Alphabet : Type}
    (L : q422187_language Alphabet) : Prop :=
  exists State : Type,
    exists _ : q422187_finite_type State,
      exists M : q422187_dfa Alphabet State,
        q422187_language_equiv (q422187_accepts M) L.

Definition q422187_left_quotient_range
    {Alphabet : Type}
    (L : q422187_language Alphabet)
    (quotient : q422187_language Alphabet) : Prop :=
  exists prefix : list Alphabet,
    q422187_language_equiv
      (q422187_left_quotient L prefix) quotient.

Definition q422187_finite_left_quotient_range
    {Alphabet : Type}
    (L : q422187_language Alphabet) : Prop :=
  exists quotients : list (q422187_language Alphabet),
    forall quotient : q422187_language Alphabet,
      q422187_left_quotient_range L quotient ->
      exists representative : q422187_language Alphabet,
        In representative quotients /\
        q422187_language_equiv quotient representative.

Theorem isRegular_iff_finite_range_leftQuotient :
  forall (Alphabet : Type) (L : q422187_language Alphabet),
    q422187_is_regular L <->
    q422187_finite_left_quotient_range L.
Admitted.

End Q422187_MyhillNerode.

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q422187,
  "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language over an arbitrary alphabet is regular if
  and only if it has finitely many distinct left quotients. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
  imports Main
begin

record 'a q422187_dfa =
  q422187_state_count :: nat
  q422187_start :: nat
  q422187_step :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> nat"
  q422187_accepting :: "nat set"

definition q422187_well_formed :: "'a q422187_dfa \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q422187_well_formed M \<longleftrightarrow>
    q422187_start M < q422187_state_count M \<and>
    q422187_accepting M \<subseteq> {..<q422187_state_count M} \<and>
    (\<forall>q < q422187_state_count M. \<forall>a.
      q422187_step M q a < q422187_state_count M)"

definition q422187_eval :: "'a q422187_dfa \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q422187_eval M w =
    foldl (q422187_step M) (q422187_start M) w"

definition q422187_accepts :: "'a q422187_dfa \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "q422187_accepts M =
    {w. q422187_eval M w \<in> q422187_accepting M}"

definition q422187_regular :: "'a list set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q422187_regular L \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>M :: 'a q422187_dfa.
      q422187_well_formed M \<and> q422187_accepts M = L)"

definition q422187_left_quotient ::
    "'a list set \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "q422187_left_quotient L x = {y. x @ y \<in> L}"

theorem q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem:
  fixes L :: "'a list set"
  shows "q422187_regular L \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite (range (q422187_left_quotient L))"
  sorry

end

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q422187,
  "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language over an arbitrary, possibly empty,
  alphabet is regular if and only if its set of left quotients by words is
  finite. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q422187_run = new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
  `(q422187_run transition state [] = state) /\
   (q422187_run transition state (CONS symbol rest) =
      q422187_run transition (transition state symbol) rest)`;;

let q422187_left_quotient = new_definition
  `q422187_left_quotient alphabet language prefix =
     \suffix.
       ALL alphabet suffix /\
       language (APPEND prefix suffix)`;;

let q422187_is_regular = new_definition
  `q422187_is_regular (alphabet:A->bool) (language:A list->bool) <=>
     ?state_count start:num.
     ?transition:num->A->num.
     ?accepting:num->bool.
       start < state_count /\
       (!state symbol.
          state < state_count /\ alphabet symbol
          ==> transition state symbol < state_count) /\
       (!word:A list.
          ALL alphabet word
          ==> (language word <=>
               accepting (q422187_run transition start word)))`;;

let Q422187_MYHILL_NERODE_THEOREM =
  `!alphabet:A->bool. !language:A list->bool.
     q422187_is_regular alphabet language <=>
     FINITE
       (IMAGE (q422187_left_quotient alphabet language)
              {prefix:A list | ALL alphabet prefix})`;;

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q422187,
;; "Myhill–Nerode theorem": over an arbitrary alphabet, a language is
;; recognized by a finite deterministic automaton if and only if its set of
;; left quotients is finite. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame unary function objects represent the arbitrary alphabet carrier and
;; language predicate. Words are all finite true lists over that carrier; no
;; finite-alphabet restriction is imposed.

(defun q422187-alphabet-member-p (alphabet symbol)
  (if (apply$ alphabet (list symbol)) t nil))

(defun q422187-language-member-p (language word)
  (if (apply$ language (list word)) t nil))

(defun q422187-word-p (alphabet word)
  (if (consp word)
      (and
       (q422187-alphabet-member-p alphabet (car word))
       (q422187-word-p alphabet (cdr word)))
    (equal word nil)))

;; Two prefixes have the same left quotient exactly when every suffix belongs
;; to one quotient iff it belongs to the other.

(defun-sk q422187-left-quotient-equal-p
    (alphabet language left-prefix right-prefix)
  (forall (suffix)
    (implies
     (q422187-word-p alphabet suffix)
     (iff
      (q422187-language-member-p
       language (append left-prefix suffix))
      (q422187-language-member-p
       language (append right-prefix suffix))))))

(defun q422187-representative-list-p
    (alphabet representatives)
  (if (consp representatives)
      (and
       (q422187-word-p alphabet (car representatives))
       (q422187-representative-list-p
        alphabet (cdr representatives)))
    (equal representatives nil)))

(defun-sk q422187-word-has-representative-p
    (alphabet language representatives word)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (member-equal representative representatives)
     (q422187-left-quotient-equal-p
      alphabet language word representative))))

(defun-sk q422187-representatives-cover-p
    (alphabet language representatives)
  (forall (word)
    (implies
     (q422187-word-p alphabet word)
     (q422187-word-has-representative-p
      alphabet language representatives word))))

(defun-sk q422187-finite-left-quotient-range-p
    (alphabet language)
  (exists (representatives)
    (and
     (true-listp representatives)
     (no-duplicatesp-equal representatives)
     (q422187-representative-list-p
      alphabet representatives)
     (q422187-representatives-cover-p
      alphabet language representatives))))

;; A finite DFA is represented extensionally by a duplicate-free finite state
;; list, a start state, a finite accepting subset, and a tame binary transition
;; function object. The transition closure condition ranges over every symbol
;; in the arbitrary alphabet.

(defun q422187-transition-value
    (transition current-state symbol)
  (apply$ transition (list current-state symbol)))

(defun-sk q422187-transition-closed-p
    (alphabet states transition)
  (forall (current-state symbol)
    (implies
     (and
      (member-equal current-state states)
      (q422187-alphabet-member-p alphabet symbol))
     (member-equal
      (q422187-transition-value
       transition current-state symbol)
      states))))

(defun q422187-subset-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and
       (member-equal (car left) right)
       (q422187-subset-p (cdr left) right))
    (equal left nil)))

(defun q422187-run (transition current-state word)
  (if (consp word)
      (q422187-run
       transition
       (q422187-transition-value
        transition current-state (car word))
       (cdr word))
    current-state))

(defun-sk q422187-recognizer-correct-p
    (alphabet language transition start accepting)
  (forall (word)
    (implies
     (q422187-word-p alphabet word)
     (iff
      (member-equal
       (q422187-run transition start word)
       accepting)
      (q422187-language-member-p language word)))))

(defun q422187-finite-dfa-recognizes-p
    (alphabet language states start accepting transition)
  (and
   (true-listp states)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal states)
   (member-equal start states)
   (true-listp accepting)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal accepting)
   (q422187-subset-p accepting states)
   (tamep-functionp transition)
   (q422187-transition-closed-p
    alphabet states transition)
   (q422187-recognizer-correct-p
    alphabet language transition start accepting)))

(defun-sk q422187-regular-language-p (alphabet language)
  (exists (states start accepting transition)
    (q422187-finite-dfa-recognizes-p
     alphabet language states start accepting transition)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q422187-myhill-nerode-theorem-statement
    (alphabet language)
  (implies
   (and
    (tamep-functionp alphabet)
    (tamep-functionp language))
   (iff
    (q422187-regular-language-p alphabet language)
    (q422187-finite-left-quotient-range-p
     alphabet language))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q422187
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q422187), "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language is
-- regular if and only if its range of left quotients is finite. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc)
  renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 5 _++_
infix 4 _iff_

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (left : Set a)
  (right : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : left -> right
    backward : right -> left

record HProp (a : Level) : Set (lsuc a) where
  constructor proposition
  field
    Carrier : Set a
    carrier-is-proposition :
      (left right : Carrier) ->
      left ≡ right

open HProp using (Carrier)

_++_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  List A ->
  List A ->
  List A
[] ++ ys =
  ys
(x ∷ xs) ++ ys =
  x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

Language :
  {a : Level} ->
  (p : Level) ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a lmax lsuc p)
Language p Alphabet =
  List Alphabet -> HProp p

LanguageEquivalent :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {Alphabet : Set a} ->
  Language p Alphabet ->
  Language p Alphabet ->
  Set (a lmax p)
LanguageEquivalent {Alphabet = Alphabet} left right =
  (word : List Alphabet) ->
  (Carrier (left word)) iff (Carrier (right word))

leftQuotient :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {Alphabet : Set a} ->
  Language p Alphabet ->
  List Alphabet ->
  Language p Alphabet
leftQuotient language prefix suffix =
  language (prefix ++ suffix)

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  here :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  there :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    enumeration : List A
    covers :
      (x : A) ->
      Member x enumeration

record DFA
  {a s p : Level}
  (Alphabet : Set a)
  (State : Set s) :
  Set (a lmax s lmax lsuc p) where

  field
    step :
      State ->
      Alphabet ->
      State
    start :
      State
    accept :
      State ->
      HProp p

open DFA

evalFrom :
  {a s p : Level} ->
  {Alphabet : Set a} ->
  {State : Set s} ->
  DFA {p = p} Alphabet State ->
  State ->
  List Alphabet ->
  State
evalFrom automaton state [] =
  state
evalFrom automaton state (letter ∷ word) =
  evalFrom automaton (step automaton state letter) word

eval :
  {a s p : Level} ->
  {Alphabet : Set a} ->
  {State : Set s} ->
  DFA {p = p} Alphabet State ->
  List Alphabet ->
  State
eval automaton =
  evalFrom automaton (start automaton)

accepts :
  {a s p : Level} ->
  {Alphabet : Set a} ->
  {State : Set s} ->
  DFA {p = p} Alphabet State ->
  Language p Alphabet
accepts automaton word =
  accept automaton (eval automaton word)

record Regular
  {a p : Level}
  {Alphabet : Set a}
  (language : Language p Alphabet) :
  Set (a lmax lsuc p) where

  field
    State : Set
    finite-state : Finite State
    automaton : DFA {p = p} Alphabet State
    accepts-language :
      LanguageEquivalent
        (accepts automaton)
        language

record FiniteLeftQuotientRange
  {a p : Level}
  {Alphabet : Set a}
  (language : Language p Alphabet) :
  Set (a lmax lsuc p) where

  field
    QuotientIndex : Set
    finite-index : Finite QuotientIndex
    representative :
      QuotientIndex ->
      Language p Alphabet
    covers-quotients :
      (prefix : List Alphabet) ->
      Σ QuotientIndex
        (\ index ->
          LanguageEquivalent
            (leftQuotient language prefix)
            (representative index))
    representatives-are-quotients :
      (index : QuotientIndex) ->
      Σ (List Alphabet)
        (\ prefix ->
          LanguageEquivalent
            (representative index)
            (leftQuotient language prefix))

MyhillNerodeTheorem :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (a lmax p))
MyhillNerodeTheorem {a} {p} =
  (Alphabet : Set a) ->
  (language : Language p Alphabet) ->
  (Regular language) iff
  (FiniteLeftQuotientRange language)

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  thousand-theorems__hol4__Q422187, "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language of
  words over an arbitrary type is recognized by a finite-state deterministic
  automaton if and only if its set of left quotients is finite. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q422187_run_def = Define`
  (q422187_run step q [] = q) /\
  (q422187_run step q (a::w) = q422187_run step (step q a) w)
`;

val q422187_left_quotient_def = new_definition (
  "q422187_left_quotient_def",
  ``q422187_left_quotient (L : 'a list set) x =
      {y | APPEND x y IN L}``
);

val q422187_is_regular_def = new_definition (
  "q422187_is_regular_def",
  ``q422187_is_regular (L : 'a list set) <=>
      ?n start (step : num -> 'a -> num) (accept : num set).
        0 < n /\
        start < n /\
        (!q a. q < n ==> step q a < n) /\
        (!q. q IN accept ==> q < n) /\
        (!w. w IN L <=> q422187_run step start w IN accept)``
);

val q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem =
  ``!(L : 'a list set).
      q422187_is_regular L <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE (q422187_left_quotient L) UNIV)``;

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q422187
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q422187), "Myhill--Nerode theorem": for an
  arbitrary alphabet and language, the language is regular if and only if
  its set of left quotients by finite words is finite. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Word A is SetMM's set of all finite words over the arbitrary alphabet A,
  and L ranges over arbitrary subsets of Word A. Q422187LeftQuotient A L x
  is the language of suffixes y for which x ++ y belongs to L.
  Q422187LeftRange A L is exactly the range of this left-quotient operation.

  Q422187Accepts A Q D q F w says that the word w has a run through the
  deterministic transition function D, starting at q and ending in F.
  Q422187Regular A L internally quantifies the finite state set Q, total
  transition function D, start state q, and accepting-state set F. This is
  the finite-DFA definition of regularity used by the Lean source.

  All declarations preceding the final assertion are syntax or faithful
  definitions. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and this root statement file contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c Q422187LeftQuotient Q422187LeftRange $.
$c Q422187Accepts Q422187Regular $.

q422187-left-quotient-syntax
  $a class ( Q422187LeftQuotient A L x ) $.
q422187-left-range-syntax
  $a class ( Q422187LeftRange A L ) $.
q422187-accepts-syntax
  $a wff ( Q422187Accepts A Q D q F w ) $.
q422187-regular-syntax
  $a wff ( Q422187Regular A L ) $.

${
  $d A L x y $.

  q422187-left-quotient-definition $a |- (
    Q422187LeftQuotient A L x
  ) = {
    y e. Word A |
    ( x ++ y ) e. L
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A L S x $.

  q422187-left-range-definition $a |- (
    Q422187LeftRange A L
  ) = {
    S e. ( ~P ( Word A ) ) |
    E. x e. Word A
      S = ( Q422187LeftQuotient A L x )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d A D F Q i q r w $.

  q422187-accepts-definition $a |- (
    Q422187Accepts A Q D q F w
  ) <->
  E. r e. Word Q
    (
      ( # ` r ) = ( ( # ` w ) + 1 )
      /\
      (
        ( r ` 0 ) = q
        /\
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` w ) )
            (
              ( r ` ( i + 1 ) )
              =
              ( D ` <. ( r ` i ) , ( w ` i ) >. )
            )
          /\
          ( r ` ( # ` w ) ) e. F
        )
      )
    ) $.
$}

${
  $d A D F L Q q w $.

  q422187-regular-definition $a |- (
    Q422187Regular A L
  ) <->
  E. Q e. Fin
    E. D e. ( ( Q X. A ) --> Q )
      E. q e. Q
        E. F e. ( ~P Q )
          A. w e. Word A
            (
              w e. L
              <->
              ( Q422187Accepts A Q D q F w )
            ) $.
$}

${
  $d A L $.

  thousand-theorems-q422187-myhill-nerode $a |- (
    A. A
      A. L e. ( ~P ( Word A ) )
        (
          ( Q422187Regular A L )
          <->
          ( Q422187LeftRange A L ) e. Fin
        )
  ) $.
$}

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for A being set, L being Subset of A* holds
    ((ex Q being non empty finite set,
         q0 being Element of Q,
         F being Subset of Q,
         delta being Function of [:Q,A:],Q,

title: Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q422187,
% "Myhill–Nerode theorem": a language over an arbitrary alphabet is regular if
% and only if its family of left quotients is finite. This file contains no proof.

Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem[Alphabet: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  word: TYPE = list[Alphabet]
  language: TYPE = [word -> bool]

  concatenate(left, right: word): RECURSIVE word =
    CASES left OF
      null: right,
      cons(symbol, rest):
        cons(symbol, concatenate(rest, right))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE left BY <<

  left_quotient(L: language, prefix: word): language =
    LAMBDA (suffix: word):
      L(concatenate(prefix, suffix))

  run(
      number_of_states: posnat,
      transition:
        [below[number_of_states], Alphabet ->
          below[number_of_states]],
      state: below[number_of_states],
      input: word): RECURSIVE below[number_of_states] =
    CASES input OF
      null: state,
      cons(symbol, rest):
        run(
          number_of_states,
          transition,
          transition(state, symbol),
          rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE input BY <<

  is_regular(L: language): bool =
    EXISTS
      (number_of_states: posnat),
      (start_state: below[number_of_states]),
      (transition:
        [below[number_of_states], Alphabet ->
          below[number_of_states]]),
      (accepting: [below[number_of_states] -> bool]):
        FORALL (input: word):
          L(input) IFF
            accepting(
              run(
                number_of_states,
                transition,
                start_state,
                input))

  finite_range_left_quotient(L: language): bool =
    EXISTS
      (number_of_quotients: posnat),
      (representative:
        [below[number_of_quotients] -> language]):
        FORALL (prefix: word):
          EXISTS (index: below[number_of_quotients]):
            left_quotient(L, prefix) = representative(index)

  myhill_nerode_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (L: language):
      is_regular(L) IFF finite_range_left_quotient(L)
END Q422187_myhill_nerode_theorem

title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q4378868
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q4378868), "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem": the
-- Phragmén–Lindelöf principle bounds a complex-differentiable normed-space-valued
-- function throughout a closed horizontal strip from its boundary bound, under a
-- controlled double-exponential growth condition. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Taylor
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic

@[expose] public section

open Set Function Filter Asymptotics Metric Complex Bornology
open scoped Topology Filter Real

local notation "expR" => Real.exp

noncomputable local instance : NormedField ℂ where
  dist_eq _ _ := rfl
  norm_mul := Complex.norm_mul

noncomputable local instance : NontriviallyNormedField ℂ where
  non_trivial := ⟨2, Complex.norm_two.symm ▸ one_lt_two⟩

/-- A function differentiable on a set and continuous on its closure. -/
structure DiffContOnCl (𝕜 : Type*) {E F : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    (f : E → F) (s : Set E) : Prop where
  protected differentiableOn : DifferentiableOn 𝕜 f s
  protected continuousOn : ContinuousOn f (closure s)

namespace PhragmenLindelof

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
variable {a b C : ℝ} {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ}

/-- The Phragmén–Lindelöf principle for a function on a horizontal strip. -/
theorem horizontal_strip (hfd : DiffContOnCl ℂ f (im ⁻¹' Ioo a b))
    (hB : ∃ c < Real.pi / (b - a), ∃ B,
      f =O[comap (_root_.abs ∘ re) atTop ⊓ 𝓟 (im ⁻¹' Ioo a b)]
        fun w ↦ expR (B * expR (c * |w.re|)))
    (hle_a : ∀ w : ℂ, im w = a → ‖f w‖ ≤ C)
    (hle_b : ∀ w : ℂ, im w = b → ‖f w‖ ≤ C)
    (hza : a ≤ im z) (hzb : im z ≤ b) : ‖f z‖ ≤ C := sorry

end PhragmenLindelof

title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4378868
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q4378868), "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem": the
  Phragmén–Lindelöf principle bounds a complex-differentiable
  normed-space-valued function throughout a closed horizontal strip from its
  boundary bound, under a controlled double-exponential growth condition.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q4378868_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q4378868_czero : q4378868_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q4378868_cone : q4378868_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q4378868_cadd
    (z w : q4378868_complex) : q4378868_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q4378868_cneg
    (z : q4378868_complex) : q4378868_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q4378868_csub
    (z w : q4378868_complex) : q4378868_complex :=
  q4378868_cadd z (q4378868_cneg w).

Definition q4378868_cmul
    (z w : q4378868_complex) : q4378868_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q4378868_cmodulus
    (z : q4378868_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Definition q4378868_horizontal_strip
    (a b : R) (z : q4378868_complex) : Prop :=
  a < snd z /\ snd z < b.

Record q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q4378868_zero : E;
  q4378868_add : E -> E -> E;
  q4378868_neg : E -> E;
  q4378868_smul : q4378868_complex -> E -> E;
  q4378868_norm : E -> R;

  q4378868_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q4378868_add x (q4378868_add y z) =
      q4378868_add (q4378868_add x y) z;
  q4378868_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q4378868_add x y = q4378868_add y x;
  q4378868_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q4378868_add x q4378868_zero = x;
  q4378868_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q4378868_add x (q4378868_neg x) = q4378868_zero;

  q4378868_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q4378868_smul q4378868_cone x = x;
  q4378868_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q4378868_complex) (x : E),
      q4378868_smul (q4378868_cmul a b) x =
      q4378868_smul a (q4378868_smul b x);
  q4378868_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q4378868_complex) (x : E),
      q4378868_smul (q4378868_cadd a b) x =
      q4378868_add
        (q4378868_smul a x) (q4378868_smul b x);
  q4378868_smul_add :
    forall (a : q4378868_complex) (x y : E),
      q4378868_smul a (q4378868_add x y) =
      q4378868_add
        (q4378868_smul a x) (q4378868_smul a y);
  q4378868_zero_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q4378868_smul q4378868_czero x = q4378868_zero;
  q4378868_smul_zero :
    forall a : q4378868_complex,
      q4378868_smul a q4378868_zero = q4378868_zero;

  q4378868_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q4378868_norm x;
  q4378868_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q4378868_norm x = 0 <-> x = q4378868_zero;
  q4378868_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q4378868_norm (q4378868_add x y) <=
      q4378868_norm x + q4378868_norm y;
  q4378868_norm_smul :
    forall (a : q4378868_complex) (x : E),
      q4378868_norm (q4378868_smul a x) =
      q4378868_cmodulus a * q4378868_norm x
}.

Arguments q4378868_zero {E} _.
Arguments q4378868_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q4378868_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q4378868_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q4378868_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q4378868_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q4378868_add V x (q4378868_neg V y).

Record q4378868_complex_linear_map
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q4378868_linear_apply : q4378868_complex -> E;
  q4378868_linear_add :
    forall z w : q4378868_complex,
      q4378868_linear_apply (q4378868_cadd z w) =
      q4378868_add V
        (q4378868_linear_apply z) (q4378868_linear_apply w);
  q4378868_linear_smul :
    forall z w : q4378868_complex,
      q4378868_linear_apply (q4378868_cmul z w) =
      q4378868_smul V z (q4378868_linear_apply w);
  q4378868_linear_bounded :
    exists bound : R,
      0 <= bound /\
      forall z : q4378868_complex,
        q4378868_norm V (q4378868_linear_apply z) <=
        bound * q4378868_cmodulus z
}.

Arguments q4378868_linear_apply {E V} _ _.

Definition q4378868_closure
    (S : q4378868_complex -> Prop)
    (z : q4378868_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists w : q4378868_complex,
      S w /\
      q4378868_cmodulus (q4378868_csub w z) < epsilon.

Definition q4378868_continuous_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
    (S : q4378868_complex -> Prop)
    (z : q4378868_complex) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q4378868_complex,
        S w ->
        q4378868_cmodulus (q4378868_csub w z) < delta ->
        q4378868_norm V
          (q4378868_sub V (f w) (f z)) < epsilon.

Definition q4378868_continuous_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
    (S : q4378868_complex -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall z : q4378868_complex,
    S z -> q4378868_continuous_within_at V f S z.

Definition q4378868_has_frechet_deriv_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
    (S : q4378868_complex -> Prop)
    (z : q4378868_complex)
    (D : q4378868_complex_linear_map V) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall w : q4378868_complex,
        S w ->
        q4378868_cmodulus (q4378868_csub w z) < delta ->
        q4378868_norm V
          (q4378868_sub V
            (q4378868_sub V (f w) (f z))
            (q4378868_linear_apply D (q4378868_csub w z))) <=
        epsilon * q4378868_cmodulus (q4378868_csub w z).

Definition q4378868_differentiable_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
    (S : q4378868_complex -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall z : q4378868_complex,
    S z ->
    exists D : q4378868_complex_linear_map V,
      @q4378868_has_frechet_deriv_within_at E V f S z D.

Definition q4378868_diff_cont_on_closure
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
    (S : q4378868_complex -> Prop) : Prop :=
  q4378868_differentiable_on V f S /\
  q4378868_continuous_on V f (q4378868_closure S).

Definition q4378868_double_exponential_growth
    {E : Type}
    (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
    (a b : R) : Prop :=
  exists c : R,
    c < PI / (b - a) /\
    exists B A threshold : R,
      0 < A /\
      forall w : q4378868_complex,
        threshold <= Rabs (fst w) ->
        q4378868_horizontal_strip a b w ->
        q4378868_norm V (f w) <=
        A * exp (B * exp (c * Rabs (fst w))).

Module PhragmenLindelof.

Theorem horizontal_strip :
  forall (E : Type)
         (V : q4378868_normed_complex_vector_space E)
         (a b C : R)
         (f : q4378868_complex -> E)
         (z : q4378868_complex),
    q4378868_diff_cont_on_closure V f
      (q4378868_horizontal_strip a b) ->
    q4378868_double_exponential_growth V f a b ->
    (forall w : q4378868_complex,
      snd w = a -> q4378868_norm V (f w) <= C) ->
    (forall w : q4378868_complex,
      snd w = b -> q4378868_norm V (f w) <= C) ->
    a <= snd z ->
    snd z <= b ->
    q4378868_norm V (f z) <= C.
Admitted.

End PhragmenLindelof.

title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q4378868, "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem": a complex-differentiable,
  complex-normed-space-valued function with controlled double-exponential
  growth and bounded boundary norms is bounded throughout a closed horizontal
  strip. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complex_Transcendental"
begin

definition q4378868_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4378868_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q4378868_has_complex_derivative_within ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> complex set \<Rightarrow>
      complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4378868_has_complex_derivative_within cscale f d S z \<longleftrightarrow>
    ((\<lambda>w. cscale (inverse (w - z)) (f w - f z)) \<longlongrightarrow> d)
      (at z within S)"

definition q4378868_horizontal_strip ::
    "real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> complex set" where
  "q4378868_horizontal_strip a b = {z. a < Im z \<and> Im z < b}"

definition q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl cscale f a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>z \<in> q4378868_horizontal_strip a b.
      \<exists>d. q4378868_has_complex_derivative_within cscale f d
        (q4378868_horizontal_strip a b) z) \<and>
    continuous_on (closure (q4378868_horizontal_strip a b)) f"

definition q4378868_strip_growth ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow>
      real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4378868_strip_growth f a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>c B A R.
      c < pi / (b - a) \<and> 0 < A \<and>
      (\<forall>w. w \<in> q4378868_horizontal_strip a b \<and> R \<le> abs (Re w)
        \<longrightarrow>
        norm (f w) \<le> A * exp (B * exp (c * abs (Re w)))))"

theorem q4378868_phragmen_lindelof_horizontal_strip:
  fixes cscale :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and f :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and a b C :: real
    and z :: complex
  assumes complex_space: "q4378868_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and diff_cont: "q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl cscale f a b"
    and growth: "q4378868_strip_growth f a b"
    and lower_boundary: "\<forall>w. Im w = a \<longrightarrow> norm (f w) \<le> C"
    and upper_boundary: "\<forall>w. Im w = b \<longrightarrow> norm (f w) \<le> C"
    and above_lower: "a \<le> Im z"
    and below_upper: "Im z \<le> b"
  shows "norm (f z) \<le> C"
  sorry

end

title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4378868,
  "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem": a complex-differentiable function into an
  arbitrary complex normed space, with subcritical double-exponential growth
  on a horizontal strip and a common norm bound on both boundary lines, obeys
  that bound throughout the closed strip. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q4378868_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
let q4378868_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q4378868_output;;
let q4378868_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q4378868_formatter path);;
let q4378868_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q4378868_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q4378868_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q4378868_formatter ();;
close_out q4378868_output;;
if not q4378868_loaded then
  failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q4378868_PHRAGMEN_LINDELOF_THEOREM =
 `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cadd =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
  let cneg =
    \(z:real#real). (--(FST z),--(SND z)) in
  let csub =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      cadd z (cneg w) in
  let cmul =
    \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
      (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
       FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
  let cnorm =
    \(z:real#real).
      sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in
  let is_complex_normed_space =
    \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
     (smul:(real#real)->A->A) (normA:A->real).
      (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      normA zero = &0 /\
      (!x:A. smul cone x = x) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smul (cmul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smul (cadd a b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x y:A.
         smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x:A. smul czero x = zero) /\
      (!x:A. &0 <= normA x) /\
      (!x:A. normA x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A.
         normA (smul a x) = cnorm a * normA x) /\
      (!x y:A. normA (add x y) <= normA x + normA y) in
  let subA =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (x:A) (y:A).
      add x (neg y) in
  let horizontal_strip =
    \(a:real) (b:real) (z:real#real).
      a < SND z /\ SND z < b in
  let in_closure_of_horizontal_strip =
    \(a:real) (b:real) (x:real#real).
      !epsilon:real.
        &0 < epsilon
        ==> ?w:real#real.
              horizontal_strip a b w /\
              cnorm (csub w x) < epsilon in
  let continuous_on_strip_closure =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (normA:A->real)
     (f:(real#real)->A) (a:real) (b:real).
      !x:real#real.
        in_closure_of_horizontal_strip a b x
        ==> !epsilon:real.
              &0 < epsilon
              ==> ?delta:real.
                    &0 < delta /\
                    !y:real#real.
                      in_closure_of_horizontal_strip a b y /\
                      cnorm (csub y x) < delta
                      ==> normA (subA add neg (f y) (f x)) < epsilon in
  let complex_differentiable_within_strip_at =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:(real#real)->A->A)
     (normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A)
     (a:real) (b:real) (x:real#real).
      ?derivative:A.
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !y:real#real.
                  horizontal_strip a b y /\
                  cnorm (csub y x) < delta
                  ==> normA
                        (subA add neg
                          (subA add neg (f y) (f x))
                          (smul (csub y x) derivative))
                      <= epsilon * cnorm (csub y x) in
  let differentiable_on_horizontal_strip =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:(real#real)->A->A)
     (normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A)
     (a:real) (b:real).
      !x:real#real.
        horizontal_strip a b x
        ==> complex_differentiable_within_strip_at
              add neg smul normA f a b x in
  let diff_cont_on_cl =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:(real#real)->A->A)
     (normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A)
     (a:real) (b:real).
      differentiable_on_horizontal_strip
        add neg smul normA f a b /\
      continuous_on_strip_closure add neg normA f a b in
  let double_exponential_growth =
    \(normA:A->real) (f:(real#real)->A)
     (a:real) (b:real).
      ?c:real.
        c < pi / (b - a) /\
        ?B:real.
          ?Acoef:real.
            &0 < Acoef /\
            ?R:real.
              !w:real#real.
                R <= abs(FST w) /\
                horizontal_strip a b w
                ==> normA (f w)
                    <= Acoef * exp(B * exp(c * abs(FST w))) in
  !(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
   (smul:(real#real)->A->A) (normA:A->real)
   (a:real) (b:real) (C:real)
   (f:(real#real)->A) (z:real#real).
    is_complex_normed_space zero add neg smul normA /\
    diff_cont_on_cl add neg smul normA f a b /\
    double_exponential_growth normA f a b /\
    (!w:real#real. SND w = a ==> normA (f w) <= C) /\
    (!w:real#real. SND w = b ==> normA (f w) <= C) /\
    a <= SND z /\
    SND z <= b
    ==> normA (f z) <= C`;;

(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces present the real field, arbitrary subsets of it,
;; an arbitrary complex normed space, and the arbitrary source function.
;; Every field, norm, analytic, typing, and growth condition used below is an
;; explicit hypothesis of the final statement predicate.

       real value (q4378868-r-zero real))
      (q4378868-r-negate real value)

(defun q4378868-r-positive-p (real value)

   (q4378868-r-member-p real value)
   (q4378868-r-less
    real (q4378868-r-zero real) value)))

(defun-sk q4378868-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4378868-r-member-p real x)
      (q4378868-r-member-p real y)
      (q4378868-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q4378868-r-zero real))
            (one (q4378868-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q4378868-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q4378868-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q4378868-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q4378868-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q4378868-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q4378868-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q4378868-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q4378868-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q4378868-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q4378868-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q4378868-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q4378868-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q4378868-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q4378868-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q4378868-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q4378868-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q4378868-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q4378868-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q4378868-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q4378868-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q4378868-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q4378868-r-multiply real x yz-add)
         (q4378868-r-add
          real
          (q4378868-r-multiply real x y)
          (q4378868-r-multiply real x z))))))))

      (q4378868-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q4378868-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q4378868-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q4378868-r-less real x y)
         (q4378868-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q4378868-r-less real x y)
          (q4378868-r-less real y z))
         (q4378868-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q4378868-r-less real x y)
         (q4378868-r-less
          real
          (q4378868-r-add real x z)
          (q4378868-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q4378868-r-less real zero x)
          (q4378868-r-less real zero y))
         (q4378868-r-less
          real zero
          (q4378868-r-multiply real x y))))))))

     (let* ((zero (q4378868-e-zero space))

            (yz (q4378868-e-add space y z))

       (and
        (q4378868-e-member-p space xy)
        (q4378868-e-member-p space neg-x)
        (q4378868-e-member-p space a-x)
        (equal
         (q4378868-e-add space xy z)
         (q4378868-e-add space x yz))
        (equal xy (q4378868-e-add space y x))
        (equal (q4378868-e-add space x zero) x)
        (equal (q4378868-e-add space x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q4378868-e-smul
          space (q4378868-c-one real) x)

        (equal
         (q4378868-e-smul
          space
          (q4378868-c-multiply real a b)
          x)
         (q4378868-e-smul space a
          (q4378868-e-smul space b x)))
        (equal
         (q4378868-e-smul
          space (q4378868-c-add real a b) x)
         (q4378868-e-add
          space
          (q4378868-e-smul space a x)
          (q4378868-e-smul space b x)))
        (equal
         (q4378868-e-smul space a xy)
         (q4378868-e-add
          space
          (q4378868-e-smul space a x)
          (q4378868-e-smul space a y)))

(defun-sk q4378868-e-norm-laws-p

;; The source big-O filter is
;; comap (abs o re) atTop inf principal(open strip). Its eventual inequality
;; is a cutoff in |Re z| restricted to the open strip. The growth exponent,

(defun-sk q4378868-growth-bound-p
    (real space function exponential lower upper

    (implies

       real cutoff
       (q4378868-r-absolute-value
        real (car w))))
     (q4378868-r-leq
      real
      (q4378868-e-norm
       real space
       (q4378868-function-value function w))
      (q4378868-r-multiply
       real
       big-o-constant
       (q4378868-r-function-value
        real exponential
        (q4378868-r-multiply
         real
         growth-scale
         (q4378868-r-function-value
          real exponential
          (q4378868-r-multiply
           real
           growth-rate
           (q4378868-r-absolute-value
            real (car w)))))))))))

(defun-sk q4378868-subcritical-growth-p
    (real space function exponential pi-value lower upper)
  (exists
   (growth-rate growth-scale big-o-constant cutoff)
   (and

    (q4378868-r-member-p real growth-scale)
    (q4378868-r-positive-p real big-o-constant)
    (q4378868-r-member-p real cutoff)
    (q4378868-r-less
     real
     growth-rate
     (q4378868-r-divide
      real pi-value
      (q4378868-r-subtract real upper lower)))

     real space function exponential lower upper
     growth-rate growth-scale big-o-constant cutoff))))
