title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4378868,
-- "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem": a complex-differentiable function of controlled
-- double-exponential growth on a horizontal strip obeys its boundary norm
-- bound throughout the closed strip. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : {a : Level} -> Set a -> Set a
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {a : Level} -> {A : Set a} -> A -> A -> Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either {a b : Level} (A : Set a) (B : Set b) : Set (a ⊔ b) where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists {a p : Level} (A : Set a) (P : A -> Set p) : Set (a ⊔ p) where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <=N n
  suc<=suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) ==
      addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) ==
      multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

powerNatR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerNatR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerNatR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerNatR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

sumFirstR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirstR reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirstR reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (sumFirstR reals terms n)
    (terms n)

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x n =
  sumFirstR reals
    (\ k ->
      divideR reals
        (powerNatR reals x k)
        (fromNatR reals (factorial k)))
    n

RealSequenceLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
RealSequenceLimit {R = R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

ExponentialValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ExponentialValue reals exponent value =
  RealSequenceLimit reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals exponent)
    value

leibnizTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
leibnizTerm reals n =
  multiplyR reals
    (powerNatR reals (negateR reals (oneR reals)) n)
    (reciprocalR reals
      (fromNatR reals
        (suc ((suc (suc zero)) * n))))

record StandardRealAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    exponentialR :
      R -> R
    exponential-seriesR :
      (x : R) ->
      ExponentialValue reals x (exponentialR x)
    exponential-positiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals (exponentialR x)

    piR :
      R
    pi-positiveR :
      Positive reals piR
    pi-leibniz-seriesR :
      RealSequenceLimit reals
        (\ n -> sumFirstR reals (leibnizTerm reals) n)
        (multiplyR reals piR
          (reciprocalR reals
            (fromNatR reals
              (suc (suc (suc (suc zero)))))))

open StandardRealAnalysis

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

complexSubtract :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexSubtract reals z w =
  complexAdd reals z (complexNegate reals w)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

record ComplexNorm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    normC : Complex R -> R
    norm-nonnegativeC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normC z)
    norm-zeroC :
      normC (complexZero reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC z == zeroR reals ->
      z == complexZero reals
    norm-negateC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC (complexNegate reals z) == normC z
    norm-addC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normC (complexAdd reals z w))
        (addR reals (normC z) (normC w))
    norm-multiplyC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      normC (complexMultiply reals z w) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC w)
    norm-squareC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexNorm

record NormedComplexVectorSpace
  {e : Level}
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals)
  (E : Set e) : Set (lsuc e) where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : Complex R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexOne reals) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexMultiply reals a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexAdd reals a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC complexNorm a) (normE x)

open NormedComplexVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

InOpenHorizontalStrip :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
InOpenHorizontalStrip reals lower upper z =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower (imaginaryPart z))
    (StrictLess reals (imaginaryPart z) upper)

InClosureOfOpenHorizontalStrip :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  ComplexNorm reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
InClosureOfOpenHorizontalStrip {R = R}
  reals complexNorm lower upper point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists (Complex R)
    (\ z ->
      Both
        (InOpenHorizontalStrip reals lower upper z)
        (StrictLess reals
          (normC complexNorm (complexSubtract reals z point))
          epsilon))

ContinuousWithinStripClosureAt :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinStripClosureAt {R = R}
  reals complexNorm space function lower upper point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((z : Complex R) ->
          InClosureOfOpenHorizontalStrip
            reals complexNorm lower upper z ->
          StrictLess reals
            (normC complexNorm (complexSubtract reals z point))
            delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (normE space
              (subtractE space (function z) (function point)))
            epsilon))

ContinuousOnStripClosure :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousOnStripClosure {R = R}
  reals complexNorm space function lower upper =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  InClosureOfOpenHorizontalStrip
    reals complexNorm lower upper point ->
  ContinuousWithinStripClosureAt
    reals complexNorm space function lower upper point

ComplexDifferentiableAt :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  Complex R ->
  Set e
ComplexDifferentiableAt {R = R} {E = E}
  reals complexNorm space function point =
  Exists E
    (\ derivative ->
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Both
            (Positive reals delta)
            ((z : Complex R) ->
              StrictLess reals
                (normC complexNorm
                  (complexSubtract reals z point))
                delta ->
              lessOrEqualR reals
                (normE space
                  (subtractE space
                    (subtractE space
                      (function z)
                      (function point))
                    (scaleE space
                      (complexSubtract reals z point)
                      derivative)))
                (multiplyR reals epsilon
                  (normC complexNorm
                    (complexSubtract reals z point))))))

DifferentiableOnOpenHorizontalStrip :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set e
DifferentiableOnOpenHorizontalStrip {R = R}
  reals complexNorm space function lower upper =
  (point : Complex R) ->
  InOpenHorizontalStrip reals lower upper point ->
  ComplexDifferentiableAt reals complexNorm space function point

DiffContOnClosedHorizontalStrip :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set e
DiffContOnClosedHorizontalStrip reals complexNorm space
  function lower upper =
  Both
    (DifferentiableOnOpenHorizontalStrip
      reals complexNorm space function lower upper)
    (ContinuousOnStripClosure
      reals complexNorm space function lower upper)

doubleExponentialMajorant :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Complex R ->
  R
doubleExponentialMajorant reals analysis c B z =
  exponentialR analysis
    (multiplyR reals B
      (exponentialR analysis
        (multiplyR reals c
          (absoluteR reals (realPart z)))))

DoubleExponentialGrowthOnHorizontalStrip :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  StandardRealAnalysis reals ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DoubleExponentialGrowthOnHorizontalStrip {R = R}
  reals analysis complexNorm space function lower upper =
  Exists R
    (\ c ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals c
          (divideR reals
            (piR analysis)
            (subtractR reals upper lower)))
        (Exists R
          (\ B ->
            Exists R
              (\ A ->
                Both
                  (Positive reals A)
                  (Exists R
                    (\ threshold ->
                      (z : Complex R) ->
                      lessOrEqualR reals threshold
                        (absoluteR reals (realPart z)) ->
                      InOpenHorizontalStrip reals lower upper z ->
                      lessOrEqualR reals
                        (normE space (function z))
                        (multiplyR reals A
                          (doubleExponentialMajorant
                            reals analysis c B z))))))))

BoundaryNormBound :
  {e : Level} ->
  {R : Set} ->
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (Complex R -> E) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
BoundaryNormBound {R = R} reals space function line bound =
  (z : Complex R) ->
  imaginaryPart z == line ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (normE space (function z)) bound

phragmen-lindelof-horizontal-strip :
  {e : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc e)
phragmen-lindelof-horizontal-strip {e} =
  (R : Set) ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardRealAnalysis reals) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (space : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (function : Complex R -> E) ->
  (lower upper bound : R) ->
  (point : Complex R) ->
  DiffContOnClosedHorizontalStrip
    reals complexNorm space function lower upper ->
  DoubleExponentialGrowthOnHorizontalStrip
    reals analysis complexNorm space function lower upper ->
  BoundaryNormBound reals space function lower bound ->
  BoundaryNormBound reals space function upper bound ->
  lessOrEqualR reals lower (imaginaryPart point) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (imaginaryPart point) upper ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (normE space (function point)) bound

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4378868 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q4378868), "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem":
  an E-valued function differentiable on an open horizontal strip and
  continuous on its closure, with sufficiently slow double-exponential growth
  and boundary norm bounded by C, has norm at most C throughout the closed
  strip. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;

val q4378868_normed_complex_space_def = new_definition (
  "q4378868_normed_complex_space_def",
  ``q4378868_normed_complex_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = modu a * norm x)``);

val q4378868_in_horizontal_strip_def = new_definition (

      (a : real) (b : real) (z : complex) <=>

      (a : real) (b : real) (z : complex) <=>

val q4378868_continuous_on_strip_closure_def = new_definition (
  "q4378868_continuous_on_strip_closure_def",
  ``q4378868_continuous_on_strip_closure
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e)
      (a : real) (b : real) <=>
      !x.
        q4378868_in_horizontal_strip_closure a b x ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !y.
              q4378868_in_horizontal_strip_closure a b y /\
              modu (y - x) < delta
              ==>

val q4378868_complex_differentiable_on_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q4378868_complex_differentiable_on_strip_def",
  ``q4378868_complex_differentiable_on_strip
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (a : real) (b : real) <=>
      !x.
        q4378868_in_horizontal_strip a b x ==>
        ?deriv : 'e.
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !h : complex.
                0 < modu h /\ modu h < delta
                ==>
                norm
                  (add
                    (add (f (x + h)) (neg (f x)))
                    (neg (smul h deriv))) <
                epsilon * modu h``);

val q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl_def = new_definition (
  "q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl_def",
  ``q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (a : real) (b : real) <=>
      q4378868_complex_differentiable_on_strip
        add neg smul norm f a b /\
      q4378868_continuous_on_strip_closure
        add neg norm f a b``);

val q4378868_double_exp_big_o_on_strip_def = new_definition (
  "q4378868_double_exp_big_o_on_strip_def",
  ``q4378868_double_exp_big_o_on_strip
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : complex -> 'e)
      (a : real) (b : real) (c : real) (B : real) <=>
      ?A R : real.
        0 < A /\
        !w.
          R <= abs (RE w) /\
          q4378868_in_horizontal_strip a b w
          ==>
          norm (f w) <=
            A * exp (B * exp (c * abs (RE w)))``);

val PhragmenLindelof_horizontal_strip =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (a : real) (b : real) (C : real)
      (f : complex -> 'e) (z : complex).
      q4378868_normed_complex_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q4378868_diff_cont_on_cl add neg smul norm f a b /\
      (?c : real.
        c < pi / (b - a) /\
        ?B : real.
          q4378868_double_exp_big_o_on_strip norm f a b c B) /\
      (!w : complex. IM w = a ==> norm (f w) <= C) /\
      (!w : complex. IM w = b ==> norm (f w) <= C) /\
      a <= IM z /\
      IM z <= b
      ==>
      norm (f z) <= C``;

title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4378868
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q4378868), "Phragmen--Lindelof theorem": a
  complex-differentiable vector-valued function on a horizontal strip,
  continuous on its closure and satisfying the stated double-exponential
  growth and boundary bounds, obeys the same norm bound throughout the
  closed strip. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q4378868OpenStrip is the inverse image under the imaginary-part map of the
  open real interval with endpoints a and b. Q4378868ClosureStrip is its
  actual closure in the standard complex topology; this preserves the Lean
  DiffContOnCl condition even when the interval is empty or degenerate.

  Q4378868ContinuousOn is relative epsilon-delta continuity. Complex
  differentiability within a set is written in the equivalent
  one-dimensional Frechet form: D is the value of the complex-linear
  derivative, so its action on an increment h is h scalar-multiplied by D,
  and the difference quotient estimate ranges over points of that set.
  Q4378868DiffContOnCl combines differentiability within the open strip with
  continuity on its closure.

  Q4378868Growth expands the source filter Big-O condition. It asserts that
  for some c < pi / (b - a), B, nonnegative multiplier A, and real threshold
  R, the norm of F(w) is at most
  A * exp(B * exp(c * |Re(w)|)) whenever w lies in the open strip and
  |Re(w)| >= R. This is exactly eventual domination along the infimum of the
  pullback of atTop by |Re| and the principal filter of the open strip.

  The final unproved $a assertion quantifies over arbitrary SetMM complex
  normed vector spaces and functions on the full complex plane. All preceding
  $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions; there is no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c Q4378868Sub Q4378868OpenStrip Q4378868ClosureStrip
   Q4378868ContinuousOn Q4378868HasComplexDerivWithinAt
   Q4378868DifferentiableOn Q4378868DiffContOnCl Q4378868Growth $.

q4378868-sub-syntax $a class ( Q4378868Sub W x y ) $.
q4378868-open-strip-syntax $a class ( Q4378868OpenStrip a b ) $.
q4378868-closure-strip-syntax $a class ( Q4378868ClosureStrip a b ) $.
q4378868-continuous-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q4378868ContinuousOn W F S ) $.
q4378868-has-complex-deriv-within-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q4378868HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F S x D ) $.
q4378868-differentiable-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q4378868DifferentiableOn W F S ) $.
q4378868-diff-cont-on-cl-syntax
  $a wff ( Q4378868DiffContOnCl W F a b ) $.
q4378868-growth-syntax
  $a wff ( Q4378868Growth W F a b ) $.

${
  $d W x y $.

  q4378868-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q4378868Sub W x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` W )
    ( ( -g ` W ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a b w $.

  q4378868-open-strip-definition $a |- (
    Q4378868OpenStrip a b
  ) = {
    w e. CC |
      (
        a < ( Im ` w )
        /\
        ( Im ` w ) < b
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d a b $.

  q4378868-closure-strip-definition $a |- (
    Q4378868ClosureStrip a b
  ) = (
    ( cls ` ( TopOpen ` CCfld ) )
    `
    ( Q4378868OpenStrip a b )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S W d e x y $.

  q4378868-continuous-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q4378868ContinuousOn W F S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  ( Q4378868Sub W ( F ` y ) ( F ` x ) )
                )
                <
                e
              )
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D F S W d e x y $.

  q4378868-has-complex-deriv-within-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q4378868HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F S x D )
    <->
    (
      D e. ( Base ` W )
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` W )
                  `
                  (
                    Q4378868Sub
                    W
                    ( Q4378868Sub W ( F ` y ) ( F ` x ) )
                    ( ( y - x ) ( .s ` W ) D )
                  )
                )
                <_
                ( e x. ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) )
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D F S W x $.

  q4378868-differentiable-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q4378868DifferentiableOn W F S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      E. D e. ( Base ` W )
        ( Q4378868HasComplexDerivWithinAt W F S x D )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F W a b $.

  q4378868-diff-cont-on-cl-definition $a |- (
    ( Q4378868DiffContOnCl W F a b )
    <->
    (
      (
        Q4378868DifferentiableOn
        W F ( Q4378868OpenStrip a b )
      )
      /\
      (
        Q4378868ContinuousOn
        W F ( Q4378868ClosureStrip a b )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B F R W a b c w $.

  q4378868-growth-definition $a |- (
    ( Q4378868Growth W F a b )
    <->
    E. c e. RR
      (
        c < ( _pi / ( b - a ) )
        /\
        E. B e. RR
          E. A e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
            E. R e. RR
              A. w e. ( Q4378868OpenStrip a b )
                (
                  R <_ ( abs ` ( Re ` w ) )
                  ->
                  (
                    ( norm ` W )
                    `
                    ( F ` w )
                  )
                  <_
                  (
                    A
                    x.
                    (
                      exp
                      `
                      (
                        B
                        x.
                        (
                          exp
                          `
                          (
                            c
                            x.
                            ( abs ` ( Re ` w ) )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                  )
                )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C F W a b w z $.

  thousand-theorems-q4378868-phragmen-lindelof-horizontal-strip $a |-
    A. W e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = CCfld }
      A. F e. ( ( Base ` W ) ^m CC )
        A. a e. RR
          A. b e. RR
            A. C e. RR
              A. z e. CC
                (
                  (
                    ( Q4378868DiffContOnCl W F a b )
                    /\
                    ( Q4378868Growth W F a b )
                    /\
                    A. w e. CC
                      (
                        ( Im ` w ) = a
                        ->
                        (
                          ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( F ` w ) )
                          <_
                          C
                        )
                      )
                    /\
                    A. w e. CC
                      (
                        ( Im ` w ) = b
                        ->
                        (
                          ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( F ` w ) )
                          <_
                          C
                        )
                      )
                    /\
                    a <_ ( Im ` z )
                    /\
                    ( Im ` z ) <_ b
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    ( ( norm ` W ) ` ( F ` z ) )
                    <_
                    C
                  )
                )
  $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4378868

:: complex-differentiable normed-space-valued function with controlled
:: double-exponential growth and bounded horizontal boundary values is bounded

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2,

 equalities XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0,
      NORMSP_0;
