      NORMSP_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for E being ComplexNormSpace,
      f being Function of COMPLEX,the carrier of E,
      a,b,C being Real,
      z being Element of COMPLEX st
    (for w being Element of COMPLEX st
        a < b & a <= Im w & Im w <= b
      holds
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for v being Element of COMPLEX st
              a <= Im v & Im v <= b & |.v-w.| < delta
            holds
              ||.f.v-f.w.|| < epsilon) &
    (for w being Element of COMPLEX st a < Im w & Im w < b holds
      ex d being Point of E st
        for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
          ex delta being Real st
            0 < delta &
            for v being Element of COMPLEX st
              0 < |.v-w.| & |.v-w.| < delta
            holds
              ||.f.v-f.w-(v-w)*d.|| < epsilon * |.v-w.|) &
    (ex c,B,A,R being Real st
      c < PI / (b-a) &
      0 < A &
      for w being Element of COMPLEX st
        R <= |.Re w.| & a < Im w & Im w < b
      holds
        ex s,t being Real st
          s = exp_R.(c * |.Re w.|) &
          t = exp_R.(B * s) &
          ||.f.w.|| <= A * t) &
    (for w being Element of COMPLEX st Im w = a holds
      ||.f.w.|| <= C) &
    (for w being Element of COMPLEX st Im w = b holds
      ||.f.w.|| <= C) &
    a <= Im z & Im z <= b
  holds
    ||.f.z.|| <= C
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q4378868_phragm_n_lindel_f_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4378868
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q4378868), "Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem": a
% complex-differentiable function with sufficiently slow double-exponential
% growth on a horizontal strip satisfies its boundary norm bound throughout
% the closed strip. This file contains no proof.

Q4378868_phragmen_lindelof_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  cscaleE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  expR: [real -> real],
  pi_value: real
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> E]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_real_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(x) * real_part(y)
           - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
           + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_squared_norm(z: complex): real =
    real_part(z) ^ 2 + imag_part(z) ^ 2

  complex_squared_distance(x, y: complex): real =
    complex_squared_norm(complex_sub(x, y))

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  complex_normed_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        cscaleE(
          real_part(a), imag_part(a), addE(x, y))
          =
        addE(
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x),
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        cscaleE(
          real_part(complex_add(a, b)),
          imag_part(complex_add(a, b)),
          x)
          =
        addE(
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x),
          cscaleE(real_part(b), imag_part(b), x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        cscaleE(
          real_part(complex_mul(a, b)),
          imag_part(complex_mul(a, b)),
          x)
          =
        cscaleE(
          real_part(a),
          imag_part(a),
          cscaleE(real_part(b), imag_part(b), x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        cscaleE(1, 0, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(
          cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x)) ^ 2
          =
        complex_squared_norm(a) * normE(x) ^ 2)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + x ^ index / (nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + alternating_sign(index) / ((2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_characterization: bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (count: nat): exponential_partial(x, count),
        expR(x))

  pi_characterization: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (count: nat): 4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
      pi_value)

  standard_real_analysis: bool =
    exponential_characterization AND pi_characterization

  in_open_horizontal_strip(
      z: complex,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower < imag_part(z) AND imag_part(z) < upper

  in_closed_horizontal_strip(
      z: complex,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    lower < upper
      AND lower <= imag_part(z)
      AND imag_part(z) <= upper

  continuous_on_strip_closure(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      in_closed_horizontal_strip(x, lower, upper)
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
            EXISTS (delta: posreal):
              FORALL (y: complex):
                (in_closed_horizontal_strip(y, lower, upper)
                  AND complex_squared_distance(y, x) < delta ^ 2)
                IMPLIES
                  normE(subE(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value

  derivative_error(
      f: complex_function,
      derivative: E,
      x, y: complex): E =
    subE(
      subE(f(y), f(x)),
      cscaleE(
        real_part(complex_sub(y, x)),
        imag_part(complex_sub(y, x)),
        derivative))

  has_complex_derivative_within_open_strip_at(
      f: complex_function,
      derivative: E,
      lower, upper: real,
      x: complex): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: complex):
          (NOT (y = x)
            AND in_open_horizontal_strip(y, lower, upper)
            AND complex_squared_distance(y, x) < delta ^ 2)
          IMPLIES
            normE(derivative_error(f, derivative, x, y)) ^ 2
              <= epsilon_value ^ 2
                * complex_squared_distance(y, x)

  differentiable_on_open_horizontal_strip(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex):
      in_open_horizontal_strip(x, lower, upper)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (derivative: E):
            has_complex_derivative_within_open_strip_at(
              f, derivative, lower, upper, x)

  diff_cont_on_closure(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    differentiable_on_open_horizontal_strip(f, lower, upper)
      AND continuous_on_strip_closure(f, lower, upper)

  has_horizontal_strip_growth(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, upper: real): bool =
    EXISTS (c: real):
      c < safe_real_div(pi_value, upper - lower)
        AND EXISTS (B: real):
          EXISTS
              (multiplier: posreal),
              (threshold: real):
            FORALL (w: complex):
              (threshold <= abs(real_part(w))
                AND in_open_horizontal_strip(w, lower, upper))
              IMPLIES
                normE(f(w))
                  <= multiplier
                    * expR(
                        B * expR(
                          c * abs(real_part(w))))

  bounded_on_lower_boundary(
      f: complex_function,
      lower, bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (w: complex):
      imag_part(w) = lower IMPLIES normE(f(w)) <= bound

  bounded_on_upper_boundary(
      f: complex_function,
      upper, bound: real): bool =
    FORALL (w: complex):
      imag_part(w) = upper IMPLIES normE(f(w)) <= bound

  phragmen_lindelof_horizontal_strip: bool =
    (standard_real_analysis AND complex_normed_vector_space)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
            (lower, upper, bound: real),
            (f: complex_function),
            (z: complex):
          (diff_cont_on_closure(f, lower, upper)
            AND has_horizontal_strip_growth(f, lower, upper)
            AND bounded_on_lower_boundary(f, lower, bound)
            AND bounded_on_upper_boundary(f, upper, bound)
            AND lower <= imag_part(z)
            AND imag_part(z) <= upper)
          IMPLIES normE(f(z)) <= bound
END Q4378868_phragmen_lindelof_theorem

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q459547
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q459547), "Ptolemy's theorem": four cospherical
-- points whose diagonals meet at a point with straight angles satisfy the
-- classical equality relating the products of side and diagonal lengths.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.AddTorsor
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Defs

@[expose] public section

open scoped RealInnerProductSpace Real

namespace Q459547

variable {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
variable {P : Type*} [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P]

/-- The defining common-center-and-radius condition for a cospherical set. -/
def Cospherical (ps : Set P) : Prop :=
  ∃ (center : P) (radius : ℝ), ∀ q ∈ ps, dist q center = radius

/--
The exact antiparallel-vector characterization of the affine angle
`∠ p₁ p₂ p₃ = π`.
-/
def AngleEqPi (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) : Prop :=
  (p₁ -ᵥ p₂ : V) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ r : ℝ, r < 0 ∧ (p₃ -ᵥ p₂ : V) = r • (p₁ -ᵥ p₂ : V)

/-- Ptolemy's theorem for four cospherical points with intersecting diagonals. -/
theorem ptolemy_s_theorem {a b c d p : P}
    (h : Cospherical ({a, b, c, d} : Set P))
    (hapc : AngleEqPi (V := V) a p c) (hbpd : AngleEqPi (V := V) b p d) :
    dist a b * dist c d + dist b c * dist d a = dist a c * dist b d := sorry

end Q459547

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q459547
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q459547), "Ptolemy's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, four cospherical points whose diagonals
  pass through a common point satisfy Ptolemy's distance identity. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q459547_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q459547_zero : V;
  q459547_add : V -> V -> V;
  q459547_neg : V -> V;
  q459547_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q459547_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q459547_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q459547_add x (q459547_add y z) =
      q459547_add (q459547_add x y) z;
  q459547_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q459547_add x y = q459547_add y x;
  q459547_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q459547_add x q459547_zero = x;
  q459547_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q459547_add x (q459547_neg x) = q459547_zero;

  q459547_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q459547_smul 1 x = x;
  q459547_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q459547_smul (a * b) x =
      q459547_smul a (q459547_smul b x);
  q459547_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q459547_smul a (q459547_add x y) =
      q459547_add (q459547_smul a x) (q459547_smul a y);
  q459547_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q459547_smul (a + b) x =
      q459547_add (q459547_smul a x) (q459547_smul b x);

  q459547_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q459547_inner (q459547_add x y) z =
      q459547_inner x z + q459547_inner y z;
  q459547_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q459547_inner (q459547_smul a x) y =
      a * q459547_inner x y;
  q459547_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q459547_inner x y = q459547_inner y x;
  q459547_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q459547_inner x x;
  q459547_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q459547_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q459547_zero
}.

Arguments q459547_zero {V} _.
Arguments q459547_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q459547_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q459547_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q459547_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q459547_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q459547_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q459547_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q459547_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q459547_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q459547_vadd (q459547_zero E) p = p;
  q459547_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q459547_vadd (q459547_add E x y) p =
      q459547_vadd x (q459547_vadd y p);
  q459547_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q459547_vsub (q459547_vadd x p) p = x;
  q459547_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q459547_vadd (q459547_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q459547_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q459547_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q459547_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q459547_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q459547_inner E x x).

Definition q459547_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q459547_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q459547_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q459547_norm E (q459547_vsub A p q).

Definition q459547_cospherical_four
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q459547_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q459547_affine_torsor V P E)
    (a b c d : P) : Prop :=
  exists (center : P) (radius : R),
    q459547_dist A a center = radius /\
    q459547_dist A b center = radius /\
    q459547_dist A c center = radius /\
    q459547_dist A d center = radius.

Definition q459547_angle
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q459547_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q459547_affine_torsor V P E)
    (a p c : P) : R :=
  let x := q459547_vsub A a p in
  let y := q459547_vsub A c p in
  acos
    (q459547_inner E x y /
      (q459547_norm E x * q459547_norm E y)).

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_mul_dist_add_mul_dist_eq_mul_dist_of_cospherical :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q459547_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q459547_affine_torsor V P E)
         (a b c d p : P),
    q459547_cospherical_four A a b c d ->
    q459547_angle A a p c = PI ->
    q459547_angle A b p d = PI ->
    q459547_dist A a b * q459547_dist A c d +
      q459547_dist A b c * q459547_dist A d a =
    q459547_dist A a c * q459547_dist A b d.
Admitted.

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q459547,
  "Ptolemy's theorem": four cospherical points in a real inner-product affine
  space satisfy Ptolemy's distance identity when a point forms straight angles
  across both diagonals. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

class q459547_real_inner = real_normed_vector +
  fixes q459547_inner :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes q459547_inner_commute:
      "q459547_inner x y = q459547_inner y x"
    and q459547_inner_add_left:
      "q459547_inner (x + y) z =
        q459547_inner x z + q459547_inner y z"
    and q459547_inner_scaleR_left:
      "q459547_inner (scaleR r x) y = r * q459547_inner x y"
    and q459547_inner_ge_zero:
      "0 \<le> q459547_inner x x"
    and q459547_inner_eq_zero_iff:
      "q459547_inner x x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0"
    and q459547_norm_eq_sqrt_inner:
      "norm x = sqrt (q459547_inner x x)"

locale q459547_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q459547_vadd :: "'v::q459547_real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q459547_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q459547_zero_vadd:
      "q459547_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q459547_add_vadd:
      "q459547_vadd (u + v) p =
        q459547_vadd u (q459547_vadd v p)"
    and q459547_vadd_vsub:
      "q459547_vadd (q459547_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q459547_vsub_vadd:
      "q459547_vsub (q459547_vadd v p) p = v"
begin

definition q459547_dist :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q459547_dist p q = norm (q459547_vsub p q)"

definition q459547_angle :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q459547_angle a p c =
    arccos (q459547_inner (q459547_vsub a p) (q459547_vsub c p) /
      (norm (q459547_vsub a p) * norm (q459547_vsub c p)))"

definition q459547_cospherical :: "'p set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q459547_cospherical S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>center radius.
      \<forall>x \<in> S. q459547_dist x center = radius)"

theorem ptolemy_s_theorem:
  fixes a b c d p :: 'p
  assumes cospherical:
      "q459547_cospherical {a, b, c, d}"
    and diagonal_ac:
      "q459547_angle a p c = pi"
    and diagonal_bd:
      "q459547_angle b p d = pi"
  shows
      "q459547_dist a b * q459547_dist c d +
        q459547_dist b c * q459547_dist d a =
        q459547_dist a c * q459547_dist b d"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q459547,
  "Ptolemy's theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, four
  cospherical points whose diagonals pass straight through a common point
  satisfy Ptolemy's distance identity. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q459547_PTOLEMY_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!q:P. vadd zero q = q) /\
       (!v w:V. !q:P.
          vadd (add v w) q = vadd v (vadd w q)) /\
       (!v:V. !q:P. vsub (vadd v q) q = v) /\
       (!q r:P. vadd (vsub q r) r = q) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (q:P) (r:P).
       norm inner (vsub q r) in
  let straight_angle =
    \(zero:V) (inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (q1:P) (q2:P) (q3:P).
       ~(vsub q1 q2 = zero) /\
       ~(vsub q3 q2 = zero) /\
       inner (vsub q1 q2) (vsub q3 q2) =
         --(norm inner (vsub q1 q2) * norm inner (vsub q3 q2)) in
  let cospherical_four =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (a:P) (b:P) (c:P) (d:P).
       ?center:P. ?radius:real.
         distance inner vsub a center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub b center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub c center = radius /\
         distance inner vsub d center = radius in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !a b c d p:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    cospherical_four inner vsub a b c d /\
    straight_angle zero inner vsub a p c /\
    straight_angle zero inner vsub b p d
    ==>
    distance inner vsub a b * distance inner vsub c d +
    distance inner vsub b c * distance inner vsub d a =
    distance inner vsub a c * distance inner vsub b d`;;

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q459547,
;; "Ptolemy's theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, four
;; cospherical points whose diagonals form straight angles at a common point
;; satisfy Ptolemy's side-and-diagonal distance identity.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols present the source's real scalar field,
;; arbitrary real inner-product space, and arbitrary affine torsor. Every
;; carrier restriction and structural law is explicit in the statement.

(defstub q459547-r-member-p (real x) t)
(defstub q459547-r-set-member-p (real set x) t)
(defstub q459547-v-member-p (vector-space x) t)
(defstub q459547-p-member-p (point-space x) t)

(defstub q459547-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q459547-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q459547-r-add (real x y) t)
(defstub q459547-r-mul (real x y) t)
(defstub q459547-r-neg (real x) t)
(defstub q459547-r-inv (real x) t)
(defstub q459547-r-less (real x y) t)

(defstub q459547-v-zero (real vector-space) t)
(defstub q459547-v-add (real vector-space x y) t)
(defstub q459547-v-neg (real vector-space x) t)
(defstub q459547-v-smul (real vector-space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q459547-inner (real vector-space x y) t)

(defstub q459547-vadd
  (real vector-space point-space vector point)
  t)
(defstub q459547-vsub
  (real vector-space point-space left-point right-point)
  t)

(defun q459547-r-leq (real x y)
  (not (q459547-r-less real y x)))

(defun q459547-r-sub (real x y)
  (q459547-r-add real x (q459547-r-neg real y)))

(defun q459547-r-two (real)
  (q459547-r-add
   real (q459547-r-one real) (q459547-r-one real)))

(defun q459547-r-four (real)
  (q459547-r-mul
   real (q459547-r-two real) (q459547-r-two real)))

(defun-sk q459547-real-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-r-member-p real x)
      (q459547-r-member-p real y)
      (q459547-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q459547-r-zero real))
           (one (q459547-r-one real)))
       (and
        (q459547-r-member-p real (q459547-r-add real x y))
        (q459547-r-member-p real (q459547-r-mul real x y))
        (q459547-r-member-p real (q459547-r-neg real x))
        (q459547-r-member-p real (q459547-r-inv real x))

        (equal
         (q459547-r-add real (q459547-r-add real x y) z)
         (q459547-r-add real x (q459547-r-add real y z)))
        (equal (q459547-r-add real x y)
               (q459547-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q459547-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q459547-r-add real x (q459547-r-neg real x))
         zero)

        (equal
         (q459547-r-mul real (q459547-r-mul real x y) z)
         (q459547-r-mul real x (q459547-r-mul real y z)))
        (equal (q459547-r-mul real x y)
               (q459547-r-mul real y x))
        (equal (q459547-r-mul real x one) x)
        (equal (q459547-r-mul real x zero) zero)
        (equal
         (q459547-r-mul real x (q459547-r-add real y z))
         (q459547-r-add
          real
          (q459547-r-mul real x y)
          (q459547-r-mul real x z)))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q459547-r-mul real x (q459547-r-inv real x))
          one))

        (not (q459547-r-less real x x))
        (or (equal x y)
            (q459547-r-less real x y)
            (q459547-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q459547-r-less real x y)
          (q459547-r-less real y z))
         (q459547-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q459547-r-less real x y)
         (q459547-r-less
          real
          (q459547-r-add real x z)
          (q459547-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q459547-r-less real zero x)
          (q459547-r-less real zero y))
         (q459547-r-less
          real zero (q459547-r-mul real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q459547-r-set-valid-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q459547-r-set-member-p real set x)
     (q459547-r-member-p real x))))

(defun-sk q459547-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q459547-r-member-p real x)
     (q459547-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q459547-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-r-member-p real x)
      (q459547-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q459547-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q459547-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q459547-r-member-p real bound)
     (q459547-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q459547-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q459547-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q459547-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q459547-r-member-p real bound)
       (q459547-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q459547-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q459547-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q459547-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q459547-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-r-set-valid-p real set)
      (q459547-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q459547-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q459547-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q459547-real-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q459547-r-zero real))
        (one (q459547-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q459547-r-member-p real zero)
     (q459547-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q459547-r-less real zero one)
     (q459547-real-field-laws-p real)
     (q459547-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

(defun-sk q459547-vector-space-laws-p (real vector-space)
  (forall (a b u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-r-member-p real a)
      (q459547-r-member-p real b)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space u)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space v)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space w))
     (let ((zero-v (q459547-v-zero real vector-space))
           (one-r (q459547-r-one real)))
       (and
        (q459547-v-member-p
         vector-space (q459547-v-add real vector-space u v))
        (q459547-v-member-p
         vector-space (q459547-v-neg real vector-space u))
        (q459547-v-member-p
         vector-space (q459547-v-smul real vector-space a u))

        (equal
         (q459547-v-add
          real vector-space
          (q459547-v-add real vector-space u v)
          w)
         (q459547-v-add
          real vector-space
          u
          (q459547-v-add real vector-space v w)))
        (equal
         (q459547-v-add real vector-space u v)
         (q459547-v-add real vector-space v u))
        (equal
         (q459547-v-add real vector-space u zero-v)
         u)
        (equal
         (q459547-v-add
          real vector-space u
          (q459547-v-neg real vector-space u))
         zero-v)

        (equal
         (q459547-v-smul real vector-space one-r u)
         u)
        (equal
         (q459547-v-smul
          real vector-space
          (q459547-r-mul real a b)
          u)
         (q459547-v-smul
          real vector-space
          a
          (q459547-v-smul real vector-space b u)))
        (equal
         (q459547-v-smul
          real vector-space
          (q459547-r-add real a b)
          u)
         (q459547-v-add
          real vector-space
          (q459547-v-smul real vector-space a u)
          (q459547-v-smul real vector-space b u)))
        (equal
         (q459547-v-smul
          real vector-space
          a
          (q459547-v-add real vector-space u v))
         (q459547-v-add
          real vector-space
          (q459547-v-smul real vector-space a u)
          (q459547-v-smul real vector-space a v))))))))

(defun-sk q459547-inner-product-laws-p (real vector-space)
  (forall (a u v w)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-r-member-p real a)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space u)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space v)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space w))
     (let ((zero-r (q459547-r-zero real))
           (zero-v (q459547-v-zero real vector-space)))
       (and
        (q459547-r-member-p
         real (q459547-inner real vector-space u v))
        (equal
         (q459547-inner
          real vector-space
          (q459547-v-add real vector-space u v)
          w)
         (q459547-r-add
          real
          (q459547-inner real vector-space u w)
          (q459547-inner real vector-space v w)))
        (equal
         (q459547-inner
          real vector-space
          (q459547-v-smul real vector-space a u)
          v)
         (q459547-r-mul
          real a (q459547-inner real vector-space u v)))
        (equal
         (q459547-inner real vector-space u v)
         (q459547-inner real vector-space v u))
        (q459547-r-leq
         real zero-r (q459547-inner real vector-space u u))
        (iff
         (equal
          (q459547-inner real vector-space u u)
          zero-r)
         (equal u zero-v)))))))

(defun-sk q459547-affine-torsor-laws-p
    (real vector-space point-space)
  (forall (p q r u v)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space p)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space q)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space r)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space u)
      (q459547-v-member-p vector-space v))
     (let ((zero-v (q459547-v-zero real vector-space)))
       (and
        (q459547-p-member-p
         point-space
         (q459547-vadd
          real vector-space point-space u p))
        (q459547-v-member-p
         vector-space
         (q459547-vsub
          real vector-space point-space p q))
        (equal
         (q459547-vadd
          real vector-space point-space zero-v p)
         p)
        (equal
         (q459547-vadd
          real vector-space point-space
          (q459547-v-add real vector-space u v)
          p)
         (q459547-vadd
          real vector-space point-space
          u
          (q459547-vadd
           real vector-space point-space v p)))
        (equal
         (q459547-vadd
          real vector-space point-space
          (q459547-vsub
           real vector-space point-space p q)
          q)
         p)
        (equal
         (q459547-vsub
          real vector-space point-space
          (q459547-vadd
           real vector-space point-space u p)
          p)
         u)
        (equal
         (q459547-vsub
          real vector-space point-space p r)
         (q459547-v-add
          real vector-space
          (q459547-vsub
           real vector-space point-space p q)
          (q459547-vsub
           real vector-space point-space q r))))))))

(defun q459547-context-p (real vector-space point-space)
  (and
   (q459547-real-p real)
   (q459547-v-member-p
    vector-space (q459547-v-zero real vector-space))
   (q459547-vector-space-laws-p real vector-space)
   (q459547-inner-product-laws-p real vector-space)
   (q459547-affine-torsor-laws-p
    real vector-space point-space)))

(defun q459547-distance-squared
    (real vector-space point-space p q)
  (let ((difference
         (q459547-vsub
          real vector-space point-space p q)))
    (q459547-inner
     real vector-space difference difference)))

;; Equal squared distances from an internally quantified center are equivalent
;; to membership of all four points in one metric sphere.
(defun q459547-cospherical-witness-p
    (real vector-space point-space center a b c d)
  (let ((sa
         (q459547-distance-squared
          real vector-space point-space a center)))
    (and
     (q459547-p-member-p point-space center)
     (equal
      sa
      (q459547-distance-squared
       real vector-space point-space b center))
     (equal
      sa
      (q459547-distance-squared
       real vector-space point-space c center))
     (equal
      sa
      (q459547-distance-squared
       real vector-space point-space d center)))))

(defun-sk q459547-cospherical-four-p
    (real vector-space point-space a b c d)
  (exists (center)
    (q459547-cospherical-witness-p
     real vector-space point-space center a b c d)))

;; For two displacement vectors in a real inner-product space, angle pi is
;; equivalent to a negative inner product attaining equality in Cauchy-Schwarz.
(defun q459547-straight-angle-p
    (real vector-space point-space first middle third)
  (let* ((left
          (q459547-vsub
           real vector-space point-space first middle))
         (right
          (q459547-vsub
           real vector-space point-space third middle))
         (dot (q459547-inner real vector-space left right))
         (left-square
          (q459547-inner real vector-space left left))
         (right-square
          (q459547-inner real vector-space right right)))
    (and
     (q459547-r-less real dot (q459547-r-zero real))
     (equal
      (q459547-r-mul real dot dot)
      (q459547-r-mul real left-square right-square)))))

;; If X is the product of the squared diagonal lengths and Y,Z are the
;; corresponding products for opposite sides, the source distance equality
;; sqrt(Y)+sqrt(Z)=sqrt(X) is equivalent to
;; X-Y-Z >= 0 and (X-Y-Z)^2 = 4*Y*Z.
(defun q459547-ptolemy-conclusion-p
    (real vector-space point-space a b c d)
  (let* ((s-ab
          (q459547-distance-squared
           real vector-space point-space a b))
         (s-bc
          (q459547-distance-squared
           real vector-space point-space b c))
         (s-cd
          (q459547-distance-squared
           real vector-space point-space c d))
         (s-da
          (q459547-distance-squared
           real vector-space point-space d a))
         (s-ac
          (q459547-distance-squared
           real vector-space point-space a c))
         (s-bd
          (q459547-distance-squared
           real vector-space point-space b d))
         (x (q459547-r-mul real s-ac s-bd))
         (y (q459547-r-mul real s-ab s-cd))
         (z (q459547-r-mul real s-bc s-da))
         (difference
          (q459547-r-sub
           real (q459547-r-sub real x y) z)))
    (and
     (q459547-r-leq
      real (q459547-r-zero real) difference)
     (equal
      (q459547-r-mul real difference difference)
      (q459547-r-mul
       real
       (q459547-r-four real)
       (q459547-r-mul real y z))))))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q459547-ptolemys-theorem-statement
    (real vector-space point-space)
  (forall (a b c d p)
    (implies
     (and
      (q459547-context-p real vector-space point-space)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space a)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space b)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space c)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space d)
      (q459547-p-member-p point-space p)
      (q459547-cospherical-four-p
       real vector-space point-space a b c d)
      (q459547-straight-angle-p
       real vector-space point-space a p c)
      (q459547-straight-angle-p
       real vector-space point-space b p d))
     (q459547-ptolemy-conclusion-p
      real vector-space point-space a b c d))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q459547,
-- "Ptolemy's theorem": four cospherical points with both opposite pairs
-- forming straight angles at a common point satisfy Ptolemy's distance
-- identity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) and (oneR != zeroR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictPositive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictPositive reals x =
  (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x) and (x != zeroR reals)

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm v)
    norm-square :
      (v : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm v) (norm v) == inner v v
    norm-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      norm v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV
    norm-negate :
      (v : V) ->
      norm (negateV v) == norm v

    piR : R
    vectorAngle : V -> V -> R

    angle-equals-pi-characterization :
      (u v : V) ->
      Iff
        (vectorAngle u v == piR)
        ((u != zeroV)
        and
        Exists R
          (\ t ->
            StrictPositive reals t
            and
            (u ==
              scaleV (negateR reals t) v)))

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine p q =
  norm space (vsub affine p q)

angleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
angleAt {space = space} affine a p c =
  vectorAngle space
    (vsub affine a p)
    (vsub affine c p)

StraightAngleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
StraightAngleAt reals space affine a p c =
  angleAt affine a p c == piR space

CosphericalFour :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
CosphericalFour {R} {P = P} reals space affine a b c d =
  Exists P
    (\ center ->
      Exists R
        (\ radius ->
          (distance affine a center == radius)
          and
          ((distance affine b center == radius)
          and
          ((distance affine c center == radius)
          and
          (distance affine d center == radius)))))

ptolemys-theorem : Set1
ptolemys-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b c d p : P) ->
  CosphericalFour reals space affine a b c d ->
  StraightAngleAt reals space affine a p c ->
  StraightAngleAt reals space affine b p d ->
  addR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (distance affine a b)
      (distance affine c d))
    (multiplyR reals
      (distance affine b c)
      (distance affine d a))
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine a c)
    (distance affine b d)

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q459547, "Ptolemy's theorem": in an arbitrary real inner-product affine
  space, four cospherical points whose diagonals form straight angles at a
  common point satisfy Ptolemy's distance identity. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q459547_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q459547_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q459547_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q459547_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q459547_norm_def",
  ``q459547_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q459547_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q459547_dist_def",
  ``q459547_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q459547_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q459547_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q459547_angle_def",
  ``q459547_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p)
      (z : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub x y) (vsub z y) /
          (q459547_norm inner (vsub x y) *
           q459547_norm inner (vsub z y)))``);

val q459547_cospherical_four_def = new_definition (
  "q459547_cospherical_four_def",
  ``q459547_cospherical_four
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a : 'p)
      (b : 'p)
      (c : 'p)
      (d : 'p) <=>
      ?centre : 'p. ?radius : real.
        q459547_dist inner vsub a centre = radius /\
        q459547_dist inner vsub b centre = radius /\
        q459547_dist inner vsub c centre = radius /\
        q459547_dist inner vsub d centre = radius``);

val q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a b c d p : 'p).
      q459547_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q459547_cospherical_four inner vsub a b c d /\
      q459547_angle inner vsub a p c = pi /\
      q459547_angle inner vsub b p d = pi
      ==>
      q459547_dist inner vsub a b *
          q459547_dist inner vsub c d +
        q459547_dist inner vsub b c *
          q459547_dist inner vsub d a =
        q459547_dist inner vsub a c *
          q459547_dist inner vsub b d``;

title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q459547
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q459547), "Ptolemy's theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, four cospherical points whose
  diagonals form straight angles at a point satisfy Ptolemy's distance
  identity. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces represented by SetMM
  CPreHil structures whose scalar field is RRfld. Choosing the source point P
  as an affine origin identifies its normed affine torsor with this vector
  presentation while preserving differences, distances, angles, and spheres.

  W Q459547Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q459547Dist A B is its norm,
  and W Q459547Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When either
  ray is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention; otherwise
  it is the arccosine of the normalized inner product.

  W Q459547Cospherical A B C D states that the four points have a common
  center and a common nonnegative real distance from it. This is equivalent
  to Cospherical {A, B, C, D}; nonnegativity follows from any of the four
  distance equalities and is made explicit here.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit
  bidirectional definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved
  corpus statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q459547Ray Q459547Dist Q459547Angle Q459547Cospherical $.

q459547-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q459547Ray A B ) $.
q459547-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q459547Dist A B ) $.
q459547-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q459547Angle A B C ) $.
q459547-cospherical-syntax
