title: Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q459547
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q459547), "Ptolemy's theorem": cospherical points
% whose diagonals pass through a common point in opposite directions satisfy
% Ptolemy's distance identity. This file contains no proof.

Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  squared_distance(p, q: P): real =
    inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  distance_value(length: real, p, q: P): bool =
    0 <= length
      AND length * length = squared_distance(p, q)

  on_sphere(p, center: P, radius: real): bool =
    distance_value(radius, p, center)

  cospherical(a, b, c, d: P): bool =
    EXISTS (center: P), (radius: real):
      on_sphere(a, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(b, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(c, center, radius)
        AND on_sphere(d, center, radius)

  angle_at_is_pi(a, p, c: P): bool =
    EXISTS (pa, pc: real):
      distance_value(pa, p, a)
        AND distance_value(pc, p, c)
        AND 0 < pa
        AND 0 < pc
        AND inner(vsub(a, p), vsub(c, p)) = -(pa * pc)

  ptolemy_distance_identity(a, b, c, d: P): bool =
    EXISTS (ab, bc, cd, da, ac, bd: real):
      distance_value(ab, a, b)
        AND distance_value(bc, b, c)
        AND distance_value(cd, c, d)
        AND distance_value(da, d, a)
        AND distance_value(ac, a, c)
        AND distance_value(bd, b, d)
        AND ab * cd + bc * da = ac * bd

  ptolemy_s_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, c, d, p: P):
        (cospherical(a, b, c, d)
          AND angle_at_is_pi(a, p, c)
          AND angle_at_is_pi(b, p, d))
        IMPLIES ptolemy_distance_identity(a, b, c, d)
END Q459547_ptolemy_s_theorem

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q468391
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q468391), "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a proper
-- pseudometric space, every sequence that is frequently in a bounded set has a
-- strictly monotone subsequence converging to a point in the set's closure; in
-- particular, this holds when every term lies in the set. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.Sequences
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Bounded

@[expose] public section

open Filter Bornology Metric
open scoped Topology

universe u

namespace Q468391

variable {X : Type u} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [ProperSpace X] {s : Set X}

/-- Bolzano–Weierstrass for a sequence frequently contained in a bounded set. -/
theorem tendsto_subseq_of_frequently_bounded (hs : IsBounded s) {x : ℕ → X}
    (hx : ∃ᶠ n in atTop, x n ∈ s) :
    ∃ a ∈ closure s, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto (x ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 a) := sorry

/-- Bolzano–Weierstrass for a sequence contained in a bounded set. -/
theorem tendsto_subseq_of_bounded (hs : IsBounded s) {x : ℕ → X}
    (hx : ∀ n, x n ∈ s) :
    ∃ a ∈ closure s, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto (x ∘ φ) atTop (𝓝 a) := sorry

end Q468391

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q468391
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q468391), "Bolzano-Weierstrass theorem": in a
  proper pseudometric space, a sequence that is frequently contained in a
  bounded set has a strictly monotone subsequence converging to a point in the
  closure of that set; this also applies when every term lies in the set.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q468391_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q468391_pseudo_metric_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q468391_dist : X -> X -> R;
  q468391_dist_nonnegative :
    forall x y : X, 0 <= q468391_dist x y;
  q468391_dist_self :
    forall x : X, q468391_dist x x = 0;
  q468391_dist_symmetric :
    forall x y : X,
      q468391_dist x y = q468391_dist y x;
  q468391_dist_triangle :
    forall x y z : X,
      q468391_dist x z <=
      q468391_dist x y + q468391_dist y z
}.

Arguments q468391_dist {X} _ _ _.

Definition q468391_is_open
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (U : q468391_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : X,
        q468391_dist M x y < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q468391_is_closed
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q468391_set X) : Prop :=
  q468391_is_open M (fun x : X => ~ S x).

Definition q468391_closure
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q468391_set X) : q468391_set X :=
  fun x : X =>
    forall C : q468391_set X,
      q468391_is_closed M C ->
      (forall y : X, S y -> C y) ->
      C x.

Definition q468391_is_compact
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q468391_set X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q468391_set (q468391_set X),
    (forall U : q468391_set X,
      cover U -> q468391_is_open M U) ->
    (forall x : X,
      S x ->
      exists U : q468391_set X, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q468391_set X),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        S x ->
        exists U : q468391_set X,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q468391_closed_ball
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (center : X)
    (radius : R) : q468391_set X :=
  fun x : X => q468391_dist M x center <= radius.

Definition q468391_proper_space
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X) : Prop :=
  forall (center : X) (radius : R),
    q468391_is_compact M
      (q468391_closed_ball M center radius).

Definition q468391_is_bounded
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (S : q468391_set X) : Prop :=
  exists bound : R,
    forall x y : X,
      S x ->
      S y ->
      q468391_dist M x y <= bound.

Definition q468391_frequently_at_top
    (P : nat -> Prop) : Prop :=
  ~ exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat -> ~ P n.

Definition q468391_strict_mono
    (phi : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    (i < j)%nat -> (phi i < phi j)%nat.

Definition q468391_tends_to
    {X : Type}
    (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X)
    (u : nat -> X)
    (a : X) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q468391_dist M (u n) a < epsilon.

Theorem tendsto_subseq_of_frequently_bounded :
  forall (X : Type)
         (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X),
    q468391_proper_space M ->
    forall (s : q468391_set X) (x : nat -> X),
      q468391_is_bounded M s ->
      q468391_frequently_at_top (fun n : nat => s (x n)) ->
      exists a : X,
        q468391_closure M s a /\
        exists phi : nat -> nat,
          q468391_strict_mono phi /\
          q468391_tends_to M (fun n : nat => x (phi n)) a.
Admitted.

Theorem tendsto_subseq_of_bounded :
  forall (X : Type)
         (M : q468391_pseudo_metric_space X),
    q468391_proper_space M ->
    forall (s : q468391_set X) (x : nat -> X),
      q468391_is_bounded M s ->
      (forall n : nat, s (x n)) ->
      exists a : X,
        q468391_closure M s a /\
        exists phi : nat -> nat,
          q468391_strict_mono phi /\
          q468391_tends_to M (fun n : nat => x (phi n)) a.
Admitted.

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q468391
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q468391), "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a
  proper pseudometric space, every sequence that is frequently contained in a
  bounded set, and hence every sequence contained in one, has a convergent
  strictly increasing subsequence whose limit lies in the set's closure. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q468391_pseudometric ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_pseudometric d \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. 0 \<le> d x y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. d x x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. d x y = d y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y z. d x z \<le> d x y + d y z)"

definition q468391_open ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_open d U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x \<in> U. \<exists>e > 0. \<forall>y. d x y < e \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U)"

definition q468391_compact ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_compact d K \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>C.
      (\<forall>U \<in> C. q468391_open d U) \<longrightarrow>
      K \<subseteq> \<Union>C \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>D. D \<subseteq> C \<and> finite D \<and> K \<subseteq> \<Union>D))"

definition q468391_cball ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q468391_cball d x r = {y. d x y \<le> r}"

definition q468391_proper ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_proper d \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x r. q468391_compact d (q468391_cball d x r))"

definition q468391_bounded ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_bounded d S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>C. \<forall>x \<in> S. \<forall>y \<in> S. d x y \<le> C)"

definition q468391_closure ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q468391_closure d S =
    {x. \<forall>e > 0. \<exists>y \<in> S. d x y < e}"

definition q468391_frequently_at_top ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_frequently_at_top P \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>N. \<exists>n \<ge> N. P n)"

definition q468391_strict_mono ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_strict_mono phi \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>m n. m < n \<longrightarrow> phi m < phi n)"

definition q468391_tends_to ::
    "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q468391_tends_to d u a \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>e > 0. \<exists>N. \<forall>n \<ge> N. d (u n) a < e)"

theorem tendsto_subseq_of_frequently_bounded:
  fixes d :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and S :: "'a set"
    and x :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes pseudometric: "q468391_pseudometric d"
    and proper: "q468391_proper d"
    and bounded: "q468391_bounded d S"
    and frequently:
      "q468391_frequently_at_top (\<lambda>n. x n \<in> S)"
  shows "\<exists>a \<in> q468391_closure d S.
    \<exists>phi :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat.
      q468391_strict_mono phi \<and>
      q468391_tends_to d (x \<circ> phi) a"
  sorry

theorem tendsto_subseq_of_bounded:
  fixes d :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> real"
    and S :: "'a set"
    and x :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes pseudometric: "q468391_pseudometric d"
    and proper: "q468391_proper d"
    and bounded: "q468391_bounded d S"
    and contained: "\<And>n. x n \<in> S"
  shows "\<exists>a \<in> q468391_closure d S.
    \<exists>phi :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat.
      q468391_strict_mono phi \<and>
      q468391_tends_to d (x \<circ> phi) a"
  sorry

end

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q468391,
  "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a proper pseudometric space, every sequence
  that is frequently contained in a bounded set has a strictly monotone
  convergent subsequence whose limit lies in the set's closure; in particular,
  this holds when every term lies in the bounded set. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let Q468391_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS_THEOREM =
  `let is_pseudometric =
     \(d:A->A->real).
       (!x y:A. &0 <= d x y) /\
       (!x:A. d x x = &0) /\
       (!x y:A. d x y = d y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. d x z <= d x y + d y z) in
   let metric_open =
     \(d:A->A->real) (u:A->bool).
       !x:A.
         x IN u
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:A. d y x < epsilon ==> y IN u in
   let metric_compact =
     \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
       !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> metric_open d u) /\
         s SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?finite_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
               finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE finite_cover /\
               s SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let proper_pseudometric_space =
     \(d:A->A->real).
       !center:A.
       !radius:real.
         metric_compact d {y:A | d y center <= radius} in
   let metric_bounded =
     \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
       ?bound:real.
         !x y:A.
           x IN s /\ y IN s
           ==> d x y <= bound in
   let metric_closure =
     \(d:A->A->real) (s:A->bool).
       {a:A |
          !u:A->bool.
            metric_open d u /\ a IN u
            ==> ?y:A. y IN s /\ y IN u} in
   let frequently_in =
     \(s:A->bool) (x:num->A).
       !N:num.
         ?n:num. N <= n /\ x n IN s in
   let strict_mono =
     \(phi:num->num).
       !m n:num. m < n ==> phi m < phi n in
   let sequence_tends_to =
     \(d:A->A->real) (u:num->A) (a:A).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?N:num.
               !n:num.
                 N <= n
                 ==> d (u n) a < epsilon in
   (!d:A->A->real.
    !s:A->bool.
    !x:num->A.
      is_pseudometric d /\
      proper_pseudometric_space d /\
      metric_bounded d s /\
      frequently_in s x
      ==> ?a:A.
            a IN metric_closure d s /\
            ?phi:num->num.
              strict_mono phi /\
              sequence_tends_to d (\n:num. x (phi n)) a) /\
   (!d:A->A->real.
    !s:A->bool.
    !x:num->A.
      is_pseudometric d /\
      proper_pseudometric_space d /\
      metric_bounded d s /\
      (!n:num. x n IN s)
      ==> ?a:A.
            a IN metric_closure d s /\
            ?phi:num->num.
              strict_mono phi /\
              sequence_tends_to d (\n:num. x (phi n)) a)`;;

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q468391,
;; "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a proper pseudometric space, a sequence
;; frequently contained in a bounded set, and in particular a sequence wholly
;; contained in one, has a subsequence converging to its closure. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ functions represent arbitrary carriers, subsets, families, and
;; sequences. Distances are represented exactly by rounded rational upper
;; cuts: DISTANCE-LT-P(d,x,y,q) means d(x,y) < q. Thus the distance may be any
;; finite nonnegative real, not merely a rational. DEFUN-SK keeps all points,
;; sets, covers, indices, limits, and subsequence functions in their source
;; quantifier scopes.

(defun q468391-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q468391-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q468391-distance-lt-p
    (distance left right radius)
  (if (apply$ distance (list left right radius)) t nil))

(defun q468391-positive-rational-p (radius)
  (and
   (rationalp radius)
   (< 0 radius)))

;; Extensional subsets and arbitrary families of subsets.

(defun-sk q468391-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q468391-member-p set x)
     (q468391-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q468391-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q468391-set-contained-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q468391-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q468391-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q468391-member-p left x)
      (q468391-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q468391-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q468391-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q468391-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q468391-member-p family left)
      (q468391-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q468391-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q468391-member-p family set)
     (q468391-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q468391-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q468391-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q468391-family-members-valid-p carrier family)))

;; Rounded rational upper cuts for genuine real-valued pseudometrics.

(defun-sk q468391-distance-finite-p
    (distance left right)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q468391-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q468391-distance-lt-p
      distance left right radius))))

(defun-sk q468391-distance-rounded-p
    (distance left right radius)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q468391-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (rationalp radius)
     (< smaller radius)
     (q468391-distance-lt-p
      distance left right smaller))))

(defun-sk q468391-pseudometric-laws-p
    (carrier distance)
  (forall (x y z q r s)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier x)
      (q468391-member-p carrier y)
      (q468391-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (implies
       (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q468391-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
        (rationalp r)
        (< q r))
       (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x y r))
      (implies
       (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q468391-distance-rounded-p
        distance x y q))
      (q468391-distance-finite-p distance x y)
      (iff
       (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x y q)
       (q468391-distance-lt-p distance y x q))
      (iff
       (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x x q)
       (q468391-positive-rational-p q))
      (implies
       (and
        (q468391-positive-rational-p r)
        (q468391-positive-rational-p s)
        (q468391-distance-lt-p distance x y r)
        (q468391-distance-lt-p distance y z s))
       (q468391-distance-lt-p
        distance x z (+ r s)))))))

(defun q468391-pseudometric-space-p (carrier distance)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp distance)
   (q468391-pseudometric-laws-p carrier distance)))

;; The topology induced by the pseudometric.

(defun-sk q468391-metric-ball-subset-p
    (carrier distance center radius set)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier point)
      (q468391-distance-lt-p
       distance center point radius))
     (q468391-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q468391-open-radius-exists-p
    (carrier distance set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q468391-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q468391-metric-ball-subset-p
      carrier distance center radius set))))

(defun-sk q468391-open-law-p (carrier distance set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier center)
      (q468391-member-p set center))
     (q468391-open-radius-exists-p
      carrier distance set center))))

(defun q468391-open-set-p (carrier distance set)
  (and
   (q468391-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q468391-open-law-p carrier distance set)))

;; Compactness via arbitrary open covers and internal finite subcovers.

(defun-sk q468391-family-members-open-p
    (carrier distance family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q468391-member-p family set)
     (q468391-open-set-p carrier distance set))))

(defun-sk q468391-cover-point-p (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q468391-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q468391-member-p family set)
     (q468391-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q468391-cover-p (carrier set family)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier x)
      (q468391-member-p set x))
     (q468391-cover-point-p carrier family x))))

(defun q468391-finite-subcover-elements-p
    (sets carrier family)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q468391-valid-set-p carrier (car sets))
       (q468391-member-p family (car sets))
       (q468391-finite-subcover-elements-p
        (cdr sets) carrier family))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun q468391-finite-subcover-point-p (sets x)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q468391-member-p (car sets) x)
       (q468391-finite-subcover-point-p (cdr sets) x))
    nil))

(defun-sk q468391-finite-subcover-covers-p
    (carrier set sets)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier x)
      (q468391-member-p set x))
     (q468391-finite-subcover-point-p sets x))))

(defun q468391-finite-subcover-p
    (sets carrier set family)
  (and
   (true-listp sets)
   (q468391-finite-subcover-elements-p
    sets carrier family)
   (q468391-finite-subcover-covers-p
    carrier set sets)))

(defun-sk q468391-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (carrier set family)
  (exists (sets)
    (q468391-finite-subcover-p
     sets carrier set family)))

(defun-sk q468391-compact-cover-law-p
    (carrier distance set)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q468391-family-members-open-p
       carrier distance family)
      (q468391-cover-p carrier set family))
     (q468391-finite-subcover-exists-p
      carrier set family))))

(defun q468391-compact-set-p (carrier distance set)
  (and
   (q468391-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q468391-compact-cover-law-p
    carrier distance set)))

;; Metric boundedness.

(defun-sk q468391-bound-p
    (carrier distance set bound)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier x)
      (q468391-member-p carrier y)
      (q468391-member-p set x)
      (q468391-member-p set y))
     (q468391-distance-lt-p
      distance x y bound))))

(defun-sk q468391-bounded-witness-exists-p
    (carrier distance set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q468391-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q468391-bound-p
      carrier distance set bound))))

(defun q468391-bounded-set-p (carrier distance set)
  (and
   (q468391-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q468391-bounded-witness-exists-p
    carrier distance set)))

;; Properness: every nonnegative rational-radius closed ball is compact.
;; Rational radii are cofinal, so this is equivalent to compactness of all
;; real-radius closed balls.

(defun-sk q468391-distance-le-p
    (distance left right bound)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp radius)
      (< bound radius))
     (q468391-distance-lt-p
      distance left right radius))))

(defun-sk q468391-closed-ball-representation-p
    (carrier distance center radius ball)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q468391-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q468391-member-p ball x)
      (q468391-distance-le-p
       distance center x radius)))))

(defun-sk q468391-compact-closed-ball-exists-p
    (carrier distance center radius)
  (exists (ball)
    (and
     (q468391-valid-set-p carrier ball)
     (q468391-closed-ball-representation-p
      carrier distance center radius ball)
     (q468391-compact-set-p
      carrier distance ball))))

(defun-sk q468391-proper-space-p (carrier distance)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (q468391-member-p carrier center)
      (rationalp radius)
      (<= 0 radius))
     (q468391-compact-closed-ball-exists-p
      carrier distance center radius))))

;; Closure, natural-number sequences, frequent membership, and convergence.

(defun-sk q468391-closure-witness-exists-p
    (carrier distance set point radius)
  (exists (nearby)
    (and
     (q468391-member-p carrier nearby)
     (q468391-member-p set nearby)
     (q468391-distance-lt-p
      distance point nearby radius))))

(defun-sk q468391-closure-point-p
    (carrier distance set point)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (q468391-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q468391-closure-witness-exists-p
      carrier distance set point radius))))

(defun-sk q468391-sequence-typed-p (carrier sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q468391-member-p
      carrier (q468391-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q468391-sequence-in-set-p (set sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q468391-member-p
      set (q468391-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q468391-later-set-index-exists-p
    (set sequence threshold)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (<= threshold n)
     (q468391-member-p
      set (q468391-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q468391-frequently-in-set-p (set sequence)
  (forall (threshold)
    (implies
     (natp threshold)
     (q468391-later-set-index-exists-p
      set sequence threshold))))

(defun-sk q468391-nat-map-p (map)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (natp (q468391-value map n)))))

(defun-sk q468391-strict-mono-p (map)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (< m n))
     (<
      (q468391-value map m)
      (q468391-value map n)))))

(defun-sk q468391-eventually-close-p
    (distance sequence map point radius threshold)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (<= threshold n))
     (q468391-distance-lt-p
      distance
      (q468391-value
       sequence (q468391-value map n))
      point
      radius))))

(defun-sk q468391-convergence-threshold-exists-p
    (distance sequence map point radius)
  (exists (threshold)
    (and
     (natp threshold)
     (q468391-eventually-close-p
      distance sequence map point radius threshold))))

(defun-sk q468391-tendsto-subsequence-p
    (distance sequence map point)
  (forall (radius)
    (implies
     (q468391-positive-rational-p radius)
     (q468391-convergence-threshold-exists-p
      distance sequence map point radius))))

(defun-sk q468391-convergent-subsequence-exists-p
    (carrier distance set sequence)
  (exists (point map)
    (and
     (q468391-member-p carrier point)
     (q468391-closure-point-p
      carrier distance set point)
     (tamep-functionp map)
     (q468391-nat-map-p map)
     (q468391-strict-mono-p map)
     (q468391-tendsto-subsequence-p
      distance sequence map point))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q468391-tendsto-subseq-of-frequently-bounded-statement
    (carrier distance set sequence)
  (implies
   (and
    (q468391-pseudometric-space-p carrier distance)
    (q468391-proper-space-p carrier distance)
    (q468391-bounded-set-p carrier distance set)
    (tamep-functionp sequence)
    (q468391-sequence-typed-p carrier sequence)
    (q468391-frequently-in-set-p set sequence))
   (q468391-convergent-subsequence-exists-p
    carrier distance set sequence)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q468391-tendsto-subseq-of-bounded-statement
    (carrier distance set sequence)
  (implies
   (and
    (q468391-pseudometric-space-p carrier distance)
    (q468391-proper-space-p carrier distance)
    (q468391-bounded-set-p carrier distance set)
    (tamep-functionp sequence)
    (q468391-sequence-typed-p carrier sequence)
    (q468391-sequence-in-set-p set sequence))
   (q468391-convergent-subsequence-exists-p
    carrier distance set sequence)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q468391,
-- "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a proper pseudometric space, a sequence
-- that is frequently contained in a bounded set, and hence any sequence
-- contained in that set, has a convergent strictly monotone subsequence whose
-- limit lies in the set's closure. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where

  zero<= :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <=N n

  suc<=suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <=N n ->
    suc m <=N suc n

data _<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where

  zero<suc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero <N suc n

  suc<suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m <N n ->
    suc m <N suc n

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real line.
record RealLine
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set r

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) == addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-one :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Σ Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Σ R P ->
      Σ R (\ upper -> (x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Σ R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

StrictLess :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set r
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

record PseudoMetricSpace
  {r a : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (r ⊔ a) where

  field
    distance :
      X ->
      X ->
      R

    distance-nonnegative :
      (x y : X) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (distance x y)

    distance-self :
      (x : X) ->
      distance x x == zeroR reals

    distance-symmetric :
      (x y : X) ->
      distance x y == distance y x

    distance-triangle :
      (x y z : X) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (distance x z)
        (addR reals (distance x y) (distance y z))

open PseudoMetricSpace

Subset :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Subset {p = p} X =
  X -> Set p

Family :
  {a p : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Family {p = p} X =
  Subset {p = p} X -> Set p

Complement :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Subset {p = p} X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

MetricOpen :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  Subset {p = r} X ->
  Set (r ⊔ a)
MetricOpen {R = R} {X = X} {reals = reals} metric U =
  (center : X) ->
  U center ->
  Σ R
    (\ radius ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) radius
      and
      ((point : X) ->
        StrictLess reals (distance metric center point) radius ->
        U point))

Covers :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Family {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Covers {p = p} {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Σ (Subset {p = p} X)
    (\ V ->
      cover V and V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Family {p = p} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
FiniteSubcover {p = p} {X = X} U cover =
  Σ (List (Subset {p = p} X))
    (\ selected ->
      ((V : Subset {p = p} X) ->
        Member V selected ->
        cover V)
      and
      ((x : X) ->
        U x ->
        Σ (Subset {p = p} X)
          (\ V ->
            Member V selected and V x)))

Compact :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  Subset {p = r} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc r)
Compact {r = r} {X = X} metric U =
  (cover : Family {p = r} X) ->
  ((V : Subset {p = r} X) ->
    cover V ->
    MetricOpen metric V) ->
  Covers U cover ->
  FiniteSubcover U cover

ClosedBall :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  X ->
  R ->
  Subset {p = r} X
ClosedBall {reals = reals} metric center radius point =
  lessOrEqualR reals (distance metric center point) radius

Proper :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc r)
Proper {R = R} {X = X} metric =
  (center : X) ->
  (radius : R) ->
  Compact metric (ClosedBall metric center radius)

IsBounded :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  Subset {p = r} X ->
  Set (r ⊔ a)
IsBounded {R = R} {X = X} {reals = reals} metric U =
  Σ R
    (\ bound ->
      (x y : X) ->
      U x ->
      U y ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (distance metric x y) bound)

Closure :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  Subset {p = r} X ->
  Subset {p = r ⊔ a} X
Closure {R = R} {X = X} {reals = reals} metric U limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Σ X
    (\ point ->
      U point
      and
      StrictLess reals (distance metric limit point) epsilon)

FrequentlyAtTop :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> X) ->
  Subset {p = p} X ->
  Set p
FrequentlyAtTop sequence U =
  (cutoff : Nat) ->
  Σ Nat
    (\ n ->
      cutoff <=N n
      and
      U (sequence n))

StrictMono :
  (Nat -> Nat) ->
  Set
StrictMono subsequence =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m <N n ->
  subsequence m <N subsequence n

ConvergesTo :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  PseudoMetricSpace reals X ->
  (Nat -> X) ->
  X ->
  Set r
ConvergesTo {R = R} {reals = reals} metric sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Σ Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (distance metric (sequence n) limit) epsilon)

HasConvergentSubsequenceInClosure :
  {r a : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace reals X) ->
  Subset {p = r} X ->
  (Nat -> X) ->
  Set (r ⊔ a)
HasConvergentSubsequenceInClosure {X = X} metric U sequence =
  Σ X
    (\ limit ->
      Closure metric U limit
      and
      Σ (Nat -> Nat)
        (\ subsequence ->
          StrictMono subsequence
          and
          ConvergesTo metric
            (\ n -> sequence (subsequence n))
            limit))

tendsto-subseq-of-frequently-bounded :
  {r a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ a))
tendsto-subseq-of-frequently-bounded {r} {a} =
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (X : Set a) ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace reals X) ->
  Proper metric ->
  (U : Subset {p = r} X) ->
  IsBounded metric U ->
  (sequence : Nat -> X) ->
  FrequentlyAtTop sequence U ->
  HasConvergentSubsequenceInClosure metric U sequence

tendsto-subseq-of-bounded :
  {r a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ a))
tendsto-subseq-of-bounded {r} {a} =
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (X : Set a) ->
  (metric : PseudoMetricSpace reals X) ->
  Proper metric ->
  (U : Subset {p = r} X) ->
  IsBounded metric U ->
  (sequence : Nat -> X) ->
  ((n : Nat) -> U (sequence n)) ->
  HasConvergentSubsequenceInClosure metric U sequence

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q468391, "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a proper pseudo-metric space,
  a sequence frequently contained in a bounded set, and hence a sequence
  contained in that set, has a convergent subsequence whose limit lies in
  the set's closure. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val q468391_pseudo_metric_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_pseudo_metric_def",
  ``q468391_pseudo_metric (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      (!x. dist x x = 0) /\
      (!x y. 0 <= dist x y) /\
      (!x y. dist x y = dist y x) /\
      (!x y z. dist x z <= dist x y + dist y z)``);

val q468391_open_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_open_def",
  ``q468391_open (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (u : 'a set) <=>
      !x.
        x IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !y. dist y x < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q468391_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_compact_def",
  ``q468391_compact (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (k : 'a set) <=>
      !cover : ('a set) set.
        (!u. u IN cover ==> q468391_open dist u) /\
        k SUBSET BIGUNION cover
        ==>
        ?subcover : ('a set) set.
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          FINITE subcover /\
          k SUBSET BIGUNION subcover``);

val q468391_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_closed_ball_def",
  ``q468391_closed_ball
      (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (x : 'a) (radius : real) =
      {y | dist y x <= radius}``);

val q468391_proper_space_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_proper_space_def",
  ``q468391_proper_space (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) <=>
      !x radius.
        q468391_compact dist (q468391_closed_ball dist x radius)``);

val q468391_bounded_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_bounded_def",
  ``q468391_bounded (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) <=>
      ?bound : real.
        !x y.
          x IN s /\ y IN s
          ==>
          dist x y <= bound``);

val q468391_in_closure_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_in_closure_def",
  ``q468391_in_closure
      (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) (a : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?y. y IN s /\ dist y a < epsilon``);

val q468391_frequently_in_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_frequently_in_def",
  ``q468391_frequently_in (x : num -> 'a) (s : 'a set) <=>
      !N : num.
        ?n : num. N <= n /\ x n IN s``);

val q468391_strict_mono_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_strict_mono_def",
  ``q468391_strict_mono (phi : num -> num) <=>
      !m n : num. m < n ==> phi m < phi n``);

val q468391_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q468391_tendsto_def",
  ``q468391_tendsto
      (dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (u : num -> 'a) (a : 'a) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num. N <= n ==> dist (u n) a < epsilon``);

val tendsto_subseq_of_frequently_bounded =
  ``!(dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) (x : num -> 'a).
      q468391_pseudo_metric dist /\
      q468391_proper_space dist /\
      q468391_bounded dist s /\
      q468391_frequently_in x s
      ==>
      ?a : 'a.
        q468391_in_closure dist s a /\
        ?phi : num -> num.
          q468391_strict_mono phi /\
          q468391_tendsto dist (\n. x (phi n)) a``;

val tendsto_subseq_of_bounded =
  ``!(dist : 'a -> 'a -> real) (s : 'a set) (x : num -> 'a).
      q468391_pseudo_metric dist /\
      q468391_proper_space dist /\
      q468391_bounded dist s /\
      (!n : num. x n IN s)
      ==>
      ?a : 'a.
        q468391_in_closure dist s a /\
        ?phi : num -> num.
          q468391_strict_mono phi /\
          q468391_tendsto dist (\n. x (phi n)) a``;

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q468391
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q468391), "Bolzano--Weierstrass theorem":
  in a proper pseudometric space, a sequence frequently contained in a bounded
  set has a strictly increasing subsequence converging to a point in the
  closure of that set; the same conclusion holds when every term lies in the
  set. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q468391MetricTopology D is the topology generated by the open balls of the
  real-valued pseudometric D. Q468391Bounded D S says that all pairwise
  distances in S have a common real upper bound, which is equivalent to
  boundedness in the pseudometric bornology.

  Q468391Proper X D states that every closed ball with center in X and real
  radius is compact in the induced subspace topology, exactly expressing the
  proper-space assumption. Q468391SubseqConverges D x p a says that p is a
  strictly increasing map from the natural numbers to themselves and that the
  subsequence n |-> x(p(n)) converges to a in the induced topology.

  Frequent membership along the natural-number atTop filter is rendered in the
  first final assertion by: after every natural index N there is an n >= N
  whose sequence value lies in S. The second final assertion instead requires
  every sequence value to lie in S. Both conclusions retain the internal
  existential limit point in the closure and the internal existential
  subsequence map.

  The two final declarations are the unproved corpus $a statements
  corresponding to the two indexed Lean declarations. All preceding $a
  declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this database contains
  no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q468391MetricTopology Q468391Bounded Q468391Proper
   Q468391SubseqConverges $.

q468391-metric-topology-syntax
  $a class ( Q468391MetricTopology D ) $.
q468391-bounded-syntax
  $a wff ( Q468391Bounded D S ) $.
q468391-proper-syntax
  $a wff ( Q468391Proper X D ) $.
q468391-subseq-converges-syntax
  $a wff ( Q468391SubseqConverges D x p a ) $.

${
  q468391-metric-topology-definition $a |- (
    Q468391MetricTopology D
  ) = (
    topGen ` ran ( ball ` D )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D S c u v $.

  q468391-bounded-definition $a |- (
    ( Q468391Bounded D S )
    <->
    E. c e. RR
      A. u e. S
        A. v e. S
          ( u D v ) <_ c
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D X q r y $.

  q468391-proper-definition $a |- (
    ( Q468391Proper X D )
    <->
    A. q e. X
      A. r e. RR
        (
          ( Q468391MetricTopology D )
          |`t
          { y e. X | ( q D y ) <_ r }
        ) e. Comp
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D a i j n p x $.

  q468391-subseq-converges-definition $a |- (
    ( Q468391SubseqConverges D x p a )
    <->
    (
      p e. ( NN0 ^m NN0 )
      /\
      A. i e. NN0
        A. j e. NN0
          (
            i < j
            ->
            ( p ` i ) < ( p ` j )
          )
      /\
      (
        n e. NN0 |->
        ( x ` ( p ` n ) )
      )
      (
        ~~>t
        `
        ( Q468391MetricTopology D )
      )
      a
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d D N S X a n p x $.

  thousand-theorems-q468391-tendsto-subseq-of-frequently-bounded $a |-
    A. X A. D A. S A. x
      (
        (
          D e. ( PsMet ` X )
          /\
          ran D C_ RR
          /\
          ( Q468391Proper X D )
          /\
          S C_ X
          /\
          x e. ( X ^m NN0 )
          /\
          ( Q468391Bounded D S )
        )
        ->
        (
          A. N e. NN0
            E. n e. NN0
              (
                N <_ n
                /\
                ( x ` n ) e. S
              )
          ->
          E. a e.
            (
              (
                cls
                `
                ( Q468391MetricTopology D )
              )
              `
              S
            )
            E. p
              ( Q468391SubseqConverges D x p a )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

${
  $d D S X a n p x $.

  thousand-theorems-q468391-tendsto-subseq-of-bounded $a |-
    A. X A. D A. S A. x
      (
        (
          D e. ( PsMet ` X )
          /\
          ran D C_ RR
          /\
          ( Q468391Proper X D )
          /\
          S C_ X
          /\
          x e. ( X ^m NN0 )
          /\
          ( Q468391Bounded D S )
        )
        ->
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            ( x ` n ) e. S
          ->
          E. a e.
            (
              (
                cls
                `
                ( Q468391MetricTopology D )
              )
              `
              S
            )
            E. p
              ( Q468391SubseqConverges D x p a )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q468391_bolzano_weierstrass_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q468391,
% "Bolzano–Weierstrass theorem": in a proper pseudometric space, a sequence
% frequently contained in a bounded set, or entirely contained in it, has a
% convergent strictly monotone subsequence with limit in the set's closure.
% This file contains no proof.

bolzano_weierstrass_theorem_Q468391[
  X: TYPE,
  distance: [X, X -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> X]
  index_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nat]

  pseudometric_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: X):
      distance(x, y) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        distance(x, x) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: X):
        distance(x, y) = distance(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: X):
        distance(x, z)
          <= distance(x, y) + distance(y, z))

  strictly_increasing(indices: index_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < right_index IMPLIES
        indices(left_index) < indices(right_index)

  converges(
      values: point_sequence,
      limit_value: X): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            distance(values(index), limit_value) < epsilon_value

  subsequence(
      values: point_sequence,
      indices: index_sequence): point_sequence =
    LAMBDA (index: nat):
      values(indices(index))

  metric_open(U: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: X):
            distance(x, y) < radius IMPLIES U(y)

  open_cover(cover: set_family, S: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES metric_open(U))
      AND (FORALL (x: X):
        S(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: point_set):
            cover(U) AND U(x))

  finite_subcover(
      cover: set_family,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: X):
          S(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_set(S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (cover: set_family):
      open_cover(cover, S) IMPLIES
        finite_subcover(cover, S)

  closed_ball(center: X, radius: real): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      distance(x, center) <= radius

  proper_space: bool =
    FORALL (center: X), (radius: real):
      compact_set(closed_ball(center, radius))

  bounded_set(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      FORALL (x, y: X):
        S(x) AND S(y) IMPLIES
          distance(x, y) <= bound

  closure_member(limit_value: X, S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (x: X):
        S(x)
          AND distance(limit_value, x) < epsilon_value

  frequently_in(
      values: point_sequence,
      S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (cutoff: nat):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        cutoff <= index AND S(values(index))

  entirely_in(
      values: point_sequence,
      S: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      S(values(index))

  has_convergent_subsequence_in_closure(
      values: point_sequence,
      S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (limit_value: X),
        (indices: index_sequence):
      closure_member(limit_value, S)
        AND strictly_increasing(indices)
        AND converges(
          subsequence(values, indices),
          limit_value)

  tendsto_subseq_of_frequently_bounded: bool =
    (pseudometric_space AND proper_space)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: point_set), (values: point_sequence):
        (bounded_set(S) AND frequently_in(values, S))
        IMPLIES
          has_convergent_subsequence_in_closure(values, S)

  tendsto_subseq_of_bounded: bool =
    (pseudometric_space AND proper_space)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: point_set), (values: point_sequence):
        (bounded_set(S) AND entirely_in(values, S))
        IMPLIES
          has_convergent_subsequence_in_closure(values, S)
END bolzano_weierstrass_theorem_Q468391

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q4695203
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q4695203), "Four functions theorem": four
-- nonnegative functions on a distributive lattice satisfying the pointwise
-- meet-join inequality satisfy the corresponding finite-family sum inequality.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Piecewise
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Pi
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Ring.Nat
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sups
public import Mathlib.Order.Sublattice

@[expose] public section

open Finset
open scoped FinsetFamily

namespace Q4695203

variable {α β : Type*}
variable [DistribLattice α] [CommSemiring β] [LinearOrder β] [IsStrictOrderedRing β]
  [ExistsAddOfLE β]

/-- The Ahlswede-Daykin four functions inequality for finite families in a
distributive lattice. -/
theorem four_functions_theorem [DecidableEq α] (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : α → β)
    (h₁ : 0 ≤ f₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ f₂) (h₃ : 0 ≤ f₃) (h₄ : 0 ≤ f₄)
    (h : ∀ a b, f₁ a * f₂ b ≤ f₃ (a ⊓ b) * f₄ (a ⊔ b)) (s t : Finset α) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, f₁ a) * ∑ a ∈ t, f₂ a ≤
      (∑ a ∈ s ⊼ t, f₃ a) * ∑ a ∈ s ⊻ t, f₄ a := sorry

end Q4695203

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4695203
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q4695203), "Four functions theorem": a pointwise
  meet-join product inequality for four nonnegative functions on a
  distributive lattice implies the corresponding inequality for sums over
  two finite families and their pairwise meets and joins. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q4695203_distributive_lattice (A : Type) : Type := {
  q4695203_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q4695203_meet : A -> A -> A;
  q4695203_join : A -> A -> A;
  q4695203_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q4695203_le x x;
  q4695203_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q4695203_le x y ->
      q4695203_le y z ->
      q4695203_le x z;
  q4695203_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q4695203_le x y ->
      q4695203_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q4695203_meet_le_left :
    forall x y : A,
      q4695203_le (q4695203_meet x y) x;
  q4695203_meet_le_right :
    forall x y : A,
      q4695203_le (q4695203_meet x y) y;
  q4695203_le_meet :
    forall x y z : A,
      q4695203_le z x ->
      q4695203_le z y ->
      q4695203_le z (q4695203_meet x y);
  q4695203_le_join_left :
    forall x y : A,
      q4695203_le x (q4695203_join x y);
  q4695203_le_join_right :
    forall x y : A,
      q4695203_le y (q4695203_join x y);
  q4695203_join_le :
    forall x y z : A,
      q4695203_le x z ->
      q4695203_le y z ->
      q4695203_le (q4695203_join x y) z;
  q4695203_meet_join_distrib_left :
    forall x y z : A,
      q4695203_meet x (q4695203_join y z) =
      q4695203_join
        (q4695203_meet x y)
        (q4695203_meet x z)
}.

Arguments q4695203_le {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q4695203_meet {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q4695203_join {A} _ _ _.

Record q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring (B : Type) : Type := {
  q4695203_zero : B;
  q4695203_one : B;
  q4695203_add : B -> B -> B;
  q4695203_mul : B -> B -> B;
  q4695203_ord_le : B -> B -> Prop;
  q4695203_ord_lt : B -> B -> Prop;
  q4695203_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_add x (q4695203_add y z) =
      q4695203_add (q4695203_add x y) z;
  q4695203_add_comm :
    forall x y : B,
      q4695203_add x y = q4695203_add y x;
  q4695203_zero_add :
    forall x : B,
      q4695203_add q4695203_zero x = x;
  q4695203_add_zero :
    forall x : B,
      q4695203_add x q4695203_zero = x;
  q4695203_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_mul x (q4695203_mul y z) =
      q4695203_mul (q4695203_mul x y) z;
  q4695203_mul_comm :
    forall x y : B,
      q4695203_mul x y = q4695203_mul y x;
  q4695203_one_mul :
    forall x : B,
      q4695203_mul q4695203_one x = x;
  q4695203_mul_one :
    forall x : B,
      q4695203_mul x q4695203_one = x;
  q4695203_mul_add :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_mul x (q4695203_add y z) =
      q4695203_add
        (q4695203_mul x y)
        (q4695203_mul x z);
  q4695203_add_mul :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_mul (q4695203_add x y) z =
      q4695203_add
        (q4695203_mul x z)
        (q4695203_mul y z);
  q4695203_zero_mul :
    forall x : B,
      q4695203_mul q4695203_zero x = q4695203_zero;
  q4695203_mul_zero :
    forall x : B,
      q4695203_mul x q4695203_zero = q4695203_zero;
  q4695203_ord_le_refl :
    forall x : B, q4695203_ord_le x x;
  q4695203_ord_le_trans :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_ord_le x y ->
      q4695203_ord_le y z ->
      q4695203_ord_le x z;
  q4695203_ord_le_antisym :
    forall x y : B,
      q4695203_ord_le x y ->
      q4695203_ord_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q4695203_ord_le_total :
    forall x y : B,
      q4695203_ord_le x y \/ q4695203_ord_le y x;
  q4695203_ord_le_dec :
    forall x y : B,
      {q4695203_ord_le x y} + {~ q4695203_ord_le x y};
  q4695203_ord_lt_iff :
    forall x y : B,
      q4695203_ord_lt x y <->
      q4695203_ord_le x y /\ x <> y;
  q4695203_ord_lt_dec :
    forall x y : B,
      {q4695203_ord_lt x y} + {~ q4695203_ord_lt x y};
  q4695203_nontrivial :
    exists x y : B, x <> y;
  q4695203_zero_le_one :
    q4695203_ord_le q4695203_zero q4695203_one;
  q4695203_add_le_add_left_iff :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_ord_le
        (q4695203_add z x)
        (q4695203_add z y) <->
      q4695203_ord_le x y;
  q4695203_mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_ord_lt q4695203_zero x ->
      q4695203_ord_lt y z ->
      q4695203_ord_lt
        (q4695203_mul x y)
        (q4695203_mul x z);
  q4695203_mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right :
    forall x y z : B,
      q4695203_ord_lt q4695203_zero z ->
      q4695203_ord_lt x y ->
      q4695203_ord_lt
        (q4695203_mul x z)
        (q4695203_mul y z);
  q4695203_exists_add_of_le :
    forall x y : B,
      q4695203_ord_le x y ->
      exists z : B, y = q4695203_add x z
}.

Arguments q4695203_zero {B} _.
Arguments q4695203_one {B} _.
Arguments q4695203_add {B} _ _ _.
Arguments q4695203_mul {B} _ _ _.
Arguments q4695203_ord_le {B} _ _ _.
Arguments q4695203_ord_lt {B} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q4695203_sum
    {A B : Type}
    (R : q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring B)
    (f : A -> B)
    (xs : list A) : B :=
  match xs with
  | [] => q4695203_zero R
  | x :: xs' =>
      q4695203_add R (f x) (q4695203_sum R f xs')
  end.

Fixpoint q4695203_image2_raw
    {A : Type}
    (op : A -> A -> A)
    (xs ys : list A) : list A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs' =>
      map (op x) ys ++ q4695203_image2_raw op xs' ys
  end.

Fixpoint q4695203_dedup
    {A : Type}
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (xs : list A) : list A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs' =>
      if in_dec eq_dec x xs'
      then q4695203_dedup eq_dec xs'
      else x :: q4695203_dedup eq_dec xs'
  end.

Definition q4695203_image2
    {A : Type}
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (op : A -> A -> A)
    (xs ys : list A) : list A :=
  q4695203_dedup eq_dec
    (q4695203_image2_raw op xs ys).

Theorem four_functions_theorem :
  forall
    (A B : Type)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (L : q4695203_distributive_lattice A)
    (R : q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring B)
    (f1 f2 f3 f4 : A -> B),
    (forall a : A,
      q4695203_ord_le R (q4695203_zero R) (f1 a)) ->
    (forall a : A,
      q4695203_ord_le R (q4695203_zero R) (f2 a)) ->
    (forall a : A,
      q4695203_ord_le R (q4695203_zero R) (f3 a)) ->
    (forall a : A,
      q4695203_ord_le R (q4695203_zero R) (f4 a)) ->
    (forall a b : A,
      q4695203_ord_le R
        (q4695203_mul R (f1 a) (f2 b))
        (q4695203_mul R
          (f3 (q4695203_meet L a b))
          (f4 (q4695203_join L a b)))) ->
    forall s t : list A,
      NoDup s ->
      NoDup t ->
      q4695203_ord_le R
        (q4695203_mul R
          (q4695203_sum R f1 s)
          (q4695203_sum R f2 t))
        (q4695203_mul R
          (q4695203_sum R f3
            (q4695203_image2 eq_dec
              (q4695203_meet L) s t))
          (q4695203_sum R f4
            (q4695203_image2 eq_dec
              (q4695203_join L) s t))).
Admitted.

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4695203
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q4695203), "Four functions theorem":
  nonnegative functions on a distributive lattice satisfying a pointwise
  meet-join inequality satisfy the corresponding product-of-sums inequality
  for finite subsets. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
  imports Main
begin

class q4695203_coefficient =
  linordered_comm_semiring_strict + comm_monoid_mult + zero_less_one +
  assumes q4695203_exists_add_of_le:
    "x \<le> y \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>z. y = x + z"

definition q4695203_pairwise_infs ::
    "'a::distrib_lattice set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q4695203_pairwise_infs s t =
    {x. \<exists>a\<in>s. \<exists>b\<in>t. x = inf a b}"

definition q4695203_pairwise_sups ::
    "'a::distrib_lattice set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q4695203_pairwise_sups s t =
    {x. \<exists>a\<in>s. \<exists>b\<in>t. x = sup a b}"

theorem four_functions_theorem:
  fixes f1 f2 f3 f4 :: "'a::distrib_lattice \<Rightarrow> 'b::q4695203_coefficient"
    and s t :: "'a set"
  assumes finite_s: "finite s"
    and finite_t: "finite t"
    and nonnegative_f1: "\<And>x. 0 \<le> f1 x"
    and nonnegative_f2: "\<And>x. 0 \<le> f2 x"
    and nonnegative_f3: "\<And>x. 0 \<le> f3 x"
    and nonnegative_f4: "\<And>x. 0 \<le> f4 x"
    and pointwise:
      "\<And>a b. f1 a * f2 b \<le> f3 (inf a b) * f4 (sup a b)"
  shows
    "(\<Sum>a\<in>s. f1 a) * (\<Sum>a\<in>t. f2 a) \<le>
      (\<Sum>a\<in>q4695203_pairwise_infs s t. f3 a) *
      (\<Sum>a\<in>q4695203_pairwise_sups s t. f4 a)"
  sorry

end

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4695203,
  "Four functions theorem": the Ahlswede-Daykin inequality for nonnegative
  functions on a distributive lattice and two finite sets. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q4695203_FOUR_FUNCTIONS_THEOREM =
  `let is_distributive_lattice =
     \(le_rel:A->A->bool) (meet:A->A->A) (join:A->A->A).
       (!x. le_rel x x) /\
       (!x y z. le_rel x y /\ le_rel y z ==> le_rel x z) /\
       (!x y. le_rel x y /\ le_rel y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z.
          (le_rel z (meet x y) <=> le_rel z x /\ le_rel z y)) /\
       (!x y z.
          (le_rel (join x y) z <=> le_rel x z /\ le_rel y z)) /\
       (!x y z.
          meet x (join y z) = join (meet x y) (meet x z)) /\
       (!x y z.
          join x (meet y z) = meet (join x y) (join x z)) in
   let is_ordered_comm_semiring =
     \(zero:B) (unitB:B) (add:B->B->B) (mul:B->B->B)
      (le_rel:B->B->bool).
       let lt_rel = \x y:B. le_rel x y /\ ~(x = y) in
       (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
       (!x. add zero x = x /\ add x zero = x) /\
       (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
       (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
       (!x. mul unitB x = x /\ mul x unitB = x) /\
       (!x. mul zero x = zero /\ mul x zero = zero) /\
       (!x y z.
          mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z) /\
          mul (add x y) z = add (mul x z) (mul y z)) /\
       (!x. le_rel x x) /\
       (!x y z. le_rel x y /\ le_rel y z ==> le_rel x z) /\
       (!x y. le_rel x y /\ le_rel y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y. le_rel x y \/ le_rel y x) /\
       (!a b c. le_rel a b ==> le_rel (add a c) (add b c)) /\
       (!a b c. le_rel a b ==> le_rel (add c a) (add c b)) /\
       (!a b c. le_rel (add a b) (add a c) ==> le_rel b c) /\
       (!a b c. le_rel (add b a) (add c a) ==> le_rel b c) /\
       le_rel zero unitB /\
       ~(zero = unitB) /\
       (!a b c.
          lt_rel zero a /\ lt_rel b c
          ==> lt_rel (mul a b) (mul a c)) /\
       (!a b c.
          lt_rel zero c /\ lt_rel a b
          ==> lt_rel (mul a c) (mul b c)) /\
       (!a b. le_rel a b ==> ?c. b = add a c) in
   let finite_sum =
     \(zero:B) (add:B->B->B) (s:A->bool) (f:A->B).
       ITSET (\x acc. add (f x) acc) s zero in
   let meet_family =
     \(meet:A->A->A) (s:A->bool) (t:A->bool).
       {x:A | ?a b. a IN s /\ b IN t /\ x = meet a b} in
   let join_family =
     \(join:A->A->A) (s:A->bool) (t:A->bool).
       {x:A | ?a b. a IN s /\ b IN t /\ x = join a b} in
   !(leA:A->A->bool) (meet:A->A->A) (join:A->A->A)
    (zero:B) (unitB:B) (add:B->B->B) (mul:B->B->B)
    (leB:B->B->bool) (f1:A->B) (f2:A->B) (f3:A->B) (f4:A->B)
    (s:A->bool) (t:A->bool).
      is_distributive_lattice leA meet join /\
      is_ordered_comm_semiring zero unitB add mul leB /\
      FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\
      (!x. leB zero (f1 x)) /\
      (!x. leB zero (f2 x)) /\
      (!x. leB zero (f3 x)) /\
      (!x. leB zero (f4 x)) /\
      (!a b.
         leB (mul (f1 a) (f2 b))
             (mul (f3 (meet a b)) (f4 (join a b))))
      ==>
      leB
        (mul (finite_sum zero add s f1)
             (finite_sum zero add t f2))
        (mul (finite_sum zero add (meet_family meet s t) f3)
             (finite_sum zero add (join_family join s t) f4))`;;

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4695203,
;; "Four functions theorem": the Ahlswede-Daykin inequality for four
;; nonnegative functions on an arbitrary distributive lattice, evaluated over
;; two finite subsets. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent the arbitrary lattice carrier,
;; coefficient carrier, operations, order, and four functions. Their laws are
;; explicit below and DEFUN-SK quantifiers are unbounded. Only the two source
;; Finset arguments are represented by duplicate-free finite lists.

(defstub q4695203-alpha-p (x) t)
(defstub q4695203-meet (x y) t)
(defstub q4695203-join (x y) t)

(defstub q4695203-beta-p (x) t)
(defstub q4695203-zero () t)
(defstub q4695203-one () t)
(defstub q4695203-add (x y) t)
(defstub q4695203-multiply (x y) t)
(defstub q4695203-less-equal (x y) t)

(defstub q4695203-f1 (x) t)
(defstub q4695203-f2 (x) t)
(defstub q4695203-f3 (x) t)
(defstub q4695203-f4 (x) t)

(defun q4695203-less (x y)
  (and
   (q4695203-less-equal x y)
   (not (equal x y))))

;; Equational distributive lattices are equivalent to ordered
;; DistribLattice structures, with x <= y defined by meet(x,y) = x.

(defun-sk q4695203-lattice-closure-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-alpha-p x)
      (q4695203-alpha-p y))
     (and
      (q4695203-alpha-p (q4695203-meet x y))
      (q4695203-alpha-p (q4695203-join x y))))))

(defun-sk q4695203-lattice-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-alpha-p x)
      (q4695203-alpha-p y)
      (q4695203-alpha-p z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q4695203-meet x y)
       (q4695203-meet y x))
      (equal
       (q4695203-join x y)
       (q4695203-join y x))
      (equal
       (q4695203-meet (q4695203-meet x y) z)
       (q4695203-meet x (q4695203-meet y z)))
      (equal
       (q4695203-join (q4695203-join x y) z)
       (q4695203-join x (q4695203-join y z)))
      (equal
       (q4695203-meet x (q4695203-join x y))
       x)
      (equal
       (q4695203-join x (q4695203-meet x y))
       x)
      (equal
       (q4695203-meet x (q4695203-join y z))
       (q4695203-join
        (q4695203-meet x y)
        (q4695203-meet x z)))
      (equal
       (q4695203-join x (q4695203-meet y z))
       (q4695203-meet
        (q4695203-join x y)
        (q4695203-join x z)))))))

(defun q4695203-distributive-lattice-p ()
  (and
   (q4695203-lattice-closure-p)
   (q4695203-lattice-laws-p)))

;; Exact first-order laws for CommSemiring, LinearOrder, and
;; IsStrictOrderedRing.

(defun-sk q4695203-coefficient-closure-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p x)
      (q4695203-beta-p y))
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-add x y))
      (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-multiply x y))))))

(defun-sk q4695203-commutative-semiring-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p x)
      (q4695203-beta-p y)
      (q4695203-beta-p z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q4695203-add (q4695203-add x y) z)
       (q4695203-add x (q4695203-add y z)))
      (equal
       (q4695203-add x y)
       (q4695203-add y x))
      (equal
       (q4695203-add x (q4695203-zero))
       x)
      (equal
       (q4695203-multiply (q4695203-multiply x y) z)
       (q4695203-multiply x (q4695203-multiply y z)))
      (equal
       (q4695203-multiply x y)
       (q4695203-multiply y x))
      (equal
       (q4695203-multiply x (q4695203-one))
       x)
      (equal
       (q4695203-multiply x (q4695203-add y z))
       (q4695203-add
        (q4695203-multiply x y)
        (q4695203-multiply x z)))
      (equal
       (q4695203-multiply x (q4695203-zero))
       (q4695203-zero))))))

(defun-sk q4695203-linear-order-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p x)
      (q4695203-beta-p y)
      (q4695203-beta-p z))
     (and
      (q4695203-less-equal x x)
      (implies
       (and
        (q4695203-less-equal x y)
        (q4695203-less-equal y z))
       (q4695203-less-equal x z))
      (implies
       (and
        (q4695203-less-equal x y)
        (q4695203-less-equal y x))
       (equal x y))
      (or
       (q4695203-less-equal x y)
       (q4695203-less-equal y x))))))

(defun-sk q4695203-strict-ordered-ring-laws-p ()
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p x)
      (q4695203-beta-p y)
      (q4695203-beta-p z))
     (and
      ;; IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid.
      (implies
       (q4695203-less-equal y z)
       (q4695203-less-equal
        (q4695203-add x y)
        (q4695203-add x z)))
      (implies
       (q4695203-less-equal
        (q4695203-add x y)
        (q4695203-add x z))
       (q4695203-less-equal y z))
      ;; PosMulStrictMono and MulPosStrictMono.
      (implies
       (and
        (q4695203-less (q4695203-zero) x)
        (q4695203-less y z))
       (q4695203-less
        (q4695203-multiply x y)
        (q4695203-multiply x z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q4695203-less (q4695203-zero) z)
        (q4695203-less x y))
       (q4695203-less
        (q4695203-multiply x z)
        (q4695203-multiply y z)))))))

;; The existential witness remains internal, exactly as in ExistsAddOfLE.

(defun-sk q4695203-add-complement-exists-p (x y)
  (exists (c)
    (and
     (q4695203-beta-p c)
     (equal y (q4695203-add x c)))))

(defun-sk q4695203-exists-add-of-le-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p x)
      (q4695203-beta-p y)
      (q4695203-less-equal x y))
     (q4695203-add-complement-exists-p x y))))

(defun q4695203-coefficient-structure-p ()
  (and
   (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-zero))
   (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-one))
   (not (equal (q4695203-zero) (q4695203-one)))
   (q4695203-coefficient-closure-p)
   (q4695203-commutative-semiring-laws-p)
   (q4695203-linear-order-laws-p)
   (q4695203-less-equal
    (q4695203-zero) (q4695203-one))
   (q4695203-strict-ordered-ring-laws-p)
   (q4695203-exists-add-of-le-p)))

;; Typing and pointwise nonnegativity of the four arbitrary functions.

(defun-sk q4695203-function-laws-p ()
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q4695203-alpha-p x)
     (and
      (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-f1 x))
      (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-f2 x))
      (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-f3 x))
      (q4695203-beta-p (q4695203-f4 x))
      (q4695203-less-equal
       (q4695203-zero) (q4695203-f1 x))
      (q4695203-less-equal
       (q4695203-zero) (q4695203-f2 x))
      (q4695203-less-equal
       (q4695203-zero) (q4695203-f3 x))
      (q4695203-less-equal
       (q4695203-zero) (q4695203-f4 x))))))

;; The pointwise four-functions hypothesis.

(defun-sk q4695203-modular-p ()
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
