title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4695203
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q4695203), "Four functions theorem": the
-- Ahlswede-Daykin inequality for nonnegative functions on an arbitrary
-- distributive lattice and two finite subsets. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q4695203_four_functions_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record DecidableEquality
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    equal : A -> A -> Bool
    equal-sound :
      (x y : A) ->
      equal x y == true ->
      x == y
    equal-complete :
      (x y : A) ->
      x == y ->
      equal x y == true

open DecidableEquality

contains :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  DecidableEquality A ->
  A ->
  List A ->
  Bool
contains equality x [] =
  false
contains equality x (y ∷ ys) with equal equality x y
... | true =
  true
... | false =
  contains equality x ys

data NoDuplicates
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (equality : DecidableEquality A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates equality []
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    contains equality x xs == false ->
    NoDuplicates equality xs ->
    NoDuplicates equality (x ∷ xs)

record FiniteSet
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (equality : DecidableEquality A) :
  Set a where

  constructor finite-set
  field
    elements      : List A
    no-duplicates : NoDuplicates equality elements

open FiniteSet

insertUnique :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  DecidableEquality A ->
  A ->
  List A ->
  List A
insertUnique equality x xs with contains equality x xs
... | true =
  xs
... | false =
  x ∷ xs

deduplicate :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  DecidableEquality A ->
  List A ->
  List A
deduplicate equality [] =
  []
deduplicate equality (x ∷ xs) =
  insertUnique equality x (deduplicate equality xs)

mapList :
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  List A ->
  List B
mapList f [] =
  []
mapList f (x ∷ xs) =
  f x ∷ mapList f xs

append :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  List A ->
  List A ->
  List A
append [] ys =
  ys
append (x ∷ xs) ys =
  x ∷ append xs ys

concatMap :
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> List B) ->
  List A ->
  List B
concatMap f [] =
  []
concatMap f (x ∷ xs) =
  append (f x) (concatMap f xs)

pairwiseValues :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A -> A) ->
  List A ->
  List A ->
  List A
pairwiseValues operation xs ys =
  concatMap
    (\ x -> mapList (\ y -> operation x y) ys)
    xs

pairwiseImageElements :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} ->
  DecidableEquality A ->
  (A -> A -> A) ->
  List A ->
  List A ->
  List A
pairwiseImageElements equality operation xs ys =
  deduplicate equality (pairwiseValues operation xs ys)

record DistributiveLattice
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    meet join : A -> A -> A

    meet-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      meet (meet x y) z == meet x (meet y z)
    meet-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      meet x y == meet y x
    meet-idempotent :
      (x : A) ->
      meet x x == x

    join-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      join (join x y) z == join x (join y z)
    join-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      join x y == join y x
    join-idempotent :
      (x : A) ->
      join x x == x

    meet-absorption :
      (x y : A) ->
      meet x (join x y) == x
    join-absorption :
      (x y : A) ->
      join x (meet x y) == x

    meet-distributes-over-join :
      (x y z : A) ->
      meet x (join y z) ==
      join (meet x y) (meet x z)
    join-distributes-over-meet :
      (x y z : A) ->
      join x (meet y z) ==
      meet (join x y) (join x z)

open DistributiveLattice

record StrictOrderedCommutativeSemiring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zero one : R
    add multiply : R -> R -> R
    lessOrEqual : R -> R -> Set r

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      add (add x y) z == add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      add x y == add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      add zero x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      add x zero == x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (multiply x y) z ==
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiply x y == multiply y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply one x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x one == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply x (add y z) ==
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiply (add x y) z ==
      add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply zero x == zero
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiply x zero == zero

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y z ->
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual y x ->
      x == y
    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqual x y) (lessOrEqual y x)

    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      lessOrEqual (add z x) (add z y)
    add-order-cancellation :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqual (add x y) (add x z) ->
      lessOrEqual y z

    zero-less-or-equal-one :
      lessOrEqual zero one
    different-elements :
      Exists R (\ x -> Exists R (\ y -> Not (x == y)))

    multiply-strict-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      Both (lessOrEqual zero x) (Not (zero == x)) ->
      Both (lessOrEqual y z) (Not (y == z)) ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqual (multiply x y) (multiply x z))
        (Not (multiply x y == multiply x z))
    multiply-strict-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      Both (lessOrEqual zero z) (Not (zero == z)) ->
      Both (lessOrEqual x y) (Not (x == y)) ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqual (multiply x z) (multiply y z))
        (Not (multiply x z == multiply y z))

    exists-add-of-less-or-equal :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqual x y ->
      Exists R (\ z -> y == add x z)

open StrictOrderedCommutativeSemiring

sumList :
  {a r : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {R : Set r} ->
  StrictOrderedCommutativeSemiring R ->
  (A -> R) ->
  List A ->
  R
sumList coefficients f [] =
  zero coefficients
sumList coefficients f (x ∷ xs) =
  add coefficients (f x) (sumList coefficients f xs)

sumFiniteSet :
  {a r : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {R : Set r} ->
  (coefficients : StrictOrderedCommutativeSemiring R) ->
  {equality : DecidableEquality A} ->
  (A -> R) ->
  FiniteSet A equality ->
  R
sumFiniteSet coefficients f set =
  sumList coefficients f (elements set)

sumPairwiseImage :
  {a r : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {R : Set r} ->
  (coefficients : StrictOrderedCommutativeSemiring R) ->
  (equality : DecidableEquality A) ->
  (A -> A -> A) ->
  (A -> R) ->
  FiniteSet A equality ->
  FiniteSet A equality ->
  R
sumPairwiseImage coefficients equality operation f s t =
  sumList coefficients f
    (pairwiseImageElements equality operation
      (elements s)
      (elements t))

four-functions-theorem : Setω
four-functions-theorem =
  {a r : Level} ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (lattice : DistributiveLattice A) ->
  (equality : DecidableEquality A) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (coefficients : StrictOrderedCommutativeSemiring R) ->
  (f1 f2 f3 f4 : A -> R) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    lessOrEqual coefficients (zero coefficients) (f1 x)) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    lessOrEqual coefficients (zero coefficients) (f2 x)) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    lessOrEqual coefficients (zero coefficients) (f3 x)) ->
  ((x : A) ->
    lessOrEqual coefficients (zero coefficients) (f4 x)) ->
  ((x y : A) ->
    lessOrEqual coefficients
      (multiply coefficients (f1 x) (f2 y))
      (multiply coefficients
        (f3 (meet lattice x y))
        (f4 (join lattice x y)))) ->
  (s t : FiniteSet A equality) ->
  lessOrEqual coefficients
    (multiply coefficients
      (sumFiniteSet coefficients f1 s)
      (sumFiniteSet coefficients f2 t))
    (multiply coefficients
      (sumPairwiseImage coefficients equality
        (meet lattice) f3 s t)
      (sumPairwiseImage coefficients equality
        (join lattice) f4 s t))

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4695203, "Four functions theorem": the Ahlswede-Daykin inequality for
  nonnegative functions on a distributive lattice and finite families.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q4695203_distributive_lattice_def = new_definition (
  "q4695203_distributive_lattice_def",
  ``q4695203_distributive_lattice
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (meet : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (join : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y. leq (meet x y) x /\ leq (meet x y) y) /\
      (!x y z. leq z x /\ leq z y ==> leq z (meet x y)) /\
      (!x y. leq x (join x y) /\ leq y (join x y)) /\
      (!x y z. leq x z /\ leq y z ==> leq (join x y) z) /\
      (!x y z.
        leq
          (meet (join x y) (join x z))
          (join x (meet y z)))``);

val q4695203_strict_less_def = new_definition (
  "q4695203_strict_less_def",
  ``q4695203_strict_less
      (leq : 'r -> 'r -> bool) (x : 'r) (y : 'r) <=>
      leq x y /\ ~leq y x``);

val q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring_def",
  ``q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (leq : 'r -> 'r -> bool) <=>
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z.
        mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
      (!x. mulR zeroR x = zeroR) /\
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y ==> leq (addR x z) (addR y z)) /\
      (!x y z. leq (addR x z) (addR y z) ==> leq x y) /\
      leq zeroR oneR /\
      zeroR <> oneR /\
      (!a b c.
        q4695203_strict_less leq zeroR a /\
        q4695203_strict_less leq b c
        ==>
        q4695203_strict_less leq (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a b c.
        q4695203_strict_less leq zeroR c /\
        q4695203_strict_less leq a b
        ==>
        q4695203_strict_less leq (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a b. leq a b ==> ?c. b = addR a c)``);

val q4695203_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q4695203_sum_def",
  ``q4695203_sum
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (f : 'a -> 'r) (s : 'a set) =
      ITSET (\x acc. addR (f x) acc) s zeroR``);

val q4695203_pair_image_def = new_definition (
  "q4695203_pair_image_def",
  ``q4695203_pair_image
      (opn : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (s : 'a set) (t : 'a set) =
      {z : 'a | ?x y. x IN s /\ y IN t /\ z = opn x y}``);

val four_functions_theorem =
  ``!(leA : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (meet : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (join : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (leR : 'r -> 'r -> bool)
      (f1 : 'a -> 'r) (f2 : 'a -> 'r)
      (f3 : 'a -> 'r) (f4 : 'a -> 'r)
      (s : 'a set) (t : 'a set).
      q4695203_distributive_lattice leA meet join /\
      q4695203_ordered_comm_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR leR /\
      FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\
      (!a. leR zeroR (f1 a)) /\
      (!a. leR zeroR (f2 a)) /\
      (!a. leR zeroR (f3 a)) /\
      (!a. leR zeroR (f4 a)) /\
      (!a b.
        leR
          (mulR (f1 a) (f2 b))
          (mulR (f3 (meet a b)) (f4 (join a b))))
      ==>
      leR
        (mulR
          (q4695203_sum zeroR addR f1 s)
          (q4695203_sum zeroR addR f2 t))
        (mulR
          (q4695203_sum zeroR addR f3
            (q4695203_pair_image meet s t))
          (q4695203_sum zeroR addR f4
            (q4695203_pair_image join s t)))``;

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4695203
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q4695203), "Four functions theorem": the
  Ahlswede-Daykin inequality for four nonnegative functions on an arbitrary
  distributive lattice, valued in an ordered commutative semiring. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q4695203Codomain R expands the source assumptions CommSemiring, LinearOrder,
  IsStrictOrderedRing, and ExistsAddOfLE. CSRing supplies the commutative
  semiring. Membership in oMnd supplies the total order and additive
  monotonicity; the next clause is the order-reflection field of
  IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid. The remaining clauses state zero <= one,
  nontriviality, strict monotonicity of multiplication by positive elements
  on both sides, and the existence of an additive difference whenever a <= b.
  Strict inequalities are rendered definitionally as <= together with
  inequality in the bundled partial order.

  Q4695203Infs K S T and Q4695203Sups K S T are respectively the finite-set
  images {a meet b | a in S, b in T} and {a join b | a in S, b in T}.
  SetMM's gsum is the finite commutative-monoid sum. The final declaration is
  the single unproved $a corpus statement; all earlier $a declarations are
  syntax or explicit definitions, and this database contains no $p proof
  statement.
$)

$c Q4695203Codomain Q4695203Infs Q4695203Sups $.

q4695203-codomain-syntax $a wff ( Q4695203Codomain R ) $.
q4695203-infs-syntax $a class ( Q4695203Infs K S T ) $.
q4695203-sups-syntax $a class ( Q4695203Sups K S T ) $.

${
  $d R a b c $.

  q4695203-codomain-definition $a |- (
    ( Q4695203Codomain R )
    <->
    (
      R e. CSRing
      /\
      (
        R e. oMnd
        /\
        (
          A. a e. ( Base ` R ) A. b e. ( Base ` R )
            A. c e. ( Base ` R )
              (
                (
                  ( a ( +g ` R ) b )
                  ( le ` R )
                  ( a ( +g ` R ) c )
                )
                ->
                b ( le ` R ) c
              )
          /\
          (
            ( 0g ` R ) ( le ` R ) ( 1r ` R )
            /\
            (
              E. a e. ( Base ` R ) E. b e. ( Base ` R ) a =/= b
              /\
              (
                A. a e. ( Base ` R ) A. b e. ( Base ` R )
                  A. c e. ( Base ` R )
                    (
                      (
                        (
                          ( ( 0g ` R ) ( le ` R ) a /\ ( 0g ` R ) =/= a )
                          /\
                          ( b ( le ` R ) c /\ b =/= c )
                        )
                        ->
                        (
                          ( a ( .r ` R ) b )
                            ( le ` R )
                          ( a ( .r ` R ) c )
                          /\
                          ( a ( .r ` R ) b ) =/= ( a ( .r ` R ) c )
                        )
                      )
                    )
                /\
                (
                  A. a e. ( Base ` R ) A. b e. ( Base ` R )
                    A. c e. ( Base ` R )
                      (
                        (
                          (
                            ( ( 0g ` R ) ( le ` R ) c /\ ( 0g ` R ) =/= c )
                            /\
                            ( a ( le ` R ) b /\ a =/= b )
                          )
                          ->
                          (
                            ( a ( .r ` R ) c )
                              ( le ` R )
                            ( b ( .r ` R ) c )
                            /\
                            ( a ( .r ` R ) c ) =/= ( b ( .r ` R ) c )
                          )
                        )
                      )
                  /\
                  A. a e. ( Base ` R ) A. b e. ( Base ` R )
                    (
                      a ( le ` R ) b
                      ->
                      E. c e. ( Base ` R )
                        b = ( a ( +g ` R ) c )
                    )
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K S T a b x $.

  q4695203-infs-definition $a |- ( Q4695203Infs K S T ) =
    {
      x e. ( Base ` K ) |
        E. a e. S E. b e. T
          x = ( a ( meet ` K ) b )
    }
  $.
$}

${
  $d K S T a b x $.

  q4695203-sups-definition $a |- ( Q4695203Sups K S T ) =
    {

theorem
  for L being set,
      latLe being Relation of L,L,

      add,mul being BinOp of R,

    (for z being set holds

title: Q4695203_four_functions_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q4695203
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q4695203), "Four functions theorem": the Ahlswede-Daykin inequality
% for finite families in an arbitrary distributive lattice with values in the stated ordered
% commutative semiring. This file contains no proof.

Q4695203_four_functions_theorem[
  A: TYPE,
  R: TYPE+,
  leA: [A, A -> bool],
  meetA: [A, A -> A],
  joinA: [A, A -> A],
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R],
  leR: [R, R -> bool],
  finite_sum: [[A -> bool], [A -> R] -> R],
  meet_image: [[A -> bool], [A -> bool] -> [A -> bool]],
  join_image: [[A -> bool], [A -> bool] -> [A -> bool]]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[A]

  setA: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  functionA: TYPE = [A -> R]

  ltR(x, y: R): bool =
    leR(x, y) AND x /= y

  partial_order_A_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): leA(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        leA(x, y) AND leA(y, z) IMPLIES leA(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        leA(x, y) AND leA(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)

  distributive_lattice_A_laws: bool =
    partial_order_A_laws
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        leA(meetA(x, y), x) AND leA(meetA(x, y), y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        leA(z, x) AND leA(z, y) IMPLIES leA(z, meetA(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        leA(x, joinA(x, y)) AND leA(y, joinA(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        leA(x, z) AND leA(y, z) IMPLIES leA(joinA(x, y), z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        meetA(x, joinA(y, z)) =
          joinA(meetA(x, y), meetA(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        joinA(x, meetA(y, z)) =
          meetA(joinA(x, y), joinA(x, z)))

  commutative_semiring_R_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      addR(addR(x, y), z) = addR(x, addR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): addR(x, y) = addR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        addR(zeroR, x) = x AND addR(x, zeroR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(mulR(x, y), z) = mulR(x, mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mulR(x, y) = mulR(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mulR(oneR, x) = x AND mulR(x, oneR) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(x, addR(y, z)) =
          addR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mulR(addR(x, y), z) =
          addR(mulR(x, z), mulR(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mulR(zeroR, x) = zeroR AND mulR(x, zeroR) = zeroR)

  linear_order_R_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: R): leR(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        leR(x, y) AND leR(y, z) IMPLIES leR(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        leR(x, y) AND leR(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): leR(x, y) OR leR(y, x))

  strict_ordered_ring_R_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      leR(y, z) IMPLIES leR(addR(x, y), addR(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        leR(y, z) IMPLIES leR(addR(y, x), addR(z, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        leR(addR(x, y), addR(x, z)) IMPLIES leR(y, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        leR(addR(y, x), addR(z, x)) IMPLIES leR(y, z))
      AND leR(zeroR, oneR)
      AND (EXISTS (x, y: R): x /= y)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        ltR(zeroR, x) AND ltR(y, z)
          IMPLIES ltR(mulR(x, y), mulR(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        ltR(zeroR, x) AND ltR(y, z)
          IMPLIES ltR(mulR(y, x), mulR(z, x)))

  exists_add_of_le_R: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: R):
      leR(x, y) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (z: R): y = addR(x, z)

  finite_sum_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (f: functionA):
      finite_sum(emptyset[A], f) = zeroR)
      AND (FORALL (S: setA), (x: A), (f: functionA):
        is_finite(S) IMPLIES
          finite_sum(add(x, S), f) =
            IF S(x) THEN
              finite_sum(S, f)
            ELSE
              addR(finite_sum(S, f), f(x))
            ENDIF)

  finite_lattice_image_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (S, T: setA), (x: A):
      meet_image(S, T)(x) IFF
        EXISTS (a, b: A):
          S(a) AND T(b) AND x = meetA(a, b))
      AND (FORALL (S, T: setA), (x: A):
        join_image(S, T)(x) IFF
          EXISTS (a, b: A):
            S(a) AND T(b) AND x = joinA(a, b))

  source_context: bool =
    distributive_lattice_A_laws
      AND commutative_semiring_R_laws
      AND linear_order_R_laws
      AND strict_ordered_ring_R_laws
      AND exists_add_of_le_R
      AND finite_sum_laws
      AND finite_lattice_image_laws

  four_functions_theorem: bool =
    source_context IMPLIES
      (FORALL (f1, f2, f3, f4: functionA), (S, T: setA):
        (is_finite(S)
          AND is_finite(T)
          AND (FORALL (x: A): leR(zeroR, f1(x)))
          AND (FORALL (x: A): leR(zeroR, f2(x)))
          AND (FORALL (x: A): leR(zeroR, f3(x)))
          AND (FORALL (x: A): leR(zeroR, f4(x)))
          AND (FORALL (a, b: A):
            leR(
              mulR(f1(a), f2(b)),
              mulR(f3(meetA(a, b)), f4(joinA(a, b))))))
        IMPLIES
          leR(
            mulR(finite_sum(S, f1), finite_sum(T, f2)),
            mulR(
              finite_sum(meet_image(S, T), f3),
              finite_sum(join_image(S, T), f4))))
END Q4695203_four_functions_theorem

module

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Factorial.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Defs

open scoped Topology Real Nat

open Filter Real

namespace Q470877

/-- The normalized factorial sequence appearing in Stirling's theorem. -/
noncomputable def stirlingSeq (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  n ! / (√(2 * n : ℝ) * (n / exp 1) ^ n)

/-- Stirling's theorem: the normalized factorial sequence converges to `√π`. -/
theorem tendsto_stirlingSeq_sqrt_pi : Tendsto stirlingSeq atTop (𝓝 (√π)) := sorry

end Q470877

(*

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q470877), "Stirling's theorem": the Stirling
  sequence n! / (sqrt (2n) * (n / e)^n) converges to sqrt pi. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.Factorial.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q470877_stirling_sequence (n : nat) : R :=
  INR (fact n) /
    (sqrt (2 * INR n) * (INR n / exp 1) ^ n).

Definition q470877_sequence_converges_to
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Theorem tendsto_stirling_sequence_sqrt_pi :
  q470877_sequence_converges_to
    q470877_stirling_sequence (sqrt PI).
Admitted.

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q470877,
;; "Stirling's theorem": the exact real sequence
;; n! / (sqrt(2*n) * (n/exp(1))^n) converges to sqrt(pi), expressed through
;; equivalent rational Cauchy representatives. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; For positive n, divide the Stirling sequence by sqrt(pi) and square:
;;
;;   (n!)^2 * e^(2*n) / (2*pi*n^(2*n+1)).
;;
;; All factors are positive, so convergence of this normalized square to 1 is
;; bidirectionally equivalent to the source sequence converging to sqrt(pi).
;; Ordinary ACL2 has exact rational arithmetic but no primitive irrational
;; reals, so each real value is represented by its full rational Cauchy
;; sequence. The factorial series represents e and Machin's arctangent series
;; represents pi. No finite prefix is treated as the real value.

(defun q470877-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (q470877-factorial (1- n)))))

(defun q470877-exp-one-prefix (terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let ((index (1- terms)))
      (+ (q470877-exp-one-prefix index)
         (/ 1 (q470877-factorial index))))))

(defun q470877-arctan-prefix (z terms)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix terms)))
  (if (zp terms)
      0
    (let* ((index (1- terms))
           (exponent (+ (* 2 index) 1))
           (unsigned (/ (expt z exponent) exponent))
           (term (if (equal (mod index 2) 0)
                     unsigned
                   (- unsigned))))
      (+ (q470877-arctan-prefix z index)
         term))))

(defun q470877-pi-prefix (terms)
  (- (* 16 (q470877-arctan-prefix (/ 1 5) terms))
     (* 4 (q470877-arctan-prefix (/ 1 239) terms))))

(defun q470877-normalized-square-approx (n terms)
  (let* ((fact-n (q470877-factorial n))
         (e-approx (q470877-exp-one-prefix terms))
         (pi-approx (q470877-pi-prefix terms))
         (twice-n (* 2 n)))
    (/ (* fact-n
          fact-n
          (expt e-approx twice-n))
       (* 2
          pi-approx
          (expt n (+ twice-n 1))))))

;; A strict inequality between the represented real ratio and 1 is encoded by
;; an internal rational bound strictly below EPSILON and an approximation
;; cutoff after which every Cauchy representative lies below that bound.

(defun-sk q470877-cauchy-close-tail-p
    (n bound approximation-cutoff)
  (forall (terms)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp terms)
      (natp approximation-cutoff)
      (<= approximation-cutoff terms))
     (< (abs
         (- (q470877-normalized-square-approx n terms)
            1))
        bound))))

(defun-sk q470877-cauchy-real-close-p (n epsilon)
  (exists (bound approximation-cutoff)
    (and
     (rationalp bound)
     (< 0 bound)
     (< bound epsilon)
     (natp approximation-cutoff)
     (q470877-cauchy-close-tail-p
      n bound approximation-cutoff))))

(defun-sk q470877-stirling-tail-p (epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q470877-cauchy-real-close-p n epsilon))))

(defun-sk q470877-stirling-cutoff-exists-p (epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q470877-stirling-tail-p epsilon cutoff))))

;; Positive rational epsilon values are cofinal among positive real epsilon
;; values, so this is the full epsilon-N limit statement, not a restriction of
;; the source theorem to rational-valued sequence terms.

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q470877-stirling-s-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (rationalp epsilon)
      (< 0 epsilon))
     (q470877-stirling-cutoff-exists-p epsilon))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =

_!=_ :

  A ->
  A ->

x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where

    first  : A

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where

  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where

    value    : A

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=     : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  succ<=succ : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :

    multiply-commutativeR :

      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x

    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR

    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))

    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)

    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

powerNatR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerNatR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerNatR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerNatR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

alternating :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R ->
  R
alternating reals zero x =
  x
alternating reals (suc n) x =
  negateR reals (alternating reals n x)

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divideR reals
    (powerNatR reals x n)
    (fromNatR reals (factorial n))

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x zero =
  zeroR reals
exponentialPartialSum reals x (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x n)
    (exponentialTerm reals x n)

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x n =
  alternating reals n
    (divideR reals
      (powerNatR reals x ((suc (suc zero)) * n))
      (fromNatR reals
        (factorial ((suc (suc zero)) * n))))

cosinePartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosinePartialSum reals x zero =
  zeroR reals
cosinePartialSum reals x (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (cosinePartialSum reals x n)
    (cosineTerm reals x n)

record StandardStirlingAnalysis
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    squareRoot cosine :
      R ->
      R

    exponentialOne halfPi :
      R

    square-root-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (squareRoot x)

    square-root-square :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x ->
      multiplyR reals (squareRoot x) (squareRoot x) == x

    exponential-one-series :
      SequentialLimit reals
        (exponentialPartialSum reals (oneR reals))
        exponentialOne

    cosine-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (cosinePartialSum reals x)
        (cosine x)

    half-pi-positive :
      Positive reals halfPi

    cosine-half-pi-zero :
      cosine halfPi == zeroR reals

    half-pi-first-positive-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      Positive reals x ->
      cosine x == zeroR reals ->
      lessOrEqualR reals halfPi x

open StandardStirlingAnalysis

piR :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardStirlingAnalysis reals ->
  R
piR {reals = reals} analysis =
  addR reals (halfPi analysis) (halfPi analysis)

stirlingSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardStirlingAnalysis reals ->
  Nat ->
  R
stirlingSequence {reals = reals} analysis n =
  divideR reals
    (fromNatR reals (factorial n))
    (multiplyR reals
      (squareRoot analysis
        (fromNatR reals ((suc (suc zero)) * n)))
      (powerNatR reals
        (divideR reals
          (fromNatR reals n)
          (exponentialOne analysis))
        n))

tendsto-stirlingSequence-square-root-pi : Set1
tendsto-stirlingSequence-square-root-pi =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardStirlingAnalysis reals) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (stirlingSequence analysis)
    (squareRoot analysis (piR analysis))

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  This assertion expands convergence along the natural numbers into its
  epsilon-threshold form. In SetMM, ! is factorial, _e is Euler's number,
  _pi is pi, and natural numbers are included in the real arithmetic below.
  Thus its sequence is exactly

    n |-> n! / (sqrt(2 n) * (n / e)^n),

  at every positive natural index. At n = 0, Lean's real division gives the
  source sequence value 0, whereas SetMM has ( 1 / 0 ) = (/). This difference
  does not affect convergence: in either epsilon-threshold formulation, any
  cutoff m can be replaced by max(m, 1), after which the sequence terms agree
  exactly. Thus the two convergence statements are bidirectionally equivalent.
  The declaration is the unproved corpus $a statement; this database contains
  no $p proof statement.
$)

thousand-theorems-metamath-Q470877-stirling $a
  |- A. e e. RR
       ( 0 < e ->
         E. m e. NN0
           A. n e. NN0
             ( m <_ n ->
               ( abs `
                 ( ( ( ! ` n ) /
                     ( ( sqrt ` ( 2 x. n ) ) x.
                       ( ( n / _e ) ^ n ) ) )
                   - ( sqrt ` _pi ) ) ) < e ) ) )
$.

title: Q470877_stirling_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q470877
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q470877), "Stirling's theorem": the
% factorial-normalized Stirling sequence converges to the nonnegative square
% root of pi. This file contains no proof.

Q470877_stirling_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  e: real = real_exponential(1)

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  leibniz_partial(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial(count),
          value))

  nonnegative_square_root(x: real): real =
    IF x >= 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (root: real):
          root >= 0 AND root * root = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  stirling_sequence(index: nat): real =
    safe_div(
      factorial(index) :: real,
      nonnegative_square_root(2 * (index :: real))
        * safe_div(index :: real, e) ^ index)

  tendsto_stirling_sequence_sqrt_pi: bool =
    converges_to(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        stirling_sequence(index),
      nonnegative_square_root(pi))
END Q470877_stirling_s_theorem

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q472883
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q472883), "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": Legendre
-- symbols of distinct odd primes, and Jacobi symbols of odd natural numbers, obey
-- the quadratic reciprocity sign law. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic

@[expose] public section

namespace Q472883

/-- The Legendre symbol on a prime modulus, encoded by zero and square status. -/
noncomputable def legendreSymbol (p : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : ℤ :=
  if (a : ZMod p) = 0 then 0
  else @ite ℤ (IsSquare (a : ZMod p)) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 (-1)

/-- The Jacobi symbol as the product over the prime factorization, with multiplicity. -/
noncomputable def jacobiSymbol (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  (b.primeFactorsList.map fun p ↦ legendreSymbol p a).prod

/-- Quadratic reciprocity for Legendre symbols of distinct odd primes. -/
theorem legendre_quadratic_reciprocity_statement {p q : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime]
    (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    legendreSymbol q p * legendreSymbol p q = (-1) ^ (p / 2 * (q / 2)) := sorry

/-- Quadratic reciprocity for Jacobi symbols of odd natural numbers. -/
theorem jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity_statement {a b : ℕ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : Odd b) :
    jacobiSymbol a b = (-1) ^ (a / 2 * (b / 2)) * jacobiSymbol b a := sorry

end Q472883

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q472883
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q472883), "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": the
  Legendre symbols of distinct odd primes and the Jacobi symbols of arbitrary
  odd natural numbers obey the quadratic-reciprocity sign law. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat ZArith ClassicalDescription.

Definition q472883_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (2 <= p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1%nat \/ d = p.

Definition q472883_quadratic_residue (p a : nat) : Prop :=
  exists x : nat,
    Nat.modulo (Nat.mul x x) p = Nat.modulo a p.

Definition q472883_legendre_symbol (p a : nat) : Z :=
  if Nat.eq_dec (Nat.modulo a p) 0%nat then
    0%Z
  else if excluded_middle_informative
            (q472883_quadratic_residue p a) then
    1%Z
  else
    (-1)%Z.

Fixpoint q472883_prime_multiplicity_fuel
    (p n fuel : nat) : nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0%nat => 0%nat
  | S fuel' =>
      if Nat.eq_dec n 0%nat then
        0%nat
      else if Nat.eq_dec (Nat.modulo n p) 0%nat then
        S (q472883_prime_multiplicity_fuel
             p (Nat.div n p) fuel')
      else
        0%nat
  end.

Definition q472883_prime_multiplicity (p n : nat) : nat :=
  q472883_prime_multiplicity_fuel p n n.

Fixpoint q472883_jacobi_product
    (a b bound : nat) : Z :=
  match bound with
  | 0%nat => 1%Z
  | S bound' =>
      (q472883_jacobi_product a b bound' *
       if excluded_middle_informative
            (q472883_prime (S bound')) then
         Z.pow
           (q472883_legendre_symbol (S bound') a)
           (Z.of_nat
             (q472883_prime_multiplicity (S bound') b))
       else
         1%Z)%Z
  end.

Definition q472883_jacobi_symbol (a b : nat) : Z :=
  q472883_jacobi_product a b b.

Definition q472883_odd (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists k : nat, n = (2 * k + 1)%nat.

Theorem q472883_legendre_quadratic_reciprocity :
  forall p q : nat,
    q472883_prime p ->
    q472883_prime q ->
    p <> 2%nat ->
    q <> 2%nat ->
    p <> q ->
    (q472883_legendre_symbol q p *
     q472883_legendre_symbol p q)%Z =
    Z.pow (-1)
      (Z.of_nat
        (Nat.mul (Nat.div p 2%nat) (Nat.div q 2%nat))).
Admitted.

Theorem q472883_jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity :
  forall a b : nat,
    q472883_odd a ->
    q472883_odd b ->
    q472883_jacobi_symbol a b =
    (Z.pow (-1)
       (Z.of_nat
         (Nat.mul (Nat.div a 2%nat) (Nat.div b 2%nat))) *
     q472883_jacobi_symbol b a)%Z.
Admitted.

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q472883
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q472883), "Quadratic reciprocity theorem":
  the Legendre symbols of two distinct odd primes, and more generally the
  Jacobi symbols of two odd natural numbers, differ by the standard
  quadratic-reciprocity sign. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q472883_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q472883_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    2 \<le> p \<and> (\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

definition q472883_legendre_symbol :: "int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "q472883_legendre_symbol a p =
    (if a mod int p = 0 then 0
     else if (\<exists>y::int. y ^ 2 mod int p = a mod int p) then 1
     else -1)"

definition q472883_prime_multiplicity :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q472883_prime_multiplicity p n =
    (if n = 0 then 0 else Max {k::nat. p ^ k dvd n})"

definition q472883_jacobi_symbol :: "int \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> int" where
  "q472883_jacobi_symbol a b =
    (\<Prod>p\<in>{p. p \<le> b \<and> q472883_prime p}.
      q472883_legendre_symbol a p ^ q472883_prime_multiplicity p b)"

theorem legendre_quadratic_reciprocity:
  fixes p q :: nat
  assumes "q472883_prime p"
    and "q472883_prime q"
    and "p \<noteq> 2"
    and "q \<noteq> 2"
    and "p \<noteq> q"
  shows
    "q472883_legendre_symbol (int p) q *
        q472883_legendre_symbol (int q) p =
      (-1 :: int) ^ (p div 2 * (q div 2))"
  sorry

theorem jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity:
  fixes a b :: nat
  assumes "odd a"
    and "odd b"
  shows
    "q472883_jacobi_symbol (int a) b =
      (-1 :: int) ^ (a div 2 * (b div 2)) *
        q472883_jacobi_symbol (int b) a"
  sorry

end

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q472883,
  "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": the Legendre-symbol product formula for
  distinct odd primes and its Jacobi-symbol form for odd natural numbers.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/jacobi.ml";;

let q472883_legendre = new_definition
  `(q472883_legendre:num#num->int)(p,a) = jacobi(a,p)`;;

let Q472883_QUADRATIC_RECIPROCITY_THEOREM =

      prime p /\
      prime q /\
      ~(p = 2) /\
      ~(q = 2) /\
      ~(p = q)
      ==> q472883_legendre(q,p) * q472883_legendre(p,q) =
          --(&1) pow (p DIV 2 * (q DIV 2))) /\
   (!a b:num.
      ODD a /\
      ODD b

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q472883,
;; "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": the Legendre form relates distinct odd
;; primes, and the Jacobi form relates all odd natural numbers by the usual
;; reciprocity sign (-1)^((a/2)*(b/2)), with natural-number division. This
;; file contains no proof.

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q472883, "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": the
-- Legendre symbols of distinct odd primes and Jacobi symbols of odd natural
-- numbers obey the standard quadratic-reciprocity sign law. This file
-- contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _!=_ _divides_
infixl 7 _*Z_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  x == y -> Bottom

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : dividend == divisor * quotient

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : two <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

record Odd (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    half : Nat
    odd-equation : n == two * half + one

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

boolOr : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
boolOr true other =
  true
boolOr false other =
  other

squareCongruent : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Bool
squareCongruent modulus value root =
  natEqual
    (naturalMod (root * root) modulus)
    (naturalMod value modulus)

hasSquareResidueThrough : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Bool
hasSquareResidueThrough modulus value zero =
  squareCongruent modulus value zero
hasSquareResidueThrough modulus value (suc bound) =
  boolOr
    (squareCongruent modulus value (suc bound))
    (hasSquareResidueThrough modulus value bound)

negative : Nat -> Int
negative zero =
  pos zero
negative (suc n) =
  negsuc n

_*Z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m *Z pos n =
  pos (m * n)
pos m *Z negsuc n =
  negative (m * suc n)
negsuc m *Z pos n =
  negative (suc m * n)
negsuc m *Z negsuc n =
  pos (suc m * suc n)

oneZ : Int
oneZ =
  pos one

minusOneZ : Int
minusOneZ =
  negsuc zero

intPower : Int -> Nat -> Int
intPower base zero =
  oneZ
intPower base (suc exponent) =
  base *Z intPower base exponent

legendreSymbol : Nat -> Nat -> Int
legendreSymbol modulus value
  with natEqual (naturalMod value modulus) zero
... | true =
  pos zero
... | false
  with hasSquareResidueThrough modulus value modulus
...   | true =
  oneZ
...   | false =
  minusOneZ

smallestDivisorFrom : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
smallestDivisorFrom value candidate zero =
  value
smallestDivisorFrom value candidate (suc fuel)
  with natEqual (naturalMod value candidate) zero
... | true =
  candidate
... | false =
  smallestDivisorFrom value (suc candidate) fuel

smallestDivisor : Nat -> Nat
smallestDivisor value =
  smallestDivisorFrom value two value

jacobiFactorProduct : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Int
jacobiFactorProduct numerator denominator zero =
  oneZ
jacobiFactorProduct numerator denominator (suc fuel)
  with natEqual denominator zero
... | true =
  oneZ
... | false
  with natEqual denominator one
...   | true =
  oneZ
...   | false =
  legendreSymbol (smallestDivisor denominator) numerator *Z
    jacobiFactorProduct numerator
      (naturalDiv denominator (smallestDivisor denominator))
      fuel

jacobiSymbol : Nat -> Nat -> Int
jacobiSymbol numerator denominator =
  jacobiFactorProduct numerator denominator denominator

quadratic-reciprocity-theorem : Set
quadratic-reciprocity-theorem =
  (p q : Nat) ->
  Prime p ->
  Prime q ->
  p != two ->
  q != two ->
  p != q ->
  legendreSymbol q p *Z legendreSymbol p q
    ==
  intPower minusOneZ
    (naturalDiv p two * naturalDiv q two)

jacobi-quadratic-reciprocity-theorem : Set
jacobi-quadratic-reciprocity-theorem =
  (a b : Nat) ->
  Odd a ->
  Odd b ->
  jacobiSymbol a b
    ==
  intPower minusOneZ
    (naturalDiv a two * naturalDiv b two)
    *Z jacobiSymbol b a

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q472883, "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": the reciprocity laws for Legendre
  symbols of distinct odd primes and for Jacobi symbols of arbitrary odd
  natural numbers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory bagTheory dividesTheory integerTheory primeFactorTheory;

val q472883_legendre_sym_def = Define`
  q472883_legendre_sym (p : num) (a : num) =
    if a MOD p = 0 then (0 : int)
    else if ?x : num. (x EXP 2) MOD p = a MOD p then 1
    else -1`;

val q472883_jacobi_sym_def = Define`
  q472883_jacobi_sym (a : num) (b : num) =
    if b = 0 then (1 : int)
    else
      ITBAG
        (\p acc. q472883_legendre_sym p a * acc)
        (PRIME_FACTORS b)
        1`;

val q472883_legendre_quadratic_reciprocity =
  ``!(p : num) (q : num).
      prime p /\
      prime q /\
      ~(p = 2) /\
      ~(q = 2) /\
      ~(p = q)
      ==>
      q472883_legendre_sym q p * q472883_legendre_sym p q =
      if EVEN ((p DIV 2) * (q DIV 2))
      then (1 : int)
      else -1``;

val q472883_jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity =
  ``!(a : num) (b : num).
      ODD a /\ ODD b
      ==>
      q472883_jacobi_sym a b =
      (if EVEN ((a DIV 2) * (b DIV 2))
       then (1 : int)
       else -1) *
      q472883_jacobi_sym b a``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q472883
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q472883), "Quadratic reciprocity theorem":
  the Legendre reciprocity law for distinct odd primes and the Jacobi
  reciprocity law for arbitrary odd natural numbers. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's /L is the integer-valued Kronecker symbol. Its restriction to an odd
  prime denominator is the Legendre symbol, and its restriction to a positive
  odd denominator is the Jacobi symbol. Thus the two assertions below encode
  the indexed Lean declarations legendreSym.quadratic_reciprocity and
  jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity.

  Prime \ { 2 } gives exactly the Legendre theorem's odd-prime assumptions.
  The Jacobi theorem ranges over NN and assumes only membership in Odd; it
  has no primality, distinctness, or coprimality assumption. For every
  positive odd natural n, Lean's natural quotient n / 2 equals the integer
  ( n - 1 ) / 2 used in the SetMM exponents.

  The final declarations are the two unproved corpus $a statements. This
  root artifact contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d p q $.

  thousand-theorems-q472883-quadratic-reciprocity $a |- (
    A. p e. ( Prime \ { 2 } )
      A. q e. ( Prime \ { 2 } )
        (
          p =/= q
          ->
          (
            ( ( q /L p ) x. ( p /L q ) )
            =
            (
              -u 1
              ^
              (
                ( ( p - 1 ) / 2 )
                x.
                ( ( q - 1 ) / 2 )
              )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a b $.

  thousand-theorems-q472883-jacobi-quadratic-reciprocity $a |- (
    A. a e. NN
      A. b e. NN
        (
          (
            a e. Odd
            /\
            b e. Odd
          )
          ->
          (
            ( a /L b )
            =
            (
              (
                -u 1
                ^
                (
                  ( ( a - 1 ) / 2 )
                  x.
                  ( ( b - 1 ) / 2 )
                )
              )
              x.
              ( b /L a )
            )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q472883,
% "Quadratic reciprocity theorem": Legendre symbols of distinct odd primes and
% Jacobi symbols of odd natural numbers satisfy the quadratic reciprocity sign
% law. This file contains no proof.

Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  nat_congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) = (modulus :: int) * offset

  quadratic_residue(numerator, prime: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (root: nat):
      nat_congruent(root ^ 2, numerator, prime)

  legendre_symbol(numerator, prime: nat): int =
    IF nat_divides(prime, numerator) THEN
      0
    ELSIF quadratic_residue(numerator, prime) THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -1
    ENDIF

  int_power(base: int, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      base * int_power(base, exponent - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  nat_quotient(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      ndiv(numerator, denominator)
    ENDIF

  prime_multiplicity(
      prime, value, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR prime < 2
        OR NOT nat_divides(prime, value) THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1 + prime_multiplicity(
        prime,
        nat_quotient(value, prime),
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  jacobi_product(
      numerator, denominator, bound: nat): RECURSIVE int =
    IF bound < 2 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      jacobi_product(numerator, denominator, bound - 1)
        * IF prime_nat(bound) THEN
            int_power(
              legendre_symbol(numerator, bound),
              prime_multiplicity(
                bound,
                denominator,
                denominator + 1))
          ELSE
            1
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE bound

  jacobi_symbol(numerator, denominator: nat): int =
    jacobi_product(numerator, denominator, denominator)

  odd_nat(value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (half: nat):
      value = 2 * half + 1

  legendre_quadratic_reciprocity: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: nat):
      (prime_nat(p)
        AND prime_nat(q)
        AND p /= 2
        AND q /= 2
        AND p /= q)
      IMPLIES
        legendre_symbol(p, q) * legendre_symbol(q, p)
          = int_power(-1, ndiv(p, 2) * ndiv(q, 2))

  jacobi_quadratic_reciprocity: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: nat):
      (odd_nat(a) AND odd_nat(b))
        IMPLIES
          jacobi_symbol(a, b)
            = int_power(-1, ndiv(a, 2) * ndiv(b, 2))
                * jacobi_symbol(b, a)

END Q472883_quadratic_reciprocity_theorem

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q474881,
;; "Cantor's theorem": for every function from an arbitrary carrier to its
;; full powerset, the complemented diagonal subset has no preimage, so the
;; function is not surjective. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; These conservative interfaces represent an arbitrary type by its carrier
;; predicate and an arbitrary function into its powerset by the binary
;; membership relation SOURCE |-> {ELEMENT | Q474881-IMAGE-MEMBERSHIP holds}.

(defstub q474881-carrier-p (element) t)

(defstub q474881-image-membership (source element) t)

(defun q474881-member-p (element)
  (if (q474881-carrier-p element)
      t
    nil))

(defun q474881-image-member-p (source element)
  (if (q474881-image-membership source element)
      t
    nil))

;; This is the subset {ELEMENT in alpha | ELEMENT is not in f(ELEMENT)}.

(defun q474881-diagonal-member-p (element)
  (and
   (q474881-member-p element)
   (not (q474881-image-member-p element element))))

;; A source maps to the diagonal exactly when its image row and the diagonal
;; have the same membership truth value at every element of the carrier.

(defun-sk q474881-row-equals-diagonal-p (source)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q474881-member-p element)
     (equal
      (q474881-image-member-p source element)
      (q474881-diagonal-member-p element)))))

;; Every source in the carrier fails that equality (at ELEMENT = SOURCE);
;; hence the diagonal subset has no preimage and the map is not surjective.

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q474881-cantor-surjective-statement ()
  (forall (source)
    (implies
     (q474881-member-p source)
     (not (q474881-row-equals-diagonal-p source)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

module Q474881_cantor_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

Powerset :
  {a : Level} ->
  (p : Level) ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a lmax lsuc p)
Powerset p X =
  X -> Set p

record LogicalEquivalence
  {a b : Level}
  (left : Set a)
  (right : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor logically-equivalent
  field
    forward : left -> right
    backward : right -> left

SameSubset :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Powerset p X ->
  Powerset p X ->
  Set (a lmax p)
SameSubset {X = X} left right =
  (x : X) ->
  LogicalEquivalence
    (left x)
    (right x)

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q476776
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q476776), "Solutions of a general quartic equation":
-- over a field with invertible 2, Ferrari's auxiliary quantities, including a root
-- of the cubic resolvent, characterize the roots of a quartic when `q` is nonzero.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Basic
public import Mathlib.Algebra.GroupWithZero.Invertible

@[expose] public section

namespace Theorems100

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] (a b c d e : K) {p q r s u v w : K}
variable [Invertible (2 : K)]

/-- The roots of a quartic polynomial when the Ferrari parameter `q` is nonzero. -/
theorem quartic_eq_zero_iff (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hp : p = (8 * a * c - 3 * b ^ 2) / (8 * a ^ 2))
    (hq : q = (b ^ 3 - 4 * a * b * c + 8 * a ^ 2 * d) / (8 * a ^ 3))
    (hq_nonzero : q ≠ 0)
    (hr : r =
      (16 * a * b ^ 2 * c + 256 * a ^ 3 * e - 3 * b ^ 4 - 64 * a ^ 2 * b * d) /
        (256 * a ^ 4))
    (hu : u ^ 3 - p * u ^ 2 - 4 * r * u + 4 * p * r - q ^ 2 = 0)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = u - p)
    (hv : v ^ 2 = 4 * s ^ 2 - 8 * (u - q / s))
    (hw : w ^ 2 = 4 * s ^ 2 - 8 * (u + q / s)) (x : K) :
    a * x ^ 4 + b * x ^ 3 + c * x ^ 2 + d * x + e = 0 ↔
      x = (-2 * s - v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) ∨
        x = (-2 * s + v) / 4 - b / (4 * a) ∨
          x = (2 * s - w) / 4 - b / (4 * a) ∨
            x = (2 * s + w) / 4 - b / (4 * a) := sorry

end Theorems100

title: Q476776_solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q476776
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q476776), "Solutions of a general quartic equation":
  over a field where 2 is invertible, the roots of a quartic with nonzero
  depressed-quartic linear coefficient are exactly the four stated expressions
  determined by a root of its cubic resolvent. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q476776_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q476776_zero : K;
  q476776_one : K;
  q476776_add : K -> K -> K;
  q476776_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q476776_neg : K -> K;
  q476776_inv : K -> K;
  q476776_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q476776_add x (q476776_add y z) =
      q476776_add (q476776_add x y) z;
  q476776_add_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q476776_add x y = q476776_add y x;
  q476776_add_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q476776_add x q476776_zero = x;
  q476776_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q476776_add x (q476776_neg x) = q476776_zero;
  q476776_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q476776_mul x (q476776_mul y z) =
      q476776_mul (q476776_mul x y) z;
  q476776_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q476776_mul x y = q476776_mul y x;
  q476776_mul_one :
    forall x : K,
      q476776_mul x q476776_one = x;
  q476776_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q476776_mul x (q476776_add y z) =
      q476776_add
        (q476776_mul x y)
        (q476776_mul x z);
  q476776_inv_zero :
    q476776_inv q476776_zero = q476776_zero;
  q476776_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q476776_zero ->
      q476776_mul x (q476776_inv x) = q476776_one;
  q476776_nontrivial :
    q476776_zero <> q476776_one
}.

Arguments q476776_zero {K} _.
Arguments q476776_one {K} _.
Arguments q476776_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q476776_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q476776_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q476776_inv {K} _ _.

Definition q476776_sub
    {K : Type} (F : q476776_field K) (x y : K) : K :=
  q476776_add F x (q476776_neg F y).

Definition q476776_div
    {K : Type} (F : q476776_field K) (x y : K) : K :=
  q476776_mul F x (q476776_inv F y).

Fixpoint q476776_pow
    {K : Type} (F : q476776_field K) (x : K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q476776_one F
  | S m => q476776_mul F x (q476776_pow F x m)
  end.

Fixpoint q476776_of_nat
    {K : Type} (F : q476776_field K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q476776_zero F
  | S m => q476776_add F (q476776_of_nat F m) (q476776_one F)
  end.

Definition q476776_invertible
    {K : Type} (F : q476776_field K) (x : K) : Prop :=
  exists y : K,
    q476776_mul F x y = q476776_one F.

Module Theorems100.

Theorem quartic_eq_zero_iff :
  forall
    (K : Type)
    (F : q476776_field K)
    (a b c d e p q r s u v w x : K),
    q476776_invertible F (q476776_of_nat F 2) ->
    a <> q476776_zero F ->
    p =
      q476776_div F
        (q476776_sub F
          (q476776_mul F
            (q476776_mul F (q476776_of_nat F 8) a) c)
          (q476776_mul F
            (q476776_of_nat F 3)
            (q476776_pow F b 2)))
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_of_nat F 8)
          (q476776_pow F a 2)) ->
    q =
      q476776_div F
        (q476776_add F
          (q476776_sub F
            (q476776_pow F b 3)
            (q476776_mul F
              (q476776_mul F
                (q476776_mul F (q476776_of_nat F 4) a) b)
              c))
          (q476776_mul F
            (q476776_mul F
              (q476776_of_nat F 8)
              (q476776_pow F a 2))
            d))
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_of_nat F 8)
          (q476776_pow F a 3)) ->
    q <> q476776_zero F ->
    r =
      q476776_div F
        (q476776_sub F
          (q476776_sub F
            (q476776_add F
              (q476776_mul F
                (q476776_mul F
                  (q476776_mul F
                    (q476776_of_nat F 16)
                    a)
                  (q476776_pow F b 2))
                c)
              (q476776_mul F
                (q476776_mul F
                  (q476776_of_nat F 256)
                  (q476776_pow F a 3))
                e))
            (q476776_mul F
              (q476776_of_nat F 3)
              (q476776_pow F b 4)))
          (q476776_mul F
            (q476776_mul F
              (q476776_mul F
                (q476776_of_nat F 64)
                (q476776_pow F a 2))
              b)
            d))
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_of_nat F 256)
          (q476776_pow F a 4)) ->
    q476776_sub F
      (q476776_add F
        (q476776_sub F
          (q476776_sub F
            (q476776_pow F u 3)
            (q476776_mul F p (q476776_pow F u 2)))
          (q476776_mul F
            (q476776_mul F (q476776_of_nat F 4) r)
            u))
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_mul F (q476776_of_nat F 4) p)
          r))
      (q476776_pow F q 2) =
      q476776_zero F ->
    q476776_pow F s 2 = q476776_sub F u p ->
    q476776_pow F v 2 =
      q476776_sub F
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_of_nat F 4)
          (q476776_pow F s 2))
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_of_nat F 8)
          (q476776_sub F u (q476776_div F q s))) ->
    q476776_pow F w 2 =

          (q476776_of_nat F 4)
          (q476776_pow F s 2))
        (q476776_mul F
          (q476776_of_nat F 8)
          (q476776_add F u (q476776_div F q s))) ->
    (q476776_add F
      (q476776_add F
        (q476776_add F
          (q476776_add F

            (q476776_mul F b (q476776_pow F x 3)))
          (q476776_mul F c (q476776_pow F x 2)))
        (q476776_mul F d x))

               (q476776_neg F (q476776_of_nat F 2))
               s)
             v)
           (q476776_of_nat F 4))
         (q476776_div F b
           (q476776_mul F (q476776_of_nat F 4) a))
     \/
     x =
       q476776_sub F
         (q476776_div F
           (q476776_add F

               s)
             v)
           (q476776_of_nat F 4))
         (q476776_div F b
           (q476776_mul F (q476776_of_nat F 4) a))

  2 is invertible, the stated cubic-resolvent and square-root data characterize
  exactly the four roots of a general quartic. This file contains no proof.

let Q476776_QUARTIC_EQ_ZERO_IFF =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroA:A) (oneA:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (neg:A->A) (invA:A->A).
       ~(zeroA = oneA) /\
       (!u. add zeroA u = u) /\
       (!u. add (neg u) u = zeroA) /\
       (!u v. add u v = add v u) /\
       (!u v w. add u (add v w) = add (add u v) w) /\
       (!u. mul oneA u = u) /\
       (!u v. mul u v = mul v u) /\
       (!u v w. mul u (mul v w) = mul (mul u v) w) /\
       (!u v w. mul u (add v w) =
                add (mul u v) (mul u w)) /\
       invA zeroA = zeroA /\
       (!u. ~(u = zeroA) ==> mul (invA u) u = oneA) in
   !zeroA oneA:A. !add mul:A->A->A. !neg invA:A->A.
   !a b c d e p q r s u v w x:A.
     let power =
       \z:A. \n:num. ITLIST mul (REPLICATE n z) oneA in
     let sub =
       \z:A. \y:A. add z (neg y) in
     let divide =
       \z:A. \y:A. mul z (invA y) in
     let two = add oneA oneA in
     let three = add two oneA in
     let four = mul two two in
     let eight = mul four two in
     let sixteen = mul four four in
     let sixtyfour = mul eight eight in
     let twohundredfiftysix = mul sixteen sixteen in
     is_field zeroA oneA add mul neg invA /\
     ~(two = zeroA) /\
     ~(a = zeroA) /\
     p =
       divide
         (sub
           (mul (mul eight a) c)
           (mul three (power b 2)))
         (mul eight (power a 2)) /\
     q =
       divide
         (add
           (sub
             (power b 3)
             (mul (mul (mul four a) b) c))
           (mul (mul eight (power a 2)) d))
         (mul eight (power a 3)) /\
     ~(q = zeroA) /\
     r =
       divide
         (sub
           (sub
             (add
               (mul (mul (mul sixteen a) (power b 2)) c)
               (mul (mul twohundredfiftysix (power a 3)) e))
             (mul three (power b 4)))
           (mul (mul (mul sixtyfour (power a 2)) b) d))
         (mul twohundredfiftysix (power a 4)) /\
     sub
       (add
         (sub
           (sub
             (power u 3)
             (mul p (power u 2)))
           (mul (mul four r) u))
         (mul (mul four p) r))
       (power q 2) = zeroA /\
     power s 2 = sub u p /\
     power v 2 =
       sub
         (mul four (power s 2))
         (mul eight (sub u (divide q s))) /\
     power w 2 =
       sub
         (mul four (power s 2))
         (mul eight (add u (divide q s)))
     ==>

        (add
          (add
            (add
              (mul a (power x 4))
              (mul b (power x 3)))
            (mul c (power x 2)))
          (mul d x))
        e = zeroA
      <=>
      x =
        sub
          (divide
            (sub (neg (mul two s)) v)
            four)
          (divide b (mul four a)) \/
      x =
        sub
          (divide
            (add (neg (mul two s)) v)
            four)
          (divide b (mul four a)) \/
      x =
        sub
          (divide
            (sub (mul two s) w)
            four)
          (divide b (mul four a)) \/
      x =

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q476776,
;; "Solutions of a general quartic equation": Ferrari's characterization of
;; the four roots of a quartic over an arbitrary field with invertible 2,
;; using a nonzero depressed linear coefficient and a cubic-resolvent root.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative function symbols present an arbitrary, potentially infinite
;; field indexed by FIELD. The declarations supply no laws; every field axiom
;; used by the source statement is explicit in Q476776-FIELD-P.

(defstub q476776-element-p (field value) t)
(defstub q476776-zero (field) t)
(defstub q476776-one (field) t)
(defstub q476776-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q476776-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q476776-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q476776-inverse (field value) t)

(defun-sk q476776-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q476776-element-p field x)
      (q476776-element-p field y)
      (q476776-element-p field z))
     (let* ((zero (q476776-zero field))
            (one (q476776-one field))
            (x-plus-y (q476776-add field x y))
            (y-plus-z (q476776-add field y z))
            (x-times-y (q476776-multiply field x y))
            (y-times-z (q476776-multiply field y z))
            (negative-x (q476776-negate field x))
            (inverse-x (q476776-inverse field x)))
       (and
        (q476776-element-p field x-plus-y)
        (q476776-element-p field x-times-y)
        (q476776-element-p field negative-x)
        (q476776-element-p field inverse-x)
        (equal
         (q476776-add field x-plus-y z)
         (q476776-add field x y-plus-z))
        (equal x-plus-y (q476776-add field y x))
        (equal (q476776-add field x zero) x)
        (equal (q476776-add field x negative-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q476776-multiply field x-times-y z)
         (q476776-multiply field x y-times-z))
        (equal x-times-y (q476776-multiply field y x))
        (equal (q476776-multiply field x one) x)
        (implies
         (equal x zero)
         (equal inverse-x zero))
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q476776-multiply field x inverse-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q476776-multiply field x y-plus-z)
         (q476776-add
          field
          (q476776-multiply field x y)
          (q476776-multiply field x z))))))))

(defun q476776-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q476776-element-p field (q476776-zero field))
   (q476776-element-p field (q476776-one field))
   (not
    (equal
     (q476776-zero field)
     (q476776-one field)))
   (q476776-field-laws-p field)))

(defun q476776-subtract (field left right)
  (q476776-add
   field
   left
   (q476776-negate field right)))

(defun q476776-divide (field numerator denominator)
  (q476776-multiply
   field
   numerator
   (q476776-inverse field denominator)))

(defun q476776-nat (field number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix number)))
  (if (zp number)
      (q476776-zero field)
    (q476776-add
     field
     (q476776-one field)
     (q476776-nat field (- number 1)))))

(defun q476776-power (field base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q476776-one field)
