title: Q476776_solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q476776,
-- "Solutions of a general quartic equation": Ferrari's four-root characterization
-- over an arbitrary field in which two is invertible. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q476776_solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _iff_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : P -> P or Q
  right : Q -> P or Q

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : P -> Q
    backward : Q -> P

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroF oneF : K
    addF multiplyF : K -> K -> K
    negateF inverseF : K -> K

    one-not-zero :
      oneF != zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addF x y == addF y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addF (addF x y) z == addF x (addF y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addF x zeroF == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addF x (negateF x) == zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyF x y == multiplyF y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyF (multiplyF x y) z ==
      multiplyF x (multiplyF y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyF x oneF == x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyF x zeroF == zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyF x (addF y z) ==
      addF (multiplyF x y) (multiplyF x z)

    inverse-zero :
      inverseF zeroF == zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x != zeroF ->
      multiplyF x (inverseF x) == oneF

open Field

subtractF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
subtractF fieldStructure x y =
  addF fieldStructure x (negateF fieldStructure y)

divideF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
divideF fieldStructure x y =
  multiplyF fieldStructure x (inverseF fieldStructure y)

fromNatF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  Nat ->
  K
fromNatF fieldStructure zero =
  zeroF fieldStructure
fromNatF fieldStructure (suc n) =
  addF fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure n) (oneF fieldStructure)

powerF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  Nat ->
  K
powerF fieldStructure x zero =
  oneF fieldStructure
powerF fieldStructure x (suc n) =
  multiplyF fieldStructure (powerF fieldStructure x n) x

scaleF :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  Nat ->
  K ->
  K
scaleF fieldStructure n x =
  multiplyF fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure n) x

product3F :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
product3F fieldStructure x y z =
  multiplyF fieldStructure (multiplyF fieldStructure x y) z

twoN : Nat
twoN =
  suc (suc zero)

threeN : Nat
threeN =
  suc twoN

fourN : Nat
fourN =
  twoN * twoN

eightN : Nat
eightN =
  twoN * fourN

sixteenN : Nat
sixteenN =
  fourN * fourN

sixtyFourN : Nat
sixtyFourN =
  fourN * sixteenN

twoHundredFiftySixN : Nat
twoHundredFiftySixN =
  sixteenN * sixteenN

record Invertible
  {a : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  (fieldStructure : Field K)
  (x : K) :
  Set a where

  field
    inverse-value : K
    inverse-times-value :
      multiplyF fieldStructure inverse-value x == oneF fieldStructure

quarticPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
quarticPolynomial fieldStructure a b c d e x =
  addF fieldStructure
    (addF fieldStructure
      (addF fieldStructure
        (addF fieldStructure
          (multiplyF fieldStructure a (powerF fieldStructure x fourN))
          (multiplyF fieldStructure b (powerF fieldStructure x threeN)))
        (multiplyF fieldStructure c (powerF fieldStructure x twoN)))
      (multiplyF fieldStructure d x))
    e

pValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
pValue fieldStructure a b c =
  divideF fieldStructure
    (subtractF fieldStructure
      (scaleF fieldStructure eightN (multiplyF fieldStructure a c))
      (scaleF fieldStructure threeN (powerF fieldStructure b twoN)))
    (scaleF fieldStructure eightN (powerF fieldStructure a twoN))

qNumerator :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
qNumerator fieldStructure a b c d =
  addF fieldStructure
    (subtractF fieldStructure
      (powerF fieldStructure b threeN)
      (scaleF fieldStructure fourN (product3F fieldStructure a b c)))
    (scaleF fieldStructure eightN
      (multiplyF fieldStructure (powerF fieldStructure a twoN) d))

qValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
qValue fieldStructure a b c d =
  divideF fieldStructure
    (qNumerator fieldStructure a b c d)
    (scaleF fieldStructure eightN (powerF fieldStructure a threeN))

rValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
rValue fieldStructure a b c d e =
  divideF fieldStructure
    (subtractF fieldStructure
      (subtractF fieldStructure
        (addF fieldStructure
          (scaleF fieldStructure sixteenN
            (product3F fieldStructure a (powerF fieldStructure b twoN) c))
          (scaleF fieldStructure twoHundredFiftySixN
            (multiplyF fieldStructure (powerF fieldStructure a threeN) e)))
        (scaleF fieldStructure threeN (powerF fieldStructure b fourN)))
      (scaleF fieldStructure sixtyFourN
        (product3F fieldStructure
          (powerF fieldStructure a twoN) b d)))
    (scaleF fieldStructure twoHundredFiftySixN
      (powerF fieldStructure a fourN))

resolventValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
resolventValue fieldStructure p q r u =
  subtractF fieldStructure
    (addF fieldStructure
      (subtractF fieldStructure
        (subtractF fieldStructure
          (powerF fieldStructure u threeN)
          (multiplyF fieldStructure p (powerF fieldStructure u twoN)))
        (scaleF fieldStructure fourN (multiplyF fieldStructure r u)))
      (scaleF fieldStructure fourN (multiplyF fieldStructure p r)))
    (powerF fieldStructure q twoN)

quarticOffset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
quarticOffset fieldStructure a b =
  divideF fieldStructure b (scaleF fieldStructure fourN a)

rootOne :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
rootOne fieldStructure a b s v =
  subtractF fieldStructure
    (divideF fieldStructure
      (subtractF fieldStructure
        (negateF fieldStructure (scaleF fieldStructure twoN s))
        v)
      (fromNatF fieldStructure fourN))
    (quarticOffset fieldStructure a b)

rootTwo :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
rootTwo fieldStructure a b s v =
  subtractF fieldStructure
    (divideF fieldStructure
      (addF fieldStructure
        (negateF fieldStructure (scaleF fieldStructure twoN s))
        v)
      (fromNatF fieldStructure fourN))
    (quarticOffset fieldStructure a b)

rootThree :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
rootThree fieldStructure a b s w =
  subtractF fieldStructure
    (divideF fieldStructure
      (subtractF fieldStructure (scaleF fieldStructure twoN s) w)
      (fromNatF fieldStructure fourN))
    (quarticOffset fieldStructure a b)

rootFour :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
rootFour fieldStructure a b s w =
  subtractF fieldStructure
    (divideF fieldStructure
      (addF fieldStructure (scaleF fieldStructure twoN s) w)
      (fromNatF fieldStructure fourN))
    (quarticOffset fieldStructure a b)

solutions-of-a-general-quartic-equation :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
solutions-of-a-general-quartic-equation a =
  (K : Set a) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  (two-invertible :
    Invertible fieldStructure (fromNatF fieldStructure twoN)) ->
  (a b c d e p q r u s v w x : K) ->
  a != zeroF fieldStructure ->
  p == pValue fieldStructure a b c ->
  q == qValue fieldStructure a b c d ->
  q != zeroF fieldStructure ->
  r == rValue fieldStructure a b c d e ->
  resolventValue fieldStructure p q r u == zeroF fieldStructure ->
  powerF fieldStructure s twoN ==
    subtractF fieldStructure u p ->
  powerF fieldStructure v twoN ==
    subtractF fieldStructure
      (scaleF fieldStructure fourN (powerF fieldStructure s twoN))
      (scaleF fieldStructure eightN
        (subtractF fieldStructure u (divideF fieldStructure q s))) ->
  powerF fieldStructure w twoN ==
    subtractF fieldStructure
      (scaleF fieldStructure fourN (powerF fieldStructure s twoN))
      (scaleF fieldStructure eightN
        (addF fieldStructure u (divideF fieldStructure q s))) ->
  (quarticPolynomial fieldStructure a b c d e x == zeroF fieldStructure)
  iff
  ((x == rootOne fieldStructure a b s v)
    or
    (x == rootTwo fieldStructure a b s v)
    or
    (x == rootThree fieldStructure a b s w)
    or
    (x == rootFour fieldStructure a b s w))

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q476776, "Solutions of a general quartic equation": the four-root
  characterization over an arbitrary field in which 2 is invertible, using a
  root of the cubic resolvent and the specified square roots. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory;

val q476776_field_def = new_definition (
  "q476776_field_def",
  ``q476776_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zeroK x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zeroK) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneK x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!x. x <> zeroK ==> mul (invK x) x = oneK)``);

val q476776_numeral_def = new_definition (
  "q476776_numeral_def",
  ``q476776_numeral
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (add oneK) n zeroK``);

val q476776_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q476776_pow_def",
  ``q476776_pow
      (oneK : 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (x : 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (mul x) n oneK``);

val q476776_sub_def = new_definition (
  "q476776_sub_def",
  ``q476776_sub
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (neg : 'k -> 'k) (x : 'k) y =
      add x (neg y)``);

val q476776_div_def = new_definition (
  "q476776_div_def",
  ``q476776_div
      (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) (x : 'k) y =
      mul x (invK y)``);

val Theorems100_quartic_eq_zero_iff =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) oneK
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (a : 'k) b c d e p q r s u v w x.
      q476776_field zeroK oneK add mul neg invK /\
      q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 2 <> zeroK /\
      a <> zeroK /\
      p =
        q476776_div mul invK
          (q476776_sub add neg
            (mul
              (mul
                (q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 8)
                a)
              c)
            (mul
              (q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 3)
              (q476776_pow oneK mul b 2)))
          (mul
            (q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 8)
            (q476776_pow oneK mul a 2)) /\
      q =
        q476776_div mul invK
          (add
            (q476776_sub add neg
              (q476776_pow oneK mul b 3)
              (mul
                (mul
                  (mul
                    (q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 4)
                    a)
                  b)
                c))
            (mul
              (mul
                (q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 8)
                (q476776_pow oneK mul a 2))
              d))
          (mul
            (q476776_numeral zeroK oneK add 8)
            (q476776_pow oneK mul a 3)) /\
      q <> zeroK /\
      r =
        q476776_div mul invK
          (q476776_sub add neg
            (q476776_sub add neg

environ

    SUBSET_1, ARYTM_1, XXREAL_0, INT_2, NAT_1, SUPINF_2, MESFUNC1,

    BINOP_1, DOMAIN_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, NAT_1,
    INT_1, INT_2, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1,
    VECTSP_2, NEWTON;
  constructors NAT_D, PEPIN, EUCLID, REALSET1, RELSET_1, BINOP_2,
    DOMAIN_1, BINOP_1, VECTSP_1, VECTSP_2, NEWTON;
  registrations STRUCT_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1, INT_1, RELAT_1, VECTSP_1,
    INT_3, SUBSET_1, XBOOLE_0, NEWTON;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  equalities ALGSTR_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      a,b,c,d,e,p,q,r,s,u,v,w,x being Element of K st
    1.K + 1.K <> 0.K &
    a <> 0.K &
    p = ((1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * a * c -
      (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (b * b)) /
      ((1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (a * a)) &
    q = (b * b * b -
      (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * a * b * c +
      (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (a * a) * d) /
      ((1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (a * a * a)) &
    q <> 0.K &
    r = ((1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K) * a * (b * b) * c +
      (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (a * a * a) * e -
      (1.K + 1.K + 1.K) * (b * b * b * b) -
      (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (a * a) * b * d) /
      ((1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) *
        (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (a * a * a * a)) &

      (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * r * u +
      (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * p * r - q * q = 0.K &
    s * s = u - p &
    v * v = (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (s * s) -

    w * w = (1.K + 1.K) * (1.K + 1.K) * (s * s) -

  holds
    (a * (x * x * x * x) + b * (x * x * x) + c * (x * x) +
        d * x + e = 0.K iff
      x = (-((1.K + 1.K) * s) - v) /

title: Q476776_solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q476776,
% "Solutions of a general quartic equation": over an arbitrary field of
% characteristic not 2, Ferrari resolvent and square-root data characterize
% exactly the four roots of a general quartic. This file contains no proof.

Q476776_solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation[
  K: TYPE+,
  zero, one: K,
  add, mul: [K, K -> K],
  neg, inv: [K -> K]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  sub(x, y: K): K = add(x, neg(y))

  divide(x, y: K): K = mul(x, inv(y))

  of_nat(value: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      add(of_nat(value - 1), one)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  power(x: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      mul(power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  field_laws: bool =
    zero /= one
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      add(x, zero) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      add(x, neg(x)) = zero)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: K):
      mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      mul(x, one) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: K):
      mul(x, add(y, z)) = add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND inv(zero) = zero
      AND
    (FORALL (x: K):
      x /= zero IMPLIES mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  quartic_value(a, b, c, d, e, x: K): K =
    add(
      add(
        add(
          add(
            mul(a, power(x, 4)),
            mul(b, power(x, 3))),
          mul(c, power(x, 2))),
        mul(d, x)),
      e)

  ferrari_p(a, b, c: K): K =
    divide(
      sub(
        mul(mul(of_nat(8), a), c),
        mul(of_nat(3), power(b, 2))),
      mul(of_nat(8), power(a, 2)))

  ferrari_q(a, b, c, d: K): K =
    divide(
      add(
        sub(
          power(b, 3),
          mul(mul(mul(of_nat(4), a), b), c)),
        mul(mul(of_nat(8), power(a, 2)), d)),
      mul(of_nat(8), power(a, 3)))

  ferrari_r(a, b, c, d, e: K): K =
    divide(
      sub(
        sub(
          add(
            mul(mul(mul(of_nat(16), a), power(b, 2)), c),
            mul(mul(of_nat(256), power(a, 3)), e)),
          mul(of_nat(3), power(b, 4))),
        mul(mul(mul(of_nat(64), power(a, 2)), b), d)),
      mul(of_nat(256), power(a, 4)))

  cubic_resolvent_value(p, q, r, u: K): K =
    sub(
      add(
        sub(
          sub(
            power(u, 3),
            mul(p, power(u, 2))),
          mul(mul(of_nat(4), r), u)),
        mul(mul(of_nat(4), p), r)),
      power(q, 2))

  depression_shift(a, b: K): K =
    divide(b, mul(of_nat(4), a))

  first_root(a, b, s, v: K): K =
    sub(
      divide(
        sub(neg(mul(of_nat(2), s)), v),
        of_nat(4)),
      depression_shift(a, b))

  second_root(a, b, s, v: K): K =
    sub(
      divide(
        add(neg(mul(of_nat(2), s)), v),
        of_nat(4)),
      depression_shift(a, b))

  third_root(a, b, s, w: K): K =
    sub(
      divide(
        sub(mul(of_nat(2), s), w),
        of_nat(4)),
      depression_shift(a, b))

  fourth_root(a, b, s, w: K): K =
    sub(
      divide(
        add(mul(of_nat(2), s), w),
        of_nat(4)),
      depression_shift(a, b))

  solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation: bool =
    (field_laws
      AND of_nat(2) /= zero)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c, d, e, p, q, r, s, u, v, w, x: K):
        (a /= zero
          AND p = ferrari_p(a, b, c)
          AND q = ferrari_q(a, b, c, d)
          AND q /= zero
          AND r = ferrari_r(a, b, c, d, e)
          AND cubic_resolvent_value(p, q, r, u) = zero
          AND power(s, 2) = sub(u, p)
          AND power(v, 2) =
            sub(
              mul(of_nat(4), power(s, 2)),
              mul(
                of_nat(8),
                sub(u, divide(q, s))))
          AND power(w, 2) =
            sub(
              mul(of_nat(4), power(s, 2)),
              mul(
                of_nat(8),
                add(u, divide(q, s)))))
        IMPLIES
          ((quartic_value(a, b, c, d, e, x) = zero)
            =
          (x = first_root(a, b, s, v)
            OR x = second_root(a, b, s, v)
            OR x = third_root(a, b, s, w)
            OR x = fourth_root(a, b, s, w))))
END Q476776_solutions_of_a_general_quartic_equation

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4830725
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q4830725), "Ax-Grothendieck theorem": over an
  algebraically closed field with finitely many variables, every injective
  polynomial self-map preserving the zero locus of an ideal is surjective on
  that zero locus. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Bool.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Import ListNotations.

Record q4830725_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q4830725_zero : K;
  q4830725_one : K;
  q4830725_add : K -> K -> K;
  q4830725_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q4830725_neg : K -> K;
  q4830725_inv : K -> K;
  q4830725_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q4830725_add x (q4830725_add y z) =
      q4830725_add (q4830725_add x y) z;
  q4830725_add_comm :
    forall x y : K, q4830725_add x y = q4830725_add y x;
  q4830725_add_zero :
    forall x : K, q4830725_add x q4830725_zero = x;
  q4830725_add_neg :
    forall x : K, q4830725_add x (q4830725_neg x) = q4830725_zero;
  q4830725_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q4830725_mul x (q4830725_mul y z) =
      q4830725_mul (q4830725_mul x y) z;
  q4830725_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K, q4830725_mul x y = q4830725_mul y x;
  q4830725_mul_one :
    forall x : K, q4830725_mul x q4830725_one = x;
  q4830725_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q4830725_mul x (q4830725_add y z) =
      q4830725_add
        (q4830725_mul x y) (q4830725_mul x z);
  q4830725_mul_inv :
    forall x : K, x <> q4830725_zero ->
      q4830725_mul x (q4830725_inv x) = q4830725_one;
  q4830725_nontrivial : q4830725_zero <> q4830725_one
}.

Arguments q4830725_zero {K} _.
Arguments q4830725_one {K} _.
Arguments q4830725_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q4830725_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q4830725_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q4830725_inv {K} _ _.

Fixpoint q4830725_univariate_eval
    {K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) (x : K) : K :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => q4830725_zero FK
  | c :: rest =>
      q4830725_add FK c
        (q4830725_mul FK x
          (q4830725_univariate_eval FK rest x))
  end.

Fixpoint q4830725_some_nonzero
    {K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => False
  | c :: rest =>
      c <> q4830725_zero FK \/
      q4830725_some_nonzero FK rest
  end.

Definition q4830725_univariate_nonconstant
    {K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (coefficients : list K) : Prop :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => False
  | _ :: positive_degree_coefficients =>
      q4830725_some_nonzero FK positive_degree_coefficients
  end.

Definition q4830725_is_algebraically_closed
    {K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K) : Prop :=
  forall coefficients : list K,
    q4830725_univariate_nonconstant FK coefficients ->
    exists x : K,
      q4830725_univariate_eval FK coefficients x =
      q4830725_zero FK.

Record q4830725_finite_index (Iota : Type) : Type := {
  q4830725_enum : list Iota;
  q4830725_enum_complete :
    forall i : Iota, In i q4830725_enum;
  q4830725_enum_nodup : NoDup q4830725_enum
}.

Arguments q4830725_enum {Iota} _.

Definition q4830725_monomial (Iota : Type) : Type := Iota -> nat.

Fixpoint q4830725_monomial_eqb_on
    {Iota : Type} (indices : list Iota)
    (a b : q4830725_monomial Iota) : bool :=
  match indices with
  | [] => true
  | i :: rest =>
      Nat.eqb (a i) (b i) &&
      q4830725_monomial_eqb_on rest a b
  end.

Definition q4830725_monomial_eqb
    {Iota : Type} (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (a b : q4830725_monomial Iota) : bool :=
  q4830725_monomial_eqb_on (q4830725_enum FI) a b.

Definition q4830725_monomial_zero
    {Iota : Type} : q4830725_monomial Iota :=
  fun _ => 0.

Definition q4830725_monomial_add
    {Iota : Type}
    (a b : q4830725_monomial Iota) : q4830725_monomial Iota :=
  fun i => a i + b i.

Definition q4830725_polynomial (Iota K : Type) : Type :=
  list (q4830725_monomial Iota * K).

Fixpoint q4830725_polynomial_coefficient
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (p : q4830725_polynomial Iota K)
    (m : q4830725_monomial Iota) : K :=
  match p with
  | [] => q4830725_zero FK
  | (n, c) :: rest =>
      if q4830725_monomial_eqb FI n m
      then q4830725_add FK c
        (q4830725_polynomial_coefficient FI FK rest m)
      else q4830725_polynomial_coefficient FI FK rest m
  end.

Definition q4830725_polynomial_equiv
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (p q : q4830725_polynomial Iota K) : Prop :=
  forall m : q4830725_monomial Iota,
    q4830725_polynomial_coefficient FI FK p m =
    q4830725_polynomial_coefficient FI FK q m.

Definition q4830725_polynomial_zero
    {Iota K : Type} : q4830725_polynomial Iota K :=
  [].

Definition q4830725_polynomial_add
    {Iota K : Type}
    (p q : q4830725_polynomial Iota K) :
    q4830725_polynomial Iota K :=
  p ++ q.

Definition q4830725_polynomial_neg
    {Iota K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (p : q4830725_polynomial Iota K) :
    q4830725_polynomial Iota K :=
  map (fun term =>
    (fst term, q4830725_neg FK (snd term))) p.

Definition q4830725_term_mul
    {Iota K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (left right : q4830725_monomial Iota * K) :
    q4830725_monomial Iota * K :=
  (q4830725_monomial_add (fst left) (fst right),
   q4830725_mul FK (snd left) (snd right)).

Definition q4830725_polynomial_mul
    {Iota K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (p q : q4830725_polynomial Iota K) :
    q4830725_polynomial Iota K :=
  flat_map
    (fun left => map (q4830725_term_mul FK left) q) p.

Record q4830725_ideal
    (Iota K : Type)
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K) : Type := {
  q4830725_ideal_mem : q4830725_polynomial Iota K -> Prop;
  q4830725_ideal_respects :
    forall p q : q4830725_polynomial Iota K,
      q4830725_polynomial_equiv FI FK p q ->
      (q4830725_ideal_mem p <-> q4830725_ideal_mem q);
  q4830725_ideal_zero :
    q4830725_ideal_mem q4830725_polynomial_zero;
  q4830725_ideal_add :
    forall p q : q4830725_polynomial Iota K,
      q4830725_ideal_mem p ->
      q4830725_ideal_mem q ->
      q4830725_ideal_mem (q4830725_polynomial_add p q);
  q4830725_ideal_neg :
    forall p : q4830725_polynomial Iota K,
      q4830725_ideal_mem p ->
      q4830725_ideal_mem (q4830725_polynomial_neg FK p);
  q4830725_ideal_mul :
    forall a p : q4830725_polynomial Iota K,
      q4830725_ideal_mem p ->
      q4830725_ideal_mem (q4830725_polynomial_mul FK a p)
}.

Arguments q4830725_ideal_mem {Iota K FI FK} _ _.

Fixpoint q4830725_field_pow
    {K : Type} (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (x : K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q4830725_one FK
  | S exponent =>
      q4830725_mul FK x
        (q4830725_field_pow FK x exponent)
  end.

Fixpoint q4830725_monomial_value_on
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (indices : list Iota)
    (point : Iota -> K)
    (m : q4830725_monomial Iota) : K :=
  match indices with
  | [] => q4830725_one FK
  | i :: rest =>
      q4830725_mul FK
        (q4830725_field_pow FK (point i) (m i))
        (q4830725_monomial_value_on FK rest point m)
  end.

Definition q4830725_monomial_value
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (point : Iota -> K)
    (m : q4830725_monomial Iota) : K :=
  q4830725_monomial_value_on
    FK (q4830725_enum FI) point m.

Fixpoint q4830725_evaluate
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (point : Iota -> K)
    (p : q4830725_polynomial Iota K) : K :=
  match p with
  | [] => q4830725_zero FK
  | (m, c) :: rest =>
      q4830725_add FK
        (q4830725_mul FK c
          (q4830725_monomial_value FI FK point m))
        (q4830725_evaluate FI FK point rest)
  end.

Definition q4830725_zero_locus
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (J : q4830725_ideal FI FK)
    (point : Iota -> K) : Prop :=
  forall p : q4830725_polynomial Iota K,
    q4830725_ideal_mem J p ->
    q4830725_evaluate FI FK point p = q4830725_zero FK.

Definition q4830725_polynomial_map
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (polynomials : Iota -> q4830725_polynomial Iota K)
    (point : Iota -> K) : Iota -> K :=
  fun i => q4830725_evaluate FI FK point (polynomials i).

Definition q4830725_maps_to_zero_locus
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
  (J : q4830725_ideal FI FK)
    (polynomials : Iota -> q4830725_polynomial Iota K) : Prop :=
  forall point : Iota -> K,
    @q4830725_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J point ->
    @q4830725_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J
      (@q4830725_polynomial_map Iota K FI FK polynomials point).

Definition q4830725_injective_on_zero_locus
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (J : q4830725_ideal FI FK)
    (polynomials : Iota -> q4830725_polynomial Iota K) : Prop :=
  forall x y : Iota -> K,
    @q4830725_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J x ->
    @q4830725_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J y ->
    (forall i : Iota,
      @q4830725_polynomial_map Iota K FI FK polynomials x i =
      @q4830725_polynomial_map Iota K FI FK polynomials y i) ->
    forall i : Iota, x i = y i.

Definition q4830725_surjective_on_zero_locus
    {Iota K : Type}
    (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota)
    (FK : q4830725_field K)
    (J : q4830725_ideal FI FK)
    (polynomials : Iota -> q4830725_polynomial Iota K) : Prop :=
  forall y : Iota -> K,
    @q4830725_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J y ->
    exists x : Iota -> K,
      @q4830725_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J x /\
      forall i : Iota,
        @q4830725_polynomial_map Iota K FI FK polynomials x i = y i.

Theorem ax_grothendieck_zeroLocus :
  forall (K Iota : Type)
         (FK : q4830725_field K)
         (FI : q4830725_finite_index Iota),
    q4830725_is_algebraically_closed FK ->
    forall (J : q4830725_ideal FI FK)
           (polynomials : Iota -> q4830725_polynomial Iota K),
      @q4830725_maps_to_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J polynomials ->
      @q4830725_injective_on_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J polynomials ->
      @q4830725_surjective_on_zero_locus Iota K FI FK J polynomials.
Admitted.

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4830725
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q4830725), "Ax-Grothendieck theorem": over an
  algebraically closed field with a finite coordinate carrier, an injective
  polynomial self-map of an ideal's zero locus is surjective on that locus.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly = "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q4830725_monomial_support ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q4830725_monomial_support m = {v. m v \<noteq> 0}"

definition q4830725_polynomial_support ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "q4830725_polynomial_support p = {m. p m \<noteq> 0}"

definition q4830725_is_mpoly_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a::zero) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4830725_is_mpoly_on V p \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite (q4830725_polynomial_support p) \<and>
    (\<forall>m\<in>q4830725_polynomial_support p.
      finite (q4830725_monomial_support m) \<and>
      q4830725_monomial_support m \<subseteq> V)"

definition q4830725_mpoly_zero ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) q4830725_raw_mpoly" where
  "q4830725_mpoly_zero = (\<lambda>_. 0)"

definition q4830725_mpoly_add ::
    "('v, 'a::plus) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly" where
  "q4830725_mpoly_add p q = (\<lambda>m. p m + q m)"

definition q4830725_mpoly_neg ::
    "('v, 'a::uminus) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly" where
  "q4830725_mpoly_neg p = (\<lambda>m. - p m)"

definition q4830725_mpoly_mul ::
    "('v, 'a::comm_semiring_1) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly" where
  "q4830725_mpoly_mul p q =
    (\<lambda>m.
      \<Sum>ab\<in>q4830725_polynomial_support p
          \<times> q4830725_polynomial_support q.
        if m = (\<lambda>v. fst ab v + snd ab v)
        then p (fst ab) * q (snd ab)
        else 0)"

definition q4830725_mpoly_eval ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'a::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q4830725_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q4830725_mpoly_eval x p =
    (\<Sum>m\<in>q4830725_polynomial_support p.
      p m * (\<Prod>v\<in>q4830725_monomial_support m. x v ^ m v))"

definition q4830725_is_ideal_on ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a::comm_ring_1) q4830725_raw_mpoly set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4830725_is_ideal_on V I \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>p\<in>I. q4830725_is_mpoly_on V p) \<and>
    q4830725_mpoly_zero \<in> I \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>I. \<forall>q\<in>I. q4830725_mpoly_add p q \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>p\<in>I. q4830725_mpoly_neg p \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. q4830725_is_mpoly_on V a \<longrightarrow>
      (\<forall>p\<in>I. q4830725_mpoly_mul a p \<in> I))"

definition q4830725_coordinate_space ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'a::zero) set" where
  "q4830725_coordinate_space V = {x. \<forall>i. i \<notin> V \<longrightarrow> x i = 0}"

definition q4830725_zero_locus ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a::comm_semiring_1) q4830725_raw_mpoly set \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'a) set" where
  "q4830725_zero_locus V I =
    {x\<in>q4830725_coordinate_space V.
      \<forall>p\<in>I. q4830725_mpoly_eval x p = 0}"

definition q4830725_poly_map ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a::comm_semiring_1) q4830725_raw_mpoly) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> 'a)" where
  "q4830725_poly_map V p =
    (\<lambda>x i. if i \<in> V then q4830725_mpoly_eval x (p i) else 0)"

definition q4830725_is_algebraically_closed ::
    "'a::field itself \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q4830725_is_algebraically_closed _ \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>c :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a.
      finite {n. c n \<noteq> 0} \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>n>0. c n \<noteq> 0) \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>x. (\<Sum>n\<in>{n. c n \<noteq> 0}. c n * x ^ n) = 0))"

theorem ax_grothendieck_zeroLocus:
  fixes V :: "'i set"
    and I :: "('i, 'K::field) q4830725_raw_mpoly set"
    and p :: "'i \<Rightarrow> ('i, 'K) q4830725_raw_mpoly"
  assumes algebraically_closed:
      "q4830725_is_algebraically_closed (TYPE('K))"
    and finite_coordinates: "finite V"
    and ideal_I: "q4830725_is_ideal_on V I"
    and polynomial_p: "\<forall>i\<in>V. q4830725_is_mpoly_on V (p i)"
  shows
    "let S = q4830725_zero_locus V I;
         F = q4830725_poly_map V p
     in F ` S \<subseteq> S \<longrightarrow>
        inj_on F S \<longrightarrow>
        S \<subseteq> F ` S"
  sorry

end

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4830725
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q4830725), "Ax–Grothendieck theorem": over an
  algebraically closed field, a polynomial self-map of the zero locus of an
  ideal in finitely many variables is surjective there if it maps the locus
  to itself and is injective there. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q4830725_AX_GROTHENDIECK_THEOREM =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x:K. addK zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x:K. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y:K. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x:K. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y:K. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:K.
          mulK x (addK y z) = addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       (!x:K. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK) in
   let power =
     \(oneK:K) (mulK:K->K->K) (x:K) (d:num).
       ITLIST mulK (REPLICATE d x) oneK in
   let is_univariate_polynomial =
     \(zeroK:K) (q:num->K). FINITE {d | ~(q d = zeroK)} in
   let univariate_eval =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (q:num->K) (x:K).
       iterate addK {d | ~(q d = zeroK)}
         (\d. mulK (q d) (power oneK mulK x d)) in
   let is_algebraically_closed =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K).
       !q:num->K.
         is_univariate_polynomial zeroK q /\
         (?d:num. ~(d = 0) /\ ~(q d = zeroK))
         ==> ?x:K.
               univariate_eval zeroK oneK addK mulK q x = zeroK in
   let is_monomial_on =
     \(n:num) (m:num->num).
       !i:num. n <= i ==> m i = 0 in
   let is_mv_polynomial =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (q:(num->num)->K).
       FINITE {m | ~(q m = zeroK)} /\
       (!m:num->num.
          ~(q m = zeroK) ==> is_monomial_on n m) in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(zeroK:K). \(m:num->num). zeroK in
   let polynomial_neg =
     \(negK:K->K) (q:(num->num)->K).
       \m. negK (q m) in
   let polynomial_add =
     \(addK:K->K->K) (q:(num->num)->K) (r:(num->num)->K).
       \m. addK (q m) (r m) in
   let polynomial_mul =
     \(zeroK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (q:(num->num)->K) (r:(num->num)->K).
       \m. iterate addK
             {(u,v) |
                ~(q u = zeroK) /\
                ~(r v = zeroK) /\
                (!i:num. m i = u i + v i)}
             (\(u,v). mulK (q u) (r v)) in
   let is_ideal =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (negK:K->K) (ideal:((num->num)->K)->bool).
       (!q. ideal q ==> is_mv_polynomial n zeroK q) /\
       ideal (polynomial_zero zeroK) /\
       (!q. ideal q ==> ideal (polynomial_neg negK q)) /\
       (!q r.
          ideal q /\ ideal r
          ==> ideal (polynomial_add addK q r)) /\
       (!a q.
          is_mv_polynomial n zeroK a /\ ideal q
          ==> ideal (polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK a q)) in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (oneK:K)
      (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (q:(num->num)->K) (x:num->K).
       iterate addK {m | ~(q m = zeroK)}
         (\m. mulK (q m)
           (iterate mulK {i:num | i < n}
             (\i. power oneK mulK (x i) (m i)))) in
   let canonical_point =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (x:num->K).
       !i:num. n <= i ==> x i = zeroK in
   let zero_locus =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (oneK:K)
      (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (ideal:((num->num)->K)->bool).
       {x:num->K |
          canonical_point n zeroK x /\
          !q. ideal q
              ==> polynomial_eval n zeroK oneK addK mulK q x = zeroK} in
   let polynomial_map =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (oneK:K)
      (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->(num->num)->K) (x:num->K).
       \i. if i < n
           then polynomial_eval n zeroK oneK addK mulK (p i) x
           else zeroK in
   !n:num.
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK invK:K->K.
   !ideal:((num->num)->K)->bool.
   !p:num->(num->num)->K.
     is_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     is_algebraically_closed zeroK oneK addK mulK /\
     is_ideal n zeroK addK mulK negK ideal /\
     (!i:num. i < n ==> is_mv_polynomial n zeroK (p i))
     ==>
     let S = zero_locus n zeroK oneK addK mulK ideal in
     let f = polynomial_map n zeroK oneK addK mulK p in
       (!x. x IN S ==> f x IN S) ==>
       (!x y. x IN S /\ y IN S /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) ==>
       (!y. y IN S ==> ?x. x IN S /\ f x = y)`;;

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4830725,
;; "Ax–Grothendieck theorem": over an algebraically closed field, an injective
;; polynomial self-map of an affine algebraic zero locus is surjective on that
;; zero locus. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; FIELD is an arbitrary field tag.  INDICES is a duplicate-free list
;; presenting an arbitrary finite index type.  Sparse canonical polynomials
;; and coordinate lists then present MvPolynomial INDICES FIELD and
;; INDICES -> FIELD without bounding either the field carrier or its values.

(defstub q4830725-field-member-p (field value) t)
(defstub q4830725-zero (field) t)
(defstub q4830725-one (field) t)
(defstub q4830725-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q4830725-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q4830725-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q4830725-inverse (field value) t)

(defun-sk q4830725-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4830725-field-member-p field x)
      (q4830725-field-member-p field y)
      (q4830725-field-member-p field z))
     (let* ((zero (q4830725-zero field))
            (one (q4830725-one field))
            (xy-add (q4830725-add field x y))
            (yz-add (q4830725-add field y z))
            (xy-mul (q4830725-multiply field x y))
            (yz-mul (q4830725-multiply field y z))
            (neg-x (q4830725-negate field x))
            (inv-x (q4830725-inverse field x)))
       (and
        (q4830725-field-member-p field xy-add)
        (q4830725-field-member-p field xy-mul)
        (q4830725-field-member-p field neg-x)
        (q4830725-field-member-p field inv-x)
        (equal
         (q4830725-add field xy-add z)
         (q4830725-add field x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q4830725-add field y x))
        (equal (q4830725-add field x zero) x)
        (equal (q4830725-add field x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q4830725-multiply field xy-mul z)
         (q4830725-multiply field x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q4830725-multiply field y x))
        (equal (q4830725-multiply field x one) x)
        (equal
         (q4830725-multiply
          field x (q4830725-add field y z))
         (q4830725-add
          field
          (q4830725-multiply field x y)
          (q4830725-multiply field x z)))
        (equal (q4830725-inverse field zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q4830725-multiply field x inv-x)
          one)))))))

(defun q4830725-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q4830725-field-member-p field (q4830725-zero field))
   (q4830725-field-member-p field (q4830725-one field))
   (not (equal (q4830725-zero field)
               (q4830725-one field)))
   (q4830725-field-laws-p field)))

;; Algebraic closedness is the usual assertion that every nonconstant
;; univariate polynomial over the field has a root.

(defun q4830725-field-list-p (field values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q4830725-field-member-p field (car values))
       (q4830725-field-list-p field (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q4830725-univariate-polynomial-p (field coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (consp (cdr coefficients))
   (q4830725-field-list-p field coefficients)
   (not
    (equal
     (car (last coefficients))
     (q4830725-zero field)))))

(defun q4830725-univariate-eval (field coefficients x)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (q4830725-add
       field
       (car coefficients)
       (q4830725-multiply
        field
        x
        (q4830725-univariate-eval
         field (cdr coefficients) x)))
    (q4830725-zero field)))

(defun-sk q4830725-root-exists-p (field coefficients)
  (exists (root)
    (and
     (q4830725-field-member-p field root)
     (equal
      (q4830725-univariate-eval
       field coefficients root)
      (q4830725-zero field)))))

(defun-sk q4830725-algebraically-closed-p (field)
  (forall (coefficients)
    (implies
     (q4830725-univariate-polynomial-p
      field coefficients)
     (q4830725-root-exists-p
      field coefficients))))

(defun q4830725-algebraically-closed-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q4830725-field-p field)
   (q4830725-algebraically-closed-p field)))

;; Canonical sparse multivariate polynomials.  A term is
;; (EXPONENT-VECTOR COEFFICIENT), terms are lexicographically ordered, and
;; zero coefficients are omitted.

(defun q4830725-nat-vector-p (vector length)
  (and
   (true-listp vector)
   (equal (len vector) length)
   (if (consp vector)
       (and
        (natp (car vector))
        (q4830725-nat-vector-p
         (cdr vector) (- length 1)))
     (equal length 0))))

(defun q4830725-exp-less-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (if (< (car left) (car right))
          t
        (and
         (equal (car left) (car right))
         (q4830725-exp-less-p
          (cdr left) (cdr right))))
    nil))

(defun q4830725-polynomial-tail-p
    (field polynomial dimension previous have-previous)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((term (car polynomial)))
        (and
         (true-listp term)
         (equal (len term) 2)
         (q4830725-nat-vector-p
          (car term) dimension)
         (q4830725-field-member-p field (cadr term))
         (not
          (equal (cadr term) (q4830725-zero field)))
         (or
          (not have-previous)
          (q4830725-exp-less-p
           previous (car term)))
         (q4830725-polynomial-tail-p
          field (cdr polynomial) dimension
          (car term) t)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun q4830725-polynomial-p
    (field indices polynomial)
  (and
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (q4830725-polynomial-tail-p
    field polynomial (len indices) nil nil)))

(defun q4830725-poly-add (field left right)
  (declare
   (xargs
    :measure
    (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond
   ((endp left) right)
   ((endp right) left)
   ((equal (caar left) (caar right))
    (let ((coefficient
           (q4830725-add
            field (cadar left) (cadar right))))
      (if (equal coefficient (q4830725-zero field))
          (q4830725-poly-add
           field (cdr left) (cdr right))
        (cons
         (list (caar left) coefficient)
         (q4830725-poly-add
          field (cdr left) (cdr right))))))
   ((q4830725-exp-less-p
     (caar left) (caar right))
    (cons
     (car left)
     (q4830725-poly-add
      field (cdr left) right)))
   (t
    (cons
     (car right)
     (q4830725-poly-add
      field left (cdr right))))))

(defun q4830725-poly-negate (field polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((coefficient
             (q4830725-negate
              field (cadar polynomial))))
        (if (equal coefficient (q4830725-zero field))
            (q4830725-poly-negate
             field (cdr polynomial))
          (cons
           (list (caar polynomial) coefficient)
           (q4830725-poly-negate
            field (cdr polynomial)))))
    nil))

(defun q4830725-exp-add (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (cons
       (+ (car left) (car right))
       (q4830725-exp-add
        (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun q4830725-poly-insert-term
    (field term polynomial)
  (cond
   ((equal (cadr term) (q4830725-zero field))
    polynomial)
   ((endp polynomial)
    (list term))
   ((equal (car term) (caar polynomial))
    (let ((coefficient
           (q4830725-add
            field
            (cadr term)
            (cadar polynomial))))
      (if (equal coefficient (q4830725-zero field))
          (cdr polynomial)
        (cons
         (list (car term) coefficient)
         (cdr polynomial)))))
   ((q4830725-exp-less-p
     (car term) (caar polynomial))
    (cons term polynomial))
   (t
    (cons
     (car polynomial)
     (q4830725-poly-insert-term
      field term (cdr polynomial))))))

(defun q4830725-poly-mul-row
    (field term polynomial accumulator)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q4830725-poly-mul-row
       field
       term
       (cdr polynomial)
       (q4830725-poly-insert-term
        field
        (list
         (q4830725-exp-add
          (car term) (caar polynomial))
         (q4830725-multiply
          field
          (cadr term)
          (cadar polynomial)))
        accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun q4830725-poly-multiply-acc
    (field left right accumulator)
  (if (consp left)
      (q4830725-poly-multiply-acc
       field
       (cdr left)
       right
       (q4830725-poly-mul-row
        field (car left) right accumulator))
    accumulator))

(defun q4830725-poly-multiply
    (field left right)
  (q4830725-poly-multiply-acc
   field left right nil))

(defun q4830725-field-power
    (field base exponent)
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q4830725-one field)
    (q4830725-multiply
     field
     base
     (q4830725-field-power
      field base (- exponent 1)))))

(defun q4830725-monomial-eval
    (field exponents point)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (q4830725-multiply
       field
       (q4830725-field-power
        field (car point) (car exponents))
       (q4830725-monomial-eval
        field (cdr exponents) (cdr point)))
    (q4830725-one field)))

(defun q4830725-polynomial-eval
    (field polynomial point)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q4830725-add
       field
       (q4830725-multiply
        field
        (cadar polynomial)
        (q4830725-monomial-eval
         field (caar polynomial) point))
       (q4830725-polynomial-eval
        field (cdr polynomial) point))
    (q4830725-zero field)))

(defun q4830725-point-p (field indices point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) (len indices))
   (q4830725-field-list-p field point)))

(defun q4830725-polynomial-map-tail-p
    (field indices remaining polynomials)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (consp polynomials)
       (q4830725-polynomial-p
        field indices (car polynomials))
       (q4830725-polynomial-map-tail-p
        field indices (cdr remaining) (cdr polynomials)))
    (equal polynomials nil)))

(defun q4830725-polynomial-map-p
    (field indices polynomials)
  (q4830725-polynomial-map-tail-p
   field indices indices polynomials))

(defun q4830725-evaluate-map
    (field polynomials point)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (cons
       (q4830725-polynomial-eval
        field (car polynomials) point)
       (q4830725-evaluate-map
        field (cdr polynomials) point))
    nil))

;; An arbitrary ideal is retained as an arbitrary membership predicate on
;; canonical polynomials; it is not replaced by a chosen finite generating
;; family.

(defstub q4830725-ideal-member-p
  (field indices ideal polynomial)
  t)

(defun-sk q4830725-ideal-closure-p
    (field indices ideal)
  (forall (left right multiplier)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q4830725-polynomial-p
        field indices left)
       (q4830725-polynomial-p
        field indices right)
       (q4830725-ideal-member-p
        field indices ideal left)
       (q4830725-ideal-member-p
        field indices ideal right))
      (q4830725-ideal-member-p
       field indices ideal
       (q4830725-poly-add field left right)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4830725-polynomial-p
        field indices left)
       (q4830725-ideal-member-p
        field indices ideal left))
      (q4830725-ideal-member-p
       field indices ideal
       (q4830725-poly-negate field left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4830725-polynomial-p
        field indices left)
       (q4830725-polynomial-p
        field indices multiplier)
       (q4830725-ideal-member-p
        field indices ideal left))
      (q4830725-ideal-member-p
       field indices ideal
       (q4830725-poly-multiply
        field multiplier left))))))

(defun q4830725-ideal-p (field indices ideal)
  (and
   (q4830725-ideal-member-p
    field indices ideal nil)
   (q4830725-ideal-closure-p
    field indices ideal)))

(defun-sk q4830725-common-zero-p
    (field indices ideal point)
  (forall (polynomial)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4830725-polynomial-p
       field indices polynomial)
      (q4830725-ideal-member-p
       field indices ideal polynomial))
     (equal
      (q4830725-polynomial-eval
       field polynomial point)
      (q4830725-zero field)))))

(defun q4830725-zero-locus-p
    (field indices ideal point)
  (and
   (q4830725-point-p field indices point)
   (q4830725-common-zero-p
    field indices ideal point)))

(defun-sk q4830725-maps-to-p
    (field indices ideal polynomials)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q4830725-zero-locus-p
      field indices ideal point)
     (q4830725-zero-locus-p
      field indices ideal
      (q4830725-evaluate-map
       field polynomials point)))))

(defun-sk q4830725-injective-on-p
    (field indices ideal polynomials)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4830725-zero-locus-p
       field indices ideal left)
      (q4830725-zero-locus-p
       field indices ideal right)
      (equal
       (q4830725-evaluate-map
        field polynomials left)
       (q4830725-evaluate-map
        field polynomials right)))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk q4830725-preimage-exists-p
    (field indices ideal polynomials target)
  (exists (source)
    (and
     (q4830725-zero-locus-p
      field indices ideal source)
     (equal
      (q4830725-evaluate-map
       field polynomials source)
      target))))

(defun-sk q4830725-surjective-on-p
    (field indices ideal polynomials)
  (forall (target)
    (implies
     (q4830725-zero-locus-p
      field indices ideal target)
     (q4830725-preimage-exists-p
      field indices ideal polynomials target))))

(defun-sk
  thousand-theorems-q4830725-ax-grothendieck-statement
  ()
  (forall (field indices ideal polynomials)
    (implies
     (and
      (true-listp indices)
      (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)
      (q4830725-algebraically-closed-field-p field)
      (q4830725-ideal-p field indices ideal)
      (q4830725-polynomial-map-p
       field indices polynomials))
     (implies
      (q4830725-maps-to-p
       field indices ideal polynomials)
      (implies
       (q4830725-injective-on-p
        field indices ideal polynomials)
       (q4830725-surjective-on-p
        field indices ideal polynomials))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4830725,
-- "Ax-Grothendieck theorem": over an algebraically closed field, an injective
-- polynomial self-map of the zero locus of a multivariate polynomial ideal in
-- finitely many variables is surjective on that zero locus. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_; refl)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ; _,_)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 4 _×_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not A =
  A → Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Dec
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  yes : A → Dec A
  no  : Not A → Dec A

cong :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (f : A → B) →
  {x y : A} →
  x ≡ y →
  f x ≡ f y
cong f refl =
  refl

subst :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  (P : A → Set b) →
  {x y : A} →
  x ≡ y →
  P x →
  P y
subst P refl px =
  px

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

Finite :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Finite A =
  Σ Nat (λ cardinality → Bijection A (Fin cardinality))

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR : R → R

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (F : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    ring : CommutativeRing F
    inverseF : F → F
    one-not-zero :
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring ≠
      CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : F) →
      x ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring →
      CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (inverseF x) ≡
      CommutativeRing.oneR ring

power :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  R →
  Nat →
  R
power ring x zero =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
power ring x (suc n) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x (power ring x n)

evaluateUnivariate :
  {a : Level} →
  {F : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing F →
  List F →
  F →
  F
evaluateUnivariate ring [] x =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
evaluateUnivariate ring (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring coefficient
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring x
      (evaluateUnivariate ring coefficients x))

data HasNonzeroCoefficient
  {a : Level}
  {F : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing F) :
  List F →
  Set a where

  here :
    {coefficient : F}
    {coefficients : List F} →
    coefficient ≠ CommutativeRing.zeroR ring →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient ring (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

  there :
    {coefficient : F}
    {coefficients : List F} →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient ring coefficients →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient ring (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

data Nonconstant
  {a : Level}
  {F : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing F) :
  List F →
  Set a where

  nonconstant :
    {constant : F}
    {higher-coefficients : List F} →
    HasNonzeroCoefficient ring higher-coefficients →
    Nonconstant ring (constant ∷ higher-coefficients)

AlgebraicallyClosed :
  {a : Level} →
  {F : Set a} →
  Field F →
  Set a
AlgebraicallyClosed field-structure =
  (coefficients : List _) →
  Nonconstant (Field.ring field-structure) coefficients →
  Σ _
    (λ root →
      evaluateUnivariate
        (Field.ring field-structure)
        coefficients
        root
      ≡
      CommutativeRing.zeroR (Field.ring field-structure))

record Monomial
  {s : Level}
  (σ : Set s) :
  Set s where

  constructor monomial
  field
    exponent : σ → Nat

record Term
  {a s : Level}
  (K : Set a)
  (σ : Set s) :
  Set (a ⊔ s) where

  constructor term
  field
    coefficient   : K
    monomial-part : Monomial σ

Polynomial :
  {a s : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set s →
  Set (a ⊔ s)
Polynomial K σ =
  List (Term K σ)

decideNatEquality :
  (m n : Nat) →
  Dec (m ≡ n)
decideNatEquality zero zero =
  yes refl
decideNatEquality zero (suc n) =
  no (λ ())
decideNatEquality (suc m) zero =
  no (λ ())
decideNatEquality (suc m) (suc n) with decideNatEquality m n
... | yes equality =
  yes (cong suc equality)
... | no inequality =
  no (λ { refl → inequality refl })

decideFinFunctionEquality :
  (n : Nat) →
  (f g : Fin n → Nat) →
  Dec ((i : Fin n) → f i ≡ g i)
decideFinFunctionEquality zero f g =
  yes (λ ())
decideFinFunctionEquality (suc n) f g
  with decideNatEquality (f fzero) (g fzero)
... | no unequal-at-zero =
  no (λ equality → unequal-at-zero (equality fzero))
... | yes equal-at-zero
  with decideFinFunctionEquality n
    (λ i → f (fsuc i))
    (λ i → g (fsuc i))
... | no unequal-later =
  no (λ equality → unequal-later (λ i → equality (fsuc i)))
... | yes equal-later =
  yes λ
    { fzero    → equal-at-zero
    ; (fsuc i) → equal-later i
    }

MonomialEqual :
  {s : Level} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  Monomial σ →
  Monomial σ →
  Set s
MonomialEqual left right =
  (x : _) →
  Monomial.exponent left x ≡
  Monomial.exponent right x

decideMonomialEquality :
  {s : Level} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  Finite σ →
  (left right : Monomial σ) →
  Dec (MonomialEqual left right)
decideMonomialEquality (cardinality , enumeration) left right
  with decideFinFunctionEquality cardinality
    (λ i →
      Monomial.exponent left
        (Bijection.from enumeration i))
    (λ i →
      Monomial.exponent right
        (Bijection.from enumeration i))
... | no inequality =
  no
    (λ equality →
      inequality
        (λ i →
          equality (Bijection.from enumeration i)))
... | yes equality =
  yes
    (λ x →
      subst
        (λ y →
          Monomial.exponent left y ≡
          Monomial.exponent right y)
        (Bijection.from-to enumeration x)
        (equality (Bijection.to enumeration x)))

append :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  List A →
  List A →
  List A
append [] ys =
  ys
append (x ∷ xs) ys =
  x ∷ append xs ys

addMonomial :
  {s : Level} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  Monomial σ →
  Monomial σ →
  Monomial σ
addMonomial left right =
  monomial
    (λ x →
      Monomial.exponent left x +
      Monomial.exponent right x)

multiplyTerms :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Term K σ →
  Term K σ →
  Term K σ
multiplyTerms ring left right =
  term
    (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring
      (Term.coefficient left)
      (Term.coefficient right))
    (addMonomial
      (Term.monomial-part left)
      (Term.monomial-part right))

multiplyByTerm :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Term K σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ
multiplyByTerm ring left [] =
  []
multiplyByTerm ring left (right ∷ rest) =
  multiplyTerms ring left right ∷
  multiplyByTerm ring left rest

addPolynomial :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ
addPolynomial =
  append

negatePolynomial :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ
negatePolynomial ring [] =
  []
negatePolynomial ring (summand ∷ rest) =
  term
    (CommutativeRing.negateR ring
      (Term.coefficient summand))
    (Term.monomial-part summand)
  ∷ negatePolynomial ring rest

multiplyPolynomial :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ
multiplyPolynomial ring [] right =
  []
multiplyPolynomial ring (left ∷ rest) right =
  append
    (multiplyByTerm ring left right)
    (multiplyPolynomial ring rest right)

coefficientAt :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Finite σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Monomial σ →
  K
coefficientAt ring finite [] target =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
coefficientAt ring finite (summand ∷ rest) target
  with decideMonomialEquality finite
    (Term.monomial-part summand)
    target
... | yes equal =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (Term.coefficient summand)
    (coefficientAt ring finite rest target)
... | no unequal =
  coefficientAt ring finite rest target

PolynomialEqual :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Finite σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  Set (a ⊔ s)
PolynomialEqual ring finite left right =
  (monomial-part : Monomial _) →
  coefficientAt ring finite left monomial-part ≡
  coefficientAt ring finite right monomial-part

record PolynomialIdeal
  {a s : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  {σ : Set s}
  (ring : CommutativeRing K)
  (finite : Finite σ) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ s)) where

  field
    member :
      Polynomial K σ →
      Set (a ⊔ s)
    membership-propositional :
      (polynomial : Polynomial K σ) →
      (u v : member polynomial) →
      u ≡ v
    respects-polynomial-equality :
      (left right : Polynomial K σ) →
      PolynomialEqual ring finite left right →
      member left →
      member right
    contains-zero :
      member []
    closed-under-addition :
      (left right : Polynomial K σ) →
      member left →
      member right →
      member (addPolynomial left right)
    closed-under-negation :
      (polynomial : Polynomial K σ) →
      member polynomial →
      member (negatePolynomial ring polynomial)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (left right : Polynomial K σ) →
      member left →
      member (multiplyPolynomial ring left right)

productFin :
  {a : Level} →
  {R : Set a} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (n : Nat) →
  (Fin n → R) →
  R
productFin ring zero values =
  CommutativeRing.oneR ring
productFin ring (suc n) values =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring
    (values fzero)
    (productFin ring n (λ i → values (fsuc i)))

evaluateMonomial :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Finite σ →
  (σ → K) →
  Monomial σ →
  K
evaluateMonomial ring (cardinality , enumeration) point monomial-part =
  productFin ring cardinality
    (λ i →
      power ring
        (point (Bijection.from enumeration i))
        (Monomial.exponent monomial-part
          (Bijection.from enumeration i)))

evaluateTerm :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Finite σ →
  (σ → K) →
  Term K σ →
  K
evaluateTerm ring finite point summand =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring
    (Term.coefficient summand)
    (evaluateMonomial ring finite point
      (Term.monomial-part summand))

evaluatePolynomial :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Finite σ →
  Polynomial K σ →
  (σ → K) →
  K
evaluatePolynomial ring finite [] point =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
evaluatePolynomial ring finite (summand ∷ rest) point =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring
    (evaluateTerm ring finite point summand)
    (evaluatePolynomial ring finite rest point)

ZeroLocus :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  (ring : CommutativeRing K) →
  (finite : Finite σ) →
  PolynomialIdeal ring finite →
  (σ → K) →
  Set (a ⊔ s)
ZeroLocus ring finite ideal point =
  (polynomial : Polynomial _ _) →
  PolynomialIdeal.member ideal polynomial →
  evaluatePolynomial ring finite polynomial point ≡
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring

PolynomialMap :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  CommutativeRing K →
  Finite σ →
  (σ → Polynomial K σ) →
  (σ → K) →
  σ →
  K
PolynomialMap ring finite polynomials point coordinate =
  evaluatePolynomial ring finite (polynomials coordinate) point

PointwiseEqual :
  {a b : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  {B : Set b} →
  (A → B) →
  (A → B) →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
PointwiseEqual left right =
  (x : _) →
  left x ≡ right x

MapsTo :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  ((σ → K) → Set (a ⊔ s)) →
  ((σ → K) → (σ → K)) →
  Set (a ⊔ s)
MapsTo subset function =
  (x : _) →
  subset x →
  subset (function x)

InjectiveOn :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  ((σ → K) → Set (a ⊔ s)) →
  ((σ → K) → (σ → K)) →
  Set (a ⊔ s)
InjectiveOn subset function =
  (x y : _) →
  subset x →
  subset y →
  PointwiseEqual (function x) (function y) →
  PointwiseEqual x y

SurjectiveOn :
  {a s : Level} →
  {K : Set a} →
  {σ : Set s} →
  ((σ → K) → Set (a ⊔ s)) →
  ((σ → K) → (σ → K)) →
  Set (a ⊔ s)
SurjectiveOn subset function =
  (y : _) →
  subset y →
  Σ _
    (λ x →
      subset x ×
      PointwiseEqual (function x) y)

-- Lean: ax_grothendieck_zeroLocus
ax-grothendieck-zero-locus :
  (a s : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ s))
ax-grothendieck-zero-locus a s =
  (K : Set a) →
  (σ : Set s) →
  (field-structure : Field K) →
  AlgebraicallyClosed field-structure →
  (finite : Finite σ) →
  (ideal :
    PolynomialIdeal
      (Field.ring field-structure)
      finite) →
  (polynomials : σ → Polynomial K σ) →
  let
    locus =
      ZeroLocus
        (Field.ring field-structure)
        finite
        ideal
    polynomial-map =
      PolynomialMap
        (Field.ring field-structure)
        finite
        polynomials
  in
  MapsTo locus polynomial-map →
  InjectiveOn locus polynomial-map →
  SurjectiveOn locus polynomial-map

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4830725, "Ax–Grothendieck theorem": over an algebraically closed field
  with finitely many variables, an injective polynomial self-map of an
  ideal's zero locus is surjective on that zero locus. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val ax_grothendieck_zeroLocus =
  ``!(kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k)
      (kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (I : ((('i -> num) -> 'k) -> bool))
      (p : 'i -> ('i -> num) -> 'k).
      let field_axioms =
        (kzero <> kone /\
        (!x. kadd kzero x = x) /\
        (!x. kadd (kneg x) x = kzero) /\
        (!x y. kadd x y = kadd y x) /\
        (!x y z. kadd (kadd x y) z = kadd x (kadd y z)) /\
        (!x. kmul kone x = x) /\
        (!x y. kmul x y = kmul y x) /\
        (!x y z. kmul (kmul x y) z = kmul x (kmul y z)) /\
        (!x y z.
           kmul x (kadd y z) = kadd (kmul x y) (kmul x z)) /\
        kinv kzero = kzero /\
        (!x. x <> kzero ==> kmul (kinv x) x = kone))
      in
      let univariate_eval =
        \(coeffs : 'k list) (x : 'k).
          FOLDR (\c acc. kadd c (kmul x acc)) kzero coeffs
      in
      let algebraically_closed =
        !coeffs : 'k list.
          1 < LENGTH coeffs /\ LAST coeffs <> kzero
          ==>
          ?x : 'k. univariate_eval coeffs x = kzero
      in
      let is_polynomial =
        \q : ('i -> num) -> 'k.
          FINITE {m | q m <> kzero}
      in
      let polynomial_zero =
        \m : 'i -> num. kzero
      in
      let polynomial_add =
        \(q : ('i -> num) -> 'k) r m.
          kadd (q m) (r m)
      in
      let polynomial_neg =
        \(q : ('i -> num) -> 'k) m.
          kneg (q m)
      in
      let coefficient_decompositions =
        \(q : ('i -> num) -> 'k) r (m : 'i -> num).
          {ab |
             q (FST ab) <> kzero /\
             r (SND ab) <> kzero /\
             !i. FST ab i + SND ab i = m i}
      in
      let polynomial_mul =
        \(q : ('i -> num) -> 'k) r m.
          ITSET
            (\ab acc.
               kadd (kmul (q (FST ab)) (r (SND ab))) acc)
            (coefficient_decompositions q r m) kzero
      in
      let monomial_value =
        \(x : 'i -> 'k) (m : 'i -> num).
          ITSET
            (\i acc.
               kmul (FUNPOW (kmul (x i)) (m i) kone) acc)
            (UNIV : 'i set) kone
      in
      let polynomial_eval =
        \(x : 'i -> 'k) (q : ('i -> num) -> 'k).
          ITSET
            (\m acc. kadd (kmul (q m) (monomial_value x m)) acc)
            {m | q m <> kzero} kzero
      in
      let is_ideal =
        ((!q. I q ==> is_polynomial q) /\
        I polynomial_zero /\
        (!q r. I q /\ I r ==> I (polynomial_add q r)) /\
        (!q. I q ==> I (polynomial_neg q)) /\
        (!q r.
           I q /\ is_polynomial r ==> I (polynomial_mul q r)))
      in
      let zero_locus =
        \x : 'i -> 'k.
          !q. I q ==> polynomial_eval x q = kzero
      in
      let polynomial_map =
        \x : 'i -> 'k.
          \i. polynomial_eval x (p i)
      in
      let maps_to =
        !x. zero_locus x ==> zero_locus (polynomial_map x)
      in
      let injective_on =
        !x y.
          zero_locus x /\
          zero_locus y /\
          polynomial_map x = polynomial_map y
          ==>
          x = y
      in
      let surjective_on =
        !y.
          zero_locus y
          ==>
          ?x.
            zero_locus x /\
            polynomial_map x = y
      in
        field_axioms /\
        algebraically_closed /\
        FINITE (UNIV : 'i set) /\
        is_ideal /\
        (!i. is_polynomial (p i))
        ==>
        maps_to ==>
        injective_on ==>
        surjective_on``;

title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4830725
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q4830725), "Ax-Grothendieck theorem":
  over an algebraically closed field with finitely many coordinates, an
  injective polynomial self-map of an affine zero locus is surjective on that
  zero locus. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  SetMM's S mPoly K is the full finite-support multivariate polynomial ring
  over K with arbitrary variable carrier S. QAGAlgClosed is the standard
  nonconstant-polynomial root property. QAGZeroLocus is exactly the set of
  K-valued assignments on which every polynomial in the ideal I vanishes.

  A tuple P in Base(S mPoly K) ^m S defines the polynomial map whose i-th
  coordinate at x is the SetMM evaluation of P(i) at x. The final assertion
  states, with the source implication scopes, that if this map preserves the
  zero locus and is injective there, then it is surjective there. Every
  declaration below is an unproved $a statement encoding; there are no $p
  proof statements.
$)

$c QAGAlgClosed QAGZeroLocus $.

qag-algebraically-closed-syntax $a wff ( QAGAlgClosed K ) $.
qag-zero-locus-syntax $a class ( QAGZeroLocus K S I ) $.

${
  $d K c p x $.

  qag-algebraically-closed-definition $a |- (
    ( QAGAlgClosed K )
    <->
    (
      K e. Field
      /\
      A. p e. ( Base ` ( 1o mPoly K ) )
        (
          A. c e. ( Base ` K )
            p =/= ( ( algSc ` ( 1o mPoly K ) ) ` c )
          ->
          E. x e. ( Base ` K )
            ( ( ( eval1 ` K ) ` p ) ` x ) = ( 0g ` K )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d I K S p x $.

  qag-zero-locus-definition $a |- (
    QAGZeroLocus K S I
  ) = {
    x e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m S ) |
    A. p e. I
      ( ( ( S eval K ) ` p ) ` x ) = ( 0g ` K )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d I K P S i x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q4830725-ax-grothendieck-zero-locus $a |-
    A. K e. Field
      A. S e. Fin
        A. I e. ( LIdeal ` ( S mPoly K ) )
          A. P e. ( ( Base ` ( S mPoly K ) ) ^m S )
            (
              ( QAGAlgClosed K )
              ->
              (
                A. x e. ( QAGZeroLocus K S I )
                  (
                    i e. S |->
                      ( ( ( S eval K ) ` ( P ` i ) ) ` x )
                  ) e. ( QAGZeroLocus K S I )
                ->
                (
                  A. x e. ( QAGZeroLocus K S I )
                    A. y e. ( QAGZeroLocus K S I )
                      (
                        (
                          i e. S |->
                            ( ( ( S eval K ) ` ( P ` i ) ) ` x )
                        )
                        =
                        (
                          i e. S |->
                            ( ( ( S eval K ) ` ( P ` i ) ) ` y )
                        )
                        ->
                        x = y
                      )
                  ->
                  A. y e. ( QAGZeroLocus K S I )
                    E. x e. ( QAGZeroLocus K S I )
                      (
                        i e. S |->
                          ( ( ( S eval K ) ` ( P ` i ) ) ` x )
                      ) = y
                )
              )
            )
  $.
$}

      POLYNOM2, GAUSSINT, RELAT_1, MOD_4, POLYNOM7, RING_2, RING_4, RING_5,
      REALSET1, POLYNOM1, POLYNOM5, FIELD_7, FIELD_8, FIELD_12, FIELD_9,
      FIELD_4, FIELD_5, FIELD_6, FIELD_10, FIELD_13, IDEAL_1, RING_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions IDEAL_1;
 equalities BINOP_1, REALSET1, XCMPLX_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, POLYNOM3, FIELD_6,
      FUNCOP_1, IDEAL_1;
 expansions STRUCT_0, GROUP_1, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, TARSKI, GROUP_6,
      FUNCT_1, RING_2, FUNCT_2, IDEAL_1, RING_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      F being Field,
      I being Subset of Polynom-Ring(n,F),
      p being Function of n,Polynom-Ring(n,F)
  st F is algebraic-closed &
     I is add-closed & I is left-ideal & I is right-ideal & I is non empty
  holds
    ((for x being Function of n,F st
        (for q being Element of Polynom-Ring(n,F) st q in I holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(x,F)).q = 0.F)
      holds ex y being Function of n,F st
        (for i being object st i in n holds
          y.i = (hom_Ext_eval(x,F)).(p.i)) &
        (for q being Element of Polynom-Ring(n,F) st q in I holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(y,F)).q = 0.F)) &
     (for x,y being Function of n,F st
        (for q being Element of Polynom-Ring(n,F) st q in I holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(x,F)).q = 0.F) &
        (for q being Element of Polynom-Ring(n,F) st q in I holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(y,F)).q = 0.F) &
        (for i being object st i in n holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(x,F)).(p.i) = (hom_Ext_eval(y,F)).(p.i))
      holds x = y))
    implies
      for y being Function of n,F st
        (for q being Element of Polynom-Ring(n,F) st q in I holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(y,F)).q = 0.F)
      holds ex x being Function of n,F st
        (for q being Element of Polynom-Ring(n,F) st q in I holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(x,F)).q = 0.F) &
        (for i being object st i in n holds
          (hom_Ext_eval(x,F)).(p.i) = y.i)
proof
end;
