title: Q4830725_ax_grothendieck_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q4830725,
% "Ax-Grothendieck theorem": over an algebraically closed field, every
% injective polynomial self-map of an ideal's zero locus is surjective there.
% This file contains no proof.

ax_grothendieck_theorem_Q4830725[
  Variable: TYPE,
  K, Poly: TYPE+,
  zero_K, one_K: K,
  neg_K: [K -> K],
  add_K, mul_K: [K, K -> K],
  inv_K: [K -> K],
  zero_poly, one_poly: Poly,
  neg_poly: [Poly -> Poly],
  add_poly, mul_poly: [Poly, Poly -> Poly],
  coefficient: [Poly, [Variable -> nat] -> K],
  evaluate: [Poly, [Variable -> K] -> K]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  monomial: TYPE = [Variable -> nat]
  point: TYPE = [Variable -> K]
  ideal: TYPE = [Poly -> bool]
  polynomial_map: TYPE = [Variable -> Poly]

  decomposition: TYPE =
    [# left_monomial: monomial, right_monomial: monomial #]

  zero_monomial: monomial =
    LAMBDA (v: Variable): 0

  monomial_add(left, right: monomial): monomial =
    LAMBDA (v: Variable): left(v) + right(v)

  power_K(x: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one_K
    ELSE
      mul_K(power_K(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  in_variable(v: Variable, variables: list[Variable]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES variables OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail): v = head OR in_variable(v, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  no_duplicate_variables(variables: list[Variable]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES variables OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT in_variable(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_variables(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  exact_variable_list(variables: list[Variable]): bool =
    no_duplicate_variables(variables)
      AND (FORALL (v: Variable): in_variable(v, variables))

  in_monomial(m: monomial, monomials: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail): m = head OR in_monomial(m, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  no_duplicate_monomials(monomials: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT in_monomial(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_monomials(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  exact_support(p: Poly, monomials: list[monomial]): bool =
    no_duplicate_monomials(monomials)
      AND (FORALL (m: monomial):
        in_monomial(m, monomials)
          IFF NOT coefficient(p, m) = zero_K)

  function_exact_support(
      f: [monomial -> K],
      monomials: list[monomial]): bool =
    no_duplicate_monomials(monomials)
      AND (FORALL (m: monomial):
        in_monomial(m, monomials)
          IFF NOT f(m) = zero_K)

  finitely_supported(f: [monomial -> K]): bool =
    EXISTS (monomials: list[monomial]):
      function_exact_support(f, monomials)

  in_decomposition(
      d: decomposition,
      decompositions: list[decomposition]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES decompositions OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        d = head OR in_decomposition(d, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE decompositions BY <<

  no_duplicate_decompositions(
      decompositions: list[decomposition]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES decompositions OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT in_decomposition(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_decompositions(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE decompositions BY <<

  exact_decompositions(
      m: monomial,
      decompositions: list[decomposition]): bool =
    no_duplicate_decompositions(decompositions)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: monomial):
        in_decomposition(
          (# left_monomial := left, right_monomial := right #),
          decompositions)
        IFF monomial_add(left, right) = m)

  convolution_sum(
      p, q: Poly,
      decompositions: list[decomposition]): RECURSIVE K =
    CASES decompositions OF
      null: zero_K,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_K(
          mul_K(
            coefficient(p, left_monomial(head)),
            coefficient(q, right_monomial(head))),
          convolution_sum(p, q, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE decompositions BY <<

  monomial_value(
      x: point,
      m: monomial,
      variables: list[Variable]): RECURSIVE K =
    CASES variables OF
      null: one_K,
      cons(head, tail):
        mul_K(
          power_K(x(head), m(head)),
          monomial_value(x, m, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  evaluation_sum(
      p: Poly,
      x: point,
      monomials: list[monomial],
      variables: list[Variable]): RECURSIVE K =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: zero_K,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_K(
          mul_K(
            coefficient(p, head),
            monomial_value(x, head, variables)),
          evaluation_sum(p, x, tail, variables))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  list_has_nonzero(coefficients: list[K]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT head = zero_K OR list_has_nonzero(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  univariate_value(coefficients: list[K], x: K): RECURSIVE K =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: zero_K,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_K(head, mul_K(x, univariate_value(tail, x)))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE coefficients BY <<

  nonconstant_polynomial(coefficients: list[K]): bool =
    CASES coefficients OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(constant, higher_coefficients):
        list_has_nonzero(higher_coefficients)
    ENDCASES

  field_laws_K: bool =
    NOT one_K = zero_K
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K): add_K(a, b) = add_K(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        add_K(add_K(a, b), c) = add_K(a, add_K(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K): add_K(a, zero_K) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K): add_K(a, neg_K(a)) = zero_K)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K): mul_K(a, b) = mul_K(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mul_K(mul_K(a, b), c) = mul_K(a, mul_K(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K): mul_K(a, one_K) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mul_K(a, add_K(b, c))
          = add_K(mul_K(a, b), mul_K(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        NOT a = zero_K IMPLIES mul_K(a, inv_K(a)) = one_K)

  algebraically_closed_K: bool =
    FORALL (coefficients: list[K]):
      nonconstant_polynomial(coefficients)
        IMPLIES EXISTS (x: K):
          univariate_value(coefficients, x) = zero_K

  polynomial_representation_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p, q: Poly):
      (FORALL (m: monomial):
        coefficient(p, m) = coefficient(q, m))
      IMPLIES p = q)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly):
        EXISTS (monomials: list[monomial]):
          exact_support(p, monomials))
      AND (FORALL (f: [monomial -> K]):
        finitely_supported(f)
          IMPLIES EXISTS (p: Poly):
            FORALL (m: monomial):
              coefficient(p, m) = f(m))
      AND (FORALL (m: monomial):
        coefficient(zero_poly, m) = zero_K)
      AND (FORALL (m: monomial):
        coefficient(one_poly, m)
          = IF m = zero_monomial THEN one_K ELSE zero_K ENDIF)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly), (m: monomial):
        coefficient(neg_poly(p), m)
          = neg_K(coefficient(p, m)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: Poly), (m: monomial):
        coefficient(add_poly(p, q), m)
          = add_K(coefficient(p, m), coefficient(q, m)))
      AND (FORALL (m: monomial):
        EXISTS (decompositions: list[decomposition]):
          exact_decompositions(m, decompositions))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: Poly), (m: monomial),
                  (decompositions: list[decomposition]):
        exact_decompositions(m, decompositions)
          IMPLIES coefficient(mul_poly(p, q), m)
            = convolution_sum(p, q, decompositions))
      AND (EXISTS (variables: list[Variable]):
        exact_variable_list(variables))
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly), (x: point),
                  (monomials: list[monomial]),
                  (variables: list[Variable]):
        exact_support(p, monomials)
          AND exact_variable_list(variables)
          IMPLIES evaluate(p, x)
            = evaluation_sum(p, x, monomials, variables))

  is_ideal(I: ideal): bool =
    I(zero_poly)
      AND (FORALL (p, q: Poly):
        I(p) AND I(q) IMPLIES I(add_poly(p, q)))
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly):
        I(p) IMPLIES I(neg_poly(p)))
      AND (FORALL (a, p: Poly):
        I(p) IMPLIES I(mul_poly(a, p)))

  zero_locus(I: ideal, x: point): bool =
    FORALL (p: Poly):
      I(p) IMPLIES evaluate(p, x) = zero_K

  apply_polynomial_map(p: polynomial_map, x: point): point =
    LAMBDA (i: Variable): evaluate(p(i), x)

  maps_zero_locus_to_itself(I: ideal, p: polynomial_map): bool =
    FORALL (x: point):
      zero_locus(I, x)
        IMPLIES zero_locus(I, apply_polynomial_map(p, x))

  injective_on_zero_locus(I: ideal, p: polynomial_map): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: point):
      zero_locus(I, x)
        AND zero_locus(I, y)
        AND apply_polynomial_map(p, x) = apply_polynomial_map(p, y)
      IMPLIES x = y

  surjective_on_zero_locus(I: ideal, p: polynomial_map): bool =
    FORALL (y: point):
      zero_locus(I, y)
        IMPLIES EXISTS (x: point):
          zero_locus(I, x)
            AND apply_polynomial_map(p, x) = y

  ax_grothendieck_zeroLocus: bool =
    (field_laws_K
      AND algebraically_closed_K
      AND is_finite_type[Variable]
      AND polynomial_representation_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (I: ideal), (p: polynomial_map):
        is_ideal(I)
          IMPLIES
            maps_zero_locus_to_itself(I, p)
              IMPLIES
                injective_on_zero_locus(I, p)
                  IMPLIES surjective_on_zero_locus(I, p)

END ax_grothendieck_theorem_Q4830725

title: Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4878586
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q4878586), "Beck's monadicity theorem": a right
  adjoint that creates coequalizers of all pairs split by that right adjoint
  is monadic. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q4878586_category (Object : Type) : Type := {
  q4878586_hom : Object -> Object -> Type;
  q4878586_id :
    forall X : Object, q4878586_hom X X;
  q4878586_comp :
    forall X Y Z : Object,
      q4878586_hom X Y ->
      q4878586_hom Y Z ->
      q4878586_hom X Z;
  q4878586_comp_id_left :
    forall (X Y : Object) (f : q4878586_hom X Y),
      q4878586_comp (q4878586_id X) f = f;
  q4878586_comp_id_right :
    forall (X Y : Object) (f : q4878586_hom X Y),
      q4878586_comp f (q4878586_id Y) = f;
  q4878586_comp_assoc :
    forall (W X Y Z : Object)
           (f : q4878586_hom W X)
           (g : q4878586_hom X Y)
           (h : q4878586_hom Y Z),
      q4878586_comp (q4878586_comp f g) h =
      q4878586_comp f (q4878586_comp g h)
}.

Arguments q4878586_hom {Object} _ _ _.
Arguments q4878586_id {Object q} _.
Arguments q4878586_comp {Object q X Y Z} _ _.

Record q4878586_functor
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject) : Type := {
  q4878586_fobj : CObject -> DObject;
  q4878586_fmap :
    forall X Y : CObject,
      q4878586_hom C X Y ->
      q4878586_hom D (q4878586_fobj X) (q4878586_fobj Y);
  q4878586_fmap_id :
    forall X : CObject,
      q4878586_fmap X X (q4878586_id X) =
      q4878586_id (q4878586_fobj X);
  q4878586_fmap_comp :
    forall (X Y Z : CObject)
           (f : q4878586_hom C X Y)
           (g : q4878586_hom C Y Z),
      q4878586_fmap X Z (q4878586_comp f g) =
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_fmap X Y f)
        (q4878586_fmap Y Z g)
}.

Arguments q4878586_fobj
  {CObject DObject C D} _ _.
Arguments q4878586_fmap
  {CObject DObject C D} _ {X Y} _.

Record q4878586_iso
    {Object : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category Object)
    (X Y : Object) : Type := {
  q4878586_iso_hom : q4878586_hom C X Y;
  q4878586_iso_inv : q4878586_hom C Y X;
  q4878586_iso_inv_hom :
    q4878586_comp q4878586_iso_hom q4878586_iso_inv =
    q4878586_id X;
  q4878586_iso_hom_inv :
    q4878586_comp q4878586_iso_inv q4878586_iso_hom =
    q4878586_id Y
}.

Arguments q4878586_iso_hom {Object C X Y} _.
Arguments q4878586_iso_inv {Object C X Y} _.

Record q4878586_is_coequalizer
    {Object : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category Object)
    {A B Q : Object}
    (f g : q4878586_hom C A B)
    (quotient : q4878586_hom C B Q) : Type := {
  q4878586_coequalizer_condition :
    q4878586_comp f quotient = q4878586_comp g quotient;
  q4878586_coequalizer_desc :
    forall (X : Object) (candidate : q4878586_hom C B X),
      q4878586_comp f candidate = q4878586_comp g candidate ->
      q4878586_hom C Q X;
  q4878586_coequalizer_fac :
    forall (X : Object) (candidate : q4878586_hom C B X)
           (condition :
             q4878586_comp f candidate =
             q4878586_comp g candidate),
      q4878586_comp quotient
        (q4878586_coequalizer_desc X candidate condition) =
      candidate;
  q4878586_coequalizer_uniq :
    forall (X : Object) (candidate : q4878586_hom C B X)
           (condition :
             q4878586_comp f candidate =
             q4878586_comp g candidate)
           (other : q4878586_hom C Q X),
      q4878586_comp quotient other = candidate ->
      other = q4878586_coequalizer_desc X candidate condition
}.

Record q4878586_split_coequalizer
    {Object : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category Object)
    {A B : Object}
    (f g : q4878586_hom C A B) : Type := {
  q4878586_split_object : Object;
  q4878586_split_quotient :
    q4878586_hom C B q4878586_split_object;
  q4878586_split_section :
    q4878586_hom C q4878586_split_object B;
  q4878586_splitting : q4878586_hom C B A;
  q4878586_split_coequalizes :
    q4878586_comp f q4878586_split_quotient =
    q4878586_comp g q4878586_split_quotient;
  q4878586_split_quotient_section :
    q4878586_comp q4878586_split_section q4878586_split_quotient =
    q4878586_id q4878586_split_object;
  q4878586_split_bottom :
    q4878586_comp q4878586_splitting g =
    q4878586_id B;
  q4878586_split_top :
    q4878586_comp q4878586_splitting f =
    q4878586_comp q4878586_split_quotient q4878586_split_section
}.

Arguments q4878586_split_object
  {Object C A B f g} _.
Arguments q4878586_split_quotient
  {Object C A B f g} _.

Definition q4878586_is_G_split_pair
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C)
    {A B : DObject}
    (f g : q4878586_hom D A B) : Prop :=
  exists split :
      q4878586_split_coequalizer C
        (q4878586_fmap G f) (q4878586_fmap G g),
    True.

Record q4878586_liftable_coequalizer
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C)
    {A B : DObject}
    (f g : q4878586_hom D A B)
    {Q : CObject}
    (quotient :
      q4878586_hom C (q4878586_fobj G B) Q) : Type := {
  q4878586_lifted_object : DObject;
  q4878586_lifted_quotient :
    q4878586_hom D B q4878586_lifted_object;
  q4878586_lifted_condition :
    q4878586_comp f q4878586_lifted_quotient =
    q4878586_comp g q4878586_lifted_quotient;
  q4878586_lifted_comparison :
    q4878586_iso C
      (q4878586_fobj G q4878586_lifted_object) Q;
  q4878586_lifted_quotient_maps_to_original :
    q4878586_comp
      (q4878586_fmap G q4878586_lifted_quotient)
      (q4878586_iso_hom q4878586_lifted_comparison) =
    quotient
}.

Record q4878586_creates_coequalizer
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C)
    {A B : DObject}
    (f g : q4878586_hom D A B) : Type := {
  q4878586_reflects_coequalizer :
    forall (Q : DObject) (q : q4878586_hom D B Q),
      q4878586_comp f q = q4878586_comp g q ->
      q4878586_is_coequalizer C
        (q4878586_fmap G f)
        (q4878586_fmap G g)
        (q4878586_fmap G q) ->
      inhabited (q4878586_is_coequalizer D f g q);
  q4878586_lifts_coequalizer :
    forall (Q : CObject)
           (q : q4878586_hom C (q4878586_fobj G B) Q),
      q4878586_is_coequalizer C
        (q4878586_fmap G f)
        (q4878586_fmap G g) q ->
      @q4878586_liftable_coequalizer
        CObject DObject C D G A B f g Q q
}.

Definition q4878586_creates_G_split_coequalizers
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C) : Type :=
  forall (A B : DObject)
         (f g : q4878586_hom D A B)
         (_ :
           @q4878586_is_G_split_pair
             CObject DObject C D G A B f g),
    @q4878586_creates_coequalizer
      CObject DObject C D G A B f g.

Record q4878586_adjunction
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (F : q4878586_functor C D)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C) : Type := {
  q4878586_unit :
    forall X : CObject,
      q4878586_hom C X
        (q4878586_fobj G (q4878586_fobj F X));
  q4878586_unit_natural :
    forall (X Y : CObject) (f : q4878586_hom C X Y),
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_unit X)
        (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_fmap F f)) =
      q4878586_comp f (q4878586_unit Y);
  q4878586_counit :
    forall Y : DObject,
      q4878586_hom D
        (q4878586_fobj F (q4878586_fobj G Y)) Y;
  q4878586_counit_natural :
    forall (Y Z : DObject) (f : q4878586_hom D Y Z),
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_fmap F (q4878586_fmap G f))
        (q4878586_counit Z) =
      q4878586_comp (q4878586_counit Y) f;
  q4878586_left_triangle :
    forall X : CObject,
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_fmap F (q4878586_unit X))
        (q4878586_counit (q4878586_fobj F X)) =
      q4878586_id (q4878586_fobj F X);
  q4878586_right_triangle :
    forall Y : DObject,
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_unit (q4878586_fobj G Y))
        (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_counit Y)) =
      q4878586_id (q4878586_fobj G Y)
}.

Arguments q4878586_unit
  {CObject DObject C D F G} _ _.
Arguments q4878586_counit
  {CObject DObject C D F G} _ _.

Record q4878586_algebra
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    {C : q4878586_category CObject}
    {D : q4878586_category DObject}
    {F : q4878586_functor C D}
    {G : q4878586_functor D C}
    (adj : @q4878586_adjunction CObject DObject C D F G) : Type := {
  q4878586_algebra_carrier : CObject;
  q4878586_algebra_action :
    q4878586_hom C
      (q4878586_fobj G (q4878586_fobj F q4878586_algebra_carrier))
      q4878586_algebra_carrier;
  q4878586_algebra_unit :
    q4878586_comp
      (q4878586_unit adj q4878586_algebra_carrier)
      q4878586_algebra_action =
    q4878586_id q4878586_algebra_carrier;
  q4878586_algebra_assoc :
    q4878586_comp
      (q4878586_fmap G
        (q4878586_fmap F q4878586_algebra_action))
      q4878586_algebra_action =
    q4878586_comp
      (q4878586_fmap G
        (q4878586_counit adj
          (q4878586_fobj F q4878586_algebra_carrier)))
      q4878586_algebra_action
}.

Arguments q4878586_algebra_carrier
  {CObject DObject C D F G adj} _.
Arguments q4878586_algebra_action
  {CObject DObject C D F G adj} _.

Definition q4878586_comparison_hom
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    {C : q4878586_category CObject}
    {D : q4878586_category DObject}
    {F : q4878586_functor C D}
    {G : q4878586_functor D C}
    (adj : @q4878586_adjunction CObject DObject C D F G)
    (A B : DObject)
    (f :
      q4878586_hom C
        (q4878586_fobj G A) (q4878586_fobj G B)) : Prop :=
  q4878586_comp
    (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_counit adj A)) f =
  q4878586_comp
    (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_fmap F f))
    (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_counit adj B)).

Definition q4878586_algebra_iso_to_comparison
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    {C : q4878586_category CObject}
    {D : q4878586_category DObject}
    {F : q4878586_functor C D}
    {G : q4878586_functor D C}
    (adj : @q4878586_adjunction CObject DObject C D F G)
    (A : q4878586_algebra adj)
    (Y : DObject) : Prop :=
  exists forward :
      q4878586_hom C
        (q4878586_algebra_carrier A) (q4878586_fobj G Y),
    exists backward :
      q4878586_hom C
        (q4878586_fobj G Y) (q4878586_algebra_carrier A),
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_algebra_action A)
        forward =
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_fmap F forward))
        (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_counit adj Y)) /\
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_counit adj Y))
        backward =
      q4878586_comp
        (q4878586_fmap G (q4878586_fmap F backward))
        (q4878586_algebra_action A) /\
      q4878586_comp forward backward =
        q4878586_id (q4878586_algebra_carrier A) /\
      q4878586_comp backward forward =
        q4878586_id (q4878586_fobj G Y).

Record q4878586_comparison_is_equivalence
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (F : q4878586_functor C D)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C)
    (adj : @q4878586_adjunction CObject DObject C D F G) : Prop := {
  q4878586_comparison_faithful :
    forall (A B : DObject)
           (f g : q4878586_hom D A B),
      q4878586_fmap G f = q4878586_fmap G g ->
      f = g;
  q4878586_comparison_full :
    forall (A B : DObject)
           (f :
             q4878586_hom C
               (q4878586_fobj G A) (q4878586_fobj G B)),
      q4878586_comparison_hom adj A B f ->
      exists lift : q4878586_hom D A B,
        q4878586_fmap G lift = f;
  q4878586_comparison_essentially_surjective :
    forall A : q4878586_algebra adj,
      exists Y : DObject,
        @q4878586_algebra_iso_to_comparison
          CObject DObject C D F G adj A Y
}.

Record q4878586_monadic_right_adjoint
    {CObject DObject : Type}
    (C : q4878586_category CObject)
    (D : q4878586_category DObject)
    (G : q4878586_functor D C) : Type := {
  q4878586_left_adjoint : q4878586_functor C D;
  q4878586_monadic_adjunction :
    @q4878586_adjunction
      CObject DObject C D q4878586_left_adjoint G;
  q4878586_monadic_comparison :
    @q4878586_comparison_is_equivalence
      CObject DObject C D q4878586_left_adjoint G
      q4878586_monadic_adjunction
}.

Theorem CategoryTheory_Monad_monadicOfCreatesGSplitCoequalizers :
  forall (CObject DObject : Type)
         (C : q4878586_category CObject)
         (D : q4878586_category DObject)
         (G : q4878586_functor D C)
         (F : q4878586_functor C D),
    @q4878586_adjunction CObject DObject C D F G ->
    @q4878586_creates_G_split_coequalizers CObject DObject C D G ->
    @q4878586_monadic_right_adjoint CObject DObject C D G.
Admitted.

title: Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4878586
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q4878586), "Beck's monadicity theorem": a
  right adjoint that creates coequalizers of pairs split by the right adjoint
  is monadic. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
  imports Main
begin

record ('o, 'm) bm_category_data =
  bm_objects :: "'o set"
  bm_arrows :: "'m set"
  bm_source :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'o"
  bm_target :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'o"
  bm_identity :: "'o \<Rightarrow> 'm"
  bm_compose :: "'m \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm"

definition bm_hom ::
    "('o, 'm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm set" where
  "bm_hom C X Y =
    {f \<in> bm_arrows C. bm_source C f = X \<and> bm_target C f = Y}"

definition bm_is_category :: "('o, 'm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_category C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>f \<in> bm_arrows C.
      bm_source C f \<in> bm_objects C \<and> bm_target C f \<in> bm_objects C) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. bm_identity C X \<in> bm_hom C X X) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> bm_hom C Y Z.
        bm_compose C g f \<in> bm_hom C X Z) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom C X Y.
        bm_compose C (bm_identity C Y) f = f \<and>
        bm_compose C f (bm_identity C X) = f) \<and>
    (\<forall>W \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom C W X. \<forall>g \<in> bm_hom C X Y.
      \<forall>h \<in> bm_hom C Y Z.
        bm_compose C h (bm_compose C g f) =
          bm_compose C (bm_compose C h g) f)"

record ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data =
  bm_obj_map :: "'co \<Rightarrow> 'do"
  bm_mor_map :: "'cm \<Rightarrow> 'dm"

definition bm_is_functor ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_functor C D F \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. bm_obj_map F X \<in> bm_objects D) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom C X Y.
        bm_mor_map F f \<in> bm_hom D (bm_obj_map F X) (bm_obj_map F Y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C.
      bm_mor_map F (bm_identity C X) = bm_identity D (bm_obj_map F X)) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Z \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom C X Y. \<forall>g \<in> bm_hom C Y Z.
        bm_mor_map F (bm_compose C g f) =
          bm_compose D (bm_mor_map F g) (bm_mor_map F f))"

record ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data =
  bm_unit :: "'co \<Rightarrow> 'cm"
  bm_counit :: "'do \<Rightarrow> 'dm"

definition bm_is_adjunction ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_adjunction C D F G A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C.
      bm_unit A X \<in>
        bm_hom C X (bm_obj_map G (bm_obj_map F X))) \<and>
    (\<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects D.
      bm_counit A Y \<in>
        bm_hom D (bm_obj_map F (bm_obj_map G Y)) Y) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects C.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom C X Y.
        bm_compose C
            (bm_mor_map G (bm_mor_map F f)) (bm_unit A X) =
          bm_compose C (bm_unit A Y) f) \<and>
    (\<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects D. \<forall>Z \<in> bm_objects D.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom D Y Z.
        bm_compose D f (bm_counit A Y) =
          bm_compose D (bm_counit A Z)
            (bm_mor_map F (bm_mor_map G f))) \<and>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects C.
      bm_compose D (bm_counit A (bm_obj_map F X))
          (bm_mor_map F (bm_unit A X)) =
        bm_identity D (bm_obj_map F X)) \<and>
    (\<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects D.
      bm_compose C (bm_mor_map G (bm_counit A Y))
          (bm_unit A (bm_obj_map G Y)) =
        bm_identity C (bm_obj_map G Y))"

definition bm_is_coequalizer ::
    "('o, 'm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_coequalizer C f g Q q \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> bm_arrows C \<and>
    g \<in> bm_hom C (bm_source C f) (bm_target C f) \<and>
    Q \<in> bm_objects C \<and>
    q \<in> bm_hom C (bm_target C f) Q \<and>
    bm_compose C q f = bm_compose C q g \<and>
    (\<forall>R \<in> bm_objects C. \<forall>r \<in> bm_hom C (bm_target C f) R.
      bm_compose C r f = bm_compose C r g \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>!u. u \<in> bm_hom C Q R \<and> bm_compose C u q = r))"

definition bm_is_split_coequalizer ::
    "('o, 'm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'o \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> 'm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_split_coequalizer C f g Q q s t \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> bm_arrows C \<and>
    g \<in> bm_hom C (bm_source C f) (bm_target C f) \<and>
    Q \<in> bm_objects C \<and>
    q \<in> bm_hom C (bm_target C f) Q \<and>
    s \<in> bm_hom C Q (bm_target C f) \<and>
    t \<in> bm_hom C (bm_target C f) (bm_source C f) \<and>
    bm_compose C q f = bm_compose C q g \<and>
    bm_compose C q s = bm_identity C Q \<and>
    bm_compose C g t = bm_identity C (bm_target C f) \<and>
    bm_compose C f t = bm_compose C s q"

definition bm_is_G_split_pair ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      'dm \<Rightarrow> 'dm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_G_split_pair C D G f g \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> bm_arrows D \<and>
    g \<in> bm_hom D (bm_source D f) (bm_target D f) \<and>
    (\<exists>Q q s t.
      bm_is_split_coequalizer C
        (bm_mor_map G f) (bm_mor_map G g) Q q s t)"

definition bm_creates_coequalizer ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      'dm \<Rightarrow> 'dm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_creates_coequalizer C D G f g \<longleftrightarrow>
    f \<in> bm_arrows D \<and>
    g \<in> bm_hom D (bm_source D f) (bm_target D f) \<and>
    (\<forall>Q q.
      bm_is_coequalizer C (bm_mor_map G f) (bm_mor_map G g) Q q \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>Q' p i j.
        Q' \<in> bm_objects D \<and>
        p \<in> bm_hom D (bm_target D f) Q' \<and>
        bm_compose D p f = bm_compose D p g \<and>
        i \<in> bm_hom C (bm_obj_map G Q') Q \<and>
        j \<in> bm_hom C Q (bm_obj_map G Q') \<and>
        bm_compose C j i = bm_identity C (bm_obj_map G Q') \<and>
        bm_compose C i j = bm_identity C Q \<and>
        bm_compose C i (bm_mor_map G p) = q)) \<and>
    (\<forall>Q' p.
      Q' \<in> bm_objects D \<longrightarrow>
      p \<in> bm_hom D (bm_target D f) Q' \<longrightarrow>
      bm_compose D p f = bm_compose D p g \<longrightarrow>
      bm_is_coequalizer C (bm_mor_map G f) (bm_mor_map G g)
        (bm_obj_map G Q') (bm_mor_map G p) \<longrightarrow>
      bm_is_coequalizer D f g Q' p)"

definition bm_creates_G_split_coequalizers ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_creates_G_split_coequalizers C D G \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>X \<in> bm_objects D. \<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects D.
      \<forall>f \<in> bm_hom D X Y. \<forall>g \<in> bm_hom D X Y.
        bm_is_G_split_pair C D G f g \<longrightarrow>
        bm_creates_coequalizer C D G f g)"

definition bm_monad_obj ::
    "('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow> 'co \<Rightarrow> 'co" where
  "bm_monad_obj F G X = bm_obj_map G (bm_obj_map F X)"

definition bm_monad_map ::
    "('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow> 'cm \<Rightarrow> 'cm" where
  "bm_monad_map F G f = bm_mor_map G (bm_mor_map F f)"

definition bm_monad_mult ::
    "('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data \<Rightarrow> 'co \<Rightarrow> 'cm" where
  "bm_monad_mult F G A X =
    bm_mor_map G (bm_counit A (bm_obj_map F X))"

definition bm_is_algebra ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data \<Rightarrow>
      'co \<Rightarrow> 'cm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_algebra C F G A X a \<longleftrightarrow>
    X \<in> bm_objects C \<and>
    a \<in> bm_hom C (bm_monad_obj F G X) X \<and>
    bm_compose C a (bm_unit A X) = bm_identity C X \<and>
    bm_compose C a (bm_monad_mult F G A X) =
      bm_compose C a (bm_monad_map F G a)"

definition bm_is_algebra_hom ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      'co \<Rightarrow> 'cm \<Rightarrow> 'co \<Rightarrow> 'cm \<Rightarrow> 'cm \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_algebra_hom C F G X a Y b h \<longleftrightarrow>
    h \<in> bm_hom C X Y \<and>
    bm_compose C h a =
      bm_compose C b (bm_monad_map F G h)"

definition bm_comparison_structure ::
    "('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data \<Rightarrow> 'do \<Rightarrow> 'cm" where
  "bm_comparison_structure G A Y = bm_mor_map G (bm_counit A Y)"

definition bm_comparison_is_equivalence ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_comparison_is_equivalence C D F G A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects D.
      bm_is_algebra C F G A (bm_obj_map G Y)
        (bm_comparison_structure G A Y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>Y \<in> bm_objects D. \<forall>Z \<in> bm_objects D.
      bij_betw (bm_mor_map G) (bm_hom D Y Z)
        {h. bm_is_algebra_hom C F G
          (bm_obj_map G Y) (bm_comparison_structure G A Y)
          (bm_obj_map G Z) (bm_comparison_structure G A Z) h}) \<and>
    (\<forall>X a.
      bm_is_algebra C F G A X a \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>Y u v.
        Y \<in> bm_objects D \<and>
        bm_is_algebra_hom C F G X a
          (bm_obj_map G Y) (bm_comparison_structure G A Y) u \<and>
        bm_is_algebra_hom C F G
          (bm_obj_map G Y) (bm_comparison_structure G A Y) X a v \<and>
        bm_compose C v u = bm_identity C X \<and>
        bm_compose C u v = bm_identity C (bm_obj_map G Y)))"

definition bm_is_monadic_right_adjoint ::
    "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm) bm_category_data \<Rightarrow>
      ('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "bm_is_monadic_right_adjoint C D G \<longleftrightarrow>
    bm_is_category C \<and>
    bm_is_category D \<and>
    bm_is_functor D C G \<and>
    (\<exists>F A.
      bm_is_functor C D F \<and>
      bm_is_adjunction C D F G A \<and>
      bm_comparison_is_equivalence C D F G A)"

theorem beck_monadicity:
  fixes C :: "('co, 'cm) bm_category_data"
    and D :: "('do, 'dm) bm_category_data"
    and F :: "('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_functor_data"
    and G :: "('do, 'dm, 'co, 'cm) bm_functor_data"
    and A :: "('co, 'cm, 'do, 'dm) bm_adjunction_data"
  assumes "bm_is_category C"
    and "bm_is_category D"
    and "bm_is_functor C D F"
    and "bm_is_functor D C G"
    and "bm_is_adjunction C D F G A"
    and "bm_creates_G_split_coequalizers C D G"
  shows "bm_is_monadic_right_adjoint C D G"
  sorry

end

title: Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4878586,
  "Beck's monadicity theorem": a right adjoint that creates coequalizers of
  the pairs split by that functor is monadic. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q4878586_BECK_S_MONADICITY_THEOREM =
  `let Chom =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO) (x:CO) (y:CO) (f:CM).
       Cobjects x /\ Cobjects y /\ Cmorphisms f /\
       Cdom f = x /\ Ccod f = y in
   let Dhom =
     \(Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO) (x:DO) (y:DO) (f:DM).
       Dobjects x /\ Dobjects y /\ Dmorphisms f /\
       Ddom f = x /\ Dcod f = y in
   let is_C_category =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM).
       (!f:CM.
          Cmorphisms f ==> Cobjects (Cdom f) /\ Cobjects (Ccod f)) /\
       (!x:CO.
          Cobjects x
          ==> Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
                x x (Cidentity x)) /\
       (!x y z:CO. !f g:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y f /\
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod y z g
          ==> Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
                x z (Ccompose g f)) /\
       (!x y:CO. !f:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y f
          ==> Ccompose (Cidentity y) f = f /\
              Ccompose f (Cidentity x) = f) /\
       (!w x y z:CO. !f g h:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod w x f /\
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y g /\
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod y z h
          ==> Ccompose h (Ccompose g f) =
              Ccompose (Ccompose h g) f) in
   let is_D_category =
     \(Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Didentity:DO->DM) (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM).
       (!f:DM.
          Dmorphisms f ==> Dobjects (Ddom f) /\ Dobjects (Dcod f)) /\
       (!x:DO.
          Dobjects x
          ==> Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod
                x x (Didentity x)) /\
       (!x y z:DO. !f g:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f /\
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y z g
          ==> Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod
                x z (Dcompose g f)) /\
       (!x y:DO. !f:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f
          ==> Dcompose (Didentity y) f = f /\
              Dcompose f (Didentity x) = f) /\
       (!w x y z:DO. !f g h:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod w x f /\
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y g /\
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y z h
          ==> Dcompose h (Dcompose g f) =
              Dcompose (Dcompose h g) f) in
   let is_functor_F =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Didentity:DO->DM) (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM)
      (Fobject:CO->DO) (Fmorphism:CM->DM).
       (!x:CO. Cobjects x ==> Dobjects (Fobject x)) /\
       (!x y:CO. !f:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y f
          ==> Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod
                (Fobject x) (Fobject y) (Fmorphism f)) /\
       (!x:CO.
          Cobjects x
          ==> Fmorphism (Cidentity x) = Didentity (Fobject x)) /\
       (!x y z:CO. !f g:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y f /\
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod y z g
          ==> Fmorphism (Ccompose g f) =
              Dcompose (Fmorphism g) (Fmorphism f)) in
   let is_functor_G =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Didentity:DO->DM) (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM).
       (!x:DO. Dobjects x ==> Cobjects (Gobject x)) /\
       (!x y:DO. !f:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f
          ==> Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
                (Gobject x) (Gobject y) (Gmorphism f)) /\
       (!x:DO.
          Dobjects x
          ==> Gmorphism (Didentity x) = Cidentity (Gobject x)) /\
       (!x y z:DO. !f g:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f /\
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y z g
          ==> Gmorphism (Dcompose g f) =
              Ccompose (Gmorphism g) (Gmorphism f)) in
   let is_adjunction =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Didentity:DO->DM) (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM)
      (Fobject:CO->DO) (Fmorphism:CM->DM)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM)
      (unit:CO->CM) (counit:DO->DM).
       (!x:CO.
          Cobjects x
          ==> Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
                x (Gobject (Fobject x)) (unit x)) /\
       (!y:DO.
          Dobjects y
          ==> Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod
                (Fobject (Gobject y)) y (counit y)) /\
       (!x x':CO. !f:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x x' f
          ==> Ccompose
                (Gmorphism (Fmorphism f)) (unit x) =
              Ccompose (unit x') f) /\
       (!y y':DO. !g:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y y' g
          ==> Dcompose g (counit y) =
              Dcompose (counit y')
                (Fmorphism (Gmorphism g))) /\
       (!x:CO.
          Cobjects x
          ==> Dcompose (counit (Fobject x))
                (Fmorphism (unit x)) =
              Didentity (Fobject x)) /\
       (!y:DO.
          Dobjects y
          ==> Ccompose (Gmorphism (counit y))
                (unit (Gobject y)) =
              Cidentity (Gobject y)) in
   let is_C_coequalizer =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (x:CO) (y:CO) (f:CM) (g:CM) (z:CO) (q:CM).
       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y f /\
       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y g /\
       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod y z q /\
       Ccompose q f = Ccompose q g /\
       (!w:CO. !h:CM.
          Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod y w h /\
          Ccompose h f = Ccompose h g
          ==> ?u:CM.
                Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod z w u /\
                Ccompose u q = h /\
                !v:CM.
                  Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod z w v /\
                  Ccompose v q = h
                  ==> v = u) in
   let is_D_coequalizer =
     \(Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM)
      (x:DO) (y:DO) (f:DM) (g:DM) (z:DO) (q:DM).
       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f /\
       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y g /\
       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y z q /\
       Dcompose q f = Dcompose q g /\
       (!w:DO. !h:DM.
          Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y w h /\
          Dcompose h f = Dcompose h g
          ==> ?u:DM.
                Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod z w u /\
                Dcompose u q = h /\
                !v:DM.
                  Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod z w v /\
                  Dcompose v q = h
                  ==> v = u) in
   let is_G_split_pair =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM)
      (x:DO) (y:DO) (f:DM) (g:DM).
       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f /\
       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y g /\
       ?z:CO. ?q section retract:CM.
         Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
           (Gobject y) z q /\
         Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
           z (Gobject y) section /\
         Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
           (Gobject y) (Gobject x) retract /\
         Ccompose q (Gmorphism f) =
           Ccompose q (Gmorphism g) /\
         Ccompose q section = Cidentity z /\
         Ccompose (Gmorphism g) retract =
           Cidentity (Gobject y) /\
         Ccompose (Gmorphism f) retract =
           Ccompose section q in
   let creates_G_split_coequalizers =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM).
       !x y:DO. !f g:DM.
         is_G_split_pair
           Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
           Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod
           Gobject Gmorphism x y f g
         ==> ((!w:DO. !r:DM.
                 Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y w r /\
                 Dcompose r f = Dcompose r g /\
                 is_C_coequalizer
                   Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Ccompose
                   (Gobject x) (Gobject y)
                   (Gmorphism f) (Gmorphism g)
                   (Gobject w) (Gmorphism r)
                 ==> is_D_coequalizer
                       Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Dcompose
                       x y f g w r) /\
              (!z:CO. !q:CM.
                 is_C_coequalizer
                   Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Ccompose
                   (Gobject x) (Gobject y)
                   (Gmorphism f) (Gmorphism g) z q
                 ==> ?w:DO. ?r:DM. ?i j:CM.
                       Dobjects w /\
                       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod y w r /\
                       Dcompose r f = Dcompose r g /\
                       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
                         (Gobject w) z i /\
                       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
                         z (Gobject w) j /\
                       Ccompose j i = Cidentity (Gobject w) /\
                       Ccompose i j = Cidentity z /\
                       Ccompose i (Gmorphism r) = q)) in
   let is_algebra =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Fobject:CO->DO) (Fmorphism:CM->DM)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM)
      (unit:CO->CM) (counit:DO->DM)
      (x:CO) (action:CM).
       Cobjects x /\
       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod
         (Gobject (Fobject x)) x action /\
       Ccompose action (unit x) = Cidentity x /\
       Ccompose action (Gmorphism (Fmorphism action)) =
         Ccompose action (Gmorphism (counit (Fobject x))) in
   let is_algebra_morphism =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Fmorphism:CM->DM) (Gmorphism:DM->CM)
      (x:CO) (action_x:CM) (y:CO) (action_y:CM) (h:CM).
       Chom Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod x y h /\
       Ccompose h action_x =
         Ccompose action_y (Gmorphism (Fmorphism h)) in
   let is_monadic_for_adjunction =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Fobject:CO->DO) (Fmorphism:CM->DM)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM)
      (unit:CO->CM) (counit:DO->DM).
       (!x y:DO.
          Dobjects x /\ Dobjects y
          ==> (!f:DM.
                 Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f
                 ==> is_algebra_morphism
                       Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Ccompose
                       Fmorphism Gmorphism
                       (Gobject x) (Gmorphism (counit x))
                       (Gobject y) (Gmorphism (counit y))
                       (Gmorphism f)) /\
              (!h:CM.
                 is_algebra_morphism
                   Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Ccompose
                   Fmorphism Gmorphism
                   (Gobject x) (Gmorphism (counit x))
                   (Gobject y) (Gmorphism (counit y)) h
                 ==> ?f:DM.
                       Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y f /\
                       Gmorphism f = h /\
                       !g:DM.
                         Dhom Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod x y g /\
                         Gmorphism g = h
                         ==> g = f)) /\
       (!x:CO. !action:CM.
          is_algebra
            Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
            Fobject Fmorphism Gobject Gmorphism unit counit
            x action
          ==> ?y:DO. ?p q:CM.
                Dobjects y /\
                is_algebra_morphism
                  Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Ccompose
                  Fmorphism Gmorphism
                  x action
                  (Gobject y) (Gmorphism (counit y)) p /\
                is_algebra_morphism
                  Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Ccompose
                  Fmorphism Gmorphism
                  (Gobject y) (Gmorphism (counit y))
                  x action q /\
                Ccompose q p = Cidentity x /\
                Ccompose p q = Cidentity (Gobject y)) in
   let is_monadic_right_adjoint =
     \(Cobjects:CO->bool) (Cmorphisms:CM->bool)
      (Cdom:CM->CO) (Ccod:CM->CO)
      (Cidentity:CO->CM) (Ccompose:CM->CM->CM)
      (Dobjects:DO->bool) (Dmorphisms:DM->bool)
      (Ddom:DM->DO) (Dcod:DM->DO)
      (Didentity:DO->DM) (Dcompose:DM->DM->DM)
      (Gobject:DO->CO) (Gmorphism:DM->CM).
       ?Fobject:CO->DO. ?Fmorphism:CM->DM.
       ?unit:CO->CM. ?counit:DO->DM.
         is_functor_F
           Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
           Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose
           Fobject Fmorphism /\
         is_adjunction
           Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
           Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose
           Fobject Fmorphism Gobject Gmorphism unit counit /\
         is_monadic_for_adjunction
           Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
           Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod
           Fobject Fmorphism Gobject Gmorphism unit counit in
   !Cobjects:CO->bool. !Cmorphisms:CM->bool.
   !Cdom:CM->CO. !Ccod:CM->CO.
   !Cidentity:CO->CM. !Ccompose:CM->CM->CM.
   !Dobjects:DO->bool. !Dmorphisms:DM->bool.
   !Ddom:DM->DO. !Dcod:DM->DO.
   !Didentity:DO->DM. !Dcompose:DM->DM->DM.
   !Fobject:CO->DO. !Fmorphism:CM->DM.
   !Gobject:DO->CO. !Gmorphism:DM->CM.
   !unit:CO->CM. !counit:DO->DM.
     is_C_category
       Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose /\
     is_D_category
       Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose /\
     is_functor_F
       Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
       Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose
       Fobject Fmorphism /\
     is_functor_G
       Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
       Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose
       Gobject Gmorphism /\
     is_adjunction
       Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
       Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose
       Fobject Fmorphism Gobject Gmorphism unit counit /\
     creates_G_split_coequalizers
       Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
       Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Dcompose
       Gobject Gmorphism
     ==> is_monadic_right_adjoint
           Cobjects Cmorphisms Cdom Ccod Cidentity Ccompose
           Dobjects Dmorphisms Ddom Dcod Didentity Dcompose
           Gobject Gmorphism`;;

title: Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4878586,
;; "Beck's monadicity theorem": a right adjoint that creates coequalizers of
;; its G-split pairs is monadic, meaning that it admits a left adjoint whose
;; comparison functor is an equivalence. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Categories and functors are represented by tame function objects over
;; arbitrary ACL2 objects. DEFUN-SK retains all universal-property and
;; essential-surjectivity witnesses inside their source quantifier scopes.

(defun q4878586-app1 (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun q4878586-app2 (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun q4878586-object-p (objects x)
  (and (tamep-functionp objects)
       (q4878586-app1 objects x)))

(defun q4878586-morphism-p (morphisms f)
  (and (tamep-functionp morphisms)
       (q4878586-app1 morphisms f)))

(defun q4878586-hom-p (morphisms domain codomain f x y)
  (and (q4878586-morphism-p morphisms f)
       (equal (q4878586-app1 domain f) x)
       (equal (q4878586-app1 codomain f) y)))

(defun q4878586-category-law-at
    (objects morphisms domain codomain identity compose tuple)
  (let* ((w (nth 0 tuple))
         (x (nth 1 tuple))
         (y (nth 2 tuple))
         (z (nth 3 tuple))
         (f (nth 4 tuple))
         (g (nth 5 tuple))
         (h (nth 6 tuple))
         (df (q4878586-app1 domain f))
         (cf (q4878586-app1 codomain f)))
    (and
     (implies
      (q4878586-object-p objects x)
      (q4878586-hom-p
       morphisms domain codomain
       (q4878586-app1 identity x) x x))
     (implies
      (q4878586-morphism-p morphisms f)
      (and
       (q4878586-object-p objects df)
       (q4878586-object-p objects cf)
       (equal
        (q4878586-app2
         compose (q4878586-app1 identity cf) f)
        f)
       (equal
        (q4878586-app2
         compose f (q4878586-app1 identity df))
        f)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4878586-hom-p morphisms domain codomain f x y)
       (q4878586-hom-p morphisms domain codomain g y z))
      (q4878586-hom-p
       morphisms domain codomain
       (q4878586-app2 compose g f) x z))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4878586-hom-p morphisms domain codomain f w x)
       (q4878586-hom-p morphisms domain codomain g x y)
       (q4878586-hom-p morphisms domain codomain h y z))
      (equal
       (q4878586-app2
        compose h (q4878586-app2 compose g f))
       (q4878586-app2
        compose (q4878586-app2 compose h g) f))))))

(defun-sk q4878586-category-laws-p
    (objects morphisms domain codomain identity compose)
  (forall (tuple)
    (q4878586-category-law-at
     objects morphisms domain codomain identity compose tuple)))

(defun q4878586-category-p
    (objects morphisms domain codomain identity compose)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp objects)
   (tamep-functionp morphisms)
   (tamep-functionp domain)
   (tamep-functionp codomain)
   (tamep-functionp identity)
   (tamep-functionp compose)
   (q4878586-category-laws-p
    objects morphisms domain codomain identity compose)))

(defun q4878586-functor-law-at
    (source-objects source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain
     source-identity source-compose
     target-objects target-morphisms target-domain target-codomain
     target-identity target-compose object-map morphism-map tuple)
  (let* ((x (nth 0 tuple))
         (y (nth 1 tuple))
         (z (nth 2 tuple))
         (f (nth 3 tuple))
         (g (nth 4 tuple))
         (fx (q4878586-app1 object-map x))
         (fy (q4878586-app1 object-map y))
         (fz (q4878586-app1 object-map z))
         (ff (q4878586-app1 morphism-map f))
         (fg (q4878586-app1 morphism-map g)))
    (and
     (implies
      (q4878586-object-p source-objects x)
      (and
       (q4878586-object-p target-objects fx)
       (equal
        (q4878586-app1
         morphism-map (q4878586-app1 source-identity x))
        (q4878586-app1 target-identity fx))))
     (implies
      (q4878586-hom-p
       source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain f x y)
      (q4878586-hom-p
       target-morphisms target-domain target-codomain ff fx fy))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4878586-hom-p
        source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain f x y)
       (q4878586-hom-p
        source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain g y z))
      (equal
       (q4878586-app1
        morphism-map (q4878586-app2 source-compose g f))
       (q4878586-app2 target-compose fg ff)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4878586-object-p source-objects x)
       (q4878586-object-p source-objects y)
       (q4878586-object-p source-objects z))
      (and
       (q4878586-object-p target-objects fx)
       (q4878586-object-p target-objects fy)
       (q4878586-object-p target-objects fz))))))

(defun-sk q4878586-functor-laws-p
    (source-objects source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain
     source-identity source-compose
     target-objects target-morphisms target-domain target-codomain
     target-identity target-compose object-map morphism-map)
  (forall (tuple)
    (q4878586-functor-law-at
     source-objects source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain
     source-identity source-compose
     target-objects target-morphisms target-domain target-codomain
     target-identity target-compose object-map morphism-map tuple)))

(defun q4878586-functor-p
    (source-objects source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain
     source-identity source-compose
     target-objects target-morphisms target-domain target-codomain
     target-identity target-compose object-map morphism-map)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp object-map)
   (tamep-functionp morphism-map)
   (q4878586-functor-laws-p
    source-objects source-morphisms source-domain source-codomain
    source-identity source-compose
    target-objects target-morphisms target-domain target-codomain
    target-identity target-compose object-map morphism-map)))

(defun q4878586-adjunction-law-at
    (c-objects c-morphisms c-domain c-codomain c-identity c-compose
     d-objects d-morphisms d-domain d-codomain d-identity d-compose
     f-object f-morphism g-object g-morphism unit counit tuple)
  (let* ((x (nth 0 tuple))
         (y (nth 1 tuple))
         (u (nth 2 tuple))
         (v (nth 3 tuple))
         (cf (nth 4 tuple))
         (df (nth 5 tuple))
         (fx (q4878586-app1 f-object x))
         (gu (q4878586-app1 g-object u))
         (eta-x (q4878586-app1 unit x))
         (eta-y (q4878586-app1 unit y))
         (eps-u (q4878586-app1 counit u))
         (eps-v (q4878586-app1 counit v)))
    (and
     (implies
      (q4878586-object-p c-objects x)
      (q4878586-hom-p
       c-morphisms c-domain c-codomain eta-x x
       (q4878586-app1 g-object fx)))
     (implies
      (q4878586-hom-p c-morphisms c-domain c-codomain cf x y)
      (equal
       (q4878586-app2 c-compose eta-y cf)
       (q4878586-app2
        c-compose
        (q4878586-app1
         g-morphism (q4878586-app1 f-morphism cf))
        eta-x)))
     (implies
      (q4878586-object-p d-objects u)
      (q4878586-hom-p
       d-morphisms d-domain d-codomain eps-u
       (q4878586-app1 f-object gu) u))
     (implies
      (q4878586-hom-p d-morphisms d-domain d-codomain df u v)
      (equal
       (q4878586-app2
        d-compose eps-v
        (q4878586-app1
         f-morphism (q4878586-app1 g-morphism df)))
       (q4878586-app2 d-compose df eps-u)))
     (implies
      (q4878586-object-p c-objects x)
      (equal

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 2 _×_

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Category
  {o h : Level}
  (Object : Set o) :
  Set (o ⊔ lsuc h) where

  infixr 7 _after_

  field
    Hom      : Object → Object → Set h
    identity : (A : Object) → Hom A A
    _after_  :
      {A B C : Object} →
      Hom B C →
      Hom A B →
      Hom A C
    compose-associative :
      {A B C D : Object} →
      (f : Hom C D) →
      (g : Hom B C) →
      (k : Hom A B) →
      f after (g after k) ≡ (f after g) after k
    identity-left :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      identity B after f ≡ f
    identity-right :
      {A B : Object} →
      (f : Hom A B) →
      f after identity A ≡ f

record Functor
  {oC hC oD hD : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  (C : Category {oC} {hC} CObject)
  (D : Category {oD} {hD} DObject) :
  Set (oC ⊔ hC ⊔ oD ⊔ hD) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module D = Category D

  field
    object : CObject → DObject
    arrow  :
      {A B : CObject} →
      C.Hom A B →
      D.Hom (object A) (object B)
    map-identity :
      (A : CObject) →
      arrow (C.identity A) ≡ D.identity (object A)
    map-compose :
      {A B E : CObject} →
      (f : C.Hom B E) →
      (g : C.Hom A B) →
      arrow (C._after_ f g) ≡
      D._after_ (arrow f) (arrow g)

record CategoryIso
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (C : Category {o} {h} Object)
  (A B : Object) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C

  field
    forward  : C.Hom A B
    backward : C.Hom B A
    backward-after-forward :
      C._after_ backward forward ≡
      C.identity A
    forward-after-backward :
      C._after_ forward backward ≡
      C.identity B

record IsCoequalizer
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (C : Category {o} {h} Object)
  {A B Q : Object}
  (f g : Category.Hom C A B)
  (quotient : Category.Hom C B Q) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C

  field
    coequalizes :
      C._after_ quotient f ≡
      C._after_ quotient g
    universal :
      (X : Object) →
      (candidate : C.Hom B X) →
      C._after_ candidate f ≡
      C._after_ candidate g →
      Σ (C.Hom Q X)
        (λ factor →
          C._after_ factor quotient ≡ candidate
          ×
          ((other : C.Hom Q X) →
            C._after_ other quotient ≡ candidate →
            other ≡ factor))

record SplitCoequalizer
  {o h : Level}
  {Object : Set o}
  (C : Category {o} {h} Object)
  {A B : Object}
  (f g : Category.Hom C A B) :
  Set (o ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C

  field
    object    : Object
    quotient  : C.Hom B object
    section   : C.Hom object B
    splitting : C.Hom B A

    coequalizes :
      C._after_ quotient f ≡
      C._after_ quotient g
    quotient-section :
      C._after_ quotient section ≡
      C.identity object
    first-splitting :
      C._after_ f splitting ≡
      C.identity B
    second-splitting :
      C._after_ g splitting ≡
      C._after_ section quotient

record CreatedCoequalizer
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  (C : Category {oC} {h} CObject)
  (D : Category {oD} {h} DObject)
  (G : Functor D C)
  {A B : DObject}
  (f g : Category.Hom D A B)
  {target : CObject}
  (target-quotient :
    Category.Hom C (Functor.object G B) target) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module D = Category D
    module G = Functor G

  field
    object   : DObject
    quotient : D.Hom B object
    is-coequalizer :
      IsCoequalizer D f g quotient
    image-comparison :
      CategoryIso C (G.object object) target
    image-quotient :
      C._after_
        (CategoryIso.forward image-comparison)
        (G.arrow quotient)
      ≡
      target-quotient

record CreatesGSplitCoequalizers
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  (C : Category {oC} {h} CObject)
  (D : Category {oD} {h} DObject)
  (G : Functor D C) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module D = Category D
    module G = Functor G

  field
    lifts-coequalizers :
      {A B : DObject} →
      (f g : D.Hom A B) →
      SplitCoequalizer C (G.arrow f) (G.arrow g) →
      {target : CObject} →
      (target-quotient : C.Hom (G.object B) target) →
      IsCoequalizer C
        (G.arrow f)
        (G.arrow g)
        target-quotient →
      CreatedCoequalizer C D G f g target-quotient

    reflects-coequalizers :
      {A B Q : DObject} →
      (f g : D.Hom A B) →
      SplitCoequalizer C (G.arrow f) (G.arrow g) →
      (quotient : D.Hom B Q) →
      D._after_ quotient f ≡
      D._after_ quotient g →
      IsCoequalizer C
        (G.arrow f)
        (G.arrow g)
        (G.arrow quotient) →
      IsCoequalizer D f g quotient

record Adjunction
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  (C : Category {oC} {h} CObject)
  (D : Category {oD} {h} DObject)
  (F : Functor C D)
  (G : Functor D C) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module D = Category D
    module F = Functor F
    module G = Functor G

  field
    unit :
      (A : CObject) →
      C.Hom A (G.object (F.object A))
    unit-natural :
      {A B : CObject} →
      (f : C.Hom A B) →
      C._after_ (G.arrow (F.arrow f)) (unit A) ≡
      C._after_ (unit B) f

    counit :
      (A : DObject) →
      D.Hom (F.object (G.object A)) A
    counit-natural :
      {A B : DObject} →
      (f : D.Hom A B) →
      D._after_ f (counit A) ≡
      D._after_ (counit B) (F.arrow (G.arrow f))

    left-triangle :
      (A : CObject) →
      D._after_
        (counit (F.object A))
        (F.arrow (unit A))
      ≡
      D.identity (F.object A)
    right-triangle :
      (A : DObject) →
      C._after_
        (G.arrow (counit A))
        (unit (G.object A))
      ≡
      C.identity (G.object A)

record AdjunctionAlgebra
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  {C : Category {oC} {h} CObject}
  {D : Category {oD} {h} DObject}
  {F : Functor C D}
  {G : Functor D C}
  (adjunction : Adjunction C D F G) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module F = Functor F
    module G = Functor G
    module A = Adjunction adjunction

  field
    carrier : CObject
    action :
      C.Hom
        (G.object (F.object carrier))
        carrier
    unit-law :
      C._after_ action (A.unit carrier) ≡
      C.identity carrier
    associativity-law :
      C._after_
        action
        (G.arrow (F.arrow action))
      ≡
      C._after_
        action
        (G.arrow (A.counit (F.object carrier)))

AlgebraHom :
  {oC oD h : Level} →
  {CObject : Set oC} →
  {DObject : Set oD} →
  {C : Category {oC} {h} CObject} →
  {D : Category {oD} {h} DObject} →
  {F : Functor C D} →
  {G : Functor D C} →
  (adjunction : Adjunction C D F G) →
  (A B : AdjunctionAlgebra adjunction) →
  Category.Hom C
    (AdjunctionAlgebra.carrier A)
    (AdjunctionAlgebra.carrier B) →
  Set h
AlgebraHom {C = C} {F = F} {G = G} adjunction A B f =
  Category._after_ C f (AdjunctionAlgebra.action A) ≡
  Category._after_ C
    (AdjunctionAlgebra.action B)
    (Functor.arrow G (Functor.arrow F f))

ComparisonHom :
  {oC oD h : Level} →
  {CObject : Set oC} →
  {DObject : Set oD} →
  {C : Category {oC} {h} CObject} →
  {D : Category {oD} {h} DObject} →
  {F : Functor C D} →
  {G : Functor D C} →
  (adjunction : Adjunction C D F G) →
  (A B : DObject) →
  Category.Hom C
    (Functor.object G A)
    (Functor.object G B) →
  Set h
ComparisonHom {C = C} {F = F} {G = G} adjunction A B f =
  Category._after_ C
    f
    (Functor.arrow G (Adjunction.counit adjunction A))
  ≡
  Category._after_ C
    (Functor.arrow G (Adjunction.counit adjunction B))
    (Functor.arrow G (Functor.arrow F f))

record AlgebraIsoToComparison
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  {C : Category {oC} {h} CObject}
  {D : Category {oD} {h} DObject}
  {F : Functor C D}
  {G : Functor D C}
  (adjunction : Adjunction C D F G)
  (algebra : AdjunctionAlgebra adjunction)
  (object : DObject) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module F = Functor F
    module G = Functor G
    module A = Adjunction adjunction
    module X = AdjunctionAlgebra algebra

  field
    forward  : C.Hom X.carrier (G.object object)
    backward : C.Hom (G.object object) X.carrier

    forward-is-algebra-hom :
      C._after_ forward X.action ≡
      C._after_
        (G.arrow (A.counit object))
        (G.arrow (F.arrow forward))
    backward-is-algebra-hom :
      C._after_
        backward
        (G.arrow (A.counit object))
      ≡
      C._after_
        X.action
        (G.arrow (F.arrow backward))

    backward-after-forward :
      C._after_ backward forward ≡
      C.identity X.carrier
    forward-after-backward :
      C._after_ forward backward ≡
      C.identity (G.object object)

record ComparisonIsEquivalence
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  (C : Category {oC} {h} CObject)
  (D : Category {oD} {h} DObject)
  (F : Functor C D)
  (G : Functor D C)
  (adjunction : Adjunction C D F G) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  private
    module C = Category C
    module D = Category D
    module F = Functor F
    module G = Functor G

  field
    faithful :
      {A B : DObject} →
      (f g : D.Hom A B) →
      G.arrow f ≡ G.arrow g →
      f ≡ g

    full :
      {A B : DObject} →
      (f : C.Hom (G.object A) (G.object B)) →
      ComparisonHom adjunction A B f →
      Σ (D.Hom A B)
        (λ lift → G.arrow lift ≡ f)

    essentially-surjective :
      (algebra : AdjunctionAlgebra adjunction) →
      Σ DObject
        (λ object →
          AlgebraIsoToComparison adjunction algebra object)

record MonadicRightAdjoint
  {oC oD h : Level}
  {CObject : Set oC}
  {DObject : Set oD}
  (C : Category {oC} {h} CObject)
  (D : Category {oD} {h} DObject)
  (G : Functor D C) :
  Set (oC ⊔ oD ⊔ h) where

  field
    left-adjoint : Functor C D
    adjunction :
      Adjunction C D left-adjoint G
    comparison-is-equivalence :
      ComparisonIsEquivalence
        C D left-adjoint G adjunction

beck-s-monadicity-theorem : Setω
beck-s-monadicity-theorem =
  ∀ {oC oD h : Level} →
  (CObject : Set oC) →
  (DObject : Set oD) →
  (C : Category {oC} {h} CObject) →
  (D : Category {oD} {h} DObject) →
  (G : Functor D C) →
  (F : Functor C D) →
  Adjunction C D F G →
  CreatesGSplitCoequalizers C D G →
  MonadicRightAdjoint C D G

title: Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4878586, "Beck's monadicity theorem": a right adjoint that creates
  coequalizers of all pairs split by the right adjoint is monadic.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory;

val q4878586_category_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_category_def",
  ``q4878586_category
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (id : 'o -> 'm) (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm) <=>
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==> dom f IN objects /\ cod f IN objects) /\
      (!x. x IN objects ==>
        id x IN morphisms /\ dom (id x) = x /\ cod (id x) = x) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ cod f = dom g
        ==>
        comp g f IN morphisms /\
        dom (comp g f) = dom f /\
        cod (comp g f) = cod g) /\
      (!f. f IN morphisms ==>
        comp f (id (dom f)) = f /\
        comp (id (cod f)) f = f) /\
      (!f g h.
        f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\ h IN morphisms /\
        cod f = dom g /\ cod g = dom h
        ==>
        comp h (comp g f) = comp (comp h g) f)``);

val q4878586_functor_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_functor_def",
  ``q4878586_functor
      (src_objects : 'o1 set) (src_morphisms : 'm1 set)
      (src_dom : 'm1 -> 'o1) (src_cod : 'm1 -> 'o1)
      (src_id : 'o1 -> 'm1) (src_comp : 'm1 -> 'm1 -> 'm1)
      (dst_objects : 'o2 set) (dst_morphisms : 'm2 set)
      (dst_dom : 'm2 -> 'o2) (dst_cod : 'm2 -> 'o2)
      (dst_id : 'o2 -> 'm2) (dst_comp : 'm2 -> 'm2 -> 'm2)
      (obj_map : 'o1 -> 'o2) (mor_map : 'm1 -> 'm2) <=>
      (!x. x IN src_objects ==> obj_map x IN dst_objects) /\
      (!f. f IN src_morphisms ==>
        mor_map f IN dst_morphisms /\
        dst_dom (mor_map f) = obj_map (src_dom f) /\
        dst_cod (mor_map f) = obj_map (src_cod f)) /\
      (!x. x IN src_objects ==>
        mor_map (src_id x) = dst_id (obj_map x)) /\
      (!f g.
        f IN src_morphisms /\ g IN src_morphisms /\
        src_cod f = src_dom g
        ==>
        mor_map (src_comp g f) = dst_comp (mor_map g) (mor_map f))``);

val q4878586_adjunction_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_adjunction_def",
  ``q4878586_adjunction
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (dobjects : 'do set) (dmorphisms : 'dm set)
      (ddom : 'dm -> 'do) (dcod : 'dm -> 'do)
      (did : 'do -> 'dm) (dcomp : 'dm -> 'dm -> 'dm)
      (fobj : 'co -> 'do) (fmap : 'cm -> 'dm)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (unit : 'co -> 'cm) (counit : 'do -> 'dm) <=>
      (!x. x IN cobjects ==>
        unit x IN cmorphisms /\
        cdom (unit x) = x /\
        ccod (unit x) = gobj (fobj x)) /\
      (!h. h IN cmorphisms ==>
        ccomp (gmap (fmap h)) (unit (cdom h)) =
          ccomp (unit (ccod h)) h) /\
      (!y. y IN dobjects ==>
        counit y IN dmorphisms /\
        ddom (counit y) = fobj (gobj y) /\
        dcod (counit y) = y) /\
      (!h. h IN dmorphisms ==>
        dcomp (counit (dcod h)) (fmap (gmap h)) =
          dcomp h (counit (ddom h))) /\
      (!x. x IN cobjects ==>
        dcomp (counit (fobj x)) (fmap (unit x)) = did (fobj x)) /\
      (!y. y IN dobjects ==>
        ccomp (gmap (counit y)) (unit (gobj y)) = cid (gobj y))``);

val q4878586_parallel_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_parallel_def",
  ``q4878586_parallel
      (morphisms : 'm set) (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (f : 'm) (g : 'm) <=>
      f IN morphisms /\ g IN morphisms /\
      dom f = dom g /\ cod f = cod g``);

val q4878586_coequalizer_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_coequalizer_def",
  ``q4878586_coequalizer
      (objects : 'o set) (morphisms : 'm set)
      (dom : 'm -> 'o) (cod : 'm -> 'o)
      (comp : 'm -> 'm -> 'm)
      (f : 'm) (g : 'm) (q : 'm) <=>
      q4878586_parallel morphisms dom cod f g /\
      q IN morphisms /\ dom q = cod f /\
      comp q f = comp q g /\
      !w h.
        w IN objects /\ h IN morphisms /\
        dom h = cod f /\ cod h = w /\
        comp h f = comp h g
        ==>
        ?u. u IN morphisms /\
            dom u = cod q /\ cod u = w /\
            comp u q = h /\
            !v. v IN morphisms /\
                dom v = cod q /\ cod v = w /\
                comp v q = h
                ==> v = u``);

val q4878586_g_split_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_g_split_pair_def",
  ``q4878586_g_split_pair
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (dmorphisms : 'dm set)
      (ddom : 'dm -> 'do) (dcod : 'dm -> 'do)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (f : 'dm) (g : 'dm) <=>
      q4878586_parallel dmorphisms ddom dcod f g /\
      ?z q s t.
        z IN cobjects /\
        q IN cmorphisms /\
        cdom q = gobj (dcod f) /\ ccod q = z /\
        s IN cmorphisms /\
        cdom s = z /\ ccod s = gobj (dcod f) /\
        t IN cmorphisms /\
        cdom t = gobj (dcod f) /\ ccod t = gobj (ddom f) /\
        ccomp q (gmap f) = ccomp q (gmap g) /\
        ccomp q s = cid z /\
        ccomp (gmap g) t = cid (gobj (dcod f)) /\
        ccomp (gmap f) t = ccomp s q``);

val q4878586_creates_coequalizer_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_creates_coequalizer_def",
  ``q4878586_creates_coequalizer
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (dobjects : 'do set) (dmorphisms : 'dm set)
      (ddom : 'dm -> 'do) (dcod : 'dm -> 'do)
      (dcomp : 'dm -> 'dm -> 'dm)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (f : 'dm) (g : 'dm) <=>
      (!q.
        q IN dmorphisms /\ ddom q = dcod f /\
        dcomp q f = dcomp q g /\
        q4878586_coequalizer
          cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod ccomp
          (gmap f) (gmap g) (gmap q)
        ==>
        q4878586_coequalizer
          dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod dcomp f g q) /\
      (!q.
        q4878586_coequalizer
          cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod ccomp
          (gmap f) (gmap g) q
        ==>
        ?w r i j.
          w IN dobjects /\
          r IN dmorphisms /\
          ddom r = dcod f /\ dcod r = w /\
          dcomp r f = dcomp r g /\
          i IN cmorphisms /\
          cdom i = gobj w /\ ccod i = ccod q /\
          j IN cmorphisms /\
          cdom j = ccod q /\ ccod j = gobj w /\
          ccomp j i = cid (gobj w) /\
          ccomp i j = cid (ccod q) /\
          ccomp i (gmap r) = q)``);

val q4878586_creates_g_split_coequalizers_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_creates_g_split_coequalizers_def",
  ``q4878586_creates_g_split_coequalizers
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (dobjects : 'do set) (dmorphisms : 'dm set)
      (ddom : 'dm -> 'do) (dcod : 'dm -> 'do)
      (dcomp : 'dm -> 'dm -> 'dm)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm) <=>
      !f g.
        q4878586_g_split_pair
          cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp
          dmorphisms ddom dcod gobj gmap f g
        ==>
        q4878586_creates_coequalizer
          cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp
          dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod dcomp
          gobj gmap f g``);

val q4878586_algebra_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_algebra_def",
  ``q4878586_algebra
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (fobj : 'co -> 'do) (fmap : 'cm -> 'dm)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (unit : 'co -> 'cm) (counit : 'do -> 'dm)
      (aobj : 'co) (action : 'cm) <=>
      aobj IN cobjects /\
      action IN cmorphisms /\
      cdom action = gobj (fobj aobj) /\
      ccod action = aobj /\
      ccomp action (unit aobj) = cid aobj /\
      ccomp action (gmap (counit (fobj aobj))) =
        ccomp action (gmap (fmap action))``);

val q4878586_algebra_hom_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_algebra_hom_def",
  ``q4878586_algebra_hom
      (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (fmap : 'cm -> 'dm) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (aobj : 'co) (action_a : 'cm)
      (bobj : 'co) (action_b : 'cm) (h : 'cm) <=>
      h IN cmorphisms /\
      cdom h = aobj /\ ccod h = bobj /\
      ccomp action_b (gmap (fmap h)) =
        ccomp h action_a``);

val q4878586_algebra_iso_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_algebra_iso_def",
  ``q4878586_algebra_iso
      (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (fmap : 'cm -> 'dm) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (aobj : 'co) (action_a : 'cm)
      (bobj : 'co) (action_b : 'cm) <=>
      ?h k.
        q4878586_algebra_hom
          cmorphisms cdom ccod ccomp fmap gmap
          aobj action_a bobj action_b h /\
        q4878586_algebra_hom
          cmorphisms cdom ccod ccomp fmap gmap
          bobj action_b aobj action_a k /\
        ccomp k h = cid aobj /\
        ccomp h k = cid bobj``);

val q4878586_comparison_equivalence_def = new_definition (
  "q4878586_comparison_equivalence_def",
  ``q4878586_comparison_equivalence
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (dobjects : 'do set) (dmorphisms : 'dm set)
      (ddom : 'dm -> 'do) (dcod : 'dm -> 'do)
      (fobj : 'co -> 'do) (fmap : 'cm -> 'dm)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (unit : 'co -> 'cm) (counit : 'do -> 'dm) <=>
      (!x y h k.
        x IN dobjects /\ y IN dobjects /\
        h IN dmorphisms /\ k IN dmorphisms /\
        ddom h = x /\ dcod h = y /\
        ddom k = x /\ dcod k = y /\
        gmap h = gmap k
        ==> h = k) /\
      (!x y h.
        x IN dobjects /\ y IN dobjects /\
        q4878586_algebra_hom
          cmorphisms cdom ccod ccomp fmap gmap
          (gobj x) (gmap (counit x))
          (gobj y) (gmap (counit y)) h
        ==>
        ?k. k IN dmorphisms /\
            ddom k = x /\ dcod k = y /\
            gmap k = h) /\
      (!aobj action.
        q4878586_algebra
          cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp
          fobj fmap gobj gmap unit counit aobj action
        ==>
        ?x. x IN dobjects /\
            q4878586_algebra_iso
              cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp fmap gmap
              (gobj x) (gmap (counit x)) aobj action)``);

  "q4878586_monadic_right_adjoint_def",
  ``q4878586_monadic_right_adjoint
      (cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
