        q4878586_comparison_equivalence
          cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp

val becks_monadicity_theorem =
  ``!(cobjects : 'co set) (cmorphisms : 'cm set)
      (cdom : 'cm -> 'co) (ccod : 'cm -> 'co)
      (cid : 'co -> 'cm) (ccomp : 'cm -> 'cm -> 'cm)
      (dobjects : 'do set) (dmorphisms : 'dm set)
      (ddom : 'dm -> 'do) (dcod : 'dm -> 'do)
      (did : 'do -> 'dm) (dcomp : 'dm -> 'dm -> 'dm)
      (fobj : 'co -> 'do) (fmap : 'cm -> 'dm)
      (gobj : 'do -> 'co) (gmap : 'dm -> 'cm)
      (unit : 'co -> 'cm) (counit : 'do -> 'dm).
      q4878586_category
        cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp /\
      q4878586_category
        dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod did dcomp /\
      q4878586_functor
        cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp

        fobj fmap /\
      q4878586_functor
        dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod did dcomp
        cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp
        gobj gmap /\
      q4878586_adjunction

        dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod did dcomp
        fobj fmap gobj gmap unit counit /\
      q4878586_creates_g_split_coequalizers
        cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp
        dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod dcomp

        cobjects cmorphisms cdom ccod cid ccomp
        dobjects dmorphisms ddom dcod did dcomp

title: Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4878586
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q4878586), "Beck's monadicity theorem": a
  right adjoint that creates coequalizers of every pair whose image under it
  has a split coequalizer is monadic. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  C and D are arbitrary SetMM categories, and F and G are native SetMM
  functors. Q4878586Adjunction expands unit and counit naturality and both
  triangle identities. Q4878586SplitCoequalizer and Q4878586Coequalizer state
  the usual split and universal properties without bounding any carrier.

  Q4878586CreatesGSplitCoequalizers says that every displayed split
  coequalizer of the image of a parallel pair lifts to a coequalizer in D,
  with its image identified with the displayed coequalizer by an isomorphism,
  and that G reflects the coequalizer universal property from every cofork on
  such a pair. These lifting and reflection clauses are the standard creation
  property specialized to G-split parallel pairs.

  Q4878586Algebra is an Eilenberg-Moore algebra for the monad induced by an
  adjunction. Q4878586ComparisonEquivalence expands full faithfulness and
  essential surjectivity of the comparison functor. Thus
  Q4878586MonadicRightAdjoint is definitionally the existence of a left
  adjoint whose comparison functor is an equivalence.

  Every declaration before the final assertion is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a assertion is the single unproved corpus statement;
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q4878586Obj Q4878586Map Q4878586Comp Q4878586Id $.
$c Q4878586Coequalizer Q4878586SplitCoequalizer
   Q4878586CreatesGSplitCoequalizers $.
$c Q4878586Adjunction Q4878586Algebra Q4878586AlgebraHom
   Q4878586ComparisonHom Q4878586ComparisonEquivalence
   Q4878586MonadicRightAdjoint $.

${
  $d A B C Q X f g h q u v $.

  q4878586-coequalizer-definition $a |- (
    Q4878586Coequalizer C A B f g Q q
  ) <->
  (
    (
      C e. Cat
      /\
      (
        A e. ( Base ` C )
        /\
        (
          B e. ( Base ` C )
          /\
          Q e. ( Base ` C )
        )

    )
    /\
    (
      (
        f e. ( A ( Hom ` C ) B )
        /\
        (
          g e. ( A ( Hom ` C ) B )
          /\
          q e. ( B ( Hom ` C ) Q )
        )
      )
      /\
      (
        (
          Q4878586Comp C A B Q q f
        ) = (
          Q4878586Comp C A B Q q g
        )
        /\
        A. X e. ( Base ` C )
          A. h e. ( B ( Hom ` C ) X )
            (
              (
                Q4878586Comp C A B X h f
              ) = (
                Q4878586Comp C A B X h g
              )
              ->
              E. u e. ( Q ( Hom ` C ) X )
                (
                  (
                    Q4878586Comp C B Q X u q
                  ) = h
                  /\
                  A. v e. ( Q ( Hom ` C ) X )
                    (
                      (
                        Q4878586Comp C B Q X v q
                      ) = h
                      ->
                      v = u
                    )
                )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${

${
  $d A B C D G Q R X Y f g i j q r s t $.

  q4878586-creates-definition $a |- (

  ) <->
  (

            A. g e. ( A ( Hom ` D ) B )

                A. q e. (
                  ( Q4878586Obj G B ) ( Hom ` C ) Q
                )

                  )
                    A. t e. (
                      ( Q4878586Obj G B )

                    )

                        (
                          Q4878586SplitCoequalizer C
                            ( Q4878586Obj G A )
                            ( Q4878586Obj G B )
                            ( Q4878586Map G A B f )
                            ( Q4878586Map G A B g )
                            Q q s t

                            E. i e. (

                              E. j e. (

                              )
                                (
                                  Q4878586Coequalizer D
                                    A B f g R r
                                  /\
                                  (
                                    (
                                      Q4878586Comp C
                                        ( Q4878586Obj G R )
                                        Q
                                        ( Q4878586Obj G R )
                                        j i
                                    ) = (

                                    )
                                    /\
                                    (
                                      (
                                        Q4878586Comp C
                                          Q
                                          ( Q4878586Obj G R )
                                          Q

                                      ) = (

                                      )
                                      /\
                                      (
                                        Q4878586Comp C
                                          ( Q4878586Obj G B )
                                          ( Q4878586Obj G R )
                                          Q
                                          i
                                          ( Q4878586Map G B R r )
                                      ) = q
                                    )
                                  )
                                )
                      )
      /\
      A. A e. ( Base ` D )
        A. B e. ( Base ` D )
          A. f e. ( A ( Hom ` D ) B )
            A. g e. ( A ( Hom ` D ) B )
              A. R e. ( Base ` D )
                A. r e. ( B ( Hom ` D ) R )
                  (
                    (
                      (
                        E. Q e. ( Base ` C )
                          E. q e. (
                            ( Q4878586Obj G B ) ( Hom ` C ) Q
                          )
                            E. s e. (
                              Q ( Hom ` C ) ( Q4878586Obj G B )
                            )
                              E. t e. (
                                ( Q4878586Obj G B )
                                  ( Hom ` C )
                                ( Q4878586Obj G A )
                              )
                                (
                                  Q4878586SplitCoequalizer C
                                    ( Q4878586Obj G A )
                                    ( Q4878586Obj G B )
                                    ( Q4878586Map G A B f )
                                    ( Q4878586Map G A B g )
                                    Q q s t
                                )
                        /\

${

        /\

      )
      /\
      (
        A. A e. ( Base ` C )
          A. B e. ( Base ` C )
            A. f e. ( A ( Hom ` C ) B )

                  ( Q4878586Obj G ( Q4878586Obj F A ) )

                    ( Q4878586Obj F ( Q4878586Obj G B ) )

                    ( E ` B )
                    ( Q4878586Map F
                      ( Q4878586Obj G A )

${
  $d C D E F G U X Y Z a f g h i j k $.

  q4878586-comparison-equivalence-definition $a |- (

Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4878586,
% "Beck's monadicity theorem": a right adjoint that creates coequalizers of
% pairs whose images have split coequalizers is monadic. This file contains no proof.

Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem[
  Object_C, Morphism_C, Object_D, Morphism_D: TYPE,
  dom_C, cod_C: [Morphism_C -> Object_C],
  id_C: [Object_C -> Morphism_C],
  comp_C: [Morphism_C, Morphism_C -> Morphism_C],
  dom_D, cod_D: [Morphism_D -> Object_D],
  id_D: [Object_D -> Morphism_D],
  comp_D: [Morphism_D, Morphism_D -> Morphism_D],
  F_obj: [Object_C -> Object_D],
  F_map: [Morphism_C -> Morphism_D],
  G_obj: [Object_D -> Object_C],
  G_map: [Morphism_D -> Morphism_C],
  eta: [Object_C -> Morphism_C],
  epsilon: [Object_D -> Morphism_D]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  hom_C(f: Morphism_C, A, B: Object_C): bool =
    dom_C(f) = A AND cod_C(f) = B

  hom_D(f: Morphism_D, X, Y: Object_D): bool =
    dom_D(f) = X AND cod_D(f) = Y

  parallel_C(f, g: Morphism_C): bool =
    dom_C(f) = dom_C(g) AND cod_C(f) = cod_C(g)

  parallel_D(f, g: Morphism_D): bool =
    dom_D(f) = dom_D(g) AND cod_D(f) = cod_D(g)

  category_C_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (A: Object_C): hom_C(id_C(A), A, A))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object_C), (f, g: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(f, A, B) AND hom_C(g, B, C)
          IMPLIES hom_C(comp_C(g, f), A, C))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C, E: Object_C),
                  (f, g, h: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(f, A, B)
          AND hom_C(g, B, C)
          AND hom_C(h, C, E)
        IMPLIES
          comp_C(h, comp_C(g, f)) =
            comp_C(comp_C(h, g), f))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object_C), (f: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES comp_C(id_C(B), f) = f)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object_C), (f: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES comp_C(f, id_C(A)) = f)

  category_D_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (X: Object_D): hom_D(id_D(X), X, X))
      AND (FORALL (X, Y, Z: Object_D), (f, g: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(f, X, Y) AND hom_D(g, Y, Z)
          IMPLIES hom_D(comp_D(g, f), X, Z))
      AND (FORALL (W, X, Y, Z: Object_D),
                  (f, g, h: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(f, W, X)
          AND hom_D(g, X, Y)
          AND hom_D(h, Y, Z)
        IMPLIES
          comp_D(h, comp_D(g, f)) =
            comp_D(comp_D(h, g), f))
      AND (FORALL (X, Y: Object_D), (f: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(f, X, Y)
          IMPLIES comp_D(id_D(Y), f) = f)
      AND (FORALL (X, Y: Object_D), (f: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(f, X, Y)
          IMPLIES comp_D(f, id_D(X)) = f)

  functor_F_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (A, B: Object_C), (f: Morphism_C):
      hom_C(f, A, B)
        IMPLIES hom_D(F_map(f), F_obj(A), F_obj(B)))
      AND (FORALL (A: Object_C):
        F_map(id_C(A)) = id_D(F_obj(A)))
      AND (FORALL (A, B, C: Object_C), (f, g: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(f, A, B) AND hom_C(g, B, C)
          IMPLIES
            F_map(comp_C(g, f)) =
              comp_D(F_map(g), F_map(f)))

  functor_G_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (X, Y: Object_D), (f: Morphism_D):
      hom_D(f, X, Y)
        IMPLIES hom_C(G_map(f), G_obj(X), G_obj(Y)))
      AND (FORALL (X: Object_D):
        G_map(id_D(X)) = id_C(G_obj(X)))
      AND (FORALL (X, Y, Z: Object_D), (f, g: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(f, X, Y) AND hom_D(g, Y, Z)
          IMPLIES
            G_map(comp_D(g, f)) =
              comp_C(G_map(g), G_map(f)))

  T_obj(A: Object_C): Object_C =
    G_obj(F_obj(A))

  T_map(f: Morphism_C): Morphism_C =
    G_map(F_map(f))

  mu(A: Object_C): Morphism_C =
    G_map(epsilon(F_obj(A)))

  adjunction_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (A: Object_C):
      hom_C(eta(A), A, T_obj(A)))
      AND (FORALL (X: Object_D):
        hom_D(
          epsilon(X),
          F_obj(G_obj(X)),
          X))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: Object_C), (f: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(f, A, B)
          IMPLIES
            comp_C(T_map(f), eta(A)) =
              comp_C(eta(B), f))
      AND (FORALL (X, Y: Object_D), (f: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(f, X, Y)
          IMPLIES
            comp_D(f, epsilon(X)) =
              comp_D(
                epsilon(Y),
                F_map(G_map(f))))
      AND (FORALL (A: Object_C):
        comp_D(
          epsilon(F_obj(A)),
          F_map(eta(A))) =
            id_D(F_obj(A)))
      AND (FORALL (X: Object_D):
        comp_C(
          G_map(epsilon(X)),
          eta(G_obj(X))) =
            id_C(G_obj(X)))

  is_cofork_C(f, g, q: Morphism_C): bool =
    parallel_C(f, g)
      AND hom_C(q, cod_C(f), cod_C(q))
      AND comp_C(q, f) = comp_C(q, g)

  is_cofork_D(f, g, q: Morphism_D): bool =
    parallel_D(f, g)
      AND hom_D(q, cod_D(f), cod_D(q))
      AND comp_D(q, f) = comp_D(q, g)

  is_coequalizer_C(f, g, q: Morphism_C): bool =
    is_cofork_C(f, g, q)
      AND (FORALL (Z: Object_C), (h: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(h, cod_C(f), Z)
          AND comp_C(h, f) = comp_C(h, g)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (u: Morphism_C):
            hom_C(u, cod_C(q), Z)
              AND comp_C(u, q) = h
              AND (FORALL (v: Morphism_C):
                hom_C(v, cod_C(q), Z)
                  AND comp_C(v, q) = h
                IMPLIES v = u))

  is_coequalizer_D(f, g, q: Morphism_D): bool =
    is_cofork_D(f, g, q)
      AND (FORALL (Z: Object_D), (h: Morphism_D):
        hom_D(h, cod_D(f), Z)
          AND comp_D(h, f) = comp_D(h, g)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (u: Morphism_D):
            hom_D(u, cod_D(q), Z)
              AND comp_D(u, q) = h
              AND (FORALL (v: Morphism_D):
                hom_D(v, cod_D(q), Z)
                  AND comp_D(v, q) = h
                IMPLIES v = u))

  is_iso_C(i: Morphism_C, A, B: Object_C): bool =
    hom_C(i, A, B)
      AND (EXISTS (j: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(j, B, A)
          AND comp_C(j, i) = id_C(A)
          AND comp_C(i, j) = id_C(B))

  G_split_pair(
      A, B: Object_D,
      f, g: Morphism_D): bool =
    hom_D(f, A, B)
      AND hom_D(g, A, B)
      AND (EXISTS
          (Q: Object_C),
          (q, right_section, left_section: Morphism_C):
        hom_C(q, G_obj(B), Q)
          AND hom_C(right_section, Q, G_obj(B))
          AND hom_C(left_section, G_obj(B), G_obj(A))
          AND comp_C(q, G_map(f)) =
            comp_C(q, G_map(g))
          AND comp_C(q, right_section) = id_C(Q)
          AND comp_C(G_map(g), left_section) =
            id_C(G_obj(B))
          AND comp_C(G_map(f), left_section) =
            comp_C(right_section, q))

  creates_coequalizer(f, g: Morphism_D): bool =
    parallel_D(f, g)
      AND (FORALL (q_D: Morphism_D):
        is_cofork_D(f, g, q_D)
          AND is_coequalizer_C(
            G_map(f),
            G_map(g),
            G_map(q_D))
        IMPLIES is_coequalizer_D(f, g, q_D))
      AND (FORALL (Q_C: Object_C), (q_C: Morphism_C):
        is_coequalizer_C(G_map(f), G_map(g), q_C)
          AND cod_C(q_C) = Q_C
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (Q_D: Object_D),
              (q_D: Morphism_D),
              (i: Morphism_C):
            is_cofork_D(f, g, q_D)
              AND cod_D(q_D) = Q_D
              AND is_iso_C(i, G_obj(Q_D), Q_C)
              AND comp_C(i, G_map(q_D)) = q_C)

  creates_G_split_coequalizers: bool =
    FORALL (A, B: Object_D), (f, g: Morphism_D):
      hom_D(f, A, B) AND hom_D(g, A, B)
        IMPLIES
          (G_split_pair(A, B, f, g)
            IMPLIES creates_coequalizer(f, g))

  algebra(A: Object_C, a: Morphism_C): bool =
    hom_C(a, T_obj(A), A)
      AND comp_C(a, eta(A)) = id_C(A)
      AND comp_C(a, mu(A)) =
        comp_C(a, T_map(a))

  algebra_morphism(
      A: Object_C,
      a: Morphism_C,
      B: Object_C,
      b, h: Morphism_C): bool =
    algebra(A, a)
      AND algebra(B, b)
      AND hom_C(h, A, B)
      AND comp_C(b, T_map(h)) =
        comp_C(h, a)

  comparison_action(X: Object_D): Morphism_C =
    G_map(epsilon(X))

  comparison_faithful: bool =
    FORALL (X, Y: Object_D), (f, g: Morphism_D):
      hom_D(f, X, Y)
        AND hom_D(g, X, Y)
        AND G_map(f) = G_map(g)
      IMPLIES f = g

  comparison_full: bool =
    FORALL (X, Y: Object_D), (h: Morphism_C):
      algebra_morphism(
        G_obj(X),
        comparison_action(X),
        G_obj(Y),
        comparison_action(Y),
        h)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (f: Morphism_D):
          hom_D(f, X, Y) AND G_map(f) = h

  comparison_essentially_surjective: bool =
    FORALL (A: Object_C), (a: Morphism_C):
      algebra(A, a)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS
            (X: Object_D),
            (h, k: Morphism_C):
          algebra_morphism(
            G_obj(X),
            comparison_action(X),
            A,
            a,
            h)
            AND algebra_morphism(
              A,
              a,
              G_obj(X),
              comparison_action(X),
              k)
            AND comp_C(k, h) = id_C(G_obj(X))
            AND comp_C(h, k) = id_C(A)

  comparison_is_equivalence: bool =
    comparison_faithful
      AND comparison_full
      AND comparison_essentially_surjective

  beck_s_monadicity_theorem: bool =
    (category_C_laws
      AND category_D_laws
      AND functor_F_laws
      AND functor_G_laws
      AND adjunction_laws
      AND creates_G_split_coequalizers)
    IMPLIES comparison_is_equivalence
END Q4878586_beck_s_monadicity_theorem

-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q4950096
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q4950096), "Bourbaki–Witt theorem": every inflationary
-- self-map of a nonempty chain-complete partial order has a fixed point.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Dynamics.FixedPoints.Basic
public import Mathlib.Order.Preorder.Chain

@[expose] public section

namespace Q4950096

variable {α : Type*}

/-- A nonempty chain in an ordered type. -/
structure NonemptyChain (α : Type*) [LE α] where
  carrier : Set α
  nonempty' : carrier.Nonempty
  isChain' : IsChain (· ≤ ·) carrier

/-- A partial order in which every nonempty chain has a least upper bound. -/
class ChainCompletePartialOrder (α : Type*) extends PartialOrder α where
  cSup : NonemptyChain α → α
  le_cSup (c : NonemptyChain α) (x : α) : x ∈ c.carrier → x ≤ cSup c
  cSup_le (c : NonemptyChain α) (x : α) : (∀ y ∈ c.carrier, y ≤ x) → cSup c ≤ x

open Function

/-- The Bourbaki-Witt fixed-point theorem for inflationary endomaps. -/
theorem nonempty_fixedPoints_of_inflationary [ChainCompletePartialOrder α] [Nonempty α]
    {f : α → α} (le_map : ∀ x, x ≤ f x) : (fixedPoints f).Nonempty := sorry

end Q4950096

  "q4950096_is_chain C \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. x \<le> y \<or> y \<le> x)"

  fixes cSup :: "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> 'a"

        \<And>y. y \<in> C \<Longrightarrow> y \<le> x\<rbrakk>

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4950096,
  "Bourbaki-Witt theorem": every inflationary self-map of a nonempty
  chain-complete partial order has a fixed point. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q4950096_BOURBAKI_WITT_THEOREM =
  `let is_partial_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) in
   let is_chain =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool).
       !x y:A. s x /\ s y ==> le x y \/ le y x in
   let is_supremum =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (u:A).
       (!x:A. s x ==> le x u) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. s x ==> le x v) ==> le u v) in
   let is_chain_complete_partial_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (cSup:(A->bool)->A).
       is_partial_order le /\
       (!s:A->bool.
          (?x:A. s x) /\ is_chain le s
          ==> is_supremum le s (cSup s)) in
   !le:A->A->bool.
   !cSup:(A->bool)->A.
   !f:A->A.
     is_chain_complete_partial_order le cSup /\
     (!x:A. le x (f x))
     ==> ?x:A. f x = x`;;

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4950096,
;; "Bourbaki–Witt theorem": every inflationary self-map of a nonempty
;; chain-complete partial order has a fixed point. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; ACL2 function objects give an extensional, potentially infinite
;; representation of the source carrier, order, self-map, and chain subsets.
;; In particular, a chain is a unary characteristic predicate, not a finite
;; list or table. All structure laws and all witnesses remain explicit below.

(defun q4950096-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x))
      t
    nil))

(defun q4950096-le-p (carrier order x y)
  (and
   (q4950096-member-p carrier x)
   (q4950096-member-p carrier y)
   (if (apply$ order (list x y))
       t
     nil)))

(defun q4950096-map-value (map x)
  (apply$ map (list x)))

(defun-sk q4950096-carrier-nonempty-p (carrier)
  (exists (x)
    (q4950096-member-p carrier x)))

(defun-sk q4950096-partial-order-p (carrier order)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q4950096-member-p carrier x)
      (q4950096-le-p carrier order x x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4950096-le-p carrier order x y)
       (q4950096-le-p carrier order y x))
      (equal x y))
     (implies
      (and
       (q4950096-le-p carrier order x y)
       (q4950096-le-p carrier order y z))
      (q4950096-le-p carrier order x z)))))

(defun-sk q4950096-map-typed-p (carrier map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q4950096-member-p carrier x)
     (q4950096-member-p
      carrier
      (q4950096-map-value map x)))))

(defun q4950096-chain-member-p (carrier chain x)
  (and
   (q4950096-member-p carrier x)
   (if (apply$ chain (list x))
       t
     nil)))

(defun-sk q4950096-chain-nonempty-p (carrier chain)
  (exists (x)
    (q4950096-chain-member-p carrier chain x)))

(defun-sk q4950096-chain-comparable-p
    (carrier order chain)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q4950096-chain-member-p carrier chain x)
      (q4950096-chain-member-p carrier chain y))
     (or
      (q4950096-le-p carrier order x y)
      (q4950096-le-p carrier order y x)))))

(defun q4950096-nonempty-chain-p
    (carrier order chain)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp chain)
   (q4950096-chain-nonempty-p carrier chain)
   (q4950096-chain-comparable-p
    carrier order chain)))

(defun-sk q4950096-below-bound-p
    (carrier order chain bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies

title: Q4950096_bourbaki_witt_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4950096
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q4950096), "Bourbaki–Witt theorem": every
-- inflationary endofunction on a nonempty chain-complete partial order has a
-- fixed point. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q4950096_bourbaki_witt_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

record Nonempty
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Set ℓ where

  constructor inhabited
  field
    element : A

record PartialOrder
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    lessOrEqual :
      A → A → Set ℓ

    order-reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y z →
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y x →
      x ≡ y

open PartialOrder

record NonemptyChain
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (order : PartialOrder A) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    carrier :
      A → Set ℓ
    carrier-nonempty :
      Σ A carrier
    comparable :
      (x y : A) →
      carrier x →
      carrier y →
      Either
        (lessOrEqual order x y)
        (lessOrEqual order y x)

open NonemptyChain

record ChainCompletePartialOrder
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    partialOrder :
      PartialOrder A
    chainSupremum :
      NonemptyChain partialOrder → A
    lessOrEqual-chainSupremum :
      (chain : NonemptyChain partialOrder) →
      (x : A) →
      carrier chain x →
      lessOrEqual partialOrder x (chainSupremum chain)
    chainSupremum-least :
      (chain : NonemptyChain partialOrder) →
      (upper : A) →
      ((x : A) →
        carrier chain x →
        lessOrEqual partialOrder x upper) →
      lessOrEqual partialOrder (chainSupremum chain) upper

open ChainCompletePartialOrder

BourbakiWittTheorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
BourbakiWittTheorem ℓ =
  (A : Set ℓ) →
  (order : ChainCompletePartialOrder A) →
  Nonempty A →
  (function : A → A) →
  ((x : A) →
    lessOrEqual
      (partialOrder order)
      x
      (function x)) →
  Σ A
    (λ fixedPoint →
      function fixedPoint ≡ fixedPoint)

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4950096, "Bourbaki–Witt theorem": every inflationary endomap of a nonempty
  chain-complete partial order has a fixed point. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val q4950096_partial_order_def = new_definition (
  "q4950096_partial_order_def",
  ``q4950096_partial_order (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x. leR x x) /\
      (!x y z. leR x y /\ leR y z ==> leR x z) /\
      (!x y. leR x y /\ leR y x ==> x = y)``);

val q4950096_nonempty_chain_def = new_definition (
  "q4950096_nonempty_chain_def",
  ``q4950096_nonempty_chain
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (c : 'a -> bool) <=>
      (?x. c x) /\
      (!x y.
        c x /\ c y /\ x <> y
        ==>
        leR x y \/ leR y x)``);

val q4950096_chain_complete_partial_order_def = new_definition (
  "q4950096_chain_complete_partial_order_def",
  ``q4950096_chain_complete_partial_order
      (leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (cSup : ('a -> bool) -> 'a) <=>
      q4950096_partial_order leR /\
      !c.
        q4950096_nonempty_chain leR c
        ==>
        (!x. c x ==> leR x (cSup c)) /\
        (!upper.
          (!x. c x ==> leR x upper)
          ==>
          leR (cSup c) upper)``);

val nonempty_fixedPoints_of_inflationary =
  ``!(leR : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (cSup : ('a -> bool) -> 'a)
      (f : 'a -> 'a).
      q4950096_chain_complete_partial_order leR cSup /\
      (!x. leR x (f x))
      ==>
      ?y. f y = y``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q4950096Chains(A,R) is the set of all nonempty subsets of A whose elements
  are pairwise comparable under R. Q4950096CCPO(A,R,S) says that R is a
  non-strict partial order on the nonempty carrier A and that S chooses, for
  every such chain, its least upper bound in A. Thus S renders exactly the
  cSup field and laws of the Lean ChainCompletePartialOrder structure.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. It
  quantifies over arbitrary set-sized carriers and all structure fields, and
  its fixed point remains existentially quantified inside the conclusion.
$)

$c Q4950096Chains Q4950096CCPO $.

q4950096-chains-syntax $a class ( Q4950096Chains A R ) $.
q4950096-ccpo-syntax $a wff ( Q4950096CCPO A R S ) $.

$d A R c x y $.
q4950096-chains-definition $a |- (
  ( Q4950096Chains A R )
  =
  { c e. ~P A |
    (
      c =/= (/)
      /\
      A. x e. c A. y e. c ( x R y \/ y R x )
    )
  }
) $.

$d A R S c x y z $.
q4950096-ccpo-definition $a |- (
  ( Q4950096CCPO A R S )
  <->
  (
    A =/= (/)
    /\
    (
      R C_ ( A X. A )
      /\
      (
        A. x e. A x R x
        /\
        (
          A. x e. A A. y e. A A. z e. A
            ( ( x R y /\ y R z ) -> x R z )
          /\
          (
            A. x e. A A. y e. A
              ( ( x R y /\ y R x ) -> x = y )
            /\
            (
              S : ( Q4950096Chains A R ) --> A
              /\
              A. c e. ( Q4950096Chains A R )
                (
                  A. x e. c x R ( S ` c )
                  /\
                  A. z e. A
                    (
                      A. y e. c y R z
                      ->
                      ( S ` c ) R z
                    )
                )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

$d a f r s x $.
thousand-theorems-q4950096-bourbaki-witt $a |-
  A. a A. r A. s A. f
    (
      (
        ( Q4950096CCPO a r s )
        /\
        (
          f : a --> a
          /\
          A. x e. a x r ( f ` x )
        )
      )
      ->
      E. x e. a ( f ` x ) = x
    )

title: Q4950096_bourbaki_witt_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q4950096,
% "Bourbaki-Witt theorem": every inflationary self-map of a nonempty
% chain-complete partial order has a fixed point. This file contains no proof.

Q4950096_bourbaki_witt_theorem[
  A: TYPE+,
  le_rel: [A, A -> bool],
  chain_supremum: [[A -> bool] -> A],
  f: [A -> A]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element_set: TYPE = [A -> bool]

  nonempty(S: element_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: A): S(x)

  chain(S: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      S(x) AND S(y) IMPLIES
        le_rel(x, y) OR le_rel(y, x)

  upper_bound(S: element_set, u: A): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_rel(x, u)

  least_upper_bound(S: element_set, s: A): bool =
    upper_bound(S, s)
      AND (FORALL (u: A):
        upper_bound(S, u) IMPLIES le_rel(s, u))

  partial_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)

  chain_complete_partial_order_laws: bool =
    partial_order_laws
      AND (FORALL (S: element_set):
        nonempty(S) AND chain(S) IMPLIES
          least_upper_bound(S, chain_supremum(S)))

  inflationary(g: [A -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      le_rel(x, g(x))

  bourbaki_witt_theorem: bool =
    chain_complete_partial_order_laws
      AND inflationary(f)
    IMPLIES
      EXISTS (x: A): f(x) = x
END Q4950096_bourbaki_witt_theorem

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4971339
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q4971339), "British flag theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, a possibly degenerate parallelogram with a
  right angle at one vertex has equal sums of squared distances from any point
  to its two pairs of opposite vertices. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q4971339_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q4971339_zero : V;
  q4971339_add : V -> V -> V;
  q4971339_neg : V -> V;
  q4971339_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q4971339_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q4971339_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q4971339_add x (q4971339_add y z) =
      q4971339_add (q4971339_add x y) z;
  q4971339_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q4971339_add x y = q4971339_add y x;
  q4971339_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q4971339_add x q4971339_zero = x;
  q4971339_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q4971339_add x (q4971339_neg x) = q4971339_zero;

  q4971339_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q4971339_smul 1 x = x;
  q4971339_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q4971339_smul (a * b) x =
      q4971339_smul a (q4971339_smul b x);
  q4971339_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q4971339_smul a (q4971339_add x y) =
      q4971339_add (q4971339_smul a x) (q4971339_smul a y);
  q4971339_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q4971339_smul (a + b) x =
      q4971339_add (q4971339_smul a x) (q4971339_smul b x);

  q4971339_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q4971339_inner (q4971339_add x y) z =
      q4971339_inner x z + q4971339_inner y z;
  q4971339_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q4971339_inner (q4971339_smul a x) y =
      a * q4971339_inner x y;
  q4971339_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V,
      q4971339_inner x y = q4971339_inner y x;
  q4971339_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q4971339_inner x x;
  q4971339_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q4971339_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q4971339_zero
}.

Arguments q4971339_zero {V} _.
Arguments q4971339_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q4971339_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q4971339_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q4971339_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q4971339_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type)
    (E : q4971339_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q4971339_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q4971339_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q4971339_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P,
      q4971339_vadd (q4971339_zero E) p = p;
  q4971339_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q4971339_vadd (q4971339_add E x y) p =
      q4971339_vadd x (q4971339_vadd y p);
  q4971339_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q4971339_vsub (q4971339_vadd x p) p = x;
  q4971339_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q4971339_vadd (q4971339_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q4971339_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q4971339_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q4971339_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q4971339_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q4971339_inner E x x).

Definition q4971339_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q4971339_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q4971339_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q4971339_norm E (q4971339_vsub A p q).

Definition q4971339_midpoint
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q4971339_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q4971339_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : P :=
  q4971339_vadd A
    (q4971339_smul E (1 / 2) (q4971339_vsub A p q)) q.

Definition q4971339_angle
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q4971339_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q4971339_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p1 p2 p3 : P) : R :=
  let x := q4971339_vsub A p1 p2 in
  let y := q4971339_vsub A p3 p2 in
  acos
    (q4971339_inner E x y /
      (q4971339_norm E x * q4971339_norm E y)).

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q4971339_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q4971339_affine_torsor V P E)
         (a b c d p : P),
    q4971339_midpoint A a c = q4971339_midpoint A b d ->
    q4971339_angle A b a d = PI / 2 ->
    q4971339_dist A p a * q4971339_dist A p a +
      q4971339_dist A p c * q4971339_dist A p c =
    q4971339_dist A p b * q4971339_dist A p b +
      q4971339_dist A p d * q4971339_dist A p d.
Admitted.

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4971339 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q4971339), "British flag theorem":
  in a real inner-product affine space, a parallelogram with a right angle has
  equal sums of squared distances from any point to opposite vertex pairs.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q4971339_british_flag_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

locale q4971339_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q4971339_vadd :: "'v::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q4971339_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q4971339_zero_vadd:
      "q4971339_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q4971339_add_vadd:
      "q4971339_vadd (u + v) p =
        q4971339_vadd u (q4971339_vadd v p)"
    and q4971339_vadd_vsub:
      "q4971339_vadd (q4971339_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q4971339_vsub_vadd:
      "q4971339_vsub (q4971339_vadd v p) p = v"
begin

definition q4971339_dist :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q4971339_dist p q = norm (q4971339_vsub p q)"

definition q4971339_midpoint :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p" where
  "q4971339_midpoint p q =
    q4971339_vadd ((1 / 2) *\<^sub>R q4971339_vsub p q) q"

definition q4971339_angle :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q4971339_angle p1 p2 p3 =
    arccos (inner (q4971339_vsub p1 p2) (q4971339_vsub p3 p2) /
      (norm (q4971339_vsub p1 p2) * norm (q4971339_vsub p3 p2)))"

theorem british_flag_theorem:
  fixes a b c d p :: 'p
  assumes parallelogram:
      "q4971339_midpoint a c = q4971339_midpoint b d"
    and right_angle:
      "q4971339_angle b a d = pi / 2"
  shows
      "q4971339_dist p a ^ 2 + q4971339_dist p c ^ 2 =
        q4971339_dist p b ^ 2 + q4971339_dist p d ^ 2"
  sorry

end

end

let q4971339_real_inner_product_space = new_definition
  `q4971339_real_inner_product_space
      (z:'v) (addv:'v->'v->'v) (negv:'v->'v)

      addR reals halfPi halfPi == pi
    vector-angle-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      vectorAngle u v == vectorAngle v u
    vector-angle-zero-left :
      (v : V) ->
      vectorAngle zeroV v == halfPi
    vector-angle-zero-right :
      (v : V) ->
      vectorAngle v zeroV == halfPi
    vector-angle-nonnegative :
      (u v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (vectorAngle u v)
    vector-angle-at-most-pi :
      (u v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (vectorAngle u v) pi
    right-angle-characterization :
      (u v : V) ->
      Iff
        (vectorAngle u v == halfPi)
        (inner u v == zeroR reals)

open RealInnerProductAngleSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

distance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine p q =
  norm space (vsub affine p q)

angleAt :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
angleAt {space = space} affine b a d =
  vectorAngle space
    (vsub affine b a)
    (vsub affine d a)

twoR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
twoR reals =
  fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))

halfR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
halfR reals =
  inverseR reals (twoR reals)

midpoint :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P
midpoint {reals = reals} {space = space} affine p q =
  vadd affine
    (scaleV space (halfR reals) (vsub affine p q))
    q

squaredDistance :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
squaredDistance {reals = reals} affine p q =
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine p q)
    (distance affine p q)

british-flag-theorem : Set1
british-flag-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductAngleSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b c d : P) ->
  midpoint affine a c == midpoint affine b d ->
  angleAt affine b a d == halfPi space ->
  (p : P) ->
  addR reals
    (squaredDistance affine p a)
    (squaredDistance affine p c)
  ==
  addR reals
    (squaredDistance affine p b)
    (squaredDistance affine p d)

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q4971339 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q4971339), "British flag theorem":
  in an arbitrary real inner-product affine space, a parallelogram with a
  right angle satisfies the opposite-corner squared-distance identity for

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q4971339_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q4971339_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q4971339_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q4971339_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q4971339_norm_def",
  ``q4971339_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q4971339_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q4971339_dist_def",
  ``q4971339_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q4971339_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q4971339_midpoint_def = new_definition (
  "q4971339_midpoint_def",
  ``q4971339_midpoint
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      vadd (smul (1 / 2) (vsub x y)) y``);

val q4971339_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q4971339_angle_def",
  ``q4971339_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p)
      (z : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub x y) (vsub z y) /
          (q4971339_norm inner (vsub x y) *
           q4971339_norm inner (vsub z y)))``);

val dist_sq_add_dist_sq_eq_dist_sq_add_dist_sq_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a b c d p : 'p).
      q4971339_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q4971339_midpoint smul vadd vsub a c =
        q4971339_midpoint smul vadd vsub b d /\
      q4971339_angle inner vsub b a d = pi / 2
      ==>
      q4971339_dist inner vsub p a pow 2 +
          q4971339_dist inner vsub p c pow 2 =
        q4971339_dist inner vsub p b pow 2 +
          q4971339_dist inner vsub p d pow 2``;

title: Q4971339_british_flag_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q4971339
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q4971339), "British flag theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, a possibly degenerate
  parallelogram with a right angle satisfies the opposite-corner
  squared-distance identity for every point. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces. The predicate
  W Q4971339RealInnerProductSpace explicitly requires a generalized
  pre-Hilbert structure over RRfld, the normed-module laws, and the defining
  equality between the norm and the square root of the self inner product.
  It is therefore the SetMM rendering of the source NormedAddCommGroup and
  InnerProductSpace real typeclass package, without a finite-dimensionality
  restriction. Choosing any affine origin identifies the source's normed
  affine torsor with Base ` W while preserving distances, angles, and
  equality of affine midpoints.

  W Q4971339Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q4971339Dist A B is its
  norm, and W Q4971339Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When
  either ray is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention;
  otherwise it is the arccosine of the normalized inner product.
  W Q4971339Mid A C is the affine midpoint of A and C. Thus equality of the
  midpoints of A,C and B,D is exactly the source's parallelogram hypothesis.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit definition.
  The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus statement, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q4971339RealInnerProductSpace
   Q4971339Ray Q4971339Dist Q4971339Angle Q4971339Mid $.

q4971339-real-inner-product-space-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q4971339RealInnerProductSpace ) $.
q4971339-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q4971339Ray A B ) $.
q4971339-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q4971339Dist A B ) $.
q4971339-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q4971339Angle A B C ) $.
q4971339-midpoint-syntax $a class ( W Q4971339Mid A C ) $.

${
  $d W x $.

  q4971339-real-inner-product-space-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q4971339RealInnerProductSpace )
    <->
    (
      (
        W e. PreHil
        /\
        W e. NrmMod
      )
      /\
      (
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
        /\
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          =
          (
            x e. ( Base ` W ) |->
              ( sqrt ` ( x ( .i ` W ) x ) )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

q4971339-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q4971339Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q4971339-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q4971339Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q4971339Ray A B )
) $.

q4971339-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q4971339Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q4971339Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q4971339Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q4971339Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q4971339Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q4971339Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q4971339Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

q4971339-midpoint-definition $a |- (
  W Q4971339Mid A C
) = (
  ( 1 / 2 )
  ( .s ` W )
  ( A ( +g ` W ) C )
) $.

${
  $d A B C D P W $.

  thousand-theorems-q4971339-british-flag-theorem $a |- A. W
    (
      ( W Q4971339RealInnerProductSpace )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            A. D e. ( Base ` W )
              A. P e. ( Base ` W )
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( W Q4971339Mid A C )
                      =
                      ( W Q4971339Mid B D )
                    )
                    /\
                    (
                      ( W Q4971339Angle B A D )
                      =
                      ( _pi / 2 )
                    )
                  )
                  ->
                  (
                    (
                      ( ( W Q4971339Dist P A ) ^ 2 )
                      +
                      ( ( W Q4971339Dist P C ) ^ 2 )
                    )
                    =
                    (
                      ( ( W Q4971339Dist P B ) ^ 2 )
                      +
                      ( ( W Q4971339Dist P D ) ^ 2 )
                    )
                  )
                )
    )
  $.
$}

title: Q4971339_british_flag_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q4971339, "British flag
% theorem": the squared-distance identity for a rectangle in an arbitrary real inner-product
% affine space, including points outside its plane. This file contains no proof.

q4971339_british_flag_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  translate: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): translate(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        translate(vadd(u, v), p) = translate(u, translate(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P): translate(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (v: V), (p: P): vsub(translate(v, p), p) = v)

  real_inner_product_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  midpoint(A, C: P): P =
    translate(scale(1 / 2, vsub(C, A)), A)

  squared_distance(P1, P2: P): real =
    inner(vsub(P1, P2), vsub(P1, P2))

  right_angle(B, A, D: P): bool =
    inner(vsub(B, A), vsub(D, A)) = 0

  british_flag_theorem: bool =
    real_inner_product_affine_space IMPLIES
      (FORALL (a, b, c, d, p: P):
        (midpoint(a, c) = midpoint(b, d)
          AND right_angle(b, a, d))
        IMPLIES
          squared_distance(p, a) + squared_distance(p, c) =
            squared_distance(p, b) + squared_distance(p, d))
END q4971339_british_flag_theorem

title: Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q505798
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q505798), "Lagrange's theorem (group theory)":
  the natural cardinal of a subgroup of an arbitrary group divides the
  natural cardinal of the ambient group. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith PeanoNat Logic.ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Unset Implicit Arguments.

Record q505798_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q505798_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q505798_one : G;
  q505798_inv : G -> G;
  q505798_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q505798_mul x (q505798_mul y z) =
      q505798_mul (q505798_mul x y) z;
  q505798_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q505798_mul q505798_one x = x;
  q505798_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q505798_mul x q505798_one = x;
  q505798_inv_mul :
    forall x : G,
      q505798_mul (q505798_inv x) x = q505798_one;
  q505798_mul_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q505798_mul x (q505798_inv x) = q505798_one
}.

Arguments q505798_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q505798_one {G} _.
Arguments q505798_inv {G} _ _.

Record q505798_subgroup
    (G : Type)
    (grp : q505798_group G) : Type := {
  q505798_subgroup_mem : G -> Prop;
  q505798_subgroup_one :
    q505798_subgroup_mem (q505798_one grp);
  q505798_subgroup_mul :
    forall x y : G,
      q505798_subgroup_mem x ->
      q505798_subgroup_mem y ->
      q505798_subgroup_mem (q505798_mul grp x y);
  q505798_subgroup_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q505798_subgroup_mem x ->
      q505798_subgroup_mem (q505798_inv grp x)
}.

Arguments q505798_subgroup_mem {G grp} _ _.

Definition q505798_fin (n : nat) : Type :=
  { k : nat | k < n }.

Definition q505798_injective
    {A B : Type} (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A, f x = f y -> x = y.

Definition q505798_has_cardinality
    {A : Type} (P : A -> Prop) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumerate : q505798_fin n -> A,
    q505798_injective enumerate /\
    (forall i : q505798_fin n, P (enumerate i)) /\
    forall x : A,
      P x ->
      exists i : q505798_fin n, enumerate i = x.

Definition q505798_nat_card
    {A : Type} (P : A -> Prop) : nat :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists n : nat, q505798_has_cardinality P n) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits 0)
        (fun n : nat => q505798_has_cardinality P n)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Theorem Subgroup_card_subgroup_dvd_card :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q505798_group G)
         (H : q505798_subgroup G grp),
    Nat.divide
      (q505798_nat_card (q505798_subgroup_mem H))
      (q505798_nat_card (fun _ : G => True)).
Admitted.

title: Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q505798
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q505798), "Lagrange's theorem (group theory)":
  the cardinality of any subgroup of an arbitrary multiplicative group divides
  the cardinality of the ambient group. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory
  imports Main
begin

definition q505798_is_group ::
    "('g \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> ('g \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q505798_is_group mul e inverse_op \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. mul e x = x \<and> mul x e = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. mul (inverse_op x) x = e \<and> mul x (inverse_op x) = e)"

definition q505798_is_subgroup ::
    "('g \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow>
      ('g \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'g set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q505798_is_subgroup mul e inverse_op H \<longleftrightarrow>
    e \<in> H \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. inverse_op x \<in> H) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<forall>y \<in> H. mul x y \<in> H)"

theorem q505798_card_subgroup_dvd_card:
  fixes mul :: "'g \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g"
    and e :: "'g"
    and inverse_op :: "'g \<Rightarrow> 'g"
    and H :: "'g set"
  assumes ambient_group: "q505798_is_group mul e inverse_op"
    and subgroup_H: "q505798_is_subgroup mul e inverse_op H"
  shows "card H dvd card (UNIV :: 'g set)"
  sorry

end

content:

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q505798,
-- "Lagrange's theorem (group theory)": the natural cardinality of a subgroup
-- divides the natural cardinality of its ambient group. This file contains no
-- proof.

module Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _∣_

data ⊥ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (Agda.Builtin.Nat.suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (Agda.Builtin.Nat.suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

InfiniteCard :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  Set ℓ →
  Set ℓ
InfiniteCard {ℓ} A =
  (count : Nat) →
  Bijection A (Fin count) →
  ⊥ {ℓ}

data NatCard
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Nat →
  Set ℓ where

  finite-card :
    {count : Nat} →
    Bijection A (Fin count) →
    NatCard A count

  infinite-card :
    {count : Nat} →
    count ≡ zero →
    InfiniteCard A →
    NatCard A count

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    divides-equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity :
      member (Group.identity structure)
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) →
      member x →
      member (Group.inverse structure x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (Group.multiply structure x y)

open SubgroupOf

SubgroupCarrier :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
SubgroupCarrier {G = G} H =
  Σ G (member H)

-- Lean: Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card
lagranges-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
lagranges-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (H : SubgroupOf structure) →
  (subgroup-order group-order : Nat) →
  NatCard (SubgroupCarrier H) subgroup-order →
  NatCard G group-order →
  subgroup-order ∣ group-order

title: Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q505798,
% "Lagrange's theorem (group theory)": the natural cardinality of every subgroup
% divides that of its ambient group, with infinite carriers assigned zero.
% This file contains no proof.

Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  element_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[G]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  is_subgroup(H: element_set): bool =
    H(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        H(x) AND H(y) IMPLIES H(mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES H(inv(x)))

  full_carrier: element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G): TRUE

  exact_finite_carrier(
      S: element_set,
      carrier: finite_set[G]): bool =
    FORALL (x: G):
      carrier(x) IFF S(x)

  natural_cardinality(
      S: element_set,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    (EXISTS (carrier: finite_set[G]):
      exact_finite_carrier(S, carrier)
        AND cardinality = card(carrier))
      OR
    (cardinality = 0
      AND NOT
        EXISTS (carrier: finite_set[G]):
          exact_finite_carrier(S, carrier))

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: nat):
      value = divisor * factor

  card_subgroup_dvd_card: bool =
    group_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (H: element_set),
              (subgroup_cardinality, group_cardinality: nat):
        (is_subgroup(H)
          AND natural_cardinality(H, subgroup_cardinality)
          AND natural_cardinality(full_carrier, group_cardinality))
        IMPLIES
          nat_divides(subgroup_cardinality, group_cardinality))

END Q505798_lagrange_s_theorem_group_theory

-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q510197), "Tutte theorem": a finite graph has a
-- perfect matching exactly when deleting any vertex subset leaves no more odd
-- connected components than the subset's cardinality. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Matching
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Metric
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Operations
public import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.UniversalVerts
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card

@[expose] public section

namespace SimpleGraph

variable {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}

/-- A vertex set whose deletion leaves more odd components than its cardinality. -/
def IsTutteViolator (G : SimpleGraph V) (u : Set V) : Prop :=
  u.ncard < ((⊤ : G.Subgraph).deleteVerts u).coe.oddComponents.ncard

variable [Finite V]

/-- Tutte's characterization of finite graphs admitting a perfect matching. -/
theorem tutte : (∃ M : Subgraph G, M.IsPerfectMatching) ↔ ∀ u, ¬G.IsTutteViolator u := sorry

end SimpleGraph

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q510197
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q510197), "Tutte theorem": a finite simple graph
  has a perfect matching if and only if deleting any set of vertices leaves
  at most that many connected components of odd cardinality. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q510197_finite (V : Type) : Type := {
  q510197_listing : list V;
  q510197_listing_nodup : NoDup q510197_listing;
  q510197_listing_complete :
    forall x : V, In x q510197_listing
}.

Record q510197_simple_graph (V : Type) : Type := {
  q510197_adj : V -> V -> Prop;
  q510197_adj_symmetric :
    forall x y : V, q510197_adj x y -> q510197_adj y x;
  q510197_adj_irreflexive :
    forall x : V, ~ q510197_adj x x
}.

Arguments q510197_adj {V} _ _ _.

Definition q510197_is_subgraph
    {V : Type}
    (M G : q510197_simple_graph V) : Prop :=
  forall x y : V, q510197_adj M x y -> q510197_adj G x y.

Definition q510197_is_perfect_matching
    {V : Type}
    (G M : q510197_simple_graph V) : Prop :=
  q510197_is_subgraph M G /\
  forall x : V,
    exists y : V,
      q510197_adj M x y /\
      forall z : V, q510197_adj M x z -> z = y.

Inductive q510197_reachable_without
    {V : Type}
    (G : q510197_simple_graph V)
    (deleted : V -> Prop) : V -> V -> Prop :=
| q510197_reachable_refl :
    forall x : V,
      ~ deleted x ->
      q510197_reachable_without G deleted x x
| q510197_reachable_step :
    forall x y z : V,
      ~ deleted x ->
      q510197_adj G x y ->
      q510197_reachable_without G deleted y z ->
      q510197_reachable_without G deleted x z.

Definition q510197_set_cardinality
    {V : Type}
    (S : V -> Prop)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists xs : list V,
    NoDup xs /\
    (forall x : V, S x <-> In x xs) /\
    length xs = n.

Definition q510197_odd (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists k : nat, n = S (2 * k).

Definition q510197_is_odd_component
    {V : Type}
    (G : q510197_simple_graph V)
    (deleted : V -> Prop)
    (root : V) : Prop :=
  ~ deleted root /\
  exists n : nat,
    q510197_set_cardinality
      (fun x : V => q510197_reachable_without G deleted root x) n /\
    q510197_odd n.

Definition q510197_pairwise_distinct_components
    {V : Type}
    (G : q510197_simple_graph V)
    (deleted : V -> Prop)
    (representatives : list V) : Prop :=
  forall x y : V,
    In x representatives ->
    In y representatives ->
    x <> y ->
    ~ q510197_reachable_without G deleted x y.

Definition q510197_odd_components_cardinality
    {V : Type}
    (G : q510197_simple_graph V)
    (deleted : V -> Prop)
    (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists representatives : list V,
    NoDup representatives /\
    (forall root : V,
      In root representatives ->
      q510197_is_odd_component G deleted root) /\
    q510197_pairwise_distinct_components G deleted representatives /\
    (forall root : V,
      q510197_is_odd_component G deleted root ->
      exists representative : V,
        In representative representatives /\
        q510197_reachable_without G deleted root representative) /\
    length representatives = n.

Definition q510197_is_tutte_violator
    {V : Type}
    (G : q510197_simple_graph V)
    (deleted : V -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists removed_count odd_component_count : nat,
    q510197_set_cardinality deleted removed_count /\
    q510197_odd_components_cardinality
      G deleted odd_component_count /\
    removed_count < odd_component_count.

Definition q510197_tutte_condition
    {V : Type}
    (_ : q510197_finite V)
    (G : q510197_simple_graph V) : Prop :=
  forall deleted : V -> Prop,
    ~ q510197_is_tutte_violator G deleted.

Module SimpleGraph.

Theorem tutte :
  forall (V : Type)
         (finite_vertices : q510197_finite V)
         (G : q510197_simple_graph V),
    (exists M : q510197_simple_graph V,
      q510197_is_perfect_matching G M) <->
    q510197_tutte_condition finite_vertices G.
Admitted.

End SimpleGraph.

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q510197
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q510197), "Tutte theorem": a finite simple
  graph has a perfect matching exactly when deleting any vertex subset leaves
  at most that many odd connected components. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q510197_tutte_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q510197_simple_graph ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q510197_simple_graph G \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>v. \<not> G v v) \<and>
    (\<forall>u v. G u v \<longleftrightarrow> G v u)"

definition q510197_perfect_matching ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q510197_perfect_matching G M \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>u v. M u v \<longrightarrow> G u v) \<and>
    (\<forall>u v. M u v \<longleftrightarrow> M v u) \<and>
    (\<forall>v. \<not> M v v) \<and>
    (\<forall>v. \<exists>!w. M v w)"

definition q510197_reachable_after_deleting ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'v set \<Rightarrow>
      'v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q510197_reachable_after_deleting G U x y \<longleftrightarrow>
    x \<notin> U \<and> y \<notin> U \<and>
    rtranclp (\<lambda>a b. a \<notin> U \<and> b \<notin> U \<and> G a b) x y"

definition q510197_component_after_deleting ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'v set \<Rightarrow>
      'v \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q510197_component_after_deleting G U v =
    {w. q510197_reachable_after_deleting G U v w}"

definition q510197_odd_components_after_deleting ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'v set \<Rightarrow>
      'v set set" where
  "q510197_odd_components_after_deleting G U =
    {C. \<exists>v. v \<notin> U \<and>
      C = q510197_component_after_deleting G U v \<and>
      odd (card C)}"

definition q510197_is_tutte_violator ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> 'v set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q510197_is_tutte_violator G U \<longleftrightarrow>
    card U < card (q510197_odd_components_after_deleting G U)"

theorem q510197_tutte:
  fixes G :: "'v::finite \<Rightarrow> 'v \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes simple_graph: "q510197_simple_graph G"
  shows "(\<exists>M. q510197_perfect_matching G M) \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>U. \<not> q510197_is_tutte_violator G U)"
  sorry

end
