content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q510197,
  "Tutte theorem": a simple graph on an arbitrary finite vertex carrier has a
  perfect matching if and only if deleting any vertex subset leaves at most
  that many odd connected components. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/rstc.ml";;

let Q510197_TUTTE_THEOREM =
  `let simple_graph_on =
     \(vertices:A->bool) (g:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. ~(g x x)) /\
       (!x y:A. g x y <=> g y x) /\
       (!x y:A. g x y ==> x IN vertices /\ y IN vertices) in
   let perfect_matching_on =
     \(vertices:A->bool) (g:A->A->bool) (m:A->A->bool).
       (!x y:A. m x y ==> x IN vertices /\ y IN vertices /\ g x y) /\
       (!x y:A. m x y <=> m y x) /\
       (!x:A. x IN vertices ==> ?!y:A. m x y) in
   let component_after_deleting =
     \(vertices:A->bool) (g:A->A->bool) (u:A->bool) (x:A).
       {y:A |
          y IN vertices /\
          ~(y IN u) /\
          RTC
            (\a b:A.
               a IN vertices /\ b IN vertices /\
               ~(a IN u) /\ ~(b IN u) /\ g a b)
            x y} in
   let odd_components_after_deleting =
     \(vertices:A->bool) (g:A->A->bool) (u:A->bool).
       {c:A->bool |
          (?x:A.
             x IN vertices /\
             ~(x IN u) /\
             c = component_after_deleting vertices g u x) /\
          ODD (CARD c)} in
   !vertices:A->bool.
   !g:A->A->bool.
     FINITE vertices /\
     simple_graph_on vertices g
     ==>
     ((?m:A->A->bool. perfect_matching_on vertices g m) <=>
      (!u:A->bool.
         u SUBSET vertices
         ==> CARD (odd_components_after_deleting vertices g u) <= CARD u))`;;

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q510197,
;; "Tutte theorem": a finite simple graph has a perfect matching if and only
;; if deleting any vertex subset leaves at most that subset's cardinality many
;; connected components of odd cardinality. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; A duplicate-free true list enumerates the finite vertex type. Each edge is
;; an unordered pair of distinct enumerated vertices, and no undirected edge
;; occurs twice. These valid lists represent exactly finite simple graphs,
;; independently of carrier order and edge orientation.

(defun q510197-carrier-p (vertices)
  (and (true-listp vertices)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal vertices)))

(defun q510197-edge-record-p (edge vertices)
  (and (true-listp edge)
       (equal (len edge) 2)
       (member-equal (nth 0 edge) vertices)
       (member-equal (nth 1 edge) vertices)
       (not (equal (nth 0 edge) (nth 1 edge)))))

(defun q510197-same-undirected-edge-p (left right)
  (or (and (equal (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
           (equal (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
      (and (equal (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
           (equal (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right)))))

(defun q510197-edge-distinct-from-list-p (edge remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and (not (q510197-same-undirected-edge-p
                 edge (car remaining)))
           (q510197-edge-distinct-from-list-p
            edge (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q510197-edge-list-p (edges vertices)
  (if (consp edges)
      (and (q510197-edge-record-p (car edges) vertices)
           (q510197-edge-distinct-from-list-p
            (car edges) (cdr edges))
           (q510197-edge-list-p (cdr edges) vertices))
    (equal edges nil)))

(defun q510197-simple-graph-p (vertices edges)
  (and (q510197-carrier-p vertices)
       (q510197-edge-list-p edges vertices)))

(defun q510197-adjacent-p (edges u v)
  (if (or (member-equal (list u v) edges)
          (member-equal (list v u) edges))
      t
    nil))

;; A matching is an edge subset whose edges have pairwise disjoint endpoints.
;; Exhausting inclusion and exclusion of every graph edge keeps the perfect
;; matching witness existentially quantified inside the statement predicate.

(defun q510197-vertex-incident-p (vertex matching)
  (if (consp matching)
      (or (equal vertex (nth 0 (car matching)))
          (equal vertex (nth 1 (car matching)))
          (q510197-vertex-incident-p vertex (cdr matching)))
    nil))

(defun q510197-matching-p (matching)
  (if (consp matching)
      (and (not (q510197-vertex-incident-p
                 (nth 0 (car matching)) (cdr matching)))
           (not (q510197-vertex-incident-p
                 (nth 1 (car matching)) (cdr matching)))
           (q510197-matching-p (cdr matching)))
    (equal matching nil)))

(defun q510197-all-vertices-covered-p (vertices matching)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (and (q510197-vertex-incident-p
            (car vertices) matching)
           (q510197-all-vertices-covered-p
            (cdr vertices) matching))
    t))

(defun q510197-perfect-matching-p (vertices matching)
  (and (q510197-matching-p matching)
       (q510197-all-vertices-covered-p vertices matching)))

(defun q510197-has-perfect-matching-from-p
    (remaining-edges selected vertices)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining-edges)))
  (if (consp remaining-edges)
      (or
       (q510197-has-perfect-matching-from-p
        (cdr remaining-edges)
        (cons (car remaining-edges) selected)
        vertices)
       (q510197-has-perfect-matching-from-p
        (cdr remaining-edges)
        selected
        vertices))
    (q510197-perfect-matching-p vertices selected)))

(defun q510197-has-perfect-matching-p (vertices edges)
  (q510197-has-perfect-matching-from-p edges nil vertices))

;; Repeated synchronous neighborhood expansion computes the connected
;; component of SEED in the subgraph induced by ALLOWED. A simple path in an
;; n-vertex graph has length below n, so n expansions give the exact component.

(defun q510197-adjacent-to-any-p (vertex reached edges)
  (if (consp reached)
      (or (q510197-adjacent-p edges vertex (car reached))
          (q510197-adjacent-to-any-p
           vertex (cdr reached) edges))
    nil))

(defun q510197-expand-reached (candidates reached edges)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (if (or (member-equal (car candidates) reached)
              (q510197-adjacent-to-any-p
               (car candidates) reached edges))
          (cons (car candidates)
                (q510197-expand-reached
                 (cdr candidates) reached edges))
        (q510197-expand-reached
         (cdr candidates) reached edges))
    nil))

(defun q510197-reach-closure (fuel allowed reached edges)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (zp fuel)
      reached
    (q510197-reach-closure
     (- fuel 1)
     allowed
     (q510197-expand-reached allowed reached edges)
     edges)))

(defun q510197-component-of (seed allowed edges)
  (q510197-reach-closure
   (len allowed) allowed (list seed) edges))

(defun q510197-remove-members (vertices removed)
  (if (consp vertices)
      (if (member-equal (car vertices) removed)
          (q510197-remove-members (cdr vertices) removed)
        (cons (car vertices)
              (q510197-remove-members
               (cdr vertices) removed)))
    nil))

(defun q510197-some-member-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (or (member-equal (car left) right)
          (q510197-some-member-p (cdr left) right))
    nil))

;; Scanning the induced carrier in its enumeration order counts each connected
;; component only at its first vertex. Its closure cardinality then determines
;; whether that component is odd.

(defun q510197-odd-components-count-aux
    (remaining earlier allowed edges)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (let* ((component
              (q510197-component-of
               (car remaining) allowed edges))
             (first-in-component
              (not (q510197-some-member-p component earlier)))
             (odd-component
              (and first-in-component
                   (equal (mod (len component) 2) 1))))
        (+ (if odd-component 1 0)
           (q510197-odd-components-count-aux
            (cdr remaining)
            (cons (car remaining) earlier)
            allowed
            edges)))
    0))

(defun q510197-odd-components-after-deletion
    (vertices edges removed)
  (let ((allowed
         (q510197-remove-members vertices removed)))
    (q510197-odd-components-count-aux
     allowed nil allowed edges)))

;; Inclusion and exclusion recursively enumerate every vertex subset U. The
;; leaf condition is the negation of IsTutteViolator:
;; oddComponents(G - U) <= |U|.

(defun q510197-all-subsets-satisfy-tutte-p
    (remaining selected vertices edges)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (q510197-all-subsets-satisfy-tutte-p
        (cdr remaining)
        (cons (car remaining) selected)
        vertices
        edges)
       (q510197-all-subsets-satisfy-tutte-p
        (cdr remaining)
        selected
        vertices
        edges))
    (<=
     (q510197-odd-components-after-deletion
      vertices edges selected)
     (len selected))))

(defun q510197-tutte-condition-p (vertices edges)
  (q510197-all-subsets-satisfy-tutte-p
   vertices nil vertices edges))

(defun thousand-theorems-q510197-tutte-theorem-statement
    (vertices edges)
  (implies
   (q510197-simple-graph-p vertices edges)
   (equal
    (q510197-has-perfect-matching-p vertices edges)
    (q510197-tutte-condition-p vertices edges))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q510197,
-- "Tutte theorem": a finite simple graph has a perfect matching exactly when
-- deleting any vertex subset leaves at most as many odd connected components
-- as deleted vertices. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q510197_tutte_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

Finite :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Finite A =
  Exists Nat (\ cardinality -> Bijection A (Fin cardinality))

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset A =
  A -> Set _

record HasCardinality
  {a p : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (member : A -> Set p)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Exists (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> item == enumerate index)
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      enumerate left-index == enumerate right-index ->
      left-index == right-index

Odd :
  Nat ->
  Set
Odd n =
  Exists Nat (\ k -> n == suc (k + k))

OddCardinality :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set p) ->
  Set (a lmax p)
OddCardinality member =
  Exists Nat
    (\ cardinality ->
      HasCardinality member cardinality
      and
      Odd cardinality)

record SimpleGraph
  {a : Level}
  (V : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    adjacent :
      V ->
      V ->
      Set a
    loopless :
      (v : V) ->
      Not (adjacent v v)
    symmetric :
      (v w : V) ->
      adjacent v w ->
      adjacent w v

open SimpleGraph

data ConnectedOutside
  {a : Level}
  {V : Set a}
  (graph : SimpleGraph V)
  (removed : Subset V) :
  V ->
  V ->
  Set a where

  at :
    (v : V) ->
    Not (removed v) ->
    ConnectedOutside graph removed v v

  extend :
    {start current next : V} ->
    ConnectedOutside graph removed start current ->
    Not (removed next) ->
    adjacent graph current next ->
    ConnectedOutside graph removed start next

OddComponentAt :
  {a : Level} ->
  {V : Set a} ->
  SimpleGraph V ->
  Subset V ->
  V ->
  Set a
OddComponentAt graph removed representative =
  Not (removed representative)
  and
  OddCardinality
    (\ vertex ->
      ConnectedOutside graph removed representative vertex)

PairwiseDifferentComponents :
  {a : Level} ->
  {V : Set a} ->
  (graph : SimpleGraph V) ->
  (removed : Subset V) ->
  {count : Nat} ->
  (Fin count -> V) ->
  Set a
PairwiseDifferentComponents graph removed representatives =
  (left right : Fin _) ->
  Not (left == right) ->
  Not
    (ConnectedOutside graph removed
      (representatives left)
      (representatives right))

IsTutteViolator :
  {a : Level} ->
  {V : Set a} ->
  SimpleGraph V ->
  Subset V ->
  Set a
IsTutteViolator {V = V} graph removed =
  Exists Nat
    (\ removed-count ->
      HasCardinality removed removed-count
      and
      Exists (Fin (suc removed-count) -> V)
        (\ representatives ->
          ((index : Fin (suc removed-count)) ->
            OddComponentAt graph removed (representatives index))
          and
          PairwiseDifferentComponents graph removed representatives))

record IsPerfectMatching
  {a : Level}
  {V : Set a}
  (graph matching : SimpleGraph V) :
  Set a where

  field
    contained :
      (v w : V) ->
      adjacent matching v w ->
      adjacent graph v w
    unique-neighbor :
      (v left right : V) ->
      adjacent matching v left ->
      adjacent matching v right ->
      left == right
    covers :
      (v : V) ->
      Exists V (\ w -> adjacent matching v w)

tutte-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
tutte-theorem {a} =
  (V : Set a) ->
  Finite V ->
  (graph : SimpleGraph V) ->
  Exists (SimpleGraph V) (IsPerfectMatching graph)
  iff
  ((removed : Subset V) ->
    Not (IsTutteViolator graph removed))

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q510197 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q510197), "Tutte theorem": a finite,
  possibly empty, simple graph has a perfect matching if and only if deleting
  any vertex set leaves at most that many odd connected components. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory relationTheory;

val q510197_simple_graph_def = new_definition (
  "q510197_simple_graph_def",
  ``q510197_simple_graph
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
         adj u v ==> u IN vertices /\ v IN vertices) /\
      (!(v : 'a).
         v IN vertices ==> ~adj v v) /\
      (!(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
         u IN vertices /\ v IN vertices
         ==>
         (adj u v <=> adj v u))``);

val q510197_deleted_adj_def = new_definition (
  "q510197_deleted_adj_def",
  ``q510197_deleted_adj
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (removed : 'a set) (u : 'a) (v : 'a) <=>
      u IN vertices /\
      v IN vertices /\
      u NOTIN removed /\
      v NOTIN removed /\
      adj u v``);

val q510197_component_def = new_definition (
  "q510197_component_def",
  ``q510197_component
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (removed : 'a set) (root : 'a) =
      {v : 'a |
        root IN vertices /\
        root NOTIN removed /\
        v IN vertices /\
        v NOTIN removed /\
        RTC (q510197_deleted_adj vertices adj removed) root v}``);

val q510197_odd_components_def = new_definition (
  "q510197_odd_components_def",
  ``q510197_odd_components
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (removed : 'a set) =
      {component : 'a set |
        ?root : 'a.
          root IN vertices /\
          root NOTIN removed /\
          component = q510197_component vertices adj removed root /\
          ODD (CARD component)}``);

val q510197_is_perfect_matching_def = new_definition (
  "q510197_is_perfect_matching_def",
  ``q510197_is_perfect_matching
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (matching : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
         matching u v
         ==>
         u IN vertices /\ v IN vertices /\ adj u v) /\
      (!(u : 'a) (v : 'a).
         u IN vertices /\ v IN vertices
         ==>
         (matching u v <=> matching v u)) /\
      (!(u : 'a).
         u IN vertices
         ==>
         ?!v : 'a. v IN vertices /\ matching u v)``);

val q510197_is_tutte_violator_def = new_definition (
  "q510197_is_tutte_violator_def",
  ``q510197_is_tutte_violator
      (vertices : 'a set) (adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool)
      (removed : 'a set) <=>
      removed SUBSET vertices /\
      CARD removed <
        CARD (q510197_odd_components vertices adj removed)``);

val tutte =
  ``!vertices : 'a set. !adj : 'a -> 'a -> bool.
      FINITE vertices /\
      q510197_simple_graph vertices adj
      ==>
      ((?matching : 'a -> 'a -> bool.
          q510197_is_perfect_matching vertices adj matching)
       <=>
       !removed : 'a set.
         removed SUBSET vertices
         ==>
         ~q510197_is_tutte_violator vertices adj removed)``;

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q510197
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q510197), "Tutte theorem": a finite simple
  graph has a perfect matching if and only if deleting any vertex subset
  leaves at most that many connected components of odd cardinality. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Finite Lean vertex types are represented by arbitrary finite sets V.
  Q510197SimpleGraph says that G is an irreflexive symmetric relation on V.
  Q510197PerfectMatching says that M is a simple subgraph of G in which every
  vertex has exactly one M-neighbor, exactly matching a spanning perfect
  matching.

  Q510197Deleted is the edge relation induced on V \ U. Q510197Component is
  the set of vertices equal to, or reachable by a nonempty finite G-path from,
  a root after deleting U. Q510197OddComponents collects these component sets
  extensionally, so roots in the same component do not create duplicates.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful bidirectional definitions.
  This file introduces no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q510197SimpleGraph Q510197PerfectMatching Q510197Deleted
   Q510197Component Q510197OddComponents $.

q510197-simple-graph-syntax $a
  wff ( Q510197SimpleGraph V G ) $.
q510197-perfect-matching-syntax $a
  wff ( Q510197PerfectMatching V G M ) $.
q510197-deleted-syntax $a
  class ( Q510197Deleted V G U ) $.
q510197-component-syntax $a
  class ( Q510197Component V G U x ) $.
q510197-odd-components-syntax $a
  class ( Q510197OddComponents V G U ) $.

${
  $d G V u v $.

  q510197-simple-graph-definition $a |- (
    ( Q510197SimpleGraph V G )
    <->
    (
      G C_ ( V X. V )
      /\
      (
        A. u e. V -. <. u , u >. e. G
        /\
        A. u e. V A. v e. V
          ( <. u , v >. e. G <-> <. v , u >. e. G )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M V u v $.

  q510197-perfect-matching-definition $a |- (
    ( Q510197PerfectMatching V G M )
    <->
    (
      M C_ G
      /\
      (
        ( Q510197SimpleGraph V M )
        /\
        A. u e. V E! v e. V <. u , v >. e. M
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G U V $.

  q510197-deleted-definition $a |- (
    ( Q510197Deleted V G U )
    =
    (
      G
      i^i
      ( ( V \ U ) X. ( V \ U ) )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G U V x y $.

  q510197-component-definition $a |- (
    ( Q510197Component V G U x )
    =
    { y e. ( V \ U ) |
      x
        (
          ( t+ ` ( Q510197Deleted V G U ) )
          u.
          _I
        )
        y
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C G U V x $.

  q510197-odd-components-definition $a |- (
    ( Q510197OddComponents V G U )
    =
    { C e. ~P ( V \ U ) |
      E. x e. ( V \ U )
        (
          C = ( Q510197Component V G U x )
          /\
          ( # ` C ) e. Odd
        )
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M U V $.

  thousand-theorems-q510197-tutte $a |- (
    A. V A. G
      (
        (
          V e. Fin
          /\
          ( Q510197SimpleGraph V G )
        )
        ->
        (
          E. M ( Q510197PerfectMatching V G M )
          <->
          A. U e. ~P V
            -.
            ( # ` U )
            <
            ( # ` ( Q510197OddComponents V G U ) )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q510197), "Tutte theorem": a finite simple graph

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for V being finite set, E being Relation of V st
    E is symmetric irreflexive
  holds

      M c= E & M is symmetric &

title: Q510197_tutte_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q510197,
% "Tutte theorem": a finite simple graph has a perfect matching exactly when
% deleting any vertex set leaves at most as many odd connected components as
% deleted vertices. This file contains no proof.

Q510197_tutte_theorem[V: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[V]

  vertex_set: TYPE = [V -> bool]
  graph: TYPE = [V, V -> bool]
  vertex_relation: TYPE = [V, V -> bool]

  simple_graph(G: graph): bool =
    (FORALL (v: V): NOT G(v, v))
      AND
    (FORALL (v, w: V): G(v, w) IFF G(w, v))

  has_cardinality(S: vertex_set, cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [below(cardinality) -> V]):
      (FORALL (i, j: below(cardinality)):
        enumeration(i) = enumeration(j) IMPLIES i = j)
        AND
      (FORALL (v: V):
        S(v)
          IFF
        EXISTS (i: below(cardinality)): enumeration(i) = v)

  connected_after_deletion(
      G: graph,
      deleted: vertex_set,
      source, target: V): bool =
    NOT deleted(source)
      AND NOT deleted(target)
      AND
        (FORALL (R: vertex_relation):
          ((FORALL (v: V):
              NOT deleted(v) IMPLIES R(v, v))
            AND
           (FORALL (x, y, z: V):
              NOT deleted(x)
                AND NOT deleted(y)
                AND NOT deleted(z)
                AND R(x, y)
                AND G(y, z)
              IMPLIES R(x, z)))
          IMPLIES R(source, target))

  component_after_deletion(
      G: graph,
      deleted: vertex_set,
      representative: V): vertex_set =
    LAMBDA (v: V):
      connected_after_deletion(G, deleted, representative, v)

  odd_component_at(
      G: graph,
      deleted: vertex_set,
      representative: V): bool =
    NOT deleted(representative)
      AND
    EXISTS (half_size: nat):
      has_cardinality(
        component_after_deletion(G, deleted, representative),
        2 * half_size + 1)

  represents_odd_components(
      G: graph,
      deleted, representatives: vertex_set): bool =
    (FORALL (representative: V):
      representatives(representative)
        IMPLIES odd_component_at(G, deleted, representative))
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      odd_component_at(G, deleted, v)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (representative: V):
            representatives(representative)
              AND connected_after_deletion(
                    G, deleted, representative, v))
      AND
    (FORALL (left, right: V):
      representatives(left)
        AND representatives(right)
        AND connected_after_deletion(G, deleted, left, right)
      IMPLIES left = right)

  odd_component_count(
      G: graph,
      deleted: vertex_set,
      count: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (representatives: vertex_set):
      represents_odd_components(G, deleted, representatives)
        AND has_cardinality(representatives, count)

  is_tutte_violator(G: graph, deleted: vertex_set): bool =
    EXISTS (deleted_count, odd_count: nat):
      has_cardinality(deleted, deleted_count)
        AND odd_component_count(G, deleted, odd_count)
        AND deleted_count < odd_count

  is_perfect_matching(G, matching: graph): bool =
    simple_graph(matching)
      AND
    (FORALL (v, w: V):
      matching(v, w) IMPLIES G(v, w))
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      EXISTS (partner: V):
        matching(v, partner)
          AND
        (FORALL (candidate: V):
          matching(v, candidate) IMPLIES candidate = partner))

  has_perfect_matching(G: graph): bool =
    EXISTS (matching: graph):
      is_perfect_matching(G, matching)

  tutte_theorem: bool =
    is_finite_type[V]
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (G: graph):
          simple_graph(G)
            IMPLIES
              (has_perfect_matching(G)
                IFF
               FORALL (deleted: vertex_set):
                 NOT is_tutte_violator(G, deleted))
END Q510197_tutte_theorem

title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q5171652
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q5171652), "Corners theorem": every sufficiently
-- dense finite subset of an initial square of natural numbers contains a
-- nontrivial corner once the side length meets the explicit bound. This file contains no proof.

module

import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.AddCircle
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Range

open Finset Function Real

namespace Q5171652

variable {n : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}

/-- The partition-size growth step in the explicit Szemerédi regularity bound. -/
def stepBound (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  n * 4 ^ n

/--
The real logarithm, represented as the unique inverse-exponential value on the
absolute value of a nonzero input and as zero at zero.
-/
noncomputable def realLog (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  letI := Classical.propDecidable
  if x = 0 then 0
  else if h : ∃ y : ℝ, Real.exp y = |x| then Classical.choose h else 0

/-- The initial partition size in the explicit Szemerédi regularity bound. -/
noncomputable def initialBound (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  max 7 <| max l <| ⌊realLog (100 / ε ^ 5) / realLog 4⌋₊ + 1

/-- The explicit partition-size bound used by the triangle removal lemma. -/
noncomputable def regularityBound (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (stepBound^[⌊4 / ε ^ 5⌋₊] <| initialBound ε l) *
    16 ^ (stepBound^[⌊4 / ε ^ 5⌋₊] <| initialBound ε l)

/-- The explicit density constant in the triangle removal lemma. -/
noncomputable def triangleRemovalBound (ε : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min (2 * ⌈4 / ε⌉₊ ^ 3)⁻¹
    ((1 - min 1 ε / 4) * (ε / (16 * regularityBound (ε / 8) ⌈4 / ε⌉₊)) ^ 3)

/-- The explicit density threshold used in the corners theorem. -/
noncomputable def cornersTheoremBound (ε : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊(triangleRemovalBound (ε / 9) * 27)⁻¹⌋₊ + 1

variable {G : Type*} [AddCommMonoid G]

/-- A corner consists of three points whose coordinate sums agree. -/
structure IsCorner (A : Set (G × G)) (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : G) : Prop where
  fst_fst_mem : (x₁, y₁) ∈ A
  fst_snd_mem : (x₁, y₂) ∈ A
  snd_fst_mem : (x₂, y₁) ∈ A
  add_eq_add : x₁ + y₂ = x₂ + y₁

/-- A set is corner-free when every corner in it has zero displacement. -/
def IsCornerFree (A : Set (G × G)) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂⦄, IsCorner A x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ → x₁ = x₂

open Fin.NatCast in
/-- The corners theorem for finite subsets of an initial square in `ℕ × ℕ`. -/
theorem corners_theorem_nat (hε : 0 < ε) (hn : cornersTheoremBound (ε / 9) ≤ n)
    (A : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (hAn : A ⊆ range n ×ˢ range n) (hAε : ε * n ^ 2 ≤ #A) :
    ¬ IsCornerFree (A : Set (ℕ × ℕ)) := sorry

end Q5171652

title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
(* Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5171652
   (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q5171652), "Corners theorem": every sufficiently
   dense finite subset of an initial square of natural numbers contains a
   nontrivial corner once the side length meets the explicit bound. This file
   contains no proof. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat ZArith.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record q5171652_finset (X : Type) : Type := {
  q5171652_elements : list X;
  q5171652_elements_nodup : NoDup q5171652_elements
}.

Arguments q5171652_elements {X} _.

Definition q5171652_nat_floor (x : R) : nat :=
  Z.to_nat (Int_part x).

Definition q5171652_nat_ceil (x : R) : nat :=
  Z.to_nat (Z.opp (Int_part (- x))).

Fixpoint q5171652_iterate
    {X : Type} (f : X -> X) (k : nat) (x : X) : X :=
  match k with
  | O => x
  | S k' => q5171652_iterate f k' (f x)
  end.

Definition q5171652_step_bound (n : nat) : nat :=
  (n * Nat.pow 4 n)%nat.

Definition q5171652_initial_bound (epsilon : R) (l : nat) : nat :=
  Nat.max 7
    (Nat.max l
      (S (q5171652_nat_floor
        (ln (100 / epsilon ^ 5) / ln 4)))).

Definition q5171652_regularity_bound (epsilon : R) (l : nat) : nat :=
  let t :=
    q5171652_iterate q5171652_step_bound
      (q5171652_nat_floor (4 / epsilon ^ 5))
      (q5171652_initial_bound epsilon l) in
  (t * Nat.pow 16 t)%nat.

Definition q5171652_triangle_removal_bound (epsilon : R) : R :=
  let c := q5171652_nat_ceil (4 / epsilon) in
  Rmin
    (/ (2 * INR (Nat.pow c 3)))
    ((1 - Rmin 1 epsilon / 4) *
      (epsilon /
        (16 * INR (q5171652_regularity_bound (epsilon / 8) c))) ^ 3).

Definition q5171652_corners_theorem_bound (epsilon : R) : nat :=
  S (q5171652_nat_floor
    (/ (q5171652_triangle_removal_bound (epsilon / 9) * 27))).

Definition q5171652_mem
    {X : Type} (x : X) (A : q5171652_finset X) : Prop :=
  In x (q5171652_elements A).

Definition q5171652_is_corner_free
    (A : q5171652_finset (nat * nat)) : Prop :=
  forall x1 y1 x2 y2 : nat,
    q5171652_mem (x1, y1) A ->
    q5171652_mem (x1, y2) A ->
    q5171652_mem (x2, y1) A ->
    (x1 + y2 = x2 + y1)%nat ->
    x1 = x2.

Theorem corners_theorem_nat :
  forall (epsilon : R) (n : nat),
    0 < epsilon ->
    (q5171652_corners_theorem_bound (epsilon / 9) <= n)%nat ->
    forall A : q5171652_finset (nat * nat),
      (forall p : nat * nat,
        q5171652_mem p A ->
        ((fst p < n)%nat /\ (snd p < n)%nat)) ->
      epsilon * INR (Nat.pow n 2) <=
        INR (length (q5171652_elements A)) ->
      ~ q5171652_is_corner_free A.
Admitted.

title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5171652
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q5171652), "Corners theorem": every sufficiently
  dense finite subset of an initial natural-number square contains a nontrivial
  additive corner once the side length meets the explicit bound. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q5171652_corners_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q5171652_nat_floor :: "real \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q5171652_nat_floor x = nat (floor x)"

definition q5171652_nat_ceiling :: "real \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q5171652_nat_ceiling x = nat (ceiling x)"

definition q5171652_step_bound :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q5171652_step_bound m = m * 4 ^ m"

definition q5171652_initial_bound :: "real \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q5171652_initial_bound delta l =
    max 7 (max l
      (q5171652_nat_floor (ln (100 / delta ^ 5) / ln 4) + 1))"

definition q5171652_regularity_bound :: "real \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q5171652_regularity_bound delta l =
    (let m =
      (q5171652_step_bound ^^ q5171652_nat_floor (4 / delta ^ 5))
        (q5171652_initial_bound delta l)
     in m * 16 ^ m)"

definition q5171652_triangle_removal_bound :: "real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q5171652_triangle_removal_bound delta =
    (let c = q5171652_nat_ceiling (4 / delta)
     in min
       (inverse (2 * (real c) ^ 3))
       ((1 - min 1 delta / 4) *
        (delta / (16 * real (q5171652_regularity_bound (delta / 8) c))) ^ 3))"

definition q5171652_corners_bound :: "real \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q5171652_corners_bound delta =
    q5171652_nat_floor
      (inverse (q5171652_triangle_removal_bound (delta / 9) * 27)) + 1"

definition q5171652_corner_free :: "(nat \<times> nat) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5171652_corner_free A \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x1 y1 x2 y2.
      (x1, y1) \<in> A \<and>
      (x1, y2) \<in> A \<and>
      (x2, y1) \<in> A \<and>
      x1 + y2 = x2 + y1
      \<longrightarrow> x1 = x2)"

theorem corners_theorem_nat:
  fixes epsilon :: real
    and n :: nat
    and A :: "(nat \<times> nat) set"
  assumes epsilon_pos: "0 < epsilon"
    and bound: "q5171652_corners_bound (epsilon / 9) \<le> n"
    and contained: "A \<subseteq> {..<n} \<times> {..<n}"
    and dense: "epsilon * (real n) ^ 2 \<le> real (card A)"
  shows "\<not> q5171652_corner_free A"
  sorry

end

title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5171652,
;; "Corners theorem": a sufficiently dense finite subset of an initial square
;; of natural-number pairs contains a nontrivial additive corner, with the
;; explicit triangle-removal bound from the source. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The Lean statement quantifies epsilon over the reals. For this universal
;; finite-density statement, exact positive rationals give a bidirectionally
;; equivalent formulation. The real theorem immediately implies its rational
;; restriction. Conversely, a counterexample has
;;
;;   epsilon <= |A| / n^2 <= 1.
;;
;; If epsilon is rational, retain it. Otherwise the first inequality is strict,
;; so density of Q supplies a rational q with
;; epsilon < q <= |A| / n^2. On 0 < epsilon <= 1, the expanded
;; cornersTheoremBound(epsilon/9) is nonincreasing: its ceil and floor indices
;; are nonincreasing, the regularity bound is therefore nonincreasing, and both
;; branches of triangleRemovalBound(epsilon/81) are nondecreasing. Replacing
;; epsilon by q thus preserves the bound and density hypotheses. Hence a real
;; counterexample exists exactly when a rational counterexample exists.

;; These predicates are the exact Nat.ceil and Nat.floor characterizations
;; occurring in triangleRemovalBound and SzemerediRegularity.bound.

(defun q5171652-ceil-four-over-p (x k)
  (and
   (rationalp x)
   (< 0 x)
   (natp k)
   (< 0 k)
   (< (* (- k 1) x) 4)
   (<= 4 (* k x))))

(defun q5171652-floor-four-over-fifth-power-p
    (fifth-power value)
  (and
   (rationalp fifth-power)
   (< 0 fifth-power)
   (natp value)
   (<= (* value fifth-power) 4)
   (< 4 (* (+ value 1) fifth-power))))

(defun q5171652-floor-log-four-p
    (fifth-power value)
  (and
   (rationalp fifth-power)
   (< 0 fifth-power)
   (natp value)
   (if (zp value)
       (< 100 (* 4 fifth-power))
     (and
      (<= (* (expt 4 value) fifth-power) 100)
      (< 100 (* (expt 4 (+ value 1)) fifth-power))))))

(defun q5171652-step-bound (value)
  (* value (expt 4 value)))

(defun q5171652-iterate-step-bound (value count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      value
    (q5171652-iterate-step-bound
     (q5171652-step-bound value)
     (- count 1))))

(defun q5171652-regularity-bound
    (ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log)
  (let* ((initial
          (max 7
               (max ceil-value (+ floor-log 1))))
         (iterated
          (q5171652-iterate-step-bound
           initial floor-iterate)))
    (* iterated (expt 16 iterated))))

(defun q5171652-triangle-removal-bound
    (epsilon ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log)
  (let* ((x (/ epsilon 81))
         (regularity-bound
          (q5171652-regularity-bound
           ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log))
         (first-branch
          (/ 1 (* 2 (expt ceil-value 3))))
         (positive-factor
          (- 1 (/ (min 1 x) 4)))
         (small-quotient
          (/ x (* 16 regularity-bound)))
         (second-branch
          (* positive-factor
             (expt small-quotient 3))))
    (min first-branch second-branch)))

;; Expanding cornersTheoremBound(epsilon/9) makes x = epsilon/81 in
;; triangleRemovalBound. For its positive value t,
;;
;;   floor((27*t)^-1) + 1 <= n  iff  1 < 27*n*t.

(defun q5171652-bound-data-p
    (epsilon n ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log)
  (let* ((x (/ epsilon 81))
         (delta (/ x 8))
         (fifth-power (expt delta 5))
         (triangle-bound
          (q5171652-triangle-removal-bound
           epsilon ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log)))
    (and
     (q5171652-ceil-four-over-p x ceil-value)
     (q5171652-floor-four-over-fifth-power-p
      fifth-power floor-iterate)
     (q5171652-floor-log-four-p
      fifth-power floor-log)
     (< 1 (* 27 n triangle-bound)))))

(defun-sk q5171652-source-bound-at-most-p (epsilon n)
  (exists (ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log)
    (q5171652-bound-data-p
     epsilon n ceil-value floor-iterate floor-log)))

;; Duplicate-free proper lists of natural pairs represent exactly Finset
;; (Nat x Nat). The recursive membership tests below are therefore invariant
;; under list order and preserve the source finite-set semantics.

(defun q5171652-natural-pair-p (pair)
  (and
   (consp pair)
   (natp (car pair))
   (natp (cdr pair))))

(defun q5171652-finite-pair-set-p (set)
  (if (consp set)
      (and
       (q5171652-natural-pair-p (car set))
       (not (member-equal (car set) (cdr set)))
       (q5171652-finite-pair-set-p (cdr set)))
    (equal set nil)))

(defun q5171652-in-initial-square-p (set n)
  (if (consp set)
      (and
       (< (caar set) n)
       (< (cdar set) n)
       (q5171652-in-initial-square-p
        (cdr set) n))
    (equal set nil)))

;; FIRST = (x1,y1), SECOND = (x1,y2), and THIRD = (x2,y1). The additive
;; equation and x1 != x2 are exactly Mathlib's nontrivial corner condition.

(defun q5171652-corner-third-p (first second third)
  (and
   (equal (car first) (car second))
   (equal (cdr first) (cdr third))
   (equal (+ (car first) (cdr second))
          (+ (car third) (cdr first)))
   (not (equal (car first) (car third)))))

(defun q5171652-corner-with-first-second-p
    (first second remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (or
       (q5171652-corner-third-p
        first second (car remaining))
       (q5171652-corner-with-first-second-p
        first second (cdr remaining)))
    nil))

(defun q5171652-corner-with-first-p
    (first set remaining-seconds)
  (if (consp remaining-seconds)
      (or
       (q5171652-corner-with-first-second-p
        first (car remaining-seconds) set)
       (q5171652-corner-with-first-p
        first set (cdr remaining-seconds)))
    nil))

(defun q5171652-has-nontrivial-corner-p
    (set remaining-firsts)
  (if (consp remaining-firsts)
      (or
       (q5171652-corner-with-first-p
        (car remaining-firsts) set set)
       (q5171652-has-nontrivial-corner-p
        set (cdr remaining-firsts)))
    nil))

(defun q5171652-density-at-least-p
    (epsilon n set)
  (<= (* epsilon n n) (len set)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q5171652-corners-theorem-nat-statement
    (epsilon n set)
  (implies
   (and
    (rationalp epsilon)
    (< 0 epsilon)
    (natp n)
    (q5171652-finite-pair-set-p set)
    (q5171652-in-initial-square-p set n)
    (q5171652-source-bound-at-most-p epsilon n)
    (q5171652-density-at-least-p epsilon n set))
   (q5171652-has-nontrivial-corner-p set set)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5171652,
-- "Corners theorem": a sufficiently dense finite subset of an initial square
-- of natural numbers contains a nontrivial corner. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q5171652_corners_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_ _<N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=     : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc   : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

_<N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m <N n =
  suc m <=N n

powNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
powNat base zero =
  1
powNat base (suc exponent) =
  base * powNat base exponent

maxNat : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
maxNat zero n =
  n
maxNat m zero =
  m
maxNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  suc (maxNat m n)

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  1
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

stepBound : Nat -> Nat
stepBound n =
  n * powNat 4 n

iterateStepBound : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
iterateStepBound zero start =
  start
iterateStepBound (suc count) start =
  iterateStepBound count (stepBound start)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerR reals x n) x

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals term zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals term (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (sumFirst reals term n)
    (term n)

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divideR reals
    (powerR reals x n)
    (fromNatR reals (factorial n))

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x n =
  sumFirst reals
    (exponentialTerm reals x)
    (suc n)

Converges :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
Converges reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (negateR reals epsilon)
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        (lessOrEqualR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit)
          epsilon))

Exponential :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Exponential reals x y =
  Converges reals (exponentialPartialSum reals x) y

Logarithm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Logarithm reals x y =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x)
    (Exponential reals y x)

NatFloor :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
NatFloor reals x floor =
  Either
    (Both
      (lessOrEqualR reals x (zeroR reals))
      (floor == zero))
    (Both
      (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) x)
      (Both
        (lessOrEqualR reals (fromNatR reals floor) x)
        (StrictLess reals x (fromNatR reals (suc floor)))))

NatCeiling :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
NatCeiling reals x ceiling =
  Either
    (Both
      (lessOrEqualR reals x (zeroR reals))
      (ceiling == zero))
    (Exists Nat
      (\ predecessor ->
        Both
          (ceiling == suc predecessor)
          (Both
            (StrictLess reals
              (fromNatR reals predecessor)
              x)
            (lessOrEqualR reals
              x
              (fromNatR reals (suc predecessor))))))

Minimum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
Minimum reals x y result =
  Either
    (Both (result == x) (lessOrEqualR reals x y))
    (Both (result == y) (lessOrEqualR reals y x))

InitialRegularityBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
InitialRegularityBound {R} reals epsilon lower result =
  Exists R
    (\ numeratorLog ->
      Both
        (Logarithm reals
          (divideR reals
            (fromNatR reals 100)
            (powerR reals epsilon 5))
          numeratorLog)
        (Exists R
          (\ denominatorLog ->
            Both
              (Logarithm reals
                (fromNatR reals 4)
                denominatorLog)
              (Exists Nat
                (\ logarithmicFloor ->
                  Both
                    (NatFloor reals
                      (divideR reals numeratorLog denominatorLog)
                      logarithmicFloor)
                    (result ==
                      maxNat 7
                        (maxNat lower
                          (suc logarithmicFloor))))))))

RegularityBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Set
RegularityBound reals epsilon lower result =
  Exists Nat
    (\ iterationCount ->
      Both
        (NatFloor reals
          (divideR reals
            (fromNatR reals 4)
            (powerR reals epsilon 5))
          iterationCount)
        (Exists Nat
          (\ initial ->
            Both
              (InitialRegularityBound reals epsilon lower initial)
              (Exists Nat
                (\ iterated ->
                  Both
                    (iterated ==
                      iterateStepBound iterationCount initial)
                    (result ==
                      iterated * powNat 16 iterated))))))

TriangleRemovalBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
TriangleRemovalBound {R} reals epsilon result =
  Exists Nat
    (\ ceilingFourOverEpsilon ->
      Both
        (NatCeiling reals
          (divideR reals (fromNatR reals 4) epsilon)
          ceilingFourOverEpsilon)
        (Exists Nat
          (\ regularityBound ->
            Both
              (RegularityBound reals
                (divideR reals epsilon (fromNatR reals 8))
                ceilingFourOverEpsilon
                regularityBound)
              (Exists R
                (\ firstTerm ->
                  Both
                    (firstTerm ==
                      reciprocalR reals
                        (fromNatR reals
                          (2 * powNat ceilingFourOverEpsilon 3)))
                    (Exists R
                      (\ epsilonMinimum ->
                        Both
                          (Minimum reals
                            (oneR reals)
                            epsilon
                            epsilonMinimum)
                          (Exists R
                            (\ secondTerm ->
                              Both
                                (secondTerm ==
                                  multiplyR reals
                                    (subtractR reals
                                      (oneR reals)
                                      (divideR reals
                                        epsilonMinimum
                                        (fromNatR reals 4)))
                                    (powerR reals
                                      (divideR reals
                                        epsilon
                                        (fromNatR reals
                                          (16 * regularityBound)))
                                      3))
                                (Minimum reals
                                  firstTerm
                                  secondTerm
                                  result))))))))))

CornersTheoremBound :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  Set
CornersTheoremBound {R} reals epsilon result =
  Exists R
    (\ triangleBound ->
      Both
        (TriangleRemovalBound reals
          (divideR reals epsilon (fromNatR reals 9))
          triangleBound)
        (Exists Nat
          (\ inverseFloor ->
            Both
              (NatFloor reals
                (reciprocalR reals
                  (multiplyR reals
                    triangleBound
                    (fromNatR reals 27)))
                inverseFloor)
              (result == suc inverseFloor))))

record Pair : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    firstNat  : Nat
    secondNat : Nat

open Pair

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

andBool : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
andBool true value =
  value
andBool false value =
  false

pairEqual : Pair -> Pair -> Bool
pairEqual p q =
  andBool
    (natEqual (firstNat p) (firstNat q))
    (natEqual (secondNat p) (secondNat q))

contains : Pair -> List Pair -> Bool
contains point [] =
  false
contains point (head ∷ tail) with pairEqual point head
... | true =
  true
... | false =
  contains point tail

data IsTrue : Bool -> Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

data NoDuplicates : List Pair -> Set where
  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates []
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {head : Pair} ->
    {tail : List Pair} ->
    contains head tail == false ->
    NoDuplicates tail ->
    NoDuplicates (head ∷ tail)

record FiniteSet : Set where
  constructor finite-set
  field
    elements      : List Pair
    no-duplicates : NoDuplicates elements

open FiniteSet

length : List Pair -> Nat
length [] =
  zero
length (head ∷ tail) =
  suc (length tail)

Member : Pair -> FiniteSet -> Set
Member point finite =
  IsTrue (contains point (elements finite))

ContainedInInitialSquare : FiniteSet -> Nat -> Set
ContainedInInitialSquare finite n =
  (point : Pair) ->
  Member point finite ->
  Both
    (firstNat point <N n)
    (secondNat point <N n)

record IsCorner
  (finite : FiniteSet)
  (x1 y1 x2 y2 : Nat) :
  Set where

  field
    first-first-member :
      Member (pair x1 y1) finite
    first-second-member :
      Member (pair x1 y2) finite
    second-first-member :
      Member (pair x2 y1) finite
    additive-relation :
      x1 + y2 == x2 + y1

IsCornerFree : FiniteSet -> Set
IsCornerFree finite =
  (x1 y1 x2 y2 : Nat) ->
  IsCorner finite x1 y1 x2 y2 ->
  x1 == x2

corners-theorem-nat : Set2
corners-theorem-nat =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ bound ->
      Both
        (CornersTheoremBound reals
          (divideR reals epsilon (fromNatR reals 9))
          bound)
        (bound <=N n)) ->
  (finite : FiniteSet) ->
  ContainedInInitialSquare finite n ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      epsilon
      (fromNatR reals (n * n)))
    (fromNatR reals (length (elements finite))) ->
  Not (IsCornerFree finite)

title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  thousand-theorems__hol4__Q5171652, "Corners theorem": every sufficiently
  dense finite subset of {0, ..., n - 1} squared contains a nontrivial
  additive corner once n meets the explicit regularity-lemma cutoff. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q5171652_step_bound_def = new_definition (
  "q5171652_step_bound_def",
  ``q5171652_step_bound (n : num) = n * 4 EXP n``);

val q5171652_initial_bound_def = new_definition (
  "q5171652_initial_bound_def",
  ``q5171652_initial_bound (epsilon : real) (l : num) =
      MAX 7
        (MAX l
          (NUM_FLOOR
            (ln (100 / epsilon pow 5) / ln 4) + 1))``);

val q5171652_regularity_bound_def = new_definition (
  "q5171652_regularity_bound_def",
  ``q5171652_regularity_bound (epsilon : real) (l : num) =
      let b =
        FUNPOW q5171652_step_bound
          (NUM_FLOOR (4 / epsilon pow 5))
          (q5171652_initial_bound epsilon l)
      in
        b * 16 EXP b``);

val q5171652_triangle_removal_bound_def = new_definition (
  "q5171652_triangle_removal_bound_def",
  ``q5171652_triangle_removal_bound (epsilon : real) =
      min
        (inv (&(2 * NUM_CEILING (4 / epsilon) EXP 3)))
        ((1 - min 1 epsilon / 4) *
          (epsilon /
            (16 *
              &(q5171652_regularity_bound
                (epsilon / 8)
                (NUM_CEILING (4 / epsilon))))) pow 3)``);

val q5171652_corners_theorem_bound_def = new_definition (
  "q5171652_corners_theorem_bound_def",
  ``q5171652_corners_theorem_bound (epsilon : real) =
      NUM_FLOOR
        (inv
          (q5171652_triangle_removal_bound (epsilon / 9) * 27)) + 1``);

val q5171652_corner_free_def = new_definition (
  "q5171652_corner_free_def",
  ``q5171652_corner_free (A : (num # num) set) <=>
      !x1 y1 x2 y2 : num.
        (x1,y1) IN A /\
        (x1,y2) IN A /\
        (x2,y1) IN A /\
        x1 + y2 = x2 + y1
        ==>
        x1 = x2``);

val corners_theorem_nat =
  ``!epsilon : real. !n : num. !A : (num # num) set.
      0 < epsilon /\
      q5171652_corners_theorem_bound (epsilon / 9) <= n /\
      FINITE A /\
      (!p. p IN A ==> FST p < n /\ SND p < n) /\
      epsilon * (&n pow 2) <= &(CARD A)
      ==>
      ~q5171652_corner_free A``;

title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5171652
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q5171652), "Corners theorem": every
  sufficiently dense finite subset of an initial square of natural-number
  pairs contains a nontrivial corner once the side length meets the explicit
  bound. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$c Q5171652NatFloor Q5171652NatCeil Q5171652Inv Q5171652Max
   Q5171652Min Q5171652Step Q5171652Initial Q5171652Regularity
   Q5171652Triangle Q5171652Bound $.

q5171652-nat-floor-syntax $a class ( Q5171652NatFloor x ) $.
q5171652-nat-ceil-syntax $a class ( Q5171652NatCeil x ) $.
q5171652-inv-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Inv x ) $.
q5171652-max-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Max A B ) $.
q5171652-min-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Min A B ) $.
q5171652-step-syntax $a class Q5171652Step $.
q5171652-initial-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Initial x A ) $.
q5171652-regularity-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Regularity x A ) $.
q5171652-triangle-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Triangle x ) $.
q5171652-bound-syntax $a class ( Q5171652Bound x ) $.

$(
  Natural floor and ceiling are totalized as in Lean's Nat.floor and
  Nat.ceil.  Q5171652Inv records Lean's total inverse convention.
$)
q5171652-nat-floor-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652NatFloor x ) = if ( x < 0 , 0 , ( |_ ` x ) ) $.

q5171652-nat-ceil-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652NatCeil x ) =
      if ( x <_ 0 , 0 ,
        if ( x = ( |_ ` x ) , ( |_ ` x ) , ( ( |_ ` x ) + 1 ) ) ) $.

q5171652-inv-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Inv x ) = if ( x = 0 , 0 , ( 1 / x ) ) $.

q5171652-max-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Max A B ) = if ( A <_ B , B , A ) $.

q5171652-min-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Min A B ) = if ( A <_ B , A , B ) $.

q5171652-step-definition $a
  |- Q5171652Step = ( k e. NN0 |-> ( k x. ( 4 ^ k ) ) ) $.

q5171652-initial-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Initial x A ) =
      ( Q5171652Max 7
        ( Q5171652Max A
          ( ( Q5171652NatFloor
              ( ( log ` ( ( ( 2 x. 5 ) ^ 2 ) / ( x ^ 5 ) ) )
                / ( log ` 4 ) ) ) + 1 ) ) ) $.

q5171652-regularity-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Regularity x A ) =
      ( ( ( ( IterComp ` Q5171652Step )
              ` ( Q5171652NatFloor ( 4 / ( x ^ 5 ) ) ) )
            ` ( Q5171652Initial x A ) )
        x.
        ( ( 4 ^ 2 ) ^
          ( ( ( IterComp ` Q5171652Step )
                ` ( Q5171652NatFloor ( 4 / ( x ^ 5 ) ) ) )
              ` ( Q5171652Initial x A ) ) ) ) $.

q5171652-triangle-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Triangle x ) =
      ( Q5171652Min
        ( Q5171652Inv
          ( 2 x. ( ( Q5171652NatCeil ( 4 / x ) ) ^ 3 ) ) )
        ( ( 1 - ( ( Q5171652Min 1 x ) / 4 ) )
          x.
          ( ( x /
              ( ( 4 ^ 2 ) x.
                ( Q5171652Regularity
                  ( x / 8 ) ( Q5171652NatCeil ( 4 / x ) ) ) ) ) ^ 3 ) ) ) $.

q5171652-bound-definition $a
  |- ( Q5171652Bound x ) =
      ( ( Q5171652NatFloor
          ( Q5171652Inv
            ( ( Q5171652Triangle ( x / 9 ) ) x. ( 3 ^ 3 ) ) ) ) + 1 ) $.

$(
  This is corners_theorem_nat.  The source conclusion that the set is not
  corner-free is written in its definitionally equivalent witness form:
  three points of A form a corner and its two horizontal coordinates differ.
  The theorem applies Q5171652Bound to e / 9, while that definition applies
  Q5171652Triangle to its own argument divided by 9, preserving the source's
  two nested divisions by 9.  The final declaration is an unproved $a
  statement; this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)
${
  $d A e n w x y z $.
  q5171652-corners-theorem $a
    |- A. e e. RR A. n e. NN0 A. A e. Fin
       ( ( ( 0 < e /\ ( Q5171652Bound ( e / 9 ) ) <_ n )
           /\
           ( A C_ ( ( 0 ..^ n ) X. ( 0 ..^ n ) )
             /\ ( e x. ( n ^ 2 ) ) <_ ( # ` A ) ) )
         ->
         E. x e. NN0 E. y e. NN0 E. z e. NN0 E. w e. NN0
           ( ( ( <. x , y >. e. A /\ <. x , w >. e. A )
               /\ <. z , y >. e. A )
             /\ ( ( x + w ) = ( z + y ) /\ x =/= z ) ) ) $.
$}

theorem
