title: Q5171652_corners_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
% thousand-theorems__pvs__Q5171652, "Corners theorem": every sufficiently
% dense finite subset of an initial square of natural numbers contains a
% nontrivial additive corner once the side length meets the explicit
% regularity-lemma bound. This file contains no proof.

Q5171652_corners_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  point: TYPE = [# first_nat: nat, second_nat: nat #]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[point]

  point_set: TYPE = finite_set[point]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(x ^ index, factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (tolerance: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < tolerance

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat): exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  real_logarithm(x: real): real =
    IF x = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = abs(x))
    ENDIF

  nat_floor(x: real): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: nat):
        (x <= 0 AND value = 0)
          OR
        (0 <= x
          AND (value :: real) <= x
          AND x < ((value + 1) :: real)))

  nat_ceiling(x: real): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: nat):
        (x <= 0 AND value = 0)
          OR
        EXISTS (predecessor: nat):
          value = predecessor + 1
            AND (predecessor :: real) < x
            AND x <= ((predecessor + 1) :: real))

  nat_max(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left <= right THEN right ELSE left ENDIF

  real_minimum(left, right: real): real =
    IF left <= right THEN left ELSE right ENDIF

  step_bound(value: nat): nat =
    value * 4 ^ value

  iterate_step_bound(count, start: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      start
    ELSE
      iterate_step_bound(count - 1, step_bound(start))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  initial_regularity_bound(epsilon: real, lower: nat): nat =
    nat_max(
      7,
      nat_max(
        lower,
        nat_floor(
          safe_div(
            real_logarithm(safe_div(100, epsilon ^ 5)),
            real_logarithm(4)))
          + 1))

  regularity_bound(epsilon: real, lower: nat): nat =
    LET iterated: nat =
      iterate_step_bound(
        nat_floor(safe_div(4, epsilon ^ 5)),
        initial_regularity_bound(epsilon, lower))
    IN iterated * 16 ^ iterated

  triangle_removal_bound(epsilon: real): real =
    LET ceiling_four_over_epsilon: nat =
      nat_ceiling(safe_div(4, epsilon))
    IN
      LET regularity: nat =
        regularity_bound(
          safe_div(epsilon, 8),
          ceiling_four_over_epsilon)
      IN
        LET first_term: real =
          safe_div(
            1,
            2 * (ceiling_four_over_epsilon :: real) ^ 3),
            epsilon_minimum: real =
              real_minimum(1, epsilon)
        IN
          LET second_term: real =
            (1 - safe_div(epsilon_minimum, 4))
              * safe_div(
                epsilon,
                16 * (regularity :: real)) ^ 3
          IN real_minimum(first_term, second_term)

  corners_theorem_bound(epsilon: real): nat =
    nat_floor(
      safe_div(
        1,
        triangle_removal_bound(safe_div(epsilon, 9)) * 27))
      + 1

  contained_in_initial_square(A: point_set, n: nat): bool =
    FORALL (p: point):
      member(p, A) IMPLIES
        first_nat(p) < n AND second_nat(p) < n

  corner_free(A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x1, y1, x2, y2: nat):
      (member((# first_nat := x1, second_nat := y1 #), A)
        AND member((# first_nat := x1, second_nat := y2 #), A)
        AND member((# first_nat := x2, second_nat := y1 #), A)
        AND x1 + y2 = x2 + y1)
      IMPLIES x1 = x2

  corners_theorem_nat: bool =
    FORALL (epsilon: real), (n: nat), (A: point_set):
      (0 < epsilon
        AND corners_theorem_bound(safe_div(epsilon, 9)) <= n
        AND contained_in_initial_square(A, n)
        AND epsilon * (n :: real) ^ 2 <= (card(A) :: real))
      IMPLIES NOT corner_free(A)
END Q5171652_corners_theorem

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q530152
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q530152), "Picard–Lindelöf theorem": local existence
-- of a solution to a time-dependent ordinary differential equation under the
-- Picard–Lindelöf hypotheses, with a prescribed initial value. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Add
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Lipschitz

@[expose] public section

open Metric Set
open scoped NNReal

namespace Q530152

/-- The hypotheses of the Picard-Lindelöf theorem on a closed time interval and ball. -/
structure IsPicardLindelof {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (f : ℝ → E → E) {tmin tmax : ℝ} (t₀ : Icc tmin tmax) (x₀ : E)
    (a r L K : ℝ≥0) : Prop where
  lipschitzOnWith : ∀ t ∈ Icc tmin tmax, LipschitzOnWith K (f t) (closedBall x₀ a)
  continuousOn : ∀ x ∈ closedBall x₀ a, ContinuousOn (f · x) (Icc tmin tmax)
  norm_le : ∀ t ∈ Icc tmin tmax, ∀ x ∈ closedBall x₀ a, ‖f t x‖ ≤ L
  mul_max_le : L * max (tmax - t₀) (t₀ - tmin) ≤ a - r

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
  {f : ℝ → E → E} {tmin tmax : ℝ} {t₀ : Icc tmin tmax} {x₀ x : E} {a r L K : ℝ≥0}

/-- The differential-form Picard-Lindelöf local existence theorem. -/
theorem exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt
    (hf : IsPicardLindelof f t₀ x₀ a r L K) (hx : x ∈ closedBall x₀ r) :
    ∃ α : ℝ → E, α t₀ = x ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Icc tmin tmax, HasDerivWithinAt α (f t (α t)) (Icc tmin tmax) t := sorry

end Q530152

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q530152
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q530152), "Picard–Lindelöf theorem":
  local existence for a time-dependent Lipschitz vector field on a real
  Banach space, with a prescribed initial value. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q530152_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q530152_normed_real_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q530152_zero : E;
  q530152_add : E -> E -> E;
  q530152_neg : E -> E;
  q530152_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q530152_norm : E -> R;
  q530152_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q530152_add x (q530152_add y z) =
      q530152_add (q530152_add x y) z;
  q530152_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q530152_add x y = q530152_add y x;
  q530152_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q530152_add x q530152_zero = x;
  q530152_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q530152_add x (q530152_neg x) = q530152_zero;
  q530152_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q530152_smul 1 x = x;
  q530152_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q530152_smul (a * b) x =
      q530152_smul a (q530152_smul b x);
  q530152_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q530152_smul (a + b) x =
      q530152_add (q530152_smul a x) (q530152_smul b x);
  q530152_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q530152_smul a (q530152_add x y) =
      q530152_add (q530152_smul a x) (q530152_smul a y);
  q530152_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q530152_smul 0 x = q530152_zero;
  q530152_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q530152_smul a q530152_zero = q530152_zero;
  q530152_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q530152_norm x;
  q530152_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q530152_norm x = 0 <-> x = q530152_zero;
  q530152_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q530152_norm (q530152_add x y) <=
      q530152_norm x + q530152_norm y;
  q530152_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q530152_norm (q530152_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q530152_norm x
}.

Arguments q530152_zero {E} _.
Arguments q530152_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q530152_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q530152_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q530152_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q530152_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q530152_add V x (q530152_neg V y).

Definition q530152_sequence_converges
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) (limit : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q530152_norm V (q530152_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

Definition q530152_sequence_cauchy
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (u : nat -> E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q530152_norm V (q530152_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

Definition q530152_complete
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> E,
    q530152_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : E,
      q530152_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q530152_Icc (lower upper : R) : q530152_set R :=
  fun t : R => lower <= t /\ t <= upper.

Definition q530152_closed_ball
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (center : E) (radius : R) : q530152_set E :=
  fun x : E => q530152_norm V (q530152_sub V x center) <= radius.

Definition q530152_lipschitz_on_with
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (constant : R) (g : E -> E) (S : q530152_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x y : E,
    S x ->
    S y ->
    q530152_norm V (q530152_sub V (g x) (g y)) <=
      constant * q530152_norm V (q530152_sub V x y).

Definition q530152_continuous_on
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (g : R -> E) (S : q530152_set R) : Prop :=
  forall t : R,
    S t ->
    forall epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall u : R,
          S u ->
          Rabs (u - t) < delta ->
          q530152_norm V (q530152_sub V (g u) (g t)) < epsilon.

Definition q530152_has_deriv_within_at
    {E : Type}
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (alpha : R -> E) (derivative : E)
    (S : q530152_set R) (t : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall u : R,
        S u ->
        Rabs (u - t) < delta ->
        q530152_norm V
          (q530152_sub V
            (q530152_sub V (alpha u) (alpha t))
            (q530152_smul V (u - t) derivative)) <=
          epsilon * Rabs (u - t).

Record q530152_is_picard_lindelof
    (E : Type)
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : R -> E -> E)
    (tmin tmax t0 : R)
    (x0 : E)
    (a r L K : R) : Prop := {
  q530152_a_nonnegative : 0 <= a;
  q530152_r_nonnegative : 0 <= r;
  q530152_L_nonnegative : 0 <= L;
  q530152_K_nonnegative : 0 <= K;
  q530152_t0_mem : q530152_Icc tmin tmax t0;
  q530152_lipschitz :
    forall t : R,
      q530152_Icc tmin tmax t ->
      q530152_lipschitz_on_with V K (f t)
        (q530152_closed_ball V x0 a);
  q530152_continuous :
    forall y : E,
      q530152_closed_ball V x0 a y ->
      q530152_continuous_on V
        (fun t : R => f t y) (q530152_Icc tmin tmax);
  q530152_norm_le :
    forall t : R,
      q530152_Icc tmin tmax t ->
      forall y : E,
        q530152_closed_ball V x0 a y ->
        q530152_norm V (f t y) <= L;
  q530152_time_bound :
    L * Rmax (tmax - t0) (t0 - tmin) <= a - r
}.

Theorem IsPicardLindelof_exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt :
  forall
    (E : Type)
    (V : q530152_normed_real_vector_space E),
    q530152_complete V ->
    forall
      (f : R -> E -> E)
      (tmin tmax t0 : R)
      (x0 x : E)
      (a r L K : R),
      q530152_is_picard_lindelof
        E V f tmin tmax t0 x0 a r L K ->
      q530152_closed_ball V x0 r x ->
      exists alpha : R -> E,
        alpha t0 = x /\
        forall t : R,
          q530152_Icc tmin tmax t ->
          q530152_has_deriv_within_at V
            alpha (f t (alpha t)) (q530152_Icc tmin tmax) t.
Admitted.

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q530152,
  "Picard–Lindelöf theorem": local existence for a time-dependent
  Lipschitz vector field on a real Banach space, with an initial point in a
  closed ball and a derivative constrained to a closed time interval. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Lipschitz" "HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition q530152_is_picard_lindelof ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow>
      real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q530152_is_picard_lindelof f tmin tmax t0 x0 a r L K \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<le> a \<and> 0 \<le> r \<and> 0 \<le> L \<and> 0 \<le> K \<and>
    t0 \<in> {tmin..tmax} \<and>
    (\<forall>t \<in> {tmin..tmax}. K-lipschitz_on (cball x0 a) (f t)) \<and>
    (\<forall>y \<in> cball x0 a. continuous_on {tmin..tmax} (\<lambda>t. f t y)) \<and>
    (\<forall>t \<in> {tmin..tmax}. \<forall>y \<in> cball x0 a. norm (f t y) \<le> L) \<and>
    L * max (tmax - t0) (t0 - tmin) \<le> a - r"

theorem picard_lindelof:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> 'e::banach \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and tmin tmax t0 :: real
    and x0 x :: 'e
    and a r L K :: real
  assumes picard_lindelof_conditions:
      "q530152_is_picard_lindelof f tmin tmax t0 x0 a r L K"
    and initial_point: "x \<in> cball x0 r"
  shows "\<exists>\<alpha> :: real \<Rightarrow> 'e.
    \<alpha> t0 = x \<and>
    (\<forall>t \<in> {tmin..tmax}.
      (\<alpha> has_vector_derivative (f t (\<alpha> t)))
        (at t within {tmin..tmax}))"
  sorry

end

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q530152,
  "Picard–Lindelöf theorem": local existence for a time-dependent vector field
  on an arbitrary real Banach space under Lipschitz, continuity, norm-bound,
  and interval-size hypotheses. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q530152_PICARD_LINDELOF_THEOREM =
  `let normed_real_vector_space =
     \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
      (smul:real->A->A) (norm:A->real).
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
       (!x:A. add x zero = x) /\
       (!x:A. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
       (!x:A. neg (neg x) = x) /\
       (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!c d:real x:A. smul (c * d) x = smul c (smul d x)) /\
       (!c d:real x:A.
          smul (c + d) x = add (smul c x) (smul d x)) /\
       (!c:real x y:A.
          smul c (add x y) = add (smul c x) (smul c y)) /\
       (!x:A. smul (&0) x = zero) /\
       (!c:real. smul c zero = zero) /\
       (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
       (!x:A. norm x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!c:real x:A. norm (smul c x) = abs c * norm x) /\
       (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let complete_space =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real).
       !u:num->A.
         (!epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?N:num.
                  !m n:num.
                    N <= m /\ N <= n
                    ==> norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon)
         ==> ?limit:A.
               !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?N:num.
                       !n:num.
                         N <= n
                         ==> norm
                               (add (u n) (neg limit)) < epsilon in
   let closed_interval =
     \(lo:real) (hi:real) (t:real). lo <= t /\ t <= hi in
   let closed_ball =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
      (center:A) (radius:real) (y:A).
       norm (add y (neg center)) <= radius in
   let continuous_on_interval =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real)
      (h:real->A) (lo:real) (hi:real).
       !t:real.
         closed_interval lo hi t
         ==> !epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon
               ==> ?delta:real.
                     &0 < delta /\
                     !s:real.
                       closed_interval lo hi s /\
                       abs(s - t) < delta
                       ==> norm (add (h s) (neg (h t))) < epsilon in
   let has_derivative_within_interval =
     \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (smul:real->A->A)
      (norm:A->real) (alpha:real->A) (v:A)
      (lo:real) (hi:real) (t:real).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !s:real.
                 closed_interval lo hi s /\
                 abs(s - t) < delta
                 ==> norm
                       (add
                         (add (alpha s) (neg (alpha t)))
                         (neg (smul (s - t) v)))
                     <= epsilon * abs(s - t) in
   !zero:A.
   !add:A->A->A.
   !neg:A->A.
   !smul:real->A->A.
   !norm:A->real.
   !f:real->A->A.
   !tmin tmax t0:real.
   !x0 x:A.
   !a r L K:real.
     normed_real_vector_space zero add neg smul norm /\
     complete_space add neg norm /\
     &0 <= a /\ &0 <= r /\ &0 <= L /\ &0 <= K /\
     closed_interval tmin tmax t0 /\
     (!t:real.
        closed_interval tmin tmax t
        ==> !y z:A.
              closed_ball add neg norm x0 a y /\
              closed_ball add neg norm x0 a z
              ==> norm
                    (add (f t y) (neg (f t z)))
                  <= K * norm (add y (neg z))) /\
     (!y:A.
        closed_ball add neg norm x0 a y
        ==> continuous_on_interval
              add neg norm (\t. f t y) tmin tmax) /\
     (!t:real.
        closed_interval tmin tmax t
        ==> !y:A.
              closed_ball add neg norm x0 a y
              ==> norm (f t y) <= L) /\
     L * max (tmax - t0) (t0 - tmin) <= a - r /\
     closed_ball add neg norm x0 r x
     ==> ?alpha:real->A.
           alpha t0 = x /\
           !t:real.
             closed_interval tmin tmax t
             ==> has_derivative_within_interval
                   add neg smul norm alpha (f t (alpha t))
                   tmin tmax t`;;

content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q530152,
;; "Picard–Lindelöf theorem": a Lipschitz time-dependent vector field on a

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces name the real and vector carriers, their
;; operations, arbitrary sets and sequences, the vector field, and arbitrary
;; curves. All ordered-field, normed-space, completeness, continuity,
;; Lipschitz, and derivative conditions are explicit below.

(defstub q530152-real-p (real value) t)
(defstub q530152-real-set-member-p (real set value) t)
(defstub q530152-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q530152-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q530152-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q530152-r-mul (real left right) t)
(defstub q530152-r-neg (real value) t)
(defstub q530152-r-inv (real value) t)
(defstub q530152-r-lt (real left right) t)

(defstub q530152-vector-p (space value) t)
(defstub q530152-v-zero (space) t)
(defstub q530152-v-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q530152-v-neg (space value) t)
(defstub q530152-v-smul (real space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q530152-v-norm (real space vector) t)

(defstub q530152-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q530152-field-value (field time point) t)
(defstub q530152-curve-value (curve time) t)

(defun q530152-r-sub (real left right)
  (q530152-r-add real left (q530152-r-neg real right)))

(defun q530152-r-le (real left right)
  (not (q530152-r-lt real right left)))

(defun q530152-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q530152-r-lt real value (q530152-r-zero real))
      (q530152-r-neg real value)
    value))

(defun q530152-r-max (real left right)
  (if (q530152-r-lt real left right)
      right
    left))

(defun q530152-positive-real-p (real value)
  (and
   (q530152-real-p real value)
   (q530152-r-lt
    real (q530152-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q530152-nonnegative-real-p (real value)
  (and
   (q530152-real-p real value)
   (q530152-r-le
    real (q530152-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q530152-v-sub (space left right)
  (q530152-v-add space left (q530152-v-neg space right)))

(defun q530152-distance (real space left right)
  (q530152-v-norm
   real space (q530152-v-sub space left right)))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.

(defun-sk q530152-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-real-p real x)
      (q530152-real-p real y)
      (q530152-real-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q530152-r-zero real))
            (one (q530152-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q530152-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q530152-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q530152-r-mul real x y))
            (yz-mul (q530152-r-mul real y z))
            (neg-x (q530152-r-neg real x))
            (inv-x (q530152-r-inv real x)))
       (and
        (q530152-real-p real xy-add)
        (q530152-real-p real xy-mul)
        (q530152-real-p real neg-x)
        (q530152-real-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q530152-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q530152-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q530152-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q530152-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q530152-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q530152-r-mul real xy-mul z)
         (q530152-r-mul real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q530152-r-mul real y x))
        (equal (q530152-r-mul real x one) x)
        (equal (q530152-r-inv real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q530152-r-mul real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q530152-r-mul real x yz-add)
         (q530152-r-add
          real
          (q530152-r-mul real x y)
          (q530152-r-mul real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q530152-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-real-p real x)
      (q530152-real-p real y)
      (q530152-real-p real z))
     (and
      (not (q530152-r-lt real x x))
      (or
       (q530152-r-lt real x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q530152-r-lt real y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q530152-r-lt real x y)
        (q530152-r-lt real y z))
       (q530152-r-lt real x z))
      (implies
       (q530152-r-lt real x y)
       (q530152-r-lt
        real
        (q530152-r-add real x z)
        (q530152-r-add real y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q530152-r-lt
         real (q530152-r-zero real) x)
        (q530152-r-lt
         real (q530152-r-zero real) y))
       (q530152-r-lt
        real
        (q530152-r-zero real)
        (q530152-r-mul real x y)))))))

(defun-sk q530152-valid-real-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q530152-real-set-member-p real set x)
     (q530152-real-p real x))))

(defun-sk q530152-real-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q530152-real-p real x)
     (q530152-real-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q530152-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q530152-real-set-member-p real set x)
     (q530152-r-le real x bound))))

(defun-sk q530152-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q530152-real-p real bound)
     (q530152-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q530152-least-upper-bound-p
    (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-real-p real bound)
      (q530152-upper-bound-p real set bound))
     (q530152-r-le real supremum bound))))

(defun q530152-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (and
   (q530152-real-p real supremum)
   (q530152-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
   (q530152-least-upper-bound-p
    real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q530152-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q530152-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q530152-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-valid-real-set-p real set)
      (q530152-real-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q530152-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q530152-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q530152-real-structure-p (real)
  (and
   (q530152-real-p real (q530152-r-zero real))
   (q530152-real-p real (q530152-r-one real))
   (not
    (equal
     (q530152-r-zero real)
     (q530152-r-one real)))
   (q530152-r-lt
    real
    (q530152-r-zero real)
    (q530152-r-one real))
   (q530152-field-laws-p real)
   (q530152-order-laws-p real)
   (q530152-dedekind-complete-p real)))

;; Real normed vector-space laws.

(defun-sk q530152-additive-group-laws-p (space)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-vector-p space x)
      (q530152-vector-p space y)
      (q530152-vector-p space z))
     (let* ((zero (q530152-v-zero space))
            (xy (q530152-v-add space x y))
            (yz (q530152-v-add space y z))
            (neg-x (q530152-v-neg space x)))
       (and
        (q530152-vector-p space zero)
        (q530152-vector-p space xy)
        (q530152-vector-p space neg-x)
        (equal
         (q530152-v-add space xy z)
         (q530152-v-add space x yz))
        (equal xy (q530152-v-add space y x))
        (equal (q530152-v-add space x zero) x)
        (equal (q530152-v-add space x neg-x) zero))))))

(defun-sk q530152-scalar-action-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-real-p real a)
      (q530152-real-p real b)
      (q530152-vector-p space x)
      (q530152-vector-p space y))
     (let ((ax (q530152-v-smul real space a x))
           (bx (q530152-v-smul real space b x)))
       (and
        (q530152-vector-p space ax)
        (equal
         (q530152-v-smul
          real space (q530152-r-one real) x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q530152-v-smul
          real space
          (q530152-r-mul real a b)
          x)
         (q530152-v-smul real space a bx))
        (equal
         (q530152-v-smul
          real space
          (q530152-r-add real a b)
          x)
         (q530152-v-add space ax bx))
        (equal
         (q530152-v-smul
          real space a
          (q530152-v-add space x y))
         (q530152-v-add
          space
          ax
          (q530152-v-smul real space a y))))))))

(defun-sk q530152-norm-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-real-p real a)
      (q530152-vector-p space x)
      (q530152-vector-p space y))
     (let ((nx (q530152-v-norm real space x))
           (ny (q530152-v-norm real space y)))
       (and
        (q530152-real-p real nx)
        (q530152-r-le
         real (q530152-r-zero real) nx)
        (iff
         (equal nx (q530152-r-zero real))
         (equal x (q530152-v-zero space)))
        (equal
         (q530152-v-norm
          real space
          (q530152-v-smul real space a x))
         (q530152-r-mul
          real (q530152-r-abs real a) nx))
        (q530152-r-le
         real
         (q530152-v-norm
          real space
          (q530152-v-add space x y))
         (q530152-r-add real nx ny)))))))

;; Sequential completeness is equivalent to metric completeness for the norm
;; metric. Sequence objects are not finite tables.

(defun-sk q530152-vector-sequence-p (space sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q530152-vector-p
      space
      (q530152-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q530152-cauchy-tail-p
    (real space sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start m)
      (<= start n))
     (q530152-r-lt
      real
      (q530152-distance
       real space
       (q530152-sequence-value sequence m)
       (q530152-sequence-value sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-cauchy-start-exists-p
    (real space sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q530152-cauchy-tail-p
      real space sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q530152-cauchy-sequence-p
    (real space sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q530152-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (q530152-cauchy-start-exists-p
      real space sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-convergence-tail-p
    (real space sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp start)
      (<= start n))
     (q530152-r-lt
      real
      (q530152-distance
       real space
       (q530152-sequence-value sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-convergence-start-exists-p
    (real space sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q530152-convergence-tail-p
      real space sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q530152-sequence-converges-p
    (real space sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q530152-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (q530152-convergence-start-exists-p
      real space sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-sequence-limit-exists-p
    (real space sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q530152-vector-p space limit)
     (q530152-sequence-converges-p
      real space sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q530152-complete-space-p (real space)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-vector-sequence-p space sequence)
      (q530152-cauchy-sequence-p
       real space sequence))
     (q530152-sequence-limit-exists-p
      real space sequence))))

(defun q530152-real-banach-space-p (real space)
  (and
   (q530152-vector-p space (q530152-v-zero space))
   (q530152-additive-group-laws-p space)
   (q530152-scalar-action-laws-p real space)
   (q530152-norm-laws-p real space)
   (q530152-complete-space-p real space)))

;; Typed vector fields and curves.

(defun-sk q530152-vector-field-p
    (real space field)
  (forall (time point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-real-p real time)
      (q530152-vector-p space point))
     (q530152-vector-p
      space
      (q530152-field-value field time point)))))

(defun-sk q530152-curve-p (real space curve)
  (forall (time)
    (implies
     (q530152-real-p real time)
     (q530152-vector-p
      space
      (q530152-curve-value curve time)))))

(defun q530152-in-interval-p
    (real tmin tmax time)
  (and
   (q530152-real-p real time)
   (q530152-r-le real tmin time)
   (q530152-r-le real time tmax)))

(defun q530152-in-closed-ball-p
    (real space center radius point)
  (and
   (q530152-vector-p space point)
   (q530152-r-le
    real
    (q530152-distance real space point center)
    radius)))

;; Lipschitz continuity in the space variable on the closed ball.

(defun-sk q530152-lipschitz-at-time-p
    (real space field center radius constant time)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-in-closed-ball-p
       real space center radius left)
      (q530152-in-closed-ball-p
       real space center radius right))
     (q530152-r-le
      real
      (q530152-distance
       real space
       (q530152-field-value field time left)
       (q530152-field-value field time right))
      (q530152-r-mul
       real
       constant
       (q530152-distance
        real space left right))))))

(defun-sk q530152-lipschitz-on-cylinder-p
    (real space field tmin tmax center radius constant)
  (forall (time)
    (implies
     (q530152-in-interval-p
      real tmin tmax time)
     (q530152-lipschitz-at-time-p
      real space field center radius constant time))))

;; Continuity in time, within the closed interval, at a fixed space point.

(defun-sk q530152-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (real space field tmin tmax point time epsilon delta)
  (forall (other-time)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-in-interval-p
       real tmin tmax other-time)
      (q530152-r-lt
       real
       (q530152-r-abs
        real
        (q530152-r-sub real other-time time))
       delta))
     (q530152-r-lt
      real
      (q530152-distance
       real space
       (q530152-field-value field other-time point)
       (q530152-field-value field time point))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-continuity-radius-exists-p
    (real space field tmin tmax point time epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q530152-positive-real-p real delta)
     (q530152-continuity-neighborhood-p
      real space field tmin tmax point time epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q530152-continuous-within-at-p
    (real space field tmin tmax point time)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q530152-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (q530152-continuity-radius-exists-p
      real space field tmin tmax point time epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-continuous-on-cylinder-p
    (real space field tmin tmax center radius)
  (forall (point time)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-in-closed-ball-p
       real space center radius point)
      (q530152-in-interval-p
       real tmin tmax time))
     (q530152-continuous-within-at-p
      real space field tmin tmax point time))))

;; Uniform norm bound on the vector field over the cylinder.

(defun-sk q530152-field-norm-bounded-p
    (real space field tmin tmax center radius bound)
  (forall (time point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-in-interval-p
       real tmin tmax time)
      (q530152-in-closed-ball-p
       real space center radius point))
     (q530152-r-le
      real
      (q530152-v-norm
       real space
       (q530152-field-value field time point))
      bound))))

(defun q530152-time-radius-bound-p
    (real tmin tmax initial outer-radius
          initial-radius norm-bound)
  (q530152-r-le
   real
   (q530152-r-mul
    real
    norm-bound
    (q530152-r-max
     real
     (q530152-r-sub real tmax initial)
     (q530152-r-sub real initial tmin)))
   (q530152-r-sub
    real outer-radius initial-radius)))

(defun q530152-is-picard-lindelof-p
    (real space field tmin tmax initial center
          outer-radius initial-radius norm-bound
          lipschitz-constant)
  (and
   (q530152-lipschitz-on-cylinder-p
    real space field tmin tmax center
    outer-radius lipschitz-constant)
   (q530152-continuous-on-cylinder-p
    real space field tmin tmax center outer-radius)
   (q530152-field-norm-bounded-p
    real space field tmin tmax center
    outer-radius norm-bound)
   (q530152-time-radius-bound-p
    real tmin tmax initial outer-radius
    initial-radius norm-bound)))

;; HasDerivWithinAt on [tmin,tmax], expanded by the normed-space
;; epsilon-delta remainder condition.

(defun q530152-derivative-remainder
    (real space field curve time other-time)
  (q530152-v-sub
   space
   (q530152-v-sub
    space
    (q530152-curve-value curve other-time)
    (q530152-curve-value curve time))
   (q530152-v-smul
    real space
    (q530152-r-sub real other-time time)
    (q530152-field-value
     field time
     (q530152-curve-value curve time)))))

(defun-sk q530152-derivative-neighborhood-p
    (real space field curve tmin tmax time epsilon delta)
  (forall (other-time)
    (implies
     (and
      (q530152-in-interval-p
       real tmin tmax other-time)
      (q530152-r-lt
       real
       (q530152-r-abs
        real
        (q530152-r-sub real other-time time))
       delta))
     (q530152-r-le
      real
      (q530152-v-norm
       real space
       (q530152-derivative-remainder
        real space field curve time other-time))
      (q530152-r-mul
       real
       epsilon
       (q530152-r-abs
        real
        (q530152-r-sub real other-time time)))))))

(defun-sk q530152-derivative-radius-exists-p
    (real space field curve tmin tmax time epsilon)
  (exists (delta)
    (and
     (q530152-positive-real-p real delta)
     (q530152-derivative-neighborhood-p
      real space field curve tmin tmax time epsilon delta))))

(defun-sk q530152-has-deriv-within-at-p
    (real space field curve tmin tmax time)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q530152-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (q530152-derivative-radius-exists-p
      real space field curve tmin tmax time epsilon))))

(defun-sk q530152-curve-solves-on-interval-p
    (real space field curve tmin tmax)
  (forall (time)
    (implies
     (q530152-in-interval-p
      real tmin tmax time)
     (q530152-has-deriv-within-at-p
      real space field curve tmin tmax time))))

(defun q530152-solution-p
    (real space field tmin tmax initial point curve)
  (and
   (q530152-curve-p real space curve)
   (equal
    (q530152-curve-value curve initial)
    point)
   (q530152-curve-solves-on-interval-p
    real space field curve tmin tmax)))

(defun-sk q530152-solution-exists-p
    (real space field tmin tmax initial point)
  (exists (curve)
    (q530152-solution-p
     real space field tmin tmax initial point curve)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q530152-picard-lindelof-theorem-statement
    (real space field tmin tmax initial center point
          outer-radius initial-radius norm-bound
          lipschitz-constant)
  (implies
   (and
    (q530152-real-structure-p real)
    (q530152-real-banach-space-p real space)
    (q530152-vector-field-p real space field)
    (q530152-real-p real tmin)
    (q530152-real-p real tmax)
    (q530152-in-interval-p
     real tmin tmax initial)
    (q530152-vector-p space center)
    (q530152-vector-p space point)
    (q530152-nonnegative-real-p real outer-radius)
    (q530152-nonnegative-real-p real initial-radius)
    (q530152-nonnegative-real-p real norm-bound)
    (q530152-nonnegative-real-p
     real lipschitz-constant)
    (q530152-is-picard-lindelof-p
     real space field tmin tmax initial center
     outer-radius initial-radius norm-bound
     lipschitz-constant)
    (q530152-in-closed-ball-p
     real space center initial-radius point))
   (q530152-solution-exists-p
    real space field tmin tmax initial point)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q530152,
-- "Picard–Lindelöf theorem": under the Picard-Lindelöf conditions on a
-- time-dependent vector field in a real Banach space, a local integral curve
-- exists with the prescribed initial value. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

open CompleteOrderedField
open NormedVectorSpace

record NonnegativeReal
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set where
  constructor nonnegative-real
  field
    nonnegative-value :
      R
    value-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (zeroR reals)
        nonnegative-value

open NonnegativeReal

ClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Predicate R
ClosedInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals lower point)
    (lessOrEqualR reals point upper)

ClosedBall :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  Predicate E
ClosedBall {reals = reals} space center radius point =
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (distanceE space point center)
    (nonnegative-value radius)

maximumR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
maximumR reals x y with order-total reals x y
... | left _ = y
... | right _ = x

LipschitzOnWith :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  NonnegativeReal reals ->
  (E -> E) ->
  Predicate E ->
  Set
LipschitzOnWith {reals = reals} space constant function domain =
  (x y : _) ->
  domain x ->
  domain y ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (distanceE space (function x) (function y))
    (multiplyR reals
      (nonnegative-value constant)
      (distanceE space x y))

ContinuousWithinAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (R -> E) ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  Set
ContinuousWithinAt {R = R} reals space function domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceR reals y point) delta ->
          StrictLess reals
            (distanceE space (function y) (function point))
            epsilon))

ContinuousOn :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (R -> E) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
ContinuousOn reals space function domain =
  (point : _) ->
  domain point ->
  ContinuousWithinAt reals space function domain point

DerivativeRemainder :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (R -> E) ->
  E ->
  R ->
  R ->
  E
DerivativeRemainder {reals = reals}
  space function derivative point y =
  subtractE space
    (subtractE space (function y) (function point))
    (scaleE space
      (subtractR reals y point)
      derivative)

HasDerivWithinAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (R -> E) ->
  E ->
  Predicate R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivWithinAt {R = R} reals space function derivative domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          StrictLess reals (distanceR reals y point) delta ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE space
              (DerivativeRemainder
                space function derivative point y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceR reals y point))))

record IsPicardLindelof
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals)
  (f : R -> E -> E)
  (tmin tmax t0 : R)
  (x0 : E)
  (a r L K : NonnegativeReal reals) : Set1 where
  field
    lipschitz-in-space :
      (time : R) ->
      ClosedInterval reals tmin tmax time ->
      LipschitzOnWith space K (f time) (ClosedBall space x0 a)

    continuous-in-time :
      (point : E) ->
      ClosedBall space x0 a point ->
      ContinuousOn reals space
        (\ time -> f time point)
        (ClosedInterval reals tmin tmax)

    norm-bound :
      (time : R) ->
      ClosedInterval reals tmin tmax time ->
      (point : E) ->
      ClosedBall space x0 a point ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE space (f time point))
        (nonnegative-value L)

    time-radius-bound :
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (multiplyR reals
          (nonnegative-value L)
          (maximumR reals
            (subtractR reals tmax t0)
            (subtractR reals t0 tmin)))
        (subtractR reals
          (nonnegative-value a)
          (nonnegative-value r))

picard-lindelof-theorem : Set1
picard-lindelof-theorem =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  Complete reals (distanceE space) ->
  (f : R -> E -> E) ->
  (tmin tmax t0 : R) ->
  ClosedInterval reals tmin tmax t0 ->
  (x0 x : E) ->
  (a r L K : NonnegativeReal reals) ->
  IsPicardLindelof reals space f tmin tmax t0 x0 a r L K ->
  ClosedBall space x0 r x ->
  Exists (R -> E)
    (\ curve ->
      Both
        (curve t0 == x)
        ((time : R) ->
          ClosedInterval reals tmin tmax time ->
          HasDerivWithinAt reals space
            curve
            (f time (curve time))
            (ClosedInterval reals tmin tmax)
            time))

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q530152 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q530152), "Picard-Lindelöf theorem": a
  time-dependent vector field on a real Banach space satisfying local
  Lipschitz, continuity, norm-bound, and interval-size conditions has a local
  solution through each permitted initial point. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory;

val q530152_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q530152_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q530152_tendsto_sequence_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_tendsto_sequence_def",
  ``q530152_tendsto_sequence
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (u : num -> 'e) (ell : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==>
            norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q530152_cauchy_sequence_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_cauchy_sequence_def",
  ``q530152_cauchy_sequence
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !m n : num.
            N <= m /\ N <= n ==>
            norm (add (u m) (neg (u n))) < epsilon``);

val q530152_complete_space_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_complete_space_def",
  ``q530152_complete_space
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q530152_cauchy_sequence add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell : 'e.
          q530152_tendsto_sequence add neg norm u ell``);

val q530152_mem_Icc_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_mem_Icc_def",
  ``q530152_mem_Icc (tmin : real) (tmax : real) (t : real) <=>
      tmin <= t /\ t <= tmax``);

val q530152_mem_closed_ball_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_mem_closed_ball_def",
  ``q530152_mem_closed_ball
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (center : 'e) (radius : real) (x : 'e) <=>
      norm (add x (neg center)) <= radius``);

val q530152_lipschitz_on_with_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_lipschitz_on_with_def",
  ``q530152_lipschitz_on_with
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (k : real) (g : 'e -> 'e) (center : 'e) (radius : real) <=>
      !x y.
        q530152_mem_closed_ball add neg norm center radius x /\
        q530152_mem_closed_ball add neg norm center radius y
        ==>
        norm (add (g x) (neg (g y))) <=
          k * norm (add x (neg y))``);

val q530152_continuous_on_Icc_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_continuous_on_Icc_def",
  ``q530152_continuous_on_Icc
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (g : real -> 'e) (tmin : real) (tmax : real) <=>
      !t.
        q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax t ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          ?delta : real.
            0 < delta /\
            !s.
              q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax s /\
              abs (s - t) < delta
              ==>
              norm (add (g s) (neg (g t))) < epsilon``);

val q530152_real_max_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_real_max_def",
  ``q530152_real_max (x : real) (y : real) =
      if x <= y then y else x``);

val q530152_is_picard_lindelof_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_is_picard_lindelof_def",
  ``q530152_is_picard_lindelof
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (tmin : real) (tmax : real) (t0 : real) (x0 : 'e)
      (a : real) (r : real) (ell : real) (k : real) <=>
      (!t.
        q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax t ==>
        q530152_lipschitz_on_with add neg norm k (f t) x0 a) /\
      (!x.
        q530152_mem_closed_ball add neg norm x0 a x ==>
        q530152_continuous_on_Icc
          add neg norm (\t. f t x) tmin tmax) /\
      (!t x.
        q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax t /\
        q530152_mem_closed_ball add neg norm x0 a x
        ==>
        norm (f t x) <= ell) /\
      ell * q530152_real_max (tmax - t0) (t0 - tmin) <= a - r``);

val q530152_has_deriv_within_at_def = new_definition (
  "q530152_has_deriv_within_at_def",
  ``q530152_has_deriv_within_at
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (alpha : real -> 'e) (v : 'e)
      (tmin : real) (tmax : real) (t : real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !s.
            q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax s /\
            0 < abs (s - t) /\
            abs (s - t) < delta
            ==>
            norm
              (add
                (add (alpha s) (neg (alpha t)))
                (neg (smul (s - t) v))) <=
              epsilon * abs (s - t)``);

val IsPicardLindelof_exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (tmin : real) (tmax : real) (t0 : real)
      (x0 : 'e) (x : 'e)
      (a : real) (r : real) (ell : real) (k : real).
      q530152_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q530152_complete_space add neg norm /\
      0 <= a /\ 0 <= r /\ 0 <= ell /\ 0 <= k /\
      q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax t0 /\
      q530152_is_picard_lindelof
        add neg norm f tmin tmax t0 x0 a r ell k /\
      q530152_mem_closed_ball add neg norm x0 r x
      ==>
      ?alpha : real -> 'e.
        alpha t0 = x /\
        !t.
          q530152_mem_Icc tmin tmax t ==>
          q530152_has_deriv_within_at
            add neg smul norm alpha (f t (alpha t))
            tmin tmax t``;

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q530152
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q530152), "Picard–Lindelöf theorem":
  a time-dependent vector field on an arbitrary real Banach space satisfying
  the local Lipschitz, continuity, norm-bound, and interval-size hypotheses
  has a local solution through every permitted initial point. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  V ranges over SetMM normed vector spaces over RRfld, and V e. CMetSp is
  completeness for the norm metric. F is a time-dependent vector field,
  represented as a function from RR to the full function space Base(V) ^
  Base(V). Q530152ClosedBall is the norm-closed ball.

  Q530152ContinuousOn is relative epsilon-delta continuity.
  Q530152LipschitzOn is the source LipschitzOnWith predicate.
  Q530152HasDerivWithin is the epsilon-delta remainder characterization of
  HasDerivWithinAt for a curve RR -> Base(V), including its one-sided
  interpretation at interval endpoints. Q530152IsPicardLindelof expands all
  four fields of the source structure. The final declaration is the single
  unproved corpus $a statement; all preceding $a declarations are syntax or
  explicit bidirectional definitions.
$)

$c Q530152Sub Q530152Max Q530152ClosedBall Q530152ContinuousOn
   Q530152LipschitzOn Q530152HasDerivWithin
   Q530152IsPicardLindelof $.

q530152-sub-syntax $a class ( Q530152Sub V x y ) $.
q530152-max-syntax $a class ( Q530152Max A B ) $.
q530152-closed-ball-syntax
  $a class ( Q530152ClosedBall V X A ) $.
q530152-continuous-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q530152ContinuousOn V G S ) $.
q530152-lipschitz-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q530152LipschitzOn V K G S ) $.
q530152-has-deriv-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q530152HasDerivWithin V H C S T ) $.
q530152-is-picard-lindelof-syntax
  $a wff
    ( Q530152IsPicardLindelof V F M N T X A R L K ) $.

${
  $d V x y $.

  q530152-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q530152Sub V x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` V )
    ( ( -g ` V ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B $.

  q530152-max-definition $a |- (
    Q530152Max A B
  ) = if ( A <_ B , B , A ) $.
$}

${
  $d A V X y $.

  q530152-closed-ball-definition $a |- (
    Q530152ClosedBall V X A
  ) = {
    y e. ( Base ` V ) |
      (
        ( norm ` V )
        `
        ( Q530152Sub V y X )
      )
      <_
      A
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G S V d e x y $.

  q530152-continuous-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q530152ContinuousOn V G S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - x ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                ( norm ` V )
                `
                (
                  Q530152Sub
                  V
                  ( G ` y )
                  ( G ` x )
                )
              )
              <
              e
            )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G K S V x y $.

  q530152-lipschitz-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q530152LipschitzOn V K G S )
    <->
    A. x e. S
      A. y e. S
        (
          ( norm ` V )
          `
          (
            Q530152Sub
            V
            ( G ` x )
            ( G ` y )
          )
        )
        <_
        (
          K
          x.
          (
            ( norm ` V )
            `
            ( Q530152Sub V x y )
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C H S T V d e y $.

  q530152-has-deriv-within-definition $a |- (
    ( Q530152HasDerivWithin V H C S T )
    <->
    A. e e. RR+
      E. d e. RR+
        A. y e. S
          (
            ( ( abs ` ( y - T ) ) < d )
            ->
            (
              ( norm ` V )
              `
              (
                Q530152Sub
                V
                (
                  Q530152Sub
                  V
                  ( H ` y )
                  ( H ` T )
                )
                (
                  ( y - T )
                  ( .s ` V )
                  C
                )
              )
            )
            <_
            (
              e
              x.
              ( abs ` ( y - T ) )
            )
          )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F K L M N R T V X t x $.

  q530152-is-picard-lindelof-definition $a |- (
    (
      Q530152IsPicardLindelof
      V F M N T X A R L K
    )
    <->
    (
      A. t e. ( M [,] N )
        (
          Q530152LipschitzOn
          V
          K
          ( F ` t )
          ( Q530152ClosedBall V X A )
        )
      /\
      A. x e. ( Q530152ClosedBall V X A )
        (
          Q530152ContinuousOn
          V
          ( t e. RR |-> ( ( F ` t ) ` x ) )
          ( M [,] N )
        )
      /\
      A. t e. ( M [,] N )
        A. x e. ( Q530152ClosedBall V X A )
          (
            ( ( norm ` V ) ` ( ( F ` t ) ` x ) )
            <_
            L
          )
      /\
      (
        L
        x.
        (
          Q530152Max
          ( N - T )
          ( T - M )
        )
      )
      <_
      ( A - R )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F H K L M N R T V X Y t w $.

  thousand-theorems-q530152-picard-lindelof $a |-
    A. V e. { w e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` w ) = RRfld }
      A. F A. M A. N A. T A. X A. A A. R A. L A. K A. Y
        (
          (
            V e. CMetSp
            /\
            F e.
              (
                ( ( Base ` V ) ^m ( Base ` V ) )
                ^m
                RR
              )
            /\
            ( M e. RR /\ N e. RR )
            /\
            T e. ( M [,] N )
            /\
            X e. ( Base ` V )
            /\
            Y e. ( Base ` V )
            /\
            A e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
            /\
            R e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
            /\
            L e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
            /\
            K e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              (
                Q530152IsPicardLindelof
                V F M N T X A R L K
              )
              /\
              Y e. ( Q530152ClosedBall V X R )
            )
            ->
            E. H e. ( ( Base ` V ) ^m RR )
              (
                ( H ` T ) = Y
                /\
                A. t e. ( M [,] N )
                  (
                    Q530152HasDerivWithin
                    V
                    H
                    ( ( F ` t ) ` ( H ` t ) )
                    ( M [,] N )
                    t
                  )
              )
          )
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:

:: time-dependent ordinary differential equation on a real Banach space under

:: hypotheses. This file contains no proof.

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, PROB_1, MEASURE1, SUBSET_1, SEQFUNC,

      MEASURE1, FUNCT_2, RELAT_1, XBOOLE_0, NUMBERS, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0,

begin

::$P-

title: Q530152_picard_ndash_lindel_f_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q530152,
% "Picard–Lindelöf theorem": a time-dependent vector field satisfying
% local Lipschitz, continuity, norm-bound, and interval-size hypotheses on a
% Banach space has a local solution through each permitted initial point.
% This file contains no proof.

picard_lindelof_theorem_Q530152[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  curve: TYPE = [real -> E]
  time_dependent_vector_field: TYPE = [real -> [E -> E]]

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a_scalar: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a_scalar, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a_scalar, x), smulE(a_scalar, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a_scalar, b_scalar: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a_scalar + b_scalar, x) =
          addE(smulE(a_scalar, x), smulE(b_scalar, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a_scalar, b_scalar: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a_scalar * b_scalar, x) =
          smulE(a_scalar, smulE(b_scalar, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a_scalar: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a_scalar, x)) =
          abs(a_scalar) * normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  converges_to_e(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_e(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_e: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_e(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E):
          converges_to_e(values, limit)

  in_closed_interval(t, tmin, tmax: real): bool =
    tmin <= t AND t <= tmax

  in_closed_ball(
      point, center: E,
      radius: real): bool =
    normE(subE(point, center)) <= radius

  max_real(left, right: real): real =
    IF left <= right THEN right ELSE left ENDIF

  lipschitz_on_closed_ball(
      function_value: [E -> E],
      center: E,
      radius, constant: real): bool =
    FORALL (left, right: E):
      (in_closed_ball(left, center, radius)
        AND in_closed_ball(right, center, radius))
      IMPLIES
        normE(
          subE(function_value(left), function_value(right)))
          <= constant * normE(subE(left, right))

  continuous_in_time_on_interval(
      vector_field: time_dependent_vector_field,
      point: E,
      tmin, tmax: real): bool =
    FORALL (t: real):
      in_closed_interval(t, tmin, tmax) IMPLIES
        FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
          EXISTS (radius: posreal):
            FORALL (nearby: real):
              (in_closed_interval(nearby, tmin, tmax)
                AND abs(nearby - t) < radius)
              IMPLIES
                normE(
                  subE(
                    vector_field(nearby)(point),
                    vector_field(t)(point)))
                  < epsilon_value

  has_derivative_within_interval_at(
      function_value: curve,
      derivative: E,
      t, tmin, tmax: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (nearby: real):
          (in_closed_interval(nearby, tmin, tmax)
            AND abs(nearby - t) < radius)
          IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(
                subE(function_value(nearby), function_value(t)),
                smulE(nearby - t, derivative)))
              <= epsilon_value * abs(nearby - t)

  is_picard_lindelof(
      vector_field: time_dependent_vector_field,
      tmin, tmax, t0: real,
      center: E,
      ball_radius, initial_radius,
      norm_bound, lipschitz_constant: real): bool =
    (FORALL (t: real):
      in_closed_interval(t, tmin, tmax) IMPLIES
        lipschitz_on_closed_ball(
          vector_field(t),
          center,
          ball_radius,
          lipschitz_constant))
      AND (FORALL (point: E):
        in_closed_ball(point, center, ball_radius) IMPLIES
          continuous_in_time_on_interval(
            vector_field, point, tmin, tmax))
      AND (FORALL (t: real), (point: E):
        (in_closed_interval(t, tmin, tmax)
          AND in_closed_ball(point, center, ball_radius))
        IMPLIES
          normE(vector_field(t)(point)) <= norm_bound)
      AND norm_bound
        * max_real(tmax - t0, t0 - tmin)
          <= ball_radius - initial_radius

  picard_lindelof_theorem: bool =
    (normed_real_vector_space AND complete_space_e) IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (vector_field: time_dependent_vector_field),
          (tmin, tmax, t0: real),
          (center, initial_point: E),
          (ball_radius, initial_radius,
            norm_bound, lipschitz_constant: real):
        (in_closed_interval(t0, tmin, tmax)
          AND ball_radius >= 0
          AND initial_radius >= 0
          AND norm_bound >= 0
          AND lipschitz_constant >= 0
          AND is_picard_lindelof(
            vector_field,
            tmin, tmax, t0,
            center,
            ball_radius, initial_radius,
            norm_bound, lipschitz_constant)
          AND in_closed_ball(
            initial_point, center, initial_radius))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (solution: curve):
            solution(t0) = initial_point
              AND FORALL (t: real):
                in_closed_interval(t, tmin, tmax) IMPLIES
                  has_derivative_within_interval_at(
                    solution,
                    vector_field(t)(solution(t)),
                    t, tmin, tmax)
END picard_lindelof_theorem_Q530152

  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q536640
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q536640), "Hall's marriage theorem": an indexed
  family of finite sets has an injective system of representatives if and
  only if every finite subfamily has a union at least as large as the
  subfamily. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q536640_finset (X : Type) : Type := {
  q536640_elements : list X;
  q536640_elements_nodup : NoDup q536640_elements
}.

Arguments q536640_elements {X} _.

Definition q536640_mem
    {X : Type} (x : X) (s : q536640_finset X) : Prop :=
  In x (q536640_elements s).

Definition q536640_biunion_elements
    {I A : Type}
    (t : I -> q536640_finset A)
    (s : q536640_finset I) : list A :=
  flat_map
    (fun i : I => q536640_elements (t i))
    (q536640_elements s).

Definition q536640_biunion_card
    {I A : Type}
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (t : I -> q536640_finset A)
    (s : q536640_finset I) : nat :=
  length (nodup eq_dec (q536640_biunion_elements t s)).

Definition q536640_injective
    {I A : Type} (f : I -> A) : Prop :=
  forall x y : I, f x = f y -> x = y.

Module Finset.

Theorem all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_exists_injective :
  forall (I A : Type)
         (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
         (t : I -> q536640_finset A),
    (forall s : q536640_finset I,
      (length (q536640_elements s) <=
       q536640_biunion_card eq_dec t s)%nat) <->
    exists f : I -> A,
      q536640_injective f /\
      forall x : I, q536640_mem (f x) (t x).
Admitted.

End Finset.

  least as large as its index set. This file contains no proof.

let Q536640_HALL_S_MARRIAGE_THEOREM =
  `!indices:A->bool.
   !t:A->B->bool.
     (!i:A. i IN indices ==> FINITE (t i))
     ==> ((!s:A->bool.
            FINITE s /\ s SUBSET indices
            ==> CARD s <= CARD (UNIONS (IMAGE t s))) <=>
          ?f:A->B.
            (!x y:A.
               x IN indices /\ y IN indices /\ f x = f y
               ==> x = y) /\
            (!x:A. x IN indices ==> f x IN t x))`;;

title: Q536640_hall_s_marriage_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q536640,
;; "Hall's marriage theorem": an indexed family of finite sets has an
;; injective choice of representatives exactly when every finite subfamily's
;; union has cardinality at least its number of indices. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Unary tame function objects are characteristic predicates for the arbitrary
;; index and element carriers. FAMILY maps each index to a duplicate-free true
;; list representing its finite set. MATCHING maps indices to representatives.

(defun q536640-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun q536640-family-set (family index)
  (apply$ family (list index)))

(defun q536640-matching-value (matching index)
  (apply$ matching (list index)))

(defun q536640-elements-in-carrier-p (elements carrier)
  (if (consp elements)
      (and
       (q536640-member-p carrier (car elements))
       (q536640-elements-in-carrier-p (cdr elements) carrier))
    (equal elements nil)))

(defun q536640-finite-set-over-p (elements carrier)
  (and
   (true-listp elements)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal elements)
   (q536640-elements-in-carrier-p elements carrier)))

(defun-sk q536640-family-well-formed-p
    (index-carrier element-carrier family)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q536640-member-p index-carrier index)
     (q536640-finite-set-over-p
      (q536640-family-set family index)
      element-carrier))))

;; Every finite subset of the arbitrary index carrier is represented
;; extensionally by a duplicate-free true list.

(defun q536640-finite-index-subset-p (indices index-carrier)
  (q536640-finite-set-over-p indices index-carrier))

(defun q536640-family-union (indices family)
  (if (consp indices)
      (union-equal
       (q536640-family-set family (car indices))
       (q536640-family-union (cdr indices) family))
    nil))

(defun-sk q536640-hall-condition-p (index-carrier family)
  (forall (indices)
    (implies
     (q536640-finite-index-subset-p indices index-carrier)
     (<=
      (len indices)
      (len (q536640-family-union indices family))))))

;; The representative function is existentially quantified inside the
;; statement. Its values lie in the corresponding finite sets and it is
;; injective on the entire, potentially infinite, index carrier.

(defun-sk q536640-matching-selects-p
    (index-carrier element-carrier family matching)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q536640-member-p index-carrier index)
     (and
      (q536640-member-p
       element-carrier
       (q536640-matching-value matching index))
      (member-equal
       (q536640-matching-value matching index)
       (q536640-family-set family index))))))

(defun-sk q536640-matching-injective-p
    (index-carrier matching)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q536640-member-p index-carrier left-index)
      (q536640-member-p index-carrier right-index)
      (equal
       (q536640-matching-value matching left-index)
       (q536640-matching-value matching right-index)))
     (equal left-index right-index))))

(defun q536640-matching-p
    (index-carrier element-carrier family matching)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp matching)
   (q536640-matching-selects-p
    index-carrier element-carrier family matching)
   (q536640-matching-injective-p
    index-carrier matching)))

(defun-sk q536640-matching-exists-p
    (index-carrier element-carrier family)
  (exists (matching)
    (q536640-matching-p
     index-carrier element-carrier family matching)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q536640-hall-s-marriage-theorem-statement
    (index-carrier element-carrier family)
  (implies
   (and
    (tamep-functionp index-carrier)
    (tamep-functionp element-carrier)
    (tamep-functionp family)
    (q536640-family-well-formed-p
     index-carrier element-carrier family))
   (iff
    (q536640-hall-condition-p index-carrier family)
    (q536640-matching-exists-p
     index-carrier element-carrier family))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q536640_hall_s_marriage_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q536640,
-- "Hall's marriage theorem": a family of finite sets has an injective system
-- of representatives exactly when every finite subfamily has a union at least
-- as large as that subfamily. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q536640_hall_s_marriage_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)

infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom : Set where

data Dec
  {p : Level}
  (P : Set p) :
  Set p where

  yes : P -> Dec P
  no  : (P -> Bottom) -> Dec P

DecidableEquality :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
DecidableEquality A =
  (x y : A) ->
  Dec (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a lmax b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    distinct  : Injective enumerate

open FiniteSubset

Member :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Member subset item =
  Exists (Fin (size subset))
    (\ index -> item == enumerate subset index)

UnionMember :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (I -> FiniteSubset A) ->
  FiniteSubset I ->
  A ->
  Set a
UnionMember family indices item =
  Exists (Fin (size indices))
    (\ index ->
      Member
        (family (enumerate indices index))
        item)

HasAtLeast :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set p) ->
  Nat ->
  Set (a lmax p)
HasAtLeast {A = A} member cardinality =
  Exists (Fin cardinality -> A)
    (\ representatives ->
      Injective representatives
      and
      ((index : Fin cardinality) ->
        member (representatives index)))

HallCondition :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (I -> FiniteSubset A) ->
  Set (i lmax a)
HallCondition family =
  (indices : FiniteSubset _) ->
  HasAtLeast
    (UnionMember family indices)
    (size indices)

Matching :
  {i a : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (I -> FiniteSubset A) ->
  Set (i lmax a)
Matching {I = I} {A = A} family =
  Exists (I -> A)
    (\ representative ->
      Injective representative
      and
      ((index : I) ->
        Member (family index) (representative index)))

hall-s-marriage-theorem :
  {i a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (i lmax a))
hall-s-marriage-theorem {i} {a} =
  (I : Set i) ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  DecidableEquality A ->
  (family : I -> FiniteSubset A) ->
  HallCondition family
  iff
  Matching family
