title: Q536640_hall_s_marriage_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
% Q536640, "Hall's marriage theorem": a family of finite sets indexed by an
% arbitrary, possibly empty carrier has an injective system of representatives
% exactly when every finite subfamily has a union at least as large as that
% subfamily. This file contains no proof.

Q536640_hall_s_marriage_theorem[
  Index: TYPE,
  Element: TYPE,
  index_carrier: [Index -> bool],
  element_carrier: [Element -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index], finite_sets[Element]

  family: TYPE = [Index -> finite_set[Element]]

  index_set_on_carrier(indices: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      member(index, indices) IMPLIES index_carrier(index)

  element_set_on_carrier(values: finite_set[Element]): bool =
    FORALL (value: Element):
      member(value, values) IMPLIES element_carrier(value)

  family_on_carriers(sets: family): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      index_carrier(index) IMPLIES
        element_set_on_carrier(sets(index))

  selected_union(
      sets: family,
      indices: finite_set[Index],
      union_set: finite_set[Element]): bool =
    element_set_on_carrier(union_set)
      AND
        (FORALL (value: Element):
          member(value, union_set) IFF
            (element_carrier(value)
              AND
                EXISTS (index: Index):
                  index_carrier(index)
                    AND member(index, indices)
                    AND member(value, sets(index))))

  hall_condition(sets: family): bool =
    FORALL (indices: finite_set[Index]):
      index_set_on_carrier(indices) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (union_set: finite_set[Element]):
          selected_union(sets, indices, union_set)
            AND card(indices) <= card(union_set)

  injective_representatives(sets: family): bool =
    EXISTS (representative: [Index -> Element]):
      (FORALL (index: Index):
        index_carrier(index) IMPLIES
          (element_carrier(representative(index))
            AND member(representative(index), sets(index))))
        AND
          (FORALL (left, right: Index):
            index_carrier(left)
              AND index_carrier(right)
              AND representative(left) = representative(right)
            IMPLIES left = right)

  hall_s_marriage_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (sets: family):
      family_on_carriers(sets) IMPLIES
        (hall_condition(sets) IFF injective_representatives(sets))
END Q536640_hall_s_marriage_theorem

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q537618
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q537618), "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": the polar of
-- any neighborhood of zero in a seminormed vector space over a proper
-- nontrivially normed field is compact in the weak-star topology. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.WeakDual
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Bounded

@[expose] public section

open Filter
open scoped Topology

namespace Q537618

variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]

/-- The polar of a subset of the seminormed vector space. -/
def polar (𝕜 : Type*) {E : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
    [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (s : Set E) : Set (WeakDual 𝕜 E) :=
  {f | ∀ x ∈ s, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1}

/-- The Banach–Alaoglu compactness theorem for polars of neighborhoods of zero. -/
theorem banach_alaoglu_theorem [ProperSpace 𝕜] {s : Set E} (s_nhds : s ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E)) :
    IsCompact (polar 𝕜 s) := sorry

end Q537618

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q537618
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q537618), "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": the polar of
  a neighborhood of zero in a seminormed space over a proper nontrivially
  normed field is compact in the weak-star topology. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q537618_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Record q537618_normed_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q537618_fzero : K;
  q537618_fone : K;
  q537618_fadd : K -> K -> K;
  q537618_fmul : K -> K -> K;
  q537618_fneg : K -> K;
  q537618_finv : K -> K;
  q537618_fadd_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q537618_fadd a (q537618_fadd b c) =
      q537618_fadd (q537618_fadd a b) c;
  q537618_fadd_comm :
    forall a b : K, q537618_fadd a b = q537618_fadd b a;
  q537618_fadd_zero :
    forall a : K, q537618_fadd a q537618_fzero = a;
  q537618_fadd_neg :
    forall a : K, q537618_fadd a (q537618_fneg a) = q537618_fzero;
  q537618_fmul_assoc :
    forall a b c : K,
      q537618_fmul a (q537618_fmul b c) =
      q537618_fmul (q537618_fmul a b) c;
  q537618_fmul_comm :
    forall a b : K, q537618_fmul a b = q537618_fmul b a;
  q537618_fmul_one :
    forall a : K, q537618_fmul a q537618_fone = a;
  q537618_fmul_inv :
    forall a : K,
      a <> q537618_fzero ->
      q537618_fmul a (q537618_finv a) = q537618_fone;
  q537618_fdistrib :
    forall a b c : K,
      q537618_fmul a (q537618_fadd b c) =
      q537618_fadd
        (q537618_fmul a b) (q537618_fmul a c);
  q537618_fzero_neq_one :
    q537618_fzero <> q537618_fone;
  q537618_fnorm : K -> R;
  q537618_fnorm_nonnegative :
    forall a : K, 0 <= q537618_fnorm a;
  q537618_fnorm_eq_zero :
    forall a : K,
      q537618_fnorm a = 0 <-> a = q537618_fzero;
  q537618_fnorm_add :
    forall a b : K,
      q537618_fnorm (q537618_fadd a b) <=
      q537618_fnorm a + q537618_fnorm b;
  q537618_fnorm_mul :
    forall a b : K,
      q537618_fnorm (q537618_fmul a b) =
      q537618_fnorm a * q537618_fnorm b;
  q537618_fnorm_one :
    q537618_fnorm q537618_fone = 1;
  q537618_fnorm_neg :
    forall a : K,
      q537618_fnorm (q537618_fneg a) = q537618_fnorm a;
  q537618_fnorm_nontrivial :
    exists a : K, 1 < q537618_fnorm a
}.

Arguments q537618_fzero {K} _.
Arguments q537618_fone {K} _.
Arguments q537618_fadd {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q537618_fmul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q537618_fneg {K} _ _.
Arguments q537618_finv {K} _ _.
Arguments q537618_fnorm {K} _ _.

Definition q537618_fsub
    {K : Type}
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K)
    (a b : K) : K :=
  q537618_fadd scalar a (q537618_fneg scalar b).

Definition q537618_fdist
    {K : Type}
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K)
    (a b : K) : R :=
  q537618_fnorm scalar (q537618_fsub scalar a b).

Record q537618_seminormed_space
    (K E : Type)
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K) : Type := {
  q537618_vzero : E;
  q537618_vadd : E -> E -> E;
  q537618_vneg : E -> E;
  q537618_smul : K -> E -> E;
  q537618_vadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q537618_vadd x (q537618_vadd y z) =
      q537618_vadd (q537618_vadd x y) z;
  q537618_vadd_comm :
    forall x y : E, q537618_vadd x y = q537618_vadd y x;
  q537618_vadd_zero :
    forall x : E, q537618_vadd x q537618_vzero = x;
  q537618_vadd_neg :
    forall x : E, q537618_vadd x (q537618_vneg x) = q537618_vzero;
  q537618_smul_one :
    forall x : E,
      q537618_smul (q537618_fone scalar) x = x;
  q537618_smul_mul :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q537618_smul (q537618_fmul scalar a b) x =
      q537618_smul a (q537618_smul b x);
  q537618_smul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : K) (x : E),
      q537618_smul (q537618_fadd scalar a b) x =
      q537618_vadd
        (q537618_smul a x) (q537618_smul b x);
  q537618_smul_add_vector :
    forall (a : K) (x y : E),
      q537618_smul a (q537618_vadd x y) =
      q537618_vadd
        (q537618_smul a x) (q537618_smul a y);
  q537618_smul_zero_scalar :
    forall x : E,
      q537618_smul (q537618_fzero scalar) x = q537618_vzero;
  q537618_smul_zero_vector :
    forall a : K,
      q537618_smul a q537618_vzero = q537618_vzero;
  q537618_vnorm : E -> R;
  q537618_vnorm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q537618_vnorm x;
  q537618_vnorm_zero :
    q537618_vnorm q537618_vzero = 0;
  q537618_vnorm_neg :
    forall x : E, q537618_vnorm (q537618_vneg x) = q537618_vnorm x;
  q537618_vnorm_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q537618_vnorm (q537618_vadd x y) <=
      q537618_vnorm x + q537618_vnorm y;
  q537618_vnorm_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q537618_vnorm (q537618_smul a x) =
      q537618_fnorm scalar a * q537618_vnorm x
}.

Arguments q537618_vzero {K E scalar} _.
Arguments q537618_vadd {K E scalar} _ _ _.
Arguments q537618_vneg {K E scalar} _ _.
Arguments q537618_smul {K E scalar} _ _ _.
Arguments q537618_vnorm {K E scalar} _ _.

Definition q537618_vsub
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    (space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q537618_vadd space x (q537618_vneg space y).

Definition q537618_vdist
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    (space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar)
    (x y : E) : R :=
  q537618_vnorm space (q537618_vsub space x y).

Definition q537618_metric_open
    {X : Type}
    (distance : X -> X -> R)
    (U : q537618_set X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : X, distance y x < radius -> U y.

Definition q537618_is_compact
    {X : Type}
    (is_open : q537618_set (q537618_set X))
    (S : q537618_set X) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q537618_set (q537618_set X),
    (forall U : q537618_set X,
      cover U -> is_open U) ->
    (forall x : X,
      S x ->
      exists U : q537618_set X, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q537618_set X),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : X,
        S x ->
        exists U : q537618_set X,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q537618_scalar_open
    {K : Type}
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K) :
    q537618_set (q537618_set K) :=
  q537618_metric_open (q537618_fdist scalar).

Definition q537618_vector_open
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    (space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar) :
    q537618_set (q537618_set E) :=
  q537618_metric_open (q537618_vdist space).

Definition q537618_closed_ball
    {K : Type}
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K)
    (center : K)
    (radius : R) : q537618_set K :=
  fun x : K => q537618_fdist scalar x center <= radius.

Definition q537618_proper_space
    {K : Type}
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K) : Prop :=
  forall (center : K) (radius : R),
    q537618_is_compact
      (q537618_scalar_open scalar)
      (q537618_closed_ball scalar center radius).

Definition q537618_neighborhood
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    (space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar)
    (x : E)
    (S : q537618_set E) : Prop :=
  exists U : q537618_set E,
    q537618_vector_open space U /\
    U x /\
    forall y : E, U y -> S y.

Record q537618_weak_dual
    (K E : Type)
    (scalar : q537618_normed_field K)
    (space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar) : Type := {
  q537618_dual_fun : E -> K;
  q537618_dual_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q537618_dual_fun (q537618_vadd space x y) =
      q537618_fadd scalar
        (q537618_dual_fun x) (q537618_dual_fun y);
  q537618_dual_smul :
    forall (a : K) (x : E),
      q537618_dual_fun (q537618_smul space a x) =
      q537618_fmul scalar a (q537618_dual_fun x);
  q537618_dual_continuous :
    forall (x : E) (epsilon : R),
      0 < epsilon ->
      exists delta : R,
        0 < delta /\
        forall y : E,
          q537618_vdist space y x < delta ->
          q537618_fdist scalar
            (q537618_dual_fun y)
            (q537618_dual_fun x) < epsilon
}.

Arguments q537618_dual_fun
  {K E scalar space} _ _.

Definition q537618_basic_weakstar_open
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    {space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar}
    (B : q537618_set (@q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space)) : Prop :=
  exists constraints : list (E * q537618_set K),
    (forall constraint : E * q537618_set K,
      In constraint constraints ->
      q537618_scalar_open scalar (snd constraint)) /\
    forall f : @q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space,
      B f <->
      forall constraint : E * q537618_set K,
        In constraint constraints ->
        (snd constraint)
          (q537618_dual_fun f (fst constraint)).

Definition q537618_weakstar_open
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    {space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar}
    (U : q537618_set (@q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space)) : Prop :=
  exists family :
      q537618_set
        (q537618_set (@q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space)),
    (forall B : q537618_set (@q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space),
      family B -> q537618_basic_weakstar_open B) /\
    forall f : @q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space,
      U f <->
      exists B : q537618_set (@q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space),
        family B /\ B f.

Definition q537618_polar
    {K E : Type}
    {scalar : q537618_normed_field K}
    {space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar}
    (S : q537618_set E) :
    q537618_set (@q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space) :=
  fun f : @q537618_weak_dual K E scalar space =>
    forall x : E,
      S x ->
      q537618_fnorm scalar (q537618_dual_fun f x) <= 1.

Theorem q537618_banach_alaoglu :
  forall (K E : Type)
         (scalar : q537618_normed_field K)
         (space : @q537618_seminormed_space K E scalar),
    q537618_proper_space scalar ->
    forall S : q537618_set E,
      q537618_neighborhood
        space (q537618_vzero space) S ->
      q537618_is_compact
        (@q537618_weakstar_open K E scalar space)
        (q537618_polar S).
Admitted.

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q537618,
  "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": over a proper nontrivially normed field, the polar
  of a neighborhood of zero in a seminormed vector space is compact in the
  weak-star topology of its continuous dual. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q537618_topspace :: "'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q537618_topspace T = \<Union>T"

definition q537618_compactin :: "'a set set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_compactin T K \<longleftrightarrow>
    K \<subseteq> q537618_topspace T \<and>
    (\<forall>C. C \<subseteq> T \<longrightarrow> K \<subseteq> \<Union>C \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>F \<subseteq> C. finite F \<and> K \<subseteq> \<Union>F))"

definition q537618_nontrivially_normed_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_nontrivially_normed_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    knorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>a. 0 \<le> knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm a = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> a = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. knorm (-a) = knorm a) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a + b) \<le> knorm a + knorm b) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. knorm (a * b) = knorm a * knorm b) \<and>
    (\<exists>a. 1 < knorm a)"

definition q537618_field_open ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'k set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_field_open knorm U \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a \<in> U. \<exists>epsilon > 0.
      \<forall>b. knorm (b - a) < epsilon \<longrightarrow> b \<in> U)"

definition q537618_field_topology ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'k set set" where
  "q537618_field_topology knorm = {U. q537618_field_open knorm U}"

definition q537618_proper_field ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_proper_field knorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a r. q537618_compactin (q537618_field_topology knorm)
      {b. knorm (b - a) \<le> r})"

definition q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group enorm \<longleftrightarrow>
    enorm 0 = 0 \<and>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. enorm (-x) = enorm x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. enorm (x + y) \<le> enorm x + enorm y)"

definition q537618_normed_space ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_normed_space knorm enorm scale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. scale a (x + y) = scale a x + scale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a + b) x = scale a x + scale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. scale (a * b) x = scale a (scale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. scale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. enorm (scale a x) = knorm a * enorm x)"

definition q537618_continuous_linear ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_continuous_linear knorm enorm scale f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x y. f (x + y) = f x + f y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. f (scale a x) = a * f x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x epsilon. 0 < epsilon \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>delta > 0. \<forall>y.
        enorm (y - x) < delta \<longrightarrow>
        knorm (f y - f x) < epsilon))"

definition q537618_dual ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) set" where
  "q537618_dual knorm enorm scale =
    {f. q537618_continuous_linear knorm enorm scale f}"

definition q537618_weak_star_open ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_weak_star_open knorm enorm scale U \<longleftrightarrow>
    U \<subseteq> q537618_dual knorm enorm scale \<and>
    (\<forall>f \<in> U. \<exists>J V.
      finite J \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> J. q537618_field_open knorm (V x)) \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> J. f x \<in> V x) \<and>
      {g. g \<in> q537618_dual knorm enorm scale \<and>
        (\<forall>x \<in> J. g x \<in> V x)} \<subseteq> U)"

definition q537618_weak_star_topology ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) set set" where
  "q537618_weak_star_topology knorm enorm scale =
    {U. q537618_weak_star_open knorm enorm scale U}"

definition q537618_polar ::
    "('k::field \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
     ('k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
     'e set \<Rightarrow> ('e \<Rightarrow> 'k) set" where
  "q537618_polar knorm enorm scale s =
    {f. f \<in> q537618_dual knorm enorm scale \<and>
      (\<forall>x \<in> s. knorm (f x) \<le> 1)}"

definition q537618_neighborhood_zero ::
    "('e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'e set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q537618_neighborhood_zero enorm s \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>epsilon > 0. {x. enorm x < epsilon} \<subseteq> s)"

theorem banach_alaoglu:
  fixes knorm :: "'k::field \<Rightarrow> real"
    and enorm :: "'e::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and scale :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and s :: "'e set"
  assumes "q537618_nontrivially_normed_field knorm"
    and "q537618_proper_field knorm"
    and "q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group enorm"
    and "q537618_normed_space knorm enorm scale"
    and "q537618_neighborhood_zero enorm s"
  shows "q537618_compactin
    (q537618_weak_star_topology knorm enorm scale)
    (q537618_polar knorm enorm scale s)"
  sorry

end

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q537618,
  "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": over a proper nontrivially normed field, the polar
  of a neighborhood of zero in a seminormed space is compact in the weak-star
  topology on the continuous dual. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q537618_BANACH_ALAOGLU_THEOREM =
 `let nontrivially_normed_field =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A)
     (negK:A->A) (invK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A. addK a (addK b c) = addK (addK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a:A. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b c:A. mulK a (mulK b c) = mulK (mulK a b) c) /\
       (!a b:A. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a:A. mulK zeroK a = zeroK) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:A. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
       (!a b c:A.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       normK zeroK = &0 /\
       (!a:A. &0 <= normK a) /\
       (!a:A. normK a = &0 <=> a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
       (!a b:A. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
       (?a:A. &1 < normK a) in
  let seminormed_add_comm_group =
    \(zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (negE:B->B) (normE:B->real).
       (!x y z:B. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
       (!x y:B. addE x y = addE y x) /\
       (!x:B. addE zeroE x = x) /\
       (!x:B. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
       normE zeroE = &0 /\
       (!x:B. &0 <= normE x) /\
       (!x:B. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
       (!x y:B. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
  let normed_space =
    \(zeroK:A) (oneK:A)
     (addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A) (normK:A->real)
     (zeroE:B) (addE:B->B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (smul:A->B->B).
       (!x:B. smul oneK x = x) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (mulK a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:A. !x:B.
          smul (addK a b) x = addE (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:A. !x y:B.
          smul a (addE x y) = addE (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!a:A. smul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
       (!x:B. smul zeroK x = zeroE) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. normE (smul a x) = normK a * normE x) in
  let norm_open =
    \(addK:A->A->A) (negK:A->A) (normK:A->real)
     (U:A->bool).
       !x:A.
         x IN U
         ==> ?epsilon:real.
               &0 < epsilon /\
               !y:A.
                 normK (addK y (negK x)) < epsilon
                 ==> y IN U in
  let is_compact_field =
    \(opens:(A->bool)->bool) (compact_set:A->bool).
       !open_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!cover_member:A->bool.
            cover_member IN open_cover ==> opens cover_member) /\
         compact_set SUBSET UNIONS open_cover
         ==> ?finite_subcover:(A->bool)->bool.
               finite_subcover SUBSET open_cover /\
               FINITE finite_subcover /\
               compact_set SUBSET UNIONS finite_subcover in
  let proper_space =
    \(addK:A->A->A) (negK:A->A) (normK:A->real).
       !center:A. !radius:real.
         is_compact_field
           (norm_open addK negK normK)
           {x:A | normK (addK x (negK center)) <= radius} in
  let continuous_linear_functional =
    \(addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A) (normK:A->real)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (normE:B->real)
     (f:B->A).
       (!x y:B. f (addE x y) = addK (f x) (f y)) /\
       (!a:A. !x:B. f (smul a x) = mulK a (f x)) /\
       (!epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !x:B. normE x < delta ==> normK (f x) < epsilon) in
  let weak_dual =
    \(addK:A->A->A) (mulK:A->A->A) (normK:A->real)
     (addE:B->B->B) (smul:A->B->B) (normE:B->real).
       {f:B->A |
          continuous_linear_functional
            addK mulK normK addE smul normE f} in
  let weak_star_open =
    \(addK:A->A->A) (negK:A->A) (normK:A->real)
     (dual:(B->A)->bool) (U:(B->A)->bool).
       U SUBSET dual /\
       !f:B->A.
         f IN U
         ==> ?coordinates:B->bool. ?epsilon:B->real.
               FINITE coordinates /\
               (!x:B. x IN coordinates ==> &0 < epsilon x) /\
               {g:B->A |
                  g IN dual /\
                  !x:B.
                    x IN coordinates
                    ==> normK (addK (g x) (negK (f x))) < epsilon x}
               SUBSET U in
  let polar =
    \(normK:A->real) (dual:(B->A)->bool) (s:B->bool).
       {f:B->A |
          f IN dual /\
          !x:B. x IN s ==> normK (f x) <= &1} in
  let is_compact_weak_dual =
    \(dual:(B->A)->bool)
     (opens:((B->A)->bool)->bool)
     (compact_set:(B->A)->bool).
       compact_set SUBSET dual /\
       !open_cover:((B->A)->bool)->bool.
         (!cover_member:(B->A)->bool.
            cover_member IN open_cover ==> opens cover_member) /\
         compact_set SUBSET UNIONS open_cover
         ==> ?finite_subcover:((B->A)->bool)->bool.
               finite_subcover SUBSET open_cover /\
               FINITE finite_subcover /\
               compact_set SUBSET UNIONS finite_subcover in
  !zeroK oneK:A.
  !addK mulK:A->A->A.
  !negK invK:A->A.
  !normK:A->real.
  !zeroE:B.
  !addE:B->B->B.
  !negE:B->B.
  !smul:A->B->B.
  !normE:B->real.
  !s:B->bool.
    nontrivially_normed_field
      zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
    seminormed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
    normed_space
      zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE normE smul /\
    proper_space addK negK normK /\
    (?epsilon:real.
       &0 < epsilon /\
       !x:B. normE x < epsilon ==> x IN s)
    ==> let dual =
          weak_dual addK mulK normK addE smul normE in
        is_compact_weak_dual
          dual
          (weak_star_open addK negK normK dual)
          (polar normK dual s)`;;

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q537618,
;; Banach–Alaoglu theorem: the polar of a neighborhood of zero in an arbitrary
;; seminormed space over a proper nontrivially normed field is compact in the
;; weak-star topology on its continuous dual. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Carriers, sets, families of sets, maps, and operations are arbitrary
;; conservative interfaces.  No carrier, set, family, or function is
;; enumerated or represented by a finite table.

(defstub ba-real-p (real-type x) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-p (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub ba-vector-p (vector-type x) t)
(defstub ba-map-p (scalar-type vector-type map) t)

(defstub ba-set-p (carrier-type set) t)
(defstub ba-in (carrier-type set x) t)
(defstub ba-family-p (carrier-type family) t)
(defstub ba-family-in (carrier-type family set) t)

(defstub ba-real-zero (real-type) t)
(defstub ba-real-one (real-type) t)
(defstub ba-real-add (real-type x y) t)
(defstub ba-real-mul (real-type x y) t)
(defstub ba-real-neg (real-type x) t)
(defstub ba-real-inv (real-type x) t)
(defstub ba-real-le (real-type x y) t)
(defstub ba-real-lt (real-type x y) t)

(defstub ba-scalar-zero (scalar-type) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-one (scalar-type) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-add (scalar-type x y) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-mul (scalar-type x y) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-neg (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-inv (scalar-type x) t)
(defstub ba-scalar-norm (real-type scalar-type x) t)

(defstub ba-vector-zero (vector-type) t)
(defstub ba-vector-add (vector-type x y) t)
(defstub ba-vector-neg (vector-type x) t)
(defstub ba-smul (scalar-type vector-type a x) t)
(defstub ba-vector-norm (real-type vector-type x) t)

(defstub ba-apply (scalar-type vector-type map x) t)
(defstub ba-zero-map (scalar-type vector-type) t)

(defstub ba-scalar-closed-ball
  (real-type scalar-type center radius)
  t)
(defstub ba-polar-set
  (real-type scalar-type vector-type set)
  t)

(defun ba-real-sub (real-type x y)
  (ba-real-add real-type x (ba-real-neg real-type y)))

(defun ba-scalar-sub (scalar-type x y)
  (ba-scalar-add scalar-type x (ba-scalar-neg scalar-type y)))

(defun ba-vector-sub (vector-type x y)
  (ba-vector-add vector-type x (ba-vector-neg vector-type y)))

(defun ba-scalar-dist (real-type scalar-type x y)
  (ba-scalar-norm
   real-type scalar-type (ba-scalar-sub scalar-type x y)))

(defun ba-weakdual-type (scalar-type vector-type)
  (list 'weak-dual scalar-type vector-type))

;; Extensionality preserves source equality for arbitrary sets, families, and
;; functionals.

(defun-sk ba-sets-extensionally-equal-p (carrier-type left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (or (ba-in carrier-type left x)
         (ba-in carrier-type right x))
     (iff
      (ba-in carrier-type left x)
      (ba-in carrier-type right x)))))

(defun-sk ba-set-extensionality-p (carrier-type)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-set-p carrier-type left)
      (ba-set-p carrier-type right)
      (ba-sets-extensionally-equal-p carrier-type left right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ba-families-extensionally-equal-p
    (carrier-type left right)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (or
      (ba-family-in carrier-type left set)
      (ba-family-in carrier-type right set))
     (iff
      (ba-family-in carrier-type left set)
      (ba-family-in carrier-type right set)))))

(defun-sk ba-family-extensionality-p (carrier-type)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-family-p carrier-type left)
      (ba-family-p carrier-type right)
      (ba-families-extensionally-equal-p
       carrier-type left right))
     (equal left right))))

(defun-sk ba-maps-extensionally-equal-p
    (scalar-type vector-type left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
     (equal
      (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type left x)
      (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type right x)))))

(defun-sk ba-map-extensionality-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-map-p scalar-type vector-type left)
      (ba-map-p scalar-type vector-type right)
      (ba-maps-extensionally-equal-p
       scalar-type vector-type left right))
     (equal left right))))

;; The real-valued norm codomain is an arbitrary complete linearly ordered
;; field, rather than ACL2 rationals.

(defun-sk ba-real-unary-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (ba-real-p real-type x)
     (and
      (ba-real-p real-type (ba-real-neg real-type x))
      (ba-real-p real-type (ba-real-inv real-type x))
      (equal
       (ba-real-add real-type x (ba-real-zero real-type))
       x)
      (equal
       (ba-real-add real-type x (ba-real-neg real-type x))
       (ba-real-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (ba-real-mul real-type x (ba-real-one real-type))
       x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (ba-real-zero real-type)))
       (equal
        (ba-real-mul real-type x (ba-real-inv real-type x))
        (ba-real-one real-type)))
      (ba-real-le real-type x x)))))

(defun-sk ba-real-binary-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-real-p real-type x)
      (ba-real-p real-type y))
     (and
      (ba-real-p real-type (ba-real-add real-type x y))
      (ba-real-p real-type (ba-real-mul real-type x y))
      (equal
       (ba-real-add real-type x y)
       (ba-real-add real-type y x))
      (equal
       (ba-real-mul real-type x y)
       (ba-real-mul real-type y x))
      (iff
       (ba-real-lt real-type x y)
       (and
        (ba-real-le real-type x y)
        (not (equal x y))))
      (or
       (ba-real-le real-type x y)
       (ba-real-le real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (ba-real-le real-type x y)
        (ba-real-le real-type y x))
       (equal x y))))))

(defun-sk ba-real-ternary-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-real-p real-type x)
      (ba-real-p real-type y)
      (ba-real-p real-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (ba-real-add
        real-type (ba-real-add real-type x y) z)
       (ba-real-add
        real-type x (ba-real-add real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (ba-real-mul
        real-type (ba-real-mul real-type x y) z)
       (ba-real-mul
        real-type x (ba-real-mul real-type y z)))
      (equal
       (ba-real-mul
        real-type x (ba-real-add real-type y z))
       (ba-real-add
        real-type
        (ba-real-mul real-type x y)
        (ba-real-mul real-type x z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ba-real-le real-type x y)
        (ba-real-le real-type y z))
       (ba-real-le real-type x z))
      (implies
       (ba-real-le real-type x y)
       (ba-real-le
        real-type
        (ba-real-add real-type x z)
        (ba-real-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (ba-real-le real-type (ba-real-zero real-type) x)
        (ba-real-le real-type (ba-real-zero real-type) y))
       (ba-real-le
        real-type
        (ba-real-zero real-type)
        (ba-real-mul real-type x y)))))))

(defun ba-real-field-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (and
   (ba-real-unary-laws-p real-type)
   (ba-real-binary-laws-p real-type)
   (ba-real-ternary-laws-p real-type)))

(defun-sk ba-real-set-nonempty-p (real-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (ba-real-p real-type x)
     (ba-in real-type set x))))

(defun-sk ba-real-upper-bound-p (real-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-real-p real-type x)
      (ba-in real-type set x))
     (ba-real-le real-type x bound))))

(defun-sk ba-real-set-bounded-above-p (real-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ba-real-p real-type bound)
     (ba-real-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))))

(defun-sk ba-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (real-type set least-upper-bound)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-real-p real-type bound)
      (ba-real-upper-bound-p real-type set bound))
     (ba-real-le real-type least-upper-bound bound))))

(defun ba-real-is-lub-p (real-type set least-upper-bound)
  (and
   (ba-real-p real-type least-upper-bound)
   (ba-real-upper-bound-p
    real-type set least-upper-bound)
   (ba-real-least-upper-bound-p
    real-type set least-upper-bound)))

(defun-sk ba-real-set-has-lub-p (real-type set)
  (exists (least-upper-bound)
    (ba-real-is-lub-p
     real-type set least-upper-bound)))

(defun-sk ba-real-complete-p (real-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-set-p real-type set)
      (ba-real-set-nonempty-p real-type set)
      (ba-real-set-bounded-above-p real-type set))
     (ba-real-set-has-lub-p real-type set))))

(defun ba-real-structure-p (real-type)
  (and
   (ba-real-p real-type (ba-real-zero real-type))
   (ba-real-p real-type (ba-real-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (ba-real-zero real-type)
     (ba-real-one real-type)))
   (ba-real-lt
    real-type
    (ba-real-zero real-type)
    (ba-real-one real-type))
   (ba-real-field-order-laws-p real-type)
   (ba-real-complete-p real-type)
   (ba-set-extensionality-p real-type)
   (ba-family-extensionality-p real-type)))

;; Nontrivially normed field structure.

(defun-sk ba-scalar-field-norm-laws-p (real-type scalar-type)
  (forall (a b c)
    (and
     (implies
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p
        scalar-type (ba-scalar-neg scalar-type a))
       (ba-scalar-p
        scalar-type (ba-scalar-inv scalar-type a))
       (ba-real-p
        real-type (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-add
         scalar-type a (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type))
        a)
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-add
         scalar-type a (ba-scalar-neg scalar-type a))
        (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-mul
         scalar-type a (ba-scalar-one scalar-type))
        a)
       (implies
        (not (equal a (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type)))
        (equal
         (ba-scalar-mul
          scalar-type a (ba-scalar-inv scalar-type a))
         (ba-scalar-one scalar-type)))
       (ba-real-le
        real-type
        (ba-real-zero real-type)
        (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a))
       (iff
        (equal
         (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a)
         (ba-real-zero real-type))
        (equal a (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type)))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-norm
         real-type scalar-type (ba-scalar-neg scalar-type a))
        (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type b))
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p
        scalar-type (ba-scalar-add scalar-type a b))
       (ba-scalar-p
        scalar-type (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a b))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-add scalar-type a b)
        (ba-scalar-add scalar-type b a))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a b)
        (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type b a))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-norm
         real-type scalar-type (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a b))
        (ba-real-mul
         real-type
         (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a)
         (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type b)))
       (ba-real-le
        real-type
        (ba-scalar-norm
         real-type scalar-type (ba-scalar-add scalar-type a b))
        (ba-real-add
         real-type
         (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a)
         (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type b)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type b)
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type c))
      (and
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-add
         scalar-type (ba-scalar-add scalar-type a b) c)
        (ba-scalar-add
         scalar-type a (ba-scalar-add scalar-type b c)))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-mul
         scalar-type (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a b) c)
        (ba-scalar-mul
         scalar-type a (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type b c)))
       (equal
        (ba-scalar-mul
         scalar-type a (ba-scalar-add scalar-type b c))
        (ba-scalar-add
         scalar-type
         (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a b)
         (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a c))))))))

(defun-sk ba-norm-is-nontrivial-p (real-type scalar-type)
  (exists (a)
    (and
     (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
     (ba-real-lt
      real-type
      (ba-real-one real-type)
      (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a)))))

(defun ba-nontrivially-normed-field-p (real-type scalar-type)
  (and
   (ba-scalar-p scalar-type (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type))
   (ba-scalar-p scalar-type (ba-scalar-one scalar-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type)
     (ba-scalar-one scalar-type)))
   (equal
    (ba-scalar-norm
     real-type scalar-type (ba-scalar-one scalar-type))
    (ba-real-one real-type))
   (ba-scalar-field-norm-laws-p real-type scalar-type)
   (ba-norm-is-nontrivial-p real-type scalar-type)
   (ba-set-extensionality-p scalar-type)
   (ba-family-extensionality-p scalar-type)))

;; Seminormed additive commutative group and normed-space laws.

(defun-sk ba-seminormed-module-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
      (and
       (ba-vector-p
        vector-type (ba-vector-neg vector-type x))
       (ba-real-p
        real-type (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x))
       (equal
        (ba-vector-add
         vector-type x (ba-vector-zero vector-type))
        x)
       (equal
        (ba-vector-add
         vector-type x (ba-vector-neg vector-type x))
        (ba-vector-zero vector-type))
       (ba-real-le
        real-type
        (ba-real-zero real-type)
        (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x))
       (equal
        (ba-vector-norm
         real-type vector-type (ba-vector-neg vector-type x))
        (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type y))
      (and
       (ba-vector-p
        vector-type (ba-vector-add vector-type x y))
       (equal
        (ba-vector-add vector-type x y)
        (ba-vector-add vector-type y x))
       (ba-real-le
        real-type
        (ba-vector-norm
         real-type vector-type (ba-vector-add vector-type x y))
        (ba-real-add
         real-type
         (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x)
         (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type y)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type y)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type z))
      (equal
       (ba-vector-add
        vector-type (ba-vector-add vector-type x y) z)
       (ba-vector-add
        vector-type x (ba-vector-add vector-type y z))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x))
      (and
       (ba-vector-p
        vector-type (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type a x))
       (equal
        (ba-vector-norm
         real-type vector-type
         (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type a x))
        (ba-real-mul
         real-type
         (ba-scalar-norm real-type scalar-type a)
         (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x)))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type y))
      (equal
       (ba-smul
        scalar-type vector-type a
        (ba-vector-add vector-type x y))
       (ba-vector-add
        vector-type
        (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type a x)
        (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type a y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type b)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x))
      (and
       (equal
        (ba-smul
         scalar-type vector-type
         (ba-scalar-add scalar-type a b)
         x)
        (ba-vector-add
         vector-type
         (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type a x)
         (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type b x)))
       (equal
        (ba-smul
         scalar-type vector-type
         (ba-scalar-mul scalar-type a b)
         x)
        (ba-smul
         scalar-type vector-type a
         (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type b x)))))
     (implies
      (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
      (equal
       (ba-smul
        scalar-type vector-type (ba-scalar-one scalar-type) x)
       x)))))

(defun ba-seminormed-space-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (ba-vector-p vector-type (ba-vector-zero vector-type))
   (equal
    (ba-vector-norm
     real-type vector-type (ba-vector-zero vector-type))
    (ba-real-zero real-type))
   (ba-seminormed-module-laws-p
    real-type scalar-type vector-type)
   (ba-set-extensionality-p vector-type)
   (ba-family-extensionality-p vector-type)))

;; Continuous linear maps are represented extensionally.  Boundedness is the
;; standard norm characterization of continuity for linear maps.

(defun-sk ba-linear-map-p
    (scalar-type vector-type map)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
      (ba-scalar-p
       scalar-type
       (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type map x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type y))
      (equal
       (ba-apply
        scalar-type vector-type map
        (ba-vector-add vector-type x y))
       (ba-scalar-add
        scalar-type
        (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type map x)
        (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type map y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type a)
       (ba-vector-p vector-type x))
      (equal
       (ba-apply
        scalar-type vector-type map
        (ba-smul scalar-type vector-type a x))
       (ba-scalar-mul
        scalar-type
        a
        (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type map x)))))))

(defun-sk ba-map-bound-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type map bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
     (ba-real-le
      real-type
      (ba-scalar-norm
       real-type scalar-type
       (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type map x))
      (ba-real-mul
       real-type
       bound
       (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x))))))

(defun-sk ba-bounded-map-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (ba-real-p real-type bound)
     (ba-real-le
      real-type (ba-real-zero real-type) bound)
     (ba-map-bound-p
      real-type scalar-type vector-type map bound))))

(defun ba-weakdual-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
  (and
   (ba-map-p scalar-type vector-type map)
   (ba-linear-map-p scalar-type vector-type map)
   (ba-bounded-map-p real-type scalar-type vector-type map)))

(defun-sk ba-map-space-laws-p (scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (ba-map-p
      scalar-type vector-type
      (ba-zero-map scalar-type vector-type))
     (implies
      (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
      (equal
       (ba-apply
        scalar-type vector-type
        (ba-zero-map scalar-type vector-type)
        x)
       (ba-scalar-zero scalar-type))))))

;; Metric openness on the scalar field.

(defun-sk ba-scalar-ball-subset-p
    (real-type scalar-type center radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type x)
      (ba-real-lt
       real-type
       (ba-scalar-dist real-type scalar-type x center)
       radius))
     (ba-in scalar-type set x))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-open-at-p
    (real-type scalar-type set center)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (ba-real-p real-type radius)
     (ba-real-lt
      real-type (ba-real-zero real-type) radius)
     (ba-scalar-ball-subset-p
      real-type scalar-type center radius set))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-open-p (real-type scalar-type set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type center)
      (ba-in scalar-type set center))
     (ba-scalar-open-at-p
      real-type scalar-type set center))))

;; The weak-star topology is the initial topology generated by every
;; evaluation map f |-> f(x).  A basic neighborhood is a finite intersection
;; of inverse images of scalar-open sets.

(defun ba-weak-basic-data-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type basis)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (consp (car basis))
       (ba-vector-p vector-type (caar basis))
       (ba-set-p scalar-type (cdar basis))
       (ba-scalar-open-p
        real-type scalar-type (cdar basis))
       (ba-weak-basic-data-p
        real-type scalar-type vector-type (cdr basis)))
    (equal basis nil)))

(defun ba-weak-basic-contains-p
    (scalar-type vector-type basis map)
  (if (consp basis)
      (and
       (ba-in
        scalar-type
        (cdar basis)
        (ba-apply
         scalar-type vector-type map (caar basis)))
       (ba-weak-basic-contains-p
        scalar-type vector-type (cdr basis) map))
    (equal basis nil)))

(defun-sk ba-weak-basic-subset-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type basis set)
  (forall (map)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-weakdual-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
      (ba-weak-basic-contains-p
       scalar-type vector-type basis map))
     (ba-in
      (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
      set
      map))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-open-at-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type set map)
  (exists (basis)
    (and
     (ba-weak-basic-data-p
      real-type scalar-type vector-type basis)
     (ba-weak-basic-contains-p
      scalar-type vector-type basis map)
     (ba-weak-basic-subset-p
      real-type scalar-type vector-type basis set))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-open-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type set)
  (forall (map)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-weakdual-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
      (ba-in
       (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
       set
       map))
     (ba-weak-open-at-p
      real-type scalar-type vector-type set map))))

;; Open-cover compactness for the scalar metric topology.

(defun-sk ba-scalar-open-family-p
    (real-type scalar-type family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ba-family-in scalar-type family set)
     (and
      (ba-set-p scalar-type set)
      (ba-scalar-open-p real-type scalar-type set)))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-point-covered-p
    (scalar-type family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (ba-family-in scalar-type family set)
     (ba-in scalar-type set x))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-family-covers-p
    (scalar-type target family)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type x)
      (ba-in scalar-type target x))
     (ba-scalar-point-covered-p scalar-type family x))))

(defun ba-scalar-subfamily-list-p
    (scalar-type family sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (ba-family-in scalar-type family (car sets))
       (ba-scalar-subfamily-list-p
        scalar-type family (cdr sets)))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-point-covered-by-list-p
    (scalar-type sets x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (member-equal set sets)
     (ba-in scalar-type set x))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-list-covers-p
    (scalar-type target sets)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type x)
      (ba-in scalar-type target x))
     (ba-scalar-point-covered-by-list-p
      scalar-type sets x))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-finite-subcover-p
    (scalar-type target family)
  (exists (sets)
    (and
     (ba-scalar-subfamily-list-p
      scalar-type family sets)
     (ba-scalar-list-covers-p
      scalar-type target sets))))

(defun-sk ba-scalar-compact-p
    (real-type scalar-type target)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-family-p scalar-type family)
      (ba-scalar-open-family-p
       real-type scalar-type family)
      (ba-scalar-family-covers-p
       scalar-type target family))
     (ba-scalar-finite-subcover-p
      scalar-type target family))))

;; Open-cover compactness in the weak-star topology.

(defun-sk ba-weak-open-family-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (ba-family-in
      (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
      family
      set)
     (and
      (ba-set-p
       (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
       set)
      (ba-weak-open-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type set)))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-point-covered-p
    (scalar-type vector-type family map)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (ba-family-in
      (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
      family
      set)
     (ba-in
      (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
      set
      map))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-family-covers-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type target family)
  (forall (map)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-weakdual-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
      (ba-in
       (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
       target
       map))
     (ba-weak-point-covered-p
      scalar-type vector-type family map))))

(defun ba-weak-subfamily-list-p
    (scalar-type vector-type family sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (ba-family-in
        (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
        family
        (car sets))
       (ba-weak-subfamily-list-p
        scalar-type vector-type family (cdr sets)))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun-sk ba-weak-point-covered-by-list-p
    (scalar-type vector-type sets map)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (member-equal set sets)
     (ba-in
      (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
      set
      map))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-list-covers-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type target sets)
  (forall (map)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-weakdual-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
      (ba-in
       (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
       target
       map))
     (ba-weak-point-covered-by-list-p
      scalar-type vector-type sets map))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-finite-subcover-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type target family)
  (exists (sets)
    (and
     (ba-weak-subfamily-list-p
      scalar-type vector-type family sets)
     (ba-weak-list-covers-p
      real-type scalar-type vector-type target sets))))

(defun-sk ba-weak-compact-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type target)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-family-p
       (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
       family)
      (ba-weak-open-family-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type family)
      (ba-weak-family-covers-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type target family))
     (ba-weak-finite-subcover-p
      real-type scalar-type vector-type target family))))

;; Properness means compactness of every scalar closed ball.  The constructor
;; laws below give closed balls and polars their exact source membership.

(defun-sk ba-scalar-closed-ball-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type)
  (forall (center radius x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type center)
      (ba-real-p real-type radius))
     (and
      (ba-set-p
       scalar-type
       (ba-scalar-closed-ball
        real-type scalar-type center radius))
      (implies
       (ba-scalar-p scalar-type x)
       (iff
        (ba-in
         scalar-type
         (ba-scalar-closed-ball
          real-type scalar-type center radius)
         x)
        (ba-real-le
         real-type
         (ba-scalar-dist
          real-type scalar-type x center)
         radius)))))))

(defun-sk ba-proper-space-p (real-type scalar-type)
  (forall (center radius)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-scalar-p scalar-type center)
      (ba-real-p real-type radius))
     (ba-scalar-compact-p
      real-type
      scalar-type
      (ba-scalar-closed-ball
       real-type scalar-type center radius)))))

(defun-sk ba-polar-bound-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type set map)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
      (ba-in vector-type set x))
     (ba-real-le
      real-type
      (ba-scalar-norm
       real-type scalar-type
       (ba-apply scalar-type vector-type map x))
      (ba-real-one real-type)))))

(defun-sk ba-polar-set-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type)
  (forall (set map)
    (implies
     (ba-set-p vector-type set)
     (and
      (ba-set-p
       (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
       (ba-polar-set
        real-type scalar-type vector-type set))
      (implies
       (ba-map-p scalar-type vector-type map)
       (iff
        (ba-in
         (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type)
         (ba-polar-set
          real-type scalar-type vector-type set)
         map)
        (and
         (ba-weakdual-p
          real-type scalar-type vector-type map)
         (ba-polar-bound-p
          real-type scalar-type vector-type set map))))))))

(defun-sk ba-vector-ball-subset-p
    (real-type vector-type radius set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-vector-p vector-type x)
      (ba-real-lt
       real-type
       (ba-vector-norm real-type vector-type x)
       radius))
     (ba-in vector-type set x))))

(defun-sk ba-neighborhood-of-zero-p
    (real-type vector-type set)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (ba-real-p real-type radius)
     (ba-real-lt
      real-type (ba-real-zero real-type) radius)
     (ba-vector-ball-subset-p
      real-type vector-type radius set))))

(defun ba-banach-alaoglu-context-p
    (real-type scalar-type vector-type)
  (and
   (ba-real-structure-p real-type)
   (ba-nontrivially-normed-field-p real-type scalar-type)
   (ba-seminormed-space-p
    real-type scalar-type vector-type)
   (ba-map-extensionality-p scalar-type vector-type)
   (ba-map-space-laws-p scalar-type vector-type)
   (ba-set-extensionality-p
    (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type))
   (ba-family-extensionality-p
    (ba-weakdual-type scalar-type vector-type))
   (ba-scalar-closed-ball-laws-p real-type scalar-type)
   (ba-polar-set-laws-p
    real-type scalar-type vector-type)
   (ba-proper-space-p real-type scalar-type)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q537618-statement ()
  (forall (real-type scalar-type vector-type set)
    (implies
     (and
      (ba-banach-alaoglu-context-p
       real-type scalar-type vector-type)
      (ba-set-p vector-type set)
      (ba-neighborhood-of-zero-p
       real-type vector-type set))
     (ba-weak-compact-p
      real-type
      scalar-type
      vector-type
      (ba-polar-set
       real-type scalar-type vector-type set)))))

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q537618,
-- "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": the polar of a neighborhood of zero in a
-- seminormed space over a proper nontrivially normed field is compact in the
-- weak-star topology on the continuous dual. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat) renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

All :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set b) ->
  List A ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
All P [] =
  Top
All P (x ∷ xs) =
  P x × All P xs

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X -> Set a

Family :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Family {a} X =
  Subset X -> Set a

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  V x

Covers :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Family X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Covers {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Exists (Subset X)
    (\ V ->
      cover V × V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Family X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} U cover =
  Exists (List (Subset X))
    (\ selected ->
      ((V : Subset X) ->
        Member V selected ->
        cover V)
      ×
      ((x : X) ->
        U x ->
        Exists (Subset X)
          (\ V ->
            Member V selected × V x)))

CompactFor :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  (Subset X -> Set a) ->
  Subset X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
CompactFor {X = X} Open U =
  (cover : Family X) ->
  ((V : Subset X) ->
    cover V ->
    Open V) ->
  Covers U cover ->
  FiniteSubcover U cover

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real line.
record RealLine
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set a

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡ multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR ≡ zeroR

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x ≠ zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x ≡ y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR × zeroR ≠ oneR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zeroN ≡ zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (sucN n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n ->
      m ≡ n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set a) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

StrictLess :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set a
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y × x ≠ y

Positive :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  RealLine R ->
  R ->
  Set a
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record NontriviallyNormedField
  {a : Level}
  (R K : Set a)
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroK oneK :
      K

    addK multiplyK :
      K ->
      K ->
      K

    negateK reciprocalK :
      K ->
      K

    normK :
      K ->
      R

    one-not-zeroK :
      oneK ≠ zeroK

    add-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y ≡ addK y x

    add-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z ≡ addK x (addK y z)

    add-zeroK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK ≡ x

    add-inverseK :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) ≡ zeroK

    multiply-commutativeK :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y ≡ multiplyK y x

    multiply-associativeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ≡ multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)

    multiply-oneK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK ≡ x

    multiply-zeroK :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x zeroK ≡ zeroK

    distributeK :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ≡
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)

    reciprocal-zeroK :
      reciprocalK zeroK ≡ zeroK

    multiply-reciprocalK :
      (x : K) ->
      x ≠ zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (reciprocalK x) ≡ oneK

    norm-nonnegativeK :
      (x : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normK x)

    norm-zeroK :
      normK zeroK ≡ zeroR reals

    norm-zero-onlyK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK x ≡ zeroR reals ->
      x ≡ zeroK

    norm-negateK :
      (x : K) ->
      normK (negateK x) ≡ normK x

    norm-addK :
      (x y : K) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normK (addK x y))
        (addR reals (normK x) (normK y))

    norm-multiplyK :
      (x y : K) ->
      normK (multiplyK x y) ≡
      multiplyR reals (normK x) (normK y)

    norm-nontrivialK :
      Exists K
        (\ x ->
          StrictLess reals (oneR reals) (normK x))

open NontriviallyNormedField

record SeminormedSpace
  {a : Level}
  (R K E : Set a)
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroE :
      E

    addE :
      E ->
      E ->
      E

    negateE :
      E ->
      E

    scaleE :
      K ->
      E ->
      E

    normE :
      E ->
      R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y ≡ addE y x

    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z ≡ addE x (addE y z)

    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE ≡ x

    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) ≡ zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneK scalars) x ≡ x

    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyK scalars a b) x ≡ scaleE a (scaleE b x)

    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ≡ addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)

    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addK scalars a b) x ≡ addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)

    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE ≡ zeroR reals

    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) ≡ normE x

    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))

    norm-scaleE :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ≡
      multiplyR reals (normK scalars a) (normE x)

open SeminormedSpace

subtractK :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  NontriviallyNormedField R K reals ->
  K ->
  K ->
  K
subtractK scalars x y =
  addK scalars x (negateK scalars y)

distanceK :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  NontriviallyNormedField R K reals ->
  K ->
  K ->
  R
distanceK scalars x y =
  normK scalars (subtractK scalars x y)

subtractE :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

NormOpenK :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals) ->
  Subset K ->
  Set a
NormOpenK {R = R} {K = K} {reals = reals} scalars U =
  (center : K) ->
  U center ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Positive reals radius
      ×
      ((point : K) ->
        StrictLess reals (distanceK scalars point center) radius ->
        U point))

ClosedBallK :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals) ->
  K ->
  R ->
  Subset K
ClosedBallK {reals = reals} scalars center radius point =
  lessOrEqualR reals (distanceK scalars point center) radius

ProperNormedField :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  NontriviallyNormedField R K reals ->
  Set (lsuc a)
ProperNormedField {K = K} scalars =
  (center : K) ->
  (radius : _) ->
  CompactFor (NormOpenK scalars) (ClosedBallK scalars center radius)

NeighborhoodOfZero :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  (space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars) ->
  Subset E ->
  Set a
NeighborhoodOfZero {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space s =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Positive reals radius
      ×
      ((x : E) ->
        StrictLess reals (normE space x) radius ->
        s x))

record ContinuousLinearFunctional
  {a : Level}
  {R K E : Set a}
  {reals : RealLine R}
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals}
  (space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars) :
  Set a where

  field
    apply :
      E ->
      K

    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addE space x y) ≡
      addK scalars (apply x) (apply y)

    map-scale :
      (a : K) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleE space a x) ≡
      multiplyK scalars a (apply x)

    continuous-at-zero :
      (epsilon : R) ->
      Positive reals epsilon ->
      Exists R
        (\ delta ->
          Positive reals delta
          ×
          ((x : E) ->
            StrictLess reals (normE space x) delta ->
            StrictLess reals (normK scalars (apply x)) epsilon))

open ContinuousLinearFunctional

record EvaluationConstraint
  {a : Level}
  {R E : Set a}
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set a where

  field
    point :
      E

    radius :
      R

    radius-positive :
      Positive reals radius

open EvaluationConstraint

SatisfiesEvaluationConstraint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  {space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars} ->
  EvaluationConstraint {E = E} reals ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional space ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional space ->
  Set a
SatisfiesEvaluationConstraint
  {reals = reals}
  {scalars = scalars}
  constraint
  center
  candidate =
  StrictLess reals
    (distanceK scalars
      (apply candidate (point constraint))
      (apply center (point constraint)))
    (radius constraint)

BasicWeakStarNeighborhood :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  {space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars} ->
  List (EvaluationConstraint {E = E} reals) ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional space ->
  Subset (ContinuousLinearFunctional space)
BasicWeakStarNeighborhood constraints center candidate =
  All
    (\ constraint ->
      SatisfiesEvaluationConstraint constraint center candidate)
    constraints

WeakStarOpen :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  (space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars) ->
  Subset (ContinuousLinearFunctional space) ->
  Set a
WeakStarOpen {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space U =
  (center : ContinuousLinearFunctional space) ->
  U center ->
  Exists (List (EvaluationConstraint {E = E} reals))
    (\ constraints ->
      SubsetOf
        (BasicWeakStarNeighborhood constraints center)
        U)

Polar :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R K E : Set a} ->
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  {scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals} ->
  (space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars) ->
  Subset E ->
  Subset (ContinuousLinearFunctional space)
Polar {E = E} {reals = reals} {scalars = scalars} space s functional =
  (x : E) ->
  s x ->
  lessOrEqualR reals
    (normK scalars (apply functional x))
    (oneR reals)

banach-alaoglu-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
banach-alaoglu-theorem {a} =
  (R K E : Set a) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  (scalars : NontriviallyNormedField R K reals) ->
  ProperNormedField scalars ->
  (space : SeminormedSpace R K E reals scalars) ->
  (s : Subset E) ->
  NeighborhoodOfZero space s ->
  CompactFor
    (WeakStarOpen space)
    (Polar space s)

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q537618 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q537618), "Banach–Alaoglu theorem":
  over a proper nontrivially normed field, the polar of a neighborhood of zero
  in a seminormed space is compact in the weak-star topology on the continuous
  dual. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory realTheory pred_setTheory;

val q537618_nontrivially_normed_field_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_nontrivially_normed_field_def",
  ``q537618_nontrivially_normed_field
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      zeroK <> oneK /\
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK a zeroK = a) /\
      (!a. addK a (negK a) = zeroK) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK a oneK = a) /\
      (!a b c.
        mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      invK zeroK = zeroK /\
      (!a. a <> zeroK ==> mulK a (invK a) = oneK) /\
      (!a. 0 <= normK a) /\
      (!a. (normK a = 0) <=> (a = zeroK)) /\
      (!a. normK (negK a) = normK a) /\
      (!a b. normK (addK a b) <= normK a + normK b) /\
      (!a b. normK (mulK a b) = normK a * normK b) /\
      (?a. 1 < normK a)``);

val q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x y z. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
      (!x. addE x zeroE = x) /\
      (!x. addE x (negE x) = zeroE) /\
      (!x. 0 <= normE x) /\
      normE zeroE = 0 /\
      (!x. normE (negE x) = normE x) /\
      (!x y. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y)``);

val q537618_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_normed_space_def",
  ``q537618_normed_space
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x. smulE oneK x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (mulK a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smulE (addK a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x. smulE zeroK x = zeroE) /\
      (!a. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!a x. normE (smulE a x) = normK a * normE x)``);

val q537618_scalar_open_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_scalar_open_def",
  ``q537618_scalar_open
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (u : 'k set) <=>
      !a. a IN u ==>
        ?epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon /\
          !b. normK (addK b (negK a)) < epsilon ==> b IN u``);

val q537618_scalar_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_scalar_compact_def",
  ``q537618_scalar_compact
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (k : 'k set) <=>
      !cover : ('k set) set.
        (!u. u IN cover ==> q537618_scalar_open addK negK normK u) /\
        k SUBSET BIGUNION cover
        ==>
        ?subcover : ('k set) set.
          FINITE subcover /\
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          k SUBSET BIGUNION subcover``);

val q537618_proper_space_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_proper_space_def",
  ``q537618_proper_space
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) <=>
      !a : 'k. !r : real.
        q537618_scalar_compact addK negK normK
          {b : 'k | normK (addK b (negK a)) <= r}``);

val q537618_continuous_linear_functional_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_continuous_linear_functional_def",
  ``q537618_continuous_linear_functional
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (f : 'e -> 'k) <=>
      (!x y. f (addE x y) = addK (f x) (f y)) /\
      (!a x. f (smulE a x) = mulK a (f x)) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\
        !x. normK (f x) <= C * normE x``);

val q537618_dual_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_dual_def",
  ``q537618_dual
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) =
      {f : 'e -> 'k |
        q537618_continuous_linear_functional
          addK mulK normK addE smulE normE f}``);

val q537618_polar_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_polar_def",
  ``q537618_polar
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (s : 'e set) =
      {f : 'e -> 'k |
        f IN q537618_dual addK mulK normK addE smulE normE /\
        !x. x IN s ==> normK (f x) <= 1}``);

val q537618_weak_star_open_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_weak_star_open_def",
  ``q537618_weak_star_open
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (dual : ('e -> 'k) set)
      (u : ('e -> 'k) set) <=>
      u SUBSET dual /\
      !f. f IN u ==>
        ?d : 'e set. ?epsilon : real.
          FINITE d /\
          0 < epsilon /\
          !g.
            g IN dual /\
            (!x. x IN d ==>
              normK (addK (g x) (negK (f x))) < epsilon)
            ==>
            g IN u``);

val q537618_weak_star_compact_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_weak_star_compact_def",
  ``q537618_weak_star_compact
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (negK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real) (dual : ('e -> 'k) set)
      (k : ('e -> 'k) set) <=>
      k SUBSET dual /\
      !cover : (('e -> 'k) set) set.
        (!u. u IN cover ==>
          q537618_weak_star_open addK negK normK dual u) /\
        k SUBSET BIGUNION cover
        ==>
        ?subcover : (('e -> 'k) set) set.
          FINITE subcover /\
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          k SUBSET BIGUNION subcover``);

val q537618_mem_nhds_zero_def = new_definition (
  "q537618_mem_nhds_zero_def",
  ``q537618_mem_nhds_zero (normE : 'e -> real) (s : 'e set) <=>
      ?epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon /\
        !x. normE x < epsilon ==> x IN s``);

val WeakDual_isCompact_polar =
  ``!(zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (negK : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (normK : 'k -> real)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (smulE : 'k -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real) (s : 'e set).
      q537618_nontrivially_normed_field
        zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK normK /\
      q537618_proper_space addK negK normK /\
      q537618_seminormed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q537618_normed_space
        zeroK oneK addK mulK normK zeroE addE smulE normE /\
      q537618_mem_nhds_zero normE s
      ==>
      q537618_weak_star_compact addK negK normK
        (q537618_dual addK mulK normK addE smulE normE)
        (q537618_polar addK mulK normK addE smulE normE s)``;

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q537618
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q537618), "Banach-Alaoglu theorem": over an
  arbitrary proper nontrivially normed field, the polar of a neighborhood of
  zero in a seminormed vector space is compact in the weak-star topology of
  the continuous dual. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q537618SeminormedSpace K V gives the exact seminorm and scalar laws of a
  seminormed vector space V over K, without adding norm definiteness.
  Q537618ContinuousLinear K V T says that T is a K-linear functional with a
  global seminorm bound, equivalently a continuous linear functional.

  Q537618WeakTopology K V is the subspace topology on the continuous dual
  inherited from the product of copies of K indexed by Base(V), hence exactly
  the topology of pointwise convergence. Q537618NeighborhoodZero V S says
  that S contains a positive-radius seminorm ball about zero, equivalent to
  membership in the neighborhood filter at zero. Q537618Proper K requires
  every norm-closed ball in K to be compact. Q537618Polar K V S is the set of
  continuous linear functionals whose norm is at most one on S.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)
