title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q537618
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q537618), "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": over any
:: proper nontrivially normed field, the polar of a zero neighborhood in a
:: seminormed vector space is compact in the weak-star topology on its
:: continuous dual. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, CARD_3,
      FINSET_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5,
      VECTSP_1, ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1,
      COMPLEX1, BINOP_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, FINSET_1,
      XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1,
      XXREAL_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      XXREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, BINOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      E being VectSp of K,
      normK being Function of the carrier of K,REAL,
      normE being Function of the carrier of E,REAL,
      D being Subset of Funcs(the carrier of E,the carrier of K),
      tau being set,
      s being Subset of E,
      P being set
  st
    (for a being Element of K holds 0 <= normK.a) &
    (for a being Element of K holds
      (normK.a = 0 iff a = 0.K)) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      normK.(a+b) <= normK.a + normK.b) &
    (for a,b being Element of K holds
      normK.(a*b) = normK.a * normK.b) &
    (ex a being Element of K st 1 < normK.a) &
    (for x being Element of E holds 0 <= normE.x) &
    normE.(0.E) = 0 &
    (for x,y being Element of E holds
      normE.(x+y) <= normE.x + normE.y) &
    (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
      normE.(a*x) = normK.a * normE.x) &
    (for c being Element of K, r being Real holds
      for C being set st
        (for U being set st U in C holds
          U c= the carrier of K &
          for u being Element of K st u in U holds
            ex epsilon being Real st
              0 < epsilon &
              for z being Element of K st
                normK.(z-u) < epsilon
              holds z in U) &
        (for z being Element of K st normK.(z-c) <= r holds
          z in union C)
      holds
        ex C0 being finite set st
          C0 c= C &
          for z being Element of K st normK.(z-c) <= r holds
            z in union C0) &
    (for f being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of K holds
      (f in D iff
        (for x,y being Element of E holds
          f.(x+y) = f.x + f.y) &
        (for a being Element of K, x being Element of E holds
          f.(a*x) = a * f.x) &
        (ex C being Real st
          0 <= C &
          for x being Element of E holds
            normK.(f.x) <= C * normE.x))) &
    (for U being set holds
      (U in tau iff
        U c= D &
        for f being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of K st
          f in U
        holds
          ex F being finite Subset of E,
             epsilon being Function of the carrier of E,REAL st
            (for x being Element of E st x in F holds
              0 < epsilon.x) &
            for g being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of K st
              g in D &
              (for x being Element of E st x in F holds
                normK.(g.x-f.x) < epsilon.x)
            holds g in U)) &
    (ex epsilon being Real st
      0 < epsilon &
      for x being Element of E st normE.x < epsilon holds
        x in s) &
    P c= D &
    (for f being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of K holds
      (f in P iff
        f in D &
        for x being Element of E st x in s holds
          normK.(f.x) <= 1))
  holds
    for C being set st C c= tau & P c= union C holds
      ex C0 being finite set st C0 c= C & P c= union C0
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q537618_banach_alaoglu_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q537618,
% "Banach–Alaoglu theorem": the polar of a neighborhood of zero in a
% seminormed vector space is compact in the weak-star topology of its
% continuous dual when the scalar field is proper. This file contains no proof.

banach_alaoglu_theorem_Q537618[
  K: TYPE+,
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroK: K,
  oneK: K,
  addK: [K, K -> K],
  mulK: [K, K -> K],
  negK: [K -> K],
  invK: [K -> K],
  normK: [K -> real],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [K, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  scalar_set: TYPE = [K -> bool]
  scalar_set_family: TYPE = [scalar_set -> bool]
  scalar_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> scalar_set]
  dual_point: TYPE = [E -> K]
  dual_set: TYPE = [dual_point -> bool]
  dual_set_family: TYPE = [dual_set -> bool]
  dual_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> dual_set]
  point_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  radius_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  subK(a, b: K): K =
    addK(a, negK(b))

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  nontrivially_normed_field: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      addK(a, b) = addK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        addK(addK(a, b), c) = addK(a, addK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, zeroK) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        addK(a, negK(a)) = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        mulK(a, b) = mulK(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(mulK(a, b), c) = mulK(a, mulK(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mulK(a, oneK) = a)
      AND zeroK /= oneK
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mulK(a, addK(b, c)) =
          addK(mulK(a, b), mulK(a, c)))
      AND invK(zeroK) = zeroK
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zeroK IMPLIES
          mulK(a, invK(a)) = oneK)
      AND normK(zeroK) = 0
      AND normK(oneK) = 1
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        0 <= normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(a) = 0 IFF a = zeroK)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        normK(negK(a)) = normK(a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(addK(a, b)) <= normK(a) + normK(b))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        normK(mulK(a, b)) = normK(a) * normK(b))
      AND (EXISTS (a: K):
        1 < normK(a))

  seminormed_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(addK(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K), (x: E):
        smulE(mulK(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(oneK, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(zeroK, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) = normK(a) * normE(x))

  scalar_open(U: scalar_set): bool =
    FORALL (a: K):
      U(a) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          0 < radius
            AND FORALL (b: K):
              normK(subK(b, a)) < radius IMPLIES U(b)

  scalar_open_cover(
      cover: scalar_set_family,
      S: scalar_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: scalar_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES scalar_open(U))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        S(a) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: scalar_set):
            cover(U) AND U(a))

  scalar_finite_subcover(
      cover: scalar_set_family,
      S: scalar_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: scalar_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (a: K):
          S(a) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(a))

  scalar_compact(S: scalar_set): bool =
    FORALL (cover: scalar_set_family):
      scalar_open_cover(cover, S) IMPLIES
        scalar_finite_subcover(cover, S)

  scalar_closed_ball(center: K, radius: real): scalar_set =
    LAMBDA (a: K):
      normK(subK(a, center)) <= radius

  proper_scalar_space: bool =
    FORALL (center: K), (radius: real):
      scalar_compact(scalar_closed_ball(center, radius))

  continuous_linear_functional(f: dual_point): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      f(addE(x, y)) = addK(f(x), f(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K), (x: E):
        f(smulE(a, x)) = mulK(a, f(x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E), (epsilon_value: real):
        0 < epsilon_value IMPLIES
          EXISTS (delta: real):
            0 < delta
              AND FORALL (y: E):
                normE(subE(y, x)) < delta IMPLIES
                  normK(subK(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value)

  dual_carrier_set(S: dual_set): bool =
    FORALL (f: dual_point):
      S(f) IMPLIES continuous_linear_functional(f)

  weak_star_open(U: dual_set): bool =
    dual_carrier_set(U)
      AND FORALL (f: dual_point):
        continuous_linear_functional(f) AND U(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (count: nat),
              (points: point_sequence),
              (radii: radius_sequence):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < count IMPLIES 0 < radii(index))
              AND (FORALL (g: dual_point):
                continuous_linear_functional(g)
                  AND (FORALL (index: nat):
                    index < count IMPLIES
                      normK(
                        subK(
                          g(points(index)),
                          f(points(index))))
                        < radii(index))
                IMPLIES U(g))

  dual_open_cover(
      cover: dual_set_family,
      S: dual_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: dual_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES weak_star_open(U))
      AND (FORALL (f: dual_point):
        S(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: dual_set):
            cover(U) AND U(f))

  dual_finite_subcover(
      cover: dual_set_family,
      S: dual_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: dual_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (f: dual_point):
          S(f) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(f))

  weak_star_compact(S: dual_set): bool =
    dual_carrier_set(S)
      AND FORALL (cover: dual_set_family):
        dual_open_cover(cover, S) IMPLIES
          dual_finite_subcover(cover, S)

  neighborhood_of_zero(S: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: real):
      0 < radius
        AND FORALL (x: E):
          normE(x) < radius IMPLIES S(x)

  polar(S: point_set): dual_set =
    LAMBDA (f: dual_point):
      continuous_linear_functional(f)
        AND FORALL (x: E):
          S(x) IMPLIES normK(f(x)) <= 1

  banach_alaoglu_theorem: bool =
    (nontrivially_normed_field
      AND seminormed_space
      AND proper_scalar_space)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: point_set):
        neighborhood_of_zero(S) IMPLIES
          weak_star_compact(polar(S))
END banach_alaoglu_theorem_Q537618

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5421989
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, if one point lies strictly
  between an exterior point and a triangle vertex, the exterior angle equals
  the sum of the two remote interior angles. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q5421989_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q5421989_zero : V;
  q5421989_add : V -> V -> V;
  q5421989_neg : V -> V;
  q5421989_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q5421989_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q5421989_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q5421989_add x (q5421989_add y z) =
      q5421989_add (q5421989_add x y) z;
  q5421989_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q5421989_add x y = q5421989_add y x;
  q5421989_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q5421989_add x q5421989_zero = x;
  q5421989_add_neg :
    forall x : V, q5421989_add x (q5421989_neg x) = q5421989_zero;

  q5421989_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q5421989_smul 1 x = x;
  q5421989_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q5421989_smul (a * b) x =
      q5421989_smul a (q5421989_smul b x);
  q5421989_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q5421989_smul a (q5421989_add x y) =
      q5421989_add (q5421989_smul a x) (q5421989_smul a y);
  q5421989_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q5421989_smul (a + b) x =
      q5421989_add (q5421989_smul a x) (q5421989_smul b x);

  q5421989_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q5421989_inner (q5421989_add x y) z =
      q5421989_inner x z + q5421989_inner y z;
  q5421989_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q5421989_inner (q5421989_smul a x) y =
      a * q5421989_inner x y;
  q5421989_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V, q5421989_inner x y = q5421989_inner y x;
  q5421989_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q5421989_inner x x;
  q5421989_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q5421989_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q5421989_zero
}.

Arguments q5421989_zero {V} _.
Arguments q5421989_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q5421989_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q5421989_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q5421989_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q5421989_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type) (E : q5421989_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q5421989_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q5421989_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q5421989_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P, q5421989_vadd (q5421989_zero E) p = p;
  q5421989_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q5421989_vadd (q5421989_add E x y) p =
      q5421989_vadd x (q5421989_vadd y p);
  q5421989_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q5421989_vsub (q5421989_vadd x p) p = x;
  q5421989_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q5421989_vadd (q5421989_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q5421989_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q5421989_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q5421989_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q5421989_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q5421989_inner E x x).

Definition q5421989_angle
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q5421989_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q5421989_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p1 p2 p3 : P) : R :=
  let x := q5421989_vsub A p1 p2 in
  let y := q5421989_vsub A p3 p2 in
  acos
    (q5421989_inner E x y /
      (q5421989_norm E x * q5421989_norm E y)).

Definition q5421989_strictly_between
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q5421989_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q5421989_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p p1 p2 : P) : Prop :=
  (exists t : R,
    0 <= t /\
    t <= 1 /\
    p1 =
      q5421989_vadd A
        (q5421989_smul E t (q5421989_vsub A p2 p)) p) /\
  p1 <> p /\
  p1 <> p2.

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_exterior_angle_eq_angle_add_angle :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q5421989_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q5421989_affine_torsor V P E)
         (p1 p2 p3 p : P),
    q5421989_strictly_between A p p1 p2 ->
    q5421989_angle A p3 p1 p =
      q5421989_angle A p1 p3 p2 +
      q5421989_angle A p3 p2 p1.
Admitted.

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q5421989 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem":
  in a real inner-product affine space, when one vertex lies strictly between
  an exterior point and a second vertex, the exterior angle equals the sum of
  the two remote interior angles. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

locale q5421989_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q5421989_vadd :: "'v::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q5421989_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q5421989_zero_vadd:
      "q5421989_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q5421989_add_vadd:
      "q5421989_vadd (u + v) p =
        q5421989_vadd u (q5421989_vadd v p)"
    and q5421989_vadd_vsub:
      "q5421989_vadd (q5421989_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q5421989_vsub_vadd:
      "q5421989_vsub (q5421989_vadd v p) p = v"
    and q5421989_dist_eq_norm_vsub:
      "dist p q = norm (q5421989_vsub p q)"
begin

definition q5421989_angle :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q5421989_angle p1 p2 p3 =
    arccos (inner (q5421989_vsub p1 p2) (q5421989_vsub p3 p2) /
      (norm (q5421989_vsub p1 p2) * norm (q5421989_vsub p3 p2)))"

definition q5421989_weakly_between ::
    "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5421989_weakly_between left middle right \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>r::real.
      0 \<le> r \<and> r \<le> 1 \<and>
      middle =
        q5421989_vadd (r *\<^sub>R q5421989_vsub right left) left)"

definition q5421989_strictly_between ::
    "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5421989_strictly_between left middle right \<longleftrightarrow>
    q5421989_weakly_between left middle right \<and>
    middle \<noteq> left \<and>
    middle \<noteq> right"

theorem exterior_angle_theorem:
  fixes p p1 p2 p3 :: 'p
  assumes p1_strictly_between_p_and_p2:
      "q5421989_strictly_between p p1 p2"
  shows
      "q5421989_angle p3 p1 p =
        q5421989_angle p1 p3 p2 + q5421989_angle p3 p2 p1"
  sorry

end

end

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5421989
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, when p1 lies strictly between an
  exterior point p and p2, the angle p3-p1-p equals the sum of the remote
  interior angles at p3 and p2. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/transc.ml";;

let Q5421989_EXTERIOR_ANGLE_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!p:P. vadd zero p = p) /\
       (!v w:V. !p:P.
          vadd (add v w) p = vadd v (vadd w p)) /\
       (!v:V. !p:P. vsub (vadd v p) p = v) /\
       (!p q:P. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let point_angle =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p1:P) (p2:P) (p3:P).
       acs (inner (vsub p1 p2) (vsub p3 p2) /
            (norm inner (vsub p1 p2) *
             norm inner (vsub p3 p2))) in
  let strictly_between =
    \(smul:real->V->V) (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (p1:P) (p2:P) (p3:P).
       (?t:real.
          &0 <= t /\
          t <= &1 /\
          p2 = vadd (smul t (vsub p3 p1)) p1) /\
       ~(p2 = p1) /\
       ~(p2 = p3) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !p1 p2 p3 p:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    strictly_between smul vadd vsub p p1 p2
    ==>
    point_angle inner vsub p3 p1 p =
      point_angle inner vsub p1 p3 p2 +
      point_angle inner vsub p3 p2 p1`;;

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q5421989,
;; "Exterior angle theorem": when one side of a triangle is extended beyond
;; a vertex in a real inner-product affine space, the resulting exterior
;; angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The three collinear points in the strict-betweenness hypothesis together
;; with the remaining triangle vertex span an affine subspace of dimension at
;; most two. An affine isometry identifies that subspace with a subspace of
;; R^2, while every R^2 configuration is itself a source instance. Therefore
;; the coordinate statement below is bidirectionally equivalent to the
;; source's quantification over arbitrary real inner-product affine spaces.
;;
;; The scalar context presents a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the
;; real field up to ordered-field isomorphism; it does not restrict scalars to
;; ACL2's executable rationals.
;;
;; For two nonzero rays u and v, the pair
;;
;;   (dot(u,v), |det(u,v)|)
;;
;; is a positive multiple of (cos(theta), sin(theta)) for their principal
;; angle theta in [0,pi]. If either ray is zero, (0,1) represents Mathlib's
;; angle pi/2 convention. Complex multiplication adds represented angles.
;; Positive collinearity of the exterior-angle code with the product of the
;; two remote-angle codes therefore expresses exact angle addition; the
;; excluded (0, pi, pi) case removes the sole possible 2*pi wraparound.

(defun q5421989-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x)) t nil))

(defun q5421989-unary-value (operation x)
  (apply$ operation (list x)))

(defun q5421989-binary-value (operation x y)
  (apply$ operation (list x y)))

(defun-sk q5421989-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (apply$ set (list x))
     (q5421989-member-p carrier x))))

(defun-sk q5421989-field-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (q5421989-member-p carrier x)
          (q5421989-member-p carrier y)
          (q5421989-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (q5421989-member-p
       carrier (q5421989-binary-value add x y))
      (q5421989-member-p
       carrier (q5421989-binary-value multiply x y))
      (q5421989-member-p
       carrier (q5421989-unary-value negate x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (q5421989-member-p
        carrier (q5421989-unary-value inverse x)))
      (equal
       (q5421989-binary-value
        add (q5421989-binary-value add x y) z)
       (q5421989-binary-value
        add x (q5421989-binary-value add y z)))
      (equal (q5421989-binary-value add x y)
             (q5421989-binary-value add y x))
      (equal (q5421989-binary-value add x zero) x)
      (equal
       (q5421989-binary-value
        add x (q5421989-unary-value negate x))
       zero)
      (equal
       (q5421989-binary-value
        multiply
        (q5421989-binary-value multiply x y)
        z)
       (q5421989-binary-value
        multiply
        x
        (q5421989-binary-value multiply y z)))
      (equal (q5421989-binary-value multiply x y)
             (q5421989-binary-value multiply y x))
      (equal (q5421989-binary-value multiply x one) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x zero))
       (equal
        (q5421989-binary-value
         multiply x (q5421989-unary-value inverse x))
        one))
      (equal
       (q5421989-binary-value
        multiply x (q5421989-binary-value add y z))
       (q5421989-binary-value
        add
        (q5421989-binary-value multiply x y)
        (q5421989-binary-value multiply x z)))))))

(defun-sk q5421989-order-laws-p
    (carrier add multiply zero less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and (q5421989-member-p carrier x)
          (q5421989-member-p carrier y)
          (q5421989-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q5421989-binary-value less x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (q5421989-binary-value less x y)
          (q5421989-binary-value less y x))
      (implies
       (and (q5421989-binary-value less x y)
            (q5421989-binary-value less y z))
       (q5421989-binary-value less x z))
      (implies
       (q5421989-binary-value less x y)
       (q5421989-binary-value
        less
        (q5421989-binary-value add x z)
        (q5421989-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and (q5421989-binary-value less zero x)
            (q5421989-binary-value less zero y))
       (q5421989-binary-value
        less
        zero
        (q5421989-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

(defun-sk q5421989-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and (q5421989-member-p carrier x)
         (apply$ set (list x)))))

(defun-sk q5421989-upper-bound-p
    (carrier less set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and (q5421989-member-p carrier x)
          (apply$ set (list x)))
     (not (q5421989-binary-value less bound x)))))

(defun-sk q5421989-bounded-above-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q5421989-member-p carrier bound)
     (q5421989-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set bound))))

(defun-sk q5421989-supremum-p
    (carrier less set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q5421989-member-p carrier supremum)
     (q5421989-upper-bound-p
      carrier less set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q5421989-member-p carrier bound)
       (q5421989-upper-bound-p
        carrier less set bound))
      (not
       (q5421989-binary-value
        less bound supremum))))))

(defun-sk q5421989-has-supremum-p
    (carrier less set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q5421989-supremum-p
     carrier less set supremum)))

(defun-sk q5421989-dedekind-complete-p
    (carrier less)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (q5421989-valid-set-p carrier set)
      (q5421989-set-nonempty-p carrier set)
      (q5421989-bounded-above-p carrier less set))
     (q5421989-has-supremum-p
      carrier less set))))

(defun q5421989-real-field-p
    (carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one less)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (tamep-functionp less)
   (q5421989-member-p carrier zero)
   (q5421989-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q5421989-field-laws-p
    carrier add multiply negate inverse zero one)
   (q5421989-order-laws-p
    carrier add multiply zero less)
   (q5421989-binary-value less zero one)
   (q5421989-dedekind-complete-p carrier less)))

(defun q5421989-r-carrier (ctx) (nth 0 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-zero (ctx) (nth 1 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-one (ctx) (nth 2 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-add (ctx) (nth 3 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-mul (ctx) (nth 4 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-neg (ctx) (nth 5 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-inv (ctx) (nth 6 ctx))
(defun q5421989-r-lt (ctx) (nth 7 ctx))

(defun q5421989-context-p (ctx)
  (and
   (true-listp ctx)
   (equal (len ctx) 8)
   (q5421989-real-field-p
    (q5421989-r-carrier ctx)
    (q5421989-r-add ctx)
    (q5421989-r-mul ctx)
    (q5421989-r-neg ctx)
    (q5421989-r-inv ctx)
    (q5421989-r-zero ctx)
    (q5421989-r-one ctx)
    (q5421989-r-lt ctx))))

(defun q5421989-r-add-value (ctx x y)
  (q5421989-binary-value (q5421989-r-add ctx) x y))

(defun q5421989-r-mul-value (ctx x y)
  (q5421989-binary-value (q5421989-r-mul ctx) x y))

(defun q5421989-r-neg-value (ctx x)
  (q5421989-unary-value (q5421989-r-neg ctx) x))

(defun q5421989-r-sub-value (ctx x y)
  (q5421989-r-add-value
   ctx x (q5421989-r-neg-value ctx y)))

(defun q5421989-r-lt-p (ctx x y)
  (if (q5421989-binary-value
       (q5421989-r-lt ctx) x y)
      t nil))

(defun q5421989-r-abs-value (ctx x)
  (if (q5421989-r-lt-p
       ctx x (q5421989-r-zero ctx))
      (q5421989-r-neg-value ctx x)
    x))

(defun q5421989-point-p (ctx point)
  (and
   (true-listp point)
   (equal (len point) 2)
   (q5421989-member-p
    (q5421989-r-carrier ctx) (nth 0 point))
   (q5421989-member-p
    (q5421989-r-carrier ctx) (nth 1 point))))

(defun q5421989-vector-subtract (ctx left right)
  (list
   (q5421989-r-sub-value
    ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (q5421989-r-sub-value
    ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))))

(defun q5421989-vector-zero-p (ctx vector)
  (and
   (equal (nth 0 vector) (q5421989-r-zero ctx))
   (equal (nth 1 vector) (q5421989-r-zero ctx))))

(defun q5421989-inner-product (ctx left right)
  (q5421989-r-add-value
   ctx
   (q5421989-r-mul-value
    ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (q5421989-r-mul-value
    ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))))

(defun q5421989-determinant (ctx left right)
  (q5421989-r-sub-value
   ctx
   (q5421989-r-mul-value
    ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
   (q5421989-r-mul-value
    ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right))))

(defun q5421989-line-map-coordinate
    (ctx left right parameter)
  (q5421989-r-add-value
   ctx
   left
   (q5421989-r-mul-value
    ctx parameter
    (q5421989-r-sub-value ctx right left))))

(defun-sk q5421989-strict-between-p
    (ctx left middle right)
  (exists (parameter)
    (and
     (q5421989-member-p
      (q5421989-r-carrier ctx) parameter)
     (q5421989-r-lt-p
      ctx (q5421989-r-zero ctx) parameter)
     (q5421989-r-lt-p
      ctx parameter (q5421989-r-one ctx))
     (not (equal middle left))
     (not (equal middle right))
     (equal
      (nth 0 middle)
      (q5421989-line-map-coordinate
       ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right) parameter))
     (equal
      (nth 1 middle)
      (q5421989-line-map-coordinate
       ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right) parameter)))))

(defun q5421989-principal-angle-code
    (ctx first-point vertex third-point)
  (let ((first-ray
         (q5421989-vector-subtract
          ctx first-point vertex))
        (second-ray
         (q5421989-vector-subtract
          ctx third-point vertex)))
    (if (or (q5421989-vector-zero-p ctx first-ray)
            (q5421989-vector-zero-p ctx second-ray))
        (list (q5421989-r-zero ctx)
              (q5421989-r-one ctx))
      (list
       (q5421989-inner-product
        ctx first-ray second-ray)
       (q5421989-r-abs-value
        ctx
        (q5421989-determinant
         ctx first-ray second-ray))))))

(defun q5421989-angle-code-multiply (ctx left right)
  (list
   (q5421989-r-sub-value
    ctx
    (q5421989-r-mul-value
     ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
    (q5421989-r-mul-value
     ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
   (q5421989-r-add-value
    ctx
    (q5421989-r-mul-value
     ctx (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
    (q5421989-r-mul-value
     ctx (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right)))))

(defun q5421989-angle-code-zero-p (ctx code)
  (and
   (equal (nth 1 code) (q5421989-r-zero ctx))
   (q5421989-r-lt-p
    ctx (q5421989-r-zero ctx) (nth 0 code))))

(defun q5421989-angle-code-pi-p (ctx code)
  (and
   (equal (nth 1 code) (q5421989-r-zero ctx))
   (q5421989-r-lt-p
    ctx (nth 0 code) (q5421989-r-zero ctx))))

(defun q5421989-angle-equals-sum-p
    (ctx exterior first-remote second-remote)
  (let ((remote-sum
         (q5421989-angle-code-multiply
          ctx first-remote second-remote)))
    (and
     (equal
      (q5421989-determinant ctx exterior remote-sum)
      (q5421989-r-zero ctx))
     (q5421989-r-lt-p
      ctx
      (q5421989-r-zero ctx)
      (q5421989-inner-product ctx exterior remote-sum))
     (not
      (and
       (q5421989-angle-code-zero-p ctx exterior)
       (q5421989-angle-code-pi-p ctx first-remote)
       (q5421989-angle-code-pi-p ctx second-remote))))))

(defun q5421989-exterior-angle-conclusion-p
    (ctx p1 p2 p3 p)
  (q5421989-angle-equals-sum-p
   ctx
   (q5421989-principal-angle-code ctx p3 p1 p)
   (q5421989-principal-angle-code ctx p1 p3 p2)
   (q5421989-principal-angle-code ctx p3 p2 p1)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q5421989-exterior-angle-statement
    (ctx)
  (forall (p1 p2 p3 p)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5421989-context-p ctx)
      (q5421989-point-p ctx p1)
      (q5421989-point-p ctx p2)
      (q5421989-point-p ctx p3)
      (q5421989-point-p ctx p)
      (q5421989-strict-between-p ctx p p1 p2))
     (q5421989-exterior-angle-conclusion-p
      ctx p1 p2 p3 p))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5421989
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem": in a real
-- inner-product affine space, strict extension of a triangle side makes the
-- canonical Euclidean exterior angle equal the sum of the two remote interior
-- angles. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infix 4 _!=_
infix 4 _natLe_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _natLe_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-le : {n : Nat} -> zero natLe n
  suc-le  : {m n : Nat} -> m natLe n -> suc m natLe suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and oneR != zeroR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

doubleNat : Nat -> Nat
doubleNat n =
  n + n

cosineTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosineTerm reals x zero =
  oneR reals
cosineTerm reals x (suc n) =
  negateR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (multiplyR reals
        (multiplyR reals (cosineTerm reals x n) x)
        x)
      (inverseR reals
        (multiplyR reals
          (fromNatR reals (suc (doubleNat n)))
          (fromNatR reals (suc (suc (doubleNat n)))))))

cosinePartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
cosinePartialSum reals x zero =
  cosineTerm reals x zero
cosinePartialSum reals x (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (cosinePartialSum reals x n)
    (cosineTerm reals x (suc n))

ConvergesTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
ConvergesTo reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ threshold ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      threshold natLe n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (subtractR reals limit epsilon)
        (sequence n)
      and
      StrictLess reals
        (sequence n)
        (addR reals limit epsilon))

CosineValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CosineValue reals x value =
  ConvergesTo reals (cosinePartialSum reals x) value

twoR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R
twoR reals =
  fromNatR reals (suc (suc zero))

halfOf :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R
halfOf reals x =
  multiplyR reals x (inverseR reals (twoR reals))

PiValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
PiValue reals piValue =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) piValue
  and
  (CosineValue reals piValue (negateR reals (oneR reals))
  and
  ((x : _) ->
    StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x ->
    CosineValue reals x (negateR reals (oneR reals)) ->
    lessOrEqualR reals piValue x))

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (V : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u v : V) ->
      addV u v == addV v u
    addV-associative :
      (u v w : V) ->
      addV (addV u v) w == addV u (addV v w)
    addV-zero :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v zeroV == v
    addV-inverse :
      (v : V) ->
      addV v (negateV v) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u v) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a v)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) v ==
      addV (scaleV a v) (scaleV b v)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) v ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b v)
    one-scaleV :
      (v : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) v == v

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u v w : V) ->
      inner (addV u v) w ==
      addR reals (inner u w) (inner v w)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u v : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) v ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u v)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u v : V) ->
      inner u v == inner v u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (v : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner v v)
    inner-definite :
      (v : V) ->
      inner v v == zeroR reals ->
      v == zeroV

open RealInnerProductSpace

NormValue :
  {R V : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealInnerProductSpace reals V ->
  V ->
  R ->
  Set
NormValue reals space v length =
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) length
  and
  multiplyR reals length length == inner space v v

ZeroVectorAngleValue :
  {R V : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ZeroVectorAngleValue reals space u v piValue angle =
  ((u == zeroV space) or (v == zeroV space))
  and
  angle == halfOf reals piValue

NonzeroVectorAngleValue :
  {R V : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
NonzeroVectorAngleValue reals space u v piValue angle =
  ((u != zeroV space) and (v != zeroV space))
  and
  ((lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) angle
    and
    lessOrEqualR reals angle piValue)
  and
  Exists _
    (\ normU ->
      NormValue reals space u normU
      and
      Exists _
        (\ normV ->
          NormValue reals space v normV
          and
          Exists _
            (\ cosineOfAngle ->
              CosineValue reals angle cosineOfAngle
              and
              inner space u v
              ==
              multiplyR reals
                (multiplyR reals normU normV)
                cosineOfAngle))))

VectorAngleValue :
  {R V : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  V ->
  V ->
  R ->
  Set
VectorAngleValue reals space u v angle =
  Exists _
    (\ piValue ->
      PiValue reals piValue
      and
      (ZeroVectorAngleValue reals space u v piValue angle
      or
      NonzeroVectorAngleValue reals space u v piValue angle))

record AffineTorsor
  {R V : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set) :
  Set1 where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) p == p
    add-vadd :
      (u v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u v) p ==
      vadd u (vadd v p)
    vadd-vsub :
      (p q : P) ->
      vadd (vsub p q) q == p
    vsub-vadd :
      (v : V) ->
      (p : P) ->
      vsub (vadd v p) p == v

open AffineTorsor

AngleAtValue :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R ->
  Set
AngleAtValue reals space affine a vertex c angle =
  VectorAngleValue reals space
    (vsub affine a vertex)
    (vsub affine c vertex)
    angle

StrictBetween :
  {R V P : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set
StrictBetween reals space affine endpoint1 middle endpoint2 =
  endpoint1 != endpoint2
  and
  Exists _
    (\ t ->
      StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) t
      and
      (StrictLess reals t (oneR reals)
      and
      middle ==
        vadd affine
          (scaleV space t (vsub affine endpoint2 endpoint1))
          endpoint1))

exterior-angle-theorem : Set1
exterior-angle-theorem =
  (R V P : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (p1 p2 p3 p : P) ->
  StrictBetween reals space affine p p1 p2 ->
  Exists _
    (\ exteriorAngle ->
      AngleAtValue reals space affine p3 p1 p exteriorAngle
      and
      Exists _
        (\ remoteAngleAtP3 ->
          AngleAtValue reals space affine p1 p3 p2 remoteAngleAtP3
          and
          Exists _
            (\ remoteAngleAtP2 ->
              AngleAtValue reals space affine p3 p2 p1 remoteAngleAtP2
              and
              exteriorAngle
              ==
              addR reals remoteAngleAtP3 remoteAngleAtP2)))

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q5421989 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem":
  if p1 lies strictly between p and p2 in a real inner-product affine space,
  then the exterior angle at p1 equals the sum of the two remote interior
  angles. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q5421989_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q5421989_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q5421989_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q5421989_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q5421989_norm_def",
  ``q5421989_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q5421989_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q5421989_angle_def",
  ``q5421989_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p1 : 'p)
      (p2 : 'p)
      (p3 : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub p1 p2) (vsub p3 p2) /
          (q5421989_norm inner (vsub p1 p2) *
           q5421989_norm inner (vsub p3 p2)))``);

val q5421989_strictly_between_def = new_definition (
  "q5421989_strictly_between_def",
  ``q5421989_strictly_between
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p : 'p)
      (p1 : 'p)
      (p2 : 'p) <=>
      p <> p2 /\
      ?r : real.
        0 < r /\ r < 1 /\
        p1 = vadd (smul r (vsub p2 p)) p``);

val exterior_angle_eq_angle_add_angle =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (p p1 p2 p3 : 'p).
      q5421989_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q5421989_strictly_between smul vadd vsub p p1 p2
      ==>
      q5421989_angle inner vsub p3 p1 p =
        q5421989_angle inner vsub p1 p3 p2 +
        q5421989_angle inner vsub p3 p2 p1``;

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5421989
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, if one triangle vertex lies
  strictly between an exterior point and a second vertex, then the exterior
  angle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces. The predicate
  W Q5421989RealInnerProductSpace explicitly requires a generalized
  pre-Hilbert structure over RRfld, the normed-module laws, and the defining
  equality between the norm and the square root of the self inner product.
  It is therefore the SetMM rendering of the source NormedAddCommGroup and
  InnerProductSpace real typeclass package, without a finite-dimensionality
  restriction. Choosing any affine origin identifies the source normed affine
  torsor with Base ` W while preserving affine combinations and angles;
  conversely, Base ` W is such a torsor.

  W Q5421989Ray A B is the vector from B to A, and
  W Q5421989Dist A B is its norm. W Q5421989Angle A B C is the total
  unoriented angle at B: it is pi/2 when either ray is zero and otherwise is
  the arccosine of the normalized real inner product, matching the source
  angle convention.

  W Q5421989StrictBetween A B C says that B is distinct from both endpoints
  and is the affine combination (1-t)A+tC for a real t strictly between zero
  and one. Thus it exactly renders Sbtw RR A B C, including its endpoint
  strictness conditions.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit faithful
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c
  Q5421989RealInnerProductSpace
  Q5421989Ray Q5421989Dist Q5421989Angle Q5421989StrictBetween
$.

q5421989-real-inner-product-space-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q5421989RealInnerProductSpace ) $.
q5421989-ray-syntax
  $a class ( W Q5421989Ray A B ) $.
q5421989-distance-syntax
  $a class ( W Q5421989Dist A B ) $.
q5421989-angle-syntax
  $a class ( W Q5421989Angle A B C ) $.
q5421989-strict-between-syntax
  $a wff ( W Q5421989StrictBetween A B C ) $.

${
  $d W x $.

  q5421989-real-inner-product-space-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q5421989RealInnerProductSpace )
    <->
    (
      (
        W e. PreHil
        /\
        W e. NrmMod
      )
      /\
      (
        ( Scalar ` W ) = RRfld
        /\
        (
          ( norm ` W )
          =
          (
            x e. ( Base ` W ) |->
              ( sqrt ` ( x ( .i ` W ) x ) )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

q5421989-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q5421989Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q5421989-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q5421989Dist A B
) = (
  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q5421989Ray A B )
) $.

q5421989-angle-definition $a |- (
  W Q5421989Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q5421989Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q5421989Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q5421989Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q5421989Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q5421989Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q5421989Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C W t $.

  q5421989-strict-between-definition $a |- (
    ( W Q5421989StrictBetween A B C )
    <->
    (
      ( B =/= A /\ B =/= C )
      /\
      E. t e. ( 0 (,) 1 )
        B
        =
        (
          ( ( 1 - t ) ( .s ` W ) A )
          ( +g ` W )
          ( t ( .s ` W ) C )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a b c d w $.

  thousand-theorems-q5421989-exterior-angle-theorem $a |- A. w
    (
      ( w Q5421989RealInnerProductSpace )
      ->
      A. a e. ( Base ` w )
        A. b e. ( Base ` w )
          A. c e. ( Base ` w )
            A. d e. ( Base ` w )
              (
                ( w Q5421989StrictBetween a b c )
                ->
                (
                  ( w Q5421989Angle d b a )
                  =
                  (
                    ( w Q5421989Angle b d c )
                    +
                    ( w Q5421989Angle d c b )
                  )
                )
              )
    )
  $.
$}

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of "Exterior angle theorem" from Thousand
:: Theorems artifact Q5421989 (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q5421989). In an
:: arbitrary real inner-product affine space, if one point lies strictly
:: between two others, its exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote
:: triangle angles. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, BHSP_1, PRE_TOPC, SUBSET_1, FINSEQ_1, FUNCT_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_2, CARD_1, TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, BINOP_1, SETWISEO, FINSET_1, MEMBER_1,

      XXREAL_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, REAL_1, XREAL_0, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      RELAT_1, BINOP_2, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, BHSP_1, SQUARE_1, BINOP_1,
      SETWISEO, FUNCT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSOP_1, SIN_COS, SIN_COS6;
 constructors BINOP_1, DOMAIN_1, SETWISEO, REAL_1, SQUARE_1, NAT_1, BINOP_2,
      MEMBERED, FINSOP_1, BHSP_1, RELSET_1, INT_1, SIN_COS, SIN_COS6;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, ORDINAL1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, FINSET_1,

 requirements SUBSET, REAL, BOOLE, NUMERALS, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI;

 expansions TARSKI;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for V being RealUnitarySpace,
      p,p1,p2,p3 being VECTOR of V st
    p <> p2 &
    (ex t being Real st
      0 < t & t < 1 &
      p1 = (1-t) * p + t * p2)
  holds
    arccos (((p3-p1) .|. (p-p1)) /
      (||.p3-p1.|| * ||.p-p1.||)) =
      arccos (((p1-p3) .|. (p2-p3)) /
        (||.p1-p3.|| * ||.p2-p3.||)) +
      arccos (((p3-p2) .|. (p1-p2)) /
        (||.p3-p2.|| * ||.p1-p2.||))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5421989
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q5421989), "Exterior angle theorem": in a real
% inner-product affine space, an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum
% of the two remote interior angles. This file contains no proof.

Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws AND inner_product_laws AND affine_torsor_laws

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  cosine_partial_sum(count: nat, x: real): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial_sum(count - 1, x)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index) * x ^ (2 * index),
              factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to(sequence: [nat -> real], value: real): bool =
    FORALL (eps: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (count: nat):
          cutoff <= count IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(count) - value) < eps

  power_series_cosine(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          (LAMBDA (count: nat): cosine_partial_sum(count, x)),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        2 < value AND value < 4
          AND power_series_cosine(value / 2) = 0)

  squared_distance(p, q: P): real =
    inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  positive_distance(length: real, p, q: P): bool =
    0 < length
      AND length * length = squared_distance(p, q)

  angle_value(a, vertex, b: P, theta: real): bool =
    0 <= theta
      AND theta <= pi
      AND
      IF a = vertex OR b = vertex THEN
        theta = pi / 2
      ELSE
        EXISTS (va_length, vb_length: real):
          positive_distance(va_length, vertex, a)
            AND positive_distance(vb_length, vertex, b)
            AND power_series_cosine(theta)
                  * va_length * vb_length =
                inner(vsub(a, vertex), vsub(b, vertex))
      ENDIF

  unoriented_angle(a, vertex, b: P): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (theta: real):
        angle_value(a, vertex, b, theta))

  strictly_between(left, middle, right: P): bool =
    middle /= left
      AND middle /= right
      AND EXISTS (t: real):
        0 < t
          AND t < 1
          AND middle =
            point_vadd(scale(t, vsub(right, left)), left)

  exterior_angle_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      (FORALL (p1, p2, p3, p: P):
        strictly_between(p, p1, p2)
          IMPLIES
            unoriented_angle(p3, p1, p) =
              unoriented_angle(p1, p3, p2)
                + unoriented_angle(p3, p2, p1))
END Q5421989_exterior_angle_theorem

/-- Fatou's lemma for a sequence of measurable extended-nonnegative functions. -/
theorem fatou_lebesgue_theorem {f : ℕ → α → ℝ≥0∞} (h_meas : ∀ n, Measurable (f n)) :
    ∫⁻ a, liminf (fun n ↦ f n a) atTop ∂μ ≤
      liminf (fun n ↦ ∫⁻ a, f n a ∂μ) atTop := sorry

title: Q5437947_fatou_lebesgue_theorem

(*

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q5437947), "Fatou–Lebesgue theorem":
  Fatou's inequality for a sequence of measurable extended-nonnegative
  functions on an arbitrary measure space. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q5437947_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q5437947_empty {A : Type} : q5437947_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q5437947_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q5437947_set A) : q5437947_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q5437947_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q5437947_set A) : q5437947_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q5437947_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q5437947_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q5437947_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q5437947_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q5437947_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q5437947_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q5437947_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Inductive q5437947_ennreal : Type :=
| q5437947_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q5437947_ennreal
| q5437947_ennreal_infinity : q5437947_ennreal.

Arguments q5437947_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_zero : q5437947_ennreal :=
  q5437947_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q5437947_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite a _,
    q5437947_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q5437947_ennreal_infinity,
    q5437947_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_le
    (x y : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite a _,
    q5437947_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q5437947_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q5437947_ennreal_infinity,
    q5437947_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q5437947_ennreal_infinity,
    q5437947_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_add
    (x y : q5437947_ennreal) : q5437947_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q5437947_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q5437947_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q5437947_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q5437947_ennreal) : q5437947_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q5437947_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q5437947_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite a _, q5437947_ennreal_infinity
  | q5437947_ennreal_infinity, q5437947_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q5437947_ennreal_zero
      else q5437947_ennreal_infinity
  | q5437947_ennreal_infinity, q5437947_ennreal_infinity =>
      q5437947_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q5437947_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q5437947_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q5437947_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q5437947_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q5437947_ennreal_add
        (q5437947_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q5437947_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q5437947_ennreal,
      values value -> q5437947_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q5437947_ennreal,
      (forall value : q5437947_ennreal,
        values value -> q5437947_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q5437947_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q5437947_ennreal_infimum
    (values : q5437947_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q5437947_ennreal,
      values value -> q5437947_ennreal_le bound value) /\
  (forall lower : q5437947_ennreal,
      (forall value : q5437947_ennreal,
        values value -> q5437947_ennreal_le lower value) ->
      q5437947_ennreal_le lower bound).

Definition q5437947_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q5437947_ennreal)
    (sum : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q5437947_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q5437947_ennreal_eq value
          (q5437947_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q5437947_liminf_has_value
    (u : nat -> q5437947_ennreal)
    (value : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists tail_infima : nat -> q5437947_ennreal,
    (forall n : nat,
      q5437947_ennreal_infimum
        (fun tail_value =>
          exists k : nat,
            (n <= k)%nat /\
            q5437947_ennreal_eq tail_value (u k))
        (tail_infima n)) /\
    q5437947_ennreal_supremum
      (fun tail_value =>
        exists n : nat,
          q5437947_ennreal_eq tail_value (tail_infima n))
      value.

Record q5437947_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q5437947_measurable : q5437947_set A -> Prop;
  q5437947_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q5437947_set A,
      q5437947_same_set E F ->
      (q5437947_measurable E <-> q5437947_measurable F);
  q5437947_measurable_empty :
    q5437947_measurable q5437947_empty;
  q5437947_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q5437947_set A,
      q5437947_measurable E ->
      q5437947_measurable (q5437947_complement E);
  q5437947_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q5437947_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q5437947_measurable (E n)) ->
      q5437947_measurable (q5437947_countable_union E);
  q5437947_measure : q5437947_set A -> q5437947_ennreal;
  q5437947_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q5437947_set A,
      q5437947_same_set E F ->
      q5437947_ennreal_eq
        (q5437947_measure E) (q5437947_measure F);
  q5437947_measure_empty :
    q5437947_ennreal_eq
      (q5437947_measure q5437947_empty)
      q5437947_ennreal_zero;
  q5437947_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q5437947_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q5437947_measurable (E n)) ->
      q5437947_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q5437947_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q5437947_measure (E n))
        (q5437947_measure (q5437947_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q5437947_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q5437947_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_below_real
    (x : q5437947_ennreal) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  match x with
  | q5437947_ennreal_finite value _ => value < bound
  | q5437947_ennreal_infinity => False
  end.

Definition q5437947_measurable_ennreal_function {A : Type}
    (mu : q5437947_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  forall bound : R,
    q5437947_measurable mu
      (fun x => q5437947_ennreal_below_real (f x) bound).

Record q5437947_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q5437947_nnreal_value : R;
  q5437947_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q5437947_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q5437947_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q5437947_nonnegative_real) : q5437947_ennreal :=
  q5437947_ennreal_finite
    (q5437947_nnreal_value x)
    (q5437947_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q5437947_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q5437947_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q5437947_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q5437947_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q5437947_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q5437947_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q5437947_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q5437947_ennreal)
    (value : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q5437947_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q5437947_set A),
    q5437947_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q5437947_ennreal_le
        (q5437947_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q5437947_ennreal_eq value
      (q5437947_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q5437947_ennreal_mul
            (q5437947_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q5437947_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q5437947_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q5437947_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q5437947_ennreal)
    (value : q5437947_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q5437947_ennreal_supremum
    (q5437947_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Theorem lintegral_liminf_le :
  forall (Alpha : Type)
         (mu : q5437947_measure_space Alpha)
         (f : nat -> Alpha -> q5437947_ennreal),
    (forall n : nat,
      q5437947_measurable_ennreal_function mu (f n)) ->
    exists (pointwise_liminf : Alpha -> q5437947_ennreal)
           (integrals : nat -> q5437947_ennreal)
           (left_integral right_liminf : q5437947_ennreal),
      (forall x : Alpha,
        q5437947_liminf_has_value
          (fun n => f n x) (pointwise_liminf x)) /\
      (forall n : nat,
        q5437947_lintegral_has_value
          mu (f n) (integrals n)) /\
      q5437947_lintegral_has_value
        mu pointwise_liminf left_integral /\
      q5437947_liminf_has_value integrals right_liminf /\
      q5437947_ennreal_le left_integral right_liminf.

theory Q5437947_fatou_lebesgue_theorem

theorem fatou_lebesgue_theorem:

    and f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> ennreal"

      "\<And>n. f n \<in> borel_measurable M"

(*

  "Fatou–Lebesgue theorem": the lower Lebesgue integral of the pointwise
  liminf of a sequence of measurable extended-nonnegative functions is at
  most the liminf of their lower Lebesgue integrals. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let Q5437947_FATOU_LEBESGUE_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let elt =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        ~(FST x) /\ (FST y \/ SND x < SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let emul =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if (~(FST x) /\ SND x = &0) \/
           (~(FST y) /\ SND y = &0)
        then ezero
        else if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x * SND y) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n:num. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\
           (!n:num. ele (u n) w)
           ==> ele z w) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:A) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:A->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n:num.
              ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n:num.
                    partial (SUC n) =
                    eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n})) in
   let measurable_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (f:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. enonnegative (f x)) /\
        (!c:real.
           &0 <= c ==> events {x:A | elt (F,c) (f x)}) in
   let simple_ennreal =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool#real).
        (!x:A. enonnegative (s x)) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s (:A)) /\
        (!c:bool#real. events {x:A | s x = c}) in
   let finite_esum =
      \(items:(bool#real)->bool)
       (h:(bool#real)->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        FINITE items /\
        (!x:bool#real.
           x IN items ==> enonnegative (h x)) /\
        ?n:num enum:num->bool#real partial:num->bool#real.
          (!x:bool#real.
             x IN items <=>
             ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = x) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 eadd (h (enum i)) (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_lintegral =
      \(mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:A->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        finite_esum (IMAGE s (:A))
          (\c:bool#real.
             emul c (mu {x:A | s x = c})) z in
   let is_supremum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele v z) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\
           (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele v w)
           ==> ele z w) in
   let is_infimum =
      \(p:(bool#real)->bool) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele z v) /\
        (!w:bool#real.
           enonnegative w /\
           (!v:bool#real. p v ==> ele w v)
           ==> ele w z) in
   let lintegral =
      \(events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->bool#real)
       (f:A->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v:bool#real.
               ?s:A->bool#real.
                 simple_ennreal events s /\
                 (!x:A. ele (s x) (f x)) /\
                 simple_lintegral mu s v)
            z in
   let eliminf =
      \(u:num->bool#real).
        @z:bool#real.
          is_supremum
            (\v:bool#real.
               ?n:num.
                 is_infimum
                   (\w:bool#real.
                      ?i:num. n <= i /\ w = u i)
                   v)
            z in
   !events:(A->bool)->bool
    mu:(A->bool)->bool#real
    f:num->A->bool#real.
      measure_space events mu /\
      (!n:num. measurable_ennreal events (f n))
      ==>
      ele
        (lintegral events mu
          (\x:A. eliminf (\n:num. f n x)))
        (eliminf
          (\n:num. lintegral events mu (f n)))`;;

(defun q5437947-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q5437947-r-less real right left)))

(defun-sk q5437947-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5437947-r-member-p real x)
      (q5437947-r-member-p real y)
      (q5437947-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q5437947-r-zero real))
            (one (q5437947-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q5437947-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q5437947-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q5437947-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q5437947-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q5437947-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q5437947-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q5437947-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q5437947-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q5437947-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q5437947-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q5437947-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q5437947-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q5437947-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q5437947-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q5437947-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q5437947-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q5437947-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q5437947-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q5437947-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q5437947-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal (q5437947-r-multiply real x inv-x) one))
        (equal
         (q5437947-r-multiply
          real x (q5437947-r-add real y z))
         (q5437947-r-add
          real
          (q5437947-r-multiply real x y)
          (q5437947-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q5437947-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5437947-r-member-p real x)
      (q5437947-r-member-p real y)
      (q5437947-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q5437947-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q5437947-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q5437947-r-less real x y)
         (q5437947-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q5437947-r-less real x y)
          (q5437947-r-less real y z))
         (q5437947-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q5437947-r-less real x y)
         (q5437947-r-less
          real
          (q5437947-r-add real x z)
          (q5437947-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q5437947-r-less real zero x)
          (q5437947-r-less real zero y))
         (q5437947-r-less
          real zero (q5437947-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q5437947-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q5437947-finite)
    (q5437947-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q5437947-r-leq
     real (q5437947-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q5437947-finite value))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q5437947-ennreal-finite (q5437947-r-zero real)))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q5437947-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q5437947-top) t)
   (t (q5437947-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q5437947-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q5437947-top)
          (equal right :q5437947-top))
      :q5437947-top
    (q5437947-ennreal-finite
     (q5437947-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q5437947-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q5437947-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q5437947-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q5437947-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q5437947-top)
        (equal right :q5437947-top))
    :q5437947-top)
   (t
    (q5437947-ennreal-finite
     (q5437947-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))
