title: Q5437947_fatou_lebesgue_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5437947,
-- "Fatou–Lebesgue theorem": Fatou's inequality for lower Lebesgue integrals
-- of measurable extended-nonnegative-real-valued sequences. This file contains
-- no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q5437947_fatou_lebesgue_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
open import Support.Q1067156X_bounded_convergence_theorem

open CompleteOrderedField
open ExtendedNonnegativeReals
open SigmaAlgebra
open Measure
open ENNRealPresentation

record IndexedSimpleBelowM
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A)
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (f : A -> M) : Set where
  field
    simpleCutoffM :
      Nat
    simpleIndexM :
      A -> Nat
    simpleValuesM :
      Nat -> M
    simpleIndexWithinM :
      (x : A) ->
      simpleIndexM x <=N simpleCutoffM
    simpleFiberMeasurableM :
      (i : Nat) ->
      i <=N simpleCutoffM ->
      measurable events (\ x -> simpleIndexM x == i)
    simplePointwiseBelowM :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualM extended (simpleValuesM (simpleIndexM x)) (f x)

open IndexedSimpleBelowM

indexedSimpleIntegralM :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  {f : A -> M} ->
  IndexedSimpleBelowM events extended f ->
  M
indexedSimpleIntegralM extended measure simple =
  sumThroughM extended
    (\ i ->
      multiplyM extended
        (simpleValuesM simple i)
        (outerMass measure
          (\ x -> simpleIndexM simple x == i)))
    (simpleCutoffM simple)

record SimpleIntegralCandidateM
  {A R M : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A}
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals)
  (measure : Measure extended events)
  (f : A -> M)
  (candidate : M) : Set where
  field
    candidateSimpleM :
      IndexedSimpleBelowM events extended f
    candidateEquationM :
      candidate ==
      indexedSimpleIntegralM extended measure candidateSimpleM

canonicalLIntegralM :
  {A R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra A} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (A -> M) ->
  M
canonicalLIntegralM extended measure f =
  supremumM extended
    (\ candidate ->
      SimpleIntegralCandidateM extended measure f candidate)

MeasurableOrder :
  {A V : Set} ->
  SigmaAlgebra A ->
  (V -> V -> Set) ->
  (A -> V) ->
  Set
MeasurableOrder events le f =
  (ray : OrderRay _) ->
  measurable events (\ x -> RayContains le ray (f x))

tailInfimumM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  Nat ->
  M
tailInfimumM extended sequence cutoff =
  supremumM extended
    (\ lower ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      lessOrEqualM extended lower (sequence n))

sequenceLiminfM :
  {R M : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  (Nat -> M) ->
  M
sequenceLiminfM extended sequence =
  supremumM extended
    (\ value ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ cutoff ->
          value == tailInfimumM extended sequence cutoff))

fatou-lebesgue-theorem : Set2
fatou-lebesgue-theorem =
  (A R M : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (extended : ExtendedNonnegativeReals R M reals) ->
  ENNRealPresentation extended ->
  (measure : Measure extended events) ->
  (functions : Nat -> A -> M) ->
  ((n : Nat) ->
    MeasurableOrder events
      (lessOrEqualM extended)
      (functions n)) ->
  lessOrEqualM extended
    (canonicalLIntegralM extended measure
      (\ x ->
        sequenceLiminfM extended
          (\ n -> functions n x)))
    (sequenceLiminfM extended
      (\ n ->
        canonicalLIntegralM extended measure (functions n)))

title: Q5437947_fatou_lebesgue_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q5437947,
% "Fatou–Lebesgue theorem": Fatou's lower-integral inequality for a sequence of
% measurable extended-nonnegative functions on an arbitrary, possibly empty
% measure space.
% This file contains no proof.

fatou_lebesgue_theorem_Q5437947[
  A: TYPE+,
  carrier: [A -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  event: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [A -> measure_value]
  nonnegative_function_sequence: TYPE =
    [nat -> nonnegative_function]

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  canonical_measure_value_sequence(
      values: measure_value_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      canonical_measure_value(values(index))

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) IMPLIES
        canonical_measure_value(function_value(omega))

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  carrier_event(E: event): bool =
    FORALL (omega: A):
      E(omega) IMPLIES carrier(omega)

  full_event: event = carrier

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A): FALSE

  event_complement(E: event): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega) AND NOT E(omega)

  countable_union(events: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  pairwise_disjoint(events: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      events: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: A):
          carrier(omega) IMPLIES
            NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
              AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND canonical_measure_value_sequence(values)
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (E: event):
      Sigma(E) IMPLIES carrier_event(E))
      AND Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(events)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (E: event):
        Sigma(E) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(E)))
      AND (FORALL (events: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(events(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(events(index)),
            M(countable_union(events))))

  sublevel_event(
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      bound: real): event =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      carrier(omega)
        AND NOT infinite_flag(function_value(omega))
        AND finite_part(function_value(omega)) <= bound

  measurable_nonnegative_function(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND (FORALL (bound: real):
        0 <= bound IMPLIES
          Sigma(sublevel_event(function_value, bound)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      omega: A): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, omega),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(omega) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (omega: A):
        carrier(omega) IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, omega),
            function_value(omega)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function):
      measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (integral_value: measure_value):
        has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
          M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))

  tail_lower_bound(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      start: nat,
      lower: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(lower)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        start <= index IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(lower, values(index)))

  has_tail_infimum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      start: nat,
      infimum: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value_sequence(values)
      AND tail_lower_bound(values, start, infimum)
      AND (FORALL (lower: measure_value):
        tail_lower_bound(values, start, lower)
          IMPLIES measure_value_le(lower, infimum))

  tail_infimum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      start: nat): measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (infimum: measure_value):
        has_tail_infimum(values, start, infimum))

  liminf_upper_bound(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND (FORALL (start: nat):
        measure_value_le(
          tail_infimum(values, start), upper))

  has_measure_value_liminf(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      limit_inferior: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value_sequence(values)
      AND liminf_upper_bound(values, limit_inferior)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        liminf_upper_bound(values, upper)
          IMPLIES
            measure_value_le(limit_inferior, upper))

  measure_value_liminf(
      values: measure_value_sequence): measure_value =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (limit_inferior: measure_value):
        has_measure_value_liminf(
          values, limit_inferior))

  pointwise_liminf(
      functions: nonnegative_function_sequence):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (omega: A):
      IF carrier(omega) THEN
        measure_value_liminf(
          LAMBDA (index: nat):
            functions(index)(omega))
      ELSE
        zero_measure_value
      ENDIF

  lintegral_liminf_le: bool =
    FORALL
        (M: measure_map),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (functions: nonnegative_function_sequence):
      (is_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          measurable_nonnegative_function(
            Sigma, functions(index))))
      IMPLIES
        measure_value_le(
          lower_lebesgue_integral(
            M, Sigma, pointwise_liminf(functions)),
          measure_value_liminf(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              lower_lebesgue_integral(
                M, Sigma, functions(index))))
END fatou_lebesgue_theorem_Q5437947

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5463860
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q5463860), "Focal subgroup theorem": for a Sylow
  p-subgroup P of finite index in an arbitrary group G, the intersection of
  the commutator subgroup of G with P is the focal subgroup generated by the
  commutators [x,u] that lie in P, with x in P and u in G. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q5463860_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q5463860_mul : G -> G -> G;
  q5463860_one : G;
  q5463860_inv : G -> G;
  q5463860_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q5463860_mul x (q5463860_mul y z) =
      q5463860_mul (q5463860_mul x y) z;
  q5463860_one_mul :
    forall x : G, q5463860_mul q5463860_one x = x;
  q5463860_mul_one :
    forall x : G, q5463860_mul x q5463860_one = x;
  q5463860_inv_mul :
    forall x : G,
      q5463860_mul (q5463860_inv x) x = q5463860_one;
  q5463860_mul_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q5463860_mul x (q5463860_inv x) = q5463860_one
}.

Arguments q5463860_mul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q5463860_one {G} _.
Arguments q5463860_inv {G} _ _.

Fixpoint q5463860_pow
    {G : Type} (grp : q5463860_group G) (x : G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q5463860_one grp
  | S k => q5463860_mul grp x (q5463860_pow grp x k)
  end.

Record q5463860_subgroup
    {G : Type} (grp : q5463860_group G) : Type := {
  q5463860_mem : G -> Prop;
  q5463860_subgroup_one :
    q5463860_mem (q5463860_one grp);
  q5463860_subgroup_mul :
    forall x y : G,
      q5463860_mem x ->
      q5463860_mem y ->
      q5463860_mem (q5463860_mul grp x y);
  q5463860_subgroup_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q5463860_mem x ->
      q5463860_mem (q5463860_inv grp x)
}.

Arguments q5463860_mem {G grp} _ _.

Definition q5463860_subgroup_included
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (H K : q5463860_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall x : G, q5463860_mem H x -> q5463860_mem K x.

Definition q5463860_subgroup_equiv
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (H K : q5463860_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall x : G, q5463860_mem H x <-> q5463860_mem K x.

Definition q5463860_predicate_equiv
    {G : Type} (A B : G -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall x : G, A x <-> B x.

Definition q5463860_prime (p : nat) : Prop :=
  (1 < p)%nat /\
  forall d : nat, Nat.divide d p -> d = 1 \/ d = p.

Definition q5463860_is_p_group
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (p : nat)
    (H : q5463860_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  forall x : G,
    q5463860_mem H x ->
    exists k : nat,
      q5463860_pow grp x (Nat.pow p k) = q5463860_one grp.

Definition q5463860_is_sylow
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (p : nat)
    (P : q5463860_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  q5463860_is_p_group p P /\
  forall Q : q5463860_subgroup grp,
    q5463860_is_p_group p Q ->
    q5463860_subgroup_included P Q ->
    q5463860_subgroup_equiv Q P.

Definition q5463860_same_left_coset
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (H : q5463860_subgroup grp)
    (x y : G) : Prop :=
  q5463860_mem H
    (q5463860_mul grp (q5463860_inv grp x) y).

Definition q5463860_finite_index
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (H : q5463860_subgroup grp) : Prop :=
  exists representatives : list G,
    forall x : G,
      exists r : G,
        In r representatives /\
        q5463860_same_left_coset H x r.

Definition q5463860_commutator
    {G : Type}
    (grp : q5463860_group G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q5463860_mul grp
    (q5463860_mul grp
      (q5463860_mul grp x y)
      (q5463860_inv grp x))
    (q5463860_inv grp y).

Definition q5463860_generated
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (S : G -> Prop)
    (g : G) : Prop :=
  forall H : q5463860_subgroup grp,
    (forall x : G, S x -> q5463860_mem H x) ->
    q5463860_mem H g.

Definition q5463860_commutator_generators
    {G : Type}
    (grp : q5463860_group G)
    (g : G) : Prop :=
  exists x y : G,
    g = q5463860_commutator grp x y.

Definition q5463860_commutator_subgroup
    {G : Type}
  (grp : q5463860_group G)
  (g : G) : Prop :=
  q5463860_generated (grp := grp)
    (q5463860_commutator_generators grp)
    g.

Definition q5463860_focal_generators
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (P : q5463860_subgroup grp)
    (g : G) : Prop :=
  q5463860_mem P g /\
  exists x : G,
    q5463860_mem P x /\
    exists u : G,
      g = q5463860_commutator grp x u.

Definition q5463860_focal_subgroup
    {G : Type}
    {grp : q5463860_group G}
    (P : q5463860_subgroup grp)
    (g : G) : Prop :=
  q5463860_generated (grp := grp)
    (q5463860_focal_generators P)
    g.

Definition q5463860_intersection
    {G : Type}
    (A B : G -> Prop)
    (g : G) : Prop :=
  A g /\ B g.

Theorem commutator_inf_eq_focalSubgroup :
  forall (G : Type)
         (grp : q5463860_group G)
         (p : nat)
         (P : q5463860_subgroup grp),
    q5463860_prime p ->
    q5463860_is_sylow p P ->
    q5463860_finite_index P ->
    q5463860_predicate_equiv
      (q5463860_intersection
        (q5463860_commutator_subgroup grp)
        (q5463860_mem P))
      (q5463860_focal_subgroup P).
Admitted.

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5463860,
  "Focal subgroup theorem": for a prime p and a finite-index Sylow p-subgroup
  P of an arbitrary group, the intersection of P with the commutator subgroup
  is the focal subgroup generated by the commutators [x,u] that lie in P with
  x in P. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q5463860_nat_prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5463860_nat_prime p \<longleftrightarrow>
    2 \<le> p \<and> (\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

primrec q5463860_add_power :: "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'g" where
  "q5463860_add_power x 0 = 0"
| "q5463860_add_power x (Suc n) = x + q5463860_add_power x n"

definition q5463860_is_subgroup :: "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5463860_is_subgroup H \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> H \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. -x \<in> H) \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<forall>y \<in> H. x + y \<in> H)"

definition q5463860_is_p_subgroup ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5463860_is_p_subgroup p H \<longleftrightarrow>
    q5463860_is_subgroup H \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> H. \<exists>k. q5463860_add_power x (p ^ k) = 0)"

definition q5463860_is_sylow_subgroup ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5463860_is_sylow_subgroup p P \<longleftrightarrow>
    q5463860_is_p_subgroup p P \<and>
    (\<forall>Q. q5463860_is_p_subgroup p Q \<longrightarrow>
      P \<subseteq> Q \<longrightarrow> Q = P)"

definition q5463860_right_cosets ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set set" where
  "q5463860_right_cosets H =
    (\<lambda>g. (\<lambda>h. h + g) ` H) ` UNIV"

definition q5463860_generated_subgroup ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q5463860_generated_subgroup S =
    {x. \<forall>H. q5463860_is_subgroup H \<longrightarrow>
      S \<subseteq> H \<longrightarrow> x \<in> H}"

definition q5463860_commutator ::
    "'g::group_add \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'g" where
  "q5463860_commutator x u = x + u + (-x) + (-u)"

definition q5463860_commutator_subgroup :: "'g::group_add set" where
  "q5463860_commutator_subgroup =
    q5463860_generated_subgroup
      {g. \<exists>x u. g = q5463860_commutator x u}"

definition q5463860_focal_subgroup ::
    "'g::group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'g set" where
  "q5463860_focal_subgroup P =
    q5463860_generated_subgroup
      {g. g \<in> P \<and>
        (\<exists>x \<in> P. \<exists>u. g = q5463860_commutator x u)}"

theorem q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem:
  fixes p :: nat
    and P :: "'g::group_add set"
  assumes prime_p: "q5463860_nat_prime p"
    and sylow_P: "q5463860_is_sylow_subgroup p P"
    and finite_index_P: "finite (q5463860_right_cosets P)"
  shows "(q5463860_commutator_subgroup :: 'g set) \<inter> P =
    q5463860_focal_subgroup P"
  sorry

end

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5463860,
;; "Focal subgroup theorem": for a Sylow p-subgroup P of finite index in an
;; arbitrary group G, the intersection of P with the commutator subgroup of G
;; equals the focal subgroup generated by the relevant commutators. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic interfaces represent an arbitrary carrier, group
;; operations, and subgroup predicate. Structure tags do not enumerate or
;; otherwise restrict the carrier.

(defstub q5463860-group-element-p (group element) t)
(defstub q5463860-group-one (group) t)
(defstub q5463860-group-mul (group left right) t)
(defstub q5463860-group-inv (group element) t)
(defstub q5463860-subgroup-element-p (group subgroup element) t)

(defun-sk q5463860-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q5463860-group-element-p group x)
      (and
       (q5463860-group-element-p
        group
        (q5463860-group-inv group x))
       (equal
        (q5463860-group-mul
         group x (q5463860-group-one group))
        x)
       (equal
        (q5463860-group-mul
         group (q5463860-group-one group) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q5463860-group-mul
         group x (q5463860-group-inv group x))
        (q5463860-group-one group))
       (equal
        (q5463860-group-mul
         group (q5463860-group-inv group x) x)
        (q5463860-group-one group))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5463860-group-element-p group x)
       (q5463860-group-element-p group y))
      (q5463860-group-element-p
       group
       (q5463860-group-mul group x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5463860-group-element-p group x)
       (q5463860-group-element-p group y)
       (q5463860-group-element-p group z))
      (equal
       (q5463860-group-mul
        group
        (q5463860-group-mul group x y)
        z)
       (q5463860-group-mul
        group
        x
        (q5463860-group-mul group y z)))))))

(defun q5463860-group-p (group)
  (and
   (q5463860-group-element-p
    group
    (q5463860-group-one group))
   (q5463860-group-laws-p group)))

(defun-sk q5463860-subgroup-laws-p (group subgroup)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q5463860-subgroup-element-p group subgroup x)
      (and
       (q5463860-group-element-p group x)
       (q5463860-subgroup-element-p
        group
        subgroup
        (q5463860-group-inv group x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5463860-subgroup-element-p group subgroup x)
       (q5463860-subgroup-element-p group subgroup y))
      (q5463860-subgroup-element-p
       group
       subgroup
       (q5463860-group-mul group x y))))))

(defun q5463860-subgroup-p (group subgroup)
  (and
   (q5463860-group-p group)
   (q5463860-subgroup-element-p
    group
    subgroup
    (q5463860-group-one group))
   (q5463860-subgroup-laws-p group subgroup)))

;; The commutator orientation matches Mathlib's notation:
;; [x,u] = x^-1 * (u * x * u^-1).

(defun q5463860-commutator (group x u)
  (q5463860-group-mul
   group
   (q5463860-group-inv group x)
   (q5463860-group-mul
    group
    u
    (q5463860-group-mul
     group
     x
     (q5463860-group-inv group u)))))

;; Prime numbers and p-elements. For prime p, x has p-power order exactly
;; when x^(p^k) = 1 for some natural k.

(defun q5463860-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and
       (natp number)
       (natp divisor)
       (<= 2 divisor)
       (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (q5463860-no-divisor-from-p
        number
        (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun q5463860-primep (number)
  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)
   (q5463860-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

(defun q5463860-power (group element exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q5463860-group-one group)
    (q5463860-group-mul
     group
     element
     (q5463860-power group element (- exponent 1)))))

(defun-sk q5463860-p-element-p (group p element)
  (exists (exponent)
    (and
     (natp exponent)
     (equal
      (q5463860-power
       group
       element
       (expt p exponent))
      (q5463860-group-one group)))))

(defun-sk q5463860-p-subgroup-elements-p
    (group subgroup p)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q5463860-subgroup-element-p group subgroup element)
     (q5463860-p-element-p group p element))))

(defun q5463860-p-subgroup-p (group subgroup p)
  (and
   (q5463860-subgroup-p group subgroup)
   (q5463860-p-subgroup-elements-p group subgroup p)))

;; A finite word in a generator set and its inverses gives the exact
;; algebraic subgroup generated by that set.

(defun q5463860-word-product (group word)
  (if (consp word)
      (q5463860-group-mul
       group
       (car word)
       (q5463860-word-product group (cdr word)))
    (q5463860-group-one group)))

;; The subgroup generated by P together with one ambient element is used to
;; express maximality among p-subgroups without quantifying over set codes.

(defun-sk q5463860-extension-factor-p
    (group subgroup adjoined factor)
  (exists (base)
    (and
     (or
      (q5463860-subgroup-element-p group subgroup base)
      (equal base adjoined))
     (or
      (equal factor base)
      (equal
       factor
       (q5463860-group-inv group base))))))

(defun q5463860-extension-word-p
    (group subgroup adjoined word)
  (if (consp word)
      (and
       (q5463860-extension-factor-p
        group subgroup adjoined (car word))
       (q5463860-extension-word-p
        group subgroup adjoined (cdr word)))
    (equal word nil)))

(defun-sk q5463860-extension-generated-member-p
    (group subgroup adjoined element)
  (exists (word)
    (and
     (q5463860-extension-word-p
      group subgroup adjoined word)
     (equal
      element
      (q5463860-word-product group word)))))

(defun-sk q5463860-extension-p-group-p
    (group subgroup p adjoined)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q5463860-extension-generated-member-p
      group subgroup adjoined element)
     (q5463860-p-element-p group p element))))

(defun-sk q5463860-sylow-maximal-p
    (group subgroup p)
  (forall (adjoined)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5463860-group-element-p group adjoined)
      (q5463860-extension-p-group-p
       group subgroup p adjoined))
     (q5463860-subgroup-element-p
      group subgroup adjoined))))

(defun q5463860-sylow-p (group subgroup p)
  (and
   (q5463860-p-subgroup-p group subgroup p)
   (q5463860-sylow-maximal-p group subgroup p)))

;; Finite index is represented by an internal finite list containing exactly
;; one representative from every left coset. The ambient carrier itself may
;; remain infinite.

(defun q5463860-same-left-coset-p
    (group subgroup left right)
  (q5463860-subgroup-element-p
   group
   subgroup
   (q5463860-group-mul
    group
    (q5463860-group-inv group left)
    right)))

(defun q5463860-list-has-coset-representative-p
    (group subgroup element representatives)
  (if (consp representatives)
      (or
       (q5463860-same-left-coset-p
        group subgroup (car representatives) element)
       (q5463860-list-has-coset-representative-p
        group subgroup element (cdr representatives)))
    nil))

(defun q5463860-representatives-in-carrier-p
    (group representatives)
  (if (consp representatives)
      (and
       (q5463860-group-element-p
        group (car representatives))
       (q5463860-representatives-in-carrier-p
        group (cdr representatives)))
    (equal representatives nil)))

(defun q5463860-coset-representatives-distinct-p
    (group subgroup representatives)
  (if (consp representatives)
      (and
       (not
        (q5463860-list-has-coset-representative-p
         group
         subgroup
         (car representatives)
         (cdr representatives)))
       (q5463860-coset-representatives-distinct-p
        group subgroup (cdr representatives)))
    (equal representatives nil)))

(defun-sk q5463860-coset-representatives-complete-p
    (group subgroup representatives)
  (forall (element)
    (implies
     (q5463860-group-element-p group element)
     (q5463860-list-has-coset-representative-p
      group subgroup element representatives))))

(defun q5463860-coset-representatives-p
    (group subgroup representatives)
  (and
   (true-listp representatives)
   (q5463860-representatives-in-carrier-p
    group representatives)
   (q5463860-coset-representatives-distinct-p
    group subgroup representatives)
   (q5463860-coset-representatives-complete-p
    group subgroup representatives)))

(defun-sk q5463860-finite-index-p (group subgroup)
  (exists (representatives)
    (q5463860-coset-representatives-p
     group subgroup representatives)))

;; Membership in the commutator subgroup G' is membership in the subgroup
;; generated by all ambient commutators.

(defun-sk q5463860-commutator-factor-p
    (group factor)
  (exists (x y)
    (and
     (q5463860-group-element-p group x)
     (q5463860-group-element-p group y)
     (or
      (equal
       factor
       (q5463860-commutator group x y))
      (equal
       factor
       (q5463860-group-inv
        group
        (q5463860-commutator group x y)))))))

(defun q5463860-commutator-word-p (group word)
  (if (consp word)
      (and
       (q5463860-commutator-factor-p
        group (car word))
       (q5463860-commutator-word-p
        group (cdr word)))
    (equal word nil)))

(defun-sk q5463860-commutator-subgroup-member-p
    (group element)
  (exists (word)
    (and
     (q5463860-commutator-word-p group word)
     (equal
      element
      (q5463860-word-product group word)))))

    (group subgroup factor)
  (exists (x u)
    (and
     (q5463860-subgroup-element-p group subgroup x)
     (q5463860-group-element-p group u)
     (q5463860-subgroup-element-p
      group
      subgroup
      (q5463860-commutator group x u))
     (or
      (equal
       factor
       (q5463860-commutator group x u))
      (equal

(defun q5463860-focal-word-p

  (if (consp word)
      (and
       (q5463860-focal-factor-p
        group subgroup (car word))
       (q5463860-focal-word-p
        group subgroup (cdr word)))

(defun-sk q5463860-focal-subgroup-member-p
    (group subgroup element)
  (exists (word)
    (and
     (q5463860-focal-word-p
      group subgroup word)
     (equal

      (q5463860-word-product group word)))))

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5463860,
-- "Focal subgroup theorem": a finite-index Sylow p-subgroup meets the ambient
-- full derived subgroup [G,G] in its focal subgroup, generated by the
-- commutators that remain in the Sylow subgroup. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≤_ _∣_ _⊆_ _≈_ _↔_
infixr 5 _×_
infixr 8 _^_

data ⊥ {ℓ : Level} : Set ℓ where

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor _,_
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _↔_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward  : A → B
    backward : B → A

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

data _≤_ : Nat → Nat → Set where
  zero≤   : {n : Nat} → zero ≤ n
  suc≤suc : {m n : Nat} → m ≤ n → suc m ≤ suc n

record _∣_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    divides-equation : divisor * quotient ≡ dividend

data _∨_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record Prime (n : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : suc (suc zero) ≤ n
    divisor-is-trivial :
      (d : Nat) →
      d ∣ n →
      (d ≡ suc zero) ∨ (d ≡ n)

_^_ : Nat → Nat → Nat
base ^ zero = suc zero
base ^ suc exponent = base * (base ^ exponent)

record Group {ℓ : Level} (G : Set ℓ) : Set ℓ where
  field
    identity       : G
    inverse        : G → G
    multiply       : G → G → G
    associative    : (x y z : G) →
                     multiply x (multiply y z) ≡
                     multiply (multiply x y) z
    identity-left  : (x : G) → multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right : (x : G) → multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left   : (x : G) → multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right  : (x : G) → multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record SubgroupOf
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  open Group structure

  field
    member : G → Set ℓ
    membership-propositional :
      (x : G) (u v : member x) → u ≡ v
    contains-identity : member identity
    closed-under-inverse :
      (x : G) → member x → member (inverse x)
    closed-under-multiply :
      (x y : G) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (multiply x y)

open SubgroupOf

_⊆_ :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  {structure : Group G} →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
H ⊆ K =
  (x : _) → member H x → member K x

record _≈_
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  {structure : Group G}
  (H K : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    same-members-forward  : H ⊆ K
    same-members-backward : K ⊆ H

power :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  G →
  Nat →
  G
power structure x zero = Group.identity structure
power structure x (suc n) =
  Group.multiply structure x (power structure x n)

IsPGroup :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  Nat →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
IsPGroup structure prime H =
  (x : _) →
  member H x →
  Σ Nat
    (λ exponent →
      power structure x (prime ^ exponent) ≡
      Group.identity structure)

record IsSylow
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (prime : Nat)
  (P : SubgroupOf structure) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    is-p-group : IsPGroup structure prime P
    maximal :
      (Q : SubgroupOf structure) →
      IsPGroup structure prime Q →
      P ⊆ Q →
      Q ≈ P

SameLeftCoset :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
SameLeftCoset structure H x y =
  member H
    (Group.multiply structure
      (Group.inverse structure x)
      y)

record CosetTransversal
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (H : SubgroupOf structure)
  (count : Nat) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    representative :
      Fin count →
      G
    covers :
      (x : G) →
      Σ (Fin count)
        (λ i →
          SameLeftCoset structure H (representative i) x)
    unique :
      (i j : Fin count) →
      SameLeftCoset
        structure H (representative i) (representative j) →
      i ≡ j

FiniteIndex :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  Set ℓ
FiniteIndex structure H =
  Σ Nat (CosetTransversal structure H)

commutatorElement :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  G →
  G →
  G
commutatorElement structure x y =
  let open Group structure
  in
  multiply
    (multiply
      (multiply x y)
      (inverse x))
    (inverse y)

data Generated
  {ℓ : Level}
  {G : Set ℓ}
  (structure : Group G)
  (seed : G → Set ℓ) :
  G →
  Set ℓ where

  generated-seed :
    {x : G} →
    seed x →
    Generated structure seed x
  generated-identity :
    Generated structure seed (Group.identity structure)
  generated-inverse :
    {x : G} →
    Generated structure seed x →
    Generated structure seed (Group.inverse structure x)
  generated-multiply :
    {x y : G} →
    Generated structure seed x →
    Generated structure seed y →
    Generated structure seed (Group.multiply structure x y)

CommutatorGenerator :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
CommutatorGenerator {G = G} structure g =
  Σ G
    (λ x →
      Σ G
        (λ y →
          commutatorElement structure x y ≡ g))

CommutatorSubgroupMember :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  Group G →
  G →
  Set ℓ
CommutatorSubgroupMember structure =
  Generated structure (CommutatorGenerator structure)

FocalGenerator :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  Set ℓ
FocalGenerator {G = G} structure P g =
  member P g
  ×
  Σ G
    (λ x →
      member P x
      ×
      Σ G
        (λ u →
          g ≡ commutatorElement structure x u))

FocalSubgroupMember :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  SubgroupOf structure →
  G →
  Set ℓ
FocalSubgroupMember structure P =
  Generated structure (FocalGenerator structure P)

focal-subgroup-theorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
focal-subgroup-theorem ℓ =
  {G : Set ℓ} →
  (structure : Group G) →
  (prime : Nat) →
  Prime prime →
  (P : SubgroupOf structure) →
  IsSylow structure prime P →
  FiniteIndex structure P →
  (g : G) →
  (CommutatorSubgroupMember structure g × member P g)
  ↔
  FocalSubgroupMember structure P g

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q5463860 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q5463860), "Focal subgroup theorem":
  for a finite-index Sylow p-subgroup of an arbitrary group, its intersection
  with the ambient commutator subgroup is its focal subgroup. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val q5463860_group_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_group_def",
  ``q5463860_group
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul e x = x) /\
      (!x. mul x e = x) /\
      (!x. mul (ginv x) x = e) /\
      (!x. mul x (ginv x) = e)``);

val q5463860_subgroup_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_subgroup_def",
  ``q5463860_subgroup
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (H : 'a set) <=>
      e IN H /\
      (!x y. x IN H /\ y IN H ==> mul x y IN H) /\
      (!x. x IN H ==> ginv x IN H)``);

val q5463860_generated_subgroup_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_generated_subgroup_def",
  ``q5463860_generated_subgroup
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (gens : 'a set) =
      {x |
        !H : 'a set.
          q5463860_subgroup mul e ginv H /\
          gens SUBSET H
          ==>
          x IN H}``);

val q5463860_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_pow_def",
  ``q5463860_pow
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (x : 'a) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (\y. mul x y) n e``);

val q5463860_p_subgroup_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_p_subgroup_def",
  ``q5463860_p_subgroup
      (p : num)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (P : 'a set) <=>
      q5463860_subgroup mul e ginv P /\
      !x.
        x IN P ==>
        ?k : num. q5463860_pow mul e x (p ** k) = e``);

val q5463860_sylow_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_sylow_def",
  ``q5463860_sylow
      (p : num)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (P : 'a set) <=>
      q5463860_p_subgroup p mul e ginv P /\
      !Q : 'a set.
        q5463860_p_subgroup p mul e ginv Q /\
        P SUBSET Q
        ==>
        Q = P``);

val q5463860_finite_index_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_finite_index_def",
  ``q5463860_finite_index
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (P : 'a set) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE (\g. IMAGE (\h. mul g h) P) UNIV)``);

val q5463860_commutator_element_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_commutator_element_def",
  ``q5463860_commutator_element
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a) (x : 'a) (u : 'a) =
      mul (mul (mul x u) (ginv x)) (ginv u)``);

val q5463860_commutator_subgroup_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_commutator_subgroup_def",
  ``q5463860_commutator_subgroup
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a) =
      q5463860_generated_subgroup mul e ginv
        {g | ?x u. g = q5463860_commutator_element mul ginv x u}``);

val q5463860_focal_subgroup_def = new_definition (
  "q5463860_focal_subgroup_def",
  ``q5463860_focal_subgroup
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (P : 'a set) =
      q5463860_generated_subgroup mul e ginv
        {g |
          g IN P /\
          ?x u.
            x IN P /\
            g = q5463860_commutator_element mul ginv x u}``);

val focal_subgroup_theorem =
  ``!(mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (e : 'a) (ginv : 'a -> 'a)
      (p : num) (P : 'a set).
      q5463860_group mul e ginv /\
      prime p /\
      q5463860_sylow p mul e ginv P /\
      q5463860_finite_index mul P
      ==>
      q5463860_commutator_subgroup mul e ginv INTER P =
      q5463860_focal_subgroup mul e ginv P``;

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5463860
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q5463860), "Focal subgroup theorem": for a
  finite-index Sylow p-subgroup P of an arbitrary group G, the intersection
  of P with the commutator subgroup of G is the focal subgroup of P. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q5463860Comm G x u is the commutator x * u * x^-1 * u^-1, matching
  Mathlib's commutatorElement convention. Q5463860Derived G is the subgroup
  generated by all such commutators in G. Q5463860Focal G P is the subgroup
  generated by those commutators whose first entry and value both lie in P.
  Subgroup generation is represented by Moore closure in SubGrp ` G.

  Membership P e. ( p pSyl G ) and p e. Prime encode the source's Sylow
  p-subgroup and prime assumptions. Finiteness of the left-coset quotient
  encodes P.FiniteIndex without imposing finiteness on the carrier of G. The
  final $a assertion is unproved and this database contains no $p statement.
$)

$c Q5463860Comm Q5463860Derived Q5463860Focal $.

q5463860-comm-syntax $a class ( Q5463860Comm G x u ) $.
q5463860-derived-syntax $a class ( Q5463860Derived G ) $.
q5463860-focal-syntax $a class ( Q5463860Focal G P ) $.

${
  $d G u x $.

  q5463860-comm-definition $a |- ( Q5463860Comm G x u ) =
    ( ( ( x ( +g ` G ) u ) ( -g ` G ) x ) ( -g ` G ) u )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G u x z $.

  q5463860-derived-definition $a |- ( Q5463860Derived G ) =
    (
      ( mrCls ` ( SubGrp ` G ) )
      `
      {
        z e. ( Base ` G ) |
        E. x e. ( Base ` G ) E. u e. ( Base ` G )
          z = ( Q5463860Comm G x u )
      }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G P u x z $.

  q5463860-focal-definition $a |- ( Q5463860Focal G P ) =
    (
      ( mrCls ` ( SubGrp ` G ) )
      `
      {
        z e. P |
        E. x e. P E. u e. ( Base ` G )
          z = ( Q5463860Comm G x u )
      }
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d g p s $.

  thousand-theorems-q5463860-focal-subgroup-theorem $a |- (
    A. g A. p A. s
      (
        (
          g e. Grp
          /\
          p e. Prime
          /\
          s e. ( p pSyl g )
          /\
          ( ( Base ` g ) /. ( g ~QG s ) ) e. Fin
        )
        ->
        (
          ( ( Q5463860Derived g ) i^i s )
          =
          ( Q5463860Focal g s )
        )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5463860,
% "Focal subgroup theorem": in an arbitrary group, the intersection of the
% commutator subgroup with a finite-index Sylow p-subgroup is its focal subgroup.
% This file contains no proof.

Q5463860_focal_subgroup_theorem[
  G: TYPE+,
  mul: [G, G -> G],
  inv: [G -> G],
  one: G,
  p: nat,
  P: [G -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  element_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[element_set]

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        mul(inv(x), x) = one
          AND mul(x, inv(x)) = one)

  subset_of(A, B: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  is_subgroup(H: element_set): bool =
    H(one)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        H(x) AND H(y) IMPLIES H(mul(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES H(inv(x)))

  generated_subgroup(S: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (g: G):
      FORALL (H: element_set):
        is_subgroup(H)
          AND subset_of(S, H)
          IMPLIES H(g)

  group_power(x: G, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE G =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      mul(group_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (factor: nat):
      value = divisor * factor

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND (FORALL (divisor: nat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value)

  is_p_subgroup(prime: nat, H: element_set): bool =
    is_subgroup(H)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        H(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (exponent: nat):
            group_power(x, prime ^ exponent) = one)

  is_sylow_p_subgroup(prime: nat, H: element_set): bool =
    is_p_subgroup(prime, H)
      AND (FORALL (K: element_set):
        is_p_subgroup(prime, K)
          AND subset_of(H, K)
          IMPLIES K = H)

  left_coset(g: G, H: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (x: G):

  finite_index(H: element_set): bool =
    EXISTS (cosets: finite_set[element_set]):
      FORALL (C: element_set):

  commutator_element(x, u: G): G =
    mul(mul(mul(x, u), inv(x)), inv(u))

  commutator_generators: element_set =

  commutator_subgroup: element_set =

  focal_generators(H: element_set): element_set =
    LAMBDA (g: G):

    IMPLIES

  (1 < p)%nat /\

(defun q550402-has-common-nontrivial-divisor-p
    (left right divisor)

  (if (or (not (natp divisor))
          (< divisor 2))

          (equal (mod right divisor) 0))
     (q550402-has-common-nontrivial-divisor-p
      left right (- divisor 1)))))

   (natp left)
   (natp right)
   (not
    (q550402-has-common-nontrivial-divisor-p
     left right (max left right)))))

    (number divisor)

  (if (or (not (natp divisor))
          (< divisor 2))
      nil

     (equal (mod number divisor) 0)
     (q550402-has-nontrivial-divisor-p
      number (- divisor 1)))))

  (and
   (natp number)
   (< 1 number)

-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q550402, "Dirichlet's theorem on arithmetic progressions":
-- for a nonzero modulus and a unit residue class, infinitely many natural primes lie in
-- that residue class. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q550402_dirichlet_s_theorem_on_arithmetic_progressions where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _*_; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 5 _and_
infixr 3 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

record Exists (A : Set) (property : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    satisfies : property value

record _and_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    left : A
    right : B

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : two <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

ModEq : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Set
ModEq modulus lhs rhs =
  naturalMod lhs modulus == naturalMod rhs modulus

record NeZero (q : Nat) : Set where
  field
    nonzero : Not (q == zero)

record ZMod (q : Nat) : Set where
  constructor residue
  field
    representative : Nat
    reduced : representative < q

open ZMod

record IsUnit {q : Nat} (a : ZMod q) : Set where
  field
    inverse : ZMod q
    inverse-equation :
      ModEq q
        (representative a * representative inverse)
        one

Infinite : (Nat -> Set) -> Set
Infinite member =
  (bound : Nat) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      member n and (bound < n))

primeInResidueClass :
  (q : Nat) ->
  ZMod q ->
  Nat ->
  Set
primeInResidueClass q a p =
  Prime p and ModEq q p (representative a)

dirichlet-s-theorem-on-arithmetic-progressions : Set
dirichlet-s-theorem-on-arithmetic-progressions =
  (q : Nat) ->
  NeZero q ->
  (a : ZMod q) ->
  IsUnit a ->
  Infinite (primeInResidueClass q a)

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q550402,
% "Dirichlet's theorem on arithmetic progressions": for every positive modulus
% and unit residue class, infinitely many natural primes lie in that class.
% This file contains no proof.

Q550402_dirichlet_s_theorem_on_arithmetic_progressions: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor: posnat, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value)
          IMPLIES divisor = 1 OR divisor = value

  coprime_nat(left, right: nat): bool =
    FORALL (divisor: posnat):
      nat_divides(divisor, left) AND nat_divides(divisor, right)
        IMPLIES divisor = 1

  nat_congruent(left, right, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (offset: int):
      (left :: int) - (right :: int) = (modulus :: int) * offset

  dirichlet_s_theorem_on_arithmetic_progressions: bool =
    FORALL (modulus, residue: nat):
      (modulus >= 1 AND coprime_nat(residue, modulus))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (bound: nat):
            EXISTS (p: nat):
              bound < p
                AND prime_nat(p)
                AND nat_congruent(p, residue, modulus)

END Q550402_dirichlet_s_theorem_on_arithmetic_progressions

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5504427,
;; "Friendship theorem": every nonempty finite simple undirected graph in which
;; each distinct pair of vertices has exactly one common neighbor has a vertex
;; adjacent to every other vertex. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A duplicate-free true list enumerates the finite vertex type. Each edge is
;; an unordered pair of distinct enumerated vertices, and no undirected edge
;; occurs twice. Thus valid lists represent exactly the finite simple graphs
;; in the source, independently of carrier order and edge orientation.

(defun q5504427-carrier-p (vertices)
  (and
   (true-listp vertices)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal vertices)))

(defun q5504427-edge-record-p (edge vertices)
  (and
   (true-listp edge)
   (equal (len edge) 2)
   (member-equal (nth 0 edge) vertices)
   (member-equal (nth 1 edge) vertices)
   (not (equal (nth 0 edge) (nth 1 edge)))))

(defun q5504427-same-undirected-edge-p (left right)
  (or
   (and
    (equal (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
    (equal (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
   (and
    (equal (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
    (equal (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right)))))

(defun q5504427-edge-distinct-from-list-p (edge remaining)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (not
        (q5504427-same-undirected-edge-p
         edge (car remaining)))
       (q5504427-edge-distinct-from-list-p
        edge (cdr remaining)))
    t))

(defun q5504427-edge-list-p (edges vertices)
  (if (consp edges)
      (and
       (q5504427-edge-record-p (car edges) vertices)
       (q5504427-edge-distinct-from-list-p
        (car edges) (cdr edges))
       (q5504427-edge-list-p (cdr edges) vertices))
    (equal edges nil)))

(defun q5504427-simple-graph-p (vertices edges)
  (and
   (q5504427-carrier-p vertices)
   (q5504427-edge-list-p edges vertices)))

(defun q5504427-adjacent-p (edges left right)
  (if (or
       (member-equal (list left right) edges)
       (member-equal (list right left) edges))
      t
    nil))

(defun q5504427-common-neighbor-count
    (left right candidates edges)
  (if (consp candidates)
      (+
       (if (and
            (q5504427-adjacent-p
             edges left (car candidates))
            (q5504427-adjacent-p
             edges right (car candidates)))
           1
         0)
       (q5504427-common-neighbor-count
        left right (cdr candidates) edges))
    0))

(defun q5504427-friendship-row-p
    (left remaining vertices edges)
  (if (consp remaining)
      (and
       (or
        (equal left (car remaining))
        (equal
         (q5504427-common-neighbor-count
          left (car remaining) vertices edges)
         1))
       (q5504427-friendship-row-p

-- "Friendship theorem": every nonempty finite simple graph in which each pair
-- of distinct vertices has exactly one common neighbor has a vertex adjacent
-- to every other vertex. This file contains no proof.

module Q5504427_friendship_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc) renaming (_⊔_ to _lmax_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record ExistsUnique
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a lmax p) where

  constructor unique-witness
  field
    unique-value    : A
    unique-property : P unique-value
    uniqueness      : (other : A) -> P other -> other == unique-value

record Nonempty
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  constructor inhabited
  field
    element : A

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a lmax b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

FinitePresentation :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
FinitePresentation A =
  Σ Nat (\ cardinality -> Bijection A (Fin cardinality))

record SimpleGraph
  {a : Level}
  (V : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    adjacent  : V -> V -> Set
    loopless  : (v : V) -> Not (adjacent v v)
    symmetric : (v w : V) -> adjacent v w -> adjacent w v

open SimpleGraph

Friendship :
  {a : Level} ->
  {V : Set a} ->
  SimpleGraph V ->
  Set a
Friendship {V = V} graph =
  (v w : V) ->
  Not (v == w) ->
  ExistsUnique V
    (\ common ->
      adjacent graph v common
      and
      adjacent graph w common)

ExistsPolitician :
  {a : Level} ->
  {V : Set a} ->
  SimpleGraph V ->
  Set a
ExistsPolitician {V = V} graph =
  Exists V
    (\ politician ->
      (other : V) ->
      Not (politician == other) ->
      adjacent graph politician other)

friendship-theorem :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc a)
friendship-theorem {a} =
  (V : Set a) ->
  FinitePresentation V ->
  Nonempty V ->
  (graph : SimpleGraph V) ->
  Friendship graph ->
  ExistsPolitician graph

title: Q5504427_friendship_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q5504427,
% "Friendship theorem": every finite nonempty simple graph in which each pair
% of distinct vertices has exactly one common neighbor has a vertex adjacent
% to every other vertex. This file contains no proof.

Q5504427_friendship_theorem[V: TYPE+]: THEORY
BEGIN
  graph: TYPE = [V, V -> bool]

  simple_graph(G: graph): bool =
    (FORALL (v: V): NOT G(v, v))
      AND
    (FORALL (v, w: V): G(v, w) IFF G(w, v))

  has_unique_common_neighbor(G: graph, v, w: V): bool =
    EXISTS (common: V):
      G(v, common)
        AND G(w, common)
        AND
          (FORALL (candidate: V):
            G(v, candidate) AND G(w, candidate)
              IMPLIES candidate = common)

  friendship_theorem: bool =
    is_finite_type[V]
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (G: graph):
          simple_graph(G)
            AND
              (FORALL (v, w: V):
                v /= w
                  IMPLIES has_unique_common_neighbor(G, v, w))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (politician: V):
                FORALL (other: V):
                  politician /= other
                    IMPLIES G(politician, other)
END Q5504427_friendship_theorem

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q5566491), "Glaisher's theorem": for every
  natural number n and positive natural number m, the number of partitions of
  n into parts not divisible by m equals the number of partitions in which
  every part occurs fewer than m times. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat List Sorting.

Import ListNotations.

Fixpoint q5566491_sum_parts (parts : list nat) : nat :=
  match parts with
  | [] => 0
  | part :: rest => part + q5566491_sum_parts rest
  end.

(* A nondecreasing list of positive parts canonically represents an unordered
   partition; the empty list is the unique partition of zero. *)
Definition q5566491_partition (n : nat) (parts : list nat) : Prop :=
  Forall (fun part : nat => 0 < part) parts /\
  StronglySorted le parts /\
  q5566491_sum_parts parts = n.

Definition q5566491_divides (m part : nat) : Prop :=
  exists k : nat, part = m * k.

Definition q5566491_divisibility_restricted_partition
    (n m : nat) (parts : list nat) : Prop :=
  q5566491_partition n parts /\
  Forall (fun part : nat => ~ q5566491_divides m part) parts.

Definition q5566491_count_restricted_partition
    (n m : nat) (parts : list nat) : Prop :=
  q5566491_partition n parts /\
  forall part : nat,
    In part parts ->
    count_occ Nat.eq_dec parts part < m.

Definition q5566491_has_cardinality
    (P : list nat -> Prop) (card : nat) : Prop :=
  exists enumeration : list (list nat),
    NoDup enumeration /\
    length enumeration = card /\
    forall parts : list nat,
      In parts enumeration <-> P parts.

Theorem q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem :
  forall n m : nat,
    0 < m ->
    exists card : nat,
      q5566491_has_cardinality
        (q5566491_divisibility_restricted_partition n m) card /\
      q5566491_has_cardinality
        (q5566491_count_restricted_partition n m) card.
Admitted.

title: Q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q5566491, "Glaisher's theorem": for every natural
;; number n and positive natural number m, the number of partitions of n using
;; no part divisible by m equals the number in which every part occurs fewer
;; than m times. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; This recurrence counts partitions of REMAINING using positive parts at
;; most PART that are not divisible by M. An admissible part may be omitted or
;; used repeatedly.
(defun q5566491-count-nonmultiples-through-part
    (remaining part m)
  (declare
   (xargs :measure (+ (nfix remaining) (nfix part))))
  (if (and (natp remaining)
           (natp part)
           (posp m))
      (if (zp part)
          (if (zp remaining) 1 0)
        (if (equal (mod part m) 0)
            (q5566491-count-nonmultiples-through-part
             remaining (- part 1) m)
          (if (<= part remaining)
              (+ (q5566491-count-nonmultiples-through-part
                  remaining (- part 1) m)
                 (q5566491-count-nonmultiples-through-part
                  (- remaining part) part m))
            (q5566491-count-nonmultiples-through-part
             remaining (- part 1) m))))
    0))

;; Let C(r,p) count partitions of r with parts at most p and multiplicities
;; below M. The exact coefficient recurrence
;; C(r,p) = C(r,p-1) + C(r-p,p) - C(r-M*p,p-1)
;; removes precisely the cases in which p would occur M times.
(defun q5566491-count-bounded-multiplicity-through-part
    (remaining part m)
  (declare
   (xargs :measure (+ (nfix remaining) (nfix part))))
  (if (and (natp remaining)
           (natp part)
           (posp m))
      (if (zp part)
          (if (zp remaining) 1 0)
        (let ((without-part
               (q5566491-count-bounded-multiplicity-through-part
                remaining (- part 1) m)))
          (if (<= part remaining)
              (- (+ without-part
                    (q5566491-count-bounded-multiplicity-through-part
                     (- remaining part) part m))
                 (if (<= (* m part) remaining)
                     (q5566491-count-bounded-multiplicity-through-part
                      (- remaining (* m part)) (- part 1) m)
                   0))
            without-part)))
    0))

;; Every positive part of a partition of n is at most n, so starting each
;; recurrence at PART = n enumerates the same finite partition classes as the
;; two Finsets in the canonical Lean statement.
(defun q5566491-nonmultiple-partition-count (n m)
  (if (and (natp n) (posp m))
      (q5566491-count-nonmultiples-through-part n n m)
    0))

(defun q5566491-bounded-multiplicity-partition-count (n m)
  (if (and (natp n) (posp m))
      (q5566491-count-bounded-multiplicity-through-part n n m)
    0))

(defun thousand-theorems-q5566491-glaishers-theorem-statement
    (n m)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (natp m)
        (< 0 m))
   (equal
    (q5566491-nonmultiple-partition-count n m)
    (q5566491-bounded-multiplicity-partition-count n m))))

title: Q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5566491,
-- "Glaisher's theorem": for every natural n and positive m, the number of
-- partitions of n into positive parts not divisible by m equals the number
-- in which every positive part occurs fewer than m times. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infixr 5 _++_
infixr 6 _and_

data IsTrue : Bool → Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

_++_ :
  {A : Set} →
  List A →
  List A →
  List A
[] ++ ys = ys
(x ∷ xs) ++ ys = x ∷ (xs ++ ys)

map :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → B) →
  List A →
  List B
map f [] = []
map f (x ∷ xs) = f x ∷ map f xs

concat :
  {A : Set} →
  List (List A) →
  List A
concat [] = []
concat (xs ∷ xss) = xs ++ concat xss

concatMap :
  {A B : Set} →
  (A → List B) →
  List A →
  List B
concatMap f xs = concat (map f xs)

_and_ :
  Bool →
  Bool →
  Bool
true and right = right
false and right = false

notBool :
  Bool →
  Bool
notBool true = false
notBool false = true

equalNat :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
equalNat zero zero = true
equalNat zero (suc right) = false
equalNat (suc left) zero = false
equalNat (suc left) (suc right) = equalNat left right

lessEqual :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
lessEqual zero right = true
lessEqual (suc left) zero = false
lessEqual (suc left) (suc right) = lessEqual left right

lessThan :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
lessThan left right = lessEqual (suc left) right

positive :
  Nat →
  Bool
positive zero = false
positive (suc n) = true

any :
  (Nat → Bool) →
  List Nat →
  Bool
any predicate [] = false
any predicate (x ∷ xs) with predicate x
... | true = true
... | false = any predicate xs

all :
  (Nat → Bool) →
  List Nat →
  Bool
all predicate [] = true
all predicate (x ∷ xs) =
  predicate x and all predicate xs

sum :
  List Nat →
  Nat
sum [] = zero
sum (x ∷ xs) = x + sum xs

nonIncreasing :
  List Nat →
  Bool
nonIncreasing [] = true
nonIncreasing (x ∷ []) = true
nonIncreasing (x ∷ y ∷ xs) =
  lessEqual y x and nonIncreasing (y ∷ xs)

naturalsThrough :
  Nat →
  List Nat
naturalsThrough zero = zero ∷ []
naturalsThrough (suc n) =
  suc n ∷ naturalsThrough n

divides :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Bool
divides divisor value =
  any
    (λ factor → equalNat (divisor * factor) value)
    (naturalsThrough value)

countOccurrences :
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Nat
countOccurrences value [] = zero
countOccurrences value (x ∷ xs) with equalNat value x
... | true = suc (countOccurrences value xs)
... | false = countOccurrences value xs

positivePartsUpTo :
  Nat →
  List Nat
positivePartsUpTo zero = []
positivePartsUpTo (suc n) =
  suc n ∷ positivePartsUpTo n

listsOfLength :
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  List (List Nat)
listsOfLength zero alphabet = [] ∷ []
listsOfLength (suc length) alphabet =
  concatMap
    (λ head →
      map
        (λ tail → head ∷ tail)
        (listsOfLength length alphabet))
    alphabet

listsUpToLength :
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  List (List Nat)
listsUpToLength zero alphabet = [] ∷ []
listsUpToLength (suc bound) alphabet =
  listsUpToLength bound alphabet ++
  listsOfLength (suc bound) alphabet

partitionCandidates :
  Nat →
  List (List Nat)
partitionCandidates n =
  listsUpToLength n (positivePartsUpTo n)

isNonDivisiblePartition :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Bool
isNonDivisiblePartition n m parts =
  equalNat (sum parts) n and
  (all positive parts and
   (nonIncreasing parts and
    all (λ part → notBool (divides m part)) parts))

multiplicitiesBelow :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Bool
multiplicitiesBelow n m parts =
  all
    (λ part → lessThan (countOccurrences part parts) m)
    (positivePartsUpTo n)

isMultiplicityRestrictedPartition :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  List Nat →
  Bool
isMultiplicityRestrictedPartition n m parts =
  equalNat (sum parts) n and
  (all positive parts and
   (nonIncreasing parts and multiplicitiesBelow n m parts))

countSatisfying :
  (List Nat → Bool) →
  List (List Nat) →
  Nat
countSatisfying predicate [] = zero
countSatisfying predicate (parts ∷ rest) with predicate parts
... | true = suc (countSatisfying predicate rest)
... | false = countSatisfying predicate rest

nonDivisiblePartitionCount :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
nonDivisiblePartitionCount n m =
  countSatisfying
    (isNonDivisiblePartition n m)
    (partitionCandidates n)

multiplicityRestrictedPartitionCount :
  Nat →
  Nat →
  Nat
multiplicityRestrictedPartitionCount n m =
  countSatisfying
    (isMultiplicityRestrictedPartition n m)
    (partitionCandidates n)

glaisher-s-theorem : Set
glaisher-s-theorem =
  (n m : Nat) →
  IsTrue (positive m) →
  nonDivisiblePartitionCount n m ≡
  multiplicityRestrictedPartitionCount n m

             is_partition p /\
             (!i. p i <> 0 ==> ~(divides m i))}
        in
          let multiplicity_restricted_partitions =
            {p : num -> num |
               is_partition p /\ (!i. p i < m)}
          in
            FINITE nondivisible_partitions /\
            FINITE multiplicity_restricted_partitions /\
            CARD nondivisible_partitions =
              CARD multiplicity_restricted_partitions``;

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

  function f : NN --> NN0 whose weighted sum is q. Its support
  ( `' f " NN ) is exactly the set of positive part sizes occurring in the
  partition.

  On the left, no supported part size is divisible by m. On the right, every
  positive part size has multiplicity strictly below m; outside the support
  the multiplicity is zero, and m is positive. These are respectively
  Nat.Partition.restricted q (not m divides .) and
  Nat.Partition.countRestricted q m.

  The declaration below is the single unproved $a corpus statement. This file
  introduces no $p proof statement.

${
  $d f g k m n q $.

  thousand-theorems-q5566491-glaisher $a
    |- A. q e. NN0
         A. m e. NN
           (
             ( # `
               { g e.
                 { f e. ( NN0 ^m NN ) |
                   ( ( `' f " NN ) e. Fin /\
                     ( sum_ k e. NN ( ( f ` k ) x. k ) ) = q
                   )

                 A. n e. ( `' g " NN ) -. m || n
