title: Q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5566491,
% "Glaisher's theorem": for every natural n and positive natural m, the number
% of partitions of n into parts not divisible by m equals the number in which
% every part occurs fewer than m times. This file contains no proof.

Q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  % For a fixed n, the n base-(n + 1) digits of code are the
  % multiplicities of the parts 1 through n.
  partition_sum(
      code, n, next_part, remaining_parts: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF remaining_parts = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      mod(code, n + 1) * next_part
        + partition_sum(
            ndiv(code, n + 1),
            n,
            next_part + 1,
            remaining_parts - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_parts

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  nondivisible_part_digits(
      code, n, m, next_part, remaining_parts: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining_parts = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      (NOT nat_divides(m, next_part) OR mod(code, n + 1) = 0)
        AND nondivisible_part_digits(
            ndiv(code, n + 1),
            n,
            m,
            next_part + 1,
            remaining_parts - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_parts

  bounded_multiplicity_digits(
      code, n, m, remaining_parts: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF remaining_parts = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      mod(code, n + 1) < m
        AND bounded_multiplicity_digits(
            ndiv(code, n + 1),
            n,
            m,
            remaining_parts - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE remaining_parts

  partition_code(code, n: nat): bool =
    code < (n + 1) ^ n
      AND partition_sum(code, n, 1, n) = n

  nondivisible_partition_code(code, n, m: nat): bool =
    partition_code(code, n)
      AND nondivisible_part_digits(code, n, m, 1, n)

  bounded_multiplicity_partition_code(code, n, m: nat): bool =
    partition_code(code, n)
      AND bounded_multiplicity_digits(code, n, m, n)

  count_below(limit: nat, property: [nat -> bool]): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_below(limit - 1, property)
        + IF property(limit - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  nondivisible_partition_count(n, m: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      (n + 1) ^ n,
      (LAMBDA (code: nat):
        nondivisible_partition_code(code, n, m)))

  bounded_multiplicity_partition_count(n, m: nat): nat =
    count_below(
      (n + 1) ^ n,
      (LAMBDA (code: nat):
        bounded_multiplicity_partition_code(code, n, m)))

  glaisher_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (n, m: nat):
      m > 0 IMPLIES
        nondivisible_partition_count(n, m)
          = bounded_multiplicity_partition_count(n, m)
END Q5566491_glaisher_s_theorem

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q5638886
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q5638886), "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly
-- ordered abelian group embeds injectively by an order-preserving additive homomorphism
-- into a real Hahn series while preserving each element's Archimedean class.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Module.HahnEmbedding
public import Mathlib.Analysis.RCLike.Basic

@[expose] public section

open ArchimedeanClass HahnSeries

namespace Q5638886

variable (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [LinearOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M]

/-- The Hahn embedding theorem for linearly ordered additive commutative groups. -/
theorem hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid :
    ∃ f : M →+o Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧, Function.Injective f ∧
      ∀ a, .mk a = FiniteArchimedeanClass.withTopOrderIso M (ofLex (f a)).orderTop := sorry

end Q5638886

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5638886
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q5638886), "Hahn embedding theorem": every
  linearly ordered abelian group embeds injectively by an order-preserving
  additive homomorphism into the real Hahn series indexed by its finite
  Archimedean classes, with leading class equal to the class of the source
  element. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith Wellfounded.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group (M : Type) : Type := {
  q5638886_zero : M;
  q5638886_add : M -> M -> M;
  q5638886_neg : M -> M;
  q5638886_le : M -> M -> Prop;
  q5638886_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : M,
      q5638886_add x (q5638886_add y z) =
      q5638886_add (q5638886_add x y) z;
  q5638886_add_comm :
    forall x y : M,
      q5638886_add x y = q5638886_add y x;
  q5638886_add_zero :
    forall x : M,
      q5638886_add x q5638886_zero = x;
  q5638886_add_neg :
    forall x : M,
      q5638886_add x (q5638886_neg x) = q5638886_zero;
  q5638886_le_refl :
    forall x : M, q5638886_le x x;
  q5638886_le_trans :
    forall x y z : M,
      q5638886_le x y ->
      q5638886_le y z ->
      q5638886_le x z;
  q5638886_le_antisym :
    forall x y : M,
      q5638886_le x y ->
      q5638886_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q5638886_le_total :
    forall x y : M,
      q5638886_le x y \/ q5638886_le y x;
  q5638886_add_le_add_left :
    forall x y z : M,
      q5638886_le x y ->
      q5638886_le
        (q5638886_add z x) (q5638886_add z y)
}.

Arguments q5638886_zero {M} _.
Arguments q5638886_add {M} _ _ _.
Arguments q5638886_neg {M} _ _.
Arguments q5638886_le {M} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q5638886_nsmul
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M)
    (n : nat) (x : M) : M :=
  match n with
  | O => q5638886_zero grp
  | S k => q5638886_add grp x (q5638886_nsmul grp k x)
  end.

Definition q5638886_is_abs
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M)
    (x a : M) : Prop :=
  (q5638886_le grp (q5638886_zero grp) x /\ a = x) \/
  (q5638886_le grp x (q5638886_zero grp) /\
   a = q5638886_neg grp x).

(* The order on Archimedean classes reverses domination, as in mathlib:
   [x] <= [y] exactly when |y| <= n |x| for some natural number n. *)
Definition q5638886_arch_preorder
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M)
    (x y : M) : Prop :=
  exists (n : nat) (ax ay : M),
    q5638886_is_abs grp x ax /\
    q5638886_is_abs grp y ay /\
    q5638886_le grp ay (q5638886_nsmul grp n ax).

Definition q5638886_arch_equiv
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M)
    (x y : M) : Prop :=
  q5638886_arch_preorder grp x y /\
  q5638886_arch_preorder grp y x.

(* A setoid presentation of the quotient of nonzero elements by
   Archimedean equivalence. *)
Record q5638886_finite_arch_class
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M) : Type := {
  q5638886_class_repr : M;
  q5638886_class_repr_nonzero :
    q5638886_class_repr <> q5638886_zero grp
}.

Arguments q5638886_class_repr {M grp} _.

Definition q5638886_class_equiv
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (c d : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp) : Prop :=
  q5638886_arch_equiv grp
    (q5638886_class_repr c) (q5638886_class_repr d).

Definition q5638886_class_le
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (c d : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp) : Prop :=
  q5638886_arch_preorder grp
    (q5638886_class_repr c) (q5638886_class_repr d).

Definition q5638886_class_lt
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (c d : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp) : Prop :=
  q5638886_class_le c d /\ ~ q5638886_class_le d c.

(* Real Hahn series on the quotient setoid. The coefficient function is
   invariant under class equivalence, and its support is well-founded. *)
Record q5638886_hahn_series
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M) : Type := {
  q5638886_coeff :
    q5638886_finite_arch_class grp -> R;
  q5638886_coeff_respects :
    forall c d : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
      q5638886_class_equiv c d ->
      q5638886_coeff c = q5638886_coeff d;
  q5638886_support_well_founded :
    well_founded
      (fun c d : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp =>
        q5638886_coeff c <> 0 /\
        q5638886_coeff d <> 0 /\
        q5638886_class_lt c d)
}.

Arguments q5638886_coeff {M grp} _ _.

Definition q5638886_hahn_support
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (s : q5638886_hahn_series grp)
    (c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp) : Prop :=
  q5638886_coeff s c <> 0.

Definition q5638886_hahn_equal
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (s t : q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  forall c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
    q5638886_coeff s c = q5638886_coeff t c.

Definition q5638886_hahn_zero
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (s : q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  forall c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
    q5638886_coeff s c = 0.

Definition q5638886_hahn_lt
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (s t : q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  exists i : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
    (forall j : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
      q5638886_class_lt j i ->
      q5638886_coeff s j = q5638886_coeff t j) /\
    q5638886_coeff s i < q5638886_coeff t i.

Definition q5638886_hahn_le
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (s t : q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  q5638886_hahn_equal s t \/ q5638886_hahn_lt s t.

Definition q5638886_ordered_add_monoid_hom
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M)
    (f : M -> q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  (forall c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
    q5638886_coeff (f (q5638886_zero grp)) c = 0) /\
  (forall (x y : M) (c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp),
    q5638886_coeff (f (q5638886_add grp x y)) c =
    q5638886_coeff (f x) c + q5638886_coeff (f y) c) /\
  forall x y : M,
    q5638886_le grp x y ->
    q5638886_hahn_le (f x) (f y).

Definition q5638886_injective
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (f : M -> q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  forall x y : M,
    q5638886_hahn_equal (f x) (f y) ->
    x = y.

Definition q5638886_minimal_support_class
    {M : Type}
    {grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M}
    (s : q5638886_hahn_series grp)
    (c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp) : Prop :=
  q5638886_hahn_support s c /\
  forall d : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
    q5638886_hahn_support s d ->
    q5638886_class_le c d.

(* This is the setoid expansion of
   mk(a) = withTopOrderIso(orderTop(s)): zero support represents top, while
   nonzero support is represented by its least finite Archimedean class. *)
Definition q5638886_leading_class_matches
    {M : Type}
    (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M)
    (a : M)
    (s : q5638886_hahn_series grp) : Prop :=
  (q5638886_hahn_zero s /\
   q5638886_arch_equiv grp a (q5638886_zero grp)) \/
  exists c : q5638886_finite_arch_class grp,
    q5638886_minimal_support_class s c /\
    q5638886_arch_equiv grp a (q5638886_class_repr c).

Theorem hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid :
  forall (M : Type)
         (grp : q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group M),
    exists f : M -> q5638886_hahn_series grp,
      @q5638886_ordered_add_monoid_hom M grp f /\
      @q5638886_injective M grp f /\
      forall a : M,
        @q5638886_leading_class_matches M grp a (f a).
Admitted.

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5638886,
  "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly ordered abelian group embeds
  injectively and order-preservingly into the lexicographically ordered group
  of real Hahn series indexed by its nonzero Archimedean classes, preserving
  the Archimedean class of every element. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

primrec q5638886_nsmult ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::linordered_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q5638886_nsmult 0 a = 0"
| "q5638886_nsmult (Suc n) a = q5638886_nsmult n a + a"

definition q5638886_abs ::
    "'a::linordered_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q5638886_abs a = (if 0 \<le> a then a else -a)"

definition q5638886_arch_equiv ::
    "'a::linordered_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_arch_equiv a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>m. q5638886_abs b \<le> q5638886_nsmult m (q5638886_abs a)) \<and>
    (\<exists>n. q5638886_abs a \<le> q5638886_nsmult n (q5638886_abs b))"

definition q5638886_arch_class ::
    "'a::linordered_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q5638886_arch_class a = {b. q5638886_arch_equiv a b}"

definition q5638886_finite_arch_classes ::
    "'a::linordered_ab_group_add set set" where
  "q5638886_finite_arch_classes =
    q5638886_arch_class ` {a. a \<noteq> 0}"

definition q5638886_arch_class_le ::
    "'a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_arch_class_le A B \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>a b.
      a \<noteq> 0 \<and> b \<noteq> 0 \<and>
      A = q5638886_arch_class a \<and>
      B = q5638886_arch_class b \<and>
      (\<exists>n.
        q5638886_abs b \<le> q5638886_nsmult n (q5638886_abs a)))"

definition q5638886_support ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set set" where
  "q5638886_support x =
    {A \<in> q5638886_finite_arch_classes. x A \<noteq> 0}"

definition q5638886_well_ordered_support ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_well_ordered_support x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>S.
      S \<subseteq> q5638886_support x \<longrightarrow>
      S \<noteq> {} \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>A \<in> S. \<forall>B \<in> S. q5638886_arch_class_le A B))"

definition q5638886_hahn_series ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_hahn_series x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>A. A \<notin> q5638886_finite_arch_classes \<longrightarrow> x A = 0) \<and>
    q5638886_well_ordered_support x"

definition q5638886_is_leading_class ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      'a set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_is_leading_class x A \<longleftrightarrow>
    A \<in> q5638886_support x \<and>
    (\<forall>B \<in> q5638886_support x. q5638886_arch_class_le A B)"

definition q5638886_leading_arch_class ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a set" where
  "q5638886_leading_arch_class x =
    (if x = (\<lambda>_. 0)
     then q5638886_arch_class 0
     else (THE A. q5638886_is_leading_class x A))"

definition q5638886_lex_le ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_lex_le x y \<longleftrightarrow>
    q5638886_hahn_series x \<and>
    q5638886_hahn_series y \<and>
    (x = y \<or>
      (\<exists>A.
        q5638886_is_leading_class (\<lambda>B. y B - x B) A \<and>
        x A < y A))"

definition q5638886_is_order_add_monoid_hom ::
    "('a::linordered_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q5638886_is_order_add_monoid_hom f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a. q5638886_hahn_series (f a)) \<and>
    f 0 = (\<lambda>_. 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b A. f (a + b) A = f a A + f b A) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b. a \<le> b \<longrightarrow> q5638886_lex_le (f a) (f b))"

theorem hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid:
  "\<exists>f :: 'a::linordered_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> real.
    q5638886_is_order_add_monoid_hom f \<and>
    inj f \<and>
    (\<forall>a. q5638886_arch_class a = q5638886_leading_arch_class (f a))"
  sorry

end

let Q5638886_HAHN_EMBEDDING_THEOREM =
  `let group_abs =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool) (x:A).
       if le (group_id G) x then x else group_neg G x in
   let is_linearly_ordered_abelian_group =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool).
       group_carrier G = (:A) /\
       abelian_group G /\
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y \/ le y x) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          le x y
          ==> le (group_add G z x) (group_add G z y)) in
   let archimedean_le =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool) (x:A) (y:A).
       ?n:num.
         le (group_abs G le y)
            (group_nmul G n (group_abs G le x)) in
   let archimedean_equiv =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool) (x:A) (y:A).
       archimedean_le G le x y /\
       archimedean_le G le y x in
   let archimedean_class =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool) (x:A).
       {y:A | archimedean_equiv G le x y} in
   let finite_archimedean_class =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool) (C:A->bool).
       ?x:A.
         ~(x = group_id G) /\
         C = archimedean_class G le x in
   let class_le =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (C:A->bool) (D:A->bool).
       ?x y:A.
         ~(x = group_id G) /\
         ~(y = group_id G) /\
         C = archimedean_class G le x /\
         D = archimedean_class G le y /\
         archimedean_le G le x y in
   let class_lt =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (C:A->bool) (D:A->bool).
       class_le G le C D /\ ~(class_le G le D C) in
   let hahn_support =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (s:(A->bool)->real).
       {C:A->bool |
          finite_archimedean_class G le C /\ ~(s C = &0)} in
   let well_ordered_support =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (s:(A->bool)->real).
       !U:(A->bool)->bool.
         U SUBSET hahn_support G le s /\ ~(U = {})
         ==> ?C:A->bool.
               C IN U /\
               !D:A->bool. D IN U ==> class_le G le C D in
   let is_hahn_series =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (s:(A->bool)->real).
       (!C:A->bool.
          ~(finite_archimedean_class G le C)
          ==> s C = &0) /\
       well_ordered_support G le s in
   let hahn_lt =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (s:(A->bool)->real) (t:(A->bool)->real).
       ?C:A->bool.
         finite_archimedean_class G le C /\
         (!D:A->bool.
            finite_archimedean_class G le D /\
            class_lt G le D C
            ==> s D = t D) /\
         s C < t C in
   let hahn_le =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (s:(A->bool)->real) (t:(A->bool)->real).
       s = t \/ hahn_lt G le s t in
   let leading_class_agrees =
     \(G:A group) (le:A->A->bool)
      (s:(A->bool)->real) (a:A).
       if a = group_id G then
         !C:A->bool. s C = &0
       else
         let C = archimedean_class G le a in
         finite_archimedean_class G le C /\
         ~(s C = &0) /\
         !D:A->bool.
           finite_archimedean_class G le D /\
           class_lt G le D C
           ==> s D = &0 in
   !G:A group. !le:A->A->bool.
     is_linearly_ordered_abelian_group G le
     ==> ?f:A->(A->bool)->real.
           (!x:A. is_hahn_series G le (f x)) /\
           (!C:A->bool. f (group_id G) C = &0) /\
           (!x y:A. !C:A->bool.
              f (group_add G x y) C = f x C + f y C) /\
           (!x y:A.
              le x y ==> hahn_le G le (f x) (f y)) /\
           (!x y:A. f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
           (!a:A. leading_class_agrees G le (f a) a)`;;

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5638886,
;; "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly ordered abelian group embeds
;; injectively and additively into the lexicographically ordered real Hahn
;; series on its finite Archimedean classes, preserving Archimedean class as
;; the least nonzero coefficient index. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Structure tags index arbitrary carriers.  Every group, ordered-field,
;; quotient, support, and embedding law used below is explicit in the final
;; predicate.

(defstub q5638886-m-member-p (group value) t)
(defstub q5638886-m-zero (group) t)
(defstub q5638886-m-add (group left right) t)
(defstub q5638886-m-negate (group value) t)
(defstub q5638886-m-leq (group left right) t)

(defstub q5638886-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q5638886-r-leq (real left right) t)

(defun q5638886-unary-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun q5638886-m-abs (group value)
  (if (q5638886-m-leq group (q5638886-m-zero group) value)
      value
    (q5638886-m-negate group value)))

(defun q5638886-m-nsmul (group n value)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q5638886-m-zero group)
    (q5638886-m-add
     group
     value
     (q5638886-m-nsmul group (1- n) value))))

(defun q5638886-r-nat (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q5638886-r-zero real)
    (q5638886-r-add
     real
     (q5638886-r-one real)
     (q5638886-r-nat real (1- n)))))

(defun q5638886-r-less (real left right)
  (and
   (q5638886-r-leq real left right)
   (not (equal left right))))

;; The source domain is an arbitrary linearly ordered additive commutative
;; group.

(defun-sk q5638886-ordered-abelian-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q5638886-m-member-p group x)
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p
        group (q5638886-m-negate group x))
       (equal
        (q5638886-m-add group x (q5638886-m-zero group))
        x)
       (equal
        (q5638886-m-add group (q5638886-m-zero group) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q5638886-m-add
         group x (q5638886-m-negate group x))
        (q5638886-m-zero group))
       (equal
        (q5638886-m-add
         group (q5638886-m-negate group x) x)
        (q5638886-m-zero group))
       (q5638886-m-leq group x x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p group x)
       (q5638886-m-member-p group y))
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p
        group (q5638886-m-add group x y))
       (equal
        (q5638886-m-add group x y)
        (q5638886-m-add group y x))
       (or
        (q5638886-m-leq group x y)
        (q5638886-m-leq group y x))
       (implies
        (and
         (q5638886-m-leq group x y)
         (q5638886-m-leq group y x))
        (equal x y))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p group x)
       (q5638886-m-member-p group y)
       (q5638886-m-member-p group z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q5638886-m-add
         group
         (q5638886-m-add group x y)
         z)
        (q5638886-m-add
         group
         x
         (q5638886-m-add group y z)))
       (implies
        (and
         (q5638886-m-leq group x y)
         (q5638886-m-leq group y z))
        (q5638886-m-leq group x z))
       (implies
        (q5638886-m-leq group x y)
        (q5638886-m-leq
         group
         (q5638886-m-add group z x)
         (q5638886-m-add group z y))))))))

(defun q5638886-ordered-abelian-group-p (group)
  (and
   (q5638886-m-member-p group (q5638886-m-zero group))
   (q5638886-ordered-abelian-group-laws-p group)))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field is a presentation of the real field.

(defun-sk q5638886-real-field-algebra-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-r-member-p real x)
      (q5638886-r-member-p real y)
      (q5638886-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q5638886-r-zero real))
           (one (q5638886-r-one real)))
       (and
        (q5638886-r-member-p
         real (q5638886-r-add real x y))
        (q5638886-r-member-p
         real (q5638886-r-multiply real x y))
        (q5638886-r-member-p
         real (q5638886-r-negate real x))
        (q5638886-r-member-p
         real (q5638886-r-inverse real x))
        (equal
         (q5638886-r-add
          real (q5638886-r-add real x y) z)
         (q5638886-r-add
          real x (q5638886-r-add real y z)))
        (equal
         (q5638886-r-add real x y)
         (q5638886-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q5638886-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q5638886-r-add
          real x (q5638886-r-negate real x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q5638886-r-multiply
          real (q5638886-r-multiply real x y) z)
         (q5638886-r-multiply
          real x (q5638886-r-multiply real y z)))
        (equal
         (q5638886-r-multiply real x y)
         (q5638886-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q5638886-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q5638886-r-multiply real x zero) zero)
        (equal (q5638886-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q5638886-r-multiply
           real x (q5638886-r-inverse real x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q5638886-r-multiply
          real x (q5638886-r-add real y z))
         (q5638886-r-add
          real
          (q5638886-r-multiply real x y)
          (q5638886-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-field-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-r-member-p real x)
      (q5638886-r-member-p real y)
      (q5638886-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q5638886-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (q5638886-r-leq real x x)
        (implies
         (and
          (q5638886-r-leq real x y)
          (q5638886-r-leq real y z))
         (q5638886-r-leq real x z))
        (implies
         (and
          (q5638886-r-leq real x y)
          (q5638886-r-leq real y x))
         (equal x y))
        (or
         (q5638886-r-leq real x y)
         (q5638886-r-leq real y x))
        (implies
         (q5638886-r-leq real x y)
         (q5638886-r-leq
          real
          (q5638886-r-add real z x)
          (q5638886-r-add real z y)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q5638886-r-leq real zero x)
          (q5638886-r-leq real zero y))
         (q5638886-r-leq
          real
          zero
          (q5638886-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q5638886-r-member-p real x)
     (q5638886-unary-value set x))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-upper-bound-p (real set upper)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-r-member-p real x)
      (q5638886-unary-value set x))
     (q5638886-r-leq real x upper))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-upper-bound-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (upper)
    (and
     (q5638886-r-member-p real upper)
     (q5638886-real-upper-bound-p real set upper))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-least-upper-bound-p
    (real set supremum)
  (forall (upper)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-r-member-p real upper)
      (q5638886-real-upper-bound-p real set upper))
     (q5638886-r-leq real supremum upper))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (and
     (q5638886-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q5638886-real-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (q5638886-real-least-upper-bound-p
      real set supremum))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp set)
      (q5638886-real-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q5638886-real-upper-bound-exists-p real set))
     (q5638886-real-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-archimedean-bound-exists-p
    (real x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q5638886-r-leq real x (q5638886-r-nat real n)))))

(defun-sk q5638886-real-archimedean-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q5638886-r-member-p real x)
     (q5638886-real-archimedean-bound-exists-p real x))))

(defun q5638886-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q5638886-r-zero real))
        (one (q5638886-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q5638886-r-member-p real zero)
     (q5638886-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q5638886-r-less real zero one)
     (q5638886-real-field-algebra-laws-p real)
     (q5638886-real-field-order-laws-p real)
     (q5638886-real-complete-p real)
     (q5638886-real-archimedean-p real))))

;; Finite Archimedean classes are presented by nonzero group elements modulo
;; mutual domination.  The order is the source order: A <= B when a natural
;; multiple of a representative of A dominates a representative of B.

(defun-sk q5638886-class-leq-p (group left right)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q5638886-m-leq
      group
      (q5638886-m-abs group right)
      (q5638886-m-nsmul
       group n (q5638886-m-abs group left))))))

(defun q5638886-class-equivalent-p (group left right)
  (and
   (q5638886-class-leq-p group left right)
   (q5638886-class-leq-p group right left)))

(defun q5638886-class-less-p (group left right)
  (and
   (q5638886-class-leq-p group left right)
   (not (q5638886-class-leq-p group right left))))

;; A real Hahn series on the quotient of nonzero elements by Archimedean
;; equivalence is represented by a tame coefficient function on nonzero
;; representatives, constant on each equivalence class.

(defun q5638886-coeff (series index)
  (q5638886-unary-value series index))

(defun q5638886-support-member-p (real series index)
  (not
   (equal
    (q5638886-coeff series index)
    (q5638886-r-zero real))))

(defun-sk q5638886-series-coefficient-laws-p
    (group real series)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p group left)
       (not (equal left (q5638886-m-zero group))))
      (q5638886-r-member-p
       real (q5638886-coeff series left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p group left)
       (q5638886-m-member-p group right)
       (not (equal left (q5638886-m-zero group)))
       (not (equal right (q5638886-m-zero group)))
       (q5638886-class-equivalent-p group left right))
      (equal
       (q5638886-coeff series left)
       (q5638886-coeff series right))))))

(defun-sk q5638886-support-subset-laws-p
    (group real series subset)
  (forall (left right)
    (and
     (implies
      (q5638886-unary-value subset left)
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p group left)
       (not (equal left (q5638886-m-zero group)))
       (q5638886-support-member-p real series left)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q5638886-m-member-p group left)
       (q5638886-m-member-p group right)
       (not (equal left (q5638886-m-zero group)))
       (not (equal right (q5638886-m-zero group)))
       (q5638886-class-equivalent-p group left right))
      (iff
       (q5638886-unary-value subset left)
       (q5638886-unary-value subset right))))))

(defun-sk q5638886-support-subset-nonempty-p (subset)
  (exists (index)
    (q5638886-unary-value subset index)))

(defun-sk q5638886-support-subset-least-p
    (group subset least)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q5638886-unary-value subset index)
     (q5638886-class-leq-p group least index))))

(defun-sk q5638886-support-subset-least-exists-p
    (group subset)
  (exists (least)
    (and
     (q5638886-unary-value subset least)
     (q5638886-support-subset-least-p
      group subset least))))

(defun-sk q5638886-support-well-ordered-p
    (group real series)
  (forall (subset)
    (implies
     (and
      (tamep-functionp subset)
      (q5638886-support-subset-laws-p
       group real series subset)
      (q5638886-support-subset-nonempty-p subset))
     (q5638886-support-subset-least-exists-p
      group subset))))

(defun q5638886-hahn-series-p (group real series)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp series)
   (q5638886-series-coefficient-laws-p
    group real series)
   (q5638886-support-well-ordered-p
    group real series)))

;; Extensional equality and the lexicographic order are defined directly on
;; the quotient-indexed coefficient functions.

(defun-sk q5638886-series-equal-p (group left right)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-m-member-p group index)
      (not (equal index (q5638886-m-zero group))))
     (equal
      (q5638886-coeff left index)
      (q5638886-coeff right index)))))

(defun-sk q5638886-series-equal-below-p
    (group left right pivot)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-m-member-p group index)
      (not (equal index (q5638886-m-zero group)))
      (q5638886-class-less-p group index pivot))
     (equal
      (q5638886-coeff left index)
      (q5638886-coeff right index)))))

(defun-sk q5638886-hahn-less-p
    (group real left right)
  (exists (pivot)
    (and
     (q5638886-m-member-p group pivot)
     (not (equal pivot (q5638886-m-zero group)))
     (q5638886-series-equal-below-p
      group left right pivot)
     (q5638886-r-less
      real
      (q5638886-coeff left pivot)
      (q5638886-coeff right pivot)))))

(defun q5638886-hahn-leq-p (group real left right)
  (or
   (q5638886-series-equal-p group left right)
   (q5638886-hahn-less-p group real left right)))

(defun-sk q5638886-zero-series-p (group real series)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-m-member-p group index)
      (not (equal index (q5638886-m-zero group))))
     (equal
      (q5638886-coeff series index)
      (q5638886-r-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q5638886-series-sum-p
    (group real left right sum)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-m-member-p group index)
      (not (equal index (q5638886-m-zero group))))
     (equal
      (q5638886-coeff sum index)
      (q5638886-r-add
       real
       (q5638886-coeff left index)
       (q5638886-coeff right index))))))

;; ORDER-TOP equals the class of A exactly when the A-coordinate is nonzero
;; and that class is below every support class.  The zero series has top
;; order, matching the Archimedean class of the group zero.

(defun-sk q5638886-support-minimum-class-p
    (group real series representative)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-m-member-p group index)
      (not (equal index (q5638886-m-zero group)))
      (q5638886-support-member-p real series index))
     (q5638886-class-leq-p
      group representative index))))

(defun q5638886-preserves-archimedean-class-p
    (group real series value)
  (if (equal value (q5638886-m-zero group))
      (q5638886-zero-series-p group real series)
    (and
     (q5638886-support-member-p real series value)
     (q5638886-support-minimum-class-p
      group real series value))))

;; These are precisely the carrier, zero, addition, monotonicity,
;; injectivity, and class-preservation fields of the required injective
;; OrderAddMonoidHom.

(defun-sk q5638886-embedding-laws-p
    (group real embedding)
  (forall (x y)
    (let ((fx (q5638886-unary-value embedding x))
          (fy (q5638886-unary-value embedding y)))
      (and
       (implies
        (q5638886-m-member-p group x)
        (and
         (q5638886-hahn-series-p group real fx)
         (q5638886-preserves-archimedean-class-p
          group real fx x)))
       (implies
        (and
         (q5638886-m-member-p group x)
         (q5638886-m-member-p group y))
        (and
         (q5638886-series-sum-p
          group
          real
          fx
          fy
          (q5638886-unary-value
           embedding
           (q5638886-m-add group x y)))
         (implies
          (q5638886-m-leq group x y)
          (q5638886-hahn-leq-p
           group real fx fy))
         (implies
          (q5638886-series-equal-p group fx fy)
          (equal x y))))))))

(defun q5638886-hahn-embedding-p
    (group real embedding)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp embedding)
   (q5638886-zero-series-p
    group
    real
    (q5638886-unary-value
     embedding (q5638886-m-zero group)))
   (q5638886-embedding-laws-p
    group real embedding)))

(defun-sk q5638886-hahn-embedding-exists-p (group real)
  (exists (embedding)
    (q5638886-hahn-embedding-p
     group real embedding)))

(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q5638886-hahn-embedding-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall (group real)
    (implies
     (and
      (q5638886-ordered-abelian-group-p group)
      (q5638886-real-field-p real))
     (q5638886-hahn-embedding-exists-p group real))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5638886,
-- "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly ordered abelian group has an
-- injective order-preserving additive embedding into the lexicographically
-- ordered group of real Hahn series indexed by its nonzero finite
-- Archimedean classes, with each nonzero element's class equal to the leading
-- index of its image. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat) renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

data Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  inhabitant : Top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record OrderedAbelianGroup
  {a : Level}
  (M : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    zeroM :
      M

    addM :
      M ->
      M ->
      M

    negateM :
      M ->
      M

    lessOrEqualM :
      M ->
      M ->
      Set a

    absoluteValueM :
      M ->
      M

    add-associativeM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      addM (addM x y) z ≡ addM x (addM y z)

    add-commutativeM :
      (x y : M) ->
      addM x y ≡ addM y x

    add-zeroM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x zeroM ≡ x

    add-inverseM :
      (x : M) ->
      addM x (negateM x) ≡ zeroM

    order-propositionalM :
      (x y : M) ->
      (p q : lessOrEqualM x y) ->
      p ≡ q

    order-reflexiveM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x x

    order-transitiveM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y z ->
      lessOrEqualM x z

    order-antisymmetricM :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM y x ->
      x ≡ y

    order-totalM :
      (x y : M) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualM x y) (lessOrEqualM y x)

    add-orderM :
      (x y z : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x y ->
      lessOrEqualM (addM z x) (addM z y)

    absolute-upper-positiveM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM x (absoluteValueM x)

    absolute-upper-negativeM :
      (x : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM (negateM x) (absoluteValueM x)

    absolute-choiceM :
      (x : M) ->
      Either
        (absoluteValueM x ≡ x)
        (absoluteValueM x ≡ negateM x)

open OrderedAbelianGroup

naturalMultiple :
  {a : Level} ->
  {M : Set a} ->
  OrderedAbelianGroup M ->
  Nat ->
  M ->
  M
naturalMultiple group zeroN x =
  zeroM group
naturalMultiple group (sucN n) x =
  addM group x (naturalMultiple group n x)

ArchimedeanClassLessOrEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {M : Set a} ->
  OrderedAbelianGroup M ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set a
ArchimedeanClassLessOrEqual group x y =
  Exists Nat
    (\ n ->
      lessOrEqualM group
        (absoluteValueM group y)
        (naturalMultiple group n (absoluteValueM group x)))

ArchimedeanEquivalent :
  {a : Level} ->
  {M : Set a} ->
  OrderedAbelianGroup M ->
  M ->
  M ->
  Set a
ArchimedeanEquivalent group x y =
  ArchimedeanClassLessOrEqual group x y
  ×
  ArchimedeanClassLessOrEqual group y x

-- This is an exact quotient presentation of the nonzero finite
-- Archimedean classes.  The order criterion has the same orientation as
-- FiniteArchimedeanClass: [x] <= [y] iff |y| <= n |x| for some natural n.
record FiniteArchimedeanClasses
  {a c : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  (group : OrderedAbelianGroup M)
  (Class : Set c) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ c)) where

  field
    classOf :
      (x : M) ->
      x ≠ zeroM group ->
      Class

    classLessOrEqual :
      Class ->
      Class ->
      Set (a ⊔ c)

    class-order-propositional :
      (x y : Class) ->
      (p q : classLessOrEqual x y) ->
      p ≡ q

    class-order-reflexive :
      (x : Class) ->
      classLessOrEqual x x

    class-order-transitive :
      (x y z : Class) ->
      classLessOrEqual x y ->
      classLessOrEqual y z ->
      classLessOrEqual x z

    class-order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : Class) ->
      classLessOrEqual x y ->
      classLessOrEqual y x ->
      x ≡ y

    class-order-total :
      (x y : Class) ->
      Either
        (classLessOrEqual x y)
        (classLessOrEqual y x)

    classOf-proof-independent :
      (x : M) ->
      (p q : x ≠ zeroM group) ->
      classOf x p ≡ classOf x q

    classOf-equality :
      (x y : M) ->
      (x-nonzero : x ≠ zeroM group) ->
      (y-nonzero : y ≠ zeroM group) ->
      Iff
        (classOf x x-nonzero ≡ classOf y y-nonzero)
        (ArchimedeanEquivalent group x y)

    classOf-order :
      (x y : M) ->
      (x-nonzero : x ≠ zeroM group) ->
      (y-nonzero : y ≠ zeroM group) ->
      Iff
        (classLessOrEqual
          (classOf x x-nonzero)
          (classOf y y-nonzero))
        (ArchimedeanClassLessOrEqual group x y)

    representative :
      Class ->
      M

    representative-nonzero :
      (class : Class) ->
      representative class ≠ zeroM group

    representative-class :
      (class : Class) ->
      classOf
        (representative class)
        (representative-nonzero class)
      ≡ class

open FiniteArchimedeanClasses

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X -> Set a

-- A complete Archimedean ordered field is a presentation of the real line.
record RealLine
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set a

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡ multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR ≡ zeroR

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x ≠ zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) ≡ oneR

    order-propositionalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      (p q : lessOrEqualR x y) ->
      p ≡ q

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x ≡ y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR × zeroR ≠ oneR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zeroN ≡ zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (sucN n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n ->
      m ≡ n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set a) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          ×
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open RealLine

StrictLess :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> A -> Set a) ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
StrictLess lessOrEqual x y =
  lessOrEqual x y × x ≠ y

ClassStrictLess :
  {a c : Level} ->
  {M : Set a} ->
  {Class : Set c} ->
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M} ->
  FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class ->
  Class ->
  Class ->
  Set (a ⊔ c)
ClassStrictLess classes x y =
  classLessOrEqual classes x y × x ≠ y

data AccessibleOn
  {c q s : Level}
  {Class : Set c}
  (less : Class -> Class -> Set q)
  (support : Class -> Set s)
  (x : Class) :
  Set (c ⊔ q ⊔ s) where

  accessible :
    ((y : Class) ->
      support y ->
      less y x ->
      AccessibleOn less support y) ->
    AccessibleOn less support x

WellFoundedOn :
  {c q s : Level} ->
  {Class : Set c} ->
  (Class -> Class -> Set q) ->
  (Class -> Set s) ->
  Set (c ⊔ q ⊔ s)
WellFoundedOn {Class = Class} less support =
  (x : Class) ->
  support x ->
  AccessibleOn less support x

record HahnSeries
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class)
  (reals : RealLine R) :
  Set (a ⊔ c ⊔ r) where

  field
    coefficient :
      Class ->
      R

    support-well-founded :
      WellFoundedOn
        (ClassStrictLess classes)
        (\ class -> coefficient class ≠ zeroR reals)

open HahnSeries

SeriesEqual :
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  {classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class}
  {reals : RealLine R} ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  Set (c ⊔ r)
SeriesEqual {Class = Class} x y =
  (class : Class) ->
  coefficient x class ≡ coefficient y class

LexicographicallyLess :
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class)
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  Set (a ⊔ c ⊔ r)
LexicographicallyLess {Class = Class} classes reals x y =
  Exists Class
    (\ leading ->
      (((earlier : Class) ->
        ClassStrictLess classes earlier leading ->
        coefficient x earlier ≡ coefficient y earlier)
      ×
      StrictLess
        (lessOrEqualR reals)
        (coefficient x leading)
        (coefficient y leading)))

LexicographicallyLessOrEqual :
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class)
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  Set (a ⊔ c ⊔ r)
LexicographicallyLessOrEqual classes reals x y =
  Either
    (SeriesEqual x y)
    (LexicographicallyLess classes reals x y)

data WithTop
  {c : Level}
  (Class : Set c) :
  Set c where

  finite : Class -> WithTop Class
  top    : WithTop Class

LeadingIndex :
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class)
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  WithTop Class ->
  Set (a ⊔ c ⊔ r)
LeadingIndex {Class = Class} classes reals series (finite leading) =
  (coefficient series leading ≠ zeroR reals)
  ×
  ((class : Class) ->
    coefficient series class ≠ zeroR reals ->
    classLessOrEqual classes leading class)
LeadingIndex {a = a} {Class = Class} classes reals series top =
  ((class : Class) ->
    coefficient series class ≡ zeroR reals)
  ×
  Top {a}

SourceClass :
  {a c : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class) ->
  M ->
  WithTop Class ->
  Set (a ⊔ c)
SourceClass {group = group} classes x (finite class) =
  Exists (x ≠ zeroM group)
    (\ x-nonzero ->
      classOf classes x x-nonzero ≡ class)
SourceClass {c = c} {group = group} classes x top =
  (x ≡ zeroM group) × Top {c}

HasMatchingLeadingClass :
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  {group : OrderedAbelianGroup M}
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class)
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  M ->
  HahnSeries classes reals ->
  Set (a ⊔ c ⊔ r)
HasMatchingLeadingClass {Class = Class} classes reals x series =
  Exists (WithTop Class)
    (\ leading ->
      LeadingIndex classes reals series leading
      ×
      SourceClass classes x leading)

record IsOrderedAdditiveEmbedding
  {a c r : Level}
  {M : Set a}
  {Class : Set c}
  {R : Set r}
  (group : OrderedAbelianGroup M)
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class)
  (reals : RealLine R)
  (embedding : M -> HahnSeries classes reals) :
  Set (a ⊔ c ⊔ r) where

  field
    map-zero :
      (class : Class) ->
      coefficient (embedding (zeroM group)) class ≡ zeroR reals

    map-add :
      (x y : M) ->
      (class : Class) ->
      coefficient (embedding (addM group x y)) class
      ≡
      addR reals
        (coefficient (embedding x) class)
        (coefficient (embedding y) class)

    order-preserving :
      (x y : M) ->
      lessOrEqualM group x y ->
      LexicographicallyLessOrEqual
        classes reals (embedding x) (embedding y)

    injective :
      (x y : M) ->
      SeriesEqual (embedding x) (embedding y) ->
      x ≡ y

hahnEmbedding-isOrderedAddMonoid :
  {a c r : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ c ⊔ r))
hahnEmbedding-isOrderedAddMonoid {a} {c} {r} =
  (M : Set a) ->
  (group : OrderedAbelianGroup M) ->
  (Class : Set c) ->
  (classes : FiniteArchimedeanClasses group Class) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (reals : RealLine R) ->
  Exists (M -> HahnSeries classes reals)
    (\ embedding ->
      IsOrderedAdditiveEmbedding group classes reals embedding
      ×
      ((x : M) ->
        HasMatchingLeadingClass classes reals x (embedding x)))

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q5638886, "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly ordered abelian group
  embeds additively and order-preservingly into the real Hahn series indexed
  by its nonzero Archimedean classes, with matching leading class. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory;

val q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x /\ add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero /\ add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y ==> leq (add z x) (add z y))``);

val q5638886_abs_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_abs_def",
  ``q5638886_abs zero neg leq (x : 'a) =
      if leq zero x then x else neg x``);

val q5638886_nsmul_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_nsmul_def",
  ``q5638886_nsmul zero add (n : num) (x : 'a) =
      FUNPOW (add x) n zero``);

val q5638886_dominated_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_dominated_def",
  ``q5638886_dominated zero neg add leq (x : 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      ?n : num.
        leq (q5638886_abs zero neg leq x)
            (q5638886_nsmul zero add n
              (q5638886_abs zero neg leq y))``);

val q5638886_arch_equiv_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_arch_equiv_def",
  ``q5638886_arch_equiv zero neg add leq (x : 'a) (y : 'a) <=>
      q5638886_dominated zero neg add leq x y /\
      q5638886_dominated zero neg add leq y x``);

val q5638886_arch_class_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_arch_class_def",
  ``q5638886_arch_class zero neg add leq (x : 'a) =
      {y | q5638886_arch_equiv zero neg add leq x y}``);

val q5638886_finite_arch_class_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_finite_arch_class_def",
  ``q5638886_finite_arch_class zero neg add leq (C : 'a set) <=>
      ?x : 'a.
        x <> zero /\
        C = q5638886_arch_class zero neg add leq x``);

val q5638886_arch_class_le_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_arch_class_le_def",
  ``q5638886_arch_class_le zero neg add leq
      (C : 'a set) (D : 'a set) <=>
      ?x y : 'a.
        x IN C /\
        y IN D /\
        q5638886_dominated zero neg add leq y x``);

val q5638886_arch_class_lt_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_arch_class_lt_def",
  ``q5638886_arch_class_lt zero neg add leq
      (C : 'a set) (D : 'a set) <=>
      q5638886_arch_class_le zero neg add leq C D /\
      C <> D``);

val q5638886_hahn_series_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_hahn_series_def",
  ``q5638886_hahn_series zero neg add leq
      (s : 'a set -> real) <=>
      (!C : 'a set.
        ~q5638886_finite_arch_class zero neg add leq C
        ==>
        s C = 0) /\
      !u : ('a set) set.
        u SUBSET
          {C |
            q5638886_finite_arch_class zero neg add leq C /\
            s C <> 0} /\
        u <> {}
        ==>
        ?C : 'a set.
          C IN u /\
          !D : 'a set.
            D IN u
            ==>
            q5638886_arch_class_le zero neg add leq C D``);

val q5638886_lex_le_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_lex_le_def",
  ``q5638886_lex_le zero neg add leq
      (s : 'a set -> real) (t : 'a set -> real) <=>
      s = t \/
      ?C : 'a set.
        q5638886_finite_arch_class zero neg add leq C /\
        s C < t C /\
        !D : 'a set.
          q5638886_finite_arch_class zero neg add leq D /\
          q5638886_arch_class_lt zero neg add leq D C
          ==>
          s D = t D``);

val q5638886_leading_class_matches_def = new_definition (
  "q5638886_leading_class_matches_def",
  ``q5638886_leading_class_matches zero neg add leq
      (a : 'a) (s : 'a set -> real) <=>
      if a = zero then
        !C : 'a set. s C = 0
      else
        s (q5638886_arch_class zero neg add leq a) <> 0 /\
        !D : 'a set.
          q5638886_finite_arch_class zero neg add leq D /\
          q5638886_arch_class_lt zero neg add leq D
            (q5638886_arch_class zero neg add leq a)
          ==>
          s D = 0``);

val hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid =
  ``!(zero : 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool).
      q5638886_ordered_add_comm_group zero neg add leq
      ==>
      ?f : 'a -> ('a set -> real).
        (!x : 'a. q5638886_hahn_series zero neg add leq (f x)) /\
        (!C : 'a set. f zero C = 0) /\
        (!x y : 'a. !C : 'a set.
          f (add x y) C = f x C + f y C) /\
        (!x y : 'a.
          leq x y
          ==>
          q5638886_lex_le zero neg add leq (f x) (f y)) /\
        (!x y : 'a. f x = f y ==> x = y) /\
        !a : 'a.
          q5638886_leading_class_matches zero neg add leq a (f a)``;

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5638886
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q5638886), "Hahn embedding theorem": every
  linearly ordered abelian group admits an injective order-preserving additive
  homomorphism into the lexicographically ordered group of real Hahn series
  indexed by its finite Archimedean classes, with each element's class equal
  to the least support index of its image. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  G e. Abel and G e. oGrp retain the arbitrary bundled linearly ordered
  abelian group of the Lean statement. Q5638886Abs and Q5638886NatMul use
  G's actual inverse and addition operations. Q5638886Dominates G a b says
  that |b| is bounded above by a natural multiple of |a|. The symmetric
  closure Q5638886ArchEq is Archimedean equivalence, and
  Q5638886ArchClass G a is the actual equivalence-class subset of Base ` G.

  Q5638886FiniteClasses G is exactly the set of Archimedean classes having a
  nonzero representative. Q5638886ClassLe uses the standard reverse-growth
  order: [a] <= [b] when |b| is bounded by a natural multiple of |a|.

  Q5638886Hahn G is the full set of real-valued functions on those classes
  whose support is well-ordered by the strict class order. This is the
  linearly ordered version of Hahn series' partially well-ordered support.
  Q5638886LexLe is the lexicographic order obtained at the least differing
  index. Q5638886Embedding requires an actual injective function preserving
  G-addition and this order.

  Q5638886TopClass expresses the source equality with HahnSeries.orderTop
  through its defining cases: zero maps to the zero series, while a nonzero
  element's Archimedean class is the least support index of its image. Thus
  the finite-class subtype and WithTop order isomorphism are represented
  without changing their mathematical content.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a bidirectional
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement. There is no $p proof statement in this file.
$)

$c Q5638886Abs Q5638886NatMul Q5638886Dominates Q5638886ArchEq
   Q5638886ArchClass Q5638886FiniteClasses Q5638886ClassLe
   Q5638886ClassLtRel Q5638886Support Q5638886Hahn Q5638886Zero
   Q5638886Add Q5638886LexLe Q5638886Embedding Q5638886TopClass $.

q5638886-abs-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886Abs G a ) $.
q5638886-nat-mul-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886NatMul G n a ) $.
q5638886-dominates-syntax
  $a wff ( Q5638886Dominates G a b ) $.
q5638886-arch-eq-syntax
  $a wff ( Q5638886ArchEq G a b ) $.
q5638886-arch-class-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886ArchClass G a ) $.
q5638886-finite-classes-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G ) $.
q5638886-class-le-syntax
  $a wff ( Q5638886ClassLe G C D ) $.
q5638886-class-lt-rel-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886ClassLtRel G ) $.
q5638886-support-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886Support G s ) $.
q5638886-hahn-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886Hahn G ) $.
q5638886-zero-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886Zero G ) $.
q5638886-add-syntax
  $a class ( Q5638886Add G s t ) $.
q5638886-lex-le-syntax
  $a wff ( Q5638886LexLe G s t ) $.
q5638886-embedding-syntax
  $a wff ( Q5638886Embedding G f ) $.
q5638886-top-class-syntax
  $a wff ( Q5638886TopClass G a s ) $.

${
  $d G a $.

  q5638886-abs-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886Abs G a
  ) = if (
    a ( le ` G ) ( 0g ` G ) ,
    ( ( -g ` G ) ` a ) ,
    a
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a k n $.

  q5638886-nat-mul-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886NatMul G n a
  ) = (
    G gsum ( k e. ( 1 ... n ) |-> a )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b n $.

  q5638886-dominates-definition $a |- (
    ( Q5638886Dominates G a b )
    <->
    E. n e. NN0
      (
        ( Q5638886Abs G b )
        ( le ` G )
        ( Q5638886NatMul G n ( Q5638886Abs G a ) )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b $.

  q5638886-arch-eq-definition $a |- (
    ( Q5638886ArchEq G a b )
    <->
    (
      ( Q5638886Dominates G a b )
      /\
      ( Q5638886Dominates G b a )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b $.

  q5638886-arch-class-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886ArchClass G a
  ) = {
    b e. ( Base ` G ) |
      ( Q5638886ArchEq G a b )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G a c $.

  q5638886-finite-classes-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886FiniteClasses G
  ) = {
    c e. ~P ( Base ` G ) |
      E. a e. ( Base ` G )
        (
          a =/= ( 0g ` G )
          /\
          c = ( Q5638886ArchClass G a )
        )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d C D G a b $.

  q5638886-class-le-definition $a |- (
    ( Q5638886ClassLe G C D )
    <->
    E. a e. C E. b e. D
      ( Q5638886Dominates G a b )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G c d p $.

  q5638886-class-lt-rel-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886ClassLtRel G
  ) = {
    p e.
      (
        ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G )
        X.
        ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G )
      ) |
      E. c e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G )
        E. d e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G )
          (
            p = <. c , d >.
            /\
            (
              ( Q5638886ClassLe G c d )
              /\
              c =/= d
            )
          )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G c s $.

  q5638886-support-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886Support G s
  ) = {
    c e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G ) |
      ( s ` c ) =/= 0
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G s $.

  q5638886-hahn-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886Hahn G
  ) = {
    s e. ( RR ^m ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G ) ) |
      ( Q5638886ClassLtRel G ) We ( Q5638886Support G s )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d G c $.

  q5638886-zero-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886Zero G
  ) = (
    c e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G ) |-> 0
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G c s t $.

  q5638886-add-definition $a |- (
    Q5638886Add G s t
  ) = (
    c e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G ) |->
      ( ( s ` c ) + ( t ` c ) )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G c d s t $.

  q5638886-lex-le-definition $a |- (
    ( Q5638886LexLe G s t )
    <->
    (
      s = t
      \/
      E. c e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G )
        (
          ( s ` c ) < ( t ` c )
          /\
          A. d e. ( Q5638886FiniteClasses G )
            (
              d ( Q5638886ClassLtRel G ) c
              ->
              ( s ` d ) = ( t ` d )
            )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b f $.

  q5638886-embedding-definition $a |- (
    ( Q5638886Embedding G f )
    <->
    (
      f
        : ( Base ` G )
        -1-1->
        ( Q5638886Hahn G )
      /\
      (
        A. a e. ( Base ` G ) A. b e. ( Base ` G )
          (
            f ` ( a ( +g ` G ) b )
          )
          =
          (
            Q5638886Add G ( f ` a ) ( f ` b )
          )
        /\
        A. a e. ( Base ` G ) A. b e. ( Base ` G )
          (
            a ( le ` G ) b
            ->
            ( Q5638886LexLe G ( f ` a ) ( f ` b ) )
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a c s $.

  q5638886-top-class-definition $a |- (
    ( Q5638886TopClass G a s )
    <->
    (
      (
        a = ( 0g ` G )
        /\
        s = ( Q5638886Zero G )
      )
      \/
      (
        a =/= ( 0g ` G )
        /\
        (
          ( Q5638886ArchClass G a )
            e. ( Q5638886Support G s )
          /\
          A. c e. ( Q5638886Support G s )
            (
              Q5638886ClassLe
                G
                ( Q5638886ArchClass G a )
                c
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d a f g $.

  thousand-theorems-q5638886-hahn-embedding $a |-
    A. g
      (
        (
          g e. Abel
          /\
          g e. oGrp
        )
        ->
        E. f
          (
            ( Q5638886Embedding g f )
            /\
            A. a e. ( Base ` g )
              ( Q5638886TopClass g a ( f ` a ) )
          )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q5638886,
:: "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly ordered abelian group embeds
:: injectively and additively into the lexicographically ordered real Hahn
:: group on its finite Archimedean classes, preserving each element's
:: Archimedean class. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, ARYTM_1,
    ARYTM_3, CARD_1, REAL_1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1;
  constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
    ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0;
  requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, REAL, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI;
  expansions TARSKI;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for G being non empty set,
      addG being Function of [:G,G:],G,
      zeroG being Element of G,
      negG being Function of G,G,
      leG being Relation of G,G st
    (for x,y,z being Element of G holds
      addG.[addG.[x,y],z] = addG.[x,addG.[y,z]]) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds addG.[x,y] = addG.[y,x]) &
    (for x being Element of G holds addG.[x,zeroG] = x) &
    (for x being Element of G holds addG.[x,negG.x] = zeroG) &
    (for x being Element of G holds [x,x] in leG) &
    (for x,y being Element of G st [x,y] in leG & [y,x] in leG
      holds x = y) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G st [x,y] in leG & [y,z] in leG
      holds [x,z] in leG) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds [x,y] in leG or [y,x] in leG) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G st [x,y] in leG
      holds [addG.[x,z],addG.[y,z]] in leG)
  holds
    ex nsmul being Function of [:NAT,G:],G,
       absG being Function of G,G,
       C being set,
       classLe being Relation of C,C,
       H being set,
       f being Function st
      (for a being Element of G holds nsmul.[0,a] = zeroG) &
      (for n being Nat, a being Element of G holds
        nsmul.[n+1,a] = addG.[a,nsmul.[n,a]]) &
      (for a being Element of G holds
        ([zeroG,a] in leG & absG.a = a) or
        ([a,zeroG] in leG & absG.a = negG.a)) &
      (for c being object holds
        (c in C iff
          ex a being Element of G st
            a <> zeroG &
            c = {b where b is Element of G :
              b <> zeroG &
              (ex m being Nat st [absG.b,nsmul.[m,absG.a]] in leG) &
              (ex n being Nat st [absG.a,nsmul.[n,absG.b]] in leG)})) &
      (for c,d being Element of C holds
        ([c,d] in classLe iff
          ex a,b being Element of G st
            a in c & b in d &
            ex n being Nat st [absG.b,nsmul.[n,absG.a]] in leG)) &
      H c= Funcs(C,REAL) &
      (for h being Function of C,REAL holds
        (h in H iff
          for A being Subset of C st
            A <> {} &
            (for c being Element of C st c in A holds h.c <> 0)
          holds
            ex c being Element of C st
              c in A &
              for d being Element of C st d in A
                holds [c,d] in classLe)) &
      dom f = G & rng f c= H &
      f is one-to-one &
      (for x,y being Element of G,
           hx,hy,hxy being Function of C,REAL st
        hx = f.x & hy = f.y & hxy = f.(addG.[x,y])
      holds
        for c being object,
            rxy,rx,ry being Real st
          c in C & rxy = hxy.c & rx = hx.c & ry = hy.c
        holds rxy = rx + ry) &
      (for x,y being Element of G,
           hx,hy being Function of C,REAL st
        hx = f.x & hy = f.y & [x,y] in leG
      holds
        hx = hy or
        ex c being Element of C,
           rx,ry being Real st
          rx = hx.c & ry = hy.c &
          (for d being Element of C st
            [d,c] in classLe & not [c,d] in classLe
          holds hx.d = hy.d) &
          rx < ry) &
      (for a being Element of G,
           ha being Function of C,REAL st ha = f.a
      holds
        (a = zeroG &
          for c being object st c in C holds ha.c = 0) or
        (a <> zeroG &
          ex c being Element of C st
            c = {b where b is Element of G :
              b <> zeroG &
              (ex m being Nat st [absG.b,nsmul.[m,absG.a]] in leG) &
              (ex n being Nat st [absG.a,nsmul.[n,absG.b]] in leG)} &
            ha.c <> 0 &
            for d being Element of C st ha.d <> 0
              holds [c,d] in classLe))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q5638886,
% "Hahn embedding theorem": every linearly ordered abelian group embeds
% injectively by an order-preserving additive homomorphism into the real Hahn
% series indexed by its finite Archimedean classes, preserving each element's
% leading Archimedean class. This file contains no proof.

Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem[
  M: TYPE+,
  zeroM: M,
  negM: [M -> M],
  addM: [M, M -> M],
  leM: [M, M -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  arch_class_set: TYPE = [M -> bool]
  arch_class_family: TYPE = [arch_class_set -> bool]
  hahn_function: TYPE = [arch_class_set -> real]
  embedding_function: TYPE = [M -> hahn_function]

  additive_commutative_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
      addM(addM(x, y), z) = addM(x, addM(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      addM(x, y) = addM(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      addM(zeroM, x) = x
        AND addM(negM(x), x) = zeroM)

  linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: M):
      leM(x, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
      leM(x, y) AND leM(y, z) IMPLIES leM(x, z))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      leM(x, y) AND leM(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      leM(x, y) OR leM(y, x))

  ordered_add_monoid_laws: bool =
    FORALL (x, y, z: M):
      leM(x, y) IMPLIES leM(addM(z, x), addM(z, y))

  linearly_ordered_abelian_group: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_laws
      AND linear_order_laws
      AND ordered_add_monoid_laws

  group_abs(x: M): M =
    IF leM(zeroM, x) THEN x ELSE negM(x) ENDIF

  natural_multiple(n: nat, x: M): RECURSIVE M =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      zeroM
    ELSE
      addM(x, natural_multiple(n - 1, x))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  archimedean_le(x, y: M): bool =
    EXISTS (n: nat):
      leM(group_abs(y), natural_multiple(n, group_abs(x)))

  archimedean_equivalent(x, y: M): bool =
    archimedean_le(x, y) AND archimedean_le(y, x)

  archimedean_class(x: M): arch_class_set =
    LAMBDA (y: M): archimedean_equivalent(x, y)

  finite_archimedean_class(C: arch_class_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: M):
      x /= zeroM AND C = archimedean_class(x)

  archimedean_class_le(C, D: arch_class_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: M):
      x /= zeroM
        AND y /= zeroM
        AND C = archimedean_class(x)
        AND D = archimedean_class(y)
        AND archimedean_le(x, y)

  archimedean_class_lt(C, D: arch_class_set): bool =
    archimedean_class_le(C, D) AND C /= D

  support_member(s: hahn_function, C: arch_class_set): bool =
    finite_archimedean_class(C) AND s(C) /= 0

  support_well_ordered(s: hahn_function): bool =
    FORALL (U: arch_class_family):
      ((EXISTS (C: arch_class_set): U(C))
        AND
       (FORALL (C: arch_class_set):
         U(C) IMPLIES support_member(s, C)))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (least: arch_class_set):
          U(least)
            AND
          (FORALL (C: arch_class_set):
            U(C) IMPLIES archimedean_class_le(least, C))

  is_hahn_series(s: hahn_function): bool =
    (FORALL (C: arch_class_set):
      NOT finite_archimedean_class(C) IMPLIES s(C) = 0)
      AND support_well_ordered(s)

  lexicographically_less(s, t: hahn_function): bool =
    EXISTS (pivot: arch_class_set):
      finite_archimedean_class(pivot)
        AND
      (FORALL (earlier: arch_class_set):
        finite_archimedean_class(earlier)
          AND archimedean_class_lt(earlier, pivot)
        IMPLIES s(earlier) = t(earlier))
        AND s(pivot) < t(pivot)

  lexicographically_le(s, t: hahn_function): bool =
    s = t OR lexicographically_less(s, t)

  leading_class_matches(a: M, s: hahn_function): bool =
    IF a = zeroM THEN
      FORALL (C: arch_class_set): s(C) = 0
    ELSE
      s(archimedean_class(a)) /= 0
        AND
      (FORALL (C: arch_class_set):
        finite_archimedean_class(C)
          AND archimedean_class_lt(C, archimedean_class(a))
        IMPLIES s(C) = 0)
    ENDIF

  is_ordered_additive_embedding(f: embedding_function): bool =
    (FORALL (x: M):
      is_hahn_series(f(x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (C: arch_class_set):
      f(zeroM)(C) = 0)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M), (C: arch_class_set):
      f(addM(x, y))(C) = f(x)(C) + f(y)(C))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      leM(x, y) IMPLIES lexicographically_le(f(x), f(y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: M):
      f(x) = f(y) IMPLIES x = y)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: M):
      leading_class_matches(x, f(x)))

  hahnEmbedding_isOrderedAddMonoid: bool =
    linearly_ordered_abelian_group
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (f: embedding_function):
          is_ordered_additive_embedding(f)
END Q5638886_hahn_embedding_theorem

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q570779
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q570779), "Vieta's formulas": over any commutative
-- semiring, the product of the polynomial factors X + C r from a multiset equals
-- the sum formed from its elementary symmetric functions. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Splits
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Symmetric.Defs

@[expose] public section

open Finset Polynomial

namespace Q570779

variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

/-- The product form of Vieta's formula for a multiset over a commutative semiring. -/
theorem prod_X_add_C_eq_sum_esymm (s : Multiset R) :
    (s.map fun r => X + C r).prod =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (Multiset.card s + 1),
        C (s.esymm j) * X ^ (Multiset.card s - j) := sorry

end Q570779

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q570779
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q570779), "Vieta's formulas": over an arbitrary
  commutative semiring, the product of the linear polynomials X + C(r) for a
  multiset of coefficients is the sum whose coefficients are its elementary
  symmetric functions. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat List Sorting.Permutation.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q570779_comm_semiring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q570779_zero : R;
  q570779_one : R;
  q570779_add : R -> R -> R;
  q570779_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q570779_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q570779_add x (q570779_add y z) =
      q570779_add (q570779_add x y) z;
  q570779_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q570779_add x y = q570779_add y x;
  q570779_add_zero_left :
    forall x : R, q570779_add q570779_zero x = x;
  q570779_add_zero_right :
    forall x : R, q570779_add x q570779_zero = x;
  q570779_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q570779_mul x (q570779_mul y z) =
      q570779_mul (q570779_mul x y) z;
  q570779_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q570779_mul x y = q570779_mul y x;
  q570779_mul_one_left :
    forall x : R, q570779_mul q570779_one x = x;
  q570779_mul_one_right :
    forall x : R, q570779_mul x q570779_one = x;
  q570779_mul_zero_left :
    forall x : R, q570779_mul q570779_zero x = q570779_zero;
  q570779_mul_zero_right :
    forall x : R, q570779_mul x q570779_zero = q570779_zero;
  q570779_mul_add_left :
    forall x y z : R,
      q570779_mul x (q570779_add y z) =
      q570779_add (q570779_mul x y) (q570779_mul x z);
  q570779_mul_add_right :
    forall x y z : R,
      q570779_mul (q570779_add x y) z =
      q570779_add (q570779_mul x z) (q570779_mul y z)
}.

Arguments q570779_zero {R} _.
Arguments q570779_one {R} _.
Arguments q570779_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q570779_mul {R} _ _ _.

Definition q570779_multiset (R : Type) : Type := list R.

Definition q570779_multiset_equiv {R : Type}
    (s t : q570779_multiset R) : Prop :=
  Permutation s t.

Fixpoint q570779_sum_range
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (f : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q570779_zero SR
  | S k =>
      q570779_add SR
        (q570779_sum_range SR f k) (f k)
  end.

Definition q570779_polynomial (R : Type) : Type :=
  nat -> R.

Definition q570779_polynomial_equal {R : Type}
    (p q : q570779_polynomial R) : Prop :=
  forall k : nat, p k = q k.

Definition q570779_polynomial_zero
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    : q570779_polynomial R :=
  fun _ => q570779_zero SR.

Definition q570779_polynomial_one
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    : q570779_polynomial R :=
  fun k =>
    match k with
    | O => q570779_one SR
    | S _ => q570779_zero SR
    end.

Definition q570779_polynomial_X
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    : q570779_polynomial R :=
  fun k =>
    match k with
    | S O => q570779_one SR
    | _ => q570779_zero SR
    end.

Definition q570779_polynomial_C
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (r : R) : q570779_polynomial R :=
  fun k =>
    match k with
    | O => r
    | S _ => q570779_zero SR
    end.

Definition q570779_polynomial_add
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (p q : q570779_polynomial R) : q570779_polynomial R :=
  fun k => q570779_add SR (p k) (q k).

Definition q570779_polynomial_mul
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (p q : q570779_polynomial R) : q570779_polynomial R :=
  fun n =>
    q570779_sum_range SR
      (fun i =>
        q570779_mul SR (p i) (q (Nat.sub n i)))
      (S n).

Fixpoint q570779_polynomial_pow
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (p : q570779_polynomial R) (n : nat)
    : q570779_polynomial R :=
  match n with
  | O => q570779_polynomial_one SR
  | S k =>
      q570779_polynomial_mul SR p
        (q570779_polynomial_pow SR p k)
  end.

Fixpoint q570779_polynomial_product
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (polynomials : list (q570779_polynomial R))
    : q570779_polynomial R :=
  match polynomials with
  | nil => q570779_polynomial_one SR
  | p :: rest =>
      q570779_polynomial_mul SR p
        (q570779_polynomial_product SR rest)
  end.

Fixpoint q570779_polynomial_sum_range
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (f : nat -> q570779_polynomial R) (n : nat)
    : q570779_polynomial R :=
  match n with
  | O => q570779_polynomial_zero SR
  | S k =>
      q570779_polynomial_add SR
        (q570779_polynomial_sum_range SR f k) (f k)
  end.

Fixpoint q570779_esymm
    {R : Type} (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
    (s : q570779_multiset R) (k : nat) {struct s} : R :=
  match s, k with
  | _, O => q570779_one SR
  | nil, S _ => q570779_zero SR
  | r :: rest, S j =>
      q570779_add SR
        (q570779_esymm SR rest (S j))
        (q570779_mul SR r (q570779_esymm SR rest j))
  end.

Theorem Multiset_prod_X_add_C_eq_sum_esymm :
  forall
      (R : Type)
      (SR : q570779_comm_semiring R)
      (s : q570779_multiset R),
    q570779_polynomial_equal
      (q570779_polynomial_product SR
        (map
          (fun r : R =>
            q570779_polynomial_add SR
              (q570779_polynomial_X SR)
              (q570779_polynomial_C SR r))
          s))
      (q570779_polynomial_sum_range SR
        (fun j : nat =>
          q570779_polynomial_mul SR
            (q570779_polynomial_C SR (q570779_esymm SR s j))
            (q570779_polynomial_pow SR
              (q570779_polynomial_X SR)
              (Nat.sub (length s) j)))
        (S (length s))).
Admitted.

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q570779
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q570779), "Vieta's formulas": over an arbitrary
  commutative semiring, the product of the linear polynomials X + a indexed by
