  a multiset expands as the sum of its elementary symmetric sums times the
  corresponding powers of X. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym 'a q570779_poly = "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q570779_poly_one ::
    "'a::{comm_semiring_0,comm_monoid_mult} q570779_poly" where
  "q570779_poly_one = (\<lambda>n. if n = 0 then 1 else 0)"

definition q570779_poly_mul ::
    "'a::comm_semiring_0 q570779_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q570779_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q570779_poly" where
  "q570779_poly_mul p q =
    (\<lambda>n. \<Sum>i\<le>n. p i * q (n - i))"

primrec q570779_poly_pow ::
    "'a::{comm_semiring_0,comm_monoid_mult} q570779_poly \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> 'a q570779_poly" where
  "q570779_poly_pow p 0 = q570779_poly_one"
| "q570779_poly_pow p (Suc n) =
    q570779_poly_mul p (q570779_poly_pow p n)"

definition q570779_linear ::
    "'a::comm_semiring_0 \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a q570779_poly" where
  "q570779_linear a b =
    (\<lambda>n. if n = 0 then a else if n = 1 then b else 0)"

definition q570779_mset_prod ::
    "('a::{comm_semiring_0,comm_monoid_mult} \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'a q570779_poly) \<Rightarrow> 'a q570779_poly" where
  "q570779_mset_prod s f =
    Finite_Set.fold
      (\<lambda>a p. q570779_poly_mul (q570779_poly_pow (f a) (s a)) p)
      q570779_poly_one {a. 0 < s a}"

definition q570779_mset_size :: "('a \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q570779_mset_size s = (\<Sum>a\<in>{a. 0 < s a}. s a)"

definition q570779_nat_cast ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::{comm_semiring_0,comm_monoid_mult}" where
  "q570779_nat_cast n = (\<Sum>i<n. 1)"

definition q570779_mset_esymm ::
    "('a::{comm_semiring_0,comm_monoid_mult} \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q570779_mset_esymm s j =
    (\<Sum>t |
      (\<forall>a. t a \<le> s a) \<and>
      (\<Sum>a\<in>{a. 0 < s a}. t a) = j.
        q570779_nat_cast
          (\<Prod>a\<in>{a. 0 < s a}. s a choose t a) *
        (\<Prod>a\<in>{a. 0 < s a}. a ^ t a))"

theorem Multiset_prod_X_add_C_eq_sum_esymm:
  fixes s :: "'a::{comm_semiring_0,comm_monoid_mult} \<Rightarrow> nat"
  assumes finite_support: "finite {a. 0 < s a}"
  shows "\<forall>n.
    q570779_mset_prod s (\<lambda>a. q570779_linear a 1) n =
      (\<Sum>j<q570779_mset_size s + 1.
        q570779_poly_mul
          (q570779_linear (q570779_mset_esymm s j) 0)
          (q570779_poly_pow (q570779_linear 0 1)
            (q570779_mset_size s - j)) n)"
  sorry

end

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q570779,
  "Vieta's formulas": over an arbitrary commutative semiring, the product of
  the linear polynomials X + C r is the polynomial whose coefficients are the
  elementary symmetric sums of the finite multiset of r's. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let q570779_comm_semiring = new_definition
  `q570779_comm_semiring (zero:A) (un:A)
      (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A) <=>
     (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
     (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
     (!x:A. add zero x = x /\ add x zero = x) /\
     (!x y:A. mul x y = mul y x) /\
     (!x y z:A. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
     (!x:A. mul un x = x /\ mul x un = x) /\
     (!x:A. mul zero x = zero /\ mul x zero = zero) /\
     (!x y z:A.
        mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z) /\
        mul (add x y) z = add (mul x z) (mul y z))`;;

let q570779_poly_zero = new_definition
  `q570779_poly_zero (zero:A) = (\n:num. zero)`;;

let q570779_poly_one = new_definition
  `q570779_poly_one (zero:A) (un:A) =
     (\n:num. if n = 0 then un else zero)`;;

let q570779_poly_add = new_definition
  `q570779_poly_add (add:A->A->A) (p:num->A) (q:num->A) =
     (\n. add (p n) (q n))`;;

let q570779_poly_mul = new_definition
  `q570779_poly_mul (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
      (p:num->A) (q:num->A) =
     (\n. iterate add (0..n) (\i. mul (p i) (q (n - i))))`;;

let q570779_C = new_definition
  `q570779_C (zero:A) (c:A) =
     (\n:num. if n = 0 then c else zero)`;;

let q570779_X = new_definition
  `q570779_X (zero:A) (un:A) =
     (\n:num. if n = 1 then un else zero)`;;

let q570779_poly_pow = new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `(q570779_poly_pow (onep:num->A) (mulp:(num->A)->(num->A)->(num->A))
       (p:num->A) 0 = onep) /\
   (!n. q570779_poly_pow onep mulp p (SUC n) =
        mulp (q570779_poly_pow onep mulp p n) p)`;;

let q570779_poly_prod = new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
  `(q570779_poly_prod (onep:num->A)
       (mulp:(num->A)->(num->A)->(num->A)) [] = onep) /\
   (!h t. q570779_poly_prod onep mulp (CONS h t) =
          mulp h (q570779_poly_prod onep mulp t))`;;

let q570779_poly_sum = new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `(q570779_poly_sum (zerop:num->A)
       (addp:(num->A)->(num->A)->(num->A)) (f:num->num->A) 0 = zerop) /\
   (!n. q570779_poly_sum zerop addp f (SUC n) =
        addp (q570779_poly_sum zerop addp f n) (f n))`;;

let q570779_esymm = new_recursive_definition list_RECURSION
  `(q570779_esymm (zero:A) (un:A) (add:A->A->A) (mul:A->A->A)
       [] k = if k = 0 then un else zero) /\
   (!h t k. q570779_esymm zero un add mul (CONS h t) k =
      if k = 0 then un
      else add (q570779_esymm zero un add mul t k)
               (mul h (q570779_esymm zero un add mul t (PRE k))))`;;

let Q570779_VIETA_S_FORMULAS =
  `!zero un:A. !add mul:A->A->A. !s:A list.
     q570779_comm_semiring zero un add mul
     ==>
     q570779_poly_prod
       (q570779_poly_one zero un)
       (q570779_poly_mul zero add mul)
       (MAP
         (\r. q570779_poly_add add
                (q570779_X zero un) (q570779_C zero r))
         s) =
     q570779_poly_sum
       (q570779_poly_zero zero)
       (q570779_poly_add add)
       (\j. q570779_poly_mul zero add mul
              (q570779_C zero (q570779_esymm zero un add mul s j))
              (q570779_poly_pow
                (q570779_poly_one zero un)
                (q570779_poly_mul zero add mul)
                (q570779_X zero un)
                (LENGTH s - j)))
       (SUC (LENGTH s))`;;

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q570779,
;; "Vieta's formulas": over an arbitrary commutative semiring, the product of
;; the linear polynomials X + C(r) for a finite multiset of elements r equals
;; the sum whose coefficients are its elementary symmetric functions. This
;; file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative generic symbols represent an arbitrary carrier and its zero,
;; one, addition, and multiplication. A semiring tag selects a structure
;; without enumerating or otherwise restricting its carrier.

(defstub q570779-element-p (semiring value) t)
(defstub q570779-zero (semiring) t)
(defstub q570779-one (semiring) t)
(defstub q570779-add (semiring left right) t)
(defstub q570779-multiply (semiring left right) t)

(defun-sk q570779-commutative-semiring-laws-p (semiring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q570779-element-p semiring x)
       (q570779-element-p semiring y))
      (and
       (q570779-element-p
        semiring (q570779-add semiring x y))
       (q570779-element-p
        semiring (q570779-multiply semiring x y))
       (equal
        (q570779-add semiring x y)
        (q570779-add semiring y x))
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply semiring x y)
        (q570779-multiply semiring y x))))
     (implies
      (q570779-element-p semiring x)
      (and
       (equal
        (q570779-add semiring x (q570779-zero semiring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q570779-add semiring (q570779-zero semiring) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply semiring x (q570779-one semiring))
        x)
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply semiring (q570779-one semiring) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply semiring x (q570779-zero semiring))
        (q570779-zero semiring))
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply semiring (q570779-zero semiring) x)
        (q570779-zero semiring))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q570779-element-p semiring x)
       (q570779-element-p semiring y)
       (q570779-element-p semiring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q570779-add
         semiring (q570779-add semiring x y) z)
        (q570779-add
         semiring x (q570779-add semiring y z)))
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply
         semiring (q570779-multiply semiring x y) z)
        (q570779-multiply
         semiring x (q570779-multiply semiring y z)))
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply
         semiring x (q570779-add semiring y z))
        (q570779-add
         semiring
         (q570779-multiply semiring x y)
         (q570779-multiply semiring x z)))
       (equal
        (q570779-multiply
         semiring (q570779-add semiring x y) z)
        (q570779-add
         semiring
         (q570779-multiply semiring x z)
         (q570779-multiply semiring y z))))))))

(defun q570779-commutative-semiring-p (semiring)
  (and
   (q570779-element-p semiring (q570779-zero semiring))
   (q570779-element-p semiring (q570779-one semiring))
   (q570779-commutative-semiring-laws-p semiring)))

;; A proper list represents a finite multiset, preserving repetitions. The
;; order is immaterial to the universally quantified identity.

(defun q570779-multiset-p (semiring elements)
  (if (consp elements)
      (and
       (q570779-element-p semiring (car elements))
       (q570779-multiset-p semiring (cdr elements)))
    (equal elements nil)))

;; Coefficient lists are in ascending degree order. Multiplication by X + C(r)
;; sends (a_0,...,a_d) to
;; (a_0*r, a_1*r+a_0, ..., a_d*r+a_(d-1), a_d).

(defun q570779-multiply-by-linear-aux
    (semiring coefficients root previous)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count coefficients)))
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons
       (q570779-add
        semiring
        (q570779-multiply semiring (car coefficients) root)
        previous)
       (q570779-multiply-by-linear-aux
        semiring
        (cdr coefficients)
        root
        (car coefficients)))
    (list previous)))

(defun q570779-multiply-by-linear
    (semiring coefficients root)
  (q570779-multiply-by-linear-aux
   semiring coefficients root (q570779-zero semiring)))

(defun q570779-product-linear-coefficients
    (semiring elements)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count elements)))
  (if (consp elements)
      (q570779-multiply-by-linear
       semiring
       (q570779-product-linear-coefficients
        semiring (cdr elements))
       (car elements))
    (list (q570779-one semiring))))

;; The elementary symmetric function e_j, including e_0 = 1.

(defun q570779-elementary-symmetric
    (semiring elements degree)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count elements)))
  (if (zp degree)
      (q570779-one semiring)
    (if (consp elements)
        (q570779-add
         semiring
         (q570779-elementary-symmetric
          semiring (cdr elements) degree)
         (q570779-multiply
          semiring
          (car elements)
          (q570779-elementary-symmetric
           semiring (cdr elements) (- degree 1))))
      (q570779-zero semiring))))

;; The coefficient list of
;; sum_{j=0}^n C(e_j) * X^(n-j) is (e_n,e_(n-1),...,e_0).

(defun q570779-vieta-sum-coefficients-aux
    (semiring elements degree)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix degree)))
  (if (zp degree)
      (list
       (q570779-elementary-symmetric
        semiring elements 0))
    (cons
     (q570779-elementary-symmetric
      semiring elements degree)
     (q570779-vieta-sum-coefficients-aux
      semiring elements (- degree 1)))))

(defun q570779-vieta-sum-coefficients
    (semiring elements)
  (q570779-vieta-sum-coefficients-aux
   semiring elements (len elements)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q570779-vieta-s-formulas-statement ()
  (forall (semiring elements)
    (implies
     (and
      (q570779-commutative-semiring-p semiring)
      (q570779-multiset-p semiring elements))
     (equal
      (q570779-product-linear-coefficients
       semiring elements)
      (q570779-vieta-sum-coefficients
       semiring elements)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q570779,
-- "Vieta's formulas": over any commutative semiring, the product of the linear
-- polynomials X + C(r) is the sum determined by the elementary symmetric
-- functions of the multiset of coefficients. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q570779_vieta_s_formulas where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_)

record CommutativeSemiring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR zeroR x == zeroR
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

Polynomial :
  {r : Level} ->
  Set r ->
  Set r
Polynomial R =
  List R

coefficient :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficient semiring [] n =
  CommutativeSemiring.zeroR semiring
coefficient semiring (a ∷ coefficients) zero =
  a
coefficient semiring (a ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficient semiring coefficients n

PolynomialEquality :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set r
PolynomialEquality semiring p q =
  (n : Nat) ->
  coefficient semiring p n == coefficient semiring q n

addPolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
addPolynomial semiring [] q =
  q
addPolynomial semiring p [] =
  p
addPolynomial semiring (a ∷ p) (b ∷ q) =
  CommutativeSemiring.addR semiring a b ∷
  addPolynomial semiring p q

scalePolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
scalePolynomial semiring a [] =
  []
scalePolynomial semiring a (b ∷ p) =
  CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring a b ∷
  scalePolynomial semiring a p

multiplyPolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
multiplyPolynomial semiring [] q =
  []
multiplyPolynomial semiring (a ∷ p) q =
  addPolynomial semiring
    (scalePolynomial semiring a q)
    (CommutativeSemiring.zeroR semiring ∷
      multiplyPolynomial semiring p q)

constantPolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R
constantPolynomial a =
  a ∷ []

xPolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R
xPolynomial semiring =
  CommutativeSemiring.zeroR semiring ∷
  CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring ∷
  []

onePolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R
onePolynomial semiring =
  constantPolynomial (CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring)

powerPolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  Polynomial R
powerPolynomial semiring p zero =
  onePolynomial semiring
powerPolynomial semiring p (suc n) =
  multiplyPolynomial semiring
    (powerPolynomial semiring p n)
    p

linearPolynomial :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R
linearPolynomial semiring a =
  addPolynomial semiring
    (xPolynomial semiring)
    (constantPolynomial a)

productOfLinearPolynomials :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  List R ->
  Polynomial R
productOfLinearPolynomials semiring [] =
  onePolynomial semiring
productOfLinearPolynomials semiring (a ∷ coefficients) =
  multiplyPolynomial semiring
    (linearPolynomial semiring a)
    (productOfLinearPolynomials semiring coefficients)

length :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  List R ->
  Nat
length [] =
  zero
length (x ∷ xs) =
  suc (length xs)

elementarySymmetric :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  List R ->
  Nat ->
  R
elementarySymmetric semiring [] zero =
  CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring
elementarySymmetric semiring [] (suc k) =
  CommutativeSemiring.zeroR semiring
elementarySymmetric semiring (x ∷ xs) zero =
  CommutativeSemiring.oneR semiring
elementarySymmetric semiring (x ∷ xs) (suc k) =
  CommutativeSemiring.addR semiring
    (elementarySymmetric semiring xs (suc k))
    (CommutativeSemiring.multiplyR semiring x
      (elementarySymmetric semiring xs k))

sumThrough :
  {r : Level}
  {R : Set r} ->
  CommutativeSemiring R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> Polynomial R) ->
  Polynomial R
sumThrough semiring zero terms =
  terms zero
sumThrough semiring (suc n) terms =
  addPolynomial semiring
    (sumThrough semiring n terms)
    (terms (suc n))

vieta-s-formulas : Setω
vieta-s-formulas =
  {r : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (semiring : CommutativeSemiring R) ->
  (coefficients : List R) ->
  PolynomialEquality semiring
    (productOfLinearPolynomials semiring coefficients)
    (sumThrough semiring (length coefficients)
      (\ j ->
        multiplyPolynomial semiring
          (constantPolynomial
            (elementarySymmetric semiring coefficients j))
          (powerPolynomial semiring
            (xPolynomial semiring)
            (length coefficients - j))))

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q570779, "Vieta's formulas": over a commutative semiring, the product of
  the linear polynomials X + C r indexed by a finite multiset equals the sum
  whose coefficients are its elementary symmetric functions. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory bagTheory pred_setTheory;

val q570779_comm_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_comm_semiring_def",
  ``q570779_comm_semiring
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) <=>
      (!x y z. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
      (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
      (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
      (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
      (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
      (!x. mulR zeroR x = zeroR)``);

val q570779_poly_one_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_poly_one_def",
  ``q570779_poly_one (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a) (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then oneR else zeroR``);

val q570779_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_linear_def",
  ``q570779_linear (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a) (r : 'a) (n : num) =
      if n = 0 then r else if n = 1 then oneR else zeroR``);

val q570779_poly_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_poly_mul_def",
  ``q570779_poly_mul
      (zeroR : 'a) (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (p : num -> 'a) (q : num -> 'a) (n : num) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc. addR (mulR (p i) (q (n - i))) acc)
        (count (SUC n))
        zeroR``);

val q570779_prod_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_prod_linear_def",
  ``q570779_prod_linear
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'a bag) =
      ITBAG
        (\r p.
           q570779_poly_mul zeroR addR mulR
             (q570779_linear zeroR oneR r) p)
        s
        (q570779_poly_one zeroR oneR)``);

val q570779_esymm_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_esymm_def",
  ``q570779_esymm
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'a bag) =
      ITBAG
        (\r e k.
           if k = 0
           then oneR
           else addR (e k) (mulR r (e (PRE k))))
        s
        (\k. if k = 0 then oneR else zeroR)``);

val q570779_monomial_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_monomial_def",
  ``q570779_monomial
      (zeroR : 'a) (c : 'a) (degree : num) (n : num) =
      if n = degree then c else zeroR``);

val q570779_sum_esymm_def = new_definition (
  "q570779_sum_esymm_def",
  ``q570779_sum_esymm
      (zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'a bag) (n : num) =
      ITSET
        (\j acc.
           addR
             (q570779_monomial zeroR
               (q570779_esymm zeroR oneR addR mulR s j)
               (BAG_CARD s - j)
               n)
             acc)
        (count (SUC (BAG_CARD s)))
        zeroR``);

val Multiset_prod_X_add_C_eq_sum_esymm =
  ``!(zeroR : 'a) (oneR : 'a)
      (addR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'a bag).
      q570779_comm_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
      FINITE_BAG s
      ==>
      q570779_prod_linear zeroR oneR addR mulR s =
      q570779_sum_esymm zeroR oneR addR mulR s``;

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q570779
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q570779), "Vieta's formulas": over every
  commutative semiring, the product of the linear polynomials X + C(r) for a
  finite multiset equals the sum of monomials whose coefficients are its
  elementary symmetric sums. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A finite multiset is represented by an arbitrary finite sequence
  f : ( 1 ... n ) --> Base(R). Repeated sequence values retain multiplicity,
  and quotienting such sequences by permutation recovers finite multisets.
  Both sides below are invariant under permutation, so universal
  quantification over finite sequences is equivalent to universal
  quantification over finite multisets.

  Q570779Prod is the coefficient function of the product of X + C(f(i)).
  For coefficient k, a binary degree choice d selects either the constant
  coefficient f(i) or the degree-one coefficient 1 at every position, and
  the choices whose degrees sum to k are added in R.

  Q570779ESymm is the elementary symmetric sum of degree j, indexed by the
  j-element subsets of the sequence positions. Q570779Sum is the coefficient
  function of the sum from j = 0 through n of
  C(Q570779ESymm(R,n,f,j)) times X^(n-j). Equality of these coefficient
  functions is equality of the corresponding polynomials. Thus the final
  unproved $a assertion is bidirectionally equivalent to the Lean statement;
  all preceding $a declarations are syntax or transparent definitions, and
  this root statement file contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c Q570779Prod Q570779ESymm Q570779Sum $.

q570779-prod-syntax $a class ( Q570779Prod R n f ) $.
q570779-esymm-syntax $a class ( Q570779ESymm R n f j ) $.
q570779-sum-syntax $a class ( Q570779Sum R n f ) $.

${
  $d R d f i k n $.

  q570779-prod-definition $a |- ( Q570779Prod R n f ) =
    (
      k e. NN0 |->
        R gsum
          (
            d e.
              {
                d e. ( ( 0 ... 1 ) ^m ( 1 ... n ) ) |
                ( sum_ i e. ( 1 ... n ) ( d ` i ) ) = k
              }
            |->
              ( mulGrp ` R ) gsum
                (
                  i e. ( 1 ... n ) |->
                    if (
                      ( d ` i ) = 0
                      ,
                      ( f ` i )
                      ,
                      ( 1r ` R )
                    )
                )
          )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d R f i j n u $.

  q570779-esymm-definition $a |- ( Q570779ESymm R n f j ) =
    R gsum
      (
        u e.
          {
            u e. ~P ( 1 ... n ) |
            ( # ` u ) = j
          }
        |->
          ( mulGrp ` R ) gsum
            ( i e. u |-> ( f ` i ) )
      )
  $.
$}

${
  $d R f j k n $.

  q570779-sum-definition $a |- ( Q570779Sum R n f ) =
    (
      k e. NN0 |->
        R gsum
          (
            j e. ( 0 ... n ) |->
              if (
                k = ( n - j )
                ,
                ( Q570779ESymm R n f j )
                ,
                ( 0g ` R )
              )
          )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d R f n $.

  thousand-theorems-q570779-vieta-s-formulas $a |-
    A. R e. CSRing
      A. n e. NN0
        A. f e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( 1 ... n ) )
          ( Q570779Prod R n f ) = ( Q570779Sum R n f )
  $.
$}

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q570779,
:: "Vieta's formulas": over an arbitrary commutative semiring, the product of
:: the linear polynomials X + r is expressed coefficientwise by the elementary
:: symmetric sums of the entries of a finite multiset. This file contains no

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1, REAL_1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
      COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, ALGSTR_0, BINOP_1, VECTSP_1, LATTICES, XBOOLE_0,
      SUBSET_1, ARYTM_1, RELAT_1, ARYTM_3, RLSUB_1, SUPINF_2, GROUP_1,
      STRUCT_0, TARSKI, REALSET1, ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, MESFUNC1,
      FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1, NEWTON, ORDINAL1, BINOM, PARTFUN1;

      FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1, CARD_1, ORDINAL1,
      NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, INT_1, NAT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0,
      DOMAIN_1, BINOP_1, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, VECTSP_1, INT_2, BINOM;
 constructors PARTFUN1, BINOP_1, REALSET1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSET_1,
      XXREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_D, VECTSP_1, RLVECT_1, RELSET_1, GROUP_1, BINOM;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, REALSET1,
      ORDINAL1, NUMBERS,
      XREAL_0, INT_1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0, VECTSP_1, RELAT_1, ALGSTR_0, NAT_1,
      FINSEQ_1, FINSET_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, REAL, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, RLVECT_1, XBOOLE_0, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1;
 equalities ORDINAL1, BINOP_1, REALSET1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for R being unital non empty doubleLoopStr,
      s being FinSequence of the carrier of R
  st
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) &
      a + b = b + a &
      a + 0.R = a &
      (a * b) * c = a * (b * c) &
      a * b = b * a &
      a * 1.R = a &
      1.R * a = a &
      a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c &
      (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c &
      a * 0.R = 0.R &
      0.R * a = 0.R)
  holds
    ex P,E being Function of [:NAT,NAT:],the carrier of R st
      P.(0,0) = 1.R &
      (for k being Nat holds P.(0,k + 1) = 0.R) &
      (for i being Nat st i < len s holds
        ex r,p0 being Element of R st
          r = s/.(i + 1) &
          p0 = P.(i,0) &
          P.(i + 1,0) = p0 * r &
          for k being Nat holds
            ex pk,pk1 being Element of R st
              pk = P.(i,k) &
              pk1 = P.(i,k + 1) &
              P.(i + 1,k + 1) = pk + pk1 * r) &
      E.(0,0) = 1.R &
      (for j being Nat holds E.(0,j + 1) = 0.R) &
      (for i being Nat st i < len s holds
        ex r being Element of R st
          r = s/.(i + 1) &
          E.(i + 1,0) = 1.R &
          for j being Nat holds
            ex ej1,ej being Element of R st
              ej1 = E.(i,j + 1) &
              ej = E.(i,j) &
              E.(i + 1,j + 1) = ej1 + ej * r) &
      (for k being Nat st k <= len s holds
        P.(len s,k) = E.(len s,len s - k)) &
      (for k being Nat st len s < k holds P.(len s,k) = 0.R)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q570779_vieta_s_formulas
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q570779,
% "Vieta's formulas": over every commutative semiring, the product indexed by
% a finite multiset of the linear polynomials X + C(r) equals the sum of its
% elementary symmetric functions times descending powers of X. This file
% contains no proof.

Q570779_vieta_s_formulas[
  R: TYPE+,
  zeroR: R,
  oneR: R,
  addR: [R, R -> R],
  mulR: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = [nat -> R]

  list_length(xs: list[R]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES xs OF
      null: 0,
      cons(a, ys): list_length(ys) + 1
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE xs BY <<

  nat_sub(n, m: nat): nat =
    IF m <= n THEN n - m ELSE 0 ENDIF

  poly_zero: polynomial =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat): zeroR

  poly_one: polynomial =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 0 THEN oneR ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  X: polynomial =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 1 THEN oneR ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  C(value: R): polynomial =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 0 THEN value ELSE zeroR ENDIF

  poly_add(left, right: polynomial): polynomial =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      addR(left(degree), right(degree))

  convolution_sum(
      left, right: polynomial,
      degree, count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroR
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        addR(
          convolution_sum(left, right, degree, count - 1),
          mulR(left(index), right(nat_sub(degree, index))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  poly_mul(left, right: polynomial): polynomial =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      convolution_sum(left, right, degree, degree + 1)

  poly_power(
      value: polynomial,
      exponent: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      poly_one
    ELSE
      poly_mul(poly_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  linear_factor(value: R): polynomial =
    poly_add(X, C(value))

  product_linear_factors(
      values: list[R]): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    CASES values OF
      null: poly_one,
      cons(value, tail):
        poly_mul(linear_factor(value), product_linear_factors(tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  elementary_symmetric(
      values: list[R],
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF degree = 0 THEN
      oneR
    ELSE
      CASES values OF
        null: zeroR,
        cons(value, tail):
          addR(
            elementary_symmetric(tail, degree),
            mulR(
              value,
              elementary_symmetric(tail, degree - 1)))
      ENDCASES
    ENDIF
  MEASURE values BY <<

  vieta_sum(values: list[R], count: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      poly_zero
    ELSE
      LET degree: nat = count - 1 IN
        poly_add(
          vieta_sum(values, count - 1),
          poly_mul(
            C(elementary_symmetric(values, degree)),
            poly_power(
              X,
              nat_sub(list_length(values), degree))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  commutative_semiring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      addR(addR(a, b), c) = addR(a, addR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        addR(a, b) = addR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        addR(zeroR, a) = a AND addR(a, zeroR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(mulR(a, b), c) = mulR(a, mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        mulR(a, b) = mulR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(oneR, a) = a AND mulR(a, oneR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(a, addR(b, c)) =
          addR(mulR(a, b), mulR(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(addR(a, b), c) =
          addR(mulR(a, c), mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(zeroR, a) = zeroR AND mulR(a, zeroR) = zeroR)

  Multiset_prod_X_add_C_eq_sum_esymm: bool =
    commutative_semiring_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (values: list[R]):
        product_linear_factors(values) =
          vieta_sum(values, list_length(values) + 1))
END Q570779_vieta_s_formulas

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q574902
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability theorem":
-- no unary formula in the first-order language of ordered semirings defines
-- truth for every closed arithmetic sentence in the standard natural-number model.
-- This file contains no proof.

namespace Q574902

/-- Terms in the first-order language with `0`, `1`, addition, and multiplication. -/
inductive Term (variables : Nat) where
  | bvar : Fin variables → Term variables
  | zero : Term variables
  | one : Term variables
  | add : Term variables → Term variables → Term variables
  | mul : Term variables → Term variables → Term variables

/--
Formulas in negation-normal form for the first-order language of ordered
semirings. Bound variables use de Bruijn indices.
-/
inductive Formula : Nat → Type where
  | verum {variables : Nat} : Formula variables
  | falsum {variables : Nat} : Formula variables
  | eq {variables : Nat} : Term variables → Term variables → Formula variables
  | neq {variables : Nat} : Term variables → Term variables → Formula variables
  | lt {variables : Nat} : Term variables → Term variables → Formula variables
  | nlt {variables : Nat} : Term variables → Term variables → Formula variables
  | and {variables : Nat} : Formula variables → Formula variables → Formula variables
  | or {variables : Nat} : Formula variables → Formula variables → Formula variables
  | all {variables : Nat} : Formula (variables + 1) → Formula variables
  | exs {variables : Nat} : Formula (variables + 1) → Formula variables

namespace Term

/-- Rename the de Bruijn variables in a term. -/
def rename {source target : Nat} (ρ : Fin source → Fin target) :
    Term source → Term target
  | .bvar index => .bvar (ρ index)
  | .zero => .zero
  | .one => .one
  | .add left right => .add (rename ρ left) (rename ρ right)
  | .mul left right => .mul (rename ρ left) (rename ρ right)

/-- Simultaneously substitute terms for all de Bruijn variables. -/
def subst {source target : Nat} (replacement : Fin source → Term target) :
    Term source → Term target
  | .bvar index => replacement index
  | .zero => .zero
  | .one => .one
  | .add left right => .add (subst replacement left) (subst replacement right)
  | .mul left right => .mul (subst replacement left) (subst replacement right)

/-- Evaluate an arithmetic term in the standard natural-number structure. -/
def eval {variables : Nat} (assignment : Fin variables → Nat) :
    Term variables → Nat
  | .bvar index => assignment index
  | .zero => 0
  | .one => 1
  | .add left right => eval assignment left + eval assignment right
  | .mul left right => eval assignment left * eval assignment right

end Term

/-- Extend an assignment with the value of the newest de Bruijn variable. -/
def extendAssignment {variables : Nat} (value : Nat)
    (assignment : Fin variables → Nat) : Fin (variables + 1) → Nat :=
  Fin.cases value assignment

/-- Lift a simultaneous substitution through one quantifier. -/
def liftSubstitution {source target : Nat}
    (replacement : Fin source → Term target) :
    Fin (source + 1) → Term (target + 1) :=
  Fin.cases (.bvar 0) (fun index => (replacement index).rename Fin.succ)

namespace Formula

/-- Capture-avoiding simultaneous substitution of arithmetic terms. -/
def subst {source target : Nat} (replacement : Fin source → Term target) :
    Formula source → Formula target
  | .verum => .verum
  | .falsum => .falsum
  | .eq left right => .eq (left.subst replacement) (right.subst replacement)
  | .neq left right => .neq (left.subst replacement) (right.subst replacement)
  | .lt left right => .lt (left.subst replacement) (right.subst replacement)
  | .nlt left right => .nlt (left.subst replacement) (right.subst replacement)
  | .and left right => .and (subst replacement left) (subst replacement right)
  | .or left right => .or (subst replacement left) (subst replacement right)
  | .all body => .all (subst (liftSubstitution replacement) body)
  | .exs body => .exs (subst (liftSubstitution replacement) body)

/-- Tarski satisfaction in the standard natural-number structure. -/
def eval {variables : Nat} (assignment : Fin variables → Nat) :
    Formula variables → Prop
  | .verum => True
  | .falsum => False
  | .eq left right => left.eval assignment = right.eval assignment
  | .neq left right => left.eval assignment ≠ right.eval assignment
  | .lt left right => left.eval assignment < right.eval assignment
  | .nlt left right => ¬left.eval assignment < right.eval assignment
  | .and left right => eval assignment left ∧ eval assignment right
  | .or left right => eval assignment left ∨ eval assignment right
  | .all body => ∀ value : Nat, eval (extendAssignment value assignment) body
  | .exs body => ∃ value : Nat, eval (extendAssignment value assignment) body

end Formula

/-- Truth of a closed arithmetic sentence in the standard model of `Nat`. -/
def TrueInNat (sentence : Formula 0) : Prop :=
  sentence.eval Fin.elim0

/-- The source's numeral term: `0`, `1`, and then repeated addition of `1`. -/
def numeral : Nat → Term 0
  | 0 => .zero
  | 1 => .one
  | n + 2 => .add (numeral (n + 1)) .one

/-- Instantiate the sole free de Bruijn variable of a unary formula by a numeral. -/
def instantiate (predicate : Formula 1) (number : Nat) : Formula 0 :=
  predicate.subst (fun _ => numeral number)

/-- The natural-number pairing function used by the source Gödel coding. -/
def pair (left right : Nat) : Nat :=
  if left < right then right * right + left else left * left + left + right

/-- Coding of a two-entry vector by the source's iterated pairing convention. -/
def vectorCode₂ (first second : Nat) : Nat :=
  pair first (pair second 0 + 1) + 1

namespace Term

/-- The source Gödel code, specialized to ordered-semiring terms. -/
def code {variables : Nat} : Term variables → Nat
  | .bvar index => pair 0 index.val + 1
  | .zero => pair 2 (pair 0 (pair 0 0)) + 1
  | .one => pair 2 (pair 0 (pair 1 0)) + 1
  | .add left right =>
      pair 2 (pair 2 (pair 0 (vectorCode₂ left.code right.code))) + 1
  | .mul left right =>
      pair 2 (pair 2 (pair 1 (vectorCode₂ left.code right.code))) + 1

end Term

namespace Formula

/-- The source Gödel code, specialized to ordered-semiring formulas. -/
def code {variables : Nat} : Formula variables → Nat
  | .eq left right =>
      pair 0 (pair 2 (pair 0 (vectorCode₂ left.code right.code))) + 1
  | .neq left right =>
      pair 1 (pair 2 (pair 0 (vectorCode₂ left.code right.code))) + 1
  | .lt left right =>
      pair 0 (pair 2 (pair 1 (vectorCode₂ left.code right.code))) + 1
  | .nlt left right =>
      pair 1 (pair 2 (pair 1 (vectorCode₂ left.code right.code))) + 1
  | .verum => pair 2 0 + 1
  | .falsum => pair 3 0 + 1
  | .and left right => pair 4 (pair left.code right.code) + 1
  | .or left right => pair 5 (pair left.code right.code) + 1
  | .all body => pair 6 body.code + 1
  | .exs body => pair 7 body.code + 1

end Formula

/--
Tarski's undefinability theorem: no unary arithmetic formula agrees, on the
Gödel code of every sentence, with truth in the standard natural-number model.
-/
theorem undefinability_of_truth :
    ¬∃ truthPredicate : Formula 1, ∀ sentence : Formula 0,
      TrueInNat sentence ↔
        TrueInNat (instantiate truthPredicate sentence.code) := sorry

end Q574902

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q574902
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability theorem": no
  unary first-order arithmetic formula defines truth for every closed
  arithmetic sentence in the standard natural-number model when applied to
  that sentence's Goedel code. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Inductive q574902_term (variables : nat) : Type :=
| q574902_variable :
    Fin.t variables -> q574902_term variables
| q574902_zero :
    q574902_term variables
| q574902_one :
    q574902_term variables
| q574902_add :
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables
| q574902_multiply :
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables.

Arguments q574902_variable {variables} _.
Arguments q574902_zero {variables}.
Arguments q574902_one {variables}.
Arguments q574902_add {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_multiply {variables} _ _.

Inductive q574902_formula (variables : nat) : Type :=
| q574902_equal :
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_not_equal :
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_less_than :
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_not_less_than :
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_term variables ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_truth :
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_falsum :
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_conjunction :
    q574902_formula variables ->
    q574902_formula variables ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_disjunction :
    q574902_formula variables ->
    q574902_formula variables ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_forall :
    q574902_formula (S variables) ->
    q574902_formula variables
| q574902_exists :
    q574902_formula (S variables) ->
    q574902_formula variables.

Arguments q574902_equal {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_not_equal {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_less_than {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_not_less_than {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_truth {variables}.
Arguments q574902_falsum {variables}.
Arguments q574902_conjunction {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_disjunction {variables} _ _.
Arguments q574902_forall {variables} _.
Arguments q574902_exists {variables} _.

Fixpoint q574902_term_map
    {n m : nat}
    (rho : Fin.t n -> Fin.t m)
    (t : q574902_term n) : q574902_term m :=
  match t with
  | q574902_variable i => q574902_variable (rho i)
  | q574902_zero => q574902_zero
  | q574902_one => q574902_one
  | q574902_add x y =>
      q574902_add
        (q574902_term_map rho x)
        (q574902_term_map rho y)
  | q574902_multiply x y =>
      q574902_multiply
        (q574902_term_map rho x)
        (q574902_term_map rho y)
  end.

Definition q574902_lift_substitution
    {n m : nat}
    (substitution : Fin.t n -> q574902_term m)
    (i : Fin.t (S n)) : q574902_term (S m) :=
  Fin.caseS' i
    (fun _ => q574902_term (S m))
    (q574902_variable Fin.F1)
    (fun j => q574902_term_map Fin.FS (substitution j)).

Fixpoint q574902_term_substitute
    {n m : nat}
    (substitution : Fin.t n -> q574902_term m)
    (t : q574902_term n) : q574902_term m :=
  match t with
  | q574902_variable i => substitution i
  | q574902_zero => q574902_zero
  | q574902_one => q574902_one
  | q574902_add x y =>
      q574902_add
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution x)
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution y)
  | q574902_multiply x y =>
      q574902_multiply
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution x)
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution y)
  end.

Fixpoint q574902_formula_substitute
    {n m : nat}
    (substitution : Fin.t n -> q574902_term m)
    (phi : q574902_formula n) : q574902_formula m :=
  match phi with
  | q574902_equal x y =>
      q574902_equal
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution x)
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution y)
  | q574902_not_equal x y =>
      q574902_not_equal
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution x)
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution y)
  | q574902_less_than x y =>
      q574902_less_than
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution x)
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution y)
  | q574902_not_less_than x y =>
      q574902_not_less_than
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution x)
        (q574902_term_substitute substitution y)
  | q574902_truth => q574902_truth
  | q574902_falsum => q574902_falsum
  | q574902_conjunction psi chi =>
      q574902_conjunction
        (q574902_formula_substitute substitution psi)
        (q574902_formula_substitute substitution chi)
  | q574902_disjunction psi chi =>
      q574902_disjunction
        (q574902_formula_substitute substitution psi)
        (q574902_formula_substitute substitution chi)
  | q574902_forall psi =>
      q574902_forall
        (q574902_formula_substitute
           (q574902_lift_substitution substitution) psi)
  | q574902_exists psi =>
      q574902_exists
        (q574902_formula_substitute
           (q574902_lift_substitution substitution) psi)
  end.

Definition q574902_substitute_only_variable
    (t : q574902_term 0)
    (i : Fin.t 1) : q574902_term 0 :=
  Fin.caseS' i
    (fun _ => q574902_term 0)
    t
    (fun j => match j with end).

Definition q574902_instantiate
    (tau : q574902_formula 1)
    (t : q574902_term 0) : q574902_formula 0 :=
  q574902_formula_substitute
    (q574902_substitute_only_variable t) tau.

Fixpoint q574902_numeral
    {variables : nat} (n : nat) : q574902_term variables :=
  match n with
  | 0 => q574902_zero
  | S k => q574902_add q574902_one (q574902_numeral k)
  end.

Definition q574902_extend_valuation
    (x : nat)
    (valuation : nat -> nat)
    (i : nat) : nat :=
  match i with
  | 0 => x
  | S j => valuation j
  end.

Fixpoint q574902_term_denote
    {variables : nat}
    (valuation : nat -> nat)
    (t : q574902_term variables) : nat :=
  match t with
  | q574902_variable i => valuation (proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i))
  | q574902_zero => 0
  | q574902_one => 1
  | q574902_add x y =>
      q574902_term_denote valuation x +
      q574902_term_denote valuation y
  | q574902_multiply x y =>
      q574902_term_denote valuation x *
      q574902_term_denote valuation y
  end.

Fixpoint q574902_satisfies
    {variables : nat}
    (valuation : nat -> nat)
    (phi : q574902_formula variables) : Prop :=
  match phi with
  | q574902_equal x y =>
      q574902_term_denote valuation x =
      q574902_term_denote valuation y
  | q574902_not_equal x y =>
      q574902_term_denote valuation x <>
      q574902_term_denote valuation y
  | q574902_less_than x y =>
      (q574902_term_denote valuation x <
       q574902_term_denote valuation y)%nat
  | q574902_not_less_than x y =>
      ~ (q574902_term_denote valuation x <
         q574902_term_denote valuation y)%nat
  | q574902_truth => True
  | q574902_falsum => False
  | q574902_conjunction psi chi =>
      q574902_satisfies valuation psi /\
      q574902_satisfies valuation chi
  | q574902_disjunction psi chi =>
      q574902_satisfies valuation psi \/
      q574902_satisfies valuation chi
  | q574902_forall psi =>
      forall x : nat,
        q574902_satisfies
          (q574902_extend_valuation x valuation) psi
  | q574902_exists psi =>
      exists x : nat,
        q574902_satisfies
          (q574902_extend_valuation x valuation) psi
  end.

Definition q574902_empty_valuation
    (_ : nat) : nat := 0.

Definition q574902_sentence_true
    (sigma : q574902_formula 0) : Prop :=
  q574902_satisfies q574902_empty_valuation sigma.

Definition q574902_pair (x y : nat) : nat :=
  (x + y) * (x + y) + x.

Fixpoint q574902_term_code
    {variables : nat}
    (t : q574902_term variables) : nat :=
  match t with
  | q574902_variable i => 5 * proj1_sig (Fin.to_nat i)
  | q574902_zero => 1
  | q574902_one => 2
  | q574902_add x y =>
      5 * q574902_pair
            (q574902_term_code x)
            (q574902_term_code y) + 3
  | q574902_multiply x y =>
      5 * q574902_pair
            (q574902_term_code x)
            (q574902_term_code y) + 4
  end.

Fixpoint q574902_formula_code
    {variables : nat}
    (phi : q574902_formula variables) : nat :=
  match phi with
  | q574902_equal x y =>
      10 * q574902_pair
             (q574902_term_code x)
             (q574902_term_code y)
  | q574902_not_equal x y =>
      10 * q574902_pair
             (q574902_term_code x)
             (q574902_term_code y) + 1
  | q574902_less_than x y =>
      10 * q574902_pair
             (q574902_term_code x)
             (q574902_term_code y) + 2
  | q574902_not_less_than x y =>
      10 * q574902_pair
             (q574902_term_code x)
             (q574902_term_code y) + 3
  | q574902_truth => 4
  | q574902_falsum => 5
  | q574902_conjunction psi chi =>
      10 * q574902_pair
             (q574902_formula_code psi)
             (q574902_formula_code chi) + 6
  | q574902_disjunction psi chi =>
      10 * q574902_pair
             (q574902_formula_code psi)
             (q574902_formula_code chi) + 7
  | q574902_forall psi =>
      10 * q574902_formula_code psi + 8
  | q574902_exists psi =>
      10 * q574902_formula_code psi + 9
  end.

Theorem q574902_undefinability_of_truth :
  ~ exists tau : q574902_formula 1,
      forall sigma : q574902_formula 0,
        q574902_sentence_true sigma <->
        q574902_sentence_true
          (q574902_instantiate tau
             (q574902_numeral (q574902_formula_code sigma))).
Admitted.

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q574902
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability theorem":
  no unary formula of first-order arithmetic defines truth for every arithmetic
  sentence in the standard natural-number model. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
  imports Main
begin

datatype q574902_term =
    Q574902_Var nat
  | Q574902_Zero
  | Q574902_One
  | Q574902_Add q574902_term q574902_term
  | Q574902_Mul q574902_term q574902_term

datatype q574902_formula =
    Q574902_False
  | Q574902_Eq q574902_term q574902_term
  | Q574902_Lt q574902_term q574902_term
  | Q574902_Imp q574902_formula q574902_formula
  | Q574902_Neg q574902_formula
  | Q574902_All nat q574902_formula

fun q574902_free_vars_term :: "q574902_term \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "q574902_free_vars_term (Q574902_Var v) = {v}"
| "q574902_free_vars_term Q574902_Zero = {}"
| "q574902_free_vars_term Q574902_One = {}"
| "q574902_free_vars_term (Q574902_Add s t) =
    q574902_free_vars_term s \<union> q574902_free_vars_term t"
| "q574902_free_vars_term (Q574902_Mul s t) =
    q574902_free_vars_term s \<union> q574902_free_vars_term t"

fun q574902_free_vars_formula :: "q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "q574902_free_vars_formula Q574902_False = {}"
| "q574902_free_vars_formula (Q574902_Eq s t) =
    q574902_free_vars_term s \<union> q574902_free_vars_term t"
| "q574902_free_vars_formula (Q574902_Lt s t) =
    q574902_free_vars_term s \<union> q574902_free_vars_term t"
| "q574902_free_vars_formula (Q574902_Imp A B) =
    q574902_free_vars_formula A \<union> q574902_free_vars_formula B"
| "q574902_free_vars_formula (Q574902_Neg A) =
    q574902_free_vars_formula A"
| "q574902_free_vars_formula (Q574902_All v A) =
    q574902_free_vars_formula A - {v}"

fun q574902_subst_term ::
    "q574902_term \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q574902_term \<Rightarrow> q574902_term" where
  "q574902_subst_term (Q574902_Var v) x s =
    (if v = x then s else Q574902_Var v)"
| "q574902_subst_term Q574902_Zero x s = Q574902_Zero"
| "q574902_subst_term Q574902_One x s = Q574902_One"
| "q574902_subst_term (Q574902_Add t u) x s =
    Q574902_Add (q574902_subst_term t x s) (q574902_subst_term u x s)"
| "q574902_subst_term (Q574902_Mul t u) x s =
    Q574902_Mul (q574902_subst_term t x s) (q574902_subst_term u x s)"

fun q574902_subst_closed ::
    "q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> q574902_term \<Rightarrow>
      q574902_formula" where
  "q574902_subst_closed Q574902_False x s = Q574902_False"
| "q574902_subst_closed (Q574902_Eq t u) x s =
    Q574902_Eq (q574902_subst_term t x s) (q574902_subst_term u x s)"
| "q574902_subst_closed (Q574902_Lt t u) x s =
    Q574902_Lt (q574902_subst_term t x s) (q574902_subst_term u x s)"
| "q574902_subst_closed (Q574902_Imp A B) x s =
    Q574902_Imp (q574902_subst_closed A x s) (q574902_subst_closed B x s)"
| "q574902_subst_closed (Q574902_Neg A) x s =
    Q574902_Neg (q574902_subst_closed A x s)"
| "q574902_subst_closed (Q574902_All v A) x s =
    (if v = x then Q574902_All v A
     else Q574902_All v (q574902_subst_closed A x s))"

fun q574902_numeral :: "nat \<Rightarrow> q574902_term" where
  "q574902_numeral 0 = Q574902_Zero"
| "q574902_numeral (Suc n) = Q574902_Add Q574902_One (q574902_numeral n)"

definition q574902_pair_code :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q574902_pair_code a b = 2 ^ a * (2 * b + 1)"

fun q574902_code_term :: "q574902_term \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q574902_code_term (Q574902_Var v) = 6 * v"
| "q574902_code_term Q574902_Zero = 1"
| "q574902_code_term Q574902_One = 2"
| "q574902_code_term (Q574902_Add s t) =
    6 * q574902_pair_code (q574902_code_term s) (q574902_code_term t) + 3"
| "q574902_code_term (Q574902_Mul s t) =
    6 * q574902_pair_code (q574902_code_term s) (q574902_code_term t) + 4"

fun q574902_code_formula :: "q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q574902_code_formula Q574902_False = 0"
| "q574902_code_formula (Q574902_Eq s t) =
    6 * q574902_pair_code (q574902_code_term s) (q574902_code_term t) + 1"
| "q574902_code_formula (Q574902_Lt s t) =
    6 * q574902_pair_code (q574902_code_term s) (q574902_code_term t) + 2"
| "q574902_code_formula (Q574902_Imp A B) =
    6 * q574902_pair_code (q574902_code_formula A) (q574902_code_formula B) + 3"
| "q574902_code_formula (Q574902_Neg A) =
    6 * q574902_code_formula A + 4"
| "q574902_code_formula (Q574902_All v A) =
    6 * q574902_pair_code v (q574902_code_formula A) + 5"

fun q574902_eval_term ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> q574902_term \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q574902_eval_term e (Q574902_Var v) = e v"
| "q574902_eval_term e Q574902_Zero = 0"
| "q574902_eval_term e Q574902_One = 1"
| "q574902_eval_term e (Q574902_Add s t) =
    q574902_eval_term e s + q574902_eval_term e t"
| "q574902_eval_term e (Q574902_Mul s t) =
    q574902_eval_term e s * q574902_eval_term e t"

fun q574902_satisfies ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q574902_satisfies e Q574902_False = False"
| "q574902_satisfies e (Q574902_Eq s t) =
    (q574902_eval_term e s = q574902_eval_term e t)"
| "q574902_satisfies e (Q574902_Lt s t) =
    (q574902_eval_term e s < q574902_eval_term e t)"
| "q574902_satisfies e (Q574902_Imp A B) =
    (q574902_satisfies e A \<longrightarrow> q574902_satisfies e B)"
| "q574902_satisfies e (Q574902_Neg A) = (\<not> q574902_satisfies e A)"
| "q574902_satisfies e (Q574902_All v A) =
    (\<forall>n. q574902_satisfies (e(v := n)) A)"

definition q574902_is_sentence :: "q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q574902_is_sentence A \<longleftrightarrow> q574902_free_vars_formula A = {}"

definition q574902_is_unary :: "q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q574902_is_unary A \<longleftrightarrow> q574902_free_vars_formula A \<subseteq> {0}"

definition q574902_true_in_nat :: "q574902_formula \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q574902_true_in_nat A \<longleftrightarrow> q574902_satisfies (\<lambda>_. 0) A"

theorem q574902_tarski_indefinability:
  "\<not> (\<exists>tau.
    q574902_is_unary tau \<and>
    (\<forall>sigma.
      q574902_is_sentence sigma \<longrightarrow>
      (q574902_true_in_nat sigma \<longleftrightarrow>
       q574902_true_in_nat
        (q574902_subst_closed tau 0
          (q574902_numeral (q574902_code_formula sigma))))))"
  sorry

end
