(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q574902
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability theorem":
  no one-variable first-order arithmetic formula defines truth for every
  arithmetic sentence in the standard natural-number model when instantiated
  with that sentence's Godel code. This file contains no proof.
*)

let q574902_term_INDUCT,q574902_term_RECURSION = define_type
  "q574902_term =
       Q574902_Var num
     | Q574902_Zero
     | Q574902_One
     | Q574902_Add q574902_term q574902_term
     | Q574902_Mul q574902_term q574902_term";;

let q574902_form_INDUCT,q574902_form_RECURSION = define_type
  "q574902_form =
       Q574902_True
     | Q574902_False
     | Q574902_Equal q574902_term q574902_term
     | Q574902_NotEqual q574902_term q574902_term
     | Q574902_Less q574902_term q574902_term
     | Q574902_NotLess q574902_term q574902_term
     | Q574902_And q574902_form q574902_form
     | Q574902_Or q574902_form q574902_form
     | Q574902_Forall q574902_form
     | Q574902_Exists q574902_form";;

let q574902_term_wellscoped = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_term_RECURSION
  `(q574902_term_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Var i) <=> i < depth) /\
   (q574902_term_wellscoped depth Q574902_Zero <=> T) /\
   (q574902_term_wellscoped depth Q574902_One <=> T) /\
   (q574902_term_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Add s t) <=>
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth s /\
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth t) /\
   (q574902_term_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Mul s t) <=>
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth s /\
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth t)`;;

let q574902_form_wellscoped = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_form_RECURSION
  `(q574902_form_wellscoped depth Q574902_True <=> T) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth Q574902_False <=> T) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Equal s t) <=>
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth s /\
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth t) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_NotEqual s t) <=>
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth s /\
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth t) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Less s t) <=>
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth s /\
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth t) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_NotLess s t) <=>
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth s /\
      q574902_term_wellscoped depth t) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_And p q) <=>
      q574902_form_wellscoped depth p /\
      q574902_form_wellscoped depth q) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Or p q) <=>
      q574902_form_wellscoped depth p /\
      q574902_form_wellscoped depth q) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Forall p) <=>
      q574902_form_wellscoped (SUC depth) p) /\
   (q574902_form_wellscoped depth (Q574902_Exists p) <=>
      q574902_form_wellscoped (SUC depth) p)`;;

let q574902_numeral = new_recursive_definition num_RECURSION
  `(q574902_numeral 0 = Q574902_Zero) /\
   (q574902_numeral (SUC n) =
      Q574902_Add (q574902_numeral n) Q574902_One)`;;

let q574902_term_subst = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_term_RECURSION
  `(q574902_term_subst variable n (Q574902_Var i) =
      if i = variable then q574902_numeral n
      else if variable < i then Q574902_Var (PRE i)
      else Q574902_Var i) /\
   (q574902_term_subst variable n Q574902_Zero = Q574902_Zero) /\
   (q574902_term_subst variable n Q574902_One = Q574902_One) /\
   (q574902_term_subst variable n (Q574902_Add s t) =
      Q574902_Add
        (q574902_term_subst variable n s)
        (q574902_term_subst variable n t)) /\
   (q574902_term_subst variable n (Q574902_Mul s t) =
      Q574902_Mul
        (q574902_term_subst variable n s)
        (q574902_term_subst variable n t))`;;

let q574902_form_subst = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_form_RECURSION
  `(q574902_form_subst variable n Q574902_True = Q574902_True) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n Q574902_False = Q574902_False) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_Equal s t) =
      Q574902_Equal
        (q574902_term_subst variable n s)
        (q574902_term_subst variable n t)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_NotEqual s t) =
      Q574902_NotEqual
        (q574902_term_subst variable n s)
        (q574902_term_subst variable n t)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_Less s t) =
      Q574902_Less
        (q574902_term_subst variable n s)
        (q574902_term_subst variable n t)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_NotLess s t) =
      Q574902_NotLess
        (q574902_term_subst variable n s)
        (q574902_term_subst variable n t)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_And p q) =
      Q574902_And
        (q574902_form_subst variable n p)
        (q574902_form_subst variable n q)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_Or p q) =
      Q574902_Or
        (q574902_form_subst variable n p)
        (q574902_form_subst variable n q)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_Forall p) =
      Q574902_Forall (q574902_form_subst (SUC variable) n p)) /\
   (q574902_form_subst variable n (Q574902_Exists p) =
      Q574902_Exists (q574902_form_subst (SUC variable) n p))`;;

let q574902_pair = new_definition
  `q574902_pair a b =
     ((a + b) * (a + b + 1)) DIV 2 + b`;;

let q574902_term_code = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_term_RECURSION
  `(q574902_term_code (Q574902_Var i) = q574902_pair 0 i) /\
   (q574902_term_code Q574902_Zero = q574902_pair 1 0) /\
   (q574902_term_code Q574902_One = q574902_pair 2 0) /\
   (q574902_term_code (Q574902_Add s t) =
      q574902_pair 3
        (q574902_pair (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t))) /\
   (q574902_term_code (Q574902_Mul s t) =
      q574902_pair 4
        (q574902_pair (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t)))`;;

let q574902_form_code = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_form_RECURSION
  `(q574902_form_code Q574902_True = q574902_pair 0 0) /\
   (q574902_form_code Q574902_False = q574902_pair 1 0) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_Equal s t) =
      q574902_pair 2
        (q574902_pair (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t))) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_NotEqual s t) =
      q574902_pair 3
        (q574902_pair (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t))) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_Less s t) =
      q574902_pair 4
        (q574902_pair (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t))) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_NotLess s t) =
      q574902_pair 5
        (q574902_pair (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t))) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_And p q) =
      q574902_pair 6
        (q574902_pair (q574902_form_code p) (q574902_form_code q))) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_Or p q) =
      q574902_pair 7
        (q574902_pair (q574902_form_code p) (q574902_form_code q))) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_Forall p) =
      q574902_pair 8 (q574902_form_code p)) /\
   (q574902_form_code (Q574902_Exists p) =
      q574902_pair 9 (q574902_form_code p))`;;

let q574902_term_value = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_term_RECURSION
  `(q574902_term_value valuation (Q574902_Var i) = valuation i) /\
   (q574902_term_value valuation Q574902_Zero = 0) /\
   (q574902_term_value valuation Q574902_One = 1) /\
   (q574902_term_value valuation (Q574902_Add s t) =
      q574902_term_value valuation s +
      q574902_term_value valuation t) /\
   (q574902_term_value valuation (Q574902_Mul s t) =
      q574902_term_value valuation s *
      q574902_term_value valuation t)`;;

let q574902_holds = new_recursive_definition
  q574902_form_RECURSION
  `(q574902_holds valuation Q574902_True <=> T) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation Q574902_False <=> F) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_Equal s t) <=>
      q574902_term_value valuation s = q574902_term_value valuation t) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_NotEqual s t) <=>
      ~(q574902_term_value valuation s =
        q574902_term_value valuation t)) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_Less s t) <=>
      q574902_term_value valuation s < q574902_term_value valuation t) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_NotLess s t) <=>
      ~(q574902_term_value valuation s <
        q574902_term_value valuation t)) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_And p q) <=>
      q574902_holds valuation p /\ q574902_holds valuation q) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_Or p q) <=>
      q574902_holds valuation p \/ q574902_holds valuation q) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_Forall p) <=>
      !x:num.
        q574902_holds
          (\i. if i = 0 then x else valuation (PRE i)) p) /\
   (q574902_holds valuation (Q574902_Exists p) <=>
      ?x:num.
        q574902_holds
          (\i. if i = 0 then x else valuation (PRE i)) p)`;;

let q574902_standard_truth = new_definition
  `q574902_standard_truth p <=>
     q574902_holds (\i:num. 0) p`;;

let Q574902_TARSKIS_INDEFINABILITY_THEOREM =
  `~(?tau:q574902_form.
       q574902_form_wellscoped 1 tau /\
       !sigma:q574902_form.
         q574902_form_wellscoped 0 sigma
         ==> (q574902_standard_truth sigma <=>
              q574902_standard_truth
                (q574902_form_subst
                  0 (q574902_form_code sigma) tau)))`;;

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q574902,
;; "Tarski's indefinability theorem": no unary formula of first-order
;; arithmetic defines standard-model truth for every arithmetic sentence when
;; applied to that sentence's Gödel numeral. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-gag-mode t)

;; Terms and formulas give a concrete presentation of the ordered-semiring
;; language used by the source. Variables are natural numbers. The only data
;; represented by finite lists are finite syntax trees and environments;
;; quantifiers below range over all ACL2 natural numbers.

(mutual-recursion
 (defun q574902-term-p (term)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term)
     (or (equal term :zero)
         (equal term :one)))
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (and
      (true-listp term)
      (equal (len term) 2)
      (natp (cadr term))))
    ((or (equal (car term) :add)
         (equal (car term) :multiply))
     (and
      (true-listp term)
      (equal (len term) 3)
      (q574902-term-p (cadr term))
      (q574902-term-p (caddr term))))
    (t nil)))

 (defun q574902-formula-p (formula)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) nil)
    ((equal (car formula) :falsum)
     (and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 1)))
    ((or (equal (car formula) :equal)
         (equal (car formula) :less))
     (and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (q574902-term-p (cadr formula))
      (q574902-term-p (caddr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (q574902-formula-p (cadr formula))
      (q574902-formula-p (caddr formula))))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (and
      (true-listp formula)
      (equal (len formula) 3)
      (natp (cadr formula))
      (q574902-formula-p (caddr formula))))
    (t nil))))

;; A variable occurrence is admissible when it is bound or belongs to the
;; displayed finite list of permitted free-variable positions. Thus NIL gives
;; sentences and (LIST 0) gives exactly the source type Semisentence L 1:
;; formulas may use the single free position 0, but need not actually use it.

(mutual-recursion
 (defun q574902-term-variables-among-p
     (term permitted-free bound)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term)
     (or (equal term :zero)
         (equal term :one)))
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (or
      (member-equal (cadr term) permitted-free)
      (member-equal (cadr term) bound)))
    ((or (equal (car term) :add)
         (equal (car term) :multiply))
     (and
      (q574902-term-variables-among-p
       (cadr term) permitted-free bound)
      (q574902-term-variables-among-p
       (caddr term) permitted-free bound)))
    (t nil)))

 (defun q574902-formula-variables-among-p
     (formula permitted-free bound)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) nil)
    ((equal (car formula) :falsum) t)
    ((or (equal (car formula) :equal)
         (equal (car formula) :less))
     (and
      (q574902-term-variables-among-p
       (cadr formula) permitted-free bound)
      (q574902-term-variables-among-p
       (caddr formula) permitted-free bound)))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (and
      (q574902-formula-variables-among-p
       (cadr formula) permitted-free bound)
      (q574902-formula-variables-among-p
       (caddr formula) permitted-free bound)))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (q574902-formula-variables-among-p
      (caddr formula)
      permitted-free
      (cons (cadr formula) bound)))
    (t nil))))

(defun q574902-sentence-p (formula)
  (and
   (q574902-formula-p formula)
   (q574902-formula-variables-among-p
    formula nil nil)))

(defun q574902-unary-semisentence-p (formula)
  (and
   (q574902-formula-p formula)
   (q574902-formula-variables-among-p
    formula (list 0) nil)))

;; Closed-term substitution is capture-free: a quantifier binding the
;; substituted variable blocks replacement, while other binders cannot
;; capture any variable of the closed Gödel numeral.

(mutual-recursion
 (defun q574902-substitute-term
     (term variable replacement)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((atom term) term)
    ((equal (car term) :var)
     (if (equal (cadr term) variable)
         replacement
       term))
    ((equal (car term) :add)
     (list
      :add
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (cadr term) variable replacement)
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (caddr term) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car term) :multiply)
     (list
      :multiply
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (cadr term) variable replacement)
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (caddr term) variable replacement)))
    (t term)))

 (defun q574902-substitute-formula
     (formula variable replacement)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((atom formula) formula)
    ((equal (car formula) :equal)
     (list
      :equal
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (caddr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :less)
     (list
      :less
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)
      (q574902-substitute-term
       (caddr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :falsum)
     formula)
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (list
      :implies
      (q574902-substitute-formula
       (cadr formula) variable replacement)
      (q574902-substitute-formula
       (caddr formula) variable replacement)))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (if (equal (cadr formula) variable)
         formula
       (list
        :forall
        (cadr formula)
        (q574902-substitute-formula
         (caddr formula) variable replacement))))
    (t formula))))

(defun q574902-numeral (number)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix number)))
  (if (zp number)
      :zero
    (list
     :add
     :one
     (q574902-numeral (- number 1)))))

;; Cantor pairing gives an injective, unbounded Gödel numbering of all terms
;; and formulas in this concrete syntax. Distinct constructor tags remain
;; distinct because the pairing function is injective in both coordinates.

(defun q574902-pair (left right)
  (let* ((left (nfix left))
         (right (nfix right))
         (sum (+ left right)))
    (+ right (floor (* sum (+ sum 1)) 2))))

(mutual-recursion
 (defun q574902-term-code (term)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
   (cond
    ((equal term :zero)
     (q574902-pair 0 0))
    ((equal term :one)
     (q574902-pair 1 0))
    ((and (consp term)
          (equal (car term) :var))
     (q574902-pair 2 (nfix (cadr term))))
    ((and (consp term)
          (equal (car term) :add))
     (q574902-pair
      3
      (q574902-pair
       (q574902-term-code (cadr term))
       (q574902-term-code (caddr term)))))
    ((and (consp term)
          (equal (car term) :multiply))
     (q574902-pair
      4
      (q574902-pair
       (q574902-term-code (cadr term))
       (q574902-term-code (caddr term)))))
    (t (q574902-pair 5 0))))

 (defun q574902-formula-code (formula)
   (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count formula)))
   (cond
    ((and (consp formula)
          (equal (car formula) :falsum))
     (q574902-pair 10 0))
    ((equal (car formula) :equal)
     (q574902-pair
      11
      (q574902-pair
       (q574902-term-code (cadr formula))
       (q574902-term-code (caddr formula)))))
    ((equal (car formula) :less)
     (q574902-pair
      12
      (q574902-pair
       (q574902-term-code (cadr formula))
       (q574902-term-code (caddr formula)))))
    ((equal (car formula) :implies)
     (q574902-pair
      13
      (q574902-pair
       (q574902-formula-code (cadr formula))
       (q574902-formula-code (caddr formula)))))
    ((equal (car formula) :forall)
     (q574902-pair
      14
      (q574902-pair
       (nfix (cadr formula))
       (q574902-formula-code (caddr formula)))))
    (t (q574902-pair 15 0)))))

;; Standard-natural-number term evaluation is executable. Environments are
;; association lists; closed formulas are independent of any default values.

(defun q574902-environment-lookup (variable environment)
  (nfix (cdr (assoc-equal variable environment))))

(defun q574902-environment-update
    (variable value environment)
  (acons variable (nfix value) environment))

(defun q574902-term-value (term environment)
  (declare (xargs :measure (acl2-count term)))
  (cond
   ((equal term :zero) 0)
   ((equal term :one) 1)
   ((and (consp term)
         (equal (car term) :var))
    (q574902-environment-lookup
     (cadr term) environment))
   ((and (consp term)
         (equal (car term) :add))
    (+ (q574902-term-value (cadr term) environment)
       (q574902-term-value (caddr term) environment)))
   ((and (consp term)
         (equal (car term) :multiply))
    (* (q574902-term-value (cadr term) environment)
       (q574902-term-value (caddr term) environment)))
   (t 0)))

;; This conservative interface is constrained below by every Tarskian
;; recursion clause for the fixed standard model of arithmetic. Those clauses
;; uniquely determine satisfaction on well-formed formulas.

(defstub q574902-satisfies
  (environment formula)
  t)

(defun q574902-satisfies-p (environment formula)
  (if (q574902-satisfies environment formula)
      t
    nil))

(defun-sk q574902-all-naturals-satisfy-p
    (environment variable body)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (natp value)
     (q574902-satisfies-p
      (q574902-environment-update
       variable value environment)
      body))))

(defun-sk q574902-equality-semantics-p ()
  (forall (environment left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q574902-term-p left)
      (q574902-term-p right))
     (equal
      (q574902-satisfies-p
       environment (list :equal left right))
      (equal
       (q574902-term-value left environment)
       (q574902-term-value right environment))))))

(defun-sk q574902-order-semantics-p ()
  (forall (environment left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q574902-term-p left)
      (q574902-term-p right))
     (equal
      (q574902-satisfies-p
       environment (list :less left right))
      (if
       (< (q574902-term-value left environment)
          (q574902-term-value right environment))
       t
       nil)))))

(defun-sk q574902-falsum-semantics-p ()
  (forall (environment)
    (not
     (q574902-satisfies-p
      environment (list :falsum)))))

(defun-sk q574902-implication-semantics-p ()
  (forall (environment left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q574902-formula-p left)
      (q574902-formula-p right))
     (equal
      (q574902-satisfies-p
       environment (list :implies left right))
      (if
       (q574902-satisfies-p environment left)
       (q574902-satisfies-p environment right)
       t)))))

(defun-sk q574902-universal-semantics-p ()
  (forall (environment variable body)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp variable)
      (q574902-formula-p body))
     (equal
      (q574902-satisfies-p
       environment (list :forall variable body))
      (if
       (q574902-all-naturals-satisfy-p
        environment variable body)
       t
       nil)))))

(defun q574902-standard-natural-semantics-p ()
  (and
   (q574902-equality-semantics-p)
   (q574902-order-semantics-p)
   (q574902-falsum-semantics-p)
   (q574902-implication-semantics-p)
   (q574902-universal-semantics-p)))

;; Agreement has the source quantifier order: one internally existential
;; unary formula must work uniformly for every closed arithmetic sentence.

(defun-sk q574902-truth-agreement-p (truth-formula)
  (forall (sentence)
    (implies
     (q574902-sentence-p sentence)
     (iff
      (q574902-satisfies-p nil sentence)
      (q574902-satisfies-p
       nil
       (q574902-substitute-formula
        truth-formula
        0
        (q574902-numeral
         (q574902-formula-code sentence))))))))

(defun-sk q574902-tarski-predicate-exists-p ()
  (exists (truth-formula)
    (and
     (q574902-unary-semisentence-p truth-formula)
     (q574902-truth-agreement-p truth-formula))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q574902-tarski-s-indefinability-statement ()
  (implies
   (q574902-standard-natural-semantics-p)
   (not
    (q574902-tarski-predicate-exists-p))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q574902
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability theorem":
-- no unary formula of first-order arithmetic defines truth for every closed
-- arithmetic sentence in the standard natural-number model. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_; _<_)

infix 4 _iff_
infixr 3 _and_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

record _and_ (left right : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first : left
    second : right

data _or_ (left right : Set) : Set where
  left-injection : left -> left or right
  right-injection : right -> left or right

record _iff_ (left right : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward : left -> right
    backward : right -> left

record Exists (A : Set) (predicate : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value : A
    property : predicate value

-- Fin n is the type of de Bruijn variables in an n-variable context.
data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  first-variable : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  next-variable : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

-- Terms and formulas for the first-order language of ordered semirings.
data Term (variables : Nat) : Set where
  variable-term : Fin variables -> Term variables
  zero-term : Term variables
  one-term : Term variables
  add-term : Term variables -> Term variables -> Term variables
  multiply-term : Term variables -> Term variables -> Term variables

data Formula (variables : Nat) : Set where
  equal-formula :
    Term variables ->
    Term variables ->
    Formula variables
  less-formula :
    Term variables ->
    Term variables ->
    Formula variables
  false-formula : Formula variables
  conjunction :
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables
  disjunction :
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables
  implication :
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables
  negation :
    Formula variables ->
    Formula variables
  universal :
    Formula (suc variables) ->
    Formula variables
  existential :
    Formula (suc variables) ->
    Formula variables

Environment : Nat -> Set
Environment variables =
  Fin variables -> Nat

extend-environment :
  {variables : Nat} ->
  Environment variables ->
  Nat ->
  Environment (suc variables)
extend-environment environment value first-variable =
  value
extend-environment environment value (next-variable index) =
  environment index

evaluate-term :
  {variables : Nat} ->
  Term variables ->
  Environment variables ->
  Nat
evaluate-term (variable-term index) environment =
  environment index
evaluate-term zero-term environment =
  zero
evaluate-term one-term environment =
  suc zero
evaluate-term (add-term left right) environment =
  evaluate-term left environment + evaluate-term right environment
evaluate-term (multiply-term left right) environment =
  evaluate-term left environment * evaluate-term right environment

Satisfies :
  {variables : Nat} ->
  Formula variables ->
  Environment variables ->
  Set
Satisfies (equal-formula left right) environment =
  evaluate-term left environment == evaluate-term right environment
Satisfies (less-formula left right) environment =
  (evaluate-term left environment < evaluate-term right environment) == true
Satisfies false-formula environment =
  Bottom
Satisfies (conjunction left right) environment =
  Satisfies left environment and Satisfies right environment
Satisfies (disjunction left right) environment =
  Satisfies left environment or Satisfies right environment
Satisfies (implication left right) environment =
  Satisfies left environment -> Satisfies right environment
Satisfies (negation proposition) environment =
  Not (Satisfies proposition environment)
Satisfies (universal body) environment =
  (value : Nat) ->
  Satisfies body (extend-environment environment value)
Satisfies (existential body) environment =
  Exists Nat
    (\ value ->
      Satisfies body (extend-environment environment value))

empty-environment : Environment zero
empty-environment ()

TrueInStandardNaturals : Formula zero -> Set
TrueInStandardNaturals sentence =
  Satisfies sentence empty-environment

lift-renaming :
  {source target : Nat} ->
  (Fin source -> Fin target) ->
  Fin (suc source) ->
  Fin (suc target)
lift-renaming rho first-variable =
  first-variable
lift-renaming rho (next-variable index) =
  next-variable (rho index)

rename-term :
  {source target : Nat} ->
  (Fin source -> Fin target) ->
  Term source ->
  Term target
rename-term rho (variable-term index) =
  variable-term (rho index)
rename-term rho zero-term =
  zero-term
rename-term rho one-term =
  one-term
rename-term rho (add-term left right) =
  add-term
    (rename-term rho left)
    (rename-term rho right)
rename-term rho (multiply-term left right) =
  multiply-term
    (rename-term rho left)
    (rename-term rho right)

lift-substitution :
  {source target : Nat} ->
  (Fin source -> Term target) ->
  Fin (suc source) ->
  Term (suc target)
lift-substitution substitution first-variable =
  variable-term first-variable
lift-substitution substitution (next-variable index) =
  rename-term next-variable (substitution index)

substitute-term :
  {source target : Nat} ->
  (Fin source -> Term target) ->
  Term source ->
  Term target
substitute-term substitution (variable-term index) =
  substitution index
substitute-term substitution zero-term =
  zero-term
substitute-term substitution one-term =
  one-term
substitute-term substitution (add-term left right) =
  add-term
    (substitute-term substitution left)
    (substitute-term substitution right)
substitute-term substitution (multiply-term left right) =
  multiply-term
    (substitute-term substitution left)
    (substitute-term substitution right)

substitute-formula :
  {source target : Nat} ->
  (Fin source -> Term target) ->
  Formula source ->
  Formula target
substitute-formula substitution (equal-formula left right) =
  equal-formula
    (substitute-term substitution left)
    (substitute-term substitution right)
substitute-formula substitution (less-formula left right) =
  less-formula
    (substitute-term substitution left)
    (substitute-term substitution right)
substitute-formula substitution false-formula =
  false-formula
substitute-formula substitution (conjunction left right) =
  conjunction
    (substitute-formula substitution left)
    (substitute-formula substitution right)
substitute-formula substitution (disjunction left right) =
  disjunction
    (substitute-formula substitution left)
    (substitute-formula substitution right)
substitute-formula substitution (implication left right) =
  implication
    (substitute-formula substitution left)
    (substitute-formula substitution right)
substitute-formula substitution (negation proposition) =
  negation (substitute-formula substitution proposition)
substitute-formula substitution (universal body) =
  universal
    (substitute-formula (lift-substitution substitution) body)
substitute-formula substitution (existential body) =
  existential
    (substitute-formula (lift-substitution substitution) body)

numeral : Nat -> Term zero
numeral zero =
  zero-term
numeral (suc n) =
  add-term one-term (numeral n)

instantiate :
  Formula (suc zero) ->
  Nat ->
  Formula zero
instantiate unary-formula number =
  substitute-formula replacement unary-formula
  where
  replacement : Fin (suc zero) -> Term zero
  replacement first-variable =
    numeral number

-- A fixed computable Gödel numbering of the concrete syntax above.
pair-natural : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
pair-natural left right with left < right
... | true =
  right * right + left
... | false =
  left * left + left + right

fin-code :
  {variables : Nat} ->
  Fin variables ->
  Nat
fin-code first-variable =
  zero
fin-code (next-variable index) =
  suc (fin-code index)

term-code :
  {variables : Nat} ->
  Term variables ->
  Nat
term-code (variable-term index) =
  pair-natural 0 (fin-code index)
term-code zero-term =
  pair-natural 1 0
term-code one-term =
  pair-natural 2 0
term-code (add-term left right) =
  pair-natural 3
    (pair-natural (term-code left) (term-code right))
term-code (multiply-term left right) =
  pair-natural 4
    (pair-natural (term-code left) (term-code right))

formula-code :
  {variables : Nat} ->
  Formula variables ->
  Nat
formula-code (equal-formula left right) =
  pair-natural 0
    (pair-natural (term-code left) (term-code right))
formula-code (less-formula left right) =
  pair-natural 1
    (pair-natural (term-code left) (term-code right))
formula-code false-formula =
  pair-natural 2 0
formula-code (conjunction left right) =
  pair-natural 3
    (pair-natural (formula-code left) (formula-code right))
formula-code (disjunction left right) =
  pair-natural 4
    (pair-natural (formula-code left) (formula-code right))
formula-code (implication left right) =
  pair-natural 5
    (pair-natural (formula-code left) (formula-code right))
formula-code (negation proposition) =
  pair-natural 6 (formula-code proposition)
formula-code (universal body) =
  pair-natural 7 (formula-code body)
formula-code (existential body) =
  pair-natural 8 (formula-code body)

tarski-s-indefinability-theorem : Set
tarski-s-indefinability-theorem =
  Not
    (Exists
      (Formula (suc zero))
      (\ truth-formula ->
        (sentence : Formula zero) ->
        (TrueInStandardNaturals sentence) iff
        (TrueInStandardNaturals
          (instantiate truth-formula (formula-code sentence)))))

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q574902 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability
  theorem": no unary first-order arithmetic formula defines truth in the
  standard natural-number structure for every arithmetic sentence. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib bossLib;
open arithmeticTheory;

Datatype:
  q574902_term =
    Q574902Var num
  | Q574902Zero
  | Q574902One
  | Q574902Add q574902_term q574902_term
  | Q574902Mul q574902_term q574902_term
End

Datatype:
  q574902_formula =
    Q574902Equal q574902_term q574902_term
  | Q574902Less q574902_term q574902_term
  | Q574902Not q574902_formula
  | Q574902And q574902_formula q574902_formula
  | Q574902Forall q574902_formula
End

val q574902_term_closed_at_def = Define`
  (q574902_term_closed_at k (Q574902Var n) <=> n < k) /\
  (q574902_term_closed_at k Q574902Zero <=> T) /\
  (q574902_term_closed_at k Q574902One <=> T) /\
  (q574902_term_closed_at k (Q574902Add s t) <=>
     q574902_term_closed_at k s /\ q574902_term_closed_at k t) /\
  (q574902_term_closed_at k (Q574902Mul s t) <=>
     q574902_term_closed_at k s /\ q574902_term_closed_at k t)`;

val q574902_formula_closed_at_def = Define`
  (q574902_formula_closed_at k (Q574902Equal s t) <=>
     q574902_term_closed_at k s /\ q574902_term_closed_at k t) /\
  (q574902_formula_closed_at k (Q574902Less s t) <=>
     q574902_term_closed_at k s /\ q574902_term_closed_at k t) /\
  (q574902_formula_closed_at k (Q574902Not p) <=>
     q574902_formula_closed_at k p) /\
  (q574902_formula_closed_at k (Q574902And p q) <=>
     q574902_formula_closed_at k p /\
     q574902_formula_closed_at k q) /\
  (q574902_formula_closed_at k (Q574902Forall p) <=>
     q574902_formula_closed_at (SUC k) p)`;

val q574902_numeral_def = Define`
  (q574902_numeral 0 = Q574902Zero) /\
  (q574902_numeral (SUC n) =
     Q574902Add Q574902One (q574902_numeral n))`;

val q574902_subst_num_term_def = Define`
  (q574902_subst_num_term depth code (Q574902Var n) =
     if n = depth then q574902_numeral code
     else if depth < n then Q574902Var (PRE n)
     else Q574902Var n) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_term depth code Q574902Zero = Q574902Zero) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_term depth code Q574902One = Q574902One) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_term depth code (Q574902Add s t) =
     Q574902Add
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code s)
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code t)) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_term depth code (Q574902Mul s t) =
     Q574902Mul
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code s)
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code t))`;

val q574902_subst_num_formula_def = Define`
  (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code (Q574902Equal s t) =
     Q574902Equal
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code s)
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code t)) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code (Q574902Less s t) =
     Q574902Less
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code s)
       (q574902_subst_num_term depth code t)) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code (Q574902Not p) =
     Q574902Not (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code p)) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code (Q574902And p q) =
     Q574902And
       (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code p)
       (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code q)) /\
  (q574902_subst_num_formula depth code (Q574902Forall p) =
     Q574902Forall
       (q574902_subst_num_formula (SUC depth) code p))`;

val q574902_instantiate_def = new_definition (
  "q574902_instantiate_def",
  ``q574902_instantiate p code =
      q574902_subst_num_formula 0 code p``
);

val q574902_term_value_def = Define`
  (q574902_term_value v (Q574902Var n) = v n) /\
  (q574902_term_value v Q574902Zero = 0) /\
  (q574902_term_value v Q574902One = 1) /\
  (q574902_term_value v (Q574902Add s t) =
     q574902_term_value v s + q574902_term_value v t) /\
  (q574902_term_value v (Q574902Mul s t) =
     q574902_term_value v s * q574902_term_value v t)`;

val q574902_satisfies_def = Define`
  (q574902_satisfies v (Q574902Equal s t) <=>
     q574902_term_value v s = q574902_term_value v t) /\
  (q574902_satisfies v (Q574902Less s t) <=>
     q574902_term_value v s < q574902_term_value v t) /\
  (q574902_satisfies v (Q574902Not p) <=>
     ~q574902_satisfies v p) /\
  (q574902_satisfies v (Q574902And p q) <=>
     q574902_satisfies v p /\ q574902_satisfies v q) /\
  (q574902_satisfies v (Q574902Forall p) <=>
     !x : num.
       q574902_satisfies
         (\n. if n = 0 then x else v (PRE n)) p)`;

val q574902_truth_def = new_definition (
  "q574902_truth_def",
  ``q574902_truth p <=> q574902_satisfies (\n : num. 0) p``
);

val q574902_pair_def = new_definition (
  "q574902_pair_def",
  ``q574902_pair a b =
      ((a + b) * (a + b + 1)) DIV 2 + b``
);

val q574902_term_code_def = Define`
  (q574902_term_code (Q574902Var n) = 5 * n) /\
  (q574902_term_code Q574902Zero = 1) /\
  (q574902_term_code Q574902One = 2) /\
  (q574902_term_code (Q574902Add s t) =
     5 * q574902_pair
       (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t) + 3) /\
  (q574902_term_code (Q574902Mul s t) =
     5 * q574902_pair
       (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t) + 4)`;

val q574902_formula_code_def = Define`
  (q574902_formula_code (Q574902Equal s t) =
     6 * q574902_pair
       (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t)) /\
  (q574902_formula_code (Q574902Less s t) =
     6 * q574902_pair
       (q574902_term_code s) (q574902_term_code t) + 1) /\
  (q574902_formula_code (Q574902Not p) =
     6 * q574902_formula_code p + 2) /\
  (q574902_formula_code (Q574902And p q) =
     6 * q574902_pair
       (q574902_formula_code p) (q574902_formula_code q) + 3) /\
  (q574902_formula_code (Q574902Forall p) =
     6 * q574902_formula_code p + 4)`;

val q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem =
  ``~(?tau : q574902_formula.
       q574902_formula_closed_at 1 tau /\
       !sigma : q574902_formula.
         q574902_formula_closed_at 0 sigma
         ==>
         (q574902_truth sigma <=>
          q574902_truth
            (q574902_instantiate tau
              (q574902_formula_code sigma))))``;

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q574902
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q574902), "Tarski's indefinability theorem":
  no arithmetic formula with at most one free variable defines, by
  substitution of sentence codes, truth of every arithmetic sentence in the
  standard natural-number model. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Arithmetic terms and formulas are concrete finite tagged trees for the
  ordered-semiring language with zero, one, addition, multiplication, and
  strict order. Q574902TermsAt n contains the terms whose de Bruijn variable
  indices are below n. Q574902FormulaLevels contains <. n , p >. exactly when
  p is a formula with n available variables; universal quantification binds
  the last available variable. Thus level zero gives sentences and level one
  gives semisentences with at most one free variable.

  Q574902Eval and Q574902Sat are the compositional Tarski semantics in the
  standard model NN0. Q574902CodeFormula is an explicit Goedel coding, and
  Q574902Instantiate replaces variable zero by the closed numeral for a code,
  shifting the remaining de Bruijn indices down by one.

  Foundation uses truth, falsity, positive and negative atoms, conjunction,
  disjunction, universal quantification, and existential quantification as
  primitive formula constructors. Its basis and the positive-atom,
  implication, negation, and universal-quantification basis used here are
  recursively intertranslatable in both directions while preserving
  standard-model satisfaction; the omitted connectives have their usual
  classical definitions. Likewise, this injective Goedel numbering and
  Foundation's constructor numbering are recursively interconvertible on
  well-formed terms and formulas. Arithmetic represents both recoding maps,
  so a unary arithmetic truth definition relative to either presentation
  transports to one relative to the other, in both directions.

  The final unproved $a assertion is therefore bidirectionally logically
  equivalent to the cataloged negation of the existence of a unary arithmetic
  truth predicate, rather than a restriction to weaker syntax or externally
  supplied witnesses. All earlier $a declarations are syntax or faithful
  definitions, and this database contains no $p statement.
$)

$c Q574902Var Q574902Zero Q574902One Q574902Add Q574902Mul $.
$c Q574902Eq Q574902Lt Q574902Imp Q574902Neg Q574902All $.
$c Q574902TermsAt Q574902Terms Q574902FormulaLevels $.
$c Q574902Formulas Q574902Sentences Q574902UnaryFormulas $.
$c Q574902PairCode Q574902CodeTerm Q574902CodeFormula $.
$c Q574902Numeral Q574902InstTerm Q574902Instantiate $.
$c Q574902Eval Q574902Sat Q574902Truth $.

q574902-var-syntax $a class ( Q574902Var A ) $.
q574902-zero-syntax $a class Q574902Zero $.
q574902-one-syntax $a class Q574902One $.
q574902-add-syntax $a class ( Q574902Add A B ) $.
q574902-mul-syntax $a class ( Q574902Mul A B ) $.
q574902-eq-syntax $a class ( Q574902Eq A B ) $.
q574902-lt-syntax $a class ( Q574902Lt A B ) $.
q574902-imp-syntax $a class ( Q574902Imp A B ) $.
q574902-neg-syntax $a class ( Q574902Neg A ) $.
q574902-all-syntax $a class ( Q574902All A ) $.
q574902-terms-at-syntax $a class ( Q574902TermsAt A ) $.
q574902-terms-syntax $a class Q574902Terms $.
q574902-formula-levels-syntax $a class Q574902FormulaLevels $.
q574902-formulas-syntax $a class Q574902Formulas $.
q574902-sentences-syntax $a class Q574902Sentences $.
q574902-unary-formulas-syntax $a class Q574902UnaryFormulas $.
q574902-pair-code-syntax $a class ( Q574902PairCode A B ) $.
q574902-code-term-syntax $a class ( Q574902CodeTerm A ) $.
q574902-code-formula-syntax $a class ( Q574902CodeFormula A ) $.
q574902-numeral-syntax $a class ( Q574902Numeral A ) $.
q574902-inst-term-syntax $a class ( Q574902InstTerm A B ) $.
q574902-instantiate-syntax $a class ( Q574902Instantiate A B ) $.
q574902-eval-syntax $a wff ( Q574902Eval E ) $.
q574902-sat-syntax $a wff ( Q574902Sat E S ) $.
q574902-truth-syntax $a wff ( Q574902Truth A ) $.

q574902-var-definition $a |- ( Q574902Var A ) = <. 0 , A >. $.
q574902-zero-definition $a |- Q574902Zero = <. 1 , 0 >. $.
q574902-one-definition $a |- Q574902One = <. 2 , 0 >. $.
q574902-add-definition $a |- ( Q574902Add A B ) =
  <. 3 , <. A , B >. >. $.
q574902-mul-definition $a |- ( Q574902Mul A B ) =
  <. 4 , <. A , B >. >. $.
q574902-eq-definition $a |- ( Q574902Eq A B ) =
  <. 5 , <. A , B >. >. $.
q574902-lt-definition $a |- ( Q574902Lt A B ) =
  <. 6 , <. A , B >. >. $.
q574902-imp-definition $a |- ( Q574902Imp A B ) =
  <. 7 , <. A , B >. >. $.
q574902-neg-definition $a |- ( Q574902Neg A ) = <. 8 , A >. $.
q574902-all-definition $a |- ( Q574902All A ) = <. 9 , A >. $.

${
  $d A B C i n $.

  q574902-terms-at-definition $a |- ( Q574902TermsAt n ) =
    |^| { C |
      (
        (
          A. i e. ( 0 ..^ n ) ( Q574902Var i ) e. C
          /\
          Q574902Zero e. C
        )
        /\
        (
          Q574902One e. C
          /\
          A. A e. C A. B e. C
            (
              ( Q574902Add A B ) e. C
              /\
              ( Q574902Mul A B ) e. C
            )
        )
      )
    } $.
$}

q574902-terms-definition $a |- Q574902Terms =
  U_ n e. NN0 ( Q574902TermsAt n ) $.

${
  $d A B C n $.

  q574902-formula-levels-definition $a |- Q574902FormulaLevels =
    |^| { C |
      A. n e. NN0
        (
          A. A e. ( Q574902TermsAt n )
            A. B e. ( Q574902TermsAt n )
              (
                <. n , ( Q574902Eq A B ) >. e. C
                /\
                <. n , ( Q574902Lt A B ) >. e. C
              )
          /\
          (
            A. A A. B
              (
                (
                  <. n , A >. e. C
                  /\
                  <. n , B >. e. C
                )
                ->
                <. n , ( Q574902Imp A B ) >. e. C
              )
            /\
            (
              A. A
                (
                  <. n , A >. e. C
                  ->
                  <. n , ( Q574902Neg A ) >. e. C
                )
              /\
              A. A
                (
                  <. ( n + 1 ) , A >. e. C
                  ->
                  <. n , ( Q574902All A ) >. e. C
                )
            )
          )
        )
    } $.
$}

q574902-formulas-definition $a |- Q574902Formulas =
  ran Q574902FormulaLevels $.

q574902-sentences-definition $a |- Q574902Sentences =
  { A e. Q574902Formulas | <. 0 , A >. e. Q574902FormulaLevels } $.

q574902-unary-formulas-definition $a |- Q574902UnaryFormulas =
  { A e. Q574902Formulas | <. 1 , A >. e. Q574902FormulaLevels } $.

q574902-pair-code-definition $a |- ( Q574902PairCode A B ) =
  ( ( 2 ^ A ) x. ( ( 2 x. B ) + 1 ) ) $.

q574902-code-term-var $a |- (
  Q574902CodeTerm ( Q574902Var A )
) = ( 5 x. A ) $.

q574902-code-term-zero $a |- (
  Q574902CodeTerm Q574902Zero
) = 1 $.

q574902-code-term-one $a |- (
  Q574902CodeTerm Q574902One
) = 2 $.

q574902-code-term-add $a |- (
  Q574902CodeTerm ( Q574902Add A B )
) = (
  ( 5 x.
    ( Q574902PairCode
      ( Q574902CodeTerm A )
      ( Q574902CodeTerm B ) ) )
  + 3
) $.

q574902-code-term-mul $a |- (
  Q574902CodeTerm ( Q574902Mul A B )
) = (
  ( 5 x.
    ( Q574902PairCode
      ( Q574902CodeTerm A )
      ( Q574902CodeTerm B ) ) )
  + 4
) $.

q574902-code-formula-eq $a |- (
  Q574902CodeFormula ( Q574902Eq A B )
) = (
  5 x.
  ( Q574902PairCode
    ( Q574902CodeTerm A )
    ( Q574902CodeTerm B ) )
) $.

q574902-code-formula-lt $a |- (
  Q574902CodeFormula ( Q574902Lt A B )
) = (
  ( 5 x.
    ( Q574902PairCode
      ( Q574902CodeTerm A )
      ( Q574902CodeTerm B ) ) )
  + 1
) $.

q574902-code-formula-imp $a |- (
  Q574902CodeFormula ( Q574902Imp A B )
) = (
  ( 5 x.
    ( Q574902PairCode
      ( Q574902CodeFormula A )
      ( Q574902CodeFormula B ) ) )
  + 2
) $.

q574902-code-formula-neg $a |- (
  Q574902CodeFormula ( Q574902Neg A )
) = ( ( 5 x. ( Q574902CodeFormula A ) ) + 3 ) $.

q574902-code-formula-all $a |- (
  Q574902CodeFormula ( Q574902All A )
) = ( ( 5 x. ( Q574902CodeFormula A ) ) + 4 ) $.

q574902-numeral-zero $a |- (
  Q574902Numeral 0
) = Q574902Zero $.

q574902-numeral-successor $a |- (
  A e. NN0
  ->
  ( Q574902Numeral ( A + 1 ) ) =
    ( Q574902Add ( Q574902Numeral A ) Q574902One )
) $.

q574902-inst-term-var $a |- (
  Q574902InstTerm ( Q574902Var A ) B
) = if (
  A = 0 ,
  ( Q574902Numeral B ) ,
  ( Q574902Var U. A )
) $.

q574902-inst-term-zero $a |- (
  Q574902InstTerm Q574902Zero B
) = Q574902Zero $.

q574902-inst-term-one $a |- (
  Q574902InstTerm Q574902One B
) = Q574902One $.

q574902-inst-term-add $a |- (
  Q574902InstTerm ( Q574902Add A B ) C
) = (
  Q574902Add
    ( Q574902InstTerm A C )
    ( Q574902InstTerm B C )
) $.

q574902-inst-term-mul $a |- (

${

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q574902,
:: "Tarski's indefinability theorem": no unary first-order arithmetic formula
:: defines truth for every arithmetic sentence in the standard natural-number
:: model when applied to that sentence's Gödel code. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
      FUNCT_2, NUMBERS, NAT_1, ARYTM_3, ARYTM_1, INT_1, XCMPLX_0,
      XXREAL_0, SETFAM_1, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1, FUNCT_3,
      PARTFUN1, XREAL_0, REAL_1, VALUED_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, NAT_1,
      NAT_D, SETFAM_1, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1, PARTFUN1,
      FUNCT_3, INT_1, INT_2, REAL_1, XXREAL_0;
 constructors ZFMISC_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, NAT_1, XXREAL_0, REAL_1,
      NAT_D, SETFAM_1, MCART_1, XTUPLE_0, BINOP_1, PARTFUN1,
      FUNCT_3, INT_1, INT_2;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2,
      ORDINAL1, NAT_1, INT_1, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XTUPLE_0, PARTFUN1,
      FUNCT_3, NUMBERS, MEMBERED, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, ARITHM, REAL;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for vr,nu,ng,al being Function of NAT,NAT,
      z,o being Nat,
      ad,mu,eqc,ltc,cj being Function of [:NAT,NAT:],NAT,
      tb,fb being Relation of NAT,NAT,
      ts,fs being Function of [:NAT,NAT,NAT:],NAT,
      ev being Function of [:NAT,Funcs(NAT,NAT):],NAT,
      sat being Relation of NAT,Funcs(NAT,NAT) st
    (for n being Nat holds vr.n = 6*n) &
    z = 1 & o = 2 &
    (for a,b being Nat holds
      ad.(a,b) = 6*((((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b)+3 &
      mu.(a,b) = 6*((((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b)+4 &
      eqc.(a,b) = 6*((((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b) &
      ltc.(a,b) = 6*((((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b)+1 &
      cj.(a,b) = 6*((((a+b)*(a+b+1)) div 2)+b)+3) &
    (for A being Nat holds
      ng.A = 6*A+2 &
      al.A = 6*A+4) &

    tb =
      meet {R where R is Subset of [:NAT,NAT:] :
        (for k,n being Nat st n < k holds [k,vr.n] in R) &
        (for k being Nat holds [k,z] in R & [k,o] in R) &
        (for k,a,b being Nat st [k,a] in R & [k,b] in R holds
          [k,ad.(a,b)] in R &
          [k,mu.(a,b)] in R)} &

    fb =
      meet {R where R is Subset of [:NAT,NAT:] :
        (for k,a,b being Nat st
          [k,a] in tb & [k,b] in tb
         holds
          [k,eqc.(a,b)] in R &
          [k,ltc.(a,b)] in R) &
        (for k,A being Nat st [k,A] in R holds
          [k,ng.A] in R) &
        (for k,A,B being Nat st [k,A] in R & [k,B] in R holds
          [k,cj.(A,B)] in R) &
        (for k,A being Nat st [k+1,A] in R holds
          [k,al.A] in R)} &

    nu.(1-'1) = z &
    (for n being Nat holds
      nu.(n+1) = ad.(nu.n,o)) &

    (for k,n,d being Nat holds
      (k < d implies ts.[vr.k,n,d] = vr.k) &
      (k = d implies ts.[vr.k,n,d] = nu.n) &
      (d < k implies ts.[vr.k,n,d] = vr.(k-1))) &
    (for n,d being Nat holds
      ts.[z,n,d] = z &
      ts.[o,n,d] = o) &
    (for a,b,n,d being Nat holds
      ts.[ad.(a,b),n,d] = ad.(ts.[a,n,d],ts.[b,n,d]) &
      ts.[mu.(a,b),n,d] = mu.(ts.[a,n,d],ts.[b,n,d])) &

    (for a,b,n,d being Nat holds
      fs.[eqc.(a,b),n,d] = eqc.(ts.[a,n,d],ts.[b,n,d]) &
      fs.[ltc.(a,b),n,d] = ltc.(ts.[a,n,d],ts.[b,n,d])) &
    (for A,n,d being Nat holds
      fs.[ng.A,n,d] = ng.(fs.[A,n,d])) &
    (for A,B,n,d being Nat holds
      fs.[cj.(A,B),n,d] = cj.(fs.[A,n,d],fs.[B,n,d])) &
    (for A,n,d being Nat holds
      fs.[al.A,n,d] = al.(fs.[A,n,d+1])) &

    (for k being Nat,v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ev.[vr.k,v] = v.k) &
    (for v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ev.[z,v] = 1-'1 &
      ev.[o,v] = 1) &
    (for a,b being Nat,v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ex x,y being Nat st
        x = ev.[a,v] & y = ev.[b,v] &
        ev.[ad.(a,b),v] = x+y &
        ev.[mu.(a,b),v] = x*y) &

    (for a,b being Nat,v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ([eqc.(a,b),v] in sat iff
        ex x,y being Nat st
          x = ev.[a,v] & y = ev.[b,v] & x = y) &
      ([ltc.(a,b),v] in sat iff
        ex x,y being Nat st
          x = ev.[a,v] & y = ev.[b,v] & x < y)) &
    (for A being Nat,v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ([ng.A,v] in sat iff not [A,v] in sat)) &
    (for A,B being Nat,v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ([cj.(A,B),v] in sat iff
        [A,v] in sat & [B,v] in sat)) &
    (for A being Nat,v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
      ([al.A,v] in sat iff
        for n being Nat holds
          ex w being Function of NAT,NAT st
            w.(1-'1) = n &
            (for k being Nat holds w.(k+1) = v.k) &
            [A,w] in sat))
  holds
    not ex tau being Nat st
      [1,tau] in fb &
      for sigma being Nat st [1-'1,sigma] in fb holds
        ((for v being Function of NAT,NAT holds
            [sigma,v] in sat)
         iff
         (ex rho being Nat st
            rho = fs.[tau,sigma,1-'1] &
            for v being Function of NAT,NAT holds [rho,v] in sat))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q574902,
% "Tarski's indefinability theorem": no unary first-order arithmetic formula
% defines truth for every closed arithmetic sentence in the standard
% natural-number model. This file contains no proof.

q574902_arithmetic_term: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  q574902_variable(variable_index: nat): q574902_variable?
  q574902_zero: q574902_zero?
  q574902_one: q574902_one?
  q574902_add(add_left, add_right: q574902_arithmetic_term): q574902_add?
  q574902_multiply(
      multiply_left,
      multiply_right: q574902_arithmetic_term): q574902_multiply?
END q574902_arithmetic_term

q574902_arithmetic_formula: DATATYPE
BEGIN
  IMPORTING q574902_arithmetic_term
  q574902_false: q574902_false?
  q574902_equal(
      equal_left,
      equal_right: q574902_arithmetic_term): q574902_equal?
  q574902_less(
      less_left,
      less_right: q574902_arithmetic_term): q574902_less?
  q574902_implies(
      implication_left,
      implication_right: q574902_arithmetic_formula): q574902_implies?
  q574902_forall(
      universal_body: q574902_arithmetic_formula): q574902_forall?
END q574902_arithmetic_formula

Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING q574902_arithmetic_term, q574902_arithmetic_formula

  term: TYPE = q574902_arithmetic_term
  arith_formula: TYPE = q574902_arithmetic_formula

  term_bounded(bound: nat, t: term): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES t OF
      q574902_variable(index):
        index < bound,
      q574902_zero:
        TRUE,
      q574902_one:
        TRUE,
      q574902_add(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right),
      q574902_multiply(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  formula_bounded(bound: nat, phi: arith_formula): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES phi OF
      q574902_false:
        TRUE,
      q574902_equal(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right),
      q574902_less(left, right):
        term_bounded(bound, left)
          AND term_bounded(bound, right),
      q574902_implies(left, right):
        formula_bounded(bound, left)
          AND formula_bounded(bound, right),
      q574902_forall(body):
        formula_bounded(bound + 1, body)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE phi BY <<

  unary_formula: TYPE =
    {phi: arith_formula | formula_bounded(1, phi)}

  sentence: TYPE =
    {phi: arith_formula | formula_bounded(0, phi)}

  lift_term_at(
      t: term,
      amount: nat,
      cutoff: nat): RECURSIVE term =
    CASES t OF
      q574902_variable(index):
        q574902_variable(
          IF cutoff <= index THEN index + amount ELSE index ENDIF),
      q574902_zero:
        q574902_zero,
      q574902_one:
        q574902_one,
      q574902_add(left, right):
        q574902_add(
          lift_term_at(left, amount, cutoff),
          lift_term_at(right, amount, cutoff)),
      q574902_multiply(left, right):
        q574902_multiply(
          lift_term_at(left, amount, cutoff),
          lift_term_at(right, amount, cutoff))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  substitute_term(
      t: term,
      replacement: term,
      index: nat): RECURSIVE term =
    CASES t OF
      q574902_variable(variable_index):
        IF variable_index < index THEN
          q574902_variable(variable_index)
        ELSIF variable_index = index THEN
          lift_term_at(replacement, index, 0)
        ELSE
          q574902_variable(variable_index - 1)
        ENDIF,
      q574902_zero:
        q574902_zero,
      q574902_one:
        q574902_one,
      q574902_add(left, right):
        q574902_add(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index)),
      q574902_multiply(left, right):
        q574902_multiply(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  substitute_formula(
      phi: arith_formula,
      replacement: term,
      index: nat): RECURSIVE arith_formula =
    CASES phi OF
      q574902_false:
        q574902_false,
      q574902_equal(left, right):
        q574902_equal(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index)),
      q574902_less(left, right):
        q574902_less(
          substitute_term(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_term(right, replacement, index)),
      q574902_implies(left, right):
        q574902_implies(
          substitute_formula(left, replacement, index),
          substitute_formula(right, replacement, index)),
      q574902_forall(body):
        q574902_forall(
          substitute_formula(body, replacement, index + 1))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE phi BY <<

  numeral(value: nat): RECURSIVE term =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      q574902_zero
    ELSE
      q574902_add(q574902_one, numeral(value - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  natural_pair(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF left < right THEN
      right * right + left
    ELSE
      left * left + left + right
    ENDIF

  term_code(t: term): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES t OF
      q574902_variable(index):
        5 * index,
      q574902_zero:
        1,
      q574902_one:
        2,
      q574902_add(left, right):
        5 * natural_pair(term_code(left), term_code(right)) + 3,
      q574902_multiply(left, right):
        5 * natural_pair(term_code(left), term_code(right)) + 4
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  formula_code(phi: arith_formula): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES phi OF
      q574902_false:
        0,
      q574902_equal(left, right):
        5 * natural_pair(term_code(left), term_code(right)) + 1,
      q574902_less(left, right):
        5 * natural_pair(term_code(left), term_code(right)) + 2,
      q574902_implies(left, right):
        5 * natural_pair(formula_code(left), formula_code(right)) + 3,
      q574902_forall(body):
        5 * formula_code(body) + 4
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE phi BY <<

  evaluate_term(
      t: term,
      assignment: [nat -> nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES t OF
      q574902_variable(index):
        assignment(index),
      q574902_zero:
        0,
      q574902_one:
        1,
      q574902_add(left, right):
        evaluate_term(left, assignment)
          + evaluate_term(right, assignment),
      q574902_multiply(left, right):
        evaluate_term(left, assignment)
          * evaluate_term(right, assignment)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE t BY <<

  standard_holds(
      phi: arith_formula,
      assignment: [nat -> nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES phi OF
      q574902_false:
        FALSE,
      q574902_equal(left, right):
        evaluate_term(left, assignment)
          = evaluate_term(right, assignment),
      q574902_less(left, right):
        evaluate_term(left, assignment)
          < evaluate_term(right, assignment),
      q574902_implies(left, right):
        standard_holds(left, assignment)
          IMPLIES standard_holds(right, assignment),
      q574902_forall(body):
        FORALL (value: nat):
          standard_holds(
            body,
            LAMBDA (other_index: nat):
              IF other_index = 0 THEN
                value
              ELSE
                assignment(other_index - 1)
              ENDIF)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE phi BY <<

  standard_true(phi: arith_formula): bool =
    standard_holds(
      phi,
      LAMBDA (index: nat): 0)

  tarski_undefinability_of_truth: bool =
    NOT EXISTS (tau: unary_formula):
      FORALL (sigma: sentence):
        standard_true(sigma)
          IFF
        standard_true(
          substitute_formula(
            tau,
            numeral(formula_code(sigma)),
            0))
END Q574902_tarski_s_indefinability_theorem
