-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q576478
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q576478), "Liouville's theorem (complex analysis)":
-- a globally complex-differentiable map between complex normed spaces with bounded range
-- takes equal values at every pair of points. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Trigonometric
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Bounded

@[expose] public section

universe u v

-- Restore the canonical complex normed-field instances omitted by the reduced module graph.
noncomputable local instance : NormedField ℂ where
  dist_eq _ _ := rfl
  norm_mul := Complex.norm_mul

noncomputable local instance : NontriviallyNormedField ℂ where
  non_trivial := ⟨2, Complex.norm_two.symm ▸ one_lt_two⟩

namespace Q576478

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
variable {F : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F]

/-- Liouville's theorem for bounded complex-differentiable maps between complex normed spaces. -/
theorem apply_eq_apply_of_bounded_statement {f : E → F} (hf : Differentiable ℂ f)
    (hb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range f)) (z w : E) : f z = f w := sorry

end Q576478

title: Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q576478
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q576478), "Liouville's theorem (complex
  analysis)": an everywhere complex-differentiable map between complex normed
  vector spaces with bounded range takes the same value at every two points.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q576478_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q576478_czero : q576478_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q576478_cone : q576478_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q576478_cadd
    (z w : q576478_complex) : q576478_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q576478_cneg
    (z : q576478_complex) : q576478_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q576478_cmul
    (z w : q576478_complex) : q576478_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q576478_cmodulus
    (z : q576478_complex) : R :=
  sqrt (fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z).

Record q576478_normed_complex_vector_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q576478_zero : E;
  q576478_add : E -> E -> E;
  q576478_neg : E -> E;
  q576478_smul : q576478_complex -> E -> E;
  q576478_norm : E -> R;

  q576478_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q576478_add x (q576478_add y z) =
      q576478_add (q576478_add x y) z;
  q576478_add_comm :
    forall x y : E, q576478_add x y = q576478_add y x;
  q576478_add_zero :
    forall x : E, q576478_add x q576478_zero = x;
  q576478_add_neg :
    forall x : E, q576478_add x (q576478_neg x) = q576478_zero;

  q576478_one_smul :
    forall x : E, q576478_smul q576478_cone x = x;
  q576478_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q576478_complex) (x : E),
      q576478_smul (q576478_cmul a b) x =
      q576478_smul a (q576478_smul b x);
  q576478_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q576478_complex) (x : E),
      q576478_smul (q576478_cadd a b) x =
      q576478_add (q576478_smul a x) (q576478_smul b x);
  q576478_smul_add :
    forall (a : q576478_complex) (x y : E),
      q576478_smul a (q576478_add x y) =
      q576478_add (q576478_smul a x) (q576478_smul a y);
  q576478_zero_smul :
    forall x : E, q576478_smul q576478_czero x = q576478_zero;
  q576478_smul_zero :
    forall a : q576478_complex,
      q576478_smul a q576478_zero = q576478_zero;

  q576478_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : E, 0 <= q576478_norm x;
  q576478_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : E, q576478_norm x = 0 <-> x = q576478_zero;
  q576478_norm_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q576478_norm (q576478_neg x) = q576478_norm x;
  q576478_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : E,
      q576478_norm (q576478_add x y) <=
      q576478_norm x + q576478_norm y;
  q576478_norm_smul :
    forall (a : q576478_complex) (x : E),
      q576478_norm (q576478_smul a x) =
      q576478_cmodulus a * q576478_norm x
}.

Arguments q576478_zero {E} _.
Arguments q576478_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q576478_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q576478_smul {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q576478_norm {E} _ _.

Definition q576478_sub
    {E : Type}
    (V : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (x y : E) : E :=
  q576478_add V x (q576478_neg V y).

Record q576478_continuous_complex_linear_map
    (E F : Type)
    (VE : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (VF : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space F) : Type := {
  q576478_linear_apply : E -> F;
  q576478_linear_add :
    forall x y : E,
      q576478_linear_apply (q576478_add VE x y) =
      q576478_add VF
        (q576478_linear_apply x) (q576478_linear_apply y);
  q576478_linear_smul :
    forall (a : q576478_complex) (x : E),
      q576478_linear_apply (q576478_smul VE a x) =
      q576478_smul VF a (q576478_linear_apply x);
  q576478_linear_bounded :
    exists C : R,
      0 <= C /\
      forall x : E,
        q576478_norm VF (q576478_linear_apply x) <=
        C * q576478_norm VE x
}.

Arguments q576478_linear_apply {E F VE VF} _ _.

Definition q576478_has_frechet_derivative_at
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (VF : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space F)
    (f : E -> F) (x : E)
    (D : @q576478_continuous_complex_linear_map E F VE VF) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall h : E,
        q576478_norm VE h < delta ->
        q576478_norm VF
          (q576478_sub VF
            (q576478_sub VF
              (f (q576478_add VE x h)) (f x))
            (q576478_linear_apply D h)) <=
        epsilon * q576478_norm VE h.

Definition q576478_differentiable
    {E F : Type}
    (VE : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space E)
    (VF : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space F)
    (f : E -> F) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    exists D : @q576478_continuous_complex_linear_map E F VE VF,
      @q576478_has_frechet_derivative_at E F VE VF f x D.

Definition q576478_bounded_range
    {E F : Type}
    (VF : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space F)
    (f : E -> F) : Prop :=
  exists C : R,
    0 <= C /\
    forall x : E, q576478_norm VF (f x) <= C.

Theorem Differentiable_apply_eq_apply_of_bounded :
  forall (E F : Type)
         (VE : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space E)
         (VF : q576478_normed_complex_vector_space F)
         (f : E -> F),
    q576478_differentiable VE VF f ->
    q576478_bounded_range VF f ->
    forall z w : E, f z = f w.
Admitted.

title: Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q576478, "Liouville's theorem (complex analysis)": an everywhere complex
  Frechet-differentiable map between arbitrary complex normed vector spaces
  with bounded range takes equal values at every two points. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Complex_Analysis_Basics"
begin

definition q576478_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q576478_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q576478_complex_differentiable ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (complex \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow>
      ('e \<Rightarrow> 'f) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q576478_complex_differentiable cscaleE cscaleF f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. \<exists>D.
      (f has_derivative D) (at x) \<and>
      (\<forall>a v. D (cscaleE a v) = cscaleF a (D v)))"

theorem q576478_liouville:
  fixes cscaleE :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and cscaleF :: "complex \<Rightarrow> 'f::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f"
    and z w :: 'e
  assumes domain_complex_space: "q576478_complex_normed_vector cscaleE"
    and codomain_complex_space: "q576478_complex_normed_vector cscaleF"
    and differentiable:
      "q576478_complex_differentiable cscaleE cscaleF f"
    and bounded_range: "bounded (range f)"
  shows "f z = f w"
  sorry

end

title: Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q576478,
  "Liouville's theorem (complex analysis)": an everywhere complex
  Frechet-differentiable function between arbitrary complex normed spaces
  with bounded range takes the same value at every two points. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q576478_LIOUVILLE_THEOREM_COMPLEX_ANALYSIS =
 `let czero = ((&0:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cone = ((&1:real),(&0:real)) in
  let cadd =
    \(a:real#real) (b:real#real).
      (FST a + FST b,SND a + SND b) in
  let cmul =
    \(a:real#real) (b:real#real).
      (FST a * FST b - SND a * SND b,
       FST a * SND b + SND a * FST b) in
  let cnorm =
    \(a:real#real).
      sqrt (FST a * FST a + SND a * SND a) in
  let normed_add_comm_group_E =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A) (normE:A->real).
      (!x y z:A. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
      (!x y:A. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x:A. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x:A. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      normE zeroE = &0 /\
      (!x:A. &0 <= normE x) /\
      (!x:A. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
      (!x y:A. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
  let normed_add_comm_group_F =
    \(zeroF:B) (addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B) (normF:B->real).
      (!x y z:B. addF x (addF y z) = addF (addF x y) z) /\
      (!x y:B. addF x y = addF y x) /\
      (!x:B. addF zeroF x = x) /\
      (!x:B. addF (negF x) x = zeroF) /\
      normF zeroF = &0 /\
      (!x:B. &0 <= normF x) /\
      (!x:B. normF x = &0 <=> x = zeroF) /\
      (!x y:B. normF (addF x y) <= normF x + normF y) in
  let complex_normed_space_E =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A).
      (!x:A. smulE cone x = x) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cmul a b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:A.
         smulE (cadd a b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x y:A.
         smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. smulE czero x = zeroE) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A.
         normE (smulE a x) = cnorm a * normE x) in
  let complex_normed_space_F =
    \(zeroF:B) (addF:B->B->B) (normF:B->real)
     (smulF:(real#real)->B->B).
      (!x:B. smulF cone x = x) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:B.
         smulF (cmul a b) x = smulF a (smulF b x)) /\
      (!a b:real#real. !x:B.
         smulF (cadd a b) x = addF (smulF a x) (smulF b x)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x y:B.
         smulF a (addF x y) = addF (smulF a x) (smulF a y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. smulF a zeroF = zeroF) /\
      (!x:B. smulF czero x = zeroF) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:B.
         normF (smulF a x) = cnorm a * normF x) in
  let subF =
    \(addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B) (x:B) (y:B).
      addF x (negF y) in
  let continuous_complex_linear =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A)
     (addF:B->B->B) (normF:B->real)
     (smulF:(real#real)->B->B) (L:A->B).
      (!x y:A. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
      (!a:real#real. !x:A. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x)) /\
      (?C:real. &0 <= C /\ !x:A. normF (L x) <= C * normE x) in
  let everywhere_complex_frechet_differentiable =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (normE:A->real)
     (smulE:(real#real)->A->A)
     (addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B) (normF:B->real)
     (smulF:(real#real)->B->B) (f:A->B).
      !x:A.
        ?L:A->B.
          continuous_complex_linear
            addE normE smulE addF normF smulF L /\
          !epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon
            ==> ?delta:real.
                  &0 < delta /\
                  !h:A.
                    normE h < delta
                    ==> normF
                          (subF addF negF
                            (subF addF negF
                              (f (addE x h)) (f x))
                            (L h))
                        <= epsilon * normE h in
  let bounded_range =
    \(normF:B->real) (f:A->B).
      ?C:real. &0 <= C /\ !x:A. normF (f x) <= C in
  !zeroE:A.
  !addE:A->A->A.
  !negE:A->A.
  !normE:A->real.
  !smulE:(real#real)->A->A.
  !zeroF:B.
  !addF:B->B->B.
  !negF:B->B.
  !normF:B->real.
  !smulF:(real#real)->B->B.
  !f:A->B.
  !z w:A.
    normed_add_comm_group_E zeroE addE negE normE /\
    normed_add_comm_group_F zeroF addF negF normF /\
    complex_normed_space_E zeroE addE normE smulE /\
    complex_normed_space_F zeroF addF normF smulF /\
    everywhere_complex_frechet_differentiable
      zeroE addE normE smulE addF negF normF smulF f /\
    bounded_range normF f
    ==> f z = f w`;;

title: Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q576478,
;; "Liouville's theorem (complex analysis)": every bounded, everywhere
;; complex-Frechet-differentiable map between arbitrary complex normed vector
;; spaces takes the same value at every pair of points. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered-field presentation of the real numbers.

(defstub q576478-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q576478-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q576478-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q576478-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q576478-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q576478-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q576478-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q576478-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q576478-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defun q576478-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q576478-r-less real right left)))

(defun q576478-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q576478-r-member-p real value)
   (q576478-r-less
    real (q576478-r-zero real) value)))

(defun-sk q576478-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q576478-r-member-p real x)
      (q576478-r-member-p real y)
      (q576478-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q576478-r-zero real))
            (one (q576478-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q576478-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q576478-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q576478-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q576478-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q576478-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q576478-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q576478-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q576478-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q576478-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q576478-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q576478-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q576478-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q576478-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q576478-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q576478-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q576478-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q576478-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q576478-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q576478-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q576478-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q576478-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q576478-r-multiply
          real x (q576478-r-add real y z))
         (q576478-r-add
          real
          (q576478-r-multiply real x y)
          (q576478-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q576478-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q576478-r-member-p real x)
      (q576478-r-member-p real y)
      (q576478-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q576478-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q576478-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q576478-r-less real x y)
         (q576478-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q576478-r-less real x y)
          (q576478-r-less real y z))
         (q576478-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q576478-r-less real x y)
         (q576478-r-less
          real
          (q576478-r-add real x z)
          (q576478-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q576478-r-less real zero x)
          (q576478-r-less real zero y))
         (q576478-r-less
          real zero
          (q576478-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q576478-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q576478-r-member-p real x)
     (q576478-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q576478-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q576478-r-member-p real x)
      (q576478-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q576478-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q576478-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q576478-r-member-p real bound)
     (q576478-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q576478-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q576478-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q576478-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q576478-r-member-p real bound)
       (q576478-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q576478-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q576478-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q576478-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q576478-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q576478-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q576478-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q576478-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q576478-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q576478-r-zero real))
        (one (q576478-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q576478-r-member-p real zero)
     (q576478-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q576478-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q576478-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q576478-r-less real zero one)
     (q576478-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; The nonnegative square root and the usual complex field represented by
;; real/imaginary coordinate pairs.

(defstub q576478-r-square-root (real square-root value) t)

(defun-sk q576478-r-square-root-laws-p
    (real square-root)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q576478-r-member-p real x)
      (q576478-r-leq
       real (q576478-r-zero real) x))
     (let ((root
            (q576478-r-square-root
             real square-root x)))
       (and
        (q576478-r-member-p real root)
        (q576478-r-leq
         real (q576478-r-zero real) root)
        (equal
         (q576478-r-multiply real root root)
         x))))))

(defun q576478-complex-p (real value)
  (and
   (consp value)
   (q576478-r-member-p real (car value))
   (q576478-r-member-p real (cdr value))))

(defun q576478-c-zero (real)
  (cons
   (q576478-r-zero real)
   (q576478-r-zero real)))

(defun q576478-c-one (real)
  (cons
   (q576478-r-one real)
   (q576478-r-zero real)))

(defun q576478-c-add (real left right)
  (cons
   (q576478-r-add real (car left) (car right))
   (q576478-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right))))

(defun q576478-c-negate (real value)
  (cons
   (q576478-r-negate real (car value))
   (q576478-r-negate real (cdr value))))

(defun q576478-c-multiply (real left right)
  (cons
   (q576478-r-add
    real
    (q576478-r-multiply
     real (car left) (car right))
    (q576478-r-negate
     real
     (q576478-r-multiply
      real (cdr left) (cdr right))))
   (q576478-r-add
    real
    (q576478-r-multiply
     real (car left) (cdr right))
    (q576478-r-multiply
     real (cdr left) (car right)))))

(defun q576478-c-norm-square (real value)
  (q576478-r-add
   real
   (q576478-r-multiply
    real (car value) (car value))
   (q576478-r-multiply
    real (cdr value) (cdr value))))

(defun q576478-c-norm (real square-root value)
  (q576478-r-square-root
   real square-root
   (q576478-c-norm-square real value)))

;; Arbitrary normed vector spaces over the represented complex field. The
;; SPACE argument distinguishes the source and codomain carriers.

(defstub q576478-v-member-p (space value) t)
(defstub q576478-v-zero (space) t)
(defstub q576478-v-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q576478-v-negate (space value) t)
(defstub q576478-v-smul (space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q576478-v-norm (real space value) t)

(defun q576478-v-subtract (space left right)
  (q576478-v-add
   space left (q576478-v-negate space right)))

(defun-sk q576478-v-additive-module-laws-p
    (real space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and

title: Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q576478,
-- "Liouville's theorem (complex analysis)": an everywhere complex
-- Frechet-differentiable map between complex normed vector spaces whose range
-- is bounded takes equal values at every two points. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not A =
  A -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

open Complex

complexZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexZero reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexOne :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R
complexOne reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

complexAdd :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexAdd reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

complexNegate :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexNegate reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

complexMultiply :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R ->
  Complex R
complexMultiply reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

record ComplexNorm
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    normC : Complex R -> R

    norm-nonnegativeC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normC z)
    norm-zeroC :
      normC (complexZero reals) == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC z == zeroR reals ->
      z == complexZero reals
    norm-negateC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      normC (complexNegate reals z) == normC z
    norm-addC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normC (complexAdd reals z w))
        (addR reals (normC z) (normC w))
    norm-multiplyC :
      (z w : Complex R) ->
      normC (complexMultiply reals z w) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC w)
    norm-squareC :
      (z : Complex R) ->
      multiplyR reals (normC z) (normC z) ==
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals (realPart z) (realPart z))
        (multiplyR reals (imaginaryPart z) (imaginaryPart z))

open ComplexNorm

record NormedComplexVectorSpace
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals)
  (E : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : Complex R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexOne reals) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexMultiply reals a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (complexAdd reals a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : Complex R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (normC complexNorm a) (normE x)

open NormedComplexVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

ComplexLinear :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (target : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  Set
ComplexLinear {R = R} source target linear =
  Both
    ((x y : _) ->
      linear (addE source x y) ==
      addE target (linear x) (linear y))
    ((scalar : Complex R) ->
      (x : _) ->
      linear (scaleE source scalar x) ==
      scaleE target scalar (linear x))

BoundedOperator :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (target : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  Set
BoundedOperator {R = R} {reals = reals} source target linear =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) bound)
        ((x : _) ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE target (linear x))
            (multiplyR reals bound (normE source x))))

FrechetApproximationAt :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (target : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  E ->
  Set
FrechetApproximationAt reals source target function linear point =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists _
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (Positive reals delta)
        ((increment : _) ->
          StrictLess reals (normE source increment) delta ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (normE target
              (subtractE target
                (subtractE target
                  (function (addE source point increment))
                  (function point))
                (linear increment)))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon (normE source increment))))

FrechetDifferentiableAt :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (target : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  E ->
  Set
FrechetDifferentiableAt reals source target function point =
  Exists (_ -> _)
    (\ linear ->
      Both
        (ComplexLinear source target linear)
        (Both
          (BoundedOperator source target linear)
          (FrechetApproximationAt
            reals source target function linear point)))

EverywhereComplexFrechetDifferentiable :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (target : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F) ->
  (E -> F) ->
  Set
EverywhereComplexFrechetDifferentiable reals source target function =
  (point : _) ->
  FrechetDifferentiableAt reals source target function point

BoundedRange :
  {R E F : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  {complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals} ->
  NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F ->
  (E -> F) ->
  Set
BoundedRange {R = R} reals target function =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      (x : _) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normE target (function x)) bound)

liouville-s-theorem-complex-analysis : Set1
liouville-s-theorem-complex-analysis =
  (R E F : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (complexNorm : ComplexNorm reals) ->
  (source : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm E) ->
  (target : NormedComplexVectorSpace reals complexNorm F) ->
  (function : E -> F) ->
  EverywhereComplexFrechetDifferentiable
    reals source target function ->
  BoundedRange reals target function ->
  (z w : E) ->
  function z == function w

      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = modu a * norm x)``);

val q576478_bounded_complex_linear_def = new_definition (
  "q576478_bounded_complex_linear_def",
  ``q576478_bounded_complex_linear
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (smulF : complex -> 'f -> 'f)
      (normF : 'f -> real) (L : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      (!x y. L (addE x y) = addF (L x) (L y)) /\
      (!a x. L (smulE a x) = smulF a (L x)) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\ !x. normF (L x) <= C * normE x``);

val q576478_complex_differentiable_def = new_definition (
  "q576478_complex_differentiable_def",
  ``q576478_complex_differentiable
      (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smulF : complex -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (f : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      !x : 'e.
        ?L : 'e -> 'f.
          q576478_bounded_complex_linear
            addE smulE normE addF smulF normF L /\
          !epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon ==>
            ?delta : real.
              0 < delta /\
              !h : 'e.
                0 < normE h /\ normE h < delta
                ==>
                normF
                  (addF
                    (addF (f (addE x h)) (negF (f x)))
                    (negF (L h))) <
                epsilon * normE h``);

val q576478_bounded_range_def = new_definition (
  "q576478_bounded_range_def",
  ``q576478_bounded_range (normF : 'f -> real) (f : 'e -> 'f) <=>
      ?C : real. 0 <= C /\ !x : 'e. normF (f x) <= C``);

val Differentiable_apply_eq_apply_of_bounded =
  ``!(zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : complex -> 'f -> 'f) (normF : 'f -> real)
      (f : 'e -> 'f) (z : 'e) (w : 'e).
      q576478_normed_complex_space zeroE addE negE smulE normE /\
      q576478_normed_complex_space zeroF addF negF smulF normF /\
      q576478_complex_differentiable
        addE normE addF negF smulE smulF normF f /\
      q576478_bounded_range normF f
      ==>
      f z = f w``;
