title: Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q576478,
% "Liouville's theorem (complex analysis)": every bounded, everywhere complex
% Frechet-differentiable map between arbitrary complex normed vector spaces is
% constant. This file contains no proof.

Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis[
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  cscaleE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroF: F,
  addF: [F, F -> F],
  negF: [F -> F],
  cscaleF: [real, real, F -> F],
  normF: [F -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  function_type: TYPE = [E -> F]
  linear_candidate: TYPE = [E -> F]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(a, b: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(a) + real_part(b),
       imag_part := imag_part(a) + imag_part(b) #)

  complex_mul(a, b: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(a) * real_part(b)
                       - imag_part(a) * imag_part(b),
       imag_part := real_part(a) * imag_part(b)
                       + imag_part(a) * real_part(b) #)

  complex_norm_squared(a: complex): real =
    real_part(a) * real_part(a)
      + imag_part(a) * imag_part(a)

  smulE(a: complex, x: E): E =
    cscaleE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x)

  smulF(a: complex, x: F): F =
    cscaleF(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x)

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  subF(x, y: F): F =
    addF(x, negF(y))

  normed_complex_vector_space_E: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        (normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_add(a, b), x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        smulE(complex_mul(a, b), x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(complex_zero, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex):
        smulE(a, zeroE) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) * normE(smulE(a, x)) =
          complex_norm_squared(a) * normE(x) * normE(x))

  normed_complex_vector_space_F: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      addF(x, y) = addF(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        addF(addF(x, y), z) = addF(x, addF(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, zeroF) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        addF(x, negF(x)) = zeroF)
      AND normF(zeroF) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        0 <= normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        (normF(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroF))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        normF(negF(x)) = normF(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F):
        normF(addF(x, y)) <= normF(x) + normF(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: F):
        smulF(a, addF(x, y)) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: F):
        smulF(complex_add(a, b), x) =
          addF(smulF(a, x), smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: F):
        smulF(complex_mul(a, b), x) =
          smulF(a, smulF(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(complex_one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        smulF(complex_zero, x) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex):
        smulF(a, zeroF) = zeroF)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: F):
        normF(smulF(a, x)) * normF(smulF(a, x)) =
          complex_norm_squared(a) * normF(x) * normF(x))

  continuous_complex_linear_map(L: linear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      L(addE(x, y)) = addF(L(x), L(y)))
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        L(smulE(a, x)) = smulF(a, L(x)))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        0 <= bound
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            normF(L(x)) <= bound * normE(x)

  has_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: function_type,
      derivative: linear_candidate,
      point: E): bool =
    continuous_complex_linear_map(derivative)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (increment: E):
            normE(increment) < radius
              IMPLIES
                normF(
                  subF(
                    subF(
                      f(addE(point, increment)),
                      f(point)),
                    derivative(increment)))
                  <= epsilon_value * normE(increment)

  complex_differentiable_everywhere(f: function_type): bool =
    FORALL (point: E):
      EXISTS (derivative: linear_candidate):
        has_frechet_derivative_at(f, derivative, point)

  bounded_range(f: function_type): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      FORALL (x: E):
        normF(f(x)) <= bound

  liouville_s_theorem: bool =
    (normed_complex_vector_space_E
      AND normed_complex_vector_space_F)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (f: function_type), (z, w: E):
        (complex_differentiable_everywhere(f)
          AND bounded_range(f))
        IMPLIES f(z) = f(w)
END Q576478_liouville_s_theorem_complex_analysis

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q595466
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q595466), "Dini's theorem": a monotone family of
-- continuous functions that converges pointwise to a continuous limit converges
-- locally uniformly. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Order.Lattice
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Ordered
public import Mathlib.Topology.UniformSpace.CompactConvergence

@[expose] public section

open Filter Topology

namespace Q595466

variable {ι α G : Type*} [Preorder ι] [TopologicalSpace α]
  [NormedAddCommGroup G] [Lattice G] [HasSolidNorm G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G]

namespace Monotone

/-- Dini's theorem for locally uniform convergence of a monotone family. -/
theorem tendstoLocallyUniformly_of_forall_tendsto {F : ι → α → G} {f : α → G}
    (hF_cont : ∀ i, Continuous (F i)) (hF_mono : Monotone F) (hf : Continuous f)
    (h_tendsto : ∀ x, Tendsto (F · x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) :
    TendstoLocallyUniformly F f atTop := sorry

end Monotone

end Q595466

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q595466
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q595466), "Dini's theorem": a monotone increasing
  family of continuous functions, indexed by an arbitrary preorder and taking
  values in a normed lattice ordered additive commutative group with solid
  norm, converges locally uniformly when it converges pointwise to a
  continuous function. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q595466_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q595466_subset {A : Type}
    (U V : q595466_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x -> V x.

Record q595466_preorder (I : Type) : Type := {
  q595466_index_le : I -> I -> Prop;
  q595466_index_le_refl :
    forall i : I, q595466_index_le i i;
  q595466_index_le_trans :
    forall i j k : I,
      q595466_index_le i j ->
      q595466_index_le j k ->
      q595466_index_le i k
}.

Arguments q595466_index_le {I} _ _ _.

Record q595466_topological_space (X : Type) : Type := {
  q595466_is_open : q595466_set X -> Prop;
  q595466_open_ext :
    forall U V : q595466_set X,
      (forall x : X, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q595466_is_open U <-> q595466_is_open V);
  q595466_open_univ :
    q595466_is_open (fun _ : X => True);
  q595466_open_inter :
    forall U V : q595466_set X,
      q595466_is_open U ->
      q595466_is_open V ->
      q595466_is_open (fun x : X => U x /\ V x);
  q595466_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q595466_set (q595466_set X),
      (forall U : q595466_set X,
        family U -> q595466_is_open U) ->
      q595466_is_open
        (fun x : X =>
          exists U : q595466_set X, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q595466_is_open {X} _ _.

Definition q595466_neighborhood {X : Type}
    (T : q595466_topological_space X)
    (x : X)
    (U : q595466_set X) : Prop :=
  exists V : q595466_set X,
    q595466_is_open T V /\
    V x /\
    q595466_subset V U.

Record q595466_normed_add_comm_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q595466_zero : G;
  q595466_add : G -> G -> G;
  q595466_neg : G -> G;
  q595466_norm : G -> R;
  q595466_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q595466_add x (q595466_add y z) =
      q595466_add (q595466_add x y) z;
  q595466_add_comm :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_add x y = q595466_add y x;
  q595466_add_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q595466_add x q595466_zero = x;
  q595466_add_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q595466_add x (q595466_neg x) = q595466_zero;
  q595466_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q595466_norm x;
  q595466_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q595466_norm x = 0 <-> x = q595466_zero;
  q595466_norm_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q595466_norm (q595466_neg x) = q595466_norm x;
  q595466_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_norm (q595466_add x y) <=
      q595466_norm x + q595466_norm y
}.

Arguments q595466_zero {G} _.
Arguments q595466_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q595466_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q595466_norm {G} _ _.

Record q595466_lattice (G : Type) : Type := {
  q595466_le : G -> G -> Prop;
  q595466_inf : G -> G -> G;
  q595466_sup : G -> G -> G;
  q595466_le_refl :
    forall x : G, q595466_le x x;
  q595466_le_antisym :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_le x y ->
      q595466_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q595466_le_trans :
    forall x y z : G,
      q595466_le x y ->
      q595466_le y z ->
      q595466_le x z;
  q595466_inf_le_left :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_le (q595466_inf x y) x;
  q595466_inf_le_right :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_le (q595466_inf x y) y;
  q595466_le_inf :
    forall x y z : G,
      q595466_le x y ->
      q595466_le x z ->
      q595466_le x (q595466_inf y z);
  q595466_le_sup_left :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_le x (q595466_sup x y);
  q595466_le_sup_right :
    forall x y : G,
      q595466_le y (q595466_sup x y);
  q595466_sup_le :
    forall x y z : G,
      q595466_le x z ->
      q595466_le y z ->
      q595466_le (q595466_sup x y) z
}.

Arguments q595466_le {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q595466_inf {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q595466_sup {G} _ _ _.

Definition q595466_is_ordered_add_monoid {G : Type}
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (L : q595466_lattice G) : Prop :=
  forall a b : G,
    q595466_le L a b ->
    forall c : G,
      q595466_le L
        (q595466_add V c a)
        (q595466_add V c b).

Definition q595466_abs {G : Type}
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (L : q595466_lattice G)
    (x : G) : G :=
  q595466_sup L x (q595466_neg V x).

Definition q595466_has_solid_norm {G : Type}
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (L : q595466_lattice G) : Prop :=
  forall x y : G,
    q595466_le L
      (q595466_abs V L x)
      (q595466_abs V L y) ->
    q595466_norm V x <= q595466_norm V y.

Definition q595466_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q595466_add V x (q595466_neg V y).

Definition q595466_dist {G : Type}
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (x y : G) : R :=
  q595466_norm V (q595466_sub V x y).

Definition q595466_metric_is_open {G : Type}
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (U : q595466_set G) : Prop :=
  forall x : G,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : G,
        q595466_dist V x y < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q595466_continuous {X G : Type}
    (T : q595466_topological_space X)
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (f : X -> G) : Prop :=
  forall U : q595466_set G,
    q595466_metric_is_open V U ->
    q595466_is_open T (fun x : X => U (f x)).

Definition q595466_eventually_at_top {I : Type}
    (O : q595466_preorder I)
    (P : I -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists bounds : list I,
    forall i : I,
      (forall b : I,
        In b bounds ->
        q595466_index_le O b i) ->
      P i.

Definition q595466_pointwise_tendsto {I X G : Type}
    (O : q595466_preorder I)
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (F : I -> X -> G)
    (f : X -> G) : Prop :=
  forall (x : X) (epsilon : R),
    0 < epsilon ->
    q595466_eventually_at_top O
      (fun i : I =>
        q595466_dist V (F i x) (f x) < epsilon).

Definition q595466_monotone {I X G : Type}
    (O : q595466_preorder I)
    (L : q595466_lattice G)
    (F : I -> X -> G) : Prop :=
  forall i j : I,
    q595466_index_le O i j ->
    forall x : X,
      q595466_le L (F i x) (F j x).

Definition q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly {I X G : Type}
    (O : q595466_preorder I)
    (T : q595466_topological_space X)
    (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
    (F : I -> X -> G)
    (f : X -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    forall x : X,
      exists U : q595466_set X,
        q595466_neighborhood T x U /\
        q595466_eventually_at_top O
          (fun i : I =>
            forall y : X,
              U y ->
              q595466_dist V (F i y) (f y) < epsilon).

Theorem Monotone_tendstoLocallyUniformly_of_forall_tendsto :
  forall (I X G : Type)
         (O : q595466_preorder I)
         (T : q595466_topological_space X)
         (V : q595466_normed_add_comm_group G)
         (L : q595466_lattice G)
         (F : I -> X -> G)
         (f : X -> G),
    q595466_has_solid_norm V L ->
    q595466_is_ordered_add_monoid V L ->
    (forall i : I, q595466_continuous T V (F i)) ->
    q595466_monotone O L F ->
    q595466_continuous T V f ->
    q595466_pointwise_tendsto O V F f ->
    q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly O T V F f.
Admitted.

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q595466,
  "Dini's theorem": a monotone family of continuous functions valued in a
  solid-normed lattice-ordered additive group that converges pointwise to a
  continuous limit converges locally uniformly, with possibly empty index and
  domain types represented by carriers. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q595466_dini_s_theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Uniform_Limit"
    "HOL-Library.Lattice_Algebras"
begin

definition q595466_at_top_on :: "'i::preorder set \<Rightarrow> 'i filter" where
  "q595466_at_top_on I = (INF k\<in>I. principal {j\<in>I. k \<le> j})"

definition q595466_normed_lattice_group ::
    "('g::lattice_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q595466_normed_lattice_group normG \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> normG x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. normG x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> x = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. normG (-x) = normG x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. normG (x + y) \<le> normG x + normG y) \<and>
    (\<forall>x y. sup x (-x) \<le> sup y (-y) \<longrightarrow> normG x \<le> normG y)"

definition q595466_continuous_on ::
    "'a::topological_space set \<Rightarrow>
      ('g::lattice_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q595466_continuous_on A normG h \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<forall>e. 0 < e \<longrightarrow>
      eventually
        (\<lambda>y. y \<in> A \<longrightarrow> normG (- h x + h y) < e)
        (inf (nhds x) (principal A)))"

definition q595466_tendsto_at_top_on ::
    "'i::preorder set \<Rightarrow>
      ('g::lattice_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i::preorder \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q595466_tendsto_at_top_on I normG u z \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>e. 0 < e \<longrightarrow>
      eventually
        (\<lambda>i. i \<in> I \<longrightarrow> normG (-z + u i) < e)
        (q595466_at_top_on I))"

definition q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly_on ::
    "'i::preorder set \<Rightarrow> 'a::topological_space set \<Rightarrow>
      ('g::lattice_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow>
      ('i::preorder \<Rightarrow> 'a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'g) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly_on I A normG F f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>e. 0 < e \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>A. \<exists>t.
      eventually (\<lambda>y. y \<in> t) (inf (nhds x) (principal A)) \<and>
      eventually
        (\<lambda>i. i \<in> I \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>y\<in>t. y \<in> A \<longrightarrow> normG (- f y + F i y) < e))
        (q595466_at_top_on I)))"

theorem dini_s_theorem:
  fixes I :: "'i::preorder set"
    and A :: "'a::topological_space set"
    and normG :: "'g::lattice_ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> real"
    and F :: "'i::preorder \<Rightarrow> 'a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'g"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'g"
  assumes normed_lattice_group:
      "q595466_normed_lattice_group normG"
    and F_continuous:
      "\<And>i. i \<in> I \<Longrightarrow> q595466_continuous_on A normG (F i)"
    and F_monotone:
      "\<And>i j x. i \<in> I \<Longrightarrow> j \<in> I \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> A \<Longrightarrow>
        i \<le> j \<Longrightarrow> F i x \<le> F j x"
    and f_continuous:
      "q595466_continuous_on A normG f"
    and pointwise_tendsto:
      "\<And>x. x \<in> A \<Longrightarrow>
        q595466_tendsto_at_top_on I normG (\<lambda>i. F i x) (f x)"
  shows "q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly_on I A normG F f"
  sorry

end

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q595466,
  "Dini's theorem": a monotone family of continuous functions into a
  solid-normed lattice ordered additive commutative group that converges
  pointwise along an arbitrary preorder converges locally uniformly. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q595466_DINI_S_THEOREM =
 `let preorder_on =
      \(carrier:'i->bool) (le:'i->'i->bool).
        (!i:'i. carrier i ==> le i i) /\
        (!i j k:'i.
           carrier i /\ carrier j /\ carrier k /\
           le i j /\ le j k
           ==> le i k) in
   let topology_on =
      \(carrier:'a->bool) (opens:('a->bool)->bool).
        opens (\x:'a. F) /\
        opens carrier /\
        (!s:'a->bool.
           opens s ==> !x:'a. s x ==> carrier x) /\
        (!s t:'a->bool.
           opens s /\ opens t
           ==> opens (\x:'a. s x /\ t x)) /\
        (!family:('a->bool)->bool.
           (!s:'a->bool. family s ==> opens s)
           ==> opens
                 (\x:'a. ?s:'a->bool. family s /\ s x)) in
   let filter_on =
      \(carrier:'i->bool) (eventually:('i->bool)->bool).
        eventually carrier /\
        (!s t:'i->bool.
           eventually s /\
           (!i:'i. carrier i /\ s i ==> t i)
           ==> eventually t) /\
        (!s t:'i->bool.
           eventually s /\ eventually t
           ==> eventually (\i:'i. s i /\ t i)) in
   let at_top =
      \(carrier:'i->bool) (le:'i->'i->bool)
       (eventually:('i->bool)->bool).
        filter_on carrier eventually /\
        (!i:'i.
           carrier i
           ==> eventually
                 (\j:'i. carrier j /\ le i j)) /\
        (!other:('i->bool)->bool.
           filter_on carrier other /\
           (!i:'i.
              carrier i
              ==> other
                    (\j:'i. carrier j /\ le i j))
           ==> !s:'i->bool.
                 eventually s ==> other s) in
   let normed_add_comm_group_on =
      \(carrier:'g->bool) (zero:'g) (add:'g->'g->'g)
       (neg:'g->'g) (norm:'g->real).
        carrier zero /\
        (!x:'g. carrier x ==> carrier (neg x)) /\
        (!x y:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y
           ==> carrier (add x y)) /\
        (!x y:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y
           ==> add x y = add y x) /\
        (!x y z:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z
           ==> add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
        (!x:'g.
           carrier x ==> add x zero = x) /\
        (!x:'g.
           carrier x ==> add x (neg x) = zero) /\
        (!x:'g.
           carrier x ==> &0 <= norm x) /\
        (!x:'g.
           carrier x ==> (norm x = &0 <=> x = zero)) /\
        (!x:'g.
           carrier x ==> norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
        (!x y:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y
           ==> norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) in
   let lattice_on =
      \(carrier:'g->bool) (le:'g->'g->bool)
       (join:'g->'g->'g) (meet:'g->'g->'g).
        (!x:'g. carrier x ==> le x x) /\
        (!x y z:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z /\
           le x y /\ le y z
           ==> le x z) /\
        (!x y:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y /\ le x y /\ le y x
           ==> x = y) /\
        (!x y:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y
           ==> carrier (join x y) /\
               le x (join x y) /\
               le y (join x y) /\
               (!z:'g.
                  carrier z /\ le x z /\ le y z
                  ==> le (join x y) z)) /\
        (!x y:'g.
           carrier x /\ carrier y
           ==> carrier (meet x y) /\
               le (meet x y) x /\
               le (meet x y) y /\
               (!z:'g.
                  carrier z /\ le z x /\ le z y
                  ==> le z (meet x y))) in
   let ordered_add_monoid_on =
      \(carrier:'g->bool) (le:'g->'g->bool)
       (add:'g->'g->'g).
        !x y z:'g.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z /\ le x y
          ==> le (add x z) (add y z) in
   let solid_norm_on =
      \(carrier:'g->bool) (le:'g->'g->bool)
       (join:'g->'g->'g) (neg:'g->'g) (norm:'g->real).
        !x y:'g.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\
          le (join x (neg x)) (join y (neg y))
          ==> norm x <= norm y in
   let continuous =
      \(acarrier:'a->bool) (gcarrier:'g->bool)
       (opens:('a->bool)->bool) (add:'g->'g->'g)
       (neg:'g->'g) (norm:'g->real) (h:'a->'g).
        (!x:'a. acarrier x ==> gcarrier (h x)) /\
        (!x:'a.
           acarrier x
           ==> !epsilon:real.
                 &0 < epsilon
                 ==> ?u:'a->bool.
                       opens u /\ u x /\
                       (!y:'a.
                          u y
                          ==> norm
                                (add (h y) (neg (h x))) <
                              epsilon)) in
   let pointwise_tends =
      \(acarrier:'a->bool)
       (eventually:('i->bool)->bool)
       (add:'g->'g->'g) (neg:'g->'g) (norm:'g->real)
       (funcs:'i->'a->'g) (f:'a->'g).
        !x:'a.
          acarrier x
          ==> !epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon
                ==> eventually
                      (\i:'i.
                         norm
                           (add (funcs i x) (neg (f x))) <
                         epsilon) in
   let locally_uniformly_tends =
      \(acarrier:'a->bool) (opens:('a->bool)->bool)
       (eventually:('i->bool)->bool)
       (add:'g->'g->'g) (neg:'g->'g) (norm:'g->real)
       (funcs:'i->'a->'g) (f:'a->'g).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> !x:'a.
                acarrier x
                ==> ?u:'a->bool.
                      opens u /\ u x /\
                      eventually
                        (\i:'i.
                           !y:'a.
                             u y
                             ==> norm
                                   (add (funcs i y)
                                     (neg (f y))) <
                                 epsilon) in
   !icarrier:'i->bool
    acarrier:'a->bool
    gcarrier:'g->bool
    ile:'i->'i->bool
    opens:('a->bool)->bool
    eventually:('i->bool)->bool
    zero:'g
    add:'g->'g->'g
    neg:'g->'g
    norm:'g->real
    gle:'g->'g->bool
    join:'g->'g->'g
    meet:'g->'g->'g
    funcs:'i->'a->'g
    f:'a->'g.
      preorder_on icarrier ile /\
      topology_on acarrier opens /\
      at_top icarrier ile eventually /\
      normed_add_comm_group_on
        gcarrier zero add neg norm /\
      lattice_on gcarrier gle join meet /\
      ordered_add_monoid_on gcarrier gle add /\
      solid_norm_on gcarrier gle join neg norm /\
      (!i:'i.
         icarrier i
         ==> continuous
               acarrier gcarrier opens add neg norm
               (funcs i)) /\
      (!i j:'i.
         icarrier i /\ icarrier j /\ ile i j
         ==> !x:'a.
               acarrier x
               ==> gle (funcs i x) (funcs j x)) /\
      continuous acarrier gcarrier opens add neg norm f /\
      pointwise_tends
        acarrier eventually add neg norm funcs f
      ==> locally_uniformly_tends
            acarrier opens eventually add neg norm funcs f`;;

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q595466,
;; "Dini's theorem": a monotone net of continuous functions from an arbitrary
;; topological space to a solid-normed lattice ordered additive commutative
;; group converges locally uniformly when it converges pointwise to a
;; continuous limit. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The DEFSTUB evaluators present arbitrary carriers, operations, neighborhood
;; bases, and functions without restricting them to finite tables or tame
;; function syntax. Every law used by the source typeclasses is an explicit
;; hypothesis of the final statement predicate.

(defstub q595466-member-p (carrier object) t)
(defstub q595466-index-le-p (order left right) t)
(defstub q595466-add-value (addition left right) t)
(defstub q595466-neg-value (negation value) t)
(defstub q595466-group-le-p (order left right) t)
(defstub q595466-meet-value (meet left right) t)
(defstub q595466-join-value (join left right) t)
(defstub q595466-norm-lt-p (norm value rational-bound) t)
(defstub q595466-basis-at-p (basis point neighborhood) t)
(defstub q595466-neighborhood-member-p (basis neighborhood point) t)
(defstub q595466-family-value (family index point) t)
(defstub q595466-limit-value (limit point) t)

(defun q595466-positive-rational-p (value)
  (and (rationalp value) (< 0 value)))

;; The arbitrary index type is a preorder. It may be empty or non-directed.

(defun-sk q595466-preorder-laws-p (carrier order)
  (forall (left middle right)
    (and
     (implies
      (q595466-member-p carrier left)
      (q595466-index-le-p order left left))
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p carrier left)
       (q595466-member-p carrier middle)
       (q595466-member-p carrier right)
       (q595466-index-le-p order left middle)
       (q595466-index-le-p order middle right))
      (q595466-index-le-p order left right)))))

;; A neighborhood basis presents exactly the topology needed by continuity
;; and local uniform convergence. The basis axioms are equivalent to the usual
;; neighborhood-system axioms and do not impose separation or compactness.

(defun-sk q595466-basis-subset-p
    (domain basis smaller larger)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-neighborhood-member-p basis smaller point))
     (q595466-neighborhood-member-p basis larger point))))

(defun-sk q595466-basis-neighborhood-exists-p
    (domain basis point)
  (exists (neighborhood)
    (q595466-basis-at-p basis point neighborhood)))

(defun-sk q595466-basis-validity-laws-p
    (domain basis)
  (forall (point neighborhood member)
    (and
     (implies
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-basis-neighborhood-exists-p
       domain basis point))
     (implies
      (q595466-basis-at-p basis point neighborhood)
      (and
       (q595466-member-p domain point)
       (q595466-neighborhood-member-p
        basis neighborhood point)
       (implies
        (q595466-neighborhood-member-p
         basis neighborhood member)
        (q595466-member-p domain member)))))))

(defun q595466-common-refinement-p
    (domain basis point left right refinement)
  (and
   (q595466-basis-at-p basis point refinement)
   (q595466-basis-subset-p
    domain basis refinement left)
   (q595466-basis-subset-p
    domain basis refinement right)))

(defun-sk q595466-common-refinement-exists-p
    (domain basis point left right)
  (exists (refinement)
    (q595466-common-refinement-p
     domain basis point left right refinement)))

(defun-sk q595466-basis-directed-laws-p
    (domain basis)
  (forall (point left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-basis-at-p basis point left)
      (q595466-basis-at-p basis point right))
     (q595466-common-refinement-exists-p
      domain basis point left right))))

(defun-sk q595466-local-refinement-at-point-exists-p
    (domain basis larger point)
  (exists (refinement)
    (and
     (q595466-basis-at-p basis point refinement)
     (q595466-basis-subset-p
      domain basis refinement larger))))

(defun-sk q595466-locality-neighborhood-p
    (domain basis point larger neighborhood)
  (forall (member)
    (and
     (q595466-basis-at-p basis point neighborhood)
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p domain member)
       (q595466-neighborhood-member-p
        basis neighborhood member))
      (q595466-local-refinement-at-point-exists-p
       domain basis larger member)))))

(defun-sk q595466-locality-neighborhood-exists-p
    (domain basis point larger)
  (exists (neighborhood)
    (q595466-locality-neighborhood-p
     domain basis point larger neighborhood)))

(defun-sk q595466-basis-locality-laws-p
    (domain basis)
  (forall (point neighborhood)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-basis-at-p basis point neighborhood))
     (q595466-locality-neighborhood-exists-p
      domain basis point neighborhood))))

(defun q595466-topological-basis-p (domain basis)
  (and
   (q595466-basis-validity-laws-p domain basis)
   (q595466-basis-directed-laws-p domain basis)
   (q595466-basis-locality-laws-p domain basis)))

;; Additive commutative group and lattice-order laws for the codomain.

(defun-sk q595466-add-comm-group-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition negation)
  (forall (left middle right)
    (and
     (q595466-member-p carrier zero)
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p carrier left)
       (q595466-member-p carrier middle)
       (q595466-member-p carrier right))
      (let ((left-middle
             (q595466-add-value addition left middle))
            (middle-right
             (q595466-add-value addition middle right))
            (negative-left
             (q595466-neg-value negation left)))
        (and
         (q595466-member-p carrier left-middle)
         (q595466-member-p carrier negative-left)
         (equal
          (q595466-add-value
           addition left-middle right)
          (q595466-add-value
           addition left middle-right))
         (equal
          left-middle
          (q595466-add-value addition middle left))
         (equal
          (q595466-add-value addition left zero)
          left)
         (equal
          (q595466-add-value
           addition left negative-left)
          zero)))))))

(defun-sk q595466-lattice-order-laws-p
    (carrier order meet join)
  (forall (left middle right)
    (and
     (implies
      (q595466-member-p carrier left)
      (q595466-group-le-p order left left))
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p carrier left)
       (q595466-member-p carrier middle)
       (q595466-group-le-p order left middle)
       (q595466-group-le-p order middle left))
      (equal left middle))
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p carrier left)
       (q595466-member-p carrier middle)
       (q595466-member-p carrier right)
       (q595466-group-le-p order left middle)
       (q595466-group-le-p order middle right))
      (q595466-group-le-p order left right))
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p carrier left)
       (q595466-member-p carrier middle)
       (q595466-member-p carrier right))
      (let ((infimum
             (q595466-meet-value meet left middle))
            (supremum
             (q595466-join-value join left middle)))
        (and
         (q595466-member-p carrier infimum)
         (q595466-member-p carrier supremum)
         (q595466-group-le-p order infimum left)
         (q595466-group-le-p order infimum middle)
         (implies
          (and
           (q595466-group-le-p order right left)
           (q595466-group-le-p order right middle))
          (q595466-group-le-p
           order right infimum))
         (q595466-group-le-p order left supremum)
         (q595466-group-le-p order middle supremum)
         (implies
          (and
           (q595466-group-le-p order left right)
           (q595466-group-le-p order middle right))
          (q595466-group-le-p
           order supremum right))))))))

(defun-sk q595466-ordered-addition-laws-p
    (carrier addition order)
  (forall (left right shift)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p carrier left)
      (q595466-member-p carrier right)
      (q595466-member-p carrier shift)
      (q595466-group-le-p order left right))
     (q595466-group-le-p
      order
      (q595466-add-value addition left shift)
      (q595466-add-value addition right shift)))))

;; Rational upper cuts represent arbitrary finite nonnegative real norm
;; values. Roundedness, upward closure, and finiteness make this equivalent to
;; a real-valued norm without restricting norm values to rational numbers.

(defun-sk q595466-norm-rounded-witness-exists-p
    (norm value bound)
  (exists (smaller)
    (and
     (q595466-positive-rational-p smaller)
     (< smaller bound)
     (q595466-norm-lt-p norm value smaller))))

(defun-sk q595466-norm-finite-bound-exists-p
    (norm value)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q595466-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q595466-norm-lt-p norm value bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-norm-cut-laws-p
    (carrier norm)
  (forall (value lower upper)
    (implies
     (q595466-member-p carrier value)
     (and
      (q595466-norm-finite-bound-exists-p
       norm value)
      (implies
       (and
        (q595466-positive-rational-p lower)
        (q595466-positive-rational-p upper)
        (< lower upper)
        (q595466-norm-lt-p norm value lower))
       (q595466-norm-lt-p norm value upper))
      (implies
       (and
        (q595466-positive-rational-p upper)
        (q595466-norm-lt-p norm value upper))
       (q595466-norm-rounded-witness-exists-p
        norm value upper))))))

(defun-sk q595466-norm-zero-p (norm value)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q595466-positive-rational-p bound)
     (q595466-norm-lt-p norm value bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-norm-equal-p (norm left right)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q595466-positive-rational-p bound)
     (iff
      (q595466-norm-lt-p norm left bound)
      (q595466-norm-lt-p norm right bound)))))

(defun-sk q595466-norm-le-p (norm left right)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-positive-rational-p bound)
      (q595466-norm-lt-p norm right bound))
     (q595466-norm-lt-p norm left bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-normed-group-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition negation norm)
  (forall (left right left-bound right-bound)
    (and
     (q595466-norm-cut-laws-p carrier norm)
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p carrier left)
       (q595466-member-p carrier right))
      (and
       (iff
        (equal left zero)
        (q595466-norm-zero-p norm left))
       (q595466-norm-equal-p
        norm
        (q595466-neg-value negation left)
        left)
       (implies
        (and
         (q595466-positive-rational-p left-bound)
         (q595466-positive-rational-p right-bound)
         (q595466-norm-lt-p
          norm left left-bound)
         (q595466-norm-lt-p
          norm right right-bound))
        (q595466-norm-lt-p
         norm
         (q595466-add-value addition left right)
         (+ left-bound right-bound))))))))

(defun q595466-absolute-value
    (join negation value)
  (q595466-join-value
   join value (q595466-neg-value negation value)))

(defun-sk q595466-solid-norm-laws-p
    (carrier order join negation norm)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p carrier left)
      (q595466-member-p carrier right)
      (q595466-group-le-p
       order
       (q595466-absolute-value
        join negation left)
       (q595466-absolute-value
        join negation right)))
     (q595466-norm-le-p norm left right))))

(defun q595466-codomain-structure-p
    (carrier zero addition negation order meet join norm)
  (and
   (q595466-add-comm-group-laws-p
    carrier zero addition negation)
   (q595466-lattice-order-laws-p
    carrier order meet join)
   (q595466-ordered-addition-laws-p
    carrier addition order)
   (q595466-normed-group-laws-p
    carrier zero addition negation norm)
   (q595466-solid-norm-laws-p
    carrier order join negation norm)))

;; Typing, continuity, and monotonicity of the arbitrary family and limit.

(defun-sk q595466-family-values-p
    (index-carrier domain codomain family)
  (forall (index point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p index-carrier index)
      (q595466-member-p domain point))
     (q595466-member-p
      codomain
      (q595466-family-value family index point)))))

(defun-sk q595466-limit-values-p
    (domain codomain limit)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q595466-member-p domain point)
     (q595466-member-p
      codomain
      (q595466-limit-value limit point)))))

(defun q595466-distance-lt-p
    (addition negation norm left right bound)
  (q595466-norm-lt-p
   norm
   (q595466-add-value
    addition left
    (q595466-neg-value negation right))
   bound))

(defun-sk q595466-family-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (domain basis addition negation norm
     family index point bound neighborhood)
  (forall (nearby)
    (and
     (q595466-basis-at-p basis point neighborhood)
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p domain nearby)
       (q595466-neighborhood-member-p
        basis neighborhood nearby))
      (q595466-distance-lt-p
       addition negation norm
       (q595466-family-value
        family index nearby)
       (q595466-family-value
        family index point)
       bound)))))

(defun-sk q595466-family-continuity-neighborhood-exists-p
    (domain basis addition negation norm
     family index point bound)
  (exists (neighborhood)
    (q595466-family-continuity-neighborhood-p
     domain basis addition negation norm
     family index point bound neighborhood)))

(defun-sk q595466-family-continuous-p
    (index-carrier domain basis addition negation norm family)
  (forall (index point bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p index-carrier index)
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-positive-rational-p bound))
     (q595466-family-continuity-neighborhood-exists-p
      domain basis addition negation norm
      family index point bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-limit-continuity-neighborhood-p
    (domain basis addition negation norm
     limit point bound neighborhood)
  (forall (nearby)
    (and
     (q595466-basis-at-p basis point neighborhood)
     (implies
      (and
       (q595466-member-p domain nearby)
       (q595466-neighborhood-member-p
        basis neighborhood nearby))
      (q595466-distance-lt-p
       addition negation norm
       (q595466-limit-value limit nearby)
       (q595466-limit-value limit point)
       bound)))))

(defun-sk q595466-limit-continuity-neighborhood-exists-p
    (domain basis addition negation norm
     limit point bound)
  (exists (neighborhood)
    (q595466-limit-continuity-neighborhood-p
     domain basis addition negation norm
     limit point bound neighborhood)))

(defun-sk q595466-limit-continuous-p
    (domain basis addition negation norm limit)
  (forall (point bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-positive-rational-p bound))
     (q595466-limit-continuity-neighborhood-exists-p
      domain basis addition negation norm
      limit point bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-family-monotone-p
    (index-carrier index-order domain
     codomain-order family)
  (forall (left right point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p index-carrier left)
      (q595466-member-p index-carrier right)
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-index-le-p
       index-order left right))
     (q595466-group-le-p
      codomain-order
      (q595466-family-value family left point)
      (q595466-family-value family right point)))))

;; Membership in an atTop-event is represented by a finite intersection of
;; principal upper sets. This is exact for an arbitrary preorder and retains
;; the bottom-filter cases caused by empty carriers or incompatible bounds.

(defun q595466-index-bound-list-p
    (bounds index-carrier)
  (if (consp bounds)
      (and
       (q595466-member-p index-carrier (car bounds))
       (q595466-index-bound-list-p
        (cdr bounds) index-carrier))
    (equal bounds nil)))

(defun q595466-above-all-bounds-p
    (index-order bounds index)
  (if (consp bounds)
      (and
       (q595466-index-le-p
        index-order (car bounds) index)
       (q595466-above-all-bounds-p
        index-order (cdr bounds) index))
    (equal bounds nil)))

(defun-sk q595466-pointwise-tail-p
    (index-carrier index-order
     addition negation norm family limit
     point bound bounds)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p index-carrier index)
      (q595466-above-all-bounds-p
       index-order bounds index))
     (q595466-distance-lt-p
      addition negation norm
      (q595466-family-value family index point)
      (q595466-limit-value limit point)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-pointwise-eventually-p
    (index-carrier index-order
     addition negation norm family limit
     point bound)
  (exists (bounds)
    (and
     (q595466-index-bound-list-p
      bounds index-carrier)
     (q595466-pointwise-tail-p
      index-carrier index-order
      addition negation norm family limit
      point bound bounds))))

(defun-sk q595466-pointwise-tendsto-p
    (index-carrier index-order domain
     addition negation norm family limit)
  (forall (point bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-positive-rational-p bound))
     (q595466-pointwise-eventually-p
      index-carrier index-order
      addition negation norm family limit
      point bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-locally-uniform-tail-p
    (index-carrier index-order domain basis
     addition negation norm family limit
     neighborhood bound bounds)
  (forall (index nearby)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p index-carrier index)
      (q595466-above-all-bounds-p
       index-order bounds index)
      (q595466-member-p domain nearby)
      (q595466-neighborhood-member-p
       basis neighborhood nearby))
     (q595466-distance-lt-p
      addition negation norm
      (q595466-family-value family index nearby)
      (q595466-limit-value limit nearby)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q595466-locally-uniform-witnesses-exist-p
    (index-carrier index-order domain basis
     addition negation norm family limit
     point bound)
  (exists (neighborhood bounds)
    (and
     (q595466-basis-at-p
      basis point neighborhood)
     (q595466-index-bound-list-p
      bounds index-carrier)
     (q595466-locally-uniform-tail-p
      index-carrier index-order domain basis
      addition negation norm family limit
      neighborhood bound bounds))))

(defun-sk q595466-tendsto-locally-uniformly-p
    (index-carrier index-order domain basis
     addition negation norm family limit)
  (forall (point bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q595466-member-p domain point)
      (q595466-positive-rational-p bound))
     (q595466-locally-uniform-witnesses-exist-p
      index-carrier index-order domain basis
      addition negation norm family limit
      point bound))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q595466-dini-s-theorem-statement
    (index-carrier index-order
     domain neighborhood-basis
     codomain zero addition negation codomain-order meet join norm
     family limit)
  (implies
   (and
    (q595466-preorder-laws-p
     index-carrier index-order)
    (q595466-topological-basis-p
     domain neighborhood-basis)
    (q595466-codomain-structure-p
     codomain zero addition negation
     codomain-order meet join norm)
    (q595466-family-values-p
     index-carrier domain codomain family)
    (q595466-limit-values-p
     domain codomain limit)
    (q595466-family-continuous-p
     index-carrier domain neighborhood-basis
     addition negation norm family)
    (q595466-family-monotone-p
     index-carrier index-order domain
     codomain-order family)
    (q595466-limit-continuous-p
     domain neighborhood-basis
     addition negation norm limit)
    (q595466-pointwise-tendsto-p
     index-carrier index-order domain
     addition negation norm family limit))
   (q595466-tendsto-locally-uniformly-p
    index-carrier index-order domain neighborhood-basis
    addition negation norm family limit)))

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q595466,
-- "Dini's theorem": a monotone family of continuous functions into a solid
-- normed lattice ordered additive group that converges pointwise along atTop
-- converges locally uniformly. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q595466_dini_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Top : Set where
  constructor top

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

Predicate : Set -> Set1
Predicate A =
  A -> Set

Whole :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A
Whole _ =
  Top

Intersection :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Intersection P Q x =
  Both (P x) (Q x)

Subset :
  {A : Set} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
Subset {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) ->
  P x ->
  Q x

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zero :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR

    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x

    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR

    absolute-negate :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x

    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))

    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-injective :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) :
  Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R ->
      S

    backwardR :
      S ->
      R

    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y

    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x

    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target

    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target

    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)

    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)

    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)

    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)

    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n

    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

StrictLessR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLessR reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

PositiveR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
PositiveR reals epsilon =
  StrictLessR reals (zeroR reals) epsilon

record Preorder (I : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    lessOrEqualI :
      I ->
      I ->
      Set

    order-reflexiveI :
      (i : I) ->
      lessOrEqualI i i

    order-transitiveI :
      (i j k : I) ->
      lessOrEqualI i j ->
      lessOrEqualI j k ->
      lessOrEqualI i k

open Preorder

-- This inductively generated predicate is membership in the filter generated
-- by all upper rays, hence it also covers empty and nondirected preorders.
data AtTopEventually
  {I : Set}
  (index : Preorder I) :
  Predicate I ->
  Set1 where

  eventually-whole :
    AtTopEventually index Whole

  eventually-upper-ray :
    (cutoff : I) ->
    AtTopEventually index
      (\ i -> lessOrEqualI index cutoff i)

  eventually-upward :
    {P Q : Predicate I} ->
    AtTopEventually index P ->
    Subset P Q ->
    AtTopEventually index Q

  eventually-intersection :
    {P Q : Predicate I} ->
    AtTopEventually index P ->
    AtTopEventually index Q ->
    AtTopEventually index (Intersection P Q)

record NeighborhoodRefinement
  {A : Set}
  (near : A -> Predicate A -> Set)
  (x : A)
  (U : Predicate A) :
  Set1 where
  field
    refinement :
      Predicate A

    refinement-near :
      near x refinement

    refinement-stays-near :
      (y : A) ->
      refinement y ->
      near y U

record TopologicalSpace (A : Set) : Set2 where
  field
    neighborhood :
      A ->
      Predicate A ->
      Set

    neighborhood-contains :
      (x : A) ->
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      U x

    neighborhood-whole :
      (x : A) ->
      neighborhood x Whole

    neighborhood-upward :
      (x : A) ->
      (U V : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      Subset U V ->
      neighborhood x V

    neighborhood-intersection :
      (x : A) ->
      (U V : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      neighborhood x V ->
      neighborhood x (Intersection U V)

    neighborhood-local :
      (x : A) ->
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      neighborhood x U ->
      NeighborhoodRefinement neighborhood x U

open TopologicalSpace

record NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup
  (R G : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where
  field
    zeroG :
      G

    addG :
      G ->
      G ->
      G

    negateG :
      G ->
      G

    normG :
      G ->
      R

    lessOrEqualG :
      G ->
      G ->
      Set

    supG infG :
      G ->
      G ->
      G

    add-commutativeG :
      (x y : G) ->
      addG x y == addG y x

    add-associativeG :
      (x y z : G) ->
      addG (addG x y) z == addG x (addG y z)

    add-zeroG :
      (x : G) ->
      addG x zeroG == x

    add-inverseG :
      (x : G) ->
      addG x (negateG x) == zeroG

    order-reflexiveG :
      (x : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG x x

    order-transitiveG :
      (x y z : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG x y ->
      lessOrEqualG y z ->
      lessOrEqualG x z

    order-antisymmetricG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG x y ->
      lessOrEqualG y x ->
      x == y

    le-sup-leftG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG x (supG x y)

    le-sup-rightG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG y (supG x y)

    sup-leastG :
      (x y z : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG x z ->
      lessOrEqualG y z ->
      lessOrEqualG (supG x y) z

    inf-le-leftG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG (infG x y) x

    inf-le-rightG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG (infG x y) y

    inf-greatestG :
      (x y z : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG z x ->
      lessOrEqualG z y ->
      lessOrEqualG z (infG x y)

    add-orderG :
      (x y z : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG x y ->
      lessOrEqualG (addG z x) (addG z y)

    norm-nonnegativeG :
      (x : G) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normG x)

    norm-zeroG :
      normG zeroG == zeroR reals

    norm-zero-onlyG :
      (x : G) ->
      normG x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroG

    norm-negateG :
      (x : G) ->
      normG (negateG x) == normG x

    norm-triangleG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normG (addG x y))
        (addR reals (normG x) (normG y))

    solid-normG :
      (x y : G) ->
      lessOrEqualG
        (supG x (negateG x))
        (supG y (negateG y)) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (normG x) (normG y)

open NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup

Distance :
  {R G : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup R G reals ->
  G ->
  G ->
  R
Distance group x y =
  normG group (addG group (negateG group x) y)

Continuous :
  {A R G : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup R G reals ->
  (A -> G) ->
  Set
Continuous {A = A} {R = R} {reals = reals} topology group function =
  (x : A) ->
  (epsilon : R) ->
  PositiveR reals epsilon ->
  neighborhood topology x
    (\ y ->
      StrictLessR reals
        (Distance group (function y) (function x))
        epsilon)

TendstoAtTop :
  {I R G : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  Preorder I ->
  NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup R G reals ->
  (I -> G) ->
  G ->
  Set1
TendstoAtTop {R = R} {reals = reals} index group values limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  PositiveR reals epsilon ->
  AtTopEventually index
    (\ i ->
      StrictLessR reals
        (Distance group (values i) limit)
        epsilon)

record LocallyUniformNeighborhood
  {I A R G : Set}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R}
  (index : Preorder I)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A)
  (group : NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup R G reals)
  (functions : I -> A -> G)
  (limit : A -> G)
  (epsilon : R)
  (x : A) :
  Set1 where
  field
    neighborhood-set :
      Predicate A

    neighborhood-witness :
      neighborhood topology x neighborhood-set

    eventually-close :
      AtTopEventually index
        (\ i ->
          (y : A) ->
          neighborhood-set y ->
          StrictLessR reals
            (Distance group (limit y) (functions i y))
            epsilon)

TendstoLocallyUniformlyAtTop :
  {I A R G : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  Preorder I ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup R G reals ->
  (I -> A -> G) ->
  (A -> G) ->
  Set1
TendstoLocallyUniformlyAtTop
  {I = I} {A = A} {R = R}
  {reals = reals}
  index topology group functions limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  PositiveR reals epsilon ->
  (x : A) ->
  LocallyUniformNeighborhood
    index topology group functions limit epsilon x

dini-s-theorem : Set2
dini-s-theorem =
  (I A R G : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (index : Preorder I) ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) ->
  (group : NormedLatticeOrderedAddCommGroup R G reals) ->
  (functions : I -> A -> G) ->
  (limit : A -> G) ->
  ((i : I) -> Continuous topology group (functions i)) ->
  ((i j : I) ->
    lessOrEqualI index i j ->
    (x : A) ->
    lessOrEqualG group (functions i x) (functions j x)) ->
  Continuous topology group limit ->
  ((x : A) ->
    TendstoAtTop index group
      (\ i -> functions i x)
      (limit x)) ->
  TendstoLocallyUniformlyAtTop
    index topology group functions limit

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q595466, "Dini's theorem": a monotone family of continuous functions into
  an ordered normed lattice group, indexed by an arbitrary preorder, that
  converges pointwise along atTop converges locally uniformly. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory topologyTheory;

val q595466_preorder_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_preorder_def",
  ``q595466_preorder (carrier : 'i set) (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool) <=>
      (!i. i IN carrier ==> leq i i) /\
      (!i j k.
        i IN carrier /\ j IN carrier /\ k IN carrier /\
        leq i j /\ leq j k
        ==>
        leq i k)``);

val q595466_directed_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_directed_def",
  ``q595466_directed
      (carrier : 'i set) (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool) <=>
      carrier <> {} /\
      !i j.
        i IN carrier /\ j IN carrier
        ==>
        ?k. k IN carrier /\ leq i k /\ leq j k``);

val q595466_eventually_at_top_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_eventually_at_top_def",
  ``q595466_eventually_at_top
      (carrier : 'i set) (leq : 'i -> 'i -> bool)
      (p : 'i -> bool) <=>
      ~q595466_directed carrier leq \/
      ?i0.
        i0 IN carrier /\
        !i. i IN carrier /\ leq i0 i ==> p i``);

val q595466_normed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_normed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q595466_normed_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)``);

val q595466_lattice_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_lattice_def",
  ``q595466_lattice
      (leq : 'g -> 'g -> bool)
      (inf : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (sup : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq (inf x y) x /\ leq (inf x y) y) /\
      (!x y z. leq z x /\ leq z y ==> leq z (inf x y)) /\
      (!x y. leq x (sup x y) /\ leq y (sup x y)) /\
      (!x y z. leq x z /\ leq y z ==> leq (sup x y) z)``);

val q595466_ordered_add_monoid_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_ordered_add_monoid_def",
  ``q595466_ordered_add_monoid
      (leq : 'g -> 'g -> bool) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) <=>
      (!a b c. leq a b ==> leq (add a c) (add b c)) /\
      (!a b c. leq a b ==> leq (add c a) (add c b))``);

val q595466_solid_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_solid_norm_def",
  ``q595466_solid_norm
      (leq : 'g -> 'g -> bool) (sup : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real) <=>
      !x y.
        leq (sup x (neg x)) (sup y (neg y))
        ==>
        norm x <= norm y``);

val q595466_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_continuous_def",
  ``q595466_continuous
      (top : 'a topology)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (norm : 'g -> real) (h : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      !x epsilon.
        x IN topspace top /\ 0 < epsilon ==>
        ?u : 'a set.
          open_in top u /\
          x IN u /\
          !y. y IN u ==>
              norm (add (h y) (neg (h x))) < epsilon``);

val q595466_tendsto_at_top_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_tendsto_at_top_def",
  ``q595466_tendsto_at_top
      (index_carrier : 'i set) (leI : 'i -> 'i -> bool)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (norm : 'g -> real) (u : 'i -> 'g) (ell : 'g) <=>
      !epsilon.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        q595466_eventually_at_top index_carrier leI
          (\i. norm (add (u i) (neg ell)) < epsilon)``);

val q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly_def = new_definition (
  "q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly_def",
  ``q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly
      (top : 'a topology)
      (index_carrier : 'i set) (leI : 'i -> 'i -> bool)
      (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (neg : 'g -> 'g)
      (norm : 'g -> real)
      (F : 'i -> 'a -> 'g) (f : 'a -> 'g) <=>
      !epsilon x.
        x IN topspace top /\ 0 < epsilon ==>
        ?u : 'a set.
          open_in top u /\
          x IN u /\
          q595466_eventually_at_top index_carrier leI
            (\i. !y. y IN u ==>
                norm (add (F i y) (neg (f y))) < epsilon)``);

val Monotone_tendstoLocallyUniformly_of_forall_tendsto =
  ``!(top : 'a topology)
      (index_carrier : 'i set) (leI : 'i -> 'i -> bool)
      (zero : 'g) (add : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (neg : 'g -> 'g) (norm : 'g -> real)
      (leG : 'g -> 'g -> bool)
      (inf : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (sup : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (F : 'i -> 'a -> 'g) (f : 'a -> 'g).
      q595466_preorder index_carrier leI /\
      q595466_normed_add_comm_group zero add neg norm /\
      q595466_lattice leG inf sup /\
      q595466_solid_norm leG sup neg norm /\
      q595466_ordered_add_monoid leG add /\
      (!i.
        i IN index_carrier ==>
        q595466_continuous top add neg norm (F i)) /\
      (!i j.
        i IN index_carrier /\ j IN index_carrier /\ leI i j
        ==>
        !x. x IN topspace top ==> leG (F i x) (F j x)) /\
      q595466_continuous top add neg norm f /\
      (!x. x IN topspace top ==>
        q595466_tendsto_at_top index_carrier leI add neg norm
          (\i. F i x) (f x))
      ==>
      q595466_tendsto_locally_uniformly
        top index_carrier leI add neg norm F f``;

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q595466
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q595466), "Dini's theorem": a monotone family,
  indexed by an arbitrary preorder, of continuous functions from an arbitrary
  topological space to a normed lattice-ordered Abelian group with solid norm,
  converging pointwise along atTop to a continuous limit, converges locally
  uniformly. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q595466Preorder expands the arbitrary preorder on the index carrier.
  Q595466AtTop is the at-top filter itself: a set is eventual exactly when it
  contains a finite intersection of upper rays. This finite-intersection form
  is important for empty or nondirected preorders and agrees with Lean's
  infimum-of-principal-filters definition of atTop.

  The codomain is a SetMM normed Abelian group and lattice on one common
  structure. Q595466SolidNorm is precisely monotonicity of the norm under the
  lattice absolute value |a| = a join (-a), and Q595466OrderedAdd is
  monotonicity of left addition.

  Q595466PointwiseTendsto and Q595466LocallyUniform use the positive-radius
  metric criteria for convergence in the norm topology. The latter requires,
  at every domain point and radius, an open neighborhood on which the same
  atTop-event makes the convergence uniform.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q595466Preorder Q595466AtTop Q595466Sub Q595466LatticeAbs
   Q595466SolidNorm Q595466OrderedAdd Q595466Monotone
   Q595466PointwiseTendsto Q595466LocallyUniform $.

q595466-preorder-syntax
  $a wff ( Q595466Preorder I R ) $.
q595466-at-top-syntax
  $a class ( Q595466AtTop I R ) $.
q595466-sub-syntax
  $a class ( Q595466Sub G a b ) $.
q595466-lattice-abs-syntax
  $a class ( Q595466LatticeAbs G a ) $.
q595466-solid-norm-syntax
  $a wff ( Q595466SolidNorm G ) $.
q595466-ordered-add-syntax
  $a wff ( Q595466OrderedAdd G ) $.
q595466-monotone-syntax
  $a wff ( Q595466Monotone G I R X F ) $.
q595466-pointwise-tendsto-syntax
  $a wff ( Q595466PointwiseTendsto G I R F f x ) $.
q595466-locally-uniform-syntax
  $a wff ( Q595466LocallyUniform G I R X J F f ) $.

${
  $d I R i j k $.

  q595466-preorder-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466Preorder I R )
    <->
    (
      R C_ ( I X. I )
      /\
      (
        A. i e. I <. i , i >. e. R
        /\
        A. i e. I A. j e. I A. k e. I
          (
            (
              <. i , j >. e. R
              /\
              <. j , k >. e. R
            )
            ->
            <. i , k >. e. R
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A I R S i k $.

  q595466-at-top-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466AtTop I R )
    =
    { A e. ~P I |
      E. S e. ( ~P I i^i Fin )
        { k e. I |
          A. i e. S <. i , k >. e. R
        }
        C_ A
    }
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b $.

  q595466-sub-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466Sub G a b )
    =
    (
      a
      ( +g ` G )
      ( ( invg ` G ) ` b )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a $.

  q595466-lattice-abs-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466LatticeAbs G a )
    =
    (
      a
      ( join ` G )
      ( ( invg ` G ) ` a )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b $.

  q595466-solid-norm-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466SolidNorm G )
    <->
    A. a e. ( Base ` G ) A. b e. ( Base ` G )
      (
        ( Q595466LatticeAbs G a )
        ( le ` G )
        ( Q595466LatticeAbs G b )
        ->
        ( ( norm ` G ) ` a )
        <_
        ( ( norm ` G ) ` b )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G a b c $.

  q595466-ordered-add-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466OrderedAdd G )
    <->
    A. a e. ( Base ` G ) A. b e. ( Base ` G )
      A. c e. ( Base ` G )
        (
          a ( le ` G ) b
          ->
          (
            c ( +g ` G ) a
          )
          ( le ` G )
          (
            c ( +g ` G ) b
          )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G I R X i j x $.

  q595466-monotone-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466Monotone G I R X F )
    <->
    A. i e. I A. j e. I
      (
        <. i , j >. e. R
        ->
        A. x e. X
          (
            ( ( F ` i ) ` x )
            ( le ` G )
            ( ( F ` j ) ` x )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G I R a f i x $.

  q595466-pointwise-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466PointwiseTendsto G I R F f x )
    <->
    A. a e. RR+
      { i e. I |
        (
          ( norm ` G )
          `
          (
            Q595466Sub
            G
            ( ( F ` i ) ` x )
            ( f ` x )
          )
        )
        <
        a
      }
      e. ( Q595466AtTop I R )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G I J R U X a f i x y $.

  q595466-locally-uniform-definition $a |- (
    ( Q595466LocallyUniform G I R X J F f )
    <->
    A. a e. RR+ A. x e. X
      E. U e. J
        (
          x e. U
          /\
          { i e. I |
            A. y e. U
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` G )
                  `
                  (
                    Q595466Sub
                    G
                    ( ( F ` i ) ` y )
                    ( f ` y )
                  )
                )
                <
                a
              )
          }
          e. ( Q595466AtTop I R )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G I J R U X a b c f i j k x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q595466-dini $a |-
    A. I A. R A. X A. J A. G A. F A. f
      (
        (
          (
            ( Q595466Preorder I R )
            /\
            (
              J e. ( TopOn ` X )
              /\
              (
                G e. ( NrmGrp i^i Abel )
                /\
                (
                  G e. Lat
                  /\
                  (
                    ( Q595466SolidNorm G )
                    /\
                    ( Q595466OrderedAdd G )
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            F e. ( ( ( Base ` G ) ^m X ) ^m I )
            /\
            f e. ( ( Base ` G ) ^m X )
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            (
              A. i e. I
                ( F ` i ) e. ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` G ) )
              /\
              ( Q595466Monotone G I R X F )
            )
            /\
            (
              f e. ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` G ) )
              /\
              A. x e. X
                ( Q595466PointwiseTendsto G I R F f x )
            )
          )
          ->
          ( Q595466LocallyUniform G I R X J F f )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q595466,
:: "Dini's theorem": a monotone net of continuous functions into a solid-normed
:: lattice ordered additive group that converges pointwise to a continuous
:: function converges locally uniformly. This file contains no proof.

environ
  vocabularies TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
    FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, FINSET_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0,
    ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, CARD_1, NAT_1, ORDINAL2;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1,
    RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
    XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, SETFAM_1, FINSET_1;
  constructors ZFMISC_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, CARD_1,
    REAL_1, COMPLEX1, XXREAL_0, NAT_1, BINOP_2, SETFAM_1, FINSET_1;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, CARD_1, XXREAL_0, MEMBERED, XCMPLX_0, XREAL_0, ORDINAL1,
    NAT_1, FINSET_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI;
  expansions TARSKI;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  (for I being set,
      A being set,
      G being non empty set,
      leI being Relation of I,I,
      Open being Subset-Family of A,
      zero being Element of G,
      add,infG,supG being BinOp of G,
      opp being UnOp of G,
      leG being Relation of G,G,
      normG being Function of G,REAL,
      F being Function of I,Funcs(A,G),
      f being Function of A,G
  st
    (for i being set st i in I holds [i,i] in leI) &
    (for i,j,k being set st
      i in I & j in I & k in I &
      [i,j] in leI & [j,k] in leI holds [i,k] in leI) &
    {} in Open &
    A in Open &
    (for S being Subset-Family of A st S c= Open holds union S in Open) &
    (for U,V being Subset of A st U in Open & V in Open
      holds U /\ V in Open) &
    (for x being Element of G holds [x,x] in leG) &
    (for x,y being Element of G st [x,y] in leG & [y,x] in leG
      holds x = y) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G st [x,y] in leG & [y,z] in leG
      holds [x,z] in leG) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds
      [infG.(x,y),x] in leG & [infG.(x,y),y] in leG) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G st [z,x] in leG & [z,y] in leG
      holds [z,infG.(x,y)] in leG) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds
      [x,supG.(x,y)] in leG & [y,supG.(x,y)] in leG) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G st [x,z] in leG & [y,z] in leG
      holds [supG.(x,y),z] in leG) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds add.(x,y) = add.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G holds
      add.(add.(x,y),z) = add.(x,add.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Element of G holds add.(x,zero) = x) &
    (for x being Element of G holds add.(x,opp.x) = zero) &
    (for x,y,z being Element of G st [x,y] in leG
      holds [add.(x,z),add.(y,z)] in leG) &
    (for x being Element of G holds 0 <= normG.x) &
    (for x being Element of G holds (normG.x = 0 iff x = zero)) &
    (for x,y being Element of G holds
      normG.(add.(x,y)) <= normG.x + normG.y) &
    (for x,y being Element of G st
      [supG.(x,opp.x),supG.(y,opp.y)] in leG
      holds normG.x <= normG.y) &
    (for i,j being set,
         u,v being Function of A,G st
      i in I & j in I & u = F.i & v = F.j & [i,j] in leI
      holds for x being set st x in A holds [u.x,v.x] in leG) &
    (for i being set,
         u being Function of A,G st i in I & u = F.i
      holds
        for x being set,
            ux being Element of G st ux = u.x holds
          x in A implies
            for e being Real st 0 < e holds
              ex U being Subset of A st
                U in Open & x in U &
                for y being set,
                    uy being Element of G st
                  y in U & uy = u.y
                holds normG.(add.(uy,opp.ux)) < e) &
    (for x being set,
         fx being Element of G st fx = f.x holds
      x in A implies
        for e being Real st 0 < e holds
          ex U being Subset of A st
            U in Open & x in U &
            for y being set,
                fy being Element of G st
              y in U & fy = f.y
            holds normG.(add.(fy,opp.fx)) < e) &
    (for x being set,
         fx being Element of G st fx = f.x holds
      x in A implies
        for e being Real st 0 < e holds
          ex B being finite Subset of I st
            for i being set,
                u being Function of A,G,
                ux being Element of G st
              i in I & u = F.i & ux = u.x &
              (for b being set st b in B holds [b,i] in leI)
            holds normG.(add.(ux,opp.fx)) < e)
  holds
    for x being set,
        fx being Element of G st fx = f.x holds
      x in A implies
        for e being Real st 0 < e holds
          ex U being Subset of A,
             B being finite Subset of I st
            U in Open & x in U &
            for i being set,
                u being Function of A,G st
              i in I & u = F.i &
              (for b being set st b in B holds [b,i] in leI)
            holds
              for y being set,
                  uy,fy being Element of G st
                y in U & uy = u.y & fy = f.y
              holds normG.(add.(uy,opp.fy)) < e
  )
proof
end;
