title: Q595466_dini_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q595466,
% "Dini's theorem": a monotone family of continuous functions from a topological
% space to a solid-normed lattice ordered additive group that converges pointwise
% along atTop converges locally uniformly. This file contains no proof.

dini_s_theorem_Q595466[
  I: TYPE,
  X: TYPE,
  G: TYPE+,
  leI: [I, I -> bool],
  openX: [[X -> bool] -> bool],
  zeroG: G,
  addG: [G, G -> G],
  negG: [G -> G],
  normG: [G -> real],
  leG: [G, G -> bool],
  supG: [G, G -> G],
  infG: [G, G -> G]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  x_set: TYPE = [X -> bool]
  x_set_family: TYPE = [x_set -> bool]
  g_set: TYPE = [G -> bool]
  g_function: TYPE = [X -> G]
  indexed_functions: TYPE = [I -> g_function]
  index_property: TYPE = [I -> bool]

  empty_x_set: x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): FALSE

  whole_x_set: x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X): TRUE

  x_intersection(U, V: x_set): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      U(x) AND V(x)

  x_union(F: x_set_family): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      EXISTS (U: x_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  x_subset(U, V: x_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: X):
      U(x) IMPLIES V(x)

  topology_laws: bool =
    openX(empty_x_set)
      AND openX(whole_x_set)
      AND (FORALL (U, V: x_set):
        openX(U) AND openX(V)
          IMPLIES openX(x_intersection(U, V)))
      AND (FORALL (F: x_set_family):
        (FORALL (U: x_set):
          F(U) IMPLIES openX(U))
        IMPLIES openX(x_union(F)))

  neighborhood(T: x_set, x: X): bool =
    EXISTS (U: x_set):
      openX(U)
        AND U(x)
        AND x_subset(U, T)

  preorder_index_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (i: I):
      leI(i, i))
      AND (FORALL (i, j, k: I):
        leI(i, j) AND leI(j, k)
          IMPLIES leI(i, k))

  above_all(i: I, bounds: list[I]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES bounds OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(bound, rest):
        leI(bound, i) AND above_all(i, rest)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE bounds BY <<

  eventually_at_top(property: index_property): bool =
    EXISTS (bounds: list[I]):
      FORALL (i: I):
        above_all(i, bounds)
          IMPLIES property(i)

  additive_commutative_group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: G):
      addG(x, y) = addG(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        addG(addG(x, y), z) =
          addG(x, addG(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        addG(x, zeroG) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        addG(x, negG(x)) = zeroG)

  subG(x, y: G): G =
    addG(x, negG(y))

  norm_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: G):
      normG(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroG)
      AND (FORALL (x: G):
        normG(negG(x)) = normG(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        normG(addG(x, y))
          <= normG(x) + normG(y))

  partial_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: G):
      leG(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        leG(x, y) AND leG(y, z)
          IMPLIES leG(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        leG(x, y) AND leG(y, x)
          IMPLIES x = y)

  lattice_laws: bool =
    partial_order_laws
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        leG(x, supG(x, y))
          AND leG(y, supG(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        leG(x, z) AND leG(y, z)
          IMPLIES leG(supG(x, y), z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: G):
        leG(infG(x, y), x)
          AND leG(infG(x, y), y))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: G):
        leG(z, x) AND leG(z, y)
          IMPLIES leG(z, infG(x, y)))

  ordered_additive_monoid_laws: bool =
    FORALL (x, y, z: G):
      leG(x, y)
        IMPLIES leG(addG(x, z), addG(y, z))

  absG(x: G): G =
    supG(x, negG(x))

  solid_norm_law: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: G):
      leG(absG(x), absG(y))
        IMPLIES normG(x) <= normG(y)

  normed_lattice_ordered_group_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_laws
      AND norm_laws
      AND lattice_laws
      AND ordered_additive_monoid_laws
      AND solid_norm_law

  g_open(U: g_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: G):
      U(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          radius > 0
            AND FORALL (y: G):
              normG(subG(y, x)) < radius
                IMPLIES U(y)

  preimage(h: g_function, U: g_set): x_set =
    LAMBDA (x: X):
      U(h(x))

  continuous(h: g_function): bool =
    FORALL (U: g_set):
      g_open(U) IMPLIES
        openX(preimage(h, U))

  monotone_family(F: indexed_functions): bool =
    FORALL (i, j: I):
      leI(i, j) IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: X):
          leG(F(i)(x), F(j)(x))

  pointwise_converges_at_top(
      F: indexed_functions,
      f: g_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: X), (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        eventually_at_top(
          LAMBDA (i: I):
            normG(subG(F(i)(x), f(x)))
              < epsilon_value)

  converges_locally_uniformly_at_top(
      F: indexed_functions,
      f: g_function): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: real):
      epsilon_value > 0 IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: X):
          EXISTS (T: x_set):
            neighborhood(T, x)
              AND eventually_at_top(
                LAMBDA (i: I):
                  FORALL (y: X):
                    T(y) IMPLIES
                      normG(subG(F(i)(y), f(y)))
                        < epsilon_value)

  tendstoLocallyUniformly_of_forall_tendsto: bool =
    (preorder_index_laws
      AND topology_laws
      AND normed_lattice_ordered_group_laws)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (F: indexed_functions),
          (f: g_function):
        ((FORALL (i: I):
            continuous(F(i)))
          AND monotone_family(F)
          AND continuous(f)
          AND pointwise_converges_at_top(F, f))
        IMPLIES
          converges_locally_uniformly_at_top(F, f)
END dini_s_theorem_Q595466

title: Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q609612
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q609612), "Knaster–Tarski theorem": the fixed points of a
-- monotone self-map of a complete lattice themselves form a complete lattice. This file
-- contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Dynamics.FixedPoints.Basic
public import Mathlib.Order.Hom.Order

@[expose] public section

universe u

open Function

namespace Q609612

variable {α : Type u} [CompleteLattice α]

/-- Every set of fixed points has a least upper bound and a greatest lower bound in the
inherited order. This is the order-theoretic content of the Knaster-Tarski complete-lattice
instance. -/
theorem knasterTarskiCompleteLattice (f : α →o α) :
    ∀ S : Set (fixedPoints f),
      (∃ u : fixedPoints f, IsLUB S u) ∧
        ∃ l : fixedPoints f, IsGLB S l := sorry

end Q609612

title: Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q609612
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q609612), "Knaster–Tarski theorem": the fixed
  points of a monotone self-map of a complete lattice themselves form a
  complete lattice under the inherited order. This file contains no proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q609612_complete_lattice (A : Type) : Type := {
  q609612_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q609612_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q609612_le x x;
  q609612_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q609612_le x y ->
      q609612_le y z ->
      q609612_le x z;
  q609612_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q609612_le x y ->
      q609612_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q609612_supremum : (A -> Prop) -> A;
  q609612_le_supremum :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (x : A),
      S x ->
      q609612_le x (q609612_supremum S);
  q609612_supremum_le :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (upper : A),
      (forall x : A, S x -> q609612_le x upper) ->
      q609612_le (q609612_supremum S) upper;
  q609612_infimum : (A -> Prop) -> A;
  q609612_infimum_le :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (x : A),
      S x ->
      q609612_le (q609612_infimum S) x;
  q609612_le_infimum :
    forall (S : A -> Prop) (lower : A),
      (forall x : A, S x -> q609612_le lower x) ->
      q609612_le lower (q609612_infimum S)
}.

Arguments q609612_le {A} _ _ _.

Record q609612_order_hom
    (A : Type) (L : q609612_complete_lattice A) : Type := {
  q609612_hom_fun : A -> A;
  q609612_hom_monotone :
    forall x y : A,
      q609612_le L x y ->
      q609612_le L (q609612_hom_fun x) (q609612_hom_fun y)
}.

Arguments q609612_order_hom A L : clear implicits.
Arguments q609612_hom_fun {A L} _ _.

Definition q609612_fixed_points
    {A : Type}
    {L : q609612_complete_lattice A}
    (f : q609612_order_hom A L) : A -> Prop :=
  fun x : A => q609612_hom_fun f x = x.

Record q609612_fixed_point
    {A : Type}
    {L : q609612_complete_lattice A}
    (f : q609612_order_hom A L) : Type := {
  q609612_fixed_point_val : A;
  q609612_fixed_point_property :
    q609612_hom_fun f q609612_fixed_point_val =
    q609612_fixed_point_val
}.

Arguments q609612_fixed_point {A L} f.
Arguments q609612_fixed_point_val {A L f} _.

Definition q609612_fixed_point_equiv
    {A : Type}
    {L : q609612_complete_lattice A}
    (f : q609612_order_hom A L)
    (x y : q609612_fixed_point f) : Prop :=
  q609612_fixed_point_val x = q609612_fixed_point_val y.

Arguments q609612_fixed_point_equiv {A L} f _ _.

Definition q609612_fixed_point_le
    {A : Type}
    {L : q609612_complete_lattice A}
    (f : q609612_order_hom A L)
    (x y : q609612_fixed_point f) : Prop :=
  q609612_le L
    (q609612_fixed_point_val x)
    (q609612_fixed_point_val y).

Arguments q609612_fixed_point_le {A L} f _ _.

Record q609612_setoid_subset
    (A : Type)
    (equiv : A -> A -> Prop) : Type := {
  q609612_setoid_subset_carrier : A -> Prop;
  q609612_setoid_subset_compatible :
    forall x y : A,
      equiv x y ->
      (q609612_setoid_subset_carrier x <->
       q609612_setoid_subset_carrier y)
}.

Arguments q609612_setoid_subset A equiv : clear implicits.
Arguments q609612_setoid_subset_carrier {A equiv} _ _.

Record q609612_complete_lattice_structure
    (A : Type)
    (equiv : A -> A -> Prop)
    (le : A -> A -> Prop) : Type := {
  q609612_structure_equiv_refl :
    forall x : A, equiv x x;
  q609612_structure_equiv_sym :
    forall x y : A,
      equiv x y ->
      equiv y x;
  q609612_structure_equiv_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      equiv x y ->
      equiv y z ->
      equiv x z;
  q609612_structure_le_compatible :
    forall x x' y y' : A,
      equiv x x' ->
      equiv y y' ->
      (le x y <-> le x' y');
  q609612_structure_le_refl :
    forall x : A, le x x;
  q609612_structure_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      le x y ->
      le y z ->
      le x z;
  q609612_structure_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      le x y ->
      le y x ->
      equiv x y;
  q609612_structure_bottom : A;
  q609612_structure_bottom_le :
    forall x : A, le q609612_structure_bottom x;
  q609612_structure_top : A;
  q609612_structure_le_top :
    forall x : A, le x q609612_structure_top;
  q609612_structure_sup : A -> A -> A;
  q609612_structure_sup_compatible :
    forall x x' y y' : A,
      equiv x x' ->
      equiv y y' ->
      equiv
        (q609612_structure_sup x y)
        (q609612_structure_sup x' y');
  q609612_structure_le_sup_left :
    forall x y : A, le x (q609612_structure_sup x y);
  q609612_structure_le_sup_right :
    forall x y : A, le y (q609612_structure_sup x y);
  q609612_structure_sup_le :
    forall x y upper : A,
      le x upper ->
      le y upper ->
      le (q609612_structure_sup x y) upper;
  q609612_structure_inf : A -> A -> A;
  q609612_structure_inf_compatible :
    forall x x' y y' : A,
      equiv x x' ->
      equiv y y' ->
      equiv
        (q609612_structure_inf x y)
        (q609612_structure_inf x' y');
  q609612_structure_inf_le_left :
    forall x y : A, le (q609612_structure_inf x y) x;
  q609612_structure_inf_le_right :
    forall x y : A, le (q609612_structure_inf x y) y;
  q609612_structure_le_inf :
    forall lower x y : A,
      le lower x ->
      le lower y ->
      le lower (q609612_structure_inf x y);
  q609612_structure_supremum :
    q609612_setoid_subset A equiv -> A;
  q609612_structure_supremum_compatible :
    forall S T : q609612_setoid_subset A equiv,
      (forall x : A,
        q609612_setoid_subset_carrier S x <->
        q609612_setoid_subset_carrier T x) ->
      equiv
        (q609612_structure_supremum S)
        (q609612_structure_supremum T);
  q609612_structure_le_supremum :
    forall (S : q609612_setoid_subset A equiv) (x : A),
      q609612_setoid_subset_carrier S x ->
      le x (q609612_structure_supremum S);
  q609612_structure_supremum_le :
    forall (S : q609612_setoid_subset A equiv) (upper : A),
      (forall x : A,
        q609612_setoid_subset_carrier S x ->
        le x upper) ->
      le (q609612_structure_supremum S) upper;
  q609612_structure_infimum :
    q609612_setoid_subset A equiv -> A;
  q609612_structure_infimum_compatible :
    forall S T : q609612_setoid_subset A equiv,
      (forall x : A,
        q609612_setoid_subset_carrier S x <->
        q609612_setoid_subset_carrier T x) ->
      equiv
        (q609612_structure_infimum S)
        (q609612_structure_infimum T);
  q609612_structure_infimum_le :
    forall (S : q609612_setoid_subset A equiv) (x : A),
      q609612_setoid_subset_carrier S x ->
      le (q609612_structure_infimum S) x;
  q609612_structure_le_infimum :
    forall (S : q609612_setoid_subset A equiv) (lower : A),
      (forall x : A,
        q609612_setoid_subset_carrier S x ->
        le lower x) ->
      le lower (q609612_structure_infimum S)
}.

Module fixedPoints.

Theorem completeLattice :
  forall (A : Type)
         (L : q609612_complete_lattice A)
         (f : q609612_order_hom A L),
    @q609612_complete_lattice_structure
      (q609612_fixed_point f)
      (q609612_fixed_point_equiv f)
      (q609612_fixed_point_le f).
Admitted.

End fixedPoints.

title: Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q609612
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q609612), "Knaster–Tarski theorem": the fixed
  points of a monotone self-map of a complete lattice form a complete lattice
  under the inherited order. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q609612_is_lub_in ::
    "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q609612_is_lub_in C S u \<longleftrightarrow>
    u \<in> C \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> S. x \<le> u) \<and>
    (\<forall>z \<in> C. (\<forall>x \<in> S. x \<le> z) \<longrightarrow> u \<le> z)"

definition q609612_is_glb_in ::
    "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q609612_is_glb_in C S l \<longleftrightarrow>
    l \<in> C \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> S. l \<le> x) \<and>
    (\<forall>z \<in> C. (\<forall>x \<in> S. z \<le> x) \<longrightarrow> z \<le> l)"

theorem q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem:
  fixes f :: "'a::complete_lattice \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes monotone: "mono f"
  shows "\<forall>S \<subseteq> {x. f x = x}.
    (\<exists>u. q609612_is_lub_in {x. f x = x} S u) \<and>
    (\<exists>l. q609612_is_glb_in {x. f x = x} S l)"
  sorry

end

title: Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q609612
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q609612), "Knaster–Tarski theorem": the fixed
  points of a monotone self-map of a complete lattice form a complete lattice
  under the inherited order. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q609612_KNASTER_TARSKI_THEOREM =
  `let is_partial_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) in
   let is_supremum =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (u:A).
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x u) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x v) ==> le u v) in
   let is_infimum =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (l:A).
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> le l x) /\
       (!v:A. (!x:A. x IN s ==> le v x) ==> le v l) in
   let is_complete_lattice =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (sSup:(A->bool)->A) (sInf:(A->bool)->A).
       is_partial_order le /\
       (!s:A->bool. is_supremum le s (sSup s)) /\
       (!s:A->bool. is_infimum le s (sInf s)) in
   let is_monotone =
     \(le:A->A->bool) (f:A->A).
       !x y:A. le x y ==> le (f x) (f y) in
   let is_partial_order_on =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. carrier x ==> le x x) /\
       (!x y:A.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ le x y /\ le y x
          ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z /\
          le x y /\ le y z
          ==> le x z) in
   let is_supremum_in =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (u:A).
       carrier u /\
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> carrier x /\ le x u) /\
       (!v:A.
          carrier v /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> le x v)
          ==> le u v) in
   let is_infimum_in =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool) (s:A->bool) (l:A).
       carrier l /\
       (!x:A. x IN s ==> carrier x /\ le l x) /\
       (!v:A.
          carrier v /\ (!x:A. x IN s ==> le v x)
          ==> le v l) in
   let is_complete_lattice_on =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (le:A->A->bool).
       is_partial_order_on carrier le /\
       (!s:A->bool.
          (!x:A. x IN s ==> carrier x)
          ==> ?u:A. is_supremum_in carrier le s u) /\
       (!s:A->bool.
          (!x:A. x IN s ==> carrier x)
          ==> ?l:A. is_infimum_in carrier le s l) in
   !le:A->A->bool.
   !sSup:(A->bool)->A.
   !sInf:(A->bool)->A.
   !f:A->A.
     is_complete_lattice le sSup sInf /\
     is_monotone le f
     ==> is_complete_lattice_on (\x:A. f x = x) le`;;

(in-package "ACL2")

;; self-map, and unary characteristic predicates of potentially infinite
;; subsets. All typing, order, completeness, and monotonicity assumptions are
;; explicit in the statement predicate.

(defun q609612-member-p (carrier x)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list x))
      t
    nil))

(defun q609612-le-p (carrier order x y)
  (and
   (q609612-member-p carrier x)
   (q609612-member-p carrier y)
   (if (apply$ order (list x y))
       t
     nil)))

(defun q609612-map-value (map x)
  (apply$ map (list x)))

(defun-sk q609612-carrier-nonempty-p (carrier)
  (exists (x)
    (q609612-member-p carrier x)))

(defun-sk q609612-partial-order-p (carrier order)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q609612-member-p carrier x)
      (q609612-le-p carrier order x x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q609612-le-p carrier order x y)
       (q609612-le-p carrier order y x))
      (equal x y))
     (implies
      (and
       (q609612-le-p carrier order x y)
       (q609612-le-p carrier order y z))
      (q609612-le-p carrier order x z)))))

(defun q609612-subset-member-p (carrier subset x)
  (and
   (q609612-member-p carrier x)
   (if (apply$ subset (list x))
       t
     nil)))

(defun-sk q609612-subset-below-p
    (carrier order subset bound)
  (forall (x)

(defun q609612-upper-bound-p
    (carrier order subset bound)
  (and

    carrier order subset bound)))

    (carrier order subset supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q609612-upper-bound-p
      carrier order subset bound)
     (q609612-le-p
      carrier order supremum bound))))

(defun q609612-least-upper-bound-p
    (carrier order subset supremum)
  (and
   (q609612-upper-bound-p
    carrier order subset supremum)
   (q609612-below-every-upper-bound-p
    carrier order subset supremum)))

    (carrier order subset)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q609612-least-upper-bound-p
     carrier order subset supremum)))

    (carrier order subset bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q609612-subset-member-p carrier subset x)

(defun q609612-lower-bound-p
    (carrier order subset bound)
  (and
   (q609612-member-p carrier bound)
   (q609612-below-subset-p
    carrier order subset bound)))

(defun-sk q609612-every-lower-bound-below-p
    (carrier order subset infimum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (q609612-lower-bound-p

    (carrier order subset infimum)

  (forall (x y)
    (implies

title: Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q609612
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q609612), "Knaster–Tarski theorem": the fixed
-- points of a monotone self-map of a complete lattice form a complete lattice
-- under the inherited order. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe --prop #-}

module Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; Prop)

infix 4 _≡_

data _≡_
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (x : A) :
  A → Prop ℓ where

  reflexivity :
    x ≡ x

record CompleteLattice
  {ℓ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    lessOrEqual :
      A → A → Prop ℓ

    order-reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      lessOrEqual x x
    order-transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y z →
      lessOrEqual x z
    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y x →
      x ≡ y

    supremum :
      (A → Prop ℓ) → A
    supremum-upper :
      (subset : A → Prop ℓ) →
      (x : A) →
      subset x →
      lessOrEqual x (supremum subset)
    supremum-least :
      (subset : A → Prop ℓ) →
      (upper : A) →
      ((x : A) → subset x → lessOrEqual x upper) →
      lessOrEqual (supremum subset) upper

    infimum :
      (A → Prop ℓ) → A
    infimum-lower :
      (subset : A → Prop ℓ) →
      (x : A) →
      subset x →
      lessOrEqual (infimum subset) x
    infimum-greatest :
      (subset : A → Prop ℓ) →
      (lower : A) →
      ((x : A) → subset x → lessOrEqual lower x) →
      lessOrEqual lower (infimum subset)

open CompleteLattice

record OrderEndomorphism
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) :
  Set ℓ where

  field
    function :
      A → A
    monotone :
      (x y : A) →
      lessOrEqual lattice x y →
      lessOrEqual lattice (function x) (function y)

open OrderEndomorphism

IsFixedPoint :
  {ℓ : Level} →
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  {lattice : CompleteLattice A} →
  OrderEndomorphism lattice →
  A →
  Prop ℓ
IsFixedPoint endomorphism x =
  function endomorphism x ≡ x

record FixedPointSubset
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A)
  (endomorphism : OrderEndomorphism lattice) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    carrier :
      A → Prop ℓ
    member-is-fixed :
      (x : A) →
      carrier x →
      IsFixedPoint endomorphism x

open FixedPointSubset

record FixedPointsCompleteLattice
  {ℓ : Level}
  {A : Set ℓ}
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A)
  (endomorphism : OrderEndomorphism lattice) :
  Set (lsuc ℓ) where

  field
    fixedSupremum :
      FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism →
      A
    fixedSupremum-is-fixed :
      (subset : FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism) →
      IsFixedPoint endomorphism (fixedSupremum subset)
    fixedSupremum-upper :
      (subset : FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism) →
      (x : A) →
      carrier subset x →
      lessOrEqual lattice x (fixedSupremum subset)
    fixedSupremum-least :
      (subset : FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism) →
      (upper : A) →
      IsFixedPoint endomorphism upper →
      ((x : A) →
        carrier subset x →
        lessOrEqual lattice x upper) →
      lessOrEqual lattice (fixedSupremum subset) upper

    fixedInfimum :
      FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism →
      A
    fixedInfimum-is-fixed :
      (subset : FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism) →
      IsFixedPoint endomorphism (fixedInfimum subset)
    fixedInfimum-lower :
      (subset : FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism) →
      (x : A) →
      carrier subset x →
      lessOrEqual lattice (fixedInfimum subset) x
    fixedInfimum-greatest :
      (subset : FixedPointSubset lattice endomorphism) →
      (lower : A) →
      IsFixedPoint endomorphism lower →
      ((x : A) →
        carrier subset x →
        lessOrEqual lattice lower x) →
      lessOrEqual lattice lower (fixedInfimum subset)

KnasterTarskiTheorem :
  (ℓ : Level) →
  Set (lsuc ℓ)
KnasterTarskiTheorem ℓ =
  {A : Set ℓ} →
  (lattice : CompleteLattice A) →
  (endomorphism : OrderEndomorphism lattice) →
  FixedPointsCompleteLattice lattice endomorphism

${

title: Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q609612,
% "Knaster–Tarski theorem": the fixed points of a monotone self-map of a
% complete lattice form a complete lattice. This file contains no proof.

Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem[
  A: TYPE+,
  le_rel: [A, A -> bool],
  supremum: [[A -> bool] -> A],
  infimum: [[A -> bool] -> A],
  f: [A -> A]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element_set: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  self_map: TYPE = [A -> A]

  upper_bound(S: element_set, u: A): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_rel(x, u)

  lower_bound(S: element_set, l: A): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      S(x) IMPLIES le_rel(l, x)

  least_upper_bound(S: element_set, s: A): bool =
    upper_bound(S, s)
      AND (FORALL (u: A):
        upper_bound(S, u) IMPLIES le_rel(s, u))

  greatest_lower_bound(S: element_set, i: A): bool =
    lower_bound(S, i)
      AND (FORALL (l: A):
        lower_bound(S, l) IMPLIES le_rel(l, i))

  partial_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): le_rel(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, z) IMPLIES le_rel(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: A):
        le_rel(x, y) AND le_rel(y, x) IMPLIES x = y)

  complete_lattice_laws: bool =
    partial_order_laws
      AND (FORALL (S: element_set):
        least_upper_bound(S, supremum(S)))
      AND (FORALL (S: element_set):
        greatest_lower_bound(S, infimum(S)))

  monotone(g: self_map): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      le_rel(x, y) IMPLIES le_rel(g(x), g(y))

  fixed_point(g: self_map, x: A): bool =
    g(x) = x

  consists_of_fixed_points(g: self_map, S: element_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: A):
      S(x) IMPLIES fixed_point(g, x)

  fixed_upper_bound(
      g: self_map,
      S: element_set,
      u: A): bool =
    fixed_point(g, u)
      AND upper_bound(S, u)

  fixed_lower_bound(
      g: self_map,
      S: element_set,
      l: A): bool =
    fixed_point(g, l)
      AND lower_bound(S, l)

  least_fixed_upper_bound(
      g: self_map,
      S: element_set,
      s: A): bool =
    fixed_upper_bound(g, S, s)
      AND (FORALL (u: A):
        fixed_upper_bound(g, S, u) IMPLIES le_rel(s, u))

  greatest_fixed_lower_bound(
      g: self_map,
      S: element_set,
      i: A): bool =
    fixed_lower_bound(g, S, i)
      AND (FORALL (l: A):
        fixed_lower_bound(g, S, l) IMPLIES le_rel(l, i))

  knaster_tarski_theorem: bool =
    complete_lattice_laws
      AND monotone(f)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: element_set):
        consists_of_fixed_points(f, S) IMPLIES
          (EXISTS (s: A):
            least_fixed_upper_bound(f, S, s))
          AND (EXISTS (i: A):
            greatest_fixed_lower_bound(f, S, i))
END Q609612_knaster_tarski_theorem

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q619985
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q619985), "Multinomial theorem": for pairwise
-- commuting values indexed by a finite set in a semiring, the power of their
-- sum is the multinomial sum over exponent functions of the same total degree.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial

@[expose] public section

open Finset
open scoped Function

namespace Q619985

variable {α R : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Semiring R]

/-- The multinomial expansion for a finite family of pairwise commuting semiring elements. -/
theorem sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute (s : Finset α) (f : α → R)
    (hc : (s : Set α).Pairwise (Commute on f)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ n =
      ∑ k ∈ piAntidiag s n, Nat.multinomial s k *
        s.noncommProd (fun i ↦ f i ^ k i) (hc.mono' fun _ _ h ↦ h.pow_pow ..) := sorry

end Q619985

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q619985
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q619985), "Multinomial theorem": for pairwise
  commuting values indexed by a finite set in a semiring, the power of their
  sum is the multinomial sum over exponent assignments of the same total
  degree. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q619985_semiring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q619985_zero : R;
  q619985_one : R;
  q619985_add : R -> R -> R;
  q619985_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q619985_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q619985_add x (q619985_add y z) =
      q619985_add (q619985_add x y) z;
  q619985_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q619985_add x y = q619985_add y x;
  q619985_zero_add :
    forall x : R, q619985_add q619985_zero x = x;
  q619985_add_zero :
    forall x : R, q619985_add x q619985_zero = x;
  q619985_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q619985_mul x (q619985_mul y z) =
      q619985_mul (q619985_mul x y) z;
  q619985_one_mul :
    forall x : R, q619985_mul q619985_one x = x;
  q619985_mul_one :
    forall x : R, q619985_mul x q619985_one = x;
  q619985_mul_add :
    forall x y z : R,
      q619985_mul x (q619985_add y z) =
      q619985_add
        (q619985_mul x y) (q619985_mul x z);
  q619985_add_mul :
    forall x y z : R,
      q619985_mul (q619985_add x y) z =
      q619985_add
        (q619985_mul x z) (q619985_mul y z);
  q619985_zero_mul :
    forall x : R, q619985_mul q619985_zero x = q619985_zero;
  q619985_mul_zero :
    forall x : R, q619985_mul x q619985_zero = q619985_zero
}.

Arguments q619985_zero {R} _.
Arguments q619985_one {R} _.
Arguments q619985_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q619985_mul {R} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q619985_pow
    {R : Type}
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (x : R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q619985_one SR
  | S k => q619985_mul SR x (q619985_pow SR x k)
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_nat_cast
    {R : Type}
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q619985_zero SR
  | S k =>
      q619985_add SR (q619985_nat_cast SR k) (q619985_one SR)
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_factorial (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S k => S k * q619985_factorial k
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_sum_exponents
    {A : Type}
    (indices : list A)
    (k : A -> nat) : nat :=
  match indices with
  | [] => O
  | i :: rest => k i + q619985_sum_exponents rest k
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_factorial_product
    {A : Type}
    (indices : list A)
    (k : A -> nat) : nat :=
  match indices with
  | [] => 1
  | i :: rest =>
      q619985_factorial (k i) *
      q619985_factorial_product rest k
  end.

Definition q619985_multinomial
    {A : Type}
    (indices : list A)
    (k : A -> nat) : nat :=
  Nat.div
    (q619985_factorial (q619985_sum_exponents indices k))
    (q619985_factorial_product indices k).

Fixpoint q619985_compositions
    (number_of_indices total_degree : nat) : list (list nat) :=
  match number_of_indices with
  | O =>
      match total_degree with
      | O => [[]]
      | S _ => []
      end
  | S smaller_number =>
      flat_map
        (fun exponent =>
          map
            (fun remaining => exponent :: remaining)
            (q619985_compositions
              smaller_number (Nat.sub total_degree exponent)))
        (seq O (S total_degree))
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_exponent_function
    {A : Type}
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (indices : list A)
    (exponents : list nat)
    (x : A) : nat :=
  match indices, exponents with
  | i :: rest_indices, exponent :: rest_exponents =>
      if eq_dec x i
      then exponent
      else
        q619985_exponent_function
          eq_dec rest_indices rest_exponents x
  | _, _ => O
  end.

Definition q619985_pi_antidiag
    {A : Type}
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (indices : list A)
    (total_degree : nat) : list (A -> nat) :=
  map
    (fun exponents =>
      q619985_exponent_function eq_dec indices exponents)
    (q619985_compositions (length indices) total_degree).

Fixpoint q619985_sum
    {A R : Type}
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (f : A -> R)
    (indices : list A) : R :=
  match indices with
  | [] => q619985_zero SR
  | i :: rest =>
      q619985_add SR (f i) (q619985_sum SR f rest)
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_product_of_powers
    {A R : Type}
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (f : A -> R)
    (indices : list A)
    (k : A -> nat) : R :=
  match indices with
  | [] => q619985_one SR
  | i :: rest_indices =>
      q619985_mul SR
        (q619985_pow SR (f i) (k i))
        (q619985_product_of_powers
          SR f rest_indices k)
  end.

Fixpoint q619985_multinomial_sum
    {A R : Type}
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (f : A -> R)
    (indices : list A)
    (exponent_assignments : list (A -> nat)) : R :=
  match exponent_assignments with
  | [] => q619985_zero SR
  | k :: rest =>
      q619985_add SR
        (q619985_mul SR
          (q619985_nat_cast SR
            (q619985_multinomial indices k))
          (q619985_product_of_powers
            SR f indices k))
        (q619985_multinomial_sum SR f indices rest)
  end.

Definition q619985_pairwise_commute
    {A R : Type}
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (f : A -> R)
    (indices : list A) : Prop :=
  forall x y : A,
    In x indices ->
    In y indices ->
    x <> y ->
    q619985_mul SR (f x) (f y) =
    q619985_mul SR (f y) (f x).

Theorem sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute :
  forall
    (A R : Type)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (SR : q619985_semiring R)
    (indices : list A)
    (f : A -> R),
    NoDup indices ->
    q619985_pairwise_commute SR f indices ->
    forall n : nat,
    q619985_pow SR (q619985_sum SR f indices) n =
    q619985_multinomial_sum
      SR f indices (q619985_pi_antidiag eq_dec indices n).
Admitted.

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q619985 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q619985), "Multinomial theorem":
  a natural power of a finite sum of pairwise-commuting elements of a semiring
  expands using multinomial coefficients and finite noncommutative products.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q619985_multinomial_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q619985_pi_antidiag :: "'i set \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "q619985_pi_antidiag s n =
    {k. (\<forall>i. i \<notin> s \<longrightarrow> k i = 0) \<and> (\<Sum>i\<in>s. k i) = n}"

definition q619985_multinomial :: "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q619985_multinomial s k =
    fact (\<Sum>i\<in>s. k i) div (\<Prod>i\<in>s. fact (k i))"

definition q619985_nat_cast :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::{semiring_0,monoid_mult}" where
  "q619985_nat_cast n = (\<Sum>i<n. 1)"

definition q619985_index_list :: "'i set \<Rightarrow> 'i list" where
  "q619985_index_list s =
    (SOME xs. distinct xs \<and> set xs = s)"

definition q619985_noncomm_prod ::
    "'i set \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a::monoid_mult) \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q619985_noncomm_prod s g =
    foldr (\<lambda>i acc. g i * acc) (q619985_index_list s) 1"

theorem sum_pow_eq_sum_pi_antidiag_of_commute:
  fixes s :: "'i set"
    and f :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a::{semiring_0,monoid_mult}"
    and n :: nat
  assumes finite_s: "finite s"
    and commute:
      "\<And>i j. i \<in> s \<Longrightarrow> j \<in> s \<Longrightarrow> i \<noteq> j \<Longrightarrow>
        f i * f j = f j * f i"
  shows "(\<Sum>i\<in>s. f i) ^ n =
    (\<Sum>k\<in>q619985_pi_antidiag s n.
      q619985_nat_cast (q619985_multinomial s k) *
        q619985_noncomm_prod s (\<lambda>i. f i ^ k i))"
  sorry

end

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q619985,
  "Multinomial theorem": in a semiring, the power of a finite sum of pairwise
  commuting elements expands as the sum over supported exponent functions of
  multinomial coefficients times the corresponding products. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q619985_MULTINOMIAL_THEOREM =
  `let is_semiring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R).
       (!a:R. addR zeroR a = a /\ addR a zeroR = a) /\
       (!a b:R. addR a b = addR b a) /\
       (!a b c:R. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
       (!a:R. mulR oneR a = a /\ mulR a oneR = a) /\
       (!a b c:R. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
       (!a b c:R.
          mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) /\
       (!a:R. mulR zeroR a = zeroR /\ mulR a zeroR = zeroR) in
   let powerR =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (x:R) (m:num).
       ITLIST mulR (REPLICATE m x) oneR in
   let natcastR =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (m:num).
       ITLIST addR (REPLICATE m oneR) zeroR in
   let enum_I =
     \(s:I->bool).
       @li:I list.
         PAIRWISE (\x y:I. ~(x = y)) li /\
         (!i:I. MEM i li <=> i IN s) in
   let sumR_I =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (s:I->bool) (g:I->R).
       ITSET (\i a. addR (g i) a) s zeroR in
   let productR_I =
     \(oneR:R) (mulR:R->R->R) (s:I->bool) (g:I->R).
       ITLIST (\i a. mulR (g i) a) (enum_I s) oneR in
   let sumN_I =
     \(s:I->bool) (k:I->num).
       ITSET (\i a. k i + a) s 0 in
   let productN_I =
     \(s:I->bool) (k:I->num).
       ITSET (\i a. k i * a) s 1 in
   let multinomial =
     \(s:I->bool) (k:I->num).
       FACT (sumN_I s k) DIV
       productN_I s (\i:I. FACT (k i)) in
   let pi_antidiag =
     \(s:I->bool) (n:num).
       {k:I->num |
          sumN_I s k = n /\
          (!i:I. ~(i IN s) ==> k i = 0)} in
   let sumR_K =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R)
      (t:(I->num)->bool) (g:(I->num)->R).
       ITSET (\k a. addR (g k) a) t zeroR in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !s:I->bool.
   !f:I->R.
   !n:num.
     is_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
     FINITE s /\
     (!i j:I.
        i IN s /\ j IN s /\ ~(i = j)
        ==> mulR (f i) (f j) = mulR (f j) (f i))
     ==>
     powerR oneR mulR (sumR_I zeroR addR s f) n =
       sumR_K zeroR addR (pi_antidiag s n)
         (\k:I->num.
            mulR
              (natcastR zeroR oneR addR (multinomial s k))
              (productR_I oneR mulR s
                (\i:I. powerR oneR mulR (f i) (k i))))`;;

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q619985,
;; "Multinomial theorem": for a finite family of pairwise commuting elements
;; in an arbitrary semiring, the nth power of their sum equals the multinomial
;; sum over all natural exponent assignments of total n. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent the arbitrary source index type,
;; semiring, and function. Tags distinguish instances without enumerating or
;; otherwise restricting their carriers.

(defstub q619985-index-member-p (index-type value) t)
(defstub q619985-scalar-member-p (semiring value) t)
(defstub q619985-zero (semiring) t)
(defstub q619985-one (semiring) t)
(defstub q619985-add (semiring left right) t)
(defstub q619985-multiply (semiring left right) t)
(defstub q619985-family-value (family index) t)

;; Exact first-order presentation of Lean's possibly trivial Semiring class.

(defun-sk q619985-semiring-laws-p (semiring)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q619985-scalar-member-p semiring x)
      (let ((zero (q619985-zero semiring))
            (one (q619985-one semiring)))
        (and
         (equal (q619985-add semiring x zero) x)
         (equal (q619985-add semiring zero x) x)
         (equal (q619985-multiply semiring x one) x)
         (equal (q619985-multiply semiring one x) x)
         (equal (q619985-multiply semiring x zero) zero)
         (equal (q619985-multiply semiring zero x) zero))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q619985-scalar-member-p semiring x)
       (q619985-scalar-member-p semiring y))
      (and
       (q619985-scalar-member-p
        semiring
        (q619985-add semiring x y))
       (q619985-scalar-member-p
        semiring
        (q619985-multiply semiring x y))
       (equal
        (q619985-add semiring x y)
        (q619985-add semiring y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q619985-scalar-member-p semiring x)
       (q619985-scalar-member-p semiring y)
       (q619985-scalar-member-p semiring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q619985-add
         semiring
         (q619985-add semiring x y)
         z)
        (q619985-add
         semiring
         x
         (q619985-add semiring y z)))
       (equal
        (q619985-multiply
         semiring
         (q619985-multiply semiring x y)
         z)
        (q619985-multiply
         semiring
         x
         (q619985-multiply semiring y z)))
       (equal
        (q619985-multiply
         semiring
         x
         (q619985-add semiring y z))
        (q619985-add
         semiring
         (q619985-multiply semiring x y)
         (q619985-multiply semiring x z)))
       (equal
        (q619985-multiply
         semiring
         (q619985-add semiring x y)
         z)
        (q619985-add
         semiring
         (q619985-multiply semiring x z)
         (q619985-multiply semiring y z))))))))

(defun q619985-semiring-p (semiring)
  (and
   (q619985-scalar-member-p
    semiring
    (q619985-zero semiring))
   (q619985-scalar-member-p
    semiring
    (q619985-one semiring))
   (q619985-semiring-laws-p semiring)))

(defun-sk q619985-family-p (index-type semiring family)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q619985-index-member-p index-type index)
     (q619985-scalar-member-p
      semiring
      (q619985-family-value family index)))))

;; A duplicate-free true list is an enumeration of the source Finset.

(defun q619985-index-elements-p (indices index-type)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (q619985-index-member-p index-type (car indices))
       (q619985-index-elements-p (cdr indices) index-type))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun q619985-finset-p (indices index-type)
  (and
   (true-listp indices)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)
   (q619985-index-elements-p indices index-type)))

(defun q619985-commutes-with-tail-p
    (semiring value tail family)
  (if (consp tail)
      (let ((next-value
             (q619985-family-value family (car tail))))
        (and
         (equal
          (q619985-multiply semiring value next-value)
          (q619985-multiply semiring next-value value))
         (q619985-commutes-with-tail-p
          semiring value (cdr tail) family)))
    (equal tail nil)))

(defun q619985-pairwise-commuting-p
    (semiring indices family)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (q619985-commutes-with-tail-p
        semiring
        (q619985-family-value family (car indices))
        (cdr indices)
        family)
       (q619985-pairwise-commuting-p
        semiring (cdr indices) family))
    (equal indices nil)))

;; Semiring-valued finite sums, natural casts, powers, and ordered products.

(defun q619985-r-nat (semiring n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q619985-zero semiring)
    (q619985-add
     semiring
     (q619985-one semiring)
     (q619985-r-nat semiring (1- n)))))

(defun q619985-r-power (semiring base exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q619985-one semiring)
    (q619985-multiply
     semiring
     base
     (q619985-r-power semiring base (1- exponent)))))

(defun q619985-sum-values (semiring indices family)
  (if (consp indices)
      (q619985-add
       semiring
       (q619985-family-value family (car indices))
       (q619985-sum-values semiring (cdr indices) family))
    (q619985-zero semiring)))

(defun q619985-factorial (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      1
    (* n (q619985-factorial (1- n)))))

(defun q619985-sum-naturals (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (+ (nfix (car values))
         (q619985-sum-naturals (cdr values)))
    0))

(defun q619985-product-factorials (values)
  (if (consp values)
      (* (q619985-factorial (nfix (car values)))
         (q619985-product-factorials (cdr values)))
    1))

(defun q619985-multinomial-coefficient (exponents)
  (floor
   (q619985-factorial
    (q619985-sum-naturals exponents))
   (q619985-product-factorials exponents)))

;; For a list of length |s|, these are exactly the tuples in {0,...,n}^|s|.
;; Filtering by total n below gives a bijective list presentation of
;; Finset.piAntidiag s n, including the empty-set cases.

(defun q619985-range-down (n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (list 0)
    (cons n (q619985-range-down (1- n)))))

(defun q619985-prepend-to-tuples (value tuples)
  (if (consp tuples)
      (cons
       (cons value (car tuples))
       (q619985-prepend-to-tuples value (cdr tuples)))
    nil))

(defun q619985-prepend-values-to-tuples (values tuples)
  (if (consp values)
      (append
       (q619985-prepend-to-tuples (car values) tuples)
       (q619985-prepend-values-to-tuples (cdr values) tuples))
    nil))

(defun q619985-exponent-tuples (count n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (list nil)
    (q619985-prepend-values-to-tuples
     (q619985-range-down n)
     (q619985-exponent-tuples (1- count) n))))

(defun q619985-noncomm-monomial
    (semiring indices exponents family)
  (if (and (consp indices) (consp exponents))
      (q619985-multiply
       semiring
       (q619985-r-power
        semiring
        (q619985-family-value family (car indices))
        (car exponents))
       (q619985-noncomm-monomial
        semiring (cdr indices) (cdr exponents) family))
    (q619985-one semiring)))

(defun q619985-multinomial-term
    (semiring indices exponents family)
  (q619985-multiply
   semiring
   (q619985-r-nat
    semiring
    (q619985-multinomial-coefficient exponents))
   (q619985-noncomm-monomial
    semiring indices exponents family)))

(defun q619985-multinomial-sum
    (semiring tuples indices n family)
  (if (consp tuples)
      (if (equal (q619985-sum-naturals (car tuples)) n)
          (q619985-add
           semiring
           (q619985-multinomial-term
            semiring indices (car tuples) family)
           (q619985-multinomial-sum
            semiring (cdr tuples) indices n family))
        (q619985-multinomial-sum
         semiring (cdr tuples) indices n family))
    (q619985-zero semiring)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q619985-multinomial-theorem-statement
    (index-type semiring family indices n)
  (implies
   (and
    (q619985-semiring-p semiring)
    (q619985-family-p index-type semiring family)
    (q619985-finset-p indices index-type)
    (q619985-pairwise-commuting-p
     semiring indices family)
    (natp n))
   (equal
    (q619985-r-power
     semiring
     (q619985-sum-values semiring indices family)
     n)
    (q619985-multinomial-sum
     semiring
     (q619985-exponent-tuples (len indices) n)
     indices
     n
     family))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q619985,
-- "Multinomial theorem": the nth power of a finite sum in a semiring expands
-- over exponent vectors with multinomial coefficients when the summands
-- commute pairwise. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q619985_multinomial_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

data Dec
  {p : Level}
  (P : Set p) :
  Set p where

  yes : P -> Dec P
  no  : (P -> Bottom {p}) -> Dec P

DecidableEquality :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
DecidableEquality A =
  (x y : A) ->
  Dec (x == y)

_not-equal_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
_not-equal_ {a} x y =
  x == y -> Bottom {a}

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record FiniteSet
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    distinct  :
      (i j : Fin size) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

open FiniteSet

record Semiring
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set r where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x == x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ==
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR zeroR x == zeroR
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

Commute :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Semiring R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set r
Commute semiring x y =
  Semiring.multiplyR semiring x y ==
  Semiring.multiplyR semiring y x

PairwiseCommuting :
  {a r : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Semiring R ->
  (s : FiniteSet A) ->
  (A -> R) ->
  Set r
PairwiseCommuting semiring s f =
  (i j : Fin (size s)) ->
  i not-equal j ->
  Commute semiring
    (f (enumerate s i))
    (f (enumerate s j))

oneN : Nat
oneN =
  suc zero

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  oneN
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

natCast :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Semiring R ->
  Nat ->
  R
natCast semiring zero =
  Semiring.zeroR semiring
natCast semiring (suc n) =
  Semiring.addR semiring
    (natCast semiring n)
    (Semiring.oneR semiring)

power :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Semiring R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power semiring x zero =
  Semiring.oneR semiring
power semiring x (suc n) =
  Semiring.multiplyR semiring
    (power semiring x n)
    x

sumFin :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  (semiring : Semiring R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin semiring {zero} terms =
  Semiring.zeroR semiring
sumFin semiring {suc n} terms =
  Semiring.addR semiring
    (terms fzero)
    (sumFin semiring (\ i -> terms (fsuc i)))

productFin :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  (semiring : Semiring R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
productFin semiring {zero} factors =
  Semiring.oneR semiring
productFin semiring {suc n} factors =
  Semiring.multiplyR semiring
    (factors fzero)
    (productFin semiring (\ i -> factors (fsuc i)))

sumNatFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
sumNatFin {zero} values =
  zero
sumNatFin {suc n} values =
  values fzero + sumNatFin (\ i -> values (fsuc i))

prepend :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Nat
prepend head tail fzero =
  head
prepend head tail (fsuc i) =
  tail i

emptyVector : Fin zero -> Nat
emptyVector ()

multinomial :
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> Nat) ->
  Nat
multinomial {zero} powers =
  oneN
multinomial {suc n} powers =
  choose
    (powers fzero + sumNatFin (\ i -> powers (fsuc i)))
    (powers fzero)
  *
  multinomial (\ i -> powers (fsuc i))

sumThrough :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  Semiring R ->
  Nat ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R
sumThrough semiring zero terms =
  terms zero
sumThrough semiring (suc n) terms =
  Semiring.addR semiring
    (sumThrough semiring n terms)
    (terms (suc n))

sumExponentVectors :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  (semiring : Semiring R) ->
  (variables total : Nat) ->
  ((Fin variables -> Nat) -> R) ->
  R
sumExponentVectors semiring zero zero term =
  term emptyVector
sumExponentVectors semiring zero (suc total) term =
  Semiring.zeroR semiring
sumExponentVectors semiring (suc variables) total term =
  sumThrough semiring total
    (\ head ->
      sumExponentVectors semiring variables (total - head)
        (\ tail -> term (prepend head tail)))

multinomialTerm :
  {a r : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  (semiring : Semiring R) ->
  (s : FiniteSet A) ->
  (f : A -> R) ->
  (Fin (size s) -> Nat) ->
  R
multinomialTerm semiring s f powers =
  Semiring.multiplyR semiring
    (natCast semiring (multinomial powers))
    (productFin semiring
      (\ i ->
        power semiring
          (f (enumerate s i))
          (powers i)))

-- Lean: Finset.sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute
multinomial-theorem : Setω
multinomial-theorem =
  {a r : Level} ->
  (A : Set a) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  DecidableEquality A ->
  (semiring : Semiring R) ->
  (s : FiniteSet A) ->
  (f : A -> R) ->
  PairwiseCommuting semiring s f ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  power semiring
    (sumFin semiring (\ i -> f (enumerate s i)))
    n
  ==
  sumExponentVectors semiring (size s) n
    (multinomialTerm semiring s f)

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q619985, "Multinomial theorem": in an arbitrary semiring, the power of a
  finite sum of pairwise commuting elements expands over exponent functions
  of total degree n with multinomial coefficients. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory pred_setTheory;

val q619985_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_semiring_def",
  ``q619985_semiring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a) /\
      (!a. mulR a oneR = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR zeroR a = zeroR) /\
      (!a. mulR a zeroR = zeroR)``);

val q619985_pow_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_pow_def",
  ``q619985_pow
      (oneR : 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (x : 'r) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (mulR x) n oneR``);

val q619985_nat_cast_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_nat_cast_def",
  ``q619985_nat_cast
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (addR oneR) n zeroR``);

val q619985_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_sum_def",
  ``q619985_sum
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'i -> bool) (f : 'i -> 'a) =
      ITSET (\i acc. add (f i) acc) s zero``);

val q619985_product_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_product_def",
  ``q619985_product
      (oneR : 'a) (mulR : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'i -> bool) (f : 'i -> 'a) =
      ITSET (\i acc. mulR (f i) acc) s oneR``);

val q619985_num_sum_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_num_sum_def",
  ``q619985_num_sum (s : 'i -> bool) (k : 'i -> num) =
      ITSET (\i acc. k i + acc) s 0``);

val q619985_pi_antidiag_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_pi_antidiag_def",
  ``q619985_pi_antidiag (s : 'i -> bool) (n : num) =
      {k : 'i -> num |
        q619985_num_sum s k = n /\
        !i. k i <> 0 ==> i IN s}``);

val q619985_multinomial_def = new_definition (
  "q619985_multinomial_def",
  ``q619985_multinomial (s : 'i -> bool) (k : 'i -> num) =
      FACT (q619985_num_sum s k) DIV
        ITSET (\i acc. FACT (k i) * acc) s 1``);

val Finset_sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute =
  ``!(zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (s : 'i -> bool) (f : 'i -> 'r) (n : num).
      q619985_semiring zeroR oneR addR mulR /\
      FINITE s /\
      (!i j.
        i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i <> j ==>
        mulR (f i) (f j) = mulR (f j) (f i))
      ==>
      q619985_pow oneR mulR (q619985_sum zeroR addR s f) n =
      q619985_sum zeroR addR (q619985_pi_antidiag s n)
        (\k.
          mulR
            (q619985_nat_cast zeroR oneR addR
              (q619985_multinomial s k))
            (q619985_product oneR mulR s
              (\i. q619985_pow oneR mulR (f i) (k i))))``;

title: Q619985_multinomial_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q619985
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q619985), "Multinomial theorem": in every
  semiring, the natural power of a finite sum of pairwise commuting values
  equals the multinomially weighted sum of their order-independent products.
  This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q619985Anti A K n is the antidiagonal of exponent functions on the
  arbitrary ambient set A: its members are natural-valued total functions
  that vanish off K and whose values on K sum to n.

  Q619985Mult K n k is the multinomial coefficient, represented without
  division as the number of length-n words over K having multiplicity k(i)
  at each i in K.  For k in Q619985Anti A K n this is definitionally
  equivalent to n! / product_i k(i)!.

  The multiplicative gsum below is the order-independent finite product in
  the multiplicative monoid of R.  Its uniqueness is ensured by the stated
  pairwise commutation hypothesis, exactly as for Finset.noncommProd.
  The transparent definitions and the final $a assertion are unproved
  statement encodings; there is no $p proof in this file.
$)

$c Q619985Anti Q619985Mult $.

q619985-antidiag-syntax $a class ( Q619985Anti A K n ) $.
q619985-multinomial-syntax $a class ( Q619985Mult K n k ) $.

${
  $d A K i k n $.
  q619985-antidiag-definition $a
    |- ( Q619985Anti A K n ) =
      { k e. ( NN0 ^m A ) |
        ( A. i e. ( A \ K ) ( k ` i ) = 0
          /\
          ( sum_ i e. K ( k ` i ) ) = n ) } $.
$}

${
  $d K i j k n u $.
  q619985-multinomial-definition $a
    |- ( Q619985Mult K n k ) =
      ( # ` { u e. ( K ^m ( 1 ... n ) ) |
        A. i e. K
          ( # ` { j e. ( 1 ... n ) | ( u ` j ) = i } )
            = ( k ` i ) } ) $.
$}

${
  $d A K R f i j k n $.
  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q619985 $a
    |- A. R e. SRing
        A. A
          A. K e. Fin
            A. f e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m A )
              A. n e. NN0
                ( ( K C_ A
                    /\
                    A. i e. K
                      A. j e. ( K \ { i } )
                        ( ( f ` i ) ( .r ` R ) ( f ` j ) )
                          =
                        ( ( f ` j ) ( .r ` R ) ( f ` i ) ) )
                  ->
                  ( n
                      ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) )
                      ( R gsum ( i e. K |-> ( f ` i ) ) ) )
                    =
                  ( R gsum
                      ( k e. ( Q619985Anti A K n ) |->
                        ( ( ( Q619985Mult K n k )
                              ( .g ` R )
                              ( 1r ` R ) )
                            ( .r ` R )
                            ( ( mulGrp ` R ) gsum
                              ( i e. K |->
                                ( ( k ` i )
                                  ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` R ) )
                                  ( f ` i ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}

:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q619985,
:: "Multinomial theorem": in an arbitrary semiring, the nth power of a finite
:: sum of pairwise commuting elements is its multinomial expansion over all
:: exponent assignments summing to n. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, INT_1, CARD_1, REAL_1, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0,
      COMPLEX1, RLVECT_1, ALGSTR_0, BINOP_1, VECTSP_1, LATTICES,

      FUNCT_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, CARD_1,

      ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSET_1, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, NAT_D, NEWTON,
      RVSUM_1, VECTSP_1, RLVECT_1, RELSET_1, GROUP_1, BINOM;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, REALSET1, ORDINAL1,
      NUMBERS, XREAL_0, INT_1, CARD_1, STRUCT_0, VECTSP_1, RELAT_1,
      RELSET_1, ALGSTR_0, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FINSEQ_2, FINSET_1, NEWTON,
      VALUED_0, VALUED_1, RVSUM_1, MEMBERED, FRAENKEL;

 definitions TARSKI, RLVECT_1, XBOOLE_0, ALGSTR_0, VECTSP_1;
 equalities FINSEQ_1, ORDINAL1, BINOP_1, REALSET1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0,
      VECTSP_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FINSEQ_1, STRUCT_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for X being set,
      R being unital non empty doubleLoopStr,
      s being finite Subset of X,
      f being Function of X,the carrier of R,
      n being Nat
  st
    (for a,b,c being Element of R holds
      (a + b) + c = a + (b + c) &
      a + b = b + a &
      a + 0.R = a &
      (a * b) * c = a * (b * c) &
      a * 1.R = a &
      1.R * a = a &
      a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c &
      (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c &
      a * 0.R = 0.R &
      0.R * a = 0.R) &
    (for i,j being Element of X st
      i in s & j in s & i <> j
    holds
      ex x,y being Element of R st
        x = f.i & y = f.j & x * y = y * x)
  holds
    for e being one-to-one FinSequence of X st rng e = s holds
      ex K being one-to-one FinSequence of NAT*,
         values,terms being FinSequence of the carrier of R st
        rng K = {k where k is FinSequence of NAT :
          len k = len e & Sum k = n} &
        len values = len e &
        (for j being Nat st j in dom e holds
          values/.j = f.(e/.j)) &
        len terms = len K &
        (for q being Nat st q in dom K holds
          ex k being FinSequence of NAT,
             coeff being Nat,
             facts,factProducts being FinSequence of NAT,
             powers,products,multiples being
               FinSequence of the carrier of R st
            k = K/.q &
            coeff = n ! div factProducts/.(len e + 1) &
            len facts = len e &
            len factProducts = len e + 1 &
            factProducts/.1 = 1 &
            len powers = len e &
            len products = len e + 1 &
            products/.1 = 1.R &
            (for j being Nat st j in dom e holds
              facts/.j = (k/.j) ! &
              factProducts/.(j + 1) =
                factProducts/.j * facts/.j &
              ex x being Element of R st
                x = f.(e/.j) &
                powers/.j = x |^ (k/.j) &
                products/.(j + 1) = products/.j * powers/.j) &
            len multiples = coeff + 1 &
            multiples/.1 = 0.R &
            (for t being Nat st t in Seg coeff holds
              multiples/.(t + 1) = multiples/.t + 1.R) &
            terms/.q =
              multiples/.(coeff + 1) * products/.(len e + 1)) &
        (Sum values) |^ n = Sum terms
proof
end;
::$P+

content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q619985,
% "Multinomial theorem": over a semiring, the power of a finite sum of pairwise
% commuting elements equals its multinomial expansion. This file contains no proof.

Q619985_multinomial_theorem[
  A: TYPE,
  R: TYPE+,
  zeroR, oneR: R,
  addR, mulR: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  semiring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
      addR(addR(a, b), c) = addR(a, addR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: R):
        addR(a, b) = addR(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        addR(zeroR, a) = a
          AND addR(a, zeroR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(mulR(a, b), c) = mulR(a, mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(oneR, a) = a
          AND mulR(a, oneR) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(a, addR(b, c)) =
          addR(mulR(a, b), mulR(a, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: R):
        mulR(addR(a, b), c) =
          addR(mulR(a, c), mulR(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: R):
        mulR(zeroR, a) = zeroR
          AND mulR(a, zeroR) = zeroR)

  member(index: A, indices: list[A]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        index = head OR member(index, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  no_duplicates(indices: list[A]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicates(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  commutes_with(
      value: A,
      indices: list[A],
      f: [A -> R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        mulR(f(value), f(head)) = mulR(f(head), f(value))
          AND commutes_with(value, tail, f)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  pairwise_commute(
      indices: list[A],
      f: [A -> R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        commutes_with(head, tail, f)
          AND pairwise_commute(tail, f)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  finite_sum(
      indices: list[A],
      f: [A -> R]): RECURSIVE R =
    CASES indices OF
      null: zeroR,
      cons(head, tail):
        addR(f(head), finite_sum(tail, f))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  semiring_power(value: R, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      oneR
    ELSE
      mulR(
        semiring_power(value, exponent - 1),
        value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  natural_cast(value: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      zeroR
    ELSE
      addR(natural_cast(value - 1), oneR)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  natural_factorial(value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      value * natural_factorial(value - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  exponent_sum(
      indices: list[A],
      code, degree: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES indices OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        mod(code, degree + 1)
          + exponent_sum(
              tail,
              ndiv(code, degree + 1),
              degree)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  exponent_factorial_product(
      indices: list[A],
      code, degree: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES indices OF
      null: 1,
      cons(head, tail):
        natural_factorial(mod(code, degree + 1))
          * exponent_factorial_product(
              tail,
              ndiv(code, degree + 1),
              degree)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  powered_product(
      indices: list[A],
      f: [A -> R],
      code, degree: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    CASES indices OF
      null: oneR,
      cons(head, tail):
        mulR(
          semiring_power(
            f(head),
            mod(code, degree + 1)),
          powered_product(
            tail,
            f,
            ndiv(code, degree + 1),
            degree))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  exponent_code_count(
      indices: list[A],
      degree: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES indices OF
      null: 1,
      cons(head, tail):
        (degree + 1) * exponent_code_count(tail, degree)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  natural_quotient(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      ndiv(numerator, denominator)
    ENDIF

  multinomial_term(
      indices: list[A],
      f: [A -> R],
      code, degree: nat): R =
    mulR(
      natural_cast(
        natural_quotient(
          natural_factorial(degree),
          exponent_factorial_product(
            indices,
            code,
            degree))),
      powered_product(indices, f, code, degree))

  multinomial_sum(
      indices: list[A],
      f: [A -> R],
      degree, count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroR
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = count - 1 IN
        addR(
          multinomial_sum(
            indices,
            f,
            degree,
            count - 1),
          IF exponent_sum(indices, code, degree) = degree THEN
            multinomial_term(indices, f, code, degree)
          ELSE
            zeroR
          ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  multinomial_theorem: bool =
    semiring_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL
          (indices: list[A]),
          (f: [A -> R]),
          (degree: nat):
        (no_duplicates(indices)
          AND pairwise_commute(indices, f))
        IMPLIES
          semiring_power(
            finite_sum(indices, f),
            degree)
          =
          multinomial_sum(
            indices,
            f,
            degree,
            exponent_code_count(indices, degree)))

END Q619985_multinomial_theorem

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun q632546-no-divisor-from-p (number divisor)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- number divisor))))
  (if (and (natp number)
           (natp divisor)
           (<= 2 divisor)
           (< divisor number))
      (and
       (not (equal (mod number divisor) 0))
       (q632546-no-divisor-from-p number (+ divisor 1)))
    t))

(defun q632546-primep (number)

       (< 1 number)
       (q632546-no-divisor-from-p number 2)))

  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix upper)))
  (if (or (not (natp lower))
          (not (natp upper))
          (zp upper)
          (< upper lower))
      nil
    (or (q632546-primep upper)
        (q632546-prime-in-interval-p lower (- upper 1)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q632546-bertrands-postulate-statement (n)

module Q632546BertrandsPostulate where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=_ _<_ _divides_
infixr 5 _and_
infixr 3 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

_<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set
m < n =
  suc m <= n

    value : A

  field

    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

two : Nat
two =
  suc one

  field
    at-least-two : two <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == one) or (d == p)

bertrands-postulate =
  (n : Nat) ->
