title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q643826
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q643826), "Slutsky's theorem": a continuous
  function of random variables converging respectively in distribution and
  in measure to a constant converges in distribution to the corresponding
  continuous function of the limits. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q643826_event (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q643826_empty {A : Type} : q643826_event A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q643826_full {A : Type} : q643826_event A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q643826_complement {A : Type}
    (U : q643826_event A) : q643826_event A :=
  fun x => ~ U x.

Definition q643826_countable_union {A : Type}
    (U : nat -> q643826_event A) : q643826_event A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, U n x.

Definition q643826_same_event {A : Type}
    (U V : q643826_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x <-> V x.

Definition q643826_subset {A : Type}
    (U V : q643826_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x -> V x.

Definition q643826_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U V : q643826_event A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (U x /\ V x).

Definition q643826_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (U : nat -> q643826_event A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat,
    i <> j -> q643826_disjoint (U i) (U j).

Record q643826_sigma_algebra (A : Type) : Type := {
  q643826_measurable : q643826_event A -> Prop;
  q643826_measurable_extensional :
    forall U V : q643826_event A,
      q643826_same_event U V ->
      (q643826_measurable U <-> q643826_measurable V);
  q643826_measurable_empty :
    q643826_measurable q643826_empty;
  q643826_measurable_complement :
    forall U : q643826_event A,
      q643826_measurable U ->
      q643826_measurable (q643826_complement U);
  q643826_measurable_countable_union :
    forall U : nat -> q643826_event A,
      (forall n : nat, q643826_measurable (U n)) ->
      q643826_measurable (q643826_countable_union U)
}.

Arguments q643826_measurable {A} _ _.

Record q643826_topological_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q643826_is_open : q643826_event A -> Prop;
  q643826_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q643826_event A,
      q643826_same_event U V ->
      (q643826_is_open U <-> q643826_is_open V);
  q643826_open_empty :
    q643826_is_open q643826_empty;
  q643826_open_full :
    q643826_is_open q643826_full;
  q643826_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q643826_event A,
      q643826_is_open U ->
      q643826_is_open V ->
      q643826_is_open (fun x => U x /\ V x);
  q643826_open_union :
    forall family : q643826_event A -> Prop,
      (forall U : q643826_event A,
        family U -> q643826_is_open U) ->
      q643826_is_open
        (fun x =>
          exists U : q643826_event A,
            family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q643826_is_open {A} _ _.

Inductive q643826_borel {A : Type}
    (T : q643826_topological_space A)
    : q643826_event A -> Prop :=
| q643826_borel_open :
    forall U : q643826_event A,
      q643826_is_open T U ->
      q643826_borel T U
| q643826_borel_extensional :
    forall U V : q643826_event A,
      q643826_borel T U ->
      q643826_same_event U V ->
      q643826_borel T V
| q643826_borel_complement :
    forall U : q643826_event A,
      q643826_borel T U ->
      q643826_borel T (q643826_complement U)
| q643826_borel_countable_union :
    forall U : nat -> q643826_event A,
      (forall n : nat, q643826_borel T (U n)) ->
      q643826_borel T (q643826_countable_union U).

Definition q643826_is_borel_space {A : Type}
    (T : q643826_topological_space A)
    (M : q643826_sigma_algebra A) : Prop :=
  forall U : q643826_event A,
    q643826_measurable M U <-> q643826_borel T U.

Definition q643826_second_countable {A : Type}
    (T : q643826_topological_space A) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q643826_event A,
    (forall n : nat, q643826_is_open T (basis n)) /\
    forall (U : q643826_event A) (x : A),
      q643826_is_open T U ->
      U x ->
      exists n : nat,
        basis n x /\ q643826_subset (basis n) U.

Definition q643826_continuous {A B : Type}
    (TA : q643826_topological_space A)
    (TB : q643826_topological_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall U : q643826_event B,
    q643826_is_open TB U ->
    q643826_is_open TA (fun x => U (f x)).

Definition q643826_product_open {A B : Type}
    (TA : q643826_topological_space A)
    (TB : q643826_topological_space B)
    (W : q643826_event (A * B)) : Prop :=
  forall (x : A) (y : B),
    W (x, y) ->
    exists (U : q643826_event A) (V : q643826_event B),
      q643826_is_open TA U /\
      q643826_is_open TB V /\
      U x /\ V y /\
      forall (a : A) (b : B), U a -> V b -> W (a, b).

Definition q643826_continuous_from_product {A B C : Type}
    (TA : q643826_topological_space A)
    (TB : q643826_topological_space B)
    (TC : q643826_topological_space C)
    (f : A * B -> C) : Prop :=
  forall U : q643826_event C,
    q643826_is_open TC U ->
    q643826_product_open TA TB (fun p => U (f p)).

Record q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group (A : Type) : Type := {
  q643826_zero : A;
  q643826_add : A -> A -> A;
  q643826_neg : A -> A;
  q643826_norm : A -> R;
  q643826_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q643826_add x (q643826_add y z) =
      q643826_add (q643826_add x y) z;
  q643826_add_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q643826_add x y = q643826_add y x;
  q643826_zero_add :
    forall x : A, q643826_add q643826_zero x = x;
  q643826_neg_add :
    forall x : A,
      q643826_add (q643826_neg x) x = q643826_zero;
  q643826_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : A, 0 <= q643826_norm x;
  q643826_norm_zero :
    q643826_norm q643826_zero = 0;
  q643826_norm_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q643826_norm (q643826_neg x) = q643826_norm x;
  q643826_norm_add :
    forall x y : A,
      q643826_norm (q643826_add x y) <=
      q643826_norm x + q643826_norm y;
  q643826_topology : q643826_topological_space A;
  q643826_open_iff_norm :
    forall U : q643826_event A,
      q643826_is_open q643826_topology U <->
      forall x : A,
        U x ->
        exists epsilon : R,
          0 < epsilon /\
          forall y : A,
            q643826_norm
              (q643826_add y (q643826_neg x)) < epsilon ->
            U y
}.

Arguments q643826_zero {A} _.
Arguments q643826_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q643826_neg {A} _ _.
Arguments q643826_norm {A} _ _.
Arguments q643826_topology {A} _.

Definition q643826_sub {A : Type}
    (V : q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group A)
    (x y : A) : A :=
  q643826_add V x (q643826_neg V y).

Definition q643826_real_open
    (U : q643826_event R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon -> U y.

Inductive q643826_real_borel : q643826_event R -> Prop :=
| q643826_real_borel_open :
    forall U : q643826_event R,
      q643826_real_open U ->
      q643826_real_borel U
| q643826_real_borel_extensional :
    forall U V : q643826_event R,
      q643826_real_borel U ->
      q643826_same_event U V ->
      q643826_real_borel V
| q643826_real_borel_complement :
    forall U : q643826_event R,
      q643826_real_borel U ->
      q643826_real_borel (q643826_complement U)
| q643826_real_borel_countable_union :
    forall U : nat -> q643826_event R,
      (forall n : nat, q643826_real_borel (U n)) ->
      q643826_real_borel (q643826_countable_union U).

Definition q643826_continuous_to_real {A : Type}
    (T : q643826_topological_space A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall U : q643826_event R,
    q643826_real_open U ->
    q643826_is_open T (fun x => U (f x)).

Definition q643826_measurable_function {A B : Type}
    (MA : q643826_sigma_algebra A)
    (MB : q643826_sigma_algebra B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall U : q643826_event B,
    q643826_measurable MB U ->
    q643826_measurable MA (fun x => U (f x)).

Definition q643826_measurable_real_function {A : Type}
    (MA : q643826_sigma_algebra A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall U : q643826_event R,
    q643826_real_borel U ->
    q643826_measurable MA (fun x => U (f x)).

Fixpoint q643826_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q643826_partial_sum u k + u k
  end.

Definition q643826_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Record q643826_probability_mass
    (A : Type) (M : q643826_sigma_algebra A) : Type := {
  q643826_mass : q643826_event A -> R;
  q643826_mass_extensional :
    forall U V : q643826_event A,
      q643826_measurable M U ->
      q643826_measurable M V ->
      q643826_same_event U V ->
      q643826_mass U = q643826_mass V;
  q643826_mass_empty :
    q643826_mass q643826_empty = 0;
  q643826_mass_full :
    q643826_mass q643826_full = 1;
  q643826_mass_nonnegative :
    forall U : q643826_event A,
      q643826_measurable M U ->
      0 <= q643826_mass U;
  q643826_mass_countably_additive :
    forall U : nat -> q643826_event A,
      (forall n : nat, q643826_measurable M (U n)) ->
      q643826_pairwise_disjoint U ->
      q643826_real_sequence_converges
        (fun n =>
          q643826_partial_sum
            (fun k => q643826_mass (U k)) n)
        (q643826_mass (q643826_countable_union U))
}.

Arguments q643826_probability_mass A M : clear implicits.
Arguments q643826_mass {A M} _ _.

Definition q643826_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    {M : q643826_sigma_algebra A}
    (mu : q643826_probability_mass A M)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists N : q643826_event A,
    q643826_measurable M N /\
    q643826_mass mu N = 0 /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> N x.

Definition q643826_ae_equal {A B : Type}
    {M : q643826_sigma_algebra A}
    (mu : q643826_probability_mass A M)
    (f g : A -> B) : Prop :=
  q643826_almost_everywhere mu (fun x => f x = g x).

Definition q643826_ae_measurable {A B : Type}
    (MA : q643826_sigma_algebra A)
    (MB : q643826_sigma_algebra B)
    (mu : q643826_probability_mass A MA)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  exists g : A -> B,
    q643826_measurable_function MA MB g /\
    q643826_ae_equal mu f g.

Arguments q643826_ae_measurable {A B} MA MB mu f.

Definition q643826_ae_measurable_real {A : Type}
    (MA : q643826_sigma_algebra A)
    (mu : q643826_probability_mass A MA)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists g : A -> R,
    q643826_measurable_real_function MA g /\
    q643826_ae_equal mu f g.

Arguments q643826_ae_measurable_real {A} MA mu f.

Definition q643826_bounded {A : Type}
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  exists C : R,
    0 <= C /\ forall x : A, Rabs (f x) <= C.

Definition q643826_nonnegative {A : Type}
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, 0 <= f x.

Definition q643826_increasing {A : Type}
    (f : nat -> A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall (n : nat) (x : A), f n x <= f (S n) x.

Definition q643826_is_indicator {A : Type}
    (U : q643826_event A)
    (f : A -> R) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    (U x /\ f x = 1) \/ (~ U x /\ f x = 0).

Record q643826_probability_measure
    (A : Type) (M : q643826_sigma_algebra A) : Type := {
  q643826_probability_mass_part :
    q643826_probability_mass A M;
  q643826_integral : (A -> R) -> R;
  q643826_integral_ae_extensional :
    forall f g : A -> R,
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part f ->
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part g ->
      q643826_bounded f ->
      q643826_bounded g ->
      q643826_ae_equal
        q643826_probability_mass_part f g ->
      q643826_integral f = q643826_integral g;
  q643826_integral_indicator :
    forall (U : q643826_event A) (f : A -> R),
      q643826_measurable M U ->
      q643826_is_indicator U f ->
      q643826_integral f =
      q643826_mass q643826_probability_mass_part U;
  q643826_integral_add :
    forall f g : A -> R,
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part f ->
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part g ->
      q643826_bounded f ->
      q643826_bounded g ->
      q643826_integral (fun x => f x + g x) =
      q643826_integral f + q643826_integral g;
  q643826_integral_scale :
    forall (c : R) (f : A -> R),
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part f ->
      q643826_bounded f ->
      q643826_integral (fun x => c * f x) =
      c * q643826_integral f;
  q643826_integral_nonnegative :
    forall f : A -> R,
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part f ->
      q643826_bounded f ->
      q643826_nonnegative f ->
      0 <= q643826_integral f;
  q643826_integral_monotone_convergence :
    forall (f : nat -> A -> R) (g : A -> R),
      (forall n : nat,
        q643826_ae_measurable_real M
          q643826_probability_mass_part (f n)) ->
      q643826_ae_measurable_real M
        q643826_probability_mass_part g ->
      (forall n : nat, q643826_bounded (f n)) ->
      q643826_bounded g ->
      (forall n : nat, q643826_nonnegative (f n)) ->
      q643826_increasing f ->
      (forall x : A,
        q643826_real_sequence_converges
          (fun n => f n x) (g x)) ->
      q643826_real_sequence_converges
        (fun n => q643826_integral (f n))
        (q643826_integral g)
}.

Arguments q643826_probability_measure A M : clear implicits.
Arguments q643826_probability_mass_part {A M} _.
Arguments q643826_integral {A M} _ _.

Record q643826_filter (I : Type) : Type := {
  q643826_eventually : (I -> Prop) -> Prop;
  q643826_eventually_true :
    q643826_eventually (fun _ => True);
  q643826_eventually_upward :
    forall P Q : I -> Prop,
      q643826_eventually P ->
      (forall i : I, P i -> Q i) ->
      q643826_eventually Q;
  q643826_eventually_intersection :
    forall P Q : I -> Prop,
      q643826_eventually P ->
      q643826_eventually Q ->
      q643826_eventually (fun i => P i /\ Q i)
}.

Arguments q643826_eventually {I} _ _.

Definition q643826_countably_generated {I : Type}
    (l : q643826_filter I) : Prop :=
  exists basis : nat -> q643826_event I,
    (forall n : nat, q643826_eventually l (basis n)) /\
    forall U : q643826_event I,
      q643826_eventually l U ->
      exists n : nat, q643826_subset (basis n) U.

Definition q643826_filter_tendsto_real {I : Type}
    (l : q643826_filter I)
    (u : I -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    q643826_eventually l
      (fun i => Rabs (u i - limit) < epsilon).

Definition q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
    {I Omega OmegaLimit E : Type}
    (TE : q643826_topological_space E)
    (ME : q643826_sigma_algebra E)
    (MOmega : q643826_sigma_algebra Omega)
    (MOLimit : q643826_sigma_algebra OmegaLimit)
    (mu : q643826_probability_measure Omega MOmega)
    (muLimit :
      q643826_probability_measure OmegaLimit MOLimit)
    (X : I -> Omega -> E)
    (l : q643826_filter I)
    (Z : OmegaLimit -> E) : Prop :=
  (forall i : I,
    q643826_ae_measurable
      MOmega ME
      (q643826_probability_mass_part mu)
      (X i)) /\
  q643826_ae_measurable
    MOLimit ME
    (q643826_probability_mass_part muLimit)
    Z /\
  forall h : E -> R,
    q643826_continuous_to_real TE h ->
    q643826_bounded h ->
    q643826_filter_tendsto_real l
      (fun i =>
        q643826_integral mu
          (fun omega => h (X i omega)))
      (q643826_integral muLimit
        (fun omega => h (Z omega))).

Arguments q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
  {I Omega OmegaLimit E}
  TE ME MOmega MOLimit mu muLimit X l Z.

Definition q643826_tendsto_in_measure_const
    {I Omega E : Type}
    (V : q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group E)
    (M : q643826_sigma_algebra Omega)
    (mu : q643826_probability_mass Omega M)
    (Y : I -> Omega -> E)
    (l : q643826_filter I)
    (c : E) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon delta : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    0 < delta ->
    q643826_eventually l
      (fun i =>
        exists U : q643826_event Omega,
          q643826_measurable M U /\
          q643826_almost_everywhere mu
            (fun omega =>
              (epsilon <=
                q643826_norm V
                  (q643826_sub V (Y i omega) c))
              <-> U omega) /\
          q643826_mass mu U < delta).

Arguments q643826_tendsto_in_measure_const
  {I Omega E} V M mu Y l c.

Theorem q643826_slutsky_s_theorem :
  forall (I Omega OmegaLimit E E' F : Type)
         (VE : q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group E)
         (VE' : q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group E')
         (TF : q643826_topological_space F)
         (ME : q643826_sigma_algebra E)
         (ME' : q643826_sigma_algebra E')
         (MF : q643826_sigma_algebra F)
         (MOmega : q643826_sigma_algebra Omega)
         (MOLimit : q643826_sigma_algebra OmegaLimit)
         (mu : q643826_probability_measure Omega MOmega)
         (muLimit :
           q643826_probability_measure OmegaLimit MOLimit)
         (l : q643826_filter I)
         (X : I -> Omega -> E)
         (Y : I -> Omega -> E')
         (Z : OmegaLimit -> E)
         (c : E')
         (g : E * E' -> F),
    q643826_second_countable (q643826_topology VE) ->
    q643826_second_countable (q643826_topology VE') ->
    q643826_is_borel_space (q643826_topology VE) ME ->
    q643826_is_borel_space (q643826_topology VE') ME' ->
    q643826_is_borel_space TF MF ->
    q643826_countably_generated l ->
    q643826_continuous_from_product
      (q643826_topology VE) (q643826_topology VE') TF g ->
    q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
      (q643826_topology VE) ME
      MOmega MOLimit mu muLimit X l Z ->
    q643826_tendsto_in_measure_const
      VE' MOmega
      (q643826_probability_mass_part mu)
      Y l c ->
    (forall i : I,
      q643826_ae_measurable
        MOmega ME'
        (q643826_probability_mass_part mu)
        (Y i)) ->
    q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
      TF MF MOmega MOLimit mu muLimit
      (fun (i : I) (omega : Omega) =>
        g (X i omega, Y i omega))
      l
      (fun omega : OmegaLimit => g (Z omega, c)).
Admitted.

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q643826,
  "Slutsky's theorem": composing a continuous function with random variables
  converging respectively in distribution and in probability to a constant
  preserves convergence in distribution. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
    "HOL-Analysis.Complete_Measure"
    "HOL-Analysis.Infinite_Sum"
begin

definition q643826_probability_measure :: "'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_probability_measure M \<longleftrightarrow>
      space M = UNIV \<and> emeasure M UNIV = 1"

definition q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group ::
    "('a::{ab_group_add, second_countable_topology} \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group normA \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x. 0 \<le> normA x) \<and>
      normA 0 = 0 \<and>
      (\<forall>x. normA (-x) = normA x) \<and>
      (\<forall>x y. normA (x + y) \<le> normA x + normA y) \<and>
      (\<forall>U. open U \<longleftrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x\<in>U. \<exists>e>0. \<forall>y. normA (-x + y) < e \<longrightarrow> y \<in> U))"

definition q643826_ae_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::topological_space) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_ae_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>f'. f' \<in> borel_measurable M \<and> (AE x in M. f x = f' x))"

definition q643826_has_law ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::topological_space) \<Rightarrow>
      'b measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_has_law M f law \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<exists>f'. f' \<in> borel_measurable M \<and>
        (AE x in M. f x = f' x) \<and> distr M borel f' = law)"

definition q643826_weak_convergence ::
    "'i filter \<Rightarrow> ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a::topological_space measure) \<Rightarrow>
      'a measure \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_weak_convergence l laws limit_law \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>i. q643826_probability_measure (laws i)) \<and>
      q643826_probability_measure limit_law \<and>
      (\<forall>i. sets (laws i) = sets limit_law) \<and>
      sets borel \<subseteq> sets limit_law \<and>
      (\<forall>f :: 'a \<Rightarrow> real.
        bounded (range f) \<and> continuous_on UNIV f \<longrightarrow>
        filterlim
          (\<lambda>i. integral\<^sup>L (laws i) f)
          (nhds (integral\<^sup>L limit_law f))
          l)"

definition q643826_tendsto_in_distribution ::
    "'i filter \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b::topological_space) \<Rightarrow>
      'c measure \<Rightarrow> ('c \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_tendsto_in_distribution l M X N Z \<longleftrightarrow>
      q643826_probability_measure M \<and>
      q643826_probability_measure N \<and>
      (\<forall>i. q643826_ae_measurable M (X i)) \<and>
      q643826_ae_measurable N Z \<and>
      (\<exists>laws limit_law.
        (\<forall>i. q643826_has_law M (X i) (laws i)) \<and>
        q643826_has_law N Z limit_law \<and>
        q643826_weak_convergence l laws limit_law)"

definition q643826_tendsto_in_measure_const ::
    "'i filter \<Rightarrow> 'a measure \<Rightarrow>
      ('i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b::{ab_group_add, second_countable_topology}) \<Rightarrow>
      ('b \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q643826_tendsto_in_measure_const l M Y normB c \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>e>0.
        filterlim
          (\<lambda>i. outer_measure_of M
            {\<omega> \<in> space M. e \<le> normB (-c + Y i \<omega>)})
          (nhds 0)
          l)"

theorem slutsky_s_theorem:
  fixes l :: "'i filter"
    and M :: "'a measure"
    and N :: "'c measure"
    and X :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e::{ab_group_add, second_countable_topology}"
    and Y :: "'i \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'd::{ab_group_add, second_countable_topology}"
    and Z :: "'c \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and c :: "'d"
    and g :: "'e \<times> 'd \<Rightarrow> 'f::topological_space"
    and normE :: "'e \<Rightarrow> real"
    and normD :: "'d \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes E_seminormed:
      "q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group normE"
    and D_seminormed:
      "q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group normD"
    and countably_generated:
      "countably_generated_filter l"
    and X_tendsto:
      "q643826_tendsto_in_distribution l M X N Z"
    and Y_tendsto:
      "q643826_tendsto_in_measure_const l M Y normD c"
    and Y_ae_measurable:
      "\<And>i. q643826_ae_measurable M (Y i)"
    and g_continuous:
      "continuous_on UNIV g"
  shows
      "q643826_tendsto_in_distribution l M
        (\<lambda>i \<omega>. g (X i \<omega>, Y i \<omega>))
        N
        (\<lambda>\<omega>. g (Z \<omega>, c))"
  sorry

end

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q643826,
  "Slutsky's theorem": a continuous function of random variables converging
  respectively in distribution and in probability to a constant converges in
  distribution to the corresponding continuous image. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let q643826_real_tends = new_definition
 `q643826_real_tends (filter:(I->bool)->bool) (u:I->real) (z:real) <=>
    !epsilon:real.
      &0 < epsilon
      ==> filter {i:I | abs(u i - z) < epsilon}`;;

let q643826_sequence_tends = new_definition
 `q643826_sequence_tends (u:num->real) (z:real) <=>
    !epsilon:real.
      &0 < epsilon
      ==> ?N:num. !n:num. N <= n ==> abs(u n - z) < epsilon`;;

let q643826_is_filter = new_definition
 `q643826_is_filter (filter:(I->bool)->bool) <=>
    filter (:I) /\
    (!s t:I->bool. filter s /\ s SUBSET t ==> filter t) /\
    (!s t:I->bool. filter s /\ filter t ==> filter (s INTER t))`;;

let q643826_countably_generated_filter = new_definition
 `q643826_countably_generated_filter (filter:(I->bool)->bool) <=>
    ?base:num->I->bool.
      (!n:num. filter (base n)) /\
      (!s:I->bool. filter s <=> ?n:num. base n SUBSET s)`;;

let q643826_topology = new_definition
 `q643826_topology (opens:(A->bool)->bool) <=>
    opens {} /\
    opens (:A) /\
    (!collection:(A->bool)->bool.
       (!u:A->bool. u IN collection ==> opens u)
       ==> opens (UNIONS collection)) /\
    (!u v:A->bool. opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v))`;;

let q643826_sigma_algebra = new_definition
 `q643826_sigma_algebra (events:(A->bool)->bool) <=>
    events {} /\
    events (:A) /\
    (!s:A->bool. events s ==> events ((:A) DIFF s)) /\
    (!sets:num->A->bool.
       (!n:num. events (sets n))
       ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n})`;;

let q643826_borel_space = new_definition
 `q643826_borel_space
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool) <=>
    q643826_sigma_algebra events /\
    (!s:A->bool.
       events s <=>
       !candidate:(A->bool)->bool.
         q643826_sigma_algebra candidate /\
         (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> candidate u)
         ==> candidate s)`;;

let q643826_probability_measure = new_definition
 `q643826_probability_measure
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) <=>
    q643826_sigma_algebra events /\
    mu {} = &0 /\
    mu (:A) = &1 /\
    (!s:A->bool. events s ==> &0 <= mu s) /\
    (!sets:num->A->bool.
       (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
       (!m n:num. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
       ==> q643826_sequence_tends
             (\N:num. sum {k:num | k < N} (\k. mu (sets k)))
             (mu {x:A | ?k:num. x IN sets k}))`;;

let q643826_outer_value = new_definition
 `q643826_outer_value
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) (s:A->bool) =
    @r:real.
      (!t:A->bool. events t /\ s SUBSET t ==> r <= mu t) /\
      (!b:real.
         (!t:A->bool. events t /\ s SUBSET t ==> b <= mu t)
         ==> b <= r)`;;

let q643826_measurable = new_definition
 `q643826_measurable
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool) (f:A->B) <=>
    !s:B->bool. eventsB s ==> eventsA {x:A | f x IN s}`;;

let q643826_ae_equal = new_definition
 `q643826_ae_equal
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (f:A->B) (g:A->B) <=>
    ?null:A->bool.
      events null /\
      mu null = &0 /\
      {x:A | ~(f x = g x)} SUBSET null`;;

let q643826_ae_measurable = new_definition
 `q643826_ae_measurable
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool) (f:A->B) <=>
    ?version:A->B.
      q643826_measurable eventsA eventsB version /\
      q643826_ae_equal eventsA mu f version`;;

let q643826_map_measure = new_definition
 `q643826_map_measure
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool) (f:A->B)
    (law:(B->bool)->real) <=>
    q643826_probability_measure eventsB law /\
    ?version:A->B.
      q643826_measurable eventsA eventsB version /\
      q643826_ae_equal eventsA mu f version /\
      (!s:B->bool.
         eventsB s ==> law s = mu {x:A | version x IN s})`;;

let q643826_simple_nonnegative = new_definition
 `q643826_simple_nonnegative
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->real) <=>
    (!x:A. &0 <= s x) /\
    FINITE (IMAGE s (:A)) /\
    (!c:real. events {x:A | s x = c})`;;

let q643826_simple_integral = new_definition
 `q643826_simple_integral
    (mu:(A->bool)->real) (s:A->real) =
    sum (IMAGE s (:A)) (\c:real. mu {x:A | s x = c} * c)`;;

let q643826_lintegral_upper = new_definition
 `q643826_lintegral_upper
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (h:A->real) (upper:real) <=>
    !s:A->real.
      q643826_simple_nonnegative events s /\
      (!x:A. s x <= h x)
      ==> q643826_simple_integral mu s <= upper`;;

let q643826_has_lintegral = new_definition
 `q643826_has_lintegral
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (h:A->real) (z:real) <=>
    &0 <= z /\
    q643826_lintegral_upper events mu h z /\
    (!upper:real.
       &0 <= upper /\
       q643826_lintegral_upper events mu h upper
       ==> z <= upper)`;;

let q643826_lintegral = new_definition
 `q643826_lintegral
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real) =
    @z:real. q643826_has_lintegral events mu h z`;;

let q643826_integral = new_definition
 `q643826_integral
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real) =
    q643826_lintegral events mu
      (\x:A. if &0 <= h x then h x else &0) -
    q643826_lintegral events mu
      (\x:A. if &0 <= --(h x) then --(h x) else &0)`;;

let q643826_real_open = new_definition
 `q643826_real_open (u:real->bool) <=>
    !x:real.
      x IN u
      ==> ?epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon /\
            !y:real. abs(y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN u`;;

let q643826_continuous_real = new_definition
 `q643826_continuous_real
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real) <=>
    !u:real->bool.
      q643826_real_open u ==> opens {x:A | h x IN u}`;;

let q643826_bounded_continuous = new_definition
 `q643826_bounded_continuous
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real) <=>
    q643826_continuous_real opens h /\
    ?bound:real. !x:A. abs(h x) <= bound`;;

let q643826_weak_tends = new_definition
 `q643826_weak_tends
    (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool)
    (filter:(I->bool)->bool)
    (laws:I->(A->bool)->real) (limit:(A->bool)->real) <=>
    !h:A->real.
      q643826_bounded_continuous opens h
      ==> q643826_real_tends filter
            (\i:I. q643826_integral events (laws i) h)
            (q643826_integral events limit h)`;;

let q643826_tends_in_distribution = new_definition
 `q643826_tends_in_distribution
    (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool) (muA:(A->bool)->real)
    (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool) (muB:(B->bool)->real)
    (target_events:(C->bool)->bool)
    (target_opens:(C->bool)->bool)
    (X:I->A->C) (filter:(I->bool)->bool) (Z:B->C) <=>
    (!i:I.
       q643826_ae_measurable eventsA muA target_events (X i)) /\
    q643826_ae_measurable eventsB muB target_events Z /\
    ?laws:I->(C->bool)->real limit_law:(C->bool)->real.
      (!i:I.
         q643826_map_measure
           eventsA muA target_events (X i) (laws i)) /\
      q643826_map_measure
        eventsB muB target_events Z limit_law /\
      q643826_weak_tends
        target_opens target_events filter laws limit_law`;;

let q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group = new_definition
 `q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group
    (zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) <=>
    (!x y z:A. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
    (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
    (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
    (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
    norm zero = &0 /\
    (!x:A. &0 <= norm x) /\
    (!x:A. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
    (!x y:A. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)`;;

let q643826_norm_open = new_definition
 `q643826_norm_open
    (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) (u:A->bool) <=>
    !x:A.
      x IN u
      ==> ?epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon /\
            !y:A. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u`;;

let q643826_second_countable_norm = new_definition
 `q643826_second_countable_norm
    (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (norm:A->real) <=>
    ?basis:num->A->bool.
      (!n:num. q643826_norm_open add neg norm (basis n)) /\
      (!u:A->bool.
         q643826_norm_open add neg norm u
         ==> !x:A.
               x IN u
               ==> ?n:num.
                     x IN basis n /\ basis n SUBSET u)`;;

let q643826_continuous_prod = new_definition
 `q643826_continuous_prod
    (addA:A->A->A) (negA:A->A) (normA:A->real)
    (addB:B->B->B) (negB:B->B) (normB:B->real)
    (opensC:(C->bool)->bool) (g:A#B->C) <=>
    !x:A y:B u:C->bool.
      opensC u /\ g (x,y) IN u
      ==> ?epsilon:real.
            &0 < epsilon /\
            !x':A y':B.
              normA (addA x' (negA x)) < epsilon /\
              normB (addB y' (negB y)) < epsilon
              ==> g (x',y') IN u`;;

let q643826_tends_in_measure_const = new_definition
 `q643826_tends_in_measure_const
    (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real)
    (add:B->B->B) (neg:B->B) (norm:B->real)
    (Y:I->A->B) (filter:(I->bool)->bool) (c:B) <=>
    !epsilon:real.
      &0 < epsilon
      ==> q643826_real_tends filter
            (\i:I.
               q643826_outer_value events mu
                 {x:A |
                    epsilon <= norm (add (Y i x) (neg c))})
            (&0)`;;

let Q643826_SLUTSKYS_THEOREM =
 `!eventsO:(O->bool)->bool
    muO:(O->bool)->real
    eventsL:(L->bool)->bool
    muL:(L->bool)->real
    eventsE:(E->bool)->bool
    eventsP:(P->bool)->bool
    opensF:(F->bool)->bool
    eventsF:(F->bool)->bool
    filter:(I->bool)->bool
    zeroE:E
    addE:E->E->E
    negE:E->E
    normE:E->real
    zeroP:P
    addP:P->P->P
    negP:P->P
    normP:P->real
    X:I->O->E
    Y:I->O->P
    Z:L->E
    c:P
    g:E#P->F.
      q643826_probability_measure eventsO muO /\
      q643826_probability_measure eventsL muL /\
      q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group
        zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group
        zeroP addP negP normP /\
      q643826_second_countable_norm addE negE normE /\
      q643826_second_countable_norm addP negP normP /\
      q643826_borel_space
        (q643826_norm_open addE negE normE) eventsE /\
      q643826_borel_space
        (q643826_norm_open addP negP normP) eventsP /\
      q643826_topology opensF /\
      q643826_borel_space opensF eventsF /\
      q643826_is_filter filter /\
      q643826_countably_generated_filter filter /\
      q643826_continuous_prod
        addE negE normE addP negP normP opensF g /\
      q643826_tends_in_distribution
        eventsO muO eventsL muL
        eventsE (q643826_norm_open addE negE normE)
        X filter Z /\
      q643826_tends_in_measure_const
        eventsO muO addP negP normP Y filter c /\
      (!i:I.
         q643826_ae_measurable eventsO muO eventsP (Y i))
      ==>
      q643826_tends_in_distribution
        eventsO muO eventsL muL eventsF opensF
        (\i:I x:O. g (X i x,Y i x))
        filter
        (\x:L. g (Z x,c))`;;

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q643826,
;; "Slutsky's theorem": a continuous function of random variables converging
;; respectively in distribution and in probability to a constant converges
;; in distribution to the corresponding continuous image. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Conservative interfaces give identifiers to arbitrary carriers, subsets,
;; functions, and sequences.  No carrier or function is replaced by a finite
;; table or restricted to an APPLY$ class.  The hypotheses below characterize
;; the real field, topological and measurable spaces, probability measures,
;; Lebesgue integrals, filters, almost-everywhere measurability, convergence
;; in measure, and weak convergence of laws explicitly.

;; Real numbers and arbitrary mathematical objects.

(defstub q643826-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q643826-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q643826-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q643826-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q643826-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q643826-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q643826-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q643826-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q643826-r-set-member-p (real set value) t)

(defstub q643826-domain-member-p (domain value) t)
(defstub q643826-set-member-p (set value) t)
(defstub q643826-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q643826-function2-value (function left right) t)
(defstub q643826-function-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q643826-set-sequence-value (sequence index) t)
(defstub q643826-measurable-set-p (measurable set) t)
(defstub q643826-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q643826-open-set-p (topology set) t)
(defstub q643826-filter-set-p (filter set) t)
(defstub q643826-set-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q643826-object-zero (zero-operation) t)
(defstub q643826-object-add (add-operation left right) t)
(defstub q643826-object-negate (negate-operation value) t)
(defstub q643826-norm-value (norm-operation real value) t)
(defstub q643826-lintegral-value
  (lintegral domain measurable measure function) t)
(defstub q643826-integral-value
  (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function) t)

(defun q643826-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q643826-r-less real right left)))

(defun q643826-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q643826-r-less real value (q643826-r-zero real))
      (q643826-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun-sk q643826-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-r-member-p real x)
      (q643826-r-member-p real y)
      (q643826-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q643826-r-zero real))
            (one (q643826-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q643826-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q643826-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q643826-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q643826-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q643826-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q643826-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q643826-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q643826-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q643826-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q643826-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q643826-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q643826-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q643826-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q643826-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q643826-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q643826-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q643826-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q643826-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q643826-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q643826-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q643826-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q643826-r-multiply
          real x (q643826-r-add real y z))
         (q643826-r-add
          real
          (q643826-r-multiply real x y)
          (q643826-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q643826-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-r-member-p real x)
      (q643826-r-member-p real y)
      (q643826-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q643826-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q643826-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q643826-r-less real x y)
         (q643826-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q643826-r-less real x y)
          (q643826-r-less real y z))
         (q643826-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q643826-r-less real x y)
         (q643826-r-less
          real
          (q643826-r-add real x z)
          (q643826-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q643826-r-less real zero x)
          (q643826-r-less real zero y))
         (q643826-r-less
          real zero
          (q643826-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun-sk q643826-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q643826-r-member-p real x)
     (q643826-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q643826-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-r-member-p real x)
      (q643826-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q643826-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q643826-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q643826-r-member-p real bound)
     (q643826-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q643826-r-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q643826-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q643826-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q643826-r-member-p real bound)
       (q643826-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q643826-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q643826-r-has-supremum-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q643826-r-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q643826-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q643826-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q643826-r-has-supremum-p real set))))

(defun q643826-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q643826-r-zero real))
        (one (q643826-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q643826-r-member-p real zero)
     (q643826-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q643826-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q643826-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q643826-r-less real zero one)
     (q643826-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Extended nonnegative reals.

(defun q643826-ennreal-p (real value)
  (or
   (equal value :q643826-top)
   (and
    (consp value)
    (equal (car value) :q643826-finite)
    (q643826-r-member-p real (cdr value))
    (q643826-r-leq
     real (q643826-r-zero real) (cdr value)))))

(defun q643826-ennreal-finite (value)
  (cons :q643826-finite value))

(defun q643826-ennreal-zero (real)
  (q643826-ennreal-finite (q643826-r-zero real)))

(defun q643826-ennreal-less (real left right)
  (cond
   ((equal left :q643826-top) nil)
   ((equal right :q643826-top) t)
   (t (q643826-r-less real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q643826-ennreal-leq (real left right)
  (not (q643826-ennreal-less real right left)))

(defun q643826-ennreal-add (real left right)
  (if (or (equal left :q643826-top)
          (equal right :q643826-top))
      :q643826-top
    (q643826-ennreal-finite
     (q643826-r-add real (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q643826-ennreal-multiply (real left right)
  (cond
   ((or (equal left (q643826-ennreal-zero real))
        (equal right (q643826-ennreal-zero real)))
    (q643826-ennreal-zero real))
   ((or (equal left :q643826-top)
        (equal right :q643826-top))
    :q643826-top)
   (t
    (q643826-ennreal-finite
     (q643826-r-multiply real (cdr left) (cdr right))))))

(defun q643826-ennreal-to-real (real value)
  (if (and (consp value)
           (equal (car value) :q643826-finite))
      (cdr value)
    (q643826-r-zero real)))

;; Sets, sigma algebras, and measures.

(defun-sk q643826-valid-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q643826-set-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-set-member-p left x)
     (q643826-set-member-p right x))))

(defun-sk q643826-set-equiv-p (domain left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (iff
      (q643826-set-member-p left x)
      (q643826-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-empty-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (and (q643826-domain-member-p domain x) nil))))

(defun-sk q643826-complement-set-p (domain set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p complement x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not (q643826-set-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q643826-set-sequence-p (domain sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q643826-valid-set-p
      domain
      (q643826-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q643826-sequence-union-member-p (sequence x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q643826-set-member-p
      (q643826-set-sequence-value sequence n)
      x))))

(defun-sk q643826-sequence-union-set-p
    (domain sequence union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q643826-sequence-union-member-p sequence x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-family-extensional-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q643826-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable left)
      (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable right)))))

(defun-sk q643826-family-valid-p (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q643826-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-empty-exists-p (domain measurable)
  (exists (empty)
    (and
     (q643826-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable empty))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-complement-exists-p
    (domain measurable set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q643826-complement-set-p domain set complement)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable complement))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-complements-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable set)
     (q643826-measurable-complement-exists-p
      domain measurable set))))

(defun-sk q643826-sequence-measurable-p (measurable sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p
      measurable
      (q643826-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-union-exists-p
    (domain measurable sequence)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q643826-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable union))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-sequence-unions-p
    (domain measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q643826-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence))
     (q643826-measurable-union-exists-p
      domain measurable sequence))))

(defun q643826-sigma-algebra-p (domain measurable)
  (and
   (q643826-family-extensional-p domain measurable)
   (q643826-family-valid-p domain measurable)
   (q643826-measurable-empty-exists-p domain measurable)
   (q643826-measurable-complements-p domain measurable)
   (q643826-measurable-sequence-unions-p domain measurable)))

(defun-sk q643826-disjoint-sets-p (left right)
  (forall (x)
    (not
     (and
      (q643826-set-member-p left x)
      (q643826-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-pairwise-disjoint-p (sequence)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (not (equal m n)))
     (q643826-disjoint-sets-p
      (q643826-set-sequence-value sequence m)
      (q643826-set-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q643826-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q643826-ennreal-zero real)
    (q643826-ennreal-add
     real
     (q643826-measure-prefix-sum
      real measure sequence (1- count))
     (q643826-measure-value
      measure
      (q643826-set-sequence-value sequence (1- count))))))

(defun-sk q643826-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q643826-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q643826-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q643826-countable-sum-p
    (real measure sequence total)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-p real total)
     (q643826-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence total)
     (implies
      (and
       (q643826-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q643826-countable-sum-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q643826-ennreal-leq real total bound)))))

(defun-sk q643826-measure-extensional-p (domain measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q643826-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (equal
      (q643826-measure-value measure left)
      (q643826-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q643826-measure-values-p (real domain measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q643826-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q643826-ennreal-p
      real (q643826-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q643826-measure-empty-zero-p
    (real domain measure)
  (forall (empty)
    (implies
     (q643826-empty-set-p domain empty)
     (equal
      (q643826-measure-value measure empty)
      (q643826-ennreal-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q643826-countably-additive-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence union)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-set-sequence-p domain sequence)
      (q643826-sequence-measurable-p measurable sequence)
      (q643826-pairwise-disjoint-p sequence)
      (q643826-sequence-union-set-p domain sequence union))
     (q643826-countable-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q643826-measure-value measure union)))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
    (real measurable measure set lower)
  (forall (superset)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable superset)
      (q643826-set-subset-p set superset))
     (q643826-ennreal-leq
      real lower
      (q643826-measure-value measure superset)))))

(defun-sk q643826-outer-measure-value-p
    (real measurable measure set)
  (forall (lower)
    (and
     (q643826-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
      real measurable measure set
      (q643826-measure-value measure set))
     (implies
      (and
       (q643826-ennreal-p real lower)
       (q643826-measurable-superset-lower-bound-p
        real measurable measure set lower))
      (q643826-ennreal-leq
       real lower
       (q643826-measure-value measure set))))))

(defun-sk q643826-outer-measure-values-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q643826-valid-set-p domain set)
     (q643826-outer-measure-value-p
      real measurable measure set))))

(defun q643826-measure-space-p
    (real domain measurable measure)
  (and
   (q643826-sigma-algebra-p domain measurable)
   (q643826-measure-extensional-p domain measure)
   (q643826-measure-values-p real domain measure)
   (q643826-measure-empty-zero-p real domain measure)
   (q643826-countably-additive-p
    real domain measurable measure)
   (q643826-outer-measure-values-p
    real domain measurable measure)))

(defun q643826-null-set-p (real domain measure set)
  (and
   (q643826-valid-set-p domain set)
   (equal
    (q643826-measure-value measure set)
    (q643826-ennreal-zero real))))

;; Typed functions and measurability through upper-ray preimages.

(defun-sk q643826-real-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q643826-r-member-p
      real (q643826-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-ennreal-function-p (real domain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q643826-ennreal-p
      real (q643826-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-real-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q643826-r-less
       real threshold
       (q643826-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q643826-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
    (real domain function threshold set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q643826-ennreal-less
       real threshold
       (q643826-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q643826-real-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q643826-real-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q643826-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
    (real domain measurable function threshold)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-upper-preimage-set-p
      real domain function threshold set)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p measurable set))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-real-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q643826-real-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q643826-r-member-p real threshold)
      (q643826-real-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    (real domain measurable function)
  (forall (threshold)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (implies
      (q643826-ennreal-p real threshold)
      (q643826-ennreal-upper-preimage-exists-p
       real domain measurable function threshold)))))

(defun-sk q643826-disagreement-set-p
    (domain left right set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (not
       (equal
        (q643826-function-value left x)
        (q643826-function-value right x)))))))

(defun-sk q643826-ae-equal-p
    (real domain measure left right)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q643826-disagreement-set-p domain left right set)
     (q643826-null-set-p real domain measure set))))

(defun-sk q643826-ae-real-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q643826-real-function-p real domain function)
     (q643826-measurable-real-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q643826-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

(defun-sk q643826-ae-ennreal-measurable-p
    (real domain measurable measure function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q643826-measurable-ennreal-function-p
      real domain measurable representative)
     (q643826-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

;; The lower Lebesgue integral as the supremum of measurable finite-range
;; simple functions below the integrand.

(defun-sk q643826-value-attained-p
    (domain function value)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (equal
      (q643826-function-value function x)
      value))))

(defun q643826-values-attained-p
    (domain function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q643826-value-attained-p
        domain function (car values))
       (q643826-values-attained-p
        domain function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q643826-ennreal-value-list-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q643826-ennreal-p real (car values))
       (q643826-ennreal-value-list-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q643826-range-in-values-p
    (domain function values)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (member-equal
      (q643826-function-value function x)
      values))))

(defun-sk q643826-fiber-set-p
    (domain function value set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q643826-function-value function x)
       value)))))

(defun q643826-fiber-list-p
    (domain function values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (consp fibers)
       (q643826-fiber-set-p
        domain function (car values) (car fibers))
       (q643826-fiber-list-p
        domain function (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (equal fibers nil)))

(defun q643826-finite-simple-integral
    (real measure values fibers)
  (if (consp values)
      (q643826-ennreal-add
       real
       (q643826-ennreal-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q643826-measure-value measure (car fibers)))
       (q643826-finite-simple-integral
        real measure (cdr values) (cdr fibers)))
    (q643826-ennreal-zero real)))

(defun q643826-simple-function-data-p
    (real domain measurable function values fibers)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (true-listp fibers)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q643826-ennreal-value-list-p real values)
   (q643826-values-attained-p domain function values)
   (q643826-range-in-values-p domain function values)
   (q643826-fiber-list-p domain function values fibers)
   (q643826-measurable-ennreal-function-p
    real domain measurable function)))

(defun-sk q643826-simple-below-p
    (real domain simple function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q643826-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q643826-function-value simple x)
      (q643826-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real domain measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values fibers)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-simple-function-data-p
       real domain measurable simple values fibers)
      (q643826-simple-below-p
       real domain simple function))
     (q643826-ennreal-leq
      real
      (q643826-finite-simple-integral
       real measure values fibers)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q643826-lintegral-value-p
    (real domain measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q643826-ennreal-p real value)
     (q643826-lintegral-upper-bound-p
      real domain measurable measure function value)
     (implies
      (and
       (q643826-ennreal-p real bound)
       (q643826-lintegral-upper-bound-p
        real domain measurable measure function bound))
      (q643826-ennreal-leq real value bound)))))

(defun-sk q643826-lintegral-operation-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain function)
     (q643826-lintegral-value-p
      real domain measurable measure function
      (q643826-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure function)))))

;; The real Bochner integral, specialized to real-valued functions.

(defun-sk q643826-enorm-function-p
    (real domain function enorm-function)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain enorm-function)
     (implies
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q643826-function-value enorm-function x)
       (q643826-ennreal-finite
        (q643826-r-abs
         real
         (q643826-function-value function x))))))))

(defun-sk q643826-integrable-enorm-exists-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
  (exists (enorm-function)
    (and
     (q643826-enorm-function-p
      real domain function enorm-function)
     (q643826-ennreal-less
      real
      (q643826-lintegral-value
       lintegral domain measurable measure enorm-function)
      :q643826-top))))

(defun q643826-integrable-p
    (real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
  (and
   (q643826-ae-real-measurable-p
    real domain measurable measure function)
   (q643826-integrable-enorm-exists-p
    real domain measurable measure lintegral function)))

(defun-sk q643826-positive-part-function-p
    (real domain function positive)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain positive)
     (implies
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (equal
       (q643826-function-value positive x)
       (q643826-ennreal-finite
        (if
            (q643826-r-less
             real
             (q643826-function-value function x)
             (q643826-r-zero real))
            (q643826-r-zero real)
          (q643826-function-value function x))))))))

(defun-sk q643826-negative-part-function-p
    (real domain function negative)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (q643826-ennreal-function-p real domain negative)
     (implies
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (let ((negated
             (q643826-r-negate
              real
              (q643826-function-value function x))))
        (equal
         (q643826-function-value negative x)
         (q643826-ennreal-finite
          (if
              (q643826-r-less
               real negated (q643826-r-zero real))
              (q643826-r-zero real)
            negated))))))))

(defun-sk q643826-real-integral-witness-exists-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function value)
  (exists (positive negative)
    (and
     (q643826-positive-part-function-p
      real domain function positive)
     (q643826-negative-part-function-p
      real domain function negative)
     (equal
      value
      (q643826-r-add
       real
       (q643826-ennreal-to-real
        real
        (q643826-lintegral-value
         lintegral domain measurable measure positive))
       (q643826-r-negate
        real
        (q643826-ennreal-to-real
         real
         (q643826-lintegral-value
          lintegral domain measurable measure negative))))))))

(defun q643826-real-integral-value-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function value)
  (and
   (q643826-r-member-p real value)
   (if
       (q643826-integrable-p
        real domain measurable measure lintegral function)
       (q643826-real-integral-witness-exists-p
        integral real domain measurable measure
        lintegral function value)
     (equal value (q643826-r-zero real)))))

(defun-sk q643826-real-integral-operation-p
    (integral real domain measurable measure lintegral)
  (forall (function)
    (implies
     (q643826-real-function-p real domain function)
     (q643826-real-integral-value-p
      integral real domain measurable measure lintegral function
      (q643826-integral-value
       integral real domain measurable measure
       lintegral function)))))

;; Generic functions, topologies, Borel sigma algebras, and filters.

(defun-sk q643826-function-p (domain codomain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
     (q643826-domain-member-p
      codomain (q643826-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-function2-p
    (left-domain right-domain codomain function)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p left-domain x)
      (q643826-domain-member-p right-domain y))
     (q643826-domain-member-p
      codomain (q643826-function2-value function x y)))))

(defun-sk q643826-function-sequence-p
    (index domain codomain sequence)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p index i)
     (q643826-function-p
      domain codomain
      (q643826-function-sequence-value sequence i)))))

(defun-sk q643826-preimage-set-p
    (domain function codomain-set preimage)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p preimage x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q643826-set-member-p
       codomain-set
       (q643826-function-value function x))))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-preimage-exists-p
    (domain domain-measurable function codomain-set)
  (exists (preimage)
    (and
     (q643826-preimage-set-p
      domain function codomain-set preimage)
     (q643826-measurable-set-p
      domain-measurable preimage))))

(defun-sk q643826-measurable-function-p
    (domain domain-measurable codomain codomain-measurable function)
  (forall (set)
    (and
     (q643826-function-p domain codomain function)
     (implies
      (q643826-measurable-set-p codomain-measurable set)
      (q643826-measurable-preimage-exists-p
       domain domain-measurable function set)))))

(defun-sk q643826-ae-measurable-p
    (real domain domain-measurable measure
     codomain codomain-measurable function)
  (exists (representative)
    (and
     (q643826-function-p domain codomain function)
     (q643826-measurable-function-p
      domain domain-measurable codomain codomain-measurable
      representative)
     (q643826-ae-equal-p
      real domain measure function representative))))

(defun-sk q643826-sequence-ae-measurable-p
    (real index domain domain-measurable measure
     codomain codomain-measurable sequence)
  (forall (i)
    (implies
     (q643826-domain-member-p index i)
     (q643826-ae-measurable-p
      real domain domain-measurable measure
      codomain codomain-measurable
      (q643826-function-sequence-value sequence i)))))

(defun-sk q643826-full-set-p (domain set)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p set x)
     (q643826-domain-member-p domain x))))

(defun-sk q643826-intersection-set-p
    (domain left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p intersection x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q643826-set-member-p left x)
      (q643826-set-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-family-union-member-p
    (family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q643826-set-family-member-p family set)
     (q643826-set-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q643826-family-union-set-p
    (domain family union)
  (forall (x)
    (iff
     (q643826-set-member-p union x)
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p domain x)
      (q643826-family-union-member-p family x)))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-extensional-p
    (domain topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (q643826-set-equiv-p domain left right)
     (iff
      (q643826-open-set-p topology left)
      (q643826-open-set-p topology right)))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-valid-p
    (domain topology)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q643826-open-set-p topology set)
     (q643826-valid-set-p domain set))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-full-exists-p
    (domain topology)
  (exists (full)
    (and
     (q643826-full-set-p domain full)
     (q643826-open-set-p topology full))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-intersection-exists-p
    (domain topology left right)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (q643826-intersection-set-p
      domain left right intersection)
     (q643826-open-set-p topology intersection))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-intersections-p
    (domain topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-open-set-p topology left)
      (q643826-open-set-p topology right))
     (q643826-topology-intersection-exists-p
      domain topology left right))))

(defun-sk q643826-open-family-p (topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q643826-set-family-member-p family set)
     (q643826-open-set-p topology set))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-union-exists-p
    (domain topology family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q643826-family-union-set-p domain family union)
     (q643826-open-set-p topology union))))

(defun-sk q643826-topology-unions-p
    (domain topology)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (q643826-open-family-p topology family)
     (q643826-topology-union-exists-p
      domain topology family))))

(defun q643826-topological-space-p (domain topology)
  (and
   (q643826-topology-extensional-p domain topology)
   (q643826-topology-valid-p domain topology)
   (q643826-topology-full-exists-p domain topology)
   (q643826-topology-intersections-p domain topology)

    (carrier zero-operation add-operation negate-operation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p carrier x)
      (q643826-domain-member-p carrier y)
      (q643826-domain-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((zero (q643826-object-zero zero-operation))
            (xy (q643826-object-add add-operation x y))
            (yz (q643826-object-add add-operation y z))
            (neg-x (q643826-object-negate negate-operation x)))
       (and
        (q643826-domain-member-p carrier xy)
        (q643826-domain-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (equal
         (q643826-object-add add-operation xy z)
         (q643826-object-add add-operation x yz))
        (equal xy (q643826-object-add add-operation y x))
        (equal
         (q643826-object-add add-operation x zero)
         x)
        (equal
         (q643826-object-add add-operation x neg-x)
         zero))))))

(defun-sk q643826-seminorm-laws-p
    (real carrier zero-operation add-operation negate-operation
     norm-operation)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q643826-domain-member-p carrier x)
      (q643826-domain-member-p carrier y))
     (let* ((zero (q643826-object-zero zero-operation))
            (norm-x (q643826-norm-value norm-operation real x))
            (norm-y (q643826-norm-value norm-operation real y))
            (norm-sum
             (q643826-norm-value
              norm-operation real
              (q643826-object-add add-operation x y))))
       (and
        (q643826-r-member-p real norm-x)
        (not
         (q643826-r-less
          real norm-x (q643826-r-zero real)))
        (equal
         (q643826-norm-value norm-operation real zero)
         (q643826-r-zero real))
        (equal
         (q643826-norm-value
          norm-operation real
          (q643826-object-negate negate-operation x))
         norm-x)
        (q643826-r-leq
         real norm-sum
         (q643826-r-add real norm-x norm-y)))))))
