title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q643826,
-- "Slutsky's theorem": a continuous function of variables converging respectively
-- in distribution and in probability to a constant converges in distribution.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
open import Support.SlutskyProbabilityBase

open CompleteOrderedField
open RealPresentation
open TopologicalSpace
open Filter
open Measure
open ProbabilitySpace

record Pair (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor pair
  field
    first-pair  : A
    second-pair : B

record SeminormedAddCommGroup
  {R : Set}
  (real : RealPresentation R)
  (A : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroA :
      A
    addA :
      A -> A -> A
    negateA :
      A -> A
    normA :
      A -> R

    add-commutativeA :
      (x y : A) ->
      addA x y == addA y x
    add-associativeA :
      (x y z : A) ->
      addA (addA x y) z == addA x (addA y z)
    add-zeroA :
      (x : A) ->
      addA x zeroA == x
    add-inverseA :
      (x : A) ->
      addA x (negateA x) == zeroA

    norm-nonnegativeA :
      (x : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR (reals real) (zeroR (reals real)) (normA x)
    norm-zeroA :
      normA zeroA == zeroR (reals real)
    norm-negateA :
      (x : A) ->
      normA (negateA x) == normA x
    norm-triangleA :
      (x y : A) ->
      lessOrEqualR (reals real)
        (normA (addA x y))
        (addR (reals real) (normA x) (normA y))

open SeminormedAddCommGroup

subtractA :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {real : RealPresentation R} ->
  SeminormedAddCommGroup real A ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
subtractA group x y =
  addA group x (negateA group y)

NormMetricOpen :
  {R A : Set} ->
  {real : RealPresentation R} ->
  SeminormedAddCommGroup real A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set
NormMetricOpen {R = R} {A = A} {real = real} group U =
  (x : A) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive (reals real) radius)
        (Subset
          (\ y ->
            StrictLess (reals real)
              (normA group (subtractA group y x))
              radius)
          U))

record NormTopologyPresentation
  {R A : Set}
  {real : RealPresentation R}
  (group : SeminormedAddCommGroup real A)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) : Set1 where
  field
    topology-is-norm-metric :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      Iff
        (openSet topology U)
        (NormMetricOpen group U)

record SecondCountableTopology
  {A : Set}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) : Set1 where
  field
    countable-basis :
      Nat -> Predicate A
    basis-open :
      (n : Nat) ->
      openSet topology (countable-basis n)
    basis-refines-open :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      openSet topology U ->
      (x : A) ->
      U x ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Both
            (countable-basis n x)
            (Subset (countable-basis n) U))

record CountablyGeneratedFilter
  {I : Set}
  (sourceFilter : Filter I) : Set1 where
  field
    filter-basis :
      Nat -> Predicate I
    basis-eventually :
      (n : Nat) ->
      eventually sourceFilter (filter-basis n)
    basis-generates :
      (P : Predicate I) ->
      eventually sourceFilter P ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          Subset (filter-basis n) P)

record ProductNeighborhood
  {A B C : Set}
  (sourceA : TopologicalSpace A)
  (sourceB : TopologicalSpace B)
  (g : Pair A B -> C)
  (U : Predicate C)
  (x : A)
  (y : B) : Set2 where
  field
    left-neighborhood :
      Predicate A
    right-neighborhood :
      Predicate B
    left-open :
      openSet sourceA left-neighborhood
    right-open :
      openSet sourceB right-neighborhood
    left-contains :
      left-neighborhood x
    right-contains :
      right-neighborhood y
    image-contained :
      (x' : A) ->
      left-neighborhood x' ->
      (y' : B) ->
      right-neighborhood y' ->
      U (g (pair x' y'))

ContinuousPair :
  {A B C : Set} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  TopologicalSpace B ->
  TopologicalSpace C ->
  (Pair A B -> C) ->
  Set2
ContinuousPair sourceA sourceB target g =
  (U : Predicate _) ->
  openSet target U ->
  (x : _) ->
  (y : _) ->
  U (g (pair x y)) ->
  ProductNeighborhood sourceA sourceB g U x y

TendstoInMeasureConstant :
  {R I A E : Set} ->
  (real : RealPresentation R) ->
  (sourceEvents : SigmaAlgebra A) ->
  (sourceProbability : ProbabilitySpace real sourceEvents) ->
  (group : SeminormedAddCommGroup real E) ->
  Filter I ->
  (I -> A -> E) ->
  E ->
  Set
TendstoInMeasureConstant
  {R = R}
  real
  sourceEvents
  sourceProbability
  group
  sourceFilter
  Y
  c =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive (reals real) epsilon ->
  TendstoReal (reals real) sourceFilter
    (\ i ->
      outerMass (probabilityMeasure sourceProbability)
        (\ omega ->
          lessOrEqualR (reals real)
            epsilon
            (normA group (subtractA group (Y i omega) c))))
    (zeroR (reals real))

slutsky-s-theorem : Set2
slutsky-s-theorem =
  (R I E EPrime F OmegaPrime OmegaDoublePrime : Set) ->
  (real : RealPresentation R) ->
  (sourceEvents : SigmaAlgebra OmegaDoublePrime) ->
  (limitEvents : SigmaAlgebra OmegaPrime) ->
  (topologyE : TopologicalSpace E) ->
  (eventsE : SigmaAlgebra E) ->
  (groupE : SeminormedAddCommGroup real E) ->
  NormTopologyPresentation groupE topologyE ->
  SecondCountableTopology topologyE ->
  BorelSpace topologyE eventsE ->
  (topologyEPrime : TopologicalSpace EPrime) ->
  (eventsEPrime : SigmaAlgebra EPrime) ->
  (groupEPrime : SeminormedAddCommGroup real EPrime) ->
  NormTopologyPresentation groupEPrime topologyEPrime ->
  SecondCountableTopology topologyEPrime ->
  BorelSpace topologyEPrime eventsEPrime ->
  (topologyF : TopologicalSpace F) ->
  (eventsF : SigmaAlgebra F) ->
  BorelSpace topologyF eventsF ->
  (sourceFilter : Filter I) ->
  CountablyGeneratedFilter sourceFilter ->
  (sourceProbability :
    ProbabilitySpace real sourceEvents) ->
  (limitProbability :
    ProbabilitySpace real limitEvents) ->
  (X : I -> OmegaDoublePrime -> E) ->
  (Y : I -> OmegaDoublePrime -> EPrime) ->
  (Z : OmegaPrime -> E) ->
  (c : EPrime) ->
  (g : Pair E EPrime -> F) ->
  ContinuousPair topologyE topologyEPrime topologyF g ->
  TendstoInDistribution
    real
    (\ _ -> OmegaDoublePrime)
    (\ _ -> sourceEvents)
    topologyE
    eventsE
    X
    sourceFilter
    Z
    limitEvents
    (\ _ -> sourceProbability)
    limitProbability ->
  TendstoInMeasureConstant
    real
    sourceEvents
    sourceProbability
    groupEPrime
    sourceFilter
    Y
    c ->
  ((i : I) ->
    AEMeasurable
      sourceEvents
      eventsEPrime
      (probabilityMeasure sourceProbability)
      (Y i)) ->
  TendstoInDistribution
    real
    (\ _ -> OmegaDoublePrime)
    (\ _ -> sourceEvents)
    topologyF
    eventsF
    (\ i omega -> g (pair (X i omega) (Y i omega)))
    sourceFilter
    (\ omega -> g (pair (Z omega) c))
    limitEvents
    (\ _ -> sourceProbability)
    limitProbability

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q643826 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q643826), "Slutsky's theorem": convergence
  in distribution of one random variable and convergence in probability of
  another to a constant are preserved after pairing and applying a continuous
  function. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;
open borelTheory lebesgueTheory probabilityTheory;

val q643826_filter_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_filter_def",
  ``q643826_filter (L : ('i set) set) <=>
      UNIV IN L /\
      (!s t. s IN L /\ s SUBSET t ==> t IN L) /\
      (!s t. s IN L /\ t IN L ==> s INTER t IN L)``);

val q643826_countably_generated_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_countably_generated_def",
  ``q643826_countably_generated (L : ('i set) set) <=>
      ?B : num -> 'i set.
        (!m n. m <= n ==> B n SUBSET B m) /\
        !s. s IN L <=> ?n. B n SUBSET s``);

val q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group_def",
  ``q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (neg : 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add x zero = x) /\
      (!x. add x (neg x) = zero) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      norm zero = 0 /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y)``);

val q643826_norm_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_norm_topology_def",
  ``q643826_norm_topology
      (top : 'e topology)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      !u. open_in top u <=>
        !x. x IN u ==>
          ?epsilon : real.
            0 < epsilon /\
            !y. norm (add y (neg x)) < epsilon ==> y IN u``);

val q643826_second_countable_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_second_countable_def",
  ``q643826_second_countable (top : 'e topology) <=>
      ?basis : ('e set) set.
        COUNTABLE basis /\
        (!v. v IN basis ==> open_in top v) /\
        !u x.
          open_in top u /\ x IN u ==>
          ?v. v IN basis /\ x IN v /\ v SUBSET u``);

val q643826_borel_space_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_borel_space_def",
  ``q643826_borel_space
      (top : 'e topology) (a : 'e algebra) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      a = general_borel top``);

val q643826_pair_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_pair_continuous_def",
  ``q643826_pair_continuous
      (topE : 'e topology) (topD : 'd topology)
      (topF : 'f topology) (g : 'e # 'd -> 'f) <=>
      !v. open_in topF v ==>
        !p. g p IN v ==>
          ?u w.
            open_in topE u /\
            open_in topD w /\
            FST p IN u /\
            SND p IN w /\
            !q. FST q IN u /\ SND q IN w ==> g q IN v``);

val q643826_ae_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_ae_measurable_def",
  ``q643826_ae_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space) (a : 'b algebra) (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      ?h.
        h IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a /\
        almost_everywhere m (\x. f x = h x)``);

val q643826_measurable_rep_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_measurable_rep_def",
  ``q643826_measurable_rep
      (m : 'a m_space) (a : 'b algebra) (f : 'a -> 'b) =
      @h.
        h IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a /\
        almost_everywhere m (\x. f x = h x)``);

val q643826_law_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_law_def",
  ``q643826_law
      (m : 'a m_space) (a : 'b algebra) (f : 'a -> 'b) =
      (space a,subsets a,distr m (q643826_measurable_rep m a f))``);

val q643826_weak_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_weak_tendsto_def",
  ``q643826_weak_tendsto
      (top : 'a topology) (L : ('i set) set)
      (nu : 'i -> 'a m_space) (nu0 : 'a m_space) <=>
      !f.
        f IN bounded_continuous top ==>
        !epsilon : real.
          0 < epsilon ==>
          {i |
            dist extreal_mr1
              (integral (nu i) (Normal o f),
               integral nu0 (Normal o f)) < epsilon} IN L``);

val q643826_tendsto_in_distribution_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_tendsto_in_distribution_def",
  ``q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
      (top : 'e topology) (a : 'e algebra) (L : ('i set) set)
      (mu : 'i -> 'w m_space) (mu0 : 'w0 m_space)
      (X : 'i -> 'w -> 'e) (Z : 'w0 -> 'e) <=>
      (!i. q643826_ae_measurable (mu i) a (X i)) /\
      q643826_ae_measurable mu0 a Z /\
      q643826_weak_tendsto top L
        (\i. q643826_law (mu i) a (X i))
        (q643826_law mu0 a Z)``);

val q643826_outer_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_outer_measure_def",
  ``q643826_outer_measure (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a set) =
      inf
        {r : extreal |
          ?t : 'a set.
            s SUBSET t /\
            t IN measurable_sets m /\
            measure m t = r}``);

val q643826_tendsto_extreal_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_tendsto_extreal_def",
  ``q643826_tendsto_extreal
      (L : ('i set) set) (u : 'i -> extreal) (ell : extreal) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        {i | dist extreal_mr1 (u i,ell) < epsilon} IN L``);

val q643826_tendsto_in_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q643826_tendsto_in_measure_def",
  ``q643826_tendsto_in_measure
      (m : 'a m_space) (L : ('i set) set)
      (add : 'd -> 'd -> 'd) (neg : 'd -> 'd)
      (norm : 'd -> real)
      (Y : 'i -> 'a -> 'd) (c : 'd) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        q643826_tendsto_extreal L
          (\i.
            q643826_outer_measure m
              {x | epsilon <= norm (add (Y i x) (neg c))})
          0``);

val slutsky_s_theorem =
  ``!(topE : 'e topology) (measE : 'e algebra)
      (zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (negE : 'e -> 'e) (normE : 'e -> real)
      (topD : 'd topology) (measD : 'd algebra)
      (zeroD : 'd) (addD : 'd -> 'd -> 'd)
      (negD : 'd -> 'd) (normD : 'd -> real)
      (topF : 'f topology) (measF : 'f algebra)
      (L : ('i set) set)
      (mu : 'w m_space) (mu0 : 'w0 m_space)
      (X : 'i -> 'w -> 'e) (Y : 'i -> 'w -> 'd)
      (Z : 'w0 -> 'e) (c : 'd) (g : 'e # 'd -> 'f).
      q643826_filter L /\
      q643826_countably_generated L /\
      prob_space mu /\
      m_space mu = UNIV /\
      prob_space mu0 /\
      m_space mu0 = UNIV /\
      q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group zeroE addE negE normE /\
      q643826_norm_topology topE addE negE normE /\
      q643826_second_countable topE /\
      q643826_borel_space topE measE /\
      q643826_seminormed_add_comm_group zeroD addD negD normD /\
      q643826_norm_topology topD addD negD normD /\
      q643826_second_countable topD /\
      q643826_borel_space topD measD /\
      topspace topF = UNIV /\
      q643826_borel_space topF measF /\
      q643826_pair_continuous topE topD topF g /\
      q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
        topE measE L (\i. mu) mu0 X Z /\
      q643826_tendsto_in_measure mu L addD negD normD Y c /\
      (!i. q643826_ae_measurable mu measD (Y i))
      ==>
      q643826_tendsto_in_distribution
        topF measF L (\i. mu) mu0
        (\i w. g (X i w,Y i w))
        (\w. g (Z w,c))``;

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q643826
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q643826), "Slutsky's theorem": if one family
  converges in distribution and another converges in measure to a constant,
  then applying an arbitrary continuous function to their paired values
  preserves convergence in distribution. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q643826SeminormedAddCommGroup is an arbitrary Abelian group equipped with a
  real-valued seminorm; importantly, no definiteness axiom is imposed.
  Q643826NormTopology is its seminorm topology. Thus these definitions retain
  Lean's full SeminormedAddCommGroup generality rather than narrowing to
  normed vector spaces.

  Q643826LeanFilter gives exactly the four axioms of Lean's Filter structure,
  including the possibly improper filter. Q643826CountablyGenerated gives it
  a countable refinement basis.

  Q643826AEMeasurable says that a function agrees outside a measurable null
  set with a measurable function. Q643826Map uses such a version to define
  the pushforward law. Q643826Integral defines real expectations as limits of
  SetMM simple integrals along L1-approximating measurable finite-range
  functions. Q643826WeakTendsto uses these expectations of bounded continuous
  real-valued test functions, and Q643826TendstoInDistribution expands
  convergence in distribution as weak convergence of pushforward probability
  measures.

  Q643826TendstoInMeasure uses the norm formulation equivalent to mathlib's
  definition: for every positive real epsilon, the outer measures of the sets
  where the norm-distance from the constant is at least epsilon converge to
  zero in the extended-nonnegative-real topology.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions. This root
  artifact declares no $p statement; the included lib/set.mm supplies the
  independently verified standard-library proofs.
$)

$c Q643826SeminormedAddCommGroup Q643826NormTopology
   Q643826LeanFilter Q643826CountablyGenerated

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q643826,
:: "Slutsky's theorem": over second-countable seminormed additive commutative
:: groups, applying a continuous function to variables converging respectively
:: in distribution and in probability to a constant preserves convergence in
:: distribution. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, CARD_3, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC,
      TOPS_1, TOPS_2, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, PROB_4, MEASURE1, MEASURE3,
      MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3,
      XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, XXREAL_2, SUPINF_1, SUPINF_2, REAL_1,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, SETFAM_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, COMPLEX1,
      FUNCOP_1, TOPMETR, BINOP_1, NAT_1;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, SETFAM_1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, CARD_1, CARD_3, ORDINAL1,
      NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_1, XXREAL_2, XXREAL_3,
      XREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, STRUCT_0,
      PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, TOPS_2, TOPGEN_4, PROB_1, PROB_2, PROB_4,
      MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE6, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2,
      MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, FUNCOP_1,
      TOPMETR, BINOP_1, NAT_1;
 constructors RELSET_1, REAL_1, EXTREAL1, TOPS_1, TOPS_2, TOPGEN_4,
      PROB_1, PROB_2, PROB_3, PROB_4, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MEASURE6,
      MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2, MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2,
      RANDOM_3, COMPLEX1, FUNCOP_1, TOPMETR, BINOP_1, NAT_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1,
      ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_3, MEMBERED,
      STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, TOPMETR, MEASURE1, MEASURE3,
      PROB_1, PROB_4, RANDOM_1, RANDOM_2, RANDOM_3, VALUED_0,
      RELSET_1, NAT_1;
 requirements BOOLE, SUBSET, NUMERALS, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, STRUCT_0, PROB_1, PROB_4;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for I being set,
      L being Subset-Family of I,
      E,D,F being non empty TopSpace,
      SigmaE being SigmaField of the carrier of E,
      SigmaD being SigmaField of the carrier of D,
      SigmaF being SigmaField of the carrier of F,
      zeroE being Point of E,
      addE being BinOp of the carrier of E,
      oppE being UnOp of the carrier of E,
      normE being Function of the carrier of E,REAL,
      zeroD being Point of D,
      addD being BinOp of the carrier of D,
      oppD being UnOp of the carrier of D,
      normD being Function of the carrier of D,REAL,
      Omega,Omega0 being non empty set,
      Sigma being SigmaField of Omega,
      Sigma0 being SigmaField of Omega0,
      P being Probability of Sigma,
      P0 being Probability of Sigma0,
      X being Function of I,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of E),
      Y being Function of I,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of D),
      Z being Function of Omega0,the carrier of E,
      c being Point of D,
      g being Function of
        [:the carrier of E,the carrier of D:],the carrier of F
  st
    I in L &
    (for A,B being Subset of I st A in L & A c= B holds B in L) &
    (for A,B being Subset of I st A in L & B in L holds A /\ B in L) &
    (ex B being Function of NAT,bool I st
      for A being Subset of I holds
        (A in L iff ex n being Nat st B.n c= A)) &
    (for x,y being Point of E holds addE.(x,y) = addE.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Point of E holds
      addE.(addE.(x,y),z) = addE.(x,addE.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Point of E holds addE.(x,zeroE) = x) &
    (for x being Point of E holds addE.(x,oppE.x) = zeroE) &
    normE.zeroE = 0 &
    (for x being Point of E holds 0 <= normE.x) &
    (for x being Point of E holds normE.(oppE.x) = normE.x) &
    (for x,y being Point of E holds
      normE.(addE.(x,y)) <= normE.x + normE.y) &
    (for U being Subset of E holds
      (U in the topology of E iff
        for x being Point of E st x in U holds
          ex epsilon being Real st
            0 < epsilon &
            for y being Point of E st
              normE.(addE.(y,oppE.x)) < epsilon
            holds y in U)) &
    (ex B being Function of NAT,bool the carrier of E st
      (for n being Nat holds B.n in the topology of E) &
      for U being Subset of E,
          x being Point of E st U in the topology of E & x in U holds
        ex n being Nat st x in B.n & B.n c= U) &
    SigmaE = BorelSets E &
    (for x,y being Point of D holds addD.(x,y) = addD.(y,x)) &
    (for x,y,z being Point of D holds
      addD.(addD.(x,y),z) = addD.(x,addD.(y,z))) &
    (for x being Point of D holds addD.(x,zeroD) = x) &
    (for x being Point of D holds addD.(x,oppD.x) = zeroD) &
    normD.zeroD = 0 &
    (for x being Point of D holds 0 <= normD.x) &
    (for x being Point of D holds normD.(oppD.x) = normD.x) &
    (for x,y being Point of D holds
      normD.(addD.(x,y)) <= normD.x + normD.y) &
    (for U being Subset of D holds
      (U in the topology of D iff
        for x being Point of D st x in U holds
          ex epsilon being Real st
            0 < epsilon &
            for y being Point of D st
              normD.(addD.(y,oppD.x)) < epsilon
            holds y in U)) &
    (ex B being Function of NAT,bool the carrier of D st
      (for n being Nat holds B.n in the topology of D) &
      for U being Subset of D,
          x being Point of D st U in the topology of D & x in U holds
        ex n being Nat st x in B.n & B.n c= U) &
    SigmaD = BorelSets D &
    SigmaF = BorelSets F &
    (for V being Subset of F st V in the topology of F holds
      for x being Point of E,
          y being Point of D st g.(x,y) in V holds
        ex U being Subset of E,
           W being Subset of D st
          U in the topology of E &
          W in the topology of D &
          x in U & y in W &
          for x1 being Point of E,
              y1 being Point of D st x1 in U & y1 in W holds
            g.(x1,y1) in V) &
    (ex XM being Function of I,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of E),
        ZM being random_variable of Sigma0,SigmaE,
        N0 being Element of Sigma0
      st
        P0.N0 = 0 &
        (for omega being Element of Omega0 st
          omega in Omega0 & not omega in N0
        holds Z.omega = ZM.omega) &
        (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
          ex XMi being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaE,
             Ni being Element of Sigma
          st
            XMi = XM.i &
            P.Ni = 0 &
            for omega being Element of Omega st
              omega in Omega & not omega in Ni
            holds X.i.omega = XMi.omega) &
        for u being Function of E,R^1
          st (for V being Subset of R^1 st V in the topology of R^1 holds
                u"V in the topology of E) &
             ex C being Real st
               for x being Point of E holds |.u.x.| <= C
        holds
          ex uR being Function of the carrier of E,REAL,
             a being Function of I,REAL,
             b being Real
          st
            uR = u &
            (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
              ex XMi being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaE
              st
                XMi = XM.i &
                a.i = Integral(P2M(probability(XMi,P)),uR)) &
            b = Integral(P2M(probability(ZM,P0)),uR) &
            for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
              {i where i is Element of I :
                i in I & |.a.i-b.| < epsilon} in L) &
    (for epsilon,delta being Real st 0 < epsilon & 0 < delta holds
      {i where i is Element of I :
        i in I &
        ex A being Element of Sigma st
          {omega where omega is Element of Omega :
            omega in Omega &
            epsilon <= normD.(addD.(Y.i.omega,oppD.c))} c= A &
          P.A < delta} in L) &
    (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
      ex YMi being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaD,
         Ni being Element of Sigma
      st
        P.Ni = 0 &
        for omega being Element of Omega st
          omega in Omega & not omega in Ni
        holds Y.i.omega = YMi.omega)
  holds
    ex GM being Function of I,Funcs(Omega,the carrier of F),
       G0M being random_variable of Sigma0,SigmaF,
       N0 being Element of Sigma0
    st
      P0.N0 = 0 &
      (for omega being Element of Omega0 st
        omega in Omega0 & not omega in N0
      holds G0M.omega = g.(Z.omega,c)) &
      (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
        ex GMi being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaF,
           Ni being Element of Sigma
        st
          GMi = GM.i &
          P.Ni = 0 &
          for omega being Element of Omega st
            omega in Omega & not omega in Ni
          holds GMi.omega = g.(X.i.omega,Y.i.omega)) &
      for u being Function of F,R^1
        st (for V being Subset of R^1 st V in the topology of R^1 holds
              u"V in the topology of F) &
           ex C being Real st
             for y being Point of F holds |.u.y.| <= C
      holds
        ex uR being Function of the carrier of F,REAL,
           a being Function of I,REAL,
           b being Real
        st
          uR = u &
          (for i being Element of I st i in I holds
            ex GMi being random_variable of Sigma,SigmaF
            st
              GMi = GM.i &
              a.i = Integral(P2M(probability(GMi,P)),uR)) &
          b = Integral(P2M(probability(G0M,P0)),uR) &
          for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
            {i where i is Element of I :
              i in I & |.a.i-b.| < epsilon} in L
proof
end;

title: Q643826_slutsky_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q643826,
% "Slutsky's theorem": a continuous function of a distributionally convergent
% random variable and a random variable converging in measure to a constant
% converges in distribution to the corresponding transformed limit.
% This file contains no proof.

slutsky_s_theorem_Q643826[
  Index: TYPE,
  Source: TYPE,
  LimitSource: TYPE,
  E: TYPE,
  EPrime: TYPE,
  F: TYPE,
  source_sigma: [[Source -> bool] -> bool],
  limit_sigma: [[LimitSource -> bool] -> bool],
  e_sigma: [[E -> bool] -> bool],
  ep_sigma: [[EPrime -> bool] -> bool],
  f_sigma: [[F -> bool] -> bool],
  source_measure: [[Source -> bool] -> real],
  limit_measure: [[LimitSource -> bool] -> real],
  source_integral: [[Source -> real] -> real],
  limit_integral: [[LimitSource -> real] -> real],
  e_open: [[E -> bool] -> bool],
  ep_open: [[EPrime -> bool] -> bool],
  f_open: [[F -> bool] -> bool],
  index_filter: [[Index -> bool] -> bool],
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real],
  zeroEP: EPrime,
  addEP: [EPrime, EPrime -> EPrime],
  negEP: [EPrime -> EPrime],
  normEP: [EPrime -> real],
  X: [Index -> [Source -> E]],
  Y: [Index -> [Source -> EPrime]],
  Z: [LimitSource -> E],
  c: EPrime,
  g: [E, EPrime -> F]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  source_event: TYPE = [Source -> bool]
  source_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> source_event]
  limit_event: TYPE = [LimitSource -> bool]
  limit_event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> limit_event]
  e_event: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  ep_event: TYPE = [EPrime -> bool]
  f_event: TYPE = [F -> bool]
  real_event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  source_empty: source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): FALSE

  source_full: source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): TRUE

  source_complement(A: source_event): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): NOT A(omega)

  source_countable_union(events: source_event_sequence): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  source_pairwise_disjoint(events: source_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: Source):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  limit_empty: limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): FALSE

  limit_full: limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): TRUE

  limit_complement(A: limit_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): NOT A(omega)

  limit_countable_union(events: limit_event_sequence): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(omega)

  limit_pairwise_disjoint(events: limit_event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (omega: LimitSource):
          NOT (events(left_index)(omega)
            AND events(right_index)(omega))

  finite_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_sum(values, count - 1) + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_real_sequence(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  source_sigma_algebra: bool =
    source_sigma(source_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: source_event):
        source_sigma(A) IMPLIES
          source_sigma(source_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: source_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          source_sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          source_sigma(source_countable_union(events)))

  limit_sigma_algebra: bool =
    limit_sigma(limit_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        limit_sigma(A) IMPLIES
          limit_sigma(limit_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          limit_sigma(events(index)))
        IMPLIES
          limit_sigma(limit_countable_union(events)))

  source_measure_laws: bool =
    source_sigma_algebra
      AND source_measure(source_empty) = 0
      AND (FORALL (A: source_event):
        0 <= source_measure(A))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: source_event):
        (FORALL (omega: Source): A(omega) IMPLIES B(omega))
        IMPLIES source_measure(A) <= source_measure(B))
      AND (FORALL (events: source_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (bound: real):
          (FORALL (count: nat):
            finite_sum(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                source_measure(events(index)),
              count) <= bound)
          IMPLIES
            source_measure(source_countable_union(events)) <= bound))
      AND (FORALL (events: source_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            source_sigma(events(index)))
          AND source_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_real_sequence(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  source_measure(events(index)),
                count),
            source_measure(source_countable_union(events))))

  limit_measure_laws: bool =
    limit_sigma_algebra
      AND limit_measure(limit_empty) = 0
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        0 <= limit_measure(A))
      AND (FORALL (A, B: limit_event):
        (FORALL (omega: LimitSource): A(omega) IMPLIES B(omega))
        IMPLIES limit_measure(A) <= limit_measure(B))
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        (FORALL (bound: real):
          (FORALL (count: nat):
            finite_sum(
              LAMBDA (index: nat):
                limit_measure(events(index)),
              count) <= bound)
          IMPLIES
            limit_measure(limit_countable_union(events)) <= bound))
      AND (FORALL (events: limit_event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            limit_sigma(events(index)))
          AND limit_pairwise_disjoint(events))
        IMPLIES
          converges_real_sequence(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              finite_sum(
                LAMBDA (index: nat):
                  limit_measure(events(index)),
                count),
            limit_measure(limit_countable_union(events))))

  source_probability_measure: bool =
    source_measure_laws
      AND source_measure(source_full) = 1

  limit_probability_measure: bool =
    limit_measure_laws
      AND limit_measure(limit_full) = 1

  e_empty: e_event =
    LAMBDA (value: E): FALSE

  e_full: e_event =
    LAMBDA (value: E): TRUE

  e_intersection(A, B: e_event): e_event =
    LAMBDA (value: E): A(value) AND B(value)

  e_union(family: [e_event -> bool]): e_event =
    LAMBDA (value: E):
      EXISTS (A: e_event):
        family(A) AND A(value)

  ep_empty: ep_event =
    LAMBDA (value: EPrime): FALSE

  ep_full: ep_event =
    LAMBDA (value: EPrime): TRUE

  ep_intersection(A, B: ep_event): ep_event =
    LAMBDA (value: EPrime): A(value) AND B(value)

  ep_union(family: [ep_event -> bool]): ep_event =
    LAMBDA (value: EPrime):
      EXISTS (A: ep_event):
        family(A) AND A(value)

  f_empty: f_event =
    LAMBDA (value: F): FALSE

  f_full: f_event =
    LAMBDA (value: F): TRUE

  f_intersection(A, B: f_event): f_event =
    LAMBDA (value: F): A(value) AND B(value)

  f_union(family: [f_event -> bool]): f_event =
    LAMBDA (value: F):
      EXISTS (A: f_event):
        family(A) AND A(value)

  topology_e: bool =
    e_open(e_empty)
      AND e_open(e_full)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: e_event):
        e_open(A) AND e_open(B) IMPLIES
          e_open(e_intersection(A, B)))
      AND (FORALL (family: [e_event -> bool]):
        (FORALL (A: e_event):
          family(A) IMPLIES e_open(A))
        IMPLIES e_open(e_union(family)))

  topology_ep: bool =
    ep_open(ep_empty)
      AND ep_open(ep_full)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: ep_event):
        ep_open(A) AND ep_open(B) IMPLIES
          ep_open(ep_intersection(A, B)))
      AND (FORALL (family: [ep_event -> bool]):
        (FORALL (A: ep_event):
          family(A) IMPLIES ep_open(A))
        IMPLIES ep_open(ep_union(family)))

  topology_f: bool =
    f_open(f_empty)
      AND f_open(f_full)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: f_event):
        f_open(A) AND f_open(B) IMPLIES
          f_open(f_intersection(A, B)))
      AND (FORALL (family: [f_event -> bool]):
        (FORALL (A: f_event):
          family(A) IMPLIES f_open(A))
        IMPLIES f_open(f_union(family)))

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  subEP(x, y: EPrime): EPrime =
    addEP(x, negEP(y))

  seminormed_add_comm_group_e: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E): addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND normE(zeroE) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: E): 0 <= normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): normE(negE(x)) = normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))
      AND (FORALL (U: e_event):
        e_open(U) IFF
          (FORALL (x: E):
            U(x) IMPLIES
              EXISTS (radius: posreal):
                FORALL (y: E):
                  normE(subE(y, x)) < radius
                    IMPLIES U(y)))

  seminormed_add_comm_group_ep: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: EPrime): addEP(x, y) = addEP(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: EPrime):
        addEP(addEP(x, y), z) = addEP(x, addEP(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: EPrime): addEP(x, zeroEP) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: EPrime): addEP(x, negEP(x)) = zeroEP)
      AND normEP(zeroEP) = 0
      AND (FORALL (x: EPrime): 0 <= normEP(x))
      AND (FORALL (x: EPrime): normEP(negEP(x)) = normEP(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: EPrime):
        normEP(addEP(x, y)) <= normEP(x) + normEP(y))
      AND (FORALL (U: ep_event):
        ep_open(U) IFF
          (FORALL (x: EPrime):
            U(x) IMPLIES
              EXISTS (radius: posreal):
                FORALL (y: EPrime):
                  normEP(subEP(y, x)) < radius
                    IMPLIES U(y)))

  second_countable_e: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: [nat -> e_event]):
      (FORALL (index: nat): e_open(basis(index)))
        AND (FORALL (U: e_event), (x: E):
          e_open(U) AND U(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              basis(index)(x)
                AND (FORALL (y: E):
                  basis(index)(y) IMPLIES U(y)))

  second_countable_ep: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: [nat -> ep_event]):
      (FORALL (index: nat): ep_open(basis(index)))
        AND (FORALL (U: ep_event), (x: EPrime):
          ep_open(U) AND U(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              basis(index)(x)
                AND (FORALL (y: EPrime):
                  basis(index)(y) IMPLIES U(y)))

  e_complement(A: e_event): e_event =
    LAMBDA (value: E): NOT A(value)

  e_countable_union(events: [nat -> e_event]): e_event =
    LAMBDA (value: E):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(value)

  ep_complement(A: ep_event): ep_event =
    LAMBDA (value: EPrime): NOT A(value)

  ep_countable_union(events: [nat -> ep_event]): ep_event =
    LAMBDA (value: EPrime):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(value)

  f_complement(A: f_event): f_event =
    LAMBDA (value: F): NOT A(value)

  f_countable_union(events: [nat -> f_event]): f_event =
    LAMBDA (value: F):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(value)

  is_e_sigma(candidate: [e_event -> bool]): bool =
    candidate(e_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: e_event):
        candidate(A) IMPLIES candidate(e_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: [nat -> e_event]):
        (FORALL (index: nat): candidate(events(index)))
        IMPLIES candidate(e_countable_union(events)))

  is_ep_sigma(candidate: [ep_event -> bool]): bool =
    candidate(ep_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: ep_event):
        candidate(A) IMPLIES candidate(ep_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: [nat -> ep_event]):
        (FORALL (index: nat): candidate(events(index)))
        IMPLIES candidate(ep_countable_union(events)))

  is_f_sigma(candidate: [f_event -> bool]): bool =
    candidate(f_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: f_event):
        candidate(A) IMPLIES candidate(f_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: [nat -> f_event]):
        (FORALL (index: nat): candidate(events(index)))
        IMPLIES candidate(f_countable_union(events)))

  borel_e: bool =
    is_e_sigma(e_sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: e_event):
        e_open(U) IMPLIES e_sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (candidate: [e_event -> bool]):
        (is_e_sigma(candidate)
          AND (FORALL (U: e_event):
            e_open(U) IMPLIES candidate(U)))
        IMPLIES
          (FORALL (A: e_event):
            e_sigma(A) IMPLIES candidate(A)))

  borel_ep: bool =
    is_ep_sigma(ep_sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: ep_event):
        ep_open(U) IMPLIES ep_sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (candidate: [ep_event -> bool]):
        (is_ep_sigma(candidate)
          AND (FORALL (U: ep_event):
            ep_open(U) IMPLIES candidate(U)))
        IMPLIES
          (FORALL (A: ep_event):
            ep_sigma(A) IMPLIES candidate(A)))

  borel_f: bool =
    is_f_sigma(f_sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: f_event):
        f_open(U) IMPLIES f_sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (candidate: [f_event -> bool]):
        (is_f_sigma(candidate)
          AND (FORALL (U: f_event):
            f_open(U) IMPLIES candidate(U)))
        IMPLIES
          (FORALL (A: f_event):
            f_sigma(A) IMPLIES candidate(A)))

  real_open(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: real):
            abs(y - x) < radius IMPLIES A(y)

  real_full: real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): TRUE

  real_complement(A: real_event): real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): NOT A(x)

  real_countable_union(events: [nat -> real_event]): real_event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat): events(index)(x)

  is_real_sigma(candidate: [real_event -> bool]): bool =
    candidate(real_full)
      AND (FORALL (A: real_event):
        candidate(A) IMPLIES candidate(real_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (events: [nat -> real_event]):
        (FORALL (index: nat): candidate(events(index)))
        IMPLIES candidate(real_countable_union(events)))

  real_borel(A: real_event): bool =
    FORALL (candidate: [real_event -> bool]):
      (is_real_sigma(candidate)
        AND (FORALL (U: real_event):
          real_open(U) IMPLIES candidate(U)))
      IMPLIES candidate(A)

  source_preimage_e(h: [Source -> E], A: e_event): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(h(omega))

  source_preimage_ep(
      h: [Source -> EPrime],
      A: ep_event): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(h(omega))

  source_preimage_f(h: [Source -> F], A: f_event): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(h(omega))

  source_preimage_real(
      h: [Source -> real],
      A: real_event): source_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source): A(h(omega))

  limit_preimage_e(
      h: [LimitSource -> E],
      A: e_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(h(omega))

  limit_preimage_f(
      h: [LimitSource -> F],
      A: f_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(h(omega))

  limit_preimage_real(
      h: [LimitSource -> real],
      A: real_event): limit_event =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): A(h(omega))

  source_measurable_e(h: [Source -> E]): bool =
    FORALL (A: e_event):
      e_sigma(A) IMPLIES source_sigma(source_preimage_e(h, A))

  source_measurable_ep(h: [Source -> EPrime]): bool =
    FORALL (A: ep_event):
      ep_sigma(A) IMPLIES source_sigma(source_preimage_ep(h, A))

  source_measurable_f(h: [Source -> F]): bool =
    FORALL (A: f_event):
      f_sigma(A) IMPLIES source_sigma(source_preimage_f(h, A))

  source_measurable_real(h: [Source -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      real_borel(A) IMPLIES source_sigma(source_preimage_real(h, A))

  limit_measurable_e(h: [LimitSource -> E]): bool =
    FORALL (A: e_event):
      e_sigma(A) IMPLIES limit_sigma(limit_preimage_e(h, A))

  limit_measurable_f(h: [LimitSource -> F]): bool =
    FORALL (A: f_event):
      f_sigma(A) IMPLIES limit_sigma(limit_preimage_f(h, A))

  limit_measurable_real(h: [LimitSource -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_event):
      real_borel(A) IMPLIES limit_sigma(limit_preimage_real(h, A))

  source_null(A: source_event): bool =
    EXISTS (cover: source_event):
      source_sigma(cover)
        AND (FORALL (omega: Source):
          A(omega) IMPLIES cover(omega))
        AND source_measure(cover) = 0

  limit_null(A: limit_event): bool =
    EXISTS (cover: limit_event):
      limit_sigma(cover)
        AND (FORALL (omega: LimitSource):
          A(omega) IMPLIES cover(omega))
        AND limit_measure(cover) = 0

  source_ae(property_value: [Source -> bool]): bool =
    source_null(
      LAMBDA (omega: Source): NOT property_value(omega))

  limit_ae(property_value: [LimitSource -> bool]): bool =
    limit_null(
      LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource): NOT property_value(omega))

  source_ae_measurable_e(h: [Source -> E]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [Source -> E]):
      source_measurable_e(version)
        AND source_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: Source):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  source_ae_measurable_ep(h: [Source -> EPrime]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [Source -> EPrime]):
      source_measurable_ep(version)
        AND source_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: Source):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  source_ae_measurable_f(h: [Source -> F]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [Source -> F]):
      source_measurable_f(version)
        AND source_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: Source):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  source_ae_measurable_real(h: [Source -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [Source -> real]):
      source_measurable_real(version)
        AND source_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: Source):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  limit_ae_measurable_e(h: [LimitSource -> E]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [LimitSource -> E]):
      limit_measurable_e(version)
        AND limit_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  limit_ae_measurable_f(h: [LimitSource -> F]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [LimitSource -> F]):
      limit_measurable_f(version)
        AND limit_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  limit_ae_measurable_real(h: [LimitSource -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (version: [LimitSource -> real]):
      limit_measurable_real(version)
        AND limit_ae(
          LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
            h(omega) = version(omega))

  bounded_e(h: [E -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (x: E): abs(h(x)) <= bound

  bounded_f(h: [F -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (x: F): abs(h(x)) <= bound

  continuous_e_real(h: [E -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (U: real_event):
      real_open(U) IMPLIES
        e_open(LAMBDA (x: E): U(h(x)))

  continuous_f_real(h: [F -> real]): bool =
    FORALL (U: real_event):
      real_open(U) IMPLIES
        f_open(LAMBDA (x: F): U(h(x)))

  source_bounded_real(h: [Source -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (omega: Source): abs(h(omega)) <= bound

  limit_bounded_real(h: [LimitSource -> real]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nonneg_real):
      FORALL (omega: LimitSource): abs(h(omega)) <= bound

  source_integral_standard: bool =
    (FORALL (left, right: [Source -> real]):
      source_ae(
        LAMBDA (omega: Source):
          left(omega) = right(omega))
      IMPLIES source_integral(left) = source_integral(right))
      AND (FORALL (A: source_event):
        source_sigma(A) IMPLIES
          source_integral(
            LAMBDA (omega: Source):
              IF A(omega) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
            = source_measure(A))
      AND (FORALL
          (left, right: [Source -> real]),
          (a, b: real):
        (source_ae_measurable_real(left)
          AND source_ae_measurable_real(right)
          AND source_bounded_real(left)
          AND source_bounded_real(right))
        IMPLIES
          source_integral(
            LAMBDA (omega: Source):
              a * left(omega) + b * right(omega))
            = a * source_integral(left)
                + b * source_integral(right))
      AND (FORALL
          (h: [Source -> real]),
          (bound: nonneg_real):
        (source_ae_measurable_real(h)
          AND (FORALL (omega: Source):
            abs(h(omega)) <= bound))
        IMPLIES abs(source_integral(h)) <= bound)

  limit_integral_standard: bool =
    (FORALL (left, right: [LimitSource -> real]):
      limit_ae(
        LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
          left(omega) = right(omega))
      IMPLIES limit_integral(left) = limit_integral(right))
      AND (FORALL (A: limit_event):
        limit_sigma(A) IMPLIES
          limit_integral(
            LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
              IF A(omega) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
            = limit_measure(A))
      AND (FORALL
          (left, right: [LimitSource -> real]),
          (a, b: real):
        (limit_ae_measurable_real(left)
          AND limit_ae_measurable_real(right)
          AND limit_bounded_real(left)
          AND limit_bounded_real(right))
        IMPLIES
          limit_integral(
            LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
              a * left(omega) + b * right(omega))
            = a * limit_integral(left)
                + b * limit_integral(right))
      AND (FORALL
          (h: [LimitSource -> real]),
          (bound: nonneg_real):
        (limit_ae_measurable_real(h)
          AND (FORALL (omega: LimitSource):
            abs(h(omega)) <= bound))
        IMPLIES abs(limit_integral(h)) <= bound)

  filter_laws: bool =
    index_filter(LAMBDA (index: Index): TRUE)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: [Index -> bool]):
        index_filter(left) AND index_filter(right)
        IMPLIES
          index_filter(
            LAMBDA (index: Index):
              left(index) AND right(index)))
      AND (FORALL (left, right: [Index -> bool]):
        index_filter(left)
          AND (FORALL (index: Index):
            left(index) IMPLIES right(index))
        IMPLIES index_filter(right))

  countably_generated_filter: bool =
    EXISTS (basis: [nat -> [Index -> bool]]):
      FORALL (A: [Index -> bool]):
        index_filter(A) IFF
          EXISTS (number: nat):
            FORALL (index: Index):
              basis(number)(index) IMPLIES A(index)

  tendsto_real_along_filter(
      values: [Index -> real],
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      index_filter(
        LAMBDA (index: Index):
          abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value)

  tendsto_in_distribution_e: bool =
    (FORALL (index: Index):
      source_ae_measurable_e(X(index)))
      AND limit_ae_measurable_e(Z)
      AND (FORALL (test: [E -> real]):
        bounded_e(test)
          AND continuous_e_real(test)
        IMPLIES
          tendsto_real_along_filter(
            LAMBDA (index: Index):
              source_integral(
                LAMBDA (omega: Source):
                  test(X(index)(omega))),
            limit_integral(
              LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
                test(Z(omega)))))

  y_tendsto_in_measure_to_c: bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      tendsto_real_along_filter(
        LAMBDA (index: Index):
          source_measure(
            LAMBDA (omega: Source):
              epsilon_value
                <= normEP(subEP(Y(index)(omega), c))),
        0)

  y_ae_measurable: bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      source_ae_measurable_ep(Y(index))

  product_open(A: [E, EPrime -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL (x: E), (y: EPrime):
      A(x, y) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (U: e_event), (V: ep_event):
          e_open(U)
            AND ep_open(V)
            AND U(x)
            AND V(y)
            AND (FORALL (u: E), (v: EPrime):
              U(u) AND V(v) IMPLIES A(u, v))

  continuous_g: bool =
    FORALL (U: f_event):
      f_open(U) IMPLIES
        product_open(
          LAMBDA (x: E), (y: EPrime):
            U(g(x, y)))

  transformed_source(index: Index): [Source -> F] =
    LAMBDA (omega: Source):
      g(X(index)(omega), Y(index)(omega))

  transformed_limit: [LimitSource -> F] =
    LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
      g(Z(omega), c)

  transformed_tendsto_in_distribution: bool =
    (FORALL (index: Index):
      source_ae_measurable_f(transformed_source(index)))
      AND limit_ae_measurable_f(transformed_limit)
      AND (FORALL (test: [F -> real]):
        bounded_f(test)
          AND continuous_f_real(test)
        IMPLIES
          tendsto_real_along_filter(
            LAMBDA (index: Index):
              source_integral(
                LAMBDA (omega: Source):
                  test(transformed_source(index)(omega))),
            limit_integral(
              LAMBDA (omega: LimitSource):
                test(transformed_limit(omega)))))

  structural_context: bool =
    source_probability_measure
      AND limit_probability_measure
      AND topology_e
      AND topology_ep
      AND topology_f
      AND seminormed_add_comm_group_e
      AND seminormed_add_comm_group_ep
      AND second_countable_e
      AND second_countable_ep
      AND borel_e
      AND borel_ep
      AND borel_f
      AND filter_laws
      AND countably_generated_filter
      AND source_integral_standard
      AND limit_integral_standard

  slutsky_s_theorem: bool =
    structural_context IMPLIES
      ((continuous_g
        AND tendsto_in_distribution_e
        AND y_tendsto_in_measure_to_c
        AND y_ae_measurable)
      IMPLIES transformed_tendsto_in_distribution)
END slutsky_s_theorem_Q643826

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656198
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q656198), "Maschke's theorem": over a field, if
  the cardinality of a finite group is nonzero in the field, every submodule
  of a module over the group algebra has a complementary submodule.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q656198_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q656198_fzero : K;
  q656198_fone : K;
  q656198_fadd : K -> K -> K;
  q656198_fmul : K -> K -> K;
  q656198_fneg : K -> K;
  q656198_finv : K -> K;
  q656198_fadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q656198_fadd x (q656198_fadd y z) =
      q656198_fadd (q656198_fadd x y) z;
  q656198_fadd_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q656198_fadd x y = q656198_fadd y x;
  q656198_fzero_add :
    forall x : K, q656198_fadd q656198_fzero x = x;
  q656198_fadd_zero :
    forall x : K, q656198_fadd x q656198_fzero = x;
  q656198_fneg_add :
    forall x : K,
      q656198_fadd (q656198_fneg x) x = q656198_fzero;
  q656198_fadd_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q656198_fadd x (q656198_fneg x) = q656198_fzero;
  q656198_fmul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q656198_fmul x (q656198_fmul y z) =
      q656198_fmul (q656198_fmul x y) z;
  q656198_fmul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q656198_fmul x y = q656198_fmul y x;
  q656198_fone_mul :
    forall x : K, q656198_fmul q656198_fone x = x;
  q656198_fmul_one :
    forall x : K, q656198_fmul x q656198_fone = x;
  q656198_fmul_add :
    forall x y z : K,
      q656198_fmul x (q656198_fadd y z) =
      q656198_fadd
        (q656198_fmul x y) (q656198_fmul x z);
  q656198_fadd_mul :
    forall x y z : K,
      q656198_fmul (q656198_fadd x y) z =
      q656198_fadd
        (q656198_fmul x z) (q656198_fmul y z);
  q656198_fzero_mul :
    forall x : K,
      q656198_fmul q656198_fzero x = q656198_fzero;
  q656198_fmul_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q656198_fmul x q656198_fzero = q656198_fzero;
  q656198_fzero_ne_one :
    q656198_fzero <> q656198_fone;
  q656198_finv_zero :
    q656198_finv q656198_fzero = q656198_fzero;
  q656198_finv_mul :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q656198_fzero ->
      q656198_fmul (q656198_finv x) x = q656198_fone;
  q656198_fmul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q656198_fzero ->
      q656198_fmul x (q656198_finv x) = q656198_fone
}.

Arguments q656198_fzero {K} _.
Arguments q656198_fone {K} _.
Arguments q656198_fadd {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q656198_fmul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q656198_fneg {K} _ _.
Arguments q656198_finv {K} _ _.

Fixpoint q656198_nat_cast
    {K : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q656198_fzero F
  | S m => q656198_fadd F (q656198_nat_cast F m) (q656198_fone F)
  end.

Record q656198_group (G : Type) : Type := {
  q656198_gone : G;
  q656198_gmul : G -> G -> G;
  q656198_ginv : G -> G;
  q656198_gmul_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q656198_gmul x (q656198_gmul y z) =
      q656198_gmul (q656198_gmul x y) z;
  q656198_gone_mul :
    forall x : G, q656198_gmul q656198_gone x = x;
  q656198_gmul_one :
    forall x : G, q656198_gmul x q656198_gone = x;
  q656198_ginv_mul :
    forall x : G,
      q656198_gmul (q656198_ginv x) x = q656198_gone;
  q656198_gmul_inv :
    forall x : G,
      q656198_gmul x (q656198_ginv x) = q656198_gone
}.

Arguments q656198_gone {G} _.
Arguments q656198_gmul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q656198_ginv {G} _ _.

Record q656198_finite_type (G : Type) : Type := {
  q656198_eq_dec :
    forall x y : G, {x = y} + {x <> y};
  q656198_enum : list G;
  q656198_enum_nodup :
    List.NoDup q656198_enum;
  q656198_enum_complete :
    forall x : G, List.In x q656198_enum
}.

Arguments q656198_eq_dec {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q656198_enum {G} _.

Definition q656198_group_algebra
    (K G : Type) : Type :=
  G -> K.

Definition q656198_ga_zero
    {K G : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K) :
    q656198_group_algebra K G :=
  fun _ => q656198_fzero F.

Definition q656198_ga_one
    {K G : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (T : q656198_finite_type G)
    (H : q656198_group G) :
    q656198_group_algebra K G :=
  fun x =>
    if q656198_eq_dec T x (q656198_gone H)
    then q656198_fone F
    else q656198_fzero F.

Definition q656198_ga_add
    {K G : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (u v : q656198_group_algebra K G) :
    q656198_group_algebra K G :=
  fun x => q656198_fadd F (u x) (v x).

Definition q656198_ga_neg
    {K G : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (u : q656198_group_algebra K G) :
    q656198_group_algebra K G :=
  fun x => q656198_fneg F (u x).

Fixpoint q656198_sum
    {K G : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (xs : list G)
    (term : G -> K) : K :=
  match xs with
  | nil => q656198_fzero F
  | cons x rest =>
      q656198_fadd F (term x) (q656198_sum F rest term)
  end.

Definition q656198_ga_mul
    {K G : Type}
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (T : q656198_finite_type G)
    (H : q656198_group G)
    (u v : q656198_group_algebra K G) :
    q656198_group_algebra K G :=
  fun x =>
    q656198_sum F (q656198_enum T)
      (fun a =>
        q656198_fmul F
          (u a)
          (v (q656198_gmul H (q656198_ginv H a) x))).

Record q656198_module
    (K G V : Type)
    (F : q656198_field K)
    (T : q656198_finite_type G)
    (H : q656198_group G) : Type := {
  q656198_mzero : V;
  q656198_madd : V -> V -> V;
  q656198_mneg : V -> V;
  q656198_smul :
    q656198_group_algebra K G -> V -> V;
  q656198_madd_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q656198_madd x (q656198_madd y z) =
      q656198_madd (q656198_madd x y) z;
  q656198_madd_comm :
    forall x y : V,
      q656198_madd x y = q656198_madd y x;
  q656198_mzero_add :
    forall x : V, q656198_madd q656198_mzero x = x;
  q656198_madd_zero :
    forall x : V, q656198_madd x q656198_mzero = x;
  q656198_mneg_add :
    forall x : V,
      q656198_madd (q656198_mneg x) x = q656198_mzero;
  q656198_madd_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q656198_madd x (q656198_mneg x) = q656198_mzero;
  q656198_one_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q656198_smul (q656198_ga_one F T H) x = x;
  q656198_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : q656198_group_algebra K G) (x : V),
      q656198_smul (q656198_ga_mul F T H a b) x =
      q656198_smul a (q656198_smul b x);
  q656198_add_smul :
    forall (a b : q656198_group_algebra K G) (x : V),
      q656198_smul (q656198_ga_add F a b) x =
      q656198_madd (q656198_smul a x) (q656198_smul b x);
  q656198_smul_add :
    forall (a : q656198_group_algebra K G) (x y : V),
      q656198_smul a (q656198_madd x y) =
      q656198_madd (q656198_smul a x) (q656198_smul a y);
  q656198_zero_smul :
    forall x : V,
      q656198_smul (q656198_ga_zero F) x = q656198_mzero;
  q656198_smul_zero :
    forall a : q656198_group_algebra K G,
      q656198_smul a q656198_mzero = q656198_mzero
}.

Arguments q656198_module (K G V) F T H : clear implicits.
Arguments q656198_mzero {K G V F T H} _.
Arguments q656198_madd {K G V F T H} _ _ _.
Arguments q656198_mneg {K G V F T H} _ _.
Arguments q656198_smul {K G V F T H} _ _ _.

Record q656198_submodule
    {K G V : Type}
    {F : q656198_field K}
    {T : q656198_finite_type G}
    {H : q656198_group G}
    (M : q656198_module K G V F T H) : Type := {
  q656198_submodule_mem : V -> Prop;
  q656198_submodule_zero :
    q656198_submodule_mem (q656198_mzero M);
  q656198_submodule_add :
    forall x y : V,
      q656198_submodule_mem x ->
      q656198_submodule_mem y ->
      q656198_submodule_mem (q656198_madd M x y);
  q656198_submodule_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q656198_submodule_mem x ->
      q656198_submodule_mem (q656198_mneg M x);
  q656198_submodule_smul :
    forall (a : q656198_group_algebra K G) (x : V),
      q656198_submodule_mem x ->
      q656198_submodule_mem (q656198_smul M a x)
}.

Arguments q656198_submodule_mem {K G V F T H M} _ _.

Definition q656198_are_complements
    {K G V : Type}
    {F : q656198_field K}
    {T : q656198_finite_type G}
    {H : q656198_group G}
    {M : q656198_module K G V F T H}
    (P Q : q656198_submodule M) : Prop :=
  (forall x : V,
    q656198_submodule_mem P x ->
    q656198_submodule_mem Q x ->
    x = q656198_mzero M) /\
  (forall x : V,
    exists p q : V,
      q656198_submodule_mem P p /\
      q656198_submodule_mem Q q /\
      x = q656198_madd M p q).

Theorem MonoidAlgebra_Submodule_exists_isCompl :
  forall (K G V : Type)
         (F : q656198_field K)
         (T : q656198_finite_type G)
         (H : q656198_group G)
         (M : q656198_module K G V F T H)
         (P : q656198_submodule M),
    q656198_nat_cast F (List.length (q656198_enum T)) <>
      q656198_fzero F ->
    exists Q : q656198_submodule M,
      q656198_are_complements P Q.
Admitted.

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656198
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q656198), "Maschke's theorem": for a finite
  group over a field in which the group cardinality is nonzero, every
  submodule of a module over the group algebra has a complementary submodule.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
  imports Main
begin

definition q656198_group_algebra_zero ::
    "'g \<Rightarrow> 'k::field" where
  "q656198_group_algebra_zero = (\<lambda>_. 0)"

definition q656198_group_algebra_one ::
    "'g::{finite,group_add} \<Rightarrow> 'k::field" where
  "q656198_group_algebra_one =
    (\<lambda>g. if g = 0 then 1 else 0)"

definition q656198_group_algebra_add ::
    "('g \<Rightarrow> 'k::field) \<Rightarrow> ('g \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow>
      'g \<Rightarrow> 'k" where
  "q656198_group_algebra_add a b = (\<lambda>g. a g + b g)"

definition q656198_group_algebra_mul ::
    "('g::{finite,group_add} \<Rightarrow> 'k::field) \<Rightarrow>
      ('g \<Rightarrow> 'k) \<Rightarrow> 'g \<Rightarrow> 'k" where
  "q656198_group_algebra_mul a b =
    (\<lambda>x. \<Sum>g\<in>UNIV. a g * b (-g + x))"

definition q656198_group_algebra_module ::
    "(('g::{finite,group_add} \<Rightarrow> 'k::field) \<Rightarrow>
      'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q656198_group_algebra_module smul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>v. smul q656198_group_algebra_one v = v) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b v.
      smul (q656198_group_algebra_mul a b) v = smul a (smul b v)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b v.
      smul (q656198_group_algebra_add a b) v = smul a v + smul b v) \<and>
    (\<forall>a v w. smul a (v + w) = smul a v + smul a w) \<and>
    (\<forall>v. smul q656198_group_algebra_zero v = 0) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. smul a 0 = 0)"

definition q656198_submodule ::
    "(('g::{finite,group_add} \<Rightarrow> 'k::field) \<Rightarrow>
      'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v) \<Rightarrow> 'v set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q656198_submodule smul P \<longleftrightarrow>
    0 \<in> P \<and>
    (\<forall>v\<in>P. -v \<in> P) \<and>
    (\<forall>v\<in>P. \<forall>w\<in>P. v + w \<in> P) \<and>
    (\<forall>a. \<forall>v\<in>P. smul a v \<in> P)"

definition q656198_are_complements ::
    "'v::ab_group_add set \<Rightarrow> 'v set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q656198_are_complements P Q \<longleftrightarrow>
    P \<inter> Q = {0} \<and>
    (\<forall>v. \<exists>p\<in>P. \<exists>q\<in>Q. v = p + q)"

theorem q656198_maschke_s_theorem:
  fixes smul ::
      "('g::{finite,group_add} \<Rightarrow> 'k::field) \<Rightarrow>
        'v::ab_group_add \<Rightarrow> 'v"
    and P :: "'v set"
  assumes cardinality_nonzero:
      "(of_nat (card (UNIV :: 'g set)) :: 'k) \<noteq> 0"
    and module:
      "q656198_group_algebra_module smul"
    and submodule:
      "q656198_submodule smul P"
  shows "\<exists>Q.
    q656198_submodule smul Q \<and>
    q656198_are_complements P Q"
  sorry

end
