(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656198
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q656198), "Maschke's theorem": for a finite
  group and a field in which the group order is nonzero, every submodule of a
  module over the group algebra has a complementary submodule. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q656198_MASCHKES_THEOREM =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k)
      (mulK:'k->'k->'k) (negK:'k->'k) (invK:'k->'k).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!a:'k. addK zeroK a = a) /\
       (!a:'k. addK (negK a) a = zeroK) /\
       (!a b:'k. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a b c:'k. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
       (!a:'k. mulK oneK a = a) /\
       (!a b:'k. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a b c:'k. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
       (!a b c:'k.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!a:'k. ~(a = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK a) a = oneK) in
   let is_group =
     \(idG:'g) (mulG:'g->'g->'g) (invG:'g->'g).
       (!g:'g. mulG idG g = g /\ mulG g idG = g) /\
       (!g:'g.
          mulG (invG g) g = idG /\ mulG g (invG g) = idG) /\
       (!g h j:'g.
          mulG (mulG g h) j = mulG g (mulG h j)) in
   let algebra_zero =
     \(zeroK:'k). \g:'g. zeroK in
   let algebra_one =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (idG:'g).
       \g:'g. if g = idG then oneK else zeroK in
   let algebra_add =
     \(addK:'k->'k->'k) (a:'g->'k) (b:'g->'k).
       \g:'g. addK (a g) (b g) in
   let algebra_neg =
     \(negK:'k->'k) (a:'g->'k).
       \g:'g. negK (a g) in
   let algebra_mul =
     \(zeroK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k) (mulK:'k->'k->'k)
      (mulG:'g->'g->'g) (invG:'g->'g)
      (a:'g->'k) (b:'g->'k).
       \x:'g.
         iterate addK (UNIV:'g->bool)
           (\g:'g. mulK (a g) (b (mulG (invG g) x))) in
   let is_add_comm_group =
     \(zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v) (negV:'v->'v).
       (!v:'v. addV zeroV v = v) /\
       (!v:'v. addV (negV v) v = zeroV) /\
       (!v w:'v. addV v w = addV w v) /\
       (!u v w:'v. addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)) in
   let is_group_algebra_module =
     \(zeroK:'k) (oneK:'k) (addK:'k->'k->'k)
      (mulK:'k->'k->'k) (negK:'k->'k)
      (idG:'g) (mulG:'g->'g->'g) (invG:'g->'g)
      (zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v)
      (smul:('g->'k)->'v->'v).
       let zeroA = algebra_zero zeroK in
       let oneA = algebra_one zeroK oneK idG in
       let addA = algebra_add addK in
       let mulA = algebra_mul zeroK addK mulK mulG invG in
       (!v:'v. smul oneA v = v) /\
       (!a b:'g->'k. !v:'v.
          smul (mulA a b) v = smul a (smul b v)) /\
       (!a b:'g->'k. !v:'v.
          smul (addA a b) v = addV (smul a v) (smul b v)) /\
       (!a:'g->'k. !v w:'v.
          smul a (addV v w) = addV (smul a v) (smul a w)) /\
       (!v:'v. smul zeroA v = zeroV) /\
       (!a:'g->'k. smul a zeroV = zeroV) in
   let is_submodule =
     \(zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v) (negV:'v->'v)
      (smul:('g->'k)->'v->'v) (p:'v->bool).
       p zeroV /\
       (!v w:'v. p v /\ p w ==> p (addV v w)) /\
       (!v:'v. p v ==> p (negV v)) /\
       (!a:'g->'k. !v:'v. p v ==> p (smul a v)) in
   let are_complements =
     \(zeroV:'v) (addV:'v->'v->'v)
      (p:'v->bool) (q:'v->bool).
       (!v:'v. (p v /\ q v) <=> v = zeroV) /\
       (!v:'v.
          ?vp vq:'v.
            p vp /\ q vq /\ v = addV vp vq) in
   !zeroK oneK:'k.
   !addK mulK:'k->'k->'k.
   !negK invK:'k->'k.
   !idG:'g.
   !mulG:'g->'g->'g.
   !invG:'g->'g.
   !zeroV:'v.
   !addV:'v->'v->'v.
   !negV:'v->'v.
   !smul:('g->'k)->'v->'v.
   !p:'v->bool.
     is_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     FINITE (UNIV:'g->bool) /\
     is_group idG mulG invG /\
     ~(ITLIST addK
         (REPLICATE (CARD (UNIV:'g->bool)) oneK) zeroK = zeroK) /\
     is_add_comm_group zeroV addV negV /\
     is_group_algebra_module
       zeroK oneK addK mulK negK idG mulG invG zeroV addV smul /\
     is_submodule zeroV addV negV smul p
     ==> ?q:'v->bool.
           is_submodule zeroV addV negV smul q /\
           are_complements zeroV addV p q`;;

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656198,
;; "Maschke's theorem": over a field in which the order of a finite group is
;; nonzero, every submodule of a module over the group algebra has a
;; complementary submodule. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative tag-indexed interfaces represent arbitrary fields, groups,
;; modules, and submodules. The tags do not supply laws: every required
;; algebraic, typing, closure, and finiteness condition is explicit below.

(defstub q656198-field-element-p (field value) t)
(defstub q656198-field-zero (field) t)
(defstub q656198-field-one (field) t)
(defstub q656198-field-add (field left right) t)
(defstub q656198-field-multiply (field left right) t)
(defstub q656198-field-negate (field value) t)
(defstub q656198-field-inverse (field value) t)

(defstub q656198-group-element-p (group value) t)
(defstub q656198-group-identity (group) t)
(defstub q656198-group-multiply (group left right) t)
(defstub q656198-group-inverse (group value) t)

(defstub q656198-module-element-p (field group module value) t)
(defstub q656198-module-zero (field group module) t)
(defstub q656198-module-add (field group module left right) t)
(defstub q656198-module-negate (field group module value) t)
(defstub q656198-module-smul
  (field group module group-algebra-element value)
  t)

(defstub q656198-submodule-member-p
  (field group module submodule value)
  t)

;; Field structure.

(defun-sk q656198-field-laws-p (field)
  (forall
   (x y z)
   (implies
    (and (q656198-field-element-p field x)
         (q656198-field-element-p field y)
         (q656198-field-element-p field z))
    (and
     (q656198-field-element-p
      field
      (q656198-field-add field x y))
     (q656198-field-element-p
      field
      (q656198-field-multiply field x y))
     (q656198-field-element-p
      field
      (q656198-field-negate field x))
     (q656198-field-element-p
      field
      (q656198-field-inverse field x))
     (equal (q656198-field-add
             field
             (q656198-field-add field x y)
             z)
            (q656198-field-add
             field
             x
             (q656198-field-add field y z)))
     (equal (q656198-field-add field x y)
            (q656198-field-add field y x))
     (equal (q656198-field-add
             field
             (q656198-field-zero field)
             x)
            x)
     (equal (q656198-field-add
             field
             x
             (q656198-field-zero field))
            x)
     (equal (q656198-field-add
             field
             (q656198-field-negate field x)
             x)
            (q656198-field-zero field))
     (equal (q656198-field-add
             field
             x
             (q656198-field-negate field x))
            (q656198-field-zero field))
     (equal (q656198-field-multiply
             field
             (q656198-field-multiply field x y)
             z)
            (q656198-field-multiply
             field
             x
             (q656198-field-multiply field y z)))
     (equal (q656198-field-multiply field x y)
            (q656198-field-multiply field y x))
     (equal (q656198-field-multiply
             field
             (q656198-field-one field)
             x)
            x)
     (equal (q656198-field-multiply
             field
             x
             (q656198-field-one field))
            x)
     (equal (q656198-field-multiply
             field
             (q656198-field-zero field)
             x)
            (q656198-field-zero field))
     (equal (q656198-field-multiply
             field
             x
             (q656198-field-zero field))
            (q656198-field-zero field))
     (equal (q656198-field-inverse
             field
             (q656198-field-zero field))
            (q656198-field-zero field))
     (implies
      (not (equal x (q656198-field-zero field)))
      (and
       (equal (q656198-field-multiply
               field
               (q656198-field-inverse field x)
               x)
              (q656198-field-one field))
       (equal (q656198-field-multiply
               field
               x
               (q656198-field-inverse field x))
              (q656198-field-one field))))
     (equal
      (q656198-field-multiply
       field
       x
       (q656198-field-add field y z))
      (q656198-field-add
       field
       (q656198-field-multiply field x y)
       (q656198-field-multiply field x z)))
     (equal
      (q656198-field-multiply
       field
       (q656198-field-add field x y)
       z)
      (q656198-field-add
       field
       (q656198-field-multiply field x z)
       (q656198-field-multiply field y z)))))))

(defun q656198-field-p (field)
  (and
   (q656198-field-element-p field (q656198-field-zero field))
   (q656198-field-element-p field (q656198-field-one field))
   (not (equal (q656198-field-zero field)
               (q656198-field-one field)))
   (q656198-field-laws-p field)))

;; Finite group structure. GROUP-ELEMENTS is an exact duplicate-free
;; enumeration of the otherwise arbitrary tag-indexed group carrier.

(defun-sk q656198-group-carrier-exact-p (group group-elements)
  (forall
   (x)
   (iff
    (q656198-group-element-p group x)
    (if (member-equal x group-elements) t nil))))

(defun-sk q656198-group-laws-p (group)
  (forall
   (x y z)
   (implies
    (and (q656198-group-element-p group x)
         (q656198-group-element-p group y)
         (q656198-group-element-p group z))
    (and
     (q656198-group-element-p
      group
      (q656198-group-multiply group x y))
     (q656198-group-element-p
      group
      (q656198-group-inverse group x))
     (equal
      (q656198-group-multiply
       group
       (q656198-group-multiply group x y)
       z)
      (q656198-group-multiply
       group
       x
       (q656198-group-multiply group y z)))
     (equal
      (q656198-group-multiply
       group
       (q656198-group-identity group)
       x)
      x)
     (equal
      (q656198-group-multiply
       group
       x
       (q656198-group-identity group))
      x)
     (equal
      (q656198-group-multiply
       group
       (q656198-group-inverse group x)
       x)
      (q656198-group-identity group))
     (equal
      (q656198-group-multiply
       group
       x
       (q656198-group-inverse group x))
      (q656198-group-identity group))))))

(defun q656198-finite-group-p (group group-elements)
  (and
   (true-listp group-elements)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal group-elements)
   (q656198-group-carrier-exact-p group group-elements)
   (q656198-group-element-p
    group
    (q656198-group-identity group))
   (q656198-group-laws-p group)))

;; The characteristic condition is the nonvanishing of the field-valued
;; natural-number cast of the finite group's cardinality.

(defun q656198-field-nat-cast (field n)
  (if (zp n)
      (q656198-field-zero field)
    (q656198-field-add
     field
     (q656198-field-one field)
     (q656198-field-nat-cast field (1- n)))))

(defun q656198-cardinality-nonzero-p (field group-elements)
  (not
   (equal
    (q656198-field-nat-cast field (len group-elements))
    (q656198-field-zero field))))

;; Since the group is finite, a group-algebra element is represented exactly
;; by its coefficient list in GROUP-ELEMENTS order.

(defun q656198-all-field-elements-p (field values)
  (if (endp values)
      t
    (and
     (q656198-field-element-p field (car values))
     (q656198-all-field-elements-p field (cdr values)))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-element-p
    (field group-elements coefficients)
  (and
   (true-listp coefficients)
   (equal (len coefficients) (len group-elements))
   (q656198-all-field-elements-p field coefficients)))

(defun q656198-coefficient
    (field group-element group-elements coefficients)
  (if (or (endp group-elements)
          (endp coefficients))
      (q656198-field-zero field)
    (if (equal group-element (car group-elements))
        (car coefficients)
      (q656198-coefficient
       field
       group-element
       (cdr group-elements)
       (cdr coefficients)))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-zero (field group-elements)
  (if (endp group-elements)
      nil
    (cons
     (q656198-field-zero field)
     (q656198-group-algebra-zero field (cdr group-elements)))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-one (field group group-elements)
  (if (endp group-elements)
      nil
    (cons
     (if (equal (car group-elements)
                (q656198-group-identity group))
         (q656198-field-one field)
       (q656198-field-zero field))
     (q656198-group-algebra-one
      field
      group
      (cdr group-elements)))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-add (field left right)
  (if (or (endp left) (endp right))
      nil
    (cons
     (q656198-field-add field (car left) (car right))
     (q656198-group-algebra-add
      field
      (cdr left)
      (cdr right)))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-negate (field coefficients)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (cons
     (q656198-field-negate field (car coefficients))
     (q656198-group-algebra-negate
      field
      (cdr coefficients)))))

(defun q656198-convolution-coefficient
    (field group target summands group-elements left right)
  (if (endp summands)
      (q656198-field-zero field)
    (q656198-field-add
     field
     (q656198-field-multiply
      field
      (q656198-coefficient
       field
       (car summands)
       group-elements
       left)
      (q656198-coefficient
       field
       (q656198-group-multiply
        group
        (q656198-group-inverse group (car summands))
        target)
       group-elements
       right))
     (q656198-convolution-coefficient
      field
      group
      target
      (cdr summands)
      group-elements
      left
      right))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-multiply-aux
    (field group targets group-elements left right)
  (if (endp targets)
      nil
    (cons
     (q656198-convolution-coefficient
      field
      group
      (car targets)
      group-elements
      group-elements
      left
      right)
     (q656198-group-algebra-multiply-aux
      field
      group
      (cdr targets)
      group-elements
      left
      right))))

(defun q656198-group-algebra-multiply
    (field group group-elements left right)
  (q656198-group-algebra-multiply-aux
   field
   group
   group-elements
   group-elements
   left
   right))

;; An arbitrary additive commutative group equipped with a left action of the
;; represented group algebra. All module axioms are explicit.

(defun-sk q656198-module-laws-p
    (field group group-elements module)
  (forall
   (a b u v w)
   (implies
    (and
     (q656198-group-algebra-element-p
      field group-elements a)
     (q656198-group-algebra-element-p
      field group-elements b)
     (q656198-module-element-p field group module u)
     (q656198-module-element-p field group module v)
     (q656198-module-element-p field group module w))
    (and
     (q656198-module-element-p
      field
      group
      module
      (q656198-module-add field group module u v))
     (q656198-module-element-p
      field
      group
      module
      (q656198-module-negate field group module u))
     (q656198-module-element-p
      field
      group
      module
      (q656198-module-smul field group module a u))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-module-add field group module u v)
       w)
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       u
       (q656198-module-add field group module v w)))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-add field group module u v)
      (q656198-module-add field group module v u))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-module-zero field group module)
       u)
      u)
     (equal
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       u
       (q656198-module-zero field group module))
      u)
     (equal
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-module-negate field group module u)
       u)
      (q656198-module-zero field group module))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       u
       (q656198-module-negate field group module u))
      (q656198-module-zero field group module))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-group-algebra-one field group group-elements)
       u)
      u)
     (equal
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-group-algebra-zero field group-elements)
       u)
      (q656198-module-zero field group module))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       a
       (q656198-module-zero field group module))
      (q656198-module-zero field group module))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       a
       (q656198-module-add field group module u v))
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-module-smul field group module a u)
       (q656198-module-smul field group module a v)))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-group-algebra-add field a b)
       u)
      (q656198-module-add
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-module-smul field group module a u)
       (q656198-module-smul field group module b u)))
     (equal
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       (q656198-group-algebra-multiply
        field group group-elements a b)
       u)
      (q656198-module-smul
       field
       group
       module
       a
       (q656198-module-smul field group module b u)))))))

(defun q656198-module-p (field group group-elements module)
  (and
   (q656198-module-element-p
    field
    group
    module
    (q656198-module-zero field group module))
   (q656198-module-laws-p
    field group group-elements module)))

;; A submodule is an arbitrary internally tagged predicate on the module,
;; closed under zero, addition, negation, and every group-algebra scalar.

(defun-sk q656198-submodule-laws-p
    (field group group-elements module submodule)
  (forall
   (a u v)
   (implies
    (and
     (q656198-group-algebra-element-p
      field group-elements a)
     (q656198-submodule-member-p
      field group module submodule u)
     (q656198-submodule-member-p
      field group module submodule v))
    (and
     (q656198-module-element-p field group module u)
     (q656198-module-element-p field group module v)
     (q656198-submodule-member-p
      field
      group
      module
      submodule
      (q656198-module-add field group module u v))
     (q656198-submodule-member-p
      field
      group
      module
      submodule
      (q656198-module-negate field group module u))
     (q656198-submodule-member-p
      field
      group
      module
      submodule
      (q656198-module-smul field group module a u))))))

(defun q656198-submodule-p
    (field group group-elements module submodule)
  (and
   (q656198-submodule-member-p
    field
    group
    module
    submodule
    (q656198-module-zero field group module))
   (q656198-submodule-laws-p
    field group group-elements module submodule)))

;; The existential witnesses for a sum decomposition, and the complement
;; submodule itself, remain internal to the translated statement.

(defun-sk q656198-sum-representation-p
    (field group module left-submodule right-submodule value)
  (exists
   (left-value right-value)
   (and
    (q656198-submodule-member-p
     field group module left-submodule left-value)
    (q656198-submodule-member-p
     field group module right-submodule right-value)
    (equal
     (q656198-module-add
      field group module left-value right-value)
     value))))

(defun-sk q656198-complement-laws-p
    (field group module submodule complement)
  (forall
   (x)
   (and
    (implies
     (and
      (q656198-submodule-member-p
       field group module submodule x)
      (q656198-submodule-member-p
       field group module complement x))
     (equal x (q656198-module-zero field group module)))
    (implies
     (q656198-module-element-p field group module x)
     (q656198-sum-representation-p
      field group module submodule complement x)))))

(defun q656198-is-complement-p
    (field group group-elements module submodule complement)
  (and
   (q656198-submodule-p
    field group group-elements module complement)
   (q656198-complement-laws-p
    field group module submodule complement)))

(defun-sk q656198-complement-exists-p
    (field group group-elements module submodule)
  (exists
   (complement)
   (q656198-is-complement-p
    field group group-elements module submodule complement)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q656198-maschke-s-theorem-statement ()
  (forall
   (field group group-elements module submodule)
   (implies
    (and
     (q656198-field-p field)
     (q656198-finite-group-p group group-elements)
     (q656198-cardinality-nonzero-p field group-elements)
     (q656198-module-p field group group-elements module)
     (q656198-submodule-p
      field group group-elements module submodule))
    (q656198-complement-exists-p
     field group group-elements module submodule))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656198,
-- "Maschke's theorem": for a finite group over a field in which the group
-- cardinality is nonzero, every invariant subspace of a linear representation
-- has an invariant direct complement. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q656198_maschke_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
  renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Empty : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not A =
  A → Empty

infix 4 _≠_

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  A →
  A →
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (sucN n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (sucN n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A → B
    from    : B → A
    from-to : (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from : (y : B) → to (from y) ≡ y

record FiniteCard
  {g : Level}
  (G : Set g) :
  Set g where

  field
    cardinality : Nat
    equivalence : Bijection G (Fin cardinality)

record Group
  {g : Level}
  (G : Set g) :
  Set g where

  field
    identity : G
    inverse : G → G
    multiply : G → G → G

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : G) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    identity-left :
      (x : G) →
      multiply identity x ≡ x
    identity-right :
      (x : G) →
      multiply x identity ≡ x
    inverse-left :
      (x : G) →
      multiply (inverse x) x ≡ identity
    inverse-right :
      (x : G) →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ identity

record Field
  {k : Level}
  (K : Set k) :
  Set k where

  field
    zero one : K
    add multiply : K → K → K
    negate inverse : K → K

    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : K) →
      add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : K) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : K) →
      add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : K) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡
      multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) →
      multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : K) →
      multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : K) →
      multiply x one ≡ x
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : K) →
      multiply zero x ≡ zero
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : K) →
      multiply x zero ≡ zero

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡
      add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : K) →
      multiply (add x y) z ≡
      add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)

    zero-not-one :
      zero ≠ one
    inverse-zero :
      inverse zero ≡ zero
    inverse-left :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ zero →
      multiply (inverse x) x ≡ one
    inverse-right :
      (x : K) →
      x ≠ zero →
      multiply x (inverse x) ≡ one

natCast :
  {k : Level} →
  {K : Set k} →
  Field K →
  Nat →
  K
natCast scalarField zeroN =
  Field.zero scalarField
natCast scalarField (sucN n) =
  Field.add
    scalarField
    (natCast scalarField n)
    (Field.one scalarField)

record AdditiveCommutativeGroup
  {v : Level}
  (V : Set v) :
  Set v where

  field
    zero : V
    add : V → V → V
    negate : V → V

    add-associative :
      (x y z : V) →
      add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : V) →
      add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : V) →
      add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : V) →
      add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : V) →
      add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : V) →
      add x (negate x) ≡ zero

record VectorSpace
  {k v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {V : Set v}
  (scalarField : Field K)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) :
  Set (k ⊔ v) where

  field
    scale : K → V → V

    one-scale :
      (x : V) →
      scale (Field.one scalarField) x ≡ x
    multiply-scale :
      (a b : K) →
      (x : V) →
      scale (Field.multiply scalarField a b) x ≡
      scale a (scale b x)
    add-scale :
      (a b : K) →
      (x : V) →
      scale (Field.add scalarField a b) x ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale b x)
    scale-add :
      (a : K) →
      (x y : V) →
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive x y) ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive
        (scale a x)
        (scale a y)
    zero-scale :
      (x : V) →
      scale (Field.zero scalarField) x ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive
    scale-zero :
      (a : K) →
      scale a (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive) ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive

record Representation
  {k g v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {G : Set g}
  {V : Set v}
  (scalarField : Field K)
  (group : Group G)
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V)
  (space : VectorSpace scalarField additive) :
  Set (k ⊔ g ⊔ v) where

  field
    act : G → V → V

    identity-act :
      (x : V) →
      act (Group.identity group) x ≡ x
    multiply-act :
      (g h : G) →
      (x : V) →
      act (Group.multiply group g h) x ≡
      act g (act h x)
    act-zero :
      (g : G) →
      act g (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive) ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive
    act-add :
      (g : G) →
      (x y : V) →
      act g (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive x y) ≡
      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive
        (act g x)
        (act g y)
    act-scale :
      (g : G) →
      (a : K) →
      (x : V) →
      act g (VectorSpace.scale space a x) ≡
      VectorSpace.scale space a (act g x)

record InvariantSubspace
  {k g v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {G : Set g}
  {V : Set v}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {group : Group G}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V}
  {space : VectorSpace scalarField additive}
  (representation : Representation scalarField group additive space) :
  Set (k ⊔ g ⊔ lsuc v) where

  field
    member : V → Set v
    membership-propositional :
      (x : V) →
      (u w : member x) →
      u ≡ w
    contains-zero :
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : V) →
      member x →
      member y →
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : V) →
      member x →
      member (AdditiveCommutativeGroup.negate additive x)
    closed-under-scaling :
      (a : K) →
      (x : V) →
      member x →
      member (VectorSpace.scale space a x)
    invariant :
      (g : G) →
      (x : V) →
      member x →
      member (Representation.act representation g x)

record DirectComplement
  {k g v : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {G : Set g}
  {V : Set v}
  {scalarField : Field K}
  {group : Group G}
  {additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V}
  {space : VectorSpace scalarField additive}
  {representation : Representation scalarField group additive space}
  (left right : InvariantSubspace representation) :
  Set (k ⊔ g ⊔ v) where

  field
    intersection-zero :
      (x : V) →
      InvariantSubspace.member left x →
      InvariantSubspace.member right x →
      x ≡ AdditiveCommutativeGroup.zero additive
    spans :
      (x : V) →
      Σ V
        (λ left-part →
          Σ (InvariantSubspace.member left left-part)
            (λ _ →
              Σ V
                (λ right-part →
                  Σ (InvariantSubspace.member right right-part)
                    (λ _ →
                      x ≡
                      AdditiveCommutativeGroup.add additive
                        left-part
                        right-part))))

maschke-s-theorem : Setω
maschke-s-theorem =
  ∀ {k g v : Level} →
  (K : Set k) →
  (scalarField : Field K) →
  (G : Set g) →
  (group : Group G) →
  (finite : FiniteCard G) →
  natCast scalarField (FiniteCard.cardinality finite) ≠
    Field.zero scalarField →
  (V : Set v) →
  (additive : AdditiveCommutativeGroup V) →
  (space : VectorSpace scalarField additive) →
  (representation : Representation scalarField group additive space) →
  (p : InvariantSubspace representation) →
  Σ (InvariantSubspace representation)
    (λ q → DirectComplement p q)

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q656198, "Maschke's theorem": over a field in which the order of a finite
  group is nonzero, every invariant subspace of a linear group action has an
  invariant complementary subspace. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinTheory pred_setTheory;

val q656198_field_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_field_def",
  ``q656198_field
      (kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k) (kinv : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      kzero <> kone /\
      (!a b. kadd a b = kadd b a) /\
      (!a b c. kadd (kadd a b) c = kadd a (kadd b c)) /\
      (!a. kadd kzero a = a) /\
      (!a. kadd (kneg a) a = kzero) /\
      (!a b. kmul a b = kmul b a) /\
      (!a b c. kmul (kmul a b) c = kmul a (kmul b c)) /\
      (!a. kmul kone a = a) /\
      (!a b c. kmul a (kadd b c) = kadd (kmul a b) (kmul a c)) /\
      kinv kzero = kzero /\
      (!a. a <> kzero ==> kmul (kinv a) a = kone)``);

val q656198_group_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_group_def",
  ``q656198_group
      (gid : 'g) (gmul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (ginv : 'g -> 'g) <=>
      (!g h i. gmul (gmul g h) i = gmul g (gmul h i)) /\
      (!g. gmul gid g = g /\ gmul g gid = g) /\
      (!g. gmul (ginv g) g = gid /\ gmul g (ginv g) = gid)``);

val q656198_nat_cast_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_nat_cast_def",
  ``q656198_nat_cast
      (kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k) (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (kadd kone) n kzero``);

val q656198_vector_space_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_vector_space_def",
  ``q656198_vector_space
      (kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (vzero : 'v) (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (vneg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y. vadd x y = vadd y x) /\
      (!x y z. vadd (vadd x y) z = vadd x (vadd y z)) /\
      (!x. vadd vzero x = x) /\
      (!x. vadd (vneg x) x = vzero) /\
      (!x. smul kone x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (kmul a b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (kadd a b) x = vadd (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (vadd x y) = vadd (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul kzero x = vzero) /\
      (!a. smul a vzero = vzero)``);

val q656198_linear_group_action_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_linear_group_action_def",
  ``q656198_linear_group_action
      (gid : 'g) (gmul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v)
      (act : 'g -> 'v -> 'v) <=>
      (!x. act gid x = x) /\
      (!g h x. act (gmul g h) x = act g (act h x)) /\
      (!g x y. act g (vadd x y) = vadd (act g x) (act g y)) /\
      (!g a x. act g (smul a x) = smul a (act g x))``);

val q656198_invariant_subspace_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_invariant_subspace_def",
  ``q656198_invariant_subspace
      (vzero : 'v) (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (vneg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (act : 'g -> 'v -> 'v)
      (p : 'v -> bool) <=>
      p vzero /\
      (!x y. p x /\ p y ==> p (vadd x y)) /\
      (!x. p x ==> p (vneg x)) /\
      (!a x. p x ==> p (smul a x)) /\
      (!g x. p x ==> p (act g x))``);

val q656198_is_compl_def = new_definition (
  "q656198_is_compl_def",
  ``q656198_is_compl
      (vzero : 'v) (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (p : 'v -> bool) (q : 'v -> bool) <=>
      (!x. p x /\ q x ==> x = vzero) /\
      (!x. ?y z. p y /\ q z /\ x = vadd y z)``);

val MonoidAlgebra_Submodule_exists_isCompl =
  ``!(kzero : 'k) (kone : 'k)
      (kadd : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (kmul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (kneg : 'k -> 'k) (kinv : 'k -> 'k)
      (gid : 'g) (gmul : 'g -> 'g -> 'g) (ginv : 'g -> 'g)
      (vzero : 'v) (vadd : 'v -> 'v -> 'v) (vneg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : 'k -> 'v -> 'v) (act : 'g -> 'v -> 'v)
      (p : 'v -> bool).
      q656198_field kzero kone kadd kmul kneg kinv /\
      q656198_group gid gmul ginv /\
      FINITE (UNIV : 'g set) /\
      q656198_nat_cast kzero kone kadd (CARD (UNIV : 'g set)) <> kzero /\
      q656198_vector_space
        kzero kone kadd kmul vzero vadd vneg smul /\
      q656198_linear_group_action gid gmul vadd smul act /\
      q656198_invariant_subspace vzero vadd vneg smul act p
      ==>
      ?q : 'v -> bool.
        q656198_invariant_subspace vzero vadd vneg smul act q /\
        q656198_is_compl vzero vadd p q``;

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656198
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q656198), "Maschke's theorem": over a field
  whose characteristic does not annihilate the order of a finite group, every
  submodule of every module over the corresponding group algebra has a
  complementary submodule. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  K is an arbitrary SetMM field and G an arbitrary finite SetMM group.
  SetMM's ( K MndRing G ) is the finitely-supported function ring on Base G
  with convolution, exactly the group algebra K[G]. Q656198NatCast is the
  repeated-addition natural-number cast into K, so its nonvanishing at the
  finite cardinality of Base G is precisely the source NeZero assumption.

  M ranges over arbitrary left modules whose scalar ring is K MndRing G.
  P and Q range over their actual linear subspaces. The complement condition
  says their intersection is the zero submodule and every vector is a sum of
  one vector from each; this is bidirectionally equivalent to IsCompl P Q in
  the submodule lattice.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus statement. The preceding
  declarations are syntax and a faithful definition, and this database
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q656198NatCast $.

q656198-natural-cast-syntax
  $a class ( Q656198NatCast K N ) $.

q656198-natural-cast-definition $a |-
  ( Q656198NatCast K N )
  =
  ( N ( .g ` K ) ( 1r ` K ) )
$.

${
  $d G K M N P Q m p q $.

  thousand-theorems-q656198-maschke-s-theorem $a |- (
    A. K A. G
      (
        (
          K e. Field
          /\
          G e. Grp
          /\
          ( Base ` G ) e. Fin
          /\
          (
            Q656198NatCast K ( # ` ( Base ` G ) )
          ) =/= ( 0g ` K )
        )
        ->
        A. M
          (
            (
              M e. LMod
              /\
              ( Scalar ` M ) = ( K MndRing G )
            )
            ->
            A. P e. ( LSubSp ` M )
              E. Q e. ( LSubSp ` M )
                (
                  ( P i^i Q ) = { ( 0g ` M ) }
                  /\
                  A. m e. ( Base ` M )
                    E. p e. P E. q e. Q
                      m = ( p ( +g ` M ) q )
                )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656198
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q656198), "Maschke's theorem": for a finite
:: group acting linearly over a field in which the group order is nonzero,
:: every invariant subspace has an invariant direct-sum complement.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, NAT_1, ORDINAL1, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1,
      TARSKI, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, FINSET_1,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, GROUP_2, RLVECT_1, RLVECT_5,
      VECTSP_1, RLSUB_1, RLSUB_2, RING_3, INT_1, INT_2,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, SUPINF_2, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, RELAT_1,
      FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, NAT_1, CARD_1, FINSET_1,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, GROUP_1, GROUP_2, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1,
      RLSUB_1, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_5, RING_3, INT_1, INT_2;
 constructors RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, GROUP_2, VECTSP_1, RLSUB_1, VECTSP_4,
      VECTSP_5, RING_3, INT_1, INT_2, NAT_D;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1,
      FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, ORDINAL1, CARD_1, FINSET_1, NAT_1,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, GROUP_1, GROUP_2, VECTSP_1,
      RLSUB_1, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_5, RING_3, INT_1;
 requirements NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, VECTSP_5;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for K being Field,
      G being finite Group,
      V being VectSp of K,
      action being Function of
        [:the carrier of G,the carrier of V:],the carrier of V,
      P being Subspace of V
  st
    not Char K divides card G &
    (for v being Element of V holds action/.[1_G,v] = v) &
    (for g,h being Element of G, v being Element of V holds
      action/.[g*h,v] = action/.[g,action/.[h,v]]) &
    (for g being Element of G, v,w being Element of V holds
      action/.[g,v+w] = action/.[g,v] + action/.[g,w]) &
    (for g being Element of G, a being Element of K,
         v being Element of V holds
      action/.[g,a*v] = a*action/.[g,v]) &
    (for g being Element of G, v being Element of V st v in P holds
      action/.[g,v] in P)
  holds
    ex Q being Subspace of V st
      V is_the_direct_sum_of P,Q &
      for g being Element of G, v being Element of V st v in Q holds
        action/.[g,v] in Q
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q656198_maschke_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
% Q656198 (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q656198), "Maschke's theorem": over a
% field in which the order of a finite group is nonzero, every invariant
% subspace of a linear group action has an invariant direct complement.
% This file contains no proof.

Q656198_maschke_s_theorem[
  K, G, V: TYPE+,
  zero_K, one_K: K,
  neg_K, inv_K: [K -> K],
  add_K, mul_K: [K, K -> K],
  one_G: G,
  inv_G: [G -> G],
  mul_G: [G, G -> G],
  zero_V: V,
  neg_V: [V -> V],
  add_V: [V, V -> V],
  smul: [K, V -> V],
  action: [G, V -> V]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  IMPORTING finite_sets[G]

  v_set: TYPE = [V -> bool]

  field_laws: bool =
    zero_K /= one_K
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      add_K(a, b) = add_K(b, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
      add_K(add_K(a, b), c) =
        add_K(a, add_K(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K):
      add_K(zero_K, a) = a
        AND add_K(a, zero_K) = a)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K):
      add_K(neg_K(a), a) = zero_K
        AND add_K(a, neg_K(a)) = zero_K)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K):
      mul_K(a, b) = mul_K(b, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
      mul_K(mul_K(a, b), c) =
        mul_K(a, mul_K(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K):
      mul_K(one_K, a) = a
        AND mul_K(a, one_K) = a)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K):
      mul_K(zero_K, a) = zero_K
        AND mul_K(a, zero_K) = zero_K)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
      mul_K(a, add_K(b, c)) =
        add_K(mul_K(a, b), mul_K(a, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
      mul_K(add_K(a, b), c) =
        add_K(mul_K(a, c), mul_K(b, c)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K):
      a /= zero_K IMPLIES
        mul_K(a, inv_K(a)) = one_K
          AND mul_K(inv_K(a), a) = one_K)

  group_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (g, h, j: G):
      mul_G(mul_G(g, h), j) =
        mul_G(g, mul_G(h, j)))
      AND
    (FORALL (g: G):
      mul_G(one_G, g) = g
        AND mul_G(g, one_G) = g)
      AND
    (FORALL (g: G):
      mul_G(inv_G(g), g) = one_G
        AND mul_G(g, inv_G(g)) = one_G)

  nat_cast(n: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      zero_K
    ELSE
      add_K(nat_cast(n - 1), one_K)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  full_group_carrier(carrier: finite_set[G]): bool =
    FORALL (g: G): carrier(g)

  finite_group_order_nonzero: bool =
    EXISTS (carrier: finite_set[G]):
      full_group_carrier(carrier)
        AND nat_cast(card(carrier)) /= zero_K

  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V):
      add_V(u, v) = add_V(v, u))
      AND
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      add_V(add_V(u, v), w) =
        add_V(u, add_V(v, w)))
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      add_V(zero_V, v) = v
        AND add_V(v, zero_V) = v)
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      add_V(neg_V(v), v) = zero_V
        AND add_V(v, neg_V(v)) = zero_V)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K), (u, v: V):
      smul(a, add_V(u, v)) =
        add_V(smul(a, u), smul(a, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (v: V):
      smul(add_K(a, b), v) =
        add_V(smul(a, v), smul(b, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: K), (v: V):
      smul(mul_K(a, b), v) =
        smul(a, smul(b, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      smul(one_K, v) = v
        AND smul(zero_K, v) = zero_V)
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K):
      smul(a, zero_V) = zero_V)

  linear_group_action_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (v: V):
      action(one_G, v) = v)
      AND
    (FORALL (g, h: G), (v: V):
      action(mul_G(g, h), v) =
        action(g, action(h, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (g: G), (u, v: V):
      action(g, add_V(u, v)) =
        add_V(action(g, u), action(g, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (g: G), (a: K), (v: V):
      action(g, smul(a, v)) =
        smul(a, action(g, v)))

  is_invariant_subspace(S: v_set): bool =
    S(zero_V)
      AND
    (FORALL (u, v: V):
      S(u) AND S(v) IMPLIES S(add_V(u, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      S(v) IMPLIES S(neg_V(v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: K), (v: V):
      S(v) IMPLIES S(smul(a, v)))
      AND
    (FORALL (g: G), (v: V):
      S(v) IMPLIES S(action(g, v)))

  direct_invariant_complements(P, Q: v_set): bool =
    is_invariant_subspace(P)
      AND is_invariant_subspace(Q)
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      P(v) AND Q(v) IMPLIES v = zero_V)
      AND
    (FORALL (v: V):
      EXISTS (p, q: V):
        P(p) AND Q(q) AND v = add_V(p, q))

  maschke_s_theorem: bool =
    (field_laws
      AND group_laws
      AND finite_group_order_nonzero
      AND vector_space_laws
      AND linear_group_action_laws)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL (P: v_set):
        is_invariant_subspace(P) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (Q: v_set):
            direct_invariant_complements(P, Q))

END Q656198_maschke_s_theorem

title: Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656645
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q656645), "Hilbert's basis theorem": for an
  arbitrary commutative ring, if every ideal of the coefficient ring is
  finitely generated, then every ideal of its univariate polynomial ring is
  finitely generated. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Bool.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Import ListNotations.

Record q656645_commutative_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q656645_zero : R;
  q656645_one : R;
  q656645_add : R -> R -> R;
  q656645_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q656645_neg : R -> R;
  q656645_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q656645_add x (q656645_add y z) =
      q656645_add (q656645_add x y) z;
  q656645_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q656645_add x y = q656645_add y x;
  q656645_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q656645_add x q656645_zero = x;
  q656645_add_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q656645_add x (q656645_neg x) = q656645_zero;
  q656645_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q656645_mul x (q656645_mul y z) =
      q656645_mul (q656645_mul x y) z;
  q656645_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q656645_mul x y = q656645_mul y x;
  q656645_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q656645_mul x q656645_one = x;
  q656645_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : R,
      q656645_mul x (q656645_add y z) =
      q656645_add
        (q656645_mul x y) (q656645_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q656645_zero {R} _.
Arguments q656645_one {R} _.
Arguments q656645_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q656645_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q656645_neg {R} _ _.

Record q656645_ideal
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R) : Type := {
  q656645_ideal_mem : R -> Prop;
  q656645_ideal_zero :
    q656645_ideal_mem (q656645_zero CR);
  q656645_ideal_add :
    forall x y : R,
      q656645_ideal_mem x ->
      q656645_ideal_mem y ->
      q656645_ideal_mem (q656645_add CR x y);
  q656645_ideal_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q656645_ideal_mem x ->
      q656645_ideal_mem (q656645_neg CR x);
  q656645_ideal_mul :
    forall a x : R,
      q656645_ideal_mem x ->
      q656645_ideal_mem (q656645_mul CR a x)
}.

Arguments q656645_ideal_mem {R CR} _ _.

Fixpoint q656645_linear_combination
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (coefficients generators : list R) : R :=
  match coefficients, generators with
  | coefficient :: coefficient_rest, generator :: generator_rest =>
      q656645_add CR
        (q656645_mul CR coefficient generator)
        (q656645_linear_combination
          CR coefficient_rest generator_rest)
  | _, _ => q656645_zero CR
  end.

Definition q656645_generated_by
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q656645_commutative_ring R}
    (generators : list R)
    (I : @q656645_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    q656645_ideal_mem I x <->
    exists coefficients : list R,
      length coefficients = length generators /\
      x = q656645_linear_combination CR coefficients generators.

Definition q656645_is_noetherian
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q656645_commutative_ring R} : Prop :=
  forall I : @q656645_ideal R CR,
    exists generators : list R,
      q656645_generated_by generators I.

Definition q656645_polynomial (R : Type) : Type :=
  list (nat * R).

Fixpoint q656645_polynomial_coefficient
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (p : q656645_polynomial R)
    (n : nat) : R :=
  match p with
  | [] => q656645_zero CR
  | (degree, coefficient) :: rest =>
      if Nat.eqb degree n
      then q656645_add CR coefficient
        (q656645_polynomial_coefficient CR rest n)
      else q656645_polynomial_coefficient CR rest n
  end.

Definition q656645_polynomial_equiv
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (p q : q656645_polynomial R) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    q656645_polynomial_coefficient CR p n =
    q656645_polynomial_coefficient CR q n.

Definition q656645_polynomial_zero
    {R : Type} : q656645_polynomial R :=
  [].

Definition q656645_polynomial_one
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R) : q656645_polynomial R :=
  [(0, q656645_one CR)].

Definition q656645_polynomial_add
    {R : Type}
    (p q : q656645_polynomial R) : q656645_polynomial R :=
  p ++ q.

Definition q656645_polynomial_neg
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (p : q656645_polynomial R) : q656645_polynomial R :=
  map
    (fun term => (fst term, q656645_neg CR (snd term)))
    p.

Definition q656645_term_mul
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (left right : nat * R) : nat * R :=
  (fst left + fst right,
   q656645_mul CR (snd left) (snd right)).

Definition q656645_polynomial_mul
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (p q : q656645_polynomial R) : q656645_polynomial R :=
  flat_map
    (fun left => map (q656645_term_mul CR left) q)
    p.

Record q656645_polynomial_ideal
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R) : Type := {
  q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem :
    q656645_polynomial R -> Prop;
  q656645_polynomial_ideal_respects :
    forall p q : q656645_polynomial R,
      q656645_polynomial_equiv CR p q ->
      (q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem p <->
       q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem q);
  q656645_polynomial_ideal_zero :
    q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem q656645_polynomial_zero;
  q656645_polynomial_ideal_add :
    forall p q : q656645_polynomial R,
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem p ->
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem q ->
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem
        (q656645_polynomial_add p q);
  q656645_polynomial_ideal_neg :
    forall p : q656645_polynomial R,
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem p ->
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem
        (q656645_polynomial_neg CR p);
  q656645_polynomial_ideal_mul :
    forall a p : q656645_polynomial R,
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem p ->
      q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem
        (q656645_polynomial_mul CR a p)
}.

Arguments q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem {R CR} _ _.

Fixpoint q656645_polynomial_linear_combination
    {R : Type}
    (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R)
    (coefficients generators : list (q656645_polynomial R)) :
    q656645_polynomial R :=
  match coefficients, generators with
  | coefficient :: coefficient_rest, generator :: generator_rest =>
      q656645_polynomial_add
        (q656645_polynomial_mul CR coefficient generator)
        (q656645_polynomial_linear_combination
          CR coefficient_rest generator_rest)
  | _, _ => q656645_polynomial_zero
  end.

Definition q656645_polynomial_generated_by
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q656645_commutative_ring R}
    (generators : list (q656645_polynomial R))
    (I : @q656645_polynomial_ideal R CR) : Prop :=
  forall p : q656645_polynomial R,
    q656645_polynomial_ideal_mem I p <->
    exists coefficients : list (q656645_polynomial R),
      length coefficients = length generators /\
      q656645_polynomial_equiv CR p
        (q656645_polynomial_linear_combination
          CR coefficients generators).

Definition q656645_polynomial_is_noetherian
    {R : Type}
    {CR : q656645_commutative_ring R} : Prop :=
  forall I : @q656645_polynomial_ideal R CR,
    exists generators : list (q656645_polynomial R),
      q656645_polynomial_generated_by generators I.

Theorem Polynomial_isNoetherianRing :
  forall (R : Type)
         (CR : q656645_commutative_ring R),
    @q656645_is_noetherian R CR ->
    @q656645_polynomial_is_noetherian R CR.
Admitted.

title: Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656645,
  "Hilbert's basis theorem": the univariate polynomial ring over a
  commutative Noetherian ring is Noetherian. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q656645_HILBERTS_BASIS_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       (!x. addR zeroR x = x) /\
       (!x. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
       (!x y. addR x y = addR y x) /\
       (!x y z. addR x (addR y z) = addR (addR x y) z) /\
       (!x. mulR oneR x = x) /\
       (!x y. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
       (!x y z. mulR x (mulR y z) = mulR (mulR x y) z) /\
       (!x y z.
          mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) in
   let is_ideal_R =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (ideal:R->bool).
       ideal zeroR /\
       (!x. ideal x ==> ideal (negR x)) /\
       (!x y. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (addR x y)) /\
       (!a x. ideal x ==> ideal (mulR a x)) in
   let finitely_generates_R =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (ideal:R->bool) (generators:R->bool).
       FINITE generators /\
       (!x. generators x ==> ideal x) /\
       (!other:R->bool.
          is_ideal_R zeroR addR mulR negR other /\
          (!x. generators x ==> other x)
          ==> !x. ideal x ==> other x) in
   let is_noetherian_R =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       !ideal:R->bool.
         is_ideal_R zeroR addR mulR negR ideal
         ==> ?generators:R->bool.
               finitely_generates_R
                 zeroR addR mulR negR ideal generators in
   let is_polynomial =
     \(zeroR:R) (p:num->R).
       FINITE {n | ~(p n = zeroR)} in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(zeroR:R). \n:num. zeroR in
   let polynomial_one =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R). \n:num.
       if n = 0 then oneR else zeroR in
   let polynomial_neg =
     \(negR:R->R) (p:num->R). \n:num. negR (p n) in
   let polynomial_add =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (p:num->R) (q:num->R).
       \n:num. addR (p n) (q n) in
   let polynomial_mul =
     \(addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (p:num->R) (q:num->R).
       \n:num.
         iterate addR {(i,j) | i + j = n}
           (\(i,j). mulR (p i) (q j)) in
   let is_ideal_polynomial =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (ideal:(num->R)->bool).
       (!p. ideal p ==> is_polynomial zeroR p) /\
       ideal (polynomial_zero zeroR) /\
       (!p.
          ideal p
          ==> ideal (polynomial_neg negR p)) /\
       (!p q.
          ideal p /\ ideal q
          ==> ideal (polynomial_add addR p q)) /\
       (!a p.
          is_polynomial zeroR a /\ ideal p
          ==> ideal (polynomial_mul addR mulR a p)) in
   let finitely_generates_polynomial =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (ideal:(num->R)->bool)
      (generators:(num->R)->bool).
       FINITE generators /\
       (!p. generators p ==> ideal p) /\
       (!other:(num->R)->bool.
          is_ideal_polynomial zeroR addR mulR negR other /\
          (!p. generators p ==> other p)
          ==> !p. ideal p ==> other p) in
   let is_noetherian_polynomial_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       !ideal:(num->R)->bool.
         is_ideal_polynomial zeroR addR mulR negR ideal
         ==> ?generators:(num->R)->bool.
               finitely_generates_polynomial
                 zeroR addR mulR negR ideal generators in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R.
     is_comm_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_noetherian_R zeroR addR mulR negR
     ==> is_noetherian_polynomial_ring
           zeroR addR mulR negR`;;

title: Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656645,
;; "Hilbert's basis theorem": the univariate polynomial ring over a
;; commutative Noetherian ring is Noetherian. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent an arbitrary commutative ring and arbitrary
;; ideal-membership predicates. No carrier or ideal is enumerated.
;; Noetherianity means that every ideal has an internally existential finite
;; generating list, with its coefficient witnesses also internally quantified.
;;
;; Polynomials are canonical finite-support coefficient lists in increasing
;; degree order: NIL is zero, and a nonzero polynomial has a nonzero final
;; coefficient. The definitions below give exact coefficientwise addition,
;; negation, and convolution multiplication over the supplied ring operations.
;; Thus polynomial degree, ideal size, and generator count remain unbounded.

(defun q656645-member-p (predicate value)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list value))
      t
    nil))

(defun q656645-unary-value (operation value)
  (apply$ operation (list value)))

(defun q656645-binary-value (operation left right)
  (apply$ operation (list left right)))

(defun q656645-neg (negation value)
  (q656645-unary-value negation value))

(defun q656645-add (addition left right)
  (q656645-binary-value addition left right))

(defun q656645-mul (multiplication left right)
  (q656645-binary-value multiplication left right))

;; Commutative rings and their ideals.

(defun-sk q656645-commutative-ring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q656645-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q656645-member-p carrier (q656645-neg negation x))
       (equal (q656645-add addition x zero) x)
       (equal (q656645-add addition zero x) x)
       (equal
        (q656645-add addition x (q656645-neg negation x))
        zero)
       (equal
        (q656645-add addition (q656645-neg negation x) x)
        zero)
       (equal (q656645-mul multiplication x one) x)
       (equal (q656645-mul multiplication one x) x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q656645-member-p carrier x)
       (q656645-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q656645-member-p
        carrier (q656645-add addition x y))
       (q656645-member-p
        carrier (q656645-mul multiplication x y))
       (equal
        (q656645-add addition x y)
        (q656645-add addition y x))
       (equal
        (q656645-mul multiplication x y)
        (q656645-mul multiplication y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q656645-member-p carrier x)
       (q656645-member-p carrier y)
       (q656645-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q656645-add
         addition (q656645-add addition x y) z)
        (q656645-add
         addition x (q656645-add addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q656645-mul
         multiplication
         (q656645-mul multiplication x y)
         z)
        (q656645-mul
         multiplication
         x
         (q656645-mul multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q656645-mul
         multiplication
         x
         (q656645-add addition y z))
        (q656645-add
         addition
         (q656645-mul multiplication x y)
         (q656645-mul multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q656645-mul
         multiplication
         (q656645-add addition x y)
         z)
        (q656645-add
         addition
         (q656645-mul multiplication x z)
         (q656645-mul multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q656645-commutative-ring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp negation)
   (q656645-member-p carrier zero)
   (q656645-member-p carrier one)
   (q656645-commutative-ring-laws-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)))

(defun-sk q656645-ideal-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q656645-member-p ideal x)
      (and
       (q656645-member-p carrier x)
       (q656645-member-p
        ideal (q656645-neg negation x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q656645-member-p ideal x)
       (q656645-member-p ideal y))
      (q656645-member-p
       ideal (q656645-add addition x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q656645-member-p carrier a)
       (q656645-member-p ideal x))
      (q656645-member-p
       ideal (q656645-mul multiplication a x))))))

(defun q656645-ideal-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q656645-member-p ideal zero)
   (q656645-ideal-laws-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)))

(defun q656645-ring-list-p (carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q656645-member-p carrier (car values))
       (q656645-ring-list-p carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q656645-linear-combination
    (zero addition multiplication coefficients generators)
  (if (and (consp coefficients)
           (consp generators))
      (q656645-add
       addition
       (q656645-mul
        multiplication (car coefficients) (car generators))
       (q656645-linear-combination
        zero
        addition
        multiplication
        (cdr coefficients)
        (cdr generators)))
    zero))

(defun-sk q656645-generated-representation-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication generators value)
  (exists (coefficients)
    (and
     (true-listp coefficients)
     (equal (len coefficients) (len generators))
     (q656645-ring-list-p carrier coefficients)

title: Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656645,
-- "Hilbert's basis theorem": the univariate polynomial ring over a commutative
-- Noetherian ring is again Noetherian. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record CommutativeRing
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR zeroR x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : R) ->
      addR (negateR x) x ≡ zeroR
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR oneR x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    distribute-left :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (addR x y) z ≡
      addR (multiplyR x z) (multiplyR y z)

record Ideal
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    member : R -> Set a
    membership-propositional :
      (x : R) ->
      (u v : member x) ->
      u ≡ v
    contains-zero :
      member (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring)
    closed-under-addition :
      (x y : R) ->
      member x ->
      member y ->
      member (CommutativeRing.addR ring x y)
    closed-under-negation :
      (x : R) ->
      member x ->
      member (CommutativeRing.negateR ring x)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (r x : R) ->
      member x ->
      member (CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring r x)

IdealIncludedIn :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set a
IdealIncludedIn {R = R} I J =
  (x : R) ->
  Ideal.member I x ->
  Ideal.member J x

data ContainsAll
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  {ring : CommutativeRing R}
  (I : Ideal ring) :
  List R ->
  Set a where

  contains-empty :
    ContainsAll I []

  contains-cons :
    {x : R} ->
    {xs : List R} ->
    Ideal.member I x ->
    ContainsAll I xs ->
    ContainsAll I (x ∷ xs)

GeneratesIdeal :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  List R ->
  Ideal ring ->
  Set (lsuc a)
GeneratesIdeal {ring = ring} generators I =
  ContainsAll I generators and
  ((J : Ideal ring) ->
    ContainsAll J generators ->
    IdealIncludedIn I J)

IsNoetherianRing :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Set (lsuc a)
IsNoetherianRing {R = R} ring =
  (I : Ideal ring) ->
  Σ (List R)
    (λ generators ->
      GeneratesIdeal generators I)

Polynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Polynomial R =
  List R

coefficientAt :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Nat ->
  R
coefficientAt ring [] n =
  CommutativeRing.zeroR ring
coefficientAt ring (coefficient ∷ coefficients) zero =
  coefficient
coefficientAt ring (coefficient ∷ coefficients) (suc n) =
  coefficientAt ring coefficients n

PolynomialEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Set a
PolynomialEqual ring left right =
  (n : Nat) ->
  coefficientAt ring left n ≡
  coefficientAt ring right n

addPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
addPolynomial ring [] right =
  right
addPolynomial ring left [] =
  left
addPolynomial ring (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =
  CommutativeRing.addR ring x y ∷
  addPolynomial ring xs ys

negatePolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
negatePolynomial ring [] =
  []
negatePolynomial ring (x ∷ xs) =
  CommutativeRing.negateR ring x ∷
  negatePolynomial ring xs

scalePolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
scalePolynomial ring scalar [] =
  []
scalePolynomial ring scalar (x ∷ xs) =
  CommutativeRing.multiplyR ring scalar x ∷
  scalePolynomial ring scalar xs

multiplyPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R ->
  Polynomial R
multiplyPolynomial ring [] right =
  []
multiplyPolynomial ring (x ∷ xs) right =
  addPolynomial ring
    (scalePolynomial ring x right)
    (CommutativeRing.zeroR ring ∷
     multiplyPolynomial ring xs right)

record PolynomialIdeal
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    member :
      Polynomial R ->
      Set a
    membership-propositional :
      (polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
      (u v : member polynomial) ->
      u ≡ v
    respects-polynomial-equality :
      (left right : Polynomial R) ->
      PolynomialEqual ring left right ->
      member left ->
      member right
    contains-zero :
      member []
    closed-under-addition :
      (left right : Polynomial R) ->
      member left ->
      member right ->
      member (addPolynomial ring left right)
    closed-under-negation :
      (polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
      member polynomial ->
      member (negatePolynomial ring polynomial)
    absorbs-multiplication :
      (factor polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
      member polynomial ->
      member (multiplyPolynomial ring factor polynomial)

PolynomialIdealIncludedIn :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  PolynomialIdeal ring ->
  PolynomialIdeal ring ->
  Set a
PolynomialIdealIncludedIn {R = R} I J =
  (polynomial : Polynomial R) ->
  PolynomialIdeal.member I polynomial ->
  PolynomialIdeal.member J polynomial

data ContainsAllPolynomials
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  {ring : CommutativeRing R}
  (I : PolynomialIdeal ring) :
  List (Polynomial R) ->
  Set a where

  contains-no-polynomials :
    ContainsAllPolynomials I []

  contains-polynomial :
    {polynomial : Polynomial R} ->
    {polynomials : List (Polynomial R)} ->
    PolynomialIdeal.member I polynomial ->
    ContainsAllPolynomials I polynomials ->
    ContainsAllPolynomials I (polynomial ∷ polynomials)

GeneratesPolynomialIdeal :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {ring : CommutativeRing R} ->
  List (Polynomial R) ->
  PolynomialIdeal ring ->
  Set (lsuc a)
GeneratesPolynomialIdeal {ring = ring} generators I =
  ContainsAllPolynomials I generators and
  ((J : PolynomialIdeal ring) ->
    ContainsAllPolynomials J generators ->
    PolynomialIdealIncludedIn I J)

IsNoetherianPolynomialRing :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  CommutativeRing R ->
  Set (lsuc a)
IsNoetherianPolynomialRing {R = R} ring =
  (I : PolynomialIdeal ring) ->
  Σ (List (Polynomial R))
    (λ generators ->
      GeneratesPolynomialIdeal generators I)

-- Lean: Polynomial.isNoetherianRing
hilbert-s-basis-theorem :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
hilbert-s-basis-theorem a =
  (R : Set a) ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) ->
  IsNoetherianRing ring ->
  IsNoetherianPolynomialRing ring

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q656645, "Hilbert's basis theorem": the univariate polynomial ring over a
  commutative Noetherian ring is Noetherian. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val q656645_comm_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_comm_ring_def",
  ``q656645_comm_ring
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z))``);

val q656645_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_ideal_def",
  ``q656645_ideal
      (carrier : 'a -> bool)
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (ideal : 'a set) <=>
      (!x. x IN ideal ==> carrier x) /\
      zero IN ideal /\
      (!x y. x IN ideal /\ y IN ideal ==> add x y IN ideal) /\
      (!x. x IN ideal ==> neg x IN ideal) /\
      (!a x. carrier a /\ x IN ideal ==> mul a x IN ideal)``);

val q656645_span_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_span_def",
  ``q656645_span
      (carrier : 'a -> bool)
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a)
      (s : 'a set) =
      {x |
        carrier x /\
        !other : 'a set.
          q656645_ideal carrier zero add mul neg other /\
          s SUBSET other
          ==>
          x IN other}``);

val q656645_noetherian_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_noetherian_def",
  ``q656645_noetherian
      (carrier : 'a -> bool)
      (zero : 'a) (add : 'a -> 'a -> 'a)
      (mul : 'a -> 'a -> 'a) (neg : 'a -> 'a) <=>
      !ideal : 'a set.
        q656645_ideal carrier zero add mul neg ideal
        ==>
        ?s : 'a set.
          FINITE s /\
          s SUBSET ideal /\
          q656645_span carrier zero add mul neg s = ideal``);

val q656645_polynomial_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_polynomial_def",
  ``q656645_polynomial (zero : 'r) (p : num -> 'r) <=>
      FINITE {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q656645_poly_zero_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_poly_zero_def",
  ``q656645_poly_zero (zero : 'r) = (\n : num. zero)``);

val q656645_poly_add_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_poly_add_def",
  ``q656645_poly_add
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (p : num -> 'r) q =
      (\n. add (p n) (q n))``);

val q656645_poly_neg_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_poly_neg_def",
  ``q656645_poly_neg (neg : 'r -> 'r) (p : num -> 'r) =
      (\n. neg (p n))``);

val q656645_poly_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q656645_poly_mul_def",
  ``q656645_poly_mul
      (zero : 'r) (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (p : num -> 'r) (q : num -> 'r) (n : num) =
      ITSET
        (\ij acc.
          add (mul (p (FST ij)) (q (SND ij))) acc)
        {ij : num # num | FST ij + SND ij = n}
        zero``);

val Polynomial_isNoetherianRing =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r).
      q656645_comm_ring zero oneR add mul neg /\
      q656645_noetherian (\x : 'r. T) zero add mul neg
      ==>
      q656645_noetherian
        (q656645_polynomial zero)
        (q656645_poly_zero zero)
        (q656645_poly_add add)
        (q656645_poly_mul zero add mul)
        (q656645_poly_neg neg)``;
