title: Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656645
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q656645), "Hilbert's basis theorem": a polynomial
% ring over a commutative Noetherian ring is Noetherian. This file contains no
% proof.

Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem[
  R: TYPE+,
  zero, one: R,
  neg: [R -> R],
  add, mul: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  coefficient_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> R]
  ring_ideal: TYPE = [R -> bool]
  polynomial_ideal: TYPE = [coefficient_sequence -> bool]

  IMPORTING finite_sets[R], finite_sets[coefficient_sequence]

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(zero, x) = x
          AND add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(neg(x), x) = zero
          AND add(x, neg(x)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(x, add(y, z)) =
          add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(add(x, y), z) =
          add(mul(x, z), mul(y, z)))

  is_ring_ideal(I: ring_ideal): bool =
    I(zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        I(x) AND I(y) IMPLIES I(add(x, y)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(neg(x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, x: R):
        I(x) IMPLIES I(mul(a, x)))

  ring_ideal_subset(I, J: ring_ideal): bool =
    FORALL (x: R):
      I(x) IMPLIES J(x)

  ring_ideal_generated_by(
      generators: finite_set[R],
      I: ring_ideal): bool =
    is_ring_ideal(I)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        member(x, generators) IMPLIES I(x))
      AND (FORALL (J: ring_ideal):
        is_ring_ideal(J)
          AND (FORALL (x: R):
            member(x, generators) IMPLIES J(x))
          IMPLIES ring_ideal_subset(I, J))

  noetherian_base_ring: bool =
    FORALL (I: ring_ideal):
      is_ring_ideal(I)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (generators: finite_set[R]):
            ring_ideal_generated_by(generators, I)

  finitely_supported(p: coefficient_sequence): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      FORALL (degree: nat):
        degree > bound IMPLIES p(degree) = zero

  polynomial_zero: coefficient_sequence =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat): zero

  polynomial_one: coefficient_sequence =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 0 THEN one ELSE zero ENDIF

  polynomial_negate(
      p: coefficient_sequence): coefficient_sequence =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      neg(p(degree))

  polynomial_add(
      p, q: coefficient_sequence): coefficient_sequence =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      add(p(degree), q(degree))

  ring_sum(
      values: [nat -> R],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      add(
        ring_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_multiply(
      p, q: coefficient_sequence): coefficient_sequence =
    LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      ring_sum(
        (LAMBDA (index: nat):
          IF index <= degree THEN
            mul(p(index), q(degree - index))
          ELSE
            zero
          ENDIF),
        degree + 1)

  is_polynomial_ideal(I: polynomial_ideal): bool =
    I(polynomial_zero)
      AND (FORALL (p: coefficient_sequence):
        I(p) IMPLIES finitely_supported(p))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: coefficient_sequence):
        I(p) AND I(q) IMPLIES I(polynomial_add(p, q)))
      AND (FORALL (p: coefficient_sequence):
        I(p) IMPLIES I(polynomial_negate(p)))
      AND (FORALL (a, p: coefficient_sequence):
        finitely_supported(a)
          AND I(p)
          IMPLIES I(polynomial_multiply(a, p)))

  polynomial_ideal_subset(
      I, J: polynomial_ideal): bool =
    FORALL (p: coefficient_sequence):
      I(p) IMPLIES J(p)

  polynomial_ideal_generated_by(
      generators: finite_set[coefficient_sequence],
      I: polynomial_ideal): bool =
    is_polynomial_ideal(I)
      AND (FORALL (p: coefficient_sequence):
        member(p, generators) IMPLIES I(p))
      AND (FORALL (J: polynomial_ideal):
        is_polynomial_ideal(J)
          AND (FORALL (p: coefficient_sequence):
            member(p, generators) IMPLIES J(p))
          IMPLIES polynomial_ideal_subset(I, J))

  noetherian_polynomial_ring: bool =
    FORALL (I: polynomial_ideal):
      is_polynomial_ideal(I)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (generators: finite_set[coefficient_sequence]):
            polynomial_ideal_generated_by(generators, I)

  hilberts_basis_theorem: bool =
    (commutative_ring_laws AND noetherian_base_ring)
      IMPLIES noetherian_polynomial_ring

END Q656645_hilbert_s_basis_theorem

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q656772
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q656772), "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": over any
-- commutative ring, evaluating a square matrix's characteristic polynomial at
-- the matrix itself gives the zero matrix. This file contains no proof.

universe u v

namespace Q656772

/-- A bundled commutative ring, including exactly the algebraic laws used by the theorem. -/
structure CommRing (R : Type u) where
  zero : R
  one : R
  add : R → R → R
  mul : R → R → R
  neg : R → R
  add_assoc : ∀ a b c, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c)
  add_comm : ∀ a b, add a b = add b a
  zero_add : ∀ a, add zero a = a
  add_neg : ∀ a, add a (neg a) = zero
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c, mul (mul a b) c = mul a (mul b c)
  mul_comm : ∀ a b, mul a b = mul b a
  one_mul : ∀ a, mul one a = a
  left_distrib : ∀ a b c, mul a (add b c) = add (mul a b) (mul a c)

/-- A permutation of an arbitrary type. -/
structure Perm (ι : Type v) where
  toFun : ι → ι
  invFun : ι → ι
  leftInv : ∀ i, invFun (toFun i) = i
  rightInv : ∀ i, toFun (invFun i) = i

/-- The entries of a list are pairwise distinct. -/
def NoDup {α : Type u} : List α → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: xs => (∀ y, List.Mem y xs → x ≠ y) ∧ NoDup xs

/--
An explicit presentation of an arbitrary finite index type and its finite permutation group.
The completeness and no-duplication fields ensure that neither carrier is bounded or sampled.
-/
structure FiniteIndex (ι : Type v) where
  elems : List ι
  elems_nodup : NoDup elems
  elems_complete : ∀ i, List.Mem i elems
  perms : List (Perm ι)
  perms_nodup : NoDup perms
  perms_complete : ∀ σ, List.Mem σ perms

/-- A square matrix over an arbitrary carrier. -/
abbrev Matrix (ι : Type v) (R : Type u) := ι → ι → R

/-- Coefficient-list polynomials, with coefficients in increasing degree order. -/
abbrev Polynomial (R : Type u) := List R

def ringSum {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) : List R → R
  | [] => r.zero
  | x :: xs => r.add x (ringSum r xs)

def ringProduct {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) : List R → R
  | [] => r.one
  | x :: xs => r.mul x (ringProduct r xs)

def indexOf {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι] (x : ι) : List ι → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | y :: ys => if x = y then 0 else Nat.succ (indexOf x ys)

def countLess (x : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | y :: ys => (if y < x then 1 else 0) + countLess x ys

def inversionCount : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => countLess x xs + inversionCount xs

def permutationInversions {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    (idx : FiniteIndex ι) (σ : Perm ι) : Nat :=
  inversionCount (idx.elems.map (fun i => indexOf (σ.toFun i) idx.elems))

def polyAdd {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) :
    Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R
  | [], q => q
  | p, [] => p
  | a :: p, b :: q => r.add a b :: polyAdd r p q

def polyNeg {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) : Polynomial R → Polynomial R
  | [] => []
  | a :: p => r.neg a :: polyNeg r p

def polySub {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) (p q : Polynomial R) : Polynomial R :=
  polyAdd r p (polyNeg r q)

def polyScale {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) (a : R) : Polynomial R → Polynomial R
  | [] => []
  | b :: p => r.mul a b :: polyScale r a p

def polyShift {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) : Polynomial R → Polynomial R
  | [] => []
  | p => r.zero :: p

def polyMul {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) :
    Polynomial R → Polynomial R → Polynomial R
  | [], _ => []
  | a :: p, q =>
      polyAdd r (polyScale r a q) (polyShift r (polyMul r p q))

def polySum {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) : List (Polynomial R) → Polynomial R
  | [] => []
  | p :: ps => polyAdd r p (polySum r ps)

def polyProduct {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) :
    List (Polynomial R) → Polynomial R
  | [] => [r.one]
  | p :: ps => polyMul r p (polyProduct r ps)

def polyConst {R : Type u} (a : R) : Polynomial R :=
  [a]

def polyX {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) : Polynomial R :=
  [r.zero, r.one]

def signedPolynomial {R : Type u} (r : CommRing R) (inversions : Nat)
    (p : Polynomial R) : Polynomial R :=
  if inversions % 2 = 0 then p else polyNeg r p

/-- The Leibniz determinant of a polynomial-valued square matrix. -/
def polynomialDeterminant {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : CommRing R) (idx : FiniteIndex ι) (A : Matrix ι (Polynomial R)) :
    Polynomial R :=
  polySum r <| idx.perms.map fun σ =>
    signedPolynomial r (permutationInversions idx σ)
      (polyProduct r (idx.elems.map fun i => A (σ.toFun i) i))

/-- The characteristic matrix `X I - M`. -/
def charmatrix {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : CommRing R) (M : Matrix ι R) : Matrix ι (Polynomial R) :=
  fun i j =>
    if i = j then
      polySub r (polyX r) (polyConst (M i j))
    else
      polyNeg r (polyConst (M i j))

/-- The characteristic polynomial `det (X I - M)`. -/
def charpoly {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : CommRing R) (idx : FiniteIndex ι) (M : Matrix ι R) : Polynomial R :=
  polynomialDeterminant r idx (charmatrix r M)

def zeroMatrix {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} (r : CommRing R) : Matrix ι R :=
  fun _ _ => r.zero

def scalarMatrix {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : CommRing R) (a : R) : Matrix ι R :=
  fun i j => if i = j then a else r.zero

def matrixAdd {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} (r : CommRing R)
    (A B : Matrix ι R) : Matrix ι R :=
  fun i j => r.add (A i j) (B i j)

def matrixMul {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} (r : CommRing R)
    (idx : FiniteIndex ι) (A B : Matrix ι R) : Matrix ι R :=
  fun i j => ringSum r (idx.elems.map fun k => r.mul (A i k) (B k j))

/-- Horner evaluation of a scalar polynomial at a square matrix. -/
def matrixEval {R : Type u} {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : CommRing R) (idx : FiniteIndex ι) (M : Matrix ι R) :
    Polynomial R → Matrix ι R
  | [] => zeroMatrix r
  | a :: p =>
      matrixAdd r (scalarMatrix r a) (matrixMul r idx M (matrixEval r idx M p))

/-- The Cayley–Hamilton theorem for square matrices over an arbitrary commutative ring. -/
theorem aeval_self_charpoly {R : Type u} {ι : Type v}
    (r : CommRing R) [DecidableEq ι] (idx : FiniteIndex ι) (M : Matrix ι R) :
    matrixEval r idx M (charpoly r idx M) = zeroMatrix r := sorry

end Q656772

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656772
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q656772), "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": over any
  commutative ring, evaluating the characteristic polynomial of a square
  matrix indexed by an arbitrary finite type at the matrix itself gives the
  zero matrix. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q656772_commutative_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q656772_zero : R;
  q656772_one : R;
  q656772_add : R -> R -> R;
  q656772_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q656772_neg : R -> R;
  q656772_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q656772_add x (q656772_add y z) =
      q656772_add (q656772_add x y) z;
  q656772_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q656772_add x y = q656772_add y x;
  q656772_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q656772_add x q656772_zero = x;
  q656772_add_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q656772_add x (q656772_neg x) = q656772_zero;
  q656772_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q656772_mul x (q656772_mul y z) =
      q656772_mul (q656772_mul x y) z;
  q656772_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q656772_mul x y = q656772_mul y x;
  q656772_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q656772_mul x q656772_one = x;
  q656772_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : R,
      q656772_mul x (q656772_add y z) =
      q656772_add
        (q656772_mul x y)
        (q656772_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q656772_zero {R} _.
Arguments q656772_one {R} _.
Arguments q656772_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q656772_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q656772_neg {R} _ _.

Record q656772_finite_type (I : Type) : Type := {
  q656772_enum : list I;
  q656772_enum_nodup : NoDup q656772_enum;
  q656772_enum_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q656772_enum;
  q656772_eq_dec :
    forall i j : I, {i = j} + {i <> j}
}.

Arguments q656772_enum {I} _.
Arguments q656772_eq_dec {I} _ _ _.

Definition q656772_matrix (I R : Type) : Type :=
  I -> I -> R.

Definition q656772_matrix_equal {I R : Type}
    (A B : q656772_matrix I R) : Prop :=
  forall i j : I, A i j = B i j.

Fixpoint q656772_sum_list {A R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (xs : list A)
    (f : A -> R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => q656772_zero ring
  | x :: rest =>
      q656772_add ring
        (f x)
        (q656772_sum_list ring rest f)
  end.

Definition q656772_finite_sum {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
    (f : I -> R) : R :=
  q656772_sum_list ring (q656772_enum fin) f.

Definition q656772_zero_matrix {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R) :
    q656772_matrix I R :=
  fun _ _ => q656772_zero ring.

Definition q656772_scalar_matrix {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
    (a : R) : q656772_matrix I R :=
  fun i j =>
    if q656772_eq_dec fin i j
    then a
    else q656772_zero ring.

Definition q656772_matrix_add {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (A B : q656772_matrix I R) :
    q656772_matrix I R :=
  fun i j => q656772_add ring (A i j) (B i j).

Definition q656772_matrix_mul {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
    (A B : q656772_matrix I R) :
    q656772_matrix I R :=
  fun i j =>
    q656772_finite_sum ring fin
      (fun k => q656772_mul ring (A i k) (B k j)).

Definition q656772_polynomial (R : Type) : Type :=
  list R.

Definition q656772_poly_zero {R : Type} :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  [].

Definition q656772_poly_one {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  [q656772_one ring].

Definition q656772_poly_constant {R : Type}
    (a : R) : q656772_polynomial R :=
  [a].

Definition q656772_poly_X {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  [q656772_zero ring; q656772_one ring].

Fixpoint q656772_poly_add {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (p q : q656772_polynomial R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  match p, q with
  | [], _ => q
  | _, [] => p
  | a :: p', b :: q' =>
      q656772_add ring a b ::
      q656772_poly_add ring p' q'
  end.

Fixpoint q656772_poly_neg {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (p : q656772_polynomial R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      q656772_neg ring a ::
      q656772_poly_neg ring rest
  end.

Definition q656772_poly_sub {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (p q : q656772_polynomial R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  q656772_poly_add ring p (q656772_poly_neg ring q).

Fixpoint q656772_poly_scale {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (a : R)
    (p : q656772_polynomial R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | b :: rest =>
      q656772_mul ring a b ::
      q656772_poly_scale ring a rest
  end.

Fixpoint q656772_poly_mul {R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (p q : q656772_polynomial R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      q656772_poly_add ring
        (q656772_poly_scale ring a q)
        (q656772_zero ring ::
          q656772_poly_mul ring rest q)
  end.

Fixpoint q656772_determinant {I A : Type}
    (zero one : A)
    (add mul : A -> A -> A)
    (neg : A -> A)
    (rows cols : list I)
    (M : I -> I -> A) {struct rows} : A :=
  match rows with
  | [] => one
  | i :: remaining_rows =>
      let fix expand
          (prefix remaining_cols : list I)
          (positive : bool) {struct remaining_cols} : A :=
        match remaining_cols with
        | [] => zero
        | j :: suffix =>
            let minor :=
              q656772_determinant
                zero one add mul neg
                remaining_rows
                (rev prefix ++ suffix)
                M in
            let term := mul (M i j) minor in
            add
              (if positive then term else neg term)
              (expand (j :: prefix) suffix (negb positive))
        end in
      expand [] cols true
  end.

Definition q656772_charmatrix_entry {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
    (M : q656772_matrix I R)
    (i j : I) : q656772_polynomial R :=
  q656772_poly_sub ring
    (if q656772_eq_dec fin i j
     then q656772_poly_X ring
     else q656772_poly_zero)
    (q656772_poly_constant (M i j)).

Definition q656772_charpoly {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
    (M : q656772_matrix I R) :
    q656772_polynomial R :=
  q656772_determinant
    q656772_poly_zero
    (q656772_poly_one ring)
    (q656772_poly_add ring)
    (q656772_poly_mul ring)
    (q656772_poly_neg ring)
    (q656772_enum fin)
    (q656772_enum fin)
    (q656772_charmatrix_entry ring fin M).

Fixpoint q656772_aeval_matrix {I R : Type}
    (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
    (M : q656772_matrix I R)
    (p : q656772_polynomial R) :
    q656772_matrix I R :=
  match p with
  | [] => q656772_zero_matrix ring
  | a :: rest =>
      q656772_matrix_add ring
        (q656772_scalar_matrix ring fin a)
        (q656772_matrix_mul ring fin M
          (q656772_aeval_matrix ring fin M rest))
  end.

Theorem Matrix_aeval_self_charpoly :
  forall (R I : Type)
         (ring : q656772_commutative_ring R)
         (fin : q656772_finite_type I)
         (M : q656772_matrix I R),
    q656772_matrix_equal
      (q656772_aeval_matrix ring fin M
        (q656772_charpoly ring fin M))
      (q656772_zero_matrix ring).
Admitted.

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656772
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q656772), "Cayley-Hamilton theorem": over an
  arbitrary commutative ring, the characteristic polynomial of every square
  matrix on a finite index type annihilates that matrix. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix = "'i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q656772_zero_matrix ::
    "('a::zero, 'i) q656772_matrix" where
  "q656772_zero_matrix = (\<lambda>_ _. 0)"

definition q656772_identity_matrix ::
    "('a::{zero, one}, 'i) q656772_matrix" where
  "q656772_identity_matrix = (\<lambda>i j. if i = j then 1 else 0)"

definition q656772_matrix_mult ::
    "('a::semiring_0, 'i::finite) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix" where
  "q656772_matrix_mult A B =
    (\<lambda>i j. \<Sum>k\<in>(UNIV :: 'i set). A i k * B k j)"

fun q656772_matrix_pow ::
    "('a::{semiring_0, monoid_mult}, 'i::finite) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix" where
  "q656772_matrix_pow A 0 = q656772_identity_matrix"
| "q656772_matrix_pow A (Suc k) =
    q656772_matrix_mult (q656772_matrix_pow A k) A"

definition q656772_scalar_mult ::
    "'a::semiring_0 \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix" where
  "q656772_scalar_mult c A = (\<lambda>i j. c * A i j)"

definition q656772_index_list :: "'i::finite list" where
  "q656772_index_list =
    (SOME xs. distinct xs \<and> set xs = (UNIV :: 'i set))"

definition q656772_poly_one :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::{zero, one}" where
  "q656772_poly_one = (\<lambda>n. if n = 0 then 1 else 0)"

definition q656772_poly_mult ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::semiring_0) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q656772_poly_mult p q =
    (\<lambda>n. \<Sum>k\<le>n. p k * q (n - k))"

definition q656772_poly_scalar_mult ::
    "'a::semiring_0 \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q656772_poly_scalar_mult c p = (\<lambda>n. c * p n)"

fun q656772_poly_sum_list ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::monoid_add) list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q656772_poly_sum_list [] = (\<lambda>_. 0)"
| "q656772_poly_sum_list (p # ps) =
    (\<lambda>n. p n + q656772_poly_sum_list ps n)"

definition q656772_characteristic_entry ::
    "('a::{comm_ring, comm_monoid_mult}, 'i) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      'i \<Rightarrow> 'i \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q656772_characteristic_entry A i j =
    (\<lambda>n.
      if n = 0 then - A i j
      else if n = 1 \<and> i = j then 1
      else 0)"

fun q656772_poly_determinant_list ::
    "('a::{comm_ring, comm_monoid_mult}, 'i) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      'i list \<Rightarrow> 'i list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q656772_poly_determinant_list A [] js = q656772_poly_one"
| "q656772_poly_determinant_list A (i # is) js =
    q656772_poly_sum_list
      (map
        (\<lambda>(k, j).
          q656772_poly_scalar_mult ((-1 :: 'a) ^ k)
            (q656772_poly_mult
              (q656772_characteristic_entry A i j)
              (q656772_poly_determinant_list A is (remove1 j js))))
        (zip [0..<length js] js))"

definition q656772_charpoly_coeff ::
    "('a::{comm_ring, comm_monoid_mult}, 'i::finite) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q656772_charpoly_coeff A =
    q656772_poly_determinant_list A
      q656772_index_list q656772_index_list"

definition q656772_eval_matrix ::
    "(nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::{comm_ring, comm_monoid_mult}) \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i::finite) q656772_matrix \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'i) q656772_matrix" where
  "q656772_eval_matrix p A =
    (\<lambda>i j.
      \<Sum>k\<le>card (UNIV :: 'i set).
        p k * q656772_matrix_pow A k i j)"

theorem q656772_cayley_hamilton:
  fixes A :: "('a::{comm_ring, comm_monoid_mult}, 'i::finite) q656772_matrix"
  shows "q656772_eval_matrix (q656772_charpoly_coeff A) A =
    q656772_zero_matrix"
  sorry

end

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656772
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q656772), "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": over
  any commutative ring, the characteristic polynomial of a square matrix on
  a finite index type annihilates that matrix. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q656772_CAYLEY_HAMILTON_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       (!x:R. addR zeroR x = x) /\
       (!x:R. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
       (!x y:R. addR x y = addR y x) /\
       (!x y z:R. addR x (addR y z) = addR (addR x y) z) /\
       (!x:R. mulR oneR x = x) /\
       (!x y:R. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
       (!x y z:R. mulR x (mulR y z) = mulR (mulR x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) in
   let matrix_identity =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (s:I->bool).
       \i j:I. if i IN s /\ j = i then oneR else zeroR in
   let matrix_mul =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (s:I->bool)
      (A:I->I->R) (B:I->I->R).
       \i j:I. iterate addR s (\k:I. mulR (A i k) (B k j)) in
   let matrix_pow =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (s:I->bool) (A:I->I->R) (n:num).
       ITLIST (matrix_mul zeroR addR mulR s)
         (REPLICATE n A) (matrix_identity zeroR oneR s) in
   let polynomial_mul =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (p:num->R) (q:num->R).
       \n:num. iterate addR (0..n) (\k:num. mulR (p k) (q (n - k))) in
   let apply_swaps =
     \(swaps:(I#I)list) (x:I).
       ITLIST
         (\ab y:I.
            if y = FST ab then SND ab
            else if y = SND ab then FST ab
            else y)
         swaps x in
   let even_permutation =
     \(s:I->bool) (p:I->I).
       ?swaps:(I#I)list.
         EVEN (LENGTH swaps) /\
         ALL
           (\ab:I#I.
              FST ab IN s /\ SND ab IN s /\ ~(FST ab = SND ab))
           swaps /\
         (!i:I. i IN s ==> apply_swaps swaps i = p i) in
   let signR =
     \(oneR:R) (negR:R->R) (s:I->bool) (p:I->I).
       if even_permutation s p then oneR else negR oneR in
   let permutations =
     \(s:I->bool).
       {p:I->I | BIJ p s s /\ (!i:I. ~(i IN s) ==> p i = i)} in
   let characteristic_coefficient =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (s:I->bool) (M:I->I->R) (n:num).
       iterate addR (permutations s)
         (\p:I->I.
            mulR (signR oneR negR s p)
              ((iterate (polynomial_mul zeroR addR mulR) s
                  (\i:I. \k:num.
                     if k = 0 then negR (M i (p i))
                     else if k = 1 /\ p i = i then oneR
                     else zeroR)) n)) in
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R.
   !s:I->bool.
   !M:I->I->R.
     is_comm_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     FINITE s
     ==>
     !i j:I.
       i IN s /\ j IN s
       ==>
       iterate addR (0..CARD s)
         (\n:num.
            mulR
              (characteristic_coefficient
                zeroR oneR addR mulR negR s M n)
              (matrix_pow zeroR oneR addR mulR s M n i j)) =
       zeroR`;;

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems artifact Q656772,
;; "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": the characteristic polynomial of every finite
;; square matrix over a commutative unital ring annihilates the matrix.  This
;; is expressed by the equivalent generic-matrix identity over an integer
;; polynomial ring.  This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; Multivariate integer polynomials are sorted lists of
;; (monomial . coefficient) pairs.  A monomial is a sorted list of variable
;; indices, with repetition recording powers.

(defun q656772-monomial-mul (left right)
  (declare (xargs :measure
                  (+ (acl2-count left) (acl2-count right))))
  (cond ((endp left) right)
        ((endp right) left)
        ((<= (car left) (car right))
         (cons (car left)
               (q656772-monomial-mul (cdr left) right)))
        (t
         (cons (car right)
               (q656772-monomial-mul left (cdr right))))))

(defun q656772-poly-insert-term (monomial coefficient polynomial)
  (cond ((equal coefficient 0) polynomial)
        ((endp polynomial)
         (list (cons monomial coefficient)))
        ((equal monomial (caar polynomial))
         (let ((sum (+ coefficient (cdar polynomial))))
           (if (equal sum 0)
               (cdr polynomial)
             (cons (cons monomial sum) (cdr polynomial)))))
        ((lexorder monomial (caar polynomial))
         (cons (cons monomial coefficient) polynomial))
        (t
         (cons (car polynomial)
               (q656772-poly-insert-term monomial coefficient
                                       (cdr polynomial))))))

(defun q656772-poly-add (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      right
    (q656772-poly-add
     (cdr left)
     (q656772-poly-insert-term (caar left) (cdar left) right))))

(defun q656772-poly-neg (polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (cons (cons (caar polynomial) (- (cdar polynomial)))
          (q656772-poly-neg (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun q656772-poly-mul-term (monomial coefficient polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (q656772-poly-insert-term
     (q656772-monomial-mul monomial (caar polynomial))
     (* coefficient (cdar polynomial))
     (q656772-poly-mul-term monomial coefficient (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun q656772-poly-mul (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (q656772-poly-add
     (q656772-poly-mul-term (caar left) (cdar left) right)
     (q656772-poly-mul (cdr left) right))))

(defun q656772-poly-one ()
  (list (cons nil 1)))

(defun q656772-poly-variable (index)
  (list (cons (list index) 1)))

;; Univariate polynomials in the characteristic indeterminate are coefficient
;; lists in ascending degree; their coefficients are the polynomials above.

(defun q656772-upoly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      nil
    (let ((tail (q656772-upoly-normalize (cdr coefficients))))
      (if (and (equal (car coefficients) nil)
               (endp tail))
          nil
        (cons (car coefficients) tail)))))

(defun q656772-upoly-add (left right)
  (cond ((endp left) right)
        ((endp right) left)
        (t
         (q656772-upoly-normalize
          (cons (q656772-poly-add (car left) (car right))
                (q656772-upoly-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))))

(defun q656772-upoly-neg (polynomial)
  (if (endp polynomial)
      nil
    (q656772-upoly-normalize
     (cons (q656772-poly-neg (car polynomial))
           (q656772-upoly-neg (cdr polynomial))))))

(defun q656772-upoly-scale (coefficient polynomial)
  (if (or (equal coefficient nil)
          (endp polynomial))
      nil
    (cons (q656772-poly-mul coefficient (car polynomial))
          (q656772-upoly-scale coefficient (cdr polynomial)))))

(defun q656772-upoly-mul (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (let ((tail-product (q656772-upoly-mul (cdr left) right)))
      (q656772-upoly-add
       (q656772-upoly-scale (car left) right)
       (if (endp tail-product)
           nil
         (cons nil tail-product))))))

(defun q656772-upoly-one ()
  (list (q656772-poly-one)))

(defun q656772-upoly-from-entry (entry diagonalp)
  (if diagonalp
      (list (q656772-poly-neg entry) (q656772-poly-one))
    (list (q656772-poly-neg entry))))

;; The generic n-by-n matrix has algebraically independent entries x_(i,j).

(defun q656772-range-from (start count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (q656772-range-from (+ 1 start) (- count 1)))))

(defun q656772-generic-row (n row columns)
  (if (endp columns)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-poly-variable
           (+ (* n row) (car columns)))
          (q656772-generic-row n row (cdr columns)))))

(defun q656772-generic-matrix-rows (n rows columns)
  (if (endp rows)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-generic-row n (car rows) columns)
          (q656772-generic-matrix-rows n (cdr rows) columns))))

(defun q656772-generic-matrix (n)
  (let ((indices (q656772-range-from 0 n)))
    (q656772-generic-matrix-rows n indices indices)))

;; Form tI-X, whose determinant is the characteristic polynomial of X.

(defun q656772-characteristic-row (row row-index column-index)
  (if (endp row)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-upoly-from-entry
           (car row)
           (equal row-index column-index))
          (q656772-characteristic-row
           (cdr row) row-index (+ 1 column-index)))))

(defun q656772-characteristic-matrix-rows (matrix row-index)
  (if (endp matrix)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-characteristic-row (car matrix) row-index 0)
          (q656772-characteristic-matrix-rows
           (cdr matrix) (+ 1 row-index)))))

(defun q656772-characteristic-matrix (matrix)
  (q656772-characteristic-matrix-rows matrix 0))

;; The determinant is the signed sum over permutations.

(defun q656772-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons (cons item (car lists))
          (q656772-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun q656772-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons (cons item list)
          (q656772-prefix-each
           (car list)
           (q656772-insert-everywhere item (cdr list))))))

(defun q656772-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append (q656772-insert-everywhere item (car lists))
            (q656772-insert-into-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun q656772-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (q656772-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (q656772-permutations (cdr list)))))

(defun q656772-count-greater (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      0
    (+ (if (> item (car list)) 1 0)
       (q656772-count-greater item (cdr list)))))

(defun q656772-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (q656772-count-greater (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (q656772-inversion-count (cdr permutation)))))

(defun q656772-upoly-diagonal-product (matrix permutation row-index)
  (if (endp permutation)
      (q656772-upoly-one)
    (q656772-upoly-mul
     (nth (car permutation) (nth row-index matrix))
     (q656772-upoly-diagonal-product
      matrix (cdr permutation) (+ 1 row-index)))))

(defun q656772-determinant-sum (matrix permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      nil
    (let* ((permutation (car permutations))
           (product
            (q656772-upoly-diagonal-product matrix permutation 0))
           (signed-product
            (if (equal (mod (q656772-inversion-count permutation) 2) 0)
                product
              (q656772-upoly-neg product))))
      (q656772-upoly-add
       signed-product
       (q656772-determinant-sum matrix (cdr permutations))))))

(defun q656772-upoly-matrix-det (matrix n)
  (q656772-determinant-sum
   matrix
   (q656772-permutations (q656772-range-from 0 n))))

;; Matrix arithmetic over the multivariate integer polynomial ring.

(defun q656772-zero-row (n)
  (if (zp n)
      nil
    (cons nil (q656772-zero-row (- n 1)))))

(defun q656772-zero-matrix-rows (n count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-zero-row n)
          (q656772-zero-matrix-rows n (- count 1)))))

(defun q656772-zero-matrix (n)
  (q656772-zero-matrix-rows n n))

(defun q656772-matrix-add-row (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-poly-add (car left) (car right))
          (q656772-matrix-add-row (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q656772-matrix-add (left right)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-matrix-add-row (car left) (car right))
          (q656772-matrix-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q656772-matrix-column (column matrix)
  (if (endp matrix)
      nil
    (cons (nth column (car matrix))
          (q656772-matrix-column column (cdr matrix)))))

(defun q656772-poly-dot-product (left right)
  (if (or (endp left) (endp right))
      nil
    (q656772-poly-add
     (q656772-poly-mul (car left) (car right))
     (q656772-poly-dot-product (cdr left) (cdr right)))))

(defun q656772-matrix-mul-row (row right column count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-poly-dot-product
           row
           (q656772-matrix-column column right))
          (q656772-matrix-mul-row
           row right (+ 1 column) (- count 1)))))

(defun q656772-matrix-mul-rows (left right n)
  (if (endp left)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-matrix-mul-row (car left) right 0 n)
          (q656772-matrix-mul-rows (cdr left) right n))))

(defun q656772-matrix-mul (left right n)
  (q656772-matrix-mul-rows left right n))

(defun q656772-scalar-row (coefficient row column count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (if (equal row column) coefficient nil)
          (q656772-scalar-row
           coefficient row (+ 1 column) (- count 1)))))

(defun q656772-scalar-matrix-rows (coefficient row n count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons (q656772-scalar-row coefficient row 0 n)
          (q656772-scalar-matrix-rows
           coefficient (+ 1 row) n (- count 1)))))

(defun q656772-scalar-matrix (coefficient n)
  (q656772-scalar-matrix-rows coefficient 0 n n))

(defun q656772-eval-upoly-at-matrix (coefficients matrix n)
  (if (endp coefficients)
      (q656772-zero-matrix n)
    (q656772-matrix-add
     (q656772-scalar-matrix (car coefficients) n)
     (q656772-matrix-mul
      matrix
      (q656772-eval-upoly-at-matrix (cdr coefficients) matrix n)
      n))))

(defun q656772-cayley-hamilton-statement (n)
  (implies
   (natp n)
   (let* ((matrix (q656772-generic-matrix n))
          (characteristic-polynomial
           (q656772-upoly-matrix-det
            (q656772-characteristic-matrix matrix)
            n)))
     (equal
      (q656772-eval-upoly-at-matrix
       characteristic-polynomial matrix n)
      (q656772-zero-matrix n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656772,
-- "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": every square matrix over a commutative ring, indexed
-- by an arbitrary finite type, is annihilated by its characteristic polynomial.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (suc n)

record FiniteIndex
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    size : Nat
    toFin : I → Fin size
    fromFin : Fin size → I
    to-from :
      (k : Fin size) →
      toFin (fromFin k) ≡ k
    from-to :
      (x : I) →
      fromFin (toFin x) ≡ x

open FiniteIndex

record RingOperations
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR : R → R

open RingOperations

record CommutativeRing
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    operations : RingOperations R

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      addR operations x y ≡ addR operations y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR operations (addR operations x y) z ≡
      addR operations x (addR operations y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) →
      addR operations x (zeroR operations) ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) →
      addR operations x (negateR operations x) ≡
      zeroR operations

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR operations x y ≡ multiplyR operations y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR operations (multiplyR operations x y) z ≡
      multiplyR operations x (multiplyR operations y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR operations x (oneR operations) ≡ x
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR operations x (addR operations y z) ≡
      addR operations
        (multiplyR operations x y)
        (multiplyR operations x z)

open CommutativeRing

Polynomial :
  {r : Level} →
  Set r →
  Set r
Polynomial R =
  List R

polynomialAdd :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
polynomialAdd operations [] q =
  q
polynomialAdd operations p [] =
  p
polynomialAdd operations (x ∷ p) (y ∷ q) =
  addR operations x y ∷ polynomialAdd operations p q

polynomialNegate :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
polynomialNegate operations [] =
  []
polynomialNegate operations (x ∷ p) =
  negateR operations x ∷ polynomialNegate operations p

polynomialScale :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
polynomialScale operations scalar [] =
  []
polynomialScale operations scalar (x ∷ p) =
  multiplyR operations scalar x ∷
  polynomialScale operations scalar p

polynomialMultiply :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R →
  Polynomial R
polynomialMultiply operations [] q =
  []
polynomialMultiply operations (x ∷ p) q =
  polynomialAdd operations
    (polynomialScale operations x q)
    (zeroR operations ∷ polynomialMultiply operations p q)

polynomialOperations :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  RingOperations (Polynomial R)
polynomialOperations operations =
  record
    { zeroR = []
    ; oneR = oneR operations ∷ []
    ; addR = polynomialAdd operations
    ; multiplyR = polynomialMultiply operations
    ; negateR = polynomialNegate operations
    }

constantPolynomial :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  R →
  Polynomial R
constantPolynomial operations x =
  x ∷ []

variablePolynomial :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  Polynomial R
variablePolynomial operations =
  zeroR operations ∷ oneR operations ∷ []

Matrix :
  {i r : Level} →
  Set i →
  Set r →
  Set (i ⊔ r)
Matrix I R =
  I → I → R

MatrixEqual :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix I R →
  Set (i ⊔ r)
MatrixEqual {I = I} A B =
  (row column : I) →
  A row column ≡ B row column

finEqual :
  {n : Nat} →
  Fin n →
  Fin n →
  Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

select :
  {a : Level} →
  {A : Set a} →
  Bool →
  A →
  A →
  A
select true yes no =
  yes
select false yes no =
  no

sumFin :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → R) →
  R
sumFin operations {zero} term =
  zeroR operations
sumFin operations {suc n} term =
  addR operations
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin operations (λ k → term (fsuc k)))

sumIndex :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  FiniteIndex I →
  RingOperations R →
  (I → R) →
  R
sumIndex finite operations term =
  sumFin operations (λ k → term (fromFin finite k))

zeroMatrix :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  Matrix I R
zeroMatrix operations row column =
  zeroR operations

scalarMatrix :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  FiniteIndex I →
  RingOperations R →
  R →
  Matrix I R
scalarMatrix finite operations scalar row column =
  select
    (finEqual (toFin finite row) (toFin finite column))
    scalar
    (zeroR operations)

matrixAdd :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix I R
matrixAdd operations A B row column =
  addR operations (A row column) (B row column)

matrixMultiply :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  FiniteIndex I →
  RingOperations R →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix I R
matrixMultiply finite operations A B row column =
  sumIndex finite operations
    (λ k → multiplyR operations (A row k) (B k column))

reindexMatrix :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix (Fin (size finite)) R
reindexMatrix finite A row column =
  A (fromFin finite row) (fromFin finite column)

skip :
  {n : Nat} →
  Fin (suc n) →
  Fin n →
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} column ()
skip {suc n} fzero k =
  fsuc k
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) (fsuc k) =
  fsuc (skip column k)

firstRowMinor :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  {n : Nat} →
  Matrix (Fin (suc n)) R →
  Fin (suc n) →
  Matrix (Fin n) R
firstRowMinor A column row minor-column =
  A (fsuc row) (skip column minor-column)

alternatingSign :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  {n : Nat} →
  Fin n →
  R
alternatingSign operations fzero =
  oneR operations
alternatingSign operations (fsuc i) =
  negateR operations (alternatingSign operations i)

determinant :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  {n : Nat} →
  Matrix (Fin n) R →
  R
determinant operations {zero} A =
  oneR operations
determinant operations {suc n} A =
  sumFin operations
    (λ column →
      multiplyR operations
        (alternatingSign operations column)
        (multiplyR operations
          (A fzero column)
          (determinant operations (firstRowMinor A column))))

characteristicMatrix :
  {r : Level} →
  {R : Set r} →
  RingOperations R →
  {n : Nat} →
  Matrix (Fin n) R →
  Matrix (Fin n) (Polynomial R)
characteristicMatrix operations A row column =
  select (finEqual row column)
    (polynomialAdd operations
      (variablePolynomial operations)
      (polynomialNegate operations
        (constantPolynomial operations (A row column))))
    (polynomialNegate operations
      (constantPolynomial operations (A row column)))

characteristicPolynomial :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  CommutativeRing R →
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) →
  Matrix I R →
  Polynomial R
characteristicPolynomial ring finite A =
  determinant
    (polynomialOperations (operations ring))
    (characteristicMatrix
      (operations ring)
      (reindexMatrix finite A))

evaluateAtMatrix :
  {i r : Level} →
  {I : Set i} →
  {R : Set r} →
  FiniteIndex I →
  RingOperations R →
  Polynomial R →
  Matrix I R →
  Matrix I R
evaluateAtMatrix finite operations [] A =
  zeroMatrix operations
evaluateAtMatrix finite operations (coefficient ∷ coefficients) A =
  matrixAdd operations
    (scalarMatrix finite operations coefficient)
    (matrixMultiply finite operations A
      (evaluateAtMatrix finite operations coefficients A))

cayley-hamilton-theorem : Setω
cayley-hamilton-theorem =
  {i r : Level} →
  (I : Set i) →
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) →
  (R : Set r) →
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) →
  (A : Matrix I R) →
  MatrixEqual
    (evaluateAtMatrix finite
      (operations ring)
      (characteristicPolynomial ring finite A)
      A)
    (zeroMatrix (operations ring))

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q656772, "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": for a square matrix over an arbitrary
  commutative ring on a finite index carrier, the characteristic polynomial
  det(XI - A) evaluates at the matrix to the zero matrix. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory permutesTheory ringTheory;

val cayley_hamilton_theorem =
  ``let poly_zero =
      \(r : 'a ring) (k : num). r.sum.id
    in
    let poly_one =
      \(r : 'a ring) (k : num).
        if k = 0 then r.prod.id else r.sum.id
    in
    let poly_add =
      \(r : 'a ring) (p : num -> 'a) (q : num -> 'a) (k : num).
        r.sum.op (p k) (q k)
    in
    let poly_neg =
      \(r : 'a ring) (p : num -> 'a) (k : num).
        r.sum.inv (p k)
    in
    let poly_mul =
      \(r : 'a ring) (p : num -> 'a) (q : num -> 'a) (k : num).
        ITSET
          (\i acc. r.sum.op (r.prod.op (p i) (q (k - i))) acc)
          (count (SUC k)) r.sum.id
    in
    let char_entry =
      \(r : 'a ring) (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a)
       (i : 'i) (j : 'i) (k : num).
        r.sum.op
          (if i = j /\ k = 1 then r.prod.id else r.sum.id)
          (if k = 0 then r.sum.inv (A i j) else r.sum.id)
    in
    let det_term =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a)
       (p : 'i -> 'i).
        let diagonal_product =
          ITSET
            (\i q. poly_mul r (char_entry r A i (p i)) q)
            s (poly_one r)
        in
          if evenperm p then diagonal_product
          else poly_neg r diagonal_product
    in
    let char_poly =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a).
        ITSET
          (\p q. poly_add r (det_term r s A p) q)
          {p : 'i -> 'i | p permutes s} (poly_zero r)
    in
    let matrix_zero =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (i : 'i) (j : 'i).
        r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_one =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (i : 'i) (j : 'i).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i = j then r.prod.id else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_add =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool)
       (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (B : 'i -> 'i -> 'a)
       (i : 'i) (j : 'i).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s
        then r.sum.op (A i j) (B i j)
        else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_mul =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool)
       (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (B : 'i -> 'i -> 'a)
       (i : 'i) (j : 'i).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s
        then
          ITSET
            (\k acc. r.sum.op (r.prod.op (A i k) (B k j)) acc)
            s r.sum.id
        else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_scale =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (c : 'a)
       (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (i : 'i) (j : 'i).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s
        then r.prod.op c (A i j)
        else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_pow =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool)
       (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a) (k : num).
        FUNPOW (\B. matrix_mul r s B A) k (matrix_one r s)
    in
    let matrix_poly_eval =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (p : num -> 'a)
       (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a).
        ITSET
          (\k B.
            matrix_add r s
              (matrix_scale r s (p k) (matrix_pow r s A k)) B)
          (count (SUC (CARD s))) (matrix_zero r s)
    in
      !(r : 'a ring) (s : 'i -> bool) (A : 'i -> 'i -> 'a).
        Ring r /\
        FINITE s /\
        (!i j. i IN s /\ j IN s ==> A i j IN r.carrier)
        ==>
        matrix_poly_eval r s (char_poly r s A) A = matrix_zero r s``;

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q656772
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q656772), "Cayley-Hamilton theorem": over every
  commutative ring, each square matrix on an arbitrary finite index carrier
  evaluates its characteristic polynomial to the zero matrix. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For a finite carrier N and commutative ring R, ( N CharPlyMat R ) maps a
  square matrix M to det(tI - M).  The coefficient function coe1, scalar
  multiplication in ( N Mat R ), powers in its multiplicative monoid, and
  gsum together give the usual polynomial evaluation at M.

  The following $a is the single unproved corpus statement.  This artifact
  adds no $p assertion.
$)

${
  $d M N R n $.
  thousand-theorems-q656772-cayley-hamilton-theorem $a |- A. R e. CRing
    A. N e. Fin
    A. M e. ( Base ` ( N Mat R ) )
      ( ( N Mat R ) gsum
          ( n e. NN0 |->
            ( ( ( coe1 ` ( ( N CharPlyMat R ) ` M ) ) ` n )
              ( .s ` ( N Mat R ) )
              ( n ( .g ` ( mulGrp ` ( N Mat R ) ) ) M ) ) ) )
        = ( 0g ` ( N Mat R ) ) ) $.
$}

title: Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q656772
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q656772), "Cayley–Hamilton theorem": every square
% matrix indexed by a finite type over an arbitrary commutative ring satisfies
% its characteristic polynomial. This file contains no proof.

Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem[
  n: nat,
  R: TYPE+,
  zero, one: R,
  neg: [R -> R],
  add, mul: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  polynomial: TYPE = [nat -> R]
  matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> R]

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: R): add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R): add(x, neg(x)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R): mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: R): mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(x, add(y, z)) =
          add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))

  ring_sum(
      values: [nat -> R],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      add(
        ring_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  polynomial_zero: polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat): zero)

  constant_polynomial(value: R): polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 0 THEN value ELSE zero ENDIF)

  polynomial_one: polynomial =
    constant_polynomial(one)

  variable_polynomial: polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      IF degree = 1 THEN one ELSE zero ENDIF)

  polynomial_negate(p: polynomial): polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat): neg(p(degree)))

  polynomial_add(p, q: polynomial): polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      add(p(degree), q(degree)))

  polynomial_scale(value: R, p: polynomial): polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      mul(value, p(degree)))

  polynomial_multiply(p, q: polynomial): polynomial =
    (LAMBDA (degree: nat):
      ring_sum(
        (LAMBDA (index: nat):
          IF index <= degree THEN
            mul(p(index), q(degree - index))
          ELSE
            zero
          ENDIF),
        degree + 1))

  zero_matrix: matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat): zero)

  identity_matrix: matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n AND column < n AND row = column THEN
        one
      ELSE
        zero
      ENDIF)

  matrix_add(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      add(A(row, column), B(row, column)))

  matrix_scale(value: R, A: matrix): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      mul(value, A(row, column)))

  matrix_multiply(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n AND column < n THEN
        ring_sum(
          (LAMBDA (index: nat):
            mul(A(row, index), B(index, column))),
          n)
      ELSE
        zero
      ENDIF)

  matrix_power(A: matrix, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE matrix =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      identity_matrix
    ELSE
      matrix_multiply(
        matrix_power(A, exponent - 1),
        A)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  matrix_sum(
      values: [nat -> matrix],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE matrix =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_matrix
    ELSE
      matrix_add(
        matrix_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  matrix_polynomial_value(p: polynomial, A: matrix): matrix =
    matrix_sum(
      (LAMBDA (degree: nat):
        matrix_scale(
          p(degree),
          matrix_power(A, degree))),
      n + 1)

  function_code_count: nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN 1 ELSE n ^ n ENDIF

  permutation_entry(code, row: nat): nat =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(safe_ndiv(code, n ^ row), n)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(code: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < n
          AND row_2 < n
          AND permutation_entry(code, row_1)
            = permutation_entry(code, row_2))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(pair: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, n)

  pair_column(pair: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, n)

  inversion_at(code, pair: nat): bool =
    pair_row(pair) < n
      AND pair_column(pair) < n
      AND pair_row(pair) < pair_column(pair)
      AND permutation_entry(code, pair_row(pair))
        > permutation_entry(code, pair_column(pair))

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(code: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat): inversion_at(code, pair)),
      n * n)

  permutation_sign(code: nat): R =
    IF mod(inversion_count(code), 2) = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      neg(one)
    ENDIF

  characteristic_entry(
      A: matrix,
      row, column: nat): polynomial =
    IF row = column THEN
      polynomial_add(
        variable_polynomial,
        polynomial_negate(
          constant_polynomial(A(row, column))))
    ELSE
      polynomial_negate(
        constant_polynomial(A(row, column)))
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: matrix,
      code, count: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      polynomial_one
    ELSE
      polynomial_multiply(
        permutation_product(A, code, count - 1),
        characteristic_entry(
          A,
          count - 1,
          permutation_entry(code, count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: matrix,
      limit: nat): RECURSIVE polynomial =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      polynomial_zero
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        polynomial_add(
          determinant_sum(A, limit - 1),
          IF permutation_code(code) THEN
            polynomial_scale(
              permutation_sign(code),
              permutation_product(A, code, n))
          ELSE
            polynomial_zero
          ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  characteristic_polynomial(A: matrix): polynomial =
    determinant_sum(A, function_code_count)

  matrix_equal_on_carrier(A, B: matrix): bool =
    FORALL (row, column: nat):
      (row < n AND column < n)
        IMPLIES A(row, column) = B(row, column)

  cayley_hamilton_theorem: bool =
    commutative_ring_laws IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A: matrix):
        matrix_equal_on_carrier(
          matrix_polynomial_value(
            characteristic_polynomial(A),
            A),
          zero_matrix))
END Q656772_cayley_hamilton_theorem
