title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q657482
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q657482), "Abel–Ruffini theorem": there exists a
  complex number algebraic over the rationals that is not solvable by radicals
  over the rationals. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List QArith.QArith Reals.

Import ListNotations.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q657482_complex : Type := (R * R)%type.

Definition q657482_czero : q657482_complex := (0, 0).
Definition q657482_cone : q657482_complex := (1, 0).

Definition q657482_cadd
    (z w : q657482_complex) : q657482_complex :=
  (fst z + fst w, snd z + snd w).

Definition q657482_cneg
    (z : q657482_complex) : q657482_complex :=
  (- fst z, - snd z).

Definition q657482_cmul
    (z w : q657482_complex) : q657482_complex :=
  (fst z * fst w - snd z * snd w,
   fst z * snd w + snd z * fst w).

Definition q657482_cinv
    (z : q657482_complex) : q657482_complex :=
  let denominator := fst z * fst z + snd z * snd z in
  (fst z / denominator, - snd z / denominator).

Fixpoint q657482_cpow
    (z : q657482_complex) (n : nat) : q657482_complex :=
  match n with
  | O => q657482_cone
  | S k => q657482_cmul z (q657482_cpow z k)
  end.

Definition q657482_rat_embed (q : Q) : q657482_complex :=
  (Q2R q, 0).

Fixpoint q657482_poly_eval
    (coefficients : list Q)
    (z : q657482_complex) : q657482_complex :=
  match coefficients with
  | [] => q657482_czero
  | coefficient :: higher_coefficients =>
      q657482_cadd
        (q657482_rat_embed coefficient)
        (q657482_cmul z
          (q657482_poly_eval higher_coefficients z))
  end.

Definition q657482_nonzero_polynomial
    (coefficients : list Q) : Prop :=
  exists coefficient : Q,
    In coefficient coefficients /\ ~ Qeq coefficient 0%Q.

Definition q657482_is_algebraic
    (z : q657482_complex) : Prop :=
  exists coefficients : list Q,
    q657482_nonzero_polynomial coefficients /\
    q657482_poly_eval coefficients z = q657482_czero.

Inductive q657482_solvable_by_rad : q657482_complex -> Prop :=
| q657482_sbr_base :
    forall q : Q,
      q657482_solvable_by_rad (q657482_rat_embed q)
| q657482_sbr_add :
    forall z w : q657482_complex,
      q657482_solvable_by_rad z ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad w ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad (q657482_cadd z w)
| q657482_sbr_neg :
    forall z : q657482_complex,
      q657482_solvable_by_rad z ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad (q657482_cneg z)
| q657482_sbr_mul :
    forall z w : q657482_complex,
      q657482_solvable_by_rad z ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad w ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad (q657482_cmul z w)
| q657482_sbr_inv :
    forall z : q657482_complex,
      q657482_solvable_by_rad z ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad (q657482_cinv z)
| q657482_sbr_rad :
    forall (z : q657482_complex) (n : nat),
      n <> O ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad (q657482_cpow z n) ->
      q657482_solvable_by_rad z.

Theorem AbelRuffini_exists_not_solvable_by_rad :
  exists z : q657482_complex,
    q657482_is_algebraic z /\
    ~ q657482_solvable_by_rad z.
Admitted.

title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q657482 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q657482), "Abel-Ruffini theorem":
  there exists a complex number algebraic over the rationals that is not
  solvable by radicals over the rationals. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

inductive q657482_solvable_by_radicals :: "complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  rational: "q657482_solvable_by_radicals (of_rat q)"
| negation:
    "q657482_solvable_by_radicals z \<Longrightarrow>
      q657482_solvable_by_radicals (-z)"
| inverse:
    "q657482_solvable_by_radicals z \<Longrightarrow>
      q657482_solvable_by_radicals (inverse z)"
| addition:
    "\<lbrakk>q657482_solvable_by_radicals z1;
      q657482_solvable_by_radicals z2\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q657482_solvable_by_radicals (z1 + z2)"
| multiplication:
    "\<lbrakk>q657482_solvable_by_radicals z1;
      q657482_solvable_by_radicals z2\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q657482_solvable_by_radicals (z1 * z2)"
| radical:
    "\<lbrakk>q657482_solvable_by_radicals (z ^ n); n > 0\<rbrakk>
      \<Longrightarrow> q657482_solvable_by_radicals z"

fun q657482_eval_rat_polynomial :: "rat list \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> complex" where
  "q657482_eval_rat_polynomial [] z = 0"
| "q657482_eval_rat_polynomial (q # qs) z =
    of_rat q + z * q657482_eval_rat_polynomial qs z"

definition q657482_algebraic_over_rationals :: "complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q657482_algebraic_over_rationals z \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>qs :: rat list.
      (\<exists>q \<in> set qs. q \<noteq> 0) \<and>
      q657482_eval_rat_polynomial qs z = 0)"

theorem q657482_abel_ruffini:
  "\<exists>z :: complex.
    q657482_algebraic_over_rationals z \<and>
    \<not> q657482_solvable_by_radicals z"
  sorry

end

title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q657482,
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q657482), "Abel–Ruffini theorem": there
  exists a complex number algebraic over the rationals that is not solvable
  by radicals over the rationals. This file contains no proof.
*)

needs "Library/floor.ml";;
needs "Complex/cpoly.ml";;

let Q657482_ABEL_RUFFINI_THEOREM =
  `let is_rational_complex =
     \c:complex. ?q:real. rational q /\ c = Cx q in
   let is_algebraic_over_rationals =
     \z:complex.
       ?p:complex list.
         ALL is_rational_complex p /\
         ~(poly p = poly []) /\
         poly p z = Cx(&0) in
   let is_radically_solvable_over_rationals =
     \z:complex.
       !R:complex->bool.
         ((!q:real. rational q ==> R (Cx q)) /\
          (!x:complex. R x ==> R (--x)) /\
          (!x:complex. R x /\ ~(x = Cx(&0)) ==> R (inv x)) /\
          (!x y:complex. R x /\ R y ==> R (x + y)) /\
          (!x y:complex. R x /\ R y ==> R (x * y)) /\
          (!n:num. ~(n = 0) ==>
             !x y:complex. R x /\ y pow n = x ==> R y))
         ==> R z in
   ?z:complex.
     is_algebraic_over_rationals z /\
     ~(is_radically_solvable_over_rationals z)`;;

title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q657482,
;; "Abel-Ruffini theorem": there exists a complex number algebraic over the
;; rationals that is not obtainable from rational numbers by field operations
;; and extraction of positive-degree roots. This file contains no proof.
;;
;; An algebraic complex number is represented exactly by rational polynomials
;; for its real and imaginary parts in one real algebraic primitive element.
;; A nonconstant rational polynomial and rational isolating interval select
;; that primitive element, and Sturm root counts decide equality and order exactly. Every
;; algebraic complex number has such a representation. Every finite radical
;; certificate also has a common primitive-element representation; an exact
;; embedding into that common field recodes the target number. Consequently
;; the predicate below is bidirectionally equivalent to the source existential
;; over algebraic elements of the usual complex numbers.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Polynomials are proper lists of rational coefficients in ascending degree
;; order. The empty list is the zero polynomial.

(defun q657482-rational-polynomial-p (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (and
       (rationalp (car polynomial))
       (q657482-rational-polynomial-p (cdr polynomial)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun q657482-poly-normalize (coefficients)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (let ((tail
             (q657482-poly-normalize (cdr coefficients))))
        (if (and
             (equal (car coefficients) 0)
             (not (consp tail)))
            nil
          (cons (car coefficients) tail)))
    nil))

(defun q657482-poly-add (left right)
  (cond
   ((consp left)
    (if (consp right)
        (cons
         (+ (car left) (car right))
         (q657482-poly-add (cdr left) (cdr right)))
      left))
   (t right)))

(defun q657482-poly-scale (scalar polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (cons
       (* scalar (car polynomial))
       (q657482-poly-scale scalar (cdr polynomial)))
    nil))

(defun q657482-poly-negate (polynomial)
  (q657482-poly-scale -1 polynomial))

(defun q657482-poly-subtract (left right)
  (q657482-poly-normalize
   (q657482-poly-add
    left
    (q657482-poly-negate right))))

(defun q657482-poly-multiply (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (q657482-poly-normalize
       (q657482-poly-add
        (q657482-poly-scale (car left) right)
        (cons
         0
         (q657482-poly-multiply (cdr left) right))))
    nil))

(defun q657482-poly-compose (outer inner)
  (if (consp outer)
      (q657482-poly-normalize
       (q657482-poly-add
        (list (car outer))
        (q657482-poly-multiply
         inner
         (q657482-poly-compose (cdr outer) inner))))
    nil))

(defun q657482-poly-derivative-aux (coefficients degree)
  (if (consp coefficients)
      (cons
       (* degree (car coefficients))
       (q657482-poly-derivative-aux
        (cdr coefficients) (+ degree 1)))
    nil))

(defun q657482-poly-derivative (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q657482-poly-normalize
       (q657482-poly-derivative-aux
        (cdr polynomial) 1))
    nil))

(defun q657482-zero-list (count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons
     0
     (q657482-zero-list (- count 1)))))

(defun q657482-poly-monomial (coefficient degree)
  (if (equal coefficient 0)
      nil
    (append
     (q657482-zero-list degree)
     (list coefficient))))

(defun q657482-poly-degree (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (q657482-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (- (len normalized) 1)
      0)))

(defun q657482-poly-leading-coefficient (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (q657482-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (nth (q657482-poly-degree normalized) normalized)
      0)))

;; The step bound makes polynomial long division total. Every nonterminal
;; division step lowers the current remainder degree.

(defun q657482-poly-divmod-steps
    (remainder divisor quotient steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (if (zp steps)
      (cons
       (q657482-poly-normalize quotient)
       (q657482-poly-normalize remainder))
    (let* ((normalized-remainder
            (q657482-poly-normalize remainder))
           (normalized-divisor
            (q657482-poly-normalize divisor)))
      (if (or
           (not (consp normalized-remainder))
           (not (consp normalized-divisor))
           (<
            (q657482-poly-degree normalized-remainder)
            (q657482-poly-degree normalized-divisor)))
          (cons
           (q657482-poly-normalize quotient)
           normalized-remainder)
        (let* ((degree-difference
                (-
                 (q657482-poly-degree normalized-remainder)
                 (q657482-poly-degree normalized-divisor)))
               (coefficient
                (/
                 (q657482-poly-leading-coefficient
                  normalized-remainder)
                 (q657482-poly-leading-coefficient
                  normalized-divisor)))
               (term
                (q657482-poly-monomial
                 coefficient degree-difference)))
          (q657482-poly-divmod-steps
           (q657482-poly-subtract
            normalized-remainder
            (q657482-poly-multiply
             term normalized-divisor))
           normalized-divisor
           (q657482-poly-add quotient term)
           (- steps 1)))))))

(defun q657482-poly-divmod (dividend divisor)
  (q657482-poly-divmod-steps
   dividend
   divisor
   nil
   (+ 1
      (len (q657482-poly-normalize dividend)))))

(defun q657482-poly-remainder (dividend divisor)
  (cdr (q657482-poly-divmod dividend divisor)))

(defun q657482-poly-gcd-steps (left right steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-left
         (q657482-poly-normalize left))
        (normalized-right
         (q657482-poly-normalize right)))
    (if (or
         (zp steps)
         (not (consp normalized-right)))
        normalized-left
      (q657482-poly-gcd-steps
       normalized-right
       (q657482-poly-remainder
        normalized-left normalized-right)
       (- steps 1)))))

(defun q657482-poly-gcd (left right)
  (q657482-poly-gcd-steps
   left
   right
   (+ 2
      (len (q657482-poly-normalize left))
      (len (q657482-poly-normalize right)))))

(defun q657482-sturm-tail (previous current steps)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix steps)))
  (let ((normalized-current
         (q657482-poly-normalize current)))
    (if (or
         (zp steps)
         (not (consp normalized-current)))
        nil
      (cons
       normalized-current
       (q657482-sturm-tail
        normalized-current
        (q657482-poly-negate
         (q657482-poly-remainder
          previous normalized-current))
        (- steps 1))))))

(defun q657482-sturm-chain (polynomial)
  (let ((normalized
         (q657482-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (if (consp normalized)
        (cons
         normalized
         (q657482-sturm-tail
          normalized
          (q657482-poly-derivative normalized)
          (+ 1 (len normalized))))
      nil)))

(defun q657482-poly-evaluate (polynomial value)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (+
       (car polynomial)
       (* value
          (q657482-poly-evaluate
           (cdr polynomial) value)))
    0))

(defun q657482-chain-values-at (chain value)
  (if (consp chain)
      (cons
       (q657482-poly-evaluate (car chain) value)
       (q657482-chain-values-at (cdr chain) value))
    nil))

(defun q657482-sign (value)
  (cond
   ((< value 0) -1)
   ((< 0 value) 1)
   (t 0)))

(defun q657482-sign-variations-aux
    (values previous-sign)
  (if (consp values)
      (let ((current-sign
             (q657482-sign (car values))))
        (cond
         ((equal current-sign 0)
          (q657482-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) previous-sign))
         ((equal previous-sign 0)
          (q657482-sign-variations-aux
           (cdr values) current-sign))
         (t
          (+
           (if (equal current-sign previous-sign) 0 1)
           (q657482-sign-variations-aux
            (cdr values) current-sign)))))
    0))

(defun q657482-sign-variations (values)
  (q657482-sign-variations-aux values 0))

(defun q657482-open-root-count
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((chain
         (q657482-sturm-chain polynomial)))
    (-
     (q657482-sign-variations
      (q657482-chain-values-at chain lower))
     (q657482-sign-variations
      (q657482-chain-values-at chain upper)))))

(defun q657482-isolates-one-root-p
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized
         (q657482-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (q657482-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (< 0 (q657482-poly-degree normalized))
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not
      (equal
       (q657482-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
       0))
     (not
      (equal
       (q657482-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
       0))
     (equal
      (q657482-open-root-count normalized lower upper)
      1))))

(defun q657482-root-free-p
    (polynomial lower upper)
  (let ((normalized
         (q657482-poly-normalize polynomial)))
    (and
     (q657482-rational-polynomial-p normalized)
     (consp normalized)
     (rationalp lower)
     (rationalp upper)
     (< lower upper)
     (not
      (equal
       (q657482-poly-evaluate normalized lower)
       0))
     (not
      (equal
       (q657482-poly-evaluate normalized upper)
       0))
     (equal
      (q657482-open-root-count normalized lower upper)
      0))))

;; The selected root of primitive is a zero of value exactly when their gcd
;; has the same unique root in the isolating interval.

(defun q657482-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (let ((normalized-value
         (q657482-poly-normalize value)))
    (or
     (not (consp normalized-value))
     (q657482-isolates-one-root-p
      (q657482-poly-gcd primitive normalized-value)
      lower
      upper))))

;; A certificate interval may always be refined until every nonzero polynomial
;; tested for order has constant sign throughout the interval.

(defun q657482-sign-decidable-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (or
   (q657482-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    primitive value lower upper)
   (q657482-root-free-p value lower upper)))

(defun q657482-sign-at-isolated-root
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (if (q657482-zero-at-isolated-root-p
       primitive value lower upper)
      0
    (q657482-sign
     (q657482-poly-evaluate value lower))))

(defun q657482-positive-at-isolated-root-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (and
   (q657482-sign-decidable-p
    primitive value lower upper)
   (equal
    (q657482-sign-at-isolated-root
     primitive value lower upper)
    1)))

;; A complex value over the selected primitive is a pair of rational
;; polynomials giving its real and imaginary parts.

(defun q657482-complex-polynomial-p (value)
  (and
   (true-listp value)
   (equal (len value) 2)
   (q657482-rational-polynomial-p (nth 0 value))
   (q657482-rational-polynomial-p (nth 1 value))))

(defun q657482-complex-zero ()
  (list nil nil))

(defun q657482-complex-one ()
  (list (list 1) nil))

(defun q657482-complex-rational (value)
  (list (list value) nil))

(defun q657482-complex-negate (value)
  (list
   (q657482-poly-negate (nth 0 value))
   (q657482-poly-negate (nth 1 value))))

(defun q657482-complex-add (left right)
  (list
   (q657482-poly-add (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
   (q657482-poly-add (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))))

(defun q657482-complex-multiply (left right)
  (list
   (q657482-poly-subtract
    (q657482-poly-multiply
     (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
    (q657482-poly-multiply
     (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right)))
   (q657482-poly-add
    (q657482-poly-multiply
     (nth 0 left) (nth 1 right))
    (q657482-poly-multiply
     (nth 1 left) (nth 0 right)))))

(defun q657482-complex-power (value exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q657482-complex-one)
    (q657482-complex-multiply
     value
     (q657482-complex-power value (- exponent 1)))))

(defun q657482-complex-compose (value substitution)
  (list
   (q657482-poly-compose (nth 0 value) substitution)
   (q657482-poly-compose (nth 1 value) substitution)))

(defun q657482-complex-equal-p
    (primitive left right lower upper)
  (and
   (q657482-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    primitive
    (q657482-poly-subtract
     (nth 0 left) (nth 0 right))
    lower upper)
   (q657482-zero-at-isolated-root-p
    primitive
    (q657482-poly-subtract
     (nth 1 left) (nth 1 right))
    lower upper)))

(defun q657482-complex-zero-p
    (primitive value lower upper)
  (q657482-complex-equal-p
   primitive value (q657482-complex-zero) lower upper))

;; A five-component code consists of the primitive polynomial, its isolating
;; interval, and the real and imaginary polynomials. This codes exactly the
;; algebraic complex numbers: polynomial evaluation in an algebraic real is
;; algebraic, while the primitive-element theorem supplies such a code for
;; the real and imaginary parts of every algebraic complex number.

(defun q657482-algebraic-complex-code-p (number)
  (and
   (true-listp number)
   (equal (len number) 5)
   (q657482-isolates-one-root-p
    (nth 0 number) (nth 1 number) (nth 2 number))
   (q657482-rational-polynomial-p (nth 3 number))
   (q657482-rational-polynomial-p (nth 4 number))))

(defun q657482-number-value (number)
  (list (nth 3 number) (nth 4 number)))

;; A radical certificate is a finite topological derivation. Each step is a
;; pair whose car is an instruction and whose cdr is the exact complex output.
;; Natural-number arguments index earlier outputs, with zero denoting the most
;; recent one. The instructions present Mathlib's solvableByRad closure:
;; rational constants, field operations, and positive-degree root extraction.

(defun q657482-radical-step-p
    (primitive lower upper step previous-values)
  (let ((instruction (car step))
        (output (cdr step)))
    (and
     (consp step)
     (true-listp instruction)
     (consp instruction)
     (q657482-complex-polynomial-p output)
     (cond
      ((equal (car instruction) :rational)
       (and
        (equal (len instruction) 2)
        (rationalp (cadr instruction))
        (q657482-complex-equal-p
         primitive
         output
         (q657482-complex-rational (cadr instruction))
         lower upper)))
      ((equal (car instruction) :negate)
       (let ((index (cadr instruction)))
         (and
          (equal (len instruction) 2)
          (natp index)
          (< index (len previous-values))
          (q657482-complex-equal-p
           primitive
           output
           (q657482-complex-negate
            (nth index previous-values))
           lower upper))))
      ((equal (car instruction) :add)
       (let ((left-index (cadr instruction))
             (right-index (caddr instruction)))
         (and
          (equal (len instruction) 3)
          (natp left-index)
          (natp right-index)
          (< left-index (len previous-values))
          (< right-index (len previous-values))
          (q657482-complex-equal-p
           primitive
           output
           (q657482-complex-add
            (nth left-index previous-values)
            (nth right-index previous-values))
           lower upper))))
      ((equal (car instruction) :multiply)
       (let ((left-index (cadr instruction))
             (right-index (caddr instruction)))
         (and
          (equal (len instruction) 3)
          (natp left-index)
          (natp right-index)
          (< left-index (len previous-values))
          (< right-index (len previous-values))
          (q657482-complex-equal-p
           primitive
           output
           (q657482-complex-multiply
            (nth left-index previous-values)
            (nth right-index previous-values))
           lower upper))))
      ((equal (car instruction) :inverse)
       (let* ((index (cadr instruction))
              (argument (nth index previous-values)))
         (and
          (equal (len instruction) 2)
          (natp index)
          (< index (len previous-values))
          (if
           (q657482-complex-zero-p
            primitive argument lower upper)
           (q657482-complex-zero-p
            primitive output lower upper)
           (q657482-complex-equal-p
            primitive
            (q657482-complex-multiply argument output)
            (q657482-complex-one)
            lower upper)))))
      ((equal (car instruction) :root)
       (let ((degree (cadr instruction))
             (index (caddr instruction)))
         (and
          (equal (len instruction) 3)
          (natp degree)
          (< 0 degree)
          (natp index)
          (< index (len previous-values))
          (q657482-complex-equal-p
           primitive
           (q657482-complex-power output degree)
           (nth index previous-values)
           lower upper))))
      (t nil)))))

(defun q657482-radical-derivation-p
    (primitive lower upper steps previous-values)
  (if (consp steps)
      (let* ((step (car steps))
             (output (cdr step)))
        (and
         (q657482-radical-step-p
          primitive lower upper step previous-values)
         (q657482-radical-derivation-p
          primitive lower upper
          (cdr steps)
          (cons output previous-values))))
    (equal steps nil)))

(defun q657482-radical-derivation-final-value (steps)
  (if (consp steps)
      (if (consp (cdr steps))
          (q657482-radical-derivation-final-value
           (cdr steps))
        (cdr (car steps)))
    nil))

;; A radical certificate may require algebraic intermediates outside the
;; field used by the target's original code. The joint primitive contains both
;; fields. The embedding polynomial maps the original primitive into it; the
;; defining polynomial and isolating inequalities select the same original
;; root, and composition then recodes the target value exactly.

(defun q657482-solvable-witness-p
    (number joint-primitive joint-lower joint-upper embedding
            derivation)
  (let* ((original-primitive (nth 0 number))
         (original-lower (nth 1 number))
         (original-upper (nth 2 number))
         (original-value (q657482-number-value number))
         (recoded-value
          (q657482-complex-compose original-value embedding))
         (output
          (q657482-radical-derivation-final-value
           derivation)))
    (and
     (q657482-algebraic-complex-code-p number)
     (q657482-isolates-one-root-p
      joint-primitive joint-lower joint-upper)
     (q657482-rational-polynomial-p embedding)
     (q657482-zero-at-isolated-root-p
      joint-primitive
      (q657482-poly-compose
       original-primitive embedding)
      joint-lower joint-upper)
     (q657482-positive-at-isolated-root-p
      joint-primitive
      (q657482-poly-subtract
       embedding (list original-lower))
      joint-lower joint-upper)
     (q657482-positive-at-isolated-root-p
      joint-primitive
      (q657482-poly-subtract
       (list original-upper) embedding)
      joint-lower joint-upper)
     (consp derivation)
     (q657482-radical-derivation-p
      joint-primitive joint-lower joint-upper derivation nil)
     (q657482-complex-equal-p
      joint-primitive output recoded-value
      joint-lower joint-upper))))

(defun-sk q657482-solvable-by-radicals-p (number)
  (exists
   (joint-primitive joint-lower joint-upper embedding
                    derivation)
   (q657482-solvable-witness-p
    number joint-primitive joint-lower joint-upper embedding
    derivation)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q657482-abel-ruffini-theorem-statement ()
  (exists (number)
    (and
     (q657482-algebraic-complex-code-p number)
     (not (q657482-solvable-by-radicals-p number)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q657482
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q657482), "Abel–Ruffini theorem": there exists a
-- complex number algebraic over the rationals that is not solvable by radicals.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ; _,_)
open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_)

infix 4 _≠_
infixr 3 _∧_
infixr 2 _∨_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : ∀ {ℓ} → Set ℓ → Set ℓ
Not proposition =
  proposition → Bottom

_≠_ : ∀ {ℓ} {A : Set ℓ} → A → A → Set ℓ
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

record _∧_ {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) :
  Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _∨_ {ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : Level}
  (A : Set ℓ₁) (B : Set ℓ₂) :
  Set (ℓ₁ ⊔ ℓ₂) where
  left  : A → A ∨ B
  right : B → A ∨ B

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set₁ where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R → R → R
    negateR inverseR : R → R
    lessOrEqualR : R → R → Set
    fromNatR : Nat → R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR ≠ zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) →
      addR x y ≡ addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      addR (addR x y) z ≡ addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) →
      addR x zeroR ≡ x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) →
      addR x (negateR x) ≡ zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) →
      multiplyR x y ≡ multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ≡
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x oneR ≡ x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) →
      multiplyR x zeroR ≡ zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) →
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ≡
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR ≡ zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) →
      x ≠ zeroR →
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) ≡ oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y z →
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR y x →
      x ≡ y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y ∨ lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) →
      lessOrEqualR x y →
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y →
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR ∧ zeroR ≠ oneR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero ≡ zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) →
      fromNatR (suc n) ≡ addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    characteristic-zeroR :
      (m n : Nat) →
      fromNatR m ≡ fromNatR n →
      m ≡ n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) →
      Σ Nat (λ n → lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R → Set) →
      Σ R P →
      Σ R
        (λ upper →
          (x : R) →
          P x →
          lessOrEqualR x upper) →
      Σ R
        (λ supremum →
          ((x : R) →
            P x →
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          ∧
          ((upper : R) →
            ((x : R) →
              P x →
              lessOrEqualR x upper) →
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record Complex (R : Set) : Set where
  constructor complex
  field
    realPart      : R
    imaginaryPart : R

zeroC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R
zeroC reals =
  complex (zeroR reals) (zeroR reals)

oneC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R
oneC reals =
  complex (oneR reals) (zeroR reals)

addC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
addC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (addR reals a c)
    (addR reals b d)

negateC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
negateC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (negateR reals a)
    (negateR reals b)

subtractR :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  R →
  R →
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

multiplyC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
multiplyC reals (complex a b) (complex c d) =
  complex
    (subtractR reals
      (multiplyR reals a c)
      (multiplyR reals b d))
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a d)
      (multiplyR reals b c))

inverseC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
inverseC reals (complex a b) =
  complex
    (multiplyR reals a denominator-inverse)
    (negateR reals
      (multiplyR reals b denominator-inverse))
  where
    denominator =
      addR reals
        (multiplyR reals a a)
        (multiplyR reals b b)

    denominator-inverse =
      inverseR reals denominator

powerC :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Nat →
  Complex R
powerC reals x zero =
  oneC reals
powerC reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyC reals x (powerC reals x n)

fromIntR :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Int →
  R
fromIntR reals (pos n) =
  fromNatR reals n
fromIntR reals (negsuc n) =
  negateR reals (fromNatR reals (suc n))

record Rational : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator            : Int
    denominatorMinusOne : Nat

rationalToComplex :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Rational →
  Complex R
rationalToComplex reals q =
  complex
    (multiplyR reals
      (fromIntR reals (Rational.numerator q))
      (inverseR reals
        (fromNatR reals
          (suc (Rational.denominatorMinusOne q)))))
    (zeroR reals)

data HasNonzeroRationalCoefficient :
  List Rational →
  Set where

  here :
    {coefficient : Rational}
    {coefficients : List Rational} →
    Rational.numerator coefficient ≠ pos zero →
    HasNonzeroRationalCoefficient
      (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

  there :
    {coefficient : Rational}
    {coefficients : List Rational} →
    HasNonzeroRationalCoefficient coefficients →
    HasNonzeroRationalCoefficient
      (coefficient ∷ coefficients)

evaluateRationalPolynomial :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  List Rational →
  Complex R →
  Complex R
evaluateRationalPolynomial reals [] x =
  zeroC reals
evaluateRationalPolynomial reals
  (coefficient ∷ coefficients) x =
  addC reals
    (rationalToComplex reals coefficient)
    (multiplyC reals x
      (evaluateRationalPolynomial reals coefficients x))

IsAlgebraic :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Set
IsAlgebraic reals x =
  Σ (List Rational)
    (λ coefficients →
      HasNonzeroRationalCoefficient coefficients ∧
      evaluateRationalPolynomial reals coefficients x ≡
      zeroC reals)

record RadicalClosedSubfield
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set₁ where

  field
    contains :
      Complex R →
      Set

    contains-rational :
      (q : Rational) →
      contains (rationalToComplex reals q)

    contains-add :
      {x y : Complex R} →
      contains x →
      contains y →
      contains (addC reals x y)

    contains-negate :
      {x : Complex R} →
      contains x →
      contains (negateC reals x)

    contains-multiply :
      {x y : Complex R} →
      contains x →
      contains y →
      contains (multiplyC reals x y)

    contains-inverse :
      {x : Complex R} →
      contains x →
      contains (inverseC reals x)

    closed-under-roots :
      (x : Complex R) →
      (n : Nat) →
      n ≠ zero →
      contains (powerC reals x n) →
      contains x

open RadicalClosedSubfield

-- Membership in the intersection of all radical-closed intermediate fields.
SolvableByRadicals :
  {R : Set} →
  CompleteOrderedField R →
  Complex R →
  Set₁
SolvableByRadicals reals x =
  (subfield : RadicalClosedSubfield reals) →
  contains subfield x

abel-ruffini-theorem : Set₁
abel-ruffini-theorem =
  (R : Set) →
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) →
  Σ (Complex R)
    (λ x →
      IsAlgebraic reals x ∧
      Not (SolvableByRadicals reals x))

title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q657482, "Abel–Ruffini theorem": there exists a complex number algebraic
  over the rationals that is not solvable by radicals over the rationals.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory complexTheory pred_setTheory ratTheory realTheory
     real_of_ratTheory;

val q657482_exists_not_solvable_by_rad =
  ``let rational_complex =
      \q : rat. complex_of_real (real_of_rat q)
    in
    let algebraic_over_rationals =
      \x : complex.
        ?p : num -> rat.
          FINITE {n | p n <> 0} /\
          (?n. p n <> 0) /\
          ITSET
            (\n z. rational_complex (p n) * x pow n + z)
            {n | p n <> 0} 0 = 0
    in
    let solvable_by_radicals =
      \x : complex.
        !S : complex -> bool.
          ((!q : rat. S (rational_complex q)) /\
           (!u v : complex.
              S u /\ S v ==> S (u + v) /\ S (u * v)) /\
           (!u : complex.
              S u ==> S (0 - u)) /\
           (!u : complex.
              S u ==> S (1 / u)) /\
           (!n : num. !u : complex.
              0 < n /\ S (u pow n) ==> S u))
          ==> S x
    in
      ?x : complex.
        algebraic_over_rationals x /\
        ~solvable_by_radicals x``;

${
  $d a b n s z $.

          A. a e. CC A. n e. NN

        )
        ->
        z e. s

$}

title: Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q657482
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q657482), "Abel-Ruffini theorem": there exists a
% complex number algebraic over the rationals that is not contained in the
% smallest intermediate field closed under nonzero-degree radicals. This file
% contains no proof.

Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_set: TYPE = [complex -> bool]
  real_coefficients: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(value: real): complex =
    (# real_part := value, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) * real_part(y)
                       - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part := real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
                       + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_norm_squared(x: complex): real =
    real_part(x) * real_part(x)
      + imag_part(x) * imag_part(x)

  complex_inverse(x: complex): complex =
    IF complex_norm_squared(x) = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      (# real_part :=
           real_part(x) / complex_norm_squared(x),
         imag_part :=
           -imag_part(x) / complex_norm_squared(x) #)
    ENDIF

  complex_power(x: complex, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      complex_one
    ELSE
      complex_mul(complex_power(x, exponent - 1), x)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  rational_polynomial_value(
      coefficients: real_coefficients,
      z: complex,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE complex =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      complex_zero
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        complex_add(
          rational_polynomial_value(
            coefficients, z, count - 1),
          complex_mul(
            complex_of_real(coefficients(index)),
            complex_power(z, index)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_algebraic_over_rationals(z: complex): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: real_coefficients),
        (count: nat):
      0 < count
        AND
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES rational?(coefficients(index)))
        AND
      (EXISTS (index: nat):
        index < count AND NOT coefficients(index) = 0)
        AND
      rational_polynomial_value(coefficients, z, count)
        = complex_zero

  contains_rationals(subfield: complex_set): bool =
    FORALL (value: real):
      rational?(value) IMPLIES subfield(complex_of_real(value))

  is_intermediate_field(subfield: complex_set): bool =
    subfield(complex_zero)
      AND subfield(complex_one)
      AND contains_rationals(subfield)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: complex):
      subfield(x) AND subfield(y)
        IMPLIES subfield(complex_add(x, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: complex):
      subfield(x) IMPLIES subfield(complex_neg(x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: complex):
      subfield(x) AND subfield(y)
        IMPLIES subfield(complex_mul(x, y)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: complex):
      subfield(x) IMPLIES subfield(complex_inverse(x)))

  closed_under_radicals(subfield: complex_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: complex), (degree: nat):
      (NOT degree = 0
        AND subfield(complex_power(x, degree)))
      IMPLIES subfield(x)

  solvable_by_radicals(z: complex): bool =
    FORALL (subfield: complex_set):
      (is_intermediate_field(subfield)
        AND closed_under_radicals(subfield))
      IMPLIES subfield(z)

  abel_ruffini: bool =
    EXISTS (z: complex):
      is_algebraic_over_rationals(z)
        AND NOT solvable_by_radicals(z)
END Q657482_abel_ruffini_theorem

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q660799
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q660799), "Darboux's theorem (analysis)":
-- derivatives on real intervals take intermediate values, so their images of
-- order-connected or convex sets remain order-connected or convex. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Add
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Mul
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.LocalExtr.Basic

public section

open Filter Set

open scoped Topology

namespace Q660799

variable {a b : ℝ} {f f' : ℝ → ℝ}

/-- Darboux's theorem for a derivative increasing strictly across two endpoint values. -/
theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_gt_of_lt_statement (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (Icc a b) x) {m : ℝ}
    (hma : f' a < m) (hmb : m < f' b) : m ∈ f' '' Ioo a b := sorry

/-- Darboux's theorem for a derivative decreasing strictly across two endpoint values. -/
theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_lt_of_gt_statement (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (Icc a b) x) {m : ℝ}
    (hma : m < f' a) (hmb : f' b < m) : m ∈ f' '' Ioo a b := sorry

/-- The derivative-value image of an order-connected set is order-connected. -/
theorem ordConnected_image_hasDerivWithinAt_statement {s : Set ℝ} (hs : OrdConnected s)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) s x) : OrdConnected (f' '' s) := sorry

/-- The `derivWithin` image of an order-connected set is order-connected. -/
theorem ordConnected_image_derivWithin_statement {s : Set ℝ} (hs : OrdConnected s)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ f s) : OrdConnected (derivWithin f s '' s) := sorry

/-- The derivative image of an order-connected set is order-connected. -/
theorem ordConnected_image_deriv_statement {s : Set ℝ} (hs : OrdConnected s)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) : OrdConnected (deriv f '' s) := sorry

/-- The derivative-value image of a convex real set is convex. -/
theorem convex_image_hasDerivWithinAt_statement {s : Set ℝ} (hs : Convex ℝ s)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) s x) : Convex ℝ (f' '' s) := sorry

/-- The `derivWithin` image of a convex real set is convex. -/
theorem convex_image_derivWithin_statement {s : Set ℝ} (hs : Convex ℝ s)
    (hf : DifferentiableOn ℝ f s) : Convex ℝ (derivWithin f s '' s) := sorry

/-- The derivative image of a convex real set is convex. -/
theorem convex_image_deriv_statement {s : Set ℝ} (hs : Convex ℝ s)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) : Convex ℝ (deriv f '' s) := sorry

/-- Darboux's theorem on a closed interval between nondecreasing endpoint values. -/
theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_ge_of_le_statement (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (Icc a b) x) {m : ℝ}
    (hma : f' a ≤ m) (hmb : m ≤ f' b) : m ∈ f' '' Icc a b := sorry

/-- The second indexed closed-interval statement, with its source endpoint inequalities. -/
theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_le_of_ge_statement (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc a b, HasDerivWithinAt f (f' x) (Icc a b) x) {m : ℝ}
    (hma : f' a ≤ m) (hmb : m ≤ f' b) : m ∈ f' '' Icc a b := sorry

end Q660799

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q660799
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q660799), "Darboux's theorem (analysis)":
  derivatives on real intervals take intermediate values, so their images of
  order-connected or convex sets remain order-connected or convex. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q660799_set : Type := R -> Prop.

Definition q660799_closed_interval
    (a b : R) : q660799_set :=
  fun x : R => a <= x /\ x <= b.

Definition q660799_open_interval
    (a b : R) : q660799_set :=
  fun x : R => a < x /\ x < b.

Definition q660799_image
    (g : R -> R) (s : q660799_set) : q660799_set :=
  fun y : R =>
    exists x : R, s x /\ g x = y.

Definition q660799_ord_connected
    (s : q660799_set) : Prop :=
  forall a : R,
    s a ->
    forall b : R,
      s b ->
      forall x : R,
        a <= x ->
        x <= b ->
        s x.

Definition q660799_convex
    (s : q660799_set) : Prop :=
  forall x y : R,
    s x ->
    s y ->
    forall alpha beta : R,
      0 <= alpha ->
      0 <= beta ->
      alpha + beta = 1 ->
      s (alpha * x + beta * y).

Definition q660799_has_deriv_within_at
    (f : R -> R) (derivative : R)
    (s : q660799_set) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        s y ->
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        Rabs
          (f y - f x - derivative * (y - x))
        <= epsilon * Rabs (y - x).

Definition q660799_differentiable_within_at
    (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set) (x : R) : Prop :=
  exists derivative : R,
    q660799_has_deriv_within_at f derivative s x.

Definition q660799_differentiable_on
    (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    s x ->
    q660799_differentiable_within_at f s x.

Definition q660799_deriv_within
    (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set) (x : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (q660799_has_deriv_within_at f 0 s x) with
  | left _ => 0
  | right _ =>
      match excluded_middle_informative
              (exists derivative : R,
                q660799_has_deriv_within_at f derivative s x) with
      | left _ =>
          epsilon (inhabits 0)
            (fun derivative : R =>
              q660799_has_deriv_within_at f derivative s x)
      | right _ => 0
      end
  end.

Definition q660799_univ : q660799_set :=
  fun _ : R => True.

Definition q660799_has_deriv_at
    (f : R -> R) (derivative x : R) : Prop :=
  q660799_has_deriv_within_at
    f derivative q660799_univ x.

Definition q660799_differentiable_at
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : Prop :=
  exists derivative : R,
    q660799_has_deriv_at f derivative x.

Definition q660799_deriv
    (f : R -> R) (x : R) : R :=
  q660799_deriv_within f q660799_univ x.

Theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_gt_of_lt :
  forall (f f' : R -> R) (a b m : R),
    a <= b ->
    (forall x : R,
      q660799_closed_interval a b x ->
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at
        f (f' x) (q660799_closed_interval a b) x) ->
    f' a < m ->
    m < f' b ->
    exists c : R,
      q660799_open_interval a b c /\
      f' c = m.
Admitted.

Theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_lt_of_gt :
  forall (f f' : R -> R) (a b m : R),
    a <= b ->
    (forall x : R,
      q660799_closed_interval a b x ->
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at
        f (f' x) (q660799_closed_interval a b) x) ->
    m < f' a ->
    f' b < m ->
    exists c : R,
      q660799_open_interval a b c /\
      f' c = m.
Admitted.

Theorem Set_OrdConnected_image_hasDerivWithinAt :
  forall (f f' : R -> R) (s : q660799_set),
    q660799_ord_connected s ->
    (forall x : R,
      s x ->
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) s x) ->
    q660799_ord_connected (q660799_image f' s).
Admitted.

Theorem Set_OrdConnected_image_derivWithin :
  forall (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set),
    q660799_ord_connected s ->
    q660799_differentiable_on f s ->
    q660799_ord_connected
      (q660799_image (q660799_deriv_within f s) s).
Admitted.

Theorem Set_OrdConnected_image_deriv :
  forall (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set),
    q660799_ord_connected s ->
    (forall x : R,
      s x ->
      q660799_differentiable_at f x) ->
    q660799_ord_connected
      (q660799_image (q660799_deriv f) s).
Admitted.

Theorem Convex_image_hasDerivWithinAt :
  forall (f f' : R -> R) (s : q660799_set),
    q660799_convex s ->
    (forall x : R,
      s x ->
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) s x) ->
    q660799_convex (q660799_image f' s).
Admitted.

Theorem Convex_image_derivWithin :
  forall (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set),
    q660799_convex s ->
    q660799_differentiable_on f s ->
    q660799_convex
      (q660799_image (q660799_deriv_within f s) s).
Admitted.

Theorem Convex_image_deriv :
  forall (f : R -> R) (s : q660799_set),
    q660799_convex s ->
    (forall x : R,
      s x ->
      q660799_differentiable_at f x) ->
    q660799_convex
      (q660799_image (q660799_deriv f) s).
Admitted.

Theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_ge_of_le :
  forall (f f' : R -> R) (a b m : R),
    a <= b ->
    (forall x : R,
      q660799_closed_interval a b x ->
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at
        f (f' x) (q660799_closed_interval a b) x) ->
    f' a <= m ->
    m <= f' b ->
    exists c : R,
      q660799_closed_interval a b c /\
      f' c = m.
Admitted.

Theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_le_of_ge :
  forall (f f' : R -> R) (a b m : R),
    a <= b ->
    (forall x : R,
      q660799_closed_interval a b x ->
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at
        f (f' x) (q660799_closed_interval a b) x) ->
    f' a <= m ->
    m <= f' b ->
    exists c : R,
      q660799_closed_interval a b c /\
      f' c = m.
Admitted.

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q660799, "Darboux's theorem (analysis)":
  derivatives of real functions on intervals take every intermediate value,
  and their images are order-connected or convex. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition q660799_has_deriv_within_at ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q660799_has_deriv_within_at f d S x \<longleftrightarrow>
    (f has_vector_derivative d) (at x within S)"

definition q660799_differentiable_on ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q660799_differentiable_on f S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x \<in> S. \<exists>d. q660799_has_deriv_within_at f d S x)"

definition q660799_deriv_within ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real set \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q660799_deriv_within f S x =
    (if q660799_has_deriv_within_at f 0 S x then 0
     else if \<exists>d. q660799_has_deriv_within_at f d S x
     then (SOME d. q660799_has_deriv_within_at f d S x)
     else 0)"

definition q660799_ord_connected :: "real set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q660799_ord_connected S \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a \<in> S. \<forall>b \<in> S. \<forall>x.
      a \<le> x \<and> x \<le> b \<longrightarrow> x \<in> S)"

theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_gt_of_lt:
  fixes a b m :: real
    and f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> {a..b}.
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) {a..b} x"
    and "f' a < m"
    and "m < f' b"
  shows "m \<in> f' ` {a<..<b}"
  sorry

theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_lt_of_gt:
  fixes a b m :: real
    and f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> {a..b}.
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) {a..b} x"
    and "m < f' a"
    and "f' b < m"
  shows "m \<in> f' ` {a<..<b}"
  sorry

theorem Set_OrdConnected_image_hasDerivWithinAt:
  fixes S :: "real set"
    and f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "q660799_ord_connected S"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> S. q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) S x"
  shows "q660799_ord_connected (f' ` S)"
  sorry

theorem Set_OrdConnected_image_derivWithin:
  fixes S :: "real set"
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "q660799_ord_connected S"
    and "q660799_differentiable_on f S"
  shows "q660799_ord_connected (q660799_deriv_within f S ` S)"
  sorry

theorem Set_OrdConnected_image_deriv:
  fixes S :: "real set"
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "q660799_ord_connected S"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> S. f differentiable (at x)"
  shows "q660799_ord_connected (deriv f ` S)"
  sorry

theorem Convex_image_hasDerivWithinAt:
  fixes S :: "real set"
    and f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "convex S"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> S. q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) S x"
  shows "convex (f' ` S)"
  sorry

theorem Convex_image_derivWithin:
  fixes S :: "real set"
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "convex S"
    and "q660799_differentiable_on f S"
  shows "convex (q660799_deriv_within f S ` S)"
  sorry

theorem Convex_image_deriv:
  fixes S :: "real set"
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "convex S"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> S. f differentiable (at x)"
  shows "convex (deriv f ` S)"
  sorry

theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_ge_of_le:
  fixes a b m :: real
    and f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> {a..b}.
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) {a..b} x"
    and "f' a \<le> m"
    and "m \<le> f' b"
  shows "m \<in> f' ` {a..b}"
  sorry

theorem exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_le_of_ge:
  fixes a b m :: real
    and f f' :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
  assumes "a \<le> b"
    and "\<forall>x \<in> {a..b}.
      q660799_has_deriv_within_at f (f' x) {a..b} x"
    and "f' a \<le> m"
    and "m \<le> f' b"
  shows "m \<in> f' ` {a..b}"
  sorry

end

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q660799,
  "Darboux's theorem (analysis)": intermediate-value properties of derivatives
  on real intervals, including ordered-connected and convex image formulations.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q660799_DARBOUX_S_THEOREM_ANALYSIS =
 `let closed_interval =
      \(a:real) (b:real) (x:real). a <= x /\ x <= b in
  let open_interval =
      \(a:real) (b:real) (x:real). a < x /\ x < b in
  let has_derivative_within =
      \(f:real->real) (d:real) (s:real->bool) (x:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !y:real.
                  y IN s /\
                  &0 < abs(y - x) /\
                  abs(y - x) < delta
                  ==> abs((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < epsilon in
  let has_derivative_at =
      \(f:real->real) (d:real) (x:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !y:real.
                  &0 < abs(y - x) /\
                  abs(y - x) < delta
                  ==> abs((f y - f x) / (y - x) - d) < epsilon in
  let real_derivative_within =
      \(f:real->real) (s:real->bool) (x:real).
        @d:real. has_derivative_within f d s x in
  let real_derivative =
      \(f:real->real) (x:real).
        @d:real. has_derivative_at f d x in
  let ord_connected =
      \(s:real->bool).
        !a b c:real.
          a IN s /\ b IN s /\ a <= c /\ c <= b ==> c IN s in
  let convex_real =
      \(s:real->bool).
        !x y u v:real.
          x IN s /\ y IN s /\
          &0 <= u /\ &0 <= v /\ u + v = &1
          ==> u * x + v * y IN s in
  ((!f df:real->real. !a b m:real.
      a <= b /\
      (!x:real.
         closed_interval a b x
         ==> has_derivative_within f (df x)
               (closed_interval a b) x) /\
      df a < m /\ m < df b
      ==> ?c:real.
            open_interval a b c /\ df c = m) /\
   (!f df:real->real. !a b m:real.
      a <= b /\
      (!x:real.
         closed_interval a b x
         ==> has_derivative_within f (df x)
               (closed_interval a b) x) /\
      m < df a /\ df b < m
      ==> ?c:real.
            open_interval a b c /\ df c = m) /\
   (!s:real->bool. !f df:real->real.
      ord_connected s /\
      (!x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> has_derivative_within f (df x) s x)
      ==> ord_connected (IMAGE df s)) /\
   (!s:real->bool. !f:real->real.
      ord_connected s /\
      (!x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?d:real. has_derivative_within f d s x)
      ==> ord_connected (IMAGE (real_derivative_within f s) s)) /\
   (!s:real->bool. !f:real->real.
      ord_connected s /\
      (!x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?d:real. has_derivative_at f d x)
      ==> ord_connected (IMAGE (real_derivative f) s)) /\
   (!s:real->bool. !f df:real->real.
      convex_real s /\
      (!x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> has_derivative_within f (df x) s x)
      ==> convex_real (IMAGE df s)) /\
   (!s:real->bool. !f:real->real.
      convex_real s /\
      (!x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?d:real. has_derivative_within f d s x)
      ==> convex_real (IMAGE (real_derivative_within f s) s)) /\
   (!s:real->bool. !f:real->real.
      convex_real s /\
      (!x:real.
         x IN s
         ==> ?d:real. has_derivative_at f d x)
      ==> convex_real (IMAGE (real_derivative f) s)) /\
   (!f df:real->real. !a b m:real.
      a <= b /\
      (!x:real.
         closed_interval a b x
         ==> has_derivative_within f (df x)
               (closed_interval a b) x) /\
      df a <= m /\ m <= df b
      ==> ?c:real.
            closed_interval a b c /\ df c = m) /\
   (!f df:real->real. !a b m:real.
      a <= b /\
      (!x:real.
         closed_interval a b x
         ==> has_derivative_within f (df x)
               (closed_interval a b) x) /\
      df a <= m /\ m <= df b
      ==> ?c:real.
            closed_interval a b c /\ df c = m))`;;

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q660799,
;; "Darboux's theorem (analysis)": derivatives of real functions have the
;; intermediate-value property on intervals, order-connected sets, and convex
;; sets, in HasDerivWithinAt, derivWithin, and deriv forms. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Real values, real functions, and sets are arbitrary ACL2 objects interpreted
;; by conservative fixed-arity interfaces. The explicit laws below present a
;; Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence the real field. Differentiation
;; within arbitrary sets and closed intervals is expanded by its epsilon-delta
;; remainder definition. Conservative DEFCHOOSE events retain the canonical
;; derivative-value witnesses internally for the derivWithin and deriv forms.

(defstub q660799-real-p (r-type value) t)
(defstub q660799-zero (r-type) t)
(defstub q660799-one (r-type) t)
(defstub q660799-add (r-type left right) t)
(defstub q660799-mul (r-type left right) t)
(defstub q660799-neg (r-type value) t)
(defstub q660799-inv (r-type value) t)
(defstub q660799-lt (r-type left right) t)

(defstub q660799-function-value (r-type function argument) t)
(defstub q660799-set-member-p (r-type set value) t)

(defun q660799-sub (r-type x y)
  (q660799-add r-type x (q660799-neg r-type y)))

(defun q660799-le (r-type x y)
  (not (q660799-lt r-type y x)))

(defun q660799-abs (r-type x)
  (if (q660799-lt r-type x (q660799-zero r-type))
      (q660799-neg r-type x)
    x))

(defun q660799-in-closed-interval-p (r-type a b x)
  (and
   (q660799-real-p r-type x)
   (q660799-le r-type a x)
   (q660799-le r-type x b)))

(defun q660799-in-open-interval-p (r-type a b x)
  (and
   (q660799-real-p r-type x)
   (q660799-lt r-type a x)
   (q660799-lt r-type x b)))

;; A complete ordered-field presentation of the real carrier.

(defun-sk q660799-operation-closure-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type (q660799-zero r-type))
     (q660799-real-p r-type (q660799-one r-type))
     (implies
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (and
       (q660799-real-p r-type (q660799-neg r-type x))
       (q660799-real-p r-type (q660799-inv r-type x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q660799-real-p r-type x)
       (q660799-real-p r-type y))
      (and
       (q660799-real-p r-type (q660799-add r-type x y))
       (q660799-real-p r-type (q660799-mul r-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk q660799-unary-field-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q660799-real-p r-type x)
     (let ((zero (q660799-zero r-type))
           (one (q660799-one r-type)))
       (and
        (equal (q660799-add r-type zero x) x)
        (equal (q660799-add r-type x zero) x)
        (equal (q660799-add r-type x (q660799-neg r-type x)) zero)
        (equal (q660799-add r-type (q660799-neg r-type x) x) zero)
        (equal (q660799-mul r-type one x) x)
        (equal (q660799-mul r-type x one) x)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (and
          (equal
           (q660799-mul r-type x (q660799-inv r-type x))
           one)
          (equal
           (q660799-mul r-type (q660799-inv r-type x) x)
           one))))))))

(defun-sk q660799-binary-field-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-real-p r-type y))
     (and
      (equal
       (q660799-add r-type x y)
       (q660799-add r-type y x))
      (equal
       (q660799-mul r-type x y)
       (q660799-mul r-type y x))))))

(defun-sk q660799-ternary-field-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-real-p r-type y)
      (q660799-real-p r-type z))
     (and
      (equal
       (q660799-add r-type (q660799-add r-type x y) z)
       (q660799-add r-type x (q660799-add r-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q660799-mul r-type (q660799-mul r-type x y) z)
       (q660799-mul r-type x (q660799-mul r-type y z)))
      (equal
       (q660799-mul r-type x (q660799-add r-type y z))
       (q660799-add
        r-type
        (q660799-mul r-type x y)
        (q660799-mul r-type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q660799-order-laws-p (r-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-real-p r-type y)
      (q660799-real-p r-type z))
     (and
      (not (q660799-lt r-type x x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q660799-lt r-type x y)
        (q660799-lt r-type y z))
       (q660799-lt r-type x z))
      (or
       (q660799-lt r-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q660799-lt r-type y x))
      (implies
       (q660799-lt r-type x y)
       (q660799-lt
        r-type
        (q660799-add r-type x z)
        (q660799-add r-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) x)
        (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) y))
       (q660799-lt
        r-type
        (q660799-zero r-type)
        (q660799-mul r-type x y)))))))

(defun-sk q660799-valid-real-set-p (r-type set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set x)
     (q660799-real-p r-type x))))

(defun-sk q660799-set-nonempty-p (r-type set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type x)
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set x))))

(defun-sk q660799-upper-bound-p (r-type set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set x)
     (q660799-le r-type x bound))))

(defun-sk q660799-set-bounded-above-p (r-type set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type bound)
     (q660799-upper-bound-p r-type set bound))))

(defun-sk q660799-least-upper-bound-p (r-type set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type supremum)
     (q660799-upper-bound-p r-type set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q660799-real-p r-type bound)
       (q660799-upper-bound-p r-type set bound))
      (q660799-le r-type supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q660799-supremum-exists-p (r-type set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type supremum)
     (q660799-least-upper-bound-p r-type set supremum))))

(defun-sk q660799-dedekind-complete-p (r-type)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-valid-real-set-p r-type set)
      (q660799-set-nonempty-p r-type set)
      (q660799-set-bounded-above-p r-type set))
     (q660799-supremum-exists-p r-type set))))

(defun q660799-real-structure-p (r-type)
  (and
   (q660799-operation-closure-p r-type)
   (q660799-unary-field-laws-p r-type)
   (q660799-binary-field-laws-p r-type)
   (q660799-ternary-field-laws-p r-type)
   (q660799-order-laws-p r-type)
   (not (equal (q660799-zero r-type) (q660799-one r-type)))
   (q660799-lt
    r-type
    (q660799-zero r-type)
    (q660799-one r-type))
   (q660799-dedekind-complete-p r-type)))

;; The source function has type R -> R.

(defun-sk q660799-real-function-p (r-type function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q660799-real-p r-type x)
     (q660799-real-p
      r-type
      (q660799-function-value r-type function x)))))

;; The norm-linear derivative remainder
;;   f(y) - f(x) - derivative * (y - x).

(defun q660799-derivative-remainder
    (r-type function derivative x y)
  (q660799-sub
   r-type
   (q660799-sub
    r-type
    (q660799-function-value r-type function y)
    (q660799-function-value r-type function x))
   (q660799-mul
    r-type derivative (q660799-sub r-type y x))))

;; HasDerivWithinAt f derivative set x, expanded by the epsilon-delta
;; remainder condition over points y belonging to set.

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-within-neighborhood-p
    (r-type function derivative set x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type y)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set y)
      (q660799-lt
       r-type
       (q660799-abs r-type (q660799-sub r-type y x))
       radius))
     (q660799-le
      r-type
      (q660799-abs
       r-type
       (q660799-derivative-remainder
        r-type function derivative x y))
      (q660799-mul
       r-type epsilon
       (q660799-abs r-type (q660799-sub r-type y x)))))))

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-within-radius-exists-p
    (r-type function derivative set x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type radius)
     (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) radius)
     (q660799-derivative-within-neighborhood-p
      r-type function derivative set x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q660799-has-deriv-within-at-p
    (r-type function derivative set x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) epsilon))
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-derivative-within-radius-exists-p
       r-type function derivative set x epsilon)))))

;; The corresponding closed-interval specialization.

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-icc-neighborhood-p
    (r-type function derivative a b x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-in-closed-interval-p r-type a b y)
      (q660799-lt
       r-type
       (q660799-abs r-type (q660799-sub r-type y x))
       radius))
     (q660799-le
      r-type
      (q660799-abs
       r-type
       (q660799-derivative-remainder
        r-type function derivative x y))
      (q660799-mul
       r-type epsilon
       (q660799-abs r-type (q660799-sub r-type y x)))))))

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-icc-radius-exists-p
    (r-type function derivative a b x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type radius)
     (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) radius)
     (q660799-derivative-icc-neighborhood-p
      r-type function derivative a b x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q660799-has-deriv-within-icc-at-p
    (r-type function derivative a b x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) epsilon))
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-derivative-icc-radius-exists-p
       r-type function derivative a b x epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-function-on-icc-p
    (r-type function derivative-function a b)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q660799-in-closed-interval-p r-type a b x)
     (q660799-has-deriv-within-icc-at-p
      r-type
      function
      (q660799-function-value r-type derivative-function x)
      a b x))))

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-function-on-set-p
    (r-type function derivative-function set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set x))
     (q660799-has-deriv-within-at-p
      r-type
      function
      (q660799-function-value r-type derivative-function x)
      set x))))

;; Differentiability within a set and the conservative internal choice used
;; for mathlib's derivWithin value under a DifferentiableOn hypothesis.

(defun-sk q660799-differentiable-within-at-p
    (r-type function set x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
     (q660799-has-deriv-within-at-p
      r-type function derivative set x))))

(defun-sk q660799-differentiable-on-set-p
    (r-type function set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set x))
     (q660799-differentiable-within-at-p
      r-type function set x))))

(defchoose q660799-deriv-within-value
    (derivative)
    (r-type function set x)
  (and
   (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
   (q660799-has-deriv-within-at-p
    r-type function derivative set x)))

;; HasDerivAt and deriv use the full real carrier as the limiting domain.

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-at-neighborhood-p
    (r-type function derivative x epsilon radius)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type y)
      (q660799-lt
       r-type
       (q660799-abs r-type (q660799-sub r-type y x))
       radius))
     (q660799-le
      r-type
      (q660799-abs
       r-type
       (q660799-derivative-remainder
        r-type function derivative x y))
      (q660799-mul
       r-type epsilon
       (q660799-abs r-type (q660799-sub r-type y x)))))))

(defun-sk q660799-derivative-at-radius-exists-p
    (r-type function derivative x epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type radius)
     (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) radius)
     (q660799-derivative-at-neighborhood-p
      r-type function derivative x epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q660799-has-deriv-at-p
    (r-type function derivative x)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type epsilon)
      (q660799-lt r-type (q660799-zero r-type) epsilon))
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-derivative-at-radius-exists-p
       r-type function derivative x epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q660799-differentiable-at-p
    (r-type function x)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
     (q660799-has-deriv-at-p
      r-type function derivative x))))

(defun-sk q660799-differentiable-at-on-set-p
    (r-type function set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-real-p r-type x)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set x))
     (q660799-differentiable-at-p r-type function x))))

(defchoose q660799-deriv-value
    (derivative)
    (r-type function x)
  (and
   (q660799-real-p r-type derivative)
   (q660799-has-deriv-at-p
    r-type function derivative x)))

;; Order-connected and convex subsets of the real line.

(defun q660799-between-p (r-type left middle right)
  (and
   (q660799-real-p r-type middle)
   (or
    (and
     (q660799-le r-type left middle)
     (q660799-le r-type middle right))
    (and
     (q660799-le r-type right middle)
     (q660799-le r-type middle left)))))

(defun-sk q660799-ord-connected-p (r-type set)
  (forall (left right middle)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-between-p r-type left middle right))
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set middle))))

(defun q660799-convex-combination
    (r-type left right weight)
  (q660799-add
   r-type
   (q660799-mul
    r-type
    (q660799-sub r-type (q660799-one r-type) weight)
    left)
   (q660799-mul r-type weight right)))

(defun-sk q660799-convex-p (r-type set)
  (forall (left right weight)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-real-p r-type weight)
      (q660799-le r-type (q660799-zero r-type) weight)
      (q660799-le r-type weight (q660799-one r-type)))
     (q660799-set-member-p
      r-type set
      (q660799-convex-combination
       r-type left right weight)))))

;; Existential image witnesses for the supplied derivative function.

(defun-sk q660799-function-image-witness-exists-p
    (r-type value-function set target)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type point)
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set point)
     (equal
      (q660799-function-value r-type value-function point)
      target))))

(defun-sk q660799-function-image-ord-connected-p
    (r-type value-function set)
  (forall (left right middle)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-between-p
       r-type
       (q660799-function-value r-type value-function left)
       middle
       (q660799-function-value r-type value-function right)))
     (q660799-function-image-witness-exists-p
      r-type value-function set middle))))

(defun-sk q660799-function-image-convex-p
    (r-type value-function set)
  (forall (left right weight)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-real-p r-type weight)
      (q660799-le r-type (q660799-zero r-type) weight)
      (q660799-le r-type weight (q660799-one r-type)))
     (q660799-function-image-witness-exists-p
      r-type
      value-function
      set
      (q660799-convex-combination
       r-type
       (q660799-function-value r-type value-function left)
       (q660799-function-value r-type value-function right)
       weight)))))

;; Image witnesses for the internally selected derivWithin values.

(defun-sk q660799-deriv-within-image-witness-exists-p
    (r-type function set target)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type point)
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set point)
     (equal
      (q660799-deriv-within-value r-type function set point)
      target))))

(defun-sk q660799-deriv-within-image-ord-connected-p
    (r-type function set)
  (forall (left right middle)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-between-p
       r-type
       (q660799-deriv-within-value
        r-type function set left)
       middle
       (q660799-deriv-within-value
        r-type function set right)))
     (q660799-deriv-within-image-witness-exists-p
      r-type function set middle))))

(defun-sk q660799-deriv-within-image-convex-p
    (r-type function set)
  (forall (left right weight)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-real-p r-type weight)
      (q660799-le r-type (q660799-zero r-type) weight)
      (q660799-le r-type weight (q660799-one r-type)))
     (q660799-deriv-within-image-witness-exists-p
      r-type
      function
      set
      (q660799-convex-combination
       r-type
       (q660799-deriv-within-value
        r-type function set left)
       (q660799-deriv-within-value
        r-type function set right)
       weight)))))

;; Image witnesses for the internally selected unrestricted deriv values.

(defun-sk q660799-deriv-image-witness-exists-p
    (r-type function set target)
  (exists (point)
    (and
     (q660799-real-p r-type point)
     (q660799-set-member-p r-type set point)
     (equal
      (q660799-deriv-value r-type function point)
      target))))

(defun-sk q660799-deriv-image-ord-connected-p
    (r-type function set)
  (forall (left right middle)
    (implies
     (and
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set left)
      (q660799-set-member-p r-type set right)
      (q660799-between-p
       r-type
       (q660799-deriv-value r-type function left)
       middle
