title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q660799,
-- "Darboux's theorem (analysis)": derivatives take intermediate values, so
-- their images on order-connected or convex real sets remain order-connected
-- or convex. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

data Top : Set where
  trivial : Top

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

CloseTo :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseTo reals center radius point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals (subtractR reals center radius) point)
    (StrictLess reals point (addR reals center radius))

ClosedInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
ClosedInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (lessOrEqualR reals lower point)
    (lessOrEqualR reals point upper)

OpenInterval :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
OpenInterval reals lower upper point =
  Both
    (StrictLess reals lower point)
    (StrictLess reals point upper)

Image :
  {R : Set} ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
Image {R} function domain output =
  Exists R
    (\ input ->
      Both
        (domain input)
        (function input == output))

OrdConnected :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
OrdConnected {R} reals domain =
  (lower upper middle : R) ->
  domain lower ->
  domain upper ->
  lessOrEqualR reals lower middle ->
  lessOrEqualR reals middle upper ->
  domain middle

Convex :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
Convex {R} reals domain =
  (x y : R) ->
  domain x ->
  domain y ->
  (a b : R) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) a ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) b ->
  addR reals a b == oneR reals ->
  domain
    (addR reals
      (multiplyR reals a x)
      (multiplyR reals b y))

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals function point y =
  divideR reals
    (subtractR reals (function y) (function point))
    (subtractR reals y point)

HasDerivWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivWithinAt {R} reals function derivative domain point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ delta ->
      Both
        (StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) delta)
        ((y : R) ->
          domain y ->
          CloseTo reals point delta y ->
          y != point ->
          CloseTo reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals function point y)))

HasDerivAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
HasDerivAt {R} reals function derivative point =
  HasDerivWithinAt reals function derivative (\ _ -> Top) point

DifferentiableWithinOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
DifferentiableWithinOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (\ derivative ->
      HasDerivWithinAt reals function derivative domain point)

DifferentiableAtOn :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  Set
DifferentiableAtOn {R} reals function domain =
  (point : R) ->
  domain point ->
  Exists R
    (\ derivative ->
      HasDerivAt reals function derivative point)

UniqueDerivWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
UniqueDerivWithinAt {R} reals function domain point derivative =
  Both
    (HasDerivWithinAt reals function derivative domain point)
    ((other : R) ->
      HasDerivWithinAt reals function other domain point ->
      other == derivative)

HasUniqueDerivWithinAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasUniqueDerivWithinAt {R} reals function domain point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivative ->
      UniqueDerivWithinAt reals function domain point derivative)

TotalizedDerivWithinValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
TotalizedDerivWithinValue {R} reals function domain point derivative =
  Either
    (Both
      (HasDerivWithinAt reals function (zeroR reals) domain point)
      (derivative == zeroR reals))
    (Either
      (Both
        (Not
          (HasDerivWithinAt
            reals function (zeroR reals) domain point))
        (UniqueDerivWithinAt
          reals function domain point derivative))
      (Both
        (Not
          (Exists R
            (\ candidate ->
              HasDerivWithinAt
                reals function candidate domain point)))
        (derivative == zeroR reals)))

UniqueDerivAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
UniqueDerivAt {R} reals function point derivative =
  Both
    (HasDerivAt reals function derivative point)
    ((other : R) ->
      HasDerivAt reals function other point ->
      other == derivative)

HasUniqueDerivAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
HasUniqueDerivAt {R} reals function point =
  Exists R
    (\ derivative ->
      UniqueDerivAt reals function point derivative)

TotalizedDerivValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
TotalizedDerivValue {R} reals function point derivative =
  Either
    (Both
      (HasDerivAt reals function (zeroR reals) point)
      (derivative == zeroR reals))
    (Either
      (Both
        (Not (HasDerivAt reals function (zeroR reals) point))
        (UniqueDerivAt reals function point derivative))
      (Both
        (Not
          (Exists R
            (\ candidate ->
              HasDerivAt reals function candidate point)))
        (derivative == zeroR reals)))

DerivWithinImage :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivWithinImage {R} reals function domain output =
  Exists R
    (\ point ->
      Both
        (domain point)
        (TotalizedDerivWithinValue
          reals function domain point output))

DerivImage :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  (R -> Set) ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivImage {R} reals function domain output =
  Exists R
    (\ point ->
      Both

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q660799, "Darboux's theorem (analysis)": derivatives of real functions on
  intervals take every intermediate value, with order-connected and convex
  image formulations. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory derivativeTheory;

val exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_gt_of_lt =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (fp : real -> real)
      (a : real) (b : real) (m : real).
      a <= b /\
      (!x.
        x IN interval [a,b] ==>
        (f has_vector_derivative fp x)
          (at x within interval [a,b])) /\
      fp a < m /\
      m < fp b
      ==>
      ?c.
        c IN interval (a,b) /\
        fp c = m``;

val exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_lt_of_gt =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (fp : real -> real)
      (a : real) (b : real) (m : real).
      a <= b /\
      (!x.
        x IN interval [a,b] ==>
        (f has_vector_derivative fp x)
          (at x within interval [a,b])) /\
      m < fp a /\
      fp b < m
      ==>
      ?c.
        c IN interval (a,b) /\
        fp c = m``;

val OrdConnected_image_hasDerivWithinAt =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (fp : real -> real) (s : real set).
      is_interval s /\
      (!x.
        x IN s ==>
        (f has_vector_derivative fp x) (at x within s))
      ==>
      is_interval (IMAGE fp s)``;

val OrdConnected_image_derivWithin =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (s : real set).
      is_interval s /\
      f differentiable_on s
      ==>
      is_interval
        (IMAGE (\x. vector_derivative f (at x within s)) s)``;

val OrdConnected_image_deriv =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (s : real set).
      is_interval s /\
      (!x. x IN s ==> f differentiable (at x))
      ==>
      is_interval (IMAGE (\x. vector_derivative f (at x)) s)``;

val Convex_image_hasDerivWithinAt =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (fp : real -> real) (s : real set).
      convex s /\
      (!x.
        x IN s ==>
        (f has_vector_derivative fp x) (at x within s))
      ==>
      convex (IMAGE fp s)``;

val Convex_image_derivWithin =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (s : real set).
      convex s /\
      f differentiable_on s
      ==>
      convex
        (IMAGE (\x. vector_derivative f (at x within s)) s)``;

val Convex_image_deriv =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (s : real set).
      convex s /\
      (!x. x IN s ==> f differentiable (at x))
      ==>
      convex (IMAGE (\x. vector_derivative f (at x)) s)``;

val exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_ge_of_le =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (fp : real -> real)
      (a : real) (b : real) (m : real).
      a <= b /\
      (!x.
        x IN interval [a,b] ==>
        (f has_vector_derivative fp x)
          (at x within interval [a,b])) /\
      fp a <= m /\
      m <= fp b
      ==>
      ?c.
        c IN interval [a,b] /\
        fp c = m``;

val exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_le_of_ge =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (fp : real -> real)
      (a : real) (b : real) (m : real).
      a <= b /\
      (!x.
        x IN interval [a,b] ==>
        (f has_vector_derivative fp x)
          (at x within interval [a,b])) /\
      m <= fp a /\
      fp b <= m
      ==>
      ?c.
        c IN interval [a,b] /\
        fp c = m``;

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q660799
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q660799), "Darboux's theorem (analysis)":
  derivatives of real functions have the intermediate value property on
  intervals, equivalently their images on order-connected or convex real sets
  are order-connected or convex. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q660799HasDerivWithin is the real epsilon-delta remainder formulation of
  HasDerivWithinAt. Q660799DifferentiableOn existentially quantifies the
  within-set derivative at each point.

  Q660799DerivWithin totalizes the unique within-set derivative, returning
  zero when it is absent or nonunique. On a real order-connected set with at
  least two points, every within derivative is unique; on an empty or singleton
  set, every derivative image is empty or a singleton. Thus this canonical
  totalization is bidirectionally equivalent to Mathlib's choice-based
  derivWithin for each image-connectedness assertion below. Q660799Deriv is
  the corresponding totalized ordinary derivative on RR.

  Q660799OrdConnected and Q660799Convex are the standard real definitions.
  The image operators retain existentially quantified preimages. The ten final
  $a declarations are the indexed unproved corpus statements. The last one
  follows its formal Lean signature, which duplicates the preceding closed-
  interval endpoint inequalities.
$)

$c Q660799HasDerivWithin Q660799DifferentiableOn
   Q660799DerivWithin Q660799Deriv Q660799OrdConnected Q660799Convex
   Q660799Image Q660799DerivWithinImage Q660799DerivImage $.

q660799-has-deriv-within-syntax
  $a wff ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G S X ) $.
q660799-differentiable-on-syntax
  $a wff ( Q660799DifferentiableOn F S ) $.
q660799-deriv-within-syntax
  $a class ( Q660799DerivWithin F S X ) $.
q660799-deriv-syntax
  $a class ( Q660799Deriv F X ) $.
q660799-ord-connected-syntax
  $a wff ( Q660799OrdConnected S ) $.
q660799-convex-syntax
  $a wff ( Q660799Convex S ) $.
q660799-image-syntax
  $a class ( Q660799Image F S ) $.
q660799-deriv-within-image-syntax
  $a class ( Q660799DerivWithinImage F S ) $.
q660799-deriv-image-syntax
  $a class ( Q660799DerivImage F S ) $.

${
  $d F G S X e d y $.

  q660799-has-deriv-within-definition $a |- (
    ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G S X )
    <->
    (
      (
        F e. ( RR ^m RR )
        /\
        (
          G e. RR
          /\
          (
            S C_ RR
            /\
            X e. RR
          )
        )
      )
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. S
            (
              ( ( abs ` ( y - X ) ) < d )
              ->
              (
                (
                  abs
                  `
                  (
                    ( ( F ` y ) - ( F ` X ) )
                    -
                    ( G x. ( y - X ) )
                  )
                )
                <_
                ( e x. ( abs ` ( y - X ) ) )
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S X G $.

  q660799-differentiable-on-definition $a |- (
    ( Q660799DifferentiableOn F S )
    <->
    (
      (
        F e. ( RR ^m RR )
        /\
        S C_ RR
      )
      /\
      A. X e. S
        E. G e. RR
          ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G S X )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S X G $.

  q660799-deriv-within-definition $a |- (
    Q660799DerivWithin F S X
  ) =
    if
    (
      E! G e. RR
        ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G S X ) ,
      (
        iota_ G e. RR
          ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G S X )
      ) ,
      0
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d F X G $.

  q660799-deriv-definition $a |- (
    Q660799Deriv F X
  ) =
    if
    (
      E! G e. RR
        ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G RR X ) ,
      (
        iota_ G e. RR
          ( Q660799HasDerivWithin F G RR X )
      ) ,
      0
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d S a b x $.

  q660799-ord-connected-definition $a |- (
    ( Q660799OrdConnected S )
    <->
    (
      S C_ RR
      /\
      A. a e. S A. b e. S A. x e. RR
        (
          (
            (
              a <_ x
              /\
              x <_ b
            )
            \/
            (
              b <_ x
              /\
              x <_ a
            )
          )
          ->
          x e. S
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S t x y $.

  q660799-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( Q660799Convex S )
    <->
    (
      S C_ RR
      /\
      A. x e. S A. y e. S A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
        (
          (
            ( t x. x )
            +
            ( ( 1 - t ) x. y )
          )
          e. S
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F S x y $.

  q660799-image-definition $a |- (
    Q660799Image F S
  ) = {
    y e. RR |
      E. x e. S
        ( F ` x ) = y
  } $.
$}

${
  $d F S x y $.

  q660799-deriv-within-image-definition $a |- (
    Q660799DerivWithinImage F S
  ) = {
    y e. RR |
      E. x e. S
        ( Q660799DerivWithin F S x ) = y
  } $.
$}

${
  $d F S x y $.

  q660799-deriv-image-definition $a |- (
    Q660799DerivImage F S
  ) = {
    y e. RR |
      E. x e. S
        ( Q660799Deriv F x ) = y

  thousand-theorems-q660799-exists-has-deriv-within-at-eq-of-gt-of-lt
    $a |-

                  M < ( G ` B )
                )

                ( G ` C ) = M
            )
  $.
$}

    $a |-
    A. A e. RR A. B e. RR

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q660799
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q660799), "Darboux's theorem (analysis)":
:: relative derivatives of a real function take intermediate values on
:: intervals, and their images of order-connected or convex sets remain
:: order-connected or convex. This file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies NUMBERS, REAL_1, SUBSET_1, SEQ_1, PARTFUN1, ARYTM_3,
    XXREAL_1, TARSKI, RELAT_1, ORDINAL2, FUNCT_1, FDIFF_1, CARD_1, RCOMP_1,
    XXREAL_2, SEQ_4, XXREAL_0, XBOOLE_0, ARYTM_1, VALUED_0, SEQ_2,
    VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, FUNCT_7, NAT_1, COMPLEX1;
  notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XCMPLX_0, REAL_1, RELSET_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, PARTFUN1, PARTFUN2,
    RCOMP_1, COMPLEX1, FDIFF_1;
  constructors PARTFUN1, REAL_1, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, RCOMP_1,
    PARTFUN2, RFUNCT_2, FDIFF_1, VALUED_1, XXREAL_2, COMPLEX1,
    RELSET_1, BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, RELSET_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, NAT_1, MEMBERED,
    RCOMP_1, FDIFF_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, XXREAL_2, ORDINAL1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI;
  equalities XCMPLX_0;
  expansions TARSKI;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b,m being Real,
      f,g being Function of REAL,REAL st
    a <= b &
    (for x being Real st x in [.a,b.] holds
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds
        ex delta being Real st 0 < delta &
          for y being Real st y in [.a,b.] & |.y-x.| < delta holds
            |.(f.y-f.x)-g.x*(y-x).| <= epsilon*|.y-x.|) &
    g.a < m & m < g.b
  holds ex c being Real st c in ].a,b.[ & g.c = m
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for a,b,m being Real,
      f,g being Function of REAL,REAL st
    a <= b &
    (for x being Real st x in [.a,b.] holds
      for epsilon being Real st 0 < epsilon holds

title: Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q660799
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q660799), "Darboux's theorem (analysis)":
% derivatives on real intervals take intermediate values, so derivative images
% of order-connected or convex real sets remain order-connected or convex.
% This file contains no proof.

Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]

  in_closed_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a <= x AND x <= b

  in_open_interval(x, a, b: real): bool =
    a < x AND x < b

  has_derivative_within_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real,
      s: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (s(y)
            AND y /= x
            AND abs(y - x) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(y) - f(x)
                - derivative * (y - x))
              < epsilon_value * abs(y - x)

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (delta: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          (y /= x
            AND abs(y - x) < delta)
          IMPLIES
            abs(
              f(y) - f(x)
                - derivative * (y - x))
              < epsilon_value * abs(y - x)

  differentiable_within_at(
      f: real_function,
      s: real_set,
      x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_within_at(f, derivative, x, s)

  differentiable_at(
      f: real_function,
      x: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x)

  differentiable_on(
      f: real_function,
      s: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      s(x) IMPLIES differentiable_within_at(f, s, x)

  deriv_within(
      f: real_function,
      s: real_set,
      x: real): real =
    IF has_derivative_within_at(f, 0, x, s) THEN
      0
    ELSIF differentiable_within_at(f, s, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_within_at(
            f, derivative, x, s))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  deriv(
      f: real_function,
      x: real): real =
    IF has_derivative_at(f, 0, x) THEN
      0
    ELSIF differentiable_at(f, x) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, x))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  order_connected(s: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (left, right, x: real):
      (s(left)
        AND s(right)
        AND left <= x
        AND x <= right)
      IMPLIES s(x)

  convex(s: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y, weight: real):
      (s(x)
        AND s(y)
        AND 0 <= weight
        AND weight <= 1)
      IMPLIES
        s((1 - weight) * x + weight * y)

  image_set(
      values: real_function,
      s: real_set): real_set =
    LAMBDA (value: real):
      EXISTS (x: real):
        s(x) AND values(x) = value

  exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_gt_of_lt: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, f_prime: real_function),
        (a, b, m: real):
      (a <= b
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES
              has_derivative_within_at(
                f,
                f_prime(x),
                x,
                LAMBDA (y: real):
                  in_closed_interval(y, a, b)))
        AND f_prime(a) < m
        AND m < f_prime(b))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (c: real):
          in_open_interval(c, a, b)
            AND f_prime(c) = m

  exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_lt_of_gt: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, f_prime: real_function),
        (a, b, m: real):
      (a <= b
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES
              has_derivative_within_at(
                f,
                f_prime(x),
                x,
                LAMBDA (y: real):
                  in_closed_interval(y, a, b)))
        AND m < f_prime(a)
        AND f_prime(b) < m)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (c: real):
          in_open_interval(c, a, b)
            AND f_prime(c) = m

  ordConnected_image_hasDerivWithinAt: bool =
    FORALL
        (s: real_set),
        (f, f_prime: real_function):
      (order_connected(s)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          s(x) IMPLIES
            has_derivative_within_at(
              f, f_prime(x), x, s)))
      IMPLIES
        order_connected(image_set(f_prime, s))

  ordConnected_image_derivWithin: bool =
    FORALL
        (s: real_set),
        (f: real_function):
      (order_connected(s)
        AND differentiable_on(f, s))
      IMPLIES
        order_connected(
          image_set(
            LAMBDA (x: real):
              deriv_within(f, s, x),
            s))

  ordConnected_image_deriv: bool =
    FORALL
        (s: real_set),
        (f: real_function):
      (order_connected(s)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          s(x) IMPLIES differentiable_at(f, x)))
      IMPLIES
        order_connected(
          image_set(
            LAMBDA (x: real): deriv(f, x),
            s))

  convex_image_hasDerivWithinAt: bool =
    FORALL
        (s: real_set),
        (f, f_prime: real_function):
      (convex(s)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          s(x) IMPLIES
            has_derivative_within_at(
              f, f_prime(x), x, s)))
      IMPLIES
        convex(image_set(f_prime, s))

  convex_image_derivWithin: bool =
    FORALL
        (s: real_set),
        (f: real_function):
      (convex(s)
        AND differentiable_on(f, s))
      IMPLIES
        convex(
          image_set(
            LAMBDA (x: real):
              deriv_within(f, s, x),
            s))

  convex_image_deriv: bool =
    FORALL
        (s: real_set),
        (f: real_function):
      (convex(s)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          s(x) IMPLIES differentiable_at(f, x)))
      IMPLIES
        convex(
          image_set(
            LAMBDA (x: real): deriv(f, x),
            s))

  exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_ge_of_le: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, f_prime: real_function),
        (a, b, m: real):
      (a <= b
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES
              has_derivative_within_at(
                f,
                f_prime(x),
                x,
                LAMBDA (y: real):
                  in_closed_interval(y, a, b)))
        AND f_prime(a) <= m
        AND m <= f_prime(b))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (c: real):
          in_closed_interval(c, a, b)
            AND f_prime(c) = m

  exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_le_of_ge: bool =
    FORALL
        (f, f_prime: real_function),
        (a, b, m: real):
      (a <= b
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          in_closed_interval(x, a, b)
            IMPLIES
              has_derivative_within_at(
                f,
                f_prime(x),
                x,
                LAMBDA (y: real):
                  in_closed_interval(y, a, b)))
        AND f_prime(a) <= m
        AND m <= f_prime(b))
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (c: real):
          in_closed_interval(c, a, b)
            AND f_prime(c) = m

  darboux_s_theorem_analysis: bool =
    exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_gt_of_lt
      AND exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_lt_of_gt
      AND ordConnected_image_hasDerivWithinAt
      AND ordConnected_image_derivWithin
      AND ordConnected_image_deriv
      AND convex_image_hasDerivWithinAt
      AND convex_image_derivWithin
      AND convex_image_deriv
      AND exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_ge_of_le
      AND exists_hasDerivWithinAt_eq_of_le_of_ge
END Q660799_darboux_s_theorem_analysis

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q670235
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q670235), "Fundamental theorem of arithmetic":
  every list of natural primes with product n is a permutation of the
  canonical increasing prime-factor list of n. This file contains no proof.
*)

From mathcomp Require Import ssreflect ssrbool ssrnat seq div bigop prime.

Definition q670235_prime_factors_list (n : nat) : seq nat :=
  flatten [seq nseq (snd pe) (fst pe) | pe <- prime_decomp n].

Definition q670235_list_product (l : seq nat) : nat :=
  foldr muln 1 l.

Theorem primeFactorsList_unique :
  forall (n : nat) (l : seq nat),
    q670235_list_product l = n ->
    (forall p : nat, p \in l -> prime p) ->
    perm_eq l (q670235_prime_factors_list n).
Admitted.

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q670235,
;; "Fundamental theorem of arithmetic": every finite list of natural primes
;; whose product is n is a permutation of the canonical increasing
;; prime-factor list of n. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(defun q670235-least-divisor-from (n d)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix (- n d))))
  (if (and (natp n)
           (natp d)
           (< 1 d)
           (< d n))
      (if (equal (mod n d) 0)
          d
        (q670235-least-divisor-from n (+ d 1)))
    n))

(defun q670235-least-divisor (n)
  (if (and (natp n)
           (< 1 n))
      (q670235-least-divisor-from n 2)
    n))

(defun q670235-primep (n)
  (and (natp n)
       (< 1 n)
       (equal (q670235-least-divisor n) n)))

(defun q670235-prime-factors-aux (n fuel)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix fuel)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (< n 2)
          (zp fuel))
      nil
    (let ((p (q670235-least-divisor n)))
      (cons p
            (q670235-prime-factors-aux
             (floor n p)
             (- fuel 1))))))

(defun q670235-prime-factors (n)
  (q670235-prime-factors-aux n n))

(defun q670235-list-product (factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (* (car factors)
         (q670235-list-product (cdr factors)))
    1))

(defun q670235-prime-list-p (factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (and (q670235-primep (car factors))
           (q670235-prime-list-p (cdr factors)))
    (null factors)))

(defun q670235-delete-one (x factors)
  (if (consp factors)
      (if (equal x (car factors))
          (cdr factors)
        (cons (car factors)
              (q670235-delete-one x (cdr factors))))
    nil))

(defun q670235-permutation-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and (member-equal (car left) right)
           (q670235-permutation-p
            (cdr left)
            (q670235-delete-one (car left) right)))
    (null right)))

(defun q670235-fundamental-theorem-of-arithmetic-statement-p
    (n factors)
  (implies
   (and (natp n)
        (q670235-prime-list-p factors)
        (equal (q670235-list-product factors) n))
   (q670235-permutation-p
    factors
    (q670235-prime-factors n))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q670235, "Fundamental theorem of arithmetic":
-- every prime list whose product is n is a permutation of the canonical list
-- obtained by repeatedly extracting the least divisor. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q670235_fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using
  (Nat; zero; suc; _*_; div-helper; mod-helper)

infix 4 _<=_ _divides_ _member_
infixr 3 _or_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

data _or_ (A B : Set) : Set where
  left : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

record Prime (p : Nat) : Set where
  field
    at-least-two : 2 <= p
    only-trivial-divisors :
      (d : Nat) ->
      d divides p ->
      (d == 1) or (d == p)

data List (A : Set) : Set where
  nil : List A
  cons : A -> List A -> List A

data _member_ {A : Set} (x : A) : List A -> Set where
  here : {xs : List A} -> x member (cons x xs)
  there :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    x member xs ->
    x member (cons y xs)

product : List Nat -> Nat
product nil =
  1
product (cons p factors) =
  p * product factors

naturalDiv : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalDiv numerator zero =
  zero
naturalDiv numerator (suc denominator) =
  div-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

naturalMod : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
naturalMod numerator zero =
  numerator
naturalMod numerator (suc denominator) =
  mod-helper zero denominator numerator denominator

natEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Bool
natEqual zero zero =
  true
natEqual zero (suc n) =
  false
natEqual (suc m) zero =
  false
natEqual (suc m) (suc n) =
  natEqual m n

smallestDivisorFrom : Nat -> Nat -> Nat -> Nat
smallestDivisorFrom value candidate zero =
  value
smallestDivisorFrom value candidate (suc fuel)
  with natEqual (naturalMod value candidate) zero
... | true =
  candidate
... | false =
  smallestDivisorFrom value (suc candidate) fuel

smallestDivisor : Nat -> Nat
smallestDivisor value =
  smallestDivisorFrom value 2 value

primeFactorsWithFuel : Nat -> Nat -> List Nat
primeFactorsWithFuel zero value =
  nil
primeFactorsWithFuel (suc fuel) zero =
  nil
primeFactorsWithFuel (suc fuel) (suc zero) =
  nil
primeFactorsWithFuel (suc fuel) value@(suc (suc n)) =
  cons
    (smallestDivisor value)
    (primeFactorsWithFuel fuel
      (naturalDiv value (smallestDivisor value)))

primeFactorsList : Nat -> List Nat
primeFactorsList n =
  primeFactorsWithFuel n n

data Permutation {A : Set} : List A -> List A -> Set where
  empty-permutation :
    Permutation nil nil
  prepend-same :
    {left-list right-list : List A} ->
    (x : A) ->
    Permutation left-list right-list ->
    Permutation (cons x left-list) (cons x right-list)
  swap-adjacent :
    (x y : A) ->
    (rest : List A) ->
    Permutation
      (cons x (cons y rest))
      (cons y (cons x rest))
  transitive-permutation :
    {first second third : List A} ->
    Permutation first second ->
    Permutation second third ->
    Permutation first third

fundamental-theorem-of-arithmetic : Set
fundamental-theorem-of-arithmetic =
  (n : Nat) ->
  (factors : List Nat) ->
  product factors == n ->
  ((p : Nat) -> p member factors -> Prime p) ->
  Permutation factors (primeFactorsList n)

title: Q670235_fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q670235
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q670235), "Fundamental theorem of
  arithmetic": any finite list of natural primes whose product is n has the
  prime multiplicities of the canonical prime-factor list of n. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  A Lean List NN0 is represented by a SetMM word, a function on the finite
  ordinal 0 ..^ #l. The first antecedent is List.prod l = n, and the second
  says that every entry of l belongs to SetMM's standard Prime class.

  For each prime p, the cardinality in the conclusion counts the occurrences
  of p in l, while ( p pCnt n ) is the exponent of p in n. Under the
  antecedents n is nonzero, and the canonical increasing list
  Nat.primeFactorsList n contains p exactly ( p pCnt n ) times. Thus equality
  of these multiplicities for every prime is bidirectionally equivalent to
  l being a permutation of Nat.primeFactorsList n.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. The file
  contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d i l n p $.

  thousand-theorems-q670235-fundamental-theorem-of-arithmetic $a
    |- A. n e. NN0 A. l e. Word NN0
         (
           (
             (
               prod_ i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` l ) ) ( l ` i )
             ) = n
             /\
             A. i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` l ) ) ( ( l ` i ) e. Prime )
           )
           ->
           A. p e. Prime
             (
               # ` { i e. ( 0 ..^ ( # ` l ) ) | ( l ` i ) = p }
             ) = ( p pCnt n )
         )
  $.
$}
