title: Q670235_fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q670235,
% "Fundamental theorem of arithmetic": every list of natural primes with
% product n is a permutation of the canonical prime-factor list of n.
% This file contains no proof.

Q670235_fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic: THEORY
BEGIN

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  prime_nat(value: nat): bool =
    value >= 2
      AND (FORALL (divisor: posnat):
        nat_divides(divisor, value) IMPLIES
          divisor = 1 OR divisor = value)

  list_product(factors: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES factors OF
      null: 1,
      cons(head, tail):
        head * list_product(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  all_prime(factors: list[nat]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES factors OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        prime_nat(head) AND all_prime(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  occurrence_count(
      value: nat,
      factors: list[nat]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES factors OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        (IF value = head THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF)
          + occurrence_count(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE factors BY <<

  list_permutation(left, right: list[nat]): bool =
    FORALL (value: nat):
      occurrence_count(value, left) = occurrence_count(value, right)

  least_prime_factor(value: nat): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (p: nat):
        prime_nat(p)
          AND nat_divides(p, value)
          AND (FORALL (q: nat):
            (prime_nat(q) AND nat_divides(q, value))
              IMPLIES p <= q))

  nat_quotient(value, divisor: nat): nat =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (quotient: nat):
        value = divisor * quotient)

  prime_factor_list_with_fuel(
      value, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE list[nat] =
    IF value < 2 OR fuel = 0 THEN
      null
    ELSE
      cons(
        least_prime_factor(value),
        prime_factor_list_with_fuel(
          nat_quotient(value, least_prime_factor(value)),
          fuel - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  prime_factor_list(value: nat): list[nat] =
    prime_factor_list_with_fuel(value, value)

  fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic_statement: bool =
    FORALL (n: nat), (factors: list[nat]):
      (list_product(factors) = n AND all_prime(factors))
        IMPLIES list_permutation(factors, prime_factor_list(n))

END Q670235_fundamental_theorem_of_arithmetic

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q6783821
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q6783821), "Mason–Stothers theorem": for three
-- nonzero polynomials over a field whose first two are coprime and whose sum is
-- zero, their degrees are bounded by the radical of their product unless all
-- three derivatives vanish. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical

@[expose] public section

open Polynomial UniqueFactorizationMonoid

namespace Q6783821

variable {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k]

/-- The polynomial ABC theorem, also known as the Mason–Stothers theorem. -/
theorem mason_stothers_theorem
    {a b c : k[X]} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hab : IsCoprime a b) (hsum : a + b + c = 0) :
    (natDegree a + 1 ≤ (radical (a * b * c)).natDegree ∧
      natDegree b + 1 ≤ (radical (a * b * c)).natDegree ∧
      natDegree c + 1 ≤ (radical (a * b * c)).natDegree) ∨
      derivative a = 0 ∧ derivative b = 0 ∧ derivative c = 0 := sorry

end Q6783821

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q6783821
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q6783821), "Mason–Stothers theorem": for three
  nonzero coprime polynomials over a field whose sum is zero, the degrees are
  bounded by the degree of the product's radical unless all three formal
  derivatives vanish. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List Arith.PeanoNat.

Import ListNotations.

Record q6783821_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q6783821_zero : K;
  q6783821_one : K;
  q6783821_add : K -> K -> K;
  q6783821_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q6783821_opp : K -> K;
  q6783821_inv : K -> K;
  q6783821_eq_dec : forall x y : K, {x = y} + {x <> y};
  q6783821_one_ne_zero : q6783821_one <> q6783821_zero;
  q6783821_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q6783821_add x (q6783821_add y z) =
      q6783821_add (q6783821_add x y) z;
  q6783821_add_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q6783821_add x y = q6783821_add y x;
  q6783821_add_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q6783821_add x q6783821_zero = x;
  q6783821_add_opp :
    forall x : K,
      q6783821_add x (q6783821_opp x) = q6783821_zero;
  q6783821_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q6783821_mul x (q6783821_mul y z) =
      q6783821_mul (q6783821_mul x y) z;
  q6783821_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q6783821_mul x y = q6783821_mul y x;
  q6783821_mul_one :
    forall x : K,
      q6783821_mul x q6783821_one = x;
  q6783821_mul_add :
    forall x y z : K,
      q6783821_mul x (q6783821_add y z) =
      q6783821_add
        (q6783821_mul x y)
        (q6783821_mul x z);
  q6783821_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q6783821_zero ->
      q6783821_mul x (q6783821_inv x) = q6783821_one;
  q6783821_inv_zero :
    q6783821_inv q6783821_zero = q6783821_zero
}.

Arguments q6783821_zero {K} _.
Arguments q6783821_one {K} _.
Arguments q6783821_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q6783821_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q6783821_opp {K} _ _.
Arguments q6783821_inv {K} _ _.
Arguments q6783821_eq_dec {K} _ _ _.

Definition q6783821_polynomial (K : Type) : Type := list K.

Fixpoint q6783821_drop_leading_zeros
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      if q6783821_eq_dec F a (q6783821_zero F)
      then q6783821_drop_leading_zeros F rest
      else p
  end.

Definition q6783821_normalize
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  rev (q6783821_drop_leading_zeros F (rev p)).

Definition q6783821_poly_eq
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  q6783821_normalize F p = q6783821_normalize F q.

Definition q6783821_poly_zero {K : Type} : q6783821_polynomial K := [].

Definition q6783821_poly_one
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  [q6783821_one F].

Fixpoint q6783821_raw_add
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match p, q with
  | [], _ => q
  | _, [] => p
  | a :: ps, b :: qs =>
      q6783821_add F a b :: q6783821_raw_add F ps qs
  end.

Definition q6783821_poly_add
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  q6783821_normalize F (q6783821_raw_add F p q).

Fixpoint q6783821_raw_scale
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (c : K) (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      q6783821_mul F c a :: q6783821_raw_scale F c rest
  end.

Definition q6783821_poly_scale
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (c : K) (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  q6783821_normalize F (q6783821_raw_scale F c p).

Fixpoint q6783821_raw_mul
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      q6783821_raw_add F
        (q6783821_raw_scale F a q)
        (q6783821_zero F :: q6783821_raw_mul F rest q)
  end.

Definition q6783821_poly_mul
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  q6783821_normalize F (q6783821_raw_mul F p q).

Fixpoint q6783821_nat_scalar
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q6783821_zero F
  | S m => q6783821_add F (q6783821_one F) (q6783821_nat_scalar F m)
  end.

Fixpoint q6783821_derivative_aux
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (n : nat) (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      q6783821_mul F (q6783821_nat_scalar F n) a
        :: q6783821_derivative_aux F (S n) rest
  end.

Definition q6783821_derivative
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match p with
  | [] => []
  | _ :: rest =>
      q6783821_normalize F (q6783821_derivative_aux F 1 rest)
  end.

Definition q6783821_nat_degree
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : nat :=
  Nat.pred (length (q6783821_normalize F p)).

Definition q6783821_poly_nonzero
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  ~ q6783821_poly_eq F p q6783821_poly_zero.

Fixpoint q6783821_poly_pow
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) (n : nat) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match n with
  | O => q6783821_poly_one F
  | S m => q6783821_poly_mul F p (q6783821_poly_pow F p m)
  end.

Definition q6783821_poly_unit
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  exists c : K,
    c <> q6783821_zero F /\
    q6783821_poly_eq F p [c].

Definition q6783821_irreducible
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  q6783821_poly_nonzero F p /\
  ~ q6783821_poly_unit F p /\
  forall q r : q6783821_polynomial K,
    q6783821_poly_eq F p (q6783821_poly_mul F q r) ->
    q6783821_poly_unit F q \/ q6783821_poly_unit F r.

Definition q6783821_associate
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  exists c : K,
    c <> q6783821_zero F /\
    q6783821_poly_eq F p (q6783821_poly_scale F c q).

Fixpoint q6783821_pairwise_nonassociate
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (factors : list (q6783821_polynomial K)) : Prop :=
  match factors with
  | [] => True
  | p :: rest =>
      (forall q : q6783821_polynomial K,
        In q rest -> ~ q6783821_associate F p q) /\
      q6783821_pairwise_nonassociate F rest
  end.

Fixpoint q6783821_all_positive (multiplicities : list nat) : Prop :=
  match multiplicities with
  | [] => True
  | n :: rest => (0 < n)%nat /\ q6783821_all_positive rest
  end.

Fixpoint q6783821_factor_power_product
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (factors : list (q6783821_polynomial K))
    (multiplicities : list nat) : q6783821_polynomial K :=
  match factors, multiplicities with
  | p :: ps, n :: ns =>
      q6783821_poly_mul F
        (q6783821_poly_pow F p n)
        (q6783821_factor_power_product F ps ns)
  | _, _ => q6783821_poly_one F
  end.

Fixpoint q6783821_sum_degrees
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (factors : list (q6783821_polynomial K)) : nat :=
  match factors with
  | [] => 0
  | p :: rest =>
      q6783821_nat_degree F p + q6783821_sum_degrees F rest
  end.

Definition q6783821_radical_degree
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p : q6783821_polynomial K) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  exists (unit_coefficient : K)
         (factors : list (q6783821_polynomial K))
         (multiplicities : list nat),
    unit_coefficient <> q6783821_zero F /\
    length factors = length multiplicities /\
    q6783821_all_positive multiplicities /\
    Forall (q6783821_irreducible F) factors /\
    q6783821_pairwise_nonassociate F factors /\
    q6783821_poly_eq F p
      (q6783821_poly_scale F unit_coefficient
        (q6783821_factor_power_product F factors multiplicities)) /\
    n = q6783821_sum_degrees F factors.

Definition q6783821_is_coprime
    {K : Type} (F : q6783821_field K)
    (p q : q6783821_polynomial K) : Prop :=
  exists x y : q6783821_polynomial K,
    q6783821_poly_eq F
      (q6783821_poly_add F
        (q6783821_poly_mul F x p)
        (q6783821_poly_mul F y q))
      (q6783821_poly_one F).

Theorem q6783821_polynomial_abc :
  forall (K : Type)
         (F : q6783821_field K)
         (a b c : q6783821_polynomial K),
    q6783821_poly_nonzero F a ->
    q6783821_poly_nonzero F b ->
    q6783821_poly_nonzero F c ->
    q6783821_is_coprime F a b ->
    q6783821_poly_eq F
      (q6783821_poly_add F (q6783821_poly_add F a b) c)
      q6783821_poly_zero ->
    (exists radical_degree : nat,
      q6783821_radical_degree F
        (q6783821_poly_mul F (q6783821_poly_mul F a b) c)
        radical_degree /\
      (q6783821_nat_degree F a + 1 <= radical_degree)%nat /\
      (q6783821_nat_degree F b + 1 <= radical_degree)%nat /\
      (q6783821_nat_degree F c + 1 <= radical_degree)%nat) \/
    (q6783821_poly_eq F
       (q6783821_derivative F a) q6783821_poly_zero /\
     q6783821_poly_eq F
       (q6783821_derivative F b) q6783821_poly_zero /\
     q6783821_poly_eq F
       (q6783821_derivative F c) q6783821_poly_zero).
Admitted.

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q6783821
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q6783821), "Mason–Stothers theorem": for three
  nonzero polynomials over an arbitrary field whose sum is zero, with the first
  two coprime, each degree plus one is at most the degree of the squarefree
  radical of their product, or all three formal derivatives vanish. This file
  represents polynomials by finitely supported coefficient functions and
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym 'a q6783821_poly = "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q6783821_support ::
    "'a::zero q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> nat set" where
  "q6783821_support p = {n. p n \<noteq> 0}"

definition q6783821_is_poly :: "'a::zero q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6783821_is_poly p \<longleftrightarrow> finite (q6783821_support p)"

definition q6783821_zero :: "'a::zero q6783821_poly" where
  "q6783821_zero = (\<lambda>_. 0)"

definition q6783821_one :: "'a::{zero,one} q6783821_poly" where
  "q6783821_one = (\<lambda>n. if n = 0 then 1 else 0)"

definition q6783821_add ::
    "'a::plus q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q6783821_poly" where
  "q6783821_add p q = (\<lambda>n. p n + q n)"

definition q6783821_mul ::
    "'a::comm_semiring_1 q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q6783821_poly" where
  "q6783821_mul p q = (\<lambda>n. \<Sum>i\<le>n. p i * q (n - i))"

definition q6783821_deriv ::
    "'a::comm_semiring_1 q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> 'a q6783821_poly" where
  "q6783821_deriv p = (\<lambda>n. of_nat (Suc n) * p (Suc n))"

definition q6783821_degree :: "'a::zero q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q6783821_degree p =
    (if q6783821_support p = {} then 0 else Max (q6783821_support p))"

definition q6783821_divides ::
    "'a::field q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6783821_divides p q \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6783821_is_poly p \<and>
    q6783821_is_poly q \<and>
    (\<exists>r. q6783821_is_poly r \<and> q = q6783821_mul p r)"

definition q6783821_unit :: "'a::field q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6783821_unit p \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6783821_divides p q6783821_one"

definition q6783821_irreducible ::
    "'a::field q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6783821_irreducible p \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6783821_is_poly p \<and>
    p \<noteq> q6783821_zero \<and>
    \<not> q6783821_unit p \<and>
    (\<forall>u v.
      q6783821_is_poly u \<longrightarrow>
      q6783821_is_poly v \<longrightarrow>
      p = q6783821_mul u v \<longrightarrow>
      q6783821_unit u \<or> q6783821_unit v)"

definition q6783821_monic :: "'a::field q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6783821_monic p \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6783821_is_poly p \<and>
    p \<noteq> q6783821_zero \<and>
    p (q6783821_degree p) = 1"

definition q6783821_coprime ::
    "'a::field q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow>
      'a q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6783821_coprime a b \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6783821_is_poly a \<and>
    q6783821_is_poly b \<and>
    (\<exists>x y.
      q6783821_is_poly x \<and>
      q6783821_is_poly y \<and>
      q6783821_add (q6783821_mul x a) (q6783821_mul y b) =
        q6783821_one)"

definition q6783821_radical_degree ::
    "'a::field q6783821_poly \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q6783821_radical_degree p =
    (\<Sum>q\<in>{q.
      q6783821_irreducible q \<and>
      q6783821_monic q \<and>
      q6783821_divides q p}.
      q6783821_degree q)"

theorem q6783821_mason_stothers:
  fixes a b c :: "'a::field q6783821_poly"
  assumes "q6783821_is_poly a"
    and "q6783821_is_poly b"
    and "q6783821_is_poly c"
    and "a \<noteq> q6783821_zero"
    and "b \<noteq> q6783821_zero"
    and "c \<noteq> q6783821_zero"
    and "q6783821_coprime a b"
    and "q6783821_add (q6783821_add a b) c = q6783821_zero"
  shows
    "(q6783821_degree a + 1 \<le>
        q6783821_radical_degree (q6783821_mul (q6783821_mul a b) c) \<and>
      q6783821_degree b + 1 \<le>
        q6783821_radical_degree (q6783821_mul (q6783821_mul a b) c) \<and>
      q6783821_degree c + 1 \<le>
        q6783821_radical_degree (q6783821_mul (q6783821_mul a b) c)) \<or>
      (q6783821_deriv a = q6783821_zero \<and>
        q6783821_deriv b = q6783821_zero \<and>
        q6783821_deriv c = q6783821_zero)"
  sorry

end

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q6783821
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q6783821), "Mason–Stothers theorem": for
  three nonzero polynomials over an arbitrary field whose first two are
  coprime and whose sum is zero, each degree plus one is bounded by the degree
  of the product's radical, unless all three formal derivatives vanish. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

let Q6783821_MASON_STOTHERS_THEOREM =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x:K. addK zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x:K. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y:K. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x:K. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y:K. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:K.
          mulK x (addK y z) = addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!x:K. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK) in
   let polynomial =
     \(zeroK:K) (p:num->K). FINITE {n:num | ~(p n = zeroK)} in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(zeroK:K). \n:num. zeroK in
   let polynomial_one =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K). \n:num. if n = 0 then oneK else zeroK in
   let polynomial_add =
     \(addK:K->K->K) (p:num->K) (q:num->K).
       \n:num. addK (p n) (q n) in
   let polynomial_mul =
     \(zeroK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K) (q:num->K).
       \n:num.
         ITLIST addK
           (GENLIST (\i:num. mulK (p i) (q (n - i))) (n + 1))
           zeroK in
   let polynomial_degree =
     \(zeroK:K) (p:num->K).
       @d:num.
         (!n:num. d < n ==> p n = zeroK) /\
         ((p = polynomial_zero zeroK /\ d = 0) \/ ~(p d = zeroK)) in
   let polynomial_derivative =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K).
       \n:num.
         mulK
           (ITLIST addK (REPLICATE (n + 1) oneK) zeroK)
           (p (n + 1)) in
   let polynomial_divides =
     \(zeroK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K) (q:num->K).
       ?r:num->K.
         polynomial zeroK r /\
         polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK p r = q in
   let polynomial_unit =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K).
       ?q:num->K.
         polynomial zeroK q /\
         polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK p q =
           polynomial_one zeroK oneK in
   let polynomial_coprime =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K) (q:num->K).
       ?x y:num->K.
         polynomial zeroK x /\
         polynomial zeroK y /\
         polynomial_add addK
           (polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK p x)
           (polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK q y) =
         polynomial_one zeroK oneK in
   let polynomial_monic =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (p:num->K).
       p (polynomial_degree zeroK p) = oneK in
   let polynomial_irreducible =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K).
       polynomial zeroK p /\
       ~(p = polynomial_zero zeroK) /\
       ~(polynomial_unit zeroK oneK addK mulK p) /\
       (!q r:num->K.
         polynomial zeroK q /\
         polynomial zeroK r /\
          p = polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK q r
          ==> polynomial_unit zeroK oneK addK mulK q \/
              polynomial_unit zeroK oneK addK mulK r) in
   let polynomial_radical_degree =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:num->K).
       nsum
         {q:num->K |
            polynomial_irreducible zeroK oneK addK mulK q /\
            polynomial_monic zeroK oneK q /\
            polynomial_divides zeroK addK mulK q p}
         (polynomial_degree zeroK) in
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK invK:K->K.
   !a b c:num->K.
     is_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     polynomial zeroK a /\
     polynomial zeroK b /\
     polynomial zeroK c /\
     ~(a = polynomial_zero zeroK) /\
     ~(b = polynomial_zero zeroK) /\
     ~(c = polynomial_zero zeroK) /\
     polynomial_coprime zeroK oneK addK mulK a b /\
     polynomial_add addK (polynomial_add addK a b) c =
       polynomial_zero zeroK
     ==>
     let abc =
       polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK
         (polynomial_mul zeroK addK mulK a b) c in
     let radical_degree =
       polynomial_radical_degree zeroK oneK addK mulK abc in
       (polynomial_degree zeroK a + 1 <=
          radical_degree /\
        polynomial_degree zeroK b + 1 <=
          radical_degree /\
        polynomial_degree zeroK c + 1 <=
          radical_degree) \/
       (polynomial_derivative zeroK oneK addK mulK a =
          polynomial_zero zeroK /\
        polynomial_derivative zeroK oneK addK mulK b =
          polynomial_zero zeroK /\
        polynomial_derivative zeroK oneK addK mulK c =
          polynomial_zero zeroK)`;;

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q6783821, "Mason–Stothers theorem": over an
;; arbitrary field, three nonzero polynomials with coprime first two terms
;; and sum zero satisfy the three polynomial-ABC radical degree bounds,
;; unless all three derivatives vanish. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The scalar field and its polynomial algebra are arbitrary tame APPLY$
;; function objects.  COORDINATES and REALIZE give a bijection between the
;; polynomial carrier and canonical ascending finite coefficient lists.
;; Horner's recursion makes this presentation isomorphic to the full
;; univariate polynomial ring, rather than a bounded-degree approximation.
;;
;; Choice selectors for Bezout witnesses, quotients, nontrivial factorizations,
;; and repeated irreducible factors are constrained in both directions.  They
;; therefore package classical choices for internal existentials without
;; turning any theorem witness into an extra hypothesis.

(defun q6783821-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q6783821-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q6783821-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q6783821-quoted nil)))

(defun q6783821-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (q6783821-quoted function)
        (q6783821-term-list arguments)))

(defun q6783821-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q6783821-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q6783821-quoted nil))
    (q6783821-quoted t)))

(defun q6783821-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q6783821-quoted t)
            (q6783821-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q6783821-quoted nil)))

(defun q6783821-not-term (term)
  (list 'if term
        (q6783821-quoted nil)
        (q6783821-quoted t)))

(defun q6783821-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q6783821-quoted t)))

(defun q6783821-iff-term (left right)
  (list 'if left
        (list 'if right
              (q6783821-quoted t)
              (q6783821-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q6783821-quoted nil)
              (q6783821-quoted t))))

(defun q6783821-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q6783821-quoted t)))

(defun q6783821-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q6783821-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q6783821-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun q6783821-unary-value (function object)
  (apply$ function (list object)))

(defun q6783821-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

(defun q6783821-canonical-coefficients-term
    (coefficients scalarp scalar-zero)
  (q6783821-and-terms
   (list
    (list 'true-listp coefficients)
    (list 'always$ (q6783821-quoted scalarp) coefficients)
    (q6783821-or-terms
     (list
      (list 'equal coefficients (q6783821-quoted nil))
      (q6783821-not-term
       (list
        'equal
        (list 'car (list 'last coefficients))
        (q6783821-quoted scalar-zero))))))))

(defun q6783821-polynomial-term (polyp polynomial)
  (q6783821-static-apply-term polyp (list polynomial)))

(defun q6783821-unit-term (polyp coordinates polynomial)
  (let ((coefficients
         (q6783821-static-apply-term coordinates (list polynomial))))
    (q6783821-and-terms
     (list
      (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp polynomial)
      (list 'consp coefficients)
      (list 'endp (list 'cdr coefficients))))))

;; An arbitrary nontrivial commutative field.

(defun q6783821-field-laws-function
    (scalarp zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (let* ((add-xy (q6783821-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (add-yz (q6783821-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (mul-xy (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (mul-yz (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q6783821-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (inv-x (q6783821-static-apply-term inverse '(x)))
         (domain
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp '(x))
            (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp '(y))
            (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp '(z))))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q6783821-implies-term
      domain
      (q6783821-and-terms
       (list
        (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp (list add-xy))
        (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp (list mul-xy))
        (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp (list neg-x))
        (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp (list inv-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q6783821-static-apply-term add (list add-xy 'z))
              (q6783821-static-apply-term add (list 'x add-yz)))
        (list 'equal add-xy
              (q6783821-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q6783821-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q6783821-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q6783821-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q6783821-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply (list mul-xy 'z))
              (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x mul-yz)))
        (list 'equal mul-xy
              (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q6783821-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q6783821-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x add-yz))
              (q6783821-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))
        (q6783821-implies-term
         (list 'equal 'x (q6783821-quoted zero))
         (list 'equal inv-x (q6783821-quoted zero)))
        (q6783821-implies-term
         (q6783821-not-term
          (list 'equal 'x (q6783821-quoted zero)))
         (list 'equal
               (q6783821-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x inv-x))
               (q6783821-quoted one)))))))))

(defun q6783821-field-p
    (scalarp zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp scalarp)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q6783821-member-p scalarp zero)
   (q6783821-member-p scalarp one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-field-laws-function
     scalarp zero one add multiply negate inverse)
    '(x y z))))

;; A polynomial ring presented by unique canonical coefficient lists.

(defun q6783821-polynomial-algebra-laws-function
    (scalarp scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply poly-negate
     constant indeterminate coordinates realize)
  (let* ((p-plus-q
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-add '(p q)))
         (q-plus-r
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-add '(q r)))
         (p-times-q
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-multiply '(p q)))
         (q-times-r
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-multiply '(q r)))
         (neg-p
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-negate '(p)))
         (const-s
          (q6783821-static-apply-term constant '(scalar)))
         (const-t
          (q6783821-static-apply-term constant '(scalar2)))
         (scalar-sum
          (q6783821-static-apply-term scalar-add '(scalar scalar2)))
         (scalar-product
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           scalar-multiply '(scalar scalar2)))
         (coordinates-p
          (q6783821-static-apply-term coordinates '(p)))
         (realized
          (q6783821-static-apply-term realize '(coefficients)))
         (realized-tail
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           realize (list (list 'cdr 'coefficients))))
         (constant-head
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           constant (list (list 'car 'coefficients))))
         (horner
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           poly-add
           (list
            constant-head
            (q6783821-static-apply-term
             poly-multiply
             (list (q6783821-quoted indeterminate)
                   realized-tail)))))
         (scalar-domain
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp '(scalar))
            (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp '(scalar2)))))
         (poly-domain
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'q)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'r))))
         (canonical
          (q6783821-canonical-coefficients-term
           'coefficients scalarp scalar-zero)))
    (list
     'lambda '(scalar scalar2 p q r coefficients)
     (q6783821-and-terms
      (list
       (q6783821-polynomial-term
        polyp (q6783821-quoted poly-zero))
       (q6783821-polynomial-term
        polyp (q6783821-quoted poly-one))
       (q6783821-polynomial-term
        polyp (q6783821-quoted indeterminate))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        poly-domain
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp p-plus-q)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp p-times-q)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp neg-p)
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-add (list p-plus-q 'r))
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-add (list 'p q-plus-r)))
          (list 'equal p-plus-q
                (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-add '(q p)))
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-add
                 (list 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
                'p)
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-add (list 'p neg-p))
                (q6783821-quoted poly-zero))
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-multiply (list p-times-q 'r))
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-multiply (list 'p q-times-r)))
          (list 'equal p-times-q
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-multiply '(q p)))
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-multiply
                 (list 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-one)))
                'p)
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-multiply (list 'p q-plus-r))
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-add
                 (list
                  (q6783821-static-apply-term
                   poly-multiply '(p q))
                  (q6783821-static-apply-term
                   poly-multiply '(p r))))))))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        scalar-domain
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp const-s)
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term constant (list scalar-sum))
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-add (list const-s const-t)))
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 constant (list scalar-product))
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 poly-multiply (list const-s const-t)))
          (q6783821-implies-term
           (list 'equal const-s const-t)
           (list 'equal 'scalar 'scalar2)))))
       (list 'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              constant (list (q6783821-quoted scalar-zero)))
             (q6783821-quoted poly-zero))
       (list 'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              constant (list (q6783821-quoted scalar-one)))
             (q6783821-quoted poly-one))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-canonical-coefficients-term
           coordinates-p scalarp scalar-zero)
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 realize (list coordinates-p))
                'p))))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        canonical
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp realized)
          (list 'equal
                (q6783821-static-apply-term
                 coordinates (list realized))
                'coefficients)
          (list 'if
                'coefficients
                (list 'equal realized horner)
                (list 'equal
                      realized
                      (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))))))))))

(defun q6783821-polynomial-algebra-p
    (scalarp scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply poly-negate
     constant indeterminate coordinates realize)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp polyp)
   (tamep-functionp poly-add)
   (tamep-functionp poly-multiply)
   (tamep-functionp poly-negate)
   (tamep-functionp constant)
   (tamep-functionp coordinates)
   (tamep-functionp realize)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-polynomial-algebra-laws-function
     scalarp scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply poly-negate
     constant indeterminate coordinates realize)
    '(scalar scalar2 p q r coefficients))))

;; The formal derivative is the unique derivation sending X to 1 and every
;; scalar constant to 0.

(defun q6783821-derivative-laws-function
    (scalarp polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
     constant indeterminate derivative)
  (let* ((derivative-p
          (q6783821-static-apply-term derivative '(p)))
         (derivative-q
          (q6783821-static-apply-term derivative '(q)))
         (p-plus-q
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-add '(p q)))
         (p-times-q
          (q6783821-static-apply-term poly-multiply '(p q))))
    (list
     'lambda '(scalar p q)
     (q6783821-and-terms
      (list
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-static-apply-term scalarp '(scalar))
        (list
         'equal
         (q6783821-static-apply-term
          derivative
          (list
           (q6783821-static-apply-term constant '(scalar))))
         (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
       (list
        'equal
        (q6783821-static-apply-term
         derivative (list (q6783821-quoted indeterminate)))
        (q6783821-quoted poly-one))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'q)))
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp derivative-p)
          (list
           'equal
           (q6783821-static-apply-term
            derivative (list p-plus-q))
           (q6783821-static-apply-term
            poly-add (list derivative-p derivative-q)))
          (list
           'equal
           (q6783821-static-apply-term
            derivative (list p-times-q))
           (q6783821-static-apply-term
            poly-add
            (list
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply (list derivative-p 'q))
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply (list 'p derivative-q)))))))))))))

(defun q6783821-derivative-p
    (scalarp polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
     constant indeterminate derivative)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp derivative)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-derivative-laws-function
     scalarp polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
     constant indeterminate derivative)
    '(scalar p q))))

;; Coprimality is exactly the existence of a Bezout identity.

(defun q6783821-coprime-laws-function
    (polyp poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
     coprime left-selector right-selector)
  (let* ((selected-left
          (q6783821-static-apply-term left-selector '(a b)))
         (selected-right
          (q6783821-static-apply-term right-selector '(a b)))
         (selected-bezout
          (list
           'equal
           (q6783821-static-apply-term
            poly-add
            (list
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply (list selected-left 'a))
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply (list selected-right 'b))))
           (q6783821-quoted poly-one)))
         (candidate-bezout
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'x)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'y)
            (list
             'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-add
              (list
               (q6783821-static-apply-term
                poly-multiply '(x a))
               (q6783821-static-apply-term
                poly-multiply '(y b))))
             (q6783821-quoted poly-one))))))
    (list
     'lambda '(a b x y)
     (q6783821-and-terms
      (list
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-static-apply-term coprime '(a b))
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'a)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'b)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp selected-left)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp selected-right)
          selected-bezout)))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        candidate-bezout
        (q6783821-static-apply-term coprime '(a b))))))))

(defun q6783821-coprime-package-p
    (polyp poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
     coprime left-selector right-selector)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp coprime)
   (tamep-functionp left-selector)
   (tamep-functionp right-selector)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-coprime-laws-function
     polyp poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
     coprime left-selector right-selector)
    '(a b x y))))

;; Divisibility is exactly multiplication by a polynomial quotient.

(defun q6783821-divisibility-laws-function
    (polyp poly-multiply divides quotient-selector)
  (let* ((selected
          (q6783821-static-apply-term quotient-selector '(divisor dividend)))
         (selected-valid
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp selected)
            (list
             'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply (list 'divisor selected))
             'dividend))))
         (candidate-valid
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'divisor)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'dividend)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'quotient)
            (list
             'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply '(divisor quotient))
             'dividend)))))
    (list
     'lambda '(divisor dividend quotient)
     (q6783821-and-terms
      (list
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-static-apply-term divides '(divisor dividend))
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'divisor)
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'dividend)
          selected-valid)))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        candidate-valid
        (q6783821-static-apply-term
         divides '(divisor dividend))))))))

(defun q6783821-divisibility-package-p
    (polyp poly-multiply divides quotient-selector)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp divides)
   (tamep-functionp quotient-selector)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-divisibility-laws-function
     polyp poly-multiply divides quotient-selector)
    '(divisor dividend quotient))))

;; Irreducibility is characterized by its factorization property, with a
;; selected nontrivial factorization for every reducible nonunit.

(defun q6783821-irreducibility-laws-function
    (polyp poly-zero poly-multiply coordinates irreducible
     left-factor-selector right-factor-selector)
  (let* ((unit-p
          (q6783821-unit-term polyp coordinates 'p))
         (unit-left
          (q6783821-unit-term polyp coordinates 'left))
         (unit-right
          (q6783821-unit-term polyp coordinates 'right))
         (factorization
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'left)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'right)
            (list
             'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply '(left right))
             'p))))
         (selected-left
          (q6783821-static-apply-term left-factor-selector '(p)))
         (selected-right
          (q6783821-static-apply-term right-factor-selector '(p)))
         (selected-factorization
          (q6783821-and-terms
           (list
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp selected-left)
            (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp selected-right)
            (q6783821-not-term
             (q6783821-unit-term
              polyp coordinates selected-left))
            (q6783821-not-term
             (q6783821-unit-term
              polyp coordinates selected-right))
            (list
             'equal
             (q6783821-static-apply-term
              poly-multiply (list selected-left selected-right))
             'p)))))
    (list
     'lambda '(p left right)
     (q6783821-and-terms
      (list
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-static-apply-term irreducible '(p))
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
          (q6783821-not-term
           (list 'equal 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
          (q6783821-not-term unit-p)
          (q6783821-implies-term
           factorization
           (q6783821-or-terms
            (list unit-left unit-right))))))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
          (q6783821-not-term
           (list 'equal 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
          (q6783821-not-term unit-p)
          (q6783821-not-term
           (q6783821-static-apply-term irreducible '(p)))))
        selected-factorization))))))

(defun q6783821-irreducibility-package-p
    (polyp poly-zero poly-multiply coordinates irreducible
     left-factor-selector right-factor-selector)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp irreducible)
   (tamep-functionp left-factor-selector)
   (tamep-functionp right-factor-selector)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-irreducibility-laws-function
     polyp poly-zero poly-multiply coordinates irreducible
     left-factor-selector right-factor-selector)
    '(p left right))))

;; Squarefreeness excludes squared irreducible divisors, and a selected
;; repeated factor witnesses every failure.

(defun q6783821-squarefree-laws-function
    (polyp poly-zero poly-multiply divides irreducible squarefree
     repeated-factor-selector)
  (let* ((factor-square
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           poly-multiply '(factor factor)))
         (selected
          (q6783821-static-apply-term repeated-factor-selector '(p)))
         (selected-square
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           poly-multiply (list selected selected))))
    (list
     'lambda '(p factor)
     (q6783821-and-terms
      (list
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-static-apply-term squarefree '(p))
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
          (q6783821-not-term
           (list 'equal 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
          (q6783821-implies-term
           (q6783821-static-apply-term irreducible '(factor))
           (q6783821-not-term
            (q6783821-static-apply-term
             divides (list factor-square 'p)))))))
       (q6783821-implies-term
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
          (q6783821-not-term
           (list 'equal 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
          (q6783821-not-term
           (q6783821-static-apply-term squarefree '(p)))))
        (q6783821-and-terms
         (list
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           irreducible (list selected))
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           divides (list selected-square 'p))))))))))

(defun q6783821-squarefree-package-p
    (polyp poly-zero poly-multiply divides irreducible squarefree
     repeated-factor-selector)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp squarefree)
   (tamep-functionp repeated-factor-selector)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-squarefree-laws-function
     polyp poly-zero poly-multiply divides irreducible squarefree
     repeated-factor-selector)
    '(p factor))))

;; For every nonzero polynomial, RADICAL is squarefree and has exactly the
;; same irreducible divisors.  This characterizes it up to a nonzero scalar,
;; which preserves the natDegree used by the theorem.

(defun q6783821-radical-laws-function
    (polyp poly-zero divides irreducible squarefree radical)
  (let ((radical-p
         (q6783821-static-apply-term radical '(p))))
    (list
     'lambda '(p factor)
     (q6783821-implies-term
      (q6783821-and-terms
       (list
        (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp 'p)
        (q6783821-not-term
         (list 'equal 'p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))))
      (q6783821-and-terms
       (list
        (q6783821-polynomial-term polyp radical-p)
        (q6783821-not-term
         (list 'equal radical-p (q6783821-quoted poly-zero)))
        (q6783821-static-apply-term squarefree (list radical-p))
        (q6783821-implies-term
         (q6783821-static-apply-term irreducible '(factor))
         (q6783821-iff-term
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           divides (list 'factor radical-p))
          (q6783821-static-apply-term
           divides '(factor p))))))))))

(defun q6783821-radical-package-p
    (polyp poly-zero divides irreducible squarefree radical)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp radical)
   (q6783821-universal-p
    (q6783821-radical-laws-function
     polyp poly-zero divides irreducible squarefree radical)
    '(p factor))))

(defun q6783821-polynomial-nat-degree
    (coordinates polynomial)
  (let ((coefficients
         (q6783821-unary-value coordinates polynomial)))
    (if (endp coefficients)
        0
      (- (len coefficients) 1))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q6783821-mason-stothers-theorem-statement
    (scalarp scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     scalar-negate scalar-inverse
     polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply poly-negate
     constant indeterminate coordinates realize derivative
     coprime bezout-left bezout-right
     divides quotient-selector
     irreducible left-factor-selector right-factor-selector
     squarefree repeated-factor-selector radical
     a b c)
  (let* ((ab (q6783821-binary-value poly-multiply a b))
         (abc (q6783821-binary-value poly-multiply ab c))
         (sum
          (q6783821-binary-value
           poly-add
           (q6783821-binary-value poly-add a b)
           c))
         (radical-abc
          (q6783821-unary-value radical abc))
         (radical-degree
          (q6783821-polynomial-nat-degree
           coordinates radical-abc)))
    (implies
     (and
      (q6783821-field-p
       scalarp scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
       scalar-negate scalar-inverse)
      (q6783821-polynomial-algebra-p
       scalarp scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
       polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply poly-negate
       constant indeterminate coordinates realize)
      (q6783821-derivative-p
       scalarp polyp poly-zero poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
       constant indeterminate derivative)
      (q6783821-coprime-package-p
       polyp poly-one poly-add poly-multiply
       coprime bezout-left bezout-right)
      (q6783821-divisibility-package-p
       polyp poly-multiply divides quotient-selector)
      (q6783821-irreducibility-package-p
       polyp poly-zero poly-multiply coordinates irreducible
       left-factor-selector right-factor-selector)
      (q6783821-squarefree-package-p
       polyp poly-zero poly-multiply divides irreducible squarefree
       repeated-factor-selector)
      (q6783821-radical-package-p
       polyp poly-zero divides irreducible squarefree radical)
      (q6783821-member-p polyp a)
      (q6783821-member-p polyp b)
      (q6783821-member-p polyp c)
      (not (equal a poly-zero))
      (not (equal b poly-zero))
      (not (equal c poly-zero))
      (q6783821-binary-value coprime a b)
      (equal sum poly-zero))
     (or
      (and
       (<=
        (+ (q6783821-polynomial-nat-degree coordinates a) 1)
        radical-degree)
       (<=
        (+ (q6783821-polynomial-nat-degree coordinates b) 1)
        radical-degree)
       (<=
        (+ (q6783821-polynomial-nat-degree coordinates c) 1)
        radical-degree))
      (and
       (equal
        (q6783821-unary-value derivative a)
        poly-zero)
       (equal
        (q6783821-unary-value derivative b)
        poly-zero)
       (equal
        (q6783821-unary-value derivative c)
        poly-zero))))))

;; Admission-time audit: every lambda reified for FN-EQUAL contains only ACL2
;; primitives, loop scions, and APPLY$ calls on quoted tame functions.

(defun q6783821-all-reified-functions-tame-p ()
  (let ((unary '(lambda (x) (quote t)))
        (binary '(lambda (x y) x)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-true-function '(x)))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-field-laws-function
       unary 0 1 binary binary unary unary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-polynomial-algebra-laws-function
       unary 0 1 binary binary
       unary 0 1 binary binary unary
       unary 'x unary unary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-derivative-laws-function
       unary unary 0 1 binary binary unary 'x unary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-coprime-laws-function
       unary 1 binary binary binary binary binary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-divisibility-laws-function
       unary binary binary binary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-irreducibility-laws-function
       unary 0 binary unary unary unary unary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-squarefree-laws-function
       unary 0 binary binary unary unary unary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q6783821-radical-laws-function
       unary 0 binary unary unary unary)))))

(value-triple
 (if (q6783821-all-reified-functions-tame-p)
     :itpeval-tame-reified-functions-checked
   (er hard 'q6783821-tameness
       "A reified statement function is not tame.")))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q6783821,
-- "Mason–Stothers theorem": the polynomial ABC degree bounds for three
-- nonzero coprime-summand polynomials over an arbitrary field, with the
-- alternative that all three formal derivatives vanish. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _≠_ _iff_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom : Set where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_≠_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x ≠ y =
  Not (x ≡ y)

data Dec
  {a : Level}
  (P : Set a) :
  Set a where

  yes : P -> Dec P
  no  : Not P -> Dec P

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : P -> P or Q
  right : Q -> P or Q

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (P : Set a)
  (Q : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward  : P -> Q
    backward : Q -> P

data LessOrEqual : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} ->
    LessOrEqual zero n
  successor-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    LessOrEqual m n ->
    LessOrEqual (suc m) (suc n)

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroF oneF : K
    addF multiplyF : K -> K -> K
    negateF inverseF : K -> K

    decidable-equality :
      (x y : K) ->
      Dec (x ≡ y)

    one-not-zero :
      oneF ≠ zeroF

    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addF x y ≡ addF y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addF (addF x y) z ≡ addF x (addF y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addF x zeroF ≡ x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addF x (negateF x) ≡ zeroF

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyF x y ≡ multiplyF y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyF (multiplyF x y) z ≡
      multiplyF x (multiplyF y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyF x oneF ≡ x
    multiply-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyF x zeroF ≡ zeroF
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyF x (addF y z) ≡
      addF (multiplyF x y) (multiplyF x z)

    inverse-zero :
      inverseF zeroF ≡ zeroF
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x ≠ zeroF ->
      multiplyF x (inverseF x) ≡ oneF

open Field

record Polynomial
  {a : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  (fieldStructure : Field K) :
  Set a where

  field
    coefficient : Nat -> K
    bound : Nat
    zero-after-bound :
      (offset : Nat) ->
      coefficient (bound + suc offset) ≡ zeroF fieldStructure

open Polynomial

oneCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  Nat ->
  K
oneCoefficient fieldStructure zero =
  oneF fieldStructure
oneCoefficient fieldStructure (suc n) =
  zeroF fieldStructure

multiplyCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  (Nat -> K) ->
  (Nat -> K) ->
  Nat ->
  K
multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure leftCoefficients rightCoefficients zero =
  multiplyF fieldStructure
    (leftCoefficients zero)
    (rightCoefficients zero)
multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure leftCoefficients rightCoefficients (suc n) =
  addF fieldStructure
    (multiplyF fieldStructure
      (leftCoefficients zero)
      (rightCoefficients (suc n)))
    (multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
      (λ i -> leftCoefficients (suc i))
      rightCoefficients
      n)

natScale :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  Nat ->
  K ->
  K
natScale fieldStructure zero x =
  zeroF fieldStructure
natScale fieldStructure (suc n) x =
  addF fieldStructure x (natScale fieldStructure n x)

NonzeroPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  {fieldStructure : Field K} ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
NonzeroPolynomial {fieldStructure = fieldStructure} polynomial =
  Σ Nat
    (λ n ->
      coefficient polynomial n ≠ zeroF fieldStructure)

DegreeOf :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  {fieldStructure : Field K} ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Nat ->
  Set a
DegreeOf {fieldStructure = fieldStructure} polynomial degree =
  (coefficient polynomial degree ≠ zeroF fieldStructure)
  and
  ((offset : Nat) ->
    coefficient polynomial (degree + suc offset) ≡ zeroF fieldStructure)

ProductEqual :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  (Nat -> K) ->
  Set a
ProductEqual fieldStructure leftPolynomial rightPolynomial result =
  (n : Nat) ->
  result n ≡
  multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
    (coefficient leftPolynomial)
    (coefficient rightPolynomial)
    n

Divides :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  (Nat -> K) ->
  Set a
Divides fieldStructure divisor dividend =
  Σ (Polynomial fieldStructure)
    (λ quotient ->
      ProductEqual fieldStructure divisor quotient dividend)

UnitPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
UnitPolynomial fieldStructure polynomial =
  Σ (Polynomial fieldStructure)
    (λ inversePolynomial ->
      ProductEqual fieldStructure
        polynomial
        inversePolynomial
        (oneCoefficient fieldStructure))

record Irreducible
  {a : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  (fieldStructure : Field K)
  (polynomial : Polynomial fieldStructure) :
  Set a where

  field
    nonzero :
      NonzeroPolynomial polynomial
    nonunit :
      Not (UnitPolynomial fieldStructure polynomial)
    factor-is-trivial :
      (leftPolynomial rightPolynomial : Polynomial fieldStructure) ->
      ProductEqual fieldStructure
        leftPolynomial
        rightPolynomial
        (coefficient polynomial) ->
      (UnitPolynomial fieldStructure leftPolynomial) or
      (UnitPolynomial fieldStructure rightPolynomial)

IsCoprime :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
IsCoprime fieldStructure leftPolynomial rightPolynomial =
  Σ (Polynomial fieldStructure)
    (λ leftCoefficient ->
      Σ (Polynomial fieldStructure)
        (λ rightCoefficient ->
          (n : Nat) ->
          addF fieldStructure
            (multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
              (coefficient leftCoefficient)
              (coefficient leftPolynomial)
              n)
            (multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
              (coefficient rightCoefficient)
              (coefficient rightPolynomial)
              n)
          ≡
          oneCoefficient fieldStructure n))

SquareDivides :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
SquareDivides fieldStructure divisor dividend =
  Σ (Polynomial fieldStructure)
    (λ quotient ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      coefficient dividend n ≡
      multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
        (multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
          (coefficient divisor)
          (coefficient divisor))
        (coefficient quotient)
        n)

SquareFree :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
SquareFree fieldStructure polynomial =
  (divisor : Polynomial fieldStructure) ->
  Irreducible fieldStructure divisor ->
  Not (SquareDivides fieldStructure divisor polynomial)

SameIrreducibleDivisors :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  (Nat -> K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
SameIrreducibleDivisors fieldStructure source radicalPolynomial =
  (divisor : Polynomial fieldStructure) ->
  Irreducible fieldStructure divisor ->
  (Divides fieldStructure divisor source)
  iff
  (Divides fieldStructure divisor (coefficient radicalPolynomial))

MonicOfDegree :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  {fieldStructure : Field K} ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Nat ->
  Set a
MonicOfDegree {fieldStructure = fieldStructure} polynomial degree =
  DegreeOf polynomial degree
  and
  (coefficient polynomial degree ≡ oneF fieldStructure)

RadicalDegree :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  (Nat -> K) ->
  Nat ->
  Set a
RadicalDegree fieldStructure source degree =
  Σ (Polynomial fieldStructure)
    (λ radicalPolynomial ->
      MonicOfDegree radicalPolynomial degree
      and
      SquareFree fieldStructure radicalPolynomial
      and
      SameIrreducibleDivisors
        fieldStructure
        source
        radicalPolynomial)

tripleProductCoefficient :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  {fieldStructure : Field K} ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Nat ->
  K
tripleProductCoefficient {fieldStructure = fieldStructure}
  firstPolynomial secondPolynomial thirdPolynomial n =
  multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
    (multiplyCoefficient fieldStructure
      (coefficient firstPolynomial)
      (coefficient secondPolynomial))
    (coefficient thirdPolynomial)
    n

SumIsZero :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
SumIsZero fieldStructure firstPolynomial secondPolynomial thirdPolynomial =
  (n : Nat) ->
  addF fieldStructure
    (addF fieldStructure
      (coefficient firstPolynomial n)
      (coefficient secondPolynomial n))
    (coefficient thirdPolynomial n)
  ≡
  zeroF fieldStructure

DerivativeIsZero :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Set a
DerivativeIsZero fieldStructure polynomial =
  (n : Nat) ->
  natScale fieldStructure
    (suc n)
    (coefficient polynomial (suc n))
  ≡
  zeroF fieldStructure

DegreeBound :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  Polynomial fieldStructure ->
  Nat ->
  Set a
DegreeBound fieldStructure polynomial radicalDegree =
  Σ Nat
    (λ polynomialDegree ->
      DegreeOf polynomial polynomialDegree
      and
      LessOrEqual (suc polynomialDegree) radicalDegree)

mason-stothers-theorem :
  (a : Level) ->
  Set (lsuc a)
mason-stothers-theorem a =
  (K : Set a) ->
  (fieldStructure : Field K) ->
  (firstPolynomial secondPolynomial thirdPolynomial :
    Polynomial fieldStructure) ->
  NonzeroPolynomial firstPolynomial ->
  NonzeroPolynomial secondPolynomial ->
  NonzeroPolynomial thirdPolynomial ->
  IsCoprime fieldStructure firstPolynomial secondPolynomial ->
  SumIsZero
    fieldStructure
    firstPolynomial
    secondPolynomial
    thirdPolynomial ->
  let product =
        tripleProductCoefficient
          firstPolynomial
          secondPolynomial
          thirdPolynomial
  in
  (Σ Nat
    (λ radicalDegree ->
      RadicalDegree fieldStructure product radicalDegree
      and
      (DegreeBound fieldStructure firstPolynomial radicalDegree)
      and
      (DegreeBound fieldStructure secondPolynomial radicalDegree)
      and
      (DegreeBound fieldStructure thirdPolynomial radicalDegree)))
  or
  ((DerivativeIsZero fieldStructure firstPolynomial)
    and
    (DerivativeIsZero fieldStructure secondPolynomial)
    and
    (DerivativeIsZero fieldStructure thirdPolynomial))

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q6783821, "Mason–Stothers theorem": for nonzero polynomials a, b, c over an
  arbitrary field, with a and b coprime and a + b + c = 0, each natural degree
  plus one is bounded by the natural degree of the radical of abc, or all
  three formal derivatives vanish. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory;

val q6783821_field_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_field_def",
  ``q6783821_field
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zero <> oneK /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x. mul oneK x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul (invK x) x = oneK)``);

val q6783821_polynomial_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_polynomial_def",
  ``q6783821_polynomial (zero : 'k) (p : num -> 'k) <=>
      FINITE {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q6783821_poly_zero_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_poly_zero_def",
  ``q6783821_poly_zero (zero : 'k) = (\n : num. zero)``);

val q6783821_poly_one_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_poly_one_def",
  ``q6783821_poly_one (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k) =
      (\n : num. if n = 0 then oneK else zero)``);

val q6783821_poly_add_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_poly_add_def",
  ``q6783821_poly_add
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (p : num -> 'k) q =
      (\n. add (p n) (q n))``);

val q6783821_poly_mul_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_poly_mul_def",
  ``q6783821_poly_mul
      (zero : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) (q : num -> 'k) (n : num) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc. add (mul (p i) (q (n - i))) acc)
        (count (SUC n))
        zero``);

val q6783821_nat_degree_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_nat_degree_def",
  ``q6783821_nat_degree (zero : 'k) (p : num -> 'k) =
      if (!n : num. p n = zero)
      then 0
      else MAX_SET {n : num | p n <> zero}``);

val q6783821_nat_cast_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_nat_cast_def",
  ``q6783821_nat_cast
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (add oneK) n zero``);

val q6783821_derivative_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_derivative_def",
  ``q6783821_derivative
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) =
      (\n : num.
         mul
           (q6783821_nat_cast zero oneK add (SUC n))
           (p (SUC n)))``);

val q6783821_divides_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_divides_def",
  ``q6783821_divides
      (zero : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) (q : num -> 'k) <=>
      ?r : num -> 'k.
        q6783821_polynomial zero r /\
        q = q6783821_poly_mul zero add mul p r``);

val q6783821_unit_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_unit_def",
  ``q6783821_unit
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) <=>
      q6783821_divides zero add mul p
        (q6783821_poly_one zero oneK)``);

val q6783821_squarefree_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_squarefree_def",
  ``q6783821_squarefree
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) <=>
      q6783821_polynomial zero p /\
      !q : num -> 'k.
        q6783821_polynomial zero q /\
        q6783821_divides zero add mul
          (q6783821_poly_mul zero add mul q q) p
        ==>
        q6783821_unit zero oneK add mul q``);

val q6783821_radical_nat_degree_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_radical_nat_degree_def",
  ``q6783821_radical_nat_degree
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) =
      MAX_SET
        {d : num |
          ?r : num -> 'k.
            q6783821_squarefree zero oneK add mul r /\
            q6783821_divides zero add mul r p /\
            d = q6783821_nat_degree zero r}``);

val q6783821_coprime_def = new_definition (
  "q6783821_coprime_def",
  ``q6783821_coprime
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num -> 'k) (q : num -> 'k) <=>
      ?x : num -> 'k. ?y : num -> 'k.
        q6783821_polynomial zero x /\
        q6783821_polynomial zero y /\
        q6783821_poly_add add
          (q6783821_poly_mul zero add mul x p)
          (q6783821_poly_mul zero add mul y q) =
        q6783821_poly_one zero oneK``);

val Polynomial_abc =
  ``!(zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (a : num -> 'k) (b : num -> 'k) (c : num -> 'k).
      q6783821_field zero oneK add mul neg invK /\
      q6783821_polynomial zero a /\
      q6783821_polynomial zero b /\
      q6783821_polynomial zero c /\
      a <> q6783821_poly_zero zero /\
      b <> q6783821_poly_zero zero /\
      c <> q6783821_poly_zero zero /\
      q6783821_coprime zero oneK add mul a b /\
      q6783821_poly_add add
        (q6783821_poly_add add a b) c =
        q6783821_poly_zero zero
      ==>
      let abc =
        q6783821_poly_mul zero add mul
          (q6783821_poly_mul zero add mul a b) c
      in
      let radical_degree =
        q6783821_radical_nat_degree zero oneK add mul abc
      in
        (q6783821_nat_degree zero a + 1 <= radical_degree /\
         q6783821_nat_degree zero b + 1 <= radical_degree /\
         q6783821_nat_degree zero c + 1 <= radical_degree) \/
        (q6783821_derivative zero oneK add mul a =
           q6783821_poly_zero zero /\
         q6783821_derivative zero oneK add mul b =
           q6783821_poly_zero zero /\
         q6783821_derivative zero oneK add mul c =
           q6783821_poly_zero zero)``;

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q6783821
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q6783821), catalog title "Mason-Stothers
  theorem": over an arbitrary field, three nonzero univariate polynomials
  that sum to zero, with the first two coprime, satisfy all three
  Mason-Stothers radical-degree bounds unless all three formal derivatives
  vanish. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q6783821Radical sends zero to one and otherwise is the product of the
  distinct monic irreducible divisors. This is the normalized polynomial
  radical used by the source. Q6783821Coprime is the polynomial-ring Bezout
  identity. On the nonzero polynomials occurring in the theorem, set.mm's
  deg1 agrees with the source's natural degree. All declarations below are
  unproved $a statement encodings; this root statement file contains no $p
  proof.
$)

$c Q6783821Factors Q6783821Radical Q6783821Coprime $.

q6783821-factors-syntax $a class ( Q6783821Factors F P ) $.
q6783821-radical-syntax $a class ( Q6783821Radical F P ) $.
q6783821-coprime-syntax $a wff ( Q6783821Coprime F A B ) $.

${
  $d F P q $.
  q6783821-factors-definition $a
    |- ( Q6783821Factors F P ) =
       { q e. ( Irred ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) |
         ( ( ( coe1 ` q ) ` ( ( deg1 ` F ) ` q ) ) = ( 1r ` F )
           /\
           q ( ||r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) P ) } $.
$}

${
  $d F P q $.
  q6783821-radical-definition $a
    |- ( Q6783821Radical F P ) =
       if ( P = ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) ,
         ( 1r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) ,
         ( ( mulGrp ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) gsum
           ( q e. ( Q6783821Factors F P ) |-> q ) ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B F U V $.
  q6783821-coprime-definition $a
    |- ( Q6783821Coprime F A B ) <->
       E. U e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
       E. V e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
       ( ( U ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) A )
           ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
           ( V ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) B ) ) =
         ( 1r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) $.
$}

${
  $d A B C F $.
  q6783821-mason-stothers-theorem $a
    |- A. F e. Field
       A. A e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
       A. B e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
       A. C e. ( Base ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
       ( ( A =/= ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
           /\
           ( B =/= ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
             /\
             ( C =/= ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
               /\
               ( ( Q6783821Coprime F A B )
                 /\
                 ( ( A ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) B )
                     ( +g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) C ) =
                   ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) ) ) ) )
         ->
         ( ( ( ( ( deg1 ` F ) ` A ) + 1 ) <_
               ( ( deg1 ` F ) `
                 ( Q6783821Radical F
                   ( ( A ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) B )
                     ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) C ) ) )
               /\
               ( ( ( ( deg1 ` F ) ` B ) + 1 ) <_
                   ( ( deg1 ` F ) `
                     ( Q6783821Radical F
                       ( ( A ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) B )
                         ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) C ) ) )
                 /\
                 ( ( ( deg1 ` F ) ` C ) + 1 ) <_
                   ( ( deg1 ` F ) `
                     ( Q6783821Radical F
                       ( ( A ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) B )
                         ( .r ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) C ) ) ) ) )
             \/
             ( ( ( ( ( 1o mPSDer F ) ` (/) ) ` A ) =
                   ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                 /\
                 ( ( ( ( 1o mPSDer F ) ` (/) ) ` B ) =
                     ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) )
                   /\
                   ( ( ( 1o mPSDer F ) ` (/) ) ` C ) =
                     ( 0g ` ( Poly1 ` F ) ) ) ) ) ) ) $.
$}
