       u *' a + v *' b = 1_.F) &
     a + b + c = 0_.F
  holds
    (ex r being Polynomial of F st
       r <> 0_.F &
       (ex t being Polynomial of F st
         r *' t = (a *' b) *' c) &
       (ex n being Nat, t being Polynomial of F st
         ((a *' b) *' c) *' t = r`^n) &
       (for q,t being Polynomial of F st
         (q *' q) *' t = r
        holds len q = 1) &
       len a < len r &
       len b < len r &
       len c < len r) or
    ((for n being Nat holds (n+1) * a.(n+1) = 0.F) &
     (for n being Nat holds (n+1) * b.(n+1) = 0.F) &
     (for n being Nat holds (n+1) * c.(n+1) = 0.F))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q6783821
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q6783821), "Mason–Stothers theorem": for three
% nonzero coprime polynomials over an arbitrary field whose sum is zero, the
% polynomial ABC degree bounds hold unless all three derivatives vanish.
% This file contains no proof.

Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem[
  F, Poly: TYPE+,
  zero_F, one_F: F,
  neg_F, inv_F: [F -> F],
  add_F, mul_F: [F, F -> F],
  zero_poly, one_poly: Poly,
  neg_poly, derivative_poly, radical_poly: [Poly -> Poly],
  add_poly, mul_poly: [Poly, Poly -> Poly],
  coefficient: [Poly, nat -> F],
  nat_degree: [Poly -> nat]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  field_laws: bool =
    NOT one_F = zero_F
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F): add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: F): add_F(x, neg_F(x)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: F): mul_F(x, y) = mul_F(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        mul_F(mul_F(x, y), z) = mul_F(x, mul_F(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F): mul_F(x, one_F) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
        mul_F(x, add_F(y, z))
          = add_F(mul_F(x, y), mul_F(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: F):
        NOT x = zero_F IMPLIES mul_F(x, inv_F(x)) = one_F)

  finitely_supported(f: [nat -> F]): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: nat):
      FORALL (index: nat):
        index > bound IMPLIES f(index) = zero_F

  nat_sub(left, right: nat): nat =
    IF right <= left THEN left - right ELSE 0 ENDIF

  natural_scalar(value: nat): RECURSIVE F =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      zero_F
    ELSE
      add_F(natural_scalar(value - 1), one_F)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  convolution_sum(
      p, q: Poly,
      target_degree, count: nat): RECURSIVE F =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_F
    ELSE
      add_F(
        convolution_sum(p, q, target_degree, count - 1),
        mul_F(
          coefficient(p, count - 1),
          coefficient(q, nat_sub(target_degree, count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_representation_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p, q: Poly):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        coefficient(p, index) = coefficient(q, index))
        IMPLIES p = q)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly):
        finitely_supported(
          LAMBDA (index: nat): coefficient(p, index)))
      AND (FORALL (f: [nat -> F]):
        finitely_supported(f) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (p: Poly):
            FORALL (index: nat):
              coefficient(p, index) = f(index))
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        coefficient(zero_poly, index) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        coefficient(one_poly, index)
          = IF index = 0 THEN one_F ELSE zero_F ENDIF)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly), (index: nat):
        coefficient(neg_poly(p), index)
          = neg_F(coefficient(p, index)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: Poly), (index: nat):
        coefficient(add_poly(p, q), index)
          = add_F(coefficient(p, index), coefficient(q, index)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: Poly), (index: nat):
        coefficient(mul_poly(p, q), index)
          = convolution_sum(p, q, index, index + 1))
      AND nat_degree(zero_poly) = 0
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly):
        NOT p = zero_poly IMPLIES
          NOT coefficient(p, nat_degree(p)) = zero_F)
      AND (FORALL (p: Poly), (index: nat):
        index > nat_degree(p) IMPLIES
          coefficient(p, index) = zero_F)

  derivative_laws: bool =
    FORALL (p: Poly), (index: nat):
      coefficient(derivative_poly(p), index)
        = mul_F(
            natural_scalar(index + 1),
            coefficient(p, index + 1))

  divides_poly(divisor, value: Poly): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: Poly):
      value = mul_poly(divisor, quotient)

  unit_poly(value: Poly): bool =
    EXISTS (inverse: Poly):
      mul_poly(value, inverse) = one_poly

  irreducible_poly(value: Poly): bool =
    NOT value = zero_poly
      AND NOT unit_poly(value)
      AND (FORALL (left, right: Poly):
        value = mul_poly(left, right)
          IMPLIES unit_poly(left) OR unit_poly(right))

  squarefree_poly(value: Poly): bool =
    FORALL (factor: Poly):
      irreducible_poly(factor) IMPLIES
        NOT divides_poly(mul_poly(factor, factor), value)

  radical_laws: bool =
    FORALL (p: Poly):
      NOT p = zero_poly IMPLIES
        divides_poly(radical_poly(p), p)
          AND squarefree_poly(radical_poly(p))
          AND (FORALL (factor: Poly):
            irreducible_poly(factor) IMPLIES
              (divides_poly(factor, radical_poly(p))
                IFF divides_poly(factor, p)))

  is_coprime(left, right: Poly): bool =
    EXISTS (x, y: Poly):
      add_poly(
        mul_poly(x, left),
        mul_poly(y, right)) = one_poly

  polynomial_context: bool =
    field_laws
      AND polynomial_representation_laws
      AND derivative_laws
      AND radical_laws

  mason_stothers_theorem: bool =
    polynomial_context IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, c: Poly):
        (NOT a = zero_poly
          AND NOT b = zero_poly
          AND NOT c = zero_poly
          AND is_coprime(a, b)
          AND add_poly(add_poly(a, b), c) = zero_poly)
        IMPLIES
          ((nat_degree(a) + 1
              <= nat_degree(
                radical_poly(mul_poly(mul_poly(a, b), c)))
            AND nat_degree(b) + 1
              <= nat_degree(
                radical_poly(mul_poly(mul_poly(a, b), c)))
            AND nat_degree(c) + 1
              <= nat_degree(
                radical_poly(mul_poly(mul_poly(a, b), c))))
          OR
            (derivative_poly(a) = zero_poly
              AND derivative_poly(b) = zero_poly
              AND derivative_poly(c) = zero_poly))

END Q6783821_mason_stothers_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q6813106
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q6813106), "Mellin inversion theorem": the
  inverse Mellin transform of the Mellin transform recovers a function at a
  positive real point under Mellin convergence, vertical integrability, and
  continuity at that point.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q6813106_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q6813106_empty {A : Type} : q6813106_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q6813106_full {A : Type} : q6813106_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q6813106_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q6813106_set A) : q6813106_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q6813106_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q6813106_set A) : q6813106_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q6813106_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q6813106_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q6813106_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E F : q6813106_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (E x /\ F x).

Definition q6813106_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q6813106_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j -> q6813106_disjoint (E i) (E j).

Definition q6813106_sigma_class {A : Type}
    (C : q6813106_set (q6813106_set A)) : Prop :=
  C q6813106_empty /\
  (forall E F : q6813106_set A,
    q6813106_same_set E F ->
    C E ->
    C F) /\
  (forall E : q6813106_set A,
    C E -> C (q6813106_complement E)) /\
  (forall E : nat -> q6813106_set A,
    (forall n : nat, C (E n)) ->
    C (q6813106_countable_union E)).

Inductive q6813106_ennreal : Type :=
| q6813106_ennreal_finite :
    forall value : R, 0 <= value -> q6813106_ennreal
| q6813106_ennreal_infinity : q6813106_ennreal.

Arguments q6813106_ennreal_finite value nonnegative : clear implicits.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_zero : q6813106_ennreal :=
  q6813106_ennreal_finite 0 (Rle_refl 0).

Definition q6813106_ennreal_eq
    (x y : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q6813106_ennreal_finite a _,
    q6813106_ennreal_finite b _ => a = b
  | q6813106_ennreal_infinity,
    q6813106_ennreal_infinity => True
  | _, _ => False
  end.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_le
    (x y : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  match x, y with
  | q6813106_ennreal_finite a _,
    q6813106_ennreal_finite b _ => a <= b
  | q6813106_ennreal_finite _ _,
    q6813106_ennreal_infinity => True
  | q6813106_ennreal_infinity,
    q6813106_ennreal_finite _ _ => False
  | q6813106_ennreal_infinity,
    q6813106_ennreal_infinity => True
  end.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_add
    (x y : q6813106_ennreal) : q6813106_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q6813106_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q6813106_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q6813106_ennreal_finite
        (a + b) (Rplus_le_le_0_compat a b ha hb)
  | _, _ => q6813106_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_mul
    (x y : q6813106_ennreal) : q6813106_ennreal :=
  match x, y with
  | q6813106_ennreal_finite a ha,
    q6813106_ennreal_finite b hb =>
      q6813106_ennreal_finite
        (a * b) (Rmult_le_pos a b ha hb)
  | q6813106_ennreal_finite a _, q6813106_ennreal_infinity
  | q6813106_ennreal_infinity, q6813106_ennreal_finite a _ =>
      if Req_EM_T a 0
      then q6813106_ennreal_zero
      else q6813106_ennreal_infinity
  | q6813106_ennreal_infinity, q6813106_ennreal_infinity =>
      q6813106_ennreal_infinity
  end.

Fixpoint q6813106_ennreal_partial_sum
    (u : nat -> q6813106_ennreal)
    (n : nat) : q6813106_ennreal :=
  match n with
  | O => q6813106_ennreal_zero
  | S k =>
      q6813106_ennreal_add
        (q6813106_ennreal_partial_sum u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_supremum
    (values : q6813106_ennreal -> Prop)
    (bound : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  (forall value : q6813106_ennreal,
      values value -> q6813106_ennreal_le value bound) /\
  (forall upper : q6813106_ennreal,
      (forall value : q6813106_ennreal,
        values value -> q6813106_ennreal_le value upper) ->
      q6813106_ennreal_le bound upper).

Definition q6813106_ennreal_series_sum
    (u : nat -> q6813106_ennreal)
    (sum : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q6813106_ennreal_supremum
    (fun value =>
      exists n : nat,
        q6813106_ennreal_eq value
          (q6813106_ennreal_partial_sum u n))
    sum.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_represents
    (x : q6813106_ennreal) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists nonnegative : 0 <= value,
    q6813106_ennreal_eq x
      (q6813106_ennreal_finite value nonnegative).

Definition q6813106_ennreal_finite_value
    (x : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists value : R, q6813106_ennreal_represents x value.

Record q6813106_measure_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q6813106_measurable : q6813106_set A -> Prop;
  q6813106_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q6813106_set A,
      q6813106_same_set E F ->
      (q6813106_measurable E <-> q6813106_measurable F);
  q6813106_measurable_empty :
    q6813106_measurable q6813106_empty;
  q6813106_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q6813106_set A,
      q6813106_measurable E ->
      q6813106_measurable (q6813106_complement E);
  q6813106_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q6813106_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q6813106_measurable (E n)) ->
      q6813106_measurable (q6813106_countable_union E);
  q6813106_measure : q6813106_set A -> q6813106_ennreal;
  q6813106_measure_extensional :
    forall E F : q6813106_set A,
      q6813106_same_set E F ->
      q6813106_ennreal_eq
        (q6813106_measure E) (q6813106_measure F);
  q6813106_measure_empty :
    q6813106_ennreal_eq
      (q6813106_measure q6813106_empty)
      q6813106_ennreal_zero;
  q6813106_measure_countable_additive :
    forall E : nat -> q6813106_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q6813106_measurable (E n)) ->
      q6813106_pairwise_disjoint E ->
      q6813106_ennreal_series_sum
        (fun n => q6813106_measure (E n))
        (q6813106_measure (q6813106_countable_union E))
}.

Arguments q6813106_measurable {A} _ _.
Arguments q6813106_measure {A} _ _.

Definition q6813106_almost_everywhere {A : Type}
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (P : A -> Prop) : Prop :=
  exists null_set : q6813106_set A,
    q6813106_measurable mu null_set /\
    q6813106_ennreal_eq
      (q6813106_measure mu null_set)
      q6813106_ennreal_zero /\
    forall x : A, ~ P x -> null_set x.

Record q6813106_normed_real_vector_space (G : Type) : Type := {
  q6813106_zero : G;
  q6813106_add : G -> G -> G;
  q6813106_neg : G -> G;
  q6813106_smul : R -> G -> G;
  q6813106_norm : G -> R;
  q6813106_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : G,
      q6813106_add x (q6813106_add y z) =
      q6813106_add (q6813106_add x y) z;
  q6813106_add_comm :
    forall x y : G, q6813106_add x y = q6813106_add y x;
  q6813106_add_zero :
    forall x : G, q6813106_add x q6813106_zero = x;
  q6813106_add_neg :
    forall x : G,
      q6813106_add x (q6813106_neg x) = q6813106_zero;
  q6813106_one_smul :
    forall x : G, q6813106_smul 1 x = x;
  q6813106_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q6813106_smul (a * b) x =
      q6813106_smul a (q6813106_smul b x);
  q6813106_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : G),
      q6813106_smul (a + b) x =
      q6813106_add (q6813106_smul a x) (q6813106_smul b x);
  q6813106_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : G),
      q6813106_smul a (q6813106_add x y) =
      q6813106_add (q6813106_smul a x) (q6813106_smul a y);
  q6813106_zero_smul :
    forall x : G, q6813106_smul 0 x = q6813106_zero;
  q6813106_smul_zero :
    forall a : R, q6813106_smul a q6813106_zero = q6813106_zero;
  q6813106_norm_nonnegative :
    forall x : G, 0 <= q6813106_norm x;
  q6813106_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : G,
      q6813106_norm x = 0 <-> x = q6813106_zero;
  q6813106_norm_add_le :
    forall x y : G,
      q6813106_norm (q6813106_add x y) <=
      q6813106_norm x + q6813106_norm y;
  q6813106_norm_smul :
    forall (a : R) (x : G),
      q6813106_norm (q6813106_smul a x) =
      Rabs a * q6813106_norm x
}.

Arguments q6813106_zero {G} _.
Arguments q6813106_add {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q6813106_neg {G} _ _.
Arguments q6813106_smul {G} _ _ _.
Arguments q6813106_norm {G} _ _.

Definition q6813106_sub {G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x y : G) : G :=
  q6813106_add V x (q6813106_neg V y).

Record q6813106_complex : Type := {
  q6813106_re : R;
  q6813106_im : R
}.

Definition q6813106_czero : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := 0; q6813106_im := 0 |}.

Definition q6813106_cone : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := 1; q6813106_im := 0 |}.

Definition q6813106_ci : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := 0; q6813106_im := 1 |}.

Definition q6813106_cadd
    (z w : q6813106_complex) : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := q6813106_re z + q6813106_re w;
     q6813106_im := q6813106_im z + q6813106_im w |}.

Definition q6813106_cmul
    (z w : q6813106_complex) : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re :=
       q6813106_re z * q6813106_re w -
       q6813106_im z * q6813106_im w;
     q6813106_im :=
       q6813106_re z * q6813106_im w +
       q6813106_im z * q6813106_re w |}.

Definition q6813106_cneg (z : q6813106_complex) : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := - q6813106_re z;
     q6813106_im := - q6813106_im z |}.

Definition q6813106_csub
    (z w : q6813106_complex) : q6813106_complex :=
  q6813106_cadd z (q6813106_cneg w).

Definition q6813106_real_to_complex (x : R) : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := x; q6813106_im := 0 |}.

Definition q6813106_complex_modulus (z : q6813106_complex) : R :=
  sqrt
    (q6813106_re z * q6813106_re z +
     q6813106_im z * q6813106_im z).

Definition q6813106_complex_exp (z : q6813106_complex) : q6813106_complex :=
  {| q6813106_re := exp (q6813106_re z) * cos (q6813106_im z);
     q6813106_im := exp (q6813106_re z) * sin (q6813106_im z) |}.

Record q6813106_complex_normed_space
    {E : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E) : Type := {
  q6813106_csmul : q6813106_complex -> E -> E;
  q6813106_csmul_one :
    forall x : E, q6813106_csmul q6813106_cone x = x;
  q6813106_csmul_mul :
    forall (a b : q6813106_complex) (x : E),
      q6813106_csmul (q6813106_cmul a b) x =
      q6813106_csmul a (q6813106_csmul b x);
  q6813106_csmul_add_scalar :
    forall (a b : q6813106_complex) (x : E),
      q6813106_csmul (q6813106_cadd a b) x =
      q6813106_add V (q6813106_csmul a x) (q6813106_csmul b x);
  q6813106_csmul_add_vector :
    forall (a : q6813106_complex) (x y : E),
      q6813106_csmul a (q6813106_add V x y) =
      q6813106_add V (q6813106_csmul a x) (q6813106_csmul a y);
  q6813106_csmul_real :
    forall (a : R) (x : E),
      q6813106_csmul (q6813106_real_to_complex a) x =
      q6813106_smul V a x;
  q6813106_norm_csmul :
    forall (a : q6813106_complex) (x : E),
      q6813106_norm V (q6813106_csmul a x) =

Definition q6813106_real_open
    (U : q6813106_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < radius ->
        U y.

Definition q6813106_real_borel_set
    (S : q6813106_set R) : Prop :=
  forall classes : q6813106_set (q6813106_set R),
    q6813106_sigma_class classes ->
    (forall U : q6813106_set R,
      q6813106_real_open U -> classes U) ->

  fun x => 0 < x <= 1.

    (mu : q6813106_measure_space R) : Prop :=

      q6813106_measurable mu S <-> q6813106_real_borel_set S) /\
  (forall (a : R) (S : q6813106_set R),
      q6813106_ennreal_eq
        (q6813106_measure mu
          (fun x => S (a + x)))
        (q6813106_measure mu S)) /\
  q6813106_ennreal_eq
    (q6813106_measure mu q6813106_unit_interval)
    (q6813106_ennreal_finite 1 Rle_0_1).

Definition q6813106_vector_sequence_converges {G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (limit : G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q6813106_norm V
          (q6813106_sub V (u n) limit) < epsilon.

    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall m n : nat,
        (N <= m)%nat ->
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q6813106_norm V
          (q6813106_sub V (u m) (u n)) < epsilon.

    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G) : Prop :=
  forall u : nat -> G,
    q6813106_vector_sequence_cauchy V u ->
    exists limit : G,
      q6813106_vector_sequence_converges V u limit.

Definition q6813106_real_sequence_converges
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->

Definition q6813106_finite_partition {A : Type}
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q6813106_set A) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat -> q6813106_measurable mu (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q6813106_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q6813106_measurable_simple {A G : Type}
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q6813106_set A),
    q6813106_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i.

Definition q6813106_ae_strongly_measurable {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists approximants : nat -> A -> G,
    (forall n : nat,
      q6813106_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    q6813106_almost_everywhere mu
      (fun x =>
        q6813106_vector_sequence_converges V
          (fun n => approximants n x) (f x)).

Record q6813106_nonnegative_real : Type := {
  q6813106_nnreal_value : R;
  q6813106_nnreal_nonnegative : 0 <= q6813106_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q6813106_ennreal_of_nonnegative
    (x : q6813106_nonnegative_real) : q6813106_ennreal :=
  q6813106_ennreal_finite
    (q6813106_nnreal_value x)
    (q6813106_nnreal_nonnegative x).

Definition q6813106_simple_lintegral_below {A : Type}
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q6813106_ennreal)
    (value : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat)
         (coefficients : nat -> q6813106_nonnegative_real)
         (cells : nat -> q6813106_set A),
    q6813106_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      q6813106_ennreal_le
        (q6813106_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
        (f x)) /\
    q6813106_ennreal_eq value
      (q6813106_ennreal_partial_sum
        (fun i =>
          q6813106_ennreal_mul
            (q6813106_ennreal_of_nonnegative (coefficients i))
            (q6813106_measure mu (cells i)))
        k).

Definition q6813106_lintegral_has_value {A : Type}
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> q6813106_ennreal)
    (value : q6813106_ennreal) : Prop :=
  q6813106_ennreal_supremum
    (q6813106_simple_lintegral_below mu f) value.

Definition q6813106_norm_ennreal {G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (x : G) : q6813106_ennreal :=
  q6813106_ennreal_finite
    (q6813106_norm V x)
    (q6813106_norm_nonnegative V x).

Definition q6813106_integrable {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  q6813106_ae_strongly_measurable V mu f /\
  exists value : q6813106_ennreal,
    q6813106_lintegral_has_value mu
      (fun x => q6813106_norm_ennreal V (f x)) value /\
    q6813106_ennreal_finite_value value.

Fixpoint q6813106_vector_sum {G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (u : nat -> G) (n : nat) : G :=
  match n with
  | O => q6813106_zero V
  | S k =>
      q6813106_add V
        (q6813106_vector_sum V u k) (u k)
  end.

Definition q6813106_weighted_cell_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (cell : q6813106_set A)
    (coefficient value : G) : Prop :=
  (coefficient = q6813106_zero V /\
    value = q6813106_zero V) \/
  exists mass : R,
    q6813106_ennreal_represents
      (q6813106_measure mu cell) mass /\
    value = q6813106_smul V mass coefficient.

Definition q6813106_simple_integral_has_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (s : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients terms : nat -> G)
         (cells : nat -> q6813106_set A),
    q6813106_finite_partition mu k cells /\
    (forall (x : A) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      s x = coefficients i) /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat ->
      q6813106_weighted_cell_value
        V mu (cells i) (coefficients i) (terms i)) /\
    value = q6813106_vector_sum V terms k.

Definition q6813106_l1_approximates {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
    (f : A -> G) : Prop :=
  exists errors : nat -> R,
    (forall n : nat,
      exists integral_error : q6813106_ennreal,
        q6813106_lintegral_has_value mu
          (fun x =>
            q6813106_norm_ennreal V
              (q6813106_sub V (approximants n x) (f x)))
          integral_error /\
        q6813106_ennreal_represents
          integral_error (errors n)) /\
    q6813106_real_sequence_converges errors 0.

Definition q6813106_standard_bochner_integral_value {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) (value : G) : Prop :=
  exists (approximants : nat -> A -> G)
         (integrals : nat -> G),
    (forall n : nat,
      q6813106_measurable_simple mu (approximants n)) /\
    (forall n : nat,
      q6813106_simple_integral_has_value
        V mu (approximants n) (integrals n)) /\
    q6813106_l1_approximates V mu approximants f /\
    q6813106_vector_sequence_converges V integrals value.

Definition q6813106_bochner_integral {A G : Type}
    (V : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space G)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space A)
    (f : A -> G) : G :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists value : G,
            q6813106_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon (inhabits (q6813106_zero V))
        (fun value : G =>
          q6813106_standard_bochner_integral_value V mu f value)
  | right _ => q6813106_zero V
  end.

Definition q6813106_continuous_at_real
    {E : Type}
    (NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (f : R -> E) (x : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < delta ->
        q6813106_norm NE
          (q6813106_sub NE (f y) (f x)) < epsilon.

Definition q6813106_real_cpow
    (x : R) (s : q6813106_complex) : q6813106_complex :=
  q6813106_complex_exp
    (q6813106_cmul s (q6813106_real_to_complex (ln x))).

Definition q6813106_vertical_point
    (sigma y : R) : q6813106_complex :=
  q6813106_cadd
    (q6813106_real_to_complex sigma)
    (q6813106_cmul (q6813106_real_to_complex y) q6813106_ci).

Definition q6813106_mellin_integrand
    {E : Type}
    {NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E}
    (CE : q6813106_complex_normed_space NE)
    (f : R -> E) (s : q6813106_complex) (t : R) : E :=
  if Rlt_dec 0 t then
    q6813106_csmul CE
      (q6813106_real_cpow t
        (q6813106_csub s q6813106_cone))
      (f t)
  else q6813106_zero NE.

Definition q6813106_mellin_convergent
    {E : Type}
    (NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (CE : q6813106_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space R)
    (f : R -> E) (s : q6813106_complex) : Prop :=
  q6813106_integrable NE mu
    (q6813106_mellin_integrand CE f s).

Definition q6813106_mellin
    {E : Type}
    (NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (CE : q6813106_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space R)
    (f : R -> E) (s : q6813106_complex) : E :=
  q6813106_bochner_integral NE mu
    (q6813106_mellin_integrand CE f s).

Definition q6813106_vertical_integrable
    {E : Type}
    (NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space R)
    (F : q6813106_complex -> E) (sigma : R) : Prop :=
  q6813106_integrable NE mu
    (fun y => F (q6813106_vertical_point sigma y)).

Definition q6813106_mellin_inverse
    {E : Type}
    (NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E)
    (CE : q6813106_complex_normed_space NE)
    (mu : q6813106_measure_space R)
    (sigma : R) (F : q6813106_complex -> E) (x : R) : E :=
  q6813106_smul NE (1 / (2 * PI))
    (q6813106_bochner_integral NE mu
      (fun y =>
        let s := q6813106_vertical_point sigma y in
        q6813106_csmul CE
          (q6813106_real_cpow x (q6813106_cneg s))
          (F s))).

Theorem mellin_inversion :
  forall (E : Type)
         (NE : q6813106_normed_real_vector_space E)
         (CE : q6813106_complex_normed_space NE)
         (mu : q6813106_measure_space R)
         (sigma : R) (f : R -> E) (x : R),
    q6813106_is_real_lebesgue_measure mu ->
    q6813106_complete NE ->
    0 < x ->
    @q6813106_mellin_convergent E NE CE mu f
      (q6813106_real_to_complex sigma) ->
    q6813106_vertical_integrable NE mu
      (@q6813106_mellin E NE CE mu f) sigma ->
    q6813106_continuous_at_real NE f x ->
    @q6813106_mellin_inverse E NE CE mu sigma
      (@q6813106_mellin E NE CE mu f) x = f x.
Admitted.

title: Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q6813106, "Mellin inversion theorem": at a positive real point of continuity,
  the inverse Mellin transform of a Mellin-convergent function equals the
  original function when its transform is integrable on the vertical line.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
    "HOL-Analysis.Lebesgue_Measure"
    "HOL-Analysis.Complex_Transcendental"
begin

definition q6813106_complex_normed_vector ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6813106_complex_normed_vector cscale \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a x y. cscale a (x + y) = cscale a x + cscale a y) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a + b) x = cscale a x + cscale b x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a b x. cscale (a * b) x = cscale a (cscale b x)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x. cscale 1 x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>r x. cscale (of_real r) x = scaleR r x) \<and>
    (\<forall>a x. norm (cscale a x) = norm a * norm x)"

definition q6813106_ae_strongly_measurable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6813106_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. simple_function M (s n)) \<and>
      (AE x in M. (\<lambda>n. s n x) \<longlonglongrightarrow> f x))"

definition q6813106_has_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6813106_has_bochner_integral M f I \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6813106_ae_strongly_measurable M f \<and>
    (\<exists>s :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'e.
      (\<forall>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integrable M (s n)) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. \<integral>\<^sup>+x. ennreal (norm (f x - s n x)) \<partial>M)
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0) \<and>
      ((\<lambda>n. Bochner_Integration.simple_bochner_integral M (s n))
        \<longlonglongrightarrow> I))"

definition q6813106_integrable ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6813106_integrable M f \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<exists>I. q6813106_has_bochner_integral M f I)"

definition q6813106_bochner_integral ::
    "'a measure \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q6813106_bochner_integral M f =
    (if \<exists>I. q6813106_has_bochner_integral M f I
     then THE I. q6813106_has_bochner_integral M f I
     else 0)"

definition q6813106_mellin_convergent ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (real \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6813106_mellin_convergent cscale f s \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6813106_integrable (restrict_space lborel {0<..})
      (\<lambda>t. cscale ((of_real t :: complex) powr (s - 1)) (f t))"

definition q6813106_mellin ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      (real \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> complex \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q6813106_mellin cscale f s =
    q6813106_bochner_integral (restrict_space lborel {0<..})
      (\<lambda>t. cscale ((of_real t :: complex) powr (s - 1)) (f t))"

definition q6813106_vertical_integrable ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q6813106_vertical_integrable F r \<longleftrightarrow>
    q6813106_integrable lborel
      (\<lambda>y. F (of_real r + of_real y * \<i>))"

definition q6813106_mellin_inverse ::
    "(complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow>
      real \<Rightarrow> (complex \<Rightarrow> 'e) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> 'e" where
  "q6813106_mellin_inverse cscale r F x =
    scaleR (1 / (2 * pi))
      (q6813106_bochner_integral lborel
        (\<lambda>y.
          cscale
            ((of_real x :: complex) powr
              (- (of_real r + of_real y * \<i>)))
            (F (of_real r + of_real y * \<i>))))"

theorem mellin_inversion:
  fixes cscale ::
      "complex \<Rightarrow> 'e::{real_normed_vector,complete_space} \<Rightarrow> 'e"
    and sigma x :: real
    and f :: "real \<Rightarrow> 'e"
  assumes complex_space: "q6813106_complex_normed_vector cscale"
    and x_positive: "0 < x"
    and mellin_convergent:
      "q6813106_mellin_convergent cscale f (of_real sigma)"
    and transform_vertical_integrable:
      "q6813106_vertical_integrable (q6813106_mellin cscale f) sigma"
    and continuous_at_x: "continuous (at x) f"
  shows
    "q6813106_mellin_inverse cscale sigma
      (q6813106_mellin cscale f) x = f x"
  sorry

end

title: Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q6813106,
  "Mellin inversion theorem": for a Banach-valued function on the reals, its
  inverse Mellin transform recovers the function at a positive continuity
  point under Mellin and vertical integrability assumptions. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let q6813106_output = open_out "/dev/null";;
Format.pp_set_formatter_out_channel Format.std_formatter q6813106_output;;
let q6813106_formatter = Format.formatter_of_out_channel q6813106_output;;
let q6813106_previous_loader = !Hol_loader.file_loader;;
Hol_loader.file_loader :=
  (fun path -> Toploop.use_file q6813106_formatter path);;
let q6813106_loaded =
  Toploop.use_file q6813106_formatter "Library/transc.ml";;
Hol_loader.file_loader := q6813106_previous_loader;;
Format.pp_print_flush q6813106_formatter ();;
if not q6813106_loaded then failwith "Unable to load transcendental library";;

let Q6813106_MELLIN_INVERSION_THEOREM =
 `let enonnegative =
      \(z:bool#real).
        (FST z /\ SND z = &0) \/
        (~(FST z) /\ &0 <= SND z) in
   let ezero = (F,&0) in
   let ele =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        FST y \/ (~(FST x) /\ SND x <= SND y) in
   let eadd =
      \(x:bool#real) (y:bool#real).
        if FST x \/ FST y
        then (T,&0)
        else (F,SND x + SND y) in
   let escale =
      \(c:real) (x:bool#real).
        if c = &0
        then ezero
        else if FST x
             then (T,&0)
             else (F,c * SND x) in
   let esup_sequence =
      \(u:num->bool#real) (z:bool#real).
        enonnegative z /\
        (!n. enonnegative (u n) /\ ele (u n) z) /\
        (!w. enonnegative w /\ (!n. ele (u n) w) ==> ele z w) in
   let cadd =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z + FST w,SND z + SND w) in
   let cmul =
      \(z:real#real) (w:real#real).
        (FST z * FST w - SND z * SND w,
         FST z * SND w + SND z * FST w) in
   let cmod =
      \(z:real#real).
        sqrt(FST z pow 2 + SND z pow 2) in
   let cone = (&1,&0) in
   let czero = (&0,&0) in
   let positive_cpow =
      \(t:real) (z:real#real).
        (exp(ln t * FST z) * cos(ln t * SND z),
         exp(ln t * FST z) * sin(ln t * SND z)) in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events (:real) /\
        (!s:real->bool. events s ==> events ((:real) DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->real->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:real | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let measure_space =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:real->bool. enonnegative (mu s)) /\
        mu {} = ezero /\
        (!sets:num->real->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> ?partial:num->bool#real.
                 partial 0 = ezero /\
                 (!n. partial (SUC n) =
                      eadd (partial n) (mu (sets n))) /\
                 esup_sequence partial
                   (mu {x:real | ?n. x IN sets n})) in
   let metric_open =
      \(s:real->bool).
        !x:real.
          x IN s
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:real. abs(y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN s in
   let borel_space =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra events /\
        (!s:real->bool. metric_open s ==> events s) /\
        (!other:(real->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra other /\
           (!s:real->bool. metric_open s ==> other s)
           ==> !s:real->bool. events s ==> other s) in
   let lebesgue_measure =
      \(mu:(real->bool)->bool#real).
        !a b:real.
          mu {x:real | a < x /\ x <= b} =
          (F,if a <= b then b - a else &0) in
   let almost_everywhere =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real) (P:real->bool).
        ?N:real->bool.
          events N /\
          mu N = ezero /\
          {x:real | x IN carrier /\ ~(P x)} SUBSET N in
   let scalar_tends =
      \(u:num->real) (l:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n ==> abs(u n - l) < epsilon in
   let vector_tends =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (u:num->E) (l:E).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                N <= n
                ==> normE (addE (u n) (negE l)) < epsilon in
   let complex_normed_vector_space =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real).
        (!x y:E. addE x y = addE y x) /\
        (!x y z:E. addE (addE x y) z = addE x (addE y z)) /\
        (!x:E. addE x zeroE = x) /\
        (!x:E. addE x (negE x) = zeroE) /\
        (!x:E. negE (negE x) = x) /\
        (!x:E. csmul cone x = x) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:E.
           csmul (cmul a b) x = csmul a (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a b:real#real x:E.
           csmul (cadd a b) x =
           addE (csmul a x) (csmul b x)) /\
        (!a:real#real x y:E.
           csmul a (addE x y) =
           addE (csmul a x) (csmul a y)) /\
        (!x:E. csmul czero x = zeroE) /\
        (!a:real#real. csmul a zeroE = zeroE) /\
        (!x:E. &0 <= normE x) /\
        (!x:E. normE x = &0 <=> x = zeroE) /\
        (!a:real#real x:E.
           normE (csmul a x) = cmod a * normE x) /\
        (!x y:E. normE (addE x y) <= normE x + normE y) in
   let complete_space =
      \(zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real).
        !u:num->E.
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !m n:num.
                   N <= m /\ N <= n
                   ==> normE
                         (addE (u m) (negE (u n))) < epsilon)
          ==> ?l:E. vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE u l in
   let simple_scalar =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (s:real->real).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real.
           events {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_vector =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (s:real->E).
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:E.
           events {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (h:real->real).
        ?s:num->real->real.
          (!n. simple_scalar carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x:real.
             x IN carrier
             ==> scalar_tends (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:real->E).
        ?s:num->real->E.
          (!n. simple_vector carrier events (s n)) /\
          (!x:real.
             x IN carrier
             ==> vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE
                   (\n. s n x) (h x)) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_scalar =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real) (h:real->real).
        ?g:real->real.
          strongly_measurable_scalar carrier events g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu
            (\x. h x = g x) in
   let ae_strongly_measurable_vector =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:real->E).
        ?g:real->E.
          strongly_measurable_vector
            carrier events zeroE addE negE normE g /\
          almost_everywhere carrier events mu
            (\x. h x = g x) in
   let integrable_simple_vector =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real) (zeroE:E) (s:real->E).
        simple_vector carrier events s /\
        (!c:E.
           c IN IMAGE s carrier /\ ~(c = zeroE)
           ==> ~(FST
                  (mu {x:real | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}))) in
   let simple_nonnegative_integral =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (s:real->real) (z:bool#real).
        (!x:real. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x) /\
        ?n:num enum:num->real partial:num->bool#real.
          (!c:real.
             c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
             ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = ezero /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 eadd
                   (partial i)
                   (escale
                     (enum i)
                     (mu {x:real |
                            x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i}))) /\
          z = partial n in
   let simple_vector_integral =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (s:real->E) (z:E).
        ?n:num enum:num->E partial:num->E.
          (!c:E.
             c IN IMAGE s carrier <=>
             ?i:num. i < n /\ enum i = c) /\
          (!i j:num.
             i < n /\ j < n /\ enum i = enum j ==> i = j) /\
          partial 0 = zeroE /\
          (!i:num.
             i < n
             ==> partial (SUC i) =
                 addE
                   (csmul
                     (SND
                       (mu {x:real |
                              x IN carrier /\ s x = enum i}),&0)
                     (enum i))
                   (partial i)) /\
          z = partial n in
   let nonnegative_integral_upper_bound =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:real->real) (u:bool#real).
        enonnegative u /\
        !s:real->real z:bool#real.
          simple_scalar carrier events s /\
          (!x:real. x IN carrier ==> s x <= h x) /\
          simple_nonnegative_integral carrier mu s z
          ==> ele z u in
   let has_nonnegative_integral =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (h:real->real) (r:bool#real).
        enonnegative r /\
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound
          carrier events mu h r /\
        (!u:bool#real.
           nonnegative_integral_upper_bound
             carrier events mu h u
           ==> ele r u) in
   let vector_integrable =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (h:real->E).
        ae_strongly_measurable_vector
          carrier events mu zeroE addE negE normE h /\
        (?r:bool#real.
           has_nonnegative_integral carrier events mu
             (\x:real. normE(h x)) r /\
           ~(FST r)) in
   let has_bochner_integral =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (h:real->E) (z:E).
        ?s:num->real->E ints:num->E.
          (!n. integrable_simple_vector
                 carrier events mu zeroE (s n)) /\
          (!n. simple_vector_integral
                 carrier mu zeroE addE csmul (s n) (ints n)) /\
          (!epsilon:real.
             &0 < epsilon
             ==> ?N:num. !n:num.
                   N <= n
                   ==> ?d:bool#real.
                         has_nonnegative_integral
                           carrier events mu
                           (\x:real.
                              normE
                                (addE (s n x) (negE (h x)))) d /\
                         ~(FST d) /\
                         SND d < epsilon) /\
          vector_tends zeroE addE negE normE ints z in
   let bochner_integral =
      \(carrier:real->bool) (events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (h:real->E).
        if complete_space zeroE addE negE normE /\
           vector_integrable
             carrier events mu zeroE addE negE normE h
        then @z:E.
               has_bochner_integral
                 carrier events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE h z
        else zeroE in
   let continuous_at =
      \(addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:real->E) (x:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?delta:real.
                &0 < delta /\
                !y:real.
                  abs(y - x) < delta
                  ==> normE
                        (addE (f y) (negE (f x))) < epsilon in
   let mellin_convergent =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:real->E) (s:real#real).
        vector_integrable
          {t:real | &0 < t} events mu zeroE addE negE normE
          (\t:real.
             csmul
               (positive_cpow t (FST s - &1,SND s))
               (f t)) in
   let mellin =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (f:real->E) (s:real#real).
        bochner_integral
          {t:real | &0 < t} events mu
          zeroE addE negE csmul normE
          (\t:real.
             csmul
               (positive_cpow t (FST s - &1,SND s))
               (f t)) in
   let vertical_integrable =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (normE:E->real) (transform:(real#real)->E) (sigma:real).
        vector_integrable
          (:real) events mu zeroE addE negE normE
          (\y:real. transform (sigma,y)) in
   let mellin_inv =
      \(events:(real->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(real->bool)->bool#real)
       (zeroE:E) (addE:E->E->E) (negE:E->E)
       (csmul:(real#real)->E->E) (normE:E->real)
       (sigma:real) (transform:(real#real)->E) (x:real).
        csmul (&1 / (&2 * pi),&0)
          (bochner_integral
            (:real) events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE
            (\y:real.
               csmul
                 (positive_cpow x (--sigma,--y))
                 (transform (sigma,y)))) in
   !events:(real->bool)->bool
    mu:(real->bool)->bool#real
    zeroE:E
    addE:E->E->E
    negE:E->E
    csmul:(real#real)->E->E
    normE:E->real.
      borel_space events /\
      measure_space events mu /\
      lebesgue_measure mu /\
      complex_normed_vector_space zeroE addE negE csmul normE /\
      complete_space zeroE addE negE normE
      ==>
      !sigma:real f:real->E x:real.
        &0 < x /\
        mellin_convergent
          events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE f (sigma,&0) /\
        vertical_integrable
          events mu zeroE addE negE normE
          (mellin
            events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE f)
          sigma /\
        continuous_at addE negE normE f x
        ==> mellin_inv
              events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE sigma
              (mellin
                events mu zeroE addE negE csmul normE f) x =
            f x`;;

title: Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q6813106,
;; "Mellin inversion theorem": for a complex Banach-valued function with a
;; convergent Mellin transform on a vertical line, integrable transform along
;; that line, and continuity at a positive point, inverse Mellin transformation
;; recovers the function there. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Mathematical objects are unrestricted ACL2 objects.  The conservative
;; interfaces below only provide application and constructor symbols; every
;; field, space, topology, measure, integral, and Fourier law used by the
;; statement is imposed explicitly by predicates below.

(defstub q6813106-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q6813106-zero (type) t)
(defstub q6813106-one (type) t)
(defstub q6813106-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q6813106-multiply (type left right) t)
(defstub q6813106-negate (type object) t)
(defstub q6813106-inverse (type object) t)
(defstub q6813106-less (type left right) t)
(defstub q6813106-norm (type object) t)
(defstub q6813106-smul (scalar-type space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q6813106-star (scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q6813106-real-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q6813106-imag-part (real-type scalar-type scalar) t)
(defstub q6813106-of-real (real-type scalar-type real) t)
(defstub q6813106-imaginary-unit (scalar-type) t)
(defstub q6813106-inner (scalar-type space left right) t)
(defstub q6813106-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q6813106-sequence-at (sequence index) t)
(defstub q6813106-basis-at (basis index) t)
(defstub q6813106-coordinate (coordinates vector index) t)
(defstub q6813106-fourier-function (fourier function) t)
(defstub q6813106-fourier-inverse-function (fourier-inverse function) t)
(defstub q6813106-character-value (fourier-char real) t)
(defstub q6813106-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q6813106-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q6813106-open-ball-set (space center radius) t)
(defstub q6813106-preimage-set (function set) t)
(defstub q6813106-complement-set (carrier set) t)
(defstub q6813106-countable-union-set (carrier sequence) t)
(defstub q6813106-translate-set (space set shift) t)
(defstub q6813106-unit-cell-set (space basis coordinates dimension) t)
(defstub q6813106-fiber-set (function value) t)
(defstub q6813106-simple-values (function) t)
(defstub q6813106-indicator-function (real-type set) t)
(defstub q6813106-function-add (type left right) t)
(defstub q6813106-function-difference (type left right) t)
(defstub q6813106-function-norm (real-type type function) t)
(defstub q6813106-fourier-integrand
  (real-type scalar-type domain space fourier-char function frequency) t)
(defstub q6813106-inverse-fourier-integrand
  (real-type scalar-type domain space fourier-char function frequency) t)
(defstub q6813106-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q6813106-lintegral-value (lintegral function) t)
(defstub q6813106-bochner-integral-value (integral function) t)
(defstub q6813106-full-set (carrier) t)
(defstub q6813106-point-sequence (function-sequence point) t)
(defstub q6813106-simple-integral-sequence
  (real-type domain space measure function-sequence) t)
(defstub q6813106-exponential-sequence (real-type x) t)
(defstub q6813106-real-exponential (real-type x) t)
(defstub q6813106-real-logarithm (real-type x) t)
(defstub q6813106-mellin-coordinate-function
  (real-type complex-type space sigma function) t)

(defun q6813106-positive-p (real-type x)
  (q6813106-less real-type (q6813106-zero real-type) x))

(defun q6813106-leq (real-type x y)
  (not (q6813106-less real-type y x)))

(defun q6813106-abs (real-type x)
  (if (q6813106-less real-type x (q6813106-zero real-type))
      (q6813106-negate real-type x)
    x))

(defun q6813106-natural-cast (type n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q6813106-zero type)
    (q6813106-add
     type
     (q6813106-one type)
     (q6813106-natural-cast type (- n 1)))))

(defun q6813106-integer-cast (type n)
  (if (and (integerp n) (< n 0))
      (q6813106-negate
       type
       (q6813106-natural-cast type (- n)))
    (q6813106-natural-cast type (nfix n))))


(defun q6813106-vector-sum
    (real-type space basis coordinates vector n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q6813106-zero space)
    (let ((i (- n 1)))
      (q6813106-add
       space
       (q6813106-vector-sum
        real-type space basis coordinates vector i)
       (q6813106-smul
        real-type space
        (q6813106-coordinate coordinates vector i)
        (q6813106-basis-at basis i))))))


;; Complete ordered real field and its canonical complexification.

(defun-sk q6813106-field-laws-p (type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p type x)
      (q6813106-member-p type y)
      (q6813106-member-p type z))
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p type (q6813106-add type x y))
      (q6813106-member-p type (q6813106-multiply type x y))
      (q6813106-member-p type (q6813106-negate type x))
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q6813106-zero type)))
       (q6813106-member-p type (q6813106-inverse type x)))
      (equal
       (q6813106-add type (q6813106-add type x y) z)
       (q6813106-add type x (q6813106-add type y z)))
      (equal (q6813106-add type x y) (q6813106-add type y x))
      (equal (q6813106-add type x (q6813106-zero type)) x)
      (equal
       (q6813106-add type x (q6813106-negate type x))
       (q6813106-zero type))
      (equal
       (q6813106-multiply type (q6813106-multiply type x y) z)
       (q6813106-multiply type x (q6813106-multiply type y z)))
      (equal
       (q6813106-multiply type x y)
       (q6813106-multiply type y x))
      (equal (q6813106-multiply type x (q6813106-one type)) x)
      (implies
       (not (equal x (q6813106-zero type)))
       (equal
        (q6813106-multiply type x (q6813106-inverse type x))
        (q6813106-one type)))
      (equal
       (q6813106-multiply type x (q6813106-add type y z))
       (q6813106-add
        type
        (q6813106-multiply type x y)
        (q6813106-multiply type x z)))))))

(defun-sk q6813106-order-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p real-type x)
      (q6813106-member-p real-type y)
      (q6813106-member-p real-type z))
     (and
      (not (q6813106-less real-type x x))
      (or
       (q6813106-less real-type x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q6813106-less real-type y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q6813106-less real-type x y)
        (q6813106-less real-type y z))
       (q6813106-less real-type x z))
      (implies
       (q6813106-less real-type x y)
       (q6813106-less
        real-type
        (q6813106-add real-type x z)
        (q6813106-add real-type y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q6813106-positive-p real-type x)
        (q6813106-positive-p real-type y))
       (q6813106-positive-p
        real-type
        (q6813106-multiply real-type x y)))))))

(defun q6813106-distance
    (real-type type x y)
  (declare (ignore real-type))
  (q6813106-norm
   type
   (q6813106-add type x (q6813106-negate type y))))

(defun-sk q6813106-norm-values-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q6813106-member-p type x)
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p real-type (q6813106-norm type x))
      (q6813106-leq
       real-type
       (q6813106-zero real-type)
       (q6813106-norm type x))
      (iff
       (equal
        (q6813106-norm type x)
        (q6813106-zero real-type))
       (equal x (q6813106-zero type)))))))

(defun-sk q6813106-norm-triangle-p (real-type type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p type x)
      (q6813106-member-p type y))
     (q6813106-leq
      real-type
      (q6813106-norm type (q6813106-add type x y))
      (q6813106-add
       real-type
       (q6813106-norm type x)
       (q6813106-norm type y))))))

(defun q6813106-norm-laws-p (real-type type)
  (and
   (q6813106-norm-values-p real-type type)
   (q6813106-norm-triangle-p real-type type)))

(defun-sk q6813106-convergence-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon start)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and (natp n) (natp start) (<= start n))
     (q6813106-less
      real-type
      (q6813106-distance
       real-type type
       (q6813106-sequence-at sequence n)
       limit)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q6813106-convergence-start-p
    (real-type type sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q6813106-convergence-tail-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q6813106-converges-p
    (real-type type sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q6813106-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q6813106-convergence-start-p
      real-type type sequence limit epsilon))))

(defun-sk q6813106-cauchy-tail-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (m n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m) (natp n) (natp start)
      (<= start m) (<= start n))
     (q6813106-less
      real-type
      (q6813106-distance
       real-type type
       (q6813106-sequence-at sequence m)
       (q6813106-sequence-at sequence n))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q6813106-cauchy-start-p
    (real-type type sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q6813106-cauchy-tail-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q6813106-cauchy-p (real-type type sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p real-type epsilon)
      (q6813106-positive-p real-type epsilon))
     (q6813106-cauchy-start-p
      real-type type sequence epsilon))))

(defun-sk q6813106-sequence-in-type-p (type sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q6813106-member-p
      type
      (q6813106-sequence-at sequence n)))))

(defun-sk q6813106-limit-exists-p
    (real-type type sequence)
  (exists (limit)
    (and
     (q6813106-member-p type limit)
     (q6813106-converges-p
      real-type type sequence limit))))

(defun-sk q6813106-complete-p (real-type type)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-sequence-in-type-p type sequence)
      (q6813106-cauchy-p real-type type sequence))
     (q6813106-limit-exists-p
      real-type type sequence))))

(defun-sk q6813106-archimedean-witness-p (real-type x)
  (exists (n)
    (and
     (natp n)
     (q6813106-less
      real-type x
      (q6813106-natural-cast real-type n)))))

(defun-sk q6813106-archimedean-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q6813106-member-p real-type x)
     (q6813106-archimedean-witness-p real-type x))))

(defun-sk q6813106-real-norm-laws-p (real-type)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q6813106-member-p real-type x)
     (and
      (equal
       (q6813106-norm real-type x)
       (q6813106-abs real-type x))
      (equal (q6813106-star real-type x) x)
      (equal
       (q6813106-real-part real-type real-type x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q6813106-imag-part real-type real-type x)
       (q6813106-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q6813106-of-real real-type real-type x)
       x)))))

(defun q6813106-real-field-p (real-type)
  (and
   (q6813106-member-p real-type (q6813106-zero real-type))
   (q6813106-member-p real-type (q6813106-one real-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q6813106-zero real-type)
     (q6813106-one real-type)))
   (q6813106-field-laws-p real-type)
   (q6813106-order-laws-p real-type)
   (q6813106-positive-p real-type (q6813106-one real-type))
   (q6813106-real-norm-laws-p real-type)
   (q6813106-complete-p real-type real-type)
   (q6813106-archimedean-p real-type)))

(defun-sk q6813106-complex-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (z)
    (implies
     (q6813106-member-p complex-type z)
     (let* ((re (q6813106-real-part real-type complex-type z))
            (im (q6813106-imag-part real-type complex-type z))
            (re-z (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type re))
            (im-z
             (q6813106-multiply
              complex-type
              (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type im)
              (q6813106-imaginary-unit complex-type))))
       (and
        (q6813106-member-p real-type re)
        (q6813106-member-p real-type im)
        (equal z (q6813106-add complex-type re-z im-z))
        (equal
         (q6813106-star complex-type z)
         (q6813106-add
          complex-type re-z
          (q6813106-negate complex-type im-z)))
        (equal
         (q6813106-multiply
          real-type
          (q6813106-norm complex-type z)
          (q6813106-norm complex-type z))
         (q6813106-add
          real-type
          (q6813106-multiply real-type re re)
          (q6813106-multiply real-type im im))))))))

(defun-sk q6813106-of-real-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p real-type x)
      (q6813106-member-p real-type y))
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p
       complex-type
       (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type x))
      (equal
       (q6813106-real-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       x)
      (equal
       (q6813106-imag-part
        real-type complex-type
        (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type x))
       (q6813106-zero real-type))
      (equal
       (q6813106-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q6813106-add real-type x y))
       (q6813106-add
        complex-type
        (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type y)))
      (equal
       (q6813106-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q6813106-multiply real-type x y))
       (q6813106-multiply
        complex-type
        (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type x)
        (q6813106-of-real real-type complex-type y)))))))

(defun q6813106-complex-field-p
    (real-type complex-type)
  (and
   (q6813106-real-field-p real-type)
   (q6813106-member-p complex-type (q6813106-zero complex-type))
   (q6813106-member-p complex-type (q6813106-one complex-type))
   (not
    (equal
     (q6813106-zero complex-type)
     (q6813106-one complex-type)))
   (q6813106-field-laws-p complex-type)
   (q6813106-of-real-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (equal
    (q6813106-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q6813106-zero real-type))
    (q6813106-zero complex-type))
   (equal
    (q6813106-of-real
     real-type complex-type (q6813106-one real-type))
    (q6813106-one complex-type))
   (equal
    (q6813106-multiply
     complex-type
     (q6813106-imaginary-unit complex-type)
     (q6813106-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q6813106-negate complex-type (q6813106-one complex-type)))
   (equal
    (q6813106-real-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q6813106-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q6813106-zero real-type))
   (equal
    (q6813106-imag-part
     real-type complex-type
     (q6813106-imaginary-unit complex-type))
    (q6813106-one real-type))
   (q6813106-complex-coordinate-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q6813106-norm-laws-p real-type complex-type)
   (q6813106-complete-p real-type complex-type)))

;; Real inner-product domains and complex Banach codomains.

(defun-sk q6813106-vector-space-laws-p
    (scalar-type space)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q6813106-member-p scalar-type b)
      (q6813106-member-p space x)
      (q6813106-member-p space y)
      (q6813106-member-p space z))
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p space (q6813106-add space x y))
      (q6813106-member-p space (q6813106-negate space x))
      (q6813106-member-p
       space (q6813106-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (equal
       (q6813106-add space (q6813106-add space x y) z)
       (q6813106-add space x (q6813106-add space y z)))
      (equal (q6813106-add space x y) (q6813106-add space y x))
      (equal (q6813106-add space x (q6813106-zero space)) x)
      (equal
       (q6813106-add space x (q6813106-negate space x))
       (q6813106-zero space))
      (equal
       (q6813106-smul
        scalar-type space (q6813106-one scalar-type) x)
       x)
      (equal
       (q6813106-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q6813106-multiply scalar-type a b) x)
       (q6813106-smul
        scalar-type space a
        (q6813106-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q6813106-smul
        scalar-type space
        (q6813106-add scalar-type a b) x)
       (q6813106-add
        space
        (q6813106-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q6813106-smul scalar-type space b x)))
      (equal
       (q6813106-smul
        scalar-type space a (q6813106-add space x y))
       (q6813106-add
        space
        (q6813106-smul scalar-type space a x)
        (q6813106-smul scalar-type space a y)))))))

(defun-sk q6813106-normed-space-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q6813106-member-p space x))
     (equal
      (q6813106-norm
       space
       (q6813106-smul scalar-type space a x))
      (q6813106-multiply
       real-type
       (q6813106-norm scalar-type a)
       (q6813106-norm space x))))))

(defun-sk q6813106-inner-product-laws-p
    (real-type scalar-type space)
  (forall (a x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p scalar-type a)
      (q6813106-member-p space x)
      (q6813106-member-p space y)
      (q6813106-member-p space z))
     (let ((xy (q6813106-inner scalar-type space x y))
           (xx (q6813106-inner scalar-type space x x)))
       (and
        (q6813106-member-p scalar-type xy)
        (equal
         (q6813106-inner
          scalar-type space x (q6813106-add space y z))
         (q6813106-add
          scalar-type xy
          (q6813106-inner scalar-type space x z)))
        (equal
         (q6813106-inner
          scalar-type space x
          (q6813106-smul scalar-type space a y))
         (q6813106-multiply scalar-type a xy))
        (equal
         (q6813106-inner scalar-type space y x)
         (q6813106-star scalar-type xy))
        (equal
         (q6813106-multiply
          real-type
          (q6813106-norm space x)
          (q6813106-norm space x))
         (q6813106-real-part real-type scalar-type xx))
        (iff
         (equal xx (q6813106-zero scalar-type))
         (equal x (q6813106-zero space))))))))

(defun-sk q6813106-real-smul-compatibility-p

(defun-sk q6813106-orthonormal-basis-laws-p

      (q6813106-member-p space (q6813106-basis-at basis i)))

      (and
       (natp i) (natp j)
       (< i dimension) (< j dimension))
      (equal
       (q6813106-inner
        real-type space
        (q6813106-basis-at basis i)
        (q6813106-basis-at basis j))
       (if (equal i j)
           (q6813106-one real-type)
         (q6813106-zero real-type))))
     (implies
      (q6813106-member-p space x)
      (and
       (implies
        (and (natp i) (< i dimension))
        (q6813106-member-p
         real-type
         (q6813106-coordinate coordinates x i)))
       (equal
        x
        (q6813106-vector-sum
         real-type space basis coordinates x dimension)))))))

(defun q6813106-finite-real-inner-product-space-p

(defun q6813106-complex-banach-space-p

(defun-sk q6813106-full-set-law-p (space)

(defun-sk q6813106-countable-union-set-law-p (space)

(defun-sk q6813106-open-ball-set-law-p (real-type space)

      (q6813106-translate-set space set shift) x)

      (q6813106-member-p space x)
      (q6813106-set-member-p

(defun q6813106-set-constructor-laws-p
    (real-type space)
  (and
   (q6813106-full-set-law-p space)

(defun q6813106-ennreal-p (real-type x)
  (or
   (equal x :q6813106-top)
   (and
    (consp x)
    (equal (car x) :q6813106-finite)
    (q6813106-member-p real-type (cdr x))
    (q6813106-leq
     real-type (q6813106-zero real-type) (cdr x)))))

       (equal y :q6813106-top))

     real-type
     (q6813106-ennreal-partial-sum

       (q6813106-nonnegative-measurable-p
        real-type domain measurable f)

        real-type domain measurable g)
       (q6813106-pointwise-leq-p real-type domain f g))
      (q6813106-ennreal-leq-p
       real-type
       (q6813106-lintegral-value lintegral f)
       (q6813106-lintegral-value lintegral g)))
     (implies
      (q6813106-family-member-p measurable set)

       (q6813106-lintegral-value

     (implies

        real-type
        (q6813106-lintegral-value lintegral f)

;; Under t = exp(-u), Mellin convergence on Re(s) = sigma is exactly
;; integrability of g(u) = exp(-sigma*u) * f(exp(-u)).  On that same line,
;; the Mellin transform is the Fourier transform of g after the nonzero
;; 2*pi reparameterization used by the source theorem.

(defun-sk q6813106-mellin-coordinate-laws-p
    (real-type complex-type space)
  (forall (sigma function u)
    (implies
     (and
      (q6813106-member-p real-type sigma)
      (q6813106-member-p real-type u))
     (equal
      (q6813106-function-at
       (q6813106-mellin-coordinate-function
        real-type complex-type space sigma function)
       u)
      (q6813106-smul
       complex-type space
       (q6813106-of-real
        real-type complex-type
        (q6813106-real-exponential
         real-type
         (q6813106-negate
          real-type
          (q6813106-multiply real-type sigma u))))
       (q6813106-function-at
        function
        (q6813106-real-exponential
         real-type
         (q6813106-negate real-type u))))))))
