title: Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q6813106,
-- "Mellin inversion theorem": for a function into a complete complex normed
-- space, Mellin convergence at a real parameter, vertical integrability of
-- its Mellin transform along that line, positivity of the input, and
-- continuity there imply that inverse Mellin transformation recovers the
-- function value. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem where

open import Support.Bochner
open import Support.Mellin
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)

open CompleteOrderedField
open ComplexNormedSpace
open MellinContext

mellin-inversion : Set2
mellin-inversion =
  (R M E : Set) ->
  (context : MellinContext R M E) ->
  (sigma : R) ->
  (f : R -> E) ->
  (x : R) ->
  Positive (reals context) x ->
  MellinConvergent context f
    (fromReal (reals context) sigma) ->
  VerticalIntegrable context (mellin context f) sigma ->
  ContinuousAt context f x ->
  mellinInv context sigma (mellin context f) x == f x

title: Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q6813106 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q6813106), "Mellin inversion theorem":
  for a function into a complete complex normed space, Mellin convergence,
  vertical integrability of its transform, and continuity at a positive point
  imply inversion at that point. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory transcTheory complexTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory extrealTheory sigma_algebraTheory;
open measureTheory borelTheory lebesgueTheory lebesgue_measureTheory;

val q6813106_complex_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_complex_normed_space_def",
  ``q6813106_complex_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!a. smul a zero = zero) /\
      (!x. neg x = smul (-1) x) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. (norm x = 0) <=> (x = zero)) /\
      (!x. norm (neg x) = norm x) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = modu a * norm x)``);

val q6813106_tendsto_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_tendsto_def",
  ``q6813106_tendsto
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) (ell : 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !n : num.
            N <= n ==> norm (add (u n) (neg ell)) < epsilon``);

val q6813106_cauchy_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_cauchy_def",
  ``q6813106_cauchy
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (u : num -> 'e) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?N : num.
          !p q : num.
            N <= p /\ N <= q ==>
            norm (add (u p) (neg (u q))) < epsilon``);

val q6813106_complete_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_complete_def",
  ``q6813106_complete
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      !u : num -> 'e.
        q6813106_cauchy add neg norm u ==>
        ?ell : 'e. q6813106_tendsto add neg norm u ell``);

val q6813106_measurable_simple_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_measurable_simple_def",
  ``q6813106_measurable_simple
      (m : 'a m_space) (s : 'a -> 'e) <=>
      FINITE (IMAGE s UNIV) /\
      !y : 'e. {x | s x = y} IN measurable_sets m``);

val q6813106_strongly_measurable_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_strongly_measurable_def",
  ``q6813106_strongly_measurable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'a -> 'e) <=>
      ?s : num -> 'a -> 'e.
        (!n. q6813106_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        !x. q6813106_tendsto add neg norm (\n. s n x) (f x)``);

val q6813106_bochner_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_bochner_integrable_def",
  ``q6813106_bochner_integrable
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'a -> 'e) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'e.
        q6813106_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x)``);

val q6813106_simple_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_simple_integral_def",
  ``q6813106_simple_integral
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (s : 'a -> 'e) =
      ITSET
        (\y acc.
          add
            (smul
              (complex_of_real (real (measure m {x | s x = y}))) y)
            acc)
        (IMAGE s UNIV DELETE zero) zero``);

val q6813106_bochner_approximates_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_bochner_approximates_def",
  ``q6813106_bochner_approximates
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'e) (s : num -> 'a -> 'e) (ell : 'e) <=>
      ?g : 'a -> 'e.
        q6813106_strongly_measurable m add neg norm g /\
        integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (g x))) /\
        (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        (!n. q6813106_measurable_simple m (s n)) /\
        (!n. integrable m (Normal o (\x. norm (s n x)))) /\
        (!n.
          integrable m
            (Normal o (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x)))))) /\
        (((\n.
            real
              (integral m
                (Normal o
                  (\x. norm (add (s n x) (neg (g x))))))) -->
          0) sequentially) /\
        q6813106_tendsto add neg norm
          (\n. q6813106_simple_integral m zero add smul (s n))
          ell``);

val q6813106_bochner_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_bochner_integral_def",
  ``q6813106_bochner_integral
      (m : 'a m_space)
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'a -> 'e) =
      if q6813106_complete add neg norm /\
         q6813106_bochner_integrable m add neg norm f
      then
        @ell : 'e.
          ?s : num -> 'a -> 'e.
            q6813106_bochner_approximates
              m zero add neg smul norm f s ell
      else
        zero``);

val q6813106_principal_arg_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_principal_arg_def",
  ``q6813106_principal_arg (z : complex) =
      if z = 0 then 0
      else if arg z <= pi then arg z else arg z - 2 * pi``);

val q6813106_complex_log_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_complex_log_def",
  ``q6813106_complex_log (z : complex) =
      (ln (modu z),q6813106_principal_arg z)``);

val q6813106_complex_cpow_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_complex_cpow_def",
  ``q6813106_complex_cpow (z : complex) (w : complex) =
      if z = 0 then
        if w = 0 then 1 else 0
      else
        complex_exp (q6813106_complex_log z * w)``);

val q6813106_continuous_at_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_continuous_at_def",
  ``q6813106_continuous_at
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : real -> 'e) (x : real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !y : real.
            abs (y - x) < delta ==>
            norm (add (f y) (neg (f x))) < epsilon``);

val q6813106_mellin_convergent_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_mellin_convergent_def",
  ``q6813106_mellin_convergent
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : real -> 'e) (s : complex) <=>
      q6813106_bochner_integrable lborel add neg norm
        (\t.
          if 0 < t then
            smul
              (q6813106_complex_cpow
                (complex_of_real t) (s - 1))
              (f t)
          else
            zero)``);

val q6813106_mellin_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_mellin_def",
  ``q6813106_mellin
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : real -> 'e) (s : complex) =
      q6813106_bochner_integral
        lborel zero add neg smul norm
        (\t.
          if 0 < t then
            smul
              (q6813106_complex_cpow
                (complex_of_real t) (s - 1))
              (f t)
          else
            zero)``);

val q6813106_vertical_integrable_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_vertical_integrable_def",
  ``q6813106_vertical_integrable
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (transform : complex -> 'e) (sigma0 : real) <=>
      q6813106_bochner_integrable lborel add neg norm
        (\y.
          transform
            (complex_of_real sigma0 +
             complex_of_real y * i))``);

val q6813106_mellin_inv_def = new_definition (
  "q6813106_mellin_inv_def",
  ``q6813106_mellin_inv
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (sigma0 : real) (transform : complex -> 'e) (x : real) =
      smul
        (complex_of_real (1 / (2 * pi)))
        (q6813106_bochner_integral
          lborel zero add neg smul norm
          (\y.
            let z =
              complex_of_real sigma0 +
              complex_of_real y * i
            in
              smul
                (q6813106_complex_cpow
                  (complex_of_real x) (-z))
                (transform z)))``);

val mellin_inversion =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : complex -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (sigma0 : real) (f : real -> 'e) (x : real).
      q6813106_complex_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q6813106_complete add neg norm /\
      0 < x /\
      q6813106_mellin_convergent
        zero add neg smul norm f (complex_of_real sigma0) /\
      q6813106_vertical_integrable add neg norm
        (q6813106_mellin zero add neg smul norm f) sigma0 /\
      q6813106_continuous_at add neg norm f x
      ==>
      q6813106_mellin_inv
        zero add neg smul norm sigma0
        (q6813106_mellin zero add neg smul norm f) x =
      f x``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q6813106), "Mellin inversion theorem": for a
  function from the reals to an arbitrary complex Banach space, the inverse
  Mellin transform recovers its value at a positive continuity point under
  Mellin convergence and vertical integrability assumptions. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

  Q6813106Restrict is zero extension from a subset of the real line, and
  Q6813106FunctionIntegrable encodes almost-everywhere strong measurability
  and finite L1 norm. Q6813106HasIntegral defines the Banach-valued Bochner
  integral by L1-approximation with measurable finite-range functions, and
  Q6813106TotalIntegral totalizes its unique value by zero.

  Q6813106MellinIntegrand W F S is t |-> t ^ (S - 1) . F(t), using SetMM's
  principal complex power and the scalar action of the complex normed space
  W. Mellin convergence is Bochner integrability of its restriction to the
  positive real axis. Q6813106Mellin is the corresponding totalized integral.

  Q6813106VerticalIntegrable W G R is integrability of
  y |-> G(R + i y). Q6813106MellinInv is (2 pi)^-1 times the Bochner integral

content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q6813106,
:: "Mellin inversion theorem": a complex Banach-valued function continuous
:: at a positive real point is recovered there from its Mellin transform when
:: the transform converges and is integrable on the relevant vertical line.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
      PARTFUN1, TARSKI, ZFMISC_1, ORDINAL1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, CARD_1,
      ARYTM_1, ARYTM_3, XXREAL_0, XCMPLX_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, VALUED_0,
      VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1,
      NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, CLVECT_1, CLOPBAN1, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MESFUNC1,
      MEASURE3, MESFUNC5, INTEGRA5, SUPINF_2, SIN_COS, FINSET_1, FUNCOP_1,
      PBOOLE, MEMBERED, SETFAM_1, TAYLOR_1, RCOMP_1, PREPOWER, POWER,
      FDIFF_1, ABIAN;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, ORDINAL1, SETFAM_1,
      RELAT_1, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, NUMBERS,
      XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, REAL_1, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1,
      FINSEQ_2, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SIN_COS, ABIAN, TAYLOR_1,
      STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, VECTSP_1, CLVECT_1,
      CLOPBAN1, PROB_1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, EXTREAL1, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5,
      MESFUNC6, SUPINF_2;
 constructors REAL_1, COMPLEX1, SIN_COS, ABIAN, TAYLOR_1, SEQ_2, FINSEQ_2,
      CLVECT_1, CLOPBAN1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, MESFUNC1, MESFUNC2,
      MESFUNC5, MESFUNC6, EXTREAL1, SUPINF_1, RELSET_1, FUNCOP_1;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0,
      MEMBERED, NAT_1, FINSEQ_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2, PARTFUN1, VALUED_0,
      VALUED_1, XCMPLX_0, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, CLVECT_1,
      CLOPBAN1, MEASURE1, MEASURE3, SIN_COS, ABIAN;
 requirements NUMERALS, BOOLE, SUBSET, REAL, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1, NORMSP_0,
      MESFUNC1, MESFUNC5;
 equalities XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, NORMSP_0,
      FINSEQ_1;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, FUNCT_2, RLVECT_1, CLVECT_1, NORMSP_0,
      MESFUNC1, FINSEQ_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for S being SigmaField of REAL,
      M being sigma_Measure of S,
      X being ComplexBanachSpace,
      J being Relation of Funcs(REAL,the carrier of X),the carrier of X,
      f being Function of REAL,the carrier of X,
      F being Function of COMPLEX,the carrier of X,
      CE being Function of COMPLEX,COMPLEX,
      s0,x being Element of REAL
  st
    (ex B being Subset-Family of REAL,
        C being Subset of REAL st
      (for A being Subset of REAL holds
        A in B iff
          ex c,r being Real st
            0 < r &
            A = {t where t is Real: |.t-c.| < r}) &
      S = sigma(B) &
      C in S &
      C = {t where t is Real: 0 <= t & t < 1} &
      M.C = 1 &
      (for A being Element of S, a being Real holds
        ex T being Element of S st
          T = {y where y is Real:
            ex t being Real st t in A & y = t+a} &
          M.T = M.A)) &
    (for g being Function of REAL,the carrier of X,
         y being Point of X holds
      [g,y] in J iff
        ex Q being sequence of Funcs(REAL,the carrier of X),
           I being sequence of X,
           E being Real_Sequence st
          (for k being Nat holds
            ex q being Function of REAL,the carrier of X,
               A being FinSequence of COM(S,M),
               z being sequence of X,
               r being Real_Sequence,
               p being sequence of X,
               e being Function of REAL,REAL st
              Q.k = q &
              p.0 = 0.X &
              (for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                p.(i+1) = p.i + ((r.i) qua Complex)*z.i) &
              I.k = p.(len A) &
              (for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                0 <= r.i & (COM(M)).(A.(i+1)) = r.i) &
              (for i,j being Nat st
                  i < len A & j < len A & i <> j
                holds A.(i+1) misses A.(j+1)) &
              (for t being Element of REAL holds
                (ex i being Nat st
                  i < len A & t in A.(i+1) & q.t = z.i) or
                ((for i being Nat st i < len A holds
                    not t in A.(i+1)) &
                  q.t = 0.X)) &
              (for t being Element of REAL holds e.t = ||.g.t-q.t.||) &
              e is_integrable_on COM(M) &
              E.k = Integral(COM(M),e)) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds |.E.k.| < e) &
          (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
            ex k0 being Nat st
              for k being Nat st k0 <= k holds ||.I.k-y.|| < e)) &
    (for u being Complex holds
      CE.u =
        exp_R.(Re u)*cos.(Im u) +
        exp_R.(Re u)*sin.(Im u)*<i>) &
    (for s being Complex holds
      ex h being Function of REAL,the carrier of X st
        (for t being Element of REAL holds
          (0 < t implies
            h.t = CE.((s-1)*ln.t)*f.t) &
          (t <= 0 implies h.t = 0.X)) &
        ((ex z being Point of X st [h,z] in J & F.s = z) or
          ((for z being Point of X holds not [h,z] in J) &
            F.s = 0.X))) &
    0 < x &
    (ex h being Function of REAL,the carrier of X,
        z being Point of X st
      (for t being Element of REAL holds
        (0 < t implies
          h.t = CE.(((s0 qua Complex)-1)*ln.t)*f.t) &
        (t <= 0 implies h.t = 0.X)) &
      [h,z] in J) &
    (ex h being Function of REAL,the carrier of X,
        z being Point of X st
      (for y being Element of REAL holds
        h.y = F.((s0 qua Complex)+(y qua Complex)*<i>)) &
      [h,z] in J) &
    (for e being Real st 0 < e holds
      ex d being Real st 0 < d &
        for t being Element of REAL st
          |.t-x.| < d holds ||.f.t-f.x.|| < e)
  holds
    ex h being Function of REAL,the carrier of X st
      (for y being Element of REAL holds
        ex u being Element of COMPLEX st
          u = (s0 qua Complex)+(y qua Complex)*<i> &
          h.y = CE.((-u)*ln.x)*F.u) &
      ((ex z being Point of X st
          [h,z] in J &
          ((1/(2*PI)) qua Complex)*z = f.x) or
        ((for z being Point of X holds not [h,z] in J) &
          ((1/(2*PI)) qua Complex)*0.X = f.x))
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q6813106,
% "Mellin inversion theorem": the inverse Mellin transform of the Mellin transform
% recovers a complex Banach-space-valued function at a positive point under the
% source convergence, vertical integrability, and continuity hypotheses.
% This file contains no proof.

Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  csmulE: [real, real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  complex: TYPE = [# real_part: real, imag_part: real #]
  complex_function: TYPE = [complex -> E]

  event: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  event_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> event]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [event -> bool]

  measure_value: TYPE =
    [# infinite_flag: bool, finite_part: real #]
  measure_value_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_value]
  measure_map: TYPE = [event -> measure_value]

  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  e_function: TYPE = [real -> E]
  e_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> e_function]
  e_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E]
  nonnegative_function: TYPE = [real -> measure_value]

  subE(x, y: E): E = addE(x, negE(y))

  complex_zero: complex =
    (# real_part := 0, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_one: complex =
    (# real_part := 1, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_of_real(x: real): complex =
    (# real_part := x, imag_part := 0 #)

  complex_add(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := real_part(x) + real_part(y),
       imag_part := imag_part(x) + imag_part(y) #)

  complex_neg(x: complex): complex =
    (# real_part := -real_part(x),
       imag_part := -imag_part(x) #)

  complex_sub(x, y: complex): complex =
    complex_add(x, complex_neg(y))

  complex_mul(x, y: complex): complex =
    (# real_part :=
         real_part(x) * real_part(y)
           - imag_part(x) * imag_part(y),
       imag_part :=
         real_part(x) * imag_part(y)
           + imag_part(x) * real_part(y) #)

  complex_norm_squared(x: complex): real =
    real_part(x) ^ 2 + imag_part(x) ^ 2

  complex_smul(a: complex, x: E): E =
    csmulE(real_part(a), imag_part(a), x)

  real_smulE(a: real, x: E): E =
    csmulE(a, 0, x)

  normed_complex_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E): addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) = addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x, y: E):
        complex_smul(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(complex_smul(a, x), complex_smul(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        complex_smul(complex_add(a, b), x) =
          addE(complex_smul(a, x), complex_smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: complex), (x: E):
        complex_smul(complex_mul(a, b), x) =
          complex_smul(a, complex_smul(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        complex_smul(complex_one, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        complex_smul(complex_zero, x) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E): normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: complex), (x: E):
        normE(complex_smul(a, x)) ^ 2 =
          complex_norm_squared(a) * normE(x) ^ 2)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <= normE(x) + normE(y))

  converges_to_e(values: e_sequence, limit: E): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            normE(subE(values(index), limit)) < epsilon_value

  cauchy_e(values: e_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
          cutoff <= left_index AND cutoff <= right_index IMPLIES
            normE(
              subE(values(left_index), values(right_index)))
              < epsilon_value

  complete_space_e: bool =
    FORALL (values: e_sequence):
      cauchy_e(values) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (limit: E): converges_to_e(values, limit)

  converges_to_real(values: real_sequence, limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  zero_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := 0 #)

  infinite_measure_value: measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := TRUE, finite_part := 0 #)

  finite_measure_value(value: real): measure_value =
    (# infinite_flag := FALSE, finite_part := value #)

  canonical_measure_value(value: measure_value): bool =
    IF infinite_flag(value) THEN
      finite_part(value) = 0
    ELSE
      finite_part(value) >= 0
    ENDIF

  measure_value_is_zero(value: measure_value): bool =
    NOT infinite_flag(value)
      AND finite_part(value) = 0

  measure_value_le(left, right: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(left)
      AND canonical_measure_value(right)
      AND IF infinite_flag(right) THEN
        TRUE
      ELSIF infinite_flag(left) THEN
        FALSE
      ELSE
        finite_part(left) <= finite_part(right)
      ENDIF

  measure_value_add(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF infinite_flag(left) OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) + finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  measure_value_product(left, right: measure_value): measure_value =
    IF measure_value_is_zero(left)
        OR measure_value_is_zero(right) THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSIF infinite_flag(left)
        OR infinite_flag(right) THEN
      infinite_measure_value
    ELSE
      finite_measure_value(
        finite_part(left) * finite_part(right))
    ENDIF

  full_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): TRUE

  empty_event: event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): FALSE

  event_complement(A: event): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): NOT A(x)

  countable_union(sets: event_sequence): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat): sets(index)(x)

  pairwise_disjoint(sets: event_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x)
            AND sets(right_index)(x))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      sets: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES
        FORALL (x: real):
          NOT (sets(left_index)(x)
            AND sets(right_index)(x))

  finite_real_sum(values: real_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  unbounded_above(values: real_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (bound: real):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        bound < values(index)

  partial_measure_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        finite_part(values(index)),
      count)

  extended_nonnegative_sum(
      values: measure_value_sequence,
      total: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(total)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        canonical_measure_value(values(index)))
      AND IF infinite_flag(total) THEN
        (EXISTS (index: nat):
          infinite_flag(values(index)))
          OR ((FORALL (index: nat):
                NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
            AND unbounded_above(
              LAMBDA (count: nat):
                partial_measure_sum(values, count)))
      ELSE
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          NOT infinite_flag(values(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(values, count),
            finite_part(total))
      ENDIF

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_event)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(event_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: event_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(sets(index)))
          IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(sets)))

  is_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND measure_value_is_zero(M(empty_event))
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES canonical_measure_value(M(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: event_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat): Sigma(sets(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(sets))
        IMPLIES
          extended_nonnegative_sum(
            LAMBDA (index: nat): M(sets(index)),
            M(countable_union(sets))))

  open_real_set(A: event): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      A(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (y: real):
            abs(y - x) < radius IMPLIES A(y)

  generated_borel_sigma(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (A: event):
        open_real_set(A) IMPLIES Sigma(A))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (A: event):
            open_real_set(A) IMPLIES Other(A)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (A: event):
            Sigma(A) IMPLIES Other(A))

  open_closed_interval(a, b: real): event =
    LAMBDA (x: real): a < x AND x <= b

  real_volume_space(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    generated_borel_sigma(Sigma)
      AND is_measure(M, Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real):
        a <= b IMPLIES
          M(open_closed_interval(a, b)) =
            finite_measure_value(b - a))

  null_event(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: event): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_cover: event):
      Sigma(measurable_cover)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          A(x) IMPLIES measurable_cover(x))
        AND measure_value_is_zero(M(measurable_cover))

  almost_everywhere(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      property: [real -> bool]): bool =
    null_event(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (x: real): NOT property(x))

  finite_e_sum(values: e_sequence, count: nat):
      RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_e_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  finite_simple_e_value(
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): E =
    finite_e_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        IF index < count AND pieces(index)(x) THEN
          coefficients(index)
        ELSE
          zeroE
        ENDIF,
      count)

  measurable_simple_e_data(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_e(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: e_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_e_data(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          function_value(x) =
            finite_simple_e_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x))

  strongly_measurable_e(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (approximants: e_function_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        measurable_simple_e(
          Sigma, approximants(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          converges_to_e(
            LAMBDA (index: nat):
              approximants(index)(x),
            function_value(x)))

  ae_strongly_measurable_e(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (measurable_version: e_function):
      strongly_measurable_e(Sigma, measurable_version)
        AND almost_everywhere(
          M,
          Sigma,
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            function_value(x) = measurable_version(x))

  restrict_e_function(
      function_value: e_function,
      A: event): e_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      IF A(x) THEN function_value(x) ELSE zeroE ENDIF

  canonical_nonnegative_function(
      function_value: nonnegative_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: real):
      canonical_measure_value(function_value(x))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: real): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
          coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x),
        IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
          coefficients(count - 1)
        ELSE
          zero_measure_value
        ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_nonnegative(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          canonical_measure_value(coefficients(index))
            AND NOT infinite_flag(coefficients(index))
            AND Sigma(pieces(index)))

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND measurable_simple_nonnegative(
        Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (x: real):
        measure_value_le(
          finite_simple_nonnegative_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, x),
          function_value(x)))

  finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: measure_value_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE measure_value =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero_measure_value
    ELSE
      measure_value_add(
        finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        measure_value_product(
          coefficients(count - 1),
          M(pieces(count - 1))))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  lower_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      upper: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_measure_value(upper)
      AND FORALL
          (coefficients: measure_value_sequence),
          (pieces: event_sequence),
          (count: nat):
        measurable_simple_minorant(
          Sigma, function_value,
          coefficients, pieces, count)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(
            finite_simple_nonnegative_integral(
              M, coefficients, pieces, count),
            upper)

  has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: nonnegative_function,
      integral_value: measure_value): bool =
    canonical_nonnegative_function(function_value)
      AND canonical_measure_value(integral_value)
      AND lower_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: measure_value):
        lower_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES
          measure_value_le(integral_value, upper))

  enorm_e(function_value: e_function):
      nonnegative_function =
    LAMBDA (x: real):
      finite_measure_value(normE(function_value(x)))

  integrable_simple_e_data(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    measurable_simple_e_data(
      Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES
          coefficients(index) = zeroE
            OR NOT infinite_flag(M(pieces(index))))

  finite_simple_e_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: e_sequence,
      pieces: event_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE E =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zeroE
    ELSE
      addE(
        finite_simple_e_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count - 1),
        real_smulE(
          finite_part(M(pieces(count - 1))),
          coefficients(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  has_simple_e_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    EXISTS
        (coefficients: e_sequence),
        (pieces: event_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      integrable_simple_e_data(
        M, Sigma, coefficients, pieces, count)
        AND (FORALL (x: real):
          function_value(x) =
            finite_simple_e_value(
              coefficients, pieces, count, x))
        AND integral_value =
          finite_simple_e_integral(
            M, coefficients, pieces, count)

  l1_error(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value,
      approximant: e_function,
      error_value: real): bool =
    error_value >= 0
      AND has_lower_lebesgue_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        enorm_e(
          LAMBDA (x: real):
            subE(
              function_value(x),
              approximant(x))),
        finite_measure_value(error_value))

  approximates_in_l1(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      approximants: e_function_sequence): bool =
    (FORALL (index: nat):
      measurable_simple_e(Sigma, approximants(index)))
      AND EXISTS (errors: real_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          l1_error(
            M,
            Sigma,
            function_value,
            approximants(index),
            errors(index)))
          AND converges_to_real(errors, 0)

  bochner_integral_witness(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    EXISTS
        (approximants: e_function_sequence),
        (simple_integrals: e_sequence):
      approximates_in_l1(
        M, Sigma, function_value, approximants)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          has_simple_e_integral(
            M,
            Sigma,
            approximants(index),
            simple_integrals(index)))
        AND converges_to_e(
          simple_integrals, integral_value)

  has_bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      integral_value: E): bool =
    ae_strongly_measurable_e(
      M, Sigma, function_value)
      AND bochner_integral_witness(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)
      AND (FORALL (other_integral: E):
        bochner_integral_witness(
          M, Sigma, function_value, other_integral)
        IMPLIES
          other_integral = integral_value)

  bochner_integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): bool =
    EXISTS (integral_value: E):
      has_bochner_integral(
        M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value)

  bochner_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function): E =
    IF bochner_integrable(M, Sigma, function_value) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (integral_value: E):
          has_bochner_integral(
            M, Sigma, function_value, integral_value))
    ELSE
      zeroE
    ENDIF

  integrable_on(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: e_function,
      A: event): bool =
    bochner_integrable(
      M, Sigma, restrict_e_function(function_value, A))

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  nat_factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * nat_factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  alternating_sign(index: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      -alternating_sign(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              nat_factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  sine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        sine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index)
                * x ^ (2 * index + 1),
              nat_factorial(2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  cosine_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        cosine_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index)
                * x ^ (2 * index),
              nat_factorial(2 * index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  leibniz_partial_sum(count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        leibniz_partial_sum(count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              alternating_sign(index),
              (2 * index + 1) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  natural_log(x: real): real =
    IF x > 0 THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (value: real):
          real_exponential(value) = x)
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  sine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            sine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  cosine_of_real(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            cosine_partial(x, count),
          value))

  pi: real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to_real(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            4 * leibniz_partial_sum(count),
          value))

  positive_real_cpow(base: real, exponent: complex): complex =
    IF base > 0 THEN
      LET logarithm: real = natural_log(base),
          magnitude: real =
            real_exponential(real_part(exponent) * logarithm),
          angle: real = imag_part(exponent) * logarithm
      IN
        (# real_part :=
             magnitude * cosine_of_real(angle),
           imag_part :=
             magnitude * sine_of_real(angle) #)
    ELSE
      complex_zero
    ENDIF

  positive_event: event =
    LAMBDA (t: real): 0 < t

  vertical_line(sigma, y: real): complex =
    (# real_part := sigma, imag_part := y #)

  mellin_integrand(
      f: e_function,
      s: complex): e_function =
    LAMBDA (t: real):
      complex_smul(
        positive_real_cpow(
          t,
          complex_sub(s, complex_one)),
        f(t))

  mellin_convergent(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: e_function,
      s: complex): bool =
    integrable_on(
      M,
      Sigma,
      mellin_integrand(f, s),
      positive_event)

  mellin(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: e_function,
      s: complex): E =
    bochner_integral(
      M,
      Sigma,
      restrict_e_function(
        mellin_integrand(f, s),
        positive_event))

  mellin_transform(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: e_function): complex_function =
    LAMBDA (s: complex):
      mellin(M, Sigma, f, s)

  vertical_integrable(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      F: complex_function,
      sigma: real): bool =
    bochner_integrable(
      M,
      Sigma,
      LAMBDA (y: real):
        F(vertical_line(sigma, y)))

  mellin_inverse_integrand(
      F: complex_function,
      sigma, x: real): e_function =
    LAMBDA (y: real):
      complex_smul(
        positive_real_cpow(
          x,
          complex_neg(vertical_line(sigma, y))),
        F(vertical_line(sigma, y)))

  mellin_inverse(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      sigma: real,
      F: complex_function,
      x: real): E =
    real_smulE(
      safe_div(1, 2 * pi),
      bochner_integral(
        M,
        Sigma,
        mellin_inverse_integrand(F, sigma, x)))

  continuous_at_e(
      f: e_function,
      x: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (y: real):
          abs(y - x) < radius
            IMPLIES
              normE(subE(f(y), f(x))) < epsilon_value

  mellin_inversion: bool =
    (normed_complex_vector_space AND complete_space_e)
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
            (M: measure_map),
            (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
            (sigma: real),
            (f: e_function),
            (x: real):
          (real_volume_space(M, Sigma)
            AND 0 < x
            AND mellin_convergent(
              M, Sigma, f, complex_of_real(sigma))
            AND vertical_integrable(
              M,
              Sigma,
              mellin_transform(M, Sigma, f),
              sigma)
            AND continuous_at_e(f, x))
          IMPLIES
            mellin_inverse(
              M,
              Sigma,
              sigma,
              mellin_transform(M, Sigma, f),
              x)
              = f(x)
END Q6813106_mellin_inversion_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q716171
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q716171), "Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv theorem": among at
  least 2n - 1 indexed residues modulo n, there is an n-element subcollection
  whose sum is zero modulo n. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List ZArith.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q716171_finset (X : Type) : Type := {
  q716171_elements : list X;
  q716171_elements_nodup : NoDup q716171_elements
}.

Arguments q716171_elements {X} _.

Definition q716171_subset
    {X : Type} (t s : q716171_finset X) : Prop :=
  forall x : X, In x (q716171_elements t) -> In x (q716171_elements s).

Record q716171_zmod (n : nat) : Type := {
  q716171_zmod_rep : Z
}.

Arguments q716171_zmod_rep {n} _.

Definition q716171_zmod_zero (n : nat) : q716171_zmod n :=
  {| q716171_zmod_rep := 0%Z |}.

Definition q716171_zmod_add
    {n : nat} (x y : q716171_zmod n) : q716171_zmod n :=
  {| q716171_zmod_rep :=
       Z.add (q716171_zmod_rep x) (q716171_zmod_rep y) |}.

Definition q716171_zmod_eq
    {n : nat} (x y : q716171_zmod n) : Prop :=
  Z.divide
    (Z.of_nat n)
    (Z.sub (q716171_zmod_rep x) (q716171_zmod_rep y)).

Fixpoint q716171_zmod_sum
    {X : Type} {n : nat}
    (a : X -> q716171_zmod n) (xs : list X) : q716171_zmod n :=
  match xs with
  | nil => q716171_zmod_zero n
  | cons x tail =>
      q716171_zmod_add (a x) (q716171_zmod_sum a tail)
  end.

Module ZMod.

Theorem erdos_ginzburg_ziv :
  forall (I : Type) (n : nat)
         (a : I -> q716171_zmod n) (s : q716171_finset I),
    (2 * n - 1 <= length (q716171_elements s))%nat ->
    exists t : q716171_finset I,
      q716171_subset t s /\
      length (q716171_elements t) = n /\
      q716171_zmod_eq
        (q716171_zmod_sum a (q716171_elements t))
        (q716171_zmod_zero n).
Admitted.

End ZMod.

;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q716171, "Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv theorem": a finite
;; set of at least 2*n-1 indices carrying not-necessarily-distinct labels in
;; ZMod n has an n-element subset whose labels sum to zero. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A duplicate-free true list represents the source Finset of indices. Only
;; label values on that finite set occur in the proposition, and every finite
;; labeling is represented by a tame unary lookup function; conversely, each
;; such ACL2 labeling gives a source function after transporting the finite
;; indices. Thus APPLY$ does not restrict the source function quantifier.
;; For positive n, ZMod n is represented by its unique natural representative
;; below n; ZMod 0 is the integers. The include/exclude recursion is an exact
;; internal existential search through all subsets of the finite index set.

(defun q716171-index-set-p (indices)
  (and (true-listp indices)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal indices)))

(defun q716171-zmod-element-p (value n)
  (if (zp n)
      (integerp value)
    (and (natp value)
         (< value n))))

(defun q716171-labels-valid-p (indices labels n)
  (if (consp indices)
      (and
       (q716171-zmod-element-p
        (apply$ labels (list (car indices)))
        n)
       (q716171-labels-valid-p (cdr indices) labels n))
    (equal indices nil)))

(defun q716171-zero-in-zmod-p (integer-sum n)
  (if (zp n)
      (equal integer-sum 0)
    (equal (mod integer-sum n) 0)))

(defun q716171-subset-witness-exists-p
    (remaining labels n needed integer-sum)
  (declare (xargs :measure (len remaining)))
  (if (zp needed)
      (q716171-zero-in-zmod-p integer-sum n)
    (if (consp remaining)
        (or
         (q716171-subset-witness-exists-p
          (cdr remaining) labels n needed integer-sum)
         (q716171-subset-witness-exists-p
          (cdr remaining)
          labels
          n
          (- needed 1)
          (+ integer-sum
             (apply$ labels (list (car remaining))))))
      nil)))

(defun q716171-twice-minus-one (n)
  (if (zp n)
      0
    (- (* 2 n) 1)))

(defun thousand-theorems-q716171-erdos-ginzburg-ziv-statement
    (n indices labels)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (q716171-index-set-p indices)
    (tamep-functionp labels)
    (q716171-labels-valid-p indices labels n)
    (<= (q716171-twice-minus-one n)
        (len indices)))
   (q716171-subset-witness-exists-p
    indices labels n n 0)))

:q

-- thousand-theorems__agda__Q716171, "Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv theorem": any finite
-- set of at least 2 * n - 1 indices labeled in Z/nZ contains an n-element

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q716171_erd_s_ginzburg_ziv_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Int using (Int; pos; negsuc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _<=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixl 6 _+z_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<= : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data LastView (n : Nat) : Set where
  before-last : Fin n -> LastView n
  at-last     : LastView n

viewLast :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  LastView n
viewLast {zero} fzero =
  at-last
viewLast {suc n} fzero =
  before-last fzero
viewLast {suc n} (fsuc i) with viewLast i
... | before-last j =
  before-last (fsuc j)
... | at-last =
  at-last

successorMod :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n)
successorMod x with viewLast x
... | before-last j =
  fsuc j
... | at-last =
  fzero

finToNat :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Nat
finToNat fzero =
  zero
finToNat (fsuc i) =
  suc (finToNat i)

iterateSuccessor :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Nat ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n)
iterateSuccessor zero x =
  x
iterateSuccessor (suc count) x =
  iterateSuccessor count (successorMod x)

addFin :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin (suc n)
addFin x y =
  iterateSuccessor (finToNat y) x

difference : Nat -> Nat -> Int
difference zero zero =
  pos zero
difference (suc m) zero =
  pos (suc m)
difference zero (suc n) =
  negsuc n
difference (suc m) (suc n) =
  difference m n

_+z_ : Int -> Int -> Int
pos m +z pos n =
  pos (m + n)
pos m +z negsuc n =
  difference m (suc n)
negsuc m +z pos n =
  difference n (suc m)
negsuc m +z negsuc n =
  negsuc (suc (m + n))

data ZMod : Nat -> Set where
  integer-residue :
    Int ->
    ZMod zero
  finite-residue :
    {n : Nat} ->
    Fin (suc n) ->
    ZMod (suc n)

zeroZMod :
  (n : Nat) ->
  ZMod n
zeroZMod zero =
  integer-residue (pos zero)
zeroZMod (suc n) =
  finite-residue fzero

addZMod :
  {n : Nat} ->
  ZMod n ->
  ZMod n ->
  ZMod n
addZMod {zero} (integer-residue x) (integer-residue y) =
  integer-residue (x +z y)
addZMod {suc n} (finite-residue x) (finite-residue y) =
  finite-residue (addFin x y)

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    distinct  :
      (i j : Fin size) ->
      enumerate i == enumerate j ->
      i == j

open FiniteSubset

Member :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Member subset item =
  Exists (Fin (size subset))
    (\ index -> item == enumerate subset index)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  Set a
SubsetOf child parent =
  (index : Fin (size child)) ->
  Member parent (enumerate child index)

sumFin :
  {n count : Nat} ->
  (Fin count -> ZMod n) ->
  ZMod n
sumFin {n} {zero} values =
  zeroZMod n
sumFin {n} {suc count} values =
  addZMod
    (values fzero)
    (sumFin (\ index -> values (fsuc index)))

sumFiniteSubset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (A -> ZMod n) ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  ZMod n
sumFiniteSubset values subset =
  sumFin (\ index -> values (enumerate subset index))

-- Lean: ZMod.erdos_ginzburg_ziv
erdos-ginzburg-ziv-theorem : Setω
erdos-ginzburg-ziv-theorem =
  {a : Level} ->
  (I : Set a) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (s : FiniteSubset I) ->
  (values : I -> ZMod n) ->
  2 * n - 1 <= size s ->
  Exists (FiniteSubset I)
    (\ t ->
      SubsetOf t s
      and
      ((size t == n)
       and
       (sumFiniteSubset values t == zeroZMod n)))

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  An arbitrary Lean index type is represented by the set I, its Finset s by
  a finite subset S of I, and a : I -> ZMod n by a function into the base of
  SetMM's commutative ring Z/nZ. This ring also has the correct n = 0 case.

  The conditional expression is exactly natural-number truncated subtraction:
  it is 0 when n = 0 and otherwise is the integer 2 * n - 1. The internally
  quantified finite subset T preserves the source witness, and Z/nZ gsum is
  the finite additive sum in the same residue-class ring.

  The following declaration is the single unproved $a corpus statement; this
  root statement file contains no $p proof statement.

${
  $d I S T a i n $.

  thousand-theorems-q716171-erdos-ginzburg-ziv $a |-
    A. n e. NN0
      A. I e. _V
        A. S e. ( ~P I i^i Fin )
          A. a

              a : I --> ( Base ` ( Z/nZ ` n ) )

title: Q716171_erd_s_ginzburg_ziv_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q716171,
% "Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv theorem": among at least 2 * n - 1 indexed elements
% of Z/nZ, some n distinct indices have sum zero. This file contains no proof.

Q716171_erdos_ginzburg_ziv_theorem[Index: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[Index]

  subset_of(left, right: finite_set[Index]): bool =
    FORALL (index: Index):
      member(index, left) IMPLIES member(index, right)

  finite_int_sum_value(
      support: finite_set[Index],
      values: [Index -> int],
      total: int): bool =
    EXISTS
      (enumeration:
        [below(card(support)) -> (support)]),
      (partial_sums:
        [upto(card(support)) -> int]):
        bijective?(enumeration)
          AND partial_sums(0) = 0
          AND
            (FORALL (index: below(card(support))):
              partial_sums(index + 1) =
                partial_sums(index) + values(enumeration(index)))
          AND total = partial_sums(card(support))

  zero_modulus_sum(total: int, modulus: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (multiple: int):
      total = (modulus :: int) * multiple

  erdos_ginzburg_ziv_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
      (n: nat),
      (s: finite_set[Index]),
      (a: [Index -> int]):
        2 * n - 1 <= card(s)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS
              (t: finite_set[Index]),
              (total: int):
                subset_of(t, s)
                  AND card(t) = n
                  AND finite_int_sum_value(t, a, total)
                  AND zero_modulus_sum(total, n)
END Q716171_erdos_ginzburg_ziv_theorem

(*

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q718875), "Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem": an
  intersecting family of r-element subsets of a finite ordinal of size n,
  with r at most n divided by two, has cardinality at most the binomial
  coefficient choosing r - 1 elements from n - 1. This file contains no proof.
*)

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

Definition q718875_uniform
    {n : nat} (family : {set {set 'I_n}}) (r : nat) : Prop :=
  forall A : {set 'I_n},
    A \in family ->
    #|A| = r.

Definition q718875_intersecting
    {n : nat} (family : {set {set 'I_n}}) : Prop :=
  forall A B : {set 'I_n},
    A \in family ->
    B \in family ->
    exists x : 'I_n, x \in A /\ x \in B.

Theorem erdos_ko_rado :
  forall (n r : nat) (family : {set {set 'I_n}}),
    q718875_intersecting family ->
    q718875_uniform family r ->
    (r <= Nat.div n 2)%nat ->
    (#|family| <= binomial (n - 1) (r - 1))%nat.
Admitted.

Q718875_erd_s_ko_rado_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q718875, "Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem": an intersecting
;; family of r-element subsets of Fin n, with r at most n/2, has cardinality
;; at most (n - 1) choose (r - 1). This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

;; A Fin n element is represented by a natural below n. Duplicate-free true
;; lists represent finite subsets, and outer lists contain no two
;; extensionally equal subsets. Hence valid outer lists represent exactly
;; Finset (Finset (Fin n)), independently of list order.

(defun q718875-fin-element-p (x n)
  (and (natp x)
       (< x n)))

(defun q718875-fin-set-elements-p (set n)
  (if (consp set)
      (and (q718875-fin-element-p (car set) n)
           (q718875-fin-set-elements-p (cdr set) n))
    (equal set nil)))

(defun q718875-fin-set-p (set n)
  (and (true-listp set)
       (no-duplicatesp-equal set)
       (q718875-fin-set-elements-p set n)))

(defun q718875-subset-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (and (member-equal (car left) right)
           (q718875-subset-p (cdr left) right))
    t))

(defun q718875-set-equal-p (left right)
  (and (q718875-subset-p left right)
       (q718875-subset-p right left)))

(defun q718875-set-distinct-from-family-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (not (q718875-set-equal-p set (car family)))
           (q718875-set-distinct-from-family-p
            set (cdr family)))
    t))

(defun q718875-family-p (family n)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q718875-fin-set-p (car family) n)
           (q718875-set-distinct-from-family-p
            (car family) (cdr family))
           (q718875-family-p (cdr family) n))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q718875-sized-family-p (family r)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (equal (len (car family)) r)
           (q718875-sized-family-p (cdr family) r))
    t))

(defun q718875-sets-intersect-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (or (member-equal (car left) right)
          (q718875-sets-intersect-p (cdr left) right))
    nil))

(defun q718875-intersects-every-set-p (set family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q718875-sets-intersect-p set (car family))
           (q718875-intersects-every-set-p set (cdr family)))
    t))

;; Including the current set in each comparison preserves Mathlib's
;; Intersecting condition for equal arguments and excludes an empty member.

(defun q718875-intersecting-family-p (family)
  (if (consp family)
      (and (q718875-intersects-every-set-p
            (car family) family)
           (q718875-intersecting-family-p (cdr family)))
    (equal family nil)))

(defun q718875-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (zp k)
          (zp n))
      (if (zp k) 1 0)
    (+ (q718875-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) k)
       (q718875-binomial-coefficient (- n 1) (- k 1)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q718875-erdos-ko-rado-theorem-statement
    (n r family)
  (implies
   (and
    (natp n)
    (natp r)
    (q718875-family-p family n)
    (q718875-intersecting-family-p family)
    (q718875-sized-family-p family r)
    (<= r (floor n 2)))
   (<=
    (len family)
    (q718875-binomial-coefficient
     (nfix (- n 1))
     (nfix (- r 1))))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q718875_erd_s_ko_rado_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q718875,
-- "Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem": an intersecting family of r-subsets of Fin n,
-- with r at most floor (n / 2), has at most choose (n - 1) (r - 1)
-- members. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q718875_erd_s_ko_rado_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_)

infixr 5 _L::_
infixr 6 _&&_
infixr 5 _||_
infix 4 _<=_

data _<=_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <= n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <= n -> suc m <= suc n

data Vec (A : Set) : Nat -> Set where
  VNil  : Vec A zero
  _V::_ : {n : Nat} -> A -> Vec A n -> Vec A (suc n)

data List (A : Set) : Set where
  LNil  : List A
  _L::_ : A -> List A -> List A

Subset : Nat -> Set
Subset n =
  Vec Bool n

Family : Nat -> Set
Family n =
  Subset n -> Bool

data IsTrue : Bool -> Set where
  true-witness : IsTrue true

_&&_ : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
true && right =
  right
false && right =
  false

_||_ : Bool -> Bool -> Bool
true || right =
  true
false || right =
  right

map-list :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  List A ->
  List B
map-list function LNil =
  LNil
map-list function (item L:: items) =
  function item L:: map-list function items

append :
  {A : Set} ->
  List A ->
  List A ->
  List A
append LNil right =
  right
append (item L:: items) right =
  item L:: append items right

all-subsets : (n : Nat) -> List (Subset n)
all-subsets zero =
  VNil L:: LNil
all-subsets (suc n) =
  append
    (map-list (\ tail -> false V:: tail) (all-subsets n))
    (map-list (\ tail -> true V:: tail) (all-subsets n))

count-where :
  {A : Set} ->
  (A -> Bool) ->
  List A ->
  Nat
count-where predicate LNil =
  zero
count-where predicate (item L:: items) with predicate item
... | false =
  count-where predicate items
... | true =
  suc (count-where predicate items)

subset-cardinality :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Nat
subset-cardinality VNil =
  zero
subset-cardinality (false V:: tail) =
  subset-cardinality tail
subset-cardinality (true V:: tail) =
  suc (subset-cardinality tail)

subsets-intersect :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Subset n ->
  Subset n ->
  Bool
subsets-intersect VNil VNil =
  false
subsets-intersect
  (left V:: left-tail)
  (right V:: right-tail) =
  (left && right) || subsets-intersect left-tail right-tail

family-size :
  (n : Nat) ->
  Family n ->
  Nat
family-size n family =
  count-where family (all-subsets n)

Sized :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Family n ->
  Nat ->
  Set
Sized {n} family r =
  (subset : Subset n) ->
  IsTrue (family subset) ->
  subset-cardinality subset == r

Intersecting :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Family n ->
  Set
Intersecting {n} family =
  (left right : Subset n) ->
  IsTrue (family left) ->
  IsTrue (family right) ->
  IsTrue (subsets-intersect left right)

pred : Nat -> Nat
pred zero =
  zero
pred (suc n) =
  n

half : Nat -> Nat
half zero =
  zero
half (suc zero) =
  zero
half (suc (suc n)) =
  suc (half n)

one : Nat
one =
  suc zero

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  one
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

erdos-ko-rado-theorem : Set
erdos-ko-rado-theorem =
  (n r : Nat) ->
  (family : Family n) ->
  Intersecting family ->
  Sized family r ->
  r <= half n ->
  family-size n family <= choose (pred n) (pred r)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;

val q718875_binomial_def = new_definition (

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(

title: Q718875_erd_s_ko_rado_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q718875,
% "Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem": a uniform intersecting family of subsets of Fin n,
% with set size at most n / 2, satisfies the sharp binomial cardinality bound.
% This file contains no proof.

Q718875_erdos_ko_rado_theorem[n: nat]: THEORY
BEGIN
  element: TYPE = below(n)

  IMPORTING finite_sets[element], finite_sets_of_sets[element]

  element_set: TYPE = finite_set[element]
  finite_family: TYPE = finite_set[element_set]

  intersecting_family(family: finite_family): bool =
    FORALL (left_set, right_set: element_set):
      (member(left_set, family) AND member(right_set, family))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (common_element: element):
            member(common_element, left_set)
              AND member(common_element, right_set)

  uniform_family(family: finite_family, r: nat): bool =
    FORALL (member_set: element_set):
      member(member_set, family)
        IMPLIES card(member_set) = r

  binomial_coefficient(n_value, k_value: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k_value = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n_value = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n_value - 1, k_value - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n_value - 1, k_value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n_value

  nat_sub(n_value, k_value: nat): nat =
    IF k_value <= n_value THEN n_value - k_value ELSE 0 ENDIF

  erdos_ko_rado_theorem: bool =
    FORALL (family: finite_family), (r: nat):
      (intersecting_family(family)
        AND uniform_family(family, r)
        AND r <= ndiv(n, 2))
      IMPLIES
        card(family)
          <= binomial_coefficient(nat_sub(n, 1), nat_sub(r, 1))
END Q718875_erdos_ko_rado_theorem

module
