@[expose] public section

namespace Q720469

open Finset MvPolynomial

variable {K σ ι : Type*} [Fintype K] [Field K] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
variable [DecidableEq K] (p : ℕ) [CharP K p]

/-- The finitary Chevalley–Warning theorem for a family of multivariate polynomials. -/
theorem char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt_statement
    {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ K}
    (h : (∑ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree) < Fintype.card σ) :
    p ∣ Fintype.card { x : σ → K // ∀ i ∈ s, eval x (f i) = 0 } := sorry

end Q720469

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q720469
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q720469), "Chevalley–Warning theorem": over a
  finite field of characteristic p, if the sum of the total degrees of a
  finite family of multivariate polynomials is smaller than the number of
  variables, then p divides the number of their common zeros. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.PeanoNat.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q720469_finite_type (A : Type) : Type := {
  q720469_enum : list A;
  q720469_enum_complete :
    forall x : A, In x q720469_enum;
  q720469_enum_nodup :
    NoDup q720469_enum
}.

Arguments q720469_enum {A} _.

Definition q720469_card
    {A : Type} (FA : q720469_finite_type A) : nat :=
  length (q720469_enum FA).

Record q720469_field (K : Type) : Type := {
  q720469_zero : K;
  q720469_one : K;
  q720469_add : K -> K -> K;
  q720469_mul : K -> K -> K;
  q720469_neg : K -> K;
  q720469_inv : K -> K;
  q720469_eq_dec :
    forall x y : K, {x = y} + {x <> y};
  q720469_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q720469_add x (q720469_add y z) =
      q720469_add (q720469_add x y) z;
  q720469_add_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q720469_add x y = q720469_add y x;
  q720469_add_zero :
    forall x : K,
      q720469_add x q720469_zero = x;
  q720469_add_neg :
    forall x : K,
      q720469_add x (q720469_neg x) = q720469_zero;
  q720469_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : K,
      q720469_mul x (q720469_mul y z) =
      q720469_mul (q720469_mul x y) z;
  q720469_mul_comm :
    forall x y : K,
      q720469_mul x y = q720469_mul y x;
  q720469_mul_one :
    forall x : K,
      q720469_mul x q720469_one = x;
  q720469_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : K,
      q720469_mul x (q720469_add y z) =
      q720469_add
        (q720469_mul x y) (q720469_mul x z);
  q720469_mul_inv :
    forall x : K,
      x <> q720469_zero ->
      q720469_mul x (q720469_inv x) = q720469_one;
  q720469_nontrivial :
    q720469_zero <> q720469_one
}.

Arguments q720469_zero {K} _.
Arguments q720469_one {K} _.
Arguments q720469_add {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q720469_mul {K} _ _ _.
Arguments q720469_neg {K} _ _.
Arguments q720469_inv {K} _ _.
Arguments q720469_eq_dec {K} _ _ _.

Fixpoint q720469_nat_cast
    {K : Type} (FK : q720469_field K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q720469_zero FK
  | S k =>
      q720469_add FK (q720469_nat_cast FK k) (q720469_one FK)
  end.

Definition q720469_has_characteristic
    {K : Type} (FK : q720469_field K) (p : nat) : Prop :=
  forall n : nat,
    q720469_nat_cast FK n = q720469_zero FK <->
    Nat.divide p n.

Definition q720469_monomial (Var : Type) : Type :=
  Var -> nat.

Fixpoint q720469_monomial_eqb_on
    {Var : Type} (variables : list Var)
    (a b : q720469_monomial Var) : bool :=
  match variables with
  | nil => true
  | variable :: rest =>
      Nat.eqb (a variable) (b variable) &&
      q720469_monomial_eqb_on rest a b
  end.

Definition q720469_monomial_eqb
    {Var : Type} (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (a b : q720469_monomial Var) : bool :=
  q720469_monomial_eqb_on (q720469_enum FVar) a b.

Fixpoint q720469_nat_sum (values : list nat) : nat :=
  match values with
  | nil => O
  | value :: rest => value + q720469_nat_sum rest
  end.

Definition q720469_monomial_degree
    {Var : Type} (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (m : q720469_monomial Var) : nat :=
  q720469_nat_sum (map m (q720469_enum FVar)).

Definition q720469_polynomial (Var K : Type) : Type :=
  list (q720469_monomial Var * K).

Fixpoint q720469_polynomial_coefficient
    {Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (polynomial : q720469_polynomial Var K)
    (m : q720469_monomial Var) : K :=
  match polynomial with
  | nil => q720469_zero FK
  | (n, coefficient) :: rest =>
      if q720469_monomial_eqb FVar n m
      then q720469_add FK coefficient
        (q720469_polynomial_coefficient FVar FK rest m)
      else q720469_polynomial_coefficient FVar FK rest m
  end.

Fixpoint q720469_total_degree_over
    {Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (polynomial remaining : q720469_polynomial Var K) : nat :=
  match remaining with
  | nil => O
  | (m, _) :: rest =>
      if q720469_eq_dec FK
           (q720469_polynomial_coefficient FVar FK polynomial m)
           (q720469_zero FK)
      then q720469_total_degree_over FVar FK polynomial rest
      else Nat.max
        (q720469_monomial_degree FVar m)
        (q720469_total_degree_over FVar FK polynomial rest)
  end.

Definition q720469_total_degree
    {Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (polynomial : q720469_polynomial Var K) : nat :=
  q720469_total_degree_over FVar FK polynomial polynomial.

Fixpoint q720469_power
    {K : Type} (FK : q720469_field K)
    (x : K) (n : nat) : K :=
  match n with
  | O => q720469_one FK
  | S k =>
      q720469_mul FK x (q720469_power FK x k)
  end.

Fixpoint q720469_monomial_value_on
    {Var K : Type}
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (variables : list Var)
    (point : Var -> K)
    (m : q720469_monomial Var) : K :=
  match variables with
  | nil => q720469_one FK
  | variable :: rest =>
      q720469_mul FK
        (q720469_power FK (point variable) (m variable))
        (q720469_monomial_value_on FK rest point m)
  end.

Definition q720469_monomial_value
    {Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (point : Var -> K)
    (m : q720469_monomial Var) : K :=
  q720469_monomial_value_on
    FK (q720469_enum FVar) point m.

Fixpoint q720469_evaluate
    {Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (point : Var -> K)
    (polynomial : q720469_polynomial Var K) : K :=
  match polynomial with
  | nil => q720469_zero FK
  | (m, coefficient) :: rest =>
      q720469_add FK
        (q720469_mul FK coefficient
          (q720469_monomial_value FVar FK point m))
        (q720469_evaluate FVar FK point rest)
  end.

Fixpoint q720469_sum_total_degrees
    {Index Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (family : Index -> q720469_polynomial Var K)
    (indices : list Index) : nat :=
  match indices with
  | nil => O
  | index :: rest =>
      q720469_total_degree FVar FK (family index) +
      q720469_sum_total_degrees FVar FK family rest
  end.

Fixpoint q720469_common_zero_b
    {Index Var K : Type}
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (family : Index -> q720469_polynomial Var K)
    (indices : list Index)
    (point : Var -> K) : bool :=
  match indices with
  | nil => true
  | index :: rest =>
      if q720469_eq_dec FK
           (q720469_evaluate FVar FK point (family index))
           (q720469_zero FK)
      then q720469_common_zero_b FVar FK family rest point
      else false
  end.

Definition q720469_number_of_common_zeros
    {Index Var K : Type}
    (FPoints : q720469_finite_type (Var -> K))
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (family : Index -> q720469_polynomial Var K)
    (indices : list Index) : nat :=
  length
    (filter
      (q720469_common_zero_b FVar FK family indices)
      (q720469_enum FPoints)).

Theorem char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt :
  forall
    (K Var Index : Type)
    (FK : q720469_field K)
    (FK_finite : q720469_finite_type K)
    (FVar : q720469_finite_type Var)
    (FPoints : q720469_finite_type (Var -> K))
    (p : nat),
    q720469_has_characteristic FK p ->
    forall
      (indices : list Index)
      (family : Index -> q720469_polynomial Var K),
      NoDup indices ->
      q720469_sum_total_degrees FVar FK family indices <
        q720469_card FVar ->
      Nat.divide p
        (q720469_number_of_common_zeros
          FPoints FVar FK family indices).
Admitted.

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q720469 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q720469), "Chevalley–Warning theorem":
  for a finite family of multivariate polynomials over a finite field, if the
  sum of their total degrees is less than the number of variables, then the
  field characteristic divides the number of common zeros. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym ('v, 'a) q720469_raw_mpoly = "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q720469_monomial_support ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q720469_monomial_support m = {v. m v \<noteq> 0}"

definition q720469_polynomial_support ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) q720469_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "q720469_polynomial_support f = {m. f m \<noteq> 0}"

definition q720469_is_mpoly ::
    "'v set \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'a::zero) q720469_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q720469_is_mpoly V f \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite (q720469_polynomial_support f) \<and>
    (\<forall>m\<in>q720469_polynomial_support f.
      finite (q720469_monomial_support m) \<and>
      q720469_monomial_support m \<subseteq> V)"

definition q720469_total_degree ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) q720469_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> nat" where
  "q720469_total_degree f =
    (if q720469_polynomial_support f = {} then 0
     else Max ((\<lambda>m. \<Sum>v\<in>q720469_monomial_support m. m v) `
       q720469_polynomial_support f))"

definition q720469_mpoly_eval ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'a::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q720469_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q720469_mpoly_eval x f =
    (\<Sum>m\<in>q720469_polynomial_support f.
      f m * (\<Prod>v\<in>q720469_monomial_support m. x v ^ m v))"

theorem char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt:
  fixes V :: "'v set"
    and s :: "'i set"
    and f :: "'i \<Rightarrow> ('v, 'K::{finite,field}) q720469_raw_mpoly"
    and p :: nat
  assumes finite_V: "finite V"
    and finite_s: "finite s"
    and polynomial_f: "\<forall>i. q720469_is_mpoly V (f i)"
    and characteristic: "p = CHAR('K)"
    and degree_sum_lt:
      "(\<Sum>i\<in>s. q720469_total_degree (f i)) < card V"
  shows
    "p dvd card
      {x :: 'v \<Rightarrow> 'K.
        (\<forall>v. v \<notin> V \<longrightarrow> x v = 0) \<and>
        (\<forall>i\<in>s. q720469_mpoly_eval x (f i) = 0)}"
  sorry

end

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q720469
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q720469), "Chevalley–Warning theorem": over
  a finite field of characteristic p, if a finite family of multivariate
  polynomials has sum of total degrees smaller than the number of variables,
  then p divides the number of their common zeros. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q720469_CHEVALLEY_WARNING_THEOREM =
  `let is_field =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (negK:K->K) (invK:K->K).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x:K. addK zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x:K. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y:K. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x:K. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y:K. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:K.
          mulK x (addK y z) = addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       invK zeroK = zeroK /\
       (!x:K. ~(x = zeroK) ==> mulK (invK x) x = oneK) in
   let natural_multiple =
     \(zeroK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (n:num) (x:K).
       ITLIST addK (REPLICATE n x) zeroK in
   let has_characteristic =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (p:num).
       !n:num.
         natural_multiple zeroK addK n oneK = zeroK <=>
         p divides n in
   let power =
     \(oneK:K) (mulK:K->K->K) (x:K) (n:num).
       ITLIST mulK (REPLICATE n x) oneK in
   let is_mv_polynomial =
     \(zeroK:K) (q:(V->num)->K).
       FINITE {m | ~(q m = zeroK)} in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(zeroK:K). \(m:V->num). zeroK in
   let monomial_total_degree =
     \(m:V->num). nsum (UNIV:V->bool) m in
   let polynomial_total_degree =
     \(zeroK:K) (q:(V->num)->K).
       @d:num.
         (!m:V->num.
            ~(q m = zeroK)
            ==> monomial_total_degree m <= d) /\
         ((q = polynomial_zero zeroK /\ d = 0) \/
          (?m:V->num.
             ~(q m = zeroK) /\
             monomial_total_degree m = d)) in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (q:(V->num)->K) (x:V->K).
       iterate addK {m | ~(q m = zeroK)}
         (\m. mulK (q m)
           (iterate mulK (UNIV:V->bool)
             (\v. power oneK mulK (x v) (m v)))) in
   let common_solutions =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (s:I->bool) (f:I->(V->num)->K).
       {x:V->K |
          !i:I.
            i IN s
            ==> polynomial_eval
                  zeroK oneK addK mulK (f i) x = zeroK} in
   !p:num.
   !s:I->bool.
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK invK:K->K.
   !f:I->(V->num)->K.
     is_field zeroK oneK addK mulK negK invK /\
     FINITE (UNIV:K->bool) /\
     has_characteristic zeroK oneK addK p /\
     FINITE (UNIV:V->bool) /\
     FINITE s /\
     (!i:I. is_mv_polynomial zeroK (f i)) /\
     nsum s (\i:I. polynomial_total_degree zeroK (f i))
       < CARD (UNIV:V->bool)
     ==> p divides
         CARD
           (common_solutions
             zeroK oneK addK mulK s f)`;;

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q720469, "Chevalley–Warning theorem": over a
;; finite field of characteristic p, if the sum of the total degrees of a
;; finite family of multivariate polynomials is smaller than the number of
;; variables, then p divides the number of their common zeros. This file
;; contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Duplicate-free lists present the finite field, variable type, and finite
;; polynomial index set. Operation tables are required to satisfy all field
;; laws on the carrier. A polynomial is a canonical sparse list of
;; (exponent-vector coefficient) terms. The polynomial list is aligned with
;; the index-set list, which is exactly the restriction of the source family
;; to the finite set occurring in the theorem.

(defun q720469-set-list-p (objects)
  (if (consp objects)
      (and (not (member-equal (car objects) (cdr objects)))
           (q720469-set-list-p (cdr objects)))
    (equal objects nil)))

(defun q720469-lookup-unary (x table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal x table)))

(defun q720469-lookup-binary (x y table)
  (cdr (assoc-equal (list x y) table)))

(defun q720469-field-z-laws-p
    (zs x y add-table multiply-table)
  (if (consp zs)
      (let ((z (car zs)))
        (and
         (equal
          (q720469-lookup-binary
           (q720469-lookup-binary x y add-table)
           z add-table)
          (q720469-lookup-binary
           x
           (q720469-lookup-binary y z add-table)
           add-table))
         (equal
          (q720469-lookup-binary
           (q720469-lookup-binary x y multiply-table)
           z multiply-table)
          (q720469-lookup-binary
           x
           (q720469-lookup-binary y z multiply-table)
           multiply-table))
         (equal
          (q720469-lookup-binary
           x
           (q720469-lookup-binary y z add-table)
           multiply-table)
          (q720469-lookup-binary
           (q720469-lookup-binary x y multiply-table)
           (q720469-lookup-binary x z multiply-table)
           add-table))
         (q720469-field-z-laws-p
          (cdr zs) x y add-table multiply-table)))
    (equal zs nil)))

(defun q720469-field-y-laws-p
    (ys carrier x add-table multiply-table)
  (if (consp ys)
      (let* ((y (car ys))
             (sum (q720469-lookup-binary x y add-table))
             (product
              (q720469-lookup-binary x y multiply-table)))
        (and
         (assoc-equal (list x y) add-table)
         (member-equal sum carrier)
         (assoc-equal (list x y) multiply-table)
         (member-equal product carrier)
         (equal sum
                (q720469-lookup-binary y x add-table))
         (equal product
                (q720469-lookup-binary y x multiply-table))
         (q720469-field-z-laws-p
          carrier x y add-table multiply-table)
         (q720469-field-y-laws-p
          (cdr ys) carrier x add-table multiply-table)))
    (equal ys nil)))

(defun q720469-field-x-laws-p
    (xs carrier zero one add-table multiply-table
        negate-table inverse-table)
  (if (consp xs)
      (let* ((x (car xs))
             (negative (q720469-lookup-unary x negate-table))
             (inverse (q720469-lookup-unary x inverse-table)))
        (and
         (assoc-equal x negate-table)
         (member-equal negative carrier)
         (assoc-equal x inverse-table)
         (member-equal inverse carrier)
         (equal
          (q720469-lookup-binary x zero add-table)
          x)
         (equal
          (q720469-lookup-binary x negative add-table)
          zero)
         (equal
          (q720469-lookup-binary x one multiply-table)
          x)
         (implies
          (not (equal x zero))
          (equal
           (q720469-lookup-binary x inverse multiply-table)
           one))
         (q720469-field-y-laws-p
          carrier carrier x add-table multiply-table)
         (q720469-field-x-laws-p
          (cdr xs) carrier zero one add-table multiply-table
          negate-table inverse-table)))
    (equal xs nil)))

(defun q720469-finite-field-p
    (carrier zero one add-table multiply-table
        negate-table inverse-table)
  (and
   (q720469-set-list-p carrier)
   (consp carrier)
   (member-equal zero carrier)
   (member-equal one carrier)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q720469-field-x-laws-p
    carrier carrier zero one add-table multiply-table
    negate-table inverse-table)))

;; For a finite field, CharP K p is equivalently that p is the least positive
;; natural number whose multiple of one is zero.

(defun q720469-natural-multiple
    (count value zero add-table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      zero
    (q720469-lookup-binary
     value
     (q720469-natural-multiple
      (- count 1) value zero add-table)
     add-table)))

(defun q720469-smaller-multiples-nonzero-p
    (count one zero add-table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      t
    (and
     (not
      (equal
       (q720469-natural-multiple count one zero add-table)
       zero))
     (q720469-smaller-multiples-nonzero-p
      (- count 1) one zero add-table))))

(defun q720469-characteristic-p
    (p one zero add-table)
  (and
   (posp p)
   (equal
    (q720469-natural-multiple p one zero add-table)
    zero)
   (q720469-smaller-multiples-nonzero-p
    (- p 1) one zero add-table)))

;; Canonical sparse multivariate polynomials.

(defun q720469-all-members-p (objects carrier)
  (if (consp objects)
      (and (member-equal (car objects) carrier)
           (q720469-all-members-p (cdr objects) carrier))
    (equal objects nil)))

(defun q720469-natural-vector-p (vector length)
  (if (consp vector)
      (and
       (posp length)
       (natp (car vector))
       (q720469-natural-vector-p
        (cdr vector) (- length 1)))
    (and (equal vector nil)
         (equal length 0))))

(defun q720469-exponent-less-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (if (< (car left) (car right))
          t
        (and
         (equal (car left) (car right))
         (q720469-exponent-less-p
          (cdr left) (cdr right))))
    nil))

(defun q720469-polynomial-tail-p
    (polynomial variable-count carrier zero
                previous have-previous)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((term (car polynomial)))
        (and
         (true-listp term)
         (equal (len term) 2)
         (q720469-natural-vector-p
          (car term) variable-count)
         (member-equal (cadr term) carrier)
         (not (equal (cadr term) zero))
         (or
          (not have-previous)
          (q720469-exponent-less-p previous (car term)))
         (q720469-polynomial-tail-p
          (cdr polynomial) variable-count carrier zero
          (car term) t)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun q720469-polynomial-p
    (polynomial variable-count carrier zero)
  (and
   (natp variable-count)
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (q720469-polynomial-tail-p
    polynomial variable-count carrier zero nil nil)))

(defun q720469-polynomial-family-p
    (polynomials variable-count carrier zero)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (and
       (q720469-polynomial-p
        (car polynomials) variable-count carrier zero)
       (q720469-polynomial-family-p
        (cdr polynomials) variable-count carrier zero))
    (equal polynomials nil)))

(defun q720469-exponent-sum (exponents)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (+ (car exponents)
         (q720469-exponent-sum (cdr exponents)))
    0))

(defun q720469-polynomial-total-degree (polynomial)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (max
       (q720469-exponent-sum (caar polynomial))
       (q720469-polynomial-total-degree (cdr polynomial)))
    0))

(defun q720469-family-degree-sum (polynomials)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (+
       (q720469-polynomial-total-degree (car polynomials))
       (q720469-family-degree-sum (cdr polynomials)))
    0))

;; Evaluation and exact enumeration of the function space sigma -> K.

(defun q720469-field-power
    (value exponent one multiply-table)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (q720469-lookup-binary
     value
     (q720469-field-power
      value (- exponent 1) one multiply-table)
     multiply-table)))

(defun q720469-monomial-eval
    (exponents point one multiply-table)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (q720469-lookup-binary
       (q720469-field-power
        (car point) (car exponents) one multiply-table)
       (q720469-monomial-eval
        (cdr exponents) (cdr point) one multiply-table)
       multiply-table)
    one))

(defun q720469-polynomial-eval
    (polynomial point zero one add-table multiply-table)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q720469-lookup-binary
       (q720469-lookup-binary
        (cadar polynomial)
        (q720469-monomial-eval
         (caar polynomial) point one multiply-table)
        multiply-table)
       (q720469-polynomial-eval
        (cdr polynomial) point zero one
        add-table multiply-table)
       add-table)
    zero))

(defun q720469-prepend-to-points (value points)
  (if (consp points)
      (cons
       (cons value (car points))
       (q720469-prepend-to-points value (cdr points)))
    nil))

(defun q720469-extend-points (values points)
  (if (consp values)
      (append
       (q720469-prepend-to-points (car values) points)
       (q720469-extend-points (cdr values) points))
    nil))

(defun q720469-all-points (variable-count carrier)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix variable-count)))
  (if (zp variable-count)
      (list nil)
    (q720469-extend-points
     carrier
     (q720469-all-points (- variable-count 1) carrier))))

(defun q720469-common-zero-p
    (polynomials point zero one add-table multiply-table)
  (if (consp polynomials)
      (and
       (equal
        (q720469-polynomial-eval
         (car polynomials) point zero one
         add-table multiply-table)
        zero)
       (q720469-common-zero-p
        (cdr polynomials) point zero one
        add-table multiply-table))
    (equal polynomials nil)))

(defun q720469-count-common-zeros
    (points polynomials zero one add-table multiply-table)
  (if (consp points)
      (+
       (if
        (q720469-common-zero-p
         polynomials (car points) zero one
         add-table multiply-table)
        1
        0)
       (q720469-count-common-zeros
        (cdr points) polynomials zero one
        add-table multiply-table))
    0))

(defun thousand-theorems-q720469-chevalley-warning-theorem-statement
    (variables indices polynomials
               carrier zero one add-table multiply-table
               negate-table inverse-table p)
  (implies
   (and
    (q720469-set-list-p variables)
    (q720469-set-list-p indices)
    (equal (len polynomials) (len indices))
    (q720469-finite-field-p
     carrier zero one add-table multiply-table
     negate-table inverse-table)
    (q720469-characteristic-p p one zero add-table)
    (q720469-polynomial-family-p
     polynomials (len variables) carrier zero))
   (implies
    (< (q720469-family-degree-sum polynomials)
       (len variables))
    (equal
     (mod
      (q720469-count-common-zeros
       (q720469-all-points (len variables) carrier)
       polynomials zero one add-table multiply-table)
      p)
     0))))

:q

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q720469,
-- "Chevalley–Warning theorem": over a finite field of characteristic p, the
-- characteristic divides the number of common zeros of a finite polynomial
-- family when the sum of total degrees is smaller than the number of variables.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _<_ _not-equal_ _divides_
infixr 3 _and_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_not-equal_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x not-equal y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Dec
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  yes : A -> Dec A
  no  : Not A -> Dec A

DecidableEquality :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
DecidableEquality A =
  (x y : A) ->
  Dec (x == y)

data _<_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-suc :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero < suc n
  suc-less-suc :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m < n ->
    suc m < suc n

record _divides_ (divisor dividend : Nat) : Set where
  field
    quotient : Nat
    division-equation : divisor * quotient == dividend

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

data Vector
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Nat ->
  Set a where

  vector-empty :
    Vector A zero
  vector-cons :
    {n : Nat} ->
    A ->
    Vector A n ->
    Vector A (suc n)

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record FiniteType
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    cardinality : Nat
    enumeration : Bijection (Fin cardinality) A

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  here :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)
  there :
    {y : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates []
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Not (Member x xs) ->
    NoDuplicates xs ->
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    elements      : List A
    no-duplicates : NoDuplicates elements

record Field
  {a : Level}
  (K : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroK oneK : K
    addK multiplyK : K -> K -> K
    negateK inverseK : K -> K

    one-not-zero :
      oneK not-equal zeroK

    add-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      addK (addK x y) z == addK x (addK y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      addK x y == addK y x
    add-zero :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x zeroK == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      addK x (negateK x) == zeroK

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK (multiplyK x y) z ==
      multiplyK x (multiplyK y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : K) ->
      multiplyK x y == multiplyK y x
    multiply-one :
      (x : K) ->
      multiplyK x oneK == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : K) ->
      multiplyK x (addK y z) ==
      addK (multiplyK x y) (multiplyK x z)
    multiply-inverse :
      (x : K) ->
      x not-equal zeroK ->
      multiplyK x (inverseK x) == oneK
    inverse-zero :
      inverseK zeroK == zeroK

fromNat :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  Nat ->
  K
fromNat algebra zero =
  Field.zeroK algebra
fromNat algebra (suc n) =
  Field.addK algebra
    (fromNat algebra n)
    (Field.oneK algebra)

record Characteristic
  {a : Level}
  {K : Set a}
  (algebra : Field K)
  (p : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    cast-is-zero :
      (n : Nat) ->
      (fromNat algebra n == Field.zeroK algebra)
      iff
      (p divides n)

power :
  {a : Level} ->
  {K : Set a} ->
  Field K ->
  K ->
  Nat ->
  K
power algebra x zero =
  Field.oneK algebra
power algebra x (suc n) =
  Field.multiplyK algebra x (power algebra x n)

maxNat :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Nat
maxNat zero n =
  n
maxNat (suc m) zero =
  suc m
maxNat (suc m) (suc n) =
  suc (maxNat m n)

Exponent :
  {s : Level} ->
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  FiniteType Sigma ->
  Set
Exponent finiteSigma =
  Vector Nat (FiniteType.cardinality finiteSigma)

sumVector :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector Nat n ->
  Nat
sumVector vector-empty =
  zero
sumVector (vector-cons value values) =
  value + sumVector values

monomialDegree :
  {s : Level} ->
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  Exponent finiteSigma ->
  Nat
monomialDegree finiteSigma exponent =
  sumVector exponent

record Polynomial
  {k s : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s}
  (algebra : Field K)
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) :
  Set (k ⊔ s) where

  field
    coefficient :
      Exponent finiteSigma ->
      K
    support :
      List (Exponent finiteSigma)
    support-exact :
      (exponent : Exponent finiteSigma) ->
      Member exponent support
      iff
      (coefficient exponent not-equal Field.zeroK algebra)
    support-no-duplicates :
      NoDuplicates support

maximumDegree :
  {s : Level} ->
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  List (Exponent finiteSigma) ->
  Nat
maximumDegree finiteSigma [] =
  zero
maximumDegree finiteSigma (exponent ∷ support) =
  maxNat
    (monomialDegree finiteSigma exponent)
    (maximumDegree finiteSigma support)

totalDegree :
  {k s : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s}
  {algebra : Field K}
  {finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma} ->
  Polynomial algebra finiteSigma ->
  Nat
totalDegree {finiteSigma = finiteSigma} polynomial =
  maximumDegree finiteSigma (Polynomial.support polynomial)

monomialProduct :
  {k : Level}
  {K : Set k} ->
  (algebra : Field K) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> K) ->
  Vector Nat n ->
  K
monomialProduct algebra values vector-empty =
  Field.oneK algebra
monomialProduct algebra values (vector-cons exponent exponents) =
  Field.multiplyK algebra
    (power algebra (values fzero) exponent)
    (monomialProduct algebra
      (\ i -> values (fsuc i))
      exponents)

monomialValue :
  {k s : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  (algebra : Field K) ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  (Sigma -> K) ->
  Exponent finiteSigma ->
  K
monomialValue algebra finiteSigma assignment exponent =
  monomialProduct algebra
    (\ i ->
      assignment
        (Bijection.to
          (FiniteType.enumeration finiteSigma)
          i))
    exponent

evaluateSupport :
  {k s : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  (algebra : Field K) ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  (coefficient : Exponent finiteSigma -> K) ->
  List (Exponent finiteSigma) ->
  (Sigma -> K) ->
  K
evaluateSupport algebra finiteSigma coefficient [] assignment =
  Field.zeroK algebra
evaluateSupport algebra finiteSigma coefficient
  (exponent ∷ support) assignment =
  Field.addK algebra
    (Field.multiplyK algebra
      (coefficient exponent)
      (monomialValue algebra finiteSigma assignment exponent))
    (evaluateSupport algebra finiteSigma coefficient support assignment)

evaluate :
  {k s : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  (algebra : Field K) ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  Polynomial algebra finiteSigma ->
  (Sigma -> K) ->
  K
evaluate algebra finiteSigma polynomial assignment =
  evaluateSupport algebra finiteSigma
    (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial)
    (Polynomial.support polynomial)
    assignment

sumDegrees :
  {i k s : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s}
  {algebra : Field K}
  {finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma} ->
  List I ->
  (I -> Polynomial algebra finiteSigma) ->
  Nat
sumDegrees [] family =
  zero
sumDegrees (index ∷ indices) family =
  totalDegree (family index) + sumDegrees indices family

CommonZero :
  {i k s : Level}
  {I : Set i}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  (algebra : Field K) ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  FiniteSubset I ->
  (I -> Polynomial algebra finiteSigma) ->
  (Sigma -> K) ->
  Set (i ⊔ k)
CommonZero algebra finiteSigma subset family assignment =
  (index : _) ->
  Member index (FiniteSubset.elements subset) ->
  evaluate algebra finiteSigma (family index) assignment ==
  Field.zeroK algebra

AssignmentEqual :
  {k s : Level}
  {K : Set k}
  {Sigma : Set s} ->
  FiniteType Sigma ->
  (Sigma -> K) ->
  (Sigma -> K) ->
  Set k
AssignmentEqual finiteSigma left right =
  (index : Fin (FiniteType.cardinality finiteSigma)) ->
  left
    (Bijection.to
      (FiniteType.enumeration finiteSigma)
      index)
  ==
  right
    (Bijection.to
      (FiniteType.enumeration finiteSigma)
      index)

record HasCardinality
  {a p e : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (member : A -> Set p)
  (equivalent : A -> A -> Set e)
  (cardinality : Nat) :
  Set (a ⊔ p ⊔ e) where

  field
    enumerate :
      Fin cardinality ->
      A
    enumerated-member :
      (index : Fin cardinality) ->
      member (enumerate index)
    enumeration-complete :
      (item : A) ->
      member item ->
      Σ (Fin cardinality)
        (\ index -> equivalent item (enumerate index))
    enumeration-injective :
      (left-index right-index : Fin cardinality) ->
      equivalent (enumerate left-index) (enumerate right-index) ->
      left-index == right-index

chevalley-warning-theorem : Setω
chevalley-warning-theorem =
  {k s i : Level} ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (Sigma : Set s) ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (algebra : Field K) ->
  FiniteType K ->
  DecidableEquality K ->
  (finiteSigma : FiniteType Sigma) ->
  DecidableEquality Sigma ->
  (p : Nat) ->
  Characteristic algebra p ->
  (subset : FiniteSubset I) ->
  (family : I -> Polynomial algebra finiteSigma) ->
  sumDegrees (FiniteSubset.elements subset) family
    < FiniteType.cardinality finiteSigma ->
  Σ Nat
    (\ solution-count ->
      HasCardinality
        (CommonZero algebra finiteSigma subset family)
        (AssignmentEqual finiteSigma)
        solution-count
      and
      (p divides solution-count))

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q720469, "Chevalley–Warning theorem": over a finite field, if the sum of
  the total degrees of a finite family of multivariate polynomials is less
  than the number of variables, then the field characteristic divides the
  number of their common zeros. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory dividesTheory pred_setTheory;

val q720469_field_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_field_def",
  ``q720469_field
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k) <=>
      zero <> oneK /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneK x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      invK zero = zero /\
      (!x. x <> zero ==> mul (invK x) x = oneK)``);

val q720469_nat_cast_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_nat_cast_def",
  ``q720469_nat_cast
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (n : num) =
      FUNPOW (add oneK) n zero``);

val q720469_characteristic_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_characteristic_def",
  ``q720469_characteristic
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k) (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (p : num) <=>
      !n : num.
        (q720469_nat_cast zero oneK add n = zero <=> divides p n)``);

val q720469_polynomial_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_polynomial_def",
  ``q720469_polynomial
      (zero : 'k) (q : ('v -> num) -> 'k) <=>
      FINITE {m : 'v -> num | q m <> zero}``);

val q720469_monomial_degree_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_monomial_degree_def",
  ``q720469_monomial_degree (m : 'v -> num) =
      ITSET (\v acc. m v + acc) (UNIV : 'v set) 0``);

val q720469_total_degree_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_total_degree_def",
  ``q720469_total_degree
      (zero : 'k) (q : ('v -> num) -> 'k) =
      if (!m : 'v -> num. q m = zero)
      then 0
      else
        MAX_SET
          (IMAGE q720469_monomial_degree
            {m : 'v -> num | q m <> zero})``);

val q720469_monomial_value_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_monomial_value_def",
  ``q720469_monomial_value
      (oneK : 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (x : 'v -> 'k) (m : 'v -> num) =
      ITSET
        (\v acc. mul (FUNPOW (mul (x v)) (m v) oneK) acc)
        (UNIV : 'v set)
        oneK``);

val q720469_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_eval_def",
  ``q720469_eval
      (zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (x : 'v -> 'k) (q : ('v -> num) -> 'k) =
      ITSET
        (\m acc.
          add
            (mul (q m) (q720469_monomial_value oneK mul x m))
            acc)
        {m : 'v -> num | q m <> zero}
        zero``);

val q720469_sum_degrees_def = new_definition (
  "q720469_sum_degrees_def",
  ``q720469_sum_degrees
      (zero : 'k) (s : 'i set)
      (f : 'i -> ('v -> num) -> 'k) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc. q720469_total_degree zero (f i) + acc)
        s
        0``);

val char_dvd_card_solutions_of_sum_lt =
  ``!(zero : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (add : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mul : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (neg : 'k -> 'k) (invK : 'k -> 'k)
      (p : num) (s : 'i set)
      (f : 'i -> ('v -> num) -> 'k).
      q720469_field zero oneK add mul neg invK /\
      FINITE (UNIV : 'k set) /\
      FINITE (UNIV : 'v set) /\
      q720469_characteristic zero oneK add p /\
      FINITE s /\
      (!i : 'i. q720469_polynomial zero (f i)) /\
      q720469_sum_degrees zero s f < CARD (UNIV : 'v set)
      ==>
      divides p
        (CARD
          {x : 'v -> 'k |
             !i : 'i.
               i IN s ==>
               q720469_eval zero oneK add mul x (f i) = zero})``;

content:
$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q720469), catalog title
  "Chevalley-Warning theorem": over a finite field, if the sum of the total
  degrees of a finite selected family of multivariate polynomials is smaller
  than the number of variables, then the field characteristic divides the

$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The finite set S is a set-theoretic carrier for the source's arbitrary
  finite variable type. The arbitrary set J is the polynomial-family index
  type, and T is its selected finite subset. SetMM's S mPoly K and S eval K
  are the finite-support multivariate polynomial ring and its evaluation map.

  SetMM's mDeg assigns -oo to the zero polynomial, whereas Lean's totalDegree
  assigns zero. Q720469TotalDegree makes exactly that definitional adjustment.
  Every $a declaration below is an unproved statement encoding. This root file
  itself contains no $p proof declaration; proofs verified during ITPEval come
  only from the imported lib/set.mm library.
$)

$c Q720469TotalDegree $.

q720469-total-degree-syntax $a
  class ( Q720469TotalDegree K S P )
$.

${
  $d K P S $.

  $( Lean's totalDegree is zero on the zero polynomial, while SetMM's mDeg
     uses the extended value -oo there. $)
  q720469-total-degree-definition $a
    |- ( Q720469TotalDegree K S P )
       =
       if ( P = ( 0g ` ( S mPoly K ) ) ,
            0 ,
            ( ( S mDeg K ) ` P ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d J K P S T f i p x $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-Q720469 $a
    |-
    A. K e. Field
      ( ( Base ` K ) e. Fin
        ->
        A. S e. Fin
          A. J e. _V
            A. p e. NN0
              ( ( chr ` K ) = p
                ->
                A. T e. ( ~P J i^i Fin )
                  A. f
                    ( f : J --> ( Base ` ( S mPoly K ) )
                      ->
                      ( ( sum_ i e. T
                            ( Q720469TotalDegree K S ( f ` i ) ) )
                        < ( # ` S )
                        ->
                        p ||
                        ( # `
                          { x e. ( ( Base ` K ) ^m S ) |
                            A. i e. T
                              ( ( ( S eval K ) ` ( f ` i ) ) ` x )
                              =
                              ( 0g ` K ) } ) ) ) ) ) ) )
  $.
$}

title: Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q720469
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q720469), "Chevalley–Warning theorem": over a
% finite field of characteristic p, p divides the number of common zeros of a
% finite polynomial family when its total-degree sum is smaller than the
% number of variables. This file contains no proof.

Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem[
  Sigma, Iota: TYPE,
  K: TYPE+,
  zero_K, one_K: K,
  neg_K, inv_K: [K -> K],
  add_K, mul_K: [K, K -> K],
  char_p: nat
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  monomial: TYPE = [Sigma -> nat]
  raw_polynomial: TYPE = [monomial -> K]
  polynomial_family: TYPE = [Iota -> raw_polynomial]
  point: TYPE = [Sigma -> K]

  nat_cast(value: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF value = 0 THEN
      zero_K
    ELSE
      add_K(nat_cast(value - 1), one_K)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE value

  field_laws: bool =
    zero_K /= one_K
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        add_K(a, b) = add_K(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        add_K(add_K(a, b), c) = add_K(a, add_K(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        add_K(a, zero_K) = a
          AND add_K(a, neg_K(a)) = zero_K)
      AND (FORALL (a, b: K):
        mul_K(a, b) = mul_K(b, a))
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mul_K(mul_K(a, b), c) = mul_K(a, mul_K(b, c)))
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        mul_K(a, one_K) = a)
      AND (FORALL (a, b, c: K):
        mul_K(a, add_K(b, c))
          = add_K(mul_K(a, b), mul_K(a, c)))
      AND inv_K(zero_K) = zero_K
      AND (FORALL (a: K):
        a /= zero_K IMPLIES mul_K(a, inv_K(a)) = one_K)

  field_has_characteristic_p: bool =
    char_p > 0
      AND nat_cast(char_p) = zero_K
      AND (FORALL (value: nat):
        value > 0 AND value < char_p
          IMPLIES nat_cast(value) /= zero_K)

  variable_member(
      variable: Sigma,
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES variables OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        variable = head OR variable_member(variable, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  no_duplicate_variables(
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES variables OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT variable_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_variables(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  variable_list_length(
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES variables OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        1 + variable_list_length(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  monomial_supported_on(
      value: monomial,
      variables: list[Sigma]): bool =
    FORALL (variable: Sigma):
      NOT variable_member(variable, variables)
        IMPLIES value(variable) = 0

  monomial_member(
      value: monomial,
      monomials: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        value = head OR monomial_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  no_duplicate_monomials(
      monomials: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES monomials OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT monomial_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_monomials(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE monomials BY <<

  exact_support_over(
      polynomial: raw_polynomial,
      support: list[monomial],
      variables: list[Sigma]): bool =
    no_duplicate_monomials(support)
      AND (FORALL (value: monomial):
        monomial_member(value, support)
          IFF polynomial(value) /= zero_K)
      AND (FORALL (value: monomial):
        monomial_member(value, support)
          IMPLIES monomial_supported_on(value, variables))

  is_polynomial_over(
      polynomial: raw_polynomial,
      variables: list[Sigma]): bool =
    EXISTS (support: list[monomial]):
      exact_support_over(polynomial, support, variables)

  monomial_degree(
      value: monomial,
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES variables OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        value(head) + monomial_degree(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  maximum_monomial_degree(
      support: list[monomial],
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES support OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        LET head_degree: nat = monomial_degree(head, variables),
            tail_degree: nat =
              maximum_monomial_degree(tail, variables)
        IN
          IF head_degree < tail_degree THEN
            tail_degree
          ELSE
            head_degree
          ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE support BY <<

  total_degree_value(
      polynomial: raw_polynomial,
      variables: list[Sigma],
      degree: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (support: list[monomial]):
        exact_support_over(polynomial, support, variables)
          AND degree =
            maximum_monomial_degree(support, variables)

  field_power(value: K, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE K =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one_K
    ELSE
      mul_K(field_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  monomial_value(
      assignment: point,
      value: monomial,
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE K =
    CASES variables OF
      null: one_K,
      cons(head, tail):
        mul_K(
          field_power(assignment(head), value(head)),
          monomial_value(assignment, value, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  polynomial_sum(
      polynomial: raw_polynomial,
      assignment: point,
      support: list[monomial],
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE K =
    CASES support OF
      null: zero_K,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_K(
          mul_K(
            polynomial(head),
            monomial_value(assignment, head, variables)),
          polynomial_sum(
            polynomial,
            assignment,
            tail,
            variables))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE support BY <<

  evaluates_to(
      polynomial: raw_polynomial,
      assignment: point,
      variables: list[Sigma],
      value: K): bool =
    EXISTS (support: list[monomial]):
        exact_support_over(polynomial, support, variables)
          AND value =
            polynomial_sum(
              polynomial,
              assignment,
              support,
              variables)

  index_member(
      index: Iota,
      indices: list[Iota]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        index = head OR index_member(index, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  no_duplicate_indices(
      indices: list[Iota]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT index_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_indices(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  degree_sum_value(
      indices: list[Iota],
      family: polynomial_family,
      variables: list[Sigma],
      total: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES indices OF
      null:
        total = 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        EXISTS (head_degree, tail_total: nat):
          total_degree_value(
            family(head),
            variables,
            head_degree)
            AND degree_sum_value(
              tail,
              family,
              variables,
              tail_total)
            AND total = head_degree + tail_total
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE indices BY <<

  same_on_variables(
      left, right: point,
      variables: list[Sigma]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES variables OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        left(head) = right(head)
          AND same_on_variables(left, right, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE variables BY <<

  common_solution(
      variables: list[Sigma],
      indices: list[Iota],
      family: polynomial_family,
      assignment: point): bool =
    FORALL (index: Iota):
      index_member(index, indices)
        IMPLIES evaluates_to(
          family(index),
          assignment,
          variables,
          zero_K)

  has_solution_cardinality(
      variables: list[Sigma],
      indices: list[Iota],
      family: polynomial_family,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [below(cardinality) -> point]):
      (FORALL (left, right: below(cardinality)):
        same_on_variables(
          enumeration(left),
          enumeration(right),
          variables)
          IMPLIES left = right)
        AND
      (FORALL (assignment: point):
        common_solution(
          variables,
          indices,
          family,
          assignment)
          IFF
        EXISTS (position: below(cardinality)):
          same_on_variables(
            enumeration(position),
            assignment,
            variables))

  nat_divides(divisor, value: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (quotient: nat):
      value = divisor * quotient

  chevalley_warning_theorem: bool =
    (is_finite_type[K]
      AND field_laws
      AND field_has_characteristic_p)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL
        (variables: list[Sigma]),
        (indices: list[Iota]),
        (family: polynomial_family):
          (no_duplicate_variables(variables)
            AND no_duplicate_indices(indices)
            AND (FORALL (index: Iota):
              is_polynomial_over(
                family(index),
                variables))
            AND
              EXISTS (degree_sum: nat):
                degree_sum_value(
                  indices,
                  family,
                  variables,
                  degree_sum)
                  AND degree_sum
                    < variable_list_length(variables))
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (solution_count: nat):
              has_solution_cardinality(
                variables,
                indices,
                family,
                solution_count)
                AND nat_divides(char_p, solution_count)

END Q720469_chevalley_warning_theorem

title: Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7208500
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q7208500), "Poisson limit theorem": if the real
  sequence n * p(n) converges to r, then the corresponding fixed-k binomial
  probability term converges to exp(-r) * r^k / k!. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals Arith.PeanoNat.

Local Open Scope R_scope.

Fixpoint q7208500_choose (n k : nat) : nat :=
  match n, k with
  | _, O => 1
  | O, S _ => 0
  | S n', S k' =>
      q7208500_choose n' k' + q7208500_choose n' (S k')
  end.

Fixpoint q7208500_factorial (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S m => S m * q7208500_factorial m
  end.

Definition q7208500_tendsto_real
    (u : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (u n - limit) < epsilon.

Theorem q7208500_canonical_statement :
  forall (p : nat -> R) (r : R) (k : nat),
    q7208500_tendsto_real
      (fun n : nat => INR n * p n) r ->
    q7208500_tendsto_real
      (fun n : nat =>
        INR (q7208500_choose n k) *
        (p n) ^ k *
        (1 - p n) ^ (n - k)%nat)
      (exp (-r) * (r ^ k) / INR (q7208500_factorial k)).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7208500
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7208500), "Poisson limit theorem": if the real
  sequence n * p n converges to r, then for each fixed natural k the associated
  binomial probability term converges to exp (-r) * r^k / k!. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

theory Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

theorem poisson_limit_theorem:
  fixes p :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
    and r :: real
    and k :: nat
  assumes scaled_probability_limit:
    "(\<lambda>n. real n * p n) \<longlonglongrightarrow> r"
  shows
    "(\<lambda>n.
        real (n choose k) * (p n) ^ k * (1 - p n) ^ (n - k))
      \<longlonglongrightarrow> exp (-r) * (r ^ k) / fact k"
  sorry

end

title: Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7208500,
;; "Poisson limit theorem": for each fixed natural k, if n times the real
;; sequence p(n) converges to r, then the corresponding binomial-expression
;; term converges to exp(-r) times r^k divided by k!. This file contains no
;; proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; An arbitrary Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.
;; The exponential operation is characterized by convergence of its complete
;; power series. Natural casts, powers, factorials, and binomial coefficients
;; below are exact recursive operations, while both limits use their full
;; epsilon-N definitions over unbounded natural indices.

(defstub q7208500-r-member-p (real value) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-less (real left right) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-generic-set-member-p (real set value) t)
(defstub q7208500-r-exponential (real value) t)
(defstub q7208500-sequence-value (sequence index) t)

(defun q7208500-r-subtract (real left right)
  (q7208500-r-add
   real left (q7208500-r-negate real right)))

(defun q7208500-r-divide (real numerator denominator)
  (q7208500-r-multiply
   real numerator (q7208500-r-inverse real denominator)))

(defun q7208500-r-leq (real left right)
  (not (q7208500-r-less real right left)))

(defun q7208500-r-absolute-value (real value)
  (if (q7208500-r-less
       real value (q7208500-r-zero real))
      (q7208500-r-negate real value)
    value))

(defun q7208500-r-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q7208500-r-member-p real value)
   (q7208500-r-less
    real (q7208500-r-zero real) value)))

;; Complete ordered-field presentation of the real scalar domain.

(defun-sk q7208500-r-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7208500-r-member-p real x)
      (q7208500-r-member-p real y)
      (q7208500-r-member-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q7208500-r-zero real))
            (one (q7208500-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q7208500-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q7208500-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q7208500-r-multiply real x y))
            (yz-mul (q7208500-r-multiply real y z))
            (neg-x (q7208500-r-negate real x))
            (inv-x (q7208500-r-inverse real x)))
       (and
        (q7208500-r-member-p real zero)
        (q7208500-r-member-p real one)
        (q7208500-r-member-p real xy-add)
        (q7208500-r-member-p real xy-mul)
        (q7208500-r-member-p real neg-x)
        (q7208500-r-member-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q7208500-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q7208500-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q7208500-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q7208500-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q7208500-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q7208500-r-multiply real xy-mul z)
         (q7208500-r-multiply real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q7208500-r-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q7208500-r-multiply real x one) x)
        (equal (q7208500-r-inverse real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q7208500-r-multiply real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q7208500-r-multiply
          real x (q7208500-r-add real y z))
         (q7208500-r-add
          real
          (q7208500-r-multiply real x y)
          (q7208500-r-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7208500-r-member-p real x)
      (q7208500-r-member-p real y)
      (q7208500-r-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q7208500-r-zero real)))
       (and
        (not (q7208500-r-less real x x))
        (or
         (equal x y)
         (q7208500-r-less real x y)
         (q7208500-r-less real y x))
        (implies
         (and
          (q7208500-r-less real x y)
          (q7208500-r-less real y z))
         (q7208500-r-less real x z))
        (implies
         (q7208500-r-less real x y)
         (q7208500-r-less
          real
          (q7208500-r-add real x z)
          (q7208500-r-add real y z)))
        (implies
         (and
          (q7208500-r-less real zero x)
          (q7208500-r-less real zero y))
         (q7208500-r-less
          real zero
          (q7208500-r-multiply real x y))))))))

(defun q7208500-r-singleton-set (real value)
  (list :q7208500-singleton real value))

(defun q7208500-r-set-member-p (real set value)
  (if
      (and
       (true-listp set)
       (equal (len set) 3)
       (equal (car set) :q7208500-singleton)
       (equal (cadr set) real))
      (equal value (caddr set))
    (q7208500-r-generic-set-member-p real set value)))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-valid-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7208500-r-set-member-p real set x)
     (q7208500-r-member-p real x))))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q7208500-r-member-p real x)
     (q7208500-r-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7208500-r-member-p real x)
      (q7208500-r-set-member-p real set x))
     (q7208500-r-leq real x bound))))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q7208500-r-member-p real bound)
     (q7208500-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-least-upper-bound-p
    (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q7208500-r-member-p real supremum)
     (q7208500-r-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q7208500-r-member-p real bound)
       (q7208500-r-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q7208500-r-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q7208500-r-least-upper-bound-p
     real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q7208500-r-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7208500-r-valid-set-p real set)
      (q7208500-r-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q7208500-r-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q7208500-r-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q7208500-real-field-p (real)
  (let ((zero (q7208500-r-zero real))
        (one (q7208500-r-one real)))
    (and
     (q7208500-r-member-p real zero)
     (q7208500-r-member-p real one)
     (not (equal zero one))
     (q7208500-r-field-laws-p real)
     (q7208500-r-order-laws-p real)
     (q7208500-r-less real zero one)
     (q7208500-r-set-nonempty-p
      real (q7208500-r-singleton-set real zero))
     (q7208500-r-dedekind-complete-p real))))

;; Exact natural arithmetic interpreted in the real field.

(defun q7208500-natural-cast (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q7208500-r-zero real)
    (q7208500-r-add
     real
     (q7208500-natural-cast real (1- n))
     (q7208500-r-one real))))

(defun q7208500-natural-power (real value exponent)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      (q7208500-r-one real)
    (q7208500-r-multiply
     real value
     (q7208500-natural-power
      real value (1- exponent)))))

(defun q7208500-natural-factorial-value (real n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q7208500-r-one real)
    (q7208500-r-multiply
     real
     (q7208500-natural-cast real n)
     (q7208500-natural-factorial-value real (1- n)))))

(defun q7208500-binomial-coefficient (n k)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (or (not (natp n))
          (not (natp k)))
      0
    (if (zp k)
        1
      (if (zp n)
          0
        (+ (q7208500-binomial-coefficient (1- n) k)
           (q7208500-binomial-coefficient
            (1- n) (1- k)))))))

;; The standard real exponential is the limit of sum_{j=0}^n x^j/j!.

(defun q7208500-exponential-partial-sum (real value n)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q7208500-r-one real)
    (q7208500-r-add
     real
     (q7208500-exponential-partial-sum
      real value (1- n))
     (q7208500-r-divide
      real
      (q7208500-natural-power real value n)
      (q7208500-natural-factorial-value real n)))))

(defun-sk q7208500-exponential-tail-close-p
    (real argument value epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q7208500-r-less
      real
      (q7208500-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q7208500-r-subtract
        real
        (q7208500-exponential-partial-sum
         real argument n)
        value))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q7208500-exponential-cutoff-exists-p
    (real argument value epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q7208500-exponential-tail-close-p
      real argument value epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q7208500-exponential-limit-p
    (real argument value)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q7208500-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q7208500-exponential-cutoff-exists-p
      real argument value epsilon))))

(defun-sk q7208500-standard-exponential-p (real)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7208500-r-member-p real x)
     (and
      (q7208500-r-positive-p
       real (q7208500-r-exponential real x))
      (q7208500-exponential-limit-p
       real x (q7208500-r-exponential real x))))))

;; Arbitrary real sequences and the source hypothesis n * p(n) -> r.

(defun-sk q7208500-sequence-typed-p (real sequence)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (natp n)
     (q7208500-r-member-p
      real (q7208500-sequence-value sequence n)))))

(defun q7208500-scaled-sequence-value
    (real sequence n)
  (q7208500-r-multiply
   real
   (q7208500-natural-cast real n)
   (q7208500-sequence-value sequence n)))

(defun-sk q7208500-scaled-tail-p
    (real sequence limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q7208500-r-less
      real
      (q7208500-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q7208500-r-subtract
        real
        (q7208500-scaled-sequence-value
         real sequence n)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q7208500-scaled-cutoff-exists-p
    (real sequence limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q7208500-scaled-tail-p
      real sequence limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q7208500-scaled-limit-p
    (real sequence limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q7208500-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q7208500-scaled-cutoff-exists-p
      real sequence limit epsilon))))

;; The exact binomial term
;; choose(n,k) * p(n)^k * (1-p(n))^(n-k), with truncated natural subtraction.

(defun q7208500-binomial-term
    (real sequence k n)
  (let* ((probability (q7208500-sequence-value sequence n))
         (one-minus-probability
          (q7208500-r-subtract
           real (q7208500-r-one real) probability))
         (choose-value
          (q7208500-natural-cast
           real (q7208500-binomial-coefficient n k)))
         (probability-power
          (q7208500-natural-power real probability k))
         (complement-power
          (q7208500-natural-power
           real
           one-minus-probability
           (nfix (- n k)))))
    (q7208500-r-multiply
     real
     (q7208500-r-multiply
      real choose-value probability-power)
     complement-power)))

(defun-sk q7208500-binomial-tail-p
    (real sequence k limit epsilon cutoff)
  (forall (n)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp n)
      (natp cutoff)
      (<= cutoff n))
     (q7208500-r-less
      real
      (q7208500-r-absolute-value
       real
       (q7208500-r-subtract
        real
        (q7208500-binomial-term
         real sequence k n)
        limit))
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q7208500-binomial-cutoff-exists-p
    (real sequence k limit epsilon)
  (exists (cutoff)
    (and
     (natp cutoff)
     (q7208500-binomial-tail-p
      real sequence k limit epsilon cutoff))))

(defun-sk q7208500-binomial-limit-p
    (real sequence k limit)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q7208500-r-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q7208500-binomial-cutoff-exists-p
      real sequence k limit epsilon))))

(defun q7208500-poisson-limit-value (real r k)
  (q7208500-r-divide
   real
   (q7208500-r-multiply
    real
    (q7208500-r-exponential
     real (q7208500-r-negate real r))
    (q7208500-natural-power real r k))
   (q7208500-natural-factorial-value real k)))

(defun-sk thousand-theorems-q7208500-poisson-limit-theorem-statement ()
  (forall (real sequence r k)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7208500-real-field-p real)
      (q7208500-standard-exponential-p real)
      (natp k)
      (q7208500-r-member-p real r)
      (q7208500-sequence-typed-p real sequence)
      (q7208500-scaled-limit-p real sequence r))
     (q7208500-binomial-limit-p
      real
      sequence
      k
      (q7208500-poisson-limit-value real r k)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7208500
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q7208500), "Poisson limit theorem": if n * p(n)
-- converges to r, then the corresponding binomial mass expression converges
-- to exp(-r) * r^k / k!. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _-_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ :
  {A : Set} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=N   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=sucN : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R ->
      R ->
      R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R ->
      R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R ->
      R ->
      Set

    fromNatR :
      Nat ->
      R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR

    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR

    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x

    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))

    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)

    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)

    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat
        (\ n ->
          lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

natCast :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Nat ->
  R
natCast reals =
  fromNatR reals

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

powerR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
powerR reals x zero =
  oneR reals
powerR reals x (suc n) =
  multiplyR reals (powerR reals x n) x

factorial : Nat -> Nat
factorial zero =
  suc zero
factorial (suc n) =
  suc n * factorial n

choose : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
choose n zero =
  suc zero
choose zero (suc k) =
  zero
choose (suc n) (suc k) =
  choose n k + choose n (suc k)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit {R = R} reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

exponentialTerm :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialTerm reals x n =
  divideR reals
    (powerR reals x n)
    (natCast reals (factorial n))

exponentialPartialSum :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
exponentialPartialSum reals x zero =
  zeroR reals
exponentialPartialSum reals x (suc n) =
  addR reals
    (exponentialPartialSum reals x n)
    (exponentialTerm reals x n)

record StandardExponential
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    exponential :
      R ->
      R

    exponential-series :
      (x : R) ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (exponentialPartialSum reals x)
        (exponential x)

open StandardExponential

scaledParameterSequence :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
scaledParameterSequence reals p n =
  multiplyR reals
    (natCast reals n)
    (p n)

binomialMassExpression :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  R
binomialMassExpression reals p k n =
  multiplyR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (natCast reals (choose n k))
      (powerR reals (p n) k))
    (powerR reals
      (subtractR reals (oneR reals) (p n))
      (n - k))

poissonLimitValue :
  {R : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  StandardExponential reals ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
poissonLimitValue {reals = reals} analysis r k =
  divideR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (exponential analysis (negateR reals r))
      (powerR reals r k))
    (natCast reals (factorial k))

poisson-limit-theorem : Set1
poisson-limit-theorem =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (analysis : StandardExponential reals) ->
  (p : Nat -> R) ->
  (r : R) ->
  (k : Nat) ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (scaledParameterSequence reals p)
    r ->
  SequentialLimit reals
    (binomialMassExpression reals p k)
    (poissonLimitValue analysis r k)

title: Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q7208500 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q7208500), "Poisson limit theorem":
  for a fixed natural number k and any real sequence p such that n * p n
  converges to r, the corresponding binomial term converges to
  exp (-r) * r^k / k!. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory combinatoricsTheory realTheory transcTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory;

val poisson_limit_theorem =
  ``!k : num. !p : num -> real. !r : real.
      (((\n : num. (&n : real) * p n) --> (r : real)) sequentially)
      ==>
      (((\n : num.
          (&(binomial n k) : real) * (p n) pow k *
          (1 - p n) pow (n - k)) -->
        (exp (-r) * (r pow k) / (&(FACT k) : real)))
       sequentially)``;

title: Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7208500
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7208500), "Poisson limit theorem": for each
  fixed nonnegative integer k, if the real sequence n * p(n) tends to r, then
  the kth binomial-probability term tends to exp(-r) * r^k / k!. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  NN0 and RR are SetMM's nonnegative integers and real numbers. The relation
  ~~>t for the usual real topology is convergence of an NN0-indexed sequence,
  exactly the source's Tendsto along atTop.

  SetMM's infix subtraction is ordinary real subtraction, so the exponent is
  written conditionally to preserve Lean's natural-number truncated
  subtraction: it is n - k when k <= n and zero otherwise. The binomial
  coefficient n _C k, factorial ! ` k, real exponential, powers, products,
  and quotient therefore reproduce the source terms exactly.

  The following declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. This
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

${
  $d k n p r $.

  thousand-theorems-metamath-q7208500-poisson-limit-theorem $a |-
    A. p e. ( RR ^m NN0 )
      A. r e. RR
        A. k e. NN0
          (
            (
              n e. NN0 |->
                ( n x. ( p ` n ) )
            )
            ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
            r
            ->
            (
              n e. NN0 |->
                (
                  (
                    ( n _C k )
                    x.
                    ( ( p ` n ) ^ k )
                  )
                  x.
                  (
                    ( 1 - ( p ` n ) )
                    ^
                    if ( k <_ n , ( n - k ) , 0 )
                  )
                )
            )
            ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
            (
              (
                ( exp ` ( -u r ) )
                x.
                ( r ^ k )
              )
              /
              ( ! ` k )
            )
          )
  $.
$}
