title: Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7208500,
% "Poisson limit theorem": if n * p(n) converges to r, then the fixed-k binomial
% mass term converges to exp(-r) * r^k / k!. This file contains no proof.

Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]

  safe_div(numerator, denominator: real): real =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      numerator / denominator
    ENDIF

  factorial(index: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF index = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      index * factorial(index - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE index

  binomial_coefficient(n, k: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF k = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSIF n = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k - 1)
        + binomial_coefficient(n - 1, k)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  converges_to(sequence: real_sequence, value: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(sequence(index) - value) < epsilon_value

  exponential_partial(x: real, count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      LET index: nat = count - 1 IN
        exponential_partial(x, count - 1)
          + safe_div(
              x ^ index,
              factorial(index) :: real)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  real_exponential(x: real): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (count: nat):
            exponential_partial(x, count),
          value))

  poisson_limit_term(
      p: real_sequence,
      k, n: nat): real =
    (binomial_coefficient(n, k) :: real)
      * p(n) ^ k
      * (1 - p(n)) ^ (n - k)

  poisson_limit_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (p: real_sequence),
        (r: real),
        (k: nat):
      converges_to(
        LAMBDA (n: nat):
          (n :: real) * p(n),
        r)
      IMPLIES
        converges_to(
          LAMBDA (n: nat):
            poisson_limit_term(p, k, n),
          safe_div(
            real_exponential(-r) * r ^ k,
            factorial(k) :: real))
END Q7208500_poisson_limit_theorem

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7249519
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q7249519), "Prokhorov's theorem": finite Borel
  measures with uniformly bounded mass and uniformly vanishing mass outside
  compact sets form a compact set in the weak topology, assuming normality of
  the space or monotonicity of the compact sets. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q7249519_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q7249519_empty {A : Type} : q7249519_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q7249519_full {A : Type} : q7249519_set A :=
  fun _ => True.

Definition q7249519_complement {A : Type}
    (S : q7249519_set A) : q7249519_set A :=
  fun x => ~ S x.

Definition q7249519_intersection {A : Type}
    (S T : q7249519_set A) : q7249519_set A :=
  fun x => S x /\ T x.

Definition q7249519_countable_union {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q7249519_set A) : q7249519_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, S n x.

Definition q7249519_arbitrary_union {A : Type}
    (F : q7249519_set (q7249519_set A)) : q7249519_set A :=
  fun x => exists S : q7249519_set A, F S /\ S x.

Definition q7249519_same_set {A : Type}
    (S T : q7249519_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x <-> T x.

Definition q7249519_subset {A : Type}
    (S T : q7249519_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Definition q7249519_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S T : q7249519_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, ~ (S x /\ T x).

Definition q7249519_pairwise_disjoint {A : Type}
    (S : nat -> q7249519_set A) : Prop :=
  forall i j : nat, i <> j ->
    q7249519_disjoint (S i) (S j).

Record q7249519_topological_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q7249519_is_open : q7249519_set E -> Prop;
  q7249519_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_same_set U V ->
      (q7249519_is_open U <-> q7249519_is_open V);
  q7249519_open_full :
    q7249519_is_open q7249519_full;
  q7249519_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_is_open U ->
      q7249519_is_open V ->
      q7249519_is_open (q7249519_intersection U V);
  q7249519_open_arbitrary_union :
    forall F : q7249519_set (q7249519_set E),
      (forall U : q7249519_set E, F U -> q7249519_is_open U) ->
      q7249519_is_open (q7249519_arbitrary_union F)
}.

Arguments q7249519_is_open {E} _ _.

Definition q7249519_is_closed {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    (S : q7249519_set E) : Prop :=
  q7249519_is_open T (q7249519_complement S).

Definition q7249519_t2_space {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E) : Prop :=
  forall x y : E,
    x <> y ->
    exists U V : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_is_open T U /\
      q7249519_is_open T V /\
      U x /\ V y /\
      q7249519_disjoint U V.

Definition q7249519_normal_space {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E) : Prop :=
  forall A B : q7249519_set E,
    q7249519_is_closed T A ->
    q7249519_is_closed T B ->
    q7249519_disjoint A B ->
    exists U V : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_is_open T U /\
      q7249519_is_open T V /\
      q7249519_subset A U /\
      q7249519_subset B V /\
      q7249519_disjoint U V.

Record q7249519_measurable_space (E : Type) : Type := {
  q7249519_measurable : q7249519_set E -> Prop;
  q7249519_measurable_extensional :
    forall A B : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_same_set A B ->
      (q7249519_measurable A <-> q7249519_measurable B);
  q7249519_measurable_empty :
    q7249519_measurable q7249519_empty;
  q7249519_measurable_complement :
    forall A : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_measurable A ->
      q7249519_measurable (q7249519_complement A);
  q7249519_measurable_countable_union :
    forall A : nat -> q7249519_set E,
      (forall n : nat, q7249519_measurable (A n)) ->
      q7249519_measurable (q7249519_countable_union A)
}.

Arguments q7249519_measurable {E} _ _.

Definition q7249519_sigma_class {E : Type}
    (C : q7249519_set (q7249519_set E)) : Prop :=
  C q7249519_empty /\
  (forall A : q7249519_set E,
    C A -> C (q7249519_complement A)) /\
  (forall A : nat -> q7249519_set E,
    (forall n : nat, C (A n)) ->
    C (q7249519_countable_union A)).

Definition q7249519_borel_set {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    (A : q7249519_set E) : Prop :=
  forall C : q7249519_set (q7249519_set E),
    q7249519_sigma_class C ->
    (forall U : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_is_open T U -> C U) ->
    C A.

Definition q7249519_borel_space {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    (M : q7249519_measurable_space E) : Prop :=
  forall A : q7249519_set E,
    q7249519_measurable M A <->
    q7249519_borel_set T A.

Definition q7249519_is_compact {A : Type}
    (is_open : q7249519_set A -> Prop)
    (K : q7249519_set A) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q7249519_set (q7249519_set A),
    (forall U : q7249519_set A, cover U -> is_open U) ->
    (forall x : A,
      K x ->
      exists U : q7249519_set A, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q7249519_set A),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : A,
        K x ->
        exists U : q7249519_set A,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Record q7249519_nnreal : Type := {
  q7249519_nnreal_value : R;
  q7249519_nnreal_nonnegative :
    0 <= q7249519_nnreal_value
}.

Definition q7249519_tends_to_zero
    (u : nat -> q7249519_nnreal) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        q7249519_nnreal_value (u n) < epsilon.

Fixpoint q7249519_sum_first
    (n : nat) (f : nat -> R) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => 0
  | S k => q7249519_sum_first k f + f k
  end.

Definition q7249519_sequence_converges
    (f : nat -> R) (limit : R) : Prop :=
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists N : nat,
      forall n : nat,
        (N <= n)%nat ->
        Rabs (f n - limit) < epsilon.

Definition q7249519_series_sum
    (f : nat -> R) (sum : R) : Prop :=
  q7249519_sequence_converges
    (fun n => q7249519_sum_first n f) sum.

Definition q7249519_infimum
    (values : R -> Prop) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  (forall value : R, values value -> bound <= value) /\
  (forall lower : R,
    (forall value : R, values value -> lower <= value) ->
    lower <= bound).

Record q7249519_finite_measure
    (E : Type) (M : q7249519_measurable_space E) : Type := {
  q7249519_measure : q7249519_set E -> R;
  q7249519_measure_extensional :
    forall A B : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_same_set A B ->
      q7249519_measure A = q7249519_measure B;
  q7249519_measure_nonnegative :
    forall A : q7249519_set E,
      0 <= q7249519_measure A;
  q7249519_measure_empty :
    q7249519_measure q7249519_empty = 0;
  q7249519_measure_monotone :
    forall A B : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_subset A B ->
      q7249519_measure A <= q7249519_measure B;
  q7249519_measure_trimmed :
    forall A : q7249519_set E,
      q7249519_infimum
        (fun value : R =>
          exists B : q7249519_set E,
            q7249519_measurable M B /\
            q7249519_subset A B /\
            value = q7249519_measure B)
        (q7249519_measure A);
  q7249519_measure_countable_additive :
    forall A : nat -> q7249519_set E,
      (forall n : nat, q7249519_measurable M (A n)) ->
      q7249519_pairwise_disjoint A ->
      q7249519_series_sum
        (fun n => q7249519_measure (A n))
        (q7249519_measure (q7249519_countable_union A))
}.

Arguments q7249519_finite_measure E M : clear implicits.
Arguments q7249519_measure {E M} _ _.

Definition q7249519_mass {E : Type}
    {M : q7249519_measurable_space E}
    (mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M) : R :=
  q7249519_measure mu q7249519_full.

Definition q7249519_real_open
    (U : q7249519_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q7249519_continuous {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    (f : E -> R) : Prop :=
  forall U : q7249519_set R,
    q7249519_real_open U ->
    q7249519_is_open T
      (fun x : E => U (f x)).

Definition q7249519_bounded
    {E : Type} (f : E -> R) : Prop :=
  exists bound : R,
    0 <= bound /\
    forall x : E, Rabs (f x) <= bound.

Definition q7249519_bounded_continuous {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    (f : E -> R) : Prop :=
  q7249519_continuous T f /\
  q7249519_bounded f.

Definition q7249519_finite_partition {E : Type}
    (M : q7249519_measurable_space E)
    (k : nat) (cells : nat -> q7249519_set E) : Prop :=
  (0 < k)%nat /\
  (forall i : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    q7249519_measurable M (cells i)) /\
  (forall i j : nat,
    (i < k)%nat ->
    (j < k)%nat ->
    i <> j ->
    q7249519_disjoint (cells i) (cells j)) /\
  (forall x : E,
    exists i : nat, (i < k)%nat /\ cells i x).

Definition q7249519_simple_integral_below {E : Type}
    {M : q7249519_measurable_space E}
    (mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M)
    (f : E -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists (k : nat) (coefficients : nat -> R)
         (cells : nat -> q7249519_set E),
    q7249519_finite_partition M k cells /\
    (forall i : nat,
      (i < k)%nat -> 0 <= coefficients i) /\
    (forall (x : E) (i : nat),
      (i < k)%nat ->
      cells i x ->
      coefficients i <= f x) /\
    value =
      q7249519_sum_first k
        (fun i =>
          coefficients i * q7249519_measure mu (cells i)).

Definition q7249519_supremum
    (values : R -> Prop) (bound : R) : Prop :=
  (forall value : R, values value -> value <= bound) /\
  (forall upper : R,
    (forall value : R, values value -> value <= upper) ->
    bound <= upper).

Definition q7249519_nonnegative_integral {E : Type}
    {M : q7249519_measurable_space E}
    (mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M)
    (f : E -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  q7249519_supremum
    (q7249519_simple_integral_below mu f) value.

Definition q7249519_positive_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax x 0.

Definition q7249519_negative_part (x : R) : R :=
  Rmax (- x) 0.

Definition q7249519_integral {E : Type}
    {M : q7249519_measurable_space E}
    (mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M)
    (f : E -> R) (value : R) : Prop :=
  exists positive_integral negative_integral : R,
    q7249519_nonnegative_integral mu
      (fun x => q7249519_positive_part (f x))
      positive_integral /\
    q7249519_nonnegative_integral mu
      (fun x => q7249519_negative_part (f x))
      negative_integral /\
    value = positive_integral - negative_integral.

Definition q7249519_weak_basic_neighborhood {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    {M : q7249519_measurable_space E}
    (center : q7249519_finite_measure E M)
    (tests : list (E -> R)) (epsilon : R)
    (mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M) : Prop :=
  0 < epsilon /\
  Forall (q7249519_bounded_continuous T) tests /\
  forall f : E -> R,
    In f tests ->
    exists center_value mu_value : R,
      q7249519_integral center f center_value /\
      q7249519_integral mu f mu_value /\
      Rabs (mu_value - center_value) < epsilon.

Definition q7249519_weak_is_open {E : Type}
    (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
    (M : q7249519_measurable_space E)
    (U : q7249519_set (q7249519_finite_measure E M)) : Prop :=
  forall mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M,
    U mu ->
    exists (tests : list (E -> R)) (epsilon : R),
      q7249519_weak_basic_neighborhood
        T mu tests epsilon mu /\
      forall nu : q7249519_finite_measure E M,
        q7249519_weak_basic_neighborhood
          T mu tests epsilon nu ->
        U nu.

Definition q7249519_monotone_sets {E : Type}
    (K : nat -> q7249519_set E) : Prop :=
  forall m n : nat,
    (m <= n)%nat ->
    q7249519_subset (K m) (K n).

Theorem q7249519_prokhorov :
  forall (E : Type)
         (T : q7249519_topological_space E)
         (M : q7249519_measurable_space E)
         (u : nat -> q7249519_nnreal)
         (K : nat -> q7249519_set E)
         (C : q7249519_nnreal),
    q7249519_t2_space T ->
    q7249519_borel_space T M ->
    q7249519_tends_to_zero u ->
    (forall n : nat,
      q7249519_is_compact
        (q7249519_is_open T) (K n)) ->
    (q7249519_normal_space T \/
     q7249519_monotone_sets K) ->
    q7249519_is_compact
      (@q7249519_weak_is_open E T M)
      (fun mu : q7249519_finite_measure E M =>
        q7249519_mass mu <= q7249519_nnreal_value C /\
        forall n : nat,
          q7249519_measure mu
              (q7249519_complement (K n))
            <= q7249519_nnreal_value (u n)).
Admitted.

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7249519
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7249519), "Prokhorov's theorem": on an
  arbitrary Hausdorff Borel space, finite measures with uniformly bounded mass
  and uniformly vanishing mass outside compact sets form a compact set in the
  weak topology, assuming normality or monotonicity of the compact sets. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
  imports
    "HOL-Analysis.Abstract_Topological_Spaces"
    "HOL-Analysis.Bochner_Integration"
begin

definition q7249519_finite_borel_measures ::
    "'a::topological_space measure set"
  where
    "q7249519_finite_borel_measures =
      {M. sets M = sets borel \<and> finite_measure M}"

definition q7249519_bounded_continuous ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7249519_bounded_continuous f \<longleftrightarrow>
      bounded (range f) \<and> continuous_on UNIV f"

definition q7249519_weak_topology ::
    "'a::topological_space measure topology"
  where
    "q7249519_weak_topology =
      topology_generated_by
        {{M \<in> q7249519_finite_borel_measures.
            integral\<^sup>L M f \<in> U}
          |f U. q7249519_bounded_continuous f \<and> open U}"

theorem prokhorov_s_theorem:
  fixes C :: real
    and u :: "nat \<Rightarrow> real"
    and K :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::t2_space set"
  assumes C_nonnegative: "0 \<le> C"
    and u_nonnegative: "\<And>n. 0 \<le> u n"
    and u_tendsto_zero: "u \<longlonglongrightarrow> 0"
    and K_compact: "\<And>n. compact (K n)"
    and normal_or_monotone:
      "normal_space (euclidean :: 'a topology) \<or> mono K"
  shows
    "compactin q7249519_weak_topology
      {M \<in> q7249519_finite_borel_measures.
        measure M UNIV \<le> C \<and>
        (\<forall>n. measure M (- K n) \<le> u n)}"
  sorry

end

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7249519,
  "Prokhorov's theorem": on an arbitrary possibly empty Hausdorff Borel space,
  finite measures of bounded mass whose masses outside a sequence of compact
  sets are bounded by a nonnegative sequence tending to zero form a compact
  set in the weak topology, provided the space is normal or the compact sets
  are monotone. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q7249519_PROKHOROVS_THEOREM =
 `let sequence_tends =
      \(a:num->real) (l:real).
        !epsilon:real.
          &0 < epsilon
          ==> ?N:num.
                !n:num. N <= n ==> abs(a n - l) < epsilon in
   let topology =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
        opens {} /\
        opens carrier /\
        (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> u SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!collection:(A->bool)->bool.
           (!u:A->bool. u IN collection ==> opens u)
           ==> opens (UNIONS collection)) /\
        (!u v:A->bool.
           opens u /\ opens v ==> opens (u INTER v)) in
   let closed_set =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool).
        s SUBSET carrier /\ opens (carrier DIFF s) in
   let compact_set =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool).
        s SUBSET carrier /\
        !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> opens u) /\
          s SUBSET UNIONS cover
          ==> ?subcover:(A->bool)->bool.
                subcover SUBSET cover /\
                FINITE subcover /\
                s SUBSET UNIONS subcover in
   let hausdorff_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
        !x y:A.
          x IN carrier /\
          y IN carrier /\
          ~(x = y)
          ==> ?u v:A->bool.
                opens u /\
                opens v /\
                x IN u /\
                y IN v /\
                DISJOINT u v in
   let normal_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (opens:(A->bool)->bool).
        !s t:A->bool.
          closed_set carrier opens s /\
          closed_set carrier opens t /\
          DISJOINT s t
          ==> ?u v:A->bool.
                opens u /\
                opens v /\
                s SUBSET u /\
                t SUBSET v /\
                DISJOINT u v in
   let sigma_algebra =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:A->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n:num. x IN sets n}) in
   let borel_space =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> events u) /\
        (!candidate:(A->bool)->bool.
           sigma_algebra carrier candidate /\
           (!u:A->bool. opens u ==> candidate u)
           ==> !s:A->bool. events s ==> candidate s) in
   let finite_measure =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool) (mu:(A->bool)->real).
        sigma_algebra carrier events /\
        mu {} = &0 /\
        (!s:A->bool. &0 <= mu s) /\
        (!s:A->bool. ~(events s) ==> mu s = &0) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n:num. events (sets n)) /\
           (!m n:num. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (sets m) (sets n))
           ==> sequence_tends
                 (\N:num. sum {k:num | k < N} (\k. mu (sets k)))
                 (mu {x:A | ?k:num. x IN sets k})) in
   let real_open =
      \(v:real->bool).
        !x:real.
          x IN v
          ==> ?epsilon:real.
                &0 < epsilon /\
                !y:real. abs(y - x) < epsilon ==> y IN v in
   let continuous_real =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real).
        !v:real->bool.
          real_open v
          ==> opens {x:A | x IN carrier /\ h x IN v} in
   let bounded_continuous_nonnegative =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool) (h:A->real).
        continuous_real carrier opens h /\
        (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= h x) /\
        ?bound:real. !x:A. x IN carrier ==> h x <= bound in
   let simple_nonnegative =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->real).
        (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> &0 <= s x) /\
        FINITE (IMAGE s carrier) /\
        (!c:real. events {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let simple_integral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->real) (s:A->real).
        sum (IMAGE s carrier)
          (\c:real. c * mu {x:A | x IN carrier /\ s x = c}) in
   let lintegral_upper =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real) (upper:real).
        !s:A->real.
          simple_nonnegative carrier events s /\
          (!x:A. x IN carrier ==> s x <= h x)
          ==> simple_integral carrier mu s <= upper in
   let has_lintegral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real) (z:real).
        &0 <= z /\
        lintegral_upper carrier events mu h z /\
        (!upper:real.
           &0 <= upper /\
           lintegral_upper carrier events mu h upper
           ==> z <= upper) in
   let lintegral =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (mu:(A->bool)->real) (h:A->real).
        @z:real. has_lintegral carrier events mu h z in
   let measure_topology =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (measure_opens:(((A->bool)->real)->bool)->bool).
        measure_opens {} /\
        measure_opens
          {mu:(A->bool)->real |
             finite_measure carrier events mu} /\
        (!u:((A->bool)->real)->bool.
           measure_opens u
           ==> u SUBSET
               {mu:(A->bool)->real |
                  finite_measure carrier events mu}) /\
        (!collection:(((A->bool)->real)->bool)->bool.
           (!u:((A->bool)->real)->bool.
              u IN collection ==> measure_opens u)
           ==> measure_opens (UNIONS collection)) /\
        (!u v:((A->bool)->real)->bool.
           measure_opens u /\ measure_opens v
           ==> measure_opens (u INTER v)) in
   let contains_weak_subbasis =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (measure_opens:(((A->bool)->real)->bool)->bool).
        !h:A->real. !v:real->bool.
          bounded_continuous_nonnegative carrier opens h /\
          real_open v
          ==> measure_opens
                {mu:(A->bool)->real |
                   finite_measure carrier events mu /\
                   lintegral carrier events mu h IN v} in
   let weak_open =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (u:((A->bool)->real)->bool).
        !measure_opens:(((A->bool)->real)->bool)->bool.
          measure_topology carrier events measure_opens /\
          contains_weak_subbasis
            carrier opens events measure_opens
          ==> measure_opens u in
   let compact_measure_set =
      \(carrier:A->bool)
       (opens:(A->bool)->bool)
       (events:(A->bool)->bool)
       (s:((A->bool)->real)->bool).
        s SUBSET
          {mu:(A->bool)->real |
             finite_measure carrier events mu} /\
        !cover:(((A->bool)->real)->bool)->bool.
          (!u:((A->bool)->real)->bool.
             u IN cover ==> weak_open carrier opens events u) /\
          s SUBSET UNIONS cover
          ==> ?subcover:(((A->bool)->real)->bool)->bool.
                subcover SUBSET cover /\
                FINITE subcover /\
                s SUBSET UNIONS subcover in
   !carrier:A->bool
    opens:(A->bool)->bool
    events:(A->bool)->bool
    u:num->real
    K:num->A->bool
    C:real.
      topology carrier opens /\
      hausdorff_space carrier opens /\
      borel_space carrier opens events /\
      &0 <= C /\
      (!n:num. &0 <= u n) /\
      sequence_tends u (&0) /\
      (!n:num. compact_set carrier opens (K n)) /\
      (normal_space carrier opens \/
       (!m n:num. m <= n ==> K m SUBSET K n))
      ==>
      compact_measure_set carrier opens events
        {mu:(A->bool)->real |
           finite_measure carrier events mu /\
           mu carrier <= C /\
           !n:num. mu (carrier DIFF K n) <= u n}`;;

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7249519,
;; "Prokhorov's theorem": on an arbitrary Hausdorff Borel space, finite
;; measures with uniformly bounded mass and uniformly vanishing tails outside
;; compact sets form a compact set in the weak topology, under normality or a
;; monotone compact exhaustion. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; The conservative interfaces below range over arbitrary carriers, sets,
;; families, functions, sequences, and measures.  Their explicit laws present
;; the complete ordered real field, topology, Borel sigma algebra, finite
;; measures, exact bounded Lebesgue integration, and the generated weak
;; topology used in the source statement.  No carrier, set, function, cover,
;; or measure family is restricted to a finite table.

(defstub q7249519-member-p (type object) t)
(defstub q7249519-set-member-p (set object) t)
(defstub q7249519-family-member-p (family set) t)
(defstub q7249519-function-at (function argument) t)
(defstub q7249519-sequence-at (sequence index) t)

(defstub q7249519-zero (real) t)
(defstub q7249519-one (real) t)
(defstub q7249519-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q7249519-multiply (real left right) t)
(defstub q7249519-negate (real value) t)
(defstub q7249519-inverse (real value) t)
(defstub q7249519-less (real left right) t)

(defstub q7249519-empty-set (type) t)
(defstub q7249519-full-set (type) t)
(defstub q7249519-complement-set (type set) t)
(defstub q7249519-intersection-set (type left right) t)
(defstub q7249519-union-set (type family) t)
(defstub q7249519-countable-union-set (type sequence) t)
(defstub q7249519-preimage-set (domain function codomain-set) t)
(defstub q7249519-fiber-set (domain function value) t)

(defstub q7249519-measure-value (measure set) t)
(defstub q7249519-lintegral-value (measure function) t)
(defstub q7249519-positive-part-function (real function) t)
(defstub q7249519-negative-part-function (real function) t)

(defstub q7249519-finite-measure-type (real space measurable) t)
(defstub q7249519-integral-preimage-set
  (real space topology measurable function real-open-set) t)
(defstub q7249519-prokhorov-target-set
  (real space measurable u compact-sequence mass-bound) t)

(defun q7249519-leq (real left right)
  (not (q7249519-less real right left)))

(defun q7249519-positive-p (real value)
  (and
   (q7249519-member-p real value)
   (q7249519-less real (q7249519-zero real) value)))

(defun q7249519-nonnegative-p (real value)
  (and
   (q7249519-member-p real value)
   (q7249519-leq real (q7249519-zero real) value)))

(defun q7249519-subtract (real left right)
  (q7249519-add real left (q7249519-negate real right)))

(defun q7249519-absolute-value (real value)
  (if (q7249519-less real value (q7249519-zero real))
      (q7249519-negate real value)
    value))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field presents the real numbers.

(defun-sk q7249519-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p real x)
      (q7249519-member-p real y)
      (q7249519-member-p real z))
     (let ((zero (q7249519-zero real))
           (one (q7249519-one real)))
       (and
        (q7249519-member-p real (q7249519-add real x y))
        (q7249519-member-p real (q7249519-multiply real x y))
        (q7249519-member-p real (q7249519-negate real x))
        (q7249519-member-p real (q7249519-inverse real x))
        (equal
         (q7249519-add real (q7249519-add real x y) z)
         (q7249519-add real x (q7249519-add real y z)))
        (equal (q7249519-add real x y)
               (q7249519-add real y x))
        (equal (q7249519-add real x zero) x)
        (equal
         (q7249519-add real x (q7249519-negate real x))
         zero)
        (equal
         (q7249519-multiply
          real (q7249519-multiply real x y) z)
         (q7249519-multiply
          real x (q7249519-multiply real y z)))
        (equal (q7249519-multiply real x y)
               (q7249519-multiply real y x))
        (equal (q7249519-multiply real x one) x)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q7249519-multiply
           real x (q7249519-inverse real x))
          one))
        (equal
         (q7249519-multiply
          real x (q7249519-add real y z))
         (q7249519-add
          real
          (q7249519-multiply real x y)
          (q7249519-multiply real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q7249519-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p real x)
      (q7249519-member-p real y)
      (q7249519-member-p real z))
     (and
      (not (q7249519-less real x x))
      (or (equal x y)
          (q7249519-less real x y)
          (q7249519-less real y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q7249519-less real x y)
        (q7249519-less real y z))
       (q7249519-less real x z))
      (implies
       (q7249519-less real x y)
       (q7249519-less
        real
        (q7249519-add real x z)
        (q7249519-add real y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q7249519-less real (q7249519-zero real) x)
        (q7249519-less real (q7249519-zero real) y))
       (q7249519-less
        real
        (q7249519-zero real)
        (q7249519-multiply real x y)))))))

(defun-sk q7249519-real-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (value)
    (and
     (q7249519-member-p real value)
     (q7249519-set-member-p set value))))

(defun-sk q7249519-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p real value)
      (q7249519-set-member-p set value))
     (q7249519-leq real value bound))))

(defun-sk q7249519-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q7249519-member-p real bound)
     (q7249519-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q7249519-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q7249519-member-p real supremum)
     (q7249519-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q7249519-member-p real bound)
       (q7249519-upper-bound-p real set bound))
      (q7249519-leq real supremum bound)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q7249519-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q7249519-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-real-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q7249519-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q7249519-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q7249519-real-structure-p (real)
  (and
   (q7249519-member-p real (q7249519-zero real))
   (q7249519-member-p real (q7249519-one real))
   (not (equal (q7249519-zero real)
               (q7249519-one real)))
   (q7249519-field-laws-p real)
   (q7249519-order-laws-p real)
   (q7249519-less
    real (q7249519-zero real) (q7249519-one real))
   (q7249519-dedekind-complete-p real)))

;; Arbitrary sets, set families, and their extensional constructors.

(defun-sk q7249519-valid-set-p (type set)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-set-member-p set object)
     (q7249519-member-p type object))))

(defun-sk q7249519-set-equiv-p (type left right)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p type object)
     (iff
      (q7249519-set-member-p left object)
      (q7249519-set-member-p right object)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-set-subset-p (type left right)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p type object)
      (q7249519-set-member-p left object))
     (q7249519-set-member-p right object))))

(defun-sk q7249519-family-valid-p (type family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7249519-family-member-p family set)
     (q7249519-valid-set-p type set))))

(defun-sk q7249519-family-extensional-p (type family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-valid-set-p type left)
      (q7249519-valid-set-p type right)
      (q7249519-set-equiv-p type left right))
     (iff
      (q7249519-family-member-p family left)
      (q7249519-family-member-p family right)))))

(defun q7249519-family-of-sets-p (type family)
  (and
   (q7249519-family-valid-p type family)
   (q7249519-family-extensional-p type family)))

(defun-sk q7249519-union-member-p (family object)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q7249519-family-member-p family set)
     (q7249519-set-member-p set object))))

(defun-sk q7249519-countable-union-member-p (sequence object)
  (exists (index)
    (and
     (natp index)
     (q7249519-set-member-p
      (q7249519-sequence-at sequence index)
      object))))

(defun-sk q7249519-set-constructor-laws-p (type)
  (forall (object left right family sequence function codomain-set value)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p type object)
     (and
      (not
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-empty-set type) object))
      (q7249519-set-member-p
       (q7249519-full-set type) object)
      (iff
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-complement-set type left) object)
       (not (q7249519-set-member-p left object)))
      (iff
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-intersection-set type left right)
        object)
       (and
        (q7249519-set-member-p left object)
        (q7249519-set-member-p right object)))
      (iff
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-union-set type family) object)
       (q7249519-union-member-p family object))
      (iff
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-countable-union-set type sequence)
        object)
       (q7249519-countable-union-member-p sequence object))
      (iff
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-preimage-set
         type function codomain-set)
        object)
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        codomain-set
        (q7249519-function-at function object)))
      (iff
       (q7249519-set-member-p
        (q7249519-fiber-set type function value)
        object)
       (equal
        (q7249519-function-at function object)
        value))))))

;; Topological spaces, compact sets, Hausdorffness, and normality.

(defun q7249519-open-set-p (type topology set)
  (and
   (q7249519-valid-set-p type set)
   (q7249519-family-member-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q7249519-open-family-p (type topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7249519-family-member-p family set)
     (q7249519-open-set-p type topology set))))

(defun-sk q7249519-topology-intersections-p (type topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-open-set-p type topology left)
      (q7249519-open-set-p type topology right))
     (q7249519-open-set-p
      type topology
      (q7249519-intersection-set type left right)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-topology-unions-p (type topology)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-family-of-sets-p type family)
      (q7249519-open-family-p type topology family))
     (q7249519-open-set-p
      type topology
      (q7249519-union-set type family)))))

(defun q7249519-topological-space-p (type topology)
  (and
   (q7249519-family-of-sets-p type topology)
   (q7249519-open-set-p
    type topology (q7249519-empty-set type))
   (q7249519-open-set-p
    type topology (q7249519-full-set type))
   (q7249519-topology-intersections-p type topology)
   (q7249519-topology-unions-p type topology)))

(defun q7249519-closed-set-p (type topology set)
  (and
   (q7249519-valid-set-p type set)
   (q7249519-open-set-p
    type topology
    (q7249519-complement-set type set))))

(defun-sk q7249519-disjoint-sets-p (type left right)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p type object)
     (not
      (and
       (q7249519-set-member-p left object)
       (q7249519-set-member-p right object))))))

(defun-sk q7249519-cover-point-p (cover object)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q7249519-family-member-p cover set)
     (q7249519-set-member-p set object))))

(defun-sk q7249519-cover-p (type topology target cover)
  (forall (object)
    (and
     (q7249519-valid-set-p type target)
     (q7249519-family-of-sets-p type cover)
     (q7249519-open-family-p type topology cover)
     (implies
      (and
       (q7249519-member-p type object)
       (q7249519-set-member-p target object))
      (q7249519-cover-point-p cover object)))))

(defun q7249519-finite-subcover-elements-p
    (sets type cover)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q7249519-valid-set-p type (car sets))
       (q7249519-family-member-p cover (car sets))
       (q7249519-finite-subcover-elements-p
        (cdr sets) type cover))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun q7249519-finite-subcover-point-p (sets object)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q7249519-set-member-p (car sets) object)
       (q7249519-finite-subcover-point-p
        (cdr sets) object))
    nil))

(defun-sk q7249519-finite-subcover-covers-p
    (sets type target)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p type object)
      (q7249519-set-member-p target object))
     (q7249519-finite-subcover-point-p sets object))))

(defun q7249519-finite-subcover-p
    (sets type target cover)
  (and
   (true-listp sets)
   (q7249519-finite-subcover-elements-p
    sets type cover)
   (q7249519-finite-subcover-covers-p
    sets type target)))

(defun-sk q7249519-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (type target cover)
  (exists (sets)
    (q7249519-finite-subcover-p
     sets type target cover)))

(defun-sk q7249519-compact-set-p
    (type topology target)
  (forall (cover)
    (and
     (q7249519-valid-set-p type target)
     (implies
      (q7249519-cover-p type topology target cover)
      (q7249519-finite-subcover-exists-p
       type target cover)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-t2-separation-exists-p
    (type topology x y)
  (exists (left right)
    (and
     (q7249519-open-set-p type topology left)
     (q7249519-open-set-p type topology right)
     (q7249519-set-member-p left x)
     (q7249519-set-member-p right y)
     (q7249519-disjoint-sets-p type left right))))

(defun-sk q7249519-t2-space-p (type topology)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p type x)
      (q7249519-member-p type y)
      (not (equal x y)))
     (q7249519-t2-separation-exists-p
      type topology x y))))

(defun-sk q7249519-normal-separation-exists-p
    (type topology left right)
  (exists (left-open right-open)
    (and
     (q7249519-open-set-p type topology left-open)
     (q7249519-open-set-p type topology right-open)
     (q7249519-set-subset-p type left left-open)
     (q7249519-set-subset-p type right right-open)
     (q7249519-disjoint-sets-p
      type left-open right-open))))

(defun-sk q7249519-normal-space-p (type topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-closed-set-p type topology left)
      (q7249519-closed-set-p type topology right)
      (q7249519-disjoint-sets-p type left right))
     (q7249519-normal-separation-exists-p
      type topology left right))))

;; Sigma algebras and equality with the Borel sigma algebra generated by the
;; given topology.

(defun-sk q7249519-set-sequence-p (type sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q7249519-valid-set-p
      type (q7249519-sequence-at sequence index)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-measurable-sequence-p
    (type measurable sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q7249519-family-member-p
      measurable
      (q7249519-sequence-at sequence index)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-sigma-complements-p
    (type measurable)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7249519-family-member-p measurable set)
     (q7249519-family-member-p
      measurable
      (q7249519-complement-set type set)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-sigma-countable-unions-p
    (type measurable)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-set-sequence-p type sequence)
      (q7249519-measurable-sequence-p
       type measurable sequence))
     (q7249519-family-member-p
      measurable
      (q7249519-countable-union-set
       type sequence)))))

(defun q7249519-sigma-algebra-p (type measurable)
  (and
   (q7249519-family-of-sets-p type measurable)
   (q7249519-family-member-p
    measurable (q7249519-empty-set type))
   (q7249519-sigma-complements-p type measurable)
   (q7249519-sigma-countable-unions-p
    type measurable)))

(defun-sk q7249519-family-subset-p (left right)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7249519-family-member-p left set)
     (q7249519-family-member-p right set))))

(defun-sk q7249519-borel-minimal-p
    (type topology measurable)
  (forall (candidate)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-sigma-algebra-p type candidate)
      (q7249519-family-subset-p topology candidate))
     (q7249519-family-subset-p
      measurable candidate))))

(defun q7249519-borel-space-p
    (type topology measurable)
  (and
   (q7249519-sigma-algebra-p type measurable)
   (q7249519-family-subset-p topology measurable)
   (q7249519-borel-minimal-p
    type topology measurable)))

;; Nonnegative-real sequences and convergence to zero.

(defun-sk q7249519-nnreal-sequence-p (real sequence)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (natp index)
     (q7249519-nonnegative-p
      real
      (q7249519-sequence-at sequence index)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-zero-limit-tail-p
    (real sequence epsilon start)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp index)
      (natp start)
      (<= start index))
     (q7249519-less
      real
      (q7249519-sequence-at sequence index)
      epsilon))))

(defun-sk q7249519-zero-limit-start-p
    (real sequence epsilon)
  (exists (start)
    (and
     (natp start)
     (q7249519-zero-limit-tail-p
      real sequence epsilon start))))

(defun-sk q7249519-tends-to-zero-p (real sequence)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q7249519-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q7249519-zero-limit-start-p
      real sequence epsilon))))

;; Countably additive finite measures with values in the nonnegative reals.

(defun-sk q7249519-pairwise-disjoint-p
    (type sequence)
  (forall (left-index right-index)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp left-index)
      (natp right-index)
      (not (equal left-index right-index)))
     (q7249519-disjoint-sets-p
      type
      (q7249519-sequence-at sequence left-index)
      (q7249519-sequence-at sequence right-index)))))

(defun q7249519-measure-prefix-sum
    (real measure sequence count)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix count)))
  (if (zp count)
      (q7249519-zero real)
    (let ((index (- count 1)))
      (q7249519-add
       real
       (q7249519-measure-prefix-sum
        real measure sequence index)
       (q7249519-measure-value
        measure
        (q7249519-sequence-at sequence index))))))

(defun-sk q7249519-series-upper-bound-p
    (real measure sequence bound)
  (forall (count)
    (implies
     (natp count)
     (q7249519-leq
      real
      (q7249519-measure-prefix-sum
       real measure sequence count)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q7249519-series-sum-p
    (real measure sequence sum)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q7249519-member-p real sum)
     (q7249519-series-upper-bound-p
      real measure sequence sum)
     (implies
      (and
       (q7249519-member-p real bound)
       (q7249519-series-upper-bound-p
        real measure sequence bound))
      (q7249519-leq real sum bound)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-measure-extensional-p
    (space measurable measure)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-family-member-p measurable left)
      (q7249519-family-member-p measurable right)
      (q7249519-set-equiv-p space left right))
     (equal
      (q7249519-measure-value measure left)
      (q7249519-measure-value measure right)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-measure-values-p
    (real measurable measure)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7249519-family-member-p measurable set)
     (q7249519-nonnegative-p
      real
      (q7249519-measure-value measure set)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-countable-additivity-p
    (real space measurable measure)
  (forall (sequence)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-set-sequence-p space sequence)
      (q7249519-measurable-sequence-p
       space measurable sequence)
      (q7249519-pairwise-disjoint-p space sequence))
     (q7249519-series-sum-p
      real measure sequence
      (q7249519-measure-value
       measure
       (q7249519-countable-union-set
        space sequence))))))

(defun q7249519-finite-measure-p
    (real space measurable measure)
  (and
   (q7249519-measure-extensional-p
    space measurable measure)
   (q7249519-measure-values-p
    real measurable measure)
   (equal
    (q7249519-measure-value
     measure (q7249519-empty-set space))
    (q7249519-zero real))
   (q7249519-countable-additivity-p
    real space measurable measure)))

(defun-sk q7249519-finite-measure-carrier-laws-p
    (real space measurable)
  (forall (measure)
    (iff
     (q7249519-member-p
      (q7249519-finite-measure-type
       real space measurable)
      measure)
     (q7249519-finite-measure-p
      real space measurable measure))))

;; Real-valued functions, continuity, boundedness, and exact bounded Lebesgue
;; integration by suprema of measurable finite-range simple functions.

(defun-sk q7249519-real-function-p
    (real space function)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p space object)
     (q7249519-member-p
      real
      (q7249519-function-at function object)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-bounded-by-p
    (real space function bound)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p space object)
     (q7249519-leq
      real
      (q7249519-absolute-value
       real
       (q7249519-function-at function object))
      bound))))

(defun-sk q7249519-bounded-function-p
    (real space function)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q7249519-nonnegative-p real bound)
     (q7249519-bounded-by-p
      real space function bound))))

(defun-sk q7249519-real-open-neighborhood-p
    (real set center epsilon)
  (forall (value)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-member-p real value)
      (q7249519-less
       real
       (q7249519-absolute-value
        real
        (q7249519-subtract real value center))
       epsilon))
     (q7249519-set-member-p set value))))

(defun-sk q7249519-real-open-radius-exists-p
    (real set center)
  (exists (epsilon)
    (and
     (q7249519-positive-p real epsilon)
     (q7249519-real-open-neighborhood-p
      real set center epsilon))))

(defun-sk q7249519-real-open-set-p (real set)
  (forall (center)
    (and
     (q7249519-valid-set-p real set)
     (implies
      (and
       (q7249519-member-p real center)
       (q7249519-set-member-p set center))
      (q7249519-real-open-radius-exists-p
       real set center)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-continuous-function-p
    (real space topology function)
  (forall (real-open-set)
    (implies
     (q7249519-real-open-set-p real real-open-set)
     (q7249519-open-set-p
      space topology
      (q7249519-preimage-set
       space function real-open-set)))))

(defun q7249519-bounded-continuous-p
    (real space topology function)
  (and
   (q7249519-real-function-p real space function)
   (q7249519-bounded-function-p real space function)
   (q7249519-continuous-function-p
    real space topology function)))

(defun q7249519-real-value-list-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q7249519-member-p real (car values))
       (q7249519-real-value-list-p real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q7249519-values-nonnegative-p (real values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q7249519-nonnegative-p real (car values))
       (q7249519-values-nonnegative-p
        real (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun-sk q7249519-range-in-values-p
    (space function values)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p space object)
     (member-equal
      (q7249519-function-at function object)
      values))))

(defun q7249519-simple-fibers-measurable-p
    (space measurable function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q7249519-family-member-p
        measurable
        (q7249519-fiber-set
         space function (car values)))
       (q7249519-simple-fibers-measurable-p
        space measurable function (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q7249519-simple-function-p
    (real space measurable function values)
  (and
   (true-listp values)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal values)
   (q7249519-real-value-list-p real values)
   (q7249519-values-nonnegative-p real values)
   (q7249519-real-function-p real space function)
   (q7249519-range-in-values-p
    space function values)
   (q7249519-simple-fibers-measurable-p
    space measurable function values)))

(defun q7249519-simple-integral
    (real space measure function values)
  (if (consp values)
      (q7249519-add
       real
       (q7249519-multiply
        real
        (car values)
        (q7249519-measure-value
         measure
         (q7249519-fiber-set
          space function (car values))))
       (q7249519-simple-integral
        real space measure function (cdr values)))
    (q7249519-zero real)))

(defun-sk q7249519-simple-below-p
    (real space simple function)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p space object)
     (and
      (q7249519-nonnegative-p
       real
       (q7249519-function-at simple object))
      (q7249519-leq
       real
       (q7249519-function-at simple object)
       (q7249519-function-at function object))))))

(defun-sk q7249519-nonnegative-function-p
    (real space function)
  (forall (object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p space object)
     (q7249519-nonnegative-p
      real
      (q7249519-function-at function object)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-lintegral-upper-bound-p
    (real space measurable measure function bound)
  (forall (simple values)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-simple-function-p
       real space measurable simple values)
      (q7249519-simple-below-p
       real space simple function))
     (q7249519-leq
      real
      (q7249519-simple-integral
       real space measure simple values)
      bound))))

(defun-sk q7249519-lintegral-value-p
    (real space measurable measure function value)
  (forall (bound)
    (and
     (q7249519-member-p real value)
     (q7249519-lintegral-upper-bound-p
      real space measurable measure function value)
     (implies
      (and
       (q7249519-member-p real bound)
       (q7249519-lintegral-upper-bound-p
        real space measurable measure function bound))
      (q7249519-leq real value bound)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-lintegral-operation-p
    (real space measurable)
  (forall (measure function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7249519-finite-measure-p
       real space measurable measure)
      (q7249519-real-function-p
       real space function)
      (q7249519-bounded-function-p
       real space function)
      (q7249519-nonnegative-function-p
       real space function))
     (q7249519-lintegral-value-p
      real space measurable measure function
      (q7249519-lintegral-value
       measure function)))))

(defun-sk q7249519-function-constructor-laws-p
    (real space)
  (forall (function object)
    (implies
     (q7249519-member-p space object)
     (let ((value
            (q7249519-function-at function object)))
       (and
        (equal
         (q7249519-function-at
          (q7249519-positive-part-function
           real function)
          object)
         (if (q7249519-less
              real value (q7249519-zero real))
             (q7249519-zero real)
           value))
        (equal
         (q7249519-function-at
          (q7249519-negative-part-function
           real function)
          object)
         (if (q7249519-less
              real value (q7249519-zero real))
             (q7249519-negate real value)
           (q7249519-zero real))))))))

(defun q7249519-real-integral-value
    (real measure function)
  (q7249519-subtract
   real
   (q7249519-lintegral-value
    measure
    (q7249519-positive-part-function
     real function))
   (q7249519-lintegral-value
    measure
    (q7249519-negative-part-function
     real function))))

;; The weak topology is the least topology on finite measures making every
;; bounded-continuous-test-function integral map continuous.

(defun-sk q7249519-integral-preimage-laws-p
    (real space topology measurable)
  (forall (function real-open-set measure)
    (iff
     (q7249519-set-member-p
