title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7249519,
-- "Prokhorov's theorem": on a Hausdorff Borel space, finite measures with
-- bounded total mass and tails tending uniformly to zero outside compact sets
-- form a compact family in the weak topology, assuming normality or monotonicity
-- of the compact sets. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lzero; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} A =
  A -> Bottom {a}

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Iff
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record Lift
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor lifted
  field
    lower : A

infix 4 _!=_ _<=N_

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

data _<=N_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero<=   : {n : Nat} -> zero <=N n
  suc<=suc : {m n : Nat} -> m <=N n -> suc m <=N suc n

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Predicate {a} A =
  A -> Set a

Family :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Family {a} A =
  Predicate A -> Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Empty {a} _ =
  Bottom {a}

Whole :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A
Whole {a} _ =
  Top {a}

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Complement P x =
  Not (P x)

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A
Intersection P Q x =
  Both (P x) (Q x)

CountableUnion :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Predicate A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
Subset {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) -> P x -> Q x

SamePredicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
SamePredicate {A = A} P Q =
  (x : A) -> Iff (P x) (Q x)

Disjoint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
Disjoint {a} {A} P Q =
  (x : A) -> P x -> Q x -> Bottom {a}

Preimage :
  {A B : Set} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate B ->
  Predicate A
Preimage f U x =
  U (f x)

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

All :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (A -> Set a) ->
  List A ->
  Set a
All P [] =
  Top
All P (x ∷ xs) =
  Both (P x) (All P xs)

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    interior :
      Predicate A ->
      Predicate A

    interior-subset :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      Subset (interior U) U

    interior-monotone :
      (U V : Predicate A) ->
      Subset U V ->
      Subset (interior U) (interior V)

    interior-open :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      Subset (interior U) (interior (interior U))

    interior-whole :
      Subset Whole (interior Whole)

    interior-intersection :
      (U V : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate
        (interior (Intersection U V))
        (Intersection (interior U) (interior V))

open TopologicalSpace

IsOpen :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  Subset U (interior topology U)

IsClosed :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  IsOpen topology (Complement U)

record CoverWitness
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (cover : Family A)
  (x : A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    member-set      : Predicate A
    member-selected : cover member-set
    member-contains : member-set x

record FiniteSubcover
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (target : Predicate A)
  (cover : Family A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    selected :
      List (Predicate A)

    selected-from-cover :
      (U : Predicate A) ->
      Member U selected ->
      cover U

    selected-covers :
      (x : A) ->
      target x ->
      Exists (Predicate A)
        (\ U -> Both (Member U selected) (U x))

CompactFor :
  {a o : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Predicate A -> Set o) ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set (lsuc a ⊔ o)
CompactFor {A = A} Open target =
  (cover : Family A) ->
  ((U : Predicate A) -> cover U -> Open U) ->
  ((x : A) -> target x -> CoverWitness cover x) ->
  FiniteSubcover target cover

Compact :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  Predicate A ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Compact topology =
  CompactFor (IsOpen topology)

record T2Separation
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A)
  (x y : A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    left-neighborhood  : Predicate A
    right-neighborhood : Predicate A
    left-open          : IsOpen topology left-neighborhood
    right-open         : IsOpen topology right-neighborhood
    left-contains      : left-neighborhood x
    right-contains     : right-neighborhood y
    neighborhoods-disjoint :
      Disjoint left-neighborhood right-neighborhood

T2Space :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  Set (lsuc a)
T2Space {A = A} topology =
  (x y : A) ->
  x != y ->
  T2Separation topology x y

record NormalSeparation
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A)
  (C D : Predicate A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    left-open-set  : Predicate A
    right-open-set : Predicate A
    left-open      : IsOpen topology left-open-set
    right-open     : IsOpen topology right-open-set
    left-contained : Subset C left-open-set
    right-contained : Subset D right-open-set
    open-sets-disjoint :
      Disjoint left-open-set right-open-set

NormalSpace :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace A ->
  Set (lsuc a)
NormalSpace {A = A} topology =
  (C D : Predicate A) ->
  IsClosed topology C ->
  IsClosed topology D ->
  Disjoint C D ->
  NormalSeparation topology C D

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    measurable :
      Predicate A ->
      Set a

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

open SigmaAlgebra

data BorelGenerated
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) :
  Predicate A ->
  Set (lsuc a) where

  borel-open :
    {U : Predicate A} ->
    IsOpen topology U ->
    BorelGenerated topology U

  borel-empty :
    BorelGenerated topology Empty

  borel-complement :
    {S : Predicate A} ->
    BorelGenerated topology S ->
    BorelGenerated topology (Complement S)

  borel-countable-union :
    (sets : Nat -> Predicate A) ->
    ((n : Nat) -> BorelGenerated topology (sets n)) ->
    BorelGenerated topology (CountableUnion sets)

  borel-congruent :
    {S T : Predicate A} ->
    SamePredicate S T ->
    BorelGenerated topology S ->
    BorelGenerated topology T

record BorelSpace
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra A) :
  Set (lsuc (lsuc a)) where

  field
    borel-measurable :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      BorelGenerated topology S ->
      measurable events S

    measurable-borel :
      (S : Predicate A) ->
      measurable events S ->
      BorelGenerated topology S

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where

  field
    zeroR oneR :
      R

    addR multiplyR :
      R -> R -> R

    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR :
      R -> R

    lessOrEqualR :
      R -> R -> Set

    fromNatR :
      Nat -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)

    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x

    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z == multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)

    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x

    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)

    multiply-reciprocal :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z

    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y

    order-total :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)

    add-order :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)

    multiply-nonnegative :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)

    zero-less-than-one :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)

    absolute-of-nonnegative :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x

    absolute-of-nonpositive :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    absolute-zero-only :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR

    absolute-add :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))

    absolute-multiply :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)

    fromNat-zero :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR

    fromNat-successor :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedean :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-bound :
      (P : Predicate R) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R -> R -> R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R -> R -> Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R -> Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

record Nonnegative
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set where

  constructor nonnegative
  field
    value       : R
    value-is-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) value

open Nonnegative

RealOpen :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Predicate R ->
  Set
RealOpen {R} reals U =
  (x : R) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : R) ->
          StrictLess reals
            (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals y x))
            radius ->
          U y))

ContinuousReal :
  {R E : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  TopologicalSpace E ->
  (E -> R) ->
  Set1
ContinuousReal reals topology f =
  (U : Predicate _) ->
  RealOpen reals U ->
  IsOpen topology (Preimage f U)

Bounded :
  {R E : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (E -> R) ->
  Set
Bounded {R} {E} reals f =
  Exists R
    (\ bound ->
      Both
        (lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) bound)
        ((x : E) ->
          lessOrEqualR reals (absoluteR reals (f x)) bound))

record BoundedContinuous
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace E)
  (f : E -> R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    bounded    : Bounded reals f
    continuous : ContinuousReal reals topology f

PairwiseDisjoint :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set a
PairwiseDisjoint {a} {A} sets =
  (i j : Nat) ->
  i != j ->
  Disjoint (sets i) (sets j)

sumFirst :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  Nat ->
  R
sumFirst reals terms zero =
  zeroR reals
sumFirst reals terms (suc n) =
  addR reals (sumFirst reals terms n) (terms n)

SequentialLimit :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (Nat -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
SequentialLimit reals sequence limit =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals
        (absoluteR reals
          (subtractR reals (sequence n) limit))
        epsilon)

record IsInfimumLarge
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (P : R -> Set1)
  (bound : R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    lower-bound :
      (x : R) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals bound x

    greatest-lower-bound :
      (lower : R) ->
      ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR reals lower x) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals lower bound

record IsSupremumLarge
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (P : R -> Set1)
  (bound : R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    upper-bound :
      (x : R) ->
      P x ->
      lessOrEqualR reals x bound

    least-upper-bound-large :
      (upper : R) ->
      ((x : R) -> P x -> lessOrEqualR reals x upper) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals bound upper

record FiniteMeasure
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) :
  Set1 where

  field
    mass :
      Predicate E ->
      R

    mass-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate E) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      mass S == mass T

    mass-empty :
      mass Empty == zeroR reals

    mass-nonnegative :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (mass S)

    mass-monotone :
      (S T : Predicate E) ->
      Subset S T ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (mass S) (mass T)

    mass-trimmed :
      (S : Predicate E) ->
      IsInfimumLarge reals
        (\ candidate ->
          Exists (Predicate E)
            (\ T ->
              Both
                (measurable events T)
                (Both
                  (Subset S T)
                  (candidate == mass T))))
        (mass S)

    measurable-countable-additivity :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate E) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable events (sets n)) ->
      PairwiseDisjoint sets ->
      SequentialLimit reals
        (\ count ->
          sumFirst reals (\ n -> mass (sets n)) count)
        (mass (CountableUnion sets))

open FiniteMeasure

record SimpleFunctionBelow
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E)
  (f : E -> R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    cutoff :
      Nat

    index :
      E -> Nat

    values :
      Nat -> R

    index-within :
      (x : E) ->
      index x <=N cutoff

    measurable-fibers :
      (n : Nat) ->
      measurable events (\ x -> index x == n)

    values-nonnegative :
      (n : Nat) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (values n)

    pointwise-below :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (values (index x)) (f x)

open SimpleFunctionBelow

simpleIntegral :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  (measure : FiniteMeasure reals events) ->
  {f : E -> R} ->
  SimpleFunctionBelow reals events f ->
  R
simpleIntegral {reals = reals} measure simple =
  sumFirst reals
    (\ n ->
      multiplyR reals
        (values simple n)
        (mass measure (\ x -> index simple x == n)))
    (suc (cutoff simple))

SimpleIntegralCandidate :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  FiniteMeasure reals events ->
  (E -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set1
SimpleIntegralCandidate {reals = reals} {events = events}
    measure f candidate =
  Exists (SimpleFunctionBelow reals events f)
    (\ simple -> candidate == simpleIntegral measure simple)

LowerIntegralValue :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  FiniteMeasure reals events ->
  (E -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set1
LowerIntegralValue {reals = reals} measure f value =
  IsSupremumLarge reals
    (SimpleIntegralCandidate measure f)
    value

record JordanParts
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (f positivePart negativePart : E -> R) :
  Set1 where

  field
    positive-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (positivePart x)

    negative-nonnegative :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (negativePart x)

    reconstructs :
      (x : E) ->
      f x ==
      subtractR reals (positivePart x) (negativePart x)

    disjoint-parts :
      (x : E) ->
      Either
        (positivePart x == zeroR reals)
        (negativePart x == zeroR reals)

IntegralValue :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  FiniteMeasure reals events ->
  (E -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set1
IntegralValue {R} {E} {reals} {events} measure f value =
  Exists (E -> R)
    (\ positivePart ->
      Exists (E -> R)
        (\ negativePart ->
          Both
            (JordanParts reals f positivePart negativePart)
            (Exists R
              (\ positiveIntegral ->
                Exists R
                  (\ negativeIntegral ->
                    Both
                      (LowerIntegralValue
                        measure positivePart positiveIntegral)
                      (Both
                        (LowerIntegralValue
                          measure negativePart negativeIntegral)
                        (value ==
                          subtractR reals
                            positiveIntegral negativeIntegral)))))))

IntegralPreimage :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  (f : E -> R) ->
  Predicate R ->
  Predicate (FiniteMeasure reals events)
IntegralPreimage f U measure =
  Exists _
    (\ integral ->
      Both
        (IntegralValue measure f integral)
        (U integral))

record WeakConstraint
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace E)
  : Set1 where

  field
    test-function :
      E -> R

    test-bounded-continuous :
      BoundedContinuous reals topology test-function

    real-region :
      Predicate R

    real-region-open :
      RealOpen reals real-region

open WeakConstraint

SatisfiesConstraint :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {topology : TopologicalSpace E} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  FiniteMeasure reals events ->
  WeakConstraint reals topology ->
  Set1
SatisfiesConstraint measure constraint =
  IntegralPreimage
    (test-function constraint)
    (real-region constraint)
    measure

BasicWeakOpen :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {topology : TopologicalSpace E} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  List (WeakConstraint reals topology) ->
  Predicate (FiniteMeasure reals events)
BasicWeakOpen constraints measure =
  All (SatisfiesConstraint measure) constraints

-- This is the topology generated by the integral subbasis: a set is weakly
-- open exactly when each of its points has a finite intersection of subbasic
-- bounded-continuous integral neighborhoods contained in the set.
WeakOpen :
  {R E : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace E) ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) ->
  Predicate (FiniteMeasure reals events) ->
  Set1
WeakOpen reals topology events U =
  (measure : FiniteMeasure reals events) ->
  U measure ->
  Exists (List (WeakConstraint reals topology))
    (\ constraints ->
      Both
        (BasicWeakOpen {events = events} constraints measure)
        (Subset (BasicWeakOpen {events = events} constraints) U))

TendsToZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (Nat -> Nonnegative reals) ->
  Set
TendsToZero reals u =
  (epsilon : _) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ cutoff ->
      (n : Nat) ->
      cutoff <=N n ->
      StrictLess reals (value (u n)) epsilon)

Monotone :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate A) ->
  Set a
Monotone sets =
  (m n : Nat) ->
  m <=N n ->
  Subset (sets m) (sets n)

ProkhorovFamily :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  {events : SigmaAlgebra E} ->
  (u : Nat -> Nonnegative reals) ->
  (K : Nat -> Predicate E) ->
  Nonnegative reals ->
  Predicate (FiniteMeasure reals events)
ProkhorovFamily {reals = reals} u K C measure =
  Lift {p = lsuc lzero}
    (Both
      (lessOrEqualR reals
        (mass measure Whole)
        (value C))
      ((n : Nat) ->
        lessOrEqualR reals
          (mass measure (Complement (K n)))
          (value (u n))))

prokhorov-s-theorem : Set2
prokhorov-s-theorem =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  (topology : TopologicalSpace E) ->
  T2Space topology ->
  (events : SigmaAlgebra E) ->
  BorelSpace topology events ->
  (u : Nat -> Nonnegative reals) ->
  (K : Nat -> Predicate E) ->
  (C : Nonnegative reals) ->
  TendsToZero reals u ->
  ((n : Nat) -> Compact topology (K n)) ->
  Either (NormalSpace topology) (Monotone K) ->
  CompactFor
    (WeakOpen reals topology events)
    (ProkhorovFamily u K C)

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q7249519 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q7249519), "Prokhorov's theorem":
  on a possibly empty Hausdorff Borel space, finite measures with uniformly
  bounded mass and vanishing compact-tail bounds form a compact set in the
  weak topology when the space is normal or the compact sets are nested.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory realTheory extrealTheory;
open topologyTheory real_topologyTheory sigma_algebraTheory measureTheory;
open borelTheory lebesgueTheory;

val q7249519_t2_space_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_t2_space_def",
  ``q7249519_t2_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      !x y.
        x IN topspace top /\
        y IN topspace top /\
        x <> y
        ==>
        ?u v.
          open_in top u /\
          open_in top v /\
          x IN u /\
          y IN v /\
          DISJOINT u v``);

val q7249519_normal_space_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_normal_space_def",
  ``q7249519_normal_space (top : 'a topology) <=>
      !s t.
        closed_in top s /\
        closed_in top t /\
        DISJOINT s t
        ==>
        ?u v.
          open_in top u /\
          open_in top v /\
          s SUBSET u /\
          t SUBSET v /\
          DISJOINT u v``);

val q7249519_borel_space_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_borel_space_def",
  ``q7249519_borel_space
      (top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra) <=>
      meas = general_borel top``);

val q7249519_finite_borel_measure_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_finite_borel_measure_def",
  ``q7249519_finite_borel_measure
      (top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra) (mu : 'a m_space) <=>
      finite_measure_space mu /\
      m_space mu = topspace top /\
      measurable_sets mu = subsets meas``);

val q7249519_real_integral_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_real_integral_def",
  ``q7249519_real_integral
      (mu : 'a m_space) (f : 'a -> real) =
      real (integral mu (Normal o f))``);

val q7249519_bounded_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_bounded_continuous_def",
  ``q7249519_bounded_continuous
      (top : 'a topology) (f : 'a -> real) <=>
      continuous_map (top,euclidean) f /\
      bounded (IMAGE f (topspace top))``);

val q7249519_weak_subbasic_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_weak_subbasic_def",
  ``q7249519_weak_subbasic
      (top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra)
      (s : ('a m_space) set) <=>
      ?f v.
        q7249519_bounded_continuous top f /\
        open_in euclidean v /\
        s =
          {mu |
            q7249519_finite_borel_measure top meas mu /\
            q7249519_real_integral mu f IN v}``);

val q7249519_weak_basic_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_weak_basic_def",
  ``q7249519_weak_basic
      (top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra)
      (b : ('a m_space) set) <=>
      ?F : (('a m_space) set) set.
        FINITE F /\
        (!s. s IN F ==> q7249519_weak_subbasic top meas s) /\
        b =
          {mu | q7249519_finite_borel_measure top meas mu} INTER
          BIGINTER F``);

val q7249519_weak_open_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_weak_open_def",
  ``q7249519_weak_open
      (top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra)
      (s : ('a m_space) set) <=>
      ?B : (('a m_space) set) set.
        (!b. b IN B ==> q7249519_weak_basic top meas b) /\
        s = BIGUNION B``);

val q7249519_weak_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q7249519_weak_topology_def",
  ``q7249519_weak_topology
      (top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra) =
      topology {s | q7249519_weak_open top meas s}``);

val prokhorov_s_theorem =
  ``!(top : 'a topology) (meas : 'a algebra)
      (u : num -> real) (K : num -> 'a set) (C : real).
      q7249519_t2_space top /\
      q7249519_borel_space top meas /\
      0 <= C /\
      (!n. 0 <= u n) /\
      ((u --> 0) sequentially) /\
      (!n. compact_in top (K n)) /\
      (q7249519_normal_space top \/
       !m n. m <= n ==> K m SUBSET K n)
      ==>
      compact_in
        (q7249519_weak_topology top meas)
        {mu |
          q7249519_finite_borel_measure top meas mu /\
          measure mu (m_space mu) <= Normal C /\
          !n.
            measure mu (m_space mu DIFF K n) <= Normal (u n)}``;

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7249519
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7249519), "Prokhorov's theorem": on an
  arbitrary Hausdorff Borel topological space, finite measures of uniformly
  bounded mass whose mass outside each compact set K(n) is bounded by a
  nonnegative sequence tending to zero form a compact set, provided the space
  is normal or K is monotone. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q7249519FiniteMeasures S is the class of all finite measures on the
  sigma-algebra S. Q7249519BoundedContinuous J H says that H is a bounded
  continuous real-valued function on the carrier of J.

  Q7249519Integral defines integration of such a function against a finite
  measure as the unique limit of SetMM simple integrals along an L1-
  approximating sequence of measurable finite-range functions.
  Q7249519WeakSubbase J S consists of the inverse images of real-open sets
  under integration against bounded continuous real functions. Closing this
  subbase under finite intersections and arbitrary unions gives
  Q7249519WeakTopology J S, the bounded-continuous-test-function weak topology
  on finite measures. This is the topology induced on Mathlib's FiniteMeasure
  by its weak dual representation.

  Q7249519TendstoZero and Q7249519Monotone expand the two sequence conditions.
  Q7249519Admissible is exactly the set of finite measures with total mass at
  most C and mass on the carrier-relative complement of K(n) at most u(n) for
  every natural n.

  In the final assertion J is an arbitrary Hausdorff topology on X. Its Borel
  measurable space is sigaGen(J), matching the Lean BorelSpace assumption.
  Compactness is expressed by membership of the restricted weak topology in
  Comp. Every declaration before the final one is syntax or a faithful
  definition. The final $a is the single unproved corpus statement, and this
  root file has no $p declaration.
$)

$c Q7249519FiniteMeasures Q7249519BoundedContinuous
   Q7249519SeqTendsto Q7249519Simple Q7249519SimpleIntegral
   Q7249519LIntegral Q7249519Diff Q7249519L1Distance
   Q7249519HasIntegral Q7249519Integral
   Q7249519WeakSubbase Q7249519WeakTopology Q7249519TendstoZero
   Q7249519Monotone Q7249519Admissible $.

q7249519-finite-measures-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519FiniteMeasures S ) $.
q7249519-bounded-continuous-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7249519BoundedContinuous J H ) $.
q7249519-seq-tendsto-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7249519SeqTendsto W S z ) $.
q7249519-simple-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7249519Simple M G ) $.
q7249519-simple-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519SimpleIntegral M G ) $.
q7249519-lintegral-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519LIntegral M H ) $.
q7249519-diff-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519Diff M H K ) $.
q7249519-l1-distance-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519L1Distance M H K ) $.
q7249519-has-integral-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7249519HasIntegral M H y ) $.
q7249519-integral-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519Integral M H ) $.
q7249519-weak-subbase-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519WeakSubbase J S ) $.
q7249519-weak-topology-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519WeakTopology J S ) $.
q7249519-tendsto-zero-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7249519TendstoZero u ) $.
q7249519-monotone-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7249519Monotone K ) $.
q7249519-admissible-syntax
  $a class ( Q7249519Admissible J K u C ) $.

${
  $d M S $.

  q7249519-finite-measures-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519FiniteMeasures S
  ) = {
    M e. ( measures ` S ) |
    ( M ` U. S ) < +oo
  } $.
$}

${
  $d H J c x $.

  q7249519-bounded-continuous-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7249519BoundedContinuous J H )
    <->
    (
      H e. ( J Cn ( TopOpen ` RRfld ) )
      /\
      E. c e. RR+
        A. x e. U. J
          ( abs ` ( H ` x ) ) < c
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d S W z $.

  q7249519-seq-tendsto-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7249519SeqTendsto W S z )
    <->
    (
      S : NN0 --> ( Base ` W )
      /\
      S ( ~~>t ` ( TopOpen ` W ) ) z
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M $.

  q7249519-simple-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7249519Simple M G )
    <->
    (
      G : U. dom M --> ( 0 [,] +oo )
      /\
      (
        G e.
          (
            dom M
            MblFnM
            (
              sigaGen `
              ( TopOpen ` ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) ) )
            )
          )
        /\
        ran G e. Fin
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d G M r $.

  q7249519-simple-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519SimpleIntegral M G
  ) =
    sum* r e. ( ran G \ { 0 } )
      ( r *e ( M ` ( `' G " { r } ) ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d G H M x y $.

  q7249519-lintegral-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519LIntegral M H
  ) =
    sup
    (
      { y e. RR* |
        E. G
          (
            ( Q7249519Simple M G )
            /\
            (
              A. x e. U. dom M
                ( G ` x ) <_ ( H ` x )
              /\
              y = ( Q7249519SimpleIntegral M G )
            )
          )
      } ,
      RR* ,
      <
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H K M x $.

  q7249519-diff-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519Diff M H K
  ) =
    ( x e. U. dom M |->
      (
        ( H ` x )
        ( +g ` RRfld )
        ( ( -g ` RRfld ) ` ( K ` x ) )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H K M x $.

  q7249519-l1-distance-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519L1Distance M H K
  ) =
    (
      Q7249519LIntegral
      M
      ( x e. U. dom M |->
        (
          ( norm ` RRfld )
          `
          ( ( Q7249519Diff M H K ) ` x )
        )
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d H M n s y $.

  q7249519-has-integral-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7249519HasIntegral M H y )
    <->
    (
      y e. RR
      /\
      E. s e. ( ( RR ^m U. dom M ) ^m NN0 )
        (
          A. n e. NN0
            ( ( s ` n ) e. dom ( RRfld sitg M ) )
          /\
          (
            Q7249519SeqTendsto
            ( RR*s |`s ( 0 [,] +oo ) )
            ( n e. NN0 |->
              ( Q7249519L1Distance M H ( s ` n ) ) )
            0
            /\
            Q7249519SeqTendsto
            RRfld
            ( n e. NN0 |-> ( ( RRfld sitg M ) ` ( s ` n ) ) )
            y
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M y $.

  q7249519-integral-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519Integral M H
    =
    (
      iota_ y e. RR
        ( Q7249519HasIntegral M H y )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A H J M O S $.

  q7249519-weak-subbase-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519WeakSubbase J S
  ) = {
    A e. ~P ( Q7249519FiniteMeasures S ) |
    E. H E. O
      (
        ( Q7249519BoundedContinuous J H )
        /\
        O e. ( TopOpen ` RRfld )
        /\
        A = {
          M e. ( Q7249519FiniteMeasures S ) |
          ( Q7249519Integral M H ) e. O
        }
      )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d J S $.

  q7249519-weak-topology-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519WeakTopology J S
  ) = (
    topGen
    `
    (
      fi
      `
      (
        { ( Q7249519FiniteMeasures S ) }
        u.
        ( Q7249519WeakSubbase J S )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d N n r u $.

  q7249519-tendsto-zero-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7249519TendstoZero u )
    <->
    (
      u : NN0 --> ( 0 [,) +oo )
      /\
      A. r e. RR+
        E. N e. NN0
          A. n e. NN0
            (
              N <_ n
              ->
              ( u ` n ) < r
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K m n $.

  q7249519-monotone-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7249519Monotone K )
    <->
    A. m e. NN0
      A. n e. NN0
        (
          m <_ n
          ->
          ( K ` m ) C_ ( K ` n )
        )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C J K M n u $.

  q7249519-admissible-definition $a |- (
    Q7249519Admissible J K u C
  ) = {
    M e.
      (
        Q7249519FiniteMeasures
        ( sigaGen ` J )
      ) |
    (
      ( M ` U. J ) <_ C
      /\
      A. n e. NN0
        (
          M
          `
          (
            U. J
            \
            ( K ` n )
          )
        )
        <_
        ( u ` n )
    )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d C H J K M N O S X c m n r u x $.

  thousand-theorems-q7249519-prokhorov-s-theorem $a |-
    A. X A. J A. C A. u A. K
      (
        (
          J e. ( TopOn ` X )
          /\
          J e. Haus
          /\
          C e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
          /\
          u : NN0 --> ( 0 [,) +oo )
          /\
          K : NN0 --> ~P X
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            ( Q7249519TendstoZero u )
            /\
            A. n e. NN0
              ( J |`t ( K ` n ) ) e. Comp
            /\
            (
              J e. Nrm
              \/
              ( Q7249519Monotone K )
            )
          )
          ->
          (
            (
              Q7249519WeakTopology
              J
              ( sigaGen ` J )
            )
            |`t
            ( Q7249519Admissible J K u C )
          ) e. Comp
        )
      )
  $.
$}

title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7249519
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q7249519), "Prokhorov's theorem": for a
:: Hausdorff space with its Borel sigma-field, finite measures of bounded mass
:: whose masses outside a compact sequence tend uniformly to zero form a
:: compact set in the weak topology, assuming normality or monotonicity of the
:: compact sequence.  The weak topology below is its equivalent initial-
:: topology presentation using integrals of bounded continuous real functions.
:: This file contains no proof.

environ
