title: Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7249519,
% "Prokhorov's theorem": finite Borel measures with uniformly bounded mass and
% vanishing bounds outside a sequence of compact sets form a compact set in the
% weak topology, under normality or monotonicity. This file contains no proof.

Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem[E: TYPE]: THEORY
BEGIN
  point_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  point_set_family: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  point_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> point_set]
  topology: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]
  sigma_algebra: TYPE = [point_set -> bool]

  nonnegative_real: TYPE = {value: real | 0 <= value}
  nonnegative_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> nonnegative_real]
  real_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real]
  real_function: TYPE = [E -> real]
  real_function_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_function]
  real_set: TYPE = [real -> bool]
  real_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> real_set]

  measure_map: TYPE = [point_set -> nonnegative_real]
  measure_set: TYPE = [measure_map -> bool]
  measure_set_family: TYPE = [measure_set -> bool]
  measure_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> measure_set]

  empty_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): FALSE

  full_set: point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): TRUE

  point_subset(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      A(x) IMPLIES B(x)

  point_disjoint(A, B: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      NOT (A(x) AND B(x))

  point_intersection(A, B: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      A(x) AND B(x)

  point_complement(A: point_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      NOT A(x)

  point_union(F: point_set_family): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (A: point_set):
        F(A) AND A(x)

  countable_union(sets: point_set_sequence): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (index: nat):
        sets(index)(x)

  topology_laws(open_sets: topology): bool =
    open_sets(empty_set)
      AND open_sets(full_set)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: point_set):
        open_sets(A) AND open_sets(B)
          IMPLIES open_sets(point_intersection(A, B)))
      AND (FORALL (F: point_set_family):
        (FORALL (A: point_set):
          F(A) IMPLIES open_sets(A))
        IMPLIES open_sets(point_union(F)))

  closed_set(open_sets: topology, A: point_set): bool =
    open_sets(point_complement(A))

  hausdorff_space(open_sets: topology): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E):
      x /= y IMPLIES
        EXISTS (U, V: point_set):
          open_sets(U)
            AND open_sets(V)
            AND U(x)
            AND V(y)
            AND point_disjoint(U, V)

  normal_space(open_sets: topology): bool =
    FORALL (A, B: point_set):
      closed_set(open_sets, A)
        AND closed_set(open_sets, B)
        AND point_disjoint(A, B)
      IMPLIES
        EXISTS (U, V: point_set):
          open_sets(U)
            AND open_sets(V)
            AND point_subset(A, U)
            AND point_subset(B, V)
            AND point_disjoint(U, V)

  point_open_cover(
      open_sets: topology,
      cover: point_set_family,
      A: point_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: point_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES open_sets(U))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        A(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: point_set):
            cover(U) AND U(x))

  point_finite_subcover(
      cover: point_set_family,
      A: point_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: point_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: E):
          A(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_set(open_sets: topology, A: point_set): bool =
    FORALL (cover: point_set_family):
      point_open_cover(open_sets, cover, A)
        IMPLIES point_finite_subcover(cover, A)

  monotone_sets(K: point_set_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index <= right_index IMPLIES
        point_subset(K(left_index), K(right_index))

  is_sigma_algebra(Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    Sigma(full_set)
      AND (FORALL (A: point_set):
        Sigma(A) IMPLIES Sigma(point_complement(A)))
      AND (FORALL (sets: point_set_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          Sigma(sets(index)))
        IMPLIES Sigma(countable_union(sets)))

  generated_borel_sigma(
      open_sets: topology,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND (FORALL (U: point_set):
        open_sets(U) IMPLIES Sigma(U))
      AND (FORALL (Other: sigma_algebra):
        (is_sigma_algebra(Other)
          AND (FORALL (U: point_set):
            open_sets(U) IMPLIES Other(U)))
        IMPLIES
          FORALL (A: point_set):
            Sigma(A) IMPLIES Other(A))

  pairwise_disjoint(sets: point_set_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index /= right_index IMPLIES
        point_disjoint(sets(left_index), sets(right_index))

  pairwise_disjoint_below(
      sets: point_set_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (left_index, right_index: nat):
      left_index < count
        AND right_index < count
        AND left_index /= right_index
      IMPLIES point_disjoint(
        sets(left_index), sets(right_index))

  finite_real_sum(
      values: real_sequence,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_real_sum(values, count - 1)
        + values(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  converges_to_real(
      values: real_sequence,
      limit: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            abs(values(index) - limit) < epsilon_value

  partial_measure_sum(
      M: measure_map,
      sets: point_set_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        M(sets(index)),
      count)

  is_finite_measure(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra): bool =
    is_sigma_algebra(Sigma)
      AND M(empty_set) = 0
      AND (FORALL (A: point_set):
        NOT Sigma(A) IMPLIES M(A) = 0)
      AND (FORALL (sets: point_set_sequence):
        ((FORALL (index: nat):
            Sigma(sets(index)))
          AND pairwise_disjoint(sets))
        IMPLIES
          converges_to_real(
            LAMBDA (count: nat):
              partial_measure_sum(M, sets, count),
            M(countable_union(sets))))

  tends_to_zero(u: nonnegative_sequence): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (cutoff: nat):
        FORALL (index: nat):
          cutoff <= index IMPLIES
            u(index) < epsilon_value

  real_open(A: real_set): bool =
    FORALL (value: real):
      A(value) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (other: real):
            abs(other - value) < radius IMPLIES A(other)

  preimage_real(f: real_function, A: real_set): point_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      A(f(x))

  continuous_real_function(
      open_sets: topology,
      f: real_function): bool =
    FORALL (A: real_set):
      real_open(A) IMPLIES
        open_sets(preimage_real(f, A))

  bounded_real_function(f: real_function): bool =
    EXISTS (bound: real):
      0 <= bound
        AND FORALL (x: E):
          abs(f(x)) <= bound

  bounded_continuous_function(
      open_sets: topology,
      f: real_function): bool =
    bounded_real_function(f)
      AND continuous_real_function(open_sets, f)

  finite_simple_value(
      coefficients: nonnegative_sequence,
      pieces: point_set_sequence,
      count: nat,
      x: E): RECURSIVE real =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      finite_simple_value(
        coefficients, pieces, count - 1, x)
        + IF pieces(count - 1)(x) THEN
            coefficients(count - 1)
          ELSE
            0
          ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  measurable_simple_minorant(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function,
      coefficients: nonnegative_sequence,
      pieces: point_set_sequence,
      count: nat): bool =
    pairwise_disjoint_below(pieces, count)
      AND (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES Sigma(pieces(index)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        0 <= function_value(x)
          AND finite_simple_value(
            coefficients, pieces, count, x)
            <= function_value(x))

  finite_simple_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      coefficients: nonnegative_sequence,
      pieces: point_set_sequence,
      count: nat): real =
    finite_real_sum(
      LAMBDA (index: nat):
        coefficients(index) * M(pieces(index)),
      count)

  nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function,
      upper: real): bool =
    FORALL
        (coefficients: nonnegative_sequence),
        (pieces: point_set_sequence),
        (count: nat):
      measurable_simple_minorant(
        Sigma, function_value, coefficients, pieces, count)
      IMPLIES
        finite_simple_integral(
          M, coefficients, pieces, count) <= upper

  has_nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function,
      value: real): bool =
    0 <= value
      AND nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
        M, Sigma, function_value, value)
      AND (FORALL (upper: real):
        nonnegative_integral_upper_bound(
          M, Sigma, function_value, upper)
        IMPLIES value <= upper)

  nonnegative_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      function_value: real_function): real =
    epsilon(
      LAMBDA (value: real):
        has_nonnegative_integral(
          M, Sigma, function_value, value))

  positive_part(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      IF 0 <= f(x) THEN f(x) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  negative_part(f: real_function): real_function =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      IF f(x) <= 0 THEN -f(x) ELSE 0 ENDIF

  lebesgue_integral(
      M: measure_map,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      f: real_function): real =
    nonnegative_integral(M, Sigma, positive_part(f))
      - nonnegative_integral(M, Sigma, negative_part(f))

  measure_carrier(Sigma: sigma_algebra): measure_set =
    LAMBDA (M: measure_map):
      is_finite_measure(M, Sigma)

  measure_subset(A, B: measure_set): bool =
    FORALL (M: measure_map):
      A(M) IMPLIES B(M)

  weakly_open_measure_set(
      open_sets: topology,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      U: measure_set): bool =
    measure_subset(U, measure_carrier(Sigma))
      AND FORALL (M: measure_map):
        U(M) IMPLIES
          EXISTS
              (count: nat),
              (functions: real_function_sequence),
              (targets: real_set_sequence):
            (FORALL (index: nat):
              index < count IMPLIES
                bounded_continuous_function(
                  open_sets, functions(index))
                  AND real_open(targets(index))
                  AND targets(index)(
                    lebesgue_integral(
                      M, Sigma, functions(index))))
              AND (FORALL (N: measure_map):
                is_finite_measure(N, Sigma)
                  AND (FORALL (index: nat):
                    index < count IMPLIES
                      targets(index)(
                        lebesgue_integral(
                          N, Sigma, functions(index))))
                IMPLIES U(N))

  measure_open_cover(
      open_sets: topology,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      cover: measure_set_family,
      A: measure_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: measure_set):
      cover(U) IMPLIES
        weakly_open_measure_set(open_sets, Sigma, U))
      AND (FORALL (M: measure_map):
        A(M) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: measure_set):
            cover(U) AND U(M))

  measure_finite_subcover(
      cover: measure_set_family,
      A: measure_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: measure_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES cover(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (M: measure_map):
          A(M) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(M))

  weakly_compact_measure_set(
      open_sets: topology,
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      A: measure_set): bool =
    measure_subset(A, measure_carrier(Sigma))
      AND FORALL (cover: measure_set_family):
        measure_open_cover(
          open_sets, Sigma, cover, A)
        IMPLIES measure_finite_subcover(cover, A)

  bounded_tight_measure_set(
      Sigma: sigma_algebra,
      C: nonnegative_real,
      u: nonnegative_sequence,
      K: point_set_sequence): measure_set =
    LAMBDA (M: measure_map):
      is_finite_measure(M, Sigma)
        AND M(full_set) <= C
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          M(point_complement(K(index))) <= u(index))

  prokhorov_s_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
        (open_sets: topology),
        (Sigma: sigma_algebra),
        (C: nonnegative_real),
        (u: nonnegative_sequence),
        (K: point_set_sequence):
      (topology_laws(open_sets)
        AND hausdorff_space(open_sets)
        AND generated_borel_sigma(open_sets, Sigma)
        AND tends_to_zero(u)
        AND (FORALL (index: nat):
          compact_set(open_sets, K(index)))
        AND (normal_space(open_sets) OR monotone_sets(K)))
      IMPLIES
        weakly_compact_measure_set(
          open_sets,
          Sigma,
          bounded_tight_measure_set(Sigma, C, u, K))
END Q7249519_prokhorov_s_theorem

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q727102
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q727102), "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)":
-- the derivative of a real-valued function at a local extremum is zero, both
-- for functions on real normed spaces and for real functions. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Add

@[expose] public section

universe u

namespace Q727102

section Frechet

variable {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  {f : E → ℝ} {a : E}

/-- Fermat's theorem for the Fréchet derivative at a local extremum. -/
theorem fderiv_eq_zero (h : IsLocalExtr f a) : fderiv ℝ f a = 0 := sorry

end Frechet

section Real

variable {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a : ℝ}

/-- Fermat's theorem for the derivative of a real function at a local extremum. -/
theorem deriv_eq_zero (h : IsLocalExtr f a) : deriv f a = 0 := sorry

end Real

end Q727102

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q727102
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q727102), "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)":
  the totalized derivative of a real-valued function at a local extremum is
  zero, both on arbitrary real normed vector spaces and on the real line.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals ClassicalDescription ClassicalEpsilon.

Set Universe Polymorphism.

Open Scope R_scope.

Record q727102_real_normed_vector_space : Type := {
  q727102_carrier : Type;
  q727102_zero : q727102_carrier;
  q727102_add :
    q727102_carrier -> q727102_carrier -> q727102_carrier;
  q727102_opp :
    q727102_carrier -> q727102_carrier;
  q727102_smul :
    R -> q727102_carrier -> q727102_carrier;
  q727102_norm :
    q727102_carrier -> R;
  q727102_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_add x (q727102_add y z) =
      q727102_add (q727102_add x y) z;
  q727102_add_comm :
    forall x y : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_add x y = q727102_add y x;
  q727102_add_zero :
    forall x : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_add x q727102_zero = x;
  q727102_add_opp :
    forall x : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_add x (q727102_opp x) = q727102_zero;
  q727102_smul_one :
    forall x : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_smul 1 x = x;
  q727102_smul_assoc :
    forall (r s : R) (x : q727102_carrier),
      q727102_smul r (q727102_smul s x) =
      q727102_smul (r * s) x;
  q727102_smul_add :
    forall (r : R) (x y : q727102_carrier),
      q727102_smul r (q727102_add x y) =
      q727102_add (q727102_smul r x) (q727102_smul r y);
  q727102_add_smul :
    forall (r s : R) (x : q727102_carrier),
      q727102_smul (r + s) x =
      q727102_add (q727102_smul r x) (q727102_smul s x);
  q727102_norm_nonneg :
    forall x : q727102_carrier,
      0 <= q727102_norm x;
  q727102_norm_eq_zero :
    forall x : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_norm x = 0 <-> x = q727102_zero;
  q727102_norm_triangle :
    forall x y : q727102_carrier,
      q727102_norm (q727102_add x y) <=
      q727102_norm x + q727102_norm y;
  q727102_norm_smul :
    forall (r : R) (x : q727102_carrier),
      q727102_norm (q727102_smul r x) =
      Rabs r * q727102_norm x
}.

Definition q727102_sub
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (x y : q727102_carrier E) : q727102_carrier E :=
  q727102_add E x (q727102_opp E y).

Definition q727102_is_local_min
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (f : q727102_carrier E -> R)
    (a : q727102_carrier E) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R,
    0 < radius /\
    forall x : q727102_carrier E,
      q727102_norm E (q727102_sub E x a) < radius ->
      f a <= f x.

Definition q727102_is_local_max
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (f : q727102_carrier E -> R)
    (a : q727102_carrier E) : Prop :=
  exists radius : R,
    0 < radius /\
    forall x : q727102_carrier E,
      q727102_norm E (q727102_sub E x a) < radius ->
      f x <= f a.

Definition q727102_is_local_extr
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (f : q727102_carrier E -> R)
    (a : q727102_carrier E) : Prop :=
  q727102_is_local_min E f a \/ q727102_is_local_max E f a.

Definition q727102_is_continuous_linear
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (L : q727102_carrier E -> R) : Prop :=
  (forall x y : q727102_carrier E,
      L (q727102_add E x y) = L x + L y) /\
  (forall (r : R) (x : q727102_carrier E),
      L (q727102_smul E r x) = r * L x) /\
  exists bound : R,
    0 <= bound /\
    forall x : q727102_carrier E,
      Rabs (L x) <= bound * q727102_norm E x.

Definition q727102_has_fderiv_at
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (f : q727102_carrier E -> R)
    (a : q727102_carrier E)
    (L : q727102_carrier E -> R) : Prop :=
  q727102_is_continuous_linear E L /\
  forall epsilon : R,
    0 < epsilon ->
    exists delta : R,
      0 < delta /\
      forall h : q727102_carrier E,
        q727102_norm E h < delta ->
        Rabs
          (f (q727102_add E a h) - f a - L h) <=
        epsilon * q727102_norm E h.

Definition q727102_fderiv
    (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
    (f : q727102_carrier E -> R)
    (a : q727102_carrier E) : q727102_carrier E -> R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists L : q727102_carrier E -> R,
            q727102_has_fderiv_at E f a L) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon
        (inhabits (fun _ : q727102_carrier E => 0))
        (fun L : q727102_carrier E -> R =>
          q727102_has_fderiv_at E f a L)
  | right _ => fun _ : q727102_carrier E => 0
  end.

Theorem IsLocalExtr_fderiv_eq_zero :
  forall (E : q727102_real_normed_vector_space)
         (f : q727102_carrier E -> R)
         (a : q727102_carrier E),
    q727102_is_local_extr E f a ->
    forall direction : q727102_carrier E,
      q727102_fderiv E f a direction = 0.
Admitted.

Definition q727102_is_local_extr_real
    (f : R -> R) (a : R) : Prop :=
  (exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall x : R,
        Rabs (x - a) < radius ->
        f a <= f x) \/
  (exists radius : R,
      0 < radius /\
      forall x : R,
        Rabs (x - a) < radius ->
        f x <= f a).

Definition q727102_deriv
    (f : R -> R) (a : R) : R :=
  match excluded_middle_informative
          (exists derivative : R,
            derivable_pt_lim f a derivative) with
  | left _ =>
      epsilon
        (inhabits 0)
        (fun derivative : R =>
          derivable_pt_lim f a derivative)
  | right _ => 0
  end.

Theorem IsLocalExtr_deriv_eq_zero :
  forall (f : R -> R) (a : R),
    q727102_is_local_extr_real f a ->
    q727102_deriv f a = 0.
Admitted.

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q727102, "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)": at a local minimum or
  maximum, the totalized real derivative and the totalized Frechet derivative
  of a real-valued function on an arbitrary real normed vector space are zero.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Derivative"
begin

definition q727102_is_local_extr ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q727102_is_local_extr f a \<longleftrightarrow>
    eventually (\<lambda>x. f a \<le> f x) (nhds a) \<or>
    eventually (\<lambda>x. f x \<le> f a) (nhds a)"

definition q727102_fderiv ::
    "('a::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> real)" where
  "q727102_fderiv f a =
    (if \<exists>D. (f has_derivative D) (at a)
     then (SOME D. (f has_derivative D) (at a))
     else (\<lambda>_. 0))"

definition q727102_deriv ::
    "(real \<Rightarrow> real) \<Rightarrow> real \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q727102_deriv f a =
    (if \<exists>d. DERIV f a :> d then (SOME d. DERIV f a :> d) else 0)"

theorem IsLocalExtr_fderiv_eq_zero:
  fixes f :: "'a::real_normed_vector \<Rightarrow> real"
    and a :: 'a
  assumes "q727102_is_local_extr f a"
  shows "q727102_fderiv f a = (\<lambda>_. 0)"
  sorry

theorem IsLocalExtr_deriv_eq_zero:
  fixes f :: "real \<Rightarrow> real"
    and a :: real
  assumes "q727102_is_local_extr f a"
  shows "q727102_deriv f a = 0"
  sorry

end

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q727102,
  "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)": the totalized Frechet derivative of
  a real-valued function on a real normed vector space, and in particular its
  totalized real derivative, vanishes at a local extremum. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q727102_FERMAT_S_THEOREM_STATIONARY_POINTS =
 `let normed_real_vector_space =
    \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A)
     (smul:real->A->A) (normA:A->real).
       (!x y z:A. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:A. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:A. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!c d:real. !x:A. smul (c * d) x = smul c (smul d x)) /\
       (!c d:real. !x:A.
          smul (c + d) x = add (smul c x) (smul d x)) /\
       (!c:real. !x y:A.
          smul c (add x y) = add (smul c x) (smul c y)) /\
       normA zero = &0 /\
       (!x:A. &0 <= normA x) /\
       (!x:A. normA x = &0 <=> x = zero) /\
       (!x:A. normA (neg x) = normA x) /\
       (!x y:A. normA (add x y) <= normA x + normA y) /\
       (!c:real. !x:A. normA (smul c x) = abs c * normA x) in
  let continuous_linear_functional =
    \(add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (normA:A->real)
     (d:A->real).
       (!x y:A. d (add x y) = d x + d y) /\
       (!c:real. !x:A. d (smul c x) = c * d x) /\
       (?bound:real.
          &0 <= bound /\
          !x:A. abs(d x) <= bound * normA x) in
  let has_frechet_derivative =
    \(add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (normA:A->real)
     (f:A->real) (d:A->real) (a:A).
       continuous_linear_functional add smul normA d /\
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !h:A.
                 &0 < normA h /\ normA h < delta
                 ==> abs(f (add a h) - f a - d h) / normA h < epsilon in
  let local_extremum =
    \(add:A->A->A) (neg:A->A) (normA:A->real)
     (f:A->real) (a:A).
       (?radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          !x:A.
            normA (add x (neg a)) < radius ==> f a <= f x) \/
       (?radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          !x:A.
            normA (add x (neg a)) < radius ==> f x <= f a) in
  let total_frechet_derivative =
    \(add:A->A->A) (smul:real->A->A) (normA:A->real)
     (f:A->real) (a:A).
       if ?d:A->real. has_frechet_derivative add smul normA f d a
       then @d:A->real. has_frechet_derivative add smul normA f d a
       else \h:A. &0 in
  let has_real_derivative =
    \(f:real->real) (d:real) (a:real).
       !epsilon:real.
         &0 < epsilon
         ==> ?delta:real.
               &0 < delta /\
               !h:real.
                 &0 < abs h /\ abs h < delta
                 ==> abs((f (a + h) - f a) / h - d) < epsilon in
  let real_local_extremum =
    \(f:real->real) (a:real).
       (?radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          !x:real. abs(x - a) < radius ==> f a <= f x) \/
       (?radius:real.
          &0 < radius /\
          !x:real. abs(x - a) < radius ==> f x <= f a) in
  let total_real_derivative =
    \(f:real->real) (a:real).
       if ?d:real. has_real_derivative f d a
       then @d:real. has_real_derivative f d a
       else &0 in
  ((!zero:A. !add:A->A->A. !neg:A->A.
    !smul:real->A->A. !normA:A->real.
    !f:A->real. !a:A.
      normed_real_vector_space zero add neg smul normA /\
      local_extremum add neg normA f a
      ==> total_frechet_derivative add smul normA f a = (\h:A. &0))
   /\
   (!f:real->real. !a:real.
      real_local_extremum f a
      ==> total_real_derivative f a = &0))`;;

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q727102,
;; "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)": the totalized Frechet derivative
;; on a real normed space, and the totalized scalar derivative on the real
;; line, vanish at a local extremum. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent the real field, arbitrary real normed
;; spaces, functions, and continuous linear maps. The explicit laws below
;; present the real numbers as a Dedekind-complete ordered field. Local extrema
;; and derivatives are expanded by equivalent metric epsilon-delta conditions.

(defstub q727102-real-p (real value) t)
(defstub q727102-real-set-member-p (real set value) t)
(defstub q727102-r-zero (real) t)
(defstub q727102-r-one (real) t)
(defstub q727102-r-add (real left right) t)
(defstub q727102-r-mul (real left right) t)
(defstub q727102-r-neg (real value) t)
(defstub q727102-r-inv (real value) t)
(defstub q727102-r-lt (real left right) t)

(defstub q727102-vector-p (space value) t)
(defstub q727102-v-zero (space) t)
(defstub q727102-v-add (space left right) t)
(defstub q727102-v-neg (space value) t)
(defstub q727102-v-smul (real space scalar vector) t)
(defstub q727102-v-norm (real space vector) t)

(defstub q727102-function-value (function argument) t)
(defstub q727102-linear-value (linear-map argument) t)

(defun q727102-r-sub (real left right)
  (q727102-r-add real left (q727102-r-neg real right)))

(defun q727102-r-le (real left right)
  (not (q727102-r-lt real right left)))

(defun q727102-r-abs (real value)
  (if (q727102-r-lt real value (q727102-r-zero real))
      (q727102-r-neg real value)
    value))

(defun q727102-positive-real-p (real value)
  (and
   (q727102-real-p real value)
   (q727102-r-lt
    real (q727102-r-zero real) value)))

(defun q727102-v-sub (space left right)
  (q727102-v-add space left (q727102-v-neg space right)))

;; A Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation of the real field.

(defun-sk q727102-field-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real x)
      (q727102-real-p real y)
      (q727102-real-p real z))
     (let* ((zero (q727102-r-zero real))
            (one (q727102-r-one real))
            (xy-add (q727102-r-add real x y))
            (yz-add (q727102-r-add real y z))
            (xy-mul (q727102-r-mul real x y))
            (yz-mul (q727102-r-mul real y z))
            (neg-x (q727102-r-neg real x))
            (inv-x (q727102-r-inv real x)))
       (and
        (q727102-real-p real xy-add)
        (q727102-real-p real xy-mul)
        (q727102-real-p real neg-x)
        (q727102-real-p real inv-x)
        (equal
         (q727102-r-add real xy-add z)
         (q727102-r-add real x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q727102-r-add real y x))
        (equal (q727102-r-add real x zero) x)
        (equal (q727102-r-add real x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q727102-r-mul real xy-mul z)
         (q727102-r-mul real x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q727102-r-mul real y x))
        (equal (q727102-r-mul real x one) x)
        (equal (q727102-r-inv real zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q727102-r-mul real x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q727102-r-mul real x yz-add)
         (q727102-r-add
          real
          (q727102-r-mul real x y)
          (q727102-r-mul real x z))))))))

(defun-sk q727102-order-laws-p (real)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real x)
      (q727102-real-p real y)
      (q727102-real-p real z))
     (and
      (not (q727102-r-lt real x x))
      (or
       (q727102-r-lt real x y)
       (equal x y)
       (q727102-r-lt real y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q727102-r-lt real x y)
        (q727102-r-lt real y z))
       (q727102-r-lt real x z))
      (implies
       (q727102-r-lt real x y)
       (q727102-r-lt
        real
        (q727102-r-add real x z)
        (q727102-r-add real y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q727102-r-lt
         real (q727102-r-zero real) x)
        (q727102-r-lt
         real (q727102-r-zero real) y))
       (q727102-r-lt
        real
        (q727102-r-zero real)
        (q727102-r-mul real x y)))))))

(defun-sk q727102-valid-real-set-p (real set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q727102-real-set-member-p real set x)
     (q727102-real-p real x))))

(defun-sk q727102-real-set-nonempty-p (real set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q727102-real-p real x)
     (q727102-real-set-member-p real set x))))

(defun-sk q727102-upper-bound-p (real set bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q727102-real-set-member-p real set x)
     (q727102-r-le real x bound))))

(defun-sk q727102-bounded-above-p (real set)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q727102-real-p real bound)
     (q727102-upper-bound-p real set bound))))

(defun-sk q727102-least-upper-bound-p
    (real set supremum)
  (forall (bound)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real bound)
      (q727102-upper-bound-p real set bound))
     (q727102-r-le real supremum bound))))

(defun q727102-supremum-p (real set supremum)
  (and
   (q727102-real-p real supremum)
   (q727102-upper-bound-p real set supremum)
   (q727102-least-upper-bound-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q727102-supremum-exists-p (real set)
  (exists (supremum)
    (q727102-supremum-p real set supremum)))

(defun-sk q727102-dedekind-complete-p (real)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-valid-real-set-p real set)
      (q727102-real-set-nonempty-p real set)
      (q727102-bounded-above-p real set))
     (q727102-supremum-exists-p real set))))

(defun q727102-real-structure-p (real)
  (and
   (q727102-real-p real (q727102-r-zero real))
   (q727102-real-p real (q727102-r-one real))
   (not
    (equal
     (q727102-r-zero real)
     (q727102-r-one real)))
   (q727102-r-lt
    real
    (q727102-r-zero real)
    (q727102-r-one real))
   (q727102-field-laws-p real)
   (q727102-order-laws-p real)
   (q727102-dedekind-complete-p real)))

;; Arbitrary real normed vector spaces.

(defun-sk q727102-additive-group-laws-p (space)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-vector-p space y)
      (q727102-vector-p space z))
     (let* ((zero (q727102-v-zero space))
            (xy (q727102-v-add space x y))
            (yz (q727102-v-add space y z))
            (neg-x (q727102-v-neg space x)))
       (and
        (q727102-vector-p space zero)
        (q727102-vector-p space xy)
        (q727102-vector-p space neg-x)
        (equal
         (q727102-v-add space xy z)
         (q727102-v-add space x yz))
        (equal xy (q727102-v-add space y x))
        (equal (q727102-v-add space x zero) x)
        (equal (q727102-v-add space x neg-x) zero))))))

(defun-sk q727102-scalar-action-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a b x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real a)
      (q727102-real-p real b)
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-vector-p space y))
     (let ((ax (q727102-v-smul real space a x))
           (bx (q727102-v-smul real space b x)))
       (and
        (q727102-vector-p space ax)
        (equal
         (q727102-v-smul
          real space (q727102-r-one real) x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q727102-v-smul
          real space
          (q727102-r-mul real a b)
          x)
         (q727102-v-smul real space a bx))
        (equal
         (q727102-v-smul
          real space
          (q727102-r-add real a b)
          x)
         (q727102-v-add space ax bx))
        (equal
         (q727102-v-smul
          real space a
          (q727102-v-add space x y))
         (q727102-v-add
          space
          ax
          (q727102-v-smul real space a y))))))))

(defun-sk q727102-norm-laws-p (real space)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real a)
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-vector-p space y))
     (let ((nx (q727102-v-norm real space x))
           (ny (q727102-v-norm real space y)))
       (and
        (q727102-real-p real nx)
        (q727102-r-le
         real (q727102-r-zero real) nx)
        (iff
         (equal nx (q727102-r-zero real))
         (equal x (q727102-v-zero space)))
        (equal
         (q727102-v-norm
          real space
          (q727102-v-smul real space a x))
         (q727102-r-mul
          real (q727102-r-abs real a) nx))
        (q727102-r-le
         real
         (q727102-v-norm
          real space
          (q727102-v-add space x y))
         (q727102-r-add real nx ny)))))))

(defun q727102-real-normed-space-p (real space)
  (and
   (q727102-vector-p space (q727102-v-zero space))
   (q727102-additive-group-laws-p space)
   (q727102-scalar-action-laws-p real space)
   (q727102-norm-laws-p real space)))

;; Arbitrary functions E -> R and continuous real-linear maps E -> R.

(defun-sk q727102-vector-function-p (real space function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q727102-vector-p space x)
     (q727102-real-p
      real
      (q727102-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q727102-linear-laws-p
    (real space linear-map)
  (forall (a x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real a)
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-vector-p space y))
     (and
      (q727102-real-p
       real
       (q727102-linear-value linear-map x))
      (equal
       (q727102-linear-value
        linear-map
        (q727102-v-add space x y))
       (q727102-r-add
        real
        (q727102-linear-value linear-map x)
        (q727102-linear-value linear-map y)))
      (equal
       (q727102-linear-value
        linear-map
        (q727102-v-smul real space a x))
       (q727102-r-mul
        real a
        (q727102-linear-value linear-map x)))))))

(defun-sk q727102-linear-bound-p
    (real space linear-map bound)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q727102-vector-p space x)
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-r-abs
       real
       (q727102-linear-value linear-map x))
      (q727102-r-mul
       real
       bound
       (q727102-v-norm real space x))))))

(defun-sk q727102-linear-bound-exists-p
    (real space linear-map)
  (exists (bound)
    (and
     (q727102-real-p real bound)
     (q727102-r-le
      real (q727102-r-zero real) bound)
     (q727102-linear-bound-p
      real space linear-map bound))))

(defun q727102-continuous-linear-map-p
    (real space linear-map)
  (and
   (q727102-linear-laws-p real space linear-map)
   (q727102-linear-bound-exists-p
    real space linear-map)))

;; Local minima and maxima use open metric balls, a neighborhood basis for
;; the norm topology. Their disjunction is mathlib's IsLocalExtr.

(defun-sk q727102-vector-local-min-neighborhood-p
    (real space function point radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-r-lt
       real
       (q727102-v-norm
        real space
        (q727102-v-sub space x point))
       radius))
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-function-value function point)
      (q727102-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q727102-vector-local-min-p
    (real space function point)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q727102-positive-real-p real radius)
     (q727102-vector-local-min-neighborhood-p
      real space function point radius))))

(defun-sk q727102-vector-local-max-neighborhood-p
    (real space function point radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-r-lt
       real
       (q727102-v-norm
        real space
        (q727102-v-sub space x point))
       radius))
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-function-value function x)
      (q727102-function-value function point)))))

(defun-sk q727102-vector-local-max-p
    (real space function point)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q727102-positive-real-p real radius)
     (q727102-vector-local-max-neighborhood-p
      real space function point radius))))

(defun q727102-vector-local-extr-p
    (real space function point)
  (or
   (q727102-vector-local-min-p
    real space function point)
   (q727102-vector-local-max-p
    real space function point)))

;; Frechet differentiability E -> R, expanded by the epsilon-delta remainder
;; estimate. DEFCHOOSE retains a derivative internally when one exists.

(defun q727102-fderiv-remainder
    (real space function point linear-map x)
  (q727102-r-sub
   real
   (q727102-r-sub
    real
    (q727102-function-value function x)
    (q727102-function-value function point))
   (q727102-linear-value
    linear-map
    (q727102-v-sub space x point))))

(defun-sk q727102-fderiv-neighborhood-p
    (real space function point linear-map epsilon radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-vector-p space x)
      (q727102-r-lt
       real
       (q727102-v-norm
        real space
        (q727102-v-sub space x point))
       radius))
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-r-abs
       real
       (q727102-fderiv-remainder
        real space function point linear-map x))
      (q727102-r-mul
       real
       epsilon
       (q727102-v-norm
        real space
        (q727102-v-sub space x point)))))))

(defun-sk q727102-fderiv-radius-exists-p
    (real space function point linear-map epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q727102-positive-real-p real radius)
     (q727102-fderiv-neighborhood-p
      real space function point linear-map
      epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q727102-fderiv-limit-p
    (real space function point linear-map)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q727102-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (q727102-fderiv-radius-exists-p
      real space function point linear-map epsilon))))

(defun q727102-has-fderiv-at-p
    (real space function point linear-map)
  (and
   (q727102-vector-p space point)
   (q727102-continuous-linear-map-p
    real space linear-map)
   (q727102-fderiv-limit-p
    real space function point linear-map)))

(defun-sk q727102-differentiable-at-p
    (real space function point)
  (exists (linear-map)
    (q727102-has-fderiv-at-p
     real space function point linear-map)))

(defchoose q727102-fderiv-choice
    (linear-map)
    (real space function point)
  (q727102-has-fderiv-at-p
   real space function point linear-map))

(defun q727102-fderiv-apply
    (real space function point direction)
  (if
      (q727102-differentiable-at-p
       real space function point)
      (q727102-linear-value
       (q727102-fderiv-choice
        real space function point)
       direction)
    (q727102-r-zero real)))

(defun-sk q727102-fderiv-eq-zero-p
    (real space function point)
  (forall (direction)
    (implies
     (q727102-vector-p space direction)
     (equal
      (q727102-fderiv-apply
       real space function point direction)
      (q727102-r-zero real)))))

;; The scalar specialization R -> R, including mathlib's totalized deriv.

(defun-sk q727102-real-function-p (real function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q727102-real-p real x)
     (q727102-real-p
      real
      (q727102-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q727102-real-local-min-neighborhood-p
    (real function point radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real x)
      (q727102-r-lt
       real
       (q727102-r-abs
        real
        (q727102-r-sub real x point))
       radius))
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-function-value function point)
      (q727102-function-value function x)))))

(defun-sk q727102-real-local-min-p
    (real function point)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q727102-positive-real-p real radius)
     (q727102-real-local-min-neighborhood-p
      real function point radius))))

(defun-sk q727102-real-local-max-neighborhood-p
    (real function point radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real x)
      (q727102-r-lt
       real
       (q727102-r-abs
        real
        (q727102-r-sub real x point))
       radius))
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-function-value function x)
      (q727102-function-value function point)))))

(defun-sk q727102-real-local-max-p
    (real function point)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q727102-positive-real-p real radius)
     (q727102-real-local-max-neighborhood-p
      real function point radius))))

(defun q727102-real-local-extr-p
    (real function point)
  (or
   (q727102-real-local-min-p real function point)
   (q727102-real-local-max-p real function point)))

(defun q727102-deriv-remainder
    (real function point derivative x)
  (q727102-r-sub
   real
   (q727102-r-sub
    real
    (q727102-function-value function x)
    (q727102-function-value function point))
   (q727102-r-mul
    real derivative
    (q727102-r-sub real x point))))

(defun-sk q727102-deriv-neighborhood-p
    (real function point derivative epsilon radius)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real x)
      (q727102-r-lt
       real
       (q727102-r-abs
        real
        (q727102-r-sub real x point))
       radius))
     (q727102-r-le
      real
      (q727102-r-abs
       real
       (q727102-deriv-remainder
        real function point derivative x))
      (q727102-r-mul
       real
       epsilon
       (q727102-r-abs
        real
        (q727102-r-sub real x point)))))))

(defun-sk q727102-deriv-radius-exists-p
    (real function point derivative epsilon)
  (exists (radius)
    (and
     (q727102-positive-real-p real radius)
     (q727102-deriv-neighborhood-p
      real function point derivative epsilon radius))))

(defun-sk q727102-has-deriv-at-p
    (real function point derivative)
  (forall (epsilon)
    (implies
     (q727102-positive-real-p real epsilon)
     (and
      (q727102-real-p real point)
      (q727102-real-p real derivative)
      (q727102-deriv-radius-exists-p
       real function point derivative epsilon)))))

(defun-sk q727102-scalar-differentiable-at-p
    (real function point)
  (exists (derivative)
    (and
     (q727102-real-p real derivative)
     (q727102-has-deriv-at-p
      real function point derivative))))

(defchoose q727102-deriv-choice
    (derivative)
    (real function point)
  (and
   (q727102-real-p real derivative)
   (q727102-has-deriv-at-p
    real function point derivative)))

(defun q727102-deriv-value
    (real function point)
  (if
      (q727102-scalar-differentiable-at-p
       real function point)
      (q727102-deriv-choice real function point)
    (q727102-r-zero real)))

;; The two indexed mathlib declarations have independent universal scopes.

(defun-sk q727102-fderiv-eq-zero-statement-p ()
  (forall (real space function point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-structure-p real)
      (q727102-real-normed-space-p real space)
      (q727102-vector-function-p real space function)
      (q727102-vector-p space point)
      (q727102-vector-local-extr-p
       real space function point))
     (q727102-fderiv-eq-zero-p
      real space function point))))

(defun-sk q727102-deriv-eq-zero-statement-p ()
  (forall (real function point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q727102-real-structure-p real)
      (q727102-real-function-p real function)
      (q727102-real-p real point)
      (q727102-real-local-extr-p
       real function point))
     (equal
      (q727102-deriv-value real function point)
      (q727102-r-zero real)))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q727102-fermat-stationary-points-statement ()
  (and
   (q727102-fderiv-eq-zero-statement-p)
   (q727102-deriv-eq-zero-statement-p)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q727102,
-- "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)": the totalized scalar derivative
-- and Frechet derivative of a real-valued function at a local extremum are zero.
-- This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points where

open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom : Set where

Not : Set -> Set
Not proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom

_!=_ : {A : Set} -> A -> A -> Set
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Both10 (A : Set1) (B : Set) : Set1 where
  constructor both10
  field
    first10  : A
    second10 : B

data Either (A B : Set) : Set where
  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

data Either01 (A : Set) (B : Set1) : Set1 where
  left01  : A -> Either01 A B
  right01 : B -> Either01 A B

record Iff (A B : Set) : Set where
  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

record Exists (A : Set) (P : A -> Set) : Set where
  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR absoluteR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) -> addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) -> multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) -> multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) -> lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    absolute-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (absoluteR x)
    absolute-zeroR :
      absoluteR zeroR == zeroR
    absolute-zero-onlyR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR x == zeroR ->
      x == zeroR
    absolute-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      absoluteR (negateR x) == absoluteR x
    absolute-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR
        (absoluteR (addR x y))
        (addR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y))
    absolute-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      absoluteR (multiplyR x y) ==
      multiplyR (absoluteR x) (absoluteR y)
    absolute-of-nonnegativeR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      absoluteR x == x
    absolute-of-nonpositiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x zeroR ->
      absoluteR x == negateR x

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-additionR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m + n) == addR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-multiplicationR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (m * n) == multiplyR (fromNatR m) (fromNatR n)
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))

    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) : Set1 where
  field
    forwardR :
      R -> S
    backwardR :
      S -> R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) -> forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) -> backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-absoluteR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (absoluteR source x) ==
      absoluteR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Iff
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set2 where
  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

divideR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
divideR reals x y =
  multiplyR reals x (reciprocalR reals y)

StrictLess :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLess reals x y =
  Both (lessOrEqualR reals x y) (x != y)

Positive :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  Set
Positive reals x =
  StrictLess reals (zeroR reals) x

CloseToR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
CloseToR reals center radius point =
  StrictLess reals
    (absoluteR reals (subtractR reals point center))
    radius

record NormedVectorSpace
  (R E : Set)
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E
    normE : E -> R

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) -> addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) -> addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) -> addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) -> scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x == scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x == addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)

    norm-nonnegativeE :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (normE x)
    norm-zeroE :
      normE zeroE == zeroR reals
    norm-zero-onlyE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE x == zeroR reals ->
      x == zeroE
    norm-negateE :
      (x : E) ->
      normE (negateE x) == normE x
    norm-addE :
      (x y : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (normE (addE x y))
        (addR reals (normE x) (normE y))
    norm-scaleE :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      normE (scaleE a x) ==
      multiplyR reals (absoluteR reals a) (normE x)

open NormedVectorSpace

subtractE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  E
subtractE space x y =
  addE space x (negateE space y)

distanceE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
distanceE space x y =
  normE space (subtractE space x y)

CloseToE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  E ->
  R ->
  E ->
  Set
CloseToE {reals = reals} space center radius point =
  StrictLess reals (distanceE space point center) radius

record ContinuousLinearFunctional
  {R E : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) : Set1 where
  field
    apply :
      E -> R
    map-add :
      (x y : E) ->
      apply (addE space x y) ==
      addR reals (apply x) (apply y)
    map-scale :
      (a : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      apply (scaleE space a x) ==
      multiplyR reals a (apply x)
    operator-bound :
      R
    operator-bound-nonnegative :
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) operator-bound
    bounded :
      (x : E) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals
        (absoluteR reals (apply x))
        (multiplyR reals operator-bound (normE space x))

open ContinuousLinearFunctional

DerivativeRemainder :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (f : E -> R) ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional reals space ->
  E ->
  E ->
  R
DerivativeRemainder {reals = reals} space f derivative point y =
  subtractR reals
    (subtractR reals (f y) (f point))
    (apply derivative (subtractE space y point))

HasFDerivAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (f : E -> R) ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional reals space ->
  E ->
  Set
HasFDerivAt {R = R} {reals = reals} space f derivative point =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          CloseToE space point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals
            (absoluteR reals
              (DerivativeRemainder space f derivative point y))
            (multiplyR reals epsilon
              (distanceE space y point))))

IsLocalMinE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (E -> R) ->
  E ->
  Set
IsLocalMinE {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space f point =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : E) ->
          CloseToE space point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals (f point) (f y)))

IsLocalMaxE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (E -> R) ->
  E ->
  Set
IsLocalMaxE {R = R} {E = E} {reals = reals} space f point =
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : E) ->
          CloseToE space point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals (f y) (f point)))

IsLocalExtrE :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  NormedVectorSpace R E reals ->
  (E -> R) ->
  E ->
  Set
IsLocalExtrE space f point =
  Either
    (IsLocalMinE space f point)
    (IsLocalMaxE space f point)

FDerivativeEqualsZero :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional reals space ->
  Set
FDerivativeEqualsZero {E = E} {reals = reals} space derivative =
  (x : E) ->
  apply derivative x == zeroR reals

IsTotalizedFDerivativeAt :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (E -> R) ->
  E ->
  ContinuousLinearFunctional reals space ->
  Set1
IsTotalizedFDerivativeAt {reals = reals} space f point derivative =
  Either01
    (HasFDerivAt space f derivative point)
    (Both10
      ((candidate : ContinuousLinearFunctional reals space) ->
        Not (HasFDerivAt space f candidate point))
      (FDerivativeEqualsZero space derivative))

TotalizedFDerivativeEqualsZero :
  {R E : Set} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (E -> R) ->
  E ->
  Set1
TotalizedFDerivativeEqualsZero {E = E} {reals = reals}
  space f point =
  (derivative : ContinuousLinearFunctional reals space) ->
  IsTotalizedFDerivativeAt space f point derivative ->
  FDerivativeEqualsZero space derivative

differenceQuotient :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
differenceQuotient reals f point y =
  divideR reals
    (subtractR reals (f y) (f point))
    (subtractR reals y point)

DerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
DerivativeAt {R} reals f point derivative =
  (epsilon : R) ->
  Positive reals epsilon ->
  Exists R
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : R) ->
          CloseToR reals point radius y ->
          y != point ->
          CloseToR reals derivative epsilon
            (differenceQuotient reals f point y)))

IsLocalMinR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsLocalMinR reals f point =
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          CloseToR reals point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals (f point) (f y)))

IsLocalMaxR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsLocalMaxR reals f point =
  Exists _
    (\ radius ->
      Both
        (Positive reals radius)
        ((y : _) ->
          CloseToR reals point radius y ->
          lessOrEqualR reals (f y) (f point)))

IsLocalExtrR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
IsLocalExtrR reals f point =
  Either
    (IsLocalMinR reals f point)
    (IsLocalMaxR reals f point)

IsTotalizedDerivativeAt :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
IsTotalizedDerivativeAt {R} reals f point derivative =
  Either
    (DerivativeAt reals f point derivative)
    (Both
      (Not
        (Exists R
          (\ candidate ->
            DerivativeAt reals f point candidate)))
      (derivative == zeroR reals))

TotalizedDerivativeEqualsZero :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  (R -> R) ->
  R ->
  Set
TotalizedDerivativeEqualsZero reals f point =
  (derivative : _) ->
  IsTotalizedDerivativeAt reals f point derivative ->
  derivative == zeroR reals

fermat-fderiv-eq-zero : Set2
fermat-fderiv-eq-zero =
  (R E : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (space : NormedVectorSpace R E reals) ->
  (f : E -> R) ->
  (point : E) ->
  IsLocalExtrE space f point ->
  TotalizedFDerivativeEqualsZero space f point

fermat-deriv-eq-zero : Set2
fermat-deriv-eq-zero =
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (f : R -> R) ->
  (point : R) ->
  IsLocalExtrR reals f point ->
  TotalizedDerivativeEqualsZero reals f point

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q727102 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q727102), "Fermat's theorem (stationary
  points)": the totalized Frechet derivative of a real-valued function at a
  local extremum is zero, both on an arbitrary real normed vector space and
  for a real function of one real variable. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory;

val q727102_real_normed_space_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_real_normed_space_def",
  ``q727102_real_normed_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y z. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x. 0 <= norm x) /\
      (!x. norm x = 0 <=> x = zero) /\
      (!x y. norm (add x y) <= norm x + norm y) /\
      (!a x. norm (smul a x) = abs a * norm x)``);

val q727102_continuous_linear_functional_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_continuous_linear_functional_def",
  ``q727102_continuous_linear_functional
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (L : 'e -> real) <=>
      (!x y. L (add x y) = L x + L y) /\
      (!c x. L (smul c x) = c * L x) /\
      ?C : real.
        0 <= C /\
        !x. abs (L x) <= C * norm x``);

val q727102_has_fderiv_at_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_has_fderiv_at_def",
  ``q727102_has_fderiv_at
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'e -> real) (L : 'e -> real) (a : 'e) <=>
      q727102_continuous_linear_functional add smul norm L /\
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !x : 'e.
            norm (add x (neg a)) < delta ==>
            abs
              (f x - f a - L (add x (neg a))) <=
            epsilon * norm (add x (neg a))``);

val q727102_fderiv_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_fderiv_def",
  ``q727102_fderiv
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'e -> real) (a : 'e) =
      if ?L : 'e -> real.
           q727102_has_fderiv_at add neg smul norm f L a
      then
        @L. q727102_has_fderiv_at add neg smul norm f L a
      else
        \x : 'e. 0``);

val q727102_is_local_min_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_is_local_min_def",
  ``q727102_is_local_min
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'e -> real) (a : 'e) <=>
      ?radius : real.
        0 < radius /\
        !x : 'e.
          norm (add x (neg a)) < radius ==>
          f a <= f x``);

val q727102_is_local_max_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_is_local_max_def",
  ``q727102_is_local_max
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'e -> real) (a : 'e) <=>
      ?radius : real.
        0 < radius /\
        !x : 'e.
          norm (add x (neg a)) < radius ==>
          f x <= f a``);

val q727102_is_local_extr_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_is_local_extr_def",
  ``q727102_is_local_extr
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (norm : 'e -> real) (f : 'e -> real) (a : 'e) <=>
      q727102_is_local_min add neg norm f a \/
      q727102_is_local_max add neg norm f a``);

val IsLocalExtr_fderiv_eq_zero =
  ``!(zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (norm : 'e -> real)
      (f : 'e -> real) (a : 'e).
      q727102_real_normed_space zero add neg smul norm /\
      q727102_is_local_extr add neg norm f a
      ==>
      q727102_fderiv add neg smul norm f a = (\x : 'e. 0)``;

val q727102_has_deriv_at_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_has_deriv_at_def",
  ``q727102_has_deriv_at
      (f : real -> real) (fprime : real) (a : real) <=>
      !epsilon : real.
        0 < epsilon ==>
        ?delta : real.
          0 < delta /\
          !x : real.
            abs (x - a) < delta ==>
            abs (f x - f a - fprime * (x - a)) <=
              epsilon * abs (x - a)``);

val q727102_deriv_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_deriv_def",
  ``q727102_deriv (f : real -> real) (a : real) =
      if ?fprime : real. q727102_has_deriv_at f fprime a
      then @fprime. q727102_has_deriv_at f fprime a
      else 0``);

val q727102_is_real_local_extr_def = new_definition (
  "q727102_is_real_local_extr_def",
  ``q727102_is_real_local_extr
      (f : real -> real) (a : real) <=>
      (?radius : real.
        0 < radius /\
        !x : real. abs (x - a) < radius ==> f a <= f x) \/
      (?radius : real.
        0 < radius /\
        !x : real. abs (x - a) < radius ==> f x <= f a)``);

val IsLocalExtr_deriv_eq_zero =
  ``!(f : real -> real) (a : real).
      q727102_is_real_local_extr f a ==>
      q727102_deriv f a = 0``;

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q727102
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q727102), "Fermat's theorem (stationary
  points)": the totalized Frechet derivative of a real-valued function on an
  arbitrary real normed vector space, and the totalized ordinary derivative
  of a real function, vanish at every local extremum. This file contains no
  proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q727102LocalExtr expands IsLocalExtr using a positive norm-ball radius.
  Q727102ContinuousLinear represents a bounded real-linear functional as its
  underlying total function, and Q727102HasFDerivAt is the epsilon-delta
  Frechet remainder estimate.

  Q727102FDeriv selects the unique Frechet derivative when it exists and is
  unique, and otherwise returns the zero function. Equality with the displayed
  zero function is therefore extensionally equivalent to Mathlib's equality
  of continuous linear maps. Q727102LocalExtrReal is the scalar specialization,
  while Q727102Deriv totalizes SetMM's partial real derivative by returning
  zero where no derivative exists. These totalizations exactly match the
  source fderiv and deriv conventions.

  The two final $a declarations are the indexed unproved corpus statements.
  Every preceding $a declaration is syntax or an explicit definition, and
  this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q727102Sub Q727102LocalExtr Q727102ContinuousLinear
   Q727102HasFDerivAt Q727102FDeriv Q727102LocalExtrReal
   Q727102Deriv $.

q727102-sub-syntax $a class ( Q727102Sub V x y ) $.
q727102-local-extr-syntax
  $a wff ( Q727102LocalExtr V F A ) $.
q727102-continuous-linear-syntax
  $a wff ( Q727102ContinuousLinear V L ) $.
q727102-has-fderiv-at-syntax
  $a wff ( Q727102HasFDerivAt V F A L ) $.
q727102-fderiv-syntax
  $a class ( Q727102FDeriv V F A ) $.
q727102-local-extr-real-syntax
  $a wff ( Q727102LocalExtrReal F A ) $.
q727102-deriv-syntax
  $a class ( Q727102Deriv F A ) $.

${
  $d V x y $.

  q727102-sub-definition $a |- (
    Q727102Sub V x y
  ) = (
    x
    ( +g ` V )
    ( ( -g ` V ) ` y )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F V d y $.

  q727102-local-extr-definition $a |- (
    ( Q727102LocalExtr V F A )
    <->
    (
      (
        F e. ( RR ^m ( Base ` V ) )
        /\
        A e. ( Base ` V )
      )
      /\
      (
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              (
                ( norm ` V )
                `
                ( Q727102Sub V y A )
              )
              <
              d
              ->
              ( F ` A ) <_ ( F ` y )
            )
        \/
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              (
                ( norm ` V )
                `
                ( Q727102Sub V y A )
              )
              <
              d
              ->
              ( F ` y ) <_ ( F ` A )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d C L V r u v $.

  q727102-continuous-linear-definition $a |- (
    ( Q727102ContinuousLinear V L )
    <->
    (
      L e. ( RR ^m ( Base ` V ) )
      /\
      (
        A. u e. ( Base ` V )
          A. v e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              L
              `
              (
                u
                ( +g ` V )
                v
              )
            )
            =
            (
              ( L ` u )
              +
              ( L ` v )
            )
        /\
        A. r e. RR
          A. u e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              L
              `
              (
                r
                ( .s ` V )
                u
              )
            )
            =
            (
              r
              x.
              ( L ` u )
            )
        /\
        E. C e. ( 0 [,) +oo )
          A. u e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              abs
              `
              ( L ` u )
            )
            <_
            (
              C
              x.
              (
                ( norm ` V )
                `
                u
              )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F L V d e y $.

  q727102-has-fderiv-at-definition $a |- (
    ( Q727102HasFDerivAt V F A L )
    <->
    (
      (
        F e. ( RR ^m ( Base ` V ) )
        /\
        A e. ( Base ` V )
        /\
        ( Q727102ContinuousLinear V L )
      )
      /\
      A. e e. RR+
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. ( Base ` V )
            (
              (
                (
                  ( norm ` V )
                  `
                  ( Q727102Sub V y A )
                )
                <
                d
              )
              ->
              (
                abs
                `
                (
                  (
                    ( F ` y )
                    -
                    ( F ` A )
                  )
                  -
                  (
                    L
                    `
                    ( Q727102Sub V y A )
                  )
                )
              )
              <_
              (
                e
                x.
                (
                  ( norm ` V )
                  `
                  ( Q727102Sub V y A )
                )
              )
            )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F L V u $.

  q727102-fderiv-definition $a |- (
    Q727102FDeriv V F A
  ) =
    if
    (
      E! L e. ( RR ^m ( Base ` V ) )
        ( Q727102HasFDerivAt V F A L ) ,
      (
        iota_ L e. ( RR ^m ( Base ` V ) )
          ( Q727102HasFDerivAt V F A L )
      ) ,
      (
        u e. ( Base ` V )
          |->
          0
      )
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A F d y $.

  q727102-local-extr-real-definition $a |- (
    ( Q727102LocalExtrReal F A )
    <->
    (
      (
        F e. ( RR ^m RR )
        /\
        A e. RR
      )
      /\
      (
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. RR
            (
              ( abs ` ( y - A ) ) < d
              ->
              ( F ` A ) <_ ( F ` y )
            )
        \/
        E. d e. RR+
          A. y e. RR
            (
              ( abs ` ( y - A ) ) < d
              ->
              ( F ` y ) <_ ( F ` A )
            )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d A F $.

  q727102-deriv-definition $a |- (
    Q727102Deriv F A
  ) =
    if
    (
      A e. dom ( RR _D F ) ,
      ( ( RR _D F ) ` A ) ,
      0
    )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A F V u v $.

  thousand-theorems-q727102-is-local-extr-fderiv-eq-zero $a |-
    A. V e. { v e. NrmVec | ( Scalar ` v ) = RRfld }
      A. F e. ( RR ^m ( Base ` V ) )
        A. A e. ( Base ` V )
          (
            ( Q727102LocalExtr V F A )
            ->
            (
              Q727102FDeriv V F A
            )
            =
            (
              u e. ( Base ` V )
                |->
                0
            )
          )
  $.
$}

${
  $d A F $.

  thousand-theorems-q727102-is-local-extr-deriv-eq-zero $a |-
    A. F e. ( RR ^m RR )
      A. A e. RR
        (
          ( Q727102LocalExtrReal F A )
          ->
          ( Q727102Deriv F A ) = 0
        )
  $.
$}

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q727102,
:: "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)": the totalized scalar and Frechet
:: derivatives of a real-valued function at a local extremum are zero. This
:: file contains no proof.

environ

  vocabularies NUMBERS, REAL_1, SUBSET_1, SEQ_1, PARTFUN1, ARYTM_3,
    TARSKI, RELAT_1, ORDINAL2, FUNCT_1, FDIFF_1, CARD_1, RCOMP_1,
    XXREAL_2, SEQ_4, XXREAL_0, XBOOLE_0, ARYTM_1, VALUED_0, SEQ_2,
    VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, FUNCOP_1, FUNCT_7, NAT_1, COMPLEX1, STRUCT_0,
    PRE_TOPC, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, RLVECT_1, LOPBAN_1,
    NFCONT_1, DUALSP02, XCMPLX_0;
