    NUMBERS, XREAL_0, XXREAL_0, XXREAL_2, XCMPLX_0, REAL_1, RELSET_1,
    VALUED_0, VALUED_1, SEQ_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, PARTFUN1, PARTFUN2,
    RCOMP_1, COMPLEX1, FDIFF_1, STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, RLVECT_1,
    VFUNCT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, LOPBAN_1, NFCONT_1, NDIFF_1,
    DUALSP02;
  constructors PARTFUN1, REAL_1, NAT_1, SEQ_2, SEQ_4, RCOMP_1,
    PARTFUN2, RFUNCT_2, FDIFF_1, VALUED_1, XXREAL_2, COMPLEX1,
    RELSET_1, BINOP_2, COMSEQ_2, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, VFUNCT_1,
    NORMSP_1, LOPBAN_1, NFCONT_1, NDIFF_1, DUALSP02;
  registrations XBOOLE_0, RELSET_1, NUMBERS, XREAL_0, NAT_1, MEMBERED,
    RCOMP_1, FDIFF_1, VALUED_0, VALUED_1, FUNCT_2, XXREAL_2,
    ORDINAL1, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, NORMSP_1, LOPBAN_1,
    NDIFF_1;
  requirements REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, BOOLE, ARITHM;
  definitions TARSKI, FDIFF_1;
  equalities XCMPLX_0, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, NORMSP_0, DUALSP02;
  expansions TARSKI, FDIFF_1, NFCONT_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for f being Function of REAL,REAL,
      a being Real st
    (ex r being Real st
      0 < r &
      ((for x being Real st |.x-a.| < r holds f.a <= f.x) or
       (for x being Real st |.x-a.| < r holds f.x <= f.a)))
  holds
    (not f is_differentiable_in a) or diff(f,a) = 0
proof
end;
::$P+

::$P-
theorem
  for E being RealNormSpace,
      f being Function of E,REAL,
      a being Point of E st
    (ex r being Real st
      0 < r &
      ((for x being Point of E st ||.x-a.|| < r holds f.a <= f.x) or
       (for x being Point of E st ||.x-a.|| < r holds f.x <= f.a)))
  holds
    ex g being Function of E,RNS_Real st
      g = f &
      ((not g is_differentiable_in a) or
       ||.diff(g,a).|| = 0)
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q727102,
% "Fermat's theorem (stationary points)": the total scalar derivative and the
% total Frechet derivative on an arbitrary real normed vector space vanish at
% a local minimum or maximum, with value zero at nondifferentiable points.
% This file contains no proof.

Q727102_fermat_s_theorem_stationary_points[
  E: TYPE+,
  zeroE: E,
  addE: [E, E -> E],
  negE: [E -> E],
  smulE: [real, E -> E],
  normE: [E -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  real_function: TYPE = [real -> real]
  e_function: TYPE = [E -> real]
  linear_candidate: TYPE = [E -> real]

  has_derivative_at(
      f: real_function,
      derivative, point: real): bool =
    FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
      EXISTS (radius: posreal):
        FORALL (increment: real):
          (increment /= 0 AND abs(increment) < radius)
            IMPLIES
              abs(
                f(point + increment) - f(point)
                  - derivative * increment)
                < epsilon_value * abs(increment)

  differentiable_at(
      f: real_function,
      point: real): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: real):
      has_derivative_at(f, derivative, point)

  deriv(
      f: real_function,
      point: real): real =
    IF differentiable_at(f, point) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: real):
          has_derivative_at(f, derivative, point))
    ELSE
      0
    ENDIF

  is_local_min_scalar(
      f: real_function,
      point: real): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (nearby: real):
        abs(nearby - point) < radius
          IMPLIES f(point) <= f(nearby)

  is_local_max_scalar(
      f: real_function,
      point: real): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (nearby: real):
        abs(nearby - point) < radius
          IMPLIES f(nearby) <= f(point)

  is_local_extremum_scalar(
      f: real_function,
      point: real): bool =
    is_local_min_scalar(f, point)
      OR is_local_max_scalar(f, point)

  IsLocalExtr_deriv_eq_zero: bool =
    FORALL (f: real_function), (point: real):
      is_local_extremum_scalar(f, point)
        IMPLIES deriv(f, point) = 0

  subE(x, y: E): E =
    addE(x, negE(y))

  normed_real_vector_space: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      addE(x, y) = addE(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
        addE(addE(x, y), z) =
          addE(x, addE(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, zeroE) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        addE(x, negE(x)) = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
        smulE(a, addE(x, y)) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(a, y)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a + b, x) =
          addE(smulE(a, x), smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
        smulE(a * b, x) =
          smulE(a, smulE(b, x)))
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        smulE(1, x) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) >= 0)
      AND (FORALL (x: E):
        normE(x) = 0 IFF x = zeroE)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        normE(smulE(a, x)) =
          abs(a) * normE(x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: E):
        normE(addE(x, y)) <=
          normE(x) + normE(y))

  continuous_real_linear_map(
      derivative: linear_candidate): bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      derivative(addE(x, y)) =
        derivative(x) + derivative(y))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (x: E):
        derivative(smulE(a, x)) =
          a * derivative(x))
      AND EXISTS (bound: real):
        bound >= 0
          AND FORALL (x: E):
            abs(derivative(x)) <=
              bound * normE(x)

  has_frechet_derivative_at(
      f: e_function,
      derivative: linear_candidate,
      point: E): bool =
    continuous_real_linear_map(derivative)
      AND FORALL (epsilon_value: posreal):
        EXISTS (radius: posreal):
          FORALL (increment: E):
            normE(increment) < radius
              IMPLIES
                abs(
                  f(addE(point, increment)) - f(point)
                    - derivative(increment))
                  <= epsilon_value * normE(increment)

  differentiable_frechet_at(
      f: e_function,
      point: E): bool =
    EXISTS (derivative: linear_candidate):
      has_frechet_derivative_at(
        f, derivative, point)

  zero_linear_map: linear_candidate =
    LAMBDA (x: E): 0

  fderiv(
      f: e_function,
      point: E): linear_candidate =
    IF differentiable_frechet_at(f, point) THEN
      epsilon(
        LAMBDA (derivative: linear_candidate):
          has_frechet_derivative_at(
            f, derivative, point))
    ELSE
      zero_linear_map
    ENDIF

  is_local_min_frechet(
      f: e_function,
      point: E): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (nearby: E):
        normE(subE(nearby, point)) < radius
          IMPLIES f(point) <= f(nearby)

  is_local_max_frechet(
      f: e_function,
      point: E): bool =
    EXISTS (radius: posreal):
      FORALL (nearby: E):
        normE(subE(nearby, point)) < radius
          IMPLIES f(nearby) <= f(point)

  is_local_extremum_frechet(
      f: e_function,
      point: E): bool =
    is_local_min_frechet(f, point)
      OR is_local_max_frechet(f, point)

  IsLocalExtr_fderiv_eq_zero: bool =
    normed_real_vector_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (f: e_function), (point: E):
        is_local_extremum_frechet(f, point)
          IMPLIES fderiv(f, point) = zero_linear_map

(*

  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, if the angle b-p-c is pi, a weighted sum
  of squared distances from a to b and c equals the corresponding product
  involving the cevian endpoint p. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Record q739403_real_inner_product_space (V : Type) : Type := {
  q739403_zero : V;
  q739403_add : V -> V -> V;
  q739403_neg : V -> V;
  q739403_smul : R -> V -> V;
  q739403_inner : V -> V -> R;

  q739403_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : V,
      q739403_add x (q739403_add y z) =
      q739403_add (q739403_add x y) z;
  q739403_add_comm :
    forall x y : V, q739403_add x y = q739403_add y x;
  q739403_add_zero :
    forall x : V, q739403_add x q739403_zero = x;
  q739403_add_neg :
    forall x : V,
      q739403_add x (q739403_neg x) = q739403_zero;

  q739403_one_smul :
    forall x : V, q739403_smul 1 x = x;
  q739403_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q739403_smul (a * b) x =
      q739403_smul a (q739403_smul b x);
  q739403_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q739403_smul a (q739403_add x y) =
      q739403_add (q739403_smul a x) (q739403_smul a y);
  q739403_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : V),
      q739403_smul (a + b) x =
      q739403_add (q739403_smul a x) (q739403_smul b x);

  q739403_inner_add_left :
    forall x y z : V,
      q739403_inner (q739403_add x y) z =
      q739403_inner x z + q739403_inner y z;
  q739403_inner_smul_left :
    forall (a : R) (x y : V),
      q739403_inner (q739403_smul a x) y =
      a * q739403_inner x y;
  q739403_inner_symm :
    forall x y : V,
      q739403_inner x y = q739403_inner y x;
  q739403_inner_nonnegative :
    forall x : V, 0 <= q739403_inner x x;
  q739403_inner_eq_zero :
    forall x : V,
      q739403_inner x x = 0 <-> x = q739403_zero
}.

Arguments q739403_zero {V} _.
Arguments q739403_add {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q739403_neg {V} _ _.
Arguments q739403_smul {V} _ _ _.
Arguments q739403_inner {V} _ _ _.

Record q739403_affine_torsor
    (V P : Type)
    (E : q739403_real_inner_product_space V) : Type := {
  q739403_vadd : V -> P -> P;
  q739403_vsub : P -> P -> V;
  q739403_zero_vadd :
    forall p : P,
      q739403_vadd (q739403_zero E) p = p;
  q739403_add_vadd :
    forall (x y : V) (p : P),
      q739403_vadd (q739403_add E x y) p =
      q739403_vadd x (q739403_vadd y p);
  q739403_vsub_vadd :
    forall (x : V) (p : P),
      q739403_vsub (q739403_vadd x p) p = x;
  q739403_vadd_vsub :
    forall p q : P,
      q739403_vadd (q739403_vsub p q) q = p
}.

Arguments q739403_vadd {V P E} _ _ _.
Arguments q739403_vsub {V P E} _ _ _.

Definition q739403_norm
    {V : Type}
    (E : q739403_real_inner_product_space V)
    (x : V) : R :=
  sqrt (q739403_inner E x x).

Definition q739403_dist
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q739403_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q739403_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p q : P) : R :=
  q739403_norm E (q739403_vsub A p q).

Definition q739403_angle
    {V P : Type}
    {E : q739403_real_inner_product_space V}
    (A : @q739403_affine_torsor V P E)
    (p1 p2 p3 : P) : R :=
  let x := q739403_vsub A p1 p2 in
  let y := q739403_vsub A p3 p2 in
  acos
    (q739403_inner E x y /
      (q739403_norm E x * q739403_norm E y)).

Theorem EuclideanGeometry_dist_sq_mul_dist_add_dist_sq_mul_dist :
  forall (V P : Type)
         (E : q739403_real_inner_product_space V)
         (A : @q739403_affine_torsor V P E)
         (a b c p : P),
    q739403_angle A b p c = PI ->
    q739403_dist A a b * q739403_dist A a b *
        q739403_dist A c p +
      q739403_dist A a c * q739403_dist A a c *
        q739403_dist A b p =
    q739403_dist A b c *
      (q739403_dist A a p * q739403_dist A a p +
       q739403_dist A b p * q739403_dist A c p).

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q739403
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in a real
  inner-product affine metric space, a point forming a straight angle with two
  endpoints satisfies Stewart's weighted squared-distance identity. This file

theory Q739403_stewart_s_theorem
  imports "HOL-Analysis.Inner_Product"
begin

locale q739403_euclidean_affine_space =
  fixes q739403_vadd :: "'v::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'p::metric_space \<Rightarrow> 'p"
    and q739403_vsub :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'v"
  assumes q739403_zero_vadd:
      "q739403_vadd 0 p = p"
    and q739403_add_vadd:
      "q739403_vadd (u + v) p =
        q739403_vadd u (q739403_vadd v p)"
    and q739403_vadd_vsub:
      "q739403_vadd (q739403_vsub p q) q = p"
    and q739403_vsub_vadd:
      "q739403_vsub (q739403_vadd v p) p = v"
    and q739403_dist_eq_norm_vsub:
      "dist p q = norm (q739403_vsub p q)"
begin

definition q739403_angle :: "'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> 'p \<Rightarrow> real" where
  "q739403_angle a p c =
    arccos (inner (q739403_vsub a p) (q739403_vsub c p) /
      (norm (q739403_vsub a p) * norm (q739403_vsub c p)))"

theorem stewart_s_theorem:
  fixes a b c p :: 'p
  assumes straight_angle:
      "q739403_angle b p c = pi"
  shows
      "dist a b ^ 2 * dist c p + dist a c ^ 2 * dist b p =
        dist b c * (dist a p ^ 2 + dist b p * dist c p)"

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q739403
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in an arbitrary
  real inner-product affine space, a point forming a straight angle with two
  endpoints satisfies Stewart's weighted squared-distance identity. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

let Q739403_STEWART_S_THEOREM =
 `let real_inner_product_space =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V) (neg:V->V)
     (smul:real->V->V) (inner:V->V->real).
       (!x y z:V. add x (add y z) = add (add x y) z) /\
       (!x y:V. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x:V. add zero x = x) /\
       (!x:V. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
       (!x:V. smul (&1) x = x) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
       (!a b:real. !x:V.
          smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
       (!x y:V. inner x y = inner y x) /\
       (!x y z:V.
          inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
       (!a:real. !x y:V.
          inner (smul a x) y = a * inner x y) /\
       (!x:V. &0 <= inner x x) /\
       (!x:V. inner x x = &0 <=> x = zero) in
  let affine_torsor =
    \(zero:V) (add:V->V->V)
     (vadd:V->P->P) (vsub:P->P->V).
       (!q:P. vadd zero q = q) /\
       (!v w:V. !q:P.
          vadd (add v w) q = vadd v (vadd w q)) /\
       (!v:V. !q:P. vsub (vadd v q) q = v) /\
       (!q r:P. vadd (vsub q r) r = q) in
  let norm =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (x:V). sqrt (inner x x) in
  let distance =
    \(inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V) (q:P) (r:P).
       norm inner (vsub q r) in
  let straight_angle =
    \(zero:V) (inner:V->V->real) (vsub:P->P->V)
     (q1:P) (q2:P) (q3:P).
       ~(vsub q1 q2 = zero) /\
       ~(vsub q3 q2 = zero) /\
       inner (vsub q1 q2) (vsub q3 q2) =
         --(norm inner (vsub q1 q2) *
            norm inner (vsub q3 q2)) in
  !zero:V.
  !add:V->V->V.
  !neg:V->V.
  !smul:real->V->V.
  !inner:V->V->real.
  !vadd:V->P->P.
  !vsub:P->P->V.
  !a b c p:P.
    real_inner_product_space zero add neg smul inner /\
    affine_torsor zero add vadd vsub /\
    straight_angle zero inner vsub b p c
    ==>
    distance inner vsub a b pow 2 * distance inner vsub c p +
    distance inner vsub a c pow 2 * distance inner vsub b p =
    distance inner vsub b c *
      (distance inner vsub a p pow 2 +
       distance inner vsub b p * distance inner vsub c p)`;;

title: Q739403_stewart_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q739403
-- (thousand-theorems__agda__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in a real
-- inner-product affine space, a straight angle at a point on a line gives
-- Stewart's distance identity. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q739403_stewart_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infix 4 _!=_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> Either A B
  right : B -> Either A B

record Exists
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record CompleteOrderedRealField
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR inverseR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set r
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    inverse-zeroR :
      inverseR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (inverseR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      Either (lessOrEqualR x y) (lessOrEqualR y x)
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      Both (lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR) (zeroR != oneR)

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set r) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          Both
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x supremum)
            ((upper : R) ->
              ((x : R) ->
                P x ->
                lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
              lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedRealField

record RealInnerProductSpace
  {r v : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R)
  (V : Set v) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v)) where

  field
    zeroV : V
    addV : V -> V -> V
    negateV : V -> V
    scaleV : R -> V -> V

    addV-commutative :
      (u w : V) ->
      addV u w == addV w u
    addV-associative :
      (u w z : V) ->
      addV (addV u w) z == addV u (addV w z)
    addV-zero :
      (u : V) ->
      addV u zeroV == u
    addV-inverse :
      (u : V) ->
      addV u (negateV u) == zeroV

    scale-addV :
      (a : R) ->
      (u w : V) ->
      scaleV a (addV u w) ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV a w)
    add-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (u : V) ->
      scaleV (addR reals a b) u ==
      addV (scaleV a u) (scaleV b u)
    multiply-scaleV :
      (a b : R) ->
      (u : V) ->
      scaleV (multiplyR reals a b) u ==
      scaleV a (scaleV b u)
    one-scaleV :
      (u : V) ->
      scaleV (oneR reals) u == u

    inner : V -> V -> R
    inner-add-left :
      (u w z : V) ->
      inner (addV u w) z ==
      addR reals (inner u z) (inner w z)
    inner-scale-left :
      (a : R) ->
      (u w : V) ->
      inner (scaleV a u) w ==
      multiplyR reals a (inner u w)
    inner-symmetric :
      (u w : V) ->
      inner u w == inner w u
    inner-nonnegative :
      (u : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (inner u u)
    inner-definite :
      (u : V) ->
      inner u u == zeroR reals ->
      u == zeroV

    norm : V -> R
    norm-nonnegative :
      (u : V) ->
      lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) (norm u)
    norm-square :
      (u : V) ->
      multiplyR reals (norm u) (norm u) == inner u u
    norm-zero :
      (u : V) ->
      norm u == zeroR reals ->
      u == zeroV
    norm-negate :
      (u : V) ->
      norm (negateV u) == norm u

open RealInnerProductSpace

record AffineTorsor
  {r v p : Level}
  {R : Set r}
  {V : Set v}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R}
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V)
  (P : Set p) :
  Set (lsuc (r ⊔ v ⊔ p)) where

  field
    vadd : V -> P -> P
    vsub : P -> P -> V

    zero-vadd :
      (x : P) ->
      vadd (zeroV space) x == x
    add-vadd :
      (u w : V) ->
      (x : P) ->
      vadd (addV space u w) x ==
      vadd u (vadd w x)
    vadd-vsub :
      (x y : P) ->
      vadd (vsub x y) y == x
    vsub-vadd :
      (u : V) ->
      (x : P) ->
      vsub (vadd u x) x == u

open AffineTorsor

square :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  CompleteOrderedRealField R ->
  R ->
  R
square reals x =
  multiplyR reals x x

distance :
  {r v p : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  {reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R} ->
  {space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V} ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  R
distance {space = space} affine x y =
  norm space (vsub affine x y)

StraightAngleAt :
  {r v p : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {V : Set v} ->
  {P : Set p} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  AffineTorsor space P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  P ->
  Set (r ⊔ v)
StraightAngleAt reals space affine b p c =
  Both
    (vsub affine b p != zeroV space)
    (Both
      (vsub affine c p != zeroV space)
      (inner space (vsub affine b p) (vsub affine c p) ==
       negateR reals
         (multiplyR reals
           (norm space (vsub affine b p))
           (norm space (vsub affine c p)))))

stewart-theorem : Setω
stewart-theorem =
  {r v p : Level} ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (V : Set v) ->
  (P : Set p) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedRealField R) ->
  (space : RealInnerProductSpace reals V) ->
  (affine : AffineTorsor space P) ->
  (a b c point : P) ->
  StraightAngleAt reals space affine b point c ->
  addR reals
    (multiplyR reals
      (square reals (distance affine a b))
      (distance affine c point))
    (multiplyR reals
      (square reals (distance affine a c))
      (distance affine b point))
  ==
  multiplyR reals
    (distance affine b c)
    (addR reals
      (square reals (distance affine a point))
      (multiplyR reals
        (distance affine b point)
        (distance affine c point)))

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q739403 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in an
  arbitrary real inner-product affine space, a cevian whose endpoint forms a
  straight angle on the opposite side satisfies Stewart's distance identity.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open realTheory transcTheory;

val q739403_real_inner_affine_space_def = new_definition (
  "q739403_real_inner_affine_space_def",
  ``q739403_real_inner_affine_space
      (zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v) <=>
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r * s) x = smul r (smul s x)) /\
      (!r s x. smul (r + s) x = add (smul r x) (smul s x)) /\
      (!r x y. smul r (add x y) = add (smul r x) (smul r y)) /\
      (!x. smul 0 x = zero) /\
      (!r. smul r zero = zero) /\
      (!x y. inner x y = inner y x) /\
      (!x y z. inner (add x y) z = inner x z + inner y z) /\
      (!r x y. inner (smul r x) y = r * inner x y) /\
      (!x. 0 <= inner x x) /\
      (!x. (inner x x = 0 <=> x = zero)) /\
      (!p. vadd zero p = p) /\
      (!u v p. vadd (add u v) p = vadd u (vadd v p)) /\
      (!p q. vadd (vsub p q) q = p) /\
      (!v p. vsub (vadd v p) p = v)``);

val q739403_norm_def = new_definition (
  "q739403_norm_def",
  ``q739403_norm (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real) (x : 'v) =
      sqrt (inner x x)``);

val q739403_dist_def = new_definition (
  "q739403_dist_def",
  ``q739403_dist
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p) =
      q739403_norm inner (vsub x y)``);

val q739403_angle_def = new_definition (
  "q739403_angle_def",
  ``q739403_angle
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (x : 'p)
      (y : 'p)
      (z : 'p) =
      acs
        (inner (vsub x y) (vsub z y) /
          (q739403_norm inner (vsub x y) *
           q739403_norm inner (vsub z y)))``);

val dist_sq_mul_dist_add_dist_sq_mul_dist =
  ``!(zero : 'v)
      (add : 'v -> 'v -> 'v)
      (neg : 'v -> 'v)
      (smul : real -> 'v -> 'v)
      (inner : 'v -> 'v -> real)
      (vadd : 'v -> 'p -> 'p)
      (vsub : 'p -> 'p -> 'v)
      (a b c p : 'p).
      q739403_real_inner_affine_space
        zero add neg smul inner vadd vsub /\
      q739403_angle inner vsub b p c = pi
      ==>
      q739403_dist inner vsub a b pow 2 *
          q739403_dist inner vsub c p +
        q739403_dist inner vsub a c pow 2 *
          q739403_dist inner vsub b p =
        q739403_dist inner vsub b c *
          (q739403_dist inner vsub a p pow 2 +
           q739403_dist inner vsub b p *
             q739403_dist inner vsub c p)``;

$(

  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in an arbitrary

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  W ranges over arbitrary real inner-product spaces represented by SetMM
  CPreHil structures whose scalar field has base RR. By the definition of
  CPreHil, its scalar field is the restriction of CCfld to that base, so this
  condition identifies it with RRfld by df-refld. The generalized real
  Euclidean spaces RR^ I satisfy these conditions by rrxcph and rrxsca, making
  the structure guard explicitly nonempty. Viewing the vector space as its
  canonical affine torsor preserves differences, distances, and angles.

  W Q739403Ray A B is the vector from B to A, W Q739403Dist A B is its norm,
  and W Q739403Angle A B C is the total unoriented angle at B. When either
  ray is zero, the angle is pi/2, matching the source convention; otherwise
  it is the arccosine of the normalized inner product.

  Every declaration before the final one is syntax or an explicit faithful
  definition. The final $a declaration is the single unproved corpus
  statement, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q739403Ray Q739403Dist Q739403Angle $.

q739403-ray-syntax $a class ( W Q739403Ray A B ) $.
q739403-distance-syntax $a class ( W Q739403Dist A B ) $.
q739403-angle-syntax $a class ( W Q739403Angle A B C ) $.

q739403-ray-definition $a |- (
  W Q739403Ray A B
) = (
  A ( -g ` W ) B
) $.

q739403-distance-definition $a |- (
  W Q739403Dist A B

  ( norm ` W ) ` ( W Q739403Ray A B )
) $.

  W Q739403Angle A B C
) = if (
  (
    ( ( W Q739403Ray A B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
    \/
    ( ( W Q739403Ray C B ) = ( 0g ` W ) )
  )
  ,
  ( _pi / 2 )
  ,
  (
    arccos
    `
    (
      (
        ( W Q739403Ray A B )
        ( .i ` W )
        ( W Q739403Ray C B )
      )
      /
      (
        ( W Q739403Dist A B )
        x.
        ( W Q739403Dist C B )
      )
    )
  )
) $.

${
  $d A B C P W $.

  thousand-theorems-q739403-stewart $a |- A. W
    (
      (
        W e. CPreHil
        /\
        ( Base ` ( Scalar ` W ) ) = RR
      )
      ->
      A. A e. ( Base ` W )
        A. B e. ( Base ` W )
          A. C e. ( Base ` W )
            A. P e. ( Base ` W )
              (
                ( ( W Q739403Angle B P C ) = _pi )
                ->
                (
                  (
                    (
                      ( W Q739403Dist A B ) ^ 2

title: Q739403_stewart_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q739403
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q739403), "Stewart's theorem": in a real
% inner-product affine space, a straight angle at a point on a side yields
% Stewart's squared-distance identity. This file contains no proof.

Q739403_stewart_s_theorem[
  V: TYPE+,
  P: TYPE+,
  zero: V,
  vadd: [V, V -> V],
  vneg: [V -> V],
  scale: [real, V -> V],
  inner: [V, V -> real],
  point_vadd: [V, P -> P],
  vsub: [P, P -> V],
  distance: [P, P -> real]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  vector_space_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v: V): vadd(u, v) = vadd(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
        vadd(vadd(u, v), w) = vadd(u, vadd(v, w)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, zero) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vadd(u, vneg(u)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        scale(a, vadd(u, v)) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(a, v)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a + b, u) = vadd(scale(a, u), scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (a, b: real), (u: V):
        scale(a * b, u) = scale(a, scale(b, u)))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(1, u) = u)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): scale(0, u) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (u: V): vneg(u) = scale(-1, u))

  inner_product_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (u, v, w: V):
      inner(vadd(u, v), w) = inner(u, w) + inner(v, w))
      AND (FORALL (a: real), (u, v: V):
        inner(scale(a, u), v) = a * inner(u, v))
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V): inner(u, v) = inner(v, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): 0 <= inner(u, u))
      AND (FORALL (u: V): inner(u, u) = 0 IFF u = zero)

  affine_torsor_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (p: P): point_vadd(zero, p) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u, v: V), (p: P):
        point_vadd(vadd(u, v), p) =
          point_vadd(u, point_vadd(v, p)))
      AND (FORALL (p, q: P):
        point_vadd(vsub(p, q), q) = p)
      AND (FORALL (u: V), (p: P):
        vsub(point_vadd(u, p), p) = u)

  distance_laws: bool =
    FORALL (p, q: P):
      0 <= distance(p, q)
        AND distance(p, q) ^ 2 =
          inner(vsub(p, q), vsub(p, q))

  euclidean_affine_space: bool =
    vector_space_laws
      AND inner_product_laws
      AND affine_torsor_laws
      AND distance_laws

  angle_at_is_pi(b, p, c: P): bool =
    0 < distance(b, p)
      AND 0 < distance(c, p)
      AND inner(vsub(b, p), vsub(c, p)) =
        -(distance(b, p) * distance(c, p))

  stewart_s_theorem: bool =
    euclidean_affine_space IMPLIES
      FORALL (a, b, c, p: P):
        angle_at_is_pi(b, p, c)
          IMPLIES
            distance(a, b) ^ 2 * distance(c, p)
              + distance(a, c) ^ 2 * distance(b, p)
            =
            distance(b, c)
              * (distance(a, p) ^ 2
                  + distance(b, p) * distance(c, p))
END Q739403_stewart_s_theorem

title: Q7432915_schroeder_bernstein_theorem_for_measurable_spaces
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7432915
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q7432915), "Schroeder–Bernstein theorem for
  measurable spaces": measurable embeddings in both directions between two
  measurable spaces yield a measurable equivalence. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Primitive Projections.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q7432915_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q7432915_empty {A : Type} : q7432915_set A :=
  fun _ => False.

Definition q7432915_complement {A : Type}
    (E : q7432915_set A) : q7432915_set A :=
  fun x => ~ E x.

Definition q7432915_countable_union {A : Type}
    (E : nat -> q7432915_set A) : q7432915_set A :=
  fun x => exists n : nat, E n x.

Definition q7432915_same_set {A : Type}
    (E F : q7432915_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, E x <-> F x.

Definition q7432915_image {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (E : q7432915_set A) : q7432915_set B :=
  fun y => exists x : A, E x /\ f x = y.

Definition q7432915_preimage {A B : Type}
    (f : A -> B) (E : q7432915_set B) : q7432915_set A :=
  fun x => E (f x).

Record q7432915_measurable_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q7432915_measurable_set : q7432915_set A -> Prop;
  q7432915_measurable_extensional :
    forall E F : q7432915_set A,
      q7432915_same_set E F ->
      (q7432915_measurable_set E <->
       q7432915_measurable_set F);
  q7432915_measurable_empty :
    q7432915_measurable_set q7432915_empty;
  q7432915_measurable_complement :
    forall E : q7432915_set A,
      q7432915_measurable_set E ->
      q7432915_measurable_set (q7432915_complement E);
  q7432915_measurable_countable_union :
    forall E : nat -> q7432915_set A,
      (forall n : nat, q7432915_measurable_set (E n)) ->
      q7432915_measurable_set (q7432915_countable_union E)
}.

Arguments q7432915_measurable_set {A} _ _.

Definition q7432915_measurable_map
    {A B : Type}
    (mA : q7432915_measurable_space A)
    (mB : q7432915_measurable_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall E : q7432915_set B,
    q7432915_measurable_set mB E ->
    q7432915_measurable_set mA (q7432915_preimage f E).

Record q7432915_measurable_embedding
    {A B : Type}
    (mA : q7432915_measurable_space A)
    (mB : q7432915_measurable_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop := {
  q7432915_embedding_injective :
    forall x y : A, f x = f y -> x = y;
  q7432915_embedding_measurable :
    q7432915_measurable_map mA mB f;
  q7432915_embedding_measurable_image :
    forall E : q7432915_set A,
      q7432915_measurable_set mA E ->
      q7432915_measurable_set mB (q7432915_image f E)
}.

Record q7432915_measurable_equiv
    {A B : Type}
    (mA : q7432915_measurable_space A)
    (mB : q7432915_measurable_space B) : Type := {
  q7432915_equiv_forward : A -> B;
  q7432915_equiv_backward : B -> A;
  q7432915_equiv_left_inverse :
    forall x : A,
      q7432915_equiv_backward (q7432915_equiv_forward x) = x;
  q7432915_equiv_right_inverse :
    forall y : B,
      q7432915_equiv_forward (q7432915_equiv_backward y) = y;
  q7432915_equiv_forward_measurable :
    q7432915_measurable_map
      mA mB q7432915_equiv_forward;
  q7432915_equiv_backward_measurable :
    q7432915_measurable_map
      mB mA q7432915_equiv_backward
}.

Theorem MeasurableEmbedding_schroederBernstein :
  forall (Alpha Beta : Type)
         (mAlpha : q7432915_measurable_space Alpha)
         (mBeta : q7432915_measurable_space Beta)
         (f : Alpha -> Beta)
         (g : Beta -> Alpha),
    q7432915_measurable_embedding mAlpha mBeta f ->
    q7432915_measurable_embedding mBeta mAlpha g ->
    q7432915_measurable_equiv mAlpha mBeta.
Admitted.

title: Q7432915_schroeder_bernstein_theorem_for_measurable_spaces

(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7432915
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7432915), "Schroeder–Bernstein theorem for
  measurable spaces": measurable embeddings in both directions between two
  possibly empty measurable spaces yield a measurable equivalence. This file
  contains no proof.
*)

theory Q7432915_schroeder_bernstein_theorem_for_measurable_spaces
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q7432915_sigma_algebra ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7432915_sigma_algebra X S \<longleftrightarrow>
    S \<subseteq> Pow X \<and>
    {} \<in> S \<and>
    (\<forall>A \<in> S. X - A \<in> S) \<and>
    (\<forall>A :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'a set.
      (\<forall>n. A n \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<Union>n. A n) \<in> S)"

definition q7432915_measurable ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow>
      'b set \<Rightarrow> 'b set set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7432915_measurable X S Y T f \<longleftrightarrow>
    f ` X \<subseteq> Y \<and>
    (\<forall>B \<in> T. {x \<in> X. f x \<in> B} \<in> S)"

definition q7432915_measurable_embedding ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow>
      'b set \<Rightarrow> 'b set set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7432915_measurable_embedding X S Y T f \<longleftrightarrow>
    inj_on f X \<and>
    q7432915_measurable X S Y T f \<and>
    (\<forall>A \<in> S. f ` A \<in> T)"

definition q7432915_measurable_equivalence ::
    "'a set \<Rightarrow> 'a set set \<Rightarrow>
      'b set \<Rightarrow> 'b set set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b) \<Rightarrow> ('b \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7432915_measurable_equivalence X S Y T h k \<longleftrightarrow>
    q7432915_measurable X S Y T h \<and>
    q7432915_measurable Y T X S k \<and>
    (\<forall>x \<in> X. k (h x) = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>y \<in> Y. h (k y) = y)"

theorem schroeder_bernstein_for_measurable_spaces:
  fixes X :: "'a set"
    and S :: "'a set set"
    and Y :: "'b set"
    and T :: "'b set set"
    and f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and g :: "'b \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes sigma_X: "q7432915_sigma_algebra X S"
    and sigma_Y: "q7432915_sigma_algebra Y T"
    and embedding_f: "q7432915_measurable_embedding X S Y T f"
    and embedding_g: "q7432915_measurable_embedding Y T X S g"
  shows "\<exists>h k.
    q7432915_measurable_equivalence X S Y T h k"
  sorry

end

(*

  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q7432915), "Schroeder–Bernstein theorem for
  measurable spaces": measurable embeddings in both directions between two
  possibly empty measurable spaces imply a measurable equivalence. This file

let Q7432915_SCHROEDER_BERNSTEIN_THEOREM_FOR_MEASURABLE_SPACES =
 `let sigma_algebraA =
      \(carrier:A->bool) (events:(A->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:A->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->A->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {x:A | ?n. x IN sets n}) in
   let sigma_algebraB =
      \(carrier:B->bool) (events:(B->bool)->bool).
        events {} /\
        events carrier /\
        (!s:B->bool. events s ==> s SUBSET carrier) /\
        (!s:B->bool.
           events s ==> events (carrier DIFF s)) /\
        (!sets:num->B->bool.
           (!n. events (sets n))
           ==> events {y:B | ?n. y IN sets n}) in
   let measurableAB =
      \(carrierA:A->bool) (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool)
       (carrierB:B->bool) (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool)
       (f:A->B).
        (!x:A. x IN carrierA ==> f x IN carrierB) /\
        (!t:B->bool.
           eventsB t
           ==> eventsA {x:A | x IN carrierA /\ f x IN t}) in
   let measurableBA =
      \(carrierB:B->bool) (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool)
       (carrierA:A->bool) (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool)
       (g:B->A).
        (!y:B. y IN carrierB ==> g y IN carrierA) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           eventsA s
           ==> eventsB {y:B | y IN carrierB /\ g y IN s}) in
   let measurable_embeddingAB =
      \(carrierA:A->bool) (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool)
       (carrierB:B->bool) (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool)
       (f:A->B).
        measurableAB carrierA eventsA carrierB eventsB f /\
        (!x y:A.
           x IN carrierA /\ y IN carrierA /\ f x = f y
           ==> x = y) /\
        (!s:A->bool.
           eventsA s
           ==> eventsB {y:B | ?x:A. x IN s /\ f x = y}) in
   let measurable_embeddingBA =
      \(carrierB:B->bool) (eventsB:(B->bool)->bool)
       (carrierA:A->bool) (eventsA:(A->bool)->bool)
       (g:B->A).
        measurableBA carrierB eventsB carrierA eventsA g /\
        (!x y:B.
           x IN carrierB /\ y IN carrierB /\ g x = g y
           ==> x = y) /\
        (!s:B->bool.
           eventsB s
           ==> eventsA {x:A | ?y:B. y IN s /\ g y = x}) in
   !carrierA:A->bool carrierB:B->bool
    eventsA:(A->bool)->bool eventsB:(B->bool)->bool
    f:A->B g:B->A.
      sigma_algebraA carrierA eventsA /\
      sigma_algebraB carrierB eventsB /\
      measurable_embeddingAB carrierA eventsA carrierB eventsB f /\
      measurable_embeddingBA carrierB eventsB carrierA eventsA g
      ==>
      ?h:A->B k:B->A.
        measurableAB carrierA eventsA carrierB eventsB h /\
        measurableBA carrierB eventsB carrierA eventsA k /\
        (!x:A. x IN carrierA ==> k (h x) = x) /\
        (!y:B. y IN carrierB ==> h (k y) = y)`;;

;; "Schroeder-Bernstein theorem for measurable spaces": measurable embeddings
;; in both directions between arbitrary measurable spaces yield a measurable
;; equivalence. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The universe below is an extensional presentation of arbitrary sets and
;; maps.  An exact comprehension constructor represents every tame unary
;; family whose natural-number values are represented sets, so countable-union
;; closure ranges over every represented countable family.  Exact operations
;; give complement, binary union, countable union, image, and preimage.
;; Additional constructors provide the standard Schroeder-Bernstein sequence
;; and its two piecewise maps; their bijectivity and measurability are not
;; assumed.  The measurable equivalence remains existentially quantified
;; inside the final statement.

(defun q7432915-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q7432915-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q7432915-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q7432915-quoted nil)))

(defun q7432915-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (q7432915-quoted function)
        (q7432915-term-list arguments)))

            (car terms)
            (q7432915-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q7432915-quoted nil))
    (q7432915-quoted t)))

(defun q7432915-not-term (term)

        (q7432915-quoted nil)
        (q7432915-quoted t)))

(defun q7432915-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q7432915-quoted t)))

(defun q7432915-iff-term (left right)

        (list 'if right
              (q7432915-quoted t)
              (q7432915-quoted nil))
        (list 'if right
              (q7432915-quoted nil)
              (q7432915-quoted t))))

(defun q7432915-universal-p (function formals)

  (P : Set p)
  (Q : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : P
    second : Q

record Iff
  {p q : Level}
  (P : Set p)
  (Q : Set q) :
  Set (p ⊔ q) where

  constructor equivalence
  field
    forward  : P -> Q
    backward : Q -> P

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Bottom {p : Level} : Set p where

Not :
  {p : Level} ->
  Set p ->
  Set p
Not {p} P =
  P -> Bottom {p}

Predicate :
  {a : Level} ->
  (p : Level) ->
  Set a ->
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p)
Predicate p A =
  A -> Set p

Empty :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate p A
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Complement :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate p A ->
  Predicate p A
Complement S x =
  Not (S x)

CountableUnion :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  (Nat -> Predicate p A) ->
  Predicate p A
CountableUnion sets x =
  Exists Nat (\ n -> sets n x)

SamePredicate :
  {a p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Predicate p A ->
  Predicate p A ->
  Set (a ⊔ p)
SamePredicate {A = A} S T =
  (x : A) ->
  Iff (S x) (T x)

record SigmaAlgebra
  {a : Level}
  (p : Level)
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (a ⊔ lsuc p) where

  field
    measurable :
      Predicate p A ->
      Set p

    measurable-congruent :
      (S T : Predicate p A) ->
      SamePredicate S T ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable T

    measurable-empty :
      measurable Empty

    measurable-complement :
      (S : Predicate p A) ->
      measurable S ->
      measurable (Complement S)

    measurable-countable-union :
      (sets : Nat -> Predicate p A) ->
      ((n : Nat) -> measurable (sets n)) ->
      measurable (CountableUnion sets)

open SigmaAlgebra

Preimage :
  {a b p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate p B ->
  Predicate p A
Preimage f T x =
  T (f x)

Image :
  {a b p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Predicate p A ->
  Predicate (a ⊔ b ⊔ p) B
Image {A = A} f S y =
  Exists A
    (\ x ->
      Both
        (S x)
        (f x ≡ y))

Injective :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} f =
  (x y : A) ->
  f x ≡ f y ->
  x ≡ y

MeasurableFunction :
  {a b p : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  SigmaAlgebra p A ->
  SigmaAlgebra p B ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (b ⊔ lsuc p)
MeasurableFunction source target f =
  (T : Predicate _ _) ->
  measurable target T ->
  measurable source (Preimage f T)

record MeasurableEmbedding
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (source : SigmaAlgebra (a ⊔ b) A)
  (target : SigmaAlgebra (a ⊔ b) B)
  (f : A -> B) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b)) where

  field
    injective :
      Injective f

    measurable-function :
      MeasurableFunction source target f

    measurable-image :
      (S : Predicate (a ⊔ b) A) ->
      measurable source S ->
      measurable target (Image f S)

record MeasurableEquivalence
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b)
  (source : SigmaAlgebra (a ⊔ b) A)
  (target : SigmaAlgebra (a ⊔ b) B) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b)) where

  field
    to   : A -> B
    from : B -> A

    from-to :
      (x : A) ->
      from (to x) ≡ x

    to-from :
      (y : B) ->
      to (from y) ≡ y

    measurable-to :
      MeasurableFunction source target to

    measurable-from :
      MeasurableFunction target source from

schroeder-bernstein-theorem-for-measurable-spaces :
  {a b : Level} ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
schroeder-bernstein-theorem-for-measurable-spaces {a} {b} =
  (A : Set a) ->
  (B : Set b) ->
  (source : SigmaAlgebra (a ⊔ b) A) ->
  (target : SigmaAlgebra (a ⊔ b) B) ->
  (f : A -> B) ->
  (g : B -> A) ->
  MeasurableEmbedding A B source target f ->
  MeasurableEmbedding B A target source g ->
  MeasurableEquivalence A B source target

title: Q7432915_schroeder_bernstein_theorem_for_measurable_spaces
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q7432915, "Schroeder–Bernstein theorem for measurable spaces": measurable
  embeddings in both directions between two measurable spaces yield a
  measurable equivalence. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory sigma_algebraTheory;

val q7432915_measurable_embedding_def = new_definition (
  "q7432915_measurable_embedding_def",
  ``q7432915_measurable_embedding
      (ma : ('a set) set) (mb : ('b set) set)
      (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      INJ f UNIV UNIV /\
      f IN measurable (UNIV,ma) (UNIV,mb) /\
      (!s. s IN ma ==> IMAGE f s IN mb)``);

val MeasurableEmbedding_schroederBernstein =
  ``!(ma : ('a set) set) (mb : ('b set) set)
      (f : 'a -> 'b) (g : 'b -> 'a).
      sigma_algebra (UNIV,ma) /\
      sigma_algebra (UNIV,mb) /\
      q7432915_measurable_embedding ma mb f /\
      q7432915_measurable_embedding mb ma g
      ==>
      ?(h : 'a -> 'b) (k : 'b -> 'a).
        (!x. k (h x) = x) /\
        (!y. h (k y) = y) /\
        h IN measurable (UNIV,ma) (UNIV,mb) /\
        k IN measurable (UNIV,mb) (UNIV,ma)``;

title: Q7432915_schroeder_bernstein_theorem_for_measurable_spaces
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7432915
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7432915), "Schroeder-Bernstein theorem for
  measurable spaces": measurable embeddings between arbitrary measurable
  spaces in both directions yield a measurable equivalence. This file
  contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q7432915MeasurableEmbedding M N F says that F is an injection from the
  carrier of sigma-algebra M into the carrier of sigma-algebra N, that F is
  measurable, and that the image under F of every M-measurable set is
  N-measurable. This is exactly the source MeasurableEmbedding structure.

  Q7432915MeasurableEquiv M N H says that H is a bijection between the
  carriers and that both H and its converse relation are measurable. For a
  bijection the converse relation is its inverse function, so this is exactly
  the source MeasurableEquiv structure.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. The two
  preceding non-syntax $a declarations are faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q7432915MeasurableEmbedding Q7432915MeasurableEquiv $.

q7432915-measurable-embedding-syntax $a wff
  ( Q7432915MeasurableEmbedding M N F ) $.
q7432915-measurable-equiv-syntax $a wff
  ( Q7432915MeasurableEquiv M N H ) $.

${
  $d A F M N $.

  q7432915-measurable-embedding-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7432915MeasurableEmbedding M N F )
    <->
    (
      F : U. M -1-1-> U. N
      /\
      (
        F e. ( M MblFnM N )
        /\
        A. A e. M ( F " A ) e. N
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d H M N $.

  q7432915-measurable-equiv-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7432915MeasurableEquiv M N H )
    <->
    (
      H : U. M -1-1-onto-> U. N
      /\
      (
        H e. ( M MblFnM N )
        /\
        `' H e. ( N MblFnM M )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F G H M N $.

  thousand-theorems-q7432915-schroeder-bernstein-measurable-spaces $a |-
    A. M e. U. ran sigAlgebra
      A. N e. U. ran sigAlgebra
        A. F A. G
          (
            (
              ( Q7432915MeasurableEmbedding M N F )
              /\
              ( Q7432915MeasurableEmbedding N M G )
            )
            ->
            E. H ( Q7432915MeasurableEquiv M N H )
          )
  $.
$}
