title: Q7432915_schroeder_bernstein_theorem_for_measurable_spaces
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q7432915,
% "Schroeder–Bernstein theorem for measurable spaces": measurable embeddings
% in both directions yield a measurable equivalence. This file contains no proof.

schroeder_bernstein_measurable_spaces_Q7432915[
  A: TYPE,
  B: TYPE
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  a_set: TYPE = [A -> bool]
  b_set: TYPE = [B -> bool]
  a_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> a_set]
  b_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> b_set]
  a_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [a_set -> bool]
  b_sigma_algebra: TYPE = [b_set -> bool]

  a_full_set: a_set =
    LAMBDA (x: A): TRUE

  b_full_set: b_set =
    LAMBDA (y: B): TRUE

  a_complement(value: a_set): a_set =
    LAMBDA (x: A): NOT value(x)

  b_complement(value: b_set): b_set =
    LAMBDA (y: B): NOT value(y)

  a_countable_union(values: a_set_sequence): a_set =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      EXISTS (index: nat): values(index)(x)

  b_countable_union(values: b_set_sequence): b_set =
    LAMBDA (y: B):
      EXISTS (index: nat): values(index)(y)

  is_a_sigma_algebra(SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra): bool =
    SigmaA(a_full_set)
      AND (FORALL (value: a_set):
        SigmaA(value) IMPLIES
          SigmaA(a_complement(value)))
      AND (FORALL (values: a_set_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          SigmaA(values(index)))
        IMPLIES
          SigmaA(a_countable_union(values)))

  is_b_sigma_algebra(SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra): bool =
    SigmaB(b_full_set)
      AND (FORALL (value: b_set):
        SigmaB(value) IMPLIES
          SigmaB(b_complement(value)))
      AND (FORALL (values: b_set_sequence):
        (FORALL (index: nat):
          SigmaB(values(index)))
        IMPLIES
          SigmaB(b_countable_union(values)))

  injective_ab(f: [A -> B]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: A):
      f(x) = f(y) IMPLIES x = y

  injective_ba(g: [B -> A]): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: B):
      g(x) = g(y) IMPLIES x = y

  image_ab(f: [A -> B], value: a_set): b_set =
    LAMBDA (y: B):
      EXISTS (x: A):
        value(x) AND f(x) = y

  image_ba(g: [B -> A], value: b_set): a_set =
    LAMBDA (x: A):
      EXISTS (y: B):
        value(y) AND g(y) = x

  preimage_ab(f: [A -> B], value: b_set): a_set =
    LAMBDA (x: A): value(f(x))

  preimage_ba(g: [B -> A], value: a_set): b_set =
    LAMBDA (y: B): value(g(y))

  measurable_ab(
      f: [A -> B],
      SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra,
      SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (value: b_set):
      SigmaB(value) IMPLIES
        SigmaA(preimage_ab(f, value))

  measurable_ba(
      g: [B -> A],
      SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra,
      SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra): bool =
    FORALL (value: a_set):
      SigmaA(value) IMPLIES
        SigmaB(preimage_ba(g, value))

  measurable_embedding_ab(
      f: [A -> B],
      SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra,
      SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra): bool =
    injective_ab(f)
      AND measurable_ab(f, SigmaA, SigmaB)
      AND (FORALL (value: a_set):
        SigmaA(value) IMPLIES
          SigmaB(image_ab(f, value)))

  measurable_embedding_ba(
      g: [B -> A],
      SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra,
      SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra): bool =
    injective_ba(g)
      AND measurable_ba(g, SigmaA, SigmaB)
      AND (FORALL (value: b_set):
        SigmaB(value) IMPLIES
          SigmaA(image_ba(g, value)))

  measurable_equivalence(
      h: [A -> B],
      k: [B -> A],
      SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra,
      SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra): bool =
    (FORALL (x: A): k(h(x)) = x)
      AND (FORALL (y: B): h(k(y)) = y)
      AND measurable_ab(h, SigmaA, SigmaB)
      AND measurable_ba(k, SigmaA, SigmaB)

  schroeder_bernstein_theorem: bool =
    FORALL
      (SigmaA: a_sigma_algebra),
      (SigmaB: b_sigma_algebra),
      (f: [A -> B]),
      (g: [B -> A]):
        (is_a_sigma_algebra(SigmaA)
          AND is_b_sigma_algebra(SigmaB)
          AND measurable_embedding_ab(f, SigmaA, SigmaB)
          AND measurable_embedding_ba(g, SigmaA, SigmaB))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (h: [A -> B]), (k: [B -> A]):
            measurable_equivalence(
              h, k, SigmaA, SigmaB)
END schroeder_bernstein_measurable_spaces_Q7432915

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q7433182
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q7433182), "Schwartz–Zippel theorem": a nonzero
-- multivariable polynomial over an integral domain has its normalized count
-- of zeros on a dependent product of finite sets bounded by a support-degree supremum.
-- This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
public import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv
public import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Variables
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.GroupWithZero.Finset
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Ring.Finset
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
public import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Finset

@[expose] public section

open Fin Finset Fintype

namespace Q7433182

local notation:70 s:70 " ^^ " n:71 => piFinset fun i : Fin n ↦ s i

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [DecidableEq R]

/-- The sharp dependent-product form of the Schwartz–Zippel theorem. -/
theorem schwartz_zippel_sup_sum_statement :
    ∀ {n} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R} (hp : p ≠ 0) (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      #{x ∈ S ^^ n | MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0} / ∏ i, (#(S i) : ℚ≥0) ≤
        p.support.sup fun s ↦ ∑ i, (s i / #(S i) : ℚ≥0) := sorry

end Q7433182

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7433182
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q7433182), "Schwartz–Zippel theorem": a nonzero
  multivariate polynomial over an integral domain has, on a product of finite
  sample sets, a zero fraction bounded by the maximum over its supported
  monomials of the sum of coordinate degrees divided by sample-set sizes.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List Arith.PeanoNat ZArith QArith.QArith.

Import ListNotations.
Open Scope Q_scope.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q7433182_commutative_integral_domain (R : Type) : Type := {
  q7433182_zero : R;
  q7433182_one : R;
  q7433182_add : R -> R -> R;
  q7433182_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q7433182_neg : R -> R;
  q7433182_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q7433182_add x (q7433182_add y z) =
      q7433182_add (q7433182_add x y) z;
  q7433182_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q7433182_add x y = q7433182_add y x;
  q7433182_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q7433182_add x q7433182_zero = x;
  q7433182_add_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q7433182_add x (q7433182_neg x) = q7433182_zero;
  q7433182_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q7433182_mul x (q7433182_mul y z) =
      q7433182_mul (q7433182_mul x y) z;
  q7433182_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q7433182_mul x y = q7433182_mul y x;
  q7433182_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q7433182_mul x q7433182_one = x;
  q7433182_mul_add :
    forall x y z : R,
      q7433182_mul x (q7433182_add y z) =
      q7433182_add
        (q7433182_mul x y) (q7433182_mul x z);
  q7433182_one_ne_zero :
    q7433182_one <> q7433182_zero;
  q7433182_no_zero_divisors :
    forall x y : R,
      q7433182_mul x y = q7433182_zero ->
      x = q7433182_zero \/ y = q7433182_zero
}.

Arguments q7433182_zero {R} _.
Arguments q7433182_one {R} _.
Arguments q7433182_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q7433182_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q7433182_neg {R} _ _.

Record q7433182_vector (A : Type) (n : nat) : Type := {
  q7433182_vector_elements : list A;
  q7433182_vector_length :
    length q7433182_vector_elements = n
}.

Arguments q7433182_vector_elements {A n} _.

Record q7433182_finset (A : Type) : Type := {
  q7433182_finset_elements : list A;
  q7433182_finset_nodup :
    NoDup q7433182_finset_elements
}.

Arguments q7433182_finset_elements {A} _.

Definition q7433182_monomial (n : nat) : Type :=
  q7433182_vector nat n.

Definition q7433182_polynomial (R : Type) (n : nat) : Type :=
  list (q7433182_monomial n * R).

Fixpoint q7433182_nat_list_eqb
    (xs ys : list nat) : bool :=
  match xs, ys with
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs', y :: ys' =>
      Nat.eqb x y && q7433182_nat_list_eqb xs' ys'
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_pow
    {R : Type}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (x : R) (n : nat) : R :=
  match n with
  | O => q7433182_one D
  | S k => q7433182_mul D x (q7433182_pow D x k)
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_coefficient
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (terms : q7433182_polynomial R n)
    (exponents : list nat) : R :=
  match terms with
  | [] => q7433182_zero D
  | (m, c) :: rest =>
      if q7433182_nat_list_eqb
          (q7433182_vector_elements m) exponents
      then
        q7433182_add D c
          (q7433182_coefficient D rest exponents)
      else q7433182_coefficient D rest exponents
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_monomial_mem
    (m : list nat) (monomials : list (list nat)) : bool :=
  match monomials with
  | [] => false
  | x :: rest =>
      if q7433182_nat_list_eqb m x
      then true
      else q7433182_monomial_mem m rest
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_collect_monomials
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (terms : q7433182_polynomial R n) : list (list nat) :=
  match terms with
  | [] => []
  | (m, _) :: rest =>
      let collected := q7433182_collect_monomials rest in
      let exponents := q7433182_vector_elements m in
      if q7433182_monomial_mem exponents collected
      then collected
      else exponents :: collected
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_filter_support
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : R, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (terms : q7433182_polynomial R n)
    (monomials : list (list nat)) : list (list nat) :=
  match monomials with
  | [] => []
  | m :: rest =>
      if eq_dec (q7433182_coefficient D terms m) (q7433182_zero D)
      then q7433182_filter_support D eq_dec terms rest
      else m :: q7433182_filter_support D eq_dec terms rest
  end.

Definition q7433182_support
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : R, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (p : q7433182_polynomial R n) : list (list nat) :=
  q7433182_filter_support D eq_dec p
    (q7433182_collect_monomials p).

Definition q7433182_polynomial_nonzero
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : R, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (p : q7433182_polynomial R n) : Prop :=
  q7433182_support D eq_dec p <> [].

Fixpoint q7433182_monomial_value
    {R : Type}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (exponents : list nat)
    (point : list R) : R :=
  match exponents, point with
  | [], [] => q7433182_one D
  | exponent :: exponents', x :: point' =>
      q7433182_mul D
        (q7433182_pow D x exponent)
        (q7433182_monomial_value D exponents' point')
  | _, _ => q7433182_one D
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_evaluate
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (point : list R)
    (p : q7433182_polynomial R n) : R :=
  match p with
  | [] => q7433182_zero D
  | (m, c) :: rest =>
      q7433182_add D
        (q7433182_mul D c
          (q7433182_monomial_value D
            (q7433182_vector_elements m) point))
        (q7433182_evaluate D point rest)
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_cartesian_product
    {R : Type}
    (sets : list (q7433182_finset R)) : list (list R) :=
  match sets with
  | [] => [[]]
  | set :: rest =>
      flat_map
        (fun x =>
          map (fun point => x :: point)
            (q7433182_cartesian_product rest))
        (q7433182_finset_elements set)
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_zero_count
    {R : Type} {n : nat}
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : R, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (p : q7433182_polynomial R n)
    (points : list (list R)) : nat :=
  match points with
  | [] => O
  | point :: rest =>
      if eq_dec (q7433182_evaluate D point p) (q7433182_zero D)
      then S (q7433182_zero_count D eq_dec p rest)
      else q7433182_zero_count D eq_dec p rest
  end.

Definition q7433182_nat_to_Q (n : nat) : Q :=
  inject_Z (Z.of_nat n).

Fixpoint q7433182_cardinality_product
    {R : Type}
    (sets : list (q7433182_finset R)) : Q :=
  match sets with
  | [] => 1
  | set :: rest =>
      q7433182_nat_to_Q
        (length (q7433182_finset_elements set)) *
      q7433182_cardinality_product rest
  end.

Fixpoint q7433182_exponent_ratio_sum
    {R : Type}
    (exponents : list nat)
    (sets : list (q7433182_finset R)) : Q :=
  match exponents, sets with
  | [], [] => 0
  | exponent :: exponents', set :: sets' =>
      q7433182_nat_to_Q exponent /
        q7433182_nat_to_Q
          (length (q7433182_finset_elements set)) +
      q7433182_exponent_ratio_sum exponents' sets'
  | _, _ => 0
  end.

Definition q7433182_Qmax (x y : Q) : Q :=
  if Qle_bool x y then y else x.

Fixpoint q7433182_support_sup_sum
    {R : Type}
    (support : list (list nat))
    (sets : list (q7433182_finset R)) : Q :=
  match support with
  | [] => 0
  | monomial :: rest =>
      q7433182_Qmax
        (q7433182_exponent_ratio_sum monomial sets)
        (q7433182_support_sup_sum rest sets)
  end.

Theorem MvPolynomial_schwartz_zippel_sup_sum :
  forall
    (R : Type)
    (D : q7433182_commutative_integral_domain R)
    (eq_dec : forall x y : R, {x = y} + {x <> y})
    (n : nat)
    (p : q7433182_polynomial R n),
    q7433182_polynomial_nonzero D eq_dec p ->
    forall S : q7433182_vector (q7433182_finset R) n,
      q7433182_nat_to_Q
        (q7433182_zero_count D eq_dec p
          (q7433182_cartesian_product
            (q7433182_vector_elements S))) /
        q7433182_cardinality_product
          (q7433182_vector_elements S)
      <=
      q7433182_support_sup_sum
        (q7433182_support D eq_dec p)
        (q7433182_vector_elements S).
Admitted.

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact
  Q7433182 (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7433182), "Schwartz–Zippel theorem":
  for a nonzero multivariate polynomial over an integral domain, the fraction
  of zeros in a product of coordinate-specific finite sets is bounded by the
  maximum, over supported monomials, of the sum of coordinate degrees divided
  by the corresponding set cardinalities. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

type_synonym ('v, 'a) q7433182_raw_mpoly = "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q7433182_monomial_support ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> 'v set" where
  "q7433182_monomial_support m = {i. m i \<noteq> 0}"

definition q7433182_polynomial_support ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) q7433182_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> nat) set" where
  "q7433182_polynomial_support p = {m. p m \<noteq> 0}"

definition q7433182_is_mpoly ::
    "('v, 'a::zero) q7433182_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "q7433182_is_mpoly p \<longleftrightarrow>
    finite (q7433182_polynomial_support p) \<and>
    (\<forall>m\<in>q7433182_polynomial_support p.
      finite (q7433182_monomial_support m))"

definition q7433182_mpoly_eval ::
    "('v \<Rightarrow> 'a::comm_semiring_1) \<Rightarrow>
      ('v, 'a) q7433182_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q7433182_mpoly_eval x p =
    (\<Sum>m\<in>q7433182_polynomial_support p.
      p m * (\<Prod>i\<in>q7433182_monomial_support m. x i ^ m i))"

definition q7433182_zero_ratio ::
    "('v::finite, 'a::comm_semiring_1) q7433182_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> rat" where
  "q7433182_zero_ratio p S =
    of_nat (card {x. (\<forall>i. x i \<in> S i) \<and>
      q7433182_mpoly_eval x p = 0}) /
      prod (\<lambda>i. of_nat (card (S i))) UNIV"

definition q7433182_monomial_score ::
    "('v::finite \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> ('v \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow> rat" where
  "q7433182_monomial_score S m =
    sum (\<lambda>i. of_nat (m i) / of_nat (card (S i))) UNIV"

definition q7433182_support_sup ::
    "('v::finite, 'a::zero) q7433182_raw_mpoly \<Rightarrow>
      ('v \<Rightarrow> 'a set) \<Rightarrow> rat" where
  "q7433182_support_sup p S =
    (if q7433182_polynomial_support p = {} then 0
     else Max (q7433182_monomial_score S `
       q7433182_polynomial_support p))"

theorem q7433182_schwartz_zippel_sup_sum:
  fixes p :: "('v::finite, 'a::idom) q7433182_raw_mpoly"
    and S :: "'v \<Rightarrow> 'a set"
  assumes polynomial_p: "q7433182_is_mpoly p"
    and nonzero_p: "p \<noteq> (\<lambda>_. 0)"
    and finite_S: "\<forall>i. finite (S i)"
  shows "q7433182_zero_ratio p S \<le> q7433182_support_sup p S"
  sorry

end

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7433182
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q7433182), "Schwartz-Zippel theorem": for a
  nonzero multivariate polynomial over an integral domain, the fraction of
  zeros in a dependent product of finite subsets is bounded by the maximum,
  over supported monomials, of the sum of coordinate degrees divided by the
  corresponding subset cardinalities. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q7433182_SCHWARTZ_ZIPPEL_SUP_SUM =
  `let is_integral_domain =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (negK:K->K).
       ~(zeroK = oneK) /\
       (!x:K. addK zeroK x = x) /\
       (!x:K. addK (negK x) x = zeroK) /\
       (!x y:K. addK x y = addK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. addK x (addK y z) = addK (addK x y) z) /\
       (!x:K. mulK oneK x = x) /\
       (!x y:K. mulK x y = mulK y x) /\
       (!x y z:K. mulK x (mulK y z) = mulK (mulK x y) z) /\
       (!x y z:K.
          mulK x (addK y z) = addK (mulK x y) (mulK x z)) /\
       (!x y:K. mulK x y = zeroK ==> x = zeroK \/ y = zeroK) in
   let power =
     \(oneK:K) (mulK:K->K->K) (x:K) (d:num).
       ITLIST mulK (REPLICATE d x) oneK in
   let is_monomial_on =
     \(n:num) (m:num->num).
       !i:num. n <= i ==> m i = 0 in
   let is_mv_polynomial =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (p:(num->num)->K).
       FINITE {m | ~(p m = zeroK)} /\
       (!m:num->num.
          ~(p m = zeroK) ==> is_monomial_on n m) in
   let polynomial_zero =
     \(zeroK:K). \(m:num->num). zeroK in
   let polynomial_eval =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (oneK:K)
      (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:(num->num)->K) (x:num->K).
       iterate addK {m | ~(p m = zeroK)}
         (\m. mulK (p m)
           (iterate mulK {i:num | i < n}
             (\i. power oneK mulK (x i) (m i)))) in
   let product_points =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (S:num->K->bool).
       {x:num->K |
          (!i:num. i < n ==> x i IN S i) /\
          (!i:num. n <= i ==> x i = zeroK)} in
   let zero_points =
     \(n:num) (zeroK:K) (oneK:K)
      (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (p:(num->num)->K) (S:num->K->bool).
       {x:num->K |
          x IN product_points n zeroK S /\
          polynomial_eval n zeroK oneK addK mulK p x = zeroK} in
   let monomial_weight =
     \(n:num) (S:num->K->bool) (m:num->num).
       sum {i:num | i < n}
         (\i. &(m i) / &(CARD (S i))) in
   !n:num.
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !negK:K->K.
   !p:(num->num)->K.
   !S:num->K->bool.
     is_integral_domain zeroK oneK addK mulK negK /\
     is_mv_polynomial n zeroK p /\
     ~(p = polynomial_zero zeroK) /\
     (!i:num. i < n ==> FINITE (S i))
     ==>
     &(CARD (zero_points n zeroK oneK addK mulK p S)) /
       product {i:num | i < n} (\i. &(CARD (S i)))
     <=
     sup
       (IMAGE (monomial_weight n S)
          {m:num->num | ~(p m = zeroK)})`;;

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact
;; thousand-theorems__acl2__Q7433182, "Schwartz–Zippel theorem": for a
;; nonzero multivariate polynomial over an arbitrary commutative integral
;; domain, the fraction of zeros on a finite dependent product is bounded by
;; the support supremum of the sums of coordinate degrees divided by the
;; corresponding set cardinalities. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; The integral-domain carrier and operations are arbitrary tame APPLY$
;; function objects. FN-EQUAL supplies universal quantification over the full
;; carrier. The polynomial and each member of the dependent family of finite
;; sets have their source-exact finite representations: a canonical sparse
;; exponent/coefficient list and a duplicate-free list, respectively.

(defun q7433182-quoted (object)
  (list 'quote object))

(defun q7433182-term-list (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'cons
            (car terms)
            (q7433182-term-list (cdr terms)))
    (q7433182-quoted nil)))

(defun q7433182-static-apply-term (function arguments)
  (list 'apply$
        (q7433182-quoted function)
        (q7433182-term-list arguments)))

(defun q7433182-and-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q7433182-and-terms (cdr terms))
            (q7433182-quoted nil))
    (q7433182-quoted t)))

(defun q7433182-or-terms (terms)
  (if (consp terms)
      (list 'if
            (car terms)
            (q7433182-quoted t)
            (q7433182-or-terms (cdr terms)))
    (q7433182-quoted nil)))

(defun q7433182-implies-term (hypothesis conclusion)
  (list 'if hypothesis conclusion (q7433182-quoted t)))

(defun q7433182-true-function (formals)
  (list 'lambda formals (q7433182-quoted t)))

(defun q7433182-universal-p (function formals)
  (let ((always-true (q7433182-true-function formals)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp function)
     (tamep-functionp always-true)
     (fn-equal function always-true))))

(defun q7433182-member-p (carrier object)
  (if (apply$ carrier (list object)) t nil))

(defun q7433182-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Arbitrary nontrivial commutative rings with no zero divisors.

(defun q7433182-ring-laws-function
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate)
  (let* ((add-xy (q7433182-static-apply-term add '(x y)))
         (add-yz (q7433182-static-apply-term add '(y z)))
         (mul-xy (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply '(x y)))
         (mul-yz (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply '(y z)))
         (neg-x (q7433182-static-apply-term negate '(x)))
         (domain
          (q7433182-and-terms
           (list
            (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
            (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
            (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier '(z))))))
    (list
     'lambda '(x y z)
     (q7433182-implies-term
      domain
      (q7433182-and-terms
       (list
        (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier (list add-xy))
        (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier (list mul-xy))
        (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier (list neg-x))
        (list 'equal
              (q7433182-static-apply-term add (list add-xy 'z))
              (q7433182-static-apply-term add (list 'x add-yz)))
        (list 'equal
              add-xy
              (q7433182-static-apply-term add '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q7433182-static-apply-term
               add (list 'x (q7433182-quoted zero)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q7433182-static-apply-term add (list 'x neg-x))
              (q7433182-quoted zero))
        (list 'equal
              (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply (list mul-xy 'z))
              (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x mul-yz)))
        (list 'equal
              mul-xy
              (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply '(y x)))
        (list 'equal
              (q7433182-static-apply-term
               multiply (list 'x (q7433182-quoted one)))
              'x)
        (list 'equal
              (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply (list 'x add-yz))
              (q7433182-static-apply-term
               add
               (list
                (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
                (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply '(x z)))))))))))

(defun q7433182-no-zero-divisors-function
    (carrier zero multiply)
  (list
   'lambda '(x y)
   (q7433182-implies-term
    (q7433182-and-terms
     (list
      (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier '(x))
      (q7433182-static-apply-term carrier '(y))
      (list 'equal
            (q7433182-static-apply-term multiply '(x y))
            (q7433182-quoted zero))))
    (q7433182-or-terms
     (list
      (list 'equal 'x (q7433182-quoted zero))
      (list 'equal 'y (q7433182-quoted zero)))))))

(defun q7433182-integral-domain-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp multiply)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (q7433182-member-p carrier zero)
   (q7433182-member-p carrier one)
   (not (equal zero one))
   (q7433182-universal-p
    (q7433182-ring-laws-function
     carrier zero one add multiply negate)
    '(x y z))
   (q7433182-universal-p
    (q7433182-no-zero-divisors-function
     carrier zero multiply)
    '(x y))))

;; Canonical finite-support multivariate polynomials. Exponent vectors have
;; one natural coordinate for each variable. Terms are strictly ordered, so
;; every exponent occurs once, and zero coefficients are omitted.

(defun q7433182-natural-vector-p (vector length)
  (if (consp vector)
      (and
       (posp length)
       (natp (car vector))
       (q7433182-natural-vector-p
        (cdr vector) (- length 1)))
    (and
     (equal vector nil)
     (equal length 0))))

(defun q7433182-exponent-less-p (left right)
  (if (consp left)
      (if (< (car left) (car right))
          t
        (and
         (equal (car left) (car right))
         (q7433182-exponent-less-p
          (cdr left) (cdr right))))
    nil))

(defun q7433182-polynomial-tail-p
    (polynomial variable-count carrier zero
                previous have-previous)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (let ((term (car polynomial)))
        (and
         (true-listp term)
         (equal (len term) 2)
         (q7433182-natural-vector-p
          (car term) variable-count)
         (q7433182-member-p carrier (cadr term))
         (not (equal (cadr term) zero))
         (or
          (not have-previous)
          (q7433182-exponent-less-p
           previous (car term)))
         (q7433182-polynomial-tail-p
          (cdr polynomial) variable-count carrier zero
          (car term) t)))
    (equal polynomial nil)))

(defun q7433182-polynomial-p
    (polynomial variable-count carrier zero)
  (and
   (natp variable-count)
   (true-listp polynomial)
   (q7433182-polynomial-tail-p
    polynomial variable-count carrier zero nil nil)))

;; A list of duplicate-free lists presents S : Fin n -> Finset R exactly.

(defun q7433182-set-elements-p (elements carrier)
  (if (consp elements)
      (and
       (q7433182-member-p carrier (car elements))
       (q7433182-set-elements-p (cdr elements) carrier))
    (equal elements nil)))

(defun q7433182-finset-p (elements carrier)
  (and
   (true-listp elements)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal elements)
   (q7433182-set-elements-p elements carrier)))

(defun q7433182-dependent-finsets-p
    (sets variable-count carrier)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (posp variable-count)
       (q7433182-finset-p (car sets) carrier)
       (q7433182-dependent-finsets-p
        (cdr sets) (- variable-count 1) carrier))
    (and
     (equal sets nil)
     (equal variable-count 0))))

;; Exact evaluation in the represented integral domain.

(defun q7433182-domain-power
    (value exponent one multiply)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix exponent)))
  (if (zp exponent)
      one
    (q7433182-binary-value
     multiply
     value
     (q7433182-domain-power
      value (- exponent 1) one multiply))))

(defun q7433182-monomial-eval
    (exponents point one multiply)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (q7433182-binary-value
       multiply
       (q7433182-domain-power
        (car point) (car exponents) one multiply)
       (q7433182-monomial-eval
        (cdr exponents) (cdr point) one multiply))
    one))

(defun q7433182-polynomial-eval
    (polynomial point zero one add multiply)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (q7433182-binary-value
       add
       (q7433182-binary-value
        multiply
        (cadar polynomial)
        (q7433182-monomial-eval
         (caar polynomial) point one multiply))
       (q7433182-polynomial-eval
        (cdr polynomial) point zero one add multiply))
    zero))

;; Exact enumeration of the dependent Cartesian product.

(defun q7433182-prepend-to-points (value points)
  (if (consp points)
      (cons
       (cons value (car points))
       (q7433182-prepend-to-points value (cdr points)))
    nil))

(defun q7433182-extend-points (values points)
  (if (consp values)
      (append
       (q7433182-prepend-to-points
        (car values) points)
       (q7433182-extend-points
        (cdr values) points))
    nil))

(defun q7433182-all-points (sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (q7433182-extend-points
       (car sets)
       (q7433182-all-points (cdr sets)))
    (list nil)))

(defun q7433182-count-zeros
    (points polynomial zero one add multiply)
  (if (consp points)
      (+
       (if
        (equal
         (q7433182-polynomial-eval
          polynomial (car points) zero one add multiply)
         zero)
        1
        0)
       (q7433182-count-zeros
        (cdr points) polynomial zero one add multiply))
    0))

(defun q7433182-cardinality-product (sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (*
       (len (car sets))
       (q7433182-cardinality-product (cdr sets)))
    1))

;; Division by zero is explicitly totalized to zero, matching division on the
;; nonnegative rationals used by the source.

(defun q7433182-nonnegative-ratio
    (numerator denominator)
  (if (zp denominator)
      0
    (/ numerator denominator)))

(defun q7433182-support-sum (exponents sets)
  (if (consp exponents)
      (+
       (q7433182-nonnegative-ratio
        (car exponents) (len (car sets)))
       (q7433182-support-sum
        (cdr exponents) (cdr sets)))
    0))

(defun q7433182-support-supremum (polynomial sets)
  (if (consp polynomial)
      (max
       (q7433182-support-sum
        (caar polynomial) sets)
       (q7433182-support-supremum
        (cdr polynomial) sets))
    0))

(defun thousand-theorems-q7433182-schwartz-zippel-theorem-statement
    (variable-count polynomial sets
                    carrier zero one add multiply negate)
  (implies
   (and
    (q7433182-integral-domain-p
     carrier zero one add multiply negate)
    (q7433182-polynomial-p
     polynomial variable-count carrier zero)
    (consp polynomial)
   (q7433182-dependent-finsets-p
     sets variable-count carrier))
   (<=
    (q7433182-nonnegative-ratio
     (q7433182-count-zeros
      (q7433182-all-points sets)
      polynomial zero one add multiply)
     (q7433182-cardinality-product sets))
    (q7433182-support-supremum
     polynomial sets))))

;; Admission-time tameness audit for every reified lambda used above.

(defun q7433182-all-reified-functions-tame-p ()
  (let ((unary '(lambda (x) (quote t)))
        (binary '(lambda (x y) x)))
    (and
     (tamep-functionp
      (q7433182-true-function '(x)))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q7433182-ring-laws-function
       unary 0 1 binary binary unary))
     (tamep-functionp
      (q7433182-no-zero-divisors-function
       unary 0 binary)))))

(value-triple
 (if (q7433182-all-reified-functions-tame-p)
     :itpeval-tame-reified-functions-checked
   (er hard 'q7433182-tameness
       "A reified statement function is not tame.")))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7433182,
-- "Schwartz–Zippel theorem": the fraction of zeros of a nonzero multivariate
-- polynomial on a product of finite subsets is bounded by the maximum, over
-- supported monomials, of the sum of coordinate degrees divided by subset
-- cardinalities. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc; _+_; _*_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _not-equal_ _less-or-equal_
infixr 3 _or_
infix 2 _iff_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_not-equal_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x not-equal y =
  Not (x == y)

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record _iff_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Dec
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  yes : A -> Dec A
  no  : Not A -> Dec A

DecidableEquality :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
DecidableEquality A =
  (x y : A) ->
  Dec (x == y)

data _less-or-equal_ : Nat -> Nat -> Set where
  zero-less-or-equal :
    {n : Nat} ->
    zero less-or-equal n
  suc-less-or-equal :
    {m n : Nat} ->
    m less-or-equal n ->
    suc m less-or-equal suc n

lessOrEqualBool :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Bool
lessOrEqualBool zero n =
  true
lessOrEqualBool (suc m) zero =
  false
lessOrEqualBool (suc m) (suc n) =
  lessOrEqualBool m n

data Vector
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Nat ->
  Set a where

  vector-empty :
    Vector A zero
  vector-cons :
    {n : Nat} ->
    A ->
    Vector A n ->
    Vector A (suc n)

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  here :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)
  there :
    {y : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

data NoDuplicates
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  no-duplicates-empty :
    NoDuplicates []
  no-duplicates-cons :
    {x : A} {xs : List A} ->
    Not (Member x xs) ->
    NoDuplicates xs ->
    NoDuplicates (x ∷ xs)

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    elements      : List A
    no-duplicates : NoDuplicates elements

length :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  List A ->
  Nat
length [] =
  zero
length (x ∷ xs) =
  suc (length xs)

cardinality :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  Nat
cardinality subset =
  length (FiniteSubset.elements subset)

record IntegralDomain
  {a : Level}
  (R : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

    one-not-zero :
      oneR not-equal zeroR

    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    multiply-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    no-zero-divisors :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == zeroR ->
      (x == zeroR) or (y == zeroR)

power :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  IntegralDomain R ->
  R ->
  Nat ->
  R
power algebra x zero =
  IntegralDomain.oneR algebra
power algebra x (suc n) =
  IntegralDomain.multiplyR algebra x (power algebra x n)

monomialValue :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  (algebra : IntegralDomain R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector R n ->
  Vector Nat n ->
  R
monomialValue algebra vector-empty vector-empty =
  IntegralDomain.oneR algebra
monomialValue algebra
  (vector-cons value values)
  (vector-cons exponent exponents) =
  IntegralDomain.multiplyR algebra
    (power algebra value exponent)
    (monomialValue algebra values exponents)

record Polynomial
  {a : Level}
  {R : Set a}
  (algebra : IntegralDomain R)
  (n : Nat) :
  Set a where

  field
    coefficient :
      Vector Nat n ->
      R
    support :
      List (Vector Nat n)
    support-exact :
      (exponent : Vector Nat n) ->
      Member exponent support
      iff
      (coefficient exponent not-equal IntegralDomain.zeroR algebra)
    support-no-duplicates :
      NoDuplicates support

evaluateSupport :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  (algebra : IntegralDomain R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (coefficient : Vector Nat n -> R) ->
  List (Vector Nat n) ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
evaluateSupport algebra coefficient [] values =
  IntegralDomain.zeroR algebra
evaluateSupport algebra coefficient
  (exponent ∷ support) values =
  IntegralDomain.addR algebra
    (IntegralDomain.multiplyR algebra
      (coefficient exponent)
      (monomialValue algebra values exponent))
    (evaluateSupport algebra coefficient support values)

evaluate :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  (algebra : IntegralDomain R) ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial algebra n ->
  Vector R n ->
  R
evaluate algebra polynomial values =
  evaluateSupport algebra
    (Polynomial.coefficient polynomial)
    (Polynomial.support polynomial)
    values

NonzeroPolynomial :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {algebra : IntegralDomain R} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial algebra n ->
  Set a
NonzeroPolynomial {algebra = algebra} polynomial =
  Σ _
    (\ exponent ->
      Polynomial.coefficient polynomial exponent
      not-equal
      IntegralDomain.zeroR algebra)

prependAssignments :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  A ->
  List (Vector A n) ->
  List (Vector A (suc n))
prependAssignments x [] =
  []
prependAssignments x (values ∷ assignments) =
  vector-cons x values ∷ prependAssignments x assignments

chooseHeads :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  List A ->
  List (Vector A n) ->
  List (Vector A (suc n))
chooseHeads [] tails =
  []
chooseHeads (x ∷ xs) tails =
  append
    (prependAssignments x tails)
    (chooseHeads xs tails)
  where
  append :
    {b : Level} ->
    {B : Set b} ->
    List B ->
    List B ->
    List B
  append [] ys =
    ys
  append (y ∷ ys) zs =
    y ∷ append ys zs

cartesianAssignments :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector (FiniteSubset A) n ->
  List (Vector A n)
cartesianAssignments vector-empty =
  vector-empty ∷ []
cartesianAssignments (vector-cons subset subsets) =
  chooseHeads
    (FiniteSubset.elements subset)
    (cartesianAssignments subsets)

countZeros :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  (algebra : IntegralDomain R) ->
  DecidableEquality R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Polynomial algebra n ->
  List (Vector R n) ->
  Nat
countZeros algebra decidableEquality polynomial [] =
  zero
countZeros algebra decidableEquality polynomial (values ∷ assignments)
  with decidableEquality
    (evaluate algebra polynomial values)
    (IntegralDomain.zeroR algebra)
... | yes equality =
  suc (countZeros algebra decidableEquality polynomial assignments)
... | no inequality =
  countZeros algebra decidableEquality polynomial assignments

record Fraction : Set where
  constructor fraction
  field
    numerator           : Nat
    denominatorMinusOne : Nat

fractionDenominator :
  Fraction ->
  Nat
fractionDenominator value =
  suc (Fraction.denominatorMinusOne value)

zeroFraction :
  Fraction
zeroFraction =
  fraction zero zero

divideNaturals :
  Nat ->
  Nat ->
  Fraction
divideNaturals numerator zero =
  zeroFraction
divideNaturals numerator (suc denominatorMinusOne) =
  fraction numerator denominatorMinusOne

addFractions :
  Fraction ->
  Fraction ->
  Fraction
addFractions first second =
  fraction
    ((Fraction.numerator first * fractionDenominator second) +
     (Fraction.numerator second * fractionDenominator first))
    ((Fraction.denominatorMinusOne first +
      Fraction.denominatorMinusOne second) +
     (Fraction.denominatorMinusOne first *
      Fraction.denominatorMinusOne second))

FractionLessOrEqual :
  Fraction ->
  Fraction ->
  Set
FractionLessOrEqual first second =
  (Fraction.numerator first * fractionDenominator second)
  less-or-equal
  (Fraction.numerator second * fractionDenominator first)

fractionLessOrEqualBool :
  Fraction ->
  Fraction ->
  Bool
fractionLessOrEqualBool first second =
  lessOrEqualBool
    (Fraction.numerator first * fractionDenominator second)
    (Fraction.numerator second * fractionDenominator first)

maxFraction :
  Fraction ->
  Fraction ->
  Fraction
maxFraction first second with fractionLessOrEqualBool first second
... | true =
  second
... | false =
  first

sumCoordinateRatios :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector Nat n ->
  Vector (FiniteSubset R) n ->
  Fraction
sumCoordinateRatios vector-empty vector-empty =
  zeroFraction
sumCoordinateRatios
  (vector-cons exponent exponents)
  (vector-cons subset subsets) =
  addFractions
    (divideNaturals exponent (cardinality subset))
    (sumCoordinateRatios exponents subsets)

supportSupremum :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  List (Vector Nat n) ->
  Vector (FiniteSubset R) n ->
  Fraction
supportSupremum [] subsets =
  zeroFraction
supportSupremum (exponent ∷ support) subsets =
  maxFraction
    (sumCoordinateRatios exponent subsets)
    (supportSupremum support subsets)

productCardinalities :
  {a : Level} ->
  {R : Set a} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Vector (FiniteSubset R) n ->
  Nat
productCardinalities vector-empty =
  suc zero
productCardinalities (vector-cons subset subsets) =
  cardinality subset * productCardinalities subsets

schwartz-zippel-theorem : Setω
schwartz-zippel-theorem =
  {a : Level} ->
  (R : Set a) ->
  (algebra : IntegralDomain R) ->
  (decidableEquality : DecidableEquality R) ->
  (n : Nat) ->
  (polynomial : Polynomial algebra n) ->
  NonzeroPolynomial polynomial ->
  (subsets : Vector (FiniteSubset R) n) ->
  FractionLessOrEqual
    (divideNaturals
      (countZeros algebra decidableEquality polynomial
        (cartesianAssignments subsets))
      (productCardinalities subsets))
    (supportSupremum
      (Polynomial.support polynomial)
      subsets)

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q7433182, "Schwartz-Zippel theorem": the sharp Schwartz-Zippel bound for a
  nonzero multivariate polynomial over an integral domain, evaluated on a
  dependent product of finite subsets. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory pred_setTheory ratTheory;

val q7433182_integral_domain_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_integral_domain_def",
  ``q7433182_integral_domain
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r) <=>
      zero <> oneR /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = mul y x) /\
      (!x y z. mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)) /\
      (!x. mul oneR x = x) /\
      (!x y z. mul x (add y z) = add (mul x y) (mul x z)) /\
      (!x y. mul x y = zero ==> x = zero \/ y = zero)``);

val q7433182_polynomial_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_polynomial_def",
  ``q7433182_polynomial
      (zero : 'r) (n : num) (p : (num -> num) -> 'r) <=>
      FINITE {m : num -> num | p m <> zero} /\
      (!m : num -> num.
         p m <> zero ==> !i : num. n <= i ==> m i = 0)``);

val q7433182_monomial_value_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_monomial_value_def",
  ``q7433182_monomial_value
      (oneR : 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (n : num) (x : num -> 'r) (m : num -> num) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc. mul (FUNPOW (mul (x i)) (m i) oneR) acc)
        (count n)
        oneR``);

val q7433182_eval_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_eval_def",
  ``q7433182_eval
      (zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (n : num) (x : num -> 'r) (p : (num -> num) -> 'r) =
      ITSET
        (\m acc.
           add
             (mul (p m)
               (q7433182_monomial_value oneR mul n x m))
             acc)
        {m : num -> num | p m <> zero}
        zero``);

val q7433182_grid_point_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_grid_point_def",
  ``q7433182_grid_point
      (zero : 'r) (n : num) (sets : num -> 'r set) (x : num -> 'r) <=>
      (!i : num. i < n ==> x i IN sets i) /\
      (!i : num. n <= i ==> x i = zero)``);

val q7433182_card_product_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_card_product_def",
  ``q7433182_card_product (n : num) (sets : num -> 'r set) =
      ITSET (\i acc. CARD (sets i) * acc) (count n) 1``);

val q7433182_safe_div_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_safe_div_def",
  ``q7433182_safe_div (a : rat) (b : rat) =
      if b = 0q then 0q else a / b``);

val q7433182_monomial_weight_def = new_definition (
  "q7433182_monomial_weight_def",
  ``q7433182_monomial_weight
      (n : num) (sets : num -> 'r set) (m : num -> num) =
      ITSET
        (\i acc.
           rat_add
             (q7433182_safe_div
               (rat_of_num (m i))
               (rat_of_num (CARD (sets i))))
             acc)
        (count n)
        0q``);

val MvPolynomial_schwartz_zippel_sup_sum =
  ``!(zero : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (add : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mul : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (neg : 'r -> 'r)
      (n : num) (p : (num -> num) -> 'r)
      (sets : num -> 'r set).
      q7433182_integral_domain zero oneR add mul neg /\
      q7433182_polynomial zero n p /\
      p <> (\m : num -> num. zero) /\
      (!i : num. i < n ==> FINITE (sets i))
      ==>
      ?m : num -> num.
        p m <> zero /\
        q7433182_safe_div
          (rat_of_num
            (CARD
              {x : num -> 'r |
                 q7433182_grid_point zero n sets x /\
                 q7433182_eval zero oneR add mul n x p = zero}))
          (rat_of_num (q7433182_card_product n sets)) <=
        q7433182_monomial_weight n sets m``;

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7433182
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7433182), "Schwartz-Zippel theorem": for a
  nonzero multivariate polynomial over an arbitrary integral domain, the
  normalized number of zeros on a dependent product of finite subsets is
  bounded by the support supremum of the sums of coordinate degrees divided
  by the corresponding subset cardinalities. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The finite ordinal n represents Lean's Fin n.  A family S maps each
  coordinate to a finite subset of Base(R), and the restricted class in the
  numerator is exactly its dependent product filtered by polynomial
  evaluation at zero.  SetMM polynomials are coefficient functions on
  finitely supported NN0-valued exponent vectors, so P supp (0g ` R) is
  Lean's polynomial support and s ` i is the exponent of coordinate i.

  All cardinalities, exponents, sums, products, and quotient values in the
  displayed inequality are nonnegative rationals.  Q7433182ZDiv explicitly
  returns zero when its denominator is zero and otherwise uses ordinary
  rational division, exactly matching Lean's nonnegative-rational division.
  Because P is nonzero, its support is finite and nonempty, making the ordered
  supremum over QQ exactly Lean's finite supremum.  The declaration below is
  an unproved $a statement; this database contains no $p proof declaration.
$)

$c Q7433182ZDiv $.

q7433182-zero-totalized-quotient-syntax $a
  class ( Q7433182ZDiv A B )
$.

${
  $d A B $.

  q7433182-zero-totalized-quotient-definition $a |-
    ( Q7433182ZDiv A B ) =
      if ( B = 0 , 0 , ( A / B ) )
  $.
$}

${
  $d P R S i n s x $.

  thousand-theorems-q7433182-schwartz-zippel-sup-sum $a |-
    A. R e. IDomn
      A. n e. NN0
        A. P e. ( Base ` ( n mPoly R ) )
          ( P =/= ( 0g ` ( n mPoly R ) )
            ->
            A. S e. ( n --> ( ~P ( Base ` R ) i^i Fin ) )
              (
                ( Q7433182ZDiv
                  ( # `
                    { x e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m n ) |
                      ( ( A. i e. n ( x ` i ) e. ( S ` i ) )
                        /\
                        ( ( ( n eval R ) ` P ) ` x ) =
                          ( 0g ` R ) ) } )
                  ( prod_ i e. n ( # ` ( S ` i ) ) )
                )
                <_
                sup (
                  ran
                    ( s e. ( P supp ( 0g ` R ) ) |->
                      ( sum_ i e. n
                        ( Q7433182ZDiv
                          ( s ` i )
                          ( # ` ( S ` i ) ) ) ) ) ,
                  QQ ,
                  <
                )
              ) )
  $.
$}

 expansions STRUCT_0, GROUP_1, ALGSTR_0, RLVECT_1, VECTSP_1, TARSKI, GROUP_6,
      FUNCT_1, RING_2, FUNCT_2, POLYNOM1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for n being Nat,
      R being domRing,
      p being Polynomial of n,R,
      S being Function of n,Fin the carrier of R st
    p <> 0_(n,R)
  holds
    ex sizes being FinSequence of REAL,
       zeros being finite set,
       bound being Element of REAL st
      len sizes = n &
      (for i being Nat st i in n holds
        sizes/.(i+1) = card (S.i)) &
      zeros =
        {x where x is Function of n,R :
          (for i being Nat st i in n holds x.i in S.i) &
          (hom_Ext_eval(x,R)).p = 0.R} &
      (ex b0 being bag of n,
          terms0 being FinSequence of REAL st
        b0 in Support p &
        len terms0 = n &
        (for i being Nat st i in n holds
          terms0/.(i+1) =
            (b0.i qua Real) / sizes/.(i+1)) &
        bound = Sum terms0) &
      (for b being bag of n st b in Support p holds
        ex terms being FinSequence of REAL st
          len terms = n &
          (for i being Nat st i in n holds
            terms/.(i+1) =
              (b.i qua Real) / sizes/.(i+1)) &
          Sum terms <= bound) &
      (card zeros qua Real) / Product sizes <= bound
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7433182,
% "Schwartz–Zippel theorem": the zero density of a nonzero multivariate
% polynomial over an integral domain is bounded by the maximum normalized
% coordinate-degree sum of a monomial in its support. This file contains no proof.

Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem[
  n: nat,
  R: TYPE+,
  zero_R, one_R: R,
  neg_R: [R -> R],
  add_R, mul_R: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN

  monomial: TYPE = [nat -> nat]
  point: TYPE = [nat -> R]
  coefficient_function: TYPE = [monomial -> R]
  coordinate_family: TYPE = [nat -> list[R]]

  polynomial: TYPE =
    [# coefficients: coefficient_function,
       support_list: list[monomial] #]

  element_member(value: R, values: list[R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        value = head OR element_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  no_duplicate_elements(values: list[R]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT element_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_elements(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  list_length(values: list[R]): RECURSIVE nat =
    CASES values OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail): 1 + list_length(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  monomial_member(
      value: monomial,
      values: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: FALSE,
      cons(head, tail):
        value = head OR monomial_member(value, tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  no_duplicate_monomials(values: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE bool =
    CASES values OF
      null: TRUE,
      cons(head, tail):
        NOT monomial_member(head, tail)
          AND no_duplicate_monomials(tail)
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE values BY <<

  supported_below(value: monomial, count: nat): bool =
    FORALL (index: nat):
      count <= index IMPLIES value(index) = 0

  exact_support(p: polynomial): bool =
    no_duplicate_monomials(support_list(p))
      AND
    (FORALL (value: monomial):
      monomial_member(value, support_list(p))
        IFF coefficients(p)(value) /= zero_R)
      AND
    (FORALL (value: monomial):
      monomial_member(value, support_list(p))
        IMPLIES supported_below(value, n))

  nonzero_polynomial(p: polynomial): bool =
    EXISTS (value: monomial):
      coefficients(p)(value) /= zero_R

  coordinate_sets_valid(
      sets: coordinate_family,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      coordinate_sets_valid(sets, count - 1)
        AND no_duplicate_elements(sets(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  ring_power(value: R, exponent: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF exponent = 0 THEN
      one_R
    ELSE
      mul_R(ring_power(value, exponent - 1), value)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE exponent

  monomial_value(
      assignment: point,
      value: monomial,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      one_R
    ELSE
      mul_R(
        monomial_value(assignment, value, count - 1),
        ring_power(
          assignment(count - 1),
          value(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  polynomial_sum(
      p: polynomial,
      assignment: point,
      terms: list[monomial]): RECURSIVE R =
    CASES terms OF
      null: zero_R,
      cons(head, tail):
        add_R(
          mul_R(
            coefficients(p)(head),
            monomial_value(assignment, head, n)),
          polynomial_sum(p, assignment, tail))
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE terms BY <<

  evaluate(p: polynomial, assignment: point): R =
    polynomial_sum(p, assignment, support_list(p))

  point_in_box(
      assignment: point,
      sets: coordinate_family,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      point_in_box(assignment, sets, count - 1)
        AND element_member(
          assignment(count - 1),
          sets(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  same_prefix(
      left, right: point,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE bool =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      TRUE
    ELSE
      same_prefix(left, right, count - 1)
        AND left(count - 1) = right(count - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  is_zero_assignment(
      p: polynomial,
      sets: coordinate_family,
      assignment: point): bool =
    point_in_box(assignment, sets, n)
      AND evaluate(p, assignment) = zero_R

  has_zero_cardinality(
      p: polynomial,
      sets: coordinate_family,
      cardinality: nat): bool =
    EXISTS (enumeration: [below(cardinality) -> point]):
      (FORALL (index: below(cardinality)):
        is_zero_assignment(p, sets, enumeration(index)))
        AND
      (FORALL (left, right: below(cardinality)):
        same_prefix(enumeration(left), enumeration(right), n)
          IMPLIES left = right)
        AND
      (FORALL (assignment: point):
        is_zero_assignment(p, sets, assignment)
          IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: below(cardinality)):
              same_prefix(
                enumeration(index),
                assignment,
                n))

  coordinate_product(
      sets: coordinate_family,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      coordinate_product(sets, count - 1)
        * list_length(sets(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  safe_ratio(numerator, denominator: nat): rat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      (numerator :: rat) / (denominator :: rat)
    ENDIF

  monomial_score(
      value: monomial,
      sets: coordinate_family,
      count: nat): RECURSIVE rat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      monomial_score(value, sets, count - 1)
        + safe_ratio(
            value(count - 1),
            list_length(sets(count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  maximum_support_score(
      terms: list[monomial],
      sets: coordinate_family): RECURSIVE rat =
    CASES terms OF
      null: 0,
      cons(head, tail):
        LET head_score: rat = monomial_score(head, sets, n),
            tail_score: rat =
              maximum_support_score(tail, sets)
        IN
          IF head_score <= tail_score THEN
            tail_score
          ELSE
            head_score
          ENDIF
    ENDCASES
  MEASURE terms BY <<

  commutative_integral_domain_laws: bool =
    zero_R /= one_R
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      add_R(x, y) = add_R(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      add_R(add_R(x, y), z) = add_R(x, add_R(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R):
      add_R(x, zero_R) = x
        AND add_R(x, neg_R(x)) = zero_R)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      mul_R(x, y) = mul_R(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mul_R(mul_R(x, y), z) = mul_R(x, mul_R(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: R):
      mul_R(x, one_R) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      mul_R(x, add_R(y, z))
        = add_R(mul_R(x, y), mul_R(x, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y: R):
      mul_R(x, y) = zero_R
        IMPLIES x = zero_R OR y = zero_R)

  schwartz_zippel_sup_sum: bool =
    commutative_integral_domain_laws
      IMPLIES
        FORALL
          (p: polynomial),
          (sets: coordinate_family):
            (exact_support(p)
              AND nonzero_polynomial(p)
              AND coordinate_sets_valid(sets, n))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (zero_count: nat):
                has_zero_cardinality(p, sets, zero_count)
                  AND
                safe_ratio(
                  zero_count,
                  coordinate_product(sets, n))
                  <=
                maximum_support_score(
                  support_list(p),
                  sets)

END Q7433182_schwartz_zippel_theorem

-- function on a nonempty compact set attains its minimum. This file contains no proof.

module

/-- The extreme value theorem: a continuous function attains its minimum on a compact set. -/
theorem extreme_value_theorem [ClosedIicTopology α] {s : Set β} (hs : IsCompact s)

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q752375
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q752375), "Extreme value theorem": a continuous
  function from a nonempty compact subset of an arbitrary topological space
  into a linearly ordered topological space with closed lower intervals
  attains its minimum on that set. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q752375_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q752375_subset
    {A : Type}
    (U V : q752375_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x -> V x.

Record q752375_linear_order (A : Type) : Type := {
  q752375_le : A -> A -> Prop;
  q752375_le_refl :
    forall x : A, q752375_le x x;
  q752375_le_antisym :
    forall x y : A,
      q752375_le x y -> q752375_le y x -> x = y;
  q752375_le_trans :
    forall x y z : A,
      q752375_le x y -> q752375_le y z -> q752375_le x z;
  q752375_le_total :
    forall x y : A, q752375_le x y \/ q752375_le y x
}.

Arguments q752375_le {A} _ _ _.

Record q752375_topological_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q752375_is_open : q752375_set A -> Prop;
  q752375_open_ext :
    forall U V : q752375_set A,
      (forall x : A, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q752375_is_open U <-> q752375_is_open V);
  q752375_open_univ :
    q752375_is_open (fun _ : A => True);
  q752375_open_inter :
    forall U V : q752375_set A,
      q752375_is_open U ->
      q752375_is_open V ->
      q752375_is_open (fun x : A => U x /\ V x);
  q752375_open_sUnion :
    forall family : q752375_set (q752375_set A),
      (forall U : q752375_set A,
        family U -> q752375_is_open U) ->
      q752375_is_open
        (fun x : A =>
          exists U : q752375_set A, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q752375_is_open {A} _ _.

Definition q752375_is_closed
    {A : Type}
    (T : q752375_topological_space A)
    (C : q752375_set A) : Prop :=
  q752375_is_open T (fun x : A => ~ C x).

Definition q752375_closed_iic_topology
    {A : Type}
    (O : q752375_linear_order A)
    (T : q752375_topological_space A) : Prop :=
  forall a : A,
    q752375_is_closed T
      (fun x : A => q752375_le O x a).

Definition q752375_neighborhood
    {A : Type}
    (T : q752375_topological_space A)
    (x : A)
    (U : q752375_set A) : Prop :=
  exists V : q752375_set A,
    q752375_is_open T V /\
    V x /\
    q752375_subset V U.

Definition q752375_is_compact
    {A : Type}
    (T : q752375_topological_space A)
    (K : q752375_set A) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q752375_set (q752375_set A),
    (forall U : q752375_set A,
      cover U -> q752375_is_open T U) ->
    (forall x : A,
      K x ->
      exists U : q752375_set A, cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q752375_set A),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : A,
        K x ->
        exists U : q752375_set A,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q752375_continuous_within_at
    {A B : Type}
    (TA : q752375_topological_space A)
    (TB : q752375_topological_space B)
    (f : A -> B)
    (s : q752375_set A)
    (x : A) : Prop :=
  forall V : q752375_set B,
    q752375_neighborhood TB (f x) V ->
    exists U : q752375_set A,
      q752375_neighborhood TA x U /\
      forall y : A, s y -> U y -> V (f y).

Definition q752375_continuous_on
    {A B : Type}
    (TA : q752375_topological_space A)
    (TB : q752375_topological_space B)
    (f : A -> B)
    (s : q752375_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    s x ->
    q752375_continuous_within_at TA TB f s x.

Theorem extreme_value_theorem :
  forall (Alpha Beta : Type)
         (OA : q752375_linear_order Alpha)
         (TA : q752375_topological_space Alpha)
         (TB : q752375_topological_space Beta)
         (ClosedIicA : q752375_closed_iic_topology OA TA)
         (s : q752375_set Beta)
         (f : Beta -> Alpha),
    q752375_is_compact TB s ->
    (exists x : Beta, s x) ->
    q752375_continuous_on TB TA f s ->
    exists x : Beta,
      s x /\
      forall y : Beta,
        s y -> q752375_le OA (f x) (f y).
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q752375,
  "Extreme value theorem": a continuous function from a nonempty compact set
  into a linearly ordered topological space whose lower intervals are closed
  attains its minimum on that set. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
  imports "HOL.Topological_Spaces"
begin

theorem q752375_extreme_value_theorem:
  fixes s :: "'b::topological_space set"
    and f :: "'b \<Rightarrow> 'a::{linorder,topological_space}"
  assumes closed_lower_intervals: "\<And>a. closed {..a}"
    and compact_s: "compact s"
    and nonempty_s: "s \<noteq> {}"
    and continuous_f: "continuous_on s f"
  shows "\<exists>x \<in> s. \<forall>y \<in> s. f x \<le> f y"
  sorry

end

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q752375,
  "Extreme value theorem": a continuous function on a nonempty compact set,
  valued in a linear order whose lower intervals are closed, attains its
  minimum on that set. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q752375_EXTREME_VALUE_THEOREM =
  `let is_topology =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (UNIV:A->bool) /\
       (!C:(A->bool)->bool.
          (!U:A->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
       (!U V:A->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V
          ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let is_topology_b =
     \(open_sets:(B->bool)->bool).
       open_sets {} /\
       open_sets (UNIV:B->bool) /\
       (!C:(B->bool)->bool.
          (!U:B->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U)
          ==> open_sets (UNIONS C)) /\
       (!U V:B->bool.
          open_sets U /\ open_sets V
          ==> open_sets (U INTER V)) in
   let is_closed =
     \(open_sets:(A->bool)->bool) (U:A->bool).
       open_sets ((UNIV:A->bool) DIFF U) in
   let is_compact =
     \(open_sets:(B->bool)->bool) (K:B->bool).
       !C:(B->bool)->bool.
         (!U:B->bool. U IN C ==> open_sets U) /\
         K SUBSET UNIONS C
         ==> ?D:(B->bool)->bool.
               D SUBSET C /\
               FINITE D /\
               K SUBSET UNIONS D in
   let is_linear_order =
     \(le:A->A->bool).
       (!x:A. le x x) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y /\ le y x ==> x = y) /\
       (!x y z:A. le x y /\ le y z ==> le x z) /\
       (!x y:A. le x y \/ le y x) in
   let is_continuous_on =
     \(open_a:(A->bool)->bool) (open_b:(B->bool)->bool)
      (f:B->A) (s:B->bool).
       !V:A->bool.
         open_a V
         ==> ?U:B->bool.
               open_b U /\
               {x:B | x IN s /\ f x IN V} = s INTER U in
   !open_a:(A->bool)->bool.
   !open_b:(B->bool)->bool.
   !le:A->A->bool.
   !s:B->bool.
   !f:B->A.
     is_topology open_a /\
     is_topology_b open_b /\
     is_linear_order le /\
     (!a:A. is_closed open_a {x:A | le x a}) /\
     is_compact open_b s /\
     (?x:B. x IN s) /\
     is_continuous_on open_a open_b f s
     ==> ?x:B.
           x IN s /\
           !y:B. y IN s ==> le (f x) (f y)`;;

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q752375,
;; "Extreme value theorem": a continuous function from a nonempty compact set
;; into a linearly ordered space with closed lower rays attains its minimum.
;; This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame APPLY$ functions represent arbitrary carriers, extensional subsets,
;; families of subsets, topologies, the order, and the source function.
;; DEFUN-SK keeps every point, cover, neighborhood, and minimum witness in the
;; same quantifier scope as the corresponding Lean statement.

(defun q752375-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q752375-relation-p (relation left right)
  (if (apply$ relation (list left right)) t nil))

(defun q752375-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

;; Extensional subsets and arbitrary families of subsets.

(defun-sk q752375-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p set x)
     (q752375-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q752375-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q752375-set-contained-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q752375-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q752375-member-p left x)
      (q752375-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q752375-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q752375-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q752375-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q752375-member-p family left)
      (q752375-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q752375-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p family set)
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q752375-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q752375-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q752375-family-members-valid-p carrier family)))

(defun-sk q752375-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (q752375-member-p set x))))

;; Topological spaces, including arbitrary unions.

(defun q752375-open-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q752375-member-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q752375-empty-representation-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (not (q752375-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q752375-empty-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q752375-empty-representation-p carrier set)
     (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q752375-full-representation-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (q752375-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q752375-full-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q752375-full-representation-p carrier set)
     (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q752375-intersection-representation-p
    (carrier left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q752375-member-p intersection x)
      (and
       (q752375-member-p left x)
       (q752375-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q752375-open-intersection-exists-p
    (carrier topology left right)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier intersection)
     (q752375-intersection-representation-p
      carrier left right intersection)
     (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology intersection))))

(defun-sk q752375-topology-intersection-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology left)
      (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology right))
     (q752375-open-intersection-exists-p
      carrier topology left right))))

(defun-sk q752375-union-member-p (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q752375-member-p family set)
     (q752375-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q752375-union-representation-p
    (carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q752375-member-p union x)
      (q752375-union-member-p carrier family x)))))

(defun-sk q752375-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p family set)
     (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q752375-open-union-exists-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier union)
     (q752375-union-representation-p carrier family union)
     (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology union))))

(defun-sk q752375-topology-union-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q752375-family-members-open-p

      carrier topology family))))

(defun q752375-topological-space-p (carrier topology)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (q752375-family-of-sets-p carrier topology)
   (q752375-empty-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q752375-full-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q752375-topology-intersection-law-p carrier topology)
   (q752375-topology-union-law-p carrier topology)))

;; Closed subsets and the ClosedIicTopology condition.

(defun-sk q752375-complement-representation-p
    (carrier set complement)

    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)

      (q752375-member-p complement x)

(defun-sk q752375-open-complement-exists-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier complement)
     (q752375-complement-representation-p
      carrier set complement)
     (q752375-open-set-p carrier topology complement))))

(defun q752375-closed-set-p (carrier topology set)

   (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q752375-open-complement-exists-p
    carrier topology set)))

;; Linear orders.

(defun-sk q752375-linear-order-laws-p (carrier le)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q752375-member-p carrier x)
      (q752375-relation-p le x x))
     (implies
      (and
       (q752375-member-p carrier x)
       (q752375-member-p carrier y)
       (q752375-relation-p le x y)
       (q752375-relation-p le y x))

      (and
       (q752375-member-p carrier x)
       (q752375-member-p carrier y)
       (q752375-member-p carrier z)
       (q752375-relation-p le x y)
       (q752375-relation-p le y z))
      (q752375-relation-p le x z))
     (implies
      (and
       (q752375-member-p carrier x)
       (q752375-member-p carrier y))
      (or
       (q752375-relation-p le x y)
       (q752375-relation-p le y x))))))

(defun q752375-linear-order-p (carrier le)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp le)
   (q752375-linear-order-laws-p carrier le)))

(defun-sk q752375-iic-representation-p
    (carrier le endpoint iic)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q752375-member-p iic x)
      (q752375-relation-p le x endpoint)))))

(defun-sk q752375-closed-iic-exists-p
    (carrier le topology endpoint)
  (exists (iic)
    (and
     (q752375-valid-set-p carrier iic)
     (q752375-iic-representation-p
      carrier le endpoint iic)

(defun-sk q752375-closed-iic-topology-p
    (carrier le topology)
  (forall (endpoint)
