      carrier le topology endpoint))))

;; Compactness via unrestricted open covers and internal finite subcovers.

(defun-sk q752375-cover-p (carrier set family)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-member-p carrier x)
      (q752375-member-p set x))
     (q752375-union-member-p carrier family x))))

(defun q752375-finite-subcover-elements-p
    (sets carrier family)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q752375-valid-set-p carrier (car sets))
       (q752375-member-p family (car sets))
       (q752375-finite-subcover-elements-p
        (cdr sets) carrier family))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun q752375-finite-subcover-point-p (sets x)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q752375-member-p (car sets) x)
       (q752375-finite-subcover-point-p (cdr sets) x))
    nil))

(defun-sk q752375-finite-subcover-covers-p
    (carrier set sets)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-member-p carrier x)
      (q752375-member-p set x))
     (q752375-finite-subcover-point-p sets x))))

(defun q752375-finite-subcover-p
    (sets carrier set family)
  (and
   (true-listp sets)
   (q752375-finite-subcover-elements-p
    sets carrier family)
   (q752375-finite-subcover-covers-p
    carrier set sets)))

(defun-sk q752375-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (carrier set family)
  (exists (sets)
    (q752375-finite-subcover-p
     sets carrier set family)))

(defun-sk q752375-compact-cover-law-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q752375-family-members-open-p
       carrier topology family)
      (q752375-cover-p carrier set family))
     (q752375-finite-subcover-exists-p
      carrier set family))))

(defun q752375-compact-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q752375-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q752375-compact-cover-law-p
    carrier topology set)))

;; Typed functions and continuity on a subset, expressed by the exact local
;; open-neighborhood characterization of ContinuousOn.

(defun-sk q752375-function-values-p
    (domain codomain function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q752375-member-p domain x)
     (q752375-member-p
      codomain (q752375-value function x)))))

(defun q752375-function-p (domain codomain function)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp function)
   (q752375-function-values-p
    domain codomain function)))

(defun-sk q752375-local-image-contained-p
    (domain set source-open function target-open)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-member-p domain y)
      (q752375-member-p set y)
      (q752375-member-p source-open y))
     (q752375-member-p
      target-open (q752375-value function y)))))

(defun q752375-continuity-neighborhood-witness-p
    (domain domain-topology set function
     target-open x source-open)
  (and
   (q752375-open-set-p
    domain domain-topology source-open)
   (q752375-member-p source-open x)
   (q752375-local-image-contained-p
    domain set source-open function target-open)))

(defun-sk q752375-continuity-neighborhood-exists-p
    (domain domain-topology set function target-open x)
  (exists (source-open)
    (q752375-continuity-neighborhood-witness-p
     domain domain-topology set function
     target-open x source-open)))

(defun-sk q752375-continuous-within-at-p
    (domain domain-topology codomain codomain-topology
     set function x)
  (forall (target-open)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-open-set-p
       codomain codomain-topology target-open)
      (q752375-member-p
       target-open (q752375-value function x)))
     (q752375-continuity-neighborhood-exists-p
      domain domain-topology set function target-open x))))

(defun-sk q752375-continuous-on-p
    (domain domain-topology codomain codomain-topology
     set function)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-member-p domain x)
      (q752375-member-p set x))
     (q752375-continuous-within-at-p
      domain domain-topology codomain codomain-topology
      set function x))))

;; The minimum witness remains existentially quantified inside the conclusion.

(defun-sk q752375-minimum-on-p
    (domain codomain le set function x)
  (forall (y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-member-p domain y)
      (q752375-member-p set y))
     (q752375-relation-p
      le
      (q752375-value function x)
      (q752375-value function y)))))

(defun-sk q752375-minimum-witness-exists-p
    (domain codomain le set function)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q752375-member-p domain x)
     (q752375-member-p set x)
     (q752375-member-p
      codomain (q752375-value function x))
     (q752375-minimum-on-p
      domain codomain le set function x))))

;; IsCompact.exists_isMinOn
(defun-sk
    thousand-theorems-q752375-extreme-value-theorem-statement
    ()
  (forall
    (alpha alpha-le alpha-topology
     beta beta-topology set function)
    (implies
     (and
      (q752375-linear-order-p alpha alpha-le)
      (q752375-topological-space-p alpha alpha-topology)
      (q752375-closed-iic-topology-p
       alpha alpha-le alpha-topology)
      (q752375-topological-space-p beta beta-topology)
      (q752375-valid-set-p beta set)
      (q752375-compact-set-p beta beta-topology set)
      (q752375-set-nonempty-p beta set)
      (q752375-function-p beta alpha function)
      (q752375-continuous-on-p
       beta beta-topology alpha alpha-topology
       set function))
     (q752375-minimum-witness-exists-p
      beta alpha alpha-le set function))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q752375,
-- "Extreme value theorem": a continuous function into a linearly ordered
-- topological space with closed lower rays attains its minimum on every
-- nonempty compact subset of its domain. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q752375_extreme_value_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infixr 3 _×_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition → Bottom {a}

record _×_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Either
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A → Either A B
  right : B → Either A B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A → Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A →
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A}
    {xs : List A} →
    Member x xs →
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

Subset :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X → Set a

Family :
  {a : Level} →
  Set a →
  Set (lsuc a)
Family {a} X =
  Subset X → Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X
Empty {a} _ =
  Bottom {a}

Union :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Union U V x =
  Either (U x) (V x)

Complement :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  V x

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      Subset X →
      Subset X

    close-empty :
      SubsetOf (close Empty) Empty

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-monotone :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf U V →
      SubsetOf (close U) (close V)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf
        (close (Union U V))
        (Union (close U) (close V))

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf
        (Union (close U) (close V))
        (close (Union U V))

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset X) →
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

Covers :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
Covers {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) →
  U x →
  Σ (Subset X)
    (λ V →
      cover V × V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Family X →
  Set (lsuc a)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} U cover =
  Σ (List (Subset X))
    (λ selected →
      ((V : Subset X) →
        Member V selected →
        cover V)
      ×
      ((x : X) →
        U x →
        Σ (Subset X)
          (λ V →
            Member V selected × V x)))

Compact :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  TopologicalSpace X →
  Subset X →
  Set (lsuc a)
Compact {X = X} topology U =
  (cover : Family X) →
  ((V : Subset X) →
    cover V →
    IsOpen topology V) →
  Covers U cover →
  FiniteSubcover U cover

Nonempty :
  {a : Level}
  {X : Set a} →
  Subset X →
  Set a
Nonempty {X = X} U =
  Exists X U

record LinearOrder
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    lessOrEqual :
      A →
      A →
      Set a

    order-reflexive :
      (x : A) →
      lessOrEqual x x

    order-transitive :
      (x y z : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y z →
      lessOrEqual x z

    order-antisymmetric :
      (x y : A) →
      lessOrEqual x y →
      lessOrEqual y x →
      x ≡ y

    order-total :
      (x y : A) →
      Either
        (lessOrEqual x y)
        (lessOrEqual y x)

open LinearOrder

LowerRay :
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a} →
  LinearOrder A →
  A →
  Subset A
LowerRay order upper x =
  lessOrEqual order x upper

record ClosedLowerRays
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (order : LinearOrder A)
  (topology : TopologicalSpace A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    lower-ray-closed :
      (upper : A) →
      IsClosed topology (LowerRay order upper)

ContinuousOn :
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b} →
  TopologicalSpace A →
  TopologicalSpace B →
  (A → B) →
  Subset A →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
ContinuousOn {A = A} {B = B} source target f domain =
  (x : A) →
  domain x →
  (V : Subset B) →
  IsOpen target V →
  V (f x) →
  Exists (Subset A)
    (λ U →
      IsOpen source U
      ×
      (U x
      ×
      ((y : A) →
        domain y →
        U y →
        V (f y))))

IsMinOn :
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b} →
  LinearOrder B →
  (A → B) →
  Subset A →
  A →
  Set (a ⊔ b)
IsMinOn {A = A} order f domain x =
  (y : A) →
  domain y →
  lessOrEqual order (f x) (f y)

extreme-value-theorem :
  {a b : Level} →
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
extreme-value-theorem {a} {b} =
  (A : Set a) →
  (B : Set b) →
  (order : LinearOrder A) →
  (target : TopologicalSpace A) →
  ClosedLowerRays order target →
  (source : TopologicalSpace B) →
  (domain : Subset B) →
  Compact source domain →
  Nonempty domain →
  (f : B → A) →
  ContinuousOn source target f domain →
  Exists B
    (λ x →
      domain x
      ×
      IsMinOn order f domain x)

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q752375, "Extreme value theorem": a continuous map from a nonempty compact
  subset of a topological space into a linearly ordered topological space with
  closed lower rays attains its minimum on that subset. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory topologyTheory;

val q752375_linear_order_def = new_definition (
  "q752375_linear_order_def",
  ``q752375_linear_order (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      (!x. leq x x) /\
      (!x y. leq x y /\ leq y x ==> x = y) /\
      (!x y z. leq x y /\ leq y z ==> leq x z) /\
      (!x y. leq x y \/ leq y x)``);

val q752375_closed_iic_topology_def = new_definition (
  "q752375_closed_iic_topology_def",
  ``q752375_closed_iic_topology
      (top : 'a topology) (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      !a. closed_in top {x | leq x a}``);

val IsCompact_exists_isMinOn =
  ``!(topA : 'a topology) (topB : 'b topology)
      (leq : 'a -> 'a -> bool) (s : 'b set) (f : 'b -> 'a).
      q752375_linear_order leq /\
      q752375_closed_iic_topology topA leq /\
      topspace topB = UNIV /\
      compact_in topB s /\
      (?x. x IN s) /\
      continuous_map (subtopology topB s,topA) f
      ==>
      ?x.
        x IN s /\
        !y. y IN s ==> leq (f x) (f y)``;

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q752375
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q752375), "Extreme value theorem": a continuous
  function from a nonempty compact subset of an arbitrary topological space
  into a linearly ordered topological space whose lower order intervals are
  closed attains its minimum on that subset. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  Q752375LinearOrder states that R is a reflexive, antisymmetric, transitive,
  total relation on Y. Q752375ClosedIicTopology states that K is a topology on
  Y and every lower interval {b in Y | b R a} is K-closed, exactly the
  ClosedIicTopology assumption of the Lean source.

  In the final assertion, (J |`t S) e. Comp expresses compactness of S with
  its subspace topology, and membership of F restricted to S in the SetMM Cn
  class expresses ContinuousOn F S. The conclusion retains the source's
  internal witness x in S and says that F(x) is below F(y) for every y in S.

  The final declaration is the single unproved corpus $a statement. All
  preceding $a declarations are syntax or faithful definitions, and this
  database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q752375LinearOrder Q752375ClosedIicTopology $.

q752375-linear-order-syntax
  $a wff ( Q752375LinearOrder R Y ) $.
q752375-closed-iic-topology-syntax
  $a wff ( Q752375ClosedIicTopology R Y K ) $.

${
  $d R Y a b c $.

  q752375-linear-order-definition $a |- (
    ( Q752375LinearOrder R Y )
    <->
    (
      R C_ ( Y X. Y )
      /\
      A. a e. Y A. b e. Y A. c e. Y
        (
          a R a
          /\
          (
            ( ( a R b /\ b R a ) -> a = b )
            /\
            (
              ( ( a R b /\ b R c ) -> a R c )
              /\
              ( a R b \/ b R a )
            )
          )
        )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d K R Y a b $.

  q752375-closed-iic-topology-definition $a |- (
    ( Q752375ClosedIicTopology R Y K )
    <->
    (
      K e. ( TopOn ` Y )
      /\
      A. a e. Y
        { b e. Y | b R a } e. ( Clsd ` K )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d F J K R S X Y a b c x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q752375-extreme-value-theorem $a |-
    A. X A. Y A. J A. K A. R A. S A. F
      (
        (
          (
            J e. ( TopOn ` X )
            /\
            (
              ( Q752375LinearOrder R Y )
              /\
              ( Q752375ClosedIicTopology R Y K )
            )
          )
          /\
          (
            S C_ X
            /\
            F : X --> Y
          )
        )
        ->
        (
          (
            (
              ( J |`t S ) e. Comp
              /\
              S =/= (/)
            )
            /\
            (
              F |` S
            )
            e.
            (
              ( J |`t S )
              Cn
              K
            )
          )
          ->
          E. x e. S
            A. y e. S
              ( F ` x ) R ( F ` y )
        )
      )
  $.
$}

  registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELAT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_1, FUNCT_2,
    STRUCT_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, COMPTS_1, BORSUK_1, TMAP_1;
  requirements SUBSET, BOOLE;
  definitions TARSKI, PRE_TOPC, BORSUK_1;
  equalities STRUCT_0, RELAT_1;
  expansions TARSKI, PRE_TOPC, BORSUK_1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for X,Y being non empty TopSpace,
      S being non empty compact Subset of X,
      le being Relation of Y,Y,
      f being Function of X|S,Y st
    (for P being Subset of Y st P is closed holds
      f"P is closed Subset of X|S) &
    (for x being Point of Y holds [x,x] in le) &
    (for x,y being Point of Y st
      [x,y] in le & [y,x] in le holds x = y) &
    (for x,y,z being Point of Y st
      [x,y] in le & [y,z] in le holds [x,z] in le) &
    (for x,y being Point of Y holds
      [x,y] in le or [y,x] in le) &
    (for a being Point of Y holds
      {z where z is Point of Y : [z,a] in le}
        is closed Subset of Y)
  holds
    ex x being Point of X|S st
      for y being Point of X|S holds [f.x,f.y] in le
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q752375_extreme_value_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q752375,
% "Extreme value theorem": a continuous function from a nonempty compact set
% into a linearly ordered topological space with closed lower rays attains its
% minimum on that set. This file contains no proof.

Q752375_extreme_value_theorem[
  alpha: TYPE,
  beta: TYPE,
  le_alpha: [alpha, alpha -> bool],
  open_alpha: [[alpha -> bool] -> bool],
  open_beta: [[beta -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  alpha_set: TYPE = [alpha -> bool]
  beta_set: TYPE = [beta -> bool]
  alpha_set_family: TYPE = [alpha_set -> bool]
  beta_set_family: TYPE = [beta_set -> bool]
  beta_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> beta_set]
  beta_alpha_function: TYPE = [beta -> alpha]

  empty_alpha_set: alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): FALSE

  whole_alpha_set: alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): TRUE

  alpha_intersection(A, B: alpha_set): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha): A(x) AND B(x)

  alpha_union(F: alpha_set_family): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha):
      EXISTS (U: alpha_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  empty_beta_set: beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta): FALSE

  whole_beta_set: beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta): TRUE

  beta_intersection(A, B: beta_set): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta): A(x) AND B(x)

  beta_union(F: beta_set_family): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (x: beta):
      EXISTS (U: beta_set):
        F(U) AND U(x)

  alpha_topology_laws: bool =
    open_alpha(empty_alpha_set)
      AND open_alpha(whole_alpha_set)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: alpha_set):
        open_alpha(A) AND open_alpha(B)
          IMPLIES open_alpha(alpha_intersection(A, B)))
      AND (FORALL (F: alpha_set_family):
        (FORALL (U: alpha_set):
          F(U) IMPLIES open_alpha(U))
          IMPLIES open_alpha(alpha_union(F)))

  beta_topology_laws: bool =
    open_beta(empty_beta_set)
      AND open_beta(whole_beta_set)
      AND (FORALL (A, B: beta_set):
        open_beta(A) AND open_beta(B)
          IMPLIES open_beta(beta_intersection(A, B)))
      AND (FORALL (F: beta_set_family):
        (FORALL (U: beta_set):
          F(U) IMPLIES open_beta(U))
          IMPLIES open_beta(beta_union(F)))

  alpha_linear_order_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: alpha):
      le_alpha(x, x))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: alpha):
        le_alpha(x, y) AND le_alpha(y, z)
          IMPLIES le_alpha(x, z))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: alpha):
        le_alpha(x, y) AND le_alpha(y, x)
          IMPLIES x = y)
      AND (FORALL (x, y: alpha):
        le_alpha(x, y) OR le_alpha(y, x))

  closed_lower_rays: bool =
    FORALL (a: alpha):
      open_alpha(
        LAMBDA (x: alpha):
          NOT le_alpha(x, a))

  open_cover(C: beta_set_family, S: beta_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: beta_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES open_beta(U))
      AND (FORALL (x: beta):
        S(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: beta_set):
            C(U) AND U(x))

  finite_subcover(
      C: beta_set_family,
      S: beta_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: beta_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES C(chosen(index)))
        AND (FORALL (x: beta):
          S(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (index: nat):
              index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_set(S: beta_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: beta_set_family):
      open_cover(C, S) IMPLIES finite_subcover(C, S)

  nonempty_set(S: beta_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: beta):
      S(x)

  continuous_on(
      f: beta_alpha_function,
      S: beta_set): bool =
    FORALL (V: alpha_set):
      open_alpha(V) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (U: beta_set):
          open_beta(U)
            AND FORALL (x: beta):
              S(x) IMPLIES (U(x) IFF V(f(x)))

  is_min_on(
      f: beta_alpha_function,
      S: beta_set,
      x: beta): bool =
    FORALL (y: beta):
      S(y) IMPLIES le_alpha(f(x), f(y))

  structure_laws: bool =
    alpha_linear_order_laws
      AND alpha_topology_laws
      AND beta_topology_laws
      AND closed_lower_rays

  exists_isMinOn_Q752375: bool =
    structure_laws IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (S: beta_set),
          (f: beta_alpha_function):
        (compact_set(S)
          AND nonempty_set(S)
          AND continuous_on(f, S))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (x: beta):
            S(x) AND is_min_on(f, S, x)
END Q752375_extreme_value_theorem

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem

-- "Sion's minimax theorem". The statement is copied exactly from

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.Sion

@[expose] public section

namespace ThousandTheorems.Q7525341

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7525341
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q7525341), "Sion's minimax theorem": for
  quasiconvex lower-semicontinuous slices and quasiconcave
  upper-semicontinuous slices on convex subsets of real topological vector
  spaces and values in a densely ordered linear order, with the first set
  nonempty and compact, the four explicit IsLUB/IsGLB hypotheses of the
  canonical statement imply the minimax equality. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Reals List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Local Open Scope R_scope.

Definition q7525341_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q7525341_subset {A : Type}
    (S T : q7525341_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, S x -> T x.

Record q7525341_linear_order (B : Type) : Type := {
  q7525341_le : B -> B -> Prop;
  q7525341_le_refl :
    forall x : B, q7525341_le x x;
  q7525341_le_antisym :
    forall x y : B,
      q7525341_le x y ->
      q7525341_le y x ->
      x = y;
  q7525341_le_trans :
    forall x y z : B,
      q7525341_le x y ->
      q7525341_le y z ->
      q7525341_le x z;
  q7525341_le_total :
    forall x y : B,
      q7525341_le x y \/ q7525341_le y x
}.

Arguments q7525341_le {B} _ _ _.

Definition q7525341_lt {B : Type}
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (x y : B) : Prop :=
  q7525341_le O x y /\ x <> y.

Definition q7525341_densely_ordered
    {B : Type}
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B) : Prop :=
  forall x y : B,
    q7525341_lt O x y ->
    exists z : B,
      q7525341_lt O x z /\
      q7525341_lt O z y.

Record q7525341_topological_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q7525341_is_open : q7525341_set A -> Prop;
  q7525341_open_extensional :
    forall U V : q7525341_set A,
      (forall x : A, U x <-> V x) ->
      (q7525341_is_open U <-> q7525341_is_open V);
  q7525341_open_univ :
    q7525341_is_open (fun _ : A => True);
  q7525341_open_intersection :
    forall U V : q7525341_set A,
      q7525341_is_open U ->
      q7525341_is_open V ->
      q7525341_is_open (fun x : A => U x /\ V x);
  q7525341_open_union :
    forall family : q7525341_set (q7525341_set A),
      (forall U : q7525341_set A,
        family U -> q7525341_is_open U) ->
      q7525341_is_open
        (fun x : A =>
          exists U : q7525341_set A, family U /\ U x)
}.

Arguments q7525341_is_open {A} _ _.

Record q7525341_real_module (E : Type) : Type := {
  q7525341_zero : E;
  q7525341_add : E -> E -> E;
  q7525341_neg : E -> E;
  q7525341_smul : R -> E -> E;
  q7525341_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : E,
      q7525341_add x (q7525341_add y z) =
      q7525341_add (q7525341_add x y) z;
  q7525341_add_comm :
    forall x y : E,
      q7525341_add x y = q7525341_add y x;
  q7525341_add_zero :
    forall x : E,
      q7525341_add x q7525341_zero = x;
  q7525341_add_neg :
    forall x : E,
      q7525341_add x (q7525341_neg x) = q7525341_zero;
  q7525341_one_smul :
    forall x : E,
      q7525341_smul 1 x = x;
  q7525341_mul_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q7525341_smul (a * b) x =
      q7525341_smul a (q7525341_smul b x);
  q7525341_add_smul :
    forall (a b : R) (x : E),
      q7525341_smul (a + b) x =
      q7525341_add
        (q7525341_smul a x)
        (q7525341_smul b x);
  q7525341_smul_add :
    forall (a : R) (x y : E),
      q7525341_smul a (q7525341_add x y) =
      q7525341_add
        (q7525341_smul a x)
        (q7525341_smul a y)
}.

Arguments q7525341_zero {E} _.
Arguments q7525341_add {E} _ _ _.
Arguments q7525341_neg {E} _ _.
Arguments q7525341_smul {E} _ _ _.

Definition q7525341_real_open
    (U : q7525341_set R) : Prop :=
  forall x : R,
    U x ->
    exists epsilon : R,
      0 < epsilon /\
      forall y : R,
        Rabs (y - x) < epsilon ->
        U y.

Definition q7525341_product_open
    {A B : Type}
    (TA : q7525341_topological_space A)
    (TB : q7525341_topological_space B)
    (U : q7525341_set (A * B)) : Prop :=
  forall (a : A) (b : B),
    U (a, b) ->
    exists V : q7525341_set A,
    exists W : q7525341_set B,
      q7525341_is_open TA V /\
      q7525341_is_open TB W /\
      V a /\
      W b /\
      forall (a' : A) (b' : B),
        V a' ->
        W b' ->
        U (a', b').

Definition q7525341_real_product_open
    {E : Type}
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E)
    (U : q7525341_set (R * E)) : Prop :=
  forall (a : R) (x : E),
    U (a, x) ->
    exists A : q7525341_set R,
    exists V : q7525341_set E,
      q7525341_real_open A /\
      q7525341_is_open T V /\
      A a /\
      V x /\
      forall (b : R) (y : E),
        A b ->
        V y ->
        U (b, y).

Definition q7525341_continuous_add
    {E : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E) : Prop :=
  forall U : q7525341_set E,
    q7525341_is_open T U ->
    q7525341_product_open T T
      (fun p : E * E =>
        U (q7525341_add V (fst p) (snd p))).

Definition q7525341_continuous_neg
    {E : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E) : Prop :=
  forall U : q7525341_set E,
    q7525341_is_open T U ->
    q7525341_is_open T
      (fun x : E => U (q7525341_neg V x)).

Definition q7525341_continuous_smul
    {E : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E) : Prop :=
  forall U : q7525341_set E,
    q7525341_is_open T U ->
    q7525341_real_product_open T
      (fun p : R * E =>
        U (q7525341_smul V (fst p) (snd p))).

Definition q7525341_is_real_topological_vector_space
    {E : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E) : Prop :=
  q7525341_continuous_add V T /\
  q7525341_continuous_neg V T /\
  q7525341_continuous_smul V T.

Definition q7525341_convex
    {E : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (S : q7525341_set E) : Prop :=
  forall (x y : E) (a b : R),
    S x ->
    S y ->
    0 <= a ->
    0 <= b ->
    a + b = 1 ->
    S
      (q7525341_add V
        (q7525341_smul V a x)
        (q7525341_smul V b y)).

Definition q7525341_is_compact
    {E : Type}
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E)
    (K : q7525341_set E) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q7525341_set (q7525341_set E),
    (forall U : q7525341_set E,
      cover U -> q7525341_is_open T U) ->
    (forall x : E,
      K x ->
      exists U : q7525341_set E,
        cover U /\ U x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q7525341_set E),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : E,
        K x ->
        exists U : q7525341_set E,
          In U finite_cover /\ U x.

Definition q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on
    {E B : Type}
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E)
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (g : E -> B)
    (S : q7525341_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    S x ->
    forall b : B,
      q7525341_lt O b (g x) ->
      exists U : q7525341_set E,
        q7525341_is_open T U /\
        U x /\
        forall z : E,
          U z ->
          S z ->
          q7525341_lt O b (g z).

Definition q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on
    {E B : Type}
    (T : q7525341_topological_space E)
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (g : E -> B)
    (S : q7525341_set E) : Prop :=
  forall x : E,
    S x ->
    forall b : B,
      q7525341_lt O (g x) b ->
      exists U : q7525341_set E,
        q7525341_is_open T U /\
        U x /\
        forall z : E,
          U z ->
          S z ->
          q7525341_lt O (g z) b.

Definition q7525341_quasiconvex_on
    {E B : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (S : q7525341_set E)
    (g : E -> B) : Prop :=
  forall b : B,
    q7525341_convex V
      (fun x : E => S x /\ q7525341_le O (g x) b).

Definition q7525341_quasiconcave_on
    {E B : Type}
    (V : q7525341_real_module E)
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (S : q7525341_set E)
    (g : E -> B) : Prop :=
  forall b : B,
    q7525341_convex V
      (fun x : E => S x /\ q7525341_le O b (g x)).

Definition q7525341_is_upper_bound
    {B : Type}
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (S : q7525341_set B)
    (bound : B) : Prop :=
  forall z : B,
    S z ->
    q7525341_le O z bound.

Definition q7525341_is_lower_bound
    {B : Type}
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (S : q7525341_set B)
    (bound : B) : Prop :=
  forall z : B,
    S z ->
    q7525341_le O bound z.

Definition q7525341_is_lub
    {B : Type}
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (S : q7525341_set B)
    (least_upper_bound : B) : Prop :=
  q7525341_is_upper_bound O S least_upper_bound /\
  forall bound : B,
    q7525341_is_upper_bound O S bound ->
    q7525341_le O least_upper_bound bound.

Definition q7525341_is_glb
    {B : Type}
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (S : q7525341_set B)
    (greatest_lower_bound : B) : Prop :=
  q7525341_is_lower_bound O S greatest_lower_bound /\
  forall bound : B,
    q7525341_is_lower_bound O S bound ->
    q7525341_le O bound greatest_lower_bound.

(* The final value-and-bound binders below are the four explicit IsLUB/IsGLB
   arguments of the canonical Sion.minimax statement. *)
Theorem sion_minimax
    (E F B : Type)
    (VE : q7525341_real_module E)
    (VF : q7525341_real_module F)
    (TE : q7525341_topological_space E)
    (TF : q7525341_topological_space F)
    (O : q7525341_linear_order B)
    (X : q7525341_set E)
    (Y : q7525341_set F)
    (f : E -> F -> B)
    (dense_B : q7525341_densely_ordered O)
    (topological_vector_E :
      q7525341_is_real_topological_vector_space VE TE)
    (topological_vector_F :
      q7525341_is_real_topological_vector_space VF TF)
    (nonempty_X : exists x : E, X x)
    (convex_X : q7525341_convex VE X)
    (compact_X : q7525341_is_compact TE X)
    (lower_semicontinuous_slices :
      forall y : F,
      Y y ->
      q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on
        TE O (fun x : E => f x y) X)
    (quasiconvex_slices :
      forall y : F,
      Y y ->
      q7525341_quasiconvex_on
        VE O X (fun x : E => f x y))
    (convex_Y : q7525341_convex VF Y)
    (upper_semicontinuous_slices :
      forall x : E,
      X x ->
      q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on
        TF O (fun y : F => f x y) Y)
    (quasiconcave_slices :
      forall x : E,
      X x ->
      q7525341_quasiconcave_on
        VF O Y (fun y : F => f x y))
    (sup_y : E -> B)
    (hsup_y :
      forall x : E,
      X x ->
      q7525341_is_lub O
        (fun z : B =>
          exists y : F, Y y /\ z = f x y)
        (sup_y x))
    (inf_sup : B)
    (hinf_sup :
      q7525341_is_glb O
        (fun z : B =>
          exists x : E, X x /\ z = sup_y x)
        inf_sup)
    (inf_x : F -> B)
    (hinf_x :
      forall y : F,
      Y y ->
      q7525341_is_glb O
        (fun z : B =>
          exists x : E, X x /\ z = f x y)
        (inf_x y))
    (sup_inf : B)
    (hsup_inf :
      q7525341_is_lub O
        (fun z : B =>
          exists y : F, Y y /\ z = inf_x y)
        sup_inf) :
  inf_sup = sup_inf.
Admitted.

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7525341
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7525341), "Sion's minimax theorem": for a
  compact nonempty convex set X and a convex set Y in real topological vector
  spaces, lower-semicontinuous quasiconvex sections in X and
  upper-semicontinuous quasiconcave sections in Y identify the specified
  infimum-of-suprema and supremum-of-infima in a linearly ordered codomain.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
  imports Complex_Main
begin

definition q7525341_convex :: "'a::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_convex S \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> S. \<forall>y \<in> S. \<forall>u \<ge> 0. \<forall>v \<ge> 0.
        u + v = 1 \<longrightarrow> u *\<^sub>R x + v *\<^sub>R y \<in> S)"

definition q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'b::preorder) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on g S \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> S. \<forall>b < g x.
        eventually (\<lambda>z. b < g z) (inf (nhds x) (principal S)))"

definition q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on ::
    "('a::topological_space \<Rightarrow> 'b::preorder) \<Rightarrow> 'a set \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on g S \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> S. \<forall>b. g x < b \<longrightarrow>
        eventually (\<lambda>z. g z < b) (inf (nhds x) (principal S)))"

definition q7525341_quasiconvex_on ::
    "'a::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::preorder) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_quasiconvex_on S g \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>b. q7525341_convex {x \<in> S. g x \<le> b})"

definition q7525341_quasiconcave_on ::
    "'a::real_vector set \<Rightarrow> ('a \<Rightarrow> 'b::preorder) \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_quasiconcave_on S g \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>b. q7525341_convex {x \<in> S. b \<le> g x})"

definition q7525341_is_lub :: "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_is_lub S a \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> S. x \<le> a) \<and>
      (\<forall>u. (\<forall>x \<in> S. x \<le> u) \<longrightarrow> a \<le> u)"

definition q7525341_is_glb :: "'a::order set \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where
    "q7525341_is_glb S a \<longleftrightarrow>
      (\<forall>x \<in> S. a \<le> x) \<and>
      (\<forall>l. (\<forall>x \<in> S. l \<le> x) \<longrightarrow> l \<le> a)"

theorem q7525341_sion_minimax:
  fixes X :: "'e::{real_vector,topological_ab_group_add} set"
    and Y :: "'f::{real_vector,topological_ab_group_add} set"
    and f :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'f \<Rightarrow> 'b::linorder"
    and sup_y :: "'e \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and inf_sup :: "'b"
    and inf_x :: "'f \<Rightarrow> 'b"
    and sup_inf :: "'b"
  assumes continuous_scale_e:
      "continuous_on UNIV (\<lambda>p :: real \<times> 'e. fst p *\<^sub>R snd p)"
    and nonempty_X: "X \<noteq> {}"
    and compact_X: "compact X"
    and lower_semicontinuous:
      "\<forall>y \<in> Y. q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on (\<lambda>x. f x y) X"
    and quasiconvex:
      "\<forall>y \<in> Y. q7525341_quasiconvex_on X (\<lambda>x. f x y)"
    and continuous_scale_f:
      "continuous_on UNIV (\<lambda>p :: real \<times> 'f. fst p *\<^sub>R snd p)"
    and convex_Y: "q7525341_convex Y"
    and upper_semicontinuous:
      "\<forall>x \<in> X. q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on (f x) Y"
    and quasiconcave:
      "\<forall>x \<in> X. q7525341_quasiconcave_on Y (f x)"
    and convex_X: "q7525341_convex X"
    and sup_y_is_lub:
      "\<forall>x \<in> X. q7525341_is_lub ((f x) ` Y) (sup_y x)"
    and inf_sup_is_glb:
      "q7525341_is_glb (sup_y ` X) inf_sup"
    and inf_x_is_glb:
      "\<forall>y \<in> Y. q7525341_is_glb ((\<lambda>x. f x y) ` X) (inf_x y)"
    and sup_inf_is_lub:
      "q7525341_is_lub (inf_x ` Y) sup_inf"
  shows "inf_sup = sup_inf"
  sorry

end

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7525341
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q7525341), "Sion's minimax theorem": for a
  compact convex subset X and a convex subset Y of real topological vector
  spaces, a lower-semicontinuous quasiconvex / upper-semicontinuous
  quasiconcave function into a densely ordered linear order has equal
  supplied infimum-of-suprema and supremum-of-infima. This file contains no
  proof.
*)

let Q7525341_SION_MINIMAX_THEOREM =
 `let strict =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (a:C) (b:C).
      le a b /\ ~(a = b) in
  let is_linear_order =
    \(le:C->C->bool).
      (!a:C. le a a) /\
      (!a b:C. le a b /\ le b a ==> a = b) /\
      (!a b c:C. le a b /\ le b c ==> le a c) /\
      (!a b:C. le a b \/ le b a) in
  let is_densely_ordered =
    \(le:C->C->bool).
      !a b:C.
        strict le a b
        ==> ?c:C. strict le a c /\ strict le c b in
  let is_topology_E =
    \(openE:(A->bool)->bool).
      openE {} /\
      openE (UNIV:A->bool) /\
      (!family:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!u:A->bool. u IN family ==> openE u)
         ==> openE (UNIONS family)) /\
      (!u v:A->bool.
         openE u /\ openE v ==> openE (u INTER v)) in
  let is_topology_F =
    \(openF:(B->bool)->bool).
      openF {} /\
      openF (UNIV:B->bool) /\
      (!family:(B->bool)->bool.
         (!u:B->bool. u IN family ==> openF u)
         ==> openF (UNIONS family)) /\
      (!u v:B->bool.
         openF u /\ openF v ==> openF (u INTER v)) in
  let real_vector_space_E =
    \(zeroE:A) (addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A)
     (smulE:real->A->A).
      (!x y z:A. addE x (addE y z) = addE (addE x y) z) /\
      (!x y:A. addE x y = addE y x) /\
      (!x:A. addE zeroE x = x) /\
      (!x:A. addE (negE x) x = zeroE) /\
      (!x:A. smulE (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:A.
         smulE (a * b) x = smulE a (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:A.
         smulE (a + b) x = addE (smulE a x) (smulE b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:A.
         smulE a (addE x y) = addE (smulE a x) (smulE a y)) /\
      (!x:A. smulE (&0) x = zeroE) /\
      (!a:real. smulE a zeroE = zeroE) in
  let real_vector_space_F =
    \(zeroF:B) (addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B)
     (smulF:real->B->B).
      (!x y z:B. addF x (addF y z) = addF (addF x y) z) /\
      (!x y:B. addF x y = addF y x) /\
      (!x:B. addF zeroF x = x) /\
      (!x:B. addF (negF x) x = zeroF) /\
      (!x:B. smulF (&1) x = x) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:B.
         smulF (a * b) x = smulF a (smulF b x)) /\
      (!a b:real. !x:B.
         smulF (a + b) x = addF (smulF a x) (smulF b x)) /\
      (!a:real. !x y:B.
         smulF a (addF x y) = addF (smulF a x) (smulF a y)) /\
      (!x:B. smulF (&0) x = zeroF) /\
      (!a:real. smulF a zeroF = zeroF) in
  let is_topological_add_group_E =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (negE:A->A)
     (openE:(A->bool)->bool).
      (!x y:A. !u:A->bool.
         openE u /\ addE x y IN u
         ==> ?v w:A->bool.
               openE v /\
               openE w /\
               x IN v /\
               y IN w /\
               (!x' y':A.
                  x' IN v /\ y' IN w ==> addE x' y' IN u)) /\
      (!x:A. !u:A->bool.
         openE u /\ negE x IN u
         ==> ?v:A->bool.
               openE v /\
               x IN v /\
               (!x':A. x' IN v ==> negE x' IN u)) in
  let is_topological_add_group_F =
    \(addF:B->B->B) (negF:B->B)
     (openF:(B->bool)->bool).
      (!x y:B. !u:B->bool.
         openF u /\ addF x y IN u
         ==> ?v w:B->bool.
               openF v /\
               openF w /\
               x IN v /\
               y IN w /\
               (!x' y':B.
                  x' IN v /\ y' IN w ==> addF x' y' IN u)) /\
      (!x:B. !u:B->bool.
         openF u /\ negF x IN u
         ==> ?v:B->bool.
               openF v /\
               x IN v /\
               (!x':B. x' IN v ==> negF x' IN u)) in
  let has_continuous_smul_E =
    \(smulE:real->A->A) (openE:(A->bool)->bool).
      !a:real. !x:A. !u:A->bool.
        openE u /\ smulE a x IN u
        ==> ?epsilon:real. ?v:A->bool.
              &0 < epsilon /\
              openE v /\
              x IN v /\
              (!b:real. !y:A.
                 abs(b - a) < epsilon /\ y IN v
                 ==> smulE b y IN u) in
  let has_continuous_smul_F =
    \(smulF:real->B->B) (openF:(B->bool)->bool).
      !a:real. !x:B. !u:B->bool.
        openF u /\ smulF a x IN u
        ==> ?epsilon:real. ?v:B->bool.
              &0 < epsilon /\
              openF v /\
              x IN v /\
              (!b:real. !y:B.
                 abs(b - a) < epsilon /\ y IN v
                 ==> smulF b y IN u) in
  let is_compact_E =
    \(openE:(A->bool)->bool) (s:A->bool).
      !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
        (!u:A->bool. u IN cover ==> openE u) /\
        s SUBSET UNIONS cover
        ==> ?subcover:(A->bool)->bool.
              subcover SUBSET cover /\
              FINITE subcover /\
              s SUBSET UNIONS subcover in
  let convex_E =
    \(addE:A->A->A) (smulE:real->A->A) (s:A->bool).
      !x y:A. !a b:real.
        x IN s /\
        y IN s /\
        &0 <= a /\
        &0 <= b /\
        a + b = &1
        ==> addE (smulE a x) (smulE b y) IN s in
  let convex_F =
    \(addF:B->B->B) (smulF:real->B->B) (s:B->bool).
      !x y:B. !a b:real.
        x IN s /\
        y IN s /\
        &0 <= a /\
        &0 <= b /\
        a + b = &1
        ==> addF (smulF a x) (smulF b y) IN s in
  let lower_semicontinuous_on_E =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (openE:(A->bool)->bool)
     (s:A->bool) (g:A->C).
      !b:C.
        ?u:A->bool.
          openE u /\
          (!x:A.
             x IN s
             ==> (strict le b (g x) <=> x IN u)) in
  let upper_semicontinuous_on_F =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (openF:(B->bool)->bool)
     (s:B->bool) (g:B->C).
      !b:C.
        ?u:B->bool.
          openF u /\
          (!y:B.
             y IN s
             ==> (strict le (g y) b <=> y IN u)) in
  let quasiconvex_on_E =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (addE:A->A->A) (smulE:real->A->A)
     (s:A->bool) (g:A->C).
      !r:C.
        convex_E addE smulE
          {x:A | x IN s /\ le (g x) r} in
  let quasiconcave_on_F =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (addF:B->B->B) (smulF:real->B->B)
     (s:B->bool) (g:B->C).
      !r:C.
        convex_F addF smulF
          {y:B | y IN s /\ le r (g y)} in
  let is_lub =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (s:C->bool) (u:C).
      (!x:C. x IN s ==> le x u) /\
      (!v:C. (!x:C. x IN s ==> le x v) ==> le u v) in
  let is_glb =
    \(le:C->C->bool) (s:C->bool) (l:C).
      (!x:C. x IN s ==> le l x) /\
      (!v:C. (!x:C. x IN s ==> le v x) ==> le v l) in
  !le:C->C->bool.
  !zeroE:A.
  !addE:A->A->A.
  !negE:A->A.
  !smulE:real->A->A.
  !openE:(A->bool)->bool.
  !zeroF:B.
  !addF:B->B->B.
  !negF:B->B.
  !smulF:real->B->B.
  !openF:(B->bool)->bool.
  !X:A->bool.
  !Y:B->bool.
  !f:A->B->C.
  !sup_y:A->C.
  !inf_sup:C.
  !inf_x:B->C.
  !sup_inf:C.
    is_linear_order le /\
    is_densely_ordered le /\
    is_topology_E openE /\
    is_topology_F openF /\
    real_vector_space_E zeroE addE negE smulE /\
    real_vector_space_F zeroF addF negF smulF /\
    is_topological_add_group_E addE negE openE /\
    is_topological_add_group_F addF negF openF /\
    has_continuous_smul_E smulE openE /\
    has_continuous_smul_F smulF openF /\
    (?x:A. x IN X) /\
    convex_E addE smulE X /\
    convex_F addF smulF Y /\
    is_compact_E openE X /\
    (!y:B.
       y IN Y
       ==> lower_semicontinuous_on_E le openE X (\x:A. f x y)) /\
    (!y:B.
       y IN Y
       ==> quasiconvex_on_E le addE smulE X (\x:A. f x y)) /\
    (!x:A.
       x IN X
       ==> upper_semicontinuous_on_F le openF Y (f x)) /\
    (!x:A.
       x IN X
       ==> quasiconcave_on_F le addF smulF Y (f x)) /\
    (!x:A.
       x IN X
       ==> is_lub le
             {v:C | ?y:B. y IN Y /\ v = f x y}
             (sup_y x)) /\
    is_glb le
      {v:C | ?x:A. x IN X /\ v = sup_y x}
      inf_sup /\
    (!y:B.
       y IN Y
       ==> is_glb le
             {v:C | ?x:A. x IN X /\ v = f x y}
             (inf_x y)) /\
    is_lub le
      {v:C | ?y:B. y IN Y /\ v = inf_x y}
      sup_inf
    ==> inf_sup = sup_inf`;;

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7525341,
;; "Sion's minimax theorem": lower-semicontinuous quasiconvex sections on a
;; nonempty compact set and upper-semicontinuous quasiconcave sections on a
;; convex set have equal iterated infimum-supremum and supremum-infimum when
;; the displayed greatest and least bounds exist. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))
(set-ignore-ok t)
(set-irrelevant-formals-ok t)

;; Tame APPLY$ functions represent arbitrary carriers, subsets, operations,
;; topologies, and the source function.  All algebraic, order, topological,
;; compactness, continuity, convexity, and bound conditions are explicit
;; hypotheses of the final predicate.

(defun q7525341-member-p (predicate object)
  (if (apply$ predicate (list object)) t nil))

(defun q7525341-binary-relation-p (relation left right)
  (if (apply$ relation (list left right)) t nil))

(defun q7525341-unary-value (function argument)
  (apply$ function (list argument)))

(defun q7525341-binary-value (function left right)
  (apply$ function (list left right)))

;; Extensional subsets, families of subsets, and topologies.

(defun-sk q7525341-set-contained-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p set x)
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x))))

(defun q7525341-valid-set-p (carrier set)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp set)
   (q7525341-set-contained-p carrier set)))

(defun-sk q7525341-set-equiv-p (carrier left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q7525341-member-p left x)
      (q7525341-member-p right x)))))

(defun-sk q7525341-family-extensional-p (carrier family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier left)
      (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier right)
      (q7525341-set-equiv-p carrier left right))
     (iff
      (q7525341-member-p family left)
      (q7525341-member-p family right)))))

(defun-sk q7525341-family-members-valid-p (carrier family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p family set)
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set))))

(defun q7525341-family-of-sets-p (carrier family)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp family)
   (q7525341-family-extensional-p carrier family)
   (q7525341-family-members-valid-p carrier family)))

(defun-sk q7525341-set-nonempty-p (carrier set)
  (exists (x)
    (and
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (q7525341-member-p set x))))

(defun q7525341-open-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q7525341-member-p topology set)))

(defun-sk q7525341-empty-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (not (q7525341-member-p set x)))))

(defun-sk q7525341-empty-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q7525341-empty-set-p carrier set)
     (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q7525341-full-set-p (carrier set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (q7525341-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q7525341-full-open-exists-p (carrier topology)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q7525341-full-set-p carrier set)
     (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q7525341-intersection-representation-p
    (carrier left right intersection)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q7525341-member-p intersection x)
      (and
       (q7525341-member-p left x)
       (q7525341-member-p right x))))))

(defun-sk q7525341-open-intersection-exists-p
    (carrier topology left right)
  (exists (intersection)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier intersection)
     (q7525341-intersection-representation-p
      carrier left right intersection)
     (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology intersection))))

(defun-sk q7525341-topology-intersection-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology left)
      (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology right))
     (q7525341-open-intersection-exists-p
      carrier topology left right))))

(defun-sk q7525341-union-member-p (carrier family x)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q7525341-member-p family set)
     (q7525341-member-p set x))))

(defun-sk q7525341-union-representation-p
    (carrier family union)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q7525341-member-p union x)
      (q7525341-union-member-p carrier family x)))))

(defun-sk q7525341-family-members-open-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p family set)
     (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology set))))

(defun-sk q7525341-open-union-exists-p
    (carrier topology family)
  (exists (union)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier union)
     (q7525341-union-representation-p carrier family union)
     (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology union))))

(defun-sk q7525341-topology-union-law-p
    (carrier topology)
  (forall (family)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-family-of-sets-p carrier family)
      (q7525341-family-members-open-p
       carrier topology family))
     (q7525341-open-union-exists-p
      carrier topology family))))

(defun q7525341-topological-space-p (carrier topology)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (q7525341-family-of-sets-p carrier topology)
   (q7525341-empty-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q7525341-full-open-exists-p carrier topology)
   (q7525341-topology-intersection-law-p carrier topology)
   (q7525341-topology-union-law-p carrier topology)))

(defun-sk q7525341-complement-representation-p
    (carrier set complement)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
     (iff
      (q7525341-member-p complement x)
      (not (q7525341-member-p set x))))))

(defun-sk q7525341-open-complement-exists-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (exists (complement)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier complement)
     (q7525341-complement-representation-p
      carrier set complement)
     (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology complement))))

(defun q7525341-closed-set-p (carrier topology set)
  (and
   (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set)
   (q7525341-open-complement-exists-p
    carrier topology set)))

;; Compactness by arbitrary open covers and internal finite subcovers.

(defun-sk q7525341-cover-point-p
    (carrier cover point)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q7525341-valid-set-p carrier set)
     (q7525341-member-p cover set)
     (q7525341-member-p set point))))

(defun-sk q7525341-cover-covers-set-p
    (carrier cover set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
      (q7525341-member-p set x))
     (q7525341-cover-point-p carrier cover x))))

(defun q7525341-open-cover-p
    (carrier topology cover set)
  (and
   (q7525341-family-of-sets-p carrier cover)
   (q7525341-family-members-open-p carrier topology cover)
   (q7525341-cover-covers-set-p carrier cover set)))

(defun q7525341-subcover-list-p
    (carrier topology cover sets)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q7525341-open-set-p carrier topology (car sets))
       (q7525341-member-p cover (car sets))
       (q7525341-subcover-list-p
        carrier topology cover (cdr sets)))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun q7525341-point-covered-by-list-p (sets point)
  (if (consp sets)
      (or
       (q7525341-member-p (car sets) point)
       (q7525341-point-covered-by-list-p (cdr sets) point))
    nil))

(defun-sk q7525341-list-covers-set-p
    (carrier sets set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
      (q7525341-member-p set x))
     (q7525341-point-covered-by-list-p sets x))))

(defun-sk q7525341-finite-subcover-exists-p
    (carrier topology cover set)
  (exists (sets)
    (and
     (true-listp sets)
     (q7525341-subcover-list-p
      carrier topology cover sets)
     (q7525341-list-covers-set-p carrier sets set))))

(defun-sk q7525341-compact-set-p
    (carrier topology set)
  (forall (cover)
    (implies
     (q7525341-open-cover-p carrier topology cover set)
     (q7525341-finite-subcover-exists-p
      carrier topology cover set))))

;; The scalar field is a Dedekind-complete ordered field, hence a presentation
;; of the real numbers.  Its topology is constrained below to be the order
;; topology rather than an independently chosen topology.

(defun-sk q7525341-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero one add multiply negate inverse)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier y)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy-add (q7525341-binary-value add x y))
            (yz-add (q7525341-binary-value add y z))
            (xy-mul (q7525341-binary-value multiply x y))
            (yz-mul (q7525341-binary-value multiply y z))
            (neg-x (q7525341-unary-value negate x))
            (inv-x (q7525341-unary-value inverse x)))
       (and
        (q7525341-member-p carrier xy-add)
        (q7525341-member-p carrier xy-mul)
        (q7525341-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (q7525341-member-p carrier inv-x)
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value add xy-add z)
         (q7525341-binary-value add x yz-add))
        (equal xy-add (q7525341-binary-value add y x))
        (equal (q7525341-binary-value add x zero) x)
        (equal (q7525341-binary-value add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value multiply xy-mul z)
         (q7525341-binary-value multiply x yz-mul))
        (equal xy-mul (q7525341-binary-value multiply y x))
        (equal (q7525341-binary-value multiply x one) x)
        (equal (q7525341-unary-value inverse zero) zero)
        (implies
         (not (equal x zero))
         (equal
          (q7525341-binary-value multiply x inv-x)
          one))
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value multiply x yz-add)
         (q7525341-binary-value
          add
          (q7525341-binary-value multiply x y)
          (q7525341-binary-value multiply x z))))))))

(defun-sk q7525341-ordered-field-laws-p
    (carrier zero add multiply less)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier y)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier z))
     (and
      (not (q7525341-binary-relation-p less x x))
      (or
       (equal x y)
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p less x y)
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p less y x))
      (implies
       (and
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p less x y)
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p less y z))
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p less x z))
      (implies
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p less x y)
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p
        less
        (q7525341-binary-value add x z)
        (q7525341-binary-value add y z)))
      (implies
       (and
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p less zero x)
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p less zero y))
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p
        less zero
        (q7525341-binary-value multiply x y)))))))

;; Additive commutative groups and real modules.

(defun-sk q7525341-module-laws-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add negate scalar-action)
  (forall (a b x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q7525341-member-p scalar-carrier a)
      (q7525341-member-p scalar-carrier b)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier x)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier y)
      (q7525341-member-p carrier z))
     (let* ((xy (q7525341-binary-value add x y))
            (yz (q7525341-binary-value add y z))
            (neg-x (q7525341-unary-value negate x))
            (a-x (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action a x)))
       (and
        (q7525341-member-p carrier xy)
        (q7525341-member-p carrier neg-x)
        (q7525341-member-p carrier a-x)
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value add xy z)
         (q7525341-binary-value add x yz))
        (equal xy (q7525341-binary-value add y x))
        (equal (q7525341-binary-value add x zero) x)
        (equal (q7525341-binary-value add x neg-x) zero)
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action scalar-one x)
         x)
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value
          scalar-action
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-multiply a b)
          x)
         (q7525341-binary-value
          scalar-action a
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action b x)))
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value
          scalar-action
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-add a b)
          x)
         (q7525341-binary-value
          add
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action a x)
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action b x)))
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action a xy)
         (q7525341-binary-value
          add
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action a x)
          (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action a y)))
        (equal
         (q7525341-binary-value scalar-action scalar-zero x)
         zero))))))

(defun q7525341-module-p
    (scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
     carrier zero add negate scalar-action)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp add)
   (tamep-functionp negate)
   (tamep-functionp scalar-action)
   (q7525341-member-p carrier zero)
   (q7525341-module-laws-p
    scalar-carrier scalar-zero scalar-one scalar-add scalar-multiply
    carrier zero add negate scalar-action)))

(defun-sk q7525341-linear-order-laws-p (carrier le)

        (q7525341-binary-relation-p le x y)
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p le y x))

      (implies
       (and
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p le x y)
        (q7525341-binary-relation-p le y z))
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p le x z))
      (or
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p le x y)
       (q7525341-binary-relation-p le y x))))))
