title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7525341,
-- "Sion's minimax theorem": under compactness, convexity, semicontinuity, and
-- quasiconvexity/quasiconcavity hypotheses, the specified infimum of suprema
-- equals the specified supremum of infima. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

infix 4 _!=_
infixr 3 _and_
infixr 2 _or_

data Bottom {a : Level} : Set a where

Not :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set a
Not {a} proposition =
  proposition -> Bottom {a}

_!=_ :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  A ->
  A ->
  Set a
x != y =
  Not (x == y)

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data _or_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  left  : A -> A or B
  right : B -> A or B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

record LogicalEquivalence
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor logically-equivalent
  field
    forward  : A -> B
    backward : B -> A

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

record CompleteOrderedField (R : Set) : Set1 where
  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR reciprocalR : R -> R
    lessOrEqualR : R -> R -> Set
    fromNatR : Nat -> R

    one-not-zeroR :
      oneR != zeroR

    add-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR x y == addR y x
    add-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR (addR x y) z == addR x (addR y z)
    add-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x zeroR == x
    add-inverseR :
      (x : R) ->
      addR x (negateR x) == zeroR

    multiply-commutativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR x y == multiplyR y x
    multiply-associativeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR (multiplyR x y) z ==
      multiplyR x (multiplyR y z)
    multiply-oneR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x oneR == x
    multiply-zeroR :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR x zeroR == zeroR
    distributeR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR x (addR y z) ==
      addR (multiplyR x y) (multiplyR x z)
    reciprocal-zeroR :
      reciprocalR zeroR == zeroR
    multiply-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      x != zeroR ->
      multiplyR x (reciprocalR x) == oneR

    order-reflexiveR :
      (x : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x x
    order-transitiveR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y z ->
      lessOrEqualR x z
    order-antisymmetricR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y or lessOrEqualR y x
    add-orderR :
      (x y z : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR x y ->
      lessOrEqualR (addR z x) (addR z y)
    multiply-nonnegativeR :
      (x y : R) ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR x ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR y ->
      lessOrEqualR zeroR (multiplyR x y)
    zero-less-than-oneR :
      lessOrEqualR zeroR oneR and zeroR != oneR

    fromNat-zeroR :
      fromNatR zero == zeroR
    fromNat-successorR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR (suc n) == addR (fromNatR n) oneR
    fromNat-injectiveR :
      (m n : Nat) ->
      fromNatR m == fromNatR n ->
      m == n

    archimedeanR :
      (x : R) ->
      Exists Nat (\ n -> lessOrEqualR x (fromNatR n))
    least-upper-boundR :
      (P : R -> Set) ->
      Exists R P ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          (x : R) ->
          P x ->
          lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
      Exists R
        (\ supremum ->
          ((x : R) ->
            P x ->
            lessOrEqualR x supremum)
          and
          ((upper : R) ->
            ((x : R) ->
              P x ->
              lessOrEqualR x upper) ->
            lessOrEqualR supremum upper))

open CompleteOrderedField

record CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence
  {R S : Set}
  (source : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (target : CompleteOrderedField S) :
  Set1 where

  field
    forwardR :
      R ->
      S
    backwardR :
      S ->
      R
    forward-after-backwardR :
      (y : S) ->
      forwardR (backwardR y) == y
    backward-after-forwardR :
      (x : R) ->
      backwardR (forwardR x) == x
    forward-zeroR :
      forwardR (zeroR source) == zeroR target
    forward-oneR :
      forwardR (oneR source) == oneR target
    forward-addR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (addR source x y) ==
      addR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-multiplyR :
      (x y : R) ->
      forwardR (multiplyR source x y) ==
      multiplyR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y)
    forward-negateR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (negateR source x) ==
      negateR target (forwardR x)
    forward-reciprocalR :
      (x : R) ->
      forwardR (reciprocalR source x) ==
      reciprocalR target (forwardR x)
    forward-fromNatR :
      (n : Nat) ->
      forwardR (fromNatR source n) == fromNatR target n
    forward-orderR :
      (x y : R) ->
      LogicalEquivalence
        (lessOrEqualR source x y)
        (lessOrEqualR target (forwardR x) (forwardR y))

record RealNumberPresentation
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) :
  Set2 where

  field
    equivalent-complete-ordered-field :
      (S : Set) ->
      (other : CompleteOrderedField S) ->
      CompleteOrderedFieldEquivalence reals other

subtractR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  R
subtractR reals x y =
  addR reals x (negateR reals y)

StrictLessR :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  R ->
  R ->
  Set
StrictLessR reals x y =
  lessOrEqualR reals x y and x != y

Subset :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Subset {a} X =
  X -> Set a

Empty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X
Empty _ =
  Bottom

Union :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X
Union U V x =
  U x or V x

Intersection :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X
Intersection U V x =
  U x and V x

Complement :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X
Complement U x =
  Not (U x)

SubsetOf :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
SubsetOf {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  V x

SameSubset :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
SameSubset {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  LogicalEquivalence (U x) (V x)

Family :
  {a : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc a))
Family {a} X =
  Subset X -> Set (lsuc a)

record TopologicalSpace
  {a : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    close :
      Subset X ->
      Subset X

    close-congruent :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      SameSubset U V ->
      SameSubset (close U) (close V)

    close-empty :
      (x : X) ->
      close Empty x ->
      Bottom {a}

    subset-close :
      (U : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf U (close U)

    close-monotone :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf U V ->
      SubsetOf (close U) (close V)

    close-union-forward :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      (x : X) ->
      close (Union U V) x ->
      close U x or close V x

    close-union-backward :
      (U V : Subset X) ->
      (x : X) ->
      (close U x or close V x) ->
      close (Union U V) x

    close-idempotent :
      (U : Subset X) ->
      SubsetOf (close (close U)) (close U)

open TopologicalSpace

IsClosed :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
IsClosed topology U =
  SubsetOf (close topology U) U

IsOpen :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
IsOpen topology U =
  IsClosed topology (Complement U)

OrderOpen :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  Subset R ->
  Set
OrderOpen {R = R} reals U =
  (x : R) ->
  U x ->
  Exists R
    (\ lower ->
      Exists R
        (\ upper ->
          StrictLessR reals lower x
          and
          (StrictLessR reals x upper
          and
          ((y : R) ->
            StrictLessR reals lower y ->
            StrictLessR reals y upper ->
            U y))))

StandardRealTopology :
  {R : Set} ->
  CompleteOrderedField R ->
  TopologicalSpace R ->
  Set1
StandardRealTopology reals topology =
  (U : Subset _) ->
  LogicalEquivalence
    (IsOpen topology U)
    (OrderOpen reals U)

Covers :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Family X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
Covers {X = X} U cover =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Σ (Subset X)
    (\ V ->
      cover V and V x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Family X ->
  Set (lsuc a)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} U cover =
  Σ (List (Subset X))
    (\ selected ->
      (((V : Subset X) ->
        Member V selected ->
        cover V)
      and
      ((x : X) ->
        U x ->
        Σ (Subset X)
          (\ V ->
            Member V selected and V x))))

Compact :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  Subset X ->
  Set (lsuc (lsuc a))
Compact {X = X} topology U =
  (cover : Family X) ->
  ((V : Subset X) ->
    cover V ->
    IsOpen topology V) ->
  Covers U cover ->
  FiniteSubcover U cover

Nonempty :
  {a : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Subset X ->
  Set a
Nonempty {X = X} U =
  Exists X U

record RealVectorSpace
  {e : Level}
  {R : Set}
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R)
  (E : Set e) :
  Set (lsuc e) where

  field
    zeroE : E
    addE : E -> E -> E
    negateE : E -> E
    scaleE : R -> E -> E

    add-commutativeE :
      (x y : E) ->
      addE x y == addE y x
    add-associativeE :
      (x y z : E) ->
      addE (addE x y) z == addE x (addE y z)
    add-zeroE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x zeroE == x
    add-inverseE :
      (x : E) ->
      addE x (negateE x) == zeroE

    scale-oneE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (oneR reals) x == x
    scale-associativeE :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (multiplyR reals a b) x ==
      scaleE a (scaleE b x)
    scale-add-vectorsE :
      (a : R) ->
      (x y : E) ->
      scaleE a (addE x y) ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE a y)
    scale-add-scalarsE :
      (a b : R) ->
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (addR reals a b) x ==
      addE (scaleE a x) (scaleE b x)
    scale-zero-vectorE :
      (a : R) ->
      scaleE a zeroE == zeroE
    scale-zero-scalarE :
      (x : E) ->
      scaleE (zeroR reals) x == zeroE

open RealVectorSpace

ContinuousAt :
  {a b : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {Y : Set b} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  TopologicalSpace Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  X ->
  Set (lsuc a ⊔ lsuc b)
ContinuousAt {X = X} source target function x =
  (V : Subset _) ->
  IsOpen target V ->
  V (function x) ->
  Exists (Subset X)
    (\ U ->
      IsOpen source U
      and
      (U x
      and
      ((y : X) ->
        U y ->
        V (function y))))

ContinuousAt2 :
  {a b c : Level}
  {X : Set a}
  {Y : Set b}
  {Z : Set c} ->
  TopologicalSpace X ->
  TopologicalSpace Y ->
  TopologicalSpace Z ->
  (X -> Y -> Z) ->
  X ->
  Y ->
  Set (lsuc a ⊔ lsuc b ⊔ lsuc c)
ContinuousAt2 {X = X} {Y = Y}
  source-left source-right target function x y =
  (W : Subset _) ->
  IsOpen target W ->
  W (function x y) ->
  Exists (Subset X)
    (\ U ->
      Exists (Subset Y)
        (\ V ->
          IsOpen source-left U
          and
          (IsOpen source-right V
          and
          (U x
          and
          (V y
          and
          ((u : X) ->
            (v : Y) ->
            U u ->
            V v ->
            W (function u v)))))))

IsTopologicalAddGroup :
  {e : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {E : Set e}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealVectorSpace reals E ->
  TopologicalSpace E ->
  Set (lsuc e)
IsTopologicalAddGroup {E = E} space topology =
  (((x y : E) ->
    ContinuousAt2 topology topology topology (addE space) x y)
  and
  ((x : E) ->
    ContinuousAt topology topology (negateE space) x))

ContinuousScalarMultiplication :
  {e : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {E : Set e}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealVectorSpace reals E ->
  TopologicalSpace R ->
  TopologicalSpace E ->
  Set (lsuc e)
ContinuousScalarMultiplication {R = R} {E = E}
  space topologyR topologyE =
  (a : R) ->
  (x : E) ->
  ContinuousAt2 topologyR topologyE topologyE (scaleE space) a x

Convex :
  {e p : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {E : Set e} ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealVectorSpace reals E ->
  (E -> Set p) ->
  Set (e ⊔ p)
Convex {R = R} {E = E} reals space S =
  (x y : E) ->
  S x ->
  S y ->
  (t : R) ->
  lessOrEqualR reals (zeroR reals) t ->
  lessOrEqualR reals t (oneR reals) ->
  S
    (addE space
      (scaleE space t x)
      (scaleE space
        (subtractR reals (oneR reals) t)
        y))

record DenselyOrderedLinearOrder
  {b : Level}
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (lsuc b) where

  field
    lessOrEqualB :
      B ->
      B ->
      Set b

    order-reflexiveB :
      (x : B) ->
      lessOrEqualB x x
    order-transitiveB :
      (x y z : B) ->
      lessOrEqualB x y ->
      lessOrEqualB y z ->
      lessOrEqualB x z
    order-antisymmetricB :
      (x y : B) ->
      lessOrEqualB x y ->
      lessOrEqualB y x ->
      x == y
    order-totalB :
      (x y : B) ->
      lessOrEqualB x y or lessOrEqualB y x

    densely-orderedB :
      (x y : B) ->
      (lessOrEqualB x y and x != y) ->
      Exists B
        (\ z ->
          (lessOrEqualB x z and x != z)
          and
          (lessOrEqualB z y and z != y))

open DenselyOrderedLinearOrder

StrictLessB :
  {b : Level}
  {B : Set b} ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  B ->
  B ->
  Set b
StrictLessB order x y =
  lessOrEqualB order x y and x != y

LowerSemicontinuousOn :
  {e b : Level}
  {E : Set e}
  {B : Set b} ->
  TopologicalSpace E ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  (E -> B) ->
  Subset E ->
  Set (lsuc e ⊔ b)
LowerSemicontinuousOn {E = E} topology order function domain =
  (x : E) ->
  domain x ->
  (threshold : _) ->
  StrictLessB order threshold (function x) ->
  Exists (Subset E)
    (\ U ->
      IsOpen topology U
      and
      (U x
      and
      ((x' : E) ->
        domain x' ->
        U x' ->
        StrictLessB order threshold (function x'))))

UpperSemicontinuousOn :
  {e b : Level}
  {E : Set e}
  {B : Set b} ->
  TopologicalSpace E ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  (E -> B) ->
  Subset E ->
  Set (lsuc e ⊔ b)
UpperSemicontinuousOn {E = E} topology order function domain =
  (x : E) ->
  domain x ->
  (threshold : _) ->
  StrictLessB order (function x) threshold ->
  Exists (Subset E)
    (\ U ->
      IsOpen topology U
      and
      (U x
      and
      ((x' : E) ->
        domain x' ->
        U x' ->
        StrictLessB order (function x') threshold)))

Sublevel :
  {e b : Level}
  {E : Set e}
  {B : Set b} ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  Subset E ->
  (E -> B) ->
  B ->
  E ->
  Set (e ⊔ b)
Sublevel order domain function threshold x =
  domain x and lessOrEqualB order (function x) threshold

Superlevel :
  {e b : Level}
  {E : Set e}
  {B : Set b} ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  Subset E ->
  (E -> B) ->
  B ->
  E ->
  Set (e ⊔ b)
Superlevel order domain function threshold x =
  domain x and lessOrEqualB order threshold (function x)

QuasiconvexOn :
  {e b : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {E : Set e}
  {B : Set b}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealVectorSpace reals E ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  Subset E ->
  (E -> B) ->
  Set (e ⊔ b)
QuasiconvexOn {reals = reals} space order domain function =
  (threshold : _) ->
  Convex reals space (Sublevel order domain function threshold)

QuasiconcaveOn :
  {e b : Level}
  {R : Set}
  {E : Set e}
  {B : Set b}
  {reals : CompleteOrderedField R} ->
  RealVectorSpace reals E ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  Subset E ->
  (E -> B) ->
  Set (e ⊔ b)
QuasiconcaveOn {reals = reals} space order domain function =
  (threshold : _) ->
  Convex reals space (Superlevel order domain function threshold)

ImageValues :
  {a b : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  {B : Set b} ->
  Subset A ->
  (A -> B) ->
  B ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
ImageValues {A = A} subset function value =
  Exists A
    (\ x ->
      subset x and function x == value)

IsLeastUpperBound :
  {b p : Level}
  {B : Set b} ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  (B -> Set p) ->
  B ->
  Set (b ⊔ p)
IsLeastUpperBound {B = B} order candidates bound =
  (((x : B) ->
    candidates x ->
    lessOrEqualB order x bound)
  and
  ((upper : B) ->
    ((x : B) ->
      candidates x ->
      lessOrEqualB order x upper) ->
    lessOrEqualB order bound upper))

IsGreatestLowerBound :
  {b p : Level}
  {B : Set b} ->
  DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B ->
  (B -> Set p) ->
  B ->
  Set (b ⊔ p)
IsGreatestLowerBound {B = B} order candidates bound =
  (((x : B) ->
    candidates x ->
    lessOrEqualB order bound x)
  and
  ((lower : B) ->
    ((x : B) ->
      candidates x ->
      lessOrEqualB order lower x) ->
    lessOrEqualB order lower bound))

sion-s-minimax-theorem : Setω
sion-s-minimax-theorem =
  {e f b : Level} ->
  (R : Set) ->
  (reals : CompleteOrderedField R) ->
  RealNumberPresentation reals ->
  (topologyR : TopologicalSpace R) ->
  StandardRealTopology reals topologyR ->
  (E : Set e) ->
  (spaceE : RealVectorSpace reals E) ->
  (topologyE : TopologicalSpace E) ->
  IsTopologicalAddGroup spaceE topologyE ->
  ContinuousScalarMultiplication spaceE topologyR topologyE ->
  (F : Set f) ->
  (spaceF : RealVectorSpace reals F) ->
  (topologyF : TopologicalSpace F) ->
  IsTopologicalAddGroup spaceF topologyF ->
  ContinuousScalarMultiplication spaceF topologyR topologyF ->
  (B : Set b) ->
  (orderB : DenselyOrderedLinearOrder B) ->
  (X : Subset E) ->
  Nonempty X ->
  Compact topologyE X ->
  Convex reals spaceE X ->
  (Y : Subset F) ->
  Convex reals spaceF Y ->
  (payoff : E -> F -> B) ->
  ((y : F) ->
    Y y ->
    LowerSemicontinuousOn
      topologyE orderB (\ x -> payoff x y) X) ->
  ((y : F) ->
    Y y ->
    QuasiconvexOn
      spaceE orderB X (\ x -> payoff x y)) ->
  ((x : E) ->
    X x ->
    UpperSemicontinuousOn
      topologyF orderB (payoff x) Y) ->
  ((x : E) ->
    X x ->
    QuasiconcaveOn
      spaceF orderB Y (payoff x)) ->
  (supremum-over-Y : E -> B) ->
  ((x : E) ->
    X x ->
    IsLeastUpperBound orderB
      (ImageValues Y (payoff x))
      (supremum-over-Y x)) ->
  (infimum-of-suprema : B) ->
  IsGreatestLowerBound orderB
    (ImageValues X supremum-over-Y)
    infimum-of-suprema ->
  (infimum-over-X : F -> B) ->
  ((y : F) ->
    Y y ->
    IsGreatestLowerBound orderB
      (ImageValues X (\ x -> payoff x y))
      (infimum-over-X y)) ->
  (supremum-of-infima : B) ->
  IsLeastUpperBound orderB
    (ImageValues Y infimum-over-X)
    supremum-of-infima ->
  infimum-of-suprema == supremum-of-infima

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q7525341 (thousand-theorems__hol4__Q7525341), "Sion's minimax theorem":
  for a lower-semicontinuous quasiconvex / upper-semicontinuous quasiconcave
  function on convex subsets of real topological vector spaces, with the
  first subset nonempty and compact, the specified infimum of row suprema
  equals the specified supremum of column infima. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory realTheory topologyTheory real_topologyTheory;

val q7525341_dense_linear_order_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_dense_linear_order_def",
  ``q7525341_dense_linear_order (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool) <=>
      (!a. leq a a) /\
      (!a b c. leq a b /\ leq b c ==> leq a c) /\
      (!a b. leq a b /\ leq b a ==> a = b) /\
      (!a b. leq a b \/ leq b a) /\
      (!a b.
        leq a b /\ a <> b ==>
        ?c. leq a c /\ a <> c /\ leq c b /\ c <> b)``);

val q7525341_real_topological_vector_space_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_real_topological_vector_space_def",
  ``q7525341_real_topological_vector_space
      (zero : 'e) (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (neg : 'e -> 'e)
      (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e) (top : 'e topology) <=>
      topspace top = UNIV /\
      (!x y z. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) /\
      (!x y. add x y = add y x) /\
      (!x. add zero x = x) /\
      (!x. add (neg x) x = zero) /\
      (!x. smul 1 x = x) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a * b) x = smul a (smul b x)) /\
      (!a b x. smul (a + b) x = add (smul a x) (smul b x)) /\
      (!a x y. smul a (add x y) = add (smul a x) (smul a y)) /\
      (!x y u.
        open_in top u /\ add x y IN u ==>
        ?v w.
          open_in top v /\ x IN v /\
          open_in top w /\ y IN w /\
          !x' y'. x' IN v /\ y' IN w ==> add x' y' IN u) /\
      (!x u.
        open_in top u /\ neg x IN u ==>
        ?v.
          open_in top v /\ x IN v /\
          !x'. x' IN v ==> neg x' IN u) /\
      (!a x u.
        open_in top u /\ smul a x IN u ==>
        ?v w.
          open_in euclidean v /\ a IN v /\
          open_in top w /\ x IN w /\
          !a' x'. a' IN v /\ x' IN w ==> smul a' x' IN u)``);

val q7525341_convex_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_convex_def",
  ``q7525341_convex
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (s : 'e set) <=>
      !x y a b.
        x IN s /\ y IN s /\
        0 <= a /\ 0 <= b /\ a + b = 1 ==>
        add (smul a x) (smul b y) IN s``);

val q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on_def",
  ``q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on
      (top : 'e topology) (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool)
      (s : 'e set) (g : 'e -> 'b) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        !b.
          leq b (g x) /\ b <> g x ==>
          ?u.
            open_in top u /\ x IN u /\
            !z.
              z IN s /\ z IN u ==>
              leq b (g z) /\ b <> g z``);

val q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on_def",
  ``q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on
      (top : 'e topology) (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool)
      (s : 'e set) (g : 'e -> 'b) <=>
      !x.
        x IN s ==>
        !b.
          leq (g x) b /\ g x <> b ==>
          ?u.
            open_in top u /\ x IN u /\
            !z.
              z IN s /\ z IN u ==>
              leq (g z) b /\ g z <> b``);

val q7525341_quasiconvex_on_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_quasiconvex_on_def",
  ``q7525341_quasiconvex_on
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool) (s : 'e set) (g : 'e -> 'b) <=>
      !r.
        q7525341_convex add smul
          {x | x IN s /\ leq (g x) r}``);

val q7525341_quasiconcave_on_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_quasiconcave_on_def",
  ``q7525341_quasiconcave_on
      (add : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (smul : real -> 'e -> 'e)
      (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool) (s : 'e set) (g : 'e -> 'b) <=>
      !r.
        q7525341_convex add smul
          {x | x IN s /\ leq r (g x)}``);

val q7525341_is_lub_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_is_lub_def",
  ``q7525341_is_lub
      (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool) (p : 'b -> bool) (a : 'b) <=>
      (!z. p z ==> leq z a) /\
      (!u. (!z. p z ==> leq z u) ==> leq a u)``);

val q7525341_is_glb_def = new_definition (
  "q7525341_is_glb_def",
  ``q7525341_is_glb
      (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool) (p : 'b -> bool) (a : 'b) <=>
      (!z. p z ==> leq a z) /\
      (!l. (!z. p z ==> leq l z) ==> leq l a)``);

val sion_minimax =
  ``!(zeroE : 'e) (addE : 'e -> 'e -> 'e) (negE : 'e -> 'e)
      (smulE : real -> 'e -> 'e) (topE : 'e topology)
      (zeroF : 'f) (addF : 'f -> 'f -> 'f) (negF : 'f -> 'f)
      (smulF : real -> 'f -> 'f) (topF : 'f topology)
      (leq : 'b -> 'b -> bool)
      (X : 'e set) (Y : 'f set) (f : 'e -> 'f -> 'b)
      (sup_y : 'e -> 'b) (inf_sup : 'b)
      (inf_x : 'f -> 'b) (sup_inf : 'b).
      q7525341_dense_linear_order leq /\
      q7525341_real_topological_vector_space
        zeroE addE negE smulE topE /\
      q7525341_real_topological_vector_space
        zeroF addF negF smulF topF /\
      (?x. x IN X) /\
      compact_in topE X /\
      q7525341_convex addE smulE X /\
      q7525341_convex addF smulF Y /\
      (!y.
        y IN Y ==>
        q7525341_lower_semicontinuous_on
          topE leq X (\x. f x y)) /\
      (!y.
        y IN Y ==>
        q7525341_quasiconvex_on
          addE smulE leq X (\x. f x y)) /\
      (!x.
        x IN X ==>
        q7525341_upper_semicontinuous_on
          topF leq Y (f x)) /\
      (!x.
        x IN X ==>
        q7525341_quasiconcave_on
          addF smulF leq Y (f x)) /\
      (!x.
        x IN X ==>
        q7525341_is_lub leq
          (\z. ?y. y IN Y /\ z = f x y)
          (sup_y x)) /\
      q7525341_is_glb leq
        (\z. ?x. x IN X /\ z = sup_y x)
        inf_sup /\
      (!y.
        y IN Y ==>
        q7525341_is_glb leq
          (\z. ?x. x IN X /\ z = f x y)
          (inf_x y)) /\
      q7525341_is_lub leq
        (\z. ?y. y IN Y /\ z = inf_x y)
        sup_inf
      ==>
      inf_sup = sup_inf``;

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7525341
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7525341), "Sion's minimax theorem": for a
  nonempty compact convex subset X of a real topological vector space, a
  convex subset Y of another real topological vector space, and a payoff into
  an arbitrary linearly ordered codomain whose X-sections are lower
  semicontinuous and quasiconvex and whose Y-sections are upper
  semicontinuous and quasiconcave, explicitly specified iterated infima and
  suprema are equal. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  The payoff f is represented on the Cartesian product of the two carriers;
  this is the uncurried form of the source function E -> F -> beta.

  Q7525341LowerSection and Q7525341UpperSection expand the source
  within-set semicontinuity predicates using their equivalent open-
  neighborhood formulations. Q7525341QuasiconvexSection and
  Q7525341QuasiconcaveSection expand the source definitions by requiring all
  sublevel, respectively superlevel, sets to be convex.

  Q7525341IsLUB and Q7525341IsGLB directly encode least-upper-bound and
  greatest-lower-bound predicates, so no completeness assumption is placed
  on the linearly ordered codomain. The final declaration is the single
  unproved corpus $a statement. All preceding $a declarations are syntax or
  faithful definitions, and this database contains no $p proof statement.
$)

$c Q7525341Convex Q7525341LowerSection Q7525341UpperSection
   Q7525341QuasiconvexSection Q7525341QuasiconcaveSection
   Q7525341RowValues Q7525341ColumnValues Q7525341RestrictedRange
   Q7525341IsLUB Q7525341IsGLB $.

q7525341-convex-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341Convex E X ) $.
q7525341-lower-section-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341LowerSection B E X f y ) $.
q7525341-upper-section-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341UpperSection B F Y f x ) $.
q7525341-quasiconvex-section-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341QuasiconvexSection B E X f y ) $.
q7525341-quasiconcave-section-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341QuasiconcaveSection B F Y f x ) $.
q7525341-row-values-syntax
  $a class ( Q7525341RowValues B f Y x ) $.
q7525341-column-values-syntax
  $a class ( Q7525341ColumnValues B f X y ) $.
q7525341-restricted-range-syntax
  $a class ( Q7525341RestrictedRange B f X ) $.
q7525341-is-lub-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341IsLUB B X x ) $.
q7525341-is-glb-syntax
  $a wff ( Q7525341IsGLB B X x ) $.

${
  $d E X t x y $.

  q7525341-convex-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341Convex E X )
    <->
    A. x e. X A. y e. X A. t e. ( 0 [,] 1 )
      (
        (
          ( t ( .s ` E ) x )
          ( +g ` E )
          ( ( 1 - t ) ( .s ` E ) y )
        )
        e. X
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B E O X b f x y z $.

  q7525341-lower-section-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341LowerSection B E X f y )
    <->
    A. x e. X A. b e. ( Base ` B )
      (
        b ( lt ` B ) ( f ` <. x , y >. )
        ->
        E. O e. ( TopOpen ` E )
          (
            x e. O
            /\
            A. z e. ( O i^i X )
              b ( lt ` B ) ( f ` <. z , y >. )
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B F O Y b f x y z $.

  q7525341-upper-section-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341UpperSection B F Y f x )
    <->
    A. y e. Y A. b e. ( Base ` B )
      (
        ( f ` <. x , y >. ) ( lt ` B ) b
        ->
        E. O e. ( TopOpen ` F )
          (
            y e. O
            /\
            A. z e. ( O i^i Y )
              ( f ` <. x , z >. ) ( lt ` B ) b
          )
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B E X b f x y $.

  q7525341-quasiconvex-section-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341QuasiconvexSection B E X f y )
    <->
    A. b e. ( Base ` B )
      (
        Q7525341Convex
        E
        { x e. X | ( f ` <. x , y >. ) ( le ` B ) b }
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B F Y b f x y $.

  q7525341-quasiconcave-section-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341QuasiconcaveSection B F Y f x )
    <->
    A. b e. ( Base ` B )
      (
        Q7525341Convex
        F
        { y e. Y | b ( le ` B ) ( f ` <. x , y >. ) }
      )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B Y b f x y $.

  q7525341-row-values-definition $a |- (
    Q7525341RowValues B f Y x
  ) = {
    b e. ( Base ` B ) |
      E. y e. Y b = ( f ` <. x , y >. )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d B X b f x y $.

  q7525341-column-values-definition $a |- (
    Q7525341ColumnValues B f X y
  ) = {
    b e. ( Base ` B ) |
      E. x e. X b = ( f ` <. x , y >. )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d B X b f x $.

  q7525341-restricted-range-definition $a |- (
    Q7525341RestrictedRange B f X
  ) = {
    b e. ( Base ` B ) |
      E. x e. X b = ( f ` x )
  } $.
$}

${
  $d B X b x z $.

  q7525341-is-lub-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341IsLUB B X x )
    <->
    (
      x e. ( Base ` B )
      /\
      (
        A. b e. X b ( le ` B ) x
        /\
        A. z e. ( Base ` B )
          (
            A. b e. X b ( le ` B ) z
            ->
            x ( le ` B ) z
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B X b x z $.

  q7525341-is-glb-definition $a |- (
    ( Q7525341IsGLB B X x )
    <->
    (
      x e. ( Base ` B )
      /\
      (
        A. b e. X x ( le ` B ) b
        /\
        A. z e. ( Base ` B )
          (
            A. b e. X z ( le ` B ) b
            ->
            z ( le ` B ) x
          )
      )
    )
  ) $.
$}

${
  $d B E F X Y f i s u v x y $.

  thousand-theorems-q7525341-sion-minimax $a |-
    A. B e. Toset
      A. E e. RRVec
        A. F e. RRVec
          A. X e. ~P ( Base ` E )
            A. Y e. ~P ( Base ` F )
              A. f e.
                ( ( Base ` B ) ^m ( ( Base ` E ) X. ( Base ` F ) ) )
                A. s e. ( ( Base ` B ) ^m ( Base ` E ) )
                  A. u e. ( Base ` B )
                    A. i e. ( ( Base ` B ) ^m ( Base ` F ) )
                      A. v e. ( Base ` B )
                        (
                          (
                            E e. TopMod
                            /\
                            (
                              F e. TopMod
                              /\
                              (
                                X =/= (/) 
                                /\
                                (
                                  ( ( TopOpen ` E ) |`t X ) e. Comp
                                  /\
                                  (

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
:: Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q7525341
:: (thousand-theorems__mizar__Q7525341), "Sion's minimax theorem": for a
:: compact nonempty convex set and a convex parameter set in real topological
:: vector spaces, semicontinuous quasiconvex-quasiconcave sections have equal
:: iterated infimum and supremum whenever the displayed bounds exist in a
:: densely ordered linear codomain. This file contains no proof.

environ

 vocabularies NUMBERS, REAL_1, XBOOLE_0, RLVECT_1, SUBSET_1, PRE_TOPC,
      RELAT_1, XCMPLX_0, SETFAM_1, TARSKI, ALGSTR_0, ARYTM_3, ZFMISC_1,
      STRUCT_0, SUPINF_2, ARYTM_1, CONNSP_2, TOPS_1, CONVEX1, CARD_1,
      XXREAL_0, RELAT_2, COMPLEX1, BINOP_1, FUNCT_1, RCOMP_1, ORDINAL2,
      TOPS_2, YELLOW13, XXREAL_2, FINSET_1, RVSUM_1, EQREL_1, COMPTS_1,
      RLTOPSP1, FUNCT_2, INCSP_1, AFF_1, PENCIL_1, ORDERS_1, ORDERS_2,
      LATTICES, YELLOW_0, WAYBEL_0;
 notations TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, ZFMISC_1, SUBSET_1, FINSET_1, SETFAM_1,
      ORDINAL1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0, XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, COMPLEX1, RELAT_1,
      RELAT_2, FUNCT_1, RELSET_1, FUNCT_2, BINOP_1, REAL_1, EQREL_1,
      DOMAIN_1, STRUCT_0, ALGSTR_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_1, TOPS_2, CONNSP_2,
      COMPTS_1, YELLOW13, RLVECT_1, RUSUB_4, CONVEX1, RLTOPSP1, ORDERS_1,
      ORDERS_2, YELLOW_0, WAYBEL_0;
 constructors SETFAM_1, BINOP_1, DOMAIN_1, XXREAL_0, REAL_1, COMPLEX1,
      EQREL_1, TOPS_1, TOPS_2, CONNSP_2, RUSUB_4, CONVEX1, URYSOHN1,
      YELLOW13, COMPTS_1, RELSET_1, NUMBERS, RLTOPSP1, ORDERS_2, YELLOW_0,
      WAYBEL_0;
 registrations XBOOLE_0, SUBSET_1, RELSET_1, PARTFUN1, NUMBERS, XCMPLX_0,
      XXREAL_0, XREAL_0, STRUCT_0, TOPS_1, RLVECT_1, CONVEX1, TOPGRP_1,
      ORDINAL1, BORSUK_1, COMPTS_1, PRE_TOPC, FUNCT_2, ANPROJ_1, RLTOPSP1,
      ORDERS_2, YELLOW_0, WAYBEL_0;
 requirements BOOLE, REAL, NUMERALS, SUBSET, ARITHM;
 definitions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, PRE_TOPC, CONNSP_2,
      TOPS_2, YELLOW13, CONVEX1, ALGSTR_0, SETFAM_1, ZFMISC_1, RLTOPSP1,
      ORDERS_2;
 equalities STRUCT_0, RLVECT_1, CONVEX1, SUBSET_1, ALGSTR_0, XCMPLX_0;
 expansions TARSKI, XBOOLE_0, PRE_TOPC, TOPS_2, CONVEX1;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for E,F being LinearTopSpace,
      B being connected non empty Poset,
      X being non empty Subset of E,
      Y being Subset of F,
      f being Function of
        [:the carrier of E,the carrier of F:],the carrier of B,
      supY being Function of the carrier of E,the carrier of B,
      infSup being Element of B,
      infX being Function of the carrier of F,the carrier of B,
      supInf being Element of B
  st
    (for a,b being Element of B st a <= b & a <> b holds
      ex c being Element of B st
        a <= c & a <> c & c <= b & c <> b) &
    X is compact &
    X is convex &
    Y is convex &
    (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds
      for b being Element of B holds
        ex C being Subset of E st
          C is closed &
          for x being Point of E st x in X holds
            (x in C iff f.[x,y] <= b)) &
    (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds
      for b being Element of B,
          x1,x2 being Point of E,
          r,s being Real st
        x1 in X & x2 in X &
        f.[x1,y] <= b & f.[x2,y] <= b &
        0 <= r & 0 <= s & r+s = 1
      holds
        r*x1+s*x2 in X & f.[r*x1+s*x2,y] <= b) &
    (for x being Point of E st x in X holds
      for b being Element of B holds
        ex C being Subset of F st
          C is closed &
          for y being Point of F st y in Y holds
            (y in C iff b <= f.[x,y])) &
    (for x being Point of E st x in X holds
      for b being Element of B,
          y1,y2 being Point of F,
          r,s being Real st
        y1 in Y & y2 in Y &
        b <= f.[x,y1] & b <= f.[x,y2] &
        0 <= r & 0 <= s & r+s = 1
      holds
        r*y1+s*y2 in Y & b <= f.[x,r*y1+s*y2]) &
    (for x being Point of E st x in X holds
      (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds
        f.[x,y] <= supY.x) &
      for b being Element of B st
        (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds f.[x,y] <= b)
      holds supY.x <= b) &
    (for x being Point of E st x in X holds infSup <= supY.x) &
    (for b being Element of B st
      (for x being Point of E st x in X holds b <= supY.x)
     holds b <= infSup) &
    (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds
      (for x being Point of E st x in X holds
        infX.y <= f.[x,y]) &
      for b being Element of B st
        (for x being Point of E st x in X holds b <= f.[x,y])
      holds b <= infX.y) &
    (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds infX.y <= supInf) &
    (for b being Element of B st
      (for y being Point of F st y in Y holds infX.y <= b)
     holds supInf <= b)
  holds
    infSup = supInf
proof
end;
::$P+

title: Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7525341,
% "Sion's minimax theorem": the infimum of the row suprema equals the supremum
% of the column infima for a nonempty compact convex set X and a convex set Y,
% under the sectionwise semicontinuity and quasiconvexity hypotheses, with
% explicit order-bound witnesses. This file contains no proof.

Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem[
  E: TYPE+,
  F: TYPE+,
  beta: TYPE,
  zero_E: E,
  add_E: [E, E -> E],
  neg_E: [E -> E],
  smul_E: [real, E -> E],
  open_E: [[E -> bool] -> bool],
  zero_F: F,
  add_F: [F, F -> F],
  neg_F: [F -> F],
  smul_F: [real, F -> F],
  open_F: [[F -> bool] -> bool],
  le_beta: [beta, beta -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  E_set: TYPE = [E -> bool]
  F_set: TYPE = [F -> bool]
  beta_set: TYPE = [beta -> bool]
  E_set_family: TYPE = [E_set -> bool]
  F_set_family: TYPE = [F_set -> bool]
  E_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> E_set]

  empty_E_set: E_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): FALSE

  whole_E_set: E_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): TRUE

  E_intersection(A, B: E_set): E_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E): A(x) AND B(x)

  E_union(C: E_set_family): E_set =
    LAMBDA (x: E):
      EXISTS (U: E_set):
        C(U) AND U(x)

  empty_F_set: F_set =
    LAMBDA (y: F): FALSE

  whole_F_set: F_set =
    LAMBDA (y: F): TRUE

  F_intersection(A, B: F_set): F_set =
    LAMBDA (y: F): A(y) AND B(y)

  F_union(C: F_set_family): F_set =
    LAMBDA (y: F):
      EXISTS (U: F_set):
        C(U) AND U(y)

  topology_E_laws: bool =
    open_E(empty_E_set)
      AND open_E(whole_E_set)
      AND
    (FORALL (A, B: E_set):
      open_E(A) AND open_E(B)
        IMPLIES open_E(E_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
    (FORALL (C: E_set_family):
      (FORALL (U: E_set):
        C(U) IMPLIES open_E(U))
        IMPLIES open_E(E_union(C)))

  topology_F_laws: bool =
    open_F(empty_F_set)
      AND open_F(whole_F_set)
      AND
    (FORALL (A, B: F_set):
      open_F(A) AND open_F(B)
        IMPLIES open_F(F_intersection(A, B)))
      AND
    (FORALL (C: F_set_family):
      (FORALL (U: F_set):
        C(U) IMPLIES open_F(U))
        IMPLIES open_F(F_union(C)))

  additive_commutative_group_E_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: E):
      add_E(x, y) = add_E(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: E):
      add_E(add_E(x, y), z) = add_E(x, add_E(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      add_E(x, zero_E) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      add_E(x, neg_E(x)) = zero_E)

  additive_commutative_group_F_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y: F):
      add_F(x, y) = add_F(y, x))
      AND
    (FORALL (x, y, z: F):
      add_F(add_F(x, y), z) = add_F(x, add_F(y, z)))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: F):
      add_F(x, zero_F) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (x: F):
      add_F(x, neg_F(x)) = zero_F)

  real_module_E_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_E_laws
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      smul_E(1, x) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
      smul_E(a * b, x) = smul_E(a, smul_E(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: E):
      smul_E(a + b, x) = add_E(smul_E(a, x), smul_E(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: E):
      smul_E(a, add_E(x, y)) =
        add_E(smul_E(a, x), smul_E(a, y)))

  real_module_F_laws: bool =
    additive_commutative_group_F_laws
      AND
    (FORALL (x: F):
      smul_F(1, x) = x)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: F):
      smul_F(a * b, x) = smul_F(a, smul_F(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: real), (x: F):
      smul_F(a + b, x) = add_F(smul_F(a, x), smul_F(b, x)))
      AND
    (FORALL (a: real), (x, y: F):
      smul_F(a, add_F(x, y)) =
        add_F(smul_F(a, x), smul_F(a, y)))

  real_open(A: [real -> bool]): bool =
    FORALL (a: real):
      A(a) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (radius: real):
          0 < radius
            AND
          (FORALL (b: real):
            abs(b - a) < radius IMPLIES A(b))

  continuous_add_E: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (W: E_set):
      open_E(W) AND W(add_E(x, y))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U, V: E_set):
            open_E(U)
              AND open_E(V)
              AND U(x)
              AND V(y)
              AND
            (FORALL (u, v: E):
              U(u) AND V(v) IMPLIES W(add_E(u, v)))

  continuous_neg_E: bool =
    FORALL (x: E), (W: E_set):
      open_E(W) AND W(neg_E(x))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: E_set):
            open_E(U)
              AND U(x)
              AND
            (FORALL (u: E):
              U(u) IMPLIES W(neg_E(u)))

  continuous_smul_E: bool =
    FORALL (a: real), (x: E), (W: E_set):
      open_E(W) AND W(smul_E(a, x))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (R: [real -> bool]), (U: E_set):
            real_open(R)
              AND open_E(U)
              AND R(a)
              AND U(x)
              AND
            (FORALL (b: real), (u: E):
              R(b) AND U(u) IMPLIES W(smul_E(b, u)))

  continuous_add_F: bool =
    FORALL (x, y: F), (W: F_set):
      open_F(W) AND W(add_F(x, y))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U, V: F_set):
            open_F(U)
              AND open_F(V)
              AND U(x)
              AND V(y)
              AND
            (FORALL (u, v: F):
              U(u) AND V(v) IMPLIES W(add_F(u, v)))

  continuous_neg_F: bool =
    FORALL (x: F), (W: F_set):
      open_F(W) AND W(neg_F(x))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (U: F_set):
            open_F(U)
              AND U(x)
              AND
            (FORALL (u: F):
              U(u) IMPLIES W(neg_F(u)))

  continuous_smul_F: bool =
    FORALL (a: real), (x: F), (W: F_set):
      open_F(W) AND W(smul_F(a, x))
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (R: [real -> bool]), (U: F_set):
            real_open(R)
              AND open_F(U)
              AND R(a)
              AND U(x)
              AND
            (FORALL (b: real), (u: F):
              R(b) AND U(u) IMPLIES W(smul_F(b, u)))

  lt_beta(a, b: beta): bool =
    le_beta(a, b) AND NOT le_beta(b, a)

  linear_order_beta_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (a: beta):
      le_beta(a, a))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b, c: beta):
      le_beta(a, b) AND le_beta(b, c)
        IMPLIES le_beta(a, c))
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: beta):
      le_beta(a, b) AND le_beta(b, a)
        IMPLIES a = b)
      AND
    (FORALL (a, b: beta):
      le_beta(a, b) OR le_beta(b, a))

  densely_ordered_beta_law: bool =
    FORALL (a, b: beta):
      lt_beta(a, b)
        IMPLIES
          EXISTS (c: beta):
            lt_beta(a, c) AND lt_beta(c, b)

  topological_real_module_E_laws: bool =
    topology_E_laws
      AND real_module_E_laws
      AND continuous_add_E
      AND continuous_neg_E
      AND continuous_smul_E

  topological_real_module_F_laws: bool =
    topology_F_laws
      AND real_module_F_laws
      AND continuous_add_F
      AND continuous_neg_F
      AND continuous_smul_F

  open_cover_E(C: E_set_family, X: E_set): bool =
    (FORALL (U: E_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES open_E(U))
      AND
    (FORALL (x: E):
      X(x) IMPLIES
        EXISTS (U: E_set):
          C(U) AND U(x))

  finite_subcover_E(C: E_set_family, X: E_set): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: E_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES C(chosen(index)))
        AND
      (FORALL (x: E):
        X(x) IMPLIES
          EXISTS (index: nat):
            index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_E_set(X: E_set): bool =
    FORALL (C: E_set_family):
      open_cover_E(C, X) IMPLIES finite_subcover_E(C, X)

  nonempty_E_set(X: E_set): bool =
    EXISTS (x: E):
      X(x)

  convex_E_set(X: E_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: E), (a, b: real):
      X(x)
        AND X(y)
        AND 0 <= a
        AND 0 <= b
        AND a + b = 1
      IMPLIES
        X(add_E(smul_E(a, x), smul_E(b, y)))

  convex_F_set(Y: F_set): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: F), (a, b: real):
      Y(x)
        AND Y(y)
        AND 0 <= a
        AND 0 <= b
        AND a + b = 1
      IMPLIES
        Y(add_F(smul_F(a, x), smul_F(b, y)))

  lower_semicontinuous_on_E(
      g: [E -> beta],
      X: E_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: E):
      X(x) IMPLIES
        FORALL (bound: beta):
          lt_beta(bound, g(x))
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (U: E_set):
                open_E(U)
                  AND U(x)
                  AND
                (FORALL (z: E):
                  X(z) AND U(z)
                    IMPLIES lt_beta(bound, g(z)))

  upper_semicontinuous_on_F(
      g: [F -> beta],
      Y: F_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: F):
      Y(y) IMPLIES
        FORALL (bound: beta):
          lt_beta(g(y), bound)
            IMPLIES
              EXISTS (U: F_set):
                open_F(U)
                  AND U(y)
                  AND
                (FORALL (z: F):
                  Y(z) AND U(z)
                    IMPLIES lt_beta(g(z), bound))

  quasiconvex_on_E(
      g: [E -> beta],
      X: E_set): bool =
    FORALL (bound: beta):
      convex_E_set(
        LAMBDA (x: E):
          X(x) AND le_beta(g(x), bound))

  quasiconcave_on_F(
      g: [F -> beta],
      Y: F_set): bool =
    FORALL (bound: beta):
      convex_F_set(
        LAMBDA (y: F):
          Y(y) AND le_beta(bound, g(y)))

  is_upper_bound(S: beta_set, upper: beta): bool =
    FORALL (value: beta):
      S(value) IMPLIES le_beta(value, upper)

  is_lower_bound(S: beta_set, lower: beta): bool =
    FORALL (value: beta):
      S(value) IMPLIES le_beta(lower, value)

  is_LUB(S: beta_set, supremum: beta): bool =
    is_upper_bound(S, supremum)
      AND
    (FORALL (upper: beta):
      is_upper_bound(S, upper)
        IMPLIES le_beta(supremum, upper))

  is_GLB(S: beta_set, infimum: beta): bool =
    is_lower_bound(S, infimum)
      AND
    (FORALL (lower: beta):
      is_lower_bound(S, lower)
        IMPLIES le_beta(lower, infimum))

  row_values(
      f: [E, F -> beta],
      Y: F_set,
      x: E): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (value: beta):
      EXISTS (y: F):
        Y(y) AND f(x, y) = value

  row_supremum_values(
      sup_y: [E -> beta],
      X: E_set): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (value: beta):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        X(x) AND sup_y(x) = value

  column_values(
      f: [E, F -> beta],
      X: E_set,
      y: F): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (value: beta):
      EXISTS (x: E):
        X(x) AND f(x, y) = value

  column_infimum_values(
      inf_x: [F -> beta],
      Y: F_set): beta_set =
    LAMBDA (value: beta):
      EXISTS (y: F):
        Y(y) AND inf_x(y) = value

  structure_laws: bool =
    topological_real_module_E_laws
      AND topological_real_module_F_laws
      AND linear_order_beta_laws
      AND densely_ordered_beta_law

  minimax_Q7525341: bool =
    structure_laws IMPLIES
      FORALL
          (X: E_set),
          (Y: F_set),
          (f: [E, F -> beta]),
          (sup_y: [E -> beta]),
          (inf_sup: beta),
          (inf_x: [F -> beta]),
          (sup_inf: beta):
        (nonempty_E_set(X)
          AND compact_E_set(X)
          AND convex_E_set(X)
          AND convex_F_set(Y)
          AND
          (FORALL (y: F):
            Y(y) IMPLIES
              lower_semicontinuous_on_E(
                LAMBDA (x: E): f(x, y), X))
          AND
          (FORALL (y: F):
            Y(y) IMPLIES
              quasiconvex_on_E(
                LAMBDA (x: E): f(x, y), X))
          AND
          (FORALL (x: E):
            X(x) IMPLIES
              upper_semicontinuous_on_F(
                LAMBDA (y: F): f(x, y), Y))
          AND
          (FORALL (x: E):
            X(x) IMPLIES
              quasiconcave_on_F(
                LAMBDA (y: F): f(x, y), Y))
          AND
          (FORALL (x: E):
            X(x) IMPLIES
              is_LUB(row_values(f, Y, x), sup_y(x)))
          AND is_GLB(row_supremum_values(sup_y, X), inf_sup)
          AND
          (FORALL (y: F):
            Y(y) IMPLIES
              is_GLB(column_values(f, X, y), inf_x(y)))
          AND is_LUB(column_infimum_values(inf_x, Y), sup_inf))
        IMPLIES inf_sup = sup_inf
END Q7525341_sion_s_minimax_theorem

title: Q756946_lagrange_s_four_square_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q756946
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q756946), "Lagrange's four-square theorem":
-- every natural number is a sum of four squares of natural numbers. This file
-- contains no proof.

module

@[expose] public section

namespace Q756946

/-- Lagrange's four-square theorem for natural numbers. -/
theorem lagrange_four_square_theorem (n : Nat) :
    ∃ a b c d : Nat, a * a + b * b + c * c + d * d = n := sorry

end Q756946

title: Q756946_lagrange_s_four_square_theorem

title: Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q764287
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q764287), "Van der Waerden's theorem": every
  finite coloring of a commutative additive monoid has a monochromatic
  homothetic copy of each finite subset. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat Lists.List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q764287_add_comm_monoid (M : Type) : Type := {
  q764287_zero : M;
  q764287_add : M -> M -> M;
  q764287_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : M,
      q764287_add x (q764287_add y z) =
      q764287_add (q764287_add x y) z;
  q764287_zero_add :
    forall x : M, q764287_add q764287_zero x = x;
  q764287_add_zero :
    forall x : M, q764287_add x q764287_zero = x;
  q764287_add_comm :
    forall x y : M, q764287_add x y = q764287_add y x
}.

Arguments q764287_zero {M} _.
Arguments q764287_add {M} _ _ _.

Record q764287_finset (X : Type) : Type := {
  q764287_elements : list X;
  q764287_elements_nodup : NoDup q764287_elements
}.

Arguments q764287_elements {X} _.

Definition q764287_mem
    {X : Type} (x : X) (s : q764287_finset X) : Prop :=
  In x (q764287_elements s).

Record q764287_finite_type (X : Type) : Type := {
  q764287_enumeration : list X;
  q764287_enumeration_complete :
    forall x : X, In x q764287_enumeration
}.

Fixpoint q764287_nat_smul
    {M : Type} (A : q764287_add_comm_monoid M)
    (n : nat) (x : M) : M :=
  match n with
  | O => q764287_zero A
  | S k => q764287_add A x (q764287_nat_smul A k x)
  end.

Theorem Combinatorics_exists_mono_homothetic_copy :
  forall (M K : Type)
         (A : q764287_add_comm_monoid M)
         (S : q764287_finset M)
         (_ : q764287_finite_type K)
         (C : M -> K),
    exists a : nat,
      (0 < a)%nat /\
      exists (b : M) (c : K),
        forall s : M,
          q764287_mem s S ->
          C (q764287_add A (q764287_nat_smul A a s) b) = c.
Admitted.

(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q764287
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q764287), "Van der Waerden's theorem": every
  finite subset of a finitely colored additive commutative monoid has a
  monochromatic homothetic copy with positive natural dilation. This file
  contains no proof.

let Q764287_VAN_DER_WAERDENS_THEOREM =
  `let is_add_comm_monoid =
     \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A).
       (!x:A. add zero x = x /\ add x zero = x) /\
       (!x y:A. add x y = add y x) /\
       (!x y z:A. add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)) in
   let natural_multiple =
     \(zero:A) (add:A->A->A) (n:num) (x:A).
       ITLIST add (REPLICATE n x) zero in
   !zero:A. !add:A->A->A. !S:A->bool. !C:A->B.
     is_add_comm_monoid zero add /\
     FINITE S /\
     FINITE (UNIV:B->bool)
     ==> ?a:num.
           0 < a /\
           ?b:A. ?c:B.
             !s:A.
               s IN S
               ==> C (add (natural_multiple zero add a s) b) = c`;;

title: Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q764287,
;; "Van der Waerden's theorem": every finite coloring of an additive
;; commutative monoid has a monochromatic positive-dilate-and-translate copy
;; of each finite subset. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Conservative interfaces represent an arbitrary additive monoid carrier,
;; its operations, and an arbitrary coloring. The monoid and coloring tags
;; let the same interfaces range over all structures supplied to the statement.

(defstub q764287-carrier-member-p (monoid value) t)
(defstub q764287-add (monoid left right) t)
(defstub q764287-zero (monoid) t)
(defstub q764287-color (coloring value) t)

;; These are exactly the AddCommMonoid laws used by the Lean source.

(defun-sk q764287-add-comm-monoid-laws-p (monoid)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid x)
      (and
       (equal
        (q764287-add monoid x (q764287-zero monoid))
        x)
       (equal
        (q764287-add monoid (q764287-zero monoid) x)
        x)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid x)
       (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid y))
      (and
       (q764287-carrier-member-p
        monoid
        (q764287-add monoid x y))
       (equal
        (q764287-add monoid x y)
        (q764287-add monoid y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid x)
       (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid y)
       (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid z))
      (equal
       (q764287-add
        monoid
        (q764287-add monoid x y)
        z)
       (q764287-add
        monoid
        x
        (q764287-add monoid y z)))))))

(defun q764287-add-comm-monoid-p (monoid)
  (and
   (q764287-carrier-member-p
    monoid
    (q764287-zero monoid))
   (q764287-add-comm-monoid-laws-p monoid)))

;; Duplicate-free true lists represent the source Finset M and a complete
;; enumeration of the finite color type. The coloring itself remains an
;; arbitrary function rather than a finite lookup table.

(defun q764287-all-in-carrier-p (monoid values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid (car values))
       (q764287-all-in-carrier-p monoid (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q764287-finite-subset-p (monoid set)
  (and
   (true-listp set)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal set)
   (q764287-all-in-carrier-p monoid set)))

(defun-sk q764287-coloring-into-p
    (monoid colors coloring)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid x)
     (member-equal
      (q764287-color coloring x)
      colors))))

(defun q764287-finite-coloring-p
    (monoid colors coloring)
  (and
   (true-listp colors)
   (no-duplicatesp-equal colors)
   (q764287-coloring-into-p
    monoid colors coloring)))

;; This is the natural-number scalar action generated by the additive monoid:
;; 0 • x = 0 and (n+1) • x = n • x + x.

(defun q764287-nsmul (monoid n x)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix n)))
  (if (zp n)
      (q764287-zero monoid)
    (q764287-add
     monoid
     (q764287-nsmul monoid (- n 1) x)
     x)))

;; For fixed witnesses a, b, and c, every member s of the finite set has color
;; c after the homothety s ↦ a • s + b.

(defun-sk q764287-monochromatic-copy-p
    (monoid set coloring dilation translation color)
  (forall (s)
    (implies
     (member-equal s set)
     (equal
      (q764287-color
       coloring
       (q764287-add
        monoid
        (q764287-nsmul monoid dilation s)
        translation))
      color))))

;; The positive dilation, translation, and common color remain internal
;; existential witnesses, matching the source quantifier scope.

(defun-sk q764287-homothetic-copy-exists-p
    (monoid set colors coloring)
  (exists (dilation translation color)
    (and
     (natp dilation)
     (< 0 dilation)
     (q764287-carrier-member-p monoid translation)
     (member-equal color colors)
     (q764287-monochromatic-copy-p
      monoid
      set
      coloring
      dilation
      translation
      color))))

(defun thousand-theorems-q764287-van-der-waerdens-theorem-statement
    (monoid set colors coloring)
  (implies
   (and
    (q764287-add-comm-monoid-p monoid)
    (q764287-finite-subset-p monoid set)
    (q764287-finite-coloring-p
     monoid colors coloring))
   (q764287-homothetic-copy-exists-p
    monoid set colors coloring)))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q764287,
-- "Van der Waerden's theorem": every finite coloring of a commutative additive
-- monoid has a monochromatic positive-dilation-and-translation copy of each
-- finite subset. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

infixr 3 _and_

record _and_
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

record Exists
  {a p : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (P : A -> Set p) :
  Set (a ⊔ p) where

  constructor witness
  field
    value    : A
    property : P value

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

Injective :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  {B : Set b} ->
  (A -> B) ->
  Set (a ⊔ b)
Injective {A = A} function =
  (x y : A) ->
  function x == function y ->
  x == y

record Bijection
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  field
    to      : A -> B
    from    : B -> A
    from-to : (x : A) -> from (to x) == x
    to-from : (y : B) -> to (from y) == y

record Finite
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size        : Nat
    equivalence : Bijection A (Fin size)

record FiniteSubset
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    size      : Nat
    enumerate : Fin size -> A
    distinct  : Injective enumerate

open FiniteSubset

Member :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  FiniteSubset A ->
  A ->
  Set a
Member subset item =
  Exists (Fin (size subset))
    (\ index -> item == enumerate subset index)

record AdditiveCommutativeMonoid
  {a : Level}
  (A : Set a) :
  Set a where

  field
    zeroA : A
    addA  : A -> A -> A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) ->
      addA (addA x y) z == addA x (addA y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) ->
      addA x y == addA y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) ->
      addA zeroA x == x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) ->
      addA x zeroA == x

naturalScale :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  AdditiveCommutativeMonoid A ->
  Nat ->
  A ->
  A
naturalScale monoid zero x =
  AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.zeroA monoid
naturalScale monoid (suc n) x =
  AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addA monoid
    x
    (naturalScale monoid n x)

data Positive : Nat -> Set where
  positive-successor : {n : Nat} -> Positive (suc n)

van-der-waerden-s-theorem : Setω
van-der-waerden-s-theorem =
  {m k : Level} ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (K : Set k) ->
  (monoid : AdditiveCommutativeMonoid M) ->
  (S : FiniteSubset M) ->
  Finite K ->
  (color : M -> K) ->
  Exists Nat
    (\ dilation ->
      Positive dilation
      and
      Exists M
        (\ translation ->
          Exists K
            (\ common-color ->
              (s : M) ->
              Member S s ->
              color
                (AdditiveCommutativeMonoid.addA monoid
                  (naturalScale monoid dilation s)
                  translation)
              ==
              common-color)))

  finite subset of an arbitrary additively written commutative monoid has a
  monochromatic positive-natural homothetic copy under every finite coloring.

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  In SetMM, G e. CMnd supplies an arbitrary commutative monoid, Base ` G is
  its carrier, +g ` G is its operation, and G gsum is its finite generalized

title: Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q764287
% (thousand-theorems__pvs__Q764287), "Van der Waerden's theorem":
% every finite subset of a finitely colored commutative monoid has a
% monochromatic homothetic copy. This file contains no proof.

Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem[
  M: TYPE+,
  K: TYPE,
  zero: M,
  add: [M, M -> M]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[M]

  commutative_monoid_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x: M):
      add(zero, x) = x
        AND add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: M):
        add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: M):
        add(x, y) = add(y, x))

  natural_multiple(n: nat, x: M): RECURSIVE M =
    IF n = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      add(x, natural_multiple(n - 1, x))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE n

  van_der_waerden_s_theorem: bool =
    commutative_monoid_laws
      AND is_finite_type[K]
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (S: finite_set[M]), (C: [M -> K]):
        EXISTS (a: nat), (b: M), (c: K):
          a > 0
            AND (FORALL (s: M):
              S(s) IMPLIES
                C(add(natural_multiple(a, s), b)) = c)
END Q764287_van_der_waerden_s_theorem

title: Q765987_heine_cantor_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q765987
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q765987), "Heine–Cantor theorem": every
  continuous function from a compact uniform space to an arbitrary uniform
  space is uniformly continuous. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Definition q765987_set (A : Type) : Type := A -> Prop.

Definition q765987_subset
    {A : Type}
    (U V : q765987_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A, U x -> V x.

Definition q765987_inverse
    {A : Type}
    (R : q765987_set (A * A)) : q765987_set (A * A) :=
  fun p : A * A => R (snd p, fst p).

Definition q765987_rel_comp
    {A : Type}
    (R S : q765987_set (A * A)) : q765987_set (A * A) :=
  fun p : A * A =>
    exists y : A, R (fst p, y) /\ S (y, snd p).

Record q765987_uniform_space (A : Type) : Type := {
  q765987_entourage : q765987_set (A * A) -> Prop;
  q765987_entourage_univ :
    q765987_entourage (fun _ : A * A => True);
  q765987_entourage_upward :
    forall U V : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage U ->
      q765987_subset U V ->
      q765987_entourage V;
  q765987_entourage_inter :
    forall U V : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage U ->
      q765987_entourage V ->
      q765987_entourage
        (fun p : A * A => U p /\ V p);
  q765987_entourage_diagonal :
    forall U : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage U ->
      forall x : A, U (x, x);
  q765987_entourage_inverse :
    forall U : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage U ->
      q765987_entourage (q765987_inverse U);
  q765987_entourage_square :
    forall U : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage U ->
      exists V : q765987_set (A * A),
        q765987_entourage V /\
        q765987_subset (q765987_rel_comp V V) U
}.

Arguments q765987_entourage {A} _ _.

Definition q765987_is_open
    {A : Type}
    (U : q765987_uniform_space A)
    (O : q765987_set A) : Prop :=
  forall x : A,
    O x ->
    exists V : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage U V /\
      forall y : A, V (x, y) -> O y.

Definition q765987_compact_space
    {A : Type}
    (U : q765987_uniform_space A) : Prop :=
  forall cover : q765987_set (q765987_set A),
    (forall O : q765987_set A,
      cover O -> q765987_is_open U O) ->
    (forall x : A,
      exists O : q765987_set A, cover O /\ O x) ->
    exists finite_cover : list (q765987_set A),
      Forall cover finite_cover /\
      forall x : A,
        exists O : q765987_set A,
          In O finite_cover /\ O x.

Definition q765987_continuous
    {A B : Type}
    (UA : q765987_uniform_space A)
    (UB : q765987_uniform_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall O : q765987_set B,
    q765987_is_open UB O ->
    q765987_is_open UA (fun x : A => O (f x)).

Definition q765987_uniform_continuous
    {A B : Type}
    (UA : q765987_uniform_space A)
    (UB : q765987_uniform_space B)
    (f : A -> B) : Prop :=
  forall V : q765987_set (B * B),
    q765987_entourage UB V ->
    exists U : q765987_set (A * A),
      q765987_entourage UA U /\
      forall x y : A,
        U (x, y) -> V (f x, f y).

Theorem CompactSpace_uniformContinuous_of_continuous :
  forall (Alpha Beta : Type)
         (UA : q765987_uniform_space Alpha)
         (UB : q765987_uniform_space Beta)
         (f : Alpha -> Beta),
    q765987_compact_space UA ->
    q765987_continuous UA UB f ->
    q765987_uniform_continuous UA UB f.
Admitted.

title: Q765987_heine_cantor_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q765987,
  "Heine–Cantor theorem": every continuous map from a compact uniform space
  to an arbitrary uniform space is uniformly continuous. This file contains
  no proof.
*)

let Q765987_HEINE_CANTOR_THEOREM =
  `let carrier_pairs_a =
     \(carrier:A->bool).
       {p:A#A | FST p IN carrier /\ SND p IN carrier} in
   let carrier_pairs_b =
     \(carrier:B->bool).
       {p:B#B | FST p IN carrier /\ SND p IN carrier} in
   let is_filter_a =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (u:((A#A)->bool)->bool).
       u (carrier_pairs_a carrier) /\
       (!r:(A#A)->bool.
          u r ==> r SUBSET carrier_pairs_a carrier) /\
       (!r s:(A#A)->bool.
          u r /\ r SUBSET s /\ s SUBSET carrier_pairs_a carrier
          ==> u s) /\
       (!r s:(A#A)->bool.
          u r /\ u s ==> u (r INTER s)) in
   let is_filter_b =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (u:((B#B)->bool)->bool).
       u (carrier_pairs_b carrier) /\
       (!r:(B#B)->bool.
          u r ==> r SUBSET carrier_pairs_b carrier) /\
       (!r s:(B#B)->bool.
          u r /\ r SUBSET s /\ s SUBSET carrier_pairs_b carrier
          ==> u s) /\
       (!r s:(B#B)->bool.
          u r /\ u s ==> u (r INTER s)) in
   let is_uniformity_a =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (u:((A#A)->bool)->bool).
       is_filter_a carrier u /\
       (!r:(A#A)->bool.
          u r ==> !x:A. x IN carrier ==> r (x,x)) /\
       (!r:(A#A)->bool.
          u r
          ==> u {p:A#A |
                   p IN carrier_pairs_a carrier /\
                   r (SND p,FST p)}) /\
       (!r:(A#A)->bool.
          u r
          ==> ?s:(A#A)->bool.
                u s /\
                !x y z:A.
                  x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier /\
                  s (x,y) /\ s (y,z)
                  ==> r (x,z)) in
   let is_uniformity_b =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (u:((B#B)->bool)->bool).
       is_filter_b carrier u /\
       (!r:(B#B)->bool.
          u r ==> !x:B. x IN carrier ==> r (x,x)) /\
       (!r:(B#B)->bool.
          u r
          ==> u {p:B#B |
                   p IN carrier_pairs_b carrier /\
                   r (SND p,FST p)}) /\
       (!r:(B#B)->bool.
          u r
          ==> ?s:(B#B)->bool.
                u s /\
                !x y z:B.
                  x IN carrier /\ y IN carrier /\ z IN carrier /\
                  s (x,y) /\ s (y,z)
                  ==> r (x,z)) in
   let uniform_open_a =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (u:((A#A)->bool)->bool) (v:A->bool).
       v SUBSET carrier /\
       !x:A.
         x IN v
         ==> ?r:(A#A)->bool.
               u r /\
               !y:A.
                 y IN carrier /\ r (x,y)
                 ==> y IN v in
   let uniform_open_b =
     \(carrier:B->bool) (u:((B#B)->bool)->bool) (v:B->bool).
       v SUBSET carrier /\
       !x:B.
         x IN v
         ==> ?r:(B#B)->bool.
               u r /\
               !y:B.
                 y IN carrier /\ r (x,y)
                 ==> y IN v in
   let compact_uniform_space =
     \(carrier:A->bool) (u:((A#A)->bool)->bool).
       !cover:(A->bool)->bool.
         (!v:A->bool.
            v IN cover ==> uniform_open_a carrier u v) /\
         carrier SUBSET UNIONS cover
         ==> ?finite_cover:(A->bool)->bool.
               finite_cover SUBSET cover /\
               FINITE finite_cover /\
               carrier SUBSET UNIONS finite_cover in
   let continuous_between_uniform_spaces =
     \(carrier_a:A->bool) (carrier_b:B->bool)
      (u_a:((A#A)->bool)->bool)
      (u_b:((B#B)->bool)->bool) (f:A->B).
       (!x:A. x IN carrier_a ==> f x IN carrier_b) /\
       !v:B->bool.
         uniform_open_b carrier_b u_b v
         ==> uniform_open_a carrier_a u_a
               {x:A | x IN carrier_a /\ f x IN v} in
   let uniformly_continuous_between_uniform_spaces =
     \(carrier_a:A->bool) (carrier_b:B->bool)
      (u_a:((A#A)->bool)->bool)
      (u_b:((B#B)->bool)->bool) (f:A->B).
       (!x:A. x IN carrier_a ==> f x IN carrier_b) /\
       !r:(B#B)->bool.
         u_b r
         ==> u_a
               {p:A#A |
                  p IN carrier_pairs_a carrier_a /\
                  r (f (FST p),f (SND p))} in
   !carrier_a:A->bool.
   !carrier_b:B->bool.
   !u_a:((A#A)->bool)->bool.
   !u_b:((B#B)->bool)->bool.
   !f:A->B.
     is_uniformity_a carrier_a u_a /\
     is_uniformity_b carrier_b u_b /\
     compact_uniform_space carrier_a u_a /\
     continuous_between_uniform_spaces
       carrier_a carrier_b u_a u_b f
     ==> uniformly_continuous_between_uniform_spaces
           carrier_a carrier_b u_a u_b f`;;

title: Q765987_heine_cantor_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q765987,
;; "Heine–Cantor theorem": every continuous map from a compact uniform space
;; to an arbitrary uniform space is uniformly continuous. This file contains
;; no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Arbitrary carriers, entourage bases, subsets, open covers, and functions
;; are represented by conservative fixed-arity interfaces.  The uniform-space
;; axioms below are the standard entourage-basis axioms.  The induced topology
;; is defined by entourage neighborhoods, and compactness uses unrestricted
;; open covers with internally quantified finite subcovers.

(defstub q765987-carrier-p (space value) t)
(defstub q765987-entourage-p (space entourage) t)
(defstub q765987-entourage-member-p
    (space entourage left right) t)
(defstub q765987-set-member-p (space set value) t)
(defstub q765987-family-member-p (space family set) t)
(defstub q765987-function-value (function argument) t)

;; Entourage bases for arbitrary uniform spaces.

(defun-sk q765987-entourage-subset-p
    (space left right)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-carrier-p space x)
      (q765987-carrier-p space y)
      (q765987-entourage-member-p space left x y))
     (q765987-entourage-member-p space right x y))))

(defun-sk q765987-entourage-exists-p (space)
  (exists (entourage)
    (q765987-entourage-p space entourage)))

(defun-sk q765987-diagonal-law-p (space)
  (forall (entourage x)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-entourage-p space entourage)
      (q765987-carrier-p space x))
     (q765987-entourage-member-p
      space entourage x x))))

(defun-sk q765987-common-refinement-exists-p
    (space left right)
  (exists (refinement)
    (and
     (q765987-entourage-p space refinement)
     (q765987-entourage-subset-p
      space refinement left)
     (q765987-entourage-subset-p
      space refinement right))))

(defun-sk q765987-directed-law-p (space)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-entourage-p space left)
      (q765987-entourage-p space right))
     (q765987-common-refinement-exists-p
      space left right))))

(defun-sk q765987-symmetric-refinement-p
    (space entourage refinement)
  (forall (x y)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-carrier-p space x)
      (q765987-carrier-p space y)
      (q765987-entourage-member-p
       space refinement x y))
     (q765987-entourage-member-p
      space entourage y x))))

(defun-sk q765987-symmetric-refinement-exists-p
    (space entourage)
  (exists (refinement)
    (and
     (q765987-entourage-p space refinement)
     (q765987-symmetric-refinement-p
      space entourage refinement))))

(defun-sk q765987-symmetry-law-p (space)
  (forall (entourage)
    (implies
     (q765987-entourage-p space entourage)
     (q765987-symmetric-refinement-exists-p
      space entourage))))

(defun-sk q765987-square-refinement-p
    (space entourage refinement)
  (forall (x y z)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-carrier-p space x)
      (q765987-carrier-p space y)
      (q765987-carrier-p space z)
      (q765987-entourage-member-p
       space refinement x y)
      (q765987-entourage-member-p
       space refinement y z))
     (q765987-entourage-member-p
      space entourage x z))))

(defun-sk q765987-square-refinement-exists-p
    (space entourage)
  (exists (refinement)
    (and
     (q765987-entourage-p space refinement)
     (q765987-square-refinement-p
      space entourage refinement))))

(defun-sk q765987-square-law-p (space)
  (forall (entourage)
    (implies
     (q765987-entourage-p space entourage)
     (q765987-square-refinement-exists-p
      space entourage))))

(defun q765987-uniform-space-p (space)
  (and
   (q765987-entourage-exists-p space)
   (q765987-diagonal-law-p space)
   (q765987-directed-law-p space)
   (q765987-symmetry-law-p space)
   (q765987-square-law-p space)))

;; The topology induced by an entourage basis.

(defun-sk q765987-valid-set-p (space set)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q765987-set-member-p space set x)
     (q765987-carrier-p space x))))

(defun-sk q765987-entourage-ball-subset-p
    (space entourage center set)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-carrier-p space point)
      (q765987-entourage-member-p
       space entourage center point))
     (q765987-set-member-p space set point))))

(defun-sk q765987-open-neighborhood-exists-p
    (space set center)
  (exists (entourage)
    (and
     (q765987-entourage-p space entourage)
     (q765987-entourage-ball-subset-p
      space entourage center set))))

(defun-sk q765987-open-law-p (space set)
  (forall (center)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-carrier-p space center)
      (q765987-set-member-p space set center))
     (q765987-open-neighborhood-exists-p
      space set center))))

(defun q765987-open-set-p (space set)
  (and
   (q765987-valid-set-p space set)
   (q765987-open-law-p space set)))

;; Extensional open covers and finite subcovers.

(defun-sk q765987-set-equiv-p
    (space left right)
  (forall (x)
    (implies
     (q765987-carrier-p space x)
     (iff
      (q765987-set-member-p space left x)
      (q765987-set-member-p space right x)))))

(defun-sk q765987-family-extensional-p
    (space family)
  (forall (left right)
    (implies
     (and
      (q765987-valid-set-p space left)
      (q765987-valid-set-p space right)
      (q765987-set-equiv-p space left right))
     (iff
      (q765987-family-member-p
       space family left)
      (q765987-family-member-p
       space family right)))))

(defun-sk q765987-family-members-valid-p
    (space family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q765987-family-member-p space family set)
     (q765987-valid-set-p space set))))

(defun q765987-family-of-sets-p
    (space family)
  (and
   (q765987-family-extensional-p space family)
   (q765987-family-members-valid-p space family)))

(defun-sk q765987-family-members-open-p
    (space family)
  (forall (set)
    (implies
     (q765987-family-member-p space family set)
     (q765987-open-set-p space set))))

(defun-sk q765987-cover-point-p
    (space family point)
  (exists (set)
    (and
     (q765987-family-member-p space family set)
     (q765987-set-member-p space set point))))

(defun-sk q765987-cover-p (space family)
  (forall (point)
    (implies
     (q765987-carrier-p space point)
     (q765987-cover-point-p
      space family point))))

(defun q765987-finite-subcover-elements-p
    (sets space family)
  (if (consp sets)
      (and
       (q765987-valid-set-p space (car sets))
       (q765987-family-member-p
        space family (car sets))
       (q765987-finite-subcover-elements-p
        (cdr sets) space family))
    (equal sets nil)))

(defun q765987-finite-subcover-point-p
    (sets space point)
