title: Q765987_heine_cantor_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q765987,
-- "Heine–Cantor theorem": every continuous function from a compact uniform
-- space to a uniform space is uniformly continuous. This file contains no
-- proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q765987_heine_cantor_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; Setω; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

record Top {a : Level} : Set a where
  constructor top

record Both
  {a b : Level}
  (A : Set a)
  (B : Set b) :
  Set (a ⊔ b) where

  constructor both
  field
    first  : A
    second : B

data Member
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (x : A) :
  List A ->
  Set a where

  at-head :
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x (x ∷ xs)

  in-tail :
    {y : A} ->
    {xs : List A} ->
    Member x xs ->
    Member x (y ∷ xs)

Predicate :
  {a q : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
Predicate {a} {q} X =
  X -> Set (a ⊔ q)

Relation :
  {a q : Level} ->
  Set a ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
Relation {a} {q} X =
  X -> X -> Set (a ⊔ q)

PredicateSubset :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Predicate {q = q} X ->
  Predicate {q = q} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
PredicateSubset {X = X} U V =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  V x

RelationSubset :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Set (a ⊔ q)
RelationSubset {X = X} U V =
  (x y : X) ->
  U x y ->
  V x y

WholeRelation :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Relation {q = q} X
WholeRelation _ _ =
  Top

IntersectionRelation :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Relation {q = q} X
IntersectionRelation U V x y =
  Both (U x y) (V x y)

Converse :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Relation {q = q} X
Converse U x y =
  U y x

Compose :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Relation {q = q} X ->
  Relation {q = q} X
Compose {X = X} U V x z =
  Σ X
    (λ y ->
      Both (U x y) (V y z))

record UniformSpace
  {a q : Level}
  (X : Set a) :
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q)) where

  field
    entourage :
      Relation {q = q} X ->
      Set (a ⊔ q)

    entourage-whole :
      entourage
        (WholeRelation {a = a} {q = q} {X = X})

    entourage-upward :
      (U V : Relation {q = q} X) ->
      entourage U ->
      RelationSubset {a = a} {q = q} {X = X} U V ->
      entourage V

    entourage-intersection :
      (U V : Relation {q = q} X) ->
      entourage U ->
      entourage V ->
      entourage
        (IntersectionRelation {a = a} {q = q} {X = X} U V)

    entourage-diagonal :
      (U : Relation {q = q} X) ->
      entourage U ->
      (x : X) ->
      U x x

    entourage-converse :
      (U : Relation {q = q} X) ->
      entourage U ->
      entourage
        (Converse {a = a} {q = q} {X = X} U)

    entourage-square-root :
      (U : Relation {q = q} X) ->
      entourage U ->
      Σ (Relation {q = q} X)
        (λ V ->
          Both
            (entourage V)
            (RelationSubset
              {a = a} {q = q} {X = X}
              (Compose {a = a} {q = q} {X = X} V V)
              U))

open UniformSpace

Neighborhood :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  UniformSpace {q = q} X ->
  X ->
  Predicate {q = q} X ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
Neighborhood {a = a} {q = q} {X = X} uniformity x U =
  Σ (Relation {q = q} X)
    (λ V ->
      Both
        (entourage
          {a = a} {q = q} {X = X}
          uniformity V)
        ((y : X) ->
          V x y ->
          U y))

IsOpen :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  UniformSpace {q = q} X ->
  Predicate {q = q} X ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ q))
IsOpen {X = X} uniformity U =
  (x : X) ->
  U x ->
  Neighborhood uniformity x U

CoversWhole :
  {a q i : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  (I -> Predicate {q = q} X) ->
  Set (a ⊔ q ⊔ i)
CoversWhole {X = X} {I = I} sets =
  (x : X) ->
  Σ I
    (λ i ->
      sets i x)

FiniteSubcover :
  {a q i : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  (I -> Predicate {q = q} X) ->
  Set (a ⊔ q ⊔ i)
FiniteSubcover {X = X} {I = I} sets =
  Σ (List I)
    (λ selected ->
      (x : X) ->
      Σ I
        (λ i ->
          Both
            (Member i selected)
            (sets i x)))

CompactSpace :
  {a q : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  UniformSpace {q = q} X ->
  Setω
CompactSpace {a = a} {q = q} {X = X} uniformity =
  (i : Level) ->
  (I : Set i) ->
  (sets : I -> Predicate {a = a} {q = q} X) ->
  ((index : I) ->
    IsOpen {a = a} {q = q} {X = X}
      uniformity (sets index)) ->
  CoversWhole {a = a} {q = q} {i = i} {X = X} {I = I} sets ->
  FiniteSubcover {a = a} {q = q} {i = i} {X = X} {I = I} sets

Continuous :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {Y : Set b} ->
  UniformSpace {q = b} X ->
  UniformSpace {q = a} Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
Continuous {a = a} {b = b} {X = X} {Y = Y}
  source target function =
  (x : X) ->
  (U : Predicate {a = b} {q = a} Y) ->
  Neighborhood {a = b} {q = a} {X = Y}
    target (function x) U ->
  Neighborhood {a = a} {q = b} {X = X}
    source x
    (λ y ->
      U (function y))

UniformContinuous :
  {a b : Level} ->
  {X : Set a} ->
  {Y : Set b} ->
  UniformSpace {q = b} X ->
  UniformSpace {q = a} Y ->
  (X -> Y) ->
  Set (lsuc (a ⊔ b))
UniformContinuous {a = a} {b = b} {X = X} {Y = Y}
  source target function =
  (V : Relation {a = b} {q = a} Y) ->
  entourage {a = b} {q = a} {X = Y}
    target V ->
  entourage {a = a} {q = b} {X = X}
    source
    (λ x y ->
      V (function x) (function y))

heine-cantor-theorem : Setω
heine-cantor-theorem =
  (a b : Level) ->
  (X : Set a) ->
  (Y : Set b) ->
  (source : UniformSpace {q = b} X) ->
  (target : UniformSpace {q = a} Y) ->
  CompactSpace source ->
  (function : X -> Y) ->
  Continuous source target function ->
  UniformContinuous source target function

content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q765987, "Heine–Cantor theorem": every continuous function from a compact
  uniform space to an arbitrary uniform space is uniformly continuous. This
  file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pairTheory pred_setTheory;

val q765987_pair_carrier_def = new_definition (
  "q765987_pair_carrier_def",
  ``q765987_pair_carrier (carrier : 'a set) =
      {p : 'a # 'a | FST p IN carrier /\ SND p IN carrier}``);

val q765987_uniform_space_def = new_definition (
  "q765987_uniform_space_def",
  ``q765987_uniform_space
      (carrier : 'a set) (entourages : (('a # 'a) set) set) <=>
      q765987_pair_carrier carrier IN entourages /\
      (!u.
        u IN entourages
        ==>
        u SUBSET q765987_pair_carrier carrier) /\
      (!u v.
        u IN entourages /\ v IN entourages
        ==>
        u INTER v IN entourages) /\
      (!u v.
        u IN entourages /\
        u SUBSET v /\
        v SUBSET q765987_pair_carrier carrier
        ==>
        v IN entourages) /\
      (!u.
        u IN entourages
        ==>
        !x. x IN carrier ==> (x,x) IN u) /\
      (!u.
        u IN entourages
        ==>
        {p | (SND p,FST p) IN u} IN entourages) /\
      (!u.
        u IN entourages
        ==>
        ?v.
          v IN entourages /\
          !x z.
            x IN carrier /\
            z IN carrier /\
            (?y.
              y IN carrier /\
              (x,y) IN v /\
              (y,z) IN v)
            ==>
            (x,z) IN u)``);

val q765987_uniform_open_def = new_definition (
  "q765987_uniform_open_def",
  ``q765987_uniform_open
      (carrier : 'a set)
      (entourages : (('a # 'a) set) set)
      (s : 'a set) <=>
      s SUBSET carrier /\
      !x.
        x IN s
        ==>
        ?u.
          u IN entourages /\
          !y. (x,y) IN u ==> y IN s``);

val q765987_compact_space_def = new_definition (
  "q765987_compact_space_def",
  ``q765987_compact_space
      (carrier : 'a set)
      (entourages : (('a # 'a) set) set) <=>
      !cover : ('a set) set.
        (!s.
          s IN cover
          ==>
          q765987_uniform_open carrier entourages s) /\
        carrier SUBSET BIGUNION cover
        ==>
        ?subcover : ('a set) set.
          FINITE subcover /\
          subcover SUBSET cover /\
          carrier SUBSET BIGUNION subcover``);

val q765987_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q765987_continuous_def",
  ``q765987_continuous
      (source_carrier : 'a set)
      (source_entourages : (('a # 'a) set) set)
      (target_carrier : 'b set)
      (target_entourages : (('b # 'b) set) set)
      (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      (!x. x IN source_carrier ==> f x IN target_carrier) /\
      !s.
        q765987_uniform_open target_carrier target_entourages s
        ==>
        q765987_uniform_open source_carrier source_entourages
          {x | x IN source_carrier /\ f x IN s}``);

val q765987_uniformly_continuous_def = new_definition (
  "q765987_uniformly_continuous_def",
  ``q765987_uniformly_continuous
      (source_carrier : 'a set)
      (source_entourages : (('a # 'a) set) set)
      (target_carrier : 'b set)
      (target_entourages : (('b # 'b) set) set)
      (f : 'a -> 'b) <=>
      (!x. x IN source_carrier ==> f x IN target_carrier) /\
      !v.
        v IN target_entourages
        ==>
        {p |
          FST p IN source_carrier /\
          SND p IN source_carrier /\
          (f (FST p),f (SND p)) IN v}
        IN source_entourages``);

val CompactSpace_uniformContinuous_of_continuous =
  ``!(source_carrier : 'a set)
      (source_entourages : (('a # 'a) set) set)
      (target_carrier : 'b set)
      (target_entourages : (('b # 'b) set) set)
      (f : 'a -> 'b).
      q765987_uniform_space source_carrier source_entourages /\
      q765987_uniform_space target_carrier target_entourages /\
      q765987_compact_space source_carrier source_entourages /\
      q765987_continuous
        source_carrier source_entourages
        target_carrier target_entourages f
      ==>
      q765987_uniformly_continuous
        source_carrier source_entourages
        target_carrier target_entourages f``;

% Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems artifact Q765987,
% "Heine–Cantor theorem": every continuous function from a compact uniform
% space to an arbitrary uniform space is uniformly continuous. This file contains no proof.

heine_cantor_theorem_Q765987[
  alpha, beta: TYPE,
  alpha_carrier: [alpha -> bool],
  beta_carrier: [beta -> bool],
  alpha_entourages: [[alpha, alpha -> bool] -> bool],
  beta_entourages: [[beta, beta -> bool] -> bool]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  alpha_set: TYPE = [alpha -> bool]
  beta_set: TYPE = [beta -> bool]
  alpha_set_family: TYPE = [alpha_set -> bool]
  alpha_set_sequence: TYPE = [nat -> alpha_set]

  alpha_relation: TYPE = [alpha, alpha -> bool]
  beta_relation: TYPE = [beta, beta -> bool]
  alpha_beta_function: TYPE = [alpha -> beta]

  alpha_set_on_carrier(U: alpha_set): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha):
      U(x) IMPLIES alpha_carrier(x)

  beta_set_on_carrier(V: beta_set): bool =
    FORALL (y: beta):
      V(y) IMPLIES beta_carrier(y)

  alpha_relation_on_carrier(R: alpha_relation): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: alpha):
      R(x, y) IMPLIES
        alpha_carrier(x) AND alpha_carrier(y)

  beta_relation_on_carrier(R: beta_relation): bool =
    FORALL (x, y: beta):

  beta_relation_intersection(

  alpha_uniform_space_laws: bool =
    alpha_entourages(alpha_whole_relation)
      AND
        (FORALL (R: alpha_relation):

        (FORALL (R, S: alpha_relation):
          (alpha_entourages(R)

      AND

      AND

        (FORALL (R: alpha_relation):
          alpha_entourages(R) IMPLIES

      AND
        (FORALL (R: alpha_relation):
          alpha_entourages(R) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (S: alpha_relation):

  beta_uniform_space_laws: bool =
    beta_entourages(beta_whole_relation)
      AND
        (FORALL (R: beta_relation):
          beta_entourages(R) IMPLIES
            beta_relation_on_carrier(R))
      AND
        (FORALL (R, S: beta_relation):
          (beta_entourages(R)
            AND beta_relation_on_carrier(S)
            AND beta_relation_subset(R, S))
          IMPLIES beta_entourages(S))
      AND
        (FORALL (R, S: beta_relation):
          (beta_entourages(R) AND beta_entourages(S))
          IMPLIES
            beta_entourages(
              beta_relation_intersection(R, S)))
      AND
        (FORALL (R: beta_relation):
          beta_entourages(R) IMPLIES
            FORALL (x: beta):
              beta_carrier(x) IMPLIES R(x, x))
      AND
        (FORALL (R: beta_relation):
          beta_entourages(R) IMPLIES
            beta_entourages(beta_relation_converse(R)))
      AND
        (FORALL (R: beta_relation):
          beta_entourages(R) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (S: beta_relation):
              beta_entourages(S)
                AND beta_relation_subset(
                  beta_relation_composition(S, S),
                  R))

  alpha_open(U: alpha_set): bool =
    alpha_set_on_carrier(U)
      AND
        FORALL (x: alpha):
          alpha_carrier(x) AND U(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (R: alpha_relation):
              alpha_entourages(R)
                AND

                    alpha_carrier(y) AND R(x, y)

  beta_open(V: beta_set): bool =
    beta_set_on_carrier(V)
      AND
        FORALL (x: beta):
          beta_carrier(x) AND V(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (R: beta_relation):
              beta_entourages(R)
                AND
                  FORALL (y: beta):
                    beta_carrier(y) AND R(x, y)
                      IMPLIES V(y)

  alpha_open_cover(C: alpha_set_family): bool =
    (FORALL (U: alpha_set):
      C(U) IMPLIES alpha_open(U))
      AND
        (FORALL (x: alpha):
          alpha_carrier(x) IMPLIES
            EXISTS (U: alpha_set):
              C(U) AND U(x))

  alpha_finite_subcover(C: alpha_set_family): bool =
    EXISTS
        (count: nat),
        (chosen: alpha_set_sequence):
      (FORALL (index: nat):
        index < count IMPLIES C(chosen(index)))
        AND
          (FORALL (x: alpha):
            alpha_carrier(x) IMPLIES
              EXISTS (index: nat):
                index < count AND chosen(index)(x))

  compact_alpha_space: bool =
    FORALL (C: alpha_set_family):
      alpha_open_cover(C) IMPLIES
        alpha_finite_subcover(C)

  maps_carrier(f: alpha_beta_function): bool =
    FORALL (x: alpha):
      alpha_carrier(x) IMPLIES beta_carrier(f(x))

  beta_preimage(
      f: alpha_beta_function,
      V: beta_set): alpha_set =
    LAMBDA (x: alpha):
      alpha_carrier(x) AND V(f(x))

  continuous_map(f: alpha_beta_function): bool =
    maps_carrier(f)
      AND
        FORALL (V: beta_set):
          beta_open(V) IMPLIES
            alpha_open(beta_preimage(f, V))

  entourage_preimage(
      f: alpha_beta_function,
      R: beta_relation): alpha_relation =
    LAMBDA (x, y: alpha):
      alpha_carrier(x)
        AND alpha_carrier(y)
        AND R(f(x), f(y))

  uniform_continuous_map(f: alpha_beta_function): bool =
    maps_carrier(f)
      AND
        FORALL (R: beta_relation):
          beta_entourages(R) IMPLIES
            alpha_entourages(entourage_preimage(f, R))

  heine_cantor_theorem: bool =
    (alpha_uniform_space_laws
      AND beta_uniform_space_laws
      AND compact_alpha_space)
    IMPLIES
      FORALL (f: alpha_beta_function):
        continuous_map(f) IMPLIES uniform_continuous_map(f)
END heine_cantor_theorem_Q765987

title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q7660749
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q7660749), "Sylvester's determinant theorem":
-- over a commutative ring, det(I + AB) = det(I + BA) for rectangular matrices
-- of compatible finite dimensions. This file contains no proof.

module

import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Mul
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Sign

namespace Q7660749

open Finset

noncomputable section

variable {m n α : Type*}
variable [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
variable [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
variable [CommRing α]

/-- The determinant in its Leibniz permutation-sum form. -/
def matrixDet {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι α) : α :=
  ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤˣ) : α) * ∏ i, M (σ i) i

/-- Sylvester's determinant theorem for rectangular matrices over a commutative ring. -/
theorem sylvester_s_determinant_theorem (A : Matrix m n α) (B : Matrix n m α) :
    matrixDet (1 + A * B) = matrixDet (1 + B * A) := sorry

end
end Q7660749

title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7660749
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q7660749), "Sylvester's determinant theorem":
  over any commutative ring, rectangular matrices indexed by arbitrary finite
  types satisfy det(I + AB) = det(I + BA). This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q7660749_commutative_ring (R : Type) : Type := {
  q7660749_zero : R;
  q7660749_one : R;
  q7660749_add : R -> R -> R;
  q7660749_mul : R -> R -> R;
  q7660749_neg : R -> R;
  q7660749_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q7660749_add x (q7660749_add y z) =
      q7660749_add (q7660749_add x y) z;
  q7660749_add_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q7660749_add x y = q7660749_add y x;
  q7660749_add_zero :
    forall x : R,
      q7660749_add x q7660749_zero = x;
  q7660749_add_neg :
    forall x : R,
      q7660749_add x (q7660749_neg x) = q7660749_zero;
  q7660749_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : R,
      q7660749_mul x (q7660749_mul y z) =
      q7660749_mul (q7660749_mul x y) z;
  q7660749_mul_comm :
    forall x y : R,
      q7660749_mul x y = q7660749_mul y x;
  q7660749_mul_one :
    forall x : R,
      q7660749_mul x q7660749_one = x;
  q7660749_left_distrib :
    forall x y z : R,
      q7660749_mul x (q7660749_add y z) =
      q7660749_add
        (q7660749_mul x y)
        (q7660749_mul x z)
}.

Arguments q7660749_zero {R} _.
Arguments q7660749_one {R} _.
Arguments q7660749_add {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q7660749_mul {R} _ _ _.
Arguments q7660749_neg {R} _ _.

Record q7660749_finite_type (I : Type) : Type := {
  q7660749_enum : list I;
  q7660749_enum_nodup : NoDup q7660749_enum;
  q7660749_enum_complete :
    forall i : I, In i q7660749_enum;
  q7660749_eq_dec :
    forall i j : I, {i = j} + {i <> j}
}.

Arguments q7660749_enum {I} _.
Arguments q7660749_eq_dec {I} _ _ _.

Definition q7660749_matrix (I J R : Type) : Type :=
  I -> J -> R.

Fixpoint q7660749_sum_list {A R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (xs : list A)
    (f : A -> R) : R :=
  match xs with
  | [] => q7660749_zero ring
  | x :: rest =>
      q7660749_add ring
        (f x)
        (q7660749_sum_list ring rest f)
  end.

Definition q7660749_finite_sum {I R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q7660749_finite_type I)
    (f : I -> R) : R :=
  q7660749_sum_list ring (q7660749_enum fin) f.

Definition q7660749_identity_matrix {I R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q7660749_finite_type I) :
    q7660749_matrix I I R :=
  fun i j =>
    if q7660749_eq_dec fin i j
    then q7660749_one ring
    else q7660749_zero ring.

Definition q7660749_matrix_add {I J R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (A B : q7660749_matrix I J R) :
    q7660749_matrix I J R :=
  fun i j => q7660749_add ring (A i j) (B i j).

Definition q7660749_matrix_mul {I J K R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q7660749_finite_type J)
    (A : q7660749_matrix I J R)
    (B : q7660749_matrix J K R) :
    q7660749_matrix I K R :=
  fun i k =>
    q7660749_finite_sum ring fin
      (fun j => q7660749_mul ring (A i j) (B j k)).

Fixpoint q7660749_determinant_expansion {I R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (rows cols : list I)
    (M : q7660749_matrix I I R) {struct rows} : R :=
  match rows with
  | [] => q7660749_one ring
  | i :: remaining_rows =>
      let fix expand
          (prefix remaining_cols : list I)
          (positive : bool) {struct remaining_cols} : R :=
        match remaining_cols with
        | [] => q7660749_zero ring
        | j :: suffix =>
            let minor :=
              q7660749_determinant_expansion ring
                remaining_rows
                (rev prefix ++ suffix)
                M in
            let term := q7660749_mul ring (M i j) minor in
            q7660749_add ring
              (if positive then term else q7660749_neg ring term)
              (expand (j :: prefix) suffix (negb positive))
        end in
      expand [] cols true
  end.

Definition q7660749_determinant {I R : Type}
    (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
    (fin : q7660749_finite_type I)
    (M : q7660749_matrix I I R) : R :=
  q7660749_determinant_expansion ring
    (q7660749_enum fin)
    (q7660749_enum fin)
    M.

Theorem Matrix_det_one_add_mul_comm :
  forall (R M N : Type)
         (ring : q7660749_commutative_ring R)
         (finM : q7660749_finite_type M)
         (finN : q7660749_finite_type N)
         (A : q7660749_matrix M N R)
         (B : q7660749_matrix N M R),
    q7660749_determinant ring finM
      (q7660749_matrix_add ring
        (q7660749_identity_matrix ring finM)
        (q7660749_matrix_mul ring finN A B)) =
    q7660749_determinant ring finN
      (q7660749_matrix_add ring
        (q7660749_identity_matrix ring finN)
        (q7660749_matrix_mul ring finM B A)).
Admitted.

title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q7660749
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q7660749), "Sylvester's determinant theorem":
  over a possibly trivial unital commutative ring, det(I + AB) equals
  det(I + BA) for rectangular matrices on finite, possibly empty, index
  carriers. This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym ('a, 'i, 'j) q7660749_matrix = "'i \<Rightarrow> 'j \<Rightarrow> 'a"

definition q7660749_matrix_add ::
    "('a::comm_ring, 'i, 'j) q7660749_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'j) q7660749_matrix \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'i, 'j) q7660749_matrix" where
  "q7660749_matrix_add A B = (\<lambda>i j. A i j + B i j)"

definition q7660749_matrix_mult ::
    "'j set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a::comm_ring, 'i, 'j) q7660749_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'j, 'k) q7660749_matrix \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'i, 'k) q7660749_matrix" where
  "q7660749_matrix_mult J A B =
    (\<lambda>i k. \<Sum>j\<in>J. A i j * B j k)"

definition q7660749_identity_matrix ::
    "'a::comm_ring \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'i) q7660749_matrix" where
  "q7660749_identity_matrix u I =
    (\<lambda>i j. if i \<in> I \<and> j \<in> I \<and> i = j then u else 0)"

definition q7660749_index_list :: "'i set \<Rightarrow> 'i list" where
  "q7660749_index_list I =
    (SOME xs. distinct xs \<and> set xs = I)"

fun q7660749_determinant_list ::
    "'a::comm_ring \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'i) q7660749_matrix \<Rightarrow>
      'i list \<Rightarrow> 'i list \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q7660749_determinant_list u M [] js = u"
| "q7660749_determinant_list u M (i # is) js =
    sum_list
      (map
        (\<lambda>(k, j).
          (if even k then u else -u) * M i j *
            q7660749_determinant_list u M is (remove1 j js))
        (zip [0..<length js] js))"

definition q7660749_determinant ::
    "'a::comm_ring \<Rightarrow> 'i set \<Rightarrow>
      ('a, 'i, 'i) q7660749_matrix \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "q7660749_determinant u I M =
    q7660749_determinant_list u M
      (q7660749_index_list I) (q7660749_index_list I)"

theorem q7660749_sylvester_determinant:
  fixes u :: "'a::comm_ring"
    and I :: "'m set"
    and J :: "'n set"
    and A :: "('a, 'm, 'n) q7660749_matrix"
    and B :: "('a, 'n, 'm) q7660749_matrix"
  assumes unit: "\<And>x. u * x = x"
    and finite_I: "finite I"
    and finite_J: "finite J"
  shows
    "q7660749_determinant u I
        (q7660749_matrix_add (q7660749_identity_matrix u I)
          (q7660749_matrix_mult J A B)) =
      q7660749_determinant u J
        (q7660749_matrix_add (q7660749_identity_matrix u J)
          (q7660749_matrix_mult I B A))"
  sorry

end

title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7660749
  (thousand-theorems__hol-light__Q7660749), "Sylvester's determinant theorem":
  over any commutative ring, rectangular matrices on arbitrary finite index
  carriers satisfy det(I + A B) = det(I + B A). This file contains no proof.
*)

let q7660749_is_comm_ring = new_definition
  `q7660749_is_comm_ring (zeroR:R) (oneR:R)
      (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R) <=>
     (!x:R. addR zeroR x = x) /\
     (!x:R. addR (negR x) x = zeroR) /\
     (!x y:R. addR x y = addR y x) /\
     (!x y z:R. addR x (addR y z) = addR (addR x y) z) /\
     (!x:R. mulR oneR x = x) /\
     (!x y:R. mulR x y = mulR y x) /\
     (!x y z:R. mulR x (mulR y z) = mulR (mulR x y) z) /\
     (!x y z:R.
        mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z))`;;

let q7660749_apply_swaps = new_definition
  `q7660749_apply_swaps (swaps:(I#I)list) (x:I) =
     ITLIST
       (\ab y:I.
          if y = FST ab then SND ab
          else if y = SND ab then FST ab
          else y)
       swaps x`;;

let q7660749_even_permutation = new_definition
  `q7660749_even_permutation (s:I->bool) (p:I->I) <=>
     ?swaps:(I#I)list.
       EVEN (LENGTH swaps) /\
       ALL
         (\ab:I#I.
            FST ab IN s /\ SND ab IN s /\ ~(FST ab = SND ab))
         swaps /\
       (!i:I. i IN s ==> q7660749_apply_swaps swaps i = p i)`;;

let q7660749_sign = new_definition
  `q7660749_sign (oneR:R) (negR:R->R) (s:I->bool) (p:I->I) =
     if q7660749_even_permutation s p then oneR else negR oneR`;;

let q7660749_permutations = new_definition
  `q7660749_permutations (s:I->bool) =
     {p:I->I | BIJ p s s /\ (!i:I. ~(i IN s) ==> p i = i)}`;;

let q7660749_determinant = new_definition
  `q7660749_determinant (zeroR:R) (oneR:R)
      (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (s:I->bool) (A:I->I->R) =
     iterate addR (q7660749_permutations s)
       (\p:I->I.
          mulR (q7660749_sign oneR negR s p)
            (iterate mulR s (\i:I. A i (p i))))`;;

let q7660749_matrix_identity = new_definition
  `q7660749_matrix_identity (zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (s:I->bool) =
     \i j:I. if i IN s /\ j = i then oneR else zeroR`;;

let q7660749_matrix_add = new_definition
  `q7660749_matrix_add (addR:R->R->R)
      (A:I->J->R) (B:I->J->R) =
     \i j. addR (A i j) (B i j)`;;

let q7660749_matrix_mul = new_definition
  `q7660749_matrix_mul (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (middle:J->bool) (A:I->J->R) (B:J->K->R) =
     \i k. iterate addR middle (\j:J. mulR (A i j) (B j k))`;;

let Q7660749_SYLVESTERS_DETERMINANT_THEOREM =
  `!zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R.
   !s:M->bool.
   !t:N->bool.
   !A:M->N->R.
   !B:N->M->R.
     q7660749_is_comm_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     FINITE s /\ FINITE t
     ==>
     q7660749_determinant zeroR oneR addR mulR negR s
       (q7660749_matrix_add addR
         (q7660749_matrix_identity zeroR oneR s)
         (q7660749_matrix_mul addR mulR t A B)) =
     q7660749_determinant zeroR oneR addR mulR negR t
       (q7660749_matrix_add addR
         (q7660749_matrix_identity zeroR oneR t)
         (q7660749_matrix_mul addR mulR s B A))`;;

        (q7660749-ring-add ring y x))
       (equal
        (q7660749-ring-multiply ring x y)
        (q7660749-ring-multiply ring y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q7660749-ring-element-p ring x)
       (q7660749-ring-element-p ring y)
       (q7660749-ring-element-p ring z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q7660749-ring-add
         ring (q7660749-ring-add ring x y) z)
        (q7660749-ring-add
         ring x (q7660749-ring-add ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q7660749-ring-multiply
         ring (q7660749-ring-multiply ring x y) z)
        (q7660749-ring-multiply
         ring x (q7660749-ring-multiply ring y z)))
       (equal
        (q7660749-ring-multiply
         ring x (q7660749-ring-add ring y z))
        (q7660749-ring-add
         ring
         (q7660749-ring-multiply ring x y)
         (q7660749-ring-multiply ring x z))))))))

(defun q7660749-commutative-ring-p (ring)
  (and
   (q7660749-ring-element-p
    ring (q7660749-ring-zero ring))
   (q7660749-ring-element-p
    ring (q7660749-ring-one ring))
   (q7660749-ring-laws-p ring)))

;; A matrix over finite index types is represented, after choosing
;; enumerations of those types, by a proper list of proper rows.  The exact
;; row and column lengths and carrier membership make this representation
;; bijective with the source's finite matrix functions.

(defun q7660749-matrix-row-p (ring row column-count)
  (if (zp column-count)
      (equal row nil)
    (and
     (consp row)
     (q7660749-ring-element-p ring (car row))
     (q7660749-matrix-row-p
      ring (cdr row) (- column-count 1)))))

(defun q7660749-matrix-p
    (ring matrix row-count column-count)
  (if (zp row-count)
      (equal matrix nil)
    (and
     (consp matrix)
     (q7660749-matrix-row-p
      ring (car matrix) column-count)
     (q7660749-matrix-p
      ring (cdr matrix) (- row-count 1) column-count))))

(defun q7660749-matrix-entry (matrix row column)
  (nth column (nth row matrix)))

;; Matrix multiplication is the usual finite sum in the selected ring.

(defun q7660749-dot-product-from
    (ring left right row column index remaining)
  (if (zp remaining)
      (q7660749-ring-zero ring)
    (q7660749-ring-add
     ring
     (q7660749-ring-multiply
      ring
      (q7660749-matrix-entry left row index)
      (q7660749-matrix-entry right index column))
     (q7660749-dot-product-from
      ring left right row column
      (+ index 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q7660749-product-entry
    (ring left right row column inner-count)
  (q7660749-dot-product-from
   ring left right row column 0 inner-count))

;; Build I + LR at the square dimension determined by the row count of L.

(defun q7660749-one-add-product-row
    (ring left right inner-count row column remaining)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (let ((entry
           (q7660749-product-entry
            ring left right row column inner-count)))
      (cons
       (if (equal row column)
           (q7660749-ring-add
            ring (q7660749-ring-one ring) entry)
         entry)
       (q7660749-one-add-product-row
        ring left right inner-count row
        (+ column 1) (- remaining 1))))))

(defun q7660749-one-add-product-rows
    (ring left right dimension inner-count row remaining)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q7660749-one-add-product-row
      ring left right inner-count row 0 dimension)
     (q7660749-one-add-product-rows
      ring left right dimension inner-count
      (+ row 1) (- remaining 1)))))

(defun q7660749-one-add-product
    (ring left right dimension inner-count)
  (q7660749-one-add-product-rows
   ring left right dimension inner-count 0 dimension))

;; The determinant is the signed Leibniz sum over all permutations.

(defun q7660749-range-from (start count)
  (if (zp count)
      nil
    (cons start
          (q7660749-range-from
           (+ start 1) (- count 1)))))

(defun q7660749-prefix-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (cons
     (cons item (car lists))
     (q7660749-prefix-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun q7660749-insert-everywhere (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list (list item))
    (cons
     (cons item list)
     (q7660749-prefix-each
      (car list)
      (q7660749-insert-everywhere item (cdr list))))))

(defun q7660749-insert-into-each (item lists)
  (if (endp lists)
      nil
    (append
     (q7660749-insert-everywhere item (car lists))
     (q7660749-insert-into-each item (cdr lists)))))

(defun q7660749-permutations (list)
  (if (endp list)
      (list nil)
    (q7660749-insert-into-each
     (car list)
     (q7660749-permutations (cdr list)))))

(defun q7660749-count-greater (item list)
  (if (endp list)
      0
    (+ (if (> item (car list)) 1 0)
       (q7660749-count-greater item (cdr list)))))

(defun q7660749-inversion-count (permutation)
  (if (endp permutation)
      0
    (+ (q7660749-count-greater
        (car permutation) (cdr permutation))
       (q7660749-inversion-count (cdr permutation)))))

(defun q7660749-diagonal-product
    (ring matrix permutation row)
  (if (endp permutation)
      (q7660749-ring-one ring)
    (q7660749-ring-multiply
     ring
     (q7660749-matrix-entry
      matrix row (car permutation))
     (q7660749-diagonal-product
      ring matrix (cdr permutation) (+ row 1)))))

(defun q7660749-determinant-sum
    (ring matrix permutations)
  (if (endp permutations)
      (q7660749-ring-zero ring)
    (let* ((permutation (car permutations))
           (product
            (q7660749-diagonal-product
             ring matrix permutation 0))
           (signed-product
            (if (equal
                 (mod
                  (q7660749-inversion-count permutation)
                  2)
                 0)
                product
              (q7660749-ring-negate ring product))))
      (q7660749-ring-add
       ring
       signed-product
       (q7660749-determinant-sum
        ring matrix (cdr permutations))))))

(defun q7660749-determinant (ring matrix dimension)
  (q7660749-determinant-sum
   ring
   matrix
   (q7660749-permutations
    (q7660749-range-from 0 dimension))))

;; This universally quantified predicate is the source proposition.  Replacing
;; finite index types by their cardinalities and enumerated tables preserves
;; both matrix spaces and the determinant identity in both directions.

(defun-sk q7660749-sylvester-determinant-statement ()
  (forall (ring m n a b)
    (implies
     (and
      (natp m)
      (natp n)
      (q7660749-commutative-ring-p ring)
      (q7660749-matrix-p ring a m n)
      (q7660749-matrix-p ring b n m))
     (equal
      (q7660749-determinant
       ring
       (q7660749-one-add-product
        ring a b m n)
       m)
      (q7660749-determinant
       ring
       (q7660749-one-add-product
        ring b a n m)
       n)))))

(value-triple :itpeval-statement-checked)
:q

title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7660749,
-- "Sylvester's determinant theorem": over a commutative ring, for rectangular
-- matrices A and B indexed by arbitrary finite types, det(I + AB) equals
-- det(I + BA). This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; _⊔_; lsuc; Setω)
open import Agda.Builtin.Bool using (Bool; false; true)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality renaming (_≡_ to _==_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat; zero; suc)

data Fin : Nat -> Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} -> Fin (suc n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} -> Fin n -> Fin (suc n)

record FiniteIndex
  {i : Level}
  (I : Set i) :
  Set (lsuc i) where

  field
    size : Nat
    toFin : I -> Fin size
    fromFin : Fin size -> I
    to-from :
      (k : Fin size) ->
      toFin (fromFin k) == k
    from-to :
      (x : I) ->
      fromFin (toFin x) == x

open FiniteIndex

record RingOperations
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    zeroR oneR : R
    addR multiplyR : R -> R -> R
    negateR : R -> R

open RingOperations

record CommutativeRing
  {r : Level}
  (R : Set r) :
  Set (lsuc r) where

  field
    operations : RingOperations R

    add-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      addR operations x y == addR operations y x
    add-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      addR operations (addR operations x y) z ==
      addR operations x (addR operations y z)
    add-zero :
      (x : R) ->
      addR operations x (zeroR operations) == x
    add-inverse :
      (x : R) ->
      addR operations x (negateR operations x) ==
      zeroR operations

    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : R) ->
      multiplyR operations x y == multiplyR operations y x
    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR operations (multiplyR operations x y) z ==
      multiplyR operations x (multiplyR operations y z)
    multiply-one :
      (x : R) ->
      multiplyR operations x (oneR operations) == x
    distribute :
      (x y z : R) ->
      multiplyR operations x (addR operations y z) ==
      addR operations
        (multiplyR operations x y)
        (multiplyR operations x z)

open CommutativeRing

Matrix :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  Set i ->
  Set j ->
  Set r ->
  Set (i ⊔ j ⊔ r)
Matrix I J R =
  I -> J -> R

finEqual :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin n ->
  Bool
finEqual fzero fzero =
  true
finEqual fzero (fsuc j) =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) fzero =
  false
finEqual (fsuc i) (fsuc j) =
  finEqual i j

select :
  {a : Level} ->
  {A : Set a} ->
  Bool ->
  A ->
  A ->
  A
select true yes no =
  yes
select false yes no =
  no

sumFin :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  (Fin n -> R) ->
  R
sumFin operations {zero} term =
  zeroR operations
sumFin operations {suc n} term =
  addR operations
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin operations (λ k -> term (fsuc k)))

sumIndex :
  {i r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  RingOperations R ->
  (I -> R) ->
  R
sumIndex finite operations term =
  sumFin operations (λ k -> term (fromFin finite k))

identityMatrix :
  {i r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex I ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Matrix I I R
identityMatrix finite operations row column =
  select
    (finEqual (toFin finite row) (toFin finite column))
    (oneR operations)
    (zeroR operations)

matrixAdd :
  {i j r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R ->
  Matrix I J R
matrixAdd operations A B row column =
  addR operations (A row column) (B row column)

matrixMultiply :
  {i j k r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {J : Set j} ->
  {K : Set k} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  FiniteIndex K ->
  RingOperations R ->
  Matrix I K R ->
  Matrix K J R ->
  Matrix I J R
matrixMultiply finite operations A B row column =
  sumIndex finite operations
    (λ middle ->
      multiplyR operations
        (A row middle)
        (B middle column))

reindexSquare :
  {i r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) ->
  Matrix I I R ->
  Matrix (Fin (size finite)) (Fin (size finite)) R
reindexSquare finite A row column =
  A (fromFin finite row) (fromFin finite column)

skip :
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Fin n ->
  Fin (suc n)
skip {zero} column ()
skip {suc n} fzero k =
  fsuc k
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) fzero =
  fzero
skip {suc n} (fsuc column) (fsuc k) =
  fsuc (skip column k)

firstRowMinor :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix (Fin (suc n)) (Fin (suc n)) R ->
  Fin (suc n) ->
  Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R
firstRowMinor A column row minor-column =
  A (fsuc row) (skip column minor-column)

alternatingSign :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Fin n ->
  R
alternatingSign operations fzero =
  oneR operations
alternatingSign operations (fsuc i) =
  negateR operations (alternatingSign operations i)

determinantFin :
  {r : Level} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  {n : Nat} ->
  Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R ->
  R
determinantFin operations {zero} A =
  oneR operations
determinantFin operations {suc n} A =
  sumFin operations
    (λ column ->
      multiplyR operations
        (alternatingSign operations column)
        (multiplyR operations
          (A fzero column)
          (determinantFin operations
            (firstRowMinor A column))))

determinant :
  {i r : Level} ->
  {I : Set i} ->
  {R : Set r} ->
  RingOperations R ->
  (finite : FiniteIndex I) ->
  Matrix I I R ->
  R
determinant operations finite A =
  determinantFin operations (reindexSquare finite A)

sylvesters-determinant-theorem : Setω
sylvesters-determinant-theorem =
  {m n r : Level} ->
  (M : Set m) ->
  (finiteM : FiniteIndex M) ->
  (N : Set n) ->
  (finiteN : FiniteIndex N) ->
  (R : Set r) ->
  (ring : CommutativeRing R) ->
  (A : Matrix M N R) ->
  (B : Matrix N M R) ->
  determinant (operations ring) finiteM
    (matrixAdd (operations ring)
      (identityMatrix finiteM (operations ring))
      (matrixMultiply finiteN (operations ring) A B))
  ==
  determinant (operations ring) finiteN
    (matrixAdd (operations ring)
      (identityMatrix finiteN (operations ring))
      (matrixMultiply finiteM (operations ring) B A))

title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q7660749, "Sylvester's determinant theorem": over an arbitrary commutative
  ring, det(I + AB) = det(I + BA) for rectangular matrices with finite row
  and column index carriers. This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open pred_setTheory permutesTheory ringTheory;

val Matrix_det_one_add_mul_comm =
  ``let matrix_det_m =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'm set) (M : 'm -> 'm -> 'a).
        ITSET
          (\p acc.
            r.sum.op
              (let diagonal_product =
                 ITSET
                   (\i product. r.prod.op (M i (p i)) product)
                   s r.prod.id
               in
                 if evenperm p then diagonal_product
                 else r.sum.inv diagonal_product)
              acc)
          {p : 'm -> 'm | p permutes s} r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_det_n =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'n set) (M : 'n -> 'n -> 'a).
        ITSET
          (\p acc.
            r.sum.op
              (let diagonal_product =
                 ITSET
                   (\i product. r.prod.op (M i (p i)) product)
                   s r.prod.id
               in
                 if evenperm p then diagonal_product
                 else r.sum.inv diagonal_product)
              acc)
          {p : 'n -> 'n | p permutes s} r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_one_m =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'm set) (i : 'm) (j : 'm).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i = j then r.prod.id else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_one_n =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'n set) (i : 'n) (j : 'n).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i = j then r.prod.id else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_add_m =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'm set)
       (M : 'm -> 'm -> 'a) (N : 'm -> 'm -> 'a)
       (i : 'm) (j : 'm).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s
        then r.sum.op (M i j) (N i j)
        else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_add_n =
      \(r : 'a ring) (s : 'n set)
       (M : 'n -> 'n -> 'a) (N : 'n -> 'n -> 'a)
       (i : 'n) (j : 'n).
        if i IN s /\ j IN s
        then r.sum.op (M i j) (N i j)
        else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_mul_ab =
      \(r : 'a ring) (rows : 'm set) (inner : 'n set)
       (cols : 'm set)
       (M : 'm -> 'n -> 'a) (N : 'n -> 'm -> 'a)
       (i : 'm) (k : 'm).
        if i IN rows /\ k IN cols
        then
          ITSET
            (\j acc. r.sum.op (r.prod.op (M i j) (N j k)) acc)
            inner r.sum.id
        else r.sum.id
    in
    let matrix_mul_ba =
      \(r : 'a ring) (rows : 'n set) (inner : 'm set)
       (cols : 'n set)
       (M : 'n -> 'm -> 'a) (N : 'm -> 'n -> 'a)
       (i : 'n) (k : 'n).
        if i IN rows /\ k IN cols
        then
          ITSET
            (\j acc. r.sum.op (r.prod.op (M i j) (N j k)) acc)
            inner r.sum.id
        else r.sum.id
    in
      !(r : 'a ring) (s : 'm set) (t : 'n set)
       (A : 'm -> 'n -> 'a) (B : 'n -> 'm -> 'a).
        Ring r /\
        FINITE s /\
        FINITE t /\
        (!i j. i IN s /\ j IN t ==> A i j IN r.carrier) /\
        (!j i. j IN t /\ i IN s ==> B j i IN r.carrier)
        ==>
        matrix_det_m r s
          (matrix_add_m r s (matrix_one_m r s)
            (matrix_mul_ab r s t s A B)) =
        matrix_det_n r t
          (matrix_add_n r t (matrix_one_n r t)
            (matrix_mul_ba r t s t B A))``;

$(
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q7660749
  (thousand-theorems__metamath__Q7660749), "Sylvester's determinant theorem":
  over every commutative ring and arbitrary finite row and column carriers,
  the determinants of I + AB and I + BA are equal for compatible rectangular
  matrices A and B. This file contains no proof.
$)

$[ lib/set.mm $]

$(
  For a commutative ring R and finite sets M and N, the function spaces over
  ( Base ` R ) indexed by M X. N and N X. M are the full rectangular matrix
  spaces. The maMul operations form the square products AB and BA, while Mat,
  1r, +g, and maDet provide the corresponding square matrix rings, identity
  matrices, addition, and determinants.

  The following $a is the single unproved corpus statement. This artifact
  adds no $p assertion.
$)

${
  $d A B M N R $.

  thousand-theorems-q7660749-sylvester-determinant-theorem $a |-
    A. R e. CRing
      A. M e. Fin
        A. N e. Fin
          A. A e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( M X. N ) )
            A. B e. ( ( Base ` R ) ^m ( N X. M ) )
              (
                ( ( M maDet R )
                  `
                  (
                    ( 1r ` ( M Mat R ) )
                    ( +g ` ( M Mat R ) )
                    ( A ( R maMul <. M , N , M >. ) B )
                  )
                )
                =
                ( ( N maDet R )
                  `
                  (
                    ( 1r ` ( N Mat R ) )
                    ( +g ` ( N Mat R ) )
                    ( B ( R maMul <. N , M , N >. ) A )
                  )
                )
              )
  $.
$}

      PARTFUN1, RELAT_1, STIRL2_1, STRUCT_0, TARSKI, VECTSP_4, VECTSP_5,
      VECTSP_6, VECTSP_7, VECTSP_9, VECTSP10, XBOOLE_0, XBOOLE_1, XREAL_1,
      XXREAL_0, MOD_2, RANKNULL, MONOID_0, GROUP_4, SYSREL, SUBSET_1,
      FINSEQ_5,
      ALGSEQ_1, POLYNOM4, POLYNOM5, HILBASIS, MATRIXJ1, MATRLIN2, VALUED_0,
      NAT_D, RLVECT_2, MATRIX_1, FINSEQ_4, RING_1;
 schemes NAT_1, FUNCT_2;

begin

::$P-
theorem
  for m,n being Nat
  for R being commutative Ring
  for A being Matrix of m,n,R
  for B being Matrix of n,m,R
  for C being Matrix of m,R
  for D being Matrix of n,R
  for E being Matrix of m,R
  for F being Matrix of n,R st
    (for i,j being Nat st [i,j] in Indices C holds
      ex p being FinSequence of R st
        len p = n &
        (for k being Nat st k in Seg n holds
          p.k = (A*(i,k)) * (B*(k,j))) &
        C*(i,j) = Sum p) &
    (for i,j being Nat st [i,j] in Indices D holds
      ex p being FinSequence of R st
        len p = m &
        (for k being Nat st k in Seg m holds
          p.k = (B*(i,k)) * (A*(k,j))) &
        D*(i,j) = Sum p) &
    E = 1.(R,m) + C &
    F = 1.(R,n) + D
  holds
    Det E = Det F
proof
end;
