title: Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem
content:
% Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q7660749,
% "Sylvester's determinant theorem": over an arbitrary commutative ring, the
% determinants of I + A B and I + B A are equal for rectangular matrices
% indexed by arbitrary finite types. This file contains no proof.

Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem[
  M, N: TYPE,
  R: TYPE+,
  zero, one: R,
  neg: [R -> R],
  add, mul: [R, R -> R]
]: THEORY
BEGIN
  IMPORTING finite_sets[M], finite_sets[N]

  matrix: TYPE = [nat, nat -> R]
  matrix_mn: TYPE = [M, N -> R]
  matrix_nm: TYPE = [N, M -> R]

  commutative_ring_laws: bool =
    (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
      add(add(x, y), z) = add(x, add(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        add(x, y) = add(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(zero, x) = x
          AND add(x, zero) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        add(neg(x), x) = zero
          AND add(x, neg(x)) = zero)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(mul(x, y), z) = mul(x, mul(y, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y: R):
        mul(x, y) = mul(y, x))
      AND (FORALL (x: R):
        mul(one, x) = x
          AND mul(x, one) = x)
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(x, add(y, z)) =
          add(mul(x, y), mul(x, z)))
      AND (FORALL (x, y, z: R):
        mul(add(x, y), z) =
          add(mul(x, z), mul(y, z)))

  ring_sum(values: [nat -> R], count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      add(
        ring_sum(values, count - 1),
        values(count - 1))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  quotient_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      0
    ELSE
      1
        + quotient_aux(
            numerator - denominator,
            denominator,
            fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  remainder_aux(
      numerator, denominator, fuel: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF fuel = 0
        OR denominator = 0
        OR numerator < denominator THEN
      numerator
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator - denominator,
        denominator,
        fuel - 1)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE fuel

  safe_ndiv(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    quotient_aux(
      numerator,
      denominator,
      numerator + 1)

  safe_mod(numerator, denominator: nat): nat =
    IF denominator = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      remainder_aux(
        numerator,
        denominator,
        numerator + 1)
    ENDIF

  function_code_count(dimension: nat): nat =
    IF dimension = 0 THEN
      1
    ELSE
      dimension ^ dimension
    ENDIF

  permutation_entry(
      dimension, code, row: nat): nat =
    IF dimension = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      safe_mod(
        safe_ndiv(code, dimension ^ row),
        dimension)
    ENDIF

  permutation_code(dimension, code: nat): bool =
    code < function_code_count(dimension)
      AND (FORALL (row_1, row_2: nat):
        (row_1 < dimension
          AND row_2 < dimension
          AND permutation_entry(dimension, code, row_1)
            = permutation_entry(dimension, code, row_2))
        IMPLIES row_1 = row_2)

  pair_row(dimension, pair: nat): nat =
    safe_ndiv(pair, dimension)

  pair_column(dimension, pair: nat): nat =
    safe_mod(pair, dimension)

  inversion_at(
      dimension, code, pair: nat): bool =
    pair_row(dimension, pair) < dimension
      AND pair_column(dimension, pair) < dimension
      AND pair_row(dimension, pair)
        < pair_column(dimension, pair)
      AND permutation_entry(
            dimension,
            code,
            pair_row(dimension, pair))
        > permutation_entry(
            dimension,
            code,
            pair_column(dimension, pair))

  count_true(
      property: [nat -> bool],
      count: nat): RECURSIVE nat =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      0
    ELSE
      count_true(property, count - 1)
        + IF property(count - 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 ENDIF
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  inversion_count(dimension, code: nat): nat =
    count_true(
      (LAMBDA (pair: nat):
        inversion_at(dimension, code, pair)),
      dimension * dimension)

  permutation_sign(dimension, code: nat): R =
    IF mod(inversion_count(dimension, code), 2) = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      neg(one)
    ENDIF

  permutation_product(
      A: matrix,
      dimension, code, count: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF count = 0 THEN
      one
    ELSE
      mul(
        permutation_product(
          A,
          dimension,
          code,
          count - 1),
        A(
          count - 1,
          permutation_entry(
            dimension,
            code,
            count - 1)))
    ENDIF
  MEASURE count

  determinant_sum(
      A: matrix,
      dimension, limit: nat): RECURSIVE R =
    IF limit = 0 THEN
      zero
    ELSE
      LET code: nat = limit - 1 IN
        add(
          determinant_sum(A, dimension, limit - 1),
          IF permutation_code(dimension, code) THEN
            mul(
              permutation_sign(dimension, code),
              permutation_product(
                A,
                dimension,
                code,
                dimension))
          ELSE
            zero
          ENDIF)
    ENDIF
  MEASURE limit

  determinant(A: matrix, dimension: nat): R =
    determinant_sum(
      A,
      dimension,
      function_code_count(dimension))

  identity_matrix(dimension: nat): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < dimension
          AND column < dimension
          AND row = column THEN
        one
      ELSE
        zero
      ENDIF)

  matrix_add(A, B: matrix): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      add(A(row, column), B(row, column)))

  matrix_multiply(
      A, B: matrix,
      inner_dimension: nat): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      ring_sum(
        (LAMBDA (index: nat):
          mul(A(row, index), B(index, column))),
        inner_dimension))

  encode_mn(
      A: matrix_mn,
      m_count, n_count: nat,
      m_enumeration: [below(m_count) -> M],
      n_enumeration: [below(n_count) -> N]): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < m_count AND column < n_count THEN
        A(
          m_enumeration(row),
          n_enumeration(column))
      ELSE
        zero
      ENDIF)

  encode_nm(
      B: matrix_nm,
      m_count, n_count: nat,
      m_enumeration: [below(m_count) -> M],
      n_enumeration: [below(n_count) -> N]): matrix =
    (LAMBDA (row, column: nat):
      IF row < n_count AND column < m_count THEN
        B(
          n_enumeration(row),
          m_enumeration(column))
      ELSE
        zero
      ENDIF)

  sylvester_determinant_theorem: bool =
    (is_finite_type[M]
      AND is_finite_type[N]
      AND commutative_ring_laws)
    IMPLIES
      (FORALL (A: matrix_mn), (B: matrix_nm):
        FORALL (m_count, n_count: nat):
          FORALL
            (m_enumeration: [below(m_count) -> M]),
            (n_enumeration: [below(n_count) -> N]):
              (bijective?(m_enumeration)
                AND bijective?(n_enumeration))
              IMPLIES
                determinant(
                  matrix_add(
                    identity_matrix(m_count),
                    matrix_multiply(
                      encode_mn(
                        A,
                        m_count,
                        n_count,
                        m_enumeration,
                        n_enumeration),
                      encode_nm(
                        B,
                        m_count,
                        n_count,
                        m_enumeration,
                        n_enumeration),
                      n_count)),
                  m_count)
                = determinant(
                    matrix_add(
                      identity_matrix(n_count),
                      matrix_multiply(
                        encode_nm(
                          B,
                          m_count,
                          n_count,
                          m_enumeration,
                          n_enumeration),
                        encode_mn(
                          A,
                          m_count,
                          n_count,
                          m_enumeration,
                          n_enumeration),
                        m_count)),
                    n_count))
END Q7660749_sylvester_s_determinant_theorem

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems artifact Q776578
-- (thousand-theorems__lean4__Q776578), "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": a semisimple
-- algebra is algebra-equivalent to a finite product of matrix algebras over
-- division algebras. This file contains no proof.

module

public import Mathlib.RingTheory.SimpleModule.Isotypic
public import Mathlib.RingTheory.SimpleRing.Matrix

@[expose] public section

namespace Q776578

universe u

/-- The algebra form of the Artin–Wedderburn theorem for a semisimple ring. -/
theorem exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing_statement
    (R₀ : Type*) (R : Type u) [CommSemiring R₀] [Ring R] [Algebra R₀ R]
    [IsSemisimpleRing R] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (D : Fin n → Type u) (d : Fin n → ℕ) (_ : ∀ i, DivisionRing (D i))
      (_ : ∀ i, Algebra R₀ (D i)), (∀ i, NeZero (d i)) ∧
      Nonempty (R ≃ₐ[R₀] Π i, Matrix (Fin (d i)) (Fin (d i)) (D i)) := sorry

end Q776578

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q776578
  (thousand-theorems__rocq__Q776578), "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": a
  semisimple algebra over a commutative semiring is algebra-equivalent to a
  finite product of nonzero-size square matrix algebras over division
  algebras. This file contains no proof.
*)

From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.

Set Universe Polymorphism.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Record q776578_comm_semiring (A : Type) : Type := {
  q776578_czero : A;
  q776578_cone : A;
  q776578_cadd : A -> A -> A;
  q776578_cmul : A -> A -> A;
  q776578_cadd_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_cadd x (q776578_cadd y z) =
      q776578_cadd (q776578_cadd x y) z;
  q776578_cadd_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q776578_cadd x y = q776578_cadd y x;
  q776578_czero_add :
    forall x : A, q776578_cadd q776578_czero x = x;
  q776578_cadd_zero :
    forall x : A, q776578_cadd x q776578_czero = x;
  q776578_cmul_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_cmul x (q776578_cmul y z) =
      q776578_cmul (q776578_cmul x y) z;
  q776578_cmul_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q776578_cmul x y = q776578_cmul y x;
  q776578_cone_mul :
    forall x : A, q776578_cmul q776578_cone x = x;
  q776578_cmul_add :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_cmul x (q776578_cadd y z) =
      q776578_cadd
        (q776578_cmul x y)
        (q776578_cmul x z);
  q776578_cadd_mul :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_cmul (q776578_cadd x y) z =
      q776578_cadd
        (q776578_cmul x z)
        (q776578_cmul y z);
  q776578_czero_mul :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_cmul q776578_czero x = q776578_czero;
  q776578_cmul_zero :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_cmul x q776578_czero = q776578_czero
}.

Arguments q776578_czero {A} _.
Arguments q776578_cone {A} _.
Arguments q776578_cadd {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q776578_cmul {A} _ _ _.

Record q776578_ring (A : Type) : Type := {
  q776578_zero : A;
  q776578_one : A;
  q776578_add : A -> A -> A;
  q776578_mul : A -> A -> A;
  q776578_neg : A -> A;
  q776578_add_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_add x (q776578_add y z) =
      q776578_add (q776578_add x y) z;
  q776578_add_comm :
    forall x y : A,
      q776578_add x y = q776578_add y x;
  q776578_zero_add :
    forall x : A, q776578_add q776578_zero x = x;
  q776578_add_zero :
    forall x : A, q776578_add x q776578_zero = x;
  q776578_neg_add :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_add (q776578_neg x) x = q776578_zero;
  q776578_add_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_add x (q776578_neg x) = q776578_zero;
  q776578_mul_assoc :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_mul x (q776578_mul y z) =
      q776578_mul (q776578_mul x y) z;
  q776578_one_mul :
    forall x : A, q776578_mul q776578_one x = x;
  q776578_mul_one :
    forall x : A, q776578_mul x q776578_one = x;
  q776578_mul_add :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_mul x (q776578_add y z) =
      q776578_add
        (q776578_mul x y)
        (q776578_mul x z);
  q776578_add_mul :
    forall x y z : A,
      q776578_mul (q776578_add x y) z =
      q776578_add
        (q776578_mul x z)
        (q776578_mul y z);
  q776578_zero_mul :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_mul q776578_zero x = q776578_zero;
  q776578_mul_zero :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_mul x q776578_zero = q776578_zero
}.

Arguments q776578_zero {A} _.
Arguments q776578_one {A} _.
Arguments q776578_add {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q776578_mul {A} _ _ _.
Arguments q776578_neg {A} _ _.

Record q776578_algebra
    {R0 A : Type}
    (base : q776578_comm_semiring R0)
    (ring : q776578_ring A) : Type := {
  q776578_algebra_map : R0 -> A;
  q776578_algebra_map_zero :
    q776578_algebra_map (q776578_czero base) =
    q776578_zero ring;
  q776578_algebra_map_one :
    q776578_algebra_map (q776578_cone base) =
    q776578_one ring;
  q776578_algebra_map_add :
    forall x y : R0,
      q776578_algebra_map (q776578_cadd base x y) =
      q776578_add ring
        (q776578_algebra_map x)
        (q776578_algebra_map y);
  q776578_algebra_map_mul :
    forall x y : R0,
      q776578_algebra_map (q776578_cmul base x y) =
      q776578_mul ring
        (q776578_algebra_map x)
        (q776578_algebra_map y);
  q776578_algebra_map_commutes :
    forall (r : R0) (x : A),
      q776578_mul ring (q776578_algebra_map r) x =
      q776578_mul ring x (q776578_algebra_map r)
}.

Arguments q776578_algebra_map {R0 A base ring} _ _.

Record q776578_left_ideal
    {A : Type}
    (ring : q776578_ring A) : Type := {
  q776578_left_ideal_mem : A -> Prop;
  q776578_left_ideal_zero :
    q776578_left_ideal_mem (q776578_zero ring);
  q776578_left_ideal_add :
    forall x y : A,
      q776578_left_ideal_mem x ->
      q776578_left_ideal_mem y ->
      q776578_left_ideal_mem (q776578_add ring x y);
  q776578_left_ideal_neg :
    forall x : A,
      q776578_left_ideal_mem x ->
      q776578_left_ideal_mem (q776578_neg ring x);
  q776578_left_ideal_smul :
    forall a x : A,
      q776578_left_ideal_mem x ->
      q776578_left_ideal_mem (q776578_mul ring a x)
}.

Arguments q776578_left_ideal_mem {A ring} _ _.

Definition q776578_are_complements
    {A : Type}
    {ring : q776578_ring A}
    (I J : q776578_left_ideal ring) : Prop :=
  (forall x : A,
    q776578_left_ideal_mem I x ->
    q776578_left_ideal_mem J x ->
    x = q776578_zero ring) /\
  (forall x : A,
    exists i j : A,
      q776578_left_ideal_mem I i /\
      q776578_left_ideal_mem J j /\
      x = q776578_add ring i j).

Definition q776578_is_semisimple_ring
    {A : Type}
    {ring : q776578_ring A} : Prop :=
  forall I : q776578_left_ideal ring,
    exists J : q776578_left_ideal ring,
      q776578_are_complements I J.

Record q776578_division_ring (A : Type) : Type := {
  q776578_division_ring_ring : q776578_ring A;
  q776578_inv : A -> A;
  q776578_zero_ne_one :
    q776578_zero q776578_division_ring_ring <>
    q776578_one q776578_division_ring_ring;
  q776578_inv_zero :
    q776578_inv
      (q776578_zero q776578_division_ring_ring) =
    q776578_zero q776578_division_ring_ring;
  q776578_mul_inv :
    forall x : A,
      x <> q776578_zero q776578_division_ring_ring ->
      q776578_mul q776578_division_ring_ring
        x (q776578_inv x) =
      q776578_one q776578_division_ring_ring;
  q776578_inv_mul :
    forall x : A,
      x <> q776578_zero q776578_division_ring_ring ->
      q776578_mul q776578_division_ring_ring
        (q776578_inv x) x =
      q776578_one q776578_division_ring_ring
}.

Arguments q776578_division_ring_ring {A} _.

Definition q776578_matrix
    (n : nat) (A : Type) : Type :=
  Fin.t n -> Fin.t n -> A.

Fixpoint q776578_fin_sum
    {A : Type}
    (ring : q776578_ring A)
    (n : nat) : (Fin.t n -> A) -> A :=
  match n return (Fin.t n -> A) -> A with
  | 0 => fun _ => q776578_zero ring
  | S k =>
      fun f =>
        q776578_add ring
          (f Fin.F1)
          (@q776578_fin_sum A ring k
            (fun i => f (Fin.FS i)))
  end.

Definition q776578_product_matrix
    {n : nat}
    (D : Fin.t n -> Type)
    (d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat) : Type :=
  forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_matrix (d i) (D i).

Definition q776578_product_equal
    {n : nat}
    {D : Fin.t n -> Type}
    {d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat}
    (X Y : q776578_product_matrix D d) : Prop :=
  forall (i : Fin.t n) (r c : Fin.t (d i)),
    X i r c = Y i r c.

Definition q776578_product_zero
    {n : nat}
    {D : Fin.t n -> Type}
    {d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat}
    (DR : forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_division_ring (D i)) :
    q776578_product_matrix D d :=
  fun i _ _ =>
    q776578_zero (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i)).

Definition q776578_product_one
    {n : nat}
    {D : Fin.t n -> Type}
    {d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat}
    (DR : forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_division_ring (D i)) :
    q776578_product_matrix D d :=
  fun i r c =>
    if Fin.eq_dec r c
    then q776578_one (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i))
    else q776578_zero (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i)).

Definition q776578_product_add
    {n : nat}
    {D : Fin.t n -> Type}
    {d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat}
    (DR : forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_division_ring (D i))
    (X Y : q776578_product_matrix D d) :
    q776578_product_matrix D d :=
  fun i r c =>
    q776578_add
      (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i))
      (X i r c) (Y i r c).

Definition q776578_product_mul
    {n : nat}
    {D : Fin.t n -> Type}
    {d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat}
    (DR : forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_division_ring (D i))
    (X Y : q776578_product_matrix D d) :
    q776578_product_matrix D d :=
  fun i r c =>
    @q776578_fin_sum (D i)
      (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i))
      (d i)
      (fun k =>
        q776578_mul
          (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i))
          (X i r k) (Y i k c)).

Definition q776578_product_algebra_map
    {R0 : Type}
    {n : nat}
    {D : Fin.t n -> Type}
    {d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat}
    {base : q776578_comm_semiring R0}
    {DR : forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_division_ring (D i)}
    (DA : forall i : Fin.t n,
      q776578_algebra base
        (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i)))
    (a : R0) : q776578_product_matrix D d :=
  fun i r c =>
    if Fin.eq_dec r c
    then q776578_algebra_map (DA i) a
    else q776578_zero (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i)).

Record q776578_alg_equiv
    {R0 R : Type}
    (base : q776578_comm_semiring R0)
    (ring : q776578_ring R)
    (source_algebra : q776578_algebra base ring)
    (n : nat)
    (D : Fin.t n -> Type)
    (d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat)
    (DR : forall i : Fin.t n, q776578_division_ring (D i))
    (DA : forall i : Fin.t n,
      q776578_algebra base
        (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i))) : Type := {
  q776578_forward :
    R -> q776578_product_matrix D d;
  q776578_inverse :
    q776578_product_matrix D d -> R;
  q776578_left_inverse :
    forall x : R,
      q776578_inverse (q776578_forward x) = x;
  q776578_right_inverse :
    forall y : q776578_product_matrix D d,
      q776578_product_equal
        (q776578_forward (q776578_inverse y)) y;
  q776578_inverse_respects :
    forall x y : q776578_product_matrix D d,
      q776578_product_equal x y ->
      q776578_inverse x = q776578_inverse y;
  q776578_map_zero :
    q776578_product_equal
      (q776578_forward (q776578_zero ring))
      (q776578_product_zero DR);
  q776578_map_one :
    q776578_product_equal
      (q776578_forward (q776578_one ring))
      (q776578_product_one DR);
  q776578_map_add :
    forall x y : R,
      q776578_product_equal
        (q776578_forward (q776578_add ring x y))
        (q776578_product_add DR
          (q776578_forward x)
          (q776578_forward y));
  q776578_map_mul :
    forall x y : R,
      q776578_product_equal
        (q776578_forward (q776578_mul ring x y))
        (q776578_product_mul DR
          (q776578_forward x)
          (q776578_forward y));
  q776578_map_algebra :
    forall a : R0,
      q776578_product_equal
        (q776578_forward
          (q776578_algebra_map source_algebra a))
        (q776578_product_algebra_map DA a)
}.

Definition q776578_nonempty (A : Type) : Prop :=
  exists _ : A, True.

Section q776578_statement.

Universe q776578_u0 q776578_u.

Theorem IsSemisimpleRing_exists_algEquiv_pi_matrix_divisionRing :
  forall (R0 : Type@{q776578_u0})
         (R : Type@{q776578_u})
         (base : q776578_comm_semiring R0)
         (ring : q776578_ring R)
         (source_algebra : q776578_algebra base ring),
    @q776578_is_semisimple_ring R ring ->
    exists (n : nat)
           (D : Fin.t n -> Type@{q776578_u})
           (d : forall i : Fin.t n, nat)
           (DR : forall i : Fin.t n,
             q776578_division_ring (D i))
           (DA : forall i : Fin.t n,
             q776578_algebra base
               (q776578_division_ring_ring (DR i))),
      (forall i : Fin.t n, d i <> 0) /\
      @q776578_nonempty
        (@q776578_alg_equiv
          R0 R base ring source_algebra n D d DR DA).
Admitted.

End q776578_statement.

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q776578
  (thousand-theorems__isabelle__Q776578), "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": every
  semisimple algebra is isomorphic, over its commutative semiring of scalars,
  to a finite product of positive-size matrix algebras over division algebras.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

theory Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
  imports Main
begin

type_synonym 'r q776578_end = "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
type_synonym 'r q776578_matrix_product =
  "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end"

definition q776578_comm_semiring where
  "q776578_comm_semiring C z one add mul \<longleftrightarrow>
    z \<in> C \<and>
    one \<in> C \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. add x y \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. mul x y \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      add (add x y) w = add x (add y w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. add z x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. add x y = add y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      mul (mul x y) w = mul x (mul y w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. mul one x = x \<and> mul x one = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. mul z x = z \<and> mul x z = z) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. mul x y = mul y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      mul x (add y w) = add (mul x y) (mul x w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      mul (add x y) w = add (mul x w) (mul y w))"

definition q776578_ring where
  "q776578_ring C z one add neg mul \<longleftrightarrow>
    z \<in> C \<and>
    one \<in> C \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. neg x \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. add x y \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. mul x y \<in> C) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      add (add x y) w = add x (add y w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. add z x = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. add (neg x) x = z) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. add x y = add y x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      mul (mul x y) w = mul x (mul y w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. mul one x = x \<and> mul x one = x) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      mul x (add y w) = add (mul x y) (mul x w)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. \<forall>y\<in>C. \<forall>w\<in>C.
      mul (add x y) w = add (mul x w) (mul y w))"

definition q776578_algebra_map where
  "q776578_algebra_map KC kz ko kadd kmul RC rz ro radd rmul alg \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>a\<in>KC. alg a \<in> RC) \<and>
    alg kz = rz \<and>
    alg ko = ro \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>KC. \<forall>b\<in>KC. alg (kadd a b) = radd (alg a) (alg b)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>KC. \<forall>b\<in>KC. alg (kmul a b) = rmul (alg a) (alg b)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>KC. \<forall>x\<in>RC. rmul (alg a) x = rmul x (alg a))"

definition q776578_left_ideal where
  "q776578_left_ideal RC rz radd rneg rmul I \<longleftrightarrow>
    I \<subseteq> RC \<and>
    rz \<in> I \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>I. rneg x \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>I. \<forall>y\<in>I. radd x y \<in> I) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>RC. \<forall>x\<in>I. rmul a x \<in> I)"

definition q776578_semisimple_ring where
  "q776578_semisimple_ring RC rz radd rneg rmul \<longleftrightarrow>
    (\<forall>I. q776578_left_ideal RC rz radd rneg rmul I \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>J. q776578_left_ideal RC rz radd rneg rmul J \<and>
        I \<inter> J = {rz} \<and>
        (\<forall>x\<in>RC. \<exists>y\<in>I. \<exists>w\<in>J. x = radd y w)))"

definition q776578_division_ring where
  "q776578_division_ring C z one add neg mul \<longleftrightarrow>
    q776578_ring C z one add neg mul \<and>
    z \<noteq> one \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>C. x \<noteq> z \<longrightarrow>
      (\<exists>y\<in>C. mul x y = one \<and> mul y x = one))"

primrec q776578_sum where
  "q776578_sum z add f 0 = z"
| "q776578_sum z add f (Suc n) =
    add (q776578_sum z add f n) (f n)"

definition q776578_matrix_product_carrier ::
    "nat \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> 'v set) \<Rightarrow> (nat \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
      (nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'v) set" where
  "q776578_matrix_product_carrier n D d =
    {A. \<forall>i p q.
      if i < n \<and> p < d i \<and> q < d i
      then A i p q \<in> D i
      else A i p q = undefined}"

definition q776578_is_algebra_equiv where
  "q776578_is_algebra_equiv
      KC kz ko kadd kmul
      RC rz ro radd rneg rmul alg
      n D Dz Do Dadd Dneg Dmul Dalg d phi \<longleftrightarrow>
    bij_betw phi RC (q776578_matrix_product_carrier n D d) \<and>
    (\<forall>i<n. \<forall>p<d i. \<forall>q<d i.
      phi rz i p q = Dz i) \<and>
    (\<forall>i<n. \<forall>p<d i. \<forall>q<d i.
      phi ro i p q = (if p = q then Do i else Dz i)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>RC. \<forall>y\<in>RC. \<forall>i<n. \<forall>p<d i. \<forall>q<d i.
      phi (radd x y) i p q = Dadd i (phi x i p q) (phi y i p q)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>RC. \<forall>i<n. \<forall>p<d i. \<forall>q<d i.
      phi (rneg x) i p q = Dneg i (phi x i p q)) \<and>
    (\<forall>x\<in>RC. \<forall>y\<in>RC. \<forall>i<n. \<forall>p<d i. \<forall>q<d i.
      phi (rmul x y) i p q =
        q776578_sum (Dz i) (Dadd i)
          (\<lambda>k. Dmul i (phi x i p k) (phi y i k q)) (d i)) \<and>
    (\<forall>a\<in>KC. \<forall>i<n. \<forall>p<d i. \<forall>q<d i.
      phi (alg a) i p q = (if p = q then Dalg i a else Dz i))"

theorem q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem:
  fixes KC :: "'k set"
    and kz ko :: "'k"
    and kadd kmul :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'k"
    and RC :: "'r set"
    and rz ro :: "'r"
    and radd rmul :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and rneg :: "'r \<Rightarrow> 'r"
    and alg :: "'k \<Rightarrow> 'r"
  assumes "q776578_comm_semiring KC kz ko kadd kmul"
    and "q776578_ring RC rz ro radd rneg rmul"
    and "q776578_algebra_map KC kz ko kadd kmul RC rz ro radd rmul alg"
    and "q776578_semisimple_ring RC rz radd rneg rmul"
  shows "\<exists>(n :: nat)
      (D :: nat \<Rightarrow> ('r q776578_end) set)
      (Dz :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end)
      (Do :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end)
      (Dadd :: nat \<Rightarrow>
        'r q776578_end \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end)
      (Dmul :: nat \<Rightarrow>
        'r q776578_end \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end)
      (Dneg :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end)
      (Dalg :: nat \<Rightarrow> 'k \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_end)
      (d :: nat \<Rightarrow> nat)
      (phi :: 'r \<Rightarrow> 'r q776578_matrix_product).
    (\<forall>i<n.
      q776578_division_ring
        (D i) (Dz i) (Do i) (Dadd i) (Dneg i) (Dmul i) \<and>
      q776578_algebra_map
        KC kz ko kadd kmul
        (D i) (Dz i) (Do i) (Dadd i) (Dmul i) (Dalg i)) \<and>
    (\<forall>i<n. 0 < d i) \<and>
    q776578_is_algebra_equiv
      KC kz ko kadd kmul
      RC rz ro radd rneg rmul alg
      n D Dz Do Dadd Dneg Dmul Dalg d phi"
  sorry

end

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of Thousand Theorems corpus artifact Q776578,
  "Artin-Wedderburn theorem": every semisimple algebra is isomorphic, as an
  algebra over its commutative base semiring, to a finite product of matrix
  algebras over division algebras. This file contains no proof.
*)

let Q776578_ARTIN_WEDDERBURN_THEOREM =
  `let is_comm_semiring =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K).
       (!a:K. addK zeroK a = a /\ addK a zeroK = a) /\
       (!a b:K. addK a b = addK b a) /\
       (!a b c:K. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
       (!a:K. mulK oneK a = a /\ mulK a oneK = a) /\
       (!a b:K. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
       (!a b c:K. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
       (!a b c:K.
          mulK (addK a b) c = addK (mulK a c) (mulK b c)) /\
       (!a:K. mulK zeroK a = zeroK /\ mulK a zeroK = zeroK) in
   let is_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R).
       (!x:R. addR zeroR x = x /\ addR x zeroR = x) /\
       (!x y:R. addR x y = addR y x) /\
       (!x y z:R. addR (addR x y) z = addR x (addR y z)) /\
       (!x:R. addR (negR x) x = zeroR /\ addR x (negR x) = zeroR) /\
       (!x:R. mulR oneR x = x /\ mulR x oneR = x) /\
       (!x y z:R. mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z)) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          mulR x (addR y z) = addR (mulR x y) (mulR x z)) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          mulR (addR x y) z = addR (mulR x z) (mulR y z)) /\
       (!x:R. mulR zeroR x = zeroR /\ mulR x zeroR = zeroR) in
   let is_algebra =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (scalar:K->R).
       scalar zeroK = zeroR /\
       scalar oneK = oneR /\
       (!a b:K. scalar (addK a b) = addR (scalar a) (scalar b)) /\
       (!a b:K. scalar (mulK a b) = mulR (scalar a) (scalar b)) /\
       (!a:K. !x:R. mulR (scalar a) x = mulR x (scalar a)) in
   let is_left_ideal =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R)
      (ideal:R->bool).
       ideal zeroR /\
       (!x y:R. ideal x /\ ideal y ==> ideal (addR x y)) /\
       (!x:R. ideal x ==> ideal (negR x)) /\
       (!a x:R. ideal x ==> ideal (mulR a x)) in
   let is_semisimple_ring =
     \(zeroR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R) (negR:R->R).
       !ideal:R->bool.
         is_left_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR ideal
         ==> ?complement:R->bool.
               is_left_ideal zeroR addR mulR negR complement /\
               (!x:R. ideal x /\ complement x ==> x = zeroR) /\
               (!x:R.
                  ?y z:R.
                    ideal y /\ complement z /\ x = addR y z) in
   let is_division_algebra =
     \(zeroK:K) (oneK:K) (addK:K->K->K) (mulK:K->K->K)
      (carrier:R->bool) (zeroD:R) (oneD:R)
      (addD:R->R->R) (mulD:R->R->R) (negD:R->R) (invD:R->R)
      (scalarD:K->R).
       carrier zeroD /\
       carrier oneD /\
       ~(oneD = zeroD) /\
       (!x y:R.
          carrier x /\ carrier y
          ==> carrier (addD x y) /\ carrier (mulD x y)) /\
       (!x:R. carrier x ==> carrier (negD x) /\ carrier (invD x)) /\
       (!x:R.
          carrier x
          ==> addD zeroD x = x /\ addD x zeroD = x) /\
       (!x y:R.
          carrier x /\ carrier y
          ==> addD x y = addD y x) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z
          ==> addD (addD x y) z = addD x (addD y z)) /\
       (!x:R.
          carrier x
          ==> addD (negD x) x = zeroD /\ addD x (negD x) = zeroD) /\
       (!x:R.
          carrier x
          ==> mulD oneD x = x /\ mulD x oneD = x) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z
          ==> mulD (mulD x y) z = mulD x (mulD y z)) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z
          ==> mulD x (addD y z) = addD (mulD x y) (mulD x z)) /\
       (!x y z:R.
          carrier x /\ carrier y /\ carrier z
          ==> mulD (addD x y) z = addD (mulD x z) (mulD y z)) /\
       (!x:R.
          carrier x
          ==> mulD zeroD x = zeroD /\ mulD x zeroD = zeroD) /\
       invD zeroD = zeroD /\
       (!x:R.
          carrier x /\ ~(x = zeroD)
          ==> mulD (invD x) x = oneD /\ mulD x (invD x) = oneD) /\
       (!a:K. carrier (scalarD a)) /\
       scalarD zeroK = zeroD /\
       scalarD oneK = oneD /\
       (!a b:K.
          scalarD (addK a b) = addD (scalarD a) (scalarD b)) /\
       (!a b:K.
          scalarD (mulK a b) = mulD (scalarD a) (scalarD b)) /\
       (!a:K. !x:R.
          carrier x
          ==> mulD (scalarD a) x = mulD x (scalarD a)) in
   let valid_entry =
     \(n:num) (d:num->num) (i:num) (r:num) (c:num).
       i < n /\ r < d i /\ c < d i in
   let matrix_product_carrier =
     \(zeroR:R) (n:num) (carrier:num->R->bool) (d:num->num)
      (x:num->num->num->R).
       !i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c
         then carrier i (x i r c)
         else x i r c = zeroR in
   let matrix_zero =
     \(zeroR:R) (n:num) (zeroD:num->R) (d:num->num).
       \i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c then zeroD i else zeroR in
  let matrix_one =
     \(zeroR:R) (n:num) (zeroD:num->R) (oneD:num->R) (d:num->num).
       \i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c
         then if r = c then oneD i else zeroD i
         else zeroR in
   let matrix_neg =
     \(zeroR:R) (negD:num->R->R) (n:num) (d:num->num)
      (x:num->num->num->R).
       \i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c then negD i (x i r c) else zeroR in
   let matrix_add =
     \(zeroR:R) (addD:num->R->R->R) (n:num) (d:num->num)
      (x:num->num->num->R) (y:num->num->num->R).
       \i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c
         then addD i (x i r c) (y i r c)
         else zeroR in
   let matrix_mul =
     \(zeroR:R) (zeroD:num->R)
      (addD:num->R->R->R) (mulD:num->R->R->R)
      (n:num) (d:num->num)
      (x:num->num->num->R) (y:num->num->num->R).
       \i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c
         then ITLIST (addD i)
                (list_of_seq
                  (\k:num. mulD i (x i r k) (y i k c))
                  (d i))
                (zeroD i)
         else zeroR in
  let matrix_scalar =
     \(zeroR:R) (zeroD:num->R) (scalarD:num->K->R)
      (n:num) (d:num->num) (a:K).
       \i r c:num.
         if valid_entry n d i r c
         then if r = c then scalarD i a else zeroD i
         else zeroR in
   let is_algebra_isomorphism =
     \(zeroR:R) (oneR:R) (addR:R->R->R) (mulR:R->R->R)
      (negR:R->R) (scalar:K->R)
      (n:num) (carrier:num->R->bool)
      (zeroD:num->R) (oneD:num->R)
      (addD:num->R->R->R) (mulD:num->R->R->R)
      (negD:num->R->R) (scalarD:num->K->R) (d:num->num)
      (phi:R->num->num->num->R).
       let target = matrix_product_carrier zeroR n carrier d in
       let target_zero = matrix_zero zeroR n zeroD d in
       let target_one = matrix_one zeroR n zeroD oneD d in
       let target_neg = matrix_neg zeroR negD n d in
       let target_add = matrix_add zeroR addD n d in
       let target_mul = matrix_mul zeroR zeroD addD mulD n d in
       let target_scalar = matrix_scalar zeroR zeroD scalarD n d in
       (!x:R. target (phi x)) /\
       (!x y:R. phi x = phi y ==> x = y) /\
       (!z:num->num->num->R. target z ==> ?x:R. phi x = z) /\
       phi zeroR = target_zero /\
       phi oneR = target_one /\
       (!x:R. phi (negR x) = target_neg (phi x)) /\
       (!x y:R. phi (addR x y) = target_add (phi x) (phi y)) /\
       (!x y:R. phi (mulR x y) = target_mul (phi x) (phi y)) /\
       (!a:K. phi (scalar a) = target_scalar a) in
   !zeroK oneK:K.
   !addK mulK:K->K->K.
   !zeroR oneR:R.
   !addR mulR:R->R->R.
   !negR:R->R.
   !scalar:K->R.
     is_comm_semiring zeroK oneK addK mulK /\
     is_ring zeroR oneR addR mulR negR /\
     is_algebra
       zeroK oneK addK mulK zeroR oneR addR mulR scalar /\
     is_semisimple_ring zeroR addR mulR negR
     ==> ?n:num.
         ?carrier:num->R->bool.
         ?zeroD:num->R.
         ?oneD:num->R.
         ?addD:num->R->R->R.
         ?mulD:num->R->R->R.
         ?negD:num->R->R.
         ?invD:num->R->R.
         ?scalarD:num->K->R.
         ?d:num->num.
         ?phi:R->num->num->num->R.
           (!i:num. i < n ==> 0 < d i) /\
           (!i:num.
              i < n
              ==> is_division_algebra
                    zeroK oneK addK mulK
                    (carrier i) (zeroD i) (oneD i)
                    (addD i) (mulD i) (negD i) (invD i)
                    (scalarD i)) /\
           is_algebra_isomorphism
             zeroR oneR addR mulR negR scalar
             n carrier zeroD oneD addD mulD negD scalarD d phi`;;

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
;; Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q776578,
;; "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": every semisimple algebra over a commutative
;; semiring is algebra-equivalent to a finite product of nonzero square matrix
;; algebras over division algebras. This file contains no proof.

(in-package "ACL2")

(set-inhibit-output-lst '(prove proof-tree event summary))

;; Tame function objects represent arbitrary carriers and operations without
;; enumerating them. Finite products and matrices are represented by nested
;; true lists, which are extensionally equivalent to functions on Fin n.

(defun q776578-app1 (function x)
  (apply$ function (list x)))

(defun q776578-app2 (function x y)
  (apply$ function (list x y)))

(defun q776578-app3 (function x y z)
  (apply$ function (list x y z)))

(defun q776578-member-p (carrier value)
  (if (q776578-app1 carrier value) t nil))

;; The commutative-semiring base and the possibly noncommutative ring.

(defun-sk q776578-commutative-semiring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q776578-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (equal (q776578-app2 addition x zero) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 addition zero x) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication x one) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication one x) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication x zero) zero)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication zero x) zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier x)
       (q776578-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier
                         (q776578-app2 addition x y))
       (q776578-member-p carrier
                         (q776578-app2 multiplication x y))
       (equal (q776578-app2 addition x y)
              (q776578-app2 addition y x))
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication x y)
              (q776578-app2 multiplication y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier x)
       (q776578-member-p carrier y)
       (q776578-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      (q776578-app2 addition x y)
                      z)
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      x
                      (q776578-app2 addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x y)
                      z)
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      x
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      x
                      (q776578-app2 addition y z))
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x y)
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      (q776578-app2 addition x y)
                      z)
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x z)
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q776578-commutative-semiring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (q776578-member-p carrier zero)
   (q776578-member-p carrier one)
   (q776578-commutative-semiring-laws-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication)))

(defun-sk q776578-ring-laws-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (q776578-member-p carrier x)
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier (q776578-app1 negation x))
       (equal (q776578-app2 addition x zero) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 addition zero x) x)
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 addition x (q776578-app1 negation x))
        zero)
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 addition (q776578-app1 negation x) x)
        zero)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication x one) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication one x) x)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication x zero) zero)
       (equal (q776578-app2 multiplication zero x) zero)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier x)
       (q776578-member-p carrier y))
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier
                         (q776578-app2 addition x y))
       (q776578-member-p carrier
                         (q776578-app2 multiplication x y))
       (equal (q776578-app2 addition x y)
              (q776578-app2 addition y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier x)
       (q776578-member-p carrier y)
       (q776578-member-p carrier z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      (q776578-app2 addition x y)
                      z)
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      x
                      (q776578-app2 addition y z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x y)
                      z)
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      x
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication y z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      x
                      (q776578-app2 addition y z))
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x y)
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 multiplication
                      (q776578-app2 addition x y)
                      z)
        (q776578-app2 addition
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication x z)
                      (q776578-app2 multiplication y z))))))))

(defun q776578-ring-p
    (carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp negation)
   (q776578-member-p carrier zero)
   (q776578-member-p carrier one)
   (q776578-ring-laws-p
    carrier zero one addition multiplication negation)))

;; An algebra map is a unital semiring homomorphism whose image is central.

(defun-sk q776578-algebra-laws-p
    (base-carrier base-zero base-one base-add base-mul
     ring-carrier ring-zero ring-one ring-add ring-mul algebra-map)
  (forall (a b x)
    (and
     (implies
      (q776578-member-p base-carrier a)
      (and
       (q776578-member-p ring-carrier
                         (q776578-app1 algebra-map a))
       (implies
        (q776578-member-p ring-carrier x)
        (equal
         (q776578-app2 ring-mul
                       (q776578-app1 algebra-map a)
                       x)
         (q776578-app2 ring-mul
                       x
                       (q776578-app1 algebra-map a))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p base-carrier a)
       (q776578-member-p base-carrier b))
      (and
       (equal
        (q776578-app1 algebra-map
                      (q776578-app2 base-add a b))
        (q776578-app2 ring-add
                      (q776578-app1 algebra-map a)
                      (q776578-app1 algebra-map b)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app1 algebra-map
                      (q776578-app2 base-mul a b))
        (q776578-app2 ring-mul
                      (q776578-app1 algebra-map a)
                      (q776578-app1 algebra-map b)))))
     (equal
      (q776578-app1 algebra-map base-zero)
      ring-zero)
     (equal
      (q776578-app1 algebra-map base-one)
      ring-one))))

(defun q776578-algebra-p
    (base-carrier base-zero base-one base-add base-mul
     ring-carrier ring-zero ring-one ring-add ring-mul algebra-map)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp algebra-map)
   (q776578-algebra-laws-p
    base-carrier base-zero base-one base-add base-mul
    ring-carrier ring-zero ring-one ring-add ring-mul algebra-map)))

;; A ring is semisimple exactly when its regular left module is semisimple;
;; equivalently, every left ideal has a complementary left ideal.

(defun-sk q776578-left-ideal-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (forall (a x y)
    (and
     (implies
      (q776578-member-p ideal x)
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier x)
       (q776578-member-p ideal (q776578-app1 negation x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p ideal x)
       (q776578-member-p ideal y))
      (q776578-member-p ideal
                        (q776578-app2 addition x y)))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p carrier a)
       (q776578-member-p ideal x))
      (q776578-member-p ideal
                        (q776578-app2 multiplication a x))))))

(defun q776578-left-ideal-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp ideal)
   (q776578-member-p ideal zero)
   (q776578-left-ideal-laws-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)))

(defun-sk q776578-ideal-sum-representation-p
    (addition left right value)
  (exists (left-value right-value)
    (and
     (q776578-member-p left left-value)
     (q776578-member-p right right-value)
     (equal
      (q776578-app2 addition left-value right-value)
      value))))

(defun-sk q776578-direct-complement-laws-p
    (carrier zero addition ideal complement)
  (forall (x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-member-p ideal x)
       (q776578-member-p complement x))
      (equal x zero))
     (implies
      (q776578-member-p carrier x)
      (q776578-ideal-sum-representation-p
       addition ideal complement x)))))

(defun q776578-direct-complement-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal complement)
  (and
   (q776578-left-ideal-p
    carrier zero addition multiplication negation complement)
   (q776578-direct-complement-laws-p
    carrier zero addition ideal complement)))

(defun-sk q776578-left-ideal-complement-exists-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
  (exists (complement)
    (q776578-direct-complement-p
     carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal complement)))

(defun-sk q776578-semisimple-ring-p
    (carrier zero addition multiplication negation)
  (forall (ideal)
    (implies
     (q776578-left-ideal-p
      carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal)
     (q776578-left-ideal-complement-exists-p
      carrier zero addition multiplication negation ideal))))

;; The existential family D_i of division algebras and the positive dimensions.

(defun q776578-valid-index-p (index size)
  (and (natp index)
       (< index size)))

(defun-sk q776578-dimensions-laws-p (size dimensions)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
     (and
      (natp (q776578-app1 dimensions index))
      (< 0 (q776578-app1 dimensions index))))))

(defun-sk q776578-division-family-points-p
    (size carrier zero one)
  (forall (index)
    (implies
     (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
     (and
      (q776578-app2 carrier index (q776578-app1 zero index))
      (q776578-app2 carrier index (q776578-app1 one index))
      (not
       (equal
        (q776578-app1 zero index)
        (q776578-app1 one index)))))))

(defun-sk q776578-division-family-laws-p
    (size carrier zero one addition multiplication negation inverse)
  (forall (index x y z)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
       (q776578-app2 carrier index x))
      (and
       (q776578-app2 carrier index
                     (q776578-app2 negation index x))
       (q776578-app2 carrier index
                     (q776578-app2 inverse index x))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 addition index x
                       (q776578-app1 zero index))
        x)
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       (q776578-app1 zero index) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 addition index x
                       (q776578-app2 negation index x))
        (q776578-app1 zero index))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       (q776578-app2 negation index x) x)
        (q776578-app1 zero index))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index x
                       (q776578-app1 one index))
        x)
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       (q776578-app1 one index) x)
        x)
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index x
                       (q776578-app1 zero index))
        (q776578-app1 zero index))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       (q776578-app1 zero index) x)
        (q776578-app1 zero index))
       (implies
        (equal x (q776578-app1 zero index))
        (equal
         (q776578-app2 inverse index x)
         (q776578-app1 zero index)))
       (implies
        (not (equal x (q776578-app1 zero index)))
        (and
         (equal
          (q776578-app3 multiplication index x
                           (q776578-app2 inverse index x))
          (q776578-app1 one index))
         (equal
          (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                           (q776578-app2 inverse index x) x)
          (q776578-app1 one index))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
       (q776578-app2 carrier index x)
       (q776578-app2 carrier index y))
      (and
       (q776578-app2 carrier index
                     (q776578-app3 addition index x y))
       (q776578-app2 carrier index
                     (q776578-app3 multiplication index x y))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 addition index x y)
        (q776578-app3 addition index y x))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
       (q776578-app2 carrier index x)
       (q776578-app2 carrier index y)
       (q776578-app2 carrier index z))
      (and
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       (q776578-app3 addition index x y) z)
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       x (q776578-app3 addition index y z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       (q776578-app3 multiplication index x y) z)
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       x (q776578-app3 multiplication index y z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       x (q776578-app3 addition index y z))
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       (q776578-app3 multiplication index x y)
                       (q776578-app3 multiplication index x z)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       (q776578-app3 addition index x y) z)
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       (q776578-app3 multiplication index x z)
                       (q776578-app3 multiplication index y z))))))))

(defun q776578-division-ring-family-p
    (size dimensions carrier zero one addition multiplication negation inverse)
  (and
   (natp size)
   (tamep-functionp dimensions)
   (tamep-functionp carrier)
   (tamep-functionp zero)
   (tamep-functionp one)
   (tamep-functionp addition)
   (tamep-functionp multiplication)
   (tamep-functionp negation)
   (tamep-functionp inverse)
   (q776578-dimensions-laws-p size dimensions)
   (q776578-division-family-points-p size carrier zero one)
   (q776578-division-family-laws-p
    size carrier zero one addition multiplication negation inverse)))

(defun-sk q776578-division-algebra-family-laws-p
    (size
     base-carrier base-zero base-one base-add base-mul
     carrier zero one addition multiplication algebra-map)
  (forall (index a b x)
    (and
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
       (q776578-member-p base-carrier a))
      (and
       (q776578-app2 carrier index
                     (q776578-app2 algebra-map index a))
       (implies
        (q776578-app2 carrier index x)
        (equal
         (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                          (q776578-app2 algebra-map index a) x)
         (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                          x (q776578-app2 algebra-map index a))))))
     (implies
      (and
       (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
       (q776578-member-p base-carrier a)
       (q776578-member-p base-carrier b))
      (and
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 algebra-map index
                       (q776578-app2 base-add a b))
        (q776578-app3 addition index
                       (q776578-app2 algebra-map index a)
                       (q776578-app2 algebra-map index b)))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 algebra-map index
                       (q776578-app2 base-mul a b))
        (q776578-app3 multiplication index
                       (q776578-app2 algebra-map index a)
                       (q776578-app2 algebra-map index b)))))
     (implies
      (q776578-valid-index-p index size)
      (and
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 algebra-map index base-zero)
        (q776578-app1 zero index))
       (equal
        (q776578-app2 algebra-map index base-one)
        (q776578-app1 one index)))))))

(defun q776578-division-algebra-family-p
    (size
     base-carrier base-zero base-one base-add base-mul
     carrier zero one addition multiplication algebra-map)
  (and
   (tamep-functionp algebra-map)
   (q776578-division-algebra-family-laws-p
    size
    base-carrier base-zero base-one base-add base-mul
    carrier zero one addition multiplication algebra-map)))

;; Canonical finite-list presentation of the product of square matrix rings.

(defun q776578-division-list-p (index carrier values)
  (if (consp values)
      (and
       (q776578-app2 carrier index (car values))
       (q776578-division-list-p index carrier (cdr values)))
    (equal values nil)))

(defun q776578-matrix-rows-p
    (index dimension carrier rows)
  (if (consp rows)
      (and
       (true-listp (car rows))
       (equal (len (car rows)) dimension)
       (q776578-division-list-p index carrier (car rows))
       (q776578-matrix-rows-p
        index dimension carrier (cdr rows)))
    (equal rows nil)))

(defun q776578-matrix-p
    (index dimension carrier matrix)
  (and
   (true-listp matrix)
   (equal (len matrix) dimension)
   (q776578-matrix-rows-p
    index dimension carrier matrix)))

(defun q776578-product-p-from
    (index remaining dimensions carrier value)
  (declare (xargs :measure (nfix remaining)))
  (if (zp remaining)
      (equal value nil)
    (and
     (consp value)
     (q776578-matrix-p
      index
      (nfix (q776578-app1 dimensions index))
      carrier
      (car value))
     (q776578-product-p-from
      (+ 1 index)
      (- remaining 1)
      dimensions
      carrier
      (cdr value)))))

(defun q776578-product-p
    (size dimensions carrier value)
  (q776578-product-p-from
   0 (nfix size) dimensions carrier value))

(defun q776578-constant-row (remaining value)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons value
          (q776578-constant-row (- remaining 1) value))))

(defun q776578-zero-matrix (index dimension zero)
  (if (zp dimension)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-constant-row
      dimension (q776578-app1 zero index))
     (q776578-zero-matrix index (- dimension 1) zero))))

(defun q776578-diagonal-row
    (index row column remaining zero one)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (if (equal row column)
         (q776578-app1 one index)
       (q776578-app1 zero index))
     (q776578-diagonal-row
      index row (+ 1 column) (- remaining 1) zero one))))

(defun q776578-one-matrix-from-row
    (index row remaining dimension zero one)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-diagonal-row
      index row 0 dimension zero one)
     (q776578-one-matrix-from-row
      index (+ 1 row) (- remaining 1) dimension zero one))))

(defun q776578-one-matrix (index dimension zero one)
  (q776578-one-matrix-from-row
   index 0 dimension dimension zero one))

(defun q776578-product-zero-from
    (index remaining dimensions zero)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-zero-matrix
      index
      (nfix (q776578-app1 dimensions index))
      zero)
     (q776578-product-zero-from
      (+ 1 index) (- remaining 1) dimensions zero))))

(defun q776578-product-zero (size dimensions zero)
  (q776578-product-zero-from
   0 (nfix size) dimensions zero))

(defun q776578-product-one-from
    (index remaining dimensions zero one)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-one-matrix
      index
      (nfix (q776578-app1 dimensions index))
      zero one)
     (q776578-product-one-from
      (+ 1 index) (- remaining 1) dimensions zero one))))

(defun q776578-product-one (size dimensions zero one)
  (q776578-product-one-from
   0 (nfix size) dimensions zero one))

(defun q776578-add-row (index addition left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (q776578-app3 addition index (car left) (car right))
       (q776578-add-row index addition (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun q776578-add-matrix (index addition left right)
  (if (and (consp left) (consp right))
      (cons
       (q776578-add-row index addition (car left) (car right))
       (q776578-add-matrix
        index addition (cdr left) (cdr right)))
    nil))

(defun q776578-product-add-from
    (index remaining addition left right)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-add-matrix
      index addition (car left) (car right))
     (q776578-product-add-from
      (+ 1 index)
      (- remaining 1)
      addition
      (cdr left)
      (cdr right)))))

(defun q776578-product-add (size addition left right)
  (q776578-product-add-from
   0 (nfix size) addition left right))

(defun q776578-dot-product-from
    (index row column term remaining left right
     zero addition multiplication)
  (if (zp remaining)
      (q776578-app1 zero index)
    (q776578-app3
     addition
     index
     (q776578-app3
      multiplication
      index
      (nth term (nth row left))
      (nth column (nth term right)))
     (q776578-dot-product-from
      index row column (+ 1 term) (- remaining 1) left right
      zero addition multiplication))))

(defun q776578-multiply-row-from
    (index row column remaining dimension left right
     zero addition multiplication)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-dot-product-from
      index row column 0 dimension left right
      zero addition multiplication)
     (q776578-multiply-row-from
      index row (+ 1 column) (- remaining 1) dimension left right
      zero addition multiplication))))

(defun q776578-multiply-matrix-from
    (index row remaining dimension left right
     zero addition multiplication)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-multiply-row-from
      index row 0 dimension dimension left right
      zero addition multiplication)
     (q776578-multiply-matrix-from
      index (+ 1 row) (- remaining 1) dimension left right
      zero addition multiplication))))

(defun q776578-multiply-matrix
    (index dimension left right zero addition multiplication)
  (q776578-multiply-matrix-from
   index 0 dimension dimension left right
   zero addition multiplication))

(defun q776578-product-multiply-from
    (index remaining dimensions left right
     zero addition multiplication)
  (if (zp remaining)
      nil
    (cons
     (q776578-multiply-matrix
      index
      (nfix (q776578-app1 dimensions index))
      (car left)
      (car right)
      zero addition multiplication)
     (q776578-product-multiply-from
      (+ 1 index)
      (- remaining 1)
      dimensions
      (cdr left)
      (cdr right)
      zero addition multiplication))))

(defun q776578-product-multiply
    (size dimensions left right zero addition multiplication)
  (q776578-product-multiply-from

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
-- Statement-only formalization of thousand-theorems corpus artifact Q776578,
-- "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": a semisimple algebra is algebra-equivalent to a finite
-- product of matrix algebras over division algebras. This file contains no proof.

{-# OPTIONS --safe #-}

module Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem where

open import Agda.Primitive using (Level; lsuc; _⊔_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Equality using (_≡_)
open import Agda.Builtin.Nat using (Nat)
  renaming (zero to zeroN; suc to sucN)
open import Agda.Builtin.Sigma using (Σ)

data Empty : Set where

Not : {a : Level} → Set a → Set a
Not A = A → Empty

infix 4 _≠_

_≠_ : {a : Level} {A : Set a} → A → A → Set a
x ≠ y = Not (x ≡ y)

data Fin : Nat → Set where
  fzero : {n : Nat} → Fin (sucN n)
  fsuc  : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin (sucN n)

record CommutativeSemiring {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  field
    zero one : A
    add multiply : A → A → A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) → add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) → add x zero ≡ x

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-commutative :
      (x y : A) → multiply x y ≡ multiply y x
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : A) → multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : A) → multiply x one ≡ x
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : A) → multiply zero x ≡ zero
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : A) → multiply x zero ≡ zero

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡ add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (add x y) z ≡ add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)

record Ring {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  field
    zero one : A
    add multiply : A → A → A
    negate : A → A

    add-associative :
      (x y z : A) → add (add x y) z ≡ add x (add y z)
    add-commutative :
      (x y : A) → add x y ≡ add y x
    add-zero-left :
      (x : A) → add zero x ≡ x
    add-zero-right :
      (x : A) → add x zero ≡ x
    add-inverse-left :
      (x : A) → add (negate x) x ≡ zero
    add-inverse-right :
      (x : A) → add x (negate x) ≡ zero

    multiply-associative :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (multiply x y) z ≡ multiply x (multiply y z)
    multiply-one-left :
      (x : A) → multiply one x ≡ x
    multiply-one-right :
      (x : A) → multiply x one ≡ x
    multiply-zero-left :
      (x : A) → multiply zero x ≡ zero
    multiply-zero-right :
      (x : A) → multiply x zero ≡ zero

    distribute-left :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply x (add y z) ≡ add (multiply x y) (multiply x z)
    distribute-right :
      (x y z : A) →
      multiply (add x y) z ≡ add (multiply x z) (multiply y z)

record DivisionRing {a : Level} (A : Set a) : Set a where
  field
    ring : Ring A
    inverse : A → A
    nontrivial : Ring.zero ring ≠ Ring.one ring
    inverse-zero :
      inverse (Ring.zero ring) ≡ Ring.zero ring
    inverse-left :
      (x : A) →
      x ≠ Ring.zero ring →
      Ring.multiply ring (inverse x) x ≡ Ring.one ring
    inverse-right :
      (x : A) →
      x ≠ Ring.zero ring →
      Ring.multiply ring x (inverse x) ≡ Ring.one ring

record Algebra
  {b a : Level}
  {Base : Set b}
  {A : Set a}
  (base : CommutativeSemiring Base)
  (ring : Ring A) :
  Set (b ⊔ a) where

  field
    scalar : Base → A
    scalar-zero :
      scalar (CommutativeSemiring.zero base) ≡ Ring.zero ring
    scalar-one :
      scalar (CommutativeSemiring.one base) ≡ Ring.one ring
    scalar-add :
      (r s : Base) →
      scalar (CommutativeSemiring.add base r s) ≡
      Ring.add ring (scalar r) (scalar s)
    scalar-multiply :
      (r s : Base) →
      scalar (CommutativeSemiring.multiply base r s) ≡
      Ring.multiply ring (scalar r) (scalar s)
    scalar-central :
      (r : Base) (x : A) →
      Ring.multiply ring (scalar r) x ≡
      Ring.multiply ring x (scalar r)

record LeftIdeal
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : Ring A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    member : A → Set a
    membership-propositional :
      (x : A) (p q : member x) → p ≡ q
    contains-zero :
      member (Ring.zero ring)
    closed-add :
      (x y : A) → member x → member y →
      member (Ring.add ring x y)
    closed-negate :
      (x : A) → member x →
      member (Ring.negate ring x)
    closed-left-multiply :
      (r x : A) → member x →
      member (Ring.multiply ring r x)

record DirectComplement
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : Ring A)
  (I J : LeftIdeal ring) :
  Set a where

  field
    intersection-zero :
      (x : A) →
      LeftIdeal.member I x →
      LeftIdeal.member J x →
      x ≡ Ring.zero ring
    spans :
      (x : A) →
      Σ A (λ y →
        Σ (LeftIdeal.member I y) (λ _ →
          Σ A (λ z →
            Σ (LeftIdeal.member J z) (λ _ →
              x ≡ Ring.add ring y z))))

record IsSemisimpleRing
  {a : Level}
  {A : Set a}
  (ring : Ring A) :
  Set (lsuc a) where

  field
    complement :
      (I : LeftIdeal ring) →
      Σ (LeftIdeal ring) (λ J → DirectComplement ring I J)

Nonzero : Nat → Set
Nonzero n = n ≠ zeroN

finEqual : {n : Nat} → Fin n → Fin n → Set
finEqual i j = i ≡ j

MatrixProduct :
  {a : Level} {n : Nat} →
  (D : Fin n → Set a) →
  (d : Fin n → Nat) →
  Set a
MatrixProduct D d =
  (i : Fin _) → Fin (d i) → Fin (d i) → D i

zeroMatrixProduct :
  {a : Level} {n : Nat}
  {D : Fin n → Set a}
  {d : Fin n → Nat} →
  (division : (i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i)) →
  MatrixProduct D d
zeroMatrixProduct division i row column =
  Ring.zero (DivisionRing.ring (division i))

addMatrixProduct :
  {a : Level} {n : Nat}
  {D : Fin n → Set a}
  {d : Fin n → Nat} →
  (division : (i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i)) →
  MatrixProduct D d →
  MatrixProduct D d →
  MatrixProduct D d
addMatrixProduct division X Y i row column =
  Ring.add (DivisionRing.ring (division i))
    (X i row column)
    (Y i row column)

sumFin :
  {a : Level} {A : Set a} →
  Ring A →
  {n : Nat} →
  (Fin n → A) →
  A
sumFin ring {zeroN} term =
  Ring.zero ring
sumFin ring {sucN n} term =
  Ring.add ring
    (term fzero)
    (sumFin ring (λ i → term (fsuc i)))

multiplyMatrixProduct :
  {a : Level} {n : Nat}
  {D : Fin n → Set a}
  {d : Fin n → Nat} →
  (division : (i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i)) →
  MatrixProduct D d →
  MatrixProduct D d →
  MatrixProduct D d
multiplyMatrixProduct division X Y i row column =
  sumFin (DivisionRing.ring (division i))
    (λ middle →
      Ring.multiply (DivisionRing.ring (division i))
        (X i row middle)
        (Y i middle column))

diagonal :
  {a : Level} {A : Set a} {n : Nat} →
  Ring A →
  A →
  Fin n →
  Fin n →
  A
diagonal ring x fzero fzero = x
diagonal ring x fzero (fsuc column) = Ring.zero ring
diagonal ring x (fsuc row) fzero = Ring.zero ring
diagonal ring x (fsuc row) (fsuc column) =
  diagonal ring x row column

oneMatrixProduct :
  {a : Level} {n : Nat}
  {D : Fin n → Set a}
  {d : Fin n → Nat} →
  (division : (i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i)) →
  MatrixProduct D d
oneMatrixProduct division i =
  diagonal
    (DivisionRing.ring (division i))
    (Ring.one (DivisionRing.ring (division i)))

scalarMatrixProduct :
  {b a : Level}
  {Base : Set b}
  {n : Nat}
  {D : Fin n → Set a}
  {d : Fin n → Nat} →
  (base : CommutativeSemiring Base) →
  (division : (i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i)) →
  (algebras :
    (i : Fin n) →
    Algebra base (DivisionRing.ring (division i))) →
  Base →
  MatrixProduct D d
scalarMatrixProduct base division algebras scalar i =
  diagonal
    (DivisionRing.ring (division i))
    (Algebra.scalar (algebras i) scalar)

record MatrixProductAlgebraEquivalence
  {b a : Level}
  {Base : Set b}
  {A : Set a}
  {n : Nat}
  {D : Fin n → Set a}
  {d : Fin n → Nat}
  (base : CommutativeSemiring Base)
  (sourceRing : Ring A)
  (sourceAlgebra : Algebra base sourceRing)
  (division : (i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i))
  (targetAlgebras :
    (i : Fin n) →
    Algebra base (DivisionRing.ring (division i))) :
  Set (b ⊔ a) where

  field
    to : A → MatrixProduct D d
    from : MatrixProduct D d → A
    from-to :
      (x : A) → from (to x) ≡ x
    to-from :
      (Y : MatrixProduct D d) →
      (i : Fin n) →
      (row column : Fin (d i)) →
      to (from Y) i row column ≡ Y i row column
    map-zero :
      (i : Fin n) →
      (row column : Fin (d i)) →
      to (Ring.zero sourceRing) i row column ≡
      zeroMatrixProduct {d = d} division i row column
    map-one :
      (i : Fin n) →
      (row column : Fin (d i)) →
      to (Ring.one sourceRing) i row column ≡
      oneMatrixProduct {d = d} division i row column
    map-add :
      (x y : A) →
      (i : Fin n) →
      (row column : Fin (d i)) →
      to (Ring.add sourceRing x y) i row column ≡
      addMatrixProduct division (to x) (to y) i row column
    map-multiply :
      (x y : A) →
      (i : Fin n) →
      (row column : Fin (d i)) →
      to (Ring.multiply sourceRing x y) i row column ≡
      multiplyMatrixProduct division (to x) (to y) i row column
    map-scalar :
      (r : Base) →
      (i : Fin n) →
      (row column : Fin (d i)) →
      to (Algebra.scalar sourceAlgebra r) i row column ≡
      scalarMatrixProduct {d = d}
        base division targetAlgebras r i row column

artin-wedderburn-theorem :
  (b a : Level) →
  Set (lsuc (b ⊔ a))
artin-wedderburn-theorem b a =
  (Base : Set b) →
  (A : Set a) →
  (base : CommutativeSemiring Base) →
  (ring : Ring A) →
  (algebra : Algebra base ring) →
  IsSemisimpleRing ring →
  Σ Nat (λ n →
    Σ (Fin n → Set a) (λ D →
      Σ (Fin n → Nat) (λ d →
        Σ ((i : Fin n) → DivisionRing (D i)) (λ division →
          Σ ((i : Fin n) →
              Algebra base (DivisionRing.ring (division i)))
            (λ targetAlgebras →
              Σ ((i : Fin n) → Nonzero (d i)) (λ _ →
                MatrixProductAlgebraEquivalence
                  {n = n} {D = D} {d = d}
                  base ring algebra division targetAlgebras))))))

title: Q776578_artin_wedderburn_theorem
content:
(*
  Statement-only formalization of the Thousand Theorems corpus artifact
  Q776578, "Artin–Wedderburn theorem": every semisimple algebra is isomorphic
  to a finite product of nonzero-size matrix algebras over division algebras.
  This file contains no proof.
*)

open HolKernel Parse boolLib;
open arithmeticTheory listTheory pred_setTheory;

val q776578_comm_semiring_def = new_definition (
  "q776578_comm_semiring_def",
  ``q776578_comm_semiring
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) <=>
      (!a b. addK a b = addK b a) /\
      (!a b c. addK (addK a b) c = addK a (addK b c)) /\
      (!a. addK zeroK a = a) /\
      (!a b. mulK a b = mulK b a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK (mulK a b) c = mulK a (mulK b c)) /\
      (!a. mulK oneK a = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulK a (addK b c) = addK (mulK a b) (mulK a c)) /\
      (!a. mulK zeroK a = zeroK)``);

val q776578_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q776578_ring_def",
  ``q776578_ring
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (negR : 'r -> 'r)
      (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      (!a b. addR a b = addR b a) /\
      (!a b c. addR (addR a b) c = addR a (addR b c)) /\
      (!a. addR zeroR a = a) /\
      (!a. addR (negR a) a = zeroR) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (mulR a b) c = mulR a (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR oneR a = a /\ mulR a oneR = a) /\
      (!a b c. mulR a (addR b c) = addR (mulR a b) (mulR a c)) /\
      (!a b c. mulR (addR a b) c = addR (mulR a c) (mulR b c)) /\
      (!a. mulR zeroR a = zeroR /\ mulR a zeroR = zeroR)``);

val q776578_algebra_def = new_definition (
  "q776578_algebra_def",
  ``q776578_algebra
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (zeroR : 'r) (oneR : 'r)
      (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (algebraMap : 'k -> 'r) <=>
      algebraMap zeroK = zeroR /\
      algebraMap oneK = oneR /\
      (!a b. algebraMap (addK a b) = addR (algebraMap a) (algebraMap b)) /\
      (!a b. algebraMap (mulK a b) = mulR (algebraMap a) (algebraMap b)) /\
      (!a x. mulR (algebraMap a) x = mulR x (algebraMap a))``);

val q776578_left_ideal_def = new_definition (
  "q776578_left_ideal_def",
  ``q776578_left_ideal
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (I : 'r set) <=>
      zeroR IN I /\
      (!x y. x IN I /\ y IN I ==> addR x y IN I) /\
      (!x. x IN I ==> negR x IN I) /\
      (!a x. x IN I ==> mulR a x IN I)``);

val q776578_semisimple_ring_def = new_definition (
  "q776578_semisimple_ring_def",
  ``q776578_semisimple_ring
      (zeroR : 'r) (addR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r)
      (negR : 'r -> 'r) (mulR : 'r -> 'r -> 'r) <=>
      !I : 'r set.
        q776578_left_ideal zeroR addR negR mulR I ==>
        ?J : 'r set.
          q776578_left_ideal zeroR addR negR mulR J /\
          (!x. x IN I /\ x IN J <=> x = zeroR) /\
          (!x. ?y z. y IN I /\ z IN J /\ x = addR y z)``);

val q776578_division_algebra_def = new_definition (
  "q776578_division_algebra_def",
  ``q776578_division_algebra
      (zeroK : 'k) (oneK : 'k)
      (addK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k) (mulK : 'k -> 'k -> 'k)
      (D : 'd set) (zeroD : 'd) (oneD : 'd)
      (addD : 'd -> 'd -> 'd) (negD : 'd -> 'd)
      (mulD : 'd -> 'd -> 'd) (invD : 'd -> 'd)
      (scalarD : 'k -> 'd) <=>
      zeroD IN D /\ oneD IN D /\ zeroD <> oneD /\
      (!x y. x IN D /\ y IN D ==> addD x y IN D) /\
      (!x. x IN D ==> negD x IN D) /\
      (!x y. x IN D /\ y IN D ==> mulD x y IN D) /\
      (!x. x IN D ==> invD x IN D) /\
      (!x y. x IN D /\ y IN D ==> addD x y = addD y x) /\
      (!x y z.
        x IN D /\ y IN D /\ z IN D ==>
        addD (addD x y) z = addD x (addD y z)) /\
      (!x. x IN D ==> addD zeroD x = x) /\
      (!x. x IN D ==> addD (negD x) x = zeroD) /\
      (!x y z.
        x IN D /\ y IN D /\ z IN D ==>
        mulD (mulD x y) z = mulD x (mulD y z)) /\
      (!x. x IN D ==> mulD oneD x = x /\ mulD x oneD = x) /\
      (!x y z.
        x IN D /\ y IN D /\ z IN D ==>
        mulD x (addD y z) = addD (mulD x y) (mulD x z)) /\
      (!x y z.
        x IN D /\ y IN D /\ z IN D ==>
        mulD (addD x y) z = addD (mulD x z) (mulD y z)) /\
      (!x. x IN D ==> mulD zeroD x = zeroD /\ mulD x zeroD = zeroD) /\
      invD zeroD = zeroD /\
      (!x.
        x IN D /\ x <> zeroD ==>
        mulD (invD x) x = oneD /\ mulD x (invD x) = oneD) /\
      (!a. scalarD a IN D) /\
      scalarD zeroK = zeroD /\
      scalarD oneK = oneD /\
      (!a b. scalarD (addK a b) = addD (scalarD a) (scalarD b)) /\
      (!a b. scalarD (mulK a b) = mulD (scalarD a) (scalarD b)) /\
      (!a x.
        x IN D ==> mulD (scalarD a) x = mulD x (scalarD a))``);
